verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when Pharaoh shall call you, and shall say, What is your occupation?

verses.raw: That you shall say, Your servants’ trade has been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.
verses.text: That you shall say, Your servants’ trade has been about cattle from our youth even until now, both we, and also our fathers: that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination unto the Egyptians.

verses.raw: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.
verses.text: Then Joseph came and told Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brethren, and their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have, are come out of the land of Canaan; and, behold, they are in the land of Goshen.

verses.raw: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.
verses.text: And he took some of his brethren, even five men, and presented them unto Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Your servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto his brethren, What is your occupation? And they said unto Pharaoh, Your servants are shepherds, both we, and also our fathers.

verses.raw: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for your servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray you, let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.
verses.text: They said moreover unto Pharaoh, For to sojourn in the land are we come; for your servants have no pasture for their flocks; for the famine is sore in the land of Canaan: now therefore, we pray you, let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Your father and your brethren are come unto you:
verses.text: And Pharaoh spake unto Joseph, saying, Your father and your brethren are come unto you:

verses.raw: The land of Egypt is before you; in the best of the land make your father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if you know any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.
verses.text: The land of Egypt is before you; in the best of the land make your father and brethren to dwell; in the land of Goshen let them dwell: and if you know any men of activity among them, then make them rulers over my cattle.

verses.raw: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.
verses.text: And Joseph brought in Jacob his father, and set him before Pharaoh: and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old are you?
verses.text: And Pharaoh said unto Jacob, How old are you?

verses.raw: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.
verses.text: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

verses.raw: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.
verses.text: And Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from before Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.
verses.text: And Joseph placed his father and his brethren, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

verses.raw: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.
verses.text: And Joseph nourished his father, and his brethren, and all his father’s household, with bread, according to their families.

verses.raw: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.
verses.text: And there was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very sore, so that the land of Egypt and all the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

verses.raw: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.
verses.text: And Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the corn which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

verses.raw: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in your presence? for the money fails.
verses.text: And when money failed in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came unto Joseph, and said, Give us bread: for why should we die in your presence? for the money fails.

verses.raw: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.
verses.text: And Joseph said, Give your cattle; and I will give you for your cattle, if money fail.

verses.raw: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.
verses.text: And they brought their cattle unto Joseph: and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for horses, and for the flocks, and for the cattle of the herds, and for the asses: and he fed them with bread for all their cattle for that year.

verses.raw: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also has our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:
verses.text: When that year was ended, they came unto him the second year, and said unto him, We will not hide it from my lord, how that our money is spent; my lord also has our herds of cattle; there is not ought left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands:

verses.raw: Wherefore shall we die before your eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.
verses.text: Wherefore shall we die before your eyes, both we and our land? buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants unto Pharaoh: and give us seed, that we may live, and not die, that the land be not desolate.

verses.raw: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.
verses.text: And Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh; for the Egyptians sold every man his field, because the famine prevailed over them: so the land became Pharaoh’s.

verses.raw: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.
verses.text: And as for the people, he removed them to cities from one end of the borders of Egypt even to the other end thereof.

verses.raw: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.
verses.text: Only the land of the priests bought he not; for the priests had a portion assigned them of Pharaoh, and did eat their portion which Pharaoh gave them: wherefore they sold not their lands.

verses.raw: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.
verses.text: Then Joseph said unto the people, Behold, I have bought you this day and your land for Pharaoh: lo, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that you shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in the increase, that you shall give the fifth part unto Pharaoh, and four parts shall be your own, for seed of the field, and for your food, and for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.

verses.raw: And they said, You have saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.
verses.text: And they said, You have saved our lives: let us find grace in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.

verses.raw: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.
verses.text: And Joseph made it a law over the land of Egypt unto this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth part; except the land of the priests only, which became not Pharaoh’s.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.
verses.text: And Yashar'el dwelt in the land of Egypt, in the country of Goshen; and they had possessions therein, and grew, and multiplied exceedingly.

verses.raw: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.
verses.text: And Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years: so the whole age of Jacob was an hundred forty and seven years.

verses.raw: And the time drew nigh that Yashar'el (Israel) must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in your sight, put, I pray you, your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray you, in Egypt:
verses.text: And the time drew nigh that Yashar'el must die: and he called his son Joseph, and said unto him, If now I have found grace in your sight, put, I pray you, your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me; bury me not, I pray you, in Egypt:

verses.raw: But I will lie with my fathers, and you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as you have said.
verses.text: But I will lie with my fathers, and you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their buryingplace. And he said, I will do as you have said.

verses.raw: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Yashar'el (Israel) bowed himself upon the bed’s head.
verses.text: And he said, Swear unto me. And he sware unto him. And Yashar'el bowed himself upon the bed’s head.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, your father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.text: And it came to pass after these things, that one told Joseph, Behold, your father is sick: and he took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.raw: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, your son Joseph comes unto you: and Yashar'el (Israel) strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.
verses.text: And one told Jacob, and said, Behold, your son Joseph comes unto you: and Yashar'el strengthened himself, and sat upon the bed.

verses.raw: And Jacob said unto Joseph, El Shaddai (God Almighty) appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,
verses.text: And Jacob said unto Joseph, El Shaddai appeared unto me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

verses.raw: And said unto me, Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a multitude of people; and will give this land to your seed after you for an everlasting possession.
verses.text: And said unto me, Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a multitude of people; and will give this land to your seed after you for an everlasting possession.

verses.raw: And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto you in the land of Egypt before I came unto you into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.
verses.text: And now your two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, which were born unto you in the land of Egypt before I came unto you into Egypt, are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine.

verses.raw: And your issue, which you begettest after them, shall be yours, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.
verses.text: And your issue, which you begettest after them, shall be yours, and shall be called after the name of their brethren in their inheritance.

verses.raw: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth-lehem.
verses.text: And as for me, when I came from Padan, Rachel died by me in the land of Canaan in the way, when yet there was but a little way to come unto Ephrath: and I buried her there in the way of Ephrath; the same is Beth-lehem.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?
verses.text: And Yashar'el beheld Joseph’s sons, and said, Who are these?

verses.raw: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom Elohim (God) has given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray you, unto me, and I will bless them.
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his father, They are my sons, whom Elohim has given me in this place. And he said, Bring them, I pray you, unto me, and I will bless them.

verses.raw: Now the eyes of Yashar'el (Israel) were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.
verses.text: Now the eyes of Yashar'el were dim for age, so that he could not see. And he brought them near unto him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see your face: and, lo, Elohim (God) has shewed me also your seed.
verses.text: And Yashar'el said unto Joseph, I had not thought to see your face: and, lo, Elohim has shewed me also your seed.

verses.raw: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.
verses.text: And Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

verses.raw: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Yashar'el's (Israel’s) left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Yashar'el's (Israel’s) right hand, and brought them near unto him.
verses.text: And Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Yashar'el's (Israel’s) left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Yashar'el's (Israel’s) right hand, and brought them near unto him.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.
verses.text: And Yashar'el stretched out his right hand, and laid it upon Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand upon Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands wittingly; for Manasseh was the firstborn.

verses.raw: And he blessed Joseph, and said, Elohim (God), before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the Elohim (God) which fed me all my life long unto this day,
verses.text: And he blessed Joseph, and said, Elohim, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the Elohim which fed me all my life long unto this day,

verses.raw: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
verses.text: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads; and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac; and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.

verses.raw: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.
verses.text: And when Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, it displeased him: and he held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head unto Manasseh’s head.

verses.raw: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put your right hand upon his head.
verses.text: And Joseph said unto his father, Not so, my father: for this is the firstborn; put your right hand upon his head.

verses.raw: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.
verses.text: And his father refused, and said, I know it, my son, I know it: he also shall become a people, and he also shall be great: but truly his younger brother shall be greater than he, and his seed shall become a multitude of nations.

verses.raw: And he blessed them that day, saying, In you shall Yashar'el (Israel) bless, saying, Elohim (God) make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.
verses.text: And he blessed them that day, saying, In you shall Yashar'el bless, saying, Elohim make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but Elohim (God) shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.
verses.text: And Yashar'el said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but Elohim shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

verses.raw: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.
verses.text: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.

verses.raw: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.
verses.text: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

verses.raw: Gather yourselves together, and hear, you sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Yashar'el (Israel) your father.
verses.text: Gather yourselves together, and hear, you sons of Jacob; and hearken unto Yashar'el your father.

verses.raw: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:
verses.text: Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

verses.raw: Unstable as water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed; then defiledst you it: he went up to my couch.
verses.text: Unstable as water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed; then defiledst you it: he went up to my couch.

verses.raw: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.
verses.text: Simeon and Levi are brethren; instruments of cruelty are in their habitations.

verses.raw: O my soul, come not you into their secret; unto their assembly, my honour, be not you united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.
verses.text: O my soul, come not you into their secret; unto their assembly, my honour, be not you united: for in their anger they slew a man, and in their selfwill they digged down a wall.

verses.raw: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah), you are he whom your brethren shall praise: your hand shall be in the neck of your enemies; your father’s children shall bow down before you.
verses.text: Yahudah, you are he whom your brethren shall praise: your hand shall be in the neck of your enemies; your father’s children shall bow down before you.

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah) is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, you are gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verses.text: Yahudah is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, you are gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

verses.raw: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.
verses.text: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah, nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

verses.raw: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:
verses.text: Binding his foal unto the vine, and his ass’s colt unto the choice vine; he washed his garments in wine, and his clothes in the blood of grapes:

verses.raw: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
verses.text: His eyes shall be red with wine, and his teeth white with milk.

verses.raw: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.
verses.text: Zebulun shall dwell at the haven of the sea; and he shall be for an haven of ships; and his border shall be unto Zidon.

verses.raw: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:
verses.text: Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens:

verses.raw: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.
verses.text: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant; and bowed his shoulder to bear, and became a servant unto tribute.

verses.raw: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that bites the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.
verses.text: Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that bites the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward.

verses.raw: I have waited for your salvation, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I have waited for your salvation, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.
verses.text: Gad, a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last.

verses.raw: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.
verses.text: Out of Asher his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield royal dainties.

verses.raw: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he gives goodly words.
verses.text: Naphtali is a hind let loose: he gives goodly words.

verses.raw: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:
verses.text: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

verses.raw: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:
verses.text: The archers have sorely grieved him, and shot at him, and hated him:

verses.raw: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Yashar'el (Israel):)
verses.text: But his bow abode in strength, and the arms of his hands were made strong by the hands of El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob; (from thence is the shepherd, the stone of Yashar'el:)

verses.raw: Even by the Elohim (God) of your father, who shall help you; and by the Almighty, who shall bless you with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:
verses.text: Even by the Elohim of your father, who shall help you; and by the Almighty, who shall bless you with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies under, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb:

verses.raw: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.
verses.text: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my progenitors unto the utmost bound of the everlasting hills: they shall be on the head of Joseph, and on the crown of the head of him that was separate from his brethren.

verses.raw: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.
verses.text: Benjamin shall ravin as a wolf: in the morning he shall devour the prey, and at night he shall divide the spoil.

verses.raw: All these are the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel): and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.
verses.text: All these are the twelve tribes of Yashar'el: and this is it that their father spake unto them, and blessed them; every one according to his blessing he blessed them.

verses.raw: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
verses.text: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

verses.raw: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.
verses.text: In the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field of Ephron the Hittite for a possession of a buryingplace.

verses.raw: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.
verses.text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

verses.raw: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.
verses.text: The purchase of the field and of the cave that is therein was from the children of Heth.

verses.raw: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.
verses.text: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

verses.raw: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.
verses.text: And Joseph fell upon his father’s face, and wept upon him, and kissed him.

verses.raw: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Joseph commanded his servants the physicians to embalm his father: and the physicians embalmed Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.
verses.text: And forty days were fulfilled for him; for so are fulfilled the days of those which are embalmed: and the Egyptians mourned for him threescore and ten days.

verses.raw: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,
verses.text: And when the days of his mourning were past, Joseph spake unto the house of Pharaoh, saying, If now I have found grace in your eyes, speak, I pray you, in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

verses.raw: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shall you bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray you, and bury my father, and I will come again.
verses.text: My father made me swear, saying, Lo, I die: in my grave which I have digged for me in the land of Canaan, there shall you bury me. Now therefore let me go up, I pray you, and bury my father, and I will come again.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said, Go up, and bury your father, according as he made you swear.

verses.raw: And you shall shew your son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which Yahuah (LORD) did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.
verses.text: And you shall shew your son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which Yahuah did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

verses.raw: And it shall be for a sign unto you upon your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD’S law may be in your mouth: for with a strong hand has Yahuah (LORD) brought you out of Egypt.
verses.text: And it shall be for a sign unto you upon your hand, and for a memorial between your eyes, that the LORD’S law may be in your mouth: for with a strong hand has Yahuah brought you out of Egypt.

verses.raw: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.
verses.text: You shall therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

verses.raw: And it shall be when Yahuah (LORD) shall bring you into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto you and to your fathers, and shall give it you,
verses.text: And it shall be when Yahuah shall bring you into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto you and to your fathers, and shall give it you,

verses.raw: That you shall set apart unto Yahuah (LORD) all that opens the matrix, and every firstling that comes of a beast which you have; the males shall be the LORD’S.
verses.text: That you shall set apart unto Yahuah all that opens the matrix, and every firstling that comes of a beast which you have; the males shall be the LORD’S.

verses.raw: And every firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among your children shall you redeem.
verses.text: And every firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb; and if you will not redeem it, then you shall break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among your children shall you redeem.

verses.raw: And it shall be when your son asks you in time to come, saying, What is this? that you shall say unto him, By strength of hand Yahuah (LORD) brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:
verses.text: And it shall be when your son asks you in time to come, saying, What is this? that you shall say unto him, By strength of hand Yahuah brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that Yahuah (LORD) slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to Yahuah (LORD) all that opens the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that Yahuah slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to Yahuah all that opens the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

verses.raw: And it shall be for a token upon your hand, and for frontlets between your eyes: for by strength of hand Yahuah (LORD) brought us forth out of Egypt.
verses.text: And it shall be for a token upon your hand, and for frontlets between your eyes: for by strength of hand Yahuah brought us forth out of Egypt.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that Elohim (God) led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for Elohim (God) said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that Elohim led them not through the way of the land of the Philistines, although that was near; for Elohim said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: But Elohim led the people about, through the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Yashar'el went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you; and you shall carry up my bones away hence with you.
verses.text: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Yashar'el, saying, Elohim will surely visit you; and you shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

verses.raw: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.text: And they took their journey from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verses.text: And Yahuah went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

verses.raw: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.
verses.text: He took not away the pillar of the cloud by day, nor the pillar of fire by night, from before the people.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall you encamp by the sea.
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, that they turn and encamp before Pi-hahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baal-zephon: before it shall you encamp by the sea.

verses.raw: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), They are entangled in the land, the wilderness has shut them in.
verses.text: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Yashar'el, They are entangled in the land, the wilderness has shut them in.

verses.raw: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am Yahuah (LORD). And they did so.
verses.text: And I will harden Pharaoh’s heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I am Yahuah. And they did so.

verses.raw: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Yashar'el (Israel) go from serving us?
verses.text: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Yashar'el go from serving us?

verses.raw: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:
verses.text: And he made ready his chariot, and took his people with him:

verses.raw: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.
verses.text: And he took six hundred chosen chariots, and all the chariots of Egypt, and captains over every one of them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went out with an high hand.
verses.text: And Yahuah hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Yashar'el: and the children of Yashar'el went out with an high hand.

verses.raw: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.
verses.text: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses and chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pi-hahiroth, before Baal-zephon.

verses.raw: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried out unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Yashar'el lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Yashar'el cried out unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore have you dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?
verses.text: And they said unto Moses, Because there were no graves in Egypt, have you taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore have you dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

verses.raw: Is not this the word that we did tell you in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.
verses.text: Is not this the word that we did tell you in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For it had been better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto the people, Fear you not, stand still, and see the salvation of Yahuah (LORD), which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom you have seen to day, you shall see them again no more for ever.
verses.text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear you not, stand still, and see the salvation of Yahuah, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom you have seen to day, you shall see them again no more for ever.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall fight for you, and you shall hold your peace.
verses.text: Yahuah shall fight for you, and you shall hold your peace.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Wherefore cry you unto me? speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they go forward:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Wherefore cry you unto me? speak unto the children of Yashar'el, that they go forward:

verses.raw: But lift you up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.
verses.text: But lift you up your rod, and stretch out your hand over the sea, and divide it: and the children of Yashar'el shall go on dry ground through the midst of the sea.

verses.raw: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.text: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

verses.raw: And the Egyptians shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD), when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
verses.text: And the Egyptians shall know that I am Yahuah, when I have gotten me honour upon Pharaoh, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.

verses.raw: And the angel of Elohim (God), which went before the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:
verses.text: And the angel of Elohim, which went before the camp of Yashar'el, removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

verses.raw: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Yashar'el (Israel); and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.
verses.text: And it came between the camp of the Egyptians and the camp of Yashar'el; and it was a cloud and darkness to them, but it gave light by night to these: so that the one came not near the other all the night.

verses.raw: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah (LORD) caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.
verses.text: And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

verses.raw: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.text: And the Egyptians pursued, and went in after them to the midst of the sea, even all Pharaoh’s horses, his chariots, and his horsemen.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch Yahuah (LORD) looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,
verses.text: And it came to pass, that in the morning watch Yahuah looked unto the host of the Egyptians through the pillar of fire and of the cloud, and troubled the host of the Egyptians,

verses.raw: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Yashar'el (Israel); for Yahuah (LORD) fighteth for them against the Egyptians.
verses.text: And took off their chariot wheels, that they drave them heavily: so that the Egyptians said, Let us flee from the face of Yashar'el; for Yahuah fighteth for them against the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Stretch out your hand over the sea, that the waters may come again upon the Egyptians, upon their chariots, and upon their horsemen.

verses.raw: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and Yahuah (LORD) overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.
verses.text: And Moses stretched forth his hand over the sea, and the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared; and the Egyptians fled against it; and Yahuah overthrew the Egyptians in the midst of the sea.

verses.raw: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.
verses.text: And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.

verses.raw: But the children of Yashar'el (Israel) walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verses.text: But the children of Yashar'el walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.

verses.raw: Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Yashar'el (Israel) that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el (Israel) saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.
verses.text: Thus Yahuah saved Yashar'el that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) saw that great work which Yahuah (LORD) did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared Yahuah (LORD), and believed Yahuah (LORD), and his servant Moses.
verses.text: And Yashar'el saw that great work which Yahuah did upon the Egyptians: and the people feared Yahuah, and believed Yahuah, and his servant Moses.

verses.raw: Then sang Moses and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) this song unto Yahuah (LORD), and spake, saying, I will sing unto Yahuah (LORD), for he has triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider has he thrown into the sea.
verses.text: Then sang Moses and the children of Yashar'el this song unto Yahuah, and spake, saying, I will sing unto Yahuah, for he has triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider has he thrown into the sea.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my Elohim (God), and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s Elohim (God), and I will exalt him.
verses.text: Yahuah is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my Elohim, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s Elohim, and I will exalt him.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is a man of war: Yahuah (LORD) is his name.
verses.text: Yahuah is a man of war: Yahuah is his name.

verses.raw: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host has he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
verses.text: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host has he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.

verses.raw: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
verses.text: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.

verses.raw: Your right hand, O Yahuah (LORD), is become glorious in power: your right hand, O Yahuah (LORD), has dashed in pieces the enemy.
verses.text: Your right hand, O Yahuah, is become glorious in power: your right hand, O Yahuah, has dashed in pieces the enemy.

verses.raw: And in the greatness of your excellency you have overthrown them that rose up against you: you sentest forth your wrath, which consumed them as stubble.
verses.text: And in the greatness of your excellency you have overthrown them that rose up against you: you sentest forth your wrath, which consumed them as stubble.

verses.raw: And with the blast of your nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.text: And with the blast of your nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, and the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.

verses.raw: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
verses.text: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.

verses.raw: You did blow with your wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
verses.text: You did blow with your wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

verses.raw: Who is like unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), among the gods? who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.text: Who is like unto you, O Yahuah, among the gods? who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?

verses.raw: You stretchedst out your right hand, the earth swallowed them.
verses.text: You stretchedst out your right hand, the earth swallowed them.

verses.raw: You in your mercy have led forth the people which you have redeemed: you have guided them in your strength unto your holy habitation.
verses.text: You in your mercy have led forth the people which you have redeemed: you have guided them in your strength unto your holy habitation.

verses.raw: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
verses.text: The people shall hear, and be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.

verses.raw: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
verses.text: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.

verses.raw: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of your arm they shall be as still as a stone; till your people pass over, O Yahuah (LORD), till the people pass over, which you have purchased.
verses.text: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of your arm they shall be as still as a stone; till your people pass over, O Yahuah, till the people pass over, which you have purchased.

verses.raw: You shall bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, in the place, O Yahuah (LORD), which you have made for you to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Adonai (Lord), which your hands have established.
verses.text: You shall bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, in the place, O Yahuah, which you have made for you to dwell in, in the Sanctuary, O Adonai, which your hands have established.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.text: Yahuah shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.raw: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahuah (LORD) brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went on dry land in the midst of the sea.
verses.text: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahuah brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Yashar'el went on dry land in the midst of the sea.

verses.raw: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
verses.text: And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.

verses.raw: And Miriam answered them, Sing you to Yahuah (LORD), for he has triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider has he thrown into the sea.
verses.text: And Miriam answered them, Sing you to Yahuah, for he has triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider has he thrown into the sea.

verses.raw: So Moses brought Yashar'el (Israel) from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.text: So Moses brought Yashar'el from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.

verses.raw: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
verses.text: And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they were bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.

verses.raw: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
verses.text: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?

verses.raw: And he cried unto Yahuah (LORD); and Yahuah (LORD) shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
verses.text: And he cried unto Yahuah; and Yahuah shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,

verses.raw: And said, If you will diligently hearken to the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and will do that which is right in his sight, and will give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon you, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am Yahuah Rapha (the LORD that healeth thee).
verses.text: And said, If you will diligently hearken to the voice of Yahuah Elohayka, and will do that which is right in his sight, and will give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon you, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am Yahuah Rapha.

verses.raw: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
verses.text: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

verses.raw: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And they took their journey from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el came unto the wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departing out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:
verses.text: And the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el murmured against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness:

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto them, Would to Elohim (God) we had died by the hand of Yahuah (LORD) in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for you have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el said unto them, Would to Elohim we had died by the hand of Yahuah in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the flesh pots, and when we did eat bread to the full; for you have brought us forth into this wilderness, to kill this whole assembly with hunger.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.
verses.text: Then said Yahuah unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that on the sixth day they shall prepare that which they bring in; and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily.

verses.raw: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), At even, then you shall know that Yahuah (LORD) has brought you out from the land of Egypt:
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron said unto all the children of Yashar'el, At even, then you shall know that Yahuah has brought you out from the land of Egypt:

verses.raw: And in the morning, then you shall see the glory of Yahuah (LORD); for that he hears your murmurings against Yahuah (LORD): and what are we, that you murmur against us?
verses.text: And in the morning, then you shall see the glory of Yahuah; for that he hears your murmurings against Yahuah: and what are we, that you murmur against us?

verses.raw: And Moses said, This shall be, when Yahuah (LORD) shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that Yahuah (LORD) hears your murmurings which you murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Moses said, This shall be, when Yahuah shall give you in the evening flesh to eat, and in the morning bread to the full; for that Yahuah hears your murmurings which you murmur against him: and what are we? your murmurings are not against us, but against Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Come near before Yahuah (LORD): for he has heard your murmurings.
verses.text: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el, Come near before Yahuah: for he has heard your murmurings.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared in the cloud.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as Aaron spake unto the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el, that they looked toward the wilderness, and, behold, the glory of Yahuah appeared in the cloud.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): speak unto them, saying, At even you shall eat flesh, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread; and you shall know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: I have heard the murmurings of the children of Yashar'el: speak unto them, saying, At even you shall eat flesh, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread; and you shall know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that at even the quails came up, and covered the camp: and in the morning the dew lay round about the host.

verses.raw: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.
verses.text: And when the dew that lay was gone up, behold, upon the face of the wilderness there lay a small round thing, as small as the hoar frost on the ground.

verses.raw: And when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which Yahuah (LORD) has given you to eat.
verses.text: And when the children of Yashar'el saw it, they said one to another, It is manna: for they wist not what it was. And Moses said unto them, This is the bread which Yahuah has given you to eat.

verses.raw: This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take you every man for them which are in his tents.
verses.text: This is the thing which Yahuah has commanded, Gather of it every man according to his eating, an omer for every man, according to the number of your persons; take you every man for them which are in his tents.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did so, and gathered, some more, some less.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did so, and gathered, some more, some less.

verses.raw: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.
verses.text: And when they did mete it with an omer, he that gathered much had nothing over, and he that gathered little had no lack; they gathered every man according to his eating.

verses.raw: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.
verses.text: And Moses said, Let no man leave of it till the morning.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.
verses.text: Notwithstanding they hearkened not unto Moses; but some of them left of it until the morning, and it bred worms, and stank: and Moses was wroth with them.

verses.raw: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.
verses.text: And they gathered it every morning, every man according to his eating: and when the sun waxed hot, it melted.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that on the sixth day they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for one man: and all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, This is that which Yahuah (LORD) has said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto Yahuah (LORD): bake that which you will bake to day, and seethe that you will seethe; and that which remains over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.
verses.text: And he said unto them, This is that which Yahuah has said, To morrow is the rest of the holy sabbath unto Yahuah: bake that which you will bake to day, and seethe that you will seethe; and that which remains over lay up for you to be kept until the morning.

verses.raw: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.
verses.text: And they laid it up till the morning, as Moses bade: and it did not stink, neither was there any worm therein.

verses.raw: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto Yahuah (LORD): to day you shall not find it in the field.
verses.text: And Moses said, Eat that to day; for to day is a sabbath unto Yahuah: to day you shall not find it in the field.

verses.raw: Six days you shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.
verses.text: Six days you shall gather it; but on the seventh day, which is the sabbath, in it there shall be none.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that there went out some of the people on the seventh day for to gather, and they found none.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, How long refuse you to keep my commandments and my laws?
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, How long refuse you to keep my commandments and my laws?

verses.raw: See, for that Yahuah (LORD) has given you the sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide you every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.
verses.text: See, for that Yahuah has given you the sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days; abide you every man in his place, let no man go out of his place on the seventh day.

verses.raw: So the people rested on the seventh day.
verses.text: So the people rested on the seventh day.

verses.raw: And the house of Yashar'el (Israel) called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
verses.text: And the house of Yashar'el called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

verses.raw: And Moses said, This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) commands, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Moses said, This is the thing which Yahuah commands, Fill an omer of it to be kept for your generations; that they may see the bread wherewith I have fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you forth from the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before Yahuah (LORD), to be kept for your generations.
verses.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a pot, and put an omer full of manna therein, and lay it up before Yahuah, to be kept for your generations.

verses.raw: As Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.
verses.text: As Yahuah commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did eat manna forty years, until they came to a land inhabited; they did eat manna, until they came unto the borders of the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.
verses.text: Now an omer is the tenth part of an ephah.

verses.raw: And all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.
verses.text: And all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el journeyed from the wilderness of Sin, after their journeys, according to the commandment of Yahuah, and pitched in Rephidim: and there was no water for the people to drink.

verses.raw: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide you with me? wherefore do you tempt Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: Wherefore the people did chide with Moses, and said, Give us water that we may drink. And Moses said unto them, Why chide you with me? wherefore do you tempt Yahuah?

verses.raw: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that you have brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?
verses.text: And the people thirsted there for water; and the people murmured against Moses, and said, Wherefore is this that you have brought us up out of Egypt, to kill us and our children and our cattle with thirst?

verses.raw: And Moses cried unto Yahuah (LORD), saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.
verses.text: And Moses cried unto Yahuah, saying, What shall I do unto this people? they be almost ready to stone me.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with you of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel); and your rod, wherewith you struck the river, take in your hand, and go.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Go on before the people, and take with you of the elders of Yashar'el; and your rod, wherewith you struck the river, take in your hand, and go.

verses.raw: Behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb; and you shall smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Behold, I will stand before you there upon the rock in Horeb; and you shall smite the rock, and there shall come water out of it, that the people may drink. And Moses did so in the sight of the elders of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and because they tempted Yahuah (LORD), saying, Is Yahuah (LORD) among us, or not?
verses.text: And he called the name of the place Massah, and Meribah, because of the chiding of the children of Yashar'el, and because they tempted Yahuah, saying, Is Yahuah among us, or not?

verses.raw: Then came Amalek, and fought with Yashar'el (Israel) in Rephidim.
verses.text: Then came Amalek, and fought with Yashar'el in Rephidim.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of Elohim (God) in my hand.
verses.text: And Moses said unto Joshua, Choose us out men, and go out, fight with Amalek: to morrow I will stand on the top of the hill with the rod of Elohim in my hand.

verses.raw: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
verses.text: So Joshua did as Moses had said to him, and fought with Amalek: and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Yashar'el (Israel) prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Moses held up his hand, that Yashar'el prevailed: and when he let down his hand, Amalek prevailed.

verses.raw: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.
verses.text: But Moses’ hands were heavy; and they took a stone, and put it under him, and he sat thereon; and Aaron and Hur stayed up his hands, the one on the one side, and the other on the other side; and his hands were steady until the going down of the sun.

verses.raw: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And Joshua discomfited Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: for I will utterly put out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

verses.raw: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Yahuah Nissi (Jehovah-nissi):
verses.text: And Moses built an altar, and called the name of it Yahuah Nissi:

verses.raw: For he said, Because Yahuah (LORD) has sworn that Yahuah (LORD) will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.
verses.text: For he said, Because Yahuah has sworn that Yahuah will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.

verses.raw: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that Elohim (God) had done for Moses, and for Yashar'el (Israel) his people, and that Yahuah (LORD) had brought Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt;
verses.text: When Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father in law, heard of all that Elohim had done for Moses, and for Yashar'el his people, and that Yahuah had brought Yashar'el out of Egypt;

verses.raw: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,
verses.text: Then Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her back,

verses.raw: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
verses.text: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:

verses.raw: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the Elohim (God) of my father, said he, was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:
verses.text: And the name of the other was Eliezer; for the Elohim of my father, said he, was my help, and delivered me from the sword of Pharaoh:

verses.raw: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of Elohim (God):
verses.text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, came with his sons and his wife unto Moses into the wilderness, where he encamped at the mount of Elohim:

verses.raw: And he said unto Moses, I your father in law Jethro am come unto you, and your wife, and her two sons with her.
verses.text: And he said unto Moses, I your father in law Jethro am come unto you, and your wife, and her two sons with her.

verses.raw: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.
verses.text: And Moses went out to meet his father in law, and did obeisance, and kissed him; and they asked each other of their welfare; and they came into the tent.

verses.raw: And Moses told his father in law all that Yahuah (LORD) had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Yashar'el's (Israel’s) sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how Yahuah (LORD) delivered them.
verses.text: And Moses told his father in law all that Yahuah had done unto Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Yashar'el's (Israel’s) sake, and all the travail that had come upon them by the way, and how Yahuah delivered them.

verses.raw: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahuah (LORD) had done to Yashar'el (Israel), whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.text: And Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which Yahuah had done to Yashar'el, whom he had delivered out of the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And Jethro said, Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.
verses.text: And Jethro said, Blessed be Yahuah, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh, who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

verses.raw: Now I know that Yahuah (LORD) is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.
verses.text: Now I know that Yahuah is greater than all gods: for in the thing wherein they dealt proudly he was above them.

verses.raw: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for Elohim (God): and Aaron came, and all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Jethro, Moses’ father in law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for Elohim: and Aaron came, and all the elders of Yashar'el, to eat bread with Moses’ father in law before Elohim.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses sat to judge the people: and the people stood by Moses from the morning unto the evening.

verses.raw: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that you do to the people? why sit you thyself alone, and all the people stand by you from morning unto even?
verses.text: And when Moses’ father in law saw all that he did to the people, he said, What is this thing that you do to the people? why sit you thyself alone, and all the people stand by you from morning unto even?

verses.raw: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of Elohim (God):
verses.text: And Moses said unto his father in law, Because the people come unto me to enquire of Elohim:

verses.raw: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of Elohim (God), and his laws.
verses.text: When they have a matter, they come unto me; and I judge between one and another, and I do make them know the statutes of Elohim, and his laws.

verses.raw: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that you do is not good.
verses.text: And Moses’ father in law said unto him, The thing that you do is not good.

verses.raw: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you: for this thing is too heavy for you; you are not able to perform it thyself alone.
verses.text: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you: for this thing is too heavy for you; you are not able to perform it thyself alone.

verses.raw: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give you counsel, and Elohim (God) shall be with you: Be you for the people to Elohim (God)-ward, that you may bring the causes unto Elohim (God):
verses.text: Hearken now unto my voice, I will give you counsel, and Elohim shall be with you: Be you for the people to Elohim-ward, that you may bring the causes unto Elohim:

verses.raw: And you shall teach them ordinances and laws, and shall shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.
verses.text: And you shall teach them ordinances and laws, and shall shew them the way wherein they must walk, and the work that they must do.

verses.raw: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men, such as fear Elohim (God), men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:
verses.text: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men, such as fear Elohim, men of truth, hating covetousness; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, and rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens:

verses.raw: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto you, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with you.
verses.text: And let them judge the people at all seasons: and it shall be, that every great matter they shall bring unto you, but every small matter they shall judge: so shall it be easier for thyself, and they shall bear the burden with you.

verses.raw: If you shall do this thing, and Elohim (God) command you so, then you shall be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.
verses.text: If you shall do this thing, and Elohim command you so, then you shall be able to endure, and all this people shall also go to their place in peace.

verses.raw: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.
verses.text: So Moses hearkened to the voice of his father in law, and did all that he had said.

verses.raw: And Moses chose able men out of all Yashar'el (Israel), and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
verses.text: And Moses chose able men out of all Yashar'el, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.
