verses.raw: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.
verses.text: And they judged the people at all seasons: the hard causes they brought unto Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

verses.raw: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.
verses.text: And Moses let his father in law depart; and he went his way into his own land.

verses.raw: In the third month, when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.text: In the third month, when the children of Yashar'el were gone forth out of the land of Egypt, the same day came they into the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.raw: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Yashar'el (Israel) camped before the mount.
verses.text: For they were departed from Rephidim, and were come to the desert of Sinai, and had pitched in the wilderness; and there Yashar'el camped before the mount.

verses.raw: And Moses went up unto Elohim (God), and Yahuah (LORD) called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shall you say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: And Moses went up unto Elohim, and Yahuah called unto him out of the mountain, saying, Thus shall you say to the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: You have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.
verses.text: You have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles’ wings, and brought you unto myself.

verses.raw: Now therefore, if you will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then you shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:
verses.text: Now therefore, if you will obey my voice indeed, and keep my covenant, then you shall be a peculiar treasure unto me above all people: for all the earth is mine:

verses.raw: And you shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And you shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. These are the words which you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which Yahuah (LORD) commanded him.
verses.text: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and laid before their faces all these words which Yahuah commanded him.

verses.raw: And all the people answered together, and said, All that Yahuah (LORD) has spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And all the people answered together, and said, All that Yahuah has spoken we will do. And Moses returned the words of the people unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and believe you for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Lo, I come unto you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and believe you for ever. And Moses told the words of the people unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,

verses.raw: And be ready against the third day: for the third day Yahuah (LORD) will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.
verses.text: And be ready against the third day: for the third day Yahuah will come down in the sight of all the people upon mount Sinai.

verses.raw: And you shall set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that you go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever touches the mount shall be surely put to death:
verses.text: And you shall set bounds unto the people round about, saying, Take heed to yourselves, that you go not up into the mount, or touch the border of it: whosoever touches the mount shall be surely put to death:

verses.raw: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.
verses.text: There shall not an hand touch it, but he shall surely be stoned, or shot through; whether it be beast or man, it shall not live: when the trumpet soundeth long, they shall come up to the mount.

verses.raw: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.
verses.text: And Moses went down from the mount unto the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

verses.raw: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.
verses.text: And he said unto the people, Be ready against the third day: come not at your wives.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the third day in the morning, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud upon the mount, and the voice of the trumpet exceeding loud; so that all the people that was in the camp trembled.

verses.raw: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with Elohim (God); and they stood at the nether part of the mount.
verses.text: And Moses brought forth the people out of the camp to meet with Elohim; and they stood at the nether part of the mount.

verses.raw: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.
verses.text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

verses.raw: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and Elohim (God) answered him by a voice.
verses.text: And when the voice of the trumpet sounded long, and waxed louder and louder, Moses spake, and Elohim answered him by a voice.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and Yahuah (LORD) called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.
verses.text: And Yahuah came down upon mount Sinai, on the top of the mount: and Yahuah called Moses up to the top of the mount; and Moses went up.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto Yahuah (LORD) to gaze, and many of them perish.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Go down, charge the people, lest they break through unto Yahuah to gaze, and many of them perish.

verses.raw: And let the priests also, which come near to Yahuah (LORD), sanctify themselves, lest Yahuah (LORD) break forth upon them.
verses.text: And let the priests also, which come near to Yahuah, sanctify themselves, lest Yahuah break forth upon them.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for you chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.
verses.text: And Moses said unto Yahuah, The people cannot come up to mount Sinai: for you chargedst us, saying, Set bounds about the mount, and sanctify it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Away, get you down, and you shall come up, you, and Aaron with you: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto Yahuah (LORD), lest he break forth upon them.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto him, Away, get you down, and you shall come up, you, and Aaron with you: but let not the priests and the people break through to come up unto Yahuah, lest he break forth upon them.

verses.raw: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.
verses.text: So Moses went down unto the people, and spake unto them.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) spake all these words, saying,
verses.text: And Elohim spake all these words, saying,

verses.raw: I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which have brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
verses.text: I am Yahuah Elohayka, which have brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

verses.raw: You shall have no other gods before me.
verses.text: You shall have no other gods before me.

verses.raw: You shall not make unto you any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:
verses.text: You shall not make unto you any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

verses.raw: You shall not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) am a jealous Elohim (God), visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;
verses.text: You shall not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I Yahuah Elohayka am a jealous Elohim, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me;

verses.raw: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.
verses.text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

verses.raw: You shall not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in vain; for Yahuah (LORD) will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.
verses.text: You shall not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka in vain; for Yahuah will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.

verses.raw: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
verses.text: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.

verses.raw: Six days shall you labour, and do all your work:
verses.text: Six days shall you labour, and do all your work:

verses.raw: But the seventh day is the sabbath of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): in it you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger that is within your gates:
verses.text: But the seventh day is the sabbath of Yahuah Elohayka: in it you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your cattle, nor your stranger that is within your gates:

verses.raw: For in six days Yahuah (LORD) made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore Yahuah (LORD) blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.
verses.text: For in six days Yahuah made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore Yahuah blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

verses.raw: Honour your father and your mother: that your days may be long upon the land which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you.
verses.text: Honour your father and your mother: that your days may be long upon the land which Yahuah Elohayka gives you.

verses.raw: You shall not kill.
verses.text: You shall not kill.

verses.raw: You shall not commit adultery.
verses.text: You shall not commit adultery.

verses.raw: You shall not steal.
verses.text: You shall not steal.

verses.raw: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbour.
verses.text: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbour.

verses.raw: You shall not covet your neighbour’s house, you shall not covet your neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is your neighbour’s.
verses.text: You shall not covet your neighbour’s house, you shall not covet your neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is your neighbour’s.

verses.raw: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.
verses.text: And all the people saw the thunderings, and the lightnings, and the noise of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking: and when the people saw it, they removed, and stood afar off.

verses.raw: And they said unto Moses, Speak you with us, and we will hear: but let not Elohim (God) speak with us, lest we die.
verses.text: And they said unto Moses, Speak you with us, and we will hear: but let not Elohim speak with us, lest we die.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for Elohim (God) is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that you sin not.
verses.text: And Moses said unto the people, Fear not: for Elohim is come to prove you, and that his fear may be before your faces, that you sin not.

verses.raw: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where Elohim (God) was.
verses.text: And the people stood afar off, and Moses drew near unto the thick darkness where Elohim was.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Thus you shall say unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), You have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Thus you shall say unto the children of Yashar'el, You have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

verses.raw: You shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall you make unto you gods of gold.
verses.text: You shall not make with me gods of silver, neither shall you make unto you gods of gold.

verses.raw: An altar of earth you shall make unto me, and shall sacrifice thereon your burnt offerings, and your peace offerings, your sheep, and your oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto you, and I will bless you.
verses.text: An altar of earth you shall make unto me, and shall sacrifice thereon your burnt offerings, and your peace offerings, your sheep, and your oxen: in all places where I record my name I will come unto you, and I will bless you.

verses.raw: And if you will make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stone: for if you lift up your tool upon it, you have polluted it.
verses.text: And if you will make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of hewn stone: for if you lift up your tool upon it, you have polluted it.

verses.raw: Neither shall you go up by steps unto my altar, that your nakedness be not discovered thereon.
verses.text: Neither shall you go up by steps unto my altar, that your nakedness be not discovered thereon.

verses.raw: Now these are the judgments which you shall set before them.
verses.text: Now these are the judgments which you shall set before them.

verses.raw: If you buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.
verses.text: If you buy an Hebrew servant, six years he shall serve: and in the seventh he shall go out free for nothing.

verses.raw: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.
verses.text: If he came in by himself, he shall go out by himself: if he were married, then his wife shall go out with him.

verses.raw: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.
verses.text: If his master have given him a wife, and she have born him sons or daughters; the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

verses.raw: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:
verses.text: And if the servant shall plainly say, I love my master, my wife, and my children; I will not go out free:

verses.raw: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.
verses.text: Then his master shall bring him unto the judges; he shall also bring him to the door, or unto the door post; and his master shall bore his ear through with an aul; and he shall serve him for ever.

verses.raw: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.
verses.text: And if a man sell his daughter to be a maidservant, she shall not go out as the menservants do.

verses.raw: If she please not her master, who has betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he has dealt deceitfully with her.
verses.text: If she please not her master, who has betrothed her to himself, then shall he let her be redeemed: to sell her unto a strange nation he shall have no power, seeing he has dealt deceitfully with her.

verses.raw: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.
verses.text: And if he have betrothed her unto his son, he shall deal with her after the manner of daughters.

verses.raw: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.
verses.text: If he take him another wife; her food, her raiment, and her duty of marriage, shall he not diminish.

verses.raw: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.
verses.text: And if he do not these three unto her, then shall she go out free without money.

verses.raw: He that smites a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.
verses.text: He that smites a man, so that he die, shall be surely put to death.

verses.raw: And if a man lie not in wait, but Elohim (God) deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint you a place whither he shall flee.
verses.text: And if a man lie not in wait, but Elohim deliver him into his hand; then I will appoint you a place whither he shall flee.

verses.raw: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.
verses.text: But if a man come presumptuously upon his neighbour, to slay him with guile; you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

verses.raw: And he that smites his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.
verses.text: And he that smites his father, or his mother, shall be surely put to death.

verses.raw: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: And he that stealeth a man, and selleth him, or if he be found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: And he that curses his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: And he that curses his father, or his mother, shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keeps his bed:
verses.text: And if men strive together, and one smite another with a stone, or with his fist, and he die not, but keeps his bed:

verses.raw: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.
verses.text: If he rise again, and walk abroad upon his staff, then shall he that smote him be quit: only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall cause him to be thoroughly healed.

verses.raw: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.
verses.text: And if a man smite his servant, or his maid, with a rod, and he die under his hand; he shall be surely punished.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.
verses.text: Notwithstanding, if he continue a day or two, he shall not be punished: for he is his money.

verses.raw: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.
verses.text: If men strive, and hurt a woman with child, so that her fruit depart from her, and yet no mischief follow: he shall be surely punished, according as the woman’s husband will lay upon him; and he shall pay as the judges determine.

verses.raw: And if any mischief follow, then you shall give life for life,
verses.text: And if any mischief follow, then you shall give life for life,

verses.raw: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
verses.text: Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

verses.raw: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.
verses.text: Burning for burning, wound for wound, stripe for stripe.

verses.raw: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.
verses.text: And if a man smite the eye of his servant, or the eye of his maid, that it perish; he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

verses.raw: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.
verses.text: And if he smite out his manservant’s tooth, or his maidservant’s tooth; he shall let him go free for his tooth’s sake.

verses.raw: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.
verses.text: If an ox gore a man or a woman, that they die: then the ox shall be surely stoned, and his flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the ox shall be quit.

verses.raw: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it has been testified to his owner, and he has not kept him in, but that he has killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.
verses.text: But if the ox were wont to push with his horn in time past, and it has been testified to his owner, and he has not kept him in, but that he has killed a man or a woman; the ox shall be stoned, and his owner also shall be put to death.

verses.raw: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.
verses.text: If there be laid on him a sum of money, then he shall give for the ransom of his life whatsoever is laid upon him.

verses.raw: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.
verses.text: Whether he have gored a son, or have gored a daughter, according to this judgment shall it be done unto him.

verses.raw: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.
verses.text: If the ox shall push a manservant or a maidservant; he shall give unto their master thirty shekels of silver, and the ox shall be stoned.

verses.raw: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;
verses.text: And if a man shall open a pit, or if a man shall dig a pit, and not cover it, and an ox or an ass fall therein;

verses.raw: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.
verses.text: The owner of the pit shall make it good, and give money unto the owner of them; and the dead beast shall be his.

verses.raw: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.
verses.text: And if one man’s ox hurt another’s, that he die; then they shall sell the live ox, and divide the money of it; and the dead ox also they shall divide.

verses.raw: Or if it be known that the ox has used to push in time past, and his owner has not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.
verses.text: Or if it be known that the ox has used to push in time past, and his owner has not kept him in; he shall surely pay ox for ox; and the dead shall be his own.

verses.raw: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.
verses.text: If a man shall steal an ox, or a sheep, and kill it, or sell it; he shall restore five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

verses.raw: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.
verses.text: If a thief be found breaking up, and be smitten that he die, there shall no blood be shed for him.

verses.raw: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.
verses.text: If the sun be risen upon him, there shall be blood shed for him; for he should make full restitution; if he have nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

verses.raw: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.
verses.text: If the theft be certainly found in his hand alive, whether it be ox, or ass, or sheep; he shall restore double.

verses.raw: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.
verses.text: If a man shall cause a field or vineyard to be eaten, and shall put in his beast, and shall feed in another man’s field; of the best of his own field, and of the best of his own vineyard, shall he make restitution.

verses.raw: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.
verses.text: If fire break out, and catch in thorns, so that the stacks of corn, or the standing corn, or the field, be consumed therewith; he that kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

verses.raw: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.
verses.text: If a man shall deliver unto his neighbour money or stuff to keep, and it be stolen out of the man’s house; if the thief be found, let him pay double.

verses.raw: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.
verses.text: If the thief be not found, then the master of the house shall be brought unto the judges, to see whether he have put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods.

verses.raw: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.
verses.text: For all manner of trespass, whether it be for ox, for ass, for sheep, for raiment, or for any manner of lost thing, which another challengeth to be his, the cause of both parties shall come before the judges; and whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay double unto his neighbour.

verses.raw: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:
verses.text: If a man deliver unto his neighbour an ass, or an ox, or a sheep, or any beast, to keep; and it die, or be hurt, or driven away, no man seeing it:

verses.raw: Then shall an oath of Yahuah (LORD) be between them both, that he has not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.
verses.text: Then shall an oath of Yahuah be between them both, that he has not put his hand unto his neighbour’s goods; and the owner of it shall accept thereof, and he shall not make it good.

verses.raw: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.
verses.text: And if it be stolen from him, he shall make restitution unto the owner thereof.

verses.raw: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.
verses.text: If it be torn in pieces, then let him bring it for witness, and he shall not make good that which was torn.

verses.raw: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.
verses.text: And if a man borrow ought of his neighbour, and it be hurt, or die, the owner thereof being not with it, he shall surely make it good.

verses.raw: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.
verses.text: But if the owner thereof be with it, he shall not make it good: if it be an hired thing, it came for his hire.

verses.raw: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.
verses.text: And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.

verses.raw: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.
verses.text: If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

verses.raw: You shall not suffer a witch to live.
verses.text: You shall not suffer a witch to live.

verses.raw: Whosoever lies with a beast shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: Whosoever lies with a beast shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto Yahuah (LORD) only, he shall be utterly destroyed.
verses.text: He that sacrificeth unto any god, save unto Yahuah only, he shall be utterly destroyed.

verses.raw: You shall neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.text: You shall neither vex a stranger, nor oppress him: for you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: You shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.
verses.text: You shall not afflict any widow, or fatherless child.

verses.raw: If you afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;
verses.text: If you afflict them in any wise, and they cry at all unto me, I will surely hear their cry;

verses.raw: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.
verses.text: And my wrath shall wax hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

verses.raw: If you lend money to any of my people that is poor by you, you shall not be to him as an usurer, neither shall you lay upon him usury.
verses.text: If you lend money to any of my people that is poor by you, you shall not be to him as an usurer, neither shall you lay upon him usury.

verses.raw: If you at all take your neighbour’s raiment to pledge, you shall deliver it unto him by that the sun goes down:
verses.text: If you at all take your neighbour’s raiment to pledge, you shall deliver it unto him by that the sun goes down:

verses.raw: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he cries unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.
verses.text: For that is his covering only, it is his raiment for his skin: wherein shall he sleep? and it shall come to pass, when he cries unto me, that I will hear; for I am gracious.

verses.raw: You shall not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of your people.
verses.text: You shall not revile the gods, nor curse the ruler of your people.

verses.raw: You shall not delay to offer the first of your ripe fruits, and of your liquors: the firstborn of your sons shall you give unto me.
verses.text: You shall not delay to offer the first of your ripe fruits, and of your liquors: the firstborn of your sons shall you give unto me.

verses.raw: Likewise shall you do with your oxen, and with your sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day you shall give it me.
verses.text: Likewise shall you do with your oxen, and with your sheep: seven days it shall be with his dam; on the eighth day you shall give it me.

verses.raw: And you shall be holy men unto me: neither shall you eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; you shall cast it to the dogs.
verses.text: And you shall be holy men unto me: neither shall you eat any flesh that is torn of beasts in the field; you shall cast it to the dogs.

verses.raw: You shall not raise a false report: put not your hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
verses.text: You shall not raise a false report: put not your hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.

verses.raw: You shall not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shall you speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:
verses.text: You shall not follow a multitude to do evil; neither shall you speak in a cause to decline after many to wrest judgment:

verses.raw: Neither shall you countenance a poor man in his cause.
verses.text: Neither shall you countenance a poor man in his cause.

verses.raw: If you meet your enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.
verses.text: If you meet your enemy’s ox or his ass going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

verses.raw: If you see the ass of him that hates you lying under his burden, and would forbear to help him, you shall surely help with him.
verses.text: If you see the ass of him that hates you lying under his burden, and would forbear to help him, you shall surely help with him.

verses.raw: You shall not wrest the judgment of your poor in his cause.
verses.text: You shall not wrest the judgment of your poor in his cause.

verses.raw: Keep you far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay you not: for I will not justify the wicked.
verses.text: Keep you far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay you not: for I will not justify the wicked.

verses.raw: And you shall take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverts the words of the righteous.
verses.text: And you shall take no gift: for the gift blindeth the wise, and perverts the words of the righteous.

verses.raw: Also you shall not oppress a stranger: for you know the heart of a stranger, seeing you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.text: Also you shall not oppress a stranger: for you know the heart of a stranger, seeing you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in the fruits thereof:
verses.text: And six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in the fruits thereof:

verses.raw: But the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie still; that the poor of your people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner you shall deal with your vineyard, and with your oliveyard.
verses.text: But the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie still; that the poor of your people may eat: and what they leave the beasts of the field shall eat. In like manner you shall deal with your vineyard, and with your oliveyard.

verses.raw: Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest: that your ox and your ass may rest, and the son of your handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.
verses.text: Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest: that your ox and your ass may rest, and the son of your handmaid, and the stranger, may be refreshed.

verses.raw: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of your mouth.
verses.text: And in all things that I have said unto you be circumspect: and make no mention of the name of other gods, neither let it be heard out of your mouth.

verses.raw: Three times you shall keep a feast unto me in the year.
verses.text: Three times you shall keep a feast unto me in the year.

verses.raw: You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread: (you shall eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded you, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it you came out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)
verses.text: You shall keep the feast of unleavened bread: (you shall eat unleavened bread seven days, as I commanded you, in the time appointed of the month Abib; for in it you came out from Egypt: and none shall appear before me empty:)

verses.raw: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of your labours, which you have sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when you have gathered in your labours out of the field.
verses.text: And the feast of harvest, the firstfruits of your labours, which you have sown in the field: and the feast of ingathering, which is in the end of the year, when you have gathered in your labours out of the field.

verses.raw: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.
verses.text: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread; neither shall the fat of my sacrifice remain until the morning.

verses.raw: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring into the house of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God). You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
verses.text: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring into the house of Yahuah Elohayka. You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

verses.raw: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.
verses.text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

verses.raw: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.
verses.text: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

verses.raw: But if you shall indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto your enemies, and an adversary unto your adversaries.
verses.text: But if you shall indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto your enemies, and an adversary unto your adversaries.

verses.raw: For my Angel shall go before you, and bring you in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.
verses.text: For my Angel shall go before you, and bring you in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.

verses.raw: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but you shall utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.
verses.text: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor do after their works: but you shall utterly overthrow them, and quite break down their images.

verses.raw: And you shall serve Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and he shall bless your bread, and your water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of you.
verses.text: And you shall serve Yahuah Elohaychem, and he shall bless your bread, and your water; and I will take sickness away from the midst of you.

verses.raw: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in your land: the number of your days I will fulfil.
verses.text: There shall nothing cast their young, nor be barren, in your land: the number of your days I will fulfil.

verses.raw: I will send my fear before you, and will destroy all the people to whom you shall come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs unto you.
verses.text: I will send my fear before you, and will destroy all the people to whom you shall come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs unto you.

verses.raw: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.
verses.text: And I will send hornets before you, which shall drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

verses.raw: I will not drive them out from before you in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against you.
verses.text: I will not drive them out from before you in one year; lest the land become desolate, and the beast of the field multiply against you.

verses.raw: By little and little I will drive them out from before you, until you be increased, and inherit the land.
verses.text: By little and little I will drive them out from before you, until you be increased, and inherit the land.

verses.raw: And I will set your bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and you shall drive them out before you.
verses.text: And I will set your bounds from the Red sea even unto the sea of the Philistines, and from the desert unto the river: for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand; and you shall drive them out before you.

verses.raw: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.
verses.text: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

verses.raw: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me: for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto you.
verses.text: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me: for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare unto you.

verses.raw: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto Yahuah (LORD), you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel); and worship you afar off.
verses.text: And he said unto Moses, Come up unto Yahuah, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el; and worship you afar off.

verses.raw: And Moses alone shall come near Yahuah (LORD): but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.
verses.text: And Moses alone shall come near Yahuah: but they shall not come nigh; neither shall the people go up with him.

verses.raw: And Moses came and told the people all the words of Yahuah (LORD), and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which Yahuah (LORD) has said will we do.
verses.text: And Moses came and told the people all the words of Yahuah, and all the judgments: and all the people answered with one voice, and said, All the words which Yahuah has said will we do.

verses.raw: And Moses wrote all the words of Yahuah (LORD), and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Moses wrote all the words of Yahuah, and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he sent young men of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he sent young men of the children of Yashar'el, which offered burnt offerings, and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.
verses.text: And Moses took half of the blood, and put it in basons; and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

verses.raw: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that Yahuah (LORD) has said will we do, and be obedient.
verses.text: And he took the book of the covenant, and read in the audience of the people: and they said, All that Yahuah has said will we do, and be obedient.

verses.raw: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) has made with you concerning all these words.
verses.text: And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah has made with you concerning all these words.

verses.raw: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And they saw the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel): and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.
verses.text: And they saw the Elohim of Yashar'el: and there was under his feet as it were a paved work of a sapphire stone, and as it were the body of heaven in his clearness.

verses.raw: And upon the nobles of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) he laid not his hand: also they saw Elohim (God), and did eat and drink.
verses.text: And upon the nobles of the children of Yashar'el he laid not his hand: also they saw Elohim, and did eat and drink.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give you tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that you may teach them.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Come up to me into the mount, and be there: and I will give you tables of stone, and a law, and commandments which I have written; that you may teach them.

verses.raw: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Moses rose up, and his minister Joshua: and Moses went up into the mount of Elohim.

verses.raw: And he said unto the elders, Tarry you here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.
verses.text: And he said unto the elders, Tarry you here for us, until we come again unto you: and, behold, Aaron and Hur are with you: if any man have any matters to do, let him come unto them.

verses.raw: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.
verses.text: And Moses went up into the mount, and a cloud covered the mount.

verses.raw: And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.
verses.text: And the glory of Yahuah abode upon mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days: and the seventh day he called unto Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

verses.raw: And the sight of the glory of Yahuah (LORD) was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the sight of the glory of Yahuah was like devouring fire on the top of the mount in the eyes of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
verses.text: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they bring me an offering: of every man that gives it willingly with his heart you shall take my offering.
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, that they bring me an offering: of every man that gives it willingly with his heart you shall take my offering.

verses.raw: And this is the offering which you shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.text: And this is the offering which you shall take of them; gold, and silver, and brass,

verses.raw: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
verses.text: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

verses.raw: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
verses.text: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

verses.raw: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,
verses.text: Oil for the light, spices for anointing oil, and for sweet incense,

verses.raw: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.
verses.text: Onyx stones, and stones to be set in the ephod, and in the breastplate.

verses.raw: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.
verses.text: And let them make me a sanctuary; that I may dwell among them.

verses.raw: According to all that I shew you, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall you make it.
verses.text: According to all that I shew you, after the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all the instruments thereof, even so shall you make it.

verses.raw: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.text: And they shall make an ark of shittim wood: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

verses.raw: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, within and without shall you overlay it, and shall make upon it a crown of gold round about.
verses.text: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, within and without shall you overlay it, and shall make upon it a crown of gold round about.

verses.raw: And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.
verses.text: And you shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in the four corners thereof; and two rings shall be in the one side of it, and two rings in the other side of it.

verses.raw: And you shall make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.text: And you shall make staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.raw: And you shall put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.
verses.text: And you shall put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne with them.

verses.raw: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.
verses.text: The staves shall be in the rings of the ark: they shall not be taken from it.

verses.raw: And you shall put into the ark the testimony which I shall give you.
verses.text: And you shall put into the ark the testimony which I shall give you.

verses.raw: And you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.
verses.text: And you shall make a mercy seat of pure gold: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof, and a cubit and a half the breadth thereof.

verses.raw: And you shall make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shall you make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.
verses.text: And you shall make two cherubims of gold, of beaten work shall you make them, in the two ends of the mercy seat.

verses.raw: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall you make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.
verses.text: And make one cherub on the one end, and the other cherub on the other end: even of the mercy seat shall you make the cherubims on the two ends thereof.

verses.raw: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.
verses.text: And the cherubims shall stretch forth their wings on high, covering the mercy seat with their wings, and their faces shall look one to another; toward the mercy seat shall the faces of the cherubims be.

verses.raw: And you shall put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I shall give you.
verses.text: And you shall put the mercy seat above upon the ark; and in the ark you shall put the testimony that I shall give you.

verses.raw: And there I will meet with you, and I will commune with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give you in commandment unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And there I will meet with you, and I will commune with you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubims which are upon the ark of the testimony, of all things which I will give you in commandment unto the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: You shall also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.
verses.text: You shall also make a table of shittim wood: two cubits shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof, and a cubit and a half the height thereof.

verses.raw: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.
verses.text: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, and make thereto a crown of gold round about.

verses.raw: And you shall make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and you shall make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.
verses.text: And you shall make unto it a border of an hand breadth round about, and you shall make a golden crown to the border thereof round about.

verses.raw: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.
verses.text: And you shall make for it four rings of gold, and put the rings in the four corners that are on the four feet thereof.

verses.raw: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.
verses.text: Over against the border shall the rings be for places of the staves to bear the table.

verses.raw: And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.
verses.text: And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be borne with them.

verses.raw: And you shall make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shall you make them.
verses.text: And you shall make the dishes thereof, and spoons thereof, and covers thereof, and bowls thereof, to cover withal: of pure gold shall you make them.

verses.raw: And you shall set upon the table shewbread before me alway.
verses.text: And you shall set upon the table shewbread before me alway.

verses.raw: And you shall make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.
verses.text: And you shall make a candlestick of pure gold: of beaten work shall the candlestick be made: his shaft, and his branches, his bowls, his knops, and his flowers, shall be of the same.

verses.raw: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:
verses.text: And six branches shall come out of the sides of it; three branches of the candlestick out of the one side, and three branches of the candlestick out of the other side:

verses.raw: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.
verses.text: Three bowls made like unto almonds, with a knop and a flower in one branch; and three bowls made like almonds in the other branch, with a knop and a flower: so in the six branches that come out of the candlestick.

verses.raw: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.
verses.text: And in the candlestick shall be four bowls made like unto almonds, with their knops and their flowers.

verses.raw: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.
verses.text: And there shall be a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, and a knop under two branches of the same, according to the six branches that proceed out of the candlestick.

verses.raw: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.
verses.text: Their knops and their branches shall be of the same: all it shall be one beaten work of pure gold.

verses.raw: And you shall make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.
verses.text: And you shall make the seven lamps thereof: and they shall light the lamps thereof, that they may give light over against it.

verses.raw: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.
verses.text: And the tongs thereof, and the snuffdishes thereof, shall be of pure gold.

verses.raw: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.
verses.text: Of a talent of pure gold shall he make it, with all these vessels.

verses.raw: And look that you make them after their pattern, which was shewed you in the mount.
verses.text: And look that you make them after their pattern, which was shewed you in the mount.

verses.raw: Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shall you make them.
verses.text: Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shall you make them.

verses.raw: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.text: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

verses.raw: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.text: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.

verses.raw: And you shall make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shall you make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.text: And you shall make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shall you make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.

verses.raw: Fifty loops shall you make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shall you make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.text: Fifty loops shall you make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shall you make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.

verses.raw: And you shall make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
verses.text: And you shall make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.

verses.raw: And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shall you make.
verses.text: And you shall make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shall you make.

verses.raw: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
verses.text: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.

verses.raw: And you shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.text: And you shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.text: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.

verses.raw: And you shall make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.text: And you shall make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

verses.raw: And the remnant that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
verses.text: And the remnant that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.text: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

verses.raw: And you shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.
verses.text: And you shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers’ skins.

verses.raw: And you shall make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
verses.text: And you shall make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.

verses.raw: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
verses.text: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

verses.raw: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shall you make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.text: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shall you make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.text: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

verses.raw: And you shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.text: And you shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.

verses.raw: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
verses.text: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:

verses.raw: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.text: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.raw: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
verses.text: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

verses.raw: And two boards shall you make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.text: And two boards shall you make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.

verses.raw: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.text: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

verses.raw: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.text: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

verses.raw: And you shall make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.text: And you shall make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

verses.raw: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
verses.text: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

verses.raw: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.text: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

verses.raw: And you shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and you shall overlay the bars with gold.

verses.text: And you shall command the children of Yashar'el, that they bring you pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamp to burn always.

verses.raw: In the tabernacle of the congregation without the vail, which is before the testimony, Aaron and his sons shall order it from evening to morning before Yahuah (LORD): it shall be a statute for ever unto their generations on the behalf of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).

verses.raw: And take you unto you Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office, even Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron’s sons.

verses.raw: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother for glory and for beauty.
verses.text: And you shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother for glory and for beauty.

verses.raw: And you shall speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.text: And you shall speak unto all that are wise hearted, whom I have filled with the spirit of wisdom, that they may make Aaron’s garments to consecrate him, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.raw: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.text: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.raw: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.text: And they shall take gold, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen.

verses.text: And they shall make the ephod of gold, of blue, and of purple, of scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cunning work.

verses.text: It shall have the two shoulderpieces thereof joined at the two edges thereof; and so it shall be joined together.

verses.raw: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.text: And the curious girdle of the ephod, which is upon it, shall be of the same, according to the work thereof; even of gold, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.raw: And you shall take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And you shall take two onyx stones, and grave on them the names of the children of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.
verses.text: Six of their names on one stone, and the other six names of the rest on the other stone, according to their birth.

verses.text: With the work of an engraver in stone, like the engravings of a signet, shall you engrave the two stones with the names of the children of Yashar'el: you shall make them to be set in ouches of gold.

verses.raw: And you shall put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and Aaron shall bear their names before Yahuah (LORD) upon his two shoulders for a memorial.
verses.text: And you shall put the two stones upon the shoulders of the ephod for stones of memorial unto the children of Yashar'el: and Aaron shall bear their names before Yahuah upon his two shoulders for a memorial.

verses.text: And you shall make ouches of gold;

verses.text: Foursquare it shall be being doubled; a span shall be the length thereof, and a span shall be the breadth thereof.

verses.raw: And you shall set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.
verses.text: And you shall set in it settings of stones, even four rows of stones: the first row shall be a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this shall be the first row.

verses.text: And the second row shall be an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.raw: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.text: And the third row a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.raw: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.
verses.text: And the fourth row a beryl, and an onyx, and a jasper: they shall be set in gold in their inclosings.

verses.raw: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.
verses.text: And the stones shall be with the names of the children of Yashar'el, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet; every one with his name shall they be according to the twelve tribes.

verses.raw: And they shall bind the breastplate by the rings thereof unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it may be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate be not loosed from the ephod.

verses.raw: And Aaron shall bear the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the breastplate of judgment upon his heart, when he goes in unto the holy place, for a memorial before Yahuah (LORD) continually.

verses.text: And you shall put in the breastplate of judgment the Urim and the Thummim; and they shall be upon Aaron’s heart, when he goes in before Yahuah: and Aaron shall bear the judgment of the children of Yashar'el upon his heart before Yahuah continually.

verses.raw: And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.
verses.text: And you shall make the robe of the ephod all of blue.

verses.raw: And it shall be upon Aaron to minister: and his sound shall be heard when he goes in unto the holy place before Yahuah (LORD), and when he comes out, that he die not.
