verses.text: And you shall take of the blood that is upon the altar, and of the anointing oil, and sprinkle it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon the garments of his sons with him: and he shall be hallowed, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.raw: Also you shall take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covers the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:
verses.text: Also you shall take of the ram the fat and the rump, and the fat that covers the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, and the right shoulder; for it is a ram of consecration:

verses.raw: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: And one loaf of bread, and one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer out of the basket of the unleavened bread that is before Yahuah:

verses.raw: And you shall put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall put all in the hands of Aaron, and in the hands of his sons; and shall wave them for a wave offering before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And you shall receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before Yahuah (LORD): it is an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall receive them of their hands, and burn them upon the altar for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour before Yahuah: it is an offering made by fire unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And you shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD): and it shall be your part.
verses.text: And you shall take the breast of the ram of Aaron’s consecration, and wave it for a wave offering before Yahuah: and it shall be your part.

verses.raw: And you shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:
verses.text: And you shall sanctify the breast of the wave offering, and the shoulder of the heave offering, which is waved, and which is heaved up, of the ram of the consecration, even of that which is for Aaron, and of that which is for his sons:

verses.raw: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Yashar'el (Israel): for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Yashar'el (Israel) of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’ by a statute for ever from the children of Yashar'el: for it is an heave offering: and it shall be an heave offering from the children of Yashar'el of the sacrifice of their peace offerings, even their heave offering unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.
verses.text: And the holy garments of Aaron shall be his sons’ after him, to be anointed therein, and to be consecrated in them.

verses.raw: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he comes into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.
verses.text: And that son that is priest in his stead shall put them on seven days, when he comes into the tabernacle of the congregation to minister in the holy place.

verses.raw: And you shall take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.
verses.text: And you shall take the ram of the consecration, and seethe his flesh in the holy place.

verses.raw: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text: And Aaron and his sons shall eat the flesh of the ram, and the bread that is in the basket, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.raw: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.
verses.text: And they shall eat those things wherewith the atonement was made, to consecrate and to sanctify them: but a stranger shall not eat thereof, because they are holy.

verses.raw: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.
verses.text: And if ought of the flesh of the consecrations, or of the bread, remain unto the morning, then you shall burn the remainder with fire: it shall not be eaten, because it is holy.

verses.raw: And thus shall you do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded you: seven days shall you consecrate them.
verses.text: And thus shall you do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded you: seven days shall you consecrate them.

verses.raw: And you shall offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and you shall cleanse the altar, when you have made an atonement for it, and you shall anoint it, to sanctify it.
verses.text: And you shall offer every day a bullock for a sin offering for atonement: and you shall cleanse the altar, when you have made an atonement for it, and you shall anoint it, to sanctify it.

verses.raw: Seven days you shall make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever touches the altar shall be holy.
verses.text: Seven days you shall make an atonement for the altar, and sanctify it; and it shall be an altar most holy: whatsoever touches the altar shall be holy.

verses.raw: Now this is that which you shall offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
verses.text: Now this is that which you shall offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.

verses.raw: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at even:
verses.text: The one lamb you shall offer in the morning; and the other lamb you shall offer at even:

verses.raw: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.
verses.text: And with the one lamb a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil; and the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering.

verses.raw: And the other lamb you shall offer at even, and shall do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the other lamb you shall offer at even, and shall do thereto according to the meat offering of the morning, and according to the drink offering thereof, for a sweet savour, an offering made by fire unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before Yahuah (LORD): where I will meet you, to speak there unto you.
verses.text: This shall be a continual burnt offering throughout your generations at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before Yahuah: where I will meet you, to speak there unto you.

verses.raw: And there I will meet with the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.
verses.text: And there I will meet with the children of Yashar'el, and the tabernacle shall be sanctified by my glory.

verses.raw: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.
verses.text: And I will sanctify the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar: I will sanctify also both Aaron and his sons, to minister to me in the priest’s office.

verses.raw: And I will dwell among the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and will be their Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I will dwell among the children of Yashar'el, and will be their Elohim.

verses.raw: And they shall know that I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: And they shall know that I am Yahuah their Elohim, that brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, that I may dwell among them: I am Yahuah their Elohim.

verses.raw: And you shall make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shall you make it.
verses.text: And you shall make an altar to burn incense upon: of shittim wood shall you make it.

verses.raw: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.
verses.text: A cubit shall be the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits shall be the height thereof: the horns thereof shall be of the same.

verses.raw: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and you shall make unto it a crown of gold round about.
verses.text: And you shall overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and you shall make unto it a crown of gold round about.

verses.raw: And two golden rings shall you make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shall you make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.
verses.text: And two golden rings shall you make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shall you make it; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal.

verses.raw: And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.
verses.text: And you shall make the staves of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

verses.raw: And you shall put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.text: And you shall put it before the vail that is by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that is over the testimony, where I will meet with you.

verses.raw: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresses the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.
verses.text: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresses the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it.

verses.raw: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before Yahuah (LORD) throughout your generations.
verses.text: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before Yahuah throughout your generations.

verses.raw: You shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall you pour drink offering thereon.
verses.text: You shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall you pour drink offering thereon.

verses.raw: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it is most holy unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: When you take the sum of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto Yahuah (LORD), when you numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when you numberest them.
verses.text: When you take the sum of the children of Yashar'el after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto Yahuah, when you numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when you numberest them.

verses.raw: This they shall give, every one that passes among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: This they shall give, every one that passes among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel is twenty gerahs:) an half shekel shall be the offering of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Every one that passes among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Every one that passes among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.text: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when they give an offering unto Yahuah, to make an atonement for your souls.

verses.raw: And you shall take the atonement money of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement for your souls.
verses.text: And you shall take the atonement money of the children of Yashar'el, and shall appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Yashar'el before Yahuah, to make an atonement for your souls.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: You shall also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and you shall put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and you shall put water therein.
verses.text: You shall also make a laver of brass, and his foot also of brass, to wash withal: and you shall put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and you shall put water therein.

verses.raw: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.text: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

verses.raw: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto Yahuah:

verses.raw: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.
verses.text: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, even to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Take you also unto you principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,
verses.text: Take you also unto you principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,

verses.raw: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:
verses.text: And of cassia five hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

verses.raw: And you shall make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the are of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.
verses.text: And you shall make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the are of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil.

verses.raw: And you shall anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,
verses.text: And you shall anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

verses.raw: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,
verses.text: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

verses.raw: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.
verses.text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

verses.raw: And you shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever touches them shall be holy.
verses.text: And you shall sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever touches them shall be holy.

verses.raw: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.text: And you shall anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.raw: And you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.
verses.text: And you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

verses.raw: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall you make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.
verses.text: Upon man’s flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall you make any other like it, after the composition of it: it is holy, and it shall be holy unto you.

verses.raw: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever puts any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.text: Whosoever compoundeth any like it, or whosoever puts any of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Take unto you sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Take unto you sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight:

verses.raw: And you shall make it a perfume, a confection after the are of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:
verses.text: And you shall make it a perfume, a confection after the are of the apothecary, tempered together, pure and holy:

verses.raw: And you shall beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with you: it shall be unto you most holy.
verses.text: And you shall beat some of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with you: it shall be unto you most holy.

verses.raw: And as for the perfume which you shall make, you shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto you holy for Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And as for the perfume which you shall make, you shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto you holy for Yahuah.

verses.raw: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.
verses.text: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah):
verses.text: See, I have called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Yahudah:

verses.raw: And I have filled him with the spirit of Elohim (God), in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,
verses.text: And I have filled him with the spirit of Elohim, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship,

verses.raw: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,
verses.text: To devise cunning works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass,

verses.raw: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.
verses.text: And in cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of timber, to work in all manner of workmanship.

verses.raw: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you;
verses.text: And I, behold, I have given with him Aholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan: and in the hearts of all that are wise hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you;

verses.raw: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,
verses.text: The tabernacle of the congregation, and the ark of the testimony, and the mercy seat that is thereupon, and all the furniture of the tabernacle,

verses.raw: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,
verses.text: And the table and his furniture, and the pure candlestick with all his furniture, and the altar of incense,

verses.raw: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,
verses.text: And the altar of burnt offering with all his furniture, and the laver and his foot,

verses.raw: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,
verses.text: And the cloths of service, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office,

verses.raw: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you shall they do.
verses.text: And the anointing oil, and sweet incense for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you shall they do.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak you also unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Verily my sabbaths you shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that you may know that I am Yahuah (LORD) that does sanctify you.
verses.text: Speak you also unto the children of Yashar'el, saying, Verily my sabbaths you shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that you may know that I am Yahuah that does sanctify you.

verses.raw: You shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defiles it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text: You shall keep the sabbath therefore; for it is holy unto you: every one that defiles it shall surely be put to death: for whosoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.raw: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to Yahuah (LORD): whosoever does any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: Six days may work be done; but in the seventh is the sabbath of rest, holy to Yahuah: whosoever does any work in the sabbath day, he shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: Wherefore the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.
verses.text: Wherefore the children of Yashar'el shall keep the sabbath, to observe the sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant.

verses.raw: It is a sign between me and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for ever: for in six days Yahuah (LORD) made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.
verses.text: It is a sign between me and the children of Yashar'el for ever: for in six days Yahuah made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.

verses.raw: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And he gave unto Moses, when he had made an end of communing with him upon mount Sinai, two tables of testimony, tables of stone, written with the finger of Elohim.

verses.raw: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.text: And when the people saw that Moses delayed to come down out of the mount, the people gathered themselves together unto Aaron, and said unto him, Up, make us gods, which shall go before us; for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

verses.raw: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.
verses.text: And Aaron said unto them, Break off the golden earrings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them unto me.

verses.raw: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.
verses.text: And all the people brake off the golden earrings which were in their ears, and brought them unto Aaron.

verses.raw: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be your gods, O Yashar'el (Israel), which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And he received them at their hand, and fashioned it with a graving tool, after he had made it a molten calf: and they said, These be your gods, O Yashar'el, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And when Aaron saw it, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made proclamation, and said, To morrow is a feast to Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.
verses.text: And they rose up early on the morrow, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Go, get you down; for your people, which you brought out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Go, get you down; for your people, which you brought out of the land of Egypt, have corrupted themselves:

verses.raw: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be your gods, O Yashar'el (Israel), which have brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto, and said, These be your gods, O Yashar'el, which have brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

verses.raw: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of you a great nation.
verses.text: Now therefore let me alone, that my wrath may wax hot against them, and that I may consume them: and I will make of you a great nation.

verses.raw: And Moses besought Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), and said, Yahuah (LORD), why does your wrath wax hot against your people, which you have brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?
verses.text: And Moses besought Yahuah Elohav, and said, Yahuah, why does your wrath wax hot against your people, which you have brought forth out of the land of Egypt with great power, and with a mighty hand?

verses.raw: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from your fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against your people.
verses.text: Wherefore should the Egyptians speak, and say, For mischief did he bring them out, to slay them in the mountains, and to consume them from the face of the earth? Turn from your fierce wrath, and repent of this evil against your people.

verses.raw: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Yashar'el (Israel), your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.
verses.text: Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Yashar'el, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and saidst unto them, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven, and all this land that I have spoken of will I give unto your seed, and they shall inherit it for ever.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.
verses.text: And Yahuah repented of the evil which he thought to do unto his people.

verses.raw: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.
verses.text: And Moses turned, and went down from the mount, and the two tables of the testimony were in his hand: the tables were written on both their sides; on the one side and on the other were they written.

verses.raw: And the tables were the work of Elohim (God), and the writing was the writing of Elohim (God), graven upon the tables.
verses.text: And the tables were the work of Elohim, and the writing was the writing of Elohim, graven upon the tables.

verses.raw: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.
verses.text: And when Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said unto Moses, There is a noise of war in the camp.

verses.raw: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.
verses.text: And he said, It is not the voice of them that shout for mastery, neither is it the voice of them that cry for being overcome: but the noise of them that sing do I hear.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as soon as he came nigh unto the camp, that he saw the calf, and the dancing: and Moses’ anger waxed hot, and he cast the tables out of his hands, and brake them beneath the mount.

verses.raw: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) drink of it.
verses.text: And he took the calf which they had made, and burnt it in the fire, and ground it to powder, and strawed it upon the water, and made the children of Yashar'el drink of it.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto you, that you have brought so great a sin upon them?
verses.text: And Moses said unto Aaron, What did this people unto you, that you have brought so great a sin upon them?

verses.raw: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: you know the people, that they are set on mischief.
verses.text: And Aaron said, Let not the anger of my lord wax hot: you know the people, that they are set on mischief.

verses.raw: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.
verses.text: For they said unto me, Make us gods, which shall go before us: for as for this Moses, the man that brought us up out of the land of Egypt, we wot not what is become of him.

verses.raw: And I said unto them, Whosoever has any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.
verses.text: And I said unto them, Whosoever has any gold, let them break it off. So they gave it me: then I cast it into the fire, and there came out this calf.

verses.raw: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)
verses.text: And when Moses saw that the people were naked; (for Aaron had made them naked unto their shame among their enemies:)

verses.raw: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’S side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.
verses.text: Then Moses stood in the gate of the camp, and said, Who is on the LORD’S side? let him come unto me. And all the sons of Levi gathered themselves together unto him.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, Put every man his sword by his side, and go in and out from gate to gate throughout the camp, and slay every man his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbour.

verses.raw: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.
verses.text: And the children of Levi did according to the word of Moses: and there fell of the people that day about three thousand men.

verses.raw: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to Yahuah (LORD), even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.
verses.text: For Moses had said, Consecrate yourselves to day to Yahuah, even every man upon his son, and upon his brother; that he may bestow upon you a blessing this day.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, You have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto Yahuah (LORD); peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Moses said unto the people, You have sinned a great sin: and now I will go up unto Yahuah; peradventure I shall make an atonement for your sin.

verses.raw: And Moses returned unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.
verses.text: And Moses returned unto Yahuah, and said, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made them gods of gold.

verses.raw: Yet now, if you will forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray you, out of your book which you have written.
verses.text: Yet now, if you will forgive their sin—; and if not, blot me, I pray you, out of your book which you have written.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Whosoever has sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Whosoever has sinned against me, him will I blot out of my book.

verses.raw: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto you: behold, my Angel shall go before you: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.
verses.text: Therefore now go, lead the people unto the place of which I have spoken unto you: behold, my Angel shall go before you: nevertheless in the day when I visit I will visit their sin upon them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.
verses.text: And Yahuah plagued the people, because they made the calf, which Aaron made.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, you and the people which you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto your seed will I give it:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Depart, and go up hence, you and the people which you have brought up out of the land of Egypt, unto the land which I sware unto Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, Unto your seed will I give it:

verses.raw: And I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
verses.text: And I will send an angel before you; and I will drive out the Canaanite, the Amorite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:

verses.raw: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of you; for you are a stiffnecked people: lest I consume you in the way.
verses.text: Unto a land flowing with milk and honey: for I will not go up in the midst of you; for you are a stiffnecked people: lest I consume you in the way.

verses.raw: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.
verses.text: And when the people heard these evil tidings, they mourned: and no man did put on him his ornaments.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), You are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of you in a moment, and consume you: therefore now put off your ornaments from you, that I may know what to do unto you.
verses.text: For Yahuah had said unto Moses, Say unto the children of Yashar'el, You are a stiffnecked people: I will come up into the midst of you in a moment, and consume you: therefore now put off your ornaments from you, that I may know what to do unto you.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el stripped themselves of their ornaments by the mount Horeb.

verses.raw: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought Yahuah (LORD) went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.
verses.text: And Moses took the tabernacle, and pitched it without the camp, afar off from the camp, and called it the Tabernacle of the congregation. And it came to pass, that every one which sought Yahuah went out unto the tabernacle of the congregation, which was without the camp.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Moses went out unto the tabernacle, that all the people rose up, and stood every man at his tent door, and looked after Moses, until he was gone into the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and Yahuah (LORD) talked with Moses.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as Moses entered into the tabernacle, the cloudy pillar descended, and stood at the door of the tabernacle, and Yahuah talked with Moses.

verses.raw: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.
verses.text: And all the people saw the cloudy pillar stand at the tabernacle door: and all the people rose up and worshipped, every man in his tent door.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaks unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses face to face, as a man speaks unto his friend. And he turned again into the camp: but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, departed not out of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Yahuah (LORD), See, you say unto me, Bring up this people: and you have not let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, I know you by name, and you have also found grace in my sight.
verses.text: And Moses said unto Yahuah, See, you say unto me, Bring up this people: and you have not let me know whom you will send with me. Yet you have said, I know you by name, and you have also found grace in my sight.

verses.raw: Now therefore, I pray you, if I have found grace in your sight, shew me now your way, that I may know you, that I may find grace in your sight: and consider that this nation is your people.
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, if I have found grace in your sight, shew me now your way, that I may know you, that I may find grace in your sight: and consider that this nation is your people.

verses.raw: And he said, My presence shall go with you, and I will give you rest.
verses.text: And he said, My presence shall go with you, and I will give you rest.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, If your presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.
verses.text: And he said unto him, If your presence go not with me, carry us not up hence.

verses.raw: For wherein shall it be known here that I and your people have found grace in your sight? is it not in that you go with us? so shall we be separated, I and your people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.text: For wherein shall it be known here that I and your people have found grace in your sight? is it not in that you go with us? so shall we be separated, I and your people, from all the people that are upon the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that you have spoken: for you have found grace in my sight, and I know you by name.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, I will do this thing also that you have spoken: for you have found grace in my sight, and I know you by name.

verses.raw: And he said, I beseech you, shew me your glory.
verses.text: And he said, I beseech you, shew me your glory.

verses.raw: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of Yahuah (LORD) before you; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.
verses.text: And he said, I will make all my goodness pass before you, and I will proclaim the name of Yahuah before you; and will be gracious to whom I will be gracious, and will shew mercy on whom I will shew mercy.

verses.raw: And he said, You can not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.
verses.text: And he said, You can not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said, Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand upon a rock:
verses.text: And Yahuah said, Behold, there is a place by me, and you shall stand upon a rock:

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a clift of the rock, and will cover you with my hand while I pass by:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passes by, that I will put you in a clift of the rock, and will cover you with my hand while I pass by:

verses.raw: And I will take away my hand, and you shall see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.
verses.text: And I will take away my hand, and you shall see my back parts: but my face shall not be seen.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Hew you two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which you brakest.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Hew you two tables of stone like unto the first: and I will write upon these tables the words that were in the first tables, which you brakest.

verses.raw: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.
verses.text: And be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning unto mount Sinai, and present thyself there to me in the top of the mount.

verses.raw: And no man shall come up with you, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.
verses.text: And no man shall come up with you, neither let any man be seen throughout all the mount; neither let the flocks nor herds feed before that mount.

verses.raw: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.
verses.text: And he hewed two tables of stone like unto the first; and Moses rose up early in the morning, and went up unto mount Sinai, as Yahuah had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tables of stone.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Yahuah descended in the cloud, and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) passed by before him, and proclaimed, Yahuah (LORD), Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God), merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,
verses.text: And Yahuah passed by before him, and proclaimed, Yahuah, Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God), merciful and gracious, longsuffering, and abundant in goodness and truth,

verses.raw: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.
verses.text: Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation.

verses.raw: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.
verses.text: And Moses made haste, and bowed his head toward the earth, and worshipped.

verses.raw: And he said, If now I have found grace in your sight, O Adonai (Lord), let my Lord, I pray you, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.
verses.text: And he said, If now I have found grace in your sight, O Adonai, let my Lord, I pray you, go among us; for it is a stiffnecked people; and pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance.

verses.raw: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which you are shall see the work of Yahuah (LORD): for it is a terrible thing that I will do with you.
verses.text: And he said, Behold, I make a covenant: before all your people I will do marvels, such as have not been done in all the earth, nor in any nation: and all the people among which you are shall see the work of Yahuah: for it is a terrible thing that I will do with you.

verses.raw: Observe you that which I command you this day: behold, I drive out before you the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.
verses.text: Observe you that which I command you this day: behold, I drive out before you the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite.

verses.raw: Take heed to thyself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither you go, lest it be for a snare in the midst of you:
verses.text: Take heed to thyself, lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land whither you go, lest it be for a snare in the midst of you:

verses.raw: But you shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:
verses.text: But you shall destroy their altars, break their images, and cut down their groves:

verses.raw: For you shall worship no other god: for Yahuah (LORD), whose name is Jealous, is a jealous Elohim (God):
verses.text: For you shall worship no other god: for Yahuah, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous Elohim:

verses.raw: Lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call you, and you eat of his sacrifice;
verses.text: Lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they go a whoring after their gods, and do sacrifice unto their gods, and one call you, and you eat of his sacrifice;

verses.raw: And you take of their daughters unto your sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make your sons go a whoring after their gods.
verses.text: And you take of their daughters unto your sons, and their daughters go a whoring after their gods, and make your sons go a whoring after their gods.

verses.raw: You shall make you no molten gods.
verses.text: You shall make you no molten gods.

verses.raw: The feast of unleavened bread shall you keep. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib you came out from Egypt.
verses.text: The feast of unleavened bread shall you keep. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, in the time of the month Abib: for in the month Abib you came out from Egypt.

verses.raw: All that opens the matrix is mine; and every firstling among your cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.
verses.text: All that opens the matrix is mine; and every firstling among your cattle, whether ox or sheep, that is male.

verses.raw: But the firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb: and if you redeem him not, then shall you break his neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.
verses.text: But the firstling of an ass you shall redeem with a lamb: and if you redeem him not, then shall you break his neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. And none shall appear before me empty.

verses.raw: Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in earing time and in harvest you shall rest.
verses.text: Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest: in earing time and in harvest you shall rest.

verses.raw: And you shall observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.
verses.text: And you shall observe the feast of weeks, of the firstfruits of wheat harvest, and the feast of ingathering at the year’s end.

verses.raw: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Thrice in the year shall all your men children appear before Adonai Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For I will cast out the nations before you, and enlarge your borders: neither shall any man desire your land, when you shall go up to appear before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) thrice in the year.
verses.text: For I will cast out the nations before you, and enlarge your borders: neither shall any man desire your land, when you shall go up to appear before Yahuah Elohayka thrice in the year.

verses.raw: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.
verses.text: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven; neither shall the sacrifice of the feast of the passover be left unto the morning.

verses.raw: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring unto the house of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God). You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
verses.text: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring unto the house of Yahuah Elohayka. You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Write you these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Write you these words: for after the tenor of these words I have made a covenant with you and with Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
verses.text: And he was there with Yahuah forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

verses.raw: And when Aaron and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.
verses.text: And when Aaron and all the children of Yashar'el saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

verses.raw: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
verses.text: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.

verses.raw: And afterward all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that Yahuah (LORD) had spoken with him in mount Sinai.
verses.text: And afterward all the children of Yashar'el came nigh: and he gave them in commandment all that Yahuah had spoken with him in mount Sinai.

verses.raw: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.
verses.text: And till Moses had done speaking with them, he put a vail on his face.

verses.raw: But when Moses went in before Yahuah (LORD) to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that which he was commanded.
verses.text: But when Moses went in before Yahuah to speak with him, he took the vail off, until he came out. And he came out, and spake unto the children of Yashar'el that which he was commanded.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el saw the face of Moses, that the skin of Moses’ face shone: and Moses put the vail upon his face again, until he went in to speak with him.

verses.raw: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) together, and said unto them, These are the words which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded, that you should do them.
verses.text: And Moses gathered all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el together, and said unto them, These are the words which Yahuah has commanded, that you should do them.

verses.raw: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to Yahuah (LORD): whosoever does work therein shall be put to death.
verses.text: Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be to you an holy day, a sabbath of rest to Yahuah: whosoever does work therein shall be put to death.

verses.raw: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.
verses.text: You shall kindle no fire throughout your habitations upon the sabbath day.

verses.raw: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) commanded, saying,
verses.text: And Moses spake unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el, saying, This is the thing which Yahuah commanded, saying,

verses.raw: Take you from among you an offering unto Yahuah (LORD): whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of Yahuah (LORD); gold, and silver, and brass,
verses.text: Take you from among you an offering unto Yahuah: whosoever is of a willing heart, let him bring it, an offering of Yahuah; gold, and silver, and brass,

verses.raw: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,
verses.text: And blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine linen, and goats’ hair,

verses.raw: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,
verses.text: And rams’ skins dyed red, and badgers’ skins, and shittim wood,

verses.raw: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,
verses.text: And oil for the light, and spices for anointing oil, and for the sweet incense,

verses.raw: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.
verses.text: And onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod, and for the breastplate.

verses.raw: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that Yahuah (LORD) has commanded;
verses.text: And every wise hearted among you shall come, and make all that Yahuah has commanded;

verses.raw: The tabernacle, his tent, and his covering, his taches, and his boards, his bars, his pillars, and his sockets,
