verses.text: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.raw: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.
verses.text: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

verses.raw: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.
verses.text: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

verses.raw: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.
verses.text: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

verses.raw: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.
verses.text: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

verses.raw: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.
verses.text: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

verses.raw: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
verses.text: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

verses.raw: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), made all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Yahudah, made all that Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.
verses.text: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

verses.raw: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.text: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.text: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

verses.raw: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.
verses.text: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

verses.raw: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.
verses.text: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

verses.raw: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.
verses.text: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

verses.raw: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.
verses.text: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

verses.raw: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,
verses.text: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

verses.raw: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.
verses.text: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

verses.raw: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And of the blue, and purple, and scarlet, they made cloths of service, to do service in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.text: And he made the ephod of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.raw: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.
verses.text: And they did beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in the blue, and in the purple, and in the scarlet, and in the fine linen, with cunning work.

verses.raw: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.
verses.text: They made shoulderpieces for it, to couple it together: by the two edges was it coupled together.

verses.raw: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And the curious girdle of his ephod, that was upon it, was of the same, according to the work thereof; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they wrought onyx stones inclosed in ouches of gold, graven, as signets are graven, with the names of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Yashar'el (Israel); as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And he put them on the shoulders of the ephod, that they should be stones for a memorial to the children of Yashar'el; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.
verses.text: And he made the breastplate of cunning work, like the work of the ephod; of gold, blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen.

verses.raw: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.
verses.text: It was foursquare; they made the breastplate double: a span was the length thereof, and a span the breadth thereof, being doubled.

verses.raw: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.
verses.text: And they set in it four rows of stones: the first row was a sardius, a topaz, and a carbuncle: this was the first row.

verses.raw: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.
verses.text: And the second row, an emerald, a sapphire, and a diamond.

verses.raw: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.
verses.text: And the third row, a ligure, an agate, and an amethyst.

verses.raw: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.
verses.text: And the fourth row, a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper: they were inclosed in ouches of gold in their inclosings.

verses.raw: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
verses.text: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Yashar'el, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.

verses.raw: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.
verses.text: And they made upon the breastplate chains at the ends, of wreathen work of pure gold.

verses.raw: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.
verses.text: And they made two ouches of gold, and two gold rings; and put the two rings in the two ends of the breastplate.

verses.raw: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.
verses.text: And they put the two wreathen chains of gold in the two rings on the ends of the breastplate.

verses.raw: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.
verses.text: And the two ends of the two wreathen chains they fastened in the two ouches, and put them on the shoulderpieces of the ephod, before it.

verses.raw: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.
verses.text: And they made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, upon the border of it, which was on the side of the ephod inward.

verses.raw: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.
verses.text: And they made two other golden rings, and put them on the two sides of the ephod underneath, toward the forepart of it, over against the other coupling thereof, above the curious girdle of the ephod.

verses.raw: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And they did bind the breastplate by his rings unto the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be above the curious girdle of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not be loosed from the ephod; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.
verses.text: And he made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

verses.raw: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.
verses.text: And there was an hole in the midst of the robe, as the hole of an habergeon, with a band round about the hole, that it should not rend.

verses.raw: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.
verses.text: And they made upon the hems of the robe pomegranates of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and twined linen.

verses.raw: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;
verses.text: And they made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates upon the hem of the robe, round about between the pomegranates;

verses.raw: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, round about the hem of the robe to minister in; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,
verses.text: And they made coats of fine linen of woven work for Aaron, and for his sons,

verses.raw: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,
verses.text: And a mitre of fine linen, and goodly bonnets of fine linen, and linen breeches of fine twined linen,

verses.raw: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And a girdle of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, of needlework; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote upon it a writing, like to the engravings of a signet, HOLINESS TO THE Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And they tied unto it a lace of blue, to fasten it on high upon the mitre; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did according to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.text: Thus was all the work of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation finished: and the children of Yashar'el did according to all that Yahuah commanded Moses, so did they.

verses.raw: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,
verses.text: And they brought the tabernacle unto Moses, the tent, and all his furniture, his taches, his boards, his bars, and his pillars, and his sockets,

verses.raw: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,
verses.text: And the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, and the covering of badgers’ skins, and the vail of the covering,

verses.raw: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,
verses.text: The ark of the testimony, and the staves thereof, and the mercy seat,

verses.raw: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,
verses.text: The table, and all the vessels thereof, and the shewbread,

verses.raw: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,
verses.text: The pure candlestick, with the lamps thereof, even with the lamps to be set in order, and all the vessels thereof, and the oil for light,

verses.raw: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,
verses.text: And the golden altar, and the anointing oil, and the sweet incense, and the hanging for the tabernacle door,

verses.raw: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,
verses.text: The brasen altar, and his grate of brass, his staves, and all his vessels, the laver and his foot,

verses.raw: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,
verses.text: The hangings of the court, his pillars, and his sockets, and the hanging for the court gate, his cords, and his pins, and all the vessels of the service of the tabernacle, for the tent of the congregation,

verses.raw: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.text: The cloths of service to do service in the holy place, and the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and his sons’ garments, to minister in the priest’s office.

verses.raw: According to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so the children of Yashar'el (Israel) made all the work.
verses.text: According to all that Yahuah commanded Moses, so the children of Yashar'el made all the work.

verses.raw: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.
verses.text: And Moses did look upon all the work, and, behold, they had done it as Yahuah had commanded, even so had they done it: and Moses blessed them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: On the first day of the first month shall you set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.text: On the first day of the first month shall you set up the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

verses.raw: And you shall put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.
verses.text: And you shall put therein the ark of the testimony, and cover the ark with the vail.

verses.raw: And you shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and you shall bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.
verses.text: And you shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are to be set in order upon it; and you shall bring in the candlestick, and light the lamps thereof.

verses.raw: And you shall set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.
verses.text: And you shall set the altar of gold for the incense before the ark of the testimony, and put the hanging of the door to the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And you shall set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.
verses.text: And you shall set the altar of the burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation.

verses.raw: And you shall set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shall put water therein.
verses.text: And you shall set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and shall put water therein.

verses.raw: And you shall set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
verses.text: And you shall set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.

verses.raw: And you shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shall hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.
verses.text: And you shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle, and all that is therein, and shall hallow it, and all the vessels thereof: and it shall be holy.

verses.raw: And you shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.
verses.text: And you shall anoint the altar of the burnt offering, and all his vessels, and sanctify the altar: and it shall be an altar most holy.

verses.raw: And you shall anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.
verses.text: And you shall anoint the laver and his foot, and sanctify it.

verses.raw: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.
verses.text: And you shall bring Aaron and his sons unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and wash them with water.

verses.raw: And you shall put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.
verses.text: And you shall put upon Aaron the holy garments, and anoint him, and sanctify him; that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

verses.raw: And you shall bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:
verses.text: And you shall bring his sons, and clothe them with coats:

verses.raw: And you shall anoint them, as you did anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.
verses.text: And you shall anoint them, as you did anoint their father, that they may minister unto me in the priest’s office: for their anointing shall surely be an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.

verses.raw: Thus did Moses: according to all that Yahuah (LORD) commanded him, so did he.
verses.text: Thus did Moses: according to all that Yahuah commanded him, so did he.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, that the tabernacle was reared up.

verses.raw: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.
verses.text: And Moses reared up the tabernacle, and fastened his sockets, and set up the boards thereof, and put in the bars thereof, and reared up his pillars.

verses.raw: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And he spread abroad the tent over the tabernacle, and put the covering of the tent above upon it; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:
verses.text: And he took and put the testimony into the ark, and set the staves on the ark, and put the mercy seat above upon the ark:

verses.raw: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And he brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the vail of the covering, and covered the ark of the testimony; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.
verses.text: And he put the table in the tent of the congregation, upon the side of the tabernacle northward, without the vail.

verses.raw: And he set the bread in order upon it before Yahuah (LORD); as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded Moses.
verses.text: And he set the bread in order upon it before Yahuah; as Yahuah had commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.text: And he put the candlestick in the tent of the congregation, over against the table, on the side of the tabernacle southward.

verses.raw: And he lighted the lamps before Yahuah (LORD); as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And he lighted the lamps before Yahuah; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:
verses.text: And he put the golden altar in the tent of the congregation before the vail:

verses.raw: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And he burnt sweet incense thereon; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.
verses.text: And he set up the hanging at the door of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And he put the altar of burnt offering by the door of the tabernacle of the tent of the congregation, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the meat offering; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.
verses.text: And he set the laver between the tent of the congregation and the altar, and put water there, to wash withal.

verses.raw: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron and his sons washed their hands and their feet thereat:

verses.raw: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: When they went into the tent of the congregation, and when they came near unto the altar, they washed; as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.
verses.text: And he reared up the court round about the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the hanging of the court gate. So Moses finished the work.

verses.raw: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) filled the tabernacle.
verses.text: Then a cloud covered the tent of the congregation, and the glory of Yahuah filled the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) filled the tabernacle.
verses.text: And Moses was not able to enter into the tent of the congregation, because the cloud abode thereon, and the glory of Yahuah filled the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went onward in all their journeys:
verses.text: And when the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Yashar'el went onward in all their journeys:

verses.raw: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.
verses.text: But if the cloud were not taken up, then they journeyed not till the day that it was taken up.

verses.raw: For the cloud of Yahuah (LORD) was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Yashar'el (Israel), throughout all their journeys.
verses.text: For the cloud of Yahuah was upon the tabernacle by day, and fire was on it by night, in the sight of all the house of Yashar'el, throughout all their journeys.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto Yahuah (LORD), you shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto Yahuah, you shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.

verses.raw: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

verses.text: As he has done this day, so Yahuah has commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

verses.raw: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest you die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel), bewail the burning which Yahuah (LORD) has kindled.

verses.raw: And you shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest you die: for the anointing oil of Yahuah (LORD) is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Aaron, saying,

verses.raw: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remains of the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:

verses.text: And you shall eat it in the holy place, because it is your due, and your sons’ due, of the sacrifices of Yahuah made by fire: for so I am commanded.

verses.raw: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,

verses.raw: Wherefore have you not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and Elohim (God) has given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: Wherefore have you not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and Elohim has given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahuah?

verses.raw: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before Yahuah (LORD); and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of Yahuah (LORD)?

verses.raw: And when Moses heard that, he was content.

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, These are the beasts which you shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

verses.raw: Nevertheless these shall you not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.text: Nevertheless these shall you not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.raw: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.text: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.raw: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.text: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.raw: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.

verses.text: The carcases of every beast which divides the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that touches them shall be unclean.

verses.raw: And whatsoever goes upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso touches their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

verses.raw: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever does touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

verses.raw: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, does fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

verses.raw: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falls, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and you shall break it.

verses.raw: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water comes shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

verses.raw: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falls shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

verses.raw: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.text: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

verses.raw: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before Yahuah (LORD) at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before Yahuah at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.raw: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Yahuah (LORD), and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Yahuah, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

verses.raw: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’S lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
verses.text: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’S lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.

verses.raw: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.text: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahuah, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

verses.raw: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
verses.text: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:

verses.raw: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before Yahuah (LORD), and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
verses.text: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before Yahuah, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:

verses.raw: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before Yahuah (LORD), that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.text: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before Yahuah, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

verses.raw: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.text: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

verses.raw: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.text: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

verses.raw: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remains among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Yashar'el, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remains among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

verses.raw: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goes in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goes in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before Yahuah (LORD), and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.text: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before Yahuah, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

verses.raw: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And when he has made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.text: And when he has made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

verses.raw: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
verses.text: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Yashar'el, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

verses.raw: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
verses.text: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:

verses.raw: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.text: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

verses.raw: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.text: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

verses.raw: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.text: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

verses.raw: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.text: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

verses.raw: And he that burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.text: And he that burns them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

verses.raw: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourns among you:
verses.text: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, you shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourns among you:

verses.raw: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that you may be clean from all your sins before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that you may be clean from all your sins before Yahuah.

verses.raw: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and you shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.text: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and you shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

verses.raw: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
verses.text: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:

verses.raw: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

verses.raw: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for all their sins once a year. And he did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Yashar'el for all their sins once a year. And he did as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them; This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded, saying,
verses.text: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them; This is the thing which Yahuah has commanded, saying,

verses.raw: What man soever there be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), that kills an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that kills it out of the camp,
verses.text: What man soever there be of the house of Yashar'el, that kills an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that kills it out of the camp,

verses.raw: And brings it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto Yahuah (LORD) before the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD); blood shall be imputed unto that man; he has shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.text: And brings it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto Yahuah before the tabernacle of Yahuah; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he has shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

verses.raw: To the end that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Yahuah (LORD), unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: To the end that the children of Yashar'el may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Yahuah, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Yahuah (LORD) at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Yahuah at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.text: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

verses.raw: And you shall say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.text: And you shall say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Yashar'el, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,

verses.raw: And brings it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto Yahuah (LORD); even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text: And brings it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto Yahuah; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.raw: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eats any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.text: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Yashar'el, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eats any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.raw: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that makes an atonement for the soul.
verses.text: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that makes an atonement for the soul.

verses.raw: Therefore I said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourns among you eat blood.
verses.text: Therefore I said unto the children of Yashar'el, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourns among you eat blood.

verses.raw: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catches any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.text: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Yashar'el, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catches any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

verses.raw: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), You shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eats it shall be cut off.
verses.text: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Yashar'el, You shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eats it shall be cut off.

verses.raw: And every soul that eats that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
verses.text: And every soul that eats that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

verses.raw: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.text: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein you dwelt, shall you not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall you not do: neither shall you walk in their ordinances.
verses.text: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein you dwelt, shall you not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall you not do: neither shall you walk in their ordinances.

verses.raw: You shall do my judgments, and keep my ordinances, to walk therein: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: You shall do my judgments, and keep my ordinances, to walk therein: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: You shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: The nakedness of your father, or the nakedness of your mother, shall you not uncover: she is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.text: The nakedness of your father, or the nakedness of your mother, shall you not uncover: she is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.

verses.raw: The nakedness of your father’s wife shall you not uncover: it is your father’s nakedness.
verses.text: The nakedness of your father’s wife shall you not uncover: it is your father’s nakedness.

verses.raw: The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or daughter of your mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness you shall not uncover.
verses.text: The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or daughter of your mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness you shall not uncover.

verses.raw: The nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness you shall not uncover: for theirs is your own nakedness.
verses.text: The nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness you shall not uncover: for theirs is your own nakedness.

verses.raw: The nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of your father, she is your sister, you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.text: The nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of your father, she is your sister, you shall not uncover her nakedness.

verses.raw: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister: she is your father’s near kinswoman.
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister: she is your father’s near kinswoman.

verses.raw: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister: for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister: for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.

verses.raw: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, you shall not approach to his wife: she is your aunt.
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, you shall not approach to his wife: she is your aunt.

verses.raw: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter in law: she is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter in law: she is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.

verses.raw: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife: it is your brother’s nakedness.
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife: it is your brother’s nakedness.

verses.raw: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shall you take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.text: You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shall you take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

verses.raw: Neither shall you take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
verses.text: Neither shall you take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.

verses.raw: Also you shall not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.text: Also you shall not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

verses.raw: Moreover you shall not lie carnally with your neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.text: Moreover you shall not lie carnally with your neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.

verses.raw: And you shall not let any of your seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shall you profane the name of your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall not let any of your seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shall you profane the name of your Elohim: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
verses.text: You shall not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

verses.raw: Neither shall you lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
verses.text: Neither shall you lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

verses.raw: Defile not you yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.text: Defile not you yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

verses.raw: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.text: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

verses.raw: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourns among you:
verses.text: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourns among you:

verses.raw: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.text: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)

verses.raw: That the land spue not you out also, when you defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
verses.text: That the land spue not you out also, when you defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.

verses.raw: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.text: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.raw: Therefore shall you keep my ordinance, that you commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that you defile not yourselves therein: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: Therefore shall you keep my ordinance, that you commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that you defile not yourselves therein: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, You shall be holy: for I Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) am holy.
verses.text: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, You shall be holy: for I Yahuah Elohaychem am holy.

verses.raw: You shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: You shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: Turn you not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: Turn you not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And if you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD), you shall offer it at your own will.
verses.text: And if you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto Yahuah, you shall offer it at your own will.

verses.raw: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.text: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.raw: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.text: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

verses.raw: Therefore every one that eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the hallowed thing of Yahuah (LORD): and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text: Therefore every one that eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the hallowed thing of Yahuah: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.raw: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
verses.text: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.

verses.raw: And you shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather every grape of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and stranger: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: And you shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather every grape of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and stranger: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: You shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.text: You shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

verses.raw: And you shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shall you profane the name of your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shall you profane the name of your Elohim: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall not defraud your neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with you all night until the morning.
verses.text: You shall not defraud your neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with you all night until the morning.

verses.raw: You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shall fear your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shall fear your Elohim: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: you shall not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shall you judge your neighbour.
verses.text: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: you shall not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shall you judge your neighbour.

verses.raw: You shall not go up and down as a talebearer among your people: neither shall you stand against the blood of your neighbour: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall not go up and down as a talebearer among your people: neither shall you stand against the blood of your neighbour: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall not hate your brother in your heart: you shall in any wise rebuke your neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.text: You shall not hate your brother in your heart: you shall in any wise rebuke your neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

verses.raw: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let your cattle gender with a diverse kind: you shall not sow your field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon you.
verses.text: You shall keep my statutes. You shall not let your cattle gender with a diverse kind: you shall not sow your field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon you.

verses.raw: And whosoever lies carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.text: And whosoever lies carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

verses.raw: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto Yahuah (LORD), unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.text: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto Yahuah, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

verses.raw: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahuah (LORD) for his sin which he has done: and the sin which he has done shall be forgiven him.
verses.text: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before Yahuah for his sin which he has done: and the sin which he has done shall be forgiven him.

verses.raw: And when you shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then you shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.text: And when you shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then you shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

verses.raw: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise Yahuah (LORD) withal.
verses.text: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise Yahuah withal.

verses.raw: And in the fifth year shall you eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: And in the fifth year shall you eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: You shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall you use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.text: You shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall you use enchantment, nor observe times.

verses.raw: You shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shall you mar the corners of your beard.
verses.text: You shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shall you mar the corners of your beard.

verses.raw: You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Do not prostitute your daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.text: Do not prostitute your daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

verses.raw: You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: You shall rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear your Elohim: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And if a stranger sojourn with you in your land, you shall not vex him.
verses.text: And if a stranger sojourn with you in your land, you shall not vex him.

verses.raw: But the stranger that dwells with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and you shall love him as thyself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: But the stranger that dwells with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and you shall love him as thyself; for you were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.text: You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

verses.raw: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall you have: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall you have: I am Yahuah Elohaychem, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: Therefore shall you observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore shall you observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Again, you shall say to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Whosoever he be of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers that sojourn in Yashar'el (Israel), that gives any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.text: Again, you shall say to the children of Yashar'el, Whosoever he be of the children of Yashar'el, or of the strangers that sojourn in Yashar'el, that gives any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

verses.raw: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he has given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.text: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he has given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

verses.raw: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he gives of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
verses.text: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he gives of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

verses.raw: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.text: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

verses.raw: And the soul that turns after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.text: And the soul that turns after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.raw: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be you holy: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be you holy: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And you shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Yahuah (LORD) which sanctify you.
verses.text: And you shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Yahuah which sanctify you.

verses.raw: For every one that curses his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he has cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.text: For every one that curses his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he has cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

verses.raw: And the man that commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he that commits adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: And the man that commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he that commits adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: And the man that lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.text: And the man that lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.raw: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.text: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.raw: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lies with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.text: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lies with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.raw: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.text: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

verses.raw: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and you shall slay the beast.
verses.text: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and you shall slay the beast.

verses.raw: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, you shall kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.text: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, you shall kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.raw: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.text: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.raw: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he has discovered her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.text: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he has discovered her fountain, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.raw: And you shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.text: And you shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.raw: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.
verses.text: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

verses.raw: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.
verses.text: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

verses.raw: You shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.
verses.text: You shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

verses.raw: And you shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
verses.text: And you shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

verses.raw: But I have said unto you, You shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that flows with milk and honey: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which have separated you from other people.
verses.text: But I have said unto you, You shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that flows with milk and honey: I am Yahuah Elohaychem, which have separated you from other people.

verses.raw: You shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and you shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creeps on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.
verses.text: You shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and you shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creeps on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

verses.raw: And you shall be holy unto me: for I Yahuah (LORD) am holy, and have severed you from other people, that you should be mine.
verses.text: And you shall be holy unto me: for I Yahuah am holy, and have severed you from other people, that you should be mine.

verses.raw: A man also or woman that has a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.
verses.text: A man also or woman that has a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

verses.raw: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,
verses.text: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

verses.raw: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which has had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
verses.text: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which has had no husband; for her may he be defiled.
