verses.raw: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
verses.text: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

verses.raw: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
verses.text: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

verses.raw: They shall be holy unto their Elohim (God), and not profane the name of their Elohim (God): for the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire, and the bread of their Elohim (God), they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.
verses.text: They shall be holy unto their Elohim, and not profane the name of their Elohim: for the offerings of Yahuah made by fire, and the bread of their Elohim, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

verses.raw: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his Elohim (God).
verses.text: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his Elohim.

verses.raw: You shall sanctify him therefore; for he offers the bread of your Elohim (God): he shall be holy unto you: for I Yahuah (LORD), which sanctify you, am holy.
verses.text: You shall sanctify him therefore; for he offers the bread of your Elohim: he shall be holy unto you: for I Yahuah, which sanctify you, am holy.

verses.raw: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.
verses.text: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

verses.raw: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;
verses.text: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

verses.raw: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;
verses.text: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

verses.raw: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his Elohim (God); for the crown of the anointing oil of his Elohim (God) is upon him: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his Elohim; for the crown of the anointing oil of his Elohim is upon him: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.
verses.text: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

verses.raw: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.
verses.text: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

verses.raw: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify him.
verses.text: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I Yahuah do sanctify him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of your seed in their generations that has any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his Elohim (God).
verses.text: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of your seed in their generations that has any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his Elohim.

verses.raw: For whatsoever man he be that has a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that has a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
verses.text: For whatsoever man he be that has a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that has a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

verses.raw: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
verses.text: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

verses.raw: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that has a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or has his stones broken;
verses.text: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that has a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or has his stones broken;

verses.raw: No man that has a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire: he has a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his Elohim (God).
verses.text: No man that has a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Yahuah made by fire: he has a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his Elohim.

verses.raw: He shall eat the bread of his Elohim (God), both of the most holy, and of the holy.
verses.text: He shall eat the bread of his Elohim, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

verses.raw: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he has a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify them.
verses.text: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he has a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I Yahuah do sanctify them.

verses.raw: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Yashar'el, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goes unto the holy things, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) hallow unto Yahuah (LORD), having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goes unto the holy things, which the children of Yashar'el hallow unto Yahuah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or has a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso touches any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;
verses.text: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or has a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso touches any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;

verses.raw: Or whosoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he has;
verses.text: Or whosoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he has;

verses.raw: The soul which has touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.
verses.text: The soul which has touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

verses.raw: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.
verses.text: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.

verses.raw: That which dies of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: That which dies of itself, or is torn with beasts, he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: They shall therefore keep my ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify them.
verses.text: They shall therefore keep my ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I Yahuah do sanctify them.

verses.raw: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
verses.text: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

verses.raw: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.
verses.text: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.

verses.raw: If the priest’s daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.
verses.text: If the priest’s daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

verses.raw: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.
verses.text: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

verses.raw: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.
verses.text: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.

verses.raw: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which they offer unto Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Yashar'el, which they offer unto Yahuah;

verses.raw: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I Yahuah (LORD) do sanctify them.
verses.text: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I Yahuah do sanctify them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), or of the strangers in Yashar'el (Israel), that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto Yahuah (LORD) for a burnt offering;
verses.text: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Yashar'el, or of the strangers in Yashar'el, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto Yahuah for a burnt offering;

verses.raw: You shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.
verses.text: You shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

verses.raw: But whatsoever has a blemish, that shall you not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.
verses.text: But whatsoever has a blemish, that shall you not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

verses.raw: And whosoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings unto Yahuah (LORD) to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.
verses.text: And whosoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings unto Yahuah to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

verses.raw: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, you shall not offer these unto Yahuah (LORD), nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, you shall not offer these unto Yahuah, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Either a bullock or a lamb that has any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that may you offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
verses.text: Either a bullock or a lamb that has any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that may you offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

verses.raw: You shall not offer unto Yahuah (LORD) that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall you make any offering thereof in your land.
verses.text: You shall not offer unto Yahuah that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall you make any offering thereof in your land.

verses.raw: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall you offer the bread of your Elohim (God) of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.
verses.text: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall you offer the bread of your Elohim of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And whether it be cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and her young both in one day.
verses.text: And whether it be cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

verses.raw: And when you will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Yahuah (LORD), offer it at your own will.
verses.text: And when you will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Yahuah, offer it at your own will.

verses.raw: On the same day it shall be eaten up; you shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: On the same day it shall be eaten up; you shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore shall you keep my commandments, and do them: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore shall you keep my commandments, and do them: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: Neither shall you profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Yashar'el (Israel): I am Yahuah (LORD) which hallow you,
verses.text: Neither shall you profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Yashar'el: I am Yahuah which hallow you,

verses.raw: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your Elohim: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

verses.raw: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; you shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of Yahuah (LORD) in all your dwellings.
verses.text: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; you shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of Yahuah in all your dwellings.

verses.raw: These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their seasons.
verses.text: These are the feasts of Yahuah, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their seasons.

verses.raw: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD’S passover.
verses.text: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD’S passover.

verses.raw: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Yahuah (LORD): seven days you must eat unleavened bread.
verses.text: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Yahuah: seven days you must eat unleavened bread.

verses.raw: In the first day you shall have an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.
verses.text: In the first day you shall have an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.

verses.raw: But you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD) seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.
verses.text: But you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, When you be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then you shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

verses.raw: And he shall wave the sheaf before Yahuah (LORD), to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
verses.text: And he shall wave the sheaf before Yahuah, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

verses.raw: And you shall offer that day when you wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall offer that day when you wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD) for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.
verses.text: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Yahuah for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

verses.raw: And you shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that you have brought an offering unto your Elohim (God): it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.text: And you shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that you have brought an offering unto your Elohim: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.raw: And you shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:
verses.text: And you shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

verses.raw: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall you number fifty days; and you shall offer a new meat offering unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall you number fifty days; and you shall offer a new meat offering unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: You shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And you shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto Yahuah (LORD), with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto Yahuah, with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then you shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
verses.text: Then you shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

verses.raw: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before Yahuah (LORD), with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Yahuah (LORD) for the priest.
verses.text: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before Yahuah, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Yahuah for the priest.

verses.raw: And you shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: you shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
verses.text: And you shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: you shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

verses.raw: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not make clean riddance of the corners of your field when you reapest, neither shall you gather any gleaning of your harvest: you shall leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not make clean riddance of the corners of your field when you reapest, neither shall you gather any gleaning of your harvest: you shall leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall you have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall you have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

verses.raw: You shall do no servile work therein: but you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall do no servile work therein: but you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and you shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and you shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And you shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: And you shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.text: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.raw: And whatsoever soul it be that does any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.
verses.text: And whatsoever soul it be that does any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

verses.raw: You shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.text: You shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.raw: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and you shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall you celebrate your sabbath.
verses.text: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and you shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall you celebrate your sabbath.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.
verses.text: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: you shall do no servile work therein.

verses.raw: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD): on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD): it is a solemn assembly; and you shall do no servile work therein.
verses.text: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah: on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and you shall offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah: it is a solemn assembly; and you shall do no servile work therein.

verses.raw: These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD), a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:
verses.text: These are the feasts of Yahuah, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto Yahuah, a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

verses.raw: Beside the sabbaths of Yahuah (LORD), and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which you give unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Beside the sabbaths of Yahuah, and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which you give unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruit of the land, you shall keep a feast unto Yahuah (LORD) seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.
verses.text: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruit of the land, you shall keep a feast unto Yahuah seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

verses.raw: And you shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) seven days.
verses.text: And you shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before Yahuah Elohaychem seven days.

verses.raw: And you shall keep it a feast unto Yahuah (LORD) seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.
verses.text: And you shall keep it a feast unto Yahuah seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: you shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

verses.raw: You shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:
verses.text: You shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

verses.raw: That your generations may know that I made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: That your generations may know that I made the children of Yashar'el to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And Moses declared unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) the feasts of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Moses declared unto the children of Yashar'el the feasts of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they bring unto you pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.
verses.text: Command the children of Yashar'el, that they bring unto you pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

verses.raw: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before Yahuah (LORD) continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.
verses.text: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before Yahuah continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

verses.raw: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Yahuah (LORD) continually.
verses.text: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Yahuah continually.

verses.raw: And you shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.
verses.text: And you shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

verses.raw: And you shall set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And you shall put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before Yahuah (LORD) continually, being taken from the children of Yashar'el (Israel) by an everlasting covenant.
verses.text: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before Yahuah continually, being taken from the children of Yashar'el by an everlasting covenant.

verses.raw: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Yahuah (LORD) made by fire by a perpetual statute.
verses.text: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Yahuah made by fire by a perpetual statute.

verses.raw: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Yashar'el (Israel) strove together in the camp;
verses.text: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Yashar'el: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Yashar'el strove together in the camp;

verses.raw: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of Yahuah (LORD), and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)
verses.text: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of Yahuah, and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

verses.raw: And they put him in ward, that the mind of Yahuah (LORD) might be shewed them.
verses.text: And they put him in ward, that the mind of Yahuah might be shewed them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Bring forth him that has cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
verses.text: Bring forth him that has cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

verses.raw: And you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Whosoever curses his Elohim (God) shall bear his sin.
verses.text: And you shall speak unto the children of Yashar'el, saying, Whosoever curses his Elohim shall bear his sin.

verses.raw: And he that blasphemeth the name of Yahuah (LORD), he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of Yahuah (LORD), shall be put to death.
verses.text: And he that blasphemeth the name of Yahuah, he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of Yahuah, shall be put to death.

verses.raw: And he that kills any man shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: And he that kills any man shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: And he that kills a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.
verses.text: And he that kills a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

verses.raw: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he has done, so shall it be done to him;
verses.text: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he has done, so shall it be done to him;

verses.raw: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he has caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.
verses.text: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he has caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again.

verses.raw: And he that kills a beast, he shall restore it: and he that kills a man, he shall be put to death.
verses.text: And he that kills a beast, he shall restore it: and he that kills a man, he shall be put to death.

verses.raw: You shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: You shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And Moses spake to the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: And Moses spake to the children of Yashar'el, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Yashar'el did as Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, When you come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;
verses.text: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

verses.raw: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for Yahuah (LORD): you shall neither sow your field, nor prune your vineyard.
verses.text: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for Yahuah: you shall neither sow your field, nor prune your vineyard.

verses.raw: That which grows of its own accord of your harvest you shall not reap, neither gather the grapes of your vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.
verses.text: That which grows of its own accord of your harvest you shall not reap, neither gather the grapes of your vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

verses.raw: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for you, and for your servant, and for your maid, and for your hired servant, and for your stranger that sojourns with you,
verses.text: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for you, and for your servant, and for your maid, and for your hired servant, and for your stranger that sojourns with you,

verses.raw: And for your cattle, and for the beast that are in your land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.
verses.text: And for your cattle, and for the beast that are in your land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

verses.raw: And you shall number seven sabbaths of years unto you, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto you forty and nine years.
verses.text: And you shall number seven sabbaths of years unto you, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto you forty and nine years.

verses.raw: Then shall you cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall you make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.
verses.text: Then shall you cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall you make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

verses.raw: And you shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and you shall return every man unto his possession, and you shall return every man unto his family.
verses.text: And you shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and you shall return every man unto his possession, and you shall return every man unto his family.

verses.raw: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of your vine undressed.
verses.text: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of your vine undressed.

verses.raw: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: you shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.
verses.text: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: you shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

verses.raw: In the year of this jubile you shall return every man unto his possession.
verses.text: In the year of this jubile you shall return every man unto his possession.

verses.raw: And if you sell ought unto your neighbour, or buyest ought of your neighbour’s hand, you shall not oppress one another:
verses.text: And if you sell ought unto your neighbour, or buyest ought of your neighbour’s hand, you shall not oppress one another:

verses.raw: According to the number of years after the jubile you shall buy of your neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto you:
verses.text: According to the number of years after the jubile you shall buy of your neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto you:

verses.raw: According to the multitude of years you shall increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years you shall diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits does he sell unto you.
verses.text: According to the multitude of years you shall increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years you shall diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits does he sell unto you.

verses.raw: You shall not therefore oppress one another; but you shall fear your Elohim (God): for I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: You shall not therefore oppress one another; but you shall fear your Elohim: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: Wherefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
verses.text: Wherefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

verses.raw: And the land shall yield her fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
verses.text: And the land shall yield her fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

verses.raw: And if you shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:
verses.text: And if you shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

verses.raw: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.
verses.text: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

verses.raw: And you shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in you shall eat of the old store.
verses.text: And you shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in you shall eat of the old store.

verses.raw: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for you are strangers and sojourners with me.
verses.text: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for you are strangers and sojourners with me.

verses.raw: And in all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
verses.text: And in all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

verses.raw: If your brother be waxen poor, and has sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.
verses.text: If your brother be waxen poor, and has sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

verses.raw: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;
verses.text: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

verses.raw: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.
verses.text: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

verses.raw: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that has bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.
verses.text: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that has bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

verses.raw: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.
verses.text: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

verses.raw: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.
verses.text: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

verses.raw: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.
verses.text: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.
verses.text: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

verses.raw: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.
verses.text: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

verses.raw: And if your brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with you; then you shall relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with you.
verses.text: And if your brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with you; then you shall relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with you.

verses.raw: Take you no usury of him, or increase: but fear your Elohim (God); that your brother may live with you.
verses.text: Take you no usury of him, or increase: but fear your Elohim; that your brother may live with you.

verses.raw: You shall not give him your money upon usury, nor lend him your victuals for increase.
verses.text: You shall not give him your money upon usury, nor lend him your victuals for increase.

verses.raw: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your Elohim (God).
verses.text: I am Yahuah Elohaychem, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your Elohim.

verses.raw: And if your brother that dwells by you be waxen poor, and be sold unto you; you shall not compel him to serve as a bondservant:
verses.text: And if your brother that dwells by you be waxen poor, and be sold unto you; you shall not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

verses.raw: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with you, and shall serve you unto the year of jubile:
verses.text: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with you, and shall serve you unto the year of jubile:

verses.raw: And then shall he depart from you, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.
verses.text: And then shall he depart from you, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

verses.raw: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.
verses.text: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

verses.raw: You shall not rule over him with rigour; but shall fear your Elohim (God).
verses.text: You shall not rule over him with rigour; but shall fear your Elohim.

verses.raw: Both your bondmen, and your bondmaids, which you shall have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall you buy bondmen and bondmaids.
verses.text: Both your bondmen, and your bondmaids, which you shall have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall you buy bondmen and bondmaids.

verses.raw: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall you buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.
verses.text: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall you buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

verses.raw: And you shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Yashar'el (Israel), you shall not rule one over another with rigour.
verses.text: And you shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Yashar'el, you shall not rule one over another with rigour.

verses.raw: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by you, and your brother that dwells by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by you, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:
verses.text: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by you, and your brother that dwells by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by you, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:

verses.raw: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:
verses.text: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

verses.raw: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.
verses.text: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

verses.raw: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.
verses.text: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

verses.raw: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.
verses.text: If there be yet many years behind, according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

verses.raw: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.
verses.text: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

verses.raw: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in your sight.
verses.text: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in your sight.

verses.raw: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.
verses.text: And if he be not redeemed in these years, then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.

verses.raw: For unto me the children of Yashar'el (Israel) are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: For unto me the children of Yashar'el are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: You shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall you set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: You shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall you set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: You shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;
verses.text: If you walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

verses.raw: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.
verses.text: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

verses.raw: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.
verses.text: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and you shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

verses.raw: And I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.
verses.text: And I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

verses.raw: And you shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.text: And you shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.raw: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.text: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.raw: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.
verses.text: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

verses.raw: And you shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.
verses.text: And you shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

verses.raw: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.
verses.text: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

verses.raw: And I will walk among you, and will be your Elohim (God), and you shall be my people.
verses.text: And I will walk among you, and will be your Elohim, and you shall be my people.

verses.raw: I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.
verses.text: I am Yahuah Elohaychem, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

verses.raw: But if you will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;
verses.text: But if you will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

verses.raw: And if you shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that you will not do all my commandments, but that you break my covenant:
verses.text: And if you shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that you will not do all my commandments, but that you break my covenant:

verses.raw: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.
verses.text: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and you shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

verses.raw: And I will set my face against you, and you shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and you shall flee when none pursueth you.
verses.text: And I will set my face against you, and you shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and you shall flee when none pursueth you.

verses.raw: And if you will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
verses.text: And if you will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

verses.raw: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:
verses.text: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

verses.raw: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
verses.text: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

verses.raw: And if you walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.
verses.text: And if you walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

verses.raw: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.
verses.text: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.

verses.raw: And if you will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;
verses.text: And if you will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

verses.raw: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.
verses.text: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

verses.raw: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when you are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.
verses.text: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when you are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and you shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

verses.raw: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and you shall eat, and not be satisfied.
verses.text: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and you shall eat, and not be satisfied.

verses.raw: And if you will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;
verses.text: And if you will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

verses.raw: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.
verses.text: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

verses.raw: And you shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall you eat.
verses.text: And you shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall you eat.

verses.raw: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.
verses.text: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

verses.raw: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.
verses.text: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

verses.raw: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.
verses.text: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

verses.raw: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.
verses.text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

verses.raw: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lies desolate, and you be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.
verses.text: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lies desolate, and you be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

verses.raw: As long as it lies desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when you dwelt upon it.
verses.text: As long as it lies desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when you dwelt upon it.

verses.raw: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.
verses.text: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

verses.raw: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.
verses.text: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and you shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

verses.raw: And you shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.
verses.text: And you shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

verses.raw: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.
verses.text: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

verses.raw: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;
verses.text: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

verses.raw: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:
verses.text: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

verses.raw: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.
verses.text: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

verses.raw: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lies desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.
verses.text: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lies desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

verses.raw: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am Yahuah their Elohim.

verses.raw: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their Elohim (God): I am Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their Elohim: I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which Yahuah (LORD) made between him and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.
verses.text: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which Yahuah made between him and the children of Yashar'el in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for Yahuah (LORD) by your estimation.
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for Yahuah by your estimation.

verses.raw: And your estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even your estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.
verses.text: And your estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even your estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And if it be a female, then your estimation shall be thirty shekels.
verses.text: And if it be a female, then your estimation shall be thirty shekels.

verses.raw: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then your estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.text: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then your estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

verses.raw: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then your estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female your estimation shall be three shekels of silver.
verses.text: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then your estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female your estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

verses.raw: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then your estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
verses.text: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then your estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

verses.raw: But if he be poorer than your estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.
verses.text: But if he be poorer than your estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

verses.raw: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto Yahuah (LORD), all that any man gives of such unto Yahuah (LORD) shall be holy.
verses.text: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto Yahuah, all that any man gives of such unto Yahuah shall be holy.

verses.raw: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.
verses.text: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

verses.raw: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto Yahuah (LORD), then he shall present the beast before the priest:
verses.text: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto Yahuah, then he shall present the beast before the priest:

verses.raw: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as you valuest it, who are the priest, so shall it be.
verses.text: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as you valuest it, who are the priest, so shall it be.

verses.raw: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto your estimation.
verses.text: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto your estimation.

verses.raw: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto Yahuah (LORD), then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
verses.text: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto Yahuah, then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.
