verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given you the charge of my heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Yashar'el; unto you have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, by an ordinance for ever.

verses.raw: This shall be your of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.
verses.text: This shall be your of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

verses.raw: In the most holy place shall you eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto you.
verses.text: In the most holy place shall you eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto you.

verses.raw: And this is yours; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): I have given them unto you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in your house shall eat of it.
verses.text: And this is yours; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Yashar'el: I have given them unto you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in your house shall eat of it.

verses.raw: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto Yahuah (LORD), them have I given you.
verses.text: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto Yahuah, them have I given you.

verses.raw: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto Yahuah (LORD), shall be yours; every one that is clean in your house shall eat of it.
verses.text: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto Yahuah, shall be yours; every one that is clean in your house shall eat of it.

verses.raw: Every thing devoted in Yashar'el (Israel) shall be yours.
verses.text: Every thing devoted in Yashar'el shall be yours.

verses.raw: Every thing that opens the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto Yahuah (LORD), whether it be of men or beasts, shall be yours: nevertheless the firstborn of man shall you surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shall you redeem.
verses.text: Every thing that opens the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto Yahuah, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be yours: nevertheless the firstborn of man shall you surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shall you redeem.

verses.raw: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shall you redeem, according to your estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.text: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shall you redeem, according to your estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

verses.raw: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, you shall not redeem; they are holy: you shall sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, you shall not redeem; they are holy: you shall sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the flesh of them shall be yours, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are yours.
verses.text: And the flesh of them shall be yours, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are yours.

verses.raw: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) offer unto Yahuah (LORD), have I given you, and your sons and your daughters with you, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before Yahuah (LORD) unto you and to your seed with you.
verses.text: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Yashar'el offer unto Yahuah, have I given you, and your sons and your daughters with you, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before Yahuah unto you and to your seed with you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Aaron, You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any part among them: I am your part and your inheritance among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Aaron, You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any part among them: I am your part and your inheritance among the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Yashar'el (Israel) for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Yashar'el for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.raw: Neither must the children of Yashar'el (Israel) henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.text: Neither must the children of Yashar'el henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

verses.raw: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Yashar'el (Israel) they have no inheritance.
verses.text: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Yashar'el they have no inheritance.

verses.raw: But the tithes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which they offer as an heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD), I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Yashar'el (Israel) they shall have no inheritance.
verses.text: But the tithes of the children of Yashar'el, which they offer as an heave offering unto Yahuah, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Yashar'el they shall have no inheritance.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When you take of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up an heave offering of it for Yahuah (LORD), even a tenth part of the tithe.
verses.text: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When you take of the children of Yashar'el the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up an heave offering of it for Yahuah, even a tenth part of the tithe.

verses.raw: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.text: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

verses.raw: Thus you also shall offer an heave offering unto Yahuah (LORD) of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and you shall give thereof the LORD’S heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.text: Thus you also shall offer an heave offering unto Yahuah of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Yashar'el; and you shall give thereof the LORD’S heave offering to Aaron the priest.

verses.raw: Out of all your gifts you shall offer every heave offering of Yahuah (LORD), of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
verses.text: Out of all your gifts you shall offer every heave offering of Yahuah, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall say unto them, When you have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.text: Therefore you shall say unto them, When you have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

verses.raw: And you shall eat it in every place, you and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text: And you shall eat it in every place, you and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.raw: And you shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall you pollute the holy things of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), lest you die.
verses.text: And you shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall you pollute the holy things of the children of Yashar'el, lest you die.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.raw: This is the ordinance of the law which Yahuah (LORD) has commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they bring you a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
verses.text: This is the ordinance of the law which Yahuah has commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, that they bring you a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:

verses.raw: And you shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
verses.text: And you shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

verses.raw: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
verses.text: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

verses.raw: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
verses.text: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

verses.raw: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.text: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

verses.raw: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

verses.raw: And he that burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
verses.text: And he that burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

verses.raw: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
verses.text: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Yashar'el for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.

verses.raw: And he that gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and unto the stranger that sojourns among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.text: And he that gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Yashar'el, and unto the stranger that sojourns among them, for a statute for ever.

verses.raw: He that touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.text: He that touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

verses.raw: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.text: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

verses.raw: Whosoever touches the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defiles the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD); and that soul shall be cut off from Yashar'el (Israel): because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
verses.text: Whosoever touches the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defiles the tabernacle of Yahuah; and that soul shall be cut off from Yashar'el: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

verses.raw: This is the law, when a man dies in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.text: This is the law, when a man dies in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.raw: And every open vessel, which has no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
verses.text: And every open vessel, which has no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

verses.raw: And whosoever touches one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.text: And whosoever touches one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.raw: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.text: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

verses.raw: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.text: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

verses.raw: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
verses.text: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

verses.raw: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahuah (LORD): the water of separation has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
verses.text: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he has defiled the sanctuary of Yahuah: the water of separation has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

verses.raw: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that touches the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
verses.text: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that touches the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

verses.raw: And whatsoever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until even.
verses.text: And whatsoever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until even.

verses.raw: Then came the children of Yashar'el (Israel), even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.text: Then came the children of Yashar'el, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

verses.raw: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.text: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

verses.raw: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would Elohim (God) that we had died when our brethren died before Yahuah (LORD)!
verses.text: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would Elohim that we had died when our brethren died before Yahuah!

verses.raw: And why have you brought up the congregation of Yahuah (LORD) into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.text: And why have you brought up the congregation of Yahuah into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

verses.raw: And wherefore have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
verses.text: And wherefore have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

verses.raw: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto them.
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of Yahuah appeared unto them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Take the rod, and gather you the assembly together, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak you unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and you shall bring forth to them water out of the rock: so you shall give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.text: Take the rod, and gather you the assembly together, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak you unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and you shall bring forth to them water out of the rock: so you shall give the congregation and their beasts drink.

verses.raw: And Moses took the rod from before Yahuah (LORD), as he commanded him.
verses.text: And Moses took the rod from before Yahuah, as he commanded him.

verses.raw: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, you rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, you rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

verses.raw: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
verses.text: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because you believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), therefore you shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because you believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Yashar'el, therefore you shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

verses.raw: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Yashar'el (Israel) strove with Yahuah (LORD), and he was sanctified in them.
verses.text: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Yashar'el strove with Yahuah, and he was sanctified in them.

verses.raw: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus says your brother Yashar'el (Israel), You know all the travail that has befallen us:
verses.text: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus says your brother Yashar'el, You know all the travail that has befallen us:

verses.raw: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.text: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:

verses.raw: And when we cried unto Yahuah (LORD), he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and has brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of your border:
verses.text: And when we cried unto Yahuah, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and has brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of your border:

verses.raw: Let us pass, I pray you, through your country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your borders.
verses.text: Let us pass, I pray you, through your country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your borders.

verses.raw: And Edom said unto him, You shall not pass by me, lest I come out against you with the sword.
verses.text: And Edom said unto him, You shall not pass by me, lest I come out against you with the sword.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of your water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of your water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else, go through on my feet.

verses.raw: And he said, You shall not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.text: And he said, You shall not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

verses.raw: Thus Edom refused to give Yashar'el (Israel) passage through his border: wherefore Yashar'el (Israel) turned away from him.
verses.text: Thus Edom refused to give Yashar'el passage through his border: wherefore Yashar'el turned away from him.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel), even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,

verses.raw: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), because you rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.text: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Yashar'el, because you rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

verses.raw: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
verses.text: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:

verses.raw: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
verses.text: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.

verses.raw: And Moses did as Yahuah (LORD) commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.text: And Moses did as Yahuah commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

verses.raw: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
verses.text: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

verses.raw: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Yashar'el (Israel) came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Yashar'el (Israel), and took some of them prisoners.
verses.text: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Yashar'el came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Yashar'el, and took some of them prisoners.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) vowed a vow unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
verses.text: And Yashar'el vowed a vow unto Yahuah, and said, If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) hearkened to the voice of Yashar'el (Israel), and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.text: And Yahuah hearkened to the voice of Yashar'el, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

verses.raw: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.text: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

verses.raw: And the people spake against Elohim (God), and against Moses, Wherefore have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.text: And the people spake against Elohim, and against Moses, Wherefore have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Yashar'el (Israel) died.
verses.text: And Yahuah sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Yashar'el died.

verses.raw: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against Yahuah (LORD), and against you; pray unto Yahuah (LORD), that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.text: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against Yahuah, and against you; pray unto Yahuah, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Make you a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looks upon it, shall live.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Make you a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looks upon it, shall live.

verses.raw: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.text: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

verses.raw: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.text: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

verses.raw: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
verses.text: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.

verses.raw: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.text: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

verses.raw: And at the stream of the brooks that goes down to the dwelling of Ar, and lies upon the border of Moab.
verses.text: And at the stream of the brooks that goes down to the dwelling of Ar, and lies upon the border of Moab.

verses.raw: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.text: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof Yahuah spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

verses.text: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

verses.raw: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks toward Jeshimon.
verses.text: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks toward Jeshimon.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.text: And Yashar'el sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

verses.raw: Let me pass through your land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king’s high way, until we be past your borders.
verses.text: Let me pass through your land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king’s high way, until we be past your borders.

verses.raw: And Sihon would not suffer Yashar'el (Israel) to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Yashar'el (Israel) into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Sihon would not suffer Yashar'el to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Yashar'el into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.text: And Yashar'el smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) took all these cities: and Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
verses.text: And Yashar'el took all these cities: and Yashar'el dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

verses.raw: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
verses.text: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

verses.raw: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
verses.text: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

verses.raw: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it has consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.text: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it has consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.

verses.raw: Woe to you, Moab! you are undone, O people of Chemosh: he has given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.text: Woe to you, Moab! you are undone, O people of Chemosh: he has given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

verses.raw: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reaches unto Medeba.
verses.text: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reaches unto Medeba.

verses.raw: Thus Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.text: Thus Yashar'el dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

verses.raw: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
verses.text: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

verses.raw: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
verses.text: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into your hand, and all his people, and his land; and you shall do to him as you did unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into your hand, and all his people, and his land; and you shall do to him as you did unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

verses.raw: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
verses.text: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.

verses.raw: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Yashar'el (Israel) had done to the Amorites.
verses.text: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Yashar'el had done to the Amorites.

verses.raw: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.text: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.

verses.raw: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
verses.text: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

verses.raw: Come now therefore, I pray you, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom you blessest is blessed, and he whom you cursest is cursed.
verses.text: Come now therefore, I pray you, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom you blessest is blessed, and he whom you cursest is cursed.

verses.raw: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.text: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahuah (LORD) shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as Yahuah shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with you?
verses.text: And Elohim came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with you?

verses.raw: And Balaam said unto Elohim (God), Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent unto me, saying,
verses.text: And Balaam said unto Elohim, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covers the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.text: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covers the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said unto Balaam, You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people: for they are blessed.
verses.text: And Elohim said unto Balaam, You shall not go with them; you shall not curse the people: for they are blessed.

verses.raw: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for Yahuah (LORD) refuses to give me leave to go with you.
verses.text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for Yahuah refuses to give me leave to go with you.

verses.raw: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuses to come with us.
verses.text: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuses to come with us.

verses.raw: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
verses.text: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

verses.raw: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray you, hinder you from coming unto me:
verses.text: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus says Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray you, hinder you from coming unto me:

verses.raw: For I will promote you unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever you say unto me: come therefore, I pray you, curse me this people.
verses.text: For I will promote you unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever you say unto me: come therefore, I pray you, curse me this people.

verses.raw: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God), to do less or more.
verses.text: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of Yahuah Elohai, to do less or more.

verses.raw: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry you also here this night, that I may know what Yahuah (LORD) will say unto me more.
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry you also here this night, that I may know what Yahuah will say unto me more.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call you, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto you, that shall you do.
verses.text: And Elohim came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call you, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto you, that shall you do.

verses.raw: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.text: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

verses.raw: And Elohim's (God’s) anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of Yahuah (LORD) stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
verses.text: And Elohim's (God’s) anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of Yahuah stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

verses.raw: And the ass saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD) standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.text: And the ass saw the angel of Yahuah standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

verses.raw: But the angel of Yahuah (LORD) stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.text: But the angel of Yahuah stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

verses.raw: And when the ass saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD), she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.text: And when the ass saw the angel of Yahuah, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

verses.raw: And when the ass saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD), she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.text: And when the ass saw the angel of Yahuah, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto you, that you have smitten me these three times?
verses.text: And Yahuah opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto you, that you have smitten me these three times?

verses.raw: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because you have mocked me: I would there were a sword in my hand, for now would I kill you.
verses.text: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because you have mocked me: I would there were a sword in my hand, for now would I kill you.

verses.raw: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I your ass, upon which you have ridden ever since I was your unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto you? And he said, Nay.
verses.text: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I your ass, upon which you have ridden ever since I was your unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto you? And he said, Nay.

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (LORD) opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD) standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
verses.text: Then Yahuah opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of Yahuah standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Wherefore have you smitten your ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand you, because your way is perverse before me:
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah said unto him, Wherefore have you smitten your ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand you, because your way is perverse before me:

verses.raw: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain you, and saved her alive.
verses.text: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain you, and saved her alive.

verses.raw: And Balaam said unto the angel of Yahuah (LORD), I have sinned; for I knew not that you stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease you, I will get me back again.
verses.text: And Balaam said unto the angel of Yahuah, I have sinned; for I knew not that you stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease you, I will get me back again.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto you, that you shall speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto you, that you shall speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

verses.raw: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
verses.text: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.

verses.raw: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto you to call you? wherefore came you not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote you to honour?
verses.text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto you to call you? wherefore came you not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote you to honour?

verses.raw: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto you: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that Elohim (God) puts in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto you: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that Elohim puts in my mouth, that shall I speak.

verses.raw: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.
verses.text: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.

verses.raw: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
verses.text: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.

verses.raw: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

verses.raw: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.text: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.

verses.raw: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure Yahuah (LORD) will come to meet me: and whatsoever he shows me I will tell you. And he went to an high place.
verses.text: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure Yahuah will come to meet me: and whatsoever he shows me I will tell you. And he went to an high place.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.text: And Elohim met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus you shall speak.
verses.text: And Yahuah put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus you shall speak.

verses.raw: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.text: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

verses.raw: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab has brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab has brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Yashar'el.

verses.raw: How shall I curse, whom Elohim (God) has not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom Yahuah (LORD) has not defied?
verses.text: How shall I curse, whom Elohim has not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom Yahuah has not defied?

verses.raw: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.text: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

verses.raw: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Yashar'el (Israel)? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.text: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Yashar'el? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

verses.raw: And Balak said unto Balaam, What have you done unto me? I took you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have blessed them altogether.
verses.text: And Balak said unto Balaam, What have you done unto me? I took you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have blessed them altogether.

verses.raw: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahuah (LORD) has put in my mouth?
verses.text: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahuah has put in my mouth?

verses.raw: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray you, with me unto another place, from whence you may see them: you shall see but the utmost part of them, and shall not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.text: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray you, with me unto another place, from whence you may see them: you shall see but the utmost part of them, and shall not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

verses.raw: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.text: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

verses.raw: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet Yahuah (LORD) yonder.
verses.text: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet Yahuah yonder.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.text: And Yahuah met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

verses.raw: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What has Yahuah (LORD) spoken?
verses.text: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What has Yahuah spoken?

verses.raw: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, you son of Zippor:
verses.text: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, you son of Zippor:

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of Adam, that he should repent: has he said, and shall he not do it? or has he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.text: Elohim is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of Adam, that he should repent: has he said, and shall he not do it? or has he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

verses.raw: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he has blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.text: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he has blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

verses.raw: He has not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither has he seen perverseness in Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
verses.text: He has not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither has he seen perverseness in Yashar'el: Yahuah Elohav is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) brought them out of Egypt; he has as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.text: Elohim brought them out of Egypt; he has as it were the strength of an unicorn.

verses.raw: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Yashar'el (Israel): according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Yashar'el (Israel), What has Elohim (God) wrought!
verses.text: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Yashar'el: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Yashar'el, What has Elohim wrought!

verses.raw: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.text: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

verses.raw: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.text: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

verses.raw: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I you, saying, All that Yahuah (LORD) speaks, that I must do?

verses.raw: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which Yahuah (LORD) has planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

verses.raw: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) brought him forth out of Egypt; he has as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

verses.raw: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesses you, and cursed is he that curses you.

verses.raw: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

verses.raw: Therefore now flee you to your place: I thought to promote you unto great honour; but, lo, Yahuah (LORD) has kept you back from honour.

verses.text: But your servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before Yahuah to battle, as my lord says.

verses.raw: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before Yahuah (LORD), and the land shall be subdued before you; then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.text: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before Yahuah, and the land shall be subdued before you; then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

verses.raw: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Yahuah (LORD) has said unto your servants, so will we do.
verses.text: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As Yahuah has said unto your servants, so will we do.

verses.raw: We will pass over armed before Yahuah (LORD) into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
verses.text: We will pass over armed before Yahuah into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.

verses.raw: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

verses.raw: These are the journeys of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.raw: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of Yahuah (LORD): and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

verses.raw: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.text: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Yashar'el went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

verses.raw: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which Yahuah (LORD) had smitten among them: upon their gods also Yahuah (LORD) executed judgments.

verses.text: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

verses.raw: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.

verses.text: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

verses.text: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.text: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.text: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.text: Speak unto the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, When you are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

verses.raw: Then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.text: Then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

verses.raw: And you shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.text: And you shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

verses.raw: And you shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falls; according to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.
verses.text: And you shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falls; according to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.

verses.raw: But if you will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which you let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein you dwell.
verses.text: But if you will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which you let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein you dwell.

verses.raw: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.text: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.raw: Command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, When you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.text: Command the children of Yashar'el, and say unto them, When you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

verses.raw: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.text: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

verses.raw: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.text: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:

verses.raw: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.text: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

verses.raw: And as for the western border, you shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.text: And as for the western border, you shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

verses.raw: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.text: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall point out for you mount Hor:

verses.raw: From mount Hor you shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.text: From mount Hor you shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

verses.raw: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
verses.text: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

verses.raw: And you shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
verses.text: And you shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:

verses.raw: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
verses.text: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

verses.raw: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.text: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

verses.raw: And Moses commanded the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.text: And Moses commanded the children of Yashar'el, saying, This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which Yahuah commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

verses.raw: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

verses.raw: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.text: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.text: And you shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

verses.raw: Command the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and you shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

verses.raw: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.text: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

verses.text: And among the cities which you shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which you shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them you shall add forty and two cities.

verses.raw: You shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall you give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
verses.text: You shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall you give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

verses.raw: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that kills any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.text: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Yashar'el, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that kills any person unawares may flee thither.

verses.raw: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.text: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.raw: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
verses.text: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

verses.raw: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
verses.text: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

verses.raw: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
verses.text: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

verses.raw: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
verses.text: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

verses.raw: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
verses.text: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

verses.raw: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.text: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

verses.raw: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.text: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

verses.raw: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.text: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

verses.raw: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
verses.text: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

verses.raw: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.text: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

verses.raw: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.text: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.raw: Whoso kills any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
verses.text: Whoso kills any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

verses.raw: Moreover you shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
verses.text: Moreover you shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

verses.raw: And you shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.text: And you shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

verses.raw: So you shall not pollute the land wherein you are: for blood it defiles the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.text: So you shall not pollute the land wherein you are: for blood it defiles the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

verses.raw: Defile not therefore the land which you shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I Yahuah (LORD) dwell among the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Defile not therefore the land which you shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I Yahuah dwell among the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And they said, Yahuah (LORD) commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and my lord was commanded by Yahuah (LORD) to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.text: And they said, Yahuah commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Yashar'el: and my lord was commanded by Yahuah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

verses.raw: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.text: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Yashar'el, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

verses.raw: And when the jubile of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
verses.text: And when the jubile of the children of Yashar'el shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

verses.raw: And Moses commanded the children of Yashar'el (Israel) according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph has said well.
verses.text: And Moses commanded the children of Yashar'el according to the word of Yahuah, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph has said well.

verses.raw: This is the thing which Yahuah (LORD) does command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
verses.text: This is the thing which Yahuah does command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
