verses.raw: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.text: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Yashar'el remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Yashar'el shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

verses.raw: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.text: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Yashar'el, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Yashar'el may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

verses.raw: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.text: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Yashar'el shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

verses.raw: Even as Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.text: Even as Yahuah commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

verses.raw: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:
verses.text: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:

verses.raw: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.text: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

verses.raw: These are the commandments and the judgments, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.text: These are the commandments and the judgments, which Yahuah commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Yashar'el in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.raw: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Yashar'el (Israel) on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.text: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Yashar'el on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

verses.raw: (There are eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)
verses.text: (There are eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), according unto all that Yahuah (LORD) had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.text: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Yashar'el, according unto all that Yahuah had given him in commandment unto them;

verses.raw: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.text: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

verses.raw: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.text: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

verses.raw: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) spake unto us in Horeb, saying, You have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.text: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) spake unto us in Horeb, saying, You have dwelt long enough in this mount:

verses.raw: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.text: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

verses.raw: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
verses.text: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which Yahuah sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

verses.raw: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.text: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

verses.raw: Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has multiplied you, and, behold, you are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.text: Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has multiplied you, and, behold, you are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

verses.raw: (Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as you are, and bless you, as he has promised you!)
verses.text: (Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as you are, and bless you, as he has promised you!)

verses.raw: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.text: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

verses.raw: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.text: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

verses.raw: And you answered me, and said, The thing which you have spoken is good for us to do.
verses.text: And you answered me, and said, The thing which you have spoken is good for us to do.

verses.raw: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.text: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

verses.raw: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.text: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

verses.raw: You shall not respect persons in judgment; but you shall hear the small as well as the great; you shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is Elohim's (God’s): and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.text: You shall not respect persons in judgment; but you shall hear the small as well as the great; you shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is Elohim's (God’s): and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

verses.raw: And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.
verses.text: And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

verses.raw: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which you saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
verses.text: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which you saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as Yahuah Eloheinu commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.raw: And I said unto you, You are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) does give unto us.
verses.text: And I said unto you, You are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which Yahuah Eloheinu does give unto us.

verses.raw: Behold, Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has set the land before you: go up and possess it, as Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers has said unto you; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.text: Behold, Yahuah Elohayka has set the land before you: go up and possess it, as Yahuah Elohim of your fathers has said unto you; fear not, neither be discouraged.

verses.raw: And you came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.text: And you came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

verses.raw: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.text: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

verses.raw: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.text: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

verses.raw: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) does give us.
verses.text: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which Yahuah Eloheinu does give us.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding you would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God):
verses.text: Notwithstanding you would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah Elohaychem:

verses.raw: And you murmured in your tents, and said, Because Yahuah (LORD) hated us, he has brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.text: And you murmured in your tents, and said, Because Yahuah hated us, he has brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

verses.raw: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.text: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

verses.raw: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.text: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

verses.raw: Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) which goes before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.text: Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) which goes before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

verses.raw: And in the wilderness, where you have seen how that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) bare you, as a man does bear his son, in all the way that you went, until you came into this place.
verses.text: And in the wilderness, where you have seen how that Yahuah Elohayka bare you, as a man does bear his son, in all the way that you went, until you came into this place.

verses.raw: Yet in this thing you did not believe Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God),
verses.text: Yet in this thing you did not believe Yahuah Elohaychem,

verses.raw: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way you should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.text: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way you should go, and in a cloud by day.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

verses.raw: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
verses.text: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

verses.raw: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he has trodden upon, and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he has trodden upon, and to his children, because he has wholly followed Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also Yahuah (LORD) was angry with me for your sakes, saying, You also shall not go in thither.
verses.text: Also Yahuah was angry with me for your sakes, saying, You also shall not go in thither.

verses.raw: But Joshua the son of Nun, which stands before you, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Yashar'el (Israel) to inherit it.
verses.text: But Joshua the son of Nun, which stands before you, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Yashar'el to inherit it.

verses.raw: Moreover your little ones, which you said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.text: Moreover your little ones, which you said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

verses.raw: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.text: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

verses.raw: Then you answered and said unto me, We have sinned against Yahuah (LORD), we will go up and fight, according to all that Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) commanded us. And when you had girded on every man his weapons of war, you were ready to go up into the hill.
verses.text: Then you answered and said unto me, We have sinned against Yahuah, we will go up and fight, according to all that Yahuah Eloheinu commanded us. And when you had girded on every man his weapons of war, you were ready to go up into the hill.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest you be smitten before your enemies.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest you be smitten before your enemies.

verses.raw: So I spake unto you; and you would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), and went presumptuously up into the hill.
verses.text: So I spake unto you; and you would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of Yahuah, and went presumptuously up into the hill.

verses.raw: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.text: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

verses.raw: And you returned and wept before Yahuah (LORD); but Yahuah (LORD) would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
verses.text: And you returned and wept before Yahuah; but Yahuah would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

verses.raw: So you abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that you abode there.
verses.text: So you abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that you abode there.

verses.raw: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as Yahuah (LORD) spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.text: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as Yahuah spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto me, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto me, saying,

verses.raw: You have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
verses.text: You have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

verses.raw: And command you the people, saying, You are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take you good heed unto yourselves therefore:
verses.text: And command you the people, saying, You are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take you good heed unto yourselves therefore:

verses.raw: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
verses.text: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

verses.raw: You shall buy meat of them for money, that you may eat; and you shall also buy water of them for money, that you may drink.
verses.text: You shall buy meat of them for money, that you may eat; and you shall also buy water of them for money, that you may drink.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has blessed you in all the works of your hand: he knows your walking through this great wilderness: these forty years Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has been with you; you have lacked nothing.
verses.text: For Yahuah Elohayka has blessed you in all the works of your hand: he knows your walking through this great wilderness: these forty years Yahuah Elohayka has been with you; you have lacked nothing.

verses.raw: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.text: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give you of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give you of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

verses.raw: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
verses.text: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

verses.raw: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
verses.text: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

verses.raw: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Yashar'el (Israel) did unto the land of his possession, which Yahuah (LORD) gave unto them.
verses.text: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Yashar'el did unto the land of his possession, which Yahuah gave unto them.

verses.raw: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.text: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

verses.raw: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as Yahuah (LORD) sware unto them.
verses.text: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as Yahuah sware unto them.

verses.raw: For indeed the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
verses.text: For indeed the hand of Yahuah was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

verses.raw: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.text: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

verses.raw: That Yahuah (LORD) spake unto me, saying,
verses.text: That Yahuah spake unto me, saying,

verses.raw: You are to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
verses.text: You are to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:

verses.raw: And when you come nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give you of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.text: And when you come nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give you of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

verses.raw: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
verses.text: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

verses.raw: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but Yahuah (LORD) destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
verses.text: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but Yahuah destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

verses.raw: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
verses.text: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

verses.raw: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.text: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

verses.raw: Rise you up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.text: Rise you up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

verses.raw: This day will I begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of you, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of you.
verses.text: This day will I begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of you, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of you.

verses.raw: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.text: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

verses.raw: Let me pass through your land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.text: Let me pass through your land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

verses.raw: You shall sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
verses.text: You shall sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

verses.raw: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) gives us.
verses.text: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which Yahuah Eloheinu gives us.

verses.raw: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as appears this day.
verses.text: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for Yahuah Elohayka hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as appears this day.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before you: begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before you: begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.

verses.raw: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
verses.text: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.text: And Yahuah Eloheinu delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

verses.raw: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
verses.text: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

verses.raw: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
verses.text: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

verses.raw: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) delivered all unto us:
verses.text: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: Yahuah Eloheinu delivered all unto us:

verses.raw: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon you came not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) forbad us.
verses.text: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon you came not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever Yahuah Eloheinu forbad us.

verses.raw: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.text: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into your hand; and you shall do unto him as you did unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into your hand; and you shall do unto him as you did unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

verses.raw: So Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.text: So Yahuah Eloheinu delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

verses.raw: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.text: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.raw: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
verses.text: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

verses.raw: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
verses.text: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

verses.raw: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
verses.text: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

verses.raw: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
verses.text: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

verses.raw: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
verses.text: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

verses.raw: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.text: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.raw: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
verses.text: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

verses.raw: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.text: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

verses.raw: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
verses.text: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

verses.raw: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.
verses.text: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

verses.raw: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.text: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

verses.raw: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.text: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.raw: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.
verses.text: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.

verses.raw: And I commanded you at that time, saying, Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has given you this land to possess it: you shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Yashar'el (Israel), all that are meet for the war.
verses.text: And I commanded you at that time, saying, Yahuah Elohaychem (The LORD your God) has given you this land to possess it: you shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Yashar'el, all that are meet for the war.

verses.raw: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that you have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.text: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that you have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

verses.raw: Until Yahuah (LORD) have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has given them beyond Jordan: and then shall you return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
verses.text: Until Yahuah have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which Yahuah Elohaychem has given them beyond Jordan: and then shall you return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

verses.raw: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen all that Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has done unto these two kings: so shall Yahuah (LORD) do unto all the kingdoms whither you passest.
verses.text: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen all that Yahuah Elohaychem has done unto these two kings: so shall Yahuah do unto all the kingdoms whither you passest.

verses.raw: You shall not fear them: for Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) he shall fight for you.
verses.text: You shall not fear them: for Yahuah Elohaychem he shall fight for you.

verses.raw: And I besought Yahuah (LORD) at that time, saying,
verses.text: And I besought Yahuah at that time, saying,

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord) GOD, you have begun to shew your servant your greatness, and your mighty hand: for what Elohim (God) is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to your works, and according to your might?
verses.text: O Adonai GOD, you have begun to shew your servant your greatness, and your mighty hand: for what Elohim is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to your works, and according to your might?

verses.raw: I pray you, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
verses.text: I pray you, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Let it suffice you; speak no more unto me of this matter.
verses.text: But Yahuah was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and Yahuah said unto me, Let it suffice you; speak no more unto me of this matter.

verses.raw: Get you up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with your eyes: for you shall not go over this Jordan.
verses.text: Get you up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with your eyes: for you shall not go over this Jordan.

verses.raw: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.
verses.text: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.

verses.raw: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.
verses.text: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

verses.raw: Now therefore hearken, O Yashar'el (Israel), unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that you may live, and go in and possess the land which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers gives you.
verses.text: Now therefore hearken, O Yashar'el, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that you may live, and go in and possess the land which Yahuah Elohim of your fathers gives you.

verses.raw: You shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall you diminish ought from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) which I command you.
verses.text: You shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall you diminish ought from it, that you may keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem which I command you.

verses.raw: Your eyes have seen what Yahuah (LORD) did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has destroyed them from among you.
verses.text: Your eyes have seen what Yahuah did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, Yahuah Elohayka has destroyed them from among you.

verses.raw: But you that did cleave unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) are alive every one of you this day.
verses.text: But you that did cleave unto Yahuah Elohaychem are alive every one of you this day.

verses.raw: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) commanded me, that you should do so in the land whither you go to possess it.
verses.text: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as Yahuah Elohai commanded me, that you should do so in the land whither you go to possess it.

verses.raw: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.text: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

verses.raw: For what nation is there so great, who has Elohim (God) so nigh unto them, as Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) is in all things that we call upon him for?
verses.text: For what nation is there so great, who has Elohim so nigh unto them, as Yahuah Eloheinu is in all things that we call upon him for?

verses.raw: And what nation is there so great, that has statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.text: And what nation is there so great, that has statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

verses.raw: Only take heed to thyself, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life: but teach them your sons, and your sons’ sons;
verses.text: Only take heed to thyself, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life: but teach them your sons, and your sons’ sons;

verses.raw: Specially the day that you stoodest before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in Horeb, when Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.text: Specially the day that you stoodest before Yahuah Elohayka in Horeb, when Yahuah said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

verses.raw: And you came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.text: And you came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: you heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only you heard a voice.
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: you heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only you heard a voice.

verses.raw: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.text: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that you might do them in the land whither you go over to possess it.
verses.text: And Yahuah commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that you might do them in the land whither you go over to possess it.

verses.raw: Take you therefore good heed unto yourselves; for you saw no manner of similitude on the day that Yahuah (LORD) spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.text: Take you therefore good heed unto yourselves; for you saw no manner of similitude on the day that Yahuah spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

verses.raw: Lest you corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.text: Lest you corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

verses.raw: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.text: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

verses.raw: The likeness of any thing that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.text: The likeness of any thing that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

verses.raw: And lest you lift up your eyes unto heaven, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, should be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.text: And lest you lift up your eyes unto heaven, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, should be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka has divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) has taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as you are this day.
verses.text: But Yahuah has taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as you are this day.

verses.raw: Furthermore Yahuah (LORD) was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you for an inheritance:
verses.text: Furthermore Yahuah was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which Yahuah Elohayka gives you for an inheritance:

verses.raw: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but you shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.text: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but you shall go over, and possess that good land.

verses.raw: Take heed unto yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has forbidden you.
verses.text: Take heed unto yourselves, lest you forget the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which Yahuah Elohayka has forbidden you.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is a consuming fire, even a jealous Elohim (God).
verses.text: For Yahuah Elohayka is a consuming fire, even a jealous Elohim.

verses.raw: When you shall beget children, and children’s children, and you shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to provoke him to anger:
verses.text: When you shall beget children, and children’s children, and you shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of Yahuah Elohayka, to provoke him to anger:

verses.raw: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto you go over Jordan to possess it; you shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.text: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that you shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto you go over Jordan to possess it; you shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall scatter you among the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither Yahuah (LORD) shall lead you.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall scatter you among the nations, and you shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither Yahuah shall lead you.

verses.raw: And there you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.text: And there you shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

verses.raw: But if from thence you shall seek Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), you shall find him, if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.text: But if from thence you shall seek Yahuah Elohayka, you shall find him, if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.raw: When you are in tribulation, and all these things are come upon you, even in the latter days, if you turn to Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shall be obedient unto his voice;
verses.text: When you are in tribulation, and all these things are come upon you, even in the latter days, if you turn to Yahuah Elohayka, and shall be obedient unto his voice;

verses.raw: (For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is a merciful Elohim (God);) he will not forsake you, neither destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.text: (For Yahuah Elohayka is a merciful Elohim;) he will not forsake you, neither destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he sware unto them.

verses.raw: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that Elohim (God) created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there has been any such thing as this great thing is, or has been heard like it?
verses.text: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that Elohim created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there has been any such thing as this great thing is, or has been heard like it?

verses.raw: Did ever people hear the voice of Elohim (God) speaking out of the midst of the fire, as you have heard, and live?
verses.text: Did ever people hear the voice of Elohim speaking out of the midst of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

verses.raw: Or has Elohim (God) assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.text: Or has Elohim assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahuah Elohaychem did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

verses.raw: Unto you it was shewed, that you might know that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God); there is none else beside him.
verses.text: Unto you it was shewed, that you might know that Yahuah he is Elohim; there is none else beside him.

verses.raw: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you: and upon earth he shewed you his great fire; and you heard his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.text: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you: and upon earth he shewed you his great fire; and you heard his words out of the midst of the fire.

verses.raw: And because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought you out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.text: And because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought you out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

verses.raw: To drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you are, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.text: To drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you are, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

verses.raw: Know therefore this day, and consider it in your heart, that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
verses.text: Know therefore this day, and consider it in your heart, that Yahuah he is Elohim in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

verses.raw: You shall keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command you this day, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days upon the earth, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you, for ever.
verses.text: You shall keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command you this day, that it may go well with you, and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days upon the earth, which Yahuah Elohayka gives you, for ever.

verses.raw: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.text: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

verses.raw: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.text: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

verses.raw: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.text: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

verses.raw: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), after they came forth out of Egypt,
verses.text: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Yashar'el, after they came forth out of Egypt,

verses.raw: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.text: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Yashar'el smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

verses.raw: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.text: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

verses.raw: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
verses.text: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

verses.raw: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
verses.text: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

verses.raw: And Moses called all Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto them, Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel), the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that you may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.text: And Moses called all Yashar'el, and said unto them, Hear, O Yashar'el, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that you may learn them, and keep, and do them.

verses.raw: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.text: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) made a covenant with us in Horeb.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.text: Yahuah made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
verses.text: Yahuah talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

verses.raw: (I stood between Yahuah (LORD) and you at that time, to shew you the word of Yahuah (LORD): for you were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
verses.text: (I stood between Yahuah and you at that time, to shew you the word of Yahuah: for you were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

verses.raw: I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.text: I am Yahuah Elohayka, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.raw: You shall have none other gods before me.
verses.text: You shall have none other gods before me.

verses.raw: You shall not make you any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.text: You shall not make you any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

verses.raw: You shall not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) am a jealous Elohim (God), visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
verses.text: You shall not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I Yahuah Elohayka am a jealous Elohim, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

verses.raw: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.text: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

verses.raw: You shall not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in vain: for Yahuah (LORD) will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.
verses.text: You shall not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka in vain: for Yahuah will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.

verses.raw: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has commanded you.
verses.text: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as Yahuah Elohayka has commanded you.

verses.raw: Six days you shall labour, and do all your work:
verses.text: Six days you shall labour, and do all your work:

verses.raw: But the seventh day is the sabbath of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): in it you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your ox, nor your ass, nor any of your cattle, nor your stranger that is within your gates; that your manservant and your maidservant may rest as well as you.
verses.text: But the seventh day is the sabbath of Yahuah Elohayka: in it you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your manservant, nor your maidservant, nor your ox, nor your ass, nor any of your cattle, nor your stranger that is within your gates; that your manservant and your maidservant may rest as well as you.

verses.raw: And remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) brought you out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) commanded you to keep the sabbath day.
verses.text: And remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and that Yahuah Elohayka brought you out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore Yahuah Elohayka commanded you to keep the sabbath day.

verses.raw: Honour your father and your mother, as Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has commanded you; that your days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with you, in the land which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you.
verses.text: Honour your father and your mother, as Yahuah Elohayka has commanded you; that your days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with you, in the land which Yahuah Elohayka gives you.

verses.raw: You shall not kill.
verses.text: You shall not kill.

verses.raw: Neither shall you commit adultery.
verses.text: Neither shall you commit adultery.

verses.raw: Neither shall you steal.
verses.text: Neither shall you steal.

verses.raw: Neither shall you bear false witness against your neighbour.
verses.text: Neither shall you bear false witness against your neighbour.

verses.raw: Neither shall you desire your neighbour’s wife, neither shall you covet your neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is your neighbour’s.
verses.text: Neither shall you desire your neighbour’s wife, neither shall you covet your neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is your neighbour’s.

verses.raw: These words Yahuah (LORD) spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
verses.text: These words Yahuah spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that you came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.text: And it came to pass, when you heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that you came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

verses.raw: And you said, Behold, Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) has shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that Elohim (God) does talk with man, and he lives.
verses.text: And you said, Behold, Yahuah Eloheinu has shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that Elohim does talk with man, and he lives.

verses.raw: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) any more, then we shall die.
verses.text: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu any more, then we shall die.

verses.raw: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living Elohim (God) speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.text: For who is there of all flesh, that has heard the voice of the living Elohim speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?

verses.raw: Go you near, and hear all that Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall say: and speak you unto us all that Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall speak unto you; and we will hear it, and do it.
verses.text: Go you near, and hear all that Yahuah Eloheinu shall say: and speak you unto us all that Yahuah Eloheinu shall speak unto you; and we will hear it, and do it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) heard the voice of your words, when you spake unto me; and Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto you: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.text: And Yahuah heard the voice of your words, when you spake unto me; and Yahuah said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto you: they have well said all that they have spoken.

verses.raw: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.text: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

verses.raw: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
verses.text: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

verses.raw: But as for you, stand you here by me, and I will speak unto you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.text: But as for you, stand you here by me, and I will speak unto you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

verses.raw: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has commanded you: you shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.text: You shall observe to do therefore as Yahuah Elohaychem has commanded you: you shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

verses.raw: You shall walk in all the ways which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.
verses.text: You shall walk in all the ways which Yahuah Elohaychem has commanded you, that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which you shall possess.

verses.raw: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land whither you go to possess it:
verses.text: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which Yahuah Elohaychem commanded to teach you, that you might do them in the land whither you go to possess it:

verses.raw: That you might fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you, you, and your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.
verses.text: That you might fear Yahuah Elohayka, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you, you, and your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

verses.raw: Hear therefore, O Yashar'el (Israel), and observe to do it; that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers has promised you, in the land that flows with milk and honey.
verses.text: Hear therefore, O Yashar'el, and observe to do it; that it may be well with you, and that you may increase mightily, as Yahuah Elohim of your fathers has promised you, in the land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.raw: Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Hear, O Yashar'el: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah:

verses.raw: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.
verses.text: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.

verses.raw: And these words, which I command you this day, shall be in your heart:
verses.text: And these words, which I command you this day, shall be in your heart:

verses.raw: And you shall teach them diligently unto your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you risest up.
verses.text: And you shall teach them diligently unto your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you risest up.

verses.raw: And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.text: And you shall bind them for a sign upon your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes.

verses.raw: And you shall write them upon the posts of your house, and on your gates.
verses.text: And you shall write them upon the posts of your house, and on your gates.

verses.raw: And it shall be, when Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall have brought you into the land which he sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you great and goodly cities, which you buildedst not,
verses.text: And it shall be, when Yahuah Elohayka shall have brought you into the land which he sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you great and goodly cities, which you buildedst not,

verses.raw: And houses full of all good things, which you filledst not, and wells digged, which you diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which you plantedst not; when you shall have eaten and be full;
verses.text: And houses full of all good things, which you filledst not, and wells digged, which you diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which you plantedst not; when you shall have eaten and be full;

verses.raw: Then beware lest you forget Yahuah (LORD), which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.text: Then beware lest you forget Yahuah, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.raw: You shall fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and serve him, and shall swear by his name.
verses.text: You shall fear Yahuah Elohayka, and serve him, and shall swear by his name.

verses.raw: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
verses.text: You shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

verses.raw: (For Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) is a jealous Elohim (God) among you) lest the anger of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) be kindled against you, and destroy you from off the face of the earth.
verses.text: (For Yahuah Elohayka is a jealous Elohim among you) lest the anger of Yahuah Elohayka be kindled against you, and destroy you from off the face of the earth.

verses.raw: You shall not tempt Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as you tempted him in Massah.
verses.text: You shall not tempt Yahuah Elohaychem, as you tempted him in Massah.

verses.raw: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.
verses.text: You shall diligently keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

verses.raw: And you shall do that which is right and good in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): that it may be well with you, and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers,
verses.text: And you shall do that which is right and good in the sight of Yahuah: that it may be well with you, and that you may go in and possess the good land which Yahuah sware unto your fathers,

verses.raw: To cast out all your enemies from before you, as Yahuah (LORD) has spoken.
verses.text: To cast out all your enemies from before you, as Yahuah has spoken.

verses.raw: And when your son asks you in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) has commanded you?
verses.text: And when your son asks you in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Yahuah Eloheinu has commanded you?

verses.raw: Then you shall say unto your son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and Yahuah (LORD) brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.text: Then you shall say unto your son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and Yahuah brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.text: And Yahuah shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

verses.raw: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.text: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
verses.text: And Yahuah commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahuah Eloheinu, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

verses.raw: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), as he has commanded us.
verses.text: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before Yahuah Eloheinu, as he has commanded us.

verses.raw: When Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bring you into the land whither you go to possess it, and has cast out many nations before you, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you;
verses.text: When Yahuah Elohayka shall bring you into the land whither you go to possess it, and has cast out many nations before you, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than you;

verses.raw: And when Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall deliver them before you; you shall smite them, and utterly destroy them; you shall make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
verses.text: And when Yahuah Elohayka shall deliver them before you; you shall smite them, and utterly destroy them; you shall make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

verses.raw: Neither shall you make marriages with them; your daughter you shall not give unto his son, nor his daughter shall you take unto your son.
verses.text: Neither shall you make marriages with them; your daughter you shall not give unto his son, nor his daughter shall you take unto your son.

verses.raw: For they will turn away your son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of Yahuah (LORD) be kindled against you, and destroy you suddenly.
verses.text: For they will turn away your son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of Yahuah be kindled against you, and destroy you suddenly.

verses.raw: But thus shall you deal with them; you shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.text: But thus shall you deal with them; you shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

verses.raw: For you are an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has chosen you to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.text: For you are an holy people unto Yahuah Elohayka: Yahuah Elohayka has chosen you to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all people:
verses.text: Yahuah did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all people:

verses.raw: But because Yahuah (LORD) loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, has Yahuah (LORD) brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.text: But because Yahuah loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, has Yahuah brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.raw: Know therefore that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), he is Elohim (God), the faithful Elohim (God), which keeps covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.text: Know therefore that Yahuah Elohayka, he is Elohim, the faithful Elohim, which keeps covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

verses.raw: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hates him, he will repay him to his face.
verses.text: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hates him, he will repay him to his face.

verses.raw: You shall therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command you this day, to do them.
verses.text: You shall therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command you this day, to do them.

verses.raw: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if you hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall keep unto you the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto your fathers:
verses.text: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if you hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that Yahuah Elohayka shall keep unto you the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto your fathers:

verses.raw: And he will love you, and bless you, and multiply you: he will also bless the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your land, your corn, and your wine, and your oil, the increase of your kine, and the flocks of your sheep, in the land which he sware unto your fathers to give you.
verses.text: And he will love you, and bless you, and multiply you: he will also bless the fruit of your womb, and the fruit of your land, your corn, and your wine, and your oil, the increase of your kine, and the flocks of your sheep, in the land which he sware unto your fathers to give you.

verses.raw: You shall be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.text: You shall be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) will take away from you all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, upon you; but will lay them upon all them that hate you.
verses.text: And Yahuah will take away from you all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which you know, upon you; but will lay them upon all them that hate you.

verses.raw: And you shall consume all the people which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall deliver you; your eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shall you serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto you.
verses.text: And you shall consume all the people which Yahuah Elohayka shall deliver you; your eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shall you serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto you.

verses.raw: If you shall say in your heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
verses.text: If you shall say in your heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
