verses.text: And you shall write upon them all the words of this law, when you are passed over, that you may go in unto the land which Yahuah Elohayka gives you, a land that flows with milk and honey; as Yahuah Elohim of your fathers has promised you.

verses.raw: Therefore it shall be when you be gone over Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and you shall plaister them with plaister.
verses.text: Therefore it shall be when you be gone over Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you this day, in mount Ebal, and you shall plaister them with plaister.

verses.raw: And there shall you build an altar unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), an altar of stones: you shall not lift up any iron tool upon them.
verses.text: And there shall you build an altar unto Yahuah Elohayka, an altar of stones: you shall not lift up any iron tool upon them.

verses.raw: You shall build the altar of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) of whole stones: and you shall offer burnt offerings thereon unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God):
verses.text: You shall build the altar of Yahuah Elohayka of whole stones: and you shall offer burnt offerings thereon unto Yahuah Elohayka:

verses.raw: And you shall offer peace offerings, and shall eat there, and rejoice before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: And you shall offer peace offerings, and shall eat there, and rejoice before Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: And you shall write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.
verses.text: And you shall write upon the stones all the words of this law very plainly.

verses.raw: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Yashar'el (Israel); this day you are become the people of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: And Moses and the priests the Levites spake unto all Yashar'el, saying, Take heed, and hearken, O Yashar'el; this day you are become the people of Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: You shall therefore obey the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you this day.
verses.text: You shall therefore obey the voice of Yahuah Elohayka, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you this day.

verses.raw: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,
verses.text: And Moses charged the people the same day, saying,

verses.raw: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Yahudah (Judah), and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:
verses.text: These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Yahudah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin:

verses.raw: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
verses.text: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

verses.raw: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) with a loud voice,
verses.text: And the Levites shall speak, and say unto all the men of Yashar'el with a loud voice,

verses.raw: Cursed be the man that makes any graven or molten image, an abomination unto Yahuah (LORD), the work of the hands of the craftsman, and puts it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be the man that makes any graven or molten image, an abomination unto Yahuah, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and puts it in a secret place. And all the people shall answer and say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that sets light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that sets light by his father or his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that removeth his neighbour’s landmark. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that makes the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that makes the blind to wander out of the way. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that perverts the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that perverts the judgment of the stranger, fatherless, and widow. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that lies with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that lies with his father’s wife; because he uncovereth his father’s skirt. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that lies with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that lies with any manner of beast. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that lies with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that lies with his sister, the daughter of his father, or the daughter of his mother. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that lies with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that lies with his mother in law. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that smites his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that smites his neighbour secretly. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that takes reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that takes reward to slay an innocent person. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.
verses.text: Cursed be he that confirmeth not all the words of this law to do them. And all the people shall say, Amen.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, if you shall hearken diligently unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to observe and to do all his commandments which I command you this day, that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will set you on high above all nations of the earth:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if you shall hearken diligently unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command you this day, that Yahuah Elohayka will set you on high above all nations of the earth:

verses.raw: And all these blessings shall come on you, and overtake you, if you shall hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: And all these blessings shall come on you, and overtake you, if you shall hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the field.
verses.text: Blessed shall you be in the city, and blessed shall you be in the field.

verses.raw: Blessed shall be the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your ground, and the fruit of your cattle, the increase of your kine, and the flocks of your sheep.
verses.text: Blessed shall be the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your ground, and the fruit of your cattle, the increase of your kine, and the flocks of your sheep.

verses.raw: Blessed shall be your basket and your store.
verses.text: Blessed shall be your basket and your store.

verses.raw: Blessed shall you be when you come in, and blessed shall you be when you go out.
verses.text: Blessed shall you be when you come in, and blessed shall you be when you go out.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall cause your enemies that rise up against you to be smitten before your face: they shall come out against you one way, and flee before you seven ways.
verses.text: Yahuah shall cause your enemies that rise up against you to be smitten before your face: they shall come out against you one way, and flee before you seven ways.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall command the blessing upon you in your storehouses, and in all that you set your hand unto; and he shall bless you in the land which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you.
verses.text: Yahuah shall command the blessing upon you in your storehouses, and in all that you set your hand unto; and he shall bless you in the land which Yahuah Elohayka gives you.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall establish you an holy people unto himself, as he has sworn unto you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and walk in his ways.
verses.text: Yahuah shall establish you an holy people unto himself, as he has sworn unto you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahuah Elohayka, and walk in his ways.

verses.raw: And all people of the earth shall see that you are called by the name of Yahuah (LORD); and they shall be afraid of you.
verses.text: And all people of the earth shall see that you are called by the name of Yahuah; and they shall be afraid of you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall make you plenteous in goods, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers to give you.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall make you plenteous in goods, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahuah sware unto your fathers to give you.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall open unto you his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto your land in his season, and to bless all the work of your hand: and you shall lend unto many nations, and you shall not borrow.
verses.text: Yahuah shall open unto you his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto your land in his season, and to bless all the work of your hand: and you shall lend unto many nations, and you shall not borrow.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall make you the head, and not the tail; and you shall be above only, and you shall not be beneath; if that you hearken unto the commandments of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which I command you this day, to observe and to do them:
verses.text: And Yahuah shall make you the head, and not the tail; and you shall be above only, and you shall not be beneath; if that you hearken unto the commandments of Yahuah Elohayka, which I command you this day, to observe and to do them:

verses.raw: And you shall not go aside from any of the words which I command you this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.text: And you shall not go aside from any of the words which I command you this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

verses.raw: But it shall come to pass, if you will not hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you this day; that all these curses shall come upon you, and overtake you:
verses.text: But it shall come to pass, if you will not hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you this day; that all these curses shall come upon you, and overtake you:

verses.raw: Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the field.
verses.text: Cursed shall you be in the city, and cursed shall you be in the field.

verses.raw: Cursed shall be your basket and your store.
verses.text: Cursed shall be your basket and your store.

verses.raw: Cursed shall be the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your land, the increase of your kine, and the flocks of your sheep.
verses.text: Cursed shall be the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your land, the increase of your kine, and the flocks of your sheep.

verses.raw: Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out.
verses.text: Cursed shall you be when you come in, and cursed shall you be when you go out.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall send upon you cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that you set your hand unto for to do, until you be destroyed, and until you perish quickly; because of the wickedness of your doings, whereby you have forsaken me.
verses.text: Yahuah shall send upon you cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that you set your hand unto for to do, until you be destroyed, and until you perish quickly; because of the wickedness of your doings, whereby you have forsaken me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall make the pestilence cleave unto you, until he have consumed you from off the land, whither you go to possess it.
verses.text: Yahuah shall make the pestilence cleave unto you, until he have consumed you from off the land, whither you go to possess it.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall smite you with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue you until you perish.
verses.text: Yahuah shall smite you with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue you until you perish.

verses.raw: And your heaven that is over your head shall be brass, and the earth that is under you shall be iron.
verses.text: And your heaven that is over your head shall be brass, and the earth that is under you shall be iron.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall make the rain of your land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon you, until you be destroyed.
verses.text: Yahuah shall make the rain of your land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon you, until you be destroyed.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall cause you to be smitten before your enemies: you shall go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shall be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.text: Yahuah shall cause you to be smitten before your enemies: you shall go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shall be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.raw: And your carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
verses.text: And your carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will smite you with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof you can not be healed.
verses.text: Yahuah will smite you with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof you can not be healed.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall smite you with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
verses.text: Yahuah shall smite you with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:

verses.raw: And you shall grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways: and you shall be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save you.
verses.text: And you shall grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways: and you shall be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save you.

verses.raw: You shall betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: you shall build an house, and you shall not dwell therein: you shall plant a vineyard, and shall not gather the grapes thereof.
verses.text: You shall betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: you shall build an house, and you shall not dwell therein: you shall plant a vineyard, and shall not gather the grapes thereof.

verses.raw: Your ox shall be slain before your eyes, and you shall not eat thereof: your ass shall be violently taken away from before your face, and shall not be restored to you: your sheep shall be given unto your enemies, and you shall have none to rescue them.
verses.text: Your ox shall be slain before your eyes, and you shall not eat thereof: your ass shall be violently taken away from before your face, and shall not be restored to you: your sheep shall be given unto your enemies, and you shall have none to rescue them.

verses.raw: Your sons and your daughters shall be given unto another people, and your eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in your hand.
verses.text: Your sons and your daughters shall be given unto another people, and your eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in your hand.

verses.raw: The fruit of your land, and all your labours, shall a nation which you know not eat up; and you shall be only oppressed and crushed alway:
verses.text: The fruit of your land, and all your labours, shall a nation which you know not eat up; and you shall be only oppressed and crushed alway:

verses.raw: So that you shall be mad for the sight of your eyes which you shall see.
verses.text: So that you shall be mad for the sight of your eyes which you shall see.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall smite you in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot unto the top of your head.
verses.text: Yahuah shall smite you in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot unto the top of your head.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall bring you, and your king which you shall set over you, unto a nation which neither you nor your fathers have known; and there shall you serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.text: Yahuah shall bring you, and your king which you shall set over you, unto a nation which neither you nor your fathers have known; and there shall you serve other gods, wood and stone.

verses.raw: And you shall become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither Yahuah (LORD) shall lead you.
verses.text: And you shall become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither Yahuah shall lead you.

verses.raw: You shall carry much seed out into the field, and shall gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.text: You shall carry much seed out into the field, and shall gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.

verses.raw: You shall plant vineyards, and dress them, but shall neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.text: You shall plant vineyards, and dress them, but shall neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.

verses.raw: You shall have olive trees throughout all your coasts, but you shall not anoint thyself with the oil; for your olive shall cast his fruit.
verses.text: You shall have olive trees throughout all your coasts, but you shall not anoint thyself with the oil; for your olive shall cast his fruit.

verses.raw: You shall beget sons and daughters, but you shall not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.text: You shall beget sons and daughters, but you shall not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.

verses.raw: All your trees and fruit of your land shall the locust consume.
verses.text: All your trees and fruit of your land shall the locust consume.

verses.raw: The stranger that is within you shall get up above you very high; and you shall come down very low.
verses.text: The stranger that is within you shall get up above you very high; and you shall come down very low.

verses.raw: He shall lend to you, and you shall not lend to him: he shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.
verses.text: He shall lend to you, and you shall not lend to him: he shall be the head, and you shall be the tail.

verses.raw: Moreover all these curses shall come upon you, and shall pursue you, and overtake you, till you be destroyed; because you hearkenedst not unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you:
verses.text: Moreover all these curses shall come upon you, and shall pursue you, and overtake you, till you be destroyed; because you hearkenedst not unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you:

verses.raw: And they shall be upon you for a sign and for a wonder, and upon your seed for ever.
verses.text: And they shall be upon you for a sign and for a wonder, and upon your seed for ever.

verses.raw: Because you servedst not Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
verses.text: Because you servedst not Yahuah Elohayka with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;

verses.raw: Therefore shall you serve your enemies which Yahuah (LORD) shall send against you, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon your neck, until he have destroyed you.
verses.text: Therefore shall you serve your enemies which Yahuah shall send against you, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon your neck, until he have destroyed you.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue you shall not understand;
verses.text: Yahuah shall bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue you shall not understand;

verses.raw: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.text: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:

verses.raw: And he shall eat the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your land, until you be destroyed: which also shall not leave you either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of your kine, or flocks of your sheep, until he have destroyed you.
verses.text: And he shall eat the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your land, until you be destroyed: which also shall not leave you either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of your kine, or flocks of your sheep, until he have destroyed you.

verses.raw: And he shall besiege you in all your gates, until your high and fenced walls come down, wherein you trustedst, throughout all your land: and he shall besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has given you.
verses.text: And he shall besiege you in all your gates, until your high and fenced walls come down, wherein you trustedst, throughout all your land: and he shall besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land, which Yahuah Elohayka has given you.

verses.raw: And you shall eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has given you, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith your enemies shall distress you:
verses.text: And you shall eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, which Yahuah Elohayka has given you, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith your enemies shall distress you:

verses.raw: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.text: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:

verses.raw: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he has nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith your enemies shall distress you in all your gates.
verses.text: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he has nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith your enemies shall distress you in all your gates.

verses.raw: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.text: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

verses.raw: And toward her young one that comes out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith your enemy shall distress you in your gates.
verses.text: And toward her young one that comes out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith your enemy shall distress you in your gates.

verses.raw: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE Yahuah (LORD) THY GOD;
verses.text: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE Yahuah THY GOD;

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (LORD) will make your plagues wonderful, and the plagues of your seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.text: Then Yahuah will make your plagues wonderful, and the plagues of your seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.

verses.raw: Moreover he will bring upon you all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they shall cleave unto you.
verses.text: Moreover he will bring upon you all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they shall cleave unto you.

verses.raw: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will Yahuah (LORD) bring upon you, until you be destroyed.
verses.text: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will Yahuah bring upon you, until you be destroyed.

verses.raw: And you shall be left few in number, whereas you were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because you would not obey the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: And you shall be left few in number, whereas you were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because you would not obey the voice of Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that as Yahuah (LORD) rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so Yahuah (LORD) will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and you shall be plucked from off the land whither you go to possess it.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that as Yahuah rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so Yahuah will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and you shall be plucked from off the land whither you go to possess it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall scatter you among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there you shall serve other gods, which neither you nor your fathers have known, even wood and stone.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall scatter you among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there you shall serve other gods, which neither you nor your fathers have known, even wood and stone.

verses.raw: And among these nations shall you find no ease, neither shall the sole of your foot have rest: but Yahuah (LORD) shall give you there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.text: And among these nations shall you find no ease, neither shall the sole of your foot have rest: but Yahuah shall give you there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:

verses.raw: And your life shall hang in doubt before you; and you shall fear day and night, and shall have none assurance of your life:
verses.text: And your life shall hang in doubt before you; and you shall fear day and night, and shall have none assurance of your life:

verses.raw: In the morning you shall say, Would Elohim (God) it were even! and at even you shall say, Would Elohim (God) it were morning! for the fear of your heart wherewith you shall fear, and for the sight of your eyes which you shall see.
verses.text: In the morning you shall say, Would Elohim it were even! and at even you shall say, Would Elohim it were morning! for the fear of your heart wherewith you shall fear, and for the sight of your eyes which you shall see.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto you, You shall see it no more again: and there you shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto you, You shall see it no more again: and there you shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.

verses.raw: These are the words of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses to make with the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.text: These are the words of the covenant, which Yahuah commanded Moses to make with the children of Yashar'el in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

verses.raw: And Moses called unto all Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto them, You have seen all that Yahuah (LORD) did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.text: And Moses called unto all Yashar'el, and said unto them, You have seen all that Yahuah did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;

verses.raw: The great temptations which your eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.text: The great temptations which your eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

verses.raw: Yet Yahuah (LORD) has not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.text: Yet Yahuah has not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.

verses.raw: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and your shoe is not waxen old upon your foot.
verses.text: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and your shoe is not waxen old upon your foot.

verses.raw: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink: that you might know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God).
verses.text: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink: that you might know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem.

verses.raw: And when you came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.text: And when you came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:

verses.raw: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.text: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.raw: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
verses.text: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

verses.raw: You stand this day all of you before Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God); your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: You stand this day all of you before Yahuah Elohaychem; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: Your little ones, your wives, and your stranger that is in your camp, from the hewer of your wood unto the drawer of your water:
verses.text: Your little ones, your wives, and your stranger that is in your camp, from the hewer of your wood unto the drawer of your water:

verses.raw: That you should enter into covenant with Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and into his oath, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) makes with you this day:
verses.text: That you should enter into covenant with Yahuah Elohayka, and into his oath, which Yahuah Elohayka makes with you this day:

verses.raw: That he may establish you to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto you a Elohim (God), as he has said unto you, and as he has sworn unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.text: That he may establish you to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto you a Elohim, as he has said unto you, and as he has sworn unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.raw: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.text: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;

verses.raw: But with him that stands here with us this day before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and also with him that is not here with us this day:
verses.text: But with him that stands here with us this day before Yahuah Eloheinu, and also with him that is not here with us this day:

verses.raw: (For you know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which you passed by;
verses.text: (For you know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which you passed by;

verses.raw: And you have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
verses.text: And you have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)

verses.raw: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turns away this day from Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that bears gall and wormwood;
verses.text: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turns away this day from Yahuah Eloheinu, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that bears gall and wormwood;

verses.raw: And it come to pass, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of my heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
verses.text: And it come to pass, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of my heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will not spare him, but then the anger of Yahuah (LORD) and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and Yahuah (LORD) shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.text: Yahuah will not spare him, but then the anger of Yahuah and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and Yahuah shall blot out his name from under heaven.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
verses.text: And Yahuah shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Yashar'el, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:

verses.raw: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which Yahuah (LORD) has laid upon it;
verses.text: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which Yahuah has laid upon it;

verses.raw: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor bears, nor any grass grows therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which Yahuah (LORD) overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.text: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor bears, nor any grass grows therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which Yahuah overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:

verses.raw: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore has Yahuah (LORD) done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
verses.text: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore has Yahuah done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?

verses.raw: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.text: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of Yahuah Elohim of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:

verses.raw: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
verses.text: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:

verses.raw: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.text: And the anger of Yahuah was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
verses.text: And Yahuah rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.

verses.raw: The secret things belong unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.text: The secret things belong unto Yahuah Eloheinu: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has driven you,
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka has driven you,

verses.raw: And shall return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shall obey his voice according to all that I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul;
verses.text: And shall return unto Yahuah Elohayka, and shall obey his voice according to all that I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul;

verses.raw: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.
verses.text: That then Yahuah Elohayka will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka has scattered you.

verses.raw: If any of yours be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather you, and from thence will he fetch you:
verses.text: If any of yours be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka gather you, and from thence will he fetch you:

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it; and he will do you good, and multiply you above your fathers.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohayka will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you shall possess it; and he will do you good, and multiply you above your fathers.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your seed, to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, that you may live.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohayka will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your seed, to love Yahuah Elohayka with all your heart, and with all your soul, that you may live.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will put all these curses upon your enemies, and on them that hate you, which persecuted you.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohayka will put all these curses upon your enemies, and on them that hate you, which persecuted you.

verses.raw: And you shall return and obey the voice of Yahuah (LORD), and do all his commandments which I command you this day.
verses.text: And you shall return and obey the voice of Yahuah, and do all his commandments which I command you this day.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will make you plenteous in every work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your land, for good: for Yahuah (LORD) will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers:
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohayka will make you plenteous in every work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, and in the fruit of your cattle, and in the fruit of your land, for good: for Yahuah will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers:

verses.raw: If you shall hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if you turn unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul.
verses.text: If you shall hearken unto the voice of Yahuah Elohayka, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if you turn unto Yahuah Elohayka with all your heart, and with all your soul.

verses.raw: For this commandment which I command you this day, it is not hidden from you, neither is it far off.
verses.text: For this commandment which I command you this day, it is not hidden from you, neither is it far off.

verses.raw: It is not in heaven, that you should say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.text: It is not in heaven, that you should say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

verses.raw: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.text: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?

verses.raw: But the word is very nigh unto you, in your mouth, and in your heart, that you may do it.
verses.text: But the word is very nigh unto you, in your mouth, and in your heart, that you may do it.

verses.raw: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.text: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;

verses.raw: In that I command you this day to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that you may live and multiply: and Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bless you in the land whither you go to possess it.
verses.text: In that I command you this day to love Yahuah Elohayka, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that you may live and multiply: and Yahuah Elohayka shall bless you in the land whither you go to possess it.

verses.raw: But if your heart turn away, so that you will not hear, but shall be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.text: But if your heart turn away, so that you will not hear, but shall be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;

verses.raw: I denounce unto you this day, that you shall surely perish, and that you shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither you passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.text: I denounce unto you this day, that you shall surely perish, and that you shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither you passest over Jordan to go to possess it.

verses.raw: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:
verses.text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:

verses.raw: That you may love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and that you may obey his voice, and that you may cleave unto him: for he is your life, and the length of your days: that you may dwell in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.text: That you may love Yahuah Elohayka, and that you may obey his voice, and that you may cleave unto him: for he is your life, and the length of your days: that you may dwell in the land which Yahuah sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

verses.raw: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also Yahuah (LORD) has said unto me, You shall not go over this Jordan.
verses.text: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also Yahuah has said unto me, You shall not go over this Jordan.

verses.raw: Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God), he will go over before you, and he will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before you, as Yahuah (LORD) has said.
verses.text: Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God), he will go over before you, and he will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before you, as Yahuah has said.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall give them up before your face, that you may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall give them up before your face, that you may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.

verses.raw: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), he it is that does go with you; he will not fail you, nor forsake you.
verses.text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for Yahuah Elohayka, he it is that does go with you; he will not fail you, nor forsake you.

verses.raw: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel), Be strong and of a good courage: for you must go with this people unto the land which Yahuah (LORD) has sworn unto their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.
verses.text: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Yashar'el, Be strong and of a good courage: for you must go with this people unto the land which Yahuah has sworn unto their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD), he it is that does go before you; he will be with you, he will not fail you, neither forsake you: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.text: And Yahuah, he it is that does go before you; he will be with you, he will not fail you, neither forsake you: fear not, neither be dismayed.

verses.raw: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), and unto all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah, and unto all the elders of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.text: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,

verses.raw: When all Yashar'el (Israel) is come to appear before Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in the place which he shall choose, you shall read this law before all Yashar'el (Israel) in their hearing.
verses.text: When all Yashar'el is come to appear before Yahuah Elohayka in the place which he shall choose, you shall read this law before all Yashar'el in their hearing.

verses.raw: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and your stranger that is within your gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and observe to do all the words of this law:
verses.text: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and your stranger that is within your gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Yahuah Elohaychem, and observe to do all the words of this law:

verses.raw: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), as long as you live in the land whither you go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.text: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear Yahuah Elohaychem, as long as you live in the land whither you go over Jordan to possess it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Behold, your days approach that you must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Behold, your days approach that you must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
verses.text: And Yahuah appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Moses, Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.

verses.raw: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our Elohim (God) is not among us?
verses.text: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our Elohim is not among us?

verses.raw: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.text: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.

verses.raw: Now therefore write you this song for you, and teach it the children of Yashar'el (Israel): put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now therefore write you this song for you, and teach it the children of Yashar'el: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that flows with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
verses.text: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that flows with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.

verses.raw: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for you shall bring the children of Yashar'el (Israel) into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with you.
verses.text: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for you shall bring the children of Yashar'el into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with you.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

verses.raw: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), that it may be there for a witness against you.
verses.text: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Elohaychem, that it may be there for a witness against you.

verses.raw: For I know your rebellion, and your stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, you have been rebellious against Yahuah (LORD); and how much more after my death?
verses.text: For I know your rebellion, and your stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, you have been rebellious against Yahuah; and how much more after my death?

verses.raw: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
verses.text: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.

verses.raw: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because you will do evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.text: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because you will do evil in the sight of Yahuah, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.

verses.raw: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) the words of this song, until they were ended.
verses.text: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Yashar'el the words of this song, until they were ended.

verses.raw: Give ear, O you heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.text: Give ear, O you heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

verses.raw: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

verses.raw: Because I will publish the name of Yahuah (LORD): ascribe you greatness unto our Elohim (God).
verses.text: Because I will publish the name of Yahuah: ascribe you greatness unto our Elohim.

verses.raw: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a Elohim (God) of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
verses.text: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a Elohim of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

verses.raw: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.text: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

verses.raw: Do you thus requite Yahuah (LORD), O foolish people and unwise? is not he your father that has bought you? has he not made you, and established you?
verses.text: Do you thus requite Yahuah, O foolish people and unwise? is not he your father that has bought you? has he not made you, and established you?

verses.raw: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask your father, and he will shew you; your elders, and they will tell you.
verses.text: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask your father, and he will shew you; your elders, and they will tell you.

verses.raw: When the El Elyon (most High) divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: When the El Elyon divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For the LORD’S portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.text: For the LORD’S portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

verses.raw: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

verses.raw: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreads abroad her wings, takes them, bears them on her wings:
verses.text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreads abroad her wings, takes them, bears them on her wings:

verses.raw: So Yahuah (LORD) alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
verses.text: So Yahuah alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

verses.raw: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

verses.raw: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and you did drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and you did drink the pure blood of the grape.

verses.raw: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: you are waxen fat, you are grown thick, you are covered with fatness; then he forsook Elohim (God) which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.text: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: you are waxen fat, you are grown thick, you are covered with fatness; then he forsook Elohim which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

verses.raw: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.text: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

verses.raw: They sacrificed unto devils, not to Elohim (God); to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to Elohim; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

verses.raw: Of the Rock that begat you you are unmindful, and have forgotten Elohim (God) that formed you.
verses.text: Of the Rock that begat you you are unmindful, and have forgotten Elohim that formed you.

verses.raw: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.text: And when Yahuah saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.

verses.raw: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
verses.text: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

verses.raw: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not Elohim (God); they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.text: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not Elohim; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

verses.raw: For a fire is kindled in my anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.text: For a fire is kindled in my anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

verses.raw: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend my arrows upon them.
verses.text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend my arrows upon them.

verses.raw: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.text: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

verses.raw: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
verses.text: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

verses.raw: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

verses.raw: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and Yahuah (LORD) has not done all this.
verses.text: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and Yahuah has not done all this.

verses.raw: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
verses.text: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

verses.raw: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.text: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

verses.raw: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and Yahuah (LORD) had shut them up?
verses.text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and Yahuah had shut them up?

verses.raw: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.text: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

verses.raw: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
verses.text: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:

verses.raw: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.text: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

verses.raw: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
verses.text: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

verses.raw: To me belongs vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.text: To me belongs vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
verses.text: For Yahuah shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.

verses.raw: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
verses.text: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

verses.raw: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
verses.text: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

verses.raw: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.text: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

verses.raw: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.text: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

verses.raw: If I whet my glittering sword, and my hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to my enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.text: If I whet my glittering sword, and my hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to my enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

verses.raw: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.text: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

verses.raw: Rejoice, O you nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
verses.text: Rejoice, O you nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.

verses.raw: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.text: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

verses.raw: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

verses.raw: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, whither you go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.text: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, whither you go over Jordan to possess it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

verses.raw: Get you up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for a possession:
verses.text: Get you up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Yashar'el for a possession:

verses.raw: And die in the mount whither you go up, and be gathered unto your people; as Aaron your brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.text: And die in the mount whither you go up, and be gathered unto your people; as Aaron your brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

verses.raw: Because you trespassed against me among the children of Yashar'el (Israel) at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Because you trespassed against me among the children of Yashar'el at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Yet you shall see the land before you; but you shall not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yet you shall see the land before you; but you shall not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of Elohim (God) blessed the children of Yashar'el (Israel) before his death.
verses.text: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of Elohim blessed the children of Yashar'el before his death.

verses.raw: And he said, Yahuah (LORD) came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
verses.text: And he said, Yahuah came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.

verses.raw: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in your hand: and they sat down at your feet; every one shall receive of your words.
verses.text: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in your hand: and they sat down at your feet; every one shall receive of your words.

verses.raw: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.text: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.

verses.raw: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) were gathered together.
verses.text: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Yashar'el were gathered together.

verses.raw: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
verses.text: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.

verses.raw: And this is the blessing of Yahudah (Judah): and he said, Hear, Yahuah (LORD), the voice of Yahudah (Judah), and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be you an help to him from his enemies.
verses.text: And this is the blessing of Yahudah: and he said, Hear, Yahuah, the voice of Yahudah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be you an help to him from his enemies.

verses.raw: And of Levi he said, Let your Thummim and your Urim be with your holy one, whom you did prove at Massah, and with whom you did strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.text: And of Levi he said, Let your Thummim and your Urim be with your holy one, whom you did prove at Massah, and with whom you did strive at the waters of Meribah;

verses.raw: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed your word, and kept your covenant.
verses.text: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed your word, and kept your covenant.

verses.raw: They shall teach Jacob your judgments, and Yashar'el (Israel) your law: they shall put incense before you, and whole burnt sacrifice upon your altar.
verses.text: They shall teach Jacob your judgments, and Yashar'el your law: they shall put incense before you, and whole burnt sacrifice upon your altar.

verses.raw: Bless, Yahuah (LORD), his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.text: Bless, Yahuah, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.

verses.raw: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of Yahuah (LORD) shall dwell in safety by him; and Yahuah (LORD) shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verses.text: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of Yahuah shall dwell in safety by him; and Yahuah shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.

verses.raw: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of Yahuah (LORD) be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
verses.text: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of Yahuah be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,

verses.raw: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
verses.text: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,

verses.raw: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
verses.text: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,

verses.raw: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
verses.text: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.

verses.raw: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
verses.text: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.

verses.raw: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and, Issachar, in your tents.
verses.text: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and, Issachar, in your tents.

verses.raw: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
verses.text: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.

verses.raw: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwells as a lion, and tears the arm with the crown of the head.
