verses.text: And Abimelech the son of Jerubbaal went to Shechem unto his mother’s brethren, and communed with them, and with all the family of the house of his mother’s father, saying,

verses.raw: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.
verses.text: Speak, I pray you, in the ears of all the men of Shechem, Whether is better for you, either that all the sons of Jerubbaal, which are threescore and ten persons, reign over you, or that one reign over you? remember also that I am your bone and your flesh.

verses.raw: And his mother’s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.
verses.text: And his mother’s brethren spake of him in the ears of all the men of Shechem all these words: and their hearts inclined to follow Abimelech; for they said, He is our brother.

verses.raw: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.
verses.text: And they gave him threescore and ten pieces of silver out of the house of Baal-berith, wherewith Abimelech hired vain and light persons, which followed him.

verses.raw: And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.
verses.text: And he went unto his father’s house at Ophrah, and slew his brethren the sons of Jerubbaal, being threescore and ten persons, upon one stone: notwithstanding yet Jotham the youngest son of Jerubbaal was left; for he hid himself.

verses.raw: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.
verses.text: And all the men of Shechem gathered together, and all the house of Millo, and went, and made Abimelech king, by the plain of the pillar that was in Shechem.

verses.raw: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, you men of Shechem, that Elohim (God) may hearken unto you.
verses.text: And when they told it to Jotham, he went and stood in the top of mount Gerizim, and lifted up his voice, and cried, and said unto them, Hearken unto me, you men of Shechem, that Elohim may hearken unto you.

verses.raw: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign you over us.
verses.text: The trees went forth on a time to anoint a king over them; and they said unto the olive tree, Reign you over us.

verses.raw: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour Elohim (God) and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.text: But the olive tree said unto them, Should I leave my fatness, wherewith by me they honour Elohim and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.raw: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come you, and reign over us.
verses.text: And the trees said to the fig tree, Come you, and reign over us.

verses.raw: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.text: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.raw: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come you, and reign over us.
verses.text: Then said the trees unto the vine, Come you, and reign over us.

verses.raw: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth Elohim (God) and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?
verses.text: And the vine said unto them, Should I leave my wine, which cheereth Elohim and man, and go to be promoted over the trees?

verses.raw: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come you, and reign over us.
verses.text: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come you, and reign over us.

verses.raw: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.text: And the bramble said unto the trees, If in truth you anoint me king over you, then come and put your trust in my shadow: and if not, let fire come out of the bramble, and devour the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.raw: Now therefore, if you have done truly and sincerely, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
verses.text: Now therefore, if you have done truly and sincerely, in that you have made Abimelech king, and if you have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;

verses.raw: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:
verses.text: (For my father fought for you, and adventured his life far, and delivered you out of the hand of Midian:

verses.raw: And you are risen up against my father’s house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)
verses.text: And you are risen up against my father’s house this day, and have slain his sons, threescore and ten persons, upon one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his maidservant, king over the men of Shechem, because he is your brother;)

verses.raw: If you then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice you in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
verses.text: If you then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice you in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:

verses.raw: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.
verses.text: But if not, let fire come out from Abimelech, and devour the men of Shechem, and the house of Millo; and let fire come out from the men of Shechem, and from the house of Millo, and devour Abimelech.

verses.raw: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
verses.text: And Jotham ran away, and fled, and went to Beer, and dwelt there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.

verses.raw: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: When Abimelech had reigned three years over Yashar'el,

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:
verses.text: Then Elohim sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the men of Shechem; and the men of Shechem dealt treacherously with Abimelech:

verses.raw: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.
verses.text: That the cruelty done to the threescore and ten sons of Jerubbaal might come, and their blood be laid upon Abimelech their brother, which slew them; and upon the men of Shechem, which aided him in the killing of his brethren.

verses.raw: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.
verses.text: And the men of Shechem set liers in wait for him in the top of the mountains, and they robbed all that came along that way by them: and it was told Abimelech.

verses.raw: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.
verses.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed came with his brethren, and went over to Shechem: and the men of Shechem put their confidence in him.

verses.raw: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.
verses.text: And they went out into the fields, and gathered their vineyards, and trode the grapes, and made merry, and went into the house of their god, and did eat and drink, and cursed Abimelech.

verses.raw: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?
verses.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed said, Who is Abimelech, and who is Shechem, that we should serve him? is not he the son of Jerubbaal? and Zebul his officer? serve the men of Hamor the father of Shechem: for why should we serve him?

verses.raw: And would to Elohim (God) this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase your army, and come out.
verses.text: And would to Elohim this people were under my hand! then would I remove Abimelech. And he said to Abimelech, Increase your army, and come out.

verses.raw: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
verses.text: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.

verses.raw: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against you.
verses.text: And he sent messengers unto Abimelech privily, saying, Behold, Gaal the son of Ebed and his brethren be come to Shechem; and, behold, they fortify the city against you.

verses.raw: Now therefore up by night, you and the people that is with you, and lie in wait in the field:
verses.text: Now therefore up by night, you and the people that is with you, and lie in wait in the field:

verses.raw: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.
verses.text: And it shall be, that in the morning, as soon as the sun is up, you shall rise early, and set upon the city: and, behold, when he and the people that is with him come out against you, then may you do to them as you shall find occasion.

verses.raw: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.
verses.text: And Abimelech rose up, and all the people that were with him, by night, and they laid wait against Shechem in four companies.

verses.raw: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.
verses.text: And Gaal the son of Ebed went out, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and Abimelech rose up, and the people that were with him, from lying in wait.

verses.raw: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, You see the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.
verses.text: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, Behold, there come people down from the top of the mountains. And Zebul said unto him, You see the shadow of the mountains as if they were men.

verses.raw: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.
verses.text: And Gaal spake again and said, See there come people down by the middle of the land, and another company come along by the plain of Meonenim.

verses.raw: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now your mouth, wherewith you saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that you have despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.
verses.text: Then said Zebul unto him, Where is now your mouth, wherewith you saidst, Who is Abimelech, that we should serve him? is not this the people that you have despised? go out, I pray now, and fight with them.

verses.raw: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.
verses.text: And Gaal went out before the men of Shechem, and fought with Abimelech.

verses.raw: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.text: And Abimelech chased him, and he fled before him, and many were overthrown and wounded, even unto the entering of the gate.

verses.raw: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.
verses.text: And Abimelech dwelt at Arumah: and Zebul thrust out Gaal and his brethren, that they should not dwell in Shechem.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that the people went out into the field; and they told Abimelech.

verses.raw: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.
verses.text: And he took the people, and divided them into three companies, and laid wait in the field, and looked, and, behold, the people were come forth out of the city; and he rose up against them, and smote them.

verses.raw: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.
verses.text: And Abimelech, and the company that was with him, rushed forward, and stood in the entering of the gate of the city: and the two other companies ran upon all the people that were in the fields, and slew them.

verses.raw: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.
verses.text: And Abimelech fought against the city all that day; and he took the city, and slew the people that was therein, and beat down the city, and sowed it with salt.

verses.raw: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.
verses.text: And when all the men of the tower of Shechem heard that, they entered into an hold of the house of the god Berith.

verses.raw: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.
verses.text: And it was told Abimelech, that all the men of the tower of Shechem were gathered together.

verses.raw: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.
verses.text: And Abimelech gat him up to mount Zalmon, he and all the people that were with him; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand, and cut down a bough from the trees, and took it, and laid it on his shoulder, and said unto the people that were with him, What you have seen me do, make haste, and do as I have done.

verses.raw: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.
verses.text: And all the people likewise cut down every man his bough, and followed Abimelech, and put them to the hold, and set the hold on fire upon them; so that all the men of the tower of Shechem died also, about a thousand men and women.

verses.raw: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.
verses.text: Then went Abimelech to Thebez, and encamped against Thebez, and took it.

verses.raw: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.
verses.text: But there was a strong tower within the city, and thither fled all the men and women, and all they of the city, and shut it to them, and gat them up to the top of the tower.

verses.raw: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
verses.text: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.

verses.raw: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and all to brake his skull.
verses.text: And a certain woman cast a piece of a millstone upon Abimelech’s head, and all to brake his skull.

verses.raw: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw your sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.
verses.text: Then he called hastily unto the young man his armourbearer, and said unto him, Draw your sword, and slay me, that men say not of me, A woman slew him. And his young man thrust him through, and he died.

verses.raw: And when the men of Yashar'el (Israel) saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.
verses.text: And when the men of Yashar'el saw that Abimelech was dead, they departed every man unto his place.

verses.raw: Thus Elohim (God) rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:
verses.text: Thus Elohim rendered the wickedness of Abimelech, which he did unto his father, in slaying his seventy brethren:

verses.raw: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did Elohim (God) render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
verses.text: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did Elohim render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.

verses.raw: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Yashar'el (Israel) Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.
verses.text: And after Abimelech there arose to defend Yashar'el Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar; and he dwelt in Shamir in mount Ephraim.

verses.raw: And he judged Yashar'el (Israel) twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.
verses.text: And he judged Yashar'el twenty and three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

verses.raw: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Yashar'el (Israel) twenty and two years.
verses.text: And after him arose Jair, a Gileadite, and judged Yashar'el twenty and two years.

verses.raw: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.
verses.text: And he had thirty sons that rode on thirty ass colts, and they had thirty cities, which are called Havoth-jair unto this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

verses.raw: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.
verses.text: And Jair died, and was buried in Camon.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did evil again in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook Yahuah (LORD), and served not him.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did evil again in the sight of Yahuah, and served Baalim, and Ashtaroth, and the gods of Syria, and the gods of Zidon, and the gods of Moab, and the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines, and forsook Yahuah, and served not him.

verses.raw: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was hot against Yashar'el (Israel), and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
verses.text: And the anger of Yahuah was hot against Yashar'el, and he sold them into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Yashar'el (Israel): eighteen years, all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.
verses.text: And that year they vexed and oppressed the children of Yashar'el: eighteen years, all the children of Yashar'el that were on the other side Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

verses.raw: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Yahudah (Judah), and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Yashar'el (Israel) was sore distressed.
verses.text: Moreover the children of Ammon passed over Jordan to fight also against Yahudah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim; so that Yashar'el was sore distressed.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried unto Yahuah (LORD), saying, We have sinned against you, both because we have forsaken our Elohim (God), and also served Baalim.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el cried unto Yahuah, saying, We have sinned against you, both because we have forsaken our Elohim, and also served Baalim.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto the children of Yashar'el, Did not I deliver you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

verses.raw: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and you cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.
verses.text: The Zidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, did oppress you; and you cried to me, and I delivered you out of their hand.

verses.raw: Yet you have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.
verses.text: Yet you have forsaken me, and served other gods: wherefore I will deliver you no more.

verses.raw: Go and cry unto the gods which you have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.
verses.text: Go and cry unto the gods which you have chosen; let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Yahuah (LORD), We have sinned: do you unto us whatsoever seems good unto you; deliver us only, we pray you, this day.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el said unto Yahuah, We have sinned: do you unto us whatsoever seems good unto you; deliver us only, we pray you, this day.

verses.raw: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served Yahuah (LORD): and his soul was grieved for the misery of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they put away the strange gods from among them, and served Yahuah: and his soul was grieved for the misery of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.
verses.text: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together, and encamped in Gilead. And the children of Yashar'el assembled themselves together, and encamped in Mizpeh.

verses.raw: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.text: And the people and princes of Gilead said one to another, What man is he that will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? he shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

verses.raw: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.
verses.text: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a mighty man of valour, and he was the son of an harlot: and Gilead begat Jephthah.

verses.raw: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, You shall not inherit in our father’s house; for you are the son of a strange woman.
verses.text: And Gilead’s wife bare him sons; and his wife’s sons grew up, and they thrust out Jephthah, and said unto him, You shall not inherit in our father’s house; for you are the son of a strange woman.

verses.raw: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.
verses.text: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out with him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And it came to pass in process of time, that the children of Ammon made war against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Yashar'el (Israel), the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:
verses.text: And it was so, that when the children of Ammon made war against Yashar'el, the elders of Gilead went to fetch Jephthah out of the land of Tob:

verses.raw: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.
verses.text: And they said unto Jephthah, Come, and be our captain, that we may fight with the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not you hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are you come unto me now when you are in distress?
verses.text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, Did not you hate me, and expel me out of my father’s house? and why are you come unto me now when you are in distress?

verses.raw: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to you now, that you may go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.
verses.text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Therefore we turn again to you now, that you may go with us, and fight against the children of Ammon, and be our head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.

verses.raw: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If you bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and Yahuah (LORD) deliver them before me, shall I be your head?
verses.text: And Jephthah said unto the elders of Gilead, If you bring me home again to fight against the children of Ammon, and Yahuah deliver them before me, shall I be your head?

verses.raw: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Yahuah (LORD) be witness between us, if we do not so according to your words.
verses.text: And the elders of Gilead said unto Jephthah, Yahuah be witness between us, if we do not so according to your words.

verses.raw: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before Yahuah (LORD) in Mizpeh.
verses.text: Then Jephthah went with the elders of Gilead, and the people made him head and captain over them: and Jephthah uttered all his words before Yahuah in Mizpeh.

verses.raw: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What have you to do with me, that you are come against me to fight in my land?
verses.text: And Jephthah sent messengers unto the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What have you to do with me, that you are come against me to fight in my land?

verses.raw: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Yashar'el (Israel) took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.
verses.text: And the king of the children of Ammon answered unto the messengers of Jephthah, Because Yashar'el took away my land, when they came up out of Egypt, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and unto Jordan: now therefore restore those lands again peaceably.

verses.raw: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:
verses.text: And Jephthah sent messengers again unto the king of the children of Ammon:

verses.raw: And said unto him, Thus says Jephthah, Yashar'el (Israel) took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:
verses.text: And said unto him, Thus says Jephthah, Yashar'el took not away the land of Moab, nor the land of the children of Ammon:

verses.raw: But when Yashar'el (Israel) came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;
verses.text: But when Yashar'el came up from Egypt, and walked through the wilderness unto the Red sea, and came to Kadesh;

verses.raw: Then Yashar'el (Israel) sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray you, pass through your land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Yashar'el (Israel) abode in Kadesh.
verses.text: Then Yashar'el sent messengers unto the king of Edom, saying, Let me, I pray you, pass through your land: but the king of Edom would not hearken thereto. And in like manner they sent unto the king of Moab: but he would not consent: and Yashar'el abode in Kadesh.

verses.raw: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.
verses.text: Then they went along through the wilderness, and compassed the land of Edom, and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, but came not within the border of Moab: for Arnon was the border of Moab.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Yashar'el (Israel) said unto him, Let us pass, we pray you, through your land into my place.
verses.text: And Yashar'el sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Yashar'el said unto him, Let us pass, we pray you, through your land into my place.

verses.raw: But Sihon trusted not Yashar'el (Israel) to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But Sihon trusted not Yashar'el to pass through his coast: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and pitched in Jahaz, and fought against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Yashar'el (Israel), and they smote them: so Yashar'el (Israel) possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el delivered Sihon and all his people into the hand of Yashar'el, and they smote them: so Yashar'el possessed all the land of the Amorites, the inhabitants of that country.

verses.raw: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.
verses.text: And they possessed all the coasts of the Amorites, from Arnon even unto Jabbok, and from the wilderness even unto Jordan.

verses.raw: So now Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Yashar'el (Israel), and should you possess it?
verses.text: So now Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el has dispossessed the Amorites from before his people Yashar'el, and should you possess it?

verses.raw: Will not you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whomsoever Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.
verses.text: Will not you possess that which Chemosh your god gives you to possess? So whomsoever Yahuah Eloheinu shall drive out from before us, them will we possess.

verses.raw: And now are you any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Yashar'el (Israel), or did he ever fight against them,
verses.text: And now are you any thing better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? did he ever strive against Yashar'el, or did he ever fight against them,

verses.raw: While Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did you not recover them within that time?
verses.text: While Yashar'el dwelt in Heshbon and her towns, and in Aroer and her towns, and in all the cities that be along by the coasts of Arnon, three hundred years? why therefore did you not recover them within that time?

verses.raw: Wherefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me: Yahuah (LORD) the Judge be judge this day between the children of Yashar'el (Israel) and the children of Ammon.
verses.text: Wherefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me: Yahuah the Judge be judge this day between the children of Yashar'el and the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
verses.text: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.

verses.raw: Then the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.
verses.text: Then the Spirit of Yahuah came upon Jephthah, and he passed over Gilead, and Manasseh, and passed over Mizpeh of Gilead, and from Mizpeh of Gilead he passed over unto the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, If you shall without fail deliver the children of Ammon into my hands,
verses.text: And Jephthah vowed a vow unto Yahuah, and said, If you shall without fail deliver the children of Ammon into my hands,

verses.raw: Then it shall be, that whatsoever comes forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD’S, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.
verses.text: Then it shall be, that whatsoever comes forth of the doors of my house to meet me, when I return in peace from the children of Ammon, shall surely be the LORD’S, and I will offer it up for a burnt offering.

verses.raw: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and Yahuah (LORD) delivered them into his hands.
verses.text: So Jephthah passed over unto the children of Ammon to fight against them; and Yahuah delivered them into his hands.

verses.raw: And he smote them from Aroer, even till you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he smote them from Aroer, even till you come to Minnith, even twenty cities, and unto the plain of the vineyards, with a very great slaughter. Thus the children of Ammon were subdued before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.
verses.text: And Jephthah came to Mizpeh unto his house, and, behold, his daughter came out to meet him with timbrels and with dances: and she was his only child; beside her he had neither son nor daughter.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! you have brought me very low, and you are one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto Yahuah (LORD), and I cannot go back.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he saw her, that he rent his clothes, and said, Alas, my daughter! you have brought me very low, and you are one of them that trouble me: for I have opened my mouth unto Yahuah, and I cannot go back.

verses.raw: And she said unto him, My father, if you have opened your mouth unto Yahuah (LORD), do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth; forasmuch as Yahuah (LORD) has taken vengeance for you of your enemies, even of the children of Ammon.
verses.text: And she said unto him, My father, if you have opened your mouth unto Yahuah, do to me according to that which has proceeded out of your mouth; forasmuch as Yahuah has taken vengeance for you of your enemies, even of the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.
verses.text: And she said unto her father, Let this thing be done for me: let me alone two months, that I may go up and down upon the mountains, and bewail my virginity, I and my fellows.

verses.raw: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.
verses.text: And he said, Go. And he sent her away for two months: and she went with her companions, and bewailed her virginity upon the mountains.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of two months, that she returned unto her father, who did with her according to his vow which he had vowed: and she knew no man. And it was a custom in Yashar'el,

verses.raw: That the daughters of Yashar'el (Israel) went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.
verses.text: That the daughters of Yashar'el went yearly to lament the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite four days in a year.

verses.raw: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst you over to fight against the children of Ammon, and did not call us to go with you? we will burn your house upon you with fire.
verses.text: And the men of Ephraim gathered themselves together, and went northward, and said unto Jephthah, Wherefore passedst you over to fight against the children of Ammon, and did not call us to go with you? we will burn your house upon you with fire.

verses.raw: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you delivered me not out of their hands.
verses.text: And Jephthah said unto them, I and my people were at great strife with the children of Ammon; and when I called you, you delivered me not out of their hands.

verses.raw: And when I saw that you delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and Yahuah (LORD) delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are you come up unto me this day, to fight against me?
verses.text: And when I saw that you delivered me not, I put my life in my hands, and passed over against the children of Ammon, and Yahuah delivered them into my hand: wherefore then are you come up unto me this day, to fight against me?

verses.raw: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, You Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.
verses.text: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim: and the men of Gilead smote Ephraim, because they said, You Gileadites are fugitives of Ephraim among the Ephraimites, and among the Manassites.

verses.raw: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Are you an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;
verses.text: And the Gileadites took the passages of Jordan before the Ephraimites: and it was so, that when those Ephraimites which were escaped said, Let me go over; that the men of Gilead said unto him, Are you an Ephraimite? If he said, Nay;

verses.raw: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.
verses.text: Then said they unto him, Say now Shibboleth: and he said Sibboleth: for he could not frame to pronounce it right. Then they took him, and slew him at the passages of Jordan: and there fell at that time of the Ephraimites forty and two thousand.

verses.raw: And Jephthah judged Yashar'el (Israel) six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.
verses.text: And Jephthah judged Yashar'el six years. Then died Jephthah the Gileadite, and was buried in one of the cities of Gilead.

verses.raw: And after him Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And after him Ibzan of Beth-lehem judged Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Yashar'el (Israel) seven years.
verses.text: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Yashar'el seven years.

verses.raw: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Beth-lehem.
verses.text: Then died Ibzan, and was buried at Beth-lehem.

verses.raw: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Yashar'el (Israel); and he judged Yashar'el (Israel) ten years.
verses.text: And after him Elon, a Zebulonite, judged Yashar'el; and he judged Yashar'el ten years.

verses.raw: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.
verses.text: And Elon the Zebulonite died, and was buried in Aijalon in the country of Zebulun.

verses.raw: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And after him Abdon the son of Hillel, a Pirathonite, judged Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Yashar'el (Israel) eight years.
verses.text: And he had forty sons and thirty nephews, that rode on threescore and ten ass colts: and he judged Yashar'el eight years.

verses.raw: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.
verses.text: And Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the mount of the Amalekites.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did evil again in the sight of Yahuah (LORD); and Yahuah (LORD) delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did evil again in the sight of Yahuah; and Yahuah delivered them into the hand of the Philistines forty years.

verses.raw: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.
verses.text: And there was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and bare not.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, you are barren, and bear not: but you shall conceive, and bear a son.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah appeared unto the woman, and said unto her, Behold now, you are barren, and bear not: but you shall conceive, and bear a son.

verses.raw: Now therefore beware, I pray you, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:
verses.text: Now therefore beware, I pray you, and drink not wine nor strong drink, and eat not any unclean thing:

verses.raw: For, lo, you shall conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto Elohim (God) from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Yashar'el (Israel) out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.text: For, lo, you shall conceive, and bear a son; and no razor shall come on his head: for the child shall be a Nazarite unto Elohim from the womb: and he shall begin to deliver Yashar'el out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.raw: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of Elohim (God) came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of Elohim (God), very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:
verses.text: Then the woman came and told her husband, saying, A man of Elohim came unto me, and his countenance was like the countenance of an angel of Elohim, very terrible: but I asked him not whence he was, neither told he me his name:

verses.raw: But he said unto me, Behold, you shall conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to Elohim (God) from the womb to the day of his death.
verses.text: But he said unto me, Behold, you shall conceive, and bear a son; and now drink no wine nor strong drink, neither eat any unclean thing: for the child shall be a Nazarite to Elohim from the womb to the day of his death.

verses.raw: Then Manoah intreated Yahuah (LORD), and said, O my Lord, let the man of Elohim (God) which you did send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.
verses.text: Then Manoah intreated Yahuah, and said, O my Lord, let the man of Elohim which you did send come again unto us, and teach us what we shall do unto the child that shall be born.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of Elohim (God) came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.
verses.text: And Elohim hearkened to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of Elohim came again unto the woman as she sat in the field: but Manoah her husband was not with her.

verses.raw: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man has appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.
verses.text: And the woman made haste, and ran, and shewed her husband, and said unto him, Behold, the man has appeared unto me, that came unto me the other day.

verses.raw: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Are you the man that spoke unto the woman? And he said, I am.
verses.text: And Manoah arose, and went after his wife, and came to the man, and said unto him, Are you the man that spoke unto the woman? And he said, I am.

verses.raw: And Manoah said, Now let your words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?
verses.text: And Manoah said, Now let your words come to pass. How shall we order the child, and how shall we do unto him?

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah said unto Manoah, Of all that I said unto the woman let her beware.

verses.raw: She may not eat of any thing that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.
verses.text: She may not eat of any thing that comes of the vine, neither let her drink wine or strong drink, nor eat any unclean thing: all that I commanded her let her observe.

verses.raw: And Manoah said unto the angel of Yahuah (LORD), I pray you, let us detain you, until we shall have made ready a kid for you.
verses.text: And Manoah said unto the angel of Yahuah, I pray you, let us detain you, until we shall have made ready a kid for you.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said unto Manoah, Though you detain me, I will not eat of your bread: and if you will offer a burnt offering, you must offer it unto Yahuah (LORD). For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah said unto Manoah, Though you detain me, I will not eat of your bread: and if you will offer a burnt offering, you must offer it unto Yahuah. For Manoah knew not that he was an angel of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Manoah said unto the angel of Yahuah (LORD), What is your name, that when your sayings come to pass we may do you honour?
verses.text: And Manoah said unto the angel of Yahuah, What is your name, that when your sayings come to pass we may do you honour?

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Why ask you thus after my name, seeing it is secret?
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah said unto him, Why ask you thus after my name, seeing it is secret?

verses.raw: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto Yahuah (LORD): and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.
verses.text: So Manoah took a kid with a meat offering, and offered it upon a rock unto Yahuah: and the angel did wondrously; and Manoah and his wife looked on.

verses.raw: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of Yahuah (LORD) ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.
verses.text: For it came to pass, when the flame went up toward heaven from off the altar, that the angel of Yahuah ascended in the flame of the altar. And Manoah and his wife looked on it, and fell on their faces to the ground.

verses.raw: But the angel of Yahuah (LORD) did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But the angel of Yahuah did no more appear to Manoah and to his wife. Then Manoah knew that he was an angel of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Manoah said unto his wife, We shall surely die, because we have seen Elohim.

verses.raw: But his wife said unto him, If Yahuah (LORD) were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.
verses.text: But his wife said unto him, If Yahuah were pleased to kill us, he would not have received a burnt offering and a meat offering at our hands, neither would he have shewed us all these things, nor would as at this time have told us such things as these.

verses.raw: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and Yahuah (LORD) blessed him.
verses.text: And the woman bare a son, and called his name Samson: and the child grew, and Yahuah blessed him.

verses.raw: And the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
verses.text: And the Spirit of Yahuah began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.

verses.raw: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
verses.text: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
verses.text: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.

verses.raw: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of your brethren, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
verses.text: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of your brethren, or among all my people, that you go to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.

verses.raw: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of Yahuah (LORD), that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of Yahuah, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.
verses.text: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.

verses.raw: And the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
verses.text: And the Spirit of Yahuah came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.

verses.raw: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
verses.text: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.

verses.raw: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
verses.text: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.

verses.raw: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.
verses.text: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.

verses.raw: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.

verses.raw: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if you can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
verses.text: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if you can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:

verses.raw: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.

verses.raw: And the children of Dan sent of their family five men from their coasts, men of valour, from Zorah, and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land, and to search it; and they said unto them, Go, search the land: who when they came to mount Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there.

verses.raw: When they were by the house of Micah, they knew the voice of the young man the Levite: and they turned in thither, and said unto him, Who brought you hither? and what make you in this place? and what have you here?

verses.text: And the priest said unto them, Go in peace: before Yahuah is your way wherein you go.

verses.raw: Then the five men departed, and came to Laish, and saw the people that were therein, how they dwelt careless, after the manner of the Zidonians, quiet and secure; and there was no magistrate in the land, that might put them to shame in any thing; and they were far from the Zidonians, and had no business with any man.

verses.raw: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say you?
verses.text: And they came unto their brethren to Zorah and Eshtaol: and their brethren said unto them, What say you?

verses.raw: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are you still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.
verses.text: And they said, Arise, that we may go up against them: for we have seen the land, and, behold, it is very good: and are you still? be not slothful to go, and to enter to possess the land.

verses.raw: When you go, you shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for Elohim (God) has given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.
verses.text: When you go, you shall come unto a people secure, and to a large land: for Elohim has given it into your hands; a place where there is no want of any thing that is in the earth.

verses.raw: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.
verses.text: And there went from thence of the family of the Danites, out of Zorah and out of Eshtaol, six hundred men appointed with weapons of war.

verses.raw: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Yahudah (Judah): wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjath-jearim.
verses.text: And they went up, and pitched in Kirjath-jearim, in Yahudah: wherefore they called that place Mahaneh-dan unto this day: behold, it is behind Kirjath-jearim.

verses.raw: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.
verses.text: And they passed thence unto mount Ephraim, and came unto the house of Micah.

verses.raw: Then answered the five men that went to spy out the country of Laish, and said unto their brethren, Do you know that there is in these houses an ephod, and teraphim, and a graven image, and a molten image? now therefore consider what you have to do.
