verses.raw: Behold, here I am: witness against me before Yahuah (LORD), and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind my eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.
verses.text: Behold, here I am: witness against me before Yahuah, and before his anointed: whose ox have I taken? or whose ass have I taken? or whom have I defrauded? whom have I oppressed? or of whose hand have I received any bribe to blind my eyes therewith? and I will restore it you.

verses.raw: And they said, You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken ought of any man’s hand.
verses.text: And they said, You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken ought of any man’s hand.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Yahuah (LORD) is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that you have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Yahuah is witness against you, and his anointed is witness this day, that you have not found ought in my hand. And they answered, He is witness.

verses.raw: And Samuel said unto the people, It is Yahuah (LORD) that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Samuel said unto the people, It is Yahuah that advanced Moses and Aaron, and that brought your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before Yahuah (LORD) of all the righteous acts of Yahuah (LORD), which he did to you and to your fathers.
verses.text: Now therefore stand still, that I may reason with you before Yahuah of all the righteous acts of Yahuah, which he did to you and to your fathers.

verses.raw: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto Yahuah (LORD), then Yahuah (LORD) sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.
verses.text: When Jacob was come into Egypt, and your fathers cried unto Yahuah, then Yahuah sent Moses and Aaron, which brought forth your fathers out of Egypt, and made them dwell in this place.

verses.raw: And when they forgat Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.
verses.text: And when they forgat Yahuah their Elohim, he sold them into the hand of Sisera, captain of the host of Hazor, and into the hand of the Philistines, and into the hand of the king of Moab, and they fought against them.

verses.raw: And they cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken Yahuah (LORD), and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.
verses.text: And they cried unto Yahuah, and said, We have sinned, because we have forsaken Yahuah, and have served Baalim and Ashtaroth: but now deliver us out of the hand of our enemies, and we will serve you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and you dwelled safe.
verses.text: And Yahuah sent Jerubbaal, and Bedan, and Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side, and you dwelled safe.

verses.raw: And when you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) was your king.
verses.text: And when you saw that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon came against you, you said unto me, Nay; but a king shall reign over us: when Yahuah Elohaychem was your king.

verses.raw: Now therefore behold the king whom you have chosen, and whom you have desired! and, behold, Yahuah (LORD) has set a king over you.
verses.text: Now therefore behold the king whom you have chosen, and whom you have desired! and, behold, Yahuah has set a king over you.

verses.raw: If you will fear Yahuah (LORD), and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), then shall both you and also the king that reigns over you continue following Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God):
verses.text: If you will fear Yahuah, and serve him, and obey his voice, and not rebel against the commandment of Yahuah, then shall both you and also the king that reigns over you continue following Yahuah Elohaychem:

verses.raw: But if you will not obey the voice of Yahuah (LORD), but rebel against the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), then shall the hand of Yahuah (LORD) be against you, as it was against your fathers.
verses.text: But if you will not obey the voice of Yahuah, but rebel against the commandment of Yahuah, then shall the hand of Yahuah be against you, as it was against your fathers.

verses.raw: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which Yahuah (LORD) will do before your eyes.
verses.text: Now therefore stand and see this great thing, which Yahuah will do before your eyes.

verses.raw: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto Yahuah (LORD), and he shall send thunder and rain; that you may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), in asking you a king.
verses.text: Is it not wheat harvest to day? I will call unto Yahuah, and he shall send thunder and rain; that you may perceive and see that your wickedness is great, which you have done in the sight of Yahuah, in asking you a king.

verses.raw: So Samuel called unto Yahuah (LORD); and Yahuah (LORD) sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared Yahuah (LORD) and Samuel.
verses.text: So Samuel called unto Yahuah; and Yahuah sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people greatly feared Yahuah and Samuel.

verses.raw: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for your servants unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.
verses.text: And all the people said unto Samuel, Pray for your servants unto Yahuah Elohayka, that we die not: for we have added unto all our sins this evil, to ask us a king.

verses.raw: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: you have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following Yahuah (LORD), but serve Yahuah (LORD) with all your heart;
verses.text: And Samuel said unto the people, Fear not: you have done all this wickedness: yet turn not aside from following Yahuah, but serve Yahuah with all your heart;

verses.raw: And turn you not aside: for then should you go after vain things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.
verses.text: And turn you not aside: for then should you go after vain things, which cannot profit nor deliver; for they are vain.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake: because it has pleased Yahuah (LORD) to make you his people.
verses.text: For Yahuah will not forsake his people for his great name’s sake: because it has pleased Yahuah to make you his people.

verses.raw: Moreover as for me, Elohim (God) forbid that I should sin against Yahuah (LORD) in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:
verses.text: Moreover as for me, Elohim forbid that I should sin against Yahuah in ceasing to pray for you: but I will teach you the good and the right way:

verses.raw: Only fear Yahuah (LORD), and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he has done for you.
verses.text: Only fear Yahuah, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he has done for you.

verses.raw: But if you shall still do wickedly, you shall be consumed, both you and your king.
verses.text: But if you shall still do wickedly, you shall be consumed, both you and your king.

verses.raw: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: Saul reigned one year; and when he had reigned two years over Yashar'el,

verses.raw: Saul chose him three thousand men of Yashar'el (Israel); whereof two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in mount Beth-el, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin: and the rest of the people he sent every man to his tent.

verses.raw: And Jonathan smote the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. And Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, Let the Hebrews hear.

verses.raw: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Yashar'el (Israel), thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Beth-aven.

verses.raw: When the men of Yashar'el (Israel) saw that they were in a strait, (for the people were distressed,) then the people did hide themselves in caves, and in thickets, and in rocks, and in high places, and in pits.

verses.raw: And some of the Hebrews went over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead. As for Saul, he was yet in Gilgal, and all the people followed him trembling.

verses.raw: And he tarried seven days, according to the set time that Samuel had appointed: but Samuel came not to Gilgal; and the people were scattered from him.

verses.raw: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.
verses.text: And Saul said, Bring hither a burnt offering to me, and peace offerings. And he offered the burnt offering.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that as soon as he had made an end of offering the burnt offering, behold, Samuel came; and Saul went out to meet him, that he might salute him.

verses.raw: And Samuel said to Saul, You have done foolishly: you have not kept the commandment of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which he commanded you: for now would Yahuah (LORD) have established your kingdom upon Yashar'el (Israel) for ever.

verses.raw: And between the passages, by which Jonathan sought to go over unto the Philistines’ garrison, there was a sharp rock on the one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.

verses.raw: And Jonathan said to the young man that bare his armour, Come, and let us go over unto the garrison of these uncircumcised: it may be that Yahuah (LORD) will work for us: for there is no restraint to Yahuah (LORD) to save by many or by few.

verses.raw: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in your heart: turn you; behold, I am with you according to your heart.
verses.text: And his armourbearer said unto him, Do all that is in your heart: turn you; behold, I am with you according to your heart.

verses.text: Then said Jonathan, Behold, we will pass over unto these men, and we will discover ourselves unto them.

verses.raw: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.
verses.text: If they say thus unto us, Tarry until we come to you; then we will stand still in our place, and will not go up unto them.

verses.raw: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for Yahuah (LORD) has delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.
verses.text: But if they say thus, Come up unto us; then we will go up: for Yahuah has delivered them into our hand: and this shall be a sign unto us.

verses.text: And both of them discovered themselves unto the garrison of the Philistines: and the Philistines said, Behold, the Hebrews come forth out of the holes where they had hid themselves.

verses.raw: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.
verses.text: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.

verses.raw: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.
verses.text: And that first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armourbearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were an half acre of land, which a yoke of oxen might plow.

verses.raw: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.
verses.text: And there was trembling in the host, in the field, and among all the people: the garrison, and the spoilers, they also trembled, and the earth quaked: so it was a very great trembling.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, while Saul talked unto the priest, that the noise that was in the host of the Philistines went on and increased: and Saul said unto the priest, Withdraw your hand.

verses.raw: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.
verses.text: And Saul and all the people that were with him assembled themselves, and they came to the battle: and, behold, every man’s sword was against his fellow, and there was a very great discomfiture.

verses.text: So Yahuah saved Yashar'el that day: and the battle passed over unto Beth-aven.

verses.raw: And the men of Yashar'el (Israel) were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eats any food until evening, that I may be avenged on my enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.
verses.text: And the men of Yashar'el were distressed that day: for Saul had adjured the people, saying, Cursed be the man that eats any food until evening, that I may be avenged on my enemies. So none of the people tasted any food.

verses.raw: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.
verses.text: And all they of the land came to a wood; and there was honey upon the ground.

verses.raw: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.
verses.text: And when the people were come into the wood, behold, the honey dropped; but no man put his hand to his mouth: for the people feared the oath.

verses.raw: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.
verses.text: But Jonathan heard not when his father charged the people with the oath: wherefore he put forth the end of the rod that was in his hand, and dipped it in an honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes were enlightened.

verses.raw: Then answered one of the people, and said, Your father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eats any food this day. And the people were faint.
verses.text: Then answered one of the people, and said, Your father straitly charged the people with an oath, saying, Cursed be the man that eats any food this day. And the people were faint.

verses.raw: Then said Jonathan, My father has troubled the land: see, I pray you, how my eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.
verses.text: Then said Jonathan, My father has troubled the land: see, I pray you, how my eyes have been enlightened, because I tasted a little of this honey.

verses.raw: How much more, if haply the people had eaten freely to day of the spoil of their enemies which they found? for had there not been now a much greater slaughter among the Philistines?

verses.raw: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto Yahuah (LORD) all night.
verses.text: It repenteth me that I have set up Saul to be king: for he is turned back from following me, and has not performed my commandments. And it grieved Samuel; and he cried unto Yahuah all night.

verses.raw: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.
verses.text: And when Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning, it was told Samuel, saying, Saul came to Carmel, and, behold, he set him up a place, and is gone about, and passed on, and gone down to Gilgal.

verses.raw: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be you of Yahuah (LORD): I have performed the commandment of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Samuel came to Saul: and Saul said unto him, Blessed be you of Yahuah: I have performed the commandment of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in my ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?
verses.text: And Samuel said, What meaneth then this bleating of the sheep in my ears, and the lowing of the oxen which I hear?

verses.raw: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God); and the rest we have utterly destroyed.
verses.text: And Saul said, They have brought them from the Amalekites: for the people spared the best of the sheep and of the oxen, to sacrifice unto Yahuah Elohayka; and the rest we have utterly destroyed.

verses.raw: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell you what Yahuah (LORD) has said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.
verses.text: Then Samuel said unto Saul, Stay, and I will tell you what Yahuah has said to me this night. And he said unto him, Say on.

verses.raw: And Samuel said, When you were little in your own sight, were you not made the head of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), and Yahuah (LORD) anointed you king over Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And Samuel said, When you were little in your own sight, were you not made the head of the tribes of Yashar'el, and Yahuah anointed you king over Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) sent you on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.
verses.text: And Yahuah sent you on a journey, and said, Go and utterly destroy the sinners the Amalekites, and fight against them until they be consumed.

verses.raw: Wherefore then did you not obey the voice of Yahuah (LORD), but did fly upon the spoil, and did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: Wherefore then did you not obey the voice of Yahuah, but did fly upon the spoil, and did evil in the sight of Yahuah?

verses.raw: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of Yahuah (LORD), and have gone the way which Yahuah (LORD) sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.
verses.text: And Saul said unto Samuel, Yea, I have obeyed the voice of Yahuah, and have gone the way which Yahuah sent me, and have brought Agag the king of Amalek, and have utterly destroyed the Amalekites.

verses.raw: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in Gilgal.
verses.text: But the people took of the spoil, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which should have been utterly destroyed, to sacrifice unto Yahuah Elohayka in Gilgal.

verses.raw: And Samuel said, Has Yahuah (LORD) as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of Yahuah (LORD)? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.
verses.text: And Samuel said, Has Yahuah as great delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices, as in obeying the voice of Yahuah? Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams.

verses.raw: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of Yahuah (LORD), he has also rejected you from being king.
verses.text: For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because you have rejected the word of Yahuah, he has also rejected you from being king.

verses.raw: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), and your words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.
verses.text: And Saul said unto Samuel, I have sinned: for I have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah, and your words: because I feared the people, and obeyed their voice.

verses.raw: Now therefore, I pray you, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, pardon my sin, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with you: for you have rejected the word of Yahuah (LORD), and Yahuah (LORD) has rejected you from being king over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Samuel said unto Saul, I will not return with you: for you have rejected the word of Yahuah, and Yahuah has rejected you from being king over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.
verses.text: And as Samuel turned about to go away, he laid hold upon the skirt of his mantle, and it rent.

verses.raw: And Samuel said unto him, Yahuah (LORD) has rent the kingdom of Yashar'el (Israel) from you this day, and has given it to a neighbour of yours, that is better than you.
verses.text: And Samuel said unto him, Yahuah has rent the kingdom of Yashar'el from you this day, and has given it to a neighbour of yours, that is better than you.

verses.raw: And also the Strength of Yashar'el (Israel) will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.
verses.text: And also the Strength of Yashar'el will not lie nor repent: for he is not a man, that he should repent.

verses.raw: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray you, before the elders of my people, and before Yashar'el (Israel), and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).
verses.text: Then he said, I have sinned: yet honour me now, I pray you, before the elders of my people, and before Yashar'el, and turn again with me, that I may worship Yahuah Elohayka.

verses.raw: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So Samuel turned again after Saul; and Saul worshipped Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then said Samuel, Bring you hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.
verses.text: Then said Samuel, Bring you hither to me Agag the king of the Amalekites. And Agag came unto him delicately. And Agag said, Surely the bitterness of death is past.

verses.raw: And Samuel said, As your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before Yahuah (LORD) in Gilgal.
verses.text: And Samuel said, As your sword has made women childless, so shall your mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before Yahuah in Gilgal.

verses.raw: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.
verses.text: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house to Gibeah of Saul.

verses.raw: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and Yahuah (LORD) repented that he had made Saul king over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Samuel came no more to see Saul until the day of his death: nevertheless Samuel mourned for Saul: and Yahuah repented that he had made Saul king over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Samuel, How long will you mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Yashar'el (Israel)? fill your horn with oil, and go, I will send you to Jesse the Beth-lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Samuel, How long will you mourn for Saul, seeing I have rejected him from reigning over Yashar'el? fill your horn with oil, and go, I will send you to Jesse the Beth-lehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons.

verses.raw: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And Yahuah (LORD) said, Take an heifer with you, and say, I am come to sacrifice to Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Samuel said, How can I go? if Saul hear it, he will kill me. And Yahuah said, Take an heifer with you, and say, I am come to sacrifice to Yahuah.

verses.raw: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew you what you shall do: and you shall anoint unto me him whom I name unto you.
verses.text: And call Jesse to the sacrifice, and I will shew you what you shall do: and you shall anoint unto me him whom I name unto you.

verses.raw: And Samuel did that which Yahuah (LORD) spake, and came to Beth-lehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Come you peaceably?
verses.text: And Samuel did that which Yahuah spake, and came to Beth-lehem. And the elders of the town trembled at his coming, and said, Come you peaceably?

verses.raw: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto Yahuah (LORD): sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.
verses.text: And he said, Peaceably: I am come to sacrifice unto Yahuah: sanctify yourselves, and come with me to the sacrifice. And he sanctified Jesse and his sons, and called them to the sacrifice.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD’S anointed is before him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they were come, that he looked on Eliab, and said, Surely the LORD’S anointed is before him.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for Yahuah (LORD) sees not as man sees; for man looks on the outward appearance, but Yahuah (LORD) looks on the heart.
verses.text: But Yahuah said unto Samuel, Look not on his countenance, or on the height of his stature; because I have refused him: for Yahuah sees not as man sees; for man looks on the outward appearance, but Yahuah looks on the heart.

verses.raw: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither has Yahuah (LORD) chosen this.
verses.text: Then Jesse called Abinadab, and made him pass before Samuel. And he said, Neither has Yahuah chosen this.

verses.raw: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither has Yahuah (LORD) chosen this.
verses.text: Then Jesse made Shammah to pass by. And he said, Neither has Yahuah chosen this.

verses.raw: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Yahuah (LORD) has not chosen these.
verses.text: Again, Jesse made seven of his sons to pass before Samuel. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Yahuah has not chosen these.

verses.raw: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all your children? And he said, There remains yet the youngest, and, behold, he keeps the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.
verses.text: And Samuel said unto Jesse, Are here all your children? And he said, There remains yet the youngest, and, behold, he keeps the sheep. And Samuel said unto Jesse, Send and fetch him: for we will not sit down till he come hither.

verses.raw: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And Yahuah (LORD) said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
verses.text: And he sent, and brought him in. Now he was ruddy, and withal of a beautiful countenance, and goodly to look to. And Yahuah said, Arise, anoint him: for this is he.

verses.raw: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.
verses.text: Then Samuel took the horn of oil, and anointed him in the midst of his brethren: and the Spirit of Yahuah came upon David from that day forward. So Samuel rose up, and went to Ramah.

verses.raw: But the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Yahuah (LORD) troubled him.
verses.text: But the Spirit of Yahuah departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from Yahuah troubled him.

verses.raw: And Saul’s servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from Elohim (God) troubles you.
verses.text: And Saul’s servants said unto him, Behold now, an evil spirit from Elohim troubles you.

verses.raw: Let our lord now command your servants, which are before you, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from Elohim (God) is upon you, that he shall play with his hand, and you shall be well.
verses.text: Let our lord now command your servants, which are before you, to seek out a man, who is a cunning player on an harp: and it shall come to pass, when the evil spirit from Elohim is upon you, that he shall play with his hand, and you shall be well.

verses.raw: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.
verses.text: And Saul said unto his servants, Provide me now a man that can play well, and bring him to me.

verses.raw: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth-lehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and Yahuah (LORD) is with him.
verses.text: Then answered one of the servants, and said, Behold, I have seen a son of Jesse the Beth-lehemite, that is cunning in playing, and a mighty valiant man, and a man of war, and prudent in matters, and a comely person, and Yahuah is with him.

verses.raw: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David your son, which is with the sheep.
verses.text: Wherefore Saul sent messengers unto Jesse, and said, Send me David your son, which is with the sheep.

verses.raw: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.
verses.text: And Jesse took an ass laden with bread, and a bottle of wine, and a kid, and sent them by David his son unto Saul.

verses.raw: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.
verses.text: And David came to Saul, and stood before him: and he loved him greatly; and he became his armourbearer.

verses.raw: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray you, stand before me; for he has found favour in my sight.
verses.text: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray you, stand before me; for he has found favour in my sight.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from Elohim (God) was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the evil spirit from Elohim was upon Saul, that David took an harp, and played with his hand: so Saul was refreshed, and was well, and the evil spirit departed from him.

verses.raw: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongs to Yahudah (Judah), and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.
verses.text: Now the Philistines gathered together their armies to battle, and were gathered together at Shochoh, which belongs to Yahudah, and pitched between Shochoh and Azekah, in Ephes-dammim.

verses.raw: And Saul and the men of Yashar'el (Israel) were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.
verses.text: And Saul and the men of Yashar'el were gathered together, and pitched by the valley of Elah, and set the battle in array against the Philistines.

verses.raw: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Yashar'el (Israel) stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
verses.text: And the Philistines stood on a mountain on the one side, and Yashar'el stood on a mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.

verses.raw: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.
verses.text: And there went out a champion out of the camp of the Philistines, named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span.

verses.raw: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.
verses.text: And he had an helmet of brass upon his head, and he was armed with a coat of mail; and the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass.

verses.raw: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.
verses.text: And he had greaves of brass upon his legs, and a target of brass between his shoulders.

verses.raw: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.
verses.text: And the staff of his spear was like a weaver’s beam; and his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron: and one bearing a shield went before him.

verses.raw: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Yashar'el (Israel), and said unto them, Why are you come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.
verses.text: And he stood and cried unto the armies of Yashar'el, and said unto them, Why are you come out to set your battle in array? am not I a Philistine, and you servants to Saul? choose you a man for you, and let him come down to me.

verses.raw: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall you be our servants, and serve us.
verses.text: If he be able to fight with me, and to kill me, then will we be your servants: but if I prevail against him, and kill him, then shall you be our servants, and serve us.

verses.raw: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Yashar'el (Israel) this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.
verses.text: And the Philistine said, I defy the armies of Yashar'el this day; give me a man, that we may fight together.

verses.raw: When Saul and all Yashar'el (Israel) heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.
verses.text: When Saul and all Yashar'el heard those words of the Philistine, they were dismayed, and greatly afraid.

verses.raw: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.
verses.text: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah, whose name was Jesse; and he had eight sons: and the man went among men for an old man in the days of Saul.

verses.raw: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.
verses.text: And the three eldest sons of Jesse went and followed Saul to the battle: and the names of his three sons that went to the battle were Eliab the firstborn, and next unto him Abinadab, and the third Shammah.

verses.raw: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.
verses.text: And David was the youngest: and the three eldest followed Saul.

verses.raw: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Beth-lehem.
verses.text: But David went and returned from Saul to feed his father’s sheep at Beth-lehem.

verses.raw: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.
verses.text: And the Philistine drew near morning and evening, and presented himself forty days.

verses.raw: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for your brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to your brethren;
verses.text: And Jesse said unto David his son, Take now for your brethren an ephah of this parched corn, and these ten loaves, and run to the camp to your brethren;

verses.raw: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how your brethren fare, and take their pledge.
verses.text: And carry these ten cheeses unto the captain of their thousand, and look how your brethren fare, and take their pledge.

verses.raw: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Yashar'el (Israel), were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
verses.text: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Yashar'el, were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.

verses.raw: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.
verses.text: And David rose up early in the morning, and left the sheep with a keeper, and took, and went, as Jesse had commanded him; and he came to the trench, as the host was going forth to the fight, and shouted for the battle.

verses.raw: For Yashar'el (Israel) and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.
verses.text: For Yashar'el and the Philistines had put the battle in array, army against army.

verses.raw: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.
verses.text: And David left his carriage in the hand of the keeper of the carriage, and ran into the army, and came and saluted his brethren.

verses.raw: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.
verses.text: And as he talked with them, behold, there came up the champion, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, out of the armies of the Philistines, and spake according to the same words: and David heard them.

verses.raw: And all the men of Yashar'el (Israel), when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.
verses.text: And all the men of Yashar'el, when they saw the man, fled from him, and were sore afraid.

verses.raw: And the men of Yashar'el (Israel) said, Have you seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Yashar'el (Israel) is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who kills him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father’s house free in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the men of Yashar'el said, Have you seen this man that is come up? surely to defy Yashar'el is he come up: and it shall be, that the man who kills him, the king will enrich him with great riches, and will give him his daughter, and make his father’s house free in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that kills this Philistine, and takes away the reproach from Yashar'el (Israel)? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living Elohim (God)?
verses.text: And David spake to the men that stood by him, saying, What shall be done to the man that kills this Philistine, and takes away the reproach from Yashar'el? for who is this uncircumcised Philistine, that he should defy the armies of the living Elohim?

verses.raw: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that kills him.
verses.text: And the people answered him after this manner, saying, So shall it be done to the man that kills him.

verses.raw: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why came you down hither? and with whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride, and the naughtiness of your heart; for you are come down that you might see the battle.
verses.text: And Eliab his eldest brother heard when he spake unto the men; and Eliab’s anger was kindled against David, and he said, Why came you down hither? and with whom have you left those few sheep in the wilderness? I know your pride, and the naughtiness of your heart; for you are come down that you might see the battle.

verses.raw: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?
verses.text: And David said, What have I now done? Is there not a cause?

verses.raw: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.
verses.text: And he turned from him toward another, and spake after the same manner: and the people answered him again after the former manner.

verses.raw: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.
verses.text: And when the words were heard which David spake, they rehearsed them before Saul: and he sent for him.

verses.raw: And David said to Saul, Let no man’s heart fail because of him; your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.
verses.text: And David said to Saul, Let no man’s heart fail because of him; your servant will go and fight with this Philistine.

verses.text: And Saul said to David, You are not able to go against this Philistine to fight with him: for you are but a youth, and he a man of war from his youth.

verses.raw: And David said unto Saul, Your servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:
verses.text: And David said unto Saul, Your servant kept his father’s sheep, and there came a lion, and a bear, and took a lamb out of the flock:

verses.raw: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.
verses.text: And I went out after him, and smote him, and delivered it out of his mouth: and when he arose against me, I caught him by his beard, and smote him, and slew him.

verses.raw: Your servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he has defied the armies of the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: Your servant slew both the lion and the bear: and this uncircumcised Philistine shall be as one of them, seeing he has defied the armies of the living Elohim.

verses.raw: David said moreover, Yahuah (LORD) that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and Yahuah (LORD) be with you.
verses.text: David said moreover, Yahuah that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and Yahuah be with you.

verses.text: And Saul armed David with his armour, and he put an helmet of brass upon his head; also he armed him with a coat of mail.

verses.raw: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.
verses.text: And David girded his sword upon his armour, and he assayed to go; for he had not proved it. And David said unto Saul, I cannot go with these; for I have not proved them. And David put them off him.

verses.raw: And he took his staff in his hand, and chose him five smooth stones out of the brook, and put them in a shepherd’s bag which he had, even in a scrip; and his sling was in his hand: and he drew near to the Philistine.

verses.raw: And the Philistine came on and drew near unto David; and the man that bare the shield went before him.

verses.raw: And all this assembly shall know that Yahuah (LORD) saves not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD’S, and he will give you into our hands.

verses.raw: And David went out whithersoever Saul sent him, and behaved himself wisely: and Saul set him over the men of war, and he was accepted in the sight of all the people, and also in the sight of Saul’s servants.

verses.raw: And it came to pass as they came, when David was returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, that the women came out of all cities of Yashar'el (Israel), singing and dancing, to meet king Saul, with tabrets, with joy, and with instruments of musick.

verses.raw: And Saul was very wroth, and the saying displeased him; and he said, They have ascribed unto David ten thousands, and to me they have ascribed but thousands: and what can he have more but the kingdom?

verses.raw: And Saul was afraid of David, because Yahuah (LORD) was with him, and was departed from Saul.

verses.raw: And David behaved himself wisely in all his ways; and Yahuah (LORD) was with him.

verses.raw: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.
verses.text: Wherefore when Saul saw that he behaved himself very wisely, he was afraid of him.

verses.raw: But all Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah) loved David, because he went out and came in before them.
verses.text: But all Yashar'el and Yahudah loved David, because he went out and came in before them.

verses.raw: And Saul said to David, Behold my elder daughter Merab, her will I give you to wife: only be you valiant for me, and fight the LORD’S battles. For Saul said, Let not my hand be upon him, but let the hand of the Philistines be upon him.

verses.raw: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father’s family in Yashar'el (Israel), that I should be son in law to the king?
verses.text: And David said unto Saul, Who am I? and what is my life, or my father’s family in Yashar'el, that I should be son in law to the king?

verses.text: And Michal Saul’s daughter loved David: and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.

verses.raw: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you: now therefore be the king’s son in law.
verses.text: And Saul commanded his servants, saying, Commune with David secretly, and say, Behold, the king has delight in you, and all his servants love you: now therefore be the king’s son in law.

verses.raw: And Saul’s servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seems it to you a light thing to be a king’s son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?
verses.text: And Saul’s servants spake those words in the ears of David. And David said, Seems it to you a light thing to be a king’s son in law, seeing that I am a poor man, and lightly esteemed?

verses.raw: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.
verses.text: And the servants of Saul told him, saying, On this manner spake David.

verses.raw: And Saul said, Thus shall you say to David, The king desires not any dowry, but an hundred foreskins of the Philistines, to be avenged of the king’s enemies. But Saul thought to make David fall by the hand of the Philistines.

verses.raw: Wherefore David arose and went, he and his men, and slew of the Philistines two hundred men; and David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full tale to the king, that he might be the king’s son in law. And Saul gave him Michal his daughter to wife.

verses.raw: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.
verses.text: And Saul spake to Jonathan his son, and to all his servants, that they should kill David.

verses.raw: But Jonathan Saul’s son delighted much in David: and Jonathan told David, saying, Saul my father seeks to kill you: now therefore, I pray you, take heed to thyself until the morning, and abide in a secret place, and hide thyself:

verses.raw: And Jonathan spake good of David unto Saul his father, and said unto him, Let not the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been to you-ward very good:

verses.raw: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and Yahuah (LORD) wrought a great salvation for all Yashar'el (Israel): you saw it, and did rejoice: wherefore then will you sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?
verses.text: For he did put his life in his hand, and slew the Philistine, and Yahuah wrought a great salvation for all Yashar'el: you saw it, and did rejoice: wherefore then will you sin against innocent blood, to slay David without a cause?

verses.text: And Saul hearkened unto the voice of Jonathan: and Saul sware, As Yahuah lives, he shall not be slain.

verses.raw: And you shall not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of Yahuah (LORD), that I die not:
verses.text: And you shall not only while yet I live shew me the kindness of Yahuah, that I die not:

verses.raw: But also you shall not cut off your kindness from my house for ever: no, not when Yahuah (LORD) has cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.
verses.text: But also you shall not cut off your kindness from my house for ever: no, not when Yahuah has cut off the enemies of David every one from the face of the earth.

verses.raw: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let Yahuah (LORD) even require it at the hand of David’s enemies.
verses.text: So Jonathan made a covenant with the house of David, saying, Let Yahuah even require it at the hand of David’s enemies.

verses.raw: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
verses.text: And Jonathan caused David to swear again, because he loved him: for he loved him as he loved his own soul.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and you shall be missed, because your seat will be empty.
verses.text: Then Jonathan said to David, To morrow is the new moon: and you shall be missed, because your seat will be empty.

verses.raw: And when you have stayed three days, then you shall go down quickly, and come to the place where you did hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shall remain by the stone Ezel.
verses.text: And when you have stayed three days, then you shall go down quickly, and come to the place where you did hide thyself when the business was in hand, and shall remain by the stone Ezel.

verses.raw: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.
verses.text: And I will shoot three arrows on the side thereof, as though I shot at a mark.

verses.raw: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of you, take them; then come you: for there is peace to you, and no hurt; as Yahuah (LORD) lives.
verses.text: And, behold, I will send a lad, saying, Go, find out the arrows. If I expressly say unto the lad, Behold, the arrows are on this side of you, take them; then come you: for there is peace to you, and no hurt; as Yahuah lives.

verses.raw: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond you; go your way: for Yahuah (LORD) has sent you away.
verses.text: But if I say thus unto the young man, Behold, the arrows are beyond you; go your way: for Yahuah has sent you away.

verses.raw: And as touching the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, Yahuah (LORD) be between you and me for ever.
verses.text: And as touching the matter which you and I have spoken of, behold, Yahuah be between you and me for ever.

verses.raw: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.
verses.text: So David hid himself in the field: and when the new moon was come, the king sat him down to eat meat.

verses.raw: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.
verses.text: And the king sat upon his seat, as at other times, even upon a seat by the wall: and Jonathan arose, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, and David’s place was empty.

verses.raw: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something has befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.
verses.text: Nevertheless Saul spake not any thing that day: for he thought, Something has befallen him, he is not clean; surely he is not clean.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore comes not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, which was the second day of the month, that David’s place was empty: and Saul said unto Jonathan his son, Wherefore comes not the son of Jesse to meat, neither yesterday, nor to day?

verses.raw: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:
verses.text: And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Beth-lehem:

verses.raw: And he said, Let me go, I pray you; for our family has a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he has commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in your eyes, let me get away, I pray you, and see my brethren. Therefore he comes not unto the king’s table.
verses.text: And he said, Let me go, I pray you; for our family has a sacrifice in the city; and my brother, he has commanded me to be there: and now, if I have found favour in your eyes, let me get away, I pray you, and see my brethren. Therefore he comes not unto the king’s table.

verses.raw: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, You son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own confusion, and unto the confusion of your mother’s nakedness?
verses.text: Then Saul’s anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, You son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own confusion, and unto the confusion of your mother’s nakedness?

verses.raw: For as long as the son of Jesse lives upon the ground, you shall not be established, nor your kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.
verses.text: For as long as the son of Jesse lives upon the ground, you shall not be established, nor your kingdom. Wherefore now send and fetch him unto me, for he shall surely die.

verses.raw: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what has he done?
verses.text: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what has he done?

verses.raw: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.
verses.text: And Saul cast a javelin at him to smite him: whereby Jonathan knew that it was determined of his father to slay David.

verses.raw: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.
verses.text: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and did eat no meat the second day of the month: for he was grieved for David, because his father had done him shame.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the morning, that Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little lad with him.

verses.raw: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.
verses.text: And he said unto his lad, Run, find out now the arrows which I shoot. And as the lad ran, he shot an arrow beyond him.

verses.raw: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond you?
verses.text: And when the lad was come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the lad, and said, Is not the arrow beyond you?

verses.raw: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
verses.text: And Jonathan cried after the lad, Make speed, haste, stay not. And Jonathan’s lad gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.

verses.raw: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.text: But the lad knew not any thing: only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

verses.raw: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
verses.text: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.

verses.raw: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.
verses.text: And as soon as the lad was gone, David arose out of a place toward the south, and fell on his face to the ground, and bowed himself three times: and they kissed one another, and wept one with another, until David exceeded.

verses.raw: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Yahuah (LORD) be between me and you, and between my seed and your seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.
verses.text: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, forasmuch as we have sworn both of us in the name of Yahuah, saying, Yahuah be between me and you, and between my seed and your seed for ever. And he arose and departed: and Jonathan went into the city.

verses.raw: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why are you alone, and no man with you?
verses.text: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was afraid at the meeting of David, and said unto him, Why are you alone, and no man with you?

verses.raw: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king has commanded me a business, and has said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send you, and what I have commanded you: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.
verses.text: And David said unto Ahimelech the priest, The king has commanded me a business, and has said unto me, Let no man know any thing of the business whereabout I send you, and what I have commanded you: and I have appointed my servants to such and such a place.

verses.raw: Now therefore what is under your hand? give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or what there is present.
verses.text: Now therefore what is under your hand? give me five loaves of bread in my hand, or what there is present.

verses.raw: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under my hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.
verses.text: And the priest answered David, and said, There is no common bread under my hand, but there is hallowed bread; if the young men have kept themselves at least from women.

verses.raw: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.
verses.text: And David answered the priest, and said unto him, Of a truth women have been kept from us about these three days, since I came out, and the vessels of the young men are holy, and the bread is in a manner common, yea, though it were sanctified this day in the vessel.

verses.raw: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before Yahuah (LORD), to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.
verses.text: So the priest gave him hallowed bread: for there was no bread there but the shewbread, that was taken from before Yahuah, to put hot bread in the day when it was taken away.

verses.raw: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Yahuah (LORD); and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.
verses.text: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, detained before Yahuah; and his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the chiefest of the herdmen that belonged to Saul.

verses.raw: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under your hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.
verses.text: And David said unto Ahimelech, And is there not here under your hand spear or sword? for I have neither brought my sword nor my weapons with me, because the king’s business required haste.

verses.raw: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if you will take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.
verses.text: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you slewest in the valley of Elah, behold, it is here wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod: if you will take that, take it: for there is no other save that here. And David said, There is none like that; give it me.

verses.raw: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
verses.text: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.

verses.raw: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
verses.text: And the servants of Achish said unto him, Is not this David the king of the land? did they not sing one to another of him in dances, saying, Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?

verses.raw: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.
verses.text: And David laid up these words in his heart, and was sore afraid of Achish the king of Gath.

verses.raw: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.
verses.text: And he changed his behaviour before them, and feigned himself mad in their hands, and scrabbled on the doors of the gate, and let his spittle fall down upon his beard.

verses.raw: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, you see the man is mad: wherefore then have you brought him to me?
verses.text: Then said Achish unto his servants, Lo, you see the man is mad: wherefore then have you brought him to me?

verses.raw: Have I need of mad men, that you have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?
verses.text: Have I need of mad men, that you have brought this fellow to play the mad man in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house?

verses.raw: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father’s house heard it, they went down thither to him.
verses.text: David therefore departed thence, and escaped to the cave Adullam: and when his brethren and all his father’s house heard it, they went down thither to him.

verses.raw: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.
verses.text: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.

verses.raw: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray you, come forth, and be with you, till I know what Elohim (God) will do for me.
verses.text: And David went thence to Mizpeh of Moab: and he said unto the king of Moab, Let my father and my mother, I pray you, come forth, and be with you, till I know what Elohim will do for me.

verses.raw: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.
verses.text: And he brought them before the king of Moab: and they dwelt with him all the while that David was in the hold.

verses.raw: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get you into the land of Yahudah (Judah). Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.
verses.text: And the prophet Gad said unto David, Abide not in the hold; depart, and get you into the land of Yahudah. Then David departed, and came into the forest of Hareth.

verses.raw: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)
verses.text: When Saul heard that David was discovered, and the men that were with him, (now Saul abode in Gibeah under a tree in Ramah, having his spear in his hand, and all his servants were standing about him;)

verses.raw: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, you Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;
verses.text: Then Saul said unto his servants that stood about him, Hear now, you Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give every one of you fields and vineyards, and make you all captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds;

verses.raw: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that shows me that my son has made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or shows unto me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.text: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that shows me that my son has made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or shows unto me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

verses.raw: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.
verses.text: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

verses.raw: And he enquired of Yahuah (LORD) for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
verses.text: And he enquired of Yahuah for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

verses.raw: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.
verses.text: Then the king sent to call Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and all his father’s house, the priests that were in Nob: and they came all of them to the king.

verses.raw: And Saul said, Hear now, you son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
verses.text: And Saul said, Hear now, you son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.

verses.raw: And Saul said unto him, Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have enquired of Elohim (God) for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
verses.text: And Saul said unto him, Why have you conspired against me, you and the son of Jesse, in that you have given him bread, and a sword, and have enquired of Elohim for him, that he should rise against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?

verses.raw: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all your servants as David, which is the king’s son in law, and goes at your bidding, and is honourable in your house?
verses.text: Then Ahimelech answered the king, and said, And who is so faithful among all your servants as David, which is the king’s son in law, and goes at your bidding, and is honourable in your house?

verses.raw: Did I then begin to enquire of Elohim (God) for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for your servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.
verses.text: Did I then begin to enquire of Elohim for him? be it far from me: let not the king impute any thing unto his servant, nor to all the house of my father: for your servant knew nothing of all this, less or more.

verses.raw: And the king said, You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you, and all your father’s house.
verses.text: And the king said, You shall surely die, Ahimelech, you, and all your father’s house.

verses.raw: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of Yahuah (LORD); because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the king said unto the footmen that stood about him, Turn, and slay the priests of Yahuah; because their hand also is with David, and because they knew when he fled, and did not shew it to me. But the servants of the king would not put forth their hand to fall upon the priests of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the king said to Doeg, Turn you, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.
verses.text: And the king said to Doeg, Turn you, and fall upon the priests. And Doeg the Edomite turned, and he fell upon the priests, and slew on that day fourscore and five persons that did wear a linen ephod.

verses.raw: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And Nob, the city of the priests, smote he with the edge of the sword, both men and women, children and sucklings, and oxen, and asses, and sheep, with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.
verses.text: And one of the sons of Ahimelech the son of Ahitub, named Abiathar, escaped, and fled after David.

verses.raw: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD’S priests.
verses.text: And Abiathar shewed David that Saul had slain the LORD’S priests.

verses.raw: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of your father’s house.
verses.text: And David said unto Abiathar, I knew it that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would surely tell Saul: I have occasioned the death of all the persons of your father’s house.

verses.raw: Abide you with me, fear not: for he that seeks my life seeks your life: but with me you shall be in safeguard.
verses.text: Abide you with me, fear not: for he that seeks my life seeks your life: but with me you shall be in safeguard.

verses.raw: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.
verses.text: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.

verses.raw: Therefore David enquired of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And Yahuah (LORD) said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.
verses.text: Therefore David enquired of Yahuah, saying, Shall I go and smite these Philistines? And Yahuah said unto David, Go, and smite the Philistines, and save Keilah.

verses.raw: And David’s men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Yahudah (Judah): how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
verses.text: And David’s men said unto him, Behold, we be afraid here in Yahudah: how much more then if we come to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

verses.raw: Then David enquired of Yahuah (LORD) yet again. And Yahuah (LORD) answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.
verses.text: Then David enquired of Yahuah yet again. And Yahuah answered him and said, Arise, go down to Keilah; for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.

verses.raw: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.
verses.text: So David and his men went to Keilah, and fought with the Philistines, and brought away their cattle, and smote them with a great slaughter. So David saved the inhabitants of Keilah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Abiathar the son of Ahimelech fled to David to Keilah, that he came down with an ephod in his hand.

verses.raw: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, Elohim (God) has delivered him into my hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that has gates and bars.
verses.text: And it was told Saul that David was come to Keilah. And Saul said, Elohim has delivered him into my hand; for he is shut in, by entering into a town that has gates and bars.

verses.raw: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.
verses.text: And Saul called all the people together to war, to go down to Keilah, to besiege David and his men.

verses.raw: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.
verses.text: And David knew that Saul secretly practised mischief against him; and he said to Abiathar the priest, Bring hither the ephod.

verses.raw: Then said David, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), your servant has certainly heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.
verses.text: Then said David, O Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, your servant has certainly heard that Saul seeks to come to Keilah, to destroy the city for my sake.

verses.raw: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), I beseech you, tell your servant. And Yahuah (LORD) said, He will come down.
verses.text: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? O Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, I beseech you, tell your servant. And Yahuah said, He will come down.

verses.raw: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And Yahuah (LORD) said, They will deliver you up.
verses.text: Then said David, Will the men of Keilah deliver me and my men into the hand of Saul? And Yahuah said, They will deliver you up.

verses.raw: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.
verses.text: Then David and his men, which were about six hundred, arose and departed out of Keilah, and went whithersoever they could go. And it was told Saul that David was escaped from Keilah; and he forbare to go forth.

verses.raw: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but Elohim (God) delivered him not into his hand.
verses.text: And David abode in the wilderness in strong holds, and remained in a mountain in the wilderness of Ziph. And Saul sought him every day, but Elohim delivered him not into his hand.

verses.raw: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.
verses.text: And David saw that Saul was come out to seek his life: and David was in the wilderness of Ziph in a wood.

verses.raw: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Jonathan Saul’s son arose, and went to David into the wood, and strengthened his hand in Elohim.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you; and you shall be king over Yashar'el (Israel), and I shall be next unto you; and that also Saul my father knows.
verses.text: And he said unto him, Fear not: for the hand of Saul my father shall not find you; and you shall be king over Yashar'el, and I shall be next unto you; and that also Saul my father knows.

verses.raw: And they two made a covenant before Yahuah (LORD): and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
verses.text: And they two made a covenant before Yahuah: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.

verses.raw: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Does not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?
verses.text: Then came up the Ziphites to Saul to Gibeah, saying, Does not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood, in the hill of Hachilah, which is on the south of Jeshimon?

verses.raw: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king’s hand.
verses.text: Now therefore, O king, come down according to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part shall be to deliver him into the king’s hand.

verses.raw: And Saul said, Blessed be you of Yahuah (LORD); for you have compassion on me.
verses.text: And Saul said, Blessed be you of Yahuah; for you have compassion on me.

verses.raw: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there: for it is told me that he deals very subtilly.
verses.text: Go, I pray you, prepare yet, and know and see his place where his haunt is, and who has seen him there: for it is told me that he deals very subtilly.
