verses.text: Ish-bosheth Saul’s son was forty years old when he began to reign over Yashar'el, and reigned two years. But the house of Yahudah followed David.

verses.raw: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Yahudah (Judah) was seven years and six months.
verses.text: And the time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Yahudah was seven years and six months.

verses.raw: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
verses.text: And Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

verses.raw: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
verses.text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out, and met together by the pool of Gibeon: and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.

verses.raw: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.
verses.text: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men now arise, and play before us. And Joab said, Let them arise.

verses.raw: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.
verses.text: Then there arose and went over by number twelve of Benjamin, which pertained to Ish-bosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of the servants of David.

verses.raw: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.
verses.text: And they caught every one his fellow by the head, and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together: wherefore that place was called Helkath-hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.

verses.raw: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Yashar'el (Israel), before the servants of David.
verses.text: And there was a very sore battle that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Yashar'el, before the servants of David.

verses.raw: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.
verses.text: And there were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab, and Abishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild roe.

verses.raw: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
verses.text: And Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he turned not to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.

verses.raw: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Are you Asahel? And he answered, I am.
verses.text: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Are you Asahel? And he answered, I am.

verses.raw: And Abner said to him, Turn you aside to your right hand or to your left, and lay you hold on one of the young men, and take you his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.
verses.text: And Abner said to him, Turn you aside to your right hand or to your left, and lay you hold on one of the young men, and take you his armour. But Asahel would not turn aside from following of him.

verses.raw: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn you aside from following me: wherefore should I smite you to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab your brother?
verses.text: And Abner said again to Asahel, Turn you aside from following me: wherefore should I smite you to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Joab your brother?

verses.raw: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
verses.text: Howbeit he refused to turn aside: wherefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear smote him under the fifth rib, that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it came to pass, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

verses.raw: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
verses.text: Joab also and Abishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

verses.raw: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.
verses.text: And the children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one troop, and stood on the top of an hill.

verses.raw: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? know you not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere you bid the people return from following their brethren?
verses.text: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, Shall the sword devour for ever? know you not that it will be bitterness in the latter end? how long shall it be then, ere you bid the people return from following their brethren?

verses.raw: And Joab said, As Elohim (God) lives, unless you had spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.
verses.text: And Joab said, As Elohim lives, unless you had spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone up every one from following his brother.

verses.raw: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Yashar'el (Israel) no more, neither fought they any more.
verses.text: So Joab blew a trumpet, and all the people stood still, and pursued after Yashar'el no more, neither fought they any more.

verses.raw: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.
verses.text: And Abner and his men walked all that night through the plain, and passed over Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and they came to Mahanaim.

verses.raw: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.
verses.text: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David’s servants nineteen men and Asahel.

verses.raw: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner’s men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.
verses.text: But the servants of David had smitten of Benjamin, and of Abner’s men, so that three hundred and threescore men died.

verses.raw: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Beth-lehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.
verses.text: And they took up Asahel, and buried him in the sepulchre of his father, which was in Beth-lehem. And Joab and his men went all night, and they came to Hebron at break of day.

verses.raw: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.
verses.text: Now there was long war between the house of Saul and the house of David: but David waxed stronger and stronger, and the house of Saul waxed weaker and weaker.

verses.raw: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
verses.text: And unto David were sons born in Hebron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;

verses.raw: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
verses.text: And his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;

verses.raw: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
verses.text: And the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;

verses.raw: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.
verses.text: And the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah David’s wife. These were born to David in Hebron.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.
verses.text: And it came to pass, while there was war between the house of Saul and the house of David, that Abner made himself strong for the house of Saul.

verses.raw: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore have you gone in unto my father’s concubine?
verses.text: And Saul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Wherefore have you gone in unto my father’s concubine?

verses.raw: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said, Am I a dog’s head, which against Yahudah (Judah) do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul your father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David, that you chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?
verses.text: Then was Abner very wroth for the words of Ish-bosheth, and said, Am I a dog’s head, which against Yahudah do shew kindness this day unto the house of Saul your father, to his brethren, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of David, that you chargest me to day with a fault concerning this woman?

verses.raw: So do Elohim (God) to Abner, and more also, except, as Yahuah (LORD) has sworn to David, even so I do to him;
verses.text: So do Elohim to Abner, and more also, except, as Yahuah has sworn to David, even so I do to him;

verses.raw: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Yashar'el (Israel) and over Yahudah (Judah), from Dan even to Beer-sheba.
verses.text: To translate the kingdom from the house of Saul, and to set up the throne of David over Yashar'el and over Yahudah, from Dan even to Beer-sheba.

verses.raw: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.
verses.text: And he could not answer Abner a word again, because he feared him.

verses.raw: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make your league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with you, to bring about all Yashar'el (Israel) unto you.
verses.text: And Abner sent messengers to David on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying also, Make your league with me, and, behold, my hand shall be with you, to bring about all Yashar'el unto you.

verses.raw: And he said, Well; I will make a league with you: but one thing I require of you, that is, You shall not see my face, except you first bring Michal Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.
verses.text: And he said, Well; I will make a league with you: but one thing I require of you, that is, You shall not see my face, except you first bring Michal Saul’s daughter, when you come to see my face.

verses.raw: And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul’s son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
verses.text: And David sent messengers to Ish-bosheth Saul’s son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, which I espoused to me for an hundred foreskins of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
verses.text: And Ish-bosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.

verses.raw: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.
verses.text: And her husband went with her along weeping behind her to Bahurim. Then said Abner unto him, Go, return. And he returned.

verses.raw: And Abner had communication with the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, You sought for David in times past to be king over you:
verses.text: And Abner had communication with the elders of Yashar'el, saying, You sought for David in times past to be king over you:

verses.raw: Now then do it: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Yashar'el (Israel) out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
verses.text: Now then do it: for Yahuah has spoken of David, saying, By the hand of my servant David I will save my people Yashar'el out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.

verses.raw: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Yashar'el (Israel), and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.
verses.text: And Abner also spake in the ears of Benjamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of David in Hebron all that seemed good to Yashar'el, and that seemed good to the whole house of Benjamin.

verses.raw: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.
verses.text: So Abner came to David to Hebron, and twenty men with him. And David made Abner and the men that were with him a feast.

verses.raw: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Yashar'el (Israel) unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with you, and that you may reign over all that your heart desires. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
verses.text: And Abner said unto David, I will arise and go, and will gather all Yashar'el unto my lord the king, that they may make a league with you, and that you may reign over all that your heart desires. And David sent Abner away; and he went in peace.

verses.raw: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
verses.text: And, behold, the servants of David and Joab came from pursuing a troop, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with David in Hebron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.

verses.raw: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
verses.text: When Joab and all the host that was with him were come, they told Joab, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he is gone in peace.

verses.raw: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What have you done? behold, Abner came unto you; why is it that you have sent him away, and he is quite gone?
verses.text: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What have you done? behold, Abner came unto you; why is it that you have sent him away, and he is quite gone?

verses.raw: You know Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.
verses.text: You know Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.

verses.raw: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.
verses.text: And when Joab was come out from David, he sent messengers after Abner, which brought him again from the well of Sirah: but David knew it not.

verses.raw: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
verses.text: And when Abner was returned to Hebron, Joab took him aside in the gate to speak with him quietly, and smote him there under the fifth rib, that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.

verses.raw: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahuah (LORD) for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
verses.text: And afterward when David heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before Yahuah for ever from the blood of Abner the son of Ner:

verses.raw: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that has an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falls on the sword, or that lacketh bread.
verses.text: Let it rest on the head of Joab, and on all his father’s house; and let there not fail from the house of Joab one that has an issue, or that is a leper, or that leaneth on a staff, or that falls on the sword, or that lacketh bread.

verses.raw: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
verses.text: So Joab and Abishai his brother slew Abner, because he had slain their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.

verses.raw: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.
verses.text: And David said to Joab, and to all the people that were with him, Rend your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. And king David himself followed the bier.

verses.raw: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
verses.text: And they buried Abner in Hebron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.

verses.raw: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dies?
verses.text: And the king lamented over Abner, and said, Died Abner as a fool dies?

verses.raw: Your hands were not bound, nor your feet put into fetters: as a man falls before wicked men, so fellest you. And all the people wept again over him.
verses.text: Your hands were not bound, nor your feet put into fetters: as a man falls before wicked men, so fellest you. And all the people wept again over him.

verses.raw: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do Elohim (God) to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.
verses.text: And when all the people came to cause David to eat meat while it was yet day, David sware, saying, So do Elohim to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or ought else, till the sun be down.

verses.raw: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.
verses.text: And all the people took notice of it, and it pleased them: as whatsoever the king did pleased all the people.

verses.raw: For all the people and all Yashar'el (Israel) understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.
verses.text: For all the people and all Yashar'el understood that day that it was not of the king to slay Abner the son of Ner.

verses.raw: And the king said unto his servants, Know you not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And the king said unto his servants, Know you not that there is a prince and a great man fallen this day in Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: Yahuah (LORD) shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.
verses.text: And I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah be too hard for me: Yahuah shall reward the doer of evil according to his wickedness.

verses.raw: And when Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
verses.text: And when Saul’s son heard that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands were feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

verses.raw: And Saul’s son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:
verses.text: And Saul’s son had two men that were captains of bands: the name of the one was Baanah, and the name of the other Rechab, the sons of Rimmon a Beerothite, of the children of Benjamin: (for Beeroth also was reckoned to Benjamin:

verses.raw: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)
verses.text: And the Beerothites fled to Gittaim, and were sojourners there until this day.)

verses.raw: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.
verses.text: And Jonathan, Saul’s son, had a son that was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the tidings came of Saul and Jonathan out of Jezreel, and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it came to pass, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. And his name was Mephibosheth.

verses.raw: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish-bosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.
verses.text: And the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ish-bosheth, who lay on a bed at noon.

verses.raw: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
verses.text: And they came thither into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they smote him under the fifth rib: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.

verses.raw: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.
verses.text: For when they came into the house, he lay on his bed in his bedchamber, and they smote him, and slew him, and beheaded him, and took his head, and gat them away through the plain all night.

verses.raw: And they brought the head of Ish-bosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul your enemy, which sought your life; and Yahuah (LORD) has avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.
verses.text: And they brought the head of Ish-bosheth unto David to Hebron, and said to the king, Behold the head of Ish-bosheth the son of Saul your enemy, which sought your life; and Yahuah has avenged my lord the king this day of Saul, and of his seed.

verses.raw: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,
verses.text: And David answered Rechab and Baanah his brother, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said unto them, As Yahuah lives, who has redeemed my soul out of all adversity,

verses.raw: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:
verses.text: When one told me, saying, Behold, Saul is dead, thinking to have brought good tidings, I took hold of him, and slew him in Ziklag, who thought that I would have given him a reward for his tidings:

verses.raw: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?
verses.text: How much more, when wicked men have slain a righteous person in his own house upon his bed? shall I not therefore now require his blood of your hand, and take you away from the earth?

verses.raw: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.
verses.text: And David commanded his young men, and they slew them, and cut off their hands and their feet, and hanged them up over the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth, and buried it in the sepulchre of Abner in Hebron.

verses.raw: Then came all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.text: Then came all the tribes of Yashar'el to David unto Hebron, and spake, saying, Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

verses.raw: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, you were he that leddest out and brought in Yashar'el (Israel): and Yahuah (LORD) said to you, You shall feed my people Yashar'el (Israel), and you shall be a captain over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Also in time past, when Saul was king over us, you were he that leddest out and brought in Yashar'el: and Yahuah said to you, You shall feed my people Yashar'el, and you shall be a captain over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before Yahuah (LORD): and they anointed David king over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So all the elders of Yashar'el came to the king to Hebron; and king David made a league with them in Hebron before Yahuah: and they anointed David king over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.
verses.text: David was thirty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years.

verses.raw: In Hebron he reigned over Yahudah (Judah) seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: In Hebron he reigned over Yahudah seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years over all Yashar'el and Yahudah.

verses.raw: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except you take away the blind and the lame, you shall not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.
verses.text: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem unto the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land: which spake unto David, saying, Except you take away the blind and the lame, you shall not come in hither: thinking, David cannot come in hither.

verses.raw: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.
verses.text: Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion: the same is the city of David.

verses.raw: And David said on that day, Whosoever gets up to the gutter, and smites the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.
verses.text: And David said on that day, Whosoever gets up to the gutter, and smites the Jebusites, and the lame and the blind, that are hated of David’s soul, he shall be chief and captain. Wherefore they said, The blind and the lame shall not come into the house.

verses.raw: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.
verses.text: So David dwelt in the fort, and called it the city of David. And David built round about from Millo and inward.

verses.raw: And David went on, and grew great, and Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts was with him.
verses.text: And David went on, and grew great, and Yahuah Elohim of hosts was with him.

verses.raw: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.
verses.text: And Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and cedar trees, and carpenters, and masons: and they built David an house.

verses.raw: And David perceived that Yahuah (LORD) had established him king over Yashar'el (Israel), and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Yashar'el's (Israel’s) sake.
verses.text: And David perceived that Yahuah had established him king over Yashar'el, and that he had exalted his kingdom for his people Yashar'el's (Israel’s) sake.

verses.raw: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
verses.text: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.

verses.raw: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.text: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,

verses.raw: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.text: Ibhar also, and Elishua, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.raw: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.text: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphalet.

verses.raw: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Yashar'el (Israel), all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.
verses.text: But when the Philistines heard that they had anointed David king over Yashar'el, all the Philistines came up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went down to the hold.

verses.raw: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text: The Philistines also came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.raw: And David enquired of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? will you deliver them into my hand? And Yahuah (LORD) said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into your hand.
verses.text: And David enquired of Yahuah, saying, Shall I go up to the Philistines? will you deliver them into my hand? And Yahuah said unto David, Go up: for I will doubtless deliver the Philistines into your hand.

verses.raw: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, Yahuah (LORD) has broken forth upon my enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.text: And David came to Baal-perazim, and David smote them there, and said, Yahuah has broken forth upon my enemies before me, as the breach of waters. Therefore he called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

verses.raw: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.
verses.text: And there they left their images, and David and his men burned them.

verses.raw: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text: And the Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.raw: And when David enquired of Yahuah (LORD), he said, You shall not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.text: And when David enquired of Yahuah, he said, You shall not go up; but fetch a compass behind them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

verses.raw: And let it be, when you hear the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then you shall bestir thyself: for then shall Yahuah (LORD) go out before you, to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.text: And let it be, when you hear the sound of a going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then you shall bestir thyself: for then shall Yahuah go out before you, to smite the host of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And David did so, as Yahuah (LORD) had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until you come to Gazer.
verses.text: And David did so, as Yahuah had commanded him; and smote the Philistines from Geba until you come to Gazer.

verses.raw: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Yashar'el (Israel), thirty thousand.
verses.text: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Yashar'el, thirty thousand.

verses.raw: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Yahudah (Judah), to bring up from thence the ark of Elohim (God), whose name is called by the name of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) that dwells between the cherubims.
verses.text: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Yahudah, to bring up from thence the ark of Elohim, whose name is called by the name of Yahuah Tseva'ot that dwells between the cherubims.

verses.raw: And they set the ark of Elohim (God) upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
verses.text: And they set the ark of Elohim upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.

verses.raw: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of Elohim (God): and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.text: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of Elohim: and Ahio went before the ark.

verses.raw: And David and all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) played before Yahuah (LORD) on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.
verses.text: And David and all the house of Yashar'el played before Yahuah on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.

verses.raw: And when they came to Nachon’s threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of Elohim (God), and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.
verses.text: And when they came to Nachon’s threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of Elohim, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.

verses.raw: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against Uzzah; and Elohim (God) smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the anger of Yahuah was kindled against Uzzah; and Elohim smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of Elohim.

verses.raw: And David was displeased, because Yahuah (LORD) had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day.
verses.text: And David was displeased, because Yahuah had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day.

verses.raw: And David was afraid of Yahuah (LORD) that day, and said, How shall the ark of Yahuah (LORD) come to me?
verses.text: And David was afraid of Yahuah that day, and said, How shall the ark of Yahuah come to me?

verses.raw: So David would not remove the ark of Yahuah (LORD) unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.text: So David would not remove the ark of Yahuah unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.raw: And the ark of Yahuah (LORD) continued in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months: and Yahuah (LORD) blessed Obed-edom, and all his household.
verses.text: And the ark of Yahuah continued in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months: and Yahuah blessed Obed-edom, and all his household.

verses.raw: And it was told king David, saying, Yahuah (LORD) has blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of Elohim (God). So David went and brought up the ark of Elohim (God) from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with gladness.
verses.text: And it was told king David, saying, Yahuah has blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of Elohim. So David went and brought up the ark of Elohim from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with gladness.

verses.raw: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of Yahuah (LORD) had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
verses.text: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of Yahuah had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.

verses.raw: And David danced before Yahuah (LORD) with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.
verses.text: And David danced before Yahuah with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.

verses.raw: So David and all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) brought up the ark of Yahuah (LORD) with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.text: So David and all the house of Yashar'el brought up the ark of Yahuah with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.

verses.raw: And as the ark of Yahuah (LORD) came into the city of David, Michal Saul’s daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before Yahuah (LORD); and she despised him in her heart.
verses.text: And as the ark of Yahuah came into the city of David, Michal Saul’s daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before Yahuah; and she despised him in her heart.

verses.raw: And they brought in the ark of Yahuah (LORD), and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they brought in the ark of Yahuah, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Yashar'el (Israel), as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.
verses.text: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Yashar'el, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.

verses.raw: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Yashar'el (Israel) to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
verses.text: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Yashar'el to day, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!

verses.raw: And David said unto Michal, It was before Yahuah (LORD), which chose me before your father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of Yahuah (LORD), over Yashar'el (Israel): therefore will I play before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And David said unto Michal, It was before Yahuah, which chose me before your father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of Yahuah, over Yashar'el: therefore will I play before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in my own sight: and of the maidservants which you have spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
verses.text: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in my own sight: and of the maidservants which you have spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.

verses.raw: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.
verses.text: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and Yahuah (LORD) had given him rest round about from all his enemies;
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the king sat in his house, and Yahuah had given him rest round about from all his enemies;

verses.raw: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of Elohim (God) dwells within curtains.
verses.text: That the king said unto Nathan the prophet, See now, I dwell in an house of cedar, but the ark of Elohim dwells within curtains.

verses.raw: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in your heart; for Yahuah (LORD) is with you.
verses.text: And Nathan said to the king, Go, do all that is in your heart; for Yahuah is with you.

verses.raw: And it came to pass that night, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Nathan, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass that night, that the word of Yahuah came unto Nathan, saying,

verses.raw: Go and tell my servant David, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Shall you build me an house for me to dwell in?
verses.text: Go and tell my servant David, Thus says Yahuah, Shall you build me an house for me to dwell in?

verses.raw: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.
verses.text: Whereas I have not dwelt in any house since the time that I brought up the children of Yashar'el out of Egypt, even to this day, but have walked in a tent and in a tabernacle.

verses.raw: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) spake I a word with any of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), whom I commanded to feed my people Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Why build you not me an house of cedar?
verses.text: In all the places wherein I have walked with all the children of Yashar'el spake I a word with any of the tribes of Yashar'el, whom I commanded to feed my people Yashar'el, saying, Why build you not me an house of cedar?

verses.raw: Now therefore so shall you say unto my servant David, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), I took you from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Now therefore so shall you say unto my servant David, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, I took you from the sheepcote, from following the sheep, to be ruler over my people, over Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And I was with you whithersoever you went, and have cut off all your enemies out of your sight, and have made you a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.text: And I was with you whithersoever you went, and have cut off all your enemies out of your sight, and have made you a great name, like unto the name of the great men that are in the earth.

verses.raw: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Yashar'el (Israel), and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,
verses.text: Moreover I will appoint a place for my people Yashar'el, and will plant them, that they may dwell in a place of their own, and move no more; neither shall the children of wickedness afflict them any more, as beforetime,

verses.raw: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Yashar'el (Israel), and have caused you to rest from all your enemies. Also Yahuah (LORD) telleth you that he will make you an house.
verses.text: And as since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Yashar'el, and have caused you to rest from all your enemies. Also Yahuah telleth you that he will make you an house.

verses.raw: And when your days be fulfilled, and you shall sleep with your fathers, I will set up your seed after you, which shall proceed out of your bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.text: And when your days be fulfilled, and you shall sleep with your fathers, I will set up your seed after you, which shall proceed out of your bowels, and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.raw: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.
verses.text: He shall build an house for my name, and I will stablish the throne of his kingdom for ever.

verses.raw: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:
verses.text: I will be his father, and he shall be my son. If he commit iniquity, I will chasten him with the rod of men, and with the stripes of the children of men:

verses.raw: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.
verses.text: But my mercy shall not depart away from him, as I took it from Saul, whom I put away before you.

verses.raw: And your house and your kingdom shall be established for ever before you: your throne shall be established for ever.
verses.text: And your house and your kingdom shall be established for ever before you: your throne shall be established for ever.

verses.raw: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

verses.raw: Then went king David in, and sat before Yahuah (LORD), and he said, Who am I, O Adonai (Lord) GOD? and what is my house, that you have brought me hitherto?
verses.text: Then went king David in, and sat before Yahuah, and he said, Who am I, O Adonai GOD? and what is my house, that you have brought me hitherto?

verses.raw: And this was yet a small thing in your sight, O Adonai (Lord) GOD; but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Adonai (Lord) GOD?
verses.text: And this was yet a small thing in your sight, O Adonai GOD; but you have spoken also of your servant’s house for a great while to come. And is this the manner of man, O Adonai GOD?

verses.raw: And what can David say more unto you? for you, Adonai (Lord) GOD, know your servant.
verses.text: And what can David say more unto you? for you, Adonai GOD, know your servant.

verses.raw: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, have you done all these great things, to make your servant know them.
verses.text: For your word’s sake, and according to your own heart, have you done all these great things, to make your servant know them.

verses.raw: Wherefore you are great, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God): for there is none like you, neither is there any Elohim (God) beside you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.text: Wherefore you are great, O Yahuah Elohim: for there is none like you, neither is there any Elohim beside you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.raw: And what one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Yashar'el (Israel), whom Elohim (God) went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for your land, before your people, which you redeemedst to you from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?
verses.text: And what one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Yashar'el, whom Elohim went to redeem for a people to himself, and to make him a name, and to do for you great things and terrible, for your land, before your people, which you redeemedst to you from Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

verses.raw: For you have confirmed to thyself your people Yashar'el (Israel) to be a people unto you for ever: and you, Yahuah (LORD), are become their Elohim (God).
verses.text: For you have confirmed to thyself your people Yashar'el to be a people unto you for ever: and you, Yahuah, are become their Elohim.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as you have said.
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah Elohim, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, establish it for ever, and do as you have said.

verses.raw: And let your name be magnified for ever, saying, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is the Elohim (God) over Yashar'el (Israel): and let the house of your servant David be established before you.
verses.text: And let your name be magnified for ever, saying, Yahuah Tseva'ot is the Elohim over Yashar'el: and let the house of your servant David be established before you.

verses.raw: For you, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), have revealed to your servant, saying, I will build you an house: therefore has your servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto you.
verses.text: For you, O Yahuah Tseva'ot, Elohim of Yashar'el, have revealed to your servant, saying, I will build you an house: therefore has your servant found in his heart to pray this prayer unto you.

verses.raw: And now, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, you are that Elohim (God), and your words be true, and you have promised this goodness unto your servant:
verses.text: And now, O Adonai GOD, you are that Elohim, and your words be true, and you have promised this goodness unto your servant:

verses.raw: Therefore now let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue for ever before you: for you, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, have spoken it: and with your blessing let the house of your servant be blessed for ever.
verses.text: Therefore now let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue for ever before you: for you, O Adonai GOD, have spoken it: and with your blessing let the house of your servant be blessed for ever.

verses.raw: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.text: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took Metheg-ammah out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.
verses.text: And he smote Moab, and measured them with a line, casting them down to the ground; even with two lines measured he to put to death, and with one full line to keep alive. And so the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

verses.raw: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.
verses.text: David smote also Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his border at the river Euphrates.

verses.raw: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.
verses.text: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for an hundred chariots.

verses.raw: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succour Hadadezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

verses.raw: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And Yahuah (LORD) preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.text: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus: and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought gifts. And Yahuah preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.raw: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
verses.text: And from Betah, and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

verses.raw: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,
verses.text: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

verses.raw: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
verses.text: Then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer, and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

verses.raw: Which also king David did dedicate unto Yahuah (LORD), with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;
verses.text: Which also king David did dedicate unto Yahuah, with the silver and gold that he had dedicated of all nations which he subdued;

verses.raw: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
verses.text: Of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

verses.raw: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.
verses.text: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt, being eighteen thousand men.

verses.raw: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David’s servants. And Yahuah (LORD) preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.text: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all they of Edom became David’s servants. And Yahuah preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.raw: And David reigned over all Yashar'el (Israel); and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.
verses.text: And David reigned over all Yashar'el; and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people.

verses.raw: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
verses.text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

verses.raw: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
verses.text: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;

verses.raw: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief rulers.
verses.text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over both the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief rulers.

verses.raw: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?
verses.text: And David said, Is there yet any that is left of the house of Saul, that I may shew him kindness for Jonathan’s sake?

verses.raw: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Are you Ziba? And he said, Your servant is he.
verses.text: And there was of the house of Saul a servant whose name was Ziba. And when they had called him unto David, the king said unto him, Are you Ziba? And he said, Your servant is he.

verses.raw: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of Elohim (God) unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan has yet a son, which is lame on his feet.
verses.text: And the king said, Is there not yet any of the house of Saul, that I may shew the kindness of Elohim unto him? And Ziba said unto the king, Jonathan has yet a son, which is lame on his feet.

verses.raw: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.
verses.text: And the king said unto him, Where is he? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.

verses.raw: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lo-debar.
verses.text: Then king David sent, and fetched him out of the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, from Lo-debar.

verses.raw: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold your servant!
verses.text: Now when Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, the son of Saul, was come unto David, he fell on his face, and did reverence. And David said, Mephibosheth. And he answered, Behold your servant!

verses.raw: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore you all the land of Saul your father; and you shall eat bread at my table continually.
verses.text: And David said unto him, Fear not: for I will surely shew you kindness for Jonathan your father’s sake, and will restore you all the land of Saul your father; and you shall eat bread at my table continually.

verses.raw: And he bowed himself, and said, What is your servant, that you should look upon such a dead dog as I am?
verses.text: And he bowed himself, and said, What is your servant, that you should look upon such a dead dog as I am?

verses.raw: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said unto him, I have given unto your master’s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.
verses.text: Then the king called to Ziba, Saul’s servant, and said unto him, I have given unto your master’s son all that pertained to Saul and to all his house.

verses.raw: You therefore, and your sons, and your servants, shall till the land for him, and you shall bring in the fruits, that your master’s son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth your master’s son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
verses.text: You therefore, and your sons, and your servants, shall till the land for him, and you shall bring in the fruits, that your master’s son may have food to eat: but Mephibosheth your master’s son shall eat bread alway at my table. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.

verses.raw: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king has commanded his servant, so shall your servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king’s sons.
verses.text: Then said Ziba unto the king, According to all that my lord the king has commanded his servant, so shall your servant do. As for Mephibosheth, said the king, he shall eat at my table, as one of the king’s sons.

verses.raw: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.
verses.text: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.

verses.raw: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king’s table; and was lame on both his feet.
verses.text: So Mephibosheth dwelt in Jerusalem: for he did eat continually at the king’s table; and was lame on both his feet.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that the king of the children of Ammon died, and Hanun his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
verses.text: Then said David, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, as his father shewed kindness unto me. And David sent to comfort him by the hand of his servants for his father. And David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest you that David does honour your father, that he has sent comforters unto you? has not David rather sent his servants unto you, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?
verses.text: And the princes of the children of Ammon said unto Hanun their lord, Thinkest you that David does honour your father, that he has sent comforters unto you? has not David rather sent his servants unto you, to search the city, and to spy it out, and to overthrow it?

verses.raw: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.text: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved off the one half of their beards, and cut off their garments in the middle, even to their buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.raw: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
verses.text: When they told it unto David, he sent to meet them, because the men were greatly ashamed: and the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

verses.raw: And when the children of Ammon saw that they stank before David, the children of Ammon sent and hired the Syrians of Beth-rehob, and the Syrians of Zoba, twenty thousand footmen, and of king Maacah a thousand men, and of Ish-tob twelve thousand men.

verses.raw: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.text: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

verses.raw: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ish-tob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
verses.text: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the entering in of the gate: and the Syrians of Zoba, and of Rehob, and Ish-tob, and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.

verses.text: And the rest of the people he delivered into the hand of Abishai his brother, that he might put them in array against the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then you shall help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for you, then I will come and help you.
verses.text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then you shall help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for you, then I will come and help you.

verses.raw: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our Elohim (God): and Yahuah (LORD) do that which seems him good.
verses.text: Be of good courage, and let us play the men for our people, and for the cities of our Elohim: and Yahuah do that which seems him good.

verses.raw: And Joab drew nigh, and the people that were with him, unto the battle against the Syrians: and they fled before him.

verses.raw: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, then fled they also before Abishai, and entered into the city. So Joab returned from the children of Ammon, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Yashar'el (Israel), they gathered themselves together.
verses.text: And when the Syrians saw that they were smitten before Yashar'el, they gathered themselves together.

verses.raw: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
verses.text: And Hadarezer sent, and brought out the Syrians that were beyond the river: and they came to Helam; and Shobach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

verses.raw: And when it was told David, he gathered all Yashar'el (Israel) together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.
verses.text: And when it was told David, he gathered all Yashar'el together, and passed over Jordan, and came to Helam. And the Syrians set themselves in array against David, and fought with him.

verses.raw: And the Syrians fled before Yashar'el (Israel); and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.
verses.text: And the Syrians fled before Yashar'el; and David slew the men of seven hundred chariots of the Syrians, and forty thousand horsemen, and smote Shobach the captain of their host, who died there.

verses.raw: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Yashar'el (Israel), they made peace with Yashar'el (Israel), and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.text: And when all the kings that were servants to Hadarezer saw that they were smitten before Yashar'el, they made peace with Yashar'el, and served them. So the Syrians feared to help the children of Ammon any more.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, after the year was expired, at the time when kings go forth to battle, that David sent Joab, and his servants with him, and all Yashar'el (Israel); and they destroyed the children of Ammon, and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried still at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.
verses.text: And it came to pass in an eveningtide, that David arose from off his bed, and walked upon the roof of the king’s house: and from the roof he saw a woman washing herself; and the woman was very beautiful to look upon.

verses.raw: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?
verses.text: And David sent and enquired after the woman. And one said, Is not this Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam, the wife of Uriah the Hittite?

verses.raw: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.
verses.text: And David sent messengers, and took her; and she came in unto him, and he lay with her; for she was purified from her uncleanness: and she returned unto her house.

verses.raw: And the woman conceived, and sent and told David, and said, I am with child.

verses.raw: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.
verses.text: And David sent to Joab, saying, Send me Uriah the Hittite. And Joab sent Uriah to David.

verses.raw: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.
verses.text: And when Uriah was come unto him, David demanded of him how Joab did, and how the people did, and how the war prospered.

verses.raw: And David said to Uriah, Go down to your house, and wash your feet. And Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.
verses.text: And David said to Uriah, Go down to your house, and wash your feet. And Uriah departed out of the king’s house, and there followed him a mess of meat from the king.

verses.raw: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.
verses.text: But Uriah slept at the door of the king’s house with all the servants of his lord, and went not down to his house.

verses.raw: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Came you not from your journey? why then did you not go down unto your house?
verses.text: And when they had told David, saying, Uriah went not down unto his house, David said unto Uriah, Came you not from your journey? why then did you not go down unto your house?

verses.raw: And Uriah said unto David, The ark, and Yashar'el (Israel), and Yahudah (Judah), abide in tents; and my lord Joab, and the servants of my lord, are encamped in the open fields; shall I then go into my house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife? as you livest, and as your soul lives, I will not do this thing.

verses.raw: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let you depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.
verses.text: And David said to Uriah, Tarry here to day also, and to morrow I will let you depart. So Uriah abode in Jerusalem that day, and the morrow.

verses.raw: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.
verses.text: And when David had called him, he did eat and drink before him; and he made him drunk: and at even he went out to lie on his bed with the servants of his lord, but went not down to his house.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the morning, that David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

verses.raw: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set you Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire you from him, that he may be smitten, and die.
verses.text: And he wrote in the letter, saying, Set you Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle, and retire you from him, that he may be smitten, and die.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Joab observed the city, that he assigned Uriah unto a place where he knew that valiant men were.

verses.raw: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.
verses.text: And the men of the city went out, and fought with Joab: and there fell some of the people of the servants of David; and Uriah the Hittite died also.

verses.raw: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;
verses.text: Then Joab sent and told David all the things concerning the war;

verses.raw: And charged the messenger, saying, When you have made an end of telling the matters of the war unto the king,

verses.raw: And if so be that the king’s wrath arise, and he say unto you, Wherefore approached you so nigh unto the city when you did fight? knew you not that they would shoot from the wall?
verses.text: And if so be that the king’s wrath arise, and he say unto you, Wherefore approached you so nigh unto the city when you did fight? knew you not that they would shoot from the wall?

verses.raw: Who smote Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? did not a woman cast a piece of a millstone upon him from the wall, that he died in Thebez? why went you nigh the wall? then say you, Your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
