verses.raw: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.
verses.text: So the messenger went, and came and shewed David all that Joab had sent him for.

verses.raw: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.
verses.text: And the messenger said unto David, Surely the men prevailed against us, and came out unto us into the field, and we were upon them even unto the entering of the gate.

verses.raw: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon your servants; and some of the king’s servants be dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.
verses.text: And the shooters shot from off the wall upon your servants; and some of the king’s servants be dead, and your servant Uriah the Hittite is dead also.

verses.raw: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shall you say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another: make your battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage you him.
verses.text: Then David said unto the messenger, Thus shall you say unto Joab, Let not this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another: make your battle more strong against the city, and overthrow it: and encourage you him.

verses.raw: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.
verses.text: And when the wife of Uriah heard that Uriah her husband was dead, she mourned for her husband.

verses.raw: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And when the mourning was past, David sent and fetched her to his house, and she became his wife, and bare him a son. But the thing that David had done displeased Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.
verses.text: And Yahuah sent Nathan unto David. And he came unto him, and said unto him, There were two men in one city; the one rich, and the other poor.

verses.raw: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:
verses.text: The rich man had exceeding many flocks and herds:

verses.raw: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.
verses.text: But the poor man had nothing, save one little ewe lamb, which he had bought and nourished up: and it grew up together with him, and with his children; it did eat of his own meat, and drank of his own cup, and lay in his bosom, and was unto him as a daughter.

verses.raw: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man’s lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.
verses.text: And there came a traveller unto the rich man, and he spared to take of his own flock and of his own herd, to dress for the wayfaring man that was come unto him; but took the poor man’s lamb, and dressed it for the man that was come to him.

verses.raw: And David’s anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, the man that has done this thing shall surely die:
verses.text: And David’s anger was greatly kindled against the man; and he said to Nathan, As Yahuah lives, the man that has done this thing shall surely die:

verses.raw: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
verses.text: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.

verses.raw: And Nathan said to David, You are the man. Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), I anointed you king over Yashar'el (Israel), and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul;
verses.text: And Nathan said to David, You are the man. Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, I anointed you king over Yashar'el, and I delivered you out of the hand of Saul;

verses.raw: And I gave you your master’s house, and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and of Yahudah (Judah); and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto you such and such things.
verses.text: And I gave you your master’s house, and your master’s wives into your bosom, and gave you the house of Yashar'el and of Yahudah; and if that had been too little, I would moreover have given unto you such and such things.

verses.raw: Wherefore have you despised the commandment of Yahuah (LORD), to do evil in his sight? you have killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.
verses.text: Wherefore have you despised the commandment of Yahuah, to do evil in his sight? you have killed Uriah the Hittite with the sword, and have taken his wife to be your wife, and have slain him with the sword of the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from your house; because you have despised me, and have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your wife.
verses.text: Now therefore the sword shall never depart from your house; because you have despised me, and have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your wife.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house, and I will take your wives before your eyes, and give them unto your neighbour, and he shall lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will raise up evil against you out of your own house, and I will take your wives before your eyes, and give them unto your neighbour, and he shall lie with your wives in the sight of this sun.

verses.raw: For you did it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Yashar'el (Israel), and before the sun.
verses.text: For you did it secretly: but I will do this thing before all Yashar'el, and before the sun.

verses.raw: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against Yahuah (LORD). And Nathan said unto David, Yahuah (LORD) also has put away your sin; you shall not die.
verses.text: And David said unto Nathan, I have sinned against Yahuah. And Nathan said unto David, Yahuah also has put away your sin; you shall not die.

verses.raw: Howbeit, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the enemies of Yahuah (LORD) to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto you shall surely die.
verses.text: Howbeit, because by this deed you have given great occasion to the enemies of Yahuah to blaspheme, the child also that is born unto you shall surely die.

verses.raw: And Nathan departed unto his house. And Yahuah (LORD) struck the child that Uriah’s wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.
verses.text: And Nathan departed unto his house. And Yahuah struck the child that Uriah’s wife bare unto David, and it was very sick.

verses.raw: David therefore besought Elohim (God) for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.
verses.text: David therefore besought Elohim for the child; and David fasted, and went in, and lay all night upon the earth.

verses.raw: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.
verses.text: And the elders of his house arose, and went to him, to raise him up from the earth: but he would not, neither did he eat bread with them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. And the servants of David feared to tell him that the child was dead: for they said, Behold, while the child was yet alive, we spake unto him, and he would not hearken unto our voice: how will he then vex himself, if we tell him that the child is dead?
verses.text: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that the child died. verses.raw: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.
verses.text: But when David saw that his servants whispered, David perceived that the child was dead: therefore David said unto his servants, Is the child dead? And they said, He is dead.

verses.raw: Then David arose from the earth, and washed, and anointed himself, and changed his apparel, and came into the house of Yahuah (LORD), and worshipped: then he came to his own house; and when he required, they set bread before him, and he did eat.

verses.raw: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that you have done? you did fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, you did rise and eat bread.
verses.text: Then said his servants unto him, What thing is this that you have done? you did fast and weep for the child, while it was alive; but when the child was dead, you did rise and eat bread.

verses.raw: And he said, While the child was yet alive, I fasted and wept: for I said, Who can tell whether GOD will be gracious to me, that the child may live?

verses.raw: But now he is dead, wherefore should I fast? can I bring him back again? I shall go to him, but he shall not return to me.

verses.raw: And David comforted Bath-sheba his wife, and went in unto her, and lay with her: and she bare a son, and he called his name Solomon: and Yahuah (LORD) loved him.

verses.raw: And Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.

verses.raw: Now therefore gather the rest of the people together, and encamp against the city, and take it: lest I take the city, and it be called after my name.

verses.raw: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.
verses.text: And David gathered all the people together, and went to Rabbah, and fought against it, and took it.

verses.raw: And he took their king’s crown from off his head, the weight whereof was a talent of gold with the precious stones: and it was set on David’s head. And he brought forth the spoil of the city in great abundance.

verses.raw: And he brought forth the people that were therein, and put them under saws, and under harrows of iron, and under axes of iron, and made them pass through the brickkiln: and thus did he unto all the cities of the children of Ammon. So David and all the people returned unto Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom the son of David had a fair sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.

verses.raw: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.
verses.text: And Amnon was so vexed, that he fell sick for his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin; and Amnon thought it hard for him to do any thing to her.

verses.raw: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.
verses.text: But Amnon had a friend, whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother: and Jonadab was a very subtil man.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Why are you, being the king’s son, lean from day to day? will you not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.
verses.text: And he said unto him, Why are you, being the king’s son, lean from day to day? will you not tell me? And Amnon said unto him, I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.

verses.raw: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay you down on your bed, and make thyself sick: and when your father comes to see you, say unto him, I pray you, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.
verses.text: And Jonadab said unto him, Lay you down on your bed, and make thyself sick: and when your father comes to see you, say unto him, I pray you, let my sister Tamar come, and give me meat, and dress the meat in my sight, that I may see it, and eat it at her hand.

verses.raw: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray you, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.
verses.text: So Amnon lay down, and made himself sick: and when the king was come to see him, Amnon said unto the king, I pray you, let Tamar my sister come, and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat at her hand.

verses.raw: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and dress him meat.
verses.text: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and dress him meat.

verses.raw: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.
verses.text: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was laid down. And she took flour, and kneaded it, and made cakes in his sight, and did bake the cakes.

verses.raw: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.
verses.text: And she took a pan, and poured them out before him; but he refused to eat. And Amnon said, Have out all men from me. And they went out every man from him.

verses.text: And Amnon said unto Tamar, Bring the meat into the chamber, that I may eat of your hand. And Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the chamber to Amnon her brother.

verses.raw: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.
verses.text: And when she had brought them unto him to eat, he took hold of her, and said unto her, Come lie with me, my sister.

verses.raw: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Yashar'el (Israel): do not you this folly.
verses.text: And she answered him, Nay, my brother, do not force me; for no such thing ought to be done in Yashar'el: do not you this folly.

verses.raw: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for you, you shall be as one of the fools in Yashar'el (Israel). Now therefore, I pray you, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from you.
verses.text: And I, whither shall I cause my shame to go? and as for you, you shall be as one of the fools in Yashar'el. Now therefore, I pray you, speak unto the king; for he will not withhold me from you.

verses.raw: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.
verses.text: Howbeit he would not hearken unto her voice: but, being stronger than she, forced her, and lay with her.

verses.raw: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.
verses.text: Then Amnon hated her exceedingly; so that the hatred wherewith he hated her was greater than the love wherewith he had loved her. And Amnon said unto her, Arise, be gone.

verses.raw: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that you did unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.
verses.text: And she said unto him, There is no cause: this evil in sending me away is greater than the other that you did unto me. But he would not hearken unto her.

verses.raw: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.
verses.text: Then he called his servant that ministered unto him, and said, Put now this woman out from me, and bolt the door after her.

verses.raw: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king’s daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.
verses.text: And she had a garment of divers colours upon her: for with such robes were the king’s daughters that were virgins apparelled. Then his servant brought her out, and bolted the door after her.

verses.raw: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.
verses.text: And Tamar put ashes on her head, and rent her garment of divers colours that was on her, and laid her hand on her head, and went on crying.

verses.raw: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Has Amnon your brother been with you? but hold now your peace, my sister: he is your brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.
verses.text: And Absalom her brother said unto her, Has Amnon your brother been with you? but hold now your peace, my sister: he is your brother; regard not this thing. So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.

verses.raw: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.
verses.text: But when king David heard of all these things, he was very wroth.

verses.raw: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
verses.text: And Absalom spake unto his brother Amnon neither good nor bad: for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal-hazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.
verses.text: And it came to pass after two full years, that Absalom had sheepshearers in Baal-hazor, which is beside Ephraim: and Absalom invited all the king’s sons.

verses.raw: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, your servant has sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech you, and his servants go with your servant.
verses.text: And Absalom came to the king, and said, Behold now, your servant has sheepshearers; let the king, I beseech you, and his servants go with your servant.

verses.raw: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto you. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.
verses.text: And the king said to Absalom, Nay, my son, let us not all now go, lest we be chargeable unto you. And he pressed him: howbeit he would not go, but blessed him.

verses.raw: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray you, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with you?
verses.text: Then said Absalom, If not, I pray you, let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said unto him, Why should he go with you?

verses.raw: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
verses.text: But Absalom pressed him, that he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.

verses.raw: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark you now when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.
verses.text: Now Absalom had commanded his servants, saying, Mark you now when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine, and when I say unto you, Smite Amnon; then kill him, fear not: have not I commanded you? be courageous, and be valiant.

verses.raw: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.
verses.text: And the servants of Absalom did unto Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man gat him up upon his mule, and fled.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left.
verses.text: And it came to pass, while they were in the way, that tidings came to David, saying, Absalom has slain all the king’s sons, and there is not one of them left.

verses.raw: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.
verses.text: Then the king arose, and tare his garments, and lay on the earth; and all his servants stood by with their clothes rent.

verses.raw: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king’s sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
verses.text: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah David’s brother, answered and said, Let not my lord suppose that they have slain all the young men the king’s sons; for Amnon only is dead: for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.

verses.raw: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.
verses.text: Now therefore let not my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead: for Amnon only is dead.

verses.raw: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.
verses.text: But Absalom fled. And the young man that kept the watch lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came much people by the way of the hill side behind him.

verses.raw: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king’s sons come: as your servant said, so it is.
verses.text: And Jonadab said unto the king, Behold, the king’s sons come: as your servant said, so it is.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as soon as he had made an end of speaking, that, behold, the king’s sons came, and lifted up their voice and wept: and the king also and all his servants wept very sore.

verses.raw: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.
verses.text: But Absalom fled, and went to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, king of Geshur. And David mourned for his son every day.

verses.raw: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.
verses.text: So Absalom fled, and went to Geshur, and was there three years.

verses.raw: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.
verses.text: And the soul of king David longed to go forth unto Absalom: for he was comforted concerning Amnon, seeing he was dead.

verses.raw: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.
verses.text: Now Joab the son of Zeruiah perceived that the king’s heart was toward Absalom.

verses.raw: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray you, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:
verses.text: And Joab sent to Tekoah, and fetched thence a wise woman, and said unto her, I pray you, feign thyself to be a mourner, and put on now mourning apparel, and anoint not thyself with oil, but be as a woman that had a long time mourned for the dead:

verses.raw: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.
verses.text: And come to the king, and speak on this manner unto him. So Joab put the words in her mouth.

verses.raw: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.
verses.text: And when the woman of Tekoah spake to the king, she fell on her face to the ground, and did obeisance, and said, Help, O king.

verses.raw: And the king said unto her, What aileth you? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and my husband is dead.
verses.text: And the king said unto her, What aileth you? And she answered, I am indeed a widow woman, and my husband is dead.

verses.raw: And your handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.
verses.text: And your handmaid had two sons, and they two strove together in the field, and there was none to part them, but the one smote the other, and slew him.

verses.raw: And, behold, the whole family is risen against your handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.
verses.text: And, behold, the whole family is risen against your handmaid, and they said, Deliver him that smote his brother, that we may kill him, for the life of his brother whom he slew; and we will destroy the heir also: and so they shall quench my coal which is left, and shall not leave to my husband neither name nor remainder upon the earth.

verses.raw: And the king said unto the woman, Go to your house, and I will give charge concerning you.
verses.text: And the king said unto the woman, Go to your house, and I will give charge concerning you.

verses.raw: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.
verses.text: And the woman of Tekoah said unto the king, My lord, O king, the iniquity be on me, and on my father’s house: and the king and his throne be guiltless.

verses.raw: And the king said, Whosoever says ought unto you, bring him to me, and he shall not touch you any more.
verses.text: And the king said, Whosoever says ought unto you, bring him to me, and he shall not touch you any more.

verses.raw: Then said she, I pray you, let the king remember Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), that you would not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, there shall not one hair of your son fall to the earth.
verses.text: Then said she, I pray you, let the king remember Yahuah Elohayka, that you would not suffer the revengers of blood to destroy any more, lest they destroy my son. And he said, As Yahuah lives, there shall not one hair of your son fall to the earth.

verses.raw: Then the woman said, Let your handmaid, I pray you, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.
verses.text: Then the woman said, Let your handmaid, I pray you, speak one word unto my lord the king. And he said, Say on.

verses.raw: And the woman said, Wherefore then have you thought such a thing against the people of Elohim (God)? for the king does speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king does not fetch home again his banished.
verses.text: And the woman said, Wherefore then have you thought such a thing against the people of Elohim? for the king does speak this thing as one which is faulty, in that the king does not fetch home again his banished.

verses.raw: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither does Elohim (God) respect any person: yet does he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.
verses.text: For we must needs die, and are as water spilt on the ground, which cannot be gathered up again; neither does Elohim respect any person: yet does he devise means, that his banished be not expelled from him.

verses.raw: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and your handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.
verses.text: Now therefore that I am come to speak of this thing unto my lord the king, it is because the people have made me afraid: and your handmaid said, I will now speak unto the king; it may be that the king will perform the request of his handmaid.

verses.raw: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For the king will hear, to deliver his handmaid out of the hand of the man that would destroy me and my son together out of the inheritance of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then your handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of Elohim (God), so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will be with you.
verses.text: Then your handmaid said, The word of my lord the king shall now be comfortable: for as an angel of Elohim, so is my lord the king to discern good and bad: therefore Yahuah Elohayka will be with you.

verses.raw: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray you, the thing that I shall ask you. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.
verses.text: Then the king answered and said unto the woman, Hide not from me, I pray you, the thing that I shall ask you. And the woman said, Let my lord the king now speak.

verses.raw: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with you in all this? And the woman answered and said, As your soul lives, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king has spoken: for your servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your handmaid:
verses.text: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with you in all this? And the woman answered and said, As your soul lives, my lord the king, none can turn to the right hand or to the left from ought that my lord the king has spoken: for your servant Joab, he bade me, and he put all these words in the mouth of your handmaid:

verses.raw: To fetch about this form of speech has your servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of Elohim (God), to know all things that are in the earth.
verses.text: To fetch about this form of speech has your servant Joab done this thing: and my lord is wise, according to the wisdom of an angel of Elohim, to know all things that are in the earth.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.
verses.text: And the king said unto Joab, Behold now, I have done this thing: go therefore, bring the young man Absalom again.

verses.raw: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day your servant knows that I have found grace in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has fulfilled the request of his servant.
verses.text: And Joab fell to the ground on his face, and bowed himself, and thanked the king: and Joab said, To day your servant knows that I have found grace in your sight, my lord, O king, in that the king has fulfilled the request of his servant.

verses.raw: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.
verses.text: So Joab arose and went to Geshur, and brought Absalom to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king’s face.
verses.text: And the king said, Let him turn to his own house, and let him not see my face. So Absalom returned to his own house, and saw not the king’s face.

verses.raw: But in all Yashar'el (Israel) there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.
verses.text: But in all Yashar'el there was none to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty: from the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no blemish in him.

verses.raw: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year’s end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king’s weight.
verses.text: And when he polled his head, (for it was at every year’s end that he polled it: because the hair was heavy on him, therefore he polled it:) he weighed the hair of his head at two hundred shekels after the king’s weight.

verses.raw: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.
verses.text: And unto Absalom there were born three sons, and one daughter, whose name was Tamar: she was a woman of a fair countenance.

verses.raw: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king’s face.
verses.text: So Absalom dwelt two full years in Jerusalem, and saw not the king’s face.

verses.raw: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.
verses.text: Therefore Absalom sent for Joab, to have sent him to the king; but he would not come to him: and when he sent again the second time, he would not come.

verses.raw: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.
verses.text: Therefore he said unto his servants, See, Joab’s field is near mine, and he has barley there; go and set it on fire. And Absalom’s servants set the field on fire.

verses.raw: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have your servants set my field on fire?
verses.text: Then Joab arose, and came to Absalom unto his house, and said unto him, Wherefore have your servants set my field on fire?

verses.raw: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto you, saying, Come hither, that I may send you to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king’s face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.
verses.text: And Absalom answered Joab, Behold, I sent unto you, saying, Come hither, that I may send you to the king, to say, Wherefore am I come from Geshur? it had been good for me to have been there still: now therefore let me see the king’s face; and if there be any iniquity in me, let him kill me.

verses.raw: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.
verses.text: So Joab came to the king, and told him: and when he had called for Absalom, he came to the king, and bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king: and the king kissed Absalom.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that Absalom prepared him chariots and horses, and fifty men to run before him.

verses.raw: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city are you? And he said, Your servant is of one of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Absalom rose up early, and stood beside the way of the gate: and it was so, that when any man that had a controversy came to the king for judgment, then Absalom called unto him, and said, Of what city are you? And he said, Your servant is of one of the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Absalom said unto him, See, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear you.
verses.text: And Absalom said unto him, See, your matters are good and right; but there is no man deputed of the king to hear you.

verses.raw: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which has any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!
verses.text: Absalom said moreover, Oh that I were made judge in the land, that every man which has any suit or cause might come unto me, and I would do him justice!

verses.raw: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.
verses.text: And it was so, that when any man came nigh to him to do him obeisance, he put forth his hand, and took him, and kissed him.

verses.raw: And on this manner did Absalom to all Yashar'el (Israel) that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And on this manner did Absalom to all Yashar'el that came to the king for judgment: so Absalom stole the hearts of the men of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray you, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto Yahuah (LORD), in Hebron.
verses.text: And it came to pass after forty years, that Absalom said unto the king, I pray you, let me go and pay my vow, which I have vowed unto Yahuah, in Hebron.

verses.raw: For your servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If Yahuah (LORD) shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For your servant vowed a vow while I abode at Geshur in Syria, saying, If Yahuah shall bring me again indeed to Jerusalem, then I will serve Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.
verses.text: And the king said unto him, Go in peace. So he arose, and went to Hebron.

verses.raw: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, Absalom reigns in Hebron.
verses.text: But Absalom sent spies throughout all the tribes of Yashar'el, saying, As soon as you hear the sound of the trumpet, then you shall say, Absalom reigns in Hebron.

verses.raw: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.
verses.text: And with Absalom went two hundred men out of Jerusalem, that were called; and they went in their simplicity, and they knew not any thing.

verses.raw: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.
verses.text: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, David’s counsellor, from his city, even from Giloh, while he offered sacrifices. And the conspiracy was strong; for the people increased continually with Absalom.

verses.raw: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Yashar'el (Israel) are after Absalom.
verses.text: And there came a messenger to David, saying, The hearts of the men of Yashar'el are after Absalom.

verses.raw: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And David said unto all his servants that were with him at Jerusalem, Arise, and let us flee; for we shall not else escape from Absalom: make speed to depart, lest he overtake us suddenly, and bring evil upon us, and smite the city with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And the king’s servants said unto the king, Behold, your servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.
verses.text: And the king’s servants said unto the king, Behold, your servants are ready to do whatsoever my lord the king shall appoint.

verses.raw: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.
verses.text: And the king went forth, and all his household after him. And the king left ten women, which were concubines, to keep the house.

verses.raw: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.
verses.text: And the king went forth, and all the people after him, and tarried in a place that was far off.

verses.raw: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.
verses.text: And all his servants passed on beside him; and all the Cherethites, and all the Pelethites, and all the Gittites, six hundred men which came after him from Gath, passed on before the king.

verses.raw: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore go you also with us? return to your place, and abide with the king: for you are a stranger, and also an exile.
verses.text: Then said the king to Ittai the Gittite, Wherefore go you also with us? return to your place, and abide with the king: for you are a stranger, and also an exile.

verses.raw: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I this day make you go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return you, and take back your brethren: mercy and truth be with you.
verses.text: Whereas you came but yesterday, should I this day make you go up and down with us? seeing I go whither I may, return you, and take back your brethren: mercy and truth be with you.

verses.raw: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will your servant be.
verses.text: And Ittai answered the king, and said, As Yahuah lives, and as my lord the king lives, surely in what place my lord the king shall be, whether in death or life, even there also will your servant be.

verses.raw: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.
verses.text: And David said to Ittai, Go and pass over. And Ittai the Gittite passed over, and all his men, and all the little ones that were with him.

verses.raw: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.
verses.text: And all the country wept with a loud voice, and all the people passed over: the king also himself passed over the brook Kidron, and all the people passed over, toward the way of the wilderness.

verses.raw: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of Elohim (God): and they set down the ark of Elohim (God); and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.
verses.text: And lo Zadok also, and all the Levites were with him, bearing the ark of the covenant of Elohim: and they set down the ark of Elohim; and Abiathar went up, until all the people had done passing out of the city.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of Elohim (God) into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:
verses.text: And the king said unto Zadok, Carry back the ark of Elohim into the city: if I shall find favour in the eyes of Yahuah, he will bring me again, and shew me both it, and his habitation:

verses.raw: But if he thus say, I have no delight in you; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seems good unto him.
verses.text: But if he thus say, I have no delight in you; behold, here am I, let him do to me as seems good unto him.

verses.raw: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Are not you a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.
verses.text: The king said also unto Zadok the priest, Are not you a seer? return into the city in peace, and your two sons with you, Ahimaaz your son, and Jonathan the son of Abiathar.

verses.raw: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.
verses.text: See, I will tarry in the plain of the wilderness, until there come word from you to certify me.

verses.raw: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of Elohim (God) again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.
verses.text: Zadok therefore and Abiathar carried the ark of Elohim again to Jerusalem: and they tarried there.

verses.raw: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.
verses.text: And David went up by the ascent of mount Olivet, and wept as he went up, and had his head covered, and he went barefoot: and all the people that was with him covered every man his head, and they went up, weeping as they went up.

verses.raw: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O Yahuah (LORD), I pray you, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.
verses.text: And one told David, saying, Ahithophel is among the conspirators with Absalom. And David said, O Yahuah, I pray you, turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped Elohim (God), behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when David was come to the top of the mount, where he worshipped Elohim, behold, Hushai the Archite came to meet him with his coat rent, and earth upon his head:

verses.raw: Unto whom David said, If you passest on with me, then you shall be a burden unto me:
verses.text: Unto whom David said, If you passest on with me, then you shall be a burden unto me:

verses.raw: But if you return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be your servant, O king; as I have been your father’s servant hitherto, so will I now also be your servant: then may you for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.
verses.text: But if you return to the city, and say unto Absalom, I will be your servant, O king; as I have been your father’s servant hitherto, so will I now also be your servant: then may you for me defeat the counsel of Ahithophel.

verses.raw: And have you not there with you Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever you shall hear out of the king’s house, you shall tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
verses.text: And have you not there with you Zadok and Abiathar the priests? therefore it shall be, that what thing soever you shall hear out of the king’s house, you shall tell it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.

verses.raw: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok’s son, and Jonathan Abiathar’s son; and by them you shall send unto me every thing that you can hear.
verses.text: Behold, they have there with them their two sons, Ahimaaz Zadok’s son, and Jonathan Abiathar’s son; and by them you shall send unto me every thing that you can hear.

verses.raw: So Hushai David’s friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.
verses.text: So Hushai David’s friend came into the city, and Absalom came into Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.
verses.text: And when David was a little past the top of the hill, behold, Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him, with a couple of asses saddled, and upon them two hundred loaves of bread, and an hundred bunches of raisins, and an hundred of summer fruits, and a bottle of wine.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest you by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.
verses.text: And the king said unto Ziba, What meanest you by these? And Ziba said, The asses be for the king’s household to ride on; and the bread and summer fruit for the young men to eat; and the wine, that such as be faint in the wilderness may drink.

verses.raw: And the king said, And where is your master’s son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abides at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Yashar'el (Israel) restore me the kingdom of my father.
verses.text: And the king said, And where is your master’s son? And Ziba said unto the king, Behold, he abides at Jerusalem: for he said, To day shall the house of Yashar'el restore me the kingdom of my father.

verses.raw: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, yours are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech you that I may find grace in your sight, my lord, O king.
verses.text: Then said the king to Ziba, Behold, yours are all that pertained unto Mephibosheth. And Ziba said, I humbly beseech you that I may find grace in your sight, my lord, O king.

verses.raw: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.
verses.text: And when king David came to Bahurim, behold, thence came out a man of the family of the house of Saul, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera: he came forth, and cursed still as he came.

verses.raw: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.
verses.text: And he cast stones at David, and at all the servants of king David: and all the people and all the mighty men were on his right hand and on his left.

verses.raw: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, you bloody man, and you man of Belial:
verses.text: And thus said Shimei when he cursed, Come out, come out, you bloody man, and you man of Belial:

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has returned upon you all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead you have reigned; and Yahuah (LORD) has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son: and, behold, you are taken in your mischief, because you are a bloody man.
verses.text: Yahuah has returned upon you all the blood of the house of Saul, in whose stead you have reigned; and Yahuah has delivered the kingdom into the hand of Absalom your son: and, behold, you are taken in your mischief, because you are a bloody man.

verses.raw: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray you, and take off his head.
verses.text: Then said Abishai the son of Zeruiah unto the king, Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? let me go over, I pray you, and take off his head.

verses.raw: And the king said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because Yahuah (LORD) has said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore have you done so?
verses.text: And the king said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? so let him curse, because Yahuah has said unto him, Curse David. Who shall then say, Wherefore have you done so?

verses.raw: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeks my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for Yahuah (LORD) has bidden him.
verses.text: And David said to Abishai, and to all his servants, Behold, my son, which came forth of my bowels, seeks my life: how much more now may this Benjamite do it? let him alone, and let him curse; for Yahuah has bidden him.

verses.raw: It may be that Yahuah (LORD) will look on my affliction, and that Yahuah (LORD) will requite me good for his cursing this day.
verses.text: It may be that Yahuah will look on my affliction, and that Yahuah will requite me good for his cursing this day.

verses.raw: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill’s side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.
verses.text: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill’s side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.

verses.raw: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.
verses.text: And the king, and all the people that were with him, came weary, and refreshed themselves there.

verses.raw: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Yashar'el (Israel), came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.
verses.text: And Absalom, and all the people the men of Yashar'el, came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel with him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, Elohim (God) save the king, Elohim (God) save the king.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Hushai the Archite, David’s friend, was come unto Absalom, that Hushai said unto Absalom, Elohim save the king, Elohim save the king.

verses.raw: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this your kindness to your friend? why went you not with your friend?
verses.text: And Absalom said to Hushai, Is this your kindness to your friend? why went you not with your friend?

verses.raw: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom Yahuah (LORD), and this people, and all the men of Yashar'el (Israel), choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.
verses.text: And Hushai said unto Absalom, Nay; but whom Yahuah, and this people, and all the men of Yashar'el, choose, his will I be, and with him will I abide.

verses.raw: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in your father’s presence, so will I be in your presence.
verses.text: And again, whom should I serve? should I not serve in the presence of his son? as I have served in your father’s presence, so will I be in your presence.

verses.raw: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.
verses.text: Then said Absalom to Ahithophel, Give counsel among you what we shall do.

verses.raw: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto your father’s concubines, which he has left to keep the house; and all Yashar'el (Israel) shall hear that you are abhorred of your father: then shall the hands of all that are with you be strong.
verses.text: And Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Go in unto your father’s concubines, which he has left to keep the house; and all Yashar'el shall hear that you are abhorred of your father: then shall the hands of all that are with you be strong.

verses.raw: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father’s concubines in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So they spread Absalom a tent upon the top of the house; and Absalom went in unto his father’s concubines in the sight of all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of Elohim (God): so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.
verses.text: And the counsel of Ahithophel, which he counselled in those days, was as if a man had enquired at the oracle of Elohim: so was all the counsel of Ahithophel both with David and with Absalom.

verses.raw: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:
verses.text: Moreover Ahithophel said unto Absalom, Let me now choose out twelve thousand men, and I will arise and pursue after David this night:

verses.raw: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:
verses.text: And I will come upon him while he is weary and weak handed, and will make him afraid: and all the people that are with him shall flee; and I will smite the king only:

verses.raw: And I will bring back all the people unto you: the man whom you seek is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.
verses.text: And I will bring back all the people unto you: the man whom you seek is as if all returned: so all the people shall be in peace.

verses.raw: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the saying pleased Absalom well, and all the elders of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he says.
verses.text: Then said Absalom, Call now Hushai the Archite also, and let us hear likewise what he says.

verses.raw: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel has spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak you.
verses.text: And when Hushai was come to Absalom, Absalom spake unto him, saying, Ahithophel has spoken after this manner: shall we do after his saying? if not; speak you.

verses.raw: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel has given is not good at this time.
verses.text: And Hushai said unto Absalom, The counsel that Ahithophel has given is not good at this time.

verses.raw: For, said Hushai, you know your father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.
verses.text: For, said Hushai, you know your father and his men, that they be mighty men, and they be chafed in their minds, as a bear robbed of her whelps in the field: and your father is a man of war, and will not lodge with the people.

verses.raw: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever hears it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.
verses.text: Behold, he is hid now in some pit, or in some other place: and it will come to pass, when some of them be overthrown at the first, that whosoever hears it will say, There is a slaughter among the people that follow Absalom.

verses.raw: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Yashar'el (Israel) knows that your father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.
verses.text: And he also that is valiant, whose heart is as the heart of a lion, shall utterly melt: for all Yashar'el knows that your father is a mighty man, and they which be with him are valiant men.

verses.raw: Therefore I counsel that all Yashar'el (Israel) be generally gathered unto you, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.
verses.text: Therefore I counsel that all Yashar'el be generally gathered unto you, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle in your own person.

verses.raw: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falls on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.
verses.text: So shall we come upon him in some place where he shall be found, and we will light upon him as the dew falls on the ground: and of him and of all the men that are with him there shall not be left so much as one.

verses.raw: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Yashar'el (Israel) bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.
verses.text: Moreover, if he be gotten into a city, then shall all Yashar'el bring ropes to that city, and we will draw it into the river, until there be not one small stone found there.

verses.raw: And Absalom and all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For Yahuah (LORD) had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Yahuah (LORD) might bring evil upon Absalom.
verses.text: And Absalom and all the men of Yashar'el said, The counsel of Hushai the Archite is better than the counsel of Ahithophel. For Yahuah had appointed to defeat the good counsel of Ahithophel, to the intent that Yahuah might bring evil upon Absalom.

verses.raw: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel); and thus and thus have I counselled.
verses.text: Then said Hushai unto Zadok and to Abiathar the priests, Thus and thus did Ahithophel counsel Absalom and the elders of Yashar'el; and thus and thus have I counselled.

verses.raw: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.
verses.text: Now therefore send quickly, and tell David, saying, Lodge not this night in the plains of the wilderness, but speedily pass over; lest the king be swallowed up, and all the people that are with him.

verses.raw: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En-rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.
verses.text: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz stayed by En-rogel; for they might not be seen to come into the city: and a wench went and told them; and they went and told king David.

verses.raw: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man’s house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.
verses.text: Nevertheless a lad saw them, and told Absalom: but they went both of them away quickly, and came to a man’s house in Bahurim, which had a well in his court; whither they went down.

verses.raw: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.
verses.text: And the woman took and spread a covering over the well’s mouth, and spread ground corn thereon; and the thing was not known.

verses.raw: And when Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And when Absalom’s servants came to the woman to the house, they said, Where is Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said unto them, They be gone over the brook of water. And when they had sought and could not find them, they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus has Ahithophel counselled against you.
verses.text: And it came to pass, after they were departed, that they came up out of the well, and went and told king David, and said unto David, Arise, and pass quickly over the water: for thus has Ahithophel counselled against you.

verses.raw: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.
verses.text: Then David arose, and all the people that were with him, and they passed over Jordan: by the morning light there lacked not one of them that was not gone over Jordan.

verses.raw: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.
verses.text: And when Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his ass, and arose, and gat him home to his house, to his city, and put his household in order, and hanged himself, and died, and was buried in the sepulchre of his father.

verses.raw: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) with him.
verses.text: Then David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom passed over Jordan, he and all the men of Yashar'el with him.

verses.raw: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man’s son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab’s mother.
verses.text: And Absalom made Amasa captain of the host instead of Joab: which Amasa was a man’s son, whose name was Ithra an Israelite, that went in to Abigail the daughter of Nahash, sister to Zeruiah Joab’s mother.

verses.raw: So Yashar'el (Israel) and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.
verses.text: So Yashar'el and Absalom pitched in the land of Gilead.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when David was come to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,

verses.raw: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,
verses.text: Brought beds, and basons, and earthen vessels, and wheat, and barley, and flour, and parched corn, and beans, and lentiles, and parched pulse,

verses.raw: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.
verses.text: And honey, and butter, and sheep, and cheese of kine, for David, and for the people that were with him, to eat: for they said, The people is hungry, and weary, and thirsty, in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.
verses.text: And David numbered the people that were with him, and set captains of thousands and captains of hundreds over them.

verses.raw: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.
verses.text: And David sent forth a third part of the people under the hand of Joab, and a third part under the hand of Abishai the son of Zeruiah, Joab’s brother, and a third part under the hand of Ittai the Gittite. And the king said unto the people, I will surely go forth with you myself also.

verses.raw: But the people answered, You shall not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now you are worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that you succour us out of the city.
verses.text: But the people answered, You shall not go forth: for if we flee away, they will not care for us; neither if half of us die, will they care for us: but now you are worth ten thousand of us: therefore now it is better that you succour us out of the city.

verses.raw: And the king said unto them, What seems you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.
verses.text: And the king said unto them, What seems you best I will do. And the king stood by the gate side, and all the people came out by hundreds and by thousands.

verses.raw: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.
verses.text: And the king commanded Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Deal gently for my sake with the young man, even with Absalom. And all the people heard when the king gave all the captains charge concerning Absalom.

verses.raw: So the people went out into the field against Yashar'el (Israel): and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;
verses.text: So the people went out into the field against Yashar'el: and the battle was in the wood of Ephraim;

verses.raw: Where the people of Yashar'el (Israel) were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.
verses.text: Where the people of Yashar'el were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.

verses.raw: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.
verses.text: For the battle was there scattered over the face of all the country: and the wood devoured more people that day than the sword devoured.

verses.raw: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.
verses.text: And Absalom met the servants of David. And Absalom rode upon a mule, and the mule went under the thick boughs of a great oak, and his head caught hold of the oak, and he was taken up between the heaven and the earth; and the mule that was under him went away.

verses.raw: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.
verses.text: And a certain man saw it, and told Joab, and said, Behold, I saw Absalom hanged in an oak.

verses.raw: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, you saw him, and why did you not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given you ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.
verses.text: And Joab said unto the man that told him, And, behold, you saw him, and why did you not smite him there to the ground? and I would have given you ten shekels of silver, and a girdle.

verses.raw: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in my hand, yet would I not put forth my hand against the king’s son: for in our hearing the king charged you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.
verses.text: And the man said unto Joab, Though I should receive a thousand shekels of silver in my hand, yet would I not put forth my hand against the king’s son: for in our hearing the king charged you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Beware that none touch the young man Absalom.

verses.raw: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against my own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and you thyself would have set thyself against me.
verses.text: Otherwise I should have wrought falsehood against my own life: for there is no matter hid from the king, and you thyself would have set thyself against me.

verses.raw: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with you. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.
verses.text: Then said Joab, I may not tarry thus with you. And he took three darts in his hand, and thrust them through the heart of Absalom, while he was yet alive in the midst of the oak.

verses.raw: And ten young men that bare Joab’s armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.
verses.text: And ten young men that bare Joab’s armour compassed about and smote Absalom, and slew him.

verses.raw: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Yashar'el (Israel): for Joab held back the people.
verses.text: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Yashar'el: for Joab held back the people.

verses.raw: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Yashar'el (Israel) fled every one to his tent.
verses.text: And they took Absalom, and cast him into a great pit in the wood, and laid a very great heap of stones upon him: and all Yashar'el fled every one to his tent.

verses.raw: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king’s dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom’s place.
verses.text: Now Absalom in his lifetime had taken and reared up for himself a pillar, which is in the king’s dale: for he said, I have no son to keep my name in remembrance: and he called the pillar after his own name: and it is called unto this day, Absalom’s place.

verses.raw: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that Yahuah (LORD) has avenged him of his enemies.
verses.text: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok, Let me now run, and bear the king tidings, how that Yahuah has avenged him of his enemies.

verses.raw: And Joab said unto him, You shall not bear tidings this day, but you shall bear tidings another day: but this day you shall bear no tidings, because the king’s son is dead.
verses.text: And Joab said unto him, You shall not bear tidings this day, but you shall bear tidings another day: but this day you shall bear no tidings, because the king’s son is dead.

verses.raw: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what you have seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.
verses.text: Then said Joab to Cushi, Go tell the king what you have seen. And Cushi bowed himself unto Joab, and ran.

verses.raw: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray you, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore will you run, my son, seeing that you have no tidings ready?
verses.text: Then said Ahimaaz the son of Zadok yet again to Joab, But howsoever, let me, I pray you, also run after Cushi. And Joab said, Wherefore will you run, my son, seeing that you have no tidings ready?

verses.raw: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.
verses.text: But howsoever, said he, let me run. And he said unto him, Run. Then Ahimaaz ran by the way of the plain, and overran Cushi.

verses.raw: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.
verses.text: And David sat between the two gates: and the watchman went up to the roof over the gate unto the wall, and lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold a man running alone.

verses.raw: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.
verses.text: And the watchman cried, and told the king. And the king said, If he be alone, there is tidings in his mouth. And he came apace, and drew near.

verses.raw: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also brings tidings.
verses.text: And the watchman saw another man running: and the watchman called unto the porter, and said, Behold another man running alone. And the king said, He also brings tidings.

verses.raw: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and comes with good tidings.
verses.text: And the watchman said, Me thinketh the running of the foremost is like the running of Ahimaaz the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and comes with good tidings.

verses.raw: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which has delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.
verses.text: And Ahimaaz called, and said unto the king, All is well. And he fell down to the earth upon his face before the king, and said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohayka, which has delivered up the men that lifted up their hand against my lord the king.

verses.raw: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king’s servant, and me your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.
verses.text: And the king said, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Ahimaaz answered, When Joab sent the king’s servant, and me your servant, I saw a great tumult, but I knew not what it was.

verses.raw: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.
verses.text: And the king said unto him, Turn aside, and stand here. And he turned aside, and stood still.

verses.raw: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for Yahuah (LORD) has avenged you this day of all them that rose up against you.
verses.text: And, behold, Cushi came; and Cushi said, Tidings, my lord the king: for Yahuah has avenged you this day of all them that rose up against you.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against you to do you hurt, be as that young man is.
verses.text: And the king said unto Cushi, Is the young man Absalom safe? And Cushi answered, The enemies of my lord the king, and all that rise against you to do you hurt, be as that young man is.

verses.raw: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would Elohim (God) I had died for you, O Absalom, my son, my son!
verses.text: And the king was much moved, and went up to the chamber over the gate, and wept: and as he went, thus he said, O my son Absalom, my son, my son Absalom! would Elohim I had died for you, O Absalom, my son, my son!

verses.raw: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.
verses.text: And it was told Joab, Behold, the king weeps and mourns for Absalom.

verses.raw: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.
verses.text: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.

verses.raw: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
verses.text: And the people gat them by stealth that day into the city, as people being ashamed steal away when they flee in battle.
