verses.text: And he made a molten sea, ten cubits from the one brim to the other: it was round all about, and his height was five cubits: and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

verses.raw: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.
verses.text: And under the brim of it round about there were knops compassing it, ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about: the knops were cast in two rows, when it was cast.

verses.raw: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

verses.raw: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.
verses.text: And it was an hand breadth thick, and the brim thereof was wrought like the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies: it contained two thousand baths.

verses.raw: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.
verses.text: And he made ten bases of brass; four cubits was the length of one base, and four cubits the breadth thereof, and three cubits the height of it.

verses.raw: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:
verses.text: And the work of the bases was on this manner: they had borders, and the borders were between the ledges:

verses.raw: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.
verses.text: And on the borders that were between the ledges were lions, oxen, and cherubims: and upon the ledges there was a base above: and beneath the lions and oxen were certain additions made of thin work.

verses.raw: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.
verses.text: And every base had four brasen wheels, and plates of brass: and the four corners thereof had undersetters: under the laver were undersetters molten, at the side of every addition.

verses.raw: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.
verses.text: And the mouth of it within the chapiter and above was a cubit: but the mouth thereof was round after the work of the base, a cubit and an half: and also upon the mouth of it were gravings with their borders, foursquare, not round.

verses.raw: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.
verses.text: And under the borders were four wheels; and the axletrees of the wheels were joined to the base: and the height of a wheel was a cubit and half a cubit.

verses.raw: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.
verses.text: And the work of the wheels was like the work of a chariot wheel: their axletrees, and their naves, and their felloes, and their spokes, were all molten.

verses.raw: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
verses.text: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.

verses.raw: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.
verses.text: And in the top of the base was there a round compass of half a cubit high: and on the top of the base the ledges thereof and the borders thereof were of the same.

verses.raw: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.
verses.text: For on the plates of the ledges thereof, and on the borders thereof, he graved cherubims, lions, and palm trees, according to the proportion of every one, and additions round about.

verses.raw: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.
verses.text: After this manner he made the ten bases: all of them had one casting, one measure, and one size.

verses.raw: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.
verses.text: Then made he ten lavers of brass: one laver contained forty baths: and every laver was four cubits: and upon every one of the ten bases one laver.

verses.raw: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.
verses.text: And he put five bases on the right side of the house, and five on the left side of the house: and he set the sea on the right side of the house eastward over against the south.

verses.raw: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: And Hiram made the lavers, and the shovels, and the basons. So Hiram made an end of doing all the work that he made king Solomon for the house of Yahuah:

verses.raw: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;
verses.text: The two pillars, and the two bowls of the chapiters that were on the top of the two pillars; and the two networks, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars;

verses.raw: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;
verses.text: And four hundred pomegranates for the two networks, even two rows of pomegranates for one network, to cover the two bowls of the chapiters that were upon the pillars;

verses.raw: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;
verses.text: And the ten bases, and ten lavers on the bases;

verses.raw: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;
verses.text: And one sea, and twelve oxen under the sea;

verses.raw: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of Yahuah (LORD), were of bright brass.
verses.text: And the pots, and the shovels, and the basons: and all these vessels, which Hiram made to king Solomon for the house of Yahuah, were of bright brass.

verses.raw: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.
verses.text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarthan.

verses.raw: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.
verses.text: And Solomon left all the vessels unweighed, because they were exceeding many: neither was the weight of the brass found out.

verses.raw: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of Yahuah (LORD): the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,
verses.text: And Solomon made all the vessels that pertained unto the house of Yahuah: the altar of gold, and the table of gold, whereupon the shewbread was,

verses.raw: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,
verses.text: And the candlesticks of pure gold, five on the right side, and five on the left, before the oracle, with the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs of gold,

verses.raw: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.
verses.text: And the bowls, and the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers of pure gold; and the hinges of gold, both for the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and for the doors of the house, to wit, of the temple.

verses.raw: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of Yahuah (LORD). And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So was ended all the work that king Solomon made for the house of Yahuah. And Solomon brought in the things which David his father had dedicated; even the silver, and the gold, and the vessels, did he put among the treasures of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Yashar'el, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Yashar'el, unto king Solomon in Jerusalem, that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah out of the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.raw: And all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.
verses.text: And all the men of Yashar'el assembled themselves unto king Solomon at the feast in the month Ethanim, which is the seventh month.

verses.raw: And all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) came, and the priests took up the ark.
verses.text: And all the elders of Yashar'el came, and the priests took up the ark.

verses.raw: And they brought up the ark of Yahuah (LORD), and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.text: And they brought up the ark of Yahuah, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.

verses.raw: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.text: And king Solomon, and all the congregation of Yashar'el, that were assembled unto him, were with him before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

verses.raw: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.
verses.text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Yahuah unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims.

verses.raw: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.text: For the cherubims spread forth their two wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

verses.raw: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.
verses.text: And they drew out the staves, that the ends of the staves were seen out in the holy place before the oracle, and they were not seen without: and there they are unto this day.

verses.raw: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahuah (LORD) made a covenant with the children of Yashar'el (Israel), when they came out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables of stone, which Moses put there at Horeb, when Yahuah made a covenant with the children of Yashar'el, when they came out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place, that the cloud filled the house of Yahuah,

verses.raw: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of Yahuah (LORD) had filled the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud: for the glory of Yahuah had filled the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then spake Solomon, Yahuah (LORD) said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.text: Then spake Solomon, Yahuah said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

verses.raw: I have surely built you an house to dwell in, a settled place for you to abide in for ever.
verses.text: I have surely built you an house to dwell in, a settled place for you to abide in for ever.

verses.raw: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel): (and all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) stood;)
verses.text: And the king turned his face about, and blessed all the congregation of Yashar'el: (and all the congregation of Yashar'el stood;)

verses.raw: And he said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,
verses.text: And he said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, which spake with his mouth unto David my father, and has with his hand fulfilled it, saying,

verses.raw: Since the day that I brought forth my people Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Since the day that I brought forth my people Yashar'el out of Egypt, I chose no city out of all the tribes of Yashar'el to build an house, that my name might be therein; but I chose David to be over my people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto David my father, Whereas it was in your heart to build an house unto my name, you did well that it was in your heart.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto David my father, Whereas it was in your heart to build an house unto my name, you did well that it was in your heart.

verses.raw: Nevertheless you shall not build the house; but your son that shall come forth out of your loins, he shall build the house unto my name.
verses.text: Nevertheless you shall not build the house; but your son that shall come forth out of your loins, he shall build the house unto my name.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) has performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel), as Yahuah (LORD) promised, and have built an house for the name of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah has performed his word that he spake, and I am risen up in the room of David my father, and sit on the throne of Yashar'el, as Yahuah promised, and have built an house for the name of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And I have set there a place for the ark, wherein is the covenant of Yahuah, which he made with our fathers, when he brought them out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Solomon stood before the altar of Yahuah (LORD) in the presence of all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), and spread forth his hands toward heaven:
verses.text: And Solomon stood before the altar of Yahuah in the presence of all the congregation of Yashar'el, and spread forth his hands toward heaven:

verses.raw: And he said, Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), there is no Elohim (God) like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with your servants that walk before you with all their heart:
verses.text: And he said, Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, there is no Elohim like you, in heaven above, or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with your servants that walk before you with all their heart:

verses.raw: Who have kept with your servant David my father that you promisedst him: you spoke also with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is this day.
verses.text: Who have kept with your servant David my father that you promisedst him: you spoke also with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is this day.

verses.raw: Therefore now, Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), keep with your servant David my father that you promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel); so that your children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as you have walked before me.
verses.text: Therefore now, Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, keep with your servant David my father that you promisedst him, saying, There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit on the throne of Yashar'el; so that your children take heed to their way, that they walk before me as you have walked before me.

verses.raw: And now, O Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), let your word, I pray you, be verified, which you spoke unto your servant David my father.
verses.text: And now, O Elohim of Yashar'el, let your word, I pray you, be verified, which you spoke unto your servant David my father.

verses.raw: But will Elohim (God) indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain you; how much less this house that I have builded?
verses.text: But will Elohim indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain you; how much less this house that I have builded?

verses.raw: Yet have you respect unto the prayer of your servant, and to his supplication, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which your servant prayeth before you to day:
verses.text: Yet have you respect unto the prayer of your servant, and to his supplication, O Yahuah my Elohim, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer, which your servant prayeth before you to day:

verses.raw: That your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, My name shall be there: that you may hearken unto the prayer which your servant shall make toward this place.
verses.text: That your eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which you have said, My name shall be there: that you may hearken unto the prayer which your servant shall make toward this place.

verses.raw: And hearken you to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Yashar'el (Israel), when they shall pray toward this place: and hear you in heaven your dwelling place: and when you hear, forgive.
verses.text: And hearken you to the supplication of your servant, and of your people Yashar'el, when they shall pray toward this place: and hear you in heaven your dwelling place: and when you hear, forgive.

verses.raw: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before your altar in this house:
verses.text: If any man trespass against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to cause him to swear, and the oath come before your altar in this house:

verses.raw: Then hear you in heaven, and do, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.
verses.text: Then hear you in heaven, and do, and judge your servants, condemning the wicked, to bring his way upon his head; and justifying the righteous, to give him according to his righteousness.

verses.raw: When your people Yashar'el (Israel) be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against you, and shall turn again to you, and confess your name, and pray, and make supplication unto you in this house:
verses.text: When your people Yashar'el be smitten down before the enemy, because they have sinned against you, and shall turn again to you, and confess your name, and pray, and make supplication unto you in this house:

verses.raw: Then hear you in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Yashar'el (Israel), and bring them again unto the land which you gave unto their fathers.
verses.text: Then hear you in heaven, and forgive the sin of your people Yashar'el, and bring them again unto the land which you gave unto their fathers.

verses.raw: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against you; if they pray toward this place, and confess your name, and turn from their sin, when you afflictest them:
verses.text: When heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against you; if they pray toward this place, and confess your name, and turn from their sin, when you afflictest them:

verses.raw: Then hear you in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Yashar'el (Israel), that you teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.
verses.text: Then hear you in heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Yashar'el, that you teach them the good way wherein they should walk, and give rain upon your land, which you have given to your people for an inheritance.

verses.raw: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;
verses.text: If there be in the land famine, if there be pestilence, blasting, mildew, locust, or if there be caterpiller; if their enemy besiege them in the land of their cities; whatsoever plague, whatsoever sickness there be;

verses.raw: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all your people Yashar'el (Israel), which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:
verses.text: What prayer and supplication soever be made by any man, or by all your people Yashar'el, which shall know every man the plague of his own heart, and spread forth his hands toward this house:

verses.raw: Then hear you in heaven your dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart you know; (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men;)
verses.text: Then hear you in heaven your dwelling place, and forgive, and do, and give to every man according to his ways, whose heart you know; (for you, even you only, know the hearts of all the children of men;)

verses.raw: That they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave unto our fathers.
verses.text: That they may fear you all the days that they live in the land which you gave unto our fathers.

verses.raw: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of your people Yashar'el (Israel), but comes out of a far country for your name’s sake;
verses.text: Moreover concerning a stranger, that is not of your people Yashar'el, but comes out of a far country for your name’s sake;

verses.raw: (For they shall hear of your great name, and of your strong hand, and of your stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;
verses.text: (For they shall hear of your great name, and of your strong hand, and of your stretched out arm;) when he shall come and pray toward this house;

verses.raw: Hear you in heaven your dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calls to you for: that all people of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Yashar'el (Israel); and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by your name.
verses.text: Hear you in heaven your dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calls to you for: that all people of the earth may know your name, to fear you, as do your people Yashar'el; and that they may know that this house, which I have builded, is called by your name.

verses.raw: If your people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever you shall send them, and shall pray unto Yahuah (LORD) toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house that I have built for your name:
verses.text: If your people go out to battle against their enemy, whithersoever you shall send them, and shall pray unto Yahuah toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house that I have built for your name:

verses.raw: Then hear you in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.text: Then hear you in heaven their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

verses.raw: If they sin against you, (for there is no man that sins not,) and you be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;
verses.text: If they sin against you, (for there is no man that sins not,) and you be angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captives unto the land of the enemy, far or near;

verses.raw: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto you in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;
verses.text: Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto you in the land of them that carried them captives, saying, We have sinned, and have done perversely, we have committed wickedness;

verses.raw: And so return unto you with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto you toward their land, which you gave unto their fathers, the city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name:
verses.text: And so return unto you with all their heart, and with all their soul, in the land of their enemies, which led them away captive, and pray unto you toward their land, which you gave unto their fathers, the city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name:

verses.raw: Then hear you their prayer and their supplication in heaven your dwelling place, and maintain their cause,
verses.text: Then hear you their prayer and their supplication in heaven your dwelling place, and maintain their cause,

verses.raw: And forgive your people that have sinned against you, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against you, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:
verses.text: And forgive your people that have sinned against you, and all their transgressions wherein they have transgressed against you, and give them compassion before them who carried them captive, that they may have compassion on them:

verses.raw: For they be your people, and your inheritance, which you brought forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:
verses.text: For they be your people, and your inheritance, which you brought forth out of Egypt, from the midst of the furnace of iron:

verses.raw: That your eyes may be open unto the supplication of your servant, and unto the supplication of your people Yashar'el (Israel), to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto you.
verses.text: That your eyes may be open unto the supplication of your servant, and unto the supplication of your people Yashar'el, to hearken unto them in all that they call for unto you.

verses.raw: For you did separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be your inheritance, as you spoke by the hand of Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, O Adonai (Lord) GOD.
verses.text: For you did separate them from among all the people of the earth, to be your inheritance, as you spoke by the hand of Moses your servant, when you brought our fathers out of Egypt, O Adonai GOD.

verses.raw: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto Yahuah (LORD), he arose from before the altar of Yahuah (LORD), from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.
verses.text: And it was so, that when Solomon had made an end of praying all this prayer and supplication unto Yahuah, he arose from before the altar of Yahuah, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven.

verses.raw: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) with a loud voice, saying,
verses.text: And he stood, and blessed all the congregation of Yashar'el with a loud voice, saying,

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), that has given rest unto his people Yashar'el (Israel), according to all that he promised: there has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah, that has given rest unto his people Yashar'el, according to all that he promised: there has not failed one word of all his good promise, which he promised by the hand of Moses his servant.

verses.raw: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:
verses.text: Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) be with us, as he was with our fathers: let him not leave us, nor forsake us:

verses.raw: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.
verses.text: That he may incline our hearts unto him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, and his statutes, and his judgments, which he commanded our fathers.

verses.raw: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before Yahuah (LORD), be nigh unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Yashar'el (Israel) at all times, as the matter shall require:
verses.text: And let these my words, wherewith I have made supplication before Yahuah, be nigh unto Yahuah Eloheinu day and night, that he maintain the cause of his servant, and the cause of his people Yashar'el at all times, as the matter shall require:

verses.raw: That all the people of the earth may know that Yahuah (LORD) is Elohim (God), and that there is none else.
verses.text: That all the people of the earth may know that Yahuah is Elohim, and that there is none else.

verses.raw: Let your heart therefore be perfect with Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.
verses.text: Let your heart therefore be perfect with Yahuah Eloheinu, to walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as at this day.

verses.raw: And the king, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, offered sacrifice before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the king, and all Yashar'el with him, offered sacrifice before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto Yahuah (LORD), two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) dedicated the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Solomon offered a sacrifice of peace offerings, which he offered unto Yahuah, two and twenty thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Yashar'el dedicated the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of Yahuah (LORD): for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before Yahuah (LORD) was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.text: The same day did the king hallow the middle of the court that was before the house of Yahuah: for there he offered burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings: because the brasen altar that was before Yahuah was too little to receive the burnt offerings, and meat offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.raw: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.
verses.text: And at that time Solomon held a feast, and all Yashar'el with him, a great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, before Yahuah Eloheinu, seven days and seven days, even fourteen days.

verses.raw: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that Yahuah (LORD) had done for David his servant, and for Yashar'el (Israel) his people.
verses.text: On the eighth day he sent the people away: and they blessed the king, and went unto their tents joyful and glad of heart for all the goodness that Yahuah had done for David his servant, and for Yashar'el his people.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Solomon had finished the building of the house of Yahuah, and the king’s house, and all Solomon’s desire which he was pleased to do,

verses.raw: That Yahuah (LORD) appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.
verses.text: That Yahuah appeared to Solomon the second time, as he had appeared unto him at Gibeon.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, I have heard your prayer and your supplication, that you have made before me: I have hallowed this house, which you have built, to put my name there for ever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto him, I have heard your prayer and your supplication, that you have made before me: I have hallowed this house, which you have built, to put my name there for ever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

verses.raw: And if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my judgments:
verses.text: And if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, in integrity of heart, and in uprightness, to do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my judgments:

verses.raw: Then I will establish the throne of your kingdom upon Yashar'el (Israel) for ever, as I promised to David your father, saying, There shall not fail you a man upon the throne of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then I will establish the throne of your kingdom upon Yashar'el for ever, as I promised to David your father, saying, There shall not fail you a man upon the throne of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: But if you shall at all turn from following me, you or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:
verses.text: But if you shall at all turn from following me, you or your children, and will not keep my commandments and my statutes which I have set before you, but go and serve other gods, and worship them:

verses.raw: Then will I cut off Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Yashar'el (Israel) shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:
verses.text: Then will I cut off Yashar'el out of the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have hallowed for my name, will I cast out of my sight; and Yashar'el shall be a proverb and a byword among all people:

verses.raw: And at this house, which is high, every one that passes by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why has Yahuah (LORD) done thus unto this land, and to this house?
verses.text: And at this house, which is high, every one that passes by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss; and they shall say, Why has Yahuah done thus unto this land, and to this house?

verses.raw: And they shall answer, Because they forsook Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore has Yahuah (LORD) brought upon them all this evil.
verses.text: And they shall answer, Because they forsook Yahuah their Elohim, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold upon other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them: therefore has Yahuah brought upon them all this evil.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s house,
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, when Solomon had built the two houses, the house of Yahuah, and the king’s house,

verses.raw: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.
verses.text: (Now Hiram the king of Tyre had furnished Solomon with cedar trees and fir trees, and with gold, according to all his desire,) that then king Solomon gave Hiram twenty cities in the land of Galilee.

verses.raw: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.
verses.text: And Hiram came out from Tyre to see the cities which Solomon had given him; and they pleased him not.

verses.raw: And he said, What cities are these which you have given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.
verses.text: And he said, What cities are these which you have given me, my brother? And he called them the land of Cabul unto this day.

verses.raw: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.
verses.text: And Hiram sent to the king sixscore talents of gold.

verses.raw: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of Yahuah (LORD), and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.
verses.text: And this is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised; for to build the house of Yahuah, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

verses.raw: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.
verses.text: For Pharaoh king of Egypt had gone up, and taken Gezer, and burnt it with fire, and slain the Canaanites that dwelt in the city, and given it for a present unto his daughter, Solomon’s wife.

verses.raw: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,
verses.text: And Solomon built Gezer, and Beth-horon the nether,

verses.raw: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,
verses.text: And Baalath, and Tadmor in the wilderness, in the land,

verses.raw: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
verses.text: And all the cities of store that Solomon had, and cities for his chariots, and cities for his horsemen, and that which Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and in all the land of his dominion.

verses.raw: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: And all the people that were left of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites, which were not of the children of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Yashar'el (Israel) also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.
verses.text: Their children that were left after them in the land, whom the children of Yashar'el also were not able utterly to destroy, upon those did Solomon levy a tribute of bondservice unto this day.

verses.raw: But of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.
verses.text: But of the children of Yashar'el did Solomon make no bondmen: but they were men of war, and his servants, and his princes, and his captains, and rulers of his chariots, and his horsemen.

verses.raw: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.text: These were the chief of the officers that were over Solomon’s work, five hundred and fifty, which bare rule over the people that wrought in the work.

verses.raw: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.
verses.text: But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of the city of David unto her house which Solomon had built for her: then did he build Millo.

verses.raw: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto Yahuah (LORD), and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before Yahuah (LORD). So he finished the house.
verses.text: And three times in a year did Solomon offer burnt offerings and peace offerings upon the altar which he built unto Yahuah, and he burnt incense upon the altar that was before Yahuah. So he finished the house.

verses.raw: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.
verses.text: And king Solomon made a navy of ships in Ezion-geber, which is beside Eloth, on the shore of the Red sea, in the land of Edom.

verses.raw: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.
verses.text: And Hiram sent in the navy his servants, shipmen that had knowledge of the sea, with the servants of Solomon.

verses.raw: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.
verses.text: And they came to Ophir, and fetched from thence gold, four hundred and twenty talents, and brought it to king Solomon.

verses.raw: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of Yahuah (LORD), she came to prove him with hard questions.
verses.text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon concerning the name of Yahuah, she came to prove him with hard questions.

verses.raw: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.text: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels that bare spices, and very much gold, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

verses.raw: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.
verses.text: And Solomon told her all her questions: there was not any thing hid from the king, which he told her not.

verses.raw: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,
verses.text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all Solomon’s wisdom, and the house that he had built,

verses.raw: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of Yahuah (LORD); there was no more spirit in her.
verses.text: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel, and his cupbearers, and his ascent by which he went up unto the house of Yahuah; there was no more spirit in her.

verses.raw: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.
verses.text: And she said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom.

verses.raw: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and my eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: your wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.
verses.text: Howbeit I believed not the words, until I came, and my eyes had seen it: and, behold, the half was not told me: your wisdom and prosperity exceedeth the fame which I heard.

verses.raw: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants, which stand continually before you, and that hear your wisdom.
verses.text: Happy are your men, happy are these your servants, which stand continually before you, and that hear your wisdom.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel): because Yahuah (LORD) loved Yashar'el (Israel) for ever, therefore made he you king, to do judgment and justice.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohayka, which delighted in you, to set you on the throne of Yashar'el: because Yahuah loved Yashar'el for ever, therefore made he you king, to do judgment and justice.

verses.raw: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.
verses.text: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices very great store, and precious stones: there came no more such abundance of spices as these which the queen of Sheba gave to king Solomon.

verses.raw: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.
verses.text: And the navy also of Hiram, that brought gold from Ophir, brought in from Ophir great plenty of almug trees, and precious stones.

verses.raw: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of Yahuah (LORD), and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.
verses.text: And the king made of the almug trees pillars for the house of Yahuah, and for the king’s house, harps also and psalteries for singers: there came no such almug trees, nor were seen unto this day.

verses.raw: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.
verses.text: And king Solomon gave unto the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which Solomon gave her of his royal bounty. So she turned and went to her own country, she and her servants.

verses.raw: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,
verses.text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred threescore and six talents of gold,

verses.raw: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.
verses.text: Beside that he had of the merchantmen, and of the traffick of the spice merchants, and of all the kings of Arabia, and of the governors of the country.

verses.raw: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.
verses.text: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of gold went to one target.

verses.raw: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.text: And he made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three pound of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

verses.raw: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
verses.text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.

verses.raw: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.
verses.text: The throne had six steps, and the top of the throne was round behind: and there were stays on either side on the place of the seat, and two lions stood beside the stays.

verses.raw: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps: there was not the like made in any kingdom.

verses.raw: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.text: And all king Solomon’s drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver: it was nothing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

verses.raw: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.text: For the king had at sea a navy of Tharshish with the navy of Hiram: once in three years came the navy of Tharshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

verses.raw: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.
verses.text: So king Solomon exceeded all the kings of the earth for riches and for wisdom.

verses.raw: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which Elohim (God) had put in his heart.
verses.text: And all the earth sought to Solomon, to hear his wisdom, which Elohim had put in his heart.

verses.raw: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and armour, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

verses.raw: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.text: And Solomon gathered together chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he bestowed in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
verses.text: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.

verses.raw: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

verses.raw: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.
verses.text: And a chariot came up and went out of Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, did they bring them out by their means.

verses.raw: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;
verses.text: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;

verses.raw: Of the nations concerning which Yahuah (LORD) said unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), You shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.
verses.text: Of the nations concerning which Yahuah said unto the children of Yashar'el, You shall not go in to them, neither shall they come in unto you: for surely they will turn away your heart after their gods: Solomon clave unto these in love.

verses.raw: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.
verses.text: And he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines: and his wives turned away his heart.

verses.raw: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), as was the heart of David his father.
verses.text: For it came to pass, when Solomon was old, that his wives turned away his heart after other gods: and his heart was not perfect with Yahuah Elohav, as was the heart of David his father.

verses.raw: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.
verses.text: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, and after Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

verses.raw: And Solomon did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and went not fully after Yahuah (LORD), as did David his father.
verses.text: And Solomon did evil in the sight of Yahuah, and went not fully after Yahuah, as did David his father.

verses.raw: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.
verses.text: Then did Solomon build an high place for Chemosh, the abomination of Moab, in the hill that is before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the abomination of the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.
verses.text: And likewise did he for all his strange wives, which burnt incense and sacrificed unto their gods.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which had appeared unto him twice,
verses.text: And Yahuah was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned from Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, which had appeared unto him twice,

verses.raw: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which Yahuah (LORD) commanded.
verses.text: And had commanded him concerning this thing, that he should not go after other gods: but he kept not that which Yahuah commanded.

verses.raw: Wherefore Yahuah (LORD) said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely rend the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.
verses.text: Wherefore Yahuah said unto Solomon, Forasmuch as this is done of you, and you have not kept my covenant and my statutes, which I have commanded you, I will surely rend the kingdom from you, and will give it to your servant.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding in your days I will not do it for David your father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of your son.
verses.text: Notwithstanding in your days I will not do it for David your father’s sake: but I will rend it out of the hand of your son.

verses.raw: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to your son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.
verses.text: Howbeit I will not rend away all the kingdom; but will give one tribe to your son for David my servant’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake which I have chosen.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.
verses.text: And Yahuah stirred up an adversary unto Solomon, Hadad the Edomite: he was of the king’s seed in Edom.

verses.raw: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;
verses.text: For it came to pass, when David was in Edom, and Joab the captain of the host was gone up to bury the slain, after he had smitten every male in Edom;

verses.raw: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Yashar'el (Israel), until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
verses.text: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Yashar'el, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)

verses.raw: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.
verses.text: That Hadad fled, he and certain Edomites of his father’s servants with him, to go into Egypt; Hadad being yet a little child.

verses.raw: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.
verses.text: And they arose out of Midian, and came to Paran: and they took men with them out of Paran, and they came to Egypt, unto Pharaoh king of Egypt; which gave him an house, and appointed him victuals, and gave him land.

verses.raw: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
verses.text: And Hadad found great favour in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him to wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

verses.raw: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.
verses.text: And the sister of Tahpenes bare him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house: and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s household among the sons of Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.
verses.text: And when Hadad heard in Egypt that David slept with his fathers, and that Joab the captain of the host was dead, Hadad said to Pharaoh, Let me depart, that I may go to my own country.

verses.raw: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what have you lacked with me, that, behold, you seek to go to your own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.
verses.text: Then Pharaoh said unto him, But what have you lacked with me, that, behold, you seek to go to your own country? And he answered, Nothing: howbeit let me go in any wise.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:
verses.text: And Elohim stirred him up another adversary, Rezon the son of Eliadah, which fled from his lord Hadadezer king of Zobah:

verses.raw: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.
verses.text: And he gathered men unto him, and became captain over a band, when David slew them of Zobah: and they went to Damascus, and dwelt therein, and reigned in Damascus.

verses.raw: And he was an adversary to Yashar'el (Israel) all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Yashar'el (Israel), and reigned over Syria.
verses.text: And he was an adversary to Yashar'el all the days of Solomon, beside the mischief that Hadad did: and he abhorred Yashar'el, and reigned over Syria.

verses.raw: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.
verses.text: And Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephrathite of Zereda, Solomon’s servant, whose mother’s name was Zeruah, a widow woman, even he lifted up his hand against the king.

verses.raw: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
verses.text: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.

verses.raw: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.
verses.text: And the man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valour: and Solomon seeing the young man that he was industrious, he made him ruler over all the charge of the house of Joseph.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:
verses.text: And it came to pass at that time when Jeroboam went out of Jerusalem, that the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him in the way; and he had clad himself with a new garment; and they two were alone in the field:

verses.raw: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:
verses.text: And Ahijah caught the new garment that was on him, and rent it in twelve pieces:

verses.raw: And he said to Jeroboam, Take you ten pieces: for thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to you:
verses.text: And he said to Jeroboam, Take you ten pieces: for thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el, Behold, I will rend the kingdom out of the hand of Solomon, and will give ten tribes to you:

verses.raw: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel):)
verses.text: (But he shall have one tribe for my servant David’s sake, and for Jerusalem’s sake, the city which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Yashar'el:)

verses.raw: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.
verses.text: Because that they have forsaken me, and have worshipped Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians, Chemosh the god of the Moabites, and Milcom the god of the children of Ammon, and have not walked in my ways, to do that which is right in my eyes, and to keep my statutes and my judgments, as did David his father.

verses.raw: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:
verses.text: Howbeit I will not take the whole kingdom out of his hand: but I will make him prince all the days of his life for David my servant’s sake, whom I chose, because he kept my commandments and my statutes:

verses.raw: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto you, even ten tribes.
verses.text: But I will take the kingdom out of his son’s hand, and will give it unto you, even ten tribes.

verses.raw: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.
verses.text: And unto his son will I give one tribe, that David my servant may have a light alway before me in Jerusalem, the city which I have chosen me to put my name there.

verses.raw: And I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And I will take you, and you shall reign according to all that your soul desires, and shall be king over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it shall be, if you will hearken unto all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with you, and build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Yashar'el (Israel) unto you.
verses.text: And it shall be, if you will hearken unto all that I command you, and will walk in my ways, and do that is right in my sight, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as David my servant did; that I will be with you, and build you a sure house, as I built for David, and will give Yashar'el unto you.

verses.raw: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.
verses.text: And I will for this afflict the seed of David, but not for ever.

verses.raw: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.
verses.text: Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. And Jeroboam arose, and fled into Egypt, unto Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all that he did, and his wisdom, are they not written in the book of the acts of Solomon?

verses.raw: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Yashar'el (Israel) was forty years.
verses.text: And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Yashar'el was forty years.

verses.raw: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Yashar'el (Israel) were come to Shechem to make him king.
verses.text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for all Yashar'el were come to Shechem to make him king.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was yet in Egypt, heard of it, (for he was fled from the presence of king Solomon, and Jeroboam dwelt in Egypt;)

verses.raw: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
verses.text: That they sent and called him. And Jeroboam and all the congregation of Yashar'el came, and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,

verses.raw: Your father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make you the grievous service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve you.
verses.text: Your father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make you the grievous service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put upon us, lighter, and we will serve you.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Depart yet for three days, then come again to me. And the people departed.

verses.raw: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do you advise that I may answer this people?
verses.text: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do you advise that I may answer this people?

verses.raw: And they spake unto him, saying, If you will be a servant unto this people this day, and will serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants for ever.
verses.text: And they spake unto him, saying, If you will be a servant unto this people this day, and will serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants for ever.

verses.raw: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:
verses.text: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him:

verses.raw: And he said unto them, What counsel give you that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which your father did put upon us lighter?
verses.text: And he said unto them, What counsel give you that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke which your father did put upon us lighter?

verses.raw: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shall you speak unto this people that spake unto you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but make you it lighter unto us; thus shall you say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
verses.text: And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shall you speak unto this people that spake unto you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but make you it lighter unto us; thus shall you say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

verses.raw: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father has chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.text: And now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father has chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.raw: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.
verses.text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam the third day, as the king had appointed, saying, Come to me again the third day.

verses.raw: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;
verses.text: And the king answered the people roughly, and forsook the old men’s counsel that they gave him;

verses.raw: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.text: And spake to them after the counsel of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke: my father also chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.raw: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from Yahuah (LORD), that he might perform his saying, which Yahuah (LORD) spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.text: Wherefore the king hearkened not unto the people; for the cause was from Yahuah, that he might perform his saying, which Yahuah spake by Ahijah the Shilonite unto Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.raw: So when all Yashar'el (Israel) saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Yashar'el (Israel): now see to your own house, David. So Yashar'el (Israel) departed unto their tents.
verses.text: So when all Yashar'el saw that the king hearkened not unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: to your tents, O Yashar'el: now see to your own house, David. So Yashar'el departed unto their tents.

verses.raw: But as for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) which dwelt in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.text: But as for the children of Yashar'el which dwelt in the cities of Yahudah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

verses.raw: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Yashar'el (Israel) stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Then king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute; and all Yashar'el stoned him with stones, that he died. Therefore king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: So Yashar'el (Israel) rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.text: So Yashar'el rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when all Yashar'el (Israel) heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Yashar'el (Israel): there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) only.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when all Yashar'el heard that Jeroboam was come again, that they sent and called him unto the congregation, and made him king over all Yashar'el: there was none that followed the house of David, but the tribe of Yahudah only.

verses.raw: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Yahudah (Judah), with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Yashar'el (Israel), to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.
verses.text: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he assembled all the house of Yahudah, with the tribe of Benjamin, an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against the house of Yashar'el, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam the son of Solomon.

verses.raw: But the word of Elohim (God) came unto Shemaiah the man of Elohim (God), saying,
verses.text: But the word of Elohim came unto Shemaiah the man of Elohim, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Yahudah (Judah), and unto all the house of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,
verses.text: Speak unto Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Yahudah, and unto all the house of Yahudah and Benjamin, and to the remnant of the people, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), You shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Yashar'el (Israel): return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of Yahuah (LORD), and returned to depart, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, You shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Yashar'el: return every man to his house; for this thing is from me. They hearkened therefore to the word of Yahuah, and returned to depart, according to the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.
verses.text: Then Jeroboam built Shechem in mount Ephraim, and dwelt therein; and went out from thence, and built Penuel.

verses.raw: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:
verses.text: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now shall the kingdom return to the house of David:

verses.raw: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of Yahuah (LORD) at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Yahudah (Judah), and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: If this people go up to do sacrifice in the house of Yahuah at Jerusalem, then shall the heart of this people turn again unto their lord, even unto Rehoboam king of Yahudah, and they shall kill me, and go again to Rehoboam king of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold your gods, O Yashar'el (Israel), which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: Whereupon the king took counsel, and made two calves of gold, and said unto them, It is too much for you to go up to Jerusalem: behold your gods, O Yashar'el, which brought you up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And he set the one in Beth-el, and the other put he in Dan.
verses.text: And he set the one in Beth-el, and the other put he in Dan.

verses.raw: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.
verses.text: And this thing became a sin: for the people went to worship before the one, even unto Dan.

verses.raw: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.
verses.text: And he made an house of high places, and made priests of the lowest of the people, which were not of the sons of Levi.

verses.raw: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Yahudah (Judah), and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Beth-el, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places which he had made.
