verses.text: And Jeroboam ordained a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like unto the feast that is in Yahudah, and he offered upon the altar. So did he in Beth-el, sacrificing unto the calves that he had made: and he placed in Beth-el the priests of the high places which he had made.

verses.raw: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth-el the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.
verses.text: So he offered upon the altar which he had made in Beth-el the fifteenth day of the eighth month, even in the month which he had devised of his own heart; and ordained a feast unto the children of Yashar'el: and he offered upon the altar, and burnt incense.

verses.raw: And, behold, there came a man of Elohim (God) out of Yahudah (Judah) by the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Beth-el: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.
verses.text: And, behold, there came a man of Elohim out of Yahudah by the word of Yahuah unto Beth-el: and Jeroboam stood by the altar to burn incense.

verses.raw: And he cried against the altar in the word of Yahuah (LORD), and said, O altar, altar, thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon you shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon you, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon you.
verses.text: And he cried against the altar in the word of Yahuah, and said, O altar, altar, thus says Yahuah; Behold, a child shall be born unto the house of David, Josiah by name; and upon you shall he offer the priests of the high places that burn incense upon you, and men’s bones shall be burnt upon you.

verses.raw: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which Yahuah (LORD) has spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.
verses.text: And he gave a sign the same day, saying, This is the sign which Yahuah has spoken; Behold, the altar shall be rent, and the ashes that are upon it shall be poured out.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of Elohim (God), which had cried against the altar in Beth-el, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when king Jeroboam heard the saying of the man of Elohim, which had cried against the altar in Beth-el, that he put forth his hand from the altar, saying, Lay hold on him. And his hand, which he put forth against him, dried up, so that he could not pull it in again to him.

verses.raw: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of Elohim (God) had given by the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The altar also was rent, and the ashes poured out from the altar, according to the sign which the man of Elohim had given by the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the king answered and said unto the man of Elohim (God), Intreat now the face of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of Elohim (God) besought Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.
verses.text: And the king answered and said unto the man of Elohim, Intreat now the face of Yahuah Elohayka, and pray for me, that my hand may be restored me again. And the man of Elohim besought Yahuah, and the king’s hand was restored him again, and became as it was before.

verses.raw: And the king said unto the man of Elohim (God), Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give you a reward.
verses.text: And the king said unto the man of Elohim, Come home with me, and refresh thyself, and I will give you a reward.

verses.raw: And the man of Elohim (God) said unto the king, If you will give me half your house, I will not go in with you, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:
verses.text: And the man of Elohim said unto the king, If you will give me half your house, I will not go in with you, neither will I eat bread nor drink water in this place:

verses.raw: For so was it charged me by the word of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that you came.
verses.text: For so was it charged me by the word of Yahuah, saying, Eat no bread, nor drink water, nor turn again by the same way that you came.

verses.raw: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.
verses.text: So he went another way, and returned not by the way that he came to Beth-el.

verses.raw: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth-el; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of Elohim (God) had done that day in Beth-el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.
verses.text: Now there dwelt an old prophet in Beth-el; and his sons came and told him all the works that the man of Elohim had done that day in Beth-el: the words which he had spoken unto the king, them they told also to their father.

verses.raw: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of Elohim (God) went, which came from Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And their father said unto them, What way went he? For his sons had seen what way the man of Elohim went, which came from Yahudah.

verses.raw: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,
verses.text: And he said unto his sons, Saddle me the ass. So they saddled him the ass: and he rode thereon,

verses.raw: And went after the man of Elohim (God), and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Are you the man of Elohim (God) that came from Yahudah (Judah)? And he said, I am.
verses.text: And went after the man of Elohim, and found him sitting under an oak: and he said unto him, Are you the man of Elohim that came from Yahudah? And he said, I am.

verses.raw: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.
verses.text: Then he said unto him, Come home with me, and eat bread.

verses.raw: And he said, I may not return with you, nor go in with you: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with you in this place:
verses.text: And he said, I may not return with you, nor go in with you: neither will I eat bread nor drink water with you in this place:

verses.raw: For it was said to me by the word of Yahuah (LORD), You shall eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that you came.
verses.text: For it was said to me by the word of Yahuah, You shall eat no bread nor drink water there, nor turn again to go by the way that you came.

verses.raw: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as you are; and an angel spake unto me by the word of Yahuah (LORD), saying, Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.
verses.text: He said unto him, I am a prophet also as you are; and an angel spake unto me by the word of Yahuah, saying, Bring him back with you into your house, that he may eat bread and drink water. But he lied unto him.

verses.raw: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.
verses.text: So he went back with him, and did eat bread in his house, and drank water.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto the prophet that brought him back:
verses.text: And it came to pass, as they sat at the table, that the word of Yahuah came unto the prophet that brought him back:

verses.raw: And he cried unto the man of Elohim (God) that came from Yahudah (Judah), saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Forasmuch as you have disobeyed the mouth of Yahuah (LORD), and have not kept the commandment which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) commanded you,
verses.text: And he cried unto the man of Elohim that came from Yahudah, saying, Thus says Yahuah, Forasmuch as you have disobeyed the mouth of Yahuah, and have not kept the commandment which Yahuah Elohayka commanded you,

verses.raw: But came back, and have eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which Yahuah (LORD) did say to you, Eat no bread, and drink no water; your carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of your fathers.
verses.text: But came back, and have eaten bread and drunk water in the place, of the which Yahuah did say to you, Eat no bread, and drink no water; your carcase shall not come unto the sepulchre of your fathers.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.
verses.text: And it came to pass, after he had eaten bread, and after he had drunk, that he saddled for him the ass, to wit, for the prophet whom he had brought back.

verses.raw: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.
verses.text: And when he was gone, a lion met him by the way, and slew him: and his carcase was cast in the way, and the ass stood by it, the lion also stood by the carcase.

verses.raw: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.
verses.text: And, behold, men passed by, and saw the carcase cast in the way, and the lion standing by the carcase: and they came and told it in the city where the old prophet dwelt.

verses.raw: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of Elohim (God), who was disobedient unto the word of Yahuah (LORD): therefore Yahuah (LORD) has delivered him unto the lion, which has torn him, and slain him, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake unto him.
verses.text: And when the prophet that brought him back from the way heard thereof, he said, It is the man of Elohim, who was disobedient unto the word of Yahuah: therefore Yahuah has delivered him unto the lion, which has torn him, and slain him, according to the word of Yahuah, which he spake unto him.

verses.raw: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.
verses.text: And he spake to his sons, saying, Saddle me the ass. And they saddled him.

verses.raw: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.
verses.text: And he went and found his carcase cast in the way, and the ass and the lion standing by the carcase: the lion had not eaten the carcase, nor torn the ass.

verses.raw: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of Elohim (God), and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.
verses.text: And the prophet took up the carcase of the man of Elohim, and laid it upon the ass, and brought it back: and the old prophet came to the city, to mourn and to bury him.

verses.raw: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!
verses.text: And he laid his carcase in his own grave; and they mourned over him, saying, Alas, my brother!

verses.raw: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of Elohim (God) is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:
verses.text: And it came to pass, after he had buried him, that he spake to his sons, saying, When I am dead, then bury me in the sepulchre wherein the man of Elohim is buried; lay my bones beside his bones:

verses.raw: For the saying which he cried by the word of Yahuah (LORD) against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.
verses.text: For the saying which he cried by the word of Yahuah against the altar in Beth-el, and against all the houses of the high places which are in the cities of Samaria, shall surely come to pass.

verses.raw: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.
verses.text: After this thing Jeroboam returned not from his evil way, but made again of the lowest of the people priests of the high places: whosoever would, he consecrated him, and he became one of the priests of the high places.

verses.raw: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.
verses.text: And this thing became sin unto the house of Jeroboam, even to cut it off, and to destroy it from off the face of the earth.

verses.raw: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.
verses.text: At that time Abijah the son of Jeroboam fell sick.

verses.raw: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray you, and disguise thyself, that you be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get you to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.
verses.text: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Arise, I pray you, and disguise thyself, that you be not known to be the wife of Jeroboam; and get you to Shiloh: behold, there is Ahijah the prophet, which told me that I should be king over this people.

verses.raw: And take with you ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell you what shall become of the child.
verses.text: And take with you ten loaves, and cracknels, and a cruse of honey, and go to him: he shall tell you what shall become of the child.

verses.raw: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.
verses.text: And Jeroboam’s wife did so, and arose, and went to Shiloh, and came to the house of Ahijah. But Ahijah could not see; for his eyes were set by reason of his age.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam comes to ask a thing of you for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shall you say unto her: for it shall be, when she comes in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Ahijah, Behold, the wife of Jeroboam comes to ask a thing of you for her son; for he is sick: thus and thus shall you say unto her: for it shall be, when she comes in, that she shall feign herself to be another woman.

verses.raw: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, you wife of Jeroboam; why feignest you thyself to be another? for I am sent to you with heavy tidings.
verses.text: And it was so, when Ahijah heard the sound of her feet, as she came in at the door, that he said, Come in, you wife of Jeroboam; why feignest you thyself to be another? for I am sent to you with heavy tidings.

verses.raw: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Forasmuch as I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: Go, tell Jeroboam, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, Forasmuch as I exalted you from among the people, and made you prince over my people Yashar'el,

verses.raw: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it you: and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes;
verses.text: And rent the kingdom away from the house of David, and gave it you: and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept my commandments, and who followed me with all his heart, to do that only which was right in my eyes;

verses.raw: But have done evil above all that were before you: for you have gone and made you other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back:
verses.text: But have done evil above all that were before you: for you have gone and made you other gods, and molten images, to provoke me to anger, and have cast me behind your back:

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Yashar'el (Israel), and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man takes away dung, till it be all gone.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will bring evil upon the house of Jeroboam, and will cut off from Jeroboam him that pisseth against the wall, and him that is shut up and left in Yashar'el, and will take away the remnant of the house of Jeroboam, as a man takes away dung, till it be all gone.

verses.raw: Him that dies of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dies in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
verses.text: Him that dies of Jeroboam in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dies in the field shall the fowls of the air eat: for Yahuah has spoken it.

verses.raw: Arise you therefore, get you to your own house: and when your feet enter into the city, the child shall die.
verses.text: Arise you therefore, get you to your own house: and when your feet enter into the city, the child shall die.

verses.raw: And all Yashar'el (Israel) shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) in the house of Jeroboam.
verses.text: And all Yashar'el shall mourn for him, and bury him: for he only of Jeroboam shall come to the grave, because in him there is found some good thing toward Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el in the house of Jeroboam.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) shall raise him up a king over Yashar'el (Israel), who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah shall raise him up a king over Yashar'el, who shall cut off the house of Jeroboam that day: but what? even now.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) shall smite Yashar'el (Israel), as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Yashar'el (Israel) out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking Yahuah (LORD) to anger.
verses.text: For Yahuah shall smite Yashar'el, as a reed is shaken in the water, and he shall root up Yashar'el out of this good land, which he gave to their fathers, and shall scatter them beyond the river, because they have made their groves, provoking Yahuah to anger.

verses.raw: And he shall give Yashar'el (Israel) up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: And he shall give Yashar'el up because of the sins of Jeroboam, who did sin, and who made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: And Jeroboam’s wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;
verses.text: And Jeroboam’s wife arose, and departed, and came to Tirzah: and when she came to the threshold of the door, the child died;

verses.raw: And they buried him; and all Yashar'el (Israel) mourned for him, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.
verses.text: And they buried him; and all Yashar'el mourned for him, according to the word of Yahuah, which he spake by the hand of his servant Ahijah the prophet.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he warred, and how he reigned, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And the days which Jeroboam reigned were two and twenty years: and he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Yahudah (Judah). Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahuah (LORD) did choose out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.text: And Rehoboam the son of Solomon reigned in Yahudah. Rehoboam was forty and one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahuah did choose out of all the tribes of Yashar'el, to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.
verses.text: And Yahudah did evil in the sight of Yahuah, and they provoked him to jealousy with their sins which they had committed, above all that their fathers had done.

verses.raw: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.
verses.text: For they also built them high places, and images, and groves, on every high hill, and under every green tree.

verses.raw: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which Yahuah (LORD) cast out before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And there were also sodomites in the land: and they did according to all the abominations of the nations which Yahuah cast out before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:
verses.text: And it came to pass in the fifth year of king Rehoboam, that Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem:

verses.raw: And he took away the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.text: And he took away the treasures of the house of Yahuah, and the treasures of the king’s house; he even took away all: and he took away all the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

verses.raw: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.
verses.text: And king Rehoboam made in their stead brasen shields, and committed them unto the hands of the chief of the guard, which kept the door of the king’s house.

verses.raw: And it was so, when the king went into the house of Yahuah (LORD), that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
verses.text: And it was so, when the king went into the house of Yahuah, that the guard bare them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
verses.text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.

verses.raw: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess. And Abijam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Yahudah.

verses.raw: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.text: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.raw: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), as the heart of David his father.
verses.text: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with Yahuah Elohav, as the heart of David his father.

verses.raw: Nevertheless for David’s sake did Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
verses.text: Nevertheless for David’s sake did Yahuah Elohav give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:

verses.raw: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.text: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.

verses.raw: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.text: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.

verses.raw: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Yashar'el (Israel) reigned Asa over Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Yashar'el reigned Asa over Yahudah.

verses.raw: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.text: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.

verses.raw: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), as did David his father.
verses.text: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah, as did David his father.

verses.raw: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
verses.text: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.

verses.raw: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
verses.text: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.

verses.raw: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with Yahuah (LORD) all his days.
verses.text: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa’s heart was perfect with Yahuah all his days.

verses.raw: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of Yahuah (LORD), silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.text: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of Yahuah, silver, and gold, and vessels.

verses.raw: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel) all their days.
verses.text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Yashar'el all their days.

verses.raw: And Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel) went up against Yahudah (Judah), and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And Baasha king of Yashar'el went up against Yahudah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.text: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of Yahuah, and the treasures of the king’s house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

verses.raw: There is a league between me and you, and between my father and your father: behold, I have sent unto you a present of silver and gold; come and break your league with Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel), that he may depart from me.
verses.text: There is a league between me and you, and between my father and your father: behold, I have sent unto you a present of silver and gold; come and break your league with Baasha king of Yashar'el, that he may depart from me.

verses.raw: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Yashar'el (Israel), and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.text: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Yashar'el, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.

verses.raw: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Yahudah (Judah); none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.text: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Yahudah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.

verses.raw: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.text: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.

verses.raw: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in the second year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah), and reigned over Yashar'el (Israel) two years.
verses.text: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Yashar'el in the second year of Asa king of Yahudah, and reigned over Yashar'el two years.

verses.raw: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Yashar'el (Israel) laid siege to Gibbethon.
verses.text: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Yashar'el laid siege to Gibbethon.

verses.raw: Even in the third year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.text: Even in the third year of Asa king of Yahudah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of Yahuah, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:

verses.raw: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Yashar'el (Israel) sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to anger.
verses.text: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Yashar'el sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el to anger.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel) all their days.
verses.text: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Yashar'el all their days.

verses.raw: In the third year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Yashar'el (Israel) in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
verses.text: In the third year of Asa king of Yahudah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Yashar'el in Tirzah, twenty and four years.

verses.raw: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,
verses.text: Then the word of Yahuah came to Jehu the son of Hanani against Baasha, saying,

verses.raw: Forasmuch as I exalted you out of the dust, and made you prince over my people Yashar'el (Israel); and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam, and have made my people Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;
verses.text: Forasmuch as I exalted you out of the dust, and made you prince over my people Yashar'el; and you have walked in the way of Jeroboam, and have made my people Yashar'el to sin, to provoke me to anger with their sins;

verses.raw: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.text: Behold, I will take away the posterity of Baasha, and the posterity of his house; and will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.raw: Him that dies of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dies of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.
verses.text: Him that dies of Baasha in the city shall the dogs eat; and him that dies of his in the fields shall the fowls of the air eat.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his might, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of Yahuah (LORD) against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.
verses.text: And also by the hand of the prophet Jehu the son of Hanani came the word of Yahuah against Baasha, and against his house, even for all the evil that he did in the sight of Yahuah, in provoking him to anger with the work of his hands, in being like the house of Jeroboam; and because he killed him.

verses.raw: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Tirzah, two years.
verses.text: In the twenty and sixth year of Asa king of Yahudah began Elah the son of Baasha to reign over Yashar'el in Tirzah, two years.

verses.raw: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.
verses.text: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his chariots, conspired against him, as he was in Tirzah, drinking himself drunk in the house of Arza steward of his house in Tirzah.

verses.raw: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah), and reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Zimri went in and smote him, and killed him, in the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Yahudah, and reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when he began to reign, as soon as he sat on his throne, that he slew all the house of Baasha: he left him not one that pisseth against a wall, neither of his kinsfolks, nor of his friends.

verses.raw: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,
verses.text: Thus did Zimri destroy all the house of Baasha, according to the word of Yahuah, which he spake against Baasha by Jehu the prophet,

verses.raw: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, in provoking Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to anger with their vanities.
verses.text: For all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, by which they sinned, and by which they made Yashar'el to sin, in provoking Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el to anger with their vanities.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.
verses.text: In the twenty and seventh year of Asa king of Yahudah did Zimri reign seven days in Tirzah. And the people were encamped against Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines.

verses.raw: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri has conspired, and has also slain the king: wherefore all Yashar'el (Israel) made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Yashar'el (Israel) that day in the camp.
verses.text: And the people that were encamped heard say, Zimri has conspired, and has also slain the king: wherefore all Yashar'el made Omri, the captain of the host, king over Yashar'el that day in the camp.

verses.raw: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, and they besieged Tirzah.
verses.text: And Omri went up from Gibbethon, and all Yashar'el with him, and they besieged Tirzah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Zimri saw that the city was taken, that he went into the palace of the king’s house, and burnt the king’s house over him with fire, and died,

verses.raw: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: For his sins which he sinned in doing evil in the sight of Yahuah, in walking in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin which he did, to make Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and his treason that he wrought, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: Then were the people of Yashar'el (Israel) divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
verses.text: Then were the people of Yashar'el divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.

verses.raw: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.
verses.text: But the people that followed Omri prevailed against the people that followed Tibni the son of Ginath: so Tibni died, and Omri reigned.

verses.raw: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) began Omri to reign over Yashar'el (Israel), twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.
verses.text: In the thirty and first year of Asa king of Yahudah began Omri to reign over Yashar'el, twelve years: six years reigned he in Tirzah.

verses.raw: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.
verses.text: And he bought the hill Samaria of Shemer for two talents of silver, and built on the hill, and called the name of the city which he built, after the name of Shemer, owner of the hill, Samaria.

verses.raw: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), and did worse than all that were before him.
verses.text: But Omri wrought evil in the eyes of Yahuah, and did worse than all that were before him.

verses.raw: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, to provoke Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to anger with their vanities.
verses.text: For he walked in all the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and in his sin wherewith he made Yashar'el to sin, to provoke Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el to anger with their vanities.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Omri which he did, and his might that he shewed, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: So Omri slept with his fathers, and was buried in Samaria: and Ahab his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah) began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Yashar'el (Israel): and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria twenty and two years.
verses.text: And in the thirty and eighth year of Asa king of Yahudah began Ahab the son of Omri to reign over Yashar'el: and Ahab the son of Omri reigned over Yashar'el in Samaria twenty and two years.

verses.raw: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD) above all that were before him.
verses.text: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of Yahuah above all that were before him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as if it had been a light thing for him to walk in the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, that he took to wife Jezebel the daughter of Ethbaal king of the Zidonians, and went and served Baal, and worshipped him.

verses.raw: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.
verses.text: And he reared up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal, which he had built in Samaria.

verses.raw: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to anger than all the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) that were before him.
verses.text: And Ahab made a grove; and Ahab did more to provoke Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el to anger than all the kings of Yashar'el that were before him.

verses.raw: In his days did Hiel the Beth-elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.text: In his days did Hiel the Beth-elite build Jericho: he laid the foundation thereof in Abiram his firstborn, and set up the gates thereof in his youngest son Segub, according to the word of Yahuah, which he spake by Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.raw: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.
verses.text: And Elijah the Tishbite, who was of the inhabitants of Gilead, said unto Ahab, As Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el lives, before whom I stand, there shall not be dew nor rain these years, but according to my word.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto him, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto him, saying,

verses.raw: Get you hence, and turn you eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.text: Get you hence, and turn you eastward, and hide thyself by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

verses.raw: And it shall be, that you shall drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.
verses.text: And it shall be, that you shall drink of the brook; and I have commanded the ravens to feed you there.

verses.raw: So he went and did according unto the word of Yahuah (LORD): for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.
verses.text: So he went and did according unto the word of Yahuah: for he went and dwelt by the brook Cherith, that is before Jordan.

verses.raw: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.
verses.text: And the ravens brought him bread and flesh in the morning, and bread and flesh in the evening; and he drank of the brook.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.
verses.text: And it came to pass after a while, that the brook dried up, because there had been no rain in the land.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto him, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto him, saying,

verses.raw: Arise, get you to Zarephath, which belongs to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain you.
verses.text: Arise, get you to Zarephath, which belongs to Zidon, and dwell there: behold, I have commanded a widow woman there to sustain you.

verses.raw: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray you, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.
verses.text: So he arose and went to Zarephath. And when he came to the gate of the city, behold, the widow woman was there gathering of sticks: and he called to her, and said, Fetch me, I pray you, a little water in a vessel, that I may drink.

verses.raw: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray you, a morsel of bread in your hand.
verses.text: And as she was going to fetch it, he called to her, and said, Bring me, I pray you, a morsel of bread in your hand.

verses.raw: And she said, As Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) lives, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.
verses.text: And she said, As Yahuah Elohayka lives, I have not a cake, but an handful of meal in a barrel, and a little oil in a cruse: and, behold, I am gathering two sticks, that I may go in and dress it for me and my son, that we may eat it, and die.

verses.raw: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as you have said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for you and for your son.
verses.text: And Elijah said unto her, Fear not; go and do as you have said: but make me thereof a little cake first, and bring it unto me, and after make for you and for your son.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that Yahuah (LORD) sends rain upon the earth.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, The barrel of meal shall not waste, neither shall the cruse of oil fail, until the day that Yahuah sends rain upon the earth.

verses.raw: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.
verses.text: And she went and did according to the saying of Elijah: and she, and he, and her house, did eat many days.

verses.raw: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), which he spake by Elijah.
verses.text: And the barrel of meal wasted not, neither did the cruse of oil fail, according to the word of Yahuah, which he spake by Elijah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.
verses.text: And it came to pass after these things, that the son of the woman, the mistress of the house, fell sick; and his sickness was so sore, that there was no breath left in him.

verses.raw: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with you, O you man of Elohim (God)? are you come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?
verses.text: And she said unto Elijah, What have I to do with you, O you man of Elohim? are you come unto me to call my sin to remembrance, and to slay my son?

verses.raw: And he said unto her, Give me your son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.
verses.text: And he said unto her, Give me your son. And he took him out of her bosom, and carried him up into a loft, where he abode, and laid him upon his own bed.

verses.raw: And he cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), have you also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?
verses.text: And he cried unto Yahuah, and said, O Yahuah my Elohim, have you also brought evil upon the widow with whom I sojourn, by slaying her son?

verses.raw: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), I pray you, let this child’s soul come into him again.
verses.text: And he stretched himself upon the child three times, and cried unto Yahuah, and said, O Yahuah my Elohim, I pray you, let this child’s soul come into him again.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.
verses.text: And Yahuah heard the voice of Elijah; and the soul of the child came into him again, and he revived.

verses.raw: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, your son lives.
verses.text: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, your son lives.

verses.raw: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that you are a man of Elohim (God), and that the word of Yahuah (LORD) in your mouth is truth.
verses.text: And the woman said to Elijah, Now by this I know that you are a man of Elohim, and that the word of Yahuah in your mouth is truth.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.
verses.text: And it came to pass after many days, that the word of Yahuah came to Elijah in the third year, saying, Go, shew thyself unto Ahab; and I will send rain upon the earth.

verses.raw: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.
verses.text: And Elijah went to shew himself unto Ahab. And there was a sore famine in Samaria.

verses.raw: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared Yahuah (LORD) greatly:
verses.text: And Ahab called Obadiah, which was the governor of his house. (Now Obadiah feared Yahuah greatly:

verses.raw: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of Yahuah (LORD), that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)
verses.text: For it was so, when Jezebel cut off the prophets of Yahuah, that Obadiah took an hundred prophets, and hid them by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water.)

verses.raw: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.
verses.text: And Ahab said unto Obadiah, Go into the land, unto all fountains of water, and unto all brooks: peradventure we may find grass to save the horses and mules alive, that we lose not all the beasts.

verses.raw: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.
verses.text: So they divided the land between them to pass throughout it: Ahab went one way by himself, and Obadiah went another way by himself.

verses.raw: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Are you that my lord Elijah?
verses.text: And as Obadiah was in the way, behold, Elijah met him: and he knew him, and fell on his face, and said, Are you that my lord Elijah?

verses.raw: And he answered him, I am: go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.text: And he answered him, I am: go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

verses.raw: And he said, What have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?
verses.text: And he said, What have I sinned, that you would deliver your servant into the hand of Ahab, to slay me?

verses.raw: As Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) lives, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord has not sent to seek you: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found you not.
verses.text: As Yahuah Elohayka lives, there is no nation or kingdom, whither my lord has not sent to seek you: and when they said, He is not there; he took an oath of the kingdom and nation, that they found you not.

verses.raw: And now you say, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here.
verses.text: And now you say, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from you, that the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall carry you whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he shall slay me: but I your servant fear Yahuah (LORD) from my youth.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, as soon as I am gone from you, that the Spirit of Yahuah shall carry you whither I know not; and so when I come and tell Ahab, and he cannot find you, he shall slay me: but I your servant fear Yahuah from my youth.

verses.raw: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of Yahuah (LORD), how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?
verses.text: Was it not told my lord what I did when Jezebel slew the prophets of Yahuah, how I hid an hundred men of the LORD’S prophets by fifty in a cave, and fed them with bread and water?

verses.raw: And now you say, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.
verses.text: And now you say, Go, tell your lord, Behold, Elijah is here: and he shall slay me.

verses.raw: And Elijah said, As Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) lives, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.
verses.text: And Elijah said, As Yahuah Tseva'ot lives, before whom I stand, I will surely shew myself unto him to day.

verses.raw: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
verses.text: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Are you he that troubles Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Ahab saw Elijah, that Ahab said unto him, Are you he that troubles Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And he answered, I have not troubled Yashar'el (Israel); but you, and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the commandments of Yahuah (LORD), and you have followed Baalim.
verses.text: And he answered, I have not troubled Yashar'el; but you, and your father’s house, in that you have forsaken the commandments of Yahuah, and you have followed Baalim.

verses.raw: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Yashar'el (Israel) unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.
verses.text: Now therefore send, and gather to me all Yashar'el unto mount Carmel, and the prophets of Baal four hundred and fifty, and the prophets of the groves four hundred, which eat at Jezebel’s table.

verses.raw: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.
verses.text: So Ahab sent unto all the children of Yashar'el, and gathered the prophets together unto mount Carmel.

verses.raw: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt you between two opinions? if Yahuah (LORD) be Elohim (God), follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.
verses.text: And Elijah came unto all the people, and said, How long halt you between two opinions? if Yahuah be Elohim, follow him: but if Baal, then follow him. And the people answered him not a word.

verses.raw: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of Yahuah (LORD); but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
verses.text: Then said Elijah unto the people, I, even I only, remain a prophet of Yahuah; but Baal’s prophets are four hundred and fifty men.

verses.raw: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:
verses.text: Let them therefore give us two bullocks; and let them choose one bullock for themselves, and cut it in pieces, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under: and I will dress the other bullock, and lay it on wood, and put no fire under:

verses.raw: And call you on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of Yahuah (LORD): and the Elohim (God) that answers by fire, let him be Elohim (God). And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.
verses.text: And call you on the name of your gods, and I will call on the name of Yahuah: and the Elohim that answers by fire, let him be Elohim. And all the people answered and said, It is well spoken.

verses.raw: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for you are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.
verses.text: And Elijah said unto the prophets of Baal, Choose you one bullock for yourselves, and dress it first; for you are many; and call on the name of your gods, but put no fire under.

verses.raw: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.
verses.text: And they took the bullock which was given them, and they dressed it, and called on the name of Baal from morning even until noon, saying, O Baal, hear us. But there was no voice, nor any that answered. And they leaped upon the altar which was made.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleeps, and must be awaked.
verses.text: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleeps, and must be awaked.

verses.raw: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.
verses.text: And they cried aloud, and cut themselves after their manner with knives and lancets, till the blood gushed out upon them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when midday was past, and they prophesied until the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that there was neither voice, nor any to answer, nor any that regarded.

verses.raw: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of Yahuah (LORD) that was broken down.
verses.text: And Elijah said unto all the people, Come near unto me. And all the people came near unto him. And he repaired the altar of Yahuah that was broken down.

verses.raw: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of Yahuah (LORD) came, saying, Yashar'el (Israel) shall be your name:
verses.text: And Elijah took twelve stones, according to the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, unto whom the word of Yahuah came, saying, Yashar'el shall be your name:

verses.raw: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of Yahuah (LORD): and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.
verses.text: And with the stones he built an altar in the name of Yahuah: and he made a trench about the altar, as great as would contain two measures of seed.

verses.raw: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.
verses.text: And he put the wood in order, and cut the bullock in pieces, and laid him on the wood, and said, Fill four barrels with water, and pour it on the burnt sacrifice, and on the wood.

verses.raw: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.
verses.text: And he said, Do it the second time. And they did it the second time. And he said, Do it the third time. And they did it the third time.

verses.raw: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.
verses.text: And the water ran round about the altar; and he filled the trench also with water.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Abraham, Isaac, and of Yashar'el (Israel), let it be known this day that you are Elohim (God) in Yashar'el (Israel), and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the time of the offering of the evening sacrifice, that Elijah the prophet came near, and said, Yahuah Elohim of Abraham, Isaac, and of Yashar'el, let it be known this day that you are Elohim in Yashar'el, and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things at your word.

verses.raw: Hear me, O Yahuah (LORD), hear me, that this people may know that you are Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), and that you have turned their heart back again.
verses.text: Hear me, O Yahuah, hear me, that this people may know that you are Yahuah Elohim, and that you have turned their heart back again.

verses.raw: Then the fire of Yahuah (LORD) fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.
verses.text: Then the fire of Yahuah fell, and consumed the burnt sacrifice, and the wood, and the stones, and the dust, and licked up the water that was in the trench.

verses.raw: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, Yahuah (LORD), he is the Elohim (God); Yahuah (LORD), he is the Elohim (God).
verses.text: And when all the people saw it, they fell on their faces: and they said, Yahuah, he is the Elohim; Yahuah, he is the Elohim.

verses.raw: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.
verses.text: And Elijah said unto them, Take the prophets of Baal; let not one of them escape. And they took them: and Elijah brought them down to the brook Kishon, and slew them there.

verses.raw: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get you up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.
verses.text: And Elijah said unto Ahab, Get you up, eat and drink; for there is a sound of abundance of rain.

verses.raw: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,
verses.text: So Ahab went up to eat and to drink. And Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he cast himself down upon the earth, and put his face between his knees,

verses.raw: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.
verses.text: And said to his servant, Go up now, look toward the sea. And he went up, and looked, and said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there arises a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare your chariot, and get you down, that the rain stop you not.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the seventh time, that he said, Behold, there arises a little cloud out of the sea, like a man’s hand. And he said, Go up, say unto Ahab, Prepare your chariot, and get you down, that the rain stop you not.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the mean while, that the heaven was black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab rode, and went to Jezreel.

verses.raw: And the hand of Yahuah (LORD) was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.
verses.text: And the hand of Yahuah was on Elijah; and he girded up his loins, and ran before Ahab to the entrance of Jezreel.

verses.raw: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.
verses.text: And Ahab told Jezebel all that Elijah had done, and withal how he had slain all the prophets with the sword.

verses.raw: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not your life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.
verses.text: Then Jezebel sent a messenger unto Elijah, saying, So let the gods do to me, and more also, if I make not your life as the life of one of them by to morrow about this time.

verses.raw: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongs to Yahudah (Judah), and left his servant there.
verses.text: And when he saw that, he arose, and went for his life, and came to Beer-sheba, which belongs to Yahudah, and left his servant there.

verses.raw: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O Yahuah (LORD), take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.
verses.text: But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree: and he requested for himself that he might die; and said, It is enough; now, O Yahuah, take away my life; for I am not better than my fathers.

verses.raw: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.
verses.text: And as he lay and slept under a juniper tree, behold, then an angel touched him, and said unto him, Arise and eat.

verses.raw: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.
verses.text: And he looked, and, behold, there was a cake baken on the coals, and a cruse of water at his head. And he did eat and drink, and laid him down again.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for you.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah came again the second time, and touched him, and said, Arise and eat; because the journey is too great for you.

verses.raw: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And he arose, and did eat and drink, and went in the strength of that meat forty days and forty nights unto Horeb the mount of Elohim.

verses.raw: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to him, and he said unto him, What do you here, Elijah?
verses.text: And he came thither unto a cave, and lodged there; and, behold, the word of Yahuah came to him, and he said unto him, What do you here, Elijah?

verses.raw: And he said, I have been very jealous for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts: for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and slain your prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.
verses.text: And he said, I have been very jealous for Yahuah Elohim of hosts: for the children of Yashar'el have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and slain your prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

verses.raw: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before Yahuah (LORD). And, behold, Yahuah (LORD) passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before Yahuah (LORD); but Yahuah (LORD) was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but Yahuah (LORD) was not in the earthquake:
verses.text: And he said, Go forth, and stand upon the mount before Yahuah. And, behold, Yahuah passed by, and a great and strong wind rent the mountains, and brake in pieces the rocks before Yahuah; but Yahuah was not in the wind: and after the wind an earthquake; but Yahuah was not in the earthquake:

verses.raw: And after the earthquake a fire; but Yahuah (LORD) was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.
verses.text: And after the earthquake a fire; but Yahuah was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice.

verses.raw: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What do you here, Elijah?
verses.text: And it was so, when Elijah heard it, that he wrapped his face in his mantle, and went out, and stood in the entering in of the cave. And, behold, there came a voice unto him, and said, What do you here, Elijah?

verses.text: And he said, I have been very jealous for Yahuah Elohim of hosts: because the children of Yashar'el have forsaken your covenant, thrown down your altars, and slain your prophets with the sword; and I, even I only, am left; and they seek my life, to take it away.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when you come, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto him, Go, return on your way to the wilderness of Damascus: and when you come, anoint Hazael to be king over Syria:

verses.raw: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shall you anoint to be king over Yashar'el (Israel): and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shall you anoint to be prophet in your room.
verses.text: And Jehu the son of Nimshi shall you anoint to be king over Yashar'el: and Elisha the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah shall you anoint to be prophet in your room.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that him that escapeth the sword of Hazael shall Jehu slay: and him that escapeth from the sword of Jehu shall Elisha slay.

verses.raw: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Yashar'el (Israel), all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed him.
verses.text: Yet I have left me seven thousand in Yashar'el, all the knees which have not bowed unto Baal, and every mouth which has not kissed him.

verses.raw: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.
verses.text: So he departed thence, and found Elisha the son of Shaphat, who was plowing with twelve yoke of oxen before him, and he with the twelfth: and Elijah passed by him, and cast his mantle upon him.

verses.raw: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray you, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to you?
verses.text: And he left the oxen, and ran after Elijah, and said, Let me, I pray you, kiss my father and my mother, and then I will follow you. And he said unto him, Go back again: for what have I done to you?

verses.raw: And he returned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen, and slew them, and boiled their flesh with the instruments of the oxen, and gave unto the people, and they did eat. Then he arose, and went after Elijah, and ministered unto him.

verses.raw: And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.
verses.text: And Ben-hadad the king of Syria gathered all his host together: and there were thirty and two kings with him, and horses, and chariots: and he went up and besieged Samaria, and warred against it.

verses.raw: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel) into the city, and said unto him, Thus says Ben-hadad,
verses.text: And he sent messengers to Ahab king of Yashar'el into the city, and said unto him, Thus says Ben-hadad,

verses.text: Your silver and your gold is mine; your wives also and your children, even the goodliest, are mine.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) answered and said, My lord, O king, according to your saying, I am yours, and all that I have.
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el answered and said, My lord, O king, according to your saying, I am yours, and all that I have.

verses.text: And the messengers came again, and said, Thus speaks Ben-hadad, saying, Although I have sent unto you, saying, You shall deliver me your silver, and your gold, and your wives, and your children;

verses.raw: Yet I will send my servants unto you to morrow about this time, and they shall search your house, and the houses of your servants; and it shall be, that whatsoever is pleasant in your eyes, they shall put it in their hand, and take it away.
