verses.raw: Then the king of Yashar'el (Israel) called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeks mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.
verses.text: Then the king of Yashar'el called all the elders of the land, and said, Mark, I pray you, and see how this man seeks mischief: for he sent unto me for my wives, and for my children, and for my silver, and for my gold; and I denied him not.

verses.raw: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.
verses.text: And all the elders and all the people said unto him, Hearken not unto him, nor consent.

verses.raw: Wherefore he said unto the messengers of Ben-hadad, Tell my lord the king, All that you did send for to your servant at the first I will do: but this thing I may not do. And the messengers departed, and brought him word again.

verses.text: And Ben-hadad sent unto him, and said, The gods do so unto me, and more also, if the dust of Samaria shall suffice for handfuls for all the people that follow me.

verses.text: And, behold, there came a prophet unto Ahab king of Yashar'el, saying, Thus says Yahuah, Have you seen all this great multitude? behold, I will deliver it into your hand this day; and you shall know that I am Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, You.
verses.text: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, Thus says Yahuah, Even by the young men of the princes of the provinces. Then he said, Who shall order the battle? And he answered, You.

verses.raw: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Yashar'el (Israel), being seven thousand.
verses.text: Then he numbered the young men of the princes of the provinces, and they were two hundred and thirty two: and after them he numbered all the people, even all the children of Yashar'el, being seven thousand.

verses.text: Now therefore, behold, Yahuah has put a lying spirit in the mouth of all these your prophets, and Yahuah has spoken evil concerning you.

verses.raw: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) from me to speak unto you?
verses.text: But Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah went near, and smote Micaiah on the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of Yahuah from me to speak unto you?

verses.raw: And Micaiah said, Behold, you shall see in that day, when you shall go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.text: And Micaiah said, Behold, you shall see in that day, when you shall go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el said, Take Micaiah, and carry him back unto Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

verses.raw: And say, Thus says the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.
verses.text: And say, Thus says the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I come in peace.

verses.raw: And Micaiah said, If you return at all in peace, Yahuah (LORD) has not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.
verses.text: And Micaiah said, If you return at all in peace, Yahuah has not spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, O people, every one of you.

verses.raw: So the king of Yashar'el (Israel) and Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah (Judah) went up to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.text: So the king of Yashar'el and Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put you on your robes. And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) disguised himself, and went into the battle.
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and enter into the battle; but put you on your robes. And the king of Yashar'el disguised himself, and went into the battle.

verses.raw: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But the king of Syria commanded his thirty and two captains that had rule over his chariots, saying, Fight neither with small nor great, save only with the king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Yashar'el (Israel). And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, Surely it is the king of Yashar'el. And they turned aside to fight against him: and Jehoshaphat cried out.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Yashar'el (Israel), that they turned back from pursuing him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Yashar'el, that they turned back from pursuing him.

verses.raw: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Yashar'el (Israel) between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn your hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.text: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Yashar'el between the joints of the harness: wherefore he said unto the driver of his chariot, Turn your hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

verses.raw: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.
verses.text: And the battle increased that day: and the king was stayed up in his chariot against the Syrians, and died at even: and the blood ran out of the wound into the midst of the chariot.

verses.raw: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.
verses.text: And there went a proclamation throughout the host about the going down of the sun, saying, Every man to his city, and every man to his own country.

verses.raw: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.
verses.text: So the king died, and was brought to Samaria; and they buried the king in Samaria.

verses.raw: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of Yahuah (LORD) which he spake.
verses.text: And one washed the chariot in the pool of Samaria; and the dogs licked up his blood; and they washed his armour; according unto the word of Yahuah which he spake.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all that he did, and the ivory house which he made, and all the cities that he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Yahudah (Judah) in the fourth year of Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat the son of Asa began to reign over Yahudah in the fourth year of Ahab king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.text: Jehoshaphat was thirty and five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.raw: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD): nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.
verses.text: And he walked in all the ways of Asa his father; he turned not aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of Yahuah: nevertheless the high places were not taken away; for the people offered and burnt incense yet in the high places.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his might that he shewed, and how he warred, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.
verses.text: And the remnant of the sodomites, which remained in the days of his father Asa, he took out of the land.

verses.raw: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.
verses.text: There was then no king in Edom: a deputy was king.

verses.raw: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.
verses.text: Jehoshaphat made ships of Tharshish to go to Ophir for gold: but they went not; for the ships were broken at Ezion-geber.

verses.raw: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with your servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.
verses.text: Then said Ahaziah the son of Ahab unto Jehoshaphat, Let my servants go with your servants in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah (Judah), and reigned two years over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Ahaziah the son of Ahab began to reign over Yashar'el in Samaria the seventeenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah, and reigned two years over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin:
verses.text: And he did evil in the sight of Yahuah, and walked in the way of his father, and in the way of his mother, and in the way of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el to sin:

verses.raw: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), according to all that his father had done.
verses.text: For he served Baal, and worshipped him, and provoked to anger Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, according to all that his father had done.

verses.raw: Then Moab rebelled against Yashar'el (Israel) after the death of Ahab.
verses.text: Then Moab rebelled against Yashar'el after the death of Ahab.

verses.raw: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.
verses.text: And Ahaziah fell down through a lattice in his upper chamber that was in Samaria, and was sick: and he sent messengers, and said unto them, Go, enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron whether I shall recover of this disease.

verses.raw: But the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a Elohim (God) in Yashar'el (Israel), that you go to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?
verses.text: But the angel of Yahuah said to Elijah the Tishbite, Arise, go up to meet the messengers of the king of Samaria, and say unto them, Is it not because there is not a Elohim in Yashar'el, that you go to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron?

verses.raw: Now therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), You shall not come down from that bed on which you are gone up, but shall surely die. And Elijah departed.
verses.text: Now therefore thus says Yahuah, You shall not come down from that bed on which you are gone up, but shall surely die. And Elijah departed.

verses.raw: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are you now turned back?
verses.text: And when the messengers turned back unto him, he said unto them, Why are you now turned back?

verses.raw: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Is it not because there is not a Elohim (God) in Yashar'el (Israel), that you send to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore you shall not come down from that bed on which you are gone up, but shall surely die.
verses.text: And they said unto him, There came a man up to meet us, and said unto us, Go, turn again unto the king that sent you, and say unto him, Thus says Yahuah, Is it not because there is not a Elohim in Yashar'el, that you send to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron? therefore you shall not come down from that bed on which you are gone up, but shall surely die.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?
verses.text: And he said unto them, What manner of man was he which came up to meet you, and told you these words?

verses.raw: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.
verses.text: And they answered him, He was an hairy man, and girt with a girdle of leather about his loins. And he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.

verses.raw: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, You man of Elohim (God), the king has said, Come down.
verses.text: Then the king sent unto him a captain of fifty with his fifty. And he went up to him: and, behold, he sat on the top of an hill. And he spake unto him, You man of Elohim, the king has said, Come down.

verses.raw: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of Elohim (God), then let fire come down from heaven, and consume you and your fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.text: And Elijah answered and said to the captain of fifty, If I be a man of Elohim, then let fire come down from heaven, and consume you and your fifty. And there came down fire from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

verses.raw: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of Elohim (God), thus has the king said, Come down quickly.
verses.text: Again also he sent unto him another captain of fifty with his fifty. And he answered and said unto him, O man of Elohim, thus has the king said, Come down quickly.

verses.raw: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of Elohim (God), let fire come down from heaven, and consume you and your fifty. And the fire of Elohim (God) came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.
verses.text: And Elijah answered and said unto them, If I be a man of Elohim, let fire come down from heaven, and consume you and your fifty. And the fire of Elohim came down from heaven, and consumed him and his fifty.

verses.raw: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of Elohim (God), I pray you, let my life, and the life of these fifty your servants, be precious in your sight.
verses.text: And he sent again a captain of the third fifty with his fifty. And the third captain of fifty went up, and came and fell on his knees before Elijah, and besought him, and said unto him, O man of Elohim, I pray you, let my life, and the life of these fifty your servants, be precious in your sight.

verses.raw: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in your sight.
verses.text: Behold, there came fire down from heaven, and burnt up the two captains of the former fifties with their fifties: therefore let my life now be precious in your sight.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah said unto Elijah, Go down with him: be not afraid of him. And he arose, and went down with him unto the king.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Forasmuch as you have sent messengers to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no Elohim (God) in Yashar'el (Israel) to enquire of his word? therefore you shall not come down off that bed on which you are gone up, but shall surely die.
verses.text: And he said unto him, Thus says Yahuah, Forasmuch as you have sent messengers to enquire of Baal-zebub the god of Ekron, is it not because there is no Elohim in Yashar'el to enquire of his word? therefore you shall not come down off that bed on which you are gone up, but shall surely die.

verses.raw: So he died according to the word of Yahuah (LORD) which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah (Judah); because he had no son.
verses.text: So he died according to the word of Yahuah which Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his stead in the second year of Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah; because he had no son.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Yahuah (LORD) would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Yahuah would take up Elijah into heaven by a whirlwind, that Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.

verses.raw: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray you; for Yahuah (LORD) has sent me to Beth-el. And Elisha said unto him, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So they went down to Beth-el.
verses.text: And Elijah said unto Elisha, Tarry here, I pray you; for Yahuah has sent me to Beth-el. And Elisha said unto him, As Yahuah lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So they went down to Beth-el.

verses.raw: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth-el came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Know you that Yahuah (LORD) will take away your master from your head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold you your peace.
verses.text: And the sons of the prophets that were at Beth-el came forth to Elisha, and said unto him, Know you that Yahuah will take away your master from your head to day? And he said, Yea, I know it; hold you your peace.

verses.raw: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray you; for Yahuah (LORD) has sent me to Jericho. And he said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So they came to Jericho.
verses.text: And Elijah said unto him, Elisha, tarry here, I pray you; for Yahuah has sent me to Jericho. And he said, As Yahuah lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. So they came to Jericho.

verses.raw: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Know you that Yahuah (LORD) will take away your master from your head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold you your peace.
verses.text: And the sons of the prophets that were at Jericho came to Elisha, and said unto him, Know you that Yahuah will take away your master from your head to day? And he answered, Yea, I know it; hold you your peace.

verses.raw: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray you, here; for Yahuah (LORD) has sent me to Jordan. And he said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And they two went on.
verses.text: And Elijah said unto him, Tarry, I pray you, here; for Yahuah has sent me to Jordan. And he said, As Yahuah lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And they two went on.

verses.raw: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.
verses.text: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood to view afar off: and they two stood by Jordan.

verses.raw: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.
verses.text: And Elijah took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and smote the waters, and they were divided hither and thither, so that they two went over on dry ground.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for you, before I be taken away from you. And Elisha said, I pray you, let a double portion of your spirit be upon me.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they were gone over, that Elijah said unto Elisha, Ask what I shall do for you, before I be taken away from you. And Elisha said, I pray you, let a double portion of your spirit be upon me.

verses.raw: And he said, You have asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if you see me when I am taken from you, it shall be so unto you; but if not, it shall not be so.
verses.text: And he said, You have asked a hard thing: nevertheless, if you see me when I am taken from you, it shall be so unto you; but if not, it shall not be so.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as they still went on, and talked, that, behold, there appeared a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, and parted them both asunder; and Elijah went up by a whirlwind into heaven.

verses.raw: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Yashar'el (Israel), and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.
verses.text: And Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariot of Yashar'el, and the horsemen thereof. And he saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and rent them in two pieces.

verses.raw: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;
verses.text: He took up also the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of Jordan;

verses.raw: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.
verses.text: And he took the mantle of Elijah that fell from him, and smote the waters, and said, Where is Yahuah Elohim of Elijah? and when he also had smitten the waters, they parted hither and thither: and Elisha went over.

verses.raw: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah does rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
verses.text: And when the sons of the prophets which were to view at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah does rest on Elisha. And they came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.

verses.raw: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with your servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray you, and seek your master: lest peradventure the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) has taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, You shall not send.
verses.text: And they said unto him, Behold now, there be with your servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray you, and seek your master: lest peradventure the Spirit of Yahuah has taken him up, and cast him upon some mountain, or into some valley. And he said, You shall not send.

verses.raw: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.
verses.text: And when they urged him till he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but found him not.

verses.raw: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?
verses.text: And when they came again to him, (for he tarried at Jericho,) he said unto them, Did I not say unto you, Go not?

verses.raw: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray you, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.
verses.text: And the men of the city said unto Elisha, Behold, I pray you, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees: but the water is naught, and the ground barren.

verses.raw: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.
verses.text: And he said, Bring me a new cruse, and put salt therein. And they brought it to him.

verses.raw: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.
verses.text: And he went forth unto the spring of the waters, and cast the salt in there, and said, Thus says Yahuah, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from thence any more death or barren land.

verses.raw: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.
verses.text: So the waters were healed unto this day, according to the saying of Elisha which he spake.

verses.raw: And he went up from thence unto Beth-el: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, you bald head; go up, you bald head.
verses.text: And he went up from thence unto Beth-el: and as he was going up by the way, there came forth little children out of the city, and mocked him, and said unto him, Go up, you bald head; go up, you bald head.

verses.raw: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of Yahuah (LORD). And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.
verses.text: And he turned back, and looked on them, and cursed them in the name of Yahuah. And there came forth two she bears out of the wood, and tare forty and two children of them.

verses.raw: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.
verses.text: And he went from thence to mount Carmel, and from thence he returned to Samaria.

verses.raw: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah (Judah), and reigned twelve years.
verses.text: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Yashar'el in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah, and reigned twelve years.

verses.raw: And he wrought evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD); but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.
verses.text: And he wrought evil in the sight of Yahuah; but not like his father, and like his mother: for he put away the image of Baal that his father had made.

verses.raw: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin; he departed not therefrom.
verses.text: Nevertheless he cleaved unto the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, which made Yashar'el to sin; he departed not therefrom.

verses.raw: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Yashar'el (Israel) an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.
verses.text: And Mesha king of Moab was a sheepmaster, and rendered unto the king of Yashar'el an hundred thousand lambs, and an hundred thousand rams, with the wool.

verses.raw: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But it came to pass, when Ahab was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And king Jehoram went out of Samaria the same time, and numbered all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah (Judah), saying, The king of Moab has rebelled against me: will you go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as you are, my people as your people, and my horses as your horses.
verses.text: And he went and sent to Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah, saying, The king of Moab has rebelled against me: will you go with me against Moab to battle? And he said, I will go up: I am as you are, my people as your people, and my horses as your horses.

verses.raw: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.
verses.text: And he said, Which way shall we go up? And he answered, The way through the wilderness of Edom.

verses.raw: So the king of Yashar'el (Israel) went, and the king of Yahudah (Judah), and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days’ journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.
verses.text: So the king of Yashar'el went, and the king of Yahudah, and the king of Edom: and they fetched a compass of seven days’ journey: and there was no water for the host, and for the cattle that followed them.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said, Alas! that Yahuah (LORD) has called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el said, Alas! that Yahuah has called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab!

verses.raw: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Yahuah (LORD), that we may enquire of Yahuah (LORD) by him? And one of the king of Yashar'el's (Israel’s) servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.
verses.text: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Yahuah, that we may enquire of Yahuah by him? And one of the king of Yashar'el's (Israel’s) servants answered and said, Here is Elisha the son of Shaphat, which poured water on the hands of Elijah.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of Yahuah (LORD) is with him. So the king of Yashar'el (Israel) and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of Yahuah is with him. So the king of Yashar'el and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.

verses.raw: And Elisha said unto the king of Yashar'el (Israel), What have I to do with you? get you to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother. And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto him, Nay: for Yahuah (LORD) has called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
verses.text: And Elisha said unto the king of Yashar'el, What have I to do with you? get you to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother. And the king of Yashar'el said unto him, Nay: for Yahuah has called these three kings together, to deliver them into the hand of Moab.

verses.raw: And Elisha said, As Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah (Judah), I would not look toward you, nor see you.
verses.text: And Elisha said, As Yahuah Tseva'ot lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.

verses.raw: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of Yahuah (LORD) came upon him.
verses.text: But now bring me a minstrel. And it came to pass, when the minstrel played, that the hand of Yahuah came upon him.

verses.raw: And he said, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Make this valley full of ditches.
verses.text: And he said, Thus says Yahuah, Make this valley full of ditches.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), You shall not see wind, neither shall you see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that you may drink, both you, and your cattle, and your beasts.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, You shall not see wind, neither shall you see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, that you may drink, both you, and your cattle, and your beasts.

verses.raw: And this is but a light thing in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.
verses.text: And this is but a light thing in the sight of Yahuah: he will deliver the Moabites also into your hand.

verses.raw: And you shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
verses.text: And you shall smite every fenced city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all wells of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the morning, when the meat offering was offered, that, behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.

verses.raw: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.
verses.text: And when all the Moabites heard that the kings were come up to fight against them, they gathered all that were able to put on armour, and upward, and stood in the border.

verses.raw: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:
verses.text: And they rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone upon the water, and the Moabites saw the water on the other side as red as blood:

verses.raw: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
verses.text: And they said, This is blood: the kings are surely slain, and they have smitten one another: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.

verses.raw: And when they came to the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.
verses.text: And when they came to the camp of Yashar'el, the Israelites rose up and smote the Moabites, so that they fled before them: but they went forward smiting the Moabites, even in their country.

verses.raw: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kir-haraseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.
verses.text: And they beat down the cities, and on every good piece of land cast every man his stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the wells of water, and felled all the good trees: only in Kir-haraseth left they the stones thereof; howbeit the slingers went about it, and smote it.

verses.raw: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.
verses.text: And when the king of Moab saw that the battle was too sore for him, he took with him seven hundred men that drew swords, to break through even unto the king of Edom: but they could not.

verses.raw: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Yashar'el (Israel): and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
verses.text: Then he took his eldest son that should have reigned in his stead, and offered him for a burnt offering upon the wall. And there was great indignation against Yashar'el: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.

verses.raw: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Your servant my husband is dead; and you know that your servant did fear Yahuah (LORD): and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.
verses.text: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets unto Elisha, saying, Your servant my husband is dead; and you know that your servant did fear Yahuah: and the creditor is come to take unto him my two sons to be bondmen.

verses.raw: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for you? tell me, what have you in the house? And she said, Your handmaid has not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.
verses.text: And Elisha said unto her, What shall I do for you? tell me, what have you in the house? And she said, Your handmaid has not any thing in the house, save a pot of oil.

verses.raw: Then he said, Go, borrow you vessels abroad of all your neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
verses.text: Then he said, Go, borrow you vessels abroad of all your neighbours, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.

verses.raw: And when you are come in, you shall shut the door upon you and upon your sons, and shall pour out into all those vessels, and you shall set aside that which is full.
verses.text: And when you are come in, you shall shut the door upon you and upon your sons, and shall pour out into all those vessels, and you shall set aside that which is full.

verses.raw: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.
verses.text: So she went from him, and shut the door upon her and upon her sons, who brought the vessels to her; and she poured out.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the vessels were full, that she said unto her son, Bring me yet a vessel. And he said unto her, There is not a vessel more. And the oil stayed.

verses.raw: Then she came and told the man of Elohim (God). And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt, and live you and your children of the rest.
verses.text: Then she came and told the man of Elohim. And he said, Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt, and live you and your children of the rest.

verses.raw: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.
verses.text: And it fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. And so it was, that as oft as he passed by, he turned in thither to eat bread.

verses.raw: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of Elohim (God), which passes by us continually.
verses.text: And she said unto her husband, Behold now, I perceive that this is an holy man of Elohim, which passes by us continually.

verses.raw: Let us make a little chamber, I pray you, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he comes to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verses.text: Let us make a little chamber, I pray you, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he comes to us, that he shall turn in thither.

verses.raw: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.
verses.text: And it fell on a day, that he came thither, and he turned into the chamber, and lay there.

verses.raw: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.
verses.text: And he said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. And when he had called her, she stood before him.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, you have been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for you? would you be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among my own people.
verses.text: And he said unto him, Say now unto her, Behold, you have been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for you? would you be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the host? And she answered, I dwell among my own people.

verses.raw: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she has no child, and her husband is old.
verses.text: And he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi answered, Verily she has no child, and her husband is old.

verses.raw: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.
verses.text: And he said, Call her. And when he had called her, she stood in the door.

verses.raw: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, you shall embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, you man of Elohim (God), do not lie unto your handmaid.
verses.text: And he said, About this season, according to the time of life, you shall embrace a son. And she said, Nay, my lord, you man of Elohim, do not lie unto your handmaid.

verses.raw: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.
verses.text: And the woman conceived, and bare a son at that season that Elisha had said unto her, according to the time of life.

verses.raw: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
verses.text: And when the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.

verses.raw: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.
verses.text: And he said unto his father, My head, my head. And he said to a lad, Carry him to his mother.

verses.raw: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.
verses.text: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and then died.

verses.raw: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of Elohim (God), and shut the door upon him, and went out.
verses.text: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of Elohim, and shut the door upon him, and went out.

verses.raw: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray you, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of Elohim (God), and come again.
verses.text: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray you, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of Elohim, and come again.

verses.raw: And he said, Wherefore will you go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.
verses.text: And he said, Wherefore will you go to him to day? it is neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, It shall be well.

verses.raw: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not your riding for me, except I bid you.
verses.text: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not your riding for me, except I bid you.

verses.raw: So she went and came unto the man of Elohim (God) to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of Elohim (God) saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:
verses.text: So she went and came unto the man of Elohim to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of Elohim saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, yonder is that Shunammite:

verses.raw: Run now, I pray you, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with you? is it well with your husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.
verses.text: Run now, I pray you, to meet her, and say unto her, Is it well with you? is it well with your husband? is it well with the child? And she answered, It is well.

verses.raw: And when she came to the man of Elohim (God) to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of Elohim (God) said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and Yahuah (LORD) has hid it from me, and has not told me.
verses.text: And when she came to the man of Elohim to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of Elohim said, Let her alone; for her soul is vexed within her: and Yahuah has hid it from me, and has not told me.

verses.raw: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
verses.text: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?

verses.raw: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up your loins, and take my staff in your hand, and go your way: if you meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute you, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
verses.text: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up your loins, and take my staff in your hand, and go your way: if you meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute you, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.

verses.raw: And the mother of the child said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And he arose, and followed her.
verses.text: And the mother of the child said, As Yahuah lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. And he arose, and followed her.

verses.raw: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.
verses.text: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.

verses.raw: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.
verses.text: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid upon his bed.

verses.raw: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.
verses.text: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

verses.raw: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verses.text: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

verses.raw: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up your son.
verses.text: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up your son.

verses.raw: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
verses.text: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.

verses.raw: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
verses.text: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and there was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.

verses.raw: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.
verses.text: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of pottage: for they knew them not.

verses.raw: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O you man of Elohim (God), there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.
verses.text: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O you man of Elohim, there is death in the pot. And they could not eat thereof.

verses.raw: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.
verses.text: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.

verses.raw: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of Elohim (God) bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
verses.text: And there came a man from Baal-shalisha, and brought the man of Elohim bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.

verses.raw: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus says Yahuah (LORD), They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.
verses.text: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus says Yahuah, They shall eat, and shall leave thereof.

verses.raw: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So he set it before them, and they did eat, and left thereof, according to the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him Yahuah (LORD) had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.
verses.text: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him Yahuah had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, but he was a leper.

verses.raw: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Yashar'el (Israel) a little maid; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.
verses.text: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Yashar'el a little maid; and she waited on Naaman’s wife.

verses.raw: And she said unto her mistress, Would Elohim (God) my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
verses.text: And she said unto her mistress, Would Elohim my lord were with the prophet that is in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.

verses.raw: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And one went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that is of the land of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Yashar'el (Israel). And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
verses.text: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Yashar'el. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand pieces of gold, and ten changes of raiment.

verses.raw: And he brought the letter to the king of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Now when this letter is come unto you, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may recover him of his leprosy.
verses.text: And he brought the letter to the king of Yashar'el, saying, Now when this letter is come unto you, behold, I have therewith sent Naaman my servant to you, that you may recover him of his leprosy.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the king of Yashar'el (Israel) had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I Elohim (God), to kill and to make alive, that this man does send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the king of Yashar'el had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, Am I Elohim, to kill and to make alive, that this man does send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeks a quarrel against me.

verses.raw: And it was so, when Elisha the man of Elohim (God) had heard that the king of Yashar'el (Israel) had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore have you rent your clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And it was so, when Elisha the man of Elohim had heard that the king of Yashar'el had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore have you rent your clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.
verses.text: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

verses.raw: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.
verses.text: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and your flesh shall come again to you, and you shall be clean.

verses.raw: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
verses.text: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of Yahuah Elohav, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.

verses.raw: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Yashar'el (Israel)? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
verses.text: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Yashar'el? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.

verses.raw: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid you do some great thing, would you not have done it? how much rather then, when he says to you, Wash, and be clean?
verses.text: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, if the prophet had bid you do some great thing, would you not have done it? how much rather then, when he says to you, Wash, and be clean?

verses.raw: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of Elohim (God): and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
verses.text: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of Elohim: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.

verses.raw: And he returned to the man of Elohim (God), he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no Elohim (God) in all the earth, but in Yashar'el (Israel): now therefore, I pray you, take a blessing of your servant.
verses.text: And he returned to the man of Elohim, he and all his company, and came, and stood before him: and he said, Behold, now I know that there is no Elohim in all the earth, but in Yashar'el: now therefore, I pray you, take a blessing of your servant.

verses.raw: But he said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.
verses.text: But he said, As Yahuah lives, before whom I stand, I will receive none. And he urged him to take it; but he refused.

verses.raw: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray you, be given to your servant two mules’ burden of earth? for your servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Naaman said, Shall there not then, I pray you, be given to your servant two mules’ burden of earth? for your servant will henceforth offer neither burnt offering nor sacrifice unto other gods, but unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: In this thing Yahuah (LORD) pardon your servant, that when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, Yahuah (LORD) pardon your servant in this thing.
verses.text: In this thing Yahuah pardon your servant, that when my master goes into the house of Rimmon to worship there, and he leaneth on my hand, and I bow myself in the house of Rimmon: when I bow down myself in the house of Rimmon, Yahuah pardon your servant in this thing.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.
verses.text: And he said unto him, Go in peace. So he departed from him a little way.

verses.raw: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of Elohim (God), said, Behold, my master has spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as Yahuah (LORD) lives, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.
verses.text: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha the man of Elohim, said, Behold, my master has spared Naaman this Syrian, in not receiving at his hands that which he brought: but, as Yahuah lives, I will run after him, and take somewhat of him.

verses.raw: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?
verses.text: So Gehazi followed after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he lighted down from the chariot to meet him, and said, Is all well?

verses.raw: And he said, All is well. My master has sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray you, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.
verses.text: And he said, All is well. My master has sent me, saying, Behold, even now there be come to me from mount Ephraim two young men of the sons of the prophets: give them, I pray you, a talent of silver, and two changes of garments.

verses.raw: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.
verses.text: And Naaman said, Be content, take two talents. And he urged him, and bound two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of garments, and laid them upon two of his servants; and they bare them before him.

verses.raw: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.
verses.text: And when he came to the tower, he took them from their hand, and bestowed them in the house: and he let the men go, and they departed.

verses.raw: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence come you, Gehazi? And he said, Your servant went no whither.
verses.text: But he went in, and stood before his master. And Elisha said unto him, Whence come you, Gehazi? And he said, Your servant went no whither.

verses.raw: And he said unto him, Went not my heart with you, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?
verses.text: And he said unto him, Went not my heart with you, when the man turned again from his chariot to meet you? Is it a time to receive money, and to receive garments, and oliveyards, and vineyards, and sheep, and oxen, and menservants, and maidservants?

verses.raw: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto you, and unto your seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.
verses.text: The leprosy therefore of Naaman shall cleave unto you, and unto your seed for ever. And he went out from his presence a leper as white as snow.

verses.raw: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with you is too strait for us.
verses.text: And the sons of the prophets said unto Elisha, Behold now, the place where we dwell with you is too strait for us.

verses.raw: Let us go, we pray you, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go you.
verses.text: Let us go, we pray you, unto Jordan, and take thence every man a beam, and let us make us a place there, where we may dwell. And he answered, Go you.

verses.raw: And one said, Be content, I pray you, and go with your servants. And he answered, I will go.
verses.text: And one said, Be content, I pray you, and go with your servants. And he answered, I will go.

verses.raw: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.
verses.text: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they cut down wood.

verses.raw: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.
verses.text: But as one was felling a beam, the axe head fell into the water: and he cried, and said, Alas, master! for it was borrowed.

verses.raw: And the man of Elohim (God) said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.
verses.text: And the man of Elohim said, Where fell it? And he shewed him the place. And he cut down a stick, and cast it in thither; and the iron did swim.

verses.raw: Therefore said he, Take it up to you. And he put out his hand, and took it.
verses.text: Therefore said he, Take it up to you. And he put out his hand, and took it.

verses.raw: Then the king of Syria warred against Yashar'el (Israel), and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.
verses.text: Then the king of Syria warred against Yashar'el, and took counsel with his servants, saying, In such and such a place shall be my camp.

verses.raw: And the man of Elohim (God) sent unto the king of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Beware that you pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.
verses.text: And the man of Elohim sent unto the king of Yashar'el, saying, Beware that you pass not such a place; for thither the Syrians are come down.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) sent to the place which the man of Elohim (God) told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el sent to the place which the man of Elohim told him and warned him of, and saved himself there, not once nor twice.

verses.raw: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will you not shew me which of us is for the king of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Therefore the heart of the king of Syria was sore troubled for this thing; and he called his servants, and said unto them, Will you not shew me which of us is for the king of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Yashar'el (Israel), telleth the king of Yashar'el (Israel) the words that you speak in your bedchamber.
verses.text: And one of his servants said, None, my lord, O king: but Elisha, the prophet that is in Yashar'el, telleth the king of Yashar'el the words that you speak in your bedchamber.

verses.raw: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.
verses.text: And he said, Go and spy where he is, that I may send and fetch him. And it was told him, saying, Behold, he is in Dothan.

verses.raw: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.
verses.text: Therefore sent he thither horses, and chariots, and a great host: and they came by night, and compassed the city about.

verses.raw: And when the servant of the man of Elohim (God) was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?
verses.text: And when the servant of the man of Elohim was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do?

verses.raw: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.
verses.text: And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.

verses.raw: And Elisha prayed, and said, Yahuah (LORD), I pray you, open his eyes, that he may see. And Yahuah (LORD) opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.
verses.text: And Elisha prayed, and said, Yahuah, I pray you, open his eyes, that he may see. And Yahuah opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.

verses.raw: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), and said, Smite this people, I pray you, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.
verses.text: And when they came down to him, Elisha prayed unto Yahuah, and said, Smite this people, I pray you, with blindness. And he smote them with blindness according to the word of Elisha.

verses.raw: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek. But he led them to Samaria.
verses.text: And Elisha said unto them, This is not the way, neither is this the city: follow me, and I will bring you to the man whom you seek. But he led them to Samaria.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, Yahuah (LORD), open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And Yahuah (LORD) opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they were come into Samaria, that Elisha said, Yahuah, open the eyes of these men, that they may see. And Yahuah opened their eyes, and they saw; and, behold, they were in the midst of Samaria.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el said unto Elisha, when he saw them, My father, shall I smite them? shall I smite them?

verses.raw: And he answered, You shall not smite them: would you smite those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.
verses.text: And he answered, You shall not smite them: would you smite those whom you have taken captive with your sword and with your bow? set bread and water before them, that they may eat and drink, and go to their master.

verses.raw: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he prepared great provision for them: and when they had eaten and drunk, he sent them away, and they went to their master. So the bands of Syria came no more into the land of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that Ben-hadad king of Syria gathered all his host, and went up, and besieged Samaria.

verses.raw: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass’s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.
verses.text: And there was a great famine in Samaria: and, behold, they besieged it, until an ass’s head was sold for fourscore pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a cab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

verses.raw: And as the king of Yashar'el (Israel) was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.
verses.text: And as the king of Yashar'el was passing by upon the wall, there cried a woman unto him, saying, Help, my lord, O king.

verses.raw: And he said, If Yahuah (LORD) do not help you, whence shall I help you? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?
verses.text: And he said, If Yahuah do not help you, whence shall I help you? out of the barnfloor, or out of the winepress?

verses.raw: And the king said unto her, What aileth you? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give your son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.
verses.text: And the king said unto her, What aileth you? And she answered, This woman said unto me, Give your son, that we may eat him to day, and we will eat my son to morrow.

verses.raw: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give your son, that we may eat him: and she has hid her son.
verses.text: So we boiled my son, and did eat him: and I said unto her on the next day, Give your son, that we may eat him: and she has hid her son.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the woman, that he rent his clothes; and he passed by upon the wall, and the people looked, and, behold, he had sackcloth within upon his flesh.

verses.raw: Then he said, Elohim (God) do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.
verses.text: Then he said, Elohim do so and more also to me, if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat shall stand on him this day.

verses.raw: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See you how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? look, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?
verses.text: But Elisha sat in his house, and the elders sat with him; and the king sent a man from before him: but ere the messenger came to him, he said to the elders, See you how this son of a murderer has sent to take away my head? look, when the messenger comes, shut the door, and hold him fast at the door: is not the sound of his master’s feet behind him?

verses.raw: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of Yahuah (LORD); what should I wait for Yahuah (LORD) any longer?
verses.text: And while he yet talked with them, behold, the messenger came down unto him: and he said, Behold, this evil is of Yahuah; what should I wait for Yahuah any longer?

verses.raw: Then Elisha said, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD); Thus says Yahuah (LORD), To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.
verses.text: Then Elisha said, Hear you the word of Yahuah; Thus says Yahuah, To morrow about this time shall a measure of fine flour be sold for a shekel, and two measures of barley for a shekel, in the gate of Samaria.

verses.raw: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of Elohim (God), and said, Behold, if Yahuah (LORD) would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, you shall see it with your eyes, but shall not eat thereof.
verses.text: Then a lord on whose hand the king leaned answered the man of Elohim, and said, Behold, if Yahuah would make windows in heaven, might this thing be? And he said, Behold, you shall see it with your eyes, but shall not eat thereof.

verses.raw: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?
verses.text: And there were four leprous men at the entering in of the gate: and they said one to another, Why sit we here until we die?

verses.raw: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.
verses.text: If we say, We will enter into the city, then the famine is in the city, and we shall die there: and if we sit still here, we die also. Now therefore come, and let us fall unto the host of the Syrians: if they save us alive, we shall live; and if they kill us, we shall but die.

verses.raw: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.
verses.text: And they rose up in the twilight, to go unto the camp of the Syrians: and when they were come to the uttermost part of the camp of Syria, behold, there was no man there.

verses.raw: For Adonai (Lord) had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Yashar'el (Israel) has hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.
verses.text: For Adonai had made the host of the Syrians to hear a noise of chariots, and a noise of horses, even the noise of a great host: and they said one to another, Lo, the king of Yashar'el has hired against us the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of the Egyptians, to come upon us.

verses.raw: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.
verses.text: Wherefore they arose and fled in the twilight, and left their tents, and their horses, and their asses, even the camp as it was, and fled for their life.

verses.raw: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.
verses.text: And when these lepers came to the uttermost part of the camp, they went into one tent, and did eat and drink, and carried thence silver, and gold, and raiment, and went and hid it; and came again, and entered into another tent, and carried thence also, and went and hid it.

verses.raw: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king’s household.
verses.text: Then they said one to another, We do not well: this day is a day of good tidings, and we hold our peace: if we tarry till the morning light, some mischief will come upon us: now therefore come, that we may go and tell the king’s household.

verses.raw: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.
verses.text: So they came and called unto the porter of the city: and they told them, saying, We came to the camp of the Syrians, and, behold, there was no man there, neither voice of man, but horses tied, and asses tied, and the tents as they were.

verses.raw: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king’s house within.
verses.text: And he called the porters; and they told it to the king’s house within.

verses.raw: And the king arose in the night, and said unto his servants, I will now shew you what the Syrians have done to us. They know that we be hungry; therefore are they gone out of the camp to hide themselves in the field, saying, When they come out of the city, we shall catch them alive, and get into the city.
