verses.raw: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Yahudah (Judah); and he reigned a full month in Samaria.
verses.text: Shallum the son of Jabesh began to reign in the nine and thirtieth year of Uzziah king of Yahudah; and he reigned a full month in Samaria.

verses.raw: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.text: For Menahem the son of Gadi went up from Tirzah, and came to Samaria, and smote Shallum the son of Jabesh in Samaria, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Shallum, and his conspiracy which he made, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.
verses.text: Then Menahem smote Tiphsah, and all that were therein, and the coasts thereof from Tirzah: because they opened not to him, therefore he smote it; and all the women therein that were with child he ripped up.

verses.raw: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Yahudah (Judah) began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Yashar'el (Israel), and reigned ten years in Samaria.
verses.text: In the nine and thirtieth year of Azariah king of Yahudah began Menahem the son of Gadi to reign over Yashar'el, and reigned ten years in Samaria.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah: he departed not all his days from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.
verses.text: And Pul the king of Assyria came against the land: and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver, that his hand might be with him to confirm the kingdom in his hand.

verses.raw: And Menahem exacted the money of Yashar'el (Israel), even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.
verses.text: And Menahem exacted the money of Yashar'el, even of all the mighty men of wealth, of each man fifty shekels of silver, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria turned back, and stayed not there in the land.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Menahem slept with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Yahudah (Judah) Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria, and reigned two years.
verses.text: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Yahudah Pekahiah the son of Menahem began to reign over Yashar'el in Samaria, and reigned two years.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.
verses.text: But Pekah the son of Remaliah, a captain of his, conspired against him, and smote him in Samaria, in the palace of the king’s house, with Argob and Arieh, and with him fifty men of the Gileadites: and he killed him, and reigned in his room.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Yahudah (Judah) Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Yashar'el (Israel) in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.
verses.text: In the two and fiftieth year of Azariah king of Yahudah Pekah the son of Remaliah began to reign over Yashar'el in Samaria, and reigned twenty years.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el (Israel) to sin.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah: he departed not from the sins of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who made Yashar'el to sin.

verses.raw: In the days of Pekah king of Yashar'el (Israel) came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.
verses.text: In the days of Pekah king of Yashar'el came Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and took Ijon, and Abel-beth-maachah, and Janoah, and Kedesh, and Hazor, and Gilead, and Galilee, all the land of Naphtali, and carried them captive to Assyria.

verses.raw: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.
verses.text: And Hoshea the son of Elah made a conspiracy against Pekah the son of Remaliah, and smote him, and slew him, and reigned in his stead, in the twentieth year of Jotham the son of Uzziah.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all that he did, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Yashar'el (Israel) began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Yahudah (Judah) to reign.
verses.text: In the second year of Pekah the son of Remaliah king of Yashar'el began Jotham the son of Uzziah king of Yahudah to reign.

verses.raw: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.text: Five and twenty years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD): he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah: he did according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

verses.raw: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Howbeit the high places were not removed: the people sacrificed and burned incense still in the high places. He built the higher gate of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: In those days Yahuah (LORD) began to send against Yahudah (Judah) Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.
verses.text: In those days Yahuah began to send against Yahudah Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah.

verses.raw: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Yahudah (Judah) began to reign.
verses.text: In the seventeenth year of Pekah the son of Remaliah Ahaz the son of Jotham king of Yahudah began to reign.

verses.raw: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), like David his father.
verses.text: Twenty years old was Ahaz when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem, and did not that which was right in the sight of Yahuah Elohav, like David his father.

verses.raw: But he walked in the way of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel), yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom Yahuah (LORD) cast out from before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But he walked in the way of the kings of Yashar'el, yea, and made his son to pass through the fire, according to the abominations of the heathen, whom Yahuah cast out from before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.text: And he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.raw: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Yashar'el (Israel) came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.
verses.text: Then Rezin king of Syria and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Yashar'el came up to Jerusalem to war: and they besieged Ahaz, but could not overcome him.

verses.raw: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Yahudim (Jews) from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.text: At that time Rezin king of Syria recovered Elath to Syria, and drave the Yahudim from Elath: and the Syrians came to Elath, and dwelt there unto this day.

verses.raw: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am your servant and your son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Yashar'el (Israel), which rise up against me.
verses.text: So Ahaz sent messengers to Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, saying, I am your servant and your son: come up, and save me out of the hand of the king of Syria, and out of the hand of the king of Yashar'el, which rise up against me.

verses.raw: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.
verses.text: And Ahaz took the silver and gold that was found in the house of Yahuah, and in the treasures of the king’s house, and sent it for a present to the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.
verses.text: And the king of Assyria hearkened unto him: for the king of Assyria went up against Damascus, and took it, and carried the people of it captive to Kir, and slew Rezin.

verses.raw: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.
verses.text: And king Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria, and saw an altar that was at Damascus: and king Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest the fashion of the altar, and the pattern of it, according to all the workmanship thereof.

verses.raw: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
verses.text: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.

verses.raw: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.
verses.text: And when the king was come from Damascus, the king saw the altar: and the king approached to the altar, and offered thereon.

verses.raw: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.
verses.text: And he burnt his burnt offering and his meat offering, and poured his drink offering, and sprinkled the blood of his peace offerings, upon the altar.

verses.raw: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before Yahuah (LORD), from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of Yahuah (LORD), and put it on the north side of the altar.
verses.text: And he brought also the brasen altar, which was before Yahuah, from the forefront of the house, from between the altar and the house of Yahuah, and put it on the north side of the altar.

verses.raw: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by.
verses.text: And king Ahaz commanded Urijah the priest, saying, Upon the great altar burn the morning burnt offering, and the evening meat offering, and the king’s burnt sacrifice, and his meat offering, with the burnt offering of all the people of the land, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings; and sprinkle upon it all the blood of the burnt offering, and all the blood of the sacrifice: and the brasen altar shall be for me to enquire by.

verses.raw: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.
verses.text: Thus did Urijah the priest, according to all that king Ahaz commanded.

verses.raw: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.
verses.text: And king Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, and removed the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off the brasen oxen that were under it, and put it upon a pavement of stones.

verses.raw: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of Yahuah (LORD) for the king of Assyria.
verses.text: And the covert for the sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry without, turned he from the house of Yahuah for the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaz which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David: and Hezekiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Yahudah (Judah) began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Yashar'el (Israel) nine years.
verses.text: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Yahudah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Yashar'el nine years.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), but not as the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) that were before him.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, but not as the kings of Yashar'el that were before him.

verses.raw: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
verses.text: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.

verses.raw: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.text: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.

verses.raw: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.text: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.

verses.raw: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Yashar'el (Israel) away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.text: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Yashar'el away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.

verses.raw: For so it was, that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) had sinned against Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
verses.text: For so it was, that the children of Yashar'el had sinned against Yahuah their Elohim, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,

verses.raw: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom Yahuah (LORD) cast out from before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel), which they had made.
verses.text: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom Yahuah cast out from before the children of Yashar'el, and of the kings of Yashar'el, which they had made.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did secretly those things that were not right against Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did secretly those things that were not right against Yahuah their Elohim, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

verses.raw: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
verses.text: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:

verses.raw: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom Yahuah (LORD) carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke Yahuah (LORD) to anger:
verses.text: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom Yahuah carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke Yahuah to anger:

verses.raw: For they served idols, whereof Yahuah (LORD) had said unto them, You shall not do this thing.
verses.text: For they served idols, whereof Yahuah had said unto them, You shall not do this thing.

verses.raw: Yet Yahuah (LORD) testified against Yashar'el (Israel), and against Yahudah (Judah), by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn you from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
verses.text: Yet Yahuah testified against Yashar'el, and against Yahudah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn you from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in Yahuah their Elohim.

verses.raw: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom Yahuah (LORD) had charged them, that they should not do like them.
verses.text: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom Yahuah had charged them, that they should not do like them.

verses.raw: And they left all the commandments of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
verses.text: And they left all the commandments of Yahuah their Elohim, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.

verses.raw: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), to provoke him to anger.
verses.text: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of Yahuah, to provoke him to anger.

verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (LORD) was very angry with Yashar'el (Israel), and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) only.
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah was very angry with Yashar'el, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Yahudah only.

verses.raw: Also Yahudah (Judah) kept not the commandments of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), but walked in the statutes of Yashar'el (Israel) which they made.
verses.text: Also Yahudah kept not the commandments of Yahuah their Elohim, but walked in the statutes of Yashar'el which they made.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) rejected all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel), and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
verses.text: And Yahuah rejected all the seed of Yashar'el, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.

verses.raw: For he rent Yashar'el (Israel) from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Yashar'el (Israel) from following Yahuah (LORD), and made them sin a great sin.
verses.text: For he rent Yashar'el from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Yashar'el from following Yahuah, and made them sin a great sin.

verses.raw: For the children of Yashar'el (Israel) walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
verses.text: For the children of Yashar'el walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;

verses.raw: Until Yahuah (LORD) removed Yashar'el (Israel) out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Yashar'el (Israel) carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
verses.text: Until Yahuah removed Yashar'el out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Yashar'el carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.

verses.raw: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
verses.text: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Yashar'el: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.

verses.raw: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not Yahuah (LORD): therefore Yahuah (LORD) sent lions among them, which slew some of them.
verses.text: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not Yahuah: therefore Yahuah sent lions among them, which slew some of them.

verses.raw: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which you have removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the Elohim (God) of the land: therefore he has sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the Elohim (God) of the land.
verses.text: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which you have removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the Elohim of the land: therefore he has sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the Elohim of the land.

verses.raw: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom you brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the Elohim (God) of the land.
verses.text: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom you brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the Elohim of the land.

verses.raw: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth-el, and taught them how they should fear Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Beth-el, and taught them how they should fear Yahuah.

verses.raw: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
verses.text: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.

verses.raw: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.text: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

verses.raw: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.text: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

verses.raw: So they feared Yahuah (LORD), and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
verses.text: So they feared Yahuah, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.

verses.raw: They feared Yahuah (LORD), and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
verses.text: They feared Yahuah, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.

verses.raw: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not Yahuah (LORD), neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which Yahuah (LORD) commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not Yahuah, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which Yahuah commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Yashar'el;

verses.raw: With whom Yahuah (LORD) had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
verses.text: With whom Yahuah had made a covenant, and charged them, saying, You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD), who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall you fear, and him shall you worship, and to him shall you do sacrifice.
verses.text: But Yahuah, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall you fear, and him shall you worship, and to him shall you do sacrifice.

verses.raw: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do for evermore; and you shall not fear other gods.
verses.text: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do for evermore; and you shall not fear other gods.

verses.raw: And the covenant that I have made with you you shall not forget; neither shall you fear other gods.
verses.text: And the covenant that I have made with you you shall not forget; neither shall you fear other gods.

verses.raw: But Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) you shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
verses.text: But Yahuah Elohaychem you shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.

verses.raw: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
verses.text: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.

verses.raw: So these nations feared Yahuah (LORD), and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
verses.text: So these nations feared Yahuah, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Yashar'el (Israel), that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Yahudah (Judah) began to reign.
verses.text: Now it came to pass in the third year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Yashar'el, that Hezekiah the son of Ahaz king of Yahudah began to reign.

verses.raw: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.
verses.text: Twenty and five years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Abi, the daughter of Zachariah.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that David his father did.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that David his father did.

verses.raw: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.
verses.text: He removed the high places, and brake the images, and cut down the groves, and brake in pieces the brasen serpent that Moses had made: for unto those days the children of Yashar'el did burn incense to it: and he called it Nehushtan.

verses.raw: He trusted in Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel); so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Yahudah (Judah), nor any that were before him.
verses.text: He trusted in Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el; so that after him was none like him among all the kings of Yahudah, nor any that were before him.

verses.raw: For he clave to Yahuah (LORD), and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which Yahuah (LORD) commanded Moses.
verses.text: For he clave to Yahuah, and departed not from following him, but kept his commandments, which Yahuah commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.
verses.text: And Yahuah was with him; and he prospered whithersoever he went forth: and he rebelled against the king of Assyria, and served him not.

verses.raw: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.text: He smote the Philistines, even unto Gaza, and the borders thereof, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Yashar'el (Israel), that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Yashar'el, that Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against Samaria, and besieged it.

verses.raw: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Yashar'el (Israel), Samaria was taken.
verses.text: And at the end of three years they took it: even in the sixth year of Hezekiah, that is the ninth year of Hoshea king of Yashar'el, Samaria was taken.

verses.raw: And the king of Assyria did carry away Yashar'el (Israel) unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:
verses.text: And the king of Assyria did carry away Yashar'el unto Assyria, and put them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes:

verses.raw: Because they obeyed not the voice of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.
verses.text: Because they obeyed not the voice of Yahuah their Elohim, but transgressed his covenant, and all that Moses the servant of Yahuah commanded, and would not hear them, nor do them.

verses.raw: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Yahudah (Judah), and took them.
verses.text: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah did Sennacherib king of Assyria come up against all the fenced cities of Yahudah, and took them.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which you put on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
verses.text: And Hezekiah king of Yahudah sent to the king of Assyria to Lachish, saying, I have offended; return from me: that which you put on me will I bear. And the king of Assyria appointed unto Hezekiah king of Yahudah three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in the treasures of the king’s house.
verses.text: And Hezekiah gave him all the silver that was found in the house of Yahuah, and in the treasures of the king’s house.

verses.raw: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of Yahuah (LORD), and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.
verses.text: At that time did Hezekiah cut off the gold from the doors of the temple of Yahuah, and from the pillars which Hezekiah king of Yahudah had overlaid, and gave it to the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.
verses.text: And the king of Assyria sent Tartan and Rabsaris and Rab-shakeh from Lachish to king Hezekiah with a great host against Jerusalem. And they went up and came to Jerusalem. And when they were come up, they came and stood by the conduit of the upper pool, which is in the highway of the fuller’s field.

verses.raw: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.
verses.text: And when they had called to the king, there came out to them Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder.

verses.raw: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak you now to Hezekiah, Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein you trust?
verses.text: And Rab-shakeh said unto them, Speak you now to Hezekiah, Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein you trust?

verses.raw: You say, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom do you trust, that you rebellest against me?
verses.text: You say, (but they are but vain words,) I have counsel and strength for the war. Now on whom do you trust, that you rebellest against me?

verses.raw: Now, behold, you trust upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.
verses.text: Now, behold, you trust upon the staff of this bruised reed, even upon Egypt, on which if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt unto all that trust on him.

verses.raw: But if you say unto me, We trust in Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?
verses.text: But if you say unto me, We trust in Yahuah Eloheinu: is not that he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah has taken away, and has said to Yahudah and Jerusalem, You shall worship before this altar in Jerusalem?

verses.raw: Now therefore, I pray you, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver you two thousand horses, if you be able on your part to set riders upon them.
verses.text: Now therefore, I pray you, give pledges to my lord the king of Assyria, and I will deliver you two thousand horses, if you be able on your part to set riders upon them.

verses.raw: How then will you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.text: How then will you turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put your trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?

verses.raw: Am I now come up without Yahuah (LORD) against this place to destroy it? Yahuah (LORD) said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.text: Am I now come up without Yahuah against this place to destroy it? Yahuah said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.

verses.raw: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray you, to your servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.text: Then said Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna, and Joah, unto Rab-shakeh, Speak, I pray you, to your servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and talk not with us in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language in the ears of the people that are on the wall.

verses.raw: But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Has my master sent me to your master, and to you, to speak these words? has he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.text: But Rab-shakeh said unto them, Has my master sent me to your master, and to you, to speak these words? has he not sent me to the men which sit on the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?

verses.raw: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:
verses.text: Then Rab-shakeh stood and cried with a loud voice in the Yahudim's (Jews’) language, and spake, saying, Hear the word of the great king, the king of Assyria:

verses.raw: Thus says the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:
verses.text: Thus says the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you out of his hand:

verses.raw: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahuah (LORD), saying, Yahuah (LORD) will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.text: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in Yahuah, saying, Yahuah will surely deliver us, and this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus says the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat you every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink you every one the waters of his cistern:
verses.text: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus says the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me, and then eat you every man of his own vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink you every one the waters of his cistern:

verses.raw: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that you may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, Yahuah (LORD) will deliver us.
verses.text: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards, a land of oil olive and of honey, that you may live, and not die: and hearken not unto Hezekiah, when he persuadeth you, saying, Yahuah will deliver us.

verses.raw: Has any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.text: Has any of the gods of the nations delivered at all his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

verses.raw: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.text: Where are the gods of Hamath, and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah? have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?

verses.raw: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahuah (LORD) should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.text: Who are they among all the gods of the countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahuah should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?

verses.raw: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.text: But the people held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.

verses.raw: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.
verses.text: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rab-shakeh.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.text: And he sent Eliakim, which was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.

verses.raw: And they said unto him, Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.text: And they said unto him, Thus says Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

verses.raw: It may be Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to reproach the living Elohim (God); and will reprove the words which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has heard: wherefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that are left.
verses.text: It may be Yahuah Elohayka will hear all the words of Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master has sent to reproach the living Elohim; and will reprove the words which Yahuah Elohayka has heard: wherefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that are left.

verses.raw: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.text: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

verses.raw: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall you say to your master, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Be not afraid of the words which you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.text: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall you say to your master, Thus says Yahuah, Be not afraid of the words which you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.

verses.raw: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.text: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.

verses.raw: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.text: So Rab-shakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

verses.raw: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against you: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,
verses.text: And when he heard say of Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, Behold, he is come out to fight against you: he sent messengers again unto Hezekiah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying, Let not your Elohim (God) in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.text: Thus shall you speak to Hezekiah king of Yahudah, saying, Let not your Elohim in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Jerusalem shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shall you be delivered?
verses.text: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shall you be delivered?

verses.raw: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?
verses.text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed; as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Thelasar?

verses.raw: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?
verses.text: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivah?

verses.raw: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of Yahuah (LORD), and spread it before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of Yahuah, and spread it before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah prayed before Yahuah (LORD), and said, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which dwell between the cherubims, you are the Elohim (God), even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made heaven and earth.
verses.text: And Hezekiah prayed before Yahuah, and said, O Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, which dwell between the cherubims, you are the Elohim, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made heaven and earth.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), bow down your ear, and hear: open, Yahuah (LORD), your eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which has sent him to reproach the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yahuah, bow down your ear, and hear: open, Yahuah, your eyes, and see: and hear the words of Sennacherib, which has sent him to reproach the living Elohim.

verses.raw: Of a truth, Yahuah (LORD), the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,
verses.text: Of a truth, Yahuah, the kings of Assyria have destroyed the nations and their lands,

verses.raw: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.text: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God), I beseech you, save you us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), even you only.
verses.text: Now therefore, O Yahuah our Elohim, I beseech you, save you us out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you are Yahuah Elohim, even you only.

verses.raw: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), That which you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.
verses.text: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, That which you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria I have heard.

verses.raw: This is the word that Yahuah (LORD) has spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion has despised you, and laughed you to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.
verses.text: This is the word that Yahuah has spoken concerning him; The virgin the daughter of Zion has despised you, and laughed you to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem has shaken her head at you.

verses.raw: Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? and against whom have you exalted your voice, and lifted up your eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? and against whom have you exalted your voice, and lifted up your eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: By your messengers you have reproached Adonai (Lord), and have said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.
verses.text: By your messengers you have reproached Adonai, and have said, With the multitude of my chariots I am come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon, and will cut down the tall cedar trees thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the lodgings of his borders, and into the forest of his Carmel.

verses.raw: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.
verses.text: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.

verses.raw: Have you not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that you should be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.
verses.text: Have you not heard long ago how I have done it, and of ancient times that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that you should be to lay waste fenced cities into ruinous heaps.

verses.raw: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
verses.text: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.

verses.raw: But I know your abode, and your going out, and your coming in, and your rage against me.
verses.text: But I know your abode, and your going out, and your coming in, and your rage against me.

verses.raw: Because your rage against me and your tumult is come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
verses.text: Because your rage against me and your tumult is come up into my ears, therefore I will put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.

verses.raw: And this shall be a sign unto you, You shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow you, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.
verses.text: And this shall be a sign unto you, You shall eat this year such things as grow of themselves, and in the second year that which springeth of the same; and in the third year sow you, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruits thereof.

verses.raw: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Yahudah (Judah) shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
verses.text: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Yahudah shall yet again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.

verses.raw: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) shall do this.
verses.text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of Yahuah Tseva'ot shall do this.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shield, nor cast a bank against it.

verses.raw: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For I will defend this city, to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
verses.text: For I will defend this city, to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.raw: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of Yahuah (LORD) went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.text: And it came to pass that night, that the angel of Yahuah went out, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians an hundred fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.

verses.raw: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.text: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword: and they escaped into the land of Armenia. And Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Set your house in order; for you shall die, and not live.
verses.text: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz came to him, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah, Set your house in order; for you shall die, and not live.

verses.raw: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: Then he turned his face to the wall, and prayed unto Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: I beseech you, O Yahuah (LORD), remember now how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.text: I beseech you, O Yahuah, remember now how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in your sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to him, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass, afore Isaiah was gone out into the middle court, that the word of Yahuah came to him, saying,

verses.raw: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of David your father, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears: behold, I will heal you: on the third day you shall go up unto the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Turn again, and tell Hezekiah the captain of my people, Thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of David your father, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears: behold, I will heal you: on the third day you shall go up unto the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will add unto your days fifteen years; and I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
verses.text: And I will add unto your days fifteen years; and I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria; and I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.

verses.raw: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
verses.text: And Isaiah said, Take a lump of figs. And they took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that Yahuah (LORD) will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of Yahuah (LORD) the third day?
verses.text: And Hezekiah said unto Isaiah, What shall be the sign that Yahuah will heal me, and that I shall go up into the house of Yahuah the third day?

verses.raw: And Isaiah said, This sign shall you have of Yahuah (LORD), that Yahuah (LORD) will do the thing that he has spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?
verses.text: And Isaiah said, This sign shall you have of Yahuah, that Yahuah will do the thing that he has spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten degrees, or go back ten degrees?

verses.raw: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.
verses.text: And Hezekiah answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to go down ten degrees: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten degrees.

verses.raw: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto Yahuah (LORD): and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.
verses.text: And Isaiah the prophet cried unto Yahuah: and he brought the shadow ten degrees backward, by which it had gone down in the dial of Ahaz.

verses.raw: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.
verses.text: At that time Berodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present unto Hezekiah: for he had heard that Hezekiah had been sick.

verses.raw: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.text: And Hezekiah hearkened unto them, and shewed them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

verses.raw: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto you? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.
verses.text: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto you? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country, even from Babylon.

verses.raw: And he said, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.text: And he said, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah answered, All the things that are in my house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

verses.raw: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Isaiah said unto Hezekiah, Hear the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Behold, the days come, that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store unto this day, shall be carried into Babylon: nothing shall be left, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And of your sons that shall issue from you, which you shall beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.text: And of your sons that shall issue from you, which you shall beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.raw: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of Yahuah (LORD) which you have spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?
verses.text: Then said Hezekiah unto Isaiah, Good is the word of Yahuah which you have spoken. And he said, Is it not good, if peace and truth be in my days?

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and all his might, and how he made a pool, and a conduit, and brought water into the city, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers: and Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzi-bah.
verses.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Hephzi-bah.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), after the abominations of the heathen, whom Yahuah (LORD) cast out before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, after the abominations of the heathen, whom Yahuah cast out before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel); and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.
verses.text: For he built up again the high places which Hezekiah his father had destroyed; and he reared up altars for Baal, and made a grove, as did Ahab king of Yashar'el; and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

verses.raw: And he built altars in the house of Yahuah (LORD), of which Yahuah (LORD) said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
verses.text: And he built altars in the house of Yahuah, of which Yahuah said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.

verses.raw: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), to provoke him to anger.
verses.text: And he made his son pass through the fire, and observed times, and used enchantments, and dealt with familiar spirits and wizards: he wrought much wickedness in the sight of Yahuah, to provoke him to anger.

verses.raw: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which Yahuah (LORD) said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), will I put my name for ever:
verses.text: And he set a graven image of the grove that he had made in the house, of which Yahuah said to David, and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all tribes of Yashar'el, will I put my name for ever:

verses.raw: Neither will I make the feet of Yashar'el (Israel) move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.
verses.text: Neither will I make the feet of Yashar'el move any more out of the land which I gave their fathers; only if they will observe to do according to all that I have commanded them, and according to all the law that my servant Moses commanded them.

verses.raw: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom Yahuah (LORD) destroyed before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But they hearkened not: and Manasseh seduced them to do more evil than did the nations whom Yahuah destroyed before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake by his servants the prophets, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake by his servants the prophets, saying,

verses.raw: Because Manasseh king of Yahudah (Judah) has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and has made Yahudah (Judah) also to sin with his idols:
verses.text: Because Manasseh king of Yahudah has done these abominations, and has done wickedly above all that the Amorites did, which were before him, and has made Yahudah also to sin with his idols:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Yahudah (Judah), that whosoever hears of it, both his ears shall tingle.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, Behold, I am bringing such evil upon Jerusalem and Yahudah, that whosoever hears of it, both his ears shall tingle.

verses.raw: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.
verses.text: And I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of the house of Ahab: and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man wipeth a dish, wiping it, and turning it upside down.

verses.raw: And I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;
verses.text: And I will forsake the remnant of my inheritance, and deliver them into the hand of their enemies; and they shall become a prey and a spoil to all their enemies;

verses.raw: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.
verses.text: Because they have done that which was evil in my sight, and have provoked me to anger, since the day their fathers came forth out of Egypt, even unto this day.

verses.raw: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Yahudah (Judah) to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Moreover Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another; beside his sin wherewith he made Yahudah to sin, in doing that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all that he did, and his sin that he sinned, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Manasseh slept with his fathers, and was buried in the garden of his own house, in the garden of Uzza: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
verses.text: Amon was twenty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned two years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.

verses.raw: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), as his father Manasseh did.
verses.text: And he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahuah, as his father Manasseh did.

verses.raw: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:
verses.text: And he walked in all the way that his father walked in, and served the idols that his father served, and worshipped them:

verses.raw: And he forsook Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of his fathers, and walked not in the way of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he forsook Yahuah Elohim of his fathers, and walked not in the way of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
verses.text: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.

verses.raw: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.
verses.text: And the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah (Judah)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Amon which he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yahudah?

verses.raw: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And he was buried in his sepulchre in the garden of Uzza: and Josiah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.
verses.text: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned thirty and one years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jedidah, the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, and walked in all the way of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass in the eighteenth year of king Josiah, that the king sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of Yahuah (LORD), which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:
verses.text: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the silver which is brought into the house of Yahuah, which the keepers of the door have gathered of the people:

verses.raw: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of Yahuah (LORD): and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of Yahuah (LORD), to repair the breaches of the house,
verses.text: And let them deliver it into the hand of the doers of the work, that have the oversight of the house of Yahuah: and let them give it to the doers of the work which is in the house of Yahuah, to repair the breaches of the house,

verses.raw: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
verses.text: Unto carpenters, and builders, and masons, and to buy timber and hewn stone to repair the house.

verses.raw: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.
verses.text: Howbeit there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand, because they dealt faithfully.

verses.raw: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of Yahuah (LORD). And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.
verses.text: And Hilkiah the high priest said unto Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of Yahuah. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

verses.raw: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Your servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Your servants have gathered the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of them that do the work, that have the oversight of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.
verses.text: And Shaphan the scribe shewed the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he rent his clothes.

verses.raw: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,
verses.text: And the king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Michaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asahiah a servant of the king’s, saying,

verses.raw: Go you, enquire of Yahuah (LORD) for me, and for the people, and for all Yahudah (Judah), concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.
verses.text: Go you, enquire of Yahuah for me, and for the people, and for all Yahudah, concerning the words of this book that is found: for great is the wrath of Yahuah that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not hearkened unto the words of this book, to do according unto all that which is written concerning us.

verses.raw: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
verses.text: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asahiah, went unto Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college;) and they communed with her.
