verses.text: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.

verses.raw: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.text: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.

verses.raw: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
verses.text: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.

verses.raw: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Yahudah (Judah) to the hold unto David.
verses.text: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Yahudah to the hold unto David.

verses.raw: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If you be come peaceably unto me to help me, my heart shall be knit unto you: but if you be come to betray me to my enemies, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, the Elohim (God) of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
verses.text: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If you be come peaceably unto me to help me, my heart shall be knit unto you: but if you be come to betray me to my enemies, seeing there is no wrong in my hands, the Elohim of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.

verses.raw: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Yours are we, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto you, and peace be to your helpers; for your Elohim (God) helps you. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.text: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Yours are we, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto you, and peace be to your helpers; for your Elohim helps you. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.

verses.raw: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
verses.text: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.

verses.raw: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
verses.text: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.

verses.raw: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
verses.text: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.

verses.raw: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of Elohim.

verses.raw: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: The children of Yahudah (Judah) that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
verses.text: The children of Yahudah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.

verses.raw: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.text: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.

verses.raw: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.text: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.

verses.raw: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
verses.text: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;

verses.raw: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.
verses.text: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.

verses.raw: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
verses.text: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.

verses.raw: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
verses.text: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.

verses.raw: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
verses.text: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.

verses.raw: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Yashar'el (Israel) ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verses.text: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Yashar'el ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.

verses.raw: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
verses.text: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.

verses.raw: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.text: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.

verses.raw: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.text: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.

verses.raw: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
verses.text: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.

verses.raw: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.text: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.

verses.raw: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Yashar'el (Israel): and all the rest also of Yashar'el (Israel) were of one heart to make David king.
verses.text: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Yashar'el: and all the rest also of Yashar'el were of one heart to make David king.

verses.raw: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.text: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

verses.raw: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.text: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

verses.raw: And David said unto all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), If it seem good unto you, and that it be of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Yashar'el (Israel), and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
verses.text: And David said unto all the congregation of Yashar'el, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of Yahuah Eloheinu, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Yashar'el, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:

verses.raw: And let us bring again the ark of our Elohim (God) to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.
verses.text: And let us bring again the ark of our Elohim to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

verses.raw: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.text: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

verses.raw: So David gathered all Yashar'el (Israel) together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of Elohim (God) from Kirjath-jearim.
verses.text: So David gathered all Yashar'el together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of Elohim from Kirjath-jearim.

verses.raw: And David went up, and all Yashar'el (Israel), to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Yahudah (Judah), to bring up thence the ark of Elohim (God) Yahuah (LORD), that dwells between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
verses.text: And David went up, and all Yashar'el, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Yahudah, to bring up thence the ark of Elohim Yahuah, that dwells between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.

verses.raw: And they carried the ark of Elohim (God) in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
verses.text: And they carried the ark of Elohim in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

verses.raw: And David and all Yashar'el (Israel) played before Elohim (God) with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.text: And David and all Yashar'el played before Elohim with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

verses.raw: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.text: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

verses.raw: And the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the anger of Yahuah was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before Elohim.

verses.raw: And David was displeased, because Yahuah (LORD) had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
verses.text: And David was displeased, because Yahuah had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

verses.raw: And David was afraid of Elohim (God) that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of Elohim (God) home to me?
verses.text: And David was afraid of Elohim that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of Elohim home to me?

verses.raw: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.text: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.raw: And the ark of Elohim (God) remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And Yahuah (LORD) blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.
verses.text: And the ark of Elohim remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And Yahuah blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.

verses.raw: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
verses.text: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

verses.raw: And David perceived that Yahuah (LORD) had confirmed him king over Yashar'el (Israel), for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And David perceived that Yahuah had confirmed him king over Yashar'el, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
verses.text: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.

verses.raw: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.text: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,

verses.raw: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.text: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,

verses.raw: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.text: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.raw: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.text: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

verses.raw: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Yashar'el (Israel), all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.text: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Yashar'el, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.

verses.raw: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.text: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.raw: And David enquired of Elohim (God), saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and will you deliver them into my hand? And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.
verses.text: And David enquired of Elohim, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and will you deliver them into my hand? And Yahuah said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.

verses.raw: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, Elohim (God) has broken in upon my enemies by my hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.text: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, Elohim has broken in upon my enemies by my hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.

verses.raw: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.text: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.

verses.raw: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.text: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.

verses.raw: Therefore David enquired again of Elohim (God); and Elohim (God) said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.text: Therefore David enquired again of Elohim; and Elohim said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

verses.raw: And it shall be, when you shall hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then you shall go out to battle: for Elohim (God) is gone forth before you to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.text: And it shall be, when you shall hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then you shall go out to battle: for Elohim is gone forth before you to smite the host of the Philistines.

verses.raw: David therefore did as Elohim (God) commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
verses.text: David therefore did as Elohim commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.

verses.raw: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahuah (LORD) brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.text: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and Yahuah brought the fear of him upon all nations.

verses.raw: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of Elohim (God), and pitched for it a tent.
verses.text: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of Elohim, and pitched for it a tent.

verses.raw: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of Elohim (God) but the Levites: for them has Yahuah (LORD) chosen to carry the ark of Elohim (God), and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.text: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of Elohim but the Levites: for them has Yahuah chosen to carry the ark of Elohim, and to minister unto him for ever.

verses.raw: And David gathered all Yashar'el (Israel) together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahuah (LORD) unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.text: And David gathered all Yashar'el together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of Yahuah unto his place, which he had prepared for it.

verses.raw: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.text: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
verses.text: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.text: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.text: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.text: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.text: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.text: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.

verses.raw: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.text: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,

verses.raw: And said unto them, You are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both you and your brethren, that you may bring up the ark of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) unto the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.text: And said unto them, You are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both you and your brethren, that you may bring up the ark of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el unto the place that I have prepared for it.

verses.raw: For because you did it not at the first, Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.text: For because you did it not at the first, Yahuah Eloheinu made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.

verses.raw: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of Elohim (God) upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of Elohim upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.text: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.

verses.raw: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.text: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

verses.raw: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.text: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.

verses.raw: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.text: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;

verses.raw: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.text: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;

verses.raw: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
verses.text: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.

verses.raw: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
verses.text: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.

verses.raw: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.text: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

verses.raw: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of Elohim (God): and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.text: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of Elohim: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

verses.raw: So David, and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.text: So David, and the elders of Yashar'el, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Elohim (God) helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Elohim helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of Yahuah, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

verses.raw: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.text: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.

verses.raw: Thus all Yashar'el (Israel) brought up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.text: Thus all Yashar'el brought up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of Yahuah came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.

verses.raw: So they brought the ark of Elohim (God), and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before Elohim (God).
verses.text: So they brought the ark of Elohim, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before Elohim.

verses.raw: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he dealt to every one of Yashar'el (Israel), both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
verses.text: And he dealt to every one of Yashar'el, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.

verses.raw: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of Yahuah (LORD), and to record, and to thank and praise Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of Yahuah, and to record, and to thank and praise Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
verses.text: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;

verses.raw: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank Yahuah (LORD) into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.text: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank Yahuah into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.

verses.raw: Give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD), call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verses.text: Give thanks unto Yahuah, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

verses.raw: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk you of all his wondrous works.
verses.text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk you of all his wondrous works.

verses.raw: Glory you in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Glory you in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek Yahuah.

verses.raw: Seek Yahuah (LORD) and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.text: Seek Yahuah and his strength, seek his face continually.

verses.raw: Remember his marvellous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.text: Remember his marvellous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.raw: O you seed of Yashar'el (Israel) his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.text: O you seed of Yashar'el his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

verses.raw: He is Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God); his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.text: He is Yahuah Eloheinu; his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.raw: Be you mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.text: Be you mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;

verses.raw: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
verses.text: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;

verses.raw: And has confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Yashar'el (Israel) for an everlasting covenant,
verses.text: And has confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Yashar'el for an everlasting covenant,

verses.raw: Saying, Unto you will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
verses.text: Saying, Unto you will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

verses.raw: When you were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
verses.text: When you were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.

verses.raw: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
verses.text: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;

verses.raw: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,

verses.raw: Saying, Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.text: Saying, Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.raw: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD), all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.text: Sing unto Yahuah, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.

verses.raw: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
verses.text: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.

verses.raw: For great is Yahuah (LORD), and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.text: For great is Yahuah, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.

verses.raw: For all the gods of the people are idols: but Yahuah (LORD) made the heavens.
verses.text: For all the gods of the people are idols: but Yahuah made the heavens.

verses.raw: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.text: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.

verses.raw: Give unto Yahuah (LORD), you kindreds of the people, give unto Yahuah (LORD) glory and strength.
verses.text: Give unto Yahuah, you kindreds of the people, give unto Yahuah glory and strength.

verses.raw: Give unto Yahuah (LORD) the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship Yahuah (LORD) in the beauty of holiness.
verses.text: Give unto Yahuah the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship Yahuah in the beauty of holiness.

verses.raw: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
verses.text: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.

verses.raw: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, Yahuah (LORD) reigns.
verses.text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, Yahuah reigns.

verses.raw: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
verses.text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.

verses.raw: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of Yahuah (LORD), because he comes to judge the earth.
verses.text: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of Yahuah, because he comes to judge the earth.

verses.raw: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good; for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks unto Yahuah; for he is good; for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: And say you, Save us, O Elohim (God) of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to your holy name, and glory in your praise.
verses.text: And say you, Save us, O Elohim of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to your holy name, and glory in your praise.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised Yahuah.

verses.raw: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:
verses.text: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of Yahuah Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:

verses.raw: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
verses.text: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:

verses.raw: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD) in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.text: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of Yahuah in the high place that was at Gibeon,

verses.raw: To offer burnt offerings unto Yahuah (LORD) upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of Yahuah (LORD), which he commanded Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: To offer burnt offerings unto Yahuah upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of Yahuah, which he commanded Yashar'el;

verses.raw: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to Yahuah (LORD), because his mercy endures for ever;
verses.text: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to Yahuah, because his mercy endures for ever;

verses.raw: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of Elohim (God). And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
verses.text: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of Elohim. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.

verses.raw: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.text: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) remains under curtains.
verses.text: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of Yahuah remains under curtains.

verses.raw: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in your heart; for Elohim (God) is with you.
verses.text: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in your heart; for Elohim is with you.

verses.raw: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of Elohim (God) came to Nathan, saying,
verses.text: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of Elohim came to Nathan, saying,

verses.raw: Go and tell David my servant, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), You shall not build me an house to dwell in:
verses.text: Go and tell David my servant, Thus says Yahuah, You shall not build me an house to dwell in:

verses.raw: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Yashar'el (Israel) unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
verses.text: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Yashar'el unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.

verses.raw: Wheresoever I have walked with all Yashar'el (Israel), spake I a word to any of the judges of Yashar'el (Israel), whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have you not built me an house of cedars?
verses.text: Wheresoever I have walked with all Yashar'el, spake I a word to any of the judges of Yashar'el, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have you not built me an house of cedars?

verses.raw: Now therefore thus shall you say unto my servant David, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), I took you from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that you should be ruler over my people Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Now therefore thus shall you say unto my servant David, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, I took you from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that you should be ruler over my people Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And I have been with you whithersoever you have walked, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.text: And I have been with you whithersoever you have walked, and have cut off all your enemies from before you, and have made you a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.

verses.raw: Also I will ordain a place for my people Yashar'el (Israel), and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
verses.text: Also I will ordain a place for my people Yashar'el, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,

verses.raw: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Yashar'el (Israel). Moreover I will subdue all your enemies. Furthermore I tell you that Yahuah (LORD) will build you an house.
verses.text: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Yashar'el. Moreover I will subdue all your enemies. Furthermore I tell you that Yahuah will build you an house.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when your days be expired that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will raise up your seed after you, which shall be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when your days be expired that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will raise up your seed after you, which shall be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.raw: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
verses.text: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.

verses.raw: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before you:
verses.text: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before you:

verses.raw: But I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.text: But I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

verses.raw: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.text: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.

verses.raw: And David the king came and sat before Yahuah (LORD), and said, Who am I, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), and what is my house, that you have brought me hitherto?
verses.text: And David the king came and sat before Yahuah, and said, Who am I, O Yahuah Elohim, and what is my house, that you have brought me hitherto?

verses.raw: And yet this was a small thing in your eyes, O Elohim (God); for you have also spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God).
verses.text: And yet this was a small thing in your eyes, O Elohim; for you have also spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Yahuah Elohim.

verses.raw: What can David speak more to you for the honour of your servant? for you know your servant.
verses.text: What can David speak more to you for the honour of your servant? for you know your servant.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, have you done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.text: O Yahuah, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, have you done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), there is none like you, neither is there any Elohim (God) beside you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.text: O Yahuah, there is none like you, neither is there any Elohim beside you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

verses.raw: And what one nation in the earth is like your people Yashar'el (Israel), whom Elohim (God) went to redeem to be his own people, to make you a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before your people, whom you have redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.text: And what one nation in the earth is like your people Yashar'el, whom Elohim went to redeem to be his own people, to make you a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before your people, whom you have redeemed out of Egypt?

verses.raw: For your people Yashar'el (Israel) did you make your own people for ever; and you, Yahuah (LORD), becamest their Elohim (God).
verses.text: For your people Yashar'el did you make your own people for ever; and you, Yahuah, becamest their Elohim.

verses.raw: Therefore now, Yahuah (LORD), let the thing that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as you have said.
verses.text: Therefore now, Yahuah, let the thing that you have spoken concerning your servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as you have said.

verses.raw: Let it even be established, that your name may be magnified for ever, saying, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), even a Elohim (God) to Yashar'el (Israel): and let the house of David your servant be established before you.
verses.text: Let it even be established, that your name may be magnified for ever, saying, Yahuah Tseva'ot is the Elohim of Yashar'el, even a Elohim to Yashar'el: and let the house of David your servant be established before you.

verses.raw: For you, O my Elohim (God), have told your servant that you will build him an house: therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray before you.
verses.text: For you, O my Elohim, have told your servant that you will build him an house: therefore your servant has found in his heart to pray before you.

verses.raw: And now, Yahuah (LORD), you are Elohim (God), and have promised this goodness unto your servant:
verses.text: And now, Yahuah, you are Elohim, and have promised this goodness unto your servant:

verses.raw: Now therefore let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may be before you for ever: for you blessest, O Yahuah (LORD), and it shall be blessed for ever.
verses.text: Now therefore let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may be before you for ever: for you blessest, O Yahuah, and it shall be blessed for ever.

verses.raw: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.text: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.
verses.text: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.

verses.raw: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.text: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

verses.raw: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.text: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

verses.raw: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.text: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

verses.raw: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus Yahuah (LORD) preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.text: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus Yahuah preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.raw: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.text: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

verses.raw: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.text: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

verses.raw: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.text: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

verses.raw: Them also king David dedicated unto Yahuah (LORD), with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.text: Them also king David dedicated unto Yahuah, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

verses.raw: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.text: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.

verses.raw: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus Yahuah (LORD) preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.text: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus Yahuah preserved David whithersoever he went.

verses.raw: So David reigned over all Yashar'el (Israel), and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.text: So David reigned over all Yashar'el, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.

verses.raw: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
verses.text: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.

verses.raw: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.text: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;

verses.raw: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.text: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.text: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.

verses.raw: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest you that David does honour your father, that he has sent comforters unto you? are not his servants come unto you for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
verses.text: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest you that David does honour your father, that he has sent comforters unto you? are not his servants come unto you for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?

verses.raw: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.text: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.raw: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
verses.text: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.

verses.raw: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.
verses.text: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.

verses.raw: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.text: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

verses.raw: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.text: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.

verses.raw: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
verses.text: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.

verses.raw: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Yashar'el (Israel), and put them in array against the Syrians.
verses.text: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Yashar'el, and put them in array against the Syrians.

verses.raw: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.text: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then you shall help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for you, then I will help you.
verses.text: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then you shall help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for you, then I will help you.

verses.raw: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our Elohim (God): and let Yahuah (LORD) do that which is good in his sight.
verses.text: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our Elohim: and let Yahuah do that which is good in his sight.

verses.raw: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.text: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.

verses.raw: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Yashar'el (Israel), they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
verses.text: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Yashar'el, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.

verses.raw: And it was told David; and he gathered all Yashar'el (Israel), and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.text: And it was told David; and he gathered all Yashar'el, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

verses.raw: But the Syrians fled before Yashar'el (Israel); and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.text: But the Syrians fled before Yashar'el; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.

verses.raw: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Yashar'el (Israel), they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.text: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Yashar'el, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.

verses.raw: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.

verses.raw: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.

verses.raw: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.text: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver’s beam.

verses.raw: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.
verses.text: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.

verses.raw: But when he defied Yashar'el (Israel), Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.

verses.raw: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.text: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.

verses.raw: And Satan stood up against Yashar'el (Israel), and provoked David to number Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Satan stood up against Yashar'el, and provoked David to number Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Yashar'el (Israel) from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
verses.text: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Yashar'el from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.

verses.raw: And Joab answered, Yahuah (LORD) make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why then does my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And Joab answered, Yahuah make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why then does my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Yashar'el?

verses.raw: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Yashar'el (Israel), and came to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Yashar'el, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Yashar'el (Israel) were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Yahudah (Judah) was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.text: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Yashar'el were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Yahudah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.

verses.raw: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
verses.text: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Elohim was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And David said unto Elohim (God), I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech you, do away the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.text: And David said unto Elohim, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech you, do away the iniquity of your servant; for I have done very foolishly.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.text: And Yahuah spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,

verses.raw: Go and tell David, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), I offer you three things: choose you one of them, that I may do it unto you.
verses.text: Go and tell David, saying, Thus says Yahuah, I offer you three things: choose you one of them, that I may do it unto you.

verses.raw: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Choose you
verses.text: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus says Yahuah, Choose you

verses.raw: Either three years’ famine; or three months to be destroyed before your foes, while that the sword of your enemies overtaketh you; or else three days the sword of Yahuah (LORD), even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of Yahuah (LORD) destroying throughout all the coasts of Yashar'el (Israel). Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.

verses.raw: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of Yahuah (LORD); for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.text: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of Yahuah; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.

verses.raw: So Yahuah (LORD) sent pestilence upon Yashar'el (Israel): and there fell of Yashar'el (Israel) seventy thousand men.
verses.text: So Yahuah sent pestilence upon Yashar'el: and there fell of Yashar'el seventy thousand men.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, Yahuah (LORD) beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now your hand. And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.raw: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of Yahuah (LORD) stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.text: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of Yahuah stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Yashar'el, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.

verses.raw: And David said unto Elohim (God), Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let your hand, I pray you, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on your people, that they should be plagued.
verses.text: And David said unto Elohim, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let your hand, I pray you, O Yahuah my Elohim, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on your people, that they should be plagued.

verses.raw: Then the angel of Yahuah (LORD) commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto Yahuah (LORD) in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.text: Then the angel of Yahuah commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto Yahuah in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.raw: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.text: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

verses.raw: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.text: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

verses.raw: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto Yahuah (LORD): you shall grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.text: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto Yahuah: you shall grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.

verses.raw: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to you, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give you the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
verses.text: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to you, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give you the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.

verses.raw: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is yours for Yahuah (LORD), nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
verses.text: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is yours for Yahuah, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.

verses.raw: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.text: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.

verses.raw: And David built there an altar unto Yahuah (LORD), and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon Yahuah (LORD); and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.text: And David built there an altar unto Yahuah, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon Yahuah; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
verses.text: And Yahuah commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.

verses.raw: At that time when David saw that Yahuah (LORD) had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

verses.raw: For the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD), which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.

verses.raw: But David could not go before it to enquire of Elohim (God): for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of Yahuah (LORD).

verses.raw: Then David said, This is the house of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then David said, This is the house of Yahuah Elohim, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Yashar'el (Israel); and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Yashar'el; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of Elohim.

verses.raw: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;

verses.raw: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.text: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.

verses.raw: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for Yahuah (LORD) must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.

verses.raw: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God):

verses.raw: But the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying, You have shed blood abundantly, and have made great wars: you shall not build an house unto my name, because you have shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.text: But the word of Yahuah came to me, saying, You have shed blood abundantly, and have made great wars: you shall not build an house unto my name, because you have shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.

verses.raw: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Yashar'el (Israel) in his days.

verses.raw: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Yashar'el (Israel) for ever.

verses.raw: Now, my son, Yahuah (LORD) be with you; and prosper you, and build the house of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), as he has said of you.

verses.raw: Then shall you prosper, if you take heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which Yahuah (LORD) charged Moses with concerning Yashar'el (Israel): be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.

verses.raw: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of Yahuah (LORD) an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and you may add thereto.

verses.raw: Moreover there are workmen with you in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.

verses.raw: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and Yahuah (LORD) be with you.

verses.raw: David also commanded all the princes of Yashar'el (Israel) to help Solomon his son, saying,

verses.raw: Is not Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) with you? and has he not given you rest on every side? for he has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before Yahuah (LORD), and before his people.

verses.raw: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Yashar'el (Israel).

verses.raw: For David said, Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) has given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:

verses.raw: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.

verses.raw: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of Yahuah (LORD), in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of Elohim (God);

verses.raw: And to stand every morning to thank and praise Yahuah (LORD), and likewise at even;

verses.raw: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of Yahuah (LORD).

verses.raw: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.raw: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
verses.text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.

verses.raw: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.text: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

verses.raw: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.text: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

verses.raw: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of Elohim (God), were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

verses.raw: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Yashar'el (Israel) on this side Jordan westward in all the business of Yahuah (LORD), and in the service of the king.

verses.raw: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

verses.raw: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to Elohim (God), and affairs of the king.
verses.text: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to Elohim, and affairs of the king.

verses.raw: Now the children of Yashar'el (Israel) after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: Now the children of Yashar'el after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.text: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.

verses.raw: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
