verses.text: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
verses.text: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.

verses.raw: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abi-ezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abi-ezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.text: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.

verses.raw: Furthermore over the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel): the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
verses.text: Furthermore over the tribes of Yashar'el: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:

verses.raw: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
verses.text: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:

verses.raw: Of Yahudah (Judah), Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.text: Of Yahudah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

verses.raw: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
verses.text: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:

verses.raw: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.text: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:

verses.raw: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.text: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:

verses.raw: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because Yahuah (LORD) had said he would increase Yashar'el (Israel) like to the stars of the heavens.
verses.text: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because Yahuah had said he would increase Yashar'el like to the stars of the heavens.

verses.raw: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Yashar'el (Israel); neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
verses.text: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Yashar'el; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.

verses.raw: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.text: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:

verses.raw: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.text: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:

verses.raw: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.text: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:

verses.raw: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
verses.text: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:

verses.raw: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.text: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:

verses.raw: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
verses.text: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:

verses.raw: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.
verses.text: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.

verses.raw: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:
verses.text: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counsellor, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:

verses.raw: And Ahithophel was the king’s counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion:
verses.text: And Ahithophel was the king’s counsellor: and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion:

verses.raw: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king’s army was Joab.
verses.text: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king’s army was Joab.

verses.raw: And David assembled all the princes of Yashar'el (Israel), the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
verses.text: And David assembled all the princes of Yashar'el, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in my heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), and for the footstool of our Elohim (God), and had made ready for the building:
verses.text: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in my heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of Yahuah, and for the footstool of our Elohim, and had made ready for the building:

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) said unto me, You shall not build an house for my name, because you have been a man of war, and have shed blood.
verses.text: But Elohim said unto me, You shall not build an house for my name, because you have been a man of war, and have shed blood.

verses.raw: Howbeit Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Yashar'el (Israel) for ever: for he has chosen Yahudah (Judah) to be the ruler; and of the house of Yahudah (Judah), the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Howbeit Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Yashar'el for ever: for he has chosen Yahudah to be the ruler; and of the house of Yahudah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And of all my sons, (for Yahuah (LORD) has given me many sons,) he has chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of Yahuah (LORD) over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And of all my sons, (for Yahuah has given me many sons,) he has chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of Yahuah over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Solomon your son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Solomon your son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

verses.raw: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
verses.text: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.

verses.raw: Now therefore in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel) the congregation of Yahuah (LORD), and in the audience of our Elohim (God), keep and seek for all the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
verses.text: Now therefore in the sight of all Yashar'el the congregation of Yahuah, and in the audience of our Elohim, keep and seek for all the commandments of Yahuah Elohaychem: that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.

verses.raw: And you, Solomon my son, know you the Elohim (God) of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for Yahuah (LORD) searcheth all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts: if you seek him, he will be found of you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off for ever.
verses.text: And you, Solomon my son, know you the Elohim of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for Yahuah searcheth all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts: if you seek him, he will be found of you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off for ever.

verses.raw: Take heed now; for Yahuah (LORD) has chosen you to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
verses.text: Take heed now; for Yahuah has chosen you to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

verses.raw: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
verses.text: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,

verses.raw: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of Elohim (God), and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
verses.text: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of Yahuah, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of Elohim, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:

verses.raw: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and for all the vessels of service in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of Yahuah, and for all the vessels of service in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
verses.text: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:

verses.raw: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
verses.text: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.

verses.raw: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
verses.text: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:

verses.raw: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
verses.text: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:

verses.raw: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of Yahuah.

verses.raw: All this, said David, Yahuah (LORD) made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
verses.text: All this, said David, Yahuah made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.

verses.raw: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), even my Elohim (God), will be with you; he will not fail you, nor forsake you, until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for Yahuah Elohim, even my Elohim, will be with you; he will not fail you, nor forsake you, until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with you for all the service of the house of Elohim (God): and there shall be with you for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at your commandment.
verses.text: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with you for all the service of the house of Elohim: and there shall be with you for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at your commandment.

verses.raw: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone Elohim (God) has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God).
verses.text: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone Elohim has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for Yahuah Elohim.

verses.raw: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my Elohim (God) the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
verses.text: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my Elohim the gold for things to be made of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and the brass for things of brass, the iron for things of iron, and wood for things of wood; onyx stones, and stones to be set, glistering stones, and of divers colours, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.

verses.raw: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my Elohim (God), I have of my own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my Elohim (God), over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
verses.text: Moreover, because I have set my affection to the house of my Elohim, I have of my own proper good, of gold and silver, which I have given to the house of my Elohim, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,

verses.raw: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:
verses.text: Even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, to overlay the walls of the houses withal:

verses.raw: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: The gold for things of gold, and the silver for things of silver, and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers. And who then is willing to consecrate his service this day unto Yahuah?

verses.raw: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly,
verses.text: Then the chief of the fathers and princes of the tribes of Yashar'el, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers of the king’s work, offered willingly,

verses.raw: And gave for the service of the house of Elohim (God) of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.
verses.text: And gave for the service of the house of Elohim of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand drams, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and one hundred thousand talents of iron.

verses.raw: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of Yahuah (LORD), by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
verses.text: And they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of Yahuah, by the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.

verses.raw: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to Yahuah (LORD): and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.
verses.text: Then the people rejoiced, for that they offered willingly, because with perfect heart they offered willingly to Yahuah: and David the king also rejoiced with great joy.

verses.raw: Wherefore David blessed Yahuah (LORD) before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be you, Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) our father, for ever and ever.
verses.text: Wherefore David blessed Yahuah before all the congregation: and David said, Blessed be you, Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el our father, for ever and ever.

verses.raw: Yours, O Yahuah (LORD), is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is yours; yours is the kingdom, O Yahuah (LORD), and you are exalted as head above all.
verses.text: Yours, O Yahuah, is the greatness, and the power, and the glory, and the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heaven and in the earth is yours; yours is the kingdom, O Yahuah, and you are exalted as head above all.

verses.raw: Both riches and honour come of you, and you reign over all; and in your hand is power and might; and in your hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.
verses.text: Both riches and honour come of you, and you reign over all; and in your hand is power and might; and in your hand it is to make great, and to give strength unto all.

verses.raw: Now therefore, our Elohim (God), we thank you, and praise your glorious name.
verses.text: Now therefore, our Elohim, we thank you, and praise your glorious name.

verses.raw: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of you, and of your own have we given you.
verses.text: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly after this sort? for all things come of you, and of your own have we given you.

verses.raw: For we are strangers before you, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.
verses.text: For we are strangers before you, and sojourners, as were all our fathers: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is none abiding.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God), all this store that we have prepared to build you an house for your holy name comes of your hand, and is all your own.
verses.text: O Yahuah our Elohim, all this store that we have prepared to build you an house for your holy name comes of your hand, and is all your own.

verses.raw: I know also, my Elohim (God), that you triest the heart, and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy your people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto you.
verses.text: I know also, my Elohim, that you triest the heart, and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy your people, which are present here, to offer willingly unto you.

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Abraham, Isaac, and of Yashar'el (Israel), our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart unto you:
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim of Abraham, Isaac, and of Yashar'el, our fathers, keep this for ever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart unto you:

verses.raw: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.
verses.text: And give unto Solomon my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for the which I have made provision.

verses.raw: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God). And all the congregation blessed Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped Yahuah (LORD), and the king.
verses.text: And David said to all the congregation, Now bless Yahuah Elohaychem. And all the congregation blessed Yahuah Elohim of their fathers, and bowed down their heads, and worshipped Yahuah, and the king.

verses.raw: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto Yahuah (LORD), and offered burnt offerings unto Yahuah (LORD), on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And they sacrificed sacrifices unto Yahuah, and offered burnt offerings unto Yahuah, on the morrow after that day, even a thousand bullocks, a thousand rams, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Yashar'el:

verses.raw: And did eat and drink before Yahuah (LORD) on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto Yahuah (LORD) to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.
verses.text: And did eat and drink before Yahuah on that day with great gladness. And they made Solomon the son of David king the second time, and anointed him unto Yahuah to be the chief governor, and Zadok to be priest.

verses.raw: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahuah (LORD) as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Yashar'el (Israel) obeyed him.
verses.text: Then Solomon sat on the throne of Yahuah as king instead of David his father, and prospered; and all Yashar'el obeyed him.

verses.raw: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.
verses.text: And all the princes, and the mighty men, and all the sons likewise of king David, submitted themselves unto Solomon the king.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Yashar'el (Israel), and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah magnified Solomon exceedingly in the sight of all Yashar'el, and bestowed upon him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Thus David the son of Jesse reigned over all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the time that he reigned over Yashar'el (Israel) was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And the time that he reigned over Yashar'el was forty years; seven years reigned he in Hebron, and thirty and three years reigned he in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And he died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honour: and Solomon his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,
verses.text: Now the acts of David the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Samuel the seer, and in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the book of Gad the seer,

verses.raw: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Yashar'el (Israel), and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.text: With all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Yashar'el, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.

verses.raw: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
verses.text: And Solomon the son of David was strengthened in his kingdom, and Yahuah Elohav was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.

verses.raw: Then Solomon spake unto all Yashar'el (Israel), to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Yashar'el (Israel), the chief of the fathers.
verses.text: Then Solomon spake unto all Yashar'el, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every governor in all Yashar'el, the chief of the fathers.

verses.raw: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of Elohim (God), which Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD) had made in the wilderness.
verses.text: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of Elohim, which Moses the servant of Yahuah had made in the wilderness.

verses.raw: But the ark of Elohim (God) had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.
verses.text: But the ark of Elohim had David brought up from Kirjath-jearim to the place which David had prepared for it: for he had pitched a tent for it at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of Yahuah (LORD): and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
verses.text: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of Yahuah: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.

verses.raw: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before Yahuah (LORD), which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.
verses.text: And Solomon went up thither to the brasen altar before Yahuah, which was at the tabernacle of the congregation, and offered a thousand burnt offerings upon it.

verses.raw: In that night did Elohim (God) appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give you.
verses.text: In that night did Elohim appear unto Solomon, and said unto him, Ask what I shall give you.

verses.raw: And Solomon said unto Elohim (God), You have shewed great mercy unto David my father, and have made me to reign in his stead.
verses.text: And Solomon said unto Elohim, You have shewed great mercy unto David my father, and have made me to reign in his stead.

verses.raw: Now, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), let your promise unto David my father be established: for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
verses.text: Now, O Yahuah Elohim, let your promise unto David my father be established: for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.

verses.raw: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this your people, that is so great?
verses.text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people: for who can judge this your people, that is so great?

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said to Solomon, Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of your enemies, neither yet have asked long life; but have asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king:
verses.text: And Elohim said to Solomon, Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, or honour, nor the life of your enemies, neither yet have asked long life; but have asked wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king:

verses.raw: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto you; and I will give you riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before you, neither shall there any after you have the like.
verses.text: Wisdom and knowledge is granted unto you; and I will give you riches, and wealth, and honour, such as none of the kings have had that have been before you, neither shall there any after you have the like.

verses.raw: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then Solomon came from his journey to the high place that was at Gibeon to Jerusalem, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.text: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had a thousand and four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, which he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
verses.text: And the king made silver and gold at Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the vale for abundance.

verses.raw: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.
verses.text: And Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt, and linen yarn: the king’s merchants received the linen yarn at a price.

verses.raw: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.
verses.text: And they fetched up, and brought forth out of Egypt a chariot for six hundred shekels of silver, and an horse for an hundred and fifty: and so brought they out horses for all the kings of the Hittites, and for the kings of Syria, by their means.

verses.raw: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of Yahuah (LORD), and an house for his kingdom.
verses.text: And Solomon determined to build an house for the name of Yahuah, and an house for his kingdom.

verses.raw: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
verses.text: And Solomon told out threescore and ten thousand men to bear burdens, and fourscore thousand to hew in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.

verses.raw: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As you did deal with David my father, and did send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.
verses.text: And Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, As you did deal with David my father, and did send him cedars to build him an house to dwell therein, even so deal with me.

verses.raw: Behold, I build an house to the name of Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God), to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God). This is an ordinance for ever to Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Behold, I build an house to the name of Yahuah Elohai, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him sweet incense, and for the continual shewbread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts of Yahuah Eloheinu. This is an ordinance for ever to Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the house which I build is great: for great is our Elohim (God) above all gods.
verses.text: And the house which I build is great: for great is our Elohim above all gods.

verses.raw: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?
verses.text: But who is able to build him an house, seeing the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain him? who am I then, that I should build him an house, save only to burn sacrifice before him?

verses.raw: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Yahudah (Judah) and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.
verses.text: Send me now therefore a man cunning to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and that can skill to grave with the cunning men that are with me in Yahudah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father did provide.

verses.raw: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that your servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with your servants,
verses.text: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon: for I know that your servants can skill to cut timber in Lebanon; and, behold, my servants shall be with your servants,

verses.raw: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.
verses.text: Even to prepare me timber in abundance: for the house which I am about to build shall be wonderful great.

verses.raw: And, behold, I will give to your servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
verses.text: And, behold, I will give to your servants, the hewers that cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.

verses.raw: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because Yahuah (LORD) has loved his people, he has made you king over them.
verses.text: Then Huram the king of Tyre answered in writing, which he sent to Solomon, Because Yahuah has loved his people, he has made you king over them.

verses.raw: Huram said moreover, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), that made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for Yahuah (LORD), and an house for his kingdom.
verses.text: Huram said moreover, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, that made heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, endued with prudence and understanding, that might build an house for Yahuah, and an house for his kingdom.

verses.raw: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father’s,
verses.text: And now I have sent a cunning man, endued with understanding, of Huram my father’s,

verses.raw: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with your cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David your father.
verses.text: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, and his father was a man of Tyre, skilful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson; also to grave any manner of graving, and to find out every device which shall be put to him, with your cunning men, and with the cunning men of my lord David your father.

verses.raw: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord has spoken of, let him send unto his servants:
verses.text: Now therefore the wheat, and the barley, the oil, and the wine, which my lord has spoken of, let him send unto his servants:

verses.raw: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you shall need: and we will bring it to you in floats by sea to Joppa; and you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And we will cut wood out of Lebanon, as much as you shall need: and we will bring it to you in floats by sea to Joppa; and you shall carry it up to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Yashar'el (Israel), after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.
verses.text: And Solomon numbered all the strangers that were in the land of Yashar'el, after the numbering wherewith David his father had numbered them; and they were found an hundred and fifty thousand and three thousand and six hundred.

verses.raw: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.
verses.text: And he set threescore and ten thousand of them to be bearers of burdens, and fourscore thousand to be hewers in the mountain, and three thousand and six hundred overseers to set the people a work.

verses.raw: Then Solomon began to build the house of Yahuah (LORD) at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.text: Then Solomon began to build the house of Yahuah at Jerusalem in mount Moriah, where Yahuah appeared unto David his father, in the place that David had prepared in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.raw: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
verses.text: And he began to build in the second day of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.

verses.raw: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of Elohim (God). The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
verses.text: Now these are the things wherein Solomon was instructed for the building of the house of Elohim. The length by cubits after the first measure was threescore cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.

verses.raw: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
verses.text: And the porch that was in the front of the house, the length of it was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the height was an hundred and twenty: and he overlaid it within with pure gold.

verses.raw: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.
verses.text: And the greater house he cieled with fir tree, which he overlaid with fine gold, and set thereon palm trees and chains.

verses.raw: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
verses.text: And he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.

verses.raw: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.
verses.text: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the posts, and the walls thereof, and the doors thereof, with gold; and graved cherubims on the walls.

verses.raw: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
verses.text: And he made the most holy house, the length whereof was according to the breadth of the house, twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits: and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.

verses.raw: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
verses.text: And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

verses.raw: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.
verses.text: And in the most holy house he made two cherubims of image work, and overlaid them with gold.

verses.raw: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.text: And the wings of the cherubims were twenty cubits long: one wing of the one cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was likewise five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.raw: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.
verses.text: And one wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house: and the other wing was five cubits also, joining to the wing of the other cherub.

verses.raw: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.
verses.text: The wings of these cherubims spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were inward.

verses.raw: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.
verses.text: And he made the vail of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and wrought cherubims thereon.

verses.raw: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
verses.text: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty and five cubits high, and the chapiter that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.

verses.raw: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
verses.text: And he made chains, as in the oracle, and put them on the heads of the pillars; and made an hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.

verses.raw: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.
verses.text: And he reared up the pillars before the temple, one on the right hand, and the other on the left; and called the name of that on the right hand Jachin, and the name of that on the left Boaz.

verses.raw: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.
verses.text: Moreover he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length thereof, and twenty cubits the breadth thereof, and ten cubits the height thereof.

verses.raw: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.
verses.text: Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits the height thereof; and a line of thirty cubits did compass it round about.

verses.raw: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.
verses.text: And under it was the similitude of oxen, which did compass it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast, when it was cast.

verses.raw: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.
verses.text: It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.

verses.raw: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.
verses.text: And the thickness of it was an handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, with flowers of lilies; and it received and held three thousand baths.

verses.raw: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
verses.text: He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as they offered for the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.

verses.raw: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.
verses.text: And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.

verses.raw: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.
verses.text: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. And he made an hundred basons of gold.

verses.raw: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.
verses.text: Furthermore he made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court, and overlaid the doors of them with brass.

verses.raw: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.
verses.text: And he set the sea on the right side of the east end, over against the south.

verses.raw: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of Elohim (God);
verses.text: And Huram made the pots, and the shovels, and the basons. And Huram finished the work that he was to make for king Solomon for the house of Elohim;

verses.raw: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;
verses.text: To wit, the two pillars, and the pommels, and the chapiters which were on the top of the two pillars, and the two wreaths to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were on the top of the pillars;

verses.raw: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.
verses.text: And four hundred pomegranates on the two wreaths; two rows of pomegranates on each wreath, to cover the two pommels of the chapiters which were upon the pillars.

verses.raw: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;
verses.text: He made also bases, and lavers made he upon the bases;

verses.raw: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.
verses.text: One sea, and twelve oxen under it.

verses.raw: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of Yahuah (LORD) of bright brass.
verses.text: The pots also, and the shovels, and the fleshhooks, and all their instruments, did Huram his father make to king Solomon for the house of Yahuah of bright brass.

verses.raw: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.
verses.text: In the plain of Jordan did the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredathah.

verses.raw: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.
verses.text: Thus Solomon made all these vessels in great abundance: for the weight of the brass could not be found out.

verses.raw: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of Elohim (God), the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;
verses.text: And Solomon made all the vessels that were for the house of Elohim, the golden altar also, and the tables whereon the shewbread was set;

verses.raw: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;
verses.text: Moreover the candlesticks with their lamps, that they should burn after the manner before the oracle, of pure gold;

verses.raw: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;
verses.text: And the flowers, and the lamps, and the tongs, made he of gold, and that perfect gold;

verses.raw: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.
verses.text: And the snuffers, and the basons, and the spoons, and the censers, of pure gold: and the entry of the house, the inner doors thereof for the most holy place, and the doors of the house of the temple, were of gold.

verses.raw: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of Yahuah (LORD) was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Thus all the work that Solomon made for the house of Yahuah was finished: and Solomon brought in all the things that David his father had dedicated; and the silver, and the gold, and all the instruments, put he among the treasures of the house of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) out of the city of David, which is Zion.
verses.text: Then Solomon assembled the elders of Yashar'el, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Yashar'el, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of Yahuah out of the city of David, which is Zion.

verses.raw: Wherefore all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.
verses.text: Wherefore all the men of Yashar'el assembled themselves unto the king in the feast which was in the seventh month.

verses.raw: And all the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) came; and the Levites took up the ark.
verses.text: And all the elders of Yashar'el came; and the Levites took up the ark.

verses.raw: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.
verses.text: And they brought up the ark, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle, these did the priests and the Levites bring up.

verses.raw: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
verses.text: Also king Solomon, and all the congregation of Yashar'el that were assembled unto him before the ark, sacrificed sheep and oxen, which could not be told nor numbered for multitude.

verses.raw: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:
verses.text: And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of Yahuah unto his place, to the oracle of the house, into the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubims:

verses.raw: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
verses.text: For the cherubims spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubims covered the ark and the staves thereof above.

verses.raw: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.
verses.text: And they drew out the staves of the ark, that the ends of the staves were seen from the ark before the oracle; but they were not seen without. And there it is unto this day.

verses.raw: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when Yahuah (LORD) made a covenant with the children of Yashar'el (Israel), when they came out of Egypt.
verses.text: There was nothing in the ark save the two tables which Moses put therein at Horeb, when Yahuah made a covenant with the children of Yashar'el, when they came out of Egypt.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the priests were come out of the holy place: (for all the priests that were present were sanctified, and did not then wait by course:

verses.raw: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)
verses.text: Also the Levites which were the singers, all of them of Asaph, of Heman, of Jeduthun, with their sons and their brethren, being arrayed in white linen, having cymbals and psalteries and harps, stood at the east end of the altar, and with them an hundred and twenty priests sounding with trumpets:)

verses.raw: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahuah (LORD); and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised Yahuah (LORD), saying, For he is good; for his mercy endures for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: It came even to pass, as the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking Yahuah; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of musick, and praised Yahuah, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endures for ever: that then the house was filled with a cloud, even the house of Yahuah;

verses.raw: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of Yahuah (LORD) had filled the house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: So that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud: for the glory of Yahuah had filled the house of Elohim.

verses.raw: Then said Solomon, Yahuah (LORD) has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.
verses.text: Then said Solomon, Yahuah has said that he would dwell in the thick darkness.

verses.raw: But I have built an house of habitation for you, and a place for your dwelling for ever.
verses.text: But I have built an house of habitation for you, and a place for your dwelling for ever.

verses.raw: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Yashar'el (Israel): and all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel) stood.
verses.text: And the king turned his face, and blessed the whole congregation of Yashar'el: and all the congregation of Yashar'el stood.

verses.raw: And he said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), who has with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,
verses.text: And he said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, who has with his hands fulfilled that which he spake with his mouth to my father David, saying,

verses.raw: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Since the day that I brought forth my people out of the land of Egypt I chose no city among all the tribes of Yashar'el to build an house in, that my name might be there; neither chose I any man to be a ruler over my people Yashar'el:

verses.raw: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But I have chosen Jerusalem, that my name might be there; and have chosen David to be over my people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build an house for the name of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in your heart to build an house for my name, you did well in that it was in your heart:
verses.text: But Yahuah said to David my father, Forasmuch as it was in your heart to build an house for my name, you did well in that it was in your heart:

verses.raw: Notwithstanding you shall not build the house; but your son which shall come forth out of your loins, he shall build the house for my name.
verses.text: Notwithstanding you shall not build the house; but your son which shall come forth out of your loins, he shall build the house for my name.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) therefore has performed his word that he has spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Yashar'el (Israel), as Yahuah (LORD) promised, and have built the house for the name of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yahuah therefore has performed his word that he has spoken: for I am risen up in the room of David my father, and am set on the throne of Yashar'el, as Yahuah promised, and have built the house for the name of Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of Yahuah (LORD), that he made with the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And in it have I put the ark, wherein is the covenant of Yahuah, that he made with the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he stood before the altar of Yahuah (LORD) in the presence of all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), and spread forth his hands:
verses.text: And he stood before the altar of Yahuah in the presence of all the congregation of Yashar'el, and spread forth his hands:

verses.raw: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), and spread forth his hands toward heaven,
verses.text: For Solomon had made a brasen scaffold, of five cubits long, and five cubits broad, and three cubits high, and had set it in the midst of the court: and upon it he stood, and kneeled down upon his knees before all the congregation of Yashar'el, and spread forth his hands toward heaven,

verses.raw: And said, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), there is no Elohim (God) like you in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto your servants, that walk before you with all their hearts:
verses.text: And said, O Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, there is no Elohim like you in the heaven, nor in the earth; which keepest covenant, and shewest mercy unto your servants, that walk before you with all their hearts:

verses.raw: You which have kept with your servant David my father that which you have promised him; and spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is this day.
verses.text: You which have kept with your servant David my father that which you have promised him; and spoke with your mouth, and have fulfilled it with your hand, as it is this day.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Yashar'el (Israel); yet so that your children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as you have walked before me.
verses.text: Now therefore, O Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, keep with your servant David my father that which you have promised him, saying, There shall not fail you a man in my sight to sit upon the throne of Yashar'el; yet so that your children take heed to their way to walk in my law, as you have walked before me.

verses.raw: Now then, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), let your word be verified, which you have spoken unto your servant David.
verses.text: Now then, O Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, let your word be verified, which you have spoken unto your servant David.

verses.raw: But will Elohim (God) in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain you; how much less this house which I have built!
verses.text: But will Elohim in very deed dwell with men on the earth? behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain you; how much less this house which I have built!

verses.raw: Have respect therefore to the prayer of your servant, and to his supplication, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which your servant prayeth before you:
verses.text: Have respect therefore to the prayer of your servant, and to his supplication, O Yahuah my Elohim, to hearken unto the cry and the prayer which your servant prayeth before you:

verses.raw: That your eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof you have said that you would put your name there; to hearken unto the prayer which your servant prayeth toward this place.
verses.text: That your eyes may be open upon this house day and night, upon the place whereof you have said that you would put your name there; to hearken unto the prayer which your servant prayeth toward this place.

verses.raw: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of your servant, and of your people Yashar'el (Israel), which they shall make toward this place: hear you from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.
verses.text: Hearken therefore unto the supplications of your servant, and of your people Yashar'el, which they shall make toward this place: hear you from your dwelling place, even from heaven; and when you hear, forgive.

verses.raw: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before your altar in this house;
verses.text: If a man sin against his neighbour, and an oath be laid upon him to make him swear, and the oath come before your altar in this house;

verses.raw: Then hear you from heaven, and do, and judge your servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.
verses.text: Then hear you from heaven, and do, and judge your servants, by requiting the wicked, by recompensing his way upon his own head; and by justifying the righteous, by giving him according to his righteousness.

verses.raw: And if your people Yashar'el (Israel) be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against you; and shall return and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house;
verses.text: And if your people Yashar'el be put to the worse before the enemy, because they have sinned against you; and shall return and confess your name, and pray and make supplication before you in this house;

verses.raw: Then hear you from the heavens, and forgive the sin of your people Yashar'el (Israel), and bring them again unto the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.
verses.text: Then hear you from the heavens, and forgive the sin of your people Yashar'el, and bring them again unto the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.

verses.raw: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against you; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess your name, and turn from their sin, when you do afflict them;
verses.text: When the heaven is shut up, and there is no rain, because they have sinned against you; yet if they pray toward this place, and confess your name, and turn from their sin, when you do afflict them;

verses.raw: Then hear you from heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Yashar'el (Israel), when you have taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon your land, which you have given unto your people for an inheritance.
verses.text: Then hear you from heaven, and forgive the sin of your servants, and of your people Yashar'el, when you have taught them the good way, wherein they should walk; and send rain upon your land, which you have given unto your people for an inheritance.

verses.raw: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:
verses.text: If there be dearth in the land, if there be pestilence, if there be blasting, or mildew, locusts, or caterpillers; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever sore or whatsoever sickness there be:

verses.raw: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all your people Yashar'el (Israel), when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:
verses.text: Then what prayer or what supplication soever shall be made of any man, or of all your people Yashar'el, when every one shall know his own sore and his own grief, and shall spread forth his hands in this house:

verses.raw: Then hear you from heaven your dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart you know; (for you only know the hearts of the children of men:)
verses.text: Then hear you from heaven your dwelling place, and forgive, and render unto every man according unto all his ways, whose heart you know; (for you only know the hearts of the children of men:)

verses.raw: That they may fear you, to walk in your ways, so long as they live in the land which you gave unto our fathers.
verses.text: That they may fear you, to walk in your ways, so long as they live in the land which you gave unto our fathers.

verses.raw: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of your people Yashar'el (Israel), but is come from a far country for your great name’s sake, and your mighty hand, and your stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;
verses.text: Moreover concerning the stranger, which is not of your people Yashar'el, but is come from a far country for your great name’s sake, and your mighty hand, and your stretched out arm; if they come and pray in this house;

verses.raw: Then hear you from the heavens, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calls to you for; that all people of the earth may know your name, and fear you, as does your people Yashar'el (Israel), and may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.
verses.text: Then hear you from the heavens, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the stranger calls to you for; that all people of the earth may know your name, and fear you, as does your people Yashar'el, and may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.

verses.raw: If your people go out to war against their enemies by the way that you shall send them, and they pray unto you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;
verses.text: If your people go out to war against their enemies by the way that you shall send them, and they pray unto you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;

verses.raw: Then hear you from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
verses.text: Then hear you from the heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.

verses.raw: If they sin against you, (for there is no man which sins not,) and you be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;
verses.text: If they sin against you, (for there is no man which sins not,) and you be angry with them, and deliver them over before their enemies, and they carry them away captives unto a land far off or near;

verses.raw: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto you in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;
verses.text: Yet if they bethink themselves in the land whither they are carried captive, and turn and pray unto you in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done amiss, and have dealt wickedly;

verses.raw: If they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which you gave unto their fathers, and toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name:
verses.text: If they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, whither they have carried them captives, and pray toward their land, which you gave unto their fathers, and toward the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name:

verses.raw: Then hear you from the heavens, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people which have sinned against you.
verses.text: Then hear you from the heavens, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their supplications, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people which have sinned against you.

verses.raw: Now, my Elohim (God), let, I beseech you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.text: Now, my Elohim, let, I beseech you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

verses.raw: Now therefore arise, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength: let your priests, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.
verses.text: Now therefore arise, O Yahuah Elohim, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength: let your priests, O Yahuah Elohim, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), turn not away the face of your anointed: remember the mercies of David your servant.
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim, turn not away the face of your anointed: remember the mercies of David your servant.

verses.raw: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) filled the house.
verses.text: Now when Solomon had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heaven, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of Yahuah filled the house.

verses.raw: And the priests could not enter into the house of Yahuah (LORD), because the glory of Yahuah (LORD) had filled the LORD’S house.
verses.text: And the priests could not enter into the house of Yahuah, because the glory of Yahuah had filled the LORD’S house.

verses.raw: And when all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw how the fire came down, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised Yahuah (LORD), saying, For he is good; for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: And when all the children of Yashar'el saw how the fire came down, and the glory of Yahuah upon the house, they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised Yahuah, saying, For he is good; for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And king Solomon offered a sacrifice of twenty and two thousand oxen, and an hundred and twenty thousand sheep: so the king and all the people dedicated the house of Elohim.

verses.raw: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of Yahuah (LORD), which David the king had made to praise Yahuah (LORD), because his mercy endures for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Yashar'el (Israel) stood.
