verses.text: And the priests waited on their offices: the Levites also with instruments of musick of Yahuah, which David the king had made to praise Yahuah, because his mercy endures for ever, when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Yashar'el stood.

verses.raw: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of Yahuah (LORD): for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.
verses.text: Moreover Solomon hallowed the middle of the court that was before the house of Yahuah: for there he offered burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brasen altar which Solomon had made was not able to receive the burnt offerings, and the meat offerings, and the fat.

verses.raw: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.
verses.text: Also at the same time Solomon kept the feast seven days, and all Yashar'el with him, a very great congregation, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt.

verses.raw: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
verses.text: And in the eighth day they made a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

verses.raw: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that Yahuah (LORD) had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his people.
verses.text: And on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away into their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that Yahuah had shewed unto David, and to Solomon, and to Yashar'el his people.

verses.raw: Thus Solomon finished the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the king’s house: and all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the house of Yahuah (LORD), and in his own house, he prosperously effected.
verses.text: Thus Solomon finished the house of Yahuah, and the king’s house: and all that came into Solomon’s heart to make in the house of Yahuah, and in his own house, he prosperously effected.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.
verses.text: And Yahuah appeared to Solomon by night, and said unto him, I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for an house of sacrifice.

verses.raw: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
verses.text: If I shut up heaven that there be no rain, or if I command the locusts to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;

verses.raw: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
verses.text: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.

verses.raw: Now my eyes shall be open, and my ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.
verses.text: Now my eyes shall be open, and my ears attent unto the prayer that is made in this place.

verses.raw: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.
verses.text: For now have I chosen and sanctified this house, that my name may be there for ever: and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.

verses.raw: And as for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and shall observe my statutes and my judgments;
verses.text: And as for you, if you will walk before me, as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and shall observe my statutes and my judgments;

verses.raw: Then will I stablish the throne of your kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David your father, saying, There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then will I stablish the throne of your kingdom, according as I have covenanted with David your father, saying, There shall not fail you a man to be ruler in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: But if you turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.text: But if you turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments, which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;

verses.raw: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.
verses.text: Then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have sanctified for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and will make it to be a proverb and a byword among all nations.

verses.raw: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passes by it; so that he shall say, Why has Yahuah (LORD) done thus unto this land, and unto this house?
verses.text: And this house, which is high, shall be an astonishment to every one that passes by it; so that he shall say, Why has Yahuah done thus unto this land, and unto this house?

verses.raw: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore has he brought all this evil upon them.
verses.text: And it shall be answered, Because they forsook Yahuah Elohim of their fathers, which brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, and laid hold on other gods, and worshipped them, and served them: therefore has he brought all this evil upon them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of Yahuah (LORD), and his own house,
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of twenty years, wherein Solomon had built the house of Yahuah, and his own house,

verses.raw: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to dwell there.
verses.text: That the cities which Huram had restored to Solomon, Solomon built them, and caused the children of Yashar'el to dwell there.

verses.raw: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.
verses.text: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah, and prevailed against it.

verses.raw: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.
verses.text: And he built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the store cities, which he built in Hamath.

verses.raw: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
verses.text: Also he built Beth-horon the upper, and Beth-horon the nether, fenced cities, with walls, gates, and bars;

verses.raw: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.
verses.text: And Baalath, and all the store cities that Solomon had, and all the chariot cities, and the cities of the horsemen, and all that Solomon desired to build in Jerusalem, and in Lebanon, and throughout all the land of his dominion.

verses.raw: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: As for all the people that were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which were not of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Yashar'el (Israel) consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.
verses.text: But of their children, who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Yashar'el consumed not, them did Solomon make to pay tribute until this day.

verses.raw: But of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.
verses.text: But of the children of Yashar'el did Solomon make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and captains of his chariots and horsemen.

verses.raw: And these were the chief of king Solomon’s officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.
verses.text: And these were the chief of king Solomon’s officers, even two hundred and fifty, that bare rule over the people.

verses.raw: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Yashar'el (Israel), because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of Yahuah (LORD) has come.
verses.text: And Solomon brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of David unto the house that he had built for her: for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of David king of Yashar'el, because the places are holy, whereunto the ark of Yahuah has come.

verses.raw: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto Yahuah (LORD) on the altar of Yahuah (LORD), which he had built before the porch,
verses.text: Then Solomon offered burnt offerings unto Yahuah on the altar of Yahuah, which he had built before the porch,

verses.raw: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.
verses.text: Even after a certain rate every day, offering according to the commandment of Moses, on the sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the solemn feasts, three times in the year, even in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles.

verses.raw: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of Elohim (God) commanded.
verses.text: And he appointed, according to the order of David his father, the courses of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their charges, to praise and minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required: the porters also by their courses at every gate: for so had David the man of Elohim commanded.

verses.raw: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
verses.text: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.

verses.raw: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and until it was finished. So the house of Yahuah (LORD) was perfected.
verses.text: Now all the work of Solomon was prepared unto the day of the foundation of the house of Yahuah, and until it was finished. So the house of Yahuah was perfected.

verses.raw: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.
verses.text: Then went Solomon to Ezion-geber, and to Eloth, at the sea side in the land of Edom.

verses.raw: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.
verses.text: And Huram sent him by the hands of his servants ships, and servants that had knowledge of the sea; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took thence four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Solomon.

verses.raw: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.
verses.text: And when the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Solomon, she came to prove Solomon with hard questions at Jerusalem, with a very great company, and camels that bare spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Solomon, she communed with him of all that was in her heart.

verses.raw: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.
verses.text: And Solomon told her all her questions: and there was nothing hid from Solomon which he told her not.

verses.raw: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,
verses.text: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built,

verses.raw: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of Yahuah (LORD); there was no more spirit in her.
verses.text: And the meat of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their apparel; his cupbearers also, and their apparel; and his ascent by which he went up into the house of Yahuah; there was no more spirit in her.

verses.raw: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in my own land of your acts, and of your wisdom:
verses.text: And she said to the king, It was a true report which I heard in my own land of your acts, and of your wisdom:

verses.raw: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and my eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me: for you exceedest the fame that I heard.
verses.text: Howbeit I believed not their words, until I came, and my eyes had seen it: and, behold, the one half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me: for you exceedest the fame that I heard.

verses.raw: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, which stand continually before you, and hear your wisdom.
verses.text: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, which stand continually before you, and hear your wisdom.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which delighted in you to set you on his throne, to be king for Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God): because your Elohim (God) loved Yashar'el (Israel), to establish them for ever, therefore made he you king over them, to do judgment and justice.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohayka, which delighted in you to set you on his throne, to be king for Yahuah Elohayka: because your Elohim loved Yashar'el, to establish them for ever, therefore made he you king over them, to do judgment and justice.

verses.raw: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.
verses.text: And she gave the king an hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave king Solomon.

verses.raw: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
verses.text: And the servants also of Huram, and the servants of Solomon, which brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.

verses.raw: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of Yahuah (LORD), and to the king’s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And the king made of the algum trees terraces to the house of Yahuah, and to the king’s palace, and harps and psalteries for singers: and there were none such seen before in the land of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.
verses.text: And king Solomon gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatsoever she asked, beside that which she had brought unto the king. So she turned, and went away to her own land, she and her servants.

verses.raw: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;
verses.text: Now the weight of gold that came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and threescore and six talents of gold;

verses.raw: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.
verses.text: Beside that which chapmen and merchants brought. And all the kings of Arabia and governors of the country brought gold and silver to Solomon.

verses.raw: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.
verses.text: And king Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold: six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one target.

verses.raw: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
verses.text: And three hundred shields made he of beaten gold: three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king put them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.

verses.raw: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
verses.text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.

verses.raw: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:
verses.text: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on each side of the sitting place, and two lions standing by the stays:

verses.raw: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.
verses.text: And twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other upon the six steps. There was not the like made in any kingdom.

verses.raw: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.
verses.text: And all the drinking vessels of king Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold: none were of silver; it was not any thing accounted of in the days of Solomon.

verses.raw: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
verses.text: For the king’s ships went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram: every three years once came the ships of Tarshish bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.

verses.raw: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
verses.text: And king Solomon passed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.

verses.raw: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that Elohim (God) had put in his heart.
verses.text: And all the kings of the earth sought the presence of Solomon, to hear his wisdom, that Elohim had put in his heart.

verses.raw: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
verses.text: And they brought every man his present, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and raiment, harness, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.

verses.raw: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.
verses.text: And Solomon had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; whom he bestowed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.
verses.text: And he reigned over all the kings from the river even unto the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Egypt.

verses.raw: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.
verses.text: And the king made silver in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycomore trees that are in the low plains in abundance.

verses.raw: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.
verses.text: And they brought unto Solomon horses out of Egypt, and out of all lands.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?

verses.raw: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Yashar'el (Israel) forty years.
verses.text: And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Yashar'el forty years.

verses.raw: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Solomon slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of David his father: and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Yashar'el (Israel) come to make him king.
verses.text: And Rehoboam went to Shechem: for to Shechem were all Yashar'el come to make him king.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who was in Egypt, whither he had fled from the presence of Solomon the king, heard it, that Jeroboam returned out of Egypt.

verses.raw: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Yashar'el (Israel) came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,
verses.text: And they sent and called him. So Jeroboam and all Yashar'el came and spake to Rehoboam, saying,

verses.raw: Your father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease you somewhat the grievous servitude of your father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve you.
verses.text: Your father made our yoke grievous: now therefore ease you somewhat the grievous servitude of your father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve you.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Come again unto me after three days. And the people departed.

verses.raw: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give you me to return answer to this people?
verses.text: And king Rehoboam took counsel with the old men that had stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give you me to return answer to this people?

verses.raw: And they spake unto him, saying, If you be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be your servants for ever.
verses.text: And they spake unto him, saying, If you be kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, they will be your servants for ever.

verses.raw: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.
verses.text: But he forsook the counsel which the old men gave him, and took counsel with the young men that were brought up with him, that stood before him.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, What advice give you that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that your father did put upon us?
verses.text: And he said unto them, What advice give you that we may return answer to this people, which have spoken to me, saying, Ease somewhat the yoke that your father did put upon us?

verses.raw: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shall you answer the people that spake unto you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but make you it somewhat lighter for us; thus shall you say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.
verses.text: And the young men that were brought up with him spake unto him, saying, Thus shall you answer the people that spake unto you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but make you it somewhat lighter for us; thus shall you say unto them, My little finger shall be thicker than my father’s loins.

verses.raw: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.text: For whereas my father put a heavy yoke upon you, I will put more to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.raw: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.
verses.text: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come again to me on the third day.

verses.raw: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,
verses.text: And the king answered them roughly; and king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the old men,

verses.raw: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.
verses.text: And answered them after the advice of the young men, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions.

verses.raw: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of Elohim (God), that Yahuah (LORD) might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.
verses.text: So the king hearkened not unto the people: for the cause was of Elohim, that Yahuah might perform his word, which he spake by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam the son of Nebat.

verses.raw: And when all Yashar'el (Israel) saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Yashar'el (Israel): and now, David, see to your own house. So all Yashar'el (Israel) went to their tents.
verses.text: And when all Yashar'el saw that the king would not hearken unto them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in David? and we have none inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to your tents, O Yashar'el: and now, David, see to your own house. So all Yashar'el went to their tents.

verses.raw: But as for the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that dwelt in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), Rehoboam reigned over them.
verses.text: But as for the children of Yashar'el that dwelt in the cities of Yahudah, Rehoboam reigned over them.

verses.raw: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Then king Rehoboam sent Hadoram that was over the tribute; and the children of Yashar'el stoned him with stones, that he died. But king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Yashar'el (Israel) rebelled against the house of David unto this day.
verses.text: And Yashar'el rebelled against the house of David unto this day.

verses.raw: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Yashar'el (Israel), that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.text: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Yahudah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Yashar'el, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.

verses.raw: But the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Shemaiah the man of Elohim (God), saying,
verses.text: But the word of Yahuah came to Shemaiah the man of Elohim, saying,

verses.raw: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Yahudah (Judah), and to all Yashar'el (Israel) in Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin, saying,
verses.text: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Yahudah, and to all Yashar'el in Yahudah and Benjamin, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), You shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of Yahuah (LORD), and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, You shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of Yahuah, and returned from going against Jeroboam.

verses.raw: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Yahudah.

verses.raw: He built even Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.text: He built even Beth-lehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,

verses.raw: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
verses.text: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,

verses.raw: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.text: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

verses.raw: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.text: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,

verses.raw: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Yahudah (Judah) and in Benjamin fenced cities.
verses.text: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Yahudah and in Benjamin fenced cities.

verses.raw: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
verses.text: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.

verses.raw: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin on his side.
verses.text: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Yahudah and Benjamin on his side.

verses.raw: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Yashar'el (Israel) resorted to him out of all their coasts.
verses.text: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Yashar'el resorted to him out of all their coasts.

verses.raw: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest’s office unto Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Yahudah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest’s office unto Yahuah:

verses.raw: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.text: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.

verses.raw: And after them out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) such as set their hearts to seek Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers.
verses.text: And after them out of all the tribes of Yashar'el such as set their hearts to seek Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto Yahuah Elohim of their fathers.

verses.raw: So they strengthened the kingdom of Yahudah (Judah), and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.text: So they strengthened the kingdom of Yahudah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.

verses.raw: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.text: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;

verses.raw: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
verses.text: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.

verses.raw: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.text: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.

verses.raw: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
verses.text: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)

verses.raw: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
verses.text: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.

verses.raw: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
verses.text: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Yahudah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of Yahuah (LORD), and all Yashar'el (Israel) with him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Rehoboam had established the kingdom, and had strengthened himself, he forsook the law of Yahuah, and all Yashar'el with him.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: And it came to pass, that in the fifth year of king Rehoboam Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, because they had transgressed against Yahuah,

verses.raw: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.
verses.text: With twelve hundred chariots, and threescore thousand horsemen: and the people were without number that came with him out of Egypt; the Lubims, the Sukkiims, and the Ethiopians.

verses.raw: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Yahudah (Judah), and came to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he took the fenced cities which pertained to Yahudah, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Yahudah (Judah), that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), You have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
verses.text: Then came Shemaiah the prophet to Rehoboam, and to the princes of Yahudah, that were gathered together to Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said unto them, Thus says Yahuah, You have forsaken me, and therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.

verses.raw: Whereupon the princes of Yashar'el (Israel) and the king humbled themselves; and they said, Yahuah (LORD) is righteous.
verses.text: Whereupon the princes of Yashar'el and the king humbled themselves; and they said, Yahuah is righteous.

verses.raw: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that they humbled themselves, the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
verses.text: And when Yahuah saw that they humbled themselves, the word of Yahuah came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves; therefore I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance; and my wrath shall not be poured out upon Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.

verses.raw: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
verses.text: Nevertheless they shall be his servants; that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.

verses.raw: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and the treasures of the king’s house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.
verses.text: So Shishak king of Egypt came up against Jerusalem, and took away the treasures of the house of Yahuah, and the treasures of the king’s house; he took all: he carried away also the shields of gold which Solomon had made.

verses.raw: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king’s house.
verses.text: Instead of which king Rehoboam made shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the chief of the guard, that kept the entrance of the king’s house.

verses.raw: And when the king entered into the house of Yahuah (LORD), the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.
verses.text: And when the king entered into the house of Yahuah, the guard came and fetched them, and brought them again into the guard chamber.

verses.raw: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Yahudah (Judah) things went well.
verses.text: And when he humbled himself, the wrath of Yahuah turned from him, that he would not destroy him altogether: and also in Yahudah things went well.

verses.raw: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahuah (LORD) had chosen out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.
verses.text: So king Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem, and reigned: for Rehoboam was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city which Yahuah had chosen out of all the tribes of Yashar'el, to put his name there. And his mother’s name was Naamah an Ammonitess.

verses.raw: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he did evil, because he prepared not his heart to seek Yahuah.

verses.raw: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.
verses.text: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not written in the book of Shemaiah the prophet, and of Iddo the seer concerning genealogies? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continually.

verses.raw: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Rehoboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David: and Abijah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam began Abijah to reign over Yahudah.

verses.raw: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
verses.text: He reigned three years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Michaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.

verses.raw: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.
verses.text: And Abijah set the battle in array with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: Jeroboam also set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, being mighty men of valour.

verses.raw: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, you Jeroboam, and all Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: And Abijah stood up upon mount Zemaraim, which is in mount Ephraim, and said, Hear me, you Jeroboam, and all Yashar'el;

verses.raw: Ought you not to know that Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) gave the kingdom over Yashar'el (Israel) to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
verses.text: Ought you not to know that Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el gave the kingdom over Yashar'el to David for ever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?

verses.raw: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and has rebelled against his lord.
verses.text: Yet Jeroboam the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon the son of David, is risen up, and has rebelled against his lord.

verses.raw: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.
verses.text: And there are gathered unto him vain men, the children of Belial, and have strengthened themselves against Rehoboam the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tenderhearted, and could not withstand them.

verses.raw: And now you think to withstand the kingdom of Yahuah (LORD) in the hand of the sons of David; and you be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.
verses.text: And now you think to withstand the kingdom of Yahuah in the hand of the sons of David; and you be a great multitude, and there are with you golden calves, which Jeroboam made you for gods.

verses.raw: Have you not cast out the priests of Yahuah (LORD), the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.
verses.text: Have you not cast out the priests of Yahuah, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and have made you priests after the manner of the nations of other lands? so that whosoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bullock and seven rams, the same may be a priest of them that are no gods.

verses.raw: But as for us, Yahuah (LORD) is our Elohim (God), and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto Yahuah (LORD), are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:
verses.text: But as for us, Yahuah is our Elohim, and we have not forsaken him; and the priests, which minister unto Yahuah, are the sons of Aaron, and the Levites wait upon their business:

verses.raw: And they burn unto Yahuah (LORD) every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God); but you have forsaken him.
verses.text: And they burn unto Yahuah every morning and every evening burnt sacrifices and sweet incense: the shewbread also set they in order upon the pure table; and the candlestick of gold with the lamps thereof, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of Yahuah Eloheinu; but you have forsaken him.

verses.raw: And, behold, Elohim (God) himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Yashar'el (Israel), fight you not against Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of your fathers; for you shall not prosper.
verses.text: And, behold, Elohim himself is with us for our captain, and his priests with sounding trumpets to cry alarm against you. O children of Yashar'el, fight you not against Yahuah Elohim of your fathers; for you shall not prosper.

verses.raw: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Yahudah (Judah), and the ambushment was behind them.
verses.text: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Yahudah, and the ambushment was behind them.

verses.raw: And when Yahudah (Judah) looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
verses.text: And when Yahudah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind: and they cried unto Yahuah, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.

verses.raw: Then the men of Yahudah (Judah) gave a shout: and as the men of Yahudah (Judah) shouted, it came to pass, that Elohim (God) smote Jeroboam and all Yashar'el (Israel) before Abijah and Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Then the men of Yahudah gave a shout: and as the men of Yahudah shouted, it came to pass, that Elohim smote Jeroboam and all Yashar'el before Abijah and Yahudah.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) fled before Yahudah (Judah): and Elohim (God) delivered them into their hand.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el fled before Yahudah: and Elohim delivered them into their hand.

verses.raw: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Yashar'el (Israel) five hundred thousand chosen men.
verses.text: And Abijah and his people slew them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Yashar'el five hundred thousand chosen men.

verses.raw: Thus the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were brought under at that time, and the children of Yahudah (Judah) prevailed, because they relied upon Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers.
verses.text: Thus the children of Yashar'el were brought under at that time, and the children of Yahudah prevailed, because they relied upon Yahuah Elohim of their fathers.

verses.raw: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.
verses.text: And Abijah pursued after Jeroboam, and took cities from him, Beth-el with the towns thereof, and Jeshanah with the towns thereof, and Ephrain with the towns thereof.

verses.raw: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and Yahuah (LORD) struck him, and he died.
verses.text: Neither did Jeroboam recover strength again in the days of Abijah: and Yahuah struck him, and he died.

verses.raw: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.
verses.text: But Abijah waxed mighty, and married fourteen wives, and begat twenty and two sons, and sixteen daughters.

verses.raw: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.
verses.text: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the story of the prophet Iddo.

verses.raw: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
verses.text: So Abijah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead. In his days the land was quiet ten years.

verses.raw: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God):
verses.text: And Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of Yahuah Elohav:

verses.raw: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:
verses.text: For he took away the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and brake down the images, and cut down the groves:

verses.raw: And commanded Yahudah (Judah) to seek Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
verses.text: And commanded Yahudah to seek Yahuah Elohim of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.

verses.raw: Also he took away out of all the cities of Yahudah (Judah) the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
verses.text: Also he took away out of all the cities of Yahudah the high places and the images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.

verses.raw: And he built fenced cities in Yahudah (Judah): for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because Yahuah (LORD) had given him rest.
verses.text: And he built fenced cities in Yahudah: for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years; because Yahuah had given him rest.

verses.raw: Therefore he said unto Yahudah (Judah), Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), we have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
verses.text: Therefore he said unto Yahudah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars, while the land is yet before us; because we have sought Yahuah Eloheinu, we have sought him, and he has given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.

verses.raw: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Yahudah (Judah) three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.
verses.text: And Asa had an army of men that bare targets and spears, out of Yahudah three hundred thousand; and out of Benjamin, that bare shields and drew bows, two hundred and fourscore thousand: all these were mighty men of valour.

verses.raw: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
verses.text: And there came out against them Zerah the Ethiopian with an host of a thousand thousand, and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.

verses.raw: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
verses.text: Then Asa went out against him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

verses.raw: And Asa cried unto Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), and said, Yahuah (LORD), it is nothing with you to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God); for we rest on you, and in your name we go against this multitude. O Yahuah (LORD), you are our Elohim (God); let not man prevail against you.
verses.text: And Asa cried unto Yahuah Elohav, and said, Yahuah, it is nothing with you to help, whether with many, or with them that have no power: help us, O Yahuah our Elohim; for we rest on you, and in your name we go against this multitude. O Yahuah, you are our Elohim; let not man prevail against you.

verses.raw: So Yahuah (LORD) smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Yahudah (Judah); and the Ethiopians fled.
verses.text: So Yahuah smote the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Yahudah; and the Ethiopians fled.

verses.raw: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before Yahuah (LORD), and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.
verses.text: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them unto Gerar: and the Ethiopians were overthrown, that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before Yahuah, and before his host; and they carried away very much spoil.

verses.raw: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of Yahuah (LORD) came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
verses.text: And they smote all the cities round about Gerar; for the fear of Yahuah came upon them: and they spoiled all the cities; for there was exceeding much spoil in them.

verses.raw: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text: They smote also the tents of cattle, and carried away sheep and camels in abundance, and returned to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And the Spirit of Elohim (God) came upon Azariah the son of Oded:
verses.text: And the Spirit of Elohim came upon Azariah the son of Oded:

verses.raw: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear you me, Asa, and all Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin; Yahuah (LORD) is with you, while you be with him; and if you seek him, he will be found of you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
verses.text: And he went out to meet Asa, and said unto him, Hear you me, Asa, and all Yahudah and Benjamin; Yahuah is with you, while you be with him; and if you seek him, he will be found of you; but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.

verses.raw: Now for a long season Yashar'el (Israel) has been without the true Elohim (God), and without a teaching priest, and without law.
verses.text: Now for a long season Yashar'el has been without the true Elohim, and without a teaching priest, and without law.

verses.raw: But when they in their trouble did turn unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and sought him, he was found of them.
verses.text: But when they in their trouble did turn unto Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, and sought him, he was found of them.

verses.raw: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.
verses.text: And in those times there was no peace to him that went out, nor to him that came in, but great vexations were upon all the inhabitants of the countries.

verses.raw: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for Elohim (God) did vex them with all adversity.
verses.text: And nation was destroyed of nation, and city of city: for Elohim did vex them with all adversity.

verses.raw: Be you strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.
verses.text: Be you strong therefore, and let not your hands be weak: for your work shall be rewarded.

verses.raw: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of Yahuah (LORD), that was before the porch of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And when Asa heard these words, and the prophecy of Oded the prophet, he took courage, and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Yahudah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim, and renewed the altar of Yahuah, that was before the porch of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he gathered all Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Yashar'el (Israel) in abundance, when they saw that Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) was with him.
verses.text: And he gathered all Yahudah and Benjamin, and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh, and out of Simeon: for they fell to him out of Yashar'el in abundance, when they saw that Yahuah Elohav was with him.

verses.raw: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.text: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.

verses.raw: And they offered unto Yahuah (LORD) the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
verses.text: And they offered unto Yahuah the same time, of the spoil which they had brought, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.

verses.raw: And they entered into a covenant to seek Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;
verses.text: And they entered into a covenant to seek Yahuah Elohim of their fathers with all their heart and with all their soul;

verses.raw: That whosoever would not seek Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.
verses.text: That whosoever would not seek Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el should be put to death, whether small or great, whether man or woman.

verses.raw: And they sware unto Yahuah (LORD) with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.
verses.text: And they sware unto Yahuah with a loud voice, and with shouting, and with trumpets, and with cornets.

verses.raw: And all Yahudah (Judah) rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and Yahuah (LORD) gave them rest round about.
verses.text: And all Yahudah rejoiced at the oath: for they had sworn with all their heart, and sought him with their whole desire; and he was found of them: and Yahuah gave them rest round about.

verses.raw: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.
verses.text: And also concerning Maachah the mother of Asa the king, he removed her from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove: and Asa cut down her idol, and stamped it, and burnt it at the brook Kidron.

verses.raw: But the high places were not taken away out of Yashar'el (Israel): nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
verses.text: But the high places were not taken away out of Yashar'el: nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.

verses.raw: And he brought into the house of Elohim (God) the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.text: And he brought into the house of Elohim the things that his father had dedicated, and that he himself had dedicated, silver, and gold, and vessels.

verses.raw: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.
verses.text: And there was no more war unto the five and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa.

verses.raw: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel) came up against Yahudah (Judah), and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: In the six and thirtieth year of the reign of Asa Baasha king of Yashar'el came up against Yahudah, and built Ramah, to the intent that he might let none go out or come in to Asa king of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of Yahuah (LORD) and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.text: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of Yahuah and of the king’s house, and sent to Ben-hadad king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,

verses.raw: There is a league between me and you, as there was between my father and your father: behold, I have sent you silver and gold; go, break your league with Baasha king of Yashar'el (Israel), that he may depart from me.
verses.text: There is a league between me and you, as there was between my father and your father: behold, I have sent you silver and gold; go, break your league with Baasha king of Yashar'el, that he may depart from me.

verses.raw: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Yashar'el (Israel); and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.
verses.text: And Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Yashar'el; and they smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-maim, and all the store cities of Naphtali.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard it, that he left off building of Ramah, and let his work cease.

verses.raw: Then Asa the king took all Yahudah (Judah); and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.
verses.text: Then Asa the king took all Yahudah; and they carried away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha was building; and he built therewith Geba and Mizpah.

verses.raw: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Yahudah (Judah), and said unto him, Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of your hand.
verses.text: And at that time Hanani the seer came to Asa king of Yahudah, and said unto him, Because you have relied on the king of Syria, and not relied on Yahuah Elohayka, therefore is the host of the king of Syria escaped out of your hand.

verses.raw: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because you did rely on Yahuah (LORD), he delivered them into your hand.
verses.text: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubims a huge host, with very many chariots and horsemen? yet, because you did rely on Yahuah, he delivered them into your hand.

verses.raw: For the eyes of Yahuah (LORD) run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein you have done foolishly: therefore from henceforth you shall have wars.
verses.text: For the eyes of Yahuah run to and fro throughout the whole earth, to shew himself strong in the behalf of them whose heart is perfect toward him. Herein you have done foolishly: therefore from henceforth you shall have wars.

verses.raw: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.
verses.text: Then Asa was wroth with the seer, and put him in a prison house; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. And Asa oppressed some of the people the same time.

verses.raw: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And, behold, the acts of Asa, first and last, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Yahudah and Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to Yahuah (LORD), but to the physicians.
verses.text: And Asa in the thirty and ninth year of his reign was diseased in his feet, until his disease was exceeding great: yet in his disease he sought not to Yahuah, but to the physicians.

verses.raw: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
verses.text: And Asa slept with his fathers, and died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.

verses.raw: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries’ are: and they made a very great burning for him.
verses.text: And they buried him in his own sepulchres, which he had made for himself in the city of David, and laid him in the bed which was filled with sweet odours and divers kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries’ are: and they made a very great burning for him.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead, and strengthened himself against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Yahudah (Judah), and set garrisons in the land of Yahudah (Judah), and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
verses.text: And he placed forces in all the fenced cities of Yahudah, and set garrisons in the land of Yahudah, and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;
verses.text: And Yahuah was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and sought not unto Baalim;

verses.raw: But sought to Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But sought to Yahuah Elohim of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not after the doings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (LORD) stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Yahudah (Judah) brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah stablished the kingdom in his hand; and all Yahudah brought to Jehoshaphat presents; and he had riches and honour in abundance.

verses.raw: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahuah (LORD): moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And his heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahuah: moreover he took away the high places and groves out of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Also in the third year of his reign he sent to his princes, even to Ben-hail, and to Obadiah, and to Zechariah, and to Nethaneel, and to Michaiah, to teach in the cities of Yahudah.

verses.raw: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.
verses.text: And with them he sent Levites, even Shemaiah, and Nethaniah, and Zebadiah, and Asahel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehonathan, and Adonijah, and Tobijah, and Tob-adonijah, Levites; and with them Elishama and Jehoram, priests.

verses.raw: And they taught in Yahudah (Judah), and had the book of the law of Yahuah (LORD) with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and taught the people.
verses.text: And they taught in Yahudah, and had the book of the law of Yahuah with them, and went about throughout all the cities of Yahudah, and taught the people.

verses.raw: And the fear of Yahuah (LORD) fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Yahudah (Judah), so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.
verses.text: And the fear of Yahuah fell upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Yahudah, so that they made no war against Jehoshaphat.

verses.raw: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.
verses.text: Also some of the Philistines brought Jehoshaphat presents, and tribute silver; and the Arabians brought him flocks, seven thousand and seven hundred rams, and seven thousand and seven hundred he goats.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Yahudah (Judah) castles, and cities of store.
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly; and he built in Yahudah castles, and cities of store.

verses.raw: And he had much business in the cities of Yahudah (Judah): and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he had much business in the cities of Yahudah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Yahudah (Judah), the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.
verses.text: And these are the numbers of them according to the house of their fathers: Of Yahudah, the captains of thousands; Adnah the chief, and with him mighty men of valour three hundred thousand.

verses.raw: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.
verses.text: And next to him was Jehohanan the captain, and with him two hundred and fourscore thousand.

verses.raw: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto Yahuah (LORD); and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.
verses.text: And next him was Amasiah the son of Zichri, who willingly offered himself unto Yahuah; and with him two hundred thousand mighty men of valour.

verses.raw: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.
verses.text: And of Benjamin; Eliada a mighty man of valour, and with him armed men with bow and shield two hundred thousand.

verses.raw: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.
verses.text: And next him was Jehozabad, and with him an hundred and fourscore thousand ready prepared for the war.

verses.raw: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: These waited on the king, beside those whom the king put in the fenced cities throughout all Yahudah.

verses.raw: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.
verses.text: Now Jehoshaphat had riches and honour in abundance, and joined affinity with Ahab.

verses.raw: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.text: And after certain years he went down to Ahab to Samaria. And Ahab killed sheep and oxen for him in abundance, and for the people that he had with him, and persuaded him to go up with him to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.raw: And Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah (Judah), Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he answered him, I am as you are, and my people as your people; and we will be with you in the war.
verses.text: And Ahab king of Yashar'el said unto Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah, Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he answered him, I am as you are, and my people as your people; and we will be with you in the war.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Yashar'el (Israel), Enquire, I pray you, at the word of Yahuah (LORD) to day.
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat said unto the king of Yashar'el, Enquire, I pray you, at the word of Yahuah to day.

verses.raw: Therefore the king of Yashar'el (Israel) gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for Elohim (God) will deliver it into the king’s hand.
verses.text: Therefore the king of Yashar'el gathered together of prophets four hundred men, and said unto them, Shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And they said, Go up; for Elohim will deliver it into the king’s hand.

verses.raw: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Yahuah (LORD) besides, that we might enquire of him?
verses.text: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there not here a prophet of Yahuah besides, that we might enquire of him?

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of Yahuah (LORD): but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el said unto Jehoshaphat, There is yet one man, by whom we may enquire of Yahuah: but I hate him; for he never prophesied good unto me, but always evil: the same is Micaiah the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el called for one of his officers, and said, Fetch quickly Micaiah the son of Imla.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) and Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah (Judah) sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el and Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah sat either of them on his throne, clothed in their robes, and they sat in a void place at the entering in of the gate of Samaria; and all the prophets prophesied before them.

verses.raw: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), With these you shall push Syria until they be consumed.
verses.text: And Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah had made him horns of iron, and said, Thus says Yahuah, With these you shall push Syria until they be consumed.

verses.raw: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for Yahuah (LORD) shall deliver it into the hand of the king.
verses.text: And all the prophets prophesied so, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and prosper: for Yahuah shall deliver it into the hand of the king.

verses.raw: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let your word therefore, I pray you, be like one of theirs, and speak you good.
verses.text: And the messenger that went to call Micaiah spake to him, saying, Behold, the words of the prophets declare good to the king with one assent; let your word therefore, I pray you, be like one of theirs, and speak you good.

verses.raw: And Micaiah said, As Yahuah (LORD) lives, even what my Elohim (God) says, that will I speak.
verses.text: And Micaiah said, As Yahuah lives, even what my Elohim says, that will I speak.

verses.raw: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go you up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.
verses.text: And when he was come to the king, the king said unto him, Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth-gilead to battle, or shall I forbear? And he said, Go you up, and prosper, and they shall be delivered into your hand.

verses.raw: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure you that you say nothing but the truth to me in the name of Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: And the king said to him, How many times shall I adjure you that you say nothing but the truth to me in the name of Yahuah?

verses.raw: Then he said, I did see all Yashar'el (Israel) scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and Yahuah (LORD) said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.
verses.text: Then he said, I did see all Yashar'el scattered upon the mountains, as sheep that have no shepherd: and Yahuah said, These have no master; let them return therefore every man to his house in peace.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not tell you that he would not prophesy good unto me, but evil?

verses.raw: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of Yahuah (LORD); I saw Yahuah (LORD) sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.
verses.text: Again he said, Therefore hear the word of Yahuah; I saw Yahuah sitting upon his throne, and all the host of heaven standing on his right hand and on his left.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel), that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.
verses.text: And Yahuah said, Who shall entice Ahab king of Yashar'el, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth-gilead? And one spake saying after this manner, and another saying after that manner.

verses.raw: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before Yahuah (LORD), and said, I will entice him. And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Wherewith?
verses.text: Then there came out a spirit, and stood before Yahuah, and said, I will entice him. And Yahuah said unto him, Wherewith?

verses.raw: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And Yahuah (LORD) said, You shall entice him, and you shall also prevail: go out, and do even so.
verses.text: And he said, I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets. And Yahuah said, You shall entice him, and you shall also prevail: go out, and do even so.
