verses.raw: Now therefore, behold, Yahuah (LORD) has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets, and Yahuah (LORD) has spoken evil against you.
verses.text: Now therefore, behold, Yahuah has put a lying spirit in the mouth of these your prophets, and Yahuah has spoken evil against you.

verses.raw: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) from me to speak unto you?
verses.text: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near, and smote Micaiah upon the cheek, and said, Which way went the Spirit of Yahuah from me to speak unto you?

verses.raw: And Micaiah said, Behold, you shall see on that day when you shall go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.
verses.text: And Micaiah said, Behold, you shall see on that day when you shall go into an inner chamber to hide thyself.

verses.raw: Then the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said, Take you Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;
verses.text: Then the king of Yashar'el said, Take you Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joash the king’s son;

verses.raw: And say, Thus says the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.
verses.text: And say, Thus says the king, Put this fellow in the prison, and feed him with bread of affliction and with water of affliction, until I return in peace.

verses.raw: And Micaiah said, If you certainly return in peace, then has not Yahuah (LORD) spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all you people.
verses.text: And Micaiah said, If you certainly return in peace, then has not Yahuah spoken by me. And he said, Hearken, all you people.

verses.raw: So the king of Yashar'el (Israel) and Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah (Judah) went up to Ramoth-gilead.
verses.text: So the king of Yashar'el and Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah went up to Ramoth-gilead.

verses.raw: And the king of Yashar'el (Israel) said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put you on your robes. So the king of Yashar'el (Israel) disguised himself; and they went to the battle.
verses.text: And the king of Yashar'el said unto Jehoshaphat, I will disguise myself, and will go to the battle; but put you on your robes. So the king of Yashar'el disguised himself; and they went to the battle.

verses.raw: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight you not with small or great, save only with the king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of the chariots that were with him, saying, Fight you not with small or great, save only with the king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Yashar'el (Israel). Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and Yahuah (LORD) helped him; and Elohim (God) moved them to depart from him.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the captains of the chariots saw Jehoshaphat, that they said, It is the king of Yashar'el. Therefore they compassed about him to fight: but Jehoshaphat cried out, and Yahuah helped him; and Elohim moved them to depart from him.

verses.raw: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Yashar'el (Israel), they turned back again from pursuing him.
verses.text: For it came to pass, that, when the captains of the chariots perceived that it was not the king of Yashar'el, they turned back again from pursuing him.

verses.raw: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Yashar'el (Israel) between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn your hand, that you may carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.
verses.text: And a certain man drew a bow at a venture, and smote the king of Yashar'el between the joints of the harness: therefore he said to his chariot man, Turn your hand, that you may carry me out of the host; for I am wounded.

verses.raw: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Yashar'el (Israel) stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.
verses.text: And the battle increased that day: howbeit the king of Yashar'el stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even: and about the time of the sun going down he died.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah (Judah) returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat the king of Yahudah returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Should you help the ungodly, and love them that hate Yahuah (LORD)? therefore is wrath upon you from before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Jehoshaphat, Should you help the ungodly, and love them that hate Yahuah? therefore is wrath upon you from before Yahuah.

verses.raw: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have taken away the groves out of the land, and have prepared your heart to seek Elohim (God).
verses.text: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have taken away the groves out of the land, and have prepared your heart to seek Elohim.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers.
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat dwelt at Jerusalem: and he went out again through the people from Beer-sheba to mount Ephraim, and brought them back unto Yahuah Elohim of their fathers.

verses.raw: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Yahudah (Judah), city by city,
verses.text: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Yahudah, city by city,

verses.raw: And said to the judges, Take heed what you do: for you judge not for man, but for Yahuah (LORD), who is with you in the judgment.
verses.text: And said to the judges, Take heed what you do: for you judge not for man, but for Yahuah, who is with you in the judgment.

verses.raw: Wherefore now let the fear of Yahuah (LORD) be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.
verses.text: Wherefore now let the fear of Yahuah be upon you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with Yahuah Eloheinu, nor respect of persons, nor taking of gifts.

verses.raw: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Yashar'el (Israel), for the judgment of Yahuah (LORD), and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Moreover in Jerusalem did Jehoshaphat set of the Levites, and of the priests, and of the chief of the fathers of Yashar'el, for the judgment of Yahuah, and for controversies, when they returned to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall you do in the fear of Yahuah (LORD), faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
verses.text: And he charged them, saying, Thus shall you do in the fear of Yahuah, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.

verses.raw: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, you shall even warn them that they trespass not against Yahuah (LORD), and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and you shall not trespass.
verses.text: And what cause soever shall come to you of your brethren that dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and judgments, you shall even warn them that they trespass not against Yahuah, and so wrath come upon you, and upon your brethren: this do, and you shall not trespass.

verses.raw: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of Yahuah (LORD); and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Yahudah (Judah), for all the king’s matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and Yahuah (LORD) shall be with the good.
verses.text: And, behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of Yahuah; and Zebadiah the son of Ishmael, the ruler of the house of Yahudah, for all the king’s matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and Yahuah shall be with the good.

verses.raw: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.
verses.text: It came to pass after this also, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them other beside the Ammonites, came against Jehoshaphat to battle.

verses.raw: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There comes a great multitude against you from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi.
verses.text: Then there came some that told Jehoshaphat, saying, There comes a great multitude against you from beyond the sea on this side Syria; and, behold, they be in Hazazon-tamar, which is En-gedi.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek Yahuah (LORD), and proclaimed a fast throughout all Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat feared, and set himself to seek Yahuah, and proclaimed a fast throughout all Yahudah.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) gathered themselves together, to ask help of Yahuah (LORD): even out of all the cities of Yahudah (Judah) they came to seek Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Yahudah gathered themselves together, to ask help of Yahuah: even out of all the cities of Yahudah they came to seek Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, in the house of Yahuah (LORD), before the new court,
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat stood in the congregation of Yahudah and Jerusalem, in the house of Yahuah, before the new court,

verses.raw: And said, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of our fathers, are not you Elohim (God) in heaven? and rulest not you over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in your hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand you?
verses.text: And said, O Yahuah Elohim of our fathers, are not you Elohim in heaven? and rulest not you over all the kingdoms of the heathen? and in your hand is there not power and might, so that none is able to withstand you?

verses.raw: Are not you our Elohim (God), who did drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Yashar'el (Israel), and gave it to the seed of Abraham your friend for ever?
verses.text: Are not you our Elohim, who did drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Yashar'el, and gave it to the seed of Abraham your friend for ever?

verses.raw: And they dwelt therein, and have built you a sanctuary therein for your name, saying,
verses.text: And they dwelt therein, and have built you a sanctuary therein for your name, saying,

verses.raw: If, when evil comes upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in your presence, (for your name is in this house,) and cry unto you in our affliction, then you will hear and help.
verses.text: If, when evil comes upon us, as the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we stand before this house, and in your presence, (for your name is in this house,) and cry unto you in our affliction, then you will hear and help.

verses.raw: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom you would not let Yashar'el (Israel) invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;
verses.text: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom you would not let Yashar'el invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned from them, and destroyed them not;

verses.raw: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.
verses.text: Behold, I say, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.

verses.raw: O our Elohim (God), will you not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that comes against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon you.
verses.text: O our Elohim, will you not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that comes against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are upon you.

verses.raw: And all Yahudah (Judah) stood before Yahuah (LORD), with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
verses.text: And all Yahudah stood before Yahuah, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.

verses.raw: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of Yahuah (LORD) in the midst of the congregation;
verses.text: Then upon Jahaziel the son of Zechariah, the son of Benaiah, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, a Levite of the sons of Asaph, came the Spirit of Yahuah in the midst of the congregation;

verses.raw: And he said, Hearken you, all Yahudah (Judah), and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you king Jehoshaphat, Thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but Elohim's (God’s).
verses.text: And he said, Hearken you, all Yahudah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem, and you king Jehoshaphat, Thus says Yahuah unto you, Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but Elohim's (God’s).

verses.raw: To morrow go you down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and you shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
verses.text: To morrow go you down against them: behold, they come up by the cliff of Ziz; and you shall find them at the end of the brook, before the wilderness of Jeruel.

verses.raw: You shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand you still, and see the salvation of Yahuah (LORD) with you, O Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for Yahuah (LORD) will be with you.
verses.text: You shall not need to fight in this battle: set yourselves, stand you still, and see the salvation of Yahuah with you, O Yahudah and Jerusalem: fear not, nor be dismayed; to morrow go out against them: for Yahuah will be with you.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Yahudah (Judah) and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before Yahuah (LORD), worshipping Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat bowed his head with his face to the ground: and all Yahudah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem fell before Yahuah, worshipping Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) with a loud voice on high.
verses.text: And the Levites, of the children of the Kohathites, and of the children of the Korhites, stood up to praise Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el with a loud voice on high.

verses.raw: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Yahudah (Judah), and you inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), so shall you be established; believe his prophets, so shall you prosper.
verses.text: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Yahudah, and you inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in Yahuah Elohaychem, so shall you be established; believe his prophets, so shall you prosper.

verses.raw: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto Yahuah (LORD), and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise Yahuah (LORD); for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: And when he had consulted with the people, he appointed singers unto Yahuah, and that should praise the beauty of holiness, as they went out before the army, and to say, Praise Yahuah; for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: And when they began to sing and to praise, Yahuah (LORD) set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Yahudah (Judah); and they were smitten.
verses.text: And when they began to sing and to praise, Yahuah set ambushments against the children of Ammon, Moab, and mount Seir, which were come against Yahudah; and they were smitten.

verses.raw: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.
verses.text: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount Seir, utterly to slay and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, every one helped to destroy another.

verses.raw: And when Yahudah (Judah) came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.
verses.text: And when Yahudah came toward the watch tower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude, and, behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and none escaped.

verses.raw: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.
verses.text: And when Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches with the dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in gathering of the spoil, it was so much.

verses.raw: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed Yahuah (LORD): therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.
verses.text: And on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed Yahuah: therefore the name of the same place was called, The valley of Berachah, unto this day.

verses.raw: Then they returned, every man of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for Yahuah (LORD) had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
verses.text: Then they returned, every man of Yahudah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for Yahuah had made them to rejoice over their enemies.

verses.raw: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the fear of Elohim (God) was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that Yahuah (LORD) fought against the enemies of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And the fear of Elohim was on all the kingdoms of those countries, when they had heard that Yahuah fought against the enemies of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his Elohim (God) gave him rest round about.
verses.text: So the realm of Jehoshaphat was quiet: for his Elohim gave him rest round about.

verses.raw: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Yahudah (Judah): he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
verses.text: And Jehoshaphat reigned over Yahudah: he was thirty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and five years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.

verses.raw: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he walked in the way of Asa his father, and departed not from it, doing that which was right in the sight of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the Elohim (God) of their fathers.
verses.text: Howbeit the high places were not taken away: for as yet the people had not prepared their hearts unto the Elohim of their fathers.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of Jehu the son of Hanani, who is mentioned in the book of the kings of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah (Judah) join himself with Ahaziah king of Yashar'el (Israel), who did very wickedly:
verses.text: And after this did Jehoshaphat king of Yahudah join himself with Ahaziah king of Yashar'el, who did very wickedly:

verses.raw: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.
verses.text: And he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish: and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.

verses.raw: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because you have joined thyself with Ahaziah, Yahuah (LORD) has broken your works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
verses.text: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, Because you have joined thyself with Ahaziah, Yahuah has broken your works. And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

verses.raw: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: Now Jehoshaphat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David. And Jehoram his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he had brethren the sons of Jehoshaphat, Azariah, and Jehiel, and Zechariah, and Azariah, and Michael, and Shephatiah: all these were the sons of Jehoshaphat king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Yahudah (Judah): but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.
verses.text: And their father gave them great gifts of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fenced cities in Yahudah: but the kingdom gave he to Jehoram; because he was the firstborn.

verses.raw: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now when Jehoram was risen up to the kingdom of his father, he strengthened himself, and slew all his brethren with the sword, and divers also of the princes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Jehoram was thirty and two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he walked in the way of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel), like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he walked in the way of the kings of Yashar'el, like as did the house of Ahab: for he had the daughter of Ahab to wife: and he wrought that which was evil in the eyes of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Howbeit Yahuah (LORD) would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.
verses.text: Howbeit Yahuah would not destroy the house of David, because of the covenant that he had made with David, and as he promised to give a light to him and to his sons for ever.

verses.raw: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Yahudah (Judah), and made themselves a king.
verses.text: In his days the Edomites revolted from under the dominion of Yahudah, and made themselves a king.

verses.raw: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.
verses.text: Then Jehoram went forth with his princes, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and smote the Edomites which compassed him in, and the captains of the chariots.

verses.raw: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Yahudah (Judah) unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of his fathers.
verses.text: So the Edomites revolted from under the hand of Yahudah unto this day. The same time also did Libnah revolt from under his hand; because he had forsaken Yahuah Elohim of his fathers.

verses.raw: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Yahudah (Judah), and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Yahudah (Judah) thereto.
verses.text: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Yahudah, and caused the inhabitants of Jerusalem to commit fornication, and compelled Yahudah thereto.

verses.raw: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of David your father, Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Yahudah (Judah),
verses.text: And there came a writing to him from Elijah the prophet, saying, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of David your father, Because you have not walked in the ways of Jehoshaphat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Yahudah,

verses.raw: But have walked in the way of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel), and have made Yahudah (Judah) and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also have slain your brethren of your father’s house, which were better than thyself:
verses.text: But have walked in the way of the kings of Yashar'el, and have made Yahudah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to go a whoring, like to the whoredoms of the house of Ahab, and also have slain your brethren of your father’s house, which were better than thyself:

verses.raw: Behold, with a great plague will Yahuah (LORD) smite your people, and your children, and your wives, and all your goods:
verses.text: Behold, with a great plague will Yahuah smite your people, and your children, and your wives, and all your goods:

verses.raw: And you shall have great sickness by disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.
verses.text: And you shall have great sickness by disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.

verses.raw: Moreover Yahuah (LORD) stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:
verses.text: Moreover Yahuah stirred up against Jehoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians, that were near the Ethiopians:

verses.raw: And they came up into Yahudah (Judah), and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king’s house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
verses.text: And they came up into Yahudah, and brake into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king’s house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.

verses.raw: And after all this Yahuah (LORD) smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
verses.text: And after all this Yahuah smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that in process of time, after the end of two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases. And his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

verses.raw: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.text: Thirty and two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years, and departed without being desired. Howbeit they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

verses.raw: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yahudah (Judah) reigned.
verses.text: And the inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his stead: for the band of men that came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Yahudah reigned.

verses.raw: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
verses.text: Forty and two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign, and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.

verses.raw: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.
verses.text: He also walked in the ways of the house of Ahab: for his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.

verses.raw: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD) like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.
verses.text: Wherefore he did evil in the sight of Yahuah like the house of Ahab: for they were his counsellors after the death of his father to his destruction.

verses.raw: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Yashar'el (Israel) to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.
verses.text: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Jehoram the son of Ahab king of Yashar'el to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead: and the Syrians smote Joram.

verses.raw: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Yahudah (Judah) went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.
verses.text: And he returned to be healed in Jezreel because of the wounds which were given him at Ramah, when he fought with Hazael king of Syria. And Azariah the son of Jehoram king of Yahudah went down to see Jehoram the son of Ahab at Jezreel, because he was sick.

verses.raw: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of Elohim (God) by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Yahuah (LORD) had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.
verses.text: And the destruction of Ahaziah was of Elohim by coming to Joram: for when he was come, he went out with Jehoram against Jehu the son of Nimshi, whom Yahuah had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Yahudah (Judah), and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that, when Jehu was executing judgment upon the house of Ahab, and found the princes of Yahudah, and the sons of the brethren of Ahaziah, that ministered to Ahaziah, he slew them.

verses.raw: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Yahuah (LORD) with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.
verses.text: And he sought Ahaziah: and they caught him, (for he was hid in Samaria,) and brought him to Jehu: and when they had slain him, they buried him: Because, said they, he is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought Yahuah with all his heart. So the house of Ahaziah had no power to keep still the kingdom.

verses.raw: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: But when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Yahudah.

verses.raw: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.
verses.text: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Joash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king’s sons that were slain, and put him and his nurse in a bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Jehoram, the wife of Jehoiada the priest, (for she was the sister of Ahaziah,) hid him from Athaliah, so that she slew him not.

verses.raw: And he was with them hid in the house of Elohim (God) six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
verses.text: And he was with them hid in the house of Elohim six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.

verses.raw: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
verses.text: And in the seventh year Jehoiada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azariah the son of Jeroham, and Ishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azariah the son of Obed, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.

verses.raw: And they went about in Yahudah (Judah), and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and the chief of the fathers of Yashar'el (Israel), and they came to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And they went about in Yahudah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Yahudah, and the chief of the fathers of Yashar'el, and they came to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of Elohim (God). And he said unto them, Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as Yahuah (LORD) has said of the sons of David.
verses.text: And all the congregation made a covenant with the king in the house of Elohim. And he said unto them, Behold, the king’s son shall reign, as Yahuah has said of the sons of David.

verses.raw: This is the thing that you shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;
verses.text: This is the thing that you shall do; A third part of you entering on the sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the doors;

verses.raw: And a third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And a third part shall be at the king’s house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: But let none come into the house of Yahuah (LORD), save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But let none come into the house of Yahuah, save the priests, and they that minister of the Levites; they shall go in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the watch of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else comes into the house, he shall be put to death: but be you with the king when he comes in, and when he goes out.
verses.text: And the Levites shall compass the king round about, every man with his weapons in his hand; and whosoever else comes into the house, he shall be put to death: but be you with the king when he comes in, and when he goes out.

verses.raw: So the Levites and all Yahudah (Judah) did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.
verses.text: So the Levites and all Yahudah did according to all things that Jehoiada the priest had commanded, and took every man his men that were to come in on the sabbath, with them that were to go out on the sabbath: for Jehoiada the priest dismissed not the courses.

verses.raw: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David’s, which were in the house of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Moreover Jehoiada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king David’s, which were in the house of Elohim.

verses.raw: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.
verses.text: And he set all the people, every man having his weapon in his hand, from the right side of the temple to the left side of the temple, along by the altar and the temple, by the king round about.

verses.raw: Then they brought out the king’s son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, Elohim (God) save the king.
verses.text: Then they brought out the king’s son, and put upon him the crown, and gave him the testimony, and made him king. And Jehoiada and his sons anointed him, and said, Elohim save the king.

verses.raw: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Now when Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of Yahuah:

verses.raw: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.
verses.text: And she looked, and, behold, the king stood at his pillar at the entering in, and the princes and the trumpets by the king: and all the people of the land rejoiced, and sounded with trumpets, also the singers with instruments of musick, and such as taught to sing praise. Then Athaliah rent her clothes, and said, Treason, Treason.

verses.raw: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso follows her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then Jehoiada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds that were set over the host, and said unto them, Have her forth of the ranges: and whoso follows her, let him be slain with the sword. For the priest said, Slay her not in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king’s house, they slew her there.
verses.text: So they laid hands on her; and when she was come to the entering of the horse gate by the king’s house, they slew her there.

verses.raw: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD’S people.
verses.text: And Jehoiada made a covenant between him, and between all the people, and between the king, that they should be the LORD’S people.

verses.raw: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
verses.text: Then all the people went to the house of Baal, and brake it down, and brake his altars and his images in pieces, and slew Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.

verses.raw: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of Yahuah (LORD) by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of Yahuah (LORD), to offer the burnt offerings of Yahuah (LORD), as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.
verses.text: Also Jehoiada appointed the offices of the house of Yahuah by the hand of the priests the Levites, whom David had distributed in the house of Yahuah, to offer the burnt offerings of Yahuah, as it is written in the law of Moses, with rejoicing and with singing, as it was ordained by David.

verses.raw: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of Yahuah (LORD), that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.
verses.text: And he set the porters at the gates of the house of Yahuah, that none which was unclean in any thing should enter in.

verses.raw: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of Yahuah (LORD): and they came through the high gate into the king’s house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.
verses.text: And he took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of Yahuah: and they came through the high gate into the king’s house, and set the king upon the throne of the kingdom.

verses.raw: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.
verses.text: And all the people of the land rejoiced: and the city was quiet, after that they had slain Athaliah with the sword.

verses.raw: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.
verses.text: Joash was seven years old when he began to reign, and he reigned forty years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Zibiah of Beer-sheba.

verses.raw: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD) all the days of Jehoiada the priest.
verses.text: And Joash did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah all the days of Jehoiada the priest.

verses.raw: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.
verses.text: And Jehoiada took for him two wives; and he begat sons and daughters.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that Joash was minded to repair the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and gather of all Yashar'el (Israel) money to repair the house of your Elohim (God) from year to year, and see that you hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.
verses.text: And he gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out unto the cities of Yahudah, and gather of all Yashar'el money to repair the house of your Elohim from year to year, and see that you hasten the matter. Howbeit the Levites hastened it not.

verses.raw: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why have you not required of the Levites to bring in out of Yahudah (Judah) and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of Yahuah (LORD), and of the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel), for the tabernacle of witness?
verses.text: And the king called for Jehoiada the chief, and said unto him, Why have you not required of the Levites to bring in out of Yahudah and out of Jerusalem the collection, according to the commandment of Moses the servant of Yahuah, and of the congregation of Yashar'el, for the tabernacle of witness?

verses.raw: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of Elohim (God); and also all the dedicated things of the house of Yahuah (LORD) did they bestow upon Baalim.
verses.text: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of Elohim; and also all the dedicated things of the house of Yahuah did they bestow upon Baalim.

verses.raw: And at the king’s commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And at the king’s commandment they made a chest, and set it without at the gate of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they made a proclamation through Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, to bring in to Yahuah (LORD) the collection that Moses the servant of Elohim (God) laid upon Yashar'el (Israel) in the wilderness.
verses.text: And they made a proclamation through Yahudah and Jerusalem, to bring in to Yahuah the collection that Moses the servant of Elohim laid upon Yashar'el in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
verses.text: And all the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king’s office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
verses.text: Now it came to pass, that at what time the chest was brought unto the king’s office by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king’s scribe and the high priest’s officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to his place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.

verses.raw: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of Yahuah (LORD), and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And the king and Jehoiada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of Yahuah, and hired masons and carpenters to repair the house of Yahuah, and also such as wrought iron and brass to mend the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of Elohim (God) in his state, and strengthened it.
verses.text: So the workmen wrought, and the work was perfected by them, and they set the house of Elohim in his state, and strengthened it.

verses.raw: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of Yahuah (LORD), even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of Yahuah (LORD) continually all the days of Jehoiada.
verses.text: And when they had finished it, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Jehoiada, whereof were made vessels for the house of Yahuah, even vessels to minister, and to offer withal, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. And they offered burnt offerings in the house of Yahuah continually all the days of Jehoiada.

verses.raw: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.
verses.text: But Jehoiada waxed old, and was full of days when he died; an hundred and thirty years old was he when he died.

verses.raw: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Yashar'el (Israel), both toward Elohim (God), and toward his house.
verses.text: And they buried him in the city of David among the kings, because he had done good in Yashar'el, both toward Elohim, and toward his house.

verses.raw: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Yahudah (Judah), and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.
verses.text: Now after the death of Jehoiada came the princes of Yahudah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king hearkened unto them.

verses.raw: And they left the house of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem for this their trespass.
verses.text: And they left the house of Yahuah Elohim of their fathers, and served groves and idols: and wrath came upon Yahudah and Jerusalem for this their trespass.

verses.raw: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto Yahuah (LORD); and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
verses.text: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again unto Yahuah; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.

verses.raw: And the Spirit of Elohim (God) came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus says Elohim (God), Why transgress you the commandments of Yahuah (LORD), that you cannot prosper? because you have forsaken Yahuah (LORD), he has also forsaken you.
verses.text: And the Spirit of Elohim came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, which stood above the people, and said unto them, Thus says Elohim, Why transgress you the commandments of Yahuah, that you cannot prosper? because you have forsaken Yahuah, he has also forsaken you.

verses.raw: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, Yahuah (LORD) look upon it, and require it.
verses.text: Thus Joash the king remembered not the kindness which Jehoiada his father had done to him, but slew his son. And when he died, he said, Yahuah look upon it, and require it.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of the year, that the host of Syria came up against him: and they came to Yahudah and Jerusalem, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them unto the king of Damascus.

verses.raw: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and Yahuah (LORD) delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.
verses.text: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men, and Yahuah delivered a very great host into their hand, because they had forsaken Yahuah Elohim of their fathers. So they executed judgment against Joash.

verses.raw: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.
verses.text: And when they were departed from him, (for they left him in great diseases,) his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and slew him on his bed, and he died: and they buried him in the city of David, but they buried him not in the sepulchres of the kings.

verses.raw: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.
verses.text: And these are they that conspired against him; Zabad the son of Shimeath an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith a Moabitess.

verses.raw: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of Elohim (God), behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of Elohim, behold, they are written in the story of the book of the kings. And Amaziah his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Amaziah was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned twenty and nine years in Jerusalem. And his mother’s name was Jehoaddan of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), but not with a perfect heart.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, but not with a perfect heart.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.
verses.text: Now it came to pass, when the kingdom was established to him, that he slew his servants that had killed the king his father.

verses.raw: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where Yahuah (LORD) commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.
verses.text: But he slew not their children, but did as it is written in the law in the book of Moses, where Yahuah commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers, but every man shall die for his own sin.

verses.raw: Moreover Amaziah gathered Yahudah (Judah) together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.
verses.text: Moreover Amaziah gathered Yahudah together, and made them captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, according to the houses of their fathers, throughout all Yahudah and Benjamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and above, and found them three hundred thousand choice men, able to go forth to war, that could handle spear and shield.

verses.raw: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Yashar'el (Israel) for an hundred talents of silver.
verses.text: He hired also an hundred thousand mighty men of valour out of Yashar'el for an hundred talents of silver.

verses.raw: But there came a man of Elohim (God) to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Yashar'el (Israel) go with you; for Yahuah (LORD) is not with Yashar'el (Israel), to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.
verses.text: But there came a man of Elohim to him, saying, O king, let not the army of Yashar'el go with you; for Yahuah is not with Yashar'el, to wit, with all the children of Ephraim.

verses.raw: But if you will go, do it, be strong for the battle: Elohim (God) shall make you fall before the enemy: for Elohim (God) has power to help, and to cast down.
verses.text: But if you will go, do it, be strong for the battle: Elohim shall make you fall before the enemy: for Elohim has power to help, and to cast down.

verses.raw: And Amaziah said to the man of Elohim (God), But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Yashar'el (Israel)? And the man of Elohim (God) answered, Yahuah (LORD) is able to give you much more than this.
verses.text: And Amaziah said to the man of Elohim, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Yashar'el? And the man of Elohim answered, Yahuah is able to give you much more than this.

verses.raw: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Yahudah (Judah), and they returned home in great anger.
verses.text: Then Amaziah separated them, to wit, the army that was come to him out of Ephraim, to go home again: wherefore their anger was greatly kindled against Yahudah, and they returned home in great anger.

verses.raw: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.
verses.text: And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.

verses.raw: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Yahudah (Judah) carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.
verses.text: And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Yahudah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.

verses.raw: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Yahudah (Judah), from Samaria even unto Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.
verses.text: But the soldiers of the army which Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell upon the cities of Yahudah, from Samaria even unto Beth-horon, and smote three thousand of them, and took much spoil.

verses.raw: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.
verses.text: Now it came to pass, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense unto them.

verses.raw: Wherefore the anger of Yahuah (LORD) was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of your hand?
verses.text: Wherefore the anger of Yahuah was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent unto him a prophet, which said unto him, Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which could not deliver their own people out of your hand?

verses.raw: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Are you made of the king’s counsel? forbear; why should you be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that Elohim (God) has determined to destroy you, because you have done this, and have not hearkened unto my counsel.
verses.text: And it came to pass, as he talked with him, that the king said unto him, Are you made of the king’s counsel? forbear; why should you be smitten? Then the prophet forbare, and said, I know that Elohim has determined to destroy you, because you have done this, and have not hearkened unto my counsel.

verses.raw: Then Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah) took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.
verses.text: Then Amaziah king of Yahudah took advice, and sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Yashar'el, saying, Come, let us see one another in the face.

verses.raw: And Joash king of Yashar'el (Israel) sent to Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.
verses.text: And Joash king of Yashar'el sent to Amaziah king of Yahudah, saying, The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that was in Lebanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son to wife: and there passed by a wild beast that was in Lebanon, and trode down the thistle.

verses.raw: You say, Lo, you have smitten the Edomites; and your heart lifts you up to boast: abide now at home; why should you meddle to your hurt, that you should fall, even you, and Yahudah (Judah) with you?
verses.text: You say, Lo, you have smitten the Edomites; and your heart lifts you up to boast: abide now at home; why should you meddle to your hurt, that you should fall, even you, and Yahudah with you?

verses.raw: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of Elohim (God), that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.
verses.text: But Amaziah would not hear; for it came of Elohim, that he might deliver them into the hand of their enemies, because they sought after the gods of Edom.

verses.raw: So Joash the king of Yashar'el (Israel) went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah), at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: So Joash the king of Yashar'el went up; and they saw one another in the face, both he and Amaziah king of Yahudah, at Beth-shemesh, which belongs to Yahudah.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) was put to the worse before Yashar'el (Israel), and they fled every man to his tent.
verses.text: And Yahudah was put to the worse before Yashar'el, and they fled every man to his tent.

verses.raw: And Joash the king of Yashar'el (Israel) took Amaziah king of Yahudah (Judah), the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
verses.text: And Joash the king of Yashar'el took Amaziah king of Yahudah, the son of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.

verses.raw: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of Elohim (God) with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.
verses.text: And he took all the gold and the silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of Elohim with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king’s house, the hostages also, and returned to Samaria.

verses.raw: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yahudah (Judah) lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Yashar'el (Israel) fifteen years.
verses.text: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Yahudah lived after the death of Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Yashar'el fifteen years.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Yahudah (Judah) and Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Yahudah and Yashar'el?

verses.raw: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following Yahuah (LORD) they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.
verses.text: Now after the time that Amaziah did turn away from following Yahuah they made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent to Lachish after him, and slew him there.

verses.raw: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And they brought him upon horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Then all the people of Yahudah (Judah) took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
verses.text: Then all the people of Yahudah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.

verses.raw: He built Eloth, and restored it to Yahudah (Judah), after that the king slept with his fathers.
verses.text: He built Eloth, and restored it to Yahudah, after that the king slept with his fathers.

verses.raw: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Sixteen years old was Uzziah when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that his father Amaziah did.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that his father Amaziah did.

verses.raw: And he sought Elohim (God) in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of Elohim (God): and as long as he sought Yahuah (LORD), Elohim (God) made him to prosper.
verses.text: And he sought Elohim in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the visions of Elohim: and as long as he sought Yahuah, Elohim made him to prosper.

verses.raw: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
verses.text: And he went forth and warred against the Philistines, and brake down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod, and built cities about Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.
verses.text: And Elohim helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians that dwelt in Gur-baal, and the Mehunims.

verses.raw: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.
verses.text: And the Ammonites gave gifts to Uzziah: and his name spread abroad even to the entering in of Egypt; for he strengthened himself exceedingly.

verses.raw: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.
verses.text: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

verses.raw: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.
verses.text: Also he built towers in the desert, and digged many wells: for he had much cattle, both in the low country, and in the plains: husbandmen also, and vine dressers in the mountains, and in Carmel: for he loved husbandry.

verses.raw: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.
verses.text: Moreover Uzziah had an host of fighting men, that went out to war by bands, according to the number of their account by the hand of Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the ruler, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

verses.raw: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.
verses.text: The whole number of the chief of the fathers of the mighty men of valour were two thousand and six hundred.

verses.raw: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
verses.text: And under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, that made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

verses.raw: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.
verses.text: And Uzziah prepared for them throughout all the host shields, and spears, and helmets, and habergeons, and bows, and slings to cast stones.

verses.raw: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
verses.text: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.

verses.raw: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God), and went into the temple of Yahuah (LORD) to burn incense upon the altar of incense.
verses.text: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up to his destruction: for he transgressed against Yahuah Elohav, and went into the temple of Yahuah to burn incense upon the altar of incense.

verses.raw: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of Yahuah (LORD), that were valiant men:
verses.text: And Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him fourscore priests of Yahuah, that were valiant men:

verses.raw: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto you, Uzziah, to burn incense unto Yahuah (LORD), but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for you have trespassed; neither shall it be for your honour from Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God).
verses.text: And they withstood Uzziah the king, and said unto him, It appertaineth not unto you, Uzziah, to burn incense unto Yahuah, but to the priests the sons of Aaron, that are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for you have trespassed; neither shall it be for your honour from Yahuah Elohim.

verses.raw: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of Yahuah (LORD), from beside the incense altar.
verses.text: Then Uzziah was wroth, and had a censer in his hand to burn incense: and while he was wroth with the priests, the leprosy even rose up in his forehead before the priests in the house of Yahuah, from beside the incense altar.

verses.raw: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because Yahuah (LORD) had smitten him.
verses.text: And Azariah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked upon him, and, behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out from thence; yea, himself hasted also to go out, because Yahuah had smitten him.

verses.raw: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of Yahuah (LORD): and Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.
verses.text: And Uzziah the king was a leper unto the day of his death, and dwelt in a several house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of Yahuah: and Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, did Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.

verses.raw: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: So Uzziah slept with his fathers, and they buried him with his fathers in the field of the burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Jotham his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.
verses.text: Jotham was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name also was Jerushah, the daughter of Zadok.

verses.raw: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of Yahuah (LORD). And the people did yet corruptly.
verses.text: And he did that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, according to all that his father Uzziah did: howbeit he entered not into the temple of Yahuah. And the people did yet corruptly.

verses.raw: He built the high gate of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
verses.text: He built the high gate of the house of Yahuah, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.

verses.raw: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Yahudah (Judah), and in the forests he built castles and towers.
verses.text: Moreover he built cities in the mountains of Yahudah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.

verses.raw: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.
verses.text: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them. And the children of Ammon gave him the same year an hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon pay unto him, both the second year, and the third.

verses.raw: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God).
verses.text: So Jotham became mighty, because he prepared his ways before Yahuah Elohav.

verses.raw: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars, and his ways, lo, they are written in the book of the kings of Yashar'el and Yahudah.

verses.raw: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
verses.text: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: and Ahaz his son reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), like David his father:
verses.text: Ahaz was twenty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem: but he did not that which was right in the sight of Yahuah, like David his father:

verses.raw: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel), and made also molten images for Baalim.
verses.text: For he walked in the ways of the kings of Yashar'el, and made also molten images for Baalim.

verses.raw: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom Yahuah (LORD) had cast out before the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, after the abominations of the heathen whom Yahuah had cast out before the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
verses.text: He sacrificed also and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.raw: Wherefore Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God) delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Yashar'el (Israel), who smote him with a great slaughter.
verses.text: Wherefore Yahuah Elohav delivered him into the hand of the king of Syria; and they smote him, and carried away a great multitude of them captives, and brought them to Damascus. And he was also delivered into the hand of the king of Yashar'el, who smote him with a great slaughter.

verses.raw: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Yahudah (Judah) an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers.
verses.text: For Pekah the son of Remaliah slew in Yahudah an hundred and twenty thousand in one day, which were all valiant men; because they had forsaken Yahuah Elohim of their fathers.

verses.raw: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
verses.text: And Zichri, a mighty man of Ephraim, slew Maaseiah the king’s son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
