verses.text: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

verses.raw: Then said the king unto her, What will you, queen Esther? and what is your request? it shall be even given you to the half of the kingdom.
verses.text: Then said the king unto her, What will you, queen Esther? and what is your request? it shall be even given you to the half of the kingdom.

verses.raw: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.
verses.text: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.

verses.raw: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther has said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.
verses.text: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther has said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is your petition? and it shall be granted you: and what is your request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.
verses.text: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is your petition? and it shall be granted you: and what is your request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

verses.raw: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;
verses.text: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;

verses.raw: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king has said.
verses.text: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king has said.

verses.raw: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.
verses.text: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

verses.raw: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.
verses.text: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

verses.raw: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.
verses.text: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

verses.raw: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.
verses.text: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

verses.raw: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Yahudi (Jew) sitting at the king’s gate.
verses.text: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Yahudi sitting at the king’s gate.

verses.raw: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak you unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go you in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.
verses.text: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak you unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go you in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

verses.raw: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.
verses.text: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

verses.raw: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.
verses.text: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

verses.raw: And the king said, What honour and dignity has been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.
verses.text: And the king said, What honour and dignity has been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king’s servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.

verses.raw: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king’s house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.
verses.text: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king’s house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

verses.raw: And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, Haman stands in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.
verses.text: And the king’s servants said unto him, Behold, Haman stands in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

verses.raw: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delights to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?
verses.text: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delights to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

verses.raw: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delights to honour,
verses.text: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delights to honour,

verses.raw: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rides upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:
verses.text: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rides upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

verses.raw: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delights to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delights to honour.
verses.text: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delights to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delights to honour.

verses.raw: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as you have said, and do even so to Mordecai the Yahudi (Jew), that sits at the king’s gate: let nothing fail of all that you have spoken.
verses.text: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as you have said, and do even so to Mordecai the Yahudi, that sits at the king’s gate: let nothing fail of all that you have spoken.

verses.raw: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delights to honour.
verses.text: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delights to honour.

verses.raw: And Mordecai came again to the king’s gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.
verses.text: And Mordecai came again to the king’s gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

verses.raw: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Yahudim (Jews), before whom you have begun to fall, you shall not prevail against him, but shall surely fall before him.
verses.text: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Yahudim, before whom you have begun to fall, you shall not prevail against him, but shall surely fall before him.

verses.raw: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king’s chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.
verses.text: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king’s chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.

verses.raw: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.
verses.text: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

verses.raw: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is your petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted you: and what is your request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.
verses.text: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is your petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted you: and what is your request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.

verses.raw: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in your sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:
verses.text: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in your sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:

verses.raw: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king’s damage.
verses.text: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king’s damage.

verses.raw: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?
verses.text: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?

verses.raw: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.
verses.text: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

verses.raw: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.
verses.text: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

verses.raw: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.
verses.text: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

verses.raw: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, stands in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.
verses.text: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, stands in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.

verses.raw: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.
verses.text: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king’s wrath pacified.

verses.raw: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Yahudim's (Jews’) enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.
verses.text: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Yahudim's (Jews’) enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.

verses.raw: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.
verses.text: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

verses.raw: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Yahudim.

verses.raw: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,
verses.text: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,

verses.raw: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Yahudim (Jews) which are in all the king’s provinces:
verses.text: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Yahudim which are in all the king’s provinces:

verses.raw: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?
verses.text: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?

verses.raw: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Yahudi (Jew), Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Yahudim (Jews).
verses.text: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Yahudi, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Yahudim.

verses.raw: Write you also for the Yahudim (Jews), as it liketh you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring: for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may no man reverse.
verses.text: Write you also for the Yahudim, as it liketh you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring: for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may no man reverse.

verses.raw: Then were the king’s scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Yahudim (Jews), and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Yahudim (Jews) according to their writing, and according to their language.
verses.text: Then were the king’s scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Yahudim, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Yahudim according to their writing, and according to their language.

verses.raw: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus’ name, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:
verses.text: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus’ name, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:

verses.raw: Wherein the king granted the Yahudim (Jews) which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,
verses.text: Wherein the king granted the Yahudim which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,

verses.raw: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
verses.text: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

verses.raw: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Yahudim (Jews) should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.
verses.text: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Yahudim should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

verses.raw: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.
verses.text: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.

verses.raw: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.
verses.text: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.
verses.text: The Yahudim had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

verses.raw: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Yahudim (Jews) had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Yahudim (Jews); for the fear of the Yahudim (Jews) fell upon them.
verses.text: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Yahudim had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Yahudim; for the fear of the Yahudim fell upon them.

verses.raw: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king’s commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Yahudim (Jews) hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Yahudim (Jews) had rule over them that hated them;)
verses.text: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king’s commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Yahudim hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Yahudim had rule over them that hated them;)

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.
verses.text: The Yahudim gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.

verses.raw: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Yahudim (Jews); because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.
verses.text: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Yahudim; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.

verses.raw: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
verses.text: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.

verses.raw: Thus the Yahudim (Jews) smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.
verses.text: Thus the Yahudim smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.

verses.raw: And in Shushan the palace the Yahudim (Jews) slew and destroyed five hundred men.
verses.text: And in Shushan the palace the Yahudim slew and destroyed five hundred men.

verses.raw: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,
verses.text: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

verses.raw: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,
verses.text: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

verses.raw: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,
verses.text: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

verses.raw: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Yahudim (Jews), slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.
verses.text: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Yahudim, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.

verses.raw: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.
verses.text: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

verses.raw: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Yahudim (Jews) have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? now what is your petition? and it shall be granted you: or what is your request further? and it shall be done.
verses.text: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Yahudim have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces? now what is your petition? and it shall be granted you: or what is your request further? and it shall be done.

verses.raw: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Yahudim (Jews) which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.
verses.text: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Yahudim which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

verses.raw: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.
verses.text: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

verses.raw: For the Yahudim (Jews) that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.
verses.text: For the Yahudim that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.

verses.raw: But the other Yahudim (Jews) that were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,
verses.text: But the other Yahudim that were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,

verses.raw: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
verses.text: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

verses.raw: But the Yahudim (Jews) that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.
verses.text: But the Yahudim that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

verses.raw: Therefore the Yahudim (Jews) of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.
verses.text: Therefore the Yahudim of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

verses.raw: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Yahudim (Jews) that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,
verses.text: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Yahudim that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,

verses.raw: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,
verses.text: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

verses.raw: As the days wherein the Yahudim (Jews) rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.
verses.text: As the days wherein the Yahudim rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

verses.raw: And the Yahudim (Jews) undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;
verses.text: And the Yahudim undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

verses.raw: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Yahudim (Jews), had devised against the Yahudim (Jews) to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;
verses.text: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Yahudim, had devised against the Yahudim to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

verses.raw: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Yahudim (Jews), should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.
verses.text: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Yahudim, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

verses.raw: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,
verses.text: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,

verses.raw: The Yahudim (Jews) ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;
verses.text: The Yahudim ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;

verses.raw: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Yahudim (Jews), nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.
verses.text: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Yahudim, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.

verses.raw: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Yahudi (Jew), wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.
verses.text: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Yahudi, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

verses.raw: And he sent the letters unto all the Yahudim (Jews), to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,
verses.text: And he sent the letters unto all the Yahudim, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,

verses.raw: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Yahudi (Jew) and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.
verses.text: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Yahudi and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.

verses.raw: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.
verses.text: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

verses.raw: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.
verses.text: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

verses.raw: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
verses.text: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

verses.raw: For Mordecai the Yahudi (Jew) was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Yahudim (Jews), and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.
verses.text: For Mordecai the Yahudi was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Yahudim, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

verses.raw: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared Elohim (God), and eschewed evil.
verses.text: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared Elohim, and eschewed evil.

verses.raw: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.
verses.text: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

verses.raw: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.
verses.text: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

verses.raw: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.
verses.text: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

verses.raw: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed Elohim (God) in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.
verses.text: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed Elohim in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

verses.raw: Now there was a day when the sons of Elohim (God) came to present themselves before Yahuah (LORD), and Satan came also among them.
verses.text: Now there was a day when the sons of Elohim came to present themselves before Yahuah, and Satan came also among them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Whence come you? Then Satan answered Yahuah (LORD), and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Satan, Whence come you? Then Satan answered Yahuah, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Have you considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that fears Elohim (God), and escheweth evil?
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Satan, Have you considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that fears Elohim, and escheweth evil?

verses.raw: Then Satan answered Yahuah (LORD), and said, Does Job fear Elohim (God) for nought?
verses.text: Then Satan answered Yahuah, and said, Does Job fear Elohim for nought?

verses.raw: Have not you made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he has on every side? you have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.
verses.text: Have not you made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he has on every side? you have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

verses.raw: But put forth your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will curse you to your face.
verses.text: But put forth your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will curse you to your face.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Behold, all that he has is in your power; only upon himself put not forth your hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Satan, Behold, all that he has is in your power; only upon himself put not forth your hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:
verses.text: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

verses.raw: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:
verses.text: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:

verses.raw: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.
verses.text: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.

verses.raw: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of Elohim (God) is fallen from heaven, and has burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.
verses.text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of Elohim is fallen from heaven, and has burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.

verses.raw: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.
verses.text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.

verses.raw: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:
verses.text: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother’s house:

verses.raw: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.
verses.text: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell you.

verses.raw: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,
verses.text: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

verses.raw: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: Yahuah (LORD) gave, and Yahuah (LORD) has taken away; blessed be the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And said, Naked came I out of my mother’s womb, and naked shall I return thither: Yahuah gave, and Yahuah has taken away; blessed be the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged Elohim (God) foolishly.
verses.text: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged Elohim foolishly.

verses.raw: Again there was a day when the sons of Elohim (God) came to present themselves before Yahuah (LORD), and Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Again there was a day when the sons of Elohim came to present themselves before Yahuah, and Satan came also among them to present himself before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, From whence come you? And Satan answered Yahuah (LORD), and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Satan, From whence come you? And Satan answered Yahuah, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Have you considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that fears Elohim (God), and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although you movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Satan, Have you considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that fears Elohim, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although you movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

verses.raw: And Satan answered Yahuah (LORD), and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man has will he give for his life.
verses.text: And Satan answered Yahuah, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man has will he give for his life.

verses.raw: But put forth your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse you to your face.
verses.text: But put forth your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse you to your face.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Behold, he is in your hand; but save his life.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Satan, Behold, he is in your hand; but save his life.

verses.raw: So went Satan forth from the presence of Yahuah (LORD), and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.
verses.text: So went Satan forth from the presence of Yahuah, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

verses.raw: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.
verses.text: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.

verses.raw: Then said his wife unto him, Do you still retain your integrity? curse Elohim (God), and die.
verses.text: Then said his wife unto him, Do you still retain your integrity? curse Elohim, and die.

verses.raw: But he said unto her, You speak as one of the foolish women speaks. What? shall we receive good at the hand of Elohim (God), and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
verses.text: But he said unto her, You speak as one of the foolish women speaks. What? shall we receive good at the hand of Elohim, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

verses.raw: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.
verses.text: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

verses.raw: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.
verses.text: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

verses.raw: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.
verses.text: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

verses.raw: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.
verses.text: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

verses.raw: And Job spake, and said,
verses.text: And Job spake, and said,

verses.raw: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.
verses.text: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.

verses.raw: Let that day be darkness; let not Elohim (God) regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.
verses.text: Let that day be darkness; let not Elohim regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

verses.raw: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.
verses.text: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

verses.raw: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.
verses.text: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.

verses.raw: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.
verses.text: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.

verses.raw: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.
verses.text: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.

verses.raw: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:
verses.text: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

verses.raw: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor hid sorrow from my eyes.
verses.text: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor hid sorrow from my eyes.

verses.raw: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?
verses.text: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?

verses.raw: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?
verses.text: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

verses.raw: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,
verses.text: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

verses.raw: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;
verses.text: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;

verses.raw: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
verses.text: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

verses.raw: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.
verses.text: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.

verses.raw: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
verses.text: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.

verses.raw: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.
verses.text: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

verses.raw: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.
verses.text: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.

verses.raw: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;
verses.text: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;

verses.raw: Which long for death, but it comes not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;
verses.text: Which long for death, but it comes not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

verses.raw: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
verses.text: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

verses.raw: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom Elohim (God) has hedged in?
verses.text: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom Elohim has hedged in?

verses.raw: For my sighing comes before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.
verses.text: For my sighing comes before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

verses.raw: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.
verses.text: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.

verses.raw: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.
verses.text: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.

verses.raw: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

verses.raw: If we assay to commune with you, will you be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.text: If we assay to commune with you, will you be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

verses.raw: Behold, you have instructed many, and you have strengthened the weak hands.
verses.text: Behold, you have instructed many, and you have strengthened the weak hands.

verses.raw: Your words have upholden him that was falling, and you have strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.text: Your words have upholden him that was falling, and you have strengthened the feeble knees.

verses.raw: But now it is come upon you, and you faintest; it touches you, and you are troubled.
verses.text: But now it is come upon you, and you faintest; it touches you, and you are troubled.

verses.raw: Is not this your fear, your confidence, your hope, and the uprightness of your ways?
verses.text: Is not this your fear, your confidence, your hope, and the uprightness of your ways?

verses.raw: Remember, I pray you, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.text: Remember, I pray you, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

verses.raw: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.text: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

verses.raw: By the blast of Elohim (God) they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.text: By the blast of Elohim they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

verses.raw: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.text: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

verses.raw: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.text: The old lion perishes for lack of prey, and the stout lion’s whelps are scattered abroad.

verses.raw: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and my ear received a little thereof.
verses.text: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and my ear received a little thereof.

verses.raw: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
verses.text: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

verses.raw: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.text: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

verses.raw: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.text: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

verses.raw: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before my eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
verses.text: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before my eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,

verses.raw: Shall mortal man be more just than Elohim (God)? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.text: Shall mortal man be more just than Elohim? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

verses.raw: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.text: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

verses.raw: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
verses.text: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?

verses.raw: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.text: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.

verses.raw: Does not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.text: Does not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.

verses.raw: Call now, if there be any that will answer you; and to which of the saints will you turn?
verses.text: Call now, if there be any that will answer you; and to which of the saints will you turn?

verses.raw: For wrath kills the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.
verses.text: For wrath kills the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

verses.raw: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.
verses.text: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

verses.raw: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.
verses.text: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.

verses.raw: Whose harvest the hungry eats up, and takes it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.
verses.text: Whose harvest the hungry eats up, and takes it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

verses.raw: Although affliction comes not forth of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;
verses.text: Although affliction comes not forth of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

verses.raw: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.
verses.text: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

verses.raw: I would seek unto Elohim (God), and unto Elohim (God) would I commit my cause:
verses.text: I would seek unto Elohim, and unto Elohim would I commit my cause:

verses.raw: Which does great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:
verses.text: Which does great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

verses.raw: Who gives rain upon the earth, and sends waters upon the fields:
verses.text: Who gives rain upon the earth, and sends waters upon the fields:

verses.raw: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.
verses.text: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

verses.raw: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.
verses.text: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

verses.raw: He takes the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.
verses.text: He takes the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

verses.raw: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.
verses.text: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

verses.raw: But he saves the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.
verses.text: But he saves the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

verses.raw: So the poor has hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
verses.text: So the poor has hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

verses.raw: Behold, happy is the man whom Elohim (God) corrects: therefore despise not you the chastening of the Almighty:
verses.text: Behold, happy is the man whom Elohim corrects: therefore despise not you the chastening of the Almighty:

verses.raw: For he makes sore, and binds up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.
verses.text: For he makes sore, and binds up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

verses.raw: He shall deliver you in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch you.
verses.text: He shall deliver you in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch you.

verses.raw: In famine he shall redeem you from death: and in war from the power of the sword.
verses.text: In famine he shall redeem you from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

verses.raw: You shall be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shall you be afraid of destruction when it comes.
verses.text: You shall be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shall you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

verses.raw: At destruction and famine you shall laugh: neither shall you be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
verses.text: At destruction and famine you shall laugh: neither shall you be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

verses.raw: For you shall be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with you.
verses.text: For you shall be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with you.

verses.raw: And you shall know that your tabernacle shall be in peace; and you shall visit your habitation, and shall not sin.
verses.text: And you shall know that your tabernacle shall be in peace; and you shall visit your habitation, and shall not sin.

verses.raw: You shall know also that your seed shall be great, and your offspring as the grass of the earth.
verses.text: You shall know also that your seed shall be great, and your offspring as the grass of the earth.

verses.raw: You shall come to your grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn comes in in his season.
verses.text: You shall come to your grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn comes in in his season.

verses.raw: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know you it for your good.
verses.text: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know you it for your good.

verses.raw: But Job answered and said,
verses.text: But Job answered and said,

verses.raw: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!
verses.text: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

verses.raw: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.
verses.text: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

verses.raw: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinks up my spirit: the terrors of Elohim (God) do set themselves in array against me.
verses.text: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinks up my spirit: the terrors of Elohim do set themselves in array against me.

verses.raw: Does the wild ass bray when he has grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?
verses.text: Does the wild ass bray when he has grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

verses.raw: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?
verses.text: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

verses.raw: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.
verses.text: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.

verses.raw: Oh that I might have my request; and that Elohim (God) would grant me the thing that I long for!
verses.text: Oh that I might have my request; and that Elohim would grant me the thing that I long for!

verses.raw: Even that it would please Elohim (God) to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
verses.text: Even that it would please Elohim to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

verses.raw: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.
verses.text: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

verses.raw: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is my end, that I should prolong my life?
verses.text: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is my end, that I should prolong my life?

verses.raw: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?
verses.text: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

verses.raw: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?
verses.text: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

verses.raw: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.
verses.text: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

verses.raw: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;
verses.text: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;

verses.raw: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:
verses.text: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:

verses.raw: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.
verses.text: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

verses.raw: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.
verses.text: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

verses.raw: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.
verses.text: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

verses.raw: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.
verses.text: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

verses.raw: For now you are nothing; you see my casting down, and are afraid.
verses.text: For now you are nothing; you see my casting down, and are afraid.

verses.raw: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?
verses.text: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

verses.raw: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?
verses.text: Or, Deliver me from the enemy’s hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

verses.raw: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.
verses.text: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

verses.raw: How forcible are right words! but what does your arguing reprove?
verses.text: How forcible are right words! but what does your arguing reprove?

verses.raw: Do you imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?
verses.text: Do you imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?

verses.raw: Yea, you overwhelm the fatherless, and you dig a pit for your friend.
verses.text: Yea, you overwhelm the fatherless, and you dig a pit for your friend.

verses.raw: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.
verses.text: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.

verses.raw: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.
verses.text: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.

verses.raw: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?
verses.text: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?

verses.raw: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?
verses.text: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?

verses.raw: As a servant earnestly desires the shadow, and as an hireling looks for the reward of his work:
verses.text: As a servant earnestly desires the shadow, and as an hireling looks for the reward of his work:

verses.raw: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.
verses.text: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

verses.raw: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.
verses.text: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

verses.raw: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.
verses.text: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.

verses.raw: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
verses.text: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

verses.raw: O remember that my life is wind: my eye shall no more see good.
verses.text: O remember that my life is wind: my eye shall no more see good.

verses.raw: The eye of him that has seen me shall see me no more: your eyes are upon me, and I am not.
verses.text: The eye of him that has seen me shall see me no more: your eyes are upon me, and I am not.

verses.raw: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away: so he that goes down to the grave shall come up no more.
verses.text: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away: so he that goes down to the grave shall come up no more.

verses.raw: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.
verses.text: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

verses.raw: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.text: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.raw: Am I a sea, or a whale, that you set a watch over me?
verses.text: Am I a sea, or a whale, that you set a watch over me?

verses.raw: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;
verses.text: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

verses.raw: Then you scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:
verses.text: Then you scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

verses.raw: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
verses.text: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.

verses.raw: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.
verses.text: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.

verses.raw: What is man, that you should magnify him? and that you should set your heart upon him?
verses.text: What is man, that you should magnify him? and that you should set your heart upon him?

verses.raw: And that you should visit him every morning, and try him every moment?
verses.text: And that you should visit him every morning, and try him every moment?

verses.raw: How long will you not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?
verses.text: How long will you not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

verses.raw: I have sinned; what shall I do unto you, O you preserver of men? why have you set me as a mark against you, so that I am a burden to myself?
verses.text: I have sinned; what shall I do unto you, O you preserver of men? why have you set me as a mark against you, so that I am a burden to myself?

verses.raw: And why do you not pardon my transgression, and take away my iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and you shall seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.
verses.text: And why do you not pardon my transgression, and take away my iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and you shall seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.

verses.raw: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,
verses.text: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

verses.raw: How long will you speak these things? and how long shall the words of your mouth be like a strong wind?
verses.text: How long will you speak these things? and how long shall the words of your mouth be like a strong wind?

verses.raw: Does Elohim (God) pervert judgment? or does the Almighty pervert justice?
verses.text: Does Elohim pervert judgment? or does the Almighty pervert justice?

verses.raw: If your children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;
verses.text: If your children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;

verses.raw: If you would seek unto Elohim (God) betimes, and make your supplication to the Almighty;
verses.text: If you would seek unto Elohim betimes, and make your supplication to the Almighty;

verses.raw: If you were pure and upright; surely now he would awake for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.
verses.text: If you were pure and upright; surely now he would awake for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

verses.raw: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end should greatly increase.
verses.text: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end should greatly increase.

verses.raw: For enquire, I pray you, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:
verses.text: For enquire, I pray you, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

verses.raw: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)
verses.text: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)

verses.raw: Shall not they teach you, and tell you, and utter words out of their heart?
verses.text: Shall not they teach you, and tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

verses.raw: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?
verses.text: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?

verses.raw: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
verses.text: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

verses.raw: So are the paths of all that forget Elohim (God); and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:
verses.text: So are the paths of all that forget Elohim; and the hypocrite’s hope shall perish:

verses.raw: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.
verses.text: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider’s web.

verses.raw: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.
verses.text: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

verses.raw: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.
verses.text: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

verses.raw: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and sees the place of stones.
verses.text: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and sees the place of stones.

verses.raw: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen you.
verses.text: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen you.

verses.raw: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.
verses.text: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

verses.raw: Behold, Elohim (God) will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:
verses.text: Behold, Elohim will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:

verses.raw: Till he fill your mouth with laughing, and your lips with rejoicing.
verses.text: Till he fill your mouth with laughing, and your lips with rejoicing.

verses.raw: They that hate you shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.
verses.text: They that hate you shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.

verses.raw: Then Job answered and said,
verses.text: Then Job answered and said,

verses.raw: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with Elohim (God)?
verses.text: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with Elohim?

verses.raw: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.
verses.text: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

verses.raw: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him, and has prospered?
verses.text: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him, and has prospered?

verses.raw: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.
verses.text: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

verses.raw: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.
verses.text: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

verses.raw: Which commands the sun, and it rises not; and sealeth up the stars.
verses.text: Which commands the sun, and it rises not; and sealeth up the stars.

verses.raw: Which alone spreads out the heavens, and treads upon the waves of the sea.
verses.text: Which alone spreads out the heavens, and treads upon the waves of the sea.

verses.raw: Which makes Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.
verses.text: Which makes Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

verses.raw: Which does great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.
verses.text: Which does great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

verses.raw: Lo, he goes by me, and I see him not: he passes on also, but I perceive him not.
verses.text: Lo, he goes by me, and I see him not: he passes on also, but I perceive him not.

verses.raw: Behold, he takes away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What do you?
verses.text: Behold, he takes away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What do you?

verses.raw: If Elohim (God) will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.
verses.text: If Elohim will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

verses.raw: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?
verses.text: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

verses.raw: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.
verses.text: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.

verses.raw: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.
verses.text: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

verses.raw: For he breaks me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
verses.text: For he breaks me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

verses.raw: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.
verses.text: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

verses.raw: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?
verses.text: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

verses.raw: If I justify myself, my own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.
verses.text: If I justify myself, my own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

verses.raw: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.
verses.text: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

verses.raw: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroys the perfect and the wicked.
verses.text: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroys the perfect and the wicked.

verses.raw: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.
verses.text: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

verses.raw: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covers the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?
verses.text: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covers the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

verses.raw: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
verses.text: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.
