verses.text: Will you play with him as with a bird? or will you bind him for your maidens?

verses.raw: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
verses.text: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?

verses.raw: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
verses.text: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?

verses.raw: Lay your hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
verses.text: Lay your hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.

verses.raw: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
verses.text: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight of him?

verses.raw: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
verses.text: None is so fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?

verses.raw: Who has prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.
verses.text: Who has prevented me, that I should repay him? whatsoever is under the whole heaven is mine.

verses.raw: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
verses.text: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.

verses.raw: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?
verses.text: Who can discover the face of his garment? or who can come to him with his double bridle?

verses.raw: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.
verses.text: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth are terrible round about.

verses.raw: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.
verses.text: His scales are his pride, shut up together as with a close seal.

verses.raw: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
verses.text: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

verses.raw: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
verses.text: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.

verses.raw: By his neesings a light does shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.
verses.text: By his neesings a light does shine, and his eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

verses.raw: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.
verses.text: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, and sparks of fire leap out.

verses.raw: Out of his nostrils goes smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.
verses.text: Out of his nostrils goes smoke, as out of a seething pot or caldron.

verses.raw: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.
verses.text: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.

verses.raw: In his neck remains strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
verses.text: In his neck remains strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.

verses.raw: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
verses.text: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.

verses.raw: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.
verses.text: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether millstone.

verses.raw: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
verses.text: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.

verses.raw: The sword of him that lays at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
verses.text: The sword of him that lays at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.

verses.raw: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.
verses.text: He esteemeth iron as straw, and brass as rotten wood.

verses.raw: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
verses.text: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.

verses.raw: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
verses.text: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.

verses.raw: Sharp stones are under him: he spreads sharp pointed things upon the mire.
verses.text: Sharp stones are under him: he spreads sharp pointed things upon the mire.

verses.raw: He makes the deep to boil like a pot: he makes the sea like a pot of ointment.
verses.text: He makes the deep to boil like a pot: he makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

verses.raw: He makes a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.
verses.text: He makes a path to shine after him; one would think the deep to be hoary.

verses.raw: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
verses.text: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.

verses.raw: He beholds all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.
verses.text: He beholds all high things: he is a king over all the children of pride.

verses.raw: Then Job answered Yahuah (LORD), and said,
verses.text: Then Job answered Yahuah, and said,

verses.raw: I know that you can do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from you.
verses.text: I know that you can do every thing, and that no thought can be withholden from you.

verses.raw: Who is he that hides counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
verses.text: Who is he that hides counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.

verses.raw: Hear, I beseech you, and I will speak: I will demand of you, and declare you unto me.
verses.text: Hear, I beseech you, and I will speak: I will demand of you, and declare you unto me.

verses.raw: I have heard of you by the hearing of the ear: but now my eye sees you.
verses.text: I have heard of you by the hearing of the ear: but now my eye sees you.

verses.raw: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.
verses.text: Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.

verses.raw: And it was so, that after Yahuah (LORD) had spoken these words unto Job, Yahuah (LORD) said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends: for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.
verses.text: And it was so, that after Yahuah had spoken these words unto Job, Yahuah said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends: for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

verses.raw: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that you have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.
verses.text: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you after your folly, in that you have not spoken of me the thing which is right, like my servant Job.

verses.raw: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as Yahuah (LORD) commanded them: Yahuah (LORD) also accepted Job.
verses.text: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as Yahuah commanded them: Yahuah also accepted Job.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also Yahuah (LORD) gave Job twice as much as he had before.
verses.text: And Yahuah turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also Yahuah gave Job twice as much as he had before.

verses.raw: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that Yahuah (LORD) had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
verses.text: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that Yahuah had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.

verses.raw: So Yahuah (LORD) blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.
verses.text: So Yahuah blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

verses.raw: He had also seven sons and three daughters.
verses.text: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

verses.raw: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.
verses.text: And he called the name of the first, Jemima; and the name of the second, Kezia; and the name of the third, Keren-happuch.

verses.raw: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.
verses.text: And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

verses.raw: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.
verses.text: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, even four generations.

verses.raw: So Job died, being old and full of days.
verses.text: So Job died, being old and full of days.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man that walks not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of the scornful.
verses.text: Blessed is the man that walks not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of the scornful.

verses.raw: But his delight is in the law of Yahuah (LORD); and in his law does he meditate day and night.
verses.text: But his delight is in the law of Yahuah; and in his law does he meditate day and night.

verses.raw: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that brings forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he does shall prosper.
verses.text: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that brings forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he does shall prosper.

verses.raw: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
verses.text: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

verses.raw: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.text: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) knows the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
verses.text: For Yahuah knows the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

verses.raw: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
verses.text: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?

verses.raw: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahuah (LORD), and against his anointed, saying,
verses.text: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahuah, and against his anointed, saying,

verses.raw: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
verses.text: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

verses.raw: He that sits in the heavens shall laugh: Adonai (Lord) shall have them in derision.
verses.text: He that sits in the heavens shall laugh: Adonai shall have them in derision.

verses.raw: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
verses.text: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

verses.raw: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
verses.text: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

verses.raw: I will declare the decree: Yahuah (LORD) has said unto me, You are my Son; this day have I begotten you.
verses.text: I will declare the decree: Yahuah has said unto me, You are my Son; this day have I begotten you.

verses.raw: Ask of me, and I shall give you the heathen for your inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
verses.text: Ask of me, and I shall give you the heathen for your inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

verses.raw: You shall break them with a rod of iron; you shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.
verses.text: You shall break them with a rod of iron; you shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

verses.raw: Be wise now therefore, O you kings: be instructed, you judges of the earth.
verses.text: Be wise now therefore, O you kings: be instructed, you judges of the earth.

verses.raw: Serve Yahuah (LORD) with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.text: Serve Yahuah with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

verses.raw: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verses.text: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.
verses.text: Yahuah, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

verses.raw: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in Elohim (God). Selah.
verses.text: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in Elohim. Selah.

verses.raw: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), are a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.
verses.text: But you, O Yahuah, are a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of my head.

verses.raw: I cried unto Yahuah (LORD) with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
verses.text: I cried unto Yahuah with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

verses.raw: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Yahuah (LORD) sustained me.
verses.text: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Yahuah sustained me.

verses.raw: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.text: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

verses.raw: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD); save me, O my Elohim (God): for you have smitten all my enemies upon the cheek bone; you have broken the teeth of the ungodly.
verses.text: Arise, O Yahuah; save me, O my Elohim: for you have smitten all my enemies upon the cheek bone; you have broken the teeth of the ungodly.

verses.raw: Salvation belongs unto Yahuah (LORD): your blessing is upon your people. Selah.
verses.text: Salvation belongs unto Yahuah: your blessing is upon your people. Selah.

verses.raw: Hear me when I call, O Elohim (God) of my righteousness: you have enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.text: Hear me when I call, O Elohim of my righteousness: you have enlarged me when I was in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.

verses.raw: O you sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into shame? how long will you love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.text: O you sons of men, how long will you turn my glory into shame? how long will you love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

verses.raw: But know that Yahuah (LORD) has set apart him that is godly for himself: Yahuah (LORD) will hear when I call unto him.
verses.text: But know that Yahuah has set apart him that is godly for himself: Yahuah will hear when I call unto him.

verses.raw: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.text: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

verses.raw: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in Yahuah.

verses.raw: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Yahuah (LORD), lift you up the light of your countenance upon us.
verses.text: There be many that say, Who will shew us any good? Yahuah, lift you up the light of your countenance upon us.

verses.raw: You have put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.
verses.text: You have put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

verses.raw: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for you, Yahuah (LORD), only make me dwell in safety.
verses.text: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for you, Yahuah, only make me dwell in safety.

verses.raw: Give ear to my words, O Yahuah (LORD), consider my meditation.
verses.text: Give ear to my words, O Yahuah, consider my meditation.

verses.raw: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my Elohim (God): for unto you will I pray.
verses.text: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my Elohim: for unto you will I pray.

verses.raw: My voice shall you hear in the morning, O Yahuah (LORD); in the morning will I direct my prayer unto you, and will look up.
verses.text: My voice shall you hear in the morning, O Yahuah; in the morning will I direct my prayer unto you, and will look up.

verses.raw: For you are not a Elohim (God) that has pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with you.
verses.text: For you are not a Elohim that has pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with you.

verses.raw: The foolish shall not stand in your sight: you hate all workers of iniquity.
verses.text: The foolish shall not stand in your sight: you hate all workers of iniquity.

verses.raw: You shall destroy them that speak leasing: Yahuah (LORD) will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
verses.text: You shall destroy them that speak leasing: Yahuah will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

verses.raw: But as for me, I will come into your house in the multitude of your mercy: and in your fear will I worship toward your holy temple.
verses.text: But as for me, I will come into your house in the multitude of your mercy: and in your fear will I worship toward your holy temple.

verses.raw: Lead me, O Yahuah (LORD), in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your way straight before my face.
verses.text: Lead me, O Yahuah, in your righteousness because of my enemies; make your way straight before my face.

verses.raw: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
verses.text: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

verses.raw: Destroy you them, O Elohim (God); let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against you.
verses.text: Destroy you them, O Elohim; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against you.

verses.raw: But let all those that put their trust in you rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because you defendest them: let them also that love your name be joyful in you.
verses.text: But let all those that put their trust in you rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because you defendest them: let them also that love your name be joyful in you.

verses.raw: For you, Yahuah (LORD), will bless the righteous; with favour will you compass him as with a shield.
verses.text: For you, Yahuah, will bless the righteous; with favour will you compass him as with a shield.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), rebuke me not in your anger, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
verses.text: O Yahuah, rebuke me not in your anger, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

verses.raw: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah (LORD); for I am weak: O Yahuah (LORD), heal me; for my bones are vexed.
verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah; for I am weak: O Yahuah, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

verses.raw: My soul is also sore vexed: but you, O Yahuah (LORD), how long?
verses.text: My soul is also sore vexed: but you, O Yahuah, how long?

verses.raw: Return, O Yahuah (LORD), deliver my soul: oh save me for your mercies’ sake.
verses.text: Return, O Yahuah, deliver my soul: oh save me for your mercies’ sake.

verses.raw: For in death there is no remembrance of you: in the grave who shall give you thanks?
verses.text: For in death there is no remembrance of you: in the grave who shall give you thanks?

verses.raw: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
verses.text: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

verses.raw: My eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all my enemies.
verses.text: My eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all my enemies.

verses.raw: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; for Yahuah (LORD) has heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.text: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity; for Yahuah has heard the voice of my weeping.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has heard my supplication; Yahuah (LORD) will receive my prayer.
verses.text: Yahuah has heard my supplication; Yahuah will receive my prayer.

verses.raw: Let all my enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
verses.text: Let all my enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), in you do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
verses.text: O Yahuah my Elohim, in you do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

verses.raw: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.text: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.text: O Yahuah my Elohim, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

verses.raw: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is my enemy:)
verses.text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is my enemy:)

verses.raw: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay my honour in the dust. Selah.
verses.text: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay my honour in the dust. Selah.

verses.raw: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD), in your anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of my enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that you have commanded.
verses.text: Arise, O Yahuah, in your anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of my enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that you have commanded.

verses.raw: So shall the congregation of the people compass you about: for their sakes therefore return you on high.
verses.text: So shall the congregation of the people compass you about: for their sakes therefore return you on high.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall judge the people: judge me, O Yahuah (LORD), according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity that is in me.
verses.text: Yahuah shall judge the people: judge me, O Yahuah, according to my righteousness, and according to my integrity that is in me.

verses.raw: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous Elohim (God) trieth the hearts and reins.
verses.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous Elohim trieth the hearts and reins.

verses.raw: My defence is of Elohim (God), which saves the upright in heart.
verses.text: My defence is of Elohim, which saves the upright in heart.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) judges the righteous, and Elohim (God) is angry with the wicked every day.
verses.text: Elohim judges the righteous, and Elohim is angry with the wicked every day.

verses.raw: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready.
verses.text: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready.

verses.raw: He has also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
verses.text: He has also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

verses.raw: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and has conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
verses.text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and has conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

verses.raw: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.text: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

verses.raw: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

verses.raw: I will praise Yahuah (LORD) according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of Yahuah (LORD) most high.
verses.text: I will praise Yahuah according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of Yahuah most high.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD) our Lord, how excellent is your name in all the earth! who have set your glory above the heavens.
verses.text: O Yahuah our Lord, how excellent is your name in all the earth! who have set your glory above the heavens.

verses.raw: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings have you ordained strength because of your enemies, that you might still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.text: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings have you ordained strength because of your enemies, that you might still the enemy and the avenger.

verses.raw: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
verses.text: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;

verses.raw: What is man, that you are mindful of him? and the son of Adam, that you visit him?
verses.text: What is man, that you are mindful of him? and the son of Adam, that you visit him?

verses.raw: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and have crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.text: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and have crowned him with glory and honour.

verses.raw: You made him to have dominion over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet:
verses.text: You made him to have dominion over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet:

verses.raw: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.text: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;

verses.raw: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passes through the paths of the seas.
verses.text: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, and whatsoever passes through the paths of the seas.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD) our Lord, how excellent is your name in all the earth!
verses.text: O Yahuah our Lord, how excellent is your name in all the earth!

verses.raw: I will praise you, O Yahuah (LORD), with my whole heart; I will shew forth all your marvellous works.
verses.text: I will praise you, O Yahuah, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all your marvellous works.

verses.raw: I will be glad and rejoice in you: I will sing praise to your name, O you El Elyon (most High).
verses.text: I will be glad and rejoice in you: I will sing praise to your name, O you El Elyon.

verses.raw: When my enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at your presence.
verses.text: When my enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at your presence.

verses.raw: For you have maintained my right and my cause; you sat in the throne judging right.
verses.text: For you have maintained my right and my cause; you sat in the throne judging right.

verses.raw: You have rebuked the heathen, you have destroyed the wicked, you have put out their name for ever and ever.
verses.text: You have rebuked the heathen, you have destroyed the wicked, you have put out their name for ever and ever.

verses.raw: O you enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and you have destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
verses.text: O you enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and you have destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) shall endure for ever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.
verses.text: But Yahuah shall endure for ever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.raw: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
verses.text: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
verses.text: Yahuah also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

verses.raw: And they that know your name will put their trust in you: for you, Yahuah (LORD), have not forsaken them that seek you.
verses.text: And they that know your name will put their trust in you: for you, Yahuah, have not forsaken them that seek you.

verses.raw: Sing praises to Yahuah (LORD), which dwells in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
verses.text: Sing praises to Yahuah, which dwells in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

verses.raw: When he makes inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
verses.text: When he makes inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

verses.raw: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah (LORD); consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, you that liftest me up from the gates of death:
verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, you that liftest me up from the gates of death:

verses.raw: That I may shew forth all your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in your salvation.
verses.text: That I may shew forth all your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in your salvation.

verses.raw: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.text: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
verses.text: Yahuah is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

verses.raw: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget Elohim (God).
verses.text: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget Elohim.

verses.raw: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.
verses.text: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.raw: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD); let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in your sight.
verses.text: Arise, O Yahuah; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in your sight.

verses.raw: Put them in fear, O Yahuah (LORD): that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
verses.text: Put them in fear, O Yahuah: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

verses.raw: Why stand you afar off, O Yahuah (LORD)? why hide you thyself in times of trouble?
verses.text: Why stand you afar off, O Yahuah? why hide you thyself in times of trouble?

verses.raw: The wicked in his pride does persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.text: The wicked in his pride does persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

verses.raw: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesses the covetous, whom Yahuah (LORD) abhors.
verses.text: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesses the covetous, whom Yahuah abhors.

verses.raw: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after Elohim (God): Elohim (God) is not in all his thoughts.
verses.text: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after Elohim: Elohim is not in all his thoughts.

verses.raw: His ways are always grievous; your judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
verses.text: His ways are always grievous; your judgments are far above out of his sight: as for all his enemies, he puffeth at them.

verses.raw: He has said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.
verses.text: He has said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for I shall never be in adversity.

verses.raw: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.
verses.text: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

verses.raw: He sits in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places does he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
verses.text: He sits in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places does he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

verses.raw: He lies in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lies in wait to catch the poor: he does catch the poor, when he draws him into his net.
verses.text: He lies in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lies in wait to catch the poor: he does catch the poor, when he draws him into his net.

verses.raw: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
verses.text: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

verses.raw: He has said in his heart, Elohim (God) has forgotten: he hides his face; he will never see it.
verses.text: He has said in his heart, Elohim has forgotten: he hides his face; he will never see it.

verses.raw: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD); O Elohim (God), lift up your hand: forget not the humble.
verses.text: Arise, O Yahuah; O Elohim, lift up your hand: forget not the humble.

verses.raw: Wherefore does the wicked contemn Elohim (God)? he has said in his heart, You will not require it.
verses.text: Wherefore does the wicked contemn Elohim? he has said in his heart, You will not require it.

verses.raw: You have seen it; for you behold mischief and spite, to requite it with your hand: the poor commits himself unto you; you are the helper of the fatherless.
verses.text: You have seen it; for you behold mischief and spite, to requite it with your hand: the poor commits himself unto you; you are the helper of the fatherless.

verses.raw: Break you the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till you find none.
verses.text: Break you the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till you find none.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
verses.text: Yahuah is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), you have heard the desire of the humble: you will prepare their heart, you will cause your ear to hear:
verses.text: Yahuah, you have heard the desire of the humble: you will prepare their heart, you will cause your ear to hear:

verses.raw: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
verses.text: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.

verses.raw: In Yahuah (LORD) put I my trust: how say you to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?
verses.text: In Yahuah put I my trust: how say you to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

verses.raw: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
verses.text: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

verses.raw: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
verses.text: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is in his holy temple, the LORD’S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.text: Yahuah is in his holy temple, the LORD’S throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loves violence his soul hates.
verses.text: Yahuah trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loves violence his soul hates.

verses.raw: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.text: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

verses.raw: For the righteous Yahuah (LORD) loves righteousness; his countenance does behold the upright.
verses.text: For the righteous Yahuah loves righteousness; his countenance does behold the upright.

verses.raw: Help, Yahuah (LORD); for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.text: Help, Yahuah; for the godly man ceases; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

verses.raw: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
verses.text: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaks proud things:
verses.text: Yahuah shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaks proud things:

verses.raw: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.text: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

verses.raw: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, says Yahuah (LORD); I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
verses.text: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, says Yahuah; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

verses.raw: The words of Yahuah (LORD) are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.text: The words of Yahuah are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

verses.raw: You shall keep them, O Yahuah (LORD), you shall preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.text: You shall keep them, O Yahuah, you shall preserve them from this generation for ever.

verses.raw: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.text: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.

verses.raw: How long will you forget me, O Yahuah (LORD)? for ever? how long will you hide your face from me?
verses.text: How long will you forget me, O Yahuah? for ever? how long will you hide your face from me?

verses.raw: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me?
verses.text: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me?

verses.raw: Consider and hear me, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God): lighten my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.text: Consider and hear me, O Yahuah my Elohim: lighten my eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

verses.raw: Lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
verses.text: Lest my enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

verses.raw: But I have trusted in your mercy; my heart shall rejoice in your salvation.
verses.text: But I have trusted in your mercy; my heart shall rejoice in your salvation.

verses.raw: I will sing unto Yahuah (LORD), because he has dealt bountifully with me.
verses.text: I will sing unto Yahuah, because he has dealt bountifully with me.

verses.raw: The fool has said in his heart, There is no Elohim (God). They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that does good.
verses.text: The fool has said in his heart, There is no Elohim. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that does good.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yahuah looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, and seek Elohim.

verses.raw: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that does good, no, not one.
verses.text: They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that does good, no, not one.

verses.raw: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon Yahuah.

verses.raw: There were they in great fear: for Elohim (God) is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.text: There were they in great fear: for Elohim is in the generation of the righteous.

verses.raw: You have shamed the counsel of the poor, because Yahuah (LORD) is his refuge.
verses.text: You have shamed the counsel of the poor, because Yahuah is his refuge.

verses.raw: Oh that the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) were come out of Zion! when Yahuah (LORD) brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall be glad.
verses.text: Oh that the salvation of Yashar'el were come out of Zion! when Yahuah brings back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Yashar'el shall be glad.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), who shall abide in your tabernacle? who shall dwell in your holy hill?
verses.text: Yahuah, who shall abide in your tabernacle? who shall dwell in your holy hill?

verses.raw: He that walks uprightly, and works righteousness, and speaks the truth in his heart.
verses.text: He that walks uprightly, and works righteousness, and speaks the truth in his heart.

verses.raw: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor does evil to his neighbour, nor takes up a reproach against his neighbour.
verses.text: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor does evil to his neighbour, nor takes up a reproach against his neighbour.

verses.raw: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear Yahuah (LORD). He that swears to his own hurt, and changeth not.
verses.text: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear Yahuah. He that swears to his own hurt, and changeth not.

verses.raw: He that puts not out his money to usury, nor takes reward against the innocent. He that does these things shall never be moved.
verses.text: He that puts not out his money to usury, nor takes reward against the innocent. He that does these things shall never be moved.

verses.raw: Preserve me, O Elohim (God): for in you do I put my trust.
verses.text: Preserve me, O Elohim: for in you do I put my trust.

verses.raw: O my soul, you have said unto Yahuah (LORD), You are my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to you;
verses.text: O my soul, you have said unto Yahuah, You are my Lord: my goodness extendeth not to you;

verses.raw: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.
verses.text: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

verses.raw: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.
verses.text: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: you maintainest my lot.
verses.text: Yahuah is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: you maintainest my lot.

verses.raw: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.text: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

verses.raw: I will bless Yahuah (LORD), who has given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.
verses.text: I will bless Yahuah, who has given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

verses.raw: I have set Yahuah (LORD) always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.text: I have set Yahuah always before me: because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

verses.raw: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices: my flesh also shall rest in hope.
verses.text: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices: my flesh also shall rest in hope.

verses.raw: For you will not leave my soul in hell; neither will you suffer your Holy One to see corruption.
verses.text: For you will not leave my soul in hell; neither will you suffer your Holy One to see corruption.

verses.raw: You will shew me the path of life: in your presence is fulness of joy; at your right hand there are pleasures for evermore.
verses.text: You will shew me the path of life: in your presence is fulness of joy; at your right hand there are pleasures for evermore.

verses.raw: Hear the right, O Yahuah (LORD), attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goes not out of feigned lips.
verses.text: Hear the right, O Yahuah, attend unto my cry, give ear unto my prayer, that goes not out of feigned lips.

verses.raw: Let my sentence come forth from your presence; let your eyes behold the things that are equal.
verses.text: Let my sentence come forth from your presence; let your eyes behold the things that are equal.

verses.raw: You have proved my heart; you have visited me in the night; you have tried me, and shall find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.
verses.text: You have proved my heart; you have visited me in the night; you have tried me, and shall find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

verses.raw: Concerning the works of men, by the word of your lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.
verses.text: Concerning the works of men, by the word of your lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

verses.raw: Hold up my goings in your paths, that my footsteps slip not.
verses.text: Hold up my goings in your paths, that my footsteps slip not.

verses.raw: I have called upon you, for you will hear me, O Elohim (God): incline your ear unto me, and hear my speech.
verses.text: I have called upon you, for you will hear me, O Elohim: incline your ear unto me, and hear my speech.

verses.raw: Shew your marvellous lovingkindness, O you that savest by your right hand them which put their trust in you from those that rise up against them.
verses.text: Shew your marvellous lovingkindness, O you that savest by your right hand them which put their trust in you from those that rise up against them.

verses.raw: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of your wings,
verses.text: Keep me as the apple of the eye, hide me under the shadow of your wings,

verses.raw: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.
verses.text: From the wicked that oppress me, from my deadly enemies, who compass me about.

verses.raw: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.text: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

verses.raw: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;
verses.text: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

verses.raw: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.text: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

verses.raw: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD), disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is your sword:
verses.text: Arise, O Yahuah, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is your sword:

verses.raw: From men which are your hand, O Yahuah (LORD), from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly you fillest with your hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.
verses.text: From men which are your hand, O Yahuah, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly you fillest with your hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

verses.raw: As for me, I will behold your face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with your likeness.
verses.text: As for me, I will behold your face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with your likeness.

verses.raw: I will love you, O Yahuah (LORD), my strength.
verses.text: I will love you, O Yahuah, my strength.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my Elohim (God), my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
verses.text: Yahuah is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my Elohim, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

verses.raw: I will call upon Yahuah (LORD), who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from my enemies.
verses.text: I will call upon Yahuah, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from my enemies.

verses.raw: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.
verses.text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

verses.raw: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.
verses.text: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

verses.raw: In my distress I called upon Yahuah (LORD), and cried unto my Elohim (God): he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.
verses.text: In my distress I called upon Yahuah, and cried unto my Elohim: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

verses.raw: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.
verses.text: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

verses.raw: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.
verses.text: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

verses.raw: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.
verses.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

verses.raw: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
verses.text: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

verses.raw: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
verses.text: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

verses.raw: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.text: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.
verses.text: Yahuah also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

verses.raw: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.text: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

verses.raw: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at your rebuke, O Yahuah (LORD), at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
verses.text: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at your rebuke, O Yahuah, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

verses.raw: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.
verses.text: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

verses.raw: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.
verses.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

verses.raw: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but Yahuah (LORD) was my stay.
verses.text: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but Yahuah was my stay.

verses.raw: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.
verses.text: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.
verses.text: Yahuah rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands has he recompensed me.

verses.raw: For I have kept the ways of Yahuah (LORD), and have not wickedly departed from my Elohim (God).
verses.text: For I have kept the ways of Yahuah, and have not wickedly departed from my Elohim.

verses.raw: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.
verses.text: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

verses.raw: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.
verses.text: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from my iniquity.

verses.raw: Therefore has Yahuah (LORD) recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
verses.text: Therefore has Yahuah recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

verses.raw: With the merciful you will shew thyself merciful; with an upright man you will shew thyself upright;
verses.text: With the merciful you will shew thyself merciful; with an upright man you will shew thyself upright;

verses.raw: With the pure you will shew thyself pure; and with the froward you will shew thyself froward.
verses.text: With the pure you will shew thyself pure; and with the froward you will shew thyself froward.

verses.raw: For you will save the afflicted people; but will bring down high looks.
verses.text: For you will save the afflicted people; but will bring down high looks.

verses.raw: For you will light my candle: Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) will enlighten my darkness.
verses.text: For you will light my candle: Yahuah Elohai will enlighten my darkness.

verses.raw: For by you I have run through a troop; and by my Elohim (God) have I leaped over a wall.
verses.text: For by you I have run through a troop; and by my Elohim have I leaped over a wall.

verses.raw: As for Elohim (God), his way is perfect: the word of Yahuah (LORD) is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.
verses.text: As for Elohim, his way is perfect: the word of Yahuah is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

verses.raw: For who is Elohim (God) save Yahuah (LORD)? or who is a rock save our Elohim (God)?
verses.text: For who is Elohim save Yahuah? or who is a rock save our Elohim?

verses.raw: It is Elohim (God) that girdeth me with strength, and makes my way perfect.
verses.text: It is Elohim that girdeth me with strength, and makes my way perfect.

verses.raw: He makes my feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me upon my high places.
verses.text: He makes my feet like hinds’ feet, and sets me upon my high places.

verses.raw: He teaches my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by my arms.
verses.text: He teaches my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by my arms.

verses.raw: You have also given me the shield of your salvation: and your right hand has holden me up, and your gentleness has made me great.
verses.text: You have also given me the shield of your salvation: and your right hand has holden me up, and your gentleness has made me great.

verses.raw: You have enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.
verses.text: You have enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

verses.raw: I have pursued my enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.
verses.text: I have pursued my enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

verses.raw: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.
verses.text: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

verses.raw: For you have girded me with strength unto the battle: you have subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.text: For you have girded me with strength unto the battle: you have subdued under me those that rose up against me.

verses.raw: You have also given me the necks of my enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.
verses.text: You have also given me the necks of my enemies; that I might destroy them that hate me.

verses.raw: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto Yahuah (LORD), but he answered them not.
verses.text: They cried, but there was none to save them: even unto Yahuah, but he answered them not.

verses.raw: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.
verses.text: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

verses.raw: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; and you have made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.
verses.text: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people; and you have made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

verses.raw: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.
verses.text: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

verses.raw: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.
verses.text: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) lives; and blessed be my rock; and let the Elohim (God) of my salvation be exalted.
verses.text: Yahuah lives; and blessed be my rock; and let the Elohim of my salvation be exalted.

verses.raw: It is Elohim (God) that avenges me, and subdueth the people under me.
verses.text: It is Elohim that avenges me, and subdueth the people under me.

verses.raw: He delivers me from my enemies: yea, you liftest me up above those that rise up against me: you have delivered me from the violent man.
verses.text: He delivers me from my enemies: yea, you liftest me up above those that rise up against me: you have delivered me from the violent man.

verses.raw: Therefore will I give thanks unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), among the heathen, and sing praises unto your name.
verses.text: Therefore will I give thanks unto you, O Yahuah, among the heathen, and sing praises unto your name.

verses.raw: Great deliverance gives he to his king; and shows mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.
verses.text: Great deliverance gives he to his king; and shows mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

verses.raw: The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament shows his handywork.
verses.text: The heavens declare the glory of Elohim; and the firmament shows his handywork.

verses.raw: Day unto day utters speech, and night unto night shows knowledge.
verses.text: Day unto day utters speech, and night unto night shows knowledge.

verses.raw: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.
verses.text: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

verses.raw: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them has he set a tabernacle for the sun,
verses.text: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them has he set a tabernacle for the sun,

verses.raw: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoices as a strong man to run a race.
verses.text: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoices as a strong man to run a race.

verses.raw: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.text: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

verses.raw: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.
verses.text: The law of Yahuah is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah is sure, making wise the simple.

verses.raw: The statutes of Yahuah (LORD) are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.text: The statutes of Yahuah are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of Yahuah is pure, enlightening the eyes.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of Yahuah (LORD) are true and righteous altogether.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of Yahuah are true and righteous altogether.

verses.raw: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.text: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.

verses.raw: Moreover by them is your servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.text: Moreover by them is your servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

verses.raw: Who can understand his errors? cleanse you me from secret faults.
verses.text: Who can understand his errors? cleanse you me from secret faults.

verses.raw: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.
verses.text: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

verses.raw: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in your sight, O Yahuah (LORD), my strength, and my redeemer.
verses.text: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in your sight, O Yahuah, my strength, and my redeemer.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) hear you in the day of trouble; the name of the Elohim (God) of Jacob defend you;
verses.text: Yahuah hear you in the day of trouble; the name of the Elohim of Jacob defend you;

verses.raw: Send you help from the sanctuary, and strengthen you out of Zion;
verses.text: Send you help from the sanctuary, and strengthen you out of Zion;

verses.raw: Remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice; Selah.
verses.text: Remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice; Selah.

verses.raw: Grant you according to your own heart, and fulfil all your counsel.
verses.text: Grant you according to your own heart, and fulfil all your counsel.

verses.raw: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our Elohim (God) we will set up our banners: Yahuah (LORD) fulfil all your petitions.
verses.text: We will rejoice in your salvation, and in the name of our Elohim we will set up our banners: Yahuah fulfil all your petitions.

verses.raw: Now know I that Yahuah (LORD) saves his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.
verses.text: Now know I that Yahuah saves his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

verses.raw: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
verses.text: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of Yahuah Eloheinu.

verses.raw: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.text: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

verses.raw: Save, Yahuah (LORD): let the king hear us when we call.
verses.text: Save, Yahuah: let the king hear us when we call.

verses.raw: The king shall joy in your strength, O Yahuah (LORD); and in your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!
verses.text: The king shall joy in your strength, O Yahuah; and in your salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

verses.raw: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.
verses.text: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

verses.raw: For you preventest him with the blessings of goodness: you set a crown of pure gold on his head.
verses.text: For you preventest him with the blessings of goodness: you set a crown of pure gold on his head.

verses.raw: He asked life of you, and you gave it him, even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.text: He asked life of you, and you gave it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

verses.raw: His glory is great in your salvation: honour and majesty have you laid upon him.
verses.text: His glory is great in your salvation: honour and majesty have you laid upon him.

verses.raw: For you have made him most blessed for ever: you have made him exceeding glad with your countenance.
verses.text: For you have made him most blessed for ever: you have made him exceeding glad with your countenance.

verses.raw: For the king trusts in Yahuah (LORD), and through the mercy of the El Elyon (most High) he shall not be moved.
verses.text: For the king trusts in Yahuah, and through the mercy of the El Elyon he shall not be moved.

verses.raw: Your hand shall find out all your enemies: your right hand shall find out those that hate you.
verses.text: Your hand shall find out all your enemies: your right hand shall find out those that hate you.

verses.raw: You shall make them as a fiery oven in the time of your anger: Yahuah (LORD) shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.text: You shall make them as a fiery oven in the time of your anger: Yahuah shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

verses.raw: Their fruit shall you destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.text: Their fruit shall you destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

verses.raw: For they intended evil against you: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.
verses.text: For they intended evil against you: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

verses.raw: Therefore shall you make them turn their back, when you shall make ready your arrows upon your strings against the face of them.
verses.text: Therefore shall you make them turn their back, when you shall make ready your arrows upon your strings against the face of them.

verses.raw: Be you exalted, Yahuah (LORD), in your own strength: so will we sing and praise your power.
verses.text: Be you exalted, Yahuah, in your own strength: so will we sing and praise your power.

verses.raw: My Elohim (God), my Elohim (God), why have you forsaken me? why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?
verses.text: My Elohim, my Elohim, why have you forsaken me? why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my roaring?

verses.raw: O my Elohim (God), I cry in the daytime, but you hear not; and in the night season, and am not silent.
verses.text: O my Elohim, I cry in the daytime, but you hear not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

verses.raw: But you are holy, O you that inhabitest the praises of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But you are holy, O you that inhabitest the praises of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Our fathers trusted in you: they trusted, and you did deliver them.
verses.text: Our fathers trusted in you: they trusted, and you did deliver them.

verses.raw: They cried unto you, and were delivered: they trusted in you, and were not confounded.
verses.text: They cried unto you, and were delivered: they trusted in you, and were not confounded.

verses.raw: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.text: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

verses.raw: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,
verses.text: All they that see me laugh me to scorn: they shoot out the lip, they shake the head, saying,

verses.raw: He trusted on Yahuah (LORD) that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.
verses.text: He trusted on Yahuah that he would deliver him: let him deliver him, seeing he delighted in him.

verses.raw: But you are he that took me out of the womb: you did make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.
verses.text: But you are he that took me out of the womb: you did make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

verses.raw: I was cast upon you from the womb: you are my Elohim (God) from my mother’s belly.
verses.text: I was cast upon you from the womb: you are my Elohim from my mother’s belly.

verses.raw: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.text: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

verses.raw: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.text: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

verses.raw: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.text: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

verses.raw: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.
verses.text: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint: my heart is like wax; it is melted in the midst of my bowels.

verses.raw: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaves to my jaws; and you have brought me into the dust of death.
verses.text: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaves to my jaws; and you have brought me into the dust of death.

verses.raw: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.
verses.text: For dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked have inclosed me: they pierced my hands and my feet.

verses.raw: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.
verses.text: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

verses.raw: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.
verses.text: They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.

verses.raw: But be not you far from me, O Yahuah (LORD): O my strength, haste you to help me.
verses.text: But be not you far from me, O Yahuah: O my strength, haste you to help me.

verses.raw: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.
verses.text: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

verses.raw: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for you have heard me from the horns of the unicorns.
verses.text: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for you have heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

verses.raw: I will declare your name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise you.
verses.text: I will declare your name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise you.

verses.raw: You that fear Yahuah (LORD), praise him; all you the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all you the seed of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: You that fear Yahuah, praise him; all you the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all you the seed of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither has he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.
verses.text: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither has he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

verses.raw: My praise shall be of you in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.
verses.text: My praise shall be of you in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

verses.raw: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise Yahuah (LORD) that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.
verses.text: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise Yahuah that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

verses.raw: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto Yahuah (LORD): and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before you.
verses.text: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto Yahuah: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before you.

verses.raw: For the kingdom is the LORD’S: and he is the governor among the nations.
verses.text: For the kingdom is the LORD’S: and he is the governor among the nations.

verses.raw: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.
verses.text: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

verses.raw: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to Adonai (Lord) for a generation.
verses.text: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to Adonai for a generation.

verses.raw: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he has done this.
verses.text: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he has done this.

verses.raw: Yahuah Ra'ah (The LORD is my shepherd); I shall not want.
verses.text: Yahuah Ra'ah; I shall not want.

verses.raw: He makes me to lie down in green pastures: he leads me beside the still waters.
verses.text: He makes me to lie down in green pastures: he leads me beside the still waters.

verses.raw: He restoreth my soul: he leads me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.text: He restoreth my soul: he leads me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

verses.raw: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for you are with me; your rod and your staff they comfort me.
verses.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for you are with me; your rod and your staff they comfort me.

verses.raw: You preparest a table before me in the presence of my enemies: you anointest my head with oil; my cup runs over.
verses.text: You preparest a table before me in the presence of my enemies: you anointest my head with oil; my cup runs over.

verses.raw: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of Yahuah (LORD) for ever.
verses.text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of Yahuah for ever.

verses.raw: The earth is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.text: The earth is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.raw: For he has founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.text: For he has founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

verses.raw: Who shall ascend into the hill of Yahuah (LORD)? or who shall stand in his holy place?
verses.text: Who shall ascend into the hill of Yahuah? or who shall stand in his holy place?

verses.raw: He that has clean hands, and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.
verses.text: He that has clean hands, and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

verses.raw: He shall receive the blessing from Yahuah (LORD), and righteousness from the Elohim (God) of his salvation.
verses.text: He shall receive the blessing from Yahuah, and righteousness from the Elohim of his salvation.

verses.raw: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek your face, O Jacob. Selah.
verses.text: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek your face, O Jacob. Selah.

verses.raw: Lift up your heads, O you gates; and be you lift up, you everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
verses.text: Lift up your heads, O you gates; and be you lift up, you everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.raw: Who is this King of glory? Yahuah (LORD) strong and mighty, Yahuah (LORD) mighty in battle.
verses.text: Who is this King of glory? Yahuah strong and mighty, Yahuah mighty in battle.

verses.raw: Lift up your heads, O you gates; even lift them up, you everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
