verses.text: Lift up your heads, O you gates; even lift them up, you everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.raw: Who is this King of glory? Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), he is the King of glory. Selah.
verses.text: Who is this King of glory? Yahuah Tseva'ot, he is the King of glory. Selah.

verses.raw: Unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), do I lift up my soul.
verses.text: Unto you, O Yahuah, do I lift up my soul.

verses.raw: O my Elohim (God), I trust in you: let me not be ashamed, let not my enemies triumph over me.
verses.text: O my Elohim, I trust in you: let me not be ashamed, let not my enemies triumph over me.

verses.raw: Yea, let none that wait on you be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.
verses.text: Yea, let none that wait on you be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

verses.raw: Shew me your ways, O Yahuah (LORD); teach me your paths.
verses.text: Shew me your ways, O Yahuah; teach me your paths.

verses.raw: Lead me in your truth, and teach me: for you are the Elohim (God) of my salvation; on you do I wait all the day.
verses.text: Lead me in your truth, and teach me: for you are the Elohim of my salvation; on you do I wait all the day.

verses.raw: Remember, O Yahuah (LORD), your tender mercies and your lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.
verses.text: Remember, O Yahuah, your tender mercies and your lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

verses.raw: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to your mercy remember you me for your goodness’ sake, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to your mercy remember you me for your goodness’ sake, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Good and upright is Yahuah (LORD): therefore will he teach sinners in the way.
verses.text: Good and upright is Yahuah: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

verses.raw: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.
verses.text: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

verses.raw: All the paths of Yahuah (LORD) are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.
verses.text: All the paths of Yahuah are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.raw: For your name’s sake, O Yahuah (LORD), pardon my iniquity; for it is great.
verses.text: For your name’s sake, O Yahuah, pardon my iniquity; for it is great.

verses.raw: What man is he that fears Yahuah (LORD)? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.
verses.text: What man is he that fears Yahuah? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

verses.raw: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.
verses.text: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

verses.raw: The secret of Yahuah (LORD) is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.
verses.text: The secret of Yahuah is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

verses.raw: My eyes are ever toward Yahuah (LORD); for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.
verses.text: My eyes are ever toward Yahuah; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.raw: Turn you unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.
verses.text: Turn you unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

verses.raw: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring you me out of my distresses.
verses.text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring you me out of my distresses.

verses.raw: Look upon my affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.
verses.text: Look upon my affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

verses.raw: Consider my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.
verses.text: Consider my enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

verses.raw: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in you.
verses.text: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in you.

verses.raw: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on you.
verses.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on you.

verses.raw: Redeem Yashar'el (Israel), O Elohim (God), out of all his troubles.
verses.text: Redeem Yashar'el, O Elohim, out of all his troubles.

verses.raw: Judge me, O Yahuah (LORD); for I have walked in my integrity: I have trusted also in Yahuah (LORD); therefore I shall not slide.
verses.text: Judge me, O Yahuah; for I have walked in my integrity: I have trusted also in Yahuah; therefore I shall not slide.

verses.raw: Examine me, O Yahuah (LORD), and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.text: Examine me, O Yahuah, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

verses.raw: For your lovingkindness is before my eyes: and I have walked in your truth.
verses.text: For your lovingkindness is before my eyes: and I have walked in your truth.

verses.raw: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.text: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

verses.raw: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.text: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.raw: I will wash my hands in innocency: so will I compass your altar, O Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: I will wash my hands in innocency: so will I compass your altar, O Yahuah:

verses.raw: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all your wondrous works.
verses.text: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all your wondrous works.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), I have loved the habitation of your house, and the place where your honour dwells.
verses.text: Yahuah, I have loved the habitation of your house, and the place where your honour dwells.

verses.raw: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.text: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

verses.raw: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.text: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.raw: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.text: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

verses.raw: My foot stands in an even place: in the congregations will I bless Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: My foot stands in an even place: in the congregations will I bless Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? Yahuah (LORD) is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.text: Yahuah is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? Yahuah is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

verses.raw: When the wicked, even my enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.
verses.text: When the wicked, even my enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

verses.raw: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.
verses.text: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

verses.raw: One thing have I desired of Yahuah (LORD), that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of Yahuah (LORD) all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of Yahuah (LORD), and to enquire in his temple.
verses.text: One thing have I desired of Yahuah, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of Yahuah all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of Yahuah, and to enquire in his temple.

verses.raw: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.
verses.text: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

verses.raw: And now shall my head be lifted up above my enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And now shall my head be lifted up above my enemies round about me: therefore will I offer in his tabernacle sacrifices of joy; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: Hear, O Yahuah (LORD), when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.
verses.text: Hear, O Yahuah, when I cry with my voice: have mercy also upon me, and answer me.

verses.raw: When you saidst, Seek you my face; my heart said unto you, Your face, Yahuah (LORD), will I seek.
verses.text: When you saidst, Seek you my face; my heart said unto you, Your face, Yahuah, will I seek.

verses.raw: Hide not your face far from me; put not your servant away in anger: you have been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O Elohim (God) of my salvation.
verses.text: Hide not your face far from me; put not your servant away in anger: you have been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O Elohim of my salvation.

verses.raw: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahuah (LORD) will take me up.
verses.text: When my father and my mother forsake me, then Yahuah will take me up.

verses.raw: Teach me your way, O Yahuah (LORD), and lead me in a plain path, because of my enemies.
verses.text: Teach me your way, O Yahuah, and lead me in a plain path, because of my enemies.

verses.raw: Deliver me not over unto the will of my enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.
verses.text: Deliver me not over unto the will of my enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

verses.raw: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of Yahuah (LORD) in the land of the living.
verses.text: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of Yahuah in the land of the living.

verses.raw: Wait on Yahuah (LORD): be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart: wait, I say, on Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Wait on Yahuah: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart: wait, I say, on Yahuah.

verses.raw: Unto you will I cry, O Yahuah (LORD) my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if you be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.text: Unto you will I cry, O Yahuah my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if you be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.raw: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto you, when I lift up my hands toward your holy oracle.
verses.text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto you, when I lift up my hands toward your holy oracle.

verses.raw: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.
verses.text: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

verses.raw: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.
verses.text: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

verses.raw: Because they regard not the works of Yahuah (LORD), nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.
verses.text: Because they regard not the works of Yahuah, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), because he has heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah, because he has heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song will I praise him.
verses.text: Yahuah is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoices; and with my song will I praise him.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
verses.text: Yahuah is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

verses.raw: Save your people, and bless your inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.
verses.text: Save your people, and bless your inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

verses.raw: Give unto Yahuah (LORD), O you mighty, give unto Yahuah (LORD) glory and strength.
verses.text: Give unto Yahuah, O you mighty, give unto Yahuah glory and strength.

verses.raw: Give unto Yahuah (LORD) the glory due unto his name; worship Yahuah (LORD) in the beauty of holiness.
verses.text: Give unto Yahuah the glory due unto his name; worship Yahuah in the beauty of holiness.

verses.raw: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) is upon the waters: the Elohim (God) of glory thundereth: Yahuah (LORD) is upon many waters.
verses.text: The voice of Yahuah is upon the waters: the Elohim of glory thundereth: Yahuah is upon many waters.

verses.raw: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) is powerful; the voice of Yahuah (LORD) is full of majesty.
verses.text: The voice of Yahuah is powerful; the voice of Yahuah is full of majesty.

verses.raw: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) breaks the cedars; yea, Yahuah (LORD) breaks the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.text: The voice of Yahuah breaks the cedars; yea, Yahuah breaks the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.raw: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.
verses.text: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

verses.raw: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) divides the flames of fire.
verses.text: The voice of Yahuah divides the flames of fire.

verses.raw: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) shaketh the wilderness; Yahuah (LORD) shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.
verses.text: The voice of Yahuah shaketh the wilderness; Yahuah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.raw: The voice of Yahuah (LORD) makes the hinds to calve, and discovers the forests: and in his temple does every one speak of his glory.
verses.text: The voice of Yahuah makes the hinds to calve, and discovers the forests: and in his temple does every one speak of his glory.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) sits upon the flood; yea, Yahuah (LORD) sits King for ever.
verses.text: Yahuah sits upon the flood; yea, Yahuah sits King for ever.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will give strength unto his people; Yahuah (LORD) will bless his people with peace.
verses.text: Yahuah will give strength unto his people; Yahuah will bless his people with peace.

verses.raw: I will extol you, O Yahuah (LORD); for you have lifted me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.
verses.text: I will extol you, O Yahuah; for you have lifted me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), I cried unto you, and you have healed me.
verses.text: O Yahuah my Elohim, I cried unto you, and you have healed me.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), you have brought up my soul from the grave: you have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
verses.text: O Yahuah, you have brought up my soul from the grave: you have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

verses.raw: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD), O you saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.text: Sing unto Yahuah, O you saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.raw: For his anger endures but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
verses.text: For his anger endures but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.

verses.raw: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.
verses.text: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), by your favour you have made my mountain to stand strong: you did hide your face, and I was troubled.
verses.text: Yahuah, by your favour you have made my mountain to stand strong: you did hide your face, and I was troubled.

verses.raw: I cried to you, O Yahuah (LORD); and unto Yahuah (LORD) I made supplication.
verses.text: I cried to you, O Yahuah; and unto Yahuah I made supplication.

verses.raw: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? shall it declare your truth?
verses.text: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? shall it declare your truth?

verses.raw: Hear, O Yahuah (LORD), and have mercy upon me: Yahuah (LORD), be you my helper.
verses.text: Hear, O Yahuah, and have mercy upon me: Yahuah, be you my helper.

verses.raw: You have turned for me my mourning into dancing: you have put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;
verses.text: You have turned for me my mourning into dancing: you have put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

verses.raw: To the end that my glory may sing praise to you, and not be silent. O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), I will give thanks unto you for ever.
verses.text: To the end that my glory may sing praise to you, and not be silent. O Yahuah my Elohim, I will give thanks unto you for ever.

verses.raw: In you, O Yahuah (LORD), do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in your righteousness.
verses.text: In you, O Yahuah, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in your righteousness.

verses.raw: Bow down your ear to me; deliver me speedily: be you my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.text: Bow down your ear to me; deliver me speedily: be you my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.

verses.raw: For you are my rock and my fortress; therefore for your name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.text: For you are my rock and my fortress; therefore for your name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

verses.raw: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for you are my strength.
verses.text: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for you are my strength.

verses.raw: Into your hand I commit my spirit: you have redeemed me, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of truth.
verses.text: Into your hand I commit my spirit: you have redeemed me, O Yahuah Elohim of truth.

verses.raw: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will be glad and rejoice in your mercy: for you have considered my trouble; you have known my soul in adversities;
verses.text: I will be glad and rejoice in your mercy: for you have considered my trouble; you have known my soul in adversities;

verses.raw: And have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: you have set my feet in a large room.
verses.text: And have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: you have set my feet in a large room.

verses.raw: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah (LORD), for I am in trouble: my eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O Yahuah, for I am in trouble: my eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

verses.raw: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.text: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength fails because of my iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

verses.raw: I was a reproach among all my enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to my acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.text: I was a reproach among all my enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to my acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

verses.raw: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.text: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

verses.raw: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.text: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

verses.raw: But I trusted in you, O Yahuah (LORD): I said, You are my Elohim (God).
verses.text: But I trusted in you, O Yahuah: I said, You are my Elohim.

verses.raw: My times are in your hand: deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.text: My times are in your hand: deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from them that persecute me.

verses.raw: Make your face to shine upon your servant: save me for your mercies’ sake.
verses.text: Make your face to shine upon your servant: save me for your mercies’ sake.

verses.raw: Let me not be ashamed, O Yahuah (LORD); for I have called upon you: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.text: Let me not be ashamed, O Yahuah; for I have called upon you: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

verses.raw: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.text: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

verses.raw: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for them that fear you; which you have wrought for them that trust in you before the sons of men!
verses.text: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for them that fear you; which you have wrought for them that trust in you before the sons of men!

verses.raw: You shall hide them in the secret of your presence from the pride of man: you shall keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.text: You shall hide them in the secret of your presence from the pride of man: you shall keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD): for he has shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah: for he has shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

verses.raw: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before your eyes: nevertheless you heard the voice of my supplications when I cried unto you.
verses.text: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before your eyes: nevertheless you heard the voice of my supplications when I cried unto you.

verses.raw: O love Yahuah (LORD), all you his saints: for Yahuah (LORD) preserves the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.text: O love Yahuah, all you his saints: for Yahuah preserves the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

verses.raw: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all you that hope in Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all you that hope in Yahuah.

verses.raw: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.
verses.text: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man unto whom Yahuah (LORD) imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.
verses.text: Blessed is the man unto whom Yahuah imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

verses.raw: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
verses.text: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

verses.raw: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
verses.text: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

verses.raw: I acknowledged my sin unto you, and my iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Yahuah (LORD); and you forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
verses.text: I acknowledged my sin unto you, and my iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Yahuah; and you forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

verses.raw: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto you in a time when you may be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
verses.text: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto you in a time when you may be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

verses.raw: You are my hiding place; you shall preserve me from trouble; you shall compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
verses.text: You are my hiding place; you shall preserve me from trouble; you shall compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

verses.raw: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go: I will guide you with my eye.
verses.text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go: I will guide you with my eye.

verses.raw: Be you not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto you.
verses.text: Be you not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto you.

verses.raw: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusts in Yahuah (LORD), mercy shall compass him about.
verses.text: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusts in Yahuah, mercy shall compass him about.

verses.raw: Be glad in Yahuah (LORD), and rejoice, you righteous: and shout for joy, all you that are upright in heart.
verses.text: Be glad in Yahuah, and rejoice, you righteous: and shout for joy, all you that are upright in heart.

verses.raw: Rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), O you righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.
verses.text: Rejoice in Yahuah, O you righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

verses.raw: Praise Yahuah (LORD) with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.
verses.text: Praise Yahuah with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

verses.raw: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
verses.text: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

verses.raw: For the word of Yahuah (LORD) is right; and all his works are done in truth.
verses.text: For the word of Yahuah is right; and all his works are done in truth.

verses.raw: He loves righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He loves righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of Yahuah.

verses.raw: By the word of Yahuah (LORD) were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
verses.text: By the word of Yahuah were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

verses.raw: He gathers the waters of the sea together as an heap: he lays up the depth in storehouses.
verses.text: He gathers the waters of the sea together as an heap: he lays up the depth in storehouses.

verses.raw: Let all the earth fear Yahuah (LORD): let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
verses.text: Let all the earth fear Yahuah: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

verses.raw: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.
verses.text: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) brings the counsel of the heathen to nought: he makes the devices of the people of none effect.
verses.text: Yahuah brings the counsel of the heathen to nought: he makes the devices of the people of none effect.

verses.raw: The counsel of Yahuah (LORD) stands for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
verses.text: The counsel of Yahuah stands for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

verses.raw: Blessed is the nation whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD); and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.
verses.text: Blessed is the nation whose Elohim is Yahuah; and the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) looks from heaven; he beholds all the sons of men.
verses.text: Yahuah looks from heaven; he beholds all the sons of men.

verses.raw: From the place of his habitation he looks upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
verses.text: From the place of his habitation he looks upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

verses.raw: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
verses.text: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

verses.raw: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
verses.text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

verses.raw: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.
verses.text: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

verses.raw: Behold, the eye of Yahuah (LORD) is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
verses.text: Behold, the eye of Yahuah is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

verses.raw: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
verses.text: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

verses.raw: Our soul waits for Yahuah (LORD): he is our help and our shield.
verses.text: Our soul waits for Yahuah: he is our help and our shield.

verses.raw: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
verses.text: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

verses.raw: Let your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), be upon us, according as we hope in you.
verses.text: Let your mercy, O Yahuah, be upon us, according as we hope in you.

verses.raw: I will bless Yahuah (LORD) at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
verses.text: I will bless Yahuah at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

verses.raw: My soul shall make her boast in Yahuah (LORD): the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
verses.text: My soul shall make her boast in Yahuah: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

verses.raw: O magnify Yahuah (LORD) with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.text: O magnify Yahuah with me, and let us exalt his name together.

verses.raw: I sought Yahuah (LORD), and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.text: I sought Yahuah, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.raw: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.text: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

verses.raw: This poor man cried, and Yahuah (LORD) heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.text: This poor man cried, and Yahuah heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.raw: The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivers them.
verses.text: The angel of Yahuah encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivers them.

verses.raw: O taste and see that Yahuah (LORD) is good: blessed is the man that trusts in him.
verses.text: O taste and see that Yahuah is good: blessed is the man that trusts in him.

verses.raw: O fear Yahuah (LORD), you his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
verses.text: O fear Yahuah, you his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.raw: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek Yahuah (LORD) shall not want any good thing.
verses.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek Yahuah shall not want any good thing.

verses.raw: Come, you children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Come, you children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Yahuah.

verses.raw: What man is he that desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?
verses.text: What man is he that desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

verses.raw: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile.
verses.text: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile.

verses.raw: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.raw: The eyes of Yahuah (LORD) are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.
verses.text: The eyes of Yahuah are upon the righteous, and his ears are open unto their cry.

verses.raw: The face of Yahuah (LORD) is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.text: The face of Yahuah is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.raw: The righteous cry, and Yahuah (LORD) hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.
verses.text: The righteous cry, and Yahuah hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saves such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.text: Yahuah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saves such as be of a contrite spirit.

verses.raw: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but Yahuah (LORD) delivers him out of them all.
verses.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but Yahuah delivers him out of them all.

verses.raw: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.text: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.

verses.raw: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.text: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.text: Yahuah redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

verses.raw: Plead my cause, O Yahuah (LORD), with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
verses.text: Plead my cause, O Yahuah, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.

verses.raw: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.
verses.text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

verses.raw: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am your salvation.
verses.text: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am your salvation.

verses.raw: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
verses.text: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

verses.raw: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of Yahuah (LORD) chase them.
verses.text: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of Yahuah chase them.

verses.raw: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of Yahuah (LORD) persecute them.
verses.text: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of Yahuah persecute them.

verses.raw: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.
verses.text: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

verses.raw: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he has hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
verses.text: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he has hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

verses.raw: And my soul shall be joyful in Yahuah (LORD): it shall rejoice in his salvation.
verses.text: And my soul shall be joyful in Yahuah: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

verses.raw: All my bones shall say, Yahuah (LORD), who is like unto you, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoils him?
verses.text: All my bones shall say, Yahuah, who is like unto you, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoils him?

verses.raw: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.
verses.text: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

verses.raw: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.
verses.text: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

verses.raw: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into my own bosom.
verses.text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into my own bosom.

verses.raw: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourns for his mother.
verses.text: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourns for his mother.

verses.raw: But in my adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:
verses.text: But in my adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

verses.raw: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
verses.text: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord), how long will you look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
verses.text: Adonai, how long will you look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

verses.raw: I will give you thanks in the great congregation: I will praise you among much people.
verses.text: I will give you thanks in the great congregation: I will praise you among much people.

verses.raw: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
verses.text: Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

verses.raw: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
verses.text: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

verses.raw: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye has seen it.
verses.text: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye has seen it.

verses.raw: This you have seen, O Yahuah (LORD): keep not silence: O Adonai (Lord), be not far from me.
verses.text: This you have seen, O Yahuah: keep not silence: O Adonai, be not far from me.

verses.raw: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my Elohim (God) and my Lord.
verses.text: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my Elohim and my Lord.

verses.raw: Judge me, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), according to your righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
verses.text: Judge me, O Yahuah my Elohim, according to your righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

verses.raw: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
verses.text: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

verses.raw: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at my hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at my hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

verses.raw: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let Yahuah (LORD) be magnified, which has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
verses.text: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let Yahuah be magnified, which has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

verses.raw: And my tongue shall speak of your righteousness and of your praise all the day long.
verses.text: And my tongue shall speak of your righteousness and of your praise all the day long.

verses.raw: The transgression of the wicked says within my heart, that there is no fear of Elohim (God) before his eyes.
verses.text: The transgression of the wicked says within my heart, that there is no fear of Elohim before his eyes.

verses.raw: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
verses.text: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

verses.raw: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he has left off to be wise, and to do good.
verses.text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he has left off to be wise, and to do good.

verses.raw: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he sets himself in a way that is not good; he abhors not evil.
verses.text: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he sets himself in a way that is not good; he abhors not evil.

verses.raw: Your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), is in the heavens; and your faithfulness reaches unto the clouds.
verses.text: Your mercy, O Yahuah, is in the heavens; and your faithfulness reaches unto the clouds.

verses.raw: Your righteousness is like the great mountains; your judgments are a great deep: O Yahuah (LORD), you preservest man and beast.
verses.text: Your righteousness is like the great mountains; your judgments are a great deep: O Yahuah, you preservest man and beast.

verses.raw: How excellent is your lovingkindness, O Elohim (God)! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of your wings.
verses.text: How excellent is your lovingkindness, O Elohim! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of your wings.

verses.raw: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of your house; and you shall make them drink of the river of your pleasures.
verses.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of your house; and you shall make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

verses.raw: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light shall we see light.
verses.text: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light shall we see light.

verses.raw: O continue your lovingkindness unto them that know you; and your righteousness to the upright in heart.
verses.text: O continue your lovingkindness unto them that know you; and your righteousness to the upright in heart.

verses.raw: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
verses.text: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

verses.raw: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
verses.text: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

verses.raw: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be you envious against the workers of iniquity.
verses.text: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be you envious against the workers of iniquity.

verses.raw: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
verses.text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

verses.raw: Trust in Yahuah (LORD), and do good; so shall you dwell in the land, and verily you shall be fed.
verses.text: Trust in Yahuah, and do good; so shall you dwell in the land, and verily you shall be fed.

verses.raw: Delight thyself also in Yahuah (LORD); and he shall give you the desires of your heart.
verses.text: Delight thyself also in Yahuah; and he shall give you the desires of your heart.

verses.raw: Commit your way unto Yahuah (LORD); trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
verses.text: Commit your way unto Yahuah; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

verses.raw: And he shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your judgment as the noonday.
verses.text: And he shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your judgment as the noonday.

verses.raw: Rest in Yahuah (LORD), and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who brings wicked devices to pass.
verses.text: Rest in Yahuah, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who brings wicked devices to pass.

verses.raw: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
verses.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

verses.raw: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon Yahuah (LORD), they shall inherit the earth.
verses.text: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon Yahuah, they shall inherit the earth.

verses.raw: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, you shall diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
verses.text: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, you shall diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

verses.raw: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
verses.text: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

verses.raw: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
verses.text: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) shall laugh at him: for he sees that his day is coming.
verses.text: Adonai shall laugh at him: for he sees that his day is coming.

verses.raw: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
verses.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

verses.raw: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
verses.text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

verses.raw: A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked.
verses.text: A little that a righteous man has is better than the riches of many wicked.

verses.raw: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but Yahuah (LORD) upholdeth the righteous.
verses.text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but Yahuah upholdeth the righteous.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) knows the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
verses.text: Yahuah knows the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

verses.raw: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
verses.text: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

verses.raw: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of Yahuah (LORD) shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
verses.text: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of Yahuah shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

verses.raw: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous shows mercy, and gives.
verses.text: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous shows mercy, and gives.

verses.raw: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
verses.text: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

verses.raw: The steps of a good man are ordered by Yahuah (LORD): and he delights in his way.
verses.text: The steps of a good man are ordered by Yahuah: and he delights in his way.

verses.raw: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for Yahuah (LORD) upholdeth him with his hand.
verses.text: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for Yahuah upholdeth him with his hand.

verses.raw: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
verses.text: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

verses.raw: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
verses.text: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

verses.raw: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) loves judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.text: For Yahuah loves judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.raw: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
verses.text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

verses.raw: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue talks of judgment.
verses.text: The mouth of the righteous speaks wisdom, and his tongue talks of judgment.

verses.raw: The law of his Elohim (God) is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
verses.text: The law of his Elohim is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

verses.raw: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeks to slay him.
verses.text: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeks to slay him.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
verses.text: Yahuah will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

verses.raw: Wait on Yahuah (LORD), and keep his way, and he shall exalt you to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
verses.text: Wait on Yahuah, and keep his way, and he shall exalt you to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

verses.raw: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
verses.text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

verses.raw: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
verses.text: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

verses.raw: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
verses.text: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

verses.raw: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
verses.text: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

verses.raw: But the salvation of the righteous is of Yahuah (LORD): he is their strength in the time of trouble.
verses.text: But the salvation of the righteous is of Yahuah: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), rebuke me not in your wrath: neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
verses.text: O Yahuah, rebuke me not in your wrath: neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

verses.raw: For your arrows stick fast in me, and your hand presseth me sore.
verses.text: For your arrows stick fast in me, and your hand presseth me sore.

verses.raw: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.
verses.text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

verses.raw: For my iniquities are gone over my head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
verses.text: For my iniquities are gone over my head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

verses.raw: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.
verses.text: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

verses.raw: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
verses.text: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

verses.raw: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.
verses.text: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

verses.raw: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
verses.text: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord), all my desire is before you; and my groaning is not hid from you.
verses.text: Adonai, all my desire is before you; and my groaning is not hid from you.

verses.raw: My heart panteth, my strength fails me: as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.
verses.text: My heart panteth, my strength fails me: as for the light of my eyes, it also is gone from me.

verses.raw: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
verses.text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

verses.raw: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
verses.text: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

verses.raw: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that opens not his mouth.
verses.text: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that opens not his mouth.

verses.raw: Thus I was as a man that hears not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.
verses.text: Thus I was as a man that hears not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

verses.raw: For in you, O Yahuah (LORD), do I hope: you will hear, O Adonai (Lord) my Elohim (God).
verses.text: For in you, O Yahuah, do I hope: you will hear, O Adonai my Elohim.

verses.raw: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
verses.text: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

verses.raw: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.
verses.text: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

verses.raw: For I will declare my iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
verses.text: For I will declare my iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

verses.raw: But my enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
verses.text: But my enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

verses.raw: They also that render evil for good are my adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.
verses.text: They also that render evil for good are my adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

verses.raw: Forsake me not, O Yahuah (LORD): O my Elohim (God), be not far from me.
verses.text: Forsake me not, O Yahuah: O my Elohim, be not far from me.

verses.raw: Make haste to help me, O Adonai (Lord) my salvation.
verses.text: Make haste to help me, O Adonai my salvation.

verses.raw: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
verses.text: I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

verses.raw: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
verses.text: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

verses.raw: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,
verses.text: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.
verses.text: Yahuah, make me to know my end, and the measure of my days, what it is; that I may know how frail I am.

verses.raw: Behold, you have made my days as an handbreadth; and my age is as nothing before you: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.
verses.text: Behold, you have made my days as an handbreadth; and my age is as nothing before you: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

verses.raw: Surely every man walks in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knows not who shall gather them.
verses.text: Surely every man walks in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up riches, and knows not who shall gather them.

verses.raw: And now, Adonai (Lord), what wait I for? my hope is in you.
verses.text: And now, Adonai, what wait I for? my hope is in you.

verses.raw: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
verses.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.

verses.raw: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because you did it.
verses.text: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because you did it.

verses.raw: Remove your stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of your hand.
verses.text: Remove your stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of your hand.

verses.raw: When you with rebukes do correct man for iniquity, you make his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.
verses.text: When you with rebukes do correct man for iniquity, you make his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man is vanity. Selah.

verses.raw: Hear my prayer, O Yahuah (LORD), and give ear unto my cry; hold not your peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with you, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O Yahuah, and give ear unto my cry; hold not your peace at my tears: for I am a stranger with you, and a sojourner, as all my fathers were.

verses.raw: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
verses.text: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.

verses.raw: I waited patiently for Yahuah (LORD); and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
verses.text: I waited patiently for Yahuah; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.

verses.raw: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.
verses.text: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

verses.raw: And he has put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our Elohim (God): many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he has put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our Elohim: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahuah.

verses.raw: Blessed is that man that makes Yahuah (LORD) his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
verses.text: Blessed is that man that makes Yahuah his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

verses.raw: Many, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), are your wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto you: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.
verses.text: Many, O Yahuah my Elohim, are your wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto you: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

verses.raw: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire; my ears have you opened: burnt offering and sin offering have you not required.
verses.text: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire; my ears have you opened: burnt offering and sin offering have you not required.

verses.raw: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,
verses.text: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

verses.raw: I delight to do your will, O my Elohim (God): yea, your law is within my heart.
verses.text: I delight to do your will, O my Elohim: yea, your law is within my heart.

verses.raw: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Yahuah (LORD), you know.
verses.text: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Yahuah, you know.

verses.raw: I have not hid your righteousness within my heart; I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation: I have not concealed your lovingkindness and your truth from the great congregation.
verses.text: I have not hid your righteousness within my heart; I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation: I have not concealed your lovingkindness and your truth from the great congregation.

verses.raw: Withhold not you your tender mercies from me, O Yahuah (LORD): let your lovingkindness and your truth continually preserve me.
verses.text: Withhold not you your tender mercies from me, O Yahuah: let your lovingkindness and your truth continually preserve me.

verses.raw: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: my iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head: therefore my heart fails me.
verses.text: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: my iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head: therefore my heart fails me.

verses.raw: Be pleased, O Yahuah (LORD), to deliver me: O Yahuah (LORD), make haste to help me.
verses.text: Be pleased, O Yahuah, to deliver me: O Yahuah, make haste to help me.

verses.raw: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

verses.raw: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
verses.text: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

verses.raw: Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: let such as love your salvation say continually, Yahuah (LORD) be magnified.
verses.text: Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: let such as love your salvation say continually, Yahuah be magnified.

verses.raw: But I am poor and needy; yet Adonai (Lord) thinketh upon me: you are my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my Elohim (God).
verses.text: But I am poor and needy; yet Adonai thinketh upon me: you are my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my Elohim.

verses.raw: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Yahuah (LORD) will deliver him in time of trouble.
verses.text: Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Yahuah will deliver him in time of trouble.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and you will not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
verses.text: Yahuah will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and you will not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: you will make all his bed in his sickness.
verses.text: Yahuah will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: you will make all his bed in his sickness.

verses.raw: I said, Yahuah (LORD), be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against you.
verses.text: I said, Yahuah, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against you.

verses.raw: My enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
verses.text: My enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

verses.raw: And if he come to see me, he speaks vanity: his heart gathers iniquity to itself; when he goes abroad, he telleth it.
verses.text: And if he come to see me, he speaks vanity: his heart gathers iniquity to itself; when he goes abroad, he telleth it.

verses.raw: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
verses.text: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

verses.raw: An evil disease, say they, cleaves fast unto him: and now that he lies he shall rise up no more.
verses.text: An evil disease, say they, cleaves fast unto him: and now that he lies he shall rise up no more.

verses.raw: Yea, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.
verses.text: Yea, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.

verses.raw: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
verses.text: But you, O Yahuah, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

verses.raw: By this I know that you favourest me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.
verses.text: By this I know that you favourest me, because my enemy does not triumph over me.

verses.raw: And as for me, you upholdest me in my integrity, and set me before your face for ever.
verses.text: And as for me, you upholdest me in my integrity, and set me before your face for ever.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

verses.raw: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after you, O Elohim (God).
verses.text: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after you, O Elohim.

verses.raw: My soul thirsteth for Elohim (God), for the living Elohim (God): when shall I come and appear before Elohim (God)?
verses.text: My soul thirsteth for Elohim, for the living Elohim: when shall I come and appear before Elohim?

verses.raw: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is your Elohim (God)?
verses.text: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is your Elohim?

verses.raw: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of Elohim (God), with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
verses.text: When I remember these things, I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of Elohim, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.

verses.raw: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted in me? hope you in Elohim (God): for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.
verses.text: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted in me? hope you in Elohim: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

verses.raw: O my Elohim (God), my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember you from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
verses.text: O my Elohim, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember you from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

verses.raw: Deep calls unto deep at the noise of your waterspouts: all your waves and your billows are gone over me.
verses.text: Deep calls unto deep at the noise of your waterspouts: all your waves and your billows are gone over me.

verses.raw: Yet Yahuah (LORD) will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the Elohim (God) of my life.
verses.text: Yet Yahuah will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the Elohim of my life.

verses.raw: I will say unto Elohim (God) my rock, Why have you forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.text: I will say unto Elohim my rock, Why have you forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.raw: As with a sword in my bones, my enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is your Elohim (God)?
verses.text: As with a sword in my bones, my enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is your Elohim?

verses.raw: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted within me? hope you in Elohim (God): for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my Elohim (God).
verses.text: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted within me? hope you in Elohim: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my Elohim.

verses.raw: Judge me, O Elohim (God), and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
verses.text: Judge me, O Elohim, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

verses.raw: For you are the Elohim (God) of my strength: why do you cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
verses.text: For you are the Elohim of my strength: why do you cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

verses.raw: O send out your light and your truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto your holy hill, and to your tabernacles.
verses.text: O send out your light and your truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto your holy hill, and to your tabernacles.

verses.raw: Then will I go unto the altar of Elohim (God), unto Elohim (God) my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise you, O Elohim (God) my Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then will I go unto the altar of Elohim, unto Elohim my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise you, O Elohim my Elohim.

verses.raw: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted within me? hope in Elohim (God): for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my Elohim (God).
verses.text: Why are you cast down, O my soul? and why are you disquieted within me? hope in Elohim: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my Elohim.

verses.raw: We have heard with our ears, O Elohim (God), our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the times of old.
verses.text: We have heard with our ears, O Elohim, our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the times of old.

verses.raw: How you did drive out the heathen with your hand, and plantedst them; how you did afflict the people, and cast them out.
verses.text: How you did drive out the heathen with your hand, and plantedst them; how you did afflict the people, and cast them out.

verses.raw: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your countenance, because you had a favour unto them.
verses.text: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your countenance, because you had a favour unto them.

verses.raw: You are my King, O Elohim (God): command deliverances for Jacob.
verses.text: You are my King, O Elohim: command deliverances for Jacob.

verses.raw: Through you will we push down our enemies: through your name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
verses.text: Through you will we push down our enemies: through your name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

verses.raw: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
verses.text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

verses.raw: But you have saved us from our enemies, and have put them to shame that hated us.
verses.text: But you have saved us from our enemies, and have put them to shame that hated us.

verses.raw: In Elohim (God) we boast all the day long, and praise your name for ever. Selah.
verses.text: In Elohim we boast all the day long, and praise your name for ever. Selah.

verses.raw: But you have cast off, and put us to shame; and go not forth with our armies.
verses.text: But you have cast off, and put us to shame; and go not forth with our armies.

verses.raw: You make us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
verses.text: You make us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

verses.raw: You have given us like sheep appointed for meat; and have scattered us among the heathen.
verses.text: You have given us like sheep appointed for meat; and have scattered us among the heathen.

verses.raw: You sellest your people for nought, and do not increase your wealth by their price.
verses.text: You sellest your people for nought, and do not increase your wealth by their price.

verses.raw: You make us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
verses.text: You make us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

verses.raw: You make us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
verses.text: You make us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

verses.raw: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,
verses.text: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face has covered me,

verses.raw: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
verses.text: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

verses.raw: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten you, neither have we dealt falsely in your covenant.
verses.text: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten you, neither have we dealt falsely in your covenant.

verses.raw: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from your way;
verses.text: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from your way;

verses.raw: Though you have sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
verses.text: Though you have sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

verses.raw: If we have forgotten the name of our Elohim (God), or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
verses.text: If we have forgotten the name of our Elohim, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;

verses.raw: Shall not Elohim (God) search this out? for he knows the secrets of the heart.
verses.text: Shall not Elohim search this out? for he knows the secrets of the heart.

verses.raw: Yea, for your sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.text: Yea, for your sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.raw: Awake, why sleepest you, O Adonai (Lord)? arise, cast us not off for ever.
verses.text: Awake, why sleepest you, O Adonai? arise, cast us not off for ever.

verses.raw: Wherefore hide you your face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
verses.text: Wherefore hide you your face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

verses.raw: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaves unto the earth.
verses.text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaves unto the earth.

verses.raw: Arise for our help, and redeem us for your mercies’ sake.
verses.text: Arise for our help, and redeem us for your mercies’ sake.

verses.raw: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
verses.text: My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

verses.raw: You are fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into your lips: therefore Elohim (God) has blessed you for ever.
verses.text: You are fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into your lips: therefore Elohim has blessed you for ever.

verses.raw: Gird your sword upon your thigh, O most mighty, with your glory and your majesty.
verses.text: Gird your sword upon your thigh, O most mighty, with your glory and your majesty.

verses.raw: And in your majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and your right hand shall teach you terrible things.
verses.text: And in your majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and your right hand shall teach you terrible things.

verses.raw: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under you.
verses.text: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under you.

verses.raw: Your throne, O Elohim (God), is for ever and ever: the sceptre of your kingdom is a right sceptre.
verses.text: Your throne, O Elohim, is for ever and ever: the sceptre of your kingdom is a right sceptre.

verses.raw: You love righteousness, and hate wickedness: therefore Elohim (God), your Elohim (God), has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
verses.text: You love righteousness, and hate wickedness: therefore Elohim, your Elohim, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

verses.raw: All your garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made you glad.
verses.text: All your garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made you glad.

verses.raw: Kings’ daughters were among your honourable women: upon your right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
verses.text: Kings’ daughters were among your honourable women: upon your right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

verses.raw: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline your ear; forget also your own people, and your father’s house;
verses.text: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline your ear; forget also your own people, and your father’s house;
