verses.text: I will praise the name of Elohim with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.raw: This also shall please Yahuah (LORD) better than an ox or bullock that has horns and hoofs.
verses.text: This also shall please Yahuah better than an ox or bullock that has horns and hoofs.

verses.raw: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek Elohim (God).
verses.text: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek Elohim.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) hears the poor, and despises not his prisoners.
verses.text: For Yahuah hears the poor, and despises not his prisoners.

verses.raw: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moves therein.
verses.text: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moves therein.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) will save Zion, and will build the cities of Yahudah (Judah): that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.text: For Elohim will save Zion, and will build the cities of Yahudah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

verses.raw: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.text: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

verses.raw: Make haste, O Elohim (God), to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Make haste, O Elohim, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
verses.text: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

verses.raw: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
verses.text: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

verses.raw: Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: and let such as love your salvation say continually, Let Elohim (God) be magnified.
verses.text: Let all those that seek you rejoice and be glad in you: and let such as love your salvation say continually, Let Elohim be magnified.

verses.raw: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O Elohim (God): you are my help and my deliverer; O Yahuah (LORD), make no tarrying.
verses.text: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O Elohim: you are my help and my deliverer; O Yahuah, make no tarrying.

verses.raw: In you, O Yahuah (LORD), do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
verses.text: In you, O Yahuah, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

verses.raw: Deliver me in your righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline your ear unto me, and save me.
verses.text: Deliver me in your righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline your ear unto me, and save me.

verses.raw: Be you my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: you have given commandment to save me; for you are my rock and my fortress.
verses.text: Be you my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: you have given commandment to save me; for you are my rock and my fortress.

verses.raw: Deliver me, O my Elohim (God), out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
verses.text: Deliver me, O my Elohim, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

verses.raw: For you are my hope, O Adonai (Lord) GOD: you are my trust from my youth.
verses.text: For you are my hope, O Adonai GOD: you are my trust from my youth.

verses.raw: By you have I been holden up from the womb: you are he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of you.
verses.text: By you have I been holden up from the womb: you are he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of you.

verses.raw: I am as a wonder unto many; but you are my strong refuge.
verses.text: I am as a wonder unto many; but you are my strong refuge.

verses.raw: Let my mouth be filled with your praise and with your honour all the day.
verses.text: Let my mouth be filled with your praise and with your honour all the day.

verses.raw: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails.
verses.text: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength fails.

verses.raw: For my enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
verses.text: For my enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

verses.raw: Saying, Elohim (God) has forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.
verses.text: Saying, Elohim has forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), be not far from me: O my Elohim (God), make haste for my help.
verses.text: O Elohim, be not far from me: O my Elohim, make haste for my help.

verses.raw: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
verses.text: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

verses.raw: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise you more and more.
verses.text: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise you more and more.

verses.raw: My mouth shall shew forth your righteousness and your salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.
verses.text: My mouth shall shew forth your righteousness and your salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

verses.raw: I will go in the strength of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): I will make mention of your righteousness, even of your only.
verses.text: I will go in the strength of Adonai Yahuah: I will make mention of your righteousness, even of your only.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), you have taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared your wondrous works.
verses.text: O Elohim, you have taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared your wondrous works.

verses.raw: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O Elohim (God), forsake me not; until I have shewed your strength unto this generation, and your power to every one that is to come.
verses.text: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O Elohim, forsake me not; until I have shewed your strength unto this generation, and your power to every one that is to come.

verses.raw: Your righteousness also, O Elohim (God), is very high, who have done great things: O Elohim (God), who is like unto you!
verses.text: Your righteousness also, O Elohim, is very high, who have done great things: O Elohim, who is like unto you!

verses.raw: You, which have shewed me great and sore troubles, shall quicken me again, and shall bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
verses.text: You, which have shewed me great and sore troubles, shall quicken me again, and shall bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

verses.raw: You shall increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
verses.text: You shall increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

verses.raw: I will also praise you with the psaltery, even your truth, O my Elohim (God): unto you will I sing with the harp, O you Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: I will also praise you with the psaltery, even your truth, O my Elohim: unto you will I sing with the harp, O you Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto you; and my soul, which you have redeemed.
verses.text: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto you; and my soul, which you have redeemed.

verses.raw: My tongue also shall talk of your righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
verses.text: My tongue also shall talk of your righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

verses.raw: Give the king your judgments, O Elohim (God), and your righteousness unto the king’s son.
verses.text: Give the king your judgments, O Elohim, and your righteousness unto the king’s son.

verses.raw: He shall judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with judgment.
verses.text: He shall judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with judgment.

verses.raw: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
verses.text: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

verses.raw: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
verses.text: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

verses.raw: They shall fear you as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
verses.text: They shall fear you as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

verses.raw: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.
verses.text: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

verses.raw: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endures.
verses.text: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endures.

verses.raw: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
verses.text: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.raw: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
verses.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.raw: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
verses.text: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

verses.raw: For he shall deliver the needy when he cries; the poor also, and him that has no helper.
verses.text: For he shall deliver the needy when he cries; the poor also, and him that has no helper.

verses.raw: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
verses.text: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

verses.raw: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
verses.text: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

verses.raw: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.
verses.text: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

verses.raw: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
verses.text: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

verses.raw: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
verses.text: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and men shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), who only does wondrous things.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim, the Elohim of Yashar'el, who only does wondrous things.

verses.raw: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
verses.text: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

verses.raw: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
verses.text: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

verses.raw: Truly Elohim (God) is good to Yashar'el (Israel), even to such as are of a clean heart.
verses.text: Truly Elohim is good to Yashar'el, even to such as are of a clean heart.

verses.raw: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
verses.text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.

verses.raw: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
verses.text: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.raw: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.
verses.text: For there are no bands in their death: but their strength is firm.

verses.raw: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.
verses.text: They are not in trouble as other men; neither are they plagued like other men.

verses.raw: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covers them as a garment.
verses.text: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covers them as a garment.

verses.raw: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
verses.text: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.

verses.raw: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.
verses.text: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly concerning oppression: they speak loftily.

verses.raw: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.
verses.text: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.

verses.raw: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.
verses.text: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full cup are wrung out to them.

verses.raw: And they say, How does Elohim (God) know? and is there knowledge in the El Elyon (most High)?
verses.text: And they say, How does Elohim know? and is there knowledge in the El Elyon?

verses.raw: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.
verses.text: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

verses.raw: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
verses.text: Verily I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocency.

verses.raw: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
verses.text: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.

verses.raw: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of your children.
verses.text: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend against the generation of your children.

verses.raw: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;
verses.text: When I thought to know this, it was too painful for me;

verses.raw: Until I went into the sanctuary of Elohim (God); then understood I their end.
verses.text: Until I went into the sanctuary of Elohim; then understood I their end.

verses.raw: Surely you did set them in slippery places: you castedst them down into destruction.
verses.text: Surely you did set them in slippery places: you castedst them down into destruction.

verses.raw: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
verses.text: How are they brought into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.

verses.raw: As a dream when one awakes; so, O Adonai (Lord), when you awakest, you shall despise their image.
verses.text: As a dream when one awakes; so, O Adonai, when you awakest, you shall despise their image.

verses.raw: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
verses.text: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.

verses.raw: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before you.
verses.text: So foolish was I, and ignorant: I was as a beast before you.

verses.raw: Nevertheless I am continually with you: you have holden me by my right hand.
verses.text: Nevertheless I am continually with you: you have holden me by my right hand.

verses.raw: You shall guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.
verses.text: You shall guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

verses.raw: Whom have I in heaven but you? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside you.
verses.text: Whom have I in heaven but you? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside you.

verses.raw: My flesh and my heart fails: but Elohim (God) is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
verses.text: My flesh and my heart fails: but Elohim is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

verses.raw: For, lo, they that are far from you shall perish: you have destroyed all them that go a whoring from you.
verses.text: For, lo, they that are far from you shall perish: you have destroyed all them that go a whoring from you.

verses.raw: But it is good for me to draw near to Elohim (God): I have put my trust in Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), that I may declare all your works.
verses.text: But it is good for me to draw near to Elohim: I have put my trust in Adonai Yahuah, that I may declare all your works.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), why have you cast us off for ever? why does your anger smoke against the sheep of your pasture?
verses.text: O Elohim, why have you cast us off for ever? why does your anger smoke against the sheep of your pasture?

verses.raw: Remember your congregation, which you have purchased of old; the rod of your inheritance, which you have redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein you have dwelt.
verses.text: Remember your congregation, which you have purchased of old; the rod of your inheritance, which you have redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein you have dwelt.

verses.raw: Lift up your feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.text: Lift up your feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary.

verses.raw: Your enemies roar in the midst of your congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.text: Your enemies roar in the midst of your congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

verses.raw: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.text: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

verses.raw: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.text: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

verses.raw: They have cast fire into your sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of your name to the ground.
verses.text: They have cast fire into your sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of your name to the ground.

verses.raw: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of Elohim (God) in the land.
verses.text: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of Elohim in the land.

verses.raw: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knows how long.
verses.text: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knows how long.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme your name for ever?
verses.text: O Elohim, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme your name for ever?

verses.raw: Why withdrawest you your hand, even your right hand? pluck it out of your bosom.
verses.text: Why withdrawest you your hand, even your right hand? pluck it out of your bosom.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.text: For Elohim is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.raw: You did divide the sea by your strength: you brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.text: You did divide the sea by your strength: you brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

verses.raw: You brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gave him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.text: You brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gave him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

verses.raw: You did cleave the fountain and the flood: you driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.text: You did cleave the fountain and the flood: you driedst up mighty rivers.

verses.raw: The day is yours, the night also is yours: you have prepared the light and the sun.
verses.text: The day is yours, the night also is yours: you have prepared the light and the sun.

verses.raw: You have set all the borders of the earth: you have made summer and winter.
verses.text: You have set all the borders of the earth: you have made summer and winter.

verses.raw: Remember this, that the enemy has reproached, O Yahuah (LORD), and that the foolish people have blasphemed your name.
verses.text: Remember this, that the enemy has reproached, O Yahuah, and that the foolish people have blasphemed your name.

verses.raw: O deliver not the soul of your turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of your poor for ever.
verses.text: O deliver not the soul of your turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of your poor for ever.

verses.raw: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.text: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

verses.raw: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise your name.
verses.text: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise your name.

verses.raw: Arise, O Elohim (God), plead your own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth you daily.
verses.text: Arise, O Elohim, plead your own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth you daily.

verses.raw: Forget not the voice of your enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against you increases continually.
verses.text: Forget not the voice of your enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against you increases continually.

verses.raw: Unto you, O Elohim (God), do we give thanks, unto you do we give thanks: for that your name is near your wondrous works declare.
verses.text: Unto you, O Elohim, do we give thanks, unto you do we give thanks: for that your name is near your wondrous works declare.

verses.raw: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
verses.text: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

verses.raw: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
verses.text: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

verses.raw: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
verses.text: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

verses.raw: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.
verses.text: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

verses.raw: For promotion comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
verses.text: For promotion comes neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) is the judge: he puts down one, and sets up another.
verses.text: But Elohim is the judge: he puts down one, and sets up another.

verses.raw: For in the hand of Yahuah (LORD) there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he pours out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.
verses.text: For in the hand of Yahuah there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he pours out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

verses.raw: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the Elohim (God) of Jacob.
verses.text: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the Elohim of Jacob.

verses.raw: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
verses.text: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

verses.raw: In Yahudah (Judah) is Elohim (God) known: his name is great in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: In Yahudah is Elohim known: his name is great in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.text: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

verses.raw: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.text: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

verses.raw: You are more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.text: You are more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

verses.raw: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.text: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

verses.raw: At your rebuke, O Elohim (God) of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.text: At your rebuke, O Elohim of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.raw: You, even you, are to be feared: and who may stand in your sight when once you are angry?
verses.text: You, even you, are to be feared: and who may stand in your sight when once you are angry?

verses.raw: You did cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.text: You did cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

verses.raw: When Elohim (God) arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.text: When Elohim arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

verses.raw: Surely the wrath of man shall praise you: the remainder of wrath shall you restrain.
verses.text: Surely the wrath of man shall praise you: the remainder of wrath shall you restrain.

verses.raw: Vow, and pay unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.text: Vow, and pay unto Yahuah Elohaychem: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.

verses.raw: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.text: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

verses.raw: I cried unto Elohim (God) with my voice, even unto Elohim (God) with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.text: I cried unto Elohim with my voice, even unto Elohim with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

verses.raw: In the day of my trouble I sought Adonai (Lord): my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.text: In the day of my trouble I sought Adonai: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

verses.raw: I remembered Elohim (God), and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.text: I remembered Elohim, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

verses.raw: You hold my eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.text: You hold my eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

verses.raw: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.text: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

verses.raw: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with my own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.text: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with my own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

verses.raw: Will Adonai (Lord) cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.text: Will Adonai cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

verses.raw: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? does his promise fail for evermore?
verses.text: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? does his promise fail for evermore?

verses.raw: Has Elohim (God) forgotten to be gracious? has he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.text: Has Elohim forgotten to be gracious? has he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

verses.raw: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the El Elyon (most High).
verses.text: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the El Elyon.

verses.raw: I will remember the works of Yahuah (LORD): surely I will remember your wonders of old.
verses.text: I will remember the works of Yahuah: surely I will remember your wonders of old.

verses.raw: I will meditate also of all your work, and talk of your doings.
verses.text: I will meditate also of all your work, and talk of your doings.

verses.raw: Your way, O Elohim (God), is in the sanctuary: who is so great a Elohim (God) as our Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Your way, O Elohim, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a Elohim as our Elohim?

verses.raw: You are the Elohim (God) that do wonders: you have declared your strength among the people.
verses.text: You are the Elohim that do wonders: you have declared your strength among the people.

verses.raw: You have with your arm redeemed your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.text: You have with your arm redeemed your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

verses.raw: The waters saw you, O Elohim (God), the waters saw you; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.text: The waters saw you, O Elohim, the waters saw you; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

verses.raw: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: your arrows also went abroad.
verses.text: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: your arrows also went abroad.

verses.raw: The voice of your thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.text: The voice of your thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

verses.raw: Your way is in the sea, and your path in the great waters, and your footsteps are not known.
verses.text: Your way is in the sea, and your path in the great waters, and your footsteps are not known.

verses.raw: You leddest your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.text: You leddest your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.raw: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
verses.text: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

verses.raw: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
verses.text: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:

verses.raw: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
verses.text: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

verses.raw: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of Yahuah (LORD), and his strength, and his wonderful works that he has done.
verses.text: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of Yahuah, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he has done.

verses.raw: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Yashar'el (Israel), which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
verses.text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Yashar'el, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:

verses.raw: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:
verses.text: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

verses.raw: That they might set their hope in Elohim (God), and not forget the works of Elohim (God), but keep his commandments:
verses.text: That they might set their hope in Elohim, and not forget the works of Elohim, but keep his commandments:

verses.raw: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with Elohim (God).
verses.text: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with Elohim.

verses.raw: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
verses.text: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

verses.raw: They kept not the covenant of Elohim (God), and refused to walk in his law;
verses.text: They kept not the covenant of Elohim, and refused to walk in his law;

verses.raw: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
verses.text: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.

verses.raw: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
verses.text: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

verses.raw: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
verses.text: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

verses.raw: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
verses.text: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

verses.raw: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.
verses.text: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

verses.raw: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
verses.text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

verses.raw: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the El Elyon (most High) in the wilderness.
verses.text: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the El Elyon in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And they tempted Elohim (God) in their heart by asking meat for their lust.
verses.text: And they tempted Elohim in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

verses.raw: Yea, they spake against Elohim (God); they said, Can Elohim (God) furnish a table in the wilderness?
verses.text: Yea, they spake against Elohim; they said, Can Elohim furnish a table in the wilderness?

verses.raw: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?
verses.text: Behold, he smote the rock, that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed; can he give bread also? can he provide flesh for his people?

verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (LORD) heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah heard this, and was wroth: so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Yashar'el;

verses.raw: Because they believed not in Elohim (God), and trusted not in his salvation:
verses.text: Because they believed not in Elohim, and trusted not in his salvation:

verses.raw: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,
verses.text: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

verses.raw: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
verses.text: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

verses.raw: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.
verses.text: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.

verses.raw: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.
verses.text: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

verses.raw: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:
verses.text: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

verses.raw: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.
verses.text: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

verses.raw: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;
verses.text: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

verses.raw: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,
verses.text: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

verses.raw: The wrath of Elohim (God) came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The wrath of Elohim came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.
verses.text: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

verses.raw: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.
verses.text: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

verses.raw: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after Elohim (God).
verses.text: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after Elohim.

verses.raw: And they remembered that Elohim (God) was their rock, and the high Elohim (God) their redeemer.
verses.text: And they remembered that Elohim was their rock, and the high Elohim their redeemer.

verses.raw: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.
verses.text: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

verses.raw: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.
verses.text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

verses.raw: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.
verses.text: But he, being full of compassion, forgave their iniquity, and destroyed them not: yea, many a time turned he his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

verses.raw: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passes away, and comes not again.
verses.text: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passes away, and comes not again.

verses.raw: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!
verses.text: How oft did they provoke him in the wilderness, and grieve him in the desert!

verses.raw: Yea, they turned back and tempted Elohim (God), and limited the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yea, they turned back and tempted Elohim, and limited the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.
verses.text: They remembered not his hand, nor the day when he delivered them from the enemy.

verses.raw: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:
verses.text: How he had wrought his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan:

verses.raw: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.
verses.text: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

verses.raw: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.
verses.text: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

verses.raw: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
verses.text: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.

verses.raw: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.
verses.text: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

verses.raw: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.
verses.text: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

verses.raw: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.
verses.text: He cast upon them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, and indignation, and trouble, by sending evil angels among them.

verses.raw: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;
verses.text: He made a way to his anger; he spared not their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence;

verses.raw: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:
verses.text: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

verses.raw: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
verses.text: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

verses.raw: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
verses.text: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

verses.raw: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.
verses.text: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

verses.raw: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) to dwell in their tents.
verses.text: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Yashar'el to dwell in their tents.

verses.raw: Yet they tempted and provoked the El Elyon (most high God), and kept not his testimonies:
verses.text: Yet they tempted and provoked the El Elyon (most high God), and kept not his testimonies:

verses.raw: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
verses.text: But turned back, and dealt unfaithfully like their fathers: they were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

verses.raw: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.
verses.text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their graven images.

verses.raw: When Elohim (God) heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: When Elohim heard this, he was wroth, and greatly abhorred Yashar'el:

verses.raw: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;
verses.text: So that he forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

verses.raw: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.
verses.text: And delivered his strength into captivity, and his glory into the enemy’s hand.

verses.raw: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.
verses.text: He gave his people over also unto the sword; and was wroth with his inheritance.

verses.raw: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.
verses.text: The fire consumed their young men; and their maidens were not given to marriage.

verses.raw: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.
verses.text: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows made no lamentation.

verses.raw: Then Adonai (Lord) awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.
verses.text: Then Adonai awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

verses.raw: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.
verses.text: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

verses.raw: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:
verses.text: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

verses.raw: But chose the tribe of Yahudah (Judah), the mount Zion which he loved.
verses.text: But chose the tribe of Yahudah, the mount Zion which he loved.

verses.raw: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he has established for ever.
verses.text: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he has established for ever.

verses.raw: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:
verses.text: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

verses.raw: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Yashar'el (Israel) his inheritance.
verses.text: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Yashar'el his inheritance.

verses.raw: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.
verses.text: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), the heathen are come into your inheritance; your holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.
verses.text: O Elohim, the heathen are come into your inheritance; your holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

verses.raw: The dead bodies of your servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of your saints unto the beasts of the earth.
verses.text: The dead bodies of your servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of your saints unto the beasts of the earth.

verses.raw: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.
verses.text: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

verses.raw: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
verses.text: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

verses.raw: How long, Yahuah (LORD)? will you be angry for ever? shall your jealousy burn like fire?
verses.text: How long, Yahuah? will you be angry for ever? shall your jealousy burn like fire?

verses.raw: Pour out your wrath upon the heathen that have not known you, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon your name.
verses.text: Pour out your wrath upon the heathen that have not known you, and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon your name.

verses.raw: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.
verses.text: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

verses.raw: O remember not against us former iniquities: let your tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.
verses.text: O remember not against us former iniquities: let your tender mercies speedily prevent us: for we are brought very low.

verses.raw: Help us, O Elohim (God) of our salvation, for the glory of your name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for your name’s sake.
verses.text: Help us, O Elohim of our salvation, for the glory of your name: and deliver us, and purge away our sins, for your name’s sake.

verses.raw: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their Elohim (God)? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of your servants which is shed.
verses.text: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their Elohim? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of your servants which is shed.

verses.raw: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you; according to the greatness of your power preserve you those that are appointed to die;
verses.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you; according to the greatness of your power preserve you those that are appointed to die;

verses.raw: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached you, O Adonai (Lord).
verses.text: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached you, O Adonai.

verses.raw: So we your people and sheep of your pasture will give you thanks for ever: we will shew forth your praise to all generations.
verses.text: So we your people and sheep of your pasture will give you thanks for ever: we will shew forth your praise to all generations.

verses.raw: Give ear, O Shepherd of Yashar'el (Israel), you that leadest Joseph like a flock; you that dwell between the cherubims, shine forth.
verses.text: Give ear, O Shepherd of Yashar'el, you that leadest Joseph like a flock; you that dwell between the cherubims, shine forth.

verses.raw: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up your strength, and come and save us.
verses.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up your strength, and come and save us.

verses.raw: Turn us again, O Elohim (God), and cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.text: Turn us again, O Elohim, and cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of hosts, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim of hosts, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

verses.raw: You feedest them with the bread of tears; and give them tears to drink in great measure.
verses.text: You feedest them with the bread of tears; and give them tears to drink in great measure.

verses.raw: You make us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
verses.text: You make us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.raw: Turn us again, O Elohim (God) of hosts, and cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.text: Turn us again, O Elohim of hosts, and cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.raw: You have brought a vine out of Egypt: you have cast out the heathen, and planted it.
verses.text: You have brought a vine out of Egypt: you have cast out the heathen, and planted it.

verses.raw: You preparedst room before it, and did cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
verses.text: You preparedst room before it, and did cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

verses.raw: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.
verses.text: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

verses.raw: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
verses.text: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

verses.raw: Why have you then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
verses.text: Why have you then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

verses.raw: The boar out of the wood does waste it, and the wild beast of the field does devour it.
verses.text: The boar out of the wood does waste it, and the wild beast of the field does devour it.

verses.raw: Return, we beseech you, O Elohim (God) of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
verses.text: Return, we beseech you, O Elohim of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;

verses.raw: And the vineyard which your right hand has planted, and the branch that you made strong for thyself.
verses.text: And the vineyard which your right hand has planted, and the branch that you made strong for thyself.

verses.raw: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of your countenance.
verses.text: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of your countenance.

verses.raw: Let your hand be upon the man of your right hand, upon the son of Adam whom you made strong for thyself.
verses.text: Let your hand be upon the man of your right hand, upon the son of Adam whom you made strong for thyself.

verses.raw: So will not we go back from you: quicken us, and we will call upon your name.
verses.text: So will not we go back from you: quicken us, and we will call upon your name.

verses.raw: Turn us again, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of hosts, cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.
verses.text: Turn us again, O Yahuah Elohim of hosts, cause your face to shine; and we shall be saved.

verses.raw: Sing aloud unto Elohim (God) our strength: make a joyful noise unto the Elohim (God) of Jacob.
verses.text: Sing aloud unto Elohim our strength: make a joyful noise unto the Elohim of Jacob.

verses.raw: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.text: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

verses.raw: Blow the trumpet at the dark new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.text: Blow the trumpet at the dark new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

verses.raw: For this was a statute for Yashar'el (Israel), and a law of the Elohim (God) of Jacob.
verses.text: For this was a statute for Yashar'el, and a law of the Elohim of Jacob.

verses.raw: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.text: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

verses.raw: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.text: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

verses.raw: You called in trouble, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder: I proved you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.text: You called in trouble, and I delivered you; I answered you in the secret place of thunder: I proved you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

verses.raw: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto you: O Yashar'el (Israel), if you will hearken unto me;
verses.text: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto you: O Yashar'el, if you will hearken unto me;

verses.raw: There shall no strange god be in you; neither shall you worship any strange god.
verses.text: There shall no strange god be in you; neither shall you worship any strange god.

verses.raw: I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), which brought you out of the land of Egypt: open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.text: I am Yahuah Elohayka, which brought you out of the land of Egypt: open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.raw: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Yashar'el (Israel) would none of me.
verses.text: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Yashar'el would none of me.

verses.raw: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.text: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

verses.raw: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Yashar'el (Israel) had walked in my ways!
verses.text: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Yashar'el had walked in my ways!

verses.raw: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.text: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.

verses.raw: The haters of Yahuah (LORD) should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.text: The haters of Yahuah should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

verses.raw: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied you.
verses.text: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied you.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) stands in the congregation of the mighty; he judges among the gods.
verses.text: Elohim stands in the congregation of the mighty; he judges among the gods.

verses.raw: How long will you judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
verses.text: How long will you judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

verses.raw: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
verses.text: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

verses.raw: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.text: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.raw: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
verses.text: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.

verses.raw: I have said, You are gods; and all of you are children of the El Elyon (most High).
verses.text: I have said, You are gods; and all of you are children of the El Elyon.

verses.raw: But you shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
verses.text: But you shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

verses.raw: Arise, O Elohim (God), judge the earth: for you shall inherit all nations.
verses.text: Arise, O Elohim, judge the earth: for you shall inherit all nations.

verses.raw: Keep not you silence, O Elohim (God): hold not your peace, and be not still, O Elohim (God).
verses.text: Keep not you silence, O Elohim: hold not your peace, and be not still, O Elohim.

verses.raw: For, lo, your enemies make a tumult: and they that hate you have lifted up the head.
verses.text: For, lo, your enemies make a tumult: and they that hate you have lifted up the head.

verses.raw: They have taken crafty counsel against your people, and consulted against your hidden ones.
verses.text: They have taken crafty counsel against your people, and consulted against your hidden ones.

verses.raw: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Yashar'el (Israel) may be no more in remembrance.
verses.text: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Yashar'el may be no more in remembrance.

verses.raw: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against you:
verses.text: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against you:

verses.raw: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
verses.text: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

verses.raw: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
verses.text: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

verses.raw: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
verses.text: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

verses.raw: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
verses.text: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

verses.raw: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.
verses.text: Which perished at Endor: they became as dung for the earth.

verses.raw: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
verses.text: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

verses.raw: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of Elohim (God) in possession.
verses.text: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of Elohim in possession.

verses.raw: O my Elohim (God), make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
verses.text: O my Elohim, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

verses.raw: As the fire burns a wood, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire;
verses.text: As the fire burns a wood, and as the flame sets the mountains on fire;

verses.raw: So persecute them with your tempest, and make them afraid with your storm.
verses.text: So persecute them with your tempest, and make them afraid with your storm.

verses.raw: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek your name, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek your name, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
verses.text: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

verses.raw: That men may know that you, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, are the most high over all the earth.
verses.text: That men may know that you, whose name alone is JEHOVAH, are the most high over all the earth.

verses.raw: How amiable are your tabernacles, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts)!
verses.text: How amiable are your tabernacles, O Yahuah Tseva'ot!

verses.raw: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Yahuah (LORD): my heart and my flesh cries out for the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of Yahuah: my heart and my flesh cries out for the living Elohim.

verses.raw: Yea, the sparrow has found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even your altars, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), my King, and my Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yea, the sparrow has found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even your altars, O Yahuah Tseva'ot, my King, and my Elohim.

verses.raw: Blessed are they that dwell in your house: they will be still praising you. Selah.
verses.text: Blessed are they that dwell in your house: they will be still praising you. Selah.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man whose strength is in you; in whose heart are the ways of them.
verses.text: Blessed is the man whose strength is in you; in whose heart are the ways of them.

verses.raw: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.text: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

verses.raw: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appears before Elohim (God).
verses.text: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appears before Elohim.

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O Elohim (God) of Jacob. Selah.
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O Elohim of Jacob. Selah.

verses.raw: Behold, O Elohim (God) our shield, and look upon the face of your anointed.
verses.text: Behold, O Elohim our shield, and look upon the face of your anointed.

verses.raw: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my Elohim (God), than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.text: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my Elohim, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) is a sun and shield: Yahuah (LORD) will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.text: For Yahuah Elohim is a sun and shield: Yahuah will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.

verses.raw: O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), blessed is the man that trusts in you.
verses.text: O Yahuah Tseva'ot, blessed is the man that trusts in you.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), you have been favourable unto your land: you have brought back the captivity of Jacob.
verses.text: Yahuah, you have been favourable unto your land: you have brought back the captivity of Jacob.

verses.raw: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people, you have covered all their sin. Selah.
verses.text: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people, you have covered all their sin. Selah.

verses.raw: You have taken away all your wrath: you have turned thyself from the fierceness of your anger.
verses.text: You have taken away all your wrath: you have turned thyself from the fierceness of your anger.

verses.raw: Turn us, O Elohim (God) of our salvation, and cause your anger toward us to cease.
verses.text: Turn us, O Elohim of our salvation, and cause your anger toward us to cease.

verses.raw: Will you be angry with us for ever? will you draw out your anger to all generations?
verses.text: Will you be angry with us for ever? will you draw out your anger to all generations?

verses.raw: Will you not revive us again: that your people may rejoice in you?
verses.text: Will you not revive us again: that your people may rejoice in you?

verses.raw: Shew us your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), and grant us your salvation.
verses.text: Shew us your mercy, O Yahuah, and grant us your salvation.

verses.raw: I will hear what Elohim (God) Yahuah (LORD) will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
verses.text: I will hear what Elohim Yahuah will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

verses.raw: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
verses.text: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.raw: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
verses.text: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

verses.raw: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
verses.text: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

verses.raw: Yea, Yahuah (LORD) shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.
verses.text: Yea, Yahuah shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

verses.raw: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
verses.text: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

verses.raw: Bow down your ear, O Yahuah (LORD), hear me: for I am poor and needy.
verses.text: Bow down your ear, O Yahuah, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

verses.raw: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O you my Elohim (God), save your servant that trusts in you.
verses.text: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O you my Elohim, save your servant that trusts in you.

verses.raw: Be merciful unto me, O Adonai (Lord): for I cry unto you daily.
verses.text: Be merciful unto me, O Adonai: for I cry unto you daily.

verses.raw: Rejoice the soul of your servant: for unto you, O Adonai (Lord), do I lift up my soul.
verses.text: Rejoice the soul of your servant: for unto you, O Adonai, do I lift up my soul.

verses.raw: For you, Adonai (Lord), are good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon you.
verses.text: For you, Adonai, are good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon you.

verses.raw: Give ear, O Yahuah (LORD), unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
verses.text: Give ear, O Yahuah, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

verses.raw: In the day of my trouble I will call upon you: for you will answer me.
verses.text: In the day of my trouble I will call upon you: for you will answer me.

verses.raw: Among the gods there is none like unto you, O Adonai (Lord); neither are there any works like unto your works.
verses.text: Among the gods there is none like unto you, O Adonai; neither are there any works like unto your works.

verses.raw: All nations whom you have made shall come and worship before you, O Adonai (Lord); and shall glorify your name.
verses.text: All nations whom you have made shall come and worship before you, O Adonai; and shall glorify your name.

verses.raw: For you are great, and do wondrous things: you are Elohim (God) alone.
verses.text: For you are great, and do wondrous things: you are Elohim alone.

verses.raw: Teach me your way, O Yahuah (LORD); I will walk in your truth: unite my heart to fear your name.
verses.text: Teach me your way, O Yahuah; I will walk in your truth: unite my heart to fear your name.

verses.raw: I will praise you, O Adonai (Lord) my Elohim (God), with all my heart: and I will glorify your name for evermore.
verses.text: I will praise you, O Adonai my Elohim, with all my heart: and I will glorify your name for evermore.

verses.raw: For great is your mercy toward me: and you have delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
verses.text: For great is your mercy toward me: and you have delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set you before them.
verses.text: O Elohim, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set you before them.

verses.raw: But you, O Adonai (Lord), are a Elohim (God) full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
verses.text: But you, O Adonai, are a Elohim full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

verses.raw: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give your strength unto your servant, and save the son of your handmaid.
verses.text: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give your strength unto your servant, and save the son of your handmaid.

verses.raw: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because you, Yahuah (LORD), have holpen me, and comforted me.
verses.text: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because you, Yahuah, have holpen me, and comforted me.

verses.raw: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
verses.text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
verses.text: Yahuah loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.raw: Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of Elohim (God). Selah.
verses.text: Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of Elohim. Selah.

verses.raw: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.
verses.text: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

verses.raw: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
verses.text: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.
verses.text: Yahuah shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

verses.raw: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in you.
verses.text: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in you.

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you:
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you:

verses.raw: Let my prayer come before you: incline your ear unto my cry;
verses.text: Let my prayer come before you: incline your ear unto my cry;

verses.raw: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draws nigh unto the grave.
verses.text: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draws nigh unto the grave.

verses.raw: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that has no strength:
verses.text: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that has no strength:

verses.raw: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom you remember no more: and they are cut off from your hand.
verses.text: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom you remember no more: and they are cut off from your hand.

verses.raw: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
verses.text: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

verses.raw: Your wrath lies hard upon me, and you have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.
verses.text: Your wrath lies hard upon me, and you have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

verses.raw: You have put away my acquaintance far from me; you have made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
verses.text: You have put away my acquaintance far from me; you have made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

verses.raw: My eye mourns by reason of affliction: Yahuah (LORD), I have called daily upon you, I have stretched out my hands unto you.
verses.text: My eye mourns by reason of affliction: Yahuah, I have called daily upon you, I have stretched out my hands unto you.

verses.raw: Will you shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise you? Selah.
verses.text: Will you shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise you? Selah.

verses.raw: Shall your lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or your faithfulness in destruction?
verses.text: Shall your lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or your faithfulness in destruction?

verses.raw: Shall your wonders be known in the dark? and your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
verses.text: Shall your wonders be known in the dark? and your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

verses.raw: But unto you have I cried, O Yahuah (LORD); and in the morning shall my prayer prevent you.
verses.text: But unto you have I cried, O Yahuah; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent you.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), why cast you off my soul? why hide you your face from me?
verses.text: Yahuah, why cast you off my soul? why hide you your face from me?

verses.raw: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer your terrors I am distracted.
verses.text: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer your terrors I am distracted.

verses.raw: Your fierce wrath goes over me; your terrors have cut me off.
verses.text: Your fierce wrath goes over me; your terrors have cut me off.

verses.raw: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
verses.text: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

verses.raw: Lover and friend have you put far from me, and my acquaintance into darkness.
verses.text: Lover and friend have you put far from me, and my acquaintance into darkness.

verses.raw: I will sing of the mercies of Yahuah (LORD) for ever: with my mouth will I make known your faithfulness to all generations.
verses.text: I will sing of the mercies of Yahuah for ever: with my mouth will I make known your faithfulness to all generations.

verses.raw: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: your faithfulness shall you establish in the very heavens.
verses.text: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: your faithfulness shall you establish in the very heavens.

verses.raw: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.text: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

verses.raw: Your seed will I establish for ever, and build up your throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.text: Your seed will I establish for ever, and build up your throne to all generations. Selah.

verses.raw: And the heavens shall praise your wonders, O Yahuah (LORD): your faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.text: And the heavens shall praise your wonders, O Yahuah: your faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

verses.raw: For who in the heaven can be compared unto Yahuah (LORD)? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: For who in the heaven can be compared unto Yahuah? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto Yahuah?

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.text: Elohim is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of hosts, who is a strong Yahuah (LORD) like unto you? or to your faithfulness round about you?
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim of hosts, who is a strong Yahuah like unto you? or to your faithfulness round about you?

verses.raw: You rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, you stillest them.
verses.text: You rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, you stillest them.

verses.raw: You have broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; you have scattered your enemies with your strong arm.
verses.text: You have broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; you have scattered your enemies with your strong arm.

verses.raw: The heavens are yours, the earth also is yours: as for the world and the fulness thereof, you have founded them.
verses.text: The heavens are yours, the earth also is yours: as for the world and the fulness thereof, you have founded them.

verses.raw: The north and the south you have created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in your name.
verses.text: The north and the south you have created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in your name.

verses.raw: You have a mighty arm: strong is your hand, and high is your right hand.
verses.text: You have a mighty arm: strong is your hand, and high is your right hand.
