verses.raw: Justice and judgment are the habitation of your throne: mercy and truth shall go before your face.
verses.text: Justice and judgment are the habitation of your throne: mercy and truth shall go before your face.

verses.raw: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Yahuah (LORD), in the light of your countenance.
verses.text: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Yahuah, in the light of your countenance.

verses.raw: In your name shall they rejoice all the day: and in your righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.text: In your name shall they rejoice all the day: and in your righteousness shall they be exalted.

verses.raw: For you are the glory of their strength: and in your favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.text: For you are the glory of their strength: and in your favour our horn shall be exalted.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) is our defence; and the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) is our king.
verses.text: For Yahuah is our defence; and the Holy One of Yashar'el is our king.

verses.raw: Then you spoke in vision to your holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.text: Then you spoke in vision to your holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

verses.raw: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.text: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

verses.raw: With whom my hand shall be established: my arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.text: With whom my hand shall be established: my arm also shall strengthen him.

verses.raw: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.text: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

verses.raw: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

verses.raw: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.text: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.raw: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.raw: He shall cry unto me, You are my father, my Elohim (God), and the rock of my salvation.
verses.text: He shall cry unto me, You are my father, my Elohim, and the rock of my salvation.

verses.raw: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.text: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

verses.raw: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.text: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

verses.raw: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.text: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.raw: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.text: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

verses.raw: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.text: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

verses.raw: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

verses.raw: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.text: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

verses.raw: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.text: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

verses.raw: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.text: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

verses.raw: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

verses.raw: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.text: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

verses.raw: But you have cast off and abhorred, you have been wroth with your anointed.
verses.text: But you have cast off and abhorred, you have been wroth with your anointed.

verses.raw: You have made void the covenant of your servant: you have profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.text: You have made void the covenant of your servant: you have profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

verses.raw: You have broken down all his hedges; you have brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.text: You have broken down all his hedges; you have brought his strong holds to ruin.

verses.raw: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.text: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

verses.raw: You have set up the right hand of his adversaries; you have made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.text: You have set up the right hand of his adversaries; you have made all his enemies to rejoice.

verses.raw: You have also turned the edge of his sword, and have not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.text: You have also turned the edge of his sword, and have not made him to stand in the battle.

verses.raw: You have made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.text: You have made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

verses.raw: The days of his youth have you shortened: you have covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.text: The days of his youth have you shortened: you have covered him with shame. Selah.

verses.raw: How long, Yahuah (LORD)? will you hide thyself for ever? shall your wrath burn like fire?
verses.text: How long, Yahuah? will you hide thyself for ever? shall your wrath burn like fire?

verses.raw: Remember how short my time is: wherefore have you made all men in vain?
verses.text: Remember how short my time is: wherefore have you made all men in vain?

verses.raw: What man is he that lives, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.text: What man is he that lives, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord), where are your former lovingkindnesses, which you swore unto David in your truth?
verses.text: Adonai, where are your former lovingkindnesses, which you swore unto David in your truth?

verses.raw: Remember, Adonai (Lord), the reproach of your servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.text: Remember, Adonai, the reproach of your servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

verses.raw: Wherewith your enemies have reproached, O Yahuah (LORD); wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of your anointed.
verses.text: Wherewith your enemies have reproached, O Yahuah; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of your anointed.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord), you have been our dwelling place in all generations.
verses.text: Adonai, you have been our dwelling place in all generations.

verses.raw: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are Elohim (God).
verses.text: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are Elohim.

verses.raw: You turn man to destruction; and say, Return, you children of men.
verses.text: You turn man to destruction; and say, Return, you children of men.

verses.raw: For a thousand years in your sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.
verses.text: For a thousand years in your sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

verses.raw: You carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which grows up.
verses.text: You carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep: in the morning they are like grass which grows up.

verses.raw: In the morning it flourisheth, and grows up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
verses.text: In the morning it flourisheth, and grows up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

verses.raw: For we are consumed by your anger, and by your wrath are we troubled.
verses.text: For we are consumed by your anger, and by your wrath are we troubled.

verses.raw: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your countenance.
verses.text: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your countenance.

verses.raw: For all our days are passed away in your wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.
verses.text: For all our days are passed away in your wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

verses.raw: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
verses.text: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

verses.raw: Who knows the power of your anger? even according to your fear, so is your wrath.
verses.text: Who knows the power of your anger? even according to your fear, so is your wrath.

verses.raw: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.
verses.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

verses.raw: Return, O Yahuah (LORD), how long? and let it repent you concerning your servants.
verses.text: Return, O Yahuah, how long? and let it repent you concerning your servants.

verses.raw: O satisfy us early with your mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
verses.text: O satisfy us early with your mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

verses.raw: Make us glad according to the days wherein you have afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.
verses.text: Make us glad according to the days wherein you have afflicted us, and the years wherein we have seen evil.

verses.raw: Let your work appear unto your servants, and your glory unto their children.
verses.text: Let your work appear unto your servants, and your glory unto their children.

verses.raw: And let the beauty of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) be upon us: and establish you the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish you it.
verses.text: And let the beauty of Yahuah Eloheinu be upon us: and establish you the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish you it.

verses.raw: He that dwells in the secret place of the El Elyon (most High) shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
verses.text: He that dwells in the secret place of the El Elyon shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

verses.raw: I will say of Yahuah (LORD), He is my refuge and my fortress: my Elohim (God); in him will I trust.
verses.text: I will say of Yahuah, He is my refuge and my fortress: my Elohim; in him will I trust.

verses.raw: Surely he shall deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.
verses.text: Surely he shall deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

verses.raw: He shall cover you with his feathers, and under his wings shall you trust: his truth shall be your shield and buckler.
verses.text: He shall cover you with his feathers, and under his wings shall you trust: his truth shall be your shield and buckler.

verses.raw: You shall not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
verses.text: You shall not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

verses.raw: Nor for the pestilence that walks in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
verses.text: Nor for the pestilence that walks in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

verses.raw: A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it shall not come nigh you.
verses.text: A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it shall not come nigh you.

verses.raw: Only with your eyes shall you behold and see the reward of the wicked.
verses.text: Only with your eyes shall you behold and see the reward of the wicked.

verses.raw: Because you have made Yahuah (LORD), which is my refuge, even the El Elyon (most High), your habitation;
verses.text: Because you have made Yahuah, which is my refuge, even the El Elyon, your habitation;

verses.raw: There shall no evil befall you, neither shall any plague come nigh your dwelling.
verses.text: There shall no evil befall you, neither shall any plague come nigh your dwelling.

verses.raw: For he shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways.
verses.text: For he shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways.

verses.raw: They shall bear you up in their hands, lest you dash your foot against a stone.
verses.text: They shall bear you up in their hands, lest you dash your foot against a stone.

verses.raw: You shall tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shall you trample under feet.
verses.text: You shall tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shall you trample under feet.

verses.raw: Because he has set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he has known my name.
verses.text: Because he has set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

verses.raw: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
verses.text: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

verses.raw: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
verses.text: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

verses.raw: It is a good thing to give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD), and to sing praises unto your name, O El Elyon (most High):
verses.text: It is a good thing to give thanks unto Yahuah, and to sing praises unto your name, O El Elyon:

verses.raw: To shew forth your lovingkindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,
verses.text: To shew forth your lovingkindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

verses.raw: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
verses.text: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

verses.raw: For you, Yahuah (LORD), have made me glad through your work: I will triumph in the works of your hands.
verses.text: For you, Yahuah, have made me glad through your work: I will triumph in the works of your hands.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), how great are your works! and your thoughts are very deep.
verses.text: O Yahuah, how great are your works! and your thoughts are very deep.

verses.raw: A brutish man knows not; neither does a fool understand this.
verses.text: A brutish man knows not; neither does a fool understand this.

verses.raw: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:
verses.text: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

verses.raw: But you, Yahuah (LORD), are most high for evermore.
verses.text: But you, Yahuah, are most high for evermore.

verses.raw: For, lo, your enemies, O Yahuah (LORD), for, lo, your enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
verses.text: For, lo, your enemies, O Yahuah, for, lo, your enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

verses.raw: But my horn shall you exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
verses.text: But my horn shall you exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.

verses.raw: My eye also shall see my desire on my enemies, and my ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.
verses.text: My eye also shall see my desire on my enemies, and my ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

verses.raw: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
verses.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

verses.raw: Those that be planted in the house of Yahuah (LORD) shall flourish in the courts of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: Those that be planted in the house of Yahuah shall flourish in the courts of our Elohim.

verses.raw: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
verses.text: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

verses.raw: To shew that Yahuah (LORD) is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
verses.text: To shew that Yahuah is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) reigns, he is clothed with majesty; Yahuah (LORD) is clothed with strength, wherewith he has girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
verses.text: Yahuah reigns, he is clothed with majesty; Yahuah is clothed with strength, wherewith he has girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.

verses.raw: Your throne is established of old: you are from everlasting.
verses.text: Your throne is established of old: you are from everlasting.

verses.raw: The floods have lifted up, O Yahuah (LORD), the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
verses.text: The floods have lifted up, O Yahuah, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.
verses.text: Yahuah on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

verses.raw: Your testimonies are very sure: holiness becomes your house, O Yahuah (LORD), for ever.
verses.text: Your testimonies are very sure: holiness becomes your house, O Yahuah, for ever.

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), to whom vengeance belongs; O Elohim (God), to whom vengeance belongs, shew thyself.
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim, to whom vengeance belongs; O Elohim, to whom vengeance belongs, shew thyself.

verses.raw: Lift up thyself, you judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
verses.text: Lift up thyself, you judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
verses.text: Yahuah, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

verses.raw: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
verses.text: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

verses.raw: They break in pieces your people, O Yahuah (LORD), and afflict your heritage.
verses.text: They break in pieces your people, O Yahuah, and afflict your heritage.

verses.raw: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
verses.text: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

verses.raw: Yet they say, Yahuah (LORD) shall not see, neither shall the Elohim (God) of Jacob regard it.
verses.text: Yet they say, Yahuah shall not see, neither shall the Elohim of Jacob regard it.

verses.raw: Understand, you brutish among the people: and you fools, when will you be wise?
verses.text: Understand, you brutish among the people: and you fools, when will you be wise?

verses.raw: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
verses.text: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?

verses.raw: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teaches man knowledge, shall not he know?
verses.text: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teaches man knowledge, shall not he know?

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) knows the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.
verses.text: Yahuah knows the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man whom you chastenest, O Yahuah (LORD), and teach him out of your law;
verses.text: Blessed is the man whom you chastenest, O Yahuah, and teach him out of your law;

verses.raw: That you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
verses.text: That you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
verses.text: For Yahuah will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

verses.raw: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
verses.text: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

verses.raw: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
verses.text: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

verses.raw: Unless Yahuah (LORD) had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
verses.text: Unless Yahuah had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

verses.raw: When I said, My foot slippeth; your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), held me up.
verses.text: When I said, My foot slippeth; your mercy, O Yahuah, held me up.

verses.raw: In the multitude of my thoughts within me your comforts delight my soul.
verses.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me your comforts delight my soul.

verses.raw: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with you, which frameth mischief by a law?
verses.text: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with you, which frameth mischief by a law?

verses.raw: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
verses.text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) is my defence; and my Elohim (God) is the rock of my refuge.
verses.text: But Yahuah is my defence; and my Elohim is the rock of my refuge.

verses.raw: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) shall cut them off.
verses.text: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, Yahuah Eloheinu shall cut them off.

verses.raw: O come, let us sing unto Yahuah (LORD): let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
verses.text: O come, let us sing unto Yahuah: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

verses.raw: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
verses.text: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) is a great Elohim (God), and a great King above all gods.
verses.text: For Yahuah is a great Elohim, and a great King above all gods.

verses.raw: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.
verses.text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

verses.raw: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.
verses.text: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

verses.raw: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before Yahuah (LORD) our maker.
verses.text: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before Yahuah our maker.

verses.raw: For he is our Elohim (God); and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if you will hear his voice,
verses.text: For he is our Elohim; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if you will hear his voice,

verses.raw: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.text: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

verses.raw: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
verses.text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

verses.raw: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
verses.text: Forty years long was I grieved with this generation, and said, It is a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:

verses.raw: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
verses.text: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

verses.raw: O sing unto Yahuah (LORD) a new song: sing unto Yahuah (LORD), all the earth.
verses.text: O sing unto Yahuah a new song: sing unto Yahuah, all the earth.

verses.raw: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD), bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.text: Sing unto Yahuah, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

verses.raw: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.text: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.text: For Yahuah is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

verses.raw: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but Yahuah (LORD) made the heavens.
verses.text: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but Yahuah made the heavens.

verses.raw: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.text: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

verses.raw: Give unto Yahuah (LORD), O you kindreds of the people, give unto Yahuah (LORD) glory and strength.
verses.text: Give unto Yahuah, O you kindreds of the people, give unto Yahuah glory and strength.

verses.raw: Give unto Yahuah (LORD) the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.text: Give unto Yahuah the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

verses.raw: O worship Yahuah (LORD) in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.text: O worship Yahuah in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

verses.raw: Say among the heathen that Yahuah (LORD) reigns: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.text: Say among the heathen that Yahuah reigns: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

verses.raw: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.text: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

verses.raw: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.text: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

verses.raw: Before Yahuah (LORD): for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.text: Before Yahuah: for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.
verses.text: Yahuah reigns; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

verses.raw: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.
verses.text: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

verses.raw: A fire goes before him, and burns up his enemies round about.
verses.text: A fire goes before him, and burns up his enemies round about.

verses.raw: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
verses.text: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

verses.raw: The hills melted like wax at the presence of Yahuah (LORD), at the presence of Adonai (Lord) of the whole earth.
verses.text: The hills melted like wax at the presence of Yahuah, at the presence of Adonai of the whole earth.

verses.raw: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
verses.text: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

verses.raw: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all you gods.
verses.text: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all you gods.

verses.raw: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Yahudah (Judah) rejoiced because of your judgments, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Yahudah rejoiced because of your judgments, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: For you, Yahuah (LORD), are high above all the earth: you are exalted far above all gods.
verses.text: For you, Yahuah, are high above all the earth: you are exalted far above all gods.

verses.raw: You that love Yahuah (LORD), hate evil: he preserves the souls of his saints; he delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.
verses.text: You that love Yahuah, hate evil: he preserves the souls of his saints; he delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

verses.raw: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
verses.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

verses.raw: Rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), you righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
verses.text: Rejoice in Yahuah, you righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.raw: O sing unto Yahuah (LORD) a new song; for he has done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, has gotten him the victory.
verses.text: O sing unto Yahuah a new song; for he has done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, has gotten him the victory.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has made known his salvation: his righteousness has he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
verses.text: Yahuah has made known his salvation: his righteousness has he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

verses.raw: He has remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Yashar'el (Israel): all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: He has remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Yashar'el: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our Elohim.

verses.raw: Make a joyful noise unto Yahuah (LORD), all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
verses.text: Make a joyful noise unto Yahuah, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

verses.raw: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD) with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
verses.text: Sing unto Yahuah with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

verses.raw: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before Yahuah (LORD), the King.
verses.text: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before Yahuah, the King.

verses.raw: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.text: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

verses.raw: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together
verses.text: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

verses.raw: Before Yahuah (LORD); for he comes to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
verses.text: Before Yahuah; for he comes to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) reigns; let the people tremble: he sits between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
verses.text: Yahuah reigns; let the people tremble: he sits between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.
verses.text: Yahuah is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

verses.raw: Let them praise your great and terrible name; for it is holy.
verses.text: Let them praise your great and terrible name; for it is holy.

verses.raw: The king’s strength also loves judgment; you do establish equity, you executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
verses.text: The king’s strength also loves judgment; you do establish equity, you executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.raw: Exalt you Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.
verses.text: Exalt you Yahuah Eloheinu, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

verses.raw: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon Yahuah (LORD), and he answered them.
verses.text: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon Yahuah, and he answered them.

verses.raw: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.
verses.text: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance that he gave them.

verses.raw: You answeredst them, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God): you were a Elohim (God) that forgavest them, though you tookest vengeance of their inventions.
verses.text: You answeredst them, O Yahuah our Elohim: you were a Elohim that forgavest them, though you tookest vengeance of their inventions.

verses.raw: Exalt Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and worship at his holy hill; for Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) is holy.
verses.text: Exalt Yahuah Eloheinu, and worship at his holy hill; for Yahuah Eloheinu is holy.

verses.raw: Make a joyful noise unto Yahuah (LORD), all you lands.
verses.text: Make a joyful noise unto Yahuah, all you lands.

verses.raw: Serve Yahuah (LORD) with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
verses.text: Serve Yahuah with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

verses.raw: Know you that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God): it is he that has made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
verses.text: Know you that Yahuah he is Elohim: it is he that has made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

verses.raw: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.
verses.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endures to all generations.
verses.text: For Yahuah is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endures to all generations.

verses.raw: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto you, O Yahuah (LORD), will I sing.
verses.text: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto you, O Yahuah, will I sing.

verses.raw: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when will you come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
verses.text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when will you come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

verses.raw: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.
verses.text: I will set no wicked thing before my eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

verses.raw: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.
verses.text: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

verses.raw: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that has an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
verses.text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that has an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

verses.raw: My eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walks in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
verses.text: My eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walks in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

verses.raw: He that works deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
verses.text: He that works deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

verses.raw: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Hear my prayer, O Yahuah (LORD), and let my cry come unto you.
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O Yahuah, and let my cry come unto you.

verses.raw: Hide not your face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline your ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.
verses.text: Hide not your face from me in the day when I am in trouble; incline your ear unto me: in the day when I call answer me speedily.

verses.raw: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
verses.text: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

verses.raw: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
verses.text: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

verses.raw: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
verses.text: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

verses.raw: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
verses.text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

verses.raw: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
verses.text: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

verses.raw: My enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
verses.text: My enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

verses.raw: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
verses.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

verses.raw: Because of your indignation and your wrath: for you have lifted me up, and cast me down.
verses.text: Because of your indignation and your wrath: for you have lifted me up, and cast me down.

verses.raw: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
verses.text: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

verses.raw: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), shall endure for ever; and your remembrance unto all generations.
verses.text: But you, O Yahuah, shall endure for ever; and your remembrance unto all generations.

verses.raw: You shall arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
verses.text: You shall arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

verses.raw: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
verses.text: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

verses.raw: So the heathen shall fear the name of Yahuah (LORD), and all the kings of the earth your glory.
verses.text: So the heathen shall fear the name of Yahuah, and all the kings of the earth your glory.

verses.raw: When Yahuah (LORD) shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
verses.text: When Yahuah shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.

verses.raw: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
verses.text: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

verses.raw: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise Yahuah.

verses.raw: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did Yahuah (LORD) behold the earth;
verses.text: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did Yahuah behold the earth;

verses.raw: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
verses.text: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

verses.raw: To declare the name of Yahuah (LORD) in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
verses.text: To declare the name of Yahuah in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

verses.raw: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve Yahuah.

verses.raw: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
verses.text: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

verses.raw: I said, O my Elohim (God), take me not away in the midst of my days: your years are throughout all generations.
verses.text: I said, O my Elohim, take me not away in the midst of my days: your years are throughout all generations.

verses.raw: Of old have you laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of your hands.
verses.text: Of old have you laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of your hands.

verses.raw: They shall perish, but you shall endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shall you change them, and they shall be changed:
verses.text: They shall perish, but you shall endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shall you change them, and they shall be changed:

verses.raw: But you are the same, and your years shall have no end.
verses.text: But you are the same, and your years shall have no end.

verses.raw: The children of your servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before you.
verses.text: The children of your servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before you.

verses.raw: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.
verses.text: Bless Yahuah, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

verses.raw: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
verses.text: Bless Yahuah, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

verses.raw: Who forgiveth all your iniquities; who healeth all your diseases;
verses.text: Who forgiveth all your iniquities; who healeth all your diseases;

verses.raw: Who redeemeth your life from destruction; who crowneth you with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
verses.text: Who redeemeth your life from destruction; who crowneth you with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

verses.raw: Who satisfies your mouth with good things; so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
verses.text: Who satisfies your mouth with good things; so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
verses.text: Yahuah executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

verses.raw: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
verses.text: Yahuah is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

verses.raw: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.
verses.text: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

verses.raw: He has not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
verses.text: He has not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

verses.raw: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
verses.text: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

verses.raw: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
verses.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

verses.raw: Like as a father pitieth his children, so Yahuah (LORD) pitieth them that fear him.
verses.text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so Yahuah pitieth them that fear him.

verses.raw: For he knows our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.
verses.text: For he knows our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

verses.raw: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
verses.text: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

verses.raw: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
verses.text: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

verses.raw: But the mercy of Yahuah (LORD) is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;
verses.text: But the mercy of Yahuah is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;

verses.raw: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
verses.text: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom rules over all.
verses.text: Yahuah has prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom rules over all.

verses.raw: Bless Yahuah (LORD), you his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
verses.text: Bless Yahuah, you his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.

verses.raw: Bless you Yahuah (LORD), all you his hosts; you ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
verses.text: Bless you Yahuah, all you his hosts; you ministers of his, that do his pleasure.

verses.raw: Bless Yahuah (LORD), all his works in all places of his dominion: bless Yahuah (LORD), O my soul.
verses.text: Bless Yahuah, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless Yahuah, O my soul.

verses.raw: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O my soul. O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), you are very great; you are clothed with honour and majesty.
verses.text: Bless Yahuah, O my soul. O Yahuah my Elohim, you are very great; you are clothed with honour and majesty.

verses.raw: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
verses.text: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

verses.raw: Who lays the beams of his chambers in the waters: who makes the clouds his chariot: who walks upon the wings of the wind:
verses.text: Who lays the beams of his chambers in the waters: who makes the clouds his chariot: who walks upon the wings of the wind:

verses.raw: Who makes his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
verses.text: Who makes his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

verses.raw: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.
verses.text: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

verses.raw: You coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
verses.text: You coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

verses.raw: At your rebuke they fled; at the voice of your thunder they hasted away.
verses.text: At your rebuke they fled; at the voice of your thunder they hasted away.

verses.raw: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which you have founded for them.
verses.text: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which you have founded for them.

verses.raw: You have set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
verses.text: You have set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

verses.raw: He sends the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.
verses.text: He sends the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

verses.raw: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
verses.text: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

verses.raw: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.
verses.text: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

verses.raw: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your works.
verses.text: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of your works.

verses.raw: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
verses.text: He causes the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

verses.raw: And wine that makes glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.
verses.text: And wine that makes glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

verses.raw: The trees of Yahuah (LORD) are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;
verses.text: The trees of Yahuah are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;

verses.raw: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.
verses.text: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

verses.raw: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.
verses.text: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

verses.raw: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down.
verses.text: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down.

verses.raw: You make darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
verses.text: You make darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

verses.raw: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from Elohim (God).
verses.text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from Elohim.

verses.raw: The sun arises, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
verses.text: The sun arises, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

verses.raw: Man goes forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
verses.text: Man goes forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), how manifold are your works! in wisdom have you made them all: the earth is full of your riches.
verses.text: O Yahuah, how manifold are your works! in wisdom have you made them all: the earth is full of your riches.

verses.raw: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
verses.text: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

verses.raw: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom you have made to play therein.
verses.text: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom you have made to play therein.

verses.raw: These wait all upon you; that you may give them their meat in due season.
verses.text: These wait all upon you; that you may give them their meat in due season.

verses.raw: That you give them they gather: you openest your hand, they are filled with good.
verses.text: That you give them they gather: you openest your hand, they are filled with good.

verses.raw: You hide your face, they are troubled: you take away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
verses.text: You hide your face, they are troubled: you take away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

verses.raw: You send forth your spirit, they are created: and you renewest the face of the earth.
verses.text: You send forth your spirit, they are created: and you renewest the face of the earth.

verses.raw: The glory of Yahuah (LORD) shall endure for ever: Yahuah (LORD) shall rejoice in his works.
verses.text: The glory of Yahuah shall endure for ever: Yahuah shall rejoice in his works.

verses.raw: He looks on the earth, and it trembles: he touches the hills, and they smoke.
verses.text: He looks on the earth, and it trembles: he touches the hills, and they smoke.

verses.raw: I will sing unto Yahuah (LORD) as long as I live: I will sing praise to my Elohim (God) while I have my being.
verses.text: I will sing unto Yahuah as long as I live: I will sing praise to my Elohim while I have my being.

verses.raw: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in Yahuah.

verses.raw: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless you Yahuah (LORD), O my soul. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless you Yahuah, O my soul. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.text: O give thanks unto Yahuah; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

verses.raw: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk you of all his wondrous works.
verses.text: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk you of all his wondrous works.

verses.raw: Glory you in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Glory you in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek Yahuah.

verses.raw: Seek Yahuah (LORD), and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.text: Seek Yahuah, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

verses.raw: Remember his marvellous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.text: Remember his marvellous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

verses.raw: O you seed of Abraham his servant, you children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.text: O you seed of Abraham his servant, you children of Jacob his chosen.

verses.raw: He is Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.text: He is Yahuah Eloheinu: his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.raw: He has remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.text: He has remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.raw: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
verses.text: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

verses.raw: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Yashar'el (Israel) for an everlasting covenant:
verses.text: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Yashar'el for an everlasting covenant:

verses.raw: Saying, Unto you will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.text: Saying, Unto you will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

verses.raw: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.text: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

verses.raw: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;
verses.text: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

verses.raw: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.text: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

verses.raw: Saying, Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.text: Saying, Touch not my anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

verses.raw: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.text: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

verses.raw: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:
verses.text: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

verses.raw: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.text: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

verses.raw: Until the time that his word came: the word of Yahuah (LORD) tried him.
verses.text: Until the time that his word came: the word of Yahuah tried him.

verses.raw: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.text: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

verses.raw: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

verses.raw: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.text: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.text: Yashar'el also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

verses.raw: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.text: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

verses.raw: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

verses.raw: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.text: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

verses.raw: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.text: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.raw: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

verses.raw: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.text: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

verses.raw: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.text: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

verses.raw: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
verses.text: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

verses.raw: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.text: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

verses.raw: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.text: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

verses.raw: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.text: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

verses.raw: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.text: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

verses.raw: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.text: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

verses.raw: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.
verses.text: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

verses.raw: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.text: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

verses.raw: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.text: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.

verses.raw: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.text: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

verses.raw: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.
verses.text: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

verses.raw: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.
verses.text: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

verses.raw: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:
verses.text: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

verses.raw: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.text: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

verses.raw: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. O give thanks unto Yahuah; for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahuah (LORD)? who can shew forth all his praise?
verses.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahuah? who can shew forth all his praise?

verses.raw: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that does righteousness at all times.
verses.text: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that does righteousness at all times.

verses.raw: Remember me, O Yahuah (LORD), with the favour that you bear unto your people: O visit me with your salvation;
verses.text: Remember me, O Yahuah, with the favour that you bear unto your people: O visit me with your salvation;

verses.raw: That I may see the good of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.
verses.text: That I may see the good of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

verses.raw: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
verses.text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

verses.raw: Our fathers understood not your wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of your mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.
verses.text: Our fathers understood not your wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of your mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

verses.raw: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
verses.text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

verses.raw: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
verses.text: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

verses.raw: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
verses.text: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.raw: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.
verses.text: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

verses.raw: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.
verses.text: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

verses.raw: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:
verses.text: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

verses.raw: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted Elohim (God) in the desert.
verses.text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted Elohim in the desert.

verses.raw: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.
verses.text: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

verses.raw: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of Yahuah.

verses.raw: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.
verses.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

verses.raw: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.
verses.text: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

verses.raw: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.
verses.text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

verses.raw: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eats grass.
verses.text: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eats grass.

verses.raw: They forgat Elohim (God) their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;
verses.text: They forgat Elohim their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

verses.raw: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.
verses.text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

verses.raw: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.
verses.text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

verses.raw: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:
verses.text: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

verses.raw: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:
verses.text: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

verses.raw: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.
verses.text: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

verses.raw: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
verses.text: They joined themselves also unto Baal-peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.raw: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.
verses.text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

verses.raw: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.
verses.text: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

verses.raw: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.
verses.text: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

verses.raw: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:
verses.text: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

verses.raw: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.
verses.text: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

verses.raw: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom Yahuah (LORD) commanded them:
verses.text: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom Yahuah commanded them:

verses.raw: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.
verses.text: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

verses.raw: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.
verses.text: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

verses.raw: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,
verses.text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

verses.raw: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.
verses.text: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

verses.raw: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.
verses.text: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

verses.raw: Therefore was the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.
verses.text: Therefore was the wrath of Yahuah kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

verses.raw: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.
verses.text: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

verses.raw: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.
verses.text: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

verses.raw: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.
verses.text: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

verses.raw: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:
verses.text: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

verses.raw: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
verses.text: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.raw: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.
verses.text: He made them also to be pitied of all those that carried them captives.

verses.raw: Save us, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God), and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto your holy name, and to triumph in your praise.
verses.text: Save us, O Yahuah our Elohim, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto your holy name, and to triumph in your praise.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD), for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks unto Yahuah, for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Let the redeemed of Yahuah (LORD) say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy;
verses.text: Let the redeemed of Yahuah say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

verses.raw: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.
verses.text: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

verses.raw: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.
verses.text: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

verses.raw: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.
verses.text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

verses.raw: Then they cried unto Yahuah (LORD) in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.
verses.text: Then they cried unto Yahuah in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.raw: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.
verses.text: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.raw: Oh that men would praise Yahuah (LORD) for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.text: Oh that men would praise Yahuah for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.raw: For he satisfies the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.
verses.text: For he satisfies the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

verses.raw: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
verses.text: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

verses.raw: Because they rebelled against the words of Elohim (God), and contemned the counsel of the El Elyon (most High):
verses.text: Because they rebelled against the words of Elohim, and contemned the counsel of the El Elyon:

verses.raw: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.
verses.text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

verses.raw: Then they cried unto Yahuah (LORD) in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.
verses.text: Then they cried unto Yahuah in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

verses.raw: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.
verses.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

verses.raw: Oh that men would praise Yahuah (LORD) for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.text: Oh that men would praise Yahuah for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.raw: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.
verses.text: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

verses.raw: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.
verses.text: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

verses.raw: Their soul abhors all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.
verses.text: Their soul abhors all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

verses.raw: Then they cry unto Yahuah (LORD) in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.
verses.text: Then they cry unto Yahuah in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

verses.raw: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.
verses.text: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.raw: Oh that men would praise Yahuah (LORD) for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.text: Oh that men would praise Yahuah for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.raw: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.
verses.text: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

verses.raw: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;
verses.text: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

verses.raw: These see the works of Yahuah (LORD), and his wonders in the deep.
verses.text: These see the works of Yahuah, and his wonders in the deep.

verses.raw: For he commands, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifts up the waves thereof.
verses.text: For he commands, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifts up the waves thereof.

verses.raw: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.
verses.text: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

verses.raw: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.
verses.text: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

verses.raw: Then they cry unto Yahuah (LORD) in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distresses.
verses.text: Then they cry unto Yahuah in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distresses.

verses.raw: He makes the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.
verses.text: He makes the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

verses.raw: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he brings them unto their desired haven.
verses.text: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he brings them unto their desired haven.

verses.raw: Oh that men would praise Yahuah (LORD) for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!
verses.text: Oh that men would praise Yahuah for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

verses.raw: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.
verses.text: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

verses.raw: He turns rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;
verses.text: He turns rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

verses.raw: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
verses.text: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.raw: He turns the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.
