verses.text: He turns the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

verses.raw: And there he makes the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
verses.text: And there he makes the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

verses.raw: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.
verses.text: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

verses.raw: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffers not their cattle to decrease.
verses.text: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly; and suffers not their cattle to decrease.

verses.raw: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.
verses.text: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

verses.raw: He pours contempt upon princes, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.
verses.text: He pours contempt upon princes, and causes them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

verses.raw: Yet sets he the poor on high from affliction, and makes him families like a flock.
verses.text: Yet sets he the poor on high from affliction, and makes him families like a flock.

verses.raw: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
verses.text: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

verses.raw: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of Yahuah.

verses.raw: O Elohim (God), my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
verses.text: O Elohim, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

verses.raw: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.
verses.text: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

verses.raw: I will praise you, O Yahuah (LORD), among the people: and I will sing praises unto you among the nations.
verses.text: I will praise you, O Yahuah, among the people: and I will sing praises unto you among the nations.

verses.raw: For your mercy is great above the heavens: and your truth reaches unto the clouds.
verses.text: For your mercy is great above the heavens: and your truth reaches unto the clouds.

verses.raw: Be you exalted, O Elohim (God), above the heavens: and your glory above all the earth;
verses.text: Be you exalted, O Elohim, above the heavens: and your glory above all the earth;

verses.raw: That your beloved may be delivered: save with your right hand, and answer me.
verses.text: That your beloved may be delivered: save with your right hand, and answer me.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.text: Elohim has spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

verses.raw: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Yahudah (Judah) is my lawgiver;
verses.text: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of my head; Yahudah is my lawgiver;

verses.raw: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
verses.text: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

verses.raw: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

verses.raw: Will not you, O Elohim (God), who have cast us off? and will not you, O Elohim (God), go forth with our hosts?
verses.text: Will not you, O Elohim, who have cast us off? and will not you, O Elohim, go forth with our hosts?

verses.raw: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.text: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

verses.raw: Through Elohim (God) we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.text: Through Elohim we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

verses.raw: Hold not your peace, O Elohim (God) of my praise;
verses.text: Hold not your peace, O Elohim of my praise;

verses.raw: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
verses.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

verses.raw: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
verses.text: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

verses.raw: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.
verses.text: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

verses.raw: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
verses.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

verses.raw: Set you a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
verses.text: Set you a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

verses.raw: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
verses.text: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

verses.raw: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.
verses.text: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

verses.raw: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
verses.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

verses.raw: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.
verses.text: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

verses.raw: Let the extortioner catch all that he has; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
verses.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he has; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

verses.raw: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
verses.text: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

verses.raw: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
verses.text: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.raw: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Yahuah (LORD); and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
verses.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Yahuah; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.raw: Let them be before Yahuah (LORD) continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
verses.text: Let them be before Yahuah continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

verses.raw: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
verses.text: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

verses.raw: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
verses.text: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

verses.raw: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
verses.text: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

verses.raw: Let it be unto him as the garment which covers him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
verses.text: Let it be unto him as the garment which covers him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.raw: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from Yahuah (LORD), and of them that speak evil against my soul.
verses.text: Let this be the reward of my adversaries from Yahuah, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.raw: But do you for me, O GOD Adonai (Lord), for your name’s sake: because your mercy is good, deliver you me.
verses.text: But do you for me, O GOD Adonai, for your name’s sake: because your mercy is good, deliver you me.

verses.raw: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
verses.text: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

verses.raw: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
verses.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.raw: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh fails of fatness.
verses.text: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh fails of fatness.

verses.raw: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
verses.text: I became also a reproach unto them: when they looked upon me they shaked their heads.

verses.raw: Help me, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God): O save me according to your mercy:
verses.text: Help me, O Yahuah my Elohim: O save me according to your mercy:

verses.raw: That they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahuah (LORD), have done it.
verses.text: That they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahuah, have done it.

verses.raw: Let them curse, but bless you: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let your servant rejoice.
verses.text: Let them curse, but bless you: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let your servant rejoice.

verses.raw: Let my adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
verses.text: Let my adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

verses.raw: I will greatly praise Yahuah (LORD) with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
verses.text: I will greatly praise Yahuah with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.raw: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.
verses.text: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit you at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool.
verses.text: Yahuah said unto my Lord, Sit you at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall send the rod of your strength out of Zion: rule you in the midst of your enemies.
verses.text: Yahuah shall send the rod of your strength out of Zion: rule you in the midst of your enemies.

verses.raw: Your people shall be willing in the day of your power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: you have the dew of your youth.
verses.text: Your people shall be willing in the day of your power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: you have the dew of your youth.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn, and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).
verses.text: Yahuah has sworn, and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord) at your right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
verses.text: Adonai at your right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.

verses.raw: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
verses.text: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

verses.raw: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
verses.text: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). I will praise Yahuah (LORD) with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. I will praise Yahuah with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

verses.raw: The works of Yahuah (LORD) are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
verses.text: The works of Yahuah are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

verses.raw: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endures for ever.
verses.text: His work is honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endures for ever.

verses.raw: He has made his wonderful works to be remembered: Yahuah (LORD) is gracious and full of compassion.
verses.text: He has made his wonderful works to be remembered: Yahuah is gracious and full of compassion.

verses.raw: He has given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
verses.text: He has given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

verses.raw: He has shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
verses.text: He has shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

verses.raw: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.
verses.text: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

verses.raw: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.
verses.text: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

verses.raw: He sent redemption unto his people: he has commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.
verses.text: He sent redemption unto his people: he has commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endures for ever.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endures for ever.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Blessed is the man that fears Yahuah (LORD), that delights greatly in his commandments.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. Blessed is the man that fears Yahuah, that delights greatly in his commandments.

verses.raw: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.text: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.

verses.raw: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endures for ever.
verses.text: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endures for ever.

verses.raw: Unto the upright there arises light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.text: Unto the upright there arises light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

verses.raw: A good man shows favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.text: A good man shows favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

verses.raw: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.text: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

verses.raw: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in Yahuah.

verses.raw: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.
verses.text: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

verses.raw: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
verses.text: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor; his righteousness endures for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.

verses.raw: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
verses.text: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise, O you servants of Yahuah (LORD), praise the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. Praise, O you servants of Yahuah, praise the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Blessed be the name of Yahuah (LORD) from this time forth and for evermore.
verses.text: Blessed be the name of Yahuah from this time forth and for evermore.

verses.raw: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’S name is to be praised.
verses.text: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’S name is to be praised.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.
verses.text: Yahuah is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

verses.raw: Who is like unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), who dwells on high,
verses.text: Who is like unto Yahuah Eloheinu, who dwells on high,

verses.raw: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!
verses.text: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

verses.raw: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifts the needy out of the dunghill;
verses.text: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifts the needy out of the dunghill;

verses.raw: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
verses.text: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

verses.raw: He makes the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He makes the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: When Yashar'el (Israel) went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.text: When Yashar'el went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of strange language;

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah) was his sanctuary, and Yashar'el (Israel) his dominion.
verses.text: Yahudah was his sanctuary, and Yashar'el his dominion.

verses.raw: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
verses.text: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

verses.raw: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verses.text: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

verses.raw: What ailed you, O you sea, that you fleddest? you Jordan, that you were driven back?
verses.text: What ailed you, O you sea, that you fleddest? you Jordan, that you were driven back?

verses.raw: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; and you little hills, like lambs?
verses.text: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; and you little hills, like lambs?

verses.raw: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of Adonai (Lord), at the presence of the Elohim (God) of Jacob;
verses.text: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of Adonai, at the presence of the Elohim of Jacob;

verses.raw: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
verses.text: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

verses.raw: Not unto us, O Yahuah (LORD), not unto us, but unto your name give glory, for your mercy, and for your truth’s sake.
verses.text: Not unto us, O Yahuah, not unto us, but unto your name give glory, for your mercy, and for your truth’s sake.

verses.raw: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their Elohim?

verses.raw: But our Elohim (God) is in the heavens: he has done whatsoever he has pleased.
verses.text: But our Elohim is in the heavens: he has done whatsoever he has pleased.

verses.raw: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.raw: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
verses.text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

verses.raw: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
verses.text: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

verses.raw: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
verses.text: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

verses.raw: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusts in them.
verses.text: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusts in them.

verses.raw: O Yashar'el (Israel), trust you in Yahuah (LORD): he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: O Yashar'el, trust you in Yahuah: he is their help and their shield.

verses.raw: O house of Aaron, trust in Yahuah (LORD): he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: O house of Aaron, trust in Yahuah: he is their help and their shield.

verses.raw: You that fear Yahuah (LORD), trust in Yahuah (LORD): he is their help and their shield.
verses.text: You that fear Yahuah, trust in Yahuah: he is their help and their shield.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Yashar'el (Israel); he will bless the house of Aaron.
verses.text: Yahuah has been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Yashar'el; he will bless the house of Aaron.

verses.raw: He will bless them that fear Yahuah (LORD), both small and great.
verses.text: He will bless them that fear Yahuah, both small and great.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
verses.text: Yahuah shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

verses.raw: You are blessed of Yahuah (LORD) which made heaven and earth.
verses.text: You are blessed of Yahuah which made heaven and earth.

verses.raw: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’S: but the earth has he given to the children of men.
verses.text: The heaven, even the heavens, are the LORD’S: but the earth has he given to the children of men.

verses.raw: The dead praise not Yahuah (LORD), neither any that go down into silence.
verses.text: The dead praise not Yahuah, neither any that go down into silence.

verses.raw: But we will bless Yahuah (LORD) from this time forth and for evermore. Praise Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But we will bless Yahuah from this time forth and for evermore. Praise Yahuah.

verses.raw: I love Yahuah (LORD), because he has heard my voice and my supplications.
verses.text: I love Yahuah, because he has heard my voice and my supplications.

verses.raw: Because he has inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.
verses.text: Because he has inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon him as long as I live.

verses.raw: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
verses.text: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

verses.raw: Then called I upon the name of Yahuah (LORD); O Yahuah (LORD), I beseech you, deliver my soul.
verses.text: Then called I upon the name of Yahuah; O Yahuah, I beseech you, deliver my soul.

verses.raw: Gracious is Yahuah (LORD), and righteous; yea, our Elohim (God) is merciful.
verses.text: Gracious is Yahuah, and righteous; yea, our Elohim is merciful.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) preserves the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
verses.text: Yahuah preserves the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

verses.raw: Return unto your rest, O my soul; for Yahuah (LORD) has dealt bountifully with you.
verses.text: Return unto your rest, O my soul; for Yahuah has dealt bountifully with you.

verses.raw: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.
verses.text: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

verses.raw: I will walk before Yahuah (LORD) in the land of the living.
verses.text: I will walk before Yahuah in the land of the living.

verses.raw: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
verses.text: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

verses.raw: I said in my haste, All men are liars.
verses.text: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

verses.raw: What shall I render unto Yahuah (LORD) for all his benefits toward me?
verses.text: What shall I render unto Yahuah for all his benefits toward me?

verses.raw: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will pay my vows unto Yahuah (LORD) now in the presence of all his people.
verses.text: I will pay my vows unto Yahuah now in the presence of all his people.

verses.raw: Precious in the sight of Yahuah (LORD) is the death of his saints.
verses.text: Precious in the sight of Yahuah is the death of his saints.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), truly I am your servant; I am your servant, and the son of your handmaid: you have loosed my bonds.
verses.text: O Yahuah, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, and the son of your handmaid: you have loosed my bonds.

verses.raw: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call upon the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will pay my vows unto Yahuah (LORD) now in the presence of all his people,
verses.text: I will pay my vows unto Yahuah now in the presence of all his people,

verses.raw: In the courts of the LORD’S house, in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: In the courts of the LORD’S house, in the midst of you, O Jerusalem. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: O praise Yahuah (LORD), all you nations: praise him, all you people.
verses.text: O praise Yahuah, all you nations: praise him, all you people.

verses.raw: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of Yahuah (LORD) endures for ever. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of Yahuah endures for ever. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good: because his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks unto Yahuah; for he is good: because his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Let Yashar'el (Israel) now say, that his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Let Yashar'el now say, that his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Let them now that fear Yahuah (LORD) say, that his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Let them now that fear Yahuah say, that his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: I called upon Yahuah (LORD) in distress: Yahuah (LORD) answered me, and set me in a large place.
verses.text: I called upon Yahuah in distress: Yahuah answered me, and set me in a large place.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.text: Yahuah is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) takes my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.
verses.text: Yahuah takes my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

verses.raw: It is better to trust in Yahuah (LORD) than to put confidence in man.
verses.text: It is better to trust in Yahuah than to put confidence in man.

verses.raw: It is better to trust in Yahuah (LORD) than to put confidence in princes.
verses.text: It is better to trust in Yahuah than to put confidence in princes.

verses.raw: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of Yahuah (LORD) will I destroy them.
verses.text: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of Yahuah will I destroy them.

verses.raw: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of Yahuah (LORD) I will destroy them.
verses.text: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of Yahuah I will destroy them.

verses.raw: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of Yahuah (LORD) I will destroy them.
verses.text: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of Yahuah I will destroy them.

verses.raw: You have thrust sore at me that I might fall: but Yahuah (LORD) helped me.
verses.text: You have thrust sore at me that I might fall: but Yahuah helped me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.text: Yahuah is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

verses.raw: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of Yahuah (LORD) does valiantly.
verses.text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of Yahuah does valiantly.

verses.raw: The right hand of Yahuah (LORD) is exalted: the right hand of Yahuah (LORD) does valiantly.
verses.text: The right hand of Yahuah is exalted: the right hand of Yahuah does valiantly.

verses.raw: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has chastened me sore: but he has not given me over unto death.
verses.text: Yahuah has chastened me sore: but he has not given me over unto death.

verses.raw: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise Yahuah:

verses.raw: This gate of Yahuah (LORD), into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.text: This gate of Yahuah, into which the righteous shall enter.

verses.raw: I will praise you: for you have heard me, and are become my salvation.
verses.text: I will praise you: for you have heard me, and are become my salvation.

verses.raw: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.
verses.text: The stone which the builders refused is become the head stone of the corner.

verses.raw: This is the LORD’S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.
verses.text: This is the LORD’S doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

verses.raw: This is the day which Yahuah (LORD) has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.text: This is the day which Yahuah has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

verses.raw: Save now, I beseech you, O Yahuah (LORD): O Yahuah (LORD), I beseech you, send now prosperity.
verses.text: Save now, I beseech you, O Yahuah: O Yahuah, I beseech you, send now prosperity.

verses.raw: Blessed be he that comes in the name of Yahuah (LORD): we have blessed you out of the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Blessed be he that comes in the name of Yahuah: we have blessed you out of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD), which has shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.
verses.text: Elohim is Yahuah, which has shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

verses.raw: You are my Elohim (God), and I will praise you: you are my Elohim (God), I will exalt you.
verses.text: You are my Elohim, and I will praise you: you are my Elohim, I will exalt you.

verses.raw: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks unto Yahuah; for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.
verses.text: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

verses.raw: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.
verses.text: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

verses.raw: You have commanded us to keep your precepts diligently.
verses.text: You have commanded us to keep your precepts diligently.

verses.raw: O that my ways were directed to keep your statutes!
verses.text: O that my ways were directed to keep your statutes!

verses.raw: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all your commandments.
verses.text: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all your commandments.

verses.raw: I will praise you with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned your righteous judgments.
verses.text: I will praise you with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned your righteous judgments.

verses.raw: I will keep your statutes: O forsake me not utterly. ב BETH.
verses.text: I will keep your statutes: O forsake me not utterly. ב BETH.

verses.raw: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to your word.
verses.text: Wherewithal shall a young man cleanse his way? by taking heed thereto according to your word.

verses.raw: With my whole heart have I sought you: O let me not wander from your commandments.
verses.text: With my whole heart have I sought you: O let me not wander from your commandments.

verses.raw: Your word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against you.
verses.text: Your word have I hid in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

verses.raw: Blessed are you, O Yahuah (LORD): teach me your statutes.
verses.text: Blessed are you, O Yahuah: teach me your statutes.

verses.raw: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of your mouth.
verses.text: With my lips have I declared all the judgments of your mouth.

verses.raw: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.
verses.text: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

verses.raw: I will meditate in your precepts, and have respect unto your ways.
verses.text: I will meditate in your precepts, and have respect unto your ways.

verses.raw: I will delight myself in your statutes: I will not forget your word. ג GIMEL.
verses.text: I will delight myself in your statutes: I will not forget your word. ג GIMEL.

verses.raw: Deal bountifully with your servant, that I may live, and keep your word.
verses.text: Deal bountifully with your servant, that I may live, and keep your word.

verses.raw: Open you my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your law.
verses.text: Open you my eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of your law.

verses.raw: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not your commandments from me.
verses.text: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not your commandments from me.

verses.raw: My soul breaks for the longing that it has unto your judgments at all times.
verses.text: My soul breaks for the longing that it has unto your judgments at all times.

verses.raw: You have rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from your commandments.
verses.text: You have rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from your commandments.

verses.raw: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept your testimonies.
verses.text: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept your testimonies.

verses.raw: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but your servant did meditate in your statutes.
verses.text: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but your servant did meditate in your statutes.

verses.raw: Your testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors. ד DALETH.
verses.text: Your testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors. ד DALETH.

verses.raw: My soul cleaves unto the dust: quicken you me according to your word.
verses.text: My soul cleaves unto the dust: quicken you me according to your word.

verses.raw: I have declared my ways, and you heard me: teach me your statutes.
verses.text: I have declared my ways, and you heard me: teach me your statutes.

verses.raw: Make me to understand the way of your precepts: so shall I talk of your wondrous works.
verses.text: Make me to understand the way of your precepts: so shall I talk of your wondrous works.

verses.raw: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen you me according unto your word.
verses.text: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen you me according unto your word.

verses.raw: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me your law graciously.
verses.text: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me your law graciously.

verses.raw: I have chosen the way of truth: your judgments have I laid before me.
verses.text: I have chosen the way of truth: your judgments have I laid before me.

verses.raw: I have stuck unto your testimonies: O Yahuah (LORD), put me not to shame.
verses.text: I have stuck unto your testimonies: O Yahuah, put me not to shame.

verses.raw: I will run the way of your commandments, when you shall enlarge my heart. ה HE.
verses.text: I will run the way of your commandments, when you shall enlarge my heart. ה HE.

verses.raw: Teach me, O Yahuah (LORD), the way of your statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.
verses.text: Teach me, O Yahuah, the way of your statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

verses.raw: Give me understanding, and I shall keep your law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.
verses.text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep your law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

verses.raw: Make me to go in the path of your commandments; for therein do I delight.
verses.text: Make me to go in the path of your commandments; for therein do I delight.

verses.raw: Incline my heart unto your testimonies, and not to covetousness.
verses.text: Incline my heart unto your testimonies, and not to covetousness.

verses.raw: Turn away my eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken you me in your way.
verses.text: Turn away my eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken you me in your way.

verses.raw: Stablish your word unto your servant, who is devoted to your fear.
verses.text: Stablish your word unto your servant, who is devoted to your fear.

verses.raw: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for your judgments are good.
verses.text: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for your judgments are good.

verses.raw: Behold, I have longed after your precepts: quicken me in your righteousness. ו VAU.
verses.text: Behold, I have longed after your precepts: quicken me in your righteousness. ו VAU.

verses.raw: Let your mercies come also unto me, O Yahuah (LORD), even your salvation, according to your word.
verses.text: Let your mercies come also unto me, O Yahuah, even your salvation, according to your word.

verses.raw: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in your word.
verses.text: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in your word.

verses.raw: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in your judgments.
verses.text: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in your judgments.

verses.raw: So shall I keep your law continually for ever and ever.
verses.text: So shall I keep your law continually for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek your precepts.
verses.text: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek your precepts.

verses.raw: I will speak of your testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.
verses.text: I will speak of your testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

verses.raw: And I will delight myself in your commandments, which I have loved.
verses.text: And I will delight myself in your commandments, which I have loved.

verses.raw: My hands also will I lift up unto your commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in your statutes. ז ZAIN.
verses.text: My hands also will I lift up unto your commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in your statutes. ז ZAIN.

verses.raw: Remember the word unto your servant, upon which you have caused me to hope.
verses.text: Remember the word unto your servant, upon which you have caused me to hope.

verses.raw: This is my comfort in my affliction: for your word has quickened me.
verses.text: This is my comfort in my affliction: for your word has quickened me.

verses.raw: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from your law.
verses.text: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from your law.

verses.raw: I remembered your judgments of old, O Yahuah (LORD); and have comforted myself.
verses.text: I remembered your judgments of old, O Yahuah; and have comforted myself.

verses.raw: Horror has taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake your law.
verses.text: Horror has taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake your law.

verses.raw: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.
verses.text: Your statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

verses.raw: I have remembered your name, O Yahuah (LORD), in the night, and have kept your law.
verses.text: I have remembered your name, O Yahuah, in the night, and have kept your law.

verses.raw: This I had, because I kept your precepts. ח CHETH.
verses.text: This I had, because I kept your precepts. ח CHETH.

verses.raw: You are my portion, O Yahuah (LORD): I have said that I would keep your words.
verses.text: You are my portion, O Yahuah: I have said that I would keep your words.

verses.raw: I intreated your favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to your word.
verses.text: I intreated your favour with my whole heart: be merciful unto me according to your word.

verses.raw: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto your testimonies.
verses.text: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto your testimonies.

verses.raw: I made haste, and delayed not to keep your commandments.
verses.text: I made haste, and delayed not to keep your commandments.

verses.raw: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten your law.
verses.text: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten your law.

verses.raw: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto you because of your righteous judgments.
verses.text: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto you because of your righteous judgments.

verses.raw: I am a companion of all them that fear you, and of them that keep your precepts.
verses.text: I am a companion of all them that fear you, and of them that keep your precepts.

verses.raw: The earth, O Yahuah (LORD), is full of your mercy: teach me your statutes. ט TETH.
verses.text: The earth, O Yahuah, is full of your mercy: teach me your statutes. ט TETH.

verses.raw: You have dealt well with your servant, O Yahuah (LORD), according unto your word.
verses.text: You have dealt well with your servant, O Yahuah, according unto your word.

verses.raw: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed your commandments.
verses.text: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed your commandments.

verses.raw: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept your word.
verses.text: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept your word.

verses.raw: You are good, and do good; teach me your statutes.
verses.text: You are good, and do good; teach me your statutes.

verses.raw: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep your precepts with my whole heart.
verses.text: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep your precepts with my whole heart.

verses.raw: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in your law.
verses.text: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in your law.

verses.raw: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn your statutes.
verses.text: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn your statutes.

verses.raw: The law of your mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver. י JOD.
verses.text: The law of your mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver. י JOD.

verses.raw: Your hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
verses.text: Your hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

verses.raw: They that fear you will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in your word.
verses.text: They that fear you will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in your word.

verses.raw: I know, O Yahuah (LORD), that your judgments are right, and that you in faithfulness have afflicted me.
verses.text: I know, O Yahuah, that your judgments are right, and that you in faithfulness have afflicted me.

verses.raw: Let, I pray you, your merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to your word unto your servant.
verses.text: Let, I pray you, your merciful kindness be for my comfort, according to your word unto your servant.

verses.raw: Let your tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for your law is my delight.
verses.text: Let your tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for your law is my delight.

verses.raw: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in your precepts.
verses.text: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in your precepts.

verses.raw: Let those that fear you turn unto me, and those that have known your testimonies.
verses.text: Let those that fear you turn unto me, and those that have known your testimonies.

verses.raw: Let my heart be sound in your statutes; that I be not ashamed. כ CAPH.
verses.text: Let my heart be sound in your statutes; that I be not ashamed. כ CAPH.

verses.raw: My soul fainteth for your salvation: but I hope in your word.
verses.text: My soul fainteth for your salvation: but I hope in your word.

verses.raw: My eyes fail for your word, saying, When will you comfort me?
verses.text: My eyes fail for your word, saying, When will you comfort me?

verses.raw: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget your statutes.
verses.text: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget your statutes.

verses.raw: How many are the days of your servant? when will you execute judgment on them that persecute me?
verses.text: How many are the days of your servant? when will you execute judgment on them that persecute me?

verses.raw: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after your law.
verses.text: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after your law.

verses.raw: All your commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help you me.
verses.text: All your commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help you me.

verses.raw: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not your precepts.
verses.text: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not your precepts.

verses.raw: Quicken me after your lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of your mouth. ל LAMED.
verses.text: Quicken me after your lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of your mouth. ל LAMED.

verses.raw: For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), your word is settled in heaven.
verses.text: For ever, O Yahuah, your word is settled in heaven.

verses.raw: Your faithfulness is unto all generations: you have established the earth, and it abides.
verses.text: Your faithfulness is unto all generations: you have established the earth, and it abides.

verses.raw: They continue this day according to your ordinances: for all are your servants.
verses.text: They continue this day according to your ordinances: for all are your servants.

verses.raw: Unless your law had been my delights, I should then have perished in my affliction.
verses.text: Unless your law had been my delights, I should then have perished in my affliction.

verses.raw: I will never forget your precepts: for with them you have quickened me.
verses.text: I will never forget your precepts: for with them you have quickened me.

verses.raw: I am yours, save me; for I have sought your precepts.
verses.text: I am yours, save me; for I have sought your precepts.

verses.raw: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider your testimonies.
verses.text: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider your testimonies.

verses.raw: I have seen an end of all perfection: but your commandment is exceeding broad. מ MEM.
verses.text: I have seen an end of all perfection: but your commandment is exceeding broad. מ MEM.

verses.raw: O how love I your law! it is my meditation all the day.
verses.text: O how love I your law! it is my meditation all the day.

verses.raw: You through your commandments have made me wiser than my enemies: for they are ever with me.
verses.text: You through your commandments have made me wiser than my enemies: for they are ever with me.

verses.raw: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for your testimonies are my meditation.
verses.text: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for your testimonies are my meditation.

verses.raw: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep your precepts.
verses.text: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep your precepts.

verses.raw: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep your word.
verses.text: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep your word.

verses.raw: I have not departed from your judgments: for you have taught me.
verses.text: I have not departed from your judgments: for you have taught me.

verses.raw: How sweet are your words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
verses.text: How sweet are your words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

verses.raw: Through your precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way. נ NUN.
verses.text: Through your precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way. נ NUN.

verses.raw: Your word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
verses.text: Your word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

verses.raw: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep your righteous judgments.
verses.text: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep your righteous judgments.

verses.raw: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Yahuah (LORD), according unto your word.
verses.text: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Yahuah, according unto your word.

verses.raw: Accept, I beseech you, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Yahuah (LORD), and teach me your judgments.
verses.text: Accept, I beseech you, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Yahuah, and teach me your judgments.

verses.raw: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget your law.
verses.text: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget your law.

verses.raw: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from your precepts.
verses.text: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from your precepts.

verses.raw: Your testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.
verses.text: Your testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

verses.raw: I have inclined my heart to perform your statutes alway, even unto the end. ס SAMECH.
verses.text: I have inclined my heart to perform your statutes alway, even unto the end. ס SAMECH.

verses.raw: I hate vain thoughts: but your law do I love.
verses.text: I hate vain thoughts: but your law do I love.

verses.raw: You are my hiding place and my shield: I hope in your word.
verses.text: You are my hiding place and my shield: I hope in your word.

verses.raw: Depart from me, you evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my Elohim (God).
verses.text: Depart from me, you evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my Elohim.

verses.raw: Uphold me according unto your word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.
verses.text: Uphold me according unto your word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

verses.raw: Hold you me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto your statutes continually.
verses.text: Hold you me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto your statutes continually.

verses.raw: You have trodden down all them that err from your statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.
verses.text: You have trodden down all them that err from your statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

verses.raw: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love your testimonies.
verses.text: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love your testimonies.

verses.raw: My flesh trembles for fear of you; and I am afraid of your judgments. ע AIN.
verses.text: My flesh trembles for fear of you; and I am afraid of your judgments. ע AIN.

verses.raw: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to my oppressors.
verses.text: I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to my oppressors.

verses.raw: Be surety for your servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.
verses.text: Be surety for your servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

verses.raw: My eyes fail for your salvation, and for the word of your righteousness.
verses.text: My eyes fail for your salvation, and for the word of your righteousness.

verses.raw: Deal with your servant according unto your mercy, and teach me your statutes.
verses.text: Deal with your servant according unto your mercy, and teach me your statutes.

verses.raw: I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.
verses.text: I am your servant; give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

verses.raw: It is time for you, Yahuah (LORD), to work: for they have made void your law.
verses.text: It is time for you, Yahuah, to work: for they have made void your law.

verses.raw: Therefore I love your commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.
verses.text: Therefore I love your commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

verses.raw: Therefore I esteem all your precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way. פ PE.
verses.text: Therefore I esteem all your precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way. פ PE.

verses.raw: Your testimonies are wonderful: therefore does my soul keep them.
verses.text: Your testimonies are wonderful: therefore does my soul keep them.

verses.raw: The entrance of your words gives light; it gives understanding unto the simple.
verses.text: The entrance of your words gives light; it gives understanding unto the simple.

verses.raw: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for your commandments.
verses.text: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for your commandments.

verses.raw: Look you upon me, and be merciful unto me, as you usest to do unto those that love your name.
verses.text: Look you upon me, and be merciful unto me, as you usest to do unto those that love your name.

verses.raw: Order my steps in your word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
verses.text: Order my steps in your word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

verses.raw: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep your precepts.
verses.text: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep your precepts.

verses.raw: Make your face to shine upon your servant; and teach me your statutes.
verses.text: Make your face to shine upon your servant; and teach me your statutes.

verses.raw: Rivers of waters run down my eyes, because they keep not your law. צ TZADDI.
verses.text: Rivers of waters run down my eyes, because they keep not your law. צ TZADDI.

verses.raw: Righteous are you, O Yahuah (LORD), and upright are your judgments.
verses.text: Righteous are you, O Yahuah, and upright are your judgments.

verses.raw: Your testimonies that you have commanded are righteous and very faithful.
verses.text: Your testimonies that you have commanded are righteous and very faithful.

verses.raw: My zeal has consumed me, because my enemies have forgotten your words.
verses.text: My zeal has consumed me, because my enemies have forgotten your words.

verses.raw: Your word is very pure: therefore your servant loves it.
verses.text: Your word is very pure: therefore your servant loves it.

verses.raw: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget your precepts.
verses.text: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget your precepts.

verses.raw: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is the truth.
verses.text: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is the truth.

verses.raw: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet your commandments are my delights.
verses.text: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet your commandments are my delights.

verses.raw: The righteousness of your testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live. ק KOPH.
verses.text: The righteousness of your testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live. ק KOPH.

verses.raw: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Yahuah (LORD): I will keep your statutes.
verses.text: I cried with my whole heart; hear me, O Yahuah: I will keep your statutes.

verses.raw: I cried unto you; save me, and I shall keep your testimonies.
verses.text: I cried unto you; save me, and I shall keep your testimonies.

verses.raw: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in your word.
verses.text: I prevented the dawning of the morning, and cried: I hoped in your word.

verses.raw: My eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in your word.
verses.text: My eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in your word.

verses.raw: Hear my voice according unto your lovingkindness: O Yahuah (LORD), quicken me according to your judgment.
verses.text: Hear my voice according unto your lovingkindness: O Yahuah, quicken me according to your judgment.

verses.raw: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from your law.
verses.text: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from your law.

verses.raw: You are near, O Yahuah (LORD); and all your commandments are truth.
verses.text: You are near, O Yahuah; and all your commandments are truth.

verses.raw: Concerning your testimonies, I have known of old that you have founded them for ever. ר RESH.
verses.text: Concerning your testimonies, I have known of old that you have founded them for ever. ר RESH.

verses.raw: Consider my affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget your law.
verses.text: Consider my affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget your law.

verses.raw: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to your word.
verses.text: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to your word.

verses.raw: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not your statutes.
verses.text: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not your statutes.

verses.raw: Great are your tender mercies, O Yahuah (LORD): quicken me according to your judgments.
verses.text: Great are your tender mercies, O Yahuah: quicken me according to your judgments.

verses.raw: Many are my persecutors and my enemies; yet do I not decline from your testimonies.
verses.text: Many are my persecutors and my enemies; yet do I not decline from your testimonies.

verses.raw: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not your word.
verses.text: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not your word.

verses.raw: Consider how I love your precepts: quicken me, O Yahuah (LORD), according to your lovingkindness.
verses.text: Consider how I love your precepts: quicken me, O Yahuah, according to your lovingkindness.

verses.raw: Your word is true from the beginning: and every one of your righteous judgments endures for ever. ש SCHIN.
verses.text: Your word is true from the beginning: and every one of your righteous judgments endures for ever. ש SCHIN.

verses.raw: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart stands in awe of your word.
verses.text: Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart stands in awe of your word.

verses.raw: I rejoice at your word, as one that finds great spoil.
verses.text: I rejoice at your word, as one that finds great spoil.

verses.raw: I hate and abhor lying: but your law do I love.
verses.text: I hate and abhor lying: but your law do I love.

verses.raw: Seven times a day do I praise you because of your righteous judgments.
verses.text: Seven times a day do I praise you because of your righteous judgments.

verses.raw: Great peace have they which love your law: and nothing shall offend them.
verses.text: Great peace have they which love your law: and nothing shall offend them.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), I have hoped for your salvation, and done your commandments.
verses.text: Yahuah, I have hoped for your salvation, and done your commandments.

verses.raw: My soul has kept your testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.
verses.text: My soul has kept your testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

verses.raw: I have kept your precepts and your testimonies: for all my ways are before you. ת TAU.
verses.text: I have kept your precepts and your testimonies: for all my ways are before you. ת TAU.

verses.raw: Let my cry come near before you, O Yahuah (LORD): give me understanding according to your word.
verses.text: Let my cry come near before you, O Yahuah: give me understanding according to your word.

verses.raw: Let my supplication come before you: deliver me according to your word.
verses.text: Let my supplication come before you: deliver me according to your word.

verses.raw: My lips shall utter praise, when you have taught me your statutes.
verses.text: My lips shall utter praise, when you have taught me your statutes.

verses.raw: My tongue shall speak of your word: for all your commandments are righteousness.
verses.text: My tongue shall speak of your word: for all your commandments are righteousness.

verses.raw: Let your hand help me; for I have chosen your precepts.
verses.text: Let your hand help me; for I have chosen your precepts.

verses.raw: I have longed for your salvation, O Yahuah (LORD); and your law is my delight.
verses.text: I have longed for your salvation, O Yahuah; and your law is my delight.

verses.raw: Let my soul live, and it shall praise you; and let your judgments help me.
verses.text: Let my soul live, and it shall praise you; and let your judgments help me.

verses.raw: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek your servant; for I do not forget your commandments.
verses.text: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek your servant; for I do not forget your commandments.

verses.raw: In my distress I cried unto Yahuah (LORD), and he heard me.
verses.text: In my distress I cried unto Yahuah, and he heard me.

verses.raw: Deliver my soul, O Yahuah (LORD), from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.
verses.text: Deliver my soul, O Yahuah, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

verses.raw: What shall be given unto you? or what shall be done unto you, you false tongue?
verses.text: What shall be given unto you? or what shall be done unto you, you false tongue?

verses.raw: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.
verses.text: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

verses.raw: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
verses.text: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

verses.raw: My soul has long dwelt with him that hates peace.
verses.text: My soul has long dwelt with him that hates peace.

verses.raw: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.
verses.text: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

verses.raw: I will lift up my eyes unto the hills, from whence comes my help.
verses.text: I will lift up my eyes unto the hills, from whence comes my help.

verses.raw: My help comes from Yahuah (LORD), which made heaven and earth.
verses.text: My help comes from Yahuah, which made heaven and earth.

verses.raw: He will not suffer your foot to be moved: he that keeps you will not slumber.
verses.text: He will not suffer your foot to be moved: he that keeps you will not slumber.

verses.raw: Behold, he that keeps Yashar'el (Israel) shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.text: Behold, he that keeps Yashar'el shall neither slumber nor sleep.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is your keeper: Yahuah (LORD) is your shade upon your right hand.
verses.text: Yahuah is your keeper: Yahuah is your shade upon your right hand.

verses.raw: The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.text: The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall preserve you from all evil: he shall preserve your soul.
verses.text: Yahuah shall preserve you from all evil: he shall preserve your soul.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall preserve your going out and your coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.text: Yahuah shall preserve your going out and your coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

verses.raw: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Our feet shall stand within your gates, O Jerusalem.
verses.text: Our feet shall stand within your gates, O Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:
verses.text: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

verses.raw: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of Yahuah (LORD), unto the testimony of Yashar'el (Israel), to give thanks unto the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of Yahuah, unto the testimony of Yashar'el, to give thanks unto the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
verses.text: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

verses.raw: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love you.
verses.text: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love you.

verses.raw: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.text: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

verses.raw: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within you.
verses.text: For my brethren and companions’ sakes, I will now say, Peace be within you.

verses.raw: Because of the house of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) I will seek your good.
verses.text: Because of the house of Yahuah Eloheinu I will seek your good.

verses.raw: Unto you lift I up my eyes, O you that dwell in the heavens.
verses.text: Unto you lift I up my eyes, O you that dwell in the heavens.

verses.raw: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), until that he have mercy upon us.
verses.text: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon Yahuah Eloheinu, until that he have mercy upon us.

verses.raw: Have mercy upon us, O Yahuah (LORD), have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.
verses.text: Have mercy upon us, O Yahuah, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

verses.raw: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.
verses.text: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

verses.raw: If it had not been Yahuah (LORD) who was on our side, now may Yashar'el (Israel) say;
verses.text: If it had not been Yahuah who was on our side, now may Yashar'el say;

verses.raw: If it had not been Yahuah (LORD) who was on our side, when men rose up against us:
verses.text: If it had not been Yahuah who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

verses.raw: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:
verses.text: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

verses.raw: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:
verses.text: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

verses.raw: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.
verses.text: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD), who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

verses.raw: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.
verses.text: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

verses.raw: Our help is in the name of Yahuah (LORD), who made heaven and earth.
verses.text: Our help is in the name of Yahuah, who made heaven and earth.

verses.raw: They that trust in Yahuah (LORD) shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abides for ever.
verses.text: They that trust in Yahuah shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abides for ever.

verses.raw: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so Yahuah (LORD) is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.
verses.text: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so Yahuah is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

verses.raw: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.
verses.text: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

verses.raw: Do good, O Yahuah (LORD), unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
verses.text: Do good, O Yahuah, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

verses.raw: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Yahuah (LORD) shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: As for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Yahuah shall lead them forth with the workers of iniquity: but peace shall be upon Yashar'el.

verses.raw: When Yahuah (LORD) turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.text: When Yahuah turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

verses.raw: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, Yahuah (LORD) has done great things for them.
verses.text: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, Yahuah has done great things for them.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.text: Yahuah has done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

verses.raw: Turn again our captivity, O Yahuah (LORD), as the streams in the south.
verses.text: Turn again our captivity, O Yahuah, as the streams in the south.

verses.raw: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.text: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

verses.raw: He that goes forth and weeps, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.text: He that goes forth and weeps, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

verses.raw: Except Yahuah (LORD) build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except Yahuah (LORD) keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.
verses.text: Except Yahuah build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except Yahuah keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

verses.raw: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he gives his beloved sleep.
verses.text: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he gives his beloved sleep.

verses.raw: Lo, children are an heritage of Yahuah (LORD): and the fruit of the womb is his reward.
verses.text: Lo, children are an heritage of Yahuah: and the fruit of the womb is his reward.

verses.raw: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.
verses.text: As arrows are in the hand of a mighty man; so are children of the youth.

verses.raw: Happy is the man that has his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.
verses.text: Happy is the man that has his quiver full of them: they shall not be ashamed, but they shall speak with the enemies in the gate.

verses.raw: Blessed is every one that fears Yahuah (LORD); that walks in his ways.
verses.text: Blessed is every one that fears Yahuah; that walks in his ways.

verses.raw: For you shall eat the labour of your hands: happy shall you be, and it shall be well with you.
verses.text: For you shall eat the labour of your hands: happy shall you be, and it shall be well with you.

verses.raw: Your wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of your house: your children like olive plants round about your table.
verses.text: Your wife shall be as a fruitful vine by the sides of your house: your children like olive plants round about your table.

verses.raw: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that fears Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Behold, that thus shall the man be blessed that fears Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall bless you out of Zion: and you shall see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.text: Yahuah shall bless you out of Zion: and you shall see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

verses.raw: Yea, you shall see your children’s children, and peace upon Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yea, you shall see your children’s children, and peace upon Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Yashar'el (Israel) now say:
verses.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Yashar'el now say:

verses.raw: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.
verses.text: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

verses.raw: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.
verses.text: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is righteous: he has cut asunder the cords of the wicked.
verses.text: Yahuah is righteous: he has cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

verses.raw: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.
verses.text: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

verses.raw: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it grows up:
verses.text: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it grows up:

verses.raw: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that binds sheaves his bosom.
verses.text: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that binds sheaves his bosom.

verses.raw: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of Yahuah (LORD) be upon you: we bless you in the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of Yahuah be upon you: we bless you in the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Out of the depths have I cried unto you, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Out of the depths have I cried unto you, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Adonai (Lord), hear my voice: let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
verses.text: Adonai, hear my voice: let your ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

verses.raw: If you, Yahuah (LORD), should mark iniquities, O Adonai (Lord), who shall stand?
verses.text: If you, Yahuah, should mark iniquities, O Adonai, who shall stand?

verses.raw: But there is forgiveness with you, that you may be feared.
verses.text: But there is forgiveness with you, that you may be feared.

verses.raw: I wait for Yahuah (LORD), my soul does wait, and in his word do I hope.
verses.text: I wait for Yahuah, my soul does wait, and in his word do I hope.

verses.raw: My soul waits for Adonai (Lord) more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.
verses.text: My soul waits for Adonai more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

verses.raw: Let Yashar'el (Israel) hope in Yahuah (LORD): for with Yahuah (LORD) there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
verses.text: Let Yashar'el hope in Yahuah: for with Yahuah there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

verses.raw: And he shall redeem Yashar'el (Israel) from all his iniquities.
verses.text: And he shall redeem Yashar'el from all his iniquities.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
verses.text: Yahuah, my heart is not haughty, nor my eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

verses.raw: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.
verses.text: Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is even as a weaned child.

verses.raw: Let Yashar'el (Israel) hope in Yahuah (LORD) from henceforth and for ever.
verses.text: Let Yashar'el hope in Yahuah from henceforth and for ever.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), remember David, and all his afflictions:
verses.text: Yahuah, remember David, and all his afflictions:

verses.raw: How he sware unto Yahuah (LORD), and vowed unto El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob;
verses.text: How he sware unto Yahuah, and vowed unto El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob;

verses.raw: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;
verses.text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

verses.raw: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,
verses.text: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

verses.raw: Until I find out a place for Yahuah (LORD), an habitation for El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob.
verses.text: Until I find out a place for Yahuah, an habitation for El Gibbor (the mighty God) of Jacob.

verses.raw: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
