verses.text: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

verses.raw: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
verses.text: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

verses.raw: Arise, O Yahuah (LORD), into your rest; you, and the ark of your strength.
verses.text: Arise, O Yahuah, into your rest; you, and the ark of your strength.

verses.raw: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; and let your saints shout for joy.
verses.text: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; and let your saints shout for joy.

verses.raw: For your servant David’s sake turn not away the face of your anointed.
verses.text: For your servant David’s sake turn not away the face of your anointed.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of your body will I set upon your throne.
verses.text: Yahuah has sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it; Of the fruit of your body will I set upon your throne.

verses.raw: If your children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon your throne for evermore.
verses.text: If your children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon your throne for evermore.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his habitation.
verses.text: For Yahuah has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his habitation.

verses.raw: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.
verses.text: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

verses.raw: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.
verses.text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

verses.raw: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.
verses.text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

verses.raw: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.
verses.text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

verses.raw: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
verses.text: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

verses.raw: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
verses.text: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

verses.raw: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;
verses.text: It is like the precious ointment upon the head, that ran down upon the beard, even Aaron’s beard: that went down to the skirts of his garments;

verses.raw: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there Yahuah (LORD) commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.
verses.text: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there Yahuah commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

verses.raw: Behold, bless you Yahuah (LORD), all you servants of Yahuah (LORD), which by night stand in the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Behold, bless you Yahuah, all you servants of Yahuah, which by night stand in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) that made heaven and earth bless you out of Zion.
verses.text: Yahuah that made heaven and earth bless you out of Zion.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise you the name of Yahuah (LORD); praise him, O you servants of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. Praise you the name of Yahuah; praise him, O you servants of Yahuah.

verses.raw: You that stand in the house of Yahuah (LORD), in the courts of the house of our Elohim (God),
verses.text: You that stand in the house of Yahuah, in the courts of the house of our Elohim,

verses.raw: Praise Yahuah (LORD); for Yahuah (LORD) is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.
verses.text: Praise Yahuah; for Yahuah is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) has chosen Jacob unto himself, and Yashar'el (Israel) for his peculiar treasure.
verses.text: For Yahuah has chosen Jacob unto himself, and Yashar'el for his peculiar treasure.

verses.raw: For I know that Yahuah (LORD) is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.
verses.text: For I know that Yahuah is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

verses.raw: Whatsoever Yahuah (LORD) pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.
verses.text: Whatsoever Yahuah pleased, that did he in heaven, and in earth, in the seas, and all deep places.

verses.raw: He causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain; he brings the wind out of his treasuries.
verses.text: He causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings for the rain; he brings the wind out of his treasuries.

verses.raw: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.
verses.text: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

verses.raw: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.
verses.text: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of you, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

verses.raw: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;
verses.text: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

verses.raw: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

verses.raw: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Yashar'el (Israel) his people.
verses.text: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Yashar'el his people.

verses.raw: Your name, O Yahuah (LORD), endures for ever; and your memorial, O Yahuah (LORD), throughout all generations.
verses.text: Your name, O Yahuah, endures for ever; and your memorial, O Yahuah, throughout all generations.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.
verses.text: For Yahuah will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

verses.raw: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.
verses.text: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

verses.raw: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;
verses.text: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

verses.raw: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.
verses.text: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

verses.raw: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusts in them.
verses.text: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusts in them.

verses.raw: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O house of Yashar'el (Israel): bless Yahuah (LORD), O house of Aaron:
verses.text: Bless Yahuah, O house of Yashar'el: bless Yahuah, O house of Aaron:

verses.raw: Bless Yahuah (LORD), O house of Levi: you that fear Yahuah (LORD), bless Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Bless Yahuah, O house of Levi: you that fear Yahuah, bless Yahuah.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) out of Zion, which dwells at Jerusalem. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah out of Zion, which dwells at Jerusalem. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: O give thanks unto Yahuah (LORD); for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks unto Yahuah; for he is good: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: O give thanks unto the Elohim (God) of gods: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks unto the Elohim of gods: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: O give thanks to Adonai (Lord) of lords: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks to Adonai of lords: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: To him who alone does great wonders: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: To him who alone does great wonders: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: To him that by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: And brought out Yashar'el (Israel) from among them: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: And brought out Yashar'el from among them: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: And made Yashar'el (Israel) to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: And made Yashar'el to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: Even an heritage unto Yashar'el (Israel) his servant: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Even an heritage unto Yashar'el his servant: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endures for ever:
verses.text: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endures for ever:

verses.raw: And has redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: And has redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: Who gives food to all flesh: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: Who gives food to all flesh: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: O give thanks unto the Elohim (God) of heaven: for his mercy endures for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks unto the Elohim of heaven: for his mercy endures for ever.

verses.raw: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.text: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

verses.raw: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.text: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

verses.raw: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.text: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

verses.raw: How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?
verses.text: How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?

verses.raw: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.text: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

verses.raw: If I do not remember you, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.text: If I do not remember you, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

verses.raw: Remember, O Yahuah (LORD), the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.text: Remember, O Yahuah, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

verses.raw: O daughter of Babylon, who are to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth you as you have served us.
verses.text: O daughter of Babylon, who are to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth you as you have served us.

verses.raw: Happy shall he be, that takes and dasheth your little ones against the stones.
verses.text: Happy shall he be, that takes and dasheth your little ones against the stones.

verses.raw: I will praise you with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto you.
verses.text: I will praise you with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto you.

verses.raw: I will worship toward your holy temple, and praise your name for your lovingkindness and for your truth: for you have magnified your word above all your name.
verses.text: I will worship toward your holy temple, and praise your name for your lovingkindness and for your truth: for you have magnified your word above all your name.

verses.raw: In the day when I cried you answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.
verses.text: In the day when I cried you answeredst me, and strengthenedst me with strength in my soul.

verses.raw: All the kings of the earth shall praise you, O Yahuah (LORD), when they hear the words of your mouth.
verses.text: All the kings of the earth shall praise you, O Yahuah, when they hear the words of your mouth.

verses.raw: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of Yahuah (LORD): for great is the glory of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Yea, they shall sing in the ways of Yahuah: for great is the glory of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Though Yahuah (LORD) be high, yet has he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knows afar off.
verses.text: Though Yahuah be high, yet has he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knows afar off.

verses.raw: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me: you shall stretch forth your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and your right hand shall save me.
verses.text: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me: you shall stretch forth your hand against the wrath of my enemies, and your right hand shall save me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will perfect that which concerneth me: your mercy, O Yahuah (LORD), endures for ever: forsake not the works of your own hands.
verses.text: Yahuah will perfect that which concerneth me: your mercy, O Yahuah, endures for ever: forsake not the works of your own hands.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), you have searched me, and known me.
verses.text: O Yahuah, you have searched me, and known me.

verses.raw: You know my downsitting and my uprising, you understand my thought afar off.
verses.text: You know my downsitting and my uprising, you understand my thought afar off.

verses.raw: You compassest my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.
verses.text: You compassest my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

verses.raw: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Yahuah (LORD), you know it altogether.
verses.text: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Yahuah, you know it altogether.

verses.raw: You have beset me behind and before, and laid your hand upon me.
verses.text: You have beset me behind and before, and laid your hand upon me.

verses.raw: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.
verses.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

verses.raw: Whither shall I go from your spirit? or whither shall I flee from your presence?
verses.text: Whither shall I go from your spirit? or whither shall I flee from your presence?

verses.raw: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, you are there.
verses.text: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, you are there.

verses.raw: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;
verses.text: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

verses.raw: Even there shall your hand lead me, and your right hand shall hold me.
verses.text: Even there shall your hand lead me, and your right hand shall hold me.

verses.raw: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.
verses.text: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

verses.raw: Yea, the darkness hides not from you; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to you.
verses.text: Yea, the darkness hides not from you; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to you.

verses.raw: For you have possessed my reins: you have covered me in my mother’s womb.
verses.text: For you have possessed my reins: you have covered me in my mother’s womb.

verses.raw: I will praise you; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are your works; and that my soul knows right well.
verses.text: I will praise you; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are your works; and that my soul knows right well.

verses.raw: My substance was not hid from you, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.text: My substance was not hid from you, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.raw: Your eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in your book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.
verses.text: Your eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in your book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

verses.raw: How precious also are your thoughts unto me, O Elohim (God)! how great is the sum of them!
verses.text: How precious also are your thoughts unto me, O Elohim! how great is the sum of them!

verses.raw: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with you.
verses.text: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with you.

verses.raw: Surely you will slay the wicked, O Elohim (God): depart from me therefore, you bloody men.
verses.text: Surely you will slay the wicked, O Elohim: depart from me therefore, you bloody men.

verses.raw: For they speak against you wickedly, and your enemies take your name in vain.
verses.text: For they speak against you wickedly, and your enemies take your name in vain.

verses.raw: Do not I hate them, O Yahuah (LORD), that hate you? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against you?
verses.text: Do not I hate them, O Yahuah, that hate you? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against you?

verses.raw: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them my enemies.
verses.text: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them my enemies.

verses.raw: Search me, O Elohim (God), and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:
verses.text: Search me, O Elohim, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

verses.raw: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.
verses.text: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

verses.raw: Deliver me, O Yahuah (LORD), from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.text: Deliver me, O Yahuah, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

verses.raw: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.
verses.text: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

verses.raw: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.
verses.text: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.

verses.raw: Keep me, O Yahuah (LORD), from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.text: Keep me, O Yahuah, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

verses.raw: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

verses.raw: I said unto Yahuah (LORD), You are my Elohim (God): hear the voice of my supplications, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I said unto Yahuah, You are my Elohim: hear the voice of my supplications, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: O GOD Adonai (Lord), the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.text: O GOD Adonai, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.raw: Grant not, O Yahuah (LORD), the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.text: Grant not, O Yahuah, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

verses.raw: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.text: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.raw: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.text: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

verses.raw: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
verses.text: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

verses.raw: I know that Yahuah (LORD) will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.
verses.text: I know that Yahuah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

verses.raw: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto your name: the upright shall dwell in your presence.
verses.text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto your name: the upright shall dwell in your presence.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), I cry unto you: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto you.
verses.text: Yahuah, I cry unto you: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto you.

verses.raw: Let my prayer be set forth before you as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
verses.text: Let my prayer be set forth before you as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

verses.raw: Set a watch, O Yahuah (LORD), before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
verses.text: Set a watch, O Yahuah, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

verses.raw: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.
verses.text: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

verses.raw: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.
verses.text: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

verses.raw: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.
verses.text: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

verses.raw: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaves wood upon the earth.
verses.text: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaves wood upon the earth.

verses.raw: But my eyes are unto you, O GOD Adonai (Lord): in you is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.
verses.text: But my eyes are unto you, O GOD Adonai: in you is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

verses.raw: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.
verses.text: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

verses.raw: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.
verses.text: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

verses.raw: I cried unto Yahuah (LORD) with my voice; with my voice unto Yahuah (LORD) did I make my supplication.
verses.text: I cried unto Yahuah with my voice; with my voice unto Yahuah did I make my supplication.

verses.raw: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.
verses.text: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

verses.raw: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then you knew my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.
verses.text: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then you knew my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

verses.raw: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.
verses.text: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

verses.raw: I cried unto you, O Yahuah (LORD): I said, You are my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.
verses.text: I cried unto you, O Yahuah: I said, You are my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

verses.raw: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.
verses.text: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

verses.raw: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise your name: the righteous shall compass me about; for you shall deal bountifully with me.
verses.text: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise your name: the righteous shall compass me about; for you shall deal bountifully with me.

verses.raw: Hear my prayer, O Yahuah (LORD), give ear to my supplications: in your faithfulness answer me, and in your righteousness.
verses.text: Hear my prayer, O Yahuah, give ear to my supplications: in your faithfulness answer me, and in your righteousness.

verses.raw: And enter not into judgment with your servant: for in your sight shall no man living be justified.
verses.text: And enter not into judgment with your servant: for in your sight shall no man living be justified.

verses.raw: For the enemy has persecuted my soul; he has smitten my life down to the ground; he has made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.
verses.text: For the enemy has persecuted my soul; he has smitten my life down to the ground; he has made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

verses.raw: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.
verses.text: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

verses.raw: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all your works; I muse on the work of your hands.
verses.text: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all your works; I muse on the work of your hands.

verses.raw: I stretch forth my hands unto you: my soul thirsteth after you, as a thirsty land. Selah.
verses.text: I stretch forth my hands unto you: my soul thirsteth after you, as a thirsty land. Selah.

verses.raw: Hear me speedily, O Yahuah (LORD): my spirit fails: hide not your face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.
verses.text: Hear me speedily, O Yahuah: my spirit fails: hide not your face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

verses.raw: Cause me to hear your lovingkindness in the morning; for in you do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto you.
verses.text: Cause me to hear your lovingkindness in the morning; for in you do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto you.

verses.raw: Deliver me, O Yahuah (LORD), from my enemies: I flee unto you to hide me.
verses.text: Deliver me, O Yahuah, from my enemies: I flee unto you to hide me.

verses.raw: Teach me to do your will; for you are my Elohim (God): your spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.
verses.text: Teach me to do your will; for you are my Elohim: your spirit is good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

verses.raw: Quicken me, O Yahuah (LORD), for your name’s sake: for your righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.
verses.text: Quicken me, O Yahuah, for your name’s sake: for your righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.

verses.raw: And of your mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am your servant.
verses.text: And of your mercy cut off my enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am your servant.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah (LORD) my strength, which teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah my strength, which teaches my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

verses.raw: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.
verses.text: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD), what is man, that you take knowledge of him! or the son of Adam, that you make account of him!
verses.text: Yahuah, what is man, that you take knowledge of him! or the son of Adam, that you make account of him!

verses.raw: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passes away.
verses.text: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passes away.

verses.raw: Bow your heavens, O Yahuah (LORD), and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.
verses.text: Bow your heavens, O Yahuah, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.raw: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out your arrows, and destroy them.
verses.text: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out your arrows, and destroy them.

verses.raw: Send your hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;
verses.text: Send your hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

verses.raw: Whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.
verses.text: Whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

verses.raw: I will sing a new song unto you, O Elohim (God): upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto you.
verses.text: I will sing a new song unto you, O Elohim: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto you.

verses.raw: It is he that gives salvation unto kings: who delivers David his servant from the hurtful sword.
verses.text: It is he that gives salvation unto kings: who delivers David his servant from the hurtful sword.

verses.raw: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:
verses.text: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaks vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

verses.raw: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:
verses.text: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

verses.raw: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:
verses.text: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

verses.raw: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.
verses.text: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

verses.raw: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose Elohim (God) is Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose Elohim is Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will extol you, my Elohim (God), O king; and I will bless your name for ever and ever.
verses.text: I will extol you, my Elohim, O king; and I will bless your name for ever and ever.

verses.raw: Every day will I bless you; and I will praise your name for ever and ever.
verses.text: Every day will I bless you; and I will praise your name for ever and ever.

verses.raw: Great is Yahuah (LORD), and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
verses.text: Great is Yahuah, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

verses.raw: One generation shall praise your works to another, and shall declare your mighty acts.
verses.text: One generation shall praise your works to another, and shall declare your mighty acts.

verses.raw: I will speak of the glorious honour of your majesty, and of your wondrous works.
verses.text: I will speak of the glorious honour of your majesty, and of your wondrous works.

verses.raw: And men shall speak of the might of your terrible acts: and I will declare your greatness.
verses.text: And men shall speak of the might of your terrible acts: and I will declare your greatness.

verses.raw: They shall abundantly utter the memory of your great goodness, and shall sing of your righteousness.
verses.text: They shall abundantly utter the memory of your great goodness, and shall sing of your righteousness.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
verses.text: Yahuah is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
verses.text: Yahuah is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.raw: All your works shall praise you, O Yahuah (LORD); and your saints shall bless you.
verses.text: All your works shall praise you, O Yahuah; and your saints shall bless you.

verses.raw: They shall speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk of your power;
verses.text: They shall speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk of your power;

verses.raw: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.
verses.text: To make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of his kingdom.

verses.raw: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures throughout all generations.
verses.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures throughout all generations.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.
verses.text: Yahuah upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

verses.raw: The eyes of all wait upon you; and you give them their meat in due season.
verses.text: The eyes of all wait upon you; and you give them their meat in due season.

verses.raw: You openest your hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.
verses.text: You openest your hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.
verses.text: Yahuah is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
verses.text: Yahuah is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.

verses.raw: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.
verses.text: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) preserves all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.
verses.text: Yahuah preserves all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

verses.raw: My mouth shall speak the praise of Yahuah (LORD): and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.
verses.text: My mouth shall speak the praise of Yahuah: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise Yahuah (LORD), O my soul.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. Praise Yahuah, O my soul.

verses.raw: While I live will I praise Yahuah (LORD): I will sing praises unto my Elohim (God) while I have any being.
verses.text: While I live will I praise Yahuah: I will sing praises unto my Elohim while I have any being.

verses.raw: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of Adam, in whom there is no help.
verses.text: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of Adam, in whom there is no help.

verses.raw: His breath goes forth, he returns to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
verses.text: His breath goes forth, he returns to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

verses.raw: Happy is he that has the Elohim (God) of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahuah Elohav (the LORD his God):
verses.text: Happy is he that has the Elohim of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in Yahuah Elohav:

verses.raw: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keeps truth for ever:
verses.text: Which made heaven, and earth, the sea, and all that therein is: which keeps truth for ever:

verses.raw: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which gives food to the hungry. Yahuah (LORD) looseth the prisoners:
verses.text: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which gives food to the hungry. Yahuah looseth the prisoners:

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) opens the eyes of the blind: Yahuah (LORD) raiseth them that are bowed down: Yahuah (LORD) loves the righteous:
verses.text: Yahuah opens the eyes of the blind: Yahuah raiseth them that are bowed down: Yahuah loves the righteous:

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) preserves the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turns upside down.
verses.text: Yahuah preserves the strangers; he relieveth the fatherless and widow: but the way of the wicked he turns upside down.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shall reign for ever, even your Elohim (God), O Zion, unto all generations. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Yahuah shall reign for ever, even your Elohim, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD): for it is good to sing praises unto our Elohim (God); for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah: for it is good to sing praises unto our Elohim; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) does build up Jerusalem: he gathers together the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yahuah does build up Jerusalem: he gathers together the outcasts of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: He healeth the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.
verses.text: He healeth the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

verses.raw: He telleth the number of the stars; he calls them all by their names.
verses.text: He telleth the number of the stars; he calls them all by their names.

verses.raw: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.
verses.text: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) lifts up the meek: he casts the wicked down to the ground.
verses.text: Yahuah lifts up the meek: he casts the wicked down to the ground.

verses.raw: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD) with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our Elohim (God):
verses.text: Sing unto Yahuah with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our Elohim:

verses.raw: Who covers the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow upon the mountains.
verses.text: Who covers the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow upon the mountains.

verses.raw: He gives to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.
verses.text: He gives to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

verses.raw: He delights not in the strength of the horse: he takes not pleasure in the legs of a man.
verses.text: He delights not in the strength of the horse: he takes not pleasure in the legs of a man.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) takes pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.
verses.text: Yahuah takes pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

verses.raw: Praise Yahuah (LORD), O Jerusalem; praise your Elohim (God), O Zion.
verses.text: Praise Yahuah, O Jerusalem; praise your Elohim, O Zion.

verses.raw: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates; he has blessed your children within you.
verses.text: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates; he has blessed your children within you.

verses.raw: He makes peace in your borders, and filleth you with the finest of the wheat.
verses.text: He makes peace in your borders, and filleth you with the finest of the wheat.

verses.raw: He sends forth his commandment upon earth: his word runs very swiftly.
verses.text: He sends forth his commandment upon earth: his word runs very swiftly.

verses.raw: He gives snow like wool: he scatters the hoarfrost like ashes.
verses.text: He gives snow like wool: he scatters the hoarfrost like ashes.

verses.raw: He casts forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?
verses.text: He casts forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

verses.raw: He sends out his word, and melteth them: he causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.
verses.text: He sends out his word, and melteth them: he causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

verses.raw: He shows his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: He shows his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Yashar'el.

verses.raw: He has not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He has not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise you Yahuah (LORD) from the heavens: praise him in the heights.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. Praise you Yahuah from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

verses.raw: Praise you him, all his angels: praise you him, all his hosts.
verses.text: Praise you him, all his angels: praise you him, all his hosts.

verses.raw: Praise you him, sun and moon: praise him, all you stars of light.
verses.text: Praise you him, sun and moon: praise him, all you stars of light.

verses.raw: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, and you waters that be above the heavens.
verses.text: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, and you waters that be above the heavens.

verses.raw: Let them praise the name of Yahuah (LORD): for he commanded, and they were created.
verses.text: Let them praise the name of Yahuah: for he commanded, and they were created.

verses.raw: He has also stablished them for ever and ever: he has made a decree which shall not pass.
verses.text: He has also stablished them for ever and ever: he has made a decree which shall not pass.

verses.raw: Praise Yahuah (LORD) from the earth, you dragons, and all deeps:
verses.text: Praise Yahuah from the earth, you dragons, and all deeps:

verses.raw: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:
verses.text: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

verses.raw: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:
verses.text: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

verses.raw: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:
verses.text: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

verses.raw: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:
verses.text: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

verses.raw: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:
verses.text: Both young men, and maidens; old men, and children:

verses.raw: Let them praise the name of Yahuah (LORD): for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.
verses.text: Let them praise the name of Yahuah: for his name alone is excellent; his glory is above the earth and heaven.

verses.raw: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), a people near unto him. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Yashar'el, a people near unto him. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Sing unto Yahuah (LORD) a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. Sing unto Yahuah a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

verses.raw: Let Yashar'el (Israel) rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.text: Let Yashar'el rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

verses.raw: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.text: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) takes pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.text: For Yahuah takes pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

verses.raw: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.text: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

verses.raw: Let the high praises of Elohim (God) be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
verses.text: Let the high praises of Elohim be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

verses.raw: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.text: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

verses.raw: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.text: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

verses.raw: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: Praise you Yahuah (LORD). Praise Elohim (God) in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.
verses.text: Praise you Yahuah. Praise Elohim in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

verses.raw: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.
verses.text: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

verses.raw: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
verses.text: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

verses.raw: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.
verses.text: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

verses.raw: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.
verses.text: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

verses.raw: Let every thing that has breath praise Yahuah (LORD). Praise you Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Let every thing that has breath praise Yahuah. Praise you Yahuah.

verses.raw: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Yashar'el;

verses.raw: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;
verses.text: To know wisdom and instruction; to perceive the words of understanding;

verses.raw: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;
verses.text: To receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and equity;

verses.raw: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.
verses.text: To give subtilty to the simple, to the young man knowledge and discretion.

verses.raw: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:
verses.text: A wise man will hear, and will increase learning; and a man of understanding shall attain unto wise counsels:

verses.raw: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.
verses.text: To understand a proverb, and the interpretation; the words of the wise, and their dark sayings.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is the beginning of knowledge: but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

verses.raw: My son, hear the instruction of your father, and forsake not the law of your mother:
verses.text: My son, hear the instruction of your father, and forsake not the law of your mother:

verses.raw: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto your head, and chains about your neck.
verses.text: For they shall be an ornament of grace unto your head, and chains about your neck.

verses.raw: My son, if sinners entice you, consent you not.
verses.text: My son, if sinners entice you, consent you not.

verses.raw: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:
verses.text: If they say, Come with us, let us lay wait for blood, let us lurk privily for the innocent without cause:

verses.raw: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:
verses.text: Let us swallow them up alive as the grave; and whole, as those that go down into the pit:

verses.raw: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:
verses.text: We shall find all precious substance, we shall fill our houses with spoil:

verses.raw: Cast in your lot among us; let us all have one purse:
verses.text: Cast in your lot among us; let us all have one purse:

verses.raw: My son, walk not you in the way with them; refrain your foot from their path:
verses.text: My son, walk not you in the way with them; refrain your foot from their path:

verses.raw: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.
verses.text: For their feet run to evil, and make haste to shed blood.

verses.raw: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.
verses.text: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird.

verses.raw: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.
verses.text: And they lay wait for their own blood; they lurk privily for their own lives.

verses.raw: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which takes away the life of the owners thereof.
verses.text: So are the ways of every one that is greedy of gain; which takes away the life of the owners thereof.

verses.raw: Wisdom cries without; she utters her voice in the streets:
verses.text: Wisdom cries without; she utters her voice in the streets:

verses.raw: She cries in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she utters her words, saying,
verses.text: She cries in the chief place of concourse, in the openings of the gates: in the city she utters her words, saying,

verses.raw: How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?
verses.text: How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? and the scorners delight in their scorning, and fools hate knowledge?

verses.raw: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.
verses.text: Turn you at my reproof: behold, I will pour out my spirit unto you, I will make known my words unto you.

verses.raw: Because I have called, and you refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;
verses.text: Because I have called, and you refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no man regarded;

verses.raw: But you have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:
verses.text: But you have set at nought all my counsel, and would none of my reproof:

verses.raw: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear comes;
verses.text: I also will laugh at your calamity; I will mock when your fear comes;

verses.raw: When your fear comes as desolation, and your destruction comes as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish comes upon you.
verses.text: When your fear comes as desolation, and your destruction comes as a whirlwind; when distress and anguish comes upon you.

verses.raw: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:
verses.text: Then shall they call upon me, but I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me:

verses.raw: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: For that they hated knowledge, and did not choose the fear of Yahuah:

verses.raw: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.
verses.text: They would none of my counsel: they despised all my reproof.

verses.raw: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.
verses.text: Therefore shall they eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own devices.

verses.raw: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.
verses.text: For the turning away of the simple shall slay them, and the prosperity of fools shall destroy them.

verses.raw: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
verses.text: But whoso hearkeneth unto me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.

verses.raw: My son, if you will receive my words, and hide my commandments with you;
verses.text: My son, if you will receive my words, and hide my commandments with you;

verses.raw: So that you incline your ear unto wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;
verses.text: So that you incline your ear unto wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

verses.raw: Yea, if you cry after knowledge, and liftest up your voice for understanding;
verses.text: Yea, if you cry after knowledge, and liftest up your voice for understanding;

verses.raw: If you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hid treasures;
verses.text: If you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hid treasures;

verses.raw: Then shall you understand the fear of Yahuah (LORD), and find the knowledge of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then shall you understand the fear of Yahuah, and find the knowledge of Elohim.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) gives wisdom: out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.
verses.text: For Yahuah gives wisdom: out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

verses.raw: He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.
verses.text: He lays up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

verses.raw: He keeps the paths of judgment, and preserves the way of his saints.
verses.text: He keeps the paths of judgment, and preserves the way of his saints.

verses.raw: Then shall you understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.
verses.text: Then shall you understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.

verses.raw: When wisdom enters into your heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto your soul;
verses.text: When wisdom enters into your heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto your soul;

verses.raw: Discretion shall preserve you, understanding shall keep you:
verses.text: Discretion shall preserve you, understanding shall keep you:

verses.raw: To deliver you from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaks froward things;
verses.text: To deliver you from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaks froward things;

verses.raw: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;
verses.text: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

verses.raw: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;
verses.text: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

verses.raw: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:
verses.text: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

verses.raw: To deliver you from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;
verses.text: To deliver you from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

verses.raw: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her Elohim (God).
verses.text: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her Elohim.

verses.raw: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.
verses.text: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

verses.raw: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.
verses.text: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

verses.raw: That you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.
verses.text: That you may walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

verses.raw: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.
verses.text: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

verses.raw: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
verses.text: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.

verses.raw: My son, forget not my law; but let your heart keep my commandments:
verses.text: My son, forget not my law; but let your heart keep my commandments:

verses.raw: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to you.
verses.text: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to you.

verses.raw: Let not mercy and truth forsake you: bind them about your neck; write them upon the table of your heart:
verses.text: Let not mercy and truth forsake you: bind them about your neck; write them upon the table of your heart:

verses.raw: So shall you find favour and good understanding in the sight of Elohim (God) and man.
verses.text: So shall you find favour and good understanding in the sight of Elohim and man.

verses.raw: Trust in Yahuah (LORD) with all your heart; and lean not unto your own understanding.
verses.text: Trust in Yahuah with all your heart; and lean not unto your own understanding.

verses.raw: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct your paths.
verses.text: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct your paths.

verses.raw: Be not wise in your own eyes: fear Yahuah (LORD), and depart from evil.
verses.text: Be not wise in your own eyes: fear Yahuah, and depart from evil.

verses.raw: It shall be health to your navel, and marrow to your bones.
verses.text: It shall be health to your navel, and marrow to your bones.

verses.raw: Honour Yahuah (LORD) with your substance, and with the firstfruits of all your increase:
verses.text: Honour Yahuah with your substance, and with the firstfruits of all your increase:

verses.raw: So shall your barns be filled with plenty, and your presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.text: So shall your barns be filled with plenty, and your presses shall burst out with new wine.

verses.raw: My son, despise not the chastening of Yahuah (LORD); neither be weary of his correction:
verses.text: My son, despise not the chastening of Yahuah; neither be weary of his correction:

verses.raw: For whom Yahuah (LORD) loves he corrects; even as a father the son in whom he delights.
verses.text: For whom Yahuah loves he corrects; even as a father the son in whom he delights.

verses.raw: Happy is the man that finds wisdom, and the man that gets understanding.
verses.text: Happy is the man that finds wisdom, and the man that gets understanding.

verses.raw: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.text: For the merchandise of it is better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.

verses.raw: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things you can desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.text: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things you can desire are not to be compared unto her.

verses.raw: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.text: Length of days is in her right hand; and in her left hand riches and honour.

verses.raw: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.
verses.text: Her ways are ways of pleasantness, and all her paths are peace.

verses.raw: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.
verses.text: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) by wisdom has founded the earth; by understanding has he established the heavens.
verses.text: Yahuah by wisdom has founded the earth; by understanding has he established the heavens.

verses.raw: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.text: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.

verses.raw: My son, let not them depart from your eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.text: My son, let not them depart from your eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:

verses.raw: So shall they be life unto your soul, and grace to your neck.
verses.text: So shall they be life unto your soul, and grace to your neck.

verses.raw: Then shall you walk in your way safely, and your foot shall not stumble.
verses.text: Then shall you walk in your way safely, and your foot shall not stumble.

verses.raw: When you lie down, you shall not be afraid: yea, you shall lie down, and your sleep shall be sweet.
verses.text: When you lie down, you shall not be afraid: yea, you shall lie down, and your sleep shall be sweet.

verses.raw: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes.
verses.text: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) shall be your confidence, and shall keep your foot from being taken.
verses.text: For Yahuah shall be your confidence, and shall keep your foot from being taken.

verses.raw: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
verses.text: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

verses.raw: Say not unto your neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when you have it by you.
verses.text: Say not unto your neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when you have it by you.

verses.raw: Devise not evil against your neighbour, seeing he dwells securely by you.
verses.text: Devise not evil against your neighbour, seeing he dwells securely by you.

verses.raw: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done you no harm.
verses.text: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done you no harm.

verses.raw: Envy you not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.text: Envy you not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.

verses.raw: For the froward is abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but his secret is with the righteous.
verses.text: For the froward is abomination to Yahuah: but his secret is with the righteous.

verses.raw: The curse of Yahuah (LORD) is in the house of the wicked: but he blesses the habitation of the just.
verses.text: The curse of Yahuah is in the house of the wicked: but he blesses the habitation of the just.

verses.raw: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he gives grace unto the lowly.
verses.text: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he gives grace unto the lowly.

verses.raw: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.text: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.

verses.raw: Hear, you children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
verses.text: Hear, you children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.

verses.raw: For I give you good doctrine, forsake you not my law.
verses.text: For I give you good doctrine, forsake you not my law.

verses.raw: For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
verses.text: For I was my father’s son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.

verses.raw: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let your heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
verses.text: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let your heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.

verses.raw: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
verses.text: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.

verses.raw: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve you: love her, and she shall keep you.
verses.text: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve you: love her, and she shall keep you.

verses.raw: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all your getting get understanding.
verses.text: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all your getting get understanding.

verses.raw: Exalt her, and she shall promote you: she shall bring you to honour, when you do embrace her.
verses.text: Exalt her, and she shall promote you: she shall bring you to honour, when you do embrace her.

verses.raw: She shall give to your head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to you.
verses.text: She shall give to your head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to you.

verses.raw: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of your life shall be many.
verses.text: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of your life shall be many.

verses.raw: I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in right paths.
verses.text: I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in right paths.

verses.raw: When you go, your steps shall not be straitened; and when you runnest, you shall not stumble.
verses.text: When you go, your steps shall not be straitened; and when you runnest, you shall not stumble.

verses.raw: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is your life.
verses.text: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is your life.

verses.raw: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
verses.text: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.

verses.raw: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
verses.text: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.

verses.raw: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
verses.text: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.

verses.raw: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
verses.text: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.

verses.raw: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
verses.text: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.

verses.raw: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
verses.text: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.

verses.raw: My son, attend to my words; incline your ear unto my sayings.
verses.text: My son, attend to my words; incline your ear unto my sayings.

verses.raw: Let them not depart from your eyes; keep them in the midst of your heart.
verses.text: Let them not depart from your eyes; keep them in the midst of your heart.

verses.raw: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
verses.text: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.

verses.raw: Keep your heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
verses.text: Keep your heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.

verses.raw: Put away from you a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from you.
verses.text: Put away from you a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from you.

verses.raw: Let your eyes look right on, and let your eyelids look straight before you.
verses.text: Let your eyes look right on, and let your eyelids look straight before you.

verses.raw: Ponder the path of your feet, and let all your ways be established.
verses.text: Ponder the path of your feet, and let all your ways be established.

verses.raw: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove your foot from evil.
verses.text: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove your foot from evil.

verses.raw: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow your ear to my understanding:
verses.text: My son, attend unto my wisdom, and bow your ear to my understanding:

verses.raw: That you may regard discretion, and that your lips may keep knowledge.
verses.text: That you may regard discretion, and that your lips may keep knowledge.

verses.raw: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:
verses.text: For the lips of a strange woman drop as an honeycomb, and her mouth is smoother than oil:

verses.raw: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.
verses.text: But her end is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a twoedged sword.

verses.raw: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.
verses.text: Her feet go down to death; her steps take hold on hell.

verses.raw: Lest you should ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that you can not know them.
verses.text: Lest you should ponder the path of life, her ways are moveable, that you can not know them.

verses.raw: Hear me now therefore, O you children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.
verses.text: Hear me now therefore, O you children, and depart not from the words of my mouth.

verses.raw: Remove your way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:
verses.text: Remove your way far from her, and come not nigh the door of her house:

verses.raw: Lest you give your honour unto others, and your years unto the cruel:
verses.text: Lest you give your honour unto others, and your years unto the cruel:

verses.raw: Lest strangers be filled with your wealth; and your labours be in the house of a stranger;
verses.text: Lest strangers be filled with your wealth; and your labours be in the house of a stranger;

verses.raw: And you mourn at the last, when your flesh and your body are consumed,
verses.text: And you mourn at the last, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

verses.raw: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
verses.text: And say, How have I hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;

verses.raw: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined my ear to them that instructed me!
verses.text: And have not obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor inclined my ear to them that instructed me!

verses.raw: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.
verses.text: I was almost in all evil in the midst of the congregation and assembly.

verses.raw: Drink waters out of your own cistern, and running waters out of your own well.
verses.text: Drink waters out of your own cistern, and running waters out of your own well.

verses.raw: Let your fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.
verses.text: Let your fountains be dispersed abroad, and rivers of waters in the streets.

verses.raw: Let them be only your own, and not strangers’ with you.
verses.text: Let them be only your own, and not strangers’ with you.

verses.raw: Let your fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of your youth.
verses.text: Let your fountain be blessed: and rejoice with the wife of your youth.

verses.raw: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy you at all times; and be you ravished always with her love.
verses.text: Let her be as the loving hind and pleasant roe; let her breasts satisfy you at all times; and be you ravished always with her love.

verses.raw: And why will you, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?
verses.text: And why will you, my son, be ravished with a strange woman, and embrace the bosom of a stranger?

verses.raw: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Yahuah (LORD), and he pondereth all his goings.
verses.text: For the ways of man are before the eyes of Yahuah, and he pondereth all his goings.

verses.raw: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.
verses.text: His own iniquities shall take the wicked himself, and he shall be holden with the cords of his sins.

verses.raw: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.
verses.text: He shall die without instruction; and in the greatness of his folly he shall go astray.

verses.raw: My son, if you be surety for your friend, if you have stricken your hand with a stranger,
verses.text: My son, if you be surety for your friend, if you have stricken your hand with a stranger,

verses.raw: You are snared with the words of your mouth, you are taken with the words of your mouth.
verses.text: You are snared with the words of your mouth, you are taken with the words of your mouth.

verses.raw: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when you are come into the hand of your friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure your friend.
verses.text: Do this now, my son, and deliver thyself, when you are come into the hand of your friend; go, humble thyself, and make sure your friend.

verses.raw: Give not sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.
verses.text: Give not sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

verses.raw: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.
verses.text: Deliver thyself as a roe from the hand of the hunter, and as a bird from the hand of the fowler.

verses.raw: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
verses.text: Go to the ant, you sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:

verses.raw: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,
verses.text: Which having no guide, overseer, or ruler,

verses.raw: Provides her meat in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.
verses.text: Provides her meat in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

verses.raw: How long will you sleep, O sluggard? when will you arise out of your sleep?
verses.text: How long will you sleep, O sluggard? when will you arise out of your sleep?

verses.raw: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.text: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

verses.raw: So shall your poverty come as one that travelleth, and your want as an armed man.
verses.text: So shall your poverty come as one that travelleth, and your want as an armed man.

verses.raw: A naughty person, a wicked man, walks with a froward mouth.
verses.text: A naughty person, a wicked man, walks with a froward mouth.

verses.raw: He winketh with his eyes, he speaks with his feet, he teaches with his fingers;
verses.text: He winketh with his eyes, he speaks with his feet, he teaches with his fingers;

verses.raw: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he sows discord.
verses.text: Frowardness is in his heart, he deviseth mischief continually; he sows discord.

verses.raw: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
verses.text: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.

verses.raw: These six things does Yahuah (LORD) hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
verses.text: These six things does Yahuah hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:

verses.raw: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
verses.text: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

verses.raw: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
verses.text: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,

verses.raw: A false witness that speaks lies, and he that sows discord among brethren.
