verses.text: A false witness that speaks lies, and he that sows discord among brethren.

verses.raw: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of your mother:
verses.text: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and forsake not the law of your mother:

verses.raw: Bind them continually upon your heart, and tie them about your neck.
verses.text: Bind them continually upon your heart, and tie them about your neck.

verses.raw: When you go, it shall lead you; when you sleepest, it shall keep you; and when you awakest, it shall talk with you.
verses.text: When you go, it shall lead you; when you sleepest, it shall keep you; and when you awakest, it shall talk with you.

verses.raw: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:
verses.text: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

verses.raw: To keep you from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.
verses.text: To keep you from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

verses.raw: Lust not after her beauty in your heart; neither let her take you with her eyelids.
verses.text: Lust not after her beauty in your heart; neither let her take you with her eyelids.

verses.raw: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.
verses.text: For by means of a whorish woman a man is brought to a piece of bread: and the adulteress will hunt for the precious life.

verses.raw: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?
verses.text: Can a man take fire in his bosom, and his clothes not be burned?

verses.raw: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?
verses.text: Can one go upon hot coals, and his feet not be burned?

verses.raw: So he that goes in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever touches her shall not be innocent.
verses.text: So he that goes in to his neighbour’s wife; whosoever touches her shall not be innocent.

verses.raw: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;
verses.text: Men do not despise a thief, if he steal to satisfy his soul when he is hungry;

verses.raw: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.
verses.text: But if he be found, he shall restore sevenfold; he shall give all the substance of his house.

verses.raw: But whoso commits adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that does it destroys his own soul.
verses.text: But whoso commits adultery with a woman lacketh understanding: he that does it destroys his own soul.

verses.raw: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.
verses.text: A wound and dishonour shall he get; and his reproach shall not be wiped away.

verses.raw: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.
verses.text: For jealousy is the rage of a man: therefore he will not spare in the day of vengeance.

verses.raw: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.
verses.text: He will not regard any ransom; neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

verses.raw: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with you.
verses.text: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with you.

verses.raw: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of your eye.
verses.text: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of your eye.

verses.raw: Bind them upon your fingers, write them upon the table of your heart.
verses.text: Bind them upon your fingers, write them upon the table of your heart.

verses.raw: Say unto wisdom, You are my sister; and call understanding your kinswoman:
verses.text: Say unto wisdom, You are my sister; and call understanding your kinswoman:

verses.raw: That they may keep you from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.
verses.text: That they may keep you from the strange woman, from the stranger which flattereth with her words.

verses.raw: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,
verses.text: For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

verses.raw: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,
verses.text: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding,

verses.raw: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,
verses.text: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

verses.raw: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:
verses.text: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night:

verses.raw: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.
verses.text: And, behold, there met him a woman with the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

verses.raw: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:
verses.text: (She is loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

verses.raw: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lies in wait at every corner.)
verses.text: Now is she without, now in the streets, and lies in wait at every corner.)

verses.raw: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,
verses.text: So she caught him, and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,

verses.raw: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.
verses.text: I have peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows.

verses.raw: Therefore came I forth to meet you, diligently to seek your face, and I have found you.
verses.text: Therefore came I forth to meet you, diligently to seek your face, and I have found you.

verses.raw: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.
verses.text: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved works, with fine linen of Egypt.

verses.raw: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
verses.text: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

verses.raw: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.
verses.text: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

verses.raw: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:
verses.text: For the goodman is not at home, he is gone a long journey:

verses.raw: He has taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.
verses.text: He has taken a bag of money with him, and will come home at the day appointed.

verses.raw: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.
verses.text: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

verses.raw: He goes after her straightway, as an ox goes to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;
verses.text: He goes after her straightway, as an ox goes to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks;

verses.raw: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knows not that it is for his life.
verses.text: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knows not that it is for his life.

verses.raw: Hearken unto me now therefore, O you children, and attend to the words of my mouth.
verses.text: Hearken unto me now therefore, O you children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

verses.raw: Let not your heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.
verses.text: Let not your heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

verses.raw: For she has cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.
verses.text: For she has cast down many wounded: yea, many strong men have been slain by her.

verses.raw: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
verses.text: Her house is the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.

verses.raw: Does not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?
verses.text: Does not wisdom cry? and understanding put forth her voice?

verses.raw: She stands in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.
verses.text: She stands in the top of high places, by the way in the places of the paths.

verses.raw: She cries at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.
verses.text: She cries at the gates, at the entry of the city, at the coming in at the doors.

verses.raw: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.
verses.text: Unto you, O men, I call; and my voice is to the sons of man.

verses.raw: O you simple, understand wisdom: and, you fools, be you of an understanding heart.
verses.text: O you simple, understand wisdom: and, you fools, be you of an understanding heart.

verses.raw: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.
verses.text: Hear; for I will speak of excellent things; and the opening of my lips shall be right things.

verses.raw: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.
verses.text: For my mouth shall speak truth; and wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

verses.raw: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.
verses.text: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness; there is nothing froward or perverse in them.

verses.raw: They are all plain to him that understands, and right to them that find knowledge.
verses.text: They are all plain to him that understands, and right to them that find knowledge.

verses.raw: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.
verses.text: Receive my instruction, and not silver; and knowledge rather than choice gold.

verses.raw: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.
verses.text: For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared to it.

verses.raw: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.
verses.text: I wisdom dwell with prudence, and find out knowledge of witty inventions.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is to hate evil: pride, and arrogancy, and the evil way, and the froward mouth, do I hate.

verses.raw: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.
verses.text: Counsel is mine, and sound wisdom: I am understanding; I have strength.

verses.raw: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.
verses.text: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

verses.raw: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.
verses.text: By me princes rule, and nobles, even all the judges of the earth.

verses.raw: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.
verses.text: I love them that love me; and those that seek me early shall find me.

verses.raw: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.
verses.text: Riches and honour are with me; yea, durable riches and righteousness.

verses.raw: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
verses.text: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.

verses.raw: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:
verses.text: I lead in the way of righteousness, in the midst of the paths of judgment:

verses.raw: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.
verses.text: That I may cause those that love me to inherit substance; and I will fill their treasures.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.
verses.text: Yahuah possessed me in the beginning of his way, before his works of old.

verses.raw: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.
verses.text: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, or ever the earth was.

verses.raw: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.
verses.text: When there were no depths, I was brought forth; when there were no fountains abounding with water.

verses.raw: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:
verses.text: Before the mountains were settled, before the hills was I brought forth:

verses.raw: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.
verses.text: While as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the highest part of the dust of the world.

verses.raw: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:
verses.text: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

verses.raw: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:
verses.text: When he established the clouds above: when he strengthened the fountains of the deep:

verses.raw: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:
verses.text: When he gave to the sea his decree, that the waters should not pass his commandment: when he appointed the foundations of the earth:

verses.raw: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;
verses.text: Then I was by him, as one brought up with him: and I was daily his delight, rejoicing always before him;

verses.raw: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.
verses.text: Rejoicing in the habitable part of his earth; and my delights were with the sons of men.

verses.raw: Now therefore hearken unto me, O you children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.
verses.text: Now therefore hearken unto me, O you children: for blessed are they that keep my ways.

verses.raw: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.
verses.text: Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man that hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.
verses.text: Blessed is the man that hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at the posts of my doors.

verses.raw: For whoso finds me finds life, and shall obtain favour of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For whoso finds me finds life, and shall obtain favour of Yahuah.

verses.raw: But he that sins against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.
verses.text: But he that sins against me wrongeth his own soul: all they that hate me love death.

verses.raw: Wisdom has builded her house, she has hewn out her seven pillars:
verses.text: Wisdom has builded her house, she has hewn out her seven pillars:

verses.raw: She has killed her beasts; she has mingled her wine; she has also furnished her table.
verses.text: She has killed her beasts; she has mingled her wine; she has also furnished her table.

verses.raw: She has sent forth her maidens: she cries upon the highest places of the city,
verses.text: She has sent forth her maidens: she cries upon the highest places of the city,

verses.raw: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she says to him,
verses.text: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: as for him that wanteth understanding, she says to him,

verses.raw: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.
verses.text: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled.

verses.raw: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.
verses.text: Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding.

verses.raw: He that reproveth a scorner gets to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man gets himself a blot.
verses.text: He that reproveth a scorner gets to himself shame: and he that rebuketh a wicked man gets himself a blot.

verses.raw: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate you: rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.
verses.text: Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate you: rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.

verses.raw: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.
verses.text: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser: teach a just man, and he will increase in learning.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

verses.raw: For by me your days shall be multiplied, and the years of your life shall be increased.
verses.text: For by me your days shall be multiplied, and the years of your life shall be increased.

verses.raw: If you be wise, you shall be wise for thyself: but if you scornest, you alone shall bear it.
verses.text: If you be wise, you shall be wise for thyself: but if you scornest, you alone shall bear it.

verses.raw: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knows nothing.
verses.text: A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knows nothing.

verses.raw: For she sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,
verses.text: For she sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

verses.raw: To call passengers who go right on their ways:
verses.text: To call passengers who go right on their ways:

verses.raw: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she says to him,
verses.text: Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she says to him,

verses.raw: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.
verses.text: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant.

verses.raw: But he knows not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.
verses.text: But he knows not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell.

verses.raw: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.
verses.text: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

verses.raw: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.text: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing: but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casts away the substance of the wicked.
verses.text: Yahuah will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casts away the substance of the wicked.

verses.raw: He becomes poor that deals with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent makes rich.
verses.text: He becomes poor that deals with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent makes rich.

verses.raw: He that gathers in summer is a wise son: but he that sleeps in harvest is a son that causes shame.
verses.text: He that gathers in summer is a wise son: but he that sleeps in harvest is a son that causes shame.

verses.raw: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.text: Blessings are upon the head of the just: but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

verses.raw: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.
verses.text: The memory of the just is blessed: but the name of the wicked shall rot.

verses.raw: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.text: The wise in heart will receive commandments: but a prating fool shall fall.

verses.raw: He that walks uprightly walks surely: but he that perverts his ways shall be known.
verses.text: He that walks uprightly walks surely: but he that perverts his ways shall be known.

verses.raw: He that winketh with the eye causes sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.
verses.text: He that winketh with the eye causes sorrow: but a prating fool shall fall.

verses.raw: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.
verses.text: The mouth of a righteous man is a well of life: but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

verses.raw: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covers all sins.
verses.text: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covers all sins.

verses.raw: In the lips of him that has understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.
verses.text: In the lips of him that has understanding wisdom is found: but a rod is for the back of him that is void of understanding.

verses.raw: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.
verses.text: Wise men lay up knowledge: but the mouth of the foolish is near destruction.

verses.raw: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.
verses.text: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city: the destruction of the poor is their poverty.

verses.raw: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.
verses.text: The labour of the righteous tendeth to life: the fruit of the wicked to sin.

verses.raw: He is in the way of life that keeps instruction: but he that refuses reproof erreth.
verses.text: He is in the way of life that keeps instruction: but he that refuses reproof erreth.

verses.raw: He that hides hatred with lying lips, and he that utters a slander, is a fool.
verses.text: He that hides hatred with lying lips, and he that utters a slander, is a fool.

verses.raw: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refrains his lips is wise.
verses.text: In the multitude of words there wanteth not sin: but he that refrains his lips is wise.

verses.raw: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.
verses.text: The tongue of the just is as choice silver: the heart of the wicked is little worth.

verses.raw: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
verses.text: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.

verses.raw: The blessing of Yahuah (LORD), it makes rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.
verses.text: The blessing of Yahuah, it makes rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it.

verses.raw: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding has wisdom.
verses.text: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding has wisdom.

verses.raw: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.
verses.text: The fear of the wicked, it shall come upon him: but the desire of the righteous shall be granted.

verses.raw: As the whirlwind passes, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.
verses.text: As the whirlwind passes, so is the wicked no more: but the righteous is an everlasting foundation.

verses.raw: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.
verses.text: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to them that send him.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah prolongeth days: but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

verses.raw: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.
verses.text: The hope of the righteous shall be gladness: but the expectation of the wicked shall perish.

verses.raw: The way of Yahuah (LORD) is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.text: The way of Yahuah is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.

verses.raw: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.
verses.text: The righteous shall never be removed: but the wicked shall not inhabit the earth.

verses.raw: The mouth of the just brings forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.
verses.text: The mouth of the just brings forth wisdom: but the froward tongue shall be cut out.

verses.raw: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaks frowardness.
verses.text: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable: but the mouth of the wicked speaks frowardness.

verses.raw: A false balance is abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but a just weight is his delight.
verses.text: A false balance is abomination to Yahuah: but a just weight is his delight.

verses.raw: When pride comes, then comes shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.
verses.text: When pride comes, then comes shame: but with the lowly is wisdom.

verses.raw: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.
verses.text: The integrity of the upright shall guide them: but the perverseness of transgressors shall destroy them.

verses.raw: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivers from death.
verses.text: Riches profit not in the day of wrath: but righteousness delivers from death.

verses.raw: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.
verses.text: The righteousness of the perfect shall direct his way: but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

verses.raw: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.
verses.text: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them: but transgressors shall be taken in their own naughtiness.

verses.raw: When a wicked man dies, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perishes.
verses.text: When a wicked man dies, his expectation shall perish: and the hope of unjust men perishes.

verses.raw: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked comes in his stead.
verses.text: The righteous is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked comes in his stead.

verses.raw: An hypocrite with his mouth destroys his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.
verses.text: An hypocrite with his mouth destroys his neighbour: but through knowledge shall the just be delivered.

verses.raw: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.
verses.text: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.

verses.raw: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.
verses.text: By the blessing of the upright the city is exalted: but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

verses.raw: He that is void of wisdom despises his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.
verses.text: He that is void of wisdom despises his neighbour: but a man of understanding holdeth his peace.

verses.raw: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.
verses.text: A talebearer revealeth secrets: but he that is of a faithful spirit concealeth the matter.

verses.raw: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.text: Where no counsel is, the people fall: but in the multitude of counsellors there is safety.

verses.raw: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hates suretiship is sure.
verses.text: He that is surety for a stranger shall smart for it: and he that hates suretiship is sure.

verses.raw: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.
verses.text: A gracious woman retaineth honour: and strong men retain riches.

verses.raw: The merciful man does good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubles his own flesh.
verses.text: The merciful man does good to his own soul: but he that is cruel troubles his own flesh.

verses.raw: The wicked works a deceitful work: but to him that sows righteousness shall be a sure reward.
verses.text: The wicked works a deceitful work: but to him that sows righteousness shall be a sure reward.

verses.raw: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.
verses.text: As righteousness tendeth to life: so he that pursueth evil pursueth it to his own death.

verses.raw: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but such as are upright in their way are his delight.
verses.text: They that are of a froward heart are abomination to Yahuah: but such as are upright in their way are his delight.

verses.raw: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.
verses.text: Though hand join in hand, the wicked shall not be unpunished: but the seed of the righteous shall be delivered.

verses.raw: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.
verses.text: As a jewel of gold in a swine’s snout, so is a fair woman which is without discretion.

verses.raw: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.
verses.text: The desire of the righteous is only good: but the expectation of the wicked is wrath.

verses.raw: There is that scatters, and yet increases; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.
verses.text: There is that scatters, and yet increases; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

verses.raw: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.
verses.text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

verses.raw: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.
verses.text: He that withholdeth corn, the people shall curse him: but blessing shall be upon the head of him that selleth it.

verses.raw: He that diligently seeks good procureth favour: but he that seeks mischief, it shall come unto him.
verses.text: He that diligently seeks good procureth favour: but he that seeks mischief, it shall come unto him.

verses.raw: He that trusts in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.
verses.text: He that trusts in his riches shall fall: but the righteous shall flourish as a branch.

verses.raw: He that troubles his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.
verses.text: He that troubles his own house shall inherit the wind: and the fool shall be servant to the wise of heart.

verses.raw: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.
verses.text: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life; and he that winneth souls is wise.

verses.raw: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.
verses.text: Behold, the righteous shall be recompensed in the earth: much more the wicked and the sinner.

verses.raw: Whoso loves instruction loves knowledge: but he that hates reproof is brutish.
verses.text: Whoso loves instruction loves knowledge: but he that hates reproof is brutish.

verses.raw: A good man obtains favour of Yahuah (LORD): but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.
verses.text: A good man obtains favour of Yahuah: but a man of wicked devices will he condemn.

verses.raw: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.
verses.text: A man shall not be established by wickedness: but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

verses.raw: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that makes ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verses.text: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that makes ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.

verses.raw: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.
verses.text: The thoughts of the righteous are right: but the counsels of the wicked are deceit.

verses.raw: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.
verses.text: The words of the wicked are to lie in wait for blood: but the mouth of the upright shall deliver them.

verses.raw: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.
verses.text: The wicked are overthrown, and are not: but the house of the righteous shall stand.

verses.raw: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.
verses.text: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom: but he that is of a perverse heart shall be despised.

verses.raw: He that is despised, and has a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.
verses.text: He that is despised, and has a servant, is better than he that honoureth himself, and lacketh bread.

verses.raw: A righteous man regards the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.
verses.text: A righteous man regards the life of his beast: but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

verses.raw: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that follows vain persons is void of understanding.
verses.text: He that tilleth his land shall be satisfied with bread: but he that follows vain persons is void of understanding.

verses.raw: The wicked desires the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.
verses.text: The wicked desires the net of evil men: but the root of the righteous yieldeth fruit.

verses.raw: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.
verses.text: The wicked is snared by the transgression of his lips: but the just shall come out of trouble.

verses.raw: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.
verses.text: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man’s hands shall be rendered unto him.

verses.raw: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.
verses.text: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes: but he that hearkeneth unto counsel is wise.

verses.raw: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covers shame.
verses.text: A fool’s wrath is presently known: but a prudent man covers shame.

verses.raw: He that speaks truth shows forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.
verses.text: He that speaks truth shows forth righteousness: but a false witness deceit.

verses.raw: There is that speaks like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.
verses.text: There is that speaks like the piercings of a sword: but the tongue of the wise is health.

verses.raw: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.
verses.text: The lip of truth shall be established for ever: but a lying tongue is but for a moment.

verses.raw: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.
verses.text: Deceit is in the heart of them that imagine evil: but to the counsellors of peace is joy.

verses.raw: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.
verses.text: There shall no evil happen to the just: but the wicked shall be filled with mischief.

verses.raw: Lying lips are abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but they that deal truly are his delight.
verses.text: Lying lips are abomination to Yahuah: but they that deal truly are his delight.

verses.raw: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.
verses.text: A prudent man concealeth knowledge: but the heart of fools proclaimeth foolishness.

verses.raw: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.
verses.text: The hand of the diligent shall bear rule: but the slothful shall be under tribute.

verses.raw: Heaviness in the heart of man makes it stoop: but a good word makes it glad.
verses.text: Heaviness in the heart of man makes it stoop: but a good word makes it glad.

verses.raw: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.
verses.text: The righteous is more excellent than his neighbour: but the way of the wicked seduceth them.

verses.raw: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.
verses.text: The slothful man roasteth not that which he took in hunting: but the substance of a diligent man is precious.

verses.raw: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.
verses.text: In the way of righteousness is life; and in the pathway thereof there is no death.

verses.raw: A wise son hears his father’s instruction: but a scorner hears not rebuke.
verses.text: A wise son hears his father’s instruction: but a scorner hears not rebuke.

verses.raw: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.
verses.text: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth: but the soul of the transgressors shall eat violence.

verses.raw: He that keeps his mouth keeps his life: but he that opens wide his lips shall have destruction.
verses.text: He that keeps his mouth keeps his life: but he that opens wide his lips shall have destruction.

verses.raw: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.
verses.text: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

verses.raw: A righteous man hates lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and comes to shame.
verses.text: A righteous man hates lying: but a wicked man is loathsome, and comes to shame.

verses.raw: Righteousness keeps him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.
verses.text: Righteousness keeps him that is upright in the way: but wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

verses.raw: There is that makes himself rich, yet has nothing: there is that makes himself poor, yet has great riches.
verses.text: There is that makes himself rich, yet has nothing: there is that makes himself poor, yet has great riches.

verses.raw: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor hears not rebuke.
verses.text: The ransom of a man’s life are his riches: but the poor hears not rebuke.

verses.raw: The light of the righteous rejoices: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.text: The light of the righteous rejoices: but the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

verses.raw: Only by pride comes contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.
verses.text: Only by pride comes contention: but with the well advised is wisdom.

verses.raw: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathers by labour shall increase.
verses.text: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished: but he that gathers by labour shall increase.

verses.raw: Hope deferred makes the heart sick: but when the desire comes, it is a tree of life.
verses.text: Hope deferred makes the heart sick: but when the desire comes, it is a tree of life.

verses.raw: Whoso despises the word shall be destroyed: but he that fears the commandment shall be rewarded.
verses.text: Whoso despises the word shall be destroyed: but he that fears the commandment shall be rewarded.

verses.raw: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.text: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

verses.raw: Good understanding gives favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.
verses.text: Good understanding gives favour: but the way of transgressors is hard.

verses.raw: Every prudent man deals with knowledge: but a fool lays open his folly.
verses.text: Every prudent man deals with knowledge: but a fool lays open his folly.

verses.raw: A wicked messenger falls into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.
verses.text: A wicked messenger falls into mischief: but a faithful ambassador is health.

verses.raw: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuses instruction: but he that regards reproof shall be honoured.
verses.text: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuses instruction: but he that regards reproof shall be honoured.

verses.raw: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.
verses.text: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul: but it is abomination to fools to depart from evil.

verses.raw: He that walks with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.
verses.text: He that walks with wise men shall be wise: but a companion of fools shall be destroyed.

verses.raw: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.
verses.text: Evil pursueth sinners: but to the righteous good shall be repayed.

verses.raw: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.
verses.text: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children’s children: and the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the just.

verses.raw: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.
verses.text: Much food is in the tillage of the poor: but there is that is destroyed for want of judgment.

verses.raw: He that spareth his rod hates his son: but he that loves him chastens him betimes.
verses.text: He that spareth his rod hates his son: but he that loves him chastens him betimes.

verses.raw: The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.
verses.text: The righteous eats to the satisfying of his soul: but the belly of the wicked shall want.

verses.raw: Every wise woman builds her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.
verses.text: Every wise woman builds her house: but the foolish plucketh it down with her hands.

verses.raw: He that walks in his uprightness fears Yahuah (LORD): but he that is perverse in his ways despises him.
verses.text: He that walks in his uprightness fears Yahuah: but he that is perverse in his ways despises him.

verses.raw: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.
verses.text: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod of pride: but the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

verses.raw: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
verses.text: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean: but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

verses.raw: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.
verses.text: A faithful witness will not lie: but a false witness will utter lies.

verses.raw: A scorner seeks wisdom, and finds it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understands.
verses.text: A scorner seeks wisdom, and finds it not: but knowledge is easy unto him that understands.

verses.raw: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when you perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.
verses.text: Go from the presence of a foolish man, when you perceivest not in him the lips of knowledge.

verses.raw: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.
verses.text: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way: but the folly of fools is deceit.

verses.raw: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.
verses.text: Fools make a mock at sin: but among the righteous there is favour.

verses.raw: The heart knows his own bitterness; and a stranger does not intermeddle with his joy.
verses.text: The heart knows his own bitterness; and a stranger does not intermeddle with his joy.

verses.raw: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.
verses.text: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown: but the tabernacle of the upright shall flourish.

verses.raw: There is a way which seems right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.text: There is a way which seems right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.raw: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.
verses.text: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; and the end of that mirth is heaviness.

verses.raw: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.
verses.text: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways: and a good man shall be satisfied from himself.

verses.raw: The simple believes every word: but the prudent man looks well to his going.
verses.text: The simple believes every word: but the prudent man looks well to his going.

verses.raw: A wise man fears, and departs from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.
verses.text: A wise man fears, and departs from evil: but the fool rageth, and is confident.

verses.raw: He that is soon angry deals foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.
verses.text: He that is soon angry deals foolishly: and a man of wicked devices is hated.

verses.raw: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
verses.text: The simple inherit folly: but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.raw: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
verses.text: The evil bow before the good; and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

verses.raw: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich has many friends.
verses.text: The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich has many friends.

verses.raw: He that despises his neighbour sins: but he that has mercy on the poor, happy is he.
verses.text: He that despises his neighbour sins: but he that has mercy on the poor, happy is he.

verses.raw: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.
verses.text: Do they not err that devise evil? but mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

verses.raw: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.
verses.text: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

verses.raw: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
verses.text: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.

verses.raw: A true witness delivers souls: but a deceitful witness speaks lies.
verses.text: A true witness delivers souls: but a deceitful witness speaks lies.

verses.raw: In the fear of Yahuah (LORD) is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.
verses.text: In the fear of Yahuah is strong confidence: and his children shall have a place of refuge.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

verses.raw: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.
verses.text: In the multitude of people is the king’s honour: but in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

verses.raw: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.
verses.text: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

verses.raw: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.
verses.text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

verses.raw: He that oppresses the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him has mercy on the poor.
verses.text: He that oppresses the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him has mercy on the poor.

verses.raw: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous has hope in his death.
verses.text: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous has hope in his death.

verses.raw: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that has understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.
verses.text: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that has understanding: but that which is in the midst of fools is made known.

verses.raw: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.
verses.text: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people.

verses.raw: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causes shame.
verses.text: The king’s favour is toward a wise servant: but his wrath is against him that causes shame.

verses.raw: A soft answer turns away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.text: A soft answer turns away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.

verses.raw: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools pours out foolishness.
verses.text: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools pours out foolishness.

verses.raw: The eyes of Yahuah (LORD) are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.text: The eyes of Yahuah are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.

verses.raw: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
verses.text: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.

verses.raw: A fool despises his father’s instruction: but he that regards reproof is prudent.
verses.text: A fool despises his father’s instruction: but he that regards reproof is prudent.

verses.raw: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.text: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.

verses.raw: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish does not so.
verses.text: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish does not so.

verses.raw: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.text: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Yahuah: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

verses.text: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto Yahuah: but he loves him that follows after righteousness.

verses.raw: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hates reproof shall die.
verses.text: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hates reproof shall die.

verses.raw: Hell and destruction are before Yahuah (LORD): how much more then the hearts of the children of men?

verses.raw: A scorner loves not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.text: A scorner loves not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.

verses.raw: A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.text: A merry heart makes a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

verses.raw: The heart of him that has understanding seeks knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.text: The heart of him that has understanding seeks knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.

verses.raw: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart has a continual feast.
verses.text: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart has a continual feast.

verses.raw: Better is little with the fear of Yahuah (LORD) than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.text: Better is little with the fear of Yahuah than great treasure and trouble therewith.

verses.raw: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.text: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.

verses.raw: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.text: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.

verses.raw: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
verses.text: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.

verses.raw: A wise son makes a glad father: but a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.text: A wise son makes a glad father: but a foolish man despises his mother.

verses.raw: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walks uprightly.
verses.text: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walks uprightly.

verses.raw: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.text: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.

verses.raw: A man has joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
verses.text: A man has joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!

verses.raw: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.text: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.text: Yahuah will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.

verses.raw: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
verses.text: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to Yahuah: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.

verses.raw: He that is greedy of gain troubles his own house; but he that hates gifts shall live.
verses.text: He that is greedy of gain troubles his own house; but he that hates gifts shall live.

verses.raw: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.
verses.text: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked pours out evil things.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is far from the wicked: but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.text: Yahuah is far from the wicked: but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

verses.raw: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart: and a good report makes the bones fat.
verses.text: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart: and a good report makes the bones fat.

verses.raw: The ear that hears the reproof of life abides among the wise.
verses.text: The ear that hears the reproof of life abides among the wise.

verses.raw: He that refuses instruction despises his own soul: but he that hears reproof gets understanding.
verses.text: He that refuses instruction despises his own soul: but he that hears reproof gets understanding.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.

verses.raw: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from Yahuah.

verses.raw: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahuah (LORD) weigheth the spirits.
verses.text: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but Yahuah weigheth the spirits.

verses.raw: Commit your works unto Yahuah (LORD), and your thoughts shall be established.
verses.text: Commit your works unto Yahuah, and your thoughts shall be established.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.
verses.text: Yahuah has made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

verses.raw: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahuah (LORD): though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.
verses.text: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to Yahuah: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

verses.raw: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of Yahuah (LORD) men depart from evil.
verses.text: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of Yahuah men depart from evil.

verses.raw: When a man’s ways please Yahuah (LORD), he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.
verses.text: When a man’s ways please Yahuah, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

verses.raw: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.
verses.text: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

verses.raw: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but Yahuah (LORD) directeth his steps.
verses.text: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but Yahuah directeth his steps.

verses.raw: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.
verses.text: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

verses.raw: A just weight and balance are the LORD’S: all the weights of the bag are his work.
verses.text: A just weight and balance are the LORD’S: all the weights of the bag are his work.

verses.raw: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.
verses.text: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

verses.raw: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaks right.
verses.text: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaks right.

verses.raw: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.
verses.text: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

verses.raw: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.
verses.text: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

verses.raw: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!
verses.text: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

verses.raw: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keeps his way preserves his soul.
verses.text: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keeps his way preserves his soul.

verses.raw: Pride goes before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.
verses.text: Pride goes before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

verses.raw: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.
verses.text: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

verses.raw: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusts in Yahuah (LORD), happy is he.
verses.text: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusts in Yahuah, happy is he.

verses.raw: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increases learning.
verses.text: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increases learning.

verses.raw: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that has it: but the instruction of fools is folly.
verses.text: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that has it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

verses.raw: The heart of the wise teaches his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.
verses.text: The heart of the wise teaches his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

verses.raw: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
verses.text: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

verses.raw: There is a way that seems right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.
verses.text: There is a way that seems right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

verses.raw: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.
verses.text: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

verses.raw: An ungodly man digs up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.
verses.text: An ungodly man digs up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

verses.raw: A froward man sows strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.
verses.text: A froward man sows strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

verses.raw: A violent man entices his neighbour, and leads him into the way that is not good.
verses.text: A violent man entices his neighbour, and leads him into the way that is not good.

verses.raw: He shuts his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he brings evil to pass.
verses.text: He shuts his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he brings evil to pass.

verses.raw: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verses.text: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

verses.raw: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that rules his spirit than he that takes a city.
verses.text: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that rules his spirit than he that takes a city.

verses.raw: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.
verses.text: Better is a dry morsel, and quietness therewith, than an house full of sacrifices with strife.

verses.raw: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causes shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.
verses.text: A wise servant shall have rule over a son that causes shame, and shall have part of the inheritance among the brethren.

verses.raw: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but Yahuah (LORD) trieth the hearts.
verses.text: The fining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold: but Yahuah trieth the hearts.

verses.raw: A wicked doer gives heed to false lips; and a liar gives ear to a naughty tongue.
verses.text: A wicked doer gives heed to false lips; and a liar gives ear to a naughty tongue.

verses.raw: Whoso mocks the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.
verses.text: Whoso mocks the poor reproacheth his Maker: and he that is glad at calamities shall not be unpunished.

verses.raw: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.
verses.text: Children’s children are the crown of old men; and the glory of children are their fathers.

verses.raw: Excellent speech becomes not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.
verses.text: Excellent speech becomes not a fool: much less do lying lips a prince.

verses.raw: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that has it: whithersoever it turns, it prospereth.
verses.text: A gift is as a precious stone in the eyes of him that has it: whithersoever it turns, it prospereth.

verses.raw: He that covers a transgression seeks love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.
verses.text: He that covers a transgression seeks love; but he that repeateth a matter separateth very friends.

verses.raw: A reproof enters more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.
verses.text: A reproof enters more into a wise man than an hundred stripes into a fool.

verses.raw: An evil man seeks only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.
verses.text: An evil man seeks only rebellion: therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

verses.raw: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.
verses.text: Let a bear robbed of her whelps meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

verses.raw: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.
verses.text: Whoso rewardeth evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

verses.raw: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.
verses.text: The beginning of strife is as when one letteth out water: therefore leave off contention, before it be meddled with.

verses.raw: He that justifies the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He that justifies the wicked, and he that condemneth the just, even they both are abomination to Yahuah.

verses.raw: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he has no heart to it?
verses.text: Wherefore is there a price in the hand of a fool to get wisdom, seeing he has no heart to it?

verses.raw: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
verses.text: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.

verses.raw: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becomes surety in the presence of his friend.
verses.text: A man void of understanding striketh hands, and becomes surety in the presence of his friend.

verses.raw: He loves transgression that loves strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeks destruction.
verses.text: He loves transgression that loves strife: and he that exalteth his gate seeks destruction.

verses.raw: He that has a froward heart finds no good: and he that has a perverse tongue falls into mischief.
verses.text: He that has a froward heart finds no good: and he that has a perverse tongue falls into mischief.

verses.raw: He that begetteth a fool does it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool has no joy.
verses.text: He that begetteth a fool does it to his sorrow: and the father of a fool has no joy.

verses.raw: A merry heart does good like a medicine: but a broken spirit dries the bones.
verses.text: A merry heart does good like a medicine: but a broken spirit dries the bones.

verses.raw: A wicked man takes a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.
verses.text: A wicked man takes a gift out of the bosom to pervert the ways of judgment.

verses.raw: Wisdom is before him that has understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.
verses.text: Wisdom is before him that has understanding; but the eyes of a fool are in the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.
verses.text: A foolish son is a grief to his father, and bitterness to her that bare him.

verses.raw: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.
verses.text: Also to punish the just is not good, nor to strike princes for equity.

verses.raw: He that has knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.
verses.text: He that has knowledge spareth his words: and a man of understanding is of an excellent spirit.

verses.raw: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shuts his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.
verses.text: Even a fool, when he holdeth his peace, is counted wise: and he that shuts his lips is esteemed a man of understanding.

verses.raw: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeks and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
verses.text: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeks and intermeddleth with all wisdom.

verses.raw: A fool has no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
verses.text: A fool has no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.

verses.raw: When the wicked comes, then comes also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
verses.text: When the wicked comes, then comes also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.

verses.raw: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
verses.text: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.

verses.raw: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.text: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.

verses.raw: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calls for strokes.
verses.text: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calls for strokes.

verses.raw: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.text: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.

verses.raw: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.text: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

verses.raw: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
verses.text: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.

verses.raw: The name of Yahuah (LORD) is a strong tower: the righteous runs into it, and is safe.
verses.text: The name of Yahuah is a strong tower: the righteous runs into it, and is safe.

verses.raw: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
verses.text: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.

verses.raw: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
verses.text: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.

verses.raw: He that answers a matter before he hears it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verses.text: He that answers a matter before he hears it, it is folly and shame unto him.

verses.raw: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
verses.text: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?

verses.raw: The heart of the prudent gets knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.
verses.text: The heart of the prudent gets knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

verses.raw: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.
verses.text: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

verses.raw: He that is first in his own cause seems just; but his neighbour comes and searcheth him.
verses.text: He that is first in his own cause seems just; but his neighbour comes and searcheth him.

verses.raw: The lot causes contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
verses.text: The lot causes contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.

verses.raw: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.text: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.

verses.raw: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.text: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.

verses.raw: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.text: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.

verses.raw: Whoso finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favour of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Whoso finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favour of Yahuah.

verses.raw: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answers roughly.
verses.text: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answers roughly.

verses.raw: A man that has friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.text: A man that has friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.

verses.raw: Better is the poor that walks in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.text: Better is the poor that walks in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

verses.raw: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sins.
verses.text: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sins.

verses.raw: The foolishness of man perverts his way: and his heart fretteth against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The foolishness of man perverts his way: and his heart fretteth against Yahuah.

verses.raw: Wealth makes many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.text: Wealth makes many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

verses.raw: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaks lies shall not escape.
verses.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaks lies shall not escape.

verses.raw: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that gives gifts.
verses.text: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that gives gifts.

verses.raw: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.text: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.

verses.raw: He that gets wisdom loves his own soul: he that keeps understanding shall find good.
verses.text: He that gets wisdom loves his own soul: he that keeps understanding shall find good.

verses.raw: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaks lies shall perish.
verses.text: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaks lies shall perish.

verses.raw: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.text: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

verses.raw: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.text: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.

verses.raw: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.text: The king’s wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.

verses.raw: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.text: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.

verses.raw: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from Yahuah.

verses.raw: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.text: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

verses.raw: He that keeps the commandment keeps his own soul; but he that despises his ways shall die.
verses.text: He that keeps the commandment keeps his own soul; but he that despises his ways shall die.

verses.raw: He that has pity upon the poor lendeth unto Yahuah (LORD); and that which he has given will he pay him again.
verses.text: He that has pity upon the poor lendeth unto Yahuah; and that which he has given will he pay him again.

verses.raw: Chasten your son while there is hope, and let not your soul spare for his crying.
verses.text: Chasten your son while there is hope, and let not your soul spare for his crying.

verses.raw: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if you deliver him, yet you must do it again.
verses.text: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if you deliver him, yet you must do it again.

verses.raw: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.
verses.text: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

verses.raw: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of Yahuah (LORD), that shall stand.
verses.text: There are many devices in a man’s heart; nevertheless the counsel of Yahuah, that shall stand.

verses.raw: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.text: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) tendeth to life: and he that has it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah tendeth to life: and he that has it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

verses.raw: A slothful man hides his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.text: A slothful man hides his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

verses.raw: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that has understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.text: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that has understanding, and he will understand knowledge.

verses.raw: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causes shame, and brings reproach.
verses.text: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causes shame, and brings reproach.

verses.raw: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causes to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.text: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causes to err from the words of knowledge.

verses.raw: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.
verses.text: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devours iniquity.

verses.raw: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.text: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.

verses.raw: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.text: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.

verses.raw: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sins against his own soul.
verses.text: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sins against his own soul.

verses.raw: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.text: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.

verses.raw: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.text: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.

verses.raw: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
