verses.raw: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.
verses.text: Arise, and let us go by night, and let us destroy her palaces.

verses.raw: For thus has Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) said, Hew you down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.
verses.text: For thus has Yahuah Tseva'ot said, Hew you down trees, and cast a mount against Jerusalem: this is the city to be visited; she is wholly oppression in the midst of her.

verses.raw: As a fountain casts out her waters, so she casts out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.
verses.text: As a fountain casts out her waters, so she casts out her wickedness: violence and spoil is heard in her; before me continually is grief and wounds.

verses.raw: Be you instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from you; lest I make you desolate, a land not inhabited.
verses.text: Be you instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from you; lest I make you desolate, a land not inhabited.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), They shall throughly glean the remnant of Yashar'el (Israel) as a vine: turn back your hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Yashar'el as a vine: turn back your hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

verses.raw: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of Yahuah (LORD) is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.
verses.text: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of Yahuah is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

verses.raw: Therefore I am full of the fury of Yahuah (LORD); I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.
verses.text: Therefore I am full of the fury of Yahuah; I am weary with holding in: I will pour it out upon the children abroad, and upon the assembly of young men together: for even the husband with the wife shall be taken, the aged with him that is full of days.

verses.raw: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And their houses shall be turned unto others, with their fields and wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of the land, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one deals falsely.
verses.text: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one deals falsely.

verses.raw: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.text: They have healed also the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

verses.raw: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore they shall fall among them that fall: at the time that I visit them they shall be cast down, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Stand you in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and you shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Stand you in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths, where is the good way, and walk therein, and you shall find rest for your souls. But they said, We will not walk therein.

verses.raw: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.
verses.text: Also I set watchmen over you, saying, Hearken to the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hearken.

verses.raw: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.
verses.text: Therefore hear, you nations, and know, O congregation, what is among them.

verses.raw: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.
verses.text: Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evil upon this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not hearkened unto my words, nor to my law, but rejected it.

verses.raw: To what purpose comes there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.
verses.text: To what purpose comes there to me incense from Sheba, and the sweet cane from a far country? your burnt offerings are not acceptable, nor your sacrifices sweet unto me.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will lay stumblingblocks before this people, and the fathers and the sons together shall fall upon them; the neighbour and his friend shall perish.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, a people comes from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Behold, a people comes from the north country, and a great nation shall be raised from the sides of the earth.

verses.raw: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against you, O daughter of Zion.
verses.text: They shall lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, set in array as men for war against you, O daughter of Zion.

verses.raw: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish has taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.text: We have heard the fame thereof: our hands wax feeble: anguish has taken hold of us, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

verses.raw: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.
verses.text: Go not forth into the field, nor walk by the way; for the sword of the enemy and fear is on every side.

verses.raw: O daughter of my people, gird you with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make you mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.
verses.text: O daughter of my people, gird you with sackcloth, and wallow thyself in ashes: make you mourning, as for an only son, most bitter lamentation: for the spoiler shall suddenly come upon us.

verses.raw: I have set you for a tower and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.
verses.text: I have set you for a tower and a fortress among my people, that you may know and try their way.

verses.raw: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
verses.text: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.

verses.raw: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.
verses.text: The bellows are burned, the lead is consumed of the fire; the founder melteth in vain: for the wicked are not plucked away.

verses.raw: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because Yahuah (LORD) has rejected them.
verses.text: Reprobate silver shall men call them, because Yahuah has rejected them.

verses.raw: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Stand in the gate of the LORD’S house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), all you of Yahudah (Judah), that enter in at these gates to worship Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Stand in the gate of the LORD’S house, and proclaim there this word, and say, Hear the word of Yahuah, all you of Yahudah, that enter in at these gates to worship Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, Amend your ways and your doings, and I will cause you to dwell in this place.

verses.raw: Trust you not in lying words, saying, The temple of Yahuah (LORD), The temple of Yahuah (LORD), The temple of Yahuah (LORD), are these.
verses.text: Trust you not in lying words, saying, The temple of Yahuah, The temple of Yahuah, The temple of Yahuah, are these.

verses.raw: For if you throughly amend your ways and your doings; if you throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;
verses.text: For if you throughly amend your ways and your doings; if you throughly execute judgment between a man and his neighbour;

verses.raw: If you oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:
verses.text: If you oppress not the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, neither walk after other gods to your hurt:

verses.raw: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.
verses.text: Then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land that I gave to your fathers, for ever and ever.

verses.raw: Behold, you trust in lying words, that cannot profit.
verses.text: Behold, you trust in lying words, that cannot profit.

verses.raw: Will you steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom you know not;
verses.text: Will you steal, murder, and commit adultery, and swear falsely, and burn incense unto Baal, and walk after other gods whom you know not;

verses.raw: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?
verses.text: And come and stand before me in this house, which is called by my name, and say, We are delivered to do all these abominations?

verses.raw: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Is this house, which is called by my name, become a den of robbers in your eyes? Behold, even I have seen it, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: But go you now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But go you now unto my place which was in Shiloh, where I set my name at the first, and see what I did to it for the wickedness of my people Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And now, because you have done all these works, says Yahuah (LORD), and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but you heard not; and I called you, but you answered not;
verses.text: And now, because you have done all these works, says Yahuah, and I spake unto you, rising up early and speaking, but you heard not; and I called you, but you answered not;

verses.raw: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein you trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
verses.text: Therefore will I do unto this house, which is called by my name, wherein you trust, and unto the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.

verses.raw: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.
verses.text: And I will cast you out of my sight, as I have cast out all your brethren, even the whole seed of Ephraim.

verses.raw: Therefore pray not you for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear you.
verses.text: Therefore pray not you for this people, neither lift up cry nor prayer for them, neither make intercession to me: for I will not hear you.

verses.raw: See you not what they do in the cities of Yahudah (Judah) and in the streets of Jerusalem?
verses.text: See you not what they do in the cities of Yahudah and in the streets of Jerusalem?

verses.raw: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.
verses.text: The children gather wood, and the fathers kindle the fire, and the women knead their dough, to make cakes to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto other gods, that they may provoke me to anger.

verses.raw: Do they provoke me to anger? says Yahuah (LORD): do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?
verses.text: Do they provoke me to anger? says Yahuah: do they not provoke themselves to the confusion of their own faces?

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, my anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; Behold, my anger and my fury shall be poured out upon this place, upon man, and upon beast, and upon the trees of the field, and upon the fruit of the ground; and it shall burn, and shall not be quenched.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Put your burnt offerings unto your sacrifices, and eat flesh.

verses.raw: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:
verses.text: For I spake not unto your fathers, nor commanded them in the day that I brought them out of the land of Egypt, concerning burnt offerings or sacrifices:

verses.raw: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your Elohim (God), and you shall be my people: and walk you in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.
verses.text: But this thing commanded I them, saying, Obey my voice, and I will be your Elohim, and you shall be my people: and walk you in all the ways that I have commanded you, that it may be well unto you.

verses.raw: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
verses.text: But they hearkened not, nor inclined their ear, but walked in the counsels and in the imagination of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.

verses.raw: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:
verses.text: Since the day that your fathers came forth out of the land of Egypt unto this day I have even sent unto you all my servants the prophets, daily rising up early and sending them:

verses.raw: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.
verses.text: Yet they hearkened not unto me, nor inclined their ear, but hardened their neck: they did worse than their fathers.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to you: you shall also call unto them; but they will not answer you.
verses.text: Therefore you shall speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to you: you shall also call unto them; but they will not answer you.

verses.raw: But you shall say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), nor receives correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.
verses.text: But you shall say unto them, This is a nation that obeyeth not the voice of Yahuah their Elohim, nor receives correction: truth is perished, and is cut off from their mouth.

verses.raw: Cut off your hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for Yahuah (LORD) has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.
verses.text: Cut off your hair, O Jerusalem, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on high places; for Yahuah has rejected and forsaken the generation of his wrath.

verses.raw: For the children of Yahudah (Judah) have done evil in my sight, says Yahuah (LORD): they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.
verses.text: For the children of Yahudah have done evil in my sight, says Yahuah: they have set their abominations in the house which is called by my name, to pollute it.

verses.raw: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.
verses.text: And they have built the high places of Tophet, which is in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to burn their sons and their daughters in the fire; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my heart.

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that it shall no more be called Tophet, nor the valley of the son of Hinnom, but the valley of slaughter: for they shall bury in Tophet, till there be no place.

verses.raw: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.
verses.text: And the carcases of this people shall be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth; and none shall fray them away.

verses.raw: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.
verses.text: Then will I cause to cease from the cities of Yahudah, and from the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: for the land shall be desolate.

verses.raw: At that time, says Yahuah (LORD), they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:
verses.text: At that time, says Yahuah, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Yahudah, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves:

verses.raw: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.
verses.text: And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And death shall be chosen rather than life by all the residue of them that remain of this evil family, which remain in all the places whither I have driven them, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Moreover you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?
verses.text: Moreover you shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah; Shall they fall, and not arise? shall he turn away, and not return?

verses.raw: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.
verses.text: Why then is this people of Jerusalem slidden back by a perpetual backsliding? they hold fast deceit, they refuse to return.

verses.raw: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.
verses.text: I hearkened and heard, but they spake not aright: no man repented him of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? every one turned to his course, as the horse rusheth into the battle.

verses.raw: Yea, the stork in the heaven knows her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Yea, the stork in the heaven knows her appointed times; and the turtle and the crane and the swallow observe the time of their coming; but my people know not the judgment of Yahuah.

verses.raw: How do you say, We are wise, and the law of Yahuah (LORD) is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.
verses.text: How do you say, We are wise, and the law of Yahuah is with us? Lo, certainly in vain made he it; the pen of the scribes is in vain.

verses.raw: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of Yahuah (LORD); and what wisdom is in them?
verses.text: The wise men are ashamed, they are dismayed and taken: lo, they have rejected the word of Yahuah; and what wisdom is in them?

verses.raw: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one deals falsely.
verses.text: Therefore will I give their wives unto others, and their fields to them that shall inherit them: for every one from the least even unto the greatest is given to covetousness, from the prophet even unto the priest every one deals falsely.

verses.raw: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
verses.text: For they have healed the hurt of the daughter of my people slightly, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.

verses.raw: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Were they ashamed when they had committed abomination? nay, they were not at all ashamed, neither could they blush: therefore shall they fall among them that fall: in the time of their visitation they shall be cast down, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will surely consume them, says Yahuah (LORD): there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.
verses.text: I will surely consume them, says Yahuah: there shall be no grapes on the vine, nor figs on the fig tree, and the leaf shall fade; and the things that I have given them shall pass away from them.

verses.raw: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) has put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the defenced cities, and let us be silent there: for Yahuah Eloheinu has put us to silence, and given us water of gall to drink, because we have sinned against Yahuah.

verses.raw: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!
verses.text: We looked for peace, but no good came; and for a time of health, and behold trouble!

verses.raw: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.
verses.text: The snorting of his horses was heard from Dan: the whole land trembled at the sound of the neighing of his strong ones; for they are come, and have devoured the land, and all that is in it; the city, and those that dwell therein.

verses.raw: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For, behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices, among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.
verses.text: When I would comfort myself against sorrow, my heart is faint in me.

verses.raw: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not Yahuah (LORD) in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?
verses.text: Behold the voice of the cry of the daughter of my people because of them that dwell in a far country: Is not Yahuah in Zion? is not her king in her? Why have they provoked me to anger with their graven images, and with strange vanities?

verses.raw: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.
verses.text: The harvest is past, the summer is ended, and we are not saved.

verses.raw: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment has taken hold on me.
verses.text: For the hurt of the daughter of my people am I hurt; I am black; astonishment has taken hold on me.

verses.raw: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?
verses.text: Is there no balm in Gilead; is there no physician there? why then is not the health of the daughter of my people recovered?

verses.raw: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!
verses.text: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

verses.raw: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
verses.text: Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! for they be all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.

verses.raw: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they bend their tongues like their bow for lies: but they are not valiant for the truth upon the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they know not me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Take you heed every one of his neighbour, and trust you not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
verses.text: Take you heed every one of his neighbour, and trust you not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.

verses.raw: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.
verses.text: And they will deceive every one his neighbour, and will not speak the truth: they have taught their tongue to speak lies, and weary themselves to commit iniquity.

verses.raw: Your habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Your habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how shall I do for the daughter of my people?

verses.raw: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he lays his wait.
verses.text: Their tongue is as an arrow shot out; it speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably to his neighbour with his mouth, but in heart he lays his wait.

verses.raw: Shall I not visit them for these things? says Yahuah (LORD): shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?
verses.text: Shall I not visit them for these things? says Yahuah: shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

verses.raw: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.
verses.text: For the mountains will I take up a weeping and wailing, and for the habitations of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that none can pass through them; neither can men hear the voice of the cattle; both the fowl of the heavens and the beast are fled; they are gone.

verses.raw: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Yahudah (Judah) desolate, without an inhabitant.
verses.text: And I will make Jerusalem heaps, and a den of dragons; and I will make the cities of Yahudah desolate, without an inhabitant.

verses.raw: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of Yahuah (LORD) has spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perishes and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passes through?
verses.text: Who is the wise man, that may understand this? and who is he to whom the mouth of Yahuah has spoken, that he may declare it, for what the land perishes and is burned up like a wilderness, that none passes through?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) says, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;
verses.text: And Yahuah says, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither walked therein;

verses.raw: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:
verses.text: But have walked after the imagination of their own heart, and after Baalim, which their fathers taught them:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.

verses.raw: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.
verses.text: I will scatter them also among the heathen, whom neither they nor their fathers have known: and I will send a sword after them, till I have consumed them.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Consider you, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, Consider you, and call for the mourning women, that they may come; and send for cunning women, that they may come:

verses.raw: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
verses.text: And let them make haste, and take up a wailing for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.

verses.raw: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.
verses.text: For a voice of wailing is heard out of Zion, How are we spoiled! we are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because our dwellings have cast us out.

verses.raw: Yet hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O you women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.
verses.text: Yet hear the word of Yahuah, O you women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth, and teach your daughters wailing, and every one her neighbour lamentation.

verses.raw: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.
verses.text: For death is come up into our windows, and is entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from without, and the young men from the streets.

verses.raw: Speak, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.
verses.text: Speak, Thus says Yahuah, Even the carcases of men shall fall as dung upon the open field, and as the handful after the harvestman, and none shall gather them.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Let not the wise man glory in his wisdom, neither let the mighty man glory in his might, let not the rich man glory in his riches:

verses.raw: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understands and knows me, that I am Yahuah (LORD) which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But let him that glorieth glory in this, that he understands and knows me, that I am Yahuah which exercise lovingkindness, judgment, and righteousness, in the earth: for in these things I delight, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will punish all them which are circumcised with the uncircumcised;

verses.raw: Egypt, and Yahudah (Judah), and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) are uncircumcised in the heart.
verses.text: Egypt, and Yahudah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Yashar'el are uncircumcised in the heart.

verses.raw: Hear you the word which Yahuah (LORD) speaks unto you, O house of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Hear you the word which Yahuah speaks unto you, O house of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Learn not the way of the heathen, and be not dismayed at the signs of heaven; for the heathen are dismayed at them.

verses.raw: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.
verses.text: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

verses.raw: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
verses.text: They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.

verses.raw: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.
verses.text: They are upright as the palm tree, but speak not: they must needs be borne, because they cannot go. Be not afraid of them; for they cannot do evil, neither also is it in them to do good.

verses.raw: Forasmuch as there is none like unto you, O Yahuah (LORD); you are great, and your name is great in might.
verses.text: Forasmuch as there is none like unto you, O Yahuah; you are great, and your name is great in might.

verses.raw: Who would not fear you, O King of nations? for to you does it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto you.
verses.text: Who would not fear you, O King of nations? for to you does it appertain: forasmuch as among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like unto you.

verses.raw: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.
verses.text: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.

verses.raw: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.
verses.text: Silver spread into plates is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the workman, and of the hands of the founder: blue and purple is their clothing: they are all the work of cunning men.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) is the true Elohim (God), he is the living Elohim (God), and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.
verses.text: But Yahuah is the true Elohim, he is the living Elohim, and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.

verses.raw: Thus shall you say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.
verses.text: Thus shall you say unto them, The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth, even they shall perish from the earth, and from under these heavens.

verses.raw: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and has stretched out the heavens by his discretion.
verses.text: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and has stretched out the heavens by his discretion.

verses.raw: When he utters his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.text: When he utters his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasures.

verses.raw: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.text: Every man is brutish in his knowledge: every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

verses.raw: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.text: They are vanity, and the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

verses.raw: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Yashar'el (Israel) is the rod of his inheritance: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name.
verses.text: The portion of Jacob is not like them: for he is the former of all things; and Yashar'el is the rod of his inheritance: Yahuah Tseva'ot is his name.

verses.raw: Gather up your wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
verses.text: Gather up your wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will sling out the inhabitants of the land at this once, and will distress them, that they may find it so.

verses.raw: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.
verses.text: Woe is me for my hurt! my wound is grievous: but I said, Truly this is a grief, and I must bear it.

verses.raw: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.
verses.text: My tabernacle is spoiled, and all my cords are broken: my children are gone forth of me, and they are not: there is none to stretch forth my tent any more, and to set up my curtains.

verses.raw: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought Yahuah (LORD): therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.
verses.text: For the pastors are become brutish, and have not sought Yahuah: therefore they shall not prosper, and all their flocks shall be scattered.

verses.raw: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Yahudah (Judah) desolate, and a den of dragons.
verses.text: Behold, the noise of the bruit is come, and a great commotion out of the north country, to make the cities of Yahudah desolate, and a den of dragons.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walks to direct his steps.
verses.text: O Yahuah, I know that the way of man is not in himself: it is not in man that walks to direct his steps.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), correct me, but with judgment; not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing.
verses.text: O Yahuah, correct me, but with judgment; not in your anger, lest you bring me to nothing.

verses.raw: Pour out your fury upon the heathen that know you not, and upon the families that call not on your name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.
verses.text: Pour out your fury upon the heathen that know you not, and upon the families that call not on your name: for they have eaten up Jacob, and devoured him, and consumed him, and have made his habitation desolate.

verses.raw: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah from Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Hear you the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Yahudah (Judah), and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;
verses.text: Hear you the words of this covenant, and speak unto the men of Yahudah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem;

verses.raw: And say you unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,
verses.text: And say you unto them, Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el; Cursed be the man that obeyeth not the words of this covenant,

verses.raw: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall you be my people, and I will be your Elohim (God):
verses.text: Which I commanded your fathers in the day that I brought them forth out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace, saying, Obey my voice, and do them, according to all which I command you: so shall you be my people, and I will be your Elohim:

verses.raw: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: That I may perform the oath which I have sworn unto your fathers, to give them a land flowing with milk and honey, as it is this day. Then answered I, and said, So be it, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear you the words of this covenant, and do them.
verses.text: Then Yahuah said unto me, Proclaim all these words in the cities of Yahudah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear you the words of this covenant, and do them.

verses.raw: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.
verses.text: For I earnestly protested unto your fathers in the day that I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, even unto this day, rising early and protesting, saying, Obey my voice.

verses.raw: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.
verses.text: Yet they obeyed not, nor inclined their ear, but walked every one in the imagination of their evil heart: therefore I will bring upon them all the words of this covenant, which I commanded them to do; but they did them not.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Yahudah (Judah), and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Yahudah, and among the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Yahudah (Judah) have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.
verses.text: They are turned back to the iniquities of their forefathers, which refused to hear my words; and they went after other gods to serve them: the house of Yashar'el and the house of Yahudah have broken my covenant which I made with their fathers.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will bring evil upon them, which they shall not be able to escape; and though they shall cry unto me, I will not hearken unto them.

verses.raw: Then shall the cities of Yahudah (Judah) and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.
verses.text: Then shall the cities of Yahudah and inhabitants of Jerusalem go, and cry unto the gods unto whom they offer incense: but they shall not save them at all in the time of their trouble.

verses.raw: For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Yahudah (Judah); and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have you set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.
verses.text: For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Yahudah; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have you set up altars to that shameful thing, even altars to burn incense unto Baal.

verses.raw: Therefore pray not you for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.
verses.text: Therefore pray not you for this people, neither lift up a cry or prayer for them: for I will not hear them in the time that they cry unto me for their trouble.

verses.raw: What has my beloved to do in my house, seeing she has wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from you? when you do evil, then you rejoicest.
verses.text: What has my beloved to do in my house, seeing she has wrought lewdness with many, and the holy flesh is passed from you? when you do evil, then you rejoicest.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) called your name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he has kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.
verses.text: Yahuah called your name, A green olive tree, fair, and of goodly fruit: with the noise of a great tumult he has kindled fire upon it, and the branches of it are broken.

verses.raw: For Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that planted you, has pronounced evil against you, for the evil of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and of the house of Yahudah (Judah), which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.
verses.text: For Yahuah Tseva'ot, that planted you, has pronounced evil against you, for the evil of the house of Yashar'el and of the house of Yahudah, which they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger in offering incense unto Baal.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) has given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then you shewedst me their doings.
verses.text: And Yahuah has given me knowledge of it, and I know it: then you shewedst me their doings.

verses.raw: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.
verses.text: But I was like a lamb or an ox that is brought to the slaughter; and I knew not that they had devised devices against me, saying, Let us destroy the tree with the fruit thereof, and let us cut him off from the land of the living, that his name may be no more remembered.

verses.raw: But, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that judge righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see your vengeance on them: for unto you have I revealed my cause.
verses.text: But, O Yahuah Tseva'ot, that judge righteously, that triest the reins and the heart, let me see your vengeance on them: for unto you have I revealed my cause.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) of the men of Anathoth, that seek your life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of Yahuah (LORD), that you die not by our hand:
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah of the men of Anathoth, that seek your life, saying, Prophesy not in the name of Yahuah, that you die not by our hand:

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, Behold, I will punish them: the young men shall die by the sword; their sons and their daughters shall die by famine:

verses.raw: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.
verses.text: And there shall be no remnant of them: for I will bring evil upon the men of Anathoth, even the year of their visitation.

verses.raw: Righteous are you, O Yahuah (LORD), when I plead with you: yet let me talk with you of your judgments: Wherefore does the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?
verses.text: Righteous are you, O Yahuah, when I plead with you: yet let me talk with you of your judgments: Wherefore does the way of the wicked prosper? wherefore are all they happy that deal very treacherously?

verses.raw: You have planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: you are near in their mouth, and far from their reins.
verses.text: You have planted them, yea, they have taken root: they grow, yea, they bring forth fruit: you are near in their mouth, and far from their reins.

verses.raw: But you, O Yahuah (LORD), know me: you have seen me, and tried my heart toward you: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.
verses.text: But you, O Yahuah, know me: you have seen me, and tried my heart toward you: pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and prepare them for the day of slaughter.

verses.raw: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.
verses.text: How long shall the land mourn, and the herbs of every field wither, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein? the beasts are consumed, and the birds; because they said, He shall not see our last end.

verses.raw: If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein you trustedst, they wearied you, then how will you do in the swelling of Jordan?
verses.text: If you have run with the footmen, and they have wearied you, then how can you contend with horses? and if in the land of peace, wherein you trustedst, they wearied you, then how will you do in the swelling of Jordan?

verses.raw: For even your brethren, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; yea, they have called a multitude after you: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto you.
verses.text: For even your brethren, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you; yea, they have called a multitude after you: believe them not, though they speak fair words unto you.

verses.raw: I have forsaken my house, I have left my heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.
verses.text: I have forsaken my house, I have left my heritage; I have given the dearly beloved of my soul into the hand of her enemies.

verses.raw: My heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it cries out against me: therefore have I hated it.
verses.text: My heritage is unto me as a lion in the forest; it cries out against me: therefore have I hated it.

verses.raw: My heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come you, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.
verses.text: My heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her; come you, assemble all the beasts of the field, come to devour.

verses.raw: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.
verses.text: Many pastors have destroyed my vineyard, they have trodden my portion under foot, they have made my pleasant portion a desolate wilderness.

verses.raw: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourns unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man lays it to heart.
verses.text: They have made it desolate, and being desolate it mourns unto me; the whole land is made desolate, because no man lays it to heart.

verses.raw: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of Yahuah (LORD) shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.
verses.text: The spoilers are come upon all high places through the wilderness: for the sword of Yahuah shall devour from the one end of the land even to the other end of the land: no flesh shall have peace.

verses.raw: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: They have sown wheat, but shall reap thorns: they have put themselves to pain, but shall not profit: and they shall be ashamed of your revenues because of the fierce anger of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) against all my evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Yashar'el (Israel) to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Yahudah (Judah) from among them.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah against all my evil neighbours, that touch the inheritance which I have caused my people Yashar'el to inherit; Behold, I will pluck them out of their land, and pluck out the house of Yahudah from among them.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, after that I have plucked them out I will return, and have compassion on them, and will bring them again, every man to his heritage, and every man to his land.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, Yahuah (LORD) lives; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if they will diligently learn the ways of my people, to swear by my name, Yahuah lives; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall they be built in the midst of my people.

verses.raw: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But if they will not obey, I will utterly pluck up and destroy that nation, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto me, Go and get you a linen girdle, and put it upon your loins, and put it not in water.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah unto me, Go and get you a linen girdle, and put it upon your loins, and put it not in water.

verses.raw: So I got a girdle according to the word of Yahuah (LORD), and put it on my loins.
verses.text: So I got a girdle according to the word of Yahuah, and put it on my loins.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me the second time, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came unto me the second time, saying,

verses.raw: Take the girdle that you have got, which is upon your loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
verses.text: Take the girdle that you have got, which is upon your loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.

verses.raw: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as Yahuah (LORD) commanded me.
verses.text: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as Yahuah commanded me.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after many days, that Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded you to hide there.
verses.text: And it came to pass after many days, that Yahuah said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded you to hide there.

verses.raw: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
verses.text: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.

verses.raw: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Then the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), After this manner will I mar the pride of Yahudah (Judah), and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, After this manner will I mar the pride of Yahudah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
verses.text: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.

verses.raw: For as the girdle cleaves to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the whole house of Yahudah (Judah), says Yahuah (LORD); that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
verses.text: For as the girdle cleaves to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Yashar'el and the whole house of Yahudah, says Yahuah; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall speak unto them this word; Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto you, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
verses.text: Therefore you shall speak unto them this word; Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto you, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?

verses.raw: Then shall you say unto them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
verses.text: Then shall you say unto them, Thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.

verses.raw: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, says Yahuah (LORD): I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
verses.text: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, says Yahuah: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.

verses.raw: Hear you, and give ear; be not proud: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken.
verses.text: Hear you, and give ear; be not proud: for Yahuah has spoken.

verses.raw: Give glory to Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
verses.text: Give glory to Yahuah Elohaychem, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.

verses.raw: But if you will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and my eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD’S flock is carried away captive.
verses.text: But if you will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and my eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD’S flock is carried away captive.

verses.raw: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
verses.text: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.

verses.raw: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Yahudah (Judah) shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
verses.text: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Yahudah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.

verses.raw: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given you, your beautiful flock?
verses.text: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given you, your beautiful flock?

verses.raw: What will you say when he shall punish you? for you have taught them to be captains, and as chief over you: shall not sorrows take you, as a woman in travail?
verses.text: What will you say when he shall punish you? for you have taught them to be captains, and as chief over you: shall not sorrows take you, as a woman in travail?

verses.raw: And if you say in your heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of your iniquity are your skirts discovered, and your heels made bare.
verses.text: And if you say in your heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of your iniquity are your skirts discovered, and your heels made bare.

verses.raw: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may you also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
verses.text: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may you also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.

verses.raw: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.
verses.text: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passes away by the wind of the wilderness.

verses.raw: This is your lot, the portion of your measures from me, says Yahuah (LORD); because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
verses.text: This is your lot, the portion of your measures from me, says Yahuah; because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.

verses.raw: Therefore will I discover your skirts upon your face, that your shame may appear.
verses.text: Therefore will I discover your skirts upon your face, that your shame may appear.

verses.raw: I have seen your adulteries, and your neighings, the lewdness of your whoredom, and your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto you, O Jerusalem! will you not be made clean? when shall it once be?
verses.text: I have seen your adulteries, and your neighings, the lewdness of your whoredom, and your abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto you, O Jerusalem! will you not be made clean? when shall it once be?

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.
verses.text: The word of Yahuah that came to Jeremiah concerning the dearth.

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah) mourns, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.
verses.text: Yahudah mourns, and the gates thereof languish; they are black unto the ground; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up.

verses.raw: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
verses.text: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.

verses.raw: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.
verses.text: Because the ground is chapt, for there was no rain in the earth, the plowmen were ashamed, they covered their heads.

verses.raw: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.
verses.text: Yea, the hind also calved in the field, and forsook it, because there was no grass.

verses.raw: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.
verses.text: And the wild asses did stand in the high places, they snuffed up the wind like dragons; their eyes did fail, because there was no grass.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), though our iniquities testify against us, do you it for your name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you.
verses.text: O Yahuah, though our iniquities testify against us, do you it for your name’s sake: for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you.

verses.raw: O the hope of Yashar'el (Israel), the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why should you be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turns aside to tarry for a night?
verses.text: O the hope of Yashar'el, the saviour thereof in time of trouble, why should you be as a stranger in the land, and as a wayfaring man that turns aside to tarry for a night?

verses.raw: Why should you be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet you, O Yahuah (LORD), are in the midst of us, and we are called by your name; leave us not.
verses.text: Why should you be as a man astonied, as a mighty man that cannot save? yet you, O Yahuah, are in the midst of us, and we are called by your name; leave us not.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore Yahuah (LORD) does not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah unto this people, Thus have they loved to wander, they have not refrained their feet, therefore Yahuah does not accept them; he will now remember their iniquity, and visit their sins.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.
verses.text: Then said Yahuah unto me, Pray not for this people for their good.

verses.raw: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.
verses.text: When they fast, I will not hear their cry; and when they offer burnt offering and an oblation, I will not accept them: but I will consume them by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence.

verses.raw: Then said I, Ah, Adonai (Lord) GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, You shall not see the sword, neither shall you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.
verses.text: Then said I, Ah, Adonai GOD! behold, the prophets say unto them, You shall not see the sword, neither shall you have famine; but I will give you assured peace in this place.

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (LORD) said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.
verses.text: Then Yahuah said unto me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, neither have I commanded them, neither spake unto them: they prophesy unto you a false vision and divination, and a thing of nought, and the deceit of their heart.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah concerning the prophets that prophesy in my name, and I sent them not, yet they say, Sword and famine shall not be in this land; By sword and famine shall those prophets be consumed.

verses.raw: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.
verses.text: And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword; and they shall have none to bury them, them, their wives, nor their sons, nor their daughters: for I will pour their wickedness upon them.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall say this word unto them; Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.
verses.text: Therefore you shall say this word unto them; Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease: for the virgin daughter of my people is broken with a great breach, with a very grievous blow.

verses.raw: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.
verses.text: If I go forth into the field, then behold the slain with the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold them that are sick with famine! yea, both the prophet and the priest go about into a land that they know not.

verses.raw: Have you utterly rejected Yahudah (Judah)? has your soul lothed Zion? why have you smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!
verses.text: Have you utterly rejected Yahudah? has your soul lothed Zion? why have you smitten us, and there is no healing for us? we looked for peace, and there is no good; and for the time of healing, and behold trouble!

verses.raw: We acknowledge, O Yahuah (LORD), our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against you.
verses.text: We acknowledge, O Yahuah, our wickedness, and the iniquity of our fathers: for we have sinned against you.

verses.raw: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of your glory: remember, break not your covenant with us.
verses.text: Do not abhor us, for your name’s sake, do not disgrace the throne of your glory: remember, break not your covenant with us.

verses.raw: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? are not you he, O Yahuah (LORD) our Elohim (God)? therefore we will wait upon you: for you have made all these things.
verses.text: Are there any among the vanities of the Gentiles that can cause rain? or can the heavens give showers? are not you he, O Yahuah our Elohim? therefore we will wait upon you: for you have made all these things.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.
verses.text: Then said Yahuah unto me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before me, yet my mind could not be toward this people: cast them out of my sight, and let them go forth.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto you, Whither shall we go forth? then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if they say unto you, Whither shall we go forth? then you shall tell them, Thus says Yahuah; Such as are for death, to death; and such as are for the sword, to the sword; and such as are for the famine, to the famine; and such as are for the captivity, to the captivity.

verses.raw: And I will appoint over them four kinds, says Yahuah (LORD): the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.
verses.text: And I will appoint over them four kinds, says Yahuah: the sword to slay, and the dogs to tear, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the earth, to devour and destroy.

verses.raw: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), for that which he did in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And I will cause them to be removed into all kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah king of Yahudah, for that which he did in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: For who shall have pity upon you, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan you? or who shall go aside to ask how you do?
verses.text: For who shall have pity upon you, O Jerusalem? or who shall bemoan you? or who shall go aside to ask how you do?

verses.raw: You have forsaken me, says Yahuah (LORD), you are gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against you, and destroy you; I am weary with repenting.
verses.text: You have forsaken me, says Yahuah, you are gone backward: therefore will I stretch out my hand against you, and destroy you; I am weary with repenting.

verses.raw: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.
verses.text: And I will fan them with a fan in the gates of the land; I will bereave them of children, I will destroy my people, since they return not from their ways.

verses.raw: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.
verses.text: Their widows are increased to me above the sand of the seas: I have brought upon them against the mother of the young men a spoiler at noonday: I have caused him to fall upon it suddenly, and terrors upon the city.

verses.raw: She that has borne seven languisheth: she has given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she has been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: She that has borne seven languisheth: she has given up the ghost; her sun is gone down while it was yet day: she has been ashamed and confounded: and the residue of them will I deliver to the sword before their enemies, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them does curse me.
verses.text: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me a man of strife and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have neither lent on usury, nor men have lent to me on usury; yet every one of them does curse me.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) said, Verily it shall be well with your remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat you well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.
verses.text: Yahuah said, Verily it shall be well with your remnant; verily I will cause the enemy to entreat you well in the time of evil and in the time of affliction.

verses.raw: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
verses.text: Shall iron break the northern iron and the steel?
