verses.raw: Your substance and your treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.
verses.text: Your substance and your treasures will I give to the spoil without price, and that for all your sins, even in all your borders.

verses.raw: And I will make you to pass with your enemies into a land which you know not: for a fire is kindled in my anger, which shall burn upon you.
verses.text: And I will make you to pass with your enemies into a land which you know not: for a fire is kindled in my anger, which shall burn upon you.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), you know: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in your longsuffering: know that for your sake I have suffered rebuke.
verses.text: O Yahuah, you know: remember me, and visit me, and revenge me of my persecutors; take me not away in your longsuffering: know that for your sake I have suffered rebuke.

verses.raw: Your words were found, and I did eat them; and your word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of my heart: for I am called by your name, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of hosts.
verses.text: Your words were found, and I did eat them; and your word was unto me the joy and rejoicing of my heart: for I am called by your name, O Yahuah Elohim of hosts.

verses.raw: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of your hand: for you have filled me with indignation.
verses.text: I sat not in the assembly of the mockers, nor rejoiced; I sat alone because of your hand: for you have filled me with indignation.

verses.raw: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? will you be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?
verses.text: Why is my pain perpetual, and my wound incurable, which refuses to be healed? will you be altogether unto me as a liar, and as waters that fail?

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD), If you return, then will I bring you again, and you shall stand before me: and if you take forth the precious from the vile, you shall be as my mouth: let them return unto you; but return not you unto them.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah, If you return, then will I bring you again, and you shall stand before me: and if you take forth the precious from the vile, you shall be as my mouth: let them return unto you; but return not you unto them.

verses.raw: And I will make you unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against you, but they shall not prevail against you: for I am with you to save you and to deliver you, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will make you unto this people a fenced brasen wall: and they shall fight against you, but they shall not prevail against you: for I am with you to save you and to deliver you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.
verses.text: And I will deliver you out of the hand of the wicked, and I will redeem you out of the hand of the terrible.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) came also unto me, saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah came also unto me, saying,

verses.raw: You shall not take you a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters in this place.
verses.text: You shall not take you a wife, neither shall you have sons or daughters in this place.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that bare them, and concerning their fathers that begat them in this land;

verses.raw: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.text: They shall die of grievous deaths; they shall not be lamented; neither shall they be buried; but they shall be as dung upon the face of the earth: and they shall be consumed by the sword, and by famine; and their carcases shall be meat for the fowls of heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, says Yahuah (LORD), even lovingkindness and mercies.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, Enter not into the house of mourning, neither go to lament nor bemoan them: for I have taken away my peace from this people, says Yahuah, even lovingkindness and mercies.

verses.raw: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:
verses.text: Both the great and the small shall die in this land: they shall not be buried, neither shall men lament for them, nor cut themselves, nor make themselves bald for them:

verses.raw: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.
verses.text: Neither shall men tear themselves for them in mourning, to comfort them for the dead; neither shall men give them the cup of consolation to drink for their father or for their mother.

verses.raw: You shall not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.
verses.text: You shall not also go into the house of feasting, to sit with them to eat and to drink.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will cause to cease out of this place in your eyes, and in your days, the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when you shall shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto you, Wherefore has Yahuah (LORD) pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God)?
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when you shall shew this people all these words, and they shall say unto you, Wherefore has Yahuah pronounced all this great evil against us? or what is our iniquity? or what is our sin that we have committed against Yahuah Eloheinu?

verses.raw: Then shall you say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, says Yahuah (LORD), and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;
verses.text: Then shall you say unto them, Because your fathers have forsaken me, says Yahuah, and have walked after other gods, and have served them, and have worshipped them, and have forsaken me, and have not kept my law;

verses.raw: And you have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, you walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:
verses.text: And you have done worse than your fathers; for, behold, you walk every one after the imagination of his evil heart, that they may not hearken unto me:

verses.raw: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that you know not, neither you nor your fathers; and there shall you serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.
verses.text: Therefore will I cast you out of this land into a land that you know not, neither you nor your fathers; and there shall you serve other gods day and night; where I will not shew you favour.

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that it shall no more be said, Yahuah (LORD) lives, that brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt;
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that it shall no more be said, Yahuah lives, that brought up the children of Yashar'el out of the land of Egypt;

verses.raw: But, Yahuah (LORD) lives, that brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.
verses.text: But, Yahuah lives, that brought up the children of Yashar'el from the land of the north, and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.

verses.raw: Behold, I will send for many fishers, says Yahuah (LORD), and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.
verses.text: Behold, I will send for many fishers, says Yahuah, and they shall fish them; and after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.

verses.raw: For my eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from my eyes.
verses.text: For my eyes are upon all their ways: they are not hid from my face, neither is their iniquity hid from my eyes.

verses.raw: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled my inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.
verses.text: And first I will recompense their iniquity and their sin double; because they have defiled my land, they have filled my inheritance with the carcases of their detestable and abominable things.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto you from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.
verses.text: O Yahuah, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto you from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.

verses.raw: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?
verses.text: Shall a man make gods unto himself, and they are no gods?

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know my hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will this once cause them to know, I will cause them to know my hand and my might; and they shall know that my name is Yahuah.

verses.raw: The sin of Yahudah (Judah) is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;
verses.text: The sin of Yahudah is written with a pen of iron, and with the point of a diamond: it is graven upon the table of their heart, and upon the horns of your altars;

verses.raw: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.
verses.text: Whilst their children remember their altars and their groves by the green trees upon the high hills.

verses.raw: O my mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures to the spoil, and your high places for sin, throughout all your borders.
verses.text: O my mountain in the field, I will give your substance and all your treasures to the spoil, and your high places for sin, throughout all your borders.

verses.raw: And you, even thyself, shall discontinue from your heritage that I gave you; and I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you know not: for you have kindled a fire in my anger, which shall burn for ever.
verses.text: And you, even thyself, shall discontinue from your heritage that I gave you; and I will cause you to serve your enemies in the land which you know not: for you have kindled a fire in my anger, which shall burn for ever.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Cursed be the man that trusts in man, and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart departs from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Cursed be the man that trusts in man, and makes flesh his arm, and whose heart departs from Yahuah.

verses.raw: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good comes; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.
verses.text: For he shall be like the heath in the desert, and shall not see when good comes; but shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, in a salt land and not inhabited.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man that trusts in Yahuah (LORD), and whose hope Yahuah (LORD) is.
verses.text: Blessed is the man that trusts in Yahuah, and whose hope Yahuah is.

verses.raw: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreads out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat comes, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.
verses.text: For he shall be as a tree planted by the waters, and that spreads out her roots by the river, and shall not see when heat comes, but her leaf shall be green; and shall not be careful in the year of drought, neither shall cease from yielding fruit.

verses.raw: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?
verses.text: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

verses.raw: I Yahuah (LORD) search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.
verses.text: I Yahuah search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.

verses.raw: As the partridge sits on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that gets riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.
verses.text: As the partridge sits on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that gets riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.

verses.raw: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.
verses.text: A glorious high throne from the beginning is the place of our sanctuary.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), the hope of Yashar'el (Israel), all that forsake you shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahuah (LORD), the fountain of living waters.
verses.text: O Yahuah, the hope of Yashar'el, all that forsake you shall be ashamed, and they that depart from me shall be written in the earth, because they have forsaken Yahuah, the fountain of living waters.

verses.raw: Heal me, O Yahuah (LORD), and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for you are my praise.
verses.text: Heal me, O Yahuah, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for you are my praise.

verses.raw: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of Yahuah (LORD)? let it come now.
verses.text: Behold, they say unto me, Where is the word of Yahuah? let it come now.

verses.raw: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow you: neither have I desired the woeful day; you know: that which came out of my lips was right before you.
verses.text: As for me, I have not hastened from being a pastor to follow you: neither have I desired the woeful day; you know: that which came out of my lips was right before you.

verses.raw: Be not a terror unto me: you are my hope in the day of evil.
verses.text: Be not a terror unto me: you are my hope in the day of evil.

verses.raw: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.
verses.text: Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.

verses.raw: Thus said Yahuah (LORD) unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Yahudah (Judah) come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.text: Thus said Yahuah unto me; Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, whereby the kings of Yahudah come in, and by the which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

verses.raw: And say unto them, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD), you kings of Yahudah (Judah), and all Yahudah (Judah), and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:
verses.text: And say unto them, Hear you the word of Yahuah, you kings of Yahudah, and all Yahudah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by these gates:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the sabbath day, nor bring it in by the gates of Jerusalem;

verses.raw: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do you any work, but hallow you the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.
verses.text: Neither carry forth a burden out of your houses on the sabbath day, neither do you any work, but hallow you the sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

verses.raw: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.
verses.text: But they obeyed not, neither inclined their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear, nor receive instruction.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, if you diligently hearken unto me, says Yahuah (LORD), to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, if you diligently hearken unto me, says Yahuah, to bring in no burden through the gates of this city on the sabbath day, but hallow the sabbath day, to do no work therein;

verses.raw: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Yahudah (Judah), and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.
verses.text: Then shall there enter into the gates of this city kings and princes sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they, and their princes, the men of Yahudah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and this city shall remain for ever.

verses.raw: And they shall come from the cities of Yahudah (Judah), and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they shall come from the cities of Yahudah, and from the places about Jerusalem, and from the land of Benjamin, and from the plain, and from the mountains, and from the south, bringing burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and meat offerings, and incense, and bringing sacrifices of praise, unto the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: But if you will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.
verses.text: But if you will not hearken unto me to hallow the sabbath day, and not to bear a burden, even entering in at the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched.

verses.raw: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), saying,
verses.text: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahuah, saying,

verses.raw: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.
verses.text: Arise, and go down to the potter’s house, and there I will cause you to hear my words.

verses.raw: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.
verses.text: Then I went down to the potter’s house, and, behold, he wrought a work on the wheels.

verses.raw: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.
verses.text: And the vessel that he made of clay was marred in the hand of the potter: so he made it again another vessel, as seemed good to the potter to make it.

verses.raw: Then the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to me, saying,
verses.text: Then the word of Yahuah came to me, saying,

verses.raw: O house of Yashar'el (Israel), cannot I do with you as this potter? says Yahuah (LORD). Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, O house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: O house of Yashar'el, cannot I do with you as this potter? says Yahuah. Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, O house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;
verses.text: At what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to pluck up, and to pull down, and to destroy it;

verses.raw: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.
verses.text: If that nation, against whom I have pronounced, turn from their evil, I will repent of the evil that I thought to do unto them.

verses.raw: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;
verses.text: And at what instant I shall speak concerning a nation, and concerning a kingdom, to build and to plant it;

verses.raw: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.
verses.text: If it do evil in my sight, that it obey not my voice, then I will repent of the good, wherewith I said I would benefit them.

verses.raw: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Yahudah (Judah), and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return you now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.
verses.text: Now therefore go to, speak to the men of Yahudah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, Thus says Yahuah; Behold, I frame evil against you, and devise a device against you: return you now every one from his evil way, and make your ways and your doings good.

verses.raw: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.
verses.text: And they said, There is no hope: but we will walk after our own devices, and we will every one do the imagination of his evil heart.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Ask you now among the heathen, who has heard such things: the virgin of Yashar'el (Israel) has done a very horrible thing.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; Ask you now among the heathen, who has heard such things: the virgin of Yashar'el has done a very horrible thing.

verses.raw: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which comes from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?
verses.text: Will a man leave the snow of Lebanon which comes from the rock of the field? or shall the cold flowing waters that come from another place be forsaken?

verses.raw: Because my people has forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;
verses.text: Because my people has forgotten me, they have burned incense to vanity, and they have caused them to stumble in their ways from the ancient paths, to walk in paths, in a way not cast up;

verses.raw: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passes thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.
verses.text: To make their land desolate, and a perpetual hissing; every one that passes thereby shall be astonished, and wag his head.

verses.raw: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.
verses.text: I will scatter them as with an east wind before the enemy; I will shew them the back, and not the face, in the day of their calamity.

verses.raw: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.
verses.text: Then said they, Come, and let us devise devices against Jeremiah; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us smite him with the tongue, and let us not give heed to any of his words.

verses.raw: Give heed to me, O Yahuah (LORD), and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.
verses.text: Give heed to me, O Yahuah, and hearken to the voice of them that contend with me.

verses.raw: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before you to speak good for them, and to turn away your wrath from them.
verses.text: Shall evil be recompensed for good? for they have digged a pit for my soul. Remember that I stood before you to speak good for them, and to turn away your wrath from them.

verses.raw: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.
verses.text: Therefore deliver up their children to the famine, and pour out their blood by the force of the sword; and let their wives be bereaved of their children, and be widows; and let their men be put to death; let their young men be slain by the sword in battle.

verses.raw: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when you shall bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.
verses.text: Let a cry be heard from their houses, when you shall bring a troop suddenly upon them: for they have digged a pit to take me, and hid snares for my feet.

verses.raw: Yet, Yahuah (LORD), you know all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from your sight, but let them be overthrown before you; deal thus with them in the time of your anger.
verses.text: Yet, Yahuah, you know all their counsel against me to slay me: forgive not their iniquity, neither blot out their sin from your sight, but let them be overthrown before you; deal thus with them in the time of your anger.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Go and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Go and get a potter’s earthen bottle, and take of the ancients of the people, and of the ancients of the priests;

verses.raw: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell you,
verses.text: And go forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is by the entry of the east gate, and proclaim there the words that I shall tell you,

verses.raw: And say, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD), O kings of Yahudah (Judah), and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever hears, his ears shall tingle.
verses.text: And say, Hear you the word of Yahuah, O kings of Yahudah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever hears, his ears shall tingle.

verses.raw: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Yahudah (Judah), and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;
verses.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have estranged this place, and have burned incense in it unto other gods, whom neither they nor their fathers have known, nor the kings of Yahudah, and have filled this place with the blood of innocents;

verses.raw: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:
verses.text: They have built also the high places of Baal, to burn their sons with fire for burnt offerings unto Baal, which I commanded not, nor spake it, neither came it into my mind:

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that this place shall no more be called Tophet, nor The valley of the son of Hinnom, but The valley of slaughter.

verses.raw: And I will make void the counsel of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.
verses.text: And I will make void the counsel of Yahudah and Jerusalem in this place; and I will cause them to fall by the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and their carcases will I give to be meat for the fowls of the heaven, and for the beasts of the earth.

verses.raw: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passes thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.
verses.text: And I will make this city desolate, and an hissing; every one that passes thereby shall be astonished and hiss because of all the plagues thereof.

verses.raw: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.
verses.text: And I will cause them to eat the flesh of their sons and the flesh of their daughters, and they shall eat every one the flesh of his friend in the siege and straitness, wherewith their enemies, and they that seek their lives, shall straiten them.

verses.raw: Then shall you break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with you,
verses.text: Then shall you break the bottle in the sight of the men that go with you,

verses.raw: And shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.
verses.text: And shall say unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Even so will I break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s vessel, that cannot be made whole again: and they shall bury them in Tophet, till there be no place to bury.

verses.raw: Thus will I do unto this place, says Yahuah (LORD), and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:
verses.text: Thus will I do unto this place, says Yahuah, and to the inhabitants thereof, and even make this city as Tophet:

verses.raw: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.
verses.text: And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Yahudah, shall be defiled as the place of Tophet, because of all the houses upon whose roofs they have burned incense unto all the host of heaven, and have poured out drink offerings unto other gods.

verses.raw: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither Yahuah (LORD) had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’S house; and said to all the people,
verses.text: Then came Jeremiah from Tophet, whither Yahuah had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the LORD’S house; and said to all the people,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will bring upon this city and upon all her towns all the evil that I have pronounced against it, because they have hardened their necks, that they might not hear my words.

verses.raw: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of Yahuah (LORD), heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.
verses.text: Now Pashur the son of Immer the priest, who was also chief governor in the house of Yahuah, heard that Jeremiah prophesied these things.

verses.raw: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then Pashur smote Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the high gate of Benjamin, which was by the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, Yahuah (LORD) has not called your name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Pashur brought forth Jeremiah out of the stocks. Then said Jeremiah unto him, Yahuah has not called your name Pashur, but Magor-missabib.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD), Behold, I will make you a terror to thyself, and to all your friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Yahudah (Judah) into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah, Behold, I will make you a terror to thyself, and to all your friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall behold it: and I will give all Yahudah into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall carry them captive into Babylon, and shall slay them with the sword.

verses.raw: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Yahudah (Judah) will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.
verses.text: Moreover I will deliver all the strength of this city, and all the labours thereof, and all the precious things thereof, and all the treasures of the kings of Yahudah will I give into the hand of their enemies, which shall spoil them, and take them, and carry them to Babylon.

verses.raw: And you, Pashur, and all that dwell in your house shall go into captivity: and you shall come to Babylon, and there you shall die, and shall be buried there, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied lies.
verses.text: And you, Pashur, and all that dwell in your house shall go into captivity: and you shall come to Babylon, and there you shall die, and shall be buried there, you, and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied lies.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), you have deceived me, and I was deceived: you are stronger than I, and have prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocks me.
verses.text: O Yahuah, you have deceived me, and I was deceived: you are stronger than I, and have prevailed: I am in derision daily, every one mocks me.

verses.raw: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of Yahuah (LORD) was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.
verses.text: For since I spake, I cried out, I cried violence and spoil; because the word of Yahuah was made a reproach unto me, and a derision, daily.

verses.raw: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in my heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.
verses.text: Then I said, I will not make mention of him, nor speak any more in his name. But his word was in my heart as a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I was weary with forbearing, and I could not stay.

verses.raw: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.
verses.text: For I heard the defaming of many, fear on every side. Report, say they, and we will report it. All my familiars watched for my halting, saying, Peradventure he will be enticed, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall take our revenge on him.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.
verses.text: But Yahuah is with me as a mighty terrible one: therefore my persecutors shall stumble, and they shall not prevail: they shall be greatly ashamed; for they shall not prosper: their everlasting confusion shall never be forgotten.

verses.raw: But, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that triest the righteous, and see the reins and the heart, let me see your vengeance on them: for unto you have I opened my cause.
verses.text: But, O Yahuah Tseva'ot, that triest the righteous, and see the reins and the heart, let me see your vengeance on them: for unto you have I opened my cause.

verses.raw: Sing unto Yahuah (LORD), praise you Yahuah (LORD): for he has delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.
verses.text: Sing unto Yahuah, praise you Yahuah: for he has delivered the soul of the poor from the hand of evildoers.

verses.raw: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
verses.text: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.

verses.raw: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto you; making him very glad.
verses.text: Cursed be the man who brought tidings to my father, saying, A man child is born unto you; making him very glad.

verses.raw: And let that man be as the cities which Yahuah (LORD) overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;
verses.text: And let that man be as the cities which Yahuah overthrew, and repented not: and let him hear the cry in the morning, and the shouting at noontide;

verses.raw: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.
verses.text: Because he slew me not from the womb; or that my mother might have been my grave, and her womb to be always great with me.

verses.raw: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?
verses.text: Wherefore came I forth out of the womb to see labour and sorrow, that my days should be consumed with shame?

verses.raw: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah (LORD), when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
verses.text: The word which came unto Jeremiah from Yahuah, when king Zedekiah sent unto him Pashur the son of Melchiah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

verses.raw: Enquire, I pray you, of Yahuah (LORD) for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon makes war against us; if so be that Yahuah (LORD) will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.
verses.text: Enquire, I pray you, of Yahuah for us; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon makes war against us; if so be that Yahuah will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

verses.raw: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall you say to Zedekiah:
verses.text: Then said Jeremiah unto them, Thus shall you say to Zedekiah:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, wherewith you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans, which besiege you without the walls, and I will assemble them into the midst of this city.

verses.raw: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.
verses.text: And I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath.

verses.raw: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.
verses.text: And I will smite the inhabitants of this city, both man and beast: they shall die of a great pestilence.

verses.raw: And afterward, says Yahuah (LORD), I will deliver Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.
verses.text: And afterward, says Yahuah, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Yahudah, and his servants, and the people, and such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those that seek their life: and he shall smite them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

verses.raw: And unto this people you shall say, Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.
verses.text: And unto this people you shall say, Thus says Yahuah; Behold, I set before you the way of life, and the way of death.

verses.raw: He that abides in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goes out, and falls to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.
verses.text: He that abides in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence: but he that goes out, and falls to the Chaldeans that besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be unto him for a prey.

verses.raw: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, says Yahuah (LORD): it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.
verses.text: For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good, says Yahuah: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

verses.raw: And touching the house of the king of Yahudah (Judah), say, Hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: And touching the house of the king of Yahudah, say, Hear you the word of Yahuah;

verses.raw: O house of David, thus says Yahuah (LORD); Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.
verses.text: O house of David, thus says Yahuah; Execute judgment in the morning, and deliver him that is spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my fury go out like fire, and burn that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

verses.raw: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, says Yahuah (LORD); which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?
verses.text: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and rock of the plain, says Yahuah; which say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

verses.raw: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says Yahuah (LORD): and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.
verses.text: But I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says Yahuah: and I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Go down to the house of the king of Yahudah (Judah), and speak there this word,
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Go down to the house of the king of Yahudah, and speak there this word,

verses.raw: And say, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), O king of Yahudah (Judah), that sit upon the throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people that enter in by these gates:
verses.text: And say, Hear the word of Yahuah, O king of Yahudah, that sit upon the throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people that enter in by these gates:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Execute you judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Execute you judgment and righteousness, and deliver the spoiled out of the hand of the oppressor: and do no wrong, do no violence to the stranger, the fatherless, nor the widow, neither shed innocent blood in this place.

verses.raw: For if you do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.
verses.text: For if you do this thing indeed, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, he, and his servants, and his people.

verses.raw: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself, says Yahuah (LORD), that this house shall become a desolation.
verses.text: But if you will not hear these words, I swear by myself, says Yahuah, that this house shall become a desolation.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto the king’s house of Yahudah (Judah); You are Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make you a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah unto the king’s house of Yahudah; You are Gilead unto me, and the head of Lebanon: yet surely I will make you a wilderness, and cities which are not inhabited.

verses.raw: And I will prepare destroyers against you, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.
verses.text: And I will prepare destroyers against you, every one with his weapons: and they shall cut down your choice cedars, and cast them into the fire.

verses.raw: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore has Yahuah (LORD) done thus unto this great city?
verses.text: And many nations shall pass by this city, and they shall say every man to his neighbour, Wherefore has Yahuah done thus unto this great city?

verses.raw: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and worshipped other gods, and served them.
verses.text: Then they shall answer, Because they have forsaken the covenant of Yahuah their Elohim, and worshipped other gods, and served them.

verses.raw: Weep you not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goes away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.
verses.text: Weep you not for the dead, neither bemoan him: but weep sore for him that goes away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native country.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah touching Shallum the son of Josiah king of Yahudah, which reigned instead of Josiah his father, which went forth out of this place; He shall not return thither any more:

verses.raw: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.
verses.text: But he shall die in the place whither they have led him captive, and shall see this land no more.

verses.raw: Woe unto him that builds his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and gives him not for his work;
verses.text: Woe unto him that builds his house by unrighteousness, and his chambers by wrong; that useth his neighbour’s service without wages, and gives him not for his work;

verses.raw: That says, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
verses.text: That says, I will build me a wide house and large chambers, and cutteth him out windows; and it is cieled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.

verses.raw: Shall you reign, because you closest thyself in cedar? did not your father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?
verses.text: Shall you reign, because you closest thyself in cedar? did not your father eat and drink, and do judgment and justice, and then it was well with him?

verses.raw: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well with him: was not this to know me? says Yahuah.

verses.raw: But your eyes and your heart are not but for your covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.
verses.text: But your eyes and your heart are not but for your covetousness, and for to shed innocent blood, and for oppression, and for violence, to do it.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD) concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah); They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah; They shall not lament for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they shall not lament for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!

verses.raw: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
verses.text: He shall be buried with the burial of an ass, drawn and cast forth beyond the gates of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all your lovers are destroyed.
verses.text: Go up to Lebanon, and cry; and lift up your voice in Bashan, and cry from the passages: for all your lovers are destroyed.

verses.raw: I spake unto you in your prosperity; but you saidst, I will not hear. This has been your manner from your youth, that you obeyedst not my voice.
verses.text: I spake unto you in your prosperity; but you saidst, I will not hear. This has been your manner from your youth, that you obeyedst not my voice.

verses.raw: The wind shall eat up all your pastors, and your lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shall you be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.
verses.text: The wind shall eat up all your pastors, and your lovers shall go into captivity: surely then shall you be ashamed and confounded for all your wickedness.

verses.raw: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that make your nest in the cedars, how gracious shall you be when pangs come upon you, the pain as of a woman in travail!
verses.text: O inhabitant of Lebanon, that make your nest in the cedars, how gracious shall you be when pangs come upon you, the pain as of a woman in travail!

verses.raw: As I live, says Yahuah (LORD), though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah) were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck you thence;
verses.text: As I live, says Yahuah, though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah were the signet upon my right hand, yet would I pluck you thence;

verses.raw: And I will give you into the hand of them that seek your life, and into the hand of them whose face you fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.text: And I will give you into the hand of them that seek your life, and into the hand of them whose face you fearest, even into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of the Chaldeans.

verses.raw: And I will cast you out, and your mother that bare you, into another country, where you were not born; and there shall you die.
verses.text: And I will cast you out, and your mother that bare you, into another country, where you were not born; and there shall you die.

verses.raw: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.
verses.text: But to the land whereunto they desire to return, thither shall they not return.

verses.raw: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?
verses.text: Is this man Coniah a despised broken idol? is he a vessel wherein is no pleasure? wherefore are they cast out, he and his seed, and are cast into a land which they know not?

verses.raw: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: O earth, earth, earth, hear the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), Write you this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Write you this man childless, a man that shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Yahudah.

verses.raw: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) against the pastors that feed my people; You have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el against the pastors that feed my people; You have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
verses.text: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.

verses.raw: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
verses.text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

verses.raw: In his days Yahudah (Judah) shall be saved, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, Yahuah Tsidkenu (THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS).
verses.text: In his days Yahudah shall be saved, and Yashar'el shall dwell safely: and this is his name whereby he shall be called, Yahuah Tsidkenu.

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that they shall no more say, Yahuah (LORD) lives, which brought up the children of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land of Egypt;
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that they shall no more say, Yahuah lives, which brought up the children of Yashar'el out of the land of Egypt;

verses.raw: But, Yahuah (LORD) lives, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
verses.text: But, Yahuah lives, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Yashar'el out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.

verses.raw: My heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahuah (LORD), and because of the words of his holiness.
verses.text: My heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine has overcome, because of Yahuah, and because of the words of his holiness.

verses.raw: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourns; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.
verses.text: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourns; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force is not right.

verses.raw: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery ways in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, even the year of their visitation, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Yashar'el (Israel) to err.
verses.text: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Yashar'el to err.

verses.raw: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
verses.text: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none does return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, and not out of the mouth of Yahuah.

verses.raw: They say still unto them that despise me, Yahuah (LORD) has said, You shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walks after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
verses.text: They say still unto them that despise me, Yahuah has said, You shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walks after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.

verses.raw: For who has stood in the counsel of Yahuah (LORD), and has perceived and heard his word? who has marked his word, and heard it?
verses.text: For who has stood in the counsel of Yahuah, and has perceived and heard his word? who has marked his word, and heard it?

verses.raw: Behold, a whirlwind of Yahuah (LORD) is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
verses.text: Behold, a whirlwind of Yahuah is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.

verses.raw: The anger of Yahuah (LORD) shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days you shall consider it perfectly.
verses.text: The anger of Yahuah shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days you shall consider it perfectly.

verses.raw: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
verses.text: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

verses.raw: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
verses.text: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.

verses.raw: Am I a Elohim (God) at hand, says Yahuah (LORD), and not a Elohim (God) afar off?
verses.text: Am I a Elohim at hand, says Yahuah, and not a Elohim afar off?

verses.raw: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? says Yahuah (LORD). Do not I fill heaven and earth? says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? says Yahuah. Do not I fill heaven and earth? says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
verses.text: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.

verses.raw: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
verses.text: How long shall this be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, they are prophets of the deceit of their own heart;

verses.raw: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
verses.text: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.

verses.raw: The prophet that has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The prophet that has a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that has my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What is the chaff to the wheat? says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Is not my word like as a fire? says Yahuah (LORD); and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?
verses.text: Is not my word like as a fire? says Yahuah; and like a hammer that breaks the rock in pieces?

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahuah (LORD), that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahuah, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.

verses.raw: Behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahuah (LORD), that use their tongues, and say, He says.
verses.text: Behold, I am against the prophets, says Yahuah, that use their tongues, and say, He says.

verses.raw: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, says Yahuah (LORD), and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Behold, I am against them that prophesy false dreams, says Yahuah, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask you, saying, What is the burden of Yahuah (LORD)? you shall then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask you, saying, What is the burden of Yahuah? you shall then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of Yahuah (LORD), I will even punish that man and his house.
verses.text: And as for the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of Yahuah, I will even punish that man and his house.

verses.raw: Thus shall you say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What has Yahuah (LORD) answered? and, What has Yahuah (LORD) spoken?
verses.text: Thus shall you say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What has Yahuah answered? and, What has Yahuah spoken?

verses.raw: And the burden of Yahuah (LORD) shall you mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for you have perverted the words of the living Elohim (God), of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) our Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the burden of Yahuah shall you mention no more: for every man’s word shall be his burden; for you have perverted the words of the living Elohim, of Yahuah Tseva'ot our Elohim.

verses.raw: Thus shall you say to the prophet, What has Yahuah (LORD) answered you? and, What has Yahuah (LORD) spoken?
verses.text: Thus shall you say to the prophet, What has Yahuah answered you? and, What has Yahuah spoken?

verses.raw: But since you say, The burden of Yahuah (LORD); therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Because you say this word, The burden of Yahuah (LORD), and I have sent unto you, saying, You shall not say, The burden of Yahuah (LORD);
verses.text: But since you say, The burden of Yahuah; therefore thus says Yahuah; Because you say this word, The burden of Yahuah, and I have sent unto you, saying, You shall not say, The burden of Yahuah;

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, and cast you out of my presence:

verses.raw: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
verses.text: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of Yahuah (LORD), after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah (Judah), and the princes of Yahudah (Judah), with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.
verses.text: Yahuah shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs were set before the temple of Yahuah, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Yahudah, and the princes of Yahudah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

verses.raw: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.
verses.text: One basket had very good figs, even like the figs that are first ripe: and the other basket had very naughty figs, which could not be eaten, they were so bad.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, What see you, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.
verses.text: Then said Yahuah unto me, What see you, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the evil, very evil, that cannot be eaten, they are so evil.

verses.raw: Again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto me, saying,
verses.text: Again the word of Yahuah came unto me, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Yahudah (Judah), whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Like these good figs, so will I acknowledge them that are carried away captive of Yahudah, whom I have sent out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for their good.

verses.raw: For I will set my eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.
verses.text: For I will set my eyes upon them for good, and I will bring them again to this land: and I will build them, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up.

verses.raw: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am Yahuah (LORD): and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God): for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.
verses.text: And I will give them an heart to know me, that I am Yahuah: and they shall be my people, and I will be their Elohim: for they shall return unto me with their whole heart.

verses.raw: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus says Yahuah (LORD), So will I give Zedekiah the king of Yahudah (Judah), and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:
verses.text: And as the evil figs, which cannot be eaten, they are so evil; surely thus says Yahuah, So will I give Zedekiah the king of Yahudah, and his princes, and the residue of Jerusalem, that remain in this land, and them that dwell in the land of Egypt:

verses.raw: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.
verses.text: And I will deliver them to be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth for their hurt, to be a reproach and a proverb, a taunt and a curse, in all places whither I shall drive them.

verses.raw: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.
verses.text: And I will send the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, among them, till they be consumed from off the land that I gave unto them and to their fathers.

verses.raw: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Yahudah (Judah) in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;
verses.text: The word that came to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Yahudah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah, that was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon;

verses.raw: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Yahudah (Judah), and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,
verses.text: The which Jeremiah the prophet spake unto all the people of Yahudah, and to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying,

verses.raw: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Yahudah (Judah), even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of Yahuah (LORD) has come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but you have not hearkened.
verses.text: From the thirteenth year of Josiah the son of Amon king of Yahudah, even unto this day, that is the three and twentieth year, the word of Yahuah has come unto me, and I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking; but you have not hearkened.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) has sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but you have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.
verses.text: And Yahuah has sent unto you all his servants the prophets, rising early and sending them; but you have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear.

verses.raw: They said, Turn you again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahuah (LORD) has given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:
verses.text: They said, Turn you again now every one from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell in the land that Yahuah has given unto you and to your fathers for ever and ever:

verses.raw: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.
verses.text: And go not after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, and provoke me not to anger with the works of your hands; and I will do you no hurt.

verses.raw: Yet you have not hearkened unto me, says Yahuah (LORD); that you might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.
verses.text: Yet you have not hearkened unto me, says Yahuah; that you might provoke me to anger with the works of your hands to your own hurt.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Because you have not heard my words,
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Because you have not heard my words,

verses.raw: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says Yahuah (LORD), and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.
verses.text: Behold, I will send and take all the families of the north, says Yahuah, and Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon, my servant, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants thereof, and against all these nations round about, and will utterly destroy them, and make them an astonishment, and an hissing, and perpetual desolations.

verses.raw: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.
verses.text: Moreover I will take from them the voice of mirth, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the millstones, and the light of the candle.

verses.raw: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.
verses.text: And this whole land shall be a desolation, and an astonishment; and these nations shall serve the king of Babylon seventy years.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, says Yahuah (LORD), for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when seventy years are accomplished, that I will punish the king of Babylon, and that nation, says Yahuah, for their iniquity, and the land of the Chaldeans, and will make it perpetual desolations.

verses.raw: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.
verses.text: And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have pronounced against it, even all that is written in this book, which Jeremiah has prophesied against all the nations.

verses.raw: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.
verses.text: For many nations and great kings shall serve themselves of them also: and I will recompense them according to their deeds, and according to the works of their own hands.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Elohim of Yashar'el unto me; Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send you, to drink it.

verses.raw: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
verses.text: And they shall drink, and be moved, and be mad, because of the sword that I will send among them.
