verses.raw: So that Yahuah (LORD) could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.
verses.text: So that Yahuah could no longer bear, because of the evil of your doings, and because of the abominations which you have committed; therefore is your land a desolation, and an astonishment, and a curse, without an inhabitant, as at this day.

verses.raw: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against Yahuah (LORD), and have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah (LORD), nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.
verses.text: Because you have burned incense, and because you have sinned against Yahuah, and have not obeyed the voice of Yahuah, nor walked in his law, nor in his statutes, nor in his testimonies; therefore this evil is happened unto you, as at this day.

verses.raw: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), all Yahudah (Judah) that are in the land of Egypt:
verses.text: Moreover Jeremiah said unto all the people, and to all the women, Hear the word of Yahuah, all Yahudah that are in the land of Egypt:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying; You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: you will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, saying; You and your wives have both spoken with your mouths, and fulfilled with your hand, saying, We will surely perform our vows that we have vowed, to burn incense to the queen of heaven, and to pour out drink offerings unto her: you will surely accomplish your vows, and surely perform your vows.

verses.raw: Therefore hear you the word of Yahuah (LORD), all Yahudah (Judah) that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, says Yahuah (LORD), that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Yahudah (Judah) in all the land of Egypt, saying, Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) lives.
verses.text: Therefore hear you the word of Yahuah, all Yahudah that dwell in the land of Egypt; Behold, I have sworn by my great name, says Yahuah, that my name shall no more be named in the mouth of any man of Yahudah in all the land of Egypt, saying, Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) lives.

verses.raw: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Yahudah (Judah) that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.
verses.text: Behold, I will watch over them for evil, and not for good: and all the men of Yahudah that are in the land of Egypt shall be consumed by the sword and by the famine, until there be an end of them.

verses.raw: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Yahudah (Judah), and all the remnant of Yahudah (Judah), that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.
verses.text: Yet a small number that escape the sword shall return out of the land of Egypt into the land of Yahudah, and all the remnant of Yahudah, that are gone into the land of Egypt to sojourn there, shall know whose words shall stand, mine, or theirs.

verses.raw: And this shall be a sign unto you, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:
verses.text: And this shall be a sign unto you, says Yahuah, that I will punish you in this place, that you may know that my words shall surely stand against you for evil:

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Behold, I will give Pharaoh-hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies, and into the hand of them that seek his life; as I gave Zedekiah king of Yahudah into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, his enemy, and that sought his life.

verses.raw: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying,
verses.text: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah, when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), unto you, O Baruch;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, the Elohim of Yashar'el, unto you, O Baruch;

verses.raw: You did say, Woe is me now! for Yahuah (LORD) has added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.
verses.text: You did say, Woe is me now! for Yahuah has added grief to my sorrow; I fainted in my sighing, and I find no rest.

verses.raw: Thus shall you say unto him, Yahuah (LORD) says thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.
verses.text: Thus shall you say unto him, Yahuah says thus; Behold, that which I have built will I break down, and that which I have planted I will pluck up, even this whole land.

verses.raw: And seek you great things for thyself? seek them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, says Yahuah (LORD): but your life will I give unto you for a prey in all places whither you go.
verses.text: And seek you great things for thyself? seek them not: for, behold, I will bring evil upon all flesh, says Yahuah: but your life will I give unto you for a prey in all places whither you go.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;
verses.text: The word of Yahuah which came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Gentiles;

verses.raw: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: Against Egypt, against the army of Pharaoh-necho king of Egypt, which was by the river Euphrates in Carchemish, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon smote in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Yahudah.

verses.raw: Order you the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.
verses.text: Order you the buckler and shield, and draw near to battle.

verses.raw: Harness the horses; and get up, you horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.
verses.text: Harness the horses; and get up, you horsemen, and stand forth with your helmets; furbish the spears, and put on the brigandines.

verses.raw: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Wherefore have I seen them dismayed and turned away back? and their mighty ones are beaten down, and are fled apace, and look not back: for fear was round about, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
verses.text: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.

verses.raw: Who is this that comes up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?
verses.text: Who is this that comes up as a flood, whose waters are moved as the rivers?

verses.raw: Egypt rises up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he says, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.text: Egypt rises up like a flood, and his waters are moved like the rivers; and he says, I will go up, and will cover the earth; I will destroy the city and the inhabitants thereof.

verses.raw: Come up, you horses; and rage, you chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.
verses.text: Come up, you horses; and rage, you chariots; and let the mighty men come forth; the Ethiopians and the Libyans, that handle the shield; and the Lydians, that handle and bend the bow.

verses.raw: For this is the day of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.
verses.text: For this is the day of Adonai Yahuah of hosts, a day of vengeance, that he may avenge him of his adversaries: and the sword shall devour, and it shall be satiate and made drunk with their blood: for Adonai Yahuah of hosts has a sacrifice in the north country by the river Euphrates.

verses.raw: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shall you use many medicines; for you shall not be cured.
verses.text: Go up into Gilead, and take balm, O virgin, the daughter of Egypt: in vain shall you use many medicines; for you shall not be cured.

verses.raw: The nations have heard of your shame, and your cry has filled the land: for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.
verses.text: The nations have heard of your shame, and your cry has filled the land: for the mighty man has stumbled against the mighty, and they are fallen both together.

verses.raw: The word that Yahuah (LORD) spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.
verses.text: The word that Yahuah spake to Jeremiah the prophet, how Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon should come and smite the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: Declare you in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say you, Stand fast, and prepare you; for the sword shall devour round about you.
verses.text: Declare you in Egypt, and publish in Migdol, and publish in Noph and in Tahpanhes: say you, Stand fast, and prepare you; for the sword shall devour round about you.

verses.raw: Why are your valiant men swept away? they stood not, because Yahuah (LORD) did drive them.
verses.text: Why are your valiant men swept away? they stood not, because Yahuah did drive them.

verses.raw: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.
verses.text: He made many to fall, yea, one fell upon another: and they said, Arise, and let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.

verses.raw: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has passed the time appointed.
verses.text: They did cry there, Pharaoh king of Egypt is but a noise; he has passed the time appointed.

verses.raw: As I live, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.
verses.text: As I live, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot, Surely as Tabor is among the mountains, and as Carmel by the sea, so shall he come.

verses.raw: O you daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.
verses.text: O you daughter dwelling in Egypt, furnish thyself to go into captivity: for Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant.

verses.raw: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction comes; it comes out of the north.
verses.text: Egypt is like a very fair heifer, but destruction comes; it comes out of the north.

verses.raw: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.
verses.text: Also her hired men are in the midst of her like fatted bullocks; for they also are turned back, and are fled away together: they did not stand, because the day of their calamity was come upon them, and the time of their visitation.

verses.raw: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.
verses.text: The voice thereof shall go like a serpent; for they shall march with an army, and come against her with axes, as hewers of wood.

verses.raw: They shall cut down her forest, says Yahuah (LORD), though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.
verses.text: They shall cut down her forest, says Yahuah, though it cannot be searched; because they are more than the grasshoppers, and are innumerable.

verses.raw: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.
verses.text: The daughter of Egypt shall be confounded; she shall be delivered into the hand of the people of the north.

verses.raw: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), says; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:
verses.text: Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, says; Behold, I will punish the multitude of No, and Pharaoh, and Egypt, with their gods, and their kings; even Pharaoh, and all them that trust in him:

verses.raw: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will deliver them into the hand of those that seek their lives, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of his servants: and afterward it shall be inhabited, as in the days of old, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: But fear not you, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Yashar'el (Israel): for, behold, I will save you from afar off, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.
verses.text: But fear not you, O my servant Jacob, and be not dismayed, O Yashar'el: for, behold, I will save you from afar off, and your seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be in rest and at ease, and none shall make him afraid.

verses.raw: Fear you not, O Jacob my servant, says Yahuah (LORD): for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven you: but I will not make a full end of you, but correct you in measure; yet will I not leave you wholly unpunished.
verses.text: Fear you not, O Jacob my servant, says Yahuah: for I am with you; for I will make a full end of all the nations whither I have driven you: but I will not make a full end of you, but correct you in measure; yet will I not leave you wholly unpunished.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.
verses.text: The word of Yahuah that came to Jeremiah the prophet against the Philistines, before that Pharaoh smote Gaza.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Behold, waters rise up out of the north, and shall be an overflowing flood, and shall overflow the land, and all that is therein; the city, and them that dwell therein: then the men shall cry, and all the inhabitants of the land shall howl.

verses.raw: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;
verses.text: At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong horses, at the rushing of his chariots, and at the rumbling of his wheels, the fathers shall not look back to their children for feebleness of hands;

verses.raw: Because of the day that comes to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remains: for Yahuah (LORD) will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.
verses.text: Because of the day that comes to spoil all the Philistines, and to cut off from Tyrus and Zidon every helper that remains: for Yahuah will spoil the Philistines, the remnant of the country of Caphtor.

verses.raw: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut thyself?
verses.text: Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is cut off with the remnant of their valley: how long will you cut thyself?

verses.raw: O you sword of Yahuah (LORD), how long will it be ere you be quiet? put up thyself into your scabbard, rest, and be still.
verses.text: O you sword of Yahuah, how long will it be ere you be quiet? put up thyself into your scabbard, rest, and be still.

verses.raw: How can it be quiet, seeing Yahuah (LORD) has given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there has he appointed it.
verses.text: How can it be quiet, seeing Yahuah has given it a charge against Ashkelon, and against the sea shore? there has he appointed it.

verses.raw: Against Moab thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.
verses.text: Against Moab thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Woe unto Nebo! for it is spoiled: Kiriathaim is confounded and taken: Misgab is confounded and dismayed.

verses.raw: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also you shall be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue you.
verses.text: There shall be no more praise of Moab: in Heshbon they have devised evil against it; come, and let us cut it off from being a nation. Also you shall be cut down, O Madmen; the sword shall pursue you.

verses.raw: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.
verses.text: A voice of crying shall be from Horonaim, spoiling and great destruction.

verses.raw: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.
verses.text: Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused a cry to be heard.

verses.raw: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.
verses.text: For in the going up of Luhith continual weeping shall go up; for in the going down of Horonaim the enemies have heard a cry of destruction.

verses.raw: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.
verses.text: Flee, save your lives, and be like the heath in the wilderness.

verses.raw: For because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you shall also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.
verses.text: For because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you shall also be taken: and Chemosh shall go forth into captivity with his priests and his princes together.

verses.raw: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as Yahuah (LORD) has spoken.
verses.text: And the spoiler shall come upon every city, and no city shall escape: the valley also shall perish, and the plain shall be destroyed, as Yahuah has spoken.

verses.raw: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.
verses.text: Give wings unto Moab, that it may flee and get away: for the cities thereof shall be desolate, without any to dwell therein.

verses.raw: Cursed be he that does the work of Yahuah (LORD) deceitfully, and cursed be he that keeps back his sword from blood.
verses.text: Cursed be he that does the work of Yahuah deceitfully, and cursed be he that keeps back his sword from blood.

verses.raw: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.
verses.text: Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, neither has he gone into captivity: therefore his taste remained in him, and his scent is not changed.

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will send unto him wanderers, that shall cause him to wander, and shall empty his vessels, and break their bottles.

verses.raw: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Yashar'el (Israel) was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.
verses.text: And Moab shall be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Yashar'el was ashamed of Beth-el their confidence.

verses.raw: How say you, We are mighty and strong men for the war?
verses.text: How say you, We are mighty and strong men for the war?

verses.raw: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Moab is spoiled, and gone up out of her cities, and his chosen young men are gone down to the slaughter, says the King, whose name is Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.
verses.text: The calamity of Moab is near to come, and his affliction hasteth fast.

verses.raw: All you that are about him, bemoan him; and all you that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!
verses.text: All you that are about him, bemoan him; and all you that know his name, say, How is the strong staff broken, and the beautiful rod!

verses.raw: You daughter that do inhabit Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon you, and he shall destroy your strong holds.
verses.text: You daughter that do inhabit Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the spoiler of Moab shall come upon you, and he shall destroy your strong holds.

verses.raw: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?
verses.text: O inhabitant of Aroer, stand by the way, and espy; ask him that fleeth, and her that escapeth, and say, What is done?

verses.raw: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell you it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,
verses.text: Moab is confounded; for it is broken down: howl and cry; tell you it in Arnon, that Moab is spoiled,

verses.raw: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
verses.text: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,

verses.raw: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,
verses.text: And upon Dibon, and upon Nebo, and upon Beth-diblathaim,

verses.raw: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,
verses.text: And upon Kiriathaim, and upon Beth-gamul, and upon Beth-meon,

verses.raw: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.
verses.text: And upon Kerioth, and upon Bozrah, and upon all the cities of the land of Moab, far or near.

verses.raw: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The horn of Moab is cut off, and his arm is broken, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Make you him drunken: for he magnified himself against Yahuah (LORD): Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
verses.text: Make you him drunken: for he magnified himself against Yahuah: Moab also shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.

verses.raw: For was not Yashar'el (Israel) a derision unto you? was he found among thieves? for since you spoke of him, you skippedst for joy.
verses.text: For was not Yashar'el a derision unto you? was he found among thieves? for since you spoke of him, you skippedst for joy.

verses.raw: O you that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that makes her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.
verses.text: O you that dwell in Moab, leave the cities, and dwell in the rock, and be like the dove that makes her nest in the sides of the hole’s mouth.

verses.raw: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.
verses.text: We have heard the pride of Moab, (he is exceeding proud) his loftiness, and his arrogancy, and his pride, and the haughtiness of his heart.

verses.raw: I know his wrath, says Yahuah (LORD); but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.
verses.text: I know his wrath, says Yahuah; but it shall not be so; his lies shall not so effect it.

verses.raw: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; my heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.
verses.text: Therefore will I howl for Moab, and I will cry out for all Moab; my heart shall mourn for the men of Kir-heres.

verses.raw: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for you with the weeping of Jazer: your plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon your summer fruits and upon your vintage.
verses.text: O vine of Sibmah, I will weep for you with the weeping of Jazer: your plants are gone over the sea, they reach even to the sea of Jazer: the spoiler is fallen upon your summer fruits and upon your vintage.

verses.raw: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.
verses.text: And joy and gladness is taken from the plentiful field, and from the land of Moab; and I have caused wine to fail from the winepresses: none shall tread with shouting; their shouting shall be no shouting.

verses.raw: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.
verses.text: From the cry of Heshbon even unto Elealeh, and even unto Jahaz, have they uttered their voice, from Zoar even unto Horonaim, as an heifer of three years old: for the waters also of Nimrim shall be desolate.

verses.raw: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, says Yahuah (LORD), him that offers in the high places, and him that burns incense to his gods.
verses.text: Moreover I will cause to cease in Moab, says Yahuah, him that offers in the high places, and him that burns incense to his gods.

verses.raw: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and my heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches that he has gotten are perished.
verses.text: Therefore my heart shall sound for Moab like pipes, and my heart shall sound like pipes for the men of Kir-heres: because the riches that he has gotten are perished.

verses.raw: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.
verses.text: For every head shall be bald, and every beard clipped: upon all the hands shall be cuttings, and upon the loins sackcloth.

verses.raw: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: There shall be lamentation generally upon all the housetops of Moab, and in the streets thereof: for I have broken Moab like a vessel wherein is no pleasure, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how has Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.
verses.text: They shall howl, saying, How is it broken down! how has Moab turned the back with shame! so shall Moab be a derision and a dismaying to all them about him.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.

verses.raw: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.text: Kerioth is taken, and the strong holds are surprised, and the mighty men’s hearts in Moab at that day shall be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

verses.raw: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahuah.

verses.raw: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon you, O inhabitant of Moab, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, shall be upon you, O inhabitant of Moab, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: He that fleeth from the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that gets up out of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for I will bring upon it, even upon Moab, the year of their visitation, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.
verses.text: They that fled stood under the shadow of Heshbon because of the force: but a fire shall come forth out of Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and shall devour the corner of Moab, and the crown of the head of the tumultuous ones.

verses.raw: Woe be unto you, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perishes: for your sons are taken captives, and your daughters captives.
verses.text: Woe be unto you, O Moab! the people of Chemosh perishes: for your sons are taken captives, and your daughters captives.

verses.raw: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahuah (LORD). Thus far is the judgment of Moab.
verses.text: Yet will I bring again the captivity of Moab in the latter days, says Yahuah. Thus far is the judgment of Moab.

verses.raw: Concerning the Ammonites, thus says Yahuah (LORD); Has Yashar'el (Israel) no sons? has he no heir? why then does their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?
verses.text: Concerning the Ammonites, thus says Yahuah; Has Yashar'el no sons? has he no heir? why then does their king inherit Gad, and his people dwell in his cities?

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Yashar'el (Israel) be heir unto them that were his heirs, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard in Rabbah of the Ammonites; and it shall be a desolate heap, and her daughters shall be burned with fire: then shall Yashar'el be heir unto them that were his heirs, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, you daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.
verses.text: Howl, O Heshbon, for Ai is spoiled: cry, you daughters of Rabbah, gird you with sackcloth; lament, and run to and fro by the hedges; for their king shall go into captivity, and his priests and his princes together.

verses.raw: Wherefore gloriest you in the valleys, your flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?
verses.text: Wherefore gloriest you in the valleys, your flowing valley, O backsliding daughter? that trusted in her treasures, saying, Who shall come unto me?

verses.raw: Behold, I will bring a fear upon you, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts, from all those that be about you; and you shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.
verses.text: Behold, I will bring a fear upon you, says Adonai Yahuah of hosts, from all those that be about you; and you shall be driven out every man right forth; and none shall gather up him that wandereth.

verses.raw: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And afterward I will bring again the captivity of the children of Ammon, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Concerning Edom, thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?
verses.text: Concerning Edom, thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Is wisdom no more in Teman? is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?

verses.raw: Flee you, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.
verses.text: Flee you, turn back, dwell deep, O inhabitants of Dedan; for I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him, the time that I will visit him.

verses.raw: If grapegatherers come to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.
verses.text: If grapegatherers come to you, would they not leave some gleaning grapes? if thieves by night, they will destroy till they have enough.

verses.raw: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.
verses.text: But I have made Esau bare, I have uncovered his secret places, and he shall not be able to hide himself: his seed is spoiled, and his brethren, and his neighbours, and he is not.

verses.raw: Leave your fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let your widows trust in me.
verses.text: Leave your fatherless children, I will preserve them alive; and let your widows trust in me.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and are you he that shall altogether go unpunished? you shall not go unpunished, but you shall surely drink of it.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah; Behold, they whose judgment was not to drink of the cup have assuredly drunken; and are you he that shall altogether go unpunished? you shall not go unpunished, but you shall surely drink of it.

verses.raw: For I have sworn by myself, says Yahuah (LORD), that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.
verses.text: For I have sworn by myself, says Yahuah, that Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse; and all the cities thereof shall be perpetual wastes.

verses.raw: I have heard a rumour from Yahuah (LORD), and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather you together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.
verses.text: I have heard a rumour from Yahuah, and an ambassador is sent unto the heathen, saying, Gather you together, and come against her, and rise up to the battle.

verses.raw: For, lo, I will make you small among the heathen, and despised among men.
verses.text: For, lo, I will make you small among the heathen, and despised among men.

verses.raw: Your terribleness has deceived you, and the pride of your heart, O you that dwell in the clefts of the rock, that hold the height of the hill: though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from thence, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Your terribleness has deceived you, and the pride of your heart, O you that dwell in the clefts of the rock, that hold the height of the hill: though you should make your nest as high as the eagle, I will bring you down from thence, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goes by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.
verses.text: Also Edom shall be a desolation: every one that goes by it shall be astonished, and shall hiss at all the plagues thereof.

verses.raw: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, says Yahuah (LORD), no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of Adam dwell in it.
verses.text: As in the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, says Yahuah, no man shall abide there, neither shall a son of Adam dwell in it.

verses.raw: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan against the habitation of the strong: but I will suddenly make him run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

verses.raw: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahuah (LORD), that he has taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.
verses.text: Therefore hear the counsel of Yahuah, that he has taken against Edom; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the inhabitants of Teman: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitations desolate with them.

verses.raw: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.
verses.text: The earth is moved at the noise of their fall, at the cry the noise thereof was heard in the Red sea.

verses.raw: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up and fly as the eagle, and spread his wings over Bozrah: and at that day shall the heart of the mighty men of Edom be as the heart of a woman in her pangs.

verses.raw: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.
verses.text: Concerning Damascus. Hamath is confounded, and Arpad: for they have heard evil tidings: they are fainthearted; there is sorrow on the sea; it cannot be quiet.

verses.raw: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turns herself to flee, and fear has seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.
verses.text: Damascus is waxed feeble, and turns herself to flee, and fear has seized on her: anguish and sorrows have taken her, as a woman in travail.

verses.raw: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!
verses.text: How is the city of praise not left, the city of my joy!

verses.raw: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Therefore her young men shall fall in her streets, and all the men of war shall be cut off in that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.
verses.text: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall consume the palaces of Ben-hadad.

verses.raw: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus says Yahuah (LORD); Arise you, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.
verses.text: Concerning Kedar, and concerning the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon shall smite, thus says Yahuah; Arise you, go up to Kedar, and spoil the men of the east.

verses.raw: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.
verses.text: Their tents and their flocks shall they take away: they shall take to themselves their curtains, and all their vessels, and their camels; and they shall cry unto them, Fear is on every side.

verses.raw: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O you inhabitants of Hazor, says Yahuah (LORD); for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.
verses.text: Flee, get you far off, dwell deep, O you inhabitants of Hazor, says Yahuah; for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon has taken counsel against you, and has conceived a purpose against you.

verses.raw: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwells without care, says Yahuah (LORD), which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.
verses.text: Arise, get you up unto the wealthy nation, that dwells without care, says Yahuah, which have neither gates nor bars, which dwell alone.

verses.raw: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And their camels shall be a booty, and the multitude of their cattle a spoil: and I will scatter into all winds them that are in the utmost corners; and I will bring their calamity from all sides thereof, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of Adam dwell in it.
verses.text: And Hazor shall be a dwelling for dragons, and a desolation for ever: there shall no man abide there, nor any son of Adam dwell in it.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Yahudah (Judah), saying,
verses.text: The word of Yahuah that came to Jeremiah the prophet against Elam in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Yahudah, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Behold, I will break the bow of Elam, the chief of their might.

verses.raw: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.
verses.text: And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds; and there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come.

verses.raw: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, says Yahuah (LORD); and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:
verses.text: For I will cause Elam to be dismayed before their enemies, and before them that seek their life: and I will bring evil upon them, even my fierce anger, says Yahuah; and I will send the sword after them, till I have consumed them:

verses.raw: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will set my throne in Elam, and will destroy from thence the king and the princes, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: But it shall come to pass in the latter days, that I will bring again the captivity of Elam, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: The word that Yahuah (LORD) spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.
verses.text: The word that Yahuah spake against Babylon and against the land of the Chaldeans by Jeremiah the prophet.

verses.raw: Declare you among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.
verses.text: Declare you among the nations, and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and conceal not: say, Babylon is taken, Bel is confounded, Merodach is broken in pieces; her idols are confounded, her images are broken in pieces.

verses.raw: For out of the north there comes up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.
verses.text: For out of the north there comes up a nation against her, which shall make her land desolate, and none shall dwell therein: they shall remove, they shall depart, both man and beast.

verses.raw: In those days, and in that time, says Yahuah (LORD), the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall come, they and the children of Yahudah (Judah) together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God).
verses.text: In those days, and in that time, says Yahuah, the children of Yashar'el shall come, they and the children of Yahudah together, going and weeping: they shall go, and seek Yahuah their Elohim.

verses.raw: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to Yahuah (LORD) in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.
verses.text: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward, saying, Come, and let us join ourselves to Yahuah in a perpetual covenant that shall not be forgotten.

verses.raw: My people has been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.
verses.text: My people has been lost sheep: their shepherds have caused them to go astray, they have turned them away on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, they have forgotten their restingplace.

verses.raw: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against Yahuah (LORD), the habitation of justice, even Yahuah (LORD), the hope of their fathers.
verses.text: All that found them have devoured them: and their adversaries said, We offend not, because they have sinned against Yahuah, the habitation of justice, even Yahuah, the hope of their fathers.

verses.raw: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.
verses.text: Remove out of the midst of Babylon, and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the he goats before the flocks.

verses.raw: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.
verses.text: For, lo, I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country: and they shall set themselves in array against her; from thence she shall be taken: their arrows shall be as of a mighty expert man; none shall return in vain.

verses.raw: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Because you were glad, because you rejoiced, O you destroyers of my heritage, because you are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;
verses.text: Because you were glad, because you rejoiced, O you destroyers of my heritage, because you are grown fat as the heifer at grass, and bellow as bulls;

verses.raw: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.
verses.text: Your mother shall be sore confounded; she that bare you shall be ashamed: behold, the hindermost of the nations shall be a wilderness, a dry land, and a desert.

verses.raw: Because of the wrath of Yahuah (LORD) it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goes by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.
verses.text: Because of the wrath of Yahuah it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be wholly desolate: every one that goes by Babylon shall be astonished, and hiss at all her plagues.

verses.raw: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all you that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she has sinned against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about: all you that bend the bow, shoot at her, spare no arrows: for she has sinned against Yahuah.

verses.raw: Shout against her round about: she has given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of Yahuah (LORD): take vengeance upon her; as she has done, do unto her.
verses.text: Shout against her round about: she has given her hand: her foundations are fallen, her walls are thrown down: for it is the vengeance of Yahuah: take vengeance upon her; as she has done, do unto her.

verses.raw: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.
verses.text: Cut off the sower from Babylon, and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people, and they shall flee every one to his own land.

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria has devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.
verses.text: Yashar'el is a scattered sheep; the lions have driven him away: first the king of Assyria has devoured him; and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon has broken his bones.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; Behold, I will punish the king of Babylon and his land, as I have punished the king of Assyria.

verses.raw: And I will bring Yashar'el (Israel) again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.
verses.text: And I will bring Yashar'el again to his habitation, and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan, and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead.

verses.raw: In those days, and in that time, says Yahuah (LORD), the iniquity of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Yahudah (Judah), and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.
verses.text: In those days, and in that time, says Yahuah, the iniquity of Yashar'el shall be sought for, and there shall be none; and the sins of Yahudah, and they shall not be found: for I will pardon them whom I reserve.

verses.raw: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, says Yahuah (LORD), and do according to all that I have commanded you.
verses.text: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the inhabitants of Pekod: waste and utterly destroy after them, says Yahuah, and do according to all that I have commanded you.

verses.raw: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.
verses.text: A sound of battle is in the land, and of great destruction.

verses.raw: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!
verses.text: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken! how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations!

verses.raw: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, O Babylon, and you were not aware: you are found, and also caught, because you have striven against Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I have laid a snare for you, and you are also taken, O Babylon, and you were not aware: you are found, and also caught, because you have striven against Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has opened his armoury, and has brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.text: Yahuah has opened his armoury, and has brought forth the weapons of his indignation: for this is the work of Adonai Yahuah of hosts in the land of the Chaldeans.

verses.raw: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.
verses.text: Come against her from the utmost border, open her storehouses: cast her up as heaps, and destroy her utterly: let nothing of her be left.

verses.raw: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.
verses.text: Slay all her bullocks; let them go down to the slaughter: woe unto them! for their day is come, the time of their visitation.

verses.raw: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), the vengeance of his temple.
verses.text: The voice of them that flee and escape out of the land of Babylon, to declare in Zion the vengeance of Yahuah Eloheinu, the vengeance of his temple.

verses.raw: Call together the archers against Babylon: all you that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she has done, do unto her: for she has been proud against Yahuah (LORD), against the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Call together the archers against Babylon: all you that bend the bow, camp against it round about; let none thereof escape: recompense her according to her work; according to all that she has done, do unto her: for she has been proud against Yahuah, against the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her men of war shall be cut off in that day, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, I am against you, O you most proud, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts: for your day is come, the time that I will visit you.
verses.text: Behold, I am against you, O you most proud, says Adonai Yahuah of hosts: for your day is come, the time that I will visit you.

verses.raw: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.
verses.text: And the most proud shall stumble and fall, and none shall raise him up: and I will kindle a fire in his cities, and it shall devour all round about him.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); The children of Yashar'el (Israel) and the children of Yahudah (Judah) were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; The children of Yashar'el and the children of Yahudah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.

verses.raw: Their Redeemer is strong; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.text: Their Redeemer is strong; Yahuah Tseva'ot is his name: he shall throughly plead their cause, that he may give rest to the land, and disquiet the inhabitants of Babylon.

verses.raw: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, says Yahuah (LORD), and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.
verses.text: A sword is upon the Chaldeans, says Yahuah, and upon the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her princes, and upon her wise men.

verses.raw: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.
verses.text: A sword is upon the liars; and they shall dote: a sword is upon her mighty men; and they shall be dismayed.

verses.raw: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.
verses.text: A sword is upon their horses, and upon their chariots, and upon all the mingled people that are in the midst of her; and they shall become as women: a sword is upon her treasures; and they shall be robbed.

verses.raw: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.
verses.text: A drought is upon her waters; and they shall be dried up: for it is the land of graven images, and they are mad upon their idols.

verses.raw: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.
verses.text: Therefore the wild beasts of the desert with the wild beasts of the islands shall dwell there, and the owls shall dwell therein: and it shall be no more inhabited for ever; neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation.

verses.raw: As Elohim (God) overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, says Yahuah (LORD); so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of Adam dwell therein.
verses.text: As Elohim overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah and the neighbour cities thereof, says Yahuah; so shall no man abide there, neither shall any son of Adam dwell therein.

verses.raw: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.
verses.text: Behold, a people shall come from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth.

verses.raw: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against you, O daughter of Babylon.
verses.text: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against you, O daughter of Babylon.

verses.raw: The king of Babylon has heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.
verses.text: The king of Babylon has heard the report of them, and his hands waxed feeble: anguish took hold of him, and pangs as of a woman in travail.

verses.raw: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?
verses.text: Behold, he shall come up like a lion from the swelling of Jordan unto the habitation of the strong: but I will make them suddenly run away from her: and who is a chosen man, that I may appoint over her? for who is like me? and who will appoint me the time? and who is that shepherd that will stand before me?

verses.raw: Therefore hear you the counsel of Yahuah (LORD), that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.
verses.text: Therefore hear you the counsel of Yahuah, that he has taken against Babylon; and his purposes, that he has purposed against the land of the Chaldeans: Surely the least of the flock shall draw them out: surely he shall make their habitation desolate with them.

verses.raw: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.
verses.text: At the noise of the taking of Babylon the earth is moved, and the cry is heard among the nations.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Behold, I will raise up against Babylon, and against them that dwell in the midst of them that rise up against me, a destroying wind;

verses.raw: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.
verses.text: And will send unto Babylon fanners, that shall fan her, and shall empty her land: for in the day of trouble they shall be against her round about.

verses.raw: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifts himself up in his brigandine: and spare you not her young men; destroy you utterly all her host.
verses.text: Against him that bendeth let the archer bend his bow, and against him that lifts himself up in his brigandine: and spare you not her young men; destroy you utterly all her host.

verses.raw: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.
verses.text: Thus the slain shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and they that are thrust through in her streets.

verses.raw: For Yashar'el (Israel) has not been forsaken, nor Yahudah (Judah) of his Elohim (God), of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: For Yashar'el has not been forsaken, nor Yahudah of his Elohim, of Yahuah Tseva'ot; though their land was filled with sin against the Holy One of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD’S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.
verses.text: Flee out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every man his soul: be not cut off in her iniquity; for this is the time of the LORD’S vengeance; he will render unto her a recompence.

verses.raw: Babylon has been a golden cup in the LORD’S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.
verses.text: Babylon has been a golden cup in the LORD’S hand, that made all the earth drunken: the nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.

verses.raw: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.
verses.text: Babylon is suddenly fallen and destroyed: howl for her; take balm for her pain, if so be she may be healed.

verses.raw: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reaches unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.
verses.text: We would have healed Babylon, but she is not healed: forsake her, and let us go every one into his own country: for her judgment reaches unto heaven, and is lifted up even to the skies.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God).
verses.text: Yahuah has brought forth our righteousness: come, and let us declare in Zion the work of Yahuah Eloheinu.

verses.raw: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: Yahuah (LORD) has raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of Yahuah (LORD), the vengeance of his temple.
verses.text: Make bright the arrows; gather the shields: Yahuah has raised up the spirit of the kings of the Medes: for his device is against Babylon, to destroy it; because it is the vengeance of Yahuah, the vengeance of his temple.

verses.raw: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for Yahuah (LORD) has both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.
verses.text: Set up the standard upon the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, set up the watchmen, prepare the ambushes: for Yahuah has both devised and done that which he spake against the inhabitants of Babylon.

verses.raw: O you that dwell upon many waters, abundant in treasures, your end is come, and the measure of your covetousness.
verses.text: O you that dwell upon many waters, abundant in treasures, your end is come, and the measure of your covetousness.

verses.raw: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill you with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against you.
verses.text: Yahuah Tseva'ot has sworn by himself, saying, Surely I will fill you with men, as with caterpillers; and they shall lift up a shout against you.

verses.raw: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and has stretched out the heaven by his understanding.
verses.text: He has made the earth by his power, he has established the world by his wisdom, and has stretched out the heaven by his understanding.

verses.raw: When he utters his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasures.
verses.text: When he utters his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens; and he causes the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth: he makes lightnings with rain, and brings forth the wind out of his treasures.

verses.raw: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.
verses.text: Every man is brutish by his knowledge; every founder is confounded by the graven image: for his molten image is falsehood, and there is no breath in them.

verses.raw: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.
verses.text: They are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish.

verses.raw: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Yashar'el (Israel) is the rod of his inheritance: Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name.
verses.text: The portion of Jacob is not like them; for he is the former of all things: and Yashar'el is the rod of his inheritance: Yahuah Tseva'ot is his name.

verses.raw: You are my battle axe and weapons of war: for with you will I break in pieces the nations, and with you will I destroy kingdoms;
verses.text: You are my battle axe and weapons of war: for with you will I break in pieces the nations, and with you will I destroy kingdoms;

verses.raw: And with you will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with you will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;
verses.text: And with you will I break in pieces the horse and his rider; and with you will I break in pieces the chariot and his rider;

verses.raw: With you also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with you will I break in pieces old and young; and with you will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;
verses.text: With you also will I break in pieces man and woman; and with you will I break in pieces old and young; and with you will I break in pieces the young man and the maid;

verses.raw: I will also break in pieces with you the shepherd and his flock; and with you will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with you will I break in pieces captains and rulers.
verses.text: I will also break in pieces with you the shepherd and his flock; and with you will I break in pieces the husbandman and his yoke of oxen; and with you will I break in pieces captains and rulers.

verses.raw: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will render unto Babylon and to all the inhabitants of Chaldea all their evil that they have done in Zion in your sight, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain, says Yahuah (LORD), which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out my hand upon you, and roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burnt mountain.
verses.text: Behold, I am against you, O destroying mountain, says Yahuah, which destroyest all the earth: and I will stretch out my hand upon you, and roll you down from the rocks, and will make you a burnt mountain.

verses.raw: And they shall not take of you a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but you shall be desolate for ever, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And they shall not take of you a stone for a corner, nor a stone for foundations; but you shall be desolate for ever, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Set you up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.
verses.text: Set you up a standard in the land, blow the trumpet among the nations, prepare the nations against her, call together against her the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashchenaz; appoint a captain against her; cause the horses to come up as the rough caterpillers.

verses.raw: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.
verses.text: Prepare against her the nations with the kings of the Medes, the captains thereof, and all the rulers thereof, and all the land of his dominion.

verses.raw: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of Yahuah (LORD) shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.
verses.text: And the land shall tremble and sorrow: for every purpose of Yahuah shall be performed against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation without an inhabitant.

verses.raw: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might has failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.
verses.text: The mighty men of Babylon have forborn to fight, they have remained in their holds: their might has failed; they became as women: they have burned her dwellingplaces; her bars are broken.

verses.raw: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,
verses.text: One post shall run to meet another, and one messenger to meet another, to shew the king of Babylon that his city is taken at one end,

verses.raw: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.
verses.text: And that the passages are stopped, and the reeds they have burned with fire, and the men of war are affrighted.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel); The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el; The daughter of Babylon is like a threshingfloor, it is time to thresh her: yet a little while, and the time of her harvest shall come.

verses.raw: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me, he has crushed me, he has made me an empty vessel, he has swallowed me up like a dragon, he has filled his belly with my delicates, he has cast me out.
verses.text: Nebuchadrezzar the king of Babylon has devoured me, he has crushed me, he has made me an empty vessel, he has swallowed me up like a dragon, he has filled his belly with my delicates, he has cast me out.

verses.raw: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.
verses.text: The violence done to me and to my flesh be upon Babylon, shall the inhabitant of Zion say; and my blood upon the inhabitants of Chaldea, shall Jerusalem say.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; Behold, I will plead your cause, and take vengeance for you; and I will dry up her sea, and make her springs dry.

verses.raw: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.
verses.text: And Babylon shall become heaps, a dwellingplace for dragons, an astonishment, and an hissing, without an inhabitant.

verses.raw: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.
verses.text: They shall roar together like lions: they shall yell as lions’ whelps.

verses.raw: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: In their heat I will make their feasts, and I will make them drunken, that they may rejoice, and sleep a perpetual sleep, and not wake, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.
verses.text: I will bring them down like lambs to the slaughter, like rams with he goats.

verses.raw: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!
verses.text: How is Sheshach taken! and how is the praise of the whole earth surprised! how is Babylon become an astonishment among the nations!

verses.raw: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.
verses.text: The sea is come up upon Babylon: she is covered with the multitude of the waves thereof.

verses.raw: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwells, neither does any son of Adam pass thereby.
verses.text: Her cities are a desolation, a dry land, and a wilderness, a land wherein no man dwells, neither does any son of Adam pass thereby.

verses.raw: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.
verses.text: And I will punish Bel in Babylon, and I will bring forth out of his mouth that which he has swallowed up: and the nations shall not flow together any more unto him: yea, the wall of Babylon shall fall.

verses.raw: My people, go you out of the midst of her, and deliver you every man his soul from the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: My people, go you out of the midst of her, and deliver you every man his soul from the fierce anger of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And lest your heart faint, and you fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.
verses.text: And lest your heart faint, and you fear for the rumour that shall be heard in the land; a rumour shall both come one year, and after that in another year shall come a rumour, and violence in the land, ruler against ruler.

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, the days come, that I will do judgment upon the graven images of Babylon: and her whole land shall be confounded, and all her slain shall fall in the midst of her.

verses.raw: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein, shall sing for Babylon: for the spoilers shall come unto her from the north, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: As Babylon has caused the slain of Yashar'el (Israel) to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.
verses.text: As Babylon has caused the slain of Yashar'el to fall, so at Babylon shall fall the slain of all the earth.

verses.raw: You that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember Yahuah (LORD) afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.
verses.text: You that have escaped the sword, go away, stand not still: remember Yahuah afar off, and let Jerusalem come into your mind.

verses.raw: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame has covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’S house.
verses.text: We are confounded, because we have heard reproach: shame has covered our faces: for strangers are come into the sanctuaries of the LORD’S house.

verses.raw: Wherefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
verses.text: Wherefore, behold, the days come, says Yahuah, that I will do judgment upon her graven images: and through all her land the wounded shall groan.
