verses.raw: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
verses.text: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.

verses.raw: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
verses.text: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

verses.raw: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
verses.text: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.

verses.raw: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.
verses.text: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

verses.raw: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
verses.text: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

verses.raw: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.text: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

verses.raw: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.
verses.text: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.

verses.raw: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.
verses.text: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.

verses.raw: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
verses.text: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.

verses.raw: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
verses.text: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.

verses.raw: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
verses.text: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?

verses.raw: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
verses.text: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

verses.raw: And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
verses.text: And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.

verses.raw: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of Adam: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.
verses.text: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of Adam: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.

verses.raw: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
verses.text: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.

verses.raw: And he said, Behold, I will make you know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.
verses.text: And he said, Behold, I will make you know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.

verses.raw: The ram which you saw having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.text: The ram which you saw having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.

verses.raw: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
verses.text: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.

verses.raw: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
verses.text: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

verses.raw: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
verses.text: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.

verses.raw: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
verses.text: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.

verses.raw: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
verses.text: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.

verses.raw: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut you up the vision; for it shall be for many days.
verses.text: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut you up the vision; for it shall be for many days.

verses.raw: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
verses.text: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.

verses.raw: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;
verses.text: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, which was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans;

verses.raw: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of Yahuah (LORD) came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
verses.text: In the first year of his reign I Daniel understood by books the number of the years, whereof the word of Yahuah came to Jeremiah the prophet, that he would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And I set my face unto Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God), to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:
verses.text: And I set my face unto Yahuah Elohim, to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

verses.raw: And I prayed unto Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God), and made my confession, and said, O Adonai (Lord), the great and dreadful Elohim (God), keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;
verses.text: And I prayed unto Yahuah Elohai, and made my confession, and said, O Adonai, the great and dreadful Elohim, keeping the covenant and mercy to them that love him, and to them that keep his commandments;

verses.raw: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from your precepts and from your judgments:
verses.text: We have sinned, and have committed iniquity, and have done wickedly, and have rebelled, even by departing from your precepts and from your judgments:

verses.raw: Neither have we hearkened unto your servants the prophets, which spake in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
verses.text: Neither have we hearkened unto your servants the prophets, which spake in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), righteousness belongs unto you, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Yahudah (Judah), and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Yashar'el (Israel), that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.
verses.text: O Adonai, righteousness belongs unto you, but unto us confusion of faces, as at this day; to the men of Yahudah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto all Yashar'el, that are near, and that are far off, through all the countries whither you have driven them, because of their trespass that they have trespassed against you.

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.
verses.text: O Adonai, to us belongs confusion of face, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.

verses.raw: To Yahuah Eloheinu (the Lord our God) belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;
verses.text: To Yahuah Eloheinu belong mercies and forgivenesses, though we have rebelled against him;

verses.raw: Neither have we obeyed the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
verses.text: Neither have we obeyed the voice of Yahuah Eloheinu, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.

verses.raw: Yea, all Yashar'el (Israel) have transgressed your law, even by departing, that they might not obey your voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of Elohim (God), because we have sinned against him.
verses.text: Yea, all Yashar'el have transgressed your law, even by departing, that they might not obey your voice; therefore the curse is poured upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of Elohim, because we have sinned against him.

verses.raw: And he has confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven has not been done as has been done upon Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he has confirmed his words, which he spake against us, and against our judges that judged us, by bringing upon us a great evil: for under the whole heaven has not been done as has been done upon Jerusalem.

verses.raw: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand your truth.
verses.text: As it is written in the law of Moses, all this evil is come upon us: yet made we not our prayer before Yahuah Eloheinu, that we might turn from our iniquities, and understand your truth.

verses.raw: Therefore has Yahuah (LORD) watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God) is righteous in all his works which he does: for we obeyed not his voice.
verses.text: Therefore has Yahuah watched upon the evil, and brought it upon us: for Yahuah Eloheinu is righteous in all his works which he does: for we obeyed not his voice.

verses.raw: And now, O Adonai (Lord) our Elohim (God), that have brought your people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten you renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
verses.text: And now, O Adonai our Elohim, that have brought your people forth out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have gotten you renown, as at this day; we have sinned, we have done wickedly.

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), according to all your righteousness, I beseech you, let your anger and your fury be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people are become a reproach to all that are about us.
verses.text: O Adonai, according to all your righteousness, I beseech you, let your anger and your fury be turned away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain: because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people are become a reproach to all that are about us.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O our Elohim (God), hear the prayer of your servant, and his supplications, and cause your face to shine upon your sanctuary that is desolate, for Yahuah's (Lord’s) sake.
verses.text: Now therefore, O our Elohim, hear the prayer of your servant, and his supplications, and cause your face to shine upon your sanctuary that is desolate, for Yahuah's (Lord’s) sake.

verses.raw: O my Elohim (God), incline your ear, and hear; open your eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by your name: for we do not present our supplications before you for our righteousnesses, but for your great mercies.
verses.text: O my Elohim, incline your ear, and hear; open your eyes, and behold our desolations, and the city which is called by your name: for we do not present our supplications before you for our righteousnesses, but for your great mercies.

verses.raw: O Adonai (Lord), hear; O Adonai (Lord), forgive; O Adonai (Lord), hearken and do; defer not, for your own sake, O my Elohim (God): for your city and your people are called by your name.
verses.text: O Adonai, hear; O Adonai, forgive; O Adonai, hearken and do; defer not, for your own sake, O my Elohim: for your city and your people are called by your name.

verses.raw: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Yashar'el (Israel), and presenting my supplication before Yahuah Elohai (the LORD my God) for the holy mountain of my Elohim (God);
verses.text: And whiles I was speaking, and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Yashar'el, and presenting my supplication before Yahuah Elohai for the holy mountain of my Elohim;

verses.raw: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.
verses.text: Yea, whiles I was speaking in prayer, even the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, touched me about the time of the evening oblation.

verses.raw: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give you skill and understanding.
verses.text: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to give you skill and understanding.

verses.raw: At the beginning of your supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew you; for you are greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.
verses.text: At the beginning of your supplications the commandment came forth, and I am come to shew you; for you are greatly beloved: therefore understand the matter, and consider the vision.

verses.raw: Seventy weeks are determined upon your people and upon your holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.
verses.text: Seventy weeks are determined upon your people and upon your holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

verses.raw: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.
verses.text: Know therefore and understand, that from the going forth of the commandment to restore and to build Jerusalem unto the Messiah the Prince shall be seven weeks, and threescore and two weeks: the street shall be built again, and the wall, even in troublous times.

verses.raw: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.
verses.text: And after threescore and two weeks shall Messiah be cut off, but not for himself: and the people of the prince that shall come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary; and the end thereof shall be with a flood, and unto the end of the war desolations are determined.

verses.raw: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.
verses.text: And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease, and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate, even until the consummation, and that determined shall be poured upon the desolate.

verses.raw: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
verses.text: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed unto Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, but the time appointed was long: and he understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.

verses.raw: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.
verses.text: In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks.

verses.raw: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.text: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

verses.raw: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;
verses.text: And in the four and twentieth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel;

verses.raw: Then I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:
verses.text: Then I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a certain man clothed in linen, whose loins were girded with fine gold of Uphaz:

verses.raw: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.
verses.text: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

verses.raw: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
verses.text: And I Daniel alone saw the vision: for the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great quaking fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.

verses.raw: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.
verses.text: Therefore I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there remained no strength in me: for my comeliness was turned in me into corruption, and I retained no strength.

verses.raw: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.
verses.text: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

verses.raw: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.
verses.text: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto you, and stand upright: for unto you am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.
verses.text: And he said unto me, O Daniel, a man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak unto you, and stand upright: for unto you am I now sent. And when he had spoken this word unto me, I stood trembling.

verses.raw: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that you did set your heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before your Elohim (God), your words were heard, and I am come for your words.
verses.text: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that you did set your heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before your Elohim, your words were heard, and I am come for your words.

verses.raw: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.
verses.text: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me one and twenty days: but, lo, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me; and I remained there with the kings of Persia.

verses.raw: Now I am come to make you understand what shall befall your people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.
verses.text: Now I am come to make you understand what shall befall your people in the latter days: for yet the vision is for many days.

verses.raw: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.
verses.text: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

verses.raw: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
verses.text: And, behold, one like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

verses.raw: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.
verses.text: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

verses.raw: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,
verses.text: Then there came again and touched me one like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

verses.raw: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto you, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.
verses.text: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto you, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me.

verses.raw: Then said he, Know you wherefore I come unto you? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.
verses.text: Then said he, Know you wherefore I come unto you? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.

verses.raw: But I will shew you that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.
verses.text: But I will shew you that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

verses.raw: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.
verses.text: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, even I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

verses.raw: And now will I shew you the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.
verses.text: And now will I shew you the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.

verses.raw: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
verses.text: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

verses.raw: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.
verses.text: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.

verses.raw: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
verses.text: And the king of the south shall be strong, and one of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.

verses.raw: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king’s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.
verses.text: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king’s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in these times.

verses.raw: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
verses.text: But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:

verses.raw: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.
verses.text: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, and with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the north.

verses.raw: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.
verses.text: So the king of the south shall come into his kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

verses.raw: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.
verses.text: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, even to his fortress.

verses.raw: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.
verses.text: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

verses.raw: And when he has taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.
verses.text: And when he has taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down many ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened by it.

verses.raw: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.
verses.text: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.

verses.raw: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of your people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
verses.text: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of your people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

verses.raw: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.
verses.text: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to withstand.

verses.raw: But he that comes against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.
verses.text: But he that comes against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.

verses.raw: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.
verses.text: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand on his side, neither be for him.

verses.raw: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.
verses.text: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause it to turn upon him.

verses.raw: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
verses.text: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

verses.raw: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
verses.text: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes in the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

verses.raw: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
verses.text: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

verses.raw: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
verses.text: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.

verses.raw: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.
verses.text: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

verses.raw: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.
verses.text: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: yea, and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.

verses.raw: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.
verses.text: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

verses.raw: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.
verses.text: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.

verses.raw: And both these kings’ hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.
verses.text: And both these kings’ hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.

verses.raw: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.
verses.text: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be against the holy covenant; and he shall do exploits, and return to his own land.

verses.raw: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.
verses.text: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.

verses.raw: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.
verses.text: For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

verses.raw: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that makes desolate.
verses.text: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that makes desolate.

verses.raw: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their Elohim (God) shall be strong, and do exploits.
verses.text: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their Elohim shall be strong, and do exploits.

verses.raw: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.
verses.text: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, many days.

verses.raw: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.
verses.text: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.

verses.raw: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.
verses.text: And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for a time appointed.

verses.raw: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the Elohim (God) of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.
verses.text: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the Elohim of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.

verses.raw: Neither shall he regard the Elohim (God) of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.
verses.text: Neither shall he regard the Elohim of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

verses.raw: But in his estate shall he honour the Elohim (God) of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
verses.text: But in his estate shall he honour the Elohim of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

verses.raw: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.
verses.text: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

verses.raw: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.
verses.text: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.

verses.raw: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
verses.text: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many countries shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, even Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

verses.raw: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.text: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

verses.raw: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
verses.text: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.

verses.raw: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.
verses.text: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.

verses.raw: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
verses.text: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

verses.raw: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
verses.text: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

verses.raw: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

verses.raw: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.
verses.text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

verses.raw: But you, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.
verses.text: But you, O Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end: many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall be increased.

verses.raw: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
verses.text: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.

verses.raw: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?
verses.text: And one said to the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?

verses.raw: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that lives for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.
verses.text: And I heard the man clothed in linen, which was upon the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand unto heaven, and sware by him that lives for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half; and when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people, all these things shall be finished.

verses.raw: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?
verses.text: And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?

verses.raw: And he said, Go your way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.text: And he said, Go your way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.

verses.raw: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.
verses.text: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

verses.raw: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.text: And from the time that the daily sacrifice shall be taken away, and the abomination that makes desolate set up, there shall be a thousand two hundred and ninety days.

verses.raw: Blessed is he that waits, and comes to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
verses.text: Blessed is he that waits, and comes to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.

verses.raw: But go you your way till the end be: for you shall rest, and stand in your lot at the end of the days.
verses.text: But go you your way till the end be: for you shall rest, and stand in your lot at the end of the days.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah (Judah), and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The word of Yahuah that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yahudah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: The beginning of the word of Yahuah (LORD) by Hosea. And Yahuah (LORD) said to Hosea, Go, take unto you a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land has committed great whoredom, departing from Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: The beginning of the word of Yahuah by Hosea. And Yahuah said to Hosea, Go, take unto you a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land has committed great whoredom, departing from Yahuah.

verses.raw: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
verses.text: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Yashar'el (Israel) in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Yashar'el in the valley of Jezreel.

verses.raw: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And Elohim (God) said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Yashar'el (Israel); but I will utterly take them away.
verses.text: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And Elohim said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Yashar'el; but I will utterly take them away.

verses.raw: But I will have mercy upon the house of Yahudah (Judah), and will save them by Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
verses.text: But I will have mercy upon the house of Yahudah, and will save them by Yahuah their Elohim, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.

verses.raw: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
verses.text: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.

verses.raw: Then said Elohim (God), Call his name Lo-ammi: for you are not my people, and I will not be your Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then said Elohim, Call his name Lo-ammi: for you are not my people, and I will not be your Elohim.

verses.raw: Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, You are the sons of the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: Yet the number of the children of Yashar'el shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, You are the sons of the living Elohim.

verses.raw: Then shall the children of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
verses.text: Then shall the children of Yahudah and the children of Yashar'el be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.

verses.raw: Say you unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.
verses.text: Say you unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru-hamah.

verses.raw: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.text: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;

verses.raw: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
verses.text: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.

verses.raw: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
verses.text: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.

verses.raw: For their mother has played the harlot: she that conceived them has done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.
verses.text: For their mother has played the harlot: she that conceived them has done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up your way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.

verses.raw: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
verses.text: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.

verses.raw: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
verses.text: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.

verses.raw: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
verses.text: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.

verses.raw: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.
verses.text: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.

verses.raw: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
verses.text: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.

verses.raw: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she has said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
verses.text: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she has said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.

verses.raw: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
verses.text: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.

verses.raw: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And it shall be at that day, says Yahuah (LORD), that you shall call me Ishi; and shall call me no more Baali.
verses.text: And it shall be at that day, says Yahuah, that you shall call me Ishi; and shall call me no more Baali.

verses.raw: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
verses.text: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.

verses.raw: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
verses.text: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.

verses.raw: And I will betroth you unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth you unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
verses.text: And I will betroth you unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth you unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

verses.raw: I will even betroth you unto me in faithfulness: and you shall know Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will even betroth you unto me in faithfulness: and you shall know Yahuah.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, says Yahuah (LORD), I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, says Yahuah, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;

verses.raw: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
verses.text: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.

verses.raw: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, You are my people; and they shall say, You are my Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, You are my people; and they shall say, You are my Elohim.

verses.raw: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of Yahuah (LORD) toward the children of Yashar'el (Israel), who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
verses.text: Then said Yahuah unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of Yahuah toward the children of Yashar'el, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

verses.raw: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
verses.text: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:

verses.raw: And I said unto her, You shall abide for me many days; you shall not play the harlot, and you shall not be for another man: so will I also be for you.
verses.text: And I said unto her, You shall abide for me many days; you shall not play the harlot, and you shall not be for another man: so will I also be for you.

verses.raw: For the children of Yashar'el (Israel) shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
verses.text: For the children of Yashar'el shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:

verses.raw: Afterward shall the children of Yashar'el (Israel) return, and seek Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and David their king; and shall fear Yahuah (LORD) and his goodness in the latter days.
verses.text: Afterward shall the children of Yashar'el return, and seek Yahuah their Elohim, and David their king; and shall fear Yahuah and his goodness in the latter days.

verses.raw: Hear the word of Yahuah (LORD), you children of Yashar'el (Israel): for Yahuah (LORD) has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of Elohim (God) in the land.
verses.text: Hear the word of Yahuah, you children of Yashar'el: for Yahuah has a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of Elohim in the land.

verses.raw: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood touches blood.
verses.text: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood touches blood.

verses.raw: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwells therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.text: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwells therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

verses.raw: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for your people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.text: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for your people are as they that strive with the priest.

verses.raw: Therefore shall you fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with you in the night, and I will destroy your mother.
verses.text: Therefore shall you fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with you in the night, and I will destroy your mother.

verses.raw: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you shall be no priest to me: seeing you have forgotten the law of your Elohim (God), I will also forget your children.
verses.text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you shall be no priest to me: seeing you have forgotten the law of your Elohim, I will also forget your children.

verses.raw: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
verses.text: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.

verses.raw: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.text: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.

verses.raw: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
verses.text: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.

verses.raw: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to Yahuah.

verses.raw: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.text: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.

verses.raw: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms has caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their Elohim (God).
verses.text: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms has caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their Elohim.

verses.raw: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
verses.text: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

verses.raw: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that does not understand shall fall.
verses.text: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that does not understand shall fall.

verses.raw: Though you, Yashar'el (Israel), play the harlot, yet let not Yahudah (Judah) offend; and come not you unto Gilgal, neither go you up to Beth-aven, nor swear, Yahuah (LORD) lives.
verses.text: Though you, Yashar'el, play the harlot, yet let not Yahudah offend; and come not you unto Gilgal, neither go you up to Beth-aven, nor swear, Yahuah lives.

verses.raw: For Yashar'el (Israel) slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now Yahuah (LORD) will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.text: For Yashar'el slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now Yahuah will feed them as a lamb in a large place.

verses.raw: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.text: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.

verses.raw: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give you.
verses.text: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give you.

verses.raw: The wind has bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.text: The wind has bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.

verses.raw: Hear you this, O priests; and hearken, you house of Yashar'el (Israel); and give you ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because you have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.text: Hear you this, O priests; and hearken, you house of Yashar'el; and give you ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because you have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.

verses.raw: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
verses.text: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.

verses.raw: I know Ephraim, and Yashar'el (Israel) is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, you committest whoredom, and Yashar'el (Israel) is defiled.
verses.text: I know Ephraim, and Yashar'el is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, you committest whoredom, and Yashar'el is defiled.

verses.raw: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their Elohim (God): for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their Elohim: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the pride of Yashar'el (Israel) does testify to his face: therefore shall Yashar'el (Israel) and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Yahudah (Judah) also shall fall with them.
verses.text: And the pride of Yashar'el does testify to his face: therefore shall Yashar'el and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Yahudah also shall fall with them.

verses.raw: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahuah (LORD); but they shall not find him; he has withdrawn himself from them.
verses.text: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Yahuah; but they shall not find him; he has withdrawn himself from them.

verses.raw: They have dealt treacherously against Yahuah (LORD): for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.text: They have dealt treacherously against Yahuah: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.

verses.raw: Blow you the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after you, O Benjamin.
verses.text: Blow you the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after you, O Benjamin.

verses.raw: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel) have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.text: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Yashar'el have I made known that which shall surely be.

verses.raw: The princes of Yahudah (Judah) were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.text: The princes of Yahudah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

verses.raw: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
verses.text: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.

verses.raw: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Yahudah (Judah) as rottenness.
verses.text: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Yahudah as rottenness.

verses.raw: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Yahudah (Judah) saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.text: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Yahudah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.

verses.raw: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Yahudah (Judah): I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
verses.text: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Yahudah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.

verses.raw: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
verses.text: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

verses.raw: Come, and let us return unto Yahuah (LORD): for he has torn, and he will heal us; he has smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.text: Come, and let us return unto Yahuah: for he has torn, and he will heal us; he has smitten, and he will bind us up.

verses.raw: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
verses.text: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.

verses.raw: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know Yahuah (LORD): his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verses.text: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know Yahuah: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.

verses.raw: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto you? O Yahudah (Judah), what shall I do unto you? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goes away.
verses.text: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto you? O Yahudah, what shall I do unto you? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goes away.

verses.raw: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and your judgments are as the light that goes forth.
verses.text: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and your judgments are as the light that goes forth.

verses.raw: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of Elohim (God) more than burnt offerings.
verses.text: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of Elohim more than burnt offerings.

verses.raw: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.text: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.

verses.raw: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
verses.text: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.

verses.raw: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
verses.text: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.

verses.raw: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Yashar'el (Israel): there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Yashar'el (Israel) is defiled.
verses.text: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Yashar'el: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Yashar'el is defiled.

verses.raw: Also, O Yahudah (Judah), he has set an harvest for you, when I returned the captivity of my people.
verses.text: Also, O Yahudah, he has set an harvest for you, when I returned the captivity of my people.

verses.raw: When I would have healed Yashar'el (Israel), then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief comes in, and the troop of robbers spoils without.
verses.text: When I would have healed Yashar'el, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief comes in, and the troop of robbers spoils without.

verses.raw: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.text: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.

verses.raw: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.

verses.raw: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceases from raising after he has kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
verses.text: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceases from raising after he has kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.

verses.raw: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
verses.text: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.

verses.raw: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleeps all the night; in the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
verses.text: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleeps all the night; in the morning it burns as a flaming fire.

verses.raw: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calls unto me.
verses.text: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calls unto me.

verses.raw: Ephraim, he has mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.text: Ephraim, he has mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.

verses.raw: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knows it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knows not.
verses.text: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knows it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knows not.

verses.raw: And the pride of Yashar'el (Israel) testifieth to his face: and they do not return to Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), nor seek him for all this.
verses.text: And the pride of Yashar'el testifieth to his face: and they do not return to Yahuah their Elohim, nor seek him for all this.

verses.raw: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.text: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.

verses.raw: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
verses.text: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.

verses.raw: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.text: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.

verses.raw: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
verses.text: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.

verses.raw: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
