verses.text: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.

verses.raw: They return, but not to the El Elyon (most High): they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.text: They return, but not to the El Elyon: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: Set the trumpet to your mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of Yahuah (LORD), because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
verses.text: Set the trumpet to your mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of Yahuah, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) shall cry unto me, My Elohim (God), we know you.
verses.text: Yashar'el shall cry unto me, My Elohim, we know you.

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) has cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.text: Yashar'el has cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.

verses.raw: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.text: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.

verses.raw: Your calf, O Samaria, has cast you off; my anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
verses.text: Your calf, O Samaria, has cast you off; my anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?

verses.raw: For from Yashar'el (Israel) was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not Elohim (God): but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.text: For from Yashar'el was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not Elohim: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.

verses.raw: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it has no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.text: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it has no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
verses.text: Yashar'el is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.

verses.raw: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim has hired lovers.
verses.text: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim has hired lovers.

verses.raw: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
verses.text: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.

verses.raw: Because Ephraim has made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
verses.text: Because Ephraim has made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.

verses.raw: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
verses.text: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.

verses.raw: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of my offerings, and eat it; but Yahuah (LORD) accepts them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
verses.text: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of my offerings, and eat it; but Yahuah accepts them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.

verses.raw: For Yashar'el (Israel) has forgotten his Maker, and builds temples; and Yahudah (Judah) has multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.text: For Yashar'el has forgotten his Maker, and builds temples; and Yahudah has multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.

verses.raw: Rejoice not, O Yashar'el (Israel), for joy, as other people: for you have gone a whoring from your Elohim (God), you have loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
verses.text: Rejoice not, O Yashar'el, for joy, as other people: for you have gone a whoring from your Elohim, you have loved a reward upon every cornfloor.

verses.raw: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
verses.text: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.

verses.raw: They shall not dwell in the LORD’S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
verses.text: They shall not dwell in the LORD’S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.

verses.raw: They shall not offer wine offerings to Yahuah (LORD), neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: They shall not offer wine offerings to Yahuah, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: What will you do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of Yahuah (LORD)?
verses.text: What will you do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of Yahuah?

verses.raw: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
verses.text: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.

verses.raw: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Yashar'el (Israel) shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of your iniquity, and the great hatred.
verses.text: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Yashar'el shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of your iniquity, and the great hatred.

verses.raw: The watchman of Ephraim was with my Elohim (God): but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his Elohim (God).
verses.text: The watchman of Ephraim was with my Elohim: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his Elohim.

verses.raw: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.text: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.

verses.raw: I found Yashar'el (Israel) like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
verses.text: I found Yashar'el like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.

verses.raw: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
verses.text: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.

verses.raw: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.text: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!

verses.raw: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
verses.text: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.

verses.raw: Give them, O Yahuah (LORD): what will you give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.text: Give them, O Yahuah: what will you give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

verses.raw: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of my house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
verses.text: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of my house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.

verses.raw: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.text: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.

verses.raw: My Elohim (God) will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.text: My Elohim will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.

verses.raw: Yashar'el (Israel) is an empty vine, he brings forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he has increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
verses.text: Yashar'el is an empty vine, he brings forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he has increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.

verses.raw: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
verses.text: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.

verses.raw: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not Yahuah (LORD); what then should a king do to us?
verses.text: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not Yahuah; what then should a king do to us?

verses.raw: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.text: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.

verses.raw: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.text: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.

verses.raw: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Yashar'el (Israel) shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.text: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Yashar'el shall be ashamed of his own counsel.

verses.raw: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
verses.text: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.

verses.raw: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Yashar'el (Israel), shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.text: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Yashar'el, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.

verses.raw: O Yashar'el (Israel), you have sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.text: O Yashar'el, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.

verses.raw: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
verses.text: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.

verses.raw: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loves to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Yahudah (Judah) shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.text: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loves to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Yahudah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.

verses.raw: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek Yahuah (LORD), till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.text: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek Yahuah, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.

verses.raw: You have plowed wickedness, you have reaped iniquity; you have eaten the fruit of lies: because you did trust in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.
verses.text: You have plowed wickedness, you have reaped iniquity; you have eaten the fruit of lies: because you did trust in your way, in the multitude of your mighty men.

verses.raw: Therefore shall a tumult arise among your people, and all your fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.text: Therefore shall a tumult arise among your people, and all your fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.

verses.raw: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Yashar'el (Israel) utterly be cut off.
verses.text: So shall Beth-el do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Yashar'el utterly be cut off.

verses.raw: When Yashar'el (Israel) was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
verses.text: When Yashar'el was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.

verses.raw: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.text: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.

verses.raw: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.text: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.

verses.raw: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
verses.text: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.

verses.raw: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
verses.text: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.

verses.raw: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
verses.text: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.

verses.raw: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the El Elyon (most High), none at all would exalt him.
verses.text: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the El Elyon, none at all would exalt him.

verses.raw: How shall I give you up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver you, Yashar'el (Israel)? how shall I make you as Admah? how shall I set you as Zeboim? my heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
verses.text: How shall I give you up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver you, Yashar'el? how shall I make you as Admah? how shall I set you as Zeboim? my heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.

verses.raw: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am Elohim (God), and not man; the Holy One in the midst of you: and I will not enter into the city.
verses.text: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am Elohim, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of you: and I will not enter into the city.

verses.raw: They shall walk after Yahuah (LORD): he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
verses.text: They shall walk after Yahuah: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.

verses.raw: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Yashar'el (Israel) with deceit: but Yahudah (Judah) yet rules with Elohim (God), and is faithful with the saints.
verses.text: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Yashar'el with deceit: but Yahudah yet rules with Elohim, and is faithful with the saints.

verses.raw: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and follows after the east wind: he daily increases lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.text: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and follows after the east wind: he daily increases lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has also a controversy with Yahudah (Judah), and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
verses.text: Yahuah has also a controversy with Yahudah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.

verses.raw: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with Elohim (God):
verses.text: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with Elohim:

verses.raw: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Beth-el, and there he spake with us;
verses.text: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Beth-el, and there he spake with us;

verses.raw: Even Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts; Yahuah (LORD) is his memorial.
verses.text: Even Yahuah Elohim of hosts; Yahuah is his memorial.

verses.raw: Therefore turn you to your Elohim (God): keep mercy and judgment, and wait on your Elohim (God) continually.
verses.text: Therefore turn you to your Elohim: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on your Elohim continually.

verses.raw: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loves to oppress.
verses.text: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loves to oppress.

verses.raw: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
verses.text: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.

verses.raw: And I that am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) from the land of Egypt will yet make you to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.text: And I that am Yahuah Elohayka from the land of Egypt will yet make you to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.

verses.raw: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
verses.text: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.

verses.raw: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
verses.text: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.

verses.raw: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Yashar'el (Israel) served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
verses.text: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Yashar'el served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.

verses.raw: And by a prophet Yahuah (LORD) brought Yashar'el (Israel) out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.text: And by a prophet Yahuah brought Yashar'el out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.

verses.raw: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
verses.text: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.

verses.raw: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Yashar'el (Israel); but when he offended in Baal, he died.
verses.text: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Yashar'el; but when he offended in Baal, he died.

verses.raw: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
verses.text: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.

verses.raw: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passes away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.text: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passes away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.

verses.raw: Yet I am Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) from the land of Egypt, and you shall know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
verses.text: Yet I am Yahuah Elohayka from the land of Egypt, and you shall know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.

verses.raw: I did know you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.text: I did know you in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.

verses.raw: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
verses.text: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.

verses.raw: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
verses.text: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:

verses.raw: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
verses.text: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.

verses.raw: O Yashar'el (Israel), you have destroyed thyself; but in me is your help.
verses.text: O Yashar'el, you have destroyed thyself; but in me is your help.

verses.raw: I will be your king: where is any other that may save you in all your cities? and your judges of whom you saidst, Give me a king and princes?
verses.text: I will be your king: where is any other that may save you in all your cities? and your judges of whom you saidst, Give me a king and princes?

verses.raw: I gave you a king in my anger, and took him away in my wrath.
verses.text: I gave you a king in my anger, and took him away in my wrath.

verses.raw: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
verses.text: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.

verses.raw: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
verses.text: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.

verses.raw: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be your plagues; O grave, I will be your destruction: repentance shall be hid from my eyes.
verses.text: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be your plagues; O grave, I will be your destruction: repentance shall be hid from my eyes.

verses.raw: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of Yahuah (LORD) shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
verses.text: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of Yahuah shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.

verses.raw: Samaria shall become desolate; for she has rebelled against her Elohim (God): they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.text: Samaria shall become desolate; for she has rebelled against her Elohim: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.

verses.raw: O Yashar'el (Israel), return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God); for you have fallen by your iniquity.
verses.text: O Yashar'el, return unto Yahuah Elohayka; for you have fallen by your iniquity.

verses.raw: Take with you words, and turn to Yahuah (LORD): say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
verses.text: Take with you words, and turn to Yahuah: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.

verses.raw: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, You are our gods: for in you the fatherless finds mercy.
verses.text: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, You are our gods: for in you the fatherless finds mercy.

verses.raw: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for my anger is turned away from him.
verses.text: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for my anger is turned away from him.

verses.raw: I will be as the dew unto Yashar'el (Israel): he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.text: I will be as the dew unto Yashar'el: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.

verses.raw: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.text: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.

verses.raw: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.text: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.

verses.raw: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is your fruit found.
verses.text: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is your fruit found.

verses.raw: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of Yahuah (LORD) are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.text: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of Yahuah are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.text: The word of Yahuah that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.

verses.raw: Hear this, you old men, and give ear, all you inhabitants of the land. Has this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
verses.text: Hear this, you old men, and give ear, all you inhabitants of the land. Has this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?

verses.raw: Tell you your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
verses.text: Tell you your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.

verses.raw: That which the palmerworm has left has the locust eaten; and that which the locust has left has the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm has left has the caterpiller eaten.
verses.text: That which the palmerworm has left has the locust eaten; and that which the locust has left has the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm has left has the caterpiller eaten.

verses.raw: Awake, you drunkards, and weep; and howl, all you drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.text: Awake, you drunkards, and weep; and howl, all you drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.

verses.raw: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the cheek teeth of a great lion.
verses.text: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the cheek teeth of a great lion.

verses.raw: He has laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he has made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
verses.text: He has laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he has made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.

verses.raw: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
verses.text: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.

verses.raw: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of Yahuah (LORD); the priests, the LORD’S ministers, mourn.
verses.text: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of Yahuah; the priests, the LORD’S ministers, mourn.

verses.raw: The field is wasted, the land mourns; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
verses.text: The field is wasted, the land mourns; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.

verses.raw: Be you ashamed, O you husbandmen; howl, O you vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.text: Be you ashamed, O you husbandmen; howl, O you vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.

verses.raw: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.text: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.

verses.raw: Gird yourselves, and lament, you priests: howl, you ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my Elohim (God): for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your Elohim (God).
verses.text: Gird yourselves, and lament, you priests: howl, you ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, you ministers of my Elohim: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your Elohim.

verses.raw: Sanctify you a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and cry unto Yahuah (LORD),
verses.text: Sanctify you a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of Yahuah Elohaychem, and cry unto Yahuah,

verses.raw: Alas for the day! for the day of Yahuah (LORD) is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.text: Alas for the day! for the day of Yahuah is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

verses.raw: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our Elohim?

verses.raw: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
verses.text: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.

verses.raw: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.text: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), to you will I cry: for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.
verses.text: O Yahuah, to you will I cry: for the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame has burned all the trees of the field.

verses.raw: The beasts of the field cry also unto you: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.text: The beasts of the field cry also unto you: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire has devoured the pastures of the wilderness.

verses.raw: Blow you the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of Yahuah (LORD) comes, for it is nigh at hand;
verses.text: Blow you the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of Yahuah comes, for it is nigh at hand;

verses.raw: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there has not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
verses.text: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there has not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.

verses.raw: A fire devours before them; and behind them a flame burns: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
verses.text: A fire devours before them; and behind them a flame burns: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.

verses.raw: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
verses.text: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.

verses.raw: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
verses.text: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devours the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.

verses.raw: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
verses.text: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.

verses.raw: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
verses.text: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:

verses.raw: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
verses.text: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.

verses.raw: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.text: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.

verses.raw: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
verses.text: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of Yahuah (LORD) is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.text: And Yahuah shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of Yahuah is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?

verses.raw: Therefore also now, says Yahuah (LORD), turn you even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.text: Therefore also now, says Yahuah, turn you even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

verses.raw: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verses.text: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Yahuah Elohaychem: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

verses.raw: Who knows if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God)?
verses.text: Who knows if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto Yahuah Elohaychem?

verses.raw: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
verses.text: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:

verses.raw: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
verses.text: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.

verses.raw: Let the priests, the ministers of Yahuah (LORD), weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare your people, O Yahuah (LORD), and give not your heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Let the priests, the ministers of Yahuah, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare your people, O Yahuah, and give not your heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their Elohim?

verses.raw: Then will Yahuah (LORD) be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
verses.text: Then will Yahuah be jealous for his land, and pity his people.

verses.raw: Yea, Yahuah (LORD) will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and you shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
verses.text: Yea, Yahuah will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and you shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:

verses.raw: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he has done great things.
verses.text: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he has done great things.

verses.raw: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for Yahuah (LORD) will do great things.
verses.text: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for Yahuah will do great things.

verses.raw: Be not afraid, you beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree bears her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.text: Be not afraid, you beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree bears her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.

verses.raw: Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): for he has given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
verses.text: Be glad then, you children of Zion, and rejoice in Yahuah Elohaychem: for he has given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.

verses.raw: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.text: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the fats shall overflow with wine and oil.

verses.raw: And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
verses.text: And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.

verses.raw: And you shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), that has dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.text: And you shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of Yahuah Elohaychem, that has dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.

verses.raw: And you shall know that I am in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel), and that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.text: And you shall know that I am in the midst of Yashar'el, and that I am Yahuah Elohaychem, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
verses.text: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

verses.raw: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
verses.text: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.

verses.raw: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.text: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.

verses.raw: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of Yahuah (LORD) come.
verses.text: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and the terrible day of Yahuah come.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of Yahuah (LORD) shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as Yahuah (LORD) has said, and in the remnant whom Yahuah (LORD) shall call.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of Yahuah shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as Yahuah has said, and in the remnant whom Yahuah shall call.

verses.raw: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Yahudah (Judah) and Jerusalem,
verses.text: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Yahudah and Jerusalem,

verses.raw: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Yashar'el (Israel), whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
verses.text: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Yashar'el, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.

verses.raw: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
verses.text: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.

verses.raw: Yea, and what have you to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will you render me a recompence? and if you recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
verses.text: Yea, and what have you to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will you render me a recompence? and if you recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;

verses.raw: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
verses.text: Because you have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:

verses.raw: The children also of Yahudah (Judah) and the children of Jerusalem have you sold unto the Grecians, that you might remove them far from their border.
verses.text: The children also of Yahudah and the children of Jerusalem have you sold unto the Grecians, that you might remove them far from their border.

verses.raw: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither you have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
verses.text: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither you have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:

verses.raw: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Yahudah (Judah), and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.
verses.text: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Yahudah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for Yahuah has spoken it.

verses.raw: Proclaim you this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
verses.text: Proclaim you this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:

verses.raw: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verses.text: Beat your plowshares into swords, and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.

verses.raw: Assemble yourselves, and come, all you heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause your mighty ones to come down, O Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Assemble yourselves, and come, all you heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause your mighty ones to come down, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
verses.text: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.

verses.raw: Put you in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
verses.text: Put you in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.

verses.raw: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of Yahuah (LORD) is near in the valley of decision.
verses.text: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of Yahuah is near in the valley of decision.

verses.raw: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
verses.text: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but Yahuah (LORD) will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yahuah also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but Yahuah will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So shall you know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
verses.text: So shall you know that I am Yahuah Elohaychem dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Yahudah (Judah) shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of Yahuah (LORD), and shall water the valley of Shittim.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Yahudah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth of the house of Yahuah, and shall water the valley of Shittim.

verses.raw: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Yahudah (Judah), because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.text: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Yahudah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.

verses.raw: But Yahudah (Judah) shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.text: But Yahudah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.

verses.raw: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for Yahuah (LORD) dwells in Zion.
verses.text: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for Yahuah dwells in Zion.

verses.raw: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Yashar'el (Israel) in the days of Uzziah king of Yahudah (Judah), and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Yashar'el (Israel), two years before the earthquake.
verses.text: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Yashar'el in the days of Uzziah king of Yahudah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Yashar'el, two years before the earthquake.

verses.raw: And he said, Yahuah (LORD) will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
verses.text: And he said, Yahuah will roar from Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the habitations of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron:

verses.raw: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.
verses.text: But I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, which shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad.

verses.raw: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will break also the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the plain of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from the house of Eden: and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; For three transgressions of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom:

verses.raw: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:
verses.text: But I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, which shall devour the palaces thereof:

verses.raw: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn my hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn my hand against Ekron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; For three transgressions of Tyrus, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant:

verses.raw: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.text: But I will send a fire on the wall of Tyrus, which shall devour the palaces thereof.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever:

verses.raw: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
verses.text: But I will send a fire upon Teman, which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border:

verses.raw: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:
verses.text: But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind:

verses.raw: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime:

verses.raw: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:
verses.text: But I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth: and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet:

verses.raw: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); For three transgressions of Yahudah (Judah), and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of Yahuah (LORD), and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; For three transgressions of Yahudah, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they have despised the law of Yahuah, and have not kept his commandments, and their lies caused them to err, after the which their fathers have walked:

verses.raw: But I will send a fire upon Yahudah (Judah), and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.text: But I will send a fire upon Yahudah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); For three transgressions of Yashar'el (Israel), and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; For three transgressions of Yashar'el, and for four, I will not turn away the punishment thereof; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for a pair of shoes;

verses.raw: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:
verses.text: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turn aside the way of the meek: and a man and his father will go in unto the same maid, to profane my holy name:

verses.raw: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.
verses.text: And they lay themselves down upon clothes laid to pledge by every altar, and they drink the wine of the condemned in the house of their god.

verses.raw: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
verses.text: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; yet I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.

verses.raw: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
verses.text: Also I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years through the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.

verses.raw: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O you children of Yashar'el (Israel)? says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, O you children of Yashar'el? says Yahuah.

verses.raw: But you gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
verses.text: But you gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.

verses.raw: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.
verses.text: Behold, I am pressed under you, as a cart is pressed that is full of sheaves.

verses.raw: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:
verses.text: Therefore the flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver himself:

verses.raw: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rides the horse deliver himself.
verses.text: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself: neither shall he that rides the horse deliver himself.

verses.raw: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And he that is courageous among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Hear this word that Yahuah (LORD) has spoken against you, O children of Yashar'el (Israel), against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.text: Hear this word that Yahuah has spoken against you, O children of Yashar'el, against the whole family which I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.raw: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
verses.text: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.

verses.raw: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?
verses.text: Can two walk together, except they be agreed?

verses.raw: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he has no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?
verses.text: Will a lion roar in the forest, when he has no prey? will a young lion cry out of his den, if he have taken nothing?

verses.raw: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?
verses.text: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, where no gin is for him? shall one take up a snare from the earth, and have taken nothing at all?

verses.raw: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and Yahuah (LORD) has not done it?
verses.text: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? shall there be evil in a city, and Yahuah has not done it?

verses.raw: Surely Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) does nothing without first revealing his secret unto his servants the prophets.
verses.text: Surely Adonai Yahuah does nothing without first revealing his secret unto his servants the prophets.

verses.raw: The lion has roared, who will not fear? Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) has spoken, who can but prophesy?
verses.text: The lion has roared, who will not fear? Adonai Yahuah has spoken, who can but prophesy?

verses.raw: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.
verses.text: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great tumults in the midst thereof, and the oppressed in the midst thereof.

verses.raw: For they know not to do right, says Yahuah (LORD), who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
verses.text: For they know not to do right, says Yahuah, who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down your strength from you, and your palaces shall be spoiled.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Adonai Yahuah; An adversary there shall be even round about the land; and he shall bring down your strength from you, and your palaces shall be spoiled.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); As the shepherd takes out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; As the shepherd takes out of the mouth of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Yashar'el be taken out that dwell in Samaria in the corner of a bed, and in Damascus in a couch.

verses.raw: Hear you, and testify in the house of Jacob, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), the Elohim (God) of hosts,
verses.text: Hear you, and testify in the house of Jacob, says Adonai Yahuah, the Elohim of hosts,

verses.raw: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Yashar'el (Israel) upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth-el: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
verses.text: That in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Yashar'el upon him I will also visit the altars of Beth-el: and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.

verses.raw: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I will smite the winter house with the summer house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and the great houses shall have an end, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Hear this word, you kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.
verses.text: Hear this word, you kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, which oppress the poor, which crush the needy, which say to their masters, Bring, and let us drink.

verses.raw: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.
verses.text: Adonai Yahuah (The Lord GOD) has sworn by his holiness, that, lo, the days shall come upon you, that he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fishhooks.

verses.raw: And you shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and you shall cast them into the palace, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And you shall go out at the breaches, every cow at that which is before her; and you shall cast them into the palace, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Come to Beth-el, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:
verses.text: Come to Beth-el, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices every morning, and your tithes after three years:

verses.raw: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O you children of Yashar'el (Israel), says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).
verses.text: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim and publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O you children of Yashar'el, says Adonai Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
verses.text: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.

verses.raw: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: So two or three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured them: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I have overthrown some of you, as Elohim (God) overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I have overthrown some of you, as Elohim overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have you not returned unto me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore thus will I do unto you, O Yashar'el (Israel): and because I will do this unto you, prepare to meet your Elohim (God), O Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Therefore thus will I do unto you, O Yashar'el: and because I will do this unto you, prepare to meet your Elohim, O Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that makes the morning darkness, and treads upon the high places of the earth, Yahuah (LORD), The Elohim (God) of hosts, is his name.
verses.text: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that makes the morning darkness, and treads upon the high places of the earth, Yahuah, The Elohim of hosts, is his name.

verses.raw: Hear you this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Hear you this word which I take up against you, even a lamentation, O house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: The virgin of Yashar'el (Israel) is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
verses.text: The virgin of Yashar'el is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.

verses.raw: For thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: For thus says Adonai Yahuah; The city that went out by a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth by an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) unto the house of Yashar'el (Israel), Seek you me, and you shall live:
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah unto the house of Yashar'el, Seek you me, and you shall live:

verses.raw: But seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.
verses.text: But seek not Beth-el, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el shall come to nought.

verses.raw: Seek Yahuah (LORD), and you shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.
verses.text: Seek Yahuah, and you shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Beth-el.

verses.raw: You who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,
verses.text: You who turn judgment to wormwood, and leave off righteousness in the earth,

verses.raw: Seek him that makes the seven stars and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night: that calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out upon the face of the earth: Yahuah (LORD) is his name:
verses.text: Seek him that makes the seven stars and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night: that calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out upon the face of the earth: Yahuah is his name:

verses.raw: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.
verses.text: That strengtheneth the spoiled against the strong, so that the spoiled shall come against the fortress.

verses.raw: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaks uprightly.
verses.text: They hate him that rebuketh in the gate, and they abhor him that speaks uprightly.

verses.raw: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and you take from him burdens of wheat: you have built houses of hewn stone, but you shall not dwell in them; you have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink wine of them.
verses.text: Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and you take from him burdens of wheat: you have built houses of hewn stone, but you shall not dwell in them; you have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink wine of them.

verses.raw: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.
verses.text: For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.

verses.raw: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.
verses.text: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in that time; for it is an evil time.

verses.raw: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live: and so Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of hosts, shall be with you, as you have spoken.
verses.text: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live: and so Yahuah, the Elohim of hosts, shall be with you, as you have spoken.

verses.raw: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
verses.text: Hate the evil, and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that Yahuah Elohim of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (LORD), the Elohim (God) of hosts, Adonai (Lord), says thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah, the Elohim of hosts, Adonai, says thus; Wailing shall be in all streets; and they shall say in all the highways, Alas! alas! and they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.

verses.raw: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through you, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: And in all vineyards shall be wailing: for I will pass through you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Woe unto you that desire the day of Yahuah (LORD)! to what end is it for you? the day of Yahuah (LORD) is darkness, and not light.
verses.text: Woe unto you that desire the day of Yahuah! to what end is it for you? the day of Yahuah is darkness, and not light.

verses.raw: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
verses.text: As if a man did flee from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house, and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.

verses.raw: Shall not the day of Yahuah (LORD) be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
verses.text: Shall not the day of Yahuah be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
