verses.raw: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.text: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

verses.raw: You will perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which you have sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
verses.text: You will perform the truth to Jacob, and the mercy to Abraham, which you have sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.

verses.raw: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.text: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is jealous, and Yahuah (LORD) revengeth; Yahuah (LORD) revengeth, and is furious; Yahuah (LORD) will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.
verses.text: Elohim is jealous, and Yahuah revengeth; Yahuah revengeth, and is furious; Yahuah will take vengeance on his adversaries, and he reserveth wrath for his enemies.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: Yahuah (LORD) has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
verses.text: Yahuah is slow to anger, and great in power, and will not at all acquit the wicked: Yahuah has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

verses.raw: He rebuketh the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
verses.text: He rebuketh the sea, and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers: Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon languisheth.

verses.raw: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
verses.text: The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.

verses.raw: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
verses.text: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knows them that trust in him.
verses.text: Yahuah is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knows them that trust in him.

verses.raw: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.
verses.text: But with an overrunning flood he will make an utter end of the place thereof, and darkness shall pursue his enemies.

verses.raw: What do you imagine against Yahuah (LORD)? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
verses.text: What do you imagine against Yahuah? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.

verses.raw: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
verses.text: For while they be folden together as thorns, and while they are drunken as drunkards, they shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.

verses.raw: There is one come out of you, that imagineth evil against Yahuah (LORD), a wicked counsellor.
verses.text: There is one come out of you, that imagineth evil against Yahuah, a wicked counsellor.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (LORD); Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah; Though they be quiet, and likewise many, yet thus shall they be cut down, when he shall pass through. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

verses.raw: For now will I break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds in sunder.
verses.text: For now will I break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds in sunder.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) has given a commandment concerning you, that no more of your name be sown: out of the house of your gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make your grave; for you are vile.
verses.text: And Yahuah has given a commandment concerning you, that no more of your name be sown: out of the house of your gods will I cut off the graven image and the molten image: I will make your grave; for you are vile.

verses.raw: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that brings good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Yahudah (Judah), keep your solemn feasts, perform your vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through you; he is utterly cut off.
verses.text: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him that brings good tidings, that publisheth peace! O Yahudah, keep your solemn feasts, perform your vows: for the wicked shall no more pass through you; he is utterly cut off.

verses.raw: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before your face: keep the munition, watch the way, make your loins strong, fortify your power mightily.
verses.text: He that dasheth in pieces is come up before your face: keep the munition, watch the way, make your loins strong, fortify your power mightily.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (LORD) has turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Yashar'el (Israel): for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.
verses.text: For Yahuah has turned away the excellency of Jacob, as the excellency of Yashar'el: for the emptiers have emptied them out, and marred their vine branches.

verses.raw: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.
verses.text: The shield of his mighty men is made red, the valiant men are in scarlet: the chariots shall be with flaming torches in the day of his preparation, and the fir trees shall be terribly shaken.

verses.raw: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.
verses.text: The chariots shall rage in the streets, they shall justle one against another in the broad ways: they shall seem like torches, they shall run like the lightnings.

verses.raw: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.
verses.text: He shall recount his worthies: they shall stumble in their walk; they shall make haste to the wall thereof, and the defence shall be prepared.

verses.raw: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.
verses.text: The gates of the rivers shall be opened, and the palace shall be dissolved.

verses.raw: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.
verses.text: And Huzzab shall be led away captive, she shall be brought up, and her maids shall lead her as with the voice of doves, tabering upon their breasts.

verses.raw: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.
verses.text: But Nineveh is of old like a pool of water: yet they shall flee away. Stand, stand, shall they cry; but none shall look back.

verses.raw: Take you the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.
verses.text: Take you the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold: for there is none end of the store and glory out of all the pleasant furniture.

verses.raw: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.
verses.text: She is empty, and void, and waste: and the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, and much pain is in all loins, and the faces of them all gather blackness.

verses.raw: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion’s whelp, and none made them afraid?
verses.text: Where is the dwelling of the lions, and the feedingplace of the young lions, where the lion, even the old lion, walked, and the lion’s whelp, and none made them afraid?

verses.raw: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.
verses.text: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, and strangled for his lionesses, and filled his holes with prey, and his dens with ravin.

verses.raw: Behold, I am against you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions: and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall no more be heard.
verses.text: Behold, I am against you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, and I will burn her chariots in the smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions: and I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall no more be heard.

verses.raw: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departs not;
verses.text: Woe to the bloody city! it is all full of lies and robbery; the prey departs not;

verses.raw: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.
verses.text: The noise of a whip, and the noise of the rattling of the wheels, and of the pransing horses, and of the jumping chariots.

verses.raw: The horseman lifts up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:
verses.text: The horseman lifts up both the bright sword and the glittering spear: and there is a multitude of slain, and a great number of carcases; and there is none end of their corpses; they stumble upon their corpses:

verses.raw: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.
verses.text: Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot, the mistress of witchcrafts, that selleth nations through her whoredoms, and families through her witchcrafts.

verses.raw: Behold, I am against you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); and I will discover your skirts upon your face, and I will shew the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.
verses.text: Behold, I am against you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot; and I will discover your skirts upon your face, and I will shew the nations your nakedness, and the kingdoms your shame.

verses.raw: And I will cast abominable filth upon you, and make you vile, and will set you as a gazingstock.
verses.text: And I will cast abominable filth upon you, and make you vile, and will set you as a gazingstock.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon you shall flee from you, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for you?
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon you shall flee from you, and say, Nineveh is laid waste: who will bemoan her? whence shall I seek comforters for you?

verses.raw: Are you better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?
verses.text: Are you better than populous No, that was situate among the rivers, that had the waters round about it, whose rampart was the sea, and her wall was from the sea?

verses.raw: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were your helpers.
verses.text: Ethiopia and Egypt were her strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were your helpers.

verses.raw: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.text: Yet was she carried away, she went into captivity: her young children also were dashed in pieces at the top of all the streets: and they cast lots for her honourable men, and all her great men were bound in chains.

verses.raw: You also shall be drunken: you shall be hid, you also shall seek strength because of the enemy.
verses.text: You also shall be drunken: you shall be hid, you also shall seek strength because of the enemy.

verses.raw: All your strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.text: All your strong holds shall be like fig trees with the firstripe figs: if they be shaken, they shall even fall into the mouth of the eater.

verses.raw: Behold, your people in the midst of you are women: the gates of your land shall be set wide open unto your enemies: the fire shall devour your bars.
verses.text: Behold, your people in the midst of you are women: the gates of your land shall be set wide open unto your enemies: the fire shall devour your bars.

verses.raw: Draw you waters for the siege, fortify your strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.
verses.text: Draw you waters for the siege, fortify your strong holds: go into clay, and tread the morter, make strong the brickkiln.

verses.raw: There shall the fire devour you; the sword shall cut you off, it shall eat you up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.
verses.text: There shall the fire devour you; the sword shall cut you off, it shall eat you up like the cankerworm: make thyself many as the cankerworm, make thyself many as the locusts.

verses.raw: You have multiplied your merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoils, and flieth away.
verses.text: You have multiplied your merchants above the stars of heaven: the cankerworm spoils, and flieth away.

verses.raw: Your crowned are as the locusts, and your captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun arises they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.
verses.text: Your crowned are as the locusts, and your captains as the great grasshoppers, which camp in the hedges in the cold day, but when the sun arises they flee away, and their place is not known where they are.

verses.raw: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: your nobles shall dwell in the dust: your people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathers them.
verses.text: Your shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria: your nobles shall dwell in the dust: your people is scattered upon the mountains, and no man gathers them.

verses.raw: There is no healing of your bruise; your wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of you shall clap the hands over you: for upon whom has not your wickedness passed continually?
verses.text: There is no healing of your bruise; your wound is grievous: all that hear the bruit of you shall clap the hands over you: for upon whom has not your wickedness passed continually?

verses.raw: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
verses.text: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), how long shall I cry, and you will not hear! even cry out unto you of violence, and you will not save!
verses.text: O Yahuah, how long shall I cry, and you will not hear! even cry out unto you of violence, and you will not save!

verses.raw: Why do you shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
verses.text: Why do you shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.

verses.raw: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment does never go forth: for the wicked does compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceeds.
verses.text: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment does never go forth: for the wicked does compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceeds.

verses.raw: Behold you among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which you will not believe, though it be told you.
verses.text: Behold you among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which you will not believe, though it be told you.

verses.raw: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.
verses.text: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.

verses.raw: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
verses.text: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

verses.raw: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
verses.text: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.

verses.raw: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
verses.text: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.

verses.raw: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
verses.text: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

verses.raw: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
verses.text: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.

verses.raw: Are you not from everlasting, O Yahuah (LORD) my Elohim (God), my Holy One? we shall not die. O Yahuah (LORD), you have ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty Elohim (God), you have established them for correction.
verses.text: Are you not from everlasting, O Yahuah my Elohim, my Holy One? we shall not die. O Yahuah, you have ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty Elohim, you have established them for correction.

verses.raw: You are of purer eyes than to behold evil, and can not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest you upon them that deal treacherously, and hold your tongue when the wicked devours the man that is more righteous than he?
verses.text: You are of purer eyes than to behold evil, and can not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest you upon them that deal treacherously, and hold your tongue when the wicked devours the man that is more righteous than he?

verses.raw: And make men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
verses.text: And make men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

verses.raw: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
verses.text: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.

verses.raw: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
verses.text: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.

verses.raw: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
verses.text: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?

verses.raw: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.
verses.text: I will stand upon my watch, and set me upon the tower, and will watch to see what he will say unto me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.
verses.text: And Yahuah answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

verses.raw: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.
verses.text: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

verses.raw: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the righteous shall live by his faith.
verses.text: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the righteous shall live by his faith.

verses.raw: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keeps at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathers unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:
verses.text: Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine, he is a proud man, neither keeps at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathers unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people:

verses.raw: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increases that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!
verses.text: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increases that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!

verses.raw: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite you, and awake that shall vex you, and you shall be for booties unto them?
verses.text: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall bite you, and awake that shall vex you, and you shall be for booties unto them?

verses.raw: Because you have spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil you; because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.text: Because you have spoiled many nations, all the remnant of the people shall spoil you; because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

verses.raw: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!
verses.text: Woe to him that coveteth an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evil!

verses.raw: You have consulted shame to your house by cutting off many people, and have sinned against your soul.
verses.text: You have consulted shame to your house by cutting off many people, and have sinned against your soul.

verses.raw: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
verses.text: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.

verses.raw: Woe to him that builds a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!
verses.text: Woe to him that builds a town with blood, and stablisheth a city by iniquity!

verses.raw: Behold, is it not of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?
verses.text: Behold, is it not of Yahuah Tseva'ot that the people shall labour in the very fire, and the people shall weary themselves for very vanity?

verses.raw: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Yahuah (LORD), as the waters cover the sea.
verses.text: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of Yahuah, as the waters cover the sea.

verses.raw: Woe unto him that gives his neighbour drink, that put your bottle to him, and make him drunken also, that you may look on their nakedness!
verses.text: Woe unto him that gives his neighbour drink, that put your bottle to him, and make him drunken also, that you may look on their nakedness!

verses.raw: You are filled with shame for glory: drink you also, and let your foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’S right hand shall be turned unto you, and shameful spewing shall be on your glory.
verses.text: You are filled with shame for glory: drink you also, and let your foreskin be uncovered: the cup of the LORD’S right hand shall be turned unto you, and shameful spewing shall be on your glory.

verses.raw: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover you, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.
verses.text: For the violence of Lebanon shall cover you, and the spoil of beasts, which made them afraid, because of men’s blood, and for the violence of the land, of the city, and of all that dwell therein.

verses.raw: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof has graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusts therein, to make dumb idols?
verses.text: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof has graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusts therein, to make dumb idols?

verses.raw: Woe unto him that says to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
verses.text: Woe unto him that says to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (LORD) is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.
verses.text: But Yahuah is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

verses.raw: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.
verses.text: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (LORD), I have heard your speech, and was afraid: O Yahuah (LORD), revive your work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
verses.text: O Yahuah, I have heard your speech, and was afraid: O Yahuah, revive your work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.
verses.text: Elohim came from Teman, and the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah. His glory covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise.

verses.raw: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.
verses.text: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.

verses.raw: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.
verses.text: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

verses.raw: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.
verses.text: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.

verses.raw: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.
verses.text: I saw the tents of Cushan in affliction: and the curtains of the land of Midian did tremble.

verses.raw: Was Yahuah (LORD) displeased against the rivers? was your anger against the rivers? was your wrath against the sea, that you did ride upon your horses and your chariots of salvation?
verses.text: Was Yahuah displeased against the rivers? was your anger against the rivers? was your wrath against the sea, that you did ride upon your horses and your chariots of salvation?

verses.raw: Your bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even your word. Selah. You did cleave the earth with rivers.
verses.text: Your bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even your word. Selah. You did cleave the earth with rivers.

verses.raw: The mountains saw you, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.
verses.text: The mountains saw you, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.

verses.raw: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of your arrows they went, and at the shining of your glittering spear.
verses.text: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of your arrows they went, and at the shining of your glittering spear.

verses.raw: You did march through the land in indignation, you did thresh the heathen in anger.
verses.text: You did march through the land in indignation, you did thresh the heathen in anger.

verses.raw: You went forth for the salvation of your people, even for salvation with your anointed; you woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.
verses.text: You went forth for the salvation of your people, even for salvation with your anointed; you woundedst the head out of the house of the wicked, by discovering the foundation unto the neck. Selah.

verses.raw: You did strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.
verses.text: You did strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.

verses.raw: You did walk through the sea with your horses, through the heap of great waters.
verses.text: You did walk through the sea with your horses, through the heap of great waters.

verses.raw: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he comes up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.
verses.text: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he comes up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

verses.raw: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:
verses.text: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:

verses.raw: Yet I will rejoice in Yahuah (LORD), I will joy in the Elohim (God) of my salvation.
verses.text: Yet I will rejoice in Yahuah, I will joy in the Elohim of my salvation.

verses.raw: Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk upon my high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.
verses.text: Yahuah Elohim (The LORD God) is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk upon my high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

verses.raw: The word of Yahuah (LORD) which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: The word of Yahuah which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hizkiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Yahudah.

verses.raw: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will utterly consume all things from off the land, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will consume man and beast; I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, and the stumblingblocks with the wicked; and I will cut off man from off the land, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will also stretch out my hand upon Yahudah (Judah), and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;
verses.text: I will also stretch out my hand upon Yahudah, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, and the name of the Chemarims with the priests;

verses.raw: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by Yahuah (LORD), and that swear by Malcham;
verses.text: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and that swear by Yahuah, and that swear by Malcham;

verses.raw: And them that are turned back from Yahuah (LORD); and those that have not sought Yahuah (LORD), nor enquired for him.
verses.text: And them that are turned back from Yahuah; and those that have not sought Yahuah, nor enquired for him.

verses.raw: Hold your peace at the presence of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD): for the day of Yahuah (LORD) is at hand: for Yahuah (LORD) has prepared a sacrifice, he has bid his guests.
verses.text: Hold your peace at the presence of Adonai Yahuah: for the day of Yahuah is at hand: for Yahuah has prepared a sacrifice, he has bid his guests.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD’S sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD’S sacrifice, that I will punish the princes, and the king’s children, and all such as are clothed with strange apparel.

verses.raw: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.
verses.text: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap on the threshold, which fill their masters’ houses with violence and deceit.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah (LORD), that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, says Yahuah, that there shall be the noise of a cry from the fish gate, and an howling from the second, and a great crashing from the hills.

verses.raw: Howl, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.
verses.text: Howl, you inhabitants of Maktesh, for all the merchant people are cut down; all they that bear silver are cut off.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, Yahuah (LORD) will not do good, neither will he do evil.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass at that time, that I will search Jerusalem with candles, and punish the men that are settled on their lees: that say in their heart, Yahuah will not do good, neither will he do evil.

verses.raw: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.
verses.text: Therefore their goods shall become a booty, and their houses a desolation: they shall also build houses, but not inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, but not drink the wine thereof.

verses.raw: The great day of Yahuah (LORD) is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of Yahuah (LORD): the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.
verses.text: The great day of Yahuah is near, it is near, and hasteth greatly, even the voice of the day of Yahuah: the mighty man shall cry there bitterly.

verses.raw: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.text: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and distress, a day of wasteness and desolation, a day of darkness and gloominess, a day of clouds and thick darkness,

verses.raw: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.
verses.text: A day of the trumpet and alarm against the fenced cities, and against the high towers.

verses.raw: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against Yahuah (LORD): and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.
verses.text: And I will bring distress upon men, that they shall walk like blind men, because they have sinned against Yahuah: and their blood shall be poured out as dust, and their flesh as the dung.

verses.raw: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’S wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.
verses.text: Neither their silver nor their gold shall be able to deliver them in the day of the LORD’S wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealousy: for he shall make even a speedy riddance of all them that dwell in the land.

verses.raw: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;
verses.text: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired;

verses.raw: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahuah (LORD) come upon you, before the day of the LORD’S anger come upon you.
verses.text: Before the decree bring forth, before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahuah come upon you, before the day of the LORD’S anger come upon you.

verses.raw: Seek you Yahuah (LORD), all you meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be you shall be hid in the day of the LORD’S anger.
verses.text: Seek you Yahuah, all you meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment; seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be you shall be hid in the day of the LORD’S anger.

verses.raw: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.
verses.text: For Gaza shall be forsaken, and Ashkelon a desolation: they shall drive out Ashdod at the noon day, and Ekron shall be rooted up.

verses.raw: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of Yahuah (LORD) is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy you, that there shall be no inhabitant.
verses.text: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea coast, the nation of the Cherethites! the word of Yahuah is against you; O Canaan, the land of the Philistines, I will even destroy you, that there shall be no inhabitant.

verses.raw: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
verses.text: And the sea coast shall be dwellings and cottages for shepherds, and folds for flocks.

verses.raw: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Yahudah (Judah); they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.
verses.text: And the coast shall be for the remnant of the house of Yahudah; they shall feed thereupon: in the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening: for Yahuah their Elohim shall visit them, and turn away their captivity.

verses.raw: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.
verses.text: I have heard the reproach of Moab, and the revilings of the children of Ammon, whereby they have reproached my people, and magnified themselves against their border.

verses.raw: Therefore as I live, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.
verses.text: Therefore as I live, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, the Elohim of Yashar'el, Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, even the breeding of nettles, and saltpits, and a perpetual desolation: the residue of my people shall spoil them, and the remnant of my people shall possess them.

verses.raw: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: This shall they have for their pride, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the people of Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.
verses.text: Yahuah will be terrible unto them: for he will famish all the gods of the earth; and men shall worship him, every one from his place, even all the isles of the heathen.

verses.raw: You Ethiopians also, you shall be slain by my sword.
verses.text: You Ethiopians also, you shall be slain by my sword.

verses.raw: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
verses.text: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.

verses.raw: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.
verses.text: And flocks shall lie down in the midst of her, all the beasts of the nations: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it; their voice shall sing in the windows; desolation shall be in the thresholds: for he shall uncover the cedar work.

verses.raw: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passes by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.
verses.text: This is the rejoicing city that dwelt carelessly, that said in her heart, I am, and there is none beside me: how is she become a desolation, a place for beasts to lie down in! every one that passes by her shall hiss, and wag his hand.

verses.raw: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!
verses.text: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, to the oppressing city!

verses.raw: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in Yahuah (LORD); she drew not near to her Elohim (God).
verses.text: She obeyed not the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in Yahuah; she drew not near to her Elohim.

verses.raw: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.
verses.text: Her princes within her are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves; they gnaw not the bones till the morrow.

verses.raw: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.
verses.text: Her prophets are light and treacherous persons: her priests have polluted the sanctuary, they have done violence to the law.

verses.raw: The just Yahuah (LORD) is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning does he bring his judgment to light, he fails not; but the unjust knows no shame.
verses.text: The just Yahuah is in the midst thereof; he will not do iniquity: every morning does he bring his judgment to light, he fails not; but the unjust knows no shame.

verses.raw: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passes by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.
verses.text: I have cut off the nations: their towers are desolate; I made their streets waste, that none passes by: their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, that there is none inhabitant.

verses.raw: I said, Surely you will fear me, you will receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.
verses.text: I said, Surely you will fear me, you will receive instruction; so their dwelling should not be cut off, howsoever I punished them: but they rose early, and corrupted all their doings.

verses.raw: Therefore wait you upon me, says Yahuah (LORD), until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them my indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.
verses.text: Therefore wait you upon me, says Yahuah, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them my indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.

verses.raw: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD), to serve him with one consent.
verses.text: For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of Yahuah, to serve him with one consent.

verses.raw: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring my offering.
verses.text: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring my offering.

verses.raw: In that day shall you not be ashamed for all your doings, wherein you have transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of you them that rejoice in your pride, and you shall no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.
verses.text: In that day shall you not be ashamed for all your doings, wherein you have transgressed against me: for then I will take away out of the midst of you them that rejoice in your pride, and you shall no more be haughty because of my holy mountain.

verses.raw: I will also leave in the midst of you an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I will also leave in the midst of you an afflicted and poor people, and they shall trust in the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: The remnant of Yashar'el (Israel) shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.text: The remnant of Yashar'el shall not do iniquity, nor speak lies; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed and lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

verses.raw: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Yashar'el (Israel); be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Sing, O daughter of Zion; shout, O Yashar'el; be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has taken away your judgments, he has cast out your enemy: the king of Yashar'el (Israel), even Yahuah (LORD), is in the midst of you: you shall not see evil any more.
verses.text: Yahuah has taken away your judgments, he has cast out your enemy: the king of Yashar'el, even Yahuah, is in the midst of you: you shall not see evil any more.

verses.raw: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear you not: and to Zion, Let not your hands be slack.
verses.text: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem, Fear you not: and to Zion, Let not your hands be slack.

verses.raw: Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) in the midst of you is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over you with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over you with singing.
verses.text: Yahuah Elohayka (The LORD thy God) in the midst of you is mighty; he will save, he will rejoice over you with joy; he will rest in his love, he will joy over you with singing.

verses.raw: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of you, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.
verses.text: I will gather them that are sorrowful for the solemn assembly, who are of you, to whom the reproach of it was a burden.

verses.raw: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict you: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.
verses.text: Behold, at that time I will undo all that afflict you: and I will save her that halteth, and gather her that was driven out; and I will get them praise and fame in every land where they have been put to shame.

verses.raw: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: At that time will I bring you again, even in the time that I gather you: for I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before your eyes, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of Yahuah (LORD) by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Yahudah (Judah), and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,
verses.text: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of Yahuah by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Yahudah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, saying,

verses.raw: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the LORD’S house should be built.
verses.text: Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot, saying, This people say, The time is not come, the time that the LORD’S house should be built.

verses.raw: Then came the word of Yahuah (LORD) by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.text: Then came the word of Yahuah by Haggai the prophet, saying,

verses.raw: Is it time for you, O you, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?
verses.text: Is it time for you, O you, to dwell in your cieled houses, and this house lie waste?

verses.raw: Now therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Consider your ways.
verses.text: Now therefore thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Consider your ways.

verses.raw: You have sown much, and bring in little; you eat, but you have not enough; you drink, but you are not filled with drink; you clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.
verses.text: You have sown much, and bring in little; you eat, but you have not enough; you drink, but you are not filled with drink; you clothe you, but there is none warm; and he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Consider your ways.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Consider your ways.

verses.raw: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Go up to the mountain, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: You looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts). Because of my house that is waste, and you run every man unto his own house.
verses.text: You looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? says Yahuah Tseva'ot. Because of my house that is waste, and you run every man unto his own house.

verses.raw: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.
verses.text: Therefore the heaven over you is stayed from dew, and the earth is stayed from her fruit.

verses.raw: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground brings forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.
verses.text: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the new wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground brings forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.

verses.raw: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God), and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahuah (LORD) their Elohim (God) had sent him, and the people did fear before Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, obeyed the voice of Yahuah their Elohim, and the words of Haggai the prophet, as Yahuah their Elohim had sent him, and the people did fear before Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then spake Haggai the LORD’S messenger in the LORD’S message unto the people, saying, I am with you, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Then spake Haggai the LORD’S messenger in the LORD’S message unto the people, saying, I am with you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Yahudah (Judah), and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), their Elohim (God),
verses.text: And Yahuah stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Yahudah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot, their Elohim,

verses.raw: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
verses.text: In the four and twentieth day of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.

verses.raw: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of Yahuah (LORD) by the prophet Haggai, saying,
verses.text: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of Yahuah by the prophet Haggai, saying,

verses.raw: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Yahudah (Judah), and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,
verses.text: Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Yahudah, and to Joshua the son of Josedech, the high priest, and to the residue of the people, saying,

verses.raw: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do you see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?
verses.text: Who is left among you that saw this house in her first glory? and how do you see it now? is it not in your eyes in comparison of it as nothing?

verses.raw: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, says Yahuah (LORD); and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all you people of the land, says Yahuah (LORD), and work: for I am with you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts):
verses.text: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, says Yahuah; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Josedech, the high priest; and be strong, all you people of the land, says Yahuah, and work: for I am with you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot:

verses.raw: According to the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, so my spirit remains among you: fear you not.
verses.text: According to the word that I covenanted with you when you came out of Egypt, so my spirit remains among you: fear you not.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;

verses.raw: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: And I will shake all nations, and the desire of all nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: The silver is mine, and the gold is mine, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): and in this place will I give peace, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, says Yahuah Tseva'ot: and in this place will I give peace, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Yahuah (LORD) by Haggai the prophet, saying,
verses.text: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Yahuah by Haggai the prophet, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Ask now the priests concerning the law, saying,

verses.raw: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.
verses.text: If one bear holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No.

verses.raw: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.
verses.text: Then said Haggai, If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean? And the priests answered and said, It shall be unclean.

verses.raw: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, says Yahuah (LORD); and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
verses.text: Then answered Haggai, and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, says Yahuah; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.

verses.raw: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of Yahuah (LORD):
verses.text: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and upward, from before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of Yahuah:

verses.raw: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.
verses.text: Since those days were, when one came to an heap of twenty measures, there were but ten: when one came to the pressfat for to draw out fifty vessels out of the press, there were but twenty.

verses.raw: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet you turned not to me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the labours of your hands; yet you turned not to me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD’S temple was laid, consider it.
verses.text: Consider now from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD’S temple was laid, consider it.

verses.raw: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, has not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.
verses.text: Is the seed yet in the barn? yea, as yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive tree, has not brought forth: from this day will I bless you.

verses.raw: And again the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,
verses.text: And again the word of Yahuah came unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying,

verses.raw: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Yahudah (Judah), saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;
verses.text: Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Yahudah, saying, I will shake the heavens and the earth;

verses.raw: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.
verses.text: And I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the heathen; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.

verses.raw: In that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), will I take you, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, says Yahuah (LORD), and will make you as a signet: for I have chosen you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: In that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, will I take you, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, says Yahuah, and will make you as a signet: for I have chosen you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.text: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Yahuah unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) has been sore displeased with your fathers.
verses.text: Yahuah has been sore displeased with your fathers.

verses.raw: Therefore say you unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Turn you unto me, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and I will turn unto you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).
verses.text: Therefore say you unto them, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Turn you unto me, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, and I will turn unto you, says Yahuah Tseva'ot.

verses.raw: Be you not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Turn you now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Be you not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets have cried, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; Turn you now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings: but they did not hear, nor hearken unto me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
verses.text: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?

verses.raw: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so has he dealt with us.
verses.text: But my words and my statutes, which I commanded my servants the prophets, did they not take hold of your fathers? and they returned and said, Like as Yahuah Tseva'ot thought to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so has he dealt with us.

verses.raw: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Yahuah (LORD) unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
verses.text: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Sebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of Yahuah unto Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,

verses.raw: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.
verses.text: I saw by night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in the bottom; and behind him were there red horses, speckled, and white.

verses.raw: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew you what these be.
verses.text: Then said I, O my lord, what are these? And the angel that talked with me said unto me, I will shew you what these be.

verses.raw: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom Yahuah (LORD) has sent to walk to and fro through the earth.
verses.text: And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said, These are they whom Yahuah has sent to walk to and fro through the earth.

verses.raw: And they answered the angel of Yahuah (LORD) that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sits still, and is at rest.
verses.text: And they answered the angel of Yahuah that stood among the myrtle trees, and said, We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sits still, and is at rest.

verses.raw: Then the angel of Yahuah (LORD) answered and said, O Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Yahudah (Judah), against which you have had indignation these threescore and ten years?
verses.text: Then the angel of Yahuah answered and said, O Yahuah Tseva'ot, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Yahudah, against which you have had indignation these threescore and ten years?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.
verses.text: And Yahuah answered the angel that talked with me with good words and comfortable words.

verses.raw: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry you, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.
verses.text: So the angel that communed with me said unto me, Cry you, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

verses.raw: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.
verses.text: And I am very sore displeased with the heathen that are at ease: for I was but a little displeased, and they helped forward the affliction.

verses.raw: Therefore thus says Yahuah (LORD); I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.
verses.text: Therefore thus says Yahuah; I am returned to Jerusalem with mercies: my house shall be built in it, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, and a line shall be stretched forth upon Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Cry yet, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and Yahuah (LORD) shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.
verses.text: Cry yet, saying, Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad; and Yahuah shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then lifted I up my eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
verses.text: Then lifted I up my eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.

verses.raw: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Yahudah (Judah), Yashar'el (Israel), and Jerusalem.
verses.text: And I said unto the angel that talked with me, What be these? And he answered me, These are the horns which have scattered Yahudah, Yashar'el, and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shewed me four carpenters.
verses.text: And Yahuah shewed me four carpenters.

verses.raw: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Yahudah (Judah), so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Yahudah (Judah) to scatter it.
verses.text: Then said I, What come these to do? And he spake, saying, These are the horns which have scattered Yahudah, so that no man did lift up his head: but these are come to fray them, to cast out the horns of the Gentiles, which lifted up their horn over the land of Yahudah to scatter it.

verses.raw: I lifted up my eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.text: I lifted up my eyes again, and looked, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.

verses.raw: Then said I, Whither go you? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.
verses.text: Then said I, Whither go you? And he said unto me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.

verses.raw: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.text: And, behold, the angel that talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,

verses.raw: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:
verses.text: And said unto him, Run, speak to this young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be inhabited as towns without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein:

verses.raw: For I, says Yahuah (LORD), will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.
verses.text: For I, says Yahuah, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and will be the glory in the midst of her.

verses.raw: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, says Yahuah (LORD): for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, says Yahuah: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwell with the daughter of Babylon.
verses.text: Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwell with the daughter of Babylon.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); After the glory has he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that touches you touches the apple of his eye.
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; After the glory has he sent me unto the nations which spoiled you: for he that touches you touches the apple of his eye.

verses.raw: For, behold, I will shake my hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me.
verses.text: For, behold, I will shake my hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to their servants: and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot has sent me.

verses.raw: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you, says Yahuah (LORD).
verses.text: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And many nations shall be joined to Yahuah (LORD) in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of you, and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me unto you.
verses.text: And many nations shall be joined to Yahuah in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of you, and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot has sent me unto you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) shall inherit Yahudah (Judah) his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall inherit Yahudah his portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.

verses.raw: Be silent, O all flesh, before Yahuah (LORD): for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.
verses.text: Be silent, O all flesh, before Yahuah: for he is raised up out of his holy habitation.

verses.raw: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Yahuah (LORD), and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.
verses.text: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Yahuah, and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Yahuah (LORD) rebuke you, O Satan; even Yahuah (LORD) that has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Satan, Yahuah rebuke you, O Satan; even Yahuah that has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

verses.raw: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
verses.text: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.

verses.raw: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with change of raiment.
verses.text: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with change of raiment.

verses.raw: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) stood by.
verses.text: And I said, Let them set a fair mitre upon his head. So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments. And the angel of Yahuah stood by.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) protested unto Joshua, saying,
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah protested unto Joshua, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); If you will walk in my ways, and if you will keep my charge, then you shall also judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you places to walk among these that stand by.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot; If you will walk in my ways, and if you will keep my charge, then you shall also judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you places to walk among these that stand by.

verses.raw: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, you, and your fellows that sit before you: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.
verses.text: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, you, and your fellows that sit before you: for they are men wondered at: for, behold, I will bring forth my servant the BRANCH.

verses.raw: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
verses.text: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone shall be seven eyes: behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

verses.raw: In that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), shall you call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.
verses.text: In that day, says Yahuah Tseva'ot, shall you call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig tree.

verses.raw: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,
verses.text: And the angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep,

verses.raw: And said unto me, What see you? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:
verses.text: And said unto me, What see you? And I said, I have looked, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and his seven lamps thereon, and seven pipes to the seven lamps, which are upon the top thereof:

verses.raw: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.
verses.text: And two olive trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.

verses.raw: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?
verses.text: So I answered and spake to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these, my lord?

verses.raw: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Know you not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
verses.text: Then the angel that talked with me answered and said unto me, Know you not what these be? And I said, No, my lord.
