verses.raw: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.
verses.text: But when the Pharisees had heard that he had put the Sadducees to silence, they were gathered together.

verses.raw: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,
verses.text: Then one of them, which was a lawyer, asked him a question, tempting him, and saying,

verses.raw: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?
verses.text: Master, which is the great commandment in the law?

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, You shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the Lord thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.
verses.text: Yahusha said unto him, You shall love Yahuah Elohayka with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind.

verses.raw: This is the first and great commandment.
verses.text: This is the first and great commandment.

verses.raw: And the second is like unto it, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.
verses.text: And the second is like unto it, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.

verses.raw: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.
verses.text: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

verses.raw: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Yahusha (Jesus) asked them,
verses.text: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Yahusha asked them,

verses.raw: Saying, What think you of Messiah (Christ)? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.
verses.text: Saying, What think you of Messiah? whose son is he? They say unto him, The Son of David.

verses.raw: He says unto them, How then does David in spirit call him the Lord, saying,
verses.text: He says unto them, How then does David in spirit call him the Lord, saying,

verses.raw: Yahuah (LORD) said unto my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool?
verses.text: Yahuah said unto my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, till I make your enemies your footstool?

verses.raw: If David then call him the Lord, how is he his son?
verses.text: If David then call him the Lord, how is he his son?

verses.raw: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.
verses.text: And no man was able to answer him a word, neither durst any man from that day forth ask him any more questions.

verses.raw: Then spake Yahusha (Jesus) to the multitude, and to his disciples,
verses.text: Then spake Yahusha to the multitude, and to his disciples,

verses.raw: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:
verses.text: Saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat:

verses.raw: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not you after their works: for they say, and do not.
verses.text: All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not you after their works: for they say, and do not.

verses.raw: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.
verses.text: For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers.

verses.raw: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,
verses.text: But all their works they do for to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments,

verses.raw: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,
verses.text: And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues,

verses.raw: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.
verses.text: And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

verses.raw: But be not you called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Messiah (Christ); and all you are brethren.
verses.text: But be not you called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Messiah; and all you are brethren.

verses.raw: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.
verses.text: And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven.

verses.raw: Neither be you called masters: for one is your Master, even Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Neither be you called masters: for one is your Master, even Messiah.

verses.raw: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.
verses.text: But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant.

verses.raw: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.
verses.text: And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be abased; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted.

verses.raw: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for you neither go in yourselves, neither suffer you them that are entering to go in.
verses.text: But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for you neither go in yourselves, neither suffer you them that are entering to go in.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore you shall receive the greater damnation.
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you devour widows’ houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore you shall receive the greater damnation.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, you make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, you make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, you blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!
verses.text: Woe unto you, you blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor!

verses.raw: You fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?
verses.text: You fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that sanctifieth the gold?

verses.raw: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever swears by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.
verses.text: And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever swears by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty.

verses.raw: You fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?
verses.text: You fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifieth the gift?

verses.raw: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, swears by it, and by all things thereon.
verses.text: Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, swears by it, and by all things thereon.

verses.raw: And whoso shall swear by the temple, swears by it, and by him that dwells therein.
verses.text: And whoso shall swear by the temple, swears by it, and by him that dwells therein.

verses.raw: And he that shall swear by heaven, swears by the throne of Elohim (God), and by him that sits thereon.
verses.text: And he that shall swear by heaven, swears by the throne of Elohim, and by him that sits thereon.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought you to have done, and not to leave the other undone.
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought you to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

verses.raw: You blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
verses.text: You blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess.

verses.raw: You blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.
verses.text: You blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for you are like unto whited sepulchres, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men’s bones, and of all uncleanness.

verses.raw: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.
verses.text: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because you build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,
verses.text: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because you build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchres of the righteous,

verses.raw: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.
verses.text: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

verses.raw: Wherefore you be witnesses unto yourselves, that you are the children of them which killed the prophets.
verses.text: Wherefore you be witnesses unto yourselves, that you are the children of them which killed the prophets.

verses.raw: Fill you up then the measure of your fathers.
verses.text: Fill you up then the measure of your fathers.

verses.raw: You serpents, you generation of vipers, how can you escape the damnation of hell?
verses.text: You serpents, you generation of vipers, how can you escape the damnation of hell?

verses.raw: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them you shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall you scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:
verses.text: Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them you shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall you scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city:

verses.raw: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom you slew between the temple and the altar.
verses.text: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom you slew between the temple and the altar.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation.

verses.raw: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto you, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and you would not!
verses.text: O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you that killest the prophets, and stonest them which are sent unto you, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and you would not!

verses.raw: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.
verses.text: Behold, your house is left unto you desolate.

verses.raw: For I say unto you, You shall not see me henceforth, till you shall say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: For I say unto you, You shall not see me henceforth, till you shall say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.
verses.text: And Yahusha went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him for to shew him the buildings of the temple.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, See you not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto them, See you not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down.

verses.raw: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of your coming, and of the end of the world?
verses.text: And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of your coming, and of the end of the world?

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.
verses.text: And Yahusha answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you.

verses.raw: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Messiah (Christ); and shall deceive many.
verses.text: For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Messiah; and shall deceive many.

verses.raw: And you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that you be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.
verses.text: And you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that you be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

verses.raw: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.
verses.text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

verses.raw: All these are the beginning of sorrows.
verses.text: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

verses.raw: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and you shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.
verses.text: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and you shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake.

verses.raw: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.
verses.text: And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.

verses.raw: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.
verses.text: And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many.

verses.raw: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.
verses.text: And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold.

verses.raw: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.
verses.text: But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved.

verses.raw: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.
verses.text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

verses.raw: When you therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)
verses.text: When you therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso readeth, let him understand:)

verses.raw: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:
verses.text: Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains:

verses.raw: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:
verses.text: Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house:

verses.raw: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.
verses.text: Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes.

verses.raw: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!
verses.text: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

verses.raw: But pray you that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
verses.text: But pray you that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:

verses.raw: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.
verses.text: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

verses.raw: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.
verses.text: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.

verses.raw: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Messiah (Christ), or there; believe it not.
verses.text: Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Messiah, or there; believe it not.

verses.raw: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.
verses.text: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

verses.raw: Behold, I have told you before.
verses.text: Behold, I have told you before.

verses.raw: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.
verses.text: Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not.

verses.raw: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
verses.text: For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shineth even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.

verses.raw: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.
verses.text: For wheresoever the carcase is, there will the eagles be gathered together.

verses.raw: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:
verses.text: Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken:

verses.raw: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of Adam in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.
verses.text: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of Adam in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

verses.raw: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.
verses.text: And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.

verses.raw: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is nigh:
verses.text: Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and puts forth leaves, you know that summer is nigh:

verses.raw: So likewise you, when you shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.
verses.text: So likewise you, when you shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled.

verses.raw: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.
verses.text: Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words shall not pass away.

verses.raw: But of that day and hour knows no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.
verses.text: But of that day and hour knows no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

verses.raw: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
verses.text: But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.

verses.raw: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,
verses.text: For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark,

verses.raw: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.
verses.text: And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.

verses.raw: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.text: Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.raw: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.
verses.text: Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left.

verses.raw: Watch therefore: for you know not what hour your Lord does come.
verses.text: Watch therefore: for you know not what hour your Lord does come.

verses.raw: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.
verses.text: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

verses.raw: Therefore be you also ready: for in such an hour as you think not the Son of Adam comes.
verses.text: Therefore be you also ready: for in such an hour as you think not the Son of Adam comes.

verses.raw: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?
verses.text: Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has made ruler over his household, to give them meat in due season?

verses.raw: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he comes shall find so doing.
verses.text: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he comes shall find so doing.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods.

verses.raw: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;
verses.text: But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming;

verses.raw: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;
verses.text: And shall begin to smite his fellowservants, and to eat and drink with the drunken;

verses.raw: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looks not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,
verses.text: The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looks not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of,

verses.raw: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text: And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.raw: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.text: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.

verses.raw: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
verses.text: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.

verses.raw: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
verses.text: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:

verses.raw: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.text: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

verses.raw: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.text: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.

verses.raw: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom comes; go you out to meet him.
verses.text: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom comes; go you out to meet him.

verses.raw: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.text: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

verses.raw: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
verses.text: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.

verses.raw: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go you rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.text: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go you rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.

verses.raw: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
verses.text: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.

verses.raw: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.text: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.

verses.raw: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.text: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.

verses.raw: Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of Adam comes.
verses.text: Watch therefore, for you know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of Adam comes.

verses.raw: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.text: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.

verses.raw: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
verses.text: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.

verses.raw: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
verses.text: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.

verses.raw: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
verses.text: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.

verses.raw: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
verses.text: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.

verses.raw: After a long time the lord of those servants comes, and reckoneth with them.
verses.text: After a long time the lord of those servants comes, and reckoneth with them.

verses.raw: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, you delivered unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
verses.text: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, you delivered unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.

verses.raw: His lord said unto him, Well done, you good and faithful servant: you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things: enter you into the joy of your lord.
verses.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, you good and faithful servant: you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things: enter you into the joy of your lord.

verses.raw: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, you delivered unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
verses.text: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, you delivered unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.

verses.raw: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things: enter you into the joy of your lord.
verses.text: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things: enter you into the joy of your lord.

verses.raw: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew you that you are an hard man, reaping where you have not sown, and gathering where you have not strawed:
verses.text: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew you that you are an hard man, reaping where you have not sown, and gathering where you have not strawed:

verses.raw: And I was afraid, and went and hid your talent in the earth: lo, there you have that is yours.
verses.text: And I was afraid, and went and hid your talent in the earth: lo, there you have that is yours.

verses.raw: His lord answered and said unto him, You wicked and slothful servant, you knew that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
verses.text: His lord answered and said unto him, You wicked and slothful servant, you knew that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:

verses.raw: You oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received my own with usury.
verses.text: You oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received my own with usury.

verses.raw: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which has ten talents.
verses.text: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which has ten talents.

verses.raw: For unto every one that has shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that has not shall be taken away even that which he has.
verses.text: For unto every one that has shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that has not shall be taken away even that which he has.

verses.raw: And cast you the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.text: And cast you the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

verses.raw: When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
verses.text: When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:

verses.raw: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divides his sheep from the goats:
verses.text: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divides his sheep from the goats:

verses.raw: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.text: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

verses.raw: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, you blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
verses.text: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, you blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:

verses.raw: For I was an hungred, and you gave me meat: I was thirsty, and you gave me drink: I was a stranger, and you took me in:
verses.text: For I was an hungred, and you gave me meat: I was thirsty, and you gave me drink: I was a stranger, and you took me in:

verses.raw: Naked, and you clothed me: I was sick, and you visited me: I was in prison, and you came unto me.
verses.text: Naked, and you clothed me: I was sick, and you visited me: I was in prison, and you came unto me.

verses.raw: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you an hungred, and fed you? or thirsty, and gave you drink?
verses.text: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you an hungred, and fed you? or thirsty, and gave you drink?

verses.raw: When saw we you a stranger, and took you in? or naked, and clothed you?
verses.text: When saw we you a stranger, and took you in? or naked, and clothed you?

verses.raw: Or when saw we you sick, or in prison, and came unto you?
verses.text: Or when saw we you sick, or in prison, and came unto you?

verses.raw: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as you have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, you have done it unto me.
verses.text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as you have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, you have done it unto me.

verses.raw: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, you cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.text: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, you cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:

verses.raw: For I was an hungred, and you gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink:
verses.text: For I was an hungred, and you gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink:

verses.raw: I was a stranger, and you took me not in: naked, and you clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and you visited me not.
verses.text: I was a stranger, and you took me not in: naked, and you clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and you visited me not.

verses.raw: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto you?
verses.text: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto you?

verses.raw: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as you did it not to one of the least of these, you did it not to me.
verses.text: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as you did it not to one of the least of these, you did it not to me.

verses.raw: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
verses.text: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when Yahusha (Jesus) had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when Yahusha had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,

verses.raw: You know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of Adam is betrayed to be crucified.
verses.text: You know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of Adam is betrayed to be crucified.

verses.raw: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,
verses.text: Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas,

verses.raw: And consulted that they might take Yahusha (Jesus) by subtilty, and kill him.
verses.text: And consulted that they might take Yahusha by subtilty, and kill him.

verses.raw: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.
verses.text: But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people.

verses.raw: Now when Yahusha (Jesus) was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,
verses.text: Now when Yahusha was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

verses.raw: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.
verses.text: There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at meat.

verses.raw: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
verses.text: But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste?

verses.raw: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.
verses.text: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

verses.raw: When Yahusha (Jesus) understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble you the woman? for she has wrought a good work upon me.
verses.text: When Yahusha understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble you the woman? for she has wrought a good work upon me.

verses.raw: For you have the poor always with you; but me you have not always.
verses.text: For you have the poor always with you; but me you have not always.

verses.raw: For in that she has poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.
verses.text: For in that she has poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial.

verses.raw: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman has done, be told for a memorial of her.
verses.text: Verily I say unto you, Wheresoever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman has done, be told for a memorial of her.

verses.raw: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,
verses.text: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests,

verses.raw: And said unto them, What will you give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.
verses.text: And said unto them, What will you give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver.

verses.raw: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.
verses.text: And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

verses.raw: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Yahusha (Jesus), saying unto him, Where will you that we prepare for you to eat the passover?
verses.text: Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Yahusha, saying unto him, Where will you that we prepare for you to eat the passover?

verses.raw: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master says, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at your house with my disciples.
verses.text: And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master says, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at your house with my disciples.

verses.raw: And the disciples did as Yahusha (Jesus) had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.
verses.text: And the disciples did as Yahusha had appointed them; and they made ready the passover.

verses.raw: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.
verses.text: Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve.

verses.raw: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.
verses.text: And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me.

verses.raw: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?
verses.text: And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I?

verses.raw: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.
verses.text: And he answered and said, He that dippeth his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me.

verses.raw: The Son of Adam goes as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of Adam is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.
verses.text: The Son of Adam goes as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of Adam is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

verses.raw: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, You have said.
verses.text: Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, You have said.

verses.raw: And as they were eating, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.
verses.text: And as they were eating, Yahusha took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

verses.raw: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink you all of it;
verses.text: And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink you all of it;

verses.raw: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.
verses.text: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

verses.raw: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.
verses.text: But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father’s kingdom.

verses.raw: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.
verses.text: And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives.

verses.raw: Then says Yahusha (Jesus) unto them, All you shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.
verses.text: Then says Yahusha unto them, All you shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will smite the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad.

verses.raw: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.
verses.text: But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee.

verses.raw: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of you, yet will I never be offended.
verses.text: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of you, yet will I never be offended.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Verily I say unto you, That this night, before the cock crow, you shall deny me thrice.
verses.text: Yahusha said unto him, Verily I say unto you, That this night, before the cock crow, you shall deny me thrice.

verses.raw: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with you, yet will I not deny you. Likewise also said all the disciples.
verses.text: Peter said unto him, Though I should die with you, yet will I not deny you. Likewise also said all the disciples.

verses.raw: Then comes Yahusha (Jesus) with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and says unto the disciples, Sit you here, while I go and pray yonder.
verses.text: Then comes Yahusha with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and says unto the disciples, Sit you here, while I go and pray yonder.

verses.raw: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.
verses.text: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy.

verses.raw: Then says he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry you here, and watch with me.
verses.text: Then says he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry you here, and watch with me.

verses.raw: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as you will.
verses.text: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as you will.

verses.raw: And he comes unto the disciples, and finds them asleep, and says unto Peter, What, could you not watch with me one hour?
verses.text: And he comes unto the disciples, and finds them asleep, and says unto Peter, What, could you not watch with me one hour?

verses.raw: Watch and pray, that you enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
verses.text: Watch and pray, that you enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

verses.raw: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, your will be done.
verses.text: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, your will be done.

verses.raw: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.
verses.text: And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy.

verses.raw: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.
verses.text: And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words.

verses.raw: Then comes he to his disciples, and says unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Adam is betrayed into the hands of sinners.
verses.text: Then comes he to his disciples, and says unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Adam is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

verses.raw: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that does betray me.
verses.text: Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that does betray me.

verses.raw: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.
verses.text: And while he yet spake, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

verses.raw: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.
verses.text: Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast.

verses.raw: And forthwith he came to Yahusha (Jesus), and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.
verses.text: And forthwith he came to Yahusha, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, Friend, wherefore are you come? Then came they, and laid hands on Yahusha (Jesus), and took him.
verses.text: And Yahusha said unto him, Friend, wherefore are you come? Then came they, and laid hands on Yahusha, and took him.

verses.raw: And, behold, one of them which were with Yahusha (Jesus) stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.
verses.text: And, behold, one of them which were with Yahusha stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest’s, and smote off his ear.

verses.raw: Then said Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, Put up again your sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.
verses.text: Then said Yahusha unto him, Put up again your sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword.

verses.raw: Thinkest you that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?
verses.text: Thinkest you that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels?

verses.raw: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?
verses.text: But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be?

verses.raw: In that same hour said Yahusha (Jesus) to the multitudes, Are you come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and you laid no hold on me.
verses.text: In that same hour said Yahusha to the multitudes, Are you come out as against a thief with swords and staves for to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and you laid no hold on me.

verses.raw: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.
verses.text: But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled.

verses.raw: And they that had laid hold on Yahusha (Jesus) led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.
verses.text: And they that had laid hold on Yahusha led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled.

verses.raw: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.
verses.text: But Peter followed him afar off unto the high priest’s palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end.

verses.raw: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Yahusha (Jesus), to put him to death;
verses.text: Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Yahusha, to put him to death;

verses.raw: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,
verses.text: But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses,

verses.raw: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of Elohim (God), and to build it in three days.
verses.text: And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of Elohim, and to build it in three days.

verses.raw: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest you nothing? what is it which these witness against you?
verses.text: And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answerest you nothing? what is it which these witness against you?

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure you by the living Elohim (God), that you tell us whether you be the Messiah (Christ), the Son of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But Yahusha held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure you by the living Elohim, that you tell us whether you be the Messiah, the Son of Elohim.

verses.raw: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.
verses.text: Yahusha says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall you see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.

verses.raw: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He has spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.
verses.text: Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He has spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

verses.raw: What think you? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.
verses.text: What think you? They answered and said, He is guilty of death.

verses.raw: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,
verses.text: Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others smote him with the palms of their hands,

verses.raw: Saying, Prophesy unto us, you Messiah (Christ), Who is he that smote you?
verses.text: Saying, Prophesy unto us, you Messiah, Who is he that smote you?

verses.raw: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, You also were with Yahusha (Jesus) of Galilee.
verses.text: Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, You also were with Yahusha of Galilee.

verses.raw: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what you say.
verses.text: But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what you say.

verses.raw: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Yahusha (Jesus) of Nazareth.
verses.text: And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Yahusha of Nazareth.

verses.raw: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.
verses.text: And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man.

verses.raw: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely you also are one of them; for your speech bewrayeth you.
verses.text: And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely you also are one of them; for your speech bewrayeth you.

verses.raw: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.
verses.text: Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew.

verses.raw: And Peter remembered the word of Yahusha (Jesus), which said unto him, Before the cock crow, you shall deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.
verses.text: And Peter remembered the word of Yahusha, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, you shall deny me thrice. And he went out, and wept bitterly.

verses.raw: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha (Jesus) to put him to death:
verses.text: When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Yahusha to put him to death:

verses.raw: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.
verses.text: And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor.

verses.raw: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,
verses.text: Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

verses.raw: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see you to that.
verses.text: Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see you to that.

verses.raw: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.
verses.text: And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself.

verses.raw: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.
verses.text: And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful for to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood.

verses.raw: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
verses.text: And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.

verses.raw: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.
verses.text: Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day.

verses.raw: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did value;
verses.text: Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Yashar'el did value;

verses.raw: And gave them for the potter’s field, as Yahuah (Lord) appointed me.
verses.text: And gave them for the potter’s field, as Yahuah appointed me.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus) stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Yahudim (Jews)? And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto him, You say.
verses.text: And Yahusha stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Yahudim? And Yahusha said unto him, You say.

verses.raw: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.
verses.text: And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

verses.raw: Then said Pilate unto him, Hear you not how many things they witness against you?
verses.text: Then said Pilate unto him, Hear you not how many things they witness against you?

verses.raw: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.
verses.text: And he answered him to never a word; insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly.

verses.raw: Now at that feast the governor was wont to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would.

verses.text: Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will you that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Yahusha which is called Messiah?

verses.raw: The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the twain will you that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas.

verses.raw: Pilate says unto them, What shall I do then with Yahusha (Jesus) which is called Messiah (Christ)? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified.

verses.text: And he asked him, What is your name? And he answered, saying, My name is Legion: for we are many.

verses.raw: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
verses.text: And he besought him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

verses.text: Now there was there nigh unto the mountains a great herd of swine feeding.

verses.text: And all the devils besought him, saying, Send us into the swine, that we may enter into them.

verses.raw: And forthwith Yahusha (Jesus) gave them leave. And the unclean spirits went out, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the sea, (they were about two thousand;) and were choked in the sea.

verses.raw: Howbeit Yahusha (Jesus) suffered him not, but says unto him, Go home to your friends, and tell them how great things the Lord has done for you, and has had compassion on you.

verses.raw: And when Yahusha (Jesus) was passed over again by ship unto the other side, much people gathered unto him: and he was nigh unto the sea.

verses.raw: And besought him greatly, saying, My little daughter lies at the point of death: I pray you, come and lay your hands on her, that she may be healed; and she shall live.

verses.text: And Yahusha went with him; and much people followed him, and thronged him.

verses.text: And had suffered many things of many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse,

verses.raw: When she had heard of Yahusha (Jesus), came in the press behind, and touched his garment.
verses.text: When she had heard of Yahusha, came in the press behind, and touched his garment.

verses.text: For she said, If I may touch but his clothes, I shall be whole.

verses.raw: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

verses.text: And his disciples said unto him, You see the multitude thronging you, and say you, Who touched me?

verses.text: As soon as Yahusha heard the word that was spoken, he says unto the ruler of the synagogue, Be not afraid, only believe.

verses.text: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

verses.raw: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto you, arise.
verses.text: And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto you, arise.

verses.raw: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.
verses.text: And straightway the damsel arose, and walked; for she was of the age of twelve years. And they were astonished with a great astonishment.

verses.raw: And he charged them straitly that no man should know it; and commanded that something should be given her to eat.

verses.raw: And he went out from thence, and came into his own country; and his disciples follow him.

verses.raw: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence has this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?
verses.text: And when the sabbath day was come, he began to teach in the synagogue: and many hearing him were astonished, saying, From whence has this man these things? and what wisdom is this which is given unto him, that even such mighty works are wrought by his hands?

verses.raw: Is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were offended at him.

verses.raw: But Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.
verses.text: But Yahusha said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

verses.raw: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

verses.raw: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:
verses.text: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

verses.text: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, In what place soever you enter into an house, there abide till you depart from that place.
verses.text: And he said unto them, In what place soever you enter into an house, there abide till you depart from that place.

verses.raw: And whosoever shall not receive you, nor hear you, when you depart thence, shake off the dust under your feet for a testimony against them. Verily I say unto you, It shall be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrha in the day of judgment, than for that city.

verses.raw: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.
verses.text: And they went out, and preached that men should repent.

verses.text: And they cast out many devils, and anointed with oil many that were sick, and healed them.

verses.raw: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.
verses.text: And king Herod heard of him; (for his name was spread abroad:) and he said, That John the Baptist was risen from the dead, and therefore mighty works do shew forth themselves in him.

verses.text: Others said, That it is Elias. And others said, That it is a prophet, or as one of the prophets.

verses.text: For Herod himself had sent forth and laid hold upon John, and bound him in prison for Herodias’ sake, his brother Philip’s wife: for he had married her.

verses.text: For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.

verses.text: Therefore Herodias had a quarrel against him, and would have killed him; but she could not:

verses.text: For Herod feared John, knowing that he was a just man and an holy, and observed him; and when he heard him, he did many things, and heard him gladly.

verses.text: And when the daughter of the said Herodias came in, and danced, and pleased Herod and them that sat with him, the king said unto the damsel, Ask of me whatsoever you will, and I will give it you.

verses.text: And he sware unto her, Whatsoever you shall ask of me, I will give it you, unto the half of my kingdom.

verses.text: And she went forth, and said unto her mother, What shall I ask? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.

verses.text: And she came in straightway with haste unto the king, and asked, saying, I will that you give me by and by in a charger the head of John the Baptist.

verses.text: And brought his head in a charger, and gave it to the damsel: and the damsel gave it to her mother.

verses.text: And the apostles gathered themselves together unto Yahusha, and told him all things, both what they had done, and what they had taught.

verses.raw: And he said unto them, Come you yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
verses.text: And he said unto them, Come you yourselves apart into a desert place, and rest a while: for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

verses.text: And the people saw them departing, and many knew him, and ran afoot thither out of all cities, and outwent them, and came together unto him.

verses.raw: And Yahusha (Jesus), when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.
verses.text: And Yahusha, when he came out, saw much people, and was moved with compassion toward them, because they were as sheep not having a shepherd: and he began to teach them many things.

verses.text: And when the day was now far spent, his disciples came unto him, and said, This is a desert place, and now the time is far passed:

verses.text: Send them away, that they may go into the country round about, and into the villages, and buy themselves bread: for they have nothing to eat.

verses.text: He says unto them, How many loaves have you? go and see. And when they knew, they say, Five, and two fishes.

verses.text: And when he had taken the five loaves and the two fishes, he looked up to heaven, and blessed, and brake the loaves, and gave them to his disciples to set before them; and the two fishes divided he among them all.

verses.text: Then came together unto him the Pharisees, and certain of the scribes, which came from Jerusalem.

verses.text: And when they saw some of his disciples eat bread with defiled, that is to say, with unwashen, hands, they found fault.

verses.raw: For the Pharisees, and all the Yahudim (Jews), except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.
verses.text: For the Pharisees, and all the Yahudim, except they wash their hands oft, eat not, holding the tradition of the elders.

verses.text: Then the Pharisees and scribes asked him, Why walk not your disciples according to the tradition of the elders, but eat bread with unwashen hands?

verses.raw: He answered and said unto them, Well has Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
verses.text: He answered and said unto them, Well has Esaias prophesied of you hypocrites, as it is written, This people honoureth me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

verses.text: Howbeit in vain do they worship me, teaching for doctrines the commandments of men.

verses.raw: For laying aside the commandment of Elohim (God), you hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things you do.
verses.text: For laying aside the commandment of Elohim, you hold the tradition of men, as the washing of pots and cups: and many other such like things you do.

verses.text: And says unto them, Go your way into the village over against you: and as soon as you be entered into it, you shall find a colt tied, whereon never man sat; loose him, and bring him.
