verses.raw: For what says the scripture? Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.text: For what says the scripture? Abraham believed Elohim, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

verses.raw: Now to him that works is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.text: Now to him that works is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

verses.raw: But to him that works not, but believes on him that justifies the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.text: But to him that works not, but believes on him that justifies the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

verses.raw: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom Elohim (God) imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.text: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom Elohim imputeth righteousness without works,

verses.raw: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.text: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man to whom Yahuah (Lord) will not impute sin.
verses.text: Blessed is the man to whom Yahuah will not impute sin.

verses.raw: Comes this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.text: Comes this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

verses.raw: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.text: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

verses.raw: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.text: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

verses.raw: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
verses.text: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

verses.raw: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.text: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

verses.raw: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.text: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

verses.raw: Because the law works wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
verses.text: Because the law works wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

verses.raw: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.text: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

verses.raw: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.
verses.text: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim, who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.

verses.raw: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall your seed be.
verses.text: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall your seed be.

verses.raw: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara’s womb:
verses.text: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara’s womb:

verses.raw: He staggered not at the promise of Elohim (God) through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to Elohim (God);
verses.text: He staggered not at the promise of Elohim through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to Elohim;

verses.raw: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.text: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

verses.raw: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.text: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

verses.raw: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.text: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

verses.raw: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Yahusha (Jesus) our Lord from the dead;
verses.text: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Yahusha our Lord from the dead;

verses.raw: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.text: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

verses.raw: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with Elohim (God) through our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with Elohim through our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of Elohim (God).
verses.text: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of Elohim.

verses.raw: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation works patience;
verses.text: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation works patience;

verses.raw: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.text: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

verses.raw: And hope makes not ashamed; because the love of Elohim (God) is shed abroad in our hearts by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) which is given unto us.
verses.text: And hope makes not ashamed; because the love of Elohim is shed abroad in our hearts by the Ruach HaKodesh which is given unto us.

verses.raw: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Messiah (Christ) died for the ungodly.
verses.text: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Messiah died for the ungodly.

verses.raw: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.text: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Messiah (Christ) died for us.
verses.text: But Elohim commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Messiah died for us.

verses.raw: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.text: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

verses.raw: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to Elohim (God) by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.text: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to Elohim by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

verses.raw: And not only so, but we also joy in Elohim (God) through our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), by whom we have now received the atonement.
verses.text: And not only so, but we also joy in Elohim through our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, by whom we have now received the atonement.

verses.raw: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
verses.text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

verses.raw: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.text: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

verses.raw: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
verses.text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

verses.raw: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of Elohim (God), and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), has abounded unto many.
verses.text: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of Elohim, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Yahusha HaMashiach, has abounded unto many.

verses.raw: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
verses.text: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

verses.raw: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).)
verses.text: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Yahusha HaMashiach.)

verses.raw: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
verses.text: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

verses.raw: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
verses.text: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

verses.raw: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
verses.text: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

verses.raw: That as sin has reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord.
verses.text: That as sin has reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Yahusha HaMashiach our Lord.

verses.raw: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

verses.raw: Elohim (God) forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
verses.text: Elohim forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

verses.raw: Know you not, that so many of us as were baptized into Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) were baptized into his death?
verses.text: Know you not, that so many of us as were baptized into Yahusha HaMashiach were baptized into his death?

verses.raw: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Messiah (Christ) was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.text: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Messiah was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

verses.raw: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
verses.text: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

verses.raw: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
verses.text: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

verses.raw: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
verses.text: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

verses.raw: Now if we be dead with Messiah (Christ), we believe that we shall also live with him:
verses.text: Now if we be dead with Messiah, we believe that we shall also live with him:

verses.raw: Knowing that Messiah (Christ) being raised from the dead dies no more; death has no more dominion over him.
verses.text: Knowing that Messiah being raised from the dead dies no more; death has no more dominion over him.

verses.raw: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he lives, he lives unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he lives, he lives unto Elohim.

verses.raw: Likewise reckon you also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto Elohim (God) through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord.
verses.text: Likewise reckon you also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto Elohim through Yahusha HaMashiach our Lord.

verses.raw: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in the lusts thereof.
verses.text: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in the lusts thereof.

verses.raw: Neither yield you your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto Elohim (God), as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: Neither yield you your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto Elohim, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto Elohim.

verses.raw: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for you are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.text: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for you are not under the law, but under grace.

verses.raw: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? Elohim (God) forbid.
verses.text: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? Elohim forbid.

verses.raw: Know you not, that to whom you yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants you are to whom you obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.text: Know you not, that to whom you yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants you are to whom you obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) be thanked, that you were the servants of sin, but you have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
verses.text: But Elohim be thanked, that you were the servants of sin, but you have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

verses.raw: Being then made free from sin, you became the servants of righteousness.
verses.text: Being then made free from sin, you became the servants of righteousness.

verses.raw: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as you have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
verses.text: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as you have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

verses.raw: For when you were the servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.
verses.text: For when you were the servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

verses.raw: What fruit had you then in those things whereof you are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
verses.text: What fruit had you then in those things whereof you are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

verses.raw: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to Elohim (God), you have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
verses.text: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to Elohim, you have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

verses.raw: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of Elohim (God) is eternal life through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord.
verses.text: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of Elohim is eternal life through Yahusha HaMashiach our Lord.

verses.raw: Know you not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law has dominion over a man as long as he lives?
verses.text: Know you not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law has dominion over a man as long as he lives?

verses.raw: For the woman which has an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he lives; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
verses.text: For the woman which has an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he lives; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

verses.raw: So then if, while her husband lives, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
verses.text: So then if, while her husband lives, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

verses.raw: Wherefore, my brethren, you also are become dead to the law by the body of Messiah (Christ); that you should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: Wherefore, my brethren, you also are become dead to the law by the body of Messiah; that you should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto Elohim.

verses.raw: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
verses.text: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

verses.raw: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
verses.text: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

verses.raw: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? Elohim (God) forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, You shall not covet.
verses.text: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? Elohim forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, You shall not covet.

verses.raw: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
verses.text: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

verses.raw: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.text: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

verses.raw: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
verses.text: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

verses.raw: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
verses.text: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

verses.raw: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
verses.text: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

verses.raw: Was then that which is good made death unto me? Elohim (God) forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
verses.text: Was then that which is good made death unto me? Elohim forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

verses.raw: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.text: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

verses.raw: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
verses.text: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

verses.raw: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
verses.text: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

verses.raw: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.
verses.text: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.

verses.raw: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwells no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
verses.text: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwells no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

verses.raw: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
verses.text: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

verses.raw: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.
verses.text: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwells in me.

verses.raw: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
verses.text: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

verses.raw: For I delight in the law of Elohim (God) after the inward man:
verses.text: For I delight in the law of Elohim after the inward man:

verses.raw: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.text: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

verses.raw: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verses.text: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

verses.raw: I thank Elohim (God) through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of Elohim (God); but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.text: I thank Elohim through Yahusha HaMashiach our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of Elohim; but with the flesh the law of sin.

verses.raw: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.text: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in HaMashiach Yahusha, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

verses.raw: For the law of the Spirit of life in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) has made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.text: For the law of the Spirit of life in HaMashiach Yahusha has made me free from the law of sin and death.

verses.raw: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, Elohim (God) sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, Elohim sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

verses.raw: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.text: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

verses.raw: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.text: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

verses.raw: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
verses.text: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

verses.raw: Because the carnal mind is enmity against Elohim (God): for it is not subject to the law of Elohim (God), neither indeed can be.
verses.text: Because the carnal mind is enmity against Elohim: for it is not subject to the law of Elohim, neither indeed can be.

verses.raw: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please Elohim (God).
verses.text: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please Elohim.

verses.raw: But you are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of Elohim (God) dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Messiah (Christ), he is none of his.
verses.text: But you are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of Elohim dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Messiah, he is none of his.

verses.raw: And if Messiah (Christ) be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.text: And if Messiah be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

verses.raw: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Yahusha (Jesus) from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Messiah (Christ) from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwells in you.
verses.text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Yahusha from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Messiah from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwells in you.

verses.raw: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.text: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

verses.raw: For if you live after the flesh, you shall die: but if you through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, you shall live.
verses.text: For if you live after the flesh, you shall die: but if you through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, you shall live.

verses.raw: For as many as are led by the Spirit of Elohim (God), they are the sons of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of Elohim, they are the sons of Elohim.

verses.raw: For you have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but you have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.text: For you have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but you have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

verses.raw: The Spirit itself bears witness with our spirit, that we are the children of Elohim (God):
verses.text: The Spirit itself bears witness with our spirit, that we are the children of Elohim:

verses.raw: And if children, then heirs; heirs of Elohim (God), and joint-heirs with Messiah (Christ); if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
verses.text: And if children, then heirs; heirs of Elohim, and joint-heirs with Messiah; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

verses.raw: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

verses.raw: For the earnest expectation of the creature waits for the manifestation of the sons of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waits for the manifestation of the sons of Elohim.

verses.raw: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who has subjected the same in hope,
verses.text: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who has subjected the same in hope,

verses.raw: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of Elohim.

verses.raw: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
verses.text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

verses.raw: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
verses.text: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

verses.raw: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man sees, why does he yet hope for?
verses.text: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man sees, why does he yet hope for?

verses.raw: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
verses.text: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

verses.raw: Likewise the Spirit also helps our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself makes intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.text: Likewise the Spirit also helps our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself makes intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

verses.raw: And he that searcheth the hearts knows what is the mind of the Spirit, because he makes intercession for the saints according to the will of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And he that searcheth the hearts knows what is the mind of the Spirit, because he makes intercession for the saints according to the will of Elohim.

verses.raw: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love Elohim (God), to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love Elohim, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

verses.raw: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.text: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

verses.raw: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.text: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

verses.raw: What shall we then say to these things? If Elohim (God) be for us, who can be against us?
verses.text: What shall we then say to these things? If Elohim be for us, who can be against us?

verses.raw: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verses.text: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

verses.raw: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of Elohim's (God’s) elect? It is Elohim (God) that justifies.
verses.text: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of Elohim's (God’s) elect? It is Elohim that justifies.

verses.raw: Who is he that condemneth? It is Messiah (Christ) that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of Elohim (God), who also makes intercession for us.
verses.text: Who is he that condemneth? It is Messiah that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of Elohim, who also makes intercession for us.

verses.raw: Who shall separate us from the love of Messiah (Christ)? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.text: Who shall separate us from the love of Messiah? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

verses.raw: As it is written, For your sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.text: As it is written, For your sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

verses.raw: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

verses.raw: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

verses.raw: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of Elohim (God), which is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) our Lord.
verses.text: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of Elohim, which is in HaMashiach Yahusha our Lord.

verses.raw: I say the truth in Messiah (Christ), I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit),
verses.text: I say the truth in Messiah, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Ruach HaKodesh,

verses.raw: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
verses.text: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

verses.raw: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Messiah (Christ) for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
verses.text: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Messiah for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

verses.raw: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of Elohim (God), and the promises;
verses.text: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of Elohim, and the promises;

verses.raw: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Messiah (Christ) came, who is over all, Elohim (God) blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.text: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Messiah came, who is over all, Elohim blessed for ever. Amen.

verses.raw: Not as though the word of Elohim (God) has taken none effect. For they are not all Yashar'el (Israel), which are of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Not as though the word of Elohim has taken none effect. For they are not all Yashar'el, which are of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall your seed be called.
verses.text: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall your seed be called.

verses.raw: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of Elohim (God): but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
verses.text: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of Elohim: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

verses.raw: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
verses.text: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.

verses.raw: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
verses.text: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

verses.raw: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of Elohim (God) according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calls;)
verses.text: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of Elohim according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calls;)

verses.raw: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
verses.text: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

verses.raw: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
verses.text: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

verses.raw: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with Elohim (God)? Elohim (God) forbid.
verses.text: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with Elohim? Elohim forbid.

verses.raw: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.text: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

verses.raw: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runs, but of Elohim (God) that shows mercy.
verses.text: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runs, but of Elohim that shows mercy.

verses.raw: For the scripture says unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised you up, that I might shew my power in you, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.text: For the scripture says unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised you up, that I might shew my power in you, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

verses.raw: Therefore has he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
verses.text: Therefore has he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

verses.raw: You will say then unto me, Why does he yet find fault? For who has resisted his will?
verses.text: You will say then unto me, Why does he yet find fault? For who has resisted his will?

verses.raw: Nay but, O man, who are you that repliest against Elohim (God)? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why have you made me thus?
verses.text: Nay but, O man, who are you that repliest against Elohim? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why have you made me thus?

verses.raw: Has not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
verses.text: Has not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

verses.raw: What if Elohim (God), willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
verses.text: What if Elohim, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

verses.raw: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
verses.text: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

verses.raw: Even us, whom he has called, not of the Yahudim (Jews) only, but also of the Gentiles?
verses.text: Even us, whom he has called, not of the Yahudim only, but also of the Gentiles?

verses.raw: As he says also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
verses.text: As he says also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, You are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living Elohim.

verses.raw: Esaias also cries concerning Yashar'el (Israel), Though the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
verses.text: Esaias also cries concerning Yashar'el, Though the number of the children of Yashar'el be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

verses.raw: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will Yahuah (Lord) make upon the earth.
verses.text: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will Yahuah make upon the earth.

verses.raw: And as Esaias said before, Except Yahuah (Lord) of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
verses.text: And as Esaias said before, Except Yahuah of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

verses.raw: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
verses.text: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

verses.raw: But Yashar'el (Israel), which followed after the law of righteousness, has not attained to the law of righteousness.
verses.text: But Yashar'el, which followed after the law of righteousness, has not attained to the law of righteousness.

verses.raw: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
verses.text: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

verses.raw: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.text: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.

verses.raw: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to Elohim (God) for Yashar'el (Israel) is, that they might be saved.
verses.text: Brethren, my heart’s desire and prayer to Elohim for Yashar'el is, that they might be saved.

verses.raw: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of Elohim (God), but not according to knowledge.
verses.text: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of Elohim, but not according to knowledge.

verses.raw: For they being ignorant of Elohim's (God’s) righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For they being ignorant of Elohim's (God’s) righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of Elohim.

verses.raw: For Messiah (Christ) is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believes.
verses.text: For Messiah is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believes.

verses.raw: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which does those things shall live by them.
verses.text: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which does those things shall live by them.

verses.raw: But the righteousness which is of faith speaks on this wise, Say not in your heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Messiah (Christ) down from above:)
verses.text: But the righteousness which is of faith speaks on this wise, Say not in your heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Messiah down from above:)

verses.raw: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Messiah (Christ) again from the dead.)
verses.text: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Messiah again from the dead.)

verses.raw: But what says it? The word is nigh you, even in your mouth, and in your heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
verses.text: But what says it? The word is nigh you, even in your mouth, and in your heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

verses.raw: That if you shall confess with your mouth Lord Yahusha (Jesus), and shall believe in your heart that Elohim (God) has raised him from the dead, you shall be saved.
verses.text: That if you shall confess with your mouth Lord Yahusha, and shall believe in your heart that Elohim has raised him from the dead, you shall be saved.

verses.raw: For with the heart man believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.text: For with the heart man believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

verses.raw: For the scripture says, Whosoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.text: For the scripture says, Whosoever believes on him shall not be ashamed.

verses.raw: For there is no difference between the Yahudi (Jew) and the Greek: for the same the Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
verses.text: For there is no difference between the Yahudi and the Greek: for the same the Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

verses.raw: For whosoever shall call upon the name of Yahuah (Lord) shall be saved.
verses.text: For whosoever shall call upon the name of Yahuah shall be saved.

verses.raw: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.text: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

verses.raw: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verses.text: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

verses.raw: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias says, Yahuah (Lord), who has believed our report?
verses.text: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias says, Yahuah, who has believed our report?

verses.raw: So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Elohim (God).
verses.text: So then faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Elohim.

verses.raw: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
verses.text: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

verses.raw: But I say, Did not Yashar'el (Israel) know? First Moses says, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
verses.text: But I say, Did not Yashar'el know? First Moses says, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

verses.raw: But Esaias is very bold, and says, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
verses.text: But Esaias is very bold, and says, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

verses.raw: But to Yashar'el (Israel) he says, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.
verses.text: But to Yashar'el he says, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

verses.raw: I say then, Has Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.text: I say then, Has Elohim cast away his people? Elohim forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) has not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot you not what the scripture says of Elias? how he makes intercession to Elohim (God) against Yashar'el (Israel), saying,
verses.text: Elohim has not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot you not what the scripture says of Elias? how he makes intercession to Elohim against Yashar'el, saying,

verses.raw: Yahuah (Lord), they have killed your prophets, and digged down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.text: Yahuah, they have killed your prophets, and digged down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

verses.raw: But what says the answer of Elohim (God) unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
verses.text: But what says the answer of Elohim unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

verses.raw: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.text: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

verses.raw: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
verses.text: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

verses.raw: What then? Yashar'el (Israel) has not obtained that which he seeks for; but the election has obtained it, and the rest were blinded
verses.text: What then? Yashar'el has not obtained that which he seeks for; but the election has obtained it, and the rest were blinded

verses.raw: (According as it is written, Elohim (God) has given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
verses.text: (According as it is written, Elohim has given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

verses.raw: And David says, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
verses.text: And David says, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:

verses.raw: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
verses.text: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

verses.raw: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? Elohim (God) forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.text: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? Elohim forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

verses.raw: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
verses.text: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

verses.raw: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify my office:
verses.text: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify my office:

verses.raw: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
verses.text: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

verses.raw: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
verses.text: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

verses.raw: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
verses.text: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

verses.raw: And if some of the branches be broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
verses.text: And if some of the branches be broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

verses.raw: Boast not against the branches. But if you boast, you bear not the root, but the root you.
verses.text: Boast not against the branches. But if you boast, you bear not the root, but the root you.

verses.raw: You will say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
verses.text: You will say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.

verses.raw: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.text: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

verses.raw: For if Elohim (God) spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not you.
verses.text: For if Elohim spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not you.

verses.raw: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of Elohim (God): on them which fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness: otherwise you also shall be cut off.
verses.text: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of Elohim: on them which fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness: otherwise you also shall be cut off.

verses.raw: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for Elohim (God) is able to graff them in again.
verses.text: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for Elohim is able to graff them in again.

verses.raw: For if you were cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and were graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
verses.text: For if you were cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and were graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

verses.raw: For I would not, brethren, that you should be ignorant of this mystery, lest you should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el (Israel), until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
verses.text: For I would not, brethren, that you should be ignorant of this mystery, lest you should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

verses.raw: And so all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.text: And so all Yashar'el shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

verses.raw: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
verses.text: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

verses.raw: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.
verses.text: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.

verses.raw: For the gifts and calling of Elohim (God) are without repentance.
verses.text: For the gifts and calling of Elohim are without repentance.

verses.raw: For as you in times past have not believed Elohim (God), yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
verses.text: For as you in times past have not believed Elohim, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

verses.raw: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
verses.text: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) has concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.text: For Elohim has concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

verses.raw: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim (God)! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

verses.raw: For who has known the mind of Yahuah (Lord)? or who has been his counsellor?
verses.text: For who has known the mind of Yahuah? or who has been his counsellor?

verses.raw: Or who has first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.text: Or who has first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

verses.raw: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
verses.text: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

verses.raw: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of Elohim (God), that you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto Elohim (God), which is your reasonable service.
verses.text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of Elohim, that you present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto Elohim, which is your reasonable service.

verses.raw: And be not conformed to this world: but be you transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And be not conformed to this world: but be you transformed by the renewing of your mind, that you may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of Elohim.

verses.raw: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as Elohim (God) has dealt to every man the measure of faith.
verses.text: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as Elohim has dealt to every man the measure of faith.

verses.raw: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
verses.text: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

verses.raw: So we, being many, are one body in Messiah (Christ), and every one members one of another.
verses.text: So we, being many, are one body in Messiah, and every one members one of another.

verses.raw: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
verses.text: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

verses.raw: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teaches, on teaching;
verses.text: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teaches, on teaching;

verses.raw: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that gives, let him do it with simplicity; he that rules, with diligence; he that shows mercy, with cheerfulness.
verses.text: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that gives, let him do it with simplicity; he that rules, with diligence; he that shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

verses.raw: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
verses.text: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

verses.raw: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
verses.text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

verses.raw: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
verses.text: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

verses.raw: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
verses.text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

verses.raw: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
verses.text: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

verses.raw: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
verses.text: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

verses.raw: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
verses.text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

verses.raw: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
verses.text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

verses.raw: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
verses.text: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

verses.raw: If it be possible, as much as lies in you, live peaceably with all men.
verses.text: If it be possible, as much as lies in you, live peaceably with all men.

verses.raw: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore if your enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing you shall heap coals of fire on his head.
verses.text: Therefore if your enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing you shall heap coals of fire on his head.

verses.raw: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
verses.text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

verses.raw: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of Elohim (God): the powers that be are ordained of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of Elohim: the powers that be are ordained of Elohim.

verses.raw: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of Elohim (God): and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
verses.text: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of Elohim: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

verses.raw: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Will you then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and you shall have praise of the same:
verses.text: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Will you then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and you shall have praise of the same:

verses.raw: For he is the minister of Elohim (God) to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid; for he bears not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of Elohim (God), a revenger to execute wrath upon him that does evil.
verses.text: For he is the minister of Elohim to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid; for he bears not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of Elohim, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that does evil.

verses.raw: Wherefore you must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
verses.text: Wherefore you must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

verses.raw: For for this cause pay you tribute also: for they are Elohim's (God’s) ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
verses.text: For for this cause pay you tribute also: for they are Elohim's (God’s) ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

verses.raw: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
verses.text: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

verses.raw: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loves another has fulfilled the law.
verses.text: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loves another has fulfilled the law.

verses.raw: For this, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not kill, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness, You shall not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.
verses.text: For this, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not kill, You shall not steal, You shall not bear false witness, You shall not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, You shall love your neighbour as thyself.

verses.raw: Love works no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
verses.text: Love works no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

verses.raw: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
verses.text: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

verses.raw: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
verses.text: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

verses.raw: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
verses.text: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

verses.raw: But put you on Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
verses.text: But put you on Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

verses.raw: Him that is weak in the faith receive you, but not to doubtful disputations.
verses.text: Him that is weak in the faith receive you, but not to doubtful disputations.

verses.raw: For one believes that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eats herbs.
verses.text: For one believes that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eats herbs.

verses.raw: Let not him that eats despise him that eats not; and let not him which eats not judge him that eats: for Elohim (God) has received him.
verses.text: Let not him that eats despise him that eats not; and let not him which eats not judge him that eats: for Elohim has received him.

verses.raw: Who are you that judge another man’s servant? to his own master he stands or falls. Yea, he shall be holden up: for Elohim (God) is able to make him stand.
verses.text: Who are you that judge another man’s servant? to his own master he stands or falls. Yea, he shall be holden up: for Elohim is able to make him stand.

verses.raw: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
verses.text: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

verses.raw: He that regards the day, regards it unto the Lord; and he that regards not the day, to the Lord he does not regard it. He that eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives Elohim (God) thanks; and he that eats not, to the Lord he eats not, and gives Elohim (God) thanks.
verses.text: He that regards the day, regards it unto the Lord; and he that regards not the day, to the Lord he does not regard it. He that eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives Elohim thanks; and he that eats not, to the Lord he eats not, and gives Elohim thanks.

verses.raw: For none of us lives to himself, and no man dies to himself.
verses.text: For none of us lives to himself, and no man dies to himself.

verses.raw: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are Yahuah's (Lord’s).
verses.text: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are Yahuah's (Lord’s).

verses.raw: For to this end Messiah (Christ) both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be the Lord both of the dead and living.
verses.text: For to this end Messiah both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be the Lord both of the dead and living.

verses.raw: But why do you judge your brother? or why do you set at nought your brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: But why do you judge your brother? or why do you set at nought your brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Messiah.

verses.raw: For it is written, As I live, says Yahuah (Lord), every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to Elohim (God).
verses.text: For it is written, As I live, says Yahuah, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to Elohim.

verses.raw: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to Elohim (God).
verses.text: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to Elohim.

verses.raw: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.
verses.text: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother’s way.

verses.raw: I know, and am persuaded by Lord Yahusha (Jesus), that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
verses.text: I know, and am persuaded by Lord Yahusha, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

verses.raw: But if your brother be grieved with your meat, now walk you not charitably. Destroy not him with your meat, for whom Messiah (Christ) died.
verses.text: But if your brother be grieved with your meat, now walk you not charitably. Destroy not him with your meat, for whom Messiah died.

verses.raw: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
verses.text: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

verses.raw: For the kingdom of Elohim (God) is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: For the kingdom of Elohim is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: For he that in these things serves Messiah (Christ) is acceptable to Elohim (God), and approved of men.
verses.text: For he that in these things serves Messiah is acceptable to Elohim, and approved of men.

verses.raw: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
verses.text: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

verses.raw: For meat destroy not the work of Elohim (God). All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eats with offence.
verses.text: For meat destroy not the work of Elohim. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eats with offence.

verses.raw: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby your brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
verses.text: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby your brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

verses.raw: Have you faith? have it to thyself before Elohim (God). Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
verses.text: Have you faith? have it to thyself before Elohim. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

verses.raw: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eats not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
verses.text: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eats not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

verses.raw: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
verses.text: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

verses.raw: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
verses.text: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

verses.raw: For even Messiah (Christ) pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached you fell on me.
verses.text: For even Messiah pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached you fell on me.

verses.raw: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
verses.text: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

verses.raw: Now the Elohim (God) of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
verses.text: Now the Elohim of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to HaMashiach Yahusha:

verses.raw: That you may with one mind and one mouth glorify Elohim (God), even the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: That you may with one mind and one mouth glorify Elohim, even the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Wherefore receive you one another, as Messiah (Christ) also received us to the glory of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Wherefore receive you one another, as Messiah also received us to the glory of Elohim.

verses.raw: Now I say that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of Elohim (God), to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
verses.text: Now I say that Yahusha HaMashiach was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of Elohim, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

verses.raw: And that the Gentiles might glorify Elohim (God) for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to you among the Gentiles, and sing unto your name.
verses.text: And that the Gentiles might glorify Elohim for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to you among the Gentiles, and sing unto your name.

verses.raw: And again he says, Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.
verses.text: And again he says, Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.

verses.raw: And again, Praise Yahuah (Lord), all you Gentiles; and laud him, all you people.
verses.text: And again, Praise Yahuah, all you Gentiles; and laud him, all you people.

verses.raw: And again, Esaias says, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
verses.text: And again, Esaias says, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

verses.raw: Now the Elohim (God) of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, through the power of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: Now the Elohim of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, through the power of the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that you also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
verses.text: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that you also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of Elohim (God),
verses.text: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of Elohim,

verses.raw: That I should be the minister of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of Elohim (God), that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: That I should be the minister of Yahusha HaMashiach to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of Elohim, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) in those things which pertain to Elohim (God).
verses.text: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Yahusha HaMashiach in those things which pertain to Elohim.

verses.raw: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Messiah (Christ) has not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
