verses.text: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Messiah has not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

verses.raw: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of Elohim (God); so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of Elohim; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Messiah.

verses.raw: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Messiah (Christ) was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:
verses.text: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Messiah was named, lest I should build upon another man’s foundation:

verses.raw: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
verses.text: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

verses.raw: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
verses.text: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

verses.raw: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
verses.text: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

verses.raw: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
verses.text: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

verses.raw: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
verses.text: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

verses.raw: For it has pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
verses.text: For it has pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: It has pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
verses.text: It has pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

verses.raw: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
verses.text: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

verses.raw: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Messiah.

verses.raw: Now I beseech you, brethren, for Lord Yahusha HaMashiach's (Jesus Christ’s) sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to Elohim (God) for me;
verses.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, for Lord Yahusha HaMashiach's (Jesus Christ’s) sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to Elohim for me;

verses.raw: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
verses.text: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

verses.raw: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of Elohim (God), and may with you be refreshed.
verses.text: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of Elohim, and may with you be refreshed.

verses.raw: Now the Elohim (God) of peace be with you all. Amen.
verses.text: Now the Elohim of peace be with you all. Amen.

verses.raw: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
verses.text: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

verses.raw: That you receive her in the Lord, as becomes saints, and that you assist her in whatsoever business she has need of you: for she has been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
verses.text: That you receive her in the Lord, as becomes saints, and that you assist her in whatsoever business she has need of you: for she has been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

verses.raw: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
verses.text: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in HaMashiach Yahusha:

verses.raw: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
verses.text: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

verses.raw: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Messiah.

verses.raw: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
verses.text: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

verses.raw: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Messiah (Christ) before me.
verses.text: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Messiah before me.

verses.raw: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
verses.text: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

verses.raw: Salute Urbane, our helper in Messiah (Christ), and Stachys my beloved.
verses.text: Salute Urbane, our helper in Messiah, and Stachys my beloved.

verses.raw: Salute Apelles approved in Messiah (Christ). Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.
verses.text: Salute Apelles approved in Messiah. Salute them which are of Aristobulus’ household.

verses.raw: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
verses.text: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

verses.raw: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
verses.text: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

verses.raw: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
verses.text: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

verses.raw: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
verses.text: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

verses.raw: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
verses.text: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

verses.raw: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Messiah (Christ) salute you.
verses.text: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Messiah salute you.

verses.raw: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which you have learned; and avoid them.
verses.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which you have learned; and avoid them.

verses.raw: For they that are such serve not our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
verses.text: For they that are such serve not our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

verses.raw: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
verses.text: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

verses.raw: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.
verses.text: And the Elohim of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with you. Amen.

verses.raw: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
verses.text: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

verses.raw: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
verses.text: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

verses.raw: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
verses.text: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

verses.raw: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you all. Amen.
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with you all. Amen.

verses.raw: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
verses.text: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Yahusha HaMashiach, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

verses.raw: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of El Olam (the everlasting God), made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
verses.text: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of El Olam, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

verses.raw: To Elohim (God) only wise, be glory through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) for ever. Amen. Written to the Romans from Corinthus, and sent by Phebe servant of the church at Cenchrea.
verses.text: To Elohim only wise, be glory through Yahusha HaMashiach for ever. Amen. Written to the Romans from Corinthus, and sent by Phebe servant of the church at Cenchrea.

verses.raw: Paul, called to be an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) through the will of Elohim (God), and Sosthenes our brother,
verses.text: Paul, called to be an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach through the will of Elohim, and Sosthenes our brother,

verses.raw: Unto the church of Elohim (God) which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord, both theirs and ours:
verses.text: Unto the church of Elohim which is at Corinth, to them that are sanctified in HaMashiach Yahusha, called to be saints, with all that in every place call upon the name of Yahusha HaMashiach our Lord, both theirs and ours:

verses.raw: Grace be unto you, and peace, from Elohim (God) our Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Grace be unto you, and peace, from Elohim our Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: I thank my Elohim (God) always on your behalf, for the grace of Elohim (God) which is given you by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ);
verses.text: I thank my Elohim always on your behalf, for the grace of Elohim which is given you by Yahusha HaMashiach;

verses.raw: That in every thing you are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;
verses.text: That in every thing you are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge;

verses.raw: Even as the testimony of Messiah (Christ) was confirmed in you:
verses.text: Even as the testimony of Messiah was confirmed in you:

verses.raw: So that you come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: So that you come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that you may be blameless in the day of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Who shall also confirm you unto the end, that you may be blameless in the day of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) is faithful, by whom you were called unto the fellowship of his Son Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord.
verses.text: Elohim is faithful, by whom you were called unto the fellowship of his Son Yahusha HaMashiach our Lord.

verses.raw: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that you be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
verses.text: Now I beseech you, brethren, by the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you; but that you be perfectly joined together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

verses.raw: For it has been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.
verses.text: For it has been declared unto me of you, my brethren, by them which are of the house of Chloe, that there are contentions among you.

verses.raw: Now this I say, that every one of you says, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Now this I say, that every one of you says, I am of Paul; and I of Apollos; and I of Cephas; and I of Messiah.

verses.raw: Is Messiah (Christ) divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were you baptized in the name of Paul?
verses.text: Is Messiah divided? was Paul crucified for you? or were you baptized in the name of Paul?

verses.raw: I thank Elohim (God) that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;
verses.text: I thank Elohim that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;

verses.raw: Lest any should say that I had baptized in my own name.
verses.text: Lest any should say that I had baptized in my own name.

verses.raw: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.
verses.text: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.

verses.raw: For Messiah (Christ) sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Messiah (Christ) should be made of none effect.
verses.text: For Messiah sent me not to baptize, but to preach the gospel: not with wisdom of words, lest the cross of Messiah should be made of none effect.

verses.raw: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For the preaching of the cross is to them that perish foolishness; but unto us which are saved it is the power of Elohim.

verses.raw: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.
verses.text: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, and will bring to nothing the understanding of the prudent.

verses.raw: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? has not Elohim (God) made foolish the wisdom of this world?
verses.text: Where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the disputer of this world? has not Elohim made foolish the wisdom of this world?

verses.raw: For after that in the wisdom of Elohim (God) the world by wisdom knew not Elohim (God), it pleased Elohim (God) by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.
verses.text: For after that in the wisdom of Elohim the world by wisdom knew not Elohim, it pleased Elohim by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.

verses.raw: For the Yahudim (Jews) require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:
verses.text: For the Yahudim require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:

verses.raw: But we preach Messiah (Christ) crucified, unto the Yahudim (Jews) a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;
verses.text: But we preach Messiah crucified, unto the Yahudim a stumblingblock, and unto the Greeks foolishness;

verses.raw: But unto them which are called, both Yahudim (Jews) and Greeks, Messiah (Christ) the power of Elohim (God), and the wisdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But unto them which are called, both Yahudim and Greeks, Messiah the power of Elohim, and the wisdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: Because the foolishness of Elohim (God) is wiser than men; and the weakness of Elohim (God) is stronger than men.
verses.text: Because the foolishness of Elohim is wiser than men; and the weakness of Elohim is stronger than men.

verses.raw: For you see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:
verses.text: For you see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called:

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) has chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and Elohim (God) has chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;
verses.text: But Elohim has chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and Elohim has chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty;

verses.raw: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, has Elohim (God) chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
verses.text: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, has Elohim chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:

verses.raw: That no flesh should glory in his presence.
verses.text: That no flesh should glory in his presence.

verses.raw: But of him are you in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), who of Elohim (God) is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:
verses.text: But of him are you in HaMashiach Yahusha, who of Elohim is made unto us wisdom, and righteousness, and sanctification, and redemption:

verses.raw: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: That, according as it is written, He that glorieth, let him glory in Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of Elohim.

verses.raw: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and him crucified.
verses.text: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Yahusha HaMashiach, and him crucified.

verses.raw: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.
verses.text: And I was with you in weakness, and in fear, and in much trembling.

verses.raw: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
verses.text: And my speech and my preaching was not with enticing words of man’s wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:

verses.raw: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of Elohim (God).
verses.text: That your faith should not stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of Elohim.

verses.raw: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:
verses.text: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:

verses.raw: But we speak the wisdom of Elohim (God) in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which Elohim (God) ordained before the world unto our glory:
verses.text: But we speak the wisdom of Elohim in a mystery, even the hidden wisdom, which Elohim ordained before the world unto our glory:

verses.raw: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
verses.text: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

verses.raw: But as it is written, Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which Elohim (God) has prepared for them that love him.
verses.text: But as it is written, Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which Elohim has prepared for them that love him.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) has revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But Elohim has revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of Elohim.

verses.raw: For what man knows the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of Elohim (God) knows no man, but the Spirit of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For what man knows the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of Elohim knows no man, but the Spirit of Elohim.

verses.raw: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of Elohim (God); that we might know the things that are freely given to us of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Now we have received, not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is of Elohim; that we might know the things that are freely given to us of Elohim.

verses.raw: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man’s wisdom teaches, but which the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) teaches; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.
verses.text: Which things also we speak, not in the words which man’s wisdom teaches, but which the Ruach HaKodesh teaches; comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

verses.raw: But the natural man receives not the things of the Spirit of Elohim (God): for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
verses.text: But the natural man receives not the things of the Spirit of Elohim: for they are foolishness unto him: neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

verses.raw: But he that is spiritual judges all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
verses.text: But he that is spiritual judges all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.

verses.raw: For who has known the mind of Yahuah (Lord), that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For who has known the mind of Yahuah, that he may instruct him? But we have the mind of Messiah.

verses.raw: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: And I, brethren, could not speak unto you as unto spiritual, but as unto carnal, even as unto babes in Messiah.

verses.raw: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto you were not able to bear it, neither yet now are you able.
verses.text: I have fed you with milk, and not with meat: for hitherto you were not able to bear it, neither yet now are you able.

verses.raw: For you are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are you not carnal, and walk as men?
verses.text: For you are yet carnal: for whereas there is among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are you not carnal, and walk as men?

verses.raw: For while one says, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are you not carnal?
verses.text: For while one says, I am of Paul; and another, I am of Apollos; are you not carnal?

verses.raw: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom you believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
verses.text: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom you believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?

verses.raw: I have planted, Apollos watered; but Elohim (God) gave the increase.
verses.text: I have planted, Apollos watered; but Elohim gave the increase.

verses.raw: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but Elohim (God) that gives the increase.
verses.text: So then neither is he that planteth any thing, neither he that watereth; but Elohim that gives the increase.

verses.raw: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.
verses.text: Now he that planteth and he that watereth are one: and every man shall receive his own reward according to his own labour.

verses.raw: For we are labourers together with Elohim (God): you are Elohim's (God’s) husbandry, you are Elohim's (God’s) building.
verses.text: For we are labourers together with Elohim: you are Elohim's (God’s) husbandry, you are Elohim's (God’s) building.

verses.raw: According to the grace of Elohim (God) which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another builds thereon. But let every man take heed how he builds thereupon.
verses.text: According to the grace of Elohim which is given unto me, as a wise masterbuilder, I have laid the foundation, and another builds thereon. But let every man take heed how he builds thereupon.

verses.raw: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;
verses.text: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;

verses.raw: Every man’s work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man’s work of what sort it is.
verses.text: Every man’s work shall be made manifest: for the day shall declare it, because it shall be revealed by fire; and the fire shall try every man’s work of what sort it is.

verses.raw: If any man’s work abide which he has built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.
verses.text: If any man’s work abide which he has built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.

verses.raw: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.
verses.text: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.

verses.raw: Know you not that you are the temple of Elohim (God), and that the Spirit of Elohim (God) dwells in you?
verses.text: Know you not that you are the temple of Elohim, and that the Spirit of Elohim dwells in you?

verses.raw: If any man defile the temple of Elohim (God), him shall Elohim (God) destroy; for the temple of Elohim (God) is holy, which temple you are.
verses.text: If any man defile the temple of Elohim, him shall Elohim destroy; for the temple of Elohim is holy, which temple you are.

verses.raw: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seems to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.
verses.text: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seems to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.

verses.raw: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with Elohim (God). For it is written, He takes the wise in their own craftiness.
verses.text: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with Elohim. For it is written, He takes the wise in their own craftiness.

verses.raw: And again, Yahuah (Lord) knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.
verses.text: And again, Yahuah knows the thoughts of the wise, that they are vain.

verses.raw: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;
verses.text: Therefore let no man glory in men. For all things are yours;

verses.raw: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;
verses.text: Whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come; all are yours;

verses.raw: And you are Messiah's (Christ’s); and Messiah (Christ) is Elohim's (God’s).
verses.text: And you are Messiah's (Christ’s); and Messiah is Elohim's (God’s).

verses.raw: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Messiah (Christ), and stewards of the mysteries of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Let a man so account of us, as of the ministers of Messiah, and stewards of the mysteries of Elohim.

verses.raw: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.
verses.text: Moreover it is required in stewards, that a man be found faithful.

verses.raw: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man’s judgment: yea, I judge not my own self.
verses.text: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged of you, or of man’s judgment: yea, I judge not my own self.

verses.raw: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judges me is the Lord.
verses.text: For I know nothing by myself; yet am I not hereby justified: but he that judges me is the Lord.

verses.raw: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord come, who both will bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and will make manifest the counsels of the hearts: and then shall every man have praise of Elohim.

verses.raw: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that you might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.
verses.text: And these things, brethren, I have in a figure transferred to myself and to Apollos for your sakes; that you might learn in us not to think of men above that which is written, that no one of you be puffed up for one against another.

verses.raw: For who makes you to differ from another? and what have you that you did not receive? now if you did receive it, why do you glory, as if you had not received it?
verses.text: For who makes you to differ from another? and what have you that you did not receive? now if you did receive it, why do you glory, as if you had not received it?

verses.raw: Now you are full, now you are rich, you have reigned as kings without us: and I would to Elohim (God) you did reign, that we also might reign with you.
verses.text: Now you are full, now you are rich, you have reigned as kings without us: and I would to Elohim you did reign, that we also might reign with you.

verses.raw: For I think that Elohim (God) has set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.
verses.text: For I think that Elohim has set forth us the apostles last, as it were appointed to death: for we are made a spectacle unto the world, and to angels, and to men.

verses.raw: We are fools for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake, but you are wise in Messiah (Christ); we are weak, but you are strong; you are honourable, but we are despised.
verses.text: We are fools for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake, but you are wise in Messiah; we are weak, but you are strong; you are honourable, but we are despised.

verses.raw: Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace;
verses.text: Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace;

verses.raw: And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:
verses.text: And labour, working with our own hands: being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it:

verses.raw: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.
verses.text: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.

verses.raw: I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.
verses.text: I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.

verses.raw: For though you have ten thousand instructers in Messiah (Christ), yet have you not many fathers: for in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) I have begotten you through the gospel.
verses.text: For though you have ten thousand instructers in Messiah, yet have you not many fathers: for in HaMashiach Yahusha I have begotten you through the gospel.

verses.raw: Wherefore I beseech you, be you followers of me.
verses.text: Wherefore I beseech you, be you followers of me.

verses.raw: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Messiah (Christ), as I teach every where in every church.
verses.text: For this cause have I sent unto you Timotheus, who is my beloved son, and faithful in the Lord, who shall bring you into remembrance of my ways which be in Messiah, as I teach every where in every church.

verses.raw: Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.
verses.text: Now some are puffed up, as though I would not come to you.

verses.raw: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.
verses.text: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord will, and will know, not the speech of them which are puffed up, but the power.

verses.raw: For the kingdom of Elohim (God) is not in word, but in power.
verses.text: For the kingdom of Elohim is not in word, but in power.

verses.raw: What will you? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?
verses.text: What will you? shall I come unto you with a rod, or in love, and in the spirit of meekness?

verses.raw: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father’s wife.
verses.text: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father’s wife.

verses.raw: And you are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that has done this deed might be taken away from among you.
verses.text: And you are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that has done this deed might be taken away from among you.

verses.raw: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that has so done this deed,
verses.text: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that has so done this deed,

verses.raw: In the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), when you are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ),
verses.text: In the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, when you are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach,

verses.raw: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of Lord Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of Lord Yahusha.

verses.raw: Your glorying is not good. Know you not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
verses.text: Your glorying is not good. Know you not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

verses.raw: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that you may be a new lump, as you are unleavened. For even Messiah (Christ) our passover is sacrificed for us:
verses.text: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that you may be a new lump, as you are unleavened. For even Messiah our passover is sacrificed for us:

verses.raw: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.text: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

verses.raw: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:
verses.text: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:

verses.raw: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must you needs go out of the world.
verses.text: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must you needs go out of the world.

verses.raw: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
verses.text: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.

verses.raw: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not you judge them that are within?
verses.text: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not you judge them that are within?

verses.raw: But them that are without Elohim (God) judges. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
verses.text: But them that are without Elohim judges. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.

verses.raw: Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?
verses.text: Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the unjust, and not before the saints?

verses.raw: Do you not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
verses.text: Do you not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

verses.raw: Know you not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life?
verses.text: Know you not that we shall judge angels? how much more things that pertain to this life?

verses.raw: If then you have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.
verses.text: If then you have judgments of things pertaining to this life, set them to judge who are least esteemed in the church.

verses.raw: I speak to your shame. Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?
verses.text: I speak to your shame. Is it so, that there is not a wise man among you? no, not one that shall be able to judge between his brethren?

verses.raw: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.
verses.text: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before the unbelievers.

verses.raw: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because you go to law one with another. Why do you not rather take wrong? why do you not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?
verses.text: Now therefore there is utterly a fault among you, because you go to law one with another. Why do you not rather take wrong? why do you not rather suffer yourselves to be defrauded?

verses.raw: Nay, you do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.
verses.text: Nay, you do wrong, and defraud, and that your brethren.

verses.raw: Know you not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of Elohim (God)? Be not deceived: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind,
verses.text: Know you not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of Elohim? Be not deceived: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind,

verses.raw: Nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: And such were some of you: but you are washed, but you are sanctified, but you are justified in the name of Lord Yahusha (Jesus), and by the Spirit of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: And such were some of you: but you are washed, but you are sanctified, but you are justified in the name of Lord Yahusha, and by the Spirit of our Elohim.

verses.raw: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.
verses.text: All things are lawful unto me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of any.

verses.raw: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but Elohim (God) shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.
verses.text: Meats for the belly, and the belly for meats: but Elohim shall destroy both it and them. Now the body is not for fornication, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) has both raised up the Lord, and will also raise up us by his own power.
verses.text: And Elohim has both raised up the Lord, and will also raise up us by his own power.

verses.raw: Know you not that your bodies are the members of Messiah (Christ)? shall I then take the members of Messiah (Christ), and make them the members of an harlot? Elohim (God) forbid.
verses.text: Know you not that your bodies are the members of Messiah? shall I then take the members of Messiah, and make them the members of an harlot? Elohim forbid.

verses.raw: What? know you not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, says he, shall be one flesh.
verses.text: What? know you not that he which is joined to an harlot is one body? for two, says he, shall be one flesh.

verses.raw: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.
verses.text: But he that is joined unto the Lord is one spirit.

verses.raw: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man does is without the body; but he that commits fornication sins against his own body.
verses.text: Flee fornication. Every sin that a man does is without the body; but he that commits fornication sins against his own body.

verses.raw: What? know you not that your body is the temple of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) which is in you, which you have of Elohim (God), and you are not your own?
verses.text: What? know you not that your body is the temple of the Ruach HaKodesh which is in you, which you have of Elohim, and you are not your own?

verses.raw: For you are bought with a price: therefore glorify Elohim (God) in your body, and in your spirit, which are Elohim's (God’s).
verses.text: For you are bought with a price: therefore glorify Elohim in your body, and in your spirit, which are Elohim's (God’s).

verses.raw: Now concerning the things whereof you wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.
verses.text: Now concerning the things whereof you wrote unto me: It is good for a man not to touch a woman.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.
verses.text: Nevertheless, to avoid fornication, let every man have his own wife, and let every woman have her own husband.

verses.raw: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.
verses.text: Let the husband render unto the wife due benevolence: and likewise also the wife unto the husband.

verses.raw: The wife has not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband has not power of his own body, but the wife.
verses.text: The wife has not power of her own body, but the husband: and likewise also the husband has not power of his own body, but the wife.

verses.raw: Defraud you not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.
verses.text: Defraud you not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.

verses.raw: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.
verses.text: But I speak this by permission, and not of commandment.

verses.raw: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man has his proper gift of Elohim (God), one after this manner, and another after that.
verses.text: For I would that all men were even as I myself. But every man has his proper gift of Elohim, one after this manner, and another after that.

verses.raw: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
verses.text: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.

verses.raw: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
verses.text: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.

verses.raw: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:
verses.text: And unto the married I command, yet not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from her husband:

verses.raw: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.
verses.text: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to her husband: and let not the husband put away his wife.

verses.raw: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother has a wife that believes not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
verses.text: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother has a wife that believes not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.

verses.raw: And the woman which has an husband that believes not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.
verses.text: And the woman which has an husband that believes not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.

verses.raw: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
verses.text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.

verses.raw: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but Elohim (God) has called us to peace.
verses.text: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but Elohim has called us to peace.

verses.raw: For what know you, O wife, whether you shall save your husband? or how know you, O man, whether you shall save your wife?
verses.text: For what know you, O wife, whether you shall save your husband? or how know you, O man, whether you shall save your wife?

verses.raw: But as Elohim (God) has distributed to every man, as the Lord has called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
verses.text: But as Elohim has distributed to every man, as the Lord has called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.

verses.raw: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.
verses.text: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.

verses.raw: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of Elohim.

verses.raw: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.
verses.text: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.

verses.raw: Are you called being a servant? care not for it: but if you may be made free, use it rather.
verses.text: Are you called being a servant? care not for it: but if you may be made free, use it rather.

verses.raw: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is Yahuah's (Lord’s) freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Messiah's (Christ’s) servant.
verses.text: For he that is called in the Lord, being a servant, is Yahuah's (Lord’s) freeman: likewise also he that is called, being free, is Messiah's (Christ’s) servant.

verses.raw: You are bought with a price; be not you the servants of men.
verses.text: You are bought with a price; be not you the servants of men.

verses.raw: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with Elohim (God).
verses.text: Brethren, let every man, wherein he is called, therein abide with Elohim.

verses.raw: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that has obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.
verses.text: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that has obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.

verses.raw: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.
verses.text: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.

verses.raw: Are you bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Are you loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.
verses.text: Are you bound unto a wife? seek not to be loosed. Are you loosed from a wife? seek not a wife.

verses.raw: But and if you marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she has not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.
verses.text: But and if you marry, you have not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she has not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.

verses.raw: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remains, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;
verses.text: But this I say, brethren, the time is short: it remains, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

verses.raw: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;
verses.text: And they that weep, as though they wept not; and they that rejoice, as though they rejoiced not; and they that buy, as though they possessed not;

verses.raw: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passes away.
verses.text: And they that use this world, as not abusing it: for the fashion of this world passes away.

verses.raw: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
verses.text: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:

verses.raw: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.
verses.text: But he that is married careth for the things that are of the world, how he may please his wife.

verses.raw: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.
verses.text: There is difference also between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please her husband.

verses.raw: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that you may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
verses.text: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that you may attend upon the Lord without distraction.

verses.raw: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sins not: let them marry.
verses.text: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sins not: let them marry.

verses.raw: Nevertheless he that stands stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but has power over his own will, and has so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, does well.
verses.text: Nevertheless he that stands stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but has power over his own will, and has so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, does well.

verses.raw: So then he that gives her in marriage does well; but he that gives her not in marriage does better.
verses.text: So then he that gives her in marriage does well; but he that gives her not in marriage does better.

verses.raw: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband lives; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.
verses.text: The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband lives; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord.

verses.raw: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of Elohim.

verses.raw: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.
verses.text: Now as touching things offered unto idols, we know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffeth up, but charity edifieth.

verses.raw: And if any man think that he knows any thing, he knows nothing yet as he ought to know.
verses.text: And if any man think that he knows any thing, he knows nothing yet as he ought to know.

verses.raw: But if any man love Elohim (God), the same is known of him.
verses.text: But if any man love Elohim, the same is known of him.

verses.raw: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other Elohim (God) but one.
verses.text: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other Elohim but one.

verses.raw: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)
verses.text: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)

verses.raw: But to us there is but one Elohim (God), the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), by whom are all things, and we by him.
verses.text: But to us there is but one Elohim, the Father, of whom are all things, and we in him; and one Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, by whom are all things, and we by him.

verses.raw: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.
verses.text: Howbeit there is not in every man that knowledge: for some with conscience of the idol unto this hour eat it as a thing offered unto an idol; and their conscience being weak is defiled.

verses.raw: But meat commendeth us not to Elohim (God): for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.
verses.text: But meat commendeth us not to Elohim: for neither, if we eat, are we the better; neither, if we eat not, are we the worse.

verses.raw: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.
verses.text: But take heed lest by any means this liberty of yours become a stumblingblock to them that are weak.

verses.raw: For if any man see you which have knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;
verses.text: For if any man see you which have knowledge sit at meat in the idol’s temple, shall not the conscience of him which is weak be emboldened to eat those things which are offered to idols;

verses.raw: And through your knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Messiah (Christ) died?
verses.text: And through your knowledge shall the weak brother perish, for whom Messiah died?

verses.raw: But when you sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, you sin against Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: But when you sin so against the brethren, and wound their weak conscience, you sin against Messiah.

verses.raw: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world stands, lest I make my brother to offend.
verses.text: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world stands, lest I make my brother to offend.

verses.raw: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Lord? are not you my work in the Lord?
verses.text: Am I not an apostle? am I not free? have I not seen Yahusha HaMashiach our Lord? are not you my work in the Lord?

verses.raw: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of my apostleship are you in the Lord.
verses.text: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of my apostleship are you in the Lord.

verses.raw: My answer to them that do examine me is this,
verses.text: My answer to them that do examine me is this,

verses.raw: Have we not power to eat and to drink?
verses.text: Have we not power to eat and to drink?

verses.raw: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?
verses.text: Have we not power to lead about a sister, a wife, as well as other apostles, and as the brethren of the Lord, and Cephas?

verses.raw: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?
verses.text: Or I only and Barnabas, have not we power to forbear working?

verses.raw: Who goes a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eats not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eats not of the milk of the flock?
verses.text: Who goes a warfare any time at his own charges? who planteth a vineyard, and eats not of the fruit thereof? or who feedeth a flock, and eats not of the milk of the flock?

verses.raw: Say I these things as a man? or says not the law the same also?
verses.text: Say I these things as a man? or says not the law the same also?

verses.raw: For it is written in the law of Moses, You shall not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treads out the corn. Does Elohim (God) take care for oxen?
verses.text: For it is written in the law of Moses, You shall not muzzle the mouth of the ox that treads out the corn. Does Elohim take care for oxen?

verses.raw: Or says he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.
verses.text: Or says he it altogether for our sakes? For our sakes, no doubt, this is written: that he that ploweth should plow in hope; and that he that thresheth in hope should be partaker of his hope.

verses.raw: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?
verses.text: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

verses.raw: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Messiah.

verses.raw: Do you not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?
verses.text: Do you not know that they which minister about holy things live of the things of the temple? and they which wait at the altar are partakers with the altar?

verses.raw: Even so has the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.
verses.text: Even so has the Lord ordained that they which preach the gospel should live of the gospel.

verses.raw: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.
verses.text: But I have used none of these things: neither have I written these things, that it should be so done unto me: for it were better for me to die, than that any man should make my glorying void.

verses.raw: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!
verses.text: For though I preach the gospel, I have nothing to glory of: for necessity is laid upon me; yea, woe is unto me, if I preach not the gospel!

verses.raw: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.
verses.text: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

verses.raw: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Messiah (Christ) without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
verses.text: What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Messiah without charge, that I abuse not my power in the gospel.

verses.raw: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
verses.text: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.

verses.raw: And unto the Yahudim (Jews) I became as a Yahudi (Jew), that I might gain the Yahudim (Jews); to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
verses.text: And unto the Yahudim I became as a Yahudi, that I might gain the Yahudim; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;

verses.raw: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to Elohim (God), but under the law to Messiah (Christ),) that I might gain them that are without law.
verses.text: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to Elohim, but under the law to Messiah,) that I might gain them that are without law.

verses.raw: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
verses.text: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.

verses.raw: And this I do for the gospel’s sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.
verses.text: And this I do for the gospel’s sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.

verses.raw: Know you not that they which run in a race run all, but one receives the prize? So run, that you may obtain.
verses.text: Know you not that they which run in a race run all, but one receives the prize? So run, that you may obtain.

verses.raw: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
verses.text: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.

verses.raw: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
verses.text: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:

verses.raw: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
verses.text: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.

verses.raw: Moreover, brethren, I would not that you should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
verses.text: Moreover, brethren, I would not that you should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

verses.raw: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
verses.text: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

verses.raw: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
verses.text: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;

verses.raw: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Messiah.

verses.raw: But with many of them Elohim (God) was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
verses.text: But with many of them Elohim was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

verses.raw: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
verses.text: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

verses.raw: Neither be you idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
verses.text: Neither be you idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

verses.raw: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
verses.text: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.

verses.raw: Neither let us tempt Messiah (Christ), as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
verses.text: Neither let us tempt Messiah, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.

verses.raw: Neither murmur you, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
verses.text: Neither murmur you, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.

verses.raw: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
verses.text: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.

verses.raw: Wherefore let him that thinketh he stands take heed lest he fall.
verses.text: Wherefore let him that thinketh he stands take heed lest he fall.

verses.raw: There has no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but Elohim (God) is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that you are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that you may be able to bear it.
verses.text: There has no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but Elohim is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that you are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that you may be able to bear it.

verses.raw: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
verses.text: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.

verses.raw: I speak as to wise men; judge you what I say.
verses.text: I speak as to wise men; judge you what I say.

verses.raw: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Messiah (Christ)? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Messiah (Christ)?
verses.text: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Messiah? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Messiah?

verses.raw: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
verses.text: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.

verses.raw: Behold Yashar'el (Israel) after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
verses.text: Behold Yashar'el after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?

verses.raw: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
verses.text: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?

verses.raw: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to Elohim (God): and I would not that you should have fellowship with devils.
verses.text: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to Elohim: and I would not that you should have fellowship with devils.

verses.raw: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: you cannot be partakers of Yahuah's (Lord’s) table, and of the table of devils.
verses.text: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: you cannot be partakers of Yahuah's (Lord’s) table, and of the table of devils.

verses.raw: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
verses.text: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?

verses.raw: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
verses.text: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.

verses.raw: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.
verses.text: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.

verses.raw: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
verses.text: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:

verses.raw: For the earth is Yahuah's (Lord’s), and the fulness thereof.
verses.text: For the earth is Yahuah's (Lord’s), and the fulness thereof.

verses.raw: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and you be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
verses.text: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and you be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

verses.raw: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is Yahuah's (Lord’s), and the fulness thereof:
verses.text: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is Yahuah's (Lord’s), and the fulness thereof:

verses.raw: Conscience, I say, not your own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?
verses.text: Conscience, I say, not your own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?

verses.raw: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
verses.text: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

verses.raw: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatsoever you do, do all to the glory of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatsoever you do, do all to the glory of Elohim.

verses.raw: Give none offence, neither to the Yahudim (Jews), nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of Elohim (God):
verses.text: Give none offence, neither to the Yahudim, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of Elohim:

verses.raw: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
verses.text: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.

verses.raw: Be you imitators of me, even as I am of the Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Be you imitators of me, even as I am of the Messiah.

verses.raw: Now I praise you, brethren, that you remember me in all things, and hold fast the traditions, even as I delivered them unto you.
verses.text: Now I praise you, brethren, that you remember me in all things, and hold fast the traditions, even as I delivered them unto you.

verses.raw: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is the Messiah (Christ); and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of the Messiah (Christ) is Elohim (God).
verses.text: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is the Messiah; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of the Messiah is Elohim.

verses.raw: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head cast down, dishonoureth his head.
verses.text: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head cast down, dishonoureth his head.

verses.raw: Not every woman who prayeth or prophesieth with uncovered head dishonoureth the head; the dishonor is upon her that is shaven.
verses.text: Not every woman who prayeth or prophesieth with uncovered head dishonoureth the head; the dishonor is upon her that is shaven.

verses.raw: For the woman shorn yet wholly covered stands not in disgrace; her covering is upon her.
verses.text: For the woman shorn yet wholly covered stands not in disgrace; her covering is upon her.

verses.raw: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head out of shame, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of Elohim (God); but the woman is the glory of the man.
verses.text: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head out of shame, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of Elohim; but the woman is the glory of the man.

verses.raw: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
verses.text: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.

verses.raw: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
verses.text: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.

verses.raw: For this cause ought the woman to have authority on her head because of the angels.
verses.text: For this cause ought the woman to have authority on her head because of the angels.

verses.raw: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of Elohim.

verses.raw: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto Elohim (God) uncovered?
verses.text: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto Elohim uncovered?

verses.raw: Does not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
verses.text: Does not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?

verses.raw: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair has been given to her as her covering.
verses.text: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair has been given to her as her covering.

verses.raw: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the assemblies of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the assemblies of Elohim.

verses.raw: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that you come together not for the better, but for the worse.
verses.text: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that you come together not for the better, but for the worse.

verses.raw: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
verses.text: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.

verses.raw: For there must be also factions among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
verses.text: For there must be also factions among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.

verses.raw: When you come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the supper of Yahusha (the Lord's supper).
verses.text: When you come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the supper of Yahusha (the Lord's supper).

verses.raw: For in eating every one takes before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
verses.text: For in eating every one takes before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.

verses.raw: What? have you not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise you the assembly of Elohim (God), and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
verses.text: What? have you not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise you the assembly of Elohim, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.

verses.raw: For I have received of Yahusha (the Lord) that which also I delivered unto you, That Yahusha (the Lord Jesus) the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
