verses.raw: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling you received him.
verses.text: And his inward affection is more abundant toward you, whilst he remembereth the obedience of you all, how with fear and trembling you received him.

verses.raw: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.
verses.text: I rejoice therefore that I have confidence in you in all things.

verses.raw: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of Elohim (God) bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;
verses.text: Moreover, brethren, we do you to wit of the grace of Elohim bestowed on the churches of Macedonia;

verses.raw: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
verses.text: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.

verses.raw: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;
verses.text: For to their power, I bear record, yea, and beyond their power they were willing of themselves;

verses.raw: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.
verses.text: Praying us with much intreaty that we would receive the gift, and take upon us the fellowship of the ministering to the saints.

verses.raw: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And this they did, not as we hoped, but first gave their own selves to the Lord, and unto us by the will of Elohim.

verses.raw: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.
verses.text: Insomuch that we desired Titus, that as he had begun, so he would also finish in you the same grace also.

verses.raw: Therefore, as you abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that you abound in this grace also.
verses.text: Therefore, as you abound in every thing, in faith, and utterance, and knowledge, and in all diligence, and in your love to us, see that you abound in this grace also.

verses.raw: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.
verses.text: I speak not by commandment, but by occasion of the forwardness of others, and to prove the sincerity of your love.

verses.raw: For you know the grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might be rich.
verses.text: For you know the grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might be rich.

verses.raw: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.
verses.text: And herein I give my advice: for this is expedient for you, who have begun before, not only to do, but also to be forward a year ago.

verses.raw: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which you have.
verses.text: Now therefore perform the doing of it; that as there was a readiness to will, so there may be a performance also out of that which you have.

verses.raw: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man has, and not according to that he has not.
verses.text: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man has, and not according to that he has not.

verses.raw: For I mean not that other men be eased, and you burdened:
verses.text: For I mean not that other men be eased, and you burdened:

verses.raw: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:
verses.text: But by an equality, that now at this time your abundance may be a supply for their want, that their abundance also may be a supply for your want: that there may be equality:

verses.raw: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.
verses.text: As it is written, He that had gathered much had nothing over; and he that had gathered little had no lack.

verses.raw: But thanks be to Elohim (God), which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.
verses.text: But thanks be to Elohim, which put the same earnest care into the heart of Titus for you.

verses.raw: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.
verses.text: For indeed he accepted the exhortation; but being more forward, of his own accord he went unto you.

verses.raw: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;
verses.text: And we have sent with him the brother, whose praise is in the gospel throughout all the churches;

verses.raw: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same the Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:
verses.text: And not that only, but who was also chosen of the churches to travel with us with this grace, which is administered by us to the glory of the same the Lord, and declaration of your ready mind:

verses.raw: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:
verses.text: Avoiding this, that no man should blame us in this abundance which is administered by us:

verses.raw: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.
verses.text: Providing for honest things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

verses.raw: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.
verses.text: And we have sent with them our brother, whom we have oftentimes proved diligent in many things, but now much more diligent, upon the great confidence which I have in you.

verses.raw: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Whether any do enquire of Titus, he is my partner and fellowhelper concerning you: or our brethren be enquired of, they are the messengers of the churches, and the glory of Messiah.

verses.raw: Wherefore shew you to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.
verses.text: Wherefore shew you to them, and before the churches, the proof of your love, and of our boasting on your behalf.

verses.raw: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:
verses.text: For as touching the ministering to the saints, it is superfluous for me to write to you:

verses.raw: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal has provoked very many.
verses.text: For I know the forwardness of your mind, for which I boast of you to them of Macedonia, that Achaia was ready a year ago; and your zeal has provoked very many.

verses.raw: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, you may be ready:
verses.text: Yet have I sent the brethren, lest our boasting of you should be in vain in this behalf; that, as I said, you may be ready:

verses.raw: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, you) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.
verses.text: Lest haply if they of Macedonia come with me, and find you unprepared, we (that we say not, you) should be ashamed in this same confident boasting.

verses.raw: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof you had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.
verses.text: Therefore I thought it necessary to exhort the brethren, that they would go before unto you, and make up beforehand your bounty, whereof you had notice before, that the same might be ready, as a matter of bounty, and not as of covetousness.

verses.raw: But this I say, He which sows sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which sows bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
verses.text: But this I say, He which sows sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which sows bountifully shall reap also bountifully.

verses.raw: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for Elohim (God) loves a cheerful giver.
verses.text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for Elohim loves a cheerful giver.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) is able to make all grace abound toward you; that you, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:
verses.text: And Elohim is able to make all grace abound toward you; that you, always having all sufficiency in all things, may abound to every good work:

verses.raw: (As it is written, He has dispersed abroad; he has given to the poor: his righteousness remains for ever.
verses.text: (As it is written, He has dispersed abroad; he has given to the poor: his righteousness remains for ever.

verses.raw: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)
verses.text: Now he that ministereth seed to the sower both minister bread for your food, and multiply your seed sown, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;)

verses.raw: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causes through us thanksgiving to Elohim (God).
verses.text: Being enriched in every thing to all bountifulness, which causes through us thanksgiving to Elohim.

verses.raw: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto Elohim (God);
verses.text: For the administration of this service not only supplieth the want of the saints, but is abundant also by many thanksgivings unto Elohim;

verses.raw: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify Elohim (God) for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Messiah (Christ), and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;
verses.text: Whiles by the experiment of this ministration they glorify Elohim for your professed subjection unto the gospel of Messiah, and for your liberal distribution unto them, and unto all men;

verses.raw: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of Elohim (God) in you.
verses.text: And by their prayer for you, which long after you for the exceeding grace of Elohim in you.

verses.raw: Thanks be unto Elohim (God) for his unspeakable gift.
verses.text: Thanks be unto Elohim for his unspeakable gift.

verses.raw: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Messiah (Christ), who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:
verses.text: Now I Paul myself beseech you by the meekness and gentleness of Messiah, who in presence am base among you, but being absent am bold toward you:

verses.raw: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.
verses.text: But I beseech you, that I may not be bold when I am present with that confidence, wherewith I think to be bold against some, which think of us as if we walked according to the flesh.

verses.raw: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:
verses.text: For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh:

verses.raw: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through Elohim (God) to the pulling down of strong holds;)
verses.text: (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through Elohim to the pulling down of strong holds;)

verses.raw: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of Elohim (God), and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Messiah (Christ);
verses.text: Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of Elohim, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Messiah;

verses.raw: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.
verses.text: And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

verses.raw: Do you look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Messiah's (Christ’s), let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Messiah's (Christ’s), even so are we Messiah's (Christ’s).
verses.text: Do you look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Messiah's (Christ’s), let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Messiah's (Christ’s), even so are we Messiah's (Christ’s).

verses.raw: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord has given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:
verses.text: For though I should boast somewhat more of our authority, which the Lord has given us for edification, and not for your destruction, I should not be ashamed:

verses.raw: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
verses.text: That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.

verses.raw: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.
verses.text: For his letters, say they, are weighty and powerful; but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech contemptible.

verses.raw: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.
verses.text: Let such an one think this, that, such as we are in word by letters when we are absent, such will we be also in deed when we are present.

verses.raw: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.
verses.text: For we dare not make ourselves of the number, or compare ourselves with some that commend themselves: but they measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves among themselves, are not wise.

verses.raw: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which Elohim (God) has distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
verses.text: But we will not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which Elohim has distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.

verses.raw: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Messiah (Christ):
verses.text: For we stretch not ourselves beyond our measure, as though we reached not unto you: for we are come as far as to you also in preaching the gospel of Messiah:

verses.raw: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,
verses.text: Not boasting of things without our measure, that is, of other men’s labours; but having hope, when your faith is increased, that we shall be enlarged by you according to our rule abundantly,

verses.raw: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.
verses.text: To preach the gospel in the regions beyond you, and not to boast in another man’s line of things made ready to our hand.

verses.raw: But he that glorieth, let him glory in Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: But he that glorieth, let him glory in Yahuah.

verses.raw: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.
verses.text: For not he that commendeth himself is approved, but whom the Lord commendeth.

verses.raw: Would to Elohim (God) you could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.
verses.text: Would to Elohim you could bear with me a little in my folly: and indeed bear with me.

verses.raw: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For I am jealous over you with godly jealousy: for I have espoused you to one husband, that I may present you as a chaste virgin to Messiah.

verses.raw: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah.

verses.raw: For if he that comes preaches another Yahusha (Jesus), whom we have not preached, or if you receive another spirit, which you have not received, or another gospel, which you have not accepted, you might well bear with him.
verses.text: For if he that comes preaches another Yahusha, whom we have not preached, or if you receive another spirit, which you have not received, or another gospel, which you have not accepted, you might well bear with him.

verses.raw: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.
verses.text: For I suppose I was not a whit behind the very chiefest apostles.

verses.raw: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.
verses.text: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

verses.raw: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that you might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of Elohim (God) freely?
verses.text: Have I committed an offence in abasing myself that you might be exalted, because I have preached to you the gospel of Elohim freely?

verses.raw: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.
verses.text: I robbed other churches, taking wages of them, to do you service.

verses.raw: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.
verses.text: And when I was present with you, and wanted, I was chargeable to no man: for that which was lacking to me the brethren which came from Macedonia supplied: and in all things I have kept myself from being burdensome unto you, and so will I keep myself.

verses.raw: As the truth of Messiah (Christ) is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.
verses.text: As the truth of Messiah is in me, no man shall stop me of this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

verses.raw: Wherefore? because I love you not? Elohim (God) knows.
verses.text: Wherefore? because I love you not? Elohim knows.

verses.raw: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.
verses.text: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them which desire occasion; that wherein they glory, they may be found even as we.

verses.raw: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Messiah.

verses.raw: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.
verses.text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

verses.raw: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.
verses.text: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

verses.raw: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.
verses.text: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

verses.raw: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.
verses.text: That which I speak, I speak it not after the Lord, but as it were foolishly, in this confidence of boasting.

verses.raw: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.
verses.text: Seeing that many glory after the flesh, I will glory also.

verses.raw: For you suffer fools gladly, seeing you yourselves are wise.
verses.text: For you suffer fools gladly, seeing you yourselves are wise.

verses.raw: For you suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.
verses.text: For you suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

verses.raw: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.
verses.text: I speak as concerning reproach, as though we had been weak. Howbeit whereinsoever any is bold, (I speak foolishly,) I am bold also.

verses.raw: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
verses.text: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they Israelites? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.

verses.raw: Are they ministers of Messiah (Christ)? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.
verses.text: Are they ministers of Messiah? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft.

verses.raw: Of the Yahudim (Jews) five times received I forty stripes save one.
verses.text: Of the Yahudim five times received I forty stripes save one.

verses.raw: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;
verses.text: Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep;

verses.raw: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by my own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;
verses.text: In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by my own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren;

verses.raw: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.
verses.text: In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

verses.raw: Beside those things that are without, that which comes upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
verses.text: Beside those things that are without, that which comes upon me daily, the care of all the churches.

verses.raw: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?
verses.text: Who is weak, and I am not weak? who is offended, and I burn not?

verses.raw: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern my infirmities.
verses.text: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern my infirmities.

verses.raw: The Elohim (God) and Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), which is blessed for evermore, knows that I lie not.
verses.text: The Elohim and Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, which is blessed for evermore, knows that I lie not.

verses.raw: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:
verses.text: In Damascus the governor under Aretas the king kept the city of the Damascenes with a garrison, desirous to apprehend me:

verses.raw: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.
verses.text: And through a window in a basket was I let down by the wall, and escaped his hands.

verses.raw: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
verses.text: It is not expedient for me doubtless to glory. I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

verses.raw: I knew a man in Messiah (Christ) above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: Elohim (God) knows;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.
verses.text: I knew a man in Messiah above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: Elohim knows;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

verses.raw: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: Elohim (God) knows;)
verses.text: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: Elohim knows;)

verses.raw: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.
verses.text: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

verses.raw: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in my infirmities.
verses.text: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in my infirmities.

verses.raw: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he sees me to be, or that he hears of me.
verses.text: For though I would desire to glory, I shall not be a fool; for I will say the truth: but now I forbear, lest any man should think of me above that which he sees me to be, or that he hears of me.

verses.raw: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.
verses.text: And lest I should be exalted above measure through the abundance of the revelations, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, the messenger of Satan to buffet me, lest I should be exalted above measure.

verses.raw: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.
verses.text: For this thing I besought the Lord thrice, that it might depart from me.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for you: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Messiah (Christ) may rest upon me.
verses.text: And he said unto me, My grace is sufficient for you: for my strength is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore will I rather glory in my infirmities, that the power of Messiah may rest upon me.

verses.raw: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.
verses.text: Therefore I take pleasure in infirmities, in reproaches, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake: for when I am weak, then am I strong.

verses.raw: I am become a fool in glorying; you have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.
verses.text: I am become a fool in glorying; you have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

verses.raw: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.
verses.text: Truly the signs of an apostle were wrought among you in all patience, in signs, and wonders, and mighty deeds.

verses.raw: For what is it wherein you were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.
verses.text: For what is it wherein you were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

verses.raw: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.
verses.text: Behold, the third time I am ready to come to you; and I will not be burdensome to you: for I seek not yours, but you: for the children ought not to lay up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

verses.raw: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.
verses.text: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

verses.raw: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.
verses.text: But be it so, I did not burden you: nevertheless, being crafty, I caught you with guile.

verses.raw: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?
verses.text: Did I make a gain of you by any of them whom I sent unto you?

verses.raw: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?
verses.text: I desired Titus, and with him I sent a brother. Did Titus make a gain of you? walked we not in the same spirit? walked we not in the same steps?

verses.raw: Again, think you that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before Elohim (God) in Messiah (Christ): but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.
verses.text: Again, think you that we excuse ourselves unto you? we speak before Elohim in Messiah: but we do all things, dearly beloved, for your edifying.

verses.raw: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as you would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:
verses.text: For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as you would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

verses.raw: And lest, when I come again, my Elohim (God) will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.
verses.text: And lest, when I come again, my Elohim will humble me among you, and that I shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.

verses.raw: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.
verses.text: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

verses.raw: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:
verses.text: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

verses.raw: Since you seek a proof of Messiah (Christ) speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.
verses.text: Since you seek a proof of Messiah speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

verses.raw: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives by the power of Elohim (God). For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of Elohim (God) toward you.
verses.text: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives by the power of Elohim. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of Elohim toward you.

verses.raw: Examine yourselves, whether you be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know you not your own selves, how that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is in you, except you be reprobates?
verses.text: Examine yourselves, whether you be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know you not your own selves, how that Yahusha HaMashiach is in you, except you be reprobates?

verses.raw: But I trust that you shall know that we are not reprobates.
verses.text: But I trust that you shall know that we are not reprobates.

verses.raw: Now I pray to Elohim (God) that you do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that you should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.
verses.text: Now I pray to Elohim that you do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that you should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

verses.raw: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.
verses.text: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

verses.raw: For we are glad, when we are weak, and you are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.
verses.text: For we are glad, when we are weak, and you are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

verses.raw: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord has given me to edification, and not to destruction.
verses.text: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord has given me to edification, and not to destruction.

verses.raw: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the Elohim (God) of love and peace shall be with you.
verses.text: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the Elohim of love and peace shall be with you.

verses.raw: Greet one another with an holy kiss.
verses.text: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

verses.raw: All the saints salute you.
verses.text: All the saints salute you.

verses.raw: The grace of Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and the love of Elohim (God), and the communion of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi, a city of Macedonia, by Titus and Lucas.
verses.text: The grace of Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, and the love of Elohim, and the communion of the Ruach HaKodesh, be with you all. Amen. The second epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi, a city of Macedonia, by Titus and Lucas.

verses.raw: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and Elohim (God) the Father, who raised him from the dead;)
verses.text: Paul, an apostle, (not of men, neither by man, but by Yahusha HaMashiach, and Elohim the Father, who raised him from the dead;)

verses.raw: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:
verses.text: And all the brethren which are with me, unto the churches of Galatia:

verses.raw: Grace be to you and peace from Elohim (God) the Father, and from our Adonai Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ),
verses.text: Grace be to you and peace from Elohim the Father, and from our Adonai Yahusha HaMashiach,

verses.raw: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of Elohim (God) and our Father:
verses.text: Who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us from this present evil world, according to the will of Elohim and our Father:

verses.raw: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: To whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: I marvel that you are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Messiah (Christ) unto another gospel:
verses.text: I marvel that you are so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Messiah unto another gospel:

verses.raw: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Messiah.

verses.raw: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.
verses.text: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

verses.raw: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that you have received, let him be accursed.
verses.text: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that you have received, let him be accursed.

verses.raw: For do I now persuade men, or Elohim (God)? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For do I now persuade men, or Elohim? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Messiah.

verses.raw: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.
verses.text: But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.

verses.raw: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: For you have heard of my conversation in time past in the Yahudim's (Jews’) religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of Elohim (God), and wasted it:
verses.text: For you have heard of my conversation in time past in the Yahudim's (Jews’) religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the church of Elohim, and wasted it:

verses.raw: And profited in the Yahudim's (Jews’) religion above many my equals in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.
verses.text: And profited in the Yahudim's (Jews’) religion above many my equals in my own nation, being more exceedingly zealous of the traditions of my fathers.

verses.raw: But when it pleased Elohim (God), who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,
verses.text: But when it pleased Elohim, who separated me from my mother’s womb, and called me by his grace,

verses.raw: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:
verses.text: To reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the heathen; immediately I conferred not with flesh and blood:

verses.raw: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.
verses.text: Neither went I up to Jerusalem to them which were apostles before me; but I went into Arabia, and returned again unto Damascus.

verses.raw: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.
verses.text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Peter, and abode with him fifteen days.

verses.raw: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James Yahusha's (Lord’s) brother.
verses.text: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James Yahusha's (Lord’s) brother.

verses.raw: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before Elohim (God), I lie not.
verses.text: Now the things which I write unto you, behold, before Elohim, I lie not.

verses.raw: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;
verses.text: Afterwards I came into the regions of Syria and Cilicia;

verses.raw: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Messiah (Christ):
verses.text: And was unknown by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Messiah:

verses.raw: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preaches the faith which once he destroyed.
verses.text: But they had heard only, That he which persecuted us in times past now preaches the faith which once he destroyed.

verses.raw: And they glorified Elohim (God) in me.
verses.text: And they glorified Elohim in me.

verses.raw: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.
verses.text: Then fourteen years after I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, and took Titus with me also.

verses.raw: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.
verses.text: And I went up by revelation, and communicated unto them that gospel which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately to them which were of reputation, lest by any means I should run, or had run, in vain.

verses.raw: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:
verses.text: But neither Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised:

verses.raw: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), that they might bring us into bondage:
verses.text: And that because of false brethren unawares brought in, who came in privily to spy out our liberty which we have in HaMashiach Yahusha, that they might bring us into bondage:

verses.raw: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.
verses.text: To whom we gave place by subjection, no, not for an hour; that the truth of the gospel might continue with you.

verses.raw: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it makes no matter to me: Elohim (God) accepts no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:
verses.text: But of these who seemed to be somewhat, (whatsoever they were, it makes no matter to me: Elohim accepts no man’s person:) for they who seemed to be somewhat in conference added nothing to me:

verses.raw: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;
verses.text: But contrariwise, when they saw that the gospel of the uncircumcision was committed unto me, as the gospel of the circumcision was unto Peter;

verses.raw: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)
verses.text: (For he that wrought effectually in Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision, the same was mighty in me toward the Gentiles:)

verses.raw: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.
verses.text: And when James, Cephas, and John, who seemed to be pillars, perceived the grace that was given unto me, they gave to me and Barnabas the right hands of fellowship; that we should go unto the heathen, and they unto the circumcision.

verses.raw: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.
verses.text: Only they would that we should remember the poor; the same which I also was forward to do.

verses.raw: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.
verses.text: But when Peter was come to Antioch, I withstood him to the face, because he was to be blamed.

verses.raw: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.
verses.text: For before that certain came from James, he did eat with the Gentiles: but when they were come, he withdrew and separated himself, fearing them which were of the circumcision.

verses.raw: And the other Yahudim (Jews) dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.
verses.text: And the other Yahudim dissembled likewise with him; insomuch that Barnabas also was carried away with their dissimulation.

verses.raw: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If you, being a Yahudi (Jew), livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Yahudim (Jews), why compellest you the Gentiles to live as do the Yahudim (Jews)?
verses.text: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If you, being a Yahudi, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Yahudim, why compellest you the Gentiles to live as do the Yahudim?

verses.raw: We who are Yahudim (Jews) by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
verses.text: We who are Yahudim by nature, and not sinners of the Gentiles,

verses.raw: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), even we have believed in Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), that we might be justified by the faith of Messiah (Christ), and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.
verses.text: Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Yahusha HaMashiach, even we have believed in Yahusha HaMashiach, that we might be justified by the faith of Messiah, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.

verses.raw: But if, while we seek to be justified by Messiah (Christ), we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Messiah (Christ) the minister of sin? Elohim (God) forbid.
verses.text: But if, while we seek to be justified by Messiah, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Messiah the minister of sin? Elohim forbid.

verses.raw: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.
verses.text: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

verses.raw: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: For I through the law am dead to the law, that I might live unto Elohim.

verses.raw: I am crucified with Messiah (Christ): nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Messiah (Christ) lives in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of Elohim (God), who loved me, and gave himself for me.
verses.text: I am crucified with Messiah: nevertheless I live; yet not I, but Messiah lives in me: and the life which I now live in the flesh I live by the faith of the Son of Elohim, who loved me, and gave himself for me.

verses.raw: I do not frustrate the grace of Elohim (God): for if righteousness come by the law, then Messiah (Christ) is dead in vain.
verses.text: I do not frustrate the grace of Elohim: for if righteousness come by the law, then Messiah is dead in vain.

verses.raw: O foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you, that you should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) has been evidently set forth, crucified among you?
verses.text: O foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you, that you should not obey the truth, before whose eyes Yahusha HaMashiach has been evidently set forth, crucified among you?

verses.raw: This only would I learn of you, Received you the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.text: This only would I learn of you, Received you the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.raw: Are you so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are you now made perfect by the flesh?
verses.text: Are you so foolish? having begun in the Spirit, are you now made perfect by the flesh?

verses.raw: Have you suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.
verses.text: Have you suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

verses.raw: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and works miracles among you, does he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
verses.text: He therefore that ministereth to you the Spirit, and works miracles among you, does he it by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?

verses.raw: Even as Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was accounted to him for righteousness.
verses.text: Even as Abraham believed Elohim, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

verses.raw: Know you therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.
verses.text: Know you therefore that they which are of faith, the same are the children of Abraham.

verses.raw: And the scripture, foreseeing that Elohim (God) would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In you shall all nations be blessed.
verses.text: And the scripture, foreseeing that Elohim would justify the heathen through faith, preached before the gospel unto Abraham, saying, In you shall all nations be blessed.

verses.raw: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.
verses.text: So then they which be of faith are blessed with faithful Abraham.

verses.raw: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continues not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.
verses.text: For as many as are of the works of the law are under the curse: for it is written, Cursed is every one that continues not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

verses.raw: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of Elohim (God), it is evident: for, The righteous shall live by faith.
verses.text: But that no man is justified by the law in the sight of Elohim, it is evident: for, The righteous shall live by faith.

verses.raw: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that does them shall live in them.
verses.text: And the law is not of faith: but, The man that does them shall live in them.

verses.raw: Messiah (Christ) has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:
verses.text: Messiah has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

verses.raw: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ); that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.
verses.text: That the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Yahusha HaMashiach; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

verses.raw: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.
verses.text: Brethren, I speak after the manner of men; Though it be but a man’s covenant, yet if it be confirmed, no man disannulleth, or addeth thereto.

verses.raw: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He says not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to your seed, which is Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Now to Abraham and his seed were the promises made. He says not, And to seeds, as of many; but as of one, And to your seed, which is Messiah.

verses.raw: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of Elohim (God) in Messiah (Christ), the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.
verses.text: And this I say, that the covenant, that was confirmed before of Elohim in Messiah, the law, which was four hundred and thirty years after, cannot disannul, that it should make the promise of none effect.

verses.raw: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but Elohim (God) gave it to Abraham by promise.
verses.text: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but Elohim gave it to Abraham by promise.

verses.raw: Wherefore then serves the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.
verses.text: Wherefore then serves the law? It was added because of transgressions, till the seed should come to whom the promise was made; and it was ordained by angels in the hand of a mediator.

verses.raw: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but Elohim (God) is one.
verses.text: Now a mediator is not a mediator of one, but Elohim is one.

verses.raw: Is the law then against the promises of Elohim (God)? Elohim (God) forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.
verses.text: Is the law then against the promises of Elohim? Elohim forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

verses.raw: But the scripture has concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) might be given to them that believe.
verses.text: But the scripture has concluded all under sin, that the promise by faith of Yahusha HaMashiach might be given to them that believe.

verses.raw: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.
verses.text: But before faith came, we were kept under the law, shut up unto the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

verses.raw: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Messiah (Christ), that we might be justified by faith.
verses.text: Wherefore the law was our schoolmaster to bring us unto Messiah, that we might be justified by faith.

verses.raw: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.
verses.text: But after that faith is come, we are no longer under a schoolmaster.

verses.raw: For you are all the children of Elohim (God) by faith in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: For you are all the children of Elohim by faith in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: For as many of you as have been baptized into Messiah (Christ) have put on Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For as many of you as have been baptized into Messiah have put on Messiah.

verses.raw: There is neither Yahudi (Jew) nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for you are all one in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: There is neither Yahudi nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for you are all one in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: And if you be Messiah's (Christ’s), then are you Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.
verses.text: And if you be Messiah's (Christ’s), then are you Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

verses.raw: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;
verses.text: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

verses.raw: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.
verses.text: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

verses.raw: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:
verses.text: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

verses.raw: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
verses.text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

verses.raw: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.
verses.text: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

verses.raw: And because you are sons, Elohim (God) has sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.
verses.text: And because you are sons, Elohim has sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

verses.raw: Wherefore you are no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of Elohim (God) through Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Wherefore you are no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of Elohim through Messiah.

verses.raw: Howbeit then, when you knew not Elohim (God), you did service unto them which by nature are no gods.
verses.text: Howbeit then, when you knew not Elohim, you did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

verses.raw: But now, after that you have known Elohim (God), or rather are known of Elohim (God), how turn you again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto you desire again to be in bondage?
verses.text: But now, after that you have known Elohim, or rather are known of Elohim, how turn you again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto you desire again to be in bondage?

verses.raw: You observe days, and months, and times, and years.
verses.text: You observe days, and months, and times, and years.

verses.raw: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.
verses.text: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

verses.raw: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as you are: you have not injured me at all.
verses.text: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as you are: you have not injured me at all.

verses.raw: You know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.
verses.text: You know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

verses.raw: And my temptation which was in my flesh you despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of Elohim (God), even as HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: And my temptation which was in my flesh you despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of Elohim, even as HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: Where is then the blessedness you spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, you would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.
verses.text: Where is then the blessedness you spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, you would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

verses.raw: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?
verses.text: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

verses.raw: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that you might affect them.
verses.text: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that you might affect them.

verses.raw: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.
verses.text: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

verses.raw: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Messiah (Christ) be formed in you,
verses.text: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Messiah be formed in you,

verses.raw: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.
verses.text: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

verses.raw: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, do you not hear the law?
verses.text: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, do you not hear the law?

verses.raw: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.
verses.text: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

verses.raw: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.
verses.text: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

verses.raw: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.
verses.text: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

verses.raw: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.
verses.text: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

verses.raw: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.
verses.text: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

verses.raw: For it is written, Rejoice, you barren that bear not; break forth and cry, you that travailest not: for the desolate has many more children than she which has an husband.
verses.text: For it is written, Rejoice, you barren that bear not; break forth and cry, you that travailest not: for the desolate has many more children than she which has an husband.

verses.raw: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.
verses.text: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

verses.raw: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.
verses.text: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

verses.raw: Nevertheless what says the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.
verses.text: Nevertheless what says the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the freewoman.

verses.raw: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.
verses.text: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

verses.raw: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Messiah (Christ) has made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.
verses.text: Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Messiah has made us free, and be not entangled again with the yoke of bondage.

verses.raw: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if you be circumcised, Messiah (Christ) shall profit you nothing.
verses.text: Behold, I Paul say unto you, that if you be circumcised, Messiah shall profit you nothing.

verses.raw: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.
verses.text: For I testify again to every man that is circumcised, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

verses.raw: Messiah (Christ) is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; you are fallen from grace.
verses.text: Messiah is become of no effect unto you, whosoever of you are justified by the law; you are fallen from grace.

verses.raw: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.
verses.text: For we through the Spirit wait for the hope of righteousness by faith.

verses.raw: For in Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which works by love.
verses.text: For in Yahusha HaMashiach neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision; but faith which works by love.

verses.raw: You did run well; who did hinder you that you should not obey the truth?
verses.text: You did run well; who did hinder you that you should not obey the truth?

verses.raw: This persuasion comes not of him that calls you.
verses.text: This persuasion comes not of him that calls you.

verses.raw: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.
verses.text: A little leaven leaveneth the whole lump.

verses.raw: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that you will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubles you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.
verses.text: I have confidence in you through the Lord, that you will be none otherwise minded: but he that troubles you shall bear his judgment, whosoever he be.

verses.raw: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.
verses.text: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

verses.raw: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.
verses.text: I would they were even cut off which trouble you.

verses.raw: For, brethren, you have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.
verses.text: For, brethren, you have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

verses.raw: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; You shall love your neighbour as thyself.
verses.text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; You shall love your neighbour as thyself.

verses.raw: But if you bite and devour one another, take heed that you be not consumed one of another.
verses.text: But if you bite and devour one another, take heed that you be not consumed one of another.

verses.raw: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and you shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
verses.text: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and you shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

verses.raw: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that you cannot do the things that you would.
verses.text: For the flesh lusteth against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh: and these are contrary the one to the other: so that you cannot do the things that you would.

verses.raw: But if you be led of the Spirit, you are not under the law.
verses.text: But if you be led of the Spirit, you are not under the law.

verses.raw: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,
verses.text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

verses.raw: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,
verses.text: Idolatry, witchcraft, hatred, variance, emulations, wrath, strife, seditions, heresies,

verses.raw: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of Elohim.

verses.raw: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,
verses.text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

verses.raw: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.
verses.text: Meekness, temperance: against such there is no law.

verses.raw: And they that are Messiah's (Christ’s) have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.
verses.text: And they that are Messiah's (Christ’s) have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

verses.raw: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.
verses.text: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

verses.raw: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
verses.text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

verses.raw: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, you which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest you also be tempted.
verses.text: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, you which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest you also be tempted.

verses.raw: Bear you one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Bear you one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Messiah.

verses.raw: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.
verses.text: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

verses.raw: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.
verses.text: But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another.

verses.raw: For every man shall bear his own burden.
verses.text: For every man shall bear his own burden.

verses.raw: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teaches in all good things.
verses.text: Let him that is taught in the word communicate unto him that teaches in all good things.

verses.raw: Be not deceived; Elohim (God) is not mocked: for whatsoever a man sows, that shall he also reap.
verses.text: Be not deceived; Elohim is not mocked: for whatsoever a man sows, that shall he also reap.

verses.raw: For he that sows to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that sows to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.
verses.text: For he that sows to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that sows to the Spirit shall of the Spirit reap life everlasting.

verses.raw: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
verses.text: And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.

verses.raw: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.
verses.text: As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith.

verses.raw: You see how large a letter I have written unto you with my own hand.
verses.text: You see how large a letter I have written unto you with my own hand.

verses.raw: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: As many as desire to make a fair shew in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Messiah.

verses.raw: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.
verses.text: For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.
verses.text: But Elohim forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

verses.raw: For in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.
verses.text: For in HaMashiach Yahusha neither circumcision availeth any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature.

verses.raw: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Yashar'el (Israel) of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Yashar'el of Elohim.

verses.raw: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of Lord Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of Lord Yahusha.

verses.raw: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with your spirit. Amen. Unto the Galatians written from Rome.
verses.text: Brethren, the grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with your spirit. Amen. Unto the Galatians written from Rome.

verses.raw: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) by the will of Elohim (God), to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach by the will of Elohim, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in HaMashiach Yahusha:

verses.raw: Grace be to you, and peace, from Elohim (God) our Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Grace be to you, and peace, from Elohim our Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Blessed be the Elohim (God) and Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), who has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Messiah (Christ):
verses.text: Blessed be the Elohim and Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, who has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Messiah:

verses.raw: According as he has chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:
verses.text: According as he has chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

verses.raw: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,
verses.text: Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Yahusha HaMashiach to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

verses.raw: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he has made us accepted in the beloved.
verses.text: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he has made us accepted in the beloved.

verses.raw: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;
verses.text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace;

verses.raw: Wherein he has abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;
verses.text: Wherein he has abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence;

verses.raw: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he has purposed in himself:
verses.text: Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he has purposed in himself:

verses.raw: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Messiah (Christ), both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:
verses.text: That in the dispensation of the fulness of times he might gather together in one all things in Messiah, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him:

verses.raw: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his own will:
verses.text: In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his own will:

verses.raw: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Messiah.

verses.raw: In whom you also trusted, after that you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that you believed, you were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,
verses.text: In whom you also trusted, after that you heard the word of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that you believed, you were sealed with that holy Spirit of promise,

verses.raw: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.
verses.text: Which is the earnest of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory.

verses.raw: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in Lord Yahusha (Jesus), and love unto all the saints,
verses.text: Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in Lord Yahusha, and love unto all the saints,

verses.raw: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;
verses.text: Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers;

verses.raw: That the Elohim (God) of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:
verses.text: That the Elohim of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him:

verses.raw: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
verses.text: The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

verses.raw: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,
verses.text: And what is the exceeding greatness of his power to us-ward who believe, according to the working of his mighty power,

verses.raw: Which he wrought in Messiah (Christ), when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,
verses.text: Which he wrought in Messiah, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places,

verses.raw: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:
verses.text: Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come:

verses.raw: And has put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
verses.text: And has put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church,
