verses.raw: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.
verses.text: Which is his body, the fulness of him that filleth all in all.

verses.raw: And you has he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;
verses.text: And you has he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins;

verses.raw: Wherein in time past you walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now works in the children of disobedience:
verses.text: Wherein in time past you walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit that now works in the children of disobedience:

verses.raw: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.
verses.text: Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God), who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,
verses.text: But Elohim, who is rich in mercy, for his great love wherewith he loved us,

verses.raw: Even when we were dead in sins, has quickened us together with Messiah (Christ), (by grace you are saved;)
verses.text: Even when we were dead in sins, has quickened us together with Messiah, (by grace you are saved;)

verses.raw: And has raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
verses.text: And has raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in HaMashiach Yahusha:

verses.raw: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: That in the ages to come he might shew the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: For by grace are you saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of Elohim (God):
verses.text: For by grace are you saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of Elohim:

verses.raw: Not of works, lest any man should boast.
verses.text: Not of works, lest any man should boast.

verses.raw: For we are his workmanship, created in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) unto good works, which Elohim (God) has before ordained that we should walk in them.
verses.text: For we are his workmanship, created in HaMashiach Yahusha unto good works, which Elohim has before ordained that we should walk in them.

verses.raw: Wherefore remember, that you being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;
verses.text: Wherefore remember, that you being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands;

verses.raw: That at that time you were without Messiah (Christ), being aliens from the commonwealth of Yashar'el (Israel), and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without Elohim (God) in the world:
verses.text: That at that time you were without Messiah, being aliens from the commonwealth of Yashar'el, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without Elohim in the world:

verses.raw: But now in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) you who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: But now in HaMashiach Yahusha you who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Messiah.

verses.raw: For he is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of partition between us;
verses.text: For he is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of partition between us;

verses.raw: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;
verses.text: Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; for to make in himself of twain one new man, so making peace;

verses.raw: And that he might reconcile both unto Elohim (God) in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:
verses.text: And that he might reconcile both unto Elohim in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby:

verses.raw: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.
verses.text: And came and preached peace to you which were afar off, and to them that were nigh.

verses.raw: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.
verses.text: For through him we both have access by one Spirit unto the Father.

verses.raw: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of Elohim (God);
verses.text: Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellowcitizens with the saints, and of the household of Elohim;

verses.raw: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) himself being the chief corner stone;
verses.text: And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Yahusha HaMashiach himself being the chief corner stone;

verses.raw: In whom all the building fitly framed together grows unto an holy temple in the Lord:
verses.text: In whom all the building fitly framed together grows unto an holy temple in the Lord:

verses.raw: In whom you also are builded together for an habitation of Elohim (God) through the Spirit.
verses.text: In whom you also are builded together for an habitation of Elohim through the Spirit.

verses.raw: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) for you Gentiles,
verses.text: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Yahusha HaMashiach for you Gentiles,

verses.raw: If you have heard of the dispensation of the grace of Elohim (God) which is given me to you-ward:
verses.text: If you have heard of the dispensation of the grace of Elohim which is given me to you-ward:

verses.raw: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,
verses.text: How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote afore in few words,

verses.raw: Whereby, when you read, you may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)
verses.text: Whereby, when you read, you may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ)

verses.raw: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;
verses.text: Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit;

verses.raw: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Messiah (Christ) by the gospel:
verses.text: That the Gentiles should be fellowheirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Messiah by the gospel:

verses.raw: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of Elohim (God) given unto me by the effectual working of his power.
verses.text: Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of Elohim given unto me by the effectual working of his power.

verses.raw: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Messiah (Christ);
verses.text: Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Messiah;

verses.raw: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world has been hid in Elohim (God), who created all things by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world has been hid in Elohim, who created all things by Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of Elohim (God),
verses.text: To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of Elohim,

verses.raw: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) our Lord:
verses.text: According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in HaMashiach Yahusha our Lord:

verses.raw: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.
verses.text: In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him.

verses.raw: Wherefore I desire that you faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.
verses.text: Wherefore I desire that you faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory.

verses.raw: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ),
verses.text: For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach,

verses.raw: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,
verses.text: Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named,

verses.raw: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;
verses.text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit in the inner man;

verses.raw: That Messiah (Christ) may dwell in your hearts by faith; that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
verses.text: That Messiah may dwell in your hearts by faith; that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

verses.raw: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;
verses.text: May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height;

verses.raw: And to know the love of Messiah (Christ), which passes knowledge, that you might be filled with all the fulness of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And to know the love of Messiah, which passes knowledge, that you might be filled with all the fulness of Elohim.

verses.raw: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
verses.text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

verses.raw: Unto him be glory in the church by HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
verses.text: Unto him be glory in the church by HaMashiach Yahusha throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

verses.raw: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that you walk worthy of the vocation wherewith you are called,
verses.text: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech you that you walk worthy of the vocation wherewith you are called,

verses.raw: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;
verses.text: With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love;

verses.raw: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
verses.text: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

verses.raw: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you are called in one hope of your calling;
verses.text: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you are called in one hope of your calling;

verses.raw: One the Lord, one faith, one baptism,
verses.text: One the Lord, one faith, one baptism,

verses.raw: One Elohim (God) and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.
verses.text: One Elohim and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all.

verses.raw: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Messiah.

verses.raw: Wherefore he says, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.
verses.text: Wherefore he says, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

verses.raw: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?
verses.text: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

verses.raw: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)
verses.text: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

verses.raw: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;
verses.text: And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers;

verses.raw: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Messiah (Christ):
verses.text: For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Messiah:

verses.raw: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of Elohim (God), unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Messiah (Christ):
verses.text: Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of Elohim, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fulness of Messiah:

verses.raw: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;
verses.text: That we henceforth be no more children, tossed to and fro, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive;

verses.raw: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Messiah (Christ):
verses.text: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Messiah:

verses.raw: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, makes increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.
verses.text: From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplieth, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, makes increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love.

verses.raw: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,
verses.text: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind,

verses.raw: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of Elohim (God) through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:
verses.text: Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of Elohim through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart:

verses.raw: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
verses.text: Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

verses.raw: But you have not so learned Messiah (Christ);
verses.text: But you have not so learned Messiah;

verses.raw: If so be that you have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Yahusha (Jesus):
verses.text: If so be that you have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Yahusha:

verses.raw: That you put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;
verses.text: That you put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts;

verses.raw: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;
verses.text: And be renewed in the spirit of your mind;

verses.raw: And that you put on the new man, which after Elohim (God) is created in righteousness and true holiness.
verses.text: And that you put on the new man, which after Elohim is created in righteousness and true holiness.

verses.raw: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.
verses.text: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

verses.raw: Be you angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:
verses.text: Be you angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

verses.raw: Neither give place to the devil.
verses.text: Neither give place to the devil.

verses.raw: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.
verses.text: Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needeth.

verses.raw: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.
verses.text: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

verses.raw: And grieve not the holy Spirit of Elohim (God), whereby you are sealed unto the day of redemption.
verses.text: And grieve not the holy Spirit of Elohim, whereby you are sealed unto the day of redemption.

verses.raw: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
verses.text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

verses.raw: And be you kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as Elohim (God) for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake has forgiven you.
verses.text: And be you kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as Elohim for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake has forgiven you.

verses.raw: Be you therefore followers of Elohim (God), as dear children;
verses.text: Be you therefore followers of Elohim, as dear children;

verses.raw: And walk in love, as Messiah (Christ) also has loved us, and has given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to Elohim (God) for a sweetsmelling savour.
verses.text: And walk in love, as Messiah also has loved us, and has given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to Elohim for a sweetsmelling savour.

verses.raw: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becomes saints;
verses.text: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becomes saints;

verses.raw: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.
verses.text: Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks.

verses.raw: For this you know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Messiah (Christ) and of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For this you know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Messiah and of Elohim.

verses.raw: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things comes the wrath of Elohim (God) upon the children of disobedience.
verses.text: Let no man deceive you with vain words: for because of these things comes the wrath of Elohim upon the children of disobedience.

verses.raw: Be not you therefore partakers with them.
verses.text: Be not you therefore partakers with them.

verses.raw: For you were sometimes darkness, but now are you light in the Lord: walk as children of light:
verses.text: For you were sometimes darkness, but now are you light in the Lord: walk as children of light:

verses.raw: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)
verses.text: (For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;)

verses.raw: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.
verses.text: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord.

verses.raw: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.
verses.text: And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them.

verses.raw: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.
verses.text: For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret.

verses.raw: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever does make manifest is light.
verses.text: But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever does make manifest is light.

verses.raw: Wherefore he says, Awake you that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Messiah (Christ) shall give you light.
verses.text: Wherefore he says, Awake you that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Messiah shall give you light.

verses.raw: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,
verses.text: See then that you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise,

verses.raw: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
verses.text: Redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

verses.raw: Wherefore be you not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
verses.text: Wherefore be you not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.

verses.raw: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;
verses.text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

verses.raw: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verses.text: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

verses.raw: Giving thanks always for all things unto Elohim (God) and the Father in the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ);
verses.text: Giving thanks always for all things unto Elohim and the Father in the name of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach;

verses.raw: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of Elohim.

verses.raw: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.
verses.text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

verses.raw: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Messiah (Christ) is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.
verses.text: For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Messiah is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body.

verses.raw: Therefore as the church is subject unto Messiah (Christ), so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.
verses.text: Therefore as the church is subject unto Messiah, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.

verses.raw: Husbands, love your wives, even as Messiah (Christ) also loved the church, and gave himself for it;
verses.text: Husbands, love your wives, even as Messiah also loved the church, and gave himself for it;

verses.raw: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,
verses.text: That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word,

verses.raw: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.
verses.text: That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

verses.raw: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loves his wife loves himself.
verses.text: So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loves his wife loves himself.

verses.raw: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:
verses.text: For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church:

verses.raw: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.
verses.text: For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones.

verses.raw: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.
verses.text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

verses.raw: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Messiah (Christ) and the church.
verses.text: This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Messiah and the church.

verses.raw: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.
verses.text: Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.

verses.raw: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

verses.raw: Honour your father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)
verses.text: Honour your father and mother; (which is the first commandment with promise;)

verses.raw: That it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.
verses.text: That it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.

verses.raw: And, you fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.
verses.text: And, you fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord.

verses.raw: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Messiah (Christ);
verses.text: Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Messiah;

verses.raw: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Messiah (Christ), doing the will of Elohim (God) from the heart;
verses.text: Not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but as the servants of Messiah, doing the will of Elohim from the heart;

verses.raw: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:
verses.text: With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men:

verses.raw: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man does, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.
verses.text: Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man does, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free.

verses.raw: And, you masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.
verses.text: And, you masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him.

verses.raw: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
verses.text: Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.

verses.raw: Put on the whole armour of Elohim (God), that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
verses.text: Put on the whole armour of Elohim, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

verses.raw: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.
verses.text: For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places.

verses.raw: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of Elohim (God), that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
verses.text: Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of Elohim, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

verses.raw: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;
verses.text: Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness;

verses.raw: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;
verses.text: And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

verses.raw: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.
verses.text: Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked.

verses.raw: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of Elohim (God):
verses.text: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of Elohim:

verses.raw: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;
verses.text: Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints;

verses.raw: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,
verses.text: And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel,

verses.raw: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
verses.text: For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

verses.raw: But that you also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:
verses.text: But that you also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

verses.raw: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that you might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.
verses.text: Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that you might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts.

verses.raw: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from Elohim (God) the Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from Elohim the Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) in sincerity. Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.
verses.text: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach in sincerity. Amen. Written from Rome unto the Ephesians by Tychicus.

verses.raw: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to all the saints in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Yahusha HaMashiach, to all the saints in HaMashiach Yahusha which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

verses.raw: Grace be unto you, and peace, from Elohim (God) our Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Grace be unto you, and peace, from Elohim our Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: I thank my Elohim (God) upon every remembrance of you,
verses.text: I thank my Elohim upon every remembrance of you,

verses.raw: Always in every prayer of my for you all making request with joy,
verses.text: Always in every prayer of my for you all making request with joy,

verses.raw: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
verses.text: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

verses.raw: Being confident of this very thing, that he which has begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which has begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers of my grace.
verses.text: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers of my grace.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: For Elohim is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
verses.text: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;

verses.raw: That you may approve things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offence till the day of Messiah (Christ);
verses.text: That you may approve things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offence till the day of Messiah;

verses.raw: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), unto the glory and praise of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Yahusha HaMashiach, unto the glory and praise of Elohim.

verses.raw: But I would you should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
verses.text: But I would you should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;

verses.raw: So that my bonds in Messiah (Christ) are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
verses.text: So that my bonds in Messiah are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

verses.raw: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.text: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

verses.raw: Some indeed preach Messiah (Christ) even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.text: Some indeed preach Messiah even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

verses.raw: The one preach Messiah (Christ) of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
verses.text: The one preach Messiah of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

verses.raw: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
verses.text: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

verses.raw: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Messiah (Christ) is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
verses.text: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Messiah is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

verses.raw: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ),
verses.text: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Yahusha HaMashiach,

verses.raw: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Messiah (Christ) shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
verses.text: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Messiah shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

verses.raw: For to me to live is Messiah (Christ), and to die is gain.
verses.text: For to me to live is Messiah, and to die is gain.

verses.raw: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
verses.text: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

verses.raw: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Messiah (Christ); which is far better:
verses.text: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Messiah; which is far better:

verses.raw: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
verses.text: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

verses.raw: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
verses.text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

verses.raw: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) for me by my coming to you again.
verses.text: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Yahusha HaMashiach for me by my coming to you again.

verses.raw: Only let your conversation be as it becomes the gospel of Messiah (Christ): that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that you stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.text: Only let your conversation be as it becomes the gospel of Messiah: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that you stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

verses.raw: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of Elohim.

verses.raw: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Messiah (Christ), not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
verses.text: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Messiah, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;

verses.raw: Having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
verses.text: Having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear to be in me.

verses.raw: If there be therefore any consolation in Messiah (Christ), if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
verses.text: If there be therefore any consolation in Messiah, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

verses.raw: Fulfil you my joy, that you be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
verses.text: Fulfil you my joy, that you be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

verses.raw: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verses.text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

verses.raw: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
verses.text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

verses.raw: Let this mind be in you, which was also in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
verses.text: Let this mind be in you, which was also in HaMashiach Yahusha:

verses.raw: Who, being in the form of Elohim (God), thought it not robbery to be equal with Elohim (God):
verses.text: Who, being in the form of Elohim, thought it not robbery to be equal with Elohim:

verses.raw: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
verses.text: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

verses.raw: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
verses.text: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

verses.raw: Wherefore Elohim (God) also has highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verses.text: Wherefore Elohim also has highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

verses.raw: That at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
verses.text: That at the name of Yahusha every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

verses.raw: And that every tongue should confess that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is the Lord, to the glory of Elohim (God) the Father.
verses.text: And that every tongue should confess that Yahusha HaMashiach is the Lord, to the glory of Elohim the Father.

verses.raw: Wherefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.text: Wherefore, my beloved, as you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

verses.raw: For it is Elohim (God) which works in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
verses.text: For it is Elohim which works in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

verses.raw: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
verses.text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

verses.raw: That you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of Elohim (God), without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom you shine as lights in the world;
verses.text: That you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of Elohim, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom you shine as lights in the world;

verses.raw: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Messiah (Christ), that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
verses.text: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Messiah, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

verses.raw: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
verses.text: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

verses.raw: For the same cause also do you joy, and rejoice with me.
verses.text: For the same cause also do you joy, and rejoice with me.

verses.raw: But I trust in Lord Yahusha (Jesus) to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
verses.text: But I trust in Lord Yahusha to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

verses.raw: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
verses.text: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

verses.raw: For all seek their own, not the things which are Yahusha HaMashiach's (Jesus Christ’s).
verses.text: For all seek their own, not the things which are Yahusha HaMashiach's (Jesus Christ’s).

verses.raw: But you know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he has served with me in the gospel.
verses.text: But you know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he has served with me in the gospel.

verses.raw: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
verses.text: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

verses.raw: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
verses.text: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

verses.raw: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
verses.text: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

verses.raw: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that you had heard that he had been sick.
verses.text: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that you had heard that he had been sick.

verses.raw: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but Elohim (God) had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.text: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but Elohim had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

verses.raw: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.text: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

verses.raw: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
verses.text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

verses.raw: Because for the work of Messiah (Christ) he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
verses.text: Because for the work of Messiah he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

verses.raw: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
verses.text: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

verses.raw: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
verses.text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.

verses.raw: For we are the circumcision, which worship Elohim (God) in the spirit, and rejoice in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), and have no confidence in the flesh.
verses.text: For we are the circumcision, which worship Elohim in the spirit, and rejoice in HaMashiach Yahusha, and have no confidence in the flesh.

verses.raw: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he has whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
verses.text: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he has whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

verses.raw: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Yashar'el (Israel), of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
verses.text: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Yashar'el, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;

verses.raw: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
verses.text: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.

verses.raw: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Messiah.

verses.raw: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Messiah (Christ),
verses.text: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of HaMashiach Yahusha my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Messiah,

verses.raw: And be found in him, not having my own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Messiah (Christ), the righteousness which is of Elohim (God) by faith:
verses.text: And be found in him, not having my own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Messiah, the righteousness which is of Elohim by faith:

verses.raw: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
verses.text: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;

verses.raw: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
verses.text: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

verses.raw: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
verses.text: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,

verses.raw: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of Elohim (God) in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of Elohim in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing you be otherwise minded, Elohim (God) shall reveal even this unto you.
verses.text: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing you be otherwise minded, Elohim shall reveal even this unto you.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
verses.text: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

verses.raw: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as you have us for an ensample.
verses.text: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as you have us for an ensample.

verses.raw: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Messiah (Christ):
verses.text: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Messiah:

verses.raw: Whose end is destruction, whose Elohim (God) is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
verses.text: Whose end is destruction, whose Elohim is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)

verses.raw: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, Lord Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
verses.text: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

verses.raw: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
verses.text: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.

verses.raw: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.text: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.

verses.raw: And I intreat you also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.text: And I intreat you also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.

verses.raw: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.
verses.text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

verses.raw: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.text: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.

verses.raw: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto Elohim.

verses.raw: And the peace of Elohim (God), which passes all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: And the peace of Elohim, which passes all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
verses.text: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

verses.raw: Those things, which you have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the Elohim (God) of peace shall be with you.
verses.text: Those things, which you have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the Elohim of peace shall be with you.

verses.raw: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me has flourished again; wherein you were also careful, but you lacked opportunity.
verses.text: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me has flourished again; wherein you were also careful, but you lacked opportunity.

verses.raw: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
verses.text: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.

verses.raw: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verses.text: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.

verses.raw: I can do all things through Messiah (Christ) which strengtheneth me.
verses.text: I can do all things through Messiah which strengtheneth me.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding you have well done, that you did communicate with my affliction.
verses.text: Notwithstanding you have well done, that you did communicate with my affliction.

verses.raw: Now you Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but you only.
verses.text: Now you Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but you only.

verses.raw: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again unto my necessity.
verses.text: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again unto my necessity.

verses.raw: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
verses.text: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.

verses.raw: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to Elohim (God).
verses.text: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to Elohim.

verses.raw: But my Elohim (God) shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: But my Elohim shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: Now unto Elohim (God) and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: Now unto Elohim and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: Salute every saint in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus). The brethren which are with me greet you.
verses.text: Salute every saint in HaMashiach Yahusha. The brethren which are with me greet you.

verses.raw: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar’s household.
verses.text: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar’s household.

verses.raw: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you all. Amen. It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with you all. Amen. It was written to the Philippians from Rome by Epaphroditus.

verses.raw: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) by the will of Elohim (God), and Timotheus our brother,
verses.text: Paul, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach by the will of Elohim, and Timotheus our brother,

verses.raw: To the saints and faithful brethren in Messiah (Christ) which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from Elohim (God) our Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: To the saints and faithful brethren in Messiah which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from Elohim our Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: We give thanks to Elohim (God) and the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), praying always for you,
verses.text: We give thanks to Elohim and the Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, praying always for you,

verses.raw: Since we heard of your faith in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), and of the love which you have to all the saints,
verses.text: Since we heard of your faith in HaMashiach Yahusha, and of the love which you have to all the saints,

verses.raw: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof you heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
verses.text: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof you heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;

verses.raw: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and brings forth fruit, as it does also in you, since the day you heard of it, and knew the grace of Elohim (God) in truth:
verses.text: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and brings forth fruit, as it does also in you, since the day you heard of it, and knew the grace of Elohim in truth:

verses.raw: As you also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Messiah (Christ);
verses.text: As you also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Messiah;

verses.raw: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
verses.text: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.

verses.raw: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that you might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
verses.text: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that you might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;

verses.raw: That you might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of Elohim (God);
verses.text: That you might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of Elohim;

verses.raw: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
verses.text: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;

verses.raw: Giving thanks unto the Father, which has made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
verses.text: Giving thanks unto the Father, which has made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:

verses.raw: Who has delivered us from the power of darkness, and has translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
verses.text: Who has delivered us from the power of darkness, and has translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:

verses.raw: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
verses.text: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:

verses.raw: Who is the image of the invisible Elohim (God), the firstborn of every creature:
verses.text: Who is the image of the invisible Elohim, the firstborn of every creature:

verses.raw: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
verses.text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

verses.raw: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
verses.text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

verses.raw: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verses.text: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

verses.raw: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
verses.text: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;

verses.raw: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
verses.text: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.

verses.raw: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now has he reconciled
verses.text: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now has he reconciled

verses.raw: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
verses.text: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:

verses.raw: If you continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which you have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
verses.text: If you continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which you have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

verses.raw: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Messiah (Christ) in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
verses.text: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Messiah in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:

verses.raw: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of Elohim (God) which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of Elohim (God);
verses.text: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of Elohim which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of Elohim;

verses.raw: Even the mystery which has been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
verses.text: Even the mystery which has been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:

verses.raw: To whom Elohim (God) would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Messiah (Christ) in you, the hope of glory:
verses.text: To whom Elohim would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Messiah in you, the hope of glory:

verses.raw: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus):
verses.text: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in HaMashiach Yahusha:

verses.raw: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
verses.text: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

verses.raw: For I would that you knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;
verses.text: For I would that you knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

verses.raw: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of Elohim (God), and of the Father, and of Messiah (Christ);
verses.text: That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of Elohim, and of the Father, and of Messiah;

verses.raw: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.
verses.text: In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge.

verses.raw: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.
verses.text: And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words.

verses.raw: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Messiah.

verses.raw: As you have therefore received HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) the Lord, so walk you in him:
verses.text: As you have therefore received HaMashiach Yahusha the Lord, so walk you in him:

verses.raw: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as you have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.
verses.text: Rooted and built up in him, and stablished in the faith, as you have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving.

verses.raw: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Messiah.

verses.raw: For in him dwells all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.
verses.text: For in him dwells all the fulness of the Godhead bodily.

verses.raw: And you are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:
verses.text: And you are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power:

verses.raw: In whom also you are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Messiah (Christ):
verses.text: In whom also you are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Messiah:

verses.raw: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also you are risen with him through the faith of the operation of Elohim (God), who has raised him from the dead.
verses.text: Buried with him in baptism, wherein also you are risen with him through the faith of the operation of Elohim, who has raised him from the dead.

verses.raw: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, has he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;
verses.text: And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, has he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses;

verses.raw: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;
verses.text: Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross;

verses.raw: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
verses.text: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

verses.raw: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:
verses.text: Let no man therefore judge you in meat, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days:

verses.raw: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Messiah.

verses.raw: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,
verses.text: Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

verses.raw: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increases with the increase of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increases with the increase of Elohim.

verses.raw: Wherefore if you be dead with Messiah (Christ) from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are you subject to ordinances,
verses.text: Wherefore if you be dead with Messiah from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are you subject to ordinances,

verses.raw: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;
verses.text: (Touch not; taste not; handle not;

verses.raw: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?
verses.text: Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men?

verses.raw: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.
verses.text: Which things have indeed a shew of wisdom in will worship, and humility, and neglecting of the body; not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.

verses.raw: If you then be risen with Messiah (Christ), seek those things which are above, where Messiah (Christ) sits on the right hand of Elohim (God).
verses.text: If you then be risen with Messiah, seek those things which are above, where Messiah sits on the right hand of Elohim.

verses.raw: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.text: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

verses.raw: For you are dead, and your life is hid with Messiah (Christ) in Elohim (God).
verses.text: For you are dead, and your life is hid with Messiah in Elohim.

verses.raw: When Messiah (Christ), who is our life, shall appear, then shall you also appear with him in glory.
verses.text: When Messiah, who is our life, shall appear, then shall you also appear with him in glory.

verses.raw: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
verses.text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

verses.raw: For which things’ sake the wrath of Elohim (God) comes on the children of disobedience:
verses.text: For which things’ sake the wrath of Elohim comes on the children of disobedience:

verses.raw: In the which you also walked some time, when you lived in them.
verses.text: In the which you also walked some time, when you lived in them.

verses.raw: But now you also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
verses.text: But now you also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.

verses.raw: Lie not one to another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his deeds;
verses.text: Lie not one to another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his deeds;

verses.raw: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
verses.text: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

verses.raw: Where there is neither Greek nor Yahudi (Jew), circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Messiah (Christ) is all, and in all.
verses.text: Where there is neither Greek nor Yahudi, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Messiah is all, and in all.

verses.raw: Put on therefore, as the elect of Elohim (God), holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.text: Put on therefore, as the elect of Elohim, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

verses.raw: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Messiah (Christ) forgave you, so also do you.
verses.text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Messiah forgave you, so also do you.

verses.raw: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
verses.text: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

verses.raw: And let the peace of Elohim (God) rule in your hearts, to the which also you are called in one body; and be you thankful.
verses.text: And let the peace of Elohim rule in your hearts, to the which also you are called in one body; and be you thankful.

verses.raw: Let the word of Messiah (Christ) dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.text: Let the word of Messiah dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

verses.raw: And what soever you do in word or deed, do all in the name of Lord Yahusha (Jesus), giving thanks to Elohim (God) and the Father by him.
verses.text: And what soever you do in word or deed, do all in the name of Lord Yahusha, giving thanks to Elohim and the Father by him.

verses.raw: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
verses.text: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

verses.raw: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
verses.text: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

verses.raw: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verses.text: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

verses.raw: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
verses.text: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

verses.raw: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing Elohim (God):
verses.text: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing Elohim:

verses.raw: And what soever you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.text: And what soever you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;

verses.raw: Knowing that of the Lord you shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for you serve the Lord Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Knowing that of the Lord you shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for you serve the Lord Messiah.

verses.raw: But he that does wrong shall receive for the wrong which he has done: and there is no respect of persons.
verses.text: But he that does wrong shall receive for the wrong which he has done: and there is no respect of persons.

verses.raw: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
verses.text: Masters, give unto your servants that which is just and equal; knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

verses.raw: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;
verses.text: Continue in prayer, and watch in the same with thanksgiving;

verses.raw: Withal praying also for us, that Elohim (God) would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Messiah (Christ), for which I am also in bonds:
verses.text: Withal praying also for us, that Elohim would open unto us a door of utterance, to speak the mystery of Messiah, for which I am also in bonds:

verses.raw: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.
verses.text: That I may make it manifest, as I ought to speak.

verses.raw: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
verses.text: Walk in wisdom toward them that are without, redeeming the time.
