verses.text: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.

verses.raw: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.text: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

verses.raw: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
verses.text: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

verses.raw: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of Elohim (God);
verses.text: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of Elohim;

verses.raw: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.text: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.

verses.raw: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
verses.text: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,

verses.raw: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.text: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

verses.raw: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.text: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.

verses.raw: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
verses.text: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.

verses.raw: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
verses.text: But you have fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,

verses.raw: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
verses.text: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.

verses.raw: Yea, and all that will live godly in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) shall suffer persecution.
verses.text: Yea, and all that will live godly in HaMashiach Yahusha shall suffer persecution.

verses.raw: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.text: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.

verses.raw: But continue you in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing of whom you have learned them;
verses.text: But continue you in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing of whom you have learned them;

verses.raw: And that from a child you have known the holy scriptures, which are able to make you wise unto salvation through faith which is in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: And that from a child you have known the holy scriptures, which are able to make you wise unto salvation through faith which is in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: All scripture is given by inspiration of Elohim (God), and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.text: All scripture is given by inspiration of Elohim, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:

verses.raw: That the man of Elohim (God) may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
verses.text: That the man of Elohim may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.

verses.raw: I charge you therefore before Elohim (God), and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.text: I charge you therefore before Elohim, and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;

verses.raw: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verses.text: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.

verses.raw: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.text: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;

verses.raw: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.text: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.

verses.raw: But watch you in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of your ministry.
verses.text: But watch you in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of your ministry.

verses.raw: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.text: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.

verses.raw: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.text: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:

verses.raw: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.text: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.

verses.raw: Do your diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.text: Do your diligence to come shortly unto me:

verses.raw: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.text: For Demas has forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.

verses.raw: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.text: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.

verses.raw: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.text: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.

verses.raw: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when you come, bring with you, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verses.text: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when you come, bring with you, and the books, but especially the parchments.

verses.raw: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: Yahuah (Lord) reward him according to his works:
verses.text: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: Yahuah reward him according to his works:

verses.raw: Of whom be you ware also; for he has greatly withstood our words.
verses.text: Of whom be you ware also; for he has greatly withstood our words.

verses.raw: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray Elohim (God) that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.text: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray Elohim that it may not be laid to their charge.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.text: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

verses.raw: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.text: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.

verses.raw: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.text: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.

verses.raw: Do your diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.text: Do your diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth you, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.

verses.raw: Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen. The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.
verses.text: Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen. The second epistle unto Timotheus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Ephesians, was written from Rome, when Paul was brought before Nero the second time.

verses.raw: Paul, a servant of Elohim (God), and an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), according to the faith of Elohim's (God’s) elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.text: Paul, a servant of Elohim, and an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach, according to the faith of Elohim's (God’s) elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

verses.raw: In hope of eternal life, which Elohim (God), that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
verses.text: In hope of eternal life, which Elohim, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;

verses.raw: But has in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of Elohim (God) our Saviour;
verses.text: But has in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of Elohim our Saviour;

verses.raw: To Titus, my own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from Elohim (God) the Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Saviour.
verses.text: To Titus, my own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from Elohim the Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach our Saviour.

verses.raw: For this cause left I you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed you:
verses.text: For this cause left I you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed you:

verses.raw: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.text: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

verses.raw: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of Elohim (God); not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.text: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of Elohim; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

verses.raw: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
verses.text: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;

verses.raw: Holding fast the faithful word as he has been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
verses.text: Holding fast the faithful word as he has been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.

verses.raw: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.text: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

verses.raw: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.
verses.text: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre’s sake.

verses.raw: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.text: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

verses.raw: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
verses.text: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

verses.raw: Not giving heed to Yahudi (Jewish) fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.text: Not giving heed to Yahudi fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

verses.raw: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.text: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

verses.raw: They profess that they know Elohim (God); but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
verses.text: They profess that they know Elohim; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.

verses.raw: But speak you the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.text: But speak you the things which become sound doctrine:

verses.raw: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.text: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.

verses.raw: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becomes holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.text: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becomes holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

verses.raw: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.text: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,

verses.raw: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of Elohim (God) be not blasphemed.
verses.text: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of Elohim be not blasphemed.

verses.raw: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.text: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.

verses.raw: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.text: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

verses.raw: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.text: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

verses.raw: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
verses.text: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;

verses.raw: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of Elohim (God) our Saviour in all things.
verses.text: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of Elohim our Saviour in all things.

verses.raw: For the grace of Elohim (God) that brings salvation has appeared to all men,
verses.text: For the grace of Elohim that brings salvation has appeared to all men,

verses.raw: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.text: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

verses.raw: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great Elohim (God) and our Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ);
verses.text: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great Elohim and our Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach;

verses.raw: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.text: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

verses.raw: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise you.
verses.text: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise you.

verses.raw: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.text: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

verses.raw: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.text: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

verses.raw: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.text: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

verses.raw: But after that the kindness and love of Elohim (God) our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.text: But after that the kindness and love of Elohim our Saviour toward man appeared,

verses.raw: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit);
verses.text: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Ruach HaKodesh;

verses.raw: Which he shed on us abundantly through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) our Saviour;
verses.text: Which he shed on us abundantly through Yahusha HaMashiach our Saviour;

verses.raw: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.text: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

verses.raw: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that you affirm constantly, that they which have believed in Elohim (God) might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.text: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that you affirm constantly, that they which have believed in Elohim might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

verses.raw: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.text: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

verses.raw: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.text: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

verses.raw: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sins, being condemned of himself.
verses.text: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sins, being condemned of himself.

verses.raw: When I shall send Artemas unto you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.text: When I shall send Artemas unto you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

verses.raw: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.text: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

verses.raw: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.text: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.

verses.raw: All that are with me salute you. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen. It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.
verses.text: All that are with me salute you. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen. It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.

verses.raw: Paul, a prisoner of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,
verses.text: Paul, a prisoner of Yahusha HaMashiach, and Timothy our brother, unto Philemon our dearly beloved, and fellowlabourer,

verses.raw: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in your house:
verses.text: And to our beloved Apphia, and Archippus our fellowsoldier, and to the church in your house:

verses.raw: Grace to you, and peace, from Elohim (God) our Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Grace to you, and peace, from Elohim our Father and Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: I thank my Elohim (God), making mention of you always in my prayers,
verses.text: I thank my Elohim, making mention of you always in my prayers,

verses.raw: Hearing of your love and faith, which you have toward Lord Yahusha (Jesus), and toward all saints;
verses.text: Hearing of your love and faith, which you have toward Lord Yahusha, and toward all saints;

verses.raw: That the communication of your faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus).
verses.text: That the communication of your faith may become effectual by the acknowledging of every good thing which is in you in HaMashiach Yahusha.

verses.raw: For we have great joy and consolation in your love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by you, brother.
verses.text: For we have great joy and consolation in your love, because the bowels of the saints are refreshed by you, brother.

verses.raw: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Messiah (Christ) to enjoin you that which is convenient,
verses.text: Wherefore, though I might be much bold in Messiah to enjoin you that which is convenient,

verses.raw: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech you, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: Yet for love’s sake I rather beseech you, being such an one as Paul the aged, and now also a prisoner of Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: I beseech you for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:
verses.text: I beseech you for my son Onesimus, whom I have begotten in my bonds:

verses.raw: Which in time past was to you unprofitable, but now profitable to you and to me:
verses.text: Which in time past was to you unprofitable, but now profitable to you and to me:

verses.raw: Whom I have sent again: you therefore receive him, that is, my own bowels:
verses.text: Whom I have sent again: you therefore receive him, that is, my own bowels:

verses.raw: Whom I would have retained with me, that in your stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:
verses.text: Whom I would have retained with me, that in your stead he might have ministered unto me in the bonds of the gospel:

verses.raw: But without your mind would I do nothing; that your benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.
verses.text: But without your mind would I do nothing; that your benefit should not be as it were of necessity, but willingly.

verses.raw: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that you should receive him for ever;
verses.text: For perhaps he therefore departed for a season, that you should receive him for ever;

verses.raw: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto you, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?
verses.text: Not now as a servant, but above a servant, a brother beloved, specially to me, but how much more unto you, both in the flesh, and in the Lord?

verses.raw: If you count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.
verses.text: If you count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

verses.raw: If he has wronged you, or owes you ought, put that on my account;
verses.text: If he has wronged you, or owes you ought, put that on my account;

verses.raw: I Paul have written it with my own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to you how you owest unto me even your own self besides.
verses.text: I Paul have written it with my own hand, I will repay it: albeit I do not say to you how you owest unto me even your own self besides.

verses.raw: Yea, brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.
verses.text: Yea, brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: refresh my bowels in the Lord.

verses.raw: Having confidence in your obedience I wrote unto you, knowing that you will also do more than I say.
verses.text: Having confidence in your obedience I wrote unto you, knowing that you will also do more than I say.

verses.raw: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
verses.text: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.

verses.raw: There salute you Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus);
verses.text: There salute you Epaphras, my fellowprisoner in HaMashiach Yahusha;

verses.raw: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.
verses.text: Marcus, Aristarchus, Demas, Lucas, my fellowlabourers.

verses.raw: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with your spirit. Amen. Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus, a servant.
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with your spirit. Amen. Written from Rome to Philemon, by Onesimus, a servant.

verses.raw: Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
verses.text: Elohim, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

verses.raw: Has in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
verses.text: Has in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

verses.raw: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
verses.text: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

verses.raw: Being made so much better than the angels, as he has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.text: Being made so much better than the angels, as he has by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.

verses.raw: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, You are my Son, this day have I begotten you? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
verses.text: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, You are my Son, this day have I begotten you? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?

verses.raw: And again, when he brings in the firstbegotten into the world, he says, And let all the angels of Elohim (God) worship him.
verses.text: And again, when he brings in the firstbegotten into the world, he says, And let all the angels of Elohim worship him.

verses.raw: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
verses.text: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

verses.raw: But unto the Son he says, Your throne, O Elohim (God), is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of your kingdom.
verses.text: But unto the Son he says, Your throne, O Elohim, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of your kingdom.

verses.raw: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore Elohim (God), even your Elohim (God), has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
verses.text: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore Elohim, even your Elohim, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

verses.raw: And, You, Yahuah (Lord), in the beginning have laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of your hands:
verses.text: And, You, Yahuah, in the beginning have laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of your hands:

verses.raw: They shall perish; but you remainest; and they all shall wax old as does a garment;
verses.text: They shall perish; but you remainest; and they all shall wax old as does a garment;

verses.raw: And as a vesture shall you fold them up, and they shall be changed: but you are the same, and your years shall not fail.
verses.text: And as a vesture shall you fold them up, and they shall be changed: but you are the same, and your years shall not fail.

verses.raw: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool?
verses.text: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool?

verses.raw: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
verses.text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

verses.raw: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
verses.text: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.

verses.raw: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.text: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

verses.raw: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
verses.text: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Lord, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;

verses.raw: Elohim (God) also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), according to his own will?
verses.text: Elohim also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Ruach HaKodesh, according to his own will?

verses.raw: For unto the angels has he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.text: For unto the angels has he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.

verses.raw: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that you are mindful of him? or the son of Adam, that you visit him?
verses.text: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that you are mindful of him? or the son of Adam, that you visit him?

verses.raw: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crownedst him with glory and honour, and did set him over the works of your hands:
verses.text: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crownedst him with glory and honour, and did set him over the works of your hands:

verses.raw: You have put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.text: You have put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.

verses.raw: But we see Yahusha (Jesus), who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of Elohim (God) should taste death for every man.
verses.text: But we see Yahusha, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of Elohim should taste death for every man.

verses.raw: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.text: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

verses.raw: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.text: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,

verses.raw: Saying, I will declare your name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto you.
verses.text: Saying, I will declare your name unto my brethren, in the midst of the church will I sing praise unto you.

verses.raw: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which Elohim (God) has given me.
verses.text: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which Elohim has given me.

verses.raw: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.text: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

verses.raw: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.text: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

verses.raw: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
verses.text: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.

verses.raw: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to Elohim (God), to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
verses.text: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to Elohim, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.

verses.raw: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
verses.text: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.

verses.raw: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus);
verses.text: Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, HaMashiach Yahusha;

verses.raw: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.
verses.text: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Moses was faithful in all his house.

verses.raw: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who has builded the house has more honour than the house.
verses.text: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who has builded the house has more honour than the house.

verses.raw: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is Elohim (God).
verses.text: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is Elohim.

verses.raw: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.text: And Moses verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;

verses.raw: But Messiah (Christ) as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.text: But Messiah as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.

verses.raw: Wherefore (as the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) says, To day if you will hear his voice,
verses.text: Wherefore (as the Ruach HaKodesh says, To day if you will hear his voice,

verses.raw: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
verses.text: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

verses.raw: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.text: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.

verses.raw: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.text: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.

verses.raw: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
verses.text: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

verses.raw: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living Elohim.

verses.raw: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.text: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.

verses.raw: For we are made partakers of Messiah (Christ), if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.text: For we are made partakers of Messiah, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;

verses.raw: While it is said, To day if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.text: While it is said, To day if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.

verses.raw: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.
verses.text: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Egypt by Moses.

verses.raw: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.text: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?

verses.raw: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.text: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

verses.raw: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.text: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.

verses.raw: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.text: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.

verses.raw: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
verses.text: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.

verses.raw: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.text: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

verses.raw: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And Elohim (God) did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.text: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And Elohim did rest the seventh day from all his works.

verses.raw: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.text: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

verses.raw: Seeing therefore it remains that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
verses.text: Seeing therefore it remains that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:

verses.raw: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.text: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in David, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if you will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.

verses.raw: For if Yahusha (Jesus) had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.text: For if Yahusha had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

verses.raw: There remains therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God).
verses.text: There remains therefore a rest to the people of Elohim.

verses.raw: For he that is entered into his rest, he also has ceased from his own works, as Elohim (God) did from his.
verses.text: For he that is entered into his rest, he also has ceased from his own works, as Elohim did from his.

verses.raw: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
verses.text: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.

verses.raw: For the word of Elohim (God) is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.text: For the word of Elohim is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

verses.raw: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

verses.raw: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Yahusha (Jesus) the Son of Elohim (God), let us hold fast our profession.
verses.text: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Yahusha the Son of Elohim, let us hold fast our profession.

verses.raw: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verses.text: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.

verses.raw: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

verses.raw: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to Elohim (God), that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.text: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to Elohim, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:

verses.raw: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
verses.text: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.

verses.raw: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.text: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.

verses.raw: And no man takes this honour unto himself, but he that is called of Elohim (God), as was Aaron.
verses.text: And no man takes this honour unto himself, but he that is called of Elohim, as was Aaron.

verses.raw: So also Messiah (Christ) glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, You are my Son, to day have I begotten you.
verses.text: So also Messiah glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, You are my Son, to day have I begotten you.

verses.raw: As he says also in another place, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).
verses.text: As he says also in another place, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq.

verses.raw: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
verses.text: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;

verses.raw: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.text: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;

verses.raw: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
verses.text: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;

verses.raw: Called of Elohim (God) an high priest after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).
verses.text: Called of Elohim an high priest after the order of Melek Tsadiq.

verses.raw: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing you are dull of hearing.
verses.text: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing you are dull of hearing.

verses.raw: For when for the time you ought to be teachers, you have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of Elohim (God); and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.text: For when for the time you ought to be teachers, you have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of Elohim; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.

verses.raw: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
verses.text: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.

verses.raw: But strong meat belongs to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
verses.text: But strong meat belongs to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.

verses.raw: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Messiah (Christ), let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward Elohim (God),
verses.text: Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Messiah, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward Elohim,

verses.raw: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.text: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

verses.raw: And this will we do, if Elohim (God) permit.
verses.text: And this will we do, if Elohim permit.

verses.raw: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit),
verses.text: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Ruach HaKodesh,

verses.raw: And have tasted the good word of Elohim (God), and the powers of the world to come,
verses.text: And have tasted the good word of Elohim, and the powers of the world to come,

verses.raw: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of Elohim (God) afresh, and put him to an open shame.
verses.text: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of Elohim afresh, and put him to an open shame.

verses.raw: For the earth which drinks in the rain that comes oft upon it, and brings forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receives blessing from Elohim (God):
verses.text: For the earth which drinks in the rain that comes oft upon it, and brings forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receives blessing from Elohim:

verses.raw: But that which bears thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
verses.text: But that which bears thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.

verses.raw: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
verses.text: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which you have shewed toward his name, in that you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.text: For Elohim is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which you have shewed toward his name, in that you have ministered to the saints, and do minister.

verses.raw: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
verses.text: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:

verses.raw: That you be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.text: That you be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.

verses.raw: For when Elohim (God) made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
verses.text: For when Elohim made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,

verses.raw: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.
verses.text: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.

verses.raw: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.text: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

verses.raw: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
verses.text: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.

verses.raw: Where in Elohim (God), willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
verses.text: Where in Elohim, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:

verses.raw: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for Elohim (God) to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
verses.text: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for Elohim to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

verses.raw: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which enters into that within the veil;
verses.text: Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which enters into that within the veil;

verses.raw: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Yahusha (Jesus), made an high priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).
verses.text: Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Yahusha, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq.

verses.raw: For this Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek), king of Salem, priest of the El Elyon (most high God), who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.text: For this Melek Tsadiq, king of Salem, priest of the El Elyon (most high God), who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;

verses.raw: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.text: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;

verses.raw: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of Elohim (God); abides a priest continually.
verses.text: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of Elohim; abides a priest continually.

verses.raw: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.text: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.

verses.raw: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.text: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:

verses.raw: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
verses.text: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.

verses.raw: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.text: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.

verses.raw: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receives them, of whom it is witnessed that he lives.
verses.text: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receives them, of whom it is witnessed that he lives.

verses.raw: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receives tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.text: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receives tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.

verses.raw: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek) met him.
verses.text: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melek Tsadiq met him.

verses.raw: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek), and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.text: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melek Tsadiq, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

verses.raw: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.text: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

verses.raw: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.text: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.

verses.raw: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.text: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

verses.raw: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek) there arises another priest,
verses.text: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melek Tsadiq there arises another priest,

verses.raw: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.text: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.

verses.raw: For he testifieth, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).
verses.text: For he testifieth, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq.

verses.raw: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.text: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.

verses.raw: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto Elohim.

verses.raw: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
verses.text: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:

verses.raw: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, Yahuah (Lord) sware and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek):)
verses.text: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, Yahuah sware and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq:)

verses.raw: By so much was Yahusha (Jesus) made a surety of a better testament.
verses.text: By so much was Yahusha made a surety of a better testament.

verses.raw: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.text: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:

verses.raw: But this man, because he continues ever, has an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.text: But this man, because he continues ever, has an unchangeable priesthood.

verses.raw: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever lives to make intercession for them.
verses.text: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim by him, seeing he ever lives to make intercession for them.

verses.raw: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
verses.text: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

verses.raw: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
verses.text: Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people’s: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.

verses.raw: For the law makes men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, makes the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
verses.text: For the law makes men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, makes the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.

verses.raw: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
verses.text: Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;

verses.raw: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.
verses.text: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, and not man.

verses.raw: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
verses.text: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.

verses.raw: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
verses.text: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

verses.raw: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of Elohim (God) when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, says he, that you make all things according to the pattern shewed to you in the mount.
verses.text: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Moses was admonished of Elohim when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, says he, that you make all things according to the pattern shewed to you in the mount.

verses.raw: But now has he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
verses.text: But now has he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

verses.raw: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
verses.text: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

verses.raw: For finding fault with them, he says, Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (Lord), when I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and with the house of Yahudah (Judah):
verses.text: For finding fault with them, he says, Behold, the days come, says Yahuah, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Yashar'el and with the house of Yahudah:

verses.raw: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, says Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el (Israel) after those days, says Yahuah (Lord); I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a Elohim (God), and they shall be to me a people:
verses.text: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Yashar'el after those days, says Yahuah; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a Elohim, and they shall be to me a people:

verses.raw: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know Yahuah (Lord): for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
verses.text: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know Yahuah: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.

verses.raw: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.text: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.

verses.raw: In that he says, A new covenant, he has made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
verses.text: In that he says, A new covenant, he has made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.

verses.raw: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
verses.text: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.

verses.raw: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
verses.text: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
verses.text: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

verses.raw: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.text: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

verses.raw: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we can not now speak particularly.
verses.text: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we can not now speak particularly.

verses.raw: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of Elohim.

verses.raw: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
verses.text: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:

verses.raw: The Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
verses.text: The Ruach HaKodesh this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:

verses.raw: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
verses.text: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;

verses.raw: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
verses.text: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.

verses.raw: But Messiah (Christ) being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
verses.text: But Messiah being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;

verses.raw: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verses.text: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.

verses.raw: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
verses.text: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

verses.raw: How much more shall the blood of Messiah (Christ), who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to Elohim (God), purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living Elohim (God)?
verses.text: How much more shall the blood of Messiah, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to Elohim, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living Elohim?

verses.raw: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
verses.text: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.

verses.raw: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
verses.text: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.

verses.raw: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator lives.
verses.text: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator lives.

verses.raw: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
verses.text: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.

verses.raw: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
verses.text: For when Moses had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,

verses.raw: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which Elohim (God) has enjoined unto you.
verses.text: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which Elohim has enjoined unto you.

verses.raw: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.text: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.

verses.raw: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
verses.text: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

verses.raw: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.text: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

verses.raw: For Messiah (Christ) is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of Elohim (God) for us:
verses.text: For Messiah is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of Elohim for us:

verses.raw: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.text: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place every year with blood of others;

verses.raw: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world has he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.text: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world has he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

verses.raw: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
verses.text: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

verses.raw: So Messiah (Christ) was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.
verses.text: So Messiah was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

verses.raw: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.text: For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.

verses.raw: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
verses.text: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.

verses.raw: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
verses.text: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.

verses.raw: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.text: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.

verses.raw: Wherefore when he comes into the world, he says, Sacrifice and offering you would not, but a body have you prepared me:
verses.text: Wherefore when he comes into the world, he says, Sacrifice and offering you would not, but a body have you prepared me:

verses.raw: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you have had no pleasure.
verses.text: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you have had no pleasure.

verses.raw: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do your will, O Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do your will, O Elohim.

verses.raw: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin you would not, neither had pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
verses.text: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin you would not, neither had pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;

verses.raw: Then said he, Lo, I come to do your will, O Elohim (God). He takes away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.text: Then said he, Lo, I come to do your will, O Elohim. He takes away the first, that he may establish the second.

verses.raw: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) once for all.
verses.text: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Yahusha HaMashiach once for all.

verses.raw: And every priest stands daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.text: And every priest stands daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

verses.raw: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of Elohim (God);
verses.text: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of Elohim;

verses.raw: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.text: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.

verses.raw: For by one offering he has perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.text: For by one offering he has perfected for ever them that are sanctified.

verses.raw: Whereof the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
verses.text: Whereof the Ruach HaKodesh also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,

verses.raw: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says Yahuah (Lord), I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.text: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, says Yahuah, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;

verses.raw: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.text: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.

verses.raw: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.text: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

verses.raw: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Yahusha (Jesus),
verses.text: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Yahusha,

verses.raw: By a new and living way, which he has consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.text: By a new and living way, which he has consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

verses.raw: And having an high priest over the house of Elohim (God);
verses.text: And having an high priest over the house of Elohim;
