verses.raw: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.text: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.

verses.raw: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verses.text: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)

verses.raw: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.text: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:

verses.raw: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as you see the day approaching.
verses.text: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as you see the day approaching.

verses.raw: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.text: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more sacrifice for sins,

verses.raw: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.text: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.

verses.raw: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.text: He that despised Moses’ law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:

verses.raw: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose you, shall he be thought worthy, who has trodden under foot the Son of Elohim (God), and has counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and has done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.text: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose you, shall he be thought worthy, who has trodden under foot the Son of Elohim, and has counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and has done despite unto the Spirit of grace?

verses.raw: For we know him that has said, Vengeance belongs unto me, I will recompense, says Yahuah (Lord). And again, Yahuah (Lord) shall judge his people.
verses.text: For we know him that has said, Vengeance belongs unto me, I will recompense, says Yahuah. And again, Yahuah shall judge his people.

verses.raw: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living Elohim (God).
verses.text: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living Elohim.

verses.raw: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after you were illuminated, you endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.text: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after you were illuminated, you endured a great fight of afflictions;

verses.raw: Partly, whilst you were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst you became companions of them that were so used.
verses.text: Partly, whilst you were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst you became companions of them that were so used.

verses.raw: For you had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that you have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.
verses.text: For you had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that you have in heaven a better and an enduring substance.

verses.raw: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which has great recompence of reward.
verses.text: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which has great recompence of reward.

verses.raw: For you have need of patience, that, after you have done the will of Elohim (God), you might receive the promise.
verses.text: For you have need of patience, that, after you have done the will of Elohim, you might receive the promise.

verses.raw: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
verses.text: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.

verses.raw: Now the righteous shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
verses.text: Now the righteous shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.

verses.raw: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
verses.text: But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.

verses.raw: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.text: Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.

verses.raw: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
verses.text: For by it the elders obtained a good report.

verses.raw: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verses.text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

verses.raw: By faith Abel offered unto Elohim (God) a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, Elohim (God) testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.
verses.text: By faith Abel offered unto Elohim a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, Elohim testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.

verses.raw: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim (God) had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim (God).
verses.text: By faith Enoch was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because Elohim had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased Elohim.

verses.raw: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that comes to Elohim (God) must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.text: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that comes to Elohim must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.

verses.raw: By faith Noah, being warned of Elohim (God) of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verses.text: By faith Noah, being warned of Elohim of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.

verses.raw: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.text: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.

verses.raw: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.text: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise:

verses.raw: For he looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is Elohim (God).
verses.text: For he looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is Elohim.

verses.raw: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
verses.text: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.

verses.raw: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
verses.text: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.

verses.raw: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.text: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

verses.raw: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
verses.text: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.

verses.raw: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
verses.text: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

verses.raw: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore Elohim (God) is not ashamed to be called their Elohim (God): for he has prepared for them a city.
verses.text: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore Elohim is not ashamed to be called their Elohim: for he has prepared for them a city.

verses.raw: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
verses.text: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Isaac: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,

verses.raw: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall your seed be called:
verses.text: Of whom it was said, That in Isaac shall your seed be called:

verses.raw: Accounting that Elohim (God) was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
verses.text: Accounting that Elohim was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.

verses.raw: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.text: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau concerning things to come.

verses.raw: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
verses.text: By faith Jacob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Joseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.

verses.raw: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Yashar'el (Israel); and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.text: By faith Joseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Yashar'el; and gave commandment concerning his bones.

verses.raw: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.
verses.text: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

verses.raw: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;
verses.text: By faith Moses, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter;

verses.raw: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of Elohim (God), than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.text: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of Elohim, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;

verses.raw: Esteeming the reproach of Messiah (Christ) greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verses.text: Esteeming the reproach of Messiah greater riches than the treasures in Egypt: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.

verses.raw: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.text: By faith he forsook Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

verses.raw: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.text: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.

verses.raw: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.
verses.text: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Egyptians assaying to do were drowned.

verses.raw: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
verses.text: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.

verses.raw: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
verses.text: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.

verses.raw: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:
verses.text: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of David also, and Samuel, and of the prophets:

verses.raw: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.text: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

verses.raw: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.text: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.

verses.raw: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.text: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

verses.raw: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.text: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:

verses.raw: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
verses.text: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;

verses.raw: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
verses.text: (Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.

verses.raw: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
verses.text: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

verses.raw: Elohim (God) having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.
verses.text: Elohim having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

verses.raw: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which does so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.text: Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which does so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

verses.raw: Looking unto Yahusha (Jesus) the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Looking unto Yahusha the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of Elohim.

verses.raw: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest you be wearied and faint in your minds.
verses.text: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest you be wearied and faint in your minds.

verses.raw: You have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
verses.text: You have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.

verses.raw: And you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks unto you as unto children, My son, despise not you the chastening of Yahuah (Lord), nor faint when you are rebuked of him:
verses.text: And you have forgotten the exhortation which speaks unto you as unto children, My son, despise not you the chastening of Yahuah, nor faint when you are rebuked of him:

verses.raw: For whom Yahuah (Lord) loves he chastens, and scourgeth every son whom he receives.
verses.text: For whom Yahuah loves he chastens, and scourgeth every son whom he receives.

verses.raw: If you endure chastening, Elohim (God) deals with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chastens not?
verses.text: If you endure chastening, Elohim deals with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chastens not?

verses.raw: But if you be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are you bastards, and not sons.
verses.text: But if you be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are you bastards, and not sons.

verses.raw: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.text: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

verses.raw: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
verses.text: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.

verses.raw: Now no chastening for the present seems to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
verses.text: Now no chastening for the present seems to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.

verses.raw: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
verses.text: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;

verses.raw: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
verses.text: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.

verses.raw: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:
verses.text: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Lord:

verses.raw: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of Elohim (God); lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
verses.text: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of Elohim; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;

verses.raw: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
verses.text: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.

verses.raw: For you know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
verses.text: For you know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.

verses.raw: For you are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.text: For you are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

verses.raw: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
verses.text: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:

verses.raw: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
verses.text: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:

verses.raw: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
verses.text: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

verses.raw: But you are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living Elohim (God), the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,
verses.text: But you are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living Elohim, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,

verses.raw: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to Elohim (God) the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.text: To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to Elohim the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

verses.raw: And to Yahusha (Jesus) the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaks better things than that of Abel.
verses.text: And to Yahusha the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaks better things than that of Abel.

verses.raw: See that you refuse not him that speaks. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaks from heaven:
verses.text: See that you refuse not him that speaks. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaks from heaven:

verses.raw: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he has promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
verses.text: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he has promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.

verses.raw: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.text: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

verses.raw: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve Elohim (God) acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verses.text: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve Elohim acceptably with reverence and godly fear:

verses.raw: For our Elohim (God) is a consuming fire.
verses.text: For our Elohim is a consuming fire.

verses.raw: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.text: Let brotherly love continue.

verses.raw: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.text: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

verses.raw: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.text: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.

verses.raw: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers Elohim (God) will judge.
verses.text: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers Elohim will judge.

verses.raw: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as you have: for he has said, I will never leave you, nor forsake you.
verses.text: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as you have: for he has said, I will never leave you, nor forsake you.

verses.raw: So that we may boldly say, Yahuah (Lord) is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.text: So that we may boldly say, Yahuah is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.

verses.raw: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of Elohim (God): whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
verses.text: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of Elohim: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.

verses.raw: Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.text: Yahusha HaMashiach the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

verses.raw: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
verses.text: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.

verses.raw: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
verses.text: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.

verses.raw: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.text: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.

verses.raw: Wherefore Yahusha (Jesus) also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.text: Wherefore Yahusha also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.

verses.raw: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.text: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

verses.raw: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
verses.text: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.

verses.raw: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to Elohim (God) continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
verses.text: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to Elohim continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

verses.raw: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices Elohim (God) is well pleased.
verses.text: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices Elohim is well pleased.

verses.raw: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
verses.text: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.

verses.raw: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
verses.text: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.

verses.raw: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.text: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

verses.raw: Now the Elohim (God) of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Yahusha (Jesus), that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
verses.text: Now the Elohim of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Yahusha, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,

verses.raw: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ); to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Yahusha HaMashiach; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
verses.text: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.

verses.raw: Know you that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.text: Know you that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

verses.raw: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.text: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

verses.raw: Grace be with you all. Amen. Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.
verses.text: Grace be with you all. Amen. Written to the Hebrews from Italy by Timothy.

verses.raw: James, a servant of Elohim (God) and of Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.
verses.text: James, a servant of Elohim and of Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, to the twelve tribes which are scattered abroad, greeting.

verses.raw: My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into divers temptations;
verses.text: My brethren, count it all joy when you fall into divers temptations;

verses.raw: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith works patience.
verses.text: Knowing this, that the trying of your faith works patience.

verses.raw: But let patience have her perfect work, that you may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.
verses.text: But let patience have her perfect work, that you may be perfect and entire, wanting nothing.

verses.raw: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of Elohim (God), that gives to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
verses.text: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of Elohim, that gives to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

verses.raw: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.
verses.text: But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed.

verses.raw: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.
verses.text: For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord.

verses.raw: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.
verses.text: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

verses.raw: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:
verses.text: Let the brother of low degree rejoice in that he is exalted:

verses.raw: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.
verses.text: But the rich, in that he is made low: because as the flower of the grass he shall pass away.

verses.raw: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falls, and the grace of the fashion of it perishes: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.
verses.text: For the sun is no sooner risen with a burning heat, but it withereth the grass, and the flower thereof falls, and the grace of the fashion of it perishes: so also shall the rich man fade away in his ways.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.
verses.text: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.

verses.raw: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of Elohim (God): for Elohim (God) cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:
verses.text: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted of Elohim: for Elohim cannot be tempted with evil, neither tempteth he any man:

verses.raw: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.
verses.text: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

verses.raw: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.
verses.text: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.

verses.raw: Do not err, my beloved brethren.
verses.text: Do not err, my beloved brethren.

verses.raw: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.
verses.text: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, and comes down from the Father of lights, with whom is no variableness, neither shadow of turning.

verses.raw: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.
verses.text: Of his own will begat he us with the word of truth, that we should be a kind of firstfruits of his creatures.

verses.raw: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:
verses.text: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

verses.raw: For the wrath of man works not the righteousness of Elohim (God).
verses.text: For the wrath of man works not the righteousness of Elohim.

verses.raw: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.
verses.text: Wherefore lay apart all filthiness and superfluity of naughtiness, and receive with meekness the engrafted word, which is able to save your souls.

verses.raw: But be you doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
verses.text: But be you doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

verses.raw: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:
verses.text: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

verses.raw: For he beholds himself, and goes his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.
verses.text: For he beholds himself, and goes his way, and straightway forgetteth what manner of man he was.

verses.raw: But whoso looks into the perfect law of liberty, and continues therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.
verses.text: But whoso looks into the perfect law of liberty, and continues therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

verses.raw: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.
verses.text: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.

verses.raw: Pure religion and undefiled before Elohim (God) and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.
verses.text: Pure religion and undefiled before Elohim and the Father is this, To visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep himself unspotted from the world.

verses.raw: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.
verses.text: My brethren, have not the faith of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, the Lord of glory, with respect of persons.

verses.raw: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;
verses.text: For if there come unto your assembly a man with a gold ring, in goodly apparel, and there come in also a poor man in vile raiment;

verses.raw: And you have respect to him that wears the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit you here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand you there, or sit here under my footstool:
verses.text: And you have respect to him that wears the gay clothing, and say unto him, Sit you here in a good place; and say to the poor, Stand you there, or sit here under my footstool:

verses.raw: Are you not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?
verses.text: Are you not then partial in yourselves, and are become judges of evil thoughts?

verses.raw: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Has not Elohim (God) chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he has promised to them that love him?
verses.text: Hearken, my beloved brethren, Has not Elohim chosen the poor of this world rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which he has promised to them that love him?

verses.raw: But you have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?
verses.text: But you have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?

verses.raw: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which you are called?
verses.text: Do not they blaspheme that worthy name by the which you are called?

verses.raw: If you fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, You shall love your neighbour as thyself, you do well:
verses.text: If you fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, You shall love your neighbour as thyself, you do well:

verses.raw: But if you have respect to persons, you commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.
verses.text: But if you have respect to persons, you commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.

verses.raw: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.
verses.text: For whosoever shall keep the whole law, and yet offend in one point, he is guilty of all.

verses.raw: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if you commit no adultery, yet if you kill, you are become a transgressor of the law.
verses.text: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if you commit no adultery, yet if you kill, you are become a transgressor of the law.

verses.raw: So speak you, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.
verses.text: So speak you, and so do, as they that shall be judged by the law of liberty.

verses.raw: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that has shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoices against judgment.
verses.text: For he shall have judgment without mercy, that has shewed no mercy; and mercy rejoices against judgment.

verses.raw: What does it profit, my brethren, though a man say he has faith, and have not works? can faith save him?
verses.text: What does it profit, my brethren, though a man say he has faith, and have not works? can faith save him?

verses.raw: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,
verses.text: If a brother or sister be naked, and destitute of daily food,

verses.raw: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be you warmed and filled; notwithstanding you give them not those things which are needful to the body; what does it profit?
verses.text: And one of you say unto them, Depart in peace, be you warmed and filled; notwithstanding you give them not those things which are needful to the body; what does it profit?

verses.raw: Even so faith, if it has not works, is dead, being alone.
verses.text: Even so faith, if it has not works, is dead, being alone.

verses.raw: Yea, a man may say, You have faith, and I have works: shew me your faith without your works, and I will shew you my faith by my works.
verses.text: Yea, a man may say, You have faith, and I have works: shew me your faith without your works, and I will shew you my faith by my works.

verses.raw: You believe that there is one Elohim (God); you do well: the devils also believe, and tremble.
verses.text: You believe that there is one Elohim; you do well: the devils also believe, and tremble.

verses.raw: But will you know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?
verses.text: But will you know, O vain man, that faith without works is dead?

verses.raw: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?
verses.text: Was not Abraham our father justified by works, when he had offered Isaac his son upon the altar?

verses.raw: See you how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?
verses.text: See you how faith wrought with his works, and by works was faith made perfect?

verses.raw: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed Elohim, and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of Elohim.

verses.raw: You see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.
verses.text: You see then how that by works a man is justified, and not by faith only.

verses.raw: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?
verses.text: Likewise also was not Rahab the harlot justified by works, when she had received the messengers, and had sent them out another way?

verses.raw: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.
verses.text: For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also.

verses.raw: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.
verses.text: My brethren, be not many masters, knowing that we shall receive the greater condemnation.

verses.raw: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.
verses.text: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.

verses.raw: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.
verses.text: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

verses.raw: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.
verses.text: Behold also the ships, which though they be so great, and are driven of fierce winds, yet are they turned about with a very small helm, whithersoever the governor listeth.

verses.raw: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!
verses.text: Even so the tongue is a little member, and boasteth great things. Behold, how great a matter a little fire kindleth!

verses.raw: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.
verses.text: And the tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity: so is the tongue among our members, that it defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature; and it is set on fire of hell.

verses.raw: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed of mankind:
verses.text: For every kind of beasts, and of birds, and of serpents, and of things in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed of mankind:

verses.raw: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
verses.text: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.

verses.raw: Therewith bless we Elohim (God), even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Therewith bless we Elohim, even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of Elohim.

verses.raw: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verses.text: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

verses.raw: Does a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?
verses.text: Does a fountain send forth at the same place sweet water and bitter?

verses.raw: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.
verses.text: Can the fig tree, my brethren, bear olive berries? either a vine, figs? so can no fountain both yield salt water and fresh.

verses.raw: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
verses.text: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.

verses.raw: But if you have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.
verses.text: But if you have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

verses.raw: This wisdom descends not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.
verses.text: This wisdom descends not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

verses.raw: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.
verses.text: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.

verses.raw: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
verses.text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

verses.raw: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.
verses.text: And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.

verses.raw: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?
verses.text: From whence come wars and fightings among you? come they not hence, even of your lusts that war in your members?

verses.raw: You lust, and have not: you kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: you fight and war, yet you have not, because you ask not.
verses.text: You lust, and have not: you kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: you fight and war, yet you have not, because you ask not.

verses.raw: You ask, and receive not, because you ask amiss, that you may consume it upon your lusts.
verses.text: You ask, and receive not, because you ask amiss, that you may consume it upon your lusts.

verses.raw: You adulterers and adulteresses, know you not that the friendship of the world is enmity with Elohim (God)? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of Elohim (God).
verses.text: You adulterers and adulteresses, know you not that the friendship of the world is enmity with Elohim? whosoever therefore will be a friend of the world is the enemy of Elohim.

verses.raw: Do you think that the scripture says in vain, The spirit that dwells in us lusteth to envy?
verses.text: Do you think that the scripture says in vain, The spirit that dwells in us lusteth to envy?

verses.raw: But he gives more grace. Wherefore he says, Elohim (God) resisteth the proud, but gives grace unto the humble.
verses.text: But he gives more grace. Wherefore he says, Elohim resisteth the proud, but gives grace unto the humble.

verses.raw: Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
verses.text: Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

verses.raw: Draw nigh to Elohim (God), and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double minded.
verses.text: Draw nigh to Elohim, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double minded.

verses.raw: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.
verses.text: Be afflicted, and mourn, and weep: let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to heaviness.

verses.raw: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.
verses.text: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he shall lift you up.

verses.raw: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaks evil of his brother, and judges his brother, speaks evil of the law, and judges the law: but if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.
verses.text: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaks evil of his brother, and judges his brother, speaks evil of the law, and judges the law: but if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

verses.raw: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who are you that judge another?
verses.text: There is one lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy: who are you that judge another?

verses.raw: Go to now, you that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:
verses.text: Go to now, you that say, To day or to morrow we will go into such a city, and continue there a year, and buy and sell, and get gain:

verses.raw: Whereas you know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.
verses.text: Whereas you know not what shall be on the morrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.

verses.raw: For that you ought to say, If Yahuah (Lord) will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
verses.text: For that you ought to say, If Yahuah will, we shall live, and do this, or that.

verses.raw: But now you rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.
verses.text: But now you rejoice in your boastings: all such rejoicing is evil.

verses.raw: Therefore to him that knows to do good, and does it not, to him it is sin.
verses.text: Therefore to him that knows to do good, and does it not, to him it is sin.

verses.raw: Go to now, you rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
verses.text: Go to now, you rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.

verses.raw: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
verses.text: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.

verses.raw: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. You have heaped treasure together for the last days.
verses.text: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. You have heaped treasure together for the last days.

verses.raw: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, cries: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.
verses.text: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, cries: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah of sabaoth.

verses.raw: You have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; you have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
verses.text: You have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; you have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.

verses.raw: You have condemned and killed the just; and he does not resist you.
verses.text: You have condemned and killed the just; and he does not resist you.

verses.raw: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waits for the precious fruit of the earth, and has long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verses.text: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waits for the precious fruit of the earth, and has long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

verses.raw: Be you also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draws nigh.
verses.text: Be you also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draws nigh.

verses.raw: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest you be condemned: behold, the judge stands before the door.
verses.text: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest you be condemned: behold, the judge stands before the door.

verses.raw: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of Yahuah (Lord), for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
verses.text: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of Yahuah, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.

verses.raw: Behold, we count them happy which endure. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of Yahuah (Lord); that Yahuah (Lord) is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
verses.text: Behold, we count them happy which endure. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of Yahuah; that Yahuah is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.

verses.raw: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest you fall into condemnation.
verses.text: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest you fall into condemnation.

verses.raw: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
verses.text: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.

verses.raw: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.text: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:

verses.raw: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
verses.text: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

verses.raw: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that you may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that you may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

verses.raw: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verses.text: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.

verses.raw: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.text: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.

verses.raw: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.text: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;

verses.raw: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
verses.text: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.

verses.raw: Peter, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.text: Peter, an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

verses.raw: Elect according to the foreknowledge of Elohim (God) the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ): Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
verses.text: Elect according to the foreknowledge of Elohim the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Yahusha HaMashiach: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.

verses.raw: Blessed be the Elohim (God) and Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), which according to his abundant mercy has begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) from the dead,
verses.text: Blessed be the Elohim and Father of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, which according to his abundant mercy has begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Yahusha HaMashiach from the dead,

verses.raw: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
verses.text: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

verses.raw: Who are kept by the power of Elohim (God) through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.text: Who are kept by the power of Elohim through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

verses.raw: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, you are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
verses.text: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, you are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

verses.raw: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perishes, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perishes, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Whom having not seen, you love; in whom, though now you see him not, yet believing, you rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
verses.text: Whom having not seen, you love; in whom, though now you see him not, yet believing, you rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:

verses.raw: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
verses.text: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

verses.raw: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
verses.text: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:

verses.raw: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Messiah (Christ) which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Messiah (Christ), and the glory that should follow.
verses.text: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Messiah which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Messiah, and the glory that should follow.

verses.raw: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
verses.text: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Ruach HaKodesh sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.

verses.raw: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ);
verses.text: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Yahusha HaMashiach;

verses.raw: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
verses.text: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:

verses.raw: But as he which has called you is holy, so be you holy in all manner of conversation;
verses.text: But as he which has called you is holy, so be you holy in all manner of conversation;

verses.raw: Because it is written, Be you holy; for I am holy.
verses.text: Because it is written, Be you holy; for I am holy.

verses.raw: And if you call on the Father, who without respect of persons judges according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
verses.text: And if you call on the Father, who without respect of persons judges according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

verses.raw: Forasmuch as you know that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
verses.text: Forasmuch as you know that you were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;

verses.raw: But with the precious blood of Messiah (Christ), as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
verses.text: But with the precious blood of Messiah, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

verses.raw: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
verses.text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

verses.raw: Who by him do believe in Elohim (God), that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in Elohim (God).
verses.text: Who by him do believe in Elohim, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in Elohim.

verses.raw: Seeing you have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that you love one another with a pure heart fervently:
verses.text: Seeing you have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that you love one another with a pure heart fervently:

verses.raw: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of Elohim (God), which lives and abides for ever.
verses.text: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of Elohim, which lives and abides for ever.

verses.raw: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falls away:
verses.text: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falls away:

verses.raw: But the word of Yahuah (Lord) endures for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
verses.text: But the word of Yahuah endures for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.

verses.raw: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,
verses.text: Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

verses.raw: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that you may grow thereby:
verses.text: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that you may grow thereby:

verses.raw: If so be you have tasted that Yahuah (Lord) is gracious.
verses.text: If so be you have tasted that Yahuah is gracious.

verses.raw: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of Elohim (God), and precious,
verses.text: To whom coming, as unto a living stone, disallowed indeed of men, but chosen of Elohim, and precious,

verses.raw: You also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to Elohim (God) by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: You also, as lively stones, are built up a spiritual house, an holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to Elohim by Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believes on him shall not be confounded.
verses.text: Wherefore also it is contained in the scripture, Behold, I lay in Sion a chief corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believes on him shall not be confounded.

verses.raw: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,
verses.text: Unto you therefore which believe he is precious: but unto them which be disobedient, the stone which the builders disallowed, the same is made the head of the corner,

verses.raw: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.
verses.text: And a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offence, even to them which stumble at the word, being disobedient: whereunto also they were appointed.

verses.raw: But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that you should shew forth the praises of him who has called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:
verses.text: But you are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that you should shew forth the praises of him who has called you out of darkness into his marvellous light:

verses.raw: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of Elohim (God): which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.
verses.text: Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of Elohim: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

verses.raw: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
verses.text: Dearly beloved, I beseech you as strangers and pilgrims, abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

verses.raw: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify Elohim (God) in the day of visitation.
verses.text: Having your conversation honest among the Gentiles: that, whereas they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they shall behold, glorify Elohim in the day of visitation.

verses.raw: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for Yahuah's (Lord’s) sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;
verses.text: Submit yourselves to every ordinance of man for Yahuah's (Lord’s) sake: whether it be to the king, as supreme;

verses.raw: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.
verses.text: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do well.

verses.raw: For so is the will of Elohim (God), that with well doing you may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:
verses.text: For so is the will of Elohim, that with well doing you may put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

verses.raw: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of Elohim (God).
verses.text: As free, and not using your liberty for a cloke of maliciousness, but as the servants of Elohim.

verses.raw: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear Elohim (God). Honour the king.
verses.text: Honour all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear Elohim. Honour the king.

verses.raw: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.
verses.text: Servants, be subject to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the froward.

verses.raw: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward Elohim (God) endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
verses.text: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward Elohim endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

verses.raw: For what glory is it, if, when you be buffeted for your faults, you shall take it patiently? but if, when you do well, and suffer for it, you take it patiently, this is acceptable with Elohim (God).
verses.text: For what glory is it, if, when you be buffeted for your faults, you shall take it patiently? but if, when you do well, and suffer for it, you take it patiently, this is acceptable with Elohim.

verses.raw: For even hereunto were you called: because Messiah (Christ) also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that you should follow his steps:
verses.text: For even hereunto were you called: because Messiah also suffered for us, leaving us an example, that you should follow his steps:

verses.raw: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:
verses.text: Who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth:

verses.raw: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judges righteously:
verses.text: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judges righteously:

verses.raw: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes you were healed.
verses.text: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree, that we, being dead to sins, should live unto righteousness: by whose stripes you were healed.

verses.raw: For you were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.
verses.text: For you were as sheep going astray; but are now returned unto the Shepherd and Bishop of your souls.

verses.raw: Likewise, you wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;
verses.text: Likewise, you wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

verses.raw: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.
verses.text: While they behold your chaste conversation coupled with fear.

verses.raw: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;
verses.text: Whose adorning let it not be that outward adorning of plaiting the hair, and of wearing of gold, or of putting on of apparel;

verses.raw: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of Elohim (God) of great price.
verses.text: But let it be the hidden man of the heart, in that which is not corruptible, even the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of Elohim of great price.

verses.raw: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in Elohim (God), adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:
verses.text: For after this manner in the old time the holy women also, who trusted in Elohim, adorned themselves, being in subjection unto their own husbands:

verses.raw: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters you are, as long as you do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.
verses.text: Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters you are, as long as you do well, and are not afraid with any amazement.

verses.raw: Likewise, you husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.
verses.text: Likewise, you husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.

verses.raw: Finally, be you all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:
verses.text: Finally, be you all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous:

verses.raw: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that you are thereunto called, that you should inherit a blessing.
verses.text: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that you are thereunto called, that you should inherit a blessing.

verses.raw: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:
verses.text: For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile:

verses.raw: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.
verses.text: Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.

verses.raw: For the eyes of Yahuah (Lord) are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of Yahuah (Lord) is against them that do evil.
verses.text: For the eyes of Yahuah are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of Yahuah is against them that do evil.

verses.raw: And who is he that will harm you, if you be followers of that which is good?
verses.text: And who is he that will harm you, if you be followers of that which is good?

verses.raw: But and if you suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are you: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
verses.text: But and if you suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are you: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

verses.raw: But sanctify Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asks you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:
verses.text: But sanctify Yahuah Elohim in your hearts: and be ready always to give an answer to every man that asks you a reason of the hope that is in you with meekness and fear:

verses.raw: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Messiah (Christ).
verses.text: Having a good conscience; that, whereas they speak evil of you, as of evildoers, they may be ashamed that falsely accuse your good conversation in Messiah.

verses.raw: For it is better, if the will of Elohim (God) be so, that you suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
verses.text: For it is better, if the will of Elohim be so, that you suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

verses.raw: For Messiah (Christ) also has once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to Elohim (God), being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:
verses.text: For Messiah also has once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to Elohim, being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

verses.raw: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;
verses.text: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

verses.raw: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of Elohim (God) waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.
verses.text: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of Elohim waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

verses.raw: The like figure whereunto even baptism does also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward Elohim (God),) by the resurrection of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: The like figure whereunto even baptism does also now save us (not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward Elohim,) by the resurrection of Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of Elohim (God); angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.
verses.text: Who is gone into heaven, and is on the right hand of Elohim; angels and authorities and powers being made subject unto him.

verses.raw: Forasmuch then as Messiah (Christ) has suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;
verses.text: Forasmuch then as Messiah has suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves likewise with the same mind: for he that has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;

verses.raw: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of Elohim (God).
