verses.text: That he no longer should live the rest of his time in the flesh to the lusts of men, but to the will of Elohim.

verses.raw: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:
verses.text: For the time past of our life may suffice us to have wrought the will of the Gentiles, when we walked in lasciviousness, lusts, excess of wine, revellings, banquetings, and abominable idolatries:

verses.raw: Wherein they think it strange that you run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:
verses.text: Wherein they think it strange that you run not with them to the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you:

verses.raw: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.
verses.text: Who shall give account to him that is ready to judge the quick and the dead.

verses.raw: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to Elohim (God) in the spirit.
verses.text: For for this cause was the gospel preached also to them that are dead, that they might be judged according to men in the flesh, but live according to Elohim in the spirit.

verses.raw: But the end of all things is at hand: be you therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.
verses.text: But the end of all things is at hand: be you therefore sober, and watch unto prayer.

verses.raw: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.
verses.text: And above all things have fervent charity among yourselves: for charity shall cover the multitude of sins.

verses.raw: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.
verses.text: Use hospitality one to another without grudging.

verses.raw: As every man has received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of Elohim (God).
verses.text: As every man has received the gift, even so minister the same one to another, as good stewards of the manifold grace of Elohim.

verses.raw: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of Elohim (God); if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which Elohim (God) gives: that Elohim (God) in all things may be glorified through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of Elohim; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which Elohim gives: that Elohim in all things may be glorified through Yahusha HaMashiach, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:
verses.text: Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you:

verses.raw: But rejoice, inasmuch as you are partakers of Messiah's (Christ’s) sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, you may be glad also with exceeding joy.
verses.text: But rejoice, inasmuch as you are partakers of Messiah's (Christ’s) sufferings; that, when his glory shall be revealed, you may be glad also with exceeding joy.

verses.raw: If you be reproached for the name of Messiah (Christ), happy are you; for the spirit of glory and of Elohim (God) resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.
verses.text: If you be reproached for the name of Messiah, happy are you; for the spirit of glory and of Elohim resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

verses.raw: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.
verses.text: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.

verses.raw: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify Elohim (God) on this behalf.
verses.text: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify Elohim on this behalf.

verses.raw: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of Elohim (God): and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of Elohim (God)?
verses.text: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of Elohim: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of Elohim?

verses.raw: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?
verses.text: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

verses.raw: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of Elohim (God) commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.
verses.text: Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of Elohim commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing, as unto a faithful Creator.

verses.raw: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Messiah (Christ), and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
verses.text: The elders which are among you I exhort, who am also an elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Messiah, and also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:

verses.raw: Feed the flock of Elohim (God) which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
verses.text: Feed the flock of Elohim which is among you, taking the oversight thereof, not by constraint, but willingly; not for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;

verses.raw: Neither as being lords over Elohim's (God’s) heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.
verses.text: Neither as being lords over Elohim's (God’s) heritage, but being ensamples to the flock.

verses.raw: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, you shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.
verses.text: And when the chief Shepherd shall appear, you shall receive a crown of glory that fadeth not away.

verses.raw: Likewise, you younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for Elohim (God) resisteth the proud, and gives grace to the humble.
verses.text: Likewise, you younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for Elohim resisteth the proud, and gives grace to the humble.

verses.raw: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of Elohim (God), that he may exalt you in due time:
verses.text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of Elohim, that he may exalt you in due time:

verses.raw: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
verses.text: Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.

verses.raw: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:
verses.text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

verses.raw: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.
verses.text: Whom resist stedfast in the faith, knowing that the same afflictions are accomplished in your brethren that are in the world.

verses.raw: But the Elohim (God) of all grace, who has called us unto his eternal glory by HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus), after that you have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.
verses.text: But the Elohim of all grace, who has called us unto his eternal glory by HaMashiach Yahusha, after that you have suffered a while, make you perfect, stablish, strengthen, settle you.

verses.raw: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: To him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of Elohim (God) wherein you stand.
verses.text: By Silvanus, a faithful brother unto you, as I suppose, I have written briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of Elohim wherein you stand.

verses.raw: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so does Marcus my son.
verses.text: The church that is at Babylon, elected together with you, saluteth you; and so does Marcus my son.

verses.raw: Greet you one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus). Amen.
verses.text: Greet you one another with a kiss of charity. Peace be with you all that are in HaMashiach Yahusha. Amen.

verses.raw: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of Elohim (God) and our Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ):
verses.text: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Yahusha HaMashiach, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of Elohim and our Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach:

verses.raw: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of Elohim (God), and of Yahusha (Jesus) our Lord,
verses.text: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of Elohim, and of Yahusha our Lord,

verses.raw: According as his divine power has given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that has called us to glory and virtue:
verses.text: According as his divine power has given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that has called us to glory and virtue:

verses.raw: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these you might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.
verses.text: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these you might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

verses.raw: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;
verses.text: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

verses.raw: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;
verses.text: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

verses.raw: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.
verses.text: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

verses.raw: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that you shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that you shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and has forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
verses.text: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and has forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

verses.raw: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if you do these things, you shall never fall:
verses.text: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if you do these things, you shall never fall:

verses.raw: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though you know them, and be established in the present truth.
verses.text: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though you know them, and be established in the present truth.

verses.raw: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
verses.text: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;

verses.raw: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) has shewed me.
verses.text: Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach has shewed me.

verses.raw: Moreover I will endeavour that you may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.
verses.text: Moreover I will endeavour that you may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

verses.raw: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
verses.text: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

verses.raw: For he received from Elohim (God) the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
verses.text: For he received from Elohim the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

verses.raw: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.
verses.text: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

verses.raw: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto you do well that you take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:
verses.text: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto you do well that you take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

verses.raw: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.
verses.text: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

verses.raw: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of Elohim (God) spake as they were moved by the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit).
verses.text: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of Elohim spake as they were moved by the Ruach HaKodesh.

verses.raw: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
verses.text: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

verses.raw: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.
verses.text: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

verses.raw: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
verses.text: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

verses.raw: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
verses.text: For if Elohim spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

verses.raw: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;
verses.text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

verses.raw: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;
verses.text: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

verses.raw: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
verses.text: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

verses.raw: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)
verses.text: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;)

verses.raw: Yahuah (Lord) knows how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:
verses.text: Yahuah knows how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

verses.raw: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.
verses.text: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous are they, selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

verses.raw: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.
verses.text: Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord.

verses.raw: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;
verses.text: But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption;

verses.raw: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;
verses.text: And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceivings while they feast with you;

verses.raw: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:
verses.text: Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children:

verses.raw: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;
verses.text: Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness;

verses.raw: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbad the madness of the prophet.
verses.text: But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man’s voice forbad the madness of the prophet.

verses.raw: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.
verses.text: These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever.

verses.raw: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.
verses.text: For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error.

verses.raw: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.
verses.text: While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage.

verses.raw: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.
verses.text: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

verses.raw: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.
verses.text: For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them.

verses.raw: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
verses.text: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.

verses.raw: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:
verses.text: This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance:

verses.raw: That you may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:
verses.text: That you may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour:

verses.raw: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,
verses.text: Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts,

verses.raw: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.
verses.text: And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

verses.raw: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of Elohim (God) the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
verses.text: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of Elohim the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:

verses.raw: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:
verses.text: Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished:

verses.raw: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.
verses.text: But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men.

verses.raw: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with Yahuah (Lord) as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.
verses.text: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with Yahuah as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

verses.raw: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
verses.text: Yahuah is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

verses.raw: But the day of Yahuah (Lord) will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.
verses.text: But the day of Yahuah will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up.

verses.raw: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought you to be in all holy conversation and godliness,
verses.text: Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought you to be in all holy conversation and godliness,

verses.raw: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of Elohim (God), wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?
verses.text: Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of Elohim, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?

verses.raw: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwells righteousness.
verses.text: Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwells righteousness.

verses.raw: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that you look for such things, be diligent that you may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.
verses.text: Wherefore, beloved, seeing that you look for such things, be diligent that you may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless.

verses.raw: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him has written unto you;
verses.text: And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him has written unto you;

verses.raw: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
verses.text: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.

verses.raw: You therefore, beloved, seeing you know these things before, beware lest you also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.
verses.text: You therefore, beloved, seeing you know these things before, beware lest you also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness.

verses.raw: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ). To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.
verses.text: But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Yahusha HaMashiach. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.

verses.raw: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
verses.text: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;

verses.raw: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
verses.text: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)

verses.raw: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that you also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that you also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
verses.text: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.

verses.raw: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that Elohim (God) is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.text: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that Elohim is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

verses.raw: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.text: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:

verses.raw: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) his Son cleanses us from all sin.
verses.text: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Yahusha HaMashiach his Son cleanses us from all sin.

verses.raw: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.text: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

verses.raw: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

verses.raw: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.text: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

verses.raw: My little children, these things write I unto you, that you sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) the righteous:
verses.text: My little children, these things write I unto you, that you sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Yahusha HaMashiach the righteous:

verses.raw: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.
verses.text: And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world.

verses.raw: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.
verses.text: And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments.

verses.raw: He that says, I know him, and keeps not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.
verses.text: He that says, I know him, and keeps not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him.

verses.raw: But whoso keeps his word, in him verily is the love of Elohim (God) perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.
verses.text: But whoso keeps his word, in him verily is the love of Elohim perfected: hereby know we that we are in him.

verses.raw: He that says he abides in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.
verses.text: He that says he abides in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked.

verses.raw: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you have heard from the beginning.
verses.text: Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you have heard from the beginning.

verses.raw: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.
verses.text: Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shineth.

verses.raw: He that says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.
verses.text: He that says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.

verses.raw: He that loves his brother abides in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.
verses.text: He that loves his brother abides in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him.

verses.raw: But he that hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and knows not whither he goes, because that darkness has blinded his eyes.
verses.text: But he that hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and knows not whither he goes, because that darkness has blinded his eyes.

verses.raw: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.
verses.text: I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

verses.raw: I write unto you, fathers, because you have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because you have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because you have known the Father.
verses.text: I write unto you, fathers, because you have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because you have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because you have known the Father.

verses.raw: I have written unto you, fathers, because you have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of Elohim (God) abides in you, and you have overcome the wicked one.
verses.text: I have written unto you, fathers, because you have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of Elohim abides in you, and you have overcome the wicked one.

verses.raw: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
verses.text: Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him.

verses.raw: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.
verses.text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

verses.raw: And the world passes away, and the lust thereof: but he that does the will of Elohim (God) abides for ever.
verses.text: And the world passes away, and the lust thereof: but he that does the will of Elohim abides for ever.

verses.raw: Little children, it is the last time: and as you have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.
verses.text: Little children, it is the last time: and as you have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time.

verses.raw: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.
verses.text: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

verses.raw: But you have an unction from the Holy One, and you know all things.
verses.text: But you have an unction from the Holy One, and you know all things.

verses.raw: I have not written unto you because you know not the truth, but because you know it, and that no lie is of the truth.
verses.text: I have not written unto you because you know not the truth, but because you know it, and that no lie is of the truth.

verses.raw: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Messiah (Christ)? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.
verses.text: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Yahusha is the Messiah? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

verses.raw: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same has not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son has the Father also.
verses.text: Whosoever denieth the Son, the same has not the Father: [but] he that acknowledgeth the Son has the Father also.

verses.raw: Let that therefore abide in you, which you have heard from the beginning. If that which you have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, you also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.
verses.text: Let that therefore abide in you, which you have heard from the beginning. If that which you have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, you also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father.

verses.raw: And this is the promise that he has promised us, even eternal life.
verses.text: And this is the promise that he has promised us, even eternal life.

verses.raw: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.
verses.text: These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you.

verses.raw: But the anointing which you have received of him abides in you, and you need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teaches you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it has taught you, you shall abide in him.
verses.text: But the anointing which you have received of him abides in you, and you need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teaches you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it has taught you, you shall abide in him.

verses.raw: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.
verses.text: And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

verses.raw: If you know that he is righteous, you know that every one that does righteousness is born of him.
verses.text: If you know that he is righteous, you know that every one that does righteousness is born of him.

verses.raw: Behold, what manner of love the Father has bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of Elohim (God): therefore the world knows us not, because it knew him not.
verses.text: Behold, what manner of love the Father has bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of Elohim: therefore the world knows us not, because it knew him not.

verses.raw: Beloved, now are we the sons of Elohim (God), and it does not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.
verses.text: Beloved, now are we the sons of Elohim, and it does not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

verses.raw: And every man that has this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.
verses.text: And every man that has this hope in him purifieth himself, even as he is pure.

verses.raw: Everyone who goes on sinning is living in lawlessness; for sin is the transgression of the law.
verses.text: Everyone who goes on sinning is living in lawlessness; for sin is the transgression of the law.

verses.raw: And you know that he was revealed to take our sins away — and in him there is no sin at all.
verses.text: And you know that he was revealed to take our sins away — and in him there is no sin at all.

verses.raw: No one who remains in him goes on sinning; whoever keeps on sinning has neither seen him nor come to know him.
verses.text: No one who remains in him goes on sinning; whoever keeps on sinning has neither seen him nor come to know him.

verses.raw: Little children, do not let anyone lead you astray: whoever practices righteousness is righteous, just as he is righteous.
verses.text: Little children, do not let anyone lead you astray: whoever practices righteousness is righteous, just as he is righteous.

verses.raw: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.
verses.text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

verses.raw: Whosoever is born of Elohim (God) does not commit sin; for his seed remains in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Whosoever is born of Elohim does not commit sin; for his seed remains in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of Elohim.

verses.raw: In this the children of Elohim (God) are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever does not righteousness is not of Elohim (God), neither he that loves not his brother.
verses.text: In this the children of Elohim are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever does not righteousness is not of Elohim, neither he that loves not his brother.

verses.raw: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
verses.text: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

verses.raw: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.
verses.text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

verses.raw: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.
verses.text: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

verses.raw: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loves not his brother abides in death.
verses.text: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loves not his brother abides in death.

verses.raw: Whosoever hates his brother is a murderer: and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.
verses.text: Whosoever hates his brother is a murderer: and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.

verses.raw: Hereby perceive we the love of Elohim (God), because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.
verses.text: Hereby perceive we the love of Elohim, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren.

verses.raw: But whoso has this world’s good, and sees his brother have need, and shuts up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwells the love of Elohim (God) in him?
verses.text: But whoso has this world’s good, and sees his brother have need, and shuts up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwells the love of Elohim in him?

verses.raw: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.
verses.text: My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth.

verses.raw: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.
verses.text: And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him.

verses.raw: For if our heart condemn us, Elohim (God) is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
verses.text: For if our heart condemn us, Elohim is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

verses.raw: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward Elohim (God).
verses.text: Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward Elohim.

verses.raw: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.
verses.text: And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.

verses.raw: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and love one another, as he gave us commandment.
verses.text: And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Yahusha HaMashiach, and love one another, as he gave us commandment.

verses.raw: And he that keeps his commandments dwells in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abides in us, by the Spirit which he has given us.
verses.text: And he that keeps his commandments dwells in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abides in us, by the Spirit which he has given us.

verses.raw: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of Elohim (God): because many false prophets are gone out into the world.
verses.text: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of Elohim: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

verses.raw: Hereby know you the Spirit of Elohim (God): Every spirit that confesseth that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is come in the flesh is of Elohim (God):
verses.text: Hereby know you the Spirit of Elohim: Every spirit that confesseth that Yahusha HaMashiach is come in the flesh is of Elohim:

verses.raw: And every spirit that confesseth not that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is come in the flesh is not of Elohim (God): and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof you have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.
verses.text: And every spirit that confesseth not that Yahusha HaMashiach is come in the flesh is not of Elohim: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof you have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.

verses.raw: You are of Elohim (God), little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.
verses.text: You are of Elohim, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world.

verses.raw: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world hears them.
verses.text: They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world hears them.

verses.raw: We are of Elohim (God): he that knows Elohim (God) hears us; he that is not of Elohim (God) hears not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.
verses.text: We are of Elohim: he that knows Elohim hears us; he that is not of Elohim hears not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

verses.raw: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of Elohim (God); and every one that loves is born of Elohim (God), and knows Elohim (God).
verses.text: Beloved, let us love one another: for love is of Elohim; and every one that loves is born of Elohim, and knows Elohim.

verses.raw: He that loves not knows not Elohim (God); for Elohim (God) is love.
verses.text: He that loves not knows not Elohim; for Elohim is love.

verses.raw: In this was manifested the love of Elohim (God) toward us, because that Elohim (God) sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.
verses.text: In this was manifested the love of Elohim toward us, because that Elohim sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him.

verses.raw: Herein is love, not that we loved Elohim (God), but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.
verses.text: Herein is love, not that we loved Elohim, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

verses.raw: Beloved, if Elohim (God) so loved us, we ought also to love one another.
verses.text: Beloved, if Elohim so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

verses.raw: No man has seen Elohim (God) at any time. If we love one another, Elohim (God) dwells in us, and his love is perfected in us.
verses.text: No man has seen Elohim at any time. If we love one another, Elohim dwells in us, and his love is perfected in us.

verses.raw: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
verses.text: Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

verses.raw: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
verses.text: And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.

verses.raw: Whosoever shall confess that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Son of Elohim (God), Elohim (God) dwells in him, and he in Elohim (God).
verses.text: Whosoever shall confess that Yahusha is the Son of Elohim, Elohim dwells in him, and he in Elohim.

verses.raw: And we have known and believed the love that Elohim (God) has to us. Elohim (God) is love; and he that dwells in love dwells in Elohim (God), and Elohim (God) in him.
verses.text: And we have known and believed the love that Elohim has to us. Elohim is love; and he that dwells in love dwells in Elohim, and Elohim in him.

verses.raw: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.
verses.text: Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world.

verses.raw: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear: because fear has torment. He that fears is not made perfect in love.
verses.text: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear: because fear has torment. He that fears is not made perfect in love.

verses.raw: We love him, because he first loved us.
verses.text: We love him, because he first loved us.

verses.raw: If a man say, I love Elohim (God), and hates his brother, he is a liar: for he that loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love Elohim (God) whom he has not seen?
verses.text: If a man say, I love Elohim, and hates his brother, he is a liar: for he that loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love Elohim whom he has not seen?

verses.raw: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loves Elohim (God) love his brother also.
verses.text: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loves Elohim love his brother also.

verses.raw: Whosoever believes that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Messiah (Christ) is born of Elohim (God): and every one that loves him that begat loves him also that is begotten of him.
verses.text: Whosoever believes that Yahusha is the Messiah is born of Elohim: and every one that loves him that begat loves him also that is begotten of him.

verses.raw: By this we know that we love the children of Elohim (God), when we love Elohim (God), and keep his commandments.
verses.text: By this we know that we love the children of Elohim, when we love Elohim, and keep his commandments.

verses.raw: For this is the love of Elohim (God), that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.
verses.text: For this is the love of Elohim, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous.

verses.raw: For whatsoever is born of Elohim (God) overcomes the world: and this is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith.
verses.text: For whatsoever is born of Elohim overcomes the world: and this is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith.

verses.raw: Who is he that overcomes the world, but he that believes that Yahusha (Jesus) is the Son of Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Who is he that overcomes the world, but he that believes that Yahusha is the Son of Elohim?

verses.raw: This is he that came by water and blood, even Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ); not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that bears witness, because the Spirit is truth.
verses.text: This is he that came by water and blood, even Yahusha HaMashiach; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that bears witness, because the Spirit is truth.

verses.raw: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit): and these three are one.
verses.text: For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Ruach HaKodesh: and these three are one.

verses.raw: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.
verses.text: And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one.

verses.raw: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of Elohim (God) is greater: for this is the witness of Elohim (God) which he has testified of his Son.
verses.text: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of Elohim is greater: for this is the witness of Elohim which he has testified of his Son.

verses.raw: He that believes on the Son of Elohim (God) has the witness in himself: he that believes not Elohim (God) has made him a liar; because he believes not the record that Elohim (God) gave of his Son.
verses.text: He that believes on the Son of Elohim has the witness in himself: he that believes not Elohim has made him a liar; because he believes not the record that Elohim gave of his Son.

verses.raw: And this is the record, that Elohim (God) has given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
verses.text: And this is the record, that Elohim has given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

verses.raw: He that has the Son has life; and he that has not the Son of Elohim (God) has not life.
verses.text: He that has the Son has life; and he that has not the Son of Elohim has not life.

verses.raw: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of Elohim (God); that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may believe on the name of the Son of Elohim (God).
verses.text: These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of Elohim; that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may believe on the name of the Son of Elohim.

verses.raw: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he hears us:
verses.text: And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he hears us:

verses.raw: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.
verses.text: And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him.

verses.raw: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.
verses.text: If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it.

verses.raw: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.
verses.text: All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death.

verses.raw: We know that whosoever is born of Elohim (God) sins not; but he that is begotten of Elohim (God) keeps himself, and that wicked one touches him not.
verses.text: We know that whosoever is born of Elohim sins not; but he that is begotten of Elohim keeps himself, and that wicked one touches him not.

verses.raw: And we know that we are of Elohim (God), and the whole world lies in wickedness.
verses.text: And we know that we are of Elohim, and the whole world lies in wickedness.

verses.raw: And we know that the Son of Elohim (God) is come, and has given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ). This is the true Elohim (God), and eternal life.
verses.text: And we know that the Son of Elohim is come, and has given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Yahusha HaMashiach. This is the true Elohim, and eternal life.

verses.raw: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.
verses.text: Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.

verses.raw: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
verses.text: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;

verses.raw: For the truth’s sake, which dwells in us, and shall be with us for ever.
verses.text: For the truth’s sake, which dwells in us, and shall be with us for ever.

verses.raw: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from Elohim (God) the Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
verses.text: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from Elohim the Father, and from Lord Yahusha HaMashiach, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

verses.raw: I rejoiced greatly that I found of your children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
verses.text: I rejoiced greatly that I found of your children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.

verses.raw: And now I beseech you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto you, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
verses.text: And now I beseech you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto you, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

verses.raw: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.
verses.text: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as you have heard from the beginning, you should walk in it.

verses.raw: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
verses.text: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Yahusha HaMashiach is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.

verses.raw: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
verses.text: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.

verses.raw: Whosoever transgresseth, and abides not in the doctrine of Messiah (Christ), has not Elohim (God). He that abides in the doctrine of Messiah (Christ), he has both the Father and the Son.
verses.text: Whosoever transgresseth, and abides not in the doctrine of Messiah, has not Elohim. He that abides in the doctrine of Messiah, he has both the Father and the Son.

verses.raw: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him Elohim (God) speed:
verses.text: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him Elohim speed:

verses.raw: For he that biddeth him Elohim (God) speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
verses.text: For he that biddeth him Elohim speed is partaker of his evil deeds.

verses.raw: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
verses.text: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.

verses.raw: The children of your elect sister greet you. Amen.
verses.text: The children of your elect sister greet you. Amen.

verses.raw: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.
verses.text: The elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

verses.raw: Beloved, I wish above all things that you may prosper and be in health, even as your soul prospereth.
verses.text: Beloved, I wish above all things that you may prosper and be in health, even as your soul prospereth.

verses.raw: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in you, even as you walk in the truth.
verses.text: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in you, even as you walk in the truth.

verses.raw: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.
verses.text: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth.

verses.raw: Beloved, you do faithfully whatsoever you do to the brethren, and to strangers;
verses.text: Beloved, you do faithfully whatsoever you do to the brethren, and to strangers;

verses.raw: Which have borne witness of your charity before the church: whom if you bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, you shall do well:
verses.text: Which have borne witness of your charity before the church: whom if you bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, you shall do well:

verses.raw: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.
verses.text: Because that for his name’s sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles.

verses.raw: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.
verses.text: We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellowhelpers to the truth.

verses.raw: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loves to have the preeminence among them, receives us not.
verses.text: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loves to have the preeminence among them, receives us not.

verses.raw: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he does, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither does he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casts them out of the church.
verses.text: Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he does, prating against us with malicious words: and not content therewith, neither does he himself receive the brethren, and forbiddeth them that would, and casts them out of the church.

verses.raw: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that does good is of Elohim (God): but he that does evil has not seen Elohim (God).
verses.text: Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that does good is of Elohim: but he that does evil has not seen Elohim.

verses.raw: Demetrius has good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and you know that our record is true.
verses.text: Demetrius has good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and you know that our record is true.

verses.raw: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto you:
verses.text: I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto you:

verses.raw: But I trust I shall shortly see you, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to you. Our friends salute you. Greet the friends by name.
verses.text: But I trust I shall shortly see you, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to you. Our friends salute you. Greet the friends by name.

verses.raw: Jude, the servant of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by Elohim (God) the Father, and preserved in Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and called:
verses.text: Jude, the servant of Yahusha HaMashiach, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by Elohim the Father, and preserved in Yahusha HaMashiach, and called:

verses.raw: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.
verses.text: Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, be multiplied.

verses.raw: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that you should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.
verses.text: Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was needful for me to write unto you, and exhort you that you should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints.

verses.raw: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our Elohim (God) into lasciviousness, and denying the only Yahuah Elohim (Lord God), and our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: For there are certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our Elohim into lasciviousness, and denying the only Yahuah Elohim, and our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though you once knew this, how that Yahuah (Lord), having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.
verses.text: I will therefore put you in remembrance, though you once knew this, how that Yahuah, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not.

verses.raw: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
verses.text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

verses.raw: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.
verses.text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

verses.raw: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.
verses.text: Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities.

verses.raw: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, Yahuah (Lord) rebuke you.
verses.text: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, Yahuah rebuke you.

verses.raw: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.
verses.text: But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves.

verses.raw: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.
verses.text: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

verses.raw: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;
verses.text: These are spots in your feasts of charity, when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withereth, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

verses.raw: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.
verses.text: Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.

verses.raw: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) comes with ten thousands of his saints,
verses.text: And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah comes with ten thousands of his saints,

verses.raw: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
verses.text: To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

verses.raw: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaks great swelling words, having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.
verses.text: These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaks great swelling words, having men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.

verses.raw: But, beloved, remember you the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ);
verses.text: But, beloved, remember you the words which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach;

verses.raw: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
verses.text: How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.

verses.raw: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
verses.text: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.

verses.raw: But you, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit),
verses.text: But you, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Ruach HaKodesh,

verses.raw: Keep yourselves in the love of Elohim (God), looking for the mercy of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) unto eternal life.
verses.text: Keep yourselves in the love of Elohim, looking for the mercy of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach unto eternal life.

verses.raw: And of some have compassion, making a difference:
verses.text: And of some have compassion, making a difference:

verses.raw: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.
verses.text: And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh.

verses.raw: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,
verses.text: Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy,

verses.raw: To the only wise Elohim (God) our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
verses.text: To the only wise Elohim our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: The Revelation of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), which Elohim (God) gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:
verses.text: The Revelation of Yahusha HaMashiach, which Elohim gave unto him, to shew unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John:

verses.raw: Who bare record of the word of Elohim (God), and of the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), and of all things that he saw.
verses.text: Who bare record of the word of Elohim, and of the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach, and of all things that he saw.

verses.raw: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.
verses.text: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

verses.raw: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
verses.text: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;

verses.raw: And from Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
verses.text: And from Yahusha HaMashiach, who is the faithful witness, and the first begotten of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood,

verses.raw: And has made us kings and priests unto Elohim (God) and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.text: And has made us kings and priests unto Elohim and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

verses.raw: Behold, he comes with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verses.text: Behold, he comes with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.

verses.raw: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, says Yahuah (Lord), which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.
verses.text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, says Yahuah, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty.

verses.raw: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of Elohim (God), and for the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).
verses.text: I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Yahusha HaMashiach, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of Elohim, and for the testimony of Yahusha HaMashiach.

verses.raw: I was in the Spirit on Yahuah's (Lord’s) day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.text: I was in the Spirit on Yahuah's (Lord’s) day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,

verses.raw: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What you see, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.
verses.text: Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What you see, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea.

verses.raw: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.text: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;

verses.raw: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of Adam, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
verses.text: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of Adam, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.

verses.raw: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.text: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

verses.raw: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
verses.text: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.

verses.raw: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verses.text: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.

verses.raw: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:
verses.text: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

verses.raw: I am he that lives, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.
verses.text: I am he that lives, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

verses.raw: Write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;
verses.text: Write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter;

verses.raw: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which you saw are the seven churches.
verses.text: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which you saw are the seven churches.

verses.raw: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things says he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;
verses.text: Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things says he that holdeth the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks;

verses.raw: I know your works, and your labour, and your patience, and how you can not bear them which are evil: and you have tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and have found them liars:
