verses.raw: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.
verses.text: And the first went, and poured out his vial upon the earth; and there fell a noisome and grievous sore upon the men which had the mark of the beast, and upon them which worshipped his image.

verses.raw: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.
verses.text: And the second angel poured out his vial upon the sea; and it became as the blood of a dead man: and every living soul died in the sea.

verses.raw: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.
verses.text: And the third angel poured out his vial upon the rivers and fountains of waters; and they became blood.

verses.raw: And I heard the angel of the waters say, You are righteous, O Yahuah (Lord), which are, and were, and shall be, because you have judged thus.
verses.text: And I heard the angel of the waters say, You are righteous, O Yahuah, which are, and were, and shall be, because you have judged thus.

verses.raw: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.
verses.text: For they have shed the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink; for they are worthy.

verses.raw: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.
verses.text: And I heard another out of the altar say, Even so, Yahuah Elohim Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.

verses.raw: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.
verses.text: And the fourth angel poured out his vial upon the sun; and power was given unto him to scorch men with fire.

verses.raw: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of Elohim (God), which has power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.
verses.text: And men were scorched with great heat, and blasphemed the name of Elohim, which has power over these plagues: and they repented not to give him glory.

verses.raw: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,
verses.text: And the fifth angel poured out his vial upon the seat of the beast; and his kingdom was full of darkness; and they gnawed their tongues for pain,

verses.raw: And blasphemed the Elohim (God) of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.
verses.text: And blasphemed the Elohim of heaven because of their pains and their sores, and repented not of their deeds.

verses.raw: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.
verses.text: And the sixth angel poured out his vial upon the great river Euphrates; and the water thereof was dried up, that the way of the kings of the east might be prepared.

verses.raw: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.
verses.text: And I saw three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.

verses.raw: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of El Shaddai (God Almighty).
verses.text: For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them to the battle of that great day of El Shaddai.

verses.raw: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.
verses.text: Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed is he that watcheth, and keeps his garments, lest he walk naked, and they see his shame.

verses.raw: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.
verses.text: And he gathered them together into a place called in the Hebrew tongue Armageddon.

verses.raw: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.
verses.text: And the seventh angel poured out his vial into the air; and there came a great voice out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.

verses.raw: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.
verses.text: And there were voices, and thunders, and lightnings; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, so mighty an earthquake, and so great.

verses.raw: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before Elohim (God), to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
verses.text: And the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon came in remembrance before Elohim, to give unto her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

verses.raw: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
verses.text: And every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

verses.raw: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed Elohim (God) because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.
verses.text: And there fell upon men a great hail out of heaven, every stone about the weight of a talent: and men blasphemed Elohim because of the plague of the hail; for the plague thereof was exceeding great.

verses.raw: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto you the judgment of the great whore that sits upon many waters:
verses.text: And there came one of the seven angels which had the seven vials, and talked with me, saying unto me, Come hither; I will shew unto you the judgment of the great whore that sits upon many waters:

verses.raw: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.
verses.text: With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.

verses.raw: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.
verses.text: So he carried me away in the spirit into the wilderness: and I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

verses.raw: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:
verses.text: And the woman was arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication:

verses.raw: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.
verses.text: And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS AND ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

verses.raw: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Yahusha (Jesus): and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.
verses.text: And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Yahusha: and when I saw her, I wondered with great admiration.

verses.raw: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.
verses.text: And the angel said unto me, Wherefore did you marvel? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carrieth her, which has the seven heads and ten horns.

verses.raw: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.
verses.text: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and shall ascend out of the bottomless pit, and go into perdition: and they that dwell on the earth shall wonder, whose names were not written in the book of life from the foundation of the world, when they behold the beast that was, and is not, and yet is.

verses.raw: And here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.
verses.text: And here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.

verses.raw: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he comes, he must continue a short space.
verses.text: And there are seven kings: five are fallen, and one is, and the other is not yet come; and when he comes, he must continue a short space.

verses.raw: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goes into perdition.
verses.text: And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth, and is of the seven, and goes into perdition.

verses.raw: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.
verses.text: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, which have received no kingdom as yet; but receive power as kings one hour with the beast.

verses.raw: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.
verses.text: These have one mind, and shall give their power and strength unto the beast.

verses.raw: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is the Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.
verses.text: These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them: for he is the Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful.

verses.raw: And he says unto me, The waters which you saw, where the whore sits, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.
verses.text: And he says unto me, The waters which you saw, where the whore sits, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.

verses.raw: And the ten horns which you saw upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
verses.text: And the ten horns which you saw upon the beast, these shall hate the whore, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) has put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of Elohim (God) shall be fulfilled.
verses.text: For Elohim has put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of Elohim shall be fulfilled.

verses.raw: And the woman which you saw is that great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.
verses.text: And the woman which you saw is that great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.

verses.raw: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
verses.text: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.

verses.raw: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
verses.text: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.

verses.raw: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
verses.text: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.

verses.raw: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that you be not partakers of her sins, and that you receive not of her plagues.
verses.text: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that you be not partakers of her sins, and that you receive not of her plagues.

verses.raw: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and Elohim (God) has remembered her iniquities.
verses.text: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and Elohim has remembered her iniquities.

verses.raw: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she has filled fill to her double.
verses.text: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she has filled fill to her double.

verses.raw: How much she has glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she says in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
verses.text: How much she has glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she says in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.

verses.raw: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) who judges her.
verses.text: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is Yahuah Elohim who judges her.

verses.raw: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
verses.text: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,

verses.raw: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is your judgment come.
verses.text: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is your judgment come.

verses.raw: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
verses.text: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:

verses.raw: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
verses.text: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,

verses.raw: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
verses.text: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.

verses.raw: And the fruits that your soul lusted after are departed from you, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from you, and you shall find them no more at all.
verses.text: And the fruits that your soul lusted after are departed from you, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from you, and you shall find them no more at all.

verses.raw: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
verses.text: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,

verses.raw: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
verses.text: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!

verses.raw: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
verses.text: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,

verses.raw: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
verses.text: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!

verses.raw: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
verses.text: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.

verses.raw: Rejoice over her, you heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets; for Elohim (God) has avenged you on her.
verses.text: Rejoice over her, you heaven, and you holy apostles and prophets; for Elohim has avenged you on her.

verses.raw: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
verses.text: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.

verses.raw: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in you; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in you; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in you;
verses.text: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in you; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in you; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in you;

verses.raw: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in you; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in you: for your merchants were the great men of the earth; for by your sorceries were all nations deceived.
verses.text: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in you; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in you: for your merchants were the great men of the earth; for by your sorceries were all nations deceived.

verses.raw: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
verses.text: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.

verses.raw: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the Lord our God):
verses.text: And after these things I heard a great voice of much people in heaven, saying, Alleluia; Salvation, and glory, and honour, and power, unto Yahuah Eloheinu:

verses.raw: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he has judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.
verses.text: For true and righteous are his judgments: for he has judged the great whore, which did corrupt the earth with her fornication, and has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

verses.raw: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.
verses.text: And again they said, Alleluia. And her smoke rose up for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped Elohim (God) that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.
verses.text: And the four and twenty elders and the four beasts fell down and worshipped Elohim that sat on the throne, saying, Amen; Alleluia.

verses.raw: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our Elohim (God), all you his servants, and you that fear him, both small and great.
verses.text: And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our Elohim, all you his servants, and you that fear him, both small and great.

verses.raw: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) omnipotent reigns.
verses.text: And I heard as it were the voice of a great multitude, and as the voice of many waters, and as the voice of mighty thunderings, saying, Alleluia: for Yahuah Elohim omnipotent reigns.

verses.raw: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife has made herself ready.
verses.text: Let us be glad and rejoice, and give honour to him: for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife has made herself ready.

verses.raw: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.
verses.text: And to her was granted that she should be arrayed in fine linen, clean and white: for the fine linen is the righteousness of saints.

verses.raw: And he says unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he says unto me, These are the true sayings of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And he says unto me, Write, Blessed are they which are called unto the marriage supper of the Lamb. And he says unto me, These are the true sayings of Elohim.

verses.raw: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See you do it not: I am your fellowservant, and of your brethren that have the testimony of Yahusha (Jesus): worship Elohim (God): for the testimony of Yahusha (Jesus) is the spirit of prophecy.
verses.text: And I fell at his feet to worship him. And he said unto me, See you do it not: I am your fellowservant, and of your brethren that have the testimony of Yahusha: worship Elohim: for the testimony of Yahusha is the spirit of prophecy.

verses.raw: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he does judge and make war.
verses.text: And I saw heaven opened, and behold a white horse; and he that sat upon him was called Faithful and True, and in righteousness he does judge and make war.

verses.raw: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.
verses.text: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.

verses.raw: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of Elohim.

verses.raw: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.
verses.text: And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses, clothed in fine linen, white and clean.

verses.raw: And out of his mouth goes a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treads the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of El Shaddai (Almighty God).
verses.text: And out of his mouth goes a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations: and he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treads the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of El Shaddai.

verses.raw: And he has on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND Yahuah (LORD) OF LORDS.
verses.text: And he has on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND Yahuah OF LORDS.

verses.raw: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great Elohim (God);
verses.text: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great Elohim;

verses.raw: That you may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.
verses.text: That you may eat the flesh of kings, and the flesh of captains, and the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses, and of them that sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and bond, both small and great.

verses.raw: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.
verses.text: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him that sat on the horse, and against his army.

verses.raw: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.
verses.text: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

verses.raw: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.
verses.text: And the remnant were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which sword proceeded out of his mouth: and all the fowls were filled with their flesh.

verses.raw: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.
verses.text: And I saw an angel come down from heaven, having the key of the bottomless pit and a great chain in his hand.

verses.raw: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,
verses.text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

verses.raw: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
verses.text: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

verses.raw: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Yahusha (Jesus), and for the word of Elohim (God), and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Messiah (Christ) a thousand years.
verses.text: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Yahusha, and for the word of Elohim, and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Messiah a thousand years.

verses.raw: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
verses.text: But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

verses.raw: Blessed and holy is he that has part in the first resurrection: on such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of Elohim (God) and of Messiah (Christ), and shall reign with him a thousand years.
verses.text: Blessed and holy is he that has part in the first resurrection: on such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of Elohim and of Messiah, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

verses.raw: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
verses.text: And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,

verses.raw: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.
verses.text: And shall go out to deceive the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to battle: the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

verses.raw: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, and devoured them.
verses.text: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and compassed the camp of the saints about, and the beloved city: and fire came down from Elohim out of heaven, and devoured them.

verses.raw: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.
verses.text: And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.
verses.text: And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.

verses.raw: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.
verses.text: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim; and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

verses.raw: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.
verses.text: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and hell delivered up the dead which were in them: and they were judged every man according to their works.

verses.raw: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
verses.text: And death and hell were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death.

verses.raw: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.
verses.text: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

verses.raw: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.
verses.text: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

verses.raw: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.
verses.text: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

verses.raw: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.
verses.text: And Elohim shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

verses.raw: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
verses.text: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.
verses.text: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.

verses.raw: He that overcomes shall inherit all things; and I will be his Elohim (God), and he shall be my son.
verses.text: He that overcomes shall inherit all things; and I will be his Elohim, and he shall be my son.

verses.raw: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burns with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.
verses.text: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burns with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.

verses.raw: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.
verses.text: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew you the bride, the Lamb’s wife.

verses.raw: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from Elohim (God),
verses.text: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from Elohim,

verses.raw: Having the glory of Elohim (God): and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;
verses.text: Having the glory of Elohim: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

verses.raw: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Yashar'el:

verses.raw: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.
verses.text: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

verses.raw: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.
verses.text: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

verses.raw: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.
verses.text: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.

verses.raw: And the city lies foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.
verses.text: And the city lies foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.

verses.raw: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.
verses.text: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.

verses.raw: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.
verses.text: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.

verses.raw: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;
verses.text: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;

verses.raw: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.
verses.text: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

verses.raw: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.
verses.text: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls; every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

verses.raw: And I saw no temple therein: for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.
verses.text: And I saw no temple therein: for Yahuah Elohim Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.

verses.raw: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of Elohim (God) did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
verses.text: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of Elohim did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.

verses.raw: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.
verses.text: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.

verses.raw: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.
verses.text: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.

verses.raw: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.
verses.text: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.

verses.raw: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defiles, neither whatsoever works abomination, or makes a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
verses.text: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defiles, neither whatsoever works abomination, or makes a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

verses.raw: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.
verses.text: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim and of the Lamb.

verses.raw: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.
verses.text: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

verses.raw: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:
verses.text: And there shall be no more curse: but the throne of Elohim and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him:

verses.raw: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.
verses.text: And they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads.

verses.raw: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) gives them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.text: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim gives them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.
verses.text: And he said unto me, These sayings are faithful and true: and Yahuah Elohim of the holy prophets sent his angel to shew unto his servants the things which must shortly be done.

verses.raw: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keeps the sayings of the prophecy of this book.
verses.text: Behold, I come quickly: blessed is he that keeps the sayings of the prophecy of this book.

verses.raw: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.
verses.text: And I John saw these things, and heard them. And when I had heard and seen, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel which shewed me these things.

verses.raw: Then says he unto me, See you do it not: for I am your fellowservant, and of your brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then says he unto me, See you do it not: for I am your fellowservant, and of your brethren the prophets, and of them which keep the sayings of this book: worship Elohim.

verses.raw: And he says unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.
verses.text: And he says unto me, Seal not the sayings of the prophecy of this book: for the time is at hand.

verses.raw: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.
verses.text: He that is unjust, let him be unjust still: and he which is filthy, let him be filthy still: and he that is righteous, let him be righteous still: and he that is holy, let him be holy still.

verses.raw: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.
verses.text: And, behold, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give every man according as his work shall be.

verses.raw: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
verses.text: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.

verses.raw: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.
verses.text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

verses.raw: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loves and makes a lie.
verses.text: For without are dogs, and sorcerers, and whoremongers, and murderers, and idolaters, and whosoever loves and makes a lie.

verses.raw: I Yahusha (Jesus) have sent my angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.
verses.text: I Yahusha have sent my angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.

verses.raw: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that hears say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
verses.text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that hears say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

verses.raw: For I testify unto every man that hears the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, Elohim (God) shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:
verses.text: For I testify unto every man that hears the words of the prophecy of this book, If any man shall add unto these things, Elohim shall add unto him the plagues that are written in this book:

verses.raw: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, Elohim (God) shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.
verses.text: And if any man shall take away from the words of the book of this prophecy, Elohim shall take away his part out of the book of life, and out of the holy city, and from the things which are written in this book.

verses.raw: He which testifieth these things says, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: He which testifieth these things says, Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Yahusha.

verses.raw: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you all. Amen.
verses.text: The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach be with you all. Amen.

verses.raw: The words of the blessing of Enoch, wherewith he blessed the elect and righteous, who will be living in the day of tribulation, when all the wicked and godless are to be removed.
verses.text: The words of the blessing of Enoch, wherewith he blessed the elect and righteous, who will be living in the day of tribulation, when all the wicked and godless are to be removed.

verses.raw: And he took up his parable and said—Enoch a righteous man, whose eyes were opened by Elohim (God), saw the vision of the Holy One in the heavens, which the angels showed me, and from them I heard everything, and from them I understood as I saw, but not for this generation, but for a remote one which is for to come.
verses.text: And he took up his parable and said—Enoch a righteous man, whose eyes were opened by Elohim, saw the vision of the Holy One in the heavens, which the angels showed me, and from them I heard everything, and from them I understood as I saw, but not for this generation, but for a remote one which is for to come.

verses.raw: Concerning the elect I said, and took up my parable concerning them: The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling,
verses.text: Concerning the elect I said, and took up my parable concerning them: The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling,

verses.raw: And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.
verses.text: And the eternal Elohim will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.

verses.raw: And all shall be smitten with fear, And the Watchers shall quake, And great fear and trembling shall seize them unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text: And all shall be smitten with fear, And the Watchers shall quake, And great fear and trembling shall seize them unto the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame.
verses.text: And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame.

verses.raw: And the earth shall be wholly rent in sunder, And all that is upon the earth shall perish, And there shall be a judgement upon all (men).
verses.text: And the earth shall be wholly rent in sunder, And all that is upon the earth shall perish, And there shall be a judgement upon all (men).

verses.raw: But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.
verses.text: But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim, And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.

verses.raw: And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.
verses.text: And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.

verses.raw: Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.
verses.text: Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.

verses.raw: Behold ye the earth, and give heed to the things which take place upon it from first to last, how steadfast they are, how none of the things upon earth change, but all the works of Elohim (God) appear to you.
verses.text: Behold ye the earth, and give heed to the things which take place upon it from first to last, how steadfast they are, how none of the things upon earth change, but all the works of Elohim appear to you.

verses.raw: Behold the summer and the winter, how the whole earth is filled with water, and clouds and dew and rain lie upon it.
verses.text: Behold the summer and the winter, how the whole earth is filled with water, and clouds and dew and rain lie upon it.

verses.raw: Observe and see how (in the winter) all the trees seem as though they had withered and shed all their leaves, except fourteen trees, which do not lose their foliage but retain the old foliage from two to three years till the new comes.
verses.text: Observe and see how (in the winter) all the trees seem as though they had withered and shed all their leaves, except fourteen trees, which do not lose their foliage but retain the old foliage from two to three years till the new comes.

verses.raw: And again, observe ye the days of summer how the sun is above the earth over against it. And you seek shade and shelter by reason of the heat of the sun, and the earth also burns with growing heat, and so you cannot tread on the earth, or on a rock by reason of its heat.
verses.text: And again, observe ye the days of summer how the sun is above the earth over against it. And you seek shade and shelter by reason of the heat of the sun, and the earth also burns with growing heat, and so you cannot tread on the earth, or on a rock by reason of its heat.

verses.raw: Observe ye how the trees cover themselves with green leaves and bear fruit: wherefore give ye heed and know with regard to all His works, and recognize how He that liveth for ever hath made them so.
verses.text: Observe ye how the trees cover themselves with green leaves and bear fruit: wherefore give ye heed and know with regard to all His works, and recognize how He that liveth for ever hath made them so.

verses.raw: And all His works go on thus from year to year for ever, and all the tasks which they accomplish for Him, and their tasks change not, but according as Elohim (God) hath ordained so is it done.
verses.text: And all His works go on thus from year to year for ever, and all the tasks which they accomplish for Him, and their tasks change not, but according as Elohim hath ordained so is it done.

verses.raw: And behold how the sea and the rivers in like manner accomplish and change not their tasks from His commandments.
verses.text: And behold how the sea and the rivers in like manner accomplish and change not their tasks from His commandments.

verses.raw: But ye—ye have not been steadfast, nor done the commandments of Yahuah (Lord), But ye have turned away and spoken proud and hard words With your impure mouths against His greatness. Oh, ye hard-hearted, ye shall find no peace.
verses.text: But ye—ye have not been steadfast, nor done the commandments of Yahuah, But ye have turned away and spoken proud and hard words With your impure mouths against His greatness. Oh, ye hard-hearted, ye shall find no peace.

verses.raw: Therefore shall ye execrate your days, And the years of your life shall perish, And the years of your destruction shall be multiplied in eternal execration, And ye shall find no mercy.
verses.text: Therefore shall ye execrate your days, And the years of your life shall perish, And the years of your destruction shall be multiplied in eternal execration, And ye shall find no mercy.

verses.raw: In those days ye shall make your names an eternal execration unto all the righteous, And by you shall all who curse, curse, And all the sinners and godless shall imprecate by you, And all the... shall rejoice, And there shall be forgiveness of sins, And every mercy and peace and forbearance: There shall be salvation unto them, a goodly light. And for all of you sinners there shall be no salvation, But on you all shall abide a curse.
verses.text: In those days ye shall make your names an eternal execration unto all the righteous, And by you shall all who curse, curse, And all the sinners and godless shall imprecate by you, And all the... shall rejoice, And there shall be forgiveness of sins, And every mercy and peace and forbearance: There shall be salvation unto them, a goodly light. And for all of you sinners there shall be no salvation, But on you all shall abide a curse.

verses.raw: And for you the godless there shall be a curse. But for the elect there shall be light and joy and peace, And they shall inherit the earth.
verses.text: And for you the godless there shall be a curse. But for the elect there shall be light and joy and peace, And they shall inherit the earth.

verses.raw: And then there shall be bestowed upon the elect wisdom, And they shall all live and never again sin, Either through ungodliness or through pride: But they who are wise shall be humble.
verses.text: And then there shall be bestowed upon the elect wisdom, And they shall all live and never again sin, Either through ungodliness or through pride: But they who are wise shall be humble.

verses.raw: And they shall not again transgress, Nor shall they sin all the days of their life, Nor shall they die of (the divine) anger or wrath, But they shall complete the number of the days of their life. And their lives shall be increased in peace, And the years of their joy shall be multiplied, In eternal gladness and peace, All the days of their life.
verses.text: And they shall not again transgress, Nor shall they sin all the days of their life, Nor shall they die of (the divine) anger or wrath, But they shall complete the number of the days of their life. And their lives shall be increased in peace, And the years of their joy shall be multiplied, In eternal gladness and peace, All the days of their life.

verses.raw: And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.
verses.text: And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters.

verses.raw: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’
verses.text: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

verses.raw: And Semjâzâ, who was their leader, said unto them: ‘I fear ye will not indeed agree to do this deed, and I alone shall have to pay the penalty of a great sin.’
verses.text: And Semjâzâ, who was their leader, said unto them: ‘I fear ye will not indeed agree to do this deed, and I alone shall have to pay the penalty of a great sin.’

verses.raw: And they all answered him and said: ‘Let us all swear an oath, and all bind ourselves by mutual imprecations not to abandon this plan but to do this thing.’
verses.text: And they all answered him and said: ‘Let us all swear an oath, and all bind ourselves by mutual imprecations not to abandon this plan but to do this thing.’

verses.raw: Then sware they all together and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.
verses.text: Then sware they all together and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.

verses.raw: And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.
verses.text: And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.

verses.raw: And these are the names of their leaders: Samîazâz, their leader, Arâkîba, Râmêêl, Kôkabîêl, Tâmîêl, Râmîêl, Dânêl, Êzêqêêl, Barâqîjâl, Asâêl, Armârôs, Batârêl, Anânêl, Zaqîêl, Samsâpêêl, Satarêl, Tûrêl, Jômjâêl, Sariêl.
verses.text: And these are the names of their leaders: Samîazâz, their leader, Arâkîba, Râmêêl, Kôkabîêl, Tâmîêl, Râmîêl, Dânêl, Êzêqêêl, Barâqîjâl, Asâêl, Armârôs, Batârêl, Anânêl, Zaqîêl, Samsâpêêl, Satarêl, Tûrêl, Jômjâêl, Sariêl.

verses.raw: These are their chiefs of tens.
verses.text: These are their chiefs of tens.

verses.raw: And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments, and the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants.
verses.text: And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments, and the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants.

verses.raw: And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:
verses.text: And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:

verses.raw: Who consumed all the acquisitions of men.
verses.text: Who consumed all the acquisitions of men.

verses.raw: And when men could no longer sustain them, the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.
verses.text: And when men could no longer sustain them, the giants turned against them and devoured mankind.

verses.raw: And they began to sin against birds, and beasts, and reptiles, and fish, and to devour one another's flesh, and drink the blood.
verses.text: And they began to sin against birds, and beasts, and reptiles, and fish, and to devour one another's flesh, and drink the blood.

verses.raw: Then the earth laid accusation against the lawless ones.
verses.text: Then the earth laid accusation against the lawless ones.

verses.raw: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.
verses.text: And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.

verses.raw: And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.
verses.text: And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.

verses.raw: Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, Armârôs the resolving of enchantments, Barâqîjâl (taught) astrology, Kôkabêl the constellations, Êzêqêêl the knowledge of the clouds, Araqiêl the signs of the earth, Shamsiêl the signs of the sun, and Sariêl the course of the moon.
verses.text: Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, Armârôs the resolving of enchantments, Barâqîjâl (taught) astrology, Kôkabêl the constellations, Êzêqêêl the knowledge of the clouds, Araqiêl the signs of the earth, Shamsiêl the signs of the sun, and Sariêl the course of the moon.

verses.raw: And as men perished, they cried, and their cry went up to heaven...
verses.text: And as men perished, they cried, and their cry went up to heaven...

verses.raw: And then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from heaven and saw much blood being shed upon the earth, and all lawlessness being wrought upon the earth.
verses.text: And then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from heaven and saw much blood being shed upon the earth, and all lawlessness being wrought upon the earth.

verses.raw: And they said one to another: ‘The earth made without inhabitant cries the voice of their cryings up to the gates of heaven.
verses.text: And they said one to another: ‘The earth made without inhabitant cries the voice of their cryings up to the gates of heaven.

verses.raw: And now to you, the holy ones of heaven, the souls of men make their suit, saying, “Bring our cause before the El Elyon (Most High).”’
verses.text: And now to you, the holy ones of heaven, the souls of men make their suit, saying, “Bring our cause before the El Elyon.”’

verses.raw: And they said to Yahuah (Lord) of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim (God) of gods, King of kings, and Elohim (God) of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!
verses.text: And they said to Yahuah of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, Elohim of gods, King of kings, and Elohim of the ages, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages!

verses.raw: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.
verses.text: Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and Thou seest all things, and nothing can hide itself from Thee.

verses.raw: Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to learn:
verses.text: Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to learn:

verses.raw: And Semjâzâ, to whom Thou hast given authority to bear rule over his associates.
verses.text: And Semjâzâ, to whom Thou hast given authority to bear rule over his associates.

verses.raw: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.
verses.text: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.

verses.raw: And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness.
verses.text: And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness.

verses.raw: And now, behold, the souls of those who have died are crying and making their suit to the gates of heaven, and their lamentations have ascended: and cannot cease because of the lawless deeds which are wrought on the earth.
verses.text: And now, behold, the souls of those who have died are crying and making their suit to the gates of heaven, and their lamentations have ascended: and cannot cease because of the lawless deeds which are wrought on the earth.

verses.raw: And Thou knowest all things before they come to pass, and Thou seest these things and Thou dost suffer them, and Thou dost not say to us what we are to do to them in regard to these.’
verses.text: And Thou knowest all things before they come to pass, and Thou seest these things and Thou dost suffer them, and Thou dost not say to us what we are to do to them in regard to these.’

verses.raw: Then said the El Elyon (Most High), the Holy and Great One spake, and sent Uriel to the son of Lamech, and said to him:
verses.text: Then said the El Elyon, the Holy and Great One spake, and sent Uriel to the son of Lamech, and said to him:

verses.raw: ’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.
verses.text: ’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.

verses.raw: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’
verses.text: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’

verses.raw: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.
verses.text: And again Yahuah said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.

verses.raw: And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light.
verses.text: And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light.

verses.raw: And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.
verses.text: And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire.

verses.raw: And heal the earth which the angels have corrupted, and proclaim the healing of the earth, that they may heal the plague, and that all the children of men may not perish through all the secret things that the Watchers have disclosed and have taught their sons.
verses.text: And heal the earth which the angels have corrupted, and proclaim the healing of the earth, that they may heal the plague, and that all the children of men may not perish through all the secret things that the Watchers have disclosed and have taught their sons.

verses.raw: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’
verses.text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’

verses.raw: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.
verses.text: And to Gabriel said Yahuah: ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

verses.raw: And no request that they (i.e. their fathers) make of thee shall be granted unto their fathers on their behalf; for they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.’
verses.text: And no request that they (i.e. their fathers) make of thee shall be granted unto their fathers on their behalf; for they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.’

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto Michael: ‘Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women so as to have defiled themselves with them in all their uncleanness.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto Michael: ‘Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women so as to have defiled themselves with them in all their uncleanness.

verses.raw: And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.
verses.text: And when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated.

verses.raw: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.
verses.text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.

verses.raw: And whosoever shall be condemned and destroyed will from thenceforth be bound together with them to the end of all generations.
verses.text: And whosoever shall be condemned and destroyed will from thenceforth be bound together with them to the end of all generations.

verses.raw: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.
verses.text: And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind.

verses.raw: Destroy all wrong from the face of the earth and let every evil work come to an end: and let the plant of righteousness and truth appear: and it shall prove a blessing; the works of righteousness and truth shall be planted in truth and joy for evermore.
verses.text: Destroy all wrong from the face of the earth and let every evil work come to an end: and let the plant of righteousness and truth appear: and it shall prove a blessing; the works of righteousness and truth shall be planted in truth and joy for evermore.

verses.raw: And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.
verses.text: And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age Shall they complete in peace.

verses.raw: And then shall the whole earth be tilled in righteousness, and shall all be planted with trees and be full of blessing.
verses.text: And then shall the whole earth be tilled in righteousness, and shall all be planted with trees and be full of blessing.

verses.raw: And all desirable trees shall be planted on it, and they shall plant vines on it: and the vine which they plant thereon shall yield wine in abundance, and as for all the seed which is sown thereon each measure (of it) shall bear a thousand, and each measure of olives shall yield ten presses of oil.
verses.text: And all desirable trees shall be planted on it, and they shall plant vines on it: and the vine which they plant thereon shall yield wine in abundance, and as for all the seed which is sown thereon each measure (of it) shall bear a thousand, and each measure of olives shall yield ten presses of oil.

verses.raw: And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.
verses.text: And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.

verses.raw: And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.
verses.text: And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.

verses.raw: And the earth shall be cleansed from all defilement, and from all sin, and from all punishment, and from all torment, and I will never again send (them) upon it from generation to generation and for ever.
verses.text: And the earth shall be cleansed from all defilement, and from all sin, and from all punishment, and from all torment, and I will never again send (them) upon it from generation to generation and for ever.

verses.raw: And in those days I will open the store chambers of blessing which are in the heaven, so as to send them down upon the earth over the work and labour of the children of men.
verses.text: And in those days I will open the store chambers of blessing which are in the heaven, so as to send them down upon the earth over the work and labour of the children of men.

verses.raw: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of men.’
verses.text: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of men.’

verses.raw: Before these things Enoch was hidden, and no one of the children of men knew where he was hidden, and where he abode, and what had become of him.
verses.text: Before these things Enoch was hidden, and no one of the children of men knew where he was hidden, and where he abode, and what had become of him.

verses.raw: And his activities had to do with the Watchers, and his days were with the holy ones.
verses.text: And his activities had to do with the Watchers, and his days were with the holy ones.

verses.raw: And I Enoch was blessing Yahuah (Lord) of majesty and the King of the ages, and lo! the Watchers called me—Enoch the scribe—and said to me:
verses.text: And I Enoch was blessing Yahuah of majesty and the King of the ages, and lo! the Watchers called me—Enoch the scribe—and said to me:

verses.raw: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:
verses.text: ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives:

verses.raw: “Ye have wrought great destruction on the earth: And ye shall have no peace nor forgiveness of sin: and inasmuch as they delight themselves in their children,
verses.text: “Ye have wrought great destruction on the earth: And ye shall have no peace nor forgiveness of sin: and inasmuch as they delight themselves in their children,

verses.raw: The murder of their beloved ones shall they see, and over the destruction of their children shall they lament, and shall make supplication unto eternity, but mercy and peace shall ye not attain.”’
verses.text: The murder of their beloved ones shall they see, and over the destruction of their children shall they lament, and shall make supplication unto eternity, but mercy and peace shall ye not attain.”’
