verses.raw: And Enoch went and said: ‘Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds:
verses.text: And Enoch went and said: ‘Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds:

verses.raw: And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’
verses.text: And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’

verses.raw: Then I went and spoke to them all together, and they were all afraid, and fear and trembling seized them.
verses.text: Then I went and spoke to them all together, and they were all afraid, and fear and trembling seized them.

verses.raw: And they besought me to draw up a petition for them that they might find forgiveness, and to read their petition in the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of heaven.
verses.text: And they besought me to draw up a petition for them that they might find forgiveness, and to read their petition in the presence of Yahuah of heaven.

verses.raw: For from thenceforward they could not speak (with Him) nor lift up their eyes to heaven for shame of their sins for which they had been condemned.
verses.text: For from thenceforward they could not speak (with Him) nor lift up their eyes to heaven for shame of their sins for which they had been condemned.

verses.raw: Then I wrote out their petition, and the prayer in regard to their spirits and their deeds individually and in regard to their requests that they should have forgiveness and length.
verses.text: Then I wrote out their petition, and the prayer in regard to their spirits and their deeds individually and in regard to their requests that they should have forgiveness and length.

verses.raw: And I went off and sat down at the waters of Dan, in the land of Dan, to the south of the west of Hermon: I read their petition till I fell asleep.
verses.text: And I went off and sat down at the waters of Dan, in the land of Dan, to the south of the west of Hermon: I read their petition till I fell asleep.

verses.raw: And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) I to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.
verses.text: And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) I to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them.

verses.raw: And when I awaked, I came unto them, and they were all sitting gathered together, weeping in ’Abelsjâîl, which is between Lebanon and Sênêsêr, with their faces covered.
verses.text: And when I awaked, I came unto them, and they were all sitting gathered together, weeping in ’Abelsjâîl, which is between Lebanon and Sênêsêr, with their faces covered.

verses.raw: And I recounted before them all the visions which I had seen in sleep, and I began to speak the words of righteousness, and to reprimand the heavenly Watchers.
verses.text: And I recounted before them all the visions which I had seen in sleep, and I began to speak the words of righteousness, and to reprimand the heavenly Watchers.

verses.raw: The book of the words of righteousness, and of the reprimand of the eternal Watchers in accordance with the command of the Holy Great One in that vision.
verses.text: The book of the words of righteousness, and of the reprimand of the eternal Watchers in accordance with the command of the Holy Great One in that vision.

verses.raw: I saw in my sleep what I will now say with a tongue of flesh and with the breath of my mouth: which the Great One has given to men to converse therewith and understand with the heart.
verses.text: I saw in my sleep what I will now say with a tongue of flesh and with the breath of my mouth: which the Great One has given to men to converse therewith and understand with the heart.

verses.raw: As He has created and given to man the power of understanding the word of wisdom, so hath He created me also and given me the power of reprimanding the Watchers, the children of heaven.
verses.text: As He has created and given to man the power of understanding the word of wisdom, so hath He created me also and given me the power of reprimanding the Watchers, the children of heaven.

verses.raw: I wrote out your petition, and in my vision it appeared thus, that your petition will not be granted unto you throughout all the days of eternity, and that judgement has been finally passed upon you: yea (your petition) will not be granted unto you.
verses.text: I wrote out your petition, and in my vision it appeared thus, that your petition will not be granted unto you throughout all the days of eternity, and that judgement has been finally passed upon you: yea (your petition) will not be granted unto you.

verses.raw: And from henceforth you shall not ascend into heaven unto all eternity, and in bonds of the earth the decree has gone forth to bind you for all the days of the world.
verses.text: And from henceforth you shall not ascend into heaven unto all eternity, and in bonds of the earth the decree has gone forth to bind you for all the days of the world.

verses.raw: And (that) previously you shall have seen the destruction of your beloved sons and ye shall have no pleasure in them, but they shall fall before you by the sword.
verses.text: And (that) previously you shall have seen the destruction of your beloved sons and ye shall have no pleasure in them, but they shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.raw: And your petition on their behalf shall not be granted, nor yet on your own: even though you weep and pray and speak all the words contained in the writing which I have written.
verses.text: And your petition on their behalf shall not be granted, nor yet on your own: even though you weep and pray and speak all the words contained in the writing which I have written.

verses.raw: And the vision was shown to me thus: Behold, in the vision clouds invited me and a mist summoned me, and the course of the stars and the lightnings sped and hastened me, and the winds in the vision caused me to fly and lifted me upward, and bore me into heaven.
verses.text: And the vision was shown to me thus: Behold, in the vision clouds invited me and a mist summoned me, and the course of the stars and the lightnings sped and hastened me, and the winds in the vision caused me to fly and lifted me upward, and bore me into heaven.

verses.raw: And I went in till I drew nigh to a wall which is built of crystals and surrounded by tongues of fire: and it began to affright me.
verses.text: And I went in till I drew nigh to a wall which is built of crystals and surrounded by tongues of fire: and it began to affright me.

verses.raw: And I went into the tongues of fire and drew nigh to a large house which was built of crystals: and the walls of the house were like a tesselated floor (made) of crystals, and its groundwork was of crystal.
verses.text: And I went into the tongues of fire and drew nigh to a large house which was built of crystals: and the walls of the house were like a tesselated floor (made) of crystals, and its groundwork was of crystal.

verses.raw: Its ceiling was like the path of the stars and the lightnings, and between them were fiery cherubim, and their heaven was (clear as) water.
verses.text: Its ceiling was like the path of the stars and the lightnings, and between them were fiery cherubim, and their heaven was (clear as) water.

verses.raw: A flaming fire surrounded the walls, and its portals blazed with fire.
verses.text: A flaming fire surrounded the walls, and its portals blazed with fire.

verses.raw: And I entered into that house, and it was hot as fire and cold as ice: there were no delights of life therein: fear covered me, and trembling got hold upon me.
verses.text: And I entered into that house, and it was hot as fire and cold as ice: there were no delights of life therein: fear covered me, and trembling got hold upon me.

verses.raw: And as I quaked and trembled, I fell upon my face.
verses.text: And as I quaked and trembled, I fell upon my face.

verses.raw: And I beheld a vision, And lo! there was a second house, greater than the former, and the entire portal stood open before me, and it was built of flames of fire.
verses.text: And I beheld a vision, And lo! there was a second house, greater than the former, and the entire portal stood open before me, and it was built of flames of fire.

verses.raw: And in every respect it so excelled in splendour and magnificence and extent that I cannot describe to you its splendour and its extent.
verses.text: And in every respect it so excelled in splendour and magnificence and extent that I cannot describe to you its splendour and its extent.

verses.raw: And its floor was of fire, and above it were lightnings and the path of the stars, and its ceiling also was flaming fire.
verses.text: And its floor was of fire, and above it were lightnings and the path of the stars, and its ceiling also was flaming fire.

verses.raw: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.
verses.text: And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim.

verses.raw: And from underneath the throne came streams of flaming fire so that I could not look thereon.
verses.text: And from underneath the throne came streams of flaming fire so that I could not look thereon.

verses.raw: And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.
verses.text: And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow.

verses.raw: None of the angels could enter and could behold His face by reason of the magnificence and glory and no flesh could behold Him.
verses.text: None of the angels could enter and could behold His face by reason of the magnificence and glory and no flesh could behold Him.

verses.raw: The flaming fire was round about Him, and a great fire stood before Him, and none around could draw nigh Him: ten thousand times ten thousand (stood) before Him, yet He needed no counsellor.
verses.text: The flaming fire was round about Him, and a great fire stood before Him, and none around could draw nigh Him: ten thousand times ten thousand (stood) before Him, yet He needed no counsellor.

verses.raw: And the most holy ones who were nigh to Him did not leave by night nor depart from Him.
verses.text: And the most holy ones who were nigh to Him did not leave by night nor depart from Him.

verses.raw: And until then I had been prostrate on my face, trembling: and Yahuah (Lord) called me with His own mouth, and said to me: ‘Come hither, Enoch, and hear my word.’
verses.text: And until then I had been prostrate on my face, trembling: and Yahuah called me with His own mouth, and said to me: ‘Come hither, Enoch, and hear my word.’

verses.raw: And one of the holy ones came to me and waked me, and He made me rise up and approach the door: and I bowed my face downwards.
verses.text: And one of the holy ones came to me and waked me, and He made me rise up and approach the door: and I bowed my face downwards.

verses.raw: And He answered and said to me, and I heard His voice: ‘Fear not, Enoch, thou righteous man and scribe of righteousness: approach hither and hear my voice.
verses.text: And He answered and said to me, and I heard His voice: ‘Fear not, Enoch, thou righteous man and scribe of righteousness: approach hither and hear my voice.

verses.raw: And go, say to the Watchers of heaven, who have sent thee to intercede for them: "You should intercede for men, and not men for you:
verses.text: And go, say to the Watchers of heaven, who have sent thee to intercede for them: "You should intercede for men, and not men for you:

verses.raw: Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?
verses.text: Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons?

verses.raw: And though ye were holy, spiritual, living the eternal life, you have defiled yourselves with the blood of women, and have begotten (children) with the blood of flesh, and, as the children of men, have lusted after flesh and blood as those also do who die and perish.
verses.text: And though ye were holy, spiritual, living the eternal life, you have defiled yourselves with the blood of women, and have begotten (children) with the blood of flesh, and, as the children of men, have lusted after flesh and blood as those also do who die and perish.

verses.raw: Therefore have I given them wives also that they might impregnate them, and beget children by them, that thus nothing might be wanting to them on earth.
verses.text: Therefore have I given them wives also that they might impregnate them, and beget children by them, that thus nothing might be wanting to them on earth.

verses.raw: But you were formerly spiritual, living the eternal life, and immortal for all generations of the world.
verses.text: But you were formerly spiritual, living the eternal life, and immortal for all generations of the world.

verses.raw: And therefore I have not appointed wives for you; for as for the spiritual ones of the heaven, in heaven is their dwelling.
verses.text: And therefore I have not appointed wives for you; for as for the spiritual ones of the heaven, in heaven is their dwelling.

verses.raw: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.
verses.text: And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.

verses.raw: Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.
verses.text: Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.

verses.raw: [As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]
verses.text: [As for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.]

verses.raw: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.
verses.text: And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences.

verses.raw: And these spirits shall rise up against the children of men and against the women, because they have proceeded from them.
verses.text: And these spirits shall rise up against the children of men and against the women, because they have proceeded from them.

verses.raw: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."
verses.text: From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."

verses.raw: And now as to the watchers who have sent thee to intercede for them, who had been aforetime in heaven, (say to them):
verses.text: And now as to the watchers who have sent thee to intercede for them, who had been aforetime in heaven, (say to them):

verses.raw: “You have been in heaven, but all the mysteries had not yet been revealed to you, and you knew worthless ones, and these in the hardness of your hearts you have made known to the women, and through these mysteries women and men work much evil on earth."
verses.text: “You have been in heaven, but all the mysteries had not yet been revealed to you, and you knew worthless ones, and these in the hardness of your hearts you have made known to the women, and through these mysteries women and men work much evil on earth."

verses.raw: Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”’
verses.text: Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”’

verses.raw: And they took and brought me to a place in which those who were there were like flaming fire, and, when they wished, they appeared as men.
verses.text: And they took and brought me to a place in which those who were there were like flaming fire, and, when they wished, they appeared as men.

verses.raw: And they brought me to the place of darkness, and to a mountain the point of whose summit reached to heaven.
verses.text: And they brought me to the place of darkness, and to a mountain the point of whose summit reached to heaven.

verses.raw: And I saw the places of the luminaries and the treasuries of the stars and of the thunder and in the uttermost depths, where were a fiery bow and arrows and their quiver, and a fiery sword and all the lightnings.
verses.text: And I saw the places of the luminaries and the treasuries of the stars and of the thunder and in the uttermost depths, where were a fiery bow and arrows and their quiver, and a fiery sword and all the lightnings.

verses.raw: And they took me to the living waters, and to the fire of the west, which receives every setting of the sun.
verses.text: And they took me to the living waters, and to the fire of the west, which receives every setting of the sun.

verses.raw: And I came to a river of fire in which the fire flows like water and discharges itself into the great sea towards the west.
verses.text: And I came to a river of fire in which the fire flows like water and discharges itself into the great sea towards the west.

verses.raw: I saw the great rivers and came to the great river and to the great darkness, and went to the place where no flesh walks.
verses.text: I saw the great rivers and came to the great river and to the great darkness, and went to the place where no flesh walks.

verses.raw: I saw the mountains of the darkness of winter and the place whence all the waters of the deep flow.
verses.text: I saw the mountains of the darkness of winter and the place whence all the waters of the deep flow.

verses.raw: I saw the mouths of all the rivers of the earth and the mouth of the deep.
verses.text: I saw the mouths of all the rivers of the earth and the mouth of the deep.

verses.raw: I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth.
verses.text: I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth.

verses.raw: And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven.
verses.text: And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven.

verses.raw: And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven.
verses.text: And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven.

verses.raw: I saw the winds of heaven which turn and bring the circumference of the sun and all the stars to their setting.
verses.text: I saw the winds of heaven which turn and bring the circumference of the sun and all the stars to their setting.

verses.raw: I saw the winds on the earth carrying the clouds: I saw the paths of the angels. I saw at the end of the earth the firmament of the heaven above.
verses.text: I saw the winds on the earth carrying the clouds: I saw the paths of the angels. I saw at the end of the earth the firmament of the heaven above.

verses.raw: And I proceeded and saw a place which burns day and night, where there are seven mountains of magnificent stones, three towards the east, and three towards the south.
verses.text: And I proceeded and saw a place which burns day and night, where there are seven mountains of magnificent stones, three towards the east, and three towards the south.

verses.raw: And as for those towards the east, one was of coloured stone, and one of pearl, and one of jacinth, and those towards the south of red stone.
verses.text: And as for those towards the east, one was of coloured stone, and one of pearl, and one of jacinth, and those towards the south of red stone.

verses.raw: But the middle one reached to heaven like the throne of Elohim (God), of alabaster, and the summit of the throne was of sapphire.
verses.text: But the middle one reached to heaven like the throne of Elohim, of alabaster, and the summit of the throne was of sapphire.

verses.raw: And I saw a flaming fire.
verses.text: And I saw a flaming fire.

verses.raw: And beyond these mountains Is a region the end of the great earth: there the heavens were completed.
verses.text: And beyond these mountains Is a region the end of the great earth: there the heavens were completed.

verses.raw: And I saw a deep abyss, with columns of heavenly fire, and among them I saw columns of fire fall, which were beyond measure alike towards the height and towards the depth.
verses.text: And I saw a deep abyss, with columns of heavenly fire, and among them I saw columns of fire fall, which were beyond measure alike towards the height and towards the depth.

verses.raw: And beyond that abyss I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above, and no firmly founded earth beneath it: there was no water upon it, and no birds, but it was a waste and horrible place.
verses.text: And beyond that abyss I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above, and no firmly founded earth beneath it: there was no water upon it, and no birds, but it was a waste and horrible place.

verses.raw: I saw there seven stars like great burning mountains, and to me, when I inquired regarding them,
verses.text: I saw there seven stars like great burning mountains, and to me, when I inquired regarding them,

verses.raw: The angel said: ‘This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.
verses.text: The angel said: ‘This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.

verses.raw: And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.
verses.text: And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.

verses.raw: And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’
verses.text: And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’

verses.raw: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.
verses.text: And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits assuming many different forms are defiling mankind and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand,) till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of.

verses.raw: And the women also of the angels who went astray shall become sirens.’
verses.text: And the women also of the angels who went astray shall become sirens.’

verses.raw: And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision, the ends of all things: and no man shall see as I have seen.
verses.text: And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision, the ends of all things: and no man shall see as I have seen.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the holy angels who watch.
verses.text: And these are the names of the holy angels who watch.

verses.raw: Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.
verses.text: Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus.

verses.raw: Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.
verses.text: Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men.

verses.raw: Raguel, one of the holy angels who takes vengeance on the world of the luminaries.
verses.text: Raguel, one of the holy angels who takes vengeance on the world of the luminaries.

verses.raw: Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind and over chaos.
verses.text: Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind and over chaos.

verses.raw: Saraqâêl, one of the holy angels, who is set over the spirits, who sin in the spirit.
verses.text: Saraqâêl, one of the holy angels, who is set over the spirits, who sin in the spirit.

verses.raw: Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim.
verses.text: Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim.

verses.raw: Remiel, one of the holy angels, whom Elohim (God) set over those who rise.
verses.text: Remiel, one of the holy angels, whom Elohim set over those who rise.

verses.raw: And I proceeded to where things were chaotic.
verses.text: And I proceeded to where things were chaotic.

verses.raw: And I saw there something horrible: I saw neither a heaven above nor a firmly founded earth, but a place chaotic and horrible.
verses.text: And I saw there something horrible: I saw neither a heaven above nor a firmly founded earth, but a place chaotic and horrible.

verses.raw: And there I saw seven stars of the heaven bound together in it, like great mountains and burning with fire.
verses.text: And there I saw seven stars of the heaven bound together in it, like great mountains and burning with fire.

verses.raw: Then I said: ‘For what sin are they bound, and on what account have they been cast in hither?’
verses.text: Then I said: ‘For what sin are they bound, and on what account have they been cast in hither?’

verses.raw: Then said Uriel, one of the holy angels, who was with me, and was chief over them, and said: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask, and why art thou eager for the truth?
verses.text: Then said Uriel, one of the holy angels, who was with me, and was chief over them, and said: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask, and why art thou eager for the truth?

verses.raw: These are of the number of the stars of heaven, which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord), and are bound here till ten thousand years, the time entailed by their sins, are consummated.’
verses.text: These are of the number of the stars of heaven, which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah, and are bound here till ten thousand years, the time entailed by their sins, are consummated.’

verses.raw: And from thence I went to another place, which was still more horrible than the former, and I saw a horrible thing: a great fire there which burnt and blazed, and the place was cleft as far as the abyss, being full of great descending columns of fire: neither its extent or magnitude could I see, nor could I conjecture.
verses.text: And from thence I went to another place, which was still more horrible than the former, and I saw a horrible thing: a great fire there which burnt and blazed, and the place was cleft as far as the abyss, being full of great descending columns of fire: neither its extent or magnitude could I see, nor could I conjecture.

verses.raw: Then I said: ‘How fearful is the place and how terrible to look upon!’
verses.text: Then I said: ‘How fearful is the place and how terrible to look upon!’

verses.raw: Then Uriel answered me, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘Enoch, why hast thou such fear and affright?’ And I answered: ‘Because of this fearful place, and because of the spectacle of the pain.’
verses.text: Then Uriel answered me, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘Enoch, why hast thou such fear and affright?’ And I answered: ‘Because of this fearful place, and because of the spectacle of the pain.’

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’

verses.raw: And thence I went to another place, and he showed me in the west another great and high mountain [and] of hard rock.
verses.text: And thence I went to another place, and he showed me in the west another great and high mountain [and] of hard rock.

verses.raw: And there was in it four hollow places, deep and wide and very smooth. How smooth are the hollow places and deep and dark to look at.
verses.text: And there was in it four hollow places, deep and wide and very smooth. How smooth are the hollow places and deep and dark to look at.

verses.raw: Then Raphael answered, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘These hollow places have been created for this very purpose, that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble therein, yea that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here.
verses.text: Then Raphael answered, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘These hollow places have been created for this very purpose, that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble therein, yea that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here.

verses.raw: And these places have been made to receive them till the day of their judgement and till their appointed period [till the period appointed], till the great judgement (comes) upon them.’
verses.text: And these places have been made to receive them till the day of their judgement and till their appointed period [till the period appointed], till the great judgement (comes) upon them.’

verses.raw: I saw the spirits of the children of men who were dead, and their voice went forth to heaven and made suit.
verses.text: I saw the spirits of the children of men who were dead, and their voice went forth to heaven and made suit.

verses.raw: Then I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit—whose is it, whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit?’
verses.text: Then I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit—whose is it, whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit?’

verses.raw: And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’
verses.text: And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’

verses.raw: Then I asked regarding it, and regarding all the hollow places: ’Why is one separated from the other?’
verses.text: Then I asked regarding it, and regarding all the hollow places: ’Why is one separated from the other?’

verses.raw: And he answered me and said unto me: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water.
verses.text: And he answered me and said unto me: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water.

verses.raw: And such has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed on them in their lifetime.
verses.text: And such has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed on them in their lifetime.

verses.raw: Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.
verses.text: Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever.

verses.raw: And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners.
verses.text: And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners.

verses.raw: Such has been made for the spirits of men who were not righteous but sinners, who were complete in transgression, and of the transgressors they shall be companions: but their spirits shall not be slain in the day of judgement nor shall they be raised from thence.
verses.text: Such has been made for the spirits of men who were not righteous but sinners, who were complete in transgression, and of the transgressors they shall be companions: but their spirits shall not be slain in the day of judgement nor shall they be raised from thence.

verses.raw: Then I blessed Yahuah (Lord) of glory and said: ‘Blessed be my Lord, Yahuah (Lord) of righteousness, who ruleth for ever.’
verses.text: Then I blessed Yahuah of glory and said: ‘Blessed be my Lord, Yahuah of righteousness, who ruleth for ever.’

verses.raw: From thence I went to another place to the west of the ends of the earth.
verses.text: From thence I went to another place to the west of the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: And I saw a burning fire which ran without resting, and paused not from its course day or night but (ran) regularly.
verses.text: And I saw a burning fire which ran without resting, and paused not from its course day or night but (ran) regularly.

verses.raw: And I asked saying: ‘What is this which rests not?’
verses.text: And I asked saying: ‘What is this which rests not?’

verses.raw: Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said unto me: ‘This course of fire which thou hast seen is the fire in the west which persecutes all the luminaries of heaven.’
verses.text: Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said unto me: ‘This course of fire which thou hast seen is the fire in the west which persecutes all the luminaries of heaven.’

verses.raw: And from thence I went to another place of the earth, and he showed me a mountain range of fire which burnt day and night.
verses.text: And from thence I went to another place of the earth, and he showed me a mountain range of fire which burnt day and night.

verses.raw: And I went beyond it and saw seven magnificent mountains all differing each from the other, and the stones (thereof) were magnificent and beautiful, magnificent as a whole, of glorious appearance and fair exterior: three towards the east, one founded on the other, and three towards the south, one upon the other, and deep rough ravines, no one of which joined with any other.
verses.text: And I went beyond it and saw seven magnificent mountains all differing each from the other, and the stones (thereof) were magnificent and beautiful, magnificent as a whole, of glorious appearance and fair exterior: three towards the east, one founded on the other, and three towards the south, one upon the other, and deep rough ravines, no one of which joined with any other.

verses.raw: And the seventh mountain was in the midst of these, and it excelled them in height, resembling the seat of a throne: and fragrant trees encircled the throne.
verses.text: And the seventh mountain was in the midst of these, and it excelled them in height, resembling the seat of a throne: and fragrant trees encircled the throne.

verses.raw: And amongst them was a tree such as I had never yet smelt, neither was any amongst them nor were others like it: it had a fragrance beyond all fragrance, and its leaves and blooms and wood wither not for ever: and its fruit is beautiful, and its fruit resembles the dates of a palm.
verses.text: And amongst them was a tree such as I had never yet smelt, neither was any amongst them nor were others like it: it had a fragrance beyond all fragrance, and its leaves and blooms and wood wither not for ever: and its fruit is beautiful, and its fruit resembles the dates of a palm.

verses.raw: Then I said: ‘How beautiful is this tree, and fragrant, and its leaves are fair, and its blooms very delightful in appearance.’
verses.text: Then I said: ‘How beautiful is this tree, and fragrant, and its leaves are fair, and its blooms very delightful in appearance.’

verses.raw: Then answered Michael, one of the holy and honoured angels who was with me, and was their leader.
verses.text: Then answered Michael, one of the holy and honoured angels who was with me, and was their leader.

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask me regarding the fragrance of the tree, and why dost thou wish to learn the truth?’
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask me regarding the fragrance of the tree, and why dost thou wish to learn the truth?’

verses.raw: Then I answered him saying: ‘I wish to know about everything, but especially about this tree.’
verses.text: Then I answered him saying: ‘I wish to know about everything, but especially about this tree.’

verses.raw: And he answered saying: ‘This high mountain which thou hast seen, whose summit is like the throne of Elohim (God), is His throne, where the Holy Great One, Yahuah (Lord) of Glory, the Eternal King, will sit, when He shall come down to visit the earth with goodness.
verses.text: And he answered saying: ‘This high mountain which thou hast seen, whose summit is like the throne of Elohim, is His throne, where the Holy Great One, Yahuah of Glory, the Eternal King, will sit, when He shall come down to visit the earth with goodness.

verses.raw: And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy.
verses.text: And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy.

verses.raw: Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King.
verses.text: Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah, the Eternal King.

verses.raw: Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad, And into the holy place shall they enter; And its fragrance shall be in their bones, And they shall live a long life on earth, Such as thy fathers lived: And in their days shall no sorrow or plague Or torment or calamity touch them.’
verses.text: Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad, And into the holy place shall they enter; And its fragrance shall be in their bones, And they shall live a long life on earth, Such as thy fathers lived: And in their days shall no sorrow or plague Or torment or calamity touch them.’

verses.raw: Then blessed I the Elohim (God) of Glory, the Eternal King, who hath prepared such things for the righteous, and hath created them and promised to give to them.
verses.text: Then blessed I the Elohim of Glory, the Eternal King, who hath prepared such things for the righteous, and hath created them and promised to give to them.

verses.raw: And I went from thence to the middle of the earth, and I saw a blessed place in which there were trees with branches abiding and blooming [of a dismembered tree].
verses.text: And I went from thence to the middle of the earth, and I saw a blessed place in which there were trees with branches abiding and blooming [of a dismembered tree].

verses.raw: And there I saw a holy mountain, and underneath the mountain to the east there was a stream and it flowed towards the south.
verses.text: And there I saw a holy mountain, and underneath the mountain to the east there was a stream and it flowed towards the south.

verses.raw: And I saw towards the east another mountain higher than this, and between them a deep and narrow ravine: in it also ran a stream underneath the mountain.
verses.text: And I saw towards the east another mountain higher than this, and between them a deep and narrow ravine: in it also ran a stream underneath the mountain.

verses.raw: And to the west thereof there was another mountain, lower than the former and of small elevation, and a ravine deep and dry between them: and another deep and dry ravine was at the extremities of the three mountains.
verses.text: And to the west thereof there was another mountain, lower than the former and of small elevation, and a ravine deep and dry between them: and another deep and dry ravine was at the extremities of the three mountains.

verses.raw: And all the ravines were deep and narrow, (being formed) of hard rock, and trees were not planted upon them.
verses.text: And all the ravines were deep and narrow, (being formed) of hard rock, and trees were not planted upon them.

verses.raw: And I marvelled at the rocks, and I marvelled at the ravine, yea, I marveled very much.
verses.text: And I marvelled at the rocks, and I marvelled at the ravine, yea, I marveled very much.

verses.raw: Then said I: ‘For what object is this blessed land, which is entirely filled with trees, and this accursed valley between?’
verses.text: Then said I: ‘For what object is this blessed land, which is entirely filled with trees, and this accursed valley between?’

verses.raw: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah (Lord) unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.
verses.text: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This accursed valley is for those who are accursed for ever: Here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against Yahuah unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement.

verses.raw: In the last days there shall be upon them the spectacle of righteous judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the merciful bless Yahuah (Lord) of glory, the Eternal King. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be the place of their habitation.
verses.text: In the last days there shall be upon them the spectacle of righteous judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the merciful bless Yahuah of glory, the Eternal King. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be the place of their habitation.

verses.raw: In the days of judgement over the former, they shall bless Him for the mercy in accordance with which He has assigned them (their lot).’
verses.text: In the days of judgement over the former, they shall bless Him for the mercy in accordance with which He has assigned them (their lot).’

verses.raw: Then I blessed Yahuah (Lord) of Glory and set forth His glory and lauded Him gloriously.
verses.text: Then I blessed Yahuah of Glory and set forth His glory and lauded Him gloriously.

verses.raw: And thence I went towards the east, into the midst of the mountain range of the desert, and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees and plants.
verses.text: And thence I went towards the east, into the midst of the mountain range of the desert, and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees and plants.

verses.raw: And water gushed forth from above.
verses.text: And water gushed forth from above.

verses.raw: Rushing like a copious watercourse [which flowed] towards the north- west it caused clouds and dew to ascend on every side.
verses.text: Rushing like a copious watercourse [which flowed] towards the north- west it caused clouds and dew to ascend on every side.

verses.raw: And thence I went to another place in the desert, and approached to the east of this mountain range.
verses.text: And thence I went to another place in the desert, and approached to the east of this mountain range.

verses.raw: And there I saw aromatic trees exhaling the fragrance of frankincense and myrrh, and the trees also were similar to the almond tree.
verses.text: And there I saw aromatic trees exhaling the fragrance of frankincense and myrrh, and the trees also were similar to the almond tree.

verses.raw: And beyond these, I went afar to the east, and I saw another place, a valley (full) of water.
verses.text: And beyond these, I went afar to the east, and I saw another place, a valley (full) of water.

verses.raw: And therein there was a tree, the colour (?) of fragrant trees such as the mastic.
verses.text: And therein there was a tree, the colour (?) of fragrant trees such as the mastic.

verses.raw: And on the sides of those valleys I saw fragrant cinnamon. And beyond these I proceeded to the east.
verses.text: And on the sides of those valleys I saw fragrant cinnamon. And beyond these I proceeded to the east.

verses.raw: And I saw other mountains, and amongst them were groves of trees, and there flowed forth from them nectar, which is named sarara and galbanum.
verses.text: And I saw other mountains, and amongst them were groves of trees, and there flowed forth from them nectar, which is named sarara and galbanum.

verses.raw: And beyond these mountains I saw another mountain to the east of the ends of the earth, whereon were aloe-trees, and all the trees were full of stacte, being like almond-trees.
verses.text: And beyond these mountains I saw another mountain to the east of the ends of the earth, whereon were aloe-trees, and all the trees were full of stacte, being like almond-trees.

verses.raw: And when one burnt it, it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour.
verses.text: And when one burnt it, it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour.

verses.raw: And after these fragrant odours, as I looked towards the north over the mountains I saw seven mountains full of choice nard and fragrant trees and cinnamon and pepper.
verses.text: And after these fragrant odours, as I looked towards the north over the mountains I saw seven mountains full of choice nard and fragrant trees and cinnamon and pepper.

verses.raw: And thence I went over the summits of all these mountains, far towards the east of the earth, and passed above the Erythraean sea and went far from it, and passed over the angel Zotîêl.
verses.text: And thence I went over the summits of all these mountains, far towards the east of the earth, and passed above the Erythraean sea and went far from it, and passed over the angel Zotîêl.

verses.raw: And I came to the Garden of Righteousness, and saw beyond those trees many large trees growing there and of goodly fragrance, large, very beautiful and glorious, and the tree of wisdom whereof they eat and know great wisdom.
verses.text: And I came to the Garden of Righteousness, and saw beyond those trees many large trees growing there and of goodly fragrance, large, very beautiful and glorious, and the tree of wisdom whereof they eat and know great wisdom.

verses.raw: That tree is in height like the fir, and its leaves are like (those of) the Carob tree: and its fruit is like the clusters of the vine, very beautiful: and the fragrance of the tree penetrates afar.
verses.text: That tree is in height like the fir, and its leaves are like (those of) the Carob tree: and its fruit is like the clusters of the vine, very beautiful: and the fragrance of the tree penetrates afar.

verses.raw: Then I said: ‘How beautiful is the tree, and how attractive is its look!’
verses.text: Then I said: ‘How beautiful is the tree, and how attractive is its look!’

verses.raw: Then Raphael the holy angel, who was with me, answered me and said: ‘This is the tree of wisdom, of which thy father old (in years) and thy aged mother, who were before thee, have eaten, and they learnt wisdom and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked and they were driven out of the garden.’
verses.text: Then Raphael the holy angel, who was with me, answered me and said: ‘This is the tree of wisdom, of which thy father old (in years) and thy aged mother, who were before thee, have eaten, and they learnt wisdom and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked and they were driven out of the garden.’

verses.raw: And from thence I went to the ends of the earth and saw there great beasts, and each differed from the other; and (I saw) birds also differing in appearance and beauty and voice, the one differing from the other.
verses.text: And from thence I went to the ends of the earth and saw there great beasts, and each differed from the other; and (I saw) birds also differing in appearance and beauty and voice, the one differing from the other.

verses.raw: And to the east of those beasts I saw the ends of the earth whereon the heaven rests, and the portals of the heaven open.
verses.text: And to the east of those beasts I saw the ends of the earth whereon the heaven rests, and the portals of the heaven open.

verses.raw: And I saw how the stars of heaven come forth, and I counted the portals out of which they proceed, and wrote down all their outlets, of each individual star by itself, according to their number and their names, their courses and their positions, and their times and their months, as Uriel the holy angel who was with me showed me.
verses.text: And I saw how the stars of heaven come forth, and I counted the portals out of which they proceed, and wrote down all their outlets, of each individual star by itself, according to their number and their names, their courses and their positions, and their times and their months, as Uriel the holy angel who was with me showed me.

verses.raw: He showed all things to me and wrote them down for me: also their names he wrote for me, and their laws and their companies.
verses.text: He showed all things to me and wrote them down for me: also their names he wrote for me, and their laws and their companies.

verses.raw: And from thence I went towards the north to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious device at the ends of the whole earth.
verses.text: And from thence I went towards the north to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious device at the ends of the whole earth.

verses.raw: And here I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven: through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain.
verses.text: And here I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven: through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain.

verses.raw: And out of one portal they blow for good: but when they blow through the other two portals, it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.
verses.text: And out of one portal they blow for good: but when they blow through the other two portals, it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.

verses.raw: And from thence I went towards the west to the ends of the earth, and saw there three portals of the heaven open such as I had seen in the east, the same number of portals, and the same number of outlets.
verses.text: And from thence I went towards the west to the ends of the earth, and saw there three portals of the heaven open such as I had seen in the east, the same number of portals, and the same number of outlets.

verses.raw: And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew, rain, and wind.
verses.text: And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew, rain, and wind.

verses.raw: And from thence I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and saw here the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them.
verses.text: And from thence I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and saw here the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them.

verses.raw: Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path which is shown to them.
verses.text: Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path which is shown to them.

verses.raw: And as often as I saw I blessed always Yahuah (Lord) of Glory, and I continued to bless Yahuah (Lord) of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to spirits and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever.
verses.text: And as often as I saw I blessed always Yahuah of Glory, and I continued to bless Yahuah of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to spirits and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever.

verses.raw: The second vision which he saw, the vision of wisdom—which Enoch the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan, the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, saw.
verses.text: The second vision which he saw, the vision of wisdom—which Enoch the son of Jared, the son of Mahalalel, the son of Cainan, the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, saw.

verses.raw: And this is the beginning of the words of wisdom which I lifted up my voice to speak and say to those which dwell on earth: Hear, ye men of old time, and see, ye that come after, the words of the Holy One which I will speak before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And this is the beginning of the words of wisdom which I lifted up my voice to speak and say to those which dwell on earth: Hear, ye men of old time, and see, ye that come after, the words of the Holy One which I will speak before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: It were better to declare (them only) to the men of old time, but even from those that come after we will not withhold the beginning of wisdom.
verses.text: It were better to declare (them only) to the men of old time, but even from those that come after we will not withhold the beginning of wisdom.

verses.raw: Till the present day such wisdom has never been given by Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits as I have received according to my insight, according to the good pleasure of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits by whom the lot of eternal life has been given to me.
verses.text: Till the present day such wisdom has never been given by Yahuah of Spirits as I have received according to my insight, according to the good pleasure of Yahuah of Spirits by whom the lot of eternal life has been given to me.

verses.raw: Now three Parables were imparted to me, and I lifted up my voice and recounted them to those that dwell on the earth.
verses.text: Now three Parables were imparted to me, and I lifted up my voice and recounted them to those that dwell on the earth.

verses.raw: The First Parable. When the congregation of the righteous shall appear, And sinners shall be judged for their sins, And shall be driven from the face of the earth:
verses.text: The First Parable. When the congregation of the righteous shall appear, And sinners shall be judged for their sins, And shall be driven from the face of the earth:

verses.raw: And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.
verses.text: And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.

verses.raw: When the secrets of the righteous shall be revealed and the sinners judged, And the godless driven from the presence of the righteous and elect,
verses.text: When the secrets of the righteous shall be revealed and the sinners judged, And the godless driven from the presence of the righteous and elect,

verses.raw: From that time those that possess the earth shall no longer be powerful and exalted: And they shall not be able to behold the face of the holy, For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has caused His light to appear On the face of the holy, righteous, and elect.
verses.text: From that time those that possess the earth shall no longer be powerful and exalted: And they shall not be able to behold the face of the holy, For Yahuah of Spirits has caused His light to appear On the face of the holy, righteous, and elect.

verses.raw: Then shall the kings and the mighty perish And be given into the hands of the righteous and holy.
verses.text: Then shall the kings and the mighty perish And be given into the hands of the righteous and holy.

verses.raw: And thenceforward none shall seek for themselves mercy from Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits For their life is at an end.
verses.text: And thenceforward none shall seek for themselves mercy from Yahuah of Spirits For their life is at an end.

verses.raw: [And it shall come to pass in those days that elect and holy children will descend from the high heaven, and their seed will become one with the children of men.
verses.text: [And it shall come to pass in those days that elect and holy children will descend from the high heaven, and their seed will become one with the children of men.

verses.raw: And in those days Enoch received books of zeal and wrath, and books of disquiet and expulsion.] And mercy shall not be accorded to them, saith Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And in those days Enoch received books of zeal and wrath, and books of disquiet and expulsion.] And mercy shall not be accorded to them, saith Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And in those days a whirlwind carried me off from the earth, And set me down at the end of the heavens.
verses.text: And in those days a whirlwind carried me off from the earth, And set me down at the end of the heavens.

verses.raw: And there I saw another vision, the dwelling-places of the holy, And the resting-places of the righteous.
verses.text: And there I saw another vision, the dwelling-places of the holy, And the resting-places of the righteous.

verses.raw: Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, And their resting-places with the holy. And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men, And righteousness flowed before them as water, And mercy like dew upon the earth: Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.
verses.text: Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, And their resting-places with the holy. And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men, And righteousness flowed before them as water, And mercy like dew upon the earth: Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And in that place mine eyes saw the Elect One of righteousness and of faith, And righteousness shall prevail in his days, And the righteous and elect shall be without number before Him for ever and ever.
verses.text: And in that place mine eyes saw the Elect One of righteousness and of faith, And righteousness shall prevail in his days, And the righteous and elect shall be without number before Him for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And I saw his dwelling-place under the wings of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And all the righteous and elect before Him shall be strong as fiery lights, And their mouth shall be full of blessing, And their lips extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And righteousness before Him shall never fail, [And uprightness shall never fail before Him.]
verses.text: And I saw his dwelling-place under the wings of Yahuah of Spirits. And all the righteous and elect before Him shall be strong as fiery lights, And their mouth shall be full of blessing, And their lips extol the name of Yahuah of Spirits, And righteousness before Him shall never fail, [And uprightness shall never fail before Him.]

verses.raw: There I wished to dwell, And my spirit longed for that dwelling-place: And there heretofore hath been my portion, For so has it been established concerning me before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: There I wished to dwell, And my spirit longed for that dwelling-place: And there heretofore hath been my portion, For so has it been established concerning me before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: In those days I praised and extolled the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits with blessings and praises, because He hath destined me for blessing and glory according to the good pleasure of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: In those days I praised and extolled the name of Yahuah of Spirits with blessings and praises, because He hath destined me for blessing and glory according to the good pleasure of Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: For a long time my eyes regarded that place, and I blessed Him and praised Him, saying: ‘Blessed is He, and may He be blessed from the beginning and for evermore.
verses.text: For a long time my eyes regarded that place, and I blessed Him and praised Him, saying: ‘Blessed is He, and may He be blessed from the beginning and for evermore.

verses.raw: And before Him there is no ceasing. He knows before the world was created what is for ever and what will be from generation unto generation.
verses.text: And before Him there is no ceasing. He knows before the world was created what is for ever and what will be from generation unto generation.

verses.raw: Those who sleep not bless Thee: they stand before Thy glory and bless, praise, and extol, saying: “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: He filleth the earth with spirits.”’
verses.text: Those who sleep not bless Thee: they stand before Thy glory and bless, praise, and extol, saying: “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah of Spirits: He filleth the earth with spirits.”’

verses.raw: And here my eyes saw all those who sleep not: they stand before Him and bless and say: ‘Blessed be Thou, and blessed be the name of Yahuah (Lord) for ever and ever.’
verses.text: And here my eyes saw all those who sleep not: they stand before Him and bless and say: ‘Blessed be Thou, and blessed be the name of Yahuah for ever and ever.’

verses.raw: And my face was changed; for I could no longer behold.
verses.text: And my face was changed; for I could no longer behold.

verses.raw: And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.
verses.text: And on the four sides of Yahuah of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.

verses.raw: And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (Lord) of glory.
verses.text: And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah of glory.

verses.raw: The first voice blesses Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.
verses.text: The first voice blesses Yahuah of Spirits for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And the third voice I heard pray and intercede for those who dwell on the earth and supplicate in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And the third voice I heard pray and intercede for those who dwell on the earth and supplicate in the name of Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.
verses.text: And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.

verses.raw: After that I asked the angel of peace who went with me, who showed me everything that is hidden: ‘Who are these four presences which I have seen and whose words I have heard and written down?’
verses.text: After that I asked the angel of peace who went with me, who showed me everything that is hidden: ‘Who are these four presences which I have seen and whose words I have heard and written down?’

verses.raw: And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’
verses.text: And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’

verses.raw: And these are the four angels of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits and the four voices I heard in those days.
verses.text: And these are the four angels of Yahuah of Spirits and the four voices I heard in those days.

verses.raw: And after that I saw all the secrets of the heavens, and how the kingdom is divided, and how the actions of men are weighed in the balance.
verses.text: And after that I saw all the secrets of the heavens, and how the kingdom is divided, and how the actions of men are weighed in the balance.

verses.raw: And there I saw the mansions of the elect and the mansions of the holy, and mine eyes saw there all the sinners being driven from thence which deny the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and being dragged off: and they could not abide because of the punishment which proceeds from Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And there I saw the mansions of the elect and the mansions of the holy, and mine eyes saw there all the sinners being driven from thence which deny the name of Yahuah of Spirits, and being dragged off: and they could not abide because of the punishment which proceeds from Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And there mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightning and of the thunder, and the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.
verses.text: And there mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightning and of the thunder, and the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.

verses.raw: And there I saw closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world.
verses.text: And there I saw closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world.

verses.raw: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.
verses.text: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.

verses.raw: And first the sun goes forth and traverses his path according to the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and mighty is His name for ever and ever.
verses.text: And first the sun goes forth and traverses his path according to the commandment of Yahuah of Spirits, and mighty is His name for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And after that I saw the hidden and the visible path of the moon, and she accomplishes the course of her path in that place by day and by night—the one holding a position opposite to the other before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And they give thanks and praise and rest not; For unto them is their thanksgiving rest.
verses.text: And after that I saw the hidden and the visible path of the moon, and she accomplishes the course of her path in that place by day and by night—the one holding a position opposite to the other before Yahuah of Spirits. And they give thanks and praise and rest not; For unto them is their thanksgiving rest.

verses.raw: For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse, And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous And darkness to the sinners in the name of Yahuah (Lord), Who made a separation between the light and the darkness, And divided the spirits of men, And strengthened the spirits of the righteous, In the name of His righteousness.
verses.text: For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse, And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous And darkness to the sinners in the name of Yahuah, Who made a separation between the light and the darkness, And divided the spirits of men, And strengthened the spirits of the righteous, In the name of His righteousness.

verses.raw: For no angel hinders and no power is able to hinder; for He appoints a judge for them all and He judges them all before Him.
verses.text: For no angel hinders and no power is able to hinder; for He appoints a judge for them all and He judges them all before Him.

verses.raw: Wisdom found no place where she might dwell; Then a dwelling-place was assigned her in the heavens.
verses.text: Wisdom found no place where she might dwell; Then a dwelling-place was assigned her in the heavens.

verses.raw: Wisdom went forth to make her dwelling among the children of men, And found no dwelling-place: Wisdom returned to her place, And took her seat among the angels.
verses.text: Wisdom went forth to make her dwelling among the children of men, And found no dwelling-place: Wisdom returned to her place, And took her seat among the angels.

verses.raw: And unrighteousness went forth from her chambers: Whom she sought not she found, And dwelt with them, As rain in a desert And dew on a thirsty land.
verses.text: And unrighteousness went forth from her chambers: Whom she sought not she found, And dwelt with them, As rain in a desert And dew on a thirsty land.

verses.raw: And I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how He called them all by their names and they hearkened unto Him.
verses.text: And I saw other lightnings and the stars of heaven, and I saw how He called them all by their names and they hearkened unto Him.

verses.raw: And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.
verses.text: And I saw how they are weighed in a righteous balance according to their proportions of light: (I saw) the width of their spaces and the day of their appearing, and how their revolution produces lightning: and (I saw) their revolution according to the number of the angels, and (how) they keep faith with each other.

verses.raw: And I asked the angel who went with me who showed me what was hidden: ‘What are these?’
verses.text: And I asked the angel who went with me who showed me what was hidden: ‘What are these?’

verses.raw: And he said to me: ‘Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath showed thee their parabolic meaning (lit. 'their parable'): these are the names of the holy who dwell on the earth and believe in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.’
verses.text: And he said to me: ‘Yahuah of Spirits hath showed thee their parabolic meaning (lit. 'their parable'): these are the names of the holy who dwell on the earth and believe in the name of Yahuah of Spirits for ever and ever.’

verses.raw: Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.
verses.text: Also another phenomenon I saw in regard to the lightnings: how some of the stars arise and become lightnings and cannot part with their new form.

verses.raw: And this is the second Parable concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And this is the second Parable concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And into the heaven they shall not ascend, And on the earth they shall not come: Such shall be the lot of the sinners Who have denied the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Who are thus preserved for the day of suffering and tribulation.
verses.text: And into the heaven they shall not ascend, And on the earth they shall not come: Such shall be the lot of the sinners Who have denied the name of Yahuah of Spirits, Who are thus preserved for the day of suffering and tribulation.

verses.raw: On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:
verses.text: On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:

verses.raw: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:
verses.text: Then will I cause Mine Elect One to dwell among them. And I will transform the heaven and make it an eternal blessing and light:

verses.raw: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.
verses.text: And I will transform the earth and make it a blessing: And I will cause Mine elect ones to dwell upon it: But the sinners and evil-doers shall not set foot thereon.

verses.raw: For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones And have caused them to dwell before Me: But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me, So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.
verses.text: For I have provided and satisfied with peace My righteous ones And have caused them to dwell before Me: But for the sinners there is judgement impending with Me, So that I shall destroy them from the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.
verses.text: And there I saw One who had a head of days, And His head was white like wool, And with Him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, And his face was full of graciousness, like one of the holy angels.

verses.raw: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?
verses.text: And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things, concerning that Son of Adam, who he was, and whence he was, (and) why he went with the Head of Days?
