verses.raw: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.
verses.text: And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah of Spirits in uprightness for ever.

verses.raw: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.
verses.text: And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.

verses.raw: [And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms] Because they do not extol and praise Him, Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.
verses.text: [And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms] Because they do not extol and praise Him, Nor humbly acknowledge whence the kingdom was bestowed upon them.

verses.raw: And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And he shall put down the countenance of the strong, And shall fill them with shame. And darkness shall be their dwelling, And worms shall be their bed, And they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, Because they do not extol the name of Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And these are they who judge the stars of heaven, [And raise their hands against the El Elyon (Most High)], And tread upon the earth and dwell upon it. And all their deeds manifest unrighteousness, And their power rests upon their riches, And their faith is in the gods which they have made with their hands, And they deny the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits,
verses.text: And these are they who judge the stars of heaven, [And raise their hands against the El Elyon], And tread upon the earth and dwell upon it. And all their deeds manifest unrighteousness, And their power rests upon their riches, And their faith is in the gods which they have made with their hands, And they deny the name of Yahuah of Spirits,

verses.raw: And they persecute the houses of His congregations, And the faithful who hang upon the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And they persecute the houses of His congregations, And the faithful who hang upon the name of Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous, And the blood of the righteous from the earth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And in those days shall have ascended the prayer of the righteous, And the blood of the righteous from the earth before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: In those days the holy ones who dwell above in the heavens Shall unite with one voice And supplicate and pray [and praise, And give thanks and bless the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits] On behalf of the blood of the righteous which has been shed, And that the prayer of the righteous may not be in vain before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, That judgement may be done unto them, And that they may not have to suffer for ever.
verses.text: In those days the holy ones who dwell above in the heavens Shall unite with one voice And supplicate and pray [and praise, And give thanks and bless the name of Yahuah of Spirits] On behalf of the blood of the righteous which has been shed, And that the prayer of the righteous may not be in vain before Yahuah of Spirits, That judgement may be done unto them, And that they may not have to suffer for ever.

verses.raw: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,
verses.text: In those days I saw the Head of Days when He seated himself upon the throne of His glory, And the books of the living were opened before Him: And all His host which is in heaven above and His counsellors stood before Him,

verses.raw: And the hearts of the holy were filled with joy; Because the number of the righteous had been offered, And the prayer of the righteous had been heard, And the blood of the righteous been required before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And the hearts of the holy were filled with joy; Because the number of the righteous had been offered, And the prayer of the righteous had been heard, And the blood of the righteous been required before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.
verses.text: And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.

verses.raw: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.
verses.text: And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.

verses.raw: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: Yea, before the sun and the signs were created, Before the stars of the heaven were made, His name was named before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.
verses.text: He shall be a staff to the righteous whereon to stay themselves and not fall, And he shall be the light of the Gentiles, And the hope of those who are troubled of heart.

verses.raw: All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him, And will praise and bless and celebrate with song Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: All who dwell on earth shall fall down and worship before him, And will praise and bless and celebrate with song Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.
verses.text: And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.

verses.raw: And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.
verses.text: And the wisdom of Yahuah of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.

verses.raw: In these days downcast in countenance shall the kings of the earth have become, And the strong who possess the land because of the works of their hands, For on the day of their anguish and affliction they shall not (be able to) save themselves.
verses.text: In these days downcast in countenance shall the kings of the earth have become, And the strong who possess the land because of the works of their hands, For on the day of their anguish and affliction they shall not (be able to) save themselves.

verses.raw: And I will give them over into the hands of Mine elect: As straw in the fire so shall they burn before the face of the holy: As lead in the water shall they sink before the face of the righteous, And no trace of them shall any more be found.
verses.text: And I will give them over into the hands of Mine elect: As straw in the fire so shall they burn before the face of the holy: As lead in the water shall they sink before the face of the righteous, And no trace of them shall any more be found.

verses.raw: And on the day of their affliction there shall be rest on the earth, And before them they shall fall and not rise again: And there shall be no one to take them with his hands and raise them: For they have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits and His Anointed. The name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits be blessed.
verses.text: And on the day of their affliction there shall be rest on the earth, And before them they shall fall and not rise again: And there shall be no one to take them with his hands and raise them: For they have denied Yahuah of Spirits and His Anointed. The name of Yahuah of Spirits be blessed.

verses.raw: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.
verses.text: For wisdom is poured out like water, And glory faileth not before him for evermore.

verses.raw: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.
verses.text: For he is mighty in all the secrets of righteousness, And unrighteousness shall disappear as a shadow, And have no continuance; Because the Elect One standeth before Yahuah of Spirits, And his glory is for ever and ever, And his might unto all generations.

verses.raw: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.
verses.text: And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.

verses.raw: And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.
verses.text: And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah of Spirits according to His good pleasure.

verses.raw: And in those days a change shall take place for the holy and elect, And the light of days shall abide upon them, And glory and honour shall turn to the holy,
verses.text: And in those days a change shall take place for the holy and elect, And the light of days shall abide upon them, And glory and honour shall turn to the holy,

verses.raw: On the day of affliction on which evil shall have been treasured up against the sinners. And the righteous shall be victorious in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: And He will cause the others to witness (this) That they may repent And forgo the works of their hands.
verses.text: On the day of affliction on which evil shall have been treasured up against the sinners. And the righteous shall be victorious in the name of Yahuah of Spirits: And He will cause the others to witness (this) That they may repent And forgo the works of their hands.

verses.raw: They shall have no honour through the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Yet through His name shall they be saved, And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits will have compassion on them, For His compassion is great.
verses.text: They shall have no honour through the name of Yahuah of Spirits, Yet through His name shall they be saved, And Yahuah of Spirits will have compassion on them, For His compassion is great.

verses.raw: And He is righteous also in His judgement, And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself: At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him.
verses.text: And He is righteous also in His judgement, And in the presence of His glory unrighteousness also shall not maintain itself: At His judgement the unrepentant shall perish before Him.

verses.raw: And from henceforth I will have no mercy on them, saith Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And from henceforth I will have no mercy on them, saith Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.
verses.text: And in those days shall the earth also give back that which has been entrusted to it, And Sheol also shall give back that which it has received, And hell shall give back that which it owes.

verses.raw: And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.
verses.text: And he shall choose the righteous and holy from among them: For the day has drawn nigh that they should be saved.

verses.raw: And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.
verses.text: And the Elect One shall in those days sit on My throne, And his mouth shall pour forth all the secrets of wisdom and counsel: For Yahuah of Spirits hath given (them) to him and hath glorified him.

verses.raw: And in those days shall the mountains leap like rams, And the hills also shall skip like lambs satisfied with milk, And the faces of [all] the angels in heaven shall be lighted up with joy.
verses.text: And in those days shall the mountains leap like rams, And the hills also shall skip like lambs satisfied with milk, And the faces of [all] the angels in heaven shall be lighted up with joy.

verses.raw: For in those days the Elect One shall arise, And the earth shall rejoice, And the righteous shall dwell upon it, And the elect shall walk thereon.
verses.text: For in those days the Elect One shall arise, And the earth shall rejoice, And the righteous shall dwell upon it, And the elect shall walk thereon.

verses.raw: And after those days in that place where I had seen all the visions of that which is hidden—for I had been carried off in a whirlwind and they had borne me towards the west—
verses.text: And after those days in that place where I had seen all the visions of that which is hidden—for I had been carried off in a whirlwind and they had borne me towards the west—

verses.raw: There mine eyes saw all the secret things of heaven that shall be, a mountain of iron, and a mountain of copper, and a mountain of silver, and a mountain of gold, and a mountain of soft metal, and a mountain of lead.
verses.text: There mine eyes saw all the secret things of heaven that shall be, a mountain of iron, and a mountain of copper, and a mountain of silver, and a mountain of gold, and a mountain of soft metal, and a mountain of lead.

verses.raw: And I asked the angel who went with me, saying, ‘What things are these which I have seen in secret?’
verses.text: And I asked the angel who went with me, saying, ‘What things are these which I have seen in secret?’

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘All these things which thou hast seen shall serve the dominion of His Anointed that he may be potent and mighty on the earth.’
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘All these things which thou hast seen shall serve the dominion of His Anointed that he may be potent and mighty on the earth.’

verses.raw: And that angel of peace answered, saying unto me: ‘Wait a little, and there shall be revealed unto thee all the secret things which surround Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And that angel of peace answered, saying unto me: ‘Wait a little, and there shall be revealed unto thee all the secret things which surround Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And these mountains which thine eyes have seen, The mountain of iron, and the mountain of copper, and the mountain of silver, And the mountain of gold, and the mountain of soft metal, and the mountain of lead, All these shall be in the presence of the Elect One As wax before the fire, And like the water which streams down from above [upon those mountains], And they shall become powerless before his feet.
verses.text: And these mountains which thine eyes have seen, The mountain of iron, and the mountain of copper, and the mountain of silver, And the mountain of gold, and the mountain of soft metal, and the mountain of lead, All these shall be in the presence of the Elect One As wax before the fire, And like the water which streams down from above [upon those mountains], And they shall become powerless before his feet.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in those days that none shall be saved, Either by gold or by silver, And none be able to escape.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in those days that none shall be saved, Either by gold or by silver, And none be able to escape.

verses.raw: And there shall be no iron for war, Nor shall one clothe oneself with a breastplate. Bronze shall be of no service, And tin [shall be of no service and] shall not be esteemed, And lead shall not be desired.
verses.text: And there shall be no iron for war, Nor shall one clothe oneself with a breastplate. Bronze shall be of no service, And tin [shall be of no service and] shall not be esteemed, And lead shall not be desired.

verses.raw: And all these things shall be [denied and] destroyed from the surface of the earth, When the Elect One shall appear before the face of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.’
verses.text: And all these things shall be [denied and] destroyed from the surface of the earth, When the Elect One shall appear before the face of Yahuah of Spirits.’

verses.raw: There mine eyes saw a deep valley with open mouths, and all who dwell on the earth and sea and islands shall bring to him gifts and presents and tokens of homage, but that deep valley shall not become full.
verses.text: There mine eyes saw a deep valley with open mouths, and all who dwell on the earth and sea and islands shall bring to him gifts and presents and tokens of homage, but that deep valley shall not become full.

verses.raw: And their hands commit lawless deeds, And the sinners devour all whom they lawlessly oppress: Yet the sinners shall be destroyed before the face of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And they shall be banished from off the face of His earth, And they shall perish for ever and ever.
verses.text: And their hands commit lawless deeds, And the sinners devour all whom they lawlessly oppress: Yet the sinners shall be destroyed before the face of Yahuah of Spirits, And they shall be banished from off the face of His earth, And they shall perish for ever and ever.

verses.raw: For I saw all the angels of punishment abiding (there) and preparing all the instruments of Satan.
verses.text: For I saw all the angels of punishment abiding (there) and preparing all the instruments of Satan.

verses.raw: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me: ‘For whom are they preparing these instruments?’
verses.text: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me: ‘For whom are they preparing these instruments?’

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘They prepare these for the kings and the mighty of this earth, that they may thereby be destroyed.
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘They prepare these for the kings and the mighty of this earth, that they may thereby be destroyed.

verses.raw: And after this the Righteous and Elect One shall cause the house of his congregation to appear: henceforth they shall be no more hindered in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And after this the Righteous and Elect One shall cause the house of his congregation to appear: henceforth they shall be no more hindered in the name of Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And these mountains shall not stand as the earth before his righteousness, But the hills shall be as a fountain of water, And the righteous shall have rest from the oppression of sinners.’
verses.text: And these mountains shall not stand as the earth before his righteousness, But the hills shall be as a fountain of water, And the righteous shall have rest from the oppression of sinners.’

verses.raw: And I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and saw there a deep valley with burning fire.
verses.text: And I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and saw there a deep valley with burning fire.

verses.raw: And they brought the kings and the mighty, and began to cast them into this deep valley.
verses.text: And they brought the kings and the mighty, and began to cast them into this deep valley.

verses.raw: And there mine eyes saw how they made these their instruments, iron chains of immeasurable weight.
verses.text: And there mine eyes saw how they made these their instruments, iron chains of immeasurable weight.

verses.raw: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘For whom are these chains being prepared?’
verses.text: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘For whom are these chains being prepared?’

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits commanded.
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘These are being prepared for the hosts of Azâzêl, so that they may take them and cast them into the abyss of complete condemnation, and they shall cover their jaws with rough stones as Yahuah of Spirits commanded.

verses.raw: And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’
verses.text: And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’

verses.raw: And in those days shall punishment come from Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and He will open all the chambers of waters which are above the heavens, and of the fountains which are beneath the earth.
verses.text: And in those days shall punishment come from Yahuah of Spirits, and He will open all the chambers of waters which are above the heavens, and of the fountains which are beneath the earth.

verses.raw: And all the waters shall be joined with the waters: that which is above the heavens is the masculine, and the water which is beneath the earth is the feminine.
verses.text: And all the waters shall be joined with the waters: that which is above the heavens is the masculine, and the water which is beneath the earth is the feminine.

verses.raw: And they shall destroy all who dwell on the earth and those who dwell under the ends of the heaven.
verses.text: And they shall destroy all who dwell on the earth and those who dwell under the ends of the heaven.

verses.raw: And when they have recognized their unrighteousness which they have wrought on the earth, then by these shall they perish.’
verses.text: And when they have recognized their unrighteousness which they have wrought on the earth, then by these shall they perish.’

verses.raw: And after that the Head of Days repented and said: ‘In vain have I destroyed all who dwell on the earth.’
verses.text: And after that the Head of Days repented and said: ‘In vain have I destroyed all who dwell on the earth.’

verses.raw: And He sware by His great name: ‘Henceforth I will not do so to all who dwell on the earth, and I will set a sign in the heaven: and this shall be a pledge of good faith between Me and them for ever, so long as heaven is above the earth. And this is in accordance with My command.
verses.text: And He sware by His great name: ‘Henceforth I will not do so to all who dwell on the earth, and I will set a sign in the heaven: and this shall be a pledge of good faith between Me and them for ever, so long as heaven is above the earth. And this is in accordance with My command.

verses.raw: When I have desired to take hold of them by the hand of the angels on the day of tribulation and pain because of this, I will cause My chastisement and My wrath to abide upon them, saith Elohim (God), Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: When I have desired to take hold of them by the hand of the angels on the day of tribulation and pain because of this, I will cause My chastisement and My wrath to abide upon them, saith Elohim, Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: Ye mighty kings who dwell on the earth, ye shall have to behold Mine Elect One, how he sits on the throne of glory and judges Azâzêl, and all his associates, and all his hosts in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.’
verses.text: Ye mighty kings who dwell on the earth, ye shall have to behold Mine Elect One, how he sits on the throne of glory and judges Azâzêl, and all his associates, and all his hosts in the name of Yahuah of Spirits.’

verses.raw: And I saw there the hosts of the angels of punishment going, and they held scourges and chains of iron and bronze.
verses.text: And I saw there the hosts of the angels of punishment going, and they held scourges and chains of iron and bronze.

verses.raw: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘To whom are these who hold the scourges going?’
verses.text: And I asked the angel of peace who went with me, saying: ‘To whom are these who hold the scourges going?’

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘To their elect and beloved ones, that they may be cast into the chasm of the abyss of the valley.
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘To their elect and beloved ones, that they may be cast into the chasm of the abyss of the valley.

verses.raw: And then that valley shall be filled with their elect and beloved, And the days of their lives shall be at an end, And the days of their leading astray shall not thenceforward be reckoned.
verses.text: And then that valley shall be filled with their elect and beloved, And the days of their lives shall be at an end, And the days of their leading astray shall not thenceforward be reckoned.

verses.raw: And in those days the angels shall return And hurl themselves to the east upon the Parthians and Medes: They shall stir up the kings, so that a spirit of unrest shall come upon them, And they shall rouse them from their thrones, That they may break forth as lions from their lairs, And as hungry wolves among their flocks.
verses.text: And in those days the angels shall return And hurl themselves to the east upon the Parthians and Medes: They shall stir up the kings, so that a spirit of unrest shall come upon them, And they shall rouse them from their thrones, That they may break forth as lions from their lairs, And as hungry wolves among their flocks.

verses.raw: And they shall go up and tread under foot the land of His elect ones, [And the land of His elect ones shall be before them a threshing-floor and a highway:]
verses.text: And they shall go up and tread under foot the land of His elect ones, [And the land of His elect ones shall be before them a threshing-floor and a highway:]

verses.raw: But the city of my righteous shall be a hindrance to their horses. And they shall begin to fight among themselves, And their right hand shall be strong against themselves, And a man shall not know his brother, Nor a son his father or his mother, Till there be no number of the corpses through their slaughter, And their punishment be not in vain.
verses.text: But the city of my righteous shall be a hindrance to their horses. And they shall begin to fight among themselves, And their right hand shall be strong against themselves, And a man shall not know his brother, Nor a son his father or his mother, Till there be no number of the corpses through their slaughter, And their punishment be not in vain.

verses.raw: In those days Sheol shall open its jaws, And they shall be swallowed up therein, And their destruction shall be at an end; Sheol shall devour the sinners in the presence of the elect.’
verses.text: In those days Sheol shall open its jaws, And they shall be swallowed up therein, And their destruction shall be at an end; Sheol shall devour the sinners in the presence of the elect.’

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this that I saw another host of wagons, and men riding thereon, and coming on the winds from the east, and from the west to the south.

verses.raw: And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.
verses.text: And the noise of their wagons was heard, and when this turmoil took place the holy ones from heaven remarked it, and the pillars of the earth were moved from their place, and the sound thereof was heard from the one end of heaven to the other, in one day.

verses.raw: And they shall all fall down and worship Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And this is the end of the second Parable.
verses.text: And they shall all fall down and worship Yahuah of Spirits. And this is the end of the second Parable.

verses.raw: And I began to speak the third Parable concerning the righteous and elect.
verses.text: And I began to speak the third Parable concerning the righteous and elect.

verses.raw: Blessed are ye, ye righteous and elect, For glorious shall be your lot.
verses.text: Blessed are ye, ye righteous and elect, For glorious shall be your lot.

verses.raw: And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.
verses.text: And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.

verses.raw: And they shall seek the light and find righteousness with Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: There shall be peace to the righteous in the name of the Eternal Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And they shall seek the light and find righteousness with Yahuah of Spirits: There shall be peace to the righteous in the name of the Eternal Yahuah.

verses.raw: And after this it shall be said to the holy in heaven That they should seek out the secrets of righteousness, the heritage of faith: For it has become bright as the sun upon earth, And the darkness is past.
verses.text: And after this it shall be said to the holy in heaven That they should seek out the secrets of righteousness, the heritage of faith: For it has become bright as the sun upon earth, And the darkness is past.

verses.raw: And there shall be a light that never endeth, And to a limit (lit. ‘number’) of days they shall not come, For the darkness shall first have been destroyed, [And the light established before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits] And the light of uprightness established for ever before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And there shall be a light that never endeth, And to a limit (lit. ‘number’) of days they shall not come, For the darkness shall first have been destroyed, [And the light established before Yahuah of Spirits] And the light of uprightness established for ever before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: [In those days mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightnings, and of the lights, and the judgements they execute (lit. ‘their judgement’): and they lighten for a blessing or a curse as Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits willeth.
verses.text: [In those days mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightnings, and of the lights, and the judgements they execute (lit. ‘their judgement’): and they lighten for a blessing or a curse as Yahuah of Spirits willeth.

verses.raw: And there I saw the secrets of the thunder, and how when it resounds above in the heaven, the sound thereof is heard, and he caused me to see the judgements executed on the earth, whether they be for well-being and blessing, or for a curse according to the word of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And there I saw the secrets of the thunder, and how when it resounds above in the heaven, the sound thereof is heard, and he caused me to see the judgements executed on the earth, whether they be for well-being and blessing, or for a curse according to the word of Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And after that all the secrets of the lights and lightnings were shown to me, and they lighten for blessing and for satisfying.]
verses.text: And after that all the secrets of the lights and lightnings were shown to me, and they lighten for blessing and for satisfying.]

verses.raw: In the year 500, in the seventh month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the life of Enoch. In that Parable I saw how a mighty quaking made the heaven of heavens to quake, and the host of the El Elyon (Most High), and the angels, a thousand thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, were disquieted with a great disquiet.
verses.text: In the year 500, in the seventh month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the life of Enoch. In that Parable I saw how a mighty quaking made the heaven of heavens to quake, and the host of the El Elyon, and the angels, a thousand thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, were disquieted with a great disquiet.

verses.raw: And the Head of Days sat on the throne of His glory, and the angels and the righteous stood around Him.
verses.text: And the Head of Days sat on the throne of His glory, and the angels and the righteous stood around Him.

verses.raw: And a great trembling seized me, And fear took hold of me, And my loins gave way, And dissolved were my reins, And I fell upon my face.
verses.text: And a great trembling seized me, And fear took hold of me, And my loins gave way, And dissolved were my reins, And I fell upon my face.

verses.raw: And Michael sent another angel from among the holy ones and he raised me up, and when he had raised me up my spirit returned; for I had not been able to endure the look of this host, and the commotion and the quaking of the heaven.
verses.text: And Michael sent another angel from among the holy ones and he raised me up, and when he had raised me up my spirit returned; for I had not been able to endure the look of this host, and the commotion and the quaking of the heaven.

verses.raw: And Michael said unto me: ‘Why art thou disquieted with such a vision? Until this day lasted the day of His mercy; and He hath been merciful and long-suffering towards those who dwell on the earth.
verses.text: And Michael said unto me: ‘Why art thou disquieted with such a vision? Until this day lasted the day of His mercy; and He hath been merciful and long-suffering towards those who dwell on the earth.

verses.raw: And when the day, and the power, and the punishment, and the judgement come, which Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath prepared for those who worship not the righteous law, and for those who deny the righteous judgement, and for those who take His name in vain—that day is prepared, for the elect a covenant, but for sinners an inquisition.’
verses.text: And when the day, and the power, and the punishment, and the judgement come, which Yahuah of Spirits hath prepared for those who worship not the righteous law, and for those who deny the righteous judgement, and for those who take His name in vain—that day is prepared, for the elect a covenant, but for sinners an inquisition.’

verses.raw: And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster named Leviathan, to dwell in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.
verses.text: And on that day were two monsters parted, a female monster named Leviathan, to dwell in the abysses of the ocean over the fountains of the waters.

verses.raw: But the male is named Behemoth, who occupied with his breast a waste wilderness named Dûidâin, on the east of the garden where the elect and righteous dwell, where my grandfather was taken up, the seventh from Adam, the first man whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits created.
verses.text: But the male is named Behemoth, who occupied with his breast a waste wilderness named Dûidâin, on the east of the garden where the elect and righteous dwell, where my grandfather was taken up, the seventh from Adam, the first man whom Yahuah of Spirits created.

verses.raw: And I besought the other angel that he should show me the might of those monsters, how they were parted on one day and cast, the one into the abysses of the sea, and the other unto the dry land of the wilderness.
verses.text: And I besought the other angel that he should show me the might of those monsters, how they were parted on one day and cast, the one into the abysses of the sea, and the other unto the dry land of the wilderness.

verses.raw: And he said to me: ‘Thou son of Adam, herein thou dost seek to know what is hidden.’
verses.text: And he said to me: ‘Thou son of Adam, herein thou dost seek to know what is hidden.’

verses.raw: And the other angel who went with me and showed me what was hidden told me what is first and last in the heaven in the height, and beneath the earth in the depth, and at the ends of the heaven, and on the foundation of the heaven.
verses.text: And the other angel who went with me and showed me what was hidden told me what is first and last in the heaven in the height, and beneath the earth in the depth, and at the ends of the heaven, and on the foundation of the heaven.

verses.raw: And the chambers of the winds, and how the winds are divided, and how they are weighed, and (how) the portals of the winds are reckoned, each according to the power of the wind, and the power of the lights of the moon, and according to the power that is fitting: and the divisions of the stars according to their names, and how all the divisions are divided.
verses.text: And the chambers of the winds, and how the winds are divided, and how they are weighed, and (how) the portals of the winds are reckoned, each according to the power of the wind, and the power of the lights of the moon, and according to the power that is fitting: and the divisions of the stars according to their names, and how all the divisions are divided.

verses.raw: And the thunders according to the places where they fall, and all the divisions that are made among the lightnings that it may lighten, and their host that they may at once obey.
verses.text: And the thunders according to the places where they fall, and all the divisions that are made among the lightnings that it may lighten, and their host that they may at once obey.

verses.raw: For the thunder has places of rest (which) are assigned (to it) while it is waiting for its peal; and the thunder and lightning are inseparable, and although not one and undivided, they both go together through the spirit and separate not.
verses.text: For the thunder has places of rest (which) are assigned (to it) while it is waiting for its peal; and the thunder and lightning are inseparable, and although not one and undivided, they both go together through the spirit and separate not.

verses.raw: For when the lightning lightens, the thunder utters its voice, and the spirit enforces a pause during the peal, and divides equally between them; for the treasury of their peals is like the sand, and each one of them as it peals is held in with a bridle, and turned back by the power of the spirit, and pushed forward according to the many quarters of the earth.
verses.text: For when the lightning lightens, the thunder utters its voice, and the spirit enforces a pause during the peal, and divides equally between them; for the treasury of their peals is like the sand, and each one of them as it peals is held in with a bridle, and turned back by the power of the spirit, and pushed forward according to the many quarters of the earth.

verses.raw: And the spirit of the sea is masculine and strong, and according to the might of his strength he draws it back with a rein, and in like manner it is driven forward and disperses amid all the mountains of the earth.
verses.text: And the spirit of the sea is masculine and strong, and according to the might of his strength he draws it back with a rein, and in like manner it is driven forward and disperses amid all the mountains of the earth.

verses.raw: And the spirit of the hoar-frost is his own angel, and the spirit of the hail is a good angel.
verses.text: And the spirit of the hoar-frost is his own angel, and the spirit of the hail is a good angel.

verses.raw: And the spirit of the snow has forsaken his chambers on account of his strength—There is a special spirit therein, and that which ascends from it is like smoke, and its name is frost.
verses.text: And the spirit of the snow has forsaken his chambers on account of his strength—There is a special spirit therein, and that which ascends from it is like smoke, and its name is frost.

verses.raw: And the spirit of the mist is not united with them in their chambers, but it has a special chamber; for its course is glorious both in light and in darkness, and in winter and in summer, and in its chamber is an angel.
verses.text: And the spirit of the mist is not united with them in their chambers, but it has a special chamber; for its course is glorious both in light and in darkness, and in winter and in summer, and in its chamber is an angel.

verses.raw: And the spirit of the dew has its dwelling at the ends of the heaven, and is connected with the chambers of the rain, and its course is in winter and summer: and its clouds and the clouds of the mist are connected, and the one gives to the other.
verses.text: And the spirit of the dew has its dwelling at the ends of the heaven, and is connected with the chambers of the rain, and its course is in winter and summer: and its clouds and the clouds of the mist are connected, and the one gives to the other.

verses.raw: And when the spirit of the rain goes forth from its chamber, the angels come and open the chamber and lead it out, and when it is diffused over the whole earth it unites with the water on the earth. And whensoever it unites with the water on the earth...
verses.text: And when the spirit of the rain goes forth from its chamber, the angels come and open the chamber and lead it out, and when it is diffused over the whole earth it unites with the water on the earth. And whensoever it unites with the water on the earth...

verses.raw: For the waters are for those who dwell on the earth; for they are nourishment for the earth from the El Elyon (Most High) who is in heaven: therefore there is a measure for the rain, and the angels take it in charge.
verses.text: For the waters are for those who dwell on the earth; for they are nourishment for the earth from the El Elyon who is in heaven: therefore there is a measure for the rain, and the angels take it in charge.

verses.raw: And these things I saw towards the Garden of the Righteous.
verses.text: And these things I saw towards the Garden of the Righteous.

verses.raw: And the angel of peace who was with me said to me: ‘These two monsters, prepared conformably to the greatness of Elohim (God), shall feed...
verses.text: And the angel of peace who was with me said to me: ‘These two monsters, prepared conformably to the greatness of Elohim, shall feed...

verses.raw: When the punishment of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits shall rest upon them, it shall rest in order that the punishment of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may not come, in vain, and it shall slay the children with their mothers and the children with their fathers. Afterwards the judgement shall take place according to His mercy and His patience.’
verses.text: When the punishment of Yahuah of Spirits shall rest upon them, it shall rest in order that the punishment of Yahuah of Spirits may not come, in vain, and it shall slay the children with their mothers and the children with their fathers. Afterwards the judgement shall take place according to His mercy and His patience.’

verses.raw: And I saw in those days how long cords were given to those angels, and they took to themselves wings and flew, and they went towards the north.
verses.text: And I saw in those days how long cords were given to those angels, and they took to themselves wings and flew, and they went towards the north.

verses.raw: And I asked the angel, saying unto him: ‘Why have those (angels) taken these cords and gone off?’ And he said unto me: ‘They have gone to measure.’
verses.text: And I asked the angel, saying unto him: ‘Why have those (angels) taken these cords and gone off?’ And he said unto me: ‘They have gone to measure.’

verses.raw: And the angel who went with me said unto me: ‘These shall bring the measures of the righteous, And the ropes of the righteous to the righteous, That they may stay themselves on the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.
verses.text: And the angel who went with me said unto me: ‘These shall bring the measures of the righteous, And the ropes of the righteous to the righteous, That they may stay themselves on the name of Yahuah of Spirits for ever and ever.

verses.raw: The elect shall begin to dwell with the elect, And those are the measures which shall be given to faith And which shall strengthen righteousness.
verses.text: The elect shall begin to dwell with the elect, And those are the measures which shall be given to faith And which shall strengthen righteousness.

verses.raw: And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, And those who have been destroyed by the desert, And those who have been devoured by the beasts, And those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea, That they may return and stay themselves On the day of the Elect One; For none shall be destroyed before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And none can be destroyed.
verses.text: And these measures shall reveal all the secrets of the depths of the earth, And those who have been destroyed by the desert, And those who have been devoured by the beasts, And those who have been devoured by the fish of the sea, That they may return and stay themselves On the day of the Elect One; For none shall be destroyed before Yahuah of Spirits, And none can be destroyed.

verses.raw: And all who dwell above in the heaven received a command and power and one voice and one light like unto fire.
verses.text: And all who dwell above in the heaven received a command and power and one voice and one light like unto fire.

verses.raw: And that One (with) their first words they blessed, And extolled and lauded with wisdom, And they were wise in utterance and in the spirit of life.
verses.text: And that One (with) their first words they blessed, And extolled and lauded with wisdom, And they were wise in utterance and in the spirit of life.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.
verses.text: And Yahuah of Spirits placed the Elect One on the throne of glory. And he shall judge all the works of the holy above in the heaven, And in the balance shall their deeds be weighed.

verses.raw: And when he shall lift up his countenance To judge their secret ways according to the word of the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And their path according to the way of the righteous judgement of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Then shall they all with one voice speak and bless, And glorify and extol and sanctify the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And when he shall lift up his countenance To judge their secret ways according to the word of the name of Yahuah of Spirits, And their path according to the way of the righteous judgement of Yahuah of Spirits, Then shall they all with one voice speak and bless, And glorify and extol and sanctify the name of Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim (God), the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.
verses.text: And He will summon all the host of the heavens, and all the holy ones above, and the host of Elohim, the Cherubin, Seraphin and Ophannin, and all the angels of power, and all the angels of principalities, and the Elect One, and the other powers on the earth (and) over the water.

verses.raw: On that day shall raise one voice, and bless and glorify and exalt in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, and in the spirit of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, and in the spirit of judgement and of peace, and in the spirit of goodness, and shall all say with one voice: "Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever."
verses.text: On that day shall raise one voice, and bless and glorify and exalt in the spirit of faith, and in the spirit of wisdom, and in the spirit of patience, and in the spirit of mercy, and in the spirit of judgement and of peace, and in the spirit of goodness, and shall all say with one voice: "Blessed is He, and may the name of Yahuah of Spirits be blessed for ever and ever."

verses.raw: All who sleep not above in heaven shall bless Him: All the holy ones who are in heaven shall bless Him, And all the elect who dwell in the garden of life: And every spirit of light who is able to bless, and glorify, and extol, and hallow Thy blessed name, And all flesh shall beyond measure glorify and bless Thy name for ever and ever.
verses.text: All who sleep not above in heaven shall bless Him: All the holy ones who are in heaven shall bless Him, And all the elect who dwell in the garden of life: And every spirit of light who is able to bless, and glorify, and extol, and hallow Thy blessed name, And all flesh shall beyond measure glorify and bless Thy name for ever and ever.

verses.raw: For great is the mercy of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and He is long- suffering, And all His works and all that He has created He has revealed to the righteous and elect In the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.’
verses.text: For great is the mercy of Yahuah of Spirits, and He is long- suffering, And all His works and all that He has created He has revealed to the righteous and elect In the name of Yahuah of Spirits.’

verses.raw: And thus Yahuah (Lord) commanded the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, and said: ‘Open your eyes and lift up your horns if ye are able to recognize the Elect One.’
verses.text: And thus Yahuah commanded the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, and said: ‘Open your eyes and lift up your horns if ye are able to recognize the Elect One.’

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.
verses.text: And Yahuah of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.

verses.raw: And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.
verses.text: And there shall stand up in that day all the kings and the mighty, And the exalted and those who hold the earth, And they shall see and recognize How he sits on the throne of his glory, And righteousness is judged before him, And no lying word is spoken before him.

verses.raw: Then shall pain come upon them as on a woman in travail, [And she has pain in bringing forth] When her child enters the mouth of the womb, And she has pain in bringing forth.
verses.text: Then shall pain come upon them as on a woman in travail, [And she has pain in bringing forth] When her child enters the mouth of the womb, And she has pain in bringing forth.

verses.raw: And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.
verses.text: And one portion of them shall look on the other, And they shall be terrified, And they shall be downcast of countenance, And pain shall seize them, When they see that Son of Adam Sitting on the throne of his glory.

verses.raw: And the kings and the mighty and all who possess the earth shall bless and glorify and extol him who rules over all, who was hidden.
verses.text: And the kings and the mighty and all who possess the earth shall bless and glorify and extol him who rules over all, who was hidden.

verses.raw: For from the beginning the Son of Adam was hidden, And the El Elyon (Most High) preserved him in the presence of His might, And revealed him to the elect.
verses.text: For from the beginning the Son of Adam was hidden, And the El Elyon preserved him in the presence of His might, And revealed him to the elect.

verses.raw: And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.
verses.text: And the congregation of the elect and holy shall be sown. And all the elect shall stand before him on that day.

verses.raw: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.
verses.text: And all the kings and the mighty and the exalted and those who rule the earth Shall fall down before him on their faces, And worship and set their hope upon that Son of Adam, And petition him and supplicate for mercy at his hands.

verses.raw: Nevertheless that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits will so press them That they shall hastily go forth from His presence, And their faces shall be filled with shame, And the darkness grow deeper on their faces.
verses.text: Nevertheless that Yahuah of Spirits will so press them That they shall hastily go forth from His presence, And their faces shall be filled with shame, And the darkness grow deeper on their faces.

verses.raw: And He will deliver them to the angels for punishment, To execute vengeance on them because they have oppressed His children and His elect
verses.text: And He will deliver them to the angels for punishment, To execute vengeance on them because they have oppressed His children and His elect

verses.raw: And they shall be a spectacle for the righteous and for His elect: They shall rejoice over them, Because the wrath of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits resteth upon them, And His sword is drunk with their blood.
verses.text: And they shall be a spectacle for the righteous and for His elect: They shall rejoice over them, Because the wrath of Yahuah of Spirits resteth upon them, And His sword is drunk with their blood.

verses.raw: And the righteous and elect shall be saved on that day, And they shall never thenceforward see the face of the sinners and unrighteous.
verses.text: And the righteous and elect shall be saved on that day, And they shall never thenceforward see the face of the sinners and unrighteous.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits will abide over them, And with that Son of Adam shall they eat And lie down and rise up for ever and ever.
verses.text: And Yahuah of Spirits will abide over them, And with that Son of Adam shall they eat And lie down and rise up for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And the righteous and elect shall have risen from the earth, And ceased to be of downcast countenance. And they shall have been clothed with garments of glory,
verses.text: And the righteous and elect shall have risen from the earth, And ceased to be of downcast countenance. And they shall have been clothed with garments of glory,

verses.raw: And these shall be the garments of life from Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: And your garments shall not grow old, Nor your glory pass away before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And these shall be the garments of life from Yahuah of Spirits: And your garments shall not grow old, Nor your glory pass away before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: In those days shall the mighty and the kings who possess the earth implore (Him) to grant them a little respite from His angels of punishment to whom they were delivered, that they might fall down and worship before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and confess their sins before Him.
verses.text: In those days shall the mighty and the kings who possess the earth implore (Him) to grant them a little respite from His angels of punishment to whom they were delivered, that they might fall down and worship before Yahuah of Spirits, and confess their sins before Him.

verses.raw: And they shall bless and glorify Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and say: ‘Blessed is Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits and Yahuah (Lord) of kings, And Yahuah (Lord) of the mighty and Yahuah (Lord) of the rich, And Yahuah (Lord) of glory and Yahuah (Lord) of wisdom,
verses.text: And they shall bless and glorify Yahuah of Spirits, and say: ‘Blessed is Yahuah of Spirits and Yahuah of kings, And Yahuah of the mighty and Yahuah of the rich, And Yahuah of glory and Yahuah of wisdom,

verses.raw: And splendid in every secret thing is Thy power from generation to generation, And Thy glory for ever and ever: Deep are all Thy secrets and innumerable, And Thy righteousness is beyond reckoning.
verses.text: And splendid in every secret thing is Thy power from generation to generation, And Thy glory for ever and ever: Deep are all Thy secrets and innumerable, And Thy righteousness is beyond reckoning.

verses.raw: We have now learnt that we should glorify And bless Yahuah (Lord) of kings and Him who is king over all kings.’
verses.text: We have now learnt that we should glorify And bless Yahuah of kings and Him who is king over all kings.’

verses.raw: And they shall say: ‘Would that we had rest to glorify and give thanks And confess our faith before His glory!
verses.text: And they shall say: ‘Would that we had rest to glorify and give thanks And confess our faith before His glory!

verses.raw: And now we long for a little rest but find it not: We follow hard upon and obtain (it) not: And light has vanished from before us, And darkness is our dwelling-place for ever and ever:
verses.text: And now we long for a little rest but find it not: We follow hard upon and obtain (it) not: And light has vanished from before us, And darkness is our dwelling-place for ever and ever:

verses.raw: For we have not believed before Him Nor glorified the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, [nor glorified our Lord] But our hope was in the sceptre of our kingdom, And in our glory.
verses.text: For we have not believed before Him Nor glorified the name of Yahuah of Spirits, [nor glorified our Lord] But our hope was in the sceptre of our kingdom, And in our glory.

verses.raw: And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not, And we find no respite for confession That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice, And His judgements have no respect of persons.
verses.text: And in the day of our suffering and tribulation He saves us not, And we find no respite for confession That our Lord is true in all His works, and in His judgements and His justice, And His judgements have no respect of persons.

verses.raw: And we pass away from before His face on account of our works, And all our sins are reckoned up in righteousness.’
verses.text: And we pass away from before His face on account of our works, And all our sins are reckoned up in righteousness.’

verses.raw: Now they shall say unto themselves: ‘Our souls are full of unrighteous gain, but it does not prevent us from descending from the midst thereof into the burden of Sheol.’
verses.text: Now they shall say unto themselves: ‘Our souls are full of unrighteous gain, but it does not prevent us from descending from the midst thereof into the burden of Sheol.’

verses.raw: And after that their faces shall be filled with darkness And shame before that Son of Adam, And they shall be driven from his presence, And the sword shall abide before his face in their midst.
verses.text: And after that their faces shall be filled with darkness And shame before that Son of Adam, And they shall be driven from his presence, And the sword shall abide before his face in their midst.

verses.raw: Thus spake Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: ‘This is the ordinance and judgement with respect to the mighty and the kings and the exalted and those who possess the earth before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.’
verses.text: Thus spake Yahuah of Spirits: ‘This is the ordinance and judgement with respect to the mighty and the kings and the exalted and those who possess the earth before Yahuah of Spirits.’

verses.raw: And other forms I saw hidden in that place.
verses.text: And other forms I saw hidden in that place.

verses.raw: I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’
verses.text: I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’

verses.raw: And in those days Noah saw the earth that it had sunk down and its destruction was nigh.
verses.text: And in those days Noah saw the earth that it had sunk down and its destruction was nigh.

verses.raw: And he arose from thence and went to the ends of the earth, and cried aloud to his grandfather Enoch: and Noah said three times with an embittered voice: ‘Hear me, hear me, hear me.’
verses.text: And he arose from thence and went to the ends of the earth, and cried aloud to his grandfather Enoch: and Noah said three times with an embittered voice: ‘Hear me, hear me, hear me.’

verses.raw: And I said unto him: ‘Tell me what it is that is falling out on the earth that the earth is in such evil plight and shaken, lest perchance I shall perish with it?’
verses.text: And I said unto him: ‘Tell me what it is that is falling out on the earth that the earth is in such evil plight and shaken, lest perchance I shall perish with it?’

verses.raw: And thereupon there was a great commotion on the earth, and a voice was heard from heaven, and I fell on my face.
verses.text: And thereupon there was a great commotion on the earth, and a voice was heard from heaven, and I fell on my face.

verses.raw: And Enoch my grandfather came and stood by me, and said unto me: ‘Why hast thou cried unto me with a bitter cry and weeping?
verses.text: And Enoch my grandfather came and stood by me, and said unto me: ‘Why hast thou cried unto me with a bitter cry and weeping?

verses.raw: And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:
verses.text: And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:

verses.raw: And how silver is produced from the dust of the earth, and how soft metal originates in the earth.
verses.text: And how silver is produced from the dust of the earth, and how soft metal originates in the earth.

verses.raw: For lead and tin are not produced from the earth like the first: it is a fountain that produces them, and an angel stands therein, and that angel is pre-eminent.’
verses.text: For lead and tin are not produced from the earth like the first: it is a fountain that produces them, and an angel stands therein, and that angel is pre-eminent.’

verses.raw: And after that my grandfather Enoch took hold of me by my hand and raised me up, and said unto me: ‘Go, for I have asked Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits as touching this commotion on the earth.
verses.text: And after that my grandfather Enoch took hold of me by my hand and raised me up, and said unto me: ‘Go, for I have asked Yahuah of Spirits as touching this commotion on the earth.

verses.raw: And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”
verses.text: And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”

verses.raw: And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.
verses.text: And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.

verses.raw: And He has destined thy name to be among the holy, And will preserve thee amongst those who dwell on the earth, And has destined thy righteous seed both for kingship and for great honours, And from thy seed shall proceed a fountain of the righteous and holy without number for ever.’
verses.text: And He has destined thy name to be among the holy, And will preserve thee amongst those who dwell on the earth, And has destined thy righteous seed both for kingship and for great honours, And from thy seed shall proceed a fountain of the righteous and holy without number for ever.’

verses.raw: And after that he showed me the angels of punishment who are prepared to come and let loose all the powers of the waters which are beneath in the earth in order to bring judgement and destruction on all who [abide and] dwell on the earth.
verses.text: And after that he showed me the angels of punishment who are prepared to come and let loose all the powers of the waters which are beneath in the earth in order to bring judgement and destruction on all who [abide and] dwell on the earth.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits gave commandment to the angels who were going forth, that they should not cause the waters to rise but should hold them in check; for those angels were over the powers of the waters.
verses.text: And Yahuah of Spirits gave commandment to the angels who were going forth, that they should not cause the waters to rise but should hold them in check; for those angels were over the powers of the waters.

verses.raw: And I went away from the presence of Enoch.
verses.text: And I went away from the presence of Enoch.

verses.raw: And in those days the word of Elohim (God) came unto me, and He said unto me: ‘Noah, thy lot has come up before Me, a lot without blame, a lot of love and uprightness.
verses.text: And in those days the word of Elohim came unto me, and He said unto me: ‘Noah, thy lot has come up before Me, a lot without blame, a lot of love and uprightness.

verses.raw: And now the angels are making a wooden (building), and when they have completed that task I will place My hand upon it and preserve it, and there shall come forth from it the seed of life, and a change shall set in so that the earth will not remain without inhabitant.
verses.text: And now the angels are making a wooden (building), and when they have completed that task I will place My hand upon it and preserve it, and there shall come forth from it the seed of life, and a change shall set in so that the earth will not remain without inhabitant.

verses.raw: And I will make fast thy seed before me for ever and ever, and I will spread abroad those who dwell with thee: it shall not be unfruitful on the face of the earth, but it shall be blessed and multiply on the earth in the name of Yahuah (Lord).’
verses.text: And I will make fast thy seed before me for ever and ever, and I will spread abroad those who dwell with thee: it shall not be unfruitful on the face of the earth, but it shall be blessed and multiply on the earth in the name of Yahuah.’

verses.raw: And He will imprison those angels, who have shown unrighteousness, in that burning valley which my grandfather Enoch had formerly shown to me in the west among the mountains of gold and silver and iron and soft metal and tin.
verses.text: And He will imprison those angels, who have shown unrighteousness, in that burning valley which my grandfather Enoch had formerly shown to me in the west among the mountains of gold and silver and iron and soft metal and tin.

verses.raw: And I saw that valley in which there was a great convulsion and a convulsion of the waters.
verses.text: And I saw that valley in which there was a great convulsion and a convulsion of the waters.

verses.raw: And when all this took place, from that fiery molten metal and from the convulsion thereof in that place, there was produced a smell of sulphur, and it was connected with those waters, and that valley of the angels who had led astray (mankind) burned beneath that land.
verses.text: And when all this took place, from that fiery molten metal and from the convulsion thereof in that place, there was produced a smell of sulphur, and it was connected with those waters, and that valley of the angels who had led astray (mankind) burned beneath that land.

verses.raw: And through its valleys proceed streams of fire, where these angels are punished who had led astray those who dwell upon the earth.
verses.text: And through its valleys proceed streams of fire, where these angels are punished who had led astray those who dwell upon the earth.

verses.raw: But those waters shall in those days serve for the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, for the healing of the body, but for the punishment of the spirit; now their spirit is full of lust, that they may be punished in their body, for they have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits and see their punishment daily, and yet believe not in His name.
verses.text: But those waters shall in those days serve for the kings and the mighty and the exalted, and those who dwell on the earth, for the healing of the body, but for the punishment of the spirit; now their spirit is full of lust, that they may be punished in their body, for they have denied Yahuah of Spirits and see their punishment daily, and yet believe not in His name.

verses.raw: And in proportion as the burning of their bodies becomes severe, a corresponding change shall take place in their spirit for ever and ever; for before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits none shall utter an idle word.
verses.text: And in proportion as the burning of their bodies becomes severe, a corresponding change shall take place in their spirit for ever and ever; for before Yahuah of Spirits none shall utter an idle word.

verses.raw: For the judgement shall come upon them, because they believe in the lust of their body and deny the Spirit of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: For the judgement shall come upon them, because they believe in the lust of their body and deny the Spirit of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And those same waters will undergo a change in those days; for when those angels are punished in these waters, these water-springs shall change their temperature, and when the angels ascend, this water of the springs shall change and become cold.
verses.text: And those same waters will undergo a change in those days; for when those angels are punished in these waters, these water-springs shall change their temperature, and when the angels ascend, this water of the springs shall change and become cold.

verses.raw: And I heard Michael answering and saying: ‘This judgement wherewith the angels are judged is a testimony for the kings and the mighty who possess the earth.’
verses.text: And I heard Michael answering and saying: ‘This judgement wherewith the angels are judged is a testimony for the kings and the mighty who possess the earth.’

verses.raw: Because these waters of judgement minister to the healing of the body of the kings and the lust of their body; therefore they will not see and will not believe that those waters will change and become a fire which burns for ever.
verses.text: Because these waters of judgement minister to the healing of the body of the kings and the lust of their body; therefore they will not see and will not believe that those waters will change and become a fire which burns for ever.

verses.raw: And after that my grandfather Enoch gave me the teaching of all the secrets in the book in the Parables which had been given to him, and he put them together for me in the words of the book of the Parables.
verses.text: And after that my grandfather Enoch gave me the teaching of all the secrets in the book in the Parables which had been given to him, and he put them together for me in the words of the book of the Parables.

verses.raw: And on that day Michael answered Raphael and said: ‘The power of the spirit transports and makes me to tremble because of the severity of the judgement of the secrets, the judgement of the angels: who can endure the severe judgement which has been executed, and before which they melt away?’
verses.text: And on that day Michael answered Raphael and said: ‘The power of the spirit transports and makes me to tremble because of the severity of the judgement of the secrets, the judgement of the angels: who can endure the severe judgement which has been executed, and before which they melt away?’

verses.raw: And Michael answered again, and said to Raphael: ‘Who is he whose heart is not softened concerning it, and whose reins are not troubled by this word of judgement (that) has gone forth upon them because of those who have thus led them out?’
verses.text: And Michael answered again, and said to Raphael: ‘Who is he whose heart is not softened concerning it, and whose reins are not troubled by this word of judgement (that) has gone forth upon them because of those who have thus led them out?’

verses.raw: And it came to pass when he stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Michael said thus to Raphael: ‘I will not take their part under the eye of Yahuah (Lord); for Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And it came to pass when he stood before Yahuah of Spirits, Michael said thus to Raphael: ‘I will not take their part under the eye of Yahuah; for Yahuah of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore all that is hidden shall come upon them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall have his portion (in it), but alone they have received their judgement for ever and ever.’
verses.text: Therefore all that is hidden shall come upon them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall have his portion (in it), but alone they have received their judgement for ever and ever.’

verses.raw: And after this judgement they shall terrify and make them to tremble because they have shown this to those who dwell on the earth.
verses.text: And after this judgement they shall terrify and make them to tremble because they have shown this to those who dwell on the earth.

verses.raw: And behold the names of those angels [and these are their names: the first of them is Samjâzâ, the second Artâqîfâ, and the third Armên, the fourth Kôkabêl, the fifth Tûrâêl, the sixth Rûmjâl, the seventh Dânjâl, the eighth Nêqâêl, the ninth Barâqêl, the tenth Azâzêl, the eleventh Armârôs, the twelfth Batarjâl, the thirteenth Busasêjal, the fourteenth Hanânêl, the fifteenth Tûrêl, and the sixteenth Simâpêsîêl, the seventeenth Jetrêl, the eighteenth Tumâêl, the nineteenth Tûrêl, the twentieth Rûmâêl, the twenty-first Azâzêl.
verses.text: And behold the names of those angels [and these are their names: the first of them is Samjâzâ, the second Artâqîfâ, and the third Armên, the fourth Kôkabêl, the fifth Tûrâêl, the sixth Rûmjâl, the seventh Dânjâl, the eighth Nêqâêl, the ninth Barâqêl, the tenth Azâzêl, the eleventh Armârôs, the twelfth Batarjâl, the thirteenth Busasêjal, the fourteenth Hanânêl, the fifteenth Tûrêl, and the sixteenth Simâpêsîêl, the seventeenth Jetrêl, the eighteenth Tumâêl, the nineteenth Tûrêl, the twentieth Rûmâêl, the twenty-first Azâzêl.

verses.raw: And these are the chiefs of their angels and their names, and their chief ones over hundreds and over fifties and over tens].
verses.text: And these are the chiefs of their angels and their names, and their chief ones over hundreds and over fifties and over tens].

verses.raw: The name of the first Jeqôn: that is, the one who led astray [all] the sons of Elohim (God), and brought them down to the earth, and led them astray through the daughters of men.
verses.text: The name of the first Jeqôn: that is, the one who led astray [all] the sons of Elohim, and brought them down to the earth, and led them astray through the daughters of men.

verses.raw: And the second was named Asbeêl: he imparted to the holy sons of Elohim (God) evil counsel, and led them astray so that they defiled their bodies with the daughters of men.
verses.text: And the second was named Asbeêl: he imparted to the holy sons of Elohim evil counsel, and led them astray so that they defiled their bodies with the daughters of men.

verses.raw: And the third was named Gâdreêl: he it is who showed the children of men all the blows of death, and he led astray Eve, and showed [the weapons of death to the sons of men] the shield and the coat of mail, and the sword for battle, and all the weapons of death to the children of men.
