verses.text: And the third was named Gâdreêl: he it is who showed the children of men all the blows of death, and he led astray Eve, and showed [the weapons of death to the sons of men] the shield and the coat of mail, and the sword for battle, and all the weapons of death to the children of men.

verses.raw: And from his hand they have proceeded against those who dwell on the earth from that day and for evermore.
verses.text: And from his hand they have proceeded against those who dwell on the earth from that day and for evermore.

verses.raw: And the fourth was named Pênemûe: he taught the children of men the bitter and the sweet, and he taught them all the secrets of their wisdom.
verses.text: And the fourth was named Pênemûe: he taught the children of men the bitter and the sweet, and he taught them all the secrets of their wisdom.

verses.raw: And he instructed mankind in writing with ink and paper, and thereby many sinned from eternity to eternity and until this day.
verses.text: And he instructed mankind in writing with ink and paper, and thereby many sinned from eternity to eternity and until this day.

verses.raw: For men were not created for such a purpose, to give confirmation to their good faith with pen and ink.
verses.text: For men were not created for such a purpose, to give confirmation to their good faith with pen and ink.

verses.raw: For men were created exactly like the angels, to the intent that they should continue pure and righteous, and death, which destroys everything, could not have taken hold of them, but through this their knowledge they are perishing, and through this power it is consuming me.
verses.text: For men were created exactly like the angels, to the intent that they should continue pure and righteous, and death, which destroys everything, could not have taken hold of them, but through this their knowledge they are perishing, and through this power it is consuming me.

verses.raw: And the fifth was named Kâsdejâ: this is he who showed the children of men all the wicked smitings of spirits and demons, and the smitings of the embryo in the womb, that it may pass away, and [the smitings of the soul] the bites of the serpent, and the smitings which befall through the noontide heat, the son of the serpent named Tabâ’ět.
verses.text: And the fifth was named Kâsdejâ: this is he who showed the children of men all the wicked smitings of spirits and demons, and the smitings of the embryo in the womb, that it may pass away, and [the smitings of the soul] the bites of the serpent, and the smitings which befall through the noontide heat, the son of the serpent named Tabâ’ět.

verses.raw: And this is the task of Kâsbeêl, the chief of the oath which he showed to the holy ones when he dwelt high above in glory, and its name is Bîqâ.
verses.text: And this is the task of Kâsbeêl, the chief of the oath which he showed to the holy ones when he dwelt high above in glory, and its name is Bîqâ.

verses.raw: This (angel) requested Michael to show him the hidden name, that he might enunciate it in the oath, so that those might quake before that name and oath who revealed all that was in secret to the children of men.
verses.text: This (angel) requested Michael to show him the hidden name, that he might enunciate it in the oath, so that those might quake before that name and oath who revealed all that was in secret to the children of men.

verses.raw: And this is the power of this oath, for it is powerful and strong, and he placed this oath Akâe in the hand of Michael.
verses.text: And this is the power of this oath, for it is powerful and strong, and he placed this oath Akâe in the hand of Michael.

verses.raw: And these are the secrets of this oath... And they are strong through his oath: And the heaven was suspended before the world was created, And for ever.
verses.text: And these are the secrets of this oath... And they are strong through his oath: And the heaven was suspended before the world was created, And for ever.

verses.raw: And through it the earth was founded upon the water, And from the secret recesses of the mountains come beautiful waters, From the creation of the world and unto eternity.
verses.text: And through it the earth was founded upon the water, And from the secret recesses of the mountains come beautiful waters, From the creation of the world and unto eternity.

verses.raw: And through that oath the sea was created, And as its foundation He set for it the sand against the time of (its) anger, And it dare not pass beyond it from the creation of the world unto eternity.
verses.text: And through that oath the sea was created, And as its foundation He set for it the sand against the time of (its) anger, And it dare not pass beyond it from the creation of the world unto eternity.

verses.raw: And through that oath are the depths made fast, And abide and stir not from their place from eternity to eternity.
verses.text: And through that oath are the depths made fast, And abide and stir not from their place from eternity to eternity.

verses.raw: And through that oath the sun and moon complete their course, And deviate not from their ordinance from eternity to eternity.
verses.text: And through that oath the sun and moon complete their course, And deviate not from their ordinance from eternity to eternity.

verses.raw: And through that oath the stars complete their course, And He calls them by their names, And they answer Him from eternity to eternity.
verses.text: And through that oath the stars complete their course, And He calls them by their names, And they answer Him from eternity to eternity.

verses.raw: [And in like manner the spirits of the water, and of the winds, and of all zephyrs, and (their) paths from all the quarters of the winds.
verses.text: [And in like manner the spirits of the water, and of the winds, and of all zephyrs, and (their) paths from all the quarters of the winds.

verses.raw: And there are preserved the voices of the thunder and the light of the lightnings: and there are preserved the chambers of the hail and the chambers of the hoar-frost, and the chambers of the mist, and the chambers of the rain and the dew.
verses.text: And there are preserved the voices of the thunder and the light of the lightnings: and there are preserved the chambers of the hail and the chambers of the hoar-frost, and the chambers of the mist, and the chambers of the rain and the dew.

verses.raw: And all these believe and give thanks before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and glorify (Him) with all their power, and their food is in every act of thanksgiving: they thank and glorify and extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.]
verses.text: And all these believe and give thanks before Yahuah of Spirits, and glorify (Him) with all their power, and their food is in every act of thanksgiving: they thank and glorify and extol the name of Yahuah of Spirits for ever and ever.]

verses.raw: And this oath is mighty over them, And through it [they are preserved and] their paths are preserved, And their course is not destroyed. Close of the Third Parable.
verses.text: And this oath is mighty over them, And through it [they are preserved and] their paths are preserved, And their course is not destroyed. Close of the Third Parable.

verses.raw: And there was great joy amongst them, And they blessed and glorified and extolled Because the name of that Son of Adam had been revealed unto them.
verses.text: And there was great joy amongst them, And they blessed and glorified and extolled Because the name of that Son of Adam had been revealed unto them.

verses.raw: And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.
verses.text: And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.

verses.raw: With chains shall they be bound, And in their assemblage-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned, And all their works vanish from the face of the earth.
verses.text: With chains shall they be bound, And in their assemblage-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned, And all their works vanish from the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And from henceforth there shall be nothing corruptible; For that Son of Adam has appeared, And has seated himself on the throne of his glory, And all evil shall pass away before his face, And the word of that Son of Adam shall go forth And be strong before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. This is the third Parable of Enoch.
verses.text: And from henceforth there shall be nothing corruptible; For that Son of Adam has appeared, And has seated himself on the throne of his glory, And all evil shall pass away before his face, And the word of that Son of Adam shall go forth And be strong before Yahuah of Spirits. This is the third Parable of Enoch.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this that his name during his lifetime was raised aloft to that Son of Adam and to Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits from amongst those who dwell on the earth.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this that his name during his lifetime was raised aloft to that Son of Adam and to Yahuah of Spirits from amongst those who dwell on the earth.

verses.raw: And he was raised aloft on the chariots of the spirit and his name vanished among them.
verses.text: And he was raised aloft on the chariots of the spirit and his name vanished among them.

verses.raw: And from that day I was no longer numbered amongst them: and he set me between the two winds, between the North and the West, where the angels took the cords to measure for me the place for the elect and righteous.
verses.text: And from that day I was no longer numbered amongst them: and he set me between the two winds, between the North and the West, where the angels took the cords to measure for me the place for the elect and righteous.

verses.raw: And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning dwell in that place.
verses.text: And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning dwell in that place.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim (God). They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the holy sons of Elohim. They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.

verses.raw: And I saw two streams of fire, And the light of that fire shone like hyacinth, And I fell on my face before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.
verses.text: And I saw two streams of fire, And the light of that fire shone like hyacinth, And I fell on my face before Yahuah of Spirits.

verses.raw: And the angel Michael [one of the archangels] seized me by my right hand, And lifted me up and led me forth into all the secrets, And he showed me all the secrets of righteousness.
verses.text: And the angel Michael [one of the archangels] seized me by my right hand, And lifted me up and led me forth into all the secrets, And he showed me all the secrets of righteousness.

verses.raw: And he showed me all the secrets of the ends of the heaven, And all the chambers of all the stars, and all the luminaries, Whence they proceed before the face of the holy ones.
verses.text: And he showed me all the secrets of the ends of the heaven, And all the chambers of all the stars, and all the luminaries, Whence they proceed before the face of the holy ones.

verses.raw: And he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens, And I saw there as it were a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.
verses.text: And he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens, And I saw there as it were a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.

verses.raw: And my spirit saw the girdle which girt that house of fire, And on its four sides were streams full of living fire, And they girt that house.
verses.text: And my spirit saw the girdle which girt that house of fire, And on its four sides were streams full of living fire, And they girt that house.

verses.raw: And round about were Seraphin, Cherubin, and Ophannin: And these are they who sleep not And guard the throne of His glory.
verses.text: And round about were Seraphin, Cherubin, and Ophannin: And these are they who sleep not And guard the throne of His glory.

verses.raw: And I saw angels who could not be counted, A thousand thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand, Encircling that house. And Michael, and Raphael, and Gabriel, and Phanuel, And the holy angels who are above the heavens, Go in and out of that house.
verses.text: And I saw angels who could not be counted, A thousand thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand, Encircling that house. And Michael, and Raphael, and Gabriel, and Phanuel, And the holy angels who are above the heavens, Go in and out of that house.

verses.raw: And they came forth from that house, And Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, And many holy angels without number.
verses.text: And they came forth from that house, And Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, And many holy angels without number.

verses.raw: And with them the Head of Days, His head white and pure as wool, And His raiment indescribable.
verses.text: And with them the Head of Days, His head white and pure as wool, And His raiment indescribable.

verses.raw: And I fell on my face, And my whole body became relaxed, And my spirit was transfigured; And I cried with a loud voice,... with the spirit of power, And blessed and glorified and extolled.
verses.text: And I fell on my face, And my whole body became relaxed, And my spirit was transfigured; And I cried with a loud voice,... with the spirit of power, And blessed and glorified and extolled.

verses.raw: And these blessings which went forth out of my mouth were well pleasing before that Head of Days.
verses.text: And these blessings which went forth out of my mouth were well pleasing before that Head of Days.

verses.raw: And that Head of Days came with Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, thousands and ten thousands of angels without number. [Lost passage wherein the Son of Adam was described as accompanying the Head of Days, and Enoch asked one of the angels (as in xlvi. 3) concerning the Son of Adam as to who he was.]
verses.text: And that Head of Days came with Michael and Gabriel, Raphael and Phanuel, thousands and ten thousands of angels without number. [Lost passage wherein the Son of Adam was described as accompanying the Head of Days, and Enoch asked one of the angels (as in xlvi. 3) concerning the Son of Adam as to who he was.]

verses.raw: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’
verses.text: And he (i.e. the angel) came to me and greeted me with His voice, and said unto me: ‘This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness, And righteousness abides over him, And the righteousness of the Head of Days forsakes him not.’

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘He proclaims unto thee peace in the name of the world to come; For from hence has proceeded peace since the creation of the world, And so shall it be unto thee for ever and for ever and ever.
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘He proclaims unto thee peace in the name of the world to come; For from hence has proceeded peace since the creation of the world, And so shall it be unto thee for ever and for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And all shall walk in his ways since righteousness never forsaketh him: With him will be their dwelling-places, and with him their heritage, And they shall not be separated from him for ever and ever and ever.
verses.text: And all shall walk in his ways since righteousness never forsaketh him: With him will be their dwelling-places, and with him their heritage, And they shall not be separated from him for ever and ever and ever.

verses.raw: And so there shall be length of days with that Son of Adam, And the righteous shall have peace and an upright way In the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.’
verses.text: And so there shall be length of days with that Son of Adam, And the righteous shall have peace and an upright way In the name of Yahuah of Spirits for ever and ever.’

verses.raw: The book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons, according to their names and places of origin, and according to their months, which Uriel, the holy angel, who was with me, who is their guide, showed me; and he showed me all their laws exactly as they are, and how it is with regard to all the years of the world and unto eternity, till the new creation is accomplished which dureth till eternity.
verses.text: The book of the courses of the luminaries of the heaven, the relations of each, according to their classes, their dominion and their seasons, according to their names and places of origin, and according to their months, which Uriel, the holy angel, who was with me, who is their guide, showed me; and he showed me all their laws exactly as they are, and how it is with regard to all the years of the world and unto eternity, till the new creation is accomplished which dureth till eternity.

verses.raw: And this is the first law of the luminaries: the luminary the Sun has its rising in the eastern portals of the heaven, and its setting in the western portals of the heaven.
verses.text: And this is the first law of the luminaries: the luminary the Sun has its rising in the eastern portals of the heaven, and its setting in the western portals of the heaven.

verses.raw: And I saw six portals in which the sun rises, and six portals in which the sun sets: and the moon rises and sets in these portals, and the leaders of the stars and those whom they lead: six in the east and six in the west, and all following each other in accurately corresponding order: also many windows to the right and left of these portals.
verses.text: And I saw six portals in which the sun rises, and six portals in which the sun sets: and the moon rises and sets in these portals, and the leaders of the stars and those whom they lead: six in the east and six in the west, and all following each other in accurately corresponding order: also many windows to the right and left of these portals.

verses.raw: And first there goes forth the great luminary, named the Sun, and his circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and he is quite filled with illuminating and heating fire.
verses.text: And first there goes forth the great luminary, named the Sun, and his circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and he is quite filled with illuminating and heating fire.

verses.raw: The chariot on which he ascends, the wind drives, and the sun goes down from the heaven and returns through the north in order to reach the east, and is so guided that he comes to the appropriate (lit. ‘that’) portal and shines in the face of the heaven.
verses.text: The chariot on which he ascends, the wind drives, and the sun goes down from the heaven and returns through the north in order to reach the east, and is so guided that he comes to the appropriate (lit. ‘that’) portal and shines in the face of the heaven.

verses.raw: In this way he rises in the first month in the great portal, which is the fourth [those six portals in the east].
verses.text: In this way he rises in the first month in the great portal, which is the fourth [those six portals in the east].

verses.raw: And in that fourth portal from which the sun rises in the first month are twelve window-openings, from which proceed a flame when they are opened in their season.
verses.text: And in that fourth portal from which the sun rises in the first month are twelve window-openings, from which proceed a flame when they are opened in their season.

verses.raw: When the sun rises in the heaven, he comes forth through that fourth portal thirty mornings in succession, and sets accurately in the fourth portal in the west of the heaven.
verses.text: When the sun rises in the heaven, he comes forth through that fourth portal thirty mornings in succession, and sets accurately in the fourth portal in the west of the heaven.

verses.raw: And during this period the day becomes daily longer and the night nightly shorter to the thirtieth morning.
verses.text: And during this period the day becomes daily longer and the night nightly shorter to the thirtieth morning.

verses.raw: On that day the day is longer than the night by a ninth part, and the day amounts exactly to ten parts and the night to eight parts.
verses.text: On that day the day is longer than the night by a ninth part, and the day amounts exactly to ten parts and the night to eight parts.

verses.raw: And the sun rises from that fourth portal, and sets in the fourth and returns to the fifth portal of the east thirty mornings, and rises from it and sets in the fifth portal.
verses.text: And the sun rises from that fourth portal, and sets in the fourth and returns to the fifth portal of the east thirty mornings, and rises from it and sets in the fifth portal.

verses.raw: And then the day becomes longer by two parts and amounts to eleven parts, and the night becomes shorter and amounts to seven parts.
verses.text: And then the day becomes longer by two parts and amounts to eleven parts, and the night becomes shorter and amounts to seven parts.

verses.raw: And it returns to the east and enters into the sixth portal, and rises and sets in the sixth portal one-and-thirty mornings on account of its sign.
verses.text: And it returns to the east and enters into the sixth portal, and rises and sets in the sixth portal one-and-thirty mornings on account of its sign.

verses.raw: On that day the day becomes longer than the night, and the day becomes double the night, and the day becomes twelve parts, and the night is shortened and becomes six parts.
verses.text: On that day the day becomes longer than the night, and the day becomes double the night, and the day becomes twelve parts, and the night is shortened and becomes six parts.

verses.raw: And the sun mounts up to make the day shorter and the night longer, and the sun returns to the east and enters into the sixth portal, and rises from it and sets thirty mornings.
verses.text: And the sun mounts up to make the day shorter and the night longer, and the sun returns to the east and enters into the sixth portal, and rises from it and sets thirty mornings.

verses.raw: And when thirty mornings are accomplished, the day decreases by exactly one part, and becomes eleven parts, and the night seven.
verses.text: And when thirty mornings are accomplished, the day decreases by exactly one part, and becomes eleven parts, and the night seven.

verses.raw: And the sun goes forth from that sixth portal in the west, and goes to the east and rises in the fifth portal for thirty mornings, and sets in the west again in the fifth western portal.
verses.text: And the sun goes forth from that sixth portal in the west, and goes to the east and rises in the fifth portal for thirty mornings, and sets in the west again in the fifth western portal.

verses.raw: On that day the day decreases by two parts, and amounts to ten parts and the night to eight parts.
verses.text: On that day the day decreases by two parts, and amounts to ten parts and the night to eight parts.

verses.raw: And the sun goes forth from that fifth portal and sets in the fifth portal of the west, and rises in the fourth portal for one-and-thirty mornings on account of its sign, and sets in the west.
verses.text: And the sun goes forth from that fifth portal and sets in the fifth portal of the west, and rises in the fourth portal for one-and-thirty mornings on account of its sign, and sets in the west.

verses.raw: On that day the day is equalized with the night, [and becomes of equal length], and the night amounts to nine parts and the day to nine parts.
verses.text: On that day the day is equalized with the night, [and becomes of equal length], and the night amounts to nine parts and the day to nine parts.

verses.raw: And the sun rises from that portal and sets in the west, and returns to the east and rises thirty mornings in the third portal and sets in the west in the third portal.
verses.text: And the sun rises from that portal and sets in the west, and returns to the east and rises thirty mornings in the third portal and sets in the west in the third portal.

verses.raw: And on that day the night becomes longer than the day, and night becomes longer than night, and day shorter than day till the thirtieth morning, and the night amounts exactly to ten parts and the day to eight parts.
verses.text: And on that day the night becomes longer than the day, and night becomes longer than night, and day shorter than day till the thirtieth morning, and the night amounts exactly to ten parts and the day to eight parts.

verses.raw: And the sun rises from that third portal and sets in the third portal in the west and returns to the east, and for thirty mornings rises in the second portal in the east, and in like manner sets in the second portal in the west of the heaven.
verses.text: And the sun rises from that third portal and sets in the third portal in the west and returns to the east, and for thirty mornings rises in the second portal in the east, and in like manner sets in the second portal in the west of the heaven.

verses.raw: And on that day the night amounts to eleven parts and the day to seven parts.
verses.text: And on that day the night amounts to eleven parts and the day to seven parts.

verses.raw: And the sun rises on that day from that second portal and sets in the west in the second portal, and returns to the east into the first portal for one-and-thirty mornings, and sets in the first portal in the west of the heaven.
verses.text: And the sun rises on that day from that second portal and sets in the west in the second portal, and returns to the east into the first portal for one-and-thirty mornings, and sets in the first portal in the west of the heaven.

verses.raw: And on that day the night becomes longer and amounts to the double of the day: and the night amounts exactly to twelve parts and the day to six.
verses.text: And on that day the night becomes longer and amounts to the double of the day: and the night amounts exactly to twelve parts and the day to six.

verses.raw: And the sun has (therewith) traversed the divisions of his orbit and turns again on those divisions of his orbit, and enters that portal thirty mornings and sets also in the west opposite to it.
verses.text: And the sun has (therewith) traversed the divisions of his orbit and turns again on those divisions of his orbit, and enters that portal thirty mornings and sets also in the west opposite to it.

verses.raw: And on that night has the night decreased in length by a ninth part, and the night has become eleven parts and the day seven parts.
verses.text: And on that night has the night decreased in length by a ninth part, and the night has become eleven parts and the day seven parts.

verses.raw: And the sun has returned and entered into the second portal in the east, and returns on those his divisions of his orbit for thirty mornings, rising and setting.
verses.text: And the sun has returned and entered into the second portal in the east, and returns on those his divisions of his orbit for thirty mornings, rising and setting.

verses.raw: And on that day the night decreases in length, and the night amounts to ten parts and the day to eight.
verses.text: And on that day the night decreases in length, and the night amounts to ten parts and the day to eight.

verses.raw: And on that day the sun rises from that portal, and sets in the west, and returns to the east, and rises in the third portal for one-and- thirty mornings, and sets in the west of the heaven.
verses.text: And on that day the sun rises from that portal, and sets in the west, and returns to the east, and rises in the third portal for one-and- thirty mornings, and sets in the west of the heaven.

verses.raw: On that day the night decreases and amounts to nine parts, and the day to nine parts, and the night is equal to the day and the year is exactly as to its days three hundred and sixty-four.
verses.text: On that day the night decreases and amounts to nine parts, and the day to nine parts, and the night is equal to the day and the year is exactly as to its days three hundred and sixty-four.

verses.raw: And the length of the day and of the night, and the shortness of the day and of the night arise—through the course of the sun these distinctions are made (lit. ‘they are separated’).
verses.text: And the length of the day and of the night, and the shortness of the day and of the night arise—through the course of the sun these distinctions are made (lit. ‘they are separated’).

verses.raw: So it comes that its course becomes daily longer, and its course nightly shorter.
verses.text: So it comes that its course becomes daily longer, and its course nightly shorter.

verses.raw: And this is the law and the course of the sun, and his return as often as he returns sixty times and rises, i.e. the great luminary which is named the sun, for ever and ever.
verses.text: And this is the law and the course of the sun, and his return as often as he returns sixty times and rises, i.e. the great luminary which is named the sun, for ever and ever.

verses.raw: And that which (thus) rises is the great luminary, and is so named according to its appearance, according as Yahuah (Lord) commanded.
verses.text: And that which (thus) rises is the great luminary, and is so named according to its appearance, according as Yahuah commanded.

verses.raw: As he rises, so he sets and decreases not, and rests not, but runs day and night, and his light is sevenfold brighter than that of the moon; but as regards size they are both equal.
verses.text: As he rises, so he sets and decreases not, and rests not, but runs day and night, and his light is sevenfold brighter than that of the moon; but as regards size they are both equal.

verses.raw: And after this law I saw another law dealing with the smaller luminary, which is named the Moon.
verses.text: And after this law I saw another law dealing with the smaller luminary, which is named the Moon.

verses.raw: And her circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and her chariot in which she rides is driven by the wind, and light is given to her in (definite) measure.
verses.text: And her circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and her chariot in which she rides is driven by the wind, and light is given to her in (definite) measure.

verses.raw: And her rising and setting change every month: and her days are like the days of the sun, and when her light is uniform (i.e. full) it amounts to the seventh part of the light of the sun.
verses.text: And her rising and setting change every month: and her days are like the days of the sun, and when her light is uniform (i.e. full) it amounts to the seventh part of the light of the sun.

verses.raw: And thus she rises. And her first phase in the east comes forth on the thirtieth morning: and on that day she becomes visible, and constitutes for you the first phase of the moon on the thirtieth day together with the sun in the portal where the sun rises.
verses.text: And thus she rises. And her first phase in the east comes forth on the thirtieth morning: and on that day she becomes visible, and constitutes for you the first phase of the moon on the thirtieth day together with the sun in the portal where the sun rises.

verses.raw: And the one half of her goes forth by a seventh part, and her whole circumference is empty, without light, with the exception of one-seventh part of it, (and) the fourteenth part of her light.
verses.text: And the one half of her goes forth by a seventh part, and her whole circumference is empty, without light, with the exception of one-seventh part of it, (and) the fourteenth part of her light.

verses.raw: And when she receives one-seventh part of the half of her light, her light amounts to one-seventh part and the half thereof.
verses.text: And when she receives one-seventh part of the half of her light, her light amounts to one-seventh part and the half thereof.

verses.raw: And she sets with the sun, and when the sun rises the moon rises with him and receives the half of one part of light, and in that night in the beginning of her morning [in the commencement of the lunar day] the moon sets with the sun, and is invisible that night with the fourteen parts and the half of one of them.
verses.text: And she sets with the sun, and when the sun rises the moon rises with him and receives the half of one part of light, and in that night in the beginning of her morning [in the commencement of the lunar day] the moon sets with the sun, and is invisible that night with the fourteen parts and the half of one of them.

verses.raw: And she rises on that day with exactly a seventh part, and comes forth and recedes from the rising of the sun, and in her remaining days she becomes bright in the (remaining) thirteen parts.
verses.text: And she rises on that day with exactly a seventh part, and comes forth and recedes from the rising of the sun, and in her remaining days she becomes bright in the (remaining) thirteen parts.

verses.raw: And I saw another course, a law for her, (and) how according to that law she performs her monthly revolution.
verses.text: And I saw another course, a law for her, (and) how according to that law she performs her monthly revolution.

verses.raw: And all these Uriel, the holy angel who is the leader of them all, showed to me, and their positions, and I wrote down their positions as he showed them to me, and I wrote down their months as they were, and the appearance of their lights till fifteen days were accomplished.
verses.text: And all these Uriel, the holy angel who is the leader of them all, showed to me, and their positions, and I wrote down their positions as he showed them to me, and I wrote down their months as they were, and the appearance of their lights till fifteen days were accomplished.

verses.raw: In single seventh parts she accomplishes all her light in the east, and in single seventh parts accomplishes all her darkness in the west.
verses.text: In single seventh parts she accomplishes all her light in the east, and in single seventh parts accomplishes all her darkness in the west.

verses.raw: And in certain months she alters her settings, and in certain months she pursues her own peculiar course.
verses.text: And in certain months she alters her settings, and in certain months she pursues her own peculiar course.

verses.raw: In two months the moon sets with the sun: in those two middle portals the third and the fourth.
verses.text: In two months the moon sets with the sun: in those two middle portals the third and the fourth.

verses.raw: She goes forth for seven days, and turns about and returns again through the portal where the sun rises, and accomplishes all her light: and she recedes from the sun, and in eight days enters the sixth portal from which the sun goes forth.
verses.text: She goes forth for seven days, and turns about and returns again through the portal where the sun rises, and accomplishes all her light: and she recedes from the sun, and in eight days enters the sixth portal from which the sun goes forth.

verses.raw: And when the sun goes forth from the fourth portal she goes forth seven days, until she goes forth from the fifth and turns back again in seven days into the fourth portal and accomplishes all her light: and she recedes and enters into the first portal in eight days.
verses.text: And when the sun goes forth from the fourth portal she goes forth seven days, until she goes forth from the fifth and turns back again in seven days into the fourth portal and accomplishes all her light: and she recedes and enters into the first portal in eight days.

verses.raw: And she returns again in seven days into the fourth portal from which the sun goes forth.
verses.text: And she returns again in seven days into the fourth portal from which the sun goes forth.

verses.raw: Thus I saw their position—how the moons rose and the sun set in those days.
verses.text: Thus I saw their position—how the moons rose and the sun set in those days.

verses.raw: And if five years are added together the sun has an overplus of thirty days, and all the days which accrue to it for one of those five years, when they are full, amount to 364 days.
verses.text: And if five years are added together the sun has an overplus of thirty days, and all the days which accrue to it for one of those five years, when they are full, amount to 364 days.

verses.raw: And the overplus of the sun and of the stars amounts to six days: in 5 years 6 days every year come to 30 days: and the moon falls behind the sun and stars to the number of 30 days.
verses.text: And the overplus of the sun and of the stars amounts to six days: in 5 years 6 days every year come to 30 days: and the moon falls behind the sun and stars to the number of 30 days.

verses.raw: And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.
verses.text: And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.

verses.raw: In 3 years there are 1,092 days, and in 5 years 1,820 days, so that in 8 years there are 2,912 days.
verses.text: In 3 years there are 1,092 days, and in 5 years 1,820 days, so that in 8 years there are 2,912 days.

verses.raw: For the moon alone the days amount in 3 years to 1,062 days, and in 5 years she falls 50 days behind: [i.e. to the sum (of 1,770) there is to be added (1,000 and) 62 days.]
verses.text: For the moon alone the days amount in 3 years to 1,062 days, and in 5 years she falls 50 days behind: [i.e. to the sum (of 1,770) there is to be added (1,000 and) 62 days.]

verses.raw: And in 5 years there are 1,770 days, so that for the moon the days in 8 years amount to 2,832 days.
verses.text: And in 5 years there are 1,770 days, so that for the moon the days in 8 years amount to 2,832 days.

verses.raw: [For in 8 years she falls behind to the amount of 80 days], all the days she falls behind in 8 years are 80.
verses.text: [For in 8 years she falls behind to the amount of 80 days], all the days she falls behind in 8 years are 80.

verses.raw: And the year is accurately completed in conformity with their world- stations and the stations of the sun, which rise from the portals through which it (the sun) rises and sets 30 days.
verses.text: And the year is accurately completed in conformity with their world- stations and the stations of the sun, which rise from the portals through which it (the sun) rises and sets 30 days.

verses.raw: And the leaders of the heads of the thousands, who are placed over the whole creation and over all the stars, have also to do with the four intercalary days, being inseparable from their office, according to the reckoning of the year, and these render service on the four days which are not reckoned in the reckoning of the year.
verses.text: And the leaders of the heads of the thousands, who are placed over the whole creation and over all the stars, have also to do with the four intercalary days, being inseparable from their office, according to the reckoning of the year, and these render service on the four days which are not reckoned in the reckoning of the year.

verses.raw: And owing to them men go wrong therein, for those luminaries truly render service on the world-stations, one in the first portal, one in the third portal of the heaven, one in the fourth portal, and one in the sixth portal, and the exactness of the year is accomplished through its separate three hundred and sixty-four stations.
verses.text: And owing to them men go wrong therein, for those luminaries truly render service on the world-stations, one in the first portal, one in the third portal of the heaven, one in the fourth portal, and one in the sixth portal, and the exactness of the year is accomplished through its separate three hundred and sixty-four stations.

verses.raw: For the signs and the times and the years and the days the angel Uriel showed to me, whom Yahuah (Lord) of glory hath set for ever over all the luminaries of the heaven, in the heaven and in the world, that they should rule on the face of the heaven and be seen on the earth, and be leaders for the day and the night, i.e. the sun, moon, and stars, and all the ministering creatures which make their revolution in all the chariots of the heaven.
verses.text: For the signs and the times and the years and the days the angel Uriel showed to me, whom Yahuah of glory hath set for ever over all the luminaries of the heaven, in the heaven and in the world, that they should rule on the face of the heaven and be seen on the earth, and be leaders for the day and the night, i.e. the sun, moon, and stars, and all the ministering creatures which make their revolution in all the chariots of the heaven.

verses.raw: In like manner twelve doors Uriel showed me, open in the circumference of the sun’s chariot in the heaven, through which the rays of the sun break forth: and from them is warmth diffused over the earth, when they are opened at their appointed seasons.
verses.text: In like manner twelve doors Uriel showed me, open in the circumference of the sun’s chariot in the heaven, through which the rays of the sun break forth: and from them is warmth diffused over the earth, when they are opened at their appointed seasons.

verses.raw: [And for the winds and the spirit of the dew when they are opened, standing open in the heavens at the ends.]
verses.text: [And for the winds and the spirit of the dew when they are opened, standing open in the heavens at the ends.]

verses.raw: As for the twelve portals in the heaven, at the ends of the earth, out of which go forth the sun, moon, and stars, and all the works of heaven in the east and in the west,
verses.text: As for the twelve portals in the heaven, at the ends of the earth, out of which go forth the sun, moon, and stars, and all the works of heaven in the east and in the west,

verses.raw: There are many windows open to the left and right of them, and one window at its (appointed) season produces warmth, corresponding (as these do) to those doors from which the stars come forth according as He has commanded them, and wherein they set corresponding to their number.
verses.text: There are many windows open to the left and right of them, and one window at its (appointed) season produces warmth, corresponding (as these do) to those doors from which the stars come forth according as He has commanded them, and wherein they set corresponding to their number.

verses.raw: And I saw chariots in the heaven, running in the world, above those portals in which revolve the stars that never set.
verses.text: And I saw chariots in the heaven, running in the world, above those portals in which revolve the stars that never set.

verses.raw: And one is larger than all the rest, and it is that that makes its course through the entire world.
verses.text: And one is larger than all the rest, and it is that that makes its course through the entire world.

verses.raw: And at the ends of the earth I saw twelve portals open to all the quarters (of the heaven), from which the winds go forth and blow over the earth.
verses.text: And at the ends of the earth I saw twelve portals open to all the quarters (of the heaven), from which the winds go forth and blow over the earth.

verses.raw: Three of them are open on the face (i.e. the east) of the heavens, and three in the west, and three on the right (i.e. the south) of the heaven, and three on the left (i.e. the north).
verses.text: Three of them are open on the face (i.e. the east) of the heavens, and three in the west, and three on the right (i.e. the south) of the heaven, and three on the left (i.e. the north).

verses.raw: And the three first are those of the east, and three are of the north, and three [after those on the left] of the south, and three of the west.
verses.text: And the three first are those of the east, and three are of the north, and three [after those on the left] of the south, and three of the west.

verses.raw: Through four of these come winds of blessing and prosperity, and from those eight come hurtful winds: when they are sent, they bring destruction on all the earth and on the water upon it, and on all who dwell thereon, and on everything which is in the water and on the land.
verses.text: Through four of these come winds of blessing and prosperity, and from those eight come hurtful winds: when they are sent, they bring destruction on all the earth and on the water upon it, and on all who dwell thereon, and on everything which is in the water and on the land.

verses.raw: And the first wind from those portals, called the east wind, comes forth through the first portal which is in the east, inclining towards the south: from it come forth desolation, drought, heat, and destruction.
verses.text: And the first wind from those portals, called the east wind, comes forth through the first portal which is in the east, inclining towards the south: from it come forth desolation, drought, heat, and destruction.

verses.raw: And through the second portal in the middle comes what is fitting, and from it there come rain and fruitfulness and prosperity and dew; and through the third portal which lies toward the north come cold and drought.
verses.text: And through the second portal in the middle comes what is fitting, and from it there come rain and fruitfulness and prosperity and dew; and through the third portal which lies toward the north come cold and drought.

verses.raw: And after these come forth the south winds through three portals: through the first portal of them inclining to the east comes forth a hot wind.
verses.text: And after these come forth the south winds through three portals: through the first portal of them inclining to the east comes forth a hot wind.

verses.raw: And through the middle portal next to it there come forth fragrant smells, and dew and rain, and prosperity and health.
verses.text: And through the middle portal next to it there come forth fragrant smells, and dew and rain, and prosperity and health.

verses.raw: And through the third portal lying to the west come forth dew and rain, locusts and desolation.
verses.text: And through the third portal lying to the west come forth dew and rain, locusts and desolation.

verses.raw: And after these the north winds: from the seventh portal in the east come dew and rain, locusts and desolation.
verses.text: And after these the north winds: from the seventh portal in the east come dew and rain, locusts and desolation.

verses.raw: And from the middle portal come in a direct direction health and rain and dew and prosperity; and through the third portal in the west come cloud and hoar-frost, and snow and rain, and dew and locusts.
verses.text: And from the middle portal come in a direct direction health and rain and dew and prosperity; and through the third portal in the west come cloud and hoar-frost, and snow and rain, and dew and locusts.

verses.raw: And after these [four] are the west winds: through the first portal adjoining the north come forth dew and hoar-frost, and cold and snow and frost.
verses.text: And after these [four] are the west winds: through the first portal adjoining the north come forth dew and hoar-frost, and cold and snow and frost.

verses.raw: And from the middle portal come forth dew and rain, and prosperity and blessing; and through the last portal which adjoins the south come forth drought and desolation, and burning and destruction.
verses.text: And from the middle portal come forth dew and rain, and prosperity and blessing; and through the last portal which adjoins the south come forth drought and desolation, and burning and destruction.

verses.raw: And the twelve portals of the four quarters of the heaven are therewith completed, and all their laws and all their plagues and all their benefactions have I shown to thee, my son Methuselah.
verses.text: And the twelve portals of the four quarters of the heaven are therewith completed, and all their laws and all their plagues and all their benefactions have I shown to thee, my son Methuselah.

verses.raw: And the first quarter is called the east, because it is the first: and the second, the south, because the El Elyon (Most High) will descend there, yea, there in quite a special sense will He who is blessed for ever descend.
verses.text: And the first quarter is called the east, because it is the first: and the second, the south, because the El Elyon will descend there, yea, there in quite a special sense will He who is blessed for ever descend.

verses.raw: And the west quarter is named the diminished, because there all the luminaries of the heaven wane and go down.
verses.text: And the west quarter is named the diminished, because there all the luminaries of the heaven wane and go down.

verses.raw: And the fourth quarter, named the north, is divided into three parts: the first of them is for the dwelling of men: and the second contains seas of water, and the abysses and forests and rivers, and darkness and clouds; and the third part contains the garden of righteousness.
verses.text: And the fourth quarter, named the north, is divided into three parts: the first of them is for the dwelling of men: and the second contains seas of water, and the abysses and forests and rivers, and darkness and clouds; and the third part contains the garden of righteousness.

verses.raw: I saw seven high mountains, higher than all the mountains which are on the earth: and thence comes forth hoar-frost, and days, seasons, and years pass away.
verses.text: I saw seven high mountains, higher than all the mountains which are on the earth: and thence comes forth hoar-frost, and days, seasons, and years pass away.

verses.raw: I saw seven rivers on the earth larger than all the rivers: one of them coming from the west pours its waters into the Great Sea.
verses.text: I saw seven rivers on the earth larger than all the rivers: one of them coming from the west pours its waters into the Great Sea.

verses.raw: And these two come from the north to the sea and pour their waters into the Erythraean Sea in the east.
verses.text: And these two come from the north to the sea and pour their waters into the Erythraean Sea in the east.

verses.raw: And the remaining four come forth on the side of the north to their own sea, two of them to the Erythraean Sea, and two into the Great Sea and discharge themselves there [and some say: into the desert].
verses.text: And the remaining four come forth on the side of the north to their own sea, two of them to the Erythraean Sea, and two into the Great Sea and discharge themselves there [and some say: into the desert].

verses.raw: Seven great islands I saw in the sea and in the mainland: two in the mainland and five in the Great Sea.
verses.text: Seven great islands I saw in the sea and in the mainland: two in the mainland and five in the Great Sea.

verses.raw: And the names of the sun are the following: the first Orjârês, and the second Tômâs.
verses.text: And the names of the sun are the following: the first Orjârês, and the second Tômâs.

verses.raw: And the moon has four names: the first name is Asônjâ, the second Eblâ, the third Benâsê, and the fourth Erâe.
verses.text: And the moon has four names: the first name is Asônjâ, the second Eblâ, the third Benâsê, and the fourth Erâe.

verses.raw: These are the two great luminaries: their circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and the size of the circumference of both is alike.
verses.text: These are the two great luminaries: their circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and the size of the circumference of both is alike.

verses.raw: In the circumference of the sun there are seven portions of light which are added to it more than to the moon, and in definite measures it is transferred till the seventh portion of the sun is exhausted.
verses.text: In the circumference of the sun there are seven portions of light which are added to it more than to the moon, and in definite measures it is transferred till the seventh portion of the sun is exhausted.

verses.raw: And they set and enter the portals of the west, and make their revolution by the north, and come forth through the eastern portals on the face of the heaven.
verses.text: And they set and enter the portals of the west, and make their revolution by the north, and come forth through the eastern portals on the face of the heaven.

verses.raw: And when the moon rises one-fourteenth part appears in the heaven: [the light becomes full in her]: on the fourteenth day she accomplishes her light.
verses.text: And when the moon rises one-fourteenth part appears in the heaven: [the light becomes full in her]: on the fourteenth day she accomplishes her light.

verses.raw: And fifteen parts of light are transferred to her till the fifteenth day (when) her light is accomplished, according to the sign of the year, and she becomes fifteen parts, and the moon grows by (the addition of) fourteenth parts.
verses.text: And fifteen parts of light are transferred to her till the fifteenth day (when) her light is accomplished, according to the sign of the year, and she becomes fifteen parts, and the moon grows by (the addition of) fourteenth parts.

verses.raw: And in her waning (the moon) decreases on the first day to fourteen parts of her light, on the second to thirteen parts of light, on the third to twelve, on the fourth to eleven, on the fifth to ten, on the sixth to nine, on the seventh to eight, on the eighth to seven, on the ninth to six, on the tenth to five, on the eleventh to four, on the twelfth to three, on the thirteenth to two, on the fourteenth to the half of a seventh, and all her remaining light disappears wholly on the fifteenth.
verses.text: And in her waning (the moon) decreases on the first day to fourteen parts of her light, on the second to thirteen parts of light, on the third to twelve, on the fourth to eleven, on the fifth to ten, on the sixth to nine, on the seventh to eight, on the eighth to seven, on the ninth to six, on the tenth to five, on the eleventh to four, on the twelfth to three, on the thirteenth to two, on the fourteenth to the half of a seventh, and all her remaining light disappears wholly on the fifteenth.

verses.raw: And in certain months the month has twenty-nine days and once twenty- eight.
verses.text: And in certain months the month has twenty-nine days and once twenty- eight.

verses.raw: And Uriel showed me another law: when light is transferred to the moon, and on which side it is transferred to her by the sun.
verses.text: And Uriel showed me another law: when light is transferred to the moon, and on which side it is transferred to her by the sun.

verses.raw: During all the period during which the moon is growing in her light, she is transferring it to herself when opposite to the sun during fourteen days [her light is accomplished in the heaven], and when she is illumined throughout, her light is accomplished full in the heaven.
verses.text: During all the period during which the moon is growing in her light, she is transferring it to herself when opposite to the sun during fourteen days [her light is accomplished in the heaven], and when she is illumined throughout, her light is accomplished full in the heaven.

verses.raw: And on the first day she is called the new moon, for on that day the light rises upon her.
verses.text: And on the first day she is called the new moon, for on that day the light rises upon her.

verses.raw: She becomes full moon exactly on the day when the sun sets in the west, and from the east she rises at night, and the moon shines the whole night through till the sun rises over against her and the moon is seen over against the sun.
verses.text: She becomes full moon exactly on the day when the sun sets in the west, and from the east she rises at night, and the moon shines the whole night through till the sun rises over against her and the moon is seen over against the sun.

verses.raw: On the side whence the light of the moon comes forth, there again she wanes till all the light vanishes and all the days of the month are at an end, and her circumference is empty, void of light.
verses.text: On the side whence the light of the moon comes forth, there again she wanes till all the light vanishes and all the days of the month are at an end, and her circumference is empty, void of light.

verses.raw: And three months she makes of thirty days, and at her time she makes three months of twenty-nine days each, in which she accomplishes her waning in the first period of time, and in the first portal for one hundred and seventy-seven days.
verses.text: And three months she makes of thirty days, and at her time she makes three months of twenty-nine days each, in which she accomplishes her waning in the first period of time, and in the first portal for one hundred and seventy-seven days.

verses.raw: And in the time of her going out she appears for three months (of) thirty days each, and for three months she appears (of) twenty-nine each.
verses.text: And in the time of her going out she appears for three months (of) thirty days each, and for three months she appears (of) twenty-nine each.

verses.raw: At night she appears like a man for twenty days each time, and by day she appears like the heaven, and there is nothing else in her save her light.
verses.text: At night she appears like a man for twenty days each time, and by day she appears like the heaven, and there is nothing else in her save her light.

verses.raw: And now, my son, I have shown thee everything, and the law of all the stars of the heaven is completed.
verses.text: And now, my son, I have shown thee everything, and the law of all the stars of the heaven is completed.

verses.raw: And he showed me all the laws of these for every day, and for every season of bearing rule, and for every year, and for its going forth, and for the order prescribed to it every month and every week:
verses.text: And he showed me all the laws of these for every day, and for every season of bearing rule, and for every year, and for its going forth, and for the order prescribed to it every month and every week:

verses.raw: And the waning of the moon which takes place in the sixth portal: for in this sixth portal her light is accomplished, and after that there is the beginning of the waning:
verses.text: And the waning of the moon which takes place in the sixth portal: for in this sixth portal her light is accomplished, and after that there is the beginning of the waning:

verses.raw: And the waning which takes place in the first portal in its season, till one hundred and seventy-seven days are accomplished: reckoned according to weeks, twenty-five (weeks) and two days.
verses.text: And the waning which takes place in the first portal in its season, till one hundred and seventy-seven days are accomplished: reckoned according to weeks, twenty-five (weeks) and two days.

verses.raw: She falls behind the sun and the order of the stars exactly five days in the course of one period, and when this place which thou seest has been traversed.
verses.text: She falls behind the sun and the order of the stars exactly five days in the course of one period, and when this place which thou seest has been traversed.

verses.raw: Such is the picture and sketch of every luminary which Uriel the archangel, who is their leader, showed unto me.
verses.text: Such is the picture and sketch of every luminary which Uriel the archangel, who is their leader, showed unto me.

verses.raw: And in those days the angel Uriel answered and said to me: ‘Behold, I have shown thee everything, Enoch, and I have revealed everything to thee that thou shouldst see this sun and this moon, and the leaders of the stars of the heaven and all those who turn them, their tasks and times and departures.
verses.text: And in those days the angel Uriel answered and said to me: ‘Behold, I have shown thee everything, Enoch, and I have revealed everything to thee that thou shouldst see this sun and this moon, and the leaders of the stars of the heaven and all those who turn them, their tasks and times and departures.

verses.raw: And in the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened, And their seed shall be tardy on their lands and fields, And all things on the earth shall alter, And shall not appear in their time: And the rain shall be kept back And the heaven shall withhold (it).
verses.text: And in the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened, And their seed shall be tardy on their lands and fields, And all things on the earth shall alter, And shall not appear in their time: And the rain shall be kept back And the heaven shall withhold (it).

verses.raw: And in those times the fruits of the earth shall be backward, And shall not grow in their time, And the fruits of the trees shall be withheld in their time.
verses.text: And in those times the fruits of the earth shall be backward, And shall not grow in their time, And the fruits of the trees shall be withheld in their time.

verses.raw: And the moon shall alter her order, And not appear at her time.
verses.text: And the moon shall alter her order, And not appear at her time.

verses.raw: [And in those days the sun shall be seen and he shall journey in the evening on the extremity of the great chariot in the west] And shall shine more brightly than accords with the order of light.
verses.text: [And in those days the sun shall be seen and he shall journey in the evening on the extremity of the great chariot in the west] And shall shine more brightly than accords with the order of light.

verses.raw: And many chiefs of the stars shall transgress the order (prescribed). And these shall alter their orbits and tasks, And not appear at the seasons prescribed to them.
verses.text: And many chiefs of the stars shall transgress the order (prescribed). And these shall alter their orbits and tasks, And not appear at the seasons prescribed to them.

verses.raw: And the whole order of the stars shall be concealed from the sinners, And the thoughts of those on the earth shall err concerning them, [And they shall be altered from all their ways], Yea, they shall err and take them to be gods.
verses.text: And the whole order of the stars shall be concealed from the sinners, And the thoughts of those on the earth shall err concerning them, [And they shall be altered from all their ways], Yea, they shall err and take them to be gods.

verses.raw: And evil shall be multiplied upon them, And punishment shall come upon them So as to destroy all.’
verses.text: And evil shall be multiplied upon them, And punishment shall come upon them So as to destroy all.’

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘Observe, Enoch, these heavenly tablets, And read what is written thereon, And mark every individual fact.’
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘Observe, Enoch, these heavenly tablets, And read what is written thereon, And mark every individual fact.’

verses.raw: And I observed the heavenly tablets, and read everything which was written (thereon) and understood everything, and read the book of all the deeds of mankind, and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth to the remotest generations.
verses.text: And I observed the heavenly tablets, and read everything which was written (thereon) and understood everything, and read the book of all the deeds of mankind, and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth to the remotest generations.

verses.raw: And forthwith I blessed the great Yahuah (Lord) the King of glory for ever, in that He has made all the works of the world, And I extolled Yahuah (Lord) because of His patience, And blessed Him because of the children of men.
verses.text: And forthwith I blessed the great Yahuah the King of glory for ever, in that He has made all the works of the world, And I extolled Yahuah because of His patience, And blessed Him because of the children of men.

verses.raw: And after that I said: ‘Blessed is the man who dies in righteousness and goodness, Concerning whom there is no book of unrighteousness written, And against whom no day of judgement shall be found.’
verses.text: And after that I said: ‘Blessed is the man who dies in righteousness and goodness, Concerning whom there is no book of unrighteousness written, And against whom no day of judgement shall be found.’

verses.raw: And those seven holy ones brought me and placed me on the earth before the door of my house, and said to me: ‘Declare everything to thy son Methuselah, and show to all thy children that no flesh is righteous in the sight of Yahuah (Lord), for He is their Creator.
verses.text: And those seven holy ones brought me and placed me on the earth before the door of my house, and said to me: ‘Declare everything to thy son Methuselah, and show to all thy children that no flesh is righteous in the sight of Yahuah, for He is their Creator.

verses.raw: One year we will leave thee with thy son, till thou givest thy (last) commands, that thou mayst teach thy children and record (it) for them, and testify to all thy children; and in the second year they shall take thee from their midst.
verses.text: One year we will leave thee with thy son, till thou givest thy (last) commands, that thou mayst teach thy children and record (it) for them, and testify to all thy children; and in the second year they shall take thee from their midst.

verses.raw: Let thy heart be strong, For the good shall announce righteousness to the good; The righteous with the righteous shall rejoice, And shall offer congratulation to one another.
verses.text: Let thy heart be strong, For the good shall announce righteousness to the good; The righteous with the righteous shall rejoice, And shall offer congratulation to one another.

verses.raw: But the sinners shall die with the sinners, And the apostate go down with the apostate.
verses.text: But the sinners shall die with the sinners, And the apostate go down with the apostate.

verses.raw: And those who practise righteousness shall die on account of the deeds of men, And be taken away on account of the doings of the godless.’
verses.text: And those who practise righteousness shall die on account of the deeds of men, And be taken away on account of the doings of the godless.’

verses.raw: And in those days they ceased to speak to me, and I came to my people, blessing Yahuah (Lord) of the world.
verses.text: And in those days they ceased to speak to me, and I came to my people, blessing Yahuah of the world.

verses.raw: And now, my son Methuselah, all these things I am recounting to thee and writing down for thee, and I have revealed to thee everything, and given thee books concerning all these: so preserve, my son Methuselah, the books from thy father’s hand, and (see) that thou deliver them to the generations of the world.
verses.text: And now, my son Methuselah, all these things I am recounting to thee and writing down for thee, and I have revealed to thee everything, and given thee books concerning all these: so preserve, my son Methuselah, the books from thy father’s hand, and (see) that thou deliver them to the generations of the world.

verses.raw: I have given wisdom to thee and to thy children, [And thy children that shall be to thee], That they may give it to their children for generations, This wisdom (namely) that passeth their thought.
verses.text: I have given wisdom to thee and to thy children, [And thy children that shall be to thee], That they may give it to their children for generations, This wisdom (namely) that passeth their thought.

verses.raw: And those who understand it shall not sleep, But shall listen with the ear that they may learn this wisdom, And it shall please those that eat thereof better than good food.
verses.text: And those who understand it shall not sleep, But shall listen with the ear that they may learn this wisdom, And it shall please those that eat thereof better than good food.

verses.raw: Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners, in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.
verses.text: Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners, in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.

verses.raw: Owing to them men shall be at fault and not reckon them in the whole reckoning of the year: yea, men shall be at fault, and not recognize them accurately.
verses.text: Owing to them men shall be at fault and not reckon them in the whole reckoning of the year: yea, men shall be at fault, and not recognize them accurately.

verses.raw: For they belong to the reckoning of the year and are truly recorded (thereon) for ever, one in the first portal and one in the third, and one in the fourth and one in the sixth, and the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.
verses.text: For they belong to the reckoning of the year and are truly recorded (thereon) for ever, one in the first portal and one in the third, and one in the fourth and one in the sixth, and the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.

verses.raw: And the account thereof is accurate and the recorded reckoning thereof exact; for the luminaries, and months and festivals, and years and days, has Uriel shown and revealed to me, to whom Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the world hath subjected the host of heaven.
verses.text: And the account thereof is accurate and the recorded reckoning thereof exact; for the luminaries, and months and festivals, and years and days, has Uriel shown and revealed to me, to whom Yahuah of the whole creation of the world hath subjected the host of heaven.

verses.raw: And he has power over night and day in the heaven to cause the light to give light to men—sun, moon, and stars, and all the powers of the heaven which revolve in their circular chariots.
verses.text: And he has power over night and day in the heaven to cause the light to give light to men—sun, moon, and stars, and all the powers of the heaven which revolve in their circular chariots.

verses.raw: And these are the orders of the stars, which set in their places, and in their seasons and festivals and months.
verses.text: And these are the orders of the stars, which set in their places, and in their seasons and festivals and months.

verses.raw: And these are the names of those who lead them, who watch that they enter at their times, in their orders, in their seasons, in their months, in their periods of dominion, and in their positions.
verses.text: And these are the names of those who lead them, who watch that they enter at their times, in their orders, in their seasons, in their months, in their periods of dominion, and in their positions.

verses.raw: Their four leaders who divide the four parts of the year enter first; and after them the twelve leaders of the orders who divide the months; and for the three hundred and sixty (days) there are heads over thousands who divide the days; and for the four intercalary days there are the leaders which sunder the four parts of the year.
verses.text: Their four leaders who divide the four parts of the year enter first; and after them the twelve leaders of the orders who divide the months; and for the three hundred and sixty (days) there are heads over thousands who divide the days; and for the four intercalary days there are the leaders which sunder the four parts of the year.

verses.raw: And these heads over thousands are intercalated between leader and leader, each behind a station, but their leaders make the division.
verses.text: And these heads over thousands are intercalated between leader and leader, each behind a station, but their leaders make the division.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the leaders who divide the four parts of the year which are ordained: Mîlkî’êl, Hel’emmêlêk, and Mêl’êjal, and Nârêl.
verses.text: And these are the names of the leaders who divide the four parts of the year which are ordained: Mîlkî’êl, Hel’emmêlêk, and Mêl’êjal, and Nârêl.

verses.raw: And the names of those who lead them: Adnâr’êl, and Îjâsûsa’êl, and ’Elômê’êl—these three follow the leaders of the orders, and there is one that follows the three leaders of the orders which follow those leaders of stations that divide the four parts of the year.
verses.text: And the names of those who lead them: Adnâr’êl, and Îjâsûsa’êl, and ’Elômê’êl—these three follow the leaders of the orders, and there is one that follows the three leaders of the orders which follow those leaders of stations that divide the four parts of the year.

verses.raw: In the beginning of the year Melkejâl rises first and rules, who is named Tam’âinî and sun, and all the days of his dominion whilst he bears rule are ninety-one days.
verses.text: In the beginning of the year Melkejâl rises first and rules, who is named Tam’âinî and sun, and all the days of his dominion whilst he bears rule are ninety-one days.

verses.raw: And these are the signs of the days which are to be seen on earth in the days of his dominion: sweat, and heat, and calms; and all the trees bear fruit, and leaves are produced on all the trees, and the harvest of wheat, and the rose-flowers, and all the flowers which come forth in the field, but the trees of the winter season become withered.
verses.text: And these are the signs of the days which are to be seen on earth in the days of his dominion: sweat, and heat, and calms; and all the trees bear fruit, and leaves are produced on all the trees, and the harvest of wheat, and the rose-flowers, and all the flowers which come forth in the field, but the trees of the winter season become withered.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the leaders which are under them: Berka’êl, Zêlebs’êl, and another who is added a head of a thousand, called Hîlujâseph: and the days of the dominion of this (leader) are at an end.
verses.text: And these are the names of the leaders which are under them: Berka’êl, Zêlebs’êl, and another who is added a head of a thousand, called Hîlujâseph: and the days of the dominion of this (leader) are at an end.

verses.raw: The next leader after him is Hel’emmêlêk, whom one names the shining sun, and all the days of his light are ninety-one days.
verses.text: The next leader after him is Hel’emmêlêk, whom one names the shining sun, and all the days of his light are ninety-one days.

verses.raw: And these are the signs of (his) days on the earth: glowing heat and dryness, and the trees ripen their fruits and produce all their fruits ripe and ready, and the sheep pair and become pregnant, and all the fruits of the earth are gathered in, and everything that is in the fields, and the winepress: these things take place in the days of his dominion.
verses.text: And these are the signs of (his) days on the earth: glowing heat and dryness, and the trees ripen their fruits and produce all their fruits ripe and ready, and the sheep pair and become pregnant, and all the fruits of the earth are gathered in, and everything that is in the fields, and the winepress: these things take place in the days of his dominion.

verses.raw: These are the names, and the orders, and the leaders of those heads of thousands: Gîdâ’ijal, Kê’êl, and Hê’êl, and the name of the head of a thousand which is added to them, Asfâ’êl: and the days of his dominion are at an end.
verses.text: These are the names, and the orders, and the leaders of those heads of thousands: Gîdâ’ijal, Kê’êl, and Hê’êl, and the name of the head of a thousand which is added to them, Asfâ’êl: and the days of his dominion are at an end.

verses.raw: And now, my son Methuselah, I will show thee all my visions which I have seen, recounting them before thee.
verses.text: And now, my son Methuselah, I will show thee all my visions which I have seen, recounting them before thee.

verses.raw: Two visions I saw before I took a wife, and the one was quite unlike the other: the first when I was learning to write: the second before I took thy mother, (when) I saw a terrible vision.
verses.text: Two visions I saw before I took a wife, and the one was quite unlike the other: the first when I was learning to write: the second before I took thy mother, (when) I saw a terrible vision.

verses.raw: And regarding them I prayed to Yahuah (Lord). I had laid me down in the house of my grandfather Mahalalel, (when) I saw in a vision how the heaven collapsed and was borne off and fell to the earth.
verses.text: And regarding them I prayed to Yahuah. I had laid me down in the house of my grandfather Mahalalel, (when) I saw in a vision how the heaven collapsed and was borne off and fell to the earth.

verses.raw: And when it fell to the earth I saw how the earth was swallowed up in a great abyss, and mountains were suspended on mountains, and hills sank down on hills, and high trees were rent from their stems, and hurled down and sunk in the abyss.
verses.text: And when it fell to the earth I saw how the earth was swallowed up in a great abyss, and mountains were suspended on mountains, and hills sank down on hills, and high trees were rent from their stems, and hurled down and sunk in the abyss.

verses.raw: And thereupon a word fell into my mouth, and I lifted up (my voice) to cry aloud, and said: ‘The earth is destroyed.’
verses.text: And thereupon a word fell into my mouth, and I lifted up (my voice) to cry aloud, and said: ‘The earth is destroyed.’

verses.raw: And my grandfather Mahalalel waked me as I lay near him, and said unto me: ‘Why dost thou cry so, my son, and why dost thou make such lamentation?’
verses.text: And my grandfather Mahalalel waked me as I lay near him, and said unto me: ‘Why dost thou cry so, my son, and why dost thou make such lamentation?’
