verses.text: And hold fast my words in the thoughts of your hearts, And suffer them not to be effaced from your hearts; For I know that sinners will tempt men to evilly-entreat wisdom, So that no place may be found for her, And no manner of temptation may minish.

verses.raw: Woe to those who build unrighteousness and oppression And lay deceit as a foundation; For they shall be suddenly overthrown, And they shall have no peace.
verses.text: Woe to those who build unrighteousness and oppression And lay deceit as a foundation; For they shall be suddenly overthrown, And they shall have no peace.

verses.raw: Woe to those who build their houses with sin; For from all their foundations shall they be overthrown, And by the sword shall they fall. [And those who acquire gold and silver in judgement suddenly shall perish.]
verses.text: Woe to those who build their houses with sin; For from all their foundations shall they be overthrown, And by the sword shall they fall. [And those who acquire gold and silver in judgement suddenly shall perish.]

verses.raw: Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon (Most High) in the days of your riches.
verses.text: Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches, And from your riches shall ye depart, Because ye have not remembered the El Elyon in the days of your riches.

verses.raw: Ye have committed blasphemy and unrighteousness, And have become ready for the day of slaughter, And the day of darkness and the day of the great judgement.
verses.text: Ye have committed blasphemy and unrighteousness, And have become ready for the day of slaughter, And the day of darkness and the day of the great judgement.

verses.raw: Thus I speak and declare unto you: He who hath created you will overthrow you, And for your fall there shall be no compassion, And your Creator will rejoice at your destruction.
verses.text: Thus I speak and declare unto you: He who hath created you will overthrow you, And for your fall there shall be no compassion, And your Creator will rejoice at your destruction.

verses.raw: And your righteous ones in those days shall be A reproach to the sinners and the godless.
verses.text: And your righteous ones in those days shall be A reproach to the sinners and the godless.

verses.raw: Oh that mine eyes were [a cloud of] waters That I might weep over you, And pour down my tears as a cloud of waters: That so I might rest from my trouble of heart!
verses.text: Oh that mine eyes were [a cloud of] waters That I might weep over you, And pour down my tears as a cloud of waters: That so I might rest from my trouble of heart!

verses.raw: Who has permitted you to practise reproaches and wickedness? And so judgement shall overtake you, sinners.
verses.text: Who has permitted you to practise reproaches and wickedness? And so judgement shall overtake you, sinners.

verses.raw: Fear not the sinners, ye righteous; For again will Yahuah (Lord) deliver them into your hands, That ye may execute judgement upon them according to your desires.
verses.text: Fear not the sinners, ye righteous; For again will Yahuah deliver them into your hands, That ye may execute judgement upon them according to your desires.

verses.raw: Woe to you who fulminate anathemas which cannot be reversed: Healing shall therefore be far from you because of your sins.
verses.text: Woe to you who fulminate anathemas which cannot be reversed: Healing shall therefore be far from you because of your sins.

verses.raw: Woe to you who requite your neighbour with evil; For ye shall be requited according to your works.
verses.text: Woe to you who requite your neighbour with evil; For ye shall be requited according to your works.

verses.raw: Woe to you, lying witnesses, And to those who weigh out injustice, For suddenly shall ye perish.
verses.text: Woe to you, lying witnesses, And to those who weigh out injustice, For suddenly shall ye perish.

verses.raw: Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.
verses.text: Woe to you, sinners, for ye persecute the righteous; For ye shall be delivered up and persecuted because of injustice, And heavy shall its yoke be upon you.

verses.raw: Be hopeful, ye righteous; for suddenly shall the sinners perish before you, And ye shall have lordship over them according to your desires.
verses.text: Be hopeful, ye righteous; for suddenly shall the sinners perish before you, And ye shall have lordship over them according to your desires.

verses.raw: [And in the day of the tribulation of the sinners, Your children shall mount and rise as eagles, And higher than the vultures will be your nest, And ye shall ascend and enter the crevices of the earth, And the clefts of the rock for ever as coneys before the unrighteous, And the sirens shall sigh because of you—and weep.]
verses.text: [And in the day of the tribulation of the sinners, Your children shall mount and rise as eagles, And higher than the vultures will be your nest, And ye shall ascend and enter the crevices of the earth, And the clefts of the rock for ever as coneys before the unrighteous, And the sirens shall sigh because of you—and weep.]

verses.raw: Wherefore fear not, ye that have suffered; For healing shall be your portion, And a bright light shall enlighten you, And the voice of rest ye shall hear from heaven.
verses.text: Wherefore fear not, ye that have suffered; For healing shall be your portion, And a bright light shall enlighten you, And the voice of rest ye shall hear from heaven.

verses.raw: Woe unto you, ye sinners, for your riches make you appear like the righteous, But your hearts convict you of being sinners, And this fact shall be a testimony against you for a memorial of (your) evil deeds.
verses.text: Woe unto you, ye sinners, for your riches make you appear like the righteous, But your hearts convict you of being sinners, And this fact shall be a testimony against you for a memorial of (your) evil deeds.

verses.raw: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.
verses.text: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.

verses.raw: Woe to you who drink water from every fountain, For suddenly shall ye be consumed and wither away, Because ye have forsaken the fountain of life.
verses.text: Woe to you who drink water from every fountain, For suddenly shall ye be consumed and wither away, Because ye have forsaken the fountain of life.

verses.raw: Woe to you who work unrighteousness And deceit and blasphemy: It shall be a memorial against you for evil.
verses.text: Woe to you who work unrighteousness And deceit and blasphemy: It shall be a memorial against you for evil.

verses.raw: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.
verses.text: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.

verses.raw: Believe, ye righteous, that the sinners will become a shame And perish in the day of unrighteousness.
verses.text: Believe, ye righteous, that the sinners will become a shame And perish in the day of unrighteousness.

verses.raw: Be it known unto you (ye sinners) that the El Elyon (Most High) is mindful of your destruction, And the angels of heaven rejoice over your destruction.
verses.text: Be it known unto you (ye sinners) that the El Elyon is mindful of your destruction, And the angels of heaven rejoice over your destruction.

verses.raw: What will ye do, ye sinners, And whither will ye flee on that day of judgement, When ye hear the voice of the prayer of the righteous?
verses.text: What will ye do, ye sinners, And whither will ye flee on that day of judgement, When ye hear the voice of the prayer of the righteous?

verses.raw: Yea, ye shall fare like unto them, Against whom this word shall be a testimony: “Ye have been companions of sinners.”
verses.text: Yea, ye shall fare like unto them, Against whom this word shall be a testimony: “Ye have been companions of sinners.”

verses.raw: And in those days the prayer of the righteous shall reach unto Yahuah (Lord), And for you the days of your judgement shall come.
verses.text: And in those days the prayer of the righteous shall reach unto Yahuah, And for you the days of your judgement shall come.

verses.raw: And all the words of your unrighteousness shall be read out before the Great Holy One, And your faces shall be covered with shame, And He will reject every work which is grounded on unrighteousness.
verses.text: And all the words of your unrighteousness shall be read out before the Great Holy One, And your faces shall be covered with shame, And He will reject every work which is grounded on unrighteousness.

verses.raw: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.
verses.text: Woe to you, ye sinners, who live on the mid ocean and on the dry land, Whose remembrance is evil against you.

verses.raw: Woe to you who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness and say: ‘We have become rich with riches and have possessions; And have acquired everything we have desired.
verses.text: Woe to you who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness and say: ‘We have become rich with riches and have possessions; And have acquired everything we have desired.

verses.raw: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,
verses.text: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,

verses.raw: Yea and like water your lies shall flow away; For your riches shall not abide But speedily ascend from you; For ye have acquired it all in unrighteousness, And ye shall be given over to a great curse.
verses.text: Yea and like water your lies shall flow away; For your riches shall not abide But speedily ascend from you; For ye have acquired it all in unrighteousness, And ye shall be given over to a great curse.

verses.raw: And now I swear unto you, to the wise and to the foolish, For ye shall have manifold experiences on the earth.
verses.text: And now I swear unto you, to the wise and to the foolish, For ye shall have manifold experiences on the earth.

verses.raw: For ye men shall put on more adornments than a woman, And coloured garments more than a virgin: In royalty and in grandeur and in power, And in silver and in gold and in purple, And in splendour and in food they shall be poured out as water.
verses.text: For ye men shall put on more adornments than a woman, And coloured garments more than a virgin: In royalty and in grandeur and in power, And in silver and in gold and in purple, And in splendour and in food they shall be poured out as water.

verses.raw: Therefore they shall be wanting in doctrine and wisdom, And they shall perish thereby together with their possessions; And with all their glory and their splendour, And in shame and in slaughter and in great destitution, Their spirits shall be cast into the furnace of fire.
verses.text: Therefore they shall be wanting in doctrine and wisdom, And they shall perish thereby together with their possessions; And with all their glory and their splendour, And in shame and in slaughter and in great destitution, Their spirits shall be cast into the furnace of fire.

verses.raw: I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, as a mountain has not become a slave, And a hill does not become the handmaid of a woman, Even so sin has not been sent upon the earth, But man of himself has created it, And under a great curse shall they fall who commit it.
verses.text: I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, as a mountain has not become a slave, And a hill does not become the handmaid of a woman, Even so sin has not been sent upon the earth, But man of himself has created it, And under a great curse shall they fall who commit it.

verses.raw: And barrenness has not been given to the woman, But on account of the deeds of her own hands she dies without children.
verses.text: And barrenness has not been given to the woman, But on account of the deeds of her own hands she dies without children.

verses.raw: I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, by the Holy Great One, That all your evil deeds are revealed in the heavens, And that none of your deeds of oppression are covered and hidden.
verses.text: I have sworn unto you, ye sinners, by the Holy Great One, That all your evil deeds are revealed in the heavens, And that none of your deeds of oppression are covered and hidden.

verses.raw: And do not think in your spirit nor say in your heart that ye do not know and that ye do not see that every sin is every day recorded in heaven in the presence of the El Elyon (Most High).
verses.text: And do not think in your spirit nor say in your heart that ye do not know and that ye do not see that every sin is every day recorded in heaven in the presence of the El Elyon.

verses.raw: From henceforth ye know that all your oppression wherewith ye oppress is written down every day till the day of your judgement.
verses.text: From henceforth ye know that all your oppression wherewith ye oppress is written down every day till the day of your judgement.

verses.raw: Woe to you, ye fools, for through your folly shall ye perish: and ye transgress against the wise, and so good hap shall not be your portion.
verses.text: Woe to you, ye fools, for through your folly shall ye perish: and ye transgress against the wise, and so good hap shall not be your portion.

verses.raw: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.
verses.text: And now, know ye that ye are prepared for the day of destruction: wherefore do not hope to live, ye sinners, but ye shall depart and die; for ye know no ransom; for ye are prepared for the day of the great judgement, for the day of tribulation and great shame for your spirits.

verses.raw: Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, who work wickedness and eat blood: Whence have ye good things to eat and to drink and to be filled? From all the good things which Yahuah (Lord) the El Elyon (Most High) has placed in abundance on the earth; therefore ye shall have no peace.
verses.text: Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, who work wickedness and eat blood: Whence have ye good things to eat and to drink and to be filled? From all the good things which Yahuah the El Elyon has placed in abundance on the earth; therefore ye shall have no peace.

verses.raw: Woe to you who love the deeds of unrighteousness: wherefore do ye hope for good hap unto yourselves? know that ye shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous, and they shall cut off your necks and slay you, and have no mercy upon you.
verses.text: Woe to you who love the deeds of unrighteousness: wherefore do ye hope for good hap unto yourselves? know that ye shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous, and they shall cut off your necks and slay you, and have no mercy upon you.

verses.raw: Woe to you who rejoice in the tribulation of the righteous; for no grave shall be dug for you.
verses.text: Woe to you who rejoice in the tribulation of the righteous; for no grave shall be dug for you.

verses.raw: Woe to you who set at nought the words of the righteous; for ye shall have no hope of life.
verses.text: Woe to you who set at nought the words of the righteous; for ye shall have no hope of life.

verses.raw: Woe to you who write down lying and godless words; for they write down their lies that men may hear them and act godlessly towards (their) neighbour.
verses.text: Woe to you who write down lying and godless words; for they write down their lies that men may hear them and act godlessly towards (their) neighbour.

verses.raw: Therefore they shall have no peace but die a sudden death.
verses.text: Therefore they shall have no peace but die a sudden death.

verses.raw: Woe to you who work godlessness, And glory in lying and extol them: Ye shall perish, and no happy life shall be yours.
verses.text: Woe to you who work godlessness, And glory in lying and extol them: Ye shall perish, and no happy life shall be yours.

verses.raw: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.
verses.text: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.

verses.raw: In those days make ready, ye righteous, to raise your prayers as a memorial, And place them as a testimony before the angels, That they may place the sin of the sinners for a memorial before the El Elyon (Most High).
verses.text: In those days make ready, ye righteous, to raise your prayers as a memorial, And place them as a testimony before the angels, That they may place the sin of the sinners for a memorial before the El Elyon.

verses.raw: In those days the nations shall be stirred up, And the families of the nations shall arise on the day of destruction.
verses.text: In those days the nations shall be stirred up, And the families of the nations shall arise on the day of destruction.

verses.raw: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.
verses.text: And in those days the destitute shall go forth and carry off their children, And they shall abandon them, so that their children shall perish through them: Yea, they shall abandon their children (that are still) sucklings, and not return to them, And shall have no pity on their beloved ones.

verses.raw: And again I swear to you, ye sinners, that sin is prepared for a day of unceasing bloodshed.
verses.text: And again I swear to you, ye sinners, that sin is prepared for a day of unceasing bloodshed.

verses.raw: And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.
verses.text: And they who worship stones, and grave images of gold and silver and wood and stone and clay, and those who worship impure spirits and demons, and all kinds of idols not according to knowledge, shall get no manner of help from them.

verses.raw: And they shall become godless by reason of the folly of their hearts, And their eyes shall be blinded through the fear of their hearts And through visions in their dreams.
verses.text: And they shall become godless by reason of the folly of their hearts, And their eyes shall be blinded through the fear of their hearts And through visions in their dreams.

verses.raw: Through these they shall become godless and fearful; For they shall have wrought all their work in a lie, And shall have worshipped a stone: Therefore in an instant shall they perish.
verses.text: Through these they shall become godless and fearful; For they shall have wrought all their work in a lie, And shall have worshipped a stone: Therefore in an instant shall they perish.

verses.raw: But in those days blessed are all they who accept the words of wisdom, and understand them, And observe the paths of the El Elyon (Most High), and walk in the path of His righteousness, And become not godless with the godless; For they shall be saved.
verses.text: But in those days blessed are all they who accept the words of wisdom, and understand them, And observe the paths of the El Elyon, and walk in the path of His righteousness, And become not godless with the godless; For they shall be saved.

verses.raw: Woe to you who spread evil to your neighbours; For you shall be slain in Sheol.
verses.text: Woe to you who spread evil to your neighbours; For you shall be slain in Sheol.

verses.raw: Woe to you who make deceitful and false measures, And (to them) who cause bitterness on the earth; For they shall thereby be utterly consumed.
verses.text: Woe to you who make deceitful and false measures, And (to them) who cause bitterness on the earth; For they shall thereby be utterly consumed.

verses.raw: Woe to you who build your houses through the grievous toil of others, And all their building materials are the bricks and stones of sin; I tell you ye shall have no peace.
verses.text: Woe to you who build your houses through the grievous toil of others, And all their building materials are the bricks and stones of sin; I tell you ye shall have no peace.

verses.raw: Woe to them who reject the measure and eternal heritage of their fathers And whose souls follow after idols; For they shall have no rest.
verses.text: Woe to them who reject the measure and eternal heritage of their fathers And whose souls follow after idols; For they shall have no rest.

verses.raw: Woe to them who work unrighteousness and help oppression, And slay their neighbours until the day of the great judgement.
verses.text: Woe to them who work unrighteousness and help oppression, And slay their neighbours until the day of the great judgement.

verses.raw: For He shall cast down your glory, And bring affliction on your hearts, And shall arouse His fierce indignation And destroy you all with the sword; And all the holy and righteous shall remember your sins.
verses.text: For He shall cast down your glory, And bring affliction on your hearts, And shall arouse His fierce indignation And destroy you all with the sword; And all the holy and righteous shall remember your sins.

verses.raw: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.
verses.text: And in those days in one place the fathers together with their sons shall be smitten And brothers one with another shall fall in death Till the streams flow with their blood.

verses.raw: For a man shall not withhold his hand from slaying his sons and his sons’ sons, And the sinner shall not withhold his hand from his honoured brother: From dawn till sunset they shall slay one another.
verses.text: For a man shall not withhold his hand from slaying his sons and his sons’ sons, And the sinner shall not withhold his hand from his honoured brother: From dawn till sunset they shall slay one another.

verses.raw: And the horse shall walk up to the breast in the blood of sinners, And the chariot shall be submerged to its height.
verses.text: And the horse shall walk up to the breast in the blood of sinners, And the chariot shall be submerged to its height.

verses.raw: In those days the angels shall descend into the secret places And gather together into one place all those who brought down sin, And the El Elyon (Most High) will arise on that day of judgement To execute great judgement amongst sinners.
verses.text: In those days the angels shall descend into the secret places And gather together into one place all those who brought down sin, And the El Elyon will arise on that day of judgement To execute great judgement amongst sinners.

verses.raw: And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels To guard them as the apple of an eye, Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.
verses.text: And over all the righteous and holy He will appoint guardians from amongst the holy angels To guard them as the apple of an eye, Until He makes an end of all wickedness and all sin, And though the righteous sleep a long sleep, they have nought to fear.

verses.raw: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.
verses.text: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.

verses.raw: Woe to you, Sinners, on the day of strong anguish, Ye who afflict the righteous and burn them with fire: Ye shall be requited according to your works.
verses.text: Woe to you, Sinners, on the day of strong anguish, Ye who afflict the righteous and burn them with fire: Ye shall be requited according to your works.

verses.raw: Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, Who watch in order to devise wickedness: Therefore shall fear come upon you And there shall be none to help you.
verses.text: Woe to you, ye obstinate of heart, Who watch in order to devise wickedness: Therefore shall fear come upon you And there shall be none to help you.

verses.raw: Woe to you, ye sinners, on account of the words of your mouth, And on account of the deeds of your hands which your godlessness has wrought, In blazing flames burning worse than fire shall ye burn.
verses.text: Woe to you, ye sinners, on account of the words of your mouth, And on account of the deeds of your hands which your godlessness has wrought, In blazing flames burning worse than fire shall ye burn.

verses.raw: And now, know ye that from the angels He will inquire as to your deeds in heaven, from the sun and from the moon and from the stars in reference to your sins because upon the earth ye execute judgement on the righteous.
verses.text: And now, know ye that from the angels He will inquire as to your deeds in heaven, from the sun and from the moon and from the stars in reference to your sins because upon the earth ye execute judgement on the righteous.

verses.raw: And He will summon to testify against you every cloud and mist and dew and rain; for they shall all be withheld because of you from descending upon you, and they shall be mindful of your sins.
verses.text: And He will summon to testify against you every cloud and mist and dew and rain; for they shall all be withheld because of you from descending upon you, and they shall be mindful of your sins.

verses.raw: And now give presents to the rain that it be not withheld from descending upon you, nor yet the dew, when it has received gold and silver from you that it may descend.
verses.text: And now give presents to the rain that it be not withheld from descending upon you, nor yet the dew, when it has received gold and silver from you that it may descend.

verses.raw: When the hoar-frost and snow with their chilliness, and all the snow- storms with all their plagues fall upon you, in those days ye shall not be able to stand before them.
verses.text: When the hoar-frost and snow with their chilliness, and all the snow- storms with all their plagues fall upon you, in those days ye shall not be able to stand before them.

verses.raw: Observe the heaven, ye children of heaven, and every work of the El Elyon (Most High), and fear ye Him and work no evil in His presence.
verses.text: Observe the heaven, ye children of heaven, and every work of the El Elyon, and fear ye Him and work no evil in His presence.

verses.raw: If He closes the windows of heaven, and withholds the rain and the dew from descending on the earth on your account, what will ye do then?
verses.text: If He closes the windows of heaven, and withholds the rain and the dew from descending on the earth on your account, what will ye do then?

verses.raw: And if He sends His anger upon you because of your deeds, ye cannot petition Him; for ye spake proud and insolent words against His righteousness: therefore ye shall have no peace.
verses.text: And if He sends His anger upon you because of your deeds, ye cannot petition Him; for ye spake proud and insolent words against His righteousness: therefore ye shall have no peace.

verses.raw: And see ye not the sailors of the ships, how their ships are tossed to and fro by the waves, and are shaken by the winds, and are in sore trouble?
verses.text: And see ye not the sailors of the ships, how their ships are tossed to and fro by the waves, and are shaken by the winds, and are in sore trouble?

verses.raw: And therefore do they fear because all their goodly possessions go upon the sea with them, and they have evil forebodings of heart that the sea will swallow them and they will perish therein.
verses.text: And therefore do they fear because all their goodly possessions go upon the sea with them, and they have evil forebodings of heart that the sea will swallow them and they will perish therein.

verses.raw: Are not the entire sea and all its waters, and all its movements, the work of the El Elyon (Most High), and has He not set limits to its doings, and confined it throughout by the sand?
verses.text: Are not the entire sea and all its waters, and all its movements, the work of the El Elyon, and has He not set limits to its doings, and confined it throughout by the sand?

verses.raw: And at His reproof it is afraid and dries up, and all its fish die and all that is in it; but ye sinners that are on the earth fear Him not.
verses.text: And at His reproof it is afraid and dries up, and all its fish die and all that is in it; but ye sinners that are on the earth fear Him not.

verses.raw: Has He not made the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein? Who has given understanding and wisdom to everything that moves on the earth and in the sea?
verses.text: Has He not made the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein? Who has given understanding and wisdom to everything that moves on the earth and in the sea?

verses.raw: Do not the sailors of the ships fear the sea? Yet sinners fear not the El Elyon (Most High).
verses.text: Do not the sailors of the ships fear the sea? Yet sinners fear not the El Elyon.

verses.raw: In those days when He hath brought a grievous fire upon you, Whither will ye flee, and where will ye find deliverance? And when He launches forth His word against you Will you not be affrighted and fear?
verses.text: In those days when He hath brought a grievous fire upon you, Whither will ye flee, and where will ye find deliverance? And when He launches forth His word against you Will you not be affrighted and fear?

verses.raw: And all the luminaries shall be affrighted with great fear, And all the earth shall be affrighted and tremble and be alarmed.
verses.text: And all the luminaries shall be affrighted with great fear, And all the earth shall be affrighted and tremble and be alarmed.

verses.raw: And all the angels shall execute their commands And shall seek to hide themselves from the presence of the Great Glory, And the children of earth shall tremble and quake; And ye sinners shall be cursed for ever, And ye shall have no peace.
verses.text: And all the angels shall execute their commands And shall seek to hide themselves from the presence of the Great Glory, And the children of earth shall tremble and quake; And ye sinners shall be cursed for ever, And ye shall have no peace.

verses.raw: Fear ye not, ye souls of the righteous, And be hopeful ye that have died in righteousness.
verses.text: Fear ye not, ye souls of the righteous, And be hopeful ye that have died in righteousness.

verses.raw: And grieve not if your soul into Sheol has descended in grief, And that in your life your body fared not according to your goodness, But wait for the day of the judgement of sinners And for the day of cursing and chastisement.
verses.text: And grieve not if your soul into Sheol has descended in grief, And that in your life your body fared not according to your goodness, But wait for the day of the judgement of sinners And for the day of cursing and chastisement.

verses.raw: And yet when ye die the sinners speak over you: ‘As we die, so die the righteous, And what benefit do they reap for their deeds?
verses.text: And yet when ye die the sinners speak over you: ‘As we die, so die the righteous, And what benefit do they reap for their deeds?

verses.raw: Behold, even as we, so do they die in grief and darkness, And what have they more than we? From henceforth we are equal.
verses.text: Behold, even as we, so do they die in grief and darkness, And what have they more than we? From henceforth we are equal.

verses.raw: And what will they receive and what will they see for ever? Behold, they too have died, And henceforth for ever shall they see no light.’
verses.text: And what will they receive and what will they see for ever? Behold, they too have died, And henceforth for ever shall they see no light.’

verses.raw: I tell you, ye sinners, ye are content to eat and drink, and rob and sin, and strip men naked, and acquire wealth and see good days.
verses.text: I tell you, ye sinners, ye are content to eat and drink, and rob and sin, and strip men naked, and acquire wealth and see good days.

verses.raw: Have ye seen the righteous how their end falls out, that no manner of violence is found in them till their death?
verses.text: Have ye seen the righteous how their end falls out, that no manner of violence is found in them till their death?

verses.raw: ‘Nevertheless they perished and became as though they had not been, and their spirits descended into Sheol in tribulation.’
verses.text: ‘Nevertheless they perished and became as though they had not been, and their spirits descended into Sheol in tribulation.’

verses.raw: Now, therefore, I swear to you, the righteous, by the glory of the Great and Honoured and
verses.text: Now, therefore, I swear to you, the righteous, by the glory of the Great and Honoured and

verses.raw: Mighty One in dominion, and by His greatness I swear to you. I know a mystery And have read the heavenly tablets, And have seen the holy books, And have found written therein and inscribed regarding them:
verses.text: Mighty One in dominion, and by His greatness I swear to you. I know a mystery And have read the heavenly tablets, And have seen the holy books, And have found written therein and inscribed regarding them:

verses.raw: That all goodness and joy and glory are prepared for them, And written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness, And that manifold good shall be given to you in recompense for your labours, And that your lot is abundantly beyond the lot of the living.
verses.text: That all goodness and joy and glory are prepared for them, And written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness, And that manifold good shall be given to you in recompense for your labours, And that your lot is abundantly beyond the lot of the living.

verses.raw: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.
verses.text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

verses.raw: Woe to you, ye sinners, when ye have died, If ye die in the wealth of your sins, And those who are like you say regarding you: “Blessed are the sinners: they have seen all their days.
verses.text: Woe to you, ye sinners, when ye have died, If ye die in the wealth of your sins, And those who are like you say regarding you: “Blessed are the sinners: they have seen all their days.

verses.raw: And now they have died in prosperity and in wealth, And have not seen tribulation or murder in their life; And they have died in honour, And judgement has not been executed on them during their life.”
verses.text: And now they have died in prosperity and in wealth, And have not seen tribulation or murder in their life; And they have died in honour, And judgement has not been executed on them during their life.”

verses.raw: Know ye, that their souls will be made to descend into Sheol And they shall be wretched in their great tribulation.
verses.text: Know ye, that their souls will be made to descend into Sheol And they shall be wretched in their great tribulation.

verses.raw: And into darkness and chains and a burning flame where there is grievous judgement shall your spirits enter; And the great judgement shall be for all the generations of the world. Woe to you, for ye shall have no peace.
verses.text: And into darkness and chains and a burning flame where there is grievous judgement shall your spirits enter; And the great judgement shall be for all the generations of the world. Woe to you, for ye shall have no peace.

verses.raw: Say not in regard to the righteous and good who are in life: “In our troubled days we have toiled laboriously and experienced every trouble, And met with much evil and been consumed, And have become few and our spirit small.
verses.text: Say not in regard to the righteous and good who are in life: “In our troubled days we have toiled laboriously and experienced every trouble, And met with much evil and been consumed, And have become few and our spirit small.

verses.raw: And we have been destroyed and have not found any to help us even with a word: We have been tortured [and destroyed], and not hoped to see life from day to day.
verses.text: And we have been destroyed and have not found any to help us even with a word: We have been tortured [and destroyed], and not hoped to see life from day to day.

verses.raw: We hoped to be the head and have become the tail: We have toiled laboriously and had no satisfaction in our toil; And we have become the food of the sinners and the unrighteous, And they have laid their yoke heavily upon us.
verses.text: We hoped to be the head and have become the tail: We have toiled laboriously and had no satisfaction in our toil; And we have become the food of the sinners and the unrighteous, And they have laid their yoke heavily upon us.

verses.raw: They have had dominion over us that hated us and smote us; And to those that hated us we have bowed our necks But they pitied us not.
verses.text: They have had dominion over us that hated us and smote us; And to those that hated us we have bowed our necks But they pitied us not.

verses.raw: We desired to get away from them that we might escape and be at rest, But found no place whereunto we should flee and be safe from them.
verses.text: We desired to get away from them that we might escape and be at rest, But found no place whereunto we should flee and be safe from them.

verses.raw: And we complained to the rulers in our tribulation, And cried out against those who devoured us, But they did not attend to our cries And would not hearken to our voice.
verses.text: And we complained to the rulers in our tribulation, And cried out against those who devoured us, But they did not attend to our cries And would not hearken to our voice.

verses.raw: And they helped those who robbed us and devoured us and those who made us few; and they concealed their oppression, and they did not remove from us the yoke of those that devoured us and dispersed us and murdered us, and they concealed their murder, and remembered not that they had lifted up their hands against us.
verses.text: And they helped those who robbed us and devoured us and those who made us few; and they concealed their oppression, and they did not remove from us the yoke of those that devoured us and dispersed us and murdered us, and they concealed their murder, and remembered not that they had lifted up their hands against us.

verses.raw: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.
verses.text: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.

verses.raw: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.
verses.text: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.

verses.raw: And in your cry, cry for judgement, and it shall appear to you; for all your tribulation shall be visited on the rulers, and on all who helped those who plundered you.
verses.text: And in your cry, cry for judgement, and it shall appear to you; for all your tribulation shall be visited on the rulers, and on all who helped those who plundered you.

verses.raw: Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.
verses.text: Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.

verses.raw: What shall ye be obliged to do? Ye shall not have to hide on the day of the great judgement and ye shall not be found as sinners, and the eternal judgement shall be far from you for all the generations of the world.
verses.text: What shall ye be obliged to do? Ye shall not have to hide on the day of the great judgement and ye shall not be found as sinners, and the eternal judgement shall be far from you for all the generations of the world.

verses.raw: And now fear not, ye righteous, when ye see the sinners growing strong and prospering in their ways: be not companions with them, but keep afar from their violence; for ye shall become companions of the hosts of heaven.
verses.text: And now fear not, ye righteous, when ye see the sinners growing strong and prospering in their ways: be not companions with them, but keep afar from their violence; for ye shall become companions of the hosts of heaven.

verses.raw: And, although ye sinners say: “All our sins shall not be searched out and be written down,” nevertheless they shall write down all your sins every day.
verses.text: And, although ye sinners say: “All our sins shall not be searched out and be written down,” nevertheless they shall write down all your sins every day.

verses.raw: And now I show unto you that light and darkness, day and night, see all your sins.
verses.text: And now I show unto you that light and darkness, day and night, see all your sins.

verses.raw: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.
verses.text: Be not godless in your hearts, and lie not and alter not the words of uprightness, nor charge with lying the words of the Holy Great One, nor take account of your idols; for all your lying and all your godlessness issue not in righteousness but in great sin.

verses.raw: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.
verses.text: And now I know this mystery, that sinners will alter and pervert the words of righteousness in many ways, and will speak wicked words, and lie, and practise great deceits, and write books concerning their words.

verses.raw: But when they write down truthfully all my words in their languages, and do not change or minish ought from my words but write them all down truthfully—all that I first testified concerning them.
verses.text: But when they write down truthfully all my words in their languages, and do not change or minish ought from my words but write them all down truthfully—all that I first testified concerning them.

verses.raw: Then, I know another mystery, that books will be given to the righteous and the wise to become a cause of joy and uprightness and much wisdom.
verses.text: Then, I know another mystery, that books will be given to the righteous and the wise to become a cause of joy and uprightness and much wisdom.

verses.raw: And to them shall the books be given, and they shall believe in them and rejoice over them, and then shall all the righteous who have learnt therefrom all the paths of uprightness be recompensed.’
verses.text: And to them shall the books be given, and they shall believe in them and rejoice over them, and then shall all the righteous who have learnt therefrom all the paths of uprightness be recompensed.’

verses.raw: In those days Yahuah (Lord) bade (them) to summon and testify to the children of earth concerning their wisdom: Show (it) unto them; for ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth.
verses.text: In those days Yahuah bade (them) to summon and testify to the children of earth concerning their wisdom: Show (it) unto them; for ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth.

verses.raw: For I and My Son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and ye shall have peace: rejoice, ye children of uprightness. Amen.
verses.text: For I and My Son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and ye shall have peace: rejoice, ye children of uprightness. Amen.

verses.raw: And after some days my son Methuselah took a wife for his son Lamech, and she became pregnant by him and bore a son.
verses.text: And after some days my son Methuselah took a wife for his son Lamech, and she became pregnant by him and bore a son.

verses.raw: And his body was white as snow and red as the blooming of a rose, and the hair of his head and his long locks were white as wool, and his eyes beautiful. And when he opened his eyes, he lighted up the whole house like the sun, and the whole house was very bright.
verses.text: And his body was white as snow and red as the blooming of a rose, and the hair of his head and his long locks were white as wool, and his eyes beautiful. And when he opened his eyes, he lighted up the whole house like the sun, and the whole house was very bright.

verses.raw: And thereupon he arose in the hands of the midwife, opened his mouth, and conversed with Yahuah (Lord) of righteousness.
verses.text: And thereupon he arose in the hands of the midwife, opened his mouth, and conversed with Yahuah of righteousness.

verses.raw: And his father Lamech was afraid of him and fled, and came to his father Methuselah.
verses.text: And his father Lamech was afraid of him and fled, and came to his father Methuselah.

verses.raw: And he said unto him: ‘I have begotten a strange son, diverse from and unlike man, and resembling the sons of the Elohim (God) of heaven; and his nature is different and he is not like us, and his eyes are as the rays of the sun, and his countenance is glorious.
verses.text: And he said unto him: ‘I have begotten a strange son, diverse from and unlike man, and resembling the sons of the Elohim of heaven; and his nature is different and he is not like us, and his eyes are as the rays of the sun, and his countenance is glorious.

verses.raw: And it seems to me that he is not sprung from me but from the angels, and I fear that in his days a wonder may be wrought on the earth.
verses.text: And it seems to me that he is not sprung from me but from the angels, and I fear that in his days a wonder may be wrought on the earth.

verses.raw: And now, my father, I am here to petition thee and implore thee that thou mayst go to Enoch, our father, and learn from him the truth, for his dwelling-place is amongst the angels.’
verses.text: And now, my father, I am here to petition thee and implore thee that thou mayst go to Enoch, our father, and learn from him the truth, for his dwelling-place is amongst the angels.’

verses.raw: And when Methuselah heard the words of his son, he came to me to the ends of the earth; for he had heard that I was there, and he cried aloud, and I heard his voice and I came to him. And I said unto him: ‘Behold, here am I, my son, wherefore hast thou come to me?’
verses.text: And when Methuselah heard the words of his son, he came to me to the ends of the earth; for he had heard that I was there, and he cried aloud, and I heard his voice and I came to him. And I said unto him: ‘Behold, here am I, my son, wherefore hast thou come to me?’

verses.raw: And he answered and said: ‘Because of a great cause of anxiety have I come to thee, and because of a disturbing vision have I approached.
verses.text: And he answered and said: ‘Because of a great cause of anxiety have I come to thee, and because of a disturbing vision have I approached.

verses.raw: And now, my father, hear me: unto Lamech my son there hath been born a son, the like of whom there is none, and his nature is not like man’s nature, and the colour of his body is whiter than snow and redder than the bloom of a rose, and the hair of his head is whiter than white wool, and his eyes are like the rays of the sun, and he opened his eyes and thereupon lighted up the whole house.
verses.text: And now, my father, hear me: unto Lamech my son there hath been born a son, the like of whom there is none, and his nature is not like man’s nature, and the colour of his body is whiter than snow and redder than the bloom of a rose, and the hair of his head is whiter than white wool, and his eyes are like the rays of the sun, and he opened his eyes and thereupon lighted up the whole house.

verses.raw: And he arose in the hands of the midwife, and opened his mouth and blessed Yahuah (Lord) of heaven.
verses.text: And he arose in the hands of the midwife, and opened his mouth and blessed Yahuah of heaven.

verses.raw: And his father Lamech became afraid and fled to me, and did not believe that he was sprung from him, but that he was in the likeness of the angels of heaven; and behold I have come to thee that thou mayst make known to me the truth.’
verses.text: And his father Lamech became afraid and fled to me, and did not believe that he was sprung from him, but that he was in the likeness of the angels of heaven; and behold I have come to thee that thou mayst make known to me the truth.’

verses.raw: And I, Enoch, answered and said unto him: ‘Yahuah (Lord) will do a new thing on the earth, and this I have already seen in a vision, and make known to thee that in the generation of my father Jared some of the angels of heaven transgressed the word of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And I, Enoch, answered and said unto him: ‘Yahuah will do a new thing on the earth, and this I have already seen in a vision, and make known to thee that in the generation of my father Jared some of the angels of heaven transgressed the word of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And behold they commit sin and transgress the law, and have united themselves with women and commit sin with them, and have married some of them, and have begot children by them.
verses.text: And behold they commit sin and transgress the law, and have united themselves with women and commit sin with them, and have married some of them, and have begot children by them.

verses.raw: Yea, there shall come a great destruction over the whole earth, and there shall be a deluge and a great destruction for one year.
verses.text: Yea, there shall come a great destruction over the whole earth, and there shall be a deluge and a great destruction for one year.

verses.raw: And this son who has been born unto you shall be left on the earth, and his three children shall be saved with him: when all mankind that are on the earth shall die [he and his sons shall be saved].
verses.text: And this son who has been born unto you shall be left on the earth, and his three children shall be saved with him: when all mankind that are on the earth shall die [he and his sons shall be saved].

verses.raw: And they shall produce on the earth giants not according to the spirit, but according to the flesh, and there shall be a great punishment on the earth, and the earth shall be cleansed from all impurity.
verses.text: And they shall produce on the earth giants not according to the spirit, but according to the flesh, and there shall be a great punishment on the earth, and the earth shall be cleansed from all impurity.

verses.raw: And now make known to thy son Lamech that he who has been born is in truth his son, and call his name Noah; for he shall be left to you, and he and his sons shall be saved from the destruction, which shall come upon the earth on account of all the sin and all the unrighteousness, which shall be consummated on the earth in his days.
verses.text: And now make known to thy son Lamech that he who has been born is in truth his son, and call his name Noah; for he shall be left to you, and he and his sons shall be saved from the destruction, which shall come upon the earth on account of all the sin and all the unrighteousness, which shall be consummated on the earth in his days.

verses.raw: And after that there shall be still more unrighteousness than that which was first consummated on the earth; for I know the mysteries of the holy ones; for He, Yahuah (Lord), has showed me and informed me, and I have read (them) in the heavenly tablets.
verses.text: And after that there shall be still more unrighteousness than that which was first consummated on the earth; for I know the mysteries of the holy ones; for He, Yahuah, has showed me and informed me, and I have read (them) in the heavenly tablets.

verses.raw: And I saw written on them that generation upon generation shall transgress, till a generation of righteousness arises, and transgression is destroyed and sin passes away from the earth, and all manner of good comes upon it.
verses.text: And I saw written on them that generation upon generation shall transgress, till a generation of righteousness arises, and transgression is destroyed and sin passes away from the earth, and all manner of good comes upon it.

verses.raw: And now, my son, go and make known to thy son Lamech that this son, which has been born, is in truth his son, and that (this) is no lie.’
verses.text: And now, my son, go and make known to thy son Lamech that this son, which has been born, is in truth his son, and that (this) is no lie.’

verses.raw: And when Methuselah had heard the words of his father Enoch—for he had shown to him everything in secret—he returned and showed (them) to him and called the name of that son Noah; for he will comfort the earth after all the destruction.
verses.text: And when Methuselah had heard the words of his father Enoch—for he had shown to him everything in secret—he returned and showed (them) to him and called the name of that son Noah; for he will comfort the earth after all the destruction.

verses.raw: Another book which Enoch wrote for his son Methuselah and for those who will come after him, and keep the law in the last days.
verses.text: Another book which Enoch wrote for his son Methuselah and for those who will come after him, and keep the law in the last days.

verses.raw: Ye who have done good shall wait for those days till an end is made of those who work evil, and an end of the might of the transgressors.
verses.text: Ye who have done good shall wait for those days till an end is made of those who work evil, and an end of the might of the transgressors.

verses.raw: And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and in the fire shall they burn; for there is no earth there.
verses.text: And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and in the fire shall they burn; for there is no earth there.

verses.raw: And I saw there something like an invisible cloud; for by reason of its depth I could not look over, and I saw a flame of fire blazing brightly, and things like shining mountains circling and sweeping to and fro.
verses.text: And I saw there something like an invisible cloud; for by reason of its depth I could not look over, and I saw a flame of fire blazing brightly, and things like shining mountains circling and sweeping to and fro.

verses.raw: And I asked one of the holy angels who was with me and said unto him: ‘What is this shining thing? for it is not a heaven but only the flame of a blazing fire, and the voice of weeping and crying and lamentation and strong pain.’
verses.text: And I asked one of the holy angels who was with me and said unto him: ‘What is this shining thing? for it is not a heaven but only the flame of a blazing fire, and the voice of weeping and crying and lamentation and strong pain.’

verses.raw: And he said unto me: ‘This place which thou seest—here are cast the spirits of sinners and blasphemers, and of those who work wickedness, and of those who pervert everything that Yahuah (Lord) hath spoken through the mouth of the prophets—(even) the things that shall be.
verses.text: And he said unto me: ‘This place which thou seest—here are cast the spirits of sinners and blasphemers, and of those who work wickedness, and of those who pervert everything that Yahuah hath spoken through the mouth of the prophets—(even) the things that shall be.

verses.raw: For some of them are written and inscribed above in the heaven, in order that the angels may read them and know that which shall befall the sinners, and the spirits of the humble, and of those who have afflicted their bodies, and been recompensed by Elohim (God); and of those who have been put to shame by wicked men:
verses.text: For some of them are written and inscribed above in the heaven, in order that the angels may read them and know that which shall befall the sinners, and the spirits of the humble, and of those who have afflicted their bodies, and been recompensed by Elohim; and of those who have been put to shame by wicked men:

verses.raw: Who love Elohim (God) and loved neither gold nor silver nor any of the good things which are in the world, but gave over their bodies to torture.
verses.text: Who love Elohim and loved neither gold nor silver nor any of the good things which are in the world, but gave over their bodies to torture.

verses.raw: Who, since they came into being, longed not after earthly food, but regarded everything as a passing breath, and lived accordingly, and Yahuah (Lord) tried them much, and their spirits were found pure so that they should bless His name.
verses.text: Who, since they came into being, longed not after earthly food, but regarded everything as a passing breath, and lived accordingly, and Yahuah tried them much, and their spirits were found pure so that they should bless His name.

verses.raw: And all the blessings destined for them I have recounted in the books. And He hath assigned them their recompense, because they have been found to be such as loved heaven more than their life in the world, and though they were trodden under foot of wicked men, and experienced abuse and reviling from them and were put to shame, yet they blessed Me.
verses.text: And all the blessings destined for them I have recounted in the books. And He hath assigned them their recompense, because they have been found to be such as loved heaven more than their life in the world, and though they were trodden under foot of wicked men, and experienced abuse and reviling from them and were put to shame, yet they blessed Me.

verses.raw: And now I will summon the spirits of the good who belong to the generation of light, and I will transform those who were born in darkness, who in the flesh were not recompensed with such honour as their faithfulness deserved.
verses.text: And now I will summon the spirits of the good who belong to the generation of light, and I will transform those who were born in darkness, who in the flesh were not recompensed with such honour as their faithfulness deserved.

verses.raw: And I will bring forth in shining light those who have loved My holy name, and I will seat each on the throne of his honour.
verses.text: And I will bring forth in shining light those who have loved My holy name, and I will seat each on the throne of his honour.

verses.raw: And they shall be resplendent for times without number; for righteousness is the judgement of Elohim (God); for to the faithful He will give faithfulness in the habitation of upright paths.
verses.text: And they shall be resplendent for times without number; for righteousness is the judgement of Elohim; for to the faithful He will give faithfulness in the habitation of upright paths.

verses.raw: And they shall see those who were born in darkness led into darkness, while the righteous shall be resplendent.
verses.text: And they shall see those who were born in darkness led into darkness, while the righteous shall be resplendent.

verses.raw: And the sinners shall cry aloud and see them resplendent, and they indeed will go where days and seasons are prescribed for them.’
verses.text: And the sinners shall cry aloud and see them resplendent, and they indeed will go where days and seasons are prescribed for them.’

verses.raw: This is the history of the division of the days of the law and of the testimony, of the events of the years, of their (year) weeks, of their jubilees throughout all the years of the world, as Yahuah (God) spake to Moses on Mount Sinai when he went up to receive the tables of the law and of the commandment, according to the voice of Elohim (God) as He said to him, “Go up to the top of the Mount.” And it came to pass in the first year of the exodus of the children of Yashar’el (Israel) out of Egypt, in the third month, on the sixteenth day of the month, that Elohim (God) spake to Moses, saying: “Come up to Me on the Mount, and I will give you two tables of stone of the law and of the commandment, which I have written, that you may teach them.”
verses.text: This is the history of the division of the days of the law and of the testimony, of the events of the years, of their (year) weeks, of their jubilees throughout all the years of the world, as Yahuah spake to Moses on Mount Sinai when he went up to receive the tables of the law and of the commandment, according to the voice of Elohim as He said to him, “Go up to the top of the Mount.” And it came to pass in the first year of the exodus of the children of Yashar’el out of Egypt, in the third month, on the sixteenth day of the month, that Elohim spake to Moses, saying: “Come up to Me on the Mount, and I will give you two tables of stone of the law and of the commandment, which I have written, that you may teach them.”

verses.raw: And Moses went up into the mount of Elohim (God), and the glory of Yahuah (God) abode on Mount Sinai, and a cloud overshadowed it six days.
verses.text: And Moses went up into the mount of Elohim, and the glory of Yahuah abode on Mount Sinai, and a cloud overshadowed it six days.

verses.raw: And He called to Moses on the seventh day out of the midst of the cloud, and the appearance of the glory of Yahuah (God) was like a flaming fire on the top of the Mount.
verses.text: And He called to Moses on the seventh day out of the midst of the cloud, and the appearance of the glory of Yahuah was like a flaming fire on the top of the Mount.

verses.raw: And Moses was on the Mount forty days and forty nights, and Elohim (God) taught him the earlier and the later history of the division of all the days of the law and of the testimony.
verses.text: And Moses was on the Mount forty days and forty nights, and Elohim taught him the earlier and the later history of the division of all the days of the law and of the testimony.

verses.raw: And He said: "Incline your heart to every word which I shall speak to you on this Mount, and write them in a book in order that their generations may see how I have not forsaken them for all the evil which they have wrought in transgressing the covenant which I establish between Me and you for their generations this day on Mount Sinai. And thus it will come to pass when all these things come upon them, that they will recognize that I am more righteous than they in all their judgments and in all their actions, and they will recognize that I have been truly with them.
verses.text: And He said: "Incline your heart to every word which I shall speak to you on this Mount, and write them in a book in order that their generations may see how I have not forsaken them for all the evil which they have wrought in transgressing the covenant which I establish between Me and you for their generations this day on Mount Sinai. And thus it will come to pass when all these things come upon them, that they will recognize that I am more righteous than they in all their judgments and in all their actions, and they will recognize that I have been truly with them.

verses.raw: And do you write for yourself all these words which I declare to you this day, for I know their rebellion and their stiff neck, before I bring them into the land of which I sware to their fathers, to Abraham and to Isaac and to Jacob, saying: “To your seed will I give a land flowing with milk and honey.
verses.text: And do you write for yourself all these words which I declare to you this day, for I know their rebellion and their stiff neck, before I bring them into the land of which I sware to their fathers, to Abraham and to Isaac and to Jacob, saying: “To your seed will I give a land flowing with milk and honey.

verses.raw: And they will eat and be satisfied, and they will turn to strange gods, to (gods) which cannot deliver them from aught of their tribulation:”and this witness shall be heard for a witness against them.
verses.text: And they will eat and be satisfied, and they will turn to strange gods, to (gods) which cannot deliver them from aught of their tribulation:”and this witness shall be heard for a witness against them.

verses.raw: For they will forget all My commandments, (even) all that I command them, and they will walk after the nations, and after their uncleanness, and after their shame, and will serve their gods, and these will prove to them an offence and a tribulation and an affliction and a snare.
verses.text: For they will forget all My commandments, (even) all that I command them, and they will walk after the nations, and after their uncleanness, and after their shame, and will serve their gods, and these will prove to them an offence and a tribulation and an affliction and a snare.

verses.raw: And many will perish and they will be taken captive, and will fall into the hands of the enemy, because they have forsaken My ordinances and My commandments, and the festivals of My covenant, and My sabbaths, and My holy place which I have hallowed for Myself in their midst, and My tabernacle, and My sanctuary, which I have hallowed for Myself in the midst of the land, that I should set My name upon it, and that it should dwell (there). And they will make to themselves high places and groves and graven images, and they will worship, each his own (graven image), so as to go astray, and they will sacrifice their children to demons, and to all the works of the error of their hearts.
verses.text: And many will perish and they will be taken captive, and will fall into the hands of the enemy, because they have forsaken My ordinances and My commandments, and the festivals of My covenant, and My sabbaths, and My holy place which I have hallowed for Myself in their midst, and My tabernacle, and My sanctuary, which I have hallowed for Myself in the midst of the land, that I should set My name upon it, and that it should dwell (there). And they will make to themselves high places and groves and graven images, and they will worship, each his own (graven image), so as to go astray, and they will sacrifice their children to demons, and to all the works of the error of their hearts.

verses.raw: And I will send witnesses to them, that I may witness against them, but they will not hear, and will slay the witnesses also, and they will persecute those who seek the law, and they will abrogate and change everything so as to work evil before My eyes.
verses.text: And I will send witnesses to them, that I may witness against them, but they will not hear, and will slay the witnesses also, and they will persecute those who seek the law, and they will abrogate and change everything so as to work evil before My eyes.

verses.raw: And I shall hide My face from them, and I shall deliver them into the hand of the nations for captivity, and for a prey, and for devouring, and I shall remove them from the midst of the land, and I shall scatter them amongst the nations.
verses.text: And I shall hide My face from them, and I shall deliver them into the hand of the nations for captivity, and for a prey, and for devouring, and I shall remove them from the midst of the land, and I shall scatter them amongst the nations.

verses.raw: And they will forget all My law and all My commandments and all My judgments, and will go astray as to new moons, and sabbaths, and festivals, and jubilees, and ordinances.
verses.text: And they will forget all My law and all My commandments and all My judgments, and will go astray as to new moons, and sabbaths, and festivals, and jubilees, and ordinances.

verses.raw: And after this they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations, and they will seek Me, so that I shall be found of them, when they seek Me with all their heart and with all their soul. And I shall disclose to them abounding peace with righteousness, and I shall remove them the plant of uprightness, with all My heart and with all My soul, and they will be for a blessing and not for a curse, and they will be the head and not the tail.
verses.text: And after this they will turn to Me from amongst the nations with all their heart and with all their soul and with all their strength, and I shall gather them from amongst all the nations, and they will seek Me, so that I shall be found of them, when they seek Me with all their heart and with all their soul. And I shall disclose to them abounding peace with righteousness, and I shall remove them the plant of uprightness, with all My heart and with all My soul, and they will be for a blessing and not for a curse, and they will be the head and not the tail.

verses.raw: And I shall build My sanctuary in their midst, and I shall dwell with them, and I shall be their Elohim (God) and they will be My people in truth and righteousness.
verses.text: And I shall build My sanctuary in their midst, and I shall dwell with them, and I shall be their Elohim and they will be My people in truth and righteousness.

verses.raw: And I shall not forsake them nor fail them; for I am Yahuah their Elohim (the LORD their God)."
verses.text: And I shall not forsake them nor fail them; for I am Yahuah their Elohim (the LORD their God)."

verses.raw: And Moses fell on his face and prayed and said, "O Yahuah (God) my Elohim (God), do not forsake Your people and Your inheritance, so that they should wander in the error of their hearts, and do not deliver them into the hands of their enemies, the nations, lest they should rule over them and cause them to sin against You.
verses.text: And Moses fell on his face and prayed and said, "O Yahuah my Elohim, do not forsake Your people and Your inheritance, so that they should wander in the error of their hearts, and do not deliver them into the hands of their enemies, the nations, lest they should rule over them and cause them to sin against You.

verses.raw: Let Your mercy, O Yahuah (God), be lifted up upon Your people, and create in them an upright spirit, and let not the spirit of Beliar rule over them to accuse them before You, and to ensnare them from all the paths of righteousness, so that they may perish from before Your face. But they are Your people and Your inheritance, which You have delivered with Your great power from the hands of the Egyptians: create in them a clean heart and a holy spirit, and let them not be ensnared in their sins from henceforth until eternity."
verses.text: Let Your mercy, O Yahuah, be lifted up upon Your people, and create in them an upright spirit, and let not the spirit of Beliar rule over them to accuse them before You, and to ensnare them from all the paths of righteousness, so that they may perish from before Your face. But they are Your people and Your inheritance, which You have delivered with Your great power from the hands of the Egyptians: create in them a clean heart and a holy spirit, and let them not be ensnared in their sins from henceforth until eternity."

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) said to Moses: "I know their contrariness and their thoughts and their stiffneckedness, and they will not be obedient till they confess their own sin and the sin of their fathers.
verses.text: And Yahuah said to Moses: "I know their contrariness and their thoughts and their stiffneckedness, and they will not be obedient till they confess their own sin and the sin of their fathers.

verses.raw: And after this they will turn to Me in all uprightness and with all (their) heart and with all (their) soul, and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.
verses.text: And after this they will turn to Me in all uprightness and with all (their) heart and with all (their) soul, and I shall circumcise the foreskin of their heart and the foreskin of the heart of their seed, and I shall create in them a holy spirit, and I shall cleanse them so that they shall not turn away from Me from that day to eternity.

verses.raw: And their souls will cleave to Me and to all My commandments, and they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.
verses.text: And their souls will cleave to Me and to all My commandments, and they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.

verses.raw: And they will all be called children of the living Elohim (God), and every angel and every spirit will know, yea, they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them. And do you write down for yourself all these words which I declare to you on this mountain, the first and the last, which shall come to pass in all the divisions of the days in the law and in the testimony and in the weeks and the jubilees to eternity, until I descend and dwell with them throughout eternity." And He said to the angel of the presence: “Write for Moses from the beginning of creation till My sanctuary has been built among them for all eternity.
verses.text: And they will all be called children of the living Elohim, and every angel and every spirit will know, yea, they will know that these are My children, and that I am their Father in uprightness and righteousness, and that I love them. And do you write down for yourself all these words which I declare to you on this mountain, the first and the last, which shall come to pass in all the divisions of the days in the law and in the testimony and in the weeks and the jubilees to eternity, until I descend and dwell with them throughout eternity." And He said to the angel of the presence: “Write for Moses from the beginning of creation till My sanctuary has been built among them for all eternity.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) will appear to the eyes of all, and all will know that I am the Elohim (God) of Yashar’el (Israel) and the Father of all the children of Jacob, and King on Mount Zion for all eternity. And Zion and Jerusalem will be holy.”
verses.text: And Yahuah will appear to the eyes of all, and all will know that I am the Elohim of Yashar’el and the Father of all the children of Jacob, and King on Mount Zion for all eternity. And Zion and Jerusalem will be holy.”

verses.raw: And the angel of the presence who went before the camp of Yashar’el (Israel) took the tables of the divisions of the years –from the time of the creation–of the law and of the testimony of the weeks, of the jubilees, according to the individual years, according to all the number of the jubilees according to the individual years, from the day of the new creation when the heavens and the earth shall be renewed and all their creation according to the powers of the heaven, and according to all the creation of the earth, until the sanctuary of Yahuah (God) shall be made in Jerusalem on Mount Zion, and all the luminaries be renewed for healing and for peace and for blessing for all the elect of Yashar’el (Israel), and that thus it may be from that day and to all the days of the earth.
verses.text: And the angel of the presence who went before the camp of Yashar’el took the tables of the divisions of the years –from the time of the creation–of the law and of the testimony of the weeks, of the jubilees, according to the individual years, according to all the number of the jubilees according to the individual years, from the day of the new creation when the heavens and the earth shall be renewed and all their creation according to the powers of the heaven, and according to all the creation of the earth, until the sanctuary of Yahuah shall be made in Jerusalem on Mount Zion, and all the luminaries be renewed for healing and for peace and for blessing for all the elect of Yashar’el, and that thus it may be from that day and to all the days of the earth.

verses.raw: And the angel of the presence spake to Moses according to the word of Yahuah (God), saying: Write the complete history of the creation, how in six days Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works.
verses.text: And the angel of the presence spake to Moses according to the word of Yahuah, saying: Write the complete history of the creation, how in six days Yahuah Elohim finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works.
