And it came to pass in the forty-first jubilee, in the third year of the first week, that he returned to this place and offered thereon a burnt sacrifice, and called on the name of Yahuah, and said: “You, the most high Elohim, are my Elohim for ever and ever.”

verses.raw: And in the fourth year of this week Lot parted from him, and Lot dwelt in Sodom, and the men of Sodom were sinners exceedingly.
verses.text: And in the fourth year of this week Lot parted from him, and Lot dwelt in Sodom, and the men of Sodom were sinners exceedingly.

verses.raw: And it grieved him in his heart that his brother’s son had parted from him; for he had no children.
verses.text: And it grieved him in his heart that his brother’s son had parted from him; for he had no children.

verses.raw: In that year when Lot was taken captive, Yahuah (God) said to Abram, after that Lot had parted from him, in the fourth year of this week: "Lift up your eyes from the place where you are dwelling, northward and southward, and westward and eastward.
verses.text: In that year when Lot was taken captive, Yahuah said to Abram, after that Lot had parted from him, in the fourth year of this week: "Lift up your eyes from the place where you are dwelling, northward and southward, and westward and eastward.

verses.raw: For all the land which you see I shall give to you and to your seed for ever, and I shall make your seed as the sand of the sea: though a man may number the dust of the earth, yet your seed shall not be numbered. Arise, walk (through the land) in the length of it and the breadth of it, and see it all; for to your seed shall I give it." And Abram went to Hebron, and dwelt there. And in this year came Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Sêllâsar and Têrgâl, king of nations, and slew the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Sodom fled, and many fell through wounds in the vale of Siddim, by the Salt Sea.
verses.text: For all the land which you see I shall give to you and to your seed for ever, and I shall make your seed as the sand of the sea: though a man may number the dust of the earth, yet your seed shall not be numbered. Arise, walk (through the land) in the length of it and the breadth of it, and see it all; for to your seed shall I give it." And Abram went to Hebron, and dwelt there. And in this year came Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Sêllâsar and Têrgâl, king of nations, and slew the king of Gomorrah, and the king of Sodom fled, and many fell through wounds in the vale of Siddim, by the Salt Sea.

verses.raw: And they took captive Sodom and Adam and Zeboim, and they took captive Lot also, the son of Abram’s brother, and all his possessions, and they went to Dan.
verses.text: And they took captive Sodom and Adam and Zeboim, and they took captive Lot also, the son of Abram’s brother, and all his possessions, and they went to Dan.

verses.raw: And one who had escaped came and told Abram that his brother’s son had been taken captive and (Abram) armed his household servants. 25…………. for Abram, and for his seed, a tenth of the first-fruits to Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) ordained it as an ordinance for ever that they should give it to the priests who served before Him, that they should possess it for ever.
verses.text: And one who had escaped came and told Abram that his brother’s son had been taken captive and (Abram) armed his household servants. 25…………. for Abram, and for his seed, a tenth of the first-fruits to Yahuah, and Yahuah ordained it as an ordinance for ever that they should give it to the priests who served before Him, that they should possess it for ever.

verses.raw: And to this law there is no limit of days; for He has ordained it for the generations for ever that they should give to Yahuah (God) the tenth of everything, of the seed and of the wine and of the oil and of the cattle and of the sheep.
verses.text: And to this law there is no limit of days; for He has ordained it for the generations for ever that they should give to Yahuah the tenth of everything, of the seed and of the wine and of the oil and of the cattle and of the sheep.

verses.raw: And He gave (it) to His priests to eat and to drink with joy before Him. And the king of Sodom came to him and bowed himself before him, and said: “Our Yahuah (God) Abram, give to us the souls which you have rescued, but let the booty be your.”
verses.text: And He gave (it) to His priests to eat and to drink with joy before Him. And the king of Sodom came to him and bowed himself before him, and said: “Our Yahuah Abram, give to us the souls which you have rescued, but let the booty be your.”

verses.raw: And Abram said to him: “I lift up my hands to the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God), that from a thread to a shoe-latchet I shall not take aught that is your, lest you should say I have made Abram rich; save only what the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me–Aner, Eschol, and Mamre. These will take their portion.”
verses.text: And Abram said to him: “I lift up my hands to the El Elyon Elohim, that from a thread to a shoe-latchet I shall not take aught that is your, lest you should say I have made Abram rich; save only what the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me–Aner, Eschol, and Mamre. These will take their portion.”

verses.raw: After these things, in the fourth year of this week, on the new moon of the third month, the word of Yahuah (God) came to Abram in a dream, saying: “Fear not, Abram; I am your defender, and your reward will be exceeding great.”
verses.text: After these things, in the fourth year of this week, on the new moon of the third month, the word of Yahuah came to Abram in a dream, saying: “Fear not, Abram; I am your defender, and your reward will be exceeding great.”

verses.raw: And he said: “Yahuah (God), Yahuah (God), what will you give me, seeing I go hence childless, and the son of Mâsêq, the son of my handmaid, is the Dammasek Eliezer: he will be my heir, and to me you have given no seed.”
verses.text: And he said: “Yahuah, Yahuah, what will you give me, seeing I go hence childless, and the son of Mâsêq, the son of my handmaid, is the Dammasek Eliezer: he will be my heir, and to me you have given no seed.”

verses.raw: And He said to him: “This (man) will not be your heir, but one that will come out of your own bowels; he will be your heir.”
verses.text: And He said to him: “This (man) will not be your heir, but one that will come out of your own bowels; he will be your heir.”

verses.raw: And He brought him forth abroad, and said to him: “Look toward heaven and number the stars, if you are able to number them.”
verses.text: And He brought him forth abroad, and said to him: “Look toward heaven and number the stars, if you are able to number them.”

verses.raw: And he looked toward heaven, and beheld the stars. And He said to him: “So shall your seed be.”
verses.text: And he looked toward heaven, and beheld the stars. And He said to him: “So shall your seed be.”

verses.raw: And he believed in Yahuah (God), and it was counted to him for righteousness. And He said to him: “I am Yahuah (God) that brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you the land of the Canaanites to possess it for ever; and I shall be Elohim (God) to you and to your seed after you.”
verses.text: And he believed in Yahuah, and it was counted to him for righteousness. And He said to him: “I am Yahuah that brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you the land of the Canaanites to possess it for ever; and I shall be Elohim to you and to your seed after you.”

verses.raw: And he said: “Yahuah (God), Yahuah (God), whereby shall I know that I shall inherit (it)?”
verses.text: And he said: “Yahuah, Yahuah, whereby shall I know that I shall inherit (it)?”

verses.raw: And he said to him: “Take Me an heifer of three years, and a goat of three years, and a sheep of three years, and a turtle-dove, and a pigeon.”
verses.text: And he said to him: “Take Me an heifer of three years, and a goat of three years, and a sheep of three years, and a turtle-dove, and a pigeon.”

verses.raw: And he took all these in the middle of the month; and he dwelt at the oak of Mamre, which is near Hebron.
verses.text: And he took all these in the middle of the month; and he dwelt at the oak of Mamre, which is near Hebron.

verses.raw: And he built there an altar, and sacrificed all these; and he poured their blood upon the altar, and divided them in the midst, and laid them over against each other; but the birds divided he not. And birds came down upon the pieces, and Abram drove them away, and did not suffer the birds to touch them.
verses.text: And he built there an altar, and sacrificed all these; and he poured their blood upon the altar, and divided them in the midst, and laid them over against each other; but the birds divided he not. And birds came down upon the pieces, and Abram drove them away, and did not suffer the birds to touch them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the sun had set, that an ecstasy fell upon Abram, and lo! an horror of great darkness fell upon him, and it was said to Abram: “Know of a surety that your seed shall be a stranger in a land (that is) not theirs, and they will bring them into bondage, and afflict them four hundred years.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the sun had set, that an ecstasy fell upon Abram, and lo! an horror of great darkness fell upon him, and it was said to Abram: “Know of a surety that your seed shall be a stranger in a land (that is) not theirs, and they will bring them into bondage, and afflict them four hundred years.

verses.raw: And the nation also to whom they will be in bondage shall I judge, and after that they will come forth thence with much substance.
verses.text: And the nation also to whom they will be in bondage shall I judge, and after that they will come forth thence with much substance.

verses.raw: And you will go to your fathers in peace, and be buried in a good old age.
verses.text: And you will go to your fathers in peace, and be buried in a good old age.

verses.raw: But in the fourth generation they will return hither; for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.” And he awoke from his sleep, and he arose, and the sun had set; and there was a flame, and behold! a furnace was smoking, and a flame of fire passed between the pieces.
verses.text: But in the fourth generation they will return hither; for the iniquity of the Amorites is not yet full.” And he awoke from his sleep, and he arose, and the sun had set; and there was a flame, and behold! a furnace was smoking, and a flame of fire passed between the pieces.

verses.raw: And on that day Yahuah (God) made a covenant with Abram, saying: “To your seed will I give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates, the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites, the Perizzites, and the Rephaim, the Phakorites, and the Hivites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”
verses.text: And on that day Yahuah made a covenant with Abram, saying: “To your seed will I give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates, the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites, the Perizzites, and the Rephaim, the Phakorites, and the Hivites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

verses.raw: And the day passed, and Abram offered the pieces, and the birds, and their fruit-offerings, and their drink-offerings, and the fire devoured them.
verses.text: And the day passed, and Abram offered the pieces, and the birds, and their fruit-offerings, and their drink-offerings, and the fire devoured them.

verses.raw: And on that day we made a covenant with Abram, according as we had covenanted with Noah in this month; and Abram renewed the festival and ordinance for himself for ever. And Abram rejoiced, and made all these things known to Sarai his wife; and he believed that he would have seed, but she did not bear.
verses.text: And on that day we made a covenant with Abram, according as we had covenanted with Noah in this month; and Abram renewed the festival and ordinance for himself for ever. And Abram rejoiced, and made all these things known to Sarai his wife; and he believed that he would have seed, but she did not bear.

verses.raw: And Sarai advised her husband Abram, and said to him: “Go in to Hagar, my Egyptian maid: it may be that I shall build up seed to you by her.”
verses.text: And Sarai advised her husband Abram, and said to him: “Go in to Hagar, my Egyptian maid: it may be that I shall build up seed to you by her.”

verses.raw: And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai his wife, and said to her, “Do (so).” And Sarai took Hagar, her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to Abram, her husband, to be his wife.
verses.text: And Abram hearkened to the voice of Sarai his wife, and said to her, “Do (so).” And Sarai took Hagar, her maid, the Egyptian, and gave her to Abram, her husband, to be his wife.

verses.raw: And he went in to her, and she conceived and bare him a son, and he called his name Ishmael, in the fifth year of this week; and this was the eighty-sixth year in the life of Abram.
verses.text: And he went in to her, and she conceived and bare him a son, and he called his name Ishmael, in the fifth year of this week; and this was the eighty-sixth year in the life of Abram.

verses.raw: And in the fifth year of the fourth week of this jubilee, in the third month, in the middle of the month, Abram celebrated the feast of the first-fruits of the grain harvest.
verses.text: And in the fifth year of the fourth week of this jubilee, in the third month, in the middle of the month, Abram celebrated the feast of the first-fruits of the grain harvest.

verses.raw: And he offered new offerings on the altar, the first-fruits of the produce, to Yahuah (God), an heifer and a goat and a sheep on the altar as a burnt sacrifice to Yahuah (God); their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings he offered upon the altar with frankincense.
verses.text: And he offered new offerings on the altar, the first-fruits of the produce, to Yahuah, an heifer and a goat and a sheep on the altar as a burnt sacrifice to Yahuah; their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings he offered upon the altar with frankincense.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) appeared to Abram, and said to him: “I am El Shaddai (God Almighty); approve yourself before Me and be you perfect.
verses.text: And Yahuah appeared to Abram, and said to him: “I am El Shaddai; approve yourself before Me and be you perfect.

verses.raw: And I will make My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly.”
verses.text: And I will make My covenant between Me and you, and I will multiply you exceedingly.”

verses.raw: And Abram fell on his face, and Elohim (God) talked with him, and said: "Behold My ordinance is with you, And you will be the father of many nations. Neither will your name any more be called Abram, But your name from henceforth, even for ever, shall be Abraham. For the father of many nations have I made you. And I shall make you very great, And I shall make you into nations, And kings will come forth from you. And I shall establish My covenant between Me and you, and your seed after you, throughout their generations, for an eternal covenant, so that I may be a Elohim (God) to you, and to your seed after you.
verses.text: And Abram fell on his face, and Elohim talked with him, and said: "Behold My ordinance is with you, And you will be the father of many nations. Neither will your name any more be called Abram, But your name from henceforth, even for ever, shall be Abraham. For the father of many nations have I made you. And I shall make you very great, And I shall make you into nations, And kings will come forth from you. And I shall establish My covenant between Me and you, and your seed after you, throughout their generations, for an eternal covenant, so that I may be a Elohim to you, and to your seed after you.

verses.raw: (And I shall give to you and to your seed after you) the land where you have been a sojourner, the land of Canaan, that you may possess it for ever, and I shall be their Elohim (God)."
verses.text: (And I shall give to you and to your seed after you) the land where you have been a sojourner, the land of Canaan, that you may possess it for ever, and I shall be their Elohim."

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) said to Abraham: "And as for you, do you keep My Covenant, you and your seed after you, and circumcise you every male among you, and circumcise your foreskins, and it will be a token of an eternal covenant between Me and you.
verses.text: And Yahuah said to Abraham: "And as for you, do you keep My Covenant, you and your seed after you, and circumcise you every male among you, and circumcise your foreskins, and it will be a token of an eternal covenant between Me and you.

verses.raw: And the child on the eighth day you will circumcise, every male throughout your generations, him that is born in the house, or whom you have bought with money from any stranger, whom you have acquired who is not of your seed.
verses.text: And the child on the eighth day you will circumcise, every male throughout your generations, him that is born in the house, or whom you have bought with money from any stranger, whom you have acquired who is not of your seed.

verses.raw: He that is born in your house will surely be circumcised, and those whom you have bought with money will be circumcised, and My covenant will be in your flesh for an eternal ordinance. And the uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin on the eighth day, that soul will be cut off from his people, for he has broken My covenant."
verses.text: He that is born in your house will surely be circumcised, and those whom you have bought with money will be circumcised, and My covenant will be in your flesh for an eternal ordinance. And the uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin on the eighth day, that soul will be cut off from his people, for he has broken My covenant."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said to Abraham: “As for Sarai your wife, her name will no more be called Sarai, but Sarah will be her name.
verses.text: And Elohim said to Abraham: “As for Sarai your wife, her name will no more be called Sarai, but Sarah will be her name.

verses.raw: And I shall bless her, and give you a son by her, and I shall bless him, and he will become a nation, and kings of nations will proceed from him.”
verses.text: And I shall bless her, and give you a son by her, and I shall bless him, and he will become a nation, and kings of nations will proceed from him.”

verses.raw: And Abraham fell on his face, and rejoiced, and said in his heart: “Shall a son be born to him that is a hundred years old, and shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bring forth?”
verses.text: And Abraham fell on his face, and rejoiced, and said in his heart: “Shall a son be born to him that is a hundred years old, and shall Sarah, who is ninety years old, bring forth?”

verses.raw: And Abraham said to Elohim (God): “O that Ishmael might live before you!” And Elohim (God) said: “Yea, and Sarah also will bear you a son, and you will call his name Isaac, and I shall establish My covenant with him, an everlasting covenant, and for his seed after him.
verses.text: And Abraham said to Elohim: “O that Ishmael might live before you!” And Elohim said: “Yea, and Sarah also will bear you a son, and you will call his name Isaac, and I shall establish My covenant with him, an everlasting covenant, and for his seed after him.

verses.raw: And as for Ishmael also have I heard you, and behold I shall bless him, and make him great, and multiply him exceedingly, and he will beget twelve princes, and I shall make him a great nation.
verses.text: And as for Ishmael also have I heard you, and behold I shall bless him, and make him great, and multiply him exceedingly, and he will beget twelve princes, and I shall make him a great nation.

verses.raw: But My covenant shall I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you, in these days, in the next year.”
verses.text: But My covenant shall I establish with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you, in these days, in the next year.”

verses.raw: And He left off speaking with him, and Elohim (God) went up from Abraham.
verses.text: And He left off speaking with him, and Elohim went up from Abraham.

verses.raw: And Abraham did according as Elohim (God) had said to him, and he took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and whom he had bought with his money, every male in his house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin. And on the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and all the men of his house, (and those born in the house), and all those, whom he had bought with money from the children of the stranger, were circumcised with him.
verses.text: And Abraham did according as Elohim had said to him, and he took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and whom he had bought with his money, every male in his house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin. And on the selfsame day was Abraham circumcised, and all the men of his house, (and those born in the house), and all those, whom he had bought with money from the children of the stranger, were circumcised with him.

verses.raw: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.
verses.text: This law is for all the generations for ever, and there is no circumcision of the days, and no omission of one day out of the eight days; for it is an eternal ordinance, ordained and written on the heavenly tables.

verses.raw: And every one that is born, the flesh of whose foreskin is not circumcised on the eighth day, belongs not to the children of the covenant which Yahuah (God) made with Abraham, but to the children of destruction; nor is there, moreover, any sign on him that he is Yahuah (God)’s, but (he is destined) to be destroyed and slain from the earth, and to be rooted out of the earth, for he has broken the covenant of Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God).
verses.text: And every one that is born, the flesh of whose foreskin is not circumcised on the eighth day, belongs not to the children of the covenant which Yahuah made with Abraham, but to the children of destruction; nor is there, moreover, any sign on him that he is Yahuah’s, but (he is destined) to be destroyed and slain from the earth, and to be rooted out of the earth, for he has broken the covenant of Yahuah our Elohim.

verses.raw: For all the angels of the presence and all the angels of sanctification have been so created from the day of their creation, and before the angels of the presence and the angels of sanctification He has sanctified Yashar’el (Israel), that they should be with Him and with His holy angels.
verses.text: For all the angels of the presence and all the angels of sanctification have been so created from the day of their creation, and before the angels of the presence and the angels of sanctification He has sanctified Yashar’el, that they should be with Him and with His holy angels.

verses.raw: And do you command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) and let them observe the sign of this covenant for their generations as an eternal ordinance, and they will not be rooted out of the land. For the command is ordained for a covenant, that they should observe it for ever among all the children of Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And do you command the children of Yashar’el and let them observe the sign of this covenant for their generations as an eternal ordinance, and they will not be rooted out of the land. For the command is ordained for a covenant, that they should observe it for ever among all the children of Yashar’el.

verses.raw: For Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah (God) did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar’el (Israel) to be His people.
verses.text: For Ishmael and his sons and his brothers and Esau, Yahuah did not cause to approach Him, and he chose them not because they are the children of Abraham, because He knew them, but He chose Yashar’el to be His people.

verses.raw: And He sanctified it, and gathered it from amongst all the children of men ; for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.
verses.text: And He sanctified it, and gathered it from amongst all the children of men ; for there are many nations and many peoples, and all are His, and over all has He placed spirits in authority to lead them astray from Him.

verses.raw: But over Yashar’el (Israel) He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler, and He will preserve them and require them at the hand of His angels and His spirits, and at the hand of all His powers in order that He may preserve them and bless them, and that they may be His and He may be theirs from henceforth for ever.
verses.text: But over Yashar’el He did not appoint any angel or spirit, for He alone is their ruler, and He will preserve them and require them at the hand of His angels and His spirits, and at the hand of all His powers in order that He may preserve them and bless them, and that they may be His and He may be theirs from henceforth for ever.

verses.raw: And now I announce to you that the children of Yashar’el (Israel) will not keep true to this ordinance, and they will not circumcise their sons according to all this law; for in the flesh of their circumcision they will omit this circumcision of their sons, and all of them, sons of Beliar, will leave their sons uncircumcised as they were born. And there will be great wrath from Yahuah (God) against the children of Yashar’el (Israel), because they have forsaken His covenant and turned aside from His word, and provoked and blasphemed, inasmuch as they do not observe the ordinance of this law; for they have treated their members like the nations, so that they may be removed and rooted out of the land. And there will no more be pardon or forgiveness to them so that there should be forgiveness and pardon for all the sin of this eternal error.
verses.text: And now I announce to you that the children of Yashar’el will not keep true to this ordinance, and they will not circumcise their sons according to all this law; for in the flesh of their circumcision they will omit this circumcision of their sons, and all of them, sons of Beliar, will leave their sons uncircumcised as they were born. And there will be great wrath from Yahuah against the children of Yashar’el, because they have forsaken His covenant and turned aside from His word, and provoked and blasphemed, inasmuch as they do not observe the ordinance of this law; for they have treated their members like the nations, so that they may be removed and rooted out of the land. And there will no more be pardon or forgiveness to them so that there should be forgiveness and pardon for all the sin of this eternal error.

verses.raw: And on the new moon of the fourth month we appeared to Abraham, at the oak of Mamre, and we talked with him, and we announced to him that a son would be given to him by Sarah his wife.
verses.text: And on the new moon of the fourth month we appeared to Abraham, at the oak of Mamre, and we talked with him, and we announced to him that a son would be given to him by Sarah his wife.

verses.raw: And Sarah laughed, for she heard that we had spoken these words with Abraham, and we admonished her, and she became afraid, and denied that she had laughed on account of the words.
verses.text: And Sarah laughed, for she heard that we had spoken these words with Abraham, and we admonished her, and she became afraid, and denied that she had laughed on account of the words.

verses.raw: And we told her the name of her son, as his name is ordained and written in the heavenly tables (i.e.) Isaac.
verses.text: And we told her the name of her son, as his name is ordained and written in the heavenly tables (i.e.) Isaac.

verses.raw: And (that) when we returned to her at a set time, she would have conceived a son.
verses.text: And (that) when we returned to her at a set time, she would have conceived a son.

verses.raw: And in this month Yahuah (God) executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day, even as lo I have declared to you all their works, that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly, and that they defile themselves and commit fornication in their flesh, and work uncleanness on the earth.
verses.text: And in this month Yahuah executed his judgments on Sodom, and Gomorrah, and Zeboim, and all the region of the Jordan, and He burned them with fire and brimstone, and destroyed them until this day, even as lo I have declared to you all their works, that they are wicked and sinners exceedingly, and that they defile themselves and commit fornication in their flesh, and work uncleanness on the earth.

verses.raw: And, in like manner, Elohim (God) will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom. But Lot we saved; for Elohim (God) remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow.
verses.text: And, in like manner, Elohim will execute judgment on the places where they have done according to the uncleanness of the Sodomites, like to the judgment of Sodom. But Lot we saved; for Elohim remembered Abraham, and sent him out from the midst of the overthrow.

verses.raw: And he and his daughters committed sin upon the earth, such as had not been on the earth since the days of Adam till his time; for the man lay with his daughters.
verses.text: And he and his daughters committed sin upon the earth, such as had not been on the earth since the days of Adam till his time; for the man lay with his daughters.

verses.raw: And, behold, it was commanded and engraven concerning all his seed, on the heavenly tables, to remove them and root them out, and to execute judgment upon them like the judgment of Sodom, and to leave no seed of the man on earth on the day of condemnation. And in this month Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar.
verses.text: And, behold, it was commanded and engraven concerning all his seed, on the heavenly tables, to remove them and root them out, and to execute judgment upon them like the judgment of Sodom, and to leave no seed of the man on earth on the day of condemnation. And in this month Abraham moved from Hebron, and departed and dwelt between Kadesh and Shur in the mountains of Gerar.

verses.raw: And in the middle of the fifth month he moved from thence, and dwelt at the Well of the Oath.
verses.text: And in the middle of the fifth month he moved from thence, and dwelt at the Well of the Oath.

verses.raw: And in the middle of the sixth month Yahuah (God) visited Sarah and did to her as He had spoken, and she conceived. And she bare a son in the third month, and in the middle of the month, at the time of which Yahuah (God) had spoken to Abraham, on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born.
verses.text: And in the middle of the sixth month Yahuah visited Sarah and did to her as He had spoken, and she conceived. And she bare a son in the third month, and in the middle of the month, at the time of which Yahuah had spoken to Abraham, on the festival of the first-fruits of the harvest, Isaac was born.

verses.raw: And Abraham circumcised his son on the eighth day: he was the first that was circumcised according to the covenant which is ordained for ever.
verses.text: And Abraham circumcised his son on the eighth day: he was the first that was circumcised according to the covenant which is ordained for ever.

verses.raw: And in the sixth year of the fourth week we came to Abraham, to the Well of the Oath, and we appeared to him as we had told Sarah that we should return to her, and she would have conceived a son.
verses.text: And in the sixth year of the fourth week we came to Abraham, to the Well of the Oath, and we appeared to him as we had told Sarah that we should return to her, and she would have conceived a son.

verses.raw: And we returned in the seventh month, and found Sarah with child before us and we blessed him, and we announced to him all the things which had been decreed concerning him, that he should not die till he should beget six sons more, and should see (them) before he died; but (that) in Isaac should his name and seed be called:
verses.text: And we returned in the seventh month, and found Sarah with child before us and we blessed him, and we announced to him all the things which had been decreed concerning him, that he should not die till he should beget six sons more, and should see (them) before he died; but (that) in Isaac should his name and seed be called:

verses.raw: And (that) all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations. For he should become the portion of the El Elyon (Most High), and all his seed had fallen into the possession of Elohim (God), that it should be to Yahuah (God) a people for (His) possession above all nations and that it should become a kingdom and priests and a holy nation.
verses.text: And (that) all the seed of his sons should be nations, and be reckoned with the nations; but from the sons of Isaac one should become a holy seed, and should not be reckoned among the nations. For he should become the portion of the El Elyon, and all his seed had fallen into the possession of Elohim, that it should be to Yahuah a people for (His) possession above all nations and that it should become a kingdom and priests and a holy nation.

verses.raw: And we went our way, and we announced to Sarah all that we had told him, and they both rejoiced with exceeding great joy.
verses.text: And we went our way, and we announced to Sarah all that we had told him, and they both rejoiced with exceeding great joy.

verses.raw: And he built there an altar to Yahuah (God) who had delivered him, and who was making him rejoice in the land of his sojourning, and he celebrated a festival of joy in this month seven days, near the altar which he had built at the Well of the Oath.
verses.text: And he built there an altar to Yahuah who had delivered him, and who was making him rejoice in the land of his sojourning, and he celebrated a festival of joy in this month seven days, near the altar which he had built at the Well of the Oath.

verses.raw: And he built booths for himself and for his servants on this festival, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth.
verses.text: And he built booths for himself and for his servants on this festival, and he was the first to celebrate the feast of tabernacles on the earth.

verses.raw: And during these seven days he brought each day to the altar a burnt-offering to Yahuah (God), two oxen, two rams, seven sheep, one he-goat, for a sin-offering, that he might atone thereby for himself and for his seed. And, as a thank-offering, seven rams, seven kids, seven sheep, and seven he-goats, and their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings; and he burnt all the fat thereof on the altar, a chosen offering to Yahuah (God) for a sweet smelling savour.
verses.text: And during these seven days he brought each day to the altar a burnt-offering to Yahuah, two oxen, two rams, seven sheep, one he-goat, for a sin-offering, that he might atone thereby for himself and for his seed. And, as a thank-offering, seven rams, seven kids, seven sheep, and seven he-goats, and their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings; and he burnt all the fat thereof on the altar, a chosen offering to Yahuah for a sweet smelling savour.

verses.raw: And morning and evening he burnt fragrant substances, frankincense and galbanum, and stacte, and nard, and myrrh, and spice, and costum; all these seven he offered, crushed, mixed together in equal parts (and) pure.
verses.text: And morning and evening he burnt fragrant substances, frankincense and galbanum, and stacte, and nard, and myrrh, and spice, and costum; all these seven he offered, crushed, mixed together in equal parts (and) pure.

verses.raw: And he celebrated this feast during seven days, rejoicing with all his heart and with all his soul, he and all those who were in his house; and there was no stranger with him, nor any that was uncircumcised.
verses.text: And he celebrated this feast during seven days, rejoicing with all his heart and with all his soul, he and all those who were in his house; and there was no stranger with him, nor any that was uncircumcised.

verses.raw: And he blessed his Creator who had created him in his generation, for He had created him according to His good pleasure; for He knew and perceived that from him would arise the plant of righteousness for the eternal generations, and from him a holy seed, so that it should become like Him who had made all things.
verses.text: And he blessed his Creator who had created him in his generation, for He had created him according to His good pleasure; for He knew and perceived that from him would arise the plant of righteousness for the eternal generations, and from him a holy seed, so that it should become like Him who had made all things.

verses.raw: And he blessed and rejoiced, and he called the name of this festival the festival of Yahuah (God), a joy acceptable to the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God). And we blessed him for ever, and all his seed after him throughout all the generations of the earth, because he celebrated this festival in its season, according to the testimony of the heavenly tables.
verses.text: And he blessed and rejoiced, and he called the name of this festival the festival of Yahuah, a joy acceptable to the El Elyon Elohim. And we blessed him for ever, and all his seed after him throughout all the generations of the earth, because he celebrated this festival in its season, according to the testimony of the heavenly tables.

verses.raw: For this reason it is ordained on the heavenly tables concerning Yashar’el (Israel), that they shall celebrate the feast of tabernacles seven days with joy, in the seventh month, acceptable before Yahuah (God)–a statute for ever throughout their generations every year.
verses.text: For this reason it is ordained on the heavenly tables concerning Yashar’el, that they shall celebrate the feast of tabernacles seven days with joy, in the seventh month, acceptable before Yahuah–a statute for ever throughout their generations every year.

verses.raw: And to this there is no limit of days; for it is ordained for ever regarding Yashar’el (Israel) that they should celebrate it and dwell in booths, and set wreaths upon their heads, and take leafy boughs, and willows from the brook.
verses.text: And to this there is no limit of days; for it is ordained for ever regarding Yashar’el that they should celebrate it and dwell in booths, and set wreaths upon their heads, and take leafy boughs, and willows from the brook.

verses.raw: And Abraham took branches of palm trees, and the fruit of goodly trees, and every day going round the altar with the branches seven times a day in the morning, he praised and gave thanks to his Elohim (God) for all things in joy.
verses.text: And Abraham took branches of palm trees, and the fruit of goodly trees, and every day going round the altar with the branches seven times a day in the morning, he praised and gave thanks to his Elohim for all things in joy.

verses.raw: And in the first year of the fifth week Isaac was weaned in this jubilee, and Abraham made a great banquet in the third month, on the day his son Isaac was weaned.
verses.text: And in the first year of the fifth week Isaac was weaned in this jubilee, and Abraham made a great banquet in the third month, on the day his son Isaac was weaned.

verses.raw: And Ishmael, the son of Hagar, the Egyptian, was before the face of Abraham, his father, in his place, and Abraham rejoiced and blessed Elohim (God) because he had seen his sons
verses.text: And Ishmael, the son of Hagar, the Egyptian, was before the face of Abraham, his father, in his place, and Abraham rejoiced and blessed Elohim because he had seen his sons

verses.raw: and had not died childless. . And he remembered the words which He had spoken to him on the day on which Lot had parted from him, and he rejoiced because Yahuah (God) had given him seed upon the earth to inherit the earth, and he blessed with all his mouth the Creator of all things.
verses.text: and had not died childless. . And he remembered the words which He had spoken to him on the day on which Lot had parted from him, and he rejoiced because Yahuah had given him seed upon the earth to inherit the earth, and he blessed with all his mouth the Creator of all things.

verses.raw: And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, “Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”
verses.text: And Sarah saw Ishmael playing and dancing and Abraham rejoicing with great joy, and she became jealous of Ishmael and said to Abraham, “Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of this bondwoman will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

verses.raw: And the thing was grievous in Abraham’s sight, because of his maidservant and because of his son, that he should drive them from him.
verses.text: And the thing was grievous in Abraham’s sight, because of his maidservant and because of his son, that he should drive them from him.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said to Abraham “Let it not be grievous in your sight, because of the child and because of the bondwoman; in all that Sarah has said to you, hearken to her words and do (them); for in Isaac shall your name and seed be called.
verses.text: And Elohim said to Abraham “Let it not be grievous in your sight, because of the child and because of the bondwoman; in all that Sarah has said to you, hearken to her words and do (them); for in Isaac shall your name and seed be called.

verses.raw: But as for the son of this bondwoman I will make him a great nation, because he is of your seed.” And Abraham rose up early in the morning and took bread and a bottle of water, and placed them on the shoulders of Hagar and the child, and sent her away.
verses.text: But as for the son of this bondwoman I will make him a great nation, because he is of your seed.” And Abraham rose up early in the morning and took bread and a bottle of water, and placed them on the shoulders of Hagar and the child, and sent her away.

verses.raw: And she departed and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba, and the water in the bottle was spent, and the child thirsted, and was not able to go on, and fell down.
verses.text: And she departed and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba, and the water in the bottle was spent, and the child thirsted, and was not able to go on, and fell down.

verses.raw: And his mother took him and cast him under an olive tree, and went and sat her down over against him, at the distance of a bow-shot; for she said, “Let me not see the death of my child,” and as she sat she wept.
verses.text: And his mother took him and cast him under an olive tree, and went and sat her down over against him, at the distance of a bow-shot; for she said, “Let me not see the death of my child,” and as she sat she wept.

verses.raw: And an angel of Elohim (God), one of the holy ones, said to her, “Why weep you, Hagar? Arise, take the child, and hold him in your hand; for Elohim (God) has heard your voice, and has seen the child.”
verses.text: And an angel of Elohim, one of the holy ones, said to her, “Why weep you, Hagar? Arise, take the child, and hold him in your hand; for Elohim has heard your voice, and has seen the child.”

verses.raw: And she opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water, and she went and filled her bottle with water, and she gave her child to drink, and she arose and went towards the wilderness of Paran. And the child grew and became an archer, and Elohim (God) was with him; and his mother took him a wife from among the daughters of Egypt.
verses.text: And she opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water, and she went and filled her bottle with water, and she gave her child to drink, and she arose and went towards the wilderness of Paran. And the child grew and became an archer, and Elohim was with him; and his mother took him a wife from among the daughters of Egypt.

verses.raw: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Nebaioth; for she said, “Yahuah (God) was nigh to me when I called upon him.” And it came to pass in the seventh week, in the first year thereof, in the first month in this jubilee, on the twelfth of this month, there were voices in heaven regarding Abraham, that he was faithful in all that He told him, and that he loved Yahuah (God), and that in every affliction he was faithful.
verses.text: And she bare him a son, and he called his name Nebaioth; for she said, “Yahuah was nigh to me when I called upon him.” And it came to pass in the seventh week, in the first year thereof, in the first month in this jubilee, on the twelfth of this month, there were voices in heaven regarding Abraham, that he was faithful in all that He told him, and that he loved Yahuah, and that in every affliction he was faithful.

verses.raw: And the prince Mastêmâ 1 came and said before Elohim (God), “Behold, Abraham loves Isaac his son, and he delights in him above all things else; bid him offer him as a burnt-offering on the altar, and You will see if he will do this command, and You will know if he is faithful in everything wherein You do try him.”
verses.text: And the prince Mastêmâ 1 came and said before Elohim, “Behold, Abraham loves Isaac his son, and he delights in him above all things else; bid him offer him as a burnt-offering on the altar, and You will see if he will do this command, and You will know if he is faithful in everything wherein You do try him.”

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) knew that Abraham was faithful in all his afflictions; for He had tried him through his country and with famine, and had tried him with the wealth of kings, and had tried him again through his wife, when she was torn (from him), and with circumcision, and had tried him through Ishmael and Hagar, his maid-servant, when he sent them away. 2 18. And in everything wherein He had tried him, he was found faithful, and his soul was not impatient, and he was not slow to act; for he was faithful and a lover of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And Yahuah knew that Abraham was faithful in all his afflictions; for He had tried him through his country and with famine, and had tried him with the wealth of kings, and had tried him again through his wife, when she was torn (from him), and with circumcision, and had tried him through Ishmael and Hagar, his maid-servant, when he sent them away. 2 18. And in everything wherein He had tried him, he was found faithful, and his soul was not impatient, and he was not slow to act; for he was faithful and a lover of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said to him, “Abraham, Abraham”; and he said, “Behold, (here) am I.” . And He said, “Take your beloved son whom you love, (even) Isaac, and go to the high country, and offer him on one of the mountains which I will point out to you.”
verses.text: And Elohim said to him, “Abraham, Abraham”; and he said, “Behold, (here) am I.” . And He said, “Take your beloved son whom you love, (even) Isaac, and go to the high country, and offer him on one of the mountains which I will point out to you.”

verses.raw: And he rose early in the morning and saddled his ass, and took his two young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood of the burnt-offering, and he went to the place on the third day, and he saw the place afar off.
verses.text: And he rose early in the morning and saddled his ass, and took his two young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood of the burnt-offering, and he went to the place on the third day, and he saw the place afar off.

verses.raw: And he came to a well of water, and he said to his young men, “Abide you here with the ass, and I and the lad shall go (yonder), and when we have worshipped we shall come again to you.”
verses.text: And he came to a well of water, and he said to his young men, “Abide you here with the ass, and I and the lad shall go (yonder), and when we have worshipped we shall come again to you.”

verses.raw: And he took the wood of the burnt-offering and laid it on Isaac his son, and he took in his hand the fire and the knife, and they went both of them together to that place.
verses.text: And he took the wood of the burnt-offering and laid it on Isaac his son, and he took in his hand the fire and the knife, and they went both of them together to that place.

verses.raw: And Isaac said to his father, “Father”; and he said, “Here am I, my son.” And he said to him, “Behold the fire, and the knife, and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?”
verses.text: And Isaac said to his father, “Father”; and he said, “Here am I, my son.” And he said to him, “Behold the fire, and the knife, and the wood; but where is the sheep for the burnt-offering, father?”

verses.raw: And he said, “Elohim (God) will provide for himself a sheep for a burnt-offering, my son.” And he drew near to the place of the mount of Elohim (God). And he built an altar, and he placed the wood on the altar, and bound Isaac his son, and placed him on the wood which was upon the altar, and stretched forth his hand to take the knife to slay Isaac his son.
verses.text: And he said, “Elohim will provide for himself a sheep for a burnt-offering, my son.” And he drew near to the place of the mount of Elohim. And he built an altar, and he placed the wood on the altar, and bound Isaac his son, and placed him on the wood which was upon the altar, and stretched forth his hand to take the knife to slay Isaac his son.

verses.raw: And I stood before him, and before the prince of the Mastêmâ, and Yahuah (God) said, “Bid him not to lay his hand on the lad, nor to do anything to him, for I have shown that he fears Yahuah (God).”
verses.text: And I stood before him, and before the prince of the Mastêmâ, and Yahuah said, “Bid him not to lay his hand on the lad, nor to do anything to him, for I have shown that he fears Yahuah.”

verses.raw: And I called to him from heaven, and said to him: “Abraham, Abraham”; and he was terrified and said: “Behold, (here) am I.”
verses.text: And I called to him from heaven, and said to him: “Abraham, Abraham”; and he was terrified and said: “Behold, (here) am I.”

verses.raw: And I said to him: “Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you anything to him; for now I have shown that you fear Yahuah (God), and have not withheld your son, your first-born son, from me.”
verses.text: And I said to him: “Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you anything to him; for now I have shown that you fear Yahuah, and have not withheld your son, your first-born son, from me.”

verses.raw: And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son. And Abraham called that place “Yahuah (God) has seen,” so that it is said “(in the mount) Yahuah (God) has seen”: that is Mount Sion.
verses.text: And the prince of the Mastêmâ was put to shame; and Abraham lifted up his eyes and looked, and, behold, a single ram caught … by his horns, and Abraham went and took the ram and offered it for a burnt-offering in the stead of his son. And Abraham called that place “Yahuah has seen,” so that it is said “(in the mount) Yahuah has seen”: that is Mount Sion.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) called Abraham by his name a second time from heaven, as he caused us to appear to speak to him in the name of Yahuah (God). And He said: "By Myself have I sworn, says Yahuah (God), Because you have done this thing, And have not withheld your son, your beloved son, from Me, That in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore. And your seed will inherit the cities of its enemies,
verses.text: And Yahuah called Abraham by his name a second time from heaven, as he caused us to appear to speak to him in the name of Yahuah. And He said: "By Myself have I sworn, says Yahuah, Because you have done this thing, And have not withheld your son, your beloved son, from Me, That in blessing I shall bless you And in multiplying I shall multiply your seed As the stars of heaven, And as the sand which is on the seashore. And your seed will inherit the cities of its enemies,

verses.raw: And in your seed will all nations of the earth be blessed; Because you have obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you: Go in peace." And Abraham went to his young men, and they arose and went together to Beersheba, and Abraham dwelt by the Well of the Oath.
verses.text: And in your seed will all nations of the earth be blessed; Because you have obeyed My voice, And I have shown to all that you are faithful to Me in all that I have said to you: Go in peace." And Abraham went to his young men, and they arose and went together to Beersheba, and Abraham dwelt by the Well of the Oath.

verses.raw: And he celebrated this festival every year, seven days with joy, and he called it the festival of Yahuah (God) according to the seven days during which he went and returned in peace.
verses.text: And he celebrated this festival every year, seven days with joy, and he called it the festival of Yahuah according to the seven days during which he went and returned in peace.

verses.raw: And accordingly has it been ordained and written on the heavenly tables regarding Yashar’el (Israel) and its seed that they should observe this festival seven days with the joy of festival.
verses.text: And accordingly has it been ordained and written on the heavenly tables regarding Yashar’el and its seed that they should observe this festival seven days with the joy of festival.

verses.raw: And in the first year of the first week in the forty-second jubilee, Abraham returned and dwelt opposite Hebron, that is Kirjath Arba, two weeks of years.
verses.text: And in the first year of the first week in the forty-second jubilee, Abraham returned and dwelt opposite Hebron, that is Kirjath Arba, two weeks of years.

verses.raw: And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron.
verses.text: And in the first year of the third week of this jubilee the days of the life of Sarah were accomplished, and she died in Hebron.

verses.raw: And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him to see if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed.
verses.text: And Abraham went to mourn over her and bury her, and we tried him to see if his spirit were patient and he were not indignant in the words of his mouth; and he was found patient in this, and was not disturbed.

verses.raw: For in patience of spirit he conversed with the children of Heth, to the intent that they should give him a place in which to bury his dead.
verses.text: For in patience of spirit he conversed with the children of Heth, to the intent that they should give him a place in which to bury his dead.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver.
verses.text: And Yahuah gave him grace before all who saw him, and he besought in gentleness the sons of Heth, and they gave him the land of the double cave over against Mamre, that is Hebron, for four hundred pieces of silver.

verses.raw: And they besought him, saying, “We shall give it to you for nothing”; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave. And all the days of the life of Sarah were one hundred and twenty-seven years, that is, two jubilees and four weeks and one year: these are the days of the years of the life of Sarah.
verses.text: And they besought him, saying, “We shall give it to you for nothing”; but he would not take it from their hands for nothing, for he gave the price of the place, the money in full, and he bowed down before them twice; and after this he buried his dead in the double cave. And all the days of the life of Sarah were one hundred and twenty-seven years, that is, two jubilees and four weeks and one year: these are the days of the years of the life of Sarah.

verses.raw: This is the tenth trial wherewith Abraham was tried, and he was found faithful, patient in spirit.
verses.text: This is the tenth trial wherewith Abraham was tried, and he was found faithful, patient in spirit.

verses.raw: And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that Elohim (God) had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of Elohim (God). 1 10. And in the fourth year thereof he took a wife for his son Isaac and her name was Rebecca the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Nahor, the brother of Abraham the sister of Laban and daughter of Bethuel; and Bethuel was the son of Mêlcâ, who was the wife of Nahor, the brother of Abraham.
verses.text: And he said not a single word regarding the rumour in the land how that Elohim had said that He would give it to him and to his seed after him, and he begged a place there to bury his dead; for he was found faithful, and was recorded on the heavenly tables as the friend of Elohim. 1 10. And in the fourth year thereof he took a wife for his son Isaac and her name was Rebecca the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Nahor, the brother of Abraham the sister of Laban and daughter of Bethuel; and Bethuel was the son of Mêlcâ, who was the wife of Nahor, the brother of Abraham.

verses.raw: And Abraham took to himself a third wife, and her name was Keturah, from among the daughters of his household servants, for Hagar had died before Sarah. And she bare him six sons, Zimram, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah, in the two weeks of years.
verses.text: And Abraham took to himself a third wife, and her name was Keturah, from among the daughters of his household servants, for Hagar had died before Sarah. And she bare him six sons, Zimram, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah, in the two weeks of years.

verses.raw: And in the sixth week, in the second year thereof, Rebecca bare to Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau, and Jacob was a smooth and upright man, and Esau was fierce, a man of the field, and hairy, and Jacob dwelt in tents.
verses.text: And in the sixth week, in the second year thereof, Rebecca bare to Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau, and Jacob was a smooth and upright man, and Esau was fierce, a man of the field, and hairy, and Jacob dwelt in tents.

verses.raw: And the youths grew, and Jacob learned to write; but Esau did not learn, for he was a man of the field and a hunter, and he learnt war, and all his deeds were fierce. And Abraham loved Jacob, but Isaac loved Esau.
verses.text: And the youths grew, and Jacob learned to write; but Esau did not learn, for he was a man of the field and a hunter, and he learnt war, and all his deeds were fierce. And Abraham loved Jacob, but Isaac loved Esau.

verses.raw: And Abraham saw the deeds of Esau, and he knew that in Jacob should his name and seed be called; and he called Rebecca and gave commandment regarding Jacob, for he knew that she (too) loved Jacob much more than Esau.
verses.text: And Abraham saw the deeds of Esau, and he knew that in Jacob should his name and seed be called; and he called Rebecca and gave commandment regarding Jacob, for he knew that she (too) loved Jacob much more than Esau.

verses.raw: And he said to her: "My daughter, watch over my son Jacob, For he shall be in my stead on the earth, And for a blessing in the midst of the children of men, And for the glory of the whole seed of Shem. For I know that Yahuah (God) will choose him to be a people for possession to Himself, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.text: And he said to her: "My daughter, watch over my son Jacob, For he shall be in my stead on the earth, And for a blessing in the midst of the children of men, And for the glory of the whole seed of Shem. For I know that Yahuah will choose him to be a people for possession to Himself, above all peoples that are upon the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And behold, Isaac my son loves Esau more than Jacob, but I see that you truly love Jacob. Add still further to your kindness to him, And let your eyes be upon him in love; For he will be a blessing to us on the earth from henceforth to all generations of the earth. Let your hands be strong And let your heart rejoice in your son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons. He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth. If a man can number the sand of the earth, His seed also will be numbered. And all the blessings wherewith Yahuah (God) has blessed me and my seed shall belong to Jacob and his seed alway.
verses.text: And behold, Isaac my son loves Esau more than Jacob, but I see that you truly love Jacob. Add still further to your kindness to him, And let your eyes be upon him in love; For he will be a blessing to us on the earth from henceforth to all generations of the earth. Let your hands be strong And let your heart rejoice in your son Jacob; For I have loved him far beyond all my sons. He will be blessed for ever, And his seed will fill the whole earth. If a man can number the sand of the earth, His seed also will be numbered. And all the blessings wherewith Yahuah has blessed me and my seed shall belong to Jacob and his seed alway.

verses.raw: And in his seed shall my name be blessed, and the name of my fathers, Shem, and Noah, and Enoch, and Mahalalel, and Enos, and Seth, and Adam.
verses.text: And in his seed shall my name be blessed, and the name of my fathers, Shem, and Noah, and Enoch, and Mahalalel, and Enos, and Seth, and Adam.

verses.raw: And these shall serve To lay the foundations of the heaven, And to strengthen the earth, And to renew all the luminaries which are in the firmament." And he called Jacob before the eyes of Rebecca his mother, and kissed him, and blessed him, and said:
verses.text: And these shall serve To lay the foundations of the heaven, And to strengthen the earth, And to renew all the luminaries which are in the firmament." And he called Jacob before the eyes of Rebecca his mother, and kissed him, and blessed him, and said:

verses.raw: “Jacob, my beloved son, whom my soul loves, may Elohim (God) bless you from above the firmament, and may He give you all the blessings wherewith He blessed Adam, and Enoch, and Noah, and Shem; and all the things of which He told me, and all the things which He promised to give me, may He cause to cleave to you and to your seed for ever, according to the days of heaven above the earth.
verses.text: “Jacob, my beloved son, whom my soul loves, may Elohim bless you from above the firmament, and may He give you all the blessings wherewith He blessed Adam, and Enoch, and Noah, and Shem; and all the things of which He told me, and all the things which He promised to give me, may He cause to cleave to you and to your seed for ever, according to the days of heaven above the earth.

verses.raw: And the spirits of Mastêmâ shall not rule over you or over your seed to turn you from Yahuah (God), who is your Elohim (God) from henceforth for ever.
verses.text: And the spirits of Mastêmâ shall not rule over you or over your seed to turn you from Yahuah, who is your Elohim from henceforth for ever.

verses.raw: And may Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) be a father to you and you the first-born son, and to the people alway. Go in peace, my son.”
verses.text: And may Yahuah Elohim be a father to you and you the first-born son, and to the people alway. Go in peace, my son.”

verses.raw: And they both went forth together from Abraham. And Rebecca loved Jacob, with all her heart and with all her soul, very much more than Esau; but Isaac loved Esau much more than Jacob.
verses.text: And they both went forth together from Abraham. And Rebecca loved Jacob, with all her heart and with all her soul, very much more than Esau; but Isaac loved Esau much more than Jacob.

verses.raw: And in the forty-second jubilee, in the first year of the seventh week, Abraham called Ishmael, and his twelve sons, and Isaac and his two sons, and the six sons of Keturah, and their sons.
verses.text: And in the forty-second jubilee, in the first year of the seventh week, Abraham called Ishmael, and his twelve sons, and Isaac and his two sons, and the six sons of Keturah, and their sons.

verses.raw: And he commanded them that they should observe the way of Yahuah (God); that they should work righteousness, and love each his neighbour, and act on this manner amongst all men; that they should each so walk with regard to them as to do judgment and righteousness on the earth.
verses.text: And he commanded them that they should observe the way of Yahuah; that they should work righteousness, and love each his neighbour, and act on this manner amongst all men; that they should each so walk with regard to them as to do judgment and righteousness on the earth.

verses.raw: That they should circumcise their sons, according to the covenant which He had made with them, and not deviate to the right hand or the left of all the paths which Yahuah (God) had commanded us; and that we should keep ourselves from all fornication and uncleanness, and renounce from amongst us all fornication and uncleanness.
verses.text: That they should circumcise their sons, according to the covenant which He had made with them, and not deviate to the right hand or the left of all the paths which Yahuah had commanded us; and that we should keep ourselves from all fornication and uncleanness, and renounce from amongst us all fornication and uncleanness.

verses.raw: And if any woman or maid commit fornication amongst you, burn her with fire, and let them not commit fornication with her after their eyes and their heart; and let them not take to themselves wives from the daughters of Canaan; for the seed of Canaan will be rooted out of the land.
verses.text: And if any woman or maid commit fornication amongst you, burn her with fire, and let them not commit fornication with her after their eyes and their heart; and let them not take to themselves wives from the daughters of Canaan; for the seed of Canaan will be rooted out of the land.

verses.raw: And he told them of the judgment of the giants, and the judgment of the Sodomites, how they had been judged on account of their wickedness, and had died on account of their fornication, and uncleanness, and mutual corruption through fornication. “And guard yourselves from all fornication and uncleanness, And from all pollution of sin, Lest you make our name a curse, And your whole life a hissing, And all your sons be destroyed by the sword, And you become accursed like Sodom, And all your remnant as the sons of Gomorrah.
verses.text: And he told them of the judgment of the giants, and the judgment of the Sodomites, how they had been judged on account of their wickedness, and had died on account of their fornication, and uncleanness, and mutual corruption through fornication. “And guard yourselves from all fornication and uncleanness, And from all pollution of sin, Lest you make our name a curse, And your whole life a hissing, And all your sons be destroyed by the sword, And you become accursed like Sodom, And all your remnant as the sons of Gomorrah.

verses.raw: I implore you, my sons, love the Elohim (God) of heaven, And cleave you to all His commandments. And walk not after their idols, and after their uncleannesses,
verses.text: I implore you, my sons, love the Elohim of heaven, And cleave you to all His commandments. And walk not after their idols, and after their uncleannesses,

verses.raw: And make not for yourselves molten or graven gods; For they are vanity, And there is no spirit in them; For they are work of (men’s) hands, And all who trust in them, trust in nothing. Serve them not, nor worship them,
verses.text: And make not for yourselves molten or graven gods; For they are vanity, And there is no spirit in them; For they are work of (men’s) hands, And all who trust in them, trust in nothing. Serve them not, nor worship them,

verses.raw: But serve you the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God), and worship Him continually: And hope for His countenance always, And work uprightness and righteousness before Him, That He may have pleasure in you and grant you His mercy, And send rain upon you morning and evening, And bless all your works which you have wrought upon the earth, And bless your bread and your water, And bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land, And the herds of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep.
verses.text: But serve you the El Elyon Elohim, and worship Him continually: And hope for His countenance always, And work uprightness and righteousness before Him, That He may have pleasure in you and grant you His mercy, And send rain upon you morning and evening, And bless all your works which you have wrought upon the earth, And bless your bread and your water, And bless the fruit of your womb and the fruit of your land, And the herds of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep.

verses.raw: And you will be for a blessing on the earth, And all nations of the earth will desire you, And bless your sons in my name, That they may be blessed as I am.” And he gave to Ishmael and to his sons, and to the sons of Keturah, gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, and he gave everything to Isaac his son. And Ishmael and his sons, and the sons of Keturah and their sons, went together and dwelt from Paran to the entering in of Babylon in all the land which is towards the East facing the desert.
verses.text: And you will be for a blessing on the earth, And all nations of the earth will desire you, And bless your sons in my name, That they may be blessed as I am.” And he gave to Ishmael and to his sons, and to the sons of Keturah, gifts, and sent them away from Isaac his son, and he gave everything to Isaac his son. And Ishmael and his sons, and the sons of Keturah and their sons, went together and dwelt from Paran to the entering in of Babylon in all the land which is towards the East facing the desert.

verses.raw: And these mingled with each other, and their name was called Arabs, and Ishmaelites.
verses.text: And these mingled with each other, and their name was called Arabs, and Ishmaelites.

verses.raw: And in the sixth year of the seventh week of this jubilee Abraham called Isaac his son, and commanded him, saying: "I am become old, and. know not the day of my death, and am full of my days.
verses.text: And in the sixth year of the seventh week of this jubilee Abraham called Isaac his son, and commanded him, saying: "I am become old, and. know not the day of my death, and am full of my days.

verses.raw: And behold, I am one hundred and seventy-five years old, and throughout all the days of my life I have remembered Yahuah (God), and sought with all my heart to do His will, and to walk uprightly in all His ways.
verses.text: And behold, I am one hundred and seventy-five years old, and throughout all the days of my life I have remembered Yahuah, and sought with all my heart to do His will, and to walk uprightly in all His ways.

verses.raw: My soul has hated idols, (and I have despised those that served them, and I have given my heart and spirit) that I might observe to do the will of Him who created me.
verses.text: My soul has hated idols, (and I have despised those that served them, and I have given my heart and spirit) that I might observe to do the will of Him who created me.

verses.raw: For He is the living Elohim (God), and He is holy and faithful, and He is righteous beyond all, and there is with Him no accepting of (men’s) persons and no accepting of gifts; for Elohim (God) is righteous, and executes judgment on all those who transgress His commandments and despise His covenant.
verses.text: For He is the living Elohim, and He is holy and faithful, and He is righteous beyond all, and there is with Him no accepting of (men’s) persons and no accepting of gifts; for Elohim is righteous, and executes judgment on all those who transgress His commandments and despise His covenant.

verses.raw: And do you, my son, observe His commandments and His ordinances and His judgments, and walk not after the abominations and after the graven images and after the molten images.
verses.text: And do you, my son, observe His commandments and His ordinances and His judgments, and walk not after the abominations and after the graven images and after the molten images.

verses.raw: And eat no blood at all of animals or cattle, or of any bird which flies in the heaven. And if you do slay a victim as an acceptable peace-offering, slay you it, and pour out its blood upon the altar, and all the fat of the offering offer on the altar with fine flour (and the meat-offering) mingled with oil, with its drink-offering–offer them all together on the altar of burnt-offering; it is a sweet savour before Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And eat no blood at all of animals or cattle, or of any bird which flies in the heaven. And if you do slay a victim as an acceptable peace-offering, slay you it, and pour out its blood upon the altar, and all the fat of the offering offer on the altar with fine flour (and the meat-offering) mingled with oil, with its drink-offering–offer them all together on the altar of burnt-offering; it is a sweet savour before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And you will offer the fat of the sacrifice of thank-offerings on the fire which is upon the altar, and the fat which is on the belly, and all the fat on the inwards and the two kidneys, and all the fat that is upon them, and upon the loins and liver you shall remove together with the kidneys.
verses.text: And you will offer the fat of the sacrifice of thank-offerings on the fire which is upon the altar, and the fat which is on the belly, and all the fat on the inwards and the two kidneys, and all the fat that is upon them, and upon the loins and liver you shall remove together with the kidneys.

verses.raw: And offer all these for a sweet savour acceptable before Yahuah (God), with its meat-offering and with its drink-offering, for a sweet savour, the bread of the offering to Yahuah (God),
verses.text: And offer all these for a sweet savour acceptable before Yahuah, with its meat-offering and with its drink-offering, for a sweet savour, the bread of the offering to Yahuah,

verses.raw: And eat its meat on that day and on the second day, and let not the sun on the second day go down upon it till it is eaten, and let nothing be left over for the third day; for it is not acceptable for it is not approved and let it no longer be eaten, and all who eat thereof will bring sin upon themselves; for thus I have found it written in the books of my forefathers, and in the words of Enoch, and in the words of Noah.
verses.text: And eat its meat on that day and on the second day, and let not the sun on the second day go down upon it till it is eaten, and let nothing be left over for the third day; for it is not acceptable for it is not approved and let it no longer be eaten, and all who eat thereof will bring sin upon themselves; for thus I have found it written in the books of my forefathers, and in the words of Enoch, and in the words of Noah.

verses.raw: And on all your oblations you shall strew salt, and let not the salt of the covenant be lacking in all your oblations before Yahuah (God). And as regards the wood of the sacrifices, beware lest you bring (other) wood for the altar in addition to these: cypress, dêfrân, sagâd, pine, fir, cedar, savin, palm, olive, myrrh, laurel, and citron, juniper, and balsam.
verses.text: And on all your oblations you shall strew salt, and let not the salt of the covenant be lacking in all your oblations before Yahuah. And as regards the wood of the sacrifices, beware lest you bring (other) wood for the altar in addition to these: cypress, dêfrân, sagâd, pine, fir, cedar, savin, palm, olive, myrrh, laurel, and citron, juniper, and balsam.

verses.raw: And of these kinds of wood lay upon the altar under the sacrifice, such as have been tested as to their appearance, and do not lay (thereon) any split or dark wood, (but) hard and clean, without fault, a sound and new growth; and do not lay (thereon) old wood, for its fragrance is gone for there is no longer fragrance in it as before.
verses.text: And of these kinds of wood lay upon the altar under the sacrifice, such as have been tested as to their appearance, and do not lay (thereon) any split or dark wood, (but) hard and clean, without fault, a sound and new growth; and do not lay (thereon) old wood, for its fragrance is gone for there is no longer fragrance in it as before.

verses.raw: Besides these kinds of wood there is none other that you shall place (on the altar), for the fragrance is dispersed, and the smell of its fragrance goes not up to heaven.
verses.text: Besides these kinds of wood there is none other that you shall place (on the altar), for the fragrance is dispersed, and the smell of its fragrance goes not up to heaven.

verses.raw: Observe this commandment and do it, my son, that you may be upright in all your deeds.
verses.text: Observe this commandment and do it, my son, that you may be upright in all your deeds.

verses.raw: And at all times be clean in your body, and wash yourself with water before you approach to offer on the altar, and wash your hands and your feet before you draw near to the altar; and when you are done sacrificing, wash again your hands and your feet. And let no blood appear upon you nor upon your clothes; be on your guard, my son, against blood, be on your guard exceedingly; cover it with dust.
verses.text: And at all times be clean in your body, and wash yourself with water before you approach to offer on the altar, and wash your hands and your feet before you draw near to the altar; and when you are done sacrificing, wash again your hands and your feet.
