verses.raw: And Laban made a feast, and took Leah his elder daughter, and gave (her) to Jacob as a wife, and gave her Zilpah his handmaid for an handmaid; and Jacob did not know, for he thought that she was Rachel.
verses.text: And Laban made a feast, and took Leah his elder daughter, and gave (her) to Jacob as a wife, and gave her Zilpah his handmaid for an handmaid; and Jacob did not know, for he thought that she was Rachel.

verses.raw: And he went in to her, and behold, she was Leah; and Jacob was angry with Laban, and said to him: “Why have you dealt thus with me? Did not I serve you for Rachel and not for Leah? Why have you wronged me? Take your daughter, and I will go; for you have done evil to me.”
verses.text: And he went in to her, and behold, she was Leah; and Jacob was angry with Laban, and said to him: “Why have you dealt thus with me? Did not I serve you for Rachel and not for Leah? Why have you wronged me? Take your daughter, and I will go; for you have done evil to me.”

verses.raw: For Jacob loved Rachel more than Leah; for Leah’s eyes were weak, but her form was very handsome; but Rachel had beautiful eyes and a beautiful and very handsome form.
verses.text: For Jacob loved Rachel more than Leah; for Leah’s eyes were weak, but her form was very handsome; but Rachel had beautiful eyes and a beautiful and very handsome form.

verses.raw: And Laban said to Jacob: “It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder.” And it is not right to do this; for thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables, that no one should give his younger daughter before the elder–but the elder one gives first and after her the younger–and the man who does so, they set down guilt against him in heaven, and none is righteous that does this thing, for this deed is evil before Yahuah (God). And command you the children of Yashar’el (Israel) that they do not this thing; let them neither take nor give the younger before they have given the elder, for it is very wicked.
verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob: “It is not so done in our country, to give the younger before the elder.” And it is not right to do this; for thus it is ordained and written in the heavenly tables, that no one should give his younger daughter before the elder–but the elder one gives first and after her the younger–and the man who does so, they set down guilt against him in heaven, and none is righteous that does this thing, for this deed is evil before Yahuah. And command you the children of Yashar’el that they do not this thing; let them neither take nor give the younger before they have given the elder, for it is very wicked.

verses.raw: And Laban said to Jacob: “Let the seven days of the feast of this one pass by, and I shall give you Rachel, that you may serve me another seven years, that you may pasture my sheep as you did in the former week.”
verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob: “Let the seven days of the feast of this one pass by, and I shall give you Rachel, that you may serve me another seven years, that you may pasture my sheep as you did in the former week.”

verses.raw: And on the day when the seven days of the feast of Leah had passed, Laban gave Rachel to Jacob, that he might serve him another seven years, and he gave to Rachel Bilhah, the sister of Zilpah as a handmaid.
verses.text: And on the day when the seven days of the feast of Leah had passed, Laban gave Rachel to Jacob, that he might serve him another seven years, and he gave to Rachel Bilhah, the sister of Zilpah as a handmaid.

verses.raw: And he served yet other seven years for Rachel, for Leah had been given to him for nothing.
verses.text: And he served yet other seven years for Rachel, for Leah had been given to him for nothing.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week. But the womb of Rachel was closed, for Yahuah (God) saw that Leah was hated and Rachel loved.
verses.text: And Yahuah opened the womb of Leah, and she conceived and bare Jacob a son, and he called his name Reuben, on the fourteenth day of the ninth month, in the first year of the third week. But the womb of Rachel was closed, for Yahuah saw that Leah was hated and Rachel loved.

verses.raw: And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name Simeon, on the twenty-first of the tenth month, and in the third year of this week.
verses.text: And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare Jacob a second son, and he called his name Simeon, on the twenty-first of the tenth month, and in the third year of this week.

verses.raw: And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare him a third son, and he called his name Levi, in the new moon of the first month in the sixth year of this week. And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah (Judah), on the fifteenth of the third month, in the first year of the fourth week.
verses.text: And again Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare him a third son, and he called his name Levi, in the new moon of the first month in the sixth year of this week. And again Jacob went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a fourth son, and he called his name Yahudah, on the fifteenth of the third month, in the first year of the fourth week.

verses.raw: And on account of all this Rachel envied Leah, for she did not bear, and she said to Jacob: “Give me children”; and Jacob said: “Have I withheld from you the fruits of your womb? Have I forsaken you?”
verses.text: And on account of all this Rachel envied Leah, for she did not bear, and she said to Jacob: “Give me children”; and Jacob said: “Have I withheld from you the fruits of your womb? Have I forsaken you?”

verses.raw: And when Rachel saw that Leah had borne four sons to Jacob, Reuben and Simeon and Levi and Yahudah (Judah), she said to him: “Go in to Bilhah my handmaid, and she will conceive, and bear a son to me.”
verses.text: And when Rachel saw that Leah had borne four sons to Jacob, Reuben and Simeon and Levi and Yahudah, she said to him: “Go in to Bilhah my handmaid, and she will conceive, and bear a son to me.”

verses.raw: (And she gave (him) Bilhah her handmaid to wife.) And he went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a son, and he called his name Dan, on the ninth of the sixth month, in the sixth year of the third week.
verses.text: (And she gave (him) Bilhah her handmaid to wife.) And he went in to her, and she conceived, and bare him a son, and he called his name Dan, on the ninth of the sixth month, in the sixth year of the third week.

verses.raw: And Jacob went in again to Bilhah a second time, and she conceived, and bare Jacob another son, and Rachel called his name Naphtali, on the fifth of the seventh month, in the second year of the fourth week. And when Leah saw that she had become sterile and did not bear, she envied (Rachel) and she also gave her handmaid Zilpah to Jacob to wife, and she conceived, and bare a son, and Leah called his name Gad, on the twelfth of the eighth month, in the third year of the fourth week.
verses.text: And Jacob went in again to Bilhah a second time, and she conceived, and bare Jacob another son, and Rachel called his name Naphtali, on the fifth of the seventh month, in the second year of the fourth week. And when Leah saw that she had become sterile and did not bear, she envied and she also gave her handmaid Zilpah to Jacob to wife, and she conceived, and bare a son, and Leah called his name Gad, on the twelfth of the eighth month, in the third year of the fourth week.

verses.raw: And he went in again to her, and she conceived, and bare him a second son, and Leah called his name Asher, on the second of the eleventh month, in the fifth year of the fourth week.
verses.text: And he went in again to her, and she conceived, and bare him a second son, and Leah called his name Asher, on the second of the eleventh month, in the fifth year of the fourth week.

verses.raw: And Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Issachar, on the fourth of the fifth month, in the fourth year of the fourth week, and she gave him to a nurse.
verses.text: And Jacob went in to Leah, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Issachar, on the fourth of the fifth month, in the fourth year of the fourth week, and she gave him to a nurse.

verses.raw: And Jacob went in again to her, and she conceived, and bare two (children), a son and a daughter, and she called the name of the son Zebulon, and the name of the daughter Dinah, in the seventh of the seventh month, in the sixth year of the fourth week.
verses.text: And Jacob went in again to her, and she conceived, and bare two (children), a son and a daughter, and she called the name of the son Zebulon, and the name of the daughter Dinah, in the seventh of the seventh month, in the sixth year of the fourth week.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Joseph, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the sixth year in this fourth week. And in the days when Joseph was born, Jacob said to Laban: “Give me my wives and sons, and let me go to my father Isaac, and let me make me an house; for I have completed the years in which I have served you for your two daughters, and I will go to the house of my father.”
verses.text: And Yahuah was gracious to Rachel, and opened her womb, and she conceived, and bare a son, and she called his name Joseph, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the sixth year in this fourth week. And in the days when Joseph was born, Jacob said to Laban: “Give me my wives and sons, and let me go to my father Isaac, and let me make me an house; for I have completed the years in which I have served you for your two daughters, and I will go to the house of my father.”

verses.raw: And Laban said to Jacob: “Tarry with me for your wages 1, and pasture my flock for me again, and take your wages.”
verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob: “Tarry with me for your wages 1, and pasture my flock for me again, and take your wages.”

verses.raw: And they agreed with one another that he should give him as his wages those of the lambs and kids which were born black and spotted and white, 2 (these) were to be his wages.
verses.text: And they agreed with one another that he should give him as his wages those of the lambs and kids which were born black and spotted and white, 2 (these) were to be his wages.

verses.raw: And all the sheep brought forth spotted and speckled and black, variously marked, 3 and they brought forth again lambs like themselves, and all that were spotted were Jacob’s and those which were not were Laban’s.
verses.text: And all the sheep brought forth spotted and speckled and black, variously marked, 3 and they brought forth again lambs like themselves, and all that were spotted were Jacob’s and those which were not were Laban’s.

verses.raw: And Jacob’s possessions multiplied exceedingly, and he possessed oxen and sheep 4 and asses and camels, and menservants and maidservants. And Laban and his sons envied Jacob, and Laban took back his sheep from him, and he observed him with evil intent.
verses.text: And Jacob’s possessions multiplied exceedingly, and he possessed oxen and sheep 4 and asses and camels, and menservants and maidservants. And Laban and his sons envied Jacob, and Laban took back his sheep from him, and he observed him with evil intent.

verses.raw: And it came to pass when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Laban went to shear his sheep; for they were distant from him a three days’ journey.
verses.text: And it came to pass when Rachel had borne Joseph, that Laban went to shear his sheep; for they were distant from him a three days’ journey.

verses.raw: And Jacob saw that Laban was going to shear his sheep, and Jacob called Leah and Rachel, and spake kindly to them that they should come with him to the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And Jacob saw that Laban was going to shear his sheep, and Jacob called Leah and Rachel, and spake kindly to them that they should come with him to the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: For he told them how he had seen everything in a dream, even all that He had spoken to him that he should return to his father’s house; and they said: “To every place whither you go we will go with you.”
verses.text: For he told them how he had seen everything in a dream, even all that He had spoken to him that he should return to his father’s house; and they said: “To every place whither you go we will go with you.”

verses.raw: And Jacob blessed the Elohim (God) of Isaac his father, and the Elohim (God) of Abraham his father’s father, and he arose and mounted his wives and his children, and took all his possessions and crossed the river, and came to the land of Gilead, and Jacob hid his intention from Laban and told him not.
verses.text: And Jacob blessed the Elohim of Isaac his father, and the Elohim of Abraham his father’s father, and he arose and mounted his wives and his children, and took all his possessions and crossed the river, and came to the land of Gilead, and Jacob hid his intention from Laban and told him not.

verses.raw: And in the seventh year of the fourth week Jacob turned (his face) toward Gilead in the first month, on the twenty-first thereof. And Laban pursued after him and overtook Jacob in the mountain of Gilead in the third month, on the thirteenth thereof.
verses.text: And in the seventh year of the fourth week Jacob turned (his face) toward Gilead in the first month, on the twenty-first thereof. And Laban pursued after him and overtook Jacob in the mountain of Gilead in the third month, on the thirteenth thereof.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) did not suffer him to injure Jacob; for He appeared to him in a dream by night. And Laban spake to Jacob, And on the fifteenth of those days Jacob made a feast for Laban, and for all who came with him, and Jacob sware to Laban that day, and Laban also to Jacob, that neither should cross the mountain of Gilead to the other with evil purpose.
verses.text: And Yahuah did not suffer him to injure Jacob; for He appeared to him in a dream by night. And Laban spake to Jacob, And on the fifteenth of those days Jacob made a feast for Laban, and for all who came with him, and Jacob sware to Laban that day, and Laban also to Jacob, that neither should cross the mountain of Gilead to the other with evil purpose.

verses.raw: And he made there a heap for a witness; wherefore the name of that place is called: “The Heap of Witness,” after this heap.
verses.text: And he made there a heap for a witness; wherefore the name of that place is called: “The Heap of Witness,” after this heap.

verses.raw: But before they used to call the land of Gilead the land of the Rephaim; for it was the land of the Rephaim, and the Rephaim were born (there), giants whose height was ten, nine, eight down to seven cubits.
verses.text: But before they used to call the land of Gilead the land of the Rephaim; for it was the land of the Rephaim, and the Rephaim were born (there), giants whose height was ten, nine, eight down to seven cubits.

verses.raw: And their habitation was from the land of the children of Ammon to Mount Hermon, and the seats of their kingdom were Karnaim and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, and Mîsûr, and Beon.
verses.text: And their habitation was from the land of the children of Ammon to Mount Hermon, and the seats of their kingdom were Karnaim and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, and Mîsûr, and Beon.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) destroyed them because of the evil of their deeds; for they were very malignant, and the Amorites dwelt in their stead, wicked and sinful, and there is no people to-day which has wrought to the full all their sins, and they have no longer length of life on the earth. And Jacob sent away Laban, and he departed into Mesopotamia, the land of the East, and Jacob returned to the land of Gilead. And he passed over the Jabbok in the ninth month, on the eleventh thereof. And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.
verses.text: And Yahuah destroyed them because of the evil of their deeds; for they were very malignant, and the Amorites dwelt in their stead, wicked and sinful, and there is no people to-day which has wrought to the full all their sins, and they have no longer length of life on the earth. And Jacob sent away Laban, and he departed into Mesopotamia, the land of the East, and Jacob returned to the land of Gilead. And he passed over the Jabbok in the ninth month, on the eleventh thereof. And on that day Esau, his brother, came to him, and he was reconciled to him, and departed from him to the land of Seir, but Jacob dwelt in tents.

verses.raw: And in the first year of the fifth week in this jubilee he crossed the Jordan, and dwelt beyond the Jordan, and he pastured his sheep from the sea of the heap to Bethshan, and to Dothan and to the forest of Akrabbim.
verses.text: And in the first year of the fifth week in this jubilee he crossed the Jordan, and dwelt beyond the Jordan, and he pastured his sheep from the sea of the heap to Bethshan, and to Dothan and to the forest of Akrabbim.

verses.raw: And he sent to his father Isaac of all his substance, clothing, and food, and meat, and drink, and milk, and butter, and cheese, and some dates of the valley,
verses.text: And he sent to his father Isaac of all his substance, clothing, and food, and meat, and drink, and milk, and butter, and cheese, and some dates of the valley,

verses.raw: And to his mother Rebecca also four times a year, between the times of the months, between ploughing and reaping, and between autumn and the rain (season) and between winter and spring, to the tower of Abraham.
verses.text: And to his mother Rebecca also four times a year, between the times of the months, between ploughing and reaping, and between autumn and the rain (season) and between winter and spring, to the tower of Abraham.

verses.raw: For Isaac had returned from the Well of the Oath and gone up to the tower of his father Abraham, and he dwelt there apart from his son Esau. For in the days when Jacob went to Mesopotamia, Esau took to himself a wife Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael, and he gathered together all the flocks of his father and his wives, and went up and dwelt on Mount Seir, and left Isaac his father at the Well of the Oath alone.
verses.text: For Isaac had returned from the Well of the Oath and gone up to the tower of his father Abraham, and he dwelt there apart from his son Esau. For in the days when Jacob went to Mesopotamia, Esau took to himself a wife Mahalath, the daughter of Ishmael, and he gathered together all the flocks of his father and his wives, and went up and dwelt on Mount Seir, and left Isaac his father at the Well of the Oath alone.

verses.raw: And Isaac went up from the Well of the Oath and dwelt in the tower of Abraham his father on the mountains of Hebron,
verses.text: And Isaac went up from the Well of the Oath and dwelt in the tower of Abraham his father on the mountains of Hebron,

verses.raw: And thither Jacob sent all that he did send to his father and his mother from time to time, all they needed, and they blessed Jacob with all their heart and with all their soul.
verses.text: And thither Jacob sent all that he did send to his father and his mother from time to time, all they needed, and they blessed Jacob with all their heart and with all their soul.

verses.raw: And in the first year of the sixth week he went up to Salem, to the east of Shechem, in peace, in the fourth month.
verses.text: And in the first year of the sixth week he went up to Salem, to the east of Shechem, in peace, in the fourth month.

verses.raw: And there they carried off Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, into the house of Shechem, the son of Hamor, the Hivite, the prince of the land, and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years.
verses.text: And there they carried off Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, into the house of Shechem, the son of Hamor, the Hivite, the prince of the land, and he lay with her and defiled her, and she was a little girl, a child of twelve years.

verses.raw: And he besought his father and her brothers that she might be given to him to wife. And Jacob and his sons were wroth because of the men of Shechem; for they had defiled Dinah, their sister, and they spake to them with evil intent and dealt deceitfully with them and beguiled them.
verses.text: And he besought his father and her brothers that she might be given to him to wife. And Jacob and his sons were wroth because of the men of Shechem; for they had defiled Dinah, their sister, and they spake to them with evil intent and dealt deceitfully with them and beguiled them.

verses.raw: And Simeon and Levi came unexpectedly to Shechem and executed judgment on all the men of Shechem, and slew all the men whom they found in it, and left not a single one remaining in it: they slew all in torments because they had dishonoured their sister Dinah.
verses.text: And Simeon and Levi came unexpectedly to Shechem and executed judgment on all the men of Shechem, and slew all the men whom they found in it, and left not a single one remaining in it: they slew all in torments because they had dishonoured their sister Dinah.

verses.raw: And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Yashar’el (Israel) be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And thus let it not again be done from henceforth that a daughter of Yashar’el be defiled; for judgment is ordained in heaven against them that they should destroy with the sword all the men of the Shechemites because they had wrought shame in Yashar’el.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) delivered them into the hands of the sons of Jacob that they might exterminate them with the sword and execute judgment upon them, and that it might not thus again be done in Yashar’el (Israel) that a virgin of Yashar’el (Israel) should be defiled. And if there is any man who wishes in Yashar’el (Israel) to give his daughter or his sister to any man who is of the seed of the nations he shall surely die, and they shall stone him with stones; for he has wrought shame in Yashar’el (Israel); and they shall burn the woman with fire, because she has dishonoured the name of the house of her father, and she shall be rooted out of Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah delivered them into the hands of the sons of Jacob that they might exterminate them with the sword and execute judgment upon them, and that it might not thus again be done in Yashar’el that a virgin of Yashar’el should be defiled. And if there is any man who wishes in Yashar’el to give his daughter or his sister to any man who is of the seed of the nations he shall surely die, and they shall stone him with stones; for he has wrought shame in Yashar’el; and they shall burn the woman with fire, because she has dishonoured the name of the house of her father, and she shall be rooted out of Yashar’el.

verses.raw: And let not an adulteress and no uncleanness be found in Yashar’el (Israel) throughout all the days of the generations of the earth; for Yashar’el (Israel) is holy to Yahuah (God), and every man who has defiled (it) shall surely die: they shall stone him with stones.
verses.text: And let not an adulteress and no uncleanness be found in Yashar’el throughout all the days of the generations of the earth; for Yashar’el is holy to Yahuah, and every man who has defiled (it) shall surely die: they shall stone him with stones.

verses.raw: For thus has it been ordained and written in the heavenly tables regarding all the seed of Yashar’el (Israel): he who defiles (it) shall surely die, and he shall be stoned with stones.
verses.text: For thus has it been ordained and written in the heavenly tables regarding all the seed of Yashar’el: he who defiles (it) shall surely die, and he shall be stoned with stones.

verses.raw: And to this law there is no limit of days, and no remission, nor any atonement: but the man who has defiled his daughter shall be rooted out in the midst of all Yashar’el (Israel), because he has given of his seed to Moloch, and wrought impiously so as to defile it.
verses.text: And to this law there is no limit of days, and no remission, nor any atonement: but the man who has defiled his daughter shall be rooted out in the midst of all Yashar’el, because he has given of his seed to Moloch, and wrought impiously so as to defile it.

verses.raw: And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) and exhort them not to give their daughters to the nations, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the nations, for this is abominable before Yahuah (God). For this reason I have written for you in the words of the Law all the deeds of the Shechemites, which they wrought against Dinah, and how the sons of Jacob spake, saying: “We shall not give our daughter to a man who is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach to us.”
verses.text: And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar’el and exhort them not to give their daughters to the nations, and not to take for their sons any of the daughters of the nations, for this is abominable before Yahuah. For this reason I have written for you in the words of the Law all the deeds of the Shechemites, which they wrought against Dinah, and how the sons of Jacob spake, saying: “We shall not give our daughter to a man who is uncircumcised; for that were a reproach to us.”

verses.raw: And it is a reproach to Yashar’el (Israel), to those who give, and to those who take the daughters of the nations; for this is unclean and abominable to Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And it is a reproach to Yashar’el, to those who give, and to those who take the daughters of the nations; for this is unclean and abominable to Yashar’el.

verses.raw: And Yashar’el (Israel) will not be free from this uncleanness if it has a wife of the daughters of the nations, or has given any of its daughters to a man who is of any of the nations.
verses.text: And Yashar’el will not be free from this uncleanness if it has a wife of the daughters of the nations, or has given any of its daughters to a man who is of any of the nations.

verses.raw: For there will be plague upon plague, and curse upon curse, and every judgment and plague and curse will come (upon him): if he do this thing, or hide his eyes from those who commit uncleanness, or those who defile the sanctuary of Yahuah (God), or those who profane His holy name, (then) will the whole nation together be judged for all the uncleanness and profanation of this (man).
verses.text: For there will be plague upon plague, and curse upon curse, and every judgment and plague and curse will come (upon him): if he do this thing, or hide his eyes from those who commit uncleanness, or those who defile the sanctuary of Yahuah, or those who profane His holy name, (then) will the whole nation together be judged for all the uncleanness and profanation of this (man).

verses.raw: And there will be no respect of persons and no consideration of persons, and no receiving at his hands of fruits and offerings and burnt-offerings and fat, nor the fragrance of sweet savour, so as to accept it: and so fare every man or woman in Yashar’el (Israel) who defiles the sanctuary. For this reason I have commanded you, saying: "Testify this testimony to Yashar’el (Israel): see how the Shechemites fared and their sons: how they were delivered into the hands of two sons of Jacob, and they slew them under tortures, and it was (reckoned) to them for righteousness, and it is written down to them for righteousness.
verses.text: And there will be no respect of persons and no consideration of persons, and no receiving at his hands of fruits and offerings and burnt-offerings and fat, nor the fragrance of sweet savour, so as to accept it: and so fare every man or woman in Yashar’el who defiles the sanctuary. For this reason I have commanded you, saying: "Testify this testimony to Yashar’el: see how the Shechemites fared and their sons: how they were delivered into the hands of two sons of Jacob, and they slew them under tortures, and it was (reckoned) to them for righteousness, and it is written down to them for righteousness.

verses.raw: And the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood, and to be Levites, that they might minister before Yahuah (God), as we, continually, and that Levi and his sons may be blessed for ever; for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment and vengeance on all those who arose against Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And the seed of Levi was chosen for the priesthood, and to be Levites, that they might minister before Yahuah, as we, continually, and that Levi and his sons may be blessed for ever; for he was zealous to execute righteousness and judgment and vengeance on all those who arose against Yashar’el.

verses.raw: And so they inscribe as a testimony in his favour on the heavenly tables blessing and righteousness before the Elohim (God) of all:
verses.text: And so they inscribe as a testimony in his favour on the heavenly tables blessing and righteousness before the Elohim of all:

verses.raw: And we remember the righteousness which the man fulfilled during his life, at all periods of the year; until a thousand generations they will record it, and it will come to him and to his descendants after him, and he has been recorded on the heavenly tables as a friend and a righteous man.
verses.text: And we remember the righteousness which the man fulfilled during his life, at all periods of the year; until a thousand generations they will record it, and it will come to him and to his descendants after him, and he has been recorded on the heavenly tables as a friend and a righteous man.

verses.raw: All this account I have written for you, and have commanded you to say to the children of Yashar’el (Israel), that they should not commit sin nor transgress the ordinances nor break the covenant which has been ordained for them, (but) that they should fulfil it and be recorded as friends. But if they transgress and work uncleanness in every way, they will be recorded on the heavenly tables as adversaries, and they will be destroyed out of the book of life, and they will be recorded in the book of those who will be destroyed and with those who will be rooted out of the earth.
verses.text: All this account I have written for you, and have commanded you to say to the children of Yashar’el, that they should not commit sin nor transgress the ordinances nor break the covenant which has been ordained for them, (but) that they should fulfil it and be recorded as friends. But if they transgress and work uncleanness in every way, they will be recorded on the heavenly tables as adversaries, and they will be destroyed out of the book of life, and they will be recorded in the book of those who will be destroyed and with those who will be rooted out of the earth.

verses.raw: And on the day when the sons of Jacob slew Shechem a writing was recorded in their favour in heaven that they had executed righteousness and uprightness and vengeance on the sinners, and it was written for a blessing.
verses.text: And on the day when the sons of Jacob slew Shechem a writing was recorded in their favour in heaven that they had executed righteousness and uprightness and vengeance on the sinners, and it was written for a blessing.

verses.raw: And they brought Dinah, their sister, out of the house of Shechem, and they took captive everything that was in Shechem, their sheep and their oxen and their asses, and all their wealth, and all their flocks, and brought them all to Jacob their father.
verses.text: And they brought Dinah, their sister, out of the house of Shechem, and they took captive everything that was in Shechem, their sheep and their oxen and their asses, and all their wealth, and all their flocks, and brought them all to Jacob their father.

verses.raw: And he reproached them because they had put the city to the sword; for he feared those who dwelt in the land, the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.text: And he reproached them because they had put the city to the sword; for he feared those who dwelt in the land, the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.raw: And the dread of Yahuah (God) was upon all the cities which are around about Shechem, and they did not rise to pursue after the sons of Jacob; for terror had fallen upon them.
verses.text: And the dread of Yahuah was upon all the cities which are around about Shechem, and they did not rise to pursue after the sons of Jacob; for terror had fallen upon them.

verses.raw: And on the new moon of the month Jacob spake to all the people of his house, saying: “Purify yourselves and change your garments, and let us arise and go up to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled from the face of Esau my brother, because He has been with me and brought me into this land in peace, and put you away the strange gods that are among you.”
verses.text: And on the new moon of the month Jacob spake to all the people of his house, saying: “Purify yourselves and change your garments, and let us arise and go up to Bethel, where I vowed a vow to Him on the day when I fled from the face of Esau my brother, because He has been with me and brought me into this land in peace, and put you away the strange gods that are among you.”

verses.raw: And they gave up the strange gods and that which was in their ears and which was on their necks, and the idols which Rachel stole from Laban her brother she gave wholly to Jacob. And he burnt and brake them to pieces and destroyed them, and hid them under an oak which is in the land of Shechem.
verses.text: And they gave up the strange gods and that which was in their ears and which was on their necks, and the idols which Rachel stole from Laban her brother she gave wholly to Jacob. And he burnt and brake them to pieces and destroyed them, and hid them under an oak which is in the land of Shechem.

verses.raw: And he went up on the new moon of the seventh month to Bethel. And he built an altar at the place where he had slept, and he set up a pillar there, and he sent word to his father Isaac to come to him to his sacrifice, and to his mother Rebecca. And Isaac said: “Let my son Jacob come, and let me see him before I die.”
verses.text: And he went up on the new moon of the seventh month to Bethel. And he built an altar at the place where he had slept, and he set up a pillar there, and he sent word to his father Isaac to come to him to his sacrifice, and to his mother Rebecca. And Isaac said: “Let my son Jacob come, and let me see him before I die.”

verses.raw: And Jacob went to his father Isaac and to his mother Rebecca, to the house of his father Abraham, and he took two of his sons with him, Levi and Yahudah (Judah), and he came to his father Isaac and to his mother Rebecca.
verses.text: And Jacob went to his father Isaac and to his mother Rebecca, to the house of his father Abraham, and he took two of his sons with him, Levi and Yahudah, and he came to his father Isaac and to his mother Rebecca.

verses.raw: And Rebecca came forth from the tower to the front of it to kiss Jacob and embrace him; for her spirit had revived when she heard: “Behold Jacob your son has come”; and she kissed him.
verses.text: And Rebecca came forth from the tower to the front of it to kiss Jacob and embrace him; for her spirit had revived when she heard: “Behold Jacob your son has come”; and she kissed him.

verses.raw: And she saw his two sons, and she recognised them, and said to him: “Are these your sons, my son?” and she embraced them and kissed them, and blessed them, saying: “In you shall the seed of Abraham become illustrious, and you will prove a blessing on the earth.”
verses.text: And she saw his two sons, and she recognised them, and said to him: “Are these your sons, my son?” and she embraced them and kissed them, and blessed them, saying: “In you shall the seed of Abraham become illustrious, and you will prove a blessing on the earth.”

verses.raw: And Jacob went in to Isaac his father, to the chamber where he lay, and his two sons were with him, and he took the hand of his father, and stooping down he kissed him, and Isaac clung to the neck of Jacob his son, and wept upon his neck. And the darkness left the eyes of Isaac, and he saw the two sons of Jacob, Levi and Yahudah (Judah), and he said: “Are these your sons, my son? for they are like you.”
verses.text: And Jacob went in to Isaac his father, to the chamber where he lay, and his two sons were with him, and he took the hand of his father, and stooping down he kissed him, and Isaac clung to the neck of Jacob his son, and wept upon his neck. And the darkness left the eyes of Isaac, and he saw the two sons of Jacob, Levi and Yahudah, and he said: “Are these your sons, my son? for they are like you.”

verses.raw: And he said to him that they were truly his sons: “And you have truly seen that they are truly my sons.”
verses.text: And he said to him that they were truly his sons: “And you have truly seen that they are truly my sons.”

verses.raw: And they came near to him, and he turned and kissed them and embraced them both together.
verses.text: And they came near to him, and he turned and kissed them and embraced them both together.

verses.raw: And the spirit of prophecy came down into his mouth, and he took Levi by his right hand and Yahudah (Judah) by his left.
verses.text: And the spirit of prophecy came down into his mouth, and he took Levi by his right hand and Yahudah by his left.

verses.raw: And he turned to Levi first, and began to bless him first, and said to him:, ’May the Elohim (God) of all, the very Yahuah (God) of all the ages, bless you and your children throughout all the ages. And may Yahuah (God) give to you and to your seed greatness and great glory, and cause you and your seed, from among all flesh, to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary as the angels of the presence and as the holy ones. (Even) as they, will the seed of your sons be for glory and greatness and holiness, and may He make them great to all the ages.
verses.text: And he turned to Levi first, and began to bless him first, and said to him:, ’May the Elohim of all, the very Yahuah of all the ages, bless you and your children throughout all the ages. And may Yahuah give to you and to your seed greatness and great glory, and cause you and your seed, from among all flesh, to approach Him to serve in His sanctuary as the angels of the presence and as the holy ones. (Even) as they, will the seed of your sons be for glory and greatness and holiness, and may He make them great to all the ages.

verses.raw: And they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob; They will speak the word of Yahuah (God) in righteousness, And they will judge all His judgments in righteousness. And they will declare My ways to Jacob And My paths to Yashar’el (Israel). The blessing of Yahuah (God) will be given in their mouths To bless all the seed of the beloved.
verses.text: And they will be princes and judges, and chiefs of all the seed of the sons of Jacob; They will speak the word of Yahuah in righteousness, And they will judge all His judgments in righteousness. And they will declare My ways to Jacob And My paths to Yashar’el. The blessing of Yahuah will be given in their mouths To bless all the seed of the beloved.

verses.raw: Your mother has called your name Levi, And justly has she called your name; You will be joined to Yahuah (God) And be the companion of all the sons of Jacob; Let His table be your, And do you and your sons eat thereof; And may your table be full to all generations, And your food fail not to all the ages.
verses.text: Your mother has called your name Levi, And justly has she called your name; You will be joined to Yahuah And be the companion of all the sons of Jacob; Let His table be your, And do you and your sons eat thereof; And may your table be full to all generations, And your food fail not to all the ages.

verses.raw: And let all who hate you fall down before you, And let all your adversaries be rooted out and perish; And blessed be he that blesses you, And cursed be every nation that curses you.
verses.text: And let all who hate you fall down before you, And let all your adversaries be rooted out and perish; And blessed be he that blesses you, And cursed be every nation that curses you.

verses.raw: And to Yahudah (Judah) he said: May Yahuah (God) give you strength and power To tread down all that hate you; A prince shall you be, you and one of your sons, over the sons of Jacob; May your name and the name of your sons go forth and traverse every land and region. Then will the nations fear before your face, And all the nations will quake And all the peoples will quake. In you shall be the help of Jacob, And in you be found the salvation of Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And to Yahudah he said: May Yahuah give you strength and power To tread down all that hate you; A prince shall you be, you and one of your sons, over the sons of Jacob; May your name and the name of your sons go forth and traverse every land and region. Then will the nations fear before your face, And all the nations will quake And all the peoples will quake. In you shall be the help of Jacob, And in you be found the salvation of Yashar’el.

verses.raw: And when you sit on the throne of the honour of your righteousness, There will be great peace for all the seed of the sons of the beloved, And blessed will he be that blesses you; And all that hate you and afflict you and curse you Shall be rooted out and destroyed from the earth and accursed." And turning he kissed him again and embraced him, and rejoiced greatly; for he had seen the sons of Jacob his son in very truth.
verses.text: And when you sit on the throne of the honour of your righteousness, There will be great peace for all the seed of the sons of the beloved, And blessed will he be that blesses you; And all that hate you and afflict you and curse you Shall be rooted out and destroyed from the earth and accursed." And turning he kissed him again and embraced him, and rejoiced greatly; for he had seen the sons of Jacob his son in very truth.

verses.raw: And he went forth from between his feet and fell down and worshipped him. And he blessed them. And (Jacob) rested there with Isaac his father that night, and they ate and drank with joy.
verses.text: And he went forth from between his feet and fell down and worshipped him. And he blessed them. And rested there with Isaac his father that night, and they ate and drank with joy.

verses.raw: And he made the two sons of Jacob sleep, the one on his right hand and the other on his left and it was counted to him for righteousness.
verses.text: And he made the two sons of Jacob sleep, the one on his right hand and the other on his left and it was counted to him for righteousness.

verses.raw: And Jacob told his father everything during the night, how Yahuah (God) had shown him great mercy, and how He had prospered (him in) all his ways, and protected him from all evil.
verses.text: And Jacob told his father everything during the night, how Yahuah had shown him great mercy, and how He had prospered (him in) all his ways, and protected him from all evil.

verses.raw: And Isaac blessed the Elohim (God) of his father Abraham, who had not withdrawn His mercy and His righteousness from the sons of His servant Isaac. And in the morning Jacob told his father Isaac the vow which he had vowed to Yahuah (God), and the vision which he had seen, and that he had built an altar, and that everything was ready for the sacrifice to be made before Yahuah (God) as he had vowed, and that he had come to set him on an ass.
verses.text: And Isaac blessed the Elohim of his father Abraham, who had not withdrawn His mercy and His righteousness from the sons of His servant Isaac. And in the morning Jacob told his father Isaac the vow which he had vowed to Yahuah, and the vision which he had seen, and that he had built an altar, and that everything was ready for the sacrifice to be made before Yahuah as he had vowed, and that he had come to set him on an ass.

verses.raw: And Isaac said to Jacob his son: “I am not able to go with you; for I am old, and not able to bear the way: go, my son, in peace; for I am one hundred and sixty-five years this day; I am no longer able to journey, set your mother (on an ass) and let her go with you.
verses.text: And Isaac said to Jacob his son: “I am not able to go with you; for I am old, and not able to bear the way: go, my son, in peace; for I am one hundred and sixty-five years this day; I am no longer able to journey, set your mother (on an ass) and let her go with you.

verses.raw: And I know, my son, that you have come on my account, and may this day be blessed on which you have seen me alive, and I also have seen you, my son.
verses.text: And I know, my son, that you have come on my account, and may this day be blessed on which you have seen me alive, and I also have seen you, my son.

verses.raw: May you prosper and fulfil the vow which you have vowed, and put not off your vow; for you will be called to account as touching the vow; now therefore make haste to perform it, and may He be pleased who has made all things, to whom you have vowed the vow.”
verses.text: May you prosper and fulfil the vow which you have vowed, and put not off your vow; for you will be called to account as touching the vow; now therefore make haste to perform it, and may He be pleased who has made all things, to whom you have vowed the vow.”

verses.raw: And he said to Rebecca: “Go with Jacob your son”; and Rebecca went with Jacob her son, and Deborah with her, and they came to Bethel. And Jacob remembered the prayer with which his father had blessed him and his two sons, Levi and Yahudah (Judah), and he rejoiced and blessed the Elohim (God) of his fathers, Abraham and Isaac.
verses.text: And he said to Rebecca: “Go with Jacob your son”; and Rebecca went with Jacob her son, and Deborah with her, and they came to Bethel. And Jacob remembered the prayer with which his father had blessed him and his two sons, Levi and Yahudah, and he rejoiced and blessed the Elohim of his fathers, Abraham and Isaac.

verses.raw: And he said: “Now I know that I have an eternal hope, and my sons also, before the Elohim (God) of all;” and thus is it ordained concerning the two; and they record it as an eternal testimony to them on the heavenly tables how Isaac blessed them.
verses.text: And he said: “Now I know that I have an eternal hope, and my sons also, before the Elohim of all;” and thus is it ordained concerning the two; and they record it as an eternal testimony to them on the heavenly tables how Isaac blessed them.

verses.raw: And he abode that night at Bethel, and Levi dreamed that they had ordained and made him the priest of the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God), him and his sons for ever; and he awoke from his sleep and blessed Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And he abode that night at Bethel, and Levi dreamed that they had ordained and made him the priest of the El Elyon Elohim, him and his sons for ever; and he awoke from his sleep and blessed Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Jacob rose early in the morning, on the fourteenth of this month, and he gave a tithe of all that came with him, both of men and cattle, both of gold and every vessel and garment, yea, he gave tithes of all.
verses.text: And Jacob rose early in the morning, on the fourteenth of this month, and he gave a tithe of all that came with him, both of men and cattle, both of gold and every vessel and garment, yea, he gave tithes of all.

verses.raw: And in those days Rachel became pregnant with her son Benjamin. And Jacob counted his sons from him upwards and Levi fell to the portion of Yahuah (God), and his father clothed him in the garments of the priesthood and filled his hands.
verses.text: And in those days Rachel became pregnant with her son Benjamin. And Jacob counted his sons from him upwards and Levi fell to the portion of Yahuah, and his father clothed him in the garments of the priesthood and filled his hands.

verses.raw: And on the fifteenth of this month, he brought to the altar fourteen oxen from amongst the cattle, and twenty-eight rams, and forty-nine sheep, and seven lambs, and twenty-one kids of the goats as a burnt-offering on the altar of sacrifice, well pleasing for a sweet savour before Elohim (God).
verses.text: And on the fifteenth of this month, he brought to the altar fourteen oxen from amongst the cattle, and twenty-eight rams, and forty-nine sheep, and seven lambs, and twenty-one kids of the goats as a burnt-offering on the altar of sacrifice, well pleasing for a sweet savour before Elohim.

verses.raw: This was his offering, in consequence of the vow which he had vowed that he would give a tenth, with their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings.
verses.text: This was his offering, in consequence of the vow which he had vowed that he would give a tenth, with their fruit-offerings and their drink-offerings.

verses.raw: And when the fire had consumed it, he burnt incense on the fire over the fire, and for a thank-offering two oxen and four rams and four sheep, four he-goats, and two sheep of a year old, and two kids of the goats; and thus he did daily for seven days. And he and all his sons and his men were eating (this) with joy there during seven days and blessing and thanking Yahuah (God), who had delivered him out of all his tribulation and had given him his vow.
verses.text: And when the fire had consumed it, he burnt incense on the fire over the fire, and for a thank-offering two oxen and four rams and four sheep, four he-goats, and two sheep of a year old, and two kids of the goats; and thus he did daily for seven days. And he and all his sons and his men were eating (this) with joy there during seven days and blessing and thanking Yahuah, who had delivered him out of all his tribulation and had given him his vow.

verses.raw: And he tithed all the clean animals, and made a burnt sacrifice, but the unclean animals he gave (not) to Levi his son, and he gave him all the souls of the men.
verses.text: And he tithed all the clean animals, and made a burnt sacrifice, but the unclean animals he gave (not) to Levi his son, and he gave him all the souls of the men.

verses.raw: And Levi discharged the priestly office at Bethel before Jacob his father in preference to his ten brothers, and he was a priest there, and Jacob gave his vow: thus he tithed again the tithe to Yahuah (God) and sanctified it, and it became holy to Him.
verses.text: And Levi discharged the priestly office at Bethel before Jacob his father in preference to his ten brothers, and he was a priest there, and Jacob gave his vow: thus he tithed again the tithe to Yahuah and sanctified it, and it became holy to Him.

verses.raw: And for this reason it is ordained on the heavenly tables as a law for the tithing again the tithe to eat before Yahuah (God) from year to year, in the place where it is chosen that His name should dwell, and to this law there is no limit of days for ever.
verses.text: And for this reason it is ordained on the heavenly tables as a law for the tithing again the tithe to eat before Yahuah from year to year, in the place where it is chosen that His name should dwell, and to this law there is no limit of days for ever.

verses.raw: This ordinance is written that it may be fulfilled from year to year in eating the second tithe before Yahuah (God) in the place where it has been chosen, and nothing shall remain over from it from this year to the year following. For in its year shall the seed be eaten till the days of the gathering of the seed of the year, and the wine till the days of the wine, and the oil till the days of its season.
verses.text: This ordinance is written that it may be fulfilled from year to year in eating the second tithe before Yahuah in the place where it has been chosen, and nothing shall remain over from it from this year to the year following. For in its year shall the seed be eaten till the days of the gathering of the seed of the year, and the wine till the days of the wine, and the oil till the days of its season.

verses.raw: And all that is left thereof and becomes old, let it be regarded as polluted: let it be burnt with fire, for it is unclean.
verses.text: And all that is left thereof and becomes old, let it be regarded as polluted: let it be burnt with fire, for it is unclean.

verses.raw: And thus let them eat it together in the sanctuary, and let them not suffer it to become old.
verses.text: And thus let them eat it together in the sanctuary, and let them not suffer it to become old.

verses.raw: And all the tithes of the oxen and sheep shall be holy to Yahuah (God), and shall belong to His priests, which they will eat before Him from year to year; for thus is it ordained and engraven regarding the tithe on the heavenly tables. And on the following night, on the twenty-second day of this month, Jacob resolved to build that place, and to surround the court with a wall, and to sanctify it and make it holy for ever, for himself and his children after him.
verses.text: And all the tithes of the oxen and sheep shall be holy to Yahuah, and shall belong to His priests, which they will eat before Him from year to year; for thus is it ordained and engraven regarding the tithe on the heavenly tables. And on the following night, on the twenty-second day of this month, Jacob resolved to build that place, and to surround the court with a wall, and to sanctify it and make it holy for ever, for himself and his children after him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) appeared to him by night and blessed him and said to him: “Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Yashar’el (Israel) shall they name your name.”
verses.text: And Yahuah appeared to him by night and blessed him and said to him: “Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Yashar’el shall they name your name.”

verses.raw: And He said to him again: “I am Yahuah (God) who created the heaven and the earth, and I shall increase you and multiply you exceedingly, and kings will come forth from you, and they will judge everywhere wherever the foot of the sons of men has trodden.
verses.text: And He said to him again: “I am Yahuah who created the heaven and the earth, and I shall increase you and multiply you exceedingly, and kings will come forth from you, and they will judge everywhere wherever the foot of the sons of men has trodden.

verses.raw: Ana I shall give to your seed all the earth which is under heaven, and they will judge all the nations according to their desires, and after that they will get possession of the whole earth and inherit it for ever.”
verses.text: Ana I shall give to your seed all the earth which is under heaven, and they will judge all the nations according to their desires, and after that they will get possession of the whole earth and inherit it for ever.”

verses.raw: And He finished speaking with him, and He went up from him, and Jacob looked till He had ascended into heaven. And he saw in a vision of the night, and behold an angel descended from heaven with seven tablets in his hands, and he gave them to Jacob, and he read them and knew all that was written therein which would befall him and his sons through- out all the ages.
verses.text: And He finished speaking with him, and He went up from him, and Jacob looked till He had ascended into heaven. And he saw in a vision of the night, and behold an angel descended from heaven with seven tablets in his hands, and he gave them to Jacob, and he read them and knew all that was written therein which would befall him and his sons through- out all the ages.

verses.raw: And he showed him all that was written on the tablets, and said to him: “Do not build this place, and do not make it an eternal sanctuary, and do not dwell here; for this is not the place. Go to the house of Abraham your father and dwell with Isaac your father until the day of the death of your father.
verses.text: And he showed him all that was written on the tablets, and said to him: “Do not build this place, and do not make it an eternal sanctuary, and do not dwell here; for this is not the place. Go to the house of Abraham your father and dwell with Isaac your father until the day of the death of your father.

verses.raw: For in Egypt you will die in peace, and in this land you will be buried with honour in the sepulchre of your fathers, with Abraham and Isaac.
verses.text: For in Egypt you will die in peace, and in this land you will be buried with honour in the sepulchre of your fathers, with Abraham and Isaac.

verses.raw: Fear not, for as you have seen and read it, thus will. it all be; and do you write down everything as you have seen and read.”
verses.text: Fear not, for as you have seen and read it, thus will. it all be; and do you write down everything as you have seen and read.”

verses.raw: And Jacob said: “Yahuah (God), how can I remember all that I have read and seen?” And he said to him: “I will bring all things to your remembrance.” And he went up from him, and he awoke from his sleep, and he remembered everything which he had read and seen, and he wrote down all the words which he had read and seen.
verses.text: And Jacob said: “Yahuah, how can I remember all that I have read and seen?” And he said to him: “I will bring all things to your remembrance.” And he went up from him, and he awoke from his sleep, and he remembered everything which he had read and seen, and he wrote down all the words which he had read and seen.

verses.raw: And he celebrated there yet another day, and he sacrificed thereon according to all that he sacrificed on the former days, and called its name “Addition,” for this day was added, and the former days he called “The Feast.”
verses.text: And he celebrated there yet another day, and he sacrificed thereon according to all that he sacrificed on the former days, and called its name “Addition,” for this day was added, and the former days he called “The Feast.”

verses.raw: And thus it was manifested that it should be, and it is written on the heavenly tables: wherefore it was revealed to him that he should celebrate it, and add it to the seven days of the feast.
verses.text: And thus it was manifested that it should be, and it is written on the heavenly tables: wherefore it was revealed to him that he should celebrate it, and add it to the seven days of the feast.

verses.raw: And its name was called “Addition,” because that it was recorded amongst the days of the feast days, according to the number of the days of the year.
verses.text: And its name was called “Addition,” because that it was recorded amongst the days of the feast days, according to the number of the days of the year.

verses.raw: And in the night, on the twenty-third of this month, Deborah Rebecca’s nurse died, and they buried her beneath the city under the oak of the river, and he called the name of this place, “The river of Deborah,” and the oak, “The oak of the mourning of Deborah.” And Rebecca went and returned to her house to his father Isaac, and Jacob sent by her hand rams and sheep and he-goats that she should prepare a meal for his father such as he desired.
verses.text: And in the night, on the twenty-third of this month, Deborah Rebecca’s nurse died, and they buried her beneath the city under the oak of the river, and he called the name of this place, “The river of Deborah,” and the oak, “The oak of the mourning of Deborah.” And Rebecca went and returned to her house to his father Isaac, and Jacob sent by her hand rams and sheep and he-goats that she should prepare a meal for his father such as he desired.

verses.raw: And he went after his mother till he came to the land of Kabrâtân, and he dwelt there.
verses.text: And he went after his mother till he came to the land of Kabrâtân, and he dwelt there.

verses.raw: And Rachel bare a son in the night, and called his name “Son of my sorrow”; for she suffered in giving him birth: but his father called his name Benjamin, on the eleventh of the eighth month in the first of the sixth week of this jubilee.
verses.text: And Rachel bare a son in the night, and called his name “Son of my sorrow”; for she suffered in giving him birth: but his father called his name Benjamin, on the eleventh of the eighth month in the first of the sixth week of this jubilee.

verses.raw: And Rachel died there and she was buried in the land of Ephrath, the same is Bethlehem, and Jacob built a pillar on the grave of Rachel, on the road above her grave.
verses.text: And Rachel died there and she was buried in the land of Ephrath, the same is Bethlehem, and Jacob built a pillar on the grave of Rachel, on the road above her grave.

verses.raw: And Jacob went and dwelt to the south of Magdalâdrâ’êf. And he went to his father Isaac, he and Leah his wife, on the new moon of the tenth month.
verses.text: And Jacob went and dwelt to the south of Magdalâdrâ’êf. And he went to his father Isaac, he and Leah his wife, on the new moon of the tenth month.

verses.raw: And Reuben saw Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, the concubine of his father, bathing in water in a secret place, and he loved her.
verses.text: And Reuben saw Bilhah, Rachel’s maid, the concubine of his father, bathing in water in a secret place, and he loved her.

verses.raw: And he hid himself at night, and he entered the house of Bilhah at night, and he found her sleeping alone on a bed in her house.
verses.text: And he hid himself at night, and he entered the house of Bilhah at night, and he found her sleeping alone on a bed in her house.

verses.raw: And he lay with her, and she awoke and saw, and behold Reuben was lying with her in the bed, and she uncovered the border of her covering and seized him, and cried out, and discovered that it was Reuben.
verses.text: And he lay with her, and she awoke and saw, and behold Reuben was lying with her in the bed, and she uncovered the border of her covering and seized him, and cried out, and discovered that it was Reuben.

verses.raw: And she was ashamed because of him, and released her hand from him, and he fled.
verses.text: And she was ashamed because of him, and released her hand from him, and he fled.

verses.raw: And she lamented because of this thing exceedingly, and did not tell it to any one. And when Jacob returned and sought her, she said to him: “I am not clean for you, for I have been defiled as regards you; for Reuben has defiled me, and has lain with me in the night, and I was asleep, and did not discover until he uncovered my skirt and slept with me.”
verses.text: And she lamented because of this thing exceedingly, and did not tell it to any one. And when Jacob returned and sought her, she said to him: “I am not clean for you, for I have been defiled as regards you; for Reuben has defiled me, and has lain with me in the night, and I was asleep, and did not discover until he uncovered my skirt and slept with me.”

verses.raw: And Jacob was exceedingly wroth with Reuben because he had lain with Bilhah, because he had uncovered his father’s skirt.
verses.text: And Jacob was exceedingly wroth with Reuben because he had lain with Bilhah, because he had uncovered his father’s skirt.

verses.raw: And Jacob did not approach her again because Reuben had defiled her. And as for any man who uncovers his father’s skirt his deed is wicked exceedingly, for he is abominable before Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And Jacob did not approach her again because Reuben had defiled her. And as for any man who uncovers his father’s skirt his deed is wicked exceedingly, for he is abominable before Yahuah.

verses.raw: For this reason it is written and ordained on the heavenly tables that a man should not lie with his father’s wife, and should not uncover his father’s skirt, for this is unclean: they shall surely die together, the man who lies with his father’s wife and the woman also, for they have wrought uncleanness on the earth.
verses.text: For this reason it is written and ordained on the heavenly tables that a man should not lie with his father’s wife, and should not uncover his father’s skirt, for this is unclean: they shall surely die together, the man who lies with his father’s wife and the woman also, for they have wrought uncleanness on the earth.

verses.raw: And there shall be nothing unclean before our Elohim (God) in the nation which He has chosen for Himself as a possession. And again, it is written a second time: “Cursed he be who lies with the wife of his father, for he has uncovered his father’s shame”; and all the holy ones of Yahuah (God) said “So be it; so be it.”
verses.text: And there shall be nothing unclean before our Elohim in the nation which He has chosen for Himself as a possession. And again, it is written a second time: “Cursed he be who lies with the wife of his father, for he has uncovered his father’s shame”; and all the holy ones of Yahuah said “So be it; so be it.”

verses.raw: And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) that they observe this word; for it (entails) a punishment of death; and it is unclean, and there is no atonement for ever to atone for the man who has committed this, but he is to be put to death and slain, and stoned with stones, and rooted out from the midst of the people of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar’el that they observe this word; for it (entails) a punishment of death; and it is unclean, and there is no atonement for ever to atone for the man who has committed this, but he is to be put to death and slain, and stoned with stones, and rooted out from the midst of the people of our Elohim.

verses.raw: For to no man who does so in Yashar’el (Israel) is it permitted to remain alive a single day on the earth, for he is abominable and unclean.
verses.text: For to no man who does so in Yashar’el is it permitted to remain alive a single day on the earth, for he is abominable and unclean.

verses.raw: And let them not say: to Reuben was granted life and forgiveness after he had lain with his father’s concubine, and to her also though she had a husband, and her husband Jacob, his father, was still alive.
verses.text: And let them not say: to Reuben was granted life and forgiveness after he had lain with his father’s concubine, and to her also though she had a husband, and her husband Jacob, his father, was still alive.

verses.raw: For until that time there had not been revealed the ordinance and judgment and law in its completeness for all, but in your days (it has been revealed) as a law of seasons and of days, and an everlasting law for the everlasting generations. And for this law there is no consummation of days, and no atonement for it, but they must both be rooted out in the midst of the nation: on the day whereon they committed it they shall slay them.
verses.text: For until that time there had not been revealed the ordinance and judgment and law in its completeness for all, but in your days (it has been revealed) as a law of seasons and of days, and an everlasting law for the everlasting generations. And for this law there is no consummation of days, and no atonement for it, but they must both be rooted out in the midst of the nation: on the day whereon they committed it they shall slay them.

verses.raw: And do you, Moses, write (it) down for Yashar’el (Israel) that they may observe it, and do according to these words, and not commit a sin to death; for Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) is judge, who respects not persons and accepts not gifts.
verses.text: And do you, Moses, write (it) down for Yashar’el that they may observe it, and do according to these words, and not commit a sin to death; for Yahuah our Elohim is judge, who respects not persons and accepts not gifts.

verses.raw: And tell them these words of the covenant, that they may hear and observe, and be on their guard with respect to them, and not be destroyed and rooted out of the land; for an uncleanness, and an abomination, and a contamination, and a pollution are all they who commit it on the earth before our Elohim (God).
verses.text: And tell them these words of the covenant, that they may hear and observe, and be on their guard with respect to them, and not be destroyed and rooted out of the land; for an uncleanness, and an abomination, and a contamination, and a pollution are all they who commit it on the earth before our Elohim.

verses.raw: And there is no greater sin than the fornication which they commit on earth; for Yashar’el (Israel) is a holy nation to Yahuah (God) its Elohim (God), and a nation of inheritance, and a priestly and royal nation and for (His own) possession; and there shall no such uncleanness appear in the midst of the holy nation. And in the third year of this sixth week Jacob and all his sons went and dwelt in the house of Abraham, near Isaac his father and Rebecca his mother.
verses.text: And there is no greater sin than the fornication which they commit on earth; for Yashar’el is a holy nation to Yahuah its Elohim, and a nation of inheritance, and a priestly and royal nation and for (His own) possession; and there shall no such uncleanness appear in the midst of the holy nation. And in the third year of this sixth week Jacob and all his sons went and dwelt in the house of Abraham, near Isaac his father and Rebecca his mother.

verses.raw: And these were the names of the sons of Jacob: the first-born Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Yahudah (Judah), Issachar, Zebulon, the sons of Leah; and the sons of Rachel, Joseph and Benjamin; and the sons of Bilhah, Dan and Naphtali, and the sons of Zilpah, Gad and Asher; and Dinah, the daughter of Leah, the only daughter of Jacob.
verses.text: And these were the names of the sons of Jacob: the first-born Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Yahudah, Issachar, Zebulon, the sons of Leah; and the sons of Rachel, Joseph and Benjamin; and the sons of Bilhah, Dan and Naphtali, and the sons of Zilpah, Gad and Asher; and Dinah, the daughter of Leah, the only daughter of Jacob.

verses.raw: And they came and bowed themselves to Isaac and Rebecca, and when they saw them they blessed Jacob and all his sons, and Isaac rejoiced exceedingly, for he saw the sons of Jacob, his younger son, and he blessed them.
verses.text: And they came and bowed themselves to Isaac and Rebecca, and when they saw them they blessed Jacob and all his sons, and Isaac rejoiced exceedingly, for he saw the sons of Jacob, his younger son, and he blessed them.

verses.raw: And in the sixth year of this week of this forty-fourth jubilee Jacob sent his sons to pasture their sheep, and his servants with them, to the pastures of Shechem.
verses.text: And in the sixth year of this week of this forty-fourth jubilee Jacob sent his sons to pasture their sheep, and his servants with them, to the pastures of Shechem.

verses.raw: And the seven kings of the Amorites assembled themselves together against them, to slay them, hiding themselves under the trees, and to take their cattle as a prey.
verses.text: And the seven kings of the Amorites assembled themselves together against them, to slay them, hiding themselves under the trees, and to take their cattle as a prey.

verses.raw: And Jacob and Levi and Yahudah (Judah) and Joseph were in the house with Isaac their father; for his spirit was sorrowful, and they could not leave him: and Benjamin was the youngest, and for this reason remained with his father.
verses.text: And Jacob and Levi and Yahudah and Joseph were in the house with Isaac their father; for his spirit was sorrowful, and they could not leave him: and Benjamin was the youngest, and for this reason remained with his father.

verses.raw: And there came the kings of Tâphû, and the kings of ’Arêsa, and the kings of Sêragân, and the kings of Sêlô, and the kings of Gâ’as, and the king of Bêthôrôn, and the king of Ma’anîsâkîr, and all those who dwell in these mountains (and) who dwell in the woods in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And there came the kings of Tâphû, and the kings of ’Arêsa, and the kings of Sêragân, and the kings of Sêlô, and the kings of Gâ’as, and the king of Bêthôrôn, and the king of Ma’anîsâkîr, and all those who dwell in these mountains (and) who dwell in the woods in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And they announced this to Jacob saying: “Behold, the kings of the Amorites have surrounded your sons, and plundered their herds.”
verses.text: And they announced this to Jacob saying: “Behold, the kings of the Amorites have surrounded your sons, and plundered their herds.”

verses.raw: And he arose from his housel he and his three sons and all the servants of his father, and his own servants, and he went against them with six thousand men, who carried swords. And he slew them in the pastures of Shechem, and pursued those who fled, and he slew them with the edge of the sword, and he slew ’Arêsa and Tâphû and Sarêgân and Sêlô and ’Amânîsakîr and Gâgâ’as, and he recovered his herds.
verses.text: And he arose from his housel he and his three sons and all the servants of his father, and his own servants, and he went against them with six thousand men, who carried swords. And he slew them in the pastures of Shechem, and pursued those who fled, and he slew them with the edge of the sword, and he slew ’Arêsa and Tâphû and Sarêgân and Sêlô and ’Amânîsakîr and Gâgâ’as, and he recovered his herds.

verses.raw: And he prevailed over them, and imposed tribute on them that they should pay him tribute, five fruit products of their land, and he built Rôbêl and Tamnâtârês
verses.text: And he prevailed over them, and imposed tribute on them that they should pay him tribute, five fruit products of their land, and he built Rôbêl and Tamnâtârês

verses.raw: And he returned in peace, and made peace with them, and they became his servants, until the day that he and his sons went down into Egypt.
verses.text: And he returned in peace, and made peace with them, and they became his servants, until the day that he and his sons went down into Egypt.

verses.raw: And in the seventh year of this week he sent Joseph to learn about the welfare of his brothers from his house to the land of Shechem, and he found them in the land of Dothan.
verses.text: And in the seventh year of this week he sent Joseph to learn about the welfare of his brothers from his house to the land of Shechem, and he found them in the land of Dothan.

verses.raw: And they dealt treacherously with him, and formed a plot against him to slay him, but changing their minds, they sold him to Ishmaelite merchants, and they brought him down into Egypt, and they sold him to Potiphar, the eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the cooks, priest of the city of ’Êlêw. And the sons of Jacob slaughtered a kid, and dipped the coat of Joseph in the blood, and sent (it) to Jacob their father on the tenth of the seventh month.
verses.text: And they dealt treacherously with him, and formed a plot against him to slay him, but changing their minds, they sold him to Ishmaelite merchants, and they brought him down into Egypt, and they sold him to Potiphar, the eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the cooks, priest of the city of ’Êlêw. And the sons of Jacob slaughtered a kid, and dipped the coat of Joseph in the blood, and sent (it) to Jacob their father on the tenth of the seventh month.

verses.raw: And he mourned all that night, for they had brought it to him in the evening, and he became feverish with mourning for his death, and he said: “An evil beast has devoured Joseph”; and all the members of his house mourned with him that day, and they were grieving and mourning with him all that day.
verses.text: And he mourned all that night, for they had brought it to him in the evening, and he became feverish with mourning for his death, and he said: “An evil beast has devoured Joseph”; and all the members of his house mourned with him that day, and they were grieving and mourning with him all that day.

verses.raw: And his sons and his daughter rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted for his son.
verses.text: And his sons and his daughter rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted for his son.

verses.raw: And on that day Bilhah heard that Joseph had perished, and she died mourning him, and she was living in Qafrâtêf and Dinah also, his daughter, died after Joseph had perished. And there came these three mournings upon Yashar’el (Israel) in one month.
verses.text: And on that day Bilhah heard that Joseph had perished, and she died mourning him, and she was living in Qafrâtêf and Dinah also, his daughter, died after Joseph had perished. And there came these three mournings upon Yashar’el in one month.

verses.raw: And they buried Bilhah over against the tomb of Rachel, and Dinah also, his daughter, they buried there. And he mourned for Joseph one year, and did not cease, for he said “Let me go down to the grave mourning for my son.”
verses.text: And they buried Bilhah over against the tomb of Rachel, and Dinah also, his daughter, they buried there. And he mourned for Joseph one year, and did not cease, for he said “Let me go down to the grave mourning for my son.”

verses.raw: For this reason it is ordained for the children of Yashar’el (Israel) that they should afflict themselves on the tenth of the seventh month–on the day that the news which made him weep for Joseph came to Jacob his father–that they should make atonement for themselves thereon with a young goat on the tenth of the seventh month, once a year, for their sins; for they had grieved the affection of their father regarding Joseph his son.
verses.text: For this reason it is ordained for the children of Yashar’el that they should afflict themselves on the tenth of the seventh month–on the day that the news which made him weep for Joseph came to Jacob his father–that they should make atonement for themselves thereon with a young goat on the tenth of the seventh month, once a year, for their sins; for they had grieved the affection of their father regarding Joseph his son.

verses.raw: And this day has been ordained that they should grieve thereon for their sins, and for all their transgressions and for all their errors, so that they might cleanse themselves on that day once a year. And after Joseph perished, the sons of Jacob took to themselves wives. The name of Reuben’s wife is ’Adâ and the name of Simeon’s wife is ’Adîbâ’a, a Canaanite; and the name of Levi’s wife is Mêlkâ, of the daughters of Aram, of the seed of the sons of Terah; and the name of Yahudah’s (Judah’s) wife, Bêtasû’êl, a Canaanite; and the name of Issachar’s wife, Hêzaqâ; and the name of Zebulon’s wife, Nî’îmân; and the name of Dan’s wife, ’Êglâ; and the name of Naphtali’s wife, Rasû’û, of Mesopotamia; and the name of Gad’s wife, Mâka; and the name of Asher’s wife, ’Îjônâ; and the name of Joseph’s wife, Asenath, the Egyptian; and the name of Benjamin’s wife, ’Îjasaka.

verses.raw: And Simeon repented, and took a second wife from Mesopotamia as his brothers.
