verses.text: And Simeon repented, and took a second wife from Mesopotamia as his brothers.

verses.raw: And in the first year of the first week of the forty-fifth jubilee Rebecca called Jacob, her son, and commanded him regarding his father and regarding his brother, that he should honour them all the days of his life.
verses.text: And in the first year of the first week of the forty-fifth jubilee Rebecca called Jacob, her son, and commanded him regarding his father and regarding his brother, that he should honour them all the days of his life.

verses.raw: And Jacob said: “I will do everything as you have commanded me; for this thing will be honour and greatness to me, and righteousness before Yahuah (God), that I should honour them.
verses.text: And Jacob said: “I will do everything as you have commanded me; for this thing will be honour and greatness to me, and righteousness before Yahuah, that I should honour them.

verses.raw: And you too, mother, know from the time I was born until this day, all my deeds and all that is in my heart, that I always think good concerning all.
verses.text: And you too, mother, know from the time I was born until this day, all my deeds and all that is in my heart, that I always think good concerning all.

verses.raw: And how should I not do this thing which you have commanded me, that I should honour my father and my brother!
verses.text: And how should I not do this thing which you have commanded me, that I should honour my father and my brother!

verses.raw: Tell me, mother, what perversity have you seen in me and I shall turn away from it, and mercy will be upon me.”
verses.text: Tell me, mother, what perversity have you seen in me and I shall turn away from it, and mercy will be upon me.”

verses.raw: And she said to him: “My son, I have not seen in you all my days any perverse but (only) upright deeds. And yet I shall tell you the truth, my son: I shall die this, year, and I shall not survive this year in my life; for I have seen in a dream the day of my death, that I should not live beyond a hundred and fifty-five years: and behold I have completed all the days of my life which I am to live.” And Jacob laughed at the words of his mother, because his mother had said to him that she should die; and she was sitting opposite to him in possession of her strength, and she was not infirm in her strength; for she went in and out and saw, and her teeth were strong, and no ailment had touched her all the days of her life.
verses.text: And she said to him: “My son, I have not seen in you all my days any perverse but (only) upright deeds. And yet I shall tell you the truth, my son: I shall die this, year, and I shall not survive this year in my life; for I have seen in a dream the day of my death, that I should not live beyond a hundred and fifty-five years: and behold I have completed all the days of my life which I am to live.” And Jacob laughed at the words of his mother, because his mother had said to him that she should die; and she was sitting opposite to him in possession of her strength, and she was not infirm in her strength; for she went in and out and saw, and her teeth were strong, and no ailment had touched her all the days of her life.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to her: “Blessed am I, mother, if my days approach the days of your life, and my strength remain with me thus as your strength: and you will not die, for you are jesting idly with me regarding your death.”
verses.text: And Jacob said to her: “Blessed am I, mother, if my days approach the days of your life, and my strength remain with me thus as your strength: and you will not die, for you are jesting idly with me regarding your death.”

verses.raw: And she went in to Isaac and said to him: "One petition I make to you: make Esau swear that he will not injure Jacob, nor pursue him with enmity; for you know Esau’s thoughts that they are perverse from his youth, and there is no goodness in him; for he desires after your death to kill him.
verses.text: And she went in to Isaac and said to him: "One petition I make to you: make Esau swear that he will not injure Jacob, nor pursue him with enmity; for you know Esau’s thoughts that they are perverse from his youth, and there is no goodness in him; for he desires after your death to kill him.

verses.raw: And you know all that he has done since the day Jacob his brother went to Haran until this day; how he has forsaken us with his whole heart, and has done evil to us; your flocks he has taken to himself, and carried off all your possessions from before your face.
verses.text: And you know all that he has done since the day Jacob his brother went to Haran until this day; how he has forsaken us with his whole heart, and has done evil to us; your flocks he has taken to himself, and carried off all your possessions from before your face.

verses.raw: And when we implored and besought him for what was our own, he did as a man who was taking pity on us. And he is bitter against you because you did bless Jacob your perfect and upright son; for there is no evil but only goodness in him, and since he came from Haran to this day he has not robbed us of aught, for he brings us everything in its season always, and rejoices with all his heart when we take at his hands, and he blesses us, and has not parted from us since he came from Haran until this day, and he remains with us continually at home honouring us."
verses.text: And when we implored and besought him for what was our own, he did as a man who was taking pity on us. And he is bitter against you because you did bless Jacob your perfect and upright son; for there is no evil but only goodness in him, and since he came from Haran to this day he has not robbed us of aught, for he brings us everything in its season always, and rejoices with all his heart when we take at his hands, and he blesses us, and has not parted from us since he came from Haran until this day, and he remains with us continually at home honouring us."

verses.raw: And Isaac said to her: "I, too, know and see the deeds of Jacob who is with us, how that with all his heart he honours us; but I loved Esau formerly more than Jacob, because he was the first-born; but now I love Jacob more than Esau, for he has done manifold evil deeds, and there is no righteousness in him, for all his ways are unrighteousness and violence, and there is no righteousness around him.
verses.text: And Isaac said to her: "I, too, know and see the deeds of Jacob who is with us, how that with all his heart he honours us; but I loved Esau formerly more than Jacob, because he was the first-born; but now I love Jacob more than Esau, for he has done manifold evil deeds, and there is no righteousness in him, for all his ways are unrighteousness and violence, and there is no righteousness around him.

verses.raw: And now my heart is troubled because of all his deeds, and neither he nor his seed is to be saved, for they are those who will be destroyed from the earth, and who will be rooted out from under heaven, for he has forsaken the Elohim (God) of Abraham and gone after his wives and after their uncleanness and after their error, he and his children.
verses.text: And now my heart is troubled because of all his deeds, and neither he nor his seed is to be saved, for they are those who will be destroyed from the earth, and who will be rooted out from under heaven, for he has forsaken the Elohim of Abraham and gone after his wives and after their uncleanness and after their error, he and his children.

verses.raw: And you do bid me make him swear that he will not slay Jacob, his brother; even if he swear he will not abide by his oath, and he will not do good but evil only.
verses.text: And you do bid me make him swear that he will not slay Jacob, his brother; even if he swear he will not abide by his oath, and he will not do good but evil only.

verses.raw: But if he desires to slay Jacob, his brother, into Jacob’s hands will he be given, and he will not escape from his hands, for he will descend into his hands. And fear you not on account of Jacob; for the guardian of Jacob is great and powerful and honoured, and praised more than the guardian of Esau."
verses.text: But if he desires to slay Jacob, his brother, into Jacob’s hands will he be given, and he will not escape from his hands, for he will descend into his hands. And fear you not on account of Jacob; for the guardian of Jacob is great and powerful and honoured, and praised more than the guardian of Esau."

verses.raw: And Rebecca sent and called Esau, and he came to her, and she said to him: “I have a petition, my son, to make to you, and do you promise to do it, my son.”
verses.text: And Rebecca sent and called Esau, and he came to her, and she said to him: “I have a petition, my son, to make to you, and do you promise to do it, my son.”

verses.raw: And he said: “I will do everything that you say to me, and I will not refuse your petition.”
verses.text: And he said: “I will do everything that you say to me, and I will not refuse your petition.”

verses.raw: And she said to him: “I ask you that the day I die, you will take me in and bury me near Sarah, your father’s mother, and that you and Jacob will love each other, and that neither will desire evil against the other, but mutual love only, and (so) you will prosper, my sons, and be honoured in the midst of the land, and no enemy will rejoice over you, and you will be a blessing and a mercy in the eyes of all those that love you.”
verses.text: And she said to him: “I ask you that the day I die, you will take me in and bury me near Sarah, your father’s mother, and that you and Jacob will love each other, and that neither will desire evil against the other, but mutual love only, and (so) you will prosper, my sons, and be honoured in the midst of the land, and no enemy will rejoice over you, and you will be a blessing and a mercy in the eyes of all those that love you.”

verses.raw: And he said: "I will do all that you have told me, and I shall bury you on the day you die near Sarah, my father’s mother, as you have desired that her bones may be near your bones. And Jacob, my brother, also, I shall love above all flesh; for I have not a brother in all the earth but him only: and this is no great merit for me if I love him; for he is my brother, and we were sown together in your body, and together came we forth from your womb, and if I do not love my brother, whom shall I love?
verses.text: And he said: "I will do all that you have told me, and I shall bury you on the day you die near Sarah, my father’s mother, as you have desired that her bones may be near your bones. And Jacob, my brother, also, I shall love above all flesh; for I have not a brother in all the earth but him only: and this is no great merit for me if I love him; for he is my brother, and we were sown together in your body, and together came we forth from your womb, and if I do not love my brother, whom shall I love?

verses.raw: And I, myself, beg you to exhort Jacob concerning me and concerning my sons, for I know that he will assuredly be king over me and my sons, for on the day my father blessed him he made him the higher and me the lower.
verses.text: And I, myself, beg you to exhort Jacob concerning me and concerning my sons, for I know that he will assuredly be king over me and my sons, for on the day my father blessed him he made him the higher and me the lower.

verses.raw: And I swear to you that I shall love him, and not desire evil against him all the days of my life but good only." And he sware to her regarding all this matter.
verses.text: And I swear to you that I shall love him, and not desire evil against him all the days of my life but good only." And he sware to her regarding all this matter.

verses.raw: And she called Jacob before the eyes of Esau, and gave him commandment according to the words which she had spoken to Esau.
verses.text: And she called Jacob before the eyes of Esau, and gave him commandment according to the words which she had spoken to Esau.

verses.raw: And he said: “I shall do your pleasure; believe me that no evil will proceed from me or from my sons against Esau, and I shall be first in naught save in love only.” And they ate and drank, she and her sons that night, and she died, three jubilees and one week and one year old, on that night, and her two sons, Esau and Jacob, buried her in the double cave near Sarah, their father’s mother.
verses.text: And he said: “I shall do your pleasure; believe me that no evil will proceed from me or from my sons against Esau, and I shall be first in naught save in love only.” And they ate and drank, she and her sons that night, and she died, three jubilees and one week and one year old, on that night, and her two sons, Esau and Jacob, buried her in the double cave near Sarah, their father’s mother.

verses.raw: And in the sixth year of this week Isaac called his two sons, Esau and Jacob, and they came to him, and he said to them: "My sons, I am going the way of my fathers, to the eternal house where my fathers are.
verses.text: And in the sixth year of this week Isaac called his two sons, Esau and Jacob, and they came to him, and he said to them: "My sons, I am going the way of my fathers, to the eternal house where my fathers are.

verses.raw: Wherefore bury me near Abraham my father, in the double cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite, where Abraham purchased a sepulchre to bury in; in the sepulchre which I digged for myself, there bury me.
verses.text: Wherefore bury me near Abraham my father, in the double cave in the field of Ephron the Hittite, where Abraham purchased a sepulchre to bury in; in the sepulchre which I digged for myself, there bury me.

verses.raw: And this I command you, my sons, that you practise righteousness and uprightness on the earth, so that Yahuah (God) may bring upon you all that Yahuah (God) said that he would do to Abraham and to his seed.
verses.text: And this I command you, my sons, that you practise righteousness and uprightness on the earth, so that Yahuah may bring upon you all that Yahuah said that he would do to Abraham and to his seed.

verses.raw: And love one another, my sons, your brothers as a man who loves his own soul, and let each seek in what he may benefit his brother, and act together on the earth; and let them love each other as their own souls.
verses.text: And love one another, my sons, your brothers as a man who loves his own soul, and let each seek in what he may benefit his brother, and act together on the earth; and let them love each other as their own souls.

verses.raw: And concerning the question of idols, I command and admonish you to reject them and hate them, and love them not; for they are full of deception for those that worship them and for those that bow down to them.
verses.text: And concerning the question of idols, I command and admonish you to reject them and hate them, and love them not; for they are full of deception for those that worship them and for those that bow down to them.

verses.raw: Remember you, my sons, Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Abraham your father, and how I too worshipped Him and served Him in righteousness and in joy, that He might multiply you and increase your seed as the stars of heaven in multitude, and establish you on the earth as the plant of righteousness which will not be rooted out to all the generations for ever. And now I shall make you swear a great oath–for there is no oath which is greater than it by the name glorious and honoured and great and splendid and wonderful and mighty, which created the heavens and the earth and all things together–that you will fear Him and worship Him.
verses.text: Remember you, my sons, Yahuah Elohim of Abraham your father, and how I too worshipped Him and served Him in righteousness and in joy, that He might multiply you and increase your seed as the stars of heaven in multitude, and establish you on the earth as the plant of righteousness which will not be rooted out to all the generations for ever. And now I shall make you swear a great oath–for there is no oath which is greater than it by the name glorious and honoured and great and splendid and wonderful and mighty, which created the heavens and the earth and all things together–that you will fear Him and worship Him.

verses.raw: And that each will love his brother with affection and righteousness, and that neither will desire evil against his brother from henceforth for ever all the days of your life, so that you may prosper in all your deeds and not be destroyed.
verses.text: And that each will love his brother with affection and righteousness, and that neither will desire evil against his brother from henceforth for ever all the days of your life, so that you may prosper in all your deeds and not be destroyed.

verses.raw: And if either of you devises evil against his brother, know that from henceforth every one that devises evil against his brother will fall into his hand, and will be rooted out of the land of the living, and his seed will be destroyed from under heaven.
verses.text: And if either of you devises evil against his brother, know that from henceforth every one that devises evil against his brother will fall into his hand, and will be rooted out of the land of the living, and his seed will be destroyed from under heaven.

verses.raw: But on the day of turbulence and execration and indignation and anger, with flaming devouring fire as He burnt Sodom, so likewise will He burn his land and his city and all that is his, and he will be blotted out of the book of the discipline of the children of men, and not be recorded in the book of life, but in that which is appointed to destruction, and he will depart into eternal execration; so that their condemnation may be always renewed in hate and in execration and in wrath and in torment and in indignation and in plagues and in disease for ever.
verses.text: But on the day of turbulence and execration and indignation and anger, with flaming devouring fire as He burnt Sodom, so likewise will He burn his land and his city and all that is his, and he will be blotted out of the book of the discipline of the children of men, and not be recorded in the book of life, but in that which is appointed to destruction, and he will depart into eternal execration; so that their condemnation may be always renewed in hate and in execration and in wrath and in torment and in indignation and in plagues and in disease for ever.

verses.raw: I say and testify to you, my sons, according to the judgment which will come upon the man who wishes to injure his brother." And he divided all his possessions between the two on that day, and he gave the larger portion to him that was the first-born, and the tower and all that was about it, and all that Abraham possessed at the Well of the Oath.
verses.text: I say and testify to you, my sons, according to the judgment which will come upon the man who wishes to injure his brother." And he divided all his possessions between the two on that day, and he gave the larger portion to him that was the first-born, and the tower and all that was about it, and all that Abraham possessed at the Well of the Oath.

verses.raw: And he said, “This larger portion I shall give to the first-born.”
verses.text: And he said, “This larger portion I shall give to the first-born.”

verses.raw: And Esau said, “I have sold to Jacob and given my birthright to Jacob; to him let it be given, and I have not a single word to say regarding it, for it is his.”
verses.text: And Esau said, “I have sold to Jacob and given my birthright to Jacob; to him let it be given, and I have not a single word to say regarding it, for it is his.”

verses.raw: And Isaac said, “May a blessing rest upon you, my sons, and upon your seed this day, for you have given me rest, and my heart is not pained concerning the birthright, lest you should work wickedness on account of it.
verses.text: And Isaac said, “May a blessing rest upon you, my sons, and upon your seed this day, for you have given me rest, and my heart is not pained concerning the birthright, lest you should work wickedness on account of it.

verses.raw: May the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God) bless the man that works righteousness, him and his seed for ever.” And he ended commanding them and blessing them, and they ate and drank together before him, and he rejoiced because there was one mind between them, and they went forth from him and rested that day and slept.
verses.text: May the El Elyon Elohim bless the man that works righteousness, him and his seed for ever.” And he ended commanding them and blessing them, and they ate and drank together before him, and he rejoiced because there was one mind between them, and they went forth from him and rested that day and slept.

verses.raw: And Isaac slept on his bed that day rejoicing; and he slept the eternal sleep, and died one hundred and eighty years old. He completed twenty-five weeks and five years; and his two sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.text: And Isaac slept on his bed that day rejoicing; and he slept the eternal sleep, and died one hundred and eighty years old. He completed twenty-five weeks and five years; and his two sons Esau and Jacob buried him.

verses.raw: And Esau went to the land of Edom, to the mountains of Seir, and dwelt there.
verses.text: And Esau went to the land of Edom, to the mountains of Seir, and dwelt there.

verses.raw: And Jacob dwelt in the mountains of Hebron, in the tower of the land of the sojournings of his father Abraham, and he worshipped Yahuah (God) with all his heart and according to the visible commands according as He had divided the days of his generations.
verses.text: And Jacob dwelt in the mountains of Hebron, in the tower of the land of the sojournings of his father Abraham, and he worshipped Yahuah with all his heart and according to the visible commands according as He had divided the days of his generations.

verses.raw: And Leah his wife died in the fourth year of the second week of the forty-fifth jubilee, and he buried her in the double cave near Rebecca his mother, to the left of the grave of Sarah, his father’s mother. And all her sons and his sons came to mourn over Leah his wife with him, and to comfort him regarding her, for he was lamenting her.
verses.text: And Leah his wife died in the fourth year of the second week of the forty-fifth jubilee, and he buried her in the double cave near Rebecca his mother, to the left of the grave of Sarah, his father’s mother. And all her sons and his sons came to mourn over Leah his wife with him, and to comfort him regarding her, for he was lamenting her.

verses.raw: For he loved her exceedingly after Rachel her sister died; for she was perfect and upright in all her ways and honoured Jacob, and all the days that she lived with him he did not hear from her mouth a harsh word, for she was gentle and peaceable and upright and honourable.
verses.text: For he loved her exceedingly after Rachel her sister died; for she was perfect and upright in all her ways and honoured Jacob, and all the days that she lived with him he did not hear from her mouth a harsh word, for she was gentle and peaceable and upright and honourable.

verses.raw: And he remembered all her deeds which she had done during her life, and he lamented her exceedingly; for he loved her with all his heart and with all his soul.
verses.text: And he remembered all her deeds which she had done during her life, and he lamented her exceedingly; for he loved her with all his heart and with all his soul.

verses.raw: And on the day that Isaac the father of Jacob and Esau died, the sons of Esau heard that Isaac had given the portion of the elder to his younger son Jacob and they were very angry.
verses.text: And on the day that Isaac the father of Jacob and Esau died, the sons of Esau heard that Isaac had given the portion of the elder to his younger son Jacob and they were very angry.

verses.raw: And they strove with their father, saying: “Why has your father given Jacob the portion of the elder and passed over you, although you are the elder and Jacob the younger?”
verses.text: And they strove with their father, saying: “Why has your father given Jacob the portion of the elder and passed over you, although you are the elder and Jacob the younger?”

verses.raw: And he said to them “Because I sold my birthright to Jacob for a small mess of lentils; and on the day my father sent me to hunt and catch and bring him something that he should eat and bless me, he came with guile and brought my father food and drink, and my father blessed him and put me under his hand.
verses.text: And he said to them “Because I sold my birthright to Jacob for a small mess of lentils; and on the day my father sent me to hunt and catch and bring him something that he should eat and bless me, he came with guile and brought my father food and drink, and my father blessed him and put me under his hand.

verses.raw: And now our father has caused us to swear, me and him, that we shall not mutually devise evil, either against his brother, and that we shall continue in love and in peace each with his brother and not make our ways corrupt.”
verses.text: And now our father has caused us to swear, me and him, that we shall not mutually devise evil, either against his brother, and that we shall continue in love and in peace each with his brother and not make our ways corrupt.”

verses.raw: And they said to him, “We shall not hearken to you to make peace with him; for our strength is greater than his strength, and we are more powerful than he; we shall go against him and slay him, and destroy him and his sons. And if you will not go with us, we shall do hurt to you also.
verses.text: And they said to him, “We shall not hearken to you to make peace with him; for our strength is greater than his strength, and we are more powerful than he; we shall go against him and slay him, and destroy him and his sons. And if you will not go with us, we shall do hurt to you also.

verses.raw: And now hearken to us: Let us send to Aram and Philistia and Moab and Ammon, and let us choose for ourselves chosen men who are ardent for battle, and let us go against him and do battle with him, and let us exterminate him from the earth before he grows strong.” And their father said to them, “Do not go and do not make war with him lest you fall before him.”
verses.text: And now hearken to us: Let us send to Aram and Philistia and Moab and Ammon, and let us choose for ourselves chosen men who are ardent for battle, and let us go against him and do battle with him, and let us exterminate him from the earth before he grows strong.” And their father said to them, “Do not go and do not make war with him lest you fall before him.”

verses.raw: And they said to him, “This too, is exactly your mode of action from your youth until this day, and you are putting your neck under his yoke. We shall not hearken to these words.”
verses.text: And they said to him, “This too, is exactly your mode of action from your youth until this day, and you are putting your neck under his yoke. We shall not hearken to these words.”

verses.raw: And they sent to Aram, and to ’Adurâm to the friend of their father, and they hired along with them one thousand fighting men, chosen men of war.
verses.text: And they sent to Aram, and to ’Adurâm to the friend of their father, and they hired along with them one thousand fighting men, chosen men of war.

verses.raw: And there came to them from Moab and from the children of Ammon, those who were hired, one thousand chosen men, and from Philistia, one thousand chosen men of war, and from Edom and from the Horites one thousand chosen fighting men, and from the Kittim mighty men of war.
verses.text: And there came to them from Moab and from the children of Ammon, those who were hired, one thousand chosen men, and from Philistia, one thousand chosen men of war, and from Edom and from the Horites one thousand chosen fighting men, and from the Kittim mighty men of war.

verses.raw: And they said to their father: “Go forth with them and lead them, else we shall slay you.” And he was filled with wrath and indignation on seeing that his sons were forcing him to go before (them) to lead them against Jacob his brother.
verses.text: And they said to their father: “Go forth with them and lead them, else we shall slay you.” And he was filled with wrath and indignation on seeing that his sons were forcing him to go before (them) to lead them against Jacob his brother.

verses.raw: But afterward he remembered all the evil which lay hidden in his heart against Jacob his brother; and he remembered not the oath which he had sworn to his father and to his mother that he would devise no evil all his days against Jacob his brother.
verses.text: But afterward he remembered all the evil which lay hidden in his heart against Jacob his brother; and he remembered not the oath which he had sworn to his father and to his mother that he would devise no evil all his days against Jacob his brother.

verses.raw: And notwithstanding all this, Jacob knew not that they were coming against him to battle, and he was mourning for Leah, his wife, until they approached very near to the tower with four thousand warriors and chosen men of war.
verses.text: And notwithstanding all this, Jacob knew not that they were coming against him to battle, and he was mourning for Leah, his wife, until they approached very near to the tower with four thousand warriors and chosen men of war.

verses.raw: And the men of Hebron sent to him saying, “Behold your brother has come against you, to fight you, with four thousand girt with the sword, and they carry shields and weapons”; for they loved Jacob more than Esau. So they told him; for Jacob was a more liberal and merciful man than Esau.
verses.text: And the men of Hebron sent to him saying, “Behold your brother has come against you, to fight you, with four thousand girt with the sword, and they carry shields and weapons”; for they loved Jacob more than Esau. So they told him; for Jacob was a more liberal and merciful man than Esau.

verses.raw: But Jacob would not believe until they came very near to the tower. And he closed the gates of the tower; and he stood on the battlements and spake to his brother Esau and said, “Noble is the comfort wherewith you have come to comfort me for my wife who has died. Is this the oath that you did swear to your father and again to your mother before they died? You have broken the oath, and on the moment that you did swear to your father were you condemned.”
verses.text: But Jacob would not believe until they came very near to the tower. And he closed the gates of the tower; and he stood on the battlements and spake to his brother Esau and said, “Noble is the comfort wherewith you have come to comfort me for my wife who has died. Is this the oath that you did swear to your father and again to your mother before they died? You have broken the oath, and on the moment that you did swear to your father were you condemned.”

verses.raw: And then Esau answered and said to him, "Neither the children of men nor the beasts of the earth have any oath of righteousness which in swearing they have sworn (an oath valid) for ever; but every day they devise evil one against another, and how each may slay his adversary and foe.
verses.text: And then Esau answered and said to him, "Neither the children of men nor the beasts of the earth have any oath of righteousness which in swearing they have sworn (an oath valid) for ever; but every day they devise evil one against another, and how each may slay his adversary and foe.

verses.raw: And you do hate me and my children for ever. And there is no observing the tie of brotherhood with you.
verses.text: And you do hate me and my children for ever. And there is no observing the tie of brotherhood with you.

verses.raw: Hear these words which I declare to you, If the boar can change its skin and make its bristles as soft as wool, Or if it can cause horns to sprout forth on its head like the horns of a stag or of a sheep, Then shall I observe the tie of brotherhood with you. And if the breasts separated themselves from their mother; for you have not been a brother to me.
verses.text: Hear these words which I declare to you, If the boar can change its skin and make its bristles as soft as wool, Or if it can cause horns to sprout forth on its head like the horns of a stag or of a sheep, Then shall I observe the tie of brotherhood with you. And if the breasts separated themselves from their mother; for you have not been a brother to me.

verses.raw: And if the wolves make peace with the lambs so as not to devour or do them violence, And if their hearts are towards them for good, Then there will be peace in my heart towards you. And if the lion becomes the friend of the ox and makes peace with him, And if he is bound under one yoke with him and ploughs with him, Then shall I make peace with you.
verses.text: And if the wolves make peace with the lambs so as not to devour or do them violence, And if their hearts are towards them for good, Then there will be peace in my heart towards you. And if the lion becomes the friend of the ox and makes peace with him, And if he is bound under one yoke with him and ploughs with him, Then shall I make peace with you.

verses.raw: And when the raven becomes white as the râzâ, Then know that -I have loved you And shall make peace with you. You shall be rooted out, And your sons shall be rooted out, And there shall be no peace for you." And when Jacob saw that he was (so) evilly disposed towards him with his heart, and with all his soul as to slay him, and that he had come springing like the wild boar which comes upon the spear that pierces and kills it, and recoils not from it;
verses.text: And when the raven becomes white as the râzâ, Then know that -I have loved you And shall make peace with you. You shall be rooted out, And your sons shall be rooted out, And there shall be no peace for you." And when Jacob saw that he was (so) evilly disposed towards him with his heart, and with all his soul as to slay him, and that he had come springing like the wild boar which comes upon the spear that pierces and kills it, and recoils not from it;

verses.raw: Then he spake to his own and to his servants that they should attack him and all his companions.
verses.text: Then he spake to his own and to his servants that they should attack him and all his companions.

verses.raw: And after that Yahudah (Judah) spake to Jacob, his father, and said to him: “Bend your bow, father, and send forth your arrows and cast down the adversary and slay the enemy; and may you have the power, for we shall not slay your brother, for he is such as you, and he is like you: let us give him (this) honour.”
verses.text: And after that Yahudah spake to Jacob, his father, and said to him: “Bend your bow, father, and send forth your arrows and cast down the adversary and slay the enemy; and may you have the power, for we shall not slay your brother, for he is such as you, and he is like you: let us give him (this) honour.”

verses.raw: Then Jacob bent his bow and sent forth the arrow and struck Esau, his brother, (on his right breast) and slew him.
verses.text: Then Jacob bent his bow and sent forth the arrow and struck Esau, his brother, (on his right breast) and slew him.

verses.raw: And again he sent forth an arrow and struck ’Adôrân the Aramaean, on the left breast, and drove him backward and slew him.
verses.text: And again he sent forth an arrow and struck ’Adôrân the Aramaean, on the left breast, and drove him backward and slew him.

verses.raw: And then went forth the sons of Jacob, they and their servants, dividing themselves into companies on the four sides of the tower.
verses.text: And then went forth the sons of Jacob, they and their servants, dividing themselves into companies on the four sides of the tower.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) went forth in front, and Naphtali and Gad with him and fifty servants with him on the south side of the tower, and they slew all they found before them, and not one individual of them escaped.
verses.text: And Yahudah went forth in front, and Naphtali and Gad with him and fifty servants with him on the south side of the tower, and they slew all they found before them, and not one individual of them escaped.

verses.raw: And Levi and Dan and Asher went forth on the east side of the tower, and fifty (men) with them, and they slew the fighting men of Moab and Ammon. And Reuben and Issachar and Zebulon went forth on the north side of the tower, and fifty men with them, and they slew the fighting men of the Philistines.
verses.text: And Levi and Dan and Asher went forth on the east side of the tower, and fifty (men) with them, and they slew the fighting men of Moab and Ammon. And Reuben and Issachar and Zebulon went forth on the north side of the tower, and fifty men with them, and they slew the fighting men of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And Simeon and Benjamin and Enoch, Reuben’s son, went forth on the west side of the tower, and fifty (men) with them, and they slew of Edom and of the Horites four hundred men, stout warriors; and six hundred fled, and four of the sons of Esau fled with them, and left their father lying slain, as he had fallen on the hill which is in ’Adûrâm.
verses.text: And Simeon and Benjamin and Enoch, Reuben’s son, went forth on the west side of the tower, and fifty (men) with them, and they slew of Edom and of the Horites four hundred men, stout warriors; and six hundred fled, and four of the sons of Esau fled with them, and left their father lying slain, as he had fallen on the hill which is in ’Adûrâm.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob pursued after them to the mountains of Seir. And Jacob buried his brother on the hill which is in ’Adûrâm, and he returned to his house.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob pursued after them to the mountains of Seir. And Jacob buried his brother on the hill which is in ’Adûrâm, and he returned to his house.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob pressed hard upon the sons of Esau in the mountains of Seir, and bowed their necks so that they became servants of the sons of Jacob.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob pressed hard upon the sons of Esau in the mountains of Seir, and bowed their necks so that they became servants of the sons of Jacob.

verses.raw: And they sent to their father (to inquire) whether they should make peace with them or slay them. And Jacob sent word to his sons that they should make peace, and they made peace with them, and placed the yoke of servitude upon them, so that they paid tribute to Jacob and to his sons always.
verses.text: And they sent to their father (to inquire) whether they should make peace with them or slay them. And Jacob sent word to his sons that they should make peace, and they made peace with them, and placed the yoke of servitude upon them, so that they paid tribute to Jacob and to his sons always.

verses.raw: And they continued to pay tribute to Jacob until the day that he went down into Egypt.
verses.text: And they continued to pay tribute to Jacob until the day that he went down into Egypt.

verses.raw: And the sons of Edom have not got quit of the yoke of servitude which the twelve sons of Jacob had imposed on them until this day. And these are the kings that reigned in Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Yashar’el (Israel) until this day in the land of Edom.
verses.text: And the sons of Edom have not got quit of the yoke of servitude which the twelve sons of Jacob had imposed on them until this day. And these are the kings that reigned in Edom before there reigned any king over the children of Yashar’el until this day in the land of Edom.

verses.raw: And Bâlâq, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Danâbâ.
verses.text: And Bâlâq, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Danâbâ.

verses.raw: And Bâlâq died, and Jobab, the son of Zârâ of Bôsêr, reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Bâlâq died, and Jobab, the son of Zârâ of Bôsêr, reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Jobab died, and ’Asâm, of the land of Têmân, reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Jobab died, and ’Asâm, of the land of Têmân, reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And ’Asâm died, and ’Adâth, the son of Barad, who slew Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead, and the name of his city was Avith. And ’Adâth died, and Salman, from ’Amâsêqâ, reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And ’Asâm died, and ’Adâth, the son of Barad, who slew Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead, and the name of his city was Avith. And ’Adâth died, and Salman, from ’Amâsêqâ, reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Salman died, and Saul of Râ’abôth (by the) river, reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Salman died, and Saul of Râ’abôth (by the) river, reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Saul died, and Ba’êlûnân, the son of Achbor, reigned in his stead.
verses.text: And Saul died, and Ba’êlûnân, the son of Achbor, reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And Ba’êlûnân, the son of Achbor, died, and ’Adâth reigned in his stead, and the name of his wife was Maiṭabîth, the daughter of Mâṭarat, the daughter of Mêtabêdzâ’ab.
verses.text: And Ba’êlûnân, the son of Achbor, died, and ’Adâth reigned in his stead, and the name of his wife was Maiṭabîth, the daughter of Mâṭarat, the daughter of Mêtabêdzâ’ab.

verses.raw: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom.
verses.text: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom.

verses.raw: And Jacob dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And Jacob dwelt in the land of his father’s sojournings in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: These are the generations of Jacob. And Joseph was seventeen years old when they took him down into the land of Egypt, and Potiphar, an eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief cook bought him.
verses.text: These are the generations of Jacob. And Joseph was seventeen years old when they took him down into the land of Egypt, and Potiphar, an eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief cook bought him.

verses.raw: And he set Joseph over all his house, and the blessing of Yahuah (God) came upon the house of the Egyptian on account of Joseph, and Yahuah (God) prospered him in all that he did.
verses.text: And he set Joseph over all his house, and the blessing of Yahuah came upon the house of the Egyptian on account of Joseph, and Yahuah prospered him in all that he did.

verses.raw: And the Egyptian committed everything into the hands of Joseph; for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) prospered him in all that he did.
verses.text: And the Egyptian committed everything into the hands of Joseph; for he saw that Yahuah was with him, and that Yahuah prospered him in all that he did.

verses.raw: And Joseph’s appearance was comely and very beautiful was his appearance, and his master’s wife lifted up her eyes and saw Joseph, and she loved him, and besought him to lie with her.
verses.text: And Joseph’s appearance was comely and very beautiful was his appearance, and his master’s wife lifted up her eyes and saw Joseph, and she loved him, and besought him to lie with her.

verses.raw: But he did not surrender his soul, and he remembered Yahuah (God) and the words which Jacob, his father, used to read from amongst the words of Abraham, that no man should commit fornication with a woman who has a husband; that for him the punishment of death has been ordained in the heavens before the El Elyon (Most High) Elohim (God), and the sin will be recorded against him in the eternal books continually before Yahuah (God). And Joseph remembered these words and refused to lie with her.
verses.text: But he did not surrender his soul, and he remembered Yahuah and the words which Jacob, his father, used to read from amongst the words of Abraham, that no man should commit fornication with a woman who has a husband; that for him the punishment of death has been ordained in the heavens before the El Elyon Elohim, and the sin will be recorded against him in the eternal books continually before Yahuah. And Joseph remembered these words and refused to lie with her.

verses.raw: And she besought him for a year, but he refused and would not listen.
verses.text: And she besought him for a year, but he refused and would not listen.

verses.raw: But she embraced him and held him fast in the house in order to force him to lie with her, and closed the doors of the house and held him fast; but he left his garment in her hands and broke through the door and fled without from her presence.
verses.text: But she embraced him and held him fast in the house in order to force him to lie with her, and closed the doors of the house and held him fast; but he left his garment in her hands and broke through the door and fled without from her presence.

verses.raw: And the woman saw that he would not lie with her, and she calumniated him in the presence of his lord, saying: “Your Hebrew servant, whom you love, sought to force me so that he might lie with me; and it came to pass when I lifted up my voice that he fled and left his garment in my hands when I held him, and he brake through the door.”
verses.text: And the woman saw that he would not lie with her, and she calumniated him in the presence of his lord, saying: “Your Hebrew servant, whom you love, sought to force me so that he might lie with me; and it came to pass when I lifted up my voice that he fled and left his garment in my hands when I held him, and he brake through the door.”

verses.raw: And the Egyptian saw the garment of Joseph and the broken door, and heard the words of his wife, and cast Joseph into prison into the place where the prisoners were kept whom the king imprisoned. And he was there in the prison; and Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah (God) was with him, and that Yahuah (God) made all that he did to prosper.
verses.text: And the Egyptian saw the garment of Joseph and the broken door, and heard the words of his wife, and cast Joseph into prison into the place where the prisoners were kept whom the king imprisoned. And he was there in the prison; and Yahuah gave Joseph favour in the sight of the chief of the prison guards and compassion before him, for he saw that Yahuah was with him, and that Yahuah made all that he did to prosper.

verses.raw: And he committed all things into his hands, and the chief of -the prison guards knew of nothing that was with him, for Joseph did everything, and Yahuah (God) perfected it. And he remained there two years. And in those days Pharaoh, king of Egypt, was wroth against his two eunuchs, against the chief butler and against the chief baker, and he put them in ward in the house of the chief cook, in the prison where Joseph was kept.
verses.text: And he committed all things into his hands, and the chief of -the prison guards knew of nothing that was with him, for Joseph did everything, and Yahuah perfected it. And he remained there two years. And in those days Pharaoh, king of Egypt, was wroth against his two eunuchs, against the chief butler and against the chief baker, and he put them in ward in the house of the chief cook, in the prison where Joseph was kept.

verses.raw: And the chief of the prison guards appointed Joseph to serve them; and he served before them.
verses.text: And the chief of the prison guards appointed Joseph to serve them; and he served before them.

verses.raw: And they both dreamed a dream, the chief butler and the chief baker, and they told it to Joseph.
verses.text: And they both dreamed a dream, the chief butler and the chief baker, and they told it to Joseph.

verses.raw: And as he interpreted to them so it befell them, and Pharaoh restored the chief butler to his office, and the (chief) baker he slew, as Joseph had interpreted to them.
verses.text: And as he interpreted to them so it befell them, and Pharaoh restored the chief butler to his office, and the (chief) baker he slew, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

verses.raw: But the chief butler forgot Joseph in the prison, although he had informed him what would befall him, and did not remember to inform Pharaoh how Joseph had told him for he forgot.
verses.text: But the chief butler forgot Joseph in the prison, although he had informed him what would befall him, and did not remember to inform Pharaoh how Joseph had told him for he forgot.

verses.raw: And in those days Pharaoh dreamed two dreams in one night concerning a famine which was to be in all the land, and he awoke from his sleep and called all the interpreters of dreams that were in Egypt, and magicians, and told them his two dreams, and they were not able to declare (them).
verses.text: And in those days Pharaoh dreamed two dreams in one night concerning a famine which was to be in all the land, and he awoke from his sleep and called all the interpreters of dreams that were in Egypt, and magicians, and told them his two dreams, and they were not able to declare (them).

verses.raw: And then the chief butler remembered Joseph and spake of him to the king, and he brought him forth from the prison, and he told his two dreams before him.
verses.text: And then the chief butler remembered Joseph and spake of him to the king, and he brought him forth from the prison, and he told his two dreams before him.

verses.raw: And he said before Pharaoh that his two dreams were one, and he said to him: “Seven years will come (in which there will be) plenty over all the land of Egypt, and after that seven years of famine, such a famine as has not been in all the land.
verses.text: And he said before Pharaoh that his two dreams were one, and he said to him: “Seven years will come (in which there will be) plenty over all the land of Egypt, and after that seven years of famine, such a famine as has not been in all the land.

verses.raw: And now let Pharaoh appoint overseers in all the land of Egypt, and let them store up food in every city throughout the days of the years of plenty, and there will be food for the seven years of famine, and the land will not perish through the famine, for it will be very severe.”
verses.text: And now let Pharaoh appoint overseers in all the land of Egypt, and let them store up food in every city throughout the days of the years of plenty, and there will be food for the seven years of famine, and the land will not perish through the famine, for it will be very severe.”

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) gave Joseph favour and mercy in the eyes of Pharaoh, and Pharaoh said to his servants: “We shall not find such a wise and discreet man as this man, for the spirit of Yahuah (God) is with him.”
verses.text: And Yahuah gave Joseph favour and mercy in the eyes of Pharaoh, and Pharaoh said to his servants: “We shall not find such a wise and discreet man as this man, for the spirit of Yahuah is with him.”

verses.raw: And he appointed him the second in all his kingdom and gave him authority over all Egypt, and caused him to ride in the second chariot of Pharaoh. And he clothed him with byssus garments, and he put a gold chain upon his neck, and (a herald) proclaimed before him “’Êl ’Êl wa’ Abîrĕr,” and he placed a ring on his hand and made him ruler over all his house, and magnified him, and said to him: “Only on the throne shall I be greater than you.”
verses.text: And he appointed him the second in all his kingdom and gave him authority over all Egypt, and caused him to ride in the second chariot of Pharaoh. And he clothed him with byssus garments, and he put a gold chain upon his neck, and (a herald) proclaimed before him “’Êl ’Êl wa’ Abîrĕr,” and he placed a ring on his hand and made him ruler over all his house, and magnified him, and said to him: “Only on the throne shall I be greater than you.”

verses.raw: And Joseph ruled over all the land of Egypt, and all the princes of Pharaoh, and all his servants, and all who did the king’s business loved him, for he walked in uprightness, for he was without pride and arrogance, and he had no respect of persons, and did not accept gifts, but he judged in uprightness all the people of the land.
verses.text: And Joseph ruled over all the land of Egypt, and all the princes of Pharaoh, and all his servants, and all who did the king’s business loved him, for he walked in uprightness, for he was without pride and arrogance, and he had no respect of persons, and did not accept gifts, but he judged in uprightness all the people of the land.

verses.raw: And the land of Egypt was at peace before Pharaoh because of Joseph, for Yahuah (God) was with him, and gave him favour and mercy for all his generations before all those who knew him and those who heard concerning him, and Pharaoh’s kingdom was well ordered, and there was no Satan 1 and no evil person (therein).
verses.text: And the land of Egypt was at peace before Pharaoh because of Joseph, for Yahuah was with him, and gave him favour and mercy for all his generations before all those who knew him and those who heard concerning him, and Pharaoh’s kingdom was well ordered, and there was no Satan 1 and no evil person (therein).

verses.raw: And the king called Joseph’s name Sĕphânṭîphâns, 2 and gave Joseph to wife the daughter of Potiphar, the daughter of the priest of Heliopolis, the chief cook. 3 11. And on the day that Joseph stood before Pharaoh he was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh. And in that year Isaac died. And it came to pass as Joseph had said in the interpretation of his two dreams, according as he had said it, there were seven years of plenty over all the land of Egypt, and the land of Egypt produced abundantly, one measure (producing) eighteen hundred measures.
verses.text: And the king called Joseph’s name Sĕphânṭîphâns, 2 and gave Joseph to wife the daughter of Potiphar, the daughter of the priest of Heliopolis, the chief cook. 3 11. And on the day that Joseph stood before Pharaoh he was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh. And in that year Isaac died. And it came to pass as Joseph had said in the interpretation of his two dreams, according as he had said it, there were seven years of plenty over all the land of Egypt, and the land of Egypt produced abundantly, one measure (producing) eighteen hundred measures.

verses.raw: And Joseph gathered food into every city until they were full of corn until they could no longer count and measure it for its multitude.
verses.text: And Joseph gathered food into every city until they were full of corn until they could no longer count and measure it for its multitude.

verses.raw: And in the forty-fifth jubilee, in the second week, (and) in the second year, Yahudah (Judah) took for his first-born Er, a wife from the daughters of Aram, named Tamar.
verses.text: And in the forty-fifth jubilee, in the second week, (and) in the second year, Yahudah took for his first-born Er, a wife from the daughters of Aram, named Tamar.

verses.raw: But he hated, and did not lie with her, because his mother was of the daughters of Canaan, and he wished to take him a wife of the kinsfolk of his mother, but Yahudah (Judah), his father, would not permit him.
verses.text: But he hated, and did not lie with her, because his mother was of the daughters of Canaan, and he wished to take him a wife of the kinsfolk of his mother, but Yahudah, his father, would not permit him.

verses.raw: And this Er, the first-born of Yahudah (Judah), was wicked, and Yahuah (God) slew him.
verses.text: And this Er, the first-born of Yahudah, was wicked, and Yahuah slew him.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) said to Onan, his brother: “Go in to your brother’s wife and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up seed to your brother.”
verses.text: And Yahudah said to Onan, his brother: “Go in to your brother’s wife and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up seed to your brother.”

verses.raw: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his, (but) his brother’s only, and he went into the house of his brother’s wife, and spilt the seed on the ground, and he was wicked in the eyes of Yahuah (God), and He slew him.
verses.text: And Onan knew that the seed would not be his, (but) his brother’s only, and he went into the house of his brother’s wife, and spilt the seed on the ground, and he was wicked in the eyes of Yahuah, and He slew him.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law: “Remain in your father’s house as a widow till Shelah my son be grown up, and I shall give you to him to wife.” And he grew up; but Bêdsû’êl, the wife of Yahudah (Judah), did not permit her son Shelah to marry. And Bêdsû’êl, the wife of Yahudah (Judah), died in the fifth year of this week.
verses.text: And Yahudah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law: “Remain in your father’s house as a widow till Shelah my son be grown up, and I shall give you to him to wife.” And he grew up; but Bêdsû’êl, the wife of Yahudah, did not permit her son Shelah to marry. And Bêdsû’êl, the wife of Yahudah, died in the fifth year of this week.

verses.raw: And in the sixth year Yahudah (Judah) went up to shear his sheep at Timnah. And they told Tamar: “Behold your father-in-law goes up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
verses.text: And in the sixth year Yahudah went up to shear his sheep at Timnah. And they told Tamar: “Behold your father-in-law goes up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

verses.raw: And she put off her widow’s clothes, and put on a veil, and adorned herself, and sat in the gate adjoining the way to Timnah.
verses.text: And she put off her widow’s clothes, and put on a veil, and adorned herself, and sat in the gate adjoining the way to Timnah.

verses.raw: And as Yahudah (Judah) was going along he found her, and thought her to be an harlot, and he said to her: “Let me come in to you”; and she said to him: “Come in,” and he went in.
verses.text: And as Yahudah was going along he found her, and thought her to be an harlot, and he said to her: “Let me come in to you”; and she said to him: “Come in,” and he went in.

verses.raw: And she said to him: “Give me my hire”; and he said to her: “I have nothing in my hand save my ring that is on my finger, and my necklace, and my staff which is in my hand.” And she said to him: “Give them to me until you do send me my hire”; and he said to her: “I will send to you a kid of the goats”; and he gave them to her, (and he went in to her,) and she conceived by him.
verses.text: And she said to him: “Give me my hire”; and he said to her: “I have nothing in my hand save my ring that is on my finger, and my necklace, and my staff which is in my hand.” And she said to him: “Give them to me until you do send me my hire”; and he said to her: “I will send to you a kid of the goats”; and he gave them to her, (and he went in to her,) and she conceived by him.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) went to his sheep, and she went to her father’s house.
verses.text: And Yahudah went to his sheep, and she went to her father’s house.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) sent a kid of the goats by the hand of his shepherd, an Adullamite, and he found her not; and he asked the people of the place, saying: “Where is the harlot who was here?” And they said to him: “There is no harlot here with us.”
verses.text: And Yahudah sent a kid of the goats by the hand of his shepherd, an Adullamite, and he found her not; and he asked the people of the place, saying: “Where is the harlot who was here?” And they said to him: “There is no harlot here with us.”

verses.raw: And he returned and informed him, and said to him that he had not found her; “I asked the people of the place, and they said to me: ‘There is no harlot here.’” And he said: “Let her keep (them) lest we become a cause of derision.”
verses.text: And he returned and informed him, and said to him that he had not found her; “I asked the people of the place, and they said to me: ‘There is no harlot here.’” And he said: “Let her keep (them) lest we become a cause of derision.”

verses.raw: And when she had completed three months, it was manifest that she was with child, and they told Yahudah (Judah), saying: “Behold Tamar, your daughter-in-law, is with child by whoredom.” And Yahudah (Judah) went to the house of her father, and said to her father and her brothers: “Bring her forth, and let them burn her, for she has wrought uncleanness in Yashar’el (Israel).”
verses.text: And when she had completed three months, it was manifest that she was with child, and they told Yahudah, saying: “Behold Tamar, your daughter-in-law, is with child by whoredom.” And Yahudah went to the house of her father, and said to her father and her brothers: “Bring her forth, and let them burn her, for she has wrought uncleanness in Yashar’el.”

verses.raw: And it came to pass when they brought her forth to bum her that she sent to her father-in-law the ring and the necklace, and the staff, saying: “Discern whose are these, for by him am I with child.”
verses.text: And it came to pass when they brought her forth to bum her that she sent to her father-in-law the ring and the necklace, and the staff, saying: “Discern whose are these, for by him am I with child.”

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged, and said: “Tamar is more righteous than I am. And therefore let them burn her not.”
verses.text: And Yahudah acknowledged, and said: “Tamar is more righteous than I am. And therefore let them burn her not.”

verses.raw: And for that reason she was not given to Shelah, and he did not again approach her.
verses.text: And for that reason she was not given to Shelah, and he did not again approach her.

verses.raw: And after that she bare two sons, Perez and Zerah, in the seventh year of this second week. And thereupon the seven years of fruitfulness were accomplished, of which Joseph spake to Pharaoh.
verses.text: And after that she bare two sons, Perez and Zerah, in the seventh year of this second week. And thereupon the seven years of fruitfulness were accomplished, of which Joseph spake to Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged that the deed which he had done was evil, for he had lain with his daughter-in-law, and he esteemed it hateful in his eyes, and he acknowledged that he had transgressed and gone astray; for he had uncovered the skirt of his son, and he began to lament and to supplicate before Yahuah (God) because of his transgression.
verses.text: And Yahudah acknowledged that the deed which he had done was evil, for he had lain with his daughter-in-law, and he esteemed it hateful in his eyes, and he acknowledged that he had transgressed and gone astray; for he had uncovered the skirt of his son, and he began to lament and to supplicate before Yahuah because of his transgression.

verses.raw: And we told him in a dream that it was forgiven him because he supplicated earnestly, and lamented, and did not again commit it.
verses.text: And we told him in a dream that it was forgiven him because he supplicated earnestly, and lamented, and did not again commit it.

verses.raw: And he received forgiveness because he turned from his sin and from his ignorance, for he transgressed greatly before our Elohim (God); and every one that acts thus, every one who lies with his mother-in-law, let them burn him with fire that he may bum therein, for there is uncleanness and pollution upon them; with fire let them bum them.
verses.text: And he received forgiveness because he turned from his sin and from his ignorance, for he transgressed greatly before our Elohim; and every one that acts thus, every one who lies with his mother-in-law, let them burn him with fire that he may bum therein, for there is uncleanness and pollution upon them; with fire let them bum them.

verses.raw: And do you command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) that there be no uncleanness amongst them, for every one who lies with his daughter-in-law or with his mother-in-law has wrought uncleanness; with fire let them bum the man who has lain with her, and likewise the woman, and He will turn away wrath and punishment from Yashar’el (Israel). And to Yahudah (Judah) we said that his two sons had not lain with her, and for this reason his seed was established for a second generation, and would not be rooted out.
verses.text: And do you command the children of Yashar’el that there be no uncleanness amongst them, for every one who lies with his daughter-in-law or with his mother-in-law has wrought uncleanness; with fire let them bum the man who has lain with her, and likewise the woman, and He will turn away wrath and punishment from Yashar’el. And to Yahudah we said that his two sons had not lain with her, and for this reason his seed was established for a second generation, and would not be rooted out.

verses.raw: For in singleness of eye he had gone and sought for punishment, namely, according to the judgment of Abraham, which he had commanded his sons, Yahudah (Judah) had sought to burn her with fire.
verses.text: For in singleness of eye he had gone and sought for punishment, namely, according to the judgment of Abraham, which he had commanded his sons, Yahudah had sought to burn her with fire.

verses.raw: And in the first year of the third week of the forty-fifth jubilee the famine began to come into the land, and the rain refused to be given to the earth, for none whatever fell.
verses.text: And in the first year of the third week of the forty-fifth jubilee the famine began to come into the land, and the rain refused to be given to the earth, for none whatever fell.

verses.raw: And the earth grew barren, but in the land of Egypt there was food, for Joseph had gathered the seed of the land in the seven years of plenty and had preserved it.
verses.text: And the earth grew barren, but in the land of Egypt there was food, for Joseph had gathered the seed of the land in the seven years of plenty and had preserved it.

verses.raw: And the Egyptians came to Joseph that he might give them food, and he opened the storehouses where was the grain of the first year, and he sold it to the people of the land for gold.
verses.text: And the Egyptians came to Joseph that he might give them food, and he opened the storehouses where was the grain of the first year, and he sold it to the people of the land for gold.

verses.raw: (Now the famine was very sore in the land of Canaan), and Jacob heard that there was food in Egypt, and he sent his ten sons that they should procure food for him in Egypt; but Benjamin he did not send, and (the ten sons of Jacob) arrived (in Egypt) among those that went (there.)
verses.text: (Now the famine was very sore in the land of Canaan), and Jacob heard that there was food in Egypt, and he sent his ten sons that they should procure food for him in Egypt; but Benjamin he did not send, and (the ten sons of Jacob) arrived (in Egypt) among those that went (there.)

verses.raw: And Joseph recognized them, but they did not recognize him, and he spake to them and questioned them, and he said to them: “Are you not spies, and have you not come to explore the approaches of the land?” And he put them in ward.
verses.text: And Joseph recognized them, but they did not recognize him, and he spake to them and questioned them, and he said to them: “Are you not spies, and have you not come to explore the approaches of the land?” And he put them in ward.

verses.raw: And after that he set them free again, and detained Simeon alone and sent off his nine brothers. And he filled their sacks with corn, and he put their gold in their sacks, and they did not know.
verses.text: And after that he set them free again, and detained Simeon alone and sent off his nine brothers. And he filled their sacks with corn, and he put their gold in their sacks, and they did not know.

verses.raw: And he commanded them to bring their younger brother, for they had told him their father was living and their younger brother.
verses.text: And he commanded them to bring their younger brother, for they had told him their father was living and their younger brother.

verses.raw: And they went up from the land of Egypt and they came to the land of Canaan; and they told their father all that had befallen them, and how the lord of the country had spoken roughly to them, and had seized Simeon till they should bring Benjamin.
verses.text: And they went up from the land of Egypt and they came to the land of Canaan; and they told their father all that had befallen them, and how the lord of the country had spoken roughly to them, and had seized Simeon till they should bring Benjamin.

verses.raw: And Jacob said: “Me have you bereaved of my children! Joseph is not and Simeon also is not, and you will take Benjamin away. On me has your wickedness come.”
verses.text: And Jacob said: “Me have you bereaved of my children! Joseph is not and Simeon also is not, and you will take Benjamin away. On me has your wickedness come.”

verses.raw: And he said: “My son will not go down with you lest perchance he fall sick; for their mother gave birth to two sons, and one has perished, and this one also you will take from me. If perchance he took a fever on the road, you would bring down my old age with sorrow to death.” For he saw that their money had been returned to every man in his sack, and for this reason he feared to send him.
verses.text: And he said: “My son will not go down with you lest perchance he fall sick; for their mother gave birth to two sons, and one has perished, and this one also you will take from me. If perchance he took a fever on the road, you would bring down my old age with sorrow to death.” For he saw that their money had been returned to every man in his sack, and for this reason he feared to send him.

verses.raw: And the famine increased and became sore in the land of Canaan, and in all lands save in the land of Egypt, for many of the children of the Egyptians had stored up their seed for food from the time when they saw Joseph gathering seed together and putting it in storehouses and preserving it for the years of famine.
verses.text: And the famine increased and became sore in the land of Canaan, and in all lands save in the land of Egypt, for many of the children of the Egyptians had stored up their seed for food from the time when they saw Joseph gathering seed together and putting it in storehouses and preserving it for the years of famine.

verses.raw: And the people of Egypt fed themselves thereon during the first year of their famine.
verses.text: And the people of Egypt fed themselves thereon during the first year of their famine.

verses.raw: But when Yashar’el (Israel) saw that the famine was very sore in the land, and there was no deliverance, he said to his sons: “Go again, and procure food for us that we die not.”
verses.text: But when Yashar’el saw that the famine was very sore in the land, and there was no deliverance, he said to his sons: “Go again, and procure food for us that we die not.”

verses.raw: And they said: “We shall not go; unless our youngest brother go with us, we shall not go.” And Yashar’el (Israel) saw that if he did not send him with them, they should all perish by reason of the famine.
verses.text: And they said: “We shall not go; unless our youngest brother go with us, we shall not go.” And Yashar’el saw that if he did not send him with them, they should all perish by reason of the famine.

verses.raw: And Reuben said: “Give him into my hand, and if I do not bring him back to you, slay my two sons instead of his soul.” And he said to him He will not go with you."
verses.text: And Reuben said: “Give him into my hand, and if I do not bring him back to you, slay my two sons instead of his soul.” And he said to him He will not go with you."

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) came near and said: “Send him with me, and if I do not bring him back to you, let me bear the blame before you all the days of my life.”
verses.text: And Yahudah came near and said: “Send him with me, and if I do not bring him back to you, let me bear the blame before you all the days of my life.”

verses.raw: And he sent him with them in the second year of this week on the first day of the month, and they came to the land of Egypt with all those who went, and (they had) presents in their hands, stacte and almonds and terebinth nuts and pure honey.
verses.text: And he sent him with them in the second year of this week on the first day of the month, and they came to the land of Egypt with all those who went, and (they had) presents in their hands, stacte and almonds and terebinth nuts and pure honey.

verses.raw: And they went and stood before Joseph, and he saw Benjamin his brother, and he knew him, and said to them: “Is this your youngest brother?” And they said to him: “It is he.” And he said: “Yahuah (God) be gracious to you, my son!” And he sent him into his house and he brought forth Simeon to them and he made a feast for them, and they presented to him the gift which they had brought in their hands.
verses.text: And they went and stood before Joseph, and he saw Benjamin his brother, and he knew him, and said to them: “Is this your youngest brother?” And they said to him: “It is he.” And he said: “Yahuah be gracious to you, my son!” And he sent him into his house and he brought forth Simeon to them and he made a feast for them, and they presented to him the gift which they had brought in their hands.

verses.raw: And they ate before him and he gave them all a portion, but the portion of Benjamin was seven times larger than that of any of theirs.
verses.text: And they ate before him and he gave them all a portion, but the portion of Benjamin was seven times larger than that of any of theirs.

verses.raw: And they ate and drank and arose and remained with their asses.
verses.text: And they ate and drank and arose and remained with their asses.

verses.raw: And Joseph devised a plan whereby he might learn their thoughts as to whether thoughts of peace prevailed amongst them, and he said to the steward who was over his house: “Fill all their sacks with food, and return their money to them into their vessels, and my cup, the silver cup out of which I drink, put it in the sack of the youngest, and send them away.”
verses.text: And Joseph devised a plan whereby he might learn their thoughts as to whether thoughts of peace prevailed amongst them, and he said to the steward who was over his house: “Fill all their sacks with food, and return their money to them into their vessels, and my cup, the silver cup out of which I drink, put it in the sack of the youngest, and send them away.”

verses.raw: And he did as Joseph had told him, and filled all their sacks for them with food and put their money in their sacks, and put the cup in Benjamin’s sack.
verses.text: And he did as Joseph had told him, and filled all their sacks for them with food and put their money in their sacks, and put the cup in Benjamin’s sack.

verses.raw: And early in the morning they departed, and it came to pass that, when they had gone from thence, Joseph said to the steward of his house: “Pursue them, run and seize them, saying, ‘For good you have requited me with evil; you have stolen from me the silver cup out of which my lord drinks.’ And bring back to me their youngest brother, and fetch (him) quickly before I go forth to my seat of judgment.”
verses.text: And early in the morning they departed, and it came to pass that, when they had gone from thence, Joseph said to the steward of his house: “Pursue them, run and seize them, saying, ‘For good you have requited me with evil; you have stolen from me the silver cup out of which my lord drinks.’ And bring back to me their youngest brother, and fetch (him) quickly before I go forth to my seat of judgment.”

verses.raw: And he ran after them and said to them according to these words.
verses.text: And he ran after them and said to them according to these words.

verses.raw: And they said to him: “Elohim (God) forbid that your servants should do this thing, and steal from the house of your lord any utensil, and the money also which we found in our sacks the first time, we your servants brought back from the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And they said to him: “Elohim forbid that your servants should do this thing, and steal from the house of your lord any utensil, and the money also which we found in our sacks the first time, we your servants brought back from the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: How then should we steal any utensil? Behold here are we and our sacks; search, and wherever you find the cup in the sack of any man amongst us, let him be slain, and we and our asses will serve your lord.”
verses.text: How then should we steal any utensil? Behold here are we and our sacks; search, and wherever you find the cup in the sack of any man amongst us, let him be slain, and we and our asses will serve your lord.”

verses.raw: And he said to them: “Not so, the man with whom I find, him only shall I take as a servant, and you will return in peace to your house.” And as he was searching in their vessels, beginning with the eldest and ending with the youngest, it was found in Benjamin’s sack.
verses.text: And he said to them: “Not so, the man with whom I find, him only shall I take as a servant, and you will return in peace to your house.” And as he was searching in their vessels, beginning with the eldest and ending with the youngest, it was found in Benjamin’s sack.

verses.raw: And they rent their garments, and laded their asses, and returned to the city and came to the house of Joseph, and they all bowed themselves on their faces to the ground before him.
verses.text: And they rent their garments, and laded their asses, and returned to the city and came to the house of Joseph, and they all bowed themselves on their faces to the ground before him.

verses.raw: And Joseph said to them: “You have done evil.” And they said: “What shall we say and how shall we defend ourselves? Our lord has discovered the transgression of his servants; behold we are the servants of our lord, and our asses also.”
verses.text: And Joseph said to them: “You have done evil.” And they said: “What shall we say and how shall we defend ourselves? Our lord has discovered the transgression of his servants; behold we are the servants of our lord, and our asses also.”

verses.raw: And Joseph said to them: “I too fear Yahuah (God); as for you, go you to your homes and let your brother be my servant, for you have done evil.. Know you not that a man delights in his cup as I with this cup? And yet you have stolen it from me.”
verses.text: And Joseph said to them: “I too fear Yahuah; as for you, go you to your homes and let your brother be my servant, for you have done evil.. Know you not that a man delights in his cup as I with this cup? And yet you have stolen it from me.”

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) said: "O my lord, let your servant, I pray you, speak a word in my lord’s ear; two brothers did your servant’s mother bear to our father; one went away and was lost, and has not been found, and he alone is left of his mother, and your servant our father loves him, and his life also is bound up with the life of this (lad). And it will come to pass, when we go to your servant our father, and the lad is not with us, that he will die, and we shall bring down our father with sorrow to death.
