verses.text: And Yahudah said: "O my lord, let your servant, I pray you, speak a word in my lord’s ear; two brothers did your servant’s mother bear to our father; one went away and was lost, and has not been found, and he alone is left of his mother, and your servant our father loves him, and his life also is bound up with the life of this (lad). And it will come to pass, when we go to your servant our father, and the lad is not with us, that he will die, and we shall bring down our father with sorrow to death.

verses.raw: Now rather let me, your servant, abide instead of the boy as a bondsman to my lord, and let the lad go with his brethren, for I became surety for him at the hand of your servant our father, and if I do not bring him back, your servant will bear the blame to our father for ever."
verses.text: Now rather let me, your servant, abide instead of the boy as a bondsman to my lord, and let the lad go with his brethren, for I became surety for him at the hand of your servant our father, and if I do not bring him back, your servant will bear the blame to our father for ever."

verses.raw: And Joseph saw that they were all accordant in goodness one with another, and he could not refrain himself, and he told them that he was Joseph.
verses.text: And Joseph saw that they were all accordant in goodness one with another, and he could not refrain himself, and he told them that he was Joseph.

verses.raw: And he conversed with them in the Hebrew tongue and fell on their neck and wept. But they knew him not and they began to weep.
verses.text: And he conversed with them in the Hebrew tongue and fell on their neck and wept. But they knew him not and they began to weep.

verses.raw: And he said to them: "Weep not over me, but hasten and bring my father to me; and you see that it is my mouth that speaks and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see. For behold this is the second year of the famine, and there are still five years without harvest or fruit of trees or ploughing.
verses.text: And he said to them: "Weep not over me, but hasten and bring my father to me; and you see that it is my mouth that speaks and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see. For behold this is the second year of the famine, and there are still five years without harvest or fruit of trees or ploughing.

verses.raw: Come down quickly you and your households, so that you perish not through the famine, and do not be grieved for your possessions, for Yahuah (God) sent me before you to set things in order that many people might live.
verses.text: Come down quickly you and your households, so that you perish not through the famine, and do not be grieved for your possessions, for Yahuah sent me before you to set things in order that many people might live.

verses.raw: And tell my father that I am still alive, and you, behold, you see that Yahuah (God) has made me as a father to Pharaoh, and ruler over his house and over all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And tell my father that I am still alive, and you, behold, you see that Yahuah has made me as a father to Pharaoh, and ruler over his house and over all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And tell my father of all my glory, and all the riches and glory that Yahuah (God) has given Me."
verses.text: And tell my father of all my glory, and all the riches and glory that Yahuah has given Me."

verses.raw: And by the command of the mouth of Pharaoh he gave them chariots and provisions for the way, and he gave them all many-coloured raiment and silver. And to their father he sent raiment and silver and ten asses which carried com, and he sent them away.
verses.text: And by the command of the mouth of Pharaoh he gave them chariots and provisions for the way, and he gave them all many-coloured raiment and silver. And to their father he sent raiment and silver and ten asses which carried com, and he sent them away.

verses.raw: And they went up and told their father that Joseph was alive, and was measuring out corn to all the nations of the earth, and that he was ruler over all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And they went up and told their father that Joseph was alive, and was measuring out corn to all the nations of the earth, and that he was ruler over all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And their father did not believe it, for he was beside himself in his mind; but when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent, the life of his spirit revived, and he said: “It is enough for me if Joseph lives; I will go down and see him before I die.”
verses.text: And their father did not believe it, for he was beside himself in his mind; but when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent, the life of his spirit revived, and he said: “It is enough for me if Joseph lives; I will go down and see him before I die.”

verses.raw: And Yashar’el (Israel) took his journey from Haran from his house on the new moon of the third month, and he went on the way of the Well of the Oath, and he offered a sacrifice to the Elohim (God) of his father Isaac on the seventh of this month.
verses.text: And Yashar’el took his journey from Haran from his house on the new moon of the third month, and he went on the way of the Well of the Oath, and he offered a sacrifice to the Elohim of his father Isaac on the seventh of this month.

verses.raw: And Jacob remembered the dream that he had seen at Bethel, and he feared to go down into Egypt.
verses.text: And Jacob remembered the dream that he had seen at Bethel, and he feared to go down into Egypt.

verses.raw: And while he was thinking of sending word to Joseph to come to him, and that he would not go down, he remained there seven days, if perchance he should see a vision as to whether he should remain or go down.
verses.text: And while he was thinking of sending word to Joseph to come to him, and that he would not go down, he remained there seven days, if perchance he should see a vision as to whether he should remain or go down.

verses.raw: And he celebrated the harvest festival of the first-fruits with old grain, for in all the land of Canaan there was not a handful of seed (in the land), for the famine was over all the beasts and cattle and birds, and also over man.
verses.text: And he celebrated the harvest festival of the first-fruits with old grain, for in all the land of Canaan there was not a handful of seed (in the land), for the famine was over all the beasts and cattle and birds, and also over man.

verses.raw: And on the sixteenth Yahuah (God) appeared to him, and said to him, “Jacob, Jacob”; and he said, “Here am I.” And He said to him: “I am the Elohim (God) of your fathers, the Elohim (God) of Abraham and Isaac; fear not to go down into Egypt, for I will there make of you a great nation.
verses.text: And on the sixteenth Yahuah appeared to him, and said to him, “Jacob, Jacob”; and he said, “Here am I.” And He said to him: “I am the Elohim of your fathers, the Elohim of Abraham and Isaac; fear not to go down into Egypt, for I will there make of you a great nation.

verses.raw: I shall go down with you, and I shall bring you up (again), and in this land will you be buried, and Joseph will put his hands upon your eyes. Fear not; go down into Egypt.” And his sons rose up, and his sons’ sons, and they placed their father and their possessions upon wagons.
verses.text: I shall go down with you, and I shall bring you up (again), and in this land will you be buried, and Joseph will put his hands upon your eyes. Fear not; go down into Egypt.” And his sons rose up, and his sons’ sons, and they placed their father and their possessions upon wagons.

verses.raw: And Yashar’el (Israel) rose up from the Well of the Oath on the sixteenth of this third month, and he went to the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Yashar’el rose up from the Well of the Oath on the sixteenth of this third month, and he went to the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Yashar’el (Israel) sent Yahudah (Judah) before him to his son Joseph to examine the Land of Goshen, for Joseph had told his brothers that they should come and dwell there that they might be near him.
verses.text: And Yashar’el sent Yahudah before him to his son Joseph to examine the Land of Goshen, for Joseph had told his brothers that they should come and dwell there that they might be near him.

verses.raw: And this was the goodliest (land) in the land of Egypt, and near to him, for all (of them) and also for the cattle.
verses.text: And this was the goodliest (land) in the land of Egypt, and near to him, for all (of them) and also for the cattle.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the sons of Jacob who went into Egypt with Jacob their father. Reuben, the first-born of Yashar’el (Israel); and these are the names of his sons: Enoch, and Pallu, and Hezron and Carmi–five.
verses.text: And these are the names of the sons of Jacob who went into Egypt with Jacob their father. Reuben, the first-born of Yashar’el; and these are the names of his sons: Enoch, and Pallu, and Hezron and Carmi–five.

verses.raw: Simeon and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of the Zephathite woman–seven.
verses.text: Simeon and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Jemuel, and Jamin, and Ohad, and Jachin, and Zohar, and Shaul, the son of the Zephathite woman–seven.

verses.raw: Levi and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari–four.
verses.text: Levi and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari–four.

verses.raw: Yahudah (Judah) and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Shela, and Perez, and Zerah–four.
verses.text: Yahudah and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Shela, and Perez, and Zerah–four.

verses.raw: Issachar and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Tola, and Phûa, and Jâsûb, and Shimron–five. Zebulon and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel–four.
verses.text: Issachar and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Tola, and Phûa, and Jâsûb, and Shimron–five. Zebulon and his sons; and these are the names of his sons: Sered, and Elon, and Jahleel–four.

verses.raw: And these are the sons of Jacob, and their sons, whom Leah bore to Jacob in Mesopotamia, six, and their one sister, Dinah: and all the souls of the sons of Leah, and their sons, who went with Jacob their father into Egypt, were twenty-nine, and Jacob their father being with them, they were thirty.
verses.text: And these are the sons of Jacob, and their sons, whom Leah bore to Jacob in Mesopotamia, six, and their one sister, Dinah: and all the souls of the sons of Leah, and their sons, who went with Jacob their father into Egypt, were twenty-nine, and Jacob their father being with them, they were thirty.

verses.raw: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid, the wife of Jacob, whom she bore to Jacob, Gad and Asher.
verses.text: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s handmaid, the wife of Jacob, whom she bore to Jacob, Gad and Asher.

verses.raw: And these are the names of their sons who went with him into Egypt: the sons of Gad: Ziphion, and Haggi, and Shuni, and Ezbon, (and Eri) and Areli, and Arodi–eight.
verses.text: And these are the names of their sons who went with him into Egypt: the sons of Gad: Ziphion, and Haggi, and Shuni, and Ezbon, (and Eri) and Areli, and Arodi–eight.

verses.raw: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, (and Ishvi), and Beriah, and Serah, their one sister–six. All the souls were fourteen, and all those of Leah were forty-four.
verses.text: And the sons of Asher: Imnah, and Ishvah, (and Ishvi), and Beriah, and Serah, their one sister–six. All the souls were fourteen, and all those of Leah were forty-four.

verses.raw: And the sons of Rachel, the wife of Jacob: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.text: And the sons of Rachel, the wife of Jacob: Joseph and Benjamin.

verses.raw: And there were born to Joseph in Egypt before his father came into Egypt, those whom Asenath, daughter of Potiphar priest of Heliopolis bare to him, Manasseh, and Ephraim–three.
verses.text: And there were born to Joseph in Egypt before his father came into Egypt, those whom Asenath, daughter of Potiphar priest of Heliopolis bare to him, Manasseh, and Ephraim–three.

verses.raw: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, and Ehi, and Rosh, and Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard–eleven.
verses.text: And the sons of Benjamin: Bela and Becher, and Ashbel, Gera, and Naaman, and Ehi, and Rosh, and Muppim, and Huppim, and Ard–eleven.

verses.raw: And all the souls of Rachel were fourteen. And the sons of Bilhah, the handmaid of Rachel, the wife of Jacob, whom she bare to Jacob, were Dan and Naphtali.
verses.text: And all the souls of Rachel were fourteen. And the sons of Bilhah, the handmaid of Rachel, the wife of Jacob, whom she bare to Jacob, were Dan and Naphtali.

verses.raw: And these are the names of their sons who went with them into Egypt. And the sons of Dan were Hushim, and Sâmôn, and Asûdî, and ’Îjâka, and Salômôn–six.
verses.text: And these are the names of their sons who went with them into Egypt. And the sons of Dan were Hushim, and Sâmôn, and Asûdî, and ’Îjâka, and Salômôn–six.

verses.raw: And they died the year in which they entered into Egypt, and there was left to Dan Hushim alone.
verses.text: And they died the year in which they entered into Egypt, and there was left to Dan Hushim alone.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, and ‘Îv.
verses.text: And these are the names of the sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, and ‘Îv.

verses.raw: And ‘Îv, who was born after the years of famine, died in Egypt. And all the souls of Rachel were twenty-six.
verses.text: And ‘Îv, who was born after the years of famine, died in Egypt. And all the souls of Rachel were twenty-six.

verses.raw: And all the souls of Jacob which went into Egypt were seventy souls. These are his children and his children’s children, in all seventy; but five died in Egypt before Joseph, and had no children.
verses.text: And all the souls of Jacob which went into Egypt were seventy souls. These are his children and his children’s children, in all seventy; but five died in Egypt before Joseph, and had no children.

verses.raw: And in the land of Canaan two sons of Yahudah (Judah) died, Er and Onan, and they had no children, and the children of Yashar’el (Israel) buried those who perished, and they were reckoned among the seventy nations.
verses.text: And in the land of Canaan two sons of Yahudah died, Er and Onan, and they had no children, and the children of Yashar’el buried those who perished, and they were reckoned among the seventy nations.

verses.raw: And Yashar’el (Israel) went into the country of Egypt, 2172 A M. into the land of Goshen, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the second year of the third week of the forty-fifth jubilee.
verses.text: And Yashar’el went into the country of Egypt, 2172 A M. into the land of Goshen, on the new moon of the fourth month, in the second year of the third week of the forty-fifth jubilee.

verses.raw: And Joseph went to meet his father Jacob, to the land of Goshen, and he fell on his father’s neck and wept.
verses.text: And Joseph went to meet his father Jacob, to the land of Goshen, and he fell on his father’s neck and wept.

verses.raw: And Yashar’el (Israel) said to Joseph: “Now let me die since I have seen you, and now may Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar’el (Israel) be blessed, the Elohim (God) of Abraham and the Elohim (God) of Isaac who has not withheld His mercy and His grace from His servant Jacob.
verses.text: And Yashar’el said to Joseph: “Now let me die since I have seen you, and now may Yahuah Elohim of Yashar’el be blessed, the Elohim of Abraham and the Elohim of Isaac who has not withheld His mercy and His grace from His servant Jacob.

verses.raw: It is enough for me that I have seen your face whilst I am yet alive; yea, true is the vision which I saw at Bethel. Blessed be Yahuah my Elohim (the LORD my God) for ever and ever, and blessed be His name.”
verses.text: It is enough for me that I have seen your face whilst I am yet alive; yea, true is the vision which I saw at Bethel. Blessed be Yahuah my Elohim for ever and ever, and blessed be His name.”

verses.raw: And Joseph and his brothers ate bread before their father and drank wine, and Jacob rejoiced with exceeding great joy because he saw Joseph eating with his brothers and drinking before him, and he blessed the Creator of all things who had preserved him, and had preserved for him his twelve sons.
verses.text: And Joseph and his brothers ate bread before their father and drank wine, and Jacob rejoiced with exceeding great joy because he saw Joseph eating with his brothers and drinking before him, and he blessed the Creator of all things who had preserved him, and had preserved for him his twelve sons.

verses.raw: And Joseph had given to his father and to his brothers as a gift the right of dwelling in the land of Goshen and in Rameses and all the region round about, which he ruled over before Pharaoh. And Yashar’el (Israel) and his sons dwelt in the land of Goshen, the best part of the land of Egypt; and Yashar’el (Israel) was one hundred and thirty years old when he came into Egypt, And Joseph nourished his father and his brethren and also their possessions with bread as much as sufficed them for the seven years of the famine.
verses.text: And Joseph had given to his father and to his brothers as a gift the right of dwelling in the land of Goshen and in Rameses and all the region round about, which he ruled over before Pharaoh. And Yashar’el and his sons dwelt in the land of Goshen, the best part of the land of Egypt; and Yashar’el was one hundred and thirty years old when he came into Egypt, And Joseph nourished his father and his brethren and also their possessions with bread as much as sufficed them for the seven years of the famine.

verses.raw: And the land of Egypt suffered by reason of the famine, and Joseph acquired all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh in return for food, and he got possession of the people and their cattle and everything for Pharaoh.
verses.text: And the land of Egypt suffered by reason of the famine, and Joseph acquired all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh in return for food, and he got possession of the people and their cattle and everything for Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And the years of the famine were accomplished, and Joseph gave to the people in the land seed and food that they might sow (the land) in the eighth year, for the river had overflowed all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And the years of the famine were accomplished, and Joseph gave to the people in the land seed and food that they might sow (the land) in the eighth year, for the river had overflowed all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: For in the seven years of the famine it had not overflowed and had irrigated only a few places on the banks of the river, but now it overflowed and the Egyptians sowed the land, and it bore much corn that year.
verses.text: For in the seven years of the famine it had not overflowed and had irrigated only a few places on the banks of the river, but now it overflowed and the Egyptians sowed the land, and it bore much corn that year.

verses.raw: And this was the first year of the fourth week of the forty-fifth jubilee. And Joseph took of the corn of the harvest the fifth part for the king and left four parts for them for food and for seed, and Joseph made it an ordinance for the land of Egypt until this day.
verses.text: And this was the first year of the fourth week of the forty-fifth jubilee. And Joseph took of the corn of the harvest the fifth part for the king and left four parts for them for food and for seed, and Joseph made it an ordinance for the land of Egypt until this day.

verses.raw: And Yashar’el (Israel) lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and all the days which he lived were three jubilees, one hundred and forty-seven years, and he died in the fourth year of the fifth week of the forty-fifth jubilee. And Yashar’el (Israel) blessed his sons before he died and told them everything 1 that would befall them in the land of Egypt; and he made known to them what would come upon them in the last days, and blessed them and gave to Joseph two portions 2 in the land.
verses.text: And Yashar’el lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years, and all the days which he lived were three jubilees, one hundred and forty-seven years, and he died in the fourth year of the fifth week of the forty-fifth jubilee. And Yashar’el blessed his sons before he died and told them everything 1 that would befall them in the land of Egypt; and he made known to them what would come upon them in the last days, and blessed them and gave to Joseph two portions 2 in the land.

verses.raw: And he slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the double cave in the land of Canaan, near Abraham his father in the grave which he dug for himself in the double cave in the land of Hebron. 3 16. And he gave all his books and the books of his fathers to Levi his son that he might preserve them and renew them for his children until this day. 4
verses.text: And he slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the double cave in the land of Canaan, near Abraham his father in the grave which he dug for himself in the double cave in the land of Hebron. 3 16. And he gave all his books and the books of his fathers to Levi his son that he might preserve them and renew them for his children until this day. 4

verses.raw: And it came to pass that after Jacob died the children of Yashar’el (Israel) multiplied in the land of Egypt, and they became a great nation, and they were of one accord in heart, so that brother loved brother and every man helped his brother, and they increased abundantly and multiplied exceedingly, ten weeks of years, all the days of the life of Joseph.
verses.text: And it came to pass that after Jacob died the children of Yashar’el multiplied in the land of Egypt, and they became a great nation, and they were of one accord in heart, so that brother loved brother and every man helped his brother, and they increased abundantly and multiplied exceedingly, ten weeks of years, all the days of the life of Joseph.

verses.raw: And there was no Satan nor any evil all the days of the life of Joseph which he lived after his father Jacob, for all the Egyptians honoured the children of Yashar’el (Israel) all the days of the life of Joseph.
verses.text: And there was no Satan nor any evil all the days of the life of Joseph which he lived after his father Jacob, for all the Egyptians honoured the children of Yashar’el all the days of the life of Joseph.

verses.raw: And Joseph died being a hundred and ten years old; seventeen years he lived in the land of Canaan, and ten years he was a servant, and three years in prison, and eighty years he was under the king, ruling all the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Joseph died being a hundred and ten years old; seventeen years he lived in the land of Canaan, and ten years he was a servant, and three years in prison, and eighty years he was under the king, ruling all the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And he died and all his brethren and all that generation.
verses.text: And he died and all his brethren and all that generation.

verses.raw: And he commanded the children of Yashar’el (Israel) before he died that they should carry his bones with them when they went forth from the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And he commanded the children of Yashar’el before he died that they should carry his bones with them when they went forth from the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And he made them swear regarding his bones, for he knew that the Egyptians would not again bring forth and bury him in the land of Canaan, for Mâkamârôn, king of Canaan, while dwelling in the land of Assyria, fought in the valley with the king of Egypt and slew him there, and pursued after the Egyptians to the gates of ’Êrmôn. But he was not able to enter, for another, a new king, had become king of Egypt, and he was stronger than he, and he returned to the land of Canaan, and the gates of Egypt were closed, and none went out and none came into Egypt.
verses.text: And he made them swear regarding his bones, for he knew that the Egyptians would not again bring forth and bury him in the land of Canaan, for Mâkamârôn, king of Canaan, while dwelling in the land of Assyria, fought in the valley with the king of Egypt and slew him there, and pursued after the Egyptians to the gates of ’Êrmôn. But he was not able to enter, for another, a new king, had become king of Egypt, and he was stronger than he, and he returned to the land of Canaan, and the gates of Egypt were closed, and none went out and none came into Egypt.

verses.raw: And Joseph died in the forty-sixth jubilee, in the sixth week, in the second year, and they buried him in the land of Egypt, and his brethren died after him.
verses.text: And Joseph died in the forty-sixth jubilee, in the sixth week, in the second year, and they buried him in the land of Egypt, and his brethren died after him.

verses.raw: And the king of Egypt went forth to war with the king of Canaan in the forty-seventh jubilee, in the second week in the second year, and the children of Yashar’el (Israel) brought forth all the bones of the children of Jacob save the bones of Joseph, and they buried them in the field in the double cave in the mountain.
verses.text: And the king of Egypt went forth to war with the king of Canaan in the forty-seventh jubilee, in the second week in the second year, and the children of Yashar’el brought forth all the bones of the children of Jacob save the bones of Joseph, and they buried them in the field in the double cave in the mountain.

verses.raw: And the most (of them) returned to Egypt, but a few of them remained in the mountains of Hebron, and Amram your father remained with them 1. 11. And the king of Canaan was victorious over the king of Egypt, and he closed the gates of Egypt. And he devised an evil device against the children of Yashar’el (Israel) of afflicting them; and he said to the people of Egypt:
verses.text: And the most (of them) returned to Egypt, but a few of them remained in the mountains of Hebron, and Amram your father remained with them 1. 11. And the king of Canaan was victorious over the king of Egypt, and he closed the gates of Egypt. And he devised an evil device against the children of Yashar’el of afflicting them; and he said to the people of Egypt:

verses.raw: “Behold the people of the children of Yashar’el (Israel) have increased and multiplied more than we. Come and let us deal wisely with them before they become too many, and let us afflict them with slavery before war come upon us and before they too fight against us; else they will join themselves to our enemies and get them up out of our land, for their hearts and faces are towards the land of Canaan.”
verses.text: “Behold the people of the children of Yashar’el have increased and multiplied more than we. Come and let us deal wisely with them before they become too many, and let us afflict them with slavery before war come upon us and before they too fight against us; else they will join themselves to our enemies and get them up out of our land, for their hearts and faces are towards the land of Canaan.”

verses.raw: And he set over them taskmasters to afflict them with slavery; and they built strong 2 cities for Pharaoh, Pithom and Raamses, and they built all the walls and all the fortifications which had fallen in the cities of Egypt.
verses.text: And he set over them taskmasters to afflict them with slavery; and they built strong 2 cities for Pharaoh, Pithom and Raamses, and they built all the walls and all the fortifications which had fallen in the cities of Egypt.

verses.raw: And they made them serve with rigour, and the more they dealt evilly with them, the more they increased and multiplied.
verses.text: And they made them serve with rigour, and the more they dealt evilly with them, the more they increased and multiplied.

verses.raw: And the people of Egypt abominated the children of Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And the people of Egypt abominated the children of Yashar’el.

verses.raw: And in the seventh week, in the seventh year, in the forty-seventh jubilee, your father went forth from the land of Canaan, and you were born in the fourth week, in the sixth year thereof, in the forty-eighth jubilee; this was the time of tribulation on the children of Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And in the seventh week, in the seventh year, in the forty-seventh jubilee, your father went forth from the land of Canaan, and you were born in the fourth week, in the sixth year thereof, in the forty-eighth jubilee; this was the time of tribulation on the children of Yashar’el.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh, king of Egypt, issued a command regarding them that they should cast all their male children which were born into the river.
verses.text: And Pharaoh, king of Egypt, issued a command regarding them that they should cast all their male children which were born into the river.

verses.raw: And they cast them in for seven months until the day that you were born. And your mother hid you for three months, and they told regarding her.
verses.text: And they cast them in for seven months until the day that you were born. And your mother hid you for three months, and they told regarding her.

verses.raw: And she made an ark for you, and covered it with pitch and asphalt, and placed it in the flags on the bank of the river, and she placed you in it seven days, and your mother came by night and suckled you, and by day Miriam, your sister, guarded you from the birds.
verses.text: And she made an ark for you, and covered it with pitch and asphalt, and placed it in the flags on the bank of the river, and she placed you in it seven days, and your mother came by night and suckled you, and by day Miriam, your sister, guarded you from the birds.

verses.raw: And in those days Tharmuth, the daughter of Pharaoh, came to bathe in the river, and she heard your voice crying, and she told her maidens to bring you forth, and they brought you to her.
verses.text: And in those days Tharmuth, the daughter of Pharaoh, came to bathe in the river, and she heard your voice crying, and she told her maidens to bring you forth, and they brought you to her.

verses.raw: And she took you out of the ark, and she had compassion on you. And your sister said to her: “Shall I go and call to you one of the Hebrew women to nurse and suckle this babe for you?” And she said (to her): “Go.”
verses.text: And she took you out of the ark, and she had compassion on you. And your sister said to her: “Shall I go and call to you one of the Hebrew women to nurse and suckle this babe for you?” And she said (to her): “Go.”

verses.raw: And she went and called your mother Jochebed, and she gave her wages, and she nursed you.
verses.text: And she went and called your mother Jochebed, and she gave her wages, and she nursed you.

verses.raw: And afterwards, when you were grown up, they brought you to the daughter of Pharaoh, and you did become her son, and Amram your father taught you writing, and after you had completed three weeks they brought you into the royal court.
verses.text: And afterwards, when you were grown up, they brought you to the daughter of Pharaoh, and you did become her son, and Amram your father taught you writing, and after you had completed three weeks they brought you into the royal court.

verses.raw: And you were three weeks of years at court until the time when you did go forth from the royal court and did see an Egyptian smiting your friend who was of the children of Yashar’el (Israel), and you did slay him and hide him in the sand.
verses.text: And you were three weeks of years at court until the time when you did go forth from the royal court and did see an Egyptian smiting your friend who was of the children of Yashar’el, and you did slay him and hide him in the sand.

verses.raw: And on the second day you did find two of the children of Yashar’el (Israel) striving together, and you did say to him who was doing the wrong: "Why do you smite your brother? And he was angry and indignant, and said “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Thinkest you to kill me as you killedst the Egyptian yesterday?” And you did fear and flee on account of these words.
verses.text: And on the second day you did find two of the children of Yashar’el striving together, and you did say to him who was doing the wrong: "Why do you smite your brother? And he was angry and indignant, and said “Who made you a prince and a judge over us? Thinkest you to kill me as you killedst the Egyptian yesterday?” And you did fear and flee on account of these words.

verses.raw: And in the sixth year of the third week of the forty-ninth jubilee you did depart and dwell in the land of Midian five weeks and one year. And you did return into Egypt in the second week in the second year in the fiftieth jubilee.
verses.text: And in the sixth year of the third week of the forty-ninth jubilee you did depart and dwell in the land of Midian five weeks and one year. And you did return into Egypt in the second week in the second year in the fiftieth jubilee.

verses.raw: And you yourself know what He spake to you on Mount Sinai, and what prince Mastêmâ desired to do with you when you were returning into Egypt on the way when you did meet him at the lodging-place.
verses.text: And you yourself know what He spake to you on Mount Sinai, and what prince Mastêmâ desired to do with you when you were returning into Egypt on the way when you did meet him at the lodging-place.

verses.raw: Did he not with all his power seek to slay you and deliver the Egyptians out of your hand when he saw that you were sent to execute judgment and vengeance on the Egyptians?
verses.text: Did he not with all his power seek to slay you and deliver the Egyptians out of your hand when he saw that you were sent to execute judgment and vengeance on the Egyptians?

verses.raw: And I delivered you out of his hand, and you did perform the signs and wonders which you were sent to perform in Egypt against Pharaoh, and against all his house, and against his servants and his people.
verses.text: And I delivered you out of his hand, and you did perform the signs and wonders which you were sent to perform in Egypt against Pharaoh, and against all his house, and against his servants and his people.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) executed a great vengeance on them for Yashar’el’s (Israel’s) sake, and smote them through (the plagues of) blood and frogs, lice and dog-flies, and malignant boils breaking forth in blains; and their cattle by death; and by hail-stones, thereby He destroyed everything that grew for them; and by locusts which devoured the residue which had been left by the hail, and by darkness; and (by the death) of the first-born of men and animals, and on all their idols Yahuah (God) took vengeance and burned them with fire.
verses.text: And Yahuah executed a great vengeance on them for Yashar’el’s (Israel’s) sake, and smote them through (the plagues of) blood and frogs, lice and dog-flies, and malignant boils breaking forth in blains; and their cattle by death; and by hail-stones, thereby He destroyed everything that grew for them; and by locusts which devoured the residue which had been left by the hail, and by darkness; and (by the death) of the first-born of men and animals, and on all their idols Yahuah took vengeance and burned them with fire.

verses.raw: And everything was sent through your hand, that you should declare (these things) before they were done, and you did speak with the king of Egypt before all his servants and before his people.
verses.text: And everything was sent through your hand, that you should declare (these things) before they were done, and you did speak with the king of Egypt before all his servants and before his people.

verses.raw: And everything took place according to your words; ten great and terrible judgments came on the land of Egypt that you might execute vengeance on it for Yashar’el (Israel). And Yahuah (God) did everything for Yashar’el’s (Israel’s) sake, and according to His covenant, which He had ordained with Abraham that He would take vengeance on them as they had brought them by force into bondage.
verses.text: And everything took place according to your words; ten great and terrible judgments came on the land of Egypt that you might execute vengeance on it for Yashar’el. And Yahuah did everything for Yashar’el’s (Israel’s) sake, and according to His covenant, which He had ordained with Abraham that He would take vengeance on them as they had brought them by force into bondage.

verses.raw: And the prince of the Mastêmâ stood up against you, and sought to cast you into the hands of Pharaoh, and he helped the Egyptian sorcerers, and they stood up and wrought before you.
verses.text: And the prince of the Mastêmâ stood up against you, and sought to cast you into the hands of Pharaoh, and he helped the Egyptian sorcerers, and they stood up and wrought before you.

verses.raw: The evils indeed we permitted them to work, but the remedies we did not allow to be wrought by their hands.
verses.text: The evils indeed we permitted them to work, but the remedies we did not allow to be wrought by their hands.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) smote them with malignant ulcers, and they were not able to stand for we destroyed them so that they could not perform a single sign.
verses.text: And Yahuah smote them with malignant ulcers, and they were not able to stand for we destroyed them so that they could not perform a single sign.

verses.raw: And notwithstanding all (these) signs and wonders the prince of the Mastêmâ was not put to shame because he took courage and cried to the Egyptians to pursue after you with all the powers of the Egyptians, with their chariots, and with their horses, and with all the hosts of the peoples of Egypt. And I stood between the Egyptians and Yashar’el (Israel), and we delivered Yashar’el (Israel) out of his hand, and out of the hand of his people, and Yahuah (God) brought them through the midst of the sea as if it were dry land.
verses.text: And notwithstanding all (these) signs and wonders the prince of the Mastêmâ was not put to shame because he took courage and cried to the Egyptians to pursue after you with all the powers of the Egyptians, with their chariots, and with their horses, and with all the hosts of the peoples of Egypt. And I stood between the Egyptians and Yashar’el, and we delivered Yashar’el out of his hand, and out of the hand of his people, and Yahuah brought them through the midst of the sea as if it were dry land.

verses.raw: And all the peoples whom he brought to pursue after Yashar’el (Israel), Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss beneath the children of Yashar’el (Israel), even as the people of Egypt had cast their children into the river. He took vengeance on 1,000,000 of them, and one thousand strong and energetic men were destroyed on account of one suckling of the children of your people which they had thrown into the river.
verses.text: And all the peoples whom he brought to pursue after Yashar’el, Yahuah our Elohim cast them into the midst of the sea, into the depths of the abyss beneath the children of Yashar’el, even as the people of Egypt had cast their children into the river. He took vengeance on 1,000,000 of them, and one thousand strong and energetic men were destroyed on account of one suckling of the children of your people which they had thrown into the river.

verses.raw: And on the fourteenth day and on the fifteenth and on the sixteenth and on the seventeenth and on the eighteenth the prince of the Mastêmâ was bound and imprisoned behind the children of Yashar’el (Israel) that he might not accuse them.
verses.text: And on the fourteenth day and on the fifteenth and on the sixteenth and on the seventeenth and on the eighteenth the prince of the Mastêmâ was bound and imprisoned behind the children of Yashar’el that he might not accuse them.

verses.raw: And on the nineteenth we let them loose that they might help the Egyptians and pursue the children of Yashar’el (Israel).
verses.text: And on the nineteenth we let them loose that they might help the Egyptians and pursue the children of Yashar’el.

verses.raw: And he hardened their hearts and made them stubborn, and the device was devised by Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) that He might smite the Egyptians and cast them into the sea. And on the fourteenth we bound him that he might not accuse the children of Yashar’el (Israel) on the day when they asked the Egyptians for vessels and garments, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze, in order to despoil the Egyptians in return for the bondage in which they had forced them to serve.
verses.text: And he hardened their hearts and made them stubborn, and the device was devised by Yahuah our Elohim that He might smite the Egyptians and cast them into the sea. And on the fourteenth we bound him that he might not accuse the children of Yashar’el on the day when they asked the Egyptians for vessels and garments, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of bronze, in order to despoil the Egyptians in return for the bondage in which they had forced them to serve.

verses.raw: And we did not lead forth the children of Yashar’el (Israel) from Egypt empty handed.
verses.text: And we did not lead forth the children of Yashar’el from Egypt empty handed.

verses.raw: Remember the commandment which Yahuah (God) commanded you concerning the passover, that you should celebrate it in its season on the fourteenth of the first month, that you should kill it before it is evening, and that they should eat it by night on the evening of the fifteenth from the time of the setting of the sun.
verses.text: Remember the commandment which Yahuah commanded you concerning the passover, that you should celebrate it in its season on the fourteenth of the first month, that you should kill it before it is evening, and that they should eat it by night on the evening of the fifteenth from the time of the setting of the sun.

verses.raw: For on this night–the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy–you were eating the passover in Egypt, when all the powers of Mastêmâ had been let loose to slay all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the first-born of the captive maidservant in the mill, and to the cattle.
verses.text: For on this night–the beginning of the festival and the beginning of the joy–you were eating the passover in Egypt, when all the powers of Mastêmâ had been let loose to slay all the first-born in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh to the first-born of the captive maidservant in the mill, and to the cattle.

verses.raw: And this is the sign which Yahuah (God) gave them: Into every house on the lintels of which they saw the blood of a lamb of the first year, into (that) house they should not enter to slay, but should pass by (it), that all those should be saved that were in the house because the sign of the blood was on its lintels.
verses.text: And this is the sign which Yahuah gave them: Into every house on the lintels of which they saw the blood of a lamb of the first year, into (that) house they should not enter to slay, but should pass by (it), that all those should be saved that were in the house because the sign of the blood was on its lintels.

verses.raw: And the powers of Yahuah (God) did everything according as Yahuah (God) commanded them, and they passed by all the children of Yashar’el (Israel), and the plague came not upon them to destroy from amongst them any soul either of cattle, or man, or dog.
verses.text: And the powers of Yahuah did everything according as Yahuah commanded them, and they passed by all the children of Yashar’el, and the plague came not upon them to destroy from amongst them any soul either of cattle, or man, or dog.

verses.raw: And the plague was very grievous in Egypt, and there was no house in Egypt where there was not one dead, and weeping and lamentation.
verses.text: And the plague was very grievous in Egypt, and there was no house in Egypt where there was not one dead, and weeping and lamentation.

verses.raw: And all Yashar’el (Israel) was eating the flesh of the paschal lamb, and drinking the wine, and was lauding and blessing, and giving thanks to Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, and was ready to go forth from under the yoke of Egypt; and from the evil bondage. And remember you this day all the days of your life, and observe it from year to year all the days of your life, once a year, on its day, according to all the law thereof, and do not adjourn (it) from day to day, or from month to month.
verses.text: And all Yashar’el was eating the flesh of the paschal lamb, and drinking the wine, and was lauding and blessing, and giving thanks to Yahuah Elohim of their fathers, and was ready to go forth from under the yoke of Egypt; and from the evil bondage. And remember you this day all the days of your life, and observe it from year to year all the days of your life, once a year, on its day, according to all the law thereof, and do not adjourn (it) from day to day, or from month to month.

verses.raw: For it is an eternal ordinance, and engraven on the heavenly tables regarding all the children of Yashar’el (Israel) that they should observe it every year on its day once a year, throughout all their generations; and there is no limit of days, for this is ordained for ever.
verses.text: For it is an eternal ordinance, and engraven on the heavenly tables regarding all the children of Yashar’el that they should observe it every year on its day once a year, throughout all their generations; and there is no limit of days, for this is ordained for ever.

verses.raw: And the man who is free from uncleanness, and does not come to observe it on occasion of its day, so as to bring an acceptable offering before Yahuah (God), and to eat and to drink before Yahuah (God) on the day of its festival, that man who is clean and close at hand will be cut off; because he offered not the oblation of Yahuah (God) in its appointed season, he will take the guilt upon himself.
verses.text: And the man who is free from uncleanness, and does not come to observe it on occasion of its day, so as to bring an acceptable offering before Yahuah, and to eat and to drink before Yahuah on the day of its festival, that man who is clean and close at hand will be cut off; because he offered not the oblation of Yahuah in its appointed season, he will take the guilt upon himself.

verses.raw: Let the children of Yashar’el (Israel) come and observe the passover on the day of its fixed time, on the fourteenth day of the first month, between the evenings, from the third part of the day to the third part of the night, for two portions of the day are given to the light, and a third part to the evening.
verses.text: Let the children of Yashar’el come and observe the passover on the day of its fixed time, on the fourteenth day of the first month, between the evenings, from the third part of the day to the third part of the night, for two portions of the day are given to the light, and a third part to the evening.

verses.raw: That is that which Yahuah (God) commanded you that you should observe it between the evenings. And it is not permissible to slay it during any period of the light, but during the period bordering on the evening, and let them eat it at the time of the evening until the third part of the night, and whatever is leftover of all its flesh from the third part of the night and onwards, let them burn it with fire.
verses.text: That is that which Yahuah commanded you that you should observe it between the evenings. And it is not permissible to slay it during any period of the light, but during the period bordering on the evening, and let them eat it at the time of the evening until the third part of the night, and whatever is leftover of all its flesh from the third part of the night and onwards, let them burn it with fire.

verses.raw: And they shall not cook it with water, nor shall they eat it raw, but roast on the fire: they shall eat it with diligence, its head with the inwards thereof and its feet they shall roast with fire, and not break any bone thereof; for of the children of Yashar’el (Israel) no bone shall be crushed.
verses.text: And they shall not cook it with water, nor shall they eat it raw, but roast on the fire: they shall eat it with diligence, its head with the inwards thereof and its feet they shall roast with fire, and not break any bone thereof; for of the children of Yashar’el no bone shall be crushed.

verses.raw: For this reason Yahuah (God) commanded the children of Yashar’el (Israel) to observe the passover on the day of its fixed time, and they shall not break a bone thereof; for it is a festival day, and a day commanded, and there may be no passing over from day to day, and month to month, but on the day of its festival let it be observed.
verses.text: For this reason Yahuah commanded the children of Yashar’el to observe the passover on the day of its fixed time, and they shall not break a bone thereof; for it is a festival day, and a day commanded, and there may be no passing over from day to day, and month to month, but on the day of its festival let it be observed.

verses.raw: And do you command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) to observe the passover throughout their days, every year, once a year on the day of its fixed time, and it will come for a memorial well pleasing before Yahuah (God), and no plague will come upon them to slay or to smite in that year in which they celebrate the passover in its season in every respect according to His command.
verses.text: And do you command the children of Yashar’el to observe the passover throughout their days, every year, once a year on the day of its fixed time, and it will come for a memorial well pleasing before Yahuah, and no plague will come upon them to slay or to smite in that year in which they celebrate the passover in its season in every respect according to His command.

verses.raw: And they shall not eat it outside the sanctuary of Yahuah (God), but before the sanctuary of Yahuah (God), and all the people of the congregation of Yashar’el (Israel) shall celebrate it in its appointed season. And every man who has come upon its day shall eat it in the sanctuary of your Elohim (God) before Yahuah (God) from twenty years old and upward; for thus is it written and ordained that they should eat it in the sanctuary of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And they shall not eat it outside the sanctuary of Yahuah, but before the sanctuary of Yahuah, and all the people of the congregation of Yashar’el shall celebrate it in its appointed season. And every man who has come upon its day shall eat it in the sanctuary of your Elohim before Yahuah from twenty years old and upward; for thus is it written and ordained that they should eat it in the sanctuary of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And when the children of Yashar’el (Israel) come into the land which they are to possess, into the land of Canaan, and set up the tabernacle of Yahuah (God) in the midst of the land in one of their tribes until the sanctuary of Yahuah (God) has been built in the land, let them come and celebrate the passover in the midst of the tabernacle of Yahuah (God), and let them slay it before Yahuah (God) from year to year.
verses.text: And when the children of Yashar’el come into the land which they are to possess, into the land of Canaan, and set up the tabernacle of Yahuah in the midst of the land in one of their tribes until the sanctuary of Yahuah has been built in the land, let them come and celebrate the passover in the midst of the tabernacle of Yahuah, and let them slay it before Yahuah from year to year.

verses.raw: And in the days when the house has been built in the name of Yahuah (God) in the land of their inheritance, they shall go there and slay the passover in the evening, at sunset, at the third part of the day.
verses.text: And in the days when the house has been built in the name of Yahuah in the land of their inheritance, they shall go there and slay the passover in the evening, at sunset, at the third part of the day.

verses.raw: And they will offer its blood on the threshold of the altar, and shall place its fat on the fire which is upon the altar, and they shall eat its flesh roasted with fire in the court of the house which has been sanctified in the name of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And they will offer its blood on the threshold of the altar, and shall place its fat on the fire which is upon the altar, and they shall eat its flesh roasted with fire in the court of the house which has been sanctified in the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they may not celebrate the passover in their cities, 1 nor in any place save before the tabernacle of Yahuah (God), or before His house where His name has dwelt; and they will not go astray from Yahuah (God). And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar’el (Israel) to observe the ordinances of the passover, as it was commanded to you; declare you to them every year and the day of its days, and 2 the festival of unleavened bread, that they should eat unleavened bread seven days, (and) that they should observe its festival, and that they bring an oblation every day during those seven days of joy before Yahuah (God) on the altar of your Elohim (God).
verses.text: And they may not celebrate the passover in their cities, 1 nor in any place save before the tabernacle of Yahuah, or before His house where His name has dwelt; and they will not go astray from Yahuah. And do you, Moses, command the children of Yashar’el to observe the ordinances of the passover, as it was commanded to you; declare you to them every year and the day of its days, and 2 the festival of unleavened bread, that they should eat unleavened bread seven days, (and) that they should observe its festival, and that they bring an oblation every day during those seven days of joy before Yahuah on the altar of your Elohim.

verses.raw: For you celebrated this festival with haste 3 when you went forth from Egypt till you entered into the wilderness of Shur; 4 for on the shore of the sea you completed it.
verses.text: For you celebrated this festival with haste 3 when you went forth from Egypt till you entered into the wilderness of Shur; 4 for on the shore of the sea you completed it.

verses.raw: And after this law I made known to you the days of the Sabbaths in the desert of Sinai, which is between Elim and Sinai.
verses.text: And after this law I made known to you the days of the Sabbaths in the desert of Sinai, which is between Elim and Sinai.

verses.raw: And I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years: but the year thereof have I not told you till you enter the land which you are to possess.
verses.text: And I told you of the Sabbaths of the land on Mount Sinai, and I told you of the jubilee years in the sabbaths of years: but the year thereof have I not told you till you enter the land which you are to possess.

verses.raw: And the land also will keep its sabbaths while they dwell upon it, and they will know the jubilee year.
verses.text: And the land also will keep its sabbaths while they dwell upon it, and they will know the jubilee year.

verses.raw: Wherefore I have ordained for you the year-weeks and the years and the jubilees: there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day, and one week and two years and there are yet forty years to come (lit. "distant for learning the commandments of Yahuah (God), until they pass over into the land of Canaan, crossing the Jordan to the west.
verses.text: Wherefore I have ordained for you the year-weeks and the years and the jubilees: there are forty-nine jubilees from the days of Adam until this day, and one week and two years and there are yet forty years to come (lit. "distant for learning the commandments of Yahuah, until they pass over into the land of Canaan, crossing the Jordan to the west.

verses.raw: And the jubilees will pass by, until Yashar’el (Israel) is cleansed from all guilt of fornication, and uncleanness, and pollution, and sin, and error, and dwells with confidence in all the land, and there will be no more a Satan or any evil one, and the land will be clean from that time for evermore. And behold the commandment regarding the Sabbaths–I have written (them) down for you and all the judgments of its laws.
verses.text: And the jubilees will pass by, until Yashar’el is cleansed from all guilt of fornication, and uncleanness, and pollution, and sin, and error, and dwells with confidence in all the land, and there will be no more a Satan or any evil one, and the land will be clean from that time for evermore. And behold the commandment regarding the Sabbaths–I have written (them) down for you and all the judgments of its laws.

verses.raw: Six days will you labour, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath of Yahuah your Elohim (the LORD your God). In it you shall do no manner of work, you and your sons, and your men-servants and your maid-servants, and all your cattle and the sojourner also who is with you.
verses.text: Six days will you labour, but on the seventh day is the Sabbath of Yahuah your Elohim. In it you shall do no manner of work, you and your sons, and your men-servants and your maid-servants, and all your cattle and the sojourner also who is with you.

verses.raw: And the man that does any work on it shall die: whoever desecrates that day, whoever lies with (his) wife or whoever says he will do something on it, that he will set out on a journey thereon in regard to any buying or selling: and whoever draws water thereon which he had not prepared for himself on the sixth day, and whoever takes up any burden to carry it out of his tent or out of his house shall die.
verses.text: And the man that does any work on it shall die: whoever desecrates that day, whoever lies with (his) wife or whoever says he will do something on it, that he will set out on a journey thereon in regard to any buying or selling: and whoever draws water thereon which he had not prepared for himself on the sixth day, and whoever takes up any burden to carry it out of his tent or out of his house shall die.

verses.raw: You shall do no work whatever on the Sabbath day save that you have prepared for yourselves on the sixth day, so as to eat, and drink, and rest, and keep Sabbath from all work on that day, and to bless Yahuah your Elohim (the LORD your God), who has given you a day of festival, and a holy day: and a day of the holy kingdom for all Yashar’el (Israel) is this day among their days for ever.
verses.text: You shall do no work whatever on the Sabbath day save that you have prepared for yourselves on the sixth day, so as to eat, and drink, and rest, and keep Sabbath from all work on that day, and to bless Yahuah your Elohim, who has given you a day of festival, and a holy day: and a day of the holy kingdom for all Yashar’el is this day among their days for ever.

verses.raw: For great is the honour which Yahuah (God) has given to Yashar’el (Israel) that they should eat and drink and be satisfied on this festival day, and rest thereon from all labour which belongs to the labour of the children of men, save burning frankincense and bringing oblations and sacrifices before Yahuah (God) for days and for Sabbaths. This work alone shall be done on the Sabbath-days in the sanctuary of Yahuah your Elohim (the LORD your God); that they may atone for Yashar’el (Israel) with sacrifice continually from day to day for a memorial well-pleasing before Yahuah (God), and that He may receive them always from day to day according as you have been commanded.
verses.text: For great is the honour which Yahuah has given to Yashar’el that they should eat and drink and be satisfied on this festival day, and rest thereon from all labour which belongs to the labour of the children of men, save burning frankincense and bringing oblations and sacrifices before Yahuah for days and for Sabbaths. This work alone shall be done on the Sabbath-days in the sanctuary of Yahuah your Elohim; that they may atone for Yashar’el with sacrifice continually from day to day for a memorial well-pleasing before Yahuah, and that He may receive them always from day to day according as you have been commanded.

verses.raw: And every man who does any work thereon, or goes a journey, or tills (his) farm, whether in his house or any other place, and whoever lights a fire, or rides on any beast, or travels by ship on the sea, and whoever strikes or kills anything, or slaughters a beast or a bird, or whoever catches an animal or a bird or a fish, or whoever fasts or makes war on the Sabbaths:
verses.text: And every man who does any work thereon, or goes a journey, or tills (his) farm, whether in his house or any other place, and whoever lights a fire, or rides on any beast, or travels by ship on the sea, and whoever strikes or kills anything, or slaughters a beast or a bird, or whoever catches an animal or a bird or a fish, or whoever fasts or makes war on the Sabbaths:

verses.raw: The man who does any of these things on the Sabbath shall die, so that the children of Yashar’el (Israel) shall observe the Sabbaths according to the commandments regarding the Sabbaths of the land, as it is written in the tables, which He gave into my hands that I should write out for you the laws of the seasons, and the seasons according to the division of their days. Herewith is completed the account of the division of the days.
verses.text: The man who does any of these things on the Sabbath shall die, so that the children of Yashar’el shall observe the Sabbaths according to the commandments regarding the Sabbaths of the land, as it is written in the tables, which He gave into my hands that I should write out for you the laws of the seasons, and the seasons according to the division of their days. Herewith is completed the account of the division of the days.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and Elohim created man in his own image.
verses.text: And Elohim said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness, and Elohim created man in his own image.

verses.raw: And Elohim formed man from the ground, and he blew into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living soul endowed with speech.
verses.text: And Elohim formed man from the ground, and he blew into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living soul endowed with speech.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said, It is not good for man to be alone; I will make to him a helpmeet.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said, It is not good for man to be alone; I will make to him a helpmeet.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept, and he took away one of his ribs, and he built flesh upon it, and formed it and brought it to Adam, and Adam awoke from his sleep, and behold a woman was standing before him.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept, and he took away one of his ribs, and he built flesh upon it, and formed it and brought it to Adam, and Adam awoke from his sleep, and behold a woman was standing before him.

verses.raw: And he said, This is a bone of my bones and it shall be called woman, for this has been taken from man; and Adam called her name Eve, for she was the mother of all living.
verses.text: And he said, This is a bone of my bones and it shall be called woman, for this has been taken from man; and Adam called her name Eve, for she was the mother of all living.

verses.raw: And Elohim blessed them and called their names Adam and Eve in the day that he created them, and Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) said, Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.
verses.text: And Elohim blessed them and called their names Adam and Eve in the day that he created them, and Yahuah Elohim said, Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohim took Adam and his wife, and he placed them in the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it; and he commanded them and said to them, From every tree of the garden you may eat, but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohim took Adam and his wife, and he placed them in the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it; and he commanded them and said to them, From every tree of the garden you may eat, but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die.

verses.raw: And when Elohim had blessed and commanded them, he went from them, and Adam and his wife dwelt in the garden according to the command which Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded them.
verses.text: And when Elohim had blessed and commanded them, he went from them, and Adam and his wife dwelt in the garden according to the command which Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded them.

verses.raw: And the serpent, which Elohim had created with them in the earth, came to them to incite them to transgress the command of Elohim which he had commanded them.
verses.text: And the serpent, which Elohim had created with them in the earth, came to them to incite them to transgress the command of Elohim which he had commanded them.

verses.raw: And the serpent enticed and persuaded the woman to eat from the tree of knowledge, and the woman hearkened to the voice of the serpent, and she transgressed the word of Elohim, and took from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and she ate, and she took from it and gave also to her husband and he ate.
verses.text: And the serpent enticed and persuaded the woman to eat from the tree of knowledge, and the woman hearkened to the voice of the serpent, and she transgressed the word of Elohim, and took from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and she ate, and she took from it and gave also to her husband and he ate.

verses.raw: And Adam and his wife transgressed the command of Elohim which he commanded them, and Elohim knew it, and his anger was kindled against them and he cursed them.
verses.text: And Adam and his wife transgressed the command of Elohim which he commanded them, and Elohim knew it, and his anger was kindled against them and he cursed them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohim drove them that day from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which they were taken, and they went and dwelt at the east of the garden of Eden; and Adam knew his wife Eve and she bore two sons and three daughters.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohim drove them that day from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which they were taken, and they went and dwelt at the east of the garden of Eden; and Adam knew his wife Eve and she bore two sons and three daughters.

verses.raw: And she called the name of the first born Cain, saying, I have obtained a man from Yahuah (the Lord), and the name of the other she called Abel, for she said, In vanity we came into the earth, and in vanity we shall be taken from it.
verses.text: And she called the name of the first born Cain, saying, I have obtained a man from Yahuah (the Lord), and the name of the other she called Abel, for she said, In vanity we came into the earth, and in vanity we shall be taken from it.

verses.raw: And the boys grew up and their father gave them a possession in the land; and Cain was a tiller of the ground, and Abel a keeper of sheep.
verses.text: And the boys grew up and their father gave them a possession in the land; and Cain was a tiller of the ground, and Abel a keeper of sheep.

verses.raw: And it was at the expiration of a few years, that they brought an approximating offering to Yahuah (the Lord), and Cain brought from the fruit of the ground, and Abel brought from the firstlings of his flock from the fat of it, and Elohim turned and inclined to Abel and his offering, and a fire came down from Yahuah (the Lord) from heaven and consumed it.
verses.text: And it was at the expiration of a few years, that they brought an approximating offering to Yahuah (the Lord), and Cain brought from the fruit of the ground, and Abel brought from the firstlings of his flock from the fat of it, and Elohim turned and inclined to Abel and his offering, and a fire came down from Yahuah (the Lord) from heaven and consumed it.

verses.raw: And to Cain and his offering Yahuah (the Lord) did not turn, and he did not incline to it, for he had brought from the inferior fruit of the ground before Yahuah (the Lord), and Cain was jealous against his brother Abel on account of this, and he sought a pretext to slay him.
verses.text: And to Cain and his offering Yahuah (the Lord) did not turn, and he did not incline to it, for he had brought from the inferior fruit of the ground before Yahuah (the Lord), and Cain was jealous against his brother Abel on account of this, and he sought a pretext to slay him.

verses.raw: And in some time after, Cain and Abel his brother, went one day into the field to do their work; and they were both in the field, Cain tilling and ploughing his ground, and Abel feeding his flock; and the flock passed that part which Cain had ploughed in the ground, and it sorely grieved Cain on this account.
verses.text: And in some time after, Cain and Abel his brother, went one day into the field to do their work; and they were both in the field, Cain tilling and ploughing his ground, and Abel feeding his flock; and the flock passed that part which Cain had ploughed in the ground, and it sorely grieved Cain on this account.

verses.raw: And Cain approached his brother Abel in anger, and he said to him, What is there between me and you, that you come to dwell and bring your flock to feed in my land?
verses.text: And Cain approached his brother Abel in anger, and he said to him, What is there between me and you, that you come to dwell and bring your flock to feed in my land?

verses.raw: And Abel answered his brother Cain and said to him, What is there between me and you, that you shall eat the flesh of my flock and clothe thyself with their wool?
verses.text: And Abel answered his brother Cain and said to him, What is there between me and you, that you shall eat the flesh of my flock and clothe thyself with their wool?

verses.raw: And now therefore, put off the wool of my sheep with which you have clothed thyself, and recompense me for their fruit and flesh which you have eaten, and when you shall have done this, I will then go from your land as you have said?
verses.text: And now therefore, put off the wool of my sheep with which you have clothed thyself, and recompense me for their fruit and flesh which you have eaten, and when you shall have done this, I will then go from your land as you have said?

verses.raw: And Cain said to his brother Abel, Surely if I slay you this day, who will require your blood from me?
verses.text: And Cain said to his brother Abel, Surely if I slay you this day, who will require your blood from me?

verses.raw: And Abel answered Cain, saying, Surely Elohim who has made us in the earth, he will avenge my cause, and he will require my blood from you should you slay me, for Yahuah (the Lord) is the judge and arbiter, and it is he who will requite man according to his evil, and the wicked man according to the wickedness that he may do upon earth.
verses.text: And Abel answered Cain, saying, Surely Elohim who has made us in the earth, he will avenge my cause, and he will require my blood from you should you slay me, for Yahuah (the Lord) is the judge and arbiter, and it is he who will requite man according to his evil, and the wicked man according to the wickedness that he may do upon earth.

verses.raw: And now, if you should slay me here, surely Elohim knows your secret views, and will judge you for the evil which you did declare to do to me this day.
verses.text: And now, if you should slay me here, surely Elohim knows your secret views, and will judge you for the evil which you did declare to do to me this day.

verses.raw: And when Cain heard the words which Abel his brother had spoken, behold the anger of Cain was kindled against his brother Abel for declaring this thing.
verses.text: And when Cain heard the words which Abel his brother had spoken, behold the anger of Cain was kindled against his brother Abel for declaring this thing.

verses.raw: And Cain hastened and rose up, and took the iron part of his ploughing instrument, with which he suddenly smote his brother and he slew him, and Cain spilt the blood of his brother Abel upon the earth, and the blood of Abel streamed upon the earth before the flock.
verses.text: And Cain hastened and rose up, and took the iron part of his ploughing instrument, with which he suddenly smote his brother and he slew him, and Cain spilt the blood of his brother Abel upon the earth, and the blood of Abel streamed upon the earth before the flock.

verses.raw: And after this Cain repented having slain his brother, and he was sadly grieved, and he wept over him and it vexed him exceedingly.
verses.text: And after this Cain repented having slain his brother, and he was sadly grieved, and he wept over him and it vexed him exceedingly.

verses.raw: And Cain rose up and dug a hole in the field, wherein he put his brother’s body, and he turned the dust over it.
verses.text: And Cain rose up and dug a hole in the field, wherein he put his brother’s body, and he turned the dust over it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) knew what Cain had done to his brother, and Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Cain and said to him, Where is Abel your brother that was with you?
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) knew what Cain had done to his brother, and Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Cain and said to him, Where is Abel your brother that was with you?

verses.raw: And Cain dissembled, and said, I do not know, am I my brother’s keeper? And Yahuah (the Lord) said to him, What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground where you have slain him.
verses.text: And Cain dissembled, and said, I do not know, am I my brother’s keeper? And Yahuah (the Lord) said to him, What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground where you have slain him.

verses.raw: For you have slain your brother and have dissembled before me, and did imagine in your heart that I saw you not, nor knew all your actions.
verses.text: For you have slain your brother and have dissembled before me, and did imagine in your heart that I saw you not, nor knew all your actions.

verses.raw: But you did this thing and did slay your brother for naught and because he spoke rightly to you, and now, therefore, cursed be you from the ground which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand, and wherein you did bury him.
verses.text: But you did this thing and did slay your brother for naught and because he spoke rightly to you, and now, therefore, cursed be you from the ground which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand, and wherein you did bury him.

verses.raw: And it shall be when you shall till it, it shall no more give you its strength as in the beginning, for thorns and thistles shall the ground produce, and you shall be moving and wandering in the earth until the day of your death.
verses.text: And it shall be when you shall till it, it shall no more give you its strength as in the beginning, for thorns and thistles shall the ground produce, and you shall be moving and wandering in the earth until the day of your death.

verses.raw: And at that time Cain went out from the presence of Yahuah (the Lord), from the place where he was, and he went moving and wandering in the land toward the east of Eden, he and all belonging to him.
verses.text: And at that time Cain went out from the presence of Yahuah (the Lord), from the place where he was, and he went moving and wandering in the land toward the east of Eden, he and all belonging to him.

verses.raw: And Cain knew his wife in those days, and she conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Enoch, saying, In that time Yahuah (the Lord) began to give him rest and quiet in the earth.
verses.text: And Cain knew his wife in those days, and she conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Enoch, saying, In that time Yahuah (the Lord) began to give him rest and quiet in the earth.

verses.raw: And at that time Cain also began to build a city: and he built the city and he called the name of the city Enoch, according to the name of his son; for in those days Yahuah (the Lord) had given him rest upon the earth, and he did not move about and wander as in the beginning.
verses.text: And at that time Cain also began to build a city: and he built the city and he called the name of the city Enoch, according to the name of his son; for in those days Yahuah (the Lord) had given him rest upon the earth, and he did not move about and wander as in the beginning.

verses.raw: And Irad was born to Enoch, and Irad begat Mechuyael and Mechuyael begat Methusael.
verses.text: And Irad was born to Enoch, and Irad begat Mechuyael and Mechuyael begat Methusael.

verses.raw: And it was in the hundred and thirtieth year of the life of Adam upon the earth, that he again knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare a son in his likeness and in his image, and she called his name Seth, saying, Because Elohim (God) has appointed me another seed in the place of Abel, for Cain has slain him.
verses.text: And it was in the hundred and thirtieth year of the life of Adam upon the earth, that he again knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare a son in his likeness and in his image, and she called his name Seth, saying, Because Elohim has appointed me another seed in the place of Abel, for Cain has slain him.

verses.raw: And Seth lived one hundred and five years, and he begat a son; and Seth called the name of his son Enosh, saying, Because in that time the sons of men began to multiply, and to afflict their souls and hearts by transgressing and rebelling against Elohim.
verses.text: And Seth lived one hundred and five years, and he begat a son; and Seth called the name of his son Enosh, saying, Because in that time the sons of men began to multiply, and to afflict their souls and hearts by transgressing and rebelling against Elohim.

verses.raw: And it was in the days of Enosh that the sons of men continued to rebel and transgress against Elohim, to increase the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) against the sons of men.
verses.text: And it was in the days of Enosh that the sons of men continued to rebel and transgress against Elohim, to increase the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) against the sons of men.

verses.raw: And the sons of men went and they served other gods, and they forgot Yahuah (the Lord) who had created them in the earth: and in those days the sons of men made images of brass and iron, wood and stone, and they bowed down and served them.
