verses.text: And the sons of men went and they served other gods, and they forgot Yahuah (the Lord) who had created them in the earth: and in those days the sons of men made images of brass and iron, wood and stone, and they bowed down and served them.

verses.raw: And every man made his god and they bowed down to them, and the sons of men forsook Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Enosh and his children; and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled on account of their works and abominations which they did in the earth.
verses.text: And every man made his god and they bowed down to them, and the sons of men forsook Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Enosh and his children; and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled on account of their works and abominations which they did in the earth.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) caused the waters of the river Gihon to overwhelm them, and he destroyed and consumed them, and he destroyed the third part of the earth, and notwithstanding this, the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and their hands were yet extended to do evil in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) caused the waters of the river Gihon to overwhelm them, and he destroyed and consumed them, and he destroyed the third part of the earth, and notwithstanding this, the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and their hands were yet extended to do evil in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And in those days there was neither sowing nor reaping in the earth; and there was no food for the sons of men and the famine was very great in those days.
verses.text: And in those days there was neither sowing nor reaping in the earth; and there was no food for the sons of men and the famine was very great in those days.

verses.raw: And the seed which they sowed in those days in the ground became thorns, thistles and briers; for from the days of Adam was this declaration concerning the earth, of the curse of Elohim, which he cursed the earth, on account of the sin which Adam sinned before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And the seed which they sowed in those days in the ground became thorns, thistles and briers; for from the days of Adam was this declaration concerning the earth, of the curse of Elohim, which he cursed the earth, on account of the sin which Adam sinned before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And it was when men continued to rebel and transgress against Elohim, and to corrupt their ways, that the earth also became corrupt.
verses.text: And it was when men continued to rebel and transgress against Elohim, and to corrupt their ways, that the earth also became corrupt.

verses.raw: And Enosh lived ninety years and he begat Cainan;
verses.text: And Enosh lived ninety years and he begat Cainan;

verses.raw: And Cainan grew up and he was forty years old, and he became wise and had knowledge and skill in all wisdom, and he reigned over all the sons of men, and he led the sons of men to wisdom and knowledge; for Cainan was a very wise man and had understanding in all wisdom, and with his wisdom he ruled over spirits and demons;
verses.text: And Cainan grew up and he was forty years old, and he became wise and had knowledge and skill in all wisdom, and he reigned over all the sons of men, and he led the sons of men to wisdom and knowledge; for Cainan was a very wise man and had understanding in all wisdom, and with his wisdom he ruled over spirits and demons;

verses.raw: And Cainan knew by his wisdom that Elohim would destroy the sons of men for having sinned upon earth, and that Yahuah (the Lord) would in the latter days bring upon them the waters of the flood.
verses.text: And Cainan knew by his wisdom that Elohim would destroy the sons of men for having sinned upon earth, and that Yahuah (the Lord) would in the latter days bring upon them the waters of the flood.

verses.raw: And in those days Cainan wrote upon tablets of stone, what was to take place in time to come, and he put them in his treasures.
verses.text: And in those days Cainan wrote upon tablets of stone, what was to take place in time to come, and he put them in his treasures.

verses.raw: And Cainan reigned over the whole earth, and he turned some of the sons of men to the service of Elohim.
verses.text: And Cainan reigned over the whole earth, and he turned some of the sons of men to the service of Elohim.

verses.raw: And when Cainan was seventy years old, he begat three sons and two daughters.
verses.text: And when Cainan was seventy years old, he begat three sons and two daughters.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the children of Cainan; the name of the first born Mahlallel, the second Enan, and the third Mered, and their sisters were Adah and Zillah; these are the five children of Cainan that were born to him.
verses.text: And these are the names of the children of Cainan; the name of the first born Mahlallel, the second Enan, and the third Mered, and their sisters were Adah and Zillah; these are the five children of Cainan that were born to him.

verses.raw: And Lamech, the son of Methusael, became related to Cainan by marriage, and he took his two daughters for his wives, and Adah conceived and bare a son to Lamech, and she called his name Jabal.
verses.text: And Lamech, the son of Methusael, became related to Cainan by marriage, and he took his two daughters for his wives, and Adah conceived and bare a son to Lamech, and she called his name Jabal.

verses.raw: And she again conceived and bare a son, and called his name Jubal; and Zillah, her sister, was barren in those days and had no offspring.
verses.text: And she again conceived and bare a son, and called his name Jubal; and Zillah, her sister, was barren in those days and had no offspring.

verses.raw: For in those days the sons of men began to trespass against Elohim, and to transgress the commandments which he had commanded to Adam, to be fruitful and multiply in the earth.
verses.text: For in those days the sons of men began to trespass against Elohim, and to transgress the commandments which he had commanded to Adam, to be fruitful and multiply in the earth.

verses.raw: And some of the sons of men caused their wives to drink a draught that would render them barren, in order that they might retain their figures and by which their beautiful appearance might not fade.
verses.text: And some of the sons of men caused their wives to drink a draught that would render them barren, in order that they might retain their figures and by which their beautiful appearance might not fade.

verses.raw: And when the sons of men caused some of their wives to drink, Zillah drank with them.
verses.text: And when the sons of men caused some of their wives to drink, Zillah drank with them.

verses.raw: And the child-bearing women appeared abominable in the sight of their husbands as widows, whilst their husbands lived, for to the barren ones only they were attached.
verses.text: And the child-bearing women appeared abominable in the sight of their husbands as widows, whilst their husbands lived, for to the barren ones only they were attached.

verses.raw: And in the end of days and years, when Zillah became old, Yahuah (the Lord) opened her womb.
verses.text: And in the end of days and years, when Zillah became old, Yahuah (the Lord) opened her womb.

verses.raw: And she conceived and bare a son and she called his name Tubal Cain, saying, After I had withered away have I obtained him from El Shaddai (the Almighty God).
verses.text: And she conceived and bare a son and she called his name Tubal Cain, saying, After I had withered away have I obtained him from El Shaddai (the Almighty God).

verses.raw: And she conceived again and bare a daughter, and she called her name Naamah, for she said, After I had withered away have I obtained pleasure and delight.
verses.text: And she conceived again and bare a daughter, and she called her name Naamah, for she said, After I had withered away have I obtained pleasure and delight.

verses.raw: And Lamech was old and advanced in years, and his eyes were dim that he could not see, and Tubal Cain, his son, was leading him and it was one day that Lamech went into the field and Tubal Cain his son was with him, and whilst they were walking in the field, Cain the son of Adam advanced towards them; for Lamech was very old and could not see much, and Tubal Cain his son was very young.
verses.text: And Lamech was old and advanced in years, and his eyes were dim that he could not see, and Tubal Cain, his son, was leading him and it was one day that Lamech went into the field and Tubal Cain his son was with him, and whilst they were walking in the field, Cain the son of Adam advanced towards them; for Lamech was very old and could not see much, and Tubal Cain his son was very young.

verses.raw: And Tubal Cain told his father to draw his bow, and with the arrows he smote Cain, who was yet far off, and he slew him, for he appeared to them to be an animal.
verses.text: And Tubal Cain told his father to draw his bow, and with the arrows he smote Cain, who was yet far off, and he slew him, for he appeared to them to be an animal.

verses.raw: And the arrows entered Cain’s body although he was distant from them, and he fell to the ground and died.
verses.text: And the arrows entered Cain’s body although he was distant from them, and he fell to the ground and died.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) requited Cain’s evil according to his wickedness, which he had done to his brother Abel, according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) which he had spoken.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) requited Cain’s evil according to his wickedness, which he had done to his brother Abel, according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) which he had spoken.

verses.raw: And it came to pass when Cain had died, that Lamech and Tubal went to see the animal which they had slain, and they saw, and behold Cain their grandfather was fallen dead upon the earth.
verses.text: And it came to pass when Cain had died, that Lamech and Tubal went to see the animal which they had slain, and they saw, and behold Cain their grandfather was fallen dead upon the earth.

verses.raw: And Lamech was very much grieved at having done this, and in clapping his hands together he struck his son and caused his death.
verses.text: And Lamech was very much grieved at having done this, and in clapping his hands together he struck his son and caused his death.

verses.raw: And the wives of Lamech heard what Lamech had done, and they sought to kill him.
verses.text: And the wives of Lamech heard what Lamech had done, and they sought to kill him.

verses.raw: And the wives of Lamech hated him from that day, because he slew Cain and Tubal Cain, and the wives of Lamech separated from him, and would not hearken to him in those days.
verses.text: And the wives of Lamech hated him from that day, because he slew Cain and Tubal Cain, and the wives of Lamech separated from him, and would not hearken to him in those days.

verses.raw: And Lamech came to his wives, and he pressed them to listen to him about this matter.
verses.text: And Lamech came to his wives, and he pressed them to listen to him about this matter.

verses.raw: And he said to his wives Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice O wives of Lamech, attend to my words, for now you have imagined and said that I slew a man with my wounds, and a child with my stripes for their having done no violence, but surely know that I am old and grey-headed, and that my eyes are heavy through age, and I did this thing unknowingly.
verses.text: And he said to his wives Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice O wives of Lamech, attend to my words, for now you have imagined and said that I slew a man with my wounds, and a child with my stripes for their having done no violence, but surely know that I am old and grey-headed, and that my eyes are heavy through age, and I did this thing unknowingly.

verses.raw: And the wives of Lamech listened to him in this matter, and they returned to him with the advice of their father Adam, but they bore no children to him from that time, knowing that Elohim’s anger was increasing in those days against the sons of men, to destroy them with the waters of the flood for their evil doings.
verses.text: And the wives of Lamech listened to him in this matter, and they returned to him with the advice of their father Adam, but they bore no children to him from that time, knowing that Elohim’s anger was increasing in those days against the sons of men, to destroy them with the waters of the flood for their evil doings.

verses.raw: And Mahlallel the son of Cainan lived sixty-five years and he begat Jared; and Jared lived sixty-two years and he begat Enoch.
verses.text: And Mahlallel the son of Cainan lived sixty-five years and he begat Jared; and Jared lived sixty-two years and he begat Enoch.

verses.raw: And Enoch lived sixty-five years and he begat Methuselah; and Enoch walked with Elohim (God) after having begot Methuselah, and he served Yahuah (the Lord), and despised the evil ways of men.
verses.text: And Enoch lived sixty-five years and he begat Methuselah; and Enoch walked with Elohim after having begot Methuselah, and he served Yahuah (the Lord), and despised the evil ways of men.

verses.raw: And the soul of Enoch was wrapped up in the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord), in knowledge and in understanding; and he wisely retired from the sons of men, and secreted himself from them for many days.
verses.text: And the soul of Enoch was wrapped up in the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord), in knowledge and in understanding; and he wisely retired from the sons of men, and secreted himself from them for many days.

verses.raw: And it was at the expiration of many years, whilst he was serving Yahuah (the Lord), and praying before him in his house, that an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) called to him from Heaven, and he said, Here am I.
verses.text: And it was at the expiration of many years, whilst he was serving Yahuah (the Lord), and praying before him in his house, that an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) called to him from Heaven, and he said, Here am I.

verses.raw: And he said, Rise, go forth from your house and from the place where you dost hide thyself, and appear to the sons of men, in order that you may teach them the way in which they should go and the work which they must accomplish to enter in the ways of Elohim.
verses.text: And he said, Rise, go forth from your house and from the place where you dost hide thyself, and appear to the sons of men, in order that you may teach them the way in which they should go and the work which they must accomplish to enter in the ways of Elohim.

verses.raw: And Enoch rose up according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and went forth from his house, from his place and from the chamber in which he was concealed; and he went to the sons of men and taught them the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and at that time assembled the sons of men and acquainted them with the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Enoch rose up according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and went forth from his house, from his place and from the chamber in which he was concealed; and he went to the sons of men and taught them the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and at that time assembled the sons of men and acquainted them with the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And he ordered it to be proclaimed in all places where the sons of men dwelt, saying, Where is the man who wishes to know the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) and good works? let him come to Enoch.
verses.text: And he ordered it to be proclaimed in all places where the sons of men dwelt, saying, Where is the man who wishes to know the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) and good works? let him come to Enoch.

verses.raw: And all the sons of Adam then assembled to him, for all who desired this thing went to Enoch, and Enoch reigned over the sons of Adam according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and they came and bowed to him and they heard his word.
verses.text: And all the sons of Adam then assembled to him, for all who desired this thing went to Enoch, and Enoch reigned over the sons of Adam according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and they came and bowed to him and they heard his word.

verses.raw: And the spirit of Elohim was upon Enoch, and he taught all his men the wisdom of Elohim and his ways, and the sons of Adam served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Enoch, and they came to hear his wisdom.
verses.text: And the spirit of Elohim was upon Enoch, and he taught all his men the wisdom of Elohim and his ways, and the sons of Adam served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Enoch, and they came to hear his wisdom.

verses.raw: And all the kings of the sons of men, both first and last, together with their princes and judges, came to Enoch when they heard of his wisdom, and they bowed down to him, and they also required of Enoch to reign over them, to which he consented.
verses.text: And all the kings of the sons of men, both first and last, together with their princes and judges, came to Enoch when they heard of his wisdom, and they bowed down to him, and they also required of Enoch to reign over them, to which he consented.

verses.raw: And they assembled in all, one hundred and thirty kings and princes, and they made Enoch king over them and they were all under his power and command.
verses.text: And they assembled in all, one hundred and thirty kings and princes, and they made Enoch king over them and they were all under his power and command.

verses.raw: And Enoch taught them wisdom, knowledge, and the ways of Yahuah (the Lord); and he made peace amongst them, and peace was throughout the earth during the life of Enoch.
verses.text: And Enoch taught them wisdom, knowledge, and the ways of Yahuah (the Lord); and he made peace amongst them, and peace was throughout the earth during the life of Enoch.

verses.raw: And Enoch reigned over the sons of Adam two hundred and forty-three years, and he did justice and righteousness with all his people, and he led them in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Enoch reigned over the sons of Adam two hundred and forty-three years, and he did justice and righteousness with all his people, and he led them in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And these are the generations of Enoch, Methuselah, Elisha, and Elimelech, three sons; and their sisters were Melca and Nahmah, and Methuselah lived eighty-seven years and he begat Lamech.
verses.text: And these are the generations of Enoch, Methuselah, Elisha, and Elimelech, three sons; and their sisters were Melca and Nahmah, and Methuselah lived eighty-seven years and he begat Lamech.

verses.raw: And it was in the fifty-sixth year of the life of Lamech when Adam died; nine hundred and thirty years old was he at his death, and his two sons, with Enoch and Methuselah his son, buried him with great pomp, as at the burial of kings, in the cave which Elohim had told him.
verses.text: And it was in the fifty-sixth year of the life of Lamech when Adam died; nine hundred and thirty years old was he at his death, and his two sons, with Enoch and Methuselah his son, buried him with great pomp, as at the burial of kings, in the cave which Elohim had told him.

verses.raw: And in that place all the sons of men made a great mourning and weeping on account of Adam; it has therefore become a custom among the sons of men to this day.
verses.text: And in that place all the sons of men made a great mourning and weeping on account of Adam; it has therefore become a custom among the sons of men to this day.

verses.raw: And Adam died because he ate of the tree of knowledge; he and his children after him, as Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) had spoken.
verses.text: And Adam died because he ate of the tree of knowledge; he and his children after him, as Yahuah Elohim had spoken.

verses.raw: And it was in the year of Adam’s death which was the two hundred and forty-third year of the reign of Enoch, in that time Enoch resolved to separate himself from the sons of men and to secret himself as at first in order to serve Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And it was in the year of Adam’s death which was the two hundred and forty-third year of the reign of Enoch, in that time Enoch resolved to separate himself from the sons of men and to secret himself as at first in order to serve Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Enoch did so, but did not entirely secret himself from them, but kept away from the sons of men three days and then went to them for one day.
verses.text: And Enoch did so, but did not entirely secret himself from them, but kept away from the sons of men three days and then went to them for one day.

verses.raw: And during the three days that he was in his chamber, he prayed to, and praised Yahuah his Elohim, and the day on which he went and appeared to his subjects he taught them the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and all they asked him about Yahuah (the Lord) he told them.
verses.text: And during the three days that he was in his chamber, he prayed to, and praised Yahuah his Elohim, and the day on which he went and appeared to his subjects he taught them the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and all they asked him about Yahuah (the Lord) he told them.

verses.raw: And he did in this manner for many years, and he afterward concealed himself for six days, and appeared to his people one day in seven; and after that once in a month, and then once in a year, until all the kings, princes and sons of men sought for him, and desired again to see the face of Enoch, and to hear his word; but they could not, as all the sons of men were greatly afraid of Enoch, and they feared to approach him on account of the Godlike awe that was seated upon his countenance; therefore no man could look at him, fearing he might be punished and die.
verses.text: And he did in this manner for many years, and he afterward concealed himself for six days, and appeared to his people one day in seven; and after that once in a month, and then once in a year, until all the kings, princes and sons of men sought for him, and desired again to see the face of Enoch, and to hear his word; but they could not, as all the sons of men were greatly afraid of Enoch, and they feared to approach him on account of the Godlike awe that was seated upon his countenance; therefore no man could look at him, fearing he might be punished and die.

verses.raw: And all the kings and princes resolved to assemble the sons of men, and to come to Enoch, thinking that they might all speak to him at the time when he should come forth amongst them, and they did so.
verses.text: And all the kings and princes resolved to assemble the sons of men, and to come to Enoch, thinking that they might all speak to him at the time when he should come forth amongst them, and they did so.

verses.raw: And the day came when Enoch went forth and they all assembled and came to him, and Enoch spoke to them the words of Yahuah (the Lord) and he taught them wisdom and knowledge, and they bowed down before him and they said, May the king live! May the king live!
verses.text: And the day came when Enoch went forth and they all assembled and came to him, and Enoch spoke to them the words of Yahuah (the Lord) and he taught them wisdom and knowledge, and they bowed down before him and they said, May the king live! May the king live!

verses.raw: And in some time after, when the kings and princes and the sons of men were speaking to Enoch, and Enoch was teaching them the ways of Elohim, behold an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) then called to Enoch from heaven, and wished to bring him up to heaven to make him reign there over the sons of Elohim, as he had reigned over the sons of men upon earth.
verses.text: And in some time after, when the kings and princes and the sons of men were speaking to Enoch, and Enoch was teaching them the ways of Elohim, behold an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) then called to Enoch from heaven, and wished to bring him up to heaven to make him reign there over the sons of Elohim, as he had reigned over the sons of men upon earth.

verses.raw: When at that time Enoch heard this he went and assembled all the inhabitants of the earth, and taught them wisdom and knowledge and gave them divine instructions, and he said to them, I have been required to ascend into heaven, I therefore do not know the day of my going.
verses.text: When at that time Enoch heard this he went and assembled all the inhabitants of the earth, and taught them wisdom and knowledge and gave them divine instructions, and he said to them, I have been required to ascend into heaven, I therefore do not know the day of my going.

verses.raw: And now therefore I will teach you wisdom and knowledge and will give you instruction before I leave you, how to act upon earth by which you may live; and he did so.
verses.text: And now therefore I will teach you wisdom and knowledge and will give you instruction before I leave you, how to act upon earth by which you may live; and he did so.

verses.raw: And he taught them wisdom and knowledge, and gave them instruction, and he reproved them, and he placed before them statutes and judgments to do upon earth, and he made peace amongst them, and he taught them everlasting life, and dwelt with them some time teaching them all these things.
verses.text: And he taught them wisdom and knowledge, and gave them instruction, and he reproved them, and he placed before them statutes and judgments to do upon earth, and he made peace amongst them, and he taught them everlasting life, and dwelt with them some time teaching them all these things.

verses.raw: And at that time the sons of Adam were with Enoch, and Enoch was speaking to them, and they lifted up their eyes and the likeness of a great horse descended from heaven, and the horse paced in the air;
verses.text: And at that time the sons of Adam were with Enoch, and Enoch was speaking to them, and they lifted up their eyes and the likeness of a great horse descended from heaven, and the horse paced in the air;

verses.raw: And they told Enoch what they had seen, and Enoch said to them, On my account does this horse descend upon earth; the time is come when I must go from you and I shall no more be seen by you.
verses.text: And they told Enoch what they had seen, and Enoch said to them, On my account does this horse descend upon earth; the time is come when I must go from you and I shall no more be seen by you.

verses.raw: And the horse descended at that time and stood before Enoch, and all the sons of Adam that were with Enoch saw him.
verses.text: And the horse descended at that time and stood before Enoch, and all the sons of Adam that were with Enoch saw him.

verses.raw: And Enoch then again ordered a voice to be proclaimed, saying, Where is the man who delights to know the ways of Yahuah his Elohim (the Lord his God), let him come this day to Enoch before he is taken from us.
verses.text: And Enoch then again ordered a voice to be proclaimed, saying, Where is the man who delights to know the ways of Yahuah his Elohim, let him come this day to Enoch before he is taken from us.

verses.raw: And all the sons of Adam assembled and came to Enoch that day; and all the kings of the earth with their princes and counsellors remained with him that day; and Enoch then taught the sons of men wisdom and knowledge, and gave them divine instruction; and he bade them serve Yahuah (the Lord) and walk in his ways all the days of their lives, and he continued to make peace amongst them.
verses.text: And all the sons of Adam assembled and came to Enoch that day; and all the kings of the earth with their princes and counsellors remained with him that day; and Enoch then taught the sons of men wisdom and knowledge, and gave them divine instruction; and he bade them serve Yahuah (the Lord) and walk in his ways all the days of their lives, and he continued to make peace amongst them.

verses.raw: And it was after this that he rose up and rode upon the horse; and he went forth and all the sons of men went after him, about eight hundred thousand men; and they went with him one day’s journey.
verses.text: And it was after this that he rose up and rode upon the horse; and he went forth and all the sons of men went after him, about eight hundred thousand men; and they went with him one day’s journey.

verses.raw: And the second day he said to them, Return home to your tents, why will you go? perhaps you may die; and some of them went from him, and those that remained went with him six day’s journey; and Enoch said to them every day, Return to your tents, lest you may die; but they were not willing to return, and they went with him.
verses.text: And the second day he said to them, Return home to your tents, why will you go? perhaps you may die; and some of them went from him, and those that remained went with him six day’s journey; and Enoch said to them every day, Return to your tents, lest you may die; but they were not willing to return, and they went with him.

verses.raw: And on the sixth day some of the men remained and clung to him, and they said to him, We will go with you to the place where you go; as Yahuah (the Lord) lives, death only shall separate us.
verses.text: And on the sixth day some of the men remained and clung to him, and they said to him, We will go with you to the place where you go; as Yahuah (the Lord) lives, death only shall separate us.

verses.raw: And they urged so much to go with him, that he ceased speaking to them; and they went after him and would not return;
verses.text: And they urged so much to go with him, that he ceased speaking to them; and they went after him and would not return;

verses.raw: And when the kings returned they caused a census to be taken, in order to know the number of remaining men that went with Enoch; and it was upon the seventh day that Enoch ascended into heaven in a whirlwind, with horses and chariots of fire.
verses.text: And when the kings returned they caused a census to be taken, in order to know the number of remaining men that went with Enoch; and it was upon the seventh day that Enoch ascended into heaven in a whirlwind, with horses and chariots of fire.

verses.raw: And on the eighth day all the kings that had been with Enoch sent to bring back the number of men that were with Enoch, in that place from which he ascended into heaven.
verses.text: And on the eighth day all the kings that had been with Enoch sent to bring back the number of men that were with Enoch, in that place from which he ascended into heaven.

verses.raw: And all those kings went to the place and they found the earth there filled with snow, and upon the snow were large stones of snow, and one said to the other, Come, let us break through the snow and see, perhaps the men that remained with Enoch are dead, and are now under the stones of snow, and they searched but could not find him, for he had ascended into heaven.

verses.raw: And all the days that Enoch lived upon earth, were three hundred and sixty-five years.
verses.text: And all the days that Enoch lived upon earth, were three hundred and sixty-five years.

verses.raw: And when Enoch had ascended into heaven, all the kings of the earth rose and took Methuselah his son and anointed him, and they caused him to reign over them in the place of his father.
verses.text: And when Enoch had ascended into heaven, all the kings of the earth rose and took Methuselah his son and anointed him, and they caused him to reign over them in the place of his father.

verses.raw: And Methuselah acted uprightly in the sight of Elohim (God), as his father Enoch had taught him, and he likewise during the whole of his life taught the sons of men wisdom, knowledge and the fear of Elohim, and he did not turn from the good way either to the right or to the left.
verses.text: And Methuselah acted uprightly in the sight of Elohim, as his father Enoch had taught him, and he likewise during the whole of his life taught the sons of men wisdom, knowledge and the fear of Elohim, and he did not turn from the good way either to the right or to the left.

verses.raw: But in the latter days of Methuselah, the sons of men turned from Yahuah (the Lord), they corrupted the earth, they robbed and plundered each other, and they rebelled against Elohim and they transgressed, and they corrupted their ways, and would not hearken to the voice of Methuselah, but rebelled against him.
verses.text: But in the latter days of Methuselah, the sons of men turned from Yahuah (the Lord), they corrupted the earth, they robbed and plundered each other, and they rebelled against Elohim and they transgressed, and they corrupted their ways, and would not hearken to the voice of Methuselah, but rebelled against him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) was exceedingly wroth against them, and Yahuah (the Lord) continued to destroy the seed in those days, so that there was neither sowing nor reaping in the earth.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) was exceedingly wroth against them, and Yahuah (the Lord) continued to destroy the seed in those days, so that there was neither sowing nor reaping in the earth.

verses.raw: For when they sowed the ground in order that they might obtain food for their support, behold, thorns and thistles were produced which they did not sow.
verses.text: For when they sowed the ground in order that they might obtain food for their support, behold, thorns and thistles were produced which they did not sow.

verses.raw: And still the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and their hands were still extended to do evil in the sight of Elohim, and they provoked Yahuah (the Lord) with their evil ways, and Yahuah (the Lord) was very wroth, and repented that he had made man.
verses.text: And still the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and their hands were still extended to do evil in the sight of Elohim, and they provoked Yahuah (the Lord) with their evil ways, and Yahuah (the Lord) was very wroth, and repented that he had made man.

verses.raw: And he thought to destroy and annihilate them and he did so.
verses.text: And he thought to destroy and annihilate them and he did so.

verses.raw: In those days when Lamech the son of Methuselah was one hundred and sixty years old, Seth the son of Adam died.
verses.text: In those days when Lamech the son of Methuselah was one hundred and sixty years old, Seth the son of Adam died.

verses.raw: And all the days that Seth lived, were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.
verses.text: And all the days that Seth lived, were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.

verses.raw: And Lamech was one hundred and eighty years old when he took Ashmua, the daughter of Elishaa the son of Enoch his uncle, and she conceived.
verses.text: And Lamech was one hundred and eighty years old when he took Ashmua, the daughter of Elishaa the son of Enoch his uncle, and she conceived.

verses.raw: And at that time the sons of men sowed the ground, and a little food was produced, yet the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and they trespassed and rebelled against Elohim.
verses.text: And at that time the sons of men sowed the ground, and a little food was produced, yet the sons of men did not turn from their evil ways, and they trespassed and rebelled against Elohim.

verses.raw: And the wife of Lamech conceived and bare him a son at that time, at the revolution of the year.
verses.text: And the wife of Lamech conceived and bare him a son at that time, at the revolution of the year.

verses.raw: And Methuselah called his name Noah, saying, The earth was in his days at rest and free from corruption, and Lamech his father called his name Menachem, saying, This one shall comfort us in our works and miserable toil in the earth, which Elohim had cursed.
verses.text: And Methuselah called his name Noah, saying, The earth was in his days at rest and free from corruption, and Lamech his father called his name Menachem, saying, This one shall comfort us in our works and miserable toil in the earth, which Elohim had cursed.

verses.raw: And the child grew up and was weaned, and he went in the ways of his father Methuselah, perfect and upright with Elohim.
verses.text: And the child grew up and was weaned, and he went in the ways of his father Methuselah, perfect and upright with Elohim.

verses.raw: And all the sons of men departed from the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) in those days as they multiplied upon the face of the earth with sons and daughters, and they taught one another their evil practices and they continued sinning against Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And all the sons of men departed from the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) in those days as they multiplied upon the face of the earth with sons and daughters, and they taught one another their evil practices and they continued sinning against Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And every man made to himself a god, and they robbed and plundered every man his neighbor as well as his relative, and they corrupted the earth, and the earth was filled with violence.
verses.text: And every man made to himself a god, and they robbed and plundered every man his neighbor as well as his relative, and they corrupted the earth, and the earth was filled with violence.

verses.raw: And their judges and rulers went to the daughters of men and took their wives by force from their husbands according to their choice, and the sons of men in those days took from the cattle of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and taught the mixture of animals of one species with the other, in order therewith to provoke Yahuah (the Lord); and Elohim saw the whole earth and it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted its ways upon earth, all men and all animals.
