verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said, I will blot out man that I created from the face of the earth, yea from man to the birds of the air, together with cattle and beasts that are in the field for I repent that I made them.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said, I will blot out man that I created from the face of the earth, yea from man to the birds of the air, together with cattle and beasts that are in the field for I repent that I made them.

verses.raw: And all men who walked in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), died in those days, before Yahuah (the Lord) brought the evil upon man which he had declared, for this was from Yahuah (the Lord), that they should not see the evil which Yahuah (the Lord) spoke of concerning the sons of men.
verses.text: And all men who walked in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), died in those days, before Yahuah (the Lord) brought the evil upon man which he had declared, for this was from Yahuah (the Lord), that they should not see the evil which Yahuah (the Lord) spoke of concerning the sons of men.

verses.raw: And Noah found grace in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him and his children to raise up seed from them upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.text: And Noah found grace in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him and his children to raise up seed from them upon the face of the whole earth.

verses.raw: And it was in the eighty-fourth year of the life of Noah, that Enoch the son of Seth died, he was nine hundred and five years old at his death.
verses.text: And it was in the eighty-fourth year of the life of Noah, that Enoch the son of Seth died, he was nine hundred and five years old at his death.

verses.raw: And in the one hundred and seventy ninth year of the life of Noah, Cainan the son of Enosh died, and all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.
verses.text: And in the one hundred and seventy ninth year of the life of Noah, Cainan the son of Enosh died, and all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.

verses.raw: And in the two hundred and thirty fourth year of the life of Noah, Mahlallel the son of Cainan died, and the days of Mahlallel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.
verses.text: And in the two hundred and thirty fourth year of the life of Noah, Mahlallel the son of Cainan died, and the days of Mahlallel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.

verses.raw: And Jared the son of Mahlallel died in those days, in the three hundred and thirty-sixth year of the life of Noah; and all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.
verses.text: And Jared the son of Mahlallel died in those days, in the three hundred and thirty-sixth year of the life of Noah; and all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.

verses.raw: And all who followed Yahuah (the Lord) died in those days, before they saw the evil which Elohim (God) declared to do upon earth.
verses.text: And all who followed Yahuah (the Lord) died in those days, before they saw the evil which Elohim declared to do upon earth.

verses.raw: And after the lapse of many years, in the four hundred and eightieth year of the life of Noah, when all those men, who followed Yahuah (the Lord) had died away from amongst the sons of men, and only Methuselah was then left, Elohim said to Noah and Methuselah, saying,
verses.text: And after the lapse of many years, in the four hundred and eightieth year of the life of Noah, when all those men, who followed Yahuah (the Lord) had died away from amongst the sons of men, and only Methuselah was then left, Elohim said to Noah and Methuselah, saying,

verses.raw: Speak you, and proclaim to the sons of men, saying, Thus says Yahuah (the Lord), return from your evil ways and forsake your works, and Yahuah (the Lord) will repent of the evil that he declared to do to you, so that it shall not come to pass.
verses.text: Speak you, and proclaim to the sons of men, saying, Thus says Yahuah (the Lord), return from your evil ways and forsake your works, and Yahuah (the Lord) will repent of the evil that he declared to do to you, so that it shall not come to pass.

verses.raw: For thus says Yahuah (the Lord), Behold I give you a period of one hundred and twenty years; if you will turn to me and forsake your evil ways, then will I also turn away from the evil which I told you, and it shall not exist, says Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: For thus says Yahuah (the Lord), Behold I give you a period of one hundred and twenty years; if you will turn to me and forsake your evil ways, then will I also turn away from the evil which I told you, and it shall not exist, says Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Noah and Methuselah spoke all the words of Yahuah (the Lord) to the sons of men, day after day, constantly speaking to them.
verses.text: And Noah and Methuselah spoke all the words of Yahuah (the Lord) to the sons of men, day after day, constantly speaking to them.

verses.raw: But the sons of men would not hearken to them, nor incline their ears to their words, and they were stiffnecked.
verses.text: But the sons of men would not hearken to them, nor incline their ears to their words, and they were stiffnecked.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) granted them a period of one hundred and twenty years, saying, If they will return, then will Elohim repent of the evil, so as not to destroy the earth.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) granted them a period of one hundred and twenty years, saying, If they will return, then will Elohim repent of the evil, so as not to destroy the earth.

verses.raw: Noah the son of Lamech refrained from taking a wife in those days, to beget children, for he said, Surely now Elohim will destroy the earth, therefore then shall I beget children?
verses.text: Noah the son of Lamech refrained from taking a wife in those days, to beget children, for he said, Surely now Elohim will destroy the earth, therefore then shall I beget children?

verses.raw: And Noah was a just man, he was perfect in his generation, and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him to raise up seed from his seed upon the face of the earth.
verses.text: And Noah was a just man, he was perfect in his generation, and Yahuah (the Lord) chose him to raise up seed from his seed upon the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, Take to you a wife, and beget children, for I have seen you righteous before me in this generation.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, Take to you a wife, and beget children, for I have seen you righteous before me in this generation.

verses.raw: And you shall raise up seed, and your children with you, in the midst of the earth; and Noah went and took a wife, and he chose Naamah the daughter of Enoch, and she was five hundred and eighty years old.
verses.text: And you shall raise up seed, and your children with you, in the midst of the earth; and Noah went and took a wife, and he chose Naamah the daughter of Enoch, and she was five hundred and eighty years old.

verses.raw: And Noah was four hundred and ninety-eight years old, when he took Naamah for a wife.
verses.text: And Noah was four hundred and ninety-eight years old, when he took Naamah for a wife.

verses.raw: And Naamah conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Japheth, saying, Elohim has enlarged me in the earth; and she conceived again and bare a son, and he called his name Shem, saying, Elohim has made me a remnant, to raise up seed in the midst of the earth.
verses.text: And Naamah conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Japheth, saying, Elohim has enlarged me in the earth; and she conceived again and bare a son, and he called his name Shem, saying, Elohim has made me a remnant, to raise up seed in the midst of the earth.

verses.raw: And Noah was five hundred and two years old when Naamah bare Shem, and the boys grew up and went in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), in all that Methuselah and Noah their father taught them.
verses.text: And Noah was five hundred and two years old when Naamah bare Shem, and the boys grew up and went in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), in all that Methuselah and Noah their father taught them.

verses.raw: And Lamech the father of Noah, died in those days; yet verily he did not go with all his heart in the ways of his father, and he died in the hundred and ninety-fifth year of the life of Noah.
verses.text: And Lamech the father of Noah, died in those days; yet verily he did not go with all his heart in the ways of his father, and he died in the hundred and ninety-fifth year of the life of Noah.

verses.raw: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy years, and he died.
verses.text: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy years, and he died.

verses.raw: And all the sons of men who knew Yahuah (the Lord), died in that year before Yahuah (the Lord) brought evil upon them; for Yahuah (the Lord) willed them to die, so as not to behold the evil that Elohim would bring upon their brothers and relatives, as he had so declared to do.
verses.text: And all the sons of men who knew Yahuah (the Lord), died in that year before Yahuah (the Lord) brought evil upon them; for Yahuah (the Lord) willed them to die, so as not to behold the evil that Elohim would bring upon their brothers and relatives, as he had so declared to do.

verses.raw: In that time, Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah and Methuselah, Stand forth and proclaim to the sons of men all the words that I spoke to you in those days, peradventure they may turn from their evil ways, and I will then repent of the evil and will not bring it.
verses.text: In that time, Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah and Methuselah, Stand forth and proclaim to the sons of men all the words that I spoke to you in those days, peradventure they may turn from their evil ways, and I will then repent of the evil and will not bring it.

verses.raw: And Noah and Methuselah stood forth, and said in the ears of the sons of men, all that Elohim had spoken concerning them.
verses.text: And Noah and Methuselah stood forth, and said in the ears of the sons of men, all that Elohim had spoken concerning them.

verses.raw: But the sons of men would not hearken, neither would they incline their ears to all their declarations.
verses.text: But the sons of men would not hearken, neither would they incline their ears to all their declarations.

verses.raw: And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth.
verses.text: And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me, on account of their evil deeds, and behold I will destroy the earth.

verses.raw: And do you take to you gopher wood, and go to a certain place and make a large ark, and place it in that spot.
verses.text: And do you take to you gopher wood, and go to a certain place and make a large ark, and place it in that spot.

verses.raw: And thus shall you make it; three hundred cubits its length, fifty cubits broad and thirty cubits high.
verses.text: And thus shall you make it; three hundred cubits its length, fifty cubits broad and thirty cubits high.

verses.raw: And you shall make to you a door, open at its side, and to a cubit you shall finish above, and cover it within and without with pitch.
verses.text: And you shall make to you a door, open at its side, and to a cubit you shall finish above, and cover it within and without with pitch.

verses.raw: And behold I will bring the flood of waters upon the earth, and all flesh be destroyed, from under the heavens all that is upon earth shall perish.
verses.text: And behold I will bring the flood of waters upon the earth, and all flesh be destroyed, from under the heavens all that is upon earth shall perish.

verses.raw: And you and your household shall go and gather two couple of all living things, male and female, and shall bring them to the ark, to raise up seed from them upon earth.
verses.text: And you and your household shall go and gather two couple of all living things, male and female, and shall bring them to the ark, to raise up seed from them upon earth.

verses.raw: And gather to you all food that is eaten by all the animals, that there may be food for you and for them.
verses.text: And gather to you all food that is eaten by all the animals, that there may be food for you and for them.

verses.raw: And you shall choose for your sons three maidens, from the daughters of men, and they shall be wives to your sons.
verses.text: And you shall choose for your sons three maidens, from the daughters of men, and they shall be wives to your sons.

verses.raw: And Noah rose up, and he made the ark, in the place where Elohim had commanded him, and Noah did as Elohim had ordered him.
verses.text: And Noah rose up, and he made the ark, in the place where Elohim had commanded him, and Noah did as Elohim had ordered him.

verses.raw: In his five hundred and ninety-fifth year Noah commenced to make the ark, and he made the ark in five years, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded.
verses.text: In his five hundred and ninety-fifth year Noah commenced to make the ark, and he made the ark in five years, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded.

verses.raw: Then Noah took the three daughters of Eliakim, son of Methuselah, for wives for his sons, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Noah.
verses.text: Then Noah took the three daughters of Eliakim, son of Methuselah, for wives for his sons, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Noah.

verses.raw: And it was at that time Methuselah the son of Enoch died, nine hundred and sixty years old was he, at his death.
verses.text: And it was at that time Methuselah the son of Enoch died, nine hundred and sixty years old was he, at his death.

verses.raw: At that time, after the death of Methuselah, Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, Go you with your household into the ark; behold I will gather to you all the animals of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and they shall all come and surround the ark.
verses.text: At that time, after the death of Methuselah, Yahuah (the Lord) said to Noah, Go you with your household into the ark; behold I will gather to you all the animals of the earth, the beasts of the field and the fowls of the air, and they shall all come and surround the ark.

verses.raw: And you shall go and seat thyself by the doors of the ark, and all the beasts, the animals, and the fowls, shall assemble and place themselves before you, and such of them as shall come and crouch before you, shall you take and deliver into the hands of your sons, who shall bring them to the ark, and all that will stand before you you shall leave.
verses.text: And you shall go and seat thyself by the doors of the ark, and all the beasts, the animals, and the fowls, shall assemble and place themselves before you, and such of them as shall come and crouch before you, shall you take and deliver into the hands of your sons, who shall bring them to the ark, and all that will stand before you you shall leave.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) brought this about on the next day, and animals, beasts and fowls came in great multitudes and surrounded the ark.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) brought this about on the next day, and animals, beasts and fowls came in great multitudes and surrounded the ark.

verses.raw: And Noah went and seated himself by the door of the ark, and of all flesh that crouched before him, he brought into the ark, and all that stood before him he left upon earth.
verses.text: And Noah went and seated himself by the door of the ark, and of all flesh that crouched before him, he brought into the ark, and all that stood before him he left upon earth.

verses.raw: And a lioness came, with her two whelps, male and female, and the three crouched before Noah, and the two whelps rose up against the lioness and smote her, and made her flee from her place, and she went away, and they returned to their places, and crouched upon the earth before Noah.
verses.text: And a lioness came, with her two whelps, male and female, and the three crouched before Noah, and the two whelps rose up against the lioness and smote her, and made her flee from her place, and she went away, and they returned to their places, and crouched upon the earth before Noah.

verses.raw: And the lioness ran away, and stood in the place of the lions.
verses.text: And the lioness ran away, and stood in the place of the lions.

verses.raw: And Noah saw this, and wondered greatly, and he rose and took the two whelps, and brought them into the ark.
verses.text: And Noah saw this, and wondered greatly, and he rose and took the two whelps, and brought them into the ark.

verses.raw: And Noah brought into the ark from all living creatures that were upon earth, so that there was none left but which Noah brought into the ark.
verses.text: And Noah brought into the ark from all living creatures that were upon earth, so that there was none left but which Noah brought into the ark.

verses.raw: Two and two came to Noah into the ark, but from the clean animals, and clean fowls, he brought seven couples, as Elohim (God) had commanded him.
verses.text: Two and two came to Noah into the ark, but from the clean animals, and clean fowls, he brought seven couples, as Elohim had commanded him.

verses.raw: And all the animals, and beasts, and fowls, were still there, and they surrounded the ark at every place, and the rain had not descended till seven days after.
verses.text: And all the animals, and beasts, and fowls, were still there, and they surrounded the ark at every place, and the rain had not descended till seven days after.

verses.raw: And on that day, Yahuah (the Lord) caused the whole earth to shake, and the sun darkened, and the foundations of the world raged, and the whole earth was moved violently, and the lightning flashed, and the thunder roared, and all the fountains in the earth were broken up, such as was not known to the inhabitants before; and Elohim did this mighty act, in order to terrify the sons of men, that there might be no more evil upon earth.
verses.text: And on that day, Yahuah (the Lord) caused the whole earth to shake, and the sun darkened, and the foundations of the world raged, and the whole earth was moved violently, and the lightning flashed, and the thunder roared, and all the fountains in the earth were broken up, such as was not known to the inhabitants before; and Elohim did this mighty act, in order to terrify the sons of men, that there might be no more evil upon earth.

verses.raw: And still the sons of men would not return from their evil ways, and they increased the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) at that time, and did not even direct their hearts to all this.
verses.text: And still the sons of men would not return from their evil ways, and they increased the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) at that time, and did not even direct their hearts to all this.

verses.raw: And at the end of seven days, in the six hundredth year of the life of Noah, the waters of the flood were upon the earth.
verses.text: And at the end of seven days, in the six hundredth year of the life of Noah, the waters of the flood were upon the earth.

verses.raw: And all the fountains of the deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened, and the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
verses.text: And all the fountains of the deep were broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened, and the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.

verses.raw: And Noah and his household, and all the living creatures that were with him, came into the ark on account of the waters of the flood, and Yahuah (the Lord) shut him in.
verses.text: And Noah and his household, and all the living creatures that were with him, came into the ark on account of the waters of the flood, and Yahuah (the Lord) shut him in.

verses.raw: And all the sons of men that were left upon the earth, became exhausted through evil on account of the rain, for the waters were coming more violently upon the earth, and the animals and beasts were still surrounding the ark.
verses.text: And all the sons of men that were left upon the earth, became exhausted through evil on account of the rain, for the waters were coming more violently upon the earth, and the animals and beasts were still surrounding the ark.

verses.raw: And the sons of men assembled together, about seven hundred thousand men and women, and they came to Noah to the ark.
verses.text: And the sons of men assembled together, about seven hundred thousand men and women, and they came to Noah to the ark.

verses.raw: And they called to Noah, saying, Open for us that we may come to you in the ark–and therefore shall we die?
verses.text: And they called to Noah, saying, Open for us that we may come to you in the ark–and therefore shall we die?

verses.raw: And Noah, with a loud voice, answered them from the ark, saying, Have you not all rebelled against Yahuah (the Lord), and said that he does not exist? and therefore Yahuah (the Lord) brought upon you this evil, to destroy and cut you off from the face of the earth.
verses.text: And Noah, with a loud voice, answered them from the ark, saying, Have you not all rebelled against Yahuah (the Lord), and said that he does not exist? and therefore Yahuah (the Lord) brought upon you this evil, to destroy and cut you off from the face of the earth.

verses.raw: Is not this the thing that I spoke to you of one hundred and twenty years back, and you would not hearken to the voice of Yahuah (the Lord), and now do you desire to live upon earth?
verses.text: Is not this the thing that I spoke to you of one hundred and twenty years back, and you would not hearken to the voice of Yahuah (the Lord), and now do you desire to live upon earth?

verses.raw: And they said to Noah, We are ready to return to Yahuah (the Lord); only open for us that we may live and not die.
verses.text: And they said to Noah, We are ready to return to Yahuah (the Lord); only open for us that we may live and not die.

verses.raw: And Noah answered them, saying, Behold now that you see the trouble of your souls, you wish to return to Yahuah (the Lord); why did you not return during these hundred and twenty years, which Yahuah (the Lord) granted you as the determined period?
verses.text: And Noah answered them, saying, Behold now that you see the trouble of your souls, you wish to return to Yahuah (the Lord); why did you not return during these hundred and twenty years, which Yahuah (the Lord) granted you as the determined period?

verses.raw: But now you come and tell me this on account of the troubles of your souls, now also Yahuah (the Lord) will not listen to you, neither will he give ear to you on this day, so that you will not now succeed in your wishes.
verses.text: But now you come and tell me this on account of the troubles of your souls, now also Yahuah (the Lord) will not listen to you, neither will he give ear to you on this day, so that you will not now succeed in your wishes.

verses.raw: And the sons of men approached in order to break into the ark, to come in on account of the rain, for they could not bear the rain upon them.
verses.text: And the sons of men approached in order to break into the ark, to come in on account of the rain, for they could not bear the rain upon them.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) sent all the beasts and animals that stood round the ark. And the beasts overpowered them and drove them from that place, and every man went his way and they again scattered themselves upon the face of the earth.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) sent all the beasts and animals that stood round the ark. And the beasts overpowered them and drove them from that place, and every man went his way and they again scattered themselves upon the face of the earth.

verses.raw: And the rain was still descending upon the earth, and it descended forty days and forty nights, and the waters prevailed greatly upon the earth; and all flesh that was upon the earth or in the waters died, whether men, animals, beasts, creeping things or birds of the air, and there only remained Noah and those that were with him in the ark.
verses.text: And the rain was still descending upon the earth, and it descended forty days and forty nights, and the waters prevailed greatly upon the earth; and all flesh that was upon the earth or in the waters died, whether men, animals, beasts, creeping things or birds of the air, and there only remained Noah and those that were with him in the ark.

verses.raw: And the waters prevailed and they greatly increased upon the earth, and they lifted up the ark and it was raised from the earth.
verses.text: And the waters prevailed and they greatly increased upon the earth, and they lifted up the ark and it was raised from the earth.

verses.raw: And the ark floated upon the face of the waters, and it was tossed upon the waters so that all the living creatures within were turned about like pottage in a cauldron.
verses.text: And the ark floated upon the face of the waters, and it was tossed upon the waters so that all the living creatures within were turned about like pottage in a cauldron.

verses.raw: And great anxiety seized all the living creatures that were in the ark, and the ark was like to be broken.
verses.text: And great anxiety seized all the living creatures that were in the ark, and the ark was like to be broken.

verses.raw: And all the living creatures that were in the ark were terrified, and the lions roared, and the oxen lowed, and the wolves howled, and every living creature in the ark spoke and lamented in its own language, so that their voices reached to a great distance, and Noah and his sons cried and wept in their troubles; they were greatly afraid that they had reached the gates of death.
verses.text: And all the living creatures that were in the ark were terrified, and the lions roared, and the oxen lowed, and the wolves howled, and every living creature in the ark spoke and lamented in its own language, so that their voices reached to a great distance, and Noah and his sons cried and wept in their troubles; they were greatly afraid that they had reached the gates of death.

verses.raw: And Noah prayed to Yahuah (the Lord), and cried to him on account of this, and he said, O Yahuah (O Lord) help us, for we have no strength to bear this evil that has encompassed us, for the waves of the waters have surrounded us, mischievous torrents have terrified us, the snares of death have come before us; answer us, O Yahuah (O Lord), answer us, light up your countenance toward us and be gracious to us, redeem us and deliver us.
verses.text: And Noah prayed to Yahuah (the Lord), and cried to him on account of this, and he said, O Yahuah (O Lord) help us, for we have no strength to bear this evil that has encompassed us, for the waves of the waters have surrounded us, mischievous torrents have terrified us, the snares of death have come before us; answer us, O Yahuah (O Lord), answer us, light up your countenance toward us and be gracious to us, redeem us and deliver us.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Noah, and Yahuah (the Lord) remembered him.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Noah, and Yahuah (the Lord) remembered him.

verses.raw: And a wind passed over the earth, and the waters were still and the ark rested.
verses.text: And a wind passed over the earth, and the waters were still and the ark rested.

verses.raw: And the fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained.
verses.text: And the fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained.

verses.raw: And the waters decreased in those days, and the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.
verses.text: And the waters decreased in those days, and the ark rested upon the mountains of Ararat.

verses.raw: And Noah then opened the windows of the ark, and Noah still called out to Yahuah (the Lord) at that time and he said, O Yahuah (O Lord), who did form the earth and the heavens and all that are in it, bring forth our souls from this confinement, and from the prison wherein you have placed us, for I am much wearied with sighing.
verses.text: And Noah then opened the windows of the ark, and Noah still called out to Yahuah (the Lord) at that time and he said, O Yahuah (O Lord), who did form the earth and the heavens and all that are in it, bring forth our souls from this confinement, and from the prison wherein you have placed us, for I am much wearied with sighing.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Noah, and said to him, When though shall have completed a full year you shall then go forth.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Noah, and said to him, When though shall have completed a full year you shall then go forth.

verses.raw: And at the revolution of the year, when a full year was completed to Noah’s dwelling in the ark, the waters were dried from off the earth, and Noah put off the covering of the ark.
verses.text: And at the revolution of the year, when a full year was completed to Noah’s dwelling in the ark, the waters were dried from off the earth, and Noah put off the covering of the ark.

verses.raw: At that time, on the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was dry, but Noah and his sons, and those that were with him, did not go out from the ark until Yahuah (the Lord) told them.
verses.text: At that time, on the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth was dry, but Noah and his sons, and those that were with him, did not go out from the ark until Yahuah (the Lord) told them.

verses.raw: And the day came that Yahuah (the Lord) told them to go out, and they all went out from the ark.
verses.text: And the day came that Yahuah (the Lord) told them to go out, and they all went out from the ark.

verses.raw: And they went and returned every one to his way and to his place, and Noah and his sons dwelt in the land that Elohim had told them, and they served Yahuah (the Lord) all their days, and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed Noah and his sons on their going out from the ark.
verses.text: And they went and returned every one to his way and to his place, and Noah and his sons dwelt in the land that Elohim had told them, and they served Yahuah (the Lord) all their days, and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed Noah and his sons on their going out from the ark.

verses.raw: And he said to them, Be fruitful and fill all the earth; become strong and increase abundantly in the earth and multiply in it.
verses.text: And he said to them, Be fruitful and fill all the earth; become strong and increase abundantly in the earth and multiply in it.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the sons of Noah: Japheth, Ham and Shem; and children were born to them after the flood, for they had taken wives before the flood.
verses.text: And these are the names of the sons of Noah: Japheth, Ham and Shem; and children were born to them after the flood, for they had taken wives before the flood.

verses.raw: These are the sons of Japheth; Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, seven sons.
verses.text: These are the sons of Japheth; Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras, seven sons.

verses.raw: And the sons of Gomer were Askinaz, Rephath and Tegarmah.
verses.text: And the sons of Gomer were Askinaz, Rephath and Tegarmah.

verses.raw: And the sons of Magog were Elichanaf and Lubal.
verses.text: And the sons of Magog were Elichanaf and Lubal.

verses.raw: And the children of Madai were Achon, Zeelo, Chazoni and Lot.
verses.text: And the children of Madai were Achon, Zeelo, Chazoni and Lot.

verses.raw: And the sons of Javan were Elisha, Tarshish, Chittim and Dudonim.
verses.text: And the sons of Javan were Elisha, Tarshish, Chittim and Dudonim.

verses.raw: And the sons of Tubal were Ariphi, Kesed and Taari.
verses.text: And the sons of Tubal were Ariphi, Kesed and Taari.

verses.raw: And the sons of Meshech were Dedon, Zaron and Shebashni.
verses.text: And the sons of Meshech were Dedon, Zaron and Shebashni.

verses.raw: And the sons of Tiras were Benib, Gera, Lupirion and Gilak; these are the sons of Japheth according to their families, and their numbers in those days were about four hundred and sixty men.
verses.text: And the sons of Tiras were Benib, Gera, Lupirion and Gilak; these are the sons of Japheth according to their families, and their numbers in those days were about four hundred and sixty men.

verses.raw: And these are the sons of Ham; Cush, Mitzraim, Phut and Canaan, four sons; and the sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama and Satecha, and the sons of Raama were Sheba and Dedan.
verses.text: And these are the sons of Ham; Cush, Mitzraim, Phut and Canaan, four sons; and the sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama and Satecha, and the sons of Raama were Sheba and Dedan.

verses.raw: And the sons of Mitzraim were Lud, Anom and Pathros, Chasloth and Chaphtor.
verses.text: And the sons of Mitzraim were Lud, Anom and Pathros, Chasloth and Chaphtor.

verses.raw: And the sons of Phut were Gebul, Hadan, Benah and Adan.
verses.text: And the sons of Phut were Gebul, Hadan, Benah and Adan.

verses.raw: And the sons of Canaan were Zidon, Heth, Amori, Gergashi, Hivi, Arkee, Seni, Arodi, Zimodi and Chamothi.
verses.text: And the sons of Canaan were Zidon, Heth, Amori, Gergashi, Hivi, Arkee, Seni, Arodi, Zimodi and Chamothi.

verses.raw: These are the sons of Ham, according to their families, and their numbers in those days were about seven hundred and thirty men.
verses.text: These are the sons of Ham, according to their families, and their numbers in those days were about seven hundred and thirty men.

verses.raw: And these are the sons of Shem; Elam, Ashur, Arpachshad, Lud and Aram, five sons; and the sons of Elam were Shushan, Machul and Harmon.
verses.text: And these are the sons of Shem; Elam, Ashur, Arpachshad, Lud and Aram, five sons; and the sons of Elam were Shushan, Machul and Harmon.

verses.raw: And the sons of Ashar were Mirus and Mokil, and the sons of Arpachshad were Shelach, Anar and Ashcol.
verses.text: And the sons of Ashar were Mirus and Mokil, and the sons of Arpachshad were Shelach, Anar and Ashcol.

verses.raw: And the sons of Lud were Pethor and Bizayon, and the sons of Aram were Uz, Chul, Gather and Mash.
verses.text: And the sons of Lud were Pethor and Bizayon, and the sons of Aram were Uz, Chul, Gather and Mash.

verses.raw: These are the sons of Shem, according to their families; and their numbers in those days were about three hundred men.
verses.text: These are the sons of Shem, according to their families; and their numbers in those days were about three hundred men.

verses.raw: These are the generations of Shem; Shem begat Arpachshad and Arpachshad begat Shelach, and Shelach begat Eber and to Eber were born two children, the name of one was Peleg, for in his days the sons of men were divided, and in the latter days, the earth was divided.
verses.text: These are the generations of Shem; Shem begat Arpachshad and Arpachshad begat Shelach, and Shelach begat Eber and to Eber were born two children, the name of one was Peleg, for in his days the sons of men were divided, and in the latter days, the earth was divided.

verses.raw: And the name of the second was Yoktan, meaning that in his day the lives of the sons of men were diminished and lessened.
verses.text: And the name of the second was Yoktan, meaning that in his day the lives of the sons of men were diminished and lessened.

verses.raw: These are the sons of Yoktan; Almodad, Shelaf, Chazarmoveth, Yerach, Hadurom, Ozel, Diklah, Obal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah and Jobab; all these are the sons of Yoktan.
verses.text: These are the sons of Yoktan; Almodad, Shelaf, Chazarmoveth, Yerach, Hadurom, Ozel, Diklah, Obal, Abimael, Sheba, Ophir, Havilah and Jobab; all these are the sons of Yoktan.

verses.raw: And Peleg his brother begat Yen, and Yen begat Serug, and Serug begat Nahor and Nahor begat Terah, and Terah was thirty-eight years old, and he begat Haran and Nahor.
verses.text: And Peleg his brother begat Yen, and Yen begat Serug, and Serug begat Nahor and Nahor begat Terah, and Terah was thirty-eight years old, and he begat Haran and Nahor.

verses.raw: And Cush the son of Ham, the son of Noah, took a wife in those days in his old age, and she bare a son, and they called his name Nimrod, saying, At that time the sons of men again began to rebel and transgress against Elohim (God), and the child grew up, and his father loved him exceedingly, for he was the son of his old age.
verses.text: And Cush the son of Ham, the son of Noah, took a wife in those days in his old age, and she bare a son, and they called his name Nimrod, saying, At that time the sons of men again began to rebel and transgress against Elohim, and the child grew up, and his father loved him exceedingly, for he was the son of his old age.

verses.raw: And the garments of skin which Elohim made for Adam and his wife, when they went out of the garden, were given to Cush.
verses.text: And the garments of skin which Elohim made for Adam and his wife, when they went out of the garden, were given to Cush.

verses.raw: For after the death of Adam and his wife, the garments were given to Enoch, the son of Jared, and when Enoch was taken up to Elohim, he gave them to Methuselah, his son.
verses.text: For after the death of Adam and his wife, the garments were given to Enoch, the son of Jared, and when Enoch was taken up to Elohim, he gave them to Methuselah, his son.

verses.raw: And at the death of Methuselah, Noah took them and brought them to the ark, and they were with him until he went out of the ark.
verses.text: And at the death of Methuselah, Noah took them and brought them to the ark, and they were with him until he went out of the ark.

verses.raw: And in their going out, Ham stole those garments from Noah his father, and he took them and hid them from his brothers.
verses.text: And in their going out, Ham stole those garments from Noah his father, and he took them and hid them from his brothers.

verses.raw: And when Ham begat his first born Cush, he gave him the garments in secret, and they were with Cush many days.
verses.text: And when Ham begat his first born Cush, he gave him the garments in secret, and they were with Cush many days.

verses.raw: And Cush also concealed them from his sons and brothers, and when Cush had begotten Nimrod, he gave him those garments through his love for him, and Nimrod grew up, and when he was twenty years old he put on those garments.
verses.text: And Cush also concealed them from his sons and brothers, and when Cush had begotten Nimrod, he gave him those garments through his love for him, and Nimrod grew up, and when he was twenty years old he put on those garments.

verses.raw: And Nimrod became strong when he put on the garments, and Elohim gave him might and strength, and he was a mighty hunter in the earth, yea, he was a mighty hunter in the field, and he hunted the animals and he built altars, and he offered upon them the animals before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Nimrod became strong when he put on the garments, and Elohim gave him might and strength, and he was a mighty hunter in the earth, yea, he was a mighty hunter in the field, and he hunted the animals and he built altars, and he offered upon them the animals before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Nimrod strengthened himself, and he rose up from amongst his brethren, and he fought the battles of his brethren against all their enemies round about.
verses.text: And Nimrod strengthened himself, and he rose up from amongst his brethren, and he fought the battles of his brethren against all their enemies round about.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) delivered all the enemies of his brethren in his hands, and Elohim prospered him from time to time in his battles, and he reigned upon earth.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) delivered all the enemies of his brethren in his hands, and Elohim prospered him from time to time in his battles, and he reigned upon earth.

verses.raw: Therefore it became current in those days, when a man ushered forth those that he had trained up for battle, he would say to them, Like Elohim did to Nimrod, who was a mighty hunter in the earth, and who succeeded in the battles that prevailed against his brethren, that he delivered them from the hands of their enemies, so may Elohim strengthen us and deliver us this day.
verses.text: Therefore it became current in those days, when a man ushered forth those that he had trained up for battle, he would say to them, Like Elohim did to Nimrod, who was a mighty hunter in the earth, and who succeeded in the battles that prevailed against his brethren, that he delivered them from the hands of their enemies, so may Elohim strengthen us and deliver us this day.

verses.raw: And when Nimrod was forty years old, at that time there was a war between his brethren and the children of Japheth, so that they were in the power of their enemies.
verses.text: And when Nimrod was forty years old, at that time there was a war between his brethren and the children of Japheth, so that they were in the power of their enemies.

verses.raw: And Nimrod went forth at that time, and he assembled all the sons of Cush and their families, about four hundred and sixty men, and he hired also from some of his friends and acquaintances about eighty men, and be gave them their hire, and he went with them to battle, and when he was on the road, Nimrod strengthened the hearts of the people that went with him.
verses.text: And Nimrod went forth at that time, and he assembled all the sons of Cush and their families, about four hundred and sixty men, and he hired also from some of his friends and acquaintances about eighty men, and be gave them their hire, and he went with them to battle, and when he was on the road, Nimrod strengthened the hearts of the people that went with him.

verses.raw: And he said to them, Do not fear, neither be alarmed, for all our enemies will be delivered into our hands, and you may do with them as you please.
verses.text: And he said to them, Do not fear, neither be alarmed, for all our enemies will be delivered into our hands, and you may do with them as you please.

verses.raw: And all the men that went were about five hundred, and they fought against their enemies, and they destroyed them, and subdued them, and Nimrod placed standing officers over them in their respective places.
verses.text: And all the men that went were about five hundred, and they fought against their enemies, and they destroyed them, and subdued them, and Nimrod placed standing officers over them in their respective places.

verses.raw: And he took some of their children as security, and they were all servants to Nimrod and to his brethren, and Nimrod and all the people that were with him turned homeward.
verses.text: And he took some of their children as security, and they were all servants to Nimrod and to his brethren, and Nimrod and all the people that were with him turned homeward.

verses.raw: And when Nimrod had joyfully returned from battle, after having conquered his enemies, all his brethren, together with those who knew him before, assembled to make him king over them, and they placed the regal crown upon his head.
verses.text: And when Nimrod had joyfully returned from battle, after having conquered his enemies, all his brethren, together with those who knew him before, assembled to make him king over them, and they placed the regal crown upon his head.

verses.raw: And he set over his subjects and people, princes, judges, and rulers, as is the custom amongst kings.
verses.text: And he set over his subjects and people, princes, judges, and rulers, as is the custom amongst kings.

verses.raw: And he placed Terah the son of Nahor the prince of his host, and he dignified him and elevated him above all his princes.
verses.text: And he placed Terah the son of Nahor the prince of his host, and he dignified him and elevated him above all his princes.

verses.raw: And whilst he was reigning according to his heart’s desire, after having conquered all his enemies around, he advised with his counselors to build a city for his palace, and they did so.
verses.text: And whilst he was reigning according to his heart’s desire, after having conquered all his enemies around, he advised with his counselors to build a city for his palace, and they did so.

verses.raw: And they found a large valley opposite to the east, and they built him a large and extensive city, and Nimrod called the name of the city that he built Shinar, for Yahuah (the Lord) had vehemently shaken his enemies and destroyed them.
verses.text: And they found a large valley opposite to the east, and they built him a large and extensive city, and Nimrod called the name of the city that he built Shinar, for Yahuah (the Lord) had vehemently shaken his enemies and destroyed them.

verses.raw: And Nimrod dwelt in Shinar, and he reigned securely, and he fought with his enemies and he subdued them, and he prospered in all his battles, and his kingdom became very great.
verses.text: And Nimrod dwelt in Shinar, and he reigned securely, and he fought with his enemies and he subdued them, and he prospered in all his battles, and his kingdom became very great.

verses.raw: And all nations and tongues heard of his fame, and they gathered themselves to him, and they bowed down to the earth, and they brought him offerings, and he became their Lord and king, and they all dwelt with him in the city at Shinar, and Nimrod reigned in the earth over all the sons of Noah, and they were all under his power and counsel.
verses.text: And all nations and tongues heard of his fame, and they gathered themselves to him, and they bowed down to the earth, and they brought him offerings, and he became their Lord and king, and they all dwelt with him in the city at Shinar, and Nimrod reigned in the earth over all the sons of Noah, and they were all under his power and counsel.

verses.raw: And all the earth was of one tongue and words of union, but Nimrod did not go in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and he was more wicked than all the men that were before him, from the days of the flood until those days.
verses.text: And all the earth was of one tongue and words of union, but Nimrod did not go in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and he was more wicked than all the men that were before him, from the days of the flood until those days.

verses.raw: And he made gods of wood and stone, and he bowed down to them, and he rebelled against Yahuah (the Lord), and taught all his subjects and the people of the earth his wicked ways; and Mardon his son was more wicked than his father.
verses.text: And he made gods of wood and stone, and he bowed down to them, and he rebelled against Yahuah (the Lord), and taught all his subjects and the people of the earth his wicked ways; and Mardon his son was more wicked than his father.

verses.raw: And every one that heard of the acts of Mardon the son of Nimrod would say, concerning him, From the wicked goes forth wickedness; therefore it became a proverb in the whole earth, saying, From the wicked goes forth wickedness, and it was current in the words of men from that time to this.
verses.text: And every one that heard of the acts of Mardon the son of Nimrod would say, concerning him, From the wicked goes forth wickedness; therefore it became a proverb in the whole earth, saying, From the wicked goes forth wickedness, and it was current in the words of men from that time to this.

verses.raw: And Terah the son of Nahor, prince of Nimrod’s host, was in those days very great in the sight of the king and his subjects, and the king and princes loved him, and they elevated him very high.
verses.text: And Terah the son of Nahor, prince of Nimrod’s host, was in those days very great in the sight of the king and his subjects, and the king and princes loved him, and they elevated him very high.

verses.raw: And Terah took a wife and her name was Amthelo the daughter of Cornebo; and the wife of Terah conceived and bare him a son in those days.
verses.text: And Terah took a wife and her name was Amthelo the daughter of Cornebo; and the wife of Terah conceived and bare him a son in those days.

verses.raw: Terah was seventy years old when he begat him, and Terah called the name of his son that was born to him Abram, because the king had raised him in those days, and dignified him above all his princes that were with him.
verses.text: Terah was seventy years old when he begat him, and Terah called the name of his son that was born to him Abram, because the king had raised him in those days, and dignified him above all his princes that were with him.

verses.raw: And it was in the night that Abram was born, that all the servants of Terah, and all the wise men of Nimrod, and his conjurors came and ate and drank in the house of Terah, and they rejoiced with him on that night.
verses.text: And it was in the night that Abram was born, that all the servants of Terah, and all the wise men of Nimrod, and his conjurors came and ate and drank in the house of Terah, and they rejoiced with him on that night.

verses.raw: And when all the wise men and conjurors went out from the house of Terah, they lifted up their eyes toward heaven that night to look at the stars, and they saw, and behold one very large star came from the east and ran in the heavens, and he swallowed up the four stars from the four sides of the heavens.
verses.text: And when all the wise men and conjurors went out from the house of Terah, they lifted up their eyes toward heaven that night to look at the stars, and they saw, and behold one very large star came from the east and ran in the heavens, and he swallowed up the four stars from the four sides of the heavens.

verses.raw: And all the wise men of the king and his conjurors were astonished at the sight, and the sages understood this matter, and they knew its import.
verses.text: And all the wise men of the king and his conjurors were astonished at the sight, and the sages understood this matter, and they knew its import.

verses.raw: And they said to each other, This only betokens the child that has been born to Terah this night, who will grow up and be fruitful, and multiply, and possess all the earth, he and his children for ever, and he and his seed will slay great kings, and inherit their lands.
verses.text: And they said to each other, This only betokens the child that has been born to Terah this night, who will grow up and be fruitful, and multiply, and possess all the earth, he and his children for ever, and he and his seed will slay great kings, and inherit their lands.

verses.raw: And the wise men and conjurors went home that night, and in the morning all these wise men and conjurors rose up early, and assembled in an appointed house.
verses.text: And the wise men and conjurors went home that night, and in the morning all these wise men and conjurors rose up early, and assembled in an appointed house.

verses.raw: And they spoke and said to each other, Behold the sight that we saw last night is hidden from the king, it has not been made known to him.
verses.text: And they spoke and said to each other, Behold the sight that we saw last night is hidden from the king, it has not been made known to him.

verses.raw: And should this thing get known to the king in the latter days, he will say to us, Why have you concealed this matter from me, and then we shall all suffer death; therefore, now let us go and tell the king the sight which we saw, and the interpretation of it, and we shall then remain clear.
verses.text: And should this thing get known to the king in the latter days, he will say to us, Why have you concealed this matter from me, and then we shall all suffer death; therefore, now let us go and tell the king the sight which we saw, and the interpretation of it, and we shall then remain clear.

verses.raw: And they did so, and they all went to the king and bowed down to him to the ground, and they said, May the king live, may the king live.
verses.text: And they did so, and they all went to the king and bowed down to him to the ground, and they said, May the king live, may the king live.

verses.raw: We heard that a son was born to Terah the son of Nahor, the prince of your host, and we yesternight came to his house, and we ate and drank and rejoiced with him that night.
verses.text: We heard that a son was born to Terah the son of Nahor, the prince of your host, and we yesternight came to his house, and we ate and drank and rejoiced with him that night.

verses.raw: And when your servants went out from the house of Terah, to go to our respective homes to abide there for the night, we lifted up our eyes to heaven, and we saw a great star coming from the east, and the same star ran with great speed, and swallowed up four great stars, from the four sides of the heavens.
verses.text: And when your servants went out from the house of Terah, to go to our respective homes to abide there for the night, we lifted up our eyes to heaven, and we saw a great star coming from the east, and the same star ran with great speed, and swallowed up four great stars, from the four sides of the heavens.

verses.raw: And your servants were astonished at the sight which we saw, and were greatly terrified, and we made our judgment upon the sight, and knew by our wisdom the proper interpretation of it, that this thing applies to the child that is born to Terah, who will grow up and multiply greatly, and become powerful, and kill all the kings of the earth, and inherit all their lands, he and his seed forever.
verses.text: And your servants were astonished at the sight which we saw, and were greatly terrified, and we made our judgment upon the sight, and knew by our wisdom the proper interpretation of it, that this thing applies to the child that is born to Terah, who will grow up and multiply greatly, and become powerful, and kill all the kings of the earth, and inherit all their lands, he and his seed forever.

verses.raw: And now our Lord and king, behold we have truly acquainted you with what we have seen concerning this child.
verses.text: And now our Lord and king, behold we have truly acquainted you with what we have seen concerning this child.

verses.raw: If it seems good to the king to give his father value for this child, we will slay him before he shall grow up and increase in the land, and his evil increase against us, that we and our children perish through his evil.
verses.text: If it seems good to the king to give his father value for this child, we will slay him before he shall grow up and increase in the land, and his evil increase against us, that we and our children perish through his evil.

verses.raw: And the king heard their words and they seemed good in his sight, and he sent and called for Terah, and Terah came before the king.
verses.text: And the king heard their words and they seemed good in his sight, and he sent and called for Terah, and Terah came before the king.

verses.raw: And the king said to Terah, I have been told that a son was yesternight born to you, and after this manner was observed in the heavens at his birth.
verses.text: And the king said to Terah, I have been told that a son was yesternight born to you, and after this manner was observed in the heavens at his birth.

verses.raw: And now therefore give me the child, that we may slay him before his evil springs up against us, and I will give you for his value, your house full of silver and gold.
verses.text: And now therefore give me the child, that we may slay him before his evil springs up against us, and I will give you for his value, your house full of silver and gold.

verses.raw: And Terah answered the king and said to him: My Lord and king, I have heard your words, and your servant shall do all that his king desires.
verses.text: And Terah answered the king and said to him: My Lord and king, I have heard your words, and your servant shall do all that his king desires.

verses.raw: But my Lord and king, I will tell you what happened to me yesternight, that I may see what advice the king will give his servant, and then I will answer the king upon what he has just spoken; and the king said, Speak.
verses.text: But my Lord and king, I will tell you what happened to me yesternight, that I may see what advice the king will give his servant, and then I will answer the king upon what he has just spoken; and the king said, Speak.

verses.raw: And Terah said to the king, Ayon, son of Mored, came to me yesternight, saying,
verses.text: And Terah said to the king, Ayon, son of Mored, came to me yesternight, saying,

verses.raw: Give to me the great and beautiful horse that the king gave you, and I will give you silver and gold, and straw and provender for its value; and I said to him, Wait till I see the king concerning your words, and behold whatever the king says, that will I do.
verses.text: Give to me the great and beautiful horse that the king gave you, and I will give you silver and gold, and straw and provender for its value; and I said to him, Wait till I see the king concerning your words, and behold whatever the king says, that will I do.

verses.raw: And now my Lord and king, behold I have made this thing known to you, and the advice which my king will give to his servant, that will I follow.
verses.text: And now my Lord and king, behold I have made this thing known to you, and the advice which my king will give to his servant, that will I follow.

verses.raw: And the king heard the words of Terah, and his anger was kindled and he considered him in the light of a fool.
verses.text: And the king heard the words of Terah, and his anger was kindled and he considered him in the light of a fool.

verses.raw: And the king answered Terah, and he said to him, Are you so silly, ignorant, or deficient in understanding, to do this thing, to give your beautiful horse for silver and gold or even for straw and provender?
verses.text: And the king answered Terah, and he said to him, Are you so silly, ignorant, or deficient in understanding, to do this thing, to give your beautiful horse for silver and gold or even for straw and provender?

verses.raw: Are you so short of silver and gold, that you should do this thing, because you can not obtain straw and provender to feed your horse? and what is silver and gold to you, or straw and provender, that you should give away that fine horse which I gave you, like which there is none to be had on the whole earth?
verses.text: Are you so short of silver and gold, that you should do this thing, because you can not obtain straw and provender to feed your horse? and what is silver and gold to you, or straw and provender, that you should give away that fine horse which I gave you, like which there is none to be had on the whole earth?

verses.raw: And the king left off speaking, and Terah answered the king, saying, Like to this has the king spoken to his servant;
verses.text: And the king left off speaking, and Terah answered the king, saying, Like to this has the king spoken to his servant;

verses.raw: I beseech you, my Lord and king, what is this which you did say to me, saying, Give your son that we may slay him, and I will give you silver and gold for his value; what shall I do with silver and gold after the death of my son? who shall inherit me? surely then at my death, the silver and gold will return to my king who gave it.
verses.text: I beseech you, my Lord and king, what is this which you did say to me, saying, Give your son that we may slay him, and I will give you silver and gold for his value; what shall I do with silver and gold after the death of my son? who shall inherit me? surely then at my death, the silver and gold will return to my king who gave it.

verses.raw: And when the king heard the words of Terah, and the parable which he brought concerning the king, it grieved him greatly and he was vexed at this thing, and his anger burned within him.
verses.text: And when the king heard the words of Terah, and the parable which he brought concerning the king, it grieved him greatly and he was vexed at this thing, and his anger burned within him.

verses.raw: And Terah saw that the anger of the king was kindled against him, and he answered the king, saying, All that I have is in the king’s power; whatever the king desires to do to his servant, that let him do, yea, even my son, he is in the king’s power, without value in exchange, he and his two brothers that are older than he.
verses.text: And Terah saw that the anger of the king was kindled against him, and he answered the king, saying, All that I have is in the king’s power; whatever the king desires to do to his servant, that let him do, yea, even my son, he is in the king’s power, without value in exchange, he and his two brothers that are older than he.

verses.raw: And the king said to Terah, No, but I will purchase your younger son for a price.
verses.text: And the king said to Terah, No, but I will purchase your younger son for a price.

verses.raw: And Terah answered the king, saying, I beseech you my Lord and king to let your servant speak a word before you, and let the king hear the word of his servant, and Terah said, Let my king give me three days’ time till I consider this matter within myself, and consult with my family concerning the words of my king; and he pressed the king greatly to agree to this.
verses.text: And Terah answered the king, saying, I beseech you my Lord and king to let your servant speak a word before you, and let the king hear the word of his servant, and Terah said, Let my king give me three days’ time till I consider this matter within myself, and consult with my family concerning the words of my king; and he pressed the king greatly to agree to this.

verses.raw: And the king hearkened to Terah, and he did so and he gave him three days’ time, and Terah went out from the king’s presence, and he came home to his family and spoke to them all the words of the king; and the people were greatly afraid.
verses.text: And the king hearkened to Terah, and he did so and he gave him three days’ time, and Terah went out from the king’s presence, and he came home to his family and spoke to them all the words of the king; and the people were greatly afraid.

verses.raw: And it was in the third day that the king sent to Terah, saying, Send me your son for a price as I spoke to you; and should you not do this, I will send and slay all you have in your house, so that you shall not even have a dog remaining.
verses.text: And it was in the third day that the king sent to Terah, saying, Send me your son for a price as I spoke to you; and should you not do this, I will send and slay all you have in your house, so that you shall not even have a dog remaining.

verses.raw: And Terah hastened, (as the thing was urgent from the king), and he took a child from one of his servants, which his handmaid had born to him that day, and Terah brought the child to the king and received value for him.
verses.text: And Terah hastened, (as the thing was urgent from the king), and he took a child from one of his servants, which his handmaid had born to him that day, and Terah brought the child to the king and received value for him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with Terah in this matter, that Nimrod might not cause Abram’s death, and the king took the child from Terah and with all his might dashed his head to the ground, for he thought it had been Abram; and this was concealed from him from that day, and it was forgotten by the king, as it was the will of Providence not to suffer Abram’s death.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with Terah in this matter, that Nimrod might not cause Abram’s death, and the king took the child from Terah and with all his might dashed his head to the ground, for he thought it had been Abram; and this was concealed from him from that day, and it was forgotten by the king, as it was the will of Providence not to suffer Abram’s death.

verses.raw: And Terah took Abram his son secretly, together with his mother and nurse, and he concealed them in a cave, and he brought them their provisions monthly.
verses.text: And Terah took Abram his son secretly, together with his mother and nurse, and he concealed them in a cave, and he brought them their provisions monthly.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with Abram in the cave and he grew up, and Abram was in the cave ten years, and the king and his princes, soothsayers and sages, thought that the king had killed Abram.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with Abram in the cave and he grew up, and Abram was in the cave ten years, and the king and his princes, soothsayers and sages, thought that the king had killed Abram.

verses.raw: And Haran, the son of Terah, Abram’s oldest brother, took a wife in those days.
verses.text: And Haran, the son of Terah, Abram’s oldest brother, took a wife in those days.

verses.raw: Haran was thirty-nine years old when he took her; and the wife of Haran conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Lot.
verses.text: Haran was thirty-nine years old when he took her; and the wife of Haran conceived and bare a son, and he called his name Lot.

verses.raw: And she conceived again and bare a daughter, and she called her name Milca; and she again conceived and bare a daughter, and she called her name Sarai.
verses.text: And she conceived again and bare a daughter, and she called her name Milca; and she again conceived and bare a daughter, and she called her name Sarai.

verses.raw: Haran was forty-two years old when he begat Sarai, which was in the tenth year of the life of Abram; and in those days Abram and his mother and nurse went out from the cave, as the king and his subjects had forgotten the affair of Abram.
verses.text: Haran was forty-two years old when he begat Sarai, which was in the tenth year of the life of Abram; and in those days Abram and his mother and nurse went out from the cave, as the king and his subjects had forgotten the affair of Abram.

verses.raw: And when Abram came out from the cave, he went to Noah and his son Shem, and he remained with them to learn the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord) and his ways, and no man knew where Abram was, and Abram served Noah and Shem his son for a long time.
verses.text: And when Abram came out from the cave, he went to Noah and his son Shem, and he remained with them to learn the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord) and his ways, and no man knew where Abram was, and Abram served Noah and Shem his son for a long time.

verses.raw: And Abram was in Noah’s house thirty-nine years, and Abram knew Yahuah (the Lord) from three years old, and he went in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) until the day of his death, as Noah and his son Shem had taught him; and all the sons of the earth in those days greatly transgressed against Yahuah (the Lord), and they rebelled against him and they served other gods, and they forgot Yahuah (the Lord) who had created them in the earth; and the inhabitants of the earth made to themselves, at that time, every man his god; gods of wood and stone which could neither speak, hear, nor deliver, and the sons of men served them and they became their gods.
verses.text: And Abram was in Noah’s house thirty-nine years, and Abram knew Yahuah (the Lord) from three years old, and he went in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) until the day of his death, as Noah and his son Shem had taught him; and all the sons of the earth in those days greatly transgressed against Yahuah (the Lord), and they rebelled against him and they served other gods, and they forgot Yahuah (the Lord) who had created them in the earth; and the inhabitants of the earth made to themselves, at that time, every man his god; gods of wood and stone which could neither speak, hear, nor deliver, and the sons of men served them and they became their gods.

verses.raw: And the king and all his servants, and Terah with all his household were then the first of those that served gods of wood and stone.
verses.text: And the king and all his servants, and Terah with all his household were then the first of those that served gods of wood and stone.

verses.raw: And Terah had twelve gods of large size, made of wood and stone, after the twelve months of the year, and he served each one monthly, and every month Terah would bring his meat offering and drink offering to his gods; thus did Terah all the days.
verses.text: And Terah had twelve gods of large size, made of wood and stone, after the twelve months of the year, and he served each one monthly, and every month Terah would bring his meat offering and drink offering to his gods; thus did Terah all the days.

verses.raw: And all that generation were wicked in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and they thus made every man his god, but they forsook Yahuah (the Lord) who had created them.
verses.text: And all that generation were wicked in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and they thus made every man his god, but they forsook Yahuah (the Lord) who had created them.

verses.raw: And there was not a man found in those days in the whole earth, who knew Yahuah (for they served each man his own Elohim (God)) except Noah and his household, and all those who were under his counsel knew Yahuah (the Lord) in those days.
verses.text: And there was not a man found in those days in the whole earth, who knew Yahuah (for they served each man his own Elohim) except Noah and his household, and all those who were under his counsel knew Yahuah (the Lord) in those days.

verses.raw: And Abram the son of Terah was waxing great in those days in the house of Noah, and no man knew it, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with him.
verses.text: And Abram the son of Terah was waxing great in those days in the house of Noah, and no man knew it, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave Abram an understanding heart, and he knew all the works of that generation were vain, and that all their gods were vain and were of no avail.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave Abram an understanding heart, and he knew all the works of that generation were vain, and that all their gods were vain and were of no avail.

verses.raw: And Abram saw the sun shining upon the earth, and Abram said to himself Surely now this sun that shines upon the earth is Elohim, and him will I serve.
verses.text: And Abram saw the sun shining upon the earth, and Abram said to himself Surely now this sun that shines upon the earth is Elohim, and him will I serve.

verses.raw: And Abram served the sun in that day and he prayed to him, and when evening came the sun set as usual, and Abram said within himself, Surely this cannot be Elohim?
verses.text: And Abram served the sun in that day and he prayed to him, and when evening came the sun set as usual, and Abram said within himself, Surely this cannot be Elohim?

verses.raw: And Abram still continued to speak within himself, Who is he who made the heavens and the earth? who created upon earth? where is he?
verses.text: And Abram still continued to speak within himself, Who is he who made the heavens and the earth? who created upon earth? where is he?

verses.raw: And night darkened over him, and he lifted up his eyes toward the west, north, south, and east, and he saw that the sun had vanished from the earth, and the day became dark.
verses.text: And night darkened over him, and he lifted up his eyes toward the west, north, south, and east, and he saw that the sun had vanished from the earth, and the day became dark.

verses.raw: And Abram saw the stars and moon before him, and he said, Surely this is the Elohim who created the whole earth as well as man, and behold these his servants are gods around him: and Abram served the moon and prayed to it all that night.
verses.text: And Abram saw the stars and moon before him, and he said, Surely this is the Elohim who created the whole earth as well as man, and behold these his servants are gods around him: and Abram served the moon and prayed to it all that night.

verses.raw: And in the morning when it was light and the sun shone upon the earth as usual, Abram saw all the things that Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) had made upon earth.
verses.text: And in the morning when it was light and the sun shone upon the earth as usual, Abram saw all the things that Yahuah Elohim had made upon earth.

verses.raw: And Abram said to himself Surely these are not gods that made the earth and all mankind, but these are the servants of Elohim, and Abram remained in the house of Noah and there knew Yahuah (the Lord) and his ways’ and he served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of his life, and all that generation forgot Yahuah (the Lord), and served other gods of wood and stone, and rebelled all their days.

verses.raw: And king Nimrod reigned securely, and all the earth was under his control, and all the earth was of one tongue and words of union.

verses.raw: And all the princes of Nimrod and his great men took counsel together; Phut, Mitzraim, Cush and Canaan with their families, and they said to each other, Come let us build ourselves a city and in it a strong tower, and its top reaching heaven, and we will make ourselves famed, so that we may reign upon the whole world, in order that the evil of our enemies may cease from us, that we may reign mightily over them, and that we may not become scattered over the earth on account of their wars.

verses.raw: And all the families assembled consisting of about six hundred thousand men, and they went to seek an extensive piece of ground to build the city and the tower, and they sought in the whole earth and they found none like one valley at the east of the land of Shinar, about two days’ walk, and they journeyed there and they dwelt there.

verses.raw: And they began to make bricks and burn fires to build the city and the tower that they had imagined to complete.

verses.raw: And the building of the tower was to them a transgression and a sin, and they began to build it, and whilst they were building against Yahuah Elohim of heaven, they imagined in their hearts to war against him and to ascend into heaven.

verses.raw: And all these people and all the families divided themselves in three parts; the first said We will ascend into heaven and fight against him; the second said, We will ascend to heaven and place our own gods there and serve them; and the third part said, We will ascend to heaven and smite him with bows and spears; and Elohim knew all their works and all their evil thoughts, and he saw the city and the tower which they were building.

verses.raw: And when they were building they built themselves a great city and a very high and strong tower; and on account of its height the mortar and bricks did not reach the builders in their ascent to it, until those who went up had completed a full year, and after that, they reached to the builders and gave them the mortar and the bricks; thus was it done daily.

verses.raw: And behold these ascended and others descended the whole day; and if a brick should fall from their hands and get broken, they would all weep over it, and if a man fell and died, none of them would look at him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) knew their thoughts, and it came to pass when they were building they cast the arrows toward the heavens, and all the arrows fell upon them filled with blood, and when they saw them they said to each other, Surely we have slain all those that are in heaven.

verses.raw: For this was from Yahuah (the Lord) in order to cause them to err, and in order; to destroy them from off the face of the ground.

verses.raw: And Elohim said to the seventy angels who stood foremost before him, to those who were near to him, saying, Come let us descend and confuse their tongues, that one man shall not understand the language of his neighbor, and they did so to them.

verses.raw: And from that day following, they forgot each man his neighbor’s tongue, and they could not understand to speak in one tongue, and when the builder took from the hands of his neighbor lime or stone which he did not order, the builder would cast it away and throw it upon his neighbor, that he would die.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) smote the three divisions that were there, and he punished them according to their works and designs; those who said, We will ascend to heaven and serve our gods, became like apes and elephants; and those who said, We will smite the heaven with arrows, Yahuah (the Lord) killed them, one man through the hand of his neighbor; and the third division of those who said, We will ascend to heaven and fight against him, Yahuah (the Lord) scattered them throughout the earth.

verses.raw: And those who were left amongst them, when they knew and understood the evil which was coming upon them, they forsook the building, and they also became scattered upon the face of the whole earth.

verses.raw: And they ceased building the city and the tower; therefore he called that place Babel, for there Yahuah (the Lord) confounded the Language of the whole earth; behold it was at the east of the land of Shinar.

verses.raw: And as to the tower which the sons of men built, the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up one third part of it, and a fire also descended from heaven and burned another third, and the other third is left to this day, and it is of that part which was aloft, and its circumference is three days’ walk.

verses.raw: And many of the sons of men died in that tower, a people without number.
