verses.raw: And Abram came to his father’s house and saw twelve gods standing there in their temples, and the anger of Abram was kindled when he saw these images in his father’s house.
verses.text: And Abram came to his father’s house and saw twelve gods standing there in their temples, and the anger of Abram was kindled when he saw these images in his father’s house.

verses.raw: And Abram said, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives these images shall not remain in my father’s house; so shall Yahuah (the Lord) who created me do to me if in three days’ time I do not break them all.
verses.text: And Abram said, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives these images shall not remain in my father’s house; so shall Yahuah (the Lord) who created me do to me if in three days’ time I do not break them all.

verses.raw: And Abram went from them, and his anger burned within him. And Abram hastened and went from the chamber to his father’s outer court, and he found his father sitting in the court, and all his servants with him, and Abram came and sat before him.
verses.text: And Abram went from them, and his anger burned within him. And Abram hastened and went from the chamber to his father’s outer court, and he found his father sitting in the court, and all his servants with him, and Abram came and sat before him.

verses.raw: And Abram asked his father, saying, Father, tell me where is Elohim who created heaven and earth, and all the sons of men upon earth, and who created you and me. And Terah answered his son Abram and said, Behold those who created us are all with us in the house.
verses.text: And Abram asked his father, saying, Father, tell me where is Elohim who created heaven and earth, and all the sons of men upon earth, and who created you and me. And Terah answered his son Abram and said, Behold those who created us are all with us in the house.

verses.raw: And Abram said to his father, My Lord, shew them to me I pray you; and Terah brought Abram into the chamber of the inner court, and Abram saw, and behold the whole room was full of gods of wood and stone, twelve great images and others less than they without number.
verses.text: And Abram said to his father, My Lord, shew them to me I pray you; and Terah brought Abram into the chamber of the inner court, and Abram saw, and behold the whole room was full of gods of wood and stone, twelve great images and others less than they without number.

verses.raw: And Terah said to his son, Behold these are they which made all you see upon earth, and which created me and you, and all mankind.
verses.text: And Terah said to his son, Behold these are they which made all you see upon earth, and which created me and you, and all mankind.

verses.raw: And Terah bowed down to his gods, and he then went away from them, and Abram, his son, went away with him.
verses.text: And Terah bowed down to his gods, and he then went away from them, and Abram, his son, went away with him.

verses.raw: And when Abram had gone from them he went to his mother and sat before her, and he said to his mother, Behold, my father has shown me those who made heaven and earth, and all the sons of men.
verses.text: And when Abram had gone from them he went to his mother and sat before her, and he said to his mother, Behold, my father has shown me those who made heaven and earth, and all the sons of men.

verses.raw: Now, therefore, hasten and fetch a kid from the flock, and make of it savory meat, that I may bring it to my father’s gods as an offering for them to eat; perhaps I may thereby become acceptable to them.
verses.text: Now, therefore, hasten and fetch a kid from the flock, and make of it savory meat, that I may bring it to my father’s gods as an offering for them to eat; perhaps I may thereby become acceptable to them.

verses.raw: And his mother did so, and she fetched a kid, and made savory meat of it, and brought it to Abram, and Abram took the savory meat from his mother and brought it before his father’s gods, and he drew nigh to them that they might eat; and Terah his father, did not know of it.
verses.text: And his mother did so, and she fetched a kid, and made savory meat of it, and brought it to Abram, and Abram took the savory meat from his mother and brought it before his father’s gods, and he drew nigh to them that they might eat; and Terah his father, did not know of it.

verses.raw: And Abram saw on the day when he was sitting amongst them, that they had no voice, no hearing, no motion, and not one of them could stretch forth his hand to eat.
verses.text: And Abram saw on the day when he was sitting amongst them, that they had no voice, no hearing, no motion, and not one of them could stretch forth his hand to eat.

verses.raw: And Abram mocked them, and said, Surely the savory meat that I prepared has not pleased them, or perhaps it was too little for them, and for that reason they would not eat; therefore tomorrow I will prepare fresh savory meat, better and more plentiful than this, in order that I may see the result.
verses.text: And Abram mocked them, and said, Surely the savory meat that I prepared has not pleased them, or perhaps it was too little for them, and for that reason they would not eat; therefore tomorrow I will prepare fresh savory meat, better and more plentiful than this, in order that I may see the result.

verses.raw: And it was on the next day that Abram directed his mother concerning the savory meat, and his mother rose and fetched three fine kids from the flock, and she made of them some excellent savory meat, such as her son was fond of, and she gave it to her son Abram; and Terah his father did not know of it.
verses.text: And it was on the next day that Abram directed his mother concerning the savory meat, and his mother rose and fetched three fine kids from the flock, and she made of them some excellent savory meat, such as her son was fond of, and she gave it to her son Abram; and Terah his father did not know of it.

verses.raw: And Abram took the savory meat from his mother, and brought it before his father’s gods into the chamber; and he came nigh to them that they might eat, and he placed it before them, and Abram sat before them all day, thinking perhaps they might eat.
verses.text: And Abram took the savory meat from his mother, and brought it before his father’s gods into the chamber; and he came nigh to them that they might eat, and he placed it before them, and Abram sat before them all day, thinking perhaps they might eat.

verses.raw: And Abram viewed them, and behold they had neither voice nor hearing, nor did one of them stretch forth his hand to the meat to eat.
verses.text: And Abram viewed them, and behold they had neither voice nor hearing, nor did one of them stretch forth his hand to the meat to eat.

verses.raw: And in the evening of that day in that house Abram was clothed with the spirit of Elohim.
verses.text: And in the evening of that day in that house Abram was clothed with the spirit of Elohim.

verses.raw: And he called out and said, Wo to my father and this wicked generation, whose hearts are all inclined to vanity, who serve these idols of wood and stone which can neither eat, smell, hear nor speak, who have mouths without speech, eyes without sight, ears without hearing, hands without feeling, and legs which cannot move; like them are those that made them and that trust in them.
verses.text: And he called out and said, Wo to my father and this wicked generation, whose hearts are all inclined to vanity, who serve these idols of wood and stone which can neither eat, smell, hear nor speak, who have mouths without speech, eyes without sight, ears without hearing, hands without feeling, and legs which cannot move; like them are those that made them and that trust in them.

verses.raw: And when Abram saw all these things his anger was kindled against his father, and he hastened and took a hatchet in his hand, and came to the chamber of the gods, and he broke all his father’s gods.
verses.text: And when Abram saw all these things his anger was kindled against his father, and he hastened and took a hatchet in his hand, and came to the chamber of the gods, and he broke all his father’s gods.

verses.raw: And when he had done breaking the images, he placed the hatchet in the hand of the great god which was there before them, and he went out; and Terah his father came home, for he had heard at the door the sound of the striking of the hatchet; so Terah came into the house to know what this was about.
verses.text: And when he had done breaking the images, he placed the hatchet in the hand of the great god which was there before them, and he went out; and Terah his father came home, for he had heard at the door the sound of the striking of the hatchet; so Terah came into the house to know what this was about.

verses.raw: And Terah, having heard the noise of the hatchet in the room of images, ran to the room to the images, and he met Abram going out.
verses.text: And Terah, having heard the noise of the hatchet in the room of images, ran to the room to the images, and he met Abram going out.

verses.raw: And Terah entered the room and found all the idols fallen down and broken, and the hatchet in the hand of the largest, which was not broken, and the savory meat which Abram his son had made was still before them.
verses.text: And Terah entered the room and found all the idols fallen down and broken, and the hatchet in the hand of the largest, which was not broken, and the savory meat which Abram his son had made was still before them.

verses.raw: And when Terah saw this his anger was greatly kindled, and he hastened and went from the room to Abram.
verses.text: And when Terah saw this his anger was greatly kindled, and he hastened and went from the room to Abram.

verses.raw: And he found Abram his son still sitting in the house; and he said to him, What is this work you have done to my gods?
verses.text: And he found Abram his son still sitting in the house; and he said to him, What is this work you have done to my gods?

verses.raw: And Abram answered Terah his father and he said, Not so my Lord, for I brought savory meat before them, and when I came nigh to them with the meat that they might eat, they all at once stretched forth their hands to eat before the great one had put forth his hand to eat.
verses.text: And Abram answered Terah his father and he said, Not so my Lord, for I brought savory meat before them, and when I came nigh to them with the meat that they might eat, they all at once stretched forth their hands to eat before the great one had put forth his hand to eat.

verses.raw: And the large one saw their works that they did before him, and his anger was violently kindled against them, and he went and took the hatchet that was in the house and came to them and broke them all, and behold the hatchet is yet in his hand as you see.
verses.text: And the large one saw their works that they did before him, and his anger was violently kindled against them, and he went and took the hatchet that was in the house and came to them and broke them all, and behold the hatchet is yet in his hand as you see.

verses.raw: And Terah’s anger was kindled against his son Abram, when he spoke this; and Terah said to Abram his son in his anger, What is this tale that you have told? You speak lies to me.
verses.text: And Terah’s anger was kindled against his son Abram, when he spoke this; and Terah said to Abram his son in his anger, What is this tale that you have told? You speak lies to me.

verses.raw: Is there in these gods spirit, soul or power to do all you have told me? Are they not wood and stone, and have I not myself made them, and can you speak such lies, saying that the large god that was with them smote them? It is you that did place the hatchet in his hands, and then say he smote them all.
verses.text: Is there in these gods spirit, soul or power to do all you have told me? Are they not wood and stone, and have I not myself made them, and can you speak such lies, saying that the large god that was with them smote them? It is you that did place the hatchet in his hands, and then say he smote them all.

verses.raw: And Abram answered his father and said to him, And how can you then serve these idols in whom there is no power to do any thing? Can those idols in which you trust deliver you? can they hear your prayers when you call upon them? can they deliver you from the hands of your enemies, or will they fight your battles for you against your enemies, that you should serve wood and stone which can neither speak nor hear?
verses.text: And Abram answered his father and said to him, And how can you then serve these idols in whom there is no power to do any thing? Can those idols in which you trust deliver you? can they hear your prayers when you call upon them? can they deliver you from the hands of your enemies, or will they fight your battles for you against your enemies, that you should serve wood and stone which can neither speak nor hear?

verses.raw: And now surely it is not good for you nor for the sons of men that are connected with you, to do these things; are you so silly, so foolish or so short of understanding that you will serve wood and stone, and do after this manner?
verses.text: And now surely it is not good for you nor for the sons of men that are connected with you, to do these things; are you so silly, so foolish or so short of understanding that you will serve wood and stone, and do after this manner?

verses.raw: And forget Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) who made heaven and earth, and who created you in the earth, and thereby bring a great evil upon your souls in this matter by serving stone and wood?
verses.text: And forget Yahuah Elohim who made heaven and earth, and who created you in the earth, and thereby bring a great evil upon your souls in this matter by serving stone and wood?

verses.raw: Did not our fathers in days of old sin in this matter, and Yahuah Elohim of the universe brought the waters of the flood upon them and destroyed the whole earth?
verses.text: Did not our fathers in days of old sin in this matter, and Yahuah Elohim of the universe brought the waters of the flood upon them and destroyed the whole earth?

verses.raw: And how can you continue to do this and serve gods of wood and stone, who cannot hear, or speak, or deliver you from oppression, thereby bringing down the anger of the Elohim of the universe upon you?
verses.text: And how can you continue to do this and serve gods of wood and stone, who cannot hear, or speak, or deliver you from oppression, thereby bringing down the anger of the Elohim of the universe upon you?

verses.raw: Now therefore my father refrain from this, and bring not evil upon your soul and the souls of your household.
verses.text: Now therefore my father refrain from this, and bring not evil upon your soul and the souls of your household.

verses.raw: And Abram hastened and sprang from before his father, and took the hatchet from his father’s largest idol, with which Abram broke it and ran away.
verses.text: And Abram hastened and sprang from before his father, and took the hatchet from his father’s largest idol, with which Abram broke it and ran away.

verses.raw: And Terah, seeing all that Abram had done, hastened to go from his house, and he went to the king and he came before Nimrod and stood before him, and he bowed down to the king; and the king said, What dost you want?
verses.text: And Terah, seeing all that Abram had done, hastened to go from his house, and he went to the king and he came before Nimrod and stood before him, and he bowed down to the king; and the king said, What dost you want?

verses.raw: And he said, I beseech you my Lord, to hear me–Now fifty years back a child was born to me, and thus has he done to my gods and thus has he spoken; and now therefore, my Lord and king, send for him that he may come before you, and judge him according to the law, that we may be delivered from his evil.
verses.text: And he said, I beseech you my Lord, to hear me–Now fifty years back a child was born to me, and thus has he done to my gods and thus has he spoken; and now therefore, my Lord and king, send for him that he may come before you, and judge him according to the law, that we may be delivered from his evil.

verses.raw: And the king sent three men of his servants, and they went and brought Abram before the king. And Nimrod and all his princes and servants were that day sitting before him, and Terah sat also before them.
verses.text: And the king sent three men of his servants, and they went and brought Abram before the king. And Nimrod and all his princes and servants were that day sitting before him, and Terah sat also before them.

verses.raw: And the king said to Abram, What is this that you have done to your father and to his gods? And Abram answered the king in the words that he spoke to his father, and he said, The large god that was with them in the house did to them what you have heard.
verses.text: And the king said to Abram, What is this that you have done to your father and to his gods? And Abram answered the king in the words that he spoke to his father, and he said, The large god that was with them in the house did to them what you have heard.

verses.raw: And the king said to Abram, Had they power to speak and eat and do as you have said? And Abram answered the king, saying, And if there be no power in them why dost you serve them and cause the sons of men to err through your follies?
verses.text: And the king said to Abram, Had they power to speak and eat and do as you have said? And Abram answered the king, saying, And if there be no power in them why dost you serve them and cause the sons of men to err through your follies?

verses.raw: Dost you imagine that they can deliver you or do anything small or great, that you should serve them? And why will you not sense the Elohim of the whole universe, who created you and in whose power it is to kill and keep alive?
verses.text: Dost you imagine that they can deliver you or do anything small or great, that you should serve them? And why will you not sense the Elohim of the whole universe, who created you and in whose power it is to kill and keep alive?

verses.raw: 0 foolish, simple, and ignorant king, woe to you forever.
verses.text: 0 foolish, simple, and ignorant king, woe to you forever.

verses.raw: I thought you would teach your servants the upright way, but you have not done this, but have filled the whole earth with your sins and the sins of your people who have followed your ways.
verses.text: I thought you would teach your servants the upright way, but you have not done this, but have filled the whole earth with your sins and the sins of your people who have followed your ways.

verses.raw: Dost you not know, or have you not heard, that this evil which you do, our ancestors sinned in it in days of old, and the eternal Elohim brought the waters of the flood upon them and destroyed them all, and also destroyed the whole earth on their account? And will you and your people rise up now and do like to this work, in order to bring down the anger of Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) of the universe, and to bring evil upon you and the whole earth?
verses.text: Dost you not know, or have you not heard, that this evil which you do, our ancestors sinned in it in days of old, and the eternal Elohim brought the waters of the flood upon them and destroyed them all, and also destroyed the whole earth on their account? And will you and your people rise up now and do like to this work, in order to bring down the anger of Yahuah Elohim of the universe, and to bring evil upon you and the whole earth?

verses.raw: Now therefore put away this evil deed which you do, and serve the Elohim of the universe, as your soul is in his hands, and then it will be well with you.
verses.text: Now therefore put away this evil deed which you do, and serve the Elohim of the universe, as your soul is in his hands, and then it will be well with you.

verses.raw: And if your wicked heart will not hearken to my words to cause you to forsake your evil ways, and to serve the eternal Elohim, then will you die in shame in the latter days, you, your people and all who are connected with you, hearing your words or walking in your evil ways.
verses.text: And if your wicked heart will not hearken to my words to cause you to forsake your evil ways, and to serve the eternal Elohim, then will you die in shame in the latter days, you, your people and all who are connected with you, hearing your words or walking in your evil ways.

verses.raw: And when Abram had ceased speaking before the king and princes, Abram lifted up his eyes to the heavens, and he said, Yahuah (the Lord) sees all the wicked, and he will judge them.
verses.text: And when Abram had ceased speaking before the king and princes, Abram lifted up his eyes to the heavens, and he said, Yahuah (the Lord) sees all the wicked, and he will judge them.

verses.raw: And when the king heard the words of Abram he ordered him to be put into prison; and Abram was ten days in prison.
verses.text: And when the king heard the words of Abram he ordered him to be put into prison; and Abram was ten days in prison.

verses.raw: And at the end of those days the king ordered that all the kings, princes and governors of different provinces and the sages should come before him, and they sat before him, and Abram was still in the house of confinement.
verses.text: And at the end of those days the king ordered that all the kings, princes and governors of different provinces and the sages should come before him, and they sat before him, and Abram was still in the house of confinement.

verses.raw: And the king said to the princes and sages, Have you heard what Abram, the son of Terah, has done to his father? Thus has he done to him, and I ordered him to be brought before me, and thus has he spoken; his heart did not misgive him, neither did he stir in my presence, and behold now he is confined in the prison.
verses.text: And the king said to the princes and sages, Have you heard what Abram, the son of Terah, has done to his father? Thus has he done to him, and I ordered him to be brought before me, and thus has he spoken; his heart did not misgive him, neither did he stir in my presence, and behold now he is confined in the prison.

verses.raw: And therefore decide what judgment is due to this man who reviled the king; who spoke and did all the things that you heard.
verses.text: And therefore decide what judgment is due to this man who reviled the king; who spoke and did all the things that you heard.

verses.raw: And they all answered the king saying, The man who reviles the king should be hanged upon a tree; but having done all the things that he said, and having despised our gods, he must therefore be burned to death, for this is the law in this matter.
verses.text: And they all answered the king saying, The man who reviles the king should be hanged upon a tree; but having done all the things that he said, and having despised our gods, he must therefore be burned to death, for this is the law in this matter.

verses.raw: If it pleases the king to do this, let him order his servants to kindle a fire both night and day in your brick furnace, and then we will cast this man into it. And the king did so, and he commanded his servants that they should prepare a fire for three days and three nights in the king’s furnace, that is in Casdim; and the king ordered them to take Abram from prison and bring him out to be burned.
verses.text: If it pleases the king to do this, let him order his servants to kindle a fire both night and day in your brick furnace, and then we will cast this man into it. And the king did so, and he commanded his servants that they should prepare a fire for three days and three nights in the king’s furnace, that is in Casdim; and the king ordered them to take Abram from prison and bring him out to be burned.

verses.raw: And all the king’s servants, princes, lords, governors, and judges, and all the inhabitants of the land, about nine hundred thousand men, stood opposite the furnace to see Abram.
verses.text: And all the king’s servants, princes, lords, governors, and judges, and all the inhabitants of the land, about nine hundred thousand men, stood opposite the furnace to see Abram.

verses.raw: And all the women and little ones crowded upon the roofs and towers to see what was doing with Abram, and they all stood together at a distance; and there was not a man left that did not come on that day to behold the scene.
verses.text: And all the women and little ones crowded upon the roofs and towers to see what was doing with Abram, and they all stood together at a distance; and there was not a man left that did not come on that day to behold the scene.

verses.raw: And when Abram was come, the conjurors of the king and the sages saw Abram, and they cried out to the king, saying, Our sovereign lord, surely this is the man whom we know to have been the child at whose birth the great star swallowed the four stars, which we declared to the king now fifty years since.
verses.text: And when Abram was come, the conjurors of the king and the sages saw Abram, and they cried out to the king, saying, Our sovereign lord, surely this is the man whom we know to have been the child at whose birth the great star swallowed the four stars, which we declared to the king now fifty years since.

verses.raw: And behold now his father has also transgressed your commands, and mocked you by bringing you another child, which you did kill.
verses.text: And behold now his father has also transgressed your commands, and mocked you by bringing you another child, which you did kill.

verses.raw: And when the king heard their words, he was exceedingly wroth, and he ordered Terah to be brought before him.
verses.text: And when the king heard their words, he was exceedingly wroth, and he ordered Terah to be brought before him.

verses.raw: And the king said, Have you heard what the conjurors have spoken? Now tell me truly, how did you; and if you shall speak truth you shall be acquitted.
verses.text: And the king said, Have you heard what the conjurors have spoken? Now tell me truly, how did you; and if you shall speak truth you shall be acquitted.

verses.raw: And seeing that the king’s anger was so much kindled, Terah said to the king, My Lord and king, you have heard the truth, and what the sages have spoken is right. And the king said, How could you do this thing, to transgress my orders and to give me a child that you did not beget, and to take value for him?
verses.text: And seeing that the king’s anger was so much kindled, Terah said to the king, My Lord and king, you have heard the truth, and what the sages have spoken is right. And the king said, How could you do this thing, to transgress my orders and to give me a child that you did not beget, and to take value for him?

verses.raw: And Terah answered the king, Because my tender feelings were excited for my son, at that time, and I took a son of my handmaid, and I brought him to the king.
verses.text: And Terah answered the king, Because my tender feelings were excited for my son, at that time, and I took a son of my handmaid, and I brought him to the king.

verses.raw: And the king said Who advised you to this? Tell me, do not hide aught from me, and then you shall not die.
verses.text: And the king said Who advised you to this? Tell me, do not hide aught from me, and then you shall not die.

verses.raw: And Terah was greatly terrified in the king’s presence, and he said to the king, It was Haran my eldest son who advised me to this; and Haran was in those days that Abram was born, two and thirty years old.
verses.text: And Terah was greatly terrified in the king’s presence, and he said to the king, It was Haran my eldest son who advised me to this; and Haran was in those days that Abram was born, two and thirty years old.

verses.raw: But Haran did not advise his father to anything, for Terah said this to the king in order to deliver his soul from the king, for he feared greatly; and the king said to Terah, Haran your son who advised you to this shall die through fire with Abram; for the sentence of death is upon him for having rebelled against the king’s desire in doing this thing.
verses.text: But Haran did not advise his father to anything, for Terah said this to the king in order to deliver his soul from the king, for he feared greatly; and the king said to Terah, Haran your son who advised you to this shall die through fire with Abram; for the sentence of death is upon him for having rebelled against the king’s desire in doing this thing.

verses.raw: And Haran at that time felt inclined to follow the ways of Abram, but he kept it within himself.
verses.text: And Haran at that time felt inclined to follow the ways of Abram, but he kept it within himself.

verses.raw: And Haran said in his heart, Behold now the king has seized Abram on account of these things which Abram did, and it shall come to pass, that if Abram prevail over the king I will follow him, but if the king prevail I will go after the king.
verses.text: And Haran said in his heart, Behold now the king has seized Abram on account of these things which Abram did, and it shall come to pass, that if Abram prevail over the king I will follow him, but if the king prevail I will go after the king.

verses.raw: And when Terah had spoken this to the king concerning Haran his son, the king ordered Haran to be seized with Abram.
verses.text: And when Terah had spoken this to the king concerning Haran his son, the king ordered Haran to be seized with Abram.

verses.raw: And they brought them both, Abram and Haran his brother, to cast them into the fire; and all the inhabitants of the land and the king’s servants and princes and all the women and little ones were there, standing that day over them.
verses.text: And they brought them both, Abram and Haran his brother, to cast them into the fire; and all the inhabitants of the land and the king’s servants and princes and all the women and little ones were there, standing that day over them.

verses.raw: And the king’s servants took Abram and his brother, and they stripped them of all their clothes excepting their lower garments which were upon them.
verses.text: And the king’s servants took Abram and his brother, and they stripped them of all their clothes excepting their lower garments which were upon them.

verses.raw: And they bound their hands and feet with linen cords, and the servants of the king lifted them up and cast them both into the furnace.
verses.text: And they bound their hands and feet with linen cords, and the servants of the king lifted them up and cast them both into the furnace.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) loved Abram and he had compassion over him, and Yahuah (the Lord) came down and delivered Abram from the fire and he was not burned.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) loved Abram and he had compassion over him, and Yahuah (the Lord) came down and delivered Abram from the fire and he was not burned.

verses.raw: But all the cords with which they bound him were burned, while Abram remained and walked about in the fire.
verses.text: But all the cords with which they bound him were burned, while Abram remained and walked about in the fire.

verses.raw: And Haran died when they had cast him into the fire, and he was burned to ashes, for his heart was not perfect with Yahuah (the Lord); and those men who cast him into the fire, the flame of the fire spread over them, and they were burned, and twelve men of them died.
verses.text: And Haran died when they had cast him into the fire, and he was burned to ashes, for his heart was not perfect with Yahuah (the Lord); and those men who cast him into the fire, the flame of the fire spread over them, and they were burned, and twelve men of them died.

verses.raw: And Abram walked in the midst of the fire three days and three nights, and all the servants of the king saw him walking in the fire, and they came and told the king, saying, Behold we have seen Abram walking about in the midst of the fire, and even the lower garments which are upon him are not burned, but the cord with which he was bound is burned.
verses.text: And Abram walked in the midst of the fire three days and three nights, and all the servants of the king saw him walking in the fire, and they came and told the king, saying, Behold we have seen Abram walking about in the midst of the fire, and even the lower garments which are upon him are not burned, but the cord with which he was bound is burned.

verses.raw: And when the king heard their words his heart fainted and he would not believe them; so he sent other faithful princes to see this matter, and they went and saw it and told it to the king; and the king rose to go and see it, and he saw Abram walking to and fro in the midst of the fire, and he saw Haran’s body burned, and the king wondered greatly.
verses.text: And when the king heard their words his heart fainted and he would not believe them; so he sent other faithful princes to see this matter, and they went and saw it and told it to the king; and the king rose to go and see it, and he saw Abram walking to and fro in the midst of the fire, and he saw Haran’s body burned, and the king wondered greatly.

verses.raw: And the king ordered Abram to be taken out from the fire; and his servants approached to take him out and they could not, for the fire was round about and the flame ascending toward them from the furnace.
verses.text: And the king ordered Abram to be taken out from the fire; and his servants approached to take him out and they could not, for the fire was round about and the flame ascending toward them from the furnace.

verses.raw: And the king’s servants fled from it, and the king rebuked them, saying, Make haste and bring Abram out of the fire that you shall not die.
verses.text: And the king’s servants fled from it, and the king rebuked them, saying, Make haste and bring Abram out of the fire that you shall not die.

verses.raw: And the servants of the king again approached to bring Abram out, and the flames came upon them and burned their faces so that eight of them died.
verses.text: And the servants of the king again approached to bring Abram out, and the flames came upon them and burned their faces so that eight of them died.

verses.raw: And when the king saw that his servants could not approach the fire lest they should be burned, the king called to Abram, O servant of the Elohim (God) who is in heaven, go forth from amidst the fire and come here before me; and Abram hearkened to the voice of the king, and he went forth from the fire and came and stood before the king.
verses.text: And when the king saw that his servants could not approach the fire lest they should be burned, the king called to Abram, O servant of the Elohim who is in heaven, go forth from amidst the fire and come here before me; and Abram hearkened to the voice of the king, and he went forth from the fire and came and stood before the king.

verses.raw: And when Abram came out the king and all his servants saw Abram coming before the king, with his lower garments upon him, for they were not burned, but the cord with which he was bound was burned.
verses.text: And when Abram came out the king and all his servants saw Abram coming before the king, with his lower garments upon him, for they were not burned, but the cord with which he was bound was burned.

verses.raw: And the king said to Abram, How is it that you were not burned in the fire?
verses.text: And the king said to Abram, How is it that you were not burned in the fire?

verses.raw: And Abram said to the king, The Elohim (God) of heaven and earth in whom I trust and who has all in his power, he delivered me from the fire into which you did cast me.
verses.text: And Abram said to the king, The Elohim of heaven and earth in whom I trust and who has all in his power, he delivered me from the fire into which you did cast me.

verses.raw: And Haran the brother of Abram was burned to ashes, and they sought for his body, and they found it consumed.
verses.text: And Haran the brother of Abram was burned to ashes, and they sought for his body, and they found it consumed.

verses.raw: And Haran was eighty-two years old when he died in the fire of Casdim. And the king, princes, and inhabitants of the land, seeing that Abram was delivered from the fire, they came and bowed down to Abram.
verses.text: And Haran was eighty-two years old when he died in the fire of Casdim. And the king, princes, and inhabitants of the land, seeing that Abram was delivered from the fire, they came and bowed down to Abram.

verses.raw: And Abram said to them, Do not bow down to me, but bow down to the Elohim of the world who made you, and serve him, and go in his ways for it is he who delivered me from out of this fire, and it is he who created the souls and spirits of all men, and formed man in his mother’s womb, and brought him forth into the world, and it is he who will deliver those who trust in him from all pain.
verses.text: And Abram said to them, Do not bow down to me, but bow down to the Elohim of the world who made you, and serve him, and go in his ways for it is he who delivered me from out of this fire, and it is he who created the souls and spirits of all men, and formed man in his mother’s womb, and brought him forth into the world, and it is he who will deliver those who trust in him from all pain.

verses.raw: And this thing seemed very wonderful in the eyes of the king and princes, that Abram was saved from the fire and that Haran was burned; and the king gave Abram many presents and he gave him his two head servants from the king’s house; the name of one was Oni and the name of the other was Eliezer.
verses.text: And this thing seemed very wonderful in the eyes of the king and princes, that Abram was saved from the fire and that Haran was burned; and the king gave Abram many presents and he gave him his two head servants from the king’s house; the name of one was Oni and the name of the other was Eliezer.

verses.raw: And all the kings, princes and servants gave Abram many gifts of silver and gold and pearl, and the king and his princes sent him away, and he went in peace.
verses.text: And all the kings, princes and servants gave Abram many gifts of silver and gold and pearl, and the king and his princes sent him away, and he went in peace.

verses.raw: And Abram went forth from the king in peace, and many of the king’s servants followed him, and about three hundred men joined him.
verses.text: And Abram went forth from the king in peace, and many of the king’s servants followed him, and about three hundred men joined him.

verses.raw: And Abram returned on that day and went to his father’s house, he and the men that followed him, and Abram served Yahuah his Elohim (the Lord his God) all the days of his life, and he walked in his ways and followed his law.
verses.text: And Abram returned on that day and went to his father’s house, he and the men that followed him, and Abram served Yahuah his Elohim all the days of his life, and he walked in his ways and followed his law.

verses.raw: And from that day forward Abram inclined the hearts of the sons of men to serve Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And from that day forward Abram inclined the hearts of the sons of men to serve Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And at that time Nahor and Abram took to themselves wives, the daughters of their brother Haran; the wife of Nahor was Milca and the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai. And Sarai, wife of Abram, was barren; she had no offspring in those days.
verses.text: And at that time Nahor and Abram took to themselves wives, the daughters of their brother Haran; the wife of Nahor was Milca and the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai. And Sarai, wife of Abram, was barren; she had no offspring in those days.

verses.raw: And at the expiration of two years from Abram’s going out of the fire, that is in the fifty-second year of his life, behold king Nimrod sat in Babel upon the throne, and the king fell asleep and dreamed that he was standing with his troops and hosts in a valley opposite the king’s furnace.
verses.text: And at the expiration of two years from Abram’s going out of the fire, that is in the fifty-second year of his life, behold king Nimrod sat in Babel upon the throne, and the king fell asleep and dreamed that he was standing with his troops and hosts in a valley opposite the king’s furnace.

verses.raw: And he lifted up his eyes and saw a man in the likeness of Abram coming forth from the furnace, and that he came and stood before the king with his drawn sword, and then sprang to the king with his sword, when the king fled from the man, for he was afraid; and while he was running, the man threw an egg upon the king’s head, and the egg became a great river.
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes and saw a man in the likeness of Abram coming forth from the furnace, and that he came and stood before the king with his drawn sword, and then sprang to the king with his sword, when the king fled from the man, for he was afraid; and while he was running, the man threw an egg upon the king’s head, and the egg became a great river.

verses.raw: And the king dreamed that all his troops sank in that river and died, and the king took flight with three men who were before him and he escaped.
verses.text: And the king dreamed that all his troops sank in that river and died, and the king took flight with three men who were before him and he escaped.

verses.raw: And the king looked at these men and they were clothed in princely dresses as the garments of kings, and had the appearance and majesty of kings.
verses.text: And the king looked at these men and they were clothed in princely dresses as the garments of kings, and had the appearance and majesty of kings.

verses.raw: And while they were running, the river again turned to an egg before the king, and there came forth from the egg a young bird which came before the king, and flew at his head and plucked out the king’s eye.
verses.text: And while they were running, the river again turned to an egg before the king, and there came forth from the egg a young bird which came before the king, and flew at his head and plucked out the king’s eye.

verses.raw: And the king was grieved at the sight, and he awoke out of his sleep and his spirit was agitated; and he felt a great terror.
verses.text: And the king was grieved at the sight, and he awoke out of his sleep and his spirit was agitated; and he felt a great terror.

verses.raw: And in the morning the king rose from his couch in fear, and he ordered all the wise men and magicians to come before him, when the king related his dream to them.
verses.text: And in the morning the king rose from his couch in fear, and he ordered all the wise men and magicians to come before him, when the king related his dream to them.

verses.raw: And a wise servant of the king, whose name was Anuki, answered the king, saying, This is nothing else but the evil of Abram and his seed which will spring up against my Lord and king in the latter days.
verses.text: And a wise servant of the king, whose name was Anuki, answered the king, saying, This is nothing else but the evil of Abram and his seed which will spring up against my Lord and king in the latter days.

verses.raw: And behold the day will come when Abram and his seed and the children of his household will war with my king, and they will smite all the king’s hosts and his troops.
verses.text: And behold the day will come when Abram and his seed and the children of his household will war with my king, and they will smite all the king’s hosts and his troops.

verses.raw: And as to what you have said concerning three men which you did see like to thyself, and which did escape, this means that only you will escape with three kings from the kings of the earth who will be with you in battle.
verses.text: And as to what you have said concerning three men which you did see like to thyself, and which did escape, this means that only you will escape with three kings from the kings of the earth who will be with you in battle.

verses.raw: And that which you saw of the river which turned to an egg as at first, and the young bird plucking out your eye, this means nothing else but the seed of Abram which will slay the king in latter days.
verses.text: And that which you saw of the river which turned to an egg as at first, and the young bird plucking out your eye, this means nothing else but the seed of Abram which will slay the king in latter days.

verses.raw: This is my king’s dream, and this is its interpretation, and the dream is true, and the interpretation which your servant has given you is right.
verses.text: This is my king’s dream, and this is its interpretation, and the dream is true, and the interpretation which your servant has given you is right.

verses.raw: Now therefore my king, surely you know that it is now fifty-two years since your sages saw this at the birth of Abram, and if my king will suffer Abram to live in the earth it will be to the injury of my Lord and king, for all the days that Abram lives neither you nor your kingdom will be established, for this was known formerly at his birth; and why will not my king slay him, that his evil may be kept from you in latter days?
verses.text: Now therefore my king, surely you know that it is now fifty-two years since your sages saw this at the birth of Abram, and if my king will suffer Abram to live in the earth it will be to the injury of my Lord and king, for all the days that Abram lives neither you nor your kingdom will be established, for this was known formerly at his birth; and why will not my king slay him, that his evil may be kept from you in latter days?

verses.raw: And Nimrod hearkened to the voice of Anuki, and he sent some of his servants in secret to go and seize Abram, and bring him before the king to suffer death.
verses.text: And Nimrod hearkened to the voice of Anuki, and he sent some of his servants in secret to go and seize Abram, and bring him before the king to suffer death.

verses.raw: And Eliezer, Abram’s servant whom the king had given him, was at that time in the presence of the king, and he heard what Anuki had advised the king, and what the king had said to cause Abram’s death.
verses.text: And Eliezer, Abram’s servant whom the king had given him, was at that time in the presence of the king, and he heard what Anuki had advised the king, and what the king had said to cause Abram’s death.

verses.raw: And Eliezer said to Abram, Hasten, rise up and save your soul, that you may not die through the hands of the king, for thus did he see in a dream concerning you, and thus did Anuki interpret it, and thus also did Anuki advise the king concerning you.
verses.text: And Eliezer said to Abram, Hasten, rise up and save your soul, that you may not die through the hands of the king, for thus did he see in a dream concerning you, and thus did Anuki interpret it, and thus also did Anuki advise the king concerning you.

verses.raw: And Abram hearkened to the voice of Eliezer, and Abram hastened and ran for safety to the house of Noah and his son Shem, and he concealed himself there and found a place of safety; and the king’s servants came to Abram’s house to seek him, but they could not find him, and they searched through out the country and he was not to be found, and they went and searched in every direction and he was not to be met with.
verses.text: And Abram hearkened to the voice of Eliezer, and Abram hastened and ran for safety to the house of Noah and his son Shem, and he concealed himself there and found a place of safety; and the king’s servants came to Abram’s house to seek him, but they could not find him, and they searched through out the country and he was not to be found, and they went and searched in every direction and he was not to be met with.

verses.raw: And when the king’s servants could not find Abram they returned to the king, but the king’s anger against Abram was stilled, as they did not find him, and the king drove from his mind this matter concerning Abram.
verses.text: And when the king’s servants could not find Abram they returned to the king, but the king’s anger against Abram was stilled, as they did not find him, and the king drove from his mind this matter concerning Abram.

verses.raw: And Abram was concealed in Noah’s house for one month, until the king had forgotten this matter, but Abram was still afraid of the king; and Terah came to see Abram his son secretly in the house of Noah, and Terah was very great in the eyes of the king.
verses.text: And Abram was concealed in Noah’s house for one month, until the king had forgotten this matter, but Abram was still afraid of the king; and Terah came to see Abram his son secretly in the house of Noah, and Terah was very great in the eyes of the king.

verses.raw: And Abram said to his father, Dost you not know that the king thinks to slay me, and to annihilate my name from the earth by the advice of his wicked counsellors?
verses.text: And Abram said to his father, Dost you not know that the king thinks to slay me, and to annihilate my name from the earth by the advice of his wicked counsellors?

verses.raw: Now whom have you here and what have you in this land? Arise, let us go together to the land of Canaan, that we may be delivered from his hand, lest you perish also through him in the latter days.
verses.text: Now whom have you here and what have you in this land? Arise, let us go together to the land of Canaan, that we may be delivered from his hand, lest you perish also through him in the latter days.

verses.raw: Dost you not know or have you not heard, that it is not through love that Nimrod gives you all this honor, but it is only for his benefit that he bestows all this good upon you?
verses.text: Dost you not know or have you not heard, that it is not through love that Nimrod gives you all this honor, but it is only for his benefit that he bestows all this good upon you?

verses.raw: And if he do to you greater good than this, surely these are only vanities of the world, for wealth and riches cannot avail in the day of wrath and anger.
verses.text: And if he do to you greater good than this, surely these are only vanities of the world, for wealth and riches cannot avail in the day of wrath and anger.

verses.raw: Now therefore hearken to my voice, and let us arise and go to the land of Canaan, out of the reach of injury from Nimrod; and serve you Yahuah (the Lord) who created you in the earth and it will be well with you; and cast away all the vain things which you pursue.
verses.text: Now therefore hearken to my voice, and let us arise and go to the land of Canaan, out of the reach of injury from Nimrod; and serve you Yahuah (the Lord) who created you in the earth and it will be well with you; and cast away all the vain things which you pursue.

verses.raw: And Abram ceased to speak, when Noah and his son Shem answered Terah, saying, True is the word which Abram has said to you.
verses.text: And Abram ceased to speak, when Noah and his son Shem answered Terah, saying, True is the word which Abram has said to you.

verses.raw: And Terah hearkened to the voice of his son Abram, and Terah did all that Abram said, for this was from Yahuah (the Lord), that the king should not cause Abram’s death.
verses.text: And Terah hearkened to the voice of his son Abram, and Terah did all that Abram said, for this was from Yahuah (the Lord), that the king should not cause Abram’s death.

verses.raw: And Terah took his son Abram and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, the wife of his son Abram, and all the souls of his household and went with them from Ur Casdim to go to the land of Canaan. And when they came as far as the land of Haran they remained there, for it was exceedingly good land for pasture, and of sufficient extent for those who accompanied them.
verses.text: And Terah took his son Abram and his grandson Lot, the son of Haran, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, the wife of his son Abram, and all the souls of his household and went with them from Ur Casdim to go to the land of Canaan. And when they came as far as the land of Haran they remained there, for it was exceedingly good land for pasture, and of sufficient extent for those who accompanied them.

verses.raw: And the people of the land of Haran saw that Abram was good and upright with Elohim (God) and men, and that Yahuah his Elohim (the Lord his God) was with him, and some of the people of the land of Haran came and joined Abram, and he taught them the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord) and his ways; and these men remained with Abram in his house and they adhered to him.
verses.text: And the people of the land of Haran saw that Abram was good and upright with Elohim and men, and that Yahuah his Elohim was with him, and some of the people of the land of Haran came and joined Abram, and he taught them the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord) and his ways; and these men remained with Abram in his house and they adhered to him.

verses.raw: And Abram remained in the land three years, and at the expiration of three years Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Abram and said to him; I am Yahuah (the Lord) who brought you forth from Ur Casdim, and delivered you from the hands of all your enemies.
verses.text: And Abram remained in the land three years, and at the expiration of three years Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Abram and said to him; I am Yahuah (the Lord) who brought you forth from Ur Casdim, and delivered you from the hands of all your enemies.

verses.raw: And now therefore if you will hearken to my voice and keep my commandments, my statutes and my laws, then will I cause your enemies to fall before you, and I will multiply your seed like the stars of heaven, and I will send my blessing upon all the works of your hands, and you shall lack nothing.
verses.text: And now therefore if you will hearken to my voice and keep my commandments, my statutes and my laws, then will I cause your enemies to fall before you, and I will multiply your seed like the stars of heaven, and I will send my blessing upon all the works of your hands, and you shall lack nothing.

verses.raw: Arise now, take your wife and all belonging to you and go to the land of Canaan and remain there, and I will there be to you for a Elohim, and I will bless you. And Abram rose and took his wife and all belonging to him, and he went to the land of Canaan as Yahuah (the Lord) had told him; and Abram was fifty years old when he went from Haran.
verses.text: Arise now, take your wife and all belonging to you and go to the land of Canaan and remain there, and I will there be to you for a Elohim, and I will bless you. And Abram rose and took his wife and all belonging to him, and he went to the land of Canaan as Yahuah (the Lord) had told him; and Abram was fifty years old when he went from Haran.

verses.raw: And Abram came to the land of Canaan and dwelt in the midst of the city, and he there pitched his tent amongst the children of Canaan, inhabitants of the land.
verses.text: And Abram came to the land of Canaan and dwelt in the midst of the city, and he there pitched his tent amongst the children of Canaan, inhabitants of the land.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Abram when he came to the land of Canaan, and said to him, This is the land which I gave to you and to your seed after you forever, and I will make your seed like the stars of heaven, and I will give to your seed for an inheritance all the lands which you see.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Abram when he came to the land of Canaan, and said to him, This is the land which I gave to you and to your seed after you forever, and I will make your seed like the stars of heaven, and I will give to your seed for an inheritance all the lands which you see.

verses.raw: And Abram built an altar in the place where Elohim had spoken to him, and Abram there called upon the name of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Abram built an altar in the place where Elohim had spoken to him, and Abram there called upon the name of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: At that time, at the end of three years of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan, in that year Noah died, which was the fifty-eighth year of the life of Abram; and all the days that Noah lived were nine hundred and fifty years and he died.
verses.text: At that time, at the end of three years of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan, in that year Noah died, which was the fifty-eighth year of the life of Abram; and all the days that Noah lived were nine hundred and fifty years and he died.

verses.raw: And Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, he, his wife, and all belonging to him, and all those that accompanied him, together with those that joined him from the people of the land; but Nahor, Abram’s brother, and Terah his father, and Lot the son of Haran and all belonging to them dwelt in Haran.
verses.text: And Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan, he, his wife, and all belonging to him, and all those that accompanied him, together with those that joined him from the people of the land; but Nahor, Abram’s brother, and Terah his father, and Lot the son of Haran and all belonging to them dwelt in Haran.

verses.raw: In the fifth year of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan the people of Sodom and Gomorrah and all the cities of the plain revolted from the power of Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; for all the kings of the cities of the plain had served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and given him a yearly tax, but in those days in the thirteenth year, they rebelled against him.
verses.text: In the fifth year of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan the people of Sodom and Gomorrah and all the cities of the plain revolted from the power of Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; for all the kings of the cities of the plain had served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and given him a yearly tax, but in those days in the thirteenth year, they rebelled against him.

verses.raw: And in the tenth year of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan there was war between Nimrod king of Shinar and Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Nimrod came to fight with Chedorlaomer and to subdue him.
verses.text: And in the tenth year of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan there was war between Nimrod king of Shinar and Chedorlaomer king of Elam, and Nimrod came to fight with Chedorlaomer and to subdue him.

verses.raw: For Chedorlaomer was at that time one of the princes of the hosts of Nimrod, and when all the people at the tower were dispersed and those that remained were also scattered upon the face of the earth, Chedorlaomer went to the land of Elam and reigned over it and rebelled against his Lord.
verses.text: For Chedorlaomer was at that time one of the princes of the hosts of Nimrod, and when all the people at the tower were dispersed and those that remained were also scattered upon the face of the earth, Chedorlaomer went to the land of Elam and reigned over it and rebelled against his Lord.

verses.raw: And in those days when Nimrod saw that the cities of the plain had rebelled, he came with pride and anger to war with Chedorlaomer, and Nimrod assembled all his princes and subjects, about seven hundred thousand men, and went against Chedorlaomer, and Chedorlaomer went out to meet him with five thousand men, and they prepared for battle in the valley of Babel which is between Elam and Shinar.
verses.text: And in those days when Nimrod saw that the cities of the plain had rebelled, he came with pride and anger to war with Chedorlaomer, and Nimrod assembled all his princes and subjects, about seven hundred thousand men, and went against Chedorlaomer, and Chedorlaomer went out to meet him with five thousand men, and they prepared for battle in the valley of Babel which is between Elam and Shinar.

verses.raw: And all those kings fought there, and Nimrod and his people were smitten before the people of Chedorlaomer, and there fell from Nimrod’s men about six hundred thousand, and Mardon the king’s son fell amongst them.
verses.text: And all those kings fought there, and Nimrod and his people were smitten before the people of Chedorlaomer, and there fell from Nimrod’s men about six hundred thousand, and Mardon the king’s son fell amongst them.

verses.raw: And Nimrod fled and returned in shame and disgrace to his land, and he was under subjection to Chedorlaomer for a long time, and Chedorlaomer returned to his land and sent princes of his host to the kings that dwelt around him, to Arioch king of Elasar, and to Tidal king of Goyim, and made a covenant with them, and they were all obedient to his commands.
verses.text: And Nimrod fled and returned in shame and disgrace to his land, and he was under subjection to Chedorlaomer for a long time, and Chedorlaomer returned to his land and sent princes of his host to the kings that dwelt around him, to Arioch king of Elasar, and to Tidal king of Goyim, and made a covenant with them, and they were all obedient to his commands.

verses.raw: And it was in the fifteenth year of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan, which is the seventieth year of the life of Abram, and Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Abram in that year and he said to him, I am Yahuah (the Lord) who brought you out from Ur Casdim to give you this land for an inheritance.
verses.text: And it was in the fifteenth year of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan, which is the seventieth year of the life of Abram, and Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Abram in that year and he said to him, I am Yahuah (the Lord) who brought you out from Ur Casdim to give you this land for an inheritance.

verses.raw: Now therefore walk before me and be perfect and keep my commands, for to you and to your seed I will give this land for an inheritance, from the river Mitzraim to the great river Euphrates.
verses.text: Now therefore walk before me and be perfect and keep my commands, for to you and to your seed I will give this land for an inheritance, from the river Mitzraim to the great river Euphrates.

verses.raw: And you shall come to your fathers in peace and in good age, and the fourth generation shall return here in this land and shall inherit it forever; and Abram built an altar, and he called upon the name of Yahuah (the Lord) who appeared to him, and he brought up sacrifices upon the altar to Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: Now therefore here is your wife, take her and go from our land lest we all die on her account. And Pharaoh took more cattle, men servants and maid servants, and silver and gold, to give to Abram, and he returned to him Sarai his wife.
verses.text: Now therefore here is your wife, take her and go from our land lest we all die on her account. And Pharaoh took more cattle, men servants and maid servants, and silver and gold, to give to Abram, and he returned to him Sarai his wife.

verses.raw: And the king took a maiden whom he begat by his concubines, and he gave her to Sarai for a handmaid.
verses.text: And the king took a maiden whom he begat by his concubines, and he gave her to Sarai for a handmaid.

verses.raw: And the king said to his daughter, It is better for you my daughter to be a handmaid in this man’s house than to be mistress in my house, after we have beheld the evil that befell us on account of this woman.
verses.text: And the king said to his daughter, It is better for you my daughter to be a handmaid in this man’s house than to be mistress in my house, after we have beheld the evil that befell us on account of this woman.

verses.raw: And Abram arose, and he and all belonging to him went away from Egypt; and Pharaoh ordered some of his men to accompany him and all that went with him.
verses.text: And Abram arose, and he and all belonging to him went away from Egypt; and Pharaoh ordered some of his men to accompany him and all that went with him.

verses.raw: And Abram returned to the land of Canaan, to the place where he had made the altar, where he at first had pitched his tent.
verses.text: And Abram returned to the land of Canaan, to the place where he had made the altar, where he at first had pitched his tent.

verses.raw: And Lot the son of Haran, Abram’s brother, had a heavy stock of cattle, flocks and herds and tents, for Yahuah (the Lord) was bountiful to them on account of Abram.
verses.text: And Lot the son of Haran, Abram’s brother, had a heavy stock of cattle, flocks and herds and tents, for Yahuah (the Lord) was bountiful to them on account of Abram.

verses.raw: And when Abram was dwelling in the land the herdsmen of Lot quarrelled with the herdsmen of Abram, for their property was too great for them to remain together in the land, and the land could not bear them on account of their cattle.
verses.text: And when Abram was dwelling in the land the herdsmen of Lot quarrelled with the herdsmen of Abram, for their property was too great for them to remain together in the land, and the land could not bear them on account of their cattle.

verses.raw: And when Abram’s herdsmen went to feed their flock they would not go into the fields of the people of the land, but the cattle of Lot’s herdsmen did otherwise, for they were suffered to feed in the fields of the people of the land.
verses.text: And when Abram’s herdsmen went to feed their flock they would not go into the fields of the people of the land, but the cattle of Lot’s herdsmen did otherwise, for they were suffered to feed in the fields of the people of the land.

verses.raw: And the people of the land saw this occurrence daily, and they came to Abram and quarrelled with him on account of Lot’s herdsmen.
verses.text: And the people of the land saw this occurrence daily, and they came to Abram and quarrelled with him on account of Lot’s herdsmen.

verses.raw: And Abram said to Lot, What is this you are doing to me, to make me despicable to the inhabitants of the land, that you order your herdsman to feed your cattle in the fields of other people? Dost you not know that I am a stranger in this land amongst the children of Canaan, and why will you do this to me?

Dost you not know that I am a stranger in this land amongst the children of Canaan, and why will you do this to me?

verses.raw: And Abram quarrelled daily with Lot on account of this, but Lot would not listen to Abram, and he continued to do the same and the inhabitants of the land came and told Abram.
verses.text: And Abram quarrelled daily with Lot on account of this, but Lot would not listen to Abram, and he continued to do the same and the inhabitants of the land came and told Abram.

verses.raw: And Abram said to Lot, How long will you be to me for a stumbling block with the inhabitants of the land? Now I beseech you let there be no more quarrelling between us, for we are kinsmen.
verses.text: And Abram said to Lot, How long will you be to me for a stumbling block with the inhabitants of the land? Now I beseech you let there be no more quarrelling between us, for we are kinsmen.

verses.raw: But I pray you separate from me, go and choose a place where you may dwell with your cattle and all belonging to you, but Keep thyself at a distance from me, you and your household.
verses.text: But I pray you separate from me, go and choose a place where you may dwell with your cattle and all belonging to you, but Keep thyself at a distance from me, you and your household.

verses.raw: And be not afraid in going from me, for if any one do an injury to you, let me know and I will avenge your cause from him, only remove from me.
verses.text: And be not afraid in going from me, for if any one do an injury to you, let me know and I will avenge your cause from him, only remove from me.

verses.raw: And when Abram had spoken all these words to Lot, then Lot arose and lifted up his eyes toward the plain of Jordan.
verses.text: And when Abram had spoken all these words to Lot, then Lot arose and lifted up his eyes toward the plain of Jordan.

verses.raw: And he saw that the whole of this place was well watered, and good for man as well as affording pasture for the cattle.
verses.text: And he saw that the whole of this place was well watered, and good for man as well as affording pasture for the cattle.

verses.raw: And Lot went from Abram to that place, and he there pitched his tent and he dwelt in Sodom, and they were separated from each other.
verses.text: And Lot went from Abram to that place, and he there pitched his tent and he dwelt in Sodom, and they were separated from each other.

verses.raw: And Abram dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and he pitched his tent there, and Abram remained in that place many years.
verses.text: And Abram dwelt in the plain of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and he pitched his tent there, and Abram remained in that place many years.

verses.raw: At that time Chedorlaomer king of Elam sent to all the neighboring kings, to Nimrod, king of Shinar who was then under his power, and to Tidal, king of Goyim, and to Arioch, king of Elasar, with whom he made a covenant, saying, Come up to me and assist me, that we may smite all the towns of Sodom and its inhabitants, for they have rebelled against me these thirteen years.
verses.text: At that time Chedorlaomer king of Elam sent to all the neighboring kings, to Nimrod, king of Shinar who was then under his power, and to Tidal, king of Goyim, and to Arioch, king of Elasar, with whom he made a covenant, saying, Come up to me and assist me, that we may smite all the towns of Sodom and its inhabitants, for they have rebelled against me these thirteen years.

verses.raw: And these four kings went up with all their camps, about eight hundred thousand men, and they went as they were, and smote every man they found in their road.
verses.text: And these four kings went up with all their camps, about eight hundred thousand men, and they went as they were, and smote every man they found in their road.

verses.raw: And the five kings of Sodom and Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboyim, Bera king of Sodom, Bersha king of Gomorrah, and Bela king of Zoar, went out to meet them, and they all joined together in the valley of Siddim.
verses.text: And the five kings of Sodom and Gomorrah, Shinab king of Admah, Shemeber king of Zeboyim, Bera king of Sodom, Bersha king of Gomorrah, and Bela king of Zoar, went out to meet them, and they all joined together in the valley of Siddim.

verses.raw: And these nine kings made war in the valley of Siddim; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah were smitten before the kings of Elam.
verses.text: And these nine kings made war in the valley of Siddim; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah were smitten before the kings of Elam.

verses.raw: And the valley of Siddim was full of lime pits and the kings of Elam pursued the kings of Sodom, and the kings of Sodom with their camps fled and fell into the lime pits, and all that remained went to the mountain for safety, and the five kings of Elam came after them and pursued them to the gates of Sodom, and they took all that there was in Sodom.
verses.text: And the valley of Siddim was full of lime pits and the kings of Elam pursued the kings of Sodom, and the kings of Sodom with their camps fled and fell into the lime pits, and all that remained went to the mountain for safety, and the five kings of Elam came after them and pursued them to the gates of Sodom, and they took all that there was in Sodom.

verses.raw: And they plundered all the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, and they also took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, and his property, and they seized all the goods of the cities of Sodom, and they went away; and Unic, Abram’s servant, who was in the battle, saw this, and told Abram all that the kings had done to the cities of Sodom, and that Lot was taken captive by them.
verses.text: And they plundered all the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah, and they also took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, and his property, and they seized all the goods of the cities of Sodom, and they went away; and Unic, Abram’s servant, who was in the battle, saw this, and told Abram all that the kings had done to the cities of Sodom, and that Lot was taken captive by them.

verses.raw: And Abram heard this, and he rose up with about three hundred and eighteen men that were with him, and he that night pursued these kings and smote them, and they all fell before Abram and his men, and there was none remaining but the four kings who fled, and they went each his own road.
verses.text: And Abram heard this, and he rose up with about three hundred and eighteen men that were with him, and he that night pursued these kings and smote them, and they all fell before Abram and his men, and there was none remaining but the four kings who fled, and they went each his own road.

verses.raw: And Abram recovered all the property of Sodom, and he also recovered Lot and his property, his wives and little ones and all belonging to him, so that Lot lacked nothing.
verses.text: And Abram recovered all the property of Sodom, and he also recovered Lot and his property, his wives and little ones and all belonging to him, so that Lot lacked nothing.

verses.raw: And when he returned from smiting these kings, he and his men passed the valley of Siddim where the kings had made war together.
verses.text: And when he returned from smiting these kings, he and his men passed the valley of Siddim where the kings had made war together.

verses.raw: And Bera king of Sodom, and the rest of his men that were with him, went out from the lime pits into which they had fallen, to meet Abram and his men.
verses.text: And Bera king of Sodom, and the rest of his men that were with him, went out from the lime pits into which they had fallen, to meet Abram and his men.

verses.raw: And Adonizedek king of Jerusalem, the same was Shem, went out with his men to meet Abram and his people, with bread and wine, and they remained together in the valley of Melech.
verses.text: And Adonizedek king of Jerusalem, the same was Shem, went out with his men to meet Abram and his people, with bread and wine, and they remained together in the valley of Melech.

verses.raw: And Adonizedek blessed Abram, and Abram gave him a tenth from all that he had brought from the spoil of his enemies, for Adonizedek was a priest before Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Adonizedek blessed Abram, and Abram gave him a tenth from all that he had brought from the spoil of his enemies, for Adonizedek was a priest before Elohim.

verses.raw: And all the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah who were there, with their servants, approached Abram and begged of him to return them their servants whom he had made captive, and to take to himself all the property.
verses.text: And all the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah who were there, with their servants, approached Abram and begged of him to return them their servants whom he had made captive, and to take to himself all the property.

verses.raw: And Abram answered the kings of Sodom, saying, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives who created heaven and earth, and who redeemed my soul from all affliction, and who delivered me this day from my enemies, and gave them into my hand, I will not take anything belonging to you, that you may not boast tomorrow, saying, Abram became rich from our property that he saved.
verses.text: And Abram answered the kings of Sodom, saying, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives who created heaven and earth, and who redeemed my soul from all affliction, and who delivered me this day from my enemies, and gave them into my hand, I will not take anything belonging to you, that you may not boast tomorrow, saying, Abram became rich from our property that he saved.

verses.raw: For Yahuah my Elohim (the Lord my God) in whom I trust said to me, You shall lack nothing, for I will bless you in all the works of your hands.
verses.text: For Yahuah my Elohim in whom I trust said to me, You shall lack nothing, for I will bless you in all the works of your hands.

verses.raw: And now therefore behold, here is all belonging to you, take it and go; as Yahuah (the Lord) lives I will not take from you from a living soul down to a shoetie or thread, excepting the expense of the food of those who went out with me to battle, as also the portions of the men who went with me, Anar, Ashcol, and Mamre, they and their men, as well as those also who had remained to watch the baggage, they shall take their portion of the spoil.
verses.text: And now therefore behold, here is all belonging to you, take it and go; as Yahuah (the Lord) lives I will not take from you from a living soul down to a shoetie or thread, excepting the expense of the food of those who went out with me to battle, as also the portions of the men who went with me, Anar, Ashcol, and Mamre, they and their men, as well as those also who had remained to watch the baggage, they shall take their portion of the spoil.

verses.raw: And the kings of Sodom gave Abram according to all that he had said, and they pressed him to take of whatever he chose, but he would not.
verses.text: And the kings of Sodom gave Abram according to all that he had said, and they pressed him to take of whatever he chose, but he would not.

verses.raw: And he sent away the kings of Sodom and the remainder of their men, and he gave them orders about Lot, and they went to their respective places.
verses.text: And he sent away the kings of Sodom and the remainder of their men, and he gave them orders about Lot, and they went to their respective places.

verses.raw: And Lot, his brother’s son, he also sent away with his property, and he went with them, and Lot returned to his home, to Sodom, and Abram and his people returned to their home to the plains of Mamre, which is in Hebron.
verses.text: And Lot, his brother’s son, he also sent away with his property, and he went with them, and Lot returned to his home, to Sodom, and Abram and his people returned to their home to the plains of Mamre, which is in Hebron.

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) again appeared to Abram in Hebron, and he said to him, Do not fear, your reward is very great before me, for I will not leave you, until I shall have multiplied you, and blessed you and made your seed like the stars in heaven, which cannot be measured nor numbered.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) again appeared to Abram in Hebron, and he said to him, Do not fear, your reward is very great before me, for I will not leave you, until I shall have multiplied you, and blessed you and made your seed like the stars in heaven, which cannot be measured nor numbered.

verses.raw: And I will give to your seed all these lands that you see with your eyes, to them will I give them for an inheritance forever, only be strong and do not fear, walk before me and be perfect.
verses.text: And I will give to your seed all these lands that you see with your eyes, to them will I give them for an inheritance forever, only be strong and do not fear, walk before me and be perfect.

verses.raw: And in the seventy-eighth year of the life of Abram, in that year died Reu, the son of Peleg, and all the days of Reu were two hundred and thirty-nine years, and he died.
verses.text: And in the seventy-eighth year of the life of Abram, in that year died Reu, the son of Peleg, and all the days of Reu were two hundred and thirty-nine years, and he died.
