verses.raw: And Sarai, the daughter of Haran, Abram’s wife, was still barren in those days; she did not bear to Abram either son or daughter.
verses.text: And Sarai, the daughter of Haran, Abram’s wife, was still barren in those days; she did not bear to Abram either son or daughter.

verses.raw: And when she saw that she bare no children she took her handmaid Hagar, whom Pharaoh had given her, and she gave her to Abram her husband for a wife.
verses.text: And when she saw that she bare no children she took her handmaid Hagar, whom Pharaoh had given her, and she gave her to Abram her husband for a wife.

verses.raw: For Hagar learned all the ways of Sarai as Sarai taught her, she was not in any way deficient in following her good ways.
verses.text: For Hagar learned all the ways of Sarai as Sarai taught her, she was not in any way deficient in following her good ways.

verses.raw: And Sarai said to Abram, Behold here is my handmaid Hagar, go to her that she may bring forth upon my knees, that I may also obtain children through her.
verses.text: And Sarai said to Abram, Behold here is my handmaid Hagar, go to her that she may bring forth upon my knees, that I may also obtain children through her.

verses.raw: And at the end of ten years of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan, which is the eighty-fifth year of Abram’s life, Sarai gave Hagar to him.
verses.text: And at the end of ten years of Abram’s dwelling in the land of Canaan, which is the eighty-fifth year of Abram’s life, Sarai gave Hagar to him.

verses.raw: And Abram hearkened to the voice of his wife Sarai, and he took his handmaid Hagar and Abram came to her and she conceived.
verses.text: And Abram hearkened to the voice of his wife Sarai, and he took his handmaid Hagar and Abram came to her and she conceived.

verses.raw: And when Hagar saw that she had conceived she rejoiced greatly, and her mistress was despised in her eyes, and she said within herself, This can only be that I am better before Elohim than Sarai my mistress, for all the days that my mistress has been with my Lord, she did not conceive, but me Yahuah (the Lord) has caused in so short a time to conceive by him.
verses.text: And when Hagar saw that she had conceived she rejoiced greatly, and her mistress was despised in her eyes, and she said within herself, This can only be that I am better before Elohim than Sarai my mistress, for all the days that my mistress has been with my Lord, she did not conceive, but me Yahuah (the Lord) has caused in so short a time to conceive by him.

verses.raw: And when Sarai saw that Hagar had conceived by Abram, Sarai was jealous of her handmaid, and Sarai said within herself, This is surely nothing else but that she must be better than I am.
verses.text: And when Sarai saw that Hagar had conceived by Abram, Sarai was jealous of her handmaid, and Sarai said within herself, This is surely nothing else but that she must be better than I am.

verses.raw: And Sarai said to Abram, My wrong be upon you, for at the time when you did pray before Yahuah (the Lord) for children why did you not pray on my account, that Yahuah (the Lord) should give me seed from you?
verses.text: And Sarai said to Abram, My wrong be upon you, for at the time when you did pray before Yahuah (the Lord) for children why did you not pray on my account, that Yahuah (the Lord) should give me seed from you?

verses.raw: And when I speak to Hagar in your presence, she despises my words, because she has conceived, and you will say nothing to her; may Yahuah (the Lord) judge between me and you for what you have done to me.
verses.text: And when I speak to Hagar in your presence, she despises my words, because she has conceived, and you will say nothing to her; may Yahuah (the Lord) judge between me and you for what you have done to me.

verses.raw: And Abram said to Sarai, Behold your handmaid is in your hand, do to her as it may seem good in your eyes; and Sarai afflicted her, and Hagar fled from her to the wilderness.
verses.text: And Abram said to Sarai, Behold your handmaid is in your hand, do to her as it may seem good in your eyes; and Sarai afflicted her, and Hagar fled from her to the wilderness.

verses.raw: And an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) found her in the place where she had fled, by a well, and he said to her, Do not fear, for I will multiply your seed, for you shall bear a son and you shall call his name Ishmael; now then return to Sarai your mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.
verses.text: And an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) found her in the place where she had fled, by a well, and he said to her, Do not fear, for I will multiply your seed, for you shall bear a son and you shall call his name Ishmael; now then return to Sarai your mistress, and submit thyself under her hands.

verses.raw: And Hagar called the place of that well Beer-lahai-roi, it is between Kadesh and the wilderness of Bered.
verses.text: And Hagar called the place of that well Beer-lahai-roi, it is between Kadesh and the wilderness of Bered.

verses.raw: And Hagar at that time returned to her master’s house, and at the end of days Hagar bare a son to Abram, and Abram called his name Ishmael; and Abram was eighty-six years old when he begat him.
verses.text: And Hagar at that time returned to her master’s house, and at the end of days Hagar bare a son to Abram, and Abram called his name Ishmael; and Abram was eighty-six years old when he begat him.

verses.raw: And in those days, in the ninety-first year of the life of Abram, the children of Chittim made war with the children of Tubal, for when Yahuah (the Lord) had scattered the sons of men upon the face of the earth, the children of Chittim went and embodied themselves in the plain of Canopia, and they built themselves cities there and dwelt by the river Tibreu.
verses.text: And in those days, in the ninety-first year of the life of Abram, the children of Chittim made war with the children of Tubal, for when Yahuah (the Lord) had scattered the sons of men upon the face of the earth, the children of Chittim went and embodied themselves in the plain of Canopia, and they built themselves cities there and dwelt by the river Tibreu.

verses.raw: And the children of Tubal dwelt in Tuscanah, and their boundaries reached the river Tibreu, and the children of Tubal built a city in Tuscanan, and they called the name Sabinah, after the name of Sabinah son of Tubal their father, and they dwelt there to this day.
verses.text: And the children of Tubal dwelt in Tuscanah, and their boundaries reached the river Tibreu, and the children of Tubal built a city in Tuscanan, and they called the name Sabinah, after the name of Sabinah son of Tubal their father, and they dwelt there to this day.

verses.raw: And it was at that time the children of Chittim made war with the children of Tubal, and the children of Tubal were smitten before the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim caused three hundred and seventy men to fall from the children of Tubal.
verses.text: And it was at that time the children of Chittim made war with the children of Tubal, and the children of Tubal were smitten before the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim caused three hundred and seventy men to fall from the children of Tubal.

verses.raw: And at that time the children of Tubal swore to the children of Chittim, saying, You shall not intermarry amongst us, and no man shall give his daughter to any of the sons of Chittim.
verses.text: And at that time the children of Tubal swore to the children of Chittim, saying, You shall not intermarry amongst us, and no man shall give his daughter to any of the sons of Chittim.

verses.raw: For all the daughters of Tubal were in those days fair, for no women were then found in the whole earth so fair as the daughters of Tubal.
verses.text: For all the daughters of Tubal were in those days fair, for no women were then found in the whole earth so fair as the daughters of Tubal.

verses.raw: And all who delighted in the beauty of women went to the daughters of Tubal and took wives from them, and the sons of men, kings and princes, who greatly delighted in the beauty of women, took wives in those days from the daughters of Tubal.
verses.text: And all who delighted in the beauty of women went to the daughters of Tubal and took wives from them, and the sons of men, kings and princes, who greatly delighted in the beauty of women, took wives in those days from the daughters of Tubal.

verses.raw: And at the end of three years after the children of Tubal had sworn to the children of Chittim not to give them their daughters for wives, about twenty men of the children of Chittim went to take some of the daughters of Tubal, but they found none.
verses.text: And at the end of three years after the children of Tubal had sworn to the children of Chittim not to give them their daughters for wives, about twenty men of the children of Chittim went to take some of the daughters of Tubal, but they found none.

verses.raw: For the children of Tubal kept their oaths not to intermarry with them, and they would not break their oaths.
verses.text: For the children of Tubal kept their oaths not to intermarry with them, and they would not break their oaths.

verses.raw: And in the days of harvest the children of Tubal went into their fields to get in their harvest, when the young men of Chittim assembled and went to the city of Sabinah, and each man took a young woman from the daughters of Tubal, and they came to their cities.
verses.text: And in the days of harvest the children of Tubal went into their fields to get in their harvest, when the young men of Chittim assembled and went to the city of Sabinah, and each man took a young woman from the daughters of Tubal, and they came to their cities.

verses.raw: And the children of Tubal heard of it and they went to make war with them, and they could not prevail over them, for the mountain was exceedingly high from them, and when they saw they could not prevail over them they returned to their land.
verses.text: And the children of Tubal heard of it and they went to make war with them, and they could not prevail over them, for the mountain was exceedingly high from them, and when they saw they could not prevail over them they returned to their land.

verses.raw: And at the revolution of the year the children of Tubal went and hired about ten thousand men from those cities that were near them, and they went to war with the children of Chittim.
verses.text: And at the revolution of the year the children of Tubal went and hired about ten thousand men from those cities that were near them, and they went to war with the children of Chittim.

verses.raw: And the children of Tubal went to war with the children of Chittim, to destroy their land and to distress them, and in this engagement the children of Tubal prevailed over the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim, seeing that they were greatly distressed, lifted up the children which they had had by the daughters of Tubal, upon the wall which had been built, to be before the eyes of the children of Tubal.
verses.text: And the children of Tubal went to war with the children of Chittim, to destroy their land and to distress them, and in this engagement the children of Tubal prevailed over the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim, seeing that they were greatly distressed, lifted up the children which they had had by the daughters of Tubal, upon the wall which had been built, to be before the eyes of the children of Tubal.

verses.raw: And the children of Chittim said to them, Have you come to make war with your own sons and daughters, and have we not been considered your flesh and bones from that time till now?
verses.text: And the children of Chittim said to them, Have you come to make war with your own sons and daughters, and have we not been considered your flesh and bones from that time till now?

verses.raw: And when the children of Tubal heard this they ceased to make war with the children of Chittim, and they went away.
verses.text: And when the children of Tubal heard this they ceased to make war with the children of Chittim, and they went away.

verses.raw: And they returned to their cities, and the children of Chittim at that time assembled and built two cities by the sea, and they called one Purtu and the other Ariza.
verses.text: And they returned to their cities, and the children of Chittim at that time assembled and built two cities by the sea, and they called one Purtu and the other Ariza.

verses.raw: And Abram the son of Terah was then ninety-nine years old.
verses.text: And Abram the son of Terah was then ninety-nine years old.

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to him and he said to him, I will make my covenant between me and you, and I will greatly multiply your seed, and this is the covenant which I make between me and you, that every male child be circumcised, you and your seed after you.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to him and he said to him, I will make my covenant between me and you, and I will greatly multiply your seed, and this is the covenant which I make between me and you, that every male child be circumcised, you and your seed after you.

verses.raw: At eight days old shall it be circumcised, and this covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.
verses.text: At eight days old shall it be circumcised, and this covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

verses.raw: And now therefore your name shall no more be called Abram but Abraham, and your wife shall no more be called Sarai but Sarah.
verses.text: And now therefore your name shall no more be called Abram but Abraham, and your wife shall no more be called Sarai but Sarah.

verses.raw: For I will bless you both, and I will multiply your seed after you that you shall become a great nation, and kings shall come forth from you.
verses.text: For I will bless you both, and I will multiply your seed after you that you shall become a great nation, and kings shall come forth from you.

verses.raw: And Abraham rose and did all that Elohim (God) had ordered him, and he took the men of his household and those bought with his money, and he circumcised them as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.
verses.text: And Abraham rose and did all that Elohim had ordered him, and he took the men of his household and those bought with his money, and he circumcised them as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.

verses.raw: And there was not one left whom he did not circumcise, and Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised in the flesh of their foreskin; thirteen years old was Ishmael when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.text: And there was not one left whom he did not circumcise, and Abraham and his son Ishmael were circumcised in the flesh of their foreskin; thirteen years old was Ishmael when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

verses.raw: And in the third day Abraham went out of his tent and sat at the door to enjoy the heat of the sun, during the pain of his flesh.
verses.text: And in the third day Abraham went out of his tent and sat at the door to enjoy the heat of the sun, during the pain of his flesh.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to him in the plain of Mamre, and sent three of his ministering angels to visit him, and he was sitting at the door of the tent, and he lifted his eyes and saw, and lo three men were coming from a distance, and he rose up and ran to meet them, and he bowed down to them and brought them into his house.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to him in the plain of Mamre, and sent three of his ministering angels to visit him, and he was sitting at the door of the tent, and he lifted his eyes and saw, and lo three men were coming from a distance, and he rose up and ran to meet them, and he bowed down to them and brought them into his house.

verses.raw: And he said to them, If now I have found favor in your sight, turn in and eat a morsel of bread; and he pressed them, and they turned in and he gave them water and they washed their feet, and he placed them under a tree at the door of the tent.
verses.text: And he said to them, If now I have found favor in your sight, turn in and eat a morsel of bread; and he pressed them, and they turned in and he gave them water and they washed their feet, and he placed them under a tree at the door of the tent.

verses.raw: And Abraham ran and took a calf, tender and good, and he hastened to kill it, and gave it to his servant Eliezer to dress.
verses.text: And Abraham ran and took a calf, tender and good, and he hastened to kill it, and gave it to his servant Eliezer to dress.

verses.raw: And Abraham came to Sarah into the tent, and he said to her, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it and make cakes to cover the pot containing the meat, and she did so.
verses.text: And Abraham came to Sarah into the tent, and he said to her, Make ready quickly three measures of fine meal, knead it and make cakes to cover the pot containing the meat, and she did so.

verses.raw: And Abraham hastened and brought before them butter and milk, beef and mutton, and gave it before them to eat before the flesh of the calf was sufficiently done, and they did eat.
verses.text: And Abraham hastened and brought before them butter and milk, beef and mutton, and gave it before them to eat before the flesh of the calf was sufficiently done, and they did eat.

verses.raw: And when they had done eating one of them said to him, I will return to you according to the time of life, and Sarah your wife shall have a son.
verses.text: And when they had done eating one of them said to him, I will return to you according to the time of life, and Sarah your wife shall have a son.

verses.raw: And the men afterward departed and went their ways, to the places to which they were sent.
verses.text: And the men afterward departed and went their ways, to the places to which they were sent.

verses.raw: In those days all the people of Sodom and Gomorrah, and of the whole five cities, were exceedingly wicked and sinful against Yahuah (the Lord) and they provoked Yahuah (the Lord) with their abominations, and they strengthened in aging abominably and scornfully before Yahuah (the Lord), and their wickedness and crimes were in those days great before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: In those days all the people of Sodom and Gomorrah, and of the whole five cities, were exceedingly wicked and sinful against Yahuah (the Lord) and they provoked Yahuah (the Lord) with their abominations, and they strengthened in aging abominably and scornfully before Yahuah (the Lord), and their wickedness and crimes were in those days great before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And they had in their land a very extensive valley, about half a day’s walk, and in it there were fountains of water and a great deal of herbage surrounding the water.
verses.text: And they had in their land a very extensive valley, about half a day’s walk, and in it there were fountains of water and a great deal of herbage surrounding the water.

verses.raw: And all the people of Sodom and Gomorrah went there four times in the year, with their wives and children and all belonging to them, and they rejoiced there with timbrels and dances.
verses.text: And all the people of Sodom and Gomorrah went there four times in the year, with their wives and children and all belonging to them, and they rejoiced there with timbrels and dances.

verses.raw: And in the time of rejoicing they would all rise and lay hold of their neighbor’s wives, and some, the virgin daughters of their neighbors, and they enjoyed them, and each man saw his wife and daughter in the hands of his neighbor and did not say a word.
verses.text: And in the time of rejoicing they would all rise and lay hold of their neighbor’s wives, and some, the virgin daughters of their neighbors, and they enjoyed them, and each man saw his wife and daughter in the hands of his neighbor and did not say a word.

verses.raw: And they did so from morning to night, and they afterward returned home each man to his house and each woman to her tent; so they always did four times in the year.
verses.text: And they did so from morning to night, and they afterward returned home each man to his house and each woman to her tent; so they always did four times in the year.

verses.raw: Also when a stranger came into their cities and brought goods which he had purchased with a view to dispose of there, the people of these cities would assemble, men, women and children, young and old, and go to the man and take his goods by force, giving a little to each man until there was an end to all the goods of the owner which he had brought into the land.
verses.text: Also when a stranger came into their cities and brought goods which he had purchased with a view to dispose of there, the people of these cities would assemble, men, women and children, young and old, and go to the man and take his goods by force, giving a little to each man until there was an end to all the goods of the owner which he had brought into the land.

verses.raw: And if the owner of the goods quarreled with them, saying, What is this work which you have done to me, then they would approach to him one by one, and each would show him the little which he took and taunt him, saying, I only took that little which you did give me; and when he heard this from them all, he would arise and go from them in sorrow and bitterness of soul, when they would all arise and go after him, and drive him out of the city with great noise and tumult.
verses.text: And if the owner of the goods quarreled with them, saying, What is this work which you have done to me, then they would approach to him one by one, and each would show him the little which he took and taunt him, saying, I only took that little which you did give me; and when he heard this from them all, he would arise and go from them in sorrow and bitterness of soul, when they would all arise and go after him, and drive him out of the city with great noise and tumult.

verses.raw: And there was a man from the country of Elam who was leisurely going on the road, seated upon his ass, which carried a fine mantle of divers colors, and the mantle was bound with a cord upon the ass.
verses.text: And there was a man from the country of Elam who was leisurely going on the road, seated upon his ass, which carried a fine mantle of divers colors, and the mantle was bound with a cord upon the ass.

verses.raw: And the man was on his journey passing through the street of Sodom when the sun set in the evening, and he remained there in order to abide during the night, but no one would let him into his house; and at that time there was in Sodom a wicked and mischievous man, one skillful to do evil, and his name was Hedad.
verses.text: And the man was on his journey passing through the street of Sodom when the sun set in the evening, and he remained there in order to abide during the night, but no one would let him into his house; and at that time there was in Sodom a wicked and mischievous man, one skillful to do evil, and his name was Hedad.

verses.raw: And he lifted up his eyes and saw the traveler in the street of the city, and he came to him and said, Whence come you and whither dost you go?
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes and saw the traveler in the street of the city, and he came to him and said, Whence come you and whither dost you go?

verses.raw: And the man said to him, I am traveling from Hebron to Elam where I belong, and as I passed the sun set and no one would suffer me to enter his house, though I had bread and water and also straw and provender for my ass, and am short of nothing.
verses.text: And the man said to him, I am traveling from Hebron to Elam where I belong, and as I passed the sun set and no one would suffer me to enter his house, though I had bread and water and also straw and provender for my ass, and am short of nothing.

verses.raw: And Hedad answered and said to him, All that you shall want shall be supplied by me, but in the street you shall not abide all night.
verses.text: And Hedad answered and said to him, All that you shall want shall be supplied by me, but in the street you shall not abide all night.

verses.raw: And Hedad brought him to his house, and he took off the mantle from the ass with the cord, and brought them to his house, and he gave the ass straw and provender whilst the traveler ate and drank in Hedad’s house, and he abode there that night.
verses.text: And Hedad brought him to his house, and he took off the mantle from the ass with the cord, and brought them to his house, and he gave the ass straw and provender whilst the traveler ate and drank in Hedad’s house, and he abode there that night.

verses.raw: And in the morning the traveler rose up early to continue his journey, when Hedad said to him, Wait, comfort your heart with a morsel of bread and then go, and the man did so; and he remained with him, and they both ate and drank together during the day, when the man rose up to go.
verses.text: And in the morning the traveler rose up early to continue his journey, when Hedad said to him, Wait, comfort your heart with a morsel of bread and then go, and the man did so; and he remained with him, and they both ate and drank together during the day, when the man rose up to go.

verses.raw: And Hedad said to him, Behold now the day is declining, you had better remain all night that your heart may be comforted; and he pressed him so that he tarried there all night, and on the second day he rose up early to go away, when Hedad pressed him, saying, Comfort your heart with a morsel of bread and then go, and he remained and ate with him also the second day, and then the man rose up to continue his journey.
verses.text: And Hedad said to him, Behold now the day is declining, you had better remain all night that your heart may be comforted; and he pressed him so that he tarried there all night, and on the second day he rose up early to go away, when Hedad pressed him, saying, Comfort your heart with a morsel of bread and then go, and he remained and ate with him also the second day, and then the man rose up to continue his journey.

verses.raw: And Hedad said to him, Behold now the day is declining, remain with me to comfort your heart and in the morning rise up early and go your way.
verses.text: And Hedad said to him, Behold now the day is declining, remain with me to comfort your heart and in the morning rise up early and go your way.

verses.raw: And the man would not remain, but rose and saddled his ass, and whilst he was saddling his ass the wife of Hedad said to her husband, Behold this man has remained with us for two days eating and drinking and he has given us nothing, and now shall he go away from us without giving anything? and Hedad said to her, Be silent.
verses.text: And the man would not remain, but rose and saddled his ass, and whilst he was saddling his ass the wife of Hedad said to her husband, Behold this man has remained with us for two days eating and drinking and he has given us nothing, and now shall he go away from us without giving anything? and Hedad said to her, Be silent.

verses.raw: And the man saddled his ass to go, and he asked Hedad to give him the cord and mantle to tie it upon the ass.
verses.text: And the man saddled his ass to go, and he asked Hedad to give him the cord and mantle to tie it upon the ass.

verses.raw: And Hedad said to him, What say you? And he said to him, That you my Lord shall give me the cord and the mantle made with divers colors which you did conceal with you in your house to take care of it.
verses.text: And Hedad said to him, What say you? And he said to him, That you my Lord shall give me the cord and the mantle made with divers colors which you did conceal with you in your house to take care of it.

verses.raw: And Hedad answered the man, saying, This is the interpretation of your dream, the cord which you did see, means that your life will be lengthened out like a cord, and having seen the mantle colored with all sorts of colors, means that you shall have a vineyard in which you will plant trees of all fruits.
verses.text: And Hedad answered the man, saying, This is the interpretation of your dream, the cord which you did see, means that your life will be lengthened out like a cord, and having seen the mantle colored with all sorts of colors, means that you shall have a vineyard in which you will plant trees of all fruits.

verses.raw: And the traveler answered, saying, Not so my Lord, for I was awake when I gave you the cord and also a mantle woven with different colors, which you did take off the ass to put them by for me; and Hedad answered and said, Surely I have told you the interpretation of your dream and it is a good dream, and this is the interpretation of it.
verses.text: And the traveler answered, saying, Not so my Lord, for I was awake when I gave you the cord and also a mantle woven with different colors, which you did take off the ass to put them by for me; and Hedad answered and said, Surely I have told you the interpretation of your dream and it is a good dream, and this is the interpretation of it.

verses.raw: Now the sons of men give me four pieces of silver, which is my charge for interpreting dreams, and of you only I require three pieces of silver.
verses.text: Now the sons of men give me four pieces of silver, which is my charge for interpreting dreams, and of you only I require three pieces of silver.

verses.raw: And the man was provoked at the words of Hedad, and he cried bitterly, and he brought Hedad to Serak judge of Sodom.
verses.text: And the man was provoked at the words of Hedad, and he cried bitterly, and he brought Hedad to Serak judge of Sodom.

verses.raw: And the man laid his cause before Serak the judge, when Hedad replied, saying, It is not so, but thus the matter stands; and the judge said to the traveler, This man Hedad tells you truth, for he is famed in the cities for the accurate interpretation of dreams.
verses.text: And the man laid his cause before Serak the judge, when Hedad replied, saying, It is not so, but thus the matter stands; and the judge said to the traveler, This man Hedad tells you truth, for he is famed in the cities for the accurate interpretation of dreams.

verses.raw: And the man cried at the word of the judge, and he said, Not so my Lord, for it was in the day that I gave him the cord and mantle which was upon the ass, in order to put them by in his house; and they both disputed before the judge, the one saying, Thus the matter was, and the other declaring otherwise.
verses.text: And the man cried at the word of the judge, and he said, Not so my Lord, for it was in the day that I gave him the cord and mantle which was upon the ass, in order to put them by in his house; and they both disputed before the judge, the one saying, Thus the matter was, and the other declaring otherwise.

verses.raw: And Hedad said to the man, Give me four pieces of silver that I charge for my interpretations of dreams; I will not make any allowance; and give me the expense of the four meals that you did eat in my house.
verses.text: And Hedad said to the man, Give me four pieces of silver that I charge for my interpretations of dreams; I will not make any allowance; and give me the expense of the four meals that you did eat in my house.

verses.raw: And the man said to Hedad, Truly I will pay you for what I ate in your house, only give me the cord and mantle which you did conceal in your house.
verses.text: And the man said to Hedad, Truly I will pay you for what I ate in your house, only give me the cord and mantle which you did conceal in your house.

verses.raw: And Hedad replied before the judge and said to the man, Did I not tell you the interpretation of your dream? the cord means that your days shall be prolonged like a cord, and the mantle, that you will have a vineyard in which you will plant all kinds of fruit trees.
verses.text: And Hedad replied before the judge and said to the man, Did I not tell you the interpretation of your dream? the cord means that your days shall be prolonged like a cord, and the mantle, that you will have a vineyard in which you will plant all kinds of fruit trees.

verses.raw: This is the proper interpretation of your dream, now give me the four pieces of silver that I require as a compensation, for I will make you no allowance.
verses.text: This is the proper interpretation of your dream, now give me the four pieces of silver that I require as a compensation, for I will make you no allowance.

verses.raw: And the man cried at the words of Hedad and they both quarreled before the judge, and the judge gave orders to his servants, who drove them rashly from the house.
verses.text: And the man cried at the words of Hedad and they both quarreled before the judge, and the judge gave orders to his servants, who drove them rashly from the house.

verses.raw: And they went away quarreling from the judge, when the people of Sodom heard them, and they gathered about them and they exclaimed against the stranger, and they drove him rashly from the city.
verses.text: And they went away quarreling from the judge, when the people of Sodom heard them, and they gathered about them and they exclaimed against the stranger, and they drove him rashly from the city.

verses.raw: And the man continued his journey upon his ass with bitterness of soul, lamenting and weeping.
verses.text: And the man continued his journey upon his ass with bitterness of soul, lamenting and weeping.

verses.raw: And whilst he was going along he wept at what had happened to him in the corrupt city of Sodom.
verses.text: And whilst he was going along he wept at what had happened to him in the corrupt city of Sodom.

verses.raw: And the cities of Sodom had four judges to four cities, and these were their names, Serak in the city of Sodom, Sharkad in Gomorrah, Zabnac in Admah, and Menon in Zeboyim.
verses.text: And the cities of Sodom had four judges to four cities, and these were their names, Serak in the city of Sodom, Sharkad in Gomorrah, Zabnac in Admah, and Menon in Zeboyim.

verses.raw: And Eliezer Abraham’s servant applied to them different names, and he converted Serak to Shakra, Sharkad to Shakrura, Zebnac to Kezobim, and Menon to Matzlodin.
verses.text: And Eliezer Abraham’s servant applied to them different names, and he converted Serak to Shakra, Sharkad to Shakrura, Zebnac to Kezobim, and Menon to Matzlodin.

verses.raw: And by desire of their four judges the people of Sodom and Gomorrah had beds erected in the streets of the cities, and if a man came to these places they laid hold of him and brought him to one of their beds, and by force made him to lie in them.
verses.text: And by desire of their four judges the people of Sodom and Gomorrah had beds erected in the streets of the cities, and if a man came to these places they laid hold of him and brought him to one of their beds, and by force made him to lie in them.

verses.raw: And as he lay down, three men would stand at his head and three at his feet, and measure him by the length of the bed, and if the man was less than the bed these six men would stretch him at each end, and when he cried out to them they would not answer him.
verses.text: And as he lay down, three men would stand at his head and three at his feet, and measure him by the length of the bed, and if the man was less than the bed these six men would stretch him at each end, and when he cried out to them they would not answer him.

verses.raw: And if he was longer than the bed they would draw together the two sides of the bed at each end, until the man had reached the gates of death.
verses.text: And if he was longer than the bed they would draw together the two sides of the bed at each end, until the man had reached the gates of death.

verses.raw: And if he continued to cry out to them, they would answer him, saying, Thus shall it be done to a man that comes into our land.
verses.text: And if he continued to cry out to them, they would answer him, saying, Thus shall it be done to a man that comes into our land.

verses.raw: And when men heard all these things that the people of the cities of Sodom did, they refrained from coming there.
verses.text: And when men heard all these things that the people of the cities of Sodom did, they refrained from coming there.

verses.raw: And when a poor man came to their land they would give him silver and gold, and cause a proclamation in the whole city not to give him a morsel of bread to eat, and if the stranger should remain there some days, and die from hunger, not having been able to obtain a morsel of bread, then at his death all the people of the city would come and take their silver and gold which they had given to him.
verses.text: And when a poor man came to their land they would give him silver and gold, and cause a proclamation in the whole city not to give him a morsel of bread to eat, and if the stranger should remain there some days, and die from hunger, not having been able to obtain a morsel of bread, then at his death all the people of the city would come and take their silver and gold which they had given to him.

verses.raw: And those that could recognize the silver or gold which they had given him took it back, and at his death they also stripped him of his garments, and they would fight about them, and he that prevailed over his neighbor took them.
verses.text: And those that could recognize the silver or gold which they had given him took it back, and at his death they also stripped him of his garments, and they would fight about them, and he that prevailed over his neighbor took them.

verses.raw: They would after that carry him and bury him under some of the shrubs in the deserts; so they did all the days to any one that came to them and died in their land.
verses.text: They would after that carry him and bury him under some of the shrubs in the deserts; so they did all the days to any one that came to them and died in their land.

verses.raw: And in the course of time Sarah sent Eliezer to Sodom, to see Lot and inquire after his welfare.
verses.text: And in the course of time Sarah sent Eliezer to Sodom, to see Lot and inquire after his welfare.

verses.raw: And Eliezer went to Sodom, and he met a man of Sodom fighting with a stranger, and the man of Sodom stripped the poor man of all his clothes and went away.
verses.text: And Eliezer went to Sodom, and he met a man of Sodom fighting with a stranger, and the man of Sodom stripped the poor man of all his clothes and went away.

verses.raw: And this poor man cried to Eliezer and supplicated his favor on account of what the man of Sodom had done to him.
verses.text: And this poor man cried to Eliezer and supplicated his favor on account of what the man of Sodom had done to him.

verses.raw: And he said to him, Why dost you act thus to the poor man who came to your land?
verses.text: And he said to him, Why dost you act thus to the poor man who came to your land?

verses.raw: And the man of Sodom answered Eliezer, saying, Is this man your brother, or have the people of Sodom made you a judge this day, that you speak about this man?
verses.text: And the man of Sodom answered Eliezer, saying, Is this man your brother, or have the people of Sodom made you a judge this day, that you speak about this man?

verses.raw: And Eliezer strove with the man of Sodom on account of the poor man, and when Eliezer approached to recover the poor man’s clothes from the man of Sodom, he hastened and with a stone smote Eliezer in the forehead.
verses.text: And Eliezer strove with the man of Sodom on account of the poor man, and when Eliezer approached to recover the poor man’s clothes from the man of Sodom, he hastened and with a stone smote Eliezer in the forehead.

verses.raw: And the blood flowed copiously from Eliezer’s forehead, and when the man saw the blood he caught hold of Eliezer, saying, Give me my hire for having rid you of this bad blood that was in your forehead, for such is the custom and the law in our land.
verses.text: And the blood flowed copiously from Eliezer’s forehead, and when the man saw the blood he caught hold of Eliezer, saying, Give me my hire for having rid you of this bad blood that was in your forehead, for such is the custom and the law in our land.

verses.raw: And Eliezer said to him, You have wounded me and require me to pay you your hire; and Eliezer would not hearken to the words of the man of Sodom.
verses.text: And Eliezer said to him, You have wounded me and require me to pay you your hire; and Eliezer would not hearken to the words of the man of Sodom.

verses.raw: And the man laid hold of Eliezer and brought him to Shakra the judge of Sodom for judgment.
verses.text: And the man laid hold of Eliezer and brought him to Shakra the judge of Sodom for judgment.

verses.raw: And the man spoke to the judge, saying, I beseech you my Lord, thus has this man done, for I smote him with a stone that the blood flowed from his forehead, and he is unwilling to give me my hire.
verses.text: And the man spoke to the judge, saying, I beseech you my Lord, thus has this man done, for I smote him with a stone that the blood flowed from his forehead, and he is unwilling to give me my hire.

verses.raw: And the judge said to Eliezer, This man speaks truth to you, give him his hire, for this is the custom in our land; and Eliezer heard the words of the judge, and he lifted up a stone and smote the judge, and the stone struck on his forehead, and the blood flowed copiously from the forehead of the judge, and Eliezer said, If this then is the custom in your land give you to this man what I should have given him, for this has been your decision, you did decree it.
verses.text: And the judge said to Eliezer, This man speaks truth to you, give him his hire, for this is the custom in our land; and Eliezer heard the words of the judge, and he lifted up a stone and smote the judge, and the stone struck on his forehead, and the blood flowed copiously from the forehead of the judge, and Eliezer said, If this then is the custom in your land give you to this man what I should have given him, for this has been your decision, you did decree it.

verses.raw: And Eliezer left the man of Sodom with the judge, and he went away.
verses.text: And Eliezer left the man of Sodom with the judge, and he went away.

verses.raw: And when the kings of Elam had made war with the kings of Sodom, the kings of Elam captured all the property of Sodom, and they took Lot captive, with his property, and when it was told to Abraham he went and made war with the kings of Elam, and he recovered from their hands all the property of Lot as well as the property of Sodom.
verses.text: And when the kings of Elam had made war with the kings of Sodom, the kings of Elam captured all the property of Sodom, and they took Lot captive, with his property, and when it was told to Abraham he went and made war with the kings of Elam, and he recovered from their hands all the property of Lot as well as the property of Sodom.

verses.raw: At that time the wife of Lot bare him a daughter, and he called her name Paltith, saying, Because Elohim (God) had delivered him and his whole household from the kings of Elam; and Paltith daughter of Lot grew up, and one of the men of Sodom took her for a wife.
verses.text: At that time the wife of Lot bare him a daughter, and he called her name Paltith, saying, Because Elohim had delivered him and his whole household from the kings of Elam; and Paltith daughter of Lot grew up, and one of the men of Sodom took her for a wife.

verses.raw: And a poor man came into the city to seek a maintenance, and he remained in the city some days, and all the people of Sodom caused a proclamation of their custom not to give this man a morsel of bread to eat, until he dropped dead upon the earth, and they did so.
verses.text: And a poor man came into the city to seek a maintenance, and he remained in the city some days, and all the people of Sodom caused a proclamation of their custom not to give this man a morsel of bread to eat, until he dropped dead upon the earth, and they did so.

verses.raw: And Paltith the daughter of Lot saw this man lying in the streets starved with hunger, and no one would give him any thing to keep him alive, and he was just upon the point of death.
verses.text: And Paltith the daughter of Lot saw this man lying in the streets starved with hunger, and no one would give him any thing to keep him alive, and he was just upon the point of death.

verses.raw: And her soul was filled with pity on account of the man, and she fed him secretly with bread for many days, and the soul of this man was revived.
verses.text: And her soul was filled with pity on account of the man, and she fed him secretly with bread for many days, and the soul of this man was revived.

verses.raw: For when she went forth to fetch water she would put the bread in the water pitcher, and when she came to the place where the poor man was, she took the bread from the pitcher and gave it him to eat; so she did many days.
verses.text: For when she went forth to fetch water she would put the bread in the water pitcher, and when she came to the place where the poor man was, she took the bread from the pitcher and gave it him to eat; so she did many days.

verses.raw: And all the people of Sodom and Gomorrah wondered how this man could bear starvation for so many days.
verses.text: And all the people of Sodom and Gomorrah wondered how this man could bear starvation for so many days.

verses.raw: And they said to each other, This can only be that he eats and drinks, for no man can bear starvation for so many days or live as this man has, without even his countenance changing; and three men concealed themselves in a place where the poor man was stationed, to know who it was that brought him bread to eat.
verses.text: And they said to each other, This can only be that he eats and drinks, for no man can bear starvation for so many days or live as this man has, without even his countenance changing; and three men concealed themselves in a place where the poor man was stationed, to know who it was that brought him bread to eat.

verses.raw: And Paltith daughter of Lot went forth that day to fetch water, and she put bread into her pitcher of water, and she went to draw water by the poor man’s place, and she took out the bread from the pitcher and gave it to the poor man and he ate it.
verses.text: And Paltith daughter of Lot went forth that day to fetch water, and she put bread into her pitcher of water, and she went to draw water by the poor man’s place, and she took out the bread from the pitcher and gave it to the poor man and he ate it.

verses.raw: And the three men saw what Paltith did to the poor man, and they said to her, It is you then who have supported him, and therefore has he not starved, nor changed in appearance nor died like the rest.
verses.text: And the three men saw what Paltith did to the poor man, and they said to her, It is you then who have supported him, and therefore has he not starved, nor changed in appearance nor died like the rest.

verses.raw: And the three men went out of the place in which they were concealed, and they seized Paltith and the bread which was in the poor man’s hand.
verses.text: And the three men went out of the place in which they were concealed, and they seized Paltith and the bread which was in the poor man’s hand.

verses.raw: And they took Paltith and brought her before their judges, and they said to them, Thus did she do, and it is she who supplied the poor man with bread, therefore did he not die all this time; now therefore declare to us the punishment due to this woman for having transgressed our law.
verses.text: And they took Paltith and brought her before their judges, and they said to them, Thus did she do, and it is she who supplied the poor man with bread, therefore did he not die all this time; now therefore declare to us the punishment due to this woman for having transgressed our law.

verses.raw: And the people of Sodom and Gomorrah assembled and kindled a fire in the street of the city, and they took the woman and cast her into the fire and she was burned to ashes.
verses.text: And the people of Sodom and Gomorrah assembled and kindled a fire in the street of the city, and they took the woman and cast her into the fire and she was burned to ashes.

verses.raw: And in the city of Admah there was a woman to whom they did the like.
verses.text: And in the city of Admah there was a woman to whom they did the like.

verses.raw: For a traveler came into the city of Admah to abide there all night, with the intention of going home in the morning, and he sat opposite the door of the house of the young woman’s father, to remain there, as the sun had set when be had reached that place; and the young woman saw him sitting by the door of the house.
verses.text: For a traveler came into the city of Admah to abide there all night, with the intention of going home in the morning, and he sat opposite the door of the house of the young woman’s father, to remain there, as the sun had set when be had reached that place; and the young woman saw him sitting by the door of the house.

verses.raw: And he asked her for a drink of water and she said to him, Who are you? and he said to her, I was this day going on the road, and reached here when the sun set, so I will abide here all night, and in the morning I will arise early and continue my journey.
verses.text: And he asked her for a drink of water and she said to him, Who are you? and he said to her, I was this day going on the road, and reached here when the sun set, so I will abide here all night, and in the morning I will arise early and continue my journey.

verses.raw: And the young woman went into the house and fetched the man bread and water to eat and drink.
verses.text: And the young woman went into the house and fetched the man bread and water to eat and drink.

verses.raw: And this affair became known to the people of Admah, and they assembled and brought the young woman before the judges, that they should judge her for this act.
verses.text: And this affair became known to the people of Admah, and they assembled and brought the young woman before the judges, that they should judge her for this act.

verses.raw: And the judge said, The judgment of death must pass upon this woman because she transgressed our law, and this therefore is the decision concerning her.
verses.text: And the judge said, The judgment of death must pass upon this woman because she transgressed our law, and this therefore is the decision concerning her.

verses.raw: And the people of those cities assembled and brought out the young woman, and anointed her with honey from head to foot, as the judge had decreed, and they placed her before a swarm of bees which were then in their hives, and the bees flew upon her and stung her that her whole body was swelled.
verses.text: And the people of those cities assembled and brought out the young woman, and anointed her with honey from head to foot, as the judge had decreed, and they placed her before a swarm of bees which were then in their hives, and the bees flew upon her and stung her that her whole body was swelled.

verses.raw: And the young woman cried out on account of the bees, but no one took notice of her or pitied her, and her cries ascended to heaven.
verses.text: And the young woman cried out on account of the bees, but no one took notice of her or pitied her, and her cries ascended to heaven.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) was provoked at this and at all the works of the cities of Sodom, for they had abundance of food, and had tranquility amongst them, and still would not sustain the poor and the needy, and in those days their evil doings and sins became great before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) was provoked at this and at all the works of the cities of Sodom, for they had abundance of food, and had tranquility amongst them, and still would not sustain the poor and the needy, and in those days their evil doings and sins became great before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) sent for two of the angels that had come to Abraham’s house, to destroy Sodom and its cities.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) sent for two of the angels that had come to Abraham’s house, to destroy Sodom and its cities.

verses.raw: And the angels rose up from the door of Abraham’s tent, after they had eaten and drunk, and they reached Sodom in the evening, and Lot was then sitting in the gate of Sodom, and when he saw them he rose to meet them, and he bowed down to the ground.
verses.text: And the angels rose up from the door of Abraham’s tent, after they had eaten and drunk, and they reached Sodom in the evening, and Lot was then sitting in the gate of Sodom, and when he saw them he rose to meet them, and he bowed down to the ground.

verses.raw: And he pressed them greatly and brought them into his house, and he gave them victuals which they ate, and they abode all night in his house.
verses.text: And he pressed them greatly and brought them into his house, and he gave them victuals which they ate, and they abode all night in his house.

verses.raw: And the angels said to Lot, Arise, go forth from this place, you and all belonging to you, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of this city, for Yahuah (the Lord) will destroy this place.
verses.text: And the angels said to Lot, Arise, go forth from this place, you and all belonging to you, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of this city, for Yahuah (the Lord) will destroy this place.

verses.raw: And the angels laid hold upon the hand of Lot and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hands of his children, and all belonging to him, and they brought him forth and set him without the cities.
verses.text: And the angels laid hold upon the hand of Lot and upon the hand of his wife, and upon the hands of his children, and all belonging to him, and they brought him forth and set him without the cities.

verses.raw: And they said to Lot, Escape for your life, and he fled and all belonging to him.
verses.text: And they said to Lot, Escape for your life, and he fled and all belonging to him.

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (the Lord) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah and upon all these cities brimstone and fire from Yahuah (the Lord) out of heaven.
verses.text: Then Yahuah (the Lord) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah and upon all these cities brimstone and fire from Yahuah (the Lord) out of heaven.

verses.raw: And he overthrew these cities, all the plain and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground; and Ado the wife of Lot looked back to see the destruction of the cities, for her compassion was moved on account of her daughters who remained in Sodom, for they did not go with her.
verses.text: And he overthrew these cities, all the plain and all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew upon the ground; and Ado the wife of Lot looked back to see the destruction of the cities, for her compassion was moved on account of her daughters who remained in Sodom, for they did not go with her.

verses.raw: And when she looked back she became a pillar of salt, and it is yet in that place to this day.
verses.text: And when she looked back she became a pillar of salt, and it is yet in that place to this day.

verses.raw: And the oxen which stood in that place daily licked up the salt to the extremities of their feet, and in the morning it would spring forth afresh, and they again licked it up to this day.
verses.text: And the oxen which stood in that place daily licked up the salt to the extremities of their feet, and in the morning it would spring forth afresh, and they again licked it up to this day.

verses.raw: And Lot and two of his daughters that remained with him fled and escaped to the cave of Adullam, and they remained there for some time.
verses.text: And Lot and two of his daughters that remained with him fled and escaped to the cave of Adullam, and they remained there for some time.

verses.raw: And Abraham rose up early in the morning to see what had been done to the cities of Sodom; and he looked and beheld the smoke of the cities going up like the smoke of a furnace.
verses.text: And Abraham rose up early in the morning to see what had been done to the cities of Sodom; and he looked and beheld the smoke of the cities going up like the smoke of a furnace.

verses.raw: And Lot and his two daughters remained in the cave, and they made their father drink wine, and they lay with him, for they said there was no man upon earth that could raise up seed from them, for they thought that the whole earth was destroyed.
verses.text: And Lot and his two daughters remained in the cave, and they made their father drink wine, and they lay with him, for they said there was no man upon earth that could raise up seed from them, for they thought that the whole earth was destroyed.

verses.raw: And they both lay with their father, and they conceived and bare sons, and the first born called the name of her son Moab, saying, From my father did I conceive him; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.
verses.text: And they both lay with their father, and they conceived and bare sons, and the first born called the name of her son Moab, saying, From my father did I conceive him; he is the father of the Moabites to this day.

verses.raw: And the younger also called her son Benami; he is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.
verses.text: And the younger also called her son Benami; he is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

verses.raw: And after this Lot and his two daughters went away from there, and he dwelt on the other side of the Jordan with his two daughters and their sons, and the sons of Lot grew up, and they went and took themselves wives from the land of Canaan, and they begat children and they were fruitful and multiplied.
verses.text: And after this Lot and his two daughters went away from there, and he dwelt on the other side of the Jordan with his two daughters and their sons, and the sons of Lot grew up, and they went and took themselves wives from the land of Canaan, and they begat children and they were fruitful and multiplied.

verses.raw: And at that time Abraham journeyed from the plain of Mamre, and he went to the land of the Philistines, and he dwelt in Gerar; it was in the twenty-fifth year of Abraham’s being in the land of Canaan, and the hundredth year of the life of Abraham, that he came to Gerar in the land of the Philistines.
verses.text: And at that time Abraham journeyed from the plain of Mamre, and he went to the land of the Philistines, and he dwelt in Gerar; it was in the twenty-fifth year of Abraham’s being in the land of Canaan, and the hundredth year of the life of Abraham, that he came to Gerar in the land of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And when they entered the land he said to Sarah his wife, Say you are my sister, to any one that shall ask you, in order that we may escape the evil of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text: And when they entered the land he said to Sarah his wife, Say you are my sister, to any one that shall ask you, in order that we may escape the evil of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.raw: And as Abraham was dwelling in the land of the Philistines, the servants of Abimelech, king of the Philistines, saw that Sarah was exceedingly beautiful, and they asked Abraham concerning her, and he said, She is my sister.
verses.text: And as Abraham was dwelling in the land of the Philistines, the servants of Abimelech, king of the Philistines, saw that Sarah was exceedingly beautiful, and they asked Abraham concerning her, and he said, She is my sister.

verses.raw: And the servants of Abimelech went to Abimelech, saying, A man from the land of Canaan is come to dwell in the land, and he has a sister that is exceeding fair.
verses.text: And the servants of Abimelech went to Abimelech, saying, A man from the land of Canaan is come to dwell in the land, and he has a sister that is exceeding fair.

verses.raw: And Abimelech heard the words of his servants who praised Sarah to him, and Abimelech sent his officers, and they brought Sarah to the king.
verses.text: And Abimelech heard the words of his servants who praised Sarah to him, and Abimelech sent his officers, and they brought Sarah to the king.

verses.raw: And Sarah came to the house of Abimelech, and the king saw that Sarah was beautiful, and she pleased him exceedingly.
verses.text: And Sarah came to the house of Abimelech, and the king saw that Sarah was beautiful, and she pleased him exceedingly.

verses.raw: And he approached her and said to her, What is that man to you with whom you did come to our land? and Sarah answered and said He is my brother, and we came from the land of Canaan to dwell wherever we could find a place.
verses.text: And he approached her and said to her, What is that man to you with whom you did come to our land? and Sarah answered and said He is my brother, and we came from the land of Canaan to dwell wherever we could find a place.

verses.raw: And Abimelech said to Sarah, Behold my land is before you, place your brother in any part of this land that pleases you, and it will be our duty to exalt and elevate him above all the people of the land since he is your brother.
verses.text: And Abimelech said to Sarah, Behold my land is before you, place your brother in any part of this land that pleases you, and it will be our duty to exalt and elevate him above all the people of the land since he is your brother.

verses.raw: And Abimelech sent for Abraham, and Abraham came to Abimelech.
verses.text: And Abimelech sent for Abraham, and Abraham came to Abimelech.

verses.raw: And Abimelech said to Abraham, Behold I have given orders that you shall be honored as you desire on account of your sister Sarah.
verses.text: And Abimelech said to Abraham, Behold I have given orders that you shall be honored as you desire on account of your sister Sarah.

verses.raw: And Abraham went forth from the king, and the king’s present followed him.
verses.text: And Abraham went forth from the king, and the king’s present followed him.

verses.raw: As at evening time, before men lie down to rest, the king was sitting upon his throne, and a deep sleep fell upon him, and he lay upon the throne and slept till morning.
verses.text: As at evening time, before men lie down to rest, the king was sitting upon his throne, and a deep sleep fell upon him, and he lay upon the throne and slept till morning.

verses.raw: And he dreamed that an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) came to him with a drawn sword in his hand, and the angel stood over Abimelech, and wished to slay him with the sword, and the king was terrified in his dream, and said to the angel, In what have I sinned against you that you come to slay me with your sword?
verses.text: And he dreamed that an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) came to him with a drawn sword in his hand, and the angel stood over Abimelech, and wished to slay him with the sword, and the king was terrified in his dream, and said to the angel, In what have I sinned against you that you come to slay me with your sword?

verses.raw: And the angel answered and said to Abimelech, Behold you die on account of the woman which you did yesternight bring to your house, for she is a married woman, the wife of Abraham who came to your house; now therefore return that man his wife, for she is his wife; and should you not return her, know that you will surely die, you and all belonging to you.
verses.text: And the angel answered and said to Abimelech, Behold you die on account of the woman which you did yesternight bring to your house, for she is a married woman, the wife of Abraham who came to your house; now therefore return that man his wife, for she is his wife; and should you not return her, know that you will surely die, you and all belonging to you.

verses.raw: And on that night there was a great outcry in the land of the Philistines, and the inhabitants of the land saw the figure of a man standing with a drawn sword in his hand, and he smote the inhabitants of the land with the sword, yea he continued to smite them.
verses.text: And on that night there was a great outcry in the land of the Philistines, and the inhabitants of the land saw the figure of a man standing with a drawn sword in his hand, and he smote the inhabitants of the land with the sword, yea he continued to smite them.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) smote the whole land of the Philistines on that night, and there was a great confusion on that night and on the following morning.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) smote the whole land of the Philistines on that night, and there was a great confusion on that night and on the following morning.

verses.raw: And every womb was closed, and all their issues, and the hand of Yahuah (the Lord) was upon them on account of Sarah, wife of Abraham, whom Abimelech had taken.
verses.text: And every womb was closed, and all their issues, and the hand of Yahuah (the Lord) was upon them on account of Sarah, wife of Abraham, whom Abimelech had taken.

verses.raw: And in the morning Abimelech rose with terror and confusion and with a great dread, and he sent and had his servants called in, and he related his dream to them, and the people were greatly afraid.
verses.text: And in the morning Abimelech rose with terror and confusion and with a great dread, and he sent and had his servants called in, and he related his dream to them, and the people were greatly afraid.

verses.raw: And one man standing amongst the servants of the king answered the king, saying, O sovereign king, restore this woman to her husband, for he is her husband, for the like happened to the king of Egypt when this man came to Egypt.
verses.text: And one man standing amongst the servants of the king answered the king, saying, O sovereign king, restore this woman to her husband, for he is her husband, for the like happened to the king of Egypt when this man came to Egypt.

verses.raw: And he said concerning his wife, She is my sister, for such is his manner of doing when he comes to dwell in the land in which he is a stranger.
verses.text: And he said concerning his wife, She is my sister, for such is his manner of doing when he comes to dwell in the land in which he is a stranger.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh sent and took this woman for a wife and Yahuah (the Lord) brought upon him grievous plagues until he returned the woman to her husband.
verses.text: And Pharaoh sent and took this woman for a wife and Yahuah (the Lord) brought upon him grievous plagues until he returned the woman to her husband.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O sovereign king, know what happened yesternight to the whole land, for there was a very great consternation and great pain and lamentation, and we know that it was on account of the woman which you did take.
verses.text: Now therefore, O sovereign king, know what happened yesternight to the whole land, for there was a very great consternation and great pain and lamentation, and we know that it was on account of the woman which you did take.

verses.raw: Now, therefore, restore this woman to her husband, lest it should befall us as it did to Pharaoh king of Egypt and his subjects, and that we may not die; and Abimelech hastened and called and had Sarah called for, and she came before him, and he had Abraham called for, and he came before him.
verses.text: Now, therefore, restore this woman to her husband, lest it should befall us as it did to Pharaoh king of Egypt and his subjects, and that we may not die; and Abimelech hastened and called and had Sarah called for, and she came before him, and he had Abraham called for, and he came before him.

verses.raw: And Abimelech said to them, What is this work you have been doing in saying you are brother and sister, and I took this woman for a wife?
verses.text: And Abimelech said to them, What is this work you have been doing in saying you are brother and sister, and I took this woman for a wife?

verses.raw: And Abraham said, Because I thought I should suffer death on account of my wife; and Abimelech took flocks and herds, and men servants and maid servants, and a thousand pieces of silver, and he gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah to him.
verses.text: And Abraham said, Because I thought I should suffer death on account of my wife; and Abimelech took flocks and herds, and men servants and maid servants, and a thousand pieces of silver, and he gave them to Abraham, and he returned Sarah to him.

verses.raw: And Abimelech said to Abraham, Behold the whole land is before you, dwell in it wherever you shall choose.
verses.text: And Abimelech said to Abraham, Behold the whole land is before you, dwell in it wherever you shall choose.

verses.raw: And Abraham and Sarah, his wife, went forth from the king’s presence with honor and respect, and they dwelt in the land, even in Gerar.
verses.text: And Abraham and Sarah, his wife, went forth from the king’s presence with honor and respect, and they dwelt in the land, even in Gerar.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of the land of the Philistines and the king’s servants were still in pain, through the plague which the angel had inflicted upon them the whole night on account of Sarah.
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of the land of the Philistines and the king’s servants were still in pain, through the plague which the angel had inflicted upon them the whole night on account of Sarah.

verses.raw: And Abimelech sent for Abraham, saying, Pray now for your servants to Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God), that he may put away this mortality from amongst us.
verses.text: And Abimelech sent for Abraham, saying, Pray now for your servants to Yahuah your Elohim, that he may put away this mortality from amongst us.

verses.raw: And Abraham prayed on account of Abimelech and his subjects, and Yahuah (the Lord) heard the prayer of Abraham, and he healed Abimelech and all his subjects.
verses.text: And Abraham prayed on account of Abimelech and his subjects, and Yahuah (the Lord) heard the prayer of Abraham, and he healed Abimelech and all his subjects.

verses.raw: And it was at that time at the end of a year and four months of Abraham’s dwelling in the land of the Philistines in Gerar, that Elohim (God) visited Sarah, and Yahuah (the Lord) remembered her, and she conceived and bare a son to Abraham.
verses.text: And it was at that time at the end of a year and four months of Abraham’s dwelling in the land of the Philistines in Gerar, that Elohim visited Sarah, and Yahuah (the Lord) remembered her, and she conceived and bare a son to Abraham.

verses.raw: And Abraham called the name of the son which was born to him, which Sarah bare to him, Isaac.
verses.text: And Abraham called the name of the son which was born to him, which Sarah bare to him, Isaac.

verses.raw: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac at eight days old, as Elohim had commanded Abraham to do to his seed after him; and Abraham was one hundred, and Sarah ninety years old, when Isaac was born to them.
verses.text: And Abraham circumcised his son Isaac at eight days old, as Elohim had commanded Abraham to do to his seed after him; and Abraham was one hundred, and Sarah ninety years old, when Isaac was born to them.

verses.raw: And the child grew up and he was weaned, and Abraham made a great feast upon the day that Isaac was weaned.
verses.text: And the child grew up and he was weaned, and Abraham made a great feast upon the day that Isaac was weaned.

verses.raw: And Shem and Eber and all the great people of the land, and Abimelech king of the Philistines, and his servants, and Phicol, the captain of his host, came to eat and drink and rejoice at the feast which Abraham made upon the day of his son Isaac’s being weaned.
verses.text: And Shem and Eber and all the great people of the land, and Abimelech king of the Philistines, and his servants, and Phicol, the captain of his host, came to eat and drink and rejoice at the feast which Abraham made upon the day of his son Isaac’s being weaned.

verses.raw: Also Terah, the father of Abraham, and Nahor his brother, came from Haran, they and all belonging to them, for they greatly rejoiced on hearing that a son had been born to Sarah.
verses.text: Also Terah, the father of Abraham, and Nahor his brother, came from Haran, they and all belonging to them, for they greatly rejoiced on hearing that a son had been born to Sarah.

verses.raw: And they came to Abraham, and they ate and drank at the feast which Abraham made upon the day of Isaac’s being weaned.
verses.text: And they came to Abraham, and they ate and drank at the feast which Abraham made upon the day of Isaac’s being weaned.

verses.raw: And Terah and Nahor rejoiced with Abraham, and they remained with him many days in the land of the Philistines.
verses.text: And Terah and Nahor rejoiced with Abraham, and they remained with him many days in the land of the Philistines.

verses.raw: At that time Serug the son of Reu died, in the first year of the birth of Isaac son of Abraham.
verses.text: At that time Serug the son of Reu died, in the first year of the birth of Isaac son of Abraham.

verses.raw: And all the days of Serug were two hundred and thirty-nine years, and he died.
verses.text: And all the days of Serug were two hundred and thirty-nine years, and he died.

verses.raw: And Ishmael the son of Abraham was grown up in those days; he was fourteen years old when Sarah bare Isaac to Abraham.
verses.text: And Ishmael the son of Abraham was grown up in those days; he was fourteen years old when Sarah bare Isaac to Abraham.

verses.raw: And Elohim was with Ishmael the son of Abraham, and he grew up, and he learned to use the bow and became an archer.
verses.text: And Elohim was with Ishmael the son of Abraham, and he grew up, and he learned to use the bow and became an archer.

verses.raw: And when Isaac was five years old he was sitting with Ishmael at the door of the tent.
verses.text: And when Isaac was five years old he was sitting with Ishmael at the door of the tent.

verses.raw: And Ishmael came to Isaac and seated himself opposite to him, and he took the bow and drew it and put the arrow in it, and intended to slay Isaac.
verses.text: And Ishmael came to Isaac and seated himself opposite to him, and he took the bow and drew it and put the arrow in it, and intended to slay Isaac.

verses.raw: And Sarah saw the act which Ishmael desired to do to her son Isaac, and it grieved her exceedingly on account of her son, and she sent for Abraham, and said to him, Cast out this bondwoman and her son, for her son shall not be heir with my son, for thus did he seek to do to him this day.

verses.raw: And Abraham hearkened to the voice of Sarah, and he rose up early in the morning, and he took twelve loaves and a bottle of water which he gave to Hagar, and sent her away with her son, and Hagar went with her son to the wilderness, and they dwelt in the wilderness of Paran with the inhabitants of the wilderness, and Ishmael was an archer, and he dwelt in the wilderness a long time.

verses.raw: And Elohim gave Ishmael flocks and herds and tents on account of Abraham his father, and the man increased in cattle.

verses.raw: And Ishmael dwelt in deserts and in tents, traveling and resting for a long time, and he did not see the face of his father.

verses.raw: And in some time after, Abraham said to Sarah his wife, I will go and see my son Ishmael, for I have a desire to see him, for I have not seen him for a long time.

verses.raw: And Abraham rode upon one of his camels to the wilderness to seek his son Ishmael, for he heard that he was dwelling in a tent in the wilderness with all belonging to him.

verses.raw: And Abraham asked the wife of Ishmael, saying, Where has Ishmael gone? and she said, He has gone to the field to hunt, and Abraham was still mounted upon the camel, for he would not get off to the ground as he had sworn to his wife Sarah that he would not get off from the camel.

verses.raw: And Ishmael’s wife answered and said to Abraham, We have neither water nor bread, and she continued sitting in the tent and did not notice Abraham, neither did she ask him who he was.

verses.raw: But she was beating her children in the tent, and she was cursing them, and she also cursed her husband Ishmael and reproached him, and Abraham heard the words of Ishmael’s wife to her children, and he was very angry and displeased.

verses.raw: And at the end of three years Abraham said, I will go again and see Ishmael my son, for I have not seen him for a long time.

verses.raw: And he rode upon his camel and went to the wilderness, and he reached the tent of Ishmael about noon.
verses.text: And he rode upon his camel and went to the wilderness, and he reached the tent of Ishmael about noon.

verses.raw: And he asked after Ishmael, and his wife came out of the tent and she said, He is not here my Lord, for he has gone to hunt in the fields, and to feed the camels, and the woman said to Abraham, Turn in my Lord into the tent, and eat a morsel of bread, for your soul must be wearied on account of the journey.
verses.text: And he asked after Ishmael, and his wife came out of the tent and she said, He is not here my Lord, for he has gone to hunt in the fields, and to feed the camels, and the woman said to Abraham, Turn in my Lord into the tent, and eat a morsel of bread, for your soul must be wearied on account of the journey.

verses.raw: And Abraham said to her, I will not stop for I am in haste to continue my journey, but give me a little water to drink, for I have thirst; and the woman hastened and ran into the tent and she brought out water and bread to Abraham, which she placed before him and she urged him to eat, and he ate and drank and his heart was comforted and he blessed his son Ishmael.

verses.raw: And he finished his meal and he blessed Yahuah (the Lord), and he said to Ishmael’s wife, When Ishmael comes home say these words to him,

verses.raw: And Abraham finished commanding the woman, and he rode off to his home to the land of the Philistines; and when Ishmael came to his tent his wife went forth to meet him with joy and a cheerful heart.

verses.raw: And Ishmael then rose up and took his wife and his children and his cattle and all belonging to him, and he journeyed from there and he went to his father in the land of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And Ishmael and his children dwelt with Abraham many days in that land, and Abraham dwelt in the land of the Philistines a long time.

verses.raw: And the days increased and reached twenty six years, and after that Abraham with his servants and all belonging to him went from the land of the Philistines and removed to a great distance, and they came near to Hebron, and they remained there, and the servants of Abraham dug wells of water, and Abraham and all belonging to him dwelt by the water, and the servants of Abimelech king of the Philistines heard the report that Abraham’s servants had dug wells of water in the borders of the land.

verses.raw: And they came and quarreled with the servants of Abraham, and they robbed them of the great well which they had dug.
