verses.raw: And Abimelech king of the Philistines heard of this affair, and he with Phicol the captain of his host and twenty of his men came to Abraham, and Abimelech spoke to Abraham concerning his servants, and Abraham rebuked Abimelech concerning the well of which his servants had robbed him.

verses.raw: And Abimelech said to Abraham, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives who created the whole earth, I did not hear of the act which my servants did to your servants until this day.

verses.raw: And Abraham took seven ewe lambs and gave them to Abimelech, saying, Take these, I pray you, from my hands that it may be a testimony for me that I dug this well.

verses.raw: And Abraham planted a large grove in Beersheba, and he made to it four gates facing the four sides of the earth, and he planted a vineyard in it, so that if a traveler came to Abraham he entered any gate which was in his road, and remained there and ate and drank and satisfied himself and then departed.

verses.raw: For the house of Abraham was always open to the sons of men that passed and repassed, who came daily to eat and drink in the house of Abraham.

verses.raw: And any man who had hunger and came to Abraham’s house, Abraham would give him bread that he might eat and drink and be satisfied, and any one that came naked to his house he would clothe with garments as he might choose, and give him silver and gold and make known to him Yahuah (the Lord) who had created him in the earth; this did Abraham all his life.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) heard the word that Isaac spoke to Ishmael, and it seemed good in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and he thought to try Abraham in this matter.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) heard the word that Isaac spoke to Ishmael, and it seemed good in the sight of Yahuah (the Lord), and he thought to try Abraham in this matter.

verses.raw: And the day arrived when the sons of Elohim came and placed themselves before Yahuah (the Lord), and Satan also came with the sons of Elohim before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And the day arrived when the sons of Elohim came and placed themselves before Yahuah (the Lord), and Satan also came with the sons of Elohim before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Satan, Whence come you? and Satan answered Yahuah (the Lord) and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Satan, Whence come you? and Satan answered Yahuah (the Lord) and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Satan, What is your word to me concerning all the children of the earth? and Satan answered Yahuah (the Lord) and said, I have seen all the children of the earth who serve you and remember you when they require anything from you.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Satan, What is your word to me concerning all the children of the earth? and Satan answered Yahuah (the Lord) and said, I have seen all the children of the earth who serve you and remember you when they require anything from you.

verses.raw: And when you give them the thing which they require from you, they sit at their ease, and forsake you and they remember you no more.
verses.text: And when you give them the thing which they require from you, they sit at their ease, and forsake you and they remember you no more.

verses.raw: Have you seen Abraham the son of Terah, who at first had no children, and he served you and erected altars to you wherever he came, and he brought up offerings upon them, and he proclaimed your name continually to all the children of the earth.
verses.text: Have you seen Abraham the son of Terah, who at first had no children, and he served you and erected altars to you wherever he came, and he brought up offerings upon them, and he proclaimed your name continually to all the children of the earth.

verses.raw: And now that his son Isaac is born to him, he has forsaken you, he has made a great feast for all the inhabitants of the land, and Yahuah (the Lord) he has forgotten.
verses.text: And now that his son Isaac is born to him, he has forsaken you, he has made a great feast for all the inhabitants of the land, and Yahuah (the Lord) he has forgotten.

verses.raw: For amidst all that he has done he brought you no offering; neither burnt offering nor peace offering, neither ox, lamb nor goat of all that he killed on the day that his son was weaned.
verses.text: For amidst all that he has done he brought you no offering; neither burnt offering nor peace offering, neither ox, lamb nor goat of all that he killed on the day that his son was weaned.

verses.raw: Even from the time of his son’s birth till now, being thirty-seven years, he built no altar before you, nor brought any offering to you, for he saw that you did give what he requested before you, and he therefore forsook you.
verses.text: Even from the time of his son’s birth till now, being thirty-seven years, he built no altar before you, nor brought any offering to you, for he saw that you did give what he requested before you, and he therefore forsook you.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Satan, Have you thus considered my servant Abraham? for there is none like him upon earth, a perfect and an upright man before me, one that fears Elohim and avoids evil; as I live, were I to say to him, Bring up Isaac your son before me, he would not withhold him from me, much more if I told him to bring up a burnt offering before me from his flock or herds.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Satan, Have you thus considered my servant Abraham? for there is none like him upon earth, a perfect and an upright man before me, one that fears Elohim and avoids evil; as I live, were I to say to him, Bring up Isaac your son before me, he would not withhold him from me, much more if I told him to bring up a burnt offering before me from his flock or herds.

verses.raw: And Satan answered Yahuah (the Lord) and said, Speak then now to Abraham as you have said, and you will see whether he will not this day transgress and cast aside your words.
verses.text: And Satan answered Yahuah (the Lord) and said, Speak then now to Abraham as you have said, and you will see whether he will not this day transgress and cast aside your words.

verses.raw: At that time the word of Yahuah (the Lord) came to Abraham, and he said to him, Abraham, and he said, Here I am.
verses.text: At that time the word of Yahuah (the Lord) came to Abraham, and he said to him, Abraham, and he said, Here I am.

verses.raw: And he said to him, Take now your son, your only son whom you love, even Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which shall be shown to you, for there will you see a cloud and the glory of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And he said to him, Take now your son, your only son whom you love, even Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which shall be shown to you, for there will you see a cloud and the glory of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Abraham said within himself, How shall I separate my son Isaac from Sarah his mother, in order to bring him up for a burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord)?
verses.text: And Abraham said within himself, How shall I separate my son Isaac from Sarah his mother, in order to bring him up for a burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord)?

verses.raw: And Abraham came into the tent, and he sat before Sarah his wife, and he spoke these words to her,
verses.text: And Abraham came into the tent, and he sat before Sarah his wife, and he spoke these words to her,

verses.raw: My son Isaac is grown up and he has not for some time studied the service of his Elohim (God), now tomorrow I will go and bring him to Shem, and Eber his son, and there he will learn the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), for they will teach him to know Yahuah (the Lord) as well as to know that when he prays continually before Yahuah (the Lord), he will answer him, therefore there he will know the way of serving Yahuah his Elohim (the Lord his God).
verses.text: My son Isaac is grown up and he has not for some time studied the service of his Elohim, now tomorrow I will go and bring him to Shem, and Eber his son, and there he will learn the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), for they will teach him to know Yahuah (the Lord) as well as to know that when he prays continually before Yahuah (the Lord), he will answer him, therefore there he will know the way of serving Yahuah his Elohim.

verses.raw: And Sarah said, You have spoken well, go my Lord and do to him as you have said, but remove him not at a great distance from me, neither let him remain there too long, for my soul is bound within his soul.
verses.text: And Sarah said, You have spoken well, go my Lord and do to him as you have said, but remove him not at a great distance from me, neither let him remain there too long, for my soul is bound within his soul.

verses.raw: And Abraham said to Sarah, My daughter, let us pray to Yahuah our Elohim (the Lord our God) that he may do good with us.
verses.text: And Abraham said to Sarah, My daughter, let us pray to Yahuah our Elohim that he may do good with us.

verses.raw: And Sarah took her son Isaac and he abode all that night with her, and she kissed and embraced him, and gave him instructions till morning.
verses.text: And Sarah took her son Isaac and he abode all that night with her, and she kissed and embraced him, and gave him instructions till morning.

verses.raw: And she said to him, O my son, how can my soul separate itself from you? And she still kissed him and embraced him, and she gave Abraham instructions concerning him.
verses.text: And she said to him, O my son, how can my soul separate itself from you? And she still kissed him and embraced him, and she gave Abraham instructions concerning him.

verses.raw: And Sarah said to Abraham, O my Lord, I pray you take heed of your son, and place your eyes over him, for I have no other son nor daughter but him.
verses.text: And Sarah said to Abraham, O my Lord, I pray you take heed of your son, and place your eyes over him, for I have no other son nor daughter but him.

verses.raw: O forsake him not. If he be hungry give him bread, and if he be thirsty give him water to drink; do not let him go on foot, neither let him sit in the sun.
verses.text: O forsake him not. If he be hungry give him bread, and if he be thirsty give him water to drink; do not let him go on foot, neither let him sit in the sun.

verses.raw: Neither let him go by himself in the road, neither force him from whatever he may desire, but do to him as he may say to you.
verses.text: Neither let him go by himself in the road, neither force him from whatever he may desire, but do to him as he may say to you.

verses.raw: And Sarah wept bitterly the whole night on account of Isaac, and she gave him instructions till morning.
verses.text: And Sarah wept bitterly the whole night on account of Isaac, and she gave him instructions till morning.

verses.raw: And in the morning Sarah selected a very fine and beautiful garment from those garments which she had in the house, that Abimelech had given to her.
verses.text: And in the morning Sarah selected a very fine and beautiful garment from those garments which she had in the house, that Abimelech had given to her.

verses.raw: And she dressed Isaac her son therewith, and she put a turban upon his head, and she enclosed a precious stone in the top of the turban, and she gave them provision for the road, and they went forth, and Isaac went with his father Abraham, and some of their servants accompanied them to see them off the road.
verses.text: And she dressed Isaac her son therewith, and she put a turban upon his head, and she enclosed a precious stone in the top of the turban, and she gave them provision for the road, and they went forth, and Isaac went with his father Abraham, and some of their servants accompanied them to see them off the road.

verses.raw: And Sarah went out with them, and she accompanied them upon the road to see them off, and they said to her, Return to the tent.
verses.text: And Sarah went out with them, and she accompanied them upon the road to see them off, and they said to her, Return to the tent.

verses.raw: And when Sarah heard the words of her son Isaac she wept bitterly, and Abraham her husband wept with her, and their son wept with them a great weeping; also those who went with them wept greatly.
verses.text: And when Sarah heard the words of her son Isaac she wept bitterly, and Abraham her husband wept with her, and their son wept with them a great weeping; also those who went with them wept greatly.

verses.raw: And Sarah caught hold of her son Isaac, and she held him in her arms, and she embraced him and continued to weep with him, and Sarah said, Who knows if after this day I shall ever see you again?
verses.text: And Sarah caught hold of her son Isaac, and she held him in her arms, and she embraced him and continued to weep with him, and Sarah said, Who knows if after this day I shall ever see you again?

verses.raw: And they still wept together, Abraham, Sarah and Isaac, and all those that accompanied them on the road wept with them, and Sarah afterward turned away from her son, weeping bitterly, and all her men servants and maid servants returned with her to the tent.
verses.text: And they still wept together, Abraham, Sarah and Isaac, and all those that accompanied them on the road wept with them, and Sarah afterward turned away from her son, weeping bitterly, and all her men servants and maid servants returned with her to the tent.

verses.raw: And Abraham went with Isaac his son to bring him up as an offering before Yahuah (the Lord), as He had commanded him.
verses.text: And Abraham went with Isaac his son to bring him up as an offering before Yahuah (the Lord), as He had commanded him.

verses.raw: And Abraham took two of his young men with him, Ishmael the son of Hagar and Eliezer his servant, and they went together with them, and whilst they were walking in the road the young men spoke these words to themselves,
verses.text: And Abraham took two of his young men with him, Ishmael the son of Hagar and Eliezer his servant, and they went together with them, and whilst they were walking in the road the young men spoke these words to themselves,

verses.raw: And Ishmael said to Eliezer, Now my father Abraham is going with Isaac to bring him up for a burnt offering to Yahuah (the Lord), as He commanded him.
verses.text: And Ishmael said to Eliezer, Now my father Abraham is going with Isaac to bring him up for a burnt offering to Yahuah (the Lord), as He commanded him.

verses.raw: Now when he returns he will give to me all that he possesses, to inherit after him, for I am his first born.
verses.text: Now when he returns he will give to me all that he possesses, to inherit after him, for I am his first born.

verses.raw: And Eliezer answered Ishmael and said, Surely Abraham did cast you away with your mother, and swear that you should not inherit any thing of all he possesses, and to whom will he give all that he has, with all his treasures, but to me his servant, who has been faithful in his house, who has served him night and day, and has done all that he desired me? to me will he bequeath at his death all that he possesses.
verses.text: And Eliezer answered Ishmael and said, Surely Abraham did cast you away with your mother, and swear that you should not inherit any thing of all he possesses, and to whom will he give all that he has, with all his treasures, but to me his servant, who has been faithful in his house, who has served him night and day, and has done all that he desired me? to me will he bequeath at his death all that he possesses.

verses.raw: And whilst Abraham was proceeding with his son Isaac along the road, Satan came and appeared to Abraham in the figure of a very aged man, humble and of contrite spirit, and he approached Abraham and said to him, Are you silly or brutish, that you go to do this thing this day to your only son?
verses.text: And whilst Abraham was proceeding with his son Isaac along the road, Satan came and appeared to Abraham in the figure of a very aged man, humble and of contrite spirit, and he approached Abraham and said to him, Are you silly or brutish, that you go to do this thing this day to your only son?

verses.raw: For Elohim gave you a son in your latter days, in your old age, and will you go and slaughter him this day because he committed no violence, and will you cause the soul of your only son to perish from the earth?
verses.text: For Elohim gave you a son in your latter days, in your old age, and will you go and slaughter him this day because he committed no violence, and will you cause the soul of your only son to perish from the earth?

verses.raw: Dost you not know and understand that this thing cannot be from Yahuah (the Lord)? for Yahuah (the Lord) cannot do to man such evil upon earth to say to him, Go slaughter your child.
verses.text: Dost you not know and understand that this thing cannot be from Yahuah (the Lord)? for Yahuah (the Lord) cannot do to man such evil upon earth to say to him, Go slaughter your child.

verses.raw: And Abraham heard this and knew that it was the word of Satan who endeavored to draw him aside from the way of Yahuah (the Lord), but Abraham would not hearken to the voice of Satan, and Abraham rebuked him so that he went away.
verses.text: And Abraham heard this and knew that it was the word of Satan who endeavored to draw him aside from the way of Yahuah (the Lord), but Abraham would not hearken to the voice of Satan, and Abraham rebuked him so that he went away.

verses.raw: And Satan returned and came to Isaac; and he appeared to Isaac in the figure of a young man comely and well favored.
verses.text: And Satan returned and came to Isaac; and he appeared to Isaac in the figure of a young man comely and well favored.

verses.raw: And he approached Isaac and said to him, Dost you not know and understand that your old silly father brings you to the slaughter this day for naught?
verses.text: And he approached Isaac and said to him, Dost you not know and understand that your old silly father brings you to the slaughter this day for naught?

verses.raw: Now therefore, my son, do not listen nor attend to him, for he is a silly old man, and let not your precious soul and beautiful figure be lost from the earth.
verses.text: Now therefore, my son, do not listen nor attend to him, for he is a silly old man, and let not your precious soul and beautiful figure be lost from the earth.

verses.raw: And Isaac heard this, and said to Abraham, Have you heard, my father, that which this man has spoken? even thus has he spoken.
verses.text: And Isaac heard this, and said to Abraham, Have you heard, my father, that which this man has spoken? even thus has he spoken.

verses.raw: And Abraham answered his son Isaac and said to him, Take heed of him and do not listen to his words, nor attend to him, for he is Satan, endeavoring to draw us aside this day from the commands of Elohim.
verses.text: And Abraham answered his son Isaac and said to him, Take heed of him and do not listen to his words, nor attend to him, for he is Satan, endeavoring to draw us aside this day from the commands of Elohim.

verses.raw: And Abraham still rebuked Satan, and Satan went from them, and seeing he could not prevail over them he hid himself from them, and he went and passed before them in the road; and he transformed himself to a large brook of water in the road, and Abraham and Isaac and his two young men reached that place, and they saw a brook large and powerful as the mighty waters.
verses.text: And Abraham still rebuked Satan, and Satan went from them, and seeing he could not prevail over them he hid himself from them, and he went and passed before them in the road; and he transformed himself to a large brook of water in the road, and Abraham and Isaac and his two young men reached that place, and they saw a brook large and powerful as the mighty waters.

verses.raw: And they entered the brook and passed through it, and the waters at first reached their legs.
verses.text: And they entered the brook and passed through it, and the waters at first reached their legs.

verses.raw: And they went deeper in the brook and the waters reached up to their necks, and they were all terrified on account of the water; and whilst they were going over the brook Abraham recognized that place, and he knew that there was no water there before.
verses.text: And they went deeper in the brook and the waters reached up to their necks, and they were all terrified on account of the water; and whilst they were going over the brook Abraham recognized that place, and he knew that there was no water there before.

verses.raw: And Abraham said to his son Isaac, I know this place in which there was no brook nor water, now therefore it is this Satan who does all this to us, to draw us aside this day from the commands of Elohim.
verses.text: And Abraham said to his son Isaac, I know this place in which there was no brook nor water, now therefore it is this Satan who does all this to us, to draw us aside this day from the commands of Elohim.

verses.raw: And Abraham rebuked him and said to him, Yahuah (the Lord) rebuke you, O Satan, begone from us for we go by the commands of Elohim.
verses.text: And Abraham rebuked him and said to him, Yahuah (the Lord) rebuke you, O Satan, begone from us for we go by the commands of Elohim.

verses.raw: And Satan was terrified at the voice of Abraham, and he went away from them, and the place again became dry land as it was at first.
verses.text: And Satan was terrified at the voice of Abraham, and he went away from them, and the place again became dry land as it was at first.

verses.raw: And Abraham went with Isaac toward the place that Elohim had told him.
verses.text: And Abraham went with Isaac toward the place that Elohim had told him.

verses.raw: And on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw the place at a distance which Elohim had told him of.
verses.text: And on the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw the place at a distance which Elohim had told him of.

verses.raw: And a pillar of fire appeared to him that reached from the earth to heaven, and a cloud of glory upon the mountain, and the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) was seen in the cloud.
verses.text: And a pillar of fire appeared to him that reached from the earth to heaven, and a cloud of glory upon the mountain, and the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) was seen in the cloud.

verses.raw: And Abraham said to Isaac, My son, dost you see in that mountain, which we perceive at a distance, that which I see upon it?
verses.text: And Abraham said to Isaac, My son, dost you see in that mountain, which we perceive at a distance, that which I see upon it?

verses.raw: And Isaac answered and said to his father, I see and lo a pillar of fire and a cloud, and the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) is seen upon the cloud.
verses.text: And Isaac answered and said to his father, I see and lo a pillar of fire and a cloud, and the glory of Yahuah (the Lord) is seen upon the cloud.

verses.raw: And Abraham knew that his son Isaac was accepted before Yahuah (the Lord) for a burnt offering.
verses.text: And Abraham knew that his son Isaac was accepted before Yahuah (the Lord) for a burnt offering.

verses.raw: And Abraham said to Eliezer and to Ishmael his son, Do you also see that which we see upon the mountain which is at a distance?
verses.text: And Abraham said to Eliezer and to Ishmael his son, Do you also see that which we see upon the mountain which is at a distance?

verses.raw: And they answered and said, We see nothing more than like the other mountains of the earth. And Abraham knew that they were not accepted before Yahuah (the Lord) to go with them, and Abraham said to them, Abide you here with the ass whilst I and Isaac my son will go to yonder mount and worship there before Yahuah (the Lord) and then return to you.
verses.text: And they answered and said, We see nothing more than like the other mountains of the earth. And Abraham knew that they were not accepted before Yahuah (the Lord) to go with them, and Abraham said to them, Abide you here with the ass whilst I and Isaac my son will go to yonder mount and worship there before Yahuah (the Lord) and then return to you.

verses.raw: And Eliezer and Ishmael remained in that place, as Abraham had commanded.
verses.text: And Eliezer and Ishmael remained in that place, as Abraham had commanded.

verses.raw: And Abraham took wood for a burnt offering and placed it upon his son Isaac, and he took the fire and the knife, and they both went to that place.
verses.text: And Abraham took wood for a burnt offering and placed it upon his son Isaac, and he took the fire and the knife, and they both went to that place.

verses.raw: And when they were going along Isaac said to his father, Behold, I see here the fire and wood, and where then is the lamb that is to be the burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord)?
verses.text: And when they were going along Isaac said to his father, Behold, I see here the fire and wood, and where then is the lamb that is to be the burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord)?

verses.raw: And Abraham answered his son Isaac, saying, Yahuah (the Lord) has made choice of you my son, to be a perfect burnt offering instead of the lamb.
verses.text: And Abraham answered his son Isaac, saying, Yahuah (the Lord) has made choice of you my son, to be a perfect burnt offering instead of the lamb.

verses.raw: And Isaac said to his father, I will do all that Yahuah (the Lord) spoke to you with joy and cheerfulness of heart.
verses.text: And Isaac said to his father, I will do all that Yahuah (the Lord) spoke to you with joy and cheerfulness of heart.

verses.raw: And Abraham again said to Isaac his son, Is there in your heart any thought or counsel concerning this, which is not proper? tell me my son, I pray you, O my son conceal it not from me.
verses.text: And Abraham again said to Isaac his son, Is there in your heart any thought or counsel concerning this, which is not proper? tell me my son, I pray you, O my son conceal it not from me.

verses.raw: And Isaac answered his father Abraham and said to him, O my father, as Yahuah (the Lord) lives and as your soul lives, there is nothing in my heart to cause me to deviate either to the right or to the left from the word that he has spoken to you.
verses.text: And Isaac answered his father Abraham and said to him, O my father, as Yahuah (the Lord) lives and as your soul lives, there is nothing in my heart to cause me to deviate either to the right or to the left from the word that he has spoken to you.

verses.raw: Neither limb nor muscle has moved or stirred at this, nor is there in my heart any thought or evil counsel concerning this.
verses.text: Neither limb nor muscle has moved or stirred at this, nor is there in my heart any thought or evil counsel concerning this.

verses.raw: But I am of joyful and cheerful heart in this matter, and I say, Blessed is Yahuah (the Lord) who has this day chosen me to be a burnt offering before Him.
verses.text: But I am of joyful and cheerful heart in this matter, and I say, Blessed is Yahuah (the Lord) who has this day chosen me to be a burnt offering before Him.

verses.raw: And Abraham greatly rejoiced at the words of Isaac, and they went on and came together to that place that Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken of.
verses.text: And Abraham greatly rejoiced at the words of Isaac, and they went on and came together to that place that Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken of.

verses.raw: And Abraham approached to build the altar in that place, and Abraham was weeping, and Isaac took stones and mortar until they had finished building the altar.
verses.text: And Abraham approached to build the altar in that place, and Abraham was weeping, and Isaac took stones and mortar until they had finished building the altar.

verses.raw: And Abraham took the wood and placed it in order upon the altar which he had built.
verses.text: And Abraham took the wood and placed it in order upon the altar which he had built.

verses.raw: And he took his son Isaac and bound him in order to place him upon the wood which was upon the altar, to slay him for a burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And he took his son Isaac and bound him in order to place him upon the wood which was upon the altar, to slay him for a burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Isaac said to his father, Bind me securely and then place me upon the altar lest I should turn and move, and break loose from the force of the knife upon my flesh and of it profane the burnt offering; and Abraham did so.
verses.text: And Isaac said to his father, Bind me securely and then place me upon the altar lest I should turn and move, and break loose from the force of the knife upon my flesh and of it profane the burnt offering; and Abraham did so.

verses.raw: And Isaac still said to his father, O my father, when you shall have slain me and burnt me for an offering, take with you that which shall remain of my ashes to bring to Sarah my mother, and say to her, This is the sweet smelling savor of Isaac; but do not tell her this if she should sit near a well or upon any high place, lest she should cast her soul after me and die.
verses.text: And Isaac still said to his father, O my father, when you shall have slain me and burnt me for an offering, take with you that which shall remain of my ashes to bring to Sarah my mother, and say to her, This is the sweet smelling savor of Isaac; but do not tell her this if she should sit near a well or upon any high place, lest she should cast her soul after me and die.

verses.raw: And Abraham heard the words of Isaac, and he lifted up his voice and wept when Isaac spoke these words; and Abraham’s tears gushed down upon Isaac his son, and Isaac wept bitterly, and he said to his father, Hasten you, O my father, and do with me the will of Yahuah our Elohim as He has commanded you.
verses.text: And Abraham heard the words of Isaac, and he lifted up his voice and wept when Isaac spoke these words; and Abraham’s tears gushed down upon Isaac his son, and Isaac wept bitterly, and he said to his father, Hasten you, O my father, and do with me the will of Yahuah our Elohim as He has commanded you.

verses.raw: And the hearts of Abraham and Isaac rejoiced at this thing which Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded them; but the eye wept bitterly whilst the heart rejoiced.
verses.text: And the hearts of Abraham and Isaac rejoiced at this thing which Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded them; but the eye wept bitterly whilst the heart rejoiced.

verses.raw: And Abraham bound his son Isaac, and placed him on the altar upon the wood, and Isaac stretched forth his neck upon the altar before his father, and Abraham stretched forth his hand to take the knife to slay his son as a burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Abraham bound his son Isaac, and placed him on the altar upon the wood, and Isaac stretched forth his neck upon the altar before his father, and Abraham stretched forth his hand to take the knife to slay his son as a burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: At that time the angels of mercy came before Yahuah (the Lord) and spoke to him concerning Isaac, saying,
verses.text: At that time the angels of mercy came before Yahuah (the Lord) and spoke to him concerning Isaac, saying,

verses.raw: 0 Yahuah (the Lord), you are a merciful and compassionate King over all that you have created in heaven and in earth, and you support them all; give therefore ransom and redemption instead of your servant Isaac, and pity and have compassion upon Abraham and Isaac his son, who are this day performing your commands.
verses.text: 0 Yahuah (the Lord), you are a merciful and compassionate King over all that you have created in heaven and in earth, and you support them all; give therefore ransom and redemption instead of your servant Isaac, and pity and have compassion upon Abraham and Isaac his son, who are this day performing your commands.

verses.raw: Have you seen, O Yahuah (O Lord), how Isaac the son of Abraham your servant is bound down to the slaughter like an animal? now therefore let your pity be roused for them, O Yahuah (O Lord).
verses.text: Have you seen, O Yahuah (O Lord), how Isaac the son of Abraham your servant is bound down to the slaughter like an animal? now therefore let your pity be roused for them, O Yahuah (O Lord).

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Abraham, and called to him, from heaven, and said to him, Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you any thing to him, for now I know that you fear Elohim in performing this act, and in not withholding your son, your only son, from me.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Abraham, and called to him, from heaven, and said to him, Lay not your hand upon the lad, neither do you any thing to him, for now I know that you fear Elohim in performing this act, and in not withholding your son, your only son, from me.

verses.raw: And Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw, and behold, a ram was caught in a thicket by his horns; that was the ram which Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) had created in the earth in the day that he made earth and heaven.
verses.text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw, and behold, a ram was caught in a thicket by his horns; that was the ram which Yahuah Elohim had created in the earth in the day that he made earth and heaven.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (the Lord) had prepared this ram from that day, to be a burnt offering instead of Isaac.
verses.text: For Yahuah (the Lord) had prepared this ram from that day, to be a burnt offering instead of Isaac.

verses.raw: And this ram was advancing to Abraham when Satan caught hold of him and entangled his horns in the thicket, that he might not advance to Abraham, in order that Abraham might slay his son.
verses.text: And this ram was advancing to Abraham when Satan caught hold of him and entangled his horns in the thicket, that he might not advance to Abraham, in order that Abraham might slay his son.

verses.raw: And Abraham, seeing the ram advancing to him and Satan withholding him, fetched him and brought him before the altar, and he loosened his son Isaac from his binding, and he put the ram in his stead, and Abraham killed the ram upon the altar, and brought it up as an offering in the place of his son Isaac.
verses.text: And Abraham, seeing the ram advancing to him and Satan withholding him, fetched him and brought him before the altar, and he loosened his son Isaac from his binding, and he put the ram in his stead, and Abraham killed the ram upon the altar, and brought it up as an offering in the place of his son Isaac.

verses.raw: And Abraham sprinkled some of the blood of the ram upon the altar, and he exclaimed and said, This is in the place of my son, and may this be considered this day as the blood of my son before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Abraham sprinkled some of the blood of the ram upon the altar, and he exclaimed and said, This is in the place of my son, and may this be considered this day as the blood of my son before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And all that Abraham did on this occasion by the altar, he would exclaim and say, This is in the room of my son, and may it this day be considered before Yahuah (the Lord) in the place of my son; and Abraham finished the whole of the service by the altar, and the service was accepted before Yahuah (the Lord), and was accounted as if it had been Isaac; and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed Abraham and his seed on that day.
verses.text: And all that Abraham did on this occasion by the altar, he would exclaim and say, This is in the room of my son, and may it this day be considered before Yahuah (the Lord) in the place of my son; and Abraham finished the whole of the service by the altar, and the service was accepted before Yahuah (the Lord), and was accounted as if it had been Isaac; and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed Abraham and his seed on that day.

verses.raw: And Satan went to Sarah, and he appeared to her in the figure of an old man very humble and meek, and Abraham was yet engaged in the burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And Satan went to Sarah, and he appeared to her in the figure of an old man very humble and meek, and Abraham was yet engaged in the burnt offering before Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And he said to her, Dost you not know all the work that Abraham has made with your only son this day? for he took Isaac and built an altar, and killed him, and brought him up as a sacrifice upon the altar, and Isaac cried and wept before his father, but he looked not at him, neither did he have compassion over him.
verses.text: And he said to her, Dost you not know all the work that Abraham has made with your only son this day? for he took Isaac and built an altar, and killed him, and brought him up as a sacrifice upon the altar, and Isaac cried and wept before his father, but he looked not at him, neither did he have compassion over him.

verses.raw: And Satan repeated these words, and he went away from her, and Sarah heard all the words of Satan, and she imagined him to be an old man from amongst the sons of men who had been with her son, and had come and told her these things.
verses.text: And Satan repeated these words, and he went away from her, and Sarah heard all the words of Satan, and she imagined him to be an old man from amongst the sons of men who had been with her son, and had come and told her these things.

verses.raw: And Sarah lifted up her voice and wept and cried out bitterly on account of her son; and she threw herself upon the ground and she cast dust upon her head, and she said, O my son, Isaac my son, O that I had this day died instead of you. And she continued to weep and said, It grieves me for you, O my son, my son Isaac, O that I had died this day in your stead.
verses.text: And Sarah lifted up her voice and wept and cried out bitterly on account of her son; and she threw herself upon the ground and she cast dust upon her head, and she said, O my son, Isaac my son, O that I had this day died instead of you. And she continued to weep and said, It grieves me for you, O my son, my son Isaac, O that I had died this day in your stead.

verses.raw: And she still continued to weep, and said, It grieves me for you after that I have reared you and have brought you up; now my joy is turned into mourning over you, I that had a longing for you, and cried and prayed to Elohim till I bare you at ninety years old; and now have you served this day for the knife and the fire, to be made an offering.
verses.text: And she still continued to weep, and said, It grieves me for you after that I have reared you and have brought you up; now my joy is turned into mourning over you, I that had a longing for you, and cried and prayed to Elohim till I bare you at ninety years old; and now have you served this day for the knife and the fire, to be made an offering.

verses.raw: But I console myself with you, my son, in its being the word of Yahuah (the Lord), for you did perform the command of your Elohim; for who can transgress the word of our Elohim, in whose hands is the soul of every living creature?
verses.text: But I console myself with you, my son, in its being the word of Yahuah (the Lord), for you did perform the command of your Elohim; for who can transgress the word of our Elohim, in whose hands is the soul of every living creature?

verses.raw: You are just, O Yahuah our Elohim, for all your works are good and righteous; for I also am rejoiced with your word which you did command, and whilst mine eye weeps bitterly my heart rejoices.
verses.text: You are just, O Yahuah our Elohim, for all your works are good and righteous; for I also am rejoiced with your word which you did command, and whilst mine eye weeps bitterly my heart rejoices.

verses.raw: And Sarah laid her head upon the bosom of one of her handmaids, and she became as still as a stone.
verses.text: And Sarah laid her head upon the bosom of one of her handmaids, and she became as still as a stone.

verses.raw: She afterward rose up and went about making inquiries till she came to Hebron, and she inquired of all those whom she met walking in the road, and no one could tell her what had happened to her son.
verses.text: She afterward rose up and went about making inquiries till she came to Hebron, and she inquired of all those whom she met walking in the road, and no one could tell her what had happened to her son.

verses.raw: And she came with her maid servants and men servants to Kireath-arba, which is Hebron, and she asked concerning her Son, and she remained there while she sent some of her servants to seek where Abraham had gone with Isaac; they went to seek him in the house of Shem and Eber, and they could not find him, and they sought throughout the land and he was not there.
verses.text: And she came with her maid servants and men servants to Kireath-arba, which is Hebron, and she asked concerning her Son, and she remained there while she sent some of her servants to seek where Abraham had gone with Isaac; they went to seek him in the house of Shem and Eber, and they could not find him, and they sought throughout the land and he was not there.

verses.raw: And behold, Satan came to Sarah in the shape of an old man, and he came and stood before her, and he said to her, I spoke falsely to you, for Abraham did not kill his son and he is not dead; and when she heard the word her joy was so exceedingly violent on account of her son, that her soul went out through joy; she died and was gathered to her people.
verses.text: And behold, Satan came to Sarah in the shape of an old man, and he came and stood before her, and he said to her, I spoke falsely to you, for Abraham did not kill his son and he is not dead; and when she heard the word her joy was so exceedingly violent on account of her son, that her soul went out through joy; she died and was gathered to her people.

verses.raw: And when Abraham had finished his service he returned with his son Isaac to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba, and they came home.
verses.text: And when Abraham had finished his service he returned with his son Isaac to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba, and they came home.

verses.raw: And Abraham sought for Sarah, and could not find her, and he made inquiries concerning her, and they said to him, She went as far as Hebron to seek you both where you had gone, for thus was she informed.
verses.text: And Abraham sought for Sarah, and could not find her, and he made inquiries concerning her, and they said to him, She went as far as Hebron to seek you both where you had gone, for thus was she informed.

verses.raw: And Abraham and Isaac went to her to Hebron, and when they found that she was dead they lifted up their voices and wept bitterly over her; and Isaac fell upon his mother’s face and wept over her, and he said, O my mother, my mother, how have you left me, and where have you gone? O how, how have you left me!
verses.text: And Abraham and Isaac went to her to Hebron, and when they found that she was dead they lifted up their voices and wept bitterly over her; and Isaac fell upon his mother’s face and wept over her, and he said, O my mother, my mother, how have you left me, and where have you gone? O how, how have you left me!

verses.raw: And Abraham and Isaac wept greatly and all their servants wept with them on account of Sarah, and they mourned over her a great and heavy mourning.
verses.text: And Abraham and Isaac wept greatly and all their servants wept with them on account of Sarah, and they mourned over her a great and heavy mourning.

verses.raw: And the life of Sarah was one hundred and twenty-seven years, and Sarah died; and Abraham rose up from before his dead to seek a burial place to bury his wife Sarah; and he went and spoke to the children of Heth, the inhabitants of the land, saying,
verses.text: And the life of Sarah was one hundred and twenty-seven years, and Sarah died; and Abraham rose up from before his dead to seek a burial place to bury his wife Sarah; and he went and spoke to the children of Heth, the inhabitants of the land, saying,

verses.raw: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you in your land; give me a possession of a burial place in your land, that I may bury my dead from before me.
verses.text: I am a stranger and a sojourner with you in your land; give me a possession of a burial place in your land, that I may bury my dead from before me.

verses.raw: And the children of Heth said to Abraham, behold the land is before you, in the choice of our sepulchers bury your dead, for no man shall withhold you from burying your dead.
verses.text: And the children of Heth said to Abraham, behold the land is before you, in the choice of our sepulchers bury your dead, for no man shall withhold you from burying your dead.

verses.raw: And Abraham said to them, If you are agreeable to this go and entreat for me to Ephron, the son of Zochar, requesting that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which is in the end of his field, and I will purchase it of him for whatever he desire for it.
verses.text: And Abraham said to them, If you are agreeable to this go and entreat for me to Ephron, the son of Zochar, requesting that he may give me the cave of Machpelah, which is in the end of his field, and I will purchase it of him for whatever he desire for it.

verses.raw: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth, and they went and called for him, and he came before Abraham, and Ephron said to Abraham, Behold all you require your servant will do; and Abraham said, No, but I will buy the cave and the field which you have for value, In order that it may be for a possession of a burial place for ever.
verses.text: And Ephron dwelt among the children of Heth, and they went and called for him, and he came before Abraham, and Ephron said to Abraham, Behold all you require your servant will do; and Abraham said, No, but I will buy the cave and the field which you have for value, In order that it may be for a possession of a burial place for ever.

verses.raw: And Ephron answered and said, Behold the field and the cave are before you, give whatever you desire; and Abraham said, Only at full value will I buy it from your hand, and from the hands of those that go in at the gate of your city, and from the hand of your seed for ever.
verses.text: And Ephron answered and said, Behold the field and the cave are before you, give whatever you desire; and Abraham said, Only at full value will I buy it from your hand, and from the hands of those that go in at the gate of your city, and from the hand of your seed for ever.

verses.raw: And Ephron and all his brethren heard this, and Abraham weighed to Ephron four hundred shekels of silver in the hands of Ephron and in the hands of all his brethren; and Abraham wrote this transaction, and he wrote it and testified it with four witnesses.
verses.text: And Ephron and all his brethren heard this, and Abraham weighed to Ephron four hundred shekels of silver in the hands of Ephron and in the hands of all his brethren; and Abraham wrote this transaction, and he wrote it and testified it with four witnesses.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the witnesses, Amigal son of Abishna the Hittite, Adichorom son of Ashunach the Hivite, Abdon son of Achiram the Gomerite, Bakdil the son of Abudish the Zidonite.
verses.text: And these are the names of the witnesses, Amigal son of Abishna the Hittite, Adichorom son of Ashunach the Hivite, Abdon son of Achiram the Gomerite, Bakdil the son of Abudish the Zidonite.

verses.raw: And Abraham took the book of the purchase, and placed it in his treasures, and these are the words that Abraham wrote in the book, namely:
verses.text: And Abraham took the book of the purchase, and placed it in his treasures, and these are the words that Abraham wrote in the book, namely:

verses.raw: That the cave and the field Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite, and from his seed, and from those that go out of his city, and from their seed for ever, are to be a purchase to Abraham and to his seed and to those that go forth from his loins, for a possession of a burial place for ever; and he put a signet to it and testified it with witnesses.
verses.text: That the cave and the field Abraham bought from Ephron the Hittite, and from his seed, and from those that go out of his city, and from their seed for ever, are to be a purchase to Abraham and to his seed and to those that go forth from his loins, for a possession of a burial place for ever; and he put a signet to it and testified it with witnesses.

verses.raw: And the field and the cave that was in it and all that place were made sure to Abraham and to his seed after him, from the children of Heth; behold it is before Mamre in Hebron, which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And the field and the cave that was in it and all that place were made sure to Abraham and to his seed after him, from the children of Heth; behold it is before Mamre in Hebron, which is in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And after this Abraham buried his wife Sarah there, and that place and all its boundary became to Abraham and to his seed for a possession of a burial place.
verses.text: And after this Abraham buried his wife Sarah there, and that place and all its boundary became to Abraham and to his seed for a possession of a burial place.

verses.raw: And Abraham buried Sarah with pomp as observed at the interment of kings, and she was buried in very fine and beautiful garments.
verses.text: And Abraham buried Sarah with pomp as observed at the interment of kings, and she was buried in very fine and beautiful garments.

verses.raw: And at her bier was Shem, his sons Eber and Abimelech, together with Anar, Ashcol and Mamre, and all the grandees of the land followed her bier.
verses.text: And at her bier was Shem, his sons Eber and Abimelech, together with Anar, Ashcol and Mamre, and all the grandees of the land followed her bier.

verses.raw: And the days of Sarah were one hundred and twenty-seven years and she died, and Abraham made a great and heavy mourning, and he performed the rites of mourning for seven days.
verses.text: And the days of Sarah were one hundred and twenty-seven years and she died, and Abraham made a great and heavy mourning, and he performed the rites of mourning for seven days.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of the land comforted Abraham and Isaac his son on account of Sarah.
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of the land comforted Abraham and Isaac his son on account of Sarah.

verses.raw: And when the days of their mourning passed by Abraham sent away his son Isaac, and he went to the house of Shem and Eber, to learn the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) and his instructions, and Abraham remained there three years.
verses.text: And when the days of their mourning passed by Abraham sent away his son Isaac, and he went to the house of Shem and Eber, to learn the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) and his instructions, and Abraham remained there three years.

verses.raw: At that time Abraham rose up with all his servants, and they went and returned homeward to Beersheba, and Abraham and all his servants remained in Beersheba.
verses.text: At that time Abraham rose up with all his servants, and they went and returned homeward to Beersheba, and Abraham and all his servants remained in Beersheba.

verses.raw: And at the revolution of the year Abimelech king of the Philistines died in that year; he was one hundred and ninety-three years old at his death; and Abraham went with his people to the land of the Philistines, and they comforted the whole household and all his servants, and he then turned and went home.
verses.text: And at the revolution of the year Abimelech king of the Philistines died in that year; he was one hundred and ninety-three years old at his death; and Abraham went with his people to the land of the Philistines, and they comforted the whole household and all his servants, and he then turned and went home.

verses.raw: And it was after the death of Abimelech that the people of Gerar took Benmalich his son, and he was only twelve years old, and they made him lying in the place of his father.
verses.text: And it was after the death of Abimelech that the people of Gerar took Benmalich his son, and he was only twelve years old, and they made him lying in the place of his father.

verses.raw: And they called his name Abimelech after the name of his father, for thus was it their custom to do in Gerar, and Abimelech reigned instead of Abimelech his father, and he sat upon his throne.
verses.text: And they called his name Abimelech after the name of his father, for thus was it their custom to do in Gerar, and Abimelech reigned instead of Abimelech his father, and he sat upon his throne.

verses.raw: And Lot the son of Haran also died in those days, in the thirty-ninth year of the life of Isaac, and all the days that Lot lived were one hundred and forty years and he died.
verses.text: And Lot the son of Haran also died in those days, in the thirty-ninth year of the life of Isaac, and all the days that Lot lived were one hundred and forty years and he died.

verses.raw: And these are the children of Lot, that were born to him by his daughters, the name of the first born was Moab, and the name of the second was Benami.
verses.text: And these are the children of Lot, that were born to him by his daughters, the name of the first born was Moab, and the name of the second was Benami.

verses.raw: And the two sons of Lot went and took themselves wives from the land of Canaan, and they bare children to them, and the children of Moab were Ed, Mayon, Tarsus, and Kanvil, four sons, these are fathers to the children of Moab to this day.
verses.text: And the two sons of Lot went and took themselves wives from the land of Canaan, and they bare children to them, and the children of Moab were Ed, Mayon, Tarsus, and Kanvil, four sons, these are fathers to the children of Moab to this day.

verses.raw: And all the families of the children of Lot went to dwell wherever they should light upon, for they were fruitful and increased abundantly.
verses.text: And all the families of the children of Lot went to dwell wherever they should light upon, for they were fruitful and increased abundantly.

verses.raw: And they went and built themselves cities in the land where they dwelt, and they called the names of the cities which they built after their own names.
verses.text: And they went and built themselves cities in the land where they dwelt, and they called the names of the cities which they built after their own names.

verses.raw: And Nahor the son of Terah, brother to Abraham, died in those days in the fortieth year of the life of Isaac, and all the days of Nahor were one hundred and seventy-two years and he died and was buried in Haran.
verses.text: And Nahor the son of Terah, brother to Abraham, died in those days in the fortieth year of the life of Isaac, and all the days of Nahor were one hundred and seventy-two years and he died and was buried in Haran.

verses.raw: And when Abraham heard that his brother was dead he grieved sadly, and he mourned over his brother many days.
verses.text: And when Abraham heard that his brother was dead he grieved sadly, and he mourned over his brother many days.

verses.raw: And Abraham called for Eliezer his head servant, to give him orders concerning his house, and he came and stood before him.
verses.text: And Abraham called for Eliezer his head servant, to give him orders concerning his house, and he came and stood before him.

verses.raw: And Abraham said to him, Behold I am old, I do not know the day of my death; for I am advanced in days; now therefore rise up, go forth and do not take a wife for my son from this place and from this land, from the daughters of the Canaanites amongst whom we dwell.
verses.text: And Abraham said to him, Behold I am old, I do not know the day of my death; for I am advanced in days; now therefore rise up, go forth and do not take a wife for my son from this place and from this land, from the daughters of the Canaanites amongst whom we dwell.

verses.raw: But go to my land and to my birthplace, and take from there a wife for my son, and Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) of Heaven and earth who took me from my father’s house and brought me to this place, and said to me, To your seed will I give this land for an inheritance for ever, he will send his angel before you and prosper your way, that you may obtain a wife for my son from my family and from my father’s house.
verses.text: But go to my land and to my birthplace, and take from there a wife for my son, and Yahuah Elohim of Heaven and earth who took me from my father’s house and brought me to this place, and said to me, To your seed will I give this land for an inheritance for ever, he will send his angel before you and prosper your way, that you may obtain a wife for my son from my family and from my father’s house.

verses.raw: And the servant answered his master Abraham and said, Behold I go to your birthplace and to your father’s house, and take a wife for your son from there; but if the woman be not willing to follow me to this land, shall I take your son back to the land of your birthplace?
verses.text: And the servant answered his master Abraham and said, Behold I go to your birthplace and to your father’s house, and take a wife for your son from there; but if the woman be not willing to follow me to this land, shall I take your son back to the land of your birthplace?

verses.raw: And Abraham said to him, Take heed that you bring not my son here again, for Yahuah (the Lord) before whom I have walked he will send his angel before you and prosper your way.
verses.text: And Abraham said to him, Take heed that you bring not my son here again, for Yahuah (the Lord) before whom I have walked he will send his angel before you and prosper your way.

verses.raw: And Eliezer did as Abraham ordered him, and Eliezer swore to Abraham his master upon this matter; and Eliezer rose up and took ten camels of the camels of his master, and ten men from his master’s servants with him, and they rose up and went to Haran, the city of Abraham and Nahor, in order to fetch a wife for Isaac the son of Abraham; and whilst they were gone Abraham sent to the house of Shem and Eber, and they brought from there his son Isaac.
verses.text: And Eliezer did as Abraham ordered him, and Eliezer swore to Abraham his master upon this matter; and Eliezer rose up and took ten camels of the camels of his master, and ten men from his master’s servants with him, and they rose up and went to Haran, the city of Abraham and Nahor, in order to fetch a wife for Isaac the son of Abraham; and whilst they were gone Abraham sent to the house of Shem and Eber, and they brought from there his son Isaac.

verses.raw: And Isaac came home to his father’s house to Beersheba, whilst Eliezer and his men came to Haran; and they stopped in the city by the watering place, and he made his camels to kneel down by the water and they remained there.
verses.text: And Isaac came home to his father’s house to Beersheba, whilst Eliezer and his men came to Haran; and they stopped in the city by the watering place, and he made his camels to kneel down by the water and they remained there.

verses.raw: And Eliezer, Abraham’s servant, prayed and said, O Elohim (God) of Abraham my master; send me I pray you good speed this day and show kindness to my master, that you shall appoint this day a wife for my master’s son from his family.
verses.text: And Eliezer, Abraham’s servant, prayed and said, O Elohim of Abraham my master; send me I pray you good speed this day and show kindness to my master, that you shall appoint this day a wife for my master’s son from his family.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Eliezer, for the sake of his servant Abraham, and he happened to meet with the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, brother to Abraham, and Eliezer came to her house.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Eliezer, for the sake of his servant Abraham, and he happened to meet with the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, brother to Abraham, and Eliezer came to her house.

verses.raw: And Eliezer related to them all his concerns, and that he was Abraham’s servant, and they greatly rejoiced at him.
verses.text: And Eliezer related to them all his concerns, and that he was Abraham’s servant, and they greatly rejoiced at him.

verses.raw: And they all blessed Yahuah (the Lord) who brought this thing about, and they gave him Rebecca, the daughter of Bethuel, for a wife for Isaac.
verses.text: And they all blessed Yahuah (the Lord) who brought this thing about, and they gave him Rebecca, the daughter of Bethuel, for a wife for Isaac.

verses.raw: And the young woman was of very comely appearance, she was a virgin, and Rebecca was ten years old in those days.
verses.text: And the young woman was of very comely appearance, she was a virgin, and Rebecca was ten years old in those days.

verses.raw: And Bethuel and Laban and his children made a feast on that night, and Eliezer and his men came and ate and drank and rejoiced there on that night.
verses.text: And Bethuel and Laban and his children made a feast on that night, and Eliezer and his men came and ate and drank and rejoiced there on that night.

verses.raw: And Eliezer rose up in the morning, he and the men that were with him, and he called to the whole household of Bethuel, saying, Send me away that I may go to my master; and they rose up and sent away Rebecca and her nurse Deborah, the daughter of Uz, and they gave her silver and gold, men servants and maid servants, and they blessed her.
verses.text: And Eliezer rose up in the morning, he and the men that were with him, and he called to the whole household of Bethuel, saying, Send me away that I may go to my master; and they rose up and sent away Rebecca and her nurse Deborah, the daughter of Uz, and they gave her silver and gold, men servants and maid servants, and they blessed her.

verses.raw: And they sent Eliezer away with his men; and the servants took Rebecca, and he went and returned to his master to the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And they sent Eliezer away with his men; and the servants took Rebecca, and he went and returned to his master to the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Isaac took Rebecca and she became his wife, and he brought her into the tent.
verses.text: And Isaac took Rebecca and she became his wife, and he brought her into the tent.

verses.raw: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebecca, the daughter of his uncle Bethuel, for a wife.
verses.text: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebecca, the daughter of his uncle Bethuel, for a wife.

verses.raw: And it was at that time that Abraham again took a wife in his old age, and her name was Keturah, from the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And it was at that time that Abraham again took a wife in his old age, and her name was Keturah, from the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And she bare to him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuach, being six sons. And the children of Zimran were Abihen, Molich and Narim.
verses.text: And she bare to him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak and Shuach, being six sons. And the children of Zimran were Abihen, Molich and Narim.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan, and the sons of Medan were Amida, Joab, Gochi, Elisha and Nothach; and the sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Chanoch, Abida and Eldaah.
verses.text: And the sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan, and the sons of Medan were Amida, Joab, Gochi, Elisha and Nothach; and the sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Chanoch, Abida and Eldaah.

verses.raw: And the sons of Ishbak were Makiro, Beyodua and Tator.
verses.text: And the sons of Ishbak were Makiro, Beyodua and Tator.

verses.raw: And the sons of Shuach were Bildad, Mamdad, Munan and Meban; all these are the families of the children of Keturah the Canaanitish woman which she bare to Abraham the Hebrew.
verses.text: And the sons of Shuach were Bildad, Mamdad, Munan and Meban; all these are the families of the children of Keturah the Canaanitish woman which she bare to Abraham the Hebrew.

verses.raw: And Abraham sent all these away, and he gave them gifts, and they went away from his son Isaac to dwell wherever they should find a place.
verses.text: And Abraham sent all these away, and he gave them gifts, and they went away from his son Isaac to dwell wherever they should find a place.

verses.raw: And all these went to the mountain at the east, and they built themselves six cities in which they dwelt to this day.
verses.text: And all these went to the mountain at the east, and they built themselves six cities in which they dwelt to this day.

verses.raw: But the children of Sheba and Dedan, children of Jokshan, with their children, did not dwell with their brethren in their cities, and they journeyed and encamped in the countries and wildernesses to this day.
verses.text: But the children of Sheba and Dedan, children of Jokshan, with their children, did not dwell with their brethren in their cities, and they journeyed and encamped in the countries and wildernesses to this day.

verses.raw: And the children of Midian, son of Abraham, went to the east of the land of Cush, and they there found a large valley in the eastern country, and they remained there and built a city, and they dwelt in it, that is the land of Midian to this day.
verses.text: And the children of Midian, son of Abraham, went to the east of the land of Cush, and they there found a large valley in the eastern country, and they remained there and built a city, and they dwelt in it, that is the land of Midian to this day.

verses.raw: And Midian dwelt in the city which he built, he and his five sons and all belonging to him.
verses.text: And Midian dwelt in the city which he built, he and his five sons and all belonging to him.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the sons of Midian according to their names in their cities, Ephah, Epher, Chanoch, Abida and Eldaah.
verses.text: And these are the names of the sons of Midian according to their names in their cities, Ephah, Epher, Chanoch, Abida and Eldaah.

verses.raw: And the sons of Ephah were Methach, Meshar, Avi and Tzanua, and the sons of Epher were Ephron, Zur, Alirun and Medin, and the sons of Chanoch were Reuel, Rekem, Azi, Alyoshub and Alad.
verses.text: And the sons of Ephah were Methach, Meshar, Avi and Tzanua, and the sons of Epher were Ephron, Zur, Alirun and Medin, and the sons of Chanoch were Reuel, Rekem, Azi, Alyoshub and Alad.

verses.raw: And the sons of Abida were Chur, Melud, Kerury, Molchi; and the sons of Eldaah were Miker, and Reba, and Malchiyah and Gabol; these are the names of the Midianites according to their families; and afterward the families of Midian spread throughout the land of Midian.
verses.text: And the sons of Abida were Chur, Melud, Kerury, Molchi; and the sons of Eldaah were Miker, and Reba, and Malchiyah and Gabol; these are the names of the Midianites according to their families; and afterward the families of Midian spread throughout the land of Midian.

verses.raw: And these are the generations of Ishmael the son Abraham, whom Hagar, Sarah’s handmaid, bare to Abraham.
verses.text: And these are the generations of Ishmael the son Abraham, whom Hagar, Sarah’s handmaid, bare to Abraham.

verses.raw: And Ishmael took a wife from the land of Egypt, and her name was Ribah, the same is Meribah.
verses.text: And Ishmael took a wife from the land of Egypt, and her name was Ribah, the same is Meribah.

verses.raw: And Ribah bare to Ishmael Nebayoth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam and their sister Bosmath.
verses.text: And Ribah bare to Ishmael Nebayoth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam and their sister Bosmath.

verses.raw: And Ishmael cast away his wife Ribah, and she went from him and returned to Egypt to the house of her father, and she dwelt there, for she had been very bad in the sight of Ishmael, and in the sight of his father Abraham.
verses.text: And Ishmael cast away his wife Ribah, and she went from him and returned to Egypt to the house of her father, and she dwelt there, for she had been very bad in the sight of Ishmael, and in the sight of his father Abraham.

verses.raw: And Ishmael afterward took a wife from the land of Canaan, and her name was Malchuth, and she bare to him Nishma, Dumah, Masa, Chadad, Tema, Yetur, Naphish and Kedma.
verses.text: And Ishmael afterward took a wife from the land of Canaan, and her name was Malchuth, and she bare to him Nishma, Dumah, Masa, Chadad, Tema, Yetur, Naphish and Kedma.

verses.raw: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, being twelve princes according to their nations; and the families of Ishmael afterward spread forth, and Ishmael took his children and all the property that he had gained, together with the souls of his household and all belonging to him, and they went to dwell where they should find a place.
verses.text: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, being twelve princes according to their nations; and the families of Ishmael afterward spread forth, and Ishmael took his children and all the property that he had gained, together with the souls of his household and all belonging to him, and they went to dwell where they should find a place.

verses.raw: And they went and dwelt near the wilderness of Paran, and their dwelling was from Havilah to Shur, that is before Egypt as you come toward Assyria.
verses.text: And they went and dwelt near the wilderness of Paran, and their dwelling was from Havilah to Shur, that is before Egypt as you come toward Assyria.

verses.raw: And Ishmael and his sons dwelt in the land, and they had children born to them, and they were fruitful and increased abundantly.
verses.text: And Ishmael and his sons dwelt in the land, and they had children born to them, and they were fruitful and increased abundantly.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the sons of Nebayoth the first born of Ishmael; Mend, Send, Mayon; and the sons of Kedar were Alyon, Kezem, Chamad and Eli.
verses.text: And these are the names of the sons of Nebayoth the first born of Ishmael; Mend, Send, Mayon; and the sons of Kedar were Alyon, Kezem, Chamad and Eli.

verses.raw: And the sons of Adbeel were Chamad and Jabin; and the sons of Mibsam were Obadiah, Ebedmelech and Yeush; these are the families of the children of Ribah the wife of Ishmael.
verses.text: And the sons of Adbeel were Chamad and Jabin; and the sons of Mibsam were Obadiah, Ebedmelech and Yeush; these are the families of the children of Ribah the wife of Ishmael.

verses.raw: And the sons of Mishma the son of Ishmael were Shamua, Zecaryon and Obed; and the sons of Dumah were Kezed, Eli, Machmad and Amed.
verses.text: And the sons of Mishma the son of Ishmael were Shamua, Zecaryon and Obed; and the sons of Dumah were Kezed, Eli, Machmad and Amed.

verses.raw: And the sons of Masa were Melon, Mula and Ebidadon; and the sons of Chadad were Azur, Minzar and Ebedmelech; and the sons of Tema were Seir, Sadon and Yakol.
verses.text: And the sons of Masa were Melon, Mula and Ebidadon; and the sons of Chadad were Azur, Minzar and Ebedmelech; and the sons of Tema were Seir, Sadon and Yakol.

verses.raw: And the sons of Yetur were Merith, Yaish, Alyo, and Pachoth; and the sons of Naphish were Ebed-Tamed, Abiyasaph and Mir; and the sons of Kedma were Calip, Tachti, and Omir; these were the children of Malchuth the wife of Ishmael according to their families.
verses.text: And the sons of Yetur were Merith, Yaish, Alyo, and Pachoth; and the sons of Naphish were Ebed-Tamed, Abiyasaph and Mir; and the sons of Kedma were Calip, Tachti, and Omir; these were the children of Malchuth the wife of Ishmael according to their families.

verses.raw: All these are the families of Ishmael according to their generations, and they dwelt in those lands wherein they had built themselves cities to this day.
verses.text: All these are the families of Ishmael according to their generations, and they dwelt in those lands wherein they had built themselves cities to this day.

verses.raw: And Rebecca the daughter of Bethuel, the wife of Abraham’s son Isaac, was barren in those days, she had no offspring; and Isaac dwelt with his father in the land of Canaan; and Yahuah (the Lord) was with Isaac; and Arpachshad the son of Shem the son of Noah died in those days, in the forty-eighth year of the life of Isaac, and all the days that Arpachshad lived were four hundred and thirty-eight years, and he died.
verses.text: And Rebecca the daughter of Bethuel, the wife of Abraham’s son Isaac, was barren in those days, she had no offspring; and Isaac dwelt with his father in the land of Canaan; and Yahuah (the Lord) was with Isaac; and Arpachshad the son of Shem the son of Noah died in those days, in the forty-eighth year of the life of Isaac, and all the days that Arpachshad lived were four hundred and thirty-eight years, and he died.

verses.raw: And in the fifty-ninth year of the life of Isaac the son of Abraham, Rebecca his wife was still barren in those days.
verses.text: And in the fifty-ninth year of the life of Isaac the son of Abraham, Rebecca his wife was still barren in those days.

verses.raw: And Rebecca said to Isaac, Truly I have heard, my Lord, that your mother Sarah was barren in her days until my Lord Abraham, your father, prayed for her and she conceived by him.
verses.text: And Rebecca said to Isaac, Truly I have heard, my Lord, that your mother Sarah was barren in her days until my Lord Abraham, your father, prayed for her and she conceived by him.

verses.raw: Now therefore stand up, pray you also to Elohim (God) and he will hear your prayer and remember us through his mercies.
verses.text: Now therefore stand up, pray you also to Elohim and he will hear your prayer and remember us through his mercies.

verses.raw: And Isaac answered his wife Rebecca, saying, Abraham has already prayed for me to Elohim to multiply his seed, now therefore this barrenness must proceed to us from you.
verses.text: And Isaac answered his wife Rebecca, saying, Abraham has already prayed for me to Elohim to multiply his seed, now therefore this barrenness must proceed to us from you.

verses.raw: And Rebecca said to him, But arise now you also and pray, that Yahuah (the Lord) may hear your prayer and grant me children, and Isaac hearkened to the words of his wife, and Isaac and his wife rose up and went to the land of Moriah to pray there and to seek Yahuah (the Lord), and when they had reached that place Isaac stood up and prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) on account of his wife because she was barren.
verses.text: And Rebecca said to him, But arise now you also and pray, that Yahuah (the Lord) may hear your prayer and grant me children, and Isaac hearkened to the words of his wife, and Isaac and his wife rose up and went to the land of Moriah to pray there and to seek Yahuah (the Lord), and when they had reached that place Isaac stood up and prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) on account of his wife because she was barren.

verses.raw: And Isaac said, O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) of heaven and earth, whose goodness and mercies fill the earth, you who did take my father from his father’s house and from his birthplace, and did bring him to this land, and did say to him, To your seed will I give the land, and you did promise him and did declare to him, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven and as the sand of the sea, now may your words be verified which you did speak to my father.
verses.text: And Isaac said, O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) of heaven and earth, whose goodness and mercies fill the earth, you who did take my father from his father’s house and from his birthplace, and did bring him to this land, and did say to him, To your seed will I give the land, and you did promise him and did declare to him, I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven and as the sand of the sea, now may your words be verified which you did speak to my father.

verses.raw: For you are Yahuah our Elohim (the Lord our God), our eyes are toward you to give us seed of men, as you did promise us, for you are Yahuah our Elohim and our eyes are directed toward you only.
verses.text: For you are Yahuah our Elohim, our eyes are toward you to give us seed of men, as you did promise us, for you are Yahuah our Elohim and our eyes are directed toward you only.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) heard the prayer of Isaac the son of Abraham, and Yahuah (the Lord) was entreated of him and Rebecca his wife conceived.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) heard the prayer of Isaac the son of Abraham, and Yahuah (the Lord) was entreated of him and Rebecca his wife conceived.

verses.raw: And in about seven months after the children struggled together within her, and it pained her greatly that she was wearied on account of them, and she said to all the women who were then in the land, Did such a thing happen to you as it has to me? and they said to her, No.
verses.text: And in about seven months after the children struggled together within her, and it pained her greatly that she was wearied on account of them, and she said to all the women who were then in the land, Did such a thing happen to you as it has to me? and they said to her, No.

verses.raw: And she said to them, Why am I alone in this amongst all the women that were upon earth? and she went to the land of Moriah to seek Yahuah (the Lord) on account of this; and she went to Shem and Eber his son to make inquiries of them in this matter, and that they should seek Yahuah (the Lord) in this thing respecting her.
verses.text: And she said to them, Why am I alone in this amongst all the women that were upon earth? and she went to the land of Moriah to seek Yahuah (the Lord) on account of this; and she went to Shem and Eber his son to make inquiries of them in this matter, and that they should seek Yahuah (the Lord) in this thing respecting her.

verses.raw: And she also asked Abraham to seek and inquire of Yahuah (the Lord) about all that had befallen her.
verses.text: And she also asked Abraham to seek and inquire of Yahuah (the Lord) about all that had befallen her.

verses.raw: And they all inquired of Yahuah (the Lord) concerning this matter, and they brought her word from Yahuah (the Lord) and told her, Two children are in your womb, and two nations shall rise from them; and one nation shall be stronger than the other, and the greater shall serve the younger.
verses.text: And they all inquired of Yahuah (the Lord) concerning this matter, and they brought her word from Yahuah (the Lord) and told her, Two children are in your womb, and two nations shall rise from them; and one nation shall be stronger than the other, and the greater shall serve the younger.

verses.raw: And when her days to be delivered were completed, she knelt down, and behold there were twins in her womb, as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to her.
