verses.text: And when her days to be delivered were completed, she knelt down, and behold there were twins in her womb, as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to her.

verses.raw: And the first came out red all over like a hairy garment, and all the people of the land called his name Esau, saying, That this one was made complete from the womb.
verses.text: And the first came out red all over like a hairy garment, and all the people of the land called his name Esau, saying, That this one was made complete from the womb.

verses.raw: And after that came his brother, and his hand took hold of Esau’s heel, therefore they called his name Jacob.
verses.text: And after that came his brother, and his hand took hold of Esau’s heel, therefore they called his name Jacob.

verses.raw: And Isaac, the son of Abraham, was sixty years old when he begat them.
verses.text: And Isaac, the son of Abraham, was sixty years old when he begat them.

verses.raw: And the boys grew up to their fifteenth year, and they came amongst the society of men. Esau was a designing and deceitful man, and an expert hunter in the field, and Jacob was a man perfect and wise, dwelling in tents, feeding flocks and learning the instructions of Yahuah (the Lord) and the commands of his father and mother.
verses.text: And the boys grew up to their fifteenth year, and they came amongst the society of men. Esau was a designing and deceitful man, and an expert hunter in the field, and Jacob was a man perfect and wise, dwelling in tents, feeding flocks and learning the instructions of Yahuah (the Lord) and the commands of his father and mother.

verses.raw: And Isaac and the children of his household dwelt with his father Abraham in the land of Canaan, as Elohim had commanded them.
verses.text: And Isaac and the children of his household dwelt with his father Abraham in the land of Canaan, as Elohim had commanded them.

verses.raw: And Ishmael the son of Abraham went with his children and all belonging to them, and they returned there to the land of Havilah, and they dwelt there.
verses.text: And Ishmael the son of Abraham went with his children and all belonging to them, and they returned there to the land of Havilah, and they dwelt there.

verses.raw: And all the children of Abraham’s concubines went to dwell in the land of the east, for Abraham had sent them away from his son, and had given them presents, and they went away.
verses.text: And all the children of Abraham’s concubines went to dwell in the land of the east, for Abraham had sent them away from his son, and had given them presents, and they went away.

verses.raw: And Abraham gave all that he had to his son Isaac, and he also gave him all his treasures.
verses.text: And Abraham gave all that he had to his son Isaac, and he also gave him all his treasures.

verses.raw: And he commanded him saying, Dost you not know and understand Yahuah (the Lord) is Elohim in heaven and in earth, and there is no other beside him?
verses.text: And he commanded him saying, Dost you not know and understand Yahuah (the Lord) is Elohim in heaven and in earth, and there is no other beside him?

verses.raw: And it was he who took me from my father’s house, and from my birth place, and gave me all the delights upon earth; who delivered me from the counsel of the wicked, for in him did I trust.
verses.text: And it was he who took me from my father’s house, and from my birth place, and gave me all the delights upon earth; who delivered me from the counsel of the wicked, for in him did I trust.

verses.raw: And he brought me to this place, and he delivered me from Ur Casdim; and he said to me, To your seed will I give all these lands, and they shall inherit them when they keep my commandments, my statutes and my judgments that I have commanded you, and which I shall command them.
verses.text: And he brought me to this place, and he delivered me from Ur Casdim; and he said to me, To your seed will I give all these lands, and they shall inherit them when they keep my commandments, my statutes and my judgments that I have commanded you, and which I shall command them.

verses.raw: Now therefore my son, hearken to my voice, and keep the commandments of Yahuah your Elohim, which I commanded you, do not turn from the right way either to the right or to the left, in order that it may be well with you and your children after you forever.
verses.text: Now therefore my son, hearken to my voice, and keep the commandments of Yahuah your Elohim, which I commanded you, do not turn from the right way either to the right or to the left, in order that it may be well with you and your children after you forever.

verses.raw: And remember the wonderful works of Yahuah (the Lord), and his kindness that he has shown toward us, in having delivered us from the hands of our enemies, and Yahuah our Elohim caused them to fall into our hands; and now therefore keep all that I have commanded you, and turn not away from the commandments of your Elohim, and serve none beside him, in order that it may be well with you and your seed after you.
verses.text: And remember the wonderful works of Yahuah (the Lord), and his kindness that he has shown toward us, in having delivered us from the hands of our enemies, and Yahuah our Elohim caused them to fall into our hands; and now therefore keep all that I have commanded you, and turn not away from the commandments of your Elohim, and serve none beside him, in order that it may be well with you and your seed after you.

verses.raw: And teach you your children and your seed the instructions of Yahuah (the Lord) and his commandments, and teach them the upright way in which they should go, in order that it may be well with them forever.
verses.text: And teach you your children and your seed the instructions of Yahuah (the Lord) and his commandments, and teach them the upright way in which they should go, in order that it may be well with them forever.

verses.raw: And Isaac answered his father and said to him, That which my Lord has commanded that will I do, and I will not depart from the commands of Yahuah my Elohim (the Lord my God), I will keep all that he commanded me; and Abraham blessed his son Isaac, and also his children; and Abraham taught Jacob the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord) and his ways.
verses.text: And Isaac answered his father and said to him, That which my Lord has commanded that will I do, and I will not depart from the commands of Yahuah my Elohim, I will keep all that he commanded me; and Abraham blessed his son Isaac, and also his children; and Abraham taught Jacob the instruction of Yahuah (the Lord) and his ways.

verses.raw: And it was at that time that Abraham died, in the fifteenth year of the life of Jacob and Esau, the sons of Isaac, and all the days of Abraham were one hundred and seventy-five years, and he died and was gathered to his people in good old age, old and satisfied with days, and Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him.
verses.text: And it was at that time that Abraham died, in the fifteenth year of the life of Jacob and Esau, the sons of Isaac, and all the days of Abraham were one hundred and seventy-five years, and he died and was gathered to his people in good old age, old and satisfied with days, and Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him.

verses.raw: And when the inhabitants of Canaan heard that Abraham was dead, they all came with their kings and princes and all their men to bury Abraham.
verses.text: And when the inhabitants of Canaan heard that Abraham was dead, they all came with their kings and princes and all their men to bury Abraham.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of the land of Haran, and all the families of the house of Abraham, and all the princes and grandees, and the sons of Abraham by the concubines, all came when they heard of Abraham’s death, and they requited Abraham’s kindness, and comforted Isaac his son, and they buried Abraham in the cave which he bought from Ephron the Hittite and his children, for the possession of a burial place.
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of the land of Haran, and all the families of the house of Abraham, and all the princes and grandees, and the sons of Abraham by the concubines, all came when they heard of Abraham’s death, and they requited Abraham’s kindness, and comforted Isaac his son, and they buried Abraham in the cave which he bought from Ephron the Hittite and his children, for the possession of a burial place.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of Canaan, and all those who had known Abraham, wept for Abraham a whole year, and men and women mourned over him.
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of Canaan, and all those who had known Abraham, wept for Abraham a whole year, and men and women mourned over him.

verses.raw: And all the little children, and all the inhabitants of the land wept on account of Abraham, for Abraham had been good to them all, and because he had been upright with Elohim and men.
verses.text: And all the little children, and all the inhabitants of the land wept on account of Abraham, for Abraham had been good to them all, and because he had been upright with Elohim and men.

verses.raw: And there arose not a man who feared Elohim like to Abraham, for he had feared his Elohim from his youth, and had served Yahuah (the Lord), and had gone in all his ways during his life, from his childhood to the day of his death.
verses.text: And there arose not a man who feared Elohim like to Abraham, for he had feared his Elohim from his youth, and had served Yahuah (the Lord), and had gone in all his ways during his life, from his childhood to the day of his death.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with him and delivered him from the counsel of Nimrod and his people, and when he made war with the four kings of Elam he conquered them.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with him and delivered him from the counsel of Nimrod and his people, and when he made war with the four kings of Elam he conquered them.

verses.raw: And he brought all the children of the earth to the service of Elohim, and he taught them the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and caused them to know Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And he brought all the children of the earth to the service of Elohim, and he taught them the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), and caused them to know Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And he formed a grove and he planted a vineyard in it, and he had always prepared in his tent meat and drink to those that passed through the land, that they might satisfy themselves in his house.
verses.text: And he formed a grove and he planted a vineyard in it, and he had always prepared in his tent meat and drink to those that passed through the land, that they might satisfy themselves in his house.

verses.raw: And Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) delivered the whole earth on account of Abraham.
verses.text: And Yahuah Elohim delivered the whole earth on account of Abraham.

verses.raw: And it was after the death of Abraham that Elohim blessed his son Isaac and his children, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with Isaac as he had been with his father Abraham, for Isaac kept all the commandments of Yahuah (the Lord) as Abraham his father had commanded him; he did not turn to the right or to the left from the right path which his father had commanded him.
verses.text: And it was after the death of Abraham that Elohim blessed his son Isaac and his children, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with Isaac as he had been with his father Abraham, for Isaac kept all the commandments of Yahuah (the Lord) as Abraham his father had commanded him; he did not turn to the right or to the left from the right path which his father had commanded him.

verses.raw: And Esau at that time, after the death of Abraham, frequently went in the field to hunt.
verses.text: And Esau at that time, after the death of Abraham, frequently went in the field to hunt.

verses.raw: And Nimrod king of Babel, the same was Amraphel, also frequently went with his mighty men to hunt in the field, and to walk about with his men in the cool of the day.
verses.text: And Nimrod king of Babel, the same was Amraphel, also frequently went with his mighty men to hunt in the field, and to walk about with his men in the cool of the day.

verses.raw: And Nimrod was observing Esau all the days, for a jealousy was formed in the heart of Nimrod against Esau all the days.
verses.text: And Nimrod was observing Esau all the days, for a jealousy was formed in the heart of Nimrod against Esau all the days.

verses.raw: And on a certain day Esau went in the field to hunt, and he found Nimrod walking in the wilderness with his two men.
verses.text: And on a certain day Esau went in the field to hunt, and he found Nimrod walking in the wilderness with his two men.

verses.raw: And all his mighty men and his people were with him in the wilderness, but they removed at a distance from him, and they went from him in different directions to hunt, and Esau concealed himself for Nimrod, and he lurked for him in the wilderness.
verses.text: And all his mighty men and his people were with him in the wilderness, but they removed at a distance from him, and they went from him in different directions to hunt, and Esau concealed himself for Nimrod, and he lurked for him in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And Nimrod and his men that were with him did not know him, and Nimrod and his men frequently walked about in the field at the cool of the day, and to know where his men were hunting in the field.
verses.text: And Nimrod and his men that were with him did not know him, and Nimrod and his men frequently walked about in the field at the cool of the day, and to know where his men were hunting in the field.

verses.raw: And Nimrod and two of his men that were with him came to the place where they were, when Esau started suddenly from his lurking place, and drew his sword, and hastened and ran to Nimrod and cut off his head.
verses.text: And Nimrod and two of his men that were with him came to the place where they were, when Esau started suddenly from his lurking place, and drew his sword, and hastened and ran to Nimrod and cut off his head.

verses.raw: And Esau fought a desperate fight with the two men that were with Nimrod, and when they called out to him, Esau turned to them and smote them to death with his sword.
verses.text: And Esau fought a desperate fight with the two men that were with Nimrod, and when they called out to him, Esau turned to them and smote them to death with his sword.

verses.raw: And all the mighty men of Nimrod, who had left him to go to the wilderness, heard the cry at a distance, and they knew the voices of those two men, and they ran to know the cause of it, when they found their king and the two men that were with him lying dead in the wilderness.
verses.text: And all the mighty men of Nimrod, who had left him to go to the wilderness, heard the cry at a distance, and they knew the voices of those two men, and they ran to know the cause of it, when they found their king and the two men that were with him lying dead in the wilderness.

verses.raw: And when Esau saw the mighty men of Nimrod coming at a distance, he fled, and thereby escaped; and Esau took the valuable garments of Nimrod, which Nimrod’s father had bequeathed to Nimrod, and with which Nimrod prevailed over the whole land, and he ran and concealed them in his house.
verses.text: And when Esau saw the mighty men of Nimrod coming at a distance, he fled, and thereby escaped; and Esau took the valuable garments of Nimrod, which Nimrod’s father had bequeathed to Nimrod, and with which Nimrod prevailed over the whole land, and he ran and concealed them in his house.

verses.raw: And Esau took those garments and ran into the city on account of Nimrod’s men, and he came to his father’s house wearied and exhausted from fight, and he was ready to die through grief when he approached his brother Jacob and sat before him.
verses.text: And Esau took those garments and ran into the city on account of Nimrod’s men, and he came to his father’s house wearied and exhausted from fight, and he was ready to die through grief when he approached his brother Jacob and sat before him.

verses.raw: And he said to his brother Jacob, Behold I shall die this day, and therefore then do I want the birthright? And Jacob acted wisely with Esau in this matter, and Esau sold his birthright to Jacob, for it was so brought about by Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And he said to his brother Jacob, Behold I shall die this day, and therefore then do I want the birthright? And Jacob acted wisely with Esau in this matter, and Esau sold his birthright to Jacob, for it was so brought about by Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Esau’s portion in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham had bought from the children of Heth for the possession of a burial ground, Esau also sold to Jacob, and Jacob bought all this from his brother Esau for value given.
verses.text: And Esau’s portion in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham had bought from the children of Heth for the possession of a burial ground, Esau also sold to Jacob, and Jacob bought all this from his brother Esau for value given.

verses.raw: And Jacob wrote the whole of this in a book, and he testified the same with witnesses, and he sealed it, and the book remained in the hands of Jacob.
verses.text: And Jacob wrote the whole of this in a book, and he testified the same with witnesses, and he sealed it, and the book remained in the hands of Jacob.

verses.raw: And when Nimrod the son of Cush died, his men lifted him up and brought him in consternation, and buried him in his city, and all the days that Nimrod lived were two hundred and fifteen years and he died.
verses.text: And when Nimrod the son of Cush died, his men lifted him up and brought him in consternation, and buried him in his city, and all the days that Nimrod lived were two hundred and fifteen years and he died.

verses.raw: And the days that Nimrod reigned upon the people of the land were one hundred and eighty-five years; and Nimrod died by the sword of Esau in shame and contempt, and the seed of Abraham caused his death as he had seen in his dream.
verses.text: And the days that Nimrod reigned upon the people of the land were one hundred and eighty-five years; and Nimrod died by the sword of Esau in shame and contempt, and the seed of Abraham caused his death as he had seen in his dream.

verses.raw: And at the death of Nimrod his kingdom became divided into many divisions, and all those parts that Nimrod reigned over were restored to the respective kings of the land, who recovered them after the death of Nimrod, and all the people of the house of Nimrod were for a long time enslaved to all the other kings of the land.
verses.text: And at the death of Nimrod his kingdom became divided into many divisions, and all those parts that Nimrod reigned over were restored to the respective kings of the land, who recovered them after the death of Nimrod, and all the people of the house of Nimrod were for a long time enslaved to all the other kings of the land.

verses.raw: And in those days, after the death of Abraham, in that year Yahuah (the Lord) brought a heavy famine in the land, and whilst the famine was raging in the land of Canaan, Isaac rose up to go down to Egypt on account of the famine, as his father Abraham had done.
verses.text: And in those days, after the death of Abraham, in that year Yahuah (the Lord) brought a heavy famine in the land, and whilst the famine was raging in the land of Canaan, Isaac rose up to go down to Egypt on account of the famine, as his father Abraham had done.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared that night to Isaac and he said to him, Do not go down to Egypt but rise and go to Gerar, to Abimelech king of the Philistines, and remain there till the famine shall cease.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared that night to Isaac and he said to him, Do not go down to Egypt but rise and go to Gerar, to Abimelech king of the Philistines, and remain there till the famine shall cease.

verses.raw: And Isaac rose up and went to Gerar, as Yahuah (the Lord) commanded him, and he remained there a full year.
verses.text: And Isaac rose up and went to Gerar, as Yahuah (the Lord) commanded him, and he remained there a full year.

verses.raw: And when Isaac came to Gerar, the people of the land saw that Rebecca his wife was of a beautiful appearance, and the people of Gerar asked Isaac concerning his wife, and he said, She is my sister, for he was afraid to say she was his wife lest the people of the land should slay him on account of her.
verses.text: And when Isaac came to Gerar, the people of the land saw that Rebecca his wife was of a beautiful appearance, and the people of Gerar asked Isaac concerning his wife, and he said, She is my sister, for he was afraid to say she was his wife lest the people of the land should slay him on account of her.

verses.raw: And the princes of Abimelech went and praised the woman to the king, but he answered them not, neither did he attend to their words.
verses.text: And the princes of Abimelech went and praised the woman to the king, but he answered them not, neither did he attend to their words.

verses.raw: But he heard them say that Isaac declared her to be his sister, so the king reserved this within himself.
verses.text: But he heard them say that Isaac declared her to be his sister, so the king reserved this within himself.

verses.raw: And when Isaac had remained three months in the land, Abimelech looked out at the window, and he saw, and behold Isaac was sporting with Rebecca his wife, for Isaac dwelt in the outer house belonging to the king, so that the house of Isaac was opposite the house of the king.
verses.text: And when Isaac had remained three months in the land, Abimelech looked out at the window, and he saw, and behold Isaac was sporting with Rebecca his wife, for Isaac dwelt in the outer house belonging to the king, so that the house of Isaac was opposite the house of the king.

verses.raw: And the king said to Isaac, What is this you have done to us in saying of your wife, She is my sister? how easily might one of the great men of the people have lain with her, and you would then have brought guilt upon us.
verses.text: And the king said to Isaac, What is this you have done to us in saying of your wife, She is my sister? how easily might one of the great men of the people have lain with her, and you would then have brought guilt upon us.

verses.raw: And Isaac said to Abimelech, Because I was afraid lest I die on account of my wife, therefore I said, She is my sister.
verses.text: And Isaac said to Abimelech, Because I was afraid lest I die on account of my wife, therefore I said, She is my sister.

verses.raw: At that time Abimelech gave orders to all his princes and great men, and they took Isaac and Rebecca his wife and brought them before the king.
verses.text: At that time Abimelech gave orders to all his princes and great men, and they took Isaac and Rebecca his wife and brought them before the king.

verses.raw: And the king commanded that they should dress them in princely garments, and make them ride through the streets of the city, and proclaim before them throughout the land, saying, This is the man and this is his wife; whoever touches this man or his wife shall surely die. And Isaac returned with his wife to the king’s house, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with Isaac and he continued to wax great and lacked nothing.
verses.text: And the king commanded that they should dress them in princely garments, and make them ride through the streets of the city, and proclaim before them throughout the land, saying, This is the man and this is his wife; whoever touches this man or his wife shall surely die. And Isaac returned with his wife to the king’s house, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with Isaac and he continued to wax great and lacked nothing.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) caused Isaac to find favor in the sight of Abimelech, and in the sight of all his subjects, and Abimelech acted well with Isaac, for Abimelech remembered the oath and the covenant that existed between his father and Abraham.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) caused Isaac to find favor in the sight of Abimelech, and in the sight of all his subjects, and Abimelech acted well with Isaac, for Abimelech remembered the oath and the covenant that existed between his father and Abraham.

verses.raw: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Behold the whole earth is before you; dwell wherever it may seem good in your sight until you shall return to your land; and Abimelech gave Isaac fields and vineyards and the best part of the land of Gerar, to sow and reap and eat the fruits of the ground until the days of the famine should have passed by.
verses.text: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Behold the whole earth is before you; dwell wherever it may seem good in your sight until you shall return to your land; and Abimelech gave Isaac fields and vineyards and the best part of the land of Gerar, to sow and reap and eat the fruits of the ground until the days of the famine should have passed by.

verses.raw: And Isaac sowed in that land, and received a hundred-fold in the same year, and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed him.
verses.text: And Isaac sowed in that land, and received a hundred-fold in the same year, and Yahuah (the Lord) blessed him.

verses.raw: And the man waxed great, and he had possession of flocks and possession of herds and great store of servants.
verses.text: And the man waxed great, and he had possession of flocks and possession of herds and great store of servants.

verses.raw: And when the days of the famine had passed away Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Isaac and said to him, Rise up, go forth from this place and return to your land, to the land of Canaan; and Isaac rose up and returned to Hebron which is in the land of Canaan, he and all belonging to him as Yahuah (the Lord) commanded him.
verses.text: And when the days of the famine had passed away Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Isaac and said to him, Rise up, go forth from this place and return to your land, to the land of Canaan; and Isaac rose up and returned to Hebron which is in the land of Canaan, he and all belonging to him as Yahuah (the Lord) commanded him.

verses.raw: And after this Shelach the son at Arpachshad died in that year, which is the eighteenth year of the lives of Jacob and Esau; and all the days that Shelach lived were four hundred and thirty-three years and he died.
verses.text: And after this Shelach the son at Arpachshad died in that year, which is the eighteenth year of the lives of Jacob and Esau; and all the days that Shelach lived were four hundred and thirty-three years and he died.

verses.raw: At that time Isaac sent his younger son Jacob to the house of Shem and Eber, and he learned the instructions of Yahuah (the Lord), and Jacob remained in the house of Shem and Eber for thirty-two years, and Esau his brother did not go, for he was not willing to go, and he remained in his father’s house in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: At that time Isaac sent his younger son Jacob to the house of Shem and Eber, and he learned the instructions of Yahuah (the Lord), and Jacob remained in the house of Shem and Eber for thirty-two years, and Esau his brother did not go, for he was not willing to go, and he remained in his father’s house in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Esau was continually hunting in the fields to bring home what he could get, so did Esau all the days.
verses.text: And Esau was continually hunting in the fields to bring home what he could get, so did Esau all the days.

verses.raw: And Esau was a designing and deceitful man, one who hunted after the hearts of men and inveigled them, and Esau was a valiant man in the field, and in the course of time went as usual to hunt; and he came as far as the field of Seir, the same is Edom.
verses.text: And Esau was a designing and deceitful man, one who hunted after the hearts of men and inveigled them, and Esau was a valiant man in the field, and in the course of time went as usual to hunt; and he came as far as the field of Seir, the same is Edom.

verses.raw: And he remained in the land of Seir hunting in the field a year and four months.
verses.text: And he remained in the land of Seir hunting in the field a year and four months.

verses.raw: And Esau there saw in the land of Seir the daughter of a man of Canaan, and her name was Jehudith, the daughter of Beeri, son of Epher, from the families of Heth the son of Canaan.
verses.text: And Esau there saw in the land of Seir the daughter of a man of Canaan, and her name was Jehudith, the daughter of Beeri, son of Epher, from the families of Heth the son of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Esau took her for a wife, and he came to her; forty years old was Esau when he took her, and he brought her to Hebron, the land of his father’s dwelling place, and he dwelt there.
verses.text: And Esau took her for a wife, and he came to her; forty years old was Esau when he took her, and he brought her to Hebron, the land of his father’s dwelling place, and he dwelt there.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in those days, in the hundred and tenth year of the life of Isaac, that is in the fiftieth year of the life of Jacob, in that year died Shem the son of Noah; Shem was six hundred years old at his death.
verses.text: And it came to pass in those days, in the hundred and tenth year of the life of Isaac, that is in the fiftieth year of the life of Jacob, in that year died Shem the son of Noah; Shem was six hundred years old at his death.

verses.raw: And when Shem died Jacob returned to his father to Hebron which is in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And when Shem died Jacob returned to his father to Hebron which is in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And in the fifty-sixth year of the life of Jacob, people came from Haran, and Rebecca was told concerning her brother Laban the son of Bethuel.
verses.text: And in the fifty-sixth year of the life of Jacob, people came from Haran, and Rebecca was told concerning her brother Laban the son of Bethuel.

verses.raw: For the wife of Laban was barren in those days, and bare no children, and also all his handmaids bare none to him.
verses.text: For the wife of Laban was barren in those days, and bare no children, and also all his handmaids bare none to him.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) afterward remembered Adinah the wife of Laban, and she conceived and bare twin daughters, and Laban called the names of his daughters, the name of the elder Leah, and the name of the younger Rachel.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) afterward remembered Adinah the wife of Laban, and she conceived and bare twin daughters, and Laban called the names of his daughters, the name of the elder Leah, and the name of the younger Rachel.

verses.raw: And those people came and told these things to Rebecca, and Rebecca rejoiced greatly that Yahuah (the Lord) had visited her brother and that he had got children.
verses.text: And those people came and told these things to Rebecca, and Rebecca rejoiced greatly that Yahuah (the Lord) had visited her brother and that he had got children.

verses.raw: And Isaac the son of Abraham became old and advanced in days, and his eyes became heavy through age; they were dim and could not see.
verses.text: And Isaac the son of Abraham became old and advanced in days, and his eyes became heavy through age; they were dim and could not see.

verses.raw: At that time Isaac called to Esau his son, saying, Get I pray you your weapons, your quiver and your bow, rise up and go forth into the field and get me some venison, and make me savory meat and bring it to me, that I may eat in order that I may bless you before my death, as I have now become old and gray-headed.
verses.text: At that time Isaac called to Esau his son, saying, Get I pray you your weapons, your quiver and your bow, rise up and go forth into the field and get me some venison, and make me savory meat and bring it to me, that I may eat in order that I may bless you before my death, as I have now become old and gray-headed.

verses.raw: And Esau did so; and he took his weapon and went forth into the field to hunt for venison, as usual, to bring to his father as he had ordered him, so that he might bless him.
verses.text: And Esau did so; and he took his weapon and went forth into the field to hunt for venison, as usual, to bring to his father as he had ordered him, so that he might bless him.

verses.raw: And Rebecca heard all the words that Isaac had spoken to Esau, and she hastened and called her son Jacob, saying, Thus did your father speak to your brother Esau, and thus did I hear, now therefore hasten you and make that which I shall tell you.
verses.text: And Rebecca heard all the words that Isaac had spoken to Esau, and she hastened and called her son Jacob, saying, Thus did your father speak to your brother Esau, and thus did I hear, now therefore hasten you and make that which I shall tell you.

verses.raw: Rise up and go, I pray you, to the flock and fetch me two fine kids of the goats, and I will get the savory meat for your father, and you shall bring the savory meat that he may eat before your brother shall have come from the chase, in order that your father may bless you.
verses.text: Rise up and go, I pray you, to the flock and fetch me two fine kids of the goats, and I will get the savory meat for your father, and you shall bring the savory meat that he may eat before your brother shall have come from the chase, in order that your father may bless you.

verses.raw: And Jacob hastened and did as his mother had commanded him, and he made the savory meat and brought it before his father before Esau had come from his chase.
verses.text: And Jacob hastened and did as his mother had commanded him, and he made the savory meat and brought it before his father before Esau had come from his chase.

verses.raw: And Isaac said to Jacob, Who are you, my son? And he said, I am your first born Esau, I have done as you did order me, now therefore rise up I pray you, and eat of my hunt, in order that your soul may bless me as you did speak to me.
verses.text: And Isaac said to Jacob, Who are you, my son? And he said, I am your first born Esau, I have done as you did order me, now therefore rise up I pray you, and eat of my hunt, in order that your soul may bless me as you did speak to me.

verses.raw: And Isaac rose up and he ate and he drank, and his heart was comforted, and he blessed Jacob and Jacob went away from his father; and as soon as Isaac had blessed Jacob and he had gone away from him, behold Esau came from his hunt from the field, and he also made savory meat and brought it to his father to eat of it and to bless him.
verses.text: And Isaac rose up and he ate and he drank, and his heart was comforted, and he blessed Jacob and Jacob went away from his father; and as soon as Isaac had blessed Jacob and he had gone away from him, behold Esau came from his hunt from the field, and he also made savory meat and brought it to his father to eat of it and to bless him.

verses.raw: And Isaac said to Esau, And who was he that has taken venison and brought it me before you came and whom I did bless? And Esau knew that his brother Jacob had done this, and the anger of Esau was kindled against his brother Jacob that he had acted thus toward him.
verses.text: And Isaac said to Esau, And who was he that has taken venison and brought it me before you came and whom I did bless? And Esau knew that his brother Jacob had done this, and the anger of Esau was kindled against his brother Jacob that he had acted thus toward him.

verses.raw: And Esau said, Is he not rightly called Jacob? for he has supplanted me twice, he took away my birthright and now he has taken away my blessing; and Esau wept greatly; and when Isaac heard the voice of his son Esau weeping, Isaac said to Esau, What can I do, my son, your brother came with subtlety and took away your blessing; and Esau hated his brother Jacob on account of the blessing that his father had given him, and his anger was greatly roused against him.
verses.text: And Esau said, Is he not rightly called Jacob? for he has supplanted me twice, he took away my birthright and now he has taken away my blessing; and Esau wept greatly; and when Isaac heard the voice of his son Esau weeping, Isaac said to Esau, What can I do, my son, your brother came with subtlety and took away your blessing; and Esau hated his brother Jacob on account of the blessing that his father had given him, and his anger was greatly roused against him.

verses.raw: And Jacob was very much afraid of his brother Esau, and he rose up and fled to the house of Eber the son of Shem, and he concealed himself there on account of his brother, and Jacob was sixty-three years old when he went forth from the land of Canaan from Hebron, and Jacob was concealed in Eber’s house fourteen years on account of his brother Esau, and he there continued to learn the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) and his commandments.
verses.text: And Jacob was very much afraid of his brother Esau, and he rose up and fled to the house of Eber the son of Shem, and he concealed himself there on account of his brother, and Jacob was sixty-three years old when he went forth from the land of Canaan from Hebron, and Jacob was concealed in Eber’s house fourteen years on account of his brother Esau, and he there continued to learn the ways of Yahuah (the Lord) and his commandments.

verses.raw: And when Esau saw that Jacob had fled and escaped from him, and that Jacob had cunningly obtained the blessing, then Esau grieved exceedingly, and he was also vexed at his father and mother; and he also rose up and took his wife and went away from his father and mother to the land of Seir, and he dwelt there; and Esau saw there a woman from amongst the daughters of Heth whose name was Bosmath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and he took her for a wife in addition to his first wife, and Esau called her name Adah, saying the blessing had in that time passed from him.
verses.text: And when Esau saw that Jacob had fled and escaped from him, and that Jacob had cunningly obtained the blessing, then Esau grieved exceedingly, and he was also vexed at his father and mother; and he also rose up and took his wife and went away from his father and mother to the land of Seir, and he dwelt there; and Esau saw there a woman from amongst the daughters of Heth whose name was Bosmath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and he took her for a wife in addition to his first wife, and Esau called her name Adah, saying the blessing had in that time passed from him.

verses.raw: And Esau dwelt in the land of Seir six months without seeing his father and mother, and afterward Esau took his wives and rose up and returned to the land of Canaan, and Esau placed his two wives in his father’s house in Hebron.
verses.text: And Esau dwelt in the land of Seir six months without seeing his father and mother, and afterward Esau took his wives and rose up and returned to the land of Canaan, and Esau placed his two wives in his father’s house in Hebron.

verses.raw: And the wives of Esau vexed and provoked Isaac and Rebecca with their works, for they walked not in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), but served their father’s gods of wood and stone as their father had taught them, and they were more wicked than their father.
verses.text: And the wives of Esau vexed and provoked Isaac and Rebecca with their works, for they walked not in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord), but served their father’s gods of wood and stone as their father had taught them, and they were more wicked than their father.

verses.raw: And they went according to the evil desires of their hearts, and they sacrificed and burnt incense to the Baalim, and Isaac and Rebecca became weary of them.
verses.text: And they went according to the evil desires of their hearts, and they sacrificed and burnt incense to the Baalim, and Isaac and Rebecca became weary of them.

verses.raw: And Rebecca said, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth; if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good then is life to me?
verses.text: And Rebecca said, I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth; if Jacob take a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these which are of the daughters of the land, what good then is life to me?

verses.raw: And in those days Adah the wife of Esau conceived and bare him a son, and Esau called the name of the son that was born to him Eliphaz, and Esau was sixty-five years old when she bare him.
verses.text: And in those days Adah the wife of Esau conceived and bare him a son, and Esau called the name of the son that was born to him Eliphaz, and Esau was sixty-five years old when she bare him.

verses.raw: And Ishmael the son of Abraham died in those days, in the sixty-forth year of the life of Jacob, and all the days that Ishmael lived were one hundred and thirty-seven years and he died.
verses.text: And Ishmael the son of Abraham died in those days, in the sixty-forth year of the life of Jacob, and all the days that Ishmael lived were one hundred and thirty-seven years and he died.

verses.raw: And when Isaac heard that Ishmael was dead he mourned for him, and Isaac lamented over him many days.
verses.text: And when Isaac heard that Ishmael was dead he mourned for him, and Isaac lamented over him many days.

verses.raw: And at the end of fourteen years of Jacob’s residing in the house of Eber, Jacob desired to see his father and mother, and Jacob came to the house of his father and mother to Hebron, and Esau had in those days forgotten what Jacob had done to him in having taken the blessing from him in those days.
verses.text: And at the end of fourteen years of Jacob’s residing in the house of Eber, Jacob desired to see his father and mother, and Jacob came to the house of his father and mother to Hebron, and Esau had in those days forgotten what Jacob had done to him in having taken the blessing from him in those days.

verses.raw: And when Esau saw Jacob coming to his father and mother he remembered what Jacob had done to him, and he was greatly incensed against him and he sought to slay him.
verses.text: And when Esau saw Jacob coming to his father and mother he remembered what Jacob had done to him, and he was greatly incensed against him and he sought to slay him.

verses.raw: And Isaac the son of Abraham was old and advanced in days, and Esau said, Now my father’s time is drawing nigh that he must die, and when he shall die I will slay my brother Jacob.
verses.text: And Isaac the son of Abraham was old and advanced in days, and Esau said, Now my father’s time is drawing nigh that he must die, and when he shall die I will slay my brother Jacob.

verses.raw: And this was told to Rebecca, and she hastened and sent and called for Jacob her son, and she said to him, Arise, go and flee to Haran to my brother Laban, and remain there for some time, until your brother’s anger be turned from you and then shall you come back.
verses.text: And this was told to Rebecca, and she hastened and sent and called for Jacob her son, and she said to him, Arise, go and flee to Haran to my brother Laban, and remain there for some time, until your brother’s anger be turned from you and then shall you come back.

verses.raw: And Isaac called to Jacob and said to him, Take not a wife from the daughters of Canaan, for thus did our father Abraham command us according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) which he had commanded him, saying, To your seed will I give this land; if your children keep my covenant that I have made with you, then will I also perform to your children that which I have spoken to you and I will not forsake them.
verses.text: And Isaac called to Jacob and said to him, Take not a wife from the daughters of Canaan, for thus did our father Abraham command us according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) which he had commanded him, saying, To your seed will I give this land; if your children keep my covenant that I have made with you, then will I also perform to your children that which I have spoken to you and I will not forsake them.

verses.raw: Now therefore my son hearken to my voice, to all that I shall command you, and refrain from taking a wife from amongst the daughters of Canaan; arise, go to Haran to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father, and take to you a wife from there from the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother.
verses.text: Now therefore my son hearken to my voice, to all that I shall command you, and refrain from taking a wife from amongst the daughters of Canaan; arise, go to Haran to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father, and take to you a wife from there from the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother.

verses.raw: Therefore take heed lest you should forget Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God) and all his ways in the land to which you go, and should get connected with the people of the land and pursue vanity and forsake Yahuah your Elohim.
verses.text: Therefore take heed lest you should forget Yahuah your Elohim and all his ways in the land to which you go, and should get connected with the people of the land and pursue vanity and forsake Yahuah your Elohim.

verses.raw: But when you come to the land serve there Yahuah (the Lord), do not turn to the right or to the left from the way which I commanded you and which you did learn.
verses.text: But when you come to the land serve there Yahuah (the Lord), do not turn to the right or to the left from the way which I commanded you and which you did learn.

verses.raw: And may El Shaddai (the Almighty God) grant you favor in the sight of the people of the earth, that you may take there a wife according to your choice; one who is good and upright in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And may El Shaddai (the Almighty God) grant you favor in the sight of the people of the earth, that you may take there a wife according to your choice; one who is good and upright in the ways of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And may Elohim (God) give to you and your seed the blessing of your father Abraham, and make you fruitful and multiply you, and may you become a multitude of people in the land whither you go, and may Elohim cause you to return to this land, the land of your father’s dwelling, with children and with great riches, with joy and with pleasure.
verses.text: And may Elohim give to you and your seed the blessing of your father Abraham, and make you fruitful and multiply you, and may you become a multitude of people in the land whither you go, and may Elohim cause you to return to this land, the land of your father’s dwelling, with children and with great riches, with joy and with pleasure.

verses.raw: And Isaac finished commanding Jacob and blessing him, and he gave him many gifts, together with silver and gold, and he sent him away; and Jacob hearkened to his father and mother; he kissed them and arose and went to Padan-aram; and Jacob was seventy-seven years old when he went out from the land of Canaan from Beersheba.
verses.text: And Isaac finished commanding Jacob and blessing him, and he gave him many gifts, together with silver and gold, and he sent him away; and Jacob hearkened to his father and mother; he kissed them and arose and went to Padan-aram; and Jacob was seventy-seven years old when he went out from the land of Canaan from Beersheba.

verses.raw: And when Jacob went away to go to Haran Esau called to his son Eliphaz, and secretly spoke to him, saying, Now hasten, take your sword in your hand and pursue Jacob and pass before him in the road, and lurk for him, and slay him with your sword in one of the mountains, and take all belonging to him and come back.
verses.text: And when Jacob went away to go to Haran Esau called to his son Eliphaz, and secretly spoke to him, saying, Now hasten, take your sword in your hand and pursue Jacob and pass before him in the road, and lurk for him, and slay him with your sword in one of the mountains, and take all belonging to him and come back.

verses.raw: And Eliphaz the son of Esau was an active man and expert with the bow as his father had taught him, and he was a noted hunter in the field and a valiant man.
verses.text: And Eliphaz the son of Esau was an active man and expert with the bow as his father had taught him, and he was a noted hunter in the field and a valiant man.

verses.raw: And Eliphaz did as his father had commanded him, and Eliphaz was at that time thirteen years old, and Eliphaz rose up and went and took ten of his mother’s brothers with him and pursued Jacob.
verses.text: And Eliphaz did as his father had commanded him, and Eliphaz was at that time thirteen years old, and Eliphaz rose up and went and took ten of his mother’s brothers with him and pursued Jacob.

verses.raw: And he closely followed Jacob, and he lurked for him in the border of the land of Canaan opposite to the city of Shechem.
verses.text: And he closely followed Jacob, and he lurked for him in the border of the land of Canaan opposite to the city of Shechem.

verses.raw: And Jacob saw Eliphaz and his men pursuing him, and Jacob stood still in the place in which he was going, in order to know what this was, for he did not know the thing; and Eliphaz drew his sword and he went on advancing, he and his men, toward Jacob; and Jacob said to them, What is to do with you that you have come here, and what means it that you pursue with your swords.
verses.text: And Jacob saw Eliphaz and his men pursuing him, and Jacob stood still in the place in which he was going, in order to know what this was, for he did not know the thing; and Eliphaz drew his sword and he went on advancing, he and his men, toward Jacob; and Jacob said to them, What is to do with you that you have come here, and what means it that you pursue with your swords.

verses.raw: And Eliphaz came near to Jacob and he answered and said to him, Thus did my father command me, and now therefore I will not deviate from the orders which my father gave me; and when Jacob saw that Esau had spoken to Eliphaz to employ force, Jacob then approached and supplicated Eliphaz and his men, saying to him,
verses.text: And Eliphaz came near to Jacob and he answered and said to him, Thus did my father command me, and now therefore I will not deviate from the orders which my father gave me; and when Jacob saw that Esau had spoken to Eliphaz to employ force, Jacob then approached and supplicated Eliphaz and his men, saying to him,

verses.raw: Behold all that I have and which my father and mother gave to me, that take to you and go from me, and do not slay me, and may this thing be accounted to you a righteousness.
verses.text: Behold all that I have and which my father and mother gave to me, that take to you and go from me, and do not slay me, and may this thing be accounted to you a righteousness.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) caused Jacob to find favor in the sight of Eliphaz the son of Esau, and his men, and they hearkened to the voice of Jacob, and they did not put him to death, and Eliphaz and his men took all belonging to Jacob together with the silver and gold that he had brought with him from Beersheba; they left him nothing.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) caused Jacob to find favor in the sight of Eliphaz the son of Esau, and his men, and they hearkened to the voice of Jacob, and they did not put him to death, and Eliphaz and his men took all belonging to Jacob together with the silver and gold that he had brought with him from Beersheba; they left him nothing.

verses.raw: And Eliphaz and his men went away from him and they returned to Esau to Beersheba, and they told him all that had occurred to them with Jacob, and they gave him all that they had taken from Jacob.
verses.text: And Eliphaz and his men went away from him and they returned to Esau to Beersheba, and they told him all that had occurred to them with Jacob, and they gave him all that they had taken from Jacob.

verses.raw: And Esau was indignant at Eliphaz his son, and at his men that were with him, because they had not put Jacob to death.
verses.text: And Esau was indignant at Eliphaz his son, and at his men that were with him, because they had not put Jacob to death.

verses.raw: And they answered and said to Esau, Because Jacob supplicated us in this matter not to slay him, our pity was excited toward him, and we took all belonging to him and brought it to you; and Esau took all the silver and gold which Eliphaz had taken from Jacob and he put them by in his house.
verses.text: And they answered and said to Esau, Because Jacob supplicated us in this matter not to slay him, our pity was excited toward him, and we took all belonging to him and brought it to you; and Esau took all the silver and gold which Eliphaz had taken from Jacob and he put them by in his house.

verses.raw: At that time when Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob, and had commanded him, saying, You shall not take a wife from amongst the daughters of Canaan, and that the daughters of Canaan were bad in the sight of Isaac and Rebecca,

verses.raw: Then he went to the house of Ishmael his uncle, and in addition to his older wives he took Machlath the daughter of Ishmael, the sister of Nebayoth, for a wife.
verses.text: Then he went to the house of Ishmael his uncle, and in addition to his older wives he took Machlath the daughter of Ishmael, the sister of Nebayoth, for a wife.

verses.raw: And Jacob went forth continuing his road to Haran, and he came as far as mount Moriah, and he tarried there all night near the city of Luz; and Yahuah (the Lord) appeared there to Jacob on that night, and he said to him, I am Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of Abraham and the Elohim (God) of Isaac your father; the land upon which you lie I will give to you and your seed.
verses.text: And Jacob went forth continuing his road to Haran, and he came as far as mount Moriah, and he tarried there all night near the city of Luz; and Yahuah (the Lord) appeared there to Jacob on that night, and he said to him, I am Yahuah Elohim of Abraham and the Elohim of Isaac your father; the land upon which you lie I will give to you and your seed.

verses.raw: And behold I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and I will multiply your seed as the stars of Heaven, and I will cause all your enemies to fall before you; and when they shall make war with you they shall not prevail over you, and I will bring you again to this land with joy, with children, and with great riches.
verses.text: And behold I am with you and will keep you wherever you go, and I will multiply your seed as the stars of Heaven, and I will cause all your enemies to fall before you; and when they shall make war with you they shall not prevail over you, and I will bring you again to this land with joy, with children, and with great riches.

verses.raw: And Jacob awoke from his sleep and he rejoiced greatly at the vision which he had seen; and he called the name of that place Bethel.
verses.text: And Jacob awoke from his sleep and he rejoiced greatly at the vision which he had seen; and he called the name of that place Bethel.

verses.raw: And Jacob rose up from that place quite rejoiced, and when he walked his feet felt light to him for joy, and he went from there to the land of the children of the East, and he returned to Haran and he set by the shepherd’s well.
verses.text: And Jacob rose up from that place quite rejoiced, and when he walked his feet felt light to him for joy, and he went from there to the land of the children of the East, and he returned to Haran and he set by the shepherd’s well.

verses.raw: And he there found some men; going from Haran to feed their flocks, and Jacob made inquiries of them, and they said, We are from Haran.
verses.text: And he there found some men; going from Haran to feed their flocks, and Jacob made inquiries of them, and they said, We are from Haran.

verses.raw: And he said to them, Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor? and they said, We know him, and behold his daughter Rachel is coming along to feed her father’s flock.
verses.text: And he said to them, Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor? and they said, We know him, and behold his daughter Rachel is coming along to feed her father’s flock.

verses.raw: Whilst he was yet speaking with them, Rachel the daughter of Laban came to feed her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
verses.text: Whilst he was yet speaking with them, Rachel the daughter of Laban came to feed her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.

verses.raw: And when Jacob saw Rachel, the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, he ran and kissed her, and lifted up his voice and wept.
verses.text: And when Jacob saw Rachel, the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, he ran and kissed her, and lifted up his voice and wept.

verses.raw: And Jacob told Rachel that he was the son of Rebecca, her father’s sister, and Rachel ran and told her father, and Jacob continued to cry because he had nothing with him to bring to the house of Laban.
verses.text: And Jacob told Rachel that he was the son of Rebecca, her father’s sister, and Rachel ran and told her father, and Jacob continued to cry because he had nothing with him to bring to the house of Laban.

verses.raw: And when Laban heard that his sister’s son Jacob had come, he ran and kissed him and embraced him and brought him into the house and gave him bread, and he ate.
verses.text: And when Laban heard that his sister’s son Jacob had come, he ran and kissed him and embraced him and brought him into the house and gave him bread, and he ate.

verses.raw: And Jacob related to Laban what his brother Esau had done to him, and what his son Eliphaz had done to him in the road.
verses.text: And Jacob related to Laban what his brother Esau had done to him, and what his son Eliphaz had done to him in the road.

verses.raw: And Jacob resided in Laban’s house for one month, and Jacob ate and drank in the house of Laban, and afterward Laban said to Jacob, Tell me what shall be your wages, for how can you serve me for nought?
verses.text: And Jacob resided in Laban’s house for one month, and Jacob ate and drank in the house of Laban, and afterward Laban said to Jacob, Tell me what shall be your wages, for how can you serve me for nought?

verses.raw: And Laban had no sons but only daughters, and his other wives and handmaids were still barren in those days; and these are the names of Laban’s daughters which his wife Adinah had borne to him; the name of the elder was Leah and the name of the younger was Rachel; and Leah was tender-eyed, but Rachel was beautiful and well favored, and Jacob loved her.
verses.text: And Laban had no sons but only daughters, and his other wives and handmaids were still barren in those days; and these are the names of Laban’s daughters which his wife Adinah had borne to him; the name of the elder was Leah and the name of the younger was Rachel; and Leah was tender-eyed, but Rachel was beautiful and well favored, and Jacob loved her.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to Laban, I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter; and Laban consented to this and Jacob served Laban seven years for his daughter Rachel.
verses.text: And Jacob said to Laban, I will serve you seven years for Rachel your younger daughter; and Laban consented to this and Jacob served Laban seven years for his daughter Rachel.

verses.raw: And in the second year of Jacob’s dwelling in Haran, that is in the seventy ninth year of the life of Jacob, in that year died Eber the son of Shem, he was four hundred and sixty-four years old at his death.
verses.text: And in the second year of Jacob’s dwelling in Haran, that is in the seventy ninth year of the life of Jacob, in that year died Eber the son of Shem, he was four hundred and sixty-four years old at his death.

verses.raw: And when Jacob heard that Eber was dead he grieved exceedingly, and he lamented and mourned over him many days.
verses.text: And when Jacob heard that Eber was dead he grieved exceedingly, and he lamented and mourned over him many days.

verses.raw: And in the third year of Jacob’s dwelling in Haran, Bosmath, the daughter of Ishmael, the wife of Esau, bare to him a son, and Esau called his name Reuel.
verses.text: And in the third year of Jacob’s dwelling in Haran, Bosmath, the daughter of Ishmael, the wife of Esau, bare to him a son, and Esau called his name Reuel.

verses.raw: And in the fourth year of Jacob’s residence in the house of Laban, Yahuah (the Lord) visited Laban and remembered him on account of Jacob, and sons were born to him, and his first born was Beor, his second was Alib, and the third was Chorash.
verses.text: And in the fourth year of Jacob’s residence in the house of Laban, Yahuah (the Lord) visited Laban and remembered him on account of Jacob, and sons were born to him, and his first born was Beor, his second was Alib, and the third was Chorash.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave Laban riches and honor, sons and daughters, and the man increased greatly on account of Jacob.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave Laban riches and honor, sons and daughters, and the man increased greatly on account of Jacob.

verses.raw: And Jacob in those days served Laban in all manner of work, in the house and in the field, and the blessing of Yahuah (the Lord) was in all that belonged to Laban in the house and in the field.
verses.text: And Jacob in those days served Laban in all manner of work, in the house and in the field, and the blessing of Yahuah (the Lord) was in all that belonged to Laban in the house and in the field.

verses.raw: And in the fifth year died Jehudith, the daughter of Beeri, the wife of Esau, in the land of Canaan, and she had no sons but daughters only.
verses.text: And in the fifth year died Jehudith, the daughter of Beeri, the wife of Esau, in the land of Canaan, and she had no sons but daughters only.

verses.raw: And these are the names of her daughters which she bare to Esau, the name of the elder was Marzith, and the name of the younger was Puith.
verses.text: And these are the names of her daughters which she bare to Esau, the name of the elder was Marzith, and the name of the younger was Puith.

verses.raw: And when Jehudith died, Esau rose up and went to Seir to hunt in the field, as usual, and Esau dwelt in the land of Seir for a long time.
verses.text: And when Jehudith died, Esau rose up and went to Seir to hunt in the field, as usual, and Esau dwelt in the land of Seir for a long time.

verses.raw: And in the sixth year Esau took for a wife, in addition to his other wives, Ahlibamah, the daughter of Zebeon the Hivite, and Esau brought her to the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And in the sixth year Esau took for a wife, in addition to his other wives, Ahlibamah, the daughter of Zebeon the Hivite, and Esau brought her to the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Ahlibamah conceived and bare to Esau three sons, Yeush, Yaalan, and Korah.
verses.text: And Ahlibamah conceived and bare to Esau three sons, Yeush, Yaalan, and Korah.

verses.raw: And in those days, in the land of Canaan, there was a quarrel between the herdsmen of Esau and the herdsmen of the inhabitants of the land of Canaan, for Esau’s cattle and goods were too abundant for him to remain in the land of Canaan, in his father’s house, and the land of Canaan could not bear him on account of his cattle.
verses.text: And in those days, in the land of Canaan, there was a quarrel between the herdsmen of Esau and the herdsmen of the inhabitants of the land of Canaan, for Esau’s cattle and goods were too abundant for him to remain in the land of Canaan, in his father’s house, and the land of Canaan could not bear him on account of his cattle.

verses.raw: And when Esau saw that his quarreling increased with the inhabitants of the land of Canaan, he rose up and took his wives and his sons and his daughters, and all belonging to him, and the cattle which he possessed, and all his property that he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went away from the inhabitants of the land to the land of Seir, and Esau and all belonging to him dwelt in the land of Seir.
verses.text: And when Esau saw that his quarreling increased with the inhabitants of the land of Canaan, he rose up and took his wives and his sons and his daughters, and all belonging to him, and the cattle which he possessed, and all his property that he had acquired in the land of Canaan, and he went away from the inhabitants of the land to the land of Seir, and Esau and all belonging to him dwelt in the land of Seir.

verses.raw: But from time to time Esau would go and see his father and mother in the land of Canaan, and Esau intermarried with the Horites, and he gave his daughters to the sons of Seir, the Horite.
verses.text: But from time to time Esau would go and see his father and mother in the land of Canaan, and Esau intermarried with the Horites, and he gave his daughters to the sons of Seir, the Horite.

verses.raw: And he gave his elder daughter Marzith to Anah, the son of Zebeon, his wife’s brother, and Puith he gave to Azar, the son of Bilhan the Horite; and Esau dwelt in the mountain, he and his children, and they were fruitful and multiplied.
verses.text: And he gave his elder daughter Marzith to Anah, the son of Zebeon, his wife’s brother, and Puith he gave to Azar, the son of Bilhan the Horite; and Esau dwelt in the mountain, he and his children, and they were fruitful and multiplied.

verses.raw: And in the seventh year, Jacob’s service which he served Laban was completed, and Jacob said to Laban, Give me my wife, for the days of my service are fulfilled; and Laban did so, and Laban and Jacob assembled all the people of that place and they made a feast.
verses.text: And in the seventh year, Jacob’s service which he served Laban was completed, and Jacob said to Laban, Give me my wife, for the days of my service are fulfilled; and Laban did so, and Laban and Jacob assembled all the people of that place and they made a feast.

verses.raw: And in the evening Laban came to the house, and afterward Jacob came there with the people of the feast, and Laban extinguished all the lights that were there in the house.
verses.text: And in the evening Laban came to the house, and afterward Jacob came there with the people of the feast, and Laban extinguished all the lights that were there in the house.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to Laban, Therefore dost you do this thing to us? and Laban answered, Such is our custom to act in this land.
verses.text: And Jacob said to Laban, Therefore dost you do this thing to us? and Laban answered, Such is our custom to act in this land.

verses.raw: And afterward Laban took his daughter Leah, and he brought her to Jacob, and he came to her and Jacob did not know that she was Leah.
verses.text: And afterward Laban took his daughter Leah, and he brought her to Jacob, and he came to her and Jacob did not know that she was Leah.

verses.raw: And Laban gave his daughter Leah his maid Zilpah for a handmaid.
verses.text: And Laban gave his daughter Leah his maid Zilpah for a handmaid.

verses.raw: And all the people at the feast knew what Laban had done to Jacob, but they did not tell the thing to Jacob.
verses.text: And all the people at the feast knew what Laban had done to Jacob, but they did not tell the thing to Jacob.

verses.raw: And all the neighbors came that night to Jacob’s house, and they ate and drank and rejoiced, and played before Leah upon timbrels, and with dances, and they responded before Jacob, Heleah, Heleah.
verses.text: And all the neighbors came that night to Jacob’s house, and they ate and drank and rejoiced, and played before Leah upon timbrels, and with dances, and they responded before Jacob, Heleah, Heleah.

verses.raw: And Jacob heard their words but did not understand their meaning, but he thought such might be their custom in this land.
verses.text: And Jacob heard their words but did not understand their meaning, but he thought such might be their custom in this land.

verses.raw: And the neighbors spoke these words before Jacob during the night, and all the lights that were in the house Laban had that night extinguished.
verses.text: And the neighbors spoke these words before Jacob during the night, and all the lights that were in the house Laban had that night extinguished.

verses.raw: And in the morning, when daylight appeared, Jacob turned to his wife and he saw, and behold it was Leah that had been lying in his bosom, and Jacob said, Behold now I know what the neighbors said last night, Heleah, they said, and I knew it not.
verses.text: And in the morning, when daylight appeared, Jacob turned to his wife and he saw, and behold it was Leah that had been lying in his bosom, and Jacob said, Behold now I know what the neighbors said last night, Heleah, they said, and I knew it not.

verses.raw: And Jacob called to Laban, and said to him, What is this that you did to me? Surely I served you for Rachel, and why did you deceive me and did give me Leah?
verses.text: And Jacob called to Laban, and said to him, What is this that you did to me? Surely I served you for Rachel, and why did you deceive me and did give me Leah?

verses.raw: And Laban answered Jacob, saying, Not so is it done in our place to give the younger before the elder now therefore if you desire to take her sister likewise, take her to you for the service which you will serve me for another seven years.
verses.text: And Laban answered Jacob, saying, Not so is it done in our place to give the younger before the elder now therefore if you desire to take her sister likewise, take her to you for the service which you will serve me for another seven years.

verses.raw: And Jacob did so, and he also took Rachel for a wife, and he served Laban seven years more, and Jacob also came to Rachel, and he loved Rachel more than Leah, and Laban gave her his maid Bilhah for a handmaid.
verses.text: And Jacob did so, and he also took Rachel for a wife, and he served Laban seven years more, and Jacob also came to Rachel, and he loved Rachel more than Leah, and Laban gave her his maid Bilhah for a handmaid.

verses.raw: And when Yahuah (the Lord) saw that Leah was hated, Yahuah (the Lord) opened her womb, and she conceived and bare Jacob four sons in those days.
verses.text: And when Yahuah (the Lord) saw that Leah was hated, Yahuah (the Lord) opened her womb, and she conceived and bare Jacob four sons in those days.

verses.raw: And these are their names, Reuben Simeon, Levi, and Judah, and she afterward left bearing.
verses.text: And these are their names, Reuben Simeon, Levi, and Judah, and she afterward left bearing.

verses.raw: And at that time Rachel was barren, and she had no offspring, and Rachel envied her sister Leah, and when Rachel saw that she bare no children to Jacob, she took her handmaid Bilhah, and she bare Jacob two sons, Dan and Naphtali.
verses.text: And at that time Rachel was barren, and she had no offspring, and Rachel envied her sister Leah, and when Rachel saw that she bare no children to Jacob, she took her handmaid Bilhah, and she bare Jacob two sons, Dan and Naphtali.

verses.raw: And when Leah saw that she had left bearing, she also took her handmaid Zilpah, and she gave her to Jacob for a wife, and Jacob also came to Zilpah, and she also bare Jacob two sons, Gad and Asher.
verses.text: And when Leah saw that she had left bearing, she also took her handmaid Zilpah, and she gave her to Jacob for a wife, and Jacob also came to Zilpah, and she also bare Jacob two sons, Gad and Asher.

verses.raw: And Leah again conceived and bare Jacob in those days two sons and one daughter, and these are their names, Issachar, Zebulon, and their sister Dinah.
verses.text: And Leah again conceived and bare Jacob in those days two sons and one daughter, and these are their names, Issachar, Zebulon, and their sister Dinah.

verses.raw: And Rachel was still barren in those days, and Rachel prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) at that time, and she said, O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) remember me and visit me, I beseech you, for now my husband will cast me off, for I have borne him no children.
verses.text: And Rachel was still barren in those days, and Rachel prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) at that time, and she said, O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) remember me and visit me, I beseech you, for now my husband will cast me off, for I have borne him no children.

verses.raw: Now O Yahuah Elohim, hear my supplication before you, and see my affliction, and give me children like one of the handmaids, that I may no more bear my reproach.
verses.text: Now O Yahuah Elohim, hear my supplication before you, and see my affliction, and give me children like one of the handmaids, that I may no more bear my reproach.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) heard her and opened her womb, and Rachel conceived and bare a son, and she said, Yahuah (the Lord) has taken away my reproach, and she called his name Joseph, saying, May Yahuah (the Lord) add to me another son; and Jacob was ninety-one years old when she bare him.
verses.text: And Elohim heard her and opened her womb, and Rachel conceived and bare a son, and she said, Yahuah (the Lord) has taken away my reproach, and she called his name Joseph, saying, May Yahuah (the Lord) add to me another son; and Jacob was ninety-one years old when she bare him.

verses.raw: At that time Jacob’s mother, Rebecca, sent her nurse Deborah the daughter of Uz, and two of Isaac’s servants to Jacob.
verses.text: At that time Jacob’s mother, Rebecca, sent her nurse Deborah the daughter of Uz, and two of Isaac’s servants to Jacob.

verses.raw: And they came to Jacob to Haran and they said to him, Rebecca has sent us to you that you shall return to your father’s house to the land of Canaan; and Jacob hearkened to them in this which his mother had spoken.
verses.text: And they came to Jacob to Haran and they said to him, Rebecca has sent us to you that you shall return to your father’s house to the land of Canaan; and Jacob hearkened to them in this which his mother had spoken.

verses.raw: At that time, the other seven years which Jacob served Laban for Rachel were completed, and it was at the end of fourteen years that he had dwelt in Haran that Jacob said to Laban, give me my wives and send me away, that I may go to my land, for behold my mother did send to me from the land at Canaan that I should return to my father’s house.
verses.text: At that time, the other seven years which Jacob served Laban for Rachel were completed, and it was at the end of fourteen years that he had dwelt in Haran that Jacob said to Laban, give me my wives and send me away, that I may go to my land, for behold my mother did send to me from the land at Canaan that I should return to my father’s house.

verses.raw: And Laban said to him, Not so I pray you; if I have found favor in your sight do not leave me; appoint me your wages and I will give them, and remain with me.
verses.text: And Laban said to him, Not so I pray you; if I have found favor in your sight do not leave me; appoint me your wages and I will give them, and remain with me.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to him, This is what you shall give me for wages, that I shall this day pass through all your flock and take away from them every lamb that is speckled and spotted and such as are brown amongst the sheep, and amongst the goats, and if you will do this thing for me I will return and feed your flock and keep them as at first.
verses.text: And Jacob said to him, This is what you shall give me for wages, that I shall this day pass through all your flock and take away from them every lamb that is speckled and spotted and such as are brown amongst the sheep, and amongst the goats, and if you will do this thing for me I will return and feed your flock and keep them as at first.

verses.raw: And Laban did so, and Laban removed from his flock all that Jacob had said and gave them to him.
verses.text: And Laban did so, and Laban removed from his flock all that Jacob had said and gave them to him.

verses.raw: And Jacob placed all that he had removed from Laban’s flock in the hands of his sons, and Jacob was feeding the remainder of Laban’s flock.
verses.text: And Jacob placed all that he had removed from Laban’s flock in the hands of his sons, and Jacob was feeding the remainder of Laban’s flock.

verses.raw: And when the servants of Isaac which he had sent to Jacob saw that Jacob would not then return with them to the land of Canaan to his father, they then went away from him, and they returned home to the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And when the servants of Isaac which he had sent to Jacob saw that Jacob would not then return with them to the land of Canaan to his father, they then went away from him, and they returned home to the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Deborah remained with Jacob in Haran, and she did not return with the servants of Isaac to the land of Canaan, and Deborah resided with Jacob’s wives and children in Haran.
verses.text: And Deborah remained with Jacob in Haran, and she did not return with the servants of Isaac to the land of Canaan, and Deborah resided with Jacob’s wives and children in Haran.

verses.raw: And Jacob served Laban six years longer, and when the sheep brought forth, Jacob removed from them such as were speckled and spotted, as he had determined with Laban, and Jacob did so at Laban’s for six years, and the man increased abundantly and he had cattle and maid servants and men servants, camels, and asses.
verses.text: And Jacob served Laban six years longer, and when the sheep brought forth, Jacob removed from them such as were speckled and spotted, as he had determined with Laban, and Jacob did so at Laban’s for six years, and the man increased abundantly and he had cattle and maid servants and men servants, camels, and asses.

verses.raw: And Jacob had two hundred drove of cattle, and his cattle were of large size and of beautiful appearance and were very productive, and all the families of the sons of men desired to get some of the cattle of Jacob, for they were exceedingly prosperous.
verses.text: And Jacob had two hundred drove of cattle, and his cattle were of large size and of beautiful appearance and were very productive, and all the families of the sons of men desired to get some of the cattle of Jacob, for they were exceedingly prosperous.

verses.raw: And many of the sons of men came to procure some of Jacob’s flock, and Jacob gave them a sheep for a man servant or a maid servant or for an ass or a camel, or whatever Jacob desired from them they gave him.
verses.text: And many of the sons of men came to procure some of Jacob’s flock, and Jacob gave them a sheep for a man servant or a maid servant or for an ass or a camel, or whatever Jacob desired from them they gave him.

verses.raw: And Jacob obtained riches and honor and possessions by means of these transactions with the sons of men, and the children of Laban envied him of this honor.
verses.text: And Jacob obtained riches and honor and possessions by means of these transactions with the sons of men, and the children of Laban envied him of this honor.

verses.raw: And in the course of time he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s, and of that which was our father’s has he acquired all this glory.
