verses.text: And in the course of time he heard the words of Laban’s sons, saying, Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s, and of that which was our father’s has he acquired all this glory.

verses.raw: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban and of his children, and behold it was not toward him in those days as it had been before.
verses.text: And Jacob beheld the countenance of Laban and of his children, and behold it was not toward him in those days as it had been before.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Jacob at the expiration of the six years, and said to him, Arise, go forth out of this land, and return to the land of your birthplace and I will be with you.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to Jacob at the expiration of the six years, and said to him, Arise, go forth out of this land, and return to the land of your birthplace and I will be with you.

verses.raw: And Jacob rose up at that time and he mounted his children and wives and all belonging to him upon camels, and he went forth to go to the land of Canaan to his father Isaac.
verses.text: And Jacob rose up at that time and he mounted his children and wives and all belonging to him upon camels, and he went forth to go to the land of Canaan to his father Isaac.

verses.raw: And Laban did not know that Jacob had gone from him, for Laban had been that day sheep-shearing.
verses.text: And Laban did not know that Jacob had gone from him, for Laban had been that day sheep-shearing.

verses.raw: And Rachel stole her father’s images, and she took them and she concealed them upon the camel upon which she sat, and she went on.
verses.text: And Rachel stole her father’s images, and she took them and she concealed them upon the camel upon which she sat, and she went on.

verses.raw: And this is the manner of the images; in taking a man who is the first born and slaying him and taking the hair off his head, and taking salt and salting the head and anointing it in oil, then taking a small tablet of copper or a tablet of gold and writing the name upon it, and placing the tablet under his tongue, and taking the head with the tablet under the tongue and putting it in the house, and lighting up lights before it and bowing down to it.
verses.text: And this is the manner of the images; in taking a man who is the first born and slaying him and taking the hair off his head, and taking salt and salting the head and anointing it in oil, then taking a small tablet of copper or a tablet of gold and writing the name upon it, and placing the tablet under his tongue, and taking the head with the tablet under the tongue and putting it in the house, and lighting up lights before it and bowing down to it.

verses.raw: And at the time when they bow down to it, it speaks to them in all matters that they ask of it, through the power of the name which is written in it.
verses.text: And at the time when they bow down to it, it speaks to them in all matters that they ask of it, through the power of the name which is written in it.

verses.raw: And some make them in the figures of men, of gold and silver, and go to them in times known to them, and the figures receive the influence of the stars, and tell them future things, and in this manner were the images which Rachel stole from her father.
verses.text: And some make them in the figures of men, of gold and silver, and go to them in times known to them, and the figures receive the influence of the stars, and tell them future things, and in this manner were the images which Rachel stole from her father.

verses.raw: And Rachel stole these images which were her father’s, in order that Laban might not know through them where Jacob had gone.
verses.text: And Rachel stole these images which were her father’s, in order that Laban might not know through them where Jacob had gone.

verses.raw: And Laban came home and he asked concerning Jacob and his household, and he was not to be found, and Laban sought his images to know where Jacob had gone, and could not find them, and he went to some other images, and he inquired of them and they told him that Jacob had fled from him to his father’s, to the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And Laban came home and he asked concerning Jacob and his household, and he was not to be found, and Laban sought his images to know where Jacob had gone, and could not find them, and he went to some other images, and he inquired of them and they told him that Jacob had fled from him to his father’s, to the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Laban then rose up and he took his brothers and all his servants, and he went forth and pursued Jacob, and he overtook him in mount Gilead.
verses.text: And Laban then rose up and he took his brothers and all his servants, and he went forth and pursued Jacob, and he overtook him in mount Gilead.

verses.raw: And Laban said to Jacob, What is this you have done to me to flee and deceive me, and lead my daughters and their children as captives taken by the sword?
verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob, What is this you have done to me to flee and deceive me, and lead my daughters and their children as captives taken by the sword?

verses.raw: And you did not suffer me to kiss them and send them away with joy, and you did steal my gods and did go away.
verses.text: And you did not suffer me to kiss them and send them away with joy, and you did steal my gods and did go away.

verses.raw: And Jacob answered Laban, saying, Because I was afraid lest you would take your daughters by force from me; and now with whomsoever you find your gods he shall die.
verses.text: And Jacob answered Laban, saying, Because I was afraid lest you would take your daughters by force from me; and now with whomsoever you find your gods he shall die.

verses.raw: And Laban searched for the images and he examined in all Jacob’s tents and furniture, but could not find them.
verses.text: And Laban searched for the images and he examined in all Jacob’s tents and furniture, but could not find them.

verses.raw: And Laban said to Jacob, We will make a covenant together and it shall be a testimony between me and you; if you shall afflict my daughters, or shall take other wives besides my daughters, even Elohim shall be a witness between me and you in this matter.
verses.text: And Laban said to Jacob, We will make a covenant together and it shall be a testimony between me and you; if you shall afflict my daughters, or shall take other wives besides my daughters, even Elohim shall be a witness between me and you in this matter.

verses.raw: And they took stones and made a heap, and Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and you, therefore he called the name of it Gilead.
verses.text: And they took stones and made a heap, and Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and you, therefore he called the name of it Gilead.

verses.raw: And Jacob and Laban offered sacrifice upon the mount, and they ate there by the heap, and they tarried in the mount all night, and Laban rose up early in the morning, and he wept with his daughters and he kissed them, and he returned to his place.
verses.text: And Jacob and Laban offered sacrifice upon the mount, and they ate there by the heap, and they tarried in the mount all night, and Laban rose up early in the morning, and he wept with his daughters and he kissed them, and he returned to his place.

verses.raw: And he hastened and sent off his son Beor, who was seventeen years old, with Abichorof the son of Uz, the son of Nahor, and with them were ten men.
verses.text: And he hastened and sent off his son Beor, who was seventeen years old, with Abichorof the son of Uz, the son of Nahor, and with them were ten men.

verses.raw: And they hastened and went and passed on the road before Jacob, and they came by another road to the land of Seir.
verses.text: And they hastened and went and passed on the road before Jacob, and they came by another road to the land of Seir.

verses.raw: And they came to Esau and said to him, Thus says your brother and relative, your mother’s brother Laban, the son of Bethuel, saying,
verses.text: And they came to Esau and said to him, Thus says your brother and relative, your mother’s brother Laban, the son of Bethuel, saying,

verses.raw: Have you heard what Jacob your brother has done to me, who first came to me naked and bare, and I went to meet him, and brought him to my house with honor, and I made him great, and I gave him my two daughters for wives and also two of my maids.
verses.text: Have you heard what Jacob your brother has done to me, who first came to me naked and bare, and I went to meet him, and brought him to my house with honor, and I made him great, and I gave him my two daughters for wives and also two of my maids.

verses.raw: And Elohim blessed him on my account, and he increased abundantly, and had sons, daughters and maid servants.
verses.text: And Elohim blessed him on my account, and he increased abundantly, and had sons, daughters and maid servants.

verses.raw: He has also an immense stock of flocks and herds, camels and asses, also silver and gold in abundance; and when he saw that his wealth increased, he left me whilst I went to shear my sheep, and he rose up and fled in secrecy.
verses.text: He has also an immense stock of flocks and herds, camels and asses, also silver and gold in abundance; and when he saw that his wealth increased, he left me whilst I went to shear my sheep, and he rose up and fled in secrecy.

verses.raw: And he lifted his wives and children upon camels, and he led away all his cattle and property which he acquired in my land, and he lifted up his countenance to go to his father Isaac, to the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And he lifted his wives and children upon camels, and he led away all his cattle and property which he acquired in my land, and he lifted up his countenance to go to his father Isaac, to the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And he did not suffer me to kiss my daughters and their children, and he led my daughters as captives taken by the sword, and he also stole my gods and he fled.
verses.text: And he did not suffer me to kiss my daughters and their children, and he led my daughters as captives taken by the sword, and he also stole my gods and he fled.

verses.raw: And now I have left him in the mountain of the brook of Jabuk, him and all belonging to him; he lacks nothing.
verses.text: And now I have left him in the mountain of the brook of Jabuk, him and all belonging to him; he lacks nothing.

verses.raw: If it be your wish to go to him, go then and there will you find him, and you can do to him as your soul desires; and Laban’s messengers came and told Esau all these things.
verses.text: If it be your wish to go to him, go then and there will you find him, and you can do to him as your soul desires; and Laban’s messengers came and told Esau all these things.

verses.raw: And Esau heard all the words of Laban’s messengers, and his anger was greatly kindled against Jacob, and he remembered his hatred, and his anger burned within him.
verses.text: And Esau heard all the words of Laban’s messengers, and his anger was greatly kindled against Jacob, and he remembered his hatred, and his anger burned within him.

verses.raw: And Esau hastened and took his children and servants and the souls of his household, being sixty men, and he went and assembled all the children of Seir the Horite and their people, being three hundred and forty men, and took all this number of four hundred men with drawn swords, and he went to Jacob to smite him.
verses.text: And Esau hastened and took his children and servants and the souls of his household, being sixty men, and he went and assembled all the children of Seir the Horite and their people, being three hundred and forty men, and took all this number of four hundred men with drawn swords, and he went to Jacob to smite him.

verses.raw: And Esau divided this number into several parts, and he took the sixty men of his children and servants and the souls of his household as one head, and gave them in care of Eliphaz his eldest son.
verses.text: And Esau divided this number into several parts, and he took the sixty men of his children and servants and the souls of his household as one head, and gave them in care of Eliphaz his eldest son.

verses.raw: And the remaining heads he gave to the care of the six sons of Seir the Horite, and he placed every man over his generations and children.
verses.text: And the remaining heads he gave to the care of the six sons of Seir the Horite, and he placed every man over his generations and children.

verses.raw: And the whole of this camp went as it was, and Esau went amongst them toward Jacob, and he conducted them with speed.
verses.text: And the whole of this camp went as it was, and Esau went amongst them toward Jacob, and he conducted them with speed.

verses.raw: And Laban’s messengers departed from Esau and went to the land of Canaan, and they came to the house of Rebecca the mother of Jacob and Esau.
verses.text: And Laban’s messengers departed from Esau and went to the land of Canaan, and they came to the house of Rebecca the mother of Jacob and Esau.

verses.raw: And they told her saying, Behold your son Esau has gone against his brother Jacob with four hundred men, for he heard that he was coming, and he is gone to make war with him, and to smite him and to take all that he has.
verses.text: And they told her saying, Behold your son Esau has gone against his brother Jacob with four hundred men, for he heard that he was coming, and he is gone to make war with him, and to smite him and to take all that he has.

verses.raw: And Rebecca hastened and sent seventy two men from the servants of Isaac to meet Jacob on the road; for she said, Peradventure, Esau may make war in the road when he meets him.
verses.text: And Rebecca hastened and sent seventy two men from the servants of Isaac to meet Jacob on the road; for she said, Peradventure, Esau may make war in the road when he meets him.

verses.raw: And these messengers went on the road to meet Jacob, and they met him in the road of the brook on the opposite side of the brook Jabuk, and Jacob said when he saw them, This camp is destined to me from Elohim, and Jacob called the name of that place Machnayim.
verses.text: And these messengers went on the road to meet Jacob, and they met him in the road of the brook on the opposite side of the brook Jabuk, and Jacob said when he saw them, This camp is destined to me from Elohim, and Jacob called the name of that place Machnayim.

verses.raw: And Jacob knew all his father’s people, and he kissed them and embraced them and came with them, and Jacob asked them concerning his father and mother, and they said, They were well.
verses.text: And Jacob knew all his father’s people, and he kissed them and embraced them and came with them, and Jacob asked them concerning his father and mother, and they said, They were well.

verses.raw: And these messengers said to Jacob, Rebecca your mother has sent us to you, saying, I have heard, my son, that your brother Esau has gone forth against you on the road with men from the children of Seir the Horite.
verses.text: And these messengers said to Jacob, Rebecca your mother has sent us to you, saying, I have heard, my son, that your brother Esau has gone forth against you on the road with men from the children of Seir the Horite.

verses.raw: And therefore, my son, hearken to my voice and see with your counsel what you will do, and when he comes up to you, supplicate him, and do not speak rashly to him, and give him a present from what you possess, and from what Elohim has favored you with.
verses.text: And therefore, my son, hearken to my voice and see with your counsel what you will do, and when he comes up to you, supplicate him, and do not speak rashly to him, and give him a present from what you possess, and from what Elohim has favored you with.

verses.raw: And when he asks you concerning your affairs, conceal nothing from him, perhaps he may turn from his anger against you and you will thereby save your soul, you and all belonging to you, for it is your duty to honor him, for he is your elder brother.
verses.text: And when he asks you concerning your affairs, conceal nothing from him, perhaps he may turn from his anger against you and you will thereby save your soul, you and all belonging to you, for it is your duty to honor him, for he is your elder brother.

verses.raw: And when Jacob heard the words of his mother which the messengers had spoken to him, Jacob lifted up his voice and wept bitterly, and did as his mother then commanded him.
verses.text: And when Jacob heard the words of his mother which the messengers had spoken to him, Jacob lifted up his voice and wept bitterly, and did as his mother then commanded him.

verses.raw: And at that time Jacob sent messengers to his brother Esau toward the land of Seir, and he spoke to him words of supplication.
verses.text: And at that time Jacob sent messengers to his brother Esau toward the land of Seir, and he spoke to him words of supplication.

verses.raw: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall you say to my Lord, to Esau, Thus says your servant Jacob, Let not my Lord imagine that my father’s blessing with which he did bless me has proved beneficial to me.
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, Thus shall you say to my Lord, to Esau, Thus says your servant Jacob, Let not my Lord imagine that my father’s blessing with which he did bless me has proved beneficial to me.

verses.raw: For I have been these twenty years with Laban, and he deceived me and changed my wages ten times, as it has all been already told to my Lord.
verses.text: For I have been these twenty years with Laban, and he deceived me and changed my wages ten times, as it has all been already told to my Lord.

verses.raw: And I served him in his house very laboriously, and Elohim (God) afterward saw my affliction, my labor and the work of my hands, and he caused me to find grace and favor in his sight.
verses.text: And I served him in his house very laboriously, and Elohim afterward saw my affliction, my labor and the work of my hands, and he caused me to find grace and favor in his sight.

verses.raw: And I afterward through Elohim’s great mercy and kindness acquired oxen and asses and cattle, and men servants and maid servants.
verses.text: And I afterward through Elohim’s great mercy and kindness acquired oxen and asses and cattle, and men servants and maid servants.

verses.raw: And now I am coming to my land and my home to my father and mother, who are in the land of Canaan; and I have sent to let my Lord know all this in order to find favor in the sight of my Lord, so that he may not imagine that I have of myself obtained wealth, or that the blessing with which my father blessed me has benefited me.
verses.text: And now I am coming to my land and my home to my father and mother, who are in the land of Canaan; and I have sent to let my Lord know all this in order to find favor in the sight of my Lord, so that he may not imagine that I have of myself obtained wealth, or that the blessing with which my father blessed me has benefited me.

verses.raw: And those messengers went to Esau, and found him on the borders of the land of Edom going toward Jacob, and four hundred men of the children of Seir the Horite were standing with drawn swords.
verses.text: And those messengers went to Esau, and found him on the borders of the land of Edom going toward Jacob, and four hundred men of the children of Seir the Horite were standing with drawn swords.

verses.raw: And the messengers of Jacob told Esau all the words that Jacob had spoken to them concerning Esau.
verses.text: And the messengers of Jacob told Esau all the words that Jacob had spoken to them concerning Esau.

verses.raw: And Esau answered them with pride and contempt, and said to them, Surely I have heard and truly it has been told to me what Jacob has done to Laban, who exalted him in his house and gave him his daughters for wives, and he begat sons and daughters, and abundantly increased in wealth and riches in Laban’s house through his means.
verses.text: And Esau answered them with pride and contempt, and said to them, Surely I have heard and truly it has been told to me what Jacob has done to Laban, who exalted him in his house and gave him his daughters for wives, and he begat sons and daughters, and abundantly increased in wealth and riches in Laban’s house through his means.

verses.raw: And when he saw that his wealth was abundant and his riches great he fled with all belonging to him, from Laban’s house, and he led Laban’s daughters away from the face of their father, as captives taken by the sword without telling him of it.
verses.text: And when he saw that his wealth was abundant and his riches great he fled with all belonging to him, from Laban’s house, and he led Laban’s daughters away from the face of their father, as captives taken by the sword without telling him of it.

verses.raw: And not only to Laban has Jacob done thus but also to me has he done so and has twice supplanted me, and shall I be silent?
verses.text: And not only to Laban has Jacob done thus but also to me has he done so and has twice supplanted me, and shall I be silent?

verses.raw: Now therefore I have this day come with my camps to meet him, and I will do to him according to the desire of my heart.
verses.text: Now therefore I have this day come with my camps to meet him, and I will do to him according to the desire of my heart.

verses.raw: And the messengers returned and came to Jacob and said to him, We came to your brother, to Esau, and we told him all your words, and thus has he answered us, and behold he comes to meet you with four hundred men.
verses.text: And the messengers returned and came to Jacob and said to him, We came to your brother, to Esau, and we told him all your words, and thus has he answered us, and behold he comes to meet you with four hundred men.

verses.raw: Now then know and see what you shall do, and pray before Elohim to deliver you from him.
verses.text: Now then know and see what you shall do, and pray before Elohim to deliver you from him.

verses.raw: And when he heard the words of his brother which he had spoken to the messengers of Jacob, Jacob was greatly afraid and he was distressed.
verses.text: And when he heard the words of his brother which he had spoken to the messengers of Jacob, Jacob was greatly afraid and he was distressed.

verses.raw: And Jacob prayed to Yahuah his Elohim (the Lord his God), and he said, O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac, you did say to me when I went away from my father’s house, saying,
verses.text: And Jacob prayed to Yahuah his Elohim, and he said, O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac, you did say to me when I went away from my father’s house, saying,

verses.raw: I am Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of your father Abraham and the Elohim of Isaac, to you do I give this land and your seed after you, and I will make your seed as the stars of heaven, and you shall spread forth to the four sides of heaven, and in you and in your seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.
verses.text: I am Yahuah Elohim of your father Abraham and the Elohim of Isaac, to you do I give this land and your seed after you, and I will make your seed as the stars of heaven, and you shall spread forth to the four sides of heaven, and in you and in your seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed.

verses.raw: And you did establish your words, and did give to me riches and children and cattle, as the utmost wishes of my heart did you give to your servant; you did give to me all that I asked from you, so that I lacked nothing.
verses.text: And you did establish your words, and did give to me riches and children and cattle, as the utmost wishes of my heart did you give to your servant; you did give to me all that I asked from you, so that I lacked nothing.

verses.raw: And you did afterward say to me, Return to your parents and to your birth place and I will still do well with you.
verses.text: And you did afterward say to me, Return to your parents and to your birth place and I will still do well with you.

verses.raw: And now that I have come, and you did deliver me from Laban, I shall fall in the hands of Esau who will slay me, yea, together with the mothers of my children.
verses.text: And now that I have come, and you did deliver me from Laban, I shall fall in the hands of Esau who will slay me, yea, together with the mothers of my children.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O Yahuah Elohim, deliver me, I pray you, also from the hands of my brother Esau, for I am greatly afraid of him.
verses.text: Now therefore, O Yahuah Elohim, deliver me, I pray you, also from the hands of my brother Esau, for I am greatly afraid of him.

verses.raw: And if there is no righteousness in me, do it for the sake of Abraham and my father Isaac.
verses.text: And if there is no righteousness in me, do it for the sake of Abraham and my father Isaac.

verses.raw: For I know that through kindness and mercy have I acquired this wealth; now therefore I beseech you to deliver me this day with your kindness and to answer me.
verses.text: For I know that through kindness and mercy have I acquired this wealth; now therefore I beseech you to deliver me this day with your kindness and to answer me.

verses.raw: And Jacob ceased praying to Yahuah (the Lord), and he divided the people that were with him with the flocks and cattle into two camps, and he gave the half to the care of Damesek, the son of Eliezer, Abraham’s servant, for a camp, with his children, and the other half he gave to the care of his brother Elianus the son of Eliezer, to be for a camp with his children.
verses.text: And Jacob ceased praying to Yahuah (the Lord), and he divided the people that were with him with the flocks and cattle into two camps, and he gave the half to the care of Damesek, the son of Eliezer, Abraham’s servant, for a camp, with his children, and the other half he gave to the care of his brother Elianus the son of Eliezer, to be for a camp with his children.

verses.raw: And he commanded them, saying, Keep yourselves at a distance with your camps, and do not come too near each other, and if Esau come to one camp and slay it, the other camp at a distance from it will escape him.
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, Keep yourselves at a distance with your camps, and do not come too near each other, and if Esau come to one camp and slay it, the other camp at a distance from it will escape him.

verses.raw: And Jacob tarried there that night, and during the whole night he gave his servants instructions concerning the forces and his children.
verses.text: And Jacob tarried there that night, and during the whole night he gave his servants instructions concerning the forces and his children.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) heard the prayer of Jacob on that day, and Yahuah (the Lord) then delivered Jacob from the hands of his brother Esau.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) heard the prayer of Jacob on that day, and Yahuah (the Lord) then delivered Jacob from the hands of his brother Esau.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) sent three angels of the angels of heaven, and they went before Esau and came to him.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) sent three angels of the angels of heaven, and they went before Esau and came to him.

verses.raw: And these angels appeared to Esau and his people as two thousand men, riding upon horses furnished with all sorts of war instruments, and they appeared in the sight of Esau and all his men to be divided into four camps, with four chiefs to them.
verses.text: And these angels appeared to Esau and his people as two thousand men, riding upon horses furnished with all sorts of war instruments, and they appeared in the sight of Esau and all his men to be divided into four camps, with four chiefs to them.

verses.raw: And one camp went on and they found Esau coming with four hundred men toward his brother Jacob, and this camp ran toward Esau and his people and terrified them, and Esau fell off the horse in alarm, and all his men separated from him in that place, for they were greatly afraid.
verses.text: And one camp went on and they found Esau coming with four hundred men toward his brother Jacob, and this camp ran toward Esau and his people and terrified them, and Esau fell off the horse in alarm, and all his men separated from him in that place, for they were greatly afraid.

verses.raw: And the whole of the camp shouted after them when they fled from Esau, and all the warlike men answered, saying,
verses.text: And the whole of the camp shouted after them when they fled from Esau, and all the warlike men answered, saying,

verses.raw: Surely we are the servants of Jacob, who is the servant of Elohim, and who then can stand against us? And Esau said to them, O then, my Lord and brother Jacob is your Lord, whom I have not seen for these twenty years, and now that I have this day come to see him, do you treat me in this manner?
verses.text: Surely we are the servants of Jacob, who is the servant of Elohim, and who then can stand against us? And Esau said to them, O then, my Lord and brother Jacob is your Lord, whom I have not seen for these twenty years, and now that I have this day come to see him, do you treat me in this manner?

verses.raw: And the angels answered him saying, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives, were not Jacob of whom you speaks your brother, we had not let one remaining from you and your people, but only on account of Jacob we will do nothing to them.
verses.text: And the angels answered him saying, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives, were not Jacob of whom you speaks your brother, we had not let one remaining from you and your people, but only on account of Jacob we will do nothing to them.

verses.raw: And this camp passed from Esau and his men and it went away, and Esau and his men had gone from them about a league when the second camp came toward him with all sorts of weapons, and they also did to Esau and his men as the first camp had done to them.
verses.text: And this camp passed from Esau and his men and it went away, and Esau and his men had gone from them about a league when the second camp came toward him with all sorts of weapons, and they also did to Esau and his men as the first camp had done to them.

verses.raw: And when they had left it to go on, behold the third camp came toward him and they were all terrified, and Esau fell off the horse, and the whole camp cried out, and said, Surely we are the servants of Jacob, who is the servant of Elohim, and who can stand against us?
verses.text: And when they had left it to go on, behold the third camp came toward him and they were all terrified, and Esau fell off the horse, and the whole camp cried out, and said, Surely we are the servants of Jacob, who is the servant of Elohim, and who can stand against us?

verses.raw: And Esau again answered them saying, O then, Jacob my Lord and your Lord is my brother, and for twenty years I have not seen his countenance and hearing this day that he was coming, I went this day to meet him, and do you treat me in this manner?
verses.text: And Esau again answered them saying, O then, Jacob my Lord and your Lord is my brother, and for twenty years I have not seen his countenance and hearing this day that he was coming, I went this day to meet him, and do you treat me in this manner?

verses.raw: And they answered him, and said to him, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives, were not Jacob your brother as you did say, we had not left a remnant from you and your men, but on account of Jacob of whom you speak being your brother, we will not meddle with you or your men.
verses.text: And they answered him, and said to him, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives, were not Jacob your brother as you did say, we had not left a remnant from you and your men, but on account of Jacob of whom you speak being your brother, we will not meddle with you or your men.

verses.raw: And the third camp also passed from them, and he still continued his road with his men toward Jacob, when the fourth camp came toward him, and they also did to him and his men as the others had done.
verses.text: And the third camp also passed from them, and he still continued his road with his men toward Jacob, when the fourth camp came toward him, and they also did to him and his men as the others had done.

verses.raw: And when Esau beheld the evil which the four angels had done to him and to his men, he became greatly afraid of his brother Jacob, and he went to meet him in peace.
verses.text: And when Esau beheld the evil which the four angels had done to him and to his men, he became greatly afraid of his brother Jacob, and he went to meet him in peace.

verses.raw: And Esau concealed his hatred against Jacob, because he was afraid of his life on account of his brother Jacob, and because he imagined that the four camps that he had lighted upon were Jacob’s servants.
verses.text: And Esau concealed his hatred against Jacob, because he was afraid of his life on account of his brother Jacob, and because he imagined that the four camps that he had lighted upon were Jacob’s servants.

verses.raw: And Jacob tarried that night with his servants in their camps, and he resolved with his servants to give to Esau a present from all that he had with him, and from all his property; and Jacob rose up in the morning, he and his men, and they chose from amongst the cattle a present for Esau.
verses.text: And Jacob tarried that night with his servants in their camps, and he resolved with his servants to give to Esau a present from all that he had with him, and from all his property; and Jacob rose up in the morning, he and his men, and they chose from amongst the cattle a present for Esau.

verses.raw: And this is the amount of the present which Jacob chose from his flock to give to his brother Esau: and he selected two hundred and forty head from the flocks, and he selected from the camels and asses thirty each, and of the herds he chose fifty kine.
verses.text: And this is the amount of the present which Jacob chose from his flock to give to his brother Esau: and he selected two hundred and forty head from the flocks, and he selected from the camels and asses thirty each, and of the herds he chose fifty kine.

verses.raw: And he put them all in ten droves, and he placed each sort by itself, and he delivered them into the hands of ten of his servants, each drove by itself.
verses.text: And he put them all in ten droves, and he placed each sort by itself, and he delivered them into the hands of ten of his servants, each drove by itself.

verses.raw: And he commanded them, and said to them, Keep yourselves at a distance from each other, and put a space between the droves, and when Esau and those who are with him shall meet you and ask you, saying, Whose are you, and whither do you go, and to whom belongs all this before you, you shall say to them, We are the servants of Jacob, and we come to meet Esau in peace, and behold Jacob comes behind us.
verses.text: And he commanded them, and said to them, Keep yourselves at a distance from each other, and put a space between the droves, and when Esau and those who are with him shall meet you and ask you, saying, Whose are you, and whither do you go, and to whom belongs all this before you, you shall say to them, We are the servants of Jacob, and we come to meet Esau in peace, and behold Jacob comes behind us.

verses.raw: And that which is before us is a present sent from Jacob to his brother Esau.
verses.text: And that which is before us is a present sent from Jacob to his brother Esau.

verses.raw: And if they shall say to you, Why does he delay behind you, from coming to meet his brother and to see his face, then you shall say to them, Surely he comes joyfully behind us to meet his brother, for he said, I will appease him with the present that goes to him, and after this I will see his face, peradventure he will accept of me.
verses.text: And if they shall say to you, Why does he delay behind you, from coming to meet his brother and to see his face, then you shall say to them, Surely he comes joyfully behind us to meet his brother, for he said, I will appease him with the present that goes to him, and after this I will see his face, peradventure he will accept of me.

verses.raw: So the whole present passed on in the hands of his servants, and went before him on that day, and he lodged that night with his camps by the border of the brook of Jabuk, and he rose up in the midst of the night, and he took his wives and his maid servants, and all belonging to him, and he that night passed them over the ford Jabuk.
verses.text: So the whole present passed on in the hands of his servants, and went before him on that day, and he lodged that night with his camps by the border of the brook of Jabuk, and he rose up in the midst of the night, and he took his wives and his maid servants, and all belonging to him, and he that night passed them over the ford Jabuk.

verses.raw: And when he passed all belonging to him over the brook, Jacob was left by himself, and a man met him, and he wrestled with him that night until the breaking of the day, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint through wrestling with him.
verses.text: And when he passed all belonging to him over the brook, Jacob was left by himself, and a man met him, and he wrestled with him that night until the breaking of the day, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was out of joint through wrestling with him.

verses.raw: And at the break of day the man left Jacob there, and he blessed him and went away, and Jacob passed the brook at the break of day, and he halted upon his thigh.
verses.text: And at the break of day the man left Jacob there, and he blessed him and went away, and Jacob passed the brook at the break of day, and he halted upon his thigh.

verses.raw: And the sun rose upon him when he had passed the brook, and he came up to the place of his cattle and children.
verses.text: And the sun rose upon him when he had passed the brook, and he came up to the place of his cattle and children.

verses.raw: And they went on till midday, and whilst they were going the present was passing on before them.
verses.text: And they went on till midday, and whilst they were going the present was passing on before them.

verses.raw: And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold Esau was at a distance, coming along with many men, about four hundred, and Jacob was greatly afraid of his brother.
verses.text: And Jacob lifted up his eyes and looked, and behold Esau was at a distance, coming along with many men, about four hundred, and Jacob was greatly afraid of his brother.

verses.raw: And Jacob hastened and divided his children to his wives and his handmaids, and his daughter Dinah he put in a chest, and delivered her into the hands of his servants.
verses.text: And Jacob hastened and divided his children to his wives and his handmaids, and his daughter Dinah he put in a chest, and delivered her into the hands of his servants.

verses.raw: And he passed before his children and wives to meet his brother, and he bowed down to the ground, yea he bowed down seven times until he approached his brother, and Elohim caused Jacob to find grace and favor in the sight of Esau and his men, for Elohim had heard the prayer of Jacob.
verses.text: And he passed before his children and wives to meet his brother, and he bowed down to the ground, yea he bowed down seven times until he approached his brother, and Elohim caused Jacob to find grace and favor in the sight of Esau and his men, for Elohim had heard the prayer of Jacob.

verses.raw: And the fear of Jacob and his terror fell upon his brother Esau, for Esau was greatly afraid of Jacob for what the angels of Elohim had done to Esau, and Esau’s anger against Jacob was turned into kindness.
verses.text: And the fear of Jacob and his terror fell upon his brother Esau, for Esau was greatly afraid of Jacob for what the angels of Elohim had done to Esau, and Esau’s anger against Jacob was turned into kindness.

verses.raw: And when Esau saw Jacob running toward him, he also ran toward him and he embraced him, and he fell upon his neck, and they kissed and they wept.
verses.text: And when Esau saw Jacob running toward him, he also ran toward him and he embraced him, and he fell upon his neck, and they kissed and they wept.

verses.raw: And Elohim put fear and kindness toward Jacob in the hearts of the men that came with Esau, and they also kissed Jacob and embraced him.
verses.text: And Elohim put fear and kindness toward Jacob in the hearts of the men that came with Esau, and they also kissed Jacob and embraced him.

verses.raw: And also Eliphaz, the son of Esau, with his four brothers, sons of Esau, wept with Jacob, and they kissed him and embraced him, for the fear of Jacob had fallen upon them all.
verses.text: And also Eliphaz, the son of Esau, with his four brothers, sons of Esau, wept with Jacob, and they kissed him and embraced him, for the fear of Jacob had fallen upon them all.

verses.raw: And Esau lifted up his eyes and saw the women with their offspring, the children of Jacob, walking behind Jacob and bowing along the road to Esau.
verses.text: And Esau lifted up his eyes and saw the women with their offspring, the children of Jacob, walking behind Jacob and bowing along the road to Esau.

verses.raw: And Esau said to Jacob, Who are these with you, my brother? are they your children or your servants? and Jacob answered Esau and said, They are my children which Elohim has graciously given to your servant.
verses.text: And Esau said to Jacob, Who are these with you, my brother? are they your children or your servants? and Jacob answered Esau and said, They are my children which Elohim has graciously given to your servant.

verses.raw: And whilst Jacob was speaking to Esau and his men, Esau beheld the whole camp, and he said to Jacob, Whence did you get the whole of the camp that I met yesternight? and Jacob said, To find favor in the sight of my Lord, it is that which Elohim graciously gave to your servant.
verses.text: And whilst Jacob was speaking to Esau and his men, Esau beheld the whole camp, and he said to Jacob, Whence did you get the whole of the camp that I met yesternight? and Jacob said, To find favor in the sight of my Lord, it is that which Elohim graciously gave to your servant.

verses.raw: And the present came before Esau, and Jacob pressed Esau, saying, Take I pray you the present that I have brought to my Lord, and Esau said, Therefore is this my purpose? keep that which you have to thyself.
verses.text: And the present came before Esau, and Jacob pressed Esau, saying, Take I pray you the present that I have brought to my Lord, and Esau said, Therefore is this my purpose? keep that which you have to thyself.

verses.raw: And Jacob said, It is incumbent upon me to give all this, since I have seen your face, that you still live in peace.
verses.text: And Jacob said, It is incumbent upon me to give all this, since I have seen your face, that you still live in peace.

verses.raw: And Esau refused to take the present, and Jacob said to him, I beseech you my Lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, for I have therefore seen your face, as though I had seen a god-like face, because you were pleased with me.
verses.text: And Esau refused to take the present, and Jacob said to him, I beseech you my Lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, for I have therefore seen your face, as though I had seen a god-like face, because you were pleased with me.

verses.raw: And Esau took the present, and Jacob also gave to Esau silver and gold and bdellium, for he pressed him so much that he took them.
verses.text: And Esau took the present, and Jacob also gave to Esau silver and gold and bdellium, for he pressed him so much that he took them.

verses.raw: And Esau divided the cattle that were in the camp, and he gave the half to the men who had come with him, for they had come on hire, and the other half he delivered to the hands of his children.
verses.text: And Esau divided the cattle that were in the camp, and he gave the half to the men who had come with him, for they had come on hire, and the other half he delivered to the hands of his children.

verses.raw: And the silver and gold and bdellium he gave in the hands of Eliphaz his eldest son, and Esau said to Jacob, Let us remain with you, and we will go slowly along with you until you come to my place with me, that we may dwell there together.
verses.text: And the silver and gold and bdellium he gave in the hands of Eliphaz his eldest son, and Esau said to Jacob, Let us remain with you, and we will go slowly along with you until you come to my place with me, that we may dwell there together.

verses.raw: And Jacob answered his brother and said, I would do as my Lord speaks to me, but my Lord knows that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with their young who are with me, go but slowly, for if they went swiftly they would all die, for you know their burdens and their fatigue.
verses.text: And Jacob answered his brother and said, I would do as my Lord speaks to me, but my Lord knows that the children are tender, and the flocks and herds with their young who are with me, go but slowly, for if they went swiftly they would all die, for you know their burdens and their fatigue.

verses.raw: Therefore let my Lord pass on before his servant, and I will go on slowly for the sake of the children and the flock, until I come to my Lord’s place to Seir.
verses.text: Therefore let my Lord pass on before his servant, and I will go on slowly for the sake of the children and the flock, until I come to my Lord’s place to Seir.

verses.raw: And Esau said to Jacob, I will place with you some of the people that are with me to take care of you in the road, and to bear your fatigue and burden, and he said, What needs it my Lord, if I may find grace in your sight?
verses.text: And Esau said to Jacob, I will place with you some of the people that are with me to take care of you in the road, and to bear your fatigue and burden, and he said, What needs it my Lord, if I may find grace in your sight?

verses.raw: Behold I will come to you to Seir to dwell there together as you have spoken, go you then with your people for I will follow you.
verses.text: Behold I will come to you to Seir to dwell there together as you have spoken, go you then with your people for I will follow you.

verses.raw: And Jacob said this to Esau in order to remove Esau and his men from him, so that Jacob might afterward go to his father’s house to the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And Jacob said this to Esau in order to remove Esau and his men from him, so that Jacob might afterward go to his father’s house to the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Esau hearkened to the voice of Jacob, and Esau returned with the four hundred men that were with him on their road to Seir, and Jacob and all belonging to him went that day as far as the extremity of the land of Canaan in its borders, and he remained there some time.
verses.text: And Esau hearkened to the voice of Jacob, and Esau returned with the four hundred men that were with him on their road to Seir, and Jacob and all belonging to him went that day as far as the extremity of the land of Canaan in its borders, and he remained there some time.

verses.raw: And in some time after Jacob went away from the borders of the land, and he came to the land of Shalem, that is the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, and he rested in front of the city.
verses.text: And in some time after Jacob went away from the borders of the land, and he came to the land of Shalem, that is the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, and he rested in front of the city.

verses.raw: And he bought a parcel of the field which was there, from the children of Hamor the people of the land, for five shekels.
verses.text: And he bought a parcel of the field which was there, from the children of Hamor the people of the land, for five shekels.

verses.raw: And Jacob there built himself a house, and he pitched his tent there, and he made booths for his cattle, therefore he called the name of that place Succoth.
verses.text: And Jacob there built himself a house, and he pitched his tent there, and he made booths for his cattle, therefore he called the name of that place Succoth.

verses.raw: And Jacob remained in Succoth a year and six months.
verses.text: And Jacob remained in Succoth a year and six months.

verses.raw: At that time some of the women of the inhabitants of the land went to the city of Shechem to dance and rejoice with the daughters of the people of the city, and when they went forth then Rachel and Leah the wives of Jacob with their families also went to behold the rejoicing of the daughters of the city.
verses.text: At that time some of the women of the inhabitants of the land went to the city of Shechem to dance and rejoice with the daughters of the people of the city, and when they went forth then Rachel and Leah the wives of Jacob with their families also went to behold the rejoicing of the daughters of the city.

verses.raw: And Dinah the daughter of Jacob also went along with them and saw the daughters of the city, and they remained there before these daughters whilst all the people of the city were standing by them to behold their rejoicings, and all the great people of the city were there.
verses.text: And Dinah the daughter of Jacob also went along with them and saw the daughters of the city, and they remained there before these daughters whilst all the people of the city were standing by them to behold their rejoicings, and all the great people of the city were there.

verses.raw: And Shechem the son of Hamor, the prince of the land was also standing there to see them.
verses.text: And Shechem the son of Hamor, the prince of the land was also standing there to see them.

verses.raw: And Shechem beheld Dinah the daughter of Jacob sitting with her mother before the daughters of the city, and the damsel pleased him greatly, and he there asked his friends and his people, saying, Whose daughter is that sitting amongst the women, whom I do not know in this city?
verses.text: And Shechem beheld Dinah the daughter of Jacob sitting with her mother before the daughters of the city, and the damsel pleased him greatly, and he there asked his friends and his people, saying, Whose daughter is that sitting amongst the women, whom I do not know in this city?

verses.raw: And they said to him, Surely this is the daughter of Jacob the son of Isaac the Hebrew, who has dwelt in this city for some time, and when it was reported that the daughters of the land were going forth to rejoice she went with her mother and maid servants to sit amongst them as you see.
verses.text: And they said to him, Surely this is the daughter of Jacob the son of Isaac the Hebrew, who has dwelt in this city for some time, and when it was reported that the daughters of the land were going forth to rejoice she went with her mother and maid servants to sit amongst them as you see.

verses.raw: And Shechem beheld Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and when he looked at her his soul became fixed upon Dinah.
verses.text: And Shechem beheld Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and when he looked at her his soul became fixed upon Dinah.

verses.raw: And he sent and had her taken by force, and Dinah came to the house of Shechem and he seized her forcibly and lay with her and humbled her, and he loved her exceedingly and placed her in his house.
verses.text: And he sent and had her taken by force, and Dinah came to the house of Shechem and he seized her forcibly and lay with her and humbled her, and he loved her exceedingly and placed her in his house.

verses.raw: And they came and told the thing to Jacob, and when Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter Dinah, Jacob sent twelve of his servants to fetch Dinah from the house of Shechem, and they went and came to the house of Shechem to take away Dinah from there.
verses.text: And they came and told the thing to Jacob, and when Jacob heard that Shechem had defiled his daughter Dinah, Jacob sent twelve of his servants to fetch Dinah from the house of Shechem, and they went and came to the house of Shechem to take away Dinah from there.

verses.raw: And when they came Shechem went out to them with his men and drove them from his house, and he would not suffer them to come before Dinah, but Shechem was sitting with Dinah kissing and embracing her before their eyes.
verses.text: And when they came Shechem went out to them with his men and drove them from his house, and he would not suffer them to come before Dinah, but Shechem was sitting with Dinah kissing and embracing her before their eyes.

verses.raw: And the servants of Jacob came back and told him, saying, When we came, he and his men drove us away, and thus did Shechem do to Dinah before our eyes.
verses.text: And the servants of Jacob came back and told him, saying, When we came, he and his men drove us away, and thus did Shechem do to Dinah before our eyes.

verses.raw: And Jacob knew moreover that Shechem had defiled his daughter, but he said nothing, and his sons were feeding his cattle in the field, and Jacob remained silent till their return.
verses.text: And Jacob knew moreover that Shechem had defiled his daughter, but he said nothing, and his sons were feeding his cattle in the field, and Jacob remained silent till their return.

verses.raw: And before his sons came home Jacob sent two maidens from his servants’ daughters to take care of Dinah in the house of Shechem, and to remain with her, and Shechem sent three of his friends to his father Hamor the son of Chiddekem, the son of Pered, saying, Get me this damsel for a wife.
verses.text: And before his sons came home Jacob sent two maidens from his servants’ daughters to take care of Dinah in the house of Shechem, and to remain with her, and Shechem sent three of his friends to his father Hamor the son of Chiddekem, the son of Pered, saying, Get me this damsel for a wife.

verses.raw: And Hamor the son of Chiddekem the Hivite came to the house of Shechem his son, and he sat before him, and Hamor said to his son, Shechem, Is there then no woman amongst the daughters of your people that you will take an Hebrew woman who is not of your people?
verses.text: And Hamor the son of Chiddekem the Hivite came to the house of Shechem his son, and he sat before him, and Hamor said to his son, Shechem, Is there then no woman amongst the daughters of your people that you will take an Hebrew woman who is not of your people?

verses.raw: And Shechem said to him, Her only must you get for me, for she is delightful in my sight; and Hamor did according to the word of his son, for he was greatly beloved by him.
verses.text: And Shechem said to him, Her only must you get for me, for she is delightful in my sight; and Hamor did according to the word of his son, for he was greatly beloved by him.

verses.raw: And Hamor went forth to Jacob to commune with him concerning this matter, and when he had gone from the house of his son Shechem, before he came to Jacob to speak to him, behold the sons of Jacob had come from the field, as soon as they heard the thing that Shechem the son of Hamor had done.
verses.text: And Hamor went forth to Jacob to commune with him concerning this matter, and when he had gone from the house of his son Shechem, before he came to Jacob to speak to him, behold the sons of Jacob had come from the field, as soon as they heard the thing that Shechem the son of Hamor had done.

verses.raw: And the men were very much grieved concerning their sister, and they all came home fired with anger, before the time of gathering in their cattle.
verses.text: And the men were very much grieved concerning their sister, and they all came home fired with anger, before the time of gathering in their cattle.

verses.raw: And they came and sat before their father and they spoke to him kindled with wrath, saying, Surely death is due to this man and to his household, because Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of the whole earth commanded Noah and his children that man shall never rob, nor commit adultery; now behold Shechem has both ravaged and committed fornication with our sister, and not one of all the people of the city spoke a word to him.
verses.text: And they came and sat before their father and they spoke to him kindled with wrath, saying, Surely death is due to this man and to his household, because Yahuah Elohim of the whole earth commanded Noah and his children that man shall never rob, nor commit adultery; now behold Shechem has both ravaged and committed fornication with our sister, and not one of all the people of the city spoke a word to him.

verses.raw: Surely you know and understand that the judgment of death is due to Shechem, and to his father, and to the whole city on account of the thing which he has done.
verses.text: Surely you know and understand that the judgment of death is due to Shechem, and to his father, and to the whole city on account of the thing which he has done.

verses.raw: And whilst they were speaking before their father in this matter, behold Hamor the father of Shechem came to speak to Jacob the words of his son concerning Dinah, and he sat before Jacob and before his sons.
verses.text: And whilst they were speaking before their father in this matter, behold Hamor the father of Shechem came to speak to Jacob the words of his son concerning Dinah, and he sat before Jacob and before his sons.

verses.raw: And Hamor spoke to them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter; I pray you give her to him for a wife and intermarry with us; give us your daughters and we will give you our daughters, and you shall dwell with us in our land and we will be as one people in the land.
verses.text: And Hamor spoke to them, saying, The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter; I pray you give her to him for a wife and intermarry with us; give us your daughters and we will give you our daughters, and you shall dwell with us in our land and we will be as one people in the land.

verses.raw: For our land is very extensive, so dwell you and trade in it and get possessions in it, and do in it as you desire, and no one shall prevent you by saying a word to you.
verses.text: For our land is very extensive, so dwell you and trade in it and get possessions in it, and do in it as you desire, and no one shall prevent you by saying a word to you.

verses.raw: And Hamor ceased speaking to Jacob and his sons, and behold Shechem his son had come after him, and he sat before them.
verses.text: And Hamor ceased speaking to Jacob and his sons, and behold Shechem his son had come after him, and he sat before them.

verses.raw: And Shechem spoke before Jacob and his sons, saying, May I find favor in your sight that you will give me your daughter, and whatever you say to me that will I do for her.
verses.text: And Shechem spoke before Jacob and his sons, saying, May I find favor in your sight that you will give me your daughter, and whatever you say to me that will I do for her.

verses.raw: Ask me for abundance of dowry and gift, and I will give it, and whatever you shall say to me that will I do, and whoever he be that will rebel against your orders, he shall die; only give me the damsel for a wife.
verses.text: Ask me for abundance of dowry and gift, and I will give it, and whatever you shall say to me that will I do, and whoever he be that will rebel against your orders, he shall die; only give me the damsel for a wife.

verses.raw: And Simeon and Levi answered Hamor and Shechem his son deceitfully, saying, All you have spoken to us we will do for you.
verses.text: And Simeon and Levi answered Hamor and Shechem his son deceitfully, saying, All you have spoken to us we will do for you.

verses.raw: And behold our sister is in your house, but keep away from her until we send to our father Isaac concerning this matter, for we can do nothing without his consent.
verses.text: And behold our sister is in your house, but keep away from her until we send to our father Isaac concerning this matter, for we can do nothing without his consent.

verses.raw: For he knows the ways of our father Abraham, and whatever he says to us we will tell you, we will conceal nothing from you.
verses.text: For he knows the ways of our father Abraham, and whatever he says to us we will tell you, we will conceal nothing from you.

verses.raw: And Simeon and Levi spoke this to Shechem and his father in order to find a pretext, and to seek counsel what was to be done to Shechem and to his city in this matter.
verses.text: And Simeon and Levi spoke this to Shechem and his father in order to find a pretext, and to seek counsel what was to be done to Shechem and to his city in this matter.

verses.raw: And when Shechem and his father heard the words of Simeon and Levi, it seemed good in their sight, and Shechem and his father came forth to go home.
verses.text: And when Shechem and his father heard the words of Simeon and Levi, it seemed good in their sight, and Shechem and his father came forth to go home.

verses.raw: And when they had gone, the sons of Jacob said to their father, saying, Behold, we know that death is due to these wicked ones and to their city, because they transgressed that which Elohim (God) had commanded to Noah and his children and his seed after them.
verses.text: And when they had gone, the sons of Jacob said to their father, saying, Behold, we know that death is due to these wicked ones and to their city, because they transgressed that which Elohim had commanded to Noah and his children and his seed after them.

verses.raw: And also because Shechem did this thing to our sister Dinah in defiling her, for such vileness shall never be done amongst us.
verses.text: And also because Shechem did this thing to our sister Dinah in defiling her, for such vileness shall never be done amongst us.

verses.raw: Now therefore know and see what you will do, and seek counsel and pretext what is to be done to them, in order to kill all the inhabitants of this city.
verses.text: Now therefore know and see what you will do, and seek counsel and pretext what is to be done to them, in order to kill all the inhabitants of this city.

verses.raw: And Simeon said to them, Here is a proper advice for you: tell them to circumcise every male amongst them as we are circumcised, and if they do not wish to do this, we shall take our daughter from them and go away.
verses.text: And Simeon said to them, Here is a proper advice for you: tell them to circumcise every male amongst them as we are circumcised, and if they do not wish to do this, we shall take our daughter from them and go away.

verses.raw: And if they consent to do this and will do it, then when they are sunk down with pain, we will attack them with our swords, as upon one who is quiet and peaceable, and we will slay every male person amongst them.
verses.text: And if they consent to do this and will do it, then when they are sunk down with pain, we will attack them with our swords, as upon one who is quiet and peaceable, and we will slay every male person amongst them.

verses.raw: And Simeon’s advice pleased them, and Simeon and Levi resolved to do to them as it was proposed.
verses.text: And Simeon’s advice pleased them, and Simeon and Levi resolved to do to them as it was proposed.

verses.raw: And on the next morning Shechem and Hamor his father came again to Jacob and his sons, to speak concerning Dinah, and to hear what answer the sons of Jacob would give to their words.
verses.text: And on the next morning Shechem and Hamor his father came again to Jacob and his sons, to speak concerning Dinah, and to hear what answer the sons of Jacob would give to their words.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob spoke deceitfully to them, saying, We told our father Isaac all your words, and your words pleased him.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob spoke deceitfully to them, saying, We told our father Isaac all your words, and your words pleased him.

verses.raw: But he spoke to us, saying, Thus did Abraham his father command him from Elohim Yahuah (the Lord) of the whole earth, that any man who is not of his descendants that should wish to take one of his daughters, shall cause every male belonging to him to be circumcised, as we are circumcised, and then we may give him our daughter for a wife.
verses.text: But he spoke to us, saying, Thus did Abraham his father command him from Elohim Yahuah (the Lord) of the whole earth, that any man who is not of his descendants that should wish to take one of his daughters, shall cause every male belonging to him to be circumcised, as we are circumcised, and then we may give him our daughter for a wife.

verses.raw: Now we have made known to you all our ways that our father spoke to us, for we cannot do this of which you spoke to us, to give our daughter to an uncircumcised man, for it is a disgrace to us.
verses.text: Now we have made known to you all our ways that our father spoke to us, for we cannot do this of which you spoke to us, to give our daughter to an uncircumcised man, for it is a disgrace to us.

verses.raw: But herein will we consent to you, to give you our daughter, and we will also take to ourselves your daughters, and will dwell amongst you and be one people as you have spoken, if you will hearken to us, and consent to be like us, to circumcise every male belonging to you, as we are circumcised.
verses.text: But herein will we consent to you, to give you our daughter, and we will also take to ourselves your daughters, and will dwell amongst you and be one people as you have spoken, if you will hearken to us, and consent to be like us, to circumcise every male belonging to you, as we are circumcised.

verses.raw: And if you will not hearken to us, to have every male circumcised as we are circumcised, as we have commanded, then we will come to you, and take our daughter from you and go away.
verses.text: And if you will not hearken to us, to have every male circumcised as we are circumcised, as we have commanded, then we will come to you, and take our daughter from you and go away.

verses.raw: And Shechem and his father Hamor heard the words of the sons of Jacob, and the thing pleased them exceedingly, and Shechem and his father Hamor hastened to do the wishes of the sons of Jacob, for Shechem was very fond of Dinah, and his soul was riveted to her.

verses.raw: And Shechem and his father Hamor hastened to the gate of the city, and they assembled all the men of their city and spoke to them the words of the sons of Jacob, saying,
verses.text: And Shechem and his father Hamor hastened to the gate of the city, and they assembled all the men of their city and spoke to them the words of the sons of Jacob, saying,

verses.raw: We came to these men, the sons of Jacob, and we spoke to them concerning their daughter, and these men will consent to do according to our wishes, and behold our land is of great extent for them, and they will dwell in it, and trade in it, and we shall be one people; we will take their daughters, and our daughters we will give to them for wives.
verses.text: We came to these men, the sons of Jacob, and we spoke to them concerning their daughter, and these men will consent to do according to our wishes, and behold our land is of great extent for them, and they will dwell in it, and trade in it, and we shall be one people; we will take their daughters, and our daughters we will give to them for wives.

verses.raw: But only on this condition will these men consent to do this thing, that every male amongst us be circumcised as they are circumcised, as their Elohim commanded them, and when we shall have done according to their instructions to be circumcised, then will they dwell amongst us, together with their cattle and possessions, and we shall be as one people with them.
verses.text: But only on this condition will these men consent to do this thing, that every male amongst us be circumcised as they are circumcised, as their Elohim commanded them, and when we shall have done according to their instructions to be circumcised, then will they dwell amongst us, together with their cattle and possessions, and we shall be as one people with them.

verses.raw: And when all the men of the city heard the words of Shechem and his father Hamor, then all the men of their city were agreeable to this proposal, and they obeyed to be circumcised, for Shechem and his father Hamor were greatly esteemed by them, being the princes of the land.
verses.text: And when all the men of the city heard the words of Shechem and his father Hamor, then all the men of their city were agreeable to this proposal, and they obeyed to be circumcised, for Shechem and his father Hamor were greatly esteemed by them, being the princes of the land.

verses.raw: And on the next day, Shechem and Hamor his father rose up early in the morning, and they assembled all the men of their city into the middle of the city, and they called for the sons of Jacob, who circumcised every male belonging to them on that day and the next.
verses.text: And on the next day, Shechem and Hamor his father rose up early in the morning, and they assembled all the men of their city into the middle of the city, and they called for the sons of Jacob, who circumcised every male belonging to them on that day and the next.

verses.raw: And they circumcised Shechem and Hamor his father, and the five brothers of Shechem, and then every one rose up and went home, for this thing was from Yahuah (the Lord) against the city of Shechem, and from Yahuah (the Lord) was Simeon’s counsel in this matter, in order that Yahuah (the Lord) might deliver the city of Shechem into the hands of Jacob’s two sons.
verses.text: And they circumcised Shechem and Hamor his father, and the five brothers of Shechem, and then every one rose up and went home, for this thing was from Yahuah (the Lord) against the city of Shechem, and from Yahuah (the Lord) was Simeon’s counsel in this matter, in order that Yahuah (the Lord) might deliver the city of Shechem into the hands of Jacob’s two sons.

verses.raw: And the number of all the males that were circumcised, were six hundred and forty-five men, and two hundred and forty-six children.
verses.text: And the number of all the males that were circumcised, were six hundred and forty-five men, and two hundred and forty-six children.

verses.raw: But Chiddekem, son of Pered, the father of Hamor, and his six brothers, would not listen to Shechem and his father Hamor, and they would not be circumcised, for the proposal of the sons of Jacob was loathsome in their sight, and their anger was greatly roused at this, that the people of the city had not hearkened to them.
verses.text: But Chiddekem, son of Pered, the father of Hamor, and his six brothers, would not listen to Shechem and his father Hamor, and they would not be circumcised, for the proposal of the sons of Jacob was loathsome in their sight, and their anger was greatly roused at this, that the people of the city had not hearkened to them.

verses.raw: And in the evening of the second day, they found eight small children who had not been circumcised, for their mothers had concealed them from Shechem and his father Hamor, and from the men of the city.
verses.text: And in the evening of the second day, they found eight small children who had not been circumcised, for their mothers had concealed them from Shechem and his father Hamor, and from the men of the city.

verses.raw: And Shechem and his father Hamor sent to have them brought before them to be circumcised, when Chiddekem and his six brothers sprang at them with their swords, and sought to slay them.
verses.text: And Shechem and his father Hamor sent to have them brought before them to be circumcised, when Chiddekem and his six brothers sprang at them with their swords, and sought to slay them.

verses.raw: And they sought to slay also Shechem and his father Hamor and they sought to slay Dinah with them on account of this matter.
verses.text: And they sought to slay also Shechem and his father Hamor and they sought to slay Dinah with them on account of this matter.

verses.raw: And they said to them, What is this thing that you have done? are there no women amongst the daughters of your brethren the Canaanites, that you wish to take to yourselves daughters of the Hebrews, whom you knew not before, and will do this act which your fathers never commanded you?
verses.text: And they said to them, What is this thing that you have done? are there no women amongst the daughters of your brethren the Canaanites, that you wish to take to yourselves daughters of the Hebrews, whom you knew not before, and will do this act which your fathers never commanded you?

verses.raw: Do you imagine that you will succeed through this act which you have done? and what will you answer in this affair to your brethren the Canaanites, who will come tomorrow and ask you concerning this thing?
verses.text: Do you imagine that you will succeed through this act which you have done? and what will you answer in this affair to your brethren the Canaanites, who will come tomorrow and ask you concerning this thing?

verses.raw: And if your act shall not appear just and good in their sight, what will you do for your lives, and me for our lives, in your not having hearkened to our voices?
verses.text: And if your act shall not appear just and good in their sight, what will you do for your lives, and me for our lives, in your not having hearkened to our voices?

verses.raw: And if the inhabitants of the land and all your brethren the children of Ham, shall hear of your act, saying,
verses.text: And if the inhabitants of the land and all your brethren the children of Ham, shall hear of your act, saying,

verses.raw: On account of a Hebrew woman did Shechem and Hamor his father, and all the inhabitants of their city, do that with which they had been unacquainted and which their ancestors never commanded them, where then will you fly or where conceal your shame, all your days before your brethren, the inhabitants of the land of Canaan?
verses.text: On account of a Hebrew woman did Shechem and Hamor his father, and all the inhabitants of their city, do that with which they had been unacquainted and which their ancestors never commanded them, where then will you fly or where conceal your shame, all your days before your brethren, the inhabitants of the land of Canaan?

verses.raw: Now therefore we cannot bear up against this thing which you have done, neither can we be burdened with this yoke upon us, which our ancestors did not command us.
verses.text: Now therefore we cannot bear up against this thing which you have done, neither can we be burdened with this yoke upon us, which our ancestors did not command us.

verses.raw: Behold tomorrow we will go and assemble all our brethren, the Canaanitish brethren who dwell in the land, and we will all come and smite you and all those who trust in you, that there shall not be a remnant left from you or them.
verses.text: Behold tomorrow we will go and assemble all our brethren, the Canaanitish brethren who dwell in the land, and we will all come and smite you and all those who trust in you, that there shall not be a remnant left from you or them.

verses.raw: And when Hamor and his son Shechem and all the people of the city heard the words of Chiddekem and his brothers, they were terribly afraid of their lives at their words, and they repented of what they had done.
verses.text: And when Hamor and his son Shechem and all the people of the city heard the words of Chiddekem and his brothers, they were terribly afraid of their lives at their words, and they repented of what they had done.

verses.raw: And Shechem and his father Hamor answered their father Chiddekem and his brethren, and they said to them, All the words which you spoke to us are true.
verses.text: And Shechem and his father Hamor answered their father Chiddekem and his brethren, and they said to them, All the words which you spoke to us are true.

verses.raw: Now do not say, nor imagine in your hearts that on account of the love of the Hebrews we did this thing that our ancestors did not command us.
verses.text: Now do not say, nor imagine in your hearts that on account of the love of the Hebrews we did this thing that our ancestors did not command us.

verses.raw: But because we saw that it was not their intention and desire to accede to our wishes concerning their daughter as to our taking her, except on this condition, so we hearkened to their voices and did this act which you saw, in order to obtain our desire from them.
verses.text: But because we saw that it was not their intention and desire to accede to our wishes concerning their daughter as to our taking her, except on this condition, so we hearkened to their voices and did this act which you saw, in order to obtain our desire from them.

verses.raw: And when we shall have obtained our request from them, we will then return to them and do to them that which you say to us.
verses.text: And when we shall have obtained our request from them, we will then return to them and do to them that which you say to us.

verses.raw: We beseech you then to wait and tarry until our flesh shall be healed and we again become strong, and we will then go together against them, and do to them that which is in your hearts and in ours.
verses.text: We beseech you then to wait and tarry until our flesh shall be healed and we again become strong, and we will then go together against them, and do to them that which is in your hearts and in ours.

verses.raw: And Dinah the daughter of Jacob heard all these words which Chiddekem and his brothers had spoken, and what Hamor and his son Shechem and the people of their city had answered them.
verses.text: And Dinah the daughter of Jacob heard all these words which Chiddekem and his brothers had spoken, and what Hamor and his son Shechem and the people of their city had answered them.

verses.raw: And she hastened and sent one of her maidens, that her father had sent to take care of her in the house of Shechem, to Jacob her father and to her brethren, saying:
verses.text: And she hastened and sent one of her maidens, that her father had sent to take care of her in the house of Shechem, to Jacob her father and to her brethren, saying:

verses.raw: Thus did Chiddekem and his brothers advise concerning you, and thus did Hamor and Shechem and the people of the city answer them.
verses.text: Thus did Chiddekem and his brothers advise concerning you, and thus did Hamor and Shechem and the people of the city answer them.

verses.raw: And when Jacob heard these words he was filled with wrath, and he was indignant at them, and his anger was kindled against them.
verses.text: And when Jacob heard these words he was filled with wrath, and he was indignant at them, and his anger was kindled against them.

verses.raw: And Simeon and Levi swore and said, As Yahuah (the Lord) lives, the Elohim (God) of the whole earth, by this time tomorrow, there shall not be a remnant left in the whole city.
