verses.text: And at the death of Isaac, he left his cattle and his possessions and all belonging to him to his sons; and Esau said to Jacob, Behold I pray you, all that our father has left we will divide it in two parts, and I will have the choice, and Jacob said, We will do so.

verses.raw: And Jacob took all that Isaac had left in the land of Canaan, the cattle and the property, and he placed them in two parts before Esau and his sons, and he said to Esau, Behold all this is before you, choose you to thyself the half which you will take.
verses.text: And Jacob took all that Isaac had left in the land of Canaan, the cattle and the property, and he placed them in two parts before Esau and his sons, and he said to Esau, Behold all this is before you, choose you to thyself the half which you will take.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to Esau, Hear you I pray you what I will speak to you, saying, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) of heaven and earth spoke to our fathers Abraham and Isaac, saying, To your seed will I give this land for an inheritance forever.
verses.text: And Jacob said to Esau, Hear you I pray you what I will speak to you, saying, Yahuah Elohim of heaven and earth spoke to our fathers Abraham and Isaac, saying, To your seed will I give this land for an inheritance forever.

verses.raw: Now therefore all that our father has left is before you, and behold all the land is before you; choose you from them what you desire.
verses.text: Now therefore all that our father has left is before you, and behold all the land is before you; choose you from them what you desire.

verses.raw: If you desire the whole land take it for you and your children forever, and I will take this riches, and it you desire the riches take it to you, and I will take this land for me and for my children to inherit it forever.
verses.text: If you desire the whole land take it for you and your children forever, and I will take this riches, and it you desire the riches take it to you, and I will take this land for me and for my children to inherit it forever.

verses.raw: And Nebayoth, the son of Ishmael, was then in the land with his children, and Esau went on that day and consulted with him, saying.
verses.text: And Nebayoth, the son of Ishmael, was then in the land with his children, and Esau went on that day and consulted with him, saying.

verses.raw: Thus has Jacob spoken to me, and thus has he answered me, now give your advice and we will hear.
verses.text: Thus has Jacob spoken to me, and thus has he answered me, now give your advice and we will hear.

verses.raw: And Nebayoth said, What is this that Jacob has spoken to you? behold all the children of Canaan are dwelling securely in their land, and Jacob says he will inherit it with his seed all the days.
verses.text: And Nebayoth said, What is this that Jacob has spoken to you? behold all the children of Canaan are dwelling securely in their land, and Jacob says he will inherit it with his seed all the days.

verses.raw: Go now therefore and take all your father’s riches and leave Jacob your brother in the land, as he has spoken.
verses.text: Go now therefore and take all your father’s riches and leave Jacob your brother in the land, as he has spoken.

verses.raw: And Esau rose up and returned to Jacob, and did all that Nebayoth the son of Ishmael had advised; and Esau took all the riches that Isaac had left, the souls, the beasts, the cattle and the property, and all the riches; he gave nothing to his brother Jacob; and Jacob took all the land of Canaan, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, and he took it for an everlasting possession, and for his children and for his seed after him forever.
verses.text: And Esau rose up and returned to Jacob, and did all that Nebayoth the son of Ishmael had advised; and Esau took all the riches that Isaac had left, the souls, the beasts, the cattle and the property, and all the riches; he gave nothing to his brother Jacob; and Jacob took all the land of Canaan, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, and he took it for an everlasting possession, and for his children and for his seed after him forever.

verses.raw: Jacob also took from his brother Esau the cave of Machpelah, which is in Hebron, which Abraham had bought from Ephron for a possession of a burial place for him and his seed forever.
verses.text: Jacob also took from his brother Esau the cave of Machpelah, which is in Hebron, which Abraham had bought from Ephron for a possession of a burial place for him and his seed forever.

verses.raw: And Jacob wrote all these things in the book of purchase, and he signed it, and he testified all this with four faithful witnesses.
verses.text: And Jacob wrote all these things in the book of purchase, and he signed it, and he testified all this with four faithful witnesses.

verses.raw: And these are the words which Jacob wrote in the book, saying: The land of Canaan and all the cities of the Hittites, the Hivites, the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, and the Gergashites, all the seven nations from the river of Egypt to the river Euphrates.
verses.text: And these are the words which Jacob wrote in the book, saying: The land of Canaan and all the cities of the Hittites, the Hivites, the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, and the Gergashites, all the seven nations from the river of Egypt to the river Euphrates.

verses.raw: And the city of Hebron Kireath-arba, and the cave which is in it, the whole did Jacob buy from his brother Esau for value, for a possession and for an inheritance for his seed after him forever.
verses.text: And the city of Hebron Kireath-arba, and the cave which is in it, the whole did Jacob buy from his brother Esau for value, for a possession and for an inheritance for his seed after him forever.

verses.raw: And Jacob took the book of purchase and the signature, the command and the statutes and the revealed book, and he placed them in an earthen vessel in order that they should remain for a long time, and he delivered them into the hands of his children.
verses.text: And Jacob took the book of purchase and the signature, the command and the statutes and the revealed book, and he placed them in an earthen vessel in order that they should remain for a long time, and he delivered them into the hands of his children.

verses.raw: Esau took all that his father had left him after his death from his brother Jacob, and he took all the property, from man and beast, camel and ass, ox and lamb, silver and gold, stones and bdellium, and all the riches which had belonged to Isaac the son of Abraham; there was nothing left which Esau did not take to himself, from all that Isaac had left after his death.
verses.text: Esau took all that his father had left him after his death from his brother Jacob, and he took all the property, from man and beast, camel and ass, ox and lamb, silver and gold, stones and bdellium, and all the riches which had belonged to Isaac the son of Abraham; there was nothing left which Esau did not take to himself, from all that Isaac had left after his death.

verses.raw: And Esau took all this, and he and his children went home to the land of Seir the Horite, away from his brother Jacob and his children.
verses.text: And Esau took all this, and he and his children went home to the land of Seir the Horite, away from his brother Jacob and his children.

verses.raw: And Esau had possessions amongst the children of Seir, and Esau returned not to the land of Canaan from that day forward.
verses.text: And Esau had possessions amongst the children of Seir, and Esau returned not to the land of Canaan from that day forward.

verses.raw: And the whole land of Canaan became an inheritance to the children of Israel for an everlasting inheritance, and Esau with all his children inherited the mountain of Seir.
verses.text: And the whole land of Canaan became an inheritance to the children of Israel for an everlasting inheritance, and Esau with all his children inherited the mountain of Seir.

verses.raw: In those days, after the death of Isaac, Yahuah (the Lord) commanded and caused a famine upon the whole earth.
verses.text: In those days, after the death of Isaac, Yahuah (the Lord) commanded and caused a famine upon the whole earth.

verses.raw: At that time Pharaoh king of Egypt was sitting upon his throne in the land of Egypt, and lay in his bed and dreamed dreams, and Pharaoh saw in his dream that he was standing by the side of the river of Egypt.
verses.text: At that time Pharaoh king of Egypt was sitting upon his throne in the land of Egypt, and lay in his bed and dreamed dreams, and Pharaoh saw in his dream that he was standing by the side of the river of Egypt.

verses.raw: And whilst he was standing he saw and behold seven fat fleshed and well favored kine came up out of the river.
verses.text: And whilst he was standing he saw and behold seven fat fleshed and well favored kine came up out of the river.

verses.raw: And seven other kine, lean fleshed and ill favored, came up after them, and the seven ill favored ones swallowed up the well favored ones, and still their appearance was ill as at first.
verses.text: And seven other kine, lean fleshed and ill favored, came up after them, and the seven ill favored ones swallowed up the well favored ones, and still their appearance was ill as at first.

verses.raw: And he awoke, and he slept again and he dreamed a second time, and he saw and behold seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good, and seven thin ears blasted with the east wind sprang, up after them, and the thin ears swallowed up the full ones, and Pharaoh awoke out of his dream.
verses.text: And he awoke, and he slept again and he dreamed a second time, and he saw and behold seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk, rank and good, and seven thin ears blasted with the east wind sprang, up after them, and the thin ears swallowed up the full ones, and Pharaoh awoke out of his dream.

verses.raw: And in the morning the king remembered his dreams, and his spirit was sadly troubled on account of his dreams, and the king hastened and sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and the wise men, and they came and stood before Pharaoh.
verses.text: And in the morning the king remembered his dreams, and his spirit was sadly troubled on account of his dreams, and the king hastened and sent and called for all the magicians of Egypt, and the wise men, and they came and stood before Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And the king said to them, I have dreamed dreams, and there is none to interpret them; and they said to the king, relate your dreams to your servants and let us hear them.
verses.text: And the king said to them, I have dreamed dreams, and there is none to interpret them; and they said to the king, relate your dreams to your servants and let us hear them.

verses.raw: And the king related his dreams to them, and they all answered and said with one voice to the king, may the king live forever; and this is the interpretation of your dreams.
verses.text: And the king related his dreams to them, and they all answered and said with one voice to the king, may the king live forever; and this is the interpretation of your dreams.

verses.raw: The seven good kine which you did see denote seven daughters that will be born to you in the latter days, and the seven kine which you saw come up after them, and swallowed them up, are for a sign that the daughters which will be born to you will all die in the life-time of the king.
verses.text: The seven good kine which you did see denote seven daughters that will be born to you in the latter days, and the seven kine which you saw come up after them, and swallowed them up, are for a sign that the daughters which will be born to you will all die in the life-time of the king.

verses.raw: And that which you did see in the second dream of seven full good ears of corn coming up upon one stalk, this is their interpretation, that you will build to thyself in the latter days seven cities throughout the land of Egypt; and that which you saw of the seven blasted ears of corn springing up after them and swallowing them up whilst you did behold them with your eyes, is for a sign that the cities which you will build will all be destroyed in the latter days, in the life-time of the king.
verses.text: And that which you did see in the second dream of seven full good ears of corn coming up upon one stalk, this is their interpretation, that you will build to thyself in the latter days seven cities throughout the land of Egypt; and that which you saw of the seven blasted ears of corn springing up after them and swallowing them up whilst you did behold them with your eyes, is for a sign that the cities which you will build will all be destroyed in the latter days, in the life-time of the king.

verses.raw: And when they spoke these words the king did not incline his ear to their words, neither did he fix his heart upon them, for the king knew in his wisdom that they did not give a proper interpretation of the dreams; and when they had finished speaking before the king, the king answered them, saying, What is this thing that you have spoken to me? surely you have uttered falsehood and spoken lies; therefore now give the proper interpretation of my dreams, that you may not die.
verses.text: And when they spoke these words the king did not incline his ear to their words, neither did he fix his heart upon them, for the king knew in his wisdom that they did not give a proper interpretation of the dreams; and when they had finished speaking before the king, the king answered them, saying, What is this thing that you have spoken to me? surely you have uttered falsehood and spoken lies; therefore now give the proper interpretation of my dreams, that you may not die.

verses.raw: And the king commanded after this, and he sent and called again for other wise men, and they came and stood before the king, and the king related his dreams to them, and they all answered him according to the first interpretation, and the king’s anger was kindled and he was very wroth, and the king said to them, Surely you speak lies and utter falsehood in what you have said.
verses.text: And the king commanded after this, and he sent and called again for other wise men, and they came and stood before the king, and the king related his dreams to them, and they all answered him according to the first interpretation, and the king’s anger was kindled and he was very wroth, and the king said to them, Surely you speak lies and utter falsehood in what you have said.

verses.raw: And the king commanded that a proclamation should be issued throughout the land of Egypt, saying, It is resolved by the king and his great men, that any wise man who knows and understands the interpretation of dreams, and will not come this day before the king, shall die.
verses.text: And the king commanded that a proclamation should be issued throughout the land of Egypt, saying, It is resolved by the king and his great men, that any wise man who knows and understands the interpretation of dreams, and will not come this day before the king, shall die.

verses.raw: And the man that will declare to the king the proper interpretation of his dreams, there shall be given to him all that he will require from the king. And all the wise men of the land of Egypt came before the king, together with all the magicians and sorcerers that were in Egypt and in Goshen, in Rameses, in Tachpanches, in Zoar, and in all the places on the borders of Egypt, and they all stood before the king.
verses.text: And the man that will declare to the king the proper interpretation of his dreams, there shall be given to him all that he will require from the king. And all the wise men of the land of Egypt came before the king, together with all the magicians and sorcerers that were in Egypt and in Goshen, in Rameses, in Tachpanches, in Zoar, and in all the places on the borders of Egypt, and they all stood before the king.

verses.raw: And all the nobles and the princes, and the attendants belonging to the king, came together from all the cities of Egypt, and they all sat before the king, and the king related his dreams before the wise men, and the princes, and all that sat before the king were astonished at the vision.
verses.text: And all the nobles and the princes, and the attendants belonging to the king, came together from all the cities of Egypt, and they all sat before the king, and the king related his dreams before the wise men, and the princes, and all that sat before the king were astonished at the vision.

verses.raw: And all the wise men who were before the king were greatly divided in their interpretation of his dreams; some of them interpreted them to the king, saying, The seven good kine are seven kings, who from the king’s issue will be raised over Egypt.
verses.text: And all the wise men who were before the king were greatly divided in their interpretation of his dreams; some of them interpreted them to the king, saying, The seven good kine are seven kings, who from the king’s issue will be raised over Egypt.

verses.raw: And the seven bad kine are seven princes, who will stand up against them in the latter days and destroy them; and the seven ears of corn are the seven great princes belonging to Egypt, who will fall in the hands of the seven less powerful princes of their enemies, in the wars of our Lord the king.
verses.text: And the seven bad kine are seven princes, who will stand up against them in the latter days and destroy them; and the seven ears of corn are the seven great princes belonging to Egypt, who will fall in the hands of the seven less powerful princes of their enemies, in the wars of our Lord the king.

verses.raw: And some of them interpreted to the king in this manner, saying, The seven good kine are the strong cities of Egypt, and the seven bad kine are the seven nations of the land of Canaan, who will come against the seven cities of Egypt in the latter days and destroy them.
verses.text: And some of them interpreted to the king in this manner, saying, The seven good kine are the strong cities of Egypt, and the seven bad kine are the seven nations of the land of Canaan, who will come against the seven cities of Egypt in the latter days and destroy them.

verses.raw: And that which you saw in the second dream, of seven good and bad ears of corn, is a sign that the government of Egypt will again return to your seed as at first.
verses.text: And that which you saw in the second dream, of seven good and bad ears of corn, is a sign that the government of Egypt will again return to your seed as at first.

verses.raw: And in his reign the people of the cities of Egypt will turn against the seven cities of Canaan who are stronger than they are, and will destroy them, and the government of Egypt will return to your seed.
verses.text: And in his reign the people of the cities of Egypt will turn against the seven cities of Canaan who are stronger than they are, and will destroy them, and the government of Egypt will return to your seed.

verses.raw: And some of them said to the king, This is the interpretation of your dreams; the seven good kine are seven queens, whom you will take for wives in the latter days, and the seven bad kine denote that those women will all die in the lifetime of the king.
verses.text: And some of them said to the king, This is the interpretation of your dreams; the seven good kine are seven queens, whom you will take for wives in the latter days, and the seven bad kine denote that those women will all die in the lifetime of the king.

verses.raw: And the seven good and bad ears of corn which you did see in the second dream are fourteen children, and it will be in the latter days that they will stand up and fight amongst themselves, and seven of them will smite the seven that are more powerful.
verses.text: And the seven good and bad ears of corn which you did see in the second dream are fourteen children, and it will be in the latter days that they will stand up and fight amongst themselves, and seven of them will smite the seven that are more powerful.

verses.raw: And some of them said these words to the king, saying, The seven good kine denote that seven children will be born to you, and they will slay seven of your children’s children in the latter days; and the seven good ears of corn which you did see in the second dream, are those princes against whom seven other less powerful princes will fight and destroy them in the latter days, and avenge your children’s cause, and the government will again return to your seed.
verses.text: And some of them said these words to the king, saying, The seven good kine denote that seven children will be born to you, and they will slay seven of your children’s children in the latter days; and the seven good ears of corn which you did see in the second dream, are those princes against whom seven other less powerful princes will fight and destroy them in the latter days, and avenge your children’s cause, and the government will again return to your seed.

verses.raw: And the king heard all the words of the wise men of Egypt and their interpretation of his dreams, and none of them pleased the king.
verses.text: And the king heard all the words of the wise men of Egypt and their interpretation of his dreams, and none of them pleased the king.

verses.raw: And the king knew in his wisdom that they did not altogether speak correctly in all these words, for this was from Yahuah (the Lord) to frustrate the words of the wise men of Egypt, in order that Joseph might go forth from the house of confinement, and in order that he should become great in Egypt.
verses.text: And the king knew in his wisdom that they did not altogether speak correctly in all these words, for this was from Yahuah (the Lord) to frustrate the words of the wise men of Egypt, in order that Joseph might go forth from the house of confinement, and in order that he should become great in Egypt.

verses.raw: And the king saw that none amongst all the wise men and magicians of Egypt spoke correctly to him, and the king’s wrath was kindled, and his anger burned within him.
verses.text: And the king saw that none amongst all the wise men and magicians of Egypt spoke correctly to him, and the king’s wrath was kindled, and his anger burned within him.

verses.raw: And the king commanded that all the wise men and magicians should go out from before him, and they all went out from before the king with shame and disgrace.
verses.text: And the king commanded that all the wise men and magicians should go out from before him, and they all went out from before the king with shame and disgrace.

verses.raw: And the king commanded that a proclamation be sent throughout Egypt to slay all the magicians that were in Egypt, and not one of them should be suffered to live.
verses.text: And the king commanded that a proclamation be sent throughout Egypt to slay all the magicians that were in Egypt, and not one of them should be suffered to live.

verses.raw: And the captains of the guards belonging to the king rose up, and each man drew his sword, and they began to smite the magicians of Egypt, and the wise men.
verses.text: And the captains of the guards belonging to the king rose up, and each man drew his sword, and they began to smite the magicians of Egypt, and the wise men.

verses.raw: And after this Merod, chief butler to the king, came and bowed down before the king and sat before him.
verses.text: And after this Merod, chief butler to the king, came and bowed down before the king and sat before him.

verses.raw: And the butler said to the king, May the king live forever, and his government be exalted in the land.
verses.text: And the butler said to the king, May the king live forever, and his government be exalted in the land.

verses.raw: You were angry with your servant in those days, now two years past, and did place me in the ward, and I was for some time in the ward, I and the chief of the bakers.
verses.text: You were angry with your servant in those days, now two years past, and did place me in the ward, and I was for some time in the ward, I and the chief of the bakers.

verses.raw: And there was with us a Hebrew servant belonging to the captain of the guard, his name was Joseph, for his master had been angry with him and placed him in the house of confinement, and he attended us there.
verses.text: And there was with us a Hebrew servant belonging to the captain of the guard, his name was Joseph, for his master had been angry with him and placed him in the house of confinement, and he attended us there.

verses.raw: And in some time after when we were in the ward, we dreamed dreams in one night, I and the chief of the bakers; we dreamed, each man according to the interpretation of his dream.
verses.text: And in some time after when we were in the ward, we dreamed dreams in one night, I and the chief of the bakers; we dreamed, each man according to the interpretation of his dream.

verses.raw: And we came in the morning and told them to that servant, and he interpreted to us our dreams, to each man according to his dream, did he correctly interpret.
verses.text: And we came in the morning and told them to that servant, and he interpreted to us our dreams, to each man according to his dream, did he correctly interpret.

verses.raw: And it came to pass as he interpreted to us, so was the event; there fell not to the ground any of his words.
verses.text: And it came to pass as he interpreted to us, so was the event; there fell not to the ground any of his words.

verses.raw: And now therefore my Lord and king do not slay the people of Egypt for naught; behold that slave is still confined in the house by the captain of the guard his master, in the house of confinement.
verses.text: And now therefore my Lord and king do not slay the people of Egypt for naught; behold that slave is still confined in the house by the captain of the guard his master, in the house of confinement.

verses.raw: If it pleases the king let him send for him that he may come before you and he will make known to you, the correct interpretation of the dream which you did dream.
verses.text: If it pleases the king let him send for him that he may come before you and he will make known to you, the correct interpretation of the dream which you did dream.

verses.raw: And the king heard the words of the chief butler, and the king ordered that the wise men of Egypt should not be slain.
verses.text: And the king heard the words of the chief butler, and the king ordered that the wise men of Egypt should not be slain.

verses.raw: And the king ordered his servants to bring Joseph before him, and the king said to them, Go to him and do not terrify him lest he be confused and will not know to speak properly.
verses.text: And the king ordered his servants to bring Joseph before him, and the king said to them, Go to him and do not terrify him lest he be confused and will not know to speak properly.

verses.raw: And the servants of the king went to Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon, and the king’s servants shaved him, and he changed his prison garment and he came before the king.
verses.text: And the servants of the king went to Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon, and the king’s servants shaved him, and he changed his prison garment and he came before the king.

verses.raw: And the king was sitting upon his royal throne in a princely dress girt around with a golden ephod, and the fine gold which was upon it sparkled, and the carbuncle and the ruby and the emerald, together with all the precious stones that were upon the king’s head, dazzled the eye, and Joseph wondered greatly at the king.
verses.text: And the king was sitting upon his royal throne in a princely dress girt around with a golden ephod, and the fine gold which was upon it sparkled, and the carbuncle and the ruby and the emerald, together with all the precious stones that were upon the king’s head, dazzled the eye, and Joseph wondered greatly at the king.

verses.raw: And the throne upon which the king sat was covered with gold and silver, and with onyx stones, and it had seventy steps.
verses.text: And the throne upon which the king sat was covered with gold and silver, and with onyx stones, and it had seventy steps.

verses.raw: And it was their custom throughout the land of Egypt, that every man who came to speak to the king, if he was a prince or one that was estimable in the sight of the king, he ascended to the king’s throne as far as the thirty-first step, and the king would descend to the thirty-sixth step, and speak with him.
verses.text: And it was their custom throughout the land of Egypt, that every man who came to speak to the king, if he was a prince or one that was estimable in the sight of the king, he ascended to the king’s throne as far as the thirty-first step, and the king would descend to the thirty-sixth step, and speak with him.

verses.raw: If he was one of the common people, he ascended to the third step, and the king would descend to the fourth and speak to him, and their custom was, moreover, that any man who understood to speak in all the seventy languages, he ascended the seventy steps, and went up and spoke till he reached the king.
verses.text: If he was one of the common people, he ascended to the third step, and the king would descend to the fourth and speak to him, and their custom was, moreover, that any man who understood to speak in all the seventy languages, he ascended the seventy steps, and went up and spoke till he reached the king.

verses.raw: And any man who could not complete the seventy, he ascended as many steps as the languages which he knew to speak in.
verses.text: And any man who could not complete the seventy, he ascended as many steps as the languages which he knew to speak in.

verses.raw: And it was customary in those days in Egypt that no one should reign over them, but who understood to speak in the seventy languages.
verses.text: And it was customary in those days in Egypt that no one should reign over them, but who understood to speak in the seventy languages.

verses.raw: And when Joseph came before the king he bowed down to the ground before the king, and he ascended to the third step, and the king sat upon the fourth step and spoke with Joseph.
verses.text: And when Joseph came before the king he bowed down to the ground before the king, and he ascended to the third step, and the king sat upon the fourth step and spoke with Joseph.

verses.raw: And the king said to Joseph, I dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter to interpret it properly, and I commanded this day that all the magicians of Egypt and the wise men of it, should come before me, and I related my dreams to them, and no one has properly interpreted them to me.
verses.text: And the king said to Joseph, I dreamed a dream, and there is no interpreter to interpret it properly, and I commanded this day that all the magicians of Egypt and the wise men of it, should come before me, and I related my dreams to them, and no one has properly interpreted them to me.

verses.raw: And after this I this day heard concerning you, that you are a wise man, and can correctly interpret every dream that you hear.
verses.text: And after this I this day heard concerning you, that you are a wise man, and can correctly interpret every dream that you hear.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, Let Pharaoh relate his dreams that he dreamed; surely the interpretations belong to Elohim (God); and Pharaoh related his dreams to Joseph, the dream of the kine, and the dream of the ears of corn, and the king left off speaking.
verses.text: And Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, Let Pharaoh relate his dreams that he dreamed; surely the interpretations belong to Elohim; and Pharaoh related his dreams to Joseph, the dream of the kine, and the dream of the ears of corn, and the king left off speaking.

verses.raw: And Joseph was then clothed with the spirit of Elohim before the king, and he knew all the things that would befall the king from that day forward, and he knew the proper interpretation of the king’s dream, and he spoke before the king.
verses.text: And Joseph was then clothed with the spirit of Elohim before the king, and he knew all the things that would befall the king from that day forward, and he knew the proper interpretation of the king’s dream, and he spoke before the king.

verses.raw: And Joseph found favor in the sight of the king, and the king inclined his ears and his heart, and he heard all the words of Joseph. And Joseph said to the king, Do not imagine that they are two dreams, for it is only one dream, for that which Elohim has chosen to do throughout the land he has shown to the king in his dream, and this is the proper interpretation of your dream:
verses.text: And Joseph found favor in the sight of the king, and the king inclined his ears and his heart, and he heard all the words of Joseph. And Joseph said to the king, Do not imagine that they are two dreams, for it is only one dream, for that which Elohim has chosen to do throughout the land he has shown to the king in his dream, and this is the proper interpretation of your dream:

verses.raw: The seven good kine and ears of corn are seven years, and the seven bad kine and ears of corn are also seven years; it is one dream.
verses.text: The seven good kine and ears of corn are seven years, and the seven bad kine and ears of corn are also seven years; it is one dream.

verses.raw: Behold the seven years that are coming there will be a great plenty throughout the land, and after that the seven years of famine will follow them, a very grievous famine; and all the plenty will be forgotten from the land, and the famine will consume the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text: Behold the seven years that are coming there will be a great plenty throughout the land, and after that the seven years of famine will follow them, a very grievous famine; and all the plenty will be forgotten from the land, and the famine will consume the inhabitants of the land.

verses.raw: The king dreamed one dream, and the dream was therefore repeated to Pharaoh because the thing is established by Elohim, and Elohim will shortly bring it to pass.
verses.text: The king dreamed one dream, and the dream was therefore repeated to Pharaoh because the thing is established by Elohim, and Elohim will shortly bring it to pass.

verses.raw: Now therefore I will give you counsel and deliver your soul and the souls of the inhabitants of the land from the evil of the famine, that you seek throughout your kingdom for a man very discreet and wise, who knows all the affairs of government, and appoint him to superintend over the land of Egypt.
verses.text: Now therefore I will give you counsel and deliver your soul and the souls of the inhabitants of the land from the evil of the famine, that you seek throughout your kingdom for a man very discreet and wise, who knows all the affairs of government, and appoint him to superintend over the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And let the man whom you place over Egypt appoint officers under him, that they gather in all the food of the good years that are coming, and let them lay up corn and deposit it in your appointed stores.
verses.text: And let the man whom you place over Egypt appoint officers under him, that they gather in all the food of the good years that are coming, and let them lay up corn and deposit it in your appointed stores.

verses.raw: And let them keep that food for the seven years of famine, that it may be found for you and your people and your whole land, and that you and your land be not cut off by the famine.
verses.text: And let them keep that food for the seven years of famine, that it may be found for you and your people and your whole land, and that you and your land be not cut off by the famine.

verses.raw: Let all the inhabitants of the land be also ordered that they gather in, every man the produce of his field, of all sorts of food, during the seven good years, and that they place it in their stores, that it may be found for them in the days of the famine and that they may live upon it.
verses.text: Let all the inhabitants of the land be also ordered that they gather in, every man the produce of his field, of all sorts of food, during the seven good years, and that they place it in their stores, that it may be found for them in the days of the famine and that they may live upon it.

verses.raw: This is the proper interpretation of your dream, and this is the counsel given to save your soul and the souls of all your subjects.
verses.text: This is the proper interpretation of your dream, and this is the counsel given to save your soul and the souls of all your subjects.

verses.raw: And the king answered and said to Joseph, Who says and who knows that your words are correct? And he said to the king, This shall be a sign for you respecting all my words, that they are true and that my advice is good for you.
verses.text: And the king answered and said to Joseph, Who says and who knows that your words are correct? And he said to the king, This shall be a sign for you respecting all my words, that they are true and that my advice is good for you.

verses.raw: Behold your wife sits this day upon the stool of delivery, and she will bear you a son and you will rejoice with him; when your child shall have gone forth from his mother’s womb, your first born son that has been born these two years back shall die, and you will be comforted in the child that will be born to you this day.
verses.text: Behold your wife sits this day upon the stool of delivery, and she will bear you a son and you will rejoice with him; when your child shall have gone forth from his mother’s womb, your first born son that has been born these two years back shall die, and you will be comforted in the child that will be born to you this day.

verses.raw: And Joseph finished speaking these words to the king, and he bowed down to the king and he went out, and when Joseph had gone out from the king’s presence, those signs which Joseph had spoken to the king came to pass on that day.
verses.text: And Joseph finished speaking these words to the king, and he bowed down to the king and he went out, and when Joseph had gone out from the king’s presence, those signs which Joseph had spoken to the king came to pass on that day.

verses.raw: And the queen bare a son on that day and the king heard the glad tidings about his son, and he rejoiced, and when the reporter had gone forth from the king’s presence, the king’s servants found the first born son of the king fallen dead upon the ground.
verses.text: And the queen bare a son on that day and the king heard the glad tidings about his son, and he rejoiced, and when the reporter had gone forth from the king’s presence, the king’s servants found the first born son of the king fallen dead upon the ground.

verses.raw: And there was great lamentation and noise in the king’s house, and the king heard it, and he said, What is the noise and lamentation that I have heard in the house? and they told the king that his first born son had died; then the king knew that all Joseph’s words that he had spoken were correct, and the king was consoled for his son by the child that was born to him on that day as Joseph had spoken.
verses.text: And there was great lamentation and noise in the king’s house, and the king heard it, and he said, What is the noise and lamentation that I have heard in the house? and they told the king that his first born son had died; then the king knew that all Joseph’s words that he had spoken were correct, and the king was consoled for his son by the child that was born to him on that day as Joseph had spoken.

verses.raw: After these things the king sent and assembled all his officers and servants, and all the princes and nobles belonging to the king, and they all came before the king.
verses.text: After these things the king sent and assembled all his officers and servants, and all the princes and nobles belonging to the king, and they all came before the king.

verses.raw: And the king said to them, Behold you have seen and heard all the words of this Hebrew man, and all the signs which he declared would come to pass, and not any of his words have fallen to the ground.
verses.text: And the king said to them, Behold you have seen and heard all the words of this Hebrew man, and all the signs which he declared would come to pass, and not any of his words have fallen to the ground.

verses.raw: You know that he has given a proper interpretation of the dream, and it will surely come to pass, now therefore take counsel, and know what you will do and how the land will be delivered from the famine.
verses.text: You know that he has given a proper interpretation of the dream, and it will surely come to pass, now therefore take counsel, and know what you will do and how the land will be delivered from the famine.

verses.raw: Seek now and see whether the like can be found, in whose heart there is wisdom and knowledge, and I will appoint him over the land.
verses.text: Seek now and see whether the like can be found, in whose heart there is wisdom and knowledge, and I will appoint him over the land.

verses.raw: For you have heard what the Hebrew man has advised concerning this to save the land therewith from the famine, and I know that the land will not be delivered from the famine but with the advice of the Hebrew man, him that advised me.
verses.text: For you have heard what the Hebrew man has advised concerning this to save the land therewith from the famine, and I know that the land will not be delivered from the famine but with the advice of the Hebrew man, him that advised me.

verses.raw: And they all answered the king and said, The counsel which the Hebrew has given concerning this is good; now therefore, our Lord and king, behold the whole land is in your hand, do that which seems good in your sight.
verses.text: And they all answered the king and said, The counsel which the Hebrew has given concerning this is good; now therefore, our Lord and king, behold the whole land is in your hand, do that which seems good in your sight.

verses.raw: Him whom you chooses, and whom you in your wisdom know to be wise and capable of delivering the land with his wisdom, him shall the king appoint to be under him over the land.
verses.text: Him whom you chooses, and whom you in your wisdom know to be wise and capable of delivering the land with his wisdom, him shall the king appoint to be under him over the land.

verses.raw: And the king said to all the officers: I have thought that since Elohim (God) has made known to the Hebrew man all that he has spoken, there is none so discreet and wise in the whole land as he is; if it seem good in your sight I will place him over the land, for he will save the land with his wisdom.
verses.text: And the king said to all the officers: I have thought that since Elohim has made known to the Hebrew man all that he has spoken, there is none so discreet and wise in the whole land as he is; if it seem good in your sight I will place him over the land, for he will save the land with his wisdom.

verses.raw: And all the officers answered the king and said, But surely it is written in the laws of Egypt, and it should not be violated, that no man shall reign over Egypt, nor be the second to the king, but one who has knowledge in all the languages of the sons of men.
verses.text: And all the officers answered the king and said, But surely it is written in the laws of Egypt, and it should not be violated, that no man shall reign over Egypt, nor be the second to the king, but one who has knowledge in all the languages of the sons of men.

verses.raw: Now therefore our Lord and king, behold this Hebrew man can only speak the Hebrew language, and how then can he be over us the second under government, a man who not even knows our language?
verses.text: Now therefore our Lord and king, behold this Hebrew man can only speak the Hebrew language, and how then can he be over us the second under government, a man who not even knows our language?

verses.raw: Now we pray you send for him, and let him come before you, and prove him in all things, and do as you see fit.
verses.text: Now we pray you send for him, and let him come before you, and prove him in all things, and do as you see fit.

verses.raw: And the king said, It shall be done tomorrow, and the thing that you have spoken is good; and all the officers came on that day before the king.
verses.text: And the king said, It shall be done tomorrow, and the thing that you have spoken is good; and all the officers came on that day before the king.

verses.raw: And on that night Yahuah (the Lord) sent one of his ministering angels, and he came into the land of Egypt to Joseph, and the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) stood over Joseph, and behold Joseph was lying in the bed at night in his master’s house in the dungeon, for his master had put him back into the dungeon on account of his wife.
verses.text: And on that night Yahuah (the Lord) sent one of his ministering angels, and he came into the land of Egypt to Joseph, and the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) stood over Joseph, and behold Joseph was lying in the bed at night in his master’s house in the dungeon, for his master had put him back into the dungeon on account of his wife.

verses.raw: And the angel roused him from his sleep, and Joseph rose up and stood upon his legs, and behold the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) was standing opposite to him; and the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) spoke with Joseph, and he taught him all the languages of man in that night, and he called his name Jehoseph.
verses.text: And the angel roused him from his sleep, and Joseph rose up and stood upon his legs, and behold the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) was standing opposite to him; and the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) spoke with Joseph, and he taught him all the languages of man in that night, and he called his name Jehoseph.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) went from him, and Joseph returned and lay upon his bed, and Joseph was astonished at the vision which he saw.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) went from him, and Joseph returned and lay upon his bed, and Joseph was astonished at the vision which he saw.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the morning that the king sent for all his officers and servants, and they all came and sat before the king, and the king ordered Joseph to be brought, and the king’s servants went and brought Joseph before Pharaoh.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the morning that the king sent for all his officers and servants, and they all came and sat before the king, and the king ordered Joseph to be brought, and the king’s servants went and brought Joseph before Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And the king came forth and ascended the steps of the throne, and Joseph spoke to the king in all languages, and Joseph went up to him and spoke to the king until he arrived before the king in the seventieth step, and he sat before the king.
verses.text: And the king came forth and ascended the steps of the throne, and Joseph spoke to the king in all languages, and Joseph went up to him and spoke to the king until he arrived before the king in the seventieth step, and he sat before the king.

verses.raw: And the king greatly rejoiced on account of Joseph, and all the king’s officers rejoiced greatly with the king when they heard all the words of Joseph.
verses.text: And the king greatly rejoiced on account of Joseph, and all the king’s officers rejoiced greatly with the king when they heard all the words of Joseph.

verses.raw: And the thing seemed good in the sight of the king and the officers, to appoint Joseph to be second to the king over the whole land of Egypt, and the king spoke to Joseph, saying,
verses.text: And the thing seemed good in the sight of the king and the officers, to appoint Joseph to be second to the king over the whole land of Egypt, and the king spoke to Joseph, saying,

verses.raw: Now you did give me counsel to appoint a wise man over the land of Egypt, in order with his wisdom to save the land from the famine; now therefore, since Elohim has made all this known to you, and all the words which you have spoken, there is not throughout the land a discreet and wise man like to you.
verses.text: Now you did give me counsel to appoint a wise man over the land of Egypt, in order with his wisdom to save the land from the famine; now therefore, since Elohim has made all this known to you, and all the words which you have spoken, there is not throughout the land a discreet and wise man like to you.

verses.raw: And your name no more shall be called Joseph, but Zaphnath Paaneah shall be your name; you shall be second to me, and according to your word shall be all the affairs of my government, and at your word shall my people go out and come in.
verses.text: And your name no more shall be called Joseph, but Zaphnath Paaneah shall be your name; you shall be second to me, and according to your word shall be all the affairs of my government, and at your word shall my people go out and come in.

verses.raw: Also from under your hand shall my servants and officers receive their salary which is given to them monthly, and to you shall all the people of the land bow down; only in my throne will I be greater than you.
verses.text: Also from under your hand shall my servants and officers receive their salary which is given to them monthly, and to you shall all the people of the land bow down; only in my throne will I be greater than you.

verses.raw: And the king took off his ring from his hand and put it upon the hand of Joseph, and the king dressed Joseph in a princely garment, and he put a golden crown upon his head, and he put a golden chain upon his neck.
verses.text: And the king took off his ring from his hand and put it upon the hand of Joseph, and the king dressed Joseph in a princely garment, and he put a golden crown upon his head, and he put a golden chain upon his neck.

verses.raw: And the king commanded his servants, and they made him ride in the second chariot belonging to the king, that went opposite to the king’s chariot, and he caused him to ride upon a great and strong horse from the king’s horses, and to be conducted through the streets of the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And the king commanded his servants, and they made him ride in the second chariot belonging to the king, that went opposite to the king’s chariot, and he caused him to ride upon a great and strong horse from the king’s horses, and to be conducted through the streets of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And the king commanded that all those that played upon timbrels, harps and other musical instruments should go forth with Joseph; one thousand timbrels, one thousand mecholoth, and one thousand nebalim went after him.
verses.text: And the king commanded that all those that played upon timbrels, harps and other musical instruments should go forth with Joseph; one thousand timbrels, one thousand mecholoth, and one thousand nebalim went after him.

verses.raw: And five thousand men, with drawn swords glittering in their hands, and they went marching and playing before Joseph, and twenty thousand of the great men of the king girt with girdles of skin covered with gold, marched at the right hand of Joseph, and twenty thousand at his left, and all the women and damsels went upon the roofs or stood in the streets playing and rejoicing at Joseph, and gazed at the appearance of Joseph and at his beauty.
verses.text: And five thousand men, with drawn swords glittering in their hands, and they went marching and playing before Joseph, and twenty thousand of the great men of the king girt with girdles of skin covered with gold, marched at the right hand of Joseph, and twenty thousand at his left, and all the women and damsels went upon the roofs or stood in the streets playing and rejoicing at Joseph, and gazed at the appearance of Joseph and at his beauty.

verses.raw: And the king’s people went before him and behind him, perfuming the road with frankincense and with cassia, and with all sorts of fine perfume, and scattered myrrh and aloes along the road, and twenty men proclaimed these words before him throughout the land in a loud voice:
verses.text: And the king’s people went before him and behind him, perfuming the road with frankincense and with cassia, and with all sorts of fine perfume, and scattered myrrh and aloes along the road, and twenty men proclaimed these words before him throughout the land in a loud voice:

verses.raw: Do you see this man whom the king has chosen to be his second? all the affairs of government shall be regulated by him, and he that transgresses his orders, or that does not bow down before him to the ground, shall die, for he rebels against the king and his second.
verses.text: Do you see this man whom the king has chosen to be his second? all the affairs of government shall be regulated by him, and he that transgresses his orders, or that does not bow down before him to the ground, shall die, for he rebels against the king and his second.

verses.raw: And when the heralds had ceased proclaiming, all the people of Egypt bowed down to the ground before Joseph and said, May the king live, also may his second live; and all the inhabitants of Egypt bowed down along the road, and when the heralds approached them, they bowed down, and they rejoiced with all sorts of timbrels, mechol and nebal before Joseph.
verses.text: And when the heralds had ceased proclaiming, all the people of Egypt bowed down to the ground before Joseph and said, May the king live, also may his second live; and all the inhabitants of Egypt bowed down along the road, and when the heralds approached them, they bowed down, and they rejoiced with all sorts of timbrels, mechol and nebal before Joseph.

verses.raw: And Joseph upon his horse lifted up his eyes to heaven, and called out and said, He raises the poor man from the dust, He lifts up the needy from the dunghill. O Yahuah (O Lord) of Hosts, happy is the man who trusts in you.
verses.text: And Joseph upon his horse lifted up his eyes to heaven, and called out and said, He raises the poor man from the dust, He lifts up the needy from the dunghill. O Yahuah (O Lord) of Hosts, happy is the man who trusts in you.

verses.raw: And Joseph passed throughout the land of Egypt with Pharaoh’s servants and officers, and they showed him the whole land of Egypt and all the king’s treasures.
verses.text: And Joseph passed throughout the land of Egypt with Pharaoh’s servants and officers, and they showed him the whole land of Egypt and all the king’s treasures.

verses.raw: And Joseph returned and came on that day before Pharaoh, and the king gave to Joseph a possession in the land of Egypt, a possession of fields and vineyards, and the king gave to Joseph three thousand talents of silver and one thousand talents of gold, and onyx stones and bdellium and many gifts.
verses.text: And Joseph returned and came on that day before Pharaoh, and the king gave to Joseph a possession in the land of Egypt, a possession of fields and vineyards, and the king gave to Joseph three thousand talents of silver and one thousand talents of gold, and onyx stones and bdellium and many gifts.

verses.raw: And on the next day the king commanded all the people of Egypt to bring to Joseph offerings and gifts, and that he that violated the command of the king should die; and they made a high place in the street of the city, and they spread out garments there, and whoever brought anything to Joseph put it into the high place.
verses.text: And on the next day the king commanded all the people of Egypt to bring to Joseph offerings and gifts, and that he that violated the command of the king should die; and they made a high place in the street of the city, and they spread out garments there, and whoever brought anything to Joseph put it into the high place.

verses.raw: And all the people of Egypt cast something into the high place, one man a golden ear-ring, and the other rings and ear-rings, and different vessels of gold and silver work, and onyx stones and bdellium did he cast upon the high place; every one gave something of what he possessed.
verses.text: And all the people of Egypt cast something into the high place, one man a golden ear-ring, and the other rings and ear-rings, and different vessels of gold and silver work, and onyx stones and bdellium did he cast upon the high place; every one gave something of what he possessed.

verses.raw: And Joseph took all these and placed them in his treasuries, and all the officers and nobles belonging to the king exalted Joseph, and they gave him many gifts, seeing that the king had chosen him to be his second.
verses.text: And Joseph took all these and placed them in his treasuries, and all the officers and nobles belonging to the king exalted Joseph, and they gave him many gifts, seeing that the king had chosen him to be his second.

verses.raw: And the king sent to Potiphera, the son of Ahiram priest of On, and he took his young daughter Osnath and gave her to Joseph for a wife.
verses.text: And the king sent to Potiphera, the son of Ahiram priest of On, and he took his young daughter Osnath and gave her to Joseph for a wife.

verses.raw: And the damsel was very comely, a virgin, one whom man had not known, and Joseph took her for a wife; and the king said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and beside you none shall dare to lift up his hand or his foot to regulate my people throughout the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And the damsel was very comely, a virgin, one whom man had not known, and Joseph took her for a wife; and the king said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh, and beside you none shall dare to lift up his hand or his foot to regulate my people throughout the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh, and Joseph went out from before the king, and he became the king’s second in Egypt.
verses.text: And Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh, and Joseph went out from before the king, and he became the king’s second in Egypt.

verses.raw: And the king gave Joseph a hundred servants to attend him in his house, and Joseph also sent and purchased many servants and they remained in the house of Joseph.
verses.text: And the king gave Joseph a hundred servants to attend him in his house, and Joseph also sent and purchased many servants and they remained in the house of Joseph.

verses.raw: Joseph then built for himself a very magnificent house like to the houses of kings, before the court of the king’s palace, and he made in the house a large temple, very elegant in appearance and convenient for his residence; three years was Joseph in erecting his house.
verses.text: Joseph then built for himself a very magnificent house like to the houses of kings, before the court of the king’s palace, and he made in the house a large temple, very elegant in appearance and convenient for his residence; three years was Joseph in erecting his house.

verses.raw: And Joseph made to himself a very elegant throne of abundance of gold and silver, and he covered it with onyx stones and bdellium, and he made upon it the likeness of the whole land of Egypt, and the likeness of the river of Egypt that waters the whole land of Egypt; and Joseph sat securely upon his throne in his house and Yahuah (the Lord) increased Joseph’s wisdom.
verses.text: And Joseph made to himself a very elegant throne of abundance of gold and silver, and he covered it with onyx stones and bdellium, and he made upon it the likeness of the whole land of Egypt, and the likeness of the river of Egypt that waters the whole land of Egypt; and Joseph sat securely upon his throne in his house and Yahuah (the Lord) increased Joseph’s wisdom.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of Egypt and Pharaoh’s servants and his princes loved Joseph exceedingly, for this thing was from Yahuah (the Lord) to Joseph.
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of Egypt and Pharaoh’s servants and his princes loved Joseph exceedingly, for this thing was from Yahuah (the Lord) to Joseph.

verses.raw: And Joseph had an army that made war, going out in hosts and troops to the number of forty thousand six hundred men, capable of bearing arms to assist the king and Joseph against the enemy, besides the king’s officers and his servants and inhabitants of Egypt without number.
verses.text: And Joseph had an army that made war, going out in hosts and troops to the number of forty thousand six hundred men, capable of bearing arms to assist the king and Joseph against the enemy, besides the king’s officers and his servants and inhabitants of Egypt without number.

verses.raw: And Joseph gave to his mighty men, and to all his host, shields and javelins, and caps and coats of mail and stones for slinging.
verses.text: And Joseph gave to his mighty men, and to all his host, shields and javelins, and caps and coats of mail and stones for slinging.

verses.raw: At that time the children of Tarshish came against the sons of Ishmael, and made war with them, and the children of Tarshish spoiled the Ishmaelites for a long time.
verses.text: At that time the children of Tarshish came against the sons of Ishmael, and made war with them, and the children of Tarshish spoiled the Ishmaelites for a long time.

verses.raw: And the children of Ishmael were small in number in those days, and they could not prevail over the children of Tarshish, and they were sorely oppressed.
verses.text: And the children of Ishmael were small in number in those days, and they could not prevail over the children of Tarshish, and they were sorely oppressed.

verses.raw: And the old men of the Ishmaelites sent a record to the king of Egypt, saying, Send I pray you to your servants officers and hosts to help us to fight against the children of Tarshish, for we have been consuming away for a long time.
verses.text: And the old men of the Ishmaelites sent a record to the king of Egypt, saying, Send I pray you to your servants officers and hosts to help us to fight against the children of Tarshish, for we have been consuming away for a long time.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh sent Joseph with the mighty men and host which were with him, and also his mighty men from the king’s house.
verses.text: And Pharaoh sent Joseph with the mighty men and host which were with him, and also his mighty men from the king’s house.

verses.raw: And they went to the land of Havilah to the children of Ishmael, to assist them against the children of Tarshish, and the children of Ishmael fought with the children of Tarshish, and Joseph smote the Tarshishites and he subdued all their land, and the children of Ishmael dwell in it to this day.
verses.text: And they went to the land of Havilah to the children of Ishmael, to assist them against the children of Tarshish, and the children of Ishmael fought with the children of Tarshish, and Joseph smote the Tarshishites and he subdued all their land, and the children of Ishmael dwell in it to this day.

verses.raw: And when the land of Tarshish was subdued, all the Tarshishites ran away, and came on the border of their brethren the children of Javan, and Joseph with all his mighty men and host returned to Egypt, not one man of them missing.
verses.text: And when the land of Tarshish was subdued, all the Tarshishites ran away, and came on the border of their brethren the children of Javan, and Joseph with all his mighty men and host returned to Egypt, not one man of them missing.

verses.raw: And at the revolution of the year, in the second year of Joseph’s reigning over Egypt, Yahuah (the Lord) gave great plenty throughout the land for seven years as Joseph had spoken, for Yahuah (the Lord) blessed all the produce of the earth in those days for seven years, and they ate and were greatly satisfied.
verses.text: And at the revolution of the year, in the second year of Joseph’s reigning over Egypt, Yahuah (the Lord) gave great plenty throughout the land for seven years as Joseph had spoken, for Yahuah (the Lord) blessed all the produce of the earth in those days for seven years, and they ate and were greatly satisfied.

verses.raw: And Joseph at that time had officers under him, and they collected all the food of the good years, and heaped corn year by year, and they placed it in the treasuries of Joseph.
verses.text: And Joseph at that time had officers under him, and they collected all the food of the good years, and heaped corn year by year, and they placed it in the treasuries of Joseph.

verses.raw: And at any time when they gathered the food Joseph commanded that they should bring the corn in the ears, and also bring with it some of the soil of the field, that it should not spoil.
verses.text: And at any time when they gathered the food Joseph commanded that they should bring the corn in the ears, and also bring with it some of the soil of the field, that it should not spoil.

verses.raw: And Joseph did according to this year by year, and he heaped up corn like the sand of the sea for abundance, for his stores were immense and could not be numbered for abundance.
verses.text: And Joseph did according to this year by year, and he heaped up corn like the sand of the sea for abundance, for his stores were immense and could not be numbered for abundance.

verses.raw: And also all the inhabitants of Egypt gathered all sorts of food in their stores in great abundance during the seven good years, but they did not do to it as Joseph did.
verses.text: And also all the inhabitants of Egypt gathered all sorts of food in their stores in great abundance during the seven good years, but they did not do to it as Joseph did.

verses.raw: And all the food which Joseph and the Egyptians had gathered during the seven years of plenty, was secured for the land in stores for the seven years of famine, for the support of the whole land.
verses.text: And all the food which Joseph and the Egyptians had gathered during the seven years of plenty, was secured for the land in stores for the seven years of famine, for the support of the whole land.

verses.raw: And the inhabitants of Egypt filled each man his store and his concealed place with corn, to be for support during the famine.
verses.text: And the inhabitants of Egypt filled each man his store and his concealed place with corn, to be for support during the famine.

verses.raw: And Joseph placed all the food that he had gathered in all the cities of Egypt, and he closed all the stores and placed sentinels over them.
verses.text: And Joseph placed all the food that he had gathered in all the cities of Egypt, and he closed all the stores and placed sentinels over them.

verses.raw: And Joseph’s wife Osnath the daughter of Potiphera bare him two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, and Joseph was thirty-four years old when he begat them.
verses.text: And Joseph’s wife Osnath the daughter of Potiphera bare him two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, and Joseph was thirty-four years old when he begat them.

verses.raw: And the lads grew up and they went in his ways and in his instructions, they did not deviate from the way which their father taught them, either to the right or left.
verses.text: And the lads grew up and they went in his ways and in his instructions, they did not deviate from the way which their father taught them, either to the right or left.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with the lads, and they grew up and had understanding and skill in all wisdom and in all the affairs of government, and all the king’s officers and his great men of the inhabitants of Egypt exalted the lads, and they were brought up amongst the king’s children.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with the lads, and they grew up and had understanding and skill in all wisdom and in all the affairs of government, and all the king’s officers and his great men of the inhabitants of Egypt exalted the lads, and they were brought up amongst the king’s children.

verses.raw: And the seven years of plenty that were throughout the land were at an end, and the seven years of famine came after them as Joseph had spoken, and the famine was throughout the land.
verses.text: And the seven years of plenty that were throughout the land were at an end, and the seven years of famine came after them as Joseph had spoken, and the famine was throughout the land.

verses.raw: And all the people of Egypt saw that the famine had commenced in the land of Egypt, and all the people of Egypt opened their stores of corn for the famine prevailed over them.
verses.text: And all the people of Egypt saw that the famine had commenced in the land of Egypt, and all the people of Egypt opened their stores of corn for the famine prevailed over them.

verses.raw: And they found all the food that was in their stores, full of vermin and not fit to eat, and the famine prevailed throughout the land, and all the inhabitants of Egypt came and cried before Pharaoh, for the famine was heavy upon them.
verses.text: And they found all the food that was in their stores, full of vermin and not fit to eat, and the famine prevailed throughout the land, and all the inhabitants of Egypt came and cried before Pharaoh, for the famine was heavy upon them.

verses.raw: And they said to Pharaoh, Give food to your servants, and therefore shall we die through hunger before your eyes, even we and our little ones?
verses.text: And they said to Pharaoh, Give food to your servants, and therefore shall we die through hunger before your eyes, even we and our little ones?

verses.raw: And Pharaoh answered them, saying, And therefore do you cry to me? did not Joseph command that the corn should be laid up during the seven years of plenty for the years of famine? and therefore did you not hearken to his voice?
verses.text: And Pharaoh answered them, saying, And therefore do you cry to me? did not Joseph command that the corn should be laid up during the seven years of plenty for the years of famine? and therefore did you not hearken to his voice?

verses.raw: And the people of Egypt answered the king, saying, As your soul lives, our Lord, your servants have done all that Joseph ordered, for your servants also gathered in all the produce of their fields during the seven years of plenty and laid it in the stores to this day.
verses.text: And the people of Egypt answered the king, saying, As your soul lives, our Lord, your servants have done all that Joseph ordered, for your servants also gathered in all the produce of their fields during the seven years of plenty and laid it in the stores to this day.

verses.raw: And when the famine prevailed over your servants we opened our stores, and behold all our produce was filled with vermin and was not fit for food.
verses.text: And when the famine prevailed over your servants we opened our stores, and behold all our produce was filled with vermin and was not fit for food.

verses.raw: And when the king heard all that had befallen the inhabitants of Egypt, the king was greatly afraid on account of the famine, and he was much terrified; and the king answered the people of Egypt, saying, Since all this has happened to you, go to Joseph, do whatever he shall say to you, transgress not his commands.
verses.text: And when the king heard all that had befallen the inhabitants of Egypt, the king was greatly afraid on account of the famine, and he was much terrified; and the king answered the people of Egypt, saying, Since all this has happened to you, go to Joseph, do whatever he shall say to you, transgress not his commands.

verses.raw: And all the people of Egypt went forth and came to Joseph, and said to him, Give to us food, and therefore shall we die before you through hunger? for we gathered in our produce during the seven years as you did command, and we put it in store, and thus has it befallen us.
verses.text: And all the people of Egypt went forth and came to Joseph, and said to him, Give to us food, and therefore shall we die before you through hunger? for we gathered in our produce during the seven years as you did command, and we put it in store, and thus has it befallen us.

verses.raw: And when Joseph heard all the words of the people of Egypt and what had befallen them, Joseph opened all his stores of the produce and he sold it to the people of Egypt.
verses.text: And when Joseph heard all the words of the people of Egypt and what had befallen them, Joseph opened all his stores of the produce and he sold it to the people of Egypt.

verses.raw: And the famine prevailed throughout the land, and the famine was in all countries, but in the land of Egypt there was produce for sale.
verses.text: And the famine prevailed throughout the land, and the famine was in all countries, but in the land of Egypt there was produce for sale.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of Egypt came to Joseph to buy corn, for the famine prevailed over them, and all their corn was spoiled, and Joseph daily sold it to all the people of Egypt.
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of Egypt came to Joseph to buy corn, for the famine prevailed over them, and all their corn was spoiled, and Joseph daily sold it to all the people of Egypt.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of the land of Canaan and the Philistines, and those beyond the Jordan, and the children of the east and all the cities of the lands far and nigh heard that there was corn in Egypt, and they all came to Egypt to buy corn, for the famine prevailed over them.
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of the land of Canaan and the Philistines, and those beyond the Jordan, and the children of the east and all the cities of the lands far and nigh heard that there was corn in Egypt, and they all came to Egypt to buy corn, for the famine prevailed over them.

verses.raw: And Joseph opened the stores of corn and placed officers over them, and they daily stood and sold to all that came.
verses.text: And Joseph opened the stores of corn and placed officers over them, and they daily stood and sold to all that came.

verses.raw: And Joseph knew that his brethren also would come to Egypt to buy corn, for the famine prevailed throughout the earth. And Joseph commanded all his people that they should cause it to be proclaimed throughout the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.text: And Joseph knew that his brethren also would come to Egypt to buy corn, for the famine prevailed throughout the earth. And Joseph commanded all his people that they should cause it to be proclaimed throughout the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.raw: It is the pleasure of the king, of his second and of their great men, that any person who wishes to buy corn in Egypt shall not send his servants to Egypt to purchase, but his sons, and also any Egyptian or Canaanite, who shall come from any of the stores from buying corn in Egypt, and shall go and sell it throughout the land, he shall die, for no one shall buy but for the support of his household.
verses.text: It is the pleasure of the king, of his second and of their great men, that any person who wishes to buy corn in Egypt shall not send his servants to Egypt to purchase, but his sons, and also any Egyptian or Canaanite, who shall come from any of the stores from buying corn in Egypt, and shall go and sell it throughout the land, he shall die, for no one shall buy but for the support of his household.

verses.raw: And any man leading two or three beasts shall die, for a man shall only lead his own beast.
verses.text: And any man leading two or three beasts shall die, for a man shall only lead his own beast.

verses.raw: And Joseph placed sentinels at the gates of Egypt, and commanded them, saying, Any person who may come to buy corn, suffer him not to enter until his name, and the name of his father, and the name of his father’s father be written down, and whatever is written by day, send their names to me in the evening that I may know their names.
verses.text: And Joseph placed sentinels at the gates of Egypt, and commanded them, saying, Any person who may come to buy corn, suffer him not to enter until his name, and the name of his father, and the name of his father’s father be written down, and whatever is written by day, send their names to me in the evening that I may know their names.

verses.raw: And Joseph placed officers throughout the land of Egypt, and he commanded them to do all these things.
verses.text: And Joseph placed officers throughout the land of Egypt, and he commanded them to do all these things.

verses.raw: And Joseph did all these things, and made these statutes, in order that he might know when his brethren should come to Egypt to buy corn; and Joseph’s people caused it daily to be proclaimed in Egypt according to these words and statutes which Joseph had commanded.
verses.text: And Joseph did all these things, and made these statutes, in order that he might know when his brethren should come to Egypt to buy corn; and Joseph’s people caused it daily to be proclaimed in Egypt according to these words and statutes which Joseph had commanded.

verses.raw: And all the inhabitants of the east and west country, and of all the earth, heard of the statutes and regulations which Joseph had enacted in Egypt, and the inhabitants of the extreme parts of the earth came and they bought corn in Egypt day after day, and then went away.
verses.text: And all the inhabitants of the east and west country, and of all the earth, heard of the statutes and regulations which Joseph had enacted in Egypt, and the inhabitants of the extreme parts of the earth came and they bought corn in Egypt day after day, and then went away.

verses.raw: And all the officers of Egypt did as Joseph had commanded, and all that came to Egypt to buy corn, the gate keepers would write their names, and their fathers’ names, and daily bring them in the evening before Joseph.
verses.text: And all the officers of Egypt did as Joseph had commanded, and all that came to Egypt to buy corn, the gate keepers would write their names, and their fathers’ names, and daily bring them in the evening before Joseph.

verses.raw: And Jacob afterward heard that there was corn in Egypt, and he called to his sons to go to Egypt to buy corn, for upon them also did the famine prevail, and he called to his sons, saying,
verses.text: And Jacob afterward heard that there was corn in Egypt, and he called to his sons to go to Egypt to buy corn, for upon them also did the famine prevail, and he called to his sons, saying,

verses.raw: Behold I hear that there is corn in Egypt, and all the people of the earth go there to purchase, now therefore why will you show yourselves satisfied before the whole earth? go you also down to Egypt and buy us a little corn amongst those that come there, that we may not die.
verses.text: Behold I hear that there is corn in Egypt, and all the people of the earth go there to purchase, now therefore why will you show yourselves satisfied before the whole earth? go you also down to Egypt and buy us a little corn amongst those that come there, that we may not die.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob hearkened to the voice of their father, and they rose up to go down to Egypt in order to buy corn amongst the rest that came there.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob hearkened to the voice of their father, and they rose up to go down to Egypt in order to buy corn amongst the rest that came there.
