verses.raw: And Jacob their father commanded them, saying, When you come into the city do not enter together in one gate, on account of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text: And Jacob their father commanded them, saying, When you come into the city do not enter together in one gate, on account of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob went forth and they went to Egypt, and the sons of Jacob did all as their father had commanded them, and Jacob did not send Benjamin, for he said, Lest an accident might befall him on the road like his brother; and ten of Jacob’s sons went forth.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob went forth and they went to Egypt, and the sons of Jacob did all as their father had commanded them, and Jacob did not send Benjamin, for he said, Lest an accident might befall him on the road like his brother; and ten of Jacob’s sons went forth.

verses.raw: And whilst the sons of Jacob were going on the road, they repented of what they had done to Joseph, and they spoke to each other, saying, We know that our brother Joseph went down to Egypt, and now we will seek him where we go, and if we find him we will take him from his master for a ransom, and if not, by force, and we will die for him.
verses.text: And whilst the sons of Jacob were going on the road, they repented of what they had done to Joseph, and they spoke to each other, saying, We know that our brother Joseph went down to Egypt, and now we will seek him where we go, and if we find him we will take him from his master for a ransom, and if not, by force, and we will die for him.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob agreed to this thing and strengthened themselves on account of Joseph, to deliver him from the hand of his master, and the sons of Jacob went to Egypt; and when they came near to Egypt they separated from each other, and they came through ten gates of Egypt, and the gate keepers wrote their names on that day, and brought them to Joseph in the evening.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob agreed to this thing and strengthened themselves on account of Joseph, to deliver him from the hand of his master, and the sons of Jacob went to Egypt; and when they came near to Egypt they separated from each other, and they came through ten gates of Egypt, and the gate keepers wrote their names on that day, and brought them to Joseph in the evening.

verses.raw: And Joseph read the names from the hand of the gate-keepers of the city, and he found that his brethren had entered at the ten gates of the city, and Joseph at that time commanded that it should be proclaimed throughout the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.text: And Joseph read the names from the hand of the gate-keepers of the city, and he found that his brethren had entered at the ten gates of the city, and Joseph at that time commanded that it should be proclaimed throughout the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.raw: Go forth all you store guards, close all the corn stores and let only one remain open, that those who come may purchase from it.
verses.text: Go forth all you store guards, close all the corn stores and let only one remain open, that those who come may purchase from it.

verses.raw: And all the officers of Joseph did so at that time, and they closed all the stores and left only one open.
verses.text: And all the officers of Joseph did so at that time, and they closed all the stores and left only one open.

verses.raw: And Joseph gave the written names of his brethren to him that was set over the open store, and he said to him, Whosoever shall come to you to buy corn, ask his name, and when men of these names shall come before you, seize them and send them, and they did so.
verses.text: And Joseph gave the written names of his brethren to him that was set over the open store, and he said to him, Whosoever shall come to you to buy corn, ask his name, and when men of these names shall come before you, seize them and send them, and they did so.

verses.raw: And when the sons of Jacob came into the city, they joined together in the city to seek Joseph before they bought themselves corn.
verses.text: And when the sons of Jacob came into the city, they joined together in the city to seek Joseph before they bought themselves corn.

verses.raw: And they went to the walls of the harlots, and they sought Joseph in the walls of the harlots for three days, for they thought that Joseph would come in the walls of the harlots, for Joseph was very comely and well favored, and the sons of Jacob sought Joseph for three days, and they could not find him.
verses.text: And they went to the walls of the harlots, and they sought Joseph in the walls of the harlots for three days, for they thought that Joseph would come in the walls of the harlots, for Joseph was very comely and well favored, and the sons of Jacob sought Joseph for three days, and they could not find him.

verses.raw: And the man who was set over the open store sought for those names which Joseph had given him, and he did not find them.
verses.text: And the man who was set over the open store sought for those names which Joseph had given him, and he did not find them.

verses.raw: And he sent to Joseph, saying, These three days have passed, and those men whose names you did give to me have not come; and Joseph sent servants to seek the men in all Egypt, and to bring them before Joseph.
verses.text: And he sent to Joseph, saying, These three days have passed, and those men whose names you did give to me have not come; and Joseph sent servants to seek the men in all Egypt, and to bring them before Joseph.

verses.raw: And Joseph’s servants went and came into Egypt and could not find them, and went to Goshen and they were not there, and then went to the city of Rameses and could not find them.
verses.text: And Joseph’s servants went and came into Egypt and could not find them, and went to Goshen and they were not there, and then went to the city of Rameses and could not find them.

verses.raw: And Joseph continued to send sixteen servants to seek his brothers, and they went and spread themselves in the four corners of the city, and four of the servants went into the house of the harlots, and they found the ten men there seeking their brother.
verses.text: And Joseph continued to send sixteen servants to seek his brothers, and they went and spread themselves in the four corners of the city, and four of the servants went into the house of the harlots, and they found the ten men there seeking their brother.

verses.raw: And those four men took them and brought them before him, and they bowed down to him to the ground, and Joseph was sitting upon his throne in his temple, clothed with princely garments, and upon his head was a large crown of gold, and all the mighty men were sitting around him.
verses.text: And those four men took them and brought them before him, and they bowed down to him to the ground, and Joseph was sitting upon his throne in his temple, clothed with princely garments, and upon his head was a large crown of gold, and all the mighty men were sitting around him.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob saw Joseph, and his figure and comeliness and dignity of countenance seemed wonderful in their eyes, and they again bowed down to him to the ground.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob saw Joseph, and his figure and comeliness and dignity of countenance seemed wonderful in their eyes, and they again bowed down to him to the ground.

verses.raw: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but they knew him not, for Joseph was very great in their eyes, therefore they knew him not.
verses.text: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but they knew him not, for Joseph was very great in their eyes, therefore they knew him not.

verses.raw: And Joseph spoke to them, saying, From whence come you? and they all answered and said, Your servants have come from the land of Canaan to buy corn, for the famine prevails throughout the earth, and your servants heard that there was corn in Egypt, so they have come amongst the other comers to buy corn for their support.
verses.text: And Joseph spoke to them, saying, From whence come you? and they all answered and said, Your servants have come from the land of Canaan to buy corn, for the famine prevails throughout the earth, and your servants heard that there was corn in Egypt, so they have come amongst the other comers to buy corn for their support.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered them, saying, If you have come to purchase as you say, why do you come through ten gates of the city? it can only be that you have come to spy through the land.
verses.text: And Joseph answered them, saying, If you have come to purchase as you say, why do you come through ten gates of the city? it can only be that you have come to spy through the land.

verses.raw: And they all together answered Joseph, and said, Not so my Lord, we are right, your servants are not spies, but we have come to buy corn, for your servants are all brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan, and our father commanded us, saying, When you come to the city do not enter together at one gate on account of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text: And they all together answered Joseph, and said, Not so my Lord, we are right, your servants are not spies, but we have come to buy corn, for your servants are all brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan, and our father commanded us, saying, When you come to the city do not enter together at one gate on account of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.raw: And Joseph again answered them and said, That is the thing which I spoke to you, you have come to spy through the land, therefore you all came through ten gates of the city; you have come to see the nakedness of the land.
verses.text: And Joseph again answered them and said, That is the thing which I spoke to you, you have come to spy through the land, therefore you all came through ten gates of the city; you have come to see the nakedness of the land.

verses.raw: Surely every one that comes to buy corn goes his way, and you are already three days in the land, and what do you do in the walls of harlots in which you have been for these three days? surely spies do like to these things.
verses.text: Surely every one that comes to buy corn goes his way, and you are already three days in the land, and what do you do in the walls of harlots in which you have been for these three days? surely spies do like to these things.

verses.raw: And they said to Joseph, Far be it from our Lord to speak thus, for we are twelve brothers, the sons of our father Jacob, in the land of Canaan, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the Hebrew, and behold the youngest is with our father this day in the land of Canaan, and one is not, for he was lost from us, and we thought perhaps he might be in this land, so we are seeking him throughout the land, and have come even to the houses of harlots to seek him there.
verses.text: And they said to Joseph, Far be it from our Lord to speak thus, for we are twelve brothers, the sons of our father Jacob, in the land of Canaan, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the Hebrew, and behold the youngest is with our father this day in the land of Canaan, and one is not, for he was lost from us, and we thought perhaps he might be in this land, so we are seeking him throughout the land, and have come even to the houses of harlots to seek him there.

verses.raw: And Joseph said to them, And have you then sought him throughout the earth, that there only remained Egypt for you to seek him in? And what also should your brother do in the houses of harlots, although he were in Egypt? have you not said, That you are from the sons of Isaac, the son of Abraham, and what shall the sons of Jacob do then in the houses of harlots?
verses.text: And Joseph said to them, And have you then sought him throughout the earth, that there only remained Egypt for you to seek him in? And what also should your brother do in the houses of harlots, although he were in Egypt? have you not said, That you are from the sons of Isaac, the son of Abraham, and what shall the sons of Jacob do then in the houses of harlots?

verses.raw: And they said to him, Because we heard that Ishmaelites stole him from us, and it was told to us that they sold him in Egypt, and your servant, our brother, is very comely and well favored, so we thought he would surely be in the houses of harlots, therefore your servants went there to seek him and give ransom for him.
verses.text: And they said to him, Because we heard that Ishmaelites stole him from us, and it was told to us that they sold him in Egypt, and your servant, our brother, is very comely and well favored, so we thought he would surely be in the houses of harlots, therefore your servants went there to seek him and give ransom for him.

verses.raw: And Joseph still answered them, saying, Surely you speak falsely and utter lies, to say of yourselves that you are the sons of Abraham; as Pharaoh lives you are spies, therefore have you come to the houses of harlots that you should not be known.
verses.text: And Joseph still answered them, saying, Surely you speak falsely and utter lies, to say of yourselves that you are the sons of Abraham; as Pharaoh lives you are spies, therefore have you come to the houses of harlots that you should not be known.

verses.raw: And Joseph said to them, And now if you find him, and his master requires of you a great price, will you give it for him? and they said, It shall be given.
verses.text: And Joseph said to them, And now if you find him, and his master requires of you a great price, will you give it for him? and they said, It shall be given.

verses.raw: And he said to them, And if his master will not consent to part with him for a great price, what will you do to him on his account? and they answered him, saying, If he will not give him to us we will slay him, and take our brother and go away.
verses.text: And he said to them, And if his master will not consent to part with him for a great price, what will you do to him on his account? and they answered him, saying, If he will not give him to us we will slay him, and take our brother and go away.

verses.raw: And Joseph said to them, That is the thing which I have spoken to you; you are spies, for you are come to slay the inhabitants of the land, for we heard that two of your brethren smote all the inhabitants of Shechem, in the land of Canaan, on account of your sister, and you now come to do the like in Egypt on account of your brother.
verses.text: And Joseph said to them, That is the thing which I have spoken to you; you are spies, for you are come to slay the inhabitants of the land, for we heard that two of your brethren smote all the inhabitants of Shechem, in the land of Canaan, on account of your sister, and you now come to do the like in Egypt on account of your brother.

verses.raw: Only hereby shall I know that you are true men; if you will send home one from amongst you to fetch your youngest brother from your father, and to bring him here to me, and by doing this thing I will know that you are right.
verses.text: Only hereby shall I know that you are true men; if you will send home one from amongst you to fetch your youngest brother from your father, and to bring him here to me, and by doing this thing I will know that you are right.

verses.raw: And Joseph called to seventy of his mighty men, and he said to them, Take these men and bring them into the ward.
verses.text: And Joseph called to seventy of his mighty men, and he said to them, Take these men and bring them into the ward.

verses.raw: And the mighty men took the ten men, they laid hold of them and put them into the ward, and they were in the ward three days.
verses.text: And the mighty men took the ten men, they laid hold of them and put them into the ward, and they were in the ward three days.

verses.raw: And on the third day Joseph had them brought out of the ward, and he said to them, Do this for yourselves if you be true men, so that you may live, one of your brethren shall be confined in the ward whilst you go and take home the corn for your household to the land of Canaan, and fetch your youngest brother, and bring him here to me, that I may know that you are true men when you do this thing.
verses.text: And on the third day Joseph had them brought out of the ward, and he said to them, Do this for yourselves if you be true men, so that you may live, one of your brethren shall be confined in the ward whilst you go and take home the corn for your household to the land of Canaan, and fetch your youngest brother, and bring him here to me, that I may know that you are true men when you do this thing.

verses.raw: And Joseph went out from them and came into the chamber, and wept a great weeping, for his pity was excited for them, and he washed his face, and returned to them again, and he took Simeon from them and ordered him to be bound, but Simeon was not willing to be done so, for he was a very powerful man and they could not bind him.
verses.text: And Joseph went out from them and came into the chamber, and wept a great weeping, for his pity was excited for them, and he washed his face, and returned to them again, and he took Simeon from them and ordered him to be bound, but Simeon was not willing to be done so, for he was a very powerful man and they could not bind him.

verses.raw: And Joseph called to his mighty men and seventy valiant men came before him with drawn swords in their hands, and the sons of Jacob were terrified at them.
verses.text: And Joseph called to his mighty men and seventy valiant men came before him with drawn swords in their hands, and the sons of Jacob were terrified at them.

verses.raw: And Joseph said to them, Seize this man and confine him in prison until his brethren come to him, and Joseph’s valiant men hastened and they all laid hold of Simeon to bind him, and Simeon gave a loud and terrible shriek and the cry was heard at a distance.
verses.text: And Joseph said to them, Seize this man and confine him in prison until his brethren come to him, and Joseph’s valiant men hastened and they all laid hold of Simeon to bind him, and Simeon gave a loud and terrible shriek and the cry was heard at a distance.

verses.raw: And all the valiant men of Joseph were terrified at the sound of the shriek, that they fell upon their faces, and they were greatly afraid and fled.
verses.text: And all the valiant men of Joseph were terrified at the sound of the shriek, that they fell upon their faces, and they were greatly afraid and fled.

verses.raw: And all the men that were with Joseph fled, for they were greatly afraid of their lives, and only Joseph and Manasseh his son remained there, and Manassah the son of Joseph saw the strength of Simeon, and he was exceedingly wroth.
verses.text: And all the men that were with Joseph fled, for they were greatly afraid of their lives, and only Joseph and Manasseh his son remained there, and Manassah the son of Joseph saw the strength of Simeon, and he was exceedingly wroth.

verses.raw: And Manassah the son of Joseph rose up to Simeon, and Manassah smote Simeon a heavy blow with his fist against the back of his neck, and Simeon was stilled of his rage.
verses.text: And Manassah the son of Joseph rose up to Simeon, and Manassah smote Simeon a heavy blow with his fist against the back of his neck, and Simeon was stilled of his rage.

verses.raw: And Manassah laid hold of Simeon and he seized him violently and he bound him and brought him into the house of confinement, and all the sons of Jacob were astonished at the act of the youth.
verses.text: And Manassah laid hold of Simeon and he seized him violently and he bound him and brought him into the house of confinement, and all the sons of Jacob were astonished at the act of the youth.

verses.raw: And Simeon said to his brethren, None of you must say that this is the smiting of an Egyptian, but it is the smiting of the house of my father.
verses.text: And Simeon said to his brethren, None of you must say that this is the smiting of an Egyptian, but it is the smiting of the house of my father.

verses.raw: And after this Joseph ordered him to be called who was set over the storehouse, to fill their sacks with corn as much as they could carry, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the road, and thus did he to them.
verses.text: And after this Joseph ordered him to be called who was set over the storehouse, to fill their sacks with corn as much as they could carry, and to restore every man’s money into his sack, and to give them provision for the road, and thus did he to them.

verses.raw: And Joseph commanded them, saying, Take heed lest you transgress my orders to bring your brother as I have told you, and it shall be when you bring your brother here to me, then will I know that you are true men, and you shall traffic in the land, and I will restore to you your brother, and you shall return in peace to your father.
verses.text: And Joseph commanded them, saying, Take heed lest you transgress my orders to bring your brother as I have told you, and it shall be when you bring your brother here to me, then will I know that you are true men, and you shall traffic in the land, and I will restore to you your brother, and you shall return in peace to your father.

verses.raw: And they all answered and said, According as our Lord speaks so will we do, and they bowed down to him to the ground.
verses.text: And they all answered and said, According as our Lord speaks so will we do, and they bowed down to him to the ground.

verses.raw: And every man lifted his corn upon his ass, and they went out to go to the land of Canaan to their father; and they came to the inn and Levi spread his sack to give provender to his ass, when he saw and behold his money in full weight was still in his sack.
verses.text: And every man lifted his corn upon his ass, and they went out to go to the land of Canaan to their father; and they came to the inn and Levi spread his sack to give provender to his ass, when he saw and behold his money in full weight was still in his sack.

verses.raw: And the man was greatly afraid, and he said to his brethren, My money is restored, and lo, it is even in my sack, and the men were greatly afraid, and they said, What is this that Elohim (God) has done to us?
verses.text: And the man was greatly afraid, and he said to his brethren, My money is restored, and lo, it is even in my sack, and the men were greatly afraid, and they said, What is this that Elohim has done to us?

verses.raw: And they all said, And where is Yahuah (the Lord)’s kindness with our fathers, with Abraham, Isaac, end Jacob, that Yahuah (the Lord) has this day delivered us into the hands of the king of Egypt to contrive against us?
verses.text: And they all said, And where is Yahuah (the Lord)’s kindness with our fathers, with Abraham, Isaac, end Jacob, that Yahuah (the Lord) has this day delivered us into the hands of the king of Egypt to contrive against us?

verses.raw: And Judah said to them, Surely we are guilty sinners before Yahuah our Elohim (the Lord our God) in having sold our brother, our own flesh, and therefore do you say, Where is Yahuah’s kindness with our fathers?
verses.text: And Judah said to them, Surely we are guilty sinners before Yahuah our Elohim in having sold our brother, our own flesh, and therefore do you say, Where is Yahuah’s kindness with our fathers?

verses.raw: And Reuben said to them, Said I not to you, do not sin against the lad, and you would not listen to me? now Elohim requires him from us, and how dare you say, Where is Yahuah’s kindness with our fathers, whilst you have sinned to Yahuah (the Lord)?
verses.text: And Reuben said to them, Said I not to you, do not sin against the lad, and you would not listen to me? now Elohim requires him from us, and how dare you say, Where is Yahuah’s kindness with our fathers, whilst you have sinned to Yahuah (the Lord)?

verses.raw: And they tarried over night in that place, and they rose up early in the morning and laded their asses with their corn, and they led them and went on and came to their father’s house in the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And they tarried over night in that place, and they rose up early in the morning and laded their asses with their corn, and they led them and went on and came to their father’s house in the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Jacob and his household went out to meet his sons, and Jacob saw and behold their brother Simeon was not with them, and Jacob said to his sons, Where is your brother Simeon, whom I do not see? and his sons told him all that had befallen them in Egypt.
verses.text: And Jacob and his household went out to meet his sons, and Jacob saw and behold their brother Simeon was not with them, and Jacob said to his sons, Where is your brother Simeon, whom I do not see? and his sons told him all that had befallen them in Egypt.

verses.raw: And they entered their house, and every man opened his sack and they saw and behold every man’s bundle of money was there, at which they and their father were greatly terrified.
verses.text: And they entered their house, and every man opened his sack and they saw and behold every man’s bundle of money was there, at which they and their father were greatly terrified.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to them, What is this that you have done to me? I sent your brother Joseph to inquire after your welfare and you said to me. A wild beast did devour him.
verses.text: And Jacob said to them, What is this that you have done to me? I sent your brother Joseph to inquire after your welfare and you said to me. A wild beast did devour him.

verses.raw: And Simeon went with you to buy food and you say the king of Egypt has confined him in prison, and you wish to take Benjamin to cause his death also, and bring down my grey hairs with sorrow to the grave on account of Benjamin and his brother Joseph.
verses.text: And Simeon went with you to buy food and you say the king of Egypt has confined him in prison, and you wish to take Benjamin to cause his death also, and bring down my grey hairs with sorrow to the grave on account of Benjamin and his brother Joseph.

verses.raw: Now therefore my son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead and he is left alone, and mischief may befall him by the way in which you go, as it befell his brother.
verses.text: Now therefore my son shall not go down with you, for his brother is dead and he is left alone, and mischief may befall him by the way in which you go, as it befell his brother.

verses.raw: And Reuben said to his father, You shall slay my two sons if I do not bring your son and place him before you; and Jacob said to his sons, Abide you here and do not go down to Egypt, for my son shall not go down with you to Egypt, nor die like his brother.
verses.text: And Reuben said to his father, You shall slay my two sons if I do not bring your son and place him before you; and Jacob said to his sons, Abide you here and do not go down to Egypt, for my son shall not go down with you to Egypt, nor die like his brother.

verses.raw: And Judah said to them, refrain you from him until the corn is finished, and he will then say, Take down your brother, when he will find his own life and the life of his household in danger from the famine.
verses.text: And Judah said to them, refrain you from him until the corn is finished, and he will then say, Take down your brother, when he will find his own life and the life of his household in danger from the famine.

verses.raw: And in those days the famine was sore throughout the land, and all the people of the earth went and came to Egypt to buy food, for the famine prevailed greatly amongst them, and the sons of Jacob remained in Canaan a year and two months until their corn was finished.
verses.text: And in those days the famine was sore throughout the land, and all the people of the earth went and came to Egypt to buy food, for the famine prevailed greatly amongst them, and the sons of Jacob remained in Canaan a year and two months until their corn was finished.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after their corn was finished, the whole household of Jacob was pinched with hunger, and all the infants of the sons of Jacob came together and they approached Jacob, and they all surrounded him, and they said to him, Give to us bread, and therefore shall we all perish through hunger in your presence?
verses.text: And it came to pass after their corn was finished, the whole household of Jacob was pinched with hunger, and all the infants of the sons of Jacob came together and they approached Jacob, and they all surrounded him, and they said to him, Give to us bread, and therefore shall we all perish through hunger in your presence?

verses.raw: Jacob heard the words of his son’s children, and he wept a great weeping, and his pity was roused for them, and Jacob called to his sons and they all came and sat before him.
verses.text: Jacob heard the words of his son’s children, and he wept a great weeping, and his pity was roused for them, and Jacob called to his sons and they all came and sat before him.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to them, And have you not seen how your children have been weeping over me this day, saying, Give to us bread, and there is none? now therefore return and buy for us a little food.
verses.text: And Jacob said to them, And have you not seen how your children have been weeping over me this day, saying, Give to us bread, and there is none? now therefore return and buy for us a little food.

verses.raw: And Judah answered and said to his father, If you will send our brother with us we will go down and buy corn for you, and if you will not send him then we will not go down, for surely the king of Egypt particularly enjoined us, saying, You shall not see my face unless your brother be with you, for the king of Egypt is a strong and mighty king, and behold if we shall go to him without our brother we shall all be put to death.
verses.text: And Judah answered and said to his father, If you will send our brother with us we will go down and buy corn for you, and if you will not send him then we will not go down, for surely the king of Egypt particularly enjoined us, saying, You shall not see my face unless your brother be with you, for the king of Egypt is a strong and mighty king, and behold if we shall go to him without our brother we shall all be put to death.

verses.raw: Dost you not know and have you not heard that this king is very powerful and wise, and there is not like to him in all the earth? behold we have seen all the kings of the earth and we have not seen one like that king, the king of Egypt; surely amongst all the kings of the earth there is none greater than Abimelech king of the Philistines, yet the king of Egypt is greater and mightier than he, and Abimelech can only be compared to one of his officers.
verses.text: Dost you not know and have you not heard that this king is very powerful and wise, and there is not like to him in all the earth? behold we have seen all the kings of the earth and we have not seen one like that king, the king of Egypt; surely amongst all the kings of the earth there is none greater than Abimelech king of the Philistines, yet the king of Egypt is greater and mightier than he, and Abimelech can only be compared to one of his officers.

verses.raw: Father, you have not seen his palace and his throne, and all his servants standing before him; you have not seen that king upon his throne in his pomp and royal appearance, dressed in his kingly robes with a large golden crown upon his head; you have not seen the honor and glory which Elohim (God) has given to him, for there is not like to him in all the earth.
verses.text: Father, you have not seen his palace and his throne, and all his servants standing before him; you have not seen that king upon his throne in his pomp and royal appearance, dressed in his kingly robes with a large golden crown upon his head; you have not seen the honor and glory which Elohim has given to him, for there is not like to him in all the earth.

verses.raw: Father, you have not seen the wisdom, the understanding and the knowledge which Elohim has given in his heart, nor heard his sweet voice when he spoke to us.
verses.text: Father, you have not seen the wisdom, the understanding and the knowledge which Elohim has given in his heart, nor heard his sweet voice when he spoke to us.

verses.raw: We know not, father, who made him acquainted with our names and all that befell us, yet he asked also after you, saying, Is your father still living, and is it well with him?
verses.text: We know not, father, who made him acquainted with our names and all that befell us, yet he asked also after you, saying, Is your father still living, and is it well with him?

verses.raw: You have not seen the affairs of the government of Egypt regulated by him, without inquiring of Pharaoh his Lord; you have not seen the awe and fear which he impressed upon all the Egyptians.
verses.text: You have not seen the affairs of the government of Egypt regulated by him, without inquiring of Pharaoh his Lord; you have not seen the awe and fear which he impressed upon all the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And also when we went from him, we threatened to do to Egypt like to the rest of the cities of the Amorites, and we were exceedingly wroth against all his words which he spoke concerning us as spies, and now when we shall again come before him his terror will fall upon us all, and not one of us will be able to speak to him either a little or a great thing.
verses.text: And also when we went from him, we threatened to do to Egypt like to the rest of the cities of the Amorites, and we were exceedingly wroth against all his words which he spoke concerning us as spies, and now when we shall again come before him his terror will fall upon us all, and not one of us will be able to speak to him either a little or a great thing.

verses.raw: Now therefore father, send we pray you the lad with us, and we will go down and buy you food for our support, and not die through hunger. And Jacob said, Why have you dealt so ill with me to tell the king you had a brother? what is this thing that you have done to me?
verses.text: Now therefore father, send we pray you the lad with us, and we will go down and buy you food for our support, and not die through hunger. And Jacob said, Why have you dealt so ill with me to tell the king you had a brother? what is this thing that you have done to me?

verses.raw: And Judah said to Jacob his father, Give the lad into my care and we will rise up and go down to Egypt and buy corn, and then return, and it shall be when we return if the lad be not with us, then let me bear your blame forever.
verses.text: And Judah said to Jacob his father, Give the lad into my care and we will rise up and go down to Egypt and buy corn, and then return, and it shall be when we return if the lad be not with us, then let me bear your blame forever.

verses.raw: Have you seen all our infants weeping over you through hunger and there is no power in your hand to satisfy them? now let your pity be roused for them and send our brother with us and we will go.
verses.text: Have you seen all our infants weeping over you through hunger and there is no power in your hand to satisfy them? now let your pity be roused for them and send our brother with us and we will go.

verses.raw: For how will Yahuah (the Lord)’s kindness to our ancestors be manifested to you when you say that the king of Egypt will take away your son? as Yahuah (the Lord) lives I will not leave him until I bring him and place him before you; but pray for us to Yahuah (the Lord), that he may deal kindly with us, to cause us to be received favorably and kindly before the king of Egypt and his men, for had we not delayed surely now we had returned a second time with your son.
verses.text: For how will Yahuah (the Lord)’s kindness to our ancestors be manifested to you when you say that the king of Egypt will take away your son? as Yahuah (the Lord) lives I will not leave him until I bring him and place him before you; but pray for us to Yahuah (the Lord), that he may deal kindly with us, to cause us to be received favorably and kindly before the king of Egypt and his men, for had we not delayed surely now we had returned a second time with your son.

verses.raw: And Jacob said to his sons, I trust in Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) that he may deliver you and give you favor in the sight of the king of Egypt, and in the sight of all his men.
verses.text: And Jacob said to his sons, I trust in Yahuah Elohim that he may deliver you and give you favor in the sight of the king of Egypt, and in the sight of all his men.

verses.raw: Now therefore rise up and go to the man, and take for him in your hands a present from what can be obtained in the land and bring it before him, and may El Shaddai (the Almighty God) give you mercy before him that he may send Benjamin and Simeon your brethren with you.
verses.text: Now therefore rise up and go to the man, and take for him in your hands a present from what can be obtained in the land and bring it before him, and may El Shaddai (the Almighty God) give you mercy before him that he may send Benjamin and Simeon your brethren with you.

verses.raw: And all the men rose up, and they took their brother Benjamin, and they took in their hands a large present of the best of the land, and they also took a double portion of silver.
verses.text: And all the men rose up, and they took their brother Benjamin, and they took in their hands a large present of the best of the land, and they also took a double portion of silver.

verses.raw: And Jacob strictly commanded his sons concerning Benjamin, Saying, Take heed of him in the way in which you are going, and do not separate yourselves from him in the road, neither in Egypt.
verses.text: And Jacob strictly commanded his sons concerning Benjamin, Saying, Take heed of him in the way in which you are going, and do not separate yourselves from him in the road, neither in Egypt.

verses.raw: And Jacob rose up from his sons and spread forth his hands and he prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) on account of his sons, saying, O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) of heaven and earth, remember your covenant with our father Abraham, remember it with my father Isaac and deal kindly with my sons and deliver them not into the hands of the king of Egypt; do it I pray you O Elohim (God) for the sake of your mercies and redeem all my children and rescue them from Egyptian power, and send them their two brothers.
verses.text: And Jacob rose up from his sons and spread forth his hands and he prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) on account of his sons, saying, O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) of heaven and earth, remember your covenant with our father Abraham, remember it with my father Isaac and deal kindly with my sons and deliver them not into the hands of the king of Egypt; do it I pray you O Elohim for the sake of your mercies and redeem all my children and rescue them from Egyptian power, and send them their two brothers.

verses.raw: And all the wives of the sons of Jacob and their children lifted up their eyes to heaven and they all wept before Yahuah (the Lord), and cried to him to deliver their fathers from the hand of the king of Egypt.
verses.text: And all the wives of the sons of Jacob and their children lifted up their eyes to heaven and they all wept before Yahuah (the Lord), and cried to him to deliver their fathers from the hand of the king of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Jacob wrote a record to the king of Egypt and gave it into the hand of Judah and into the hands of his sons for the king of Egypt, saying,
verses.text: And Jacob wrote a record to the king of Egypt and gave it into the hand of Judah and into the hands of his sons for the king of Egypt, saying,

verses.raw: From your servant Jacob, son of Isaac, son of Abraham the Hebrew, the prince of Elohim, to the powerful and wise king, the revealer of secrets, king of Egypt, greeting.
verses.text: From your servant Jacob, son of Isaac, son of Abraham the Hebrew, the prince of Elohim, to the powerful and wise king, the revealer of secrets, king of Egypt, greeting.

verses.raw: Be it known to my Lord the king of Egypt, the famine was sore upon us in the land of Canaan, and I sent my sons to you to buy us a little food from you for our support.
verses.text: Be it known to my Lord the king of Egypt, the famine was sore upon us in the land of Canaan, and I sent my sons to you to buy us a little food from you for our support.

verses.raw: For my sons surrounded me and I being very old cannot see with my eyes, for my eyes have become very heavy through age, as well as with daily weeping for my son, for Joseph who was lost from before me, and I commanded my sons that they should not enter the gates of the city when they came to Egypt, on account of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.text: For my sons surrounded me and I being very old cannot see with my eyes, for my eyes have become very heavy through age, as well as with daily weeping for my son, for Joseph who was lost from before me, and I commanded my sons that they should not enter the gates of the city when they came to Egypt, on account of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.raw: And I also commanded them to go about Egypt to seek for my son Joseph, perhaps they might find him there, and they did so, and you did consider them as spies of the land.
verses.text: And I also commanded them to go about Egypt to seek for my son Joseph, perhaps they might find him there, and they did so, and you did consider them as spies of the land.

verses.raw: Have we not heard concerning you that you did interpret Pharaoh’s dream and did speak truly to him? how then dost you not know in your wisdom whether my sons are spies or not?
verses.text: Have we not heard concerning you that you did interpret Pharaoh’s dream and did speak truly to him? how then dost you not know in your wisdom whether my sons are spies or not?

verses.raw: Now therefore, my Lord and king, behold I have sent my son before you, as you did speak to my sons; I beseech you to put your eyes upon him until he is returned to me in peace with his brethren.
verses.text: Now therefore, my Lord and king, behold I have sent my son before you, as you did speak to my sons; I beseech you to put your eyes upon him until he is returned to me in peace with his brethren.

verses.raw: For dost you not know, or have you not heard that which our Elohim did to Pharaoh when he took my mother Sarah, and what he did to Abimelech king of the Philistines on account of her, and also what our father Abraham did to the nine kings of Elam, how he smote them all with a few men that were with him?
verses.text: For dost you not know, or have you not heard that which our Elohim did to Pharaoh when he took my mother Sarah, and what he did to Abimelech king of the Philistines on account of her, and also what our father Abraham did to the nine kings of Elam, how he smote them all with a few men that were with him?

verses.raw: And also what my two sons Simeon and Levi did to the eight cities of the Amorites, how they destroyed them on account of their sister Dinah?
verses.text: And also what my two sons Simeon and Levi did to the eight cities of the Amorites, how they destroyed them on account of their sister Dinah?

verses.raw: And also on account of their brother Benjamin they consoled themselves for the loss of his brother Joseph; what will they then do for him when they see the hand of any people prevailing over them, for his sake?
verses.text: And also on account of their brother Benjamin they consoled themselves for the loss of his brother Joseph; what will they then do for him when they see the hand of any people prevailing over them, for his sake?

verses.raw: Dost you not know, O king of Egypt, that the power of Elohim is with us, and that also Elohim ever hears our prayers and forsakes us not all the days?
verses.text: Dost you not know, O king of Egypt, that the power of Elohim is with us, and that also Elohim ever hears our prayers and forsakes us not all the days?

verses.raw: And when my sons told me of your dealings with them, I called not to Yahuah (the Lord) on account of you, for then you would have perished with your men before my son Benjamin came before you, but I thought that as Simeon my son was in your house, perhaps you might deal kindly with him, therefore I did not this thing to you.
verses.text: And when my sons told me of your dealings with them, I called not to Yahuah (the Lord) on account of you, for then you would have perished with your men before my son Benjamin came before you, but I thought that as Simeon my son was in your house, perhaps you might deal kindly with him, therefore I did not this thing to you.

verses.raw: Now therefore behold Benjamin my son comes to you with my sons, take heed of him and put your eyes upon him, and then will Elohim place his eyes over you and throughout your kingdom.
verses.text: Now therefore behold Benjamin my son comes to you with my sons, take heed of him and put your eyes upon him, and then will Elohim place his eyes over you and throughout your kingdom.

verses.raw: Now I have told you all that is in my heart, and behold my sons are coming to you with their brother, examine the face of the whole earth for their sake and send them back in peace with their brethren.
verses.text: Now I have told you all that is in my heart, and behold my sons are coming to you with their brother, examine the face of the whole earth for their sake and send them back in peace with their brethren.

verses.raw: And Jacob gave the record to his sons into the care of Judah to give it to the king of Egypt.
verses.text: And Jacob gave the record to his sons into the care of Judah to give it to the king of Egypt.

verses.raw: And the sons of Jacob rose up and took Benjamin and the whole of the presents, and they went and came to Egypt and they stood before Joseph.
verses.text: And the sons of Jacob rose up and took Benjamin and the whole of the presents, and they went and came to Egypt and they stood before Joseph.

verses.raw: And Joseph beheld his brother Benjamin with them and he saluted them, and these men came to Joseph’s house.
verses.text: And Joseph beheld his brother Benjamin with them and he saluted them, and these men came to Joseph’s house.

verses.raw: And Joseph commanded the superintendent of his house to give to his brethren to eat, and he did so to them.
verses.text: And Joseph commanded the superintendent of his house to give to his brethren to eat, and he did so to them.

verses.raw: And at noon time Joseph sent for the men to come before him with Benjamin, and the men told the superintendent of Joseph’s house concerning the silver that was returned in their sacks, and he said to them, It will be well with you, fear not, and he brought their brother Simeon to them.
verses.text: And at noon time Joseph sent for the men to come before him with Benjamin, and the men told the superintendent of Joseph’s house concerning the silver that was returned in their sacks, and he said to them, It will be well with you, fear not, and he brought their brother Simeon to them.

verses.raw: And Simeon said to his brethren, The lord of the Egyptians has acted very kindly to me, he did not keep me bound, as you saw with your eyes, for when you went out from the city he let me free and dealt kindly with me in his house.
verses.text: And Simeon said to his brethren, The lord of the Egyptians has acted very kindly to me, he did not keep me bound, as you saw with your eyes, for when you went out from the city he let me free and dealt kindly with me in his house.

verses.raw: And Judah took Benjamin by the hand, and they came before Joseph, and they bowed down to him to the ground.
verses.text: And Judah took Benjamin by the hand, and they came before Joseph, and they bowed down to him to the ground.

verses.raw: And the men gave the present to Joseph and they all sat before him, and Joseph said to them, Is it well with you, is it well with your children, is it well with your aged father? and they said, It is well, and Judah took the record which Jacob had sent and gave it into the hand of Joseph.
verses.text: And the men gave the present to Joseph and they all sat before him, and Joseph said to them, Is it well with you, is it well with your children, is it well with your aged father? and they said, It is well, and Judah took the record which Jacob had sent and gave it into the hand of Joseph.

verses.raw: And Joseph read the letter and knew his father’s writing, and he wished to weep and he went into an inner room and he wept a great weeping; and he went out.
verses.text: And Joseph read the letter and knew his father’s writing, and he wished to weep and he went into an inner room and he wept a great weeping; and he went out.

verses.raw: And he lifted up his eyes and beheld his brother Benjamin, and he said, Is this your brother of whom you spoke to me? And Benjamin approached Joseph, and Joseph placed his hand upon his head and he said to him, May Elohim (God) be gracious to you my son.
verses.text: And he lifted up his eyes and beheld his brother Benjamin, and he said, Is this your brother of whom you spoke to me? And Benjamin approached Joseph, and Joseph placed his hand upon his head and he said to him, May Elohim be gracious to you my son.

verses.raw: And when Joseph saw his brother, the son of his mother, he again wished to weep, and he entered the chamber, and he wept there, and he washed his face, and went out and refrained from weeping, and he said, Prepare food.
verses.text: And when Joseph saw his brother, the son of his mother, he again wished to weep, and he entered the chamber, and he wept there, and he washed his face, and went out and refrained from weeping, and he said, Prepare food.

verses.raw: And Joseph had a cup from which he drank, and it was of silver beautifully inlaid with onyx stones and bdellium, and Joseph struck the cup in the sight of his brethren whilst they were sitting to eat with him.
verses.text: And Joseph had a cup from which he drank, and it was of silver beautifully inlaid with onyx stones and bdellium, and Joseph struck the cup in the sight of his brethren whilst they were sitting to eat with him.

verses.raw: And Joseph said to the men, I know by this cup that Reuben the first born, Simeon and Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun are children from one mother, seat yourselves to eat according to your births.
verses.text: And Joseph said to the men, I know by this cup that Reuben the first born, Simeon and Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun are children from one mother, seat yourselves to eat according to your births.

verses.raw: And he also placed the others according to their births, and he said, I know that this your youngest brother has no brother, and I, like him, have no brother, he shall therefore sit down to eat with me.
verses.text: And he also placed the others according to their births, and he said, I know that this your youngest brother has no brother, and I, like him, have no brother, he shall therefore sit down to eat with me.

verses.raw: And Benjamin went up before Joseph and sat upon the throne, and the men beheld the acts of Joseph, and they were astonished at them; and the men ate and drank at that time with Joseph, and he then gave presents to them, and Joseph gave one gift to Benjamin, and Manasseh and Ephraim saw the acts of their father, and they also gave presents to him, and Osnath gave him one present, and they were five presents in the hand of Benjamin.
verses.text: And Benjamin went up before Joseph and sat upon the throne, and the men beheld the acts of Joseph, and they were astonished at them; and the men ate and drank at that time with Joseph, and he then gave presents to them, and Joseph gave one gift to Benjamin, and Manasseh and Ephraim saw the acts of their father, and they also gave presents to him, and Osnath gave him one present, and they were five presents in the hand of Benjamin.

verses.raw: And Joseph brought them out wine to drink, and they would not drink, and they said, From the day on which Joseph was lost we have not drunk wine, nor eaten any delicacies.
verses.text: And Joseph brought them out wine to drink, and they would not drink, and they said, From the day on which Joseph was lost we have not drunk wine, nor eaten any delicacies.

verses.raw: And Joseph swore to them, and he pressed them hard, and they drank plentifully with him on that day, and Joseph afterward turned to his brother Benjamin to speak with him, and Benjamin was still sitting upon the throne before Joseph.
verses.text: And Joseph swore to them, and he pressed them hard, and they drank plentifully with him on that day, and Joseph afterward turned to his brother Benjamin to speak with him, and Benjamin was still sitting upon the throne before Joseph.

verses.raw: And Joseph said to him, Have you begotten any children? and he said, Your servant has ten sons, and these are their names, Bela, Becher, Ashbal, Gera, Naaman, Achi, Rosh, Mupim, Chupim, and Ord, and I called their names after my brother whom I have not seen.
verses.text: And Joseph said to him, Have you begotten any children? and he said, Your servant has ten sons, and these are their names, Bela, Becher, Ashbal, Gera, Naaman, Achi, Rosh, Mupim, Chupim, and Ord, and I called their names after my brother whom I have not seen.

verses.raw: And he ordered them to bring before him his map of the stars, by which Joseph knew all the times, and Joseph said to Benjamin, I have heard that the Hebrews are acquainted with all wisdom, dost you know anything of this?
verses.text: And he ordered them to bring before him his map of the stars, by which Joseph knew all the times, and Joseph said to Benjamin, I have heard that the Hebrews are acquainted with all wisdom, dost you know anything of this?

verses.raw: And Benjamin said, Your servant is knowing also in all the wisdom which my father taught me, and Joseph said to Benjamin, Look now at this instrument and understand where your brother Joseph is in Egypt, who you said went down to Egypt.
verses.text: And Benjamin said, Your servant is knowing also in all the wisdom which my father taught me, and Joseph said to Benjamin, Look now at this instrument and understand where your brother Joseph is in Egypt, who you said went down to Egypt.

verses.raw: And Benjamin beheld that instrument with the map of the stars of heaven, and he was wise and looked in it to know where his brother was, and Benjamin divided the whole land of Egypt into four divisions, and he found that he who was sitting upon the throne before him was his brother Joseph, and Benjamin wondered greatly, and when Joseph saw that his brother Benjamin was so much astonished, he said to Benjamin, What have you seen, and why are you astonished?
verses.text: And Benjamin beheld that instrument with the map of the stars of heaven, and he was wise and looked in it to know where his brother was, and Benjamin divided the whole land of Egypt into four divisions, and he found that he who was sitting upon the throne before him was his brother Joseph, and Benjamin wondered greatly, and when Joseph saw that his brother Benjamin was so much astonished, he said to Benjamin, What have you seen, and why are you astonished?

verses.raw: And Benjamin said to Joseph, I can see by this that Joseph my brother sits here with me upon the throne, and Joseph said to him, I am Joseph your brother, reveal not this thing to your brethren; behold I will send you with them when they go away, and I will command them to be brought back again into the city, and I will take you away from them.
verses.text: And Benjamin said to Joseph, I can see by this that Joseph my brother sits here with me upon the throne, and Joseph said to him, I am Joseph your brother, reveal not this thing to your brethren; behold I will send you with them when they go away, and I will command them to be brought back again into the city, and I will take you away from them.

verses.raw: And if they dare their lives and fight for you, then shall I know that they have repented of what they did to me, and I will make myself known to them, and if they forsake you when I take you, then shall you remain with me, and I will wrangle with them, and they shall go away, and I will not become known to them.
verses.text: And if they dare their lives and fight for you, then shall I know that they have repented of what they did to me, and I will make myself known to them, and if they forsake you when I take you, then shall you remain with me, and I will wrangle with them, and they shall go away, and I will not become known to them.

verses.raw: At that time Joseph commanded his officer to fill their sacks with food, and to put each man’s money into his sack, and to put the cup in the sack of Benjamin, and to give them provision for the road, and they did so to them.
verses.text: At that time Joseph commanded his officer to fill their sacks with food, and to put each man’s money into his sack, and to put the cup in the sack of Benjamin, and to give them provision for the road, and they did so to them.

verses.raw: And on the next day the men rose up early in the morning, and they loaded their asses with their corn, and they went forth with Benjamin, and they went to the land of Canaan with their brother Benjamin.
verses.text: And on the next day the men rose up early in the morning, and they loaded their asses with their corn, and they went forth with Benjamin, and they went to the land of Canaan with their brother Benjamin.

verses.raw: They had not gone far from Egypt when Joseph commanded him that was set over his house, saying, Rise, pursue these men before they get too far from Egypt, and say to them, Why have you stolen my master’s cup?
verses.text: They had not gone far from Egypt when Joseph commanded him that was set over his house, saying, Rise, pursue these men before they get too far from Egypt, and say to them, Why have you stolen my master’s cup?

verses.raw: And Joseph’s officer rose up and he reached them, and he spoke to them all the words of Joseph; and when they heard this thing they became exceedingly wroth, and they said, He with whom your master’s cup shall be found shall die, and we will also become slaves.
verses.text: And Joseph’s officer rose up and he reached them, and he spoke to them all the words of Joseph; and when they heard this thing they became exceedingly wroth, and they said, He with whom your master’s cup shall be found shall die, and we will also become slaves.

verses.raw: And they hastened and each man brought down his sack from his ass, and they looked in their bags and the cup was found in Benjamin’s bag, and they all tore their garments and they returned to the city, and they smote Benjamin in the road, continually smiting him until he came into the city, and they stood before Joseph.
verses.text: And they hastened and each man brought down his sack from his ass, and they looked in their bags and the cup was found in Benjamin’s bag, and they all tore their garments and they returned to the city, and they smote Benjamin in the road, continually smiting him until he came into the city, and they stood before Joseph.

verses.raw: And Judah’s anger was kindled, and he said, This man has only brought me back to destroy Egypt this day.
verses.text: And Judah’s anger was kindled, and he said, This man has only brought me back to destroy Egypt this day.

verses.raw: And the men came to Joseph’s house, and they found Joseph sitting upon his throne, and all the mighty men standing at his right and left.
verses.text: And the men came to Joseph’s house, and they found Joseph sitting upon his throne, and all the mighty men standing at his right and left.

verses.raw: And Joseph said to them, What is this act that you have done, that you took away my silver cup and went away? but I know that you took my cup in order to know thereby in what part of the land your brother was.
verses.text: And Joseph said to them, What is this act that you have done, that you took away my silver cup and went away? but I know that you took my cup in order to know thereby in what part of the land your brother was.

verses.raw: And Judah said, What shall we say to our Lord, what shall we speak and how shall we justify ourselves, Elohim has this day found the iniquity of all your servants, therefore has he done this thing to us this day.
verses.text: And Judah said, What shall we say to our Lord, what shall we speak and how shall we justify ourselves, Elohim has this day found the iniquity of all your servants, therefore has he done this thing to us this day.

verses.raw: And Joseph rose up and caught hold of Benjamin and took him from his brethren with violence, and he came to the house and locked the door at them, and Joseph commanded him that was set over his house that he should say to them, Thus says the king, Go in peace to your father, behold I have taken the man in whose hand my cup was found.
verses.text: And Joseph rose up and caught hold of Benjamin and took him from his brethren with violence, and he came to the house and locked the door at them, and Joseph commanded him that was set over his house that he should say to them, Thus says the king, Go in peace to your father, behold I have taken the man in whose hand my cup was found.

verses.raw: And when Judah saw the dealings of Joseph with them, Judah approached him and broke open the door, and came with his brethren before Joseph.
verses.text: And when Judah saw the dealings of Joseph with them, Judah approached him and broke open the door, and came with his brethren before Joseph.

verses.raw: And Judah said to Joseph, Let it not seem grievous in the sight of my Lord, may your servant I pray you speak a word before you? and Joseph said to him, Speak.
verses.text: And Judah said to Joseph, Let it not seem grievous in the sight of my Lord, may your servant I pray you speak a word before you? and Joseph said to him, Speak.

verses.raw: And Judah spoke before Joseph, and his brethren were there standing before them; and Judah said to Joseph, Surely when we first came to our Lord to buy food, you did consider us as spies of the land, and we brought Benjamin before you, and you still make sport of us this day.
verses.text: And Judah spoke before Joseph, and his brethren were there standing before them; and Judah said to Joseph, Surely when we first came to our Lord to buy food, you did consider us as spies of the land, and we brought Benjamin before you, and you still make sport of us this day.

verses.raw: Now therefore let the king hear my words, and send I pray you our brother that he may go along with us to our father, lest your soul perish this day with all the souls of the inhabitants of Egypt.
verses.text: Now therefore let the king hear my words, and send I pray you our brother that he may go along with us to our father, lest your soul perish this day with all the souls of the inhabitants of Egypt.

verses.raw: Dost you not know what two of my brethren, Simeon and Levi, did to the city of Shechem, and to seven cities of the Amorites, on account of our sister Dinah, and also what they would do for the sake of their brother Benjamin?
verses.text: Dost you not know what two of my brethren, Simeon and Levi, did to the city of Shechem, and to seven cities of the Amorites, on account of our sister Dinah, and also what they would do for the sake of their brother Benjamin?

verses.raw: And I with my strength, who am greater and mightier than both of them, come this day upon you and your land if you are unwilling to send our brother.
verses.text: And I with my strength, who am greater and mightier than both of them, come this day upon you and your land if you are unwilling to send our brother.

verses.raw: Have you not heard what our Elohim (God) who made choice of us did to Pharaoh on account of Sarah our mother, whom he took away from our father, that he smote him and his household with heavy plagues, that even to this day the Egyptians relate this wonder to each other? so will our Elohim do to you on account of Benjamin whom you have this day taken from his father, and on account of the evils which you this day heap over us in your land; for our Elohim will remember his covenant with our father Abraham and bring evil upon you, because you have grieved the soul of our father this day.
verses.text: Have you not heard what our Elohim who made choice of us did to Pharaoh on account of Sarah our mother, whom he took away from our father, that he smote him and his household with heavy plagues, that even to this day the Egyptians relate this wonder to each other? so will our Elohim do to you on account of Benjamin whom you have this day taken from his father, and on account of the evils which you this day heap over us in your land; for our Elohim will remember his covenant with our father Abraham and bring evil upon you, because you have grieved the soul of our father this day.

verses.raw: Now therefore hear my words that I have this day spoken to you, and send our brother that he may go away lest you and the people of your land die by the sword, for you cannot all prevail over me.
verses.text: Now therefore hear my words that I have this day spoken to you, and send our brother that he may go away lest you and the people of your land die by the sword, for you cannot all prevail over me.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered Judah, saying, Why have you opened wide your mouth and why dost you boast over us, saying, Strength is with you? as Pharaoh lives, if I command all my valiant men to fight with you, surely you and these your brethren would sink in the mire.
verses.text: And Joseph answered Judah, saying, Why have you opened wide your mouth and why dost you boast over us, saying, Strength is with you? as Pharaoh lives, if I command all my valiant men to fight with you, surely you and these your brethren would sink in the mire.

verses.raw: And Judah said to Joseph, Surely it becomes you and your people to fear me; as Yahuah (the Lord) lives if I once draw my sword I shall not sheathe it again until I shall this day have slain all Egypt, and I will commence with you and finish with Pharaoh your master.
verses.text: And Judah said to Joseph, Surely it becomes you and your people to fear me; as Yahuah (the Lord) lives if I once draw my sword I shall not sheathe it again until I shall this day have slain all Egypt, and I will commence with you and finish with Pharaoh your master.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered and said to him, Surely strength belongs not alone to you; I am stronger and mightier than you, surely if you draw your sword I will put it to your neck and the necks of all your brethren.
verses.text: And Joseph answered and said to him, Surely strength belongs not alone to you; I am stronger and mightier than you, surely if you draw your sword I will put it to your neck and the necks of all your brethren.

verses.raw: And Judah said to him, Surely if I this day open my mouth against you I would swallow you up that you be destroyed from off the earth and perish this day from your kingdom. And Joseph said, Surely if you open your mouth I have power and might to close your mouth with a stone until you shall not be able to utter a word; see how many stones are before us, truly I can take a stone, and force it into your mouth and break your jaws.
verses.text: And Judah said to him, Surely if I this day open my mouth against you I would swallow you up that you be destroyed from off the earth and perish this day from your kingdom. And Joseph said, Surely if you open your mouth I have power and might to close your mouth with a stone until you shall not be able to utter a word; see how many stones are before us, truly I can take a stone, and force it into your mouth and break your jaws.

verses.raw: And Judah said, Elohim is witness between us, that we have not hitherto desired to battle with you, only give us our brother and we will go from you; and Joseph answered and said, As Pharaoh lives, if all the kings of Canaan came together with you, you should not take him from my hand.
verses.text: And Judah said, Elohim is witness between us, that we have not hitherto desired to battle with you, only give us our brother and we will go from you; and Joseph answered and said, As Pharaoh lives, if all the kings of Canaan came together with you, you should not take him from my hand.

verses.raw: Now therefore go your way to your father, and your brother shall be to me for a slave, for he has robbed the king’s house. And Judah said, What is it to you or to the character of the king, surely the king sends forth from his house, throughout the land, silver and gold either in gifts or expenses, and you still talk about your cup which you did place in our brother’s bag and say that he has stolen it from you?
verses.text: Now therefore go your way to your father, and your brother shall be to me for a slave, for he has robbed the king’s house. And Judah said, What is it to you or to the character of the king, surely the king sends forth from his house, throughout the land, silver and gold either in gifts or expenses, and you still talk about your cup which you did place in our brother’s bag and say that he has stolen it from you?

verses.raw: Elohim forbid that our brother Benjamin or any of the seed of Abraham should do this thing to steal from you, or from any one else, whether king, prince, or any man.
verses.text: Elohim forbid that our brother Benjamin or any of the seed of Abraham should do this thing to steal from you, or from any one else, whether king, prince, or any man.

verses.raw: Now therefore cease this accusation lest the whole earth hear your words, saying, For a little silver the king of Egypt wrangled with the men, and he accused them and took their brother for a slave.
verses.text: Now therefore cease this accusation lest the whole earth hear your words, saying, For a little silver the king of Egypt wrangled with the men, and he accused them and took their brother for a slave.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered and said, Take to you this cup and go from me and leave your brother for a slave, for it is the judgment of a thief to be a slave.
verses.text: And Joseph answered and said, Take to you this cup and go from me and leave your brother for a slave, for it is the judgment of a thief to be a slave.

verses.raw: And Judah said, Why are you not ashamed of your words, to leave our brother and to take your cup? Surely if you give us your cup, or a thousand times as much, we will not leave our brother for the silver which is found in the hand of any man, that we will not die over him.
verses.text: And Judah said, Why are you not ashamed of your words, to leave our brother and to take your cup? Surely if you give us your cup, or a thousand times as much, we will not leave our brother for the silver which is found in the hand of any man, that we will not die over him.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered, And why did you forsake your brother and sell him for twenty pieces of silver to this day, and why then will you not do the same to this your brother?
verses.text: And Joseph answered, And why did you forsake your brother and sell him for twenty pieces of silver to this day, and why then will you not do the same to this your brother?

verses.raw: And Judah said, Yahuah (the Lord) is witness between me and you that we desire not your battles; now therefore give us our brother and we will go from you without quarreling.
verses.text: And Judah said, Yahuah (the Lord) is witness between me and you that we desire not your battles; now therefore give us our brother and we will go from you without quarreling.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered and said, If all the kings of the land should assemble they will not be able to take your brother from my hand; and Judah said, What shall we say to our father, when he sees that our brother comes not with us, and will grieve over him?
verses.text: And Joseph answered and said, If all the kings of the land should assemble they will not be able to take your brother from my hand; and Judah said, What shall we say to our father, when he sees that our brother comes not with us, and will grieve over him?

verses.raw: And Joseph answered and said, This is the thing which you shall tell to your father, saying, The rope has gone after the bucket.
verses.text: And Joseph answered and said, This is the thing which you shall tell to your father, saying, The rope has gone after the bucket.

verses.raw: And Judah said, Surely you are a king, and why speak you these things, giving a false judgment? woe to the king who is like to you.
verses.text: And Judah said, Surely you are a king, and why speak you these things, giving a false judgment? woe to the king who is like to you.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered and said, There is no false judgment in the word that I spoke on account of your brother Joseph, for all of you sold him to the Midianites for twenty pieces of silver, and you all denied it to your father and said to him, An evil beast has devoured him, Joseph has been torn to pieces.
verses.text: And Joseph answered and said, There is no false judgment in the word that I spoke on account of your brother Joseph, for all of you sold him to the Midianites for twenty pieces of silver, and you all denied it to your father and said to him, An evil beast has devoured him, Joseph has been torn to pieces.

verses.raw: And Judah said, Behold the fire of Shem burns in my heart, now I will burn all your land with fire; and Joseph answered and said, Surely your sister-in-law Tamar, who killed your sons, extinguished the fire of Shechem.
verses.text: And Judah said, Behold the fire of Shem burns in my heart, now I will burn all your land with fire; and Joseph answered and said, Surely your sister-in-law Tamar, who killed your sons, extinguished the fire of Shechem.

verses.raw: And Judah said, If I pluck out a single hair from my flesh, I will fill all Egypt with its blood.
verses.text: And Judah said, If I pluck out a single hair from my flesh, I will fill all Egypt with its blood.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered and said, Such is your custom to do as you did to your brother whom you sold, and you dipped his coat in blood and brought it to your father in order that he might say an evil beast devoured him and here is his blood.
verses.text: And Joseph answered and said, Such is your custom to do as you did to your brother whom you sold, and you dipped his coat in blood and brought it to your father in order that he might say an evil beast devoured him and here is his blood.

verses.raw: And when Judah heard this thing he was exceedingly wroth and his anger burned within him, and there was before him in that place a stone, the weight of which was about four hundred shekels, and Judah’s anger was kindled and he took the stone in one hand and cast it to the heavens and caught it with his left hand.
verses.text: And when Judah heard this thing he was exceedingly wroth and his anger burned within him, and there was before him in that place a stone, the weight of which was about four hundred shekels, and Judah’s anger was kindled and he took the stone in one hand and cast it to the heavens and caught it with his left hand.

verses.raw: And he placed it afterward under his legs, and he sat upon it with all his strength and the stone was turned into dust from the force of Judah.
verses.text: And he placed it afterward under his legs, and he sat upon it with all his strength and the stone was turned into dust from the force of Judah.

verses.raw: And Joseph saw the act of Judah and he was very much afraid, but he commanded Manassah his son and he also did with another stone like to the act of Judah, and Judah said to his brethren, Let not any of you say, this man is an Egyptian, but by his doing this thing he is of our father’s family.
verses.text: And Joseph saw the act of Judah and he was very much afraid, but he commanded Manassah his son and he also did with another stone like to the act of Judah, and Judah said to his brethren, Let not any of you say, this man is an Egyptian, but by his doing this thing he is of our father’s family.

verses.raw: And Joseph said, Not to you only is strength given, for we are also powerful men, and why will you boast over us all? and Judah said to Joseph, Send I pray you our brother and ruin not your country this day.
verses.text: And Joseph said, Not to you only is strength given, for we are also powerful men, and why will you boast over us all? and Judah said to Joseph, Send I pray you our brother and ruin not your country this day.

verses.raw: And Joseph answered and said to them, Go and tell your father, an evil beast has devoured him as you said concerning your brother Joseph.
verses.text: And Joseph answered and said to them, Go and tell your father, an evil beast has devoured him as you said concerning your brother Joseph.

verses.raw: And Judah spoke to his brother Naphtali, and he said to him, Make haste, go now and number all the streets of Egypt and come and tell me; and Simeon said to him, Let not this thing be a trouble to you; now I will go to the mount and take up one large stone from the mount and level it at every one in Egypt, and kill all that are in it.
verses.text: And Judah spoke to his brother Naphtali, and he said to him, Make haste, go now and number all the streets of Egypt and come and tell me; and Simeon said to him, Let not this thing be a trouble to you; now I will go to the mount and take up one large stone from the mount and level it at every one in Egypt, and kill all that are in it.

verses.raw: And Joseph heard all these words that his brethren spoke before him, and they did not know that Joseph understood them, for they imagined that he knew not to speak Hebrew.
verses.text: And Joseph heard all these words that his brethren spoke before him, and they did not know that Joseph understood them, for they imagined that he knew not to speak Hebrew.

verses.raw: And Joseph was greatly afraid at the words of his brethren lest they should destroy Egypt, and he commanded his son Manasseh, saying, Go now make haste and gather to me all the inhabitants of Egypt, and all the valiant men together, and let them come to me now upon horseback and on foot and with all sorts of musical instruments, and Manasseh went and did so.
verses.text: And Joseph was greatly afraid at the words of his brethren lest they should destroy Egypt, and he commanded his son Manasseh, saying, Go now make haste and gather to me all the inhabitants of Egypt, and all the valiant men together, and let them come to me now upon horseback and on foot and with all sorts of musical instruments, and Manasseh went and did so.

verses.raw: And Naphtali went as Judah had commanded him, for Naphtali was lightfooted as one of the swift stags, and he would go upon the ears of corn and they would not break under him.
verses.text: And Naphtali went as Judah had commanded him, for Naphtali was lightfooted as one of the swift stags, and he would go upon the ears of corn and they would not break under him.
