verses.text: In those days died Zepho the son of Eliphaz, son of Esau, king of Chittim, and Janeas reigned in his stead.

verses.raw: And the time that Zepho reigned over the children of Chittim was fifty years, and he died and was buried in the city of Nabna in the land of Chittim.
verses.text: And the time that Zepho reigned over the children of Chittim was fifty years, and he died and was buried in the city of Nabna in the land of Chittim.

verses.raw: And Janeas, one of the mighty men of the children of Chittim, reigned after him and he reigned fifty years.
verses.text: And Janeas, one of the mighty men of the children of Chittim, reigned after him and he reigned fifty years.

verses.raw: And it was after the death of the king of Chittim that Balaam the son of Beor fled from the land of Chittim, and he went and came to Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.text: And it was after the death of the king of Chittim that Balaam the son of Beor fled from the land of Chittim, and he went and came to Egypt to Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh received him with great honor, for he had heard of his wisdom, and he gave him presents and made him for a counsellor, and aggrandized him.
verses.text: And Pharaoh received him with great honor, for he had heard of his wisdom, and he gave him presents and made him for a counsellor, and aggrandized him.

verses.raw: And Balaam dwelt in Egypt, in honor with all the nobles of the king, and the nobles exalted him, because they all coveted to learn his wisdom.
verses.text: And Balaam dwelt in Egypt, in honor with all the nobles of the king, and the nobles exalted him, because they all coveted to learn his wisdom.

verses.raw: And in the hundred and thirtieth year of Israel’s going down to Egypt, Pharaoh dreamed that he was sitting upon his kingly throne, and lifted up his eyes and saw an old man standing before him, and there were scales in the hands of the old man, such scales as are used by merchants.
verses.text: And in the hundred and thirtieth year of Israel’s going down to Egypt, Pharaoh dreamed that he was sitting upon his kingly throne, and lifted up his eyes and saw an old man standing before him, and there were scales in the hands of the old man, such scales as are used by merchants.

verses.raw: And the old man took the scales and hung them before Pharaoh.
verses.text: And the old man took the scales and hung them before Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And the old man took all the elders of Egypt and all its nobles and great men, and he tied them together and put them in one scale.
verses.text: And the old man took all the elders of Egypt and all its nobles and great men, and he tied them together and put them in one scale.

verses.raw: And he took a milk kid and put it into the other scale, and the kid preponderated over all.
verses.text: And he took a milk kid and put it into the other scale, and the kid preponderated over all.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh was astonished at this dreadful vision, why the kid should preponderate over all, and Pharaoh awoke and behold it was a dream.
verses.text: And Pharaoh was astonished at this dreadful vision, why the kid should preponderate over all, and Pharaoh awoke and behold it was a dream.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh rose up early in the morning and called all his servants and related to them the dream, and the men were greatly afraid.
verses.text: And Pharaoh rose up early in the morning and called all his servants and related to them the dream, and the men were greatly afraid.

verses.raw: And the king said to all his wise men, Interpret I pray you the dream which I dreamed, that I may know it.
verses.text: And the king said to all his wise men, Interpret I pray you the dream which I dreamed, that I may know it.

verses.raw: And Balaam the son of Beor answered the king and said to him, This means nothing else but a great evil that will spring up against Egypt in the latter days.
verses.text: And Balaam the son of Beor answered the king and said to him, This means nothing else but a great evil that will spring up against Egypt in the latter days.

verses.raw: For a son will be born to Israel who will destroy all Egypt and its inhabitants, and bring forth the Israelites from Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.text: For a son will be born to Israel who will destroy all Egypt and its inhabitants, and bring forth the Israelites from Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O king, take counsel upon this matter, that you may destroy the hope of the children of Israel and their expectation, before this evil arise against Egypt.
verses.text: Now therefore, O king, take counsel upon this matter, that you may destroy the hope of the children of Israel and their expectation, before this evil arise against Egypt.

verses.raw: And the king said to Balaam, And what shall we do to Israel? surely after a certain manner did we at first counsel against them and could not prevail over them.
verses.text: And the king said to Balaam, And what shall we do to Israel? surely after a certain manner did we at first counsel against them and could not prevail over them.

verses.raw: Now therefore give you also advice against them by which we may prevail over them.
verses.text: Now therefore give you also advice against them by which we may prevail over them.

verses.raw: And Balaam answered the king, saying, Send now and call your two counsellors, and we will see what their advice is upon this matter and afterward your servant will speak.
verses.text: And Balaam answered the king, saying, Send now and call your two counsellors, and we will see what their advice is upon this matter and afterward your servant will speak.

verses.raw: And the king sent and called his two counsellors Reuel the Midianite and Job the Uzite, and they came and sat before the king.
verses.text: And the king sent and called his two counsellors Reuel the Midianite and Job the Uzite, and they came and sat before the king.

verses.raw: And the king said to them, Behold you have both heard the dream which I have dreamed, and the interpretation of it; now therefore give counsel and know and see what is to be done to the children of Israel, by which we may prevail over them, before their evil shall spring up against us.
verses.text: And the king said to them, Behold you have both heard the dream which I have dreamed, and the interpretation of it; now therefore give counsel and know and see what is to be done to the children of Israel, by which we may prevail over them, before their evil shall spring up against us.

verses.raw: And Reuel the Midianite answered the king and said, May the king live, may the king live forever.
verses.text: And Reuel the Midianite answered the king and said, May the king live, may the king live forever.

verses.raw: If it seem good to the king, let him desist from the Hebrews and leave them, and let him not stretch forth his hand against them.
verses.text: If it seem good to the king, let him desist from the Hebrews and leave them, and let him not stretch forth his hand against them.

verses.raw: For these are they whom Yahuah (the Lord) chose in days of old, and took as the lot of his inheritance from amongst all the nations of the earth and the kings of the earth; and who is there that stretched his hand against them with impunity, of whom their Elohim (God) was not avenged?
verses.text: For these are they whom Yahuah (the Lord) chose in days of old, and took as the lot of his inheritance from amongst all the nations of the earth and the kings of the earth; and who is there that stretched his hand against them with impunity, of whom their Elohim was not avenged?

verses.raw: Surely you know that when Abraham went down to Egypt, Pharaoh, the former king of Egypt, saw Sarah his wife, and took her for a wife, because Abraham said, She is my sister, for he was afraid, lest the men of Egypt should slay him on account of his wife.
verses.text: Surely you know that when Abraham went down to Egypt, Pharaoh, the former king of Egypt, saw Sarah his wife, and took her for a wife, because Abraham said, She is my sister, for he was afraid, lest the men of Egypt should slay him on account of his wife.

verses.raw: And when the king of Egypt had taken Sarah then Elohim smote him and his household with heavy plagues, until he restored to Abraham his wife Sarah, then was he healed.
verses.text: And when the king of Egypt had taken Sarah then Elohim smote him and his household with heavy plagues, until he restored to Abraham his wife Sarah, then was he healed.

verses.raw: And Abimelech the Gerarite, king of the Philistines, Elohim punished on account of Sarah wife of Abraham, in stopping up every womb from man to beast.
verses.text: And Abimelech the Gerarite, king of the Philistines, Elohim punished on account of Sarah wife of Abraham, in stopping up every womb from man to beast.

verses.raw: When their Elohim came to Abimelech in the dream of night and terrified him in order that he might restore to Abraham Sarah whom he had taken, and afterward all the people of Gerar were punished on account of Sarah, and Abraham prayed to his Elohim for them, and he was entreated of him, and he healed them.
verses.text: When their Elohim came to Abimelech in the dream of night and terrified him in order that he might restore to Abraham Sarah whom he had taken, and afterward all the people of Gerar were punished on account of Sarah, and Abraham prayed to his Elohim for them, and he was entreated of him, and he healed them.

verses.raw: And Abimelech feared all this evil that came upon him and his people, and he returned to Abraham his wife Sarah, and gave him with her many gifts.
verses.text: And Abimelech feared all this evil that came upon him and his people, and he returned to Abraham his wife Sarah, and gave him with her many gifts.

verses.raw: He did so also to Isaac when he had driven him from Gerar, and Elohim had done wonderful things to him, that all the water courses of Gerar were dried up, and their productive trees did not bring forth.
verses.text: He did so also to Isaac when he had driven him from Gerar, and Elohim had done wonderful things to him, that all the water courses of Gerar were dried up, and their productive trees did not bring forth.

verses.raw: Until Abimelech of Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Pichol the captain of his host, went to him and they bent and bowed down before him to the ground.
verses.text: Until Abimelech of Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Pichol the captain of his host, went to him and they bent and bowed down before him to the ground.

verses.raw: And they requested of him to supplicate for them, and he prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) for them, and Yahuah (the Lord) was entreated of him and he healed them.
verses.text: And they requested of him to supplicate for them, and he prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) for them, and Yahuah (the Lord) was entreated of him and he healed them.

verses.raw: Jacob also, the plain man, was delivered through his integrity from the hand of his brother Esau, and the hand of Laban the Syrian his mother’s brother, who had sought his life; likewise from the hand of all the kings of Canaan who had come together against him and his children to destroy them, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered them out of their hands, that they turned upon them and smote them, for who had ever stretched forth his hand against them with impunity?
verses.text: Jacob also, the plain man, was delivered through his integrity from the hand of his brother Esau, and the hand of Laban the Syrian his mother’s brother, who had sought his life; likewise from the hand of all the kings of Canaan who had come together against him and his children to destroy them, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered them out of their hands, that they turned upon them and smote them, for who had ever stretched forth his hand against them with impunity?

verses.raw: Surely Pharaoh the former, your father’s father, raised Joseph the son of Jacob above all the princes of the land of Egypt, when he saw his wisdom, for through his wisdom he rescued all the inhabitants of the land from the famine.
verses.text: Surely Pharaoh the former, your father’s father, raised Joseph the son of Jacob above all the princes of the land of Egypt, when he saw his wisdom, for through his wisdom he rescued all the inhabitants of the land from the famine.

verses.raw: After which he ordered Jacob and his children to come down to Egypt, in order that through their virtue, the land of Egypt and the land of Goshen might be delivered from the famine.
verses.text: After which he ordered Jacob and his children to come down to Egypt, in order that through their virtue, the land of Egypt and the land of Goshen might be delivered from the famine.

verses.raw: Now therefore if it seem good in your eyes, cease from destroying the children of Israel, but if it be not your will that they shall dwell in Egypt, send them forth from here, that they may go to the land of Canaan, the land where their ancestors sojourned.
verses.text: Now therefore if it seem good in your eyes, cease from destroying the children of Israel, but if it be not your will that they shall dwell in Egypt, send them forth from here, that they may go to the land of Canaan, the land where their ancestors sojourned.

verses.raw: And when Pharaoh heard the words of Jethro he was very angry with him, so that he rose with shame from the king’s presence, and went to Midian, his land, and took Joseph’s stick with him.
verses.text: And when Pharaoh heard the words of Jethro he was very angry with him, so that he rose with shame from the king’s presence, and went to Midian, his land, and took Joseph’s stick with him.

verses.raw: And the king said to Job the Uzite, What say you Job, and what is your advice respecting the Hebrews?
verses.text: And the king said to Job the Uzite, What say you Job, and what is your advice respecting the Hebrews?

verses.raw: So Job said to the king, Behold all the inhabitants of the land are in your power, let the king do as it seems good in his eyes.
verses.text: So Job said to the king, Behold all the inhabitants of the land are in your power, let the king do as it seems good in his eyes.

verses.raw: And the king said to Balaam, What dost you say, Balaam, speak your word that we may hear it.
verses.text: And the king said to Balaam, What dost you say, Balaam, speak your word that we may hear it.

verses.raw: And Balaam said to the king, Of all that the king has counselled against the Hebrews will they be delivered, and the king will not be able to prevail over them with any counsel.
verses.text: And Balaam said to the king, Of all that the king has counselled against the Hebrews will they be delivered, and the king will not be able to prevail over them with any counsel.

verses.raw: For if you think to lessen them by the flaming fire, you can not prevail over them, for surely their Elohim delivered Abraham their father from Ur of the Chaldeans; and if you think to destroy them with a sword, surely Isaac their father was delivered from it, and a ram was placed in his stead.
verses.text: For if you think to lessen them by the flaming fire, you can not prevail over them, for surely their Elohim delivered Abraham their father from Ur of the Chaldeans; and if you think to destroy them with a sword, surely Isaac their father was delivered from it, and a ram was placed in his stead.

verses.raw: And if with hard and rigorous labor you think to lessen them, you will not prevail even in this, for their father Jacob served Laban in all manner of hard work, and prospered.
verses.text: And if with hard and rigorous labor you think to lessen them, you will not prevail even in this, for their father Jacob served Laban in all manner of hard work, and prospered.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O King, hear my words, for this is the counsel which is counselled against them, by which you will prevail over them, and from which you should not depart.
verses.text: Now therefore, O King, hear my words, for this is the counsel which is counselled against them, by which you will prevail over them, and from which you should not depart.

verses.raw: If it please the king let him order all their children which shall be born from this day forward, to be thrown into the water, for by this can you wipe away their name, for none of them, nor of their fathers, were tried in this manner.
verses.text: If it please the king let him order all their children which shall be born from this day forward, to be thrown into the water, for by this can you wipe away their name, for none of them, nor of their fathers, were tried in this manner.

verses.raw: And the king heard the words of Balaam, and the thing pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Balaam.
verses.text: And the king heard the words of Balaam, and the thing pleased the king and the princes, and the king did according to the word of Balaam.

verses.raw: And the king ordered a proclamation to be issued and a law to be made throughout the land of Egypt, saying, Every male child born to the Hebrews from this day forward shall be thrown into the water.
verses.text: And the king ordered a proclamation to be issued and a law to be made throughout the land of Egypt, saying, Every male child born to the Hebrews from this day forward shall be thrown into the water.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh called to all his servants, saying, Go now and seek throughout the land of Goshen where the children of Israel are, and see that every son born to the Hebrews shall be cast into the river, but every daughter you shall let live.
verses.text: And Pharaoh called to all his servants, saying, Go now and seek throughout the land of Goshen where the children of Israel are, and see that every son born to the Hebrews shall be cast into the river, but every daughter you shall let live.

verses.raw: And when the children of Israel heard this thing which Pharaoh had commanded, to cast their male children into the river, some of the people separated from their wives and others adhered to them.
verses.text: And when the children of Israel heard this thing which Pharaoh had commanded, to cast their male children into the river, some of the people separated from their wives and others adhered to them.

verses.raw: And from that day forward, when the time of delivery arrived to those women of Israel who had remained with their husbands, they went to the field to bring forth there, and they brought forth in the field, and left their children upon the field and returned home.
verses.text: And from that day forward, when the time of delivery arrived to those women of Israel who had remained with their husbands, they went to the field to bring forth there, and they brought forth in the field, and left their children upon the field and returned home.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) who had sworn to their ancestors to multiply them, sent one of his ministering angels which are in heaven to wash each child in water, to anoint and swathe it and to put into its hands two smooth stones from one of which it sucked milk and from the other honey, and he caused its hair to grow to its knees, by which it might cover itself; to comfort it and to cleave to it, through his compassion for it.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) who had sworn to their ancestors to multiply them, sent one of his ministering angels which are in heaven to wash each child in water, to anoint and swathe it and to put into its hands two smooth stones from one of which it sucked milk and from the other honey, and he caused its hair to grow to its knees, by which it might cover itself; to comfort it and to cleave to it, through his compassion for it.

verses.raw: And when Elohim had compassion over them and had desired to multiply them upon the face of the land, he ordered his earth to receive them to be preserved in it till the time of their growing up, after which the earth opened its mouth and vomited them forth and they sprouted forth from the city like the herb of the earth, and the grass of the forest, and they returned each to his family and to his father’s house, and they remained with them.
verses.text: And when Elohim had compassion over them and had desired to multiply them upon the face of the land, he ordered his earth to receive them to be preserved in it till the time of their growing up, after which the earth opened its mouth and vomited them forth and they sprouted forth from the city like the herb of the earth, and the grass of the forest, and they returned each to his family and to his father’s house, and they remained with them.

verses.raw: And the babes of the children of Israel were upon the earth like the herb of the field, through Elohim’s grace to them.
verses.text: And the babes of the children of Israel were upon the earth like the herb of the field, through Elohim’s grace to them.

verses.raw: And when all the Egyptians saw this thing, they went forth, each to his field with his yoke of oxen and his ploughshare, and they ploughed it up as one ploughs the earth at seed time.
verses.text: And when all the Egyptians saw this thing, they went forth, each to his field with his yoke of oxen and his ploughshare, and they ploughed it up as one ploughs the earth at seed time.

verses.raw: And when they ploughed they were unable to hurt the infants of the children of Israel, so the people increased and waxed exceedingly.
verses.text: And when they ploughed they were unable to hurt the infants of the children of Israel, so the people increased and waxed exceedingly.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh ordered his officers daily to go to Goshen to seek for the babes of the children of Israel.
verses.text: And Pharaoh ordered his officers daily to go to Goshen to seek for the babes of the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And when they had sought and found one, they took it from its mother’s bosom by force, and threw it into the river, but the female child they left with its mother; thus did the Egyptians do to the Israelites all the days.
verses.text: And when they had sought and found one, they took it from its mother’s bosom by force, and threw it into the river, but the female child they left with its mother; thus did the Egyptians do to the Israelites all the days.

verses.raw: And it was at that time the spirit of Elohim (God) was upon Miriam the daughter of Amram the sister of Aaron, and she went forth and prophesied about the house, saying, Behold a son will be born to us from my father and mother this time, and he will save Israel from the hands of Egypt.
verses.text: And it was at that time the spirit of Elohim was upon Miriam the daughter of Amram the sister of Aaron, and she went forth and prophesied about the house, saying, Behold a son will be born to us from my father and mother this time, and he will save Israel from the hands of Egypt.

verses.raw: And when Amram heard the words of his daughter, he went and took his wife back to the house, after he had driven her away at the time when Pharaoh ordered every male child of the house of Jacob to be thrown into the water.
verses.text: And when Amram heard the words of his daughter, he went and took his wife back to the house, after he had driven her away at the time when Pharaoh ordered every male child of the house of Jacob to be thrown into the water.

verses.raw: So Amram took Jochebed his wife, three years after he had driven her away, and he came to her and she conceived.
verses.text: So Amram took Jochebed his wife, three years after he had driven her away, and he came to her and she conceived.

verses.raw: And at the end of seven months from her conception she brought forth a son, and the whole house was filled with great light as of the light of the sun and moon at the time of their shining.
verses.text: And at the end of seven months from her conception she brought forth a son, and the whole house was filled with great light as of the light of the sun and moon at the time of their shining.

verses.raw: And when the woman saw the child that it was good and pleasing to the sight, she hid it for three months in an inner room.
verses.text: And when the woman saw the child that it was good and pleasing to the sight, she hid it for three months in an inner room.

verses.raw: In those days the Egyptians conspired to destroy all the Hebrews there.
verses.text: In those days the Egyptians conspired to destroy all the Hebrews there.

verses.raw: And the Egyptian women went to Goshen where the children of Israel were, and they carried their young ones upon their shoulders, their babes who could not yet speak.
verses.text: And the Egyptian women went to Goshen where the children of Israel were, and they carried their young ones upon their shoulders, their babes who could not yet speak.

verses.raw: And in those days, when the women of the children of Israel brought forth, each woman had hidden her son from before the Egyptians, that the Egyptians might not know of their bringing forth, and might not destroy them from the land.
verses.text: And in those days, when the women of the children of Israel brought forth, each woman had hidden her son from before the Egyptians, that the Egyptians might not know of their bringing forth, and might not destroy them from the land.

verses.raw: And the Egyptian women came to Goshen and their children who could not speak were upon their shoulders, and when an Egyptian woman came into the house of a Hebrew woman her babe began to cry.
verses.text: And the Egyptian women came to Goshen and their children who could not speak were upon their shoulders, and when an Egyptian woman came into the house of a Hebrew woman her babe began to cry.

verses.raw: And when it cried the child that was in the inner room answered it, so the Egyptian women went and told it at the house of Pharaoh.
verses.text: And when it cried the child that was in the inner room answered it, so the Egyptian women went and told it at the house of Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh sent his officers to take the children and slay them; thus did the Egyptians to the Hebrew women all the days.
verses.text: And Pharaoh sent his officers to take the children and slay them; thus did the Egyptians to the Hebrew women all the days.

verses.raw: And it was at that time, about three months from Jochebed’s concealment of her son, that the thing was known in Pharaoh’s house.
verses.text: And it was at that time, about three months from Jochebed’s concealment of her son, that the thing was known in Pharaoh’s house.

verses.raw: And the woman hastened to take away her son before the officers came, and she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child in it, and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.
verses.text: And the woman hastened to take away her son before the officers came, and she took for him an ark of bulrushes, and daubed it with slime and with pitch, and put the child in it, and she laid it in the flags by the river’s brink.

verses.raw: And his sister Miriam stood afar off to know what would be done to him, and what would become of her words.
verses.text: And his sister Miriam stood afar off to know what would be done to him, and what would become of her words.

verses.raw: And Elohim sent forth at that time a terrible heat in the land of Egypt, which burned up the flesh of man like the sun in his circuit, and it greatly oppressed the Egyptians.
verses.text: And Elohim sent forth at that time a terrible heat in the land of Egypt, which burned up the flesh of man like the sun in his circuit, and it greatly oppressed the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And all the Egyptians went down to bathe in the river, on account of the consuming heat which burned up their flesh.
verses.text: And all the Egyptians went down to bathe in the river, on account of the consuming heat which burned up their flesh.

verses.raw: And Bathia, the daughter of Pharaoh, went also to bathe in the river, owing to the consuming heat, and her maidens walked at the river side, and all the women of Egypt as well.
verses.text: And Bathia, the daughter of Pharaoh, went also to bathe in the river, owing to the consuming heat, and her maidens walked at the river side, and all the women of Egypt as well.

verses.raw: And Bathia lifted up her eyes to the river, and she saw the ark upon the water, and sent her maid to fetch it.
verses.text: And Bathia lifted up her eyes to the river, and she saw the ark upon the water, and sent her maid to fetch it.

verses.raw: And she opened it and saw the child, and behold the babe wept, and she had compassion on him, and she said, This is one of the Hebrew children.
verses.text: And she opened it and saw the child, and behold the babe wept, and she had compassion on him, and she said, This is one of the Hebrew children.

verses.raw: And all the women of Egypt walking on the river side desired to give him suck, but he would not suck, for this thing was from Yahuah (the Lord), in order to restore him to his mother’s breast.
verses.text: And all the women of Egypt walking on the river side desired to give him suck, but he would not suck, for this thing was from Yahuah (the Lord), in order to restore him to his mother’s breast.

verses.raw: And Miriam his sister was at that time amongst the Egyptian women at the river side, and she saw this thing and she said to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and fetch a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?
verses.text: And Miriam his sister was at that time amongst the Egyptian women at the river side, and she saw this thing and she said to Pharaoh’s daughter, Shall I go and fetch a nurse of the Hebrew women, that she may nurse the child for you?

verses.raw: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go, and the young woman went and called the child’s mother.
verses.text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, Go, and the young woman went and called the child’s mother.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to Jochebed, Take this child away and suckle it for me, and I will pay you your wages, two bits of silver daily; and the woman took the child and nursed it.
verses.text: And Pharaoh’s daughter said to Jochebed, Take this child away and suckle it for me, and I will pay you your wages, two bits of silver daily; and the woman took the child and nursed it.

verses.raw: And at the end of two years, when the child grew up, she brought him to the daughter of Pharaoh, and he was to her as a son, and she called his name Moses, for she said, Because I drew him out of the water.
verses.text: And at the end of two years, when the child grew up, she brought him to the daughter of Pharaoh, and he was to her as a son, and she called his name Moses, for she said, Because I drew him out of the water.

verses.raw: And Amram his father called his name Chabar, for he said, It was for him that he associated with his wife whom he had turned away.
verses.text: And Amram his father called his name Chabar, for he said, It was for him that he associated with his wife whom he had turned away.

verses.raw: And Jochebed his mother called his name Jekuthiel, Because, she said, I have hoped for him to El Shaddai (the Almighty), and Elohim restored him to me.
verses.text: And Jochebed his mother called his name Jekuthiel, Because, she said, I have hoped for him to El Shaddai (the Almighty), and Elohim restored him to me.

verses.raw: And Miriam his sister called him Jered, for she descended after him to the river to know what his end would be.
verses.text: And Miriam his sister called him Jered, for she descended after him to the river to know what his end would be.

verses.raw: And Aaron his brother called his name Abi Zanuch, saying, My father left my mother and returned to her on his account.

verses.raw: And in the third year from the birth of Moses, Pharaoh was sitting at a banquet, when Alparanith the queen was sitting at his right and Bathia at his left, and the lad Moses was lying upon her bosom, and Balaam the son of Beor with his two sons, and all the princes of the kingdom were sitting at table in the king’s presence.

verses.raw: And the lad stretched forth his hand upon the king’s head, and took the crown from the king’s head and placed it on his own head.
verses.text: And the lad stretched forth his hand upon the king’s head, and took the crown from the king’s head and placed it on his own head.

verses.raw: And when the king and princes saw the work which the boy had done, the king and princes were terrified, and one man to his neighbor expressed astonishment.
verses.text: And when the king and princes saw the work which the boy had done, the king and princes were terrified, and one man to his neighbor expressed astonishment.

verses.raw: And the king said to the princes who were before him at table, What speak you and what say you, O you princes, in this matter, and what is to be the judgment against the boy on account of this act?
verses.text: And the king said to the princes who were before him at table, What speak you and what say you, O you princes, in this matter, and what is to be the judgment against the boy on account of this act?

verses.raw: And Balaam the son of Beor the magician answered before the king and princes, and he said, Remember now, O my Lord and king, the dream which you did dream many days since, and that which your servant interpreted to you.
verses.text: And Balaam the son of Beor the magician answered before the king and princes, and he said, Remember now, O my Lord and king, the dream which you did dream many days since, and that which your servant interpreted to you.

verses.raw: Now therefore this is a child from the Hebrew children, in whom is the spirit of Elohim (God), and let not my Lord the king imagine that this youngster did this thing without knowledge.
verses.text: Now therefore this is a child from the Hebrew children, in whom is the spirit of Elohim, and let not my Lord the king imagine that this youngster did this thing without knowledge.

verses.raw: For he is a Hebrew boy, and wisdom and understanding are with him, although he is yet a child, and with wisdom has he done this and chosen to himself the kingdom of Egypt.
verses.text: For he is a Hebrew boy, and wisdom and understanding are with him, although he is yet a child, and with wisdom has he done this and chosen to himself the kingdom of Egypt.

verses.raw: For this is the manner of all the Hebrews to deceive kings and their nobles, to do all these things cunningly, in order to make the kings of the earth and their men tremble.
verses.text: For this is the manner of all the Hebrews to deceive kings and their nobles, to do all these things cunningly, in order to make the kings of the earth and their men tremble.

verses.raw: Surely you know that Abraham their father acted thus, who deceived the army of Nimrod king of Babel, and Abimelech king of Gerar, and that he possessed himself of the land of the children of Heth and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
verses.text: Surely you know that Abraham their father acted thus, who deceived the army of Nimrod king of Babel, and Abimelech king of Gerar, and that he possessed himself of the land of the children of Heth and all the kingdoms of Canaan.

verses.raw: And that he descended into Egypt and said of Sarah his wife, she is my sister, in order to mislead Egypt and her king.

verses.raw: His son Isaac also did so when he went to Gerar and dwelt there, and his strength prevailed over the army of Abimelech king of the Philistines.
verses.text: His son Isaac also did so when he went to Gerar and dwelt there, and his strength prevailed over the army of Abimelech king of the Philistines.

verses.raw: He also thought of making the kingdom of the Philistines stumble, in saying that Rebecca his wife was his sister.

verses.raw: Jacob also dealt treacherously with his brother, and took from his hand his birthright and his blessing.
verses.text: Jacob also dealt treacherously with his brother, and took from his hand his birthright and his blessing.

verses.raw: He went then to Padan-aram to the house of Laban his mother’s brother, and cunningly obtained from him his daughter, his cattle, and all belonging to him, and fled away and returned to the land of Canaan to his father.
verses.text: He went then to Padan-aram to the house of Laban his mother’s brother, and cunningly obtained from him his daughter, his cattle, and all belonging to him, and fled away and returned to the land of Canaan to his father.

verses.raw: His sons sold their brother Joseph, who went down into Egypt and became a slave, and was placed in the prison house for twelve years.

verses.raw: Until the former Pharaoh dreamed dreams, and withdrew him from the prison house, and magnified him above all the princes in Egypt on account of his interpreting his dreams to him.

verses.raw: And when Elohim caused a famine throughout the land he sent for and brought his father and all his brothers, and the whole of his father’s household, and supported them without price or reward, and bought the Egyptians for slaves.

verses.raw: Now therefore my Lord king behold this child has risen up in their stead in Egypt, to do according to their deeds and to trifle with every king, prince and judge.
verses.text: Now therefore my Lord king behold this child has risen up in their stead in Egypt, to do according to their deeds and to trifle with every king, prince and judge.

verses.raw: If it please the king, let us now spill his blood upon the ground, lest he grow up and take away the government from your hand, and the hope of Egypt perish after he shall have reigned.
verses.text: If it please the king, let us now spill his blood upon the ground, lest he grow up and take away the government from your hand, and the hope of Egypt perish after he shall have reigned.

verses.raw: And Balaam said to the king, Let us moreover call for all the judges of Egypt and the wise men of it, and let us know if the judgment of death is due to this boy as you did say, and then we will slay him.
verses.text: And Balaam said to the king, Let us moreover call for all the judges of Egypt and the wise men of it, and let us know if the judgment of death is due to this boy as you did say, and then we will slay him.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh sent and called for all the wise men of Egypt and they came before the king, and an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) came amongst them, and he was like one of the wise men of Egypt.
verses.text: And Pharaoh sent and called for all the wise men of Egypt and they came before the king, and an angel of Yahuah (the Lord) came amongst them, and he was like one of the wise men of Egypt.

verses.raw: And the king said to the wise men, Surely you have heard what this Hebrew boy who is in the house has done, and thus has Balaam judged in the matter.
verses.text: And the king said to the wise men, Surely you have heard what this Hebrew boy who is in the house has done, and thus has Balaam judged in the matter.

verses.raw: Now judge you also and see what is due to the boy for the act he has committed.
verses.text: Now judge you also and see what is due to the boy for the act he has committed.

verses.raw: And the angel, who seemed like one of the wise men of Pharaoh, answered and said as follows, before all the wise men of Egypt and before the king and the princes:
verses.text: And the angel, who seemed like one of the wise men of Pharaoh, answered and said as follows, before all the wise men of Egypt and before the king and the princes:

verses.raw: If it please the king let the king send for men who shall bring before him an onyx stone and a coal of fire, and place them before the child, and if the child shall stretch forth his hand and take the onyx stone, then shall we know that with wisdom has the youth done all that he has done, and we must slay him.
verses.text: If it please the king let the king send for men who shall bring before him an onyx stone and a coal of fire, and place them before the child, and if the child shall stretch forth his hand and take the onyx stone, then shall we know that with wisdom has the youth done all that he has done, and we must slay him.

verses.raw: But if he stretch forth his hand upon the coal, then shall we know that it was not with knowledge that he did this thing, and he shall live.
verses.text: But if he stretch forth his hand upon the coal, then shall we know that it was not with knowledge that he did this thing, and he shall live.

verses.raw: And the thing seemed good in the eyes of the king and the princes, so the king did according to the word of the angel of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And the thing seemed good in the eyes of the king and the princes, so the king did according to the word of the angel of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And the king ordered the onyx stone and coal to be brought and placed before Moses.
verses.text: And the king ordered the onyx stone and coal to be brought and placed before Moses.

verses.text: And they placed the boy before them, and the lad endeavored to stretch forth his hand to the onyx stone, but the angel of Yahuah (the Lord) took his hand and placed it upon the coal, and the coal became extinguished in his hand, and he lifted it up and put it into his mouth, and burned part of his lips and part of his tongue, and he became heavy in mouth and tongue.

verses.raw: And when Moses grew up in the king’s house, Bathia the daughter of Pharaoh considered him as a son, and all the household of Pharaoh honored him, and all the men of Egypt were afraid of him.
verses.text: And when Moses grew up in the king’s house, Bathia the daughter of Pharaoh considered him as a son, and all the household of Pharaoh honored him, and all the men of Egypt were afraid of him.

verses.raw: And he daily went forth and came into the land of Goshen, where his brethren the children of Israel were, and Moses saw them daily in shortness of breath and hard labor.

verses.text: And Moses asked them, saying, Therefore is this labor meted out to you day by day?

verses.raw: And they told him all the counsels which Balaam the son of Beor had counselled against them, and what he had also counselled against him in order to slay him when he had taken the king’s crown from off his head.

verses.raw: And the day arrived when Moses went to Goshen to see his brethren, that he saw the children of Israel in their burdens and hard labor, and Moses was grieved on their account.

verses.raw: And Moses returned to Egypt and came to the house of Pharaoh, and came before the king, and Moses bowed down before the king.

verses.raw: And Moses said to Pharaoh, I pray you my Lord, I have come to seek a small request from you, turn not away my face empty; and Pharaoh said to him, Speak.
verses.text: And Moses said to Pharaoh, I pray you my Lord, I have come to seek a small request from you, turn not away my face empty; and Pharaoh said to him, Speak.

verses.text: And Moses said to Pharaoh, Let there be given to your servants the children of Israel who are in Goshen, one day to rest in it from their labor.

verses.raw: To you, all the children of Israel, thus says the king, for six days you shall do your work and labor, but on the seventh day you shall rest, and shall not preform any work, thus shall you do all the days, as the king and Moses the son of Bathia have commanded.

verses.raw: And Moses rejoiced at this thing which the king had granted to him, and all the children of Israel did as Moses ordered them.

verses.raw: And when Moses was eighteen years old, he desired to see his father and mother and he went to them to Goshen, and when Moses had come near Goshen, he came to the place where the children of Israel were engaged in work, and he observed their burdens, and he saw an Egyptian smiting one of his Hebrew brethren.

verses.text: And when the man who was beaten saw Moses he ran to him for help, for the man Moses was greatly respected in the house of Pharaoh, and he said to him, My Lord attend to me, this Egyptian came to my house in the night, bound me, and came to my wife in my presence, and now he seeks to take my life away.

verses.raw: And when Moses heard this wicked thing, his anger was kindled against the Egyptian, and he turned this way and the other, and when he saw there was no man there he smote the Egyptian and hid him in the sand, and delivered the Hebrew from the hand of him that smote him.

verses.raw: And Moses was nine years in the camp of Kikianus king of Cush, all the time that they were besieging Cush, and Moses went out and came in with them.

verses.raw: And the king and princes and all the fighting men loved Moses, for he was great and worthy, his stature was like a noble lion, his face was like the sun, and his strength was like that of a lion, and he was counsellor to the king.

verses.raw: And they built over him an elegant strong and high building, and they placed great stones below.

verses.raw: And the king’s scribes engraved upon those stones all the might of their king Kikianus, and all his battles which he had fought, behold they are written there at this day.

verses.raw: Now after the death of Kikianus king of Cush it grieved his men and troops greatly on account of the war.
verses.text: Now after the death of Kikianus king of Cush it grieved his men and troops greatly on account of the war.

verses.raw: So they said one to the other, Give us counsel what we are to do at this time, as we have resided in the wilderness nine years away from our homes.
verses.text: So they said one to the other, Give us counsel what we are to do at this time, as we have resided in the wilderness nine years away from our homes.

verses.raw: If we say we will fight against the city many of us will fall wounded or killed, and if we remain here in the siege we shall also die.
verses.text: If we say we will fight against the city many of us will fall wounded or killed, and if we remain here in the siege we shall also die.

verses.raw: For now all the kings of Aram and of the children of the east will hear that our king is dead, and they will attack us suddenly in a hostile manner, and they will fight against us and leave no remnant of us.
verses.text: For now all the kings of Aram and of the children of the east will hear that our king is dead, and they will attack us suddenly in a hostile manner, and they will fight against us and leave no remnant of us.

verses.raw: Now therefore let us go and make a king over us, and let us remain in the siege until the city is delivered up to us.
verses.text: Now therefore let us go and make a king over us, and let us remain in the siege until the city is delivered up to us.

verses.raw: And they wished to choose on that day a man for king from the army of Kikianus, and they found no object of their choice like Moses to reign over them.
verses.text: And they wished to choose on that day a man for king from the army of Kikianus, and they found no object of their choice like Moses to reign over them.

verses.raw: And they hastened and stripped off each man his garments and cast them upon the ground, and they made a great heap and placed Moses on it.

verses.text: And they spread out a sheet upon the heap, and every man cast into it something of what he had, one a gold earring and the other a coin.

verses.raw: And Moses reigned over the children of Cush on that day, in the place of Kikianus king of Cush.

verses.text: Moses was twenty-seven years old when he began to reign over Cush, and forty years did he reign.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) granted Moses favor and grace in the eyes of all the children of Cush, and the children of Cush loved him exceedingly, so Moses was favored by Yahuah (the Lord) and by men.

verses.text: And in those days died Janeas king of the children of Chittim, and they buried him in his temple which he had built for himself in the plain of Canopia for a residence, and Latinus reigned in his stead.

verses.text: In the twenty-second year of the reign of Moses over the children of Cush, Latinus reigned over the children of Chittim forty-five years.

verses.raw: And he also built for himself a great and mighty tower, and he built in it an elegant temple for his residence, to conduct his government, as was the custom.
verses.text: And he also built for himself a great and mighty tower, and he built in it an elegant temple for his residence, to conduct his government, as was the custom.

verses.raw: In the third year of his reign he caused a proclamation to be made to all his skilful men, who made many ships for him.
verses.text: In the third year of his reign he caused a proclamation to be made to all his skilful men, who made many ships for him.

verses.raw: And Latinus assembled all his forces, and they came in ships, and went in it to fight with Azdrubal son of Angeas king of Africa, and they came to Africa and engaged in battle with Azdrubal and his army.
verses.text: And Latinus assembled all his forces, and they came in ships, and went in it to fight with Azdrubal son of Angeas king of Africa, and they came to Africa and engaged in battle with Azdrubal and his army.

verses.raw: And Latinus prevailed over Azdrubal, and Latinus took from Azdrubal the aqueduct which his father had brought from the children of Chittim, when he took Janiah the daughter of Uzi for a wife, so Latinus overthrew the bridge of the aqueduct, and smote the whole army of Azdrubal a severe blow.

verses.raw: And the remaining strong men of Azdrubal strengthened themselves, and their hearts were filled with envy, and they courted death, and again engaged in battle with Latinus king of Chittim.

verses.raw: And the battle was severe upon all the men of Africa, and they all fell wounded before Latinus and his people, and Azdrubal the king also fell in that battle.

verses.raw: And the king Azdrubal had a very beautiful daughter, whose name was Ushpezena, and all the men of Africa embroidered her likeness on their garments, on account of her great beauty and comely appearance.

verses.raw: And the men of Latinus saw Ushpezena, the daughter of Azdrubal, and praised her to Latinus their king.

verses.raw: And Latinus ordered her to be brought to him, and Latinus took Ushpezena for a wife, and he turned back on his way to Chittim.

verses.raw: And it was after the death of Azdrubal son of Angeas, when Latinus had turned back to his land from the battle, that all the inhabitants of Africa rose up and took Anibal the son of Angeas, the younger brother of Azdrubal, and made him king instead at his brother over the whole land at Africa.

verses.raw: And when he reigned, he resolved to go to Chittim to fight with the children of Chittim, to avenge the cause of Azdrubal his brother, and the cause of the inhabitants of Africa, and he did so.
verses.text: And when he reigned, he resolved to go to Chittim to fight with the children of Chittim, to avenge the cause of Azdrubal his brother, and the cause of the inhabitants of Africa, and he did so.

verses.raw: And he made many ships, and he came in it with his whole army, and he went to Chittim.
verses.text: And he made many ships, and he came in it with his whole army, and he went to Chittim.

verses.raw: So Anibal fought with the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim fell wounded before Anibal and his army, and Anibal avenged his brother’s cause.
verses.text: So Anibal fought with the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim fell wounded before Anibal and his army, and Anibal avenged his brother’s cause.

verses.raw: And Anibal continued the war for eighteen years with the children of Chittim, and Anibal dwelt in the land of Chittim and encamped there for a long time.
verses.text: And Anibal continued the war for eighteen years with the children of Chittim, and Anibal dwelt in the land of Chittim and encamped there for a long time.

verses.raw: And Anibal smote the children of Chittim very severely, and he slew their great men and princes, and of the rest of the people he smote about eighty thousand men.

verses.raw: And at the end of days and years, Anibal returned to his land of Africa, and he reigned securely in the place of Azdrubal his brother.

verses.raw: At that time, in the hundred and eightieth year of the Israelites going down into Egypt, there went forth from Egypt valiant men, thirty thousand on foot, from the children of Israel, who were all of the tribe of Joseph, of the children of Ephraim the son of Joseph.

verses.raw: For they said the period was completed which Yahuah (the Lord) had appointed to the children of Israel in the times of old, which he had spoken to Abraham.
verses.text: For they said the period was completed which Yahuah (the Lord) had appointed to the children of Israel in the times of old, which he had spoken to Abraham.

verses.raw: And these men girded themselves, and they put each man his sword at his side, and every man his armor upon him, and they trusted to their strength, and they went out together from Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.text: And these men girded themselves, and they put each man his sword at his side, and every man his armor upon him, and they trusted to their strength, and they went out together from Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.raw: But they brought no provision for the road, only silver and gold, not even bread for that day did they bring in their hands, for they thought of getting their provision for pay from the Philistines, and if not they would take it by force.

verses.raw: And these men were very mighty and valiant men, one man could pursue a thousand and two could rout ten thousand, so they trusted to their strength and went together as they were.

verses.raw: And they directed their course toward the land of Gath, and they went down and found the shepherds of Gath feeding the cattle of the children of Gath.

verses.raw: And they said to the shepherds, Give us some of the sheep for pay, that we may eat, for we are hungry, for we have eaten no bread this day.
verses.text: And they said to the shepherds, Give us some of the sheep for pay, that we may eat, for we are hungry, for we have eaten no bread this day.

verses.raw: And the shepherds said, Are they our sheep or cattle that we should give them to you even for pay? so the children of Ephraim approached to take them by force.
verses.text: And the shepherds said, Are they our sheep or cattle that we should give them to you even for pay? so the children of Ephraim approached to take them by force.

verses.raw: And the shepherds of Gath shouted over them that their cry was heard at a distance, so all the children of Gath went out to them.

verses.raw: And when the children of Gath saw the evil doings of the children of Ephraim, they returned and assembled the men of Gath, and they put on each man his armor, and came forth to the children of Ephraim for battle.
verses.text: And when the children of Gath saw the evil doings of the children of Ephraim, they returned and assembled the men of Gath, and they put on each man his armor, and came forth to the children of Ephraim for battle.

verses.raw: And they engaged with them in the valley of Gath, and the battle was severe, and they smote from each other a great many on that day.
verses.text: And they engaged with them in the valley of Gath, and the battle was severe, and they smote from each other a great many on that day.

verses.raw: And on the second day the children of Gath sent to all the cities of the Philistines that they should come to their help, saying,
verses.text: And on the second day the children of Gath sent to all the cities of the Philistines that they should come to their help, saying,

verses.raw: Come up to us and help us, that we may smite the children of Ephraim who have come forth from Egypt to take our cattle, and to fight against us without cause.
verses.text: Come up to us and help us, that we may smite the children of Ephraim who have come forth from Egypt to take our cattle, and to fight against us without cause.

verses.raw: Now the souls of the children of Ephraim were exhausted with hunger and thirst, for they had eaten no bread for three days. And forty thousand men went forth from the cities of the Philistines to the assistance of the men of Gath.
verses.text: Now the souls of the children of Ephraim were exhausted with hunger and thirst, for they had eaten no bread for three days. And forty thousand men went forth from the cities of the Philistines to the assistance of the men of Gath.

verses.raw: And these men were engaged in battle with the children of Ephraim, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered the children of Ephraim into the hands of the Philistines.
verses.text: And these men were engaged in battle with the children of Ephraim, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered the children of Ephraim into the hands of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And they smote all the children of Ephraim, all who had gone forth from Egypt, none were remaining but ten men who had run away from the engagement.
verses.text: And they smote all the children of Ephraim, all who had gone forth from Egypt, none were remaining but ten men who had run away from the engagement.

verses.raw: For this evil was from Yahuah (the Lord) against the children of Ephraim, for they transgressed the word of Yahuah (the Lord) in going forth from Egypt, before the period had arrived which Yahuah (the Lord) in the days of old had appointed to Israel.

verses.raw: And of the Philistines also there fell a great many, about twenty thousand men, and their brethren carried them and buried them in their cities.
verses.text: And of the Philistines also there fell a great many, about twenty thousand men, and their brethren carried them and buried them in their cities.

verses.raw: And the slain of the children of Ephraim remained forsaken in the valley of Gath for many days and years, and were not brought to burial, and the valley was filled with men’s bones.
verses.text: And the slain of the children of Ephraim remained forsaken in the valley of Gath for many days and years, and were not brought to burial, and the valley was filled with men’s bones.

verses.raw: And the men who had escaped from the battle came to Egypt, and told all the children of Israel all that had befallen them.
verses.text: And the men who had escaped from the battle came to Egypt, and told all the children of Israel all that had befallen them.

verses.raw: And their father Ephraim mourned over them for many days, and his brethren came to console him.

verses.raw: And he came to his wife and she bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, for she was unfortunate in his house.
verses.text: And he came to his wife and she bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, for she was unfortunate in his house.

verses.raw: And Moses the son of Amram was still king in the land of Cush in those days, and he prospered in his kingdom, and he conducted the government of the children of Cush in justice, in righteousness, and integrity.
verses.text: And Moses the son of Amram was still king in the land of Cush in those days, and he prospered in his kingdom, and he conducted the government of the children of Cush in justice, in righteousness, and integrity.

verses.raw: And all the children of Cush loved Moses all the days that he reigned over them, and all the inhabitants of the land of Cush were greatly afraid of him.
verses.text: And all the children of Cush loved Moses all the days that he reigned over them, and all the inhabitants of the land of Cush were greatly afraid of him.

verses.raw: And in the fortieth year of the reign of Moses over Cush, Moses was sitting on the royal throne whilst Adoniah the queen was before him, and all the nobles were sitting around him.
verses.text: And in the fortieth year of the reign of Moses over Cush, Moses was sitting on the royal throne whilst Adoniah the queen was before him, and all the nobles were sitting around him.

verses.raw: And Adoniah the queen said before the king and the princes, What is this thing which you, the children of Cush, have done for this long time?
verses.text: And Adoniah the queen said before the king and the princes, What is this thing which you, the children of Cush, have done for this long time?

verses.raw: Surely you know that for forty years that this man has reigned over Cush he has not approached me, nor has he served the gods of the children of Cush.
verses.text: Surely you know that for forty years that this man has reigned over Cush he has not approached me, nor has he served the gods of the children of Cush.

verses.raw: Now therefore hear, O you children of Cush, and let this man no more reign over you as he is not of our flesh.
verses.text: Now therefore hear, O you children of Cush, and let this man no more reign over you as he is not of our flesh.

verses.raw: Behold Menacrus my son is grown up, let him reign over you, for it is better for you to serve the son of your Lord, than to serve a stranger, slave of the king of Egypt.
verses.text: Behold Menacrus my son is grown up, let him reign over you, for it is better for you to serve the son of your Lord, than to serve a stranger, slave of the king of Egypt.

verses.raw: And all the people and nobles of the children of Cush heard the words which Adoniah the queen had spoken in their ears.
verses.text: And all the people and nobles of the children of Cush heard the words which Adoniah the queen had spoken in their ears.

verses.raw: And all the people were preparing until the evening, and in the morning they rose up early and made Menacrus, son of Kikianus, king over them.
verses.text: And all the people were preparing until the evening, and in the morning they rose up early and made Menacrus, son of Kikianus, king over them.

verses.raw: And all the children of Cush were afraid to stretch forth their hand against Moses, for Yahuah (the Lord) was with Moses, and the children of Cush remembered the oath which they swore to Moses, therefore they did no harm to him.
verses.text: And all the children of Cush were afraid to stretch forth their hand against Moses, for Yahuah (the Lord) was with Moses, and the children of Cush remembered the oath which they swore to Moses, therefore they did no harm to him.

verses.raw: But the children of Cush gave many presents to Moses, and sent him from them with great honor.
verses.text: But the children of Cush gave many presents to Moses, and sent him from them with great honor.

verses.raw: So Moses went forth from the land of Cush, and went home and ceased to reign over Cush, and Moses was sixty-six years old when he went out of the land of Cush, for the thing was from Yahuah (the Lord), for the period had arrived which he had appointed in the days of old, to bring forth Israel from the affliction of the children of Ham.

verses.raw: So Moses went to Midian, for he was afraid to return to Egypt on account of Pharaoh, and he went and sat at a well of water in Midian.
verses.text: So Moses went to Midian, for he was afraid to return to Egypt on account of Pharaoh, and he went and sat at a well of water in Midian.

verses.raw: And the seven daughters of Reuel the Midianite went out to feed their father’s flock.
verses.text: And the seven daughters of Reuel the Midianite went out to feed their father’s flock.

verses.raw: And they came to the well and drew water to water their father’s flock.
verses.text: And they came to the well and drew water to water their father’s flock.

verses.raw: So the shepherds of Midian came and drove them away, and Moses rose up and helped them and watered the flock.
verses.text: So the shepherds of Midian came and drove them away, and Moses rose up and helped them and watered the flock.

verses.raw: And they came home to their father Reuel, and told him what Moses did for them.
verses.text: And they came home to their father Reuel, and told him what Moses did for them.

verses.raw: And they said, An Egyptian man has delivered us from the hands of the shepherds, he drew up water for us and watered the flock.
verses.text: And they said, An Egyptian man has delivered us from the hands of the shepherds, he drew up water for us and watered the flock.

verses.raw: And Reuel said to his daughters, And where is he? therefore have you left the man?
verses.text: And Reuel said to his daughters, And where is he? therefore have you left the man?

verses.raw: And Reuel sent for him and fetched him and brought him home, and he ate bread with him.
verses.text: And Reuel sent for him and fetched him and brought him home, and he ate bread with him.

verses.raw: And Moses related to Reuel that he had fled from Egypt and that he reigned forty years over Cush, and that they afterward had taken the government from him, and had sent him away in peace with honor and with presents.
verses.text: And Moses related to Reuel that he had fled from Egypt and that he reigned forty years over Cush, and that they afterward had taken the government from him, and had sent him away in peace with honor and with presents.

verses.raw: And when Reuel had heard the words of Moses, Reuel said within himself, I will put this man into the prison house, by which I shall conciliate the children of Cush, for he has fled from them.
verses.text: And when Reuel had heard the words of Moses, Reuel said within himself, I will put this man into the prison house, by which I shall conciliate the children of Cush, for he has fled from them.

verses.raw: And they took and put him into the prison house, and Moses was in prison ten years, and whilst Moses was in the prison house, Zipporah the daughter of Reuel took pity over him, and supported him with bread and water all the time.
verses.text: And they took and put him into the prison house, and Moses was in prison ten years, and whilst Moses was in the prison house, Zipporah the daughter of Reuel took pity over him, and supported him with bread and water all the time.

verses.raw: And all the children of Israel were yet in the land of Egypt serving the Egyptians in all manner of hard work, and the hand of Egypt continued in severity over the children of Israel in those days.
verses.text: And all the children of Israel were yet in the land of Egypt serving the Egyptians in all manner of hard work, and the hand of Egypt continued in severity over the children of Israel in those days.

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) smote Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he afflicted with the plague of leprosy from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head; owing to the cruel treatment of the children of Israel was this plague at that time from Yahuah (the Lord) upon Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) smote Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he afflicted with the plague of leprosy from the sole of his foot to the crown of his head; owing to the cruel treatment of the children of Israel was this plague at that time from Yahuah (the Lord) upon Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (the Lord) had hearkened to the prayer of his people the children of Israel, and their cry reached him on account of their hard work.
verses.text: For Yahuah (the Lord) had hearkened to the prayer of his people the children of Israel, and their cry reached him on account of their hard work.

verses.raw: Still his anger did not turn from them, and the hand of Pharaoh was still stretched out against the children of Israel, and Pharaoh hardened his neck before Yahuah (the Lord), and he increased his yoke over the children of Israel, and embittered their lives with all manner of hard work.

verses.raw: And when Yahuah (the Lord) had inflicted the plague upon Pharaoh king of Egypt, he asked his wise men and sorcerers to cure him.

verses.text: And his wise men and sorcerers said to him, That if the blood of little children were put into the wounds he would be healed.

verses.raw: At that time the two ministers of Pharaoh came from the land of Goshen where all the children of Israel were, and went to the house of Pharaoh and said to him, We have seen the children of Israel slacken in their work and negligent in their labor.

verses.raw: And Aaron the son of Amram, the brother of Moses, was in Egypt walking at the river side on that day.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared to him in that place, and he said to him, Go now toward Moses in the wilderness, and he went and met him in the mountain of Elohim, and he kissed him.

verses.raw: And when they came to the king’s gate, two young lions were confined there with iron instruments, and no person went out or came in from before them, unless those whom the king ordered to come, when the conjurors came and withdrew the lions by their incantations, and this brought them to the king.

verses.raw: And Moses hastened and lifted up the stick upon the lions, and he loosed them, and Moses and Aaron came into the king’s house.

verses.raw: And when Pharaoh saw this thing he was astonished at it, and he was greatly terrified at the report, for their appearance was like the appearance of the children of Elohim.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said to Moses, What do you require? and they answered him, saying, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) of the Hebrews has sent us to you, to say, Send forth my people that they may serve me.
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Moses, What do you require? and they answered him, saying, Yahuah Elohim of the Hebrews has sent us to you, to say, Send forth my people that they may serve me.

verses.raw: And when Pharaoh heard their words he was greatly terrified before them, and he said to them, Go today and come back to me tomorrow, and they did according to the word of the king.

verses.raw: And when they had gone Pharaoh sent for Balaam the magician and to Jannes and Jambres his sons, and to all the magicians and conjurors and counsellors which belonged to the king, and they all came and sat before the king.
verses.text: And when they had gone Pharaoh sent for Balaam the magician and to Jannes and Jambres his sons, and to all the magicians and conjurors and counsellors which belonged to the king, and they all came and sat before the king.

verses.raw: And the king said, Because they lifted up their rod against the lions and loosed them, and came to me, and the lions also rejoiced at them as a dog rejoices to meet his master.
verses.text: And the king said, Because they lifted up their rod against the lions and loosed them, and came to me, and the lions also rejoiced at them as a dog rejoices to meet his master.

verses.raw: And Balaam the son of Beor the magician answered the king, saying, These are none else than magicians like ourselves.

verses.raw: Now therefore send for them, and let them come and we will try them, and the king did so.

verses.text: Thus said Yahuah Elohim of the Hebrews, Send my people that they may serve me.

verses.raw: And the king said to them, But who will believe you that you are the messengers of Elohim and that you come to me by his order?
verses.text: And the king said to them, But who will believe you that you are the messengers of Elohim and that you come to me by his order?

verses.text: Now therefore give a wonder or sign in this matter, and then the words which you speak will be believed.

verses.raw: And Aaron hastened and threw the rod out of his hand before Pharaoh and before his servants, and the rod turned into a serpent.

verses.raw: And the sorcerers saw this and they cast each man his rod upon the ground and they became serpents.
verses.text: And the sorcerers saw this and they cast each man his rod upon the ground and they became serpents.

verses.raw: And the serpent of Aaron’s rod lifted up its head and opened its mouth to swallow the rods of the magicians.
verses.text: And the serpent of Aaron’s rod lifted up its head and opened its mouth to swallow the rods of the magicians.

verses.raw: And Balaam the magician answered and said, This thing has been from the days of old, that a serpent should swallow its fellow, and that living things devour each other.
verses.text: And Balaam the magician answered and said, This thing has been from the days of old, that a serpent should swallow its fellow, and that living things devour each other.

verses.raw: Now therefore restore it to a rod as it was at first, and we will also restore our rods as they were at first, and if your rod shall swallow our rods, then shall we know that the spirit of Elohim is in you, and if not, you are only an artificer like to ourselves.
verses.text: Now therefore restore it to a rod as it was at first, and we will also restore our rods as they were at first, and if your rod shall swallow our rods, then shall we know that the spirit of Elohim is in you, and if not, you are only an artificer like to ourselves.

verses.raw: And Aaron hastened and stretched forth his hand and caught hold of the serpent’s tail and it became a rod in his hand, and the sorcerers did the like with their rods, and they got hold, each man of the tail of his serpent, and they became rods as at first.

verses.raw: And when they were restored to rods, the rod of Aaron swallowed up their rods.
verses.text: And when they were restored to rods, the rod of Aaron swallowed up their rods.

verses.raw: And when the king saw this thing, he ordered the book of records that related to the kings of Egypt, to be brought, and they brought the book of records, the chronicles of the kings of Egypt, in which all the idols of Egypt were inscribed, for they thought of finding in it the name of Yahuah (Jehovah), but they found it not.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said to Moses and Aaron, Behold I have not found the name of your Elohim written in this book, and his name I know not.
verses.text: And Pharaoh said to Moses and Aaron, Behold I have not found the name of your Elohim written in this book, and his name I know not.

verses.raw: And the counsellors and wise men answered the king, We have heard that the Elohim of the Hebrews is a son of the wise, the son of ancient kings.
verses.text: And the counsellors and wise men answered the king, We have heard that the Elohim of the Hebrews is a son of the wise, the son of ancient kings.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh turned to Moses and Aaron and said to them, I know not Yahuah (the Lord) whom you have declared, neither will I send his people.
verses.text: And Pharaoh turned to Moses and Aaron and said to them, I know not Yahuah (the Lord) whom you have declared, neither will I send his people.

verses.raw: And they answered and said to the king, Yahuah Elohim of elohim (of Gods) is his name, and he proclaimed his name over us from the days of our ancestors, and sent us, saying, Go to Pharaoh and say to him, Send my people that they may serve me.
verses.text: And they answered and said to the king, Yahuah Elohim of elohim (of Gods) is his name, and he proclaimed his name over us from the days of our ancestors, and sent us, saying, Go to Pharaoh and say to him, Send my people that they may serve me.

verses.raw: Now therefore send us, that we may take a journey for three days in the wilderness, and there may sacrifice to him, for from the days of our going down to Egypt, he has not taken from our hands either burnt offering, oblation or sacrifice, and if you will not send us, his anger will be kindled against you, and he will smite Egypt either with the plague or with the sword.
verses.text: Now therefore send us, that we may take a journey for three days in the wilderness, and there may sacrifice to him, for from the days of our going down to Egypt, he has not taken from our hands either burnt offering, oblation or sacrifice, and if you will not send us, his anger will be kindled against you, and he will smite Egypt either with the plague or with the sword.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh said to them, Tell me now his power and his might; and they said to him, He created the heaven and the earth, the seas and all their fishes, he formed the light, created the darkness, caused rain upon the earth and watered it, and made the herbage and grass to sprout, he created man and beast and the animals of the forest, the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, and by his mouth they live and die.

verses.raw: Surely he created you in your mother’s womb, and put into you the breath of life, and reared you and placed you upon the royal throne of Egypt, and he will take your breath and soul from you, and return you to the ground whence you were taken.

verses.raw: And the anger of the king was kindled at their words, and he said to them, But who amongst all the elohim (gods) of the nations can do this? my river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.
verses.text: And the anger of the king was kindled at their words, and he said to them, But who amongst all the elohim (gods) of the nations can do this? my river is mine own, and I have made it for myself.

verses.raw: And he drove them from him, and he ordered the labor upon Israel to be more severe than it was yesterday and before.
verses.text: And he drove them from him, and he ordered the labor upon Israel to be more severe than it was yesterday and before.

verses.raw: And Moses and Aaron went out from the king’s presence, and they saw the children of Israel in an evil condition for the task-masters had made their labor exceedingly heavy.
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron went out from the king’s presence, and they saw the children of Israel in an evil condition for the task-masters had made their labor exceedingly heavy.

verses.raw: And Moses returned to Yahuah (the Lord) and said, Why have you ill treated your people? for since I came to speak to Pharaoh what you did send me for, he has exceedingly ill used the children of Israel.
verses.text: And Moses returned to Yahuah (the Lord) and said, Why have you ill treated your people? for since I came to speak to Pharaoh what you did send me for, he has exceedingly ill used the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And Moses and Aaron dwelt amongst their brethren the children of Israel in Egypt.
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron dwelt amongst their brethren the children of Israel in Egypt.

verses.raw: And as for the children of Israel the Egyptians embittered their lives, with the heavy work which they imposed upon them.

verses.raw: And at the end of two years, Yahuah (the Lord) again sent Moses to Pharaoh to bring forth the children of Israel, and to send them out of the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And Moses went and came to the house of Pharaoh, and he spoke to him the words of Yahuah (the Lord) who had sent him, but Pharaoh would not hearken to the voice of Yahuah (the Lord), and Elohim (God) roused his might in Egypt upon Pharaoh and his subjects, and Elohim smote Pharaoh and his people with very great and sore plagues.
