verses.text: And the darkness was very great in Egypt for three days, and any person who was standing when the darkness came, remained standing in his place, and he that was sitting remained sitting, and he that was lying continued lying in the same state, and he that was walking remained sitting upon the ground in the same spot; and this thing happened to all the Egyptians, until the darkness had passed away.

verses.raw: And the days of darkness passed away, and Yahuah (the Lord) sent Moses and Aaron to the children of Israel, saying, Celebrate your feast and make your Passover, for behold I come in the midst of the night amongst all the Egyptians, and I will smite all their first born, from the first born of a man to the first born of a beast, and when I see your Passover, I will pass over you.
verses.text: And the days of darkness passed away, and Yahuah (the Lord) sent Moses and Aaron to the children of Israel, saying, Celebrate your feast and make your Passover, for behold I come in the midst of the night amongst all the Egyptians, and I will smite all their first born, from the first born of a man to the first born of a beast, and when I see your Passover, I will pass over you.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel did according to all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses and Aaron, thus did they in that night.
verses.text: And the children of Israel did according to all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses and Aaron, thus did they in that night.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the middle of the night, that Yahuah (the Lord) went forth in the midst of Egypt, and smote all the first born of the Egyptians, from the first born of man to the first born of beast.
verses.text: And it came to pass in the middle of the night, that Yahuah (the Lord) went forth in the midst of Egypt, and smote all the first born of the Egyptians, from the first born of man to the first born of beast.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he and all his servants and all the Egyptians, and there was a great cry throughout Egypt in that night, for there was not a house in which there was not a corpse.
verses.text: And Pharaoh rose up in the night, he and all his servants and all the Egyptians, and there was a great cry throughout Egypt in that night, for there was not a house in which there was not a corpse.

verses.raw: Also the likenesses of the first born of Egypt, which were carved in the walls at their houses, were destroyed and fell to the ground.
verses.text: Also the likenesses of the first born of Egypt, which were carved in the walls at their houses, were destroyed and fell to the ground.

verses.raw: Even the bones of their first born who had died before this and whom they had buried in their houses, were raked up by the dogs of Egypt on that night and dragged before the Egyptians and cast before them.
verses.text: Even the bones of their first born who had died before this and whom they had buried in their houses, were raked up by the dogs of Egypt on that night and dragged before the Egyptians and cast before them.

verses.raw: And all the Egyptians saw this evil which had suddenly come upon them, and all the Egyptians cried out with a loud voice.
verses.text: And all the Egyptians saw this evil which had suddenly come upon them, and all the Egyptians cried out with a loud voice.

verses.raw: And all the families of Egypt wept upon that night, each man for his son and each man for his daughter, being the first born, and the tumult of Egypt was heard at a distance on that night.
verses.text: And all the families of Egypt wept upon that night, each man for his son and each man for his daughter, being the first born, and the tumult of Egypt was heard at a distance on that night.

verses.raw: And Bathia the daughter of Pharaoh went forth with the king on that night to seek Moses and Aaron in their houses, and they found them in their houses, eating and drinking and rejoicing with all Israel.
verses.text: And Bathia the daughter of Pharaoh went forth with the king on that night to seek Moses and Aaron in their houses, and they found them in their houses, eating and drinking and rejoicing with all Israel.

verses.raw: And Bathia said to Moses, Is this the reward for the good which I have done to you, who have reared you and stretched you out, and you have brought this evil upon me and my father’s house?
verses.text: And Bathia said to Moses, Is this the reward for the good which I have done to you, who have reared you and stretched you out, and you have brought this evil upon me and my father’s house?

verses.raw: And Moses said to her, Surely ten plagues did Yahuah (the Lord) bring upon Egypt; did any evil accrue to you from any of them? did one of them affect you? and she said, No.
verses.text: And Moses said to her, Surely ten plagues did Yahuah (the Lord) bring upon Egypt; did any evil accrue to you from any of them? did one of them affect you? and she said, No.

verses.raw: And Moses said to her, Although you are the first born to your mother, you shall not die, and no evil shall reach you in the midst of Egypt.
verses.text: And Moses said to her, Although you are the first born to your mother, you shall not die, and no evil shall reach you in the midst of Egypt.

verses.raw: And she said, What advantage is it to me, when I see the king, my brother, and all his household and subjects in this evil, whose first born perish with all the first born of Egypt?
verses.text: And she said, What advantage is it to me, when I see the king, my brother, and all his household and subjects in this evil, whose first born perish with all the first born of Egypt?

verses.raw: And Moses said to her, Surely your brother and his household, and subjects, the families of Egypt, would not hearken to the words of Yahuah (the Lord), therefore did this evil come upon them.
verses.text: And Moses said to her, Surely your brother and his household, and subjects, the families of Egypt, would not hearken to the words of Yahuah (the Lord), therefore did this evil come upon them.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh king of Egypt approached Moses and Aaron, and some of the children of Israel who were with them in that place, and he prayed to them, saying,
verses.text: And Pharaoh king of Egypt approached Moses and Aaron, and some of the children of Israel who were with them in that place, and he prayed to them, saying,

verses.raw: Rise up and take your brethren, all the children of Israel who are in the land, with their sheep and oxen, and all belonging to them, they shall leave nothing remaining, only pray for me to Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God).
verses.text: Rise up and take your brethren, all the children of Israel who are in the land, with their sheep and oxen, and all belonging to them, they shall leave nothing remaining, only pray for me to Yahuah your Elohim.

verses.raw: And Moses said to Pharaoh, Behold though you are your mother’s first born, yet fear not, for you will not die, for Yahuah (the Lord) has commanded that you shall live, in order to show you his great might and strong stretched out arm.
verses.text: And Moses said to Pharaoh, Behold though you are your mother’s first born, yet fear not, for you will not die, for Yahuah (the Lord) has commanded that you shall live, in order to show you his great might and strong stretched out arm.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh ordered the children of Israel to be sent away, and all the Egyptians strengthened themselves to send them, for they said, We are all perishing.
verses.text: And Pharaoh ordered the children of Israel to be sent away, and all the Egyptians strengthened themselves to send them, for they said, We are all perishing.

verses.raw: And all the Egyptians sent the Israelites forth, with great riches, sheep and oxen and precious things, according to the oath of Yahuah (the Lord) between him and our Father Abraham.
verses.text: And all the Egyptians sent the Israelites forth, with great riches, sheep and oxen and precious things, according to the oath of Yahuah (the Lord) between him and our Father Abraham.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel delayed going forth at night, and when the Egyptians came to them to bring them out, they said to them, Are we thieves, that we should go forth at night?
verses.text: And the children of Israel delayed going forth at night, and when the Egyptians came to them to bring them out, they said to them, Are we thieves, that we should go forth at night?

verses.raw: And the children of Israel asked of the Egyptians, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and the children of Israel stripped the Egyptians.
verses.text: And the children of Israel asked of the Egyptians, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and garments, and the children of Israel stripped the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And Moses hastened and rose up and went to the river of Egypt, and brought up from there the coffin of Joseph and took it with him.
verses.text: And Moses hastened and rose up and went to the river of Egypt, and brought up from there the coffin of Joseph and took it with him.

verses.raw: The children of Israel also brought up, each man his father’s coffin with him, and each man the coffins of his tribe.
verses.text: The children of Israel also brought up, each man his father’s coffin with him, and each man the coffins of his tribe.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides the little ones and their wives.
verses.text: And the children of Israel journeyed from Rameses to Succoth, about six hundred thousand men on foot, besides the little ones and their wives.

verses.raw: Also a mixed multitude went up with them, and flocks and herds, even much cattle.
verses.text: Also a mixed multitude went up with them, and flocks and herds, even much cattle.

verses.raw: And the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in the land of Egypt in hard labor, was two hundred and ten years.
verses.text: And the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in the land of Egypt in hard labor, was two hundred and ten years.

verses.raw: And at the end of two hundred and ten years, Yahuah (the Lord) brought forth the children of Israel from Egypt with a strong hand.
verses.text: And at the end of two hundred and ten years, Yahuah (the Lord) brought forth the children of Israel from Egypt with a strong hand.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel traveled from Egypt and from Goshen and from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth on the fifteenth day of the first month.
verses.text: And the children of Israel traveled from Egypt and from Goshen and from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth on the fifteenth day of the first month.

verses.raw: And the Egyptians buried all their first born whom Yahuah (the Lord) had smitten, and all the Egyptians buried their slain for three days.
verses.text: And the Egyptians buried all their first born whom Yahuah (the Lord) had smitten, and all the Egyptians buried their slain for three days.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel traveled from Succoth and encamped in Ethom, at the end of the wilderness.
verses.text: And the children of Israel traveled from Succoth and encamped in Ethom, at the end of the wilderness.

verses.raw: And on the third day after the Egyptians had buried their first born, many men rose up from Egypt and went after Israel to make them return to Egypt, for they repented that they had sent the Israelites away from their servitude.
verses.text: And on the third day after the Egyptians had buried their first born, many men rose up from Egypt and went after Israel to make them return to Egypt, for they repented that they had sent the Israelites away from their servitude.

verses.raw: And one man said to his neighbor, Surely Moses and Aaron spoke to Pharaoh, saying, We will go a three days’ journey in the wilderness and sacrifice to Yahuah our Elohim (the Lord our God).
verses.text: And one man said to his neighbor, Surely Moses and Aaron spoke to Pharaoh, saying, We will go a three days’ journey in the wilderness and sacrifice to Yahuah our Elohim.

verses.raw: Now therefore let us rise up early in the morning and cause them to return, and it shall be that if they return with us to Egypt to their masters, then shall we know that there is faith in them, but if they will not return, then will we fight with them, and make them come back with great power and a strong hand.
verses.text: Now therefore let us rise up early in the morning and cause them to return, and it shall be that if they return with us to Egypt to their masters, then shall we know that there is faith in them, but if they will not return, then will we fight with them, and make them come back with great power and a strong hand.

verses.raw: And all the nobles of Pharaoh rose up in the morning, and with them about seven hundred thousand men, and they went forth from Egypt on that day, and came to the place where the children of Israel were.
verses.text: And all the nobles of Pharaoh rose up in the morning, and with them about seven hundred thousand men, and they went forth from Egypt on that day, and came to the place where the children of Israel were.

verses.raw: And all the Egyptians saw and behold Moses and Aaron and all the children of Israel were sitting before Pi-hahiroth, eating and drinking and celebrating the feast of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And all the Egyptians saw and behold Moses and Aaron and all the children of Israel were sitting before Pi-hahiroth, eating and drinking and celebrating the feast of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And all the Egyptians said to the children of Israel, Surely you said, We will go a journey for three days in the wilderness and sacrifice to our Elohim (God) and return.
verses.text: And all the Egyptians said to the children of Israel, Surely you said, We will go a journey for three days in the wilderness and sacrifice to our Elohim and return.

verses.raw: Now therefore this day makes five days since you went, why do you not return to your masters?
verses.text: Now therefore this day makes five days since you went, why do you not return to your masters?

verses.raw: And Moses and Aaron answered them, saying, Because Yahuah our Elohim has testified in us, saying, You shall no more return to Egypt, but we will betake ourselves to a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahuah our Elohim had sworn to our ancestors to give to us.
verses.text: And Moses and Aaron answered them, saying, Because Yahuah our Elohim has testified in us, saying, You shall no more return to Egypt, but we will betake ourselves to a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahuah our Elohim had sworn to our ancestors to give to us.

verses.raw: And when the nobles of Egypt saw that the children of Israel did not hearken to them, to return to Egypt, they girded themselves to fight with Israel.
verses.text: And when the nobles of Egypt saw that the children of Israel did not hearken to them, to return to Egypt, they girded themselves to fight with Israel.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) strengthened the hearts of the children of Israel over the Egyptians, that they gave them a severe beating, and the battle was sore upon the Egyptians, and all the Egyptians fled from before the children of Israel, for many of them perished by the hand of Israel.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) strengthened the hearts of the children of Israel over the Egyptians, that they gave them a severe beating, and the battle was sore upon the Egyptians, and all the Egyptians fled from before the children of Israel, for many of them perished by the hand of Israel.

verses.raw: And the nobles of Pharaoh went to Egypt and told Pharaoh, saying, The children of Israel have fled, and will no more return to Egypt, and in this manner did Moses and Aaron speak to us.
verses.text: And the nobles of Pharaoh went to Egypt and told Pharaoh, saying, The children of Israel have fled, and will no more return to Egypt, and in this manner did Moses and Aaron speak to us.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh heard this thing, and his heart and the hearts of all his subjects were turned against Israel, and they repented that they had sent Israel; and all the Egyptians advised Pharaoh to pursue the children of Israel to make them come back to their burdens.
verses.text: And Pharaoh heard this thing, and his heart and the hearts of all his subjects were turned against Israel, and they repented that they had sent Israel; and all the Egyptians advised Pharaoh to pursue the children of Israel to make them come back to their burdens.

verses.raw: And they said each man to his brother, What is this which we have done, that we have sent Israel from our servitude?
verses.text: And they said each man to his brother, What is this which we have done, that we have sent Israel from our servitude?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) strengthened the hearts of all the Egyptians to pursue the Israelites, for Yahuah (the Lord) desired to overthrow the Egyptians in the Red Sea.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) strengthened the hearts of all the Egyptians to pursue the Israelites, for Yahuah (the Lord) desired to overthrow the Egyptians in the Red Sea.

verses.raw: And Pharaoh rose up and harnessed his chariot, and he ordered all the Egyptians to assemble, not one man was left excepting the little ones and the women.
verses.text: And Pharaoh rose up and harnessed his chariot, and he ordered all the Egyptians to assemble, not one man was left excepting the little ones and the women.

verses.raw: And all the Egyptians went forth with Pharaoh to pursue the children of Israel, and the camp of Egypt was an exceedingly large and heavy camp, about ten hundred thousand men.
verses.text: And all the Egyptians went forth with Pharaoh to pursue the children of Israel, and the camp of Egypt was an exceedingly large and heavy camp, about ten hundred thousand men.

verses.raw: And the whole of this camp went and pursued the children of Israel to bring them back to Egypt, and they reached them encamping by the Red Sea.
verses.text: And the whole of this camp went and pursued the children of Israel to bring them back to Egypt, and they reached them encamping by the Red Sea.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and beheld all the Egyptians pursuing them, and the children of Israel were greatly terrified at them, and the children of Israel cried to Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and beheld all the Egyptians pursuing them, and the children of Israel were greatly terrified at them, and the children of Israel cried to Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And on account of the Egyptians, the children of Israel divided themselves into four divisions, and they were divided in their opinions, for they were afraid of the Egyptians, and Moses spoke to each of them.
verses.text: And on account of the Egyptians, the children of Israel divided themselves into four divisions, and they were divided in their opinions, for they were afraid of the Egyptians, and Moses spoke to each of them.

verses.raw: The first division was of the children of Reuben, Simeon, and Issachar, and they resolved to cast themselves into the sea, for they were exceedingly afraid of the Egyptians.
verses.text: The first division was of the children of Reuben, Simeon, and Issachar, and they resolved to cast themselves into the sea, for they were exceedingly afraid of the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And Moses said to them, Fear not, stand still and see the salvation of Yahuah (the Lord) which He will effect this day for you.
verses.text: And Moses said to them, Fear not, stand still and see the salvation of Yahuah (the Lord) which He will effect this day for you.

verses.raw: The second division was of the children of Zebulun, Benjamin and Naphtali, and they resolved to go back to Egypt with the Egyptians.
verses.text: The second division was of the children of Zebulun, Benjamin and Naphtali, and they resolved to go back to Egypt with the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And Moses said to them, Fear not, for as you have seen the Egyptians this day, so shall you see them no more for ever.
verses.text: And Moses said to them, Fear not, for as you have seen the Egyptians this day, so shall you see them no more for ever.

verses.raw: The third division was of the children of Judah and Joseph, and they resolved to go to meet the Egyptians to fight with them.
verses.text: The third division was of the children of Judah and Joseph, and they resolved to go to meet the Egyptians to fight with them.

verses.raw: And Moses said to them, Stand in your places, for Yahuah (the Lord) will fight for you, and you shall remain silent.
verses.text: And Moses said to them, Stand in your places, for Yahuah (the Lord) will fight for you, and you shall remain silent.

verses.raw: And the fourth division was of the children of Levi, Gad, and Asher, and they resolved to go into the midst of the Egyptians to confound them, and Moses said to them, Remain in your stations and fear not, only call to Yahuah (the Lord) that he may save you out of their hands.
verses.text: And the fourth division was of the children of Levi, Gad, and Asher, and they resolved to go into the midst of the Egyptians to confound them, and Moses said to them, Remain in your stations and fear not, only call to Yahuah (the Lord) that he may save you out of their hands.

verses.raw: After this Moses rose up from amidst the people, and he prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) and said,
verses.text: After this Moses rose up from amidst the people, and he prayed to Yahuah (the Lord) and said,

verses.raw: O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) of the whole earth, save now your people whom you did bring forth from Egypt, and let not the Egyptians boast that power and might are theirs.
verses.text: O Yahuah Elohim (O Lord God) of the whole earth, save now your people whom you did bring forth from Egypt, and let not the Egyptians boast that power and might are theirs.

verses.raw: So Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Why dost you cry to me? speak to the children of Israel that they shall proceed, and do you stretch out your rod upon the sea and divide it, and the children of Israel shall pass through it.
verses.text: So Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Why dost you cry to me? speak to the children of Israel that they shall proceed, and do you stretch out your rod upon the sea and divide it, and the children of Israel shall pass through it.

verses.raw: And Moses did so, and he lifted up his rod upon the sea and divided it.
verses.text: And Moses did so, and he lifted up his rod upon the sea and divided it.

verses.raw: And the waters of the sea were divided into twelve parts, and the children of Israel passed through on foot, with shoes, as a man would pass through a prepared road.
verses.text: And the waters of the sea were divided into twelve parts, and the children of Israel passed through on foot, with shoes, as a man would pass through a prepared road.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) manifested to the children of Israel his wonders in Egypt and in the sea by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) manifested to the children of Israel his wonders in Egypt and in the sea by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.raw: And when the children of Israel had entered the sea, the Egyptians came after them, and the waters of the sea resumed upon them, and they all sank in the water, and not one man was left excepting Pharaoh, who gave thanks to Yahuah (the Lord) and believed in him, therefore Yahuah (the Lord) did not cause him to perish at that time with the Egyptians.
verses.text: And when the children of Israel had entered the sea, the Egyptians came after them, and the waters of the sea resumed upon them, and they all sank in the water, and not one man was left excepting Pharaoh, who gave thanks to Yahuah (the Lord) and believed in him, therefore Yahuah (the Lord) did not cause him to perish at that time with the Egyptians.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) ordered an angel to take him from amongst the Egyptians, who cast him upon the land of Ninevah and he reigned over it for a long time.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) ordered an angel to take him from amongst the Egyptians, who cast him upon the land of Ninevah and he reigned over it for a long time.

verses.raw: And on that day Yahuah (the Lord) saved Israel from the hand of Egypt, and all the children of Israel saw that the Egyptians had perished, and they beheld the great hand of Yahuah (the Lord), in what he had performed in Egypt and in the sea.
verses.text: And on that day Yahuah (the Lord) saved Israel from the hand of Egypt, and all the children of Israel saw that the Egyptians had perished, and they beheld the great hand of Yahuah (the Lord), in what he had performed in Egypt and in the sea.

verses.raw: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song to Yahuah (the Lord), on the day when Yahuah (the Lord) caused the Egyptians to fall before them.
verses.text: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song to Yahuah (the Lord), on the day when Yahuah (the Lord) caused the Egyptians to fall before them.

verses.raw: And all Israel sang in concert, saying, I will sing to Yahuah (the Lord) for He is greatly exalted, the horse and his rider has he cast into the sea; behold it is written in the book of the law of Elohim.
verses.text: And all Israel sang in concert, saying, I will sing to Yahuah (the Lord) for He is greatly exalted, the horse and his rider has he cast into the sea; behold it is written in the book of the law of Elohim.

verses.raw: After this the children of Israel proceeded on their journey, and encamped in Marah, and Yahuah (the Lord) gave to the children of Israel statutes and judgments in that place in Marah, and Yahuah (the Lord) commanded the children of Israel to walk in all his ways and to serve him.
verses.text: After this the children of Israel proceeded on their journey, and encamped in Marah, and Yahuah (the Lord) gave to the children of Israel statutes and judgments in that place in Marah, and Yahuah (the Lord) commanded the children of Israel to walk in all his ways and to serve him.

verses.raw: And they journeyed from Marah and came to Elim, and in Elim were twelve springs of water and seventy date trees, and the children encamped there by the waters.
verses.text: And they journeyed from Marah and came to Elim, and in Elim were twelve springs of water and seventy date trees, and the children encamped there by the waters.

verses.raw: And they journeyed from Elim and came to the wilderness of Sin, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departure from Egypt.
verses.text: And they journeyed from Elim and came to the wilderness of Sin, on the fifteenth day of the second month after their departure from Egypt.

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) gave the manna to the children of Israel to eat, and Yahuah (the Lord) caused food to rain from heaven for the children of Israel day by day.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) gave the manna to the children of Israel to eat, and Yahuah (the Lord) caused food to rain from heaven for the children of Israel day by day.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel ate the manna for forty years, all the days that they were in the wilderness, until they came to the land of Canaan to possess it.
verses.text: And the children of Israel ate the manna for forty years, all the days that they were in the wilderness, until they came to the land of Canaan to possess it.

verses.raw: And they proceeded from the wilderness of Sin and encamped in Alush.
verses.text: And they proceeded from the wilderness of Sin and encamped in Alush.

verses.raw: And they proceeded from Alush and encamped in Rephidim.
verses.text: And they proceeded from Alush and encamped in Rephidim.

verses.raw: And when the children of Israel were in Rephidim, Amalek the son of Eliphaz, the son of Esau, the brother of Zepho, came to fight with Israel.
verses.text: And when the children of Israel were in Rephidim, Amalek the son of Eliphaz, the son of Esau, the brother of Zepho, came to fight with Israel.

verses.raw: And he brought with him eight hundred and one thousand men, magicians and conjurers, and he prepared for battle with Israel in Rephidim.
verses.text: And he brought with him eight hundred and one thousand men, magicians and conjurers, and he prepared for battle with Israel in Rephidim.

verses.raw: And they carried on a great and severe battle against Israel, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered Amalek and his people into the hands of Moses and the children of Israel, and into the hand of Joshua, the son of Nun, the Ephrathite, the servant of Moses.
verses.text: And they carried on a great and severe battle against Israel, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered Amalek and his people into the hands of Moses and the children of Israel, and into the hand of Joshua, the son of Nun, the Ephrathite, the servant of Moses.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel smote Amalek and his people at the edge of the sword, but the battle was very sore upon the children of Israel.
verses.text: And the children of Israel smote Amalek and his people at the edge of the sword, but the battle was very sore upon the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Write this thing as a memorial for you in a book, and place it in the hand of Joshua, the son of Nun, your servant, and you shall command the children of Israel, saying, When you shall come to the land of Canaan, you shall utterly efface the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Write this thing as a memorial for you in a book, and place it in the hand of Joshua, the son of Nun, your servant, and you shall command the children of Israel, saying, When you shall come to the land of Canaan, you shall utterly efface the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven.

verses.raw: And Moses did so, and he took the book and wrote upon it these words, saying,
verses.text: And Moses did so, and he took the book and wrote upon it these words, saying,

verses.raw: Remember what Amalek has done to you in the road when you went forth from Egypt.
verses.text: Remember what Amalek has done to you in the road when you went forth from Egypt.

verses.raw: Who met you in the road and smote your rear, even those that were feeble behind you when you were faint and weary.
verses.text: Who met you in the road and smote your rear, even those that were feeble behind you when you were faint and weary.

verses.raw: Therefore it shall be when Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God) shall have given you rest from all your enemies round about in the land which Yahuah your Elohim gives you for an inheritance, to possess it, that you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven, you shall not forget it.
verses.text: Therefore it shall be when Yahuah your Elohim shall have given you rest from all your enemies round about in the land which Yahuah your Elohim gives you for an inheritance, to possess it, that you shall blot out the remembrance of Amalek from under heaven, you shall not forget it.

verses.raw: And the king who shall have pity on Amalek, or upon his memory or upon his seed, behold I will require it of him, and I will cut him off from amongst his people.
verses.text: And the king who shall have pity on Amalek, or upon his memory or upon his seed, behold I will require it of him, and I will cut him off from amongst his people.

verses.raw: And Moses wrote all these things in a book, and he enjoined the children of Israel respecting all these matters.

verses.raw: And during the forty days did Moses entreat Yahuah (the Lord) in behalf of the children of Israel, and Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the prayer of Moses, and Yahuah (the Lord) was entreated of him in behalf of Israel.

verses.raw: Then spoke Yahuah (the Lord) to Moses to hew two stone tablets and to bring them up to Yahuah (the Lord), who would write upon them the ten commandments.
verses.text: Then spoke Yahuah (the Lord) to Moses to hew two stone tablets and to bring them up to Yahuah (the Lord), who would write upon them the ten commandments.

verses.raw: And Moses came to the children of Israel and spoke to them all the words of Yahuah (the Lord), and he taught them laws, statutes and judgments which Yahuah (the Lord) had taught him.
verses.text: And Moses came to the children of Israel and spoke to them all the words of Yahuah (the Lord), and he taught them laws, statutes and judgments which Yahuah (the Lord) had taught him.

verses.raw: And Moses told the children of Israel the word of Yahuah (the Lord), that a sanctuary should be made for him, to dwell amongst the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And the people rejoiced greatly at all the good which Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to them, through Moses, and they said, We will do all that Yahuah (the Lord) has spoken to you.

verses.text: And all the children of Israel brought each man of all that was found in his possession for the work of the sanctuary of Yahuah (the Lord), gold, silver and brass, and every thing that was serviceable for the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And all the wise men who were practiced in work came and made the sanctuary of Yahuah (the Lord), according to all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded, every man in the work in which he had been practiced; and all the wise men in heart made the sanctuary, and its furniture and all the vessels for the holy service, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And the work of the sanctuary of the tabernacle was completed at the end of five months, and the children of Israel did all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses.
verses.text: And the work of the sanctuary of the tabernacle was completed at the end of five months, and the children of Israel did all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses.

verses.raw: And Moses saw the work, and behold they did it as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him, so Moses blessed them.

verses.raw: And in the twelfth month, in the twenty-third day of the month, Moses took Aaron and his sons, and he dressed them in their garments, and anointed them and did to them as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him, and Moses brought up all the offerings which Yahuah (the Lord) had on that day commanded him.

verses.raw: Moses afterward took Aaron and his sons and said to them, For seven days shall you remain at the door of the tabernacle, for thus am I commanded.
verses.text: Moses afterward took Aaron and his sons and said to them, For seven days shall you remain at the door of the tabernacle, for thus am I commanded.

verses.raw: And Aaron and his sons did all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded them through Moses, and they remained for seven days at the door of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And all the offerings which they brought, each man in his day, one silver charger weighing one hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels after the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour, mingled with oil for a meat offering.

verses.raw: Therefore did the children of Esau fight against the children of Seir in former times, and Yahuah (the Lord) had delivered the children of Seir into the hands of the children of Esau, and destroyed them from before them, and the children of Esau dwelt in their stead to this day.

verses.raw: And all the children of Moab did this thing to the children of Israel, and every man placed his wife and daughter at the door of his tent, and all the children of Israel saw the act of the children of Moab, and the children of Israel turned to the daughters of Moab and coveted them, and they went to them.
verses.text: And all the children of Moab did this thing to the children of Israel, and every man placed his wife and daughter at the door of his tent, and all the children of Israel saw the act of the children of Moab, and the children of Israel turned to the daughters of Moab and coveted them, and they went to them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass that when a Hebrew came to the door of the tent of Moab, and saw a daughter of Moab and desired her in his heart, and spoke with her at the door of the tent that which he desired, whilst they were speaking together the men of the tent would come out and speak to the Hebrew like to these words:
verses.text: And it came to pass that when a Hebrew came to the door of the tent of Moab, and saw a daughter of Moab and desired her in his heart, and spoke with her at the door of the tent that which he desired, whilst they were speaking together the men of the tent would come out and speak to the Hebrew like to these words:

verses.raw: Surely you know that we are brethren, we are all the descendants of Lot and the descendants of Abraham his brother, therefore then will you not remain with us, and therefore will you not eat our bread and our sacrifice?
verses.text: Surely you know that we are brethren, we are all the descendants of Lot and the descendants of Abraham his brother, therefore then will you not remain with us, and therefore will you not eat our bread and our sacrifice?

verses.raw: And when the children of Moab had thus overwhelmed him with their speeches, and enticed him by their flattering words, they seated him in the tent and cooked and sacrificed for him, and he ate of their sacrifice and of their bread.
verses.text: And when the children of Moab had thus overwhelmed him with their speeches, and enticed him by their flattering words, they seated him in the tent and cooked and sacrificed for him, and he ate of their sacrifice and of their bread.

verses.raw: They then gave him wine and he drank and became intoxicated, and they placed before him a beautiful damsel, and he did with her as he liked, for he knew not what he was doing, as he had drunk plentifully of wine.
verses.text: They then gave him wine and he drank and became intoxicated, and they placed before him a beautiful damsel, and he did with her as he liked, for he knew not what he was doing, as he had drunk plentifully of wine.

verses.raw: Thus did the children of Moab to Israel in that place, in the plain of Shittim, and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled against Israel on account of this matter, and he sent a pestilence amongst them, and there died of the Israelites twenty-four thousand men.
verses.text: Thus did the children of Moab to Israel in that place, in the plain of Shittim, and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled against Israel on account of this matter, and he sent a pestilence amongst them, and there died of the Israelites twenty-four thousand men.

verses.raw: Now there was a man of the children of Simeon whose name was Zimri, the son of Salu, who connected himself with the Midianite Cosbi, the daughter of Zur, king of Midian, in the sight of all the children of Israel.
verses.text: Now there was a man of the children of Simeon whose name was Zimri, the son of Salu, who connected himself with the Midianite Cosbi, the daughter of Zur, king of Midian, in the sight of all the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And Phineas the son of Elazer, the son of Aaron the priest, saw this wicked thing which Zimri had done, and he took a spear and rose up and went after them, and pierced them both and slew them, and the pestilence ceased from the children of Israel.
verses.text: And Phineas the son of Elazer, the son of Aaron the priest, saw this wicked thing which Zimri had done, and he took a spear and rose up and went after them, and pierced them both and slew them, and the pestilence ceased from the children of Israel.

verses.raw: At that time after the pestilence, Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, and to Elazer the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.text: At that time after the pestilence, Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, and to Elazer the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

verses.raw: Number the heads of the whole community of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth in the army.
verses.text: Number the heads of the whole community of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, all that went forth in the army.

verses.raw: And Moses and Elazer numbered the children of Israel after their families, and the number of all Israel was seven hundred thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
verses.text: And Moses and Elazer numbered the children of Israel after their families, and the number of all Israel was seven hundred thousand, seven hundred and thirty.

verses.raw: And the number of the children of Levi, from one month old and upward, was twenty-three thousand, and amongst these there was not a man of those numbered by Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.text: And the number of the children of Levi, from one month old and upward, was twenty-three thousand, and amongst these there was not a man of those numbered by Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (the Lord) had told them that they would die in the wilderness, so they all died, and not one had been left of them excepting Caleb the son of Jephuneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.text: For Yahuah (the Lord) had told them that they would die in the wilderness, so they all died, and not one had been left of them excepting Caleb the son of Jephuneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.raw: And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel to avenge upon Midian the cause of their brethren the children of Israel.
verses.text: And it was after this that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel to avenge upon Midian the cause of their brethren the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And Moses did so, and the children of Israel chose from amongst them twelve thousand men, being one thousand to a tribe, and they went to Midian.
verses.text: And Moses did so, and the children of Israel chose from amongst them twelve thousand men, being one thousand to a tribe, and they went to Midian.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel warred against Midian, and they slew every male, also the five princes of Midian, and Balaam the son of Beor did they slay with the sword.
verses.text: And the children of Israel warred against Midian, and they slew every male, also the five princes of Midian, and Balaam the son of Beor did they slay with the sword.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel took the wives of Midian captive, with their little ones and their cattle, and all belonging to them.
verses.text: And the children of Israel took the wives of Midian captive, with their little ones and their cattle, and all belonging to them.

verses.raw: And they took all the spoil and all the prey, and they brought it to Moses and to Elazer to the plains of Moab.
verses.text: And they took all the spoil and all the prey, and they brought it to Moses and to Elazer to the plains of Moab.

verses.raw: And Moses and Elazer and all the princes of the congregation went forth to meet them with joy.
verses.text: And Moses and Elazer and all the princes of the congregation went forth to meet them with joy.

verses.raw: And they divided all the spoil of Midian, and the children of Israel had been revenged upon Midian for the cause of their brethren the children of Israel.
verses.text: And they divided all the spoil of Midian, and the children of Israel had been revenged upon Midian for the cause of their brethren the children of Israel.

verses.raw: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Behold your days are approaching to an end, take now Joshua the son of Nun your servant and place him in the tabernacle, and I will command him, and Moses did so.
verses.text: At that time Yahuah (the Lord) said to Moses, Behold your days are approaching to an end, take now Joshua the son of Nun your servant and place him in the tabernacle, and I will command him, and Moses did so.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood at the entrance of the tabernacle.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood at the entrance of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) commanded Joshua the son of Nun and said to him, Be strong and courageous, for you shall bring the children of Israel to the land which I swore to give them, and I will be with you.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) commanded Joshua the son of Nun and said to him, Be strong and courageous, for you shall bring the children of Israel to the land which I swore to give them, and I will be with you.

verses.raw: And Moses said to Joshua, Be strong and courageous, for you will make the children of Israel inherit the land, and Yahuah (the Lord) will be with you, he will not leave you nor forsake you, be not afraid nor disheartened.
verses.text: And Moses said to Joshua, Be strong and courageous, for you will make the children of Israel inherit the land, and Yahuah (the Lord) will be with you, he will not leave you nor forsake you, be not afraid nor disheartened.

verses.raw: And Moses called to all the children of Israel and said to them, You have seen all the good which Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God) has done for you in the wilderness.
verses.text: And Moses called to all the children of Israel and said to them, You have seen all the good which Yahuah your Elohim has done for you in the wilderness.

verses.raw: Now therefore observe all the words of this law, and walk in the way of Yahuah your Elohim, turn not from the way which Yahuah (the Lord) has commanded you, either to the right or to the left.
verses.text: Now therefore observe all the words of this law, and walk in the way of Yahuah your Elohim, turn not from the way which Yahuah (the Lord) has commanded you, either to the right or to the left.

verses.raw: And Moses taught the children of Israel statutes and judgments and laws to do in the land as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.
verses.text: And Moses taught the children of Israel statutes and judgments and laws to do in the land as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.

verses.raw: And he taught them the way of Yahuah (the Lord) and his laws; behold they are written upon the book of the law of Elohim (God) which he gave to the children of Israel by the hand of Moses.
verses.text: And he taught them the way of Yahuah (the Lord) and his laws; behold they are written upon the book of the law of Elohim which he gave to the children of Israel by the hand of Moses.

verses.raw: And Moses finished commanding the children of Israel, and Yahuah (the Lord) said to him, saying, Go up to the Mount Abarim and die there, and be gathered to your people as Aaron your brother was gathered.
verses.text: And Moses finished commanding the children of Israel, and Yahuah (the Lord) said to him, saying, Go up to the Mount Abarim and die there, and be gathered to your people as Aaron your brother was gathered.

verses.raw: And Moses went up as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him, and he died there in the land of Moab by the order of Yahuah (the Lord), in the fortieth year from the Israelites going forth from the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And Moses went up as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him, and he died there in the land of Moab by the order of Yahuah (the Lord), in the fortieth year from the Israelites going forth from the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab for thirty days, and the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were completed.
verses.text: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab for thirty days, and the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were completed.

verses.raw: And it was after the death of Moses that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua the son of Nun, saying,
verses.text: And it was after the death of Moses that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua the son of Nun, saying,

verses.raw: Rise up and pass the Jordan to the land which I have given to the children of Israel, and you shall make the children of Israel inherit the land.
verses.text: Rise up and pass the Jordan to the land which I have given to the children of Israel, and you shall make the children of Israel inherit the land.

verses.raw: Every place upon which the sole of your feet shall tread shall belong to you, from the wilderness of Lebanon to the great river the river of Perath shall be your boundary.
verses.text: Every place upon which the sole of your feet shall tread shall belong to you, from the wilderness of Lebanon to the great river the river of Perath shall be your boundary.

verses.raw: No man shall stand up against you all the days of your life; as I was with Moses, so will I be with you, only be strong and of good courage to observe all the law which Moses commanded you, turn not from the way either to the right or to the left, in order that you may prosper in all that you do.
verses.text: No man shall stand up against you all the days of your life; as I was with Moses, so will I be with you, only be strong and of good courage to observe all the law which Moses commanded you, turn not from the way either to the right or to the left, in order that you may prosper in all that you do.

verses.raw: And Joshua commanded the officers of Israel, saying, Pass through the camp and command the people, saying, Prepare for yourselves provisions, for in three days more you will pass the Jordan to possess the land.
verses.text: And Joshua commanded the officers of Israel, saying, Pass through the camp and command the people, saying, Prepare for yourselves provisions, for in three days more you will pass the Jordan to possess the land.

verses.raw: And the officers of the children of Israel did so, and they commanded the people and they did all that Joshua had commanded.
verses.text: And the officers of the children of Israel did so, and they commanded the people and they did all that Joshua had commanded.

verses.raw: And Joshua sent two men to spy out the land of Jericho, and the men went and spied out Jericho.
verses.text: And Joshua sent two men to spy out the land of Jericho, and the men went and spied out Jericho.

verses.raw: And at the end of seven days they came to Joshua in the camp and said to him, Yahuah (the Lord) has delivered the whole land into our hand, and the inhabitants of it are melted with fear because of us.
verses.text: And at the end of seven days they came to Joshua in the camp and said to him, Yahuah (the Lord) has delivered the whole land into our hand, and the inhabitants of it are melted with fear because of us.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after that, that Joshua rose up in the morning and all Israel with him, and they journeyed from Shittim, and Joshua and all Israel with him passed the Jordan; and Joshua was eighty-two years old when he passed the Jordan with Israel.
verses.text: And it came to pass after that, that Joshua rose up in the morning and all Israel with him, and they journeyed from Shittim, and Joshua and all Israel with him passed the Jordan; and Joshua was eighty-two years old when he passed the Jordan with Israel.

verses.raw: And the people went up from Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and they encamped in Gilgal at the eastern corner of Jericho.
verses.text: And the people went up from Jordan on the tenth day of the first month, and they encamped in Gilgal at the eastern corner of Jericho.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel kept the Passover in Gilgal, in the plains of Jericho, on the fourteenth day at the month, as it is written in the law of Moses.
verses.text: And the children of Israel kept the Passover in Gilgal, in the plains of Jericho, on the fourteenth day at the month, as it is written in the law of Moses.

verses.raw: And the manna ceased at that time on the morrow of the Passover, and there was no more manna for the children of Israel, and they ate of the produce of the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And the manna ceased at that time on the morrow of the Passover, and there was no more manna for the children of Israel, and they ate of the produce of the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And Jericho was entirely closed against the children of Israel, no one came out or went in.
verses.text: And Jericho was entirely closed against the children of Israel, no one came out or went in.

verses.raw: And it was in the second month, on the first day of the month, that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Rise up, behold I have given Jericho into your hand with all the people of it; and all your fighting men shall go round the city, once each day, thus shall you do for six days.
verses.text: And it was in the second month, on the first day of the month, that Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Rise up, behold I have given Jericho into your hand with all the people of it; and all your fighting men shall go round the city, once each day, thus shall you do for six days.

verses.raw: And the priests shall blow upon trumpets, and when you shall hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall give a great shouting, that the walls of the city shall fall down; all the people shall go up every man against his opponent.
verses.text: And the priests shall blow upon trumpets, and when you shall hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall give a great shouting, that the walls of the city shall fall down; all the people shall go up every man against his opponent.

verses.raw: And Joshua did so according to all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.
verses.text: And Joshua did so according to all that Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.

verses.raw: And on the seventh day they went round the city seven times, and the priests blew upon trumpets.
verses.text: And on the seventh day they went round the city seven times, and the priests blew upon trumpets.

verses.raw: And at the seventh round, Joshua said to the people, Shout, for Yahuah (the Lord) has delivered the whole city into our hands.
verses.text: And at the seventh round, Joshua said to the people, Shout, for Yahuah (the Lord) has delivered the whole city into our hands.

verses.raw: Only the city and all that it contains shall be accursed to Yahuah (the Lord), and keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest you make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.
verses.text: Only the city and all that it contains shall be accursed to Yahuah (the Lord), and keep yourselves from the accursed thing, lest you make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.

verses.raw: But all the silver and gold and brass and iron shall be consecrated to Yahuah (the Lord), they shall come into the treasury of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: But all the silver and gold and brass and iron shall be consecrated to Yahuah (the Lord), they shall come into the treasury of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And the people blew upon trumpets and made a great shouting, and the walls of Jericho fell down, and all the people went up, every man straight before him, and they took the city and utterly destroyed all that was in it, both man and woman, young and old, ox and sheep and ass, with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And the people blew upon trumpets and made a great shouting, and the walls of Jericho fell down, and all the people went up, every man straight before him, and they took the city and utterly destroyed all that was in it, both man and woman, young and old, ox and sheep and ass, with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And they burned the whole city with fire; only the vessels of silver and gold, and brass and iron, they put into the treasury of Yahuah (the Lord).
verses.text: And they burned the whole city with fire; only the vessels of silver and gold, and brass and iron, they put into the treasury of Yahuah (the Lord).

verses.raw: And Joshua swore at that time, saying, Cursed be the man who builds Jericho; he shall lay the foundation of it in his first-born, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.
verses.text: And Joshua swore at that time, saying, Cursed be the man who builds Jericho; he shall lay the foundation of it in his first-born, and in his youngest son shall he set up the gates of it.

verses.raw: And Achan the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, son of Judah, dealt treacherously in the accursed thing, and he took of the accursed thing and hid it in the tent, and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled against Israel.
verses.text: And Achan the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, son of Judah, dealt treacherously in the accursed thing, and he took of the accursed thing and hid it in the tent, and the anger of Yahuah (the Lord) was kindled against Israel.

verses.raw: And it was after this when the children of Israel had returned from burning Jericho, Joshua sent men to spy out also Ai, and to fight against it.
verses.text: And it was after this when the children of Israel had returned from burning Jericho, Joshua sent men to spy out also Ai, and to fight against it.

verses.raw: And the men went up and spied out Ai, and they returned and said, Let not all the people go up with you to Ai, only let about three thousand men go up and smite the city, for the men of it are but few.
verses.text: And the men went up and spied out Ai, and they returned and said, Let not all the people go up with you to Ai, only let about three thousand men go up and smite the city, for the men of it are but few.

verses.raw: And Joshua did so, and there went up with him of the children of Israel about three thousand men, and they fought against the men of Ai.
verses.text: And Joshua did so, and there went up with him of the children of Israel about three thousand men, and they fought against the men of Ai.

verses.raw: And the battle was severe against Israel, and the men of Ai smote thirty-six men of Israel, and the children of Israel fled from before the men of Ai.
verses.text: And the battle was severe against Israel, and the men of Ai smote thirty-six men of Israel, and the children of Israel fled from before the men of Ai.

verses.raw: And when Joshua saw this thing, he tore his garments and fell upon his face to the ground before Yahuah (the Lord), he, with the elders of Israel, and they put dust upon their heads.
verses.text: And when Joshua saw this thing, he tore his garments and fell upon his face to the ground before Yahuah (the Lord), he, with the elders of Israel, and they put dust upon their heads.

verses.raw: And Joshua said, Why O Yahuah (O Lord) did you bring this people over the Jordan? what shall I say after the Israelites have turned their backs against their enemies?
verses.text: And Joshua said, Why O Yahuah (O Lord) did you bring this people over the Jordan? what shall I say after the Israelites have turned their backs against their enemies?

verses.raw: Now therefore all the Canaanites, inhabitants of the land, will hear this thing, and surround us and cut off our name.
verses.text: Now therefore all the Canaanites, inhabitants of the land, will hear this thing, and surround us and cut off our name.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Why dost you fall upon your face? rise, get you off, for the Israelites have sinned, and taken of the accursed thing; I will no more be with them unless they destroy the accursed thing from amongst them.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Why dost you fall upon your face? rise, get you off, for the Israelites have sinned, and taken of the accursed thing; I will no more be with them unless they destroy the accursed thing from amongst them.

verses.raw: And Joshua rose up and assembled the people, and brought the Urim by the order of Yahuah (the Lord), and the tribe of Judah was taken, and Achan the son of Carmi was taken.
verses.text: And Joshua rose up and assembled the people, and brought the Urim by the order of Yahuah (the Lord), and the tribe of Judah was taken, and Achan the son of Carmi was taken.

verses.raw: And Joshua said to Achan, Tell me my son, what have you done, and Achan said, I saw amongst the spoil a goodly garment of Shinar and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight; I coveted them and took them, and behold they are all hid in the earth in the midst of the tent.
verses.text: And Joshua said to Achan, Tell me my son, what have you done, and Achan said, I saw amongst the spoil a goodly garment of Shinar and two hundred shekels of silver, and a wedge of gold of fifty shekels weight; I coveted them and took them, and behold they are all hid in the earth in the midst of the tent.

verses.raw: And Joshua sent men who went and took them from the tent of Achan, and they brought them to Joshua.
verses.text: And Joshua sent men who went and took them from the tent of Achan, and they brought them to Joshua.

verses.raw: And Joshua took Achan and these utensils, and his sons and daughters and all belonging to him, and they brought them into the valley of Achor.
verses.text: And Joshua took Achan and these utensils, and his sons and daughters and all belonging to him, and they brought them into the valley of Achor.

verses.raw: And Joshua burned them there with fire, and all the Israelites stoned Achan with stones, and they raised over him a heap of stones, therefore did he call that place the valley of Achor, so Yahuah’s anger was appeased, and Joshua afterward came to the city and fought against it.
verses.text: And Joshua burned them there with fire, and all the Israelites stoned Achan with stones, and they raised over him a heap of stones, therefore did he call that place the valley of Achor, so Yahuah’s anger was appeased, and Joshua afterward came to the city and fought against it.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Fear not, neither be you dismayed, behold I have given into your hand Ai, her king and her people, and you shall do to them as you did to Jericho and her king, only the spoil of it and the cattle of it shall you take for a prey for yourselves; lay an ambush for the city behind it.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Fear not, neither be you dismayed, behold I have given into your hand Ai, her king and her people, and you shall do to them as you did to Jericho and her king, only the spoil of it and the cattle of it shall you take for a prey for yourselves; lay an ambush for the city behind it.

verses.raw: So Joshua did according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and he chose from amongst the sons of war thirty thousand valiant men, and he sent them, and they lay in ambush for the city.
verses.text: So Joshua did according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord), and he chose from amongst the sons of war thirty thousand valiant men, and he sent them, and they lay in ambush for the city.

verses.raw: And he commanded them, saying, When you shall see us we will flee before them with cunning, and they will pursue us, you shall then rise out of the ambush and take the city, and they did so.
verses.text: And he commanded them, saying, When you shall see us we will flee before them with cunning, and they will pursue us, you shall then rise out of the ambush and take the city, and they did so.

verses.raw: And Joshua fought, and the men of the city went out toward Israel, not knowing that they were lying in ambush for them behind the city.
verses.text: And Joshua fought, and the men of the city went out toward Israel, not knowing that they were lying in ambush for them behind the city.

verses.raw: And Joshua and all the Israelites feigned themselves wearied out before them, and they fled by the way of the wilderness with cunning.
verses.text: And Joshua and all the Israelites feigned themselves wearied out before them, and they fled by the way of the wilderness with cunning.

verses.raw: And the men of Ai gathered all the people who were in the city to pursue the Israelites, and they went out and were drawn away from the city, not one remained, and they left the city open and pursued the Israelites.
verses.text: And the men of Ai gathered all the people who were in the city to pursue the Israelites, and they went out and were drawn away from the city, not one remained, and they left the city open and pursued the Israelites.

verses.raw: And those who were lying in ambush rose up out of their places, and hastened to come to the city and took it and set it on fire, and the men of Ai turned back, and behold the smoke of the city ascended to the skies, and they had no means of retreating either one way or the other.
verses.text: And those who were lying in ambush rose up out of their places, and hastened to come to the city and took it and set it on fire, and the men of Ai turned back, and behold the smoke of the city ascended to the skies, and they had no means of retreating either one way or the other.

verses.raw: And all the men of Ai were in the midst of Israel, some on this side and some on that side, and they smote them so that not one of them remained.
verses.text: And all the men of Ai were in the midst of Israel, some on this side and some on that side, and they smote them so that not one of them remained.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel took Melosh king of Ai alive, and they brought him to Joshua, and Joshua hanged him on a tree and he died.
verses.text: And the children of Israel took Melosh king of Ai alive, and they brought him to Joshua, and Joshua hanged him on a tree and he died.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel returned to the city after having burned it, and they smote all those that were in it with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And the children of Israel returned to the city after having burned it, and they smote all those that were in it with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And the number of those that had fallen of the men of Ai, both man and woman, was twelve thousand; only the cattle and the spoil of the city they took to themselves, according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) to Joshua.
verses.text: And the number of those that had fallen of the men of Ai, both man and woman, was twelve thousand; only the cattle and the spoil of the city they took to themselves, according to the word of Yahuah (the Lord) to Joshua.

verses.raw: And all the kings on this side Jordan, all the kings of Canaan, heard of the evil which the children of Israel had done to Jericho and to Ai, and they gathered themselves together to fight against Israel.
verses.text: And all the kings on this side Jordan, all the kings of Canaan, heard of the evil which the children of Israel had done to Jericho and to Ai, and they gathered themselves together to fight against Israel.

verses.raw: Only the inhabitants of Gibeon were greatly afraid of fighting against the Israelites lest they should perish, so they acted cunningly, and they came to Joshua and to all Israel, and said to them, We have come from a distant land, now therefore make a covenant with us.
verses.text: Only the inhabitants of Gibeon were greatly afraid of fighting against the Israelites lest they should perish, so they acted cunningly, and they came to Joshua and to all Israel, and said to them, We have come from a distant land, now therefore make a covenant with us.

verses.raw: And the inhabitants of Gibeon over-reached the children of Israel, and the children of Israel made a covenant with them, and they made peace with them, and the princes of the congregation swore to them, but afterward the children of Israel knew that they were neighbors to them and were dwelling amongst them.
verses.text: And the inhabitants of Gibeon over-reached the children of Israel, and the children of Israel made a covenant with them, and they made peace with them, and the princes of the congregation swore to them, but afterward the children of Israel knew that they were neighbors to them and were dwelling amongst them.

verses.raw: But the children of Israel slew them not; for they had sworn to them by Yahuah (the Lord), and they became hewers of wood and drawers of water.
verses.text: But the children of Israel slew them not; for they had sworn to them by Yahuah (the Lord), and they became hewers of wood and drawers of water.

verses.raw: And Joshua said to them, Why did you deceive me, to do this thing to us? and they answered him, saying, Because it was told to your servants all that you had done to all the kings of the Amorites, and we were greatly afraid of our lives, and we did this thing.
verses.text: And Joshua said to them, Why did you deceive me, to do this thing to us? and they answered him, saying, Because it was told to your servants all that you had done to all the kings of the Amorites, and we were greatly afraid of our lives, and we did this thing.

verses.raw: And Joshua appointed them on that day to hew wood and to draw water, and he divided them for slaves to all the tribes of Israel.
verses.text: And Joshua appointed them on that day to hew wood and to draw water, and he divided them for slaves to all the tribes of Israel.

verses.raw: And when Adonizedek king of Jerusalem heard all that the children of Israel had done to Jericho and to Ai, he sent to Hoham king of Hebron and to Piram king at Jarmuth, and to Japhia king of Lachish and to Deber king of Eglon, saying,
verses.text: And when Adonizedek king of Jerusalem heard all that the children of Israel had done to Jericho and to Ai, he sent to Hoham king of Hebron and to Piram king at Jarmuth, and to Japhia king of Lachish and to Deber king of Eglon, saying,

verses.raw: Come up to me and help me, that we may smite the children of Israel and the inhabitants of Gibeon who have made peace with the children of Israel.
verses.text: Come up to me and help me, that we may smite the children of Israel and the inhabitants of Gibeon who have made peace with the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And they gathered themselves together and the five kings of the Amorites went up with all their camps, a mighty people numerous as the sand of the sea shore.
verses.text: And they gathered themselves together and the five kings of the Amorites went up with all their camps, a mighty people numerous as the sand of the sea shore.

verses.raw: And all these kings came and encamped before Gibeon, and they began to fight against the inhabitants of Gibeon, and all the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua, saying, Come up quickly to us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites have gathered together to fight against us.
verses.text: And all these kings came and encamped before Gibeon, and they began to fight against the inhabitants of Gibeon, and all the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua, saying, Come up quickly to us and help us, for all the kings of the Amorites have gathered together to fight against us.

verses.raw: And Joshua and all the fighting people went up from Gilgal, and Joshua came suddenly to them, and smote these five kings with a great slaughter.
verses.text: And Joshua and all the fighting people went up from Gilgal, and Joshua came suddenly to them, and smote these five kings with a great slaughter.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) confounded them before the children at Israel, who smote them with a terrible slaughter in Gibeon, and pursued them along the way that goes up to Beth Horon to Makkedah, and they fled from before the children of Israel.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) confounded them before the children at Israel, who smote them with a terrible slaughter in Gibeon, and pursued them along the way that goes up to Beth Horon to Makkedah, and they fled from before the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And whilst they were fleeing, Yahuah (the Lord) sent upon them hailstones from heaven, and more of them died by the hailstones, than by the slaughter of the children of Israel.
verses.text: And whilst they were fleeing, Yahuah (the Lord) sent upon them hailstones from heaven, and more of them died by the hailstones, than by the slaughter of the children of Israel.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel pursued them, and they still smote them in the road, going on and smiting them.
verses.text: And the children of Israel pursued them, and they still smote them in the road, going on and smiting them.

verses.raw: And when they were smiting, the day was declining toward evening, and Joshua said in the sight of all the people, Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon, and you moon in the valley of Ajalon, until the nation shall have revenged itself upon its enemies.
verses.text: And when they were smiting, the day was declining toward evening, and Joshua said in the sight of all the people, Sun, stand you still upon Gibeon, and you moon in the valley of Ajalon, until the nation shall have revenged itself upon its enemies.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Joshua, and the sun stood still in the midst of the heavens, and it stood still six and thirty moments, and the moon also stood still and hastened not to go down a whole day.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of Joshua, and the sun stood still in the midst of the heavens, and it stood still six and thirty moments, and the moon also stood still and hastened not to go down a whole day.

verses.raw: And there was no day like that, before it or after it, that Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of a man, for Yahuah (the Lord) fought for Israel.
verses.text: And there was no day like that, before it or after it, that Yahuah (the Lord) hearkened to the voice of a man, for Yahuah (the Lord) fought for Israel.

verses.raw: Then spoke Joshua this song, on the day that Yahuah (the Lord) had given the Amorites into the hand of Joshua and the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of all Israel,
verses.text: Then spoke Joshua this song, on the day that Yahuah (the Lord) had given the Amorites into the hand of Joshua and the children of Israel, and he said in the sight of all Israel,

verses.raw: You have done mighty things, O Yahuah (O Lord), you have performed great deeds; who is like to you? my lips shall sing to your name.
verses.text: You have done mighty things, O Yahuah (O Lord), you have performed great deeds; who is like to you? my lips shall sing to your name.

verses.raw: My goodness and my fortress, my high tower, I will sing a new song to you, with thanksgiving will I sing to you, you are the strength of my salvation.
verses.text: My goodness and my fortress, my high tower, I will sing a new song to you, with thanksgiving will I sing to you, you are the strength of my salvation.

verses.raw: All the kings of the earth shall praise you, the princes of the world shall sing to you, the children of Israel shall rejoice in your salvation, they shall sing and praise your power.
verses.text: All the kings of the earth shall praise you, the princes of the world shall sing to you, the children of Israel shall rejoice in your salvation, they shall sing and praise your power.

verses.raw: To you, O Yahuah (O Lord), did we confide; we said you are our Elohim (God), for you were our shelter and strong tower against our enemies.
verses.text: To you, O Yahuah (O Lord), did we confide; we said you are our Elohim, for you were our shelter and strong tower against our enemies.

verses.raw: To you we cried and were not ashamed, in you we trusted and were delivered; when we cried to you, you did hear our voice, you did deliver our souls from the sword, you did show to us your grace, you did give to us your salvation, you did rejoice our hearts with your strength.
verses.text: To you we cried and were not ashamed, in you we trusted and were delivered; when we cried to you, you did hear our voice, you did deliver our souls from the sword, you did show to us your grace, you did give to us your salvation, you did rejoice our hearts with your strength.

verses.raw: You did go forth for our salvation, with your arm you did redeem your people; you did answer us from the heavens of your holiness, you did save us from ten thousands of people.
verses.text: You did go forth for our salvation, with your arm you did redeem your people; you did answer us from the heavens of your holiness, you did save us from ten thousands of people.

verses.raw: The sun and moon stood still in heaven, and you did stand in your wrath against our oppressors and did command your judgments over them.
verses.text: The sun and moon stood still in heaven, and you did stand in your wrath against our oppressors and did command your judgments over them.

verses.raw: All the princes of the earth stood up, the kings of the nations had gathered themselves together, they were not moved at your presence, they desired your battles.
verses.text: All the princes of the earth stood up, the kings of the nations had gathered themselves together, they were not moved at your presence, they desired your battles.

verses.raw: You did rise against them in your anger, and did bring down your wrath upon them; you did destroy them in your anger, and cut them off in your heart.
verses.text: You did rise against them in your anger, and did bring down your wrath upon them; you did destroy them in your anger, and cut them off in your heart.

verses.raw: Nations have been consumed with your fury, kingdoms have declined because of your wrath, you did wound kings in the day of your anger.
verses.text: Nations have been consumed with your fury, kingdoms have declined because of your wrath, you did wound kings in the day of your anger.

verses.raw: You did pour out your fury upon them, your wrathful anger took hold of them; you did turn their iniquity upon them, and did cut them off in their wickedness.
verses.text: You did pour out your fury upon them, your wrathful anger took hold of them; you did turn their iniquity upon them, and did cut them off in their wickedness.

verses.raw: They did spread a trap, they fell in it, in the net they hid, their foot was caught.
verses.text: They did spread a trap, they fell in it, in the net they hid, their foot was caught.

verses.raw: Your hand was ready for all your enemies who said, Through their sword they possessed the land, through their arm they dwelt in the city; you did fill their faces with shame, you did bring their horns down to the ground, you did terrify them in your wrath, and did destroy them in your anger.
verses.text: Your hand was ready for all your enemies who said, Through their sword they possessed the land, through their arm they dwelt in the city; you did fill their faces with shame, you did bring their horns down to the ground, you did terrify them in your wrath, and did destroy them in your anger.

verses.raw: The earth trembled and shook at the sound of your storm over them, you did not withhold their souls from death, and did bring down their lives to the grave.
verses.text: The earth trembled and shook at the sound of your storm over them, you did not withhold their souls from death, and did bring down their lives to the grave.

verses.raw: You did pursue them in your storm, you did consume them in your whirlwind, you did turn their rain into hail, they fell in deep pits so that they could not rise.
verses.text: You did pursue them in your storm, you did consume them in your whirlwind, you did turn their rain into hail, they fell in deep pits so that they could not rise.

verses.raw: Their carcasses were like rubbish cast out in the middle of the streets.
verses.text: Their carcasses were like rubbish cast out in the middle of the streets.

verses.raw: They were consumed and destroyed in your anger, you did save your people with your might.
verses.text: They were consumed and destroyed in your anger, you did save your people with your might.
