verses.raw: Therefore our hearts rejoice in you, our souls exalt in your salvation.
verses.text: Therefore our hearts rejoice in you, our souls exalt in your salvation.

verses.raw: Our tongues shall relate your might, we will sing and praise your wondrous works.
verses.text: Our tongues shall relate your might, we will sing and praise your wondrous works.

verses.raw: For you did save us from our enemies, you did deliver us from those who rose up against us, you did destroy them from before us and depress them beneath our feet.
verses.text: For you did save us from our enemies, you did deliver us from those who rose up against us, you did destroy them from before us and depress them beneath our feet.

verses.raw: Thus shall all your enemies perish O Yahuah (O Lord), and the wicked shall be like chaff driven by the wind, and your beloved shall be like trees planted by the waters.
verses.text: Thus shall all your enemies perish O Yahuah (O Lord), and the wicked shall be like chaff driven by the wind, and your beloved shall be like trees planted by the waters.

verses.raw: So Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp in Gilgal, after having smitten all the kings, so that not a remnant was left of them.
verses.text: So Joshua and all Israel with him returned to the camp in Gilgal, after having smitten all the kings, so that not a remnant was left of them.

verses.raw: And the five kings fled alone on foot from battle, and hid themselves in a cave, and Joshua sought for them in the field of battle, and did not find them.
verses.text: And the five kings fled alone on foot from battle, and hid themselves in a cave, and Joshua sought for them in the field of battle, and did not find them.

verses.raw: And it was afterward told to Joshua, saying, The kings are found and behold they are hidden in a cave.
verses.text: And it was afterward told to Joshua, saying, The kings are found and behold they are hidden in a cave.

verses.raw: And Joshua said, Appoint men to be at the mouth of the cave, to guard them, lest they take themselves away; and the children of Israel did so.
verses.text: And Joshua said, Appoint men to be at the mouth of the cave, to guard them, lest they take themselves away; and the children of Israel did so.

verses.raw: And Joshua called to all Israel and said to the officers of battle, Place your feet upon the necks of these kings, and Joshua said, So shall Yahuah (the Lord) do to all your enemies.
verses.text: And Joshua called to all Israel and said to the officers of battle, Place your feet upon the necks of these kings, and Joshua said, So shall Yahuah (the Lord) do to all your enemies.

verses.raw: And Joshua commanded afterward that they should slay the kings and cast them into the cave, and to put great stones at the mouth of the cave.
verses.text: And Joshua commanded afterward that they should slay the kings and cast them into the cave, and to put great stones at the mouth of the cave.

verses.raw: And Joshua went afterward with all the people that were with him on that day to Makkedah, and he smote it with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And Joshua went afterward with all the people that were with him on that day to Makkedah, and he smote it with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And he utterly destroyed the souls and all belonging to the city, and he did to the king and people of it as he had done to Jericho.
verses.text: And he utterly destroyed the souls and all belonging to the city, and he did to the king and people of it as he had done to Jericho.

verses.raw: And he passed from there to Libnah and he fought against it, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered it into his hand, and Joshua smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls of it, and he did to it and to the king of it as he had done to Jericho.
verses.text: And he passed from there to Libnah and he fought against it, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered it into his hand, and Joshua smote it with the edge of the sword, and all the souls of it, and he did to it and to the king of it as he had done to Jericho.

verses.raw: And from there he passed on to Lachish to fight against it, and Horam king of Gaza went up to assist the men of Lachish, and Joshua smote him and his people until there was none left to him.
verses.text: And from there he passed on to Lachish to fight against it, and Horam king of Gaza went up to assist the men of Lachish, and Joshua smote him and his people until there was none left to him.

verses.raw: And Joshua took Lachish and all the people of it, and he did to it as he had done to Libnah.
verses.text: And Joshua took Lachish and all the people of it, and he did to it as he had done to Libnah.

verses.raw: And Joshua passed from there to Eglon, and he took that also, and he smote it and all the people of it with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And Joshua passed from there to Eglon, and he took that also, and he smote it and all the people of it with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And from there he passed to Hebron and fought against it and took it and utterly destroyed it, and he returned from there with all Israel to Debir and fought against it and smote it with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And from there he passed to Hebron and fought against it and took it and utterly destroyed it, and he returned from there with all Israel to Debir and fought against it and smote it with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And he destroyed every soul in it, he left none remaining, and he did to it and the king of it as he had done to Jericho.
verses.text: And he destroyed every soul in it, he left none remaining, and he did to it and the king of it as he had done to Jericho.

verses.raw: And Joshua smote all the kings of the Amorites from Kadesh-barnea to Azah, and he took their country at once, for Yahuah (the Lord) had fought for Israel.
verses.text: And Joshua smote all the kings of the Amorites from Kadesh-barnea to Azah, and he took their country at once, for Yahuah (the Lord) had fought for Israel.

verses.raw: And Joshua with all Israel came to the camp to Gilgal.
verses.text: And Joshua with all Israel came to the camp to Gilgal.

verses.raw: When at that time Jabin king of Chazor heard all that Joshua had done to the kings of the Amorites, Jabin sent to Jobat king of Midian, and to Laban king of Shimron, to Jephal king of Achshaph, and to all the kings of the Amorites, saying,
verses.text: When at that time Jabin king of Chazor heard all that Joshua had done to the kings of the Amorites, Jabin sent to Jobat king of Midian, and to Laban king of Shimron, to Jephal king of Achshaph, and to all the kings of the Amorites, saying,

verses.raw: Come quickly to us and help us, that we may smite the children of Israel, before they come upon us and do to us as they have done to the other kings of the Amorites.
verses.text: Come quickly to us and help us, that we may smite the children of Israel, before they come upon us and do to us as they have done to the other kings of the Amorites.

verses.raw: And all these kings hearkened to the words of Jabin, king of Chazor, and they went forth with all their camps, seventeen kings, and their people were as numerous as the sand on the sea shore, together with horses and chariots innumerable, and they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, and they were met together to fight against Israel.
verses.text: And all these kings hearkened to the words of Jabin, king of Chazor, and they went forth with all their camps, seventeen kings, and their people were as numerous as the sand on the sea shore, together with horses and chariots innumerable, and they came and pitched together at the waters of Merom, and they were met together to fight against Israel.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Fear them not, for tomorrow about this time I will deliver them up all slain before you, you shall hough their horses and burn their chariots with fire.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, Fear them not, for tomorrow about this time I will deliver them up all slain before you, you shall hough their horses and burn their chariots with fire.

verses.raw: And Joshua with all the men of war came suddenly upon them and smote them, and they fell into their hands, for Yahuah (the Lord) had delivered them into the hands of the children of Israel.
verses.text: And Joshua with all the men of war came suddenly upon them and smote them, and they fell into their hands, for Yahuah (the Lord) had delivered them into the hands of the children of Israel.

verses.raw: So the children of Israel pursued all these kings with their camps, and smote them until there was none left of them, and Joshua did to them as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to him.
verses.text: So the children of Israel pursued all these kings with their camps, and smote them until there was none left of them, and Joshua did to them as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to him.

verses.raw: And Joshua returned at that time to Chazor and smote it with the sword and destroyed every soul in it and burned it with fire, and from Chazor, Joshua passed to Shimron and smote it and utterly destroyed it.
verses.text: And Joshua returned at that time to Chazor and smote it with the sword and destroyed every soul in it and burned it with fire, and from Chazor, Joshua passed to Shimron and smote it and utterly destroyed it.

verses.raw: From there he passed to Achshaph and he did to it as he had done to Shimron.
verses.text: From there he passed to Achshaph and he did to it as he had done to Shimron.

verses.raw: From there he passed to Adulam and he smote all the people in it, and he did to Adulam as he had done to Achshaph and to Shimron.
verses.text: From there he passed to Adulam and he smote all the people in it, and he did to Adulam as he had done to Achshaph and to Shimron.

verses.raw: And he passed from them to all the cities of the kings which he had smitten, and he smote all the people that were left of them and he utterly destroyed them.
verses.text: And he passed from them to all the cities of the kings which he had smitten, and he smote all the people that were left of them and he utterly destroyed them.

verses.raw: Only their booty and cattle the Israelites took to themselves as a prey, but every human being they smote, they suffered not a soul to live.
verses.text: Only their booty and cattle the Israelites took to themselves as a prey, but every human being they smote, they suffered not a soul to live.

verses.raw: As Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses so did Joshua and all Israel, they failed not in anything.
verses.text: As Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses so did Joshua and all Israel, they failed not in anything.

verses.raw: So Joshua and all the children of Israel smote the whole land of Canaan as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded them, and smote all their kings, being thirty and one kings, and the children of Israel took their whole country.
verses.text: So Joshua and all the children of Israel smote the whole land of Canaan as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded them, and smote all their kings, being thirty and one kings, and the children of Israel took their whole country.

verses.raw: Besides the kingdoms of Sihon and Og which are on the other side Jordan, of which Moses had smitten many cities, and Moses gave them to the Reubenites and the Gadites and to half the tribe of Manasseh.
verses.text: Besides the kingdoms of Sihon and Og which are on the other side Jordan, of which Moses had smitten many cities, and Moses gave them to the Reubenites and the Gadites and to half the tribe of Manasseh.

verses.raw: And Joshua smote all the kings that were on this side Jordan to the west, and gave them for an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half tribe of Israel.
verses.text: And Joshua smote all the kings that were on this side Jordan to the west, and gave them for an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half tribe of Israel.

verses.raw: For five years did Joshua carry on the war with these kings, and he gave their cities to the Israelites, and the land became tranquil from battle throughout the cities of the Amorites and the Canaanites.
verses.text: For five years did Joshua carry on the war with these kings, and he gave their cities to the Israelites, and the land became tranquil from battle throughout the cities of the Amorites and the Canaanites.

verses.raw: At that time in the fifth year after the children of Israel had passed over Jordan, after the children of Israel had rested from their war with the Canaanites, at that time great and severe battles arose between Edom and the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim fought against Edom.
verses.text: At that time in the fifth year after the children of Israel had passed over Jordan, after the children of Israel had rested from their war with the Canaanites, at that time great and severe battles arose between Edom and the children of Chittim, and the children of Chittim fought against Edom.

verses.raw: And Abianus king of Chittim went forth in that year, that is in the thirty-first year of his reign, and a great force with him of the mighty men of the children of Chittim, and he went to Seir to fight against the children of Esau.
verses.text: And Abianus king of Chittim went forth in that year, that is in the thirty-first year of his reign, and a great force with him of the mighty men of the children of Chittim, and he went to Seir to fight against the children of Esau.

verses.raw: And Hadad the king of Edom heard of his report, and he went forth to meet him with a heavy people and strong force, and engaged in battle with him in the field of Edom.
verses.text: And Hadad the king of Edom heard of his report, and he went forth to meet him with a heavy people and strong force, and engaged in battle with him in the field of Edom.

verses.raw: And the hand of Chittim prevailed over the children of Esau, and the children of Chittim slew of the children of Esau, two and twenty thousand men, and all the children of Esau fled from before them.
verses.text: And the hand of Chittim prevailed over the children of Esau, and the children of Chittim slew of the children of Esau, two and twenty thousand men, and all the children of Esau fled from before them.

verses.raw: And the children of Chittim pursued them and they reached Hadad king of Edom, who was running before them and they caught him alive, and brought him to Abianus king of Chittim.
verses.text: And the children of Chittim pursued them and they reached Hadad king of Edom, who was running before them and they caught him alive, and brought him to Abianus king of Chittim.

verses.raw: And Abianus ordered him to be slain, and Hadad king of Edom died in the forty-eighth year of his reign.
verses.text: And Abianus ordered him to be slain, and Hadad king of Edom died in the forty-eighth year of his reign.

verses.raw: And the children of Chittim continued their pursuit of Edom, and they smote them with a great slaughter and Edom became subject to the children of Chittim.
verses.text: And the children of Chittim continued their pursuit of Edom, and they smote them with a great slaughter and Edom became subject to the children of Chittim.

verses.raw: And the children of Chittim ruled over Edom, and Edom became under the hand of the children of Chittim and became one kingdom from that day.
verses.text: And the children of Chittim ruled over Edom, and Edom became under the hand of the children of Chittim and became one kingdom from that day.

verses.raw: And from that time they could no more lift up their heads, and their kingdom became one with the children of Chittim.
verses.text: And from that time they could no more lift up their heads, and their kingdom became one with the children of Chittim.

verses.raw: And Abianus placed officers in Edom and all the children of Edom became subject and tributary to Abianus, and Abianus turned back to his own land, Chittim.
verses.text: And Abianus placed officers in Edom and all the children of Edom became subject and tributary to Abianus, and Abianus turned back to his own land, Chittim.

verses.raw: And when he returned he renewed his government and built for himself a spacious and fortified palace for a royal residence, and reigned securely over the children of Chittim and over Edom.
verses.text: And when he returned he renewed his government and built for himself a spacious and fortified palace for a royal residence, and reigned securely over the children of Chittim and over Edom.

verses.raw: In those days, after the children of Israel had driven away all the Canaanites and the Amorites, Joshua was old and advanced in years.
verses.text: In those days, after the children of Israel had driven away all the Canaanites and the Amorites, Joshua was old and advanced in years.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, You are old, advanced in life, and a great part of the land remains to be possessed.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) said to Joshua, You are old, advanced in life, and a great part of the land remains to be possessed.

verses.raw: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half tribe of Manasseh, and Joshua rose up and did as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to him.
verses.text: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and to the half tribe of Manasseh, and Joshua rose up and did as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to him.

verses.raw: And he divided the whole land to the tribes of Israel as an inheritance according to their divisions.
verses.text: And he divided the whole land to the tribes of Israel as an inheritance according to their divisions.

verses.raw: But to the tribe at Levi he gave no inheritance, the offerings of Yahuah (the Lord) are their inheritance as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken of them by the hand of Moses.
verses.text: But to the tribe at Levi he gave no inheritance, the offerings of Yahuah (the Lord) are their inheritance as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken of them by the hand of Moses.

verses.raw: And Joshua gave Mount Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephuneh, one portion above his brethren, as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken through Moses.
verses.text: And Joshua gave Mount Hebron to Caleb the son of Jephuneh, one portion above his brethren, as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken through Moses.

verses.raw: Therefore Hebron became an inheritance to Caleb and his children to this day.
verses.text: Therefore Hebron became an inheritance to Caleb and his children to this day.

verses.raw: And Joshua divided the whole land by lots to all Israel for an inheritance, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.
verses.text: And Joshua divided the whole land by lots to all Israel for an inheritance, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded him.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel gave cities to the Levites from their own inheritance, and suburbs for their cattle, and property, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses so did the children of Israel, and they divided the land by lot whether great or small.
verses.text: And the children of Israel gave cities to the Levites from their own inheritance, and suburbs for their cattle, and property, as Yahuah (the Lord) had commanded Moses so did the children of Israel, and they divided the land by lot whether great or small.

verses.raw: And they went to inherit the land according to their boundaries, and the children of Israel gave to Joshua the son of Nun an inheritance amongst them.
verses.text: And they went to inherit the land according to their boundaries, and the children of Israel gave to Joshua the son of Nun an inheritance amongst them.

verses.raw: By the word of Yahuah (the Lord) did they give to him the city which he required, Timnath-serach in Mount Ephraim, and he built the city and dwelt in it.
verses.text: By the word of Yahuah (the Lord) did they give to him the city which he required, Timnath-serach in Mount Ephraim, and he built the city and dwelt in it.

verses.raw: These are the inheritances which Elazer the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes portioned out to the children of Israel by lot in Shiloh, before Yahuah (the Lord), at the door of the tabernacle, and they left off dividing the land.
verses.text: These are the inheritances which Elazer the priest and Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers of the tribes portioned out to the children of Israel by lot in Shiloh, before Yahuah (the Lord), at the door of the tabernacle, and they left off dividing the land.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave the land to the Israelites, and they possessed it as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to them, and as Yahuah (the Lord) had sworn to their ancestors.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave the land to the Israelites, and they possessed it as Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to them, and as Yahuah (the Lord) had sworn to their ancestors.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave to the Israelites rest from all their enemies around them, and no man stood up against them, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered all their enemies into their hands, and not one thing failed of all the good which Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to the children of Israel, yea Yahuah (the Lord) performed every thing.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave to the Israelites rest from all their enemies around them, and no man stood up against them, and Yahuah (the Lord) delivered all their enemies into their hands, and not one thing failed of all the good which Yahuah (the Lord) had spoken to the children of Israel, yea Yahuah (the Lord) performed every thing.

verses.raw: And Joshua called to all the children of Israel and he blessed them, and commanded them to serve Yahuah (the Lord), and he afterward sent them away, and they went each man to his city, and each man to his inheritance.
verses.text: And Joshua called to all the children of Israel and he blessed them, and commanded them to serve Yahuah (the Lord), and he afterward sent them away, and they went each man to his city, and each man to his inheritance.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Joshua, and Yahuah (the Lord) gave them rest from all around them, and they dwelt securely in their cities.
verses.text: And the children of Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Joshua, and Yahuah (the Lord) gave them rest from all around them, and they dwelt securely in their cities.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in those days, that Abianus king of Chittim died, in the thirty-eighth year of his reign, that is the seventh year of his reign over Edom, and they buried him in his place which he had built for himself, and Latinus reigned in his stead fifty years.
verses.text: And it came to pass in those days, that Abianus king of Chittim died, in the thirty-eighth year of his reign, that is the seventh year of his reign over Edom, and they buried him in his place which he had built for himself, and Latinus reigned in his stead fifty years.

verses.raw: And during his reign he brought forth an army, and he went and fought against the inhabitants of Britannia and Kernania, the children of Elisha son of Javan, and he prevailed over them and made them tributary.
verses.text: And during his reign he brought forth an army, and he went and fought against the inhabitants of Britannia and Kernania, the children of Elisha son of Javan, and he prevailed over them and made them tributary.

verses.raw: He then heard that Edom had revolted from under the hand of Chittim, and Latinus went to them and smote them and subdued them, and placed them under the hand of the children of Chittim, and Edom became one kingdom with the children of Chittim all the days.
verses.text: He then heard that Edom had revolted from under the hand of Chittim, and Latinus went to them and smote them and subdued them, and placed them under the hand of the children of Chittim, and Edom became one kingdom with the children of Chittim all the days.

verses.raw: And for many years there was no king in Edom, and their government was with the children of Chittim and their king.
verses.text: And for many years there was no king in Edom, and their government was with the children of Chittim and their king.

verses.raw: And it was in the twenty-sixth year after the children of Israel had passed the Jordan, that is the sixty-sixth year after the children of Israel had departed from Egypt, that Joshua was old, advanced in years, being one hundred and eight years old in those days.
verses.text: And it was in the twenty-sixth year after the children of Israel had passed the Jordan, that is the sixty-sixth year after the children of Israel had departed from Egypt, that Joshua was old, advanced in years, being one hundred and eight years old in those days.

verses.raw: And Joshua called to all Israel, to their elders, their judges and officers, after Yahuah (the Lord) had given to all the Israelites rest from all their enemies round about, and Joshua said to the elders of Israel, and to their judges, Behold I am old, advanced in years, and you have seen what Yahuah (the Lord) has done to all the nations whom he has driven away from before you, for it is Yahuah (the Lord) who has fought for you.
verses.text: And Joshua called to all Israel, to their elders, their judges and officers, after Yahuah (the Lord) had given to all the Israelites rest from all their enemies round about, and Joshua said to the elders of Israel, and to their judges, Behold I am old, advanced in years, and you have seen what Yahuah (the Lord) has done to all the nations whom he has driven away from before you, for it is Yahuah (the Lord) who has fought for you.

verses.raw: Now therefore strengthen yourselves to keep and to do all the words of the law of Moses, not to deviate from it to the right or to the left, and not to come amongst those nations who are left in the land; neither shall you make mention of the name of their gods, but you shall cleave to Yahuah your Elohim (the Lord your God), as you have done to this day.
verses.text: Now therefore strengthen yourselves to keep and to do all the words of the law of Moses, not to deviate from it to the right or to the left, and not to come amongst those nations who are left in the land; neither shall you make mention of the name of their gods, but you shall cleave to Yahuah your Elohim, as you have done to this day.

verses.raw: And Joshua greatly exhorted the children of Israel to serve Yahuah (the Lord) all their days.
verses.text: And Joshua greatly exhorted the children of Israel to serve Yahuah (the Lord) all their days.

verses.raw: And all the Israelites said, We will serve Yahuah our Elohim (the Lord our God) all our days, we and our children, and our children’s children, and our seed for ever.
verses.text: And all the Israelites said, We will serve Yahuah our Elohim all our days, we and our children, and our children’s children, and our seed for ever.

verses.raw: And Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day, and he sent away the children of Israel, and they went each man to his inheritance and to his city.
verses.text: And Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day, and he sent away the children of Israel, and they went each man to his inheritance and to his city.

verses.raw: And it was in those days, when the children of Israel were dwelling securely in their cities, that they buried the coffins of the tribes of their ancestors, which they had brought up from Egypt, each man in the inheritance of his children, the twelve sons of Jacob did the children of Israel bury, each man in the possession of his children.
verses.text: And it was in those days, when the children of Israel were dwelling securely in their cities, that they buried the coffins of the tribes of their ancestors, which they had brought up from Egypt, each man in the inheritance of his children, the twelve sons of Jacob did the children of Israel bury, each man in the possession of his children.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the cities wherein they buried the twelve sons of Jacob, whom the children of Israel had brought up from Egypt.
verses.text: And these are the names of the cities wherein they buried the twelve sons of Jacob, whom the children of Israel had brought up from Egypt.

verses.raw: And they buried Reuben and Gad on this side Jordan, in Romia, which Moses had given to their children.
verses.text: And they buried Reuben and Gad on this side Jordan, in Romia, which Moses had given to their children.

verses.raw: And Simeon and Levi they buried in the city Mauda, which he had given to the children of Simeon, and the suburb of the city was for the children of Levi.
verses.text: And Simeon and Levi they buried in the city Mauda, which he had given to the children of Simeon, and the suburb of the city was for the children of Levi.

verses.raw: And Judah they buried in the city of Benjamin opposite Bethlehem.
verses.text: And Judah they buried in the city of Benjamin opposite Bethlehem.

verses.raw: And the bones of Issachar and Zebulun they buried in Zidon, in the portion which fell to their children.
verses.text: And the bones of Issachar and Zebulun they buried in Zidon, in the portion which fell to their children.

verses.raw: And Dan was buried in the city of his children in Eshtael, and Naphtali and Asher they buried in Kadesh-naphtali, each man in his place which he had given to his children.
verses.text: And Dan was buried in the city of his children in Eshtael, and Naphtali and Asher they buried in Kadesh-naphtali, each man in his place which he had given to his children.

verses.raw: And the bones of Joseph they buried in Shechem, in the part of the field which Jacob had purchased from Hamor, and which became to Joseph for an inheritance.
verses.text: And the bones of Joseph they buried in Shechem, in the part of the field which Jacob had purchased from Hamor, and which became to Joseph for an inheritance.

verses.raw: And they buried Benjamin in Jerusalem opposite the Jebusite, which was given to the children of Benjamin; the children of Israel buried their fathers each man in the city of his children.
verses.text: And they buried Benjamin in Jerusalem opposite the Jebusite, which was given to the children of Benjamin; the children of Israel buried their fathers each man in the city of his children.

verses.raw: And at the end of two years, Joshua the son of Nun died, one hundred and ten years old, and the time which Joshua judged Israel was twenty-eight years, and Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of his life.
verses.text: And at the end of two years, Joshua the son of Nun died, one hundred and ten years old, and the time which Joshua judged Israel was twenty-eight years, and Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of his life.

verses.raw: And the other affairs of Joshua and his battles and his reproofs with which he reproved Israel, and all which he had commanded them, and the names of the cities which the children of Israel possessed in his days, behold they are written in the book of the words of Joshua to the children of Israel, and in the book of the wars of Yahuah (the Lord), which Moses and Joshua and the children of Israel had written.
verses.text: And the other affairs of Joshua and his battles and his reproofs with which he reproved Israel, and all which he had commanded them, and the names of the cities which the children of Israel possessed in his days, behold they are written in the book of the words of Joshua to the children of Israel, and in the book of the wars of Yahuah (the Lord), which Moses and Joshua and the children of Israel had written.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel buried Joshua in the border of his inheritance, in Timnath-serach, which was given to him in Mount Ephraim.
verses.text: And the children of Israel buried Joshua in the border of his inheritance, in Timnath-serach, which was given to him in Mount Ephraim.

verses.raw: And Elazer the son of Aaron died in those days, and they buried him in a hill belonging to Phineas his son, which was given him in Mount Ephraim.
verses.text: And Elazer the son of Aaron died in those days, and they buried him in a hill belonging to Phineas his son, which was given him in Mount Ephraim.

verses.raw: At that time, after the death of Joshua, the children of the Canaanites were still in the land, and the Israelites resolved to drive them out.
verses.text: At that time, after the death of Joshua, the children of the Canaanites were still in the land, and the Israelites resolved to drive them out.

verses.raw: And the children of Israel asked of Yahuah (the Lord), saying, Who shall first go up for us to the Canaanites to fight against them? and Yahuah (the Lord) said, Judah shall go up.
verses.text: And the children of Israel asked of Yahuah (the Lord), saying, Who shall first go up for us to the Canaanites to fight against them? and Yahuah (the Lord) said, Judah shall go up.

verses.raw: And the children of Judah said to Simeon, Go up with us into our lot, and we will fight against the Canaanites and we likewise will go up with you, in your lot, so the children of Simeon went with the children of Judah.
verses.text: And the children of Judah said to Simeon, Go up with us into our lot, and we will fight against the Canaanites and we likewise will go up with you, in your lot, so the children of Simeon went with the children of Judah.

verses.raw: And the children of Judah went up and fought against the Canaanites, so Yahuah (the Lord) delivered the Canaanites into the hands of the children of Judah, and they smote them in Bezek, ten thousand men.
verses.text: And the children of Judah went up and fought against the Canaanites, so Yahuah (the Lord) delivered the Canaanites into the hands of the children of Judah, and they smote them in Bezek, ten thousand men.

verses.raw: And they fought with Adonibezek in Bezek, and he fled from before them, and they pursued him and caught him, and they took hold of him and cut off his thumbs and great toes.
verses.text: And they fought with Adonibezek in Bezek, and he fled from before them, and they pursued him and caught him, and they took hold of him and cut off his thumbs and great toes.

verses.raw: And Adonibezek said, Three score and ten kings having their thumbs and great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table, as I have done, so Elohim (God) has requited me, and they brought him to Jerusalem and he died there.
verses.text: And Adonibezek said, Three score and ten kings having their thumbs and great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table, as I have done, so Elohim has requited me, and they brought him to Jerusalem and he died there.

verses.raw: And the children of Simeon went with the children of Judah, and they smote the Canaanites with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And the children of Simeon went with the children of Judah, and they smote the Canaanites with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with the children of Judah, and they possessed the mountain, and the children of Joseph went up to Bethel, the same is Luz, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with them.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) was with the children of Judah, and they possessed the mountain, and the children of Joseph went up to Bethel, the same is Luz, and Yahuah (the Lord) was with them.

verses.raw: And the children of Joseph spied out Bethel, and the watchmen saw a man going forth from the city, and they caught him and said to him, Show us now the entrance of the city and we will show kindness to you.
verses.text: And the children of Joseph spied out Bethel, and the watchmen saw a man going forth from the city, and they caught him and said to him, Show us now the entrance of the city and we will show kindness to you.

verses.raw: And that man showed them the entrance of the city, and the children of Joseph came and smote the City with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And that man showed them the entrance of the city, and the children of Joseph came and smote the City with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And the man with his family they sent away, and he went to the Hittites and he built a city, and he called the name of it Luz, so all the Israelites dwelt in their cities, and the children at Israel dwelt in their cities, and the children of Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders, who had lengthened their days after Joshua, and saw the great work of Yahuah (the Lord), which he had performed for Israel.
verses.text: And the man with his family they sent away, and he went to the Hittites and he built a city, and he called the name of it Luz, so all the Israelites dwelt in their cities, and the children at Israel dwelt in their cities, and the children of Israel served Yahuah (the Lord) all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders, who had lengthened their days after Joshua, and saw the great work of Yahuah (the Lord), which he had performed for Israel.

verses.raw: And the elders judged Israel after the death of Joshua for seventeen years.
verses.text: And the elders judged Israel after the death of Joshua for seventeen years.

verses.raw: And all the elders also fought the battles of Israel against the Canaanites and Yahuah (the Lord) drove the Canaanites from before the children of Israel, in order to place the Israelites in their land.
verses.text: And all the elders also fought the battles of Israel against the Canaanites and Yahuah (the Lord) drove the Canaanites from before the children of Israel, in order to place the Israelites in their land.

verses.raw: And he accomplished all the words which he had spoken to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the oath which he had sworn, to give to them and to their children, the land of the Canaanites.
verses.text: And he accomplished all the words which he had spoken to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the oath which he had sworn, to give to them and to their children, the land of the Canaanites.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave to the children of Israel the whole land of Canaan, as he had sworn to their ancestors, and Yahuah (the Lord) gave them rest from those around them, and the children of Israel dwelt securely in their cities.
verses.text: And Yahuah (the Lord) gave to the children of Israel the whole land of Canaan, as he had sworn to their ancestors, and Yahuah (the Lord) gave them rest from those around them, and the children of Israel dwelt securely in their cities.

verses.raw: Blessed be Yahuah (the Lord) for ever, amen, and amen.
verses.text: Blessed be Yahuah (the Lord) for ever, amen, and amen.

verses.raw: Strengthen yourselves, and let the hearts of all you that trust in Yahuah (the Lord) be of good courage.
verses.text: Strengthen yourselves, and let the hearts of all you that trust in Yahuah (the Lord) be of good courage.

verses.raw: And Josias held the feast of the passover in Jerusalem to his Elohim (God), and offered the passover the fourteenth day of the first month;
verses.text: And Josias held the feast of the passover in Jerusalem to his Elohim, and offered the passover the fourteenth day of the first month;

verses.raw: Having set the priests according to their daily courses, being arrayed in long garments, in the temple of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Having set the priests according to their daily courses, being arrayed in long garments, in the temple of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he spoke to the Levites, the holy ministers of Yashar'el (Israel), that they should hallow themselves to Yahuah (God), to set the holy ark of Yahuah (God) in the house that king Solomon the son of David had built:
verses.text: And he spoke to the Levites, the holy ministers of Yashar'el, that they should hallow themselves to Yahuah, to set the holy ark of Yahuah in the house that king Solomon the son of David had built:

verses.raw: And said, You shall no more bear the ark upon your shoulders: now therefore serve Yahuah (God), your Elohim (God), and minister to his people Yashar'el (Israel), and prepare you after your families and kindreds,
verses.text: And said, You shall no more bear the ark upon your shoulders: now therefore serve Yahuah, your Elohim, and minister to his people Yashar'el, and prepare you after your families and kindreds,

verses.raw: According as David the king of Yashar'el (Israel) prescribed, and according to the magnificence of Solomon his son: and standing in the temple according to the several dignity of the families of you the Levites, who minister in the presence of your brothers the children of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: According as David the king of Yashar'el prescribed, and according to the magnificence of Solomon his son: and standing in the temple according to the several dignity of the families of you the Levites, who minister in the presence of your brothers the children of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: Offer the passover in order, and make ready the sacrifices for your brothers, and keep the passover according to the commandment of Yahuah (God), which was given to Moses.
verses.text: Offer the passover in order, and make ready the sacrifices for your brothers, and keep the passover according to the commandment of Yahuah, which was given to Moses.

verses.raw: And to the people that was found there Josias gave thirty thousand lambs and kids, and three thousand calves: these things were given of the king’s allowance, according as he promised, to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites.
verses.text: And to the people that was found there Josias gave thirty thousand lambs and kids, and three thousand calves: these things were given of the king’s allowance, according as he promised, to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites.

verses.raw: And Helkias, Zacharias, and Syelus, the governors of the temple, gave to the priests for the passover two thousand and six hundred sheep, and three hundred calves.
verses.text: And Helkias, Zacharias, and Syelus, the governors of the temple, gave to the priests for the passover two thousand and six hundred sheep, and three hundred calves.

verses.raw: And Jeconias, and Samaias, and Nathanael his brother, and Assabias, and Ochiel, and Joram, captains over thousands, gave to the Levites for the passover five thousand sheep, and seven hundred calves.
verses.text: And Jeconias, and Samaias, and Nathanael his brother, and Assabias, and Ochiel, and Joram, captains over thousands, gave to the Levites for the passover five thousand sheep, and seven hundred calves.

verses.raw: And when these things were done, the priests and Levites, having the unleavened bread, stood in very comely order according to the kindreds,
verses.text: And when these things were done, the priests and Levites, having the unleavened bread, stood in very comely order according to the kindreds,

verses.raw: And according to the several dignities of the fathers, before the people, to offer to Yahuah (God), as it is written in the book of Moses: and thus did they in the morning.
verses.text: And according to the several dignities of the fathers, before the people, to offer to Yahuah, as it is written in the book of Moses: and thus did they in the morning.

verses.raw: And they roasted the passover with fire, as appertaineth: as for the sacrifices, they sod them in brass pots and pans with a good savour,
verses.text: And they roasted the passover with fire, as appertaineth: as for the sacrifices, they sod them in brass pots and pans with a good savour,

verses.raw: And set them before all the people: and afterward they prepared for themselves, and for the priests their brothers, the sons of Aaron.
verses.text: And set them before all the people: and afterward they prepared for themselves, and for the priests their brothers, the sons of Aaron.

verses.raw: For the priests offered the fat until night: and the Levites prepared for themselves, and the priests their brothers, the sons of Aaron.
verses.text: For the priests offered the fat until night: and the Levites prepared for themselves, and the priests their brothers, the sons of Aaron.

verses.raw: The holy singers also, the sons of Asaph, were in their order, according to the appointment of David, to wit, Asaph, Zacharias, and Jeduthun, who was of the king’s retinue.
verses.text: The holy singers also, the sons of Asaph, were in their order, according to the appointment of David, to wit, Asaph, Zacharias, and Jeduthun, who was of the king’s retinue.

verses.raw: Moreover the porters were at every gate; it was not lawful for any to go from his ordinary service: for their brothers the Levites prepared for them.
verses.text: Moreover the porters were at every gate; it was not lawful for any to go from his ordinary service: for their brothers the Levites prepared for them.

verses.raw: Thus were the things that belonged to the sacrifices of Yahuah (God) accomplished in that day, that they might hold the passover,
verses.text: Thus were the things that belonged to the sacrifices of Yahuah accomplished in that day, that they might hold the passover,

verses.raw: And offer sacrifices upon the altar of Yahuah (God), according to the commandment of king Josias.
verses.text: And offer sacrifices upon the altar of Yahuah, according to the commandment of king Josias.

verses.raw: So the children of Yashar'el (Israel) which were present held the passover at that time, and the feast of sweet bread seven days.
verses.text: So the children of Yashar'el which were present held the passover at that time, and the feast of sweet bread seven days.

verses.raw: And such a passover was not kept in Yashar'el (Israel) since the time of the prophet Samuel.
verses.text: And such a passover was not kept in Yashar'el since the time of the prophet Samuel.

verses.raw: Yea, all the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) held not such a passover as Josias, and the priests, and the Levites, and the Yahudim (Jews), held with all Yashar'el (Israel) that were found dwelling at Jerusalem.
verses.text: Yea, all the kings of Yashar'el held not such a passover as Josias, and the priests, and the Levites, and the Yahudim, held with all Yashar'el that were found dwelling at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josias was this passover kept.
verses.text: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josias was this passover kept.

verses.raw: And the works or Josias were upright before his Elohim (God) with an heart full of godliness.
verses.text: And the works or Josias were upright before his Elohim with an heart full of godliness.

verses.raw: As for the things that came to pass in his time, they were written in former times, concerning those that sinned, and did wickedly against Yahuah (God) above all people and kingdoms, and how they grieved him exceedingly, so that the words of Yahuah (God) rose up against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: As for the things that came to pass in his time, they were written in former times, concerning those that sinned, and did wickedly against Yahuah above all people and kingdoms, and how they grieved him exceedingly, so that the words of Yahuah rose up against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Now after all these acts of Josias it came to pass, that Pharaoh the king of Egypt came to raise war at Carchamis upon Euphrates: and Josias went out against him.
verses.text: Now after all these acts of Josias it came to pass, that Pharaoh the king of Egypt came to raise war at Carchamis upon Euphrates: and Josias went out against him.

verses.raw: But the king of Egypt sent to him, saying, What have I to do with you, O king of Judea?
verses.text: But the king of Egypt sent to him, saying, What have I to do with you, O king of Judea?

verses.raw: I am not sent out from Yahuah (God) against you; for my war is upon Euphrates: and now Yahuah (God) is with me, yes, Yahuah (God) is with me hasting me forward: depart from me, and be not against Yahuah (God).
verses.text: I am not sent out from Yahuah against you; for my war is upon Euphrates: and now Yahuah is with me, yes, Yahuah is with me hasting me forward: depart from me, and be not against Yahuah.

verses.raw: Howbeit Josias did not turn back his chariot from him, but undertook to fight with him, not regarding the words of the prophet Jeremy spoken by the mouth of Yahuah (God):
verses.text: Howbeit Josias did not turn back his chariot from him, but undertook to fight with him, not regarding the words of the prophet Jeremy spoken by the mouth of Yahuah:

verses.raw: But joined battle with him in the plain of Magiddo, and the princes came against king Josias.
verses.text: But joined battle with him in the plain of Magiddo, and the princes came against king Josias.

verses.raw: Then said the king to his servants, Carry me away out of the battle; for I am very weak. And immediately his servants took him away out of the battle.
verses.text: Then said the king to his servants, Carry me away out of the battle; for I am very weak. And immediately his servants took him away out of the battle.

verses.raw: Then got he up upon his second chariot; and being brought back to Jerusalem died, and was buried in his father’s sepulchre.
verses.text: Then got he up upon his second chariot; and being brought back to Jerusalem died, and was buried in his father’s sepulchre.

verses.raw: And in all Jewry they mourned for Josias, yes, Jeremy the prophet lamented for Josias, and the chief men with the women made lamentation for him to this day: and this was given out for an ordinance to be done continually in all the nation of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And in all Jewry they mourned for Josias, yes, Jeremy the prophet lamented for Josias, and the chief men with the women made lamentation for him to this day: and this was given out for an ordinance to be done continually in all the nation of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: These things are written in the book of the stories of the kings of Yahudah (Judah), and every one of the acts that Josias did, and his glory, and his understanding in the law of Yahuah (God), and the things that he had done before, and the things now recited, are reported in the book of the kings of Yashar'el (Israel) and Judea.
verses.text: These things are written in the book of the stories of the kings of Yahudah, and every one of the acts that Josias did, and his glory, and his understanding in the law of Yahuah, and the things that he had done before, and the things now recited, are reported in the book of the kings of Yashar'el and Judea.

verses.raw: And the people took Joachaz the son of Josias, and made him king instead of Josias his father, when he was twenty and three years old.
verses.text: And the people took Joachaz the son of Josias, and made him king instead of Josias his father, when he was twenty and three years old.

verses.raw: And he reigned in Judea and in Jerusalem three months: and then the king of Egypt deposed him from reigning in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And he reigned in Judea and in Jerusalem three months: and then the king of Egypt deposed him from reigning in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he set a tax upon the land of an hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold.
verses.text: And he set a tax upon the land of an hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold.

verses.raw: The king of Egypt also made king Joacim his brother king of Judea and Jerusalem.
verses.text: The king of Egypt also made king Joacim his brother king of Judea and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And he bound Joacim and the nobles: but Zaraces his brother he apprehended, and brought him out of Egypt.
verses.text: And he bound Joacim and the nobles: but Zaraces his brother he apprehended, and brought him out of Egypt.

verses.raw: Five and twenty years old was Joacim when he was made king in the land of Judea and Jerusalem; and he did evil before Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Five and twenty years old was Joacim when he was made king in the land of Judea and Jerusalem; and he did evil before Yahuah.

verses.raw: Wherefore against him Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon came up, and bound him with a chain of brass, and carried him into Babylon.
verses.text: Wherefore against him Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon came up, and bound him with a chain of brass, and carried him into Babylon.

verses.raw: Nabuchodonosor also took of the holy vessels of Yahuah (God), and carried them away, and set them in his own temple at Babylon.
verses.text: Nabuchodonosor also took of the holy vessels of Yahuah, and carried them away, and set them in his own temple at Babylon.

verses.raw: But those things that are recorded of him, and of his uncleaness and impiety, are written in the chronicles of the kings.
verses.text: But those things that are recorded of him, and of his uncleaness and impiety, are written in the chronicles of the kings.

verses.raw: And Joacim his son reigned in his stead: he was made king being eighteen years old;
verses.text: And Joacim his son reigned in his stead: he was made king being eighteen years old;

verses.raw: And reigned but three months and ten days in Jerusalem; and did evil before Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And reigned but three months and ten days in Jerusalem; and did evil before Yahuah.

verses.raw: So after a year Nabuchodonosor sent and caused him to be brought into Babylon with the holy vessels of Yahuah (God);
verses.text: So after a year Nabuchodonosor sent and caused him to be brought into Babylon with the holy vessels of Yahuah;

verses.raw: And made Zedechias king of Judea and Jerusalem, when he was one and twenty years old; and he reigned eleven years:
verses.text: And made Zedechias king of Judea and Jerusalem, when he was one and twenty years old; and he reigned eleven years:

verses.raw: And he did evil also in the sight of Yahuah (God), and cared not for the words that were spoken to him by the prophet Jeremy from the mouth of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And he did evil also in the sight of Yahuah, and cared not for the words that were spoken to him by the prophet Jeremy from the mouth of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And after that king Nabuchodonosor had made him to swear by the name of Yahuah (God), he forswore himself, and rebelled; and hardening his neck, his heart, he transgressed the laws of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And after that king Nabuchodonosor had made him to swear by the name of Yahuah, he forswore himself, and rebelled; and hardening his neck, his heart, he transgressed the laws of Yahuah of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: The governors also of the people and of the priests did many things against the laws, and passed all the pollutions of all nations, and defiled the temple of Yahuah (God), which was sanctified in Jerusalem.
verses.text: The governors also of the people and of the priests did many things against the laws, and passed all the pollutions of all nations, and defiled the temple of Yahuah, which was sanctified in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Nevertheless Yahuah (God) of their fathers sent by his messenger to call them back, because he spared them and his tabernacle also.
verses.text: Nevertheless Yahuah of their fathers sent by his messenger to call them back, because he spared them and his tabernacle also.

verses.raw: But they had his messengers in derision; and, look, when Yahuah (God) spoke to them, they made a sport of his prophets:
verses.text: But they had his messengers in derision; and, look, when Yahuah spoke to them, they made a sport of his prophets:

verses.raw: So far forth, that he, being wroth with his people for their great ungodliness, commanded the kings of the Chaldees to come up against them;
verses.text: So far forth, that he, being wroth with his people for their great ungodliness, commanded the kings of the Chaldees to come up against them;

verses.raw: Who slew their young men with the sword, yes, even within the compass of their holy temple, and spared neither young man nor maid, old man nor child, among them; for he delivered all into their hands.
verses.text: Who slew their young men with the sword, yes, even within the compass of their holy temple, and spared neither young man nor maid, old man nor child, among them; for he delivered all into their hands.

verses.raw: And they took all the holy vessels of Yahuah (God), both great and small, with the vessels of the ark of Yahuah (God), and the king’s treasures, and carried them away into Babylon.
verses.text: And they took all the holy vessels of Yahuah, both great and small, with the vessels of the ark of Yahuah, and the king’s treasures, and carried them away into Babylon.

verses.raw: As for the house of Yahuah (God), they burnt it, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem, and set fire upon her towers:
verses.text: As for the house of Yahuah, they burnt it, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem, and set fire upon her towers:

verses.raw: And as for her glorious things, they never ceased till they had consumed and brought them all to nought: and the people that were not slain with the sword he carried to Babylon:
verses.text: And as for her glorious things, they never ceased till they had consumed and brought them all to nought: and the people that were not slain with the sword he carried to Babylon:

verses.raw: Who became servants to him and his children, till the Persians reigned, to fulfil the word of Yahuah (God) spoken by the mouth of Jeremy:
verses.text: Who became servants to him and his children, till the Persians reigned, to fulfil the word of Yahuah spoken by the mouth of Jeremy:

verses.raw: Until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths, the whole time of her desolation shall she rest, until the full term of seventy years. ⸻
verses.text: Until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths, the whole time of her desolation shall she rest, until the full term of seventy years. ⸻

verses.raw: In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, that the word of Yahuah (God) might be accomplished, that he had promised by the mouth of Jeremy;
verses.text: In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, that the word of Yahuah might be accomplished, that he had promised by the mouth of Jeremy;

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) raised up the spirit of Cyrus the king of the Persians, and he made proclamation through all his kingdom, and also by writing,
verses.text: Yahuah raised up the spirit of Cyrus the king of the Persians, and he made proclamation through all his kingdom, and also by writing,

verses.raw: Saying, Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians; Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), the most high Yahuah (God), has made me king of the whole world,
verses.text: Saying, Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians; Yahuah of Yashar'el, the most high Yahuah, has made me king of the whole world,

verses.raw: And commanded me to build him an house at Jerusalem in Jewry.
verses.text: And commanded me to build him an house at Jerusalem in Jewry.

verses.raw: If therefore there be any of you that are of his people, let Yahuah (God), even his Elohim (God), be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem that is in Judea, and build the house of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel): for he is Yahuah (God) that dwells in Jerusalem.
verses.text: If therefore there be any of you that are of his people, let Yahuah, even his Elohim, be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem that is in Judea, and build the house of Yahuah of Yashar'el: for he is Yahuah that dwells in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Whoever then dwell in the places about, let them help him, those, I say, that are his neighbours, with gold, and with silver,
verses.text: Whoever then dwell in the places about, let them help him, those, I say, that are his neighbours, with gold, and with silver,

verses.raw: With gifts, with horses, and with cattle, and other things, which have been set forth by vow, for the temple of Yahuah (God) at Jerusalem.
verses.text: With gifts, with horses, and with cattle, and other things, which have been set forth by vow, for the temple of Yahuah at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then the chief of the families of Judea and of the tribe of Benjamin stood up; the priests also, and the Levites, and all they whose mind Yahuah (God) had moved to go up, and to build an house for Yahuah (God) at Jerusalem,
verses.text: Then the chief of the families of Judea and of the tribe of Benjamin stood up; the priests also, and the Levites, and all they whose mind Yahuah had moved to go up, and to build an house for Yahuah at Jerusalem,

verses.raw: And they that dwelt round about them, and helped them in all things with silver and gold, with horses and cattle, and with very many free gifts of a great number whose minds were stirred up to it.
verses.text: And they that dwelt round about them, and helped them in all things with silver and gold, with horses and cattle, and with very many free gifts of a great number whose minds were stirred up to it.

verses.raw: King Cyrus also brought forth the holy vessels, which Nabuchodonosor had carried away from Jerusalem, and had set up in his temple of idols.
verses.text: King Cyrus also brought forth the holy vessels, which Nabuchodonosor had carried away from Jerusalem, and had set up in his temple of idols.

verses.raw: Now when Cyrus king of the Persians had brought them forth, he delivered them to Mithridates his treasurer:
verses.text: Now when Cyrus king of the Persians had brought them forth, he delivered them to Mithridates his treasurer:

verses.raw: And by him they were delivered to Sanabassar the governor of Judea.
verses.text: And by him they were delivered to Sanabassar the governor of Judea.

verses.raw: And this was the number of them; A thousand golden cups, and a thousand of silver, censers of silver twenty nine, vials of gold thirty, and of silver two thousand four hundred and ten, and a thousand other vessels.
verses.text: And this was the number of them; A thousand golden cups, and a thousand of silver, censers of silver twenty nine, vials of gold thirty, and of silver two thousand four hundred and ten, and a thousand other vessels.

verses.raw: So all the vessels of gold and of silver, which were carried away, were five thousand four hundred threescore and nine.
verses.text: So all the vessels of gold and of silver, which were carried away, were five thousand four hundred threescore and nine.

verses.raw: These were brought back by Sanabassar, together with them of the captivity, from Babylon to Jerusalem.
verses.text: These were brought back by Sanabassar, together with them of the captivity, from Babylon to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: But in the time of Artexerxes king of the Persians Belemus, and Mithridates, and Tabellius, and Rathumus, and Beeltethmus, and Semellius the secretary, with others that were in commission with them, dwelling in Samaria and other places, wrote to him against them that dwelt in Judea and Jerusalem these letters following;
verses.text: But in the time of Artexerxes king of the Persians Belemus, and Mithridates, and Tabellius, and Rathumus, and Beeltethmus, and Semellius the secretary, with others that were in commission with them, dwelling in Samaria and other places, wrote to him against them that dwelt in Judea and Jerusalem these letters following;

verses.raw: To king Artexerxes our lord, Your servants, Rathumus the storywriter, and Semellius the scribe, and the rest of their council, and the judges that are in Celosyria and Phenice.
verses.text: To king Artexerxes our lord, Your servants, Rathumus the storywriter, and Semellius the scribe, and the rest of their council, and the judges that are in Celosyria and Phenice.

verses.raw: Be it now known to the lord king, that the Yahudim (Jews) that are up from you to us, being come into Jerusalem, that rebellious and wicked city, do build the marketplaces, and repair the walls of it and do lay the foundation of the temple.
verses.text: Be it now known to the lord king, that the Yahudim that are up from you to us, being come into Jerusalem, that rebellious and wicked city, do build the marketplaces, and repair the walls of it and do lay the foundation of the temple.

verses.raw: Now if this city and the walls thereof be made up again, they will not only refuse to give tribute, but also rebel against kings.
verses.text: Now if this city and the walls thereof be made up again, they will not only refuse to give tribute, but also rebel against kings.

verses.raw: And forasmuch as the things pertaining to the temple are now in hand, we think it meet not to neglect such a matter,
verses.text: And forasmuch as the things pertaining to the temple are now in hand, we think it meet not to neglect such a matter,

verses.raw: But to speak to our lord the king, to the intent that, if it be your pleasure it may be sought out in the books of your fathers:
verses.text: But to speak to our lord the king, to the intent that, if it be your pleasure it may be sought out in the books of your fathers:

verses.raw: And you shall find in the chronicles what is written concerning these things, and shall understand that that city was rebellious, troubling both kings and cities:
verses.text: And you shall find in the chronicles what is written concerning these things, and shall understand that that city was rebellious, troubling both kings and cities:

verses.raw: And that the Yahudim (Jews) were rebellious, and raised always wars in it; for the which cause even this city was made desolate.
verses.text: And that the Yahudim were rebellious, and raised always wars in it; for the which cause even this city was made desolate.

verses.raw: Wherefore now we do declare to you, O lord the king, that if this city be built again, and the walls thereof set up anew, you shall from henceforth have no passage into Celosyria and Phenice.
verses.text: Wherefore now we do declare to you, O lord the king, that if this city be built again, and the walls thereof set up anew, you shall from henceforth have no passage into Celosyria and Phenice.

verses.raw: Then the king wrote back again to Rathumus the storywriter, to Beeltethmus, to Semellius the scribe, and to the rest that were in commission, and dwellers in Samaria and Syria and Phenice, after this manner;
verses.text: Then the king wrote back again to Rathumus the storywriter, to Beeltethmus, to Semellius the scribe, and to the rest that were in commission, and dwellers in Samaria and Syria and Phenice, after this manner;

verses.raw: I have read the epistle which you have sent to me: therefore I commanded to make diligent search, and it has been found that that city was from the beginning practising against kings;
verses.text: I have read the epistle which you have sent to me: therefore I commanded to make diligent search, and it has been found that that city was from the beginning practising against kings;

verses.raw: And the men in it were given to rebellion and war: and that mighty kings and fierce were in Jerusalem, who reigned and exacted tributes in Celosyria and Phenice.
verses.text: And the men in it were given to rebellion and war: and that mighty kings and fierce were in Jerusalem, who reigned and exacted tributes in Celosyria and Phenice.

verses.raw: Now therefore I have commanded to hinder those men from building the city, and heed to be taken that there be no more done in it;
verses.text: Now therefore I have commanded to hinder those men from building the city, and heed to be taken that there be no more done in it;

verses.raw: And that those wicked workers proceed no further to the annoyance of kings,
verses.text: And that those wicked workers proceed no further to the annoyance of kings,

verses.raw: Then king Artexerxes his letters being read, Rathumus, and Semellius the scribe, and the rest that were in commission with them, removing in haste toward Jerusalem with a troop of horsemen and a multitude of people in battle array, began to hinder the builders; and the building of the temple in Jerusalem ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians. ⸻
verses.text: Then king Artexerxes his letters being read, Rathumus, and Semellius the scribe, and the rest that were in commission with them, removing in haste toward Jerusalem with a troop of horsemen and a multitude of people in battle array, began to hinder the builders; and the building of the temple in Jerusalem ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians. ⸻

verses.raw: Now when Darius reigned, he made a great feast to all his subjects, and to all his household, and to all the princes of Media and Persia,
verses.text: Now when Darius reigned, he made a great feast to all his subjects, and to all his household, and to all the princes of Media and Persia,

verses.raw: And to all the governors and captains and lieutenants that were under him, from India to Ethiopia, of an hundred twenty and seven provinces.
verses.text: And to all the governors and captains and lieutenants that were under him, from India to Ethiopia, of an hundred twenty and seven provinces.

verses.raw: And when they had eaten and drunken, and being satisfied were gone home, then Darius the king went into his bedchamber, and slept, and soon after awaked.
verses.text: And when they had eaten and drunken, and being satisfied were gone home, then Darius the king went into his bedchamber, and slept, and soon after awaked.

verses.raw: Then three young men, that were of the guard that kept the king’s body, spoke one to another;
verses.text: Then three young men, that were of the guard that kept the king’s body, spoke one to another;

verses.raw: Let every one of us speak a sentence: he that shall overcome, and whose sentence shall seem wiser than the others, to him shall the king Darius give great gifts, and great things in token of victory:
verses.text: Let every one of us speak a sentence: he that shall overcome, and whose sentence shall seem wiser than the others, to him shall the king Darius give great gifts, and great things in token of victory:

verses.raw: As, to be clothed in purple, to drink in gold, and to sleep upon gold, and a chariot with bridles of gold, and an headtire of fine linen, and a chain about his neck:
verses.text: As, to be clothed in purple, to drink in gold, and to sleep upon gold, and a chariot with bridles of gold, and an headtire of fine linen, and a chain about his neck:

verses.raw: And he shall sit next to Darius because of his wisdom, and shall be called Darius his cousin.
verses.text: And he shall sit next to Darius because of his wisdom, and shall be called Darius his cousin.

verses.raw: And then every one wrote his sentence, sealed it, and laid it under king Darius his pillow;
verses.text: And then every one wrote his sentence, sealed it, and laid it under king Darius his pillow;

verses.raw: And said that, when the king is risen, some will give him the writings; and of whose side the king and the three princes of Persia shall judge that his sentence is the wisest, to him shall the victory be given, as was appointed.
verses.text: And said that, when the king is risen, some will give him the writings; and of whose side the king and the three princes of Persia shall judge that his sentence is the wisest, to him shall the victory be given, as was appointed.

verses.raw: The first wrote, Wine is the strongest.
verses.text: The first wrote, Wine is the strongest.

verses.raw: The second wrote, The king is strongest.
verses.text: The second wrote, The king is strongest.

verses.raw: The third wrote, Women are strongest: but above all things Truth bears away the victory.
verses.text: The third wrote, Women are strongest: but above all things Truth bears away the victory.

verses.raw: Now when the king was risen up, they took their writings, and delivered them to him, and so he read them:
verses.text: Now when the king was risen up, they took their writings, and delivered them to him, and so he read them:

verses.raw: And sending forth he called all the princes of Persia and Media, and the governors, and the captains, and the lieutenants, and the chief officers;
verses.text: And sending forth he called all the princes of Persia and Media, and the governors, and the captains, and the lieutenants, and the chief officers;

verses.raw: And sat him down in the royal seat of judgment; and the writings were read before them.
verses.text: And sat him down in the royal seat of judgment; and the writings were read before them.

verses.raw: And he said, Call the young men, and they shall declare their own sentences. So they were called, and came in.
verses.text: And he said, Call the young men, and they shall declare their own sentences. So they were called, and came in.

verses.raw: And he said to them, Declare to us your mind concerning the writings. Then began the first, who had spoken of the strength of wine;
verses.text: And he said to them, Declare to us your mind concerning the writings. Then began the first, who had spoken of the strength of wine;

verses.raw: And he said thus, O you men, how exceeding strong is wine! it causeth all men to err that drink it:
verses.text: And he said thus, O you men, how exceeding strong is wine! it causeth all men to err that drink it:

verses.raw: It makes the mind of the king and of the fatherless child to be all one; of the bondman and of the freeman, of the poor man and of the rich:
verses.text: It makes the mind of the king and of the fatherless child to be all one; of the bondman and of the freeman, of the poor man and of the rich:

verses.raw: It turns also every thought into jollity and mirth, so that a man remembereth neither sorrow nor debt:
verses.text: It turns also every thought into jollity and mirth, so that a man remembereth neither sorrow nor debt:

verses.raw: And it makes every heart rich, so that a man remembereth neither king nor governor; and it makes to speak all things by talents:
verses.text: And it makes every heart rich, so that a man remembereth neither king nor governor; and it makes to speak all things by talents:

verses.raw: And when they are in their cups, they forget their love both to friends and brothers, and a little after draw out swords:
verses.text: And when they are in their cups, they forget their love both to friends and brothers, and a little after draw out swords:

verses.raw: But when they are from the wine, they remember not what they have done.
verses.text: But when they are from the wine, they remember not what they have done.

verses.raw: O you men, is not wine the strongest, that enforceth to do thus? And when he had so spoken, he held his peace. ⸻
verses.text: O you men, is not wine the strongest, that enforceth to do thus? And when he had so spoken, he held his peace. ⸻

verses.raw: Then the second, that had spoken of the strength of the king, began to say,
verses.text: Then the second, that had spoken of the strength of the king, began to say,

verses.raw: O you men, do not men excel in strength that bear rule over sea and land and all things in them?
verses.text: O you men, do not men excel in strength that bear rule over sea and land and all things in them?

verses.raw: But yet the king is more mighty: for he is lord of all these things, and has dominion over them; and whatsoever he commands them they do.
verses.text: But yet the king is more mighty: for he is lord of all these things, and has dominion over them; and whatsoever he commands them they do.

verses.raw: If he bid them make war the one against the other, they do it: if he send them out against the enemies, they go, and break down mountains walls and towers.
verses.text: If he bid them make war the one against the other, they do it: if he send them out against the enemies, they go, and break down mountains walls and towers.

verses.raw: They slay and are slain, and transgress not the king’s commandment: if they get the victory, they bring all to the king, as well the spoil, as all things else.
verses.text: They slay and are slain, and transgress not the king’s commandment: if they get the victory, they bring all to the king, as well the spoil, as all things else.

verses.raw: Likewise for those that are no soldiers, and have not to do with wars, but use husbundry, when they have reaped again that which they had sown, they bring it to the king, and compel one another to pay tribute to the king.
verses.text: Likewise for those that are no soldiers, and have not to do with wars, but use husbundry, when they have reaped again that which they had sown, they bring it to the king, and compel one another to pay tribute to the king.

verses.raw: And yet he is but one man: if he command to kill, they kill; if he command to spare, they spare;
verses.text: And yet he is but one man: if he command to kill, they kill; if he command to spare, they spare;

verses.raw: If he command to smite, they smite; if he command to make desolate, they make desolate; if he command to build, they build;
verses.text: If he command to smite, they smite; if he command to make desolate, they make desolate; if he command to build, they build;

verses.raw: If he command to cut down, they cut down; if he command to plant, they plant.
verses.text: If he command to cut down, they cut down; if he command to plant, they plant.

verses.raw: So all his people and his armies obey him: furthermore he lieth down, he eats and drinks, and takes his rest:
verses.text: So all his people and his armies obey him: furthermore he lieth down, he eats and drinks, and takes his rest:

verses.raw: And these keep watch round about him, neither may any one depart, and do his own business, neither disobey they him in any thing.
verses.text: And these keep watch round about him, neither may any one depart, and do his own business, neither disobey they him in any thing.

verses.raw: O you men, how should not the king be mightiest, when in such sort he is obeyed? And he held his tongue.
verses.text: O you men, how should not the king be mightiest, when in such sort he is obeyed? And he held his tongue.

verses.raw: Then the third, who had spoken of women, and of the truth, (this was Zorobabel) began to speak.
verses.text: Then the third, who had spoken of women, and of the truth, (this was Zorobabel) began to speak.

verses.raw: O you men, it is not the great king, nor the multitude of men, neither is it wine, that excelleth; who is it then that ruleth them, or has the lordship over them? are they not women?
verses.text: O you men, it is not the great king, nor the multitude of men, neither is it wine, that excelleth; who is it then that ruleth them, or has the lordship over them? are they not women?

verses.raw: Women have borne the king and all the people that bear rule by sea and land.
verses.text: Women have borne the king and all the people that bear rule by sea and land.

verses.raw: Even of them came they: and they nourished them up that planted the vineyards, from whence the wine comes.
verses.text: Even of them came they: and they nourished them up that planted the vineyards, from whence the wine comes.

verses.raw: These also make garments for men; these bring glory to men; and without women cannot men be.
verses.text: These also make garments for men; these bring glory to men; and without women cannot men be.

verses.raw: Yea, and if men have gathered together gold and silver, or any other goodly thing, do they not love a woman which is comely in favour and beauty?
verses.text: Yea, and if men have gathered together gold and silver, or any other goodly thing, do they not love a woman which is comely in favour and beauty?

verses.raw: And letting all those things go, do they not gape, and even with open mouth fix their eyes fast on her; and have not all men more desire to her than to silver or gold, or any goodly thing whatsoever?
