verses.text: And letting all those things go, do they not gape, and even with open mouth fix their eyes fast on her; and have not all men more desire to her than to silver or gold, or any goodly thing whatsoever?

verses.raw: A man leaveth his own father that brought him up, and his own country, and cleaveth to his wife.
verses.text: A man leaveth his own father that brought him up, and his own country, and cleaveth to his wife.

verses.raw: He sticketh not to spend his life with his wife. and remembereth neither father, nor mother, nor country.
verses.text: He sticketh not to spend his life with his wife. and remembereth neither father, nor mother, nor country.

verses.raw: By this also you must know that women have dominion over you: do you not labour and toil, and give and bring all to the woman?
verses.text: By this also you must know that women have dominion over you: do you not labour and toil, and give and bring all to the woman?

verses.raw: Yea, a man takes his sword, and goes his way to rob and to steal, to sail upon the sea and upon rivers;
verses.text: Yea, a man takes his sword, and goes his way to rob and to steal, to sail upon the sea and upon rivers;

verses.raw: And looketh upon a lion, and goes in the darkness; and when he has stolen, spoiled, and robbed, he brings it to his love.
verses.text: And looketh upon a lion, and goes in the darkness; and when he has stolen, spoiled, and robbed, he brings it to his love.

verses.raw: Wherefore a man loves his wife better than father or mother.
verses.text: Wherefore a man loves his wife better than father or mother.

verses.raw: Yea, many there be that have run out of their wits for women, and become servants for their sakes.
verses.text: Yea, many there be that have run out of their wits for women, and become servants for their sakes.

verses.raw: Many also have perished, have erred, and sinned, for women.
verses.text: Many also have perished, have erred, and sinned, for women.

verses.raw: And now do you not believe me? is not the king great in his power? do not all regions fear to touch him?
verses.text: And now do you not believe me? is not the king great in his power? do not all regions fear to touch him?

verses.raw: Yet did I see him and Apame the king’s concubine, the daughter of the admirable Bartacus, sitting at the right hand of the king,
verses.text: Yet did I see him and Apame the king’s concubine, the daughter of the admirable Bartacus, sitting at the right hand of the king,

verses.raw: And taking the crown from the king’s head, and setting it upon her own head; she also struck the king with her left hand.
verses.text: And taking the crown from the king’s head, and setting it upon her own head; she also struck the king with her left hand.

verses.raw: And yet for all this the king gaped and gazed upon her with open mouth: if she laughed upon him, he laughed also: but if she took any displeasure at him, the king was fain to flatter, that she might be reconciled to him again.
verses.text: And yet for all this the king gaped and gazed upon her with open mouth: if she laughed upon him, he laughed also: but if she took any displeasure at him, the king was fain to flatter, that she might be reconciled to him again.

verses.raw: O you men, how can it be but women should be strong, seeing they do thus?
verses.text: O you men, how can it be but women should be strong, seeing they do thus?

verses.raw: Then the king and the princes looked one upon another: so he began to speak of the truth.
verses.text: Then the king and the princes looked one upon another: so he began to speak of the truth.

verses.raw: O you men, are not women strong? great is the earth, high is the heaven, swift is the sun in his course, for he compasseth the heavens round about, and fetcheth his course again to his own place in one day.
verses.text: O you men, are not women strong? great is the earth, high is the heaven, swift is the sun in his course, for he compasseth the heavens round about, and fetcheth his course again to his own place in one day.

verses.raw: Is he not great that makes these things? therefore great is the truth, and stronger than all things.
verses.text: Is he not great that makes these things? therefore great is the truth, and stronger than all things.

verses.raw: All the earth cries upon the truth, and the heaven blesses it: all works shake and tremble at it, and with it is no unrighteous thing.
verses.text: All the earth cries upon the truth, and the heaven blesses it: all works shake and tremble at it, and with it is no unrighteous thing.

verses.raw: Wine is wicked, the king is wicked, women are wicked, all the children of men are wicked, and such are all their wicked works; and there is no truth in them; in their unrighteousness also they shall perish.
verses.text: Wine is wicked, the king is wicked, women are wicked, all the children of men are wicked, and such are all their wicked works; and there is no truth in them; in their unrighteousness also they shall perish.

verses.raw: As for the truth, it endureth, and is always strong; it lives and conquereth for evermore.
verses.text: As for the truth, it endureth, and is always strong; it lives and conquereth for evermore.

verses.raw: With her there is no accepting of persons or rewards; but she doeth the things that are just, and refraineth from all unjust and wicked things; and all men do well like of her works.
verses.text: With her there is no accepting of persons or rewards; but she doeth the things that are just, and refraineth from all unjust and wicked things; and all men do well like of her works.

verses.raw: Neither in her judgment is any unrighteousness; and she is the strength, kingdom, power, and majesty, of all ages. Blessed be Yahuah (God) of truth.
verses.text: Neither in her judgment is any unrighteousness; and she is the strength, kingdom, power, and majesty, of all ages. Blessed be Yahuah of truth.

verses.raw: And with that he held his peace. And all the people then shouted, and said, Great is Truth, and mighty above all things.
verses.text: And with that he held his peace. And all the people then shouted, and said, Great is Truth, and mighty above all things.

verses.raw: Then said the king to him, Ask what you will more than is appointed in the writing, and we will give it you, because you are found wisest; and you shall sit next me, and shall be called my cousin.
verses.text: Then said the king to him, Ask what you will more than is appointed in the writing, and we will give it you, because you are found wisest; and you shall sit next me, and shall be called my cousin.

verses.raw: Then said he to the king, Remember your vow, which you have vowed to build Jerusalem, in the day when you camest to your kingdom,
verses.text: Then said he to the king, Remember your vow, which you have vowed to build Jerusalem, in the day when you camest to your kingdom,

verses.raw: And to send away all the vessels that were taken away out of Jerusalem, which Cyrus set apart, when he vowed to destroy Babylon, and to send them again thither.
verses.text: And to send away all the vessels that were taken away out of Jerusalem, which Cyrus set apart, when he vowed to destroy Babylon, and to send them again thither.

verses.raw: You also have vowed to build up the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldees.
verses.text: You also have vowed to build up the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldees.

verses.raw: And now, O lord the king, this is that which I require, and which I desire of you, and this is the princely liberality proceeding from thyself: I desire therefore that you make good the vow, the performance of which with your own mouth you have vowed to the King of heaven.
verses.text: And now, O lord the king, this is that which I require, and which I desire of you, and this is the princely liberality proceeding from thyself: I desire therefore that you make good the vow, the performance of which with your own mouth you have vowed to the King of heaven.

verses.raw: Then Darius the king stood up, and kissed him, and wrote letters for him to all the treasurers and lieutenants and captains and governors, that they should safely convey on their way both him, and all those that go up with him to build Jerusalem.
verses.text: Then Darius the king stood up, and kissed him, and wrote letters for him to all the treasurers and lieutenants and captains and governors, that they should safely convey on their way both him, and all those that go up with him to build Jerusalem.

verses.raw: He wrote letters also to the lieutenants that were in Celosyria and Phenice, and to them in Libanus, that they should bring cedar wood from Libanus to Jerusalem, and that they should build the city with him.
verses.text: He wrote letters also to the lieutenants that were in Celosyria and Phenice, and to them in Libanus, that they should bring cedar wood from Libanus to Jerusalem, and that they should build the city with him.

verses.raw: Moreover he wrote for all the Yahudim (Jews) that went out of his realm up into Jewry, concerning their freedom, that no officer, no ruler, no lieutenant, nor treasurer, should forcibly enter into their doors;
verses.text: Moreover he wrote for all the Yahudim that went out of his realm up into Jewry, concerning their freedom, that no officer, no ruler, no lieutenant, nor treasurer, should forcibly enter into their doors;

verses.raw: And that all the country which they hold should be free without tribute; and that the Edomites should give over the villages of the Yahudim (Jews) which then they held:
verses.text: And that all the country which they hold should be free without tribute; and that the Edomites should give over the villages of the Yahudim which then they held:

verses.raw: Yea, that there should be yearly given twenty talents to the building of the temple, until the time that it were built;
verses.text: Yea, that there should be yearly given twenty talents to the building of the temple, until the time that it were built;

verses.raw: And other ten talents yearly, to maintain the burnt offerings upon the altar every day, as they had a commandment to offer seventeen:
verses.text: And other ten talents yearly, to maintain the burnt offerings upon the altar every day, as they had a commandment to offer seventeen:

verses.raw: And that all they that went from Babylon to build the city should have free liberty, as well they as their posterity, and all the priests that went away.
verses.text: And that all they that went from Babylon to build the city should have free liberty, as well they as their posterity, and all the priests that went away.

verses.raw: He wrote also concerning. the charges, and the priests’ vestments in which they minister;
verses.text: He wrote also concerning. the charges, and the priests’ vestments in which they minister;

verses.raw: And likewise for the charges of the Levites, to be given them until the day that the house were finished, and Jerusalem builded up.
verses.text: And likewise for the charges of the Levites, to be given them until the day that the house were finished, and Jerusalem builded up.

verses.raw: And he commanded to give to all that kept the city pensions and wages.
verses.text: And he commanded to give to all that kept the city pensions and wages.

verses.raw: He sent away also all the vessels from Babylon, that Cyrus had set apart; and all that Cyrus had given in commandment, the same charged he also to be done, and sent to Jerusalem.
verses.text: He sent away also all the vessels from Babylon, that Cyrus had set apart; and all that Cyrus had given in commandment, the same charged he also to be done, and sent to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Now when this young man was gone forth, he lifted up his face to heaven toward Jerusalem, and praised the King of heaven,
verses.text: Now when this young man was gone forth, he lifted up his face to heaven toward Jerusalem, and praised the King of heaven,

verses.raw: And said, From you comes victory, from you comes wisdom, and yours is the glory, and I am your servant.
verses.text: And said, From you comes victory, from you comes wisdom, and yours is the glory, and I am your servant.

verses.raw: Blessed art you, who have given me wisdom: for to you I give thanks, O Yahuah (God) of our fathers.
verses.text: Blessed art you, who have given me wisdom: for to you I give thanks, O Yahuah of our fathers.

verses.raw: And so he took the letters, and went out, and came to Babylon, and told it all his brothers.
verses.text: And so he took the letters, and went out, and came to Babylon, and told it all his brothers.

verses.raw: And they praised Yahuah (God) of their fathers, because he had given them freedom and liberty
verses.text: And they praised Yahuah of their fathers, because he had given them freedom and liberty

verses.raw: To go up, and to build Jerusalem, and the temple which is called by his name: and they feasted with instruments of musick and gladness seven days. ⸻
verses.text: To go up, and to build Jerusalem, and the temple which is called by his name: and they feasted with instruments of musick and gladness seven days. ⸻

verses.raw: After this were the principal men of the families chosen according to their tribes, to go up with their wives and sons and daughters, with their menservants and maidservants, and their cattle.
verses.text: After this were the principal men of the families chosen according to their tribes, to go up with their wives and sons and daughters, with their menservants and maidservants, and their cattle.

verses.raw: And Darius sent with them a thousand horsemen, till they had brought them back to Jerusalem safely, and with musical instruments tabrets and flutes.
verses.text: And Darius sent with them a thousand horsemen, till they had brought them back to Jerusalem safely, and with musical instruments tabrets and flutes.

verses.raw: And all their brothers played, and he made them go up together with them.
verses.text: And all their brothers played, and he made them go up together with them.

verses.raw: And these are the names of the men which went up, according to their families among their tribes, after their several heads.
verses.text: And these are the names of the men which went up, according to their families among their tribes, after their several heads.

verses.raw: The priests, the sons of Phinees the son of Aaron: Jesus the son of Josedec, the son of Saraias, and Joacim the son of Zorobabel, the son of Salathiel, of the house of David, out of the kindred of Phares, of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah);
verses.text: The priests, the sons of Phinees the son of Aaron: Jesus the son of Josedec, the son of Saraias, and Joacim the son of Zorobabel, the son of Salathiel, of the house of David, out of the kindred of Phares, of the tribe of Yahudah;

verses.raw: Who spoke wise sentences before Darius the king of Persia in the second year of his reign, in the month Nisan, which is the first month.
verses.text: Who spoke wise sentences before Darius the king of Persia in the second year of his reign, in the month Nisan, which is the first month.

verses.raw: And these are they of Jewry that came up from the captivity, where they dwelt as strangers, whom Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon.
verses.text: And these are they of Jewry that came up from the captivity, where they dwelt as strangers, whom Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon.

verses.raw: And they returned to Jerusalem, and to the other parts of Jewry, every man to his own city, who came with Zorobabel, with Jesus, Nehemias, and Zacharias, and Reesaias, Enenius, Mardocheus. Beelsarus, Aspharasus, Reelius, Roimus, and Baana, their guides.
verses.text: And they returned to Jerusalem, and to the other parts of Jewry, every man to his own city, who came with Zorobabel, with Jesus, Nehemias, and Zacharias, and Reesaias, Enenius, Mardocheus. Beelsarus, Aspharasus, Reelius, Roimus, and Baana, their guides.

verses.raw: The number of them of the nation, and their governors, sons of Phoros, two thousand an hundred seventy and two; the sons of Saphat, four hundred seventy and two:
verses.text: The number of them of the nation, and their governors, sons of Phoros, two thousand an hundred seventy and two; the sons of Saphat, four hundred seventy and two:

verses.raw: The sons of Ares, seven hundred fifty and six:
verses.text: The sons of Ares, seven hundred fifty and six:

verses.raw: The sons of Phaath Moab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve:
verses.text: The sons of Phaath Moab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve:

verses.text: The sons of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four: the sons of Zathul, nine hundred forty and five: the sons of Corbe, seven hundred and five: the sons of Bani, six hundred forty and eight:

verses.text: The sons of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three: the sons of Sadas, three thousand two hundred twenty and two:

verses.text: The sons of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and seven: the sons of Bagoi, two thousand sixty and six: the sons of Adin, four hundred fifty and four:

verses.text: The sons of Aterezias, ninety and two: the sons of Ceilan and Azetas threescore and seven: the sons of Azuran, four hundred thirty and two:

verses.text: The sons of Ananias, an hundred and one: the sons of Arom, thirty two: and the sons of Bassa, three hundred twenty and three: the sons of Azephurith, an hundred and two:

verses.text: The sons of Meterus, three thousand and five: the sons of Bethlomon, an hundred twenty and three:

verses.text: They of Netophah, fifty and five: they of Anathoth, an hundred fifty and eight: they of Bethsamos, forty and two:

verses.text: They of Kiriathiarius, twenty and five: they of Caphira and Beroth, seven hundred forty and three: they of Pira, seven hundred:

verses.text: They of Chadias and Ammidoi, four hundred twenty and two: they of Cirama and Gabdes, six hundred twenty and one:

verses.text: They of Macalon, an hundred twenty and two: they of Betolius, fifty and two: the sons of Nephis, an hundred fifty and six:

verses.text: The sons of Calamolalus and Onus, seven hundred twenty and five: the sons of Jerechus, two hundred forty and five:

verses.text: The sons of Annas, three thousand three hundred and thirty.

verses.text: The priests: the sons of Jeddu, the son of Jesus among the sons of Sanasib, nine hundred seventy and two: the sons of Meruth, a thousand fifty and two:

verses.text: The sons of Phassaron, a thousand forty and seven: the sons of Carme, a thousand and seventeen.

verses.text: The Levites: the sons of Jessue, and Cadmiel, and Banuas, and Sudias, seventy and four.

verses.text: The holy singers: the sons of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.

verses.text: The porters: the sons of Salum, the sons of Jatal, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Dacobi, the sons of Teta, the sons of Sami, in all an hundred thirty and nine.

verses.text: All the ministers of the temple, and the sons of the servants of Solomon, were three hundred seventy and two.

verses.raw: These came up from Thermeleth and Thelersas, Charaathalar leading them, and Aalar;
verses.text: These came up from Thermeleth and Thelersas, Charaathalar leading them, and Aalar;

verses.raw: Neither could they shew their families, nor their stock, how they were of Yashar'el (Israel): the sons of Ladan, the son of Ban, the sons of Necodan, six hundred fifty and two.
verses.text: Neither could they shew their families, nor their stock, how they were of Yashar'el: the sons of Ladan, the son of Ban, the sons of Necodan, six hundred fifty and two.

verses.raw: And of the priests that usurped the office of the priesthood, and were not found: the sons of Obdia, the sons of Accoz, the sons of Addus, who married Augia one of the daughters of Barzelus, and was named after his name.
verses.text: And of the priests that usurped the office of the priesthood, and were not found: the sons of Obdia, the sons of Accoz, the sons of Addus, who married Augia one of the daughters of Barzelus, and was named after his name.

verses.raw: And when the description of the kindred of these men was sought in the register, and was not found, they were removed from executing the office of the priesthood:
verses.text: And when the description of the kindred of these men was sought in the register, and was not found, they were removed from executing the office of the priesthood:

verses.raw: For to them said Nehemias and Atharias, that they should not be partakers of the holy things, till there arose up an high priest clothed with doctrine and truth.
verses.text: For to them said Nehemias and Atharias, that they should not be partakers of the holy things, till there arose up an high priest clothed with doctrine and truth.

verses.raw: So of Yashar'el (Israel), from them of twelve years old and upward, they were all in number forty thousand, beside menservants and womenservants two thousand three hundred and sixty.
verses.text: So of Yashar'el, from them of twelve years old and upward, they were all in number forty thousand, beside menservants and womenservants two thousand three hundred and sixty.

verses.raw: Their menservants and handmaids were seven thousand three hundred forty and seven: the singing men and singing women, two hundred forty and five:
verses.text: Their menservants and handmaids were seven thousand three hundred forty and seven: the singing men and singing women, two hundred forty and five:

verses.raw: Four hundred thirty and five camels, seven thousand thirty and six horses, two hundred forty and five mules, five thousand five hundred twenty and five beasts used to the yoke.
verses.text: Four hundred thirty and five camels, seven thousand thirty and six horses, two hundred forty and five mules, five thousand five hundred twenty and five beasts used to the yoke.

verses.raw: And certain of the chief of their families, when they came to the temple of Yahuah (God) that is in Jerusalem, vowed to set up the house again in his own place according to their ability,
verses.text: And certain of the chief of their families, when they came to the temple of Yahuah that is in Jerusalem, vowed to set up the house again in his own place according to their ability,

verses.raw: And to give into the holy treasury of the works a thousand pounds of gold, five thousand of silver, and an hundred priestly vestments.
verses.text: And to give into the holy treasury of the works a thousand pounds of gold, five thousand of silver, and an hundred priestly vestments.

verses.raw: And so dwelt the priests and the Levites and the people in Jerusalem, and in the country, the singers also and the porters; and all Yashar'el (Israel) in their villages.
verses.text: And so dwelt the priests and the Levites and the people in Jerusalem, and in the country, the singers also and the porters; and all Yashar'el in their villages.

verses.raw: But when the seventh month was at hand, and when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were every man in his own place, they came all together with one consent into the open place of the first gate which is toward the east.
verses.text: But when the seventh month was at hand, and when the children of Yashar'el were every man in his own place, they came all together with one consent into the open place of the first gate which is toward the east.

verses.raw: Then stood up Jesus the son of Josedec, and his brothers the priests and Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and his brothers, and made ready the altar of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel),
verses.text: Then stood up Jesus the son of Josedec, and his brothers the priests and Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and his brothers, and made ready the altar of Yahuah of Yashar'el,

verses.raw: To offer burnt sacrifices upon it, according as it is expressly commanded in the book of Moses the man of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: To offer burnt sacrifices upon it, according as it is expressly commanded in the book of Moses the man of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And there were gathered to them out of the other nations of the land, and they erected the altar upon his own place, because all the nations of the land were at enmity with them, and oppressed them; and they offered sacrifices according to the time, and burnt offerings to Yahuah (God) both morning and evening.
verses.text: And there were gathered to them out of the other nations of the land, and they erected the altar upon his own place, because all the nations of the land were at enmity with them, and oppressed them; and they offered sacrifices according to the time, and burnt offerings to Yahuah both morning and evening.

verses.raw: Also they held the feast of tabernacles, as it is commanded in the law, and offered sacrifices daily, as was meet:
verses.text: Also they held the feast of tabernacles, as it is commanded in the law, and offered sacrifices daily, as was meet:

verses.raw: And after that, the continual oblations, and the sacrifice of the sabbaths, and of the new moons, and of all holy feasts.
verses.text: And after that, the continual oblations, and the sacrifice of the sabbaths, and of the new moons, and of all holy feasts.

verses.raw: And all they that had made any vow to Yahuah (God) began to offer sacrifices to Yahuah (God) from the first day of the seventh month, although the temple of Yahuah (God) was not yet built.
verses.text: And all they that had made any vow to Yahuah began to offer sacrifices to Yahuah from the first day of the seventh month, although the temple of Yahuah was not yet built.

verses.raw: And they gave to the masons and carpenters money, meat, and drink, with cheerfulness.
verses.text: And they gave to the masons and carpenters money, meat, and drink, with cheerfulness.

verses.raw: To them of Zidon also and Tyre they gave carrs, that they should bring cedar trees from Libanus, which should be brought by floats to the haven of Joppa, according as it was commanded them by Cyrus king of the Persians.
verses.text: To them of Zidon also and Tyre they gave carrs, that they should bring cedar trees from Libanus, which should be brought by floats to the haven of Joppa, according as it was commanded them by Cyrus king of the Persians.

verses.raw: And in the second year and second month after his coming to the temple of Yahuah (God) at Jerusalem began Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec, and their brothers, and the priests, and the Levites, and all they that were come to Jerusalem out of the captivity:
verses.text: And in the second year and second month after his coming to the temple of Yahuah at Jerusalem began Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec, and their brothers, and the priests, and the Levites, and all they that were come to Jerusalem out of the captivity:

verses.raw: And they laid the foundation of the house of Yahuah (God) in the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come to Jewry and Jerusalem.
verses.text: And they laid the foundation of the house of Yahuah in the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come to Jewry and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And they appointed the Levites from twenty years old over the works of Yahuah (God). Then stood up Jesus, and his sons and brothers, and Cadmiel his brother, and the sons of Madiabun, with the sons of Joda the son of Eliadun, with their sons and brothers, all Levites, with one accord setters forward of the business, labouring to advance the works in the house of Yahuah (God). So the workmen built the temple of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And they appointed the Levites from twenty years old over the works of Yahuah. Then stood up Jesus, and his sons and brothers, and Cadmiel his brother, and the sons of Madiabun, with the sons of Joda the son of Eliadun, with their sons and brothers, all Levites, with one accord setters forward of the business, labouring to advance the works in the house of Yahuah. So the workmen built the temple of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the priests stood arrayed in their vestments with musical instruments and trumpets; and the Levites the sons of Asaph had cymbals,
verses.text: And the priests stood arrayed in their vestments with musical instruments and trumpets; and the Levites the sons of Asaph had cymbals,

verses.raw: Singing songs of thanksgiving, and praising Yahuah (God), according as David the king of Yashar'el (Israel) had ordained.
verses.text: Singing songs of thanksgiving, and praising Yahuah, according as David the king of Yashar'el had ordained.

verses.raw: And they sung with loud voices songs to the praise of Yahuah (God), because his mercy and glory is for ever in all Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they sung with loud voices songs to the praise of Yahuah, because his mercy and glory is for ever in all Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And all the people sounded trumpets, and shouted with a loud voice, singing songs of thanksgiving to Yahuah (God) for the rearing up of the house of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And all the people sounded trumpets, and shouted with a loud voice, singing songs of thanksgiving to Yahuah for the rearing up of the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also of the priests and Levites, and of the chief of their families, the ancients who had seen the former house came to the building of this with weeping and great crying.
verses.text: Also of the priests and Levites, and of the chief of their families, the ancients who had seen the former house came to the building of this with weeping and great crying.

verses.raw: But many with trumpets and joy shouted with loud voice,
verses.text: But many with trumpets and joy shouted with loud voice,

verses.raw: Insomuch that the trumpets might not be heard for the weeping of the people: yet the multitude sounded marvellously, so that it was heard afar off.
verses.text: Insomuch that the trumpets might not be heard for the weeping of the people: yet the multitude sounded marvellously, so that it was heard afar off.

verses.raw: Wherefore when the enemies of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin heard it, they came to know what that noise of trumpets should mean.
verses.text: Wherefore when the enemies of the tribe of Yahudah and Benjamin heard it, they came to know what that noise of trumpets should mean.

verses.raw: And they perceived that they that were of the captivity did build the temple to Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they perceived that they that were of the captivity did build the temple to Yahuah of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So they went to Zorobabel and Jesus, and to the chief of the families, and said to them, We will build together with you.
verses.text: So they went to Zorobabel and Jesus, and to the chief of the families, and said to them, We will build together with you.

verses.raw: For we likewise, as you, do obey your Elohim (God), and do sacrifice to him from the days of Azbazareth the king of the Assyrians, who brought us hither.
verses.text: For we likewise, as you, do obey your Elohim, and do sacrifice to him from the days of Azbazareth the king of the Assyrians, who brought us hither.

verses.raw: Then Zorobabel and Jesus and the chief of the families of Yashar'el (Israel) said to them, It is not for us and you to build together an house to Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God).
verses.text: Then Zorobabel and Jesus and the chief of the families of Yashar'el said to them, It is not for us and you to build together an house to Yahuah, our Elohim.

verses.raw: We ourselves alone will build to Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), according as Cyrus the king of the Persians has commanded us.
verses.text: We ourselves alone will build to Yahuah of Yashar'el, according as Cyrus the king of the Persians has commanded us.

verses.raw: But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building;
verses.text: But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building;

verses.raw: And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius. ⸻
verses.text: And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius. ⸻

verses.raw: Now in the second year of the reign of Darius Aggeus and Zacharias the son of Addo, the prophets, prophesied to the Yahudim (Jews) in Jewry and Jerusalem in the name of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), which was upon them.
verses.text: Now in the second year of the reign of Darius Aggeus and Zacharias the son of Addo, the prophets, prophesied to the Yahudim in Jewry and Jerusalem in the name of Yahuah of Yashar'el, which was upon them.

verses.raw: Then stood up Zorobabel the son of Salatiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec, and began to build the house of Yahuah (God) at Jerusalem, the prophets of Yahuah (God) being with them, and helping them.
verses.text: Then stood up Zorobabel the son of Salatiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec, and began to build the house of Yahuah at Jerusalem, the prophets of Yahuah being with them, and helping them.

verses.raw: At the same time came to them Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phenice, with Sathrabuzanes and his companions, and said to them,
verses.text: At the same time came to them Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phenice, with Sathrabuzanes and his companions, and said to them,

verses.raw: By whose appointment do you build this house and this roof, and perform all the other things? and who are the workmen that perform these things?
verses.text: By whose appointment do you build this house and this roof, and perform all the other things? and who are the workmen that perform these things?

verses.raw: Nevertheless the elders of the Yahudim (Jews) obtained favour, because Yahuah (God) had visited the captivity;
verses.text: Nevertheless the elders of the Yahudim obtained favour, because Yahuah had visited the captivity;

verses.raw: And they were not hindered from building, until such time as signification was given to Darius concerning them, and an answer received.
verses.text: And they were not hindered from building, until such time as signification was given to Darius concerning them, and an answer received.

verses.raw: The copy of the letters which Sisinnes, governor of Syria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions, rulers in Syria and Phenice, wrote and sent to Darius; To king Darius, greeting:
verses.text: The copy of the letters which Sisinnes, governor of Syria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions, rulers in Syria and Phenice, wrote and sent to Darius; To king Darius, greeting:

verses.raw: Let all things be known to our lord the king, that being come into the country of Judea, and entered into the city of Jerusalem we found in the city of Jerusalem the ancients of the Yahudim (Jews) that were of the captivity
verses.text: Let all things be known to our lord the king, that being come into the country of Judea, and entered into the city of Jerusalem we found in the city of Jerusalem the ancients of the Yahudim that were of the captivity

verses.raw: Building an house to Yahuah (God), great and new, of hewn and costly stones, and the timber already laid upon the walls.
verses.text: Building an house to Yahuah, great and new, of hewn and costly stones, and the timber already laid upon the walls.

verses.raw: And those works are done with great speed, and the work goes on prosperously in their hands, and with all glory and diligence is it made.
verses.text: And those works are done with great speed, and the work goes on prosperously in their hands, and with all glory and diligence is it made.

verses.raw: Then asked we these elders, saying, By whose commandment build you this house, and lay the foundations of these works?
verses.text: Then asked we these elders, saying, By whose commandment build you this house, and lay the foundations of these works?

verses.raw: Therefore to the intent that we might give knowledge to you by writing, we demanded of them who were the chief doers, and we required of them the names in writing of their principal men.
verses.text: Therefore to the intent that we might give knowledge to you by writing, we demanded of them who were the chief doers, and we required of them the names in writing of their principal men.

verses.raw: So they gave us this answer, We are the servants of Yahuah (God) which made heaven and earth.
verses.text: So they gave us this answer, We are the servants of Yahuah which made heaven and earth.

verses.raw: And as for this house, it was builded many years ago by a king of Yashar'el (Israel) great and strong, and was finished.
verses.text: And as for this house, it was builded many years ago by a king of Yashar'el great and strong, and was finished.

verses.raw: But when our fathers provoked Yahuah (God) to wrath, and sinned against Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) which is in heaven, he gave them over into the power of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, of the Chaldees;
verses.text: But when our fathers provoked Yahuah to wrath, and sinned against Yahuah of Yashar'el which is in heaven, he gave them over into the power of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, of the Chaldees;

verses.raw: Who pulled down the house, and burned it, and carried away the people captives to Babylon.
verses.text: Who pulled down the house, and burned it, and carried away the people captives to Babylon.

verses.raw: But in the first year that king Cyrus reigned over the country of Babylon Cyrus the king wrote to build up this house.
verses.text: But in the first year that king Cyrus reigned over the country of Babylon Cyrus the king wrote to build up this house.

verses.raw: And the holy vessels of gold and of silver, that Nabuchodonosor had carried away out of the house at Jerusalem, and had set them in his own temple those Cyrus the king brought forth again out of the temple at Babylon, and they were delivered to Zorobabel and to Sanabassarus the ruler,
verses.text: And the holy vessels of gold and of silver, that Nabuchodonosor had carried away out of the house at Jerusalem, and had set them in his own temple those Cyrus the king brought forth again out of the temple at Babylon, and they were delivered to Zorobabel and to Sanabassarus the ruler,

verses.raw: With commandment that he should carry away the same vessels, and put them in the temple at Jerusalem; and that the temple of Yahuah (God) should be built in his place.
verses.text: With commandment that he should carry away the same vessels, and put them in the temple at Jerusalem; and that the temple of Yahuah should be built in his place.

verses.raw: Then the same Sanabassarus, being come hither, laid the foundations of the house of Yahuah (God) at Jerusalem; and from that time to this being still a building, it is not yet fully ended.
verses.text: Then the same Sanabassarus, being come hither, laid the foundations of the house of Yahuah at Jerusalem; and from that time to this being still a building, it is not yet fully ended.

verses.raw: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let search be made among the records of king Cyrus:
verses.text: Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let search be made among the records of king Cyrus:

verses.raw: And if it be found that the building of the house of Yahuah (God) at Jerusalem has been done with the consent of king Cyrus, and if our lord the king be so minded, let him signify to us thereof.
verses.text: And if it be found that the building of the house of Yahuah at Jerusalem has been done with the consent of king Cyrus, and if our lord the king be so minded, let him signify to us thereof.

verses.raw: Then commanded king Darius to seek among the records at Babylon: and so at Ecbatane the palace, which is in the country of Media, there was found a roll in which these things were recorded.
verses.text: Then commanded king Darius to seek among the records at Babylon: and so at Ecbatane the palace, which is in the country of Media, there was found a roll in which these things were recorded.

verses.raw: In the first year of the reign of Cyrus king Cyrus commanded that the house of Yahuah (God) at Jerusalem should be built again, where they do sacrifice with continual fire:
verses.text: In the first year of the reign of Cyrus king Cyrus commanded that the house of Yahuah at Jerusalem should be built again, where they do sacrifice with continual fire:

verses.raw: Whose height shall be sixty cubits and the breadth sixty cubits, with three rows of hewn stones, and one row of new wood of that country; and the expences thereof to be given out of the house of king Cyrus:
verses.text: Whose height shall be sixty cubits and the breadth sixty cubits, with three rows of hewn stones, and one row of new wood of that country; and the expences thereof to be given out of the house of king Cyrus:

verses.raw: And that the holy vessels of the house of Yahuah (God), both of gold and silver, that Nabuchodonosor took out of the house at Jerusalem, and brought to Babylon, should be restored to the house at Jerusalem, and be set in the place where they were before.
verses.text: And that the holy vessels of the house of Yahuah, both of gold and silver, that Nabuchodonosor took out of the house at Jerusalem, and brought to Babylon, should be restored to the house at Jerusalem, and be set in the place where they were before.

verses.raw: And also he commanded that Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, and their companions, and those which were appointed rulers in Syria and Phenice, should be careful not to meddle with the place, but suffer Zorobabel, the servant of Yahuah (God), and governor of Judea, and the elders of the Yahudim (Jews), to build the house of Yahuah (God) in that place.
verses.text: And also he commanded that Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, and their companions, and those which were appointed rulers in Syria and Phenice, should be careful not to meddle with the place, but suffer Zorobabel, the servant of Yahuah, and governor of Judea, and the elders of the Yahudim, to build the house of Yahuah in that place.

verses.raw: I have commanded also to have it built up whole again; and that they look diligently to help those that be of the captivity of the Yahudim (Jews), till the house of Yahuah (God) be finished:
verses.text: I have commanded also to have it built up whole again; and that they look diligently to help those that be of the captivity of the Yahudim, till the house of Yahuah be finished:

verses.raw: And out of the tribute of Celosyria and Phenice a portion carefully to be given these men for the sacrifices of Yahuah (God), that is, to Zorobabel the governor, for bullocks, and rams, and lambs;
verses.text: And out of the tribute of Celosyria and Phenice a portion carefully to be given these men for the sacrifices of Yahuah, that is, to Zorobabel the governor, for bullocks, and rams, and lambs;

verses.raw: And also corn, salt, wine, and oil, and that continually every year without further question, according as the priests that be in Jerusalem shall signify to be daily spent:
verses.text: And also corn, salt, wine, and oil, and that continually every year without further question, according as the priests that be in Jerusalem shall signify to be daily spent:

verses.raw: That offerings may be made to the most high Yahuah (God) for the king and for his children, and that they may pray for their lives.
verses.text: That offerings may be made to the most high Yahuah for the king and for his children, and that they may pray for their lives.

verses.raw: And he commanded that whoever should transgress, yes, or make light of any thing afore spoken or written, out of his own house should a tree be taken, and he on it be hanged, and all his goods seized for the king.
verses.text: And he commanded that whoever should transgress, yes, or make light of any thing afore spoken or written, out of his own house should a tree be taken, and he on it be hanged, and all his goods seized for the king.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) therefore, whose name is there called upon, utterly destroy every king and nation, that stretcheth out his hand to hinder or endamage that house of Yahuah (God) in Jerusalem.
verses.text: Yahuah therefore, whose name is there called upon, utterly destroy every king and nation, that stretcheth out his hand to hinder or endamage that house of Yahuah in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: I Darius the king have ordained that according to these things it be done with diligence. ⸻
verses.text: I Darius the king have ordained that according to these things it be done with diligence. ⸻

verses.raw: Then Sisinnes the governor of Celosyria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions following the commandments of king Darius,
verses.text: Then Sisinnes the governor of Celosyria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions following the commandments of king Darius,

verses.raw: Did very carefully oversee the holy works, assisting the ancients of the Yahudim (Jews) and governors of the temple.
verses.text: Did very carefully oversee the holy works, assisting the ancients of the Yahudim and governors of the temple.

verses.raw: And so the holy works prospered, when Aggeus and Zacharias the prophets prophesied.
verses.text: And so the holy works prospered, when Aggeus and Zacharias the prophets prophesied.

verses.raw: And they finished these things by the commandment of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and with the consent of Cyrus, Darius, and Artexerxes, kings of Persia.
verses.text: And they finished these things by the commandment of Yahuah of Yashar'el, and with the consent of Cyrus, Darius, and Artexerxes, kings of Persia.

verses.raw: And thus was the holy house finished in the three and twentieth day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of Darius king of the Persians
verses.text: And thus was the holy house finished in the three and twentieth day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of Darius king of the Persians

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel), the priests, and the Levites, and others that were of the captivity, that were added to them, did according to the things written in the book of Moses.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el, the priests, and the Levites, and others that were of the captivity, that were added to them, did according to the things written in the book of Moses.

verses.raw: And to the dedication of the temple of Yahuah (God) they offered an hundred bullocks two hundred rams, four hundred lambs;
verses.text: And to the dedication of the temple of Yahuah they offered an hundred bullocks two hundred rams, four hundred lambs;

verses.raw: And twelve goats for the sin of all Yashar'el (Israel), according to the number of the chief of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And twelve goats for the sin of all Yashar'el, according to the number of the chief of the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: The priests also and the Levites stood arrayed in their vestments, according to their kindreds, in the service of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), according to the book of Moses: and the porters at every gate.
verses.text: The priests also and the Levites stood arrayed in their vestments, according to their kindreds, in the service of Yahuah of Yashar'el, according to the book of Moses: and the porters at every gate.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that were of the captivity held the passover the fourteenth day of the first month, after that the priests and the Levites were sanctified.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el that were of the captivity held the passover the fourteenth day of the first month, after that the priests and the Levites were sanctified.

verses.raw: They that were of the captivity were not all sanctified together: but the Levites were all sanctified together.
verses.text: They that were of the captivity were not all sanctified together: but the Levites were all sanctified together.

verses.raw: And so they offered the passover for all them of the captivity, and for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.
verses.text: And so they offered the passover for all them of the captivity, and for their brothers the priests, and for themselves.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that came out of the captivity did eat, even all they that had separated themselves from the abominations of the people of the land, and sought Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el that came out of the captivity did eat, even all they that had separated themselves from the abominations of the people of the land, and sought Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days, making merry before Yahuah (God),
verses.text: And they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days, making merry before Yahuah,

verses.raw: For that he had turned the counsel of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the works of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel). ⸻
verses.text: For that he had turned the counsel of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the works of Yahuah of Yashar'el. ⸻

verses.raw: And after these things, when Artexerxes the king of the Persians reigned came Esdras the son of Saraias, the son of Ezerias, the son of Helchiah, the son of Salum,
verses.text: And after these things, when Artexerxes the king of the Persians reigned came Esdras the son of Saraias, the son of Ezerias, the son of Helchiah, the son of Salum,

verses.raw: The son of Sadduc, the son of Achitob, the son of Amarias, the son of Ezias, the son of Meremoth, the son of Zaraias, the son of Savias, the son of Boccas, the son of Abisum, the son of Phinees, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest.
verses.text: The son of Sadduc, the son of Achitob, the son of Amarias, the son of Ezias, the son of Meremoth, the son of Zaraias, the son of Savias, the son of Boccas, the son of Abisum, the son of Phinees, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest.

verses.raw: This Esdras went up from Babylon, as a scribe, being very ready in the law of Moses, that was given by Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: This Esdras went up from Babylon, as a scribe, being very ready in the law of Moses, that was given by Yahuah of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And the king did him honour: for he found grace in his sight in all his requests.
verses.text: And the king did him honour: for he found grace in his sight in all his requests.

verses.raw: There went up with him also certain of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), of the priest of the Levites, of the holy singers, porters, and ministers of the temple, to Jerusalem,
verses.text: There went up with him also certain of the children of Yashar'el, of the priest of the Levites, of the holy singers, porters, and ministers of the temple, to Jerusalem,

verses.raw: In the seventh year of the reign of Artexerxes, in the fifth month, this was the king’s seventh year; for they went from Babylon in the first day of the first month, and came to Jerusalem, according to the prosperous journey which Yahuah (God) gave them.
verses.text: In the seventh year of the reign of Artexerxes, in the fifth month, this was the king’s seventh year; for they went from Babylon in the first day of the first month, and came to Jerusalem, according to the prosperous journey which Yahuah gave them.

verses.raw: For Esdras had very great skill, so that he omitted nothing of the law and commandments of Yahuah (God), but taught all Yashar'el (Israel) the ordinances and judgments.
verses.text: For Esdras had very great skill, so that he omitted nothing of the law and commandments of Yahuah, but taught all Yashar'el the ordinances and judgments.

verses.raw: Now the copy of the commission, which was written from Artexerxes the king, and came to Esdras the priest and reader of the law of Yahuah (God), is this that followeth;
verses.text: Now the copy of the commission, which was written from Artexerxes the king, and came to Esdras the priest and reader of the law of Yahuah, is this that followeth;

verses.raw: King Artexerxes to Esdras the priest and reader of the law of Yahuah (God) sends greeting:
verses.text: King Artexerxes to Esdras the priest and reader of the law of Yahuah sends greeting:

verses.raw: Having determined to deal graciously, I have given order, that such of the nation of the Yahudim (Jews), and of the priests and Levites being within our realm, as are willing and desirous should go with you to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Having determined to deal graciously, I have given order, that such of the nation of the Yahudim, and of the priests and Levites being within our realm, as are willing and desirous should go with you to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: As many therefore as have a mind to it, let them depart with you, as it has seemed good both to me and my seven friends the counsellors;
verses.text: As many therefore as have a mind to it, let them depart with you, as it has seemed good both to me and my seven friends the counsellors;

verses.raw: That they may look to the affairs of Judea and Jerusalem, agreeably to that which is in the law of Yahuah (God);
verses.text: That they may look to the affairs of Judea and Jerusalem, agreeably to that which is in the law of Yahuah;

verses.raw: And carry the gifts to Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to Jerusalem, which I and my friends have vowed, and all the gold and silver that in the country of Babylon can be found, to Yahuah (God) in Jerusalem,
verses.text: And carry the gifts to Yahuah of Yashar'el to Jerusalem, which I and my friends have vowed, and all the gold and silver that in the country of Babylon can be found, to Yahuah in Jerusalem,

verses.raw: With that also which is given of the people for the temple of Yahuah (God), their Elohim (God) at Jerusalem: and that silver and gold may be collected for bullocks, rams, and lambs, and things to it appertaining;
verses.text: With that also which is given of the people for the temple of Yahuah, their Elohim at Jerusalem: and that silver and gold may be collected for bullocks, rams, and lambs, and things to it appertaining;

verses.raw: To the end that they may offer sacrifices to Yahuah (God) upon the altar of Yahuah (God), their Elohim (God), which is in Jerusalem.
verses.text: To the end that they may offer sacrifices to Yahuah upon the altar of Yahuah, their Elohim, which is in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And whatsoever you and your brothers will do with the silver and gold, that do, according to the will of your Elohim (God).
verses.text: And whatsoever you and your brothers will do with the silver and gold, that do, according to the will of your Elohim.

verses.raw: And the holy vessels of Yahuah (God), which are given you for the use of the temple of your Elohim (God), which is in Jerusalem, you shall set before your Elohim (God) in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And the holy vessels of Yahuah, which are given you for the use of the temple of your Elohim, which is in Jerusalem, you shall set before your Elohim in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And whatsoever thing else you shall remember for the use of the temple of your Elohim (God), you shall give it out of the king’s treasury.
verses.text: And whatsoever thing else you shall remember for the use of the temple of your Elohim, you shall give it out of the king’s treasury.

verses.raw: And I king Artexerxes have also commanded the keepers of the treasures in Syria and Phenice, that whatsoever Esdras the priest and the reader of the law of the most high Yahuah (God) shall send for, they should give it him with speed,
verses.text: And I king Artexerxes have also commanded the keepers of the treasures in Syria and Phenice, that whatsoever Esdras the priest and the reader of the law of the most high Yahuah shall send for, they should give it him with speed,

verses.raw: To the sum of an hundred talents of silver, likewise also of wheat even to an hundred cors, and an hundred pieces of wine, and other things in abundance.
verses.text: To the sum of an hundred talents of silver, likewise also of wheat even to an hundred cors, and an hundred pieces of wine, and other things in abundance.

verses.raw: Let all things be performed after the law of Yahuah (God) diligently to the most high Yahuah (God), that wrath come not upon the kingdom of the king and his sons.
verses.text: Let all things be performed after the law of Yahuah diligently to the most high Yahuah, that wrath come not upon the kingdom of the king and his sons.

verses.raw: I command you also, that you require no tax, nor any other imposition, of any of the priests, or Levites, or holy singers, or porters, or ministers of the temple, or of any that have doings in this temple, and that no man have authority to impose any thing upon them.
verses.text: I command you also, that you require no tax, nor any other imposition, of any of the priests, or Levites, or holy singers, or porters, or ministers of the temple, or of any that have doings in this temple, and that no man have authority to impose any thing upon them.

verses.raw: And you, Esdras, according to the wisdom of Yahuah (God) ordain judges and justices, that they may judge in all Syria and Phenice all those that know the law of your Elohim (God); and those that know it not you shall teach.
verses.text: And you, Esdras, according to the wisdom of Yahuah ordain judges and justices, that they may judge in all Syria and Phenice all those that know the law of your Elohim; and those that know it not you shall teach.

verses.raw: And whoever shall transgress the law of your Elohim (God), and of the king, shall be punished diligently, whether it be by death, or other punishment, by penalty of money, or by imprisonment.
verses.text: And whoever shall transgress the law of your Elohim, and of the king, shall be punished diligently, whether it be by death, or other punishment, by penalty of money, or by imprisonment.

verses.raw: Then said Esdras the scribe, Blessed be the only Yahuah (God) of my fathers, who has put these things into the heart of the king, to glorify his house that is in Jerusalem:
verses.text: Then said Esdras the scribe, Blessed be the only Yahuah of my fathers, who has put these things into the heart of the king, to glorify his house that is in Jerusalem:

verses.raw: And has honoured me in the sight of the king, and his counsellors, and all his friends and nobles.
verses.text: And has honoured me in the sight of the king, and his counsellors, and all his friends and nobles.

verses.raw: Therefore was I encouraged by the help of Yahuah (God), my Elohim (God), and gathered together men of Yashar'el (Israel) to go up with me.
verses.text: Therefore was I encouraged by the help of Yahuah, my Elohim, and gathered together men of Yashar'el to go up with me.

verses.raw: And these are the chief according to their families and several dignities, that went up with me from Babylon in the reign of king Artexerxes:
verses.text: And these are the chief according to their families and several dignities, that went up with me from Babylon in the reign of king Artexerxes:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Phinees, Gerson: of the sons of Ithamar, Gamael: of the sons of David, Lettus the son of Sechenias:
verses.text: Of the sons of Phinees, Gerson: of the sons of Ithamar, Gamael: of the sons of David, Lettus the son of Sechenias:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Pharez, Zacharias; and with him were counted an hundred and fifty men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Pharez, Zacharias; and with him were counted an hundred and fifty men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Pahath Moab, Eliaonias, the son of Zaraias, and with him two hundred men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Pahath Moab, Eliaonias, the son of Zaraias, and with him two hundred men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Zathoe, Sechenias the son of Jezelus, and with him three hundred men: of the sons of Adin, Obeth the son of Jonathan, and with him two hundred and fifty men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Zathoe, Sechenias the son of Jezelus, and with him three hundred men: of the sons of Adin, Obeth the son of Jonathan, and with him two hundred and fifty men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Elam, Josias son of Gotholias, and with him seventy men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Elam, Josias son of Gotholias, and with him seventy men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Saphatias, Zaraias son of Michael, and with him threescore and ten men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Saphatias, Zaraias son of Michael, and with him threescore and ten men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Joab, Abadias son of Jezelus, and with him two hundred and twelve men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Joab, Abadias son of Jezelus, and with him two hundred and twelve men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Banid, Assalimoth son of Josaphias, and with him an hundred and threescore men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Banid, Assalimoth son of Josaphias, and with him an hundred and threescore men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Babi, Zacharias son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Babi, Zacharias son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Astath, Johannes son of Acatan, and with him an hundred and ten men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Astath, Johannes son of Acatan, and with him an hundred and ten men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Adonikam the last, and these are the names of them, Eliphalet, Jewel, and Samaias, and with them seventy men:
verses.text: Of the sons of Adonikam the last, and these are the names of them, Eliphalet, Jewel, and Samaias, and with them seventy men:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Bago, Uthi the son of Istalcurus, and with him seventy men.
verses.text: Of the sons of Bago, Uthi the son of Istalcurus, and with him seventy men.

verses.raw: And these I gathered together to the river called Theras, where we pitched our tents three days: and then I surveyed them.
verses.text: And these I gathered together to the river called Theras, where we pitched our tents three days: and then I surveyed them.

verses.raw: But when I had found there none of the priests and Levites,
verses.text: But when I had found there none of the priests and Levites,

verses.raw: Then sent I to Eleazar, and Iduel, and Masman,
verses.text: Then sent I to Eleazar, and Iduel, and Masman,

verses.raw: And Alnathan, and Mamaias, and Joribas, and Nathan, Eunatan, Zacharias, and Mosollamon, principal men and learned.
verses.text: And Alnathan, and Mamaias, and Joribas, and Nathan, Eunatan, Zacharias, and Mosollamon, principal men and learned.

verses.raw: And I told them that they should go to Saddeus the captain, who was in the place of the treasury:
verses.text: And I told them that they should go to Saddeus the captain, who was in the place of the treasury:

verses.raw: And commanded them that they should speak to Daddeus, and to his brothers, and to the treasurers in that place, to send us such men as might execute the priests’ office in the house of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And commanded them that they should speak to Daddeus, and to his brothers, and to the treasurers in that place, to send us such men as might execute the priests’ office in the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And by the mighty hand of our Elohim (God) they brought to us skilful men of the sons of Moli the son of Levi, the son of Yashar'el (Israel), Asebebia, and his sons, and his brothers, who were eighteen.
verses.text: And by the mighty hand of our Elohim they brought to us skilful men of the sons of Moli the son of Levi, the son of Yashar'el, Asebebia, and his sons, and his brothers, who were eighteen.

verses.raw: And Asebia, and Annus, and Osaias his brother, of the sons of Channuneus, and their sons, were twenty men.
verses.text: And Asebia, and Annus, and Osaias his brother, of the sons of Channuneus, and their sons, were twenty men.

verses.raw: And of the servants of the temple whom David had ordained, and the principal men for the service of the Levites to wit, the servants of the temple two hundred and twenty, the catalogue of whose names were shewed.
verses.text: And of the servants of the temple whom David had ordained, and the principal men for the service of the Levites to wit, the servants of the temple two hundred and twenty, the catalogue of whose names were shewed.

verses.raw: And there I vowed a fast to the young men before our Elohim (God), to desire of him a prosperous journey both for us and them that were with us, for our children, and for the cattle:
verses.text: And there I vowed a fast to the young men before our Elohim, to desire of him a prosperous journey both for us and them that were with us, for our children, and for the cattle:

verses.raw: For I was ashamed to ask the king footmen, and horsemen, and conduct for safeguard against our adversaries.
verses.text: For I was ashamed to ask the king footmen, and horsemen, and conduct for safeguard against our adversaries.

verses.raw: For we had said to the king, that the power of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) should be with them that seek him, to support them in all ways.
verses.text: For we had said to the king, that the power of Yahuah, our Elohim should be with them that seek him, to support them in all ways.

verses.raw: And again we besought our Elohim (God) as touching these things, and found him favourable to us.
verses.text: And again we besought our Elohim as touching these things, and found him favourable to us.

verses.raw: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Esebrias, and Assanias, and ten men of their brothers with them:
verses.text: Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Esebrias, and Assanias, and ten men of their brothers with them:

verses.raw: And I weighed them the gold, and the silver, and the holy vessels of the house of our Elohim (God), which the king, and his council, and the princes, and all Yashar'el (Israel), had given.
verses.text: And I weighed them the gold, and the silver, and the holy vessels of the house of our Elohim, which the king, and his council, and the princes, and all Yashar'el, had given.

verses.raw: And when I had weighed it, I delivered to them six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels of an hundred talents, and an hundred talents of gold,
verses.text: And when I had weighed it, I delivered to them six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels of an hundred talents, and an hundred talents of gold,

verses.raw: And twenty golden vessels, and twelve vessels of brass, even of fine brass, glittering like gold.
verses.text: And twenty golden vessels, and twelve vessels of brass, even of fine brass, glittering like gold.

verses.raw: And I said to them, Both you are holy to Yahuah (God), and the vessels are holy, and the gold and the silver is a vow to Yahuah (God), Yahuah (God) of our fathers.
verses.text: And I said to them, Both you are holy to Yahuah, and the vessels are holy, and the gold and the silver is a vow to Yahuah, Yahuah of our fathers.

verses.raw: Watch you, and keep them till you deliver them to the chief of the priests and Levites, and to the principal men of the families of Yashar'el (Israel), in Jerusalem, into the chambers of the house of our Elohim (God).
verses.text: Watch you, and keep them till you deliver them to the chief of the priests and Levites, and to the principal men of the families of Yashar'el, in Jerusalem, into the chambers of the house of our Elohim.

verses.raw: So the priests and the Levites, who had received the silver and the gold and the vessels, brought them to Jerusalem, into the temple of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: So the priests and the Levites, who had received the silver and the gold and the vessels, brought them to Jerusalem, into the temple of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And from the river Theras we departed the twelfth day of the first month, and came to Jerusalem by the mighty hand of our Elohim (God), which was with us: and from the beginning of our journey Yahuah (God) delivered us from every enemy, and so we came to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And from the river Theras we departed the twelfth day of the first month, and came to Jerusalem by the mighty hand of our Elohim, which was with us: and from the beginning of our journey Yahuah delivered us from every enemy, and so we came to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And when we had been there three days, the gold and silver that was weighed was delivered in the house of our Elohim (God) on the fourth day to Marmoth the priest the son of Iri.
verses.text: And when we had been there three days, the gold and silver that was weighed was delivered in the house of our Elohim on the fourth day to Marmoth the priest the son of Iri.

verses.raw: And with him was Eleazar the son of Phinees, and with them were Josabad the son of Jesu and Moeth the son of Sabban, Levites: all was delivered them by number and weight.
verses.text: And with him was Eleazar the son of Phinees, and with them were Josabad the son of Jesu and Moeth the son of Sabban, Levites: all was delivered them by number and weight.

verses.raw: And all the weight of them was written up the same hour.
verses.text: And all the weight of them was written up the same hour.

verses.raw: Moreover they that were come out of the captivity offered sacrifice to Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), even twelve bullocks for all Yashar'el (Israel), fourscore and sixteen rams,
verses.text: Moreover they that were come out of the captivity offered sacrifice to Yahuah of Yashar'el, even twelve bullocks for all Yashar'el, fourscore and sixteen rams,

verses.raw: Threescore and twelve lambs, goats for a peace offering, twelve; all of them a sacrifice to Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Threescore and twelve lambs, goats for a peace offering, twelve; all of them a sacrifice to Yahuah.

verses.raw: And they delivered the king’s commandments to the king’s stewards’ and to the governors of Celosyria and Phenice; and they honoured the people and the temple of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And they delivered the king’s commandments to the king’s stewards’ and to the governors of Celosyria and Phenice; and they honoured the people and the temple of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Now when these things were done, the rulers came to me, and said,
verses.text: Now when these things were done, the rulers came to me, and said,

verses.raw: The nation of Yashar'el (Israel), the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land, nor the pollutions of the Gentiles to wit, of the Canaanites, Hittites, Pheresites, Jebusites, and the Moabites, Egyptians, and Edomites.
verses.text: The nation of Yashar'el, the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land, nor the pollutions of the Gentiles to wit, of the Canaanites, Hittites, Pheresites, Jebusites, and the Moabites, Egyptians, and Edomites.

verses.raw: For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land; and from the beginning of this matter the rulers and the great men have been partakers of this iniquity.
verses.text: For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land; and from the beginning of this matter the rulers and the great men have been partakers of this iniquity.

verses.raw: And as soon as I had heard these things, I rent my clothes, and the holy garment, and pulled off the hair from off my head and beard, and sat me down sad and very heavy.
verses.text: And as soon as I had heard these things, I rent my clothes, and the holy garment, and pulled off the hair from off my head and beard, and sat me down sad and very heavy.

verses.raw: So all they that were then moved at the word of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) assembled to me, while I mourned for the iniquity: but I sat still full of heaviness until the evening sacrifice.
verses.text: So all they that were then moved at the word of Yahuah of Yashar'el assembled to me, while I mourned for the iniquity: but I sat still full of heaviness until the evening sacrifice.

verses.raw: Then rising up from the fast with my clothes and the holy garment rent, and bowing my knees, and stretching forth my hands to Yahuah (God),
verses.text: Then rising up from the fast with my clothes and the holy garment rent, and bowing my knees, and stretching forth my hands to Yahuah,

verses.raw: I said, O Yahuah (God), I am confounded and ashamed before your face;
verses.text: I said, O Yahuah, I am confounded and ashamed before your face;

verses.raw: For our sins are multiplied above our heads, and our ignorances have reached up to heaven.
verses.text: For our sins are multiplied above our heads, and our ignorances have reached up to heaven.

verses.raw: For ever since the time of our fathers we have been and are in great sin, even to this day.
verses.text: For ever since the time of our fathers we have been and are in great sin, even to this day.

verses.raw: And for our sins and our fathers’ we with our brothers and our kings and our priests were given up to the kings of the earth, to the sword, and to captivity, and for a prey with shame, to this day.
verses.text: And for our sins and our fathers’ we with our brothers and our kings and our priests were given up to the kings of the earth, to the sword, and to captivity, and for a prey with shame, to this day.

verses.raw: And now in some measure has mercy been shewed to us from you, O Yahuah (God), that there should be left us a root and a name in the place of your sanctuary;
verses.text: And now in some measure has mercy been shewed to us from you, O Yahuah, that there should be left us a root and a name in the place of your sanctuary;

verses.raw: And to discover to us a light in the house of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), and to give us food in the time of our servitude.
verses.text: And to discover to us a light in the house of Yahuah, our Elohim, and to give us food in the time of our servitude.

verses.raw: Yea, when we were in bondage, we were not forsaken of our Elohim (God); but he made us gracious before the kings of Persia, so that they gave us food;
verses.text: Yea, when we were in bondage, we were not forsaken of our Elohim; but he made us gracious before the kings of Persia, so that they gave us food;

verses.raw: Yea, and honoured the temple of our Elohim (God), and raised up the desolate Sion, that they have given us a sure abiding in Jewry and Jerusalem.
verses.text: Yea, and honoured the temple of our Elohim, and raised up the desolate Sion, that they have given us a sure abiding in Jewry and Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah (God), what shall we say, having these things? for we have transgressed your commandments, which you gavest by the hand of your servants the prophets, saying,
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah, what shall we say, having these things? for we have transgressed your commandments, which you gavest by the hand of your servants the prophets, saying,

verses.raw: That the land, which you enter into to possess as an heritage, is a land polluted with the pollutions of the strangers of the land, and they have filled it with their uncleanness.
verses.text: That the land, which you enter into to possess as an heritage, is a land polluted with the pollutions of the strangers of the land, and they have filled it with their uncleanness.

verses.raw: Therefore now shall you not join your daughters to their sons, neither shall you take their daughters to your sons.
verses.text: Therefore now shall you not join your daughters to their sons, neither shall you take their daughters to your sons.

verses.raw: Moreover you shall never seek to have peace with them, that you may be strong, and eat the good things of the land, and that you may leave the inheritance of the land to your children for evermore.
verses.text: Moreover you shall never seek to have peace with them, that you may be strong, and eat the good things of the land, and that you may leave the inheritance of the land to your children for evermore.

verses.raw: And all that is befallen is done to us for our wicked works and great sins; for you, O Yahuah (God), did make our sins light,
verses.text: And all that is befallen is done to us for our wicked works and great sins; for you, O Yahuah, did make our sins light,

verses.raw: And did give to us such a root: but we have turned back again to transgress your law, and to mingle ourselves with the uncleanness of the nations of the land.
verses.text: And did give to us such a root: but we have turned back again to transgress your law, and to mingle ourselves with the uncleanness of the nations of the land.

verses.raw: Might not you be angry with us to destroy us, till you had left us neither root, seed, nor name?
verses.text: Might not you be angry with us to destroy us, till you had left us neither root, seed, nor name?

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), you are true: for we are left a root this day.
verses.text: O Yahuah of Yashar'el, you are true: for we are left a root this day.

verses.raw: Behold, now are we before you in our iniquities, for we cannot stand any longer by reason of these things before you.
verses.text: Behold, now are we before you in our iniquities, for we cannot stand any longer by reason of these things before you.

verses.raw: And as Esdras in his prayer made his confession, weeping, and lying flat upon the ground before the temple, there gathered to him from Jerusalem a very great multitude of men and women and children: for there was great weeping among the multitude.
verses.text: And as Esdras in his prayer made his confession, weeping, and lying flat upon the ground before the temple, there gathered to him from Jerusalem a very great multitude of men and women and children: for there was great weeping among the multitude.

verses.raw: Then Jechonias the son of Jeelus, one of the sons of Yashar'el (Israel), called out, and said, O Esdras, we have sinned against Yahuah (God), we have married strange women of the nations of the land, and now is all Yashar'el (Israel) aloft.
verses.text: Then Jechonias the son of Jeelus, one of the sons of Yashar'el, called out, and said, O Esdras, we have sinned against Yahuah, we have married strange women of the nations of the land, and now is all Yashar'el aloft.

verses.raw: Let us make an oath to Yahuah (God), that we will put away all our wives, which we have taken of the heathen, with their children,
verses.text: Let us make an oath to Yahuah, that we will put away all our wives, which we have taken of the heathen, with their children,

verses.raw: Like as you have decreed, and as many as do obey the law of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Like as you have decreed, and as many as do obey the law of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Arise and put in execution: for to you does this matter appertain, and we will be with you: do valiantly.
verses.text: Arise and put in execution: for to you does this matter appertain, and we will be with you: do valiantly.

verses.raw: So Esdras arose, and took an oath of the chief of the priests and Levites of all Yashar'el (Israel) to do after these things; and so they sware. ⸻
