verses.text: So Esdras arose, and took an oath of the chief of the priests and Levites of all Yashar'el to do after these things; and so they sware. ⸻

verses.raw: Then Esdras rising from the court of the temple went to the chamber of Joanan the son of Eliasib,
verses.text: Then Esdras rising from the court of the temple went to the chamber of Joanan the son of Eliasib,

verses.raw: And remained there, and did eat no meat nor drink water, mourning for the great iniquities of the multitude.
verses.text: And remained there, and did eat no meat nor drink water, mourning for the great iniquities of the multitude.

verses.raw: And there was a proclamation in all Jewry and Jerusalem to all them that were of the captivity, that they should be gathered together at Jerusalem:
verses.text: And there was a proclamation in all Jewry and Jerusalem to all them that were of the captivity, that they should be gathered together at Jerusalem:

verses.raw: And that whoever met not there within two or three days according as the elders that bare rule appointed, their cattle should be seized to the use of the temple, and himself cast out from them that were of the captivity.
verses.text: And that whoever met not there within two or three days according as the elders that bare rule appointed, their cattle should be seized to the use of the temple, and himself cast out from them that were of the captivity.

verses.raw: And in three days were all they of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) and Benjamin gathered together at Jerusalem the twentieth day of the ninth month.
verses.text: And in three days were all they of the tribe of Yahudah and Benjamin gathered together at Jerusalem the twentieth day of the ninth month.

verses.raw: And all the multitude sat trembling in the broad court of the temple because of the present foul weather.
verses.text: And all the multitude sat trembling in the broad court of the temple because of the present foul weather.

verses.raw: So Esdras arose up, and said to them, You have transgressed the law in marrying strange wives, thereby to increase the sins of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So Esdras arose up, and said to them, You have transgressed the law in marrying strange wives, thereby to increase the sins of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And now by confessing give glory to Yahuah (God) of our fathers,
verses.text: And now by confessing give glory to Yahuah of our fathers,

verses.raw: And do his will, and separate yourselves from the heathen of the land, and from the strange women.
verses.text: And do his will, and separate yourselves from the heathen of the land, and from the strange women.

verses.raw: Then cried the whole multitude, and said with a loud voice, Like as you have spoken, so will we do.
verses.text: Then cried the whole multitude, and said with a loud voice, Like as you have spoken, so will we do.

verses.raw: But forasmuch as the people are many, and it is foul weather, so that we cannot stand without, and this is not a work of a day or two, seeing our sin in these things is spread far:
verses.text: But forasmuch as the people are many, and it is foul weather, so that we cannot stand without, and this is not a work of a day or two, seeing our sin in these things is spread far:

verses.raw: Therefore let the rulers of the multitude stay, and let all them of our habitations that have strange wives come at the time appointed,
verses.text: Therefore let the rulers of the multitude stay, and let all them of our habitations that have strange wives come at the time appointed,

verses.raw: And with them the rulers and judges of every place, till we turn away the wrath of Yahuah (God) from us for this matter.
verses.text: And with them the rulers and judges of every place, till we turn away the wrath of Yahuah from us for this matter.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan the son of Azael and Ezechias the son of Theocanus accordingly took this matter upon them: and Mosollam and Levis and Sabbatheus helped them.
verses.text: Then Jonathan the son of Azael and Ezechias the son of Theocanus accordingly took this matter upon them: and Mosollam and Levis and Sabbatheus helped them.

verses.raw: And they that were of the captivity did according to all these things.
verses.text: And they that were of the captivity did according to all these things.

verses.raw: And Esdras the priest chose to him the principal men of their families, all by name: and in the first day of the tenth month they sat together to examine the matter.
verses.text: And Esdras the priest chose to him the principal men of their families, all by name: and in the first day of the tenth month they sat together to examine the matter.

verses.raw: So their cause that held strange wives was brought to an end in the first day of the first month.
verses.text: So their cause that held strange wives was brought to an end in the first day of the first month.

verses.raw: And of the priests that were come together, and had strange wives, there were found:
verses.text: And of the priests that were come together, and had strange wives, there were found:

verses.raw: Of the sons of Jesus the son of Josedec, and his brothers; Matthelas and Eleazar, and Joribus and Joadanus.
verses.text: Of the sons of Jesus the son of Josedec, and his brothers; Matthelas and Eleazar, and Joribus and Joadanus.

verses.raw: And they gave their hands to put away their wives and to offer rams to make reconcilement for their errors.
verses.text: And they gave their hands to put away their wives and to offer rams to make reconcilement for their errors.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Emmer; Ananias, and Zabdeus, and Eanes, and Sameius, and Hiereel, and Azarias.
verses.text: And of the sons of Emmer; Ananias, and Zabdeus, and Eanes, and Sameius, and Hiereel, and Azarias.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Phaisur; Elionas, Massias Yashar'el (Israel), and Nathanael, and Ocidelus and Talsas.
verses.text: And of the sons of Phaisur; Elionas, Massias Yashar'el, and Nathanael, and Ocidelus and Talsas.

verses.raw: And of the Levites; Jozabad, and Semis, and Colius, who was called Calitas, and Patheus, and Judas, and Jonas.
verses.text: And of the Levites; Jozabad, and Semis, and Colius, who was called Calitas, and Patheus, and Judas, and Jonas.

verses.raw: Of the holy singers; Eleazurus, Bacchurus.
verses.text: Of the holy singers; Eleazurus, Bacchurus.

verses.raw: Of the porters; Sallumus, and Tolbanes.
verses.text: Of the porters; Sallumus, and Tolbanes.

verses.raw: Of them of Yashar'el (Israel), of the sons of Phoros; Hiermas, and Eddias, and Melchias, and Maelus, and Eleazar, and Asibias, and Baanias.
verses.text: Of them of Yashar'el, of the sons of Phoros; Hiermas, and Eddias, and Melchias, and Maelus, and Eleazar, and Asibias, and Baanias.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Ela; Matthanias, Zacharias, and Hierielus, and Hieremoth, and Aedias.
verses.text: Of the sons of Ela; Matthanias, Zacharias, and Hierielus, and Hieremoth, and Aedias.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Zamoth; Eliadas, Elisimus, Othonias, Jarimoth, and Sabatus, and Sardeus.
verses.text: And of the sons of Zamoth; Eliadas, Elisimus, Othonias, Jarimoth, and Sabatus, and Sardeus.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Babai; Johannes, and Ananias and Josabad, and Amatheis.
verses.text: Of the sons of Babai; Johannes, and Ananias and Josabad, and Amatheis.

verses.raw: Of the sons of Mani; Olamus, Mamuchus, Jedeus, Jasubus, Jasael, and Hieremoth.
verses.text: Of the sons of Mani; Olamus, Mamuchus, Jedeus, Jasubus, Jasael, and Hieremoth.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Addi; Naathus, and Moosias, Lacunus, and Naidus, and Mathanias, and Sesthel, Balnuus, and Manasseas.
verses.text: And of the sons of Addi; Naathus, and Moosias, Lacunus, and Naidus, and Mathanias, and Sesthel, Balnuus, and Manasseas.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Annas; Elionas and Aseas, and Melchias, and Sabbeus, and Simon Chosameus.
verses.text: And of the sons of Annas; Elionas and Aseas, and Melchias, and Sabbeus, and Simon Chosameus.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Asom; Altaneus, and Matthias, and Baanaia, Eliphalet, and Manasses, and Semei.
verses.text: And of the sons of Asom; Altaneus, and Matthias, and Baanaia, Eliphalet, and Manasses, and Semei.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Maani; Jeremias, Momdis, Omaerus, Juel, Mabdai, and Pelias, and Anos, Carabasion, and Enasibus, and Mamnitanaimus, Eliasis, Bannus, Eliali, Samis, Selemias, Nathanias: and of the sons of Ozora; Sesis, Esril, Azaelus, Samatus, Zambis, Josephus.
verses.text: And of the sons of Maani; Jeremias, Momdis, Omaerus, Juel, Mabdai, and Pelias, and Anos, Carabasion, and Enasibus, and Mamnitanaimus, Eliasis, Bannus, Eliali, Samis, Selemias, Nathanias: and of the sons of Ozora; Sesis, Esril, Azaelus, Samatus, Zambis, Josephus.

verses.raw: And of the sons of Ethma; Mazitias, Zabadaias, Edes, Juel, Banaias.
verses.text: And of the sons of Ethma; Mazitias, Zabadaias, Edes, Juel, Banaias.

verses.raw: All these had taken strange wives, and they put them away with their children.
verses.text: All these had taken strange wives, and they put them away with their children.

verses.raw: And the priests and Levites, and they that were of Yashar'el (Israel), dwelt in Jerusalem, and in the country, in the first day of the seventh month: so the children of Yashar'el (Israel) were in their habitations.
verses.text: And the priests and Levites, and they that were of Yashar'el, dwelt in Jerusalem, and in the country, in the first day of the seventh month: so the children of Yashar'el were in their habitations.

verses.raw: And the whole multitude came together with one accord into the broad place of the holy porch toward the east:
verses.text: And the whole multitude came together with one accord into the broad place of the holy porch toward the east:

verses.raw: And they spoke to Esdras the priest and reader, that he would bring the law of Moses, that was given of Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And they spoke to Esdras the priest and reader, that he would bring the law of Moses, that was given of Yahuah of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So Esdras the chief priest brought the law to the whole multitude from man to woman, and to all the priests, to hear law in the first day of the seventh month.
verses.text: So Esdras the chief priest brought the law to the whole multitude from man to woman, and to all the priests, to hear law in the first day of the seventh month.

verses.raw: And he read in the broad court before the holy porch from morning to midday, before both men and women; and the multitude gave heed to the law.
verses.text: And he read in the broad court before the holy porch from morning to midday, before both men and women; and the multitude gave heed to the law.

verses.raw: And Esdras the priest and reader of the law stood up upon a pulpit of wood, which was made for that purpose.
verses.text: And Esdras the priest and reader of the law stood up upon a pulpit of wood, which was made for that purpose.

verses.raw: And there stood up by him Mattathias, Sammus, Ananias, Azarias, Urias, Ezecias, Balasamus, upon the right hand:
verses.text: And there stood up by him Mattathias, Sammus, Ananias, Azarias, Urias, Ezecias, Balasamus, upon the right hand:

verses.raw: And upon his left hand stood Phaldaius, Misael, Melchias, Lothasubus, and Nabarias.
verses.text: And upon his left hand stood Phaldaius, Misael, Melchias, Lothasubus, and Nabarias.

verses.raw: Then took Esdras the book of the law before the multitude: for he sat honourably in the first place in the sight of them all.
verses.text: Then took Esdras the book of the law before the multitude: for he sat honourably in the first place in the sight of them all.

verses.raw: And when he opened the law, they stood all straight up. So Esdras blessed Yahuah (God) most High, Yahuah (God) of hosts, Almighty.
verses.text: And when he opened the law, they stood all straight up. So Esdras blessed Yahuah most High, Yahuah of hosts, Almighty.

verses.raw: And all the people answered, Amen; and lifting up their hands they fell to the ground, and worshipped Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And all the people answered, Amen; and lifting up their hands they fell to the ground, and worshipped Yahuah.

verses.raw: Also Jesus, Anus, Sarabias, Adinus, Jacubus, Sabateas, Auteas, Maianeas, and Calitas, Asrias, and Joazabdus, and Ananias, Biatas, the Levites, taught the law of Yahuah (God), making them withal to understand it.
verses.text: Also Jesus, Anus, Sarabias, Adinus, Jacubus, Sabateas, Auteas, Maianeas, and Calitas, Asrias, and Joazabdus, and Ananias, Biatas, the Levites, taught the law of Yahuah, making them withal to understand it.

verses.raw: Then spoke Attharates to Esdras the chief priest. and reader, and to the Levites that taught the multitude, even to all, saying,
verses.text: Then spoke Attharates to Esdras the chief priest. and reader, and to the Levites that taught the multitude, even to all, saying,

verses.raw: This day is holy to Yahuah (God); (for they all wept when they heard the law:)
verses.text: This day is holy to Yahuah; (for they all wept when they heard the law:)

verses.raw: Go then, and eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send part to them that have nothing;
verses.text: Go then, and eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send part to them that have nothing;

verses.raw: For this day is holy to Yahuah (God): and be not sorrowful; for Yahuah (God) will bring you to honour.
verses.text: For this day is holy to Yahuah: and be not sorrowful; for Yahuah will bring you to honour.

verses.raw: So the Levites published all things to the people, saying, This day is holy to Yahuah (God); be not sorrowful.
verses.text: So the Levites published all things to the people, saying, This day is holy to Yahuah; be not sorrowful.

verses.raw: Then went they their way, every one to eat and drink, and make merry, and to give part to them that had nothing, and to make great cheer;
verses.text: Then went they their way, every one to eat and drink, and make merry, and to give part to them that had nothing, and to make great cheer;

verses.raw: Because they understood the words in which they were instructed, and for the which they had been assembled. ⸻
verses.text: Because they understood the words in which they were instructed, and for the which they had been assembled. ⸻

verses.raw: The second book of the prophet Esdras, the son of Saraias, the son of Azarias, the son of Helchias, the son of Sadamias, the son of Sadoc, the son of Achitob,
verses.text: The second book of the prophet Esdras, the son of Saraias, the son of Azarias, the son of Helchias, the son of Sadamias, the son of Sadoc, the son of Achitob,

verses.raw: The son of Achias, the son of Phinees, the son of Heli, the son of Amarias, the son of Aziei, the son of Marimoth, the son of Arna, the son of Ozias, the son of Borith, the son of Abisei, the son of Phinees, the son of Eleazar,
verses.text: The son of Achias, the son of Phinees, the son of Heli, the son of Amarias, the son of Aziei, the son of Marimoth, the son of Arna, the son of Ozias, the son of Borith, the son of Abisei, the son of Phinees, the son of Eleazar,

verses.raw: The son of Aaron, of the tribe of Levi; which was captive in the land of the Medes, in the reign of Artexerxes king of the Persians.
verses.text: The son of Aaron, of the tribe of Levi; which was captive in the land of the Medes, in the reign of Artexerxes king of the Persians.

verses.raw: And the word of Yahuah (God) came to me, saying,
verses.text: And the word of Yahuah came to me, saying,

verses.raw: Go your way, and shew my people their sinful deeds, and their children their wickedness which they have done against me; that they may tell their children’s children:
verses.text: Go your way, and shew my people their sinful deeds, and their children their wickedness which they have done against me; that they may tell their children’s children:

verses.raw: Because the sins of their fathers are increased in them: for they have forgotten me, and have offered to strange gods.
verses.text: Because the sins of their fathers are increased in them: for they have forgotten me, and have offered to strange gods.

verses.raw: Am not I even he that brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage? but they have provoked me to wrath, and despised my counsels.
verses.text: Am not I even he that brought them out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage? but they have provoked me to wrath, and despised my counsels.

verses.raw: Pull you off then the hair of your head, and cast all evil upon them, for they have not been obedient to my law, but it is a rebellious people.
verses.text: Pull you off then the hair of your head, and cast all evil upon them, for they have not been obedient to my law, but it is a rebellious people.

verses.raw: How long shall I forbear them, into whom I have done so much good?
verses.text: How long shall I forbear them, into whom I have done so much good?

verses.raw: Many kings have I destroyed for their sakes; Pharaoh with his servants and all his power have I struck down.
verses.text: Many kings have I destroyed for their sakes; Pharaoh with his servants and all his power have I struck down.

verses.raw: All the nations have I destroyed before them, and in the east I have scattered the people of two provinces, even of Tyrus and Sidon, and have slain all their enemies.
verses.text: All the nations have I destroyed before them, and in the east I have scattered the people of two provinces, even of Tyrus and Sidon, and have slain all their enemies.

verses.raw: Speak you therefore to them, saying, Thus says Yahuah (God),
verses.text: Speak you therefore to them, saying, Thus says Yahuah,

verses.raw: I led you through the sea and in the beginning gave you a large and safe passage; I gave you Moses for a leader, and Aaron for a priest.
verses.text: I led you through the sea and in the beginning gave you a large and safe passage; I gave you Moses for a leader, and Aaron for a priest.

verses.raw: I gave you light in a pillar of fire, and great wonders have I done among you; yet have you forgotten me, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: I gave you light in a pillar of fire, and great wonders have I done among you; yet have you forgotten me, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), The quails were as a token to you; I gave you tents for your safeguard: nevertheless you murmured there,
verses.text: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah, The quails were as a token to you; I gave you tents for your safeguard: nevertheless you murmured there,

verses.raw: And triumphed not in my name for the destruction of your enemies, but ever to this day do you yet murmur.
verses.text: And triumphed not in my name for the destruction of your enemies, but ever to this day do you yet murmur.

verses.raw: Where are the benefits that I have done for you? when you were hungry and thirsty in the wilderness, did you not cry to me,
verses.text: Where are the benefits that I have done for you? when you were hungry and thirsty in the wilderness, did you not cry to me,

verses.raw: Saying, Why have you brought us into this wilderness to kill us? it had been better for us to have served the Egyptians, than to die in this wilderness.
verses.text: Saying, Why have you brought us into this wilderness to kill us? it had been better for us to have served the Egyptians, than to die in this wilderness.

verses.raw: Then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so you did eat angels’ bread.
verses.text: Then had I pity upon your mournings, and gave you manna to eat; so you did eat angels’ bread.

verses.raw: When you were thirsty, did I not cleave the rock, and waters flowed out to your fill? for the heat I covered you with the leaves of the trees.
verses.text: When you were thirsty, did I not cleave the rock, and waters flowed out to your fill? for the heat I covered you with the leaves of the trees.

verses.raw: I divided among you a fruitful land, I cast out the Canaanites, the Pherezites, and the Philistines, before you: what shall I yet do more for you? says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: I divided among you a fruitful land, I cast out the Canaanites, the Pherezites, and the Philistines, before you: what shall I yet do more for you? says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), When you were in the wilderness, in the river of the Amorites, being athirst, and blaspheming my name,
verses.text: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah, When you were in the wilderness, in the river of the Amorites, being athirst, and blaspheming my name,

verses.raw: I gave you not fire for your blasphemies, but cast a tree in the water, and made the river sweet.
verses.text: I gave you not fire for your blasphemies, but cast a tree in the water, and made the river sweet.

verses.raw: What shall I do to you, O Jacob? you, Juda, wouldest not obey me: I will turn me to other nations, and to those will I give my name, that they may keep my statutes.
verses.text: What shall I do to you, O Jacob? you, Juda, wouldest not obey me: I will turn me to other nations, and to those will I give my name, that they may keep my statutes.

verses.raw: Seeing you have forsaken me, I will forsake you also; when you desire me to be gracious to you, I shall have no mercy upon you.
verses.text: Seeing you have forsaken me, I will forsake you also; when you desire me to be gracious to you, I shall have no mercy upon you.

verses.raw: Whenever you shall call upon me, I will not hear you: for you have defiled your hands with blood, and your feet are swift to commit manslaughter.
verses.text: Whenever you shall call upon me, I will not hear you: for you have defiled your hands with blood, and your feet are swift to commit manslaughter.

verses.raw: You have not as it were forsaken me, but your own selves, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: You have not as it were forsaken me, but your own selves, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), Have I not prayed you as a father his sons, as a mother her daughters, and a nurse her young babes,
verses.text: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah, Have I not prayed you as a father his sons, as a mother her daughters, and a nurse her young babes,

verses.raw: That you would be my people, and I should be your Elohim (God); that you would be my children, and I should be your father?
verses.text: That you would be my people, and I should be your Elohim; that you would be my children, and I should be your father?

verses.raw: I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings: but now, what shall I do to you? I will cast you out from my face.
verses.text: I gathered you together, as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings: but now, what shall I do to you? I will cast you out from my face.

verses.raw: When you offer to me, I will turn my face from you: for your solemn feastdays, your new moons, and your circumcisions, have I forsaken.
verses.text: When you offer to me, I will turn my face from you: for your solemn feastdays, your new moons, and your circumcisions, have I forsaken.

verses.raw: I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: I sent to you my servants the prophets, whom you have taken and slain, and torn their bodies in pieces, whose blood I will require of your hands, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah (God), Your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble.
verses.text: Thus says the Almighty Yahuah, Your house is desolate, I will cast you out as the wind does stubble.

verses.raw: And your children shall not be fruitful; for they have despised my commandment, and done the thing that is an evil before me.
verses.text: And your children shall not be fruitful; for they have despised my commandment, and done the thing that is an evil before me.

verses.raw: Your houses will I give to a people that shall come; which not having heard of me yet shall believe me; to whom I have shewed no signs, yet they shall do that I have commanded them.
verses.text: Your houses will I give to a people that shall come; which not having heard of me yet shall believe me; to whom I have shewed no signs, yet they shall do that I have commanded them.

verses.raw: They have seen no prophets, yet they shall call their sins to remembrance, and acknowledge them.
verses.text: They have seen no prophets, yet they shall call their sins to remembrance, and acknowledge them.

verses.raw: I take to witness the grace of the people to come, whose little ones rejoice in gladness: and though they have not seen me with bodily eyes, yet in spirit they believe the thing that I say.
verses.text: I take to witness the grace of the people to come, whose little ones rejoice in gladness: and though they have not seen me with bodily eyes, yet in spirit they believe the thing that I say.

verses.raw: And now, brother, behold what glory; and see the people that come from the east:
verses.text: And now, brother, behold what glory; and see the people that come from the east:

verses.raw: To whom I will give for leaders, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Oseas, Amos, and Micheas, Joel, Abdias, and Jonas,
verses.text: To whom I will give for leaders, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Oseas, Amos, and Micheas, Joel, Abdias, and Jonas,

verses.raw: Nahum, and Abacuc, Sophonias, Aggeus, Zachary, and Malachy, which is called also an angel of Yahuah (God). ⸻
verses.text: Nahum, and Abacuc, Sophonias, Aggeus, Zachary, and Malachy, which is called also an angel of Yahuah. ⸻

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (God), I brought this people out of bondage, and I gave them my commandments by my servants the prophets; whom they would not hear, but despised my counsels.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, I brought this people out of bondage, and I gave them my commandments by my servants the prophets; whom they would not hear, but despised my counsels.

verses.raw: The mother that bare them says to them, Go your way, you children; for I am a widow and forsaken.
verses.text: The mother that bare them says to them, Go your way, you children; for I am a widow and forsaken.

verses.raw: I brought you up with gladness; but with sorrow and heaviness have I lost you: for you have sinned before Yahuah (God), your Elohim (God), and done that thing that is evil before him.
verses.text: I brought you up with gladness; but with sorrow and heaviness have I lost you: for you have sinned before Yahuah, your Elohim, and done that thing that is evil before him.

verses.raw: But what shall I now do to you? I am a widow and forsaken: go your way, O my children, and ask mercy of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: But what shall I now do to you? I am a widow and forsaken: go your way, O my children, and ask mercy of Yahuah.

verses.raw: As for me, O father, I call upon you for a witness over the mother of these children, which would not keep my covenant,
verses.text: As for me, O father, I call upon you for a witness over the mother of these children, which would not keep my covenant,

verses.raw: That you bring them to confusion, and their mother to a spoil, that there may be no offspring of them.
verses.text: That you bring them to confusion, and their mother to a spoil, that there may be no offspring of them.

verses.raw: Let them be scattered abroad among the heathen, let their names be put out of the earth: for they have despised my covenant.
verses.text: Let them be scattered abroad among the heathen, let their names be put out of the earth: for they have despised my covenant.

verses.raw: Woe be to you, Assur, you that hidest the unrighteous in you! O you wicked people, remember what I did to Sodom and Gomorrha;
verses.text: Woe be to you, Assur, you that hidest the unrighteous in you! O you wicked people, remember what I did to Sodom and Gomorrha;

verses.raw: Whose land lieth in clods of pitch and heaps of ashes: even so also will I do to them that hear me not, says the Almighty Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Whose land lieth in clods of pitch and heaps of ashes: even so also will I do to them that hear me not, says the Almighty Yahuah.

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (God) to Esdras, Tell my people that I will give them the kingdom of Jerusalem, which I would have given to Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah to Esdras, Tell my people that I will give them the kingdom of Jerusalem, which I would have given to Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Their glory also will I take to me, and give these the everlasting tabernacles, which I had prepared for them.
verses.text: Their glory also will I take to me, and give these the everlasting tabernacles, which I had prepared for them.

verses.raw: They shall have the tree of life for an ointment of sweet savour; they shall neither labour, nor be weary.
verses.text: They shall have the tree of life for an ointment of sweet savour; they shall neither labour, nor be weary.

verses.raw: Go, and you shall receive: pray for few days to you, that they may be shortened: the kingdom is already prepared for you: watch.
verses.text: Go, and you shall receive: pray for few days to you, that they may be shortened: the kingdom is already prepared for you: watch.

verses.raw: Take heaven and earth to witness; for I have broken the evil in pieces, and created the good: for I live, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Take heaven and earth to witness; for I have broken the evil in pieces, and created the good: for I live, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Mother, embrace your children, and bring them up with gladness, make their feet as fast as a pillar: for I have chosen you, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Mother, embrace your children, and bring them up with gladness, make their feet as fast as a pillar: for I have chosen you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: And those that be dead will I raise up again from their places, and bring them out of the graves: for I have known my name in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And those that be dead will I raise up again from their places, and bring them out of the graves: for I have known my name in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Fear not, you mother of the children: for I have chosen you, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Fear not, you mother of the children: for I have chosen you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: For your help will I send my servants Esay and Jeremy, after whose counsel I have sanctified and prepared for you twelve trees laden with divers fruits,
verses.text: For your help will I send my servants Esay and Jeremy, after whose counsel I have sanctified and prepared for you twelve trees laden with divers fruits,

verses.raw: And as many fountains flowing with milk and honey, and seven mighty mountains, whereupon there grow roses and lilies, by which I will fill your children with joy.
verses.text: And as many fountains flowing with milk and honey, and seven mighty mountains, whereupon there grow roses and lilies, by which I will fill your children with joy.

verses.raw: Do right to the widow, judge for the fatherless, give to the poor, defend the orphan, clothe the naked,
verses.text: Do right to the widow, judge for the fatherless, give to the poor, defend the orphan, clothe the naked,

verses.raw: Heal the broken and the weak, laugh not a lame man to scorn, defend the maimed, and let the blind man come into the sight of my clearness.
verses.text: Heal the broken and the weak, laugh not a lame man to scorn, defend the maimed, and let the blind man come into the sight of my clearness.

verses.raw: Keep the old and young within your walls.
verses.text: Keep the old and young within your walls.

verses.raw: Wherever you findest the dead, take them and bury them, and I will give you the first place in my resurrection.
verses.text: Wherever you findest the dead, take them and bury them, and I will give you the first place in my resurrection.

verses.raw: Abide still, O my people, and take your rest, for your quietness still come.
verses.text: Abide still, O my people, and take your rest, for your quietness still come.

verses.raw: Nourish your children, O you good nurse; stablish their feet.
verses.text: Nourish your children, O you good nurse; stablish their feet.

verses.raw: As for the servants whom I have given you, there shall not one of them perish; for I will require them from among your number.
verses.text: As for the servants whom I have given you, there shall not one of them perish; for I will require them from among your number.

verses.raw: Be not weary: for when the day of trouble and heaviness comes, others shall weep and be sorrowful, but you shall be merry and have abundance.
verses.text: Be not weary: for when the day of trouble and heaviness comes, others shall weep and be sorrowful, but you shall be merry and have abundance.

verses.raw: The heathen shall envy you, but they shall be able to do nothing against you, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: The heathen shall envy you, but they shall be able to do nothing against you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: My hands shall cover you, so that your children shall not see hell.
verses.text: My hands shall cover you, so that your children shall not see hell.

verses.raw: Be joyful, O you mother, with your children; for I will deliver you, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Be joyful, O you mother, with your children; for I will deliver you, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy to them: for I am merciful, says Yahuah (God) Almighty.
verses.text: Remember your children that sleep, for I shall bring them out of the sides of the earth, and shew mercy to them: for I am merciful, says Yahuah Almighty.

verses.raw: Embrace your children until I come and shew mercy to them: for my wells run over, and my grace shall not fail.
verses.text: Embrace your children until I come and shew mercy to them: for my wells run over, and my grace shall not fail.

verses.raw: I Esdras received a charge of Yahuah (God) upon the mount Oreb, that I should go to Yashar'el (Israel); but when I came to them, they set me at nought, and despised the commandment of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: I Esdras received a charge of Yahuah upon the mount Oreb, that I should go to Yashar'el; but when I came to them, they set me at nought, and despised the commandment of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And therefore I say to you, O you heathen, that hear and understand, look for your Shepherd, he shall give you everlasting rest; for he is nigh at hand, that shall come in the end of the world.
verses.text: And therefore I say to you, O you heathen, that hear and understand, look for your Shepherd, he shall give you everlasting rest; for he is nigh at hand, that shall come in the end of the world.

verses.raw: Be ready to the reward of the kingdom, for the everlasting light shall shine upon you for evermore.
verses.text: Be ready to the reward of the kingdom, for the everlasting light shall shine upon you for evermore.

verses.raw: Flee the shadow of this world, receive the joyfulness of your glory: I testify my Saviour openly.
verses.text: Flee the shadow of this world, receive the joyfulness of your glory: I testify my Saviour openly.

verses.raw: O receive the gift that is given you, and be glad, giving thanks to him that has led you to the heavenly kingdom.
verses.text: O receive the gift that is given you, and be glad, giving thanks to him that has led you to the heavenly kingdom.

verses.raw: Arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of Yahuah (God);
verses.text: Arise up and stand, behold the number of those that be sealed in the feast of Yahuah;

verses.raw: Which are departed from the shadow of the world, and have received glorious garments of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Which are departed from the shadow of the world, and have received glorious garments of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Take your number, O Sion, and shut up those of yours that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Take your number, O Sion, and shut up those of yours that are clothed in white, which have fulfilled the law of Yahuah.

verses.raw: The number of your children, whom you longedst for, is fulfilled: beseech the power of Yahuah (God), that your people, which have been called from the beginning, may be hallowed.
verses.text: The number of your children, whom you longedst for, is fulfilled: beseech the power of Yahuah, that your people, which have been called from the beginning, may be hallowed.

verses.raw: I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised Yahuah (God) with songs.
verses.text: I Esdras saw upon the mount Sion a great people, whom I could not number, and they all praised Yahuah with songs.

verses.raw: And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted; which I marvelled at greatly.
verses.text: And in the midst of them there was a young man of a high stature, taller than all the rest, and upon every one of their heads he set crowns, and was more exalted; which I marvelled at greatly.

verses.raw: So I asked the angel, and said, Sir, what are these?
verses.text: So I asked the angel, and said, Sir, what are these?

verses.raw: He answered and said to me, These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of Yahuah (God): now are they crowned, and receive palms.
verses.text: He answered and said to me, These be they that have put off the mortal clothing, and put on the immortal, and have confessed the name of Yahuah: now are they crowned, and receive palms.

verses.raw: Then said I to the angel, What young person is it that crowneth them, and gives them palms in their hands?
verses.text: Then said I to the angel, What young person is it that crowneth them, and gives them palms in their hands?

verses.raw: So he answered and said to me, It is the Son of Yahuah (God), whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: So he answered and said to me, It is the Son of Yahuah, whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then the angel said to me, Go your way, and tell my people what manner of things, and how great wonders of Yahuah (God), your Elohim (God), you have seen. ⸻
verses.text: Then the angel said to me, Go your way, and tell my people what manner of things, and how great wonders of Yahuah, your Elohim, you have seen. ⸻

verses.raw: In the thirtieth year after the ruin of the city I was in Babylon, and lay troubled upon my bed, and my thoughts came up over my heart:
verses.text: In the thirtieth year after the ruin of the city I was in Babylon, and lay troubled upon my bed, and my thoughts came up over my heart:

verses.raw: For I saw the desolation of Sion, and the wealth of them that dwelt at Babylon.
verses.text: For I saw the desolation of Sion, and the wealth of them that dwelt at Babylon.

verses.raw: And my spirit was sore moved, so that I began to speak words full of fear to the Most High, and said,
verses.text: And my spirit was sore moved, so that I began to speak words full of fear to the Most High, and said,

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), who bearest rule, you spakest at the beginning, when you did plant the earth, and that thyself alone, and commandedst the people,
verses.text: O Yahuah, who bearest rule, you spakest at the beginning, when you did plant the earth, and that thyself alone, and commandedst the people,

verses.raw: And gavest a body to Adam without soul, which was the workmanship of yours hands, and did breathe into him the breath of life, and he was made living before you.
verses.text: And gavest a body to Adam without soul, which was the workmanship of yours hands, and did breathe into him the breath of life, and he was made living before you.

verses.raw: And you leadest him into paradise, which your right hand had planted, before ever the earth came forward.
verses.text: And you leadest him into paradise, which your right hand had planted, before ever the earth came forward.

verses.raw: And to him you gavest commandment to love your way: which he transgressed, and immediately you appointedst death in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people, and kindreds, out of number.
verses.text: And to him you gavest commandment to love your way: which he transgressed, and immediately you appointedst death in him and in his generations, of whom came nations, tribes, people, and kindreds, out of number.

verses.raw: And every people walked after their own will, and did wonderful things before you, and despised your commandments.
verses.text: And every people walked after their own will, and did wonderful things before you, and despised your commandments.

verses.raw: And again in process of time you broughtest the flood upon those that dwelt in the world, and destroyedst them.
verses.text: And again in process of time you broughtest the flood upon those that dwelt in the world, and destroyedst them.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in every of them, that as death was to Adam, so was the flood to these.
verses.text: And it came to pass in every of them, that as death was to Adam, so was the flood to these.

verses.raw: Nevertheless one of them you leftest, namely, Noah with his household, of whom came all righteous men.
verses.text: Nevertheless one of them you leftest, namely, Noah with his household, of whom came all righteous men.

verses.raw: And it happened, that when they that dwelt upon the earth began to multiply, and had gotten them many children, and were a great people, they began again to be more ungodly than the first.
verses.text: And it happened, that when they that dwelt upon the earth began to multiply, and had gotten them many children, and were a great people, they began again to be more ungodly than the first.

verses.raw: Now when they lived so wickedly before you, you did choose you a man from among them, whose name was Abraham.
verses.text: Now when they lived so wickedly before you, you did choose you a man from among them, whose name was Abraham.

verses.raw: Him you lovedst, and to him only you shewedst your will:
verses.text: Him you lovedst, and to him only you shewedst your will:

verses.raw: And madest an everlasting covenant with him, promising him that you would never forsake his seed.
verses.text: And madest an everlasting covenant with him, promising him that you would never forsake his seed.

verses.raw: And to him you gavest Isaac, and to Isaac also you gavest Jacob and Esau. As for Jacob, you did choose him to you, and put by Esau: and so Jacob became a great multitude.
verses.text: And to him you gavest Isaac, and to Isaac also you gavest Jacob and Esau. As for Jacob, you did choose him to you, and put by Esau: and so Jacob became a great multitude.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, that when you leadest his seed out of Egypt, you broughtest them up to the mount Sinai.
verses.text: And it came to pass, that when you leadest his seed out of Egypt, you broughtest them up to the mount Sinai.

verses.raw: And bowing the heavens, you did set fast the earth, movedst the whole world, and madest the depths to tremble, and troubledst the men of that age.
verses.text: And bowing the heavens, you did set fast the earth, movedst the whole world, and madest the depths to tremble, and troubledst the men of that age.

verses.raw: And your glory went through four gates, of fire, and of earthquake, and of wind, and of cold; that you might give the law to the seed of Jacob, and diligence to the generation of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And your glory went through four gates, of fire, and of earthquake, and of wind, and of cold; that you might give the law to the seed of Jacob, and diligence to the generation of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And yet tookest you not away from them a wicked heart, that your law might bring forth fruit in them.
verses.text: And yet tookest you not away from them a wicked heart, that your law might bring forth fruit in them.

verses.raw: For the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.
verses.text: For the first Adam bearing a wicked heart transgressed, and was overcome; and so be all they that are born of him.

verses.raw: Thus infirmity was made permanent; and the law (also) in the heart of the people with the malignity of the root; so that the good departed away, and the evil abode still.
verses.text: Thus infirmity was made permanent; and the law (also) in the heart of the people with the malignity of the root; so that the good departed away, and the evil abode still.

verses.raw: So the times passed away, and the years were brought to an end: then did you raise you up a servant, called David:
verses.text: So the times passed away, and the years were brought to an end: then did you raise you up a servant, called David:

verses.raw: Whom you commandedst to build a city to your name, and to offer incense and oblations to you in it.
verses.text: Whom you commandedst to build a city to your name, and to offer incense and oblations to you in it.

verses.raw: When this was done many years, then they that inhabited the city forsook you,
verses.text: When this was done many years, then they that inhabited the city forsook you,

verses.raw: And in all things did even as Adam and all his generations had done: for they also had a wicked heart:
verses.text: And in all things did even as Adam and all his generations had done: for they also had a wicked heart:

verses.raw: And so you gavest your city over into the hands of your enemies.
verses.text: And so you gavest your city over into the hands of your enemies.

verses.raw: Are their deeds then any better that inhabit Babylon, that they should therefore have the dominion over Sion?
verses.text: Are their deeds then any better that inhabit Babylon, that they should therefore have the dominion over Sion?

verses.raw: For when I came thither, and had seen impieties without number, then my soul saw many evildoers in this thirtieth year, so that my heart failed me.
verses.text: For when I came thither, and had seen impieties without number, then my soul saw many evildoers in this thirtieth year, so that my heart failed me.

verses.raw: For I have seen how you sufferest them sinning, and have spared wicked doers: and have destroyed your people, and have preserved your enemies, and have not signified it.
verses.text: For I have seen how you sufferest them sinning, and have spared wicked doers: and have destroyed your people, and have preserved your enemies, and have not signified it.

verses.raw: I do not remember how this way may be left: Are they then of Babylon better than they of Sion?
verses.text: I do not remember how this way may be left: Are they then of Babylon better than they of Sion?

verses.raw: Or is there any other people that knoweth you beside Yashar'el (Israel)? or what generation has so believed your covenants as Jacob?
verses.text: Or is there any other people that knoweth you beside Yashar'el? or what generation has so believed your covenants as Jacob?

verses.raw: And yet their reward appears not, and their labour has no fruit: for I have gone here and there through the heathen, and I see that they flow in wealth, and think not upon your commandments.
verses.text: And yet their reward appears not, and their labour has no fruit: for I have gone here and there through the heathen, and I see that they flow in wealth, and think not upon your commandments.

verses.raw: Weigh you therefore our wickedness now in the balance, and their’s also that dwell the world; and so shall your name no where be found but in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Weigh you therefore our wickedness now in the balance, and their’s also that dwell the world; and so shall your name no where be found but in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Or when was it that they which dwell upon the earth have not sinned in your sight? or what people have so kept your commandments?
verses.text: Or when was it that they which dwell upon the earth have not sinned in your sight? or what people have so kept your commandments?

verses.raw: You shall find that Yashar'el (Israel) by name has kept your precepts; but not the heathen. ⸻
verses.text: You shall find that Yashar'el by name has kept your precepts; but not the heathen. ⸻

verses.raw: And the angel that was sent to me, whose name was Uriel, gave me an answer,
verses.text: And the angel that was sent to me, whose name was Uriel, gave me an answer,

verses.raw: And said, Your heart has gone to far in this world, and thinkest you to comprehend the way of the Most High?
verses.text: And said, Your heart has gone to far in this world, and thinkest you to comprehend the way of the Most High?

verses.raw: Then said I, Yea, my lord. And he answered me, and said, I am sent to shew you three ways, and to set forth three similitudes before you:
verses.text: Then said I, Yea, my lord. And he answered me, and said, I am sent to shew you three ways, and to set forth three similitudes before you:

verses.raw: Of which if you can declare me one, I will shew you also the way that you desirest to see, and I shall shew you from whence the wicked heart comes.
verses.text: Of which if you can declare me one, I will shew you also the way that you desirest to see, and I shall shew you from whence the wicked heart comes.

verses.raw: And I said, Tell on, my lord. Then said he to me, Go your way, weigh me the weight of the fire, or measure me the blast of the wind, or call me again the day that is past.
verses.text: And I said, Tell on, my lord. Then said he to me, Go your way, weigh me the weight of the fire, or measure me the blast of the wind, or call me again the day that is past.

verses.raw: Then answered I and said, What man is able to do that, that you should ask such things of me?
verses.text: Then answered I and said, What man is able to do that, that you should ask such things of me?

verses.raw: And he said to me, If I should ask you how great dwellings are in the midst of the sea, or how many springs are in the beginning of the deep, or how many springs are above the firmament, or which are the outgoings of paradise:
verses.text: And he said to me, If I should ask you how great dwellings are in the midst of the sea, or how many springs are in the beginning of the deep, or how many springs are above the firmament, or which are the outgoings of paradise:

verses.raw: Perhaps you would say to me, I never went down into the deep, nor as yet into hell, neither did I ever climb up into heaven.
verses.text: Perhaps you would say to me, I never went down into the deep, nor as yet into hell, neither did I ever climb up into heaven.

verses.raw: Nevertheless now have I asked you but only of the fire and wind, and of the day wherethrough you have passed, and of things from which you can not be separated, and yet can you give me no answer of them.
verses.text: Nevertheless now have I asked you but only of the fire and wind, and of the day wherethrough you have passed, and of things from which you can not be separated, and yet can you give me no answer of them.

verses.raw: He said moreover to me, Your own things, and such as are grown up with you, can you not know;
verses.text: He said moreover to me, Your own things, and such as are grown up with you, can you not know;

verses.raw: How should your vessel then be able to comprehend the way of the Highest, and, the world being now outwardly corrupted to understand the corruption that is evident in my sight?
verses.text: How should your vessel then be able to comprehend the way of the Highest, and, the world being now outwardly corrupted to understand the corruption that is evident in my sight?

verses.raw: Then said I to him, It were better that we were not at all, than that we should live still in wickedness, and to suffer, and not to know wherefore.
verses.text: Then said I to him, It were better that we were not at all, than that we should live still in wickedness, and to suffer, and not to know wherefore.

verses.raw: He answered me, and said, I went into a forest into a plain, and the trees took counsel,
verses.text: He answered me, and said, I went into a forest into a plain, and the trees took counsel,

verses.raw: And said, Come, let us go and make war against the sea that it may depart away before us, and that we may make us more woods.
verses.text: And said, Come, let us go and make war against the sea that it may depart away before us, and that we may make us more woods.

verses.raw: The floods of the sea also in like manner took counsel, and said, Come, let us go up and subdue the woods of the plain, that there also we may make us another country.
verses.text: The floods of the sea also in like manner took counsel, and said, Come, let us go up and subdue the woods of the plain, that there also we may make us another country.

verses.raw: The thought of the wood was in vain, for the fire came and consumed it.
verses.text: The thought of the wood was in vain, for the fire came and consumed it.

verses.raw: The thought of the floods of the sea came likewise to nought, for the sand stood up and stopped them.
verses.text: The thought of the floods of the sea came likewise to nought, for the sand stood up and stopped them.

verses.raw: If you were judge now between these two, whom wouldest you begin to justify? or whom wouldest you condemn?
verses.text: If you were judge now between these two, whom wouldest you begin to justify? or whom wouldest you condemn?

verses.raw: I answered and said, Verily it is a foolish thought that they both have devised, for the ground is given to the wood, and the sea also has his place to bear his floods.
verses.text: I answered and said, Verily it is a foolish thought that they both have devised, for the ground is given to the wood, and the sea also has his place to bear his floods.

verses.raw: Then answered he me, and said, You have given a right judgment, but why judgest you not thyself also?
verses.text: Then answered he me, and said, You have given a right judgment, but why judgest you not thyself also?

verses.raw: For like as the ground is given to the wood, and the sea to his floods: even so they that dwell upon the earth may understand nothing but that which is upon the earth: and he that dwells above the heavens may only understand the things that are above the height of the heavens.
verses.text: For like as the ground is given to the wood, and the sea to his floods: even so they that dwell upon the earth may understand nothing but that which is upon the earth: and he that dwells above the heavens may only understand the things that are above the height of the heavens.

verses.raw: Then answered I and said, I beseech you, O Yahuah (God), let me have understanding:
verses.text: Then answered I and said, I beseech you, O Yahuah, let me have understanding:

verses.raw: For it was not my mind to be curious of the high things, but of such as pass by us daily, namely, wherefore Yashar'el (Israel) is given up as a reproach to the heathen, and for what cause the people whom you have loved is given over to ungodly nations, and why the law of our forefathers is brought to nought, and the written covenants come to none effect,
verses.text: For it was not my mind to be curious of the high things, but of such as pass by us daily, namely, wherefore Yashar'el is given up as a reproach to the heathen, and for what cause the people whom you have loved is given over to ungodly nations, and why the law of our forefathers is brought to nought, and the written covenants come to none effect,

verses.raw: And we pass away out of the world as grasshoppers, and our life is astonishment and fear, and we are not worthy to obtain mercy.
verses.text: And we pass away out of the world as grasshoppers, and our life is astonishment and fear, and we are not worthy to obtain mercy.

verses.raw: What will he then do to his name by which we are called? of these things have I asked.
verses.text: What will he then do to his name by which we are called? of these things have I asked.

verses.raw: Then answered he me, and said, The more you searchest, the more you shall marvel; for the world hasteth fast to pass away,
verses.text: Then answered he me, and said, The more you searchest, the more you shall marvel; for the world hasteth fast to pass away,

verses.raw: And cannot comprehend the things that are promised to the righteous in time to come: for this world is full of unrighteousness and infirmities.
verses.text: And cannot comprehend the things that are promised to the righteous in time to come: for this world is full of unrighteousness and infirmities.

verses.raw: But as concerning the things of which you ask me, I will tell you; for the evil is sown, but the destruction thereof is not yet come.
verses.text: But as concerning the things of which you ask me, I will tell you; for the evil is sown, but the destruction thereof is not yet come.

verses.raw: If therefore that which is sown be not turned upside down, and if the place where the evil is sown pass not away, then cannot it come that is sown with good.
verses.text: If therefore that which is sown be not turned upside down, and if the place where the evil is sown pass not away, then cannot it come that is sown with good.

verses.raw: For the grain of evil seed has been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness has it brought up to this time? and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing come?
verses.text: For the grain of evil seed has been sown in the heart of Adam from the beginning, and how much ungodliness has it brought up to this time? and how much shall it yet bring forth until the time of threshing come?

verses.raw: Ponder now by thyself, how great fruit of wickedness the grain of evil seed has brought forth.
verses.text: Ponder now by thyself, how great fruit of wickedness the grain of evil seed has brought forth.

verses.raw: And when the ears shall be cut down, which are without number, how great a floor shall they fill?
verses.text: And when the ears shall be cut down, which are without number, how great a floor shall they fill?

verses.raw: Then I answered and said, How, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?
verses.text: Then I answered and said, How, and when shall these things come to pass? wherefore are our years few and evil?

verses.raw: And he answered me, saying, Do not you hasten above the most Highest: for your haste is in vain to be above him, for you have much exceeded.
verses.text: And he answered me, saying, Do not you hasten above the most Highest: for your haste is in vain to be above him, for you have much exceeded.

verses.raw: Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?
verses.text: Did not the souls also of the righteous ask question of these things in their chambers, saying, How long shall I hope on this fashion? when comes the fruit of the floor of our reward?

verses.raw: And to these things Uriel the archangel gave them answer, and said, Even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he has weighed the world in the balance.
verses.text: And to these things Uriel the archangel gave them answer, and said, Even when the number of seeds is filled in you: for he has weighed the world in the balance.

verses.raw: By measure has he measured the times; and by number has he numbered the times; and he does not move nor stir them, until the said measure be fulfilled.
verses.text: By measure has he measured the times; and by number has he numbered the times; and he does not move nor stir them, until the said measure be fulfilled.

verses.raw: Then answered I and said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, even we all are full of impiety.
verses.text: Then answered I and said, O Yahuah that bearest rule, even we all are full of impiety.

verses.raw: And for our sakes perhaps it is that the floors of the righteous are not filled, because of the sins of them that dwell upon the earth.
verses.text: And for our sakes perhaps it is that the floors of the righteous are not filled, because of the sins of them that dwell upon the earth.

verses.raw: So he answered me, and said, Go your way to a woman with child, and ask of her when she has fulfilled her nine months, if her womb may keep the birth any longer within her.
verses.text: So he answered me, and said, Go your way to a woman with child, and ask of her when she has fulfilled her nine months, if her womb may keep the birth any longer within her.

verses.raw: Then said I, No, Yahuah (God), that can she not. And he said to me, In the grave the chambers of souls are like the womb of a woman:
verses.text: Then said I, No, Yahuah, that can she not. And he said to me, In the grave the chambers of souls are like the womb of a woman:

verses.raw: For like as a woman that travaileth makes haste to escape the necessity of the travail: even so do these places haste to deliver those things that are committed to them.
verses.text: For like as a woman that travaileth makes haste to escape the necessity of the travail: even so do these places haste to deliver those things that are committed to them.

verses.raw: From the beginning, look, what you desirest to see, it shall be shewed you.
verses.text: From the beginning, look, what you desirest to see, it shall be shewed you.

verses.raw: Then answered I and said, If I have found favour in your sight, and if it be possible, and if I be meet therefore,
verses.text: Then answered I and said, If I have found favour in your sight, and if it be possible, and if I be meet therefore,

verses.raw: Shew me then whether there be more to come than is past, or more past than is to come.
verses.text: Shew me then whether there be more to come than is past, or more past than is to come.

verses.raw: What is past I know, but what is for to come I know not.
verses.text: What is past I know, but what is for to come I know not.

verses.raw: And he said to me, Stand up upon the right side, and I shall expound the similitude to you.
verses.text: And he said to me, Stand up upon the right side, and I shall expound the similitude to you.

verses.raw: So I stood, and saw, and, behold, an hot burning oven passed by before me: and it happened that when the flame was gone by I looked, and, behold, the smoke remained still.
verses.text: So I stood, and saw, and, behold, an hot burning oven passed by before me: and it happened that when the flame was gone by I looked, and, behold, the smoke remained still.

verses.raw: After this there passed by before me a watery cloud, and sent down much rain with a storm; and when the stormy rain was past, the drops remained still.
verses.text: After this there passed by before me a watery cloud, and sent down much rain with a storm; and when the stormy rain was past, the drops remained still.

verses.raw: Then said he to me, Consider with thyself; as the rain is more than the drops, and as the fire is greater than the smoke; but the drops and the smoke remain behind: so the quantity which is past did more exceed.
verses.text: Then said he to me, Consider with thyself; as the rain is more than the drops, and as the fire is greater than the smoke; but the drops and the smoke remain behind: so the quantity which is past did more exceed.

verses.raw: Then I prayed, and said, May I live, thinkest you, until that time? or what shall happen in those days?
verses.text: Then I prayed, and said, May I live, thinkest you, until that time? or what shall happen in those days?

verses.raw: He answered me, and said, As for the tokens of which you ask me, I may tell you of them in part: but as touching your life, I am not sent to shew you; for I do not know it. ⸻
verses.text: He answered me, and said, As for the tokens of which you ask me, I may tell you of them in part: but as touching your life, I am not sent to shew you; for I do not know it. ⸻

verses.raw: Nevertheless as concerning the tokens, behold, the days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number, and the way of truth shall be hidden, and the land shall be barren of faith.
verses.text: Nevertheless as concerning the tokens, behold, the days shall come, that they which dwell upon earth shall be taken in a great number, and the way of truth shall be hidden, and the land shall be barren of faith.

verses.raw: But iniquity shall be increased above that which now you see, or that you have heard long ago.
verses.text: But iniquity shall be increased above that which now you see, or that you have heard long ago.

verses.raw: And the land, that you see now to have root, shall you see wasted suddenly.
verses.text: And the land, that you see now to have root, shall you see wasted suddenly.

verses.raw: But if the Most High grant you to live, you shall see after the third trumpet that the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day:
verses.text: But if the Most High grant you to live, you shall see after the third trumpet that the sun shall suddenly shine again in the night, and the moon thrice in the day:

verses.raw: And blood shall drop out of wood, and the stone shall give his voice, and the people shall be troubled:
verses.text: And blood shall drop out of wood, and the stone shall give his voice, and the people shall be troubled:

verses.raw: And even he shall rule, whom they look not for that dwell upon the earth, and the fowls shall take their flight away together:
verses.text: And even he shall rule, whom they look not for that dwell upon the earth, and the fowls shall take their flight away together:

verses.raw: And the Sodomitish sea shall cast out fish, and make a noise in the night, which many have not known: but they shall all hear the voice thereof.
verses.text: And the Sodomitish sea shall cast out fish, and make a noise in the night, which many have not known: but they shall all hear the voice thereof.

verses.raw: There shall be a confusion also in many places, and the fire shall be oft sent out again, and the wild beasts shall change their places, and menstruous women shall bring forth monsters:
verses.text: There shall be a confusion also in many places, and the fire shall be oft sent out again, and the wild beasts shall change their places, and menstruous women shall bring forth monsters:

verses.raw: And salt waters shall be found in the sweet, and all friends shall destroy one another; then shall wit hide itself, and understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber,
verses.text: And salt waters shall be found in the sweet, and all friends shall destroy one another; then shall wit hide itself, and understanding withdraw itself into his secret chamber,

verses.raw: And shall be sought of many, and yet not be found: then shall unrighteousness and incontinency be multiplied upon earth.
verses.text: And shall be sought of many, and yet not be found: then shall unrighteousness and incontinency be multiplied upon earth.

verses.raw: One land also shall ask another, and say, Is righteousness that makes a man righteous gone through you? And it shall say, No.
verses.text: One land also shall ask another, and say, Is righteousness that makes a man righteous gone through you? And it shall say, No.

verses.raw: At the same time shall men hope, but nothing obtain: they shall labour, but their ways shall not prosper.
verses.text: At the same time shall men hope, but nothing obtain: they shall labour, but their ways shall not prosper.

verses.raw: To shew you such tokens I have leave; and if you will pray again, and weep as now, and fast even days, you shall hear yet greater things.
verses.text: To shew you such tokens I have leave; and if you will pray again, and weep as now, and fast even days, you shall hear yet greater things.

verses.raw: Then I awaked, and an extreme fearfulness went through all my body, and my mind was troubled, so that it fainted.
verses.text: Then I awaked, and an extreme fearfulness went through all my body, and my mind was troubled, so that it fainted.

verses.raw: So the angel that was come to talk with me held me, comforted me, and set me up upon my feet.
verses.text: So the angel that was come to talk with me held me, comforted me, and set me up upon my feet.

verses.raw: And in the second night it came to pass, that Salathiel the captain of the people came to me, saying, Where have you been? and why is your countenance so heavy?
verses.text: And in the second night it came to pass, that Salathiel the captain of the people came to me, saying, Where have you been? and why is your countenance so heavy?

verses.raw: Knowest you not that Yashar'el (Israel) is committed to you in the land of their captivity?
verses.text: Knowest you not that Yashar'el is committed to you in the land of their captivity?

verses.raw: Up then, and eat bread, and forsake us not, as the shepherd that leaveth his flock in the hands of cruel wolves.
verses.text: Up then, and eat bread, and forsake us not, as the shepherd that leaveth his flock in the hands of cruel wolves.

verses.raw: Then said I to him, Go your ways from me, and come not nigh me. And he heard what I said, and went from me.
verses.text: Then said I to him, Go your ways from me, and come not nigh me. And he heard what I said, and went from me.

verses.raw: And so I fasted seven days, mourning and weeping, like as Uriel the angel commanded me.
verses.text: And so I fasted seven days, mourning and weeping, like as Uriel the angel commanded me.

verses.raw: And after seven days so it was, that the thoughts of my heart were very grievous to me again,
verses.text: And after seven days so it was, that the thoughts of my heart were very grievous to me again,

verses.raw: And my soul recovered the spirit of understanding, and I began to talk with the Most High again,
verses.text: And my soul recovered the spirit of understanding, and I began to talk with the Most High again,

verses.raw: And said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine:
verses.text: And said, O Yahuah that bearest rule, of every wood of the earth, and of all the trees thereof, you have chosen you one only vine:

verses.raw: And of all lands of the whole world you have chosen you one pit: and of all the flowers thereof one lily:
verses.text: And of all lands of the whole world you have chosen you one pit: and of all the flowers thereof one lily:

verses.raw: And of all the depths of the sea you have filled you one river: and of all builded cities you have hallowed Sion to thyself:
verses.text: And of all the depths of the sea you have filled you one river: and of all builded cities you have hallowed Sion to thyself:

verses.raw: And of all the fowls that are created you have named you one dove: and of all the cattle that are made you have provided you one sheep:
verses.text: And of all the fowls that are created you have named you one dove: and of all the cattle that are made you have provided you one sheep:

verses.raw: And among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.
verses.text: And among all the multitudes of people you have gotten you one people: and to this people, whom you lovedst, you gavest a law that is approved of all.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah (God), why have you given this one people over to many? and upon the one root have you prepared others, and why have you scattered your only one people among many?
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah, why have you given this one people over to many? and upon the one root have you prepared others, and why have you scattered your only one people among many?

verses.raw: And they which did gainsay your promises, and believed not your covenants, have trodden them down.
verses.text: And they which did gainsay your promises, and believed not your covenants, have trodden them down.

verses.raw: If you did so much hate your people, yet shouldest you punish them with your own hands.
verses.text: If you did so much hate your people, yet shouldest you punish them with your own hands.

verses.raw: Now when I had spoken these words, the angel that came to me the night afore was sent to me,
verses.text: Now when I had spoken these words, the angel that came to me the night afore was sent to me,

verses.raw: And said to me, Hear me, and I will instruct you; hearken to the thing that I say, and I shall tell you more.
verses.text: And said to me, Hear me, and I will instruct you; hearken to the thing that I say, and I shall tell you more.

verses.raw: And I said, Speak on, my Elohim (God). Then said he to me, You are sore troubled in mind for Yashar'el (Israel)’s sake: lovest you that people better than he that made them?
verses.text: And I said, Speak on, my Elohim. Then said he to me, You are sore troubled in mind for Yashar'el’s sake: lovest you that people better than he that made them?

verses.raw: And I said, No, Yahuah (God): but of very grief have I spoken: for my reins pain me every hour, while I labour to comprehend the way of the Most High, and to seek out part of his judgment.
verses.text: And I said, No, Yahuah: but of very grief have I spoken: for my reins pain me every hour, while I labour to comprehend the way of the Most High, and to seek out part of his judgment.

verses.raw: And he said to me, You can not. And I said, Wherefore, Yahuah (God)? to which was I born then? or why was not my mother’s womb then my grave, that I might not have seen the travail of Jacob, and the wearisome toil of the stock of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: And he said to me, You can not. And I said, Wherefore, Yahuah? to which was I born then? or why was not my mother’s womb then my grave, that I might not have seen the travail of Jacob, and the wearisome toil of the stock of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: And he said to me, Number me the things that are not yet come, gather me together the dross that are scattered abroad, make me the flowers green again that are withered,
verses.text: And he said to me, Number me the things that are not yet come, gather me together the dross that are scattered abroad, make me the flowers green again that are withered,

verses.raw: Open me the places that are closed, and bring me forth the winds that in them are shut up, shew me the image of a voice: and then I will declare to you the thing that you labourest to know.
verses.text: Open me the places that are closed, and bring me forth the winds that in them are shut up, shew me the image of a voice: and then I will declare to you the thing that you labourest to know.

verses.raw: And I said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, who may know these things, but he that has not his dwelling with men?
verses.text: And I said, O Yahuah that bearest rule, who may know these things, but he that has not his dwelling with men?

verses.raw: As for me, I am unwise: how may I then speak of these things of which you ask me?
verses.text: As for me, I am unwise: how may I then speak of these things of which you ask me?

verses.raw: Then said he to me, Like as you can do none of these things that I have spoken of, even so can you not find out my judgment, or in the end the love that I have promised to my people.
verses.text: Then said he to me, Like as you can do none of these things that I have spoken of, even so can you not find out my judgment, or in the end the love that I have promised to my people.

verses.raw: And I said, Behold, O Yahuah (God), yet art you nigh to them that be reserved till the end: and what shall they do that have been before me, or we that be now, or they that shall come after us?
verses.text: And I said, Behold, O Yahuah, yet art you nigh to them that be reserved till the end: and what shall they do that have been before me, or we that be now, or they that shall come after us?

verses.raw: And he said to me, I will liken my judgment to a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.
verses.text: And he said to me, I will liken my judgment to a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.

verses.raw: So I answered and said, Couldest you not make those that have been made, and be now, and that are for to come, at once; that you might shew your judgment the sooner?
verses.text: So I answered and said, Couldest you not make those that have been made, and be now, and that are for to come, at once; that you might shew your judgment the sooner?

verses.raw: Then answered he me, and said, The creature may not haste above the maker; neither may the world hold them at once that shall be created in it.
verses.text: Then answered he me, and said, The creature may not haste above the maker; neither may the world hold them at once that shall be created in it.

verses.raw: And I said, As you have said to your servant, that you, which givest life to all, have given life at once to the creature that you have created, and the creature bare it: even so it might now also bear them that now be present at once.
verses.text: And I said, As you have said to your servant, that you, which givest life to all, have given life at once to the creature that you have created, and the creature bare it: even so it might now also bear them that now be present at once.

verses.raw: And he said to me, Ask the womb of a woman, and say to her, If you bring forth children, why do you it not together, but one after another? pray her therefore to bring forth ten children at once.
verses.text: And he said to me, Ask the womb of a woman, and say to her, If you bring forth children, why do you it not together, but one after another? pray her therefore to bring forth ten children at once.

verses.raw: And I said, She cannot: but must do it by distance of time.
verses.text: And I said, She cannot: but must do it by distance of time.

verses.raw: Then said he to me, Even so have I given the womb of the earth to those that be sown in it in their times.
verses.text: Then said he to me, Even so have I given the womb of the earth to those that be sown in it in their times.

verses.raw: For like as a young child may not bring forth the things that belong to the aged, even so have I disposed the world which I created.
verses.text: For like as a young child may not bring forth the things that belong to the aged, even so have I disposed the world which I created.

verses.raw: And I asked, and said, Seeing you have now given me the way, I will proceed to speak before you: for our mother, of whom you have told me that she is young, draws now nigh to age.
verses.text: And I asked, and said, Seeing you have now given me the way, I will proceed to speak before you: for our mother, of whom you have told me that she is young, draws now nigh to age.

verses.raw: He answered me, and said, Ask a woman that bears children, and she shall tell you.
verses.text: He answered me, and said, Ask a woman that bears children, and she shall tell you.

verses.raw: Say to her, Wherefore are to they whom you have now brought forth like those that were before, but less of stature?
