verses.text: Say to her, Wherefore are to they whom you have now brought forth like those that were before, but less of stature?

verses.raw: And she shall answer you, They that be born in the strength of youth are of one fashion, and they that are born in the time of age, when the womb fails, are otherwise.
verses.text: And she shall answer you, They that be born in the strength of youth are of one fashion, and they that are born in the time of age, when the womb fails, are otherwise.

verses.raw: Consider you therefore also, how that you are less of stature than those that were before you.
verses.text: Consider you therefore also, how that you are less of stature than those that were before you.

verses.raw: And so are they that come after you less than you, as the creatures which now begin to be old, and have passed over the strength of youth.
verses.text: And so are they that come after you less than you, as the creatures which now begin to be old, and have passed over the strength of youth.

verses.raw: Then said I, Yahuah (God), I beseech you, if I have found favour in your sight, shew your servant by whom you visitest your creature. ⸻
verses.text: Then said I, Yahuah, I beseech you, if I have found favour in your sight, shew your servant by whom you visitest your creature. ⸻

verses.raw: And he said to me, In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,
verses.text: And he said to me, In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew,

verses.raw: Before it thundered and lightened, or ever the foundations of paradise were laid,
verses.text: Before it thundered and lightened, or ever the foundations of paradise were laid,

verses.raw: Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together,
verses.text: Before the fair flowers were seen, or ever the moveable powers were established, before the innumerable multitude of angels were gathered together,

verses.raw: Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot,
verses.text: Or ever the heights of the air were lifted up, before the measures of the firmament were named, or ever the chimneys in Sion were hot,

verses.raw: And ere the present years were sought out, and or ever the inventions of them that now sin were turned, before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure:
verses.text: And ere the present years were sought out, and or ever the inventions of them that now sin were turned, before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure:

verses.raw: Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.
verses.text: Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.

verses.raw: Then answered I and said, What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?
verses.text: Then answered I and said, What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?

verses.raw: And he said to me, From Abraham to Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau.
verses.text: And he said to me, From Abraham to Isaac, when Jacob and Esau were born of him, Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau.

verses.raw: For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.
verses.text: For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.

verses.raw: The hand of man is between the heel and the hand: other question, Esdras, ask you not.
verses.text: The hand of man is between the heel and the hand: other question, Esdras, ask you not.

verses.raw: I answered then and said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, if I have found favour in your sight,
verses.text: I answered then and said, O Yahuah that bearest rule, if I have found favour in your sight,

verses.raw: I beseech you, shew your servant the end of your tokens, of which you shewedst me part the last night.
verses.text: I beseech you, shew your servant the end of your tokens, of which you shewedst me part the last night.

verses.raw: So he answered and said to me, Stand up upon your feet, and hear a mighty sounding voice.
verses.text: So he answered and said to me, Stand up upon your feet, and hear a mighty sounding voice.

verses.raw: And it shall be as it were a great motion; but the place where you standest shall not be moved.
verses.text: And it shall be as it were a great motion; but the place where you standest shall not be moved.

verses.raw: And therefore when it speaks be not afraid: for the word is of the end, and the foundation of the earth is understood.
verses.text: And therefore when it speaks be not afraid: for the word is of the end, and the foundation of the earth is understood.

verses.raw: And why? because the speech of these things trembles and is moved: for it knoweth that the end of these things must be changed.
verses.text: And why? because the speech of these things trembles and is moved: for it knoweth that the end of these things must be changed.

verses.raw: And it happened, that when I had heard it I stood up upon my feet, and hearkened, and, behold, there was a voice that spoke, and the sound of it was like the sound of many waters.
verses.text: And it happened, that when I had heard it I stood up upon my feet, and hearkened, and, behold, there was a voice that spoke, and the sound of it was like the sound of many waters.

verses.raw: And it said, Behold, the days come, that I will begin to draw nigh, and to visit them that dwell upon the earth,
verses.text: And it said, Behold, the days come, that I will begin to draw nigh, and to visit them that dwell upon the earth,

verses.raw: And will begin to make inquisition of them, what they be that have hurt unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Sion shall be fulfilled;
verses.text: And will begin to make inquisition of them, what they be that have hurt unjustly with their unrighteousness, and when the affliction of Sion shall be fulfilled;

verses.raw: And when the world, that shall begin to vanish away, shall be finished, then will I shew these tokens: the books shall be opened before the firmament, and they shall see all together:
verses.text: And when the world, that shall begin to vanish away, shall be finished, then will I shew these tokens: the books shall be opened before the firmament, and they shall see all together:

verses.raw: And the children of a year old shall speak with their voices, the women with child shall bring forth untimely children of three or four months old, and they shall live, and be raised up.
verses.text: And the children of a year old shall speak with their voices, the women with child shall bring forth untimely children of three or four months old, and they shall live, and be raised up.

verses.raw: And suddenly shall the sown places appear unsown, the full storehouses shall suddenly be found empty:
verses.text: And suddenly shall the sown places appear unsown, the full storehouses shall suddenly be found empty:

verses.raw: And the trumpet shall give a sound, which when every man heareth, they shall be suddenly afraid.
verses.text: And the trumpet shall give a sound, which when every man heareth, they shall be suddenly afraid.

verses.raw: At that time shall friends fight one against another like enemies, and the earth shall stand in fear with those that dwell in it, the springs of the fountains shall stand still, and in three hours they shall not run.
verses.text: At that time shall friends fight one against another like enemies, and the earth shall stand in fear with those that dwell in it, the springs of the fountains shall stand still, and in three hours they shall not run.

verses.raw: Whoever remains from all these that I have told you shall escape, and see my salvation, and the end of your world.
verses.text: Whoever remains from all these that I have told you shall escape, and see my salvation, and the end of your world.

verses.raw: And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth: and the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.
verses.text: And the men that are received shall see it, who have not tasted death from their birth: and the heart of the inhabitants shall be changed, and turned into another meaning.

verses.raw: For evil shall be put out, and deceit shall be quenched.
verses.text: For evil shall be put out, and deceit shall be quenched.

verses.raw: As for faith, it shall flourish, corruption shall be overcome, and the truth, which has been so long without fruit, shall be declared.
verses.text: As for faith, it shall flourish, corruption shall be overcome, and the truth, which has been so long without fruit, shall be declared.

verses.raw: And when he talked with me, behold, I looked by little and little upon him before whom I stood.
verses.text: And when he talked with me, behold, I looked by little and little upon him before whom I stood.

verses.raw: And these words said he to me; I am come to shew you the time of the night to come.
verses.text: And these words said he to me; I am come to shew you the time of the night to come.

verses.raw: If you will pray yet more, and fast seven days again, I shall tell you greater things by day than I have heard.
verses.text: If you will pray yet more, and fast seven days again, I shall tell you greater things by day than I have heard.

verses.raw: For your voice is heard before the Most High: for the Mighty has seen your righteous dealing, he has seen also your chastity, which you have had ever since your youth.
verses.text: For your voice is heard before the Most High: for the Mighty has seen your righteous dealing, he has seen also your chastity, which you have had ever since your youth.

verses.raw: And therefore has he sent me to shew you all these things, and to say to you, Be of good comfort and fear not
verses.text: And therefore has he sent me to shew you all these things, and to say to you, Be of good comfort and fear not

verses.raw: And hasten not with the times that are past, to think vain things, that you may not hasten from the latter times.
verses.text: And hasten not with the times that are past, to think vain things, that you may not hasten from the latter times.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after this, that I wept again, and fasted seven days in like manner, that I might fulfil the three weeks which he told me.
verses.text: And it came to pass after this, that I wept again, and fasted seven days in like manner, that I might fulfil the three weeks which he told me.

verses.raw: And in the eighth night was my heart vexed within me again, and I began to speak before the Most High.
verses.text: And in the eighth night was my heart vexed within me again, and I began to speak before the Most High.

verses.raw: For my spirit was greatly set on fire, and my soul was in distress.
verses.text: For my spirit was greatly set on fire, and my soul was in distress.

verses.raw: And I said, O Yahuah (God), you spakest from the beginning of the creation, even the first day, and saidst thus; Let heaven and earth be made; and your word was a perfect work.
verses.text: And I said, O Yahuah, you spakest from the beginning of the creation, even the first day, and saidst thus; Let heaven and earth be made; and your word was a perfect work.

verses.raw: And then was the spirit, and darkness and silence were on every side; the sound of man’s voice was not yet formed.
verses.text: And then was the spirit, and darkness and silence were on every side; the sound of man’s voice was not yet formed.

verses.raw: Then commandedst you a fair light to come forth of your treasures, that your work might appear.
verses.text: Then commandedst you a fair light to come forth of your treasures, that your work might appear.

verses.raw: Upon the second day you madest the spirit of the firmament, and commandedst it to part asunder, and to make a division between the waters, that the one part might go up, and the other remain beneath.
verses.text: Upon the second day you madest the spirit of the firmament, and commandedst it to part asunder, and to make a division between the waters, that the one part might go up, and the other remain beneath.

verses.raw: Upon the third day you did command that the waters should be gathered in the seventh part of the earth: six parts have you dried up, and kept them, to the intent that of these some being planted of Yahuah (God) and tilled might serve you.
verses.text: Upon the third day you did command that the waters should be gathered in the seventh part of the earth: six parts have you dried up, and kept them, to the intent that of these some being planted of Yahuah and tilled might serve you.

verses.raw: For as soon as your word went forth the work was made.
verses.text: For as soon as your word went forth the work was made.

verses.raw: For immediately there was great and innumerable fruit, and many and divers pleasures for the taste, and flowers of unchangeable colour, and odours of wonderful smell: and this was done the third day.
verses.text: For immediately there was great and innumerable fruit, and many and divers pleasures for the taste, and flowers of unchangeable colour, and odours of wonderful smell: and this was done the third day.

verses.raw: Upon the fourth day you commandedst that the sun should shine, and the moon give her light, and the stars should be in order:
verses.text: Upon the fourth day you commandedst that the sun should shine, and the moon give her light, and the stars should be in order:

verses.raw: And gavest them a charge to do service to man, that was to be made.
verses.text: And gavest them a charge to do service to man, that was to be made.

verses.raw: Upon the fifth day you saidst to the seventh part, where the waters were gathered that it should bring forth living creatures, fowls and fishes: and so it came to pass.
verses.text: Upon the fifth day you saidst to the seventh part, where the waters were gathered that it should bring forth living creatures, fowls and fishes: and so it came to pass.

verses.raw: For the dumb water and without life brought forth living things at the commandment of Yahuah (God), that all people might praise your wondrous works.
verses.text: For the dumb water and without life brought forth living things at the commandment of Yahuah, that all people might praise your wondrous works.

verses.raw: Then did you ordain two living creatures, the one you calledst Enoch, and the other Leviathan;
verses.text: Then did you ordain two living creatures, the one you calledst Enoch, and the other Leviathan;

verses.raw: And did separate the one from the other: for the seventh part, namely, where the water was gathered together, might not hold them both.
verses.text: And did separate the one from the other: for the seventh part, namely, where the water was gathered together, might not hold them both.

verses.raw: To Enoch you gavest one part, which was dried up the third day, that he should dwell in the same part, in which are a thousand hills:
verses.text: To Enoch you gavest one part, which was dried up the third day, that he should dwell in the same part, in which are a thousand hills:

verses.raw: But to Leviathan you gavest the seventh part, namely, the moist; and have kept him to be devoured of whom you will, and when.
verses.text: But to Leviathan you gavest the seventh part, namely, the moist; and have kept him to be devoured of whom you will, and when.

verses.raw: Upon the sixth day you gavest commandment to the earth, that before you it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things:
verses.text: Upon the sixth day you gavest commandment to the earth, that before you it should bring forth beasts, cattle, and creeping things:

verses.raw: And after these, Adam also, whom you madest lord of all your creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom you have chosen.
verses.text: And after these, Adam also, whom you madest lord of all your creatures: of him come we all, and the people also whom you have chosen.

verses.raw: All this have I spoken before you, O Yahuah (God), because you madest the world for our sakes
verses.text: All this have I spoken before you, O Yahuah, because you madest the world for our sakes

verses.raw: As for the other people, which also come of Adam, you have said that they are nothing, but be like to spittle: and have likened the abundance of them to a drop that falls from a vessel.
verses.text: As for the other people, which also come of Adam, you have said that they are nothing, but be like to spittle: and have likened the abundance of them to a drop that falls from a vessel.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah (God), behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah, behold, these heathen, which have ever been reputed as nothing, have begun to be lords over us, and to devour us.

verses.raw: But we your people, whom you have called your firstborn, your only begotten, and your fervent lover, are given into their hands.
verses.text: But we your people, whom you have called your firstborn, your only begotten, and your fervent lover, are given into their hands.

verses.raw: If the world now be made for our sakes, why do we not possess an inheritance with the world? how long shall this endure? ⸻
verses.text: If the world now be made for our sakes, why do we not possess an inheritance with the world? how long shall this endure? ⸻

verses.raw: And when I had made an end of speaking these words, there was sent to me the angel which had been sent to me the nights afore:
verses.text: And when I had made an end of speaking these words, there was sent to me the angel which had been sent to me the nights afore:

verses.raw: And he said to me, Up, Esdras, and hear the words that I am come to tell you.
verses.text: And he said to me, Up, Esdras, and hear the words that I am come to tell you.

verses.raw: And I said, Speak on, my Elohim (God). Then said he to me, The sea is set in a wide place, that it might be deep and great.
verses.text: And I said, Speak on, my Elohim. Then said he to me, The sea is set in a wide place, that it might be deep and great.

verses.raw: But put the case the entrance were narrow, and like a river;
verses.text: But put the case the entrance were narrow, and like a river;

verses.raw: Who then could go into the sea to look upon it, and to rule it? if he went not through the narrow, how could he come into the broad?
verses.text: Who then could go into the sea to look upon it, and to rule it? if he went not through the narrow, how could he come into the broad?

verses.raw: There is also another thing; A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things:
verses.text: There is also another thing; A city is builded, and set upon a broad field, and is full of all good things:

verses.raw: The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water:
verses.text: The entrance thereof is narrow, and is set in a dangerous place to fall, like as if there were a fire on the right hand, and on the left a deep water:

verses.raw: And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so small that there could but one man go there at once.
verses.text: And one only path between them both, even between the fire and the water, so small that there could but one man go there at once.

verses.raw: If this city now were given to a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance?
verses.text: If this city now were given to a man for an inheritance, if he never shall pass the danger set before it, how shall he receive this inheritance?

verses.raw: And I said, It is so, Yahuah (God). Then said he to me, Even so also is Yashar'el (Israel)’s portion.
verses.text: And I said, It is so, Yahuah. Then said he to me, Even so also is Yashar'el’s portion.

verses.raw: Because for their sakes I made the world: and when Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done.
verses.text: Because for their sakes I made the world: and when Adam transgressed my statutes, then was decreed that now is done.

verses.raw: Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail: they are but few and evil, full of perils, and very painful.
verses.text: Then were the entrances of this world made narrow, full of sorrow and travail: they are but few and evil, full of perils, and very painful.

verses.raw: For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.
verses.text: For the entrances of the elder world were wide and sure, and brought immortal fruit.

verses.raw: If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.
verses.text: If then they that live labour not to enter these strait and vain things, they can never receive those that are laid up for them.

verses.raw: Now therefore why disquietest you thyself, seeing you are but a corruptible man? and why art you moved, whereas you are but mortal?
verses.text: Now therefore why disquietest you thyself, seeing you are but a corruptible man? and why art you moved, whereas you are but mortal?

verses.raw: Why have you not considered in your mind this thing that is to come, rather than that which is present?
verses.text: Why have you not considered in your mind this thing that is to come, rather than that which is present?

verses.raw: Then answered I and said, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, you have ordained in your law, that the righteous should inherit these things, but that the ungodly should perish.
verses.text: Then answered I and said, O Yahuah that bearest rule, you have ordained in your law, that the righteous should inherit these things, but that the ungodly should perish.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide: for they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.
verses.text: Nevertheless the righteous shall suffer strait things, and hope for wide: for they that have done wickedly have suffered the strait things, and yet shall not see the wide.

verses.raw: And he said to me. There is no judge above Yahuah (God), and none that has understanding above the Highest.
verses.text: And he said to me. There is no judge above Yahuah, and none that has understanding above the Highest.

verses.raw: For there be many that perish in this life, because they despise the law of Yahuah (God) that is set before them.
verses.text: For there be many that perish in this life, because they despise the law of Yahuah that is set before them.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) has given strait commandment to such as came, what they should do to live, even as they came, and what they should observe to avoid punishment.
verses.text: For Yahuah has given strait commandment to such as came, what they should do to live, even as they came, and what they should observe to avoid punishment.

verses.raw: Nevertheless they were not obedient to him; but spoke against him, and imagined vain things;
verses.text: Nevertheless they were not obedient to him; but spoke against him, and imagined vain things;

verses.raw: And deceived themselves by their wicked deeds; and said of the Most High, that he is not; and knew not his ways:
verses.text: And deceived themselves by their wicked deeds; and said of the Most High, that he is not; and knew not his ways:

verses.raw: But his law have they despised, and denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.
verses.text: But his law have they despised, and denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.

verses.raw: And therefore, Esdras, for the empty are empty things, and for the full are the full things.
verses.text: And therefore, Esdras, for the empty are empty things, and for the full are the full things.

verses.raw: Behold, the time shall come, that these tokens which I have told you shall come to pass, and the bride shall appear, and she coming forth shall be seen, that now is withdrawn from the earth.
verses.text: Behold, the time shall come, that these tokens which I have told you shall come to pass, and the bride shall appear, and she coming forth shall be seen, that now is withdrawn from the earth.

verses.raw: And whoever is delivered from the foresaid evils shall see my wonders.
verses.text: And whoever is delivered from the foresaid evils shall see my wonders.

verses.raw: For my son the Messiah shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.
verses.text: For my son the Messiah shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.

verses.raw: After these years shall my son Messiah (Christ) die, and all men that have life.
verses.text: After these years shall my son Messiah die, and all men that have life.

verses.raw: And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.
verses.text: And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.

verses.raw: And after seven days the world, that yet awakes not, shall be raised up, and that shall die that is corrupt
verses.text: And after seven days the world, that yet awakes not, shall be raised up, and that shall die that is corrupt

verses.raw: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.
verses.text: And the earth shall restore those that are asleep in her, and so shall the dust those that dwell in silence, and the secret places shall deliver those souls that were committed to them.

verses.raw: And the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:
verses.text: And the Most High shall appear upon the seat of judgment, and misery shall pass away, and the long suffering shall have an end:

verses.raw: But judgment only shall remain, truth shall stand, and faith shall wax strong:
verses.text: But judgment only shall remain, truth shall stand, and faith shall wax strong:

verses.raw: And the work shall follow, and the reward shall be shewed, and the good deeds shall be of force, and wicked deeds shall bear no rule.
verses.text: And the work shall follow, and the reward shall be shewed, and the good deeds shall be of force, and wicked deeds shall bear no rule.

verses.raw: Then said I, Abraham prayed first for the Sodomites, and Moses for the fathers that sinned in the wilderness:
verses.text: Then said I, Abraham prayed first for the Sodomites, and Moses for the fathers that sinned in the wilderness:

verses.raw: And Jesus after him for Yashar'el (Israel) in the time of Achan:
verses.text: And Jesus after him for Yashar'el in the time of Achan:

verses.raw: And Samuel and David for the destruction: and Solomon for them that should come to the sanctuary:
verses.text: And Samuel and David for the destruction: and Solomon for them that should come to the sanctuary:

verses.raw: And Helias for those that received rain; and for the dead, that he might live:
verses.text: And Helias for those that received rain; and for the dead, that he might live:

verses.raw: And Ezechias for the people in the time of Sennacherib: and many for many.
verses.text: And Ezechias for the people in the time of Sennacherib: and many for many.

verses.raw: Even so now, seeing corruption is grown up, and wickedness increased, and the righteous have prayed for the ungodly: wherefore shall it not be so now also?
verses.text: Even so now, seeing corruption is grown up, and wickedness increased, and the righteous have prayed for the ungodly: wherefore shall it not be so now also?

verses.raw: He answered me, and said, This present life is not the end where much glory does abide; therefore have they prayed for the weak.
verses.text: He answered me, and said, This present life is not the end where much glory does abide; therefore have they prayed for the weak.

verses.raw: But the day of doom shall be the end of this time, and the beginning of the immortality for to come, in which corruption is past,
verses.text: But the day of doom shall be the end of this time, and the beginning of the immortality for to come, in which corruption is past,

verses.raw: Intemperance is at an end, infidelity is cut off, righteousness is grown, and truth is sprung up.
verses.text: Intemperance is at an end, infidelity is cut off, righteousness is grown, and truth is sprung up.

verses.raw: Then shall no man be able to save him that is destroyed, nor to oppress him that has gotten the victory.
verses.text: Then shall no man be able to save him that is destroyed, nor to oppress him that has gotten the victory.

verses.raw: I answered then and said, This is my first and last saying, that it had been better not to have given the earth to Adam: or else, when it was given him, to have restrained him from sinning.
verses.text: I answered then and said, This is my first and last saying, that it had been better not to have given the earth to Adam: or else, when it was given him, to have restrained him from sinning.

verses.raw: For what profit is it for men now in this present time to live in heaviness, and after death to look for punishment?
verses.text: For what profit is it for men now in this present time to live in heaviness, and after death to look for punishment?

verses.raw: O you Adam, what have you done? for though it was you that sinned, you are not fallen alone, but we all that come of you.
verses.text: O you Adam, what have you done? for though it was you that sinned, you are not fallen alone, but we all that come of you.

verses.raw: For what profit is it to us, if there be promised us an immortal time, whereas we have done the works that bring death?
verses.text: For what profit is it to us, if there be promised us an immortal time, whereas we have done the works that bring death?

verses.raw: And that there is promised us an everlasting hope, whereas ourselves being most wicked are made vain?
verses.text: And that there is promised us an everlasting hope, whereas ourselves being most wicked are made vain?

verses.raw: And that there are laid up for us dwellings of health and safety, whereas we have lived wickedly?
verses.text: And that there are laid up for us dwellings of health and safety, whereas we have lived wickedly?

verses.raw: And that the glory of the Most High is kept to defend them which have led a wary life, whereas we have walked in the most wicked ways of all?
verses.text: And that the glory of the Most High is kept to defend them which have led a wary life, whereas we have walked in the most wicked ways of all?

verses.raw: And that there should be shewed a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, in which is security and medicine, since we shall not enter into it?
verses.text: And that there should be shewed a paradise, whose fruit endureth for ever, in which is security and medicine, since we shall not enter into it?

verses.raw: (For we have walked in unpleasant places.)
verses.text: (For we have walked in unpleasant places.)

verses.raw: And that the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars, whereas our faces shall be blacker than darkness?
verses.text: And that the faces of them which have used abstinence shall shine above the stars, whereas our faces shall be blacker than darkness?

verses.raw: For while we lived and committed iniquity, we considered not that we should begin to suffer for it after death.
verses.text: For while we lived and committed iniquity, we considered not that we should begin to suffer for it after death.

verses.raw: Then answered he me, and said, This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight;
verses.text: Then answered he me, and said, This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight;

verses.raw: That, if he be overcome, he shall suffer as you have said: but if he get the victory, he shall receive the thing that I say.
verses.text: That, if he be overcome, he shall suffer as you have said: but if he get the victory, he shall receive the thing that I say.

verses.raw: For this is the life of which Moses spoke to the people while he lived, saying, Choose you life, that you may live.
verses.text: For this is the life of which Moses spoke to the people while he lived, saying, Choose you life, that you may live.

verses.raw: Nevertheless they believed not him, nor yet the prophets after him, no nor me which have spoken to them,
verses.text: Nevertheless they believed not him, nor yet the prophets after him, no nor me which have spoken to them,

verses.raw: That there should not be such heaviness in their destruction, as shall be joy over them that are persuaded to salvation.
verses.text: That there should not be such heaviness in their destruction, as shall be joy over them that are persuaded to salvation.

verses.raw: I answered then, and said, I know, Yahuah (God), that the Most High is called merciful, in that he has mercy upon them which are not yet come into the world,
verses.text: I answered then, and said, I know, Yahuah, that the Most High is called merciful, in that he has mercy upon them which are not yet come into the world,

verses.raw: And upon those also that turn to his law;
verses.text: And upon those also that turn to his law;

verses.raw: And that he is patient, and long suffers those that have sinned, as his creatures;
verses.text: And that he is patient, and long suffers those that have sinned, as his creatures;

verses.raw: And that he is bountiful, for he is ready to give where it needeth;
verses.text: And that he is bountiful, for he is ready to give where it needeth;

verses.raw: And that he is of great mercy, for he multiplieth more and more mercies to them that are present, and that are past, and also to them which are to come.
verses.text: And that he is of great mercy, for he multiplieth more and more mercies to them that are present, and that are past, and also to them which are to come.

verses.raw: For if he shall not multiply his mercies, the world would not continue with them that inherit in it.
verses.text: For if he shall not multiply his mercies, the world would not continue with them that inherit in it.

verses.raw: And he pardoneth; for if he did not so of his goodness, that they which have committed iniquities might be eased of them, the ten thousandth part of men should not remain living.
verses.text: And he pardoneth; for if he did not so of his goodness, that they which have committed iniquities might be eased of them, the ten thousandth part of men should not remain living.

verses.raw: And being judge, if he should not forgive them that are cured with his word, and put out the multitude of contentions,
verses.text: And being judge, if he should not forgive them that are cured with his word, and put out the multitude of contentions,

verses.raw: There should be very few left perhaps in an innumerable multitude. ⸻
verses.text: There should be very few left perhaps in an innumerable multitude. ⸻

verses.raw: And he answered me, saying, The most High has made this world for many, but the world to come for few.
verses.text: And he answered me, saying, The most High has made this world for many, but the world to come for few.

verses.raw: I will tell you a similitude, Esdras; As when you ask the earth, it shall say to you, that it gives much mould of which earthen vessels are made, but little dust that gold comes of: even so is the course of this present world.
verses.text: I will tell you a similitude, Esdras; As when you ask the earth, it shall say to you, that it gives much mould of which earthen vessels are made, but little dust that gold comes of: even so is the course of this present world.

verses.raw: There be many created, but few shall be saved.
verses.text: There be many created, but few shall be saved.

verses.raw: So answered I and said, Swallow then down, O my soul, understanding, and devour wisdom.
verses.text: So answered I and said, Swallow then down, O my soul, understanding, and devour wisdom.

verses.raw: For you have agreed to give ear, and art willing to prophesy: for you have no longer space than only to live.
verses.text: For you have agreed to give ear, and art willing to prophesy: for you have no longer space than only to live.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), if you suffer not your servant, that we may pray before you, and you give us seed to our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it; how shall each man live that is corrupt, who bears the place of a man?
verses.text: O Yahuah, if you suffer not your servant, that we may pray before you, and you give us seed to our heart, and culture to our understanding, that there may come fruit of it; how shall each man live that is corrupt, who bears the place of a man?

verses.raw: For you are alone, and we all one workmanship of yours hands, like as you have said.
verses.text: For you are alone, and we all one workmanship of yours hands, like as you have said.

verses.raw: For when the body is fashioned now in the mother’s womb, and you give it members, your creature is preserved in fire and water, and nine months does your workmanship endure your creature which is created in her.
verses.text: For when the body is fashioned now in the mother’s womb, and you give it members, your creature is preserved in fire and water, and nine months does your workmanship endure your creature which is created in her.

verses.raw: But that which keepeth and is kept shall both be preserved: and when the time comes, the womb preserved delivers up the things that grew in it.
verses.text: But that which keepeth and is kept shall both be preserved: and when the time comes, the womb preserved delivers up the things that grew in it.

verses.raw: For you have commanded out of the parts of the body, that is to say, out of the breasts, milk to be given, which is the fruit of the breasts,
verses.text: For you have commanded out of the parts of the body, that is to say, out of the breasts, milk to be given, which is the fruit of the breasts,

verses.raw: That the thing which is fashioned may be nourished for a time, till you disposest it to your mercy.
verses.text: That the thing which is fashioned may be nourished for a time, till you disposest it to your mercy.

verses.raw: You broughtest it up with your righteousness, and nurturedst it in your law, and reformedst it with your judgment.
verses.text: You broughtest it up with your righteousness, and nurturedst it in your law, and reformedst it with your judgment.

verses.raw: And you shall mortify it as your creature, and quicken it as your work.
verses.text: And you shall mortify it as your creature, and quicken it as your work.

verses.raw: If therefore you shall destroy him which with so great labour was fashioned, it is an easy thing to be ordained by your commandment, that the thing which was made might be preserved.
verses.text: If therefore you shall destroy him which with so great labour was fashioned, it is an easy thing to be ordained by your commandment, that the thing which was made might be preserved.

verses.raw: Now therefore, Yahuah (God), I will speak; touching man in general, you know best; but touching your people, for whose sake I am sorry;
verses.text: Now therefore, Yahuah, I will speak; touching man in general, you know best; but touching your people, for whose sake I am sorry;

verses.raw: And for your inheritance, for whose cause I mourn; and for Yashar'el (Israel), for whom I am heavy; and for Jacob, for whose sake I am troubled;
verses.text: And for your inheritance, for whose cause I mourn; and for Yashar'el, for whom I am heavy; and for Jacob, for whose sake I am troubled;

verses.raw: Therefore will I begin to pray before you for myself and for them: for I see the falls of us that dwell in the land.
verses.text: Therefore will I begin to pray before you for myself and for them: for I see the falls of us that dwell in the land.

verses.raw: But I have heard the swiftness of the judge which is to come.
verses.text: But I have heard the swiftness of the judge which is to come.

verses.raw: Therefore hear my voice, and understand my words, and I shall speak before you. This is the beginning of the words of Esdras, before he was taken up: and I said,
verses.text: Therefore hear my voice, and understand my words, and I shall speak before you. This is the beginning of the words of Esdras, before he was taken up: and I said,

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), you that dwellest in everlastingness which beholdest from above things in the heaven and in the air;
verses.text: O Yahuah, you that dwellest in everlastingness which beholdest from above things in the heaven and in the air;

verses.raw: Whose throne is inestimable; whose glory may not be comprehended; before whom the hosts of angels stand with trembling,
verses.text: Whose throne is inestimable; whose glory may not be comprehended; before whom the hosts of angels stand with trembling,

verses.raw: Whose service is conversant in wind and fire; whose word is true, and sayings constant; whose commandment is strong, and ordinance fearful;
verses.text: Whose service is conversant in wind and fire; whose word is true, and sayings constant; whose commandment is strong, and ordinance fearful;

verses.raw: Whose look drieth up the depths, and indignation makes the mountains to melt away; which the truth witnesseth:
verses.text: Whose look drieth up the depths, and indignation makes the mountains to melt away; which the truth witnesseth:

verses.raw: O hear the prayer of your servant, and give ear to the petition of your creature.
verses.text: O hear the prayer of your servant, and give ear to the petition of your creature.

verses.raw: For while I live I will speak, and so long as I have understanding I will answer.
verses.text: For while I live I will speak, and so long as I have understanding I will answer.

verses.raw: O look not upon the sins of your people; but on them which serve you in truth.
verses.text: O look not upon the sins of your people; but on them which serve you in truth.

verses.raw: Regard not the wicked inventions of the heathen, but the desire of those that keep your testimonies in afflictions.
verses.text: Regard not the wicked inventions of the heathen, but the desire of those that keep your testimonies in afflictions.

verses.raw: Think not upon those that have walked feignedly before you: but remember them, which according to your will have known your fear.
verses.text: Think not upon those that have walked feignedly before you: but remember them, which according to your will have known your fear.

verses.raw: Let it not be your will to destroy them which have lived like beasts; but to look upon them that have clearly taught your law.
verses.text: Let it not be your will to destroy them which have lived like beasts; but to look upon them that have clearly taught your law.

verses.raw: Take you no indignation at them which are deemed worse than beasts; but love them that always put their trust in your righteousness and glory.
verses.text: Take you no indignation at them which are deemed worse than beasts; but love them that always put their trust in your righteousness and glory.

verses.raw: For we and our fathers do languish of such diseases: but because of us sinners you shall be called merciful.
verses.text: For we and our fathers do languish of such diseases: but because of us sinners you shall be called merciful.

verses.raw: For if you have a desire to have mercy upon us, you shall be called merciful, to us namely, that have no works of righteousness.
verses.text: For if you have a desire to have mercy upon us, you shall be called merciful, to us namely, that have no works of righteousness.

verses.raw: For the just, which have many good works laid up with you, shall out of their own deeds receive reward.
verses.text: For the just, which have many good works laid up with you, shall out of their own deeds receive reward.

verses.raw: For what is man, that you should take displeasure at him? or what is a corruptible generation, that you should be so bitter toward it?
verses.text: For what is man, that you should take displeasure at him? or what is a corruptible generation, that you should be so bitter toward it?

verses.raw: For in truth them is no man among them that be born, but he has dealt wickedly; and among the faithful there is none which has not done amiss.
verses.text: For in truth them is no man among them that be born, but he has dealt wickedly; and among the faithful there is none which has not done amiss.

verses.raw: For in this, O Yahuah (God), your righteousness and your goodness shall be declared, if you be merciful to them which have not the confidence of good works.
verses.text: For in this, O Yahuah, your righteousness and your goodness shall be declared, if you be merciful to them which have not the confidence of good works.

verses.raw: Then answered he me, and said, Some things have you spoken aright, and according to your words it shall be.
verses.text: Then answered he me, and said, Some things have you spoken aright, and according to your words it shall be.

verses.raw: For indeed I will not think on the disposition of them which have sinned before death, before judgment, before destruction:
verses.text: For indeed I will not think on the disposition of them which have sinned before death, before judgment, before destruction:

verses.raw: But I will rejoice over the disposition of the righteous, and I will remember also their pilgrimage, and the salvation, and the reward, that they shall have.
verses.text: But I will rejoice over the disposition of the righteous, and I will remember also their pilgrimage, and the salvation, and the reward, that they shall have.

verses.raw: Like as I have spoken now, so shall it come to pass.
verses.text: Like as I have spoken now, so shall it come to pass.

verses.raw: For as the husbandman sows much seed upon the ground, and planteth many trees, and yet the thing that is sown good in his season comes not up, neither does all that is planted take root: even so is it of them that are sown in the world; they shall not all be saved.
verses.text: For as the husbandman sows much seed upon the ground, and planteth many trees, and yet the thing that is sown good in his season comes not up, neither does all that is planted take root: even so is it of them that are sown in the world; they shall not all be saved.

verses.raw: I answered then and said, If I have found grace, let me speak.
verses.text: I answered then and said, If I have found grace, let me speak.

verses.raw: Like as the husbandman’s seed perishes, if it come not up, and receive not your rain in due season; or if there come too much rain, and corrupt it:
verses.text: Like as the husbandman’s seed perishes, if it come not up, and receive not your rain in due season; or if there come too much rain, and corrupt it:

verses.raw: Even so perishes man also, which is formed with your hands, and is called your own image, because you are like to him, for whose sake you have made all things, and likened him to the husbandman’s seed.
verses.text: Even so perishes man also, which is formed with your hands, and is called your own image, because you are like to him, for whose sake you have made all things, and likened him to the husbandman’s seed.

verses.raw: Be not wroth with us but spare your people, and have mercy upon your own inheritance: for you are merciful to your creature.
verses.text: Be not wroth with us but spare your people, and have mercy upon your own inheritance: for you are merciful to your creature.

verses.raw: Then answered he me, and said, Things present are for the present, and things to comes for such as be to come.
verses.text: Then answered he me, and said, Things present are for the present, and things to comes for such as be to come.

verses.raw: For you come far short that you should be able to love my creature more than I: but I have ofttimes drawn nigh to you, and to it, but never to the unrighteous.
verses.text: For you come far short that you should be able to love my creature more than I: but I have ofttimes drawn nigh to you, and to it, but never to the unrighteous.

verses.raw: In this also you are marvellous before the Most High:
verses.text: In this also you are marvellous before the Most High:

verses.raw: In that you have humbled thyself, as it becometh you, and have not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.
verses.text: In that you have humbled thyself, as it becometh you, and have not judged thyself worthy to be much glorified among the righteous.

verses.raw: For many great miseries shall be done to them that in the latter time shall dwell in the world, because they have walked in great pride.
verses.text: For many great miseries shall be done to them that in the latter time shall dwell in the world, because they have walked in great pride.

verses.raw: But understand you for thyself, and seek out the glory for such as be like you.
verses.text: But understand you for thyself, and seek out the glory for such as be like you.

verses.raw: For to you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yes, perfect goodness and wisdom.
verses.text: For to you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yes, perfect goodness and wisdom.

verses.raw: The root of evil is sealed up from you, weakness and the moth is hid from you, and corruption is fled into hell to be forgotten:
verses.text: The root of evil is sealed up from you, weakness and the moth is hid from you, and corruption is fled into hell to be forgotten:

verses.raw: Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality.
verses.text: Sorrows are passed, and in the end is shewed the treasure of immortality.

verses.raw: And therefore ask you no more questions concerning the multitude of them that perish.
verses.text: And therefore ask you no more questions concerning the multitude of them that perish.

verses.raw: For when they had taken liberty, they despised the Most High, thought scorn of his law, and forsook his ways.
verses.text: For when they had taken liberty, they despised the Most High, thought scorn of his law, and forsook his ways.

verses.raw: Moreover they have trodden down his righteous,
verses.text: Moreover they have trodden down his righteous,

verses.raw: And said in their heart, that there is no Yahuah (God); yes, and that knowing they must die.
verses.text: And said in their heart, that there is no Yahuah; yes, and that knowing they must die.

verses.raw: For as the things aforesaid shall receive you, so thirst and pain are prepared for them: for it was not his will that men should come to nought:
verses.text: For as the things aforesaid shall receive you, so thirst and pain are prepared for them: for it was not his will that men should come to nought:

verses.raw: But they which be created have defiled the name of him that made them, and were unthankful to him which prepared life for them.
verses.text: But they which be created have defiled the name of him that made them, and were unthankful to him which prepared life for them.

verses.raw: And therefore is my judgment now at hand.
verses.text: And therefore is my judgment now at hand.

verses.raw: These things have I not shewed to all men, but to you, and a few like you. Then answered I and said,
verses.text: These things have I not shewed to all men, but to you, and a few like you. Then answered I and said,

verses.raw: Behold, O Yahuah (God), now have you shewed me the multitude of the wonders, which you will begin to do in the last times: but at what time, you have not shewed me. ⸻
verses.text: Behold, O Yahuah, now have you shewed me the multitude of the wonders, which you will begin to do in the last times: but at what time, you have not shewed me. ⸻

verses.raw: He answered me then, and said, Measure you the time diligently in itself: and when you see part of the signs past, which I have told you before,
verses.text: He answered me then, and said, Measure you the time diligently in itself: and when you see part of the signs past, which I have told you before,

verses.raw: Then shall you understand, that it is the very same time, in which the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.
verses.text: Then shall you understand, that it is the very same time, in which the Highest will begin to visit the world which he made.

verses.raw: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world:
verses.text: Therefore when there shall be seen earthquakes and uproars of the people in the world:

verses.raw: Then shall you well understand, that the Most High spoke of those things from the days that were before you, even from the beginning.
verses.text: Then shall you well understand, that the Most High spoke of those things from the days that were before you, even from the beginning.

verses.raw: For like as all that is made in the world has a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest:
verses.text: For like as all that is made in the world has a beginning and an end, and the end is manifest:

verses.raw: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.
verses.text: Even so the times also of the Highest have plain beginnings in wonder and powerful works, and endings in effects and signs.

verses.raw: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, by which you have believed,
verses.text: And every one that shall be saved, and shall be able to escape by his works, and by faith, by which you have believed,

verses.raw: Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.
verses.text: Shall be preserved from the said perils, and shall see my salvation in my land, and within my borders: for I have sanctified them for me from the beginning.

verses.raw: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.
verses.text: Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully shall dwell in torments.

verses.raw: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me;
verses.text: For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me;

verses.raw: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open to them, understood not, but despised it;
verses.text: And they that have loathed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open to them, understood not, but despised it;

verses.raw: The same must know it after death by pain.
verses.text: The same must know it after death by pain.

verses.raw: And therefore be you not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved, whose the world is, and for whom the world is created.
verses.text: And therefore be you not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved, whose the world is, and for whom the world is created.

verses.raw: Then answered I and said,
verses.text: Then answered I and said,

verses.raw: I have said before, and now do speak, and will speak it also hereafter, that there be many more of them which perish, than of them which shall be saved:
verses.text: I have said before, and now do speak, and will speak it also hereafter, that there be many more of them which perish, than of them which shall be saved:

verses.raw: Like as a wave is greater than a drop.
verses.text: Like as a wave is greater than a drop.

verses.raw: And he answered me, saying, Like as the field is, so is also the seed; as the flowers be, such are the colours also; such as the workman is, such also is the work; and as the husbandman is himself, so is his husbandry also: for it was the time of the world.
verses.text: And he answered me, saying, Like as the field is, so is also the seed; as the flowers be, such are the colours also; such as the workman is, such also is the work; and as the husbandman is himself, so is his husbandry also: for it was the time of the world.

verses.raw: And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spoke against me.
verses.text: And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spoke against me.

verses.raw: For then every one obeyed: but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed, and by a law which is unsearchable rid themselves.
verses.text: For then every one obeyed: but now the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed, and by a law which is unsearchable rid themselves.

verses.raw: So I considered the world, and, behold, there was peril because of the devices that were come into it.
verses.text: So I considered the world, and, behold, there was peril because of the devices that were come into it.

verses.raw: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.
verses.text: And I saw, and spared it greatly, and have kept me a grape of the cluster, and a plant of a great people.

verses.raw: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.
verses.text: Let the multitude perish then, which was born in vain; and let my grape be kept, and my plant; for with great labour have I made it perfect.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, if you will cease yet seven days more, (but you shall not fast in them,
verses.text: Nevertheless, if you will cease yet seven days more, (but you shall not fast in them,

verses.raw: But go into a field of flowers, where no house is builded, and eat only the flowers of the field; taste no flesh, drink no wine, but eat flowers only;)
verses.text: But go into a field of flowers, where no house is builded, and eat only the flowers of the field; taste no flesh, drink no wine, but eat flowers only;)

verses.raw: And pray to the Highest continually, then will I come and talk with you.
verses.text: And pray to the Highest continually, then will I come and talk with you.

verses.raw: So I went my way into the field which is called Ardath, like as he commanded me; and there I sat among the flowers, and did eat of the herbs of the field, and the meat of the same satisfied me.
verses.text: So I went my way into the field which is called Ardath, like as he commanded me; and there I sat among the flowers, and did eat of the herbs of the field, and the meat of the same satisfied me.

verses.raw: After seven days I sat upon the grass, and my heart was vexed within me, like as before:
verses.text: After seven days I sat upon the grass, and my heart was vexed within me, like as before:

verses.raw: And I opened my mouth, and began to talk before the Most High, and said,
verses.text: And I opened my mouth, and began to talk before the Most High, and said,

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), you that shewest thyself to us, you were shewed to our fathers in the wilderness, in a place where no man treadeth, in a barren place, when they came out of Egypt.
verses.text: O Yahuah, you that shewest thyself to us, you were shewed to our fathers in the wilderness, in a place where no man treadeth, in a barren place, when they came out of Egypt.

verses.raw: And you spakest saying, Hear me, O Yashar'el (Israel); and mark my words, you seed of Jacob.
verses.text: And you spakest saying, Hear me, O Yashar'el; and mark my words, you seed of Jacob.

verses.raw: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and you shall be honoured in it for ever.
verses.text: For, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and you shall be honoured in it for ever.

verses.raw: But our fathers, which received the law, kept it not, and observed not your ordinances: and though the fruit of your law did not perish, neither could it, for it was yours;
verses.text: But our fathers, which received the law, kept it not, and observed not your ordinances: and though the fruit of your law did not perish, neither could it, for it was yours;

verses.raw: Yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.
verses.text: Yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.

verses.raw: And, lo, it is a custom, when the ground has received seed, or the sea a ship, or any vessel meat or drink, that, that being perished in which it was sown or cast into,
verses.text: And, lo, it is a custom, when the ground has received seed, or the sea a ship, or any vessel meat or drink, that, that being perished in which it was sown or cast into,

verses.raw: That thing also which was sown, or cast in it, or received, does perish, and remains not with us: but with us it has not happened so.
verses.text: That thing also which was sown, or cast in it, or received, does perish, and remains not with us: but with us it has not happened so.

verses.raw: For we that have received the law perish by sin, and our heart also which received it
verses.text: For we that have received the law perish by sin, and our heart also which received it

verses.raw: Notwithstanding the law perishes not, but remains in his force.
verses.text: Notwithstanding the law perishes not, but remains in his force.

verses.raw: And when I spoke these things in my heart, I looked back with my eyes, and upon the right side I saw a woman, and, behold, she mourned and wept with a loud voice, and was much grieved in heart, and her clothes were rent, and she had ashes upon her head.
verses.text: And when I spoke these things in my heart, I looked back with my eyes, and upon the right side I saw a woman, and, behold, she mourned and wept with a loud voice, and was much grieved in heart, and her clothes were rent, and she had ashes upon her head.

verses.raw: Then let I my thoughts go that I was in, and turned me to her,
verses.text: Then let I my thoughts go that I was in, and turned me to her,

verses.raw: And said to her, Wherefore weepest you? why art you so grieved in your mind?
verses.text: And said to her, Wherefore weepest you? why art you so grieved in your mind?

verses.raw: And she said to me, Sir, let me alone, that I may bewail myself, and add to my sorrow, for I am sore vexed in my mind, and brought very low.
verses.text: And she said to me, Sir, let me alone, that I may bewail myself, and add to my sorrow, for I am sore vexed in my mind, and brought very low.

verses.raw: And I said to her, What aileth you? tell me.
verses.text: And I said to her, What aileth you? tell me.

verses.raw: She said to me, I your servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years,
verses.text: She said to me, I your servant have been barren, and had no child, though I had an husband thirty years,

verses.raw: And those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my, prayer to the Highest.
verses.text: And those thirty years I did nothing else day and night, and every hour, but make my, prayer to the Highest.

verses.raw: After thirty years Yahuah (God) heard me yours handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son: and I was very glad of him, so was my husband also, and all my neighbours: and we gave great honour to the Almighty.
verses.text: After thirty years Yahuah heard me yours handmaid, looked upon my misery, considered my trouble, and gave me a son: and I was very glad of him, so was my husband also, and all my neighbours: and we gave great honour to the Almighty.

verses.raw: And I nourished him with great travail.
verses.text: And I nourished him with great travail.

verses.raw: So when he grew up, and came to the time that he should have a wife, I made a feast. ⸻
verses.text: So when he grew up, and came to the time that he should have a wife, I made a feast. ⸻

verses.raw: And it so came to pass, that when my son was entered into his wedding chamber, he fell down, and died.
verses.text: And it so came to pass, that when my son was entered into his wedding chamber, he fell down, and died.

verses.raw: Then we all overthrew the lights, and all my neighbours rose up to comfort me: so I took my rest to the second day at night.
verses.text: Then we all overthrew the lights, and all my neighbours rose up to comfort me: so I took my rest to the second day at night.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when they had all left off to comfort me, to the end I might be quiet; then rose I up by night and fled, and came hither into this field, as you see.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when they had all left off to comfort me, to the end I might be quiet; then rose I up by night and fled, and came hither into this field, as you see.

verses.raw: And I do now purpose not to return into the city, but here to stay, and neither to eat nor drink, but continually to mourn and to fast until I die.
verses.text: And I do now purpose not to return into the city, but here to stay, and neither to eat nor drink, but continually to mourn and to fast until I die.

verses.raw: Then left I the meditations in which I was, and spoke to her in anger, saying,
verses.text: Then left I the meditations in which I was, and spoke to her in anger, saying,

verses.raw: You foolish woman above all other, seest you not our mourning, and what happeneth to us?
verses.text: You foolish woman above all other, seest you not our mourning, and what happeneth to us?

verses.raw: How that Sion our mother is full of all heaviness, and much humbled, mourning very sore?
verses.text: How that Sion our mother is full of all heaviness, and much humbled, mourning very sore?

verses.raw: And now, seeing we all mourn and are sad, for we are all in heaviness, art you grieved for one son?
verses.text: And now, seeing we all mourn and are sad, for we are all in heaviness, art you grieved for one son?

verses.raw: For ask the earth, and she shall tell you, that it is she which ought to mourn for the fall of so many that grow upon her.
verses.text: For ask the earth, and she shall tell you, that it is she which ought to mourn for the fall of so many that grow upon her.

verses.raw: For out of her came all at the first, and out of her shall all others come, and, behold, they walk almost all into destruction, and a multitude of them is utterly rooted out.
verses.text: For out of her came all at the first, and out of her shall all others come, and, behold, they walk almost all into destruction, and a multitude of them is utterly rooted out.

verses.raw: Who then should make more mourning than she, that has lost so great a multitude; and not you, which are sorry but for one?
verses.text: Who then should make more mourning than she, that has lost so great a multitude; and not you, which are sorry but for one?

verses.raw: But if you say to me, My lamentation is not like the earth’s, because I have lost the fruit of my womb, which I brought forth with pains, and bare with sorrows;
verses.text: But if you say to me, My lamentation is not like the earth’s, because I have lost the fruit of my womb, which I brought forth with pains, and bare with sorrows;

verses.raw: But the earth not so: for the multitude present in it according to the course of the earth is gone, as it came:
verses.text: But the earth not so: for the multitude present in it according to the course of the earth is gone, as it came:

verses.raw: Then say I to you, Like as you have brought forth with labour; even so the earth also has given her fruit, namely, man, ever since the beginning to him that made her.
verses.text: Then say I to you, Like as you have brought forth with labour; even so the earth also has given her fruit, namely, man, ever since the beginning to him that made her.

verses.raw: Now therefore keep your sorrow to thyself, and bear with a good courage that which has befallen you.
verses.text: Now therefore keep your sorrow to thyself, and bear with a good courage that which has befallen you.

verses.raw: For if you shall acknowledge the determination of Yahuah (God) to be just, you shall both receive your son in time, and shall be commended among women.
verses.text: For if you shall acknowledge the determination of Yahuah to be just, you shall both receive your son in time, and shall be commended among women.

verses.raw: Go your way then into the city to yours husband.
verses.text: Go your way then into the city to yours husband.

verses.raw: And she said to me, That will I not do: I will not go into the city, but here will I die.
verses.text: And she said to me, That will I not do: I will not go into the city, but here will I die.

verses.raw: So I proceeded to speak further to her, and said,
verses.text: So I proceeded to speak further to her, and said,

verses.raw: Do not so, but be counselled. by me: for how many are the adversities of Sion? be comforted in regard of the sorrow of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Do not so, but be counselled. by me: for how many are the adversities of Sion? be comforted in regard of the sorrow of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: For you see that our sanctuary is laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed;
verses.text: For you see that our sanctuary is laid waste, our altar broken down, our temple destroyed;

verses.raw: Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned: our children are put to shame, our priests are burnt, our Levites are gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled, and our wives ravished; our righteous men carried away, our little ones destroyed, our young men are brought in bondage, and our strong men are become weak;
verses.text: Our psaltery is laid on the ground, our song is put to silence, our rejoicing is at an end, the light of our candlestick is put out, the ark of our covenant is spoiled, our holy things are defiled, and the name that is called upon us is almost profaned: our children are put to shame, our priests are burnt, our Levites are gone into captivity, our virgins are defiled, and our wives ravished; our righteous men carried away, our little ones destroyed, our young men are brought in bondage, and our strong men are become weak;

verses.raw: And, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion has now lost her honour; for she is delivered into the hands of them that hate us.
verses.text: And, which is the greatest of all, the seal of Sion has now lost her honour; for she is delivered into the hands of them that hate us.

verses.raw: And therefore shake off your great heaviness, and put away the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty may be merciful to you again, and the Highest shall give you rest and ease from your labour.
verses.text: And therefore shake off your great heaviness, and put away the multitude of sorrows, that the Mighty may be merciful to you again, and the Highest shall give you rest and ease from your labour.

verses.raw: And it came to pass while I was talking with her, behold, her face upon a sudden shined exceedingly, and her countenance glistered, so that I was afraid of her, and mused what it might be.
verses.text: And it came to pass while I was talking with her, behold, her face upon a sudden shined exceedingly, and her countenance glistered, so that I was afraid of her, and mused what it might be.

verses.raw: And, behold, suddenly she made a great cry very fearful: so that the earth shook at the noise of the woman.
verses.text: And, behold, suddenly she made a great cry very fearful: so that the earth shook at the noise of the woman.

verses.raw: And I looked, and, behold, the woman appeared to me no more, but there was a city builded, and a large place shewed itself from the foundations: then was I afraid, and cried with a loud voice, and said,
verses.text: And I looked, and, behold, the woman appeared to me no more, but there was a city builded, and a large place shewed itself from the foundations: then was I afraid, and cried with a loud voice, and said,

verses.raw: Where is Uriel the angel, who came to me at the first? for he has caused me to fall into many trances, and my end is turned into corruption, and my prayer to rebuke.
verses.text: Where is Uriel the angel, who came to me at the first? for he has caused me to fall into many trances, and my end is turned into corruption, and my prayer to rebuke.

verses.raw: And as I was speaking these words behold, he came to me, and looked upon me.
verses.text: And as I was speaking these words behold, he came to me, and looked upon me.

verses.raw: And, lo, I lay as one that had been dead, and my understanding was taken from me: and he took me by the right hand, and comforted me, and set me upon my feet, and said to me,
verses.text: And, lo, I lay as one that had been dead, and my understanding was taken from me: and he took me by the right hand, and comforted me, and set me upon my feet, and said to me,

verses.raw: What aileth you? and why art you so disquieted? and why is your understanding troubled, and the thoughts of yours heart?
verses.text: What aileth you? and why art you so disquieted? and why is your understanding troubled, and the thoughts of yours heart?

verses.raw: And I said, Because you have forsaken me, and yet I did according to your words, and I went into the field, and, lo, I have seen, and yet see, that I am not able to express.
verses.text: And I said, Because you have forsaken me, and yet I did according to your words, and I went into the field, and, lo, I have seen, and yet see, that I am not able to express.

verses.raw: And he said to me, Stand up manfully, and I will advise you.
verses.text: And he said to me, Stand up manfully, and I will advise you.

verses.raw: Then said I, Speak on, my lord, in me; only forsake me not, lest I die frustrate of my hope.
verses.text: Then said I, Speak on, my lord, in me; only forsake me not, lest I die frustrate of my hope.

verses.raw: For I have seen that I knew not, and hear that I do not know.
verses.text: For I have seen that I knew not, and hear that I do not know.

verses.raw: Or is my sense deceived, or my soul in a dream?
verses.text: Or is my sense deceived, or my soul in a dream?

verses.raw: Now therefore I beseech you that you will shew your servant of this vision.
verses.text: Now therefore I beseech you that you will shew your servant of this vision.

verses.raw: He answered me then, and said, Hear me, and I shall inform you, and tell you wherefore you are afraid: for the Highest will reveal many secret things to you.
verses.text: He answered me then, and said, Hear me, and I shall inform you, and tell you wherefore you are afraid: for the Highest will reveal many secret things to you.

verses.raw: He has seen that your way is right: for that you sorrowest continually for your people, and makest great lamentation for Sion.
verses.text: He has seen that your way is right: for that you sorrowest continually for your people, and makest great lamentation for Sion.

verses.raw: This therefore is the meaning of the vision which you lately sawest:
verses.text: This therefore is the meaning of the vision which you lately sawest:

verses.raw: You sawest a woman mourning, and you begannest to comfort her:
verses.text: You sawest a woman mourning, and you begannest to comfort her:

verses.raw: But now seest you the likeness of the woman no more, but there appeared to you a city builded.
verses.text: But now seest you the likeness of the woman no more, but there appeared to you a city builded.

verses.raw: And whereas she told you of the death of her son, this is the solution:
verses.text: And whereas she told you of the death of her son, this is the solution:

verses.text: This woman, whom you sawest is Sion: and whereas she said to you, even she whom you see as a city builded,

verses.raw: Whereas, I say, she said to you, that she has been thirty years barren: those are the thirty years in which there was no offering made in her.
verses.text: Whereas, I say, she said to you, that she has been thirty years barren: those are the thirty years in which there was no offering made in her.

verses.raw: But after thirty years Solomon builded the city and offered offerings: and then bare the barren a son.
verses.text: But after thirty years Solomon builded the city and offered offerings: and then bare the barren a son.

verses.raw: And whereas she told you that she nourished him with labour: that was the dwelling in Jerusalem.
verses.text: And whereas she told you that she nourished him with labour: that was the dwelling in Jerusalem.

verses.raw: But whereas she said to you, That my son coming into his marriage chamber happened to have a fail, and died: this was the destruction that came to Jerusalem.
verses.text: But whereas she said to you, That my son coming into his marriage chamber happened to have a fail, and died: this was the destruction that came to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And, behold, you sawest her likeness, and because she mourned for her son, you begannest to comfort her: and of these things which have chanced, these are to be opened to you.
verses.text: And, behold, you sawest her likeness, and because she mourned for her son, you begannest to comfort her: and of these things which have chanced, these are to be opened to you.

verses.raw: For now the Most High seeth that you are grieved unfeignedly, and sufferest from your whole heart for her, so has he shewed you the brightness of her glory, and the comeliness of her beauty:
verses.text: For now the Most High seeth that you are grieved unfeignedly, and sufferest from your whole heart for her, so has he shewed you the brightness of her glory, and the comeliness of her beauty:

verses.raw: And therefore I told you remain in the field where no house was builded:
verses.text: And therefore I told you remain in the field where no house was builded:

verses.raw: For I knew that the Highest would shew this to you.
