verses.text: For I knew that the Highest would shew this to you.

verses.raw: Therefore I commanded you to go into the field, where no foundation of any building was.
verses.text: Therefore I commanded you to go into the field, where no foundation of any building was.

verses.raw: For in the place in which the Highest begins to shew his city, there can no man’s building be able to stand.
verses.text: For in the place in which the Highest begins to shew his city, there can no man’s building be able to stand.

verses.raw: And therefore fear not, let not yours heart be affrighted, but go your way in, and see the beauty and greatness of the building, as much as your eyes be able to see:
verses.text: And therefore fear not, let not yours heart be affrighted, but go your way in, and see the beauty and greatness of the building, as much as your eyes be able to see:

verses.raw: And then shall you hear as much as your ears may comprehend.
verses.text: And then shall you hear as much as your ears may comprehend.

verses.raw: For you are blessed above many other, and art called with the Highest; and so are but few.
verses.text: For you are blessed above many other, and art called with the Highest; and so are but few.

verses.raw: But to morrow at night you shall remain here;
verses.text: But to morrow at night you shall remain here;

verses.raw: And so shall the Highest shew you visions of the high things, which the Most High will do to them that dwell upon the earth in the last days. So I slept that night and another, like as he commanded me. ⸻
verses.text: And so shall the Highest shew you visions of the high things, which the Most High will do to them that dwell upon the earth in the last days. So I slept that night and another, like as he commanded me. ⸻

verses.raw: Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.
verses.text: Then saw I a dream, and, behold, there came up from the sea an eagle, which had twelve feathered wings, and three heads.

verses.raw: And I saw, and, behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the air blew on her, and were gathered together.
verses.text: And I saw, and, behold, she spread her wings over all the earth, and all the winds of the air blew on her, and were gathered together.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and out of her feathers there grew other contrary feathers; and they became little feathers and small.
verses.text: And I beheld, and out of her feathers there grew other contrary feathers; and they became little feathers and small.

verses.raw: But her heads were at rest: the head in the midst was greater than the other, yet rested it with the residue.
verses.text: But her heads were at rest: the head in the midst was greater than the other, yet rested it with the residue.

verses.raw: Moreover I beheld, and, lo, the eagle flew with her feathers, and reigned upon earth, and over them that dwelt in it.
verses.text: Moreover I beheld, and, lo, the eagle flew with her feathers, and reigned upon earth, and over them that dwelt in it.

verses.raw: And I saw that all things under heaven were subject to her, and no man spoke against her, no, not one creature upon earth.
verses.text: And I saw that all things under heaven were subject to her, and no man spoke against her, no, not one creature upon earth.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and, lo, the eagle rose upon her talons, and spoke to her feathers, saying,
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, the eagle rose upon her talons, and spoke to her feathers, saying,

verses.raw: Watch not all at once: sleep every one in his own place, and watch by course:
verses.text: Watch not all at once: sleep every one in his own place, and watch by course:

verses.raw: But let the heads be preserved for the last.
verses.text: But let the heads be preserved for the last.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and, lo, the voice went not out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, the voice went not out of her heads, but from the midst of her body.

verses.raw: And I numbered her contrary feathers, and, behold, there were eight of them.
verses.text: And I numbered her contrary feathers, and, behold, there were eight of them.

verses.raw: And I looked, and, behold, on the right side there arose one feather, and reigned over all the earth;
verses.text: And I looked, and, behold, on the right side there arose one feather, and reigned over all the earth;

verses.raw: And so it was, that when it reigned, the end of it came, and the place thereof appeared no more: so the next following stood up. and reigned, and had a great time;
verses.text: And so it was, that when it reigned, the end of it came, and the place thereof appeared no more: so the next following stood up. and reigned, and had a great time;

verses.raw: And it happened, that when it reigned, the end of it came also, like as the first, so that it appeared no more.
verses.text: And it happened, that when it reigned, the end of it came also, like as the first, so that it appeared no more.

verses.raw: Then came there a voice to it, and said,
verses.text: Then came there a voice to it, and said,

verses.raw: Hear you that have borne rule over the earth so long: this I say to you, before you beginnest to appear no more,
verses.text: Hear you that have borne rule over the earth so long: this I say to you, before you beginnest to appear no more,

verses.raw: There shall none after you attain to your time, neither to the half thereof.
verses.text: There shall none after you attain to your time, neither to the half thereof.

verses.raw: Then arose the third, and reigned as the other before, and appeared no more also.
verses.text: Then arose the third, and reigned as the other before, and appeared no more also.

verses.raw: So went it with all the residue one after another, as that every one reigned, and then appeared no more.
verses.text: So went it with all the residue one after another, as that every one reigned, and then appeared no more.

verses.raw: Then I beheld, and, lo, in process of time the feathers that followed stood up upon the right side, that they might rule also; and some of them ruled, but within a while they appeared no more:
verses.text: Then I beheld, and, lo, in process of time the feathers that followed stood up upon the right side, that they might rule also; and some of them ruled, but within a while they appeared no more:

verses.raw: For some of them were set up, but ruled not.
verses.text: For some of them were set up, but ruled not.

verses.raw: After this I looked, and, behold, the twelve feathers appeared no more, nor the two little feathers:
verses.text: After this I looked, and, behold, the twelve feathers appeared no more, nor the two little feathers:

verses.raw: And there was no more upon the eagle’s body, but three heads that rested, and six little wings.
verses.text: And there was no more upon the eagle’s body, but three heads that rested, and six little wings.

verses.raw: Then saw I also that two little feathers divided themselves from the six, and remained under the head that was upon the right side: for the four continued in their place.
verses.text: Then saw I also that two little feathers divided themselves from the six, and remained under the head that was upon the right side: for the four continued in their place.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and, lo, the feathers that were under the wing thought to set up themselves and to have the rule.
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, the feathers that were under the wing thought to set up themselves and to have the rule.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and, lo, there was one set up, but shortly it appeared no more.
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, there was one set up, but shortly it appeared no more.

verses.raw: And the second was sooner away than the first.
verses.text: And the second was sooner away than the first.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and, lo, the two that remained thought also in themselves to reign:
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, the two that remained thought also in themselves to reign:

verses.raw: And when they so thought, behold, there awaked one of the heads that were at rest, namely, it that was in the midst; for that was greater than the two other heads.
verses.text: And when they so thought, behold, there awaked one of the heads that were at rest, namely, it that was in the midst; for that was greater than the two other heads.

verses.raw: And then I saw that the two other heads were joined with it.
verses.text: And then I saw that the two other heads were joined with it.

verses.raw: And, behold, the head was turned with them that were with it, and did eat up the two feathers under the wing that would have reigned.
verses.text: And, behold, the head was turned with them that were with it, and did eat up the two feathers under the wing that would have reigned.

verses.raw: But this head put the whole earth in fear, and bare rule in it over all those that dwelt upon the earth with much oppression; and it had the governance of the world more than all the wings that had been.
verses.text: But this head put the whole earth in fear, and bare rule in it over all those that dwelt upon the earth with much oppression; and it had the governance of the world more than all the wings that had been.

verses.raw: And after this I beheld, and, lo, the head that was in the midst suddenly appeared no more, like as the wings.
verses.text: And after this I beheld, and, lo, the head that was in the midst suddenly appeared no more, like as the wings.

verses.raw: But there remained the two heads, which also in like sort ruled upon the earth, and over those that dwelt in it.
verses.text: But there remained the two heads, which also in like sort ruled upon the earth, and over those that dwelt in it.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and, lo, the head upon the right side devoured it that was upon the left side.
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, the head upon the right side devoured it that was upon the left side.

verses.raw: Then I head a voice, which said to me, Look before you, and consider the thing that you see.
verses.text: Then I head a voice, which said to me, Look before you, and consider the thing that you see.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice to the eagle, and said,
verses.text: And I beheld, and lo, as it were a roaring lion chased out of the wood: and I saw that he sent out a man’s voice to the eagle, and said,

verses.raw: Hear you, I will talk with you, and the Highest shall say to you,
verses.text: Hear you, I will talk with you, and the Highest shall say to you,

verses.raw: Art not you it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?
verses.text: Art not you it that remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?

verses.raw: And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression; and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.
verses.text: And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression; and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.

verses.raw: For the earth have you not judged with truth.
verses.text: For the earth have you not judged with truth.

verses.raw: For you have afflicted the meek, you have hurt the peaceable, you have loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and have cast down the walls of such as did you no harm.
verses.text: For you have afflicted the meek, you have hurt the peaceable, you have loved liars, and destroyed the dwellings of them that brought forth fruit, and have cast down the walls of such as did you no harm.

verses.raw: Therefore is your wrongful dealing come up to the Highest, and your pride to the Mighty.
verses.text: Therefore is your wrongful dealing come up to the Highest, and your pride to the Mighty.

verses.raw: The Highest also has looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled.
verses.text: The Highest also has looked upon the proud times, and, behold, they are ended, and his abominations are fulfilled.

verses.raw: And therefore appear no more, you eagle, nor your horrible wings, nor your wicked feathers nor your malicious heads, nor your hurtful claws, nor all your vain body:
verses.text: And therefore appear no more, you eagle, nor your horrible wings, nor your wicked feathers nor your malicious heads, nor your hurtful claws, nor all your vain body:

verses.raw: That all the earth may be refreshed, and may return, being delivered from your violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her. ⸻
verses.text: That all the earth may be refreshed, and may return, being delivered from your violence, and that she may hope for the judgment and mercy of him that made her. ⸻

verses.raw: And it came to pass, whiles the lion spoke these words to the eagle, I saw,
verses.text: And it came to pass, whiles the lion spoke these words to the eagle, I saw,

verses.raw: And, behold, the head that remained and the four wings appeared no more, and the two went to it and set themselves up to reign, and their kingdom was small, and fill of uproar.
verses.text: And, behold, the head that remained and the four wings appeared no more, and the two went to it and set themselves up to reign, and their kingdom was small, and fill of uproar.

verses.raw: And I saw, and, behold, they appeared no more, and the whole body of the eagle was burnt so that the earth was in great fear: then awaked I out of the trouble and trance of my mind, and from great fear, and said to my spirit,
verses.text: And I saw, and, behold, they appeared no more, and the whole body of the eagle was burnt so that the earth was in great fear: then awaked I out of the trouble and trance of my mind, and from great fear, and said to my spirit,

verses.raw: Lo, this have you done to me, in that you searchest out the ways of the Highest.
verses.text: Lo, this have you done to me, in that you searchest out the ways of the Highest.

verses.raw: Lo, yet am I weary in my mind, and very weak in my spirit; and little strength is there in me, for the great fear with which I was afflicted this night.
verses.text: Lo, yet am I weary in my mind, and very weak in my spirit; and little strength is there in me, for the great fear with which I was afflicted this night.

verses.raw: Therefore will I now beseech the Highest, that he will comfort me to the end.
verses.text: Therefore will I now beseech the Highest, that he will comfort me to the end.

verses.raw: And I said, Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, if I have found grace before your sight, and if I am justified with you before many others, and if my prayer indeed be come up before your face;
verses.text: And I said, Yahuah that bearest rule, if I have found grace before your sight, and if I am justified with you before many others, and if my prayer indeed be come up before your face;

verses.raw: Comfort me then, and shew me your servant the interpretation and plain difference of this fearful vision, that you may perfectly comfort my soul.
verses.text: Comfort me then, and shew me your servant the interpretation and plain difference of this fearful vision, that you may perfectly comfort my soul.

verses.raw: For you have judged me worthy to shew me the last times.
verses.text: For you have judged me worthy to shew me the last times.

verses.raw: And he said to me, This is the interpretation of the vision:
verses.text: And he said to me, This is the interpretation of the vision:

verses.raw: The eagle, whom you sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of your brother Daniel.
verses.text: The eagle, whom you sawest come up from the sea, is the kingdom which was seen in the vision of your brother Daniel.

verses.raw: But it was not expounded to him, therefore now I declare it to you.
verses.text: But it was not expounded to him, therefore now I declare it to you.

verses.raw: Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it.
verses.text: Behold, the days will come, that there shall rise up a kingdom upon earth, and it shall be feared above all the kingdoms that were before it.

verses.raw: In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another:
verses.text: In the same shall twelve kings reign, one after another:

verses.raw: Of which the second shall begin to reign, and shall have more time than any of the twelve.
verses.text: Of which the second shall begin to reign, and shall have more time than any of the twelve.

verses.raw: And this do the twelve wings signify, which you sawest.
verses.text: And this do the twelve wings signify, which you sawest.

verses.raw: As for the voice which you heardest speak, and that you sawest not to go out from the heads but from the midst of the body thereof, this is the interpretation:
verses.text: As for the voice which you heardest speak, and that you sawest not to go out from the heads but from the midst of the body thereof, this is the interpretation:

verses.raw: That after the time of that kingdom there shall arise great strivings, and it shall stand in peril of failing: nevertheless it shall not then fall, but shall be restored again to his beginning.
verses.text: That after the time of that kingdom there shall arise great strivings, and it shall stand in peril of failing: nevertheless it shall not then fall, but shall be restored again to his beginning.

verses.raw: And whereas you sawest the eight small under feathers sticking to her wings, this is the interpretation:
verses.text: And whereas you sawest the eight small under feathers sticking to her wings, this is the interpretation:

verses.raw: That in him there shall arise eight kings, whose times shall be but small, and their years swift.
verses.text: That in him there shall arise eight kings, whose times shall be but small, and their years swift.

verses.raw: And two of them shall perish, the middle time approaching: four shall be kept until their end begin to approach: but two shall be kept to the end.
verses.text: And two of them shall perish, the middle time approaching: four shall be kept until their end begin to approach: but two shall be kept to the end.

verses.raw: And whereas you sawest three heads resting, this is the interpretation:
verses.text: And whereas you sawest three heads resting, this is the interpretation:

verses.raw: In his last days shall the Most High raise up three kingdoms, and renew many things in it, and they shall have the dominion of the earth,
verses.text: In his last days shall the Most High raise up three kingdoms, and renew many things in it, and they shall have the dominion of the earth,

verses.raw: And of those that dwell in it, with much oppression, above all those that were before them: therefore are they called the heads of the eagle.
verses.text: And of those that dwell in it, with much oppression, above all those that were before them: therefore are they called the heads of the eagle.

verses.raw: For these are they that shall accomplish his wickedness, and that shall finish his last end.
verses.text: For these are they that shall accomplish his wickedness, and that shall finish his last end.

verses.raw: And whereas you sawest that the great head appeared no more, it signifieth that one of them shall die upon his bed, and yet with pain.
verses.text: And whereas you sawest that the great head appeared no more, it signifieth that one of them shall die upon his bed, and yet with pain.

verses.raw: For the two that remain shall be slain with the sword.
verses.text: For the two that remain shall be slain with the sword.

verses.raw: For the sword of the one shall devour the other: but at the last shall he fall through the sword himself.
verses.text: For the sword of the one shall devour the other: but at the last shall he fall through the sword himself.

verses.raw: And whereas you sawest two feathers under the wings passing over the head that is on the right side;
verses.text: And whereas you sawest two feathers under the wings passing over the head that is on the right side;

verses.raw: It signifieth that these are they, whom the Highest has kept to their end: this is the small kingdom and full of trouble, as you sawest.
verses.text: It signifieth that these are they, whom the Highest has kept to their end: this is the small kingdom and full of trouble, as you sawest.

verses.raw: And the lion, whom you sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which you have heard;
verses.text: And the lion, whom you sawest rising up out of the wood, and roaring, and speaking to the eagle, and rebuking her for her unrighteousness with all the words which you have heard;

verses.raw: This is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them and for their wickedness to the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.
verses.text: This is the anointed, which the Highest has kept for them and for their wickedness to the end: he shall reprove them, and shall upbraid them with their cruelty.

verses.raw: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.
verses.text: For he shall set them before him alive in judgment, and shall rebuke them, and correct them.

verses.raw: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.
verses.text: For the rest of my people shall he deliver with mercy, those that have been pressed upon my borders, and he shall make them joyful until the coming of the day of judgment, of which I have spoken to you from the beginning.

verses.raw: This is the dream that you sawest, and these are the interpretations.
verses.text: This is the dream that you sawest, and these are the interpretations.

verses.raw: You only have been meet to know this secret of the Highest.
verses.text: You only have been meet to know this secret of the Highest.

verses.raw: Therefore write all these things that you have seen in a book, and hide them:
verses.text: Therefore write all these things that you have seen in a book, and hide them:

verses.raw: And teach them to the wise of the people, whose hearts you know may comprehend and keep these secrets.
verses.text: And teach them to the wise of the people, whose hearts you know may comprehend and keep these secrets.

verses.raw: But wait you here thyself yet seven days more, that it may be shewed you, whatsoever it pleaseth the Highest to declare to you. And with that he went his way.
verses.text: But wait you here thyself yet seven days more, that it may be shewed you, whatsoever it pleaseth the Highest to declare to you. And with that he went his way.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when all the people saw that the seven days were past, and I not come again into the city, they gathered them all together, from the least to the greatest, and came to me, and said,
verses.text: And it came to pass, when all the people saw that the seven days were past, and I not come again into the city, they gathered them all together, from the least to the greatest, and came to me, and said,

verses.raw: What have we offended you? and what evil have we done against you, that you forsakest us, and sittest here in this place?
verses.text: What have we offended you? and what evil have we done against you, that you forsakest us, and sittest here in this place?

verses.raw: For of all the prophets you only art left us, as a cluster of the vintage, and as a candle in a dark place, and as a haven or ship preserved from the tempest.
verses.text: For of all the prophets you only art left us, as a cluster of the vintage, and as a candle in a dark place, and as a haven or ship preserved from the tempest.

verses.raw: Are not the evils which are come to us sufficient?
verses.text: Are not the evils which are come to us sufficient?

verses.raw: If you shall forsake us, how much better had it been for us, if we also had been burned in the midst of Sion?
verses.text: If you shall forsake us, how much better had it been for us, if we also had been burned in the midst of Sion?

verses.raw: For we are not better than they that died there. And they wept with a loud voice. Then answered I them, and said,
verses.text: For we are not better than they that died there. And they wept with a loud voice. Then answered I them, and said,

verses.raw: Be of good comfort, O Yashar'el (Israel); and be not heavy, you house of Jacob:
verses.text: Be of good comfort, O Yashar'el; and be not heavy, you house of Jacob:

verses.raw: For the Highest has you in remembrance, and the Mighty has not forgotten you in temptation.
verses.text: For the Highest has you in remembrance, and the Mighty has not forgotten you in temptation.

verses.raw: As for me, I have not forsaken you, neither am I departed from you: but am come into this place, to pray for the desolation of Sion, and that I might seek mercy for the low estate of your sanctuary.
verses.text: As for me, I have not forsaken you, neither am I departed from you: but am come into this place, to pray for the desolation of Sion, and that I might seek mercy for the low estate of your sanctuary.

verses.raw: And now go your way home every man, and after these days will I come to you.
verses.text: And now go your way home every man, and after these days will I come to you.

verses.raw: So the people went their way into the city, like as I commanded them:
verses.text: So the people went their way into the city, like as I commanded them:

verses.raw: But I remained still in the field seven days, as the angel commanded me; and did eat only in those days of the flowers of the field, and had my meat of the herbs. ⸻
verses.text: But I remained still in the field seven days, as the angel commanded me; and did eat only in those days of the flowers of the field, and had my meat of the herbs. ⸻

verses.raw: And it came to pass after seven days, I dreamed a dream by night:
verses.text: And it came to pass after seven days, I dreamed a dream by night:

verses.raw: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea, that it moved all the waves thereof.
verses.text: And, lo, there arose a wind from the sea, that it moved all the waves thereof.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.
verses.text: And I beheld, and, lo, that man waxed strong with the thousands of heaven: and when he turned his countenance to look, all the things trembled that were seen under him.

verses.raw: And whenever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth fails when it feeleth the fire.
verses.text: And whenever the voice went out of his mouth, all they burned that heard his voice, like as the earth fails when it feeleth the fire.

verses.raw: And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea
verses.text: And after this I beheld, and, lo, there was gathered together a multitude of men, out of number, from the four winds of the heaven, to subdue the man that came out of the sea

verses.raw: But I beheld, and, lo, he had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it.
verses.text: But I beheld, and, lo, he had graved himself a great mountain, and flew up upon it.

verses.raw: But I would have seen the region or place whereout the hill was graven, and I could not.
verses.text: But I would have seen the region or place whereout the hill was graven, and I could not.

verses.raw: And after this I beheld, and, lo, all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.
verses.text: And after this I beheld, and, lo, all they which were gathered together to subdue him were sore afraid, and yet durst fight.

verses.raw: And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came, he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war:
verses.text: And, lo, as he saw the violence of the multitude that came, he neither lifted up his hand, nor held sword, nor any instrument of war:

verses.raw: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.
verses.text: But only I saw that he sent out of his mouth as it had been a blast of fire, and out of his lips a flaming breath, and out of his tongue he cast out sparks and tempests.

verses.raw: And they were all mixed together; the blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest; and fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke: when I saw this I was afraid.
verses.text: And they were all mixed together; the blast of fire, the flaming breath, and the great tempest; and fell with violence upon the multitude which was prepared to fight, and burned them up every one, so that upon a sudden of an innumerable multitude nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke: when I saw this I was afraid.

verses.raw: Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call to him another peaceable Multitude.
verses.text: Afterward saw I the same man come down from the mountain, and call to him another peaceable Multitude.

verses.raw: And there came much people to him, of which some were glad, some were sorry, and some of them were bound, and other some brought of them that were offered: then was I sick through great fear, and I awaked, and said,
verses.text: And there came much people to him, of which some were glad, some were sorry, and some of them were bound, and other some brought of them that were offered: then was I sick through great fear, and I awaked, and said,

verses.raw: You have shewed your servant these wonders from the beginning, and have counted me worthy that you should receive my prayer:
verses.text: You have shewed your servant these wonders from the beginning, and have counted me worthy that you should receive my prayer:

verses.raw: Shew me now yet the interpretation of this dream.
verses.text: Shew me now yet the interpretation of this dream.

verses.raw: For as I conceive in my understanding, woe to them that shall be left in those days and much more woe to them that are not left behind!
verses.text: For as I conceive in my understanding, woe to them that shall be left in those days and much more woe to them that are not left behind!

verses.raw: For they that were not left were in heaviness.
verses.text: For they that were not left were in heaviness.

verses.raw: Now understand I the things that are laid up in the latter days, which shall happen to them, and to those that are left behind.
verses.text: Now understand I the things that are laid up in the latter days, which shall happen to them, and to those that are left behind.

verses.raw: Therefore are they come into great perils and many necessities, like as these dreams declare.
verses.text: Therefore are they come into great perils and many necessities, like as these dreams declare.

verses.raw: Yet is it easier for him that is in danger to come into these things, than to pass away as a cloud out of the world, and not to see the things that happen in the last days. And he answered to me, and said,
verses.text: Yet is it easier for him that is in danger to come into these things, than to pass away as a cloud out of the world, and not to see the things that happen in the last days. And he answered to me, and said,

verses.raw: The interpretation of the vision shall I shew you, and I will open to you the thing that you have required.
verses.text: The interpretation of the vision shall I shew you, and I will open to you the thing that you have required.

verses.raw: Whereas you have spoken of them that are left behind, this is the interpretation:
verses.text: Whereas you have spoken of them that are left behind, this is the interpretation:

verses.raw: He that shall endure the peril in that time has kept himself: they that be fallen into danger are such as have works, and faith toward the Almighty.
verses.text: He that shall endure the peril in that time has kept himself: they that be fallen into danger are such as have works, and faith toward the Almighty.

verses.raw: Know this therefore, that they which be left behind are more blessed than they that be dead.
verses.text: Know this therefore, that they which be left behind are more blessed than they that be dead.

verses.raw: This is the meaning of the vision: Whereas you sawest a man coming up from the midst of the sea:
verses.text: This is the meaning of the vision: Whereas you sawest a man coming up from the midst of the sea:

verses.raw: The same is he whom Yahuah (God) the Highest has kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature: and he shall order them that are left behind.
verses.text: The same is he whom Yahuah the Highest has kept a great season, which by his own self shall deliver his creature: and he shall order them that are left behind.

verses.raw: And whereas you sawest, that out of his mouth there came as a blast of wind, and fire, and storm;
verses.text: And whereas you sawest, that out of his mouth there came as a blast of wind, and fire, and storm;

verses.raw: And that he held neither sword, nor any instrument of war, but that the rushing in of him destroyed the whole multitude that came to subdue him; this is the interpretation:
verses.text: And that he held neither sword, nor any instrument of war, but that the rushing in of him destroyed the whole multitude that came to subdue him; this is the interpretation:

verses.raw: Behold, the days come, when the Most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.
verses.text: Behold, the days come, when the Most High will begin to deliver them that are upon the earth.

verses.raw: And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.
verses.text: And he shall come to the astonishment of them that dwell on the earth.

verses.raw: And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.
verses.text: And one shall undertake to fight against another, one city against another, one place against another, one people against another, and one realm against another.

verses.raw: And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed you before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom you sawest as a man ascending.
verses.text: And the time shall be when these things shall come to pass, and the signs shall happen which I shewed you before, and then shall my Son be declared, whom you sawest as a man ascending.

verses.raw: And when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another.
verses.text: And when all the people hear his voice, every man shall in their own land leave the battle they have one against another.

verses.raw: And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as you sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting.
verses.text: And an innumerable multitude shall be gathered together, as you sawest them, willing to come, and to overcome him by fighting.

verses.raw: But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.
verses.text: But he shall stand upon the top of the mount Sion.

verses.raw: And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded, like as you sawest the hill graven without hands.
verses.text: And Sion shall come, and shall be shewed to all men, being prepared and builded, like as you sawest the hill graven without hands.

verses.raw: And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest;
verses.text: And this my Son shall rebuke the wicked inventions of those nations, which for their wicked life are fallen into the tempest;

verses.raw: And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments with which they shall begin to be tormented, which are like to a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like to fire.
verses.text: And shall lay before them their evil thoughts, and the torments with which they shall begin to be tormented, which are like to a flame: and he shall destroy them without labour by the law which is like to fire.

verses.raw: And whereas you sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude to him;
verses.text: And whereas you sawest that he gathered another peaceable multitude to him;

verses.raw: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.
verses.text: Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.

verses.raw: But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt,
verses.text: But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt,

verses.raw: That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.
verses.text: That they might there keep their statutes, which they never kept in their own land.

verses.raw: And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.
verses.text: And they entered into Euphrates by the narrow places of the river.

verses.raw: For the Most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.
verses.text: For the Most High then shewed signs for them, and held still the flood, till they were passed over.

verses.raw: For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth.
verses.text: For through that country there was a great way to go, namely, of a year and a half: and the same region is called Arsareth.

verses.raw: Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come,
verses.text: Then dwelt they there until the latter time; and now when they shall begin to come,

verses.raw: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.
verses.text: The Highest shall stay the springs of the stream again, that they may go through: therefore sawest you the multitude with peace.

verses.raw: But those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders.
verses.text: But those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders.

verses.raw: Now when he destroys the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he shall defend his people that remain.
verses.text: Now when he destroys the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he shall defend his people that remain.

verses.raw: And then shall he shew them great wonders.
verses.text: And then shall he shew them great wonders.

verses.raw: Then said I, O Yahuah (God) that bearest rule, shew me this: Wherefore have I seen the man coming up from the midst of the sea?
verses.text: Then said I, O Yahuah that bearest rule, shew me this: Wherefore have I seen the man coming up from the midst of the sea?

verses.raw: And he said to me, Like as you can neither seek out nor know the things that are in the deep of the sea: even so can no man upon earth see my Son, or those that be with him, but in the day time.
verses.text: And he said to me, Like as you can neither seek out nor know the things that are in the deep of the sea: even so can no man upon earth see my Son, or those that be with him, but in the day time.

verses.raw: This is the interpretation of the dream which you sawest, and by which you only art here lightened.
verses.text: This is the interpretation of the dream which you sawest, and by which you only art here lightened.

verses.raw: For you have forsaken your own way, and applied your diligence to my law, and sought it.
verses.text: For you have forsaken your own way, and applied your diligence to my law, and sought it.

verses.raw: Your life have you ordered in wisdom, and have called understanding your mother.
verses.text: Your life have you ordered in wisdom, and have called understanding your mother.

verses.raw: And therefore have I shewed you the treasures of the Highest: after other three days I will speak other things to you, and declare to you mighty and wondrous things.
verses.text: And therefore have I shewed you the treasures of the Highest: after other three days I will speak other things to you, and declare to you mighty and wondrous things.

verses.raw: Then went I forth into the field, giving praise and thanks greatly to the Most High because of his wonders which he did in time;
verses.text: Then went I forth into the field, giving praise and thanks greatly to the Most High because of his wonders which he did in time;

verses.raw: And because he governeth the same, and such things as fall in their seasons: and there I sat three days. ⸻
verses.text: And because he governeth the same, and such things as fall in their seasons: and there I sat three days. ⸻

verses.raw: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.
verses.text: And it came to pass upon the third day, I sat under an oak, and, behold, there came a voice out of a bush over against me, and said, Esdras, Esdras.

verses.raw: And I said, Here am I, Yahuah (God) And I stood up upon my feet.
verses.text: And I said, Here am I, Yahuah And I stood up upon my feet.

verses.raw: Then said he to me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself to Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:
verses.text: Then said he to me, In the bush I did manifestly reveal myself to Moses, and talked with him, when my people served in Egypt:

verses.raw: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,
verses.text: And I sent him and led my people out of Egypt, and brought him up to the mount of where I held him by me a long season,

verses.raw: And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end; and commanded him, saying,
verses.text: And told him many wondrous things, and shewed him the secrets of the times, and the end; and commanded him, saying,

verses.raw: These words shall you declare, and these shall you hide.
verses.text: These words shall you declare, and these shall you hide.

verses.raw: And now I say to you,
verses.text: And now I say to you,

verses.raw: That you lay up in your heart the signs that I have shewed, and the dreams that you have seen, and the interpretations which you have heard:
verses.text: That you lay up in your heart the signs that I have shewed, and the dreams that you have seen, and the interpretations which you have heard:

verses.raw: For you shall be taken away from all, and from henceforth you shall remain with my Son, and with such as be like you, until the times be ended.
verses.text: For you shall be taken away from all, and from henceforth you shall remain with my Son, and with such as be like you, until the times be ended.

verses.raw: For the world has lost his youth, and the times begin to wax old.
verses.text: For the world has lost his youth, and the times begin to wax old.

verses.raw: For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part:
verses.text: For the world is divided into twelve parts, and the ten parts of it are gone already, and half of a tenth part:

verses.raw: And there remains that which is after the half of the tenth part.
verses.text: And there remains that which is after the half of the tenth part.

verses.raw: Now therefore set yours house in order, and reprove your people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption,
verses.text: Now therefore set yours house in order, and reprove your people, comfort such of them as be in trouble, and now renounce corruption,

verses.raw: Let go from you mortal thoughts, cast away the burdens of man, put off now the weak nature,
verses.text: Let go from you mortal thoughts, cast away the burdens of man, put off now the weak nature,

verses.raw: And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy to you, and haste you to flee from these times.
verses.text: And set aside the thoughts that are most heavy to you, and haste you to flee from these times.

verses.raw: For yet greater evils than those which you have seen happen shall be done hereafter.
verses.text: For yet greater evils than those which you have seen happen shall be done hereafter.

verses.raw: For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell in it.
verses.text: For look how much the world shall be weaker through age, so much the more shall evils increase upon them that dwell in it.

verses.raw: For the time is fled far away, and leasing is hard at hand: for now hasteth the vision to come, which you have seen.
verses.text: For the time is fled far away, and leasing is hard at hand: for now hasteth the vision to come, which you have seen.

verses.raw: Then answered I before you, and said,
verses.text: Then answered I before you, and said,

verses.raw: Behold, Yahuah (God), I will go, as you have commanded me, and reprove the people which are present: but they that shall be born afterward, who shall admonish them? thus the world is set in darkness, and they that dwell in it are without light.
verses.text: Behold, Yahuah, I will go, as you have commanded me, and reprove the people which are present: but they that shall be born afterward, who shall admonish them? thus the world is set in darkness, and they that dwell in it are without light.

verses.raw: For your law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of you, or the work that shall begin.
verses.text: For your law is burnt, therefore no man knoweth the things that are done of you, or the work that shall begin.

verses.raw: But if I have found grace before you, send the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) into me, and I shall write all that has been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in your law, that men may find your path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.
verses.text: But if I have found grace before you, send the Ruach HaKodesh into me, and I shall write all that has been done in the world since the beginning, which were written in your law, that men may find your path, and that they which will live in the latter days may live.

verses.raw: And he answered me, saying, Go your way, gather the people together, and say to them, that they seek you not for forty days.
verses.text: And he answered me, saying, Go your way, gather the people together, and say to them, that they seek you not for forty days.

verses.raw: But look you prepare you many box trees, and take with you Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ecanus, and Asiel, these five which are ready to write swiftly;
verses.text: But look you prepare you many box trees, and take with you Sarea, Dabria, Selemia, Ecanus, and Asiel, these five which are ready to write swiftly;

verses.raw: And come hither, and I shall light a candle of understanding in yours heart, which shall not be put out, till the things be performed which you shall begin to write.
verses.text: And come hither, and I shall light a candle of understanding in yours heart, which shall not be put out, till the things be performed which you shall begin to write.

verses.raw: And when you have done, some things shall you publish, and some things shall you shew secretly to the wise: to morrow this hour shall you begin to write.
verses.text: And when you have done, some things shall you publish, and some things shall you shew secretly to the wise: to morrow this hour shall you begin to write.

verses.raw: Then went I forth, as he commanded, and gathered all the people together, and said,
verses.text: Then went I forth, as he commanded, and gathered all the people together, and said,

verses.raw: Hear these words, O Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Hear these words, O Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Our fathers at the beginning were strangers in Egypt, from whence they were delivered:
verses.text: Our fathers at the beginning were strangers in Egypt, from whence they were delivered:

verses.raw: And received the law of life, which they kept not, which you also have transgressed after them.
verses.text: And received the law of life, which they kept not, which you also have transgressed after them.

verses.raw: Then was the land, even the land of Sion, parted among you by lot: but your fathers, and you yourselves, have done unrighteousness, and have not kept the ways which the Highest commanded you.
verses.text: Then was the land, even the land of Sion, parted among you by lot: but your fathers, and you yourselves, have done unrighteousness, and have not kept the ways which the Highest commanded you.

verses.raw: And forasmuch as he is a righteous judge, he took from you in time the thing that he had given you.
verses.text: And forasmuch as he is a righteous judge, he took from you in time the thing that he had given you.

verses.raw: And now are you here, and your brothers among you.
verses.text: And now are you here, and your brothers among you.

verses.raw: Therefore if so be that you will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, you shall be kept alive and after death you shall obtain mercy.
verses.text: Therefore if so be that you will subdue your own understanding, and reform your hearts, you shall be kept alive and after death you shall obtain mercy.

verses.raw: For after death shall the judgment come, when we shall live again: and then shall the names of the righteous be manifest, and the works of the ungodly shall be declared.
verses.text: For after death shall the judgment come, when we shall live again: and then shall the names of the righteous be manifest, and the works of the ungodly shall be declared.

verses.raw: Let no man therefore come to me now, nor seek after me these forty days.
verses.text: Let no man therefore come to me now, nor seek after me these forty days.

verses.raw: So I took the five men, as he commanded me, and we went into the field, and remained there.
verses.text: So I took the five men, as he commanded me, and we went into the field, and remained there.

verses.raw: And the next day, behold, a voice called me, saying, Esdras, open your mouth, and drink that I give you to drink.
verses.text: And the next day, behold, a voice called me, saying, Esdras, open your mouth, and drink that I give you to drink.

verses.raw: Then opened I my mouth, and, behold, he reached me a full cup, which was full as it were with water, but the colour of it was like fire.
verses.text: Then opened I my mouth, and, behold, he reached me a full cup, which was full as it were with water, but the colour of it was like fire.

verses.raw: And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory:
verses.text: And I took it, and drank: and when I had drunk of it, my heart uttered understanding, and wisdom grew in my breast, for my spirit strengthened my memory:

verses.raw: And my mouth was opened, and shut no more.
verses.text: And my mouth was opened, and shut no more.

verses.raw: The Highest gave understanding to the five men, and they wrote the wonderful visions of the night that were told, which they knew not: and they sat forty days, and they wrote in the day, and at night they ate bread.
verses.text: The Highest gave understanding to the five men, and they wrote the wonderful visions of the night that were told, which they knew not: and they sat forty days, and they wrote in the day, and at night they ate bread.

verses.raw: As for me. I spoke in the day, and I held not my tongue by night.
verses.text: As for me. I spoke in the day, and I held not my tongue by night.

verses.raw: In forty days they wrote two hundred and four books.
verses.text: In forty days they wrote two hundred and four books.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spoke, saying, The first that you have written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the forty days were filled, that the Highest spoke, saying, The first that you have written publish openly, that the worthy and unworthy may read it:

verses.raw: But keep the seventy last, that you may deliver them only to such as be wise among the people:
verses.text: But keep the seventy last, that you may deliver them only to such as be wise among the people:

verses.raw: For in them is the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge.
verses.text: For in them is the spring of understanding, the fountain of wisdom, and the stream of knowledge.

verses.raw: And I did so. ⸻
verses.text: And I did so. ⸻

verses.raw: Behold, speak you in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in your mouth, says Yahuah (God):
verses.text: Behold, speak you in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in your mouth, says Yahuah:

verses.raw: And cause them to be written in paper: for they are faithful and true.
verses.text: And cause them to be written in paper: for they are faithful and true.

verses.raw: Fear not the imaginations against you, let not the incredulity of them trouble you, that speak against you.
verses.text: Fear not the imaginations against you, let not the incredulity of them trouble you, that speak against you.

verses.raw: For all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness.
verses.text: For all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness.

verses.raw: Behold, says Yahuah (God), I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.
verses.text: Behold, says Yahuah, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.

verses.raw: For wickedness has exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled.
verses.text: For wickedness has exceedingly polluted the whole earth, and their hurtful works are fulfilled.

verses.raw: Therefore says Yahuah (God),
verses.text: Therefore says Yahuah,

verses.raw: I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness, which they profanely commit, neither will I suffer them in those things, in which they wickedly exercise themselves: behold, the innocent and righteous blood cries to me, and the souls of the just complain continually.
verses.text: I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness, which they profanely commit, neither will I suffer them in those things, in which they wickedly exercise themselves: behold, the innocent and righteous blood cries to me, and the souls of the just complain continually.

verses.raw: And therefore, says Yahuah (God), I will surely avenge them, and receive to me all the innocent blood from among them.
verses.text: And therefore, says Yahuah, I will surely avenge them, and receive to me all the innocent blood from among them.

verses.raw: Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt:
verses.text: Behold, my people is led as a flock to the slaughter: I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt:

verses.raw: But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof.
verses.text: But I will bring them with a mighty hand and a stretched out arm, and smite Egypt with plagues, as before, and will destroy all the land thereof.

verses.raw: Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be struck with the plague and punishment that Yahuah (God) shall bring upon it.
verses.text: Egypt shall mourn, and the foundation of it shall be struck with the plague and punishment that Yahuah shall bring upon it.

verses.raw: They that till the ground shall mourn: for their seeds shall fail through the blasting and hail, and with a fearful constellation.
verses.text: They that till the ground shall mourn: for their seeds shall fail through the blasting and hail, and with a fearful constellation.

verses.raw: Woe to the world and them that dwell in it!
verses.text: Woe to the world and them that dwell in it!

verses.raw: For the sword and their destruction draws nigh, and one people shall stand up and fight against another, and swords in their hands.
verses.text: For the sword and their destruction draws nigh, and one people shall stand up and fight against another, and swords in their hands.

verses.raw: For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another; they shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.
verses.text: For there shall be sedition among men, and invading one another; they shall not regard their kings nor princes, and the course of their actions shall stand in their power.

verses.raw: A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able.
verses.text: A man shall desire to go into a city, and shall not be able.

verses.raw: For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.
verses.text: For because of their pride the cities shall be troubled, the houses shall be destroyed, and men shall be afraid.

verses.raw: A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation.
verses.text: A man shall have no pity upon his neighbour, but shall destroy their houses with the sword, and spoil their goods, because of the lack of bread, and for great tribulation.

verses.raw: Behold, says Yahuah (God), I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus; to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them.
verses.text: Behold, says Yahuah, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus; to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them.

verses.raw: Like as they do yet this day to my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom. Thus says Yahuah (God);
verses.text: Like as they do yet this day to my chosen, so will I do also, and recompense in their bosom. Thus says Yahuah;

verses.raw: My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth.
verses.text: My right hand shall not spare the sinners, and my sword shall not cease over them that shed innocent blood upon the earth.

verses.raw: The fire is gone forth from his wrath, and has consumed the foundations of the earth, and the sinners, like the straw that is kindled.
verses.text: The fire is gone forth from his wrath, and has consumed the foundations of the earth, and the sinners, like the straw that is kindled.

verses.raw: Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments! says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Woe to them that sin, and keep not my commandments! says Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will not spare them: go your way, you children, from the power, defile not my sanctuary.
verses.text: I will not spare them: go your way, you children, from the power, defile not my sanctuary.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) knoweth all them that sin against him, and therefore delivers he them to death and destruction.
verses.text: For Yahuah knoweth all them that sin against him, and therefore delivers he them to death and destruction.

verses.raw: For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth and you shall remain in them: for Yahuah (God) shall not deliver you, because you have sinned against him.
verses.text: For now are the plagues come upon the whole earth and you shall remain in them: for Yahuah shall not deliver you, because you have sinned against him.

verses.raw: Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east:
verses.text: Behold an horrible vision, and the appearance thereof from the east:

verses.raw: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.
verses.text: Where the nations of the dragons of Arabia shall come out with many chariots, and the multitude of them shall be carried as the wind upon earth, that all they which hear them may fear and tremble.

verses.raw: Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.
verses.text: Also the Carmanians raging in wrath shall go forth as the wild boars of the wood, and with great power shall they come, and join battle with them, and shall waste a portion of the land of the Assyrians.

verses.raw: And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature; and if they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them,
verses.text: And then shall the dragons have the upper hand, remembering their nature; and if they shall turn themselves, conspiring together in great power to persecute them,

verses.raw: Then these shall be troubled bled, and keep silence through their power, and shall flee.
verses.text: Then these shall be troubled bled, and keep silence through their power, and shall flee.

verses.raw: And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them, and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.
verses.text: And from the land of the Assyrians shall the enemy besiege them, and consume some of them, and in their host shall be fear and dread, and strife among their kings.

verses.raw: Behold clouds from the east and from the north to the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and storm.
verses.text: Behold clouds from the east and from the north to the south, and they are very horrible to look upon, full of wrath and storm.

verses.raw: They shall smite one upon another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star; and blood shall be from the sword to the belly,
verses.text: They shall smite one upon another, and they shall smite down a great multitude of stars upon the earth, even their own star; and blood shall be from the sword to the belly,

verses.raw: And dung of men to the camel’s hough.
verses.text: And dung of men to the camel’s hough.

verses.raw: And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and they that see the wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall come upon them.
verses.text: And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and they that see the wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall come upon them.

verses.raw: And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west.
verses.text: And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west.

verses.raw: And strong winds shall arise from the east, and shall open it; and the cloud which he raised up in wrath, and the star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind, shall be destroyed.
verses.text: And strong winds shall arise from the east, and shall open it; and the cloud which he raised up in wrath, and the star stirred to cause fear toward the east and west wind, shall be destroyed.

verses.raw: The great and mighty clouds shall be puffed up full of wrath, and the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell in it; and they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star,
verses.text: The great and mighty clouds shall be puffed up full of wrath, and the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell in it; and they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star,

verses.raw: Fire, and hail, and flying swords, and many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters.
verses.text: Fire, and hail, and flying swords, and many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters.

verses.raw: And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.
verses.text: And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.

verses.raw: And they shall go stedfastly to Babylon, and make her afraid.
verses.text: And they shall go stedfastly to Babylon, and make her afraid.

verses.raw: They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her: then shall the dust and smoke go up to the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.
verses.text: They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her: then shall the dust and smoke go up to the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.

verses.raw: And they that remain under her shall do service to them that have put her in fear.
verses.text: And they that remain under her shall do service to them that have put her in fear.

verses.raw: And you, Asia, that are partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person:
verses.text: And you, Asia, that are partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person:

verses.raw: Woe be to you, you wretch, because you have made thyself like to her; and have decked your daughters in whoredom, that they might please and glory in your lovers, which have always desired to commit whoredom with you.
verses.text: Woe be to you, you wretch, because you have made thyself like to her; and have decked your daughters in whoredom, that they might please and glory in your lovers, which have always desired to commit whoredom with you.

verses.raw: You have followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions: therefore says Yahuah (God),
verses.text: You have followed her that is hated in all her works and inventions: therefore says Yahuah,

verses.raw: I will send plagues upon you; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste your houses with destruction and death.
verses.text: I will send plagues upon you; widowhood, poverty, famine, sword, and pestilence, to waste your houses with destruction and death.

verses.raw: And the glory of your Power shall be dried up as a flower, the heat shall arise that is sent over you.
verses.text: And the glory of your Power shall be dried up as a flower, the heat shall arise that is sent over you.

verses.raw: You shall be weakened as a poor woman with stripes, and as one chastised with wounds, so that the mighty and lovers shall not be able to receive you.
verses.text: You shall be weakened as a poor woman with stripes, and as one chastised with wounds, so that the mighty and lovers shall not be able to receive you.

verses.raw: Would I with jealousy have so proceeded against you, says Yahuah (God),
verses.text: Would I with jealousy have so proceeded against you, says Yahuah,

verses.raw: If you had not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of yours hands, and saying over their dead, when you were drunken,
verses.text: If you had not always slain my chosen, exalting the stroke of yours hands, and saying over their dead, when you were drunken,

verses.raw: Set forth the beauty of your countenance?
verses.text: Set forth the beauty of your countenance?

verses.raw: The reward of your whoredom shall be in your bosom, therefore shall you receive recompence.
verses.text: The reward of your whoredom shall be in your bosom, therefore shall you receive recompence.

verses.raw: Like as you have done to my chosen, says Yahuah (God), even so shall Yahuah (God) do to you, and shall deliver you into mischief
verses.text: Like as you have done to my chosen, says Yahuah, even so shall Yahuah do to you, and shall deliver you into mischief

verses.raw: Your children shall die of hunger, and you shall fall through the sword: your cities shall be broken down, and all yours shall perish with the sword in the field.
verses.text: Your children shall die of hunger, and you shall fall through the sword: your cities shall be broken down, and all yours shall perish with the sword in the field.

verses.raw: They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger, and eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood, for very hunger of bread, and thirst of water.
verses.text: They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger, and eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood, for very hunger of bread, and thirst of water.

verses.raw: You as unhappy shall come through the sea, and receive plagues again.
verses.text: You as unhappy shall come through the sea, and receive plagues again.

verses.raw: And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of your land, and consume part of your glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.
verses.text: And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of your land, and consume part of your glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.

verses.raw: And you shall be cast down by them as stubble, and they shall be to you as fire;
verses.text: And you shall be cast down by them as stubble, and they shall be to you as fire;

verses.raw: And shall consume you, and your cities, your land, and your mountains; all your woods and your fruitful trees shall they burn up with fire.
verses.text: And shall consume you, and your cities, your land, and your mountains; all your woods and your fruitful trees shall they burn up with fire.

verses.raw: Your children shall they carry away captive, and, look, what you have, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of your face. ⸻
verses.text: Your children shall they carry away captive, and, look, what you have, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of your face. ⸻

verses.raw: Woe be to you, Babylon, and Asia! woe be to you, Egypt and Syria!
verses.text: Woe be to you, Babylon, and Asia! woe be to you, Egypt and Syria!

verses.raw: Gird up yourselves with cloths of sack and hair, bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand.
verses.text: Gird up yourselves with cloths of sack and hair, bewail your children, and be sorry; for your destruction is at hand.

verses.raw: A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back?
verses.text: A sword is sent upon you, and who may turn it back?

verses.raw: A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it?
verses.text: A fire is sent among you, and who may quench it?

verses.raw: Plagues are sent to you, and what is he that may drive them away?
verses.text: Plagues are sent to you, and what is he that may drive them away?

verses.raw: May any man drive away an hungry lion in the wood? or may any one quench the fire in stubble, when it has begun to burn?
verses.text: May any man drive away an hungry lion in the wood? or may any one quench the fire in stubble, when it has begun to burn?

verses.raw: May one turn again the arrow that is shot of a strong archer?
verses.text: May one turn again the arrow that is shot of a strong archer?

verses.raw: The mighty Yahuah (God) sends the plagues and who is he that can drive them away?
verses.text: The mighty Yahuah sends the plagues and who is he that can drive them away?

verses.raw: A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is he that may quench it?
verses.text: A fire shall go forth from his wrath, and who is he that may quench it?

verses.raw: He shall cast lightnings, and who shall not fear? he shall thunder, and who shall not be afraid?
verses.text: He shall cast lightnings, and who shall not fear? he shall thunder, and who shall not be afraid?

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) shall threaten, and who shall not be utterly beaten to powder at his presence?
verses.text: Yahuah shall threaten, and who shall not be utterly beaten to powder at his presence?

verses.raw: The earth quakes, and the foundations thereof; the sea ariseth up with waves from the deep, and the waves of it are troubled, and the fishes thereof also, before Yahuah (God), and before the glory of his power:
verses.text: The earth quakes, and the foundations thereof; the sea ariseth up with waves from the deep, and the waves of it are troubled, and the fishes thereof also, before Yahuah, and before the glory of his power:

verses.raw: For strong is his right hand that bendeth the bow, his arrows that he shooteth are sharp, and shall not miss, when they begin to be shot into the ends of the world.
verses.text: For strong is his right hand that bendeth the bow, his arrows that he shooteth are sharp, and shall not miss, when they begin to be shot into the ends of the world.

verses.raw: Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.
verses.text: Behold, the plagues are sent, and shall not return again, until they come upon the earth.

verses.raw: The fire is kindled, and shall not be put out, till it consume the foundation of the earth.
verses.text: The fire is kindled, and shall not be put out, till it consume the foundation of the earth.

verses.raw: Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returns not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.
verses.text: Like as an arrow which is shot of a mighty archer returns not backward: even so the plagues that shall be sent upon earth shall not return again.

verses.raw: Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?
verses.text: Woe is me! woe is me! who will deliver me in those days?

verses.raw: The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils! what shall I do when these evils shall come?
verses.text: The beginning of sorrows and great mournings; the beginning of famine and great death; the beginning of wars, and the powers shall stand in fear; the beginning of evils! what shall I do when these evils shall come?

verses.raw: Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.
verses.text: Behold, famine and plague, tribulation and anguish, are sent as scourges for amendment.

verses.raw: But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be always mindful of the scourges.
verses.text: But for all these things they shall not turn from their wickedness, nor be always mindful of the scourges.

verses.raw: Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.
verses.text: Behold, victuals shall be so good cheap upon earth, that they shall think themselves to be in good case, and even then shall evils grow upon earth, sword, famine, and great confusion.

verses.raw: For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.
verses.text: For many of them that dwell upon earth shall perish of famine; and the other, that escape the hunger, shall the sword destroy.

verses.raw: And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them: for the earth shall be wasted, and the cities shall be cast down.
verses.text: And the dead shall be cast out as dung, and there shall be no man to comfort them: for the earth shall be wasted, and the cities shall be cast down.

verses.raw: There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it
verses.text: There shall be no man left to till the earth, and to sow it

verses.raw: The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?
verses.text: The trees shall give fruit, and who shall gather them?

verses.raw: The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them? for all places shall be desolate of men:
verses.text: The grapes shall ripen, and who shall tread them? for all places shall be desolate of men:

verses.raw: So that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.
verses.text: So that one man shall desire to see another, and to hear his voice.

verses.raw: For of a city there shall be ten left, and two of the field, which shall hide themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks.
verses.text: For of a city there shall be ten left, and two of the field, which shall hide themselves in the thick groves, and in the clefts of the rocks.

verses.raw: As in an orchard of Olives upon every tree there are left three or four olives;
verses.text: As in an orchard of Olives upon every tree there are left three or four olives;

verses.raw: Or as when a vineyard is gathered, there are left some clusters of them that diligently seek through the vineyard:
verses.text: Or as when a vineyard is gathered, there are left some clusters of them that diligently seek through the vineyard:

verses.raw: Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword.
verses.text: Even so in those days there shall be three or four left by them that search their houses with the sword.

verses.raw: And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns, because no man shall travel therethrough.
verses.text: And the earth shall be laid waste, and the fields thereof shall wax old, and her ways and all her paths shall grow full of thorns, because no man shall travel therethrough.

verses.raw: The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms; the women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers.
verses.text: The virgins shall mourn, having no bridegrooms; the women shall mourn, having no husbands; their daughters shall mourn, having no helpers.
