verses.raw: In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed, and their husbands shall perish of famine.
verses.text: In the wars shall their bridegrooms be destroyed, and their husbands shall perish of famine.

verses.raw: Hear now these things and understand them, you servants of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Hear now these things and understand them, you servants of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Behold, the word of Yahuah (God), receive it: believe not the gods of whom Yahuah (God) spoke.
verses.text: Behold, the word of Yahuah, receive it: believe not the gods of whom Yahuah spoke.

verses.raw: Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.
verses.text: Behold, the plagues draw nigh, and are not slack.

verses.raw: As when a woman with child in the ninth month brings forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child comes forth, they slack not a moment:
verses.text: As when a woman with child in the ninth month brings forth her son, with two or three hours of her birth great pains compass her womb, which pains, when the child comes forth, they slack not a moment:

verses.raw: Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.
verses.text: Even so shall not the plagues be slack to come upon the earth, and the world shall mourn, and sorrows shall come upon it on every side.

verses.raw: O my people, hear my word: make you ready to your battle, and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.
verses.text: O my people, hear my word: make you ready to your battle, and in those evils be even as pilgrims upon the earth.

verses.raw: He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away: and he that buyeth, as one that will lose:
verses.text: He that selleth, let him be as he that fleeth away: and he that buyeth, as one that will lose:

verses.raw: He that occupieth merchandise, as he that has no profit by it: and he that buildeth, as he that shall not dwell in it:
verses.text: He that occupieth merchandise, as he that has no profit by it: and he that buildeth, as he that shall not dwell in it:

verses.raw: He that sows, as if he should not reap: so also he that planteth the vineyard, as he that shall not gather the grapes:
verses.text: He that sows, as if he should not reap: so also he that planteth the vineyard, as he that shall not gather the grapes:

verses.raw: They that marry, as they that shall get no children; and they that marry not, as the widowers.
verses.text: They that marry, as they that shall get no children; and they that marry not, as the widowers.

verses.raw: And therefore they that labour labour in vain:
verses.text: And therefore they that labour labour in vain:

verses.raw: For strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captives, for in captivity and famine shall they get children.
verses.text: For strangers shall reap their fruits, and spoil their goods, overthrow their houses, and take their children captives, for in captivity and famine shall they get children.

verses.raw: And they that occupy their merchandise with robbery, the more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons:
verses.text: And they that occupy their merchandise with robbery, the more they deck their cities, their houses, their possessions, and their own persons:

verses.raw: The more will I be angry with them for their sin, says Yahuah (God).
verses.text: The more will I be angry with them for their sin, says Yahuah.

verses.raw: Like as a whore envies a right honest and virtuous woman:
verses.text: Like as a whore envies a right honest and virtuous woman:

verses.raw: So shall righteousness hate iniquity, when she decketh herself, and shall accuse her to her face, when he comes that shall defend him that diligently searcheth out every sin upon earth.
verses.text: So shall righteousness hate iniquity, when she decketh herself, and shall accuse her to her face, when he comes that shall defend him that diligently searcheth out every sin upon earth.

verses.raw: And therefore be you not like to it, nor to the works thereof.
verses.text: And therefore be you not like to it, nor to the works thereof.

verses.raw: For yet a little, and iniquity shall be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness shall reign among you.
verses.text: For yet a little, and iniquity shall be taken away out of the earth, and righteousness shall reign among you.

verses.raw: Let not the sinner say that he has not sinned: for Yahuah (God) shall burn coals of fire upon his head, which says before Yahuah (God) and his glory, I have not sinned.
verses.text: Let not the sinner say that he has not sinned: for Yahuah shall burn coals of fire upon his head, which says before Yahuah and his glory, I have not sinned.

verses.raw: Behold, Yahuah (God) knoweth all the works of men, their imaginations, their thoughts, and their hearts:
verses.text: Behold, Yahuah knoweth all the works of men, their imaginations, their thoughts, and their hearts:

verses.raw: Which spoke but the word, Let the earth be made; and it was made: Let the heaven be made; and it was created.
verses.text: Which spoke but the word, Let the earth be made; and it was made: Let the heaven be made; and it was created.

verses.raw: In his word were the stars made, and he knoweth the number of them.
verses.text: In his word were the stars made, and he knoweth the number of them.

verses.raw: He searcheth the deep, and the treasures thereof; he has measured the sea, and what it containeth.
verses.text: He searcheth the deep, and the treasures thereof; he has measured the sea, and what it containeth.

verses.raw: He has shut the sea in the midst of the waters, and with his word has he hanged the earth upon the waters.
verses.text: He has shut the sea in the midst of the waters, and with his word has he hanged the earth upon the waters.

verses.raw: He spreadeth out the heavens like a vault; upon the waters has he founded it.
verses.text: He spreadeth out the heavens like a vault; upon the waters has he founded it.

verses.raw: In the desert has he made springs of water, and pools upon the tops of the mountains, that the floods might pour down from the high rocks to water the earth.
verses.text: In the desert has he made springs of water, and pools upon the tops of the mountains, that the floods might pour down from the high rocks to water the earth.

verses.raw: He made man, and put his heart in the midst of the body, and gave him breath, life, and understanding.
verses.text: He made man, and put his heart in the midst of the body, and gave him breath, life, and understanding.

verses.raw: Yea and the Spirit of Almighty Yahuah (God), which made all things, and searcheth out all hidden things in the secrets of the earth,
verses.text: Yea and the Spirit of Almighty Yahuah, which made all things, and searcheth out all hidden things in the secrets of the earth,

verses.raw: Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what you think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.
verses.text: Surely he knoweth your inventions, and what you think in your hearts, even them that sin, and would hide their sin.

verses.raw: Therefore has Yahuah (God) exactly searched out all your works, and he will put you all to shame.
verses.text: Therefore has Yahuah exactly searched out all your works, and he will put you all to shame.

verses.raw: And when your sins are brought forth, you shall be ashamed before men, and your own sins shall be your accusers in that day.
verses.text: And when your sins are brought forth, you shall be ashamed before men, and your own sins shall be your accusers in that day.

verses.raw: What will you do? or how will you hide your sins before Yahuah (God) and his angels?
verses.text: What will you do? or how will you hide your sins before Yahuah and his angels?

verses.raw: Behold, Yahuah (God) himself is the judge, fear him: leave off from your sins, and forget your iniquities, to meddle no more with them for ever: so shall Yahuah (God) lead you forth, and deliver you from all trouble.
verses.text: Behold, Yahuah himself is the judge, fear him: leave off from your sins, and forget your iniquities, to meddle no more with them for ever: so shall Yahuah lead you forth, and deliver you from all trouble.

verses.raw: For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered to idols.
verses.text: For, behold, the burning wrath of a great multitude is kindled over you, and they shall take away certain of you, and feed you, being idle, with things offered to idols.

verses.raw: And they that consent to them shall be had in derision and in reproach, and trodden under foot.
verses.text: And they that consent to them shall be had in derision and in reproach, and trodden under foot.

verses.raw: For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear Yahuah (God).
verses.text: For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear Yahuah.

verses.raw: They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear Yahuah (God).
verses.text: They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear Yahuah.

verses.raw: For they shall waste and take away their goods, and cast them out of their houses.
verses.text: For they shall waste and take away their goods, and cast them out of their houses.

verses.raw: Then shall they be known, who are my chosen; and they shall be tried as the gold in the fire.
verses.text: Then shall they be known, who are my chosen; and they shall be tried as the gold in the fire.

verses.raw: Hear, O you my beloved, says Yahuah (God): behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same.
verses.text: Hear, O you my beloved, says Yahuah: behold, the days of trouble are at hand, but I will deliver you from the same.

verses.raw: Be you not afraid neither doubt; for Yahuah (God) is your guide,
verses.text: Be you not afraid neither doubt; for Yahuah is your guide,

verses.raw: And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, says Yahuah (God): let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.
verses.text: And the guide of them who keep my commandments and precepts, says Yahuah: let not your sins weigh you down, and let not your iniquities lift up themselves.

verses.raw: Woe be to them that are bound with their sins, and covered with their iniquities like as a field is covered over with bushes, and the path thereof covered with thorns, that no man may travel through!
verses.text: Woe be to them that are bound with their sins, and covered with their iniquities like as a field is covered over with bushes, and the path thereof covered with thorns, that no man may travel through!

verses.raw: It is left undressed, and is cast into the fire to be consumed with it. ⸻
verses.text: It is left undressed, and is cast into the fire to be consumed with it. ⸻

verses.raw: The book of the words of Tobit, son of Tobiel, the son of Ananiel, the son of Aduel, the son of Gabael, of the seed of Asael, of the tribe of Nephthali;
verses.text: The book of the words of Tobit, son of Tobiel, the son of Ananiel, the son of Aduel, the son of Gabael, of the seed of Asael, of the tribe of Nephthali;

verses.raw: Who in the time of Enemessar king of the Assyrians was led captive out of Thisbe, which is at the right hand of that city, which is called properly Nephthali in Galilee above Aser.
verses.text: Who in the time of Enemessar king of the Assyrians was led captive out of Thisbe, which is at the right hand of that city, which is called properly Nephthali in Galilee above Aser.

verses.raw: I Tobit have walked all the days of my life in the ways of truth and justice, and I did many almsdeeds to my brothers, and my nation, who came with me to Nineve, into the land of the Assyrians.
verses.text: I Tobit have walked all the days of my life in the ways of truth and justice, and I did many almsdeeds to my brothers, and my nation, who came with me to Nineve, into the land of the Assyrians.

verses.raw: And when I was in my own country, in the land of Yashar'el (Israel) being but young, all the tribe of Nephthali my father fell from the house of Jerusalem, which was chosen out of all the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel), that all the tribes should sacrifice there, where the temple of the habitation of the Most High was consecrated and built for all ages.
verses.text: And when I was in my own country, in the land of Yashar'el being but young, all the tribe of Nephthali my father fell from the house of Jerusalem, which was chosen out of all the tribes of Yashar'el, that all the tribes should sacrifice there, where the temple of the habitation of the Most High was consecrated and built for all ages.

verses.raw: Now all the tribes which together revolted, and the house of my father Nephthali, sacrificed to the heifer Baal.
verses.text: Now all the tribes which together revolted, and the house of my father Nephthali, sacrificed to the heifer Baal.

verses.raw: But I alone went often to Jerusalem at the feasts, as it was ordained to all the people of Yashar'el (Israel) by an everlasting decree, having the firstfruits and tenths of increase, with that which was first shorn; and them gave I at the altar to the priests the children of Aaron.
verses.text: But I alone went often to Jerusalem at the feasts, as it was ordained to all the people of Yashar'el by an everlasting decree, having the firstfruits and tenths of increase, with that which was first shorn; and them gave I at the altar to the priests the children of Aaron.

verses.raw: The first tenth part of all increase I gave to the sons of Aaron, who ministered at Jerusalem: another tenth part I sold away, and went, and spent it every year at Jerusalem:
verses.text: The first tenth part of all increase I gave to the sons of Aaron, who ministered at Jerusalem: another tenth part I sold away, and went, and spent it every year at Jerusalem:

verses.raw: And the third I gave to them to whom it was meet, as Debora my father’s mother had commanded me, because I was left an orphan by my father.
verses.text: And the third I gave to them to whom it was meet, as Debora my father’s mother had commanded me, because I was left an orphan by my father.

verses.raw: Furthermore, when I was come to the age of a man, I married Anna of my own kindred, and of her I begat Tobias.
verses.text: Furthermore, when I was come to the age of a man, I married Anna of my own kindred, and of her I begat Tobias.

verses.raw: And when we were carried away captives to Nineve, all my brothers and those that were of my kindred did eat of the bread of the Gentiles.
verses.text: And when we were carried away captives to Nineve, all my brothers and those that were of my kindred did eat of the bread of the Gentiles.

verses.raw: But I kept myself from eating;
verses.text: But I kept myself from eating;

verses.raw: Because I remembered Yahuah (God) with all my heart.
verses.text: Because I remembered Yahuah with all my heart.

verses.raw: And the Most High gave me grace and favour before Enemessar, so that I was his purveyor.
verses.text: And the Most High gave me grace and favour before Enemessar, so that I was his purveyor.

verses.raw: And I went into Media, and left in trust with Gabael, the brother of Gabrias, at Rages a city of Media ten talents of silver.
verses.text: And I went into Media, and left in trust with Gabael, the brother of Gabrias, at Rages a city of Media ten talents of silver.

verses.raw: Now when Enemessar was dead, Sennacherib his son reigned in his stead; whose estate was troubled, that I could not go into Media.
verses.text: Now when Enemessar was dead, Sennacherib his son reigned in his stead; whose estate was troubled, that I could not go into Media.

verses.raw: And in the time of Enemessar I gave many alms to my brothers, and gave my bread to the hungry,
verses.text: And in the time of Enemessar I gave many alms to my brothers, and gave my bread to the hungry,

verses.raw: And my clothes to the naked: and if I saw any of my nation dead, or cast about the walls of Nineve, I buried him.
verses.text: And my clothes to the naked: and if I saw any of my nation dead, or cast about the walls of Nineve, I buried him.

verses.raw: And if the king Sennacherib had slain any, when he was come, and fled from Judea, I buried them privily; for in his wrath he killed many; but the bodies were not found, when they were sought for of the king.
verses.text: And if the king Sennacherib had slain any, when he was come, and fled from Judea, I buried them privily; for in his wrath he killed many; but the bodies were not found, when they were sought for of the king.

verses.raw: And when one of the Ninevites went and complained of me to the king, that I buried them, and hid myself; understanding that I was sought for to be put to death, I withdrew myself for fear.
verses.text: And when one of the Ninevites went and complained of me to the king, that I buried them, and hid myself; understanding that I was sought for to be put to death, I withdrew myself for fear.

verses.raw: Then all my goods were forcibly taken away, neither was there any thing left me, beside my wife Anna and my son Tobias.
verses.text: Then all my goods were forcibly taken away, neither was there any thing left me, beside my wife Anna and my son Tobias.

verses.raw: And there passed not five and fifty days, before two of his sons killed him, and they fled into the mountains of Ararath; and Sarchedonus his son reigned in his stead; who appointed over his father’s accounts, and over all his affairs, Achiacharus my brother Anael’s son.
verses.text: And there passed not five and fifty days, before two of his sons killed him, and they fled into the mountains of Ararath; and Sarchedonus his son reigned in his stead; who appointed over his father’s accounts, and over all his affairs, Achiacharus my brother Anael’s son.

verses.raw: And Achiacharus intreating for me, I returned to Nineve. Now Achiacharus was cupbearer, and keeper of the signet, and steward, and overseer of the accounts: and Sarchedonus appointed him next to him: and he was my brother’s son. ⸻
verses.text: And Achiacharus intreating for me, I returned to Nineve. Now Achiacharus was cupbearer, and keeper of the signet, and steward, and overseer of the accounts: and Sarchedonus appointed him next to him: and he was my brother’s son. ⸻

verses.raw: Now when I was come home again, and my wife Anna was restored to me, with my son Tobias, in the feast of Pentecost, which is the holy feast of the seven weeks, there was a good dinner prepared me, in the which I sat down to eat.
verses.text: Now when I was come home again, and my wife Anna was restored to me, with my son Tobias, in the feast of Pentecost, which is the holy feast of the seven weeks, there was a good dinner prepared me, in the which I sat down to eat.

verses.raw: And when I saw abundance of meat, I said to my son, Go and bring what poor man soever you shall find out of our brothers, who is mindful of Yahuah (God); and, lo, I tarry for you.
verses.text: And when I saw abundance of meat, I said to my son, Go and bring what poor man soever you shall find out of our brothers, who is mindful of Yahuah; and, lo, I tarry for you.

verses.raw: But he came again, and said, Father, one of our nation is strangled, and is cast out in the marketplace.
verses.text: But he came again, and said, Father, one of our nation is strangled, and is cast out in the marketplace.

verses.raw: Then before I had tasted of any meat, I started up, and took him up into a room until the going down of the sun.
verses.text: Then before I had tasted of any meat, I started up, and took him up into a room until the going down of the sun.

verses.raw: Then I returned, and washed myself, and ate my meat in heaviness,
verses.text: Then I returned, and washed myself, and ate my meat in heaviness,

verses.raw: Remembering that prophecy of Amos, as he said, Your feasts shall be turned into mourning, and all your mirth into lamentation.
verses.text: Remembering that prophecy of Amos, as he said, Your feasts shall be turned into mourning, and all your mirth into lamentation.

verses.raw: Therefore I wept: and after the going down of the sun I went and made a grave, and buried him.
verses.text: Therefore I wept: and after the going down of the sun I went and made a grave, and buried him.

verses.raw: But my neighbours mocked me, and said, This man is not yet afraid to be put to death for this matter: who fled away; and yet, lo, he burieth the dead again.
verses.text: But my neighbours mocked me, and said, This man is not yet afraid to be put to death for this matter: who fled away; and yet, lo, he burieth the dead again.

verses.raw: The same night also I returned from the burial, and slept by the wall of my courtyard, being polluted and my face was uncovered:
verses.text: The same night also I returned from the burial, and slept by the wall of my courtyard, being polluted and my face was uncovered:

verses.raw: And I knew not that there were sparrows in the wall, and my eyes being open, the sparrows muted warm dung into my eyes, and a whiteness came in my eyes: and I went to the physicians, but they helped me not: moreover Achiacharus did nourish me, until I went into Elymais.
verses.text: And I knew not that there were sparrows in the wall, and my eyes being open, the sparrows muted warm dung into my eyes, and a whiteness came in my eyes: and I went to the physicians, but they helped me not: moreover Achiacharus did nourish me, until I went into Elymais.

verses.raw: And my wife Anna did take women’s works to do.
verses.text: And my wife Anna did take women’s works to do.

verses.raw: And when she had sent them home to the owners, they paid her wages, and gave her also besides a kid.
verses.text: And when she had sent them home to the owners, they paid her wages, and gave her also besides a kid.

verses.raw: And when it was in my house, and began to cry, I said to her, From whence is this kid? is it not stolen? render it to the owners; for it is not lawful to eat any thing that is stolen.
verses.text: And when it was in my house, and began to cry, I said to her, From whence is this kid? is it not stolen? render it to the owners; for it is not lawful to eat any thing that is stolen.

verses.raw: But she replied upon me, It was given for a gift more than the wages. Howbeit I did not believe her, but told her render it to the owners: and I was abashed at her. But she replied upon me, Where are your alms and your righteous deeds? behold, you and all your works are known. ⸻
verses.text: But she replied upon me, It was given for a gift more than the wages. Howbeit I did not believe her, but told her render it to the owners: and I was abashed at her. But she replied upon me, Where are your alms and your righteous deeds? behold, you and all your works are known. ⸻

verses.raw: Then I being grieved did weep, and in my sorrow prayed, saying,
verses.text: Then I being grieved did weep, and in my sorrow prayed, saying,

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), you are just, and all your works and all your ways are mercy and truth, and you judgest truly and justly for ever.
verses.text: O Yahuah, you are just, and all your works and all your ways are mercy and truth, and you judgest truly and justly for ever.

verses.raw: Remember me, and look on me, punish me not for my sins and ignorances, and the sins of my fathers, who have sinned before you:
verses.text: Remember me, and look on me, punish me not for my sins and ignorances, and the sins of my fathers, who have sinned before you:

verses.raw: For they obeyed not your commandments: wherefore you have delivered us for a spoil, and to captivity, and to death, and for a proverb of reproach to all the nations among whom we are dispersed.
verses.text: For they obeyed not your commandments: wherefore you have delivered us for a spoil, and to captivity, and to death, and for a proverb of reproach to all the nations among whom we are dispersed.

verses.raw: And now your judgments are many and true: deal with me according to my sins and my fathers’: because we have not kept your commandments, neither have walked in truth before you.
verses.text: And now your judgments are many and true: deal with me according to my sins and my fathers’: because we have not kept your commandments, neither have walked in truth before you.

verses.raw: Now therefore deal with me as seemeth best to you, and command my spirit to be taken from me, that I may be dissolved, and become earth: for it is profitable for me to die rather than to live, because I have heard false reproaches, and have much sorrow: command therefore that I may now be delivered out of this distress, and go into the everlasting place: turn not your face away from me.
verses.text: Now therefore deal with me as seemeth best to you, and command my spirit to be taken from me, that I may be dissolved, and become earth: for it is profitable for me to die rather than to live, because I have heard false reproaches, and have much sorrow: command therefore that I may now be delivered out of this distress, and go into the everlasting place: turn not your face away from me.

verses.raw: It came to pass the same day, that in Ecbatane a city of Media Sara the daughter of Raguel was also reproached by her father’s maids;
verses.text: It came to pass the same day, that in Ecbatane a city of Media Sara the daughter of Raguel was also reproached by her father’s maids;

verses.raw: Because that she had been married to seven husbands, whom Asmodeus the evil spirit had killed, before they had lain with her. Do you not know, said they, that you have strangled yours husbands? you have had already seven husbands, neither were you named after any of them.
verses.text: Because that she had been married to seven husbands, whom Asmodeus the evil spirit had killed, before they had lain with her. Do you not know, said they, that you have strangled yours husbands? you have had already seven husbands, neither were you named after any of them.

verses.raw: Wherefore do you beat us for them? if they be dead, go your ways after them, let us never see of you either son or daughter.
verses.text: Wherefore do you beat us for them? if they be dead, go your ways after them, let us never see of you either son or daughter.

verses.raw: Whe she heard these things, she was very sorrowful, so that she thought to have strangled herself; and she said, I am the only daughter of my father, and if I do this, it shall be a reproach to him, and I shall bring his old age with sorrow to the grave.
verses.text: Whe she heard these things, she was very sorrowful, so that she thought to have strangled herself; and she said, I am the only daughter of my father, and if I do this, it shall be a reproach to him, and I shall bring his old age with sorrow to the grave.

verses.raw: Then she prayed toward the window, and said, Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God), my Elohim (God), and yours holy and glorious name is blessed and honourable for ever: let all your works praise you for ever.
verses.text: Then she prayed toward the window, and said, Blessed art you, O Yahuah, my Elohim, and yours holy and glorious name is blessed and honourable for ever: let all your works praise you for ever.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah (God), I set my eyes and my face toward you,
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah, I set my eyes and my face toward you,

verses.raw: And say, Take me out of the earth, that I may hear no more the reproach.
verses.text: And say, Take me out of the earth, that I may hear no more the reproach.

verses.raw: You know, Yahuah (God), that I am pure from all sin with man,
verses.text: You know, Yahuah, that I am pure from all sin with man,

verses.raw: And that I never polluted my name, nor the name of my father, in the land of my captivity: I am the only daughter of my father, neither has he any child to be his heir, neither any near kinsman, nor any son of his alive, to whom I may keep myself for a wife: my seven husbands are already dead; and why should I live? but if it please not you that I should die, command some regard to be had of me, and pity taken of me, that I hear no more reproach.
verses.text: And that I never polluted my name, nor the name of my father, in the land of my captivity: I am the only daughter of my father, neither has he any child to be his heir, neither any near kinsman, nor any son of his alive, to whom I may keep myself for a wife: my seven husbands are already dead; and why should I live? but if it please not you that I should die, command some regard to be had of me, and pity taken of me, that I hear no more reproach.

verses.raw: So the prayers of them both were heard before the majesty of the great Yahuah (God).
verses.text: So the prayers of them both were heard before the majesty of the great Yahuah.

verses.raw: And Raphael was sent to heal them both, that is, to scale away the whiteness of Tobit’s eyes, and to give Sara the daughter of Raguel for a wife to Tobias the son of Tobit; and to bind Asmodeus the evil spirit; because she belonged to Tobias by right of inheritance. The selfsame time came Tobit home, and entered into his house, and Sara the daughter of Raguel came down from her upper chamber. ⸻
verses.text: And Raphael was sent to heal them both, that is, to scale away the whiteness of Tobit’s eyes, and to give Sara the daughter of Raguel for a wife to Tobias the son of Tobit; and to bind Asmodeus the evil spirit; because she belonged to Tobias by right of inheritance. The selfsame time came Tobit home, and entered into his house, and Sara the daughter of Raguel came down from her upper chamber. ⸻

verses.raw: In that day Tobit remembered the money which he had committed to Gabael in Rages of Media,
verses.text: In that day Tobit remembered the money which he had committed to Gabael in Rages of Media,

verses.raw: And said with himself, I have wished for death; wherefore do I not call for my son Tobias that I may signify to him of the money before I die?
verses.text: And said with himself, I have wished for death; wherefore do I not call for my son Tobias that I may signify to him of the money before I die?

verses.raw: And when he had called him, he said, My son, when I am dead, bury me; and despise not your mother, but honour her all the days of your life, and do that which shall please her, and grieve her not.
verses.text: And when he had called him, he said, My son, when I am dead, bury me; and despise not your mother, but honour her all the days of your life, and do that which shall please her, and grieve her not.

verses.raw: Remember, my son, that she saw many dangers for you, when you were in her womb: and when she is dead, bury her by me in one grave.
verses.text: Remember, my son, that she saw many dangers for you, when you were in her womb: and when she is dead, bury her by me in one grave.

verses.raw: My son, be mindful of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) all your days, and let not your will be set to sin, or to transgress his commandments: do uprightly all your life long, and follow not the ways of unrighteousness.
verses.text: My son, be mindful of Yahuah, our Elohim all your days, and let not your will be set to sin, or to transgress his commandments: do uprightly all your life long, and follow not the ways of unrighteousness.

verses.raw: For if you deal truly, your doings shall prosperously succeed to you, and to all them that live justly.
verses.text: For if you deal truly, your doings shall prosperously succeed to you, and to all them that live justly.

verses.raw: Give alms of your substance; and when you give alms, let not your eye be envious, neither turn your face from any poor, and the face of Yahuah (God) shall not be turned away from you.
verses.text: Give alms of your substance; and when you give alms, let not your eye be envious, neither turn your face from any poor, and the face of Yahuah shall not be turned away from you.

verses.raw: If you have abundance give alms accordingly: if you have but a little, be not afraid to give according to that little:
verses.text: If you have abundance give alms accordingly: if you have but a little, be not afraid to give according to that little:

verses.raw: For you layest up a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.
verses.text: For you layest up a good treasure for thyself against the day of necessity.

verses.raw: Because that alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.
verses.text: Because that alms do deliver from death, and suffers not to come into darkness.

verses.raw: For alms is a good gift to all that give it in the sight of the Most High.
verses.text: For alms is a good gift to all that give it in the sight of the Most High.

verses.raw: Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of your fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of your father’s tribe: for we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.
verses.text: Beware of all whoredom, my son, and chiefly take a wife of the seed of your fathers, and take not a strange woman to wife, which is not of your father’s tribe: for we are the children of the prophets, Noe, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob: remember, my son, that our fathers from the beginning, even that they all married wives of their own kindred, and were blessed in their children, and their seed shall inherit the land.

verses.raw: Now therefore, my son, love your brothers, and despise not in your heart your brothers, the sons and daughters of your people, in not taking a wife of them: for in pride is destruction and much trouble, and in lewdness is decay and great want: for lewdness is the mother of famine.
verses.text: Now therefore, my son, love your brothers, and despise not in your heart your brothers, the sons and daughters of your people, in not taking a wife of them: for in pride is destruction and much trouble, and in lewdness is decay and great want: for lewdness is the mother of famine.

verses.raw: Let not the wages of any man, which has wrought for you, tarry with you, but give him it out of hand: for if you serve Yahuah (God), he will also repay you: be circumspect my son, in all things you do, and be wise in all your conversation.
verses.text: Let not the wages of any man, which has wrought for you, tarry with you, but give him it out of hand: for if you serve Yahuah, he will also repay you: be circumspect my son, in all things you do, and be wise in all your conversation.

verses.raw: Do that to no man which you hatest: drink not wine to make you drunken: neither let drunkenness go with you in your journey.
verses.text: Do that to no man which you hatest: drink not wine to make you drunken: neither let drunkenness go with you in your journey.

verses.raw: Give of your bread to the hungry, and of your garments to them that are naked; and according to your abundance give alms: and let not your eye be envious, when you give alms.
verses.text: Give of your bread to the hungry, and of your garments to them that are naked; and according to your abundance give alms: and let not your eye be envious, when you give alms.

verses.raw: Pour out your bread on the burial of the just, but give nothing to the wicked.
verses.text: Pour out your bread on the burial of the just, but give nothing to the wicked.

verses.raw: Ask counsel of all that are wise, and despise not any counsel that is profitable.
verses.text: Ask counsel of all that are wise, and despise not any counsel that is profitable.

verses.raw: Bless Yahuah (God), your Elohim (God) alway, and desire of him that your ways may be directed, and that all your paths and counsels may prosper: for every nation has not counsel; but Yahuah (God) himself gives all good things, and he humbleth whom he will, as he will; now therefore, my son, remember my commandments, neither let them be put out of your mind.
verses.text: Bless Yahuah, your Elohim alway, and desire of him that your ways may be directed, and that all your paths and counsels may prosper: for every nation has not counsel; but Yahuah himself gives all good things, and he humbleth whom he will, as he will; now therefore, my son, remember my commandments, neither let them be put out of your mind.

verses.raw: And now I signify this to they that I committed ten talents to Gabael the son of Gabrias at Rages in Media.
verses.text: And now I signify this to they that I committed ten talents to Gabael the son of Gabrias at Rages in Media.

verses.raw: And fear not, my son, that we are made poor: for you have much wealth, if you fear Yahuah (God), and depart from all sin, and do that which is pleasing in his sight. ⸻
verses.text: And fear not, my son, that we are made poor: for you have much wealth, if you fear Yahuah, and depart from all sin, and do that which is pleasing in his sight. ⸻

verses.raw: Tobias then answered and said, Father, I will do all things which you have commanded me:
verses.text: Tobias then answered and said, Father, I will do all things which you have commanded me:

verses.raw: But how can I receive the money, seeing I know him not?
verses.text: But how can I receive the money, seeing I know him not?

verses.raw: Then he gave him the handwriting, and said to him, Seek you a man which may go with you, whiles I yet live, and I will give him wages: and go and receive the money.
verses.text: Then he gave him the handwriting, and said to him, Seek you a man which may go with you, whiles I yet live, and I will give him wages: and go and receive the money.

verses.raw: Therefore when he went to seek a man, he found Raphael that was an angel.
verses.text: Therefore when he went to seek a man, he found Raphael that was an angel.

verses.raw: But he knew not; and he said to him, Can you go with me to Rages? and knowest you those places well?
verses.text: But he knew not; and he said to him, Can you go with me to Rages? and knowest you those places well?

verses.raw: To whom the angel said, I will go with you, and I know the way well: for I have lodged with our brother Gabael.
verses.text: To whom the angel said, I will go with you, and I know the way well: for I have lodged with our brother Gabael.

verses.raw: Then Tobias said to him, Tarry for me, till I tell my father.
verses.text: Then Tobias said to him, Tarry for me, till I tell my father.

verses.raw: Then he said to him, Go and tarry not. So he went in and said to his father, Behold, I have found one which will go with me. Then he said, Call him to me, that I may know of what tribe he is, and whether he be a trusty man to go with you.
verses.text: Then he said to him, Go and tarry not. So he went in and said to his father, Behold, I have found one which will go with me. Then he said, Call him to me, that I may know of what tribe he is, and whether he be a trusty man to go with you.

verses.raw: So he called him, and he came in, and they saluted one another.
verses.text: So he called him, and he came in, and they saluted one another.

verses.raw: Then Tobit said to him, Brother, shew me of what tribe and family you are.
verses.text: Then Tobit said to him, Brother, shew me of what tribe and family you are.

verses.raw: To whom he said, Do you seek for a tribe or family, or an hired man to go with your son? Then Tobit said to him, I would know, brother, your kindred and name.
verses.text: To whom he said, Do you seek for a tribe or family, or an hired man to go with your son? Then Tobit said to him, I would know, brother, your kindred and name.

verses.raw: Then he said, I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and of your brothers.
verses.text: Then he said, I am Azarias, the son of Ananias the great, and of your brothers.

verses.raw: Then Tobit said, You are welcome, brother; be not now angry with me, because I have enquired to know your tribe and your family; for you are my brother, of an honest and good stock: for I know Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias, as we went together to Jerusalem to worship, and offered the firstborn, and the tenths of the fruits; and they were not seduced with the error of our brothers: my brother, you are of a good stock.
verses.text: Then Tobit said, You are welcome, brother; be not now angry with me, because I have enquired to know your tribe and your family; for you are my brother, of an honest and good stock: for I know Ananias and Jonathas, sons of that great Samaias, as we went together to Jerusalem to worship, and offered the firstborn, and the tenths of the fruits; and they were not seduced with the error of our brothers: my brother, you are of a good stock.

verses.raw: But tell me, what wages shall I give you? will you a drachm a day, and things necessary, as to my own son?
verses.text: But tell me, what wages shall I give you? will you a drachm a day, and things necessary, as to my own son?

verses.raw: Yea, moreover, if you return safe, I will add something to your wages.
verses.text: Yea, moreover, if you return safe, I will add something to your wages.

verses.raw: So they were well pleased. Then said he to Tobias, Prepare thyself for the journey, and Yahuah (God) send you a good journey. And when his son had prepared all things for the journey, his father said, Go you with this man, and Yahuah (God), which dwells in heaven, prosper your journey, and the angel of Yahuah (God) keep you company. So they went forth both, and the young man’s dog with them.
verses.text: So they were well pleased. Then said he to Tobias, Prepare thyself for the journey, and Yahuah send you a good journey. And when his son had prepared all things for the journey, his father said, Go you with this man, and Yahuah, which dwells in heaven, prosper your journey, and the angel of Yahuah keep you company. So they went forth both, and the young man’s dog with them.

verses.raw: But Anna his mother wept, and said to Tobit, Why have you sent away our son? is he not the staff of our hand, in going in and out before us?
verses.text: But Anna his mother wept, and said to Tobit, Why have you sent away our son? is he not the staff of our hand, in going in and out before us?

verses.raw: Be not greedy to add money to money: but let it be as refuse in respect of our child.
verses.text: Be not greedy to add money to money: but let it be as refuse in respect of our child.

verses.raw: For that which Yahuah (God) has given us to live with does suffice us.
verses.text: For that which Yahuah has given us to live with does suffice us.

verses.raw: Then said Tobit to her, Take no care, my sister; he shall return in safety, and your eyes shall see him.
verses.text: Then said Tobit to her, Take no care, my sister; he shall return in safety, and your eyes shall see him.

verses.raw: For the good angel will keep him company, and his journey shall be prosperous, and he shall return safe.
verses.text: For the good angel will keep him company, and his journey shall be prosperous, and he shall return safe.

verses.raw: Then she made an end of weeping. ⸻
verses.text: Then she made an end of weeping. ⸻

verses.raw: And as they went on their journey, they came in the evening to the river Tigris, and they lodged there.
verses.text: And as they went on their journey, they came in the evening to the river Tigris, and they lodged there.

verses.raw: And when the young man went down to wash himself, a fish leaped out of the river, and would have devoured him.
verses.text: And when the young man went down to wash himself, a fish leaped out of the river, and would have devoured him.

verses.raw: Then the angel said to him, Take the fish. And the young man laid hold of the fish, and drew it to land.
verses.text: Then the angel said to him, Take the fish. And the young man laid hold of the fish, and drew it to land.

verses.raw: To whom the angel said, Open the fish, and take the heart and the liver and the gall, and put them up safely.
verses.text: To whom the angel said, Open the fish, and take the heart and the liver and the gall, and put them up safely.

verses.raw: So the young man did as the angel commanded him; and when they had roasted the fish, they did eat it: then they both went on their way, till they drew near to Ecbatane.
verses.text: So the young man did as the angel commanded him; and when they had roasted the fish, they did eat it: then they both went on their way, till they drew near to Ecbatane.

verses.raw: Then the young man said to the angel, Brother Azarias, to what use is the heart and the liver and the gal of the fish?
verses.text: Then the young man said to the angel, Brother Azarias, to what use is the heart and the liver and the gal of the fish?

verses.raw: And he said to him, Touching the heart and the liver, if a devil or an evil spirit trouble any, we must make a smoke thereof before the man or the woman, and the party shall be no more vexed.
verses.text: And he said to him, Touching the heart and the liver, if a devil or an evil spirit trouble any, we must make a smoke thereof before the man or the woman, and the party shall be no more vexed.

verses.raw: As for the gall, it is good to anoint a man that has whiteness in his eyes, and he shall be healed.
verses.text: As for the gall, it is good to anoint a man that has whiteness in his eyes, and he shall be healed.

verses.raw: And when they were come near to Rages,
verses.text: And when they were come near to Rages,

verses.raw: The angel said to the young man, Brother, to day we shall lodge with Raguel, who is your cousin; he also has one only daughter, named Sara; I will speak for her, that she may be given you for a wife.
verses.text: The angel said to the young man, Brother, to day we shall lodge with Raguel, who is your cousin; he also has one only daughter, named Sara; I will speak for her, that she may be given you for a wife.

verses.raw: For to you does the right of her appertain, seeing you only art of her kindred.
verses.text: For to you does the right of her appertain, seeing you only art of her kindred.

verses.raw: And the maid is fair and wise: now therefore hear me, and I will speak to her father; and when we return from Rages we will celebrate the marriage: for I know that Raguel cannot marry her to another according to the law of Moses, but he shall be guilty of death, because the right of inheritance does rather appertain to you than to any other.
verses.text: And the maid is fair and wise: now therefore hear me, and I will speak to her father; and when we return from Rages we will celebrate the marriage: for I know that Raguel cannot marry her to another according to the law of Moses, but he shall be guilty of death, because the right of inheritance does rather appertain to you than to any other.

verses.raw: Then the young man answered the angel, I have heard, brother Azarias that this maid has been given to seven men, who all died in the marriage chamber.
verses.text: Then the young man answered the angel, I have heard, brother Azarias that this maid has been given to seven men, who all died in the marriage chamber.

verses.raw: And now I am the only son of my father, and I am afraid, lest if I go in to her, I die, as the other before: for a wicked spirit loves her, which hurteth no body, but those which come to her; wherefore I also fear lest I die, and bring my father’s and my mother’s life because of me to the grave with sorrow: for they have no other son to bury them.
verses.text: And now I am the only son of my father, and I am afraid, lest if I go in to her, I die, as the other before: for a wicked spirit loves her, which hurteth no body, but those which come to her; wherefore I also fear lest I die, and bring my father’s and my mother’s life because of me to the grave with sorrow: for they have no other son to bury them.

verses.raw: Then the angel said to him, Do you not remember the precepts which your father gave you, that you should marry a wife of your own kindred? wherefore hear me, O my brother; for she shall be given you to wife; and make you no reckoning of the evil spirit; for this same night shall she be given you in marriage.
verses.text: Then the angel said to him, Do you not remember the precepts which your father gave you, that you should marry a wife of your own kindred? wherefore hear me, O my brother; for she shall be given you to wife; and make you no reckoning of the evil spirit; for this same night shall she be given you in marriage.

verses.raw: And when you shall come into the marriage chamber, you shall take the ashes of perfume, and shall lay upon them some of the heart and liver of the fish, and shall make a smoke with it:
verses.text: And when you shall come into the marriage chamber, you shall take the ashes of perfume, and shall lay upon them some of the heart and liver of the fish, and shall make a smoke with it:

verses.raw: And the devil shall smell it, and flee away, and never come again any more: but when you shall come to her, rise up both of you, and pray to Yahuah (God) which is merciful, who will have pity on you, and save you: fear not, for she is appointed to you from the beginning; and you shall preserve her, and she shall go with you. Moreover I suppose that she shall bear you children. Now when Tobias had heard these things, he loved her, and his heart was effectually joined to her. ⸻
verses.text: And the devil shall smell it, and flee away, and never come again any more: but when you shall come to her, rise up both of you, and pray to Yahuah which is merciful, who will have pity on you, and save you: fear not, for she is appointed to you from the beginning; and you shall preserve her, and she shall go with you. Moreover I suppose that she shall bear you children. Now when Tobias had heard these things, he loved her, and his heart was effectually joined to her. ⸻

verses.raw: And when they were come to Ecbatane, they came to the house of Raguel, and Sara met them: and after they had saluted one another, she brought them into the house.
verses.text: And when they were come to Ecbatane, they came to the house of Raguel, and Sara met them: and after they had saluted one another, she brought them into the house.

verses.raw: Then said Raguel to Edna his wife, How like is this young man to Tobit my cousin!
verses.text: Then said Raguel to Edna his wife, How like is this young man to Tobit my cousin!

verses.raw: And Raguel asked them, From whence are you, brothers? To whom they said, We are of the sons of Nephthalim, which are captives in Nineve.
verses.text: And Raguel asked them, From whence are you, brothers? To whom they said, We are of the sons of Nephthalim, which are captives in Nineve.

verses.raw: Then he said to them, Do you know Tobit our kinsman? And they said, We know him. Then said he, Is he in good health?
verses.text: Then he said to them, Do you know Tobit our kinsman? And they said, We know him. Then said he, Is he in good health?

verses.raw: And they said, He is both alive, and in good health: and Tobias said, He is my father.
verses.text: And they said, He is both alive, and in good health: and Tobias said, He is my father.

verses.raw: Then Raguel leaped up, and kissed him, and wept,
verses.text: Then Raguel leaped up, and kissed him, and wept,

verses.raw: And blessed him, and said to him, You are the son of an honest and good man. But when he had heard that Tobit was blind, he was sorrowful, and wept.
verses.text: And blessed him, and said to him, You are the son of an honest and good man. But when he had heard that Tobit was blind, he was sorrowful, and wept.

verses.raw: And likewise Edna his wife and Sara his daughter wept. Moreover they entertained them cheerfully; and after that they had killed a ram of the flock, they set store of meat on the table. Then said Tobias to Raphael, Brother Azarias, speak of those things of which you did talk in the way, and let this business be dispatched.
verses.text: And likewise Edna his wife and Sara his daughter wept. Moreover they entertained them cheerfully; and after that they had killed a ram of the flock, they set store of meat on the table. Then said Tobias to Raphael, Brother Azarias, speak of those things of which you did talk in the way, and let this business be dispatched.

verses.raw: So he communicated the matter with Raguel: and Raguel said to Tobias, Eat and drink, and make merry:
verses.text: So he communicated the matter with Raguel: and Raguel said to Tobias, Eat and drink, and make merry:

verses.raw: For it is meet that you should marry my daughter: nevertheless I will declare to you the truth.
verses.text: For it is meet that you should marry my daughter: nevertheless I will declare to you the truth.

verses.raw: I have given my daughter in marriage to seven men, who died that night they came in to her: nevertheless for the present be merry. But Tobias said, I will eat nothing here, till we agree and swear one to another.
verses.text: I have given my daughter in marriage to seven men, who died that night they came in to her: nevertheless for the present be merry. But Tobias said, I will eat nothing here, till we agree and swear one to another.

verses.raw: Raguel said, Then take her from henceforth according to the manner, for you are her cousin, and she is yours, and the merciful Yahuah (God) give you good success in all things.
verses.text: Raguel said, Then take her from henceforth according to the manner, for you are her cousin, and she is yours, and the merciful Yahuah give you good success in all things.

verses.raw: Then he called his daughter Sara, and she came to her father, and he took her by the hand, and gave her to be wife to Tobias, saying, Behold, take her after the law of Moses, and lead her away to your father. And he blessed them;
verses.text: Then he called his daughter Sara, and she came to her father, and he took her by the hand, and gave her to be wife to Tobias, saying, Behold, take her after the law of Moses, and lead her away to your father. And he blessed them;

verses.raw: And called Edna his wife, and took paper, and did write an instrument of covenants, and sealed it.
verses.text: And called Edna his wife, and took paper, and did write an instrument of covenants, and sealed it.

verses.raw: Then they began to eat.
verses.text: Then they began to eat.

verses.raw: After Raguel called his wife Edna, and said to her, Sister, prepare another chamber, and bring her in thither.
verses.text: After Raguel called his wife Edna, and said to her, Sister, prepare another chamber, and bring her in thither.

verses.raw: Which when she had done as he had bidden her, she brought her thither: and she wept, and she received the tears of her daughter, and said to her,
verses.text: Which when she had done as he had bidden her, she brought her thither: and she wept, and she received the tears of her daughter, and said to her,

verses.raw: Be of good comfort, my daughter; Yahuah (God) of heaven and earth give you joy for this your sorrow: be of good comfort, my daughter. ⸻
verses.text: Be of good comfort, my daughter; Yahuah of heaven and earth give you joy for this your sorrow: be of good comfort, my daughter. ⸻

verses.raw: And when they had supped, they brought Tobias in to her.
verses.text: And when they had supped, they brought Tobias in to her.

verses.raw: And as he went, he remembered the words of Raphael, and took the ashes of the perfumes, and put the heart and the liver of the fish thereupon, and made a smoke with it.
verses.text: And as he went, he remembered the words of Raphael, and took the ashes of the perfumes, and put the heart and the liver of the fish thereupon, and made a smoke with it.

verses.raw: The which smell when the evil spirit had smelled, he fled into the utmost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him.
verses.text: The which smell when the evil spirit had smelled, he fled into the utmost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him.

verses.raw: And after that they were both shut in together, Tobias rose out of the bed, and said, Sister, arise, and let us pray that Yahuah (God) would have pity on us.
verses.text: And after that they were both shut in together, Tobias rose out of the bed, and said, Sister, arise, and let us pray that Yahuah would have pity on us.

verses.raw: Then began Tobias to say, Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God) of our fathers, and blessed is your holy and glorious name for ever; let the heavens bless you, and all your creatures.
verses.text: Then began Tobias to say, Blessed art you, O Yahuah of our fathers, and blessed is your holy and glorious name for ever; let the heavens bless you, and all your creatures.

verses.raw: You madest Adam, and gavest him Eve his wife for an helper and stay: of them came mankind: you have said, It is not good that man should be alone; let us make to him an aid like to himself.
verses.text: You madest Adam, and gavest him Eve his wife for an helper and stay: of them came mankind: you have said, It is not good that man should be alone; let us make to him an aid like to himself.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah (God), I take not this my sister for lust but uprightly: therefore mercifully ordain that we may become aged together.
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah, I take not this my sister for lust but uprightly: therefore mercifully ordain that we may become aged together.

verses.raw: And she said with him, Amen.
verses.text: And she said with him, Amen.

verses.raw: So they slept both that night. And Raguel arose, and went and made a grave,
verses.text: So they slept both that night. And Raguel arose, and went and made a grave,

verses.raw: Saying, I fear lest he also be dead.
verses.text: Saying, I fear lest he also be dead.

verses.raw: But when Raguel was come into his house,
verses.text: But when Raguel was come into his house,

verses.raw: He said to his wife Edna. Send one of the maids, and let her see whether he be alive: if he be not, that we may bury him, and no man know it.
verses.text: He said to his wife Edna. Send one of the maids, and let her see whether he be alive: if he be not, that we may bury him, and no man know it.

verses.raw: So the maid opened the door, and went in, and found them both asleep,
verses.text: So the maid opened the door, and went in, and found them both asleep,

verses.raw: And came forth, and told them that he was alive.
verses.text: And came forth, and told them that he was alive.

verses.raw: Then Raguel praised Yahuah (God), and said, O Yahuah (God), you are worthy to be praised with all pure and holy praise; therefore let your saints praise you with all your creatures; and let all your angels and your elect praise you for ever.
verses.text: Then Raguel praised Yahuah, and said, O Yahuah, you are worthy to be praised with all pure and holy praise; therefore let your saints praise you with all your creatures; and let all your angels and your elect praise you for ever.

verses.raw: You are to be praised, for you have made me joyful; and that is not come to me which I suspected; but you have dealt with us according to your great mercy.
verses.text: You are to be praised, for you have made me joyful; and that is not come to me which I suspected; but you have dealt with us according to your great mercy.

verses.raw: You are to be praised because you have had mercy of two that were the only begotten children of their fathers: grant them mercy, O Yahuah (God), and finish their life in health with joy and mercy.
verses.text: You are to be praised because you have had mercy of two that were the only begotten children of their fathers: grant them mercy, O Yahuah, and finish their life in health with joy and mercy.

verses.raw: Then Raguel told his servants to fill the grave.
verses.text: Then Raguel told his servants to fill the grave.

verses.raw: And he kept the wedding feast fourteen days.
verses.text: And he kept the wedding feast fourteen days.

verses.raw: For before the days of the marriage were finished, Raguel had said to him by an oath, that he should not depart till the fourteen days of the marriage were expired;
verses.text: For before the days of the marriage were finished, Raguel had said to him by an oath, that he should not depart till the fourteen days of the marriage were expired;

verses.raw: And then he should take the half of his goods, and go in safety to his father; and should have the rest when I and my wife be dead. ⸻
verses.text: And then he should take the half of his goods, and go in safety to his father; and should have the rest when I and my wife be dead. ⸻

verses.raw: Then Tobias called Raphael, and said to him,
verses.text: Then Tobias called Raphael, and said to him,

verses.raw: Brother Azarias, take with you a servant, and two camels, and go to Rages of Media to Gabael, and bring me the money, and bring him to the wedding.
verses.text: Brother Azarias, take with you a servant, and two camels, and go to Rages of Media to Gabael, and bring me the money, and bring him to the wedding.

verses.raw: For Raguel has sworn that I shall not depart.
verses.text: For Raguel has sworn that I shall not depart.

verses.raw: But my father counteth the days; and if I tarry long, he will be very sorry.
verses.text: But my father counteth the days; and if I tarry long, he will be very sorry.

verses.raw: So Raphael went out, and lodged with Gabael, and gave him the handwriting: who brought forth bags which were sealed up, and gave them to him.
verses.text: So Raphael went out, and lodged with Gabael, and gave him the handwriting: who brought forth bags which were sealed up, and gave them to him.

verses.raw: And early in the morning they went forth both together, and came to the wedding: and Tobias blessed his wife. ⸻
verses.text: And early in the morning they went forth both together, and came to the wedding: and Tobias blessed his wife. ⸻

verses.raw: Now Tobit his father counted every day: and when the days of the journey were expired, and they came not,
verses.text: Now Tobit his father counted every day: and when the days of the journey were expired, and they came not,

verses.raw: Then Tobit said, Are they detained? or is Gabael dead, and there is no man to give him the money?
verses.text: Then Tobit said, Are they detained? or is Gabael dead, and there is no man to give him the money?

verses.raw: Therefore he was very sorry.
verses.text: Therefore he was very sorry.

verses.raw: Then his wife said to him, My son is dead, seeing he stayeth long; and she began to wail him, and said,
verses.text: Then his wife said to him, My son is dead, seeing he stayeth long; and she began to wail him, and said,

verses.raw: Now I care for nothing, my son, since I have let you go, the light of my eyes.
verses.text: Now I care for nothing, my son, since I have let you go, the light of my eyes.

verses.raw: To whom Tobit said, Hold your peace, take no care, for he is safe.
verses.text: To whom Tobit said, Hold your peace, take no care, for he is safe.

verses.raw: But she said, Hold your peace, and deceive me not; my son is dead. And she went out every day into the way which they went, and did eat no meat on the daytime, and ceased not whole nights to bewail her son Tobias, until the fourteen days of the wedding were expired, which Raguel had sworn that he should spend there. Then Tobias said to Raguel, Let me go, for my father and my mother look no more to see me.
verses.text: But she said, Hold your peace, and deceive me not; my son is dead. And she went out every day into the way which they went, and did eat no meat on the daytime, and ceased not whole nights to bewail her son Tobias, until the fourteen days of the wedding were expired, which Raguel had sworn that he should spend there. Then Tobias said to Raguel, Let me go, for my father and my mother look no more to see me.

verses.raw: But his father in law said to him, Tarry with me, and I will send to your father, and they shall declare to him how things go with you.
verses.text: But his father in law said to him, Tarry with me, and I will send to your father, and they shall declare to him how things go with you.

verses.raw: But Tobias said, No; but let me go to my father.
verses.text: But Tobias said, No; but let me go to my father.

verses.raw: Then Raguel arose, and gave him Sara his wife, and half his goods, servants, and cattle, and money:
verses.text: Then Raguel arose, and gave him Sara his wife, and half his goods, servants, and cattle, and money:

verses.raw: And he blessed them, and sent them away, saying, Yahuah (God) of heaven give you a prosperous journey, my children.
verses.text: And he blessed them, and sent them away, saying, Yahuah of heaven give you a prosperous journey, my children.

verses.raw: And he said to his daughter, Honour your father and your mother in law, which are now your parents, that I may hear good report of you. And he kissed her. Edna also said to Tobias, Yahuah (God) of heaven restore you, my dear brother, and grant that I may see your children of my daughter Sara before I die, that I may rejoice before Yahuah (God): behold, I commit my daughter to you of special trust; where are do not entreat her evil. ⸻
verses.text: And he said to his daughter, Honour your father and your mother in law, which are now your parents, that I may hear good report of you. And he kissed her. Edna also said to Tobias, Yahuah of heaven restore you, my dear brother, and grant that I may see your children of my daughter Sara before I die, that I may rejoice before Yahuah: behold, I commit my daughter to you of special trust; where are do not entreat her evil. ⸻

verses.raw: After these things Tobias went his way, praising Yahuah (God) that he had given him a prosperous journey, and blessed Raguel and Edna his wife, and went on his way till they drew near to Nineve.
verses.text: After these things Tobias went his way, praising Yahuah that he had given him a prosperous journey, and blessed Raguel and Edna his wife, and went on his way till they drew near to Nineve.

verses.raw: Then Raphael said to Tobias, You know, brother, how you did leave your father:
verses.text: Then Raphael said to Tobias, You know, brother, how you did leave your father:

verses.raw: Let us haste before your wife, and prepare the house.
verses.text: Let us haste before your wife, and prepare the house.

verses.raw: And take in yours hand the gall of the fish. So they went their way, and the dog went after them.
verses.text: And take in yours hand the gall of the fish. So they went their way, and the dog went after them.

verses.raw: Now Anna sat looking about toward the way for her son.
verses.text: Now Anna sat looking about toward the way for her son.

verses.raw: And when she espied him coming, she said to his father, Behold, your son comes, and the man that went with him.
verses.text: And when she espied him coming, she said to his father, Behold, your son comes, and the man that went with him.

verses.raw: Then said Raphael, I know, Tobias, that your father will open his eyes.
verses.text: Then said Raphael, I know, Tobias, that your father will open his eyes.

verses.raw: Therefore anoint you his eyes with the gall, and being pricked with it, he shall rub, and the whiteness shall fall away, and he shall see you.
verses.text: Therefore anoint you his eyes with the gall, and being pricked with it, he shall rub, and the whiteness shall fall away, and he shall see you.

verses.raw: Then Anna ran forth, and fell upon the neck of her son, and said to him, Seeing I have seen you, my son, from henceforth I am content to die. And they wept both.
verses.text: Then Anna ran forth, and fell upon the neck of her son, and said to him, Seeing I have seen you, my son, from henceforth I am content to die. And they wept both.

verses.raw: Tobit also went forth toward the door, and stumbled: but his son ran to him,
verses.text: Tobit also went forth toward the door, and stumbled: but his son ran to him,

verses.raw: And took hold of his father: and he strake of the gall on his fathers’ eyes, saying, Be of good hope, my father.
verses.text: And took hold of his father: and he strake of the gall on his fathers’ eyes, saying, Be of good hope, my father.

verses.raw: And when his eyes began to smart, he rubbed them;
verses.text: And when his eyes began to smart, he rubbed them;

verses.raw: And the whiteness pilled away from the corners of his eyes: and when he saw his son, he fell upon his neck.
verses.text: And the whiteness pilled away from the corners of his eyes: and when he saw his son, he fell upon his neck.

verses.raw: And he wept, and said, Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God), and blessed is your name for ever; and blessed are all yours holy angels:
verses.text: And he wept, and said, Blessed art you, O Yahuah, and blessed is your name for ever; and blessed are all yours holy angels:

verses.raw: For you have scourged, and have taken pity on me: for, behold, I see my son Tobias. And his son went in rejoicing, and told his father the great things that had happened to him in Media.
verses.text: For you have scourged, and have taken pity on me: for, behold, I see my son Tobias. And his son went in rejoicing, and told his father the great things that had happened to him in Media.

verses.raw: Then Tobit went out to meet his daughter in law at the gate of Nineve, rejoicing and praising Yahuah (God): and they which saw him go marvelled, because he had received his sight.
verses.text: Then Tobit went out to meet his daughter in law at the gate of Nineve, rejoicing and praising Yahuah: and they which saw him go marvelled, because he had received his sight.

verses.raw: But Tobias gave thanks before them, because Yahuah (God) had mercy on him. And when he came near to Sara his daughter in law, he blessed her, saying, You are welcome, daughter: Yahuah (God) be blessed, which has brought you to us, and blessed be your father and your mother. And there was joy among all his brothers which were at Nineve.
verses.text: But Tobias gave thanks before them, because Yahuah had mercy on him. And when he came near to Sara his daughter in law, he blessed her, saying, You are welcome, daughter: Yahuah be blessed, which has brought you to us, and blessed be your father and your mother. And there was joy among all his brothers which were at Nineve.

verses.raw: And Achiacharus, and Nasbas his brother’s son, came:
verses.text: And Achiacharus, and Nasbas his brother’s son, came:

verses.raw: And Tobias’ wedding was kept seven days with great joy. ⸻
verses.text: And Tobias’ wedding was kept seven days with great joy. ⸻

verses.raw: Then Tobit called his son Tobias, and said to him, My son, see that the man have his wages, which went with you, and you must give him more.
verses.text: Then Tobit called his son Tobias, and said to him, My son, see that the man have his wages, which went with you, and you must give him more.

verses.raw: And Tobias said to him, O father, it is no harm to me to give him half of those things which I have brought:
verses.text: And Tobias said to him, O father, it is no harm to me to give him half of those things which I have brought:

verses.raw: For he has brought me again to you in safety, and made whole my wife, and brought me the money, and likewise healed you.
verses.text: For he has brought me again to you in safety, and made whole my wife, and brought me the money, and likewise healed you.

verses.raw: Then the old man said, It is due to him.
verses.text: Then the old man said, It is due to him.

verses.raw: So he called the angel, and he said to him, Take half of all that you have brought and go away in safety.
verses.text: So he called the angel, and he said to him, Take half of all that you have brought and go away in safety.

verses.raw: Then he took them both apart, and said to them, Bless Yahuah (God), praise him, and magnify him, and praise him for the things which he has done to you in the sight of all that live. It is good to praise Yahuah (God), and exalt his name, and honourably to shew forth the works of Yahuah (God); therefore be not slack to praise him.
verses.text: Then he took them both apart, and said to them, Bless Yahuah, praise him, and magnify him, and praise him for the things which he has done to you in the sight of all that live. It is good to praise Yahuah, and exalt his name, and honourably to shew forth the works of Yahuah; therefore be not slack to praise him.

verses.raw: It is good to keep close the secret of a king, but it is honourable to reveal the works of Yahuah (God). Do that which is good, and no evil shall touch you.
verses.text: It is good to keep close the secret of a king, but it is honourable to reveal the works of Yahuah. Do that which is good, and no evil shall touch you.

verses.raw: Prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold:
verses.text: Prayer is good with fasting and alms and righteousness. A little with righteousness is better than much with unrighteousness. It is better to give alms than to lay up gold:

verses.raw: For alms does deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin. Those that exercise alms and righteousness shall be filled with life:
verses.text: For alms does deliver from death, and shall purge away all sin. Those that exercise alms and righteousness shall be filled with life:

verses.raw: But they that sin are enemies to their own life.
verses.text: But they that sin are enemies to their own life.

verses.raw: Surely I will keep close nothing from you. For I said, It was good to keep close the secret of a king, but that it was honourable to reveal the works of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Surely I will keep close nothing from you. For I said, It was good to keep close the secret of a king, but that it was honourable to reveal the works of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Now therefore, when you did pray, and Sara your daughter in law, I did bring the remembrance of your prayers before the Holy One: and when you did bury the dead, I was with you likewise.
verses.text: Now therefore, when you did pray, and Sara your daughter in law, I did bring the remembrance of your prayers before the Holy One: and when you did bury the dead, I was with you likewise.

verses.raw: And when you did not delay to rise up, and leave your dinner, to go and cover the dead, your good deed was not hid from me: but I was with you.
verses.text: And when you did not delay to rise up, and leave your dinner, to go and cover the dead, your good deed was not hid from me: but I was with you.

verses.raw: And now Yahuah (God) has sent me to heal you and Sara your daughter in law.
verses.text: And now Yahuah has sent me to heal you and Sara your daughter in law.

verses.raw: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.
verses.text: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.

verses.raw: Then they were both troubled, and fell upon their faces: for they feared.
verses.text: Then they were both troubled, and fell upon their faces: for they feared.

verses.raw: But he said to them, Fear not, for it shall go well with you; praise Yahuah (God) therefore.
verses.text: But he said to them, Fear not, for it shall go well with you; praise Yahuah therefore.

verses.raw: For not of any favour of mine, but by the will of our Elohim (God) I came; wherefore praise him for ever.
verses.text: For not of any favour of mine, but by the will of our Elohim I came; wherefore praise him for ever.

verses.raw: All these days I did appear to you; but I did neither eat nor drink, but you did see a vision.
verses.text: All these days I did appear to you; but I did neither eat nor drink, but you did see a vision.

verses.raw: Now therefore give Yahuah (God) thanks: for I go up to him that sent me; but write all things which are done in a book.
verses.text: Now therefore give Yahuah thanks: for I go up to him that sent me; but write all things which are done in a book.

verses.raw: And when they arose, they saw him no more.
verses.text: And when they arose, they saw him no more.

verses.raw: Then they confessed the great and wonderful works of Yahuah (God), and how the angel of Yahuah (God) had appeared to them. ⸻
verses.text: Then they confessed the great and wonderful works of Yahuah, and how the angel of Yahuah had appeared to them. ⸻

verses.raw: Then Tobit wrote a prayer of rejoicing, and said, Blessed be Yahuah (God) that lives for ever, and blessed be his kingdom.
verses.text: Then Tobit wrote a prayer of rejoicing, and said, Blessed be Yahuah that lives for ever, and blessed be his kingdom.

verses.raw: For he does scourge, and has mercy: he leadeth down to hell, and brings up again: neither is there any that can avoid his hand.
verses.text: For he does scourge, and has mercy: he leadeth down to hell, and brings up again: neither is there any that can avoid his hand.

verses.raw: Confess him before the Gentiles, you children of Yashar'el (Israel): for he has scattered us among them.
verses.text: Confess him before the Gentiles, you children of Yashar'el: for he has scattered us among them.

verses.raw: There declare his greatness, and extol him before all the living: for he is our Elohim (God), and he is Yahuah (God) our Father for ever.
verses.text: There declare his greatness, and extol him before all the living: for he is our Elohim, and he is Yahuah our Father for ever.

verses.raw: And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.
verses.text: And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.

verses.raw: If you turn to him with your whole heart, and with your whole mind, and deal uprightly before him, then will he turn to you, and will not hide his face from you. Therefore see what he will do with you, and confess him with your whole mouth, and praise Yahuah (God) of might, and extol the everlasting King. In the land of my captivity do I praise him, and declare his might and majesty to a sinful nation. O you sinners, turn and do justice before him: who can tell if he will accept you, and have mercy on you?
verses.text: If you turn to him with your whole heart, and with your whole mind, and deal uprightly before him, then will he turn to you, and will not hide his face from you. Therefore see what he will do with you, and confess him with your whole mouth, and praise Yahuah of might, and extol the everlasting King. In the land of my captivity do I praise him, and declare his might and majesty to a sinful nation. O you sinners, turn and do justice before him: who can tell if he will accept you, and have mercy on you?

verses.raw: I will extol my Elohim (God), and my soul shall praise the King of heaven, and shall rejoice in his greatness.
verses.text: I will extol my Elohim, and my soul shall praise the King of heaven, and shall rejoice in his greatness.

verses.raw: Let all men speak, and let all praise him for his righteousness.
