verses.text: Let all men speak, and let all praise him for his righteousness.

verses.raw: O Jerusalem, the holy city, he will scourge you for your children’s works, and will have mercy again on the sons of the righteous.
verses.text: O Jerusalem, the holy city, he will scourge you for your children’s works, and will have mercy again on the sons of the righteous.

verses.raw: Give praise to Yahuah (God), for he is good: and praise the everlasting King, that his tabernacle may be builded in you again with joy, and let him make joyful there in you those that are captives, and love in you for ever those that are miserable.
verses.text: Give praise to Yahuah, for he is good: and praise the everlasting King, that his tabernacle may be builded in you again with joy, and let him make joyful there in you those that are captives, and love in you for ever those that are miserable.

verses.raw: Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah (God) with gifts in their hands, even gifts to the King of heaven; all generations shall praise you with great joy.
verses.text: Many nations shall come from far to the name of Yahuah with gifts in their hands, even gifts to the King of heaven; all generations shall praise you with great joy.

verses.raw: Cursed are all they which hate you, and blessed shall all be which love you for ever.
verses.text: Cursed are all they which hate you, and blessed shall all be which love you for ever.

verses.raw: Rejoice and be glad for the children of the just: for they shall be gathered together, and shall bless Yahuah (God) of the just.
verses.text: Rejoice and be glad for the children of the just: for they shall be gathered together, and shall bless Yahuah of the just.

verses.raw: O blessed are they which love you, for they shall rejoice in your peace: blessed are they which have been sorrowful for all your scourges; for they shall rejoice for you, when they have seen all your glory, and shall be glad for ever.
verses.text: O blessed are they which love you, for they shall rejoice in your peace: blessed are they which have been sorrowful for all your scourges; for they shall rejoice for you, when they have seen all your glory, and shall be glad for ever.

verses.raw: Let my soul bless Yahuah (God) the great King.
verses.text: Let my soul bless Yahuah the great King.

verses.raw: For Jerusalem shall be built up with sapphires and emeralds, and precious stone: your walls and towers and battlements with pure gold.
verses.text: For Jerusalem shall be built up with sapphires and emeralds, and precious stone: your walls and towers and battlements with pure gold.

verses.raw: And the streets of Jerusalem shall be paved with beryl and carbuncle and stones of Ophir.
verses.text: And the streets of Jerusalem shall be paved with beryl and carbuncle and stones of Ophir.

verses.raw: And all her streets shall say, Alleluia; and they shall praise him, saying, Blessed be Yahuah (God), which has extolled it for ever. ⸻
verses.text: And all her streets shall say, Alleluia; and they shall praise him, saying, Blessed be Yahuah, which has extolled it for ever. ⸻

verses.raw: So Tobit made an end of praising Yahuah (God).
verses.text: So Tobit made an end of praising Yahuah.

verses.raw: And he was eight and fifty years old when he lost his sight, which was restored to him after eight years: and he gave alms, and he increased in the fear of Yahuah (God), and praised him.
verses.text: And he was eight and fifty years old when he lost his sight, which was restored to him after eight years: and he gave alms, and he increased in the fear of Yahuah, and praised him.

verses.raw: And when he was very aged he called his son, and the sons of his son, and said to him, My son, take your children; for, behold, I am aged, and am ready to depart out of this life.
verses.text: And when he was very aged he called his son, and the sons of his son, and said to him, My son, take your children; for, behold, I am aged, and am ready to depart out of this life.

verses.raw: Go into Media my son, for I surely believe those things which Jonas the prophet spoke of Nineve, that it shall be overthrown; and that for a time peace shall rather be in Media; and that our brothers shall lie scattered in the earth from that good land: and Jerusalem shall be desolate, and the house of Yahuah (God) in it shall be burned, and shall be desolate for a time;
verses.text: Go into Media my son, for I surely believe those things which Jonas the prophet spoke of Nineve, that it shall be overthrown; and that for a time peace shall rather be in Media; and that our brothers shall lie scattered in the earth from that good land: and Jerusalem shall be desolate, and the house of Yahuah in it shall be burned, and shall be desolate for a time;

verses.raw: And that again Yahuah (God) will have mercy on them, and bring them again into the land, where they shall build a temple, but not like to the first, until the time of that age be fulfilled; and afterward they shall return from all places of their captivity, and build up Jerusalem gloriously, and the house of Yahuah (God) shall be built in it for ever with a glorious building, as the prophets have spoken thereof.
verses.text: And that again Yahuah will have mercy on them, and bring them again into the land, where they shall build a temple, but not like to the first, until the time of that age be fulfilled; and afterward they shall return from all places of their captivity, and build up Jerusalem gloriously, and the house of Yahuah shall be built in it for ever with a glorious building, as the prophets have spoken thereof.

verses.raw: And all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah (God) truly, and shall bury their idols.
verses.text: And all nations shall turn, and fear Yahuah truly, and shall bury their idols.

verses.raw: So shall all nations praise Yahuah (God), and his people shall confess Yahuah (God), and Yahuah (God) shall exalt his people; and all those which love Yahuah (God) in truth and justice shall rejoice, shewing mercy to our brothers.
verses.text: So shall all nations praise Yahuah, and his people shall confess Yahuah, and Yahuah shall exalt his people; and all those which love Yahuah in truth and justice shall rejoice, shewing mercy to our brothers.

verses.raw: And now, my son, depart out of Nineve, because that those things which the prophet Jonas spoke shall surely come to pass.
verses.text: And now, my son, depart out of Nineve, because that those things which the prophet Jonas spoke shall surely come to pass.

verses.raw: But keep you the law and the commandments, and shew thyself merciful and just, that it may go well with you.
verses.text: But keep you the law and the commandments, and shew thyself merciful and just, that it may go well with you.

verses.raw: And bury me decently, and your mother with me; but tarry no longer at Nineve. Remember, my son, how Aman handled Achiacharus that brought him up, how out of light he brought him into darkness, and how he rewarded him again: yet Achiacharus was saved, but the other had his reward: for he went down into darkness. Manasses gave alms, and escaped the snares of death which they had set for him: but Aman fell into the snare, and perished.
verses.text: And bury me decently, and your mother with me; but tarry no longer at Nineve. Remember, my son, how Aman handled Achiacharus that brought him up, how out of light he brought him into darkness, and how he rewarded him again: yet Achiacharus was saved, but the other had his reward: for he went down into darkness. Manasses gave alms, and escaped the snares of death which they had set for him: but Aman fell into the snare, and perished.

verses.raw: Wherefore now, my son, consider what alms doeth, and how righteousness does deliver. When he had said these things, he gave up the ghost in the bed, being an hundred and eight and fifty years old; and he buried him honourably.
verses.text: Wherefore now, my son, consider what alms doeth, and how righteousness does deliver. When he had said these things, he gave up the ghost in the bed, being an hundred and eight and fifty years old; and he buried him honourably.

verses.raw: And when Anna his mother was dead, he buried her with his father. But Tobias departed with his wife and children to Ecbatane to Raguel his father in law,
verses.text: And when Anna his mother was dead, he buried her with his father. But Tobias departed with his wife and children to Ecbatane to Raguel his father in law,

verses.raw: Where he became old with honour, and he buried his father and mother in law honourably, and he inherited their substance, and his father Tobit’s.
verses.text: Where he became old with honour, and he buried his father and mother in law honourably, and he inherited their substance, and his father Tobit’s.

verses.raw: And he died at Ecbatane in Media, being an hundred and seven and twenty years old.
verses.text: And he died at Ecbatane in Media, being an hundred and seven and twenty years old.

verses.raw: But before he died he heard of the destruction of Nineve, which was taken by Nabuchodonosor and Assuerus: and before his death he rejoiced over Nineve. ⸻
verses.text: But before he died he heard of the destruction of Nineve, which was taken by Nabuchodonosor and Assuerus: and before his death he rejoiced over Nineve. ⸻

verses.raw: In the twelfth year of the reign of Nabuchodonosor, who reigned in Nineve, the great city; in the days of Arphaxad, which reigned over the Medes in Ecbatane,
verses.text: In the twelfth year of the reign of Nabuchodonosor, who reigned in Nineve, the great city; in the days of Arphaxad, which reigned over the Medes in Ecbatane,

verses.raw: And built in Ecbatane walls round about of stones hewn three cubits broad and six cubits long, and made the height of the wall seventy cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits:
verses.text: And built in Ecbatane walls round about of stones hewn three cubits broad and six cubits long, and made the height of the wall seventy cubits, and the breadth thereof fifty cubits:

verses.raw: And set the towers thereof upon the gates of it an hundred cubits high, and the breadth thereof in the foundation threescore cubits:
verses.text: And set the towers thereof upon the gates of it an hundred cubits high, and the breadth thereof in the foundation threescore cubits:

verses.raw: And he made the gates thereof, even gates that were raised to the height of seventy cubits, and the breadth of them was forty cubits, for the going forth of his mighty armies, and for the setting in array of his footmen:
verses.text: And he made the gates thereof, even gates that were raised to the height of seventy cubits, and the breadth of them was forty cubits, for the going forth of his mighty armies, and for the setting in array of his footmen:

verses.raw: Even in those days king Nabuchodonosor made war with king Arphaxad in the great plain, which is the plain in the borders of Ragau.
verses.text: Even in those days king Nabuchodonosor made war with king Arphaxad in the great plain, which is the plain in the borders of Ragau.

verses.raw: And there came to him all they that dwelt in the hill country, and all that dwelt by Euphrates, and Tigris and Hydaspes, and the plain of Arioch the king of the Elymeans, and very many nations of the sons of Chelod, assembled themselves to the battle.
verses.text: And there came to him all they that dwelt in the hill country, and all that dwelt by Euphrates, and Tigris and Hydaspes, and the plain of Arioch the king of the Elymeans, and very many nations of the sons of Chelod, assembled themselves to the battle.

verses.raw: Then Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians sent to all that dwelt in Persia, and to all that dwelt westward, and to those that dwelt in Cilicia, and Damascus, and Libanus, and Antilibanus, and to all that dwelt upon the sea coast,
verses.text: Then Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians sent to all that dwelt in Persia, and to all that dwelt westward, and to those that dwelt in Cilicia, and Damascus, and Libanus, and Antilibanus, and to all that dwelt upon the sea coast,

verses.raw: And to those among the nations that were of Carmel, and Galaad, and the higher Galilee, and the great plain of Esdrelom,
verses.text: And to those among the nations that were of Carmel, and Galaad, and the higher Galilee, and the great plain of Esdrelom,

verses.raw: And to all that were in Samaria and the cities thereof, and beyond Jordan to Jerusalem, and Betane, and Chelus, and Kades, and the river of Egypt, and Taphnes, and Ramesse, and all the land of Gesem,
verses.text: And to all that were in Samaria and the cities thereof, and beyond Jordan to Jerusalem, and Betane, and Chelus, and Kades, and the river of Egypt, and Taphnes, and Ramesse, and all the land of Gesem,

verses.raw: Until you come beyond Tanis and Memphis, and to all the inhabitants of Egypt, until you come to the borders of Ethiopia.
verses.text: Until you come beyond Tanis and Memphis, and to all the inhabitants of Egypt, until you come to the borders of Ethiopia.

verses.raw: But all the inhabitants of the land made light of the commandment of Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians, neither went they with him to the battle; for they were not afraid of him: yes, he was before them as one man, and they sent away his ambassadors from them without effect, and with disgrace.
verses.text: But all the inhabitants of the land made light of the commandment of Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians, neither went they with him to the battle; for they were not afraid of him: yes, he was before them as one man, and they sent away his ambassadors from them without effect, and with disgrace.

verses.raw: Therefore Nabuchodonosor was very angry with all this country, and sware by his throne and kingdom, that he would surely be avenged upon all those coasts of Cilicia, and Damascus, and Syria, and that he would slay with the sword all the inhabitants of the land of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and all Judea, and all that were in Egypt, till you come to the borders of the two seas.
verses.text: Therefore Nabuchodonosor was very angry with all this country, and sware by his throne and kingdom, that he would surely be avenged upon all those coasts of Cilicia, and Damascus, and Syria, and that he would slay with the sword all the inhabitants of the land of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and all Judea, and all that were in Egypt, till you come to the borders of the two seas.

verses.raw: Then he marched in battle array with his power against king Arphaxad in the seventeenth year, and he prevailed in his battle: for he overthrew all the power of Arphaxad, and all his horsemen, and all his chariots,
verses.text: Then he marched in battle array with his power against king Arphaxad in the seventeenth year, and he prevailed in his battle: for he overthrew all the power of Arphaxad, and all his horsemen, and all his chariots,

verses.raw: And became lord of his cities, and came to Ecbatane, and took the towers, and spoiled the streets thereof, and turned the beauty thereof into shame.
verses.text: And became lord of his cities, and came to Ecbatane, and took the towers, and spoiled the streets thereof, and turned the beauty thereof into shame.

verses.raw: He took also Arphaxad in the mountains of Ragau, and struck him through with his darts, and destroyed him utterly that day.
verses.text: He took also Arphaxad in the mountains of Ragau, and struck him through with his darts, and destroyed him utterly that day.

verses.raw: So he returned afterward to Nineve, both he and all his company of sundry nations being a very great multitude of men of war, and there he took his ease, and banqueted, both he and his army, an hundred and twenty days. ⸻
verses.text: So he returned afterward to Nineve, both he and all his company of sundry nations being a very great multitude of men of war, and there he took his ease, and banqueted, both he and his army, an hundred and twenty days. ⸻

verses.raw: And in the eighteenth year, the two and twentieth day of the first month, there was talk in the house of Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians that he should, as he said, avenge himself on all the earth.
verses.text: And in the eighteenth year, the two and twentieth day of the first month, there was talk in the house of Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians that he should, as he said, avenge himself on all the earth.

verses.raw: So he called to him all his officers, and all his nobles, and communicated with them his secret counsel, and concluded the afflicting of the whole earth out of his own mouth.
verses.text: So he called to him all his officers, and all his nobles, and communicated with them his secret counsel, and concluded the afflicting of the whole earth out of his own mouth.

verses.raw: Then they decreed to destroy all flesh, that did not obey the commandment of his mouth.
verses.text: Then they decreed to destroy all flesh, that did not obey the commandment of his mouth.

verses.raw: And when he had ended his counsel, Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians called Holofernes the chief captain of his army, which was next to him, and said to him.
verses.text: And when he had ended his counsel, Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians called Holofernes the chief captain of his army, which was next to him, and said to him.

verses.raw: Thus says the great king, the lord of the whole earth, Behold, you shall go forth from my presence, and take with you men that trust in their own strength, of footmen an hundred and twenty thousand; and the number of horses with their riders twelve thousand.
verses.text: Thus says the great king, the lord of the whole earth, Behold, you shall go forth from my presence, and take with you men that trust in their own strength, of footmen an hundred and twenty thousand; and the number of horses with their riders twelve thousand.

verses.raw: And you shall go against all the west country, because they disobeyed my commandment.
verses.text: And you shall go against all the west country, because they disobeyed my commandment.

verses.raw: And you shall declare to that they prepare for me earth and water: for I will go forth in my wrath against them and will cover the whole face of the earth with the feet of my army, and I will give them for a spoil to them:
verses.text: And you shall declare to that they prepare for me earth and water: for I will go forth in my wrath against them and will cover the whole face of the earth with the feet of my army, and I will give them for a spoil to them:

verses.raw: So that their slain shall fill their valleys and brooks and the river shall be filled with their dead, till it overflow:
verses.text: So that their slain shall fill their valleys and brooks and the river shall be filled with their dead, till it overflow:

verses.raw: And I will lead them captives to the utmost parts of all the earth.
verses.text: And I will lead them captives to the utmost parts of all the earth.

verses.raw: You therefore shall go forth. and take beforehand for me all their coasts: and if they will yield themselves to you, you shall reserve them for me till the day of their punishment.
verses.text: You therefore shall go forth. and take beforehand for me all their coasts: and if they will yield themselves to you, you shall reserve them for me till the day of their punishment.

verses.raw: But concerning them that rebel, let not your eye spare them; but put them to the slaughter, and spoil them wherever you go.
verses.text: But concerning them that rebel, let not your eye spare them; but put them to the slaughter, and spoil them wherever you go.

verses.raw: For as I live, and by the power of my kingdom, whatsoever I have spoken, that will I do by my hand.
verses.text: For as I live, and by the power of my kingdom, whatsoever I have spoken, that will I do by my hand.

verses.raw: And take you heed that you transgress none of the commandments of your lord, but accomplish them fully, as I have commanded you, and defer not to do them.
verses.text: And take you heed that you transgress none of the commandments of your lord, but accomplish them fully, as I have commanded you, and defer not to do them.

verses.raw: Then Holofernes went forth from the presence of his lord, and called all the governors and captains, and the officers of the army of Assur;
verses.text: Then Holofernes went forth from the presence of his lord, and called all the governors and captains, and the officers of the army of Assur;

verses.raw: And he mustered the chosen men for the battle, as his lord had commanded him, to an hundred and twenty thousand, and twelve thousand archers on horseback;
verses.text: And he mustered the chosen men for the battle, as his lord had commanded him, to an hundred and twenty thousand, and twelve thousand archers on horseback;

verses.raw: And he ranged them, as a great army is ordered for the war.
verses.text: And he ranged them, as a great army is ordered for the war.

verses.raw: And he took camels and asses for their carriages, a very great number; and sheep and oxen and goats without number for their provision:
verses.text: And he took camels and asses for their carriages, a very great number; and sheep and oxen and goats without number for their provision:

verses.raw: And plenty of victual for every man of the army, and very much gold and silver out of the king’s house.
verses.text: And plenty of victual for every man of the army, and very much gold and silver out of the king’s house.

verses.raw: Then he went forth and all his power to go before king Nabuchodonosor in the voyage, and to cover all the face of the earth westward with their chariots, and horsemen, and their chosen footmen.
verses.text: Then he went forth and all his power to go before king Nabuchodonosor in the voyage, and to cover all the face of the earth westward with their chariots, and horsemen, and their chosen footmen.

verses.raw: A great number also sundry countries came with them like locusts, and like the sand of the earth: for the multitude was without number.
verses.text: A great number also sundry countries came with them like locusts, and like the sand of the earth: for the multitude was without number.

verses.raw: And they went forth of Nineve three days’ journey toward the plain of Bectileth, and pitched from Bectileth near the mountain which is at the left hand of the upper Cilicia.
verses.text: And they went forth of Nineve three days’ journey toward the plain of Bectileth, and pitched from Bectileth near the mountain which is at the left hand of the upper Cilicia.

verses.raw: Then he took all his army, his footmen, and horsemen and chariots, and went from thence into the hill country;
verses.text: Then he took all his army, his footmen, and horsemen and chariots, and went from thence into the hill country;

verses.raw: And destroyed Phud and Lud, and spoiled all the children of Rasses, and the children of Yashar'el (Israel), which were toward the wilderness at the south of the land of the Chellians.
verses.text: And destroyed Phud and Lud, and spoiled all the children of Rasses, and the children of Yashar'el, which were toward the wilderness at the south of the land of the Chellians.

verses.raw: Then he went over Euphrates, and went through Mesopotamia, and destroyed all the high cities that were upon the river Arbonai, till you come to the sea.
verses.text: Then he went over Euphrates, and went through Mesopotamia, and destroyed all the high cities that were upon the river Arbonai, till you come to the sea.

verses.raw: And he took the borders of Cilicia, and killed all that resisted him, and came to the borders of Japheth, which were toward the south, over against Arabia.
verses.text: And he took the borders of Cilicia, and killed all that resisted him, and came to the borders of Japheth, which were toward the south, over against Arabia.

verses.raw: He compassed also all the children of Madian, and burned up their tabernacles, and spoiled their sheepcotes.
verses.text: He compassed also all the children of Madian, and burned up their tabernacles, and spoiled their sheepcotes.

verses.raw: Then he went down into the plain of Damascus in the time of wheat harvest, and burnt up all their fields, and destroyed their flocks and herds, also he spoiled their cities, and utterly wasted their countries, and struck all their young men with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: Then he went down into the plain of Damascus in the time of wheat harvest, and burnt up all their fields, and destroyed their flocks and herds, also he spoiled their cities, and utterly wasted their countries, and struck all their young men with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: Therefore the fear and dread of him fell upon all the inhabitants of the sea coasts, which were in Sidon and Tyrus, and them that dwelt in Sur and Ocina, and all that dwelt in Jemnaan; and they that dwelt in Azotus and Ascalon feared him greatly. ⸻
verses.text: Therefore the fear and dread of him fell upon all the inhabitants of the sea coasts, which were in Sidon and Tyrus, and them that dwelt in Sur and Ocina, and all that dwelt in Jemnaan; and they that dwelt in Azotus and Ascalon feared him greatly. ⸻

verses.raw: So they sent ambassadors to him to treat of peace, saying,
verses.text: So they sent ambassadors to him to treat of peace, saying,

verses.raw: Behold, we the servants of Nabuchodonosor the great king lie before you; use us as shall be good in your sight.
verses.text: Behold, we the servants of Nabuchodonosor the great king lie before you; use us as shall be good in your sight.

verses.raw: Behold, our houses, and all our places, and all our fields of wheat, and flocks, and herds, and all the lodges of our tents lie before your face; use them as it pleaseth you.
verses.text: Behold, our houses, and all our places, and all our fields of wheat, and flocks, and herds, and all the lodges of our tents lie before your face; use them as it pleaseth you.

verses.raw: Behold, even our cities and the inhabitants thereof are your servants; come and deal with them as seemeth good to you.
verses.text: Behold, even our cities and the inhabitants thereof are your servants; come and deal with them as seemeth good to you.

verses.raw: So the men came to Holofernes, and declared to him after this manner.
verses.text: So the men came to Holofernes, and declared to him after this manner.

verses.raw: Then came he down toward the sea coast, both he and his army, and set garrisons in the high cities, and took out of them chosen men for aid.
verses.text: Then came he down toward the sea coast, both he and his army, and set garrisons in the high cities, and took out of them chosen men for aid.

verses.raw: So they and all the country round about received them with garlands, with dances, and with timbrels.
verses.text: So they and all the country round about received them with garlands, with dances, and with timbrels.

verses.raw: Yet he did cast down their frontiers, and cut down their groves: for he had decreed to destroy all the gods of the land, that all nations should worship Nabuchodonosor only, and that all tongues and tribes should call upon him as god.
verses.text: Yet he did cast down their frontiers, and cut down their groves: for he had decreed to destroy all the gods of the land, that all nations should worship Nabuchodonosor only, and that all tongues and tribes should call upon him as god.

verses.raw: Also he came over against Esdraelon near to Judea, over against the great strait of Judea.
verses.text: Also he came over against Esdraelon near to Judea, over against the great strait of Judea.

verses.raw: And he pitched between Geba and Scythopolis, and there he tarried a whole month, that he might gather together all the carriages of his army. ⸻
verses.text: And he pitched between Geba and Scythopolis, and there he tarried a whole month, that he might gather together all the carriages of his army. ⸻

verses.raw: Now the children of Yashar'el (Israel), that dwelt in Judea, heard all that Holofernes the chief captain of Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians had done to the nations, and after what manner he had spoiled all their temples, and brought them to nought.
verses.text: Now the children of Yashar'el, that dwelt in Judea, heard all that Holofernes the chief captain of Nabuchodonosor king of the Assyrians had done to the nations, and after what manner he had spoiled all their temples, and brought them to nought.

verses.raw: Therefore they were exceedingly afraid of him, and were troubled for Jerusalem, and for the temple of Yahuah (God), their Elohim (God):
verses.text: Therefore they were exceedingly afraid of him, and were troubled for Jerusalem, and for the temple of Yahuah, their Elohim:

verses.raw: For they were newly returned from the captivity, and all the people of Judea were lately gathered together: and the vessels, and the altar, and the house, were sanctified after the profanation.
verses.text: For they were newly returned from the captivity, and all the people of Judea were lately gathered together: and the vessels, and the altar, and the house, were sanctified after the profanation.

verses.raw: Therefore they sent into all the coasts of Samaria, and the villages and to Bethoron, and Belmen, and Jericho, and to Choba, and Esora, and to the valley of Salem:
verses.text: Therefore they sent into all the coasts of Samaria, and the villages and to Bethoron, and Belmen, and Jericho, and to Choba, and Esora, and to the valley of Salem:

verses.raw: And possessed themselves beforehand of all the tops of the high mountains, and fortified the villages that were in them, and laid up victuals for the provision of war: for their fields were of late reaped.
verses.text: And possessed themselves beforehand of all the tops of the high mountains, and fortified the villages that were in them, and laid up victuals for the provision of war: for their fields were of late reaped.

verses.raw: Also Joacim the high priest, which was in those days in Jerusalem, wrote to them that dwelt in Bethulia, and Betomestham, which is over against Esdraelon toward the open country, near to Dothaim,
verses.text: Also Joacim the high priest, which was in those days in Jerusalem, wrote to them that dwelt in Bethulia, and Betomestham, which is over against Esdraelon toward the open country, near to Dothaim,

verses.raw: Charging them to keep the passages of the hill country: for by them there was an entrance into Judea, and it was easy to stop them that would come up, because the passage was straight, for two men at the most.
verses.text: Charging them to keep the passages of the hill country: for by them there was an entrance into Judea, and it was easy to stop them that would come up, because the passage was straight, for two men at the most.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did as Joacim the high priest had commanded them, with the ancients of all the people of Yashar'el (Israel), which dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el did as Joacim the high priest had commanded them, with the ancients of all the people of Yashar'el, which dwelt at Jerusalem.

verses.raw: Then every man of Yashar'el (Israel) cried to Yahuah (God) with great fervency, and with great vehemency did they humble their souls:
verses.text: Then every man of Yashar'el cried to Yahuah with great fervency, and with great vehemency did they humble their souls:

verses.raw: Both they, and their wives and their children, and their cattle, and every stranger and hireling, and their servants bought with money, put sackcloth upon their loins.
verses.text: Both they, and their wives and their children, and their cattle, and every stranger and hireling, and their servants bought with money, put sackcloth upon their loins.

verses.raw: Thus every man and women, and the little children, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, fell before the temple, and cast ashes upon their heads, and spread out their sackcloth before the face of Yahuah (God): also they put sackcloth about the altar,
verses.text: Thus every man and women, and the little children, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, fell before the temple, and cast ashes upon their heads, and spread out their sackcloth before the face of Yahuah: also they put sackcloth about the altar,

verses.raw: And cried to Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) all with one consent earnestly, that he would not give their children for a prey, and their wives for a spoil, and the cities of their inheritance to destruction, and the sanctuary to profanation and reproach, and for the nations to rejoice at.
verses.text: And cried to Yahuah of Yashar'el all with one consent earnestly, that he would not give their children for a prey, and their wives for a spoil, and the cities of their inheritance to destruction, and the sanctuary to profanation and reproach, and for the nations to rejoice at.

verses.raw: So Yahuah (God) heard their prayers, and looked upon their afflictions: for the people fasted many days in all Judea and Jerusalem before the sanctuary of Yahuah (God) Almighty.
verses.text: So Yahuah heard their prayers, and looked upon their afflictions: for the people fasted many days in all Judea and Jerusalem before the sanctuary of Yahuah Almighty.

verses.raw: And Joacim the high priest, and all the priests that stood before Yahuah (God), and they which ministered to Yahuah (God), had their loins girt with sackcloth, and offered the daily burnt offerings, with the vows and free gifts of the people,
verses.text: And Joacim the high priest, and all the priests that stood before Yahuah, and they which ministered to Yahuah, had their loins girt with sackcloth, and offered the daily burnt offerings, with the vows and free gifts of the people,

verses.raw: And had ashes on their mitres, and cried to Yahuah (God) with all their power, that he would look upon all the house of Yashar'el (Israel) graciously. ⸻
verses.text: And had ashes on their mitres, and cried to Yahuah with all their power, that he would look upon all the house of Yashar'el graciously. ⸻

verses.raw: Then was it declared to Holofernes, the chief captain of the army of Assur, that the children of Yashar'el (Israel) had prepared for war, and had shut up the passages of the hill country, and had fortified all the tops of the high hills and had laid impediments in the champaign countries:
verses.text: Then was it declared to Holofernes, the chief captain of the army of Assur, that the children of Yashar'el had prepared for war, and had shut up the passages of the hill country, and had fortified all the tops of the high hills and had laid impediments in the champaign countries:

verses.raw: With which he was very angry, and called all the princes of Moab, and the captains of Ammon, and all the governors of the sea coast,
verses.text: With which he was very angry, and called all the princes of Moab, and the captains of Ammon, and all the governors of the sea coast,

verses.raw: And he said to them, Tell me now, you sons of Chanaan, who this people is, that dwells in the hill country, and what are the cities that they inhabit, and what is the multitude of their army, and in which is their power and strength, and what king is set over them, or captain of their army;
verses.text: And he said to them, Tell me now, you sons of Chanaan, who this people is, that dwells in the hill country, and what are the cities that they inhabit, and what is the multitude of their army, and in which is their power and strength, and what king is set over them, or captain of their army;

verses.raw: And why have they determined not to come and meet me, more than all the inhabitants of the west.
verses.text: And why have they determined not to come and meet me, more than all the inhabitants of the west.

verses.raw: Then said Achior, the captain of all the sons of Ammon, Let my lord now hear a word from the mouth of your servant, and I will declare to you the truth concerning this people, which dwells near you, and inhabiteth the hill countries: and there shall no lie come out of the mouth of your servant.
verses.text: Then said Achior, the captain of all the sons of Ammon, Let my lord now hear a word from the mouth of your servant, and I will declare to you the truth concerning this people, which dwells near you, and inhabiteth the hill countries: and there shall no lie come out of the mouth of your servant.

verses.raw: This people are descended of the Chaldeans:
verses.text: This people are descended of the Chaldeans:

verses.raw: And they sojourned heretofore in Mesopotamia, because they would not follow the gods of their fathers, which were in the land of Chaldea.
verses.text: And they sojourned heretofore in Mesopotamia, because they would not follow the gods of their fathers, which were in the land of Chaldea.

verses.raw: For they left the way of their ancestors, and worshipped Yahuah (God) of heaven, Yahuah (God) whom they knew: so they cast them out from the face of their gods, and they fled into Mesopotamia, and sojourned there many days.
verses.text: For they left the way of their ancestors, and worshipped Yahuah of heaven, Yahuah whom they knew: so they cast them out from the face of their gods, and they fled into Mesopotamia, and sojourned there many days.

verses.raw: Then their Elohim (God) commanded them to depart from the place where they sojourned, and to go into the land of Chanaan: where they dwelt, and were increased with gold and silver, and with very much cattle.
verses.text: Then their Elohim commanded them to depart from the place where they sojourned, and to go into the land of Chanaan: where they dwelt, and were increased with gold and silver, and with very much cattle.

verses.raw: But when a famine covered all the land of Chanaan, they went down into Egypt, and sojourned there, while they were nourished, and became there a great multitude, so that one could not number their nation.
verses.text: But when a famine covered all the land of Chanaan, they went down into Egypt, and sojourned there, while they were nourished, and became there a great multitude, so that one could not number their nation.

verses.raw: Therefore the king of Egypt rose up against them, and dealt subtilly with them, and brought them low with labouring in brick, and made them slaves.
verses.text: Therefore the king of Egypt rose up against them, and dealt subtilly with them, and brought them low with labouring in brick, and made them slaves.

verses.raw: Then they cried to their Elohim (God), and he struck all the land of Egypt with incurable plagues: so the Egyptians cast them out of their sight.
verses.text: Then they cried to their Elohim, and he struck all the land of Egypt with incurable plagues: so the Egyptians cast them out of their sight.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) dried the Red sea before them,
verses.text: And Yahuah dried the Red sea before them,

verses.raw: And brought them to mount Sina, and Cades-Barne, and cast forth all that dwelt in the wilderness.
verses.text: And brought them to mount Sina, and Cades-Barne, and cast forth all that dwelt in the wilderness.

verses.raw: So they dwelt in the land of the Amorites, and they destroyed by their strength all them of Esebon, and passing over Jordan they possessed all the hill country.
verses.text: So they dwelt in the land of the Amorites, and they destroyed by their strength all them of Esebon, and passing over Jordan they possessed all the hill country.

verses.raw: And they cast forth before them the Chanaanite, the Pherezite, the Jebusite, and the Sychemite, and all the Gergesites, and they dwelt in that country many days.
verses.text: And they cast forth before them the Chanaanite, the Pherezite, the Jebusite, and the Sychemite, and all the Gergesites, and they dwelt in that country many days.

verses.raw: And while they sinned not before their Elohim (God), they prospered, because Yahuah (God) that hates iniquity was with them.
verses.text: And while they sinned not before their Elohim, they prospered, because Yahuah that hates iniquity was with them.

verses.raw: But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore, and were led captives into a land that was not their’s, and the temple of their Elohim (God) was cast to the ground, and their cities were taken by the enemies.
verses.text: But when they departed from the way which he appointed them, they were destroyed in many battles very sore, and were led captives into a land that was not their’s, and the temple of their Elohim was cast to the ground, and their cities were taken by the enemies.

verses.raw: But now are they returned to their Elohim (God), and are come up from the places where they were scattered, and have possessed Jerusalem, where their sanctuary is, and are seated in the hill country; for it was desolate.
verses.text: But now are they returned to their Elohim, and are come up from the places where they were scattered, and have possessed Jerusalem, where their sanctuary is, and are seated in the hill country; for it was desolate.

verses.raw: Now therefore, my lord and governor, if there be any error against this people, and they sin against their Elohim (God), let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them.
verses.text: Now therefore, my lord and governor, if there be any error against this people, and they sin against their Elohim, let us consider that this shall be their ruin, and let us go up, and we shall overcome them.

verses.raw: But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Elohim (God) defend them, and their Elohim (God) be for them, and we become a reproach before all the world.
verses.text: But if there be no iniquity in their nation, let my lord now pass by, lest their Elohim defend them, and their Elohim be for them, and we become a reproach before all the world.

verses.raw: And when Achior had finished these sayings, all the people standing round about the tent murmured, and the chief men of Holofernes, and all that dwelt by the sea side, and in Moab, spoke that he should kill him.
verses.text: And when Achior had finished these sayings, all the people standing round about the tent murmured, and the chief men of Holofernes, and all that dwelt by the sea side, and in Moab, spoke that he should kill him.

verses.raw: For, say they, we will not be afraid of the face of the children of Yashar'el (Israel): for, lo, it is a people that have no strength nor power for a strong battle
verses.text: For, say they, we will not be afraid of the face of the children of Yashar'el: for, lo, it is a people that have no strength nor power for a strong battle

verses.raw: Now therefore, lord Holofernes, we will go up, and they shall be a prey to be devoured of all your army. ⸻
verses.text: Now therefore, lord Holofernes, we will go up, and they shall be a prey to be devoured of all your army. ⸻

verses.raw: And when the tumult of men that were about the council was ceased, Holofernes the chief captain of the army of Assur said to Achior and all the Moabites before all the company of other nations,
verses.text: And when the tumult of men that were about the council was ceased, Holofernes the chief captain of the army of Assur said to Achior and all the Moabites before all the company of other nations,

verses.raw: And who are you, Achior, and the hirelings of Ephraim, that you have prophesied against us as to day, and have said, that we should not make war with the people of Yashar'el (Israel), because their Elohim (God) will defend them? and who is Yahuah (God) but Nabuchodonosor?
verses.text: And who are you, Achior, and the hirelings of Ephraim, that you have prophesied against us as to day, and have said, that we should not make war with the people of Yashar'el, because their Elohim will defend them? and who is Yahuah but Nabuchodonosor?

verses.raw: He will send his power, and will destroy them from the face of the earth, and their Elohim (God) shall not deliver them: but we his servants will destroy them as one man; for they are not able to sustain the power of our horses.
verses.text: He will send his power, and will destroy them from the face of the earth, and their Elohim shall not deliver them: but we his servants will destroy them as one man; for they are not able to sustain the power of our horses.

verses.raw: For with them we will tread them under foot, and their mountains shall be drunken with their blood, and their fields shall be filled with their dead bodies, and their footsteps shall not be able to stand before us, for they shall utterly perish, says king Nabuchodonosor, lord of all the earth: for he said, None of my words shall be in vain.
verses.text: For with them we will tread them under foot, and their mountains shall be drunken with their blood, and their fields shall be filled with their dead bodies, and their footsteps shall not be able to stand before us, for they shall utterly perish, says king Nabuchodonosor, lord of all the earth: for he said, None of my words shall be in vain.

verses.raw: And you, Achior, an hireling of Ammon, which have spoken these words in the day of your iniquity, shall see my face no more from this day, until I take vengeance of this nation that came out of Egypt.
verses.text: And you, Achior, an hireling of Ammon, which have spoken these words in the day of your iniquity, shall see my face no more from this day, until I take vengeance of this nation that came out of Egypt.

verses.raw: And then shall the sword of my army, and the multitude of them that serve me, pass through your sides, and you shall fall among their slain, when I return.
verses.text: And then shall the sword of my army, and the multitude of them that serve me, pass through your sides, and you shall fall among their slain, when I return.

verses.raw: Now therefore my servants shall bring you back into the hill country, and shall set you in one of the cities of the passages:
verses.text: Now therefore my servants shall bring you back into the hill country, and shall set you in one of the cities of the passages:

verses.raw: And you shall not perish, till you be destroyed with them.
verses.text: And you shall not perish, till you be destroyed with them.

verses.raw: And if you persuade thyself in your mind that they shall be taken, let not your countenance fall: I have spoken it, and none of my words shall be in vain.
verses.text: And if you persuade thyself in your mind that they shall be taken, let not your countenance fall: I have spoken it, and none of my words shall be in vain.

verses.raw: Then Holofernes commanded his servants, that waited in his tent, to take Achior, and bring him to Bethulia, and deliver him into the hands of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then Holofernes commanded his servants, that waited in his tent, to take Achior, and bring him to Bethulia, and deliver him into the hands of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So his servants took him, and brought him out of the camp into the plain, and they went from the midst of the plain into the hill country, and came to the fountains that were under Bethulia.
verses.text: So his servants took him, and brought him out of the camp into the plain, and they went from the midst of the plain into the hill country, and came to the fountains that were under Bethulia.

verses.raw: And when the men of the city saw them, they took up their weapons, and went out of the city to the top of the hill: and every man that used a sling kept them from coming up by casting of stones against them.
verses.text: And when the men of the city saw them, they took up their weapons, and went out of the city to the top of the hill: and every man that used a sling kept them from coming up by casting of stones against them.

verses.raw: Nevertheless having gotten privily under the hill, they bound Achior, and cast him down, and left him at the foot of the hill, and returned to their lord.
verses.text: Nevertheless having gotten privily under the hill, they bound Achior, and cast him down, and left him at the foot of the hill, and returned to their lord.

verses.raw: But the Israelites descended from their city, and came to him, and loosed him, and brought him to Bethulia, and presented him to the governors of the city:
verses.text: But the Israelites descended from their city, and came to him, and loosed him, and brought him to Bethulia, and presented him to the governors of the city:

verses.raw: Which were in those days Ozias the son of Micha, of the tribe of Simeon, and Chabris the son of Gothoniel, and Charmis the son of Melchiel.
verses.text: Which were in those days Ozias the son of Micha, of the tribe of Simeon, and Chabris the son of Gothoniel, and Charmis the son of Melchiel.

verses.raw: And they called together all the ancients of the city, and all their youth ran together, and their women, to the assembly, and they set Achior in the midst of all their people. Then Ozias asked him of that which was done.
verses.text: And they called together all the ancients of the city, and all their youth ran together, and their women, to the assembly, and they set Achior in the midst of all their people. Then Ozias asked him of that which was done.

verses.raw: And he answered and declared to them the words of the council of Holofernes, and all the words that he had spoken in the midst of the princes of Assur, and whatsoever Holofernes had spoken proudly against the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And he answered and declared to them the words of the council of Holofernes, and all the words that he had spoken in the midst of the princes of Assur, and whatsoever Holofernes had spoken proudly against the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then the people fell down and worshipped Yahuah (God), and cried to Yahuah (God). saying,
verses.text: Then the people fell down and worshipped Yahuah, and cried to Yahuah. saying,

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God) of heaven, behold their pride, and pity the low estate of our nation, and look upon the face of those that are sanctified to you this day.
verses.text: O Yahuah of heaven, behold their pride, and pity the low estate of our nation, and look upon the face of those that are sanctified to you this day.

verses.raw: Then they comforted Achior, and praised him greatly.
verses.text: Then they comforted Achior, and praised him greatly.

verses.raw: And Ozias took him out of the assembly to his house, and made a feast to the elders; and they called on Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) all that night for help. ⸻
verses.text: And Ozias took him out of the assembly to his house, and made a feast to the elders; and they called on Yahuah of Yashar'el all that night for help. ⸻

verses.raw: The next day Holofernes commanded all his army, and all his people which were come to take his part, that they should remove their camp against Bethulia, to take aforehand the ascents of the hill country, and to make war against the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The next day Holofernes commanded all his army, and all his people which were come to take his part, that they should remove their camp against Bethulia, to take aforehand the ascents of the hill country, and to make war against the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then their strong men removed their camps in that day, and the army of the men of war was an hundred and seventy thousand footmen, and twelve thousand horsemen, beside the baggage, and other men that were afoot among them, a very great multitude.
verses.text: Then their strong men removed their camps in that day, and the army of the men of war was an hundred and seventy thousand footmen, and twelve thousand horsemen, beside the baggage, and other men that were afoot among them, a very great multitude.

verses.raw: And they camped in the valley near to Bethulia, by the fountain, and they spread themselves in breadth over Dothaim even to Belmaim, and in length from Bethulia to Cynamon, which is over against Esdraelon.
verses.text: And they camped in the valley near to Bethulia, by the fountain, and they spread themselves in breadth over Dothaim even to Belmaim, and in length from Bethulia to Cynamon, which is over against Esdraelon.

verses.raw: Now the children of Yashar'el (Israel), when they saw the multitude of them, were greatly troubled, and said every one to his neighbour, Now will these men lick up the face of the earth; for neither the high mountains, nor the valleys, nor the hills, are able to bear their weight.
verses.text: Now the children of Yashar'el, when they saw the multitude of them, were greatly troubled, and said every one to his neighbour, Now will these men lick up the face of the earth; for neither the high mountains, nor the valleys, nor the hills, are able to bear their weight.

verses.raw: Then every man took up his weapons of war, and when they had kindled fires upon their towers, they remained and watched all that night.
verses.text: Then every man took up his weapons of war, and when they had kindled fires upon their towers, they remained and watched all that night.

verses.raw: But in the second day Holofernes brought forth all his horsemen in the sight of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) which were in Bethulia,
verses.text: But in the second day Holofernes brought forth all his horsemen in the sight of the children of Yashar'el which were in Bethulia,

verses.raw: And viewed the passages up to the city, and came to the fountains of their waters, and took them, and set garrisons of men of war over them, and he himself removed toward his people.
verses.text: And viewed the passages up to the city, and came to the fountains of their waters, and took them, and set garrisons of men of war over them, and he himself removed toward his people.

verses.raw: Then came to him all the chief of the children of Esau, and all the governors of the people of Moab, and the captains of the sea coast, and said,
verses.text: Then came to him all the chief of the children of Esau, and all the governors of the people of Moab, and the captains of the sea coast, and said,

verses.raw: Let our lord now hear a word, that there be not an overthrow in your army.
verses.text: Let our lord now hear a word, that there be not an overthrow in your army.

verses.raw: For this people of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) do not trust in their spears, but in the height of the mountains in which they dwell, because it is not easy to come up to the tops of their mountains.
verses.text: For this people of the children of Yashar'el do not trust in their spears, but in the height of the mountains in which they dwell, because it is not easy to come up to the tops of their mountains.

verses.raw: Now therefore, my lord, fight not against them in battle array, and there shall not so much as one man of your people perish.
verses.text: Now therefore, my lord, fight not against them in battle array, and there shall not so much as one man of your people perish.

verses.raw: Remain in your camp, and keep all the men of your army, and let your servants get into their hands the fountain of water, which issues forth of the foot of the mountain:
verses.text: Remain in your camp, and keep all the men of your army, and let your servants get into their hands the fountain of water, which issues forth of the foot of the mountain:

verses.raw: For all the inhabitants of Bethulia have their water thence; so shall thirst kill them, and they shall give up their city, and we and our people shall go up to the tops of the mountains that are near, and will camp upon them, to watch that none go out of the city.
verses.text: For all the inhabitants of Bethulia have their water thence; so shall thirst kill them, and they shall give up their city, and we and our people shall go up to the tops of the mountains that are near, and will camp upon them, to watch that none go out of the city.

verses.raw: So they and their wives and their children shall be consumed with fire, and before the sword come against them, they shall be overthrown in the streets where they dwell.
verses.text: So they and their wives and their children shall be consumed with fire, and before the sword come against them, they shall be overthrown in the streets where they dwell.

verses.raw: Thus shall you render them an evil reward; because they rebelled, and met not your person peaceably.
verses.text: Thus shall you render them an evil reward; because they rebelled, and met not your person peaceably.

verses.raw: And these words pleased Holofernes and all his servants, and he appointed to do as they had spoken.
verses.text: And these words pleased Holofernes and all his servants, and he appointed to do as they had spoken.

verses.raw: So the camp of the children of Ammon departed, and with them five thousand of the Assyrians, and they pitched in the valley, and took the waters, and the fountains of the waters of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So the camp of the children of Ammon departed, and with them five thousand of the Assyrians, and they pitched in the valley, and took the waters, and the fountains of the waters of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then the children of Esau went up with the children of Ammon, and camped in the hill country over against Dothaim: and they sent some of them toward the south, and toward the east over against Ekrebel, which is near to Chusi, that is upon the brook Mochmur; and the rest of the army of the Assyrians camped in the plain, and covered the face of the whole land; and their tents and carriages were pitched to a very great multitude.
verses.text: Then the children of Esau went up with the children of Ammon, and camped in the hill country over against Dothaim: and they sent some of them toward the south, and toward the east over against Ekrebel, which is near to Chusi, that is upon the brook Mochmur; and the rest of the army of the Assyrians camped in the plain, and covered the face of the whole land; and their tents and carriages were pitched to a very great multitude.

verses.raw: Then the children of Yashar'el (Israel) cried to Yahuah (God), their Elohim (God), because their heart failed, for all their enemies had compassed them round about, and there was no way to escape out from among them.
verses.text: Then the children of Yashar'el cried to Yahuah, their Elohim, because their heart failed, for all their enemies had compassed them round about, and there was no way to escape out from among them.

verses.raw: Thus all the company of Assur remained about them, both their footmen, chariots, and horsemen, four and thirty days, so that all their vessels of water failed all the inhibitants of Bethulia.
verses.text: Thus all the company of Assur remained about them, both their footmen, chariots, and horsemen, four and thirty days, so that all their vessels of water failed all the inhibitants of Bethulia.

verses.raw: And the cisterns were emptied, and they had not water to drink their fill for one day; for they gave them drink by measure.
verses.text: And the cisterns were emptied, and they had not water to drink their fill for one day; for they gave them drink by measure.

verses.raw: Therefore their young children were out of heart, and their women and young men fainted for thirst, and fell down in the streets of the city, and by the passages of the gates, and there was no longer any strength in them.
verses.text: Therefore their young children were out of heart, and their women and young men fainted for thirst, and fell down in the streets of the city, and by the passages of the gates, and there was no longer any strength in them.

verses.raw: Then all the people assembled to Ozias, and to the chief of the city, both young men, and women, and children, and cried with a loud voice, and said before all the elders,
verses.text: Then all the people assembled to Ozias, and to the chief of the city, both young men, and women, and children, and cried with a loud voice, and said before all the elders,

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) be judge between us and you: for you have done us great injury, in that you have not required peace of the children of Assur.
verses.text: Yahuah be judge between us and you: for you have done us great injury, in that you have not required peace of the children of Assur.

verses.raw: For now we have no helper: but Yahuah (God) has sold us into their hands, that we should be thrown down before them with thirst and great destruction.
verses.text: For now we have no helper: but Yahuah has sold us into their hands, that we should be thrown down before them with thirst and great destruction.

verses.raw: Now therefore call them to you, and deliver the whole city for a spoil to the people of Holofernes, and to all his army.
verses.text: Now therefore call them to you, and deliver the whole city for a spoil to the people of Holofernes, and to all his army.

verses.raw: For it is better for us to be made a spoil to them, than to die for thirst: for we will be his servants, that our souls may live, and not see the death of our infants before our eyes, nor our wives nor our children to die.
verses.text: For it is better for us to be made a spoil to them, than to die for thirst: for we will be his servants, that our souls may live, and not see the death of our infants before our eyes, nor our wives nor our children to die.

verses.raw: We take to witness against you the heaven and the earth, and our Elohim (God) and Yahuah (God) of our fathers, which punishes us according to our sins and the sins of our fathers, that he do not according as we have said this day.
verses.text: We take to witness against you the heaven and the earth, and our Elohim and Yahuah of our fathers, which punishes us according to our sins and the sins of our fathers, that he do not according as we have said this day.

verses.raw: Then there was great weeping with one consent in the midst of the assembly; and they cried to Yahuah (God) with a loud voice.
verses.text: Then there was great weeping with one consent in the midst of the assembly; and they cried to Yahuah with a loud voice.

verses.raw: Then said Ozias to them, Brothers, be of good courage, let us yet endure five days, in the which space Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) may turn his mercy toward us; for he will not forsake us utterly.
verses.text: Then said Ozias to them, Brothers, be of good courage, let us yet endure five days, in the which space Yahuah, our Elohim may turn his mercy toward us; for he will not forsake us utterly.

verses.raw: And if these days pass, and there come no help to us, I will do according to your word.
verses.text: And if these days pass, and there come no help to us, I will do according to your word.

verses.raw: And he dispersed the people, every one to their own charge; and they went to the walls and towers of their city, and sent the women and children into their houses: and they were very low brought in the city. ⸻
verses.text: And he dispersed the people, every one to their own charge; and they went to the walls and towers of their city, and sent the women and children into their houses: and they were very low brought in the city. ⸻

verses.raw: Now at that time Judith heard thereof, which was the daughter of Merari, the son of Ox, the son of Joseph, the son of Ozel, the son of Elcia, the son of Ananias, the son of Gedeon, the son of Raphaim, the son of Acitho, the son of Eliu, the son of Eliab, the son of Nathanael, the son of Samael, the son of Salasadal, the son of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Now at that time Judith heard thereof, which was the daughter of Merari, the son of Ox, the son of Joseph, the son of Ozel, the son of Elcia, the son of Ananias, the son of Gedeon, the son of Raphaim, the son of Acitho, the son of Eliu, the son of Eliab, the son of Nathanael, the son of Samael, the son of Salasadal, the son of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And Manasses was her husband, of her tribe and kindred, who died in the barley harvest.
verses.text: And Manasses was her husband, of her tribe and kindred, who died in the barley harvest.

verses.raw: For as he stood overseeing them that bound sheaves in the field, the heat came upon his head, and he fell on his bed, and died in the city of Bethulia: and they buried him with his fathers in the field between Dothaim and Balamo.
verses.text: For as he stood overseeing them that bound sheaves in the field, the heat came upon his head, and he fell on his bed, and died in the city of Bethulia: and they buried him with his fathers in the field between Dothaim and Balamo.

verses.raw: So Judith was a widow in her house three years and four months.
verses.text: So Judith was a widow in her house three years and four months.

verses.raw: And she made her a tent upon the top of her house, and put on sackcloth upon her loins and ware her widow’s apparel.
verses.text: And she made her a tent upon the top of her house, and put on sackcloth upon her loins and ware her widow’s apparel.

verses.raw: And she fasted all the days of her widowhood, save the eves of the sabbaths, and the sabbaths, and the eves of the new moons, and the new moons and the feasts and solemn days of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And she fasted all the days of her widowhood, save the eves of the sabbaths, and the sabbaths, and the eves of the new moons, and the new moons and the feasts and solemn days of the house of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: She was also of a goodly countenance, and very beautiful to behold: and her husband Manasses had left her gold, and silver, and menservants and maidservants, and cattle, and lands; and she remained upon them.
verses.text: She was also of a goodly countenance, and very beautiful to behold: and her husband Manasses had left her gold, and silver, and menservants and maidservants, and cattle, and lands; and she remained upon them.

verses.raw: And there was none that gave her an ill word; as she feared Yahuah (God) greatly.
verses.text: And there was none that gave her an ill word; as she feared Yahuah greatly.

verses.raw: Now when she heard the evil words of the people against the governor, that they fainted for lack of water; for Judith had heard all the words that Ozias had spoken to them, and that he had sworn to deliver the city to the Assyrians after five days;
verses.text: Now when she heard the evil words of the people against the governor, that they fainted for lack of water; for Judith had heard all the words that Ozias had spoken to them, and that he had sworn to deliver the city to the Assyrians after five days;

verses.raw: Then she sent her waitingwoman, that had the government of all things that she had, to call Ozias and Chabris and Charmis, the ancients of the city.
verses.text: Then she sent her waitingwoman, that had the government of all things that she had, to call Ozias and Chabris and Charmis, the ancients of the city.

verses.raw: And they came to her, and she said to them, Hear me now, O you governors of the inhabitants of Bethulia: for your words that you have spoken before the people this day are not right, touching this oath which you made and pronounced between Yahuah (God) and you, and have promised to deliver the city to our enemies, unless within these days Yahuah (God) turn to help you.
verses.text: And they came to her, and she said to them, Hear me now, O you governors of the inhabitants of Bethulia: for your words that you have spoken before the people this day are not right, touching this oath which you made and pronounced between Yahuah and you, and have promised to deliver the city to our enemies, unless within these days Yahuah turn to help you.

verses.raw: And now who are you that have tempted Yahuah (God) this day, and stand instead of Yahuah (God) among the children of men?
verses.text: And now who are you that have tempted Yahuah this day, and stand instead of Yahuah among the children of men?

verses.raw: And now try Yahuah (God) Almighty, but you shall never know any thing.
verses.text: And now try Yahuah Almighty, but you shall never know any thing.

verses.raw: For you cannot find the depth of the heart of man, neither can you perceive the things that he thinketh: then how can you search out Yahuah (God), that has made all these things, and know his mind, or comprehend his purpose? No, my brothers, provoke not Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) to anger.
verses.text: For you cannot find the depth of the heart of man, neither can you perceive the things that he thinketh: then how can you search out Yahuah, that has made all these things, and know his mind, or comprehend his purpose? No, my brothers, provoke not Yahuah, our Elohim to anger.

verses.raw: For if he will not help us within these five days, he has power to defend us when he will, even every day, or to destroy us before our enemies.
verses.text: For if he will not help us within these five days, he has power to defend us when he will, even every day, or to destroy us before our enemies.

verses.raw: Do not bind the counsels of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God): for Yahuah (God) is not as man, that he may be threatened; neither is he as the son of Adam, that he should be wavering.
verses.text: Do not bind the counsels of Yahuah, our Elohim: for Yahuah is not as man, that he may be threatened; neither is he as the son of Adam, that he should be wavering.

verses.raw: Therefore let us wait for salvation of him, and call upon him to help us, and he will hear our voice, if it please him.
verses.text: Therefore let us wait for salvation of him, and call upon him to help us, and he will hear our voice, if it please him.

verses.raw: For there arose none in our age, neither is there any now in these days neither tribe, nor family, nor people, nor city among us, which worship gods made with hands, as has been aforetime.
verses.text: For there arose none in our age, neither is there any now in these days neither tribe, nor family, nor people, nor city among us, which worship gods made with hands, as has been aforetime.

verses.raw: For the which cause our fathers were given to the sword, and for a spoil, and had a great fall before our enemies.
verses.text: For the which cause our fathers were given to the sword, and for a spoil, and had a great fall before our enemies.

verses.raw: But we know none other god, therefore we trust that he will not despise us, nor any of our nation.
verses.text: But we know none other god, therefore we trust that he will not despise us, nor any of our nation.

verses.raw: For if we be taken so, all Judea shall lie waste, and our sanctuary shall be spoiled; and he will require the profanation thereof at our mouth.
verses.text: For if we be taken so, all Judea shall lie waste, and our sanctuary shall be spoiled; and he will require the profanation thereof at our mouth.

verses.raw: And the slaughter of our brothers, and the captivity of the country, and the desolation of our inheritance, will he turn upon our heads among the Gentiles, wherever we shall be in bondage; and we shall be an offence and a reproach to all them that possess us.
verses.text: And the slaughter of our brothers, and the captivity of the country, and the desolation of our inheritance, will he turn upon our heads among the Gentiles, wherever we shall be in bondage; and we shall be an offence and a reproach to all them that possess us.

verses.raw: For our servitude shall not be directed to favour: but Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) shall turn it to dishonour.
verses.text: For our servitude shall not be directed to favour: but Yahuah, our Elohim shall turn it to dishonour.

verses.raw: Now therefore, O brothers, let us shew an example to our brothers, because their hearts depend upon us, and the sanctuary, and the house, and the altar, rest upon us.
verses.text: Now therefore, O brothers, let us shew an example to our brothers, because their hearts depend upon us, and the sanctuary, and the house, and the altar, rest upon us.

verses.raw: Moreover let us give thanks to Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), which trieth us, even as he did our fathers.
verses.text: Moreover let us give thanks to Yahuah, our Elohim, which trieth us, even as he did our fathers.

verses.raw: Remember what things he did to Abraham, and how he tried Isaac, and what happened to Jacob in Mesopotamia of Syria, when he kept the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother.
verses.text: Remember what things he did to Abraham, and how he tried Isaac, and what happened to Jacob in Mesopotamia of Syria, when he kept the sheep of Laban his mother’s brother.

verses.raw: For he has not tried us in the fire, as he did them, for the examination of their hearts, neither has he taken vengeance on us: but Yahuah (God) does scourge them that come near to him, to admonish them.
verses.text: For he has not tried us in the fire, as he did them, for the examination of their hearts, neither has he taken vengeance on us: but Yahuah does scourge them that come near to him, to admonish them.

verses.raw: Then said Ozias to her, All that you have spoken have you spoken with a good heart, and there is none that may gainsay your words.
verses.text: Then said Ozias to her, All that you have spoken have you spoken with a good heart, and there is none that may gainsay your words.

verses.raw: For this is not the first day in which your wisdom is manifested; but from the beginning of your days all the people have known your understanding, because the disposition of yours heart is good.
verses.text: For this is not the first day in which your wisdom is manifested; but from the beginning of your days all the people have known your understanding, because the disposition of yours heart is good.

verses.raw: But the people were very thirsty, and compelled us to do to them as we have spoken, and to bring an oath upon ourselves, which we will not break.
verses.text: But the people were very thirsty, and compelled us to do to them as we have spoken, and to bring an oath upon ourselves, which we will not break.

verses.raw: Therefore now pray you for us, because you are a godly woman, and Yahuah (God) will send us rain to fill our cisterns, and we shall faint no more.
verses.text: Therefore now pray you for us, because you are a godly woman, and Yahuah will send us rain to fill our cisterns, and we shall faint no more.

verses.raw: Then said Judith to them, Hear me, and I will do a thing, which shall go throughout all generations to the children of our nation.
verses.text: Then said Judith to them, Hear me, and I will do a thing, which shall go throughout all generations to the children of our nation.

verses.raw: You shall stand this night in the gate, and I will go forth with my waitingwoman: and within the days that you have promised to deliver the city to our enemies Yahuah (God) will visit Yashar'el (Israel) by my hand.
verses.text: You shall stand this night in the gate, and I will go forth with my waitingwoman: and within the days that you have promised to deliver the city to our enemies Yahuah will visit Yashar'el by my hand.

verses.raw: But enquire not you of my act: for I will not declare it to you, till the things be finished that I do.
verses.text: But enquire not you of my act: for I will not declare it to you, till the things be finished that I do.

verses.raw: Then said Ozias and the princes to her, Go in peace, and Yahuah (God) be before you, to take vengeance on our enemies.
verses.text: Then said Ozias and the princes to her, Go in peace, and Yahuah be before you, to take vengeance on our enemies.

verses.raw: So they returned from the tent, and went to their wards. ⸻
verses.text: So they returned from the tent, and went to their wards. ⸻

verses.raw: Judith fell upon her face, and put ashes upon her head, and uncovered the sackcloth with which she was clothed; and about the time that the incense of that evening was offered in Jerusalem in the house of Yahuah (God) Judith cried with a loud voice, and said,
verses.text: Judith fell upon her face, and put ashes upon her head, and uncovered the sackcloth with which she was clothed; and about the time that the incense of that evening was offered in Jerusalem in the house of Yahuah Judith cried with a loud voice, and said,

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God) of my father Simeon, to whom you gavest a sword to take vengeance of the strangers, who loosened the girdle of a maid to defile her, and discovered the thigh to her shame, and polluted her virginity to her reproach; for you saidst, It shall not be so; and yet they did so:
verses.text: O Yahuah of my father Simeon, to whom you gavest a sword to take vengeance of the strangers, who loosened the girdle of a maid to defile her, and discovered the thigh to her shame, and polluted her virginity to her reproach; for you saidst, It shall not be so; and yet they did so:

verses.raw: Wherefore you gavest their rulers to be slain, so that they dyed their bed in blood, being deceived, and smotest the servants with their lords, and the lords upon their thrones;
verses.text: Wherefore you gavest their rulers to be slain, so that they dyed their bed in blood, being deceived, and smotest the servants with their lords, and the lords upon their thrones;

verses.raw: And have given their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives, and all their spoils to be divided among your dear children; which were moved with your zeal, and abhorred the pollution of their blood, and called upon you for aid: O Yahuah (God), O my Elohim (God), hear me also a widow.
verses.text: And have given their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives, and all their spoils to be divided among your dear children; which were moved with your zeal, and abhorred the pollution of their blood, and called upon you for aid: O Yahuah, O my Elohim, hear me also a widow.

verses.raw: For you have wrought not only those things, but also the things which fell out before, and which ensued after; you have thought upon the things which are now, and which are to come.
verses.text: For you have wrought not only those things, but also the things which fell out before, and which ensued after; you have thought upon the things which are now, and which are to come.

verses.raw: Yea, what things you did determine were ready at hand, and said, Lo, we are here: for all your ways are prepared, and your judgments are in your foreknowledge.
verses.text: Yea, what things you did determine were ready at hand, and said, Lo, we are here: for all your ways are prepared, and your judgments are in your foreknowledge.

verses.raw: For, behold, the Assyrians are multiplied in their power; they are exalted with horse and man; they glory in the strength of their footmen; they trust in shield, and spear, and bow, and sling; and know not that you are Yahuah (God) that breakest the battles: Yahuah (God) is your name.
verses.text: For, behold, the Assyrians are multiplied in their power; they are exalted with horse and man; they glory in the strength of their footmen; they trust in shield, and spear, and bow, and sling; and know not that you are Yahuah that breakest the battles: Yahuah is your name.

verses.raw: Throw down their strength in your power, and bring down their force in your wrath: for they have purposed to defile your sanctuary, and to pollute the tabernacle where your glorious name resteth and to cast down with sword the horn of your altar.
verses.text: Throw down their strength in your power, and bring down their force in your wrath: for they have purposed to defile your sanctuary, and to pollute the tabernacle where your glorious name resteth and to cast down with sword the horn of your altar.
