verses.raw: Behold their pride, and send your wrath upon their heads: give into my hand, which am a widow, the power that I have conceived.
verses.text: Behold their pride, and send your wrath upon their heads: give into my hand, which am a widow, the power that I have conceived.

verses.raw: Smite by the deceit of my lips the servant with the prince, and the prince with the servant: break down their stateliness by the hand of a woman.
verses.text: Smite by the deceit of my lips the servant with the prince, and the prince with the servant: break down their stateliness by the hand of a woman.

verses.raw: For your power stands not in multitude nor your might in strong men: for you are a Yahuah (God) of the afflicted, an helper of the oppressed, an upholder of the weak, a protector of the forlorn, a saviour of them that are without hope.
verses.text: For your power stands not in multitude nor your might in strong men: for you are a Yahuah of the afflicted, an helper of the oppressed, an upholder of the weak, a protector of the forlorn, a saviour of them that are without hope.

verses.raw: I pray you, I pray you, O Yahuah (God) of my father, and Yahuah (God) of the inheritance of Yashar'el (Israel), Yahuah (God) of the heavens and earth, Creator of the waters, king of every creature, hear you my prayer:
verses.text: I pray you, I pray you, O Yahuah of my father, and Yahuah of the inheritance of Yashar'el, Yahuah of the heavens and earth, Creator of the waters, king of every creature, hear you my prayer:

verses.raw: And make my speech and deceit to be their wound and stripe, who have purposed cruel things against your covenant, and your hallowed house, and against the top of Sion, and against the house of the possession of your children.
verses.text: And make my speech and deceit to be their wound and stripe, who have purposed cruel things against your covenant, and your hallowed house, and against the top of Sion, and against the house of the possession of your children.

verses.raw: And make every nation and tribe to acknowledge that you are Yahuah (God) of all power and might, and that there is none other that protecteth the people of Yashar'el (Israel) but you. ⸻
verses.text: And make every nation and tribe to acknowledge that you are Yahuah of all power and might, and that there is none other that protecteth the people of Yashar'el but you. ⸻

verses.raw: Now after that she had ceased to cry to Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), and had made an end of all these words.
verses.text: Now after that she had ceased to cry to Yahuah of Yashar'el, and had made an end of all these words.

verses.raw: She rose where she had fallen down, and called her maid, and went down into the house in the which she abode in the sabbath days, and in her feast days,
verses.text: She rose where she had fallen down, and called her maid, and went down into the house in the which she abode in the sabbath days, and in her feast days,

verses.raw: And pulled off the sackcloth which she had on, and put off the garments of her widowhood, and washed her body all over with water, and anointed herself with precious ointment, and braided the hair of her head, and put on a tire upon it, and put on her garments of gladness, with which she was clad during the life of Manasses her husband.
verses.text: And pulled off the sackcloth which she had on, and put off the garments of her widowhood, and washed her body all over with water, and anointed herself with precious ointment, and braided the hair of her head, and put on a tire upon it, and put on her garments of gladness, with which she was clad during the life of Manasses her husband.

verses.raw: And she took sandals upon her feet, and put about her her bracelets, and her chains, and her rings, and her earrings, and all her ornaments, and decked herself bravely, to allure the eyes of all men that should see her.
verses.text: And she took sandals upon her feet, and put about her her bracelets, and her chains, and her rings, and her earrings, and all her ornaments, and decked herself bravely, to allure the eyes of all men that should see her.

verses.raw: Then she gave her maid a bottle of wine, and a cruse of oil, and filled a bag with parched corn, and lumps of figs, and with fine bread; so she folded all these things together, and laid them upon her.
verses.text: Then she gave her maid a bottle of wine, and a cruse of oil, and filled a bag with parched corn, and lumps of figs, and with fine bread; so she folded all these things together, and laid them upon her.

verses.raw: Thus they went forth to the gate of the city of Bethulia, and found standing there Ozias and the ancients of the city, Chabris and Charmis.
verses.text: Thus they went forth to the gate of the city of Bethulia, and found standing there Ozias and the ancients of the city, Chabris and Charmis.

verses.raw: And when they saw her, that her countenance was altered, and her apparel was changed, they wondered at her beauty very greatly, and said to her.
verses.text: And when they saw her, that her countenance was altered, and her apparel was changed, they wondered at her beauty very greatly, and said to her.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God), Yahuah (God) of our fathers give you favour, and accomplish your enterprizes to the glory of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and to the exaltation of Jerusalem. Then they worshipped Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Yahuah, Yahuah of our fathers give you favour, and accomplish your enterprizes to the glory of the children of Yashar'el, and to the exaltation of Jerusalem. Then they worshipped Yahuah.

verses.raw: And she said to them, Command the gates of the city to be opened to me, that I may go forth to accomplish the things of which you have spoken with me. So they commanded the young men to open to her, as she had spoken.
verses.text: And she said to them, Command the gates of the city to be opened to me, that I may go forth to accomplish the things of which you have spoken with me. So they commanded the young men to open to her, as she had spoken.

verses.raw: And when they had done so, Judith went out, she, and her maid with her; and the men of the city looked after her, until she was gone down the mountain, and till she had passed the valley, and could see her no more.
verses.text: And when they had done so, Judith went out, she, and her maid with her; and the men of the city looked after her, until she was gone down the mountain, and till she had passed the valley, and could see her no more.

verses.raw: Thus they went straight forth in the valley: and the first watch of the Assyrians met her,
verses.text: Thus they went straight forth in the valley: and the first watch of the Assyrians met her,

verses.raw: And took her, and asked her, Of what people art you? and whence comest you? and whither goest you? And she said, I am a woman of the Hebrews, and am fled from them: for they shall be given you to be consumed:
verses.text: And took her, and asked her, Of what people art you? and whence comest you? and whither goest you? And she said, I am a woman of the Hebrews, and am fled from them: for they shall be given you to be consumed:

verses.raw: And I am coming before Holofernes the chief captain of your army, to declare words of truth; and I will shew him a way, by which he shall go, and win all the hill country, without losing the body or life of any one of his men.
verses.text: And I am coming before Holofernes the chief captain of your army, to declare words of truth; and I will shew him a way, by which he shall go, and win all the hill country, without losing the body or life of any one of his men.

verses.raw: Now when the men heard her words, and beheld her countenance, they wondered greatly at her beauty, and said to her,
verses.text: Now when the men heard her words, and beheld her countenance, they wondered greatly at her beauty, and said to her,

verses.raw: You have saved your life, in that you have hasted to come down to the presence of our lord: now therefore come to his tent, and some of us shall conduct you, until they have delivered you to his hands.
verses.text: You have saved your life, in that you have hasted to come down to the presence of our lord: now therefore come to his tent, and some of us shall conduct you, until they have delivered you to his hands.

verses.raw: And when you standest before him, be not afraid in yours heart, but shew to him according to your word; and he will entreat you well.
verses.text: And when you standest before him, be not afraid in yours heart, but shew to him according to your word; and he will entreat you well.

verses.raw: Then they chose out of them an hundred men to accompany her and her maid; and they brought her to the tent of Holofernes.
verses.text: Then they chose out of them an hundred men to accompany her and her maid; and they brought her to the tent of Holofernes.

verses.raw: Then was there a concourse throughout all the camp: for her coming was noised among the tents, and they came about her, as she stood without the tent of Holofernes, till they told him of her.
verses.text: Then was there a concourse throughout all the camp: for her coming was noised among the tents, and they came about her, as she stood without the tent of Holofernes, till they told him of her.

verses.raw: And they wondered at her beauty, and admired the children of Yashar'el (Israel) because of her, and every one said to his neighbour, Who would despise this people, that have among them such women? surely it is not good that one man of them be left who being let go might deceive the whole earth.
verses.text: And they wondered at her beauty, and admired the children of Yashar'el because of her, and every one said to his neighbour, Who would despise this people, that have among them such women? surely it is not good that one man of them be left who being let go might deceive the whole earth.

verses.raw: And they that lay near Holofernes went out, and all his servants and they brought her into the tent.
verses.text: And they that lay near Holofernes went out, and all his servants and they brought her into the tent.

verses.raw: Now Holofernes rested upon his bed under a canopy, which was woven with purple, and gold, and emeralds, and precious stones.
verses.text: Now Holofernes rested upon his bed under a canopy, which was woven with purple, and gold, and emeralds, and precious stones.

verses.raw: So they shewed him of her; and he came out before his tent with silver lamps going before him.
verses.text: So they shewed him of her; and he came out before his tent with silver lamps going before him.

verses.raw: And when Judith was come before him and his servants they all marvelled at the beauty of her countenance; and she fell down upon her face, and did reverence to him: and his servants took her up. ⸻
verses.text: And when Judith was come before him and his servants they all marvelled at the beauty of her countenance; and she fell down upon her face, and did reverence to him: and his servants took her up. ⸻

verses.raw: Then said Holofernes to her, Woman, be of good comfort, fear not in yours heart: for I never hurt any that was willing to serve Nabuchodonosor, the king of all the earth.
verses.text: Then said Holofernes to her, Woman, be of good comfort, fear not in yours heart: for I never hurt any that was willing to serve Nabuchodonosor, the king of all the earth.

verses.raw: Now therefore, if your people that dwells in the mountains had not set light by me, I would not have lifted up my spear against them: but they have done these things to themselves.
verses.text: Now therefore, if your people that dwells in the mountains had not set light by me, I would not have lifted up my spear against them: but they have done these things to themselves.

verses.raw: But now tell me wherefore you are fled from them, and art come to us: for you are come for safeguard; be of good comfort, you shall live this night, and hereafter:
verses.text: But now tell me wherefore you are fled from them, and art come to us: for you are come for safeguard; be of good comfort, you shall live this night, and hereafter:

verses.raw: For none shall hurt you, but entreat you well, as they do the servants of king Nabuchodonosor my lord.
verses.text: For none shall hurt you, but entreat you well, as they do the servants of king Nabuchodonosor my lord.

verses.raw: Then Judith said to him, Receive the words of your servant, and suffer yours handmaid to speak in your presence, and I will declare no lie to my lord this night.
verses.text: Then Judith said to him, Receive the words of your servant, and suffer yours handmaid to speak in your presence, and I will declare no lie to my lord this night.

verses.raw: And if you will follow the words of yours handmaid, Yahuah (God) will bring the thing perfectly to pass by you; and my lord shall not fail of his purposes.
verses.text: And if you will follow the words of yours handmaid, Yahuah will bring the thing perfectly to pass by you; and my lord shall not fail of his purposes.

verses.raw: As Nabuchodonosor king of all the earth lives, and as his power lives, who has sent you for the upholding of every living thing: for not only men shall serve him by you, but also the beasts of the field, and the cattle, and the fowls of the air, shall live by your power under Nabuchodonosor and all his house.
verses.text: As Nabuchodonosor king of all the earth lives, and as his power lives, who has sent you for the upholding of every living thing: for not only men shall serve him by you, but also the beasts of the field, and the cattle, and the fowls of the air, shall live by your power under Nabuchodonosor and all his house.

verses.raw: For we have heard of your wisdom and your policies, and it is reported in all the earth, that you only art excellent in all the kingdom, and mighty in knowledge, and wonderful in feats of war.
verses.text: For we have heard of your wisdom and your policies, and it is reported in all the earth, that you only art excellent in all the kingdom, and mighty in knowledge, and wonderful in feats of war.

verses.raw: Now as concerning the matter, which Achior did speak in your council, we have heard his words; for the men of Bethulia saved him, and he declared to them all that he had spoken to you.
verses.text: Now as concerning the matter, which Achior did speak in your council, we have heard his words; for the men of Bethulia saved him, and he declared to them all that he had spoken to you.

verses.raw: Therefore, O lord and governor, respect not his word; but lay it up in yours heart, for it is true: for our nation shall not be punished, neither can sword prevail against them, except they sin against their Elohim (God).
verses.text: Therefore, O lord and governor, respect not his word; but lay it up in yours heart, for it is true: for our nation shall not be punished, neither can sword prevail against them, except they sin against their Elohim.

verses.raw: And now, that my lord be not defeated and frustrate of his purpose, even death is now fallen upon them, and their sin has overtaken them, with which they will provoke their Elohim (God) to anger whenever they shall do that which is not fit to be done:
verses.text: And now, that my lord be not defeated and frustrate of his purpose, even death is now fallen upon them, and their sin has overtaken them, with which they will provoke their Elohim to anger whenever they shall do that which is not fit to be done:

verses.raw: For their victuals fail them, and all their water is scant, and they have determined to lay hands upon their cattle, and purposed to consume all those things, that Yahuah (God) has forbidden them to eat by his laws:
verses.text: For their victuals fail them, and all their water is scant, and they have determined to lay hands upon their cattle, and purposed to consume all those things, that Yahuah has forbidden them to eat by his laws:

verses.raw: And are resolved to spend the firstfruits of the tenths of wine and oil, which they had sanctified, and reserved for the priests that serve in Jerusalem before the face of our Elohim (God); the which things it is not lawful for any of the people so much as to touch with their hands.
verses.text: And are resolved to spend the firstfruits of the tenths of wine and oil, which they had sanctified, and reserved for the priests that serve in Jerusalem before the face of our Elohim; the which things it is not lawful for any of the people so much as to touch with their hands.

verses.raw: For they have sent some to Jerusalem, because they also that dwell there have done the like, to bring them a licence from the senate.
verses.text: For they have sent some to Jerusalem, because they also that dwell there have done the like, to bring them a licence from the senate.

verses.raw: Now when they shall bring them word, they will forthwith do it, and they shall be given to you to be destroyed the same day.
verses.text: Now when they shall bring them word, they will forthwith do it, and they shall be given to you to be destroyed the same day.

verses.raw: Wherefore I yours handmaid, knowing all this, am fled from their presence; and Yahuah (God) has sent me to work things with you, whereat all the earth shall be astonished, and whoever shall hear it.
verses.text: Wherefore I yours handmaid, knowing all this, am fled from their presence; and Yahuah has sent me to work things with you, whereat all the earth shall be astonished, and whoever shall hear it.

verses.raw: For your servant is religious, and serveth Yahuah (God) of heaven day and night: now therefore, my lord, I will remain with you, and your servant will go out by night into the valley, and I will pray to Yahuah (God), and he will tell me when they have committed their sins:
verses.text: For your servant is religious, and serveth Yahuah of heaven day and night: now therefore, my lord, I will remain with you, and your servant will go out by night into the valley, and I will pray to Yahuah, and he will tell me when they have committed their sins:

verses.raw: And I will come and shew it to you: then you shall go forth with all your army, and there shall be none of them that shall resist you.
verses.text: And I will come and shew it to you: then you shall go forth with all your army, and there shall be none of them that shall resist you.

verses.raw: And I will lead you through the midst of Judea, until you come before Jerusalem; and I will set your throne in the midst thereof; and you shall drive them as sheep that have no shepherd, and a dog shall not so much as open his mouth at you: for these things were told me according to my foreknowledge, and they were declared to me, and I am sent to tell you.
verses.text: And I will lead you through the midst of Judea, until you come before Jerusalem; and I will set your throne in the midst thereof; and you shall drive them as sheep that have no shepherd, and a dog shall not so much as open his mouth at you: for these things were told me according to my foreknowledge, and they were declared to me, and I am sent to tell you.

verses.raw: Then her words pleased Holofernes and all his servants; and they marvelled at her wisdom, and said,
verses.text: Then her words pleased Holofernes and all his servants; and they marvelled at her wisdom, and said,

verses.raw: There is not such a woman from one end of the earth to the other, both for beauty of face, and wisdom of words.
verses.text: There is not such a woman from one end of the earth to the other, both for beauty of face, and wisdom of words.

verses.raw: Likewise Holofernes said to her. Yahuah (God) has done well to send you before the people, that strength might be in our hands and destruction upon them that lightly regard my lord.
verses.text: Likewise Holofernes said to her. Yahuah has done well to send you before the people, that strength might be in our hands and destruction upon them that lightly regard my lord.

verses.raw: And now you are both beautiful in your countenance, and witty in your words: surely if you do as you have spoken your Elohim (God) shall be my Elohim (God), and you shall dwell in the house of king Nabuchodonosor, and shall be renowned through the whole earth. ⸻
verses.text: And now you are both beautiful in your countenance, and witty in your words: surely if you do as you have spoken your Elohim shall be my Elohim, and you shall dwell in the house of king Nabuchodonosor, and shall be renowned through the whole earth. ⸻

verses.raw: Then he commanded to bring her in where his plate was set; and told that they should prepare for her of his own meats, and that she should drink of his own wine.
verses.text: Then he commanded to bring her in where his plate was set; and told that they should prepare for her of his own meats, and that she should drink of his own wine.

verses.raw: And Judith said, I will not eat thereof, lest there be an offence: but provision shall be made for me of the things that I have brought.
verses.text: And Judith said, I will not eat thereof, lest there be an offence: but provision shall be made for me of the things that I have brought.

verses.raw: Then Holofernes said to her, If your provision should fail, how should we give you the like? for there be none with us of your nation.
verses.text: Then Holofernes said to her, If your provision should fail, how should we give you the like? for there be none with us of your nation.

verses.raw: Then said Judith to him As your soul lives, my lord, yours handmaid shall not spend those things that I have, before Yahuah (God) work by my hand the things that he has determined.
verses.text: Then said Judith to him As your soul lives, my lord, yours handmaid shall not spend those things that I have, before Yahuah work by my hand the things that he has determined.

verses.raw: Then the servants of Holofernes brought her into the tent, and she slept till midnight, and she arose when it was toward the morning watch,
verses.text: Then the servants of Holofernes brought her into the tent, and she slept till midnight, and she arose when it was toward the morning watch,

verses.raw: And sent to Holofernes, saving, Let my lord now command that yours handmaid may go forth to prayer.
verses.text: And sent to Holofernes, saving, Let my lord now command that yours handmaid may go forth to prayer.

verses.raw: Then Holofernes commanded his guard that they should not stay her: thus she abode in the camp three days, and went out in the night into the valley of Bethulia, and washed herself in a fountain of water by the camp.
verses.text: Then Holofernes commanded his guard that they should not stay her: thus she abode in the camp three days, and went out in the night into the valley of Bethulia, and washed herself in a fountain of water by the camp.

verses.raw: And when she came out, she besought Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) to direct her way to the raising up of the children of her people.
verses.text: And when she came out, she besought Yahuah of Yashar'el to direct her way to the raising up of the children of her people.

verses.raw: So she came in clean, and remained in the tent, until she did eat her meat at evening.
verses.text: So she came in clean, and remained in the tent, until she did eat her meat at evening.

verses.raw: And in the fourth day Holofernes made a feast to his own servants only, and called none of the officers to the banquet.
verses.text: And in the fourth day Holofernes made a feast to his own servants only, and called none of the officers to the banquet.

verses.raw: Then said he to Bagoas the eunuch, who had charge over all that he had, Go now, and persuade this Hebrew woman which is with you, that she come to us, and eat and drink with us.
verses.text: Then said he to Bagoas the eunuch, who had charge over all that he had, Go now, and persuade this Hebrew woman which is with you, that she come to us, and eat and drink with us.

verses.raw: For, lo, it will be a shame for our person, if we shall let such a woman go, not having had her company; for if we draw her not to us, she will laugh us to scorn.
verses.text: For, lo, it will be a shame for our person, if we shall let such a woman go, not having had her company; for if we draw her not to us, she will laugh us to scorn.

verses.raw: Then went Bagoas from the presence of Holofernes, and came to her, and he said, Let not this fair damsel fear to come to my lord, and to be honoured in his presence, and drink wine, and be merry with us and be made this day as one of the daughters of the Assyrians, which serve in the house of Nabuchodonosor.
verses.text: Then went Bagoas from the presence of Holofernes, and came to her, and he said, Let not this fair damsel fear to come to my lord, and to be honoured in his presence, and drink wine, and be merry with us and be made this day as one of the daughters of the Assyrians, which serve in the house of Nabuchodonosor.

verses.raw: Then said Judith to him, Who am I now, that I should gainsay my lord? surely whatsoever pleaseth him I will do speedily, and it shall be my joy to the day of my death.
verses.text: Then said Judith to him, Who am I now, that I should gainsay my lord? surely whatsoever pleaseth him I will do speedily, and it shall be my joy to the day of my death.

verses.raw: So she arose, and decked herself with her apparel and all her woman’s attire, and her maid went and laid soft skins on the ground for her over against Holofernes, which she had received of Bagoas for her daily use, that she might sit and eat upon them.
verses.text: So she arose, and decked herself with her apparel and all her woman’s attire, and her maid went and laid soft skins on the ground for her over against Holofernes, which she had received of Bagoas for her daily use, that she might sit and eat upon them.

verses.raw: Now when Judith came in and sat down, Holofernes his heart was ravished with her, and his mind was moved, and he desired greatly her company; for he waited a time to deceive her, from the day that he had seen her.
verses.text: Now when Judith came in and sat down, Holofernes his heart was ravished with her, and his mind was moved, and he desired greatly her company; for he waited a time to deceive her, from the day that he had seen her.

verses.raw: Then said Holofernes to her, Drink now, and be merry with us.
verses.text: Then said Holofernes to her, Drink now, and be merry with us.

verses.raw: So Judith said, I will drink now, my lord, because my life is magnified in me this day more than all the days since I was born.
verses.text: So Judith said, I will drink now, my lord, because my life is magnified in me this day more than all the days since I was born.

verses.raw: Then she took and ate and drank before him what her maid had prepared.
verses.text: Then she took and ate and drank before him what her maid had prepared.

verses.raw: And Holofernes took great delight in her, and drank more wine than he had drunk at any time in one day since he was born. ⸻
verses.text: And Holofernes took great delight in her, and drank more wine than he had drunk at any time in one day since he was born. ⸻

verses.raw: Now when the evening was come, his servants made haste to depart, and Bagoas shut his tent without, and dismissed the waiters from the presence of his lord; and they went to their beds: for they were all weary, because the feast had been long.
verses.text: Now when the evening was come, his servants made haste to depart, and Bagoas shut his tent without, and dismissed the waiters from the presence of his lord; and they went to their beds: for they were all weary, because the feast had been long.

verses.raw: And Judith was left alone in the tent, and Holofernes lying alone upon his bed: for he was filled with wine.
verses.text: And Judith was left alone in the tent, and Holofernes lying alone upon his bed: for he was filled with wine.

verses.raw: Now Judith had commanded her maid to stand without her bedchamber, and to wait for her. coming forth, as she did daily: for she said she would go forth to her prayers, and she spoke to Bagoas according to the same purpose.
verses.text: Now Judith had commanded her maid to stand without her bedchamber, and to wait for her. coming forth, as she did daily: for she said she would go forth to her prayers, and she spoke to Bagoas according to the same purpose.

verses.raw: So all went forth and none was left in the bedchamber, neither little nor great. Then Judith, standing by his bed, said in her heart, O Yahuah (God) of all power, look at this present upon the works of my hands for the exaltation of Jerusalem.
verses.text: So all went forth and none was left in the bedchamber, neither little nor great. Then Judith, standing by his bed, said in her heart, O Yahuah of all power, look at this present upon the works of my hands for the exaltation of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: For now is the time to help your inheritance, and to execute your enterprizes to the destruction of the enemies which are risen against us.
verses.text: For now is the time to help your inheritance, and to execute your enterprizes to the destruction of the enemies which are risen against us.

verses.raw: Then she came to the pillar of the bed, which was at Holofernes’ head, and took down his fauchion from thence,
verses.text: Then she came to the pillar of the bed, which was at Holofernes’ head, and took down his fauchion from thence,

verses.raw: And approached to his bed, and took hold of the hair of his head, and said, Strengthen me, O Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), this day.
verses.text: And approached to his bed, and took hold of the hair of his head, and said, Strengthen me, O Yahuah of Yashar'el, this day.

verses.raw: And she struck twice upon his neck with all her might, and she took away his head from him.
verses.text: And she struck twice upon his neck with all her might, and she took away his head from him.

verses.raw: And tumbled his body down from the bed, and pulled down the canopy from the pillars; and anon after she went forth, and gave Holofernes his head to her maid;
verses.text: And tumbled his body down from the bed, and pulled down the canopy from the pillars; and anon after she went forth, and gave Holofernes his head to her maid;

verses.raw: And she put it in her bag of meat: so they twain went together according to their custom to prayer: and when they passed the camp, they compassed the valley, and went up the mountain of Bethulia, and came to the gates thereof.
verses.text: And she put it in her bag of meat: so they twain went together according to their custom to prayer: and when they passed the camp, they compassed the valley, and went up the mountain of Bethulia, and came to the gates thereof.

verses.raw: Then said Judith afar off, to the watchmen at the gate, Open, open now the gate: Yahuah (God), even our Elohim (God), is with us, to shew his power yet in Jerusalem, and his forces against the enemy, as he has even done this day.
verses.text: Then said Judith afar off, to the watchmen at the gate, Open, open now the gate: Yahuah, even our Elohim, is with us, to shew his power yet in Jerusalem, and his forces against the enemy, as he has even done this day.

verses.raw: Now when the men of her city heard her voice, they made haste to go down to the gate of their city, and they called the elders of the city.
verses.text: Now when the men of her city heard her voice, they made haste to go down to the gate of their city, and they called the elders of the city.

verses.raw: And then they ran all together, both small and great, for it was strange to them that she was come: so they opened the gate, and received them, and made a fire for a light, and stood round about them.
verses.text: And then they ran all together, both small and great, for it was strange to them that she was come: so they opened the gate, and received them, and made a fire for a light, and stood round about them.

verses.raw: Then she said to them with a loud voice, Praise, praise Yahuah (God), praise Yahuah (God), I say, for he has not taken away his mercy from the house of Yashar'el (Israel), but has destroyed our enemies by my hands this night.
verses.text: Then she said to them with a loud voice, Praise, praise Yahuah, praise Yahuah, I say, for he has not taken away his mercy from the house of Yashar'el, but has destroyed our enemies by my hands this night.

verses.raw: So she took the head out of the bag, and shewed it, and said to them, behold the head of Holofernes, the chief captain of the army of Assur, and behold the canopy, in which he did lie in his drunkenness; and Yahuah (God) has struck him by the hand of a woman.
verses.text: So she took the head out of the bag, and shewed it, and said to them, behold the head of Holofernes, the chief captain of the army of Assur, and behold the canopy, in which he did lie in his drunkenness; and Yahuah has struck him by the hand of a woman.

verses.raw: As Yahuah (God) lives, who has kept me in my way that I went, my countenance has deceived him to his destruction, and yet has he not committed sin with me, to defile and shame me.
verses.text: As Yahuah lives, who has kept me in my way that I went, my countenance has deceived him to his destruction, and yet has he not committed sin with me, to defile and shame me.

verses.raw: Then all the people were wonderfully astonished, and bowed themselves and worshipped Yahuah (God), and said with one accord, Blessed be you, O our Elohim (God), which have this day brought to nought the enemies of your people.
verses.text: Then all the people were wonderfully astonished, and bowed themselves and worshipped Yahuah, and said with one accord, Blessed be you, O our Elohim, which have this day brought to nought the enemies of your people.

verses.raw: Then said Ozias to her, O daughter, blessed art you of the most high Yahuah (God) above all the women upon the earth; and blessed be Yahuah (God), which has created the heavens and the earth, which has directed you to the cutting off of the head of the chief of our enemies.
verses.text: Then said Ozias to her, O daughter, blessed art you of the most high Yahuah above all the women upon the earth; and blessed be Yahuah, which has created the heavens and the earth, which has directed you to the cutting off of the head of the chief of our enemies.

verses.raw: For this your confidence shall not depart from the heart of men, which remember the power of Yahuah (God) for ever.
verses.text: For this your confidence shall not depart from the heart of men, which remember the power of Yahuah for ever.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) turn these things to you for a perpetual praise, to visit you in good things because you have not spared your life for the affliction of our nation, but have revenged our ruin, walking a straight way before our Elohim (God). And all the people said; So be it, so be it. ⸻
verses.text: And Yahuah turn these things to you for a perpetual praise, to visit you in good things because you have not spared your life for the affliction of our nation, but have revenged our ruin, walking a straight way before our Elohim. And all the people said; So be it, so be it. ⸻

verses.raw: Then said Judith to them, Hear me now, my brothers, and take this head, and hang it upon the highest place of your walls.
verses.text: Then said Judith to them, Hear me now, my brothers, and take this head, and hang it upon the highest place of your walls.

verses.raw: And so soon as the morning shall appear, and the sun shall come forth upon the earth, take you every one his weapons, and go forth every valiant man out of the city, and set you a captain over them, as though you would go down into the field toward the watch of the Assyrians; but go not down.
verses.text: And so soon as the morning shall appear, and the sun shall come forth upon the earth, take you every one his weapons, and go forth every valiant man out of the city, and set you a captain over them, as though you would go down into the field toward the watch of the Assyrians; but go not down.

verses.raw: Then they shall take their armour, and shall go into their camp, and raise up the captains of the army of Assur, and shall run to the tent of Holofernes, but shall not find him: then fear shall fall upon them, and they shall flee before your face.
verses.text: Then they shall take their armour, and shall go into their camp, and raise up the captains of the army of Assur, and shall run to the tent of Holofernes, but shall not find him: then fear shall fall upon them, and they shall flee before your face.

verses.raw: So you, and all that inhabit the coast of Yashar'el (Israel), shall pursue them, and overthrow them as they go.
verses.text: So you, and all that inhabit the coast of Yashar'el, shall pursue them, and overthrow them as they go.

verses.raw: But before you do these things, call me Achior the Ammonite, that he may see and know him that despised the house of Yashar'el (Israel), and that sent him to us as it were to his death.
verses.text: But before you do these things, call me Achior the Ammonite, that he may see and know him that despised the house of Yashar'el, and that sent him to us as it were to his death.

verses.raw: Then they called Achior out of the house of Ozias; and when he was come, and saw the head of Holofernes in a man’s hand in the assembly of the people, he fell down on his face, and his spirit failed.
verses.text: Then they called Achior out of the house of Ozias; and when he was come, and saw the head of Holofernes in a man’s hand in the assembly of the people, he fell down on his face, and his spirit failed.

verses.raw: But when they had recovered him, he fell at Judith’s feet, and reverenced her, and said, Blessed art you in all the tabernacles of Juda, and in all nations, which hearing your name shall be astonished.
verses.text: But when they had recovered him, he fell at Judith’s feet, and reverenced her, and said, Blessed art you in all the tabernacles of Juda, and in all nations, which hearing your name shall be astonished.

verses.raw: Now therefore tell me all the things that you have done in these days. Then Judith declared to him in the midst of the people all that she had done, from the day that she went forth until that hour she spoke to them.
verses.text: Now therefore tell me all the things that you have done in these days. Then Judith declared to him in the midst of the people all that she had done, from the day that she went forth until that hour she spoke to them.

verses.raw: And when she had left off speaking, the people shouted with a loud voice, and made a joyful noise in their city.
verses.text: And when she had left off speaking, the people shouted with a loud voice, and made a joyful noise in their city.

verses.raw: And when Achior had seen all that Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) had done, he believed in Yahuah (God) greatly, and circumcised the flesh of his foreskin, and was joined to the house of Yashar'el (Israel) to this day.
verses.text: And when Achior had seen all that Yahuah of Yashar'el had done, he believed in Yahuah greatly, and circumcised the flesh of his foreskin, and was joined to the house of Yashar'el to this day.

verses.raw: And as soon as the morning arose, they hanged the head of Holofernes upon the wall, and every man took his weapons, and they went forth by bands to the straits of the mountain.
verses.text: And as soon as the morning arose, they hanged the head of Holofernes upon the wall, and every man took his weapons, and they went forth by bands to the straits of the mountain.

verses.raw: But when the Assyrians saw them, they sent to their leaders, which came to their captains and tribunes, and to every one of their rulers.
verses.text: But when the Assyrians saw them, they sent to their leaders, which came to their captains and tribunes, and to every one of their rulers.

verses.raw: So they came to Holofernes’ tent, and said to him that had the charge of all his things, Waken now our lord: for the slaves have been bold to come down against us to battle, that they may be utterly destroyed.
verses.text: So they came to Holofernes’ tent, and said to him that had the charge of all his things, Waken now our lord: for the slaves have been bold to come down against us to battle, that they may be utterly destroyed.

verses.raw: Then went in Bagoas, and knocked at the door of the tent; for he thought that he had slept with Judith.
verses.text: Then went in Bagoas, and knocked at the door of the tent; for he thought that he had slept with Judith.

verses.raw: But because none answered, he opened it, and went into the bedchamber, and found him cast upon the floor dead, and his head was taken from him.
verses.text: But because none answered, he opened it, and went into the bedchamber, and found him cast upon the floor dead, and his head was taken from him.

verses.raw: Therefore he cried with a loud voice, with weeping, and sighing, and a mighty cry, and rent his garments.
verses.text: Therefore he cried with a loud voice, with weeping, and sighing, and a mighty cry, and rent his garments.

verses.raw: After he went into the tent where Judith lodged: and when he found her not, he leaped out to the people, and cried,
verses.text: After he went into the tent where Judith lodged: and when he found her not, he leaped out to the people, and cried,

verses.raw: These slaves have dealt treacherously; one woman of the Hebrews has brought shame upon the house of king Nabuchodonosor: for, behold, Holofernes lieth upon the ground without a head.
verses.text: These slaves have dealt treacherously; one woman of the Hebrews has brought shame upon the house of king Nabuchodonosor: for, behold, Holofernes lieth upon the ground without a head.

verses.raw: When the captains of the Assyrians’ army heard these words, they rent their coats and their minds were wonderfully troubled, and there was a cry and a very great noise throughout the camp. ⸻
verses.text: When the captains of the Assyrians’ army heard these words, they rent their coats and their minds were wonderfully troubled, and there was a cry and a very great noise throughout the camp. ⸻

verses.raw: And when they that were in the tents heard, they were astonished at the thing that was done.
verses.text: And when they that were in the tents heard, they were astonished at the thing that was done.

verses.raw: And fear and trembling fell upon them, so that there was no man that durst abide in the sight of his neighbour, but rushing out all together, they fled into every way of the plain, and of the hill country.
verses.text: And fear and trembling fell upon them, so that there was no man that durst abide in the sight of his neighbour, but rushing out all together, they fled into every way of the plain, and of the hill country.

verses.raw: They also that had camped in the mountains round about Bethulia fled away. Then the children of Yashar'el (Israel), every one that was a warrior among them, rushed out upon them.
verses.text: They also that had camped in the mountains round about Bethulia fled away. Then the children of Yashar'el, every one that was a warrior among them, rushed out upon them.

verses.raw: Then sent Ozias to Betomasthem, and to Bebai, and Chobai, and Cola and to all the coasts of Yashar'el (Israel), such as should tell the things that were done, and that all should rush forth upon their enemies to destroy them.
verses.text: Then sent Ozias to Betomasthem, and to Bebai, and Chobai, and Cola and to all the coasts of Yashar'el, such as should tell the things that were done, and that all should rush forth upon their enemies to destroy them.

verses.raw: Now when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) heard it, they all fell upon them with one consent, and slew them to Chobai: likewise also they that came from Jerusalem, and from all the hill country, (for men had told them what things were done in the camp of their enemies) and they that were in Galaad, and in Galilee, chased them with a great slaughter, until they were past Damascus and the borders thereof.
verses.text: Now when the children of Yashar'el heard it, they all fell upon them with one consent, and slew them to Chobai: likewise also they that came from Jerusalem, and from all the hill country, (for men had told them what things were done in the camp of their enemies) and they that were in Galaad, and in Galilee, chased them with a great slaughter, until they were past Damascus and the borders thereof.

verses.raw: And the residue that dwelt at Bethulia, fell upon the camp of Assur, and spoiled them, and were greatly enriched.
verses.text: And the residue that dwelt at Bethulia, fell upon the camp of Assur, and spoiled them, and were greatly enriched.

verses.raw: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that returned from the slaughter had that which remained; and the villages and the cities, that were in the mountains and in the plain, got many spoils: for the multitude was very great.
verses.text: And the children of Yashar'el that returned from the slaughter had that which remained; and the villages and the cities, that were in the mountains and in the plain, got many spoils: for the multitude was very great.

verses.raw: Then Joacim the high priest, and the ancients of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that dwelt in Jerusalem, came to behold the good things that Yahuah (God) had shewed to Yashar'el (Israel), and to see Judith, and to salute her.
verses.text: Then Joacim the high priest, and the ancients of the children of Yashar'el that dwelt in Jerusalem, came to behold the good things that Yahuah had shewed to Yashar'el, and to see Judith, and to salute her.

verses.raw: And when they came to her, they blessed her with one accord, and said to her, You are the exaltation of Jerusalem, you are the great glory of Yashar'el (Israel), you are the great rejoicing of our nation:
verses.text: And when they came to her, they blessed her with one accord, and said to her, You are the exaltation of Jerusalem, you are the great glory of Yashar'el, you are the great rejoicing of our nation:

verses.raw: You have done all these things by yours hand: you have done much good to Yashar'el (Israel), and Yahuah (God) is pleased with it: blessed be you of the Almighty Yahuah (God) for evermore. And all the people said, So be it.
verses.text: You have done all these things by yours hand: you have done much good to Yashar'el, and Yahuah is pleased with it: blessed be you of the Almighty Yahuah for evermore. And all the people said, So be it.

verses.raw: And the people spoiled the camp the space of thirty days: and they gave to Judith Holofernes his tent, and all his plate, and beds, and vessels, and all his stuff: and she took it and laid it on her mule; and made ready her carts, and laid them on it.
verses.text: And the people spoiled the camp the space of thirty days: and they gave to Judith Holofernes his tent, and all his plate, and beds, and vessels, and all his stuff: and she took it and laid it on her mule; and made ready her carts, and laid them on it.

verses.raw: Then all the women of Yashar'el (Israel) ran together to see her, and blessed her, and made a dance among them for her: and she took branches in her hand, and gave also to the women that were with her.
verses.text: Then all the women of Yashar'el ran together to see her, and blessed her, and made a dance among them for her: and she took branches in her hand, and gave also to the women that were with her.

verses.raw: And they put a garland of olive upon her and her maid that was with her, and she went before all the people in the dance, leading all the women: and all the men of Yashar'el (Israel) followed in their armour with garlands, and with songs in their mouths. ⸻
verses.text: And they put a garland of olive upon her and her maid that was with her, and she went before all the people in the dance, leading all the women: and all the men of Yashar'el followed in their armour with garlands, and with songs in their mouths. ⸻

verses.raw: Then Judith began to sing this thanksgiving in all Yashar'el (Israel), and all the people sang after her this song of praise.
verses.text: Then Judith began to sing this thanksgiving in all Yashar'el, and all the people sang after her this song of praise.

verses.raw: And Judith said, Begin to my Elohim (God) with timbrels, sing to my Elohim (God) with cymbals: tune to him a new psalm: exalt him, and call upon his name.
verses.text: And Judith said, Begin to my Elohim with timbrels, sing to my Elohim with cymbals: tune to him a new psalm: exalt him, and call upon his name.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) breaks the battles: for among the camps in the midst of the people he has delivered me out of the hands of them that persecuted me.
verses.text: For Yahuah breaks the battles: for among the camps in the midst of the people he has delivered me out of the hands of them that persecuted me.

verses.raw: Assur came out of the mountains from the north, he came with ten thousands of his army, the multitude of which stopped the torrents, and their horsemen have covered the hills.
verses.text: Assur came out of the mountains from the north, he came with ten thousands of his army, the multitude of which stopped the torrents, and their horsemen have covered the hills.

verses.raw: He bragged that he would burn up my borders, and kill my young men with the sword, and dash the sucking children against the ground, and make my infants as a prey, and my virgins as a spoil.
verses.text: He bragged that he would burn up my borders, and kill my young men with the sword, and dash the sucking children against the ground, and make my infants as a prey, and my virgins as a spoil.

verses.raw: But the Almighty Yahuah (God) has disappointed them by the hand of a woman.
verses.text: But the Almighty Yahuah has disappointed them by the hand of a woman.

verses.raw: For the mighty one did not fall by the young men, neither did the sons of the Titans smite him, nor high giants set upon him: but Judith the daughter of Merari weakened him with the beauty of her countenance.
verses.text: For the mighty one did not fall by the young men, neither did the sons of the Titans smite him, nor high giants set upon him: but Judith the daughter of Merari weakened him with the beauty of her countenance.

verses.raw: For she put off the garment of her widowhood for the exaltation of those that were oppressed in Yashar'el (Israel), and anointed her face with ointment, and bound her hair in a tire, and took a linen garment to deceive him.
verses.text: For she put off the garment of her widowhood for the exaltation of those that were oppressed in Yashar'el, and anointed her face with ointment, and bound her hair in a tire, and took a linen garment to deceive him.

verses.raw: Her sandals ravished his eyes, her beauty took his mind prisoner, and the fauchion passed through his neck.
verses.text: Her sandals ravished his eyes, her beauty took his mind prisoner, and the fauchion passed through his neck.

verses.raw: The Persians quaked at her boldness, and the Medes were daunted at her hardiness.
verses.text: The Persians quaked at her boldness, and the Medes were daunted at her hardiness.

verses.raw: Then my afflicted shouted for joy, and my weak ones cried aloud; but they were astonished: these lifted up their voices, but they were overthrown.
verses.text: Then my afflicted shouted for joy, and my weak ones cried aloud; but they were astonished: these lifted up their voices, but they were overthrown.

verses.raw: The sons of the damsels have pierced them through, and wounded them as fugatives’ children: they perished by the battle of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: The sons of the damsels have pierced them through, and wounded them as fugatives’ children: they perished by the battle of Yahuah.

verses.raw: I will sing to Yahuah (God) a new song: O Yahuah (God), you are great and glorious, wonderful in strength, and invincible.
verses.text: I will sing to Yahuah a new song: O Yahuah, you are great and glorious, wonderful in strength, and invincible.

verses.raw: Let all creatures serve you: for you spakest, and they were made, you did send forth your spirit, and it created them, and there is none that can resist your voice.
verses.text: Let all creatures serve you: for you spakest, and they were made, you did send forth your spirit, and it created them, and there is none that can resist your voice.

verses.raw: For the mountains shall be moved from their foundations with the waters, the rocks shall melt as wax at your presence: yet you are merciful to them that fear you.
verses.text: For the mountains shall be moved from their foundations with the waters, the rocks shall melt as wax at your presence: yet you are merciful to them that fear you.

verses.raw: For all sacrifice is too little for a sweet savour to you, and all the fat is not sufficient for your burnt offering: but he that fears Yahuah (God) is great at all times.
verses.text: For all sacrifice is too little for a sweet savour to you, and all the fat is not sufficient for your burnt offering: but he that fears Yahuah is great at all times.

verses.raw: Woe to the nations that rise up against my kindred! Yahuah (God) Almighty will take vengeance of them in the day of judgment, in putting fire and worms in their flesh; and they shall feel them, and weep for ever.
verses.text: Woe to the nations that rise up against my kindred! Yahuah Almighty will take vengeance of them in the day of judgment, in putting fire and worms in their flesh; and they shall feel them, and weep for ever.

verses.raw: Now as soon as they entered into Jerusalem, they worshipped Yahuah (God); and as soon as the people were purified, they offered their burnt offerings, and their free offerings, and their gifts.
verses.text: Now as soon as they entered into Jerusalem, they worshipped Yahuah; and as soon as the people were purified, they offered their burnt offerings, and their free offerings, and their gifts.

verses.raw: Judith also dedicated all the stuff of Holofernes, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy, which she had taken out of his bedchamber, for a gift to Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Judith also dedicated all the stuff of Holofernes, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy, which she had taken out of his bedchamber, for a gift to Yahuah.

verses.raw: So the people continued feasting in Jerusalem before the sanctuary for the space of three months and Judith remained with them.
verses.text: So the people continued feasting in Jerusalem before the sanctuary for the space of three months and Judith remained with them.

verses.raw: After this time every one returned to his own inheritance, and Judith went to Bethulia, and remained in her own possession, and was in her time honourable in all the country.
verses.text: After this time every one returned to his own inheritance, and Judith went to Bethulia, and remained in her own possession, and was in her time honourable in all the country.

verses.raw: And many desired her, but none knew her all the days of her life, after that Manasses her husband was dead, and was gathered to his people.
verses.text: And many desired her, but none knew her all the days of her life, after that Manasses her husband was dead, and was gathered to his people.

verses.raw: But she increased more and more in honour, and waxed old in her husband’s house, being an hundred and five years old, and made her maid free; so she died in Bethulia: and they buried her in the cave of her husband Manasses.
verses.text: But she increased more and more in honour, and waxed old in her husband’s house, being an hundred and five years old, and made her maid free; so she died in Bethulia: and they buried her in the cave of her husband Manasses.

verses.raw: And the house of Yashar'el (Israel) lamented her seven days: and before she died, she did distribute her goods to all them that were nearest of kindred to Manasses her husband, and to them that were the nearest of her kindred.
verses.text: And the house of Yashar'el lamented her seven days: and before she died, she did distribute her goods to all them that were nearest of kindred to Manasses her husband, and to them that were the nearest of her kindred.

verses.raw: And there was none that made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) any more afraid in the days of Judith, nor a long time after her death. ⸻
verses.text: And there was none that made the children of Yashar'el any more afraid in the days of Judith, nor a long time after her death. ⸻

verses.raw: 4 Then Mardocheus said, Yahuah (God) has done these things. 5 For I remember a dream which I saw concerning these matters, and nothing thereof has failed. 6 A little fountain became a river, and there was light, and the sun, and much water: this river is Esther, whom the king married, and made queen: 7 And the two dragons are I and Aman. 8 And the nations were those that were assembled to destroy the name of the Yahudim (Jews): 9 And my nation is this Yashar'el (Israel), which cried to Yahuah (God), and were saved: for Yahuah (God) has saved his people, and Yahuah (God) has delivered us from all those evils, and Yahuah (God) has wrought signs and great wonders, which have not been done among the Gentiles. 10 Therefore has he made two lots, one for the people of Yahuah (God), and another for all the Gentiles. 11 And these two lots came at the hour, and time, and day of judgment, before Yahuah (God) among all nations. 12 So Yahuah (God) remembered his people, and justified his inheritance. 13 Therefore those days shall be to them in the month Adar, the fourteenth and fifteenth day of the same month, with an assembly, and joy, and with gladness before Yahuah (God), according to the generations for ever among his people. ⸻
verses.text: 4 Then Mardocheus said, Yahuah has done these things. 5 For I remember a dream which I saw concerning these matters, and nothing thereof has failed. 6 A little fountain became a river, and there was light, and the sun, and much water: this river is Esther, whom the king married, and made queen: 7 And the two dragons are I and Aman. 8 And the nations were those that were assembled to destroy the name of the Yahudim: 9 And my nation is this Yashar'el, which cried to Yahuah, and were saved: for Yahuah has saved his people, and Yahuah has delivered us from all those evils, and Yahuah has wrought signs and great wonders, which have not been done among the Gentiles. 10 Therefore has he made two lots, one for the people of Yahuah, and another for all the Gentiles. 11 And these two lots came at the hour, and time, and day of judgment, before Yahuah among all nations. 12 So Yahuah remembered his people, and justified his inheritance. 13 Therefore those days shall be to them in the month Adar, the fourteenth and fifteenth day of the same month, with an assembly, and joy, and with gladness before Yahuah, according to the generations for ever among his people. ⸻

verses.raw: In the fourth year of the reign of Ptolemeus and Cleopatra, Dositheus, who said he was a priest and Levite, and Ptolemeus his son, brought this epistle of Phurim, which they said was the same, and that Lysimachus the son of Ptolemeus, that was in Jerusalem, had interpreted it. [PLACED IN THE GREEK BEFORE CHAP. 1.1 OF THE HEBREW]
verses.text: In the fourth year of the reign of Ptolemeus and Cleopatra, Dositheus, who said he was a priest and Levite, and Ptolemeus his son, brought this epistle of Phurim, which they said was the same, and that Lysimachus the son of Ptolemeus, that was in Jerusalem, had interpreted it. [PLACED IN THE GREEK BEFORE CHAP. 1.1 OF THE HEBREW]

verses.raw: In the second year of the reign of Artexerxes the great, in the first day of the month Nisan, Mardocheus the son of Jairus, the son of Semei, the son of Cisai, of the tribe of Benjamin, had a dream;
verses.text: In the second year of the reign of Artexerxes the great, in the first day of the month Nisan, Mardocheus the son of Jairus, the son of Semei, the son of Cisai, of the tribe of Benjamin, had a dream;

verses.raw: Who was a Yahudi (Jew), and dwelt in the city of Susa, a great man, being a servitor in the king’s court.
verses.text: Who was a Yahudi, and dwelt in the city of Susa, a great man, being a servitor in the king’s court.

verses.raw: He was also one of the captives, which Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon carried from Jerusalem with Jechonias king of Judea; and this was his dream:
verses.text: He was also one of the captives, which Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon carried from Jerusalem with Jechonias king of Judea; and this was his dream:

verses.raw: Behold a noise of a tumult, with thunder, and earthquakes, and uproar in the land:
verses.text: Behold a noise of a tumult, with thunder, and earthquakes, and uproar in the land:

verses.raw: And, behold, two great dragons came forth ready to fight, and their cry was great.
verses.text: And, behold, two great dragons came forth ready to fight, and their cry was great.

verses.raw: And at their cry all nations were prepared to battle, that they might fight against the righteous people.
verses.text: And at their cry all nations were prepared to battle, that they might fight against the righteous people.

verses.raw: And lo a day of darkness and obscurity, tribulation and anguish, affliction and great uproar, upon earth.
verses.text: And lo a day of darkness and obscurity, tribulation and anguish, affliction and great uproar, upon earth.

verses.raw: And the whole righteous nation was troubled, fearing their own evils, and were ready to perish.
verses.text: And the whole righteous nation was troubled, fearing their own evils, and were ready to perish.

verses.raw: Then they cried to Yahuah (God), and upon their cry, as it were from a little fountain, was made a great flood, even much water.
verses.text: Then they cried to Yahuah, and upon their cry, as it were from a little fountain, was made a great flood, even much water.

verses.raw: The light and the sun rose up, and the lowly were exalted, and devoured the glorious.
verses.text: The light and the sun rose up, and the lowly were exalted, and devoured the glorious.

verses.raw: Now when Mardocheus, who had seen this dream, and what Yahuah (God) had determined to do, was awake, he bare this dream in mind, and until night by all means was desirous to know it. ⸻
verses.text: Now when Mardocheus, who had seen this dream, and what Yahuah had determined to do, was awake, he bare this dream in mind, and until night by all means was desirous to know it. ⸻

verses.raw: And Mardocheus took his rest in the court with Gabatha and Tharra, the two eunuchs of the king, and keepers of the palace.
verses.text: And Mardocheus took his rest in the court with Gabatha and Tharra, the two eunuchs of the king, and keepers of the palace.

verses.raw: And he heard their devices, and searched out their purposes, and learned that they were about to lay hands upon Artexerxes the king; and so he certified the king of them.
verses.text: And he heard their devices, and searched out their purposes, and learned that they were about to lay hands upon Artexerxes the king; and so he certified the king of them.

verses.raw: Then the king examined the two eunuchs, and after that they had confessed it, they were strangled.
verses.text: Then the king examined the two eunuchs, and after that they had confessed it, they were strangled.

verses.raw: And the king made a record of these things, and Mardocheus also wrote thereof.
verses.text: And the king made a record of these things, and Mardocheus also wrote thereof.

verses.raw: So the king commanded, Mardocheus to serve in the court, and for this he rewarded him.
verses.text: So the king commanded, Mardocheus to serve in the court, and for this he rewarded him.

verses.raw: Howbeit Aman the son of Amadathus the Agagite, who was in great honour with the king, sought to molest Mardocheus and his people because of the two eunuchs of the king. ⸻
verses.text: Howbeit Aman the son of Amadathus the Agagite, who was in great honour with the king, sought to molest Mardocheus and his people because of the two eunuchs of the king. ⸻

verses.raw: The copy of the letters was this: The great king Artexerxes writeth these things to the princes and governours that are under him from India to Ethiopia in an hundred and seven and twenty provinces.
verses.text: The copy of the letters was this: The great king Artexerxes writeth these things to the princes and governours that are under him from India to Ethiopia in an hundred and seven and twenty provinces.

verses.raw: After that I became lord over many nations and had dominion over the whole world, not lifted up with presumption of my authority, but carrying myself always with equity and mildness, I purposed to settle my subjects continually in a quiet life, and making my kingdom peaceable, and open for passage to the utmost coasts, to renew peace, which is desired of all men.
verses.text: After that I became lord over many nations and had dominion over the whole world, not lifted up with presumption of my authority, but carrying myself always with equity and mildness, I purposed to settle my subjects continually in a quiet life, and making my kingdom peaceable, and open for passage to the utmost coasts, to renew peace, which is desired of all men.

verses.raw: Now when I asked my counsellors how this might be brought to pass, Aman, that excelled in wisdom among us, and was approved for his constant good will and steadfast fidelity, and had the honour of the second place in the kingdom,
verses.text: Now when I asked my counsellors how this might be brought to pass, Aman, that excelled in wisdom among us, and was approved for his constant good will and steadfast fidelity, and had the honour of the second place in the kingdom,

verses.raw: Declared to us, that in all nations throughout the world there was scattered a certain malicious people, that had laws contrary to all nations, and continually despised the commandments of kings, so as the uniting of our kingdoms, honourably intended by us cannot go forward.
verses.text: Declared to us, that in all nations throughout the world there was scattered a certain malicious people, that had laws contrary to all nations, and continually despised the commandments of kings, so as the uniting of our kingdoms, honourably intended by us cannot go forward.

verses.raw: Seeing then we understand that this people alone is continually in opposition to all men, differing in the strange manner of their laws, and evil affected to our state, working all the mischief they can that our kingdom may not be firmly established:
verses.text: Seeing then we understand that this people alone is continually in opposition to all men, differing in the strange manner of their laws, and evil affected to our state, working all the mischief they can that our kingdom may not be firmly established:

verses.raw: Therefore have we commanded, that all they that are signified in writing to you by Aman, who is ordained over the affairs, and is next to us, shall all, with their wives and children, be utterly destroyed by the sword of their enemies, without all mercy and pity, the fourteenth day of the twelfth month Adar of this present year:
verses.text: Therefore have we commanded, that all they that are signified in writing to you by Aman, who is ordained over the affairs, and is next to us, shall all, with their wives and children, be utterly destroyed by the sword of their enemies, without all mercy and pity, the fourteenth day of the twelfth month Adar of this present year:

verses.raw: That they, who of old and now also are malicious, may in one day with violence go into the grave, and so ever hereafter cause our affairs to be well settled, and without trouble. [PLACED IN THE GREEK AFTER CHAP. 4.17 OF THE HEBREW]
verses.text: That they, who of old and now also are malicious, may in one day with violence go into the grave, and so ever hereafter cause our affairs to be well settled, and without trouble. [PLACED IN THE GREEK AFTER CHAP. 4.17 OF THE HEBREW]

verses.raw: Then Mardocheus thought upon all the works of Yahuah (God), and made his prayer to him,
verses.text: Then Mardocheus thought upon all the works of Yahuah, and made his prayer to him,

verses.raw: Saying, O Yahuah (God), Yahuah (God), the King Almighty: for the whole world is in your power, and if you have appointed to save Yashar'el (Israel), there is no man that can gainsay you:
verses.text: Saying, O Yahuah, Yahuah, the King Almighty: for the whole world is in your power, and if you have appointed to save Yashar'el, there is no man that can gainsay you:

verses.raw: For you have made heaven and earth, and all the wondrous things under the heaven.
verses.text: For you have made heaven and earth, and all the wondrous things under the heaven.

verses.raw: You are Yahuah (God) of all things, and there is no man that can resist you, which are Yahuah (God).
verses.text: You are Yahuah of all things, and there is no man that can resist you, which are Yahuah.

verses.raw: You know all things, and you know, Yahuah (God), that it was neither in contempt nor pride, nor for any desire of glory, that I did not bow down to proud Aman.
verses.text: You know all things, and you know, Yahuah, that it was neither in contempt nor pride, nor for any desire of glory, that I did not bow down to proud Aman.

verses.raw: For I could have been content with good will for the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) to kiss the soles of his feet.
verses.text: For I could have been content with good will for the salvation of Yashar'el to kiss the soles of his feet.

verses.raw: But I did this, that I might not prefer the glory of man above the glory of Yahuah (God): neither will I worship any but you, O Yahuah (God), neither will I do it in pride.
verses.text: But I did this, that I might not prefer the glory of man above the glory of Yahuah: neither will I worship any but you, O Yahuah, neither will I do it in pride.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah (God) and King, spare your people: for their eyes are upon us to bring us to nought; yes, they desire to destroy the inheritance, that has been yours from the beginning.
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah and King, spare your people: for their eyes are upon us to bring us to nought; yes, they desire to destroy the inheritance, that has been yours from the beginning.

verses.raw: Despise not the portion, which you have delivered out of Egypt for your own self.
verses.text: Despise not the portion, which you have delivered out of Egypt for your own self.

verses.raw: Hear my prayer, and be merciful to your inheritance: turn our sorrow into joy, that we may live, O Yahuah (God), and praise your name: and destroy not the mouths of them that praise you, O Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Hear my prayer, and be merciful to your inheritance: turn our sorrow into joy, that we may live, O Yahuah, and praise your name: and destroy not the mouths of them that praise you, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: All Yashar'el (Israel) in like manner cried most earnestly to Yahuah (God), because their death was before their eyes. ⸻
verses.text: All Yashar'el in like manner cried most earnestly to Yahuah, because their death was before their eyes. ⸻

verses.raw: Queen Esther also, being in fear of death, resorted to Yahuah (God):
verses.text: Queen Esther also, being in fear of death, resorted to Yahuah:

verses.raw: And laid away her glorious apparel, and put on the garments of anguish and mourning: and instead of precious ointments, she covered her head with ashes and dung, and she humbled her body greatly, and all the places of her joy she filled with her torn hair.
verses.text: And laid away her glorious apparel, and put on the garments of anguish and mourning: and instead of precious ointments, she covered her head with ashes and dung, and she humbled her body greatly, and all the places of her joy she filled with her torn hair.

verses.raw: And she prayed to Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, O my Elohim (God), you only art our King: help me, desolate woman, which have no helper but you:
verses.text: And she prayed to Yahuah of Yashar'el, saying, O my Elohim, you only art our King: help me, desolate woman, which have no helper but you:

verses.raw: For my danger is in my hand.
verses.text: For my danger is in my hand.

verses.raw: From my youth up I have heard in the tribe of my family that you, O Yahuah (God), tookest Yashar'el (Israel) from among all people, and our fathers from all their predecessors, for a perpetual inheritance, and you have performed whatsoever you did promise them.
verses.text: From my youth up I have heard in the tribe of my family that you, O Yahuah, tookest Yashar'el from among all people, and our fathers from all their predecessors, for a perpetual inheritance, and you have performed whatsoever you did promise them.

verses.raw: And now we have sinned before you: therefore have you given us into the hands of our enemies,
verses.text: And now we have sinned before you: therefore have you given us into the hands of our enemies,

verses.raw: Because we worshipped their gods: O Yahuah (God), you are righteous.
verses.text: Because we worshipped their gods: O Yahuah, you are righteous.

verses.raw: Nevertheless it satisfies them not, that we are in bitter captivity: but they have stricken hands with their idols,
verses.text: Nevertheless it satisfies them not, that we are in bitter captivity: but they have stricken hands with their idols,

verses.raw: That they will abolish the thing that you with your mouth have ordained, and destroy your inheritance, and stop the mouth of them that praise you, and quench the glory of your house, and of your altar,
verses.text: That they will abolish the thing that you with your mouth have ordained, and destroy your inheritance, and stop the mouth of them that praise you, and quench the glory of your house, and of your altar,

verses.raw: And open the mouths of the heathen to set forth the praises of the idols, and to magnify a fleshly king for ever.
verses.text: And open the mouths of the heathen to set forth the praises of the idols, and to magnify a fleshly king for ever.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), give not your sceptre to them that be nothing, and let them not laugh at our fall; but turn their device upon themselves, and make him an example, that has begun this against us.
verses.text: O Yahuah, give not your sceptre to them that be nothing, and let them not laugh at our fall; but turn their device upon themselves, and make him an example, that has begun this against us.

verses.raw: Remember, O Yahuah (God), make thyself known in time of our affliction, and give me boldness, O King of the nations, and Yahuah (God) of all power.
verses.text: Remember, O Yahuah, make thyself known in time of our affliction, and give me boldness, O King of the nations, and Yahuah of all power.

verses.raw: Give me eloquent speech in my mouth before the lion: turn his heart to hate him that fighteth against us, that there may be an end of him, and of all that are likeminded to him:
verses.text: Give me eloquent speech in my mouth before the lion: turn his heart to hate him that fighteth against us, that there may be an end of him, and of all that are likeminded to him:

verses.raw: But deliver us with yours hand, and help me that am desolate, and which have no other help but you.
verses.text: But deliver us with yours hand, and help me that am desolate, and which have no other help but you.

verses.raw: You know all things, O Yahuah (God); you know that I hate the glory of the unrighteous, and abhor the bed of the uncircumcised, and of all the heathen.
verses.text: You know all things, O Yahuah; you know that I hate the glory of the unrighteous, and abhor the bed of the uncircumcised, and of all the heathen.

verses.raw: You know my necessity: for I abhor the sign of my high estate, which is upon my head in the days in which I shew myself, and that I abhor it as a menstruous rag, and that I wear it not when I am private by myself.
verses.text: You know my necessity: for I abhor the sign of my high estate, which is upon my head in the days in which I shew myself, and that I abhor it as a menstruous rag, and that I wear it not when I am private by myself.

verses.raw: And that yours handmaid has not eaten at Aman’s table, and that I have not greatly esteemed the king’s feast, nor drunk the wine of the drink offerings.
verses.text: And that yours handmaid has not eaten at Aman’s table, and that I have not greatly esteemed the king’s feast, nor drunk the wine of the drink offerings.

verses.raw: Neither had yours handmaid any joy since the day that I was brought hither to this present, but in you, O Yahuah (God) of Abraham.
verses.text: Neither had yours handmaid any joy since the day that I was brought hither to this present, but in you, O Yahuah of Abraham.

verses.raw: O you mighty Yahuah (God) above all, hear the voice of the forlorn and deliver us out of the hands of the mischievous, and deliver me out of my fear. ⸻
verses.text: O you mighty Yahuah above all, hear the voice of the forlorn and deliver us out of the hands of the mischievous, and deliver me out of my fear. ⸻

verses.raw: And upon the third day, when she had ended her prayers, she laid away her mourning garments, and put on her glorious apparel.
verses.text: And upon the third day, when she had ended her prayers, she laid away her mourning garments, and put on her glorious apparel.

verses.raw: And being gloriously adorned, after she had called upon Yahuah (God), who is the beholder and saviour of all things, she took two maids with her:
verses.text: And being gloriously adorned, after she had called upon Yahuah, who is the beholder and saviour of all things, she took two maids with her:

verses.raw: And upon the one she leaned, as carrying herself daintily;
verses.text: And upon the one she leaned, as carrying herself daintily;

verses.raw: And the other followed, bearing up her train.
verses.text: And the other followed, bearing up her train.

verses.raw: And she was ruddy through the perfection of her beauty, and her countenance was cheerful and very amiable: but her heart was in anguish for fear.
verses.text: And she was ruddy through the perfection of her beauty, and her countenance was cheerful and very amiable: but her heart was in anguish for fear.

verses.raw: Then having passed through all the doors, she stood before the king, who sat upon his royal throne, and was clothed with all his robes of majesty, all glittering with gold and precious stones; and he was very dreadful.
verses.text: Then having passed through all the doors, she stood before the king, who sat upon his royal throne, and was clothed with all his robes of majesty, all glittering with gold and precious stones; and he was very dreadful.

verses.raw: Then lifting up his countenance that shone with majesty, he looked very fiercely upon her: and the queen fell down, and was pale, and fainted, and bowed herself upon the head of the maid that went before her.
verses.text: Then lifting up his countenance that shone with majesty, he looked very fiercely upon her: and the queen fell down, and was pale, and fainted, and bowed herself upon the head of the maid that went before her.

verses.raw: Then Yahuah (God) changed the spirit of the king into mildness, who in a fear leaped from his throne, and took her in his arms, till she came to herself again, and comforted her with loving words and said to her,
