verses.text: Then Yahuah changed the spirit of the king into mildness, who in a fear leaped from his throne, and took her in his arms, till she came to herself again, and comforted her with loving words and said to her,

verses.raw: Esther, what is the matter? I am your brother, be of good cheer:
verses.text: Esther, what is the matter? I am your brother, be of good cheer:

verses.raw: You shall not die, though our commandment be general: come near.
verses.text: You shall not die, though our commandment be general: come near.

verses.raw: And so he held up his golden sceptre, and laid it upon her neck,
verses.text: And so he held up his golden sceptre, and laid it upon her neck,

verses.raw: And embraced her, and said, Speak to me.
verses.text: And embraced her, and said, Speak to me.

verses.raw: Then said she to him, I saw you, my lord, as an angel of Yahuah (God), and my heart was troubled for fear of your majesty.
verses.text: Then said she to him, I saw you, my lord, as an angel of Yahuah, and my heart was troubled for fear of your majesty.

verses.raw: For wonderful art you, lord, and your countenance is full of grace.
verses.text: For wonderful art you, lord, and your countenance is full of grace.

verses.raw: And as she was speaking, she fell down for faintness.
verses.text: And as she was speaking, she fell down for faintness.

verses.raw: Then the king was troubled, and all his servants comforted her. ⸻
verses.text: Then the king was troubled, and all his servants comforted her. ⸻

verses.raw: The great king Artexerxes to the princes and governors of an hundred and seven and twenty provinces from India to Ethiopia, and to all our faithful subjects, greeting.
verses.text: The great king Artexerxes to the princes and governors of an hundred and seven and twenty provinces from India to Ethiopia, and to all our faithful subjects, greeting.

verses.raw: Many, the more often they are honoured with the great bounty of their gracious princes, the more proud they are waxen,
verses.text: Many, the more often they are honoured with the great bounty of their gracious princes, the more proud they are waxen,

verses.raw: And endeavour to hurt not our subjects only, but not being able to bear abundance, do take in hand to practise also against those that do them good:
verses.text: And endeavour to hurt not our subjects only, but not being able to bear abundance, do take in hand to practise also against those that do them good:

verses.raw: And take not only thankfulness away from among men, but also lifted up with the glorious words of lewd persons, that were never good, they think to escape the justice of Yahuah (God), that seeth all things and hates evil.
verses.text: And take not only thankfulness away from among men, but also lifted up with the glorious words of lewd persons, that were never good, they think to escape the justice of Yahuah, that seeth all things and hates evil.

verses.raw: Often also fair speech of those, that are put in trust to manage their friends’ affairs, has caused many that are in authority to be partakers of innocent blood, and has enwrapped them in remediless calamities:
verses.text: Often also fair speech of those, that are put in trust to manage their friends’ affairs, has caused many that are in authority to be partakers of innocent blood, and has enwrapped them in remediless calamities:

verses.raw: Beguiling with the falsehood and deceit of their lewd disposition the innocency and goodness of princes.
verses.text: Beguiling with the falsehood and deceit of their lewd disposition the innocency and goodness of princes.

verses.raw: Now you may see this, as we have declared, not so much by ancient histories, as you may, if you search what has been wickedly done of late through the pestilent behaviour of them that are unworthily placed in authority.
verses.text: Now you may see this, as we have declared, not so much by ancient histories, as you may, if you search what has been wickedly done of late through the pestilent behaviour of them that are unworthily placed in authority.

verses.raw: And we must take care for the time to come, that our kingdom may be quiet and peaceable for all men,
verses.text: And we must take care for the time to come, that our kingdom may be quiet and peaceable for all men,

verses.raw: Both by changing our purposes, and always judging things that are evident with more equal proceeding.
verses.text: Both by changing our purposes, and always judging things that are evident with more equal proceeding.

verses.raw: For Aman, a Macedonian, the son of Amadatha, being indeed a stranger from the Persian blood, and far distant from our goodness, and as a stranger received of us,
verses.text: For Aman, a Macedonian, the son of Amadatha, being indeed a stranger from the Persian blood, and far distant from our goodness, and as a stranger received of us,

verses.raw: Had so far forth obtained the favour that we shew toward every nation, as that he was called our father, and was continually honoured of all the next person to the king.
verses.text: Had so far forth obtained the favour that we shew toward every nation, as that he was called our father, and was continually honoured of all the next person to the king.

verses.raw: But he, not bearing his great dignity, went about to deprive us of our kingdom and life:
verses.text: But he, not bearing his great dignity, went about to deprive us of our kingdom and life:

verses.raw: Having by manifold and cunning deceits sought of us the destruction, as well of Mardocheus, who saved our life, and continually procured our good, as also of blameless Esther, partaker of our kingdom, with their whole nation.
verses.text: Having by manifold and cunning deceits sought of us the destruction, as well of Mardocheus, who saved our life, and continually procured our good, as also of blameless Esther, partaker of our kingdom, with their whole nation.

verses.raw: For by these means he thought, finding us destitute of friends, to have translated the kingdom of the Persians to the Macedonians.
verses.text: For by these means he thought, finding us destitute of friends, to have translated the kingdom of the Persians to the Macedonians.

verses.raw: But we find that the Yahudim (Jews), whom this wicked wretch has delivered to utter destruction, are no evildoers, but live by most just laws:
verses.text: But we find that the Yahudim, whom this wicked wretch has delivered to utter destruction, are no evildoers, but live by most just laws:

verses.raw: And that they be children of the most high and most mighty, living Yahuah (God), who has ordered the kingdom both to us and to our progenitors in the most excellent manner.
verses.text: And that they be children of the most high and most mighty, living Yahuah, who has ordered the kingdom both to us and to our progenitors in the most excellent manner.

verses.raw: Wherefore you shall do well not to put in execution the letters sent to you by Aman the son of Amadatha.
verses.text: Wherefore you shall do well not to put in execution the letters sent to you by Aman the son of Amadatha.

verses.raw: For he that was the worker of these things, is hanged at the gates of Susa with all his family: Yahuah (God), who ruleth all things, speedily rendering vengeance to him according to his deserts.
verses.text: For he that was the worker of these things, is hanged at the gates of Susa with all his family: Yahuah, who ruleth all things, speedily rendering vengeance to him according to his deserts.

verses.raw: Therefore you shall publish the copy of this letter in all places, that the Yahudim (Jews) may freely live after their own laws.
verses.text: Therefore you shall publish the copy of this letter in all places, that the Yahudim may freely live after their own laws.

verses.raw: And you shall aid them, that even the same day, being the thirteenth day of the twelfth month Adar, they may be avenged on them, who in the time of their affliction shall set upon them.
verses.text: And you shall aid them, that even the same day, being the thirteenth day of the twelfth month Adar, they may be avenged on them, who in the time of their affliction shall set upon them.

verses.raw: For Almighty Yahuah (God) has turned to joy to them the day, in which the chosen people should have perished.
verses.text: For Almighty Yahuah has turned to joy to them the day, in which the chosen people should have perished.

verses.raw: You shall therefore among your solemn feasts keep it an high day with all feasting:
verses.text: You shall therefore among your solemn feasts keep it an high day with all feasting:

verses.raw: That both now and hereafter there may be safety to us and the well affected Persians; but to those which do conspire against us a memorial of destruction.
verses.text: That both now and hereafter there may be safety to us and the well affected Persians; but to those which do conspire against us a memorial of destruction.

verses.raw: Therefore every city and country whatsoever, which shall not do according to these things, shall be destroyed without mercy with fire and sword, and shall be made not only unpassable for men, but also most hateful to wild beasts and fowls for ever. ⸻
verses.text: Therefore every city and country whatsoever, which shall not do according to these things, shall be destroyed without mercy with fire and sword, and shall be made not only unpassable for men, but also most hateful to wild beasts and fowls for ever. ⸻

verses.raw: Love righteousness, you that be judges of the earth: think of Yahuah (God) with a good (heart,) and in simplicity of heart seek him.
verses.text: Love righteousness, you that be judges of the earth: think of Yahuah with a good (heart,) and in simplicity of heart seek him.

verses.raw: For he will be found of them that tempt him not; and sheweth himself to such as do not distrust him.
verses.text: For he will be found of them that tempt him not; and sheweth himself to such as do not distrust him.

verses.raw: For froward thoughts separate from Yahuah (God): and his power, when it is tried, reproveth the unwise.
verses.text: For froward thoughts separate from Yahuah: and his power, when it is tried, reproveth the unwise.

verses.raw: For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject to sin.
verses.text: For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject to sin.

verses.raw: For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness comes in.
verses.text: For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness comes in.

verses.raw: For wisdom is a loving spirit; and will not acquit a blasphemer of his words: for Yahuah (God) is witness of his reins, and a true beholder of his heart, and a hearer of his tongue.
verses.text: For wisdom is a loving spirit; and will not acquit a blasphemer of his words: for Yahuah is witness of his reins, and a true beholder of his heart, and a hearer of his tongue.

verses.raw: For the Spirit of Yahuah (God) filleth the world: and that which containeth all things has knowledge of the voice.
verses.text: For the Spirit of Yahuah filleth the world: and that which containeth all things has knowledge of the voice.

verses.raw: Therefore he that speaks unrighteous things cannot be hid: neither shall vengeance, when it punishes, pass by him.
verses.text: Therefore he that speaks unrighteous things cannot be hid: neither shall vengeance, when it punishes, pass by him.

verses.raw: For inquisition shall be made into the counsels of the ungodly: and the sound of his words shall come to Yahuah (God) for the manifestation of his wicked deeds.
verses.text: For inquisition shall be made into the counsels of the ungodly: and the sound of his words shall come to Yahuah for the manifestation of his wicked deeds.

verses.raw: For the ear of jealousy heareth all things: and the noise of murmurings is not hid.
verses.text: For the ear of jealousy heareth all things: and the noise of murmurings is not hid.

verses.raw: Therefore beware of murmuring, which is unprofitable; and refrain your tongue from backbiting: for there is no word so secret, that shall go for nought: and the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.
verses.text: Therefore beware of murmuring, which is unprofitable; and refrain your tongue from backbiting: for there is no word so secret, that shall go for nought: and the mouth that belieth slayeth the soul.

verses.raw: Seek not death in the error of your life: and pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your hands.
verses.text: Seek not death in the error of your life: and pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your hands.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) made not death: neither has he pleasure in the destruction of the living.
verses.text: For Yahuah made not death: neither has he pleasure in the destruction of the living.

verses.raw: For he created all things, that they might have their being: and the generations of the world were healthful; and there is no poison of destruction in them, nor the kingdom of death upon the earth:
verses.text: For he created all things, that they might have their being: and the generations of the world were healthful; and there is no poison of destruction in them, nor the kingdom of death upon the earth:

verses.raw: (For righteousness is immortal:)
verses.text: (For righteousness is immortal:)

verses.raw: But ungodly men with their works and words called it to them: for when they thought to have it their friend, they consumed to nought, and made a covenant with it, because they are worthy to take part with it. ⸻
verses.text: But ungodly men with their works and words called it to them: for when they thought to have it their friend, they consumed to nought, and made a covenant with it, because they are worthy to take part with it. ⸻

verses.raw: For the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright, Our life is short and tedious, and in the death of a man there is no remedy: neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave.
verses.text: For the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright, Our life is short and tedious, and in the death of a man there is no remedy: neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave.

verses.raw: For we are born at all adventure: and we shall be hereafter as though we had never been: for the breath in our nostrils is as smoke, and a little spark in the moving of our heart:
verses.text: For we are born at all adventure: and we shall be hereafter as though we had never been: for the breath in our nostrils is as smoke, and a little spark in the moving of our heart:

verses.raw: Which being extinguished, our body shall be turned into ashes, and our spirit shall vanish as the soft air,
verses.text: Which being extinguished, our body shall be turned into ashes, and our spirit shall vanish as the soft air,

verses.raw: And our name shall be forgotten in time, and no man shall have our works in remembrance, and our life shall pass away as the trace of a cloud, and shall be dispersed as a mist, that is driven away with the beams of the sun, and overcome with the heat thereof.
verses.text: And our name shall be forgotten in time, and no man shall have our works in remembrance, and our life shall pass away as the trace of a cloud, and shall be dispersed as a mist, that is driven away with the beams of the sun, and overcome with the heat thereof.

verses.raw: For our time is a very shadow that passeth away; and after our end there is no returning: for it is fast sealed, so that no man comes again.
verses.text: For our time is a very shadow that passeth away; and after our end there is no returning: for it is fast sealed, so that no man comes again.

verses.raw: Come on therefore, let us enjoy the good things that are present: and let us speedily use the creatures like as in youth.
verses.text: Come on therefore, let us enjoy the good things that are present: and let us speedily use the creatures like as in youth.

verses.raw: Let us fill ourselves with costly wine and ointments: and let no flower of the spring pass by us:
verses.text: Let us fill ourselves with costly wine and ointments: and let no flower of the spring pass by us:

verses.raw: Let us crown ourselves with rosebuds, before they be withered:
verses.text: Let us crown ourselves with rosebuds, before they be withered:

verses.raw: Let none of us go without his part of our voluptuousness: let us leave tokens of our joyfulness in every place: for this is our portion, and our lot is this.
verses.text: Let none of us go without his part of our voluptuousness: let us leave tokens of our joyfulness in every place: for this is our portion, and our lot is this.

verses.raw: Let us oppress the poor righteous man, let us not spare the widow, nor reverence the ancient gray hairs of the aged.
verses.text: Let us oppress the poor righteous man, let us not spare the widow, nor reverence the ancient gray hairs of the aged.

verses.raw: Let our strength be the law of justice: for that which is feeble is found to be nothing worth.
verses.text: Let our strength be the law of justice: for that which is feeble is found to be nothing worth.

verses.raw: Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous; because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings: he upbraideth us with our offending the law, and objecteth to our infamy the transgressings of our education.
verses.text: Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous; because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings: he upbraideth us with our offending the law, and objecteth to our infamy the transgressings of our education.

verses.raw: He professeth to have the knowledge of Yahuah (God): and he calls himself the child of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: He professeth to have the knowledge of Yahuah: and he calls himself the child of Yahuah.

verses.raw: He was made to reprove our thoughts.
verses.text: He was made to reprove our thoughts.

verses.raw: He is grievous to us even to behold: for his life is not like other men’s, his ways are of another fashion.
verses.text: He is grievous to us even to behold: for his life is not like other men’s, his ways are of another fashion.

verses.raw: We are esteemed of him as counterfeits: he abstaineth from our ways as from filthiness: he pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed, and makes his boast that Yahuah (God) is his father.
verses.text: We are esteemed of him as counterfeits: he abstaineth from our ways as from filthiness: he pronounceth the end of the just to be blessed, and makes his boast that Yahuah is his father.

verses.raw: Let us see if his words be true: and let us prove what shall happen in the end of him.
verses.text: Let us see if his words be true: and let us prove what shall happen in the end of him.

verses.raw: For if the just man be the son of Yahuah (God), he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.
verses.text: For if the just man be the son of Yahuah, he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies.

verses.raw: Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.
verses.text: Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience.

verses.raw: Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected.
verses.text: Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected.

verses.raw: Such things they did imagine, and were deceived: for their own wickedness has blinded them.
verses.text: Such things they did imagine, and were deceived: for their own wickedness has blinded them.

verses.raw: As for the mysteries of Yahuah (God), they knew them not: neither hoped they for the wages of righteousness, nor discerned a reward for blameless souls.
verses.text: As for the mysteries of Yahuah, they knew them not: neither hoped they for the wages of righteousness, nor discerned a reward for blameless souls.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity.
verses.text: For Yahuah created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity.

verses.raw: Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it. ⸻
verses.text: Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it. ⸻

verses.raw: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.
verses.text: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah, and there shall no torment touch them.

verses.raw: In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,
verses.text: In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,

verses.raw: And their going from us to be utter destruction: but they are in peace.
verses.text: And their going from us to be utter destruction: but they are in peace.

verses.raw: For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.
verses.text: For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.

verses.raw: And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah (God) proved them, and found them worthy for himself.
verses.text: And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for Yahuah proved them, and found them worthy for himself.

verses.raw: As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering.
verses.text: As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering.

verses.raw: And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.
verses.text: And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.

verses.raw: They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Elohim (God) shall reign for ever.
verses.text: They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Elohim shall reign for ever.

verses.raw: They that put their trust in him shall understand the truth: and such as be faithful in love shall abide with him: for grace and mercy is to his saints, and he has care for his elect.
verses.text: They that put their trust in him shall understand the truth: and such as be faithful in love shall abide with him: for grace and mercy is to his saints, and he has care for his elect.

verses.raw: But the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous, and forsaken Yahuah (God).
verses.text: But the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous, and forsaken Yahuah.

verses.raw: For whoso despiseth wisdom and nurture, he is miserable, and their hope is vain, their labours unfruitful, and their works unprofitable:
verses.text: For whoso despiseth wisdom and nurture, he is miserable, and their hope is vain, their labours unfruitful, and their works unprofitable:

verses.raw: Their wives are foolish, and their children wicked:
verses.text: Their wives are foolish, and their children wicked:

verses.raw: Their offspring is cursed. Wherefore blessed is the barren that is undefiled, which has not known the sinful bed: she shall have fruit in the visitation of souls.
verses.text: Their offspring is cursed. Wherefore blessed is the barren that is undefiled, which has not known the sinful bed: she shall have fruit in the visitation of souls.

verses.raw: And blessed is the eunuch, which with his hands has wrought no iniquity, nor imagined wicked things against Yahuah (God): for to him shall be given the special gift of faith, and an inheritance in the temple of Yahuah (God) more acceptable to his mind.
verses.text: And blessed is the eunuch, which with his hands has wrought no iniquity, nor imagined wicked things against Yahuah: for to him shall be given the special gift of faith, and an inheritance in the temple of Yahuah more acceptable to his mind.

verses.raw: For glorious is the fruit of good labours: and the root of wisdom shall never fall away.
verses.text: For glorious is the fruit of good labours: and the root of wisdom shall never fall away.

verses.raw: As for the children of adulterers, they shall not come to their perfection, and the seed of an unrighteous bed shall be rooted out.
verses.text: As for the children of adulterers, they shall not come to their perfection, and the seed of an unrighteous bed shall be rooted out.

verses.raw: For though they live long, yet shall they be nothing regarded: and their last age shall be without honour.
verses.text: For though they live long, yet shall they be nothing regarded: and their last age shall be without honour.

verses.raw: Or, if they die quickly, they have no hope, neither comfort in the day of trial.
verses.text: Or, if they die quickly, they have no hope, neither comfort in the day of trial.

verses.raw: For horrible is the end of the unrighteous generation. ⸻
verses.text: For horrible is the end of the unrighteous generation. ⸻

verses.raw: Better it is to have no children, and to have virtue: for the memorial thereof is immortal: because it is known with Yahuah (God), and with men.
verses.text: Better it is to have no children, and to have virtue: for the memorial thereof is immortal: because it is known with Yahuah, and with men.

verses.raw: When it is present, men take example at it; and when it is gone, they desire it: it wears a crown, and triumpheth for ever, having gotten the victory, striving for undefiled rewards.
verses.text: When it is present, men take example at it; and when it is gone, they desire it: it wears a crown, and triumpheth for ever, having gotten the victory, striving for undefiled rewards.

verses.raw: But the multiplying brood of the ungodly shall not thrive, nor take deep rooting from bastard slips, nor lay any fast foundation.
verses.text: But the multiplying brood of the ungodly shall not thrive, nor take deep rooting from bastard slips, nor lay any fast foundation.

verses.raw: For though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out.
verses.text: For though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out.

verses.raw: The imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing.
verses.text: The imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing.

verses.raw: For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial.
verses.text: For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial.

verses.raw: But though the righteous be prevented with death, yet shall he be in rest.
verses.text: But though the righteous be prevented with death, yet shall he be in rest.

verses.raw: For honourable age is not that which stands in length of time, nor that is measured by number of years.
verses.text: For honourable age is not that which stands in length of time, nor that is measured by number of years.

verses.raw: But wisdom is the gray hair to men, and an unspotted life is old age.
verses.text: But wisdom is the gray hair to men, and an unspotted life is old age.

verses.raw: He pleased Yahuah (God), and was beloved of him: so that living among sinners he was translated.
verses.text: He pleased Yahuah, and was beloved of him: so that living among sinners he was translated.

verses.raw: Yea speedily was he taken away, lest that wickedness should alter his understanding, or deceit beguile his soul.
verses.text: Yea speedily was he taken away, lest that wickedness should alter his understanding, or deceit beguile his soul.

verses.raw: For the bewitching of naughtiness does obscure things that are honest; and the wandering of concupiscence does undermine the simple mind.
verses.text: For the bewitching of naughtiness does obscure things that are honest; and the wandering of concupiscence does undermine the simple mind.

verses.raw: He, being made perfect in a short time, fulfilled a long time:
verses.text: He, being made perfect in a short time, fulfilled a long time:

verses.raw: For his soul pleased Yahuah (God): therefore hasted he to take him away from among the wicked.
verses.text: For his soul pleased Yahuah: therefore hasted he to take him away from among the wicked.

verses.raw: This the people saw, and understood it not, neither laid they up this in their minds, That his grace and mercy is with his saints, and that he has respect to his chosen.
verses.text: This the people saw, and understood it not, neither laid they up this in their minds, That his grace and mercy is with his saints, and that he has respect to his chosen.

verses.raw: Thus the righteous that is dead shall condemn the ungodly which are living; and youth that is soon perfected the many years and old age of the unrighteous.
verses.text: Thus the righteous that is dead shall condemn the ungodly which are living; and youth that is soon perfected the many years and old age of the unrighteous.

verses.raw: For they shall see the end of the wise, and shall not understand what Yahuah (God) in his counsel has decreed of him, and to what end Yahuah (God) has set him in safety.
verses.text: For they shall see the end of the wise, and shall not understand what Yahuah in his counsel has decreed of him, and to what end Yahuah has set him in safety.

verses.raw: They shall see him, and despise him; but Yahuah (God) shall laugh them to scorn: and they shall hereafter be a vile carcase, and a reproach among the dead for evermore.
verses.text: They shall see him, and despise him; but Yahuah shall laugh them to scorn: and they shall hereafter be a vile carcase, and a reproach among the dead for evermore.

verses.raw: For he shall rend them, and cast them down headlong, that they shall be speechless; and he shall shake them from the foundation; and they shall be utterly laid waste, and be in sorrow; and their memorial shall perish.
verses.text: For he shall rend them, and cast them down headlong, that they shall be speechless; and he shall shake them from the foundation; and they shall be utterly laid waste, and be in sorrow; and their memorial shall perish.

verses.raw: And when they cast up the accounts of their sins, they shall come with fear: and their own iniquities shall convince them to their face. ⸻
verses.text: And when they cast up the accounts of their sins, they shall come with fear: and their own iniquities shall convince them to their face. ⸻

verses.raw: Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labours.
verses.text: Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labours.

verses.raw: When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for.
verses.text: When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for.

verses.raw: And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach:
verses.text: And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach:

verses.raw: We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour:
verses.text: We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour:

verses.raw: How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah (God), and his lot is among the saints!
verses.text: How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah, and his lot is among the saints!

verses.raw: Therefore have we erred from the way of truth, and the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us.
verses.text: Therefore have we erred from the way of truth, and the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us.

verses.raw: We wearied ourselves in the way of wickedness and destruction: yes, we have gone through deserts, where there lay no way: but as for the way of Yahuah (God), we have not known it.
verses.text: We wearied ourselves in the way of wickedness and destruction: yes, we have gone through deserts, where there lay no way: but as for the way of Yahuah, we have not known it.

verses.raw: What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?
verses.text: What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?

verses.raw: All those things are passed away like a shadow, and as a post that hasted by;
verses.text: All those things are passed away like a shadow, and as a post that hasted by;

verses.raw: And as a ship that passeth over the waves of the water, which when it is gone by, the trace thereof cannot be found, neither the pathway of the keel in the waves;
verses.text: And as a ship that passeth over the waves of the water, which when it is gone by, the trace thereof cannot be found, neither the pathway of the keel in the waves;

verses.raw: Or as when a bird has flown through the air, there is no token of her way to be found, but the light air being beaten with the stroke of her wings and parted with the violent noise and motion of them, is passed through, and in it afterwards no sign where she went is to be found;
verses.text: Or as when a bird has flown through the air, there is no token of her way to be found, but the light air being beaten with the stroke of her wings and parted with the violent noise and motion of them, is passed through, and in it afterwards no sign where she went is to be found;

verses.raw: Or like as when an arrow is shot at a mark, it parteth the air, which immediately comes together again, so that a man cannot know where it went through:
verses.text: Or like as when an arrow is shot at a mark, it parteth the air, which immediately comes together again, so that a man cannot know where it went through:

verses.raw: Even so we in like manner, as soon as we were born, began to draw to our end, and had no sign of virtue to shew; but were consumed in our own wickedness.
verses.text: Even so we in like manner, as soon as we were born, began to draw to our end, and had no sign of virtue to shew; but were consumed in our own wickedness.

verses.raw: For the hope of the ungodly is like dust that is blown away with the wind; like a thin froth that is driven away with the storm; like as the smoke which is dispersed here and there with a tempest, and passeth away as the remembrance of a guest that tarrieth but a day.
verses.text: For the hope of the ungodly is like dust that is blown away with the wind; like a thin froth that is driven away with the storm; like as the smoke which is dispersed here and there with a tempest, and passeth away as the remembrance of a guest that tarrieth but a day.

verses.raw: But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with Yahuah (God), and the care of them is with the Most High.
verses.text: But the righteous live for evermore; their reward also is with Yahuah, and the care of them is with the Most High.

verses.raw: Therefore shall they receive a glorious kingdom, and a beautiful crown from the hand of Yahuah (God): for with his right hand shall he cover them, and with his arm shall he protect them.
verses.text: Therefore shall they receive a glorious kingdom, and a beautiful crown from the hand of Yahuah: for with his right hand shall he cover them, and with his arm shall he protect them.

verses.raw: He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour, and make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies.
verses.text: He shall take to him his jealousy for complete armour, and make the creature his weapon for the revenge of his enemies.

verses.raw: He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate, and true judgment instead of an helmet.
verses.text: He shall put on righteousness as a breastplate, and true judgment instead of an helmet.

verses.raw: He shall take holiness for an invincible shield.
verses.text: He shall take holiness for an invincible shield.

verses.raw: His severe wrath shall he sharpen for a sword, and the world shall fight with him against the unwise.
verses.text: His severe wrath shall he sharpen for a sword, and the world shall fight with him against the unwise.

verses.raw: Then shall the right aiming thunderbolts go abroad; and from the clouds, as from a well drawn bow, shall they fly to the mark.
verses.text: Then shall the right aiming thunderbolts go abroad; and from the clouds, as from a well drawn bow, shall they fly to the mark.

verses.raw: And hailstones full of wrath shall be cast as out of a stone bow, and the water of the sea shall rage against them, and the floods shall cruelly drown them.
verses.text: And hailstones full of wrath shall be cast as out of a stone bow, and the water of the sea shall rage against them, and the floods shall cruelly drown them.

verses.raw: Yea, a mighty wind shall stand up against them, and like a storm shall blow them away: thus iniquity shall lay waste the whole earth, and ill dealing shall overthrow the thrones of the mighty. ⸻
verses.text: Yea, a mighty wind shall stand up against them, and like a storm shall blow them away: thus iniquity shall lay waste the whole earth, and ill dealing shall overthrow the thrones of the mighty. ⸻

verses.raw: Hear therefore, O you kings, and understand; learn, you that be judges of the ends of the earth.
verses.text: Hear therefore, O you kings, and understand; learn, you that be judges of the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: Give ear, you that rule the people, and glory in the multitude of nations.
verses.text: Give ear, you that rule the people, and glory in the multitude of nations.

verses.raw: For power is given you of Yahuah (God), and sovereignty from the Highest, who shall try your works, and search out your counsels.
verses.text: For power is given you of Yahuah, and sovereignty from the Highest, who shall try your works, and search out your counsels.

verses.raw: Because, being ministers of his kingdom, you have not judged aright, nor kept the law, nor walked after the counsel of Yahuah (God);
verses.text: Because, being ministers of his kingdom, you have not judged aright, nor kept the law, nor walked after the counsel of Yahuah;

verses.raw: Horribly and speedily shall he come upon you: for a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places.
verses.text: Horribly and speedily shall he come upon you: for a sharp judgment shall be to them that be in high places.

verses.raw: For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.
verses.text: For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.

verses.raw: For he which is Yahuah (God) over all shall fear no man’s person, neither shall he stand in awe of any man’s greatness: for he has made the small and great, and careth for all alike.
verses.text: For he which is Yahuah over all shall fear no man’s person, neither shall he stand in awe of any man’s greatness: for he has made the small and great, and careth for all alike.

verses.raw: But a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.
verses.text: But a sore trial shall come upon the mighty.

verses.raw: To you therefore, O kings, do I speak, that you may learn wisdom, and not fall away.
verses.text: To you therefore, O kings, do I speak, that you may learn wisdom, and not fall away.

verses.raw: For they that keep holiness holily shall be judged holy: and they that have learned such things shall find what to answer.
verses.text: For they that keep holiness holily shall be judged holy: and they that have learned such things shall find what to answer.

verses.raw: Wherefore set your affection upon my words; desire them, and you shall be instructed.
verses.text: Wherefore set your affection upon my words; desire them, and you shall be instructed.

verses.raw: Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: yes, she is easily seen of them that love her, and found of such as seek her.
verses.text: Wisdom is glorious, and never fadeth away: yes, she is easily seen of them that love her, and found of such as seek her.

verses.raw: She preventeth them that desire her, in making herself first known to them.
verses.text: She preventeth them that desire her, in making herself first known to them.

verses.raw: Whoso seeks her early shall have no great travail: for he shall find her sitting at his doors.
verses.text: Whoso seeks her early shall have no great travail: for he shall find her sitting at his doors.

verses.raw: To think therefore upon her is perfection of wisdom: and whoso watcheth for her shall quickly be without care.
verses.text: To think therefore upon her is perfection of wisdom: and whoso watcheth for her shall quickly be without care.

verses.raw: For she goes about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably to them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.
verses.text: For she goes about seeking such as are worthy of her, sheweth herself favourably to them in the ways, and meeteth them in every thought.

verses.raw: For the very true beginning of her is the desire of discipline; and the care of discipline is love;
verses.text: For the very true beginning of her is the desire of discipline; and the care of discipline is love;

verses.raw: And love is the keeping of her laws; and the giving heed to her laws is the assurance of incorruption;
verses.text: And love is the keeping of her laws; and the giving heed to her laws is the assurance of incorruption;

verses.raw: And incorruption makes us near to Yahuah (God):
verses.text: And incorruption makes us near to Yahuah:

verses.raw: Therefore the desire of wisdom brings to a kingdom.
verses.text: Therefore the desire of wisdom brings to a kingdom.

verses.raw: If your delight be then in thrones and sceptres, O you kings of the people, honour wisdom, that you may reign for evermore.
verses.text: If your delight be then in thrones and sceptres, O you kings of the people, honour wisdom, that you may reign for evermore.

verses.raw: As for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you: but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light, and will not pass over the truth.
verses.text: As for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you: but will seek her out from the beginning of her nativity, and bring the knowledge of her into light, and will not pass over the truth.

verses.raw: Neither will I go with consuming envy; for such a man shall have no fellowship with wisdom.
verses.text: Neither will I go with consuming envy; for such a man shall have no fellowship with wisdom.

verses.raw: But the multitude of the wise is the welfare of the world: and a wise king is the upholding of the people.
verses.text: But the multitude of the wise is the welfare of the world: and a wise king is the upholding of the people.

verses.raw: Receive therefore instruction through my words, and it shall do you good. ⸻
verses.text: Receive therefore instruction through my words, and it shall do you good. ⸻

verses.raw: I myself also am a mortal man, like to all, and the offspring of him that was first made of the earth,
verses.text: I myself also am a mortal man, like to all, and the offspring of him that was first made of the earth,

verses.raw: And in my mother’s womb was fashioned to be flesh in the time of ten months, being compacted in blood, of the seed of man, and the pleasure that came with sleep.
verses.text: And in my mother’s womb was fashioned to be flesh in the time of ten months, being compacted in blood, of the seed of man, and the pleasure that came with sleep.

verses.raw: And when I was born, I drew in the common air, and fell upon the earth, which is of like nature, and the first voice which I uttered was crying, as all others do.
verses.text: And when I was born, I drew in the common air, and fell upon the earth, which is of like nature, and the first voice which I uttered was crying, as all others do.

verses.raw: I was nursed in swaddling clothes, and that with cares.
verses.text: I was nursed in swaddling clothes, and that with cares.

verses.raw: For there is no king that had any other beginning of birth.
verses.text: For there is no king that had any other beginning of birth.

verses.raw: For all men have one entrance into life, and the like going out.
verses.text: For all men have one entrance into life, and the like going out.

verses.raw: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah (God), and the spirit of wisdom came to me.
verses.text: Wherefore I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon Yahuah, and the spirit of wisdom came to me.

verses.raw: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her.
verses.text: I preferred her before sceptres and thrones, and esteemed riches nothing in comparison of her.

verses.raw: Neither compared I to her any precious stone, because all gold in respect of her is as a little sand, and silver shall be counted as clay before her.
verses.text: Neither compared I to her any precious stone, because all gold in respect of her is as a little sand, and silver shall be counted as clay before her.

verses.raw: I loved her above health and beauty, and chose to have her instead of light: for the light that comes from her never goes out.
verses.text: I loved her above health and beauty, and chose to have her instead of light: for the light that comes from her never goes out.

verses.raw: All good things together came to me with her, and innumerable riches in her hands.
verses.text: All good things together came to me with her, and innumerable riches in her hands.

verses.raw: And I rejoiced in them all, because wisdom goes before them: and I knew not that she was the mother of them.
verses.text: And I rejoiced in them all, because wisdom goes before them: and I knew not that she was the mother of them.

verses.raw: I learned diligently, and do communicate her liberally: I do not hide her riches.
verses.text: I learned diligently, and do communicate her liberally: I do not hide her riches.

verses.raw: For she is a treasure to men that never fails: which they that use become the friends of Yahuah (God), being commended for the gifts that come from learning.
verses.text: For she is a treasure to men that never fails: which they that use become the friends of Yahuah, being commended for the gifts that come from learning.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) has granted me to speak as I would, and to conceive as is meet for the things that are given me: because it is he that leadeth to wisdom, and directeth the wise.
verses.text: Yahuah has granted me to speak as I would, and to conceive as is meet for the things that are given me: because it is he that leadeth to wisdom, and directeth the wise.

verses.raw: For in his hand are both we and our words; all wisdom also, and knowledge of workmanship.
verses.text: For in his hand are both we and our words; all wisdom also, and knowledge of workmanship.

verses.raw: For he has given me certain knowledge of the things that are, namely, to know how the world was made, and the operation of the elements:
verses.text: For he has given me certain knowledge of the things that are, namely, to know how the world was made, and the operation of the elements:

verses.raw: The beginning, ending, and midst of the times: the alterations of the turning of the sun, and the change of seasons:
verses.text: The beginning, ending, and midst of the times: the alterations of the turning of the sun, and the change of seasons:

verses.raw: The circuits of years, and the positions of stars:
verses.text: The circuits of years, and the positions of stars:

verses.raw: The natures of living creatures, and the furies of wild beasts: the violence of winds, and the reasonings of men: the diversities of plants and the virtues of roots:
verses.text: The natures of living creatures, and the furies of wild beasts: the violence of winds, and the reasonings of men: the diversities of plants and the virtues of roots:

verses.raw: And all such things as are either secret or manifest, them I know.
verses.text: And all such things as are either secret or manifest, them I know.

verses.raw: For wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me: for in her is an understanding spirit holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled, plain, not subject to hurt, loving the thing that is good quick, which cannot be letted, ready to do good,
verses.text: For wisdom, which is the worker of all things, taught me: for in her is an understanding spirit holy, one only, manifold, subtil, lively, clear, undefiled, plain, not subject to hurt, loving the thing that is good quick, which cannot be letted, ready to do good,

verses.raw: Kind to man, steadfast, sure, free from care, having all power, overseeing all things, and going through all understanding, pure, and most subtil, spirits.
verses.text: Kind to man, steadfast, sure, free from care, having all power, overseeing all things, and going through all understanding, pure, and most subtil, spirits.

verses.raw: For wisdom is more moving than any motion: she passeth and goes through all things by reason of her pureness.
verses.text: For wisdom is more moving than any motion: she passeth and goes through all things by reason of her pureness.

verses.raw: For she is the breath of the power of Yahuah (God), and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.
verses.text: For she is the breath of the power of Yahuah, and a pure influence flowing from the glory of the Almighty: therefore can no defiled thing fall into her.

verses.raw: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah (God), and the image of his goodness.
verses.text: For she is the brightness of the everlasting light, the unspotted mirror of the power of Yahuah, and the image of his goodness.

verses.raw: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she makes all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she makes them friends of Yahuah (God), and prophets.
verses.text: And being but one, she can do all things: and remaining in herself, she makes all things new: and in all ages entering into holy souls, she makes them friends of Yahuah, and prophets.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) loves none but him that dwells with wisdom.
verses.text: For Yahuah loves none but him that dwells with wisdom.

verses.raw: For she is more beautiful than the sun, and above all the order of stars: being compared with the light, she is found before it.
verses.text: For she is more beautiful than the sun, and above all the order of stars: being compared with the light, she is found before it.

verses.raw: For after this comes night: but vice shall not prevail against wisdom. ⸻
verses.text: For after this comes night: but vice shall not prevail against wisdom. ⸻

verses.raw: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.
verses.text: Wisdom reacheth from one end to another mightily: and sweetly does she order all things.

verses.raw: I loved her, and sought her out from my youth, I desired to make her my spouse, and I was a lover of her beauty.
verses.text: I loved her, and sought her out from my youth, I desired to make her my spouse, and I was a lover of her beauty.

verses.raw: In that she is conversant with Yahuah (God), she magnifies her nobility: yes, Yahuah (God) of all things himself loved her.
verses.text: In that she is conversant with Yahuah, she magnifies her nobility: yes, Yahuah of all things himself loved her.

verses.raw: For she is privy to the mysteries of the knowledge of Yahuah (God), and a lover of his works.
verses.text: For she is privy to the mysteries of the knowledge of Yahuah, and a lover of his works.

verses.raw: If riches be a possession to be desired in this life; what is richer than wisdom, that works all things?
verses.text: If riches be a possession to be desired in this life; what is richer than wisdom, that works all things?

verses.raw: And if prudence work; who of all that are is a more cunning workman than she?
verses.text: And if prudence work; who of all that are is a more cunning workman than she?

verses.raw: And if a man love righteousness her labours are virtues: for she teaches temperance and prudence, justice and fortitude: which are such things, as men can have nothing more profitable in their life.
verses.text: And if a man love righteousness her labours are virtues: for she teaches temperance and prudence, justice and fortitude: which are such things, as men can have nothing more profitable in their life.

verses.raw: If a man desire much experience, she knoweth things of old, and conjectureth aright what is to come: she knoweth the subtilties of speeches, and can expound dark sentences: she foreseeth signs and wonders, and the events of seasons and times.
verses.text: If a man desire much experience, she knoweth things of old, and conjectureth aright what is to come: she knoweth the subtilties of speeches, and can expound dark sentences: she foreseeth signs and wonders, and the events of seasons and times.

verses.raw: Therefore I purposed to take her to me to live with me, knowing that she would be a counsellor of good things, and a comfort in cares and grief.
verses.text: Therefore I purposed to take her to me to live with me, knowing that she would be a counsellor of good things, and a comfort in cares and grief.

verses.raw: For her sake I shall have estimation among the multitude, and honour with the elders, though I be young.
verses.text: For her sake I shall have estimation among the multitude, and honour with the elders, though I be young.

verses.raw: I shall be found of a quick conceit in judgment, and shall be admired in the sight of great men.
verses.text: I shall be found of a quick conceit in judgment, and shall be admired in the sight of great men.

verses.raw: When I hold my tongue, they shall bide my leisure, and when I speak, they shall give good ear to me: if I talk much, they shall lay their hands upon their mouth.
verses.text: When I hold my tongue, they shall bide my leisure, and when I speak, they shall give good ear to me: if I talk much, they shall lay their hands upon their mouth.

verses.raw: Moreover by the means of her I shall obtain immortality, and leave behind me an everlasting memorial to them that come after me.
verses.text: Moreover by the means of her I shall obtain immortality, and leave behind me an everlasting memorial to them that come after me.

verses.raw: I shall set the people in order, and the nations shall be subject to me.
verses.text: I shall set the people in order, and the nations shall be subject to me.

verses.raw: Horrible tyrants shall be afraid, when they do but hear of me; I shall be found good among the multitude, and valiant in war.
verses.text: Horrible tyrants shall be afraid, when they do but hear of me; I shall be found good among the multitude, and valiant in war.

verses.raw: After I am come into my house, I will repose myself with her: for her conversation has no bitterness; and to live with her has no sorrow, but mirth and joy.
verses.text: After I am come into my house, I will repose myself with her: for her conversation has no bitterness; and to live with her has no sorrow, but mirth and joy.

verses.raw: Now when I considered these things in myself, and pondered them in my heart, how that to be allied to wisdom is immortality;
verses.text: Now when I considered these things in myself, and pondered them in my heart, how that to be allied to wisdom is immortality;

verses.raw: And great pleasure it is to have her friendship; and in the works of her hands are infinite riches; and in the exercise of conference with her, prudence; and in talking with her, a good report; I went about seeking how to take her to me.
verses.text: And great pleasure it is to have her friendship; and in the works of her hands are infinite riches; and in the exercise of conference with her, prudence; and in talking with her, a good report; I went about seeking how to take her to me.

verses.raw: For I was a witty child, and had a good spirit.
verses.text: For I was a witty child, and had a good spirit.

verses.raw: Yea rather, being good, I came into a body undefiled.
verses.text: Yea rather, being good, I came into a body undefiled.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, when I perceived that I could not otherwise obtain her, except Yahuah (God) gave her me; and that was a point of wisdom also to know whose gift she was; I prayed to Yahuah (God), and besought him, and with my whole heart I said, ⸻
verses.text: Nevertheless, when I perceived that I could not otherwise obtain her, except Yahuah gave her me; and that was a point of wisdom also to know whose gift she was; I prayed to Yahuah, and besought him, and with my whole heart I said, ⸻

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God) of my fathers, and Yahuah (God) of mercy, who have made all things with your word,
verses.text: O Yahuah of my fathers, and Yahuah of mercy, who have made all things with your word,

verses.raw: And ordained man through your wisdom, that he should have dominion over the creatures which you have made,
verses.text: And ordained man through your wisdom, that he should have dominion over the creatures which you have made,

verses.raw: And order the world according to equity and righteousness, and execute judgment with an upright heart:
verses.text: And order the world according to equity and righteousness, and execute judgment with an upright heart:

verses.raw: Give me wisdom, that sits by your throne; and reject me not from among your children:
verses.text: Give me wisdom, that sits by your throne; and reject me not from among your children:

verses.raw: For I your servant and son of yours handmaid am a feeble person, and of a short time, and too young for the understanding of judgment and laws.
verses.text: For I your servant and son of yours handmaid am a feeble person, and of a short time, and too young for the understanding of judgment and laws.

verses.raw: For though a man be never so perfect among the children of men, yet if your wisdom be not with him, he shall be nothing regarded.
verses.text: For though a man be never so perfect among the children of men, yet if your wisdom be not with him, he shall be nothing regarded.

verses.raw: You have chosen me to be a king of your people, and a judge of your sons and daughters:
verses.text: You have chosen me to be a king of your people, and a judge of your sons and daughters:

verses.raw: You have commanded me to build a temple upon your holy mount, and an altar in the city in which you dwellest, a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning.
verses.text: You have commanded me to build a temple upon your holy mount, and an altar in the city in which you dwellest, a resemblance of the holy tabernacle, which you have prepared from the beginning.

verses.raw: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.
verses.text: And wisdom was with you: which knoweth your works, and was present when you madest the world, and knew what was acceptable in your sight, and right in your commandments.

verses.raw: O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory, that being present she may labour with me, that I may know what is pleasing to you.
verses.text: O send her out of your holy heavens, and from the throne of your glory, that being present she may labour with me, that I may know what is pleasing to you.

verses.raw: For she knoweth and understands all things, and she shall lead me soberly in my doings, and preserve me in her power.
verses.text: For she knoweth and understands all things, and she shall lead me soberly in my doings, and preserve me in her power.

verses.raw: So shall my works be acceptable, and then shall I judge your people righteously, and be worthy to sit in my father’s seat.
verses.text: So shall my works be acceptable, and then shall I judge your people righteously, and be worthy to sit in my father’s seat.

verses.raw: For what man is he that can know the counsel of Yahuah (God)? or who can think what the will of Yahuah (God) is?
verses.text: For what man is he that can know the counsel of Yahuah? or who can think what the will of Yahuah is?

verses.raw: For the thoughts of mortal men are miserable, and our devices are but uncertain.
verses.text: For the thoughts of mortal men are miserable, and our devices are but uncertain.

verses.raw: For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things.
verses.text: For the corruptible body presseth down the soul, and the earthy tabernacle weigheth down the mind that museth upon many things.

verses.raw: And hardly do we guess aright at things that are upon earth, and with labour do we find the things that are before us: but the things that are in heaven who has searched out?
verses.text: And hardly do we guess aright at things that are upon earth, and with labour do we find the things that are before us: but the things that are in heaven who has searched out?

verses.raw: And your counsel who has known, except you give wisdom, and send your Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) from above?
verses.text: And your counsel who has known, except you give wisdom, and send your Ruach HaKodesh from above?

verses.raw: For so the ways of them which lived on the earth were reformed, and men were taught the things that are pleasing to you, and were saved through wisdom. ⸻
verses.text: For so the ways of them which lived on the earth were reformed, and men were taught the things that are pleasing to you, and were saved through wisdom. ⸻

verses.raw: She preserved the first formed father of the world, that was created alone, and brought him out of his fall,
verses.text: She preserved the first formed father of the world, that was created alone, and brought him out of his fall,

verses.raw: And gave him power to rule all things.
verses.text: And gave him power to rule all things.

verses.raw: But when the unrighteous went away from her in his anger, he perished also in the fury with which he murdered his brother.
verses.text: But when the unrighteous went away from her in his anger, he perished also in the fury with which he murdered his brother.

verses.raw: For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood, wisdom again preserved it, and directed the course of the righteous in a piece of wood of small value.
verses.text: For whose cause the earth being drowned with the flood, wisdom again preserved it, and directed the course of the righteous in a piece of wood of small value.

verses.raw: Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy being confounded, she found out the righteous, and preserved him blameless to Yahuah (God), and kept him strong against his tender compassion toward his son.
verses.text: Moreover, the nations in their wicked conspiracy being confounded, she found out the righteous, and preserved him blameless to Yahuah, and kept him strong against his tender compassion toward his son.

verses.raw: When the ungodly perished, she delivered the righteous man, who fled from the fire which fell down upon the five cities.
verses.text: When the ungodly perished, she delivered the righteous man, who fled from the fire which fell down upon the five cities.

verses.raw: Of whose wickedness even to this day the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and plants bearing fruit that never come to ripeness: and a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.
verses.text: Of whose wickedness even to this day the waste land that smoketh is a testimony, and plants bearing fruit that never come to ripeness: and a standing pillar of salt is a monument of an unbelieving soul.

verses.raw: For regarding not wisdom, they got not only this hurt, that they knew not the things which were good; but also left behind them to the world a memorial of their foolishness: so that in the things in which they offended they could not so much as be hid.
verses.text: For regarding not wisdom, they got not only this hurt, that they knew not the things which were good; but also left behind them to the world a memorial of their foolishness: so that in the things in which they offended they could not so much as be hid.

verses.raw: But wisdom delivered from pain those that attended upon her.
verses.text: But wisdom delivered from pain those that attended upon her.

verses.raw: When the righteous fled from his brother’s wrath she guided him in right paths, shewed him the kingdom of Yahuah (God), and gave him knowledge of holy things, made him rich in his travels, and multiplied the fruit of his labours.
verses.text: When the righteous fled from his brother’s wrath she guided him in right paths, shewed him the kingdom of Yahuah, and gave him knowledge of holy things, made him rich in his travels, and multiplied the fruit of his labours.

verses.raw: In the covetousness of such as oppressed him she stood by him, and made him rich.
verses.text: In the covetousness of such as oppressed him she stood by him, and made him rich.

verses.raw: She defended him from his enemies, and kept him safe from those that lay in wait, and in a sore conflict she gave him the victory; that he might know that goodness is stronger than all.
verses.text: She defended him from his enemies, and kept him safe from those that lay in wait, and in a sore conflict she gave him the victory; that he might know that goodness is stronger than all.

verses.raw: When the righteous was sold, she forsook him not, but delivered him from sin: she went down with him into the pit,
verses.text: When the righteous was sold, she forsook him not, but delivered him from sin: she went down with him into the pit,

verses.raw: And left him not in bonds, till she brought him the sceptre of the kingdom, and power against those that oppressed him: as for them that had accused him, she shewed them to be liars, and gave him perpetual glory.
verses.text: And left him not in bonds, till she brought him the sceptre of the kingdom, and power against those that oppressed him: as for them that had accused him, she shewed them to be liars, and gave him perpetual glory.

verses.raw: She delivered the righteous people and blameless seed from the nation that oppressed them.
verses.text: She delivered the righteous people and blameless seed from the nation that oppressed them.

verses.raw: She entered into the soul of the servant of Yahuah (God), and withstood dreadful kings in wonders and signs;
verses.text: She entered into the soul of the servant of Yahuah, and withstood dreadful kings in wonders and signs;

verses.raw: Rendered to the righteous a reward of their labours, guided them in a marvellous way, and was to them for a cover by day, and a light of stars in the night season;
verses.text: Rendered to the righteous a reward of their labours, guided them in a marvellous way, and was to them for a cover by day, and a light of stars in the night season;

verses.raw: Brought them through the Red sea, and led them through much water:
verses.text: Brought them through the Red sea, and led them through much water:

verses.raw: But she drowned their enemies, and cast them up out of the bottom of the deep.
verses.text: But she drowned their enemies, and cast them up out of the bottom of the deep.

verses.raw: Therefore the righteous spoiled the ungodly, and praised your holy name, O Yahuah (God), and magnified with one accord yours hand, that fought for them.
verses.text: Therefore the righteous spoiled the ungodly, and praised your holy name, O Yahuah, and magnified with one accord yours hand, that fought for them.

verses.raw: For wisdom opened the mouth of the dumb, and made the tongues of them that cannot speak eloquent. ⸻
verses.text: For wisdom opened the mouth of the dumb, and made the tongues of them that cannot speak eloquent. ⸻

verses.raw: She prospered their works in the hand of the holy prophet.
verses.text: She prospered their works in the hand of the holy prophet.

verses.raw: They went through the wilderness that was not inhabited, and pitched tents in places where there lay no way.
verses.text: They went through the wilderness that was not inhabited, and pitched tents in places where there lay no way.

verses.raw: They stood against their enemies, and were avenged of their adversaries.
verses.text: They stood against their enemies, and were avenged of their adversaries.

verses.raw: When they were thirsty, they called upon you, and water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone.
verses.text: When they were thirsty, they called upon you, and water was given them out of the flinty rock, and their thirst was quenched out of the hard stone.

verses.raw: For by what things their enemies were punished, by the same they in their need were benefited.
verses.text: For by what things their enemies were punished, by the same they in their need were benefited.

verses.raw: For instead of a perpetual running river troubled with foul blood,
verses.text: For instead of a perpetual running river troubled with foul blood,

verses.raw: For a manifest reproof of that commandment, by which the infants were slain, you gavest to them abundance of water by a means which they hoped not for:
verses.text: For a manifest reproof of that commandment, by which the infants were slain, you gavest to them abundance of water by a means which they hoped not for:

verses.raw: Declaring by that thirst then how you had punished their adversaries.
verses.text: Declaring by that thirst then how you had punished their adversaries.

verses.raw: For when they were tried albeit but in mercy chastised, they knew how the ungodly were judged in wrath and tormented, thirsting in another manner than the just.
verses.text: For when they were tried albeit but in mercy chastised, they knew how the ungodly were judged in wrath and tormented, thirsting in another manner than the just.

verses.raw: For these you did admonish and try, as a father: but the other, as a severe king, you did condemn and punish.
verses.text: For these you did admonish and try, as a father: but the other, as a severe king, you did condemn and punish.

verses.raw: Whether they were absent or present, they were vexed alike.
verses.text: Whether they were absent or present, they were vexed alike.

verses.raw: For a double grief came upon them, and a groaning for the remembrance of things past.
verses.text: For a double grief came upon them, and a groaning for the remembrance of things past.

verses.raw: For when they heard by their own punishments the other to be benefited, they had some feeling of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: For when they heard by their own punishments the other to be benefited, they had some feeling of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For whom they respected with scorn, when he was long before thrown out at the casting forth of the infants, him in the end, when they saw what came to pass, they admired.
verses.text: For whom they respected with scorn, when he was long before thrown out at the casting forth of the infants, him in the end, when they saw what came to pass, they admired.

verses.raw: But for the foolish devices of their wickedness, with which being deceived they worshipped serpents void of reason, and vile beasts, you did send a multitude of unreasonable beasts upon them for vengeance;
verses.text: But for the foolish devices of their wickedness, with which being deceived they worshipped serpents void of reason, and vile beasts, you did send a multitude of unreasonable beasts upon them for vengeance;

verses.raw: That they might know, that wherewithal a man sinneth, by the same also shall he be punished.
verses.text: That they might know, that wherewithal a man sinneth, by the same also shall he be punished.

verses.raw: For your Almighty hand, that made the world of matter without form, wanted not means to send among them a multitude of bears or fierce lions,
verses.text: For your Almighty hand, that made the world of matter without form, wanted not means to send among them a multitude of bears or fierce lions,

verses.raw: Or unknown wild beasts, full of rage, newly created, breathing out either a fiery vapour, or filthy scents of scattered smoke, or shooting horrible sparkles out of their eyes:
verses.text: Or unknown wild beasts, full of rage, newly created, breathing out either a fiery vapour, or filthy scents of scattered smoke, or shooting horrible sparkles out of their eyes:

verses.raw: Of which not only the harm might dispatch them at once, but also the terrible sight utterly destroy them.
verses.text: Of which not only the harm might dispatch them at once, but also the terrible sight utterly destroy them.

verses.raw: Yea, and without these might they have fallen down with one blast, being persecuted of vengeance, and scattered abroad through the breath of your power: but you have ordered all things in measure and number and weight.
verses.text: Yea, and without these might they have fallen down with one blast, being persecuted of vengeance, and scattered abroad through the breath of your power: but you have ordered all things in measure and number and weight.

verses.raw: For you can shew your great strength at all times when you will; and who may withstand the power of your arm?
verses.text: For you can shew your great strength at all times when you will; and who may withstand the power of your arm?

verses.raw: For the whole world before you is as a little grain of the balance, yes, as a drop of the morning dew that falls down upon the earth.
verses.text: For the whole world before you is as a little grain of the balance, yes, as a drop of the morning dew that falls down upon the earth.

verses.raw: But you have mercy upon all; for you can do all things, and winkest at the sins of men, because they should amend.
verses.text: But you have mercy upon all; for you can do all things, and winkest at the sins of men, because they should amend.

verses.raw: For you lovest all the things that are, and abhorrest nothing which you have made: for never wouldest you have made any thing, if you had hated it.
verses.text: For you lovest all the things that are, and abhorrest nothing which you have made: for never wouldest you have made any thing, if you had hated it.

verses.raw: And how could any thing have endured, if it had not been your will? or been preserved, if not called by you?
verses.text: And how could any thing have endured, if it had not been your will? or been preserved, if not called by you?

verses.raw: But you sparest all: for they are yours, O Yahuah (God), you lover of souls. ⸻
verses.text: But you sparest all: for they are yours, O Yahuah, you lover of souls. ⸻

verses.raw: For your incorruptible Spirit is in all things.
verses.text: For your incorruptible Spirit is in all things.

verses.raw: Therefore chastenest you them by little and little that offend, and warnest them by putting them in remembrance in which they have offended, that leaving their wickedness they may believe on you, O Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Therefore chastenest you them by little and little that offend, and warnest them by putting them in remembrance in which they have offended, that leaving their wickedness they may believe on you, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: For it was your will to destroy by the hands of our fathers both those old inhabitants of your holy land,
verses.text: For it was your will to destroy by the hands of our fathers both those old inhabitants of your holy land,

verses.raw: Whom you hatedst for doing most odious works of witchcrafts, and wicked sacrifices;
verses.text: Whom you hatedst for doing most odious works of witchcrafts, and wicked sacrifices;

verses.raw: And also those merciless murderers of children, and devourers of man’s flesh, and the feasts of blood,
verses.text: And also those merciless murderers of children, and devourers of man’s flesh, and the feasts of blood,

verses.raw: With their priests out of the midst of their idolatrous crew, and the parents, that killed with their own hands souls destitute of help:
verses.text: With their priests out of the midst of their idolatrous crew, and the parents, that killed with their own hands souls destitute of help:

verses.raw: That the land, which you esteemedst above all other, might receive a worthy colony of the children of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: That the land, which you esteemedst above all other, might receive a worthy colony of the children of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Nevertheless even those you sparedst as men, and did send wasps, forerunners of yours host, to destroy them by little and little.
verses.text: Nevertheless even those you sparedst as men, and did send wasps, forerunners of yours host, to destroy them by little and little.

verses.raw: Not that you were unable to bring the ungodly under the hand of the righteous in battle, or to destroy them at once with cruel beasts, or with one rough word:
verses.text: Not that you were unable to bring the ungodly under the hand of the righteous in battle, or to destroy them at once with cruel beasts, or with one rough word:

verses.raw: But executing your judgments upon them by little and little, you gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.
verses.text: But executing your judgments upon them by little and little, you gavest them place of repentance, not being ignorant that they were a naughty generation, and that their malice was bred in them, and that their cogitation would never be changed.

verses.raw: For it was a cursed seed from the beginning; neither did you for fear of any man give them pardon for those things in which they sinned.
verses.text: For it was a cursed seed from the beginning; neither did you for fear of any man give them pardon for those things in which they sinned.

verses.raw: For who shall say, What have you done? or who shall withstand your judgment? or who shall accuse you for the nations that perish, whom you made? or who shall come to stand against you, to be revenged for the unrighteous men?
