verses.text: Accept no person against your soul, and let not the reverence of any man cause you to fall.

verses.raw: And refrain not to speak, when there is occasion to do good, and hide not your wisdom in her beauty.
verses.text: And refrain not to speak, when there is occasion to do good, and hide not your wisdom in her beauty.

verses.raw: For by speech wisdom shall be known: and learning by the word of the tongue.
verses.text: For by speech wisdom shall be known: and learning by the word of the tongue.

verses.raw: In no wise speak against the truth; but be abashed of the error of your ignorance.
verses.text: In no wise speak against the truth; but be abashed of the error of your ignorance.

verses.raw: Be not ashamed to confess your sins; and force not the course of the river.
verses.text: Be not ashamed to confess your sins; and force not the course of the river.

verses.raw: Make not thyself an underling to a foolish man; neither accept the person of the mighty.
verses.text: Make not thyself an underling to a foolish man; neither accept the person of the mighty.

verses.raw: Strive for the truth to death, and Yahuah (God) shall fight for you.
verses.text: Strive for the truth to death, and Yahuah shall fight for you.

verses.raw: Be not hasty in your tongue, and in your deeds slack and remiss.
verses.text: Be not hasty in your tongue, and in your deeds slack and remiss.

verses.raw: Be not as a lion in your house, nor frantick among your servants.
verses.text: Be not as a lion in your house, nor frantick among your servants.

verses.raw: Let not yours hand be stretched out to receive, and shut when you should repay. ⸻
verses.text: Let not yours hand be stretched out to receive, and shut when you should repay. ⸻

verses.raw: Set your heart upon your goods; and say not, I have enough for my life.
verses.text: Set your heart upon your goods; and say not, I have enough for my life.

verses.raw: Follow not your own mind and your strength, to walk in the ways of your heart:
verses.text: Follow not your own mind and your strength, to walk in the ways of your heart:

verses.raw: And say not, Who shall controul me for my works? for Yahuah (God) will surely revenge your pride.
verses.text: And say not, Who shall controul me for my works? for Yahuah will surely revenge your pride.

verses.raw: Say not, I have sinned, and what harm has happened to me? for Yahuah (God) is longsuffering, he will in no wise let you go.
verses.text: Say not, I have sinned, and what harm has happened to me? for Yahuah is longsuffering, he will in no wise let you go.

verses.raw: Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin to sin:
verses.text: Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin to sin:

verses.raw: And say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: for mercy and wrath come from him, and his indignation resteth upon sinners.
verses.text: And say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: for mercy and wrath come from him, and his indignation resteth upon sinners.

verses.raw: Make no tarrying to turn to Yahuah (God), and put not off from day to day: for suddenly shall the wrath of Yahuah (God) come forth, and in your security you shall be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance.
verses.text: Make no tarrying to turn to Yahuah, and put not off from day to day: for suddenly shall the wrath of Yahuah come forth, and in your security you shall be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance.

verses.raw: Set not yours heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity.
verses.text: Set not yours heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity.

verses.raw: Winnow not with every wind, and go not into every way: for so does the sinner that has a double tongue.
verses.text: Winnow not with every wind, and go not into every way: for so does the sinner that has a double tongue.

verses.raw: Be stedfast in your understanding; and let your word be the same.
verses.text: Be stedfast in your understanding; and let your word be the same.

verses.raw: Be swift to hear; and let your life be sincere; and with patience give answer.
verses.text: Be swift to hear; and let your life be sincere; and with patience give answer.

verses.raw: If you have understanding, answer your neighbour; if not, lay your hand upon your mouth.
verses.text: If you have understanding, answer your neighbour; if not, lay your hand upon your mouth.

verses.raw: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall.
verses.text: Honour and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall.

verses.raw: Be not called a whisperer, and lie not in wait with your tongue: for a foul shame is upon the thief, and an evil condemnation upon the double tongue.
verses.text: Be not called a whisperer, and lie not in wait with your tongue: for a foul shame is upon the thief, and an evil condemnation upon the double tongue.

verses.raw: Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small. ⸻
verses.text: Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small. ⸻

verses.raw: Instead of a friend become not an enemy; for thereby you shall inherit an ill name, shame, and reproach: even so shall a sinner that has a double tongue.
verses.text: Instead of a friend become not an enemy; for thereby you shall inherit an ill name, shame, and reproach: even so shall a sinner that has a double tongue.

verses.raw: Extol not thyself in the counsel of your own heart; that your soul be not torn in pieces as a bull straying alone.
verses.text: Extol not thyself in the counsel of your own heart; that your soul be not torn in pieces as a bull straying alone.

verses.raw: You shall eat up your leaves, and lose your fruit, and leave thyself as a dry tree.
verses.text: You shall eat up your leaves, and lose your fruit, and leave thyself as a dry tree.

verses.raw: A wicked soul shall destroy him that has it, and shall make him to be laughed to scorn of his enemies.
verses.text: A wicked soul shall destroy him that has it, and shall make him to be laughed to scorn of his enemies.

verses.raw: Sweet language will multiply friends: and a fairspeaking tongue will increase kind greetings.
verses.text: Sweet language will multiply friends: and a fairspeaking tongue will increase kind greetings.

verses.raw: Be in peace with many: nevertheless have but one counsellor of a thousand.
verses.text: Be in peace with many: nevertheless have but one counsellor of a thousand.

verses.raw: If you would get a friend, prove him first and be not hasty to credit him.
verses.text: If you would get a friend, prove him first and be not hasty to credit him.

verses.raw: For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble.
verses.text: For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble.

verses.raw: And there is a friend, who being turned to enmity, and strife will discover your reproach.
verses.text: And there is a friend, who being turned to enmity, and strife will discover your reproach.

verses.raw: Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of your affliction.
verses.text: Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of your affliction.

verses.raw: But in your prosperity he will be as thyself, and will be bold over your servants.
verses.text: But in your prosperity he will be as thyself, and will be bold over your servants.

verses.raw: If you be brought low, he will be against you, and will hide himself from your face.
verses.text: If you be brought low, he will be against you, and will hide himself from your face.

verses.raw: Separate thyself from your enemies, and take heed of your friends.
verses.text: Separate thyself from your enemies, and take heed of your friends.

verses.raw: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that has found such an one has found a treasure.
verses.text: A faithfull friend is a strong defence: and he that has found such an one has found a treasure.

verses.raw: Nothing does countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable.
verses.text: Nothing does countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable.

verses.raw: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear Yahuah (God) shall find him.
verses.text: A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear Yahuah shall find him.

verses.raw: Whoso fears Yahuah (God) shall direct his friendship aright: for as he is, so shall his neighbour be also.
verses.text: Whoso fears Yahuah shall direct his friendship aright: for as he is, so shall his neighbour be also.

verses.raw: My son, gather instruction from your youth up: so shall you find wisdom till your old age.
verses.text: My son, gather instruction from your youth up: so shall you find wisdom till your old age.

verses.raw: Come to her as one that ploweth and sows, and wait for her good fruits: for you shall not toil much in labouring about her, but you shall eat of her fruits right soon.
verses.text: Come to her as one that ploweth and sows, and wait for her good fruits: for you shall not toil much in labouring about her, but you shall eat of her fruits right soon.

verses.raw: She is very unpleasant to the unlearned: he that is without understanding will not remain with her.
verses.text: She is very unpleasant to the unlearned: he that is without understanding will not remain with her.

verses.raw: She will lie upon him as a mighty stone of trial; and he will cast her from him ere it be long.
verses.text: She will lie upon him as a mighty stone of trial; and he will cast her from him ere it be long.

verses.raw: For wisdom is according to her name, and she is not manifest to many.
verses.text: For wisdom is according to her name, and she is not manifest to many.

verses.raw: Give ear, my son, receive my advice, and refuse not my counsel,
verses.text: Give ear, my son, receive my advice, and refuse not my counsel,

verses.raw: And put your feet into her fetters, and your neck into her chain.
verses.text: And put your feet into her fetters, and your neck into her chain.

verses.raw: Bow down your shoulder, and bear her, and be not grieved with her bonds.
verses.text: Bow down your shoulder, and bear her, and be not grieved with her bonds.

verses.raw: Come to her with your whole heart, and keep her ways with all your power.
verses.text: Come to her with your whole heart, and keep her ways with all your power.

verses.raw: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known to you: and when you have got hold of her, let her not go.
verses.text: Search, and seek, and she shall be made known to you: and when you have got hold of her, let her not go.

verses.raw: For at the last you shall find her rest, and that shall be turned to your joy.
verses.text: For at the last you shall find her rest, and that shall be turned to your joy.

verses.raw: Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for you, and her chains a robe of glory.
verses.text: Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for you, and her chains a robe of glory.

verses.raw: For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are purple lace.
verses.text: For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are purple lace.

verses.raw: You shall put her on as a robe of honour, and shall put her about you as a crown of joy.
verses.text: You shall put her on as a robe of honour, and shall put her about you as a crown of joy.

verses.raw: My son, if you will, you shall be taught: and if you will apply your mind, you shall be prudent.
verses.text: My son, if you will, you shall be taught: and if you will apply your mind, you shall be prudent.

verses.raw: If you love to hear, you shall receive understanding: and if you bow your ear, you shall be wise,
verses.text: If you love to hear, you shall receive understanding: and if you bow your ear, you shall be wise,

verses.raw: Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave to him that is wise.
verses.text: Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave to him that is wise.

verses.raw: Be willing to hear every godly discourse; and let not the parables of understanding escape you.
verses.text: Be willing to hear every godly discourse; and let not the parables of understanding escape you.

verses.raw: And if you see a man of understanding, get you betimes to him, and let your foot wear the steps of his door.
verses.text: And if you see a man of understanding, get you betimes to him, and let your foot wear the steps of his door.

verses.raw: Let your mind be upon the ordinances of Yahuah (God) and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish yours heart, and give you wisdom at your owns desire. ⸻
verses.text: Let your mind be upon the ordinances of Yahuah and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish yours heart, and give you wisdom at your owns desire. ⸻

verses.raw: Do no evil, so shall no harm come to you.
verses.text: Do no evil, so shall no harm come to you.

verses.raw: Depart from the unjust, and iniquity shall turn away from you.
verses.text: Depart from the unjust, and iniquity shall turn away from you.

verses.raw: My son, sow not upon the furrows of unrighteousness, and you shall not reap them sevenfold.
verses.text: My son, sow not upon the furrows of unrighteousness, and you shall not reap them sevenfold.

verses.raw: Seek not of Yahuah (God) preeminence, neither of the king the seat of honour.
verses.text: Seek not of Yahuah preeminence, neither of the king the seat of honour.

verses.raw: justify not thyself before Yahuah (God); and boast not of your wisdom before the king.
verses.text: justify not thyself before Yahuah; and boast not of your wisdom before the king.

verses.raw: Seek not to be judge, being not able to take away iniquity; lest at any time you fear the person of the mighty, an stumblingblock in the way of your uprightness.
verses.text: Seek not to be judge, being not able to take away iniquity; lest at any time you fear the person of the mighty, an stumblingblock in the way of your uprightness.

verses.raw: Offend not against the multitude of a city, and then you shall not cast thyself down among the people.
verses.text: Offend not against the multitude of a city, and then you shall not cast thyself down among the people.

verses.raw: Bind not one sin upon another; for in one you shall not be unpunished.
verses.text: Bind not one sin upon another; for in one you shall not be unpunished.

verses.raw: Say not, Yahuah (God) will look upon the multitude of my oblations, and when I offer to the most high Yahuah (God), he will accept it.
verses.text: Say not, Yahuah will look upon the multitude of my oblations, and when I offer to the most high Yahuah, he will accept it.

verses.raw: Be not fainthearted when you makest your prayer, and neglect not to give alms.
verses.text: Be not fainthearted when you makest your prayer, and neglect not to give alms.

verses.raw: Laugh no man to scorn in the bitterness of his soul: for there is one which humbleth and exalteth.
verses.text: Laugh no man to scorn in the bitterness of his soul: for there is one which humbleth and exalteth.

verses.raw: Devise not a lie against your brother; neither do the like to your friend.
verses.text: Devise not a lie against your brother; neither do the like to your friend.

verses.raw: Use not to make any manner of lie: for the custom thereof is not good.
verses.text: Use not to make any manner of lie: for the custom thereof is not good.

verses.raw: Use not many words in a multitude of elders, and make not much babbling when you prayest.
verses.text: Use not many words in a multitude of elders, and make not much babbling when you prayest.

verses.raw: Hate not laborious work, neither husbandry, which the Most High has ordained.
verses.text: Hate not laborious work, neither husbandry, which the Most High has ordained.

verses.raw: Number not thyself among the multitude of sinners, but remember that wrath will not tarry long.
verses.text: Number not thyself among the multitude of sinners, but remember that wrath will not tarry long.

verses.raw: Humble thyself greatly: for the vengeance of the ungodly is fire and worms.
verses.text: Humble thyself greatly: for the vengeance of the ungodly is fire and worms.

verses.raw: Change not a friend for any good by no means; neither a faithful brother for the gold of Ophir.
verses.text: Change not a friend for any good by no means; neither a faithful brother for the gold of Ophir.

verses.raw: Forego not a wise and good woman: for her grace is above gold.
verses.text: Forego not a wise and good woman: for her grace is above gold.

verses.raw: Whereas your servant works truly, entreat him not evil, nor the hireling that bestoweth himself wholly for you.
verses.text: Whereas your servant works truly, entreat him not evil, nor the hireling that bestoweth himself wholly for you.

verses.raw: Let your soul love a good servant, and defraud him not of liberty.
verses.text: Let your soul love a good servant, and defraud him not of liberty.

verses.raw: Have you cattle? have an eye to them: and if they be for your profit, keep them with you.
verses.text: Have you cattle? have an eye to them: and if they be for your profit, keep them with you.

verses.raw: Have you children? instruct them, and bow down their neck from their youth.
verses.text: Have you children? instruct them, and bow down their neck from their youth.

verses.raw: Have you daughters? have a care of their body, and shew not thyself cheerful toward them.
verses.text: Have you daughters? have a care of their body, and shew not thyself cheerful toward them.

verses.raw: Marry your daughter, and so shall you have performed a weighty matter: but give her to a man of understanding.
verses.text: Marry your daughter, and so shall you have performed a weighty matter: but give her to a man of understanding.

verses.raw: Have you a wife after your mind? forsake her not: but give not thyself over to a light woman.
verses.text: Have you a wife after your mind? forsake her not: but give not thyself over to a light woman.

verses.raw: Honour your father with your whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of your mother.
verses.text: Honour your father with your whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of your mother.

verses.raw: Remember that you were begotten of them; and how can you recompense them the things that they have done for you?
verses.text: Remember that you were begotten of them; and how can you recompense them the things that they have done for you?

verses.raw: Fear Yahuah (God) with all your soul, and reverence his priests.
verses.text: Fear Yahuah with all your soul, and reverence his priests.

verses.raw: Love him that made you with all your strength, and forsake not his ministers.
verses.text: Love him that made you with all your strength, and forsake not his ministers.

verses.raw: Fear Yahuah (God), and honor the priest; and give him his portion, as it is commanded you; the firstfruits, and the trespass offering, and the gift of the shoulders, and the sacrifice of sanctification, and the firstfruits of the holy things.
verses.text: Fear Yahuah, and honor the priest; and give him his portion, as it is commanded you; the firstfruits, and the trespass offering, and the gift of the shoulders, and the sacrifice of sanctification, and the firstfruits of the holy things.

verses.raw: And stretch yours hand to the poor, that your blessing may be perfected.
verses.text: And stretch yours hand to the poor, that your blessing may be perfected.

verses.raw: A gift has grace in the sight of every man living; and for the dead detain it not.
verses.text: A gift has grace in the sight of every man living; and for the dead detain it not.

verses.raw: Fail not to be with them that weep, and mourn with them that mourn.
verses.text: Fail not to be with them that weep, and mourn with them that mourn.

verses.raw: Be not slow to visit the sick: for that shall make you to be beloved.
verses.text: Be not slow to visit the sick: for that shall make you to be beloved.

verses.raw: Whatsoever you take in hand, remember the end, and you shall never do amiss. ⸻
verses.text: Whatsoever you take in hand, remember the end, and you shall never do amiss. ⸻

verses.raw: Strive not with a mighty man’ lest you fall into his hands.
verses.text: Strive not with a mighty man’ lest you fall into his hands.

verses.raw: Be not at variance with a rich man, lest he overweigh you: for gold has destroyed many, and perverted the hearts of kings.
verses.text: Be not at variance with a rich man, lest he overweigh you: for gold has destroyed many, and perverted the hearts of kings.

verses.raw: Strive not with a man that is full of tongue, and heap not wood upon his fire.
verses.text: Strive not with a man that is full of tongue, and heap not wood upon his fire.

verses.raw: Jest not with a rude man, lest your ancestors be disgraced.
verses.text: Jest not with a rude man, lest your ancestors be disgraced.

verses.raw: Reproach not a man that turns from sin, but remember that we are all worthy of punishment.
verses.text: Reproach not a man that turns from sin, but remember that we are all worthy of punishment.

verses.raw: Dishonour not a man in his old age: for even some of us wax old.
verses.text: Dishonour not a man in his old age: for even some of us wax old.

verses.raw: Rejoice not over your greatest enemy being dead, but remember that we die all.
verses.text: Rejoice not over your greatest enemy being dead, but remember that we die all.

verses.raw: Despise not the discourse of the wise, but acquaint thyself with their proverbs: for of them you shall learn instruction, and how to serve great men with ease.
verses.text: Despise not the discourse of the wise, but acquaint thyself with their proverbs: for of them you shall learn instruction, and how to serve great men with ease.

verses.raw: Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers, and of them you shall learn understanding, and to give answer as need requires.
verses.text: Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers, and of them you shall learn understanding, and to give answer as need requires.

verses.raw: Kindle not the coals of a sinner, lest you be burnt with the flame of his fire.
verses.text: Kindle not the coals of a sinner, lest you be burnt with the flame of his fire.

verses.raw: Rise not up in anger at the presence of an injurious person, lest he lie in wait to entrap you in your words
verses.text: Rise not up in anger at the presence of an injurious person, lest he lie in wait to entrap you in your words

verses.raw: Lend not to him that is mightier than thyself; for if you lendest him, count it but lost.
verses.text: Lend not to him that is mightier than thyself; for if you lendest him, count it but lost.

verses.raw: Be not surety above your power: for if you be surety, take care to pay it.
verses.text: Be not surety above your power: for if you be surety, take care to pay it.

verses.raw: Go not to law with a judge; for they will judge for him according to his honour.
verses.text: Go not to law with a judge; for they will judge for him according to his honour.

verses.raw: Travel not by the way with a bold fellow, lest he become grievous to you: for he will do according to his own will, and you shall perish with him through his folly.
verses.text: Travel not by the way with a bold fellow, lest he become grievous to you: for he will do according to his own will, and you shall perish with him through his folly.

verses.raw: Strive not with an angry man, and go not with him into a solitary place: for blood is as nothing in his sight, and where there is no help, he will overthrow you.
verses.text: Strive not with an angry man, and go not with him into a solitary place: for blood is as nothing in his sight, and where there is no help, he will overthrow you.

verses.raw: Consult not with a fool; for he cannot keep counsel.
verses.text: Consult not with a fool; for he cannot keep counsel.

verses.raw: Do no secret thing before a stranger; for you know not what he will bring forth.
verses.text: Do no secret thing before a stranger; for you know not what he will bring forth.

verses.raw: Open not yours heart to every man, lest he requite you with a shrewd turn. ⸻
verses.text: Open not yours heart to every man, lest he requite you with a shrewd turn. ⸻

verses.raw: Be not jealous over the wife of your bosom, and teach her not an evil lesson against thyself.
verses.text: Be not jealous over the wife of your bosom, and teach her not an evil lesson against thyself.

verses.raw: Give not your soul to a woman to set her foot upon your substance.
verses.text: Give not your soul to a woman to set her foot upon your substance.

verses.raw: Meet not with an harlot, lest you fall into her snares.
verses.text: Meet not with an harlot, lest you fall into her snares.

verses.raw: Use not much the company of a woman that is a singer, lest you be taken with her attempts.
verses.text: Use not much the company of a woman that is a singer, lest you be taken with her attempts.

verses.raw: Gaze not on a maid, that you fall not by those things that are precious in her.
verses.text: Gaze not on a maid, that you fall not by those things that are precious in her.

verses.raw: Give not your soul to harlots, that you lose not your inheritance.
verses.text: Give not your soul to harlots, that you lose not your inheritance.

verses.raw: Look not round about you in the streets of the city, neither wander you in the solitary place thereof.
verses.text: Look not round about you in the streets of the city, neither wander you in the solitary place thereof.

verses.raw: Turn away your eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another’s beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire.
verses.text: Turn away your eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another’s beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire.

verses.raw: Sit not at all with another man’s wife, nor sit down with her in your arms, and spend not your money with her at the wine; lest yours heart incline to her, and so through your desire you fall into destruction.
verses.text: Sit not at all with another man’s wife, nor sit down with her in your arms, and spend not your money with her at the wine; lest yours heart incline to her, and so through your desire you fall into destruction.

verses.raw: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, you shall drink it with pleasure.
verses.text: Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, you shall drink it with pleasure.

verses.raw: Envy not the glory of a sinner: for you know not what shall be his end.
verses.text: Envy not the glory of a sinner: for you know not what shall be his end.

verses.raw: Delight not in the thing that the ungodly have pleasure in; but remember they shall not go unpunished to their grave.
verses.text: Delight not in the thing that the ungodly have pleasure in; but remember they shall not go unpunished to their grave.

verses.raw: Keep you far from the man that has power to kill; so shall you not doubt the fear of death: and if you come to him, make no fault, lest he take away your life presently: remember that you go in the midst of snares, and that you walkest upon the battlements of the city.
verses.text: Keep you far from the man that has power to kill; so shall you not doubt the fear of death: and if you come to him, make no fault, lest he take away your life presently: remember that you go in the midst of snares, and that you walkest upon the battlements of the city.

verses.raw: As near as you can, guess at your neighbour, and consult with the wise.
verses.text: As near as you can, guess at your neighbour, and consult with the wise.

verses.raw: Let your talk be with the wise, and all your communication in the law of the Most High.
verses.text: Let your talk be with the wise, and all your communication in the law of the Most High.

verses.raw: And let just men eat and drink with you; and let your glorying be in the fear of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And let just men eat and drink with you; and let your glorying be in the fear of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For the hand of the artificer the work shall be commended: and the wise ruler of the people for his speech.
verses.text: For the hand of the artificer the work shall be commended: and the wise ruler of the people for his speech.

verses.raw: A man of an ill tongue is dangerous in his city; and he that is rash in his talk shall be hated. ⸻
verses.text: A man of an ill tongue is dangerous in his city; and he that is rash in his talk shall be hated. ⸻

verses.raw: A wise judge will instruct his people; and the government of a prudent man is well ordered.
verses.text: A wise judge will instruct his people; and the government of a prudent man is well ordered.

verses.raw: As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers; and what manner of man the ruler of the city is, such are all they that dwell in it.
verses.text: As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers; and what manner of man the ruler of the city is, such are all they that dwell in it.

verses.raw: An unwise king destroys his people; but through the prudence of them which are in authority the city shall be inhabited.
verses.text: An unwise king destroys his people; but through the prudence of them which are in authority the city shall be inhabited.

verses.raw: The power of the earth is in the hand of Yahuah (God), and in due time he will set over it one that is profitable.
verses.text: The power of the earth is in the hand of Yahuah, and in due time he will set over it one that is profitable.

verses.raw: In the hand of Yahuah (God) is the prosperity of man: and upon the person of the scribe shall he lay his honour.
verses.text: In the hand of Yahuah is the prosperity of man: and upon the person of the scribe shall he lay his honour.

verses.raw: Bear not hatred to your neighbour for every wrong; and do nothing at all by injurious practices.
verses.text: Bear not hatred to your neighbour for every wrong; and do nothing at all by injurious practices.

verses.raw: Pride is hateful before Yahuah (God) and man: and by both does one commit iniquity.
verses.text: Pride is hateful before Yahuah and man: and by both does one commit iniquity.

verses.raw: Because of unrighteous dealings, injuries, and riches got by deceit, the kingdom is translated from one people to another.
verses.text: Because of unrighteous dealings, injuries, and riches got by deceit, the kingdom is translated from one people to another.

verses.raw: Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man: for such an one sets his own soul to sale; because while he lives he casteth away his bowels.
verses.text: Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man: for such an one sets his own soul to sale; because while he lives he casteth away his bowels.

verses.raw: The physician cutteth off a long disease; and he that is to day a king to morrow shall die.
verses.text: The physician cutteth off a long disease; and he that is to day a king to morrow shall die.

verses.raw: For when a man is dead, he shall inherit creeping things, beasts, and worms.
verses.text: For when a man is dead, he shall inherit creeping things, beasts, and worms.

verses.raw: The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah (God), and his heart is turned away from his Maker.
verses.text: The beginning of pride is when one departs from Yahuah, and his heart is turned away from his Maker.

verses.raw: For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that has it shall pour out abomination: and therefore Yahuah (God) brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.
verses.text: For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that has it shall pour out abomination: and therefore Yahuah brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) has cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead.
verses.text: Yahuah has cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) has plucked up the roots of the proud nations, and planted the lowly in their place.
verses.text: Yahuah has plucked up the roots of the proud nations, and planted the lowly in their place.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) overthrew countries of the heathen, and destroyed them to the foundations of the earth.
verses.text: Yahuah overthrew countries of the heathen, and destroyed them to the foundations of the earth.

verses.raw: He took some of them away, and destroyed them, and has made their memorial to cease from the earth.
verses.text: He took some of them away, and destroyed them, and has made their memorial to cease from the earth.

verses.raw: Pride was not made for men, nor furious anger for them that are born of a woman.
verses.text: Pride was not made for men, nor furious anger for them that are born of a woman.

verses.raw: They that fear Yahuah (God) are a sure seed, and they that love him an honourable plant: they that regard not the law are a dishonourable seed; they that transgress the commandments are a deceivable seed.
verses.text: They that fear Yahuah are a sure seed, and they that love him an honourable plant: they that regard not the law are a dishonourable seed; they that transgress the commandments are a deceivable seed.

verses.raw: Among brothers he that is chief is honorable; so are they that fear Yahuah (God) in his eyes.
verses.text: Among brothers he that is chief is honorable; so are they that fear Yahuah in his eyes.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (God) goes before the obtaining of authority: but roughness and pride is the losing thereof.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah goes before the obtaining of authority: but roughness and pride is the losing thereof.

verses.raw: Whether he be rich, noble, or poor, their glory is the fear of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Whether he be rich, noble, or poor, their glory is the fear of Yahuah.

verses.raw: It is not meet to despise the poor man that has understanding; neither is it convenient to magnify a sinful man.
verses.text: It is not meet to despise the poor man that has understanding; neither is it convenient to magnify a sinful man.

verses.raw: Great men, and judges, and potentates, shall be honoured; yet is there none of them greater than he that fears Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Great men, and judges, and potentates, shall be honoured; yet is there none of them greater than he that fears Yahuah.

verses.raw: To the servant that is wise shall they that are free do service: and he that has knowledge will not grudge when he is reformed.
verses.text: To the servant that is wise shall they that are free do service: and he that has knowledge will not grudge when he is reformed.

verses.raw: Be not overwise in doing your business; and boast not thyself in the time of your distress.
verses.text: Be not overwise in doing your business; and boast not thyself in the time of your distress.

verses.raw: Better is he that laboureth, and abounds in all things, than he that boasteth himself, and wanteth bread.
verses.text: Better is he that laboureth, and abounds in all things, than he that boasteth himself, and wanteth bread.

verses.raw: My son, glorify your soul in meekness, and give it honour according to the dignity thereof.
verses.text: My son, glorify your soul in meekness, and give it honour according to the dignity thereof.

verses.raw: Who will justify him that sinneth against his own soul? and who will honour him that dishonoureth his own life?
verses.text: Who will justify him that sinneth against his own soul? and who will honour him that dishonoureth his own life?

verses.raw: The poor man is honoured for his skill, and the rich man is honoured for his riches.
verses.text: The poor man is honoured for his skill, and the rich man is honoured for his riches.

verses.raw: He that is honoured in poverty, how much more in riches? and he that is dishonourable in riches, how much more in poverty? ⸻
verses.text: He that is honoured in poverty, how much more in riches? and he that is dishonourable in riches, how much more in poverty? ⸻

verses.raw: Wisdom lifteth up the head of him that is of low degree, and makes him to sit among great men.
verses.text: Wisdom lifteth up the head of him that is of low degree, and makes him to sit among great men.

verses.raw: Commend not a man for his beauty; neither abhor a man for his outward appearance.
verses.text: Commend not a man for his beauty; neither abhor a man for his outward appearance.

verses.raw: The bee is little among such as fly; but her fruit is the chief of sweet things.
verses.text: The bee is little among such as fly; but her fruit is the chief of sweet things.

verses.raw: Boast not of your clothing and raiment, and exalt not thyself in the day of honour: for the works of Yahuah (God) are wonderful, and his works among men are hidden.
verses.text: Boast not of your clothing and raiment, and exalt not thyself in the day of honour: for the works of Yahuah are wonderful, and his works among men are hidden.

verses.raw: Many kings have sat down upon the ground; and one that was never thought of has worn the crown.
verses.text: Many kings have sat down upon the ground; and one that was never thought of has worn the crown.

verses.raw: Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced; and the honourable delivered into other men’s hands.
verses.text: Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced; and the honourable delivered into other men’s hands.

verses.raw: Blame not before you have examined the truth: understand first, and then rebuke.
verses.text: Blame not before you have examined the truth: understand first, and then rebuke.

verses.raw: Answer not before you have heard the cause: neither interrupt men in the midst of their talk.
verses.text: Answer not before you have heard the cause: neither interrupt men in the midst of their talk.

verses.raw: Strive not in a matter that concerneth you not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.
verses.text: Strive not in a matter that concerneth you not; and sit not in judgment with sinners.

verses.raw: My son, meddle not with many matters: for if you meddle much, you shall not be innocent; and if you follow after, you shall not obtain, neither shall you escape by fleeing.
verses.text: My son, meddle not with many matters: for if you meddle much, you shall not be innocent; and if you follow after, you shall not obtain, neither shall you escape by fleeing.

verses.raw: There is one that laboureth, and takes pains, and makes haste, and is so much the more behind.
verses.text: There is one that laboureth, and takes pains, and makes haste, and is so much the more behind.

verses.raw: Again, there is another that is slow, and has need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty; yet the eye of Yahuah (God) looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate,
verses.text: Again, there is another that is slow, and has need of help, wanting ability, and full of poverty; yet the eye of Yahuah looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate,

verses.raw: And lifted up his head from misery; so that many that saw it marvelled at him.
verses.text: And lifted up his head from misery; so that many that saw it marvelled at him.

verses.raw: Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Wisdom, knowledge, and understanding of the law, are of Yahuah (God): love, and the way of good works, are from him.
verses.text: Wisdom, knowledge, and understanding of the law, are of Yahuah: love, and the way of good works, are from him.

verses.raw: Error and darkness had their beginning together with sinners: and evil shall wax old with them that glory in it.
verses.text: Error and darkness had their beginning together with sinners: and evil shall wax old with them that glory in it.

verses.raw: The gift of Yahuah (God) remains with the ungodly, and his favour brings prosperity for ever.
verses.text: The gift of Yahuah remains with the ungodly, and his favour brings prosperity for ever.

verses.raw: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward:
verses.text: There is that waxeth rich by his wariness and pinching, and this is the portion of his reward:

verses.raw: Whereas he says, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.
verses.text: Whereas he says, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.

verses.raw: Be stedfast in your covenant, and be conversant in it, and wax old in your work.
verses.text: Be stedfast in your covenant, and be conversant in it, and wax old in your work.

verses.raw: Marvel not at the works of sinners; but trust in Yahuah (God), and abide in your labour: for it is an easy thing in the sight of Yahuah (God) on the sudden to make a poor man rich.
verses.text: Marvel not at the works of sinners; but trust in Yahuah, and abide in your labour: for it is an easy thing in the sight of Yahuah on the sudden to make a poor man rich.

verses.raw: The blessing of Yahuah (God) is in the reward of the godly, and suddenly he makes his blessing flourish.
verses.text: The blessing of Yahuah is in the reward of the godly, and suddenly he makes his blessing flourish.

verses.raw: Say not, What profit is there of my service? and what good things shall I have hereafter?
verses.text: Say not, What profit is there of my service? and what good things shall I have hereafter?

verses.raw: Again, say not, I have enough, and possess many things, and what evil shall I have hereafter?
verses.text: Again, say not, I have enough, and possess many things, and what evil shall I have hereafter?

verses.raw: In the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction: and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity.
verses.text: In the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction: and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity.

verses.raw: For it is an easy thing to Yahuah (God) in the day of death to reward a man according to his ways.
verses.text: For it is an easy thing to Yahuah in the day of death to reward a man according to his ways.

verses.raw: The affliction of an hour makes a man forget pleasure: and in his end his deeds shall be discovered.
verses.text: The affliction of an hour makes a man forget pleasure: and in his end his deeds shall be discovered.

verses.raw: Judge none blessed before his death: for a man shall be known in his children.
verses.text: Judge none blessed before his death: for a man shall be known in his children.

verses.raw: Bring not every man into yours house: for the deceitful man has many trains.
verses.text: Bring not every man into yours house: for the deceitful man has many trains.

verses.raw: Like as a partridge taken and kept in a cage, so is the heart of the proud; and like as a spy, watcheth he for your fall:
verses.text: Like as a partridge taken and kept in a cage, so is the heart of the proud; and like as a spy, watcheth he for your fall:

verses.raw: For he lieth in wait, and turns good into evil, and in things worthy praise will lay blame upon you.
verses.text: For he lieth in wait, and turns good into evil, and in things worthy praise will lay blame upon you.

verses.raw: Of a spark of fire a heap of coals is kindled: and a sinful man layeth wait for blood.
verses.text: Of a spark of fire a heap of coals is kindled: and a sinful man layeth wait for blood.

verses.raw: Take heed of a mischievous man, for he works wickedness; lest he bring upon you a perpetual blot.
verses.text: Take heed of a mischievous man, for he works wickedness; lest he bring upon you a perpetual blot.

verses.raw: Receive a stranger into yours house, and he will disturb you, and turn you out of your own. ⸻
verses.text: Receive a stranger into yours house, and he will disturb you, and turn you out of your own. ⸻

verses.raw: When you will do good know to whom you do it; so shall you be thanked for your benefits.
verses.text: When you will do good know to whom you do it; so shall you be thanked for your benefits.

verses.raw: Do good to the godly man, and you shall find a recompence; and if not from him, yet from the Most High.
verses.text: Do good to the godly man, and you shall find a recompence; and if not from him, yet from the Most High.

verses.raw: There can no good come to him that is always occupied in evil, nor to him that gives no alms.
verses.text: There can no good come to him that is always occupied in evil, nor to him that gives no alms.

verses.raw: Give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.
verses.text: Give to the godly man, and help not a sinner.

verses.raw: Do well to him that is lowly, but give not to the ungodly: hold back your bread, and give it not to him, lest he overmaster you thereby: for else you shall receive twice as much evil for all the good you shall have done to him.
verses.text: Do well to him that is lowly, but give not to the ungodly: hold back your bread, and give it not to him, lest he overmaster you thereby: for else you shall receive twice as much evil for all the good you shall have done to him.

verses.raw: For the Most High hates sinners, and will repay vengeance to the ungodly, and keepeth them against the mighty day of their punishment.
verses.text: For the Most High hates sinners, and will repay vengeance to the ungodly, and keepeth them against the mighty day of their punishment.

verses.raw: Give to the good, and help not the sinner.
verses.text: Give to the good, and help not the sinner.

verses.raw: A friend cannot be known in prosperity: and an enemy cannot be hidden in adversity.
verses.text: A friend cannot be known in prosperity: and an enemy cannot be hidden in adversity.

verses.raw: In the prosperity of a man enemies will be grieved: but in his adversity even a friend will depart.
verses.text: In the prosperity of a man enemies will be grieved: but in his adversity even a friend will depart.

verses.raw: Never trust your enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.
verses.text: Never trust your enemy: for like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.

verses.raw: Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him, and you shall be to him as if you had wiped a lookingglass, and you shall know that his rust has not been altogether wiped away.
verses.text: Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him, and you shall be to him as if you had wiped a lookingglass, and you shall know that his rust has not been altogether wiped away.

verses.raw: Set him not by you, lest, when he has overthrown you, he stand up in your place; neither let him sit at your right hand, lest he seek to take your seat, and you at the last remember my words, and be pricked with it.
verses.text: Set him not by you, lest, when he has overthrown you, he stand up in your place; neither let him sit at your right hand, lest he seek to take your seat, and you at the last remember my words, and be pricked with it.

verses.raw: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent, or any such as come nigh wild beasts?
verses.text: Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent, or any such as come nigh wild beasts?

verses.raw: So one that goes to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity?
verses.text: So one that goes to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity?

verses.raw: For a while he will abide with you, but if you begin to fall, he will not tarry.
verses.text: For a while he will abide with you, but if you begin to fall, he will not tarry.

verses.raw: An enemy speaks sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagineth how to throw you into a pit: he will weep with his eyes, but if he find opportunity, he will not be satisfied with blood.
verses.text: An enemy speaks sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagineth how to throw you into a pit: he will weep with his eyes, but if he find opportunity, he will not be satisfied with blood.

verses.raw: If adversity come upon you, you shall find him there first; and though he pretend to help you, yet shall he undermine you.
verses.text: If adversity come upon you, you shall find him there first; and though he pretend to help you, yet shall he undermine you.

verses.raw: He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance. ⸻
verses.text: He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance. ⸻

verses.raw: He that toucheth pitch shall be defiled with it; and he that has fellowship with a proud man shall be like to him.
verses.text: He that toucheth pitch shall be defiled with it; and he that has fellowship with a proud man shall be like to him.

verses.raw: Burden not thyself above your power while you livest; and have no fellowship with one that is mightier and richer than thyself: for how agree the kettle and the earthen pot together? for if the one be struck against the other, it shall be broken.
verses.text: Burden not thyself above your power while you livest; and have no fellowship with one that is mightier and richer than thyself: for how agree the kettle and the earthen pot together? for if the one be struck against the other, it shall be broken.

verses.raw: The rich man has done wrong, and yet he threateneth withal: the poor is wronged, and he must intreat also.
verses.text: The rich man has done wrong, and yet he threateneth withal: the poor is wronged, and he must intreat also.

verses.raw: If you be for his profit, he will use you: but if you have nothing, he will forsake you.
verses.text: If you be for his profit, he will use you: but if you have nothing, he will forsake you.

verses.raw: If you have any thing, he will live with you: yes, he will make you bare, and will not be sorry for it.
verses.text: If you have any thing, he will live with you: yes, he will make you bare, and will not be sorry for it.

verses.raw: If he have need of you, he will deceive you, and smile upon you, and put you in hope; he will speak you fair, and say, What wantest you?
verses.text: If he have need of you, he will deceive you, and smile upon you, and put you in hope; he will speak you fair, and say, What wantest you?

verses.raw: And he will shame you by his meats, until he have drawn you dry twice or thrice, and at the last he will laugh you to scorn afterward, when he seeth you, he will forsake you, and shake his head at you.
verses.text: And he will shame you by his meats, until he have drawn you dry twice or thrice, and at the last he will laugh you to scorn afterward, when he seeth you, he will forsake you, and shake his head at you.

verses.raw: Beware that you be not deceived and brought down in your jollity.
verses.text: Beware that you be not deceived and brought down in your jollity.

verses.raw: If you be invited of a mighty man, withdraw thyself, and so much the more will he invite you.
verses.text: If you be invited of a mighty man, withdraw thyself, and so much the more will he invite you.

verses.raw: Press you not upon him, lest you be put back; stand not far off, lest you be forgotten.
verses.text: Press you not upon him, lest you be put back; stand not far off, lest you be forgotten.

verses.raw: Affect not to be made equal to him in talk, and believe not his many words: for with much communication will he tempt you, and smiling upon you will get out your secrets:
verses.text: Affect not to be made equal to him in talk, and believe not his many words: for with much communication will he tempt you, and smiling upon you will get out your secrets:

verses.raw: But cruelly he will lay up your words, and will not spare to do you hurt, and to put you in prison.
verses.text: But cruelly he will lay up your words, and will not spare to do you hurt, and to put you in prison.

verses.raw: Observe, and take good heed, for you walkest in peril of your overthrowing: when you hear these things, awake in your sleep.
verses.text: Observe, and take good heed, for you walkest in peril of your overthrowing: when you hear these things, awake in your sleep.

verses.raw: Love Yahuah (God) all your life, and call upon him for your salvation.
verses.text: Love Yahuah all your life, and call upon him for your salvation.

verses.raw: Every beast loves his like, and every man loves his neighbor.
verses.text: Every beast loves his like, and every man loves his neighbor.

verses.raw: All flesh consorteth according to kind, and a man will cleave to his like.
verses.text: All flesh consorteth according to kind, and a man will cleave to his like.

verses.raw: What fellowship has the wolf with the lamb? so the sinner with the godly.
verses.text: What fellowship has the wolf with the lamb? so the sinner with the godly.

verses.raw: What agreement is there between the hyena and a dog? and what peace between the rich and the poor?
verses.text: What agreement is there between the hyena and a dog? and what peace between the rich and the poor?

verses.raw: As the wild ass is the lion’s prey in the wilderness: so the rich eat up the poor.
verses.text: As the wild ass is the lion’s prey in the wilderness: so the rich eat up the poor.

verses.raw: As the proud hate humility: so does the rich abhor the poor.
verses.text: As the proud hate humility: so does the rich abhor the poor.

verses.raw: A rich man beginning to fall is held up of his friends: but a poor man being down is thrust away by his friends.
verses.text: A rich man beginning to fall is held up of his friends: but a poor man being down is thrust away by his friends.

verses.raw: When a rich man is fallen, he has many helpers: he speaks things not to be spoken, and yet men justify him: the poor man slipped, and yet they rebuked him too; he spoke wisely, and could have no place.
verses.text: When a rich man is fallen, he has many helpers: he speaks things not to be spoken, and yet men justify him: the poor man slipped, and yet they rebuked him too; he spoke wisely, and could have no place.

verses.raw: When a rich man speaks, every man holdeth his tongue, and, look, what he says, they extol it to the clouds: but if the poor man speak, they say, What fellow is this? and if he stumble, they will help to overthrow him.
verses.text: When a rich man speaks, every man holdeth his tongue, and, look, what he says, they extol it to the clouds: but if the poor man speak, they say, What fellow is this? and if he stumble, they will help to overthrow him.

verses.raw: Riches are good to him that has no sin, and poverty is evil in the mouth of the ungodly.
verses.text: Riches are good to him that has no sin, and poverty is evil in the mouth of the ungodly.

verses.raw: The heart of a man changeth his countenance, whether it be for good or evil: and a merry heart makes a cheerful countenance.
verses.text: The heart of a man changeth his countenance, whether it be for good or evil: and a merry heart makes a cheerful countenance.

verses.raw: A cheerful countenance is a token of a heart that is in prosperity; and the finding out of parables is a wearisome labour of the mind. ⸻
verses.text: A cheerful countenance is a token of a heart that is in prosperity; and the finding out of parables is a wearisome labour of the mind. ⸻

verses.raw: Blessed is the man that has not slipped with his mouth, and is not pricked with the multitude of sins.
verses.text: Blessed is the man that has not slipped with his mouth, and is not pricked with the multitude of sins.

verses.raw: Blessed is he whose conscience has not condemned him, and who is not fallen from his hope in Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Blessed is he whose conscience has not condemned him, and who is not fallen from his hope in Yahuah.

verses.raw: Riches are not comely for a niggard: and what should an envious man do with money?
verses.text: Riches are not comely for a niggard: and what should an envious man do with money?

verses.raw: He that gathers by defrauding his own soul gathers for others, that shall spend his goods riotously.
verses.text: He that gathers by defrauding his own soul gathers for others, that shall spend his goods riotously.

verses.raw: He that is evil to himself, to whom will he be good? he shall not take pleasure in his goods.
verses.text: He that is evil to himself, to whom will he be good? he shall not take pleasure in his goods.

verses.raw: There is none worse than he that envies himself; and this is a recompence of his wickedness.
verses.text: There is none worse than he that envies himself; and this is a recompence of his wickedness.

verses.raw: And if he doeth good, he doeth it unwillingly; and at the last he will declare his wickedness.
verses.text: And if he doeth good, he doeth it unwillingly; and at the last he will declare his wickedness.

verses.raw: The envious man has a wicked eye; he turns away his face, and despiseth men.
verses.text: The envious man has a wicked eye; he turns away his face, and despiseth men.

verses.raw: A covetous man’s eye is not satisfied with his portion; and the iniquity of the wicked drieth up his soul.
verses.text: A covetous man’s eye is not satisfied with his portion; and the iniquity of the wicked drieth up his soul.

verses.raw: A wicked eye envies his bread, and he is a niggard at his table.
verses.text: A wicked eye envies his bread, and he is a niggard at his table.

verses.raw: My son, according to your ability do good to thyself, and give Yahuah (God) his due offering.
verses.text: My son, according to your ability do good to thyself, and give Yahuah his due offering.

verses.raw: Remember that death will not be long in coming, and that the covenant of the grave is not shewed to you.
verses.text: Remember that death will not be long in coming, and that the covenant of the grave is not shewed to you.

verses.raw: Do good to your friend before you die, and according to your ability stretch out your hand and give to him.
verses.text: Do good to your friend before you die, and according to your ability stretch out your hand and give to him.

verses.raw: Defraud not thyself of the good day, and let not the part of a good desire overpass you.
verses.text: Defraud not thyself of the good day, and let not the part of a good desire overpass you.

verses.raw: Shall you not leave your travails to another? and your labours to be divided by lot?
verses.text: Shall you not leave your travails to another? and your labours to be divided by lot?

verses.raw: Give, and take, and sanctify your soul; for there is no seeking of dainties in the grave.
verses.text: Give, and take, and sanctify your soul; for there is no seeking of dainties in the grave.

verses.raw: All flesh waxeth old as a garment: for the covenant from the beginning is, You shall die the death.
verses.text: All flesh waxeth old as a garment: for the covenant from the beginning is, You shall die the death.

verses.raw: As of the green leaves on a thick tree, some fall, and some grow; so is the generation of flesh and blood, one comes to an end, and another is born.
verses.text: As of the green leaves on a thick tree, some fall, and some grow; so is the generation of flesh and blood, one comes to an end, and another is born.

verses.raw: Every work rotteth and consumeth away, and the worker thereof shall go withal.
verses.text: Every work rotteth and consumeth away, and the worker thereof shall go withal.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man that does meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasoneth of holy things by his understanding.
verses.text: Blessed is the man that does meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasoneth of holy things by his understanding.

verses.raw: He that considereth her ways in his heart shall also have understanding in her secrets.
verses.text: He that considereth her ways in his heart shall also have understanding in her secrets.

verses.raw: Go after her as one that traceth, and lie in wait in her ways.
verses.text: Go after her as one that traceth, and lie in wait in her ways.

verses.raw: He that prieth in at her windows shall also hearken at her doors.
verses.text: He that prieth in at her windows shall also hearken at her doors.

verses.raw: He that does lodge near her house shall also fasten a pin in her walls.
verses.text: He that does lodge near her house shall also fasten a pin in her walls.

verses.raw: He shall pitch his tent nigh to her, and shall lodge in a lodging where good things are.
verses.text: He shall pitch his tent nigh to her, and shall lodge in a lodging where good things are.

verses.raw: He shall set his children under her shelter, and shall lodge under her branches.
verses.text: He shall set his children under her shelter, and shall lodge under her branches.

verses.raw: By her he shall be covered from heat, and in her glory shall he dwell. ⸻
verses.text: By her he shall be covered from heat, and in her glory shall he dwell. ⸻

verses.raw: He that fears Yahuah (God) will do good, and he that has the knowledge of the law shall obtain her.
verses.text: He that fears Yahuah will do good, and he that has the knowledge of the law shall obtain her.

verses.raw: And as a mother shall she meet him, and receive him as a wife married of a virgin.
verses.text: And as a mother shall she meet him, and receive him as a wife married of a virgin.

verses.raw: With the bread of understanding shall she feed him, and give him the water of wisdom to drink.
verses.text: With the bread of understanding shall she feed him, and give him the water of wisdom to drink.

verses.raw: He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; and shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded.
verses.text: He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; and shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded.

verses.raw: She shall exalt him above his neighbours, and in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth.
verses.text: She shall exalt him above his neighbours, and in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth.

verses.raw: He shall find joy and a crown of gladness, and she shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name.
verses.text: He shall find joy and a crown of gladness, and she shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name.

verses.raw: But foolish men shall not attain to her, and sinners shall not see her.
verses.text: But foolish men shall not attain to her, and sinners shall not see her.

verses.raw: For she is far from pride, and men that are liars cannot remember her.
verses.text: For she is far from pride, and men that are liars cannot remember her.

verses.raw: Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For praise shall be uttered in wisdom, and Yahuah (God) will prosper it.
verses.text: For praise shall be uttered in wisdom, and Yahuah will prosper it.

verses.raw: Say not you, It is through Yahuah (God) that I fell away: for you oughtest not to do the things that he hates.
verses.text: Say not you, It is through Yahuah that I fell away: for you oughtest not to do the things that he hates.

verses.raw: Say not you, He has caused me to err: for he has no need of the sinful man.
verses.text: Say not you, He has caused me to err: for he has no need of the sinful man.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) hates all abomination; and they that fear Yahuah (God) love it not.
verses.text: Yahuah hates all abomination; and they that fear Yahuah love it not.

verses.raw: He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel;
verses.text: He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel;

verses.raw: If you will, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness.
verses.text: If you will, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness.

verses.raw: He has set fire and water before you: stretch forth your hand to whether you will.
verses.text: He has set fire and water before you: stretch forth your hand to whether you will.

verses.raw: Before man is life and death; and whether him liketh shall be given him.
verses.text: Before man is life and death; and whether him liketh shall be given him.

verses.raw: For the wisdom of Yahuah (God) is great, and he is mighty in power, and beholds all things:
verses.text: For the wisdom of Yahuah is great, and he is mighty in power, and beholds all things:

verses.raw: And his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knoweth every work of man.
verses.text: And his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knoweth every work of man.

verses.raw: He has commanded no man to do wickedly, neither has he given any man licence to sin. ⸻
verses.text: He has commanded no man to do wickedly, neither has he given any man licence to sin. ⸻

verses.raw: Desire not a multitude of unprofitable children, neither delight in ungodly sons.
verses.text: Desire not a multitude of unprofitable children, neither delight in ungodly sons.

verses.raw: Though they multiply, rejoice not in them, except the fear of Yahuah (God) be with them.
verses.text: Though they multiply, rejoice not in them, except the fear of Yahuah be with them.

verses.raw: Trust not you in their life, neither respect their multitude: for one that is just is better than a thousand; and better it is to die without children, than to have them that are ungodly.
verses.text: Trust not you in their life, neither respect their multitude: for one that is just is better than a thousand; and better it is to die without children, than to have them that are ungodly.

verses.raw: For by one that has understanding shall the city be replenished: but the kindred of the wicked shall speedily become desolate.
verses.text: For by one that has understanding shall the city be replenished: but the kindred of the wicked shall speedily become desolate.

verses.raw: Many such things have I seen with my eyes, and my ear has heard greater things than these.
verses.text: Many such things have I seen with my eyes, and my ear has heard greater things than these.

verses.raw: In the congregation of the ungodly shall a fire be kindled; and in a rebellious nation wrath is set on fire.
verses.text: In the congregation of the ungodly shall a fire be kindled; and in a rebellious nation wrath is set on fire.

verses.raw: He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.
verses.text: He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness.

verses.raw: Neither spared he the place where Lot sojourned, but abhorred them for their pride.
verses.text: Neither spared he the place where Lot sojourned, but abhorred them for their pride.

verses.raw: He pitied not the people of perdition, who were taken away in their sins:
verses.text: He pitied not the people of perdition, who were taken away in their sins:

verses.raw: Nor the six hundred thousand footmen, who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts.
verses.text: Nor the six hundred thousand footmen, who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts.

verses.raw: And if there be one stiffnecked among the people, it is marvel if he escape unpunished: for mercy and wrath are with him; he is mighty to forgive, and to pour out displeasure.
verses.text: And if there be one stiffnecked among the people, it is marvel if he escape unpunished: for mercy and wrath are with him; he is mighty to forgive, and to pour out displeasure.

verses.raw: As his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judges a man according to his works
verses.text: As his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judges a man according to his works

verses.raw: The sinner shall not escape with his spoils: and the patience of the godly shall not be frustrate.
verses.text: The sinner shall not escape with his spoils: and the patience of the godly shall not be frustrate.

verses.raw: Make way for every work of mercy: for every man shall find according to his works.
verses.text: Make way for every work of mercy: for every man shall find according to his works.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) hardened Pharaoh, that he should not know him, that his powerful works might be known to the world.
verses.text: Yahuah hardened Pharaoh, that he should not know him, that his powerful works might be known to the world.

verses.raw: His mercy is manifest to every creature; and he has separated his light from the darkness with an adamant.
verses.text: His mercy is manifest to every creature; and he has separated his light from the darkness with an adamant.

verses.raw: Say not you, I will hide myself from Yahuah (God): shall any remember me from above? I shall not be remembered among so many people: for what is my soul among such an infinite number of creatures?
verses.text: Say not you, I will hide myself from Yahuah: shall any remember me from above? I shall not be remembered among so many people: for what is my soul among such an infinite number of creatures?

verses.raw: Behold, the heaven, and the heaven of heavens, the deep, and the earth, and all that in it is, shall be moved when he shall visit.
verses.text: Behold, the heaven, and the heaven of heavens, the deep, and the earth, and all that in it is, shall be moved when he shall visit.

verses.raw: The mountains also and foundations of the earth be shaken with trembling, when Yahuah (God) looketh upon them.
verses.text: The mountains also and foundations of the earth be shaken with trembling, when Yahuah looketh upon them.

verses.raw: No heart can think upon these things worthily: and who is able to conceive his ways?
verses.text: No heart can think upon these things worthily: and who is able to conceive his ways?

verses.raw: It is a tempest which no man can see: for the most part of his works are hid.
verses.text: It is a tempest which no man can see: for the most part of his works are hid.

verses.raw: Who can declare the works of his justice? or who can endure them? for his covenant is afar off, and the trial of all things is in the end.
verses.text: Who can declare the works of his justice? or who can endure them? for his covenant is afar off, and the trial of all things is in the end.

verses.raw: He that wanteth understanding will think upon vain things: and a foolish man erring imagineth follies.
verses.text: He that wanteth understanding will think upon vain things: and a foolish man erring imagineth follies.

verses.raw: My son, hearken to me, and learn knowledge, and mark my words with your heart.
verses.text: My son, hearken to me, and learn knowledge, and mark my words with your heart.

verses.raw: I will shew forth doctrine in weight, and declare his knowledge exactly.
verses.text: I will shew forth doctrine in weight, and declare his knowledge exactly.

verses.raw: The works of Yahuah (God) are done in judgment from the beginning: and from the time he made them he disposed the parts thereof.
verses.text: The works of Yahuah are done in judgment from the beginning: and from the time he made them he disposed the parts thereof.

verses.raw: He garnished his works for ever, and in his hand are the chief of them to all generations: they neither labour, nor are weary, nor cease from their works.
verses.text: He garnished his works for ever, and in his hand are the chief of them to all generations: they neither labour, nor are weary, nor cease from their works.

verses.raw: None of them hindereth another, and they shall never disobey his word.
verses.text: None of them hindereth another, and they shall never disobey his word.

verses.raw: After this Yahuah (God) looked upon the earth, and filled it with his blessings.
verses.text: After this Yahuah looked upon the earth, and filled it with his blessings.

verses.raw: With all manner of living things has he covered the face thereof; and they shall return into it again. ⸻
verses.text: With all manner of living things has he covered the face thereof; and they shall return into it again. ⸻

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) created man of the earth, and turned him into it again.
verses.text: Yahuah created man of the earth, and turned him into it again.

verses.raw: He gave them few days, and a short time, and power also over the things in it.
verses.text: He gave them few days, and a short time, and power also over the things in it.

verses.raw: He endued them with strength by themselves, and made them according to his image,
verses.text: He endued them with strength by themselves, and made them according to his image,

verses.raw: And put the fear of man upon all flesh, and gave him dominion over beasts and fowls.
verses.text: And put the fear of man upon all flesh, and gave him dominion over beasts and fowls.

verses.raw: They received the use of the five operations of Yahuah (God), and in the sixth place he imparted them understanding, and in the seventh speech, an interpreter of the cogitations thereof.
verses.text: They received the use of the five operations of Yahuah, and in the sixth place he imparted them understanding, and in the seventh speech, an interpreter of the cogitations thereof.

verses.raw: Counsel, and a tongue, and eyes, ears, and a heart, gave he them to understand.
verses.text: Counsel, and a tongue, and eyes, ears, and a heart, gave he them to understand.

verses.raw: Withal he filled them with the knowledge of understanding, and shewed them good and evil.
verses.text: Withal he filled them with the knowledge of understanding, and shewed them good and evil.

verses.raw: He set his eye upon their hearts, that he might shew them the greatness of his works.
verses.text: He set his eye upon their hearts, that he might shew them the greatness of his works.

verses.raw: He gave them to glory in his marvellous acts for ever, that they might declare his works with understanding.
verses.text: He gave them to glory in his marvellous acts for ever, that they might declare his works with understanding.

verses.raw: And the elect shall praise his holy name.
verses.text: And the elect shall praise his holy name.

verses.raw: Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.
verses.text: Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage.

verses.raw: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and shewed them his judgments.
verses.text: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and shewed them his judgments.

verses.raw: Their eyes saw the majesty of his glory, and their ears heard his glorious voice.
verses.text: Their eyes saw the majesty of his glory, and their ears heard his glorious voice.

verses.raw: And he said to them, Beware of all unrighteousness; and he gave every man commandment concerning his neighbour.
verses.text: And he said to them, Beware of all unrighteousness; and he gave every man commandment concerning his neighbour.

verses.raw: Their ways are ever before him, and shall not be hid from his eyes.
verses.text: Their ways are ever before him, and shall not be hid from his eyes.

verses.raw: Every man from his youth is given to evil; neither could they make to themselves fleshy hearts for stony.
verses.text: Every man from his youth is given to evil; neither could they make to themselves fleshy hearts for stony.

verses.raw: For in the division of the nations of the whole earth he set a ruler over every people; but Yashar'el (Israel) is the portion of Yahuah (God):
verses.text: For in the division of the nations of the whole earth he set a ruler over every people; but Yashar'el is the portion of Yahuah:

verses.raw: Whom, being his firstborn, he nourishes with discipline, and giving him the light of his love does not forsake him.
verses.text: Whom, being his firstborn, he nourishes with discipline, and giving him the light of his love does not forsake him.

verses.raw: Therefore all their works are as the sun before him, and his eyes are continually upon their ways.
verses.text: Therefore all their works are as the sun before him, and his eyes are continually upon their ways.

verses.raw: None of their unrighteous deeds are hid from him, but all their sins are before Yahuah (God)
verses.text: None of their unrighteous deeds are hid from him, but all their sins are before Yahuah

verses.raw: But Yahuah (God) being gracious and knowing his workmanship, neither left nor forsook them, but spared them.
verses.text: But Yahuah being gracious and knowing his workmanship, neither left nor forsook them, but spared them.

verses.raw: The alms of a man is as a signet with him, and he will keep the good deeds of man as the apple of the eye, and give repentance to his sons and daughters.
verses.text: The alms of a man is as a signet with him, and he will keep the good deeds of man as the apple of the eye, and give repentance to his sons and daughters.

verses.raw: Afterwards he will rise up and reward them, and render their recompence upon their heads.
verses.text: Afterwards he will rise up and reward them, and render their recompence upon their heads.

verses.raw: But to them that repent, he granted them return, and comforted those that failed in patience.
verses.text: But to them that repent, he granted them return, and comforted those that failed in patience.

verses.raw: Return to Yahuah (God), and forsake your sins, make your prayer before his face, and offend less.
verses.text: Return to Yahuah, and forsake your sins, make your prayer before his face, and offend less.

verses.raw: Turn again to the Most High, and turn away from iniquity: for he will lead you out of darkness into the light of health, and hate you abomination vehemently.
verses.text: Turn again to the Most High, and turn away from iniquity: for he will lead you out of darkness into the light of health, and hate you abomination vehemently.

verses.raw: Who shall praise the Most High in the grave, instead of them which live and give thanks?
verses.text: Who shall praise the Most High in the grave, instead of them which live and give thanks?

verses.raw: Thanksgiving perishes from the dead, as from one that is not: the living and sound in heart shall praise Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Thanksgiving perishes from the dead, as from one that is not: the living and sound in heart shall praise Yahuah.

verses.raw: How great is the lovingkindness of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), and his compassion to such as turn to him in holiness!
verses.text: How great is the lovingkindness of Yahuah, our Elohim, and his compassion to such as turn to him in holiness!

verses.raw: For all things cannot be in men, because the son of Adam is not immortal.
verses.text: For all things cannot be in men, because the son of Adam is not immortal.

verses.raw: What is brighter than the sun? yet the light thereof fails; and flesh and blood will imagine evil.
