verses.text: What is brighter than the sun? yet the light thereof fails; and flesh and blood will imagine evil.

verses.raw: He vieweth the power of the height of heaven; and all men are but earth and ashes. ⸻
verses.text: He vieweth the power of the height of heaven; and all men are but earth and ashes. ⸻

verses.raw: He that lives for ever Has created all things in general.
verses.text: He that lives for ever Has created all things in general.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) only is righteous, and there is none other but he,
verses.text: Yahuah only is righteous, and there is none other but he,

verses.raw: Who governeth the world with the palm of his hand, and all things obey his will: for he is the King of all, by his power dividing holy things among them from profane.
verses.text: Who governeth the world with the palm of his hand, and all things obey his will: for he is the King of all, by his power dividing holy things among them from profane.

verses.raw: To whom has he given power to declare his works? and who shall find out his noble acts?
verses.text: To whom has he given power to declare his works? and who shall find out his noble acts?

verses.raw: Who shall number the strength of his majesty? and who shall also tell out his mercies?
verses.text: Who shall number the strength of his majesty? and who shall also tell out his mercies?

verses.raw: As for the wondrous works of Yahuah (God), there may nothing be taken from them, neither may any thing be put to them, neither can the ground of them be found out.
verses.text: As for the wondrous works of Yahuah, there may nothing be taken from them, neither may any thing be put to them, neither can the ground of them be found out.

verses.raw: When a man has done, then he begins; and when he leaveth off, then he shall be doubtful.
verses.text: When a man has done, then he begins; and when he leaveth off, then he shall be doubtful.

verses.raw: What is man, and to which serveth he? what is his good, and what is his evil?
verses.text: What is man, and to which serveth he? what is his good, and what is his evil?

verses.raw: The number of a man’s days at the most are an hundred years.
verses.text: The number of a man’s days at the most are an hundred years.

verses.raw: As a drop of water to the sea, and a gravelstone in comparison of the sand; so are a thousand years to the days of eternity.
verses.text: As a drop of water to the sea, and a gravelstone in comparison of the sand; so are a thousand years to the days of eternity.

verses.raw: Therefore is Yahuah (God) patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them.
verses.text: Therefore is Yahuah patient with them, and poureth forth his mercy upon them.

verses.raw: He saw and perceived their end to be evil; therefore he multiplied his compassion.
verses.text: He saw and perceived their end to be evil; therefore he multiplied his compassion.

verses.raw: The mercy of man is toward his neighbour; but the mercy of Yahuah (God) is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.
verses.text: The mercy of man is toward his neighbour; but the mercy of Yahuah is upon all flesh: he reproveth, and nurtureth, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock.

verses.raw: He has mercy on them that receive discipline, and that diligently seek after his judgments.
verses.text: He has mercy on them that receive discipline, and that diligently seek after his judgments.

verses.raw: My son, blemish not your good deeds, neither use uncomfortable words when you give any thing.
verses.text: My son, blemish not your good deeds, neither use uncomfortable words when you give any thing.

verses.raw: Shall not the dew asswage the heat? so is a word better than a gift.
verses.text: Shall not the dew asswage the heat? so is a word better than a gift.

verses.raw: Lo, is not a word better than a gift? but both are with a gracious man.
verses.text: Lo, is not a word better than a gift? but both are with a gracious man.

verses.raw: A fool will upbraid churlishly, and a gift of the envious consumeth the eyes.
verses.text: A fool will upbraid churlishly, and a gift of the envious consumeth the eyes.

verses.raw: Learn before you speak, and use physick or ever you be sick.
verses.text: Learn before you speak, and use physick or ever you be sick.

verses.raw: Before judgment examine thyself, and in the day of visitation you shall find mercy.
verses.text: Before judgment examine thyself, and in the day of visitation you shall find mercy.

verses.raw: Humble thyself before you be sick, and in the time of sins shew repentance.
verses.text: Humble thyself before you be sick, and in the time of sins shew repentance.

verses.raw: Let nothing hinder you to pay your vow in due time, and defer not until death to be justified.
verses.text: Let nothing hinder you to pay your vow in due time, and defer not until death to be justified.

verses.raw: Before you prayest, prepare thyself; and be not as one that tempteth Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Before you prayest, prepare thyself; and be not as one that tempteth Yahuah.

verses.raw: Think upon the wrath that shall be at the end, and the time of vengeance, when he shall turn away his face.
verses.text: Think upon the wrath that shall be at the end, and the time of vengeance, when he shall turn away his face.

verses.raw: When you have enough, remember the time of hunger: and when you are rich, think upon poverty and need.
verses.text: When you have enough, remember the time of hunger: and when you are rich, think upon poverty and need.

verses.raw: From the morning until the evening the time is changed, and all things are soon done before Yahuah (God).
verses.text: From the morning until the evening the time is changed, and all things are soon done before Yahuah.

verses.raw: A wise man will fear in every thing, and in the day of sinning he will beware of offence: but a fool will not observe time.
verses.text: A wise man will fear in every thing, and in the day of sinning he will beware of offence: but a fool will not observe time.

verses.raw: Every man of understanding knoweth wisdom, and will give praise to him that found her.
verses.text: Every man of understanding knoweth wisdom, and will give praise to him that found her.

verses.raw: They that were of understanding in sayings became also wise themselves, and poured forth exquisite parables.
verses.text: They that were of understanding in sayings became also wise themselves, and poured forth exquisite parables.

verses.raw: Go not after your lusts, but refrain thyself from your appetites.
verses.text: Go not after your lusts, but refrain thyself from your appetites.

verses.raw: If you give your soul the desires that please her, she will make you a laughingstock to your enemies that malign you.
verses.text: If you give your soul the desires that please her, she will make you a laughingstock to your enemies that malign you.

verses.raw: Take not pleasure in much good cheer, neither be tied to the expence thereof.
verses.text: Take not pleasure in much good cheer, neither be tied to the expence thereof.

verses.raw: Be not made a beggar by banqueting upon borrowing, when you have nothing in your purse: for you shall lie in wait for your own life, and be talked on. ⸻
verses.text: Be not made a beggar by banqueting upon borrowing, when you have nothing in your purse: for you shall lie in wait for your own life, and be talked on. ⸻

verses.raw: A labouring man that is given to drunkenness shall not be rich: and he that contemneth small things shall fall by little and little.
verses.text: A labouring man that is given to drunkenness shall not be rich: and he that contemneth small things shall fall by little and little.

verses.raw: Wine and women will make men of understanding to fall away: and he that cleaveth to harlots will become impudent.
verses.text: Wine and women will make men of understanding to fall away: and he that cleaveth to harlots will become impudent.

verses.raw: Moths and worms shall have him to heritage, and a bold man shall be taken away.
verses.text: Moths and worms shall have him to heritage, and a bold man shall be taken away.

verses.raw: He that is hasty to give credit is lightminded; and he that sinneth shall offend against his own soul.
verses.text: He that is hasty to give credit is lightminded; and he that sinneth shall offend against his own soul.

verses.raw: Whoso takes pleasure in wickedness shall be condemned: but he that resisteth pleasures crowneth his life.
verses.text: Whoso takes pleasure in wickedness shall be condemned: but he that resisteth pleasures crowneth his life.

verses.raw: He that can rule his tongue shall live without strife; and he that hates babbling shall have less evil.
verses.text: He that can rule his tongue shall live without strife; and he that hates babbling shall have less evil.

verses.raw: Rehearse not to another that which is told to you, and you shall fare never the worse.
verses.text: Rehearse not to another that which is told to you, and you shall fare never the worse.

verses.raw: Whether it be to friend or foe, talk not of other men’s lives; and if you can without offence, reveal them not.
verses.text: Whether it be to friend or foe, talk not of other men’s lives; and if you can without offence, reveal them not.

verses.raw: For he heard and observed you, and when time comes he will hate you.
verses.text: For he heard and observed you, and when time comes he will hate you.

verses.raw: If you have heard a word, let it die with you; and be bold, it will not burst you.
verses.text: If you have heard a word, let it die with you; and be bold, it will not burst you.

verses.raw: A fool travaileth with a word, as a woman in labour of a child.
verses.text: A fool travaileth with a word, as a woman in labour of a child.

verses.raw: As an arrow that sticketh in a man’s thigh, so is a word within a fool’s belly.
verses.text: As an arrow that sticketh in a man’s thigh, so is a word within a fool’s belly.

verses.raw: Admonish a friend, it may be he has not done it: and if he have done it, that he do it no more.
verses.text: Admonish a friend, it may be he has not done it: and if he have done it, that he do it no more.

verses.raw: Admonish your friend, it may be he has not said it: and if he have, that he speak it not again.
verses.text: Admonish your friend, it may be he has not said it: and if he have, that he speak it not again.

verses.raw: Admonish a friend: for many times it is a slander, and believe not every tale.
verses.text: Admonish a friend: for many times it is a slander, and believe not every tale.

verses.raw: There is one that slippeth in his speech, but not from his heart; and who is he that has not offended with his tongue?
verses.text: There is one that slippeth in his speech, but not from his heart; and who is he that has not offended with his tongue?

verses.raw: Admonish your neighbour before you threaten him; and not being angry, give place to the law of the Most High.
verses.text: Admonish your neighbour before you threaten him; and not being angry, give place to the law of the Most High.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (God) is the first step to be accepted of him, and wisdom obtaineth his love.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is the first step to be accepted of him, and wisdom obtaineth his love.

verses.raw: The knowledge of the commandments of Yahuah (God) is the doctrine of life: and they that do things that please him shall receive the fruit of the tree of immortality.
verses.text: The knowledge of the commandments of Yahuah is the doctrine of life: and they that do things that please him shall receive the fruit of the tree of immortality.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (God) is all wisdom; and in all wisdom is the performance of the law, and the knowledge of his omnipotency.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is all wisdom; and in all wisdom is the performance of the law, and the knowledge of his omnipotency.

verses.raw: If a servant say to his master, I will not do as it pleaseth you; though afterward he do it, he angereth him that nourishes him.
verses.text: If a servant say to his master, I will not do as it pleaseth you; though afterward he do it, he angereth him that nourishes him.

verses.raw: The knowledge of wickedness is not wisdom, neither at any time the counsel of sinners prudence.
verses.text: The knowledge of wickedness is not wisdom, neither at any time the counsel of sinners prudence.

verses.raw: There is a wickedness, and the same an abomination; and there is a fool wanting in wisdom.
verses.text: There is a wickedness, and the same an abomination; and there is a fool wanting in wisdom.

verses.raw: He that has small understanding, and fears Yahuah (God), is better than one that has much wisdom, and transgresseth the law of the Most High.
verses.text: He that has small understanding, and fears Yahuah, is better than one that has much wisdom, and transgresseth the law of the Most High.

verses.raw: There is an exquisite subtilty, and the same is unjust; and there is one that turns aside to make judgment appear; and there is a wise man that justifies in judgment.
verses.text: There is an exquisite subtilty, and the same is unjust; and there is one that turns aside to make judgment appear; and there is a wise man that justifies in judgment.

verses.raw: There is a wicked man that hangeth down his head sadly; but inwardly he is full of deceit,
verses.text: There is a wicked man that hangeth down his head sadly; but inwardly he is full of deceit,

verses.raw: Casting down his countenance, and making as if he heard not: where he is not known, he will do you a mischief before you be aware.
verses.text: Casting down his countenance, and making as if he heard not: where he is not known, he will do you a mischief before you be aware.

verses.raw: And if for want of power he be hindered from sinning, yet when he finds opportunity he will do evil.
verses.text: And if for want of power he be hindered from sinning, yet when he finds opportunity he will do evil.

verses.raw: A man may be known by his look, and one that has understanding by his countenance, when you meetest him.
verses.text: A man may be known by his look, and one that has understanding by his countenance, when you meetest him.

verses.raw: A man’s attire, and excessive laughter, and gait, shew what he is. ⸻
verses.text: A man’s attire, and excessive laughter, and gait, shew what he is. ⸻

verses.raw: There is a reproof that is not comely: again, some man holdeth his tongue, and he is wise.
verses.text: There is a reproof that is not comely: again, some man holdeth his tongue, and he is wise.

verses.raw: It is much better to reprove, than to be angry secretly: and he that confesseth his fault shall be preserved from hurt.
verses.text: It is much better to reprove, than to be angry secretly: and he that confesseth his fault shall be preserved from hurt.

verses.raw: How good is it, when you are reproved, to shew repentance! for so shall you escape wilful sin.
verses.text: How good is it, when you are reproved, to shew repentance! for so shall you escape wilful sin.

verses.raw: As is the lust of an eunuch to deflower a virgin; so is he that executeth judgment with violence.
verses.text: As is the lust of an eunuch to deflower a virgin; so is he that executeth judgment with violence.

verses.raw: There is one that keepeth silence, and is found wise: and another by much babbling becometh hateful.
verses.text: There is one that keepeth silence, and is found wise: and another by much babbling becometh hateful.

verses.raw: Some man holdeth his tongue, because he has not to answer: and some keepeth silence, knowing his time.
verses.text: Some man holdeth his tongue, because he has not to answer: and some keepeth silence, knowing his time.

verses.raw: A wise man will hold his tongue till he see opportunity: but a babbler and a fool will regard no time.
verses.text: A wise man will hold his tongue till he see opportunity: but a babbler and a fool will regard no time.

verses.raw: He that useth many words shall be abhorred; and he that takes to himself authority in it shall be hated.
verses.text: He that useth many words shall be abhorred; and he that takes to himself authority in it shall be hated.

verses.raw: There is a sinner that has good success in evil things; and there is a gain that turns to loss.
verses.text: There is a sinner that has good success in evil things; and there is a gain that turns to loss.

verses.raw: There is a gift that shall not profit you; and there is a gift whose recompence is double.
verses.text: There is a gift that shall not profit you; and there is a gift whose recompence is double.

verses.raw: There is an abasement because of glory; and there is that lifteth up his head from a low estate.
verses.text: There is an abasement because of glory; and there is that lifteth up his head from a low estate.

verses.raw: There is that buyeth much for a little, and repayeth it sevenfold.
verses.text: There is that buyeth much for a little, and repayeth it sevenfold.

verses.raw: A wise man by his words makes him beloved: but the graces of fools shall be poured out.
verses.text: A wise man by his words makes him beloved: but the graces of fools shall be poured out.

verses.raw: The gift of a fool shall do you no good when you have it; neither yet of the envious for his necessity: for he looketh to receive many things for one.
verses.text: The gift of a fool shall do you no good when you have it; neither yet of the envious for his necessity: for he looketh to receive many things for one.

verses.raw: He gives little, and upbraideth much; he opens his mouth like a crier; to day he lendeth, and to morrow will he ask it again: such an one is to be hated of Yahuah (God) and man.
verses.text: He gives little, and upbraideth much; he opens his mouth like a crier; to day he lendeth, and to morrow will he ask it again: such an one is to be hated of Yahuah and man.

verses.raw: The fool says, I have no friends, I have no thank for all my good deeds, and they that eat my bread speak evil of me.
verses.text: The fool says, I have no friends, I have no thank for all my good deeds, and they that eat my bread speak evil of me.

verses.raw: How oft, and of how many shall he be laughed to scorn! for he knoweth not aright what it is to have; and it is all one to him as if he had it not.
verses.text: How oft, and of how many shall he be laughed to scorn! for he knoweth not aright what it is to have; and it is all one to him as if he had it not.

verses.raw: To slip upon a pavement is better than to slip with the tongue: so the fall of the wicked shall come speedily.
verses.text: To slip upon a pavement is better than to slip with the tongue: so the fall of the wicked shall come speedily.

verses.raw: An unseasonable tale will always be in the mouth of the unwise.
verses.text: An unseasonable tale will always be in the mouth of the unwise.

verses.raw: A wise sentence shall be rejected when it comes out of a fool’s mouth; for he will not speak it in due season.
verses.text: A wise sentence shall be rejected when it comes out of a fool’s mouth; for he will not speak it in due season.

verses.raw: There is that is hindered from sinning through want: and when he takes rest, he shall not be troubled.
verses.text: There is that is hindered from sinning through want: and when he takes rest, he shall not be troubled.

verses.raw: There is that destroys his own soul through bashfulness, and by accepting of persons overthroweth himself.
verses.text: There is that destroys his own soul through bashfulness, and by accepting of persons overthroweth himself.

verses.raw: There is that for bashfulness promiseth to his friend, and makes him his enemy for nothing.
verses.text: There is that for bashfulness promiseth to his friend, and makes him his enemy for nothing.

verses.raw: A lie is a foul blot in a man, yet it is continually in the mouth of the untaught.
verses.text: A lie is a foul blot in a man, yet it is continually in the mouth of the untaught.

verses.raw: A thief is better than a man that is accustomed to lie: but they both shall have destruction to heritage.
verses.text: A thief is better than a man that is accustomed to lie: but they both shall have destruction to heritage.

verses.raw: The disposition of a liar is dishonourable, and his shame is ever with him.
verses.text: The disposition of a liar is dishonourable, and his shame is ever with him.

verses.raw: A wise man shall promote himself to honour with his words: and he that has understanding will please great men.
verses.text: A wise man shall promote himself to honour with his words: and he that has understanding will please great men.

verses.raw: He that tilleth his land shall increase his heap: and he that pleaseth great men shall get pardon for iniquity.
verses.text: He that tilleth his land shall increase his heap: and he that pleaseth great men shall get pardon for iniquity.

verses.raw: Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise, and stop up his mouth that he cannot reprove.
verses.text: Presents and gifts blind the eyes of the wise, and stop up his mouth that he cannot reprove.

verses.raw: Wisdom that is hid, and treasure that is hoarded up, what profit is in them both?
verses.text: Wisdom that is hid, and treasure that is hoarded up, what profit is in them both?

verses.raw: Better is he that hideth his folly than a man that hideth his wisdom.
verses.text: Better is he that hideth his folly than a man that hideth his wisdom.

verses.raw: Necessary patience in seeking Yahuah (God) is better than he that leadeth his life without a guide. ⸻
verses.text: Necessary patience in seeking Yahuah is better than he that leadeth his life without a guide. ⸻

verses.raw: My son, have you sinned? do so no more, but ask pardon for your former sins.
verses.text: My son, have you sinned? do so no more, but ask pardon for your former sins.

verses.raw: Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent: for if you come too near it, it will bite you: the teeth thereof are as the teeth of a lion, slaying the souls of men.
verses.text: Flee from sin as from the face of a serpent: for if you come too near it, it will bite you: the teeth thereof are as the teeth of a lion, slaying the souls of men.

verses.raw: All iniquity is as a two edged sword, the wounds of which cannot be healed.
verses.text: All iniquity is as a two edged sword, the wounds of which cannot be healed.

verses.raw: To terrify and do wrong will waste riches: thus the house of proud men shall be made desolate.
verses.text: To terrify and do wrong will waste riches: thus the house of proud men shall be made desolate.

verses.raw: A prayer out of a poor man’s mouth reacheth to the ears of Yahuah (God), and his judgment comes speedily.
verses.text: A prayer out of a poor man’s mouth reacheth to the ears of Yahuah, and his judgment comes speedily.

verses.raw: He that hates to be reproved is in the way of sinners: but he that fears Yahuah (God) will repent from his heart.
verses.text: He that hates to be reproved is in the way of sinners: but he that fears Yahuah will repent from his heart.

verses.raw: An eloquent man is known far and near; but a man of understanding knoweth when he slippeth.
verses.text: An eloquent man is known far and near; but a man of understanding knoweth when he slippeth.

verses.raw: He that buildeth his house with other men’s money is like one that gathers himself stones for the tomb of his burial.
verses.text: He that buildeth his house with other men’s money is like one that gathers himself stones for the tomb of his burial.

verses.raw: The congregation of the wicked is like tow wrapped together: and the end of them is a flame of fire to destroy them.
verses.text: The congregation of the wicked is like tow wrapped together: and the end of them is a flame of fire to destroy them.

verses.raw: The way of sinners is made plain with stones, but at the end thereof is the pit of hell.
verses.text: The way of sinners is made plain with stones, but at the end thereof is the pit of hell.

verses.raw: He that keepeth the law of Yahuah (God) getteth the understanding thereof: and the perfection of the fear of Yahuah (God) is wisdom.
verses.text: He that keepeth the law of Yahuah getteth the understanding thereof: and the perfection of the fear of Yahuah is wisdom.

verses.raw: He that is not wise will not be taught: but there is a wisdom which multiplieth bitterness.
verses.text: He that is not wise will not be taught: but there is a wisdom which multiplieth bitterness.

verses.raw: The knowledge of a wise man shall abound like a flood: and his counsel is like a pure fountain of life.
verses.text: The knowledge of a wise man shall abound like a flood: and his counsel is like a pure fountain of life.

verses.raw: The inner parts of a fool are like a broken vessel, and he will hold no knowledge as long as he lives.
verses.text: The inner parts of a fool are like a broken vessel, and he will hold no knowledge as long as he lives.

verses.raw: If a skilful man hear a wise word, he will commend it, and add to it: but as soon as one of no understanding heareth it, it displeaseth him, and he casteth it behind his back.
verses.text: If a skilful man hear a wise word, he will commend it, and add to it: but as soon as one of no understanding heareth it, it displeaseth him, and he casteth it behind his back.

verses.raw: The talking of a fool is like a burden in the way: but grace shall be found in the lips of the wise.
verses.text: The talking of a fool is like a burden in the way: but grace shall be found in the lips of the wise.

verses.raw: They enquire at the mouth of the wise man in the congregation, and they shall ponder his words in their heart.
verses.text: They enquire at the mouth of the wise man in the congregation, and they shall ponder his words in their heart.

verses.raw: As is a house that is destroyed, so is wisdom to a fool: and the knowledge of the unwise is as talk without sense.
verses.text: As is a house that is destroyed, so is wisdom to a fool: and the knowledge of the unwise is as talk without sense.

verses.raw: Doctrine to fools is as fetters on the feet, and like manacles on the right hand.
verses.text: Doctrine to fools is as fetters on the feet, and like manacles on the right hand.

verses.raw: A fool lifteth up his voice with laughter; but a wise man does scarce smile a little.
verses.text: A fool lifteth up his voice with laughter; but a wise man does scarce smile a little.

verses.raw: Learning is to a wise man as an ornament of gold, and like a bracelet upon his right arm.
verses.text: Learning is to a wise man as an ornament of gold, and like a bracelet upon his right arm.

verses.raw: A foolish man’s foot is soon in his neighbour’s house: but a man of experience is ashamed of him.
verses.text: A foolish man’s foot is soon in his neighbour’s house: but a man of experience is ashamed of him.

verses.raw: A fool will peep in at the door into the house: but he that is well nurtured will stand without.
verses.text: A fool will peep in at the door into the house: but he that is well nurtured will stand without.

verses.raw: It is the rudeness of a man to hearken at the door: but a wise man will be grieved with the disgrace.
verses.text: It is the rudeness of a man to hearken at the door: but a wise man will be grieved with the disgrace.

verses.raw: The lips of talkers will be telling such things as pertain not to them: but the words of such as have understanding are weighed in the balance.
verses.text: The lips of talkers will be telling such things as pertain not to them: but the words of such as have understanding are weighed in the balance.

verses.raw: The heart of fools is in their mouth: but the mouth of the wise is in their heart.
verses.text: The heart of fools is in their mouth: but the mouth of the wise is in their heart.

verses.raw: When the ungodly curses Satan, he curses his own soul.
verses.text: When the ungodly curses Satan, he curses his own soul.

verses.raw: A whisperer defiles his own soul, and is hated wherever he dwells. ⸻
verses.text: A whisperer defiles his own soul, and is hated wherever he dwells. ⸻

verses.raw: A slothful man is compared to a filthy stone, and every one will hiss him out to his disgrace.
verses.text: A slothful man is compared to a filthy stone, and every one will hiss him out to his disgrace.

verses.raw: A slothful man is compared to the filth of a dunghill: every man that takes it up will shake his hand.
verses.text: A slothful man is compared to the filth of a dunghill: every man that takes it up will shake his hand.

verses.raw: An evilnurtured man is the dishonour of his father that begat him: and a foolish daughter is born to his loss.
verses.text: An evilnurtured man is the dishonour of his father that begat him: and a foolish daughter is born to his loss.

verses.raw: A wise daughter shall bring an inheritance to her husband: but she that lives dishonestly is her father’s heaviness.
verses.text: A wise daughter shall bring an inheritance to her husband: but she that lives dishonestly is her father’s heaviness.

verses.raw: She that is bold dishonoureth both her father and her husband, but they both shall despise her.
verses.text: She that is bold dishonoureth both her father and her husband, but they both shall despise her.

verses.raw: A tale out of season is as musick in mourning: but stripes and correction of wisdom are never out of time.
verses.text: A tale out of season is as musick in mourning: but stripes and correction of wisdom are never out of time.

verses.raw: Whoso teaches a fool is as one that glueth a potsherd together, and as he that waketh one from a sound sleep.
verses.text: Whoso teaches a fool is as one that glueth a potsherd together, and as he that waketh one from a sound sleep.

verses.raw: He that telleth a tale to a fool speaks to one in a slumber: when he has told his tale, he will say, What is the matter?
verses.text: He that telleth a tale to a fool speaks to one in a slumber: when he has told his tale, he will say, What is the matter?

verses.raw: If children live honestly, and have wherewithal, they shall cover the baseness of their parents.
verses.text: If children live honestly, and have wherewithal, they shall cover the baseness of their parents.

verses.raw: But children, being haughty, through disdain and want of nurture do stain the nobility of their kindred.
verses.text: But children, being haughty, through disdain and want of nurture do stain the nobility of their kindred.

verses.raw: Weep for the dead, for he has lost the light: and weep for the fool, for he wanteth understanding: make little weeping for the dead, for he is at rest: but the life of the fool is worse than death.
verses.text: Weep for the dead, for he has lost the light: and weep for the fool, for he wanteth understanding: make little weeping for the dead, for he is at rest: but the life of the fool is worse than death.

verses.raw: Seven days do men mourn for him that is dead; but for a fool and an ungodly man all the days of his life.
verses.text: Seven days do men mourn for him that is dead; but for a fool and an ungodly man all the days of his life.

verses.raw: Talk not much with a fool, and go not to him that has no understanding: beware of him, lest you have trouble, and you shall never be defiled with his fooleries: depart from him, and you shall find rest, and never be disquieted with madness.
verses.text: Talk not much with a fool, and go not to him that has no understanding: beware of him, lest you have trouble, and you shall never be defiled with his fooleries: depart from him, and you shall find rest, and never be disquieted with madness.

verses.raw: What is heavier than lead? and what is the name thereof, but a fool?
verses.text: What is heavier than lead? and what is the name thereof, but a fool?

verses.raw: Sand, and salt, and a mass of iron, is easier to bear, than a man without understanding.
verses.text: Sand, and salt, and a mass of iron, is easier to bear, than a man without understanding.

verses.raw: As timber girt and bound together in a building cannot be loosed with shaking: so the heart that is stablished by advised counsel shall fear at no time.
verses.text: As timber girt and bound together in a building cannot be loosed with shaking: so the heart that is stablished by advised counsel shall fear at no time.

verses.raw: A heart settled upon a thought of understanding is as a fair plaistering on the wall of a gallery.
verses.text: A heart settled upon a thought of understanding is as a fair plaistering on the wall of a gallery.

verses.raw: Pales set on an high place will never stand against the wind: so a fearful heart in the imagination of a fool cannot stand against any fear.
verses.text: Pales set on an high place will never stand against the wind: so a fearful heart in the imagination of a fool cannot stand against any fear.

verses.raw: He that pricketh the eye will make tears to fall: and he that pricketh the heart makes it to shew her knowledge.
verses.text: He that pricketh the eye will make tears to fall: and he that pricketh the heart makes it to shew her knowledge.

verses.raw: Whoso casteth a stone at the birds frayeth them away: and he that upbraideth his friend breaks friendship.
verses.text: Whoso casteth a stone at the birds frayeth them away: and he that upbraideth his friend breaks friendship.

verses.raw: Though you drewest a sword at your friend, yet despair not: for there may be a returning to favour.
verses.text: Though you drewest a sword at your friend, yet despair not: for there may be a returning to favour.

verses.raw: If you have opened your mouth against your friend, fear not; for there may be a reconciliation: except for upbraiding, or pride, or disclosing of secrets, or a treacherous wound: for for these things every friend will depart.
verses.text: If you have opened your mouth against your friend, fear not; for there may be a reconciliation: except for upbraiding, or pride, or disclosing of secrets, or a treacherous wound: for for these things every friend will depart.

verses.raw: Be faithful to your neighbour in his poverty, that you may rejoice in his prosperity: abide stedfast to him in the time of his trouble, that you may be heir with him in his heritage: for a mean estate is not always to be contemned: nor the rich that is foolish to be had in admiration.
verses.text: Be faithful to your neighbour in his poverty, that you may rejoice in his prosperity: abide stedfast to him in the time of his trouble, that you may be heir with him in his heritage: for a mean estate is not always to be contemned: nor the rich that is foolish to be had in admiration.

verses.raw: As the vapour and smoke of a furnace goes before the fire; so reviling before blood.
verses.text: As the vapour and smoke of a furnace goes before the fire; so reviling before blood.

verses.raw: I will not be ashamed to defend a friend; neither will I hide myself from him.
verses.text: I will not be ashamed to defend a friend; neither will I hide myself from him.

verses.raw: And if any evil happen to me by him, every one that heareth it will beware of him.
verses.text: And if any evil happen to me by him, every one that heareth it will beware of him.

verses.raw: Who shall set a watch before my mouth, and a seal of wisdom upon my lips, that I fall not suddenly by them, and that my tongue destroy me not? ⸻
verses.text: Who shall set a watch before my mouth, and a seal of wisdom upon my lips, that I fall not suddenly by them, and that my tongue destroy me not? ⸻

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), Father and Governor of all my whole life, leave me not to their counsels, and let me not fall by them.
verses.text: O Yahuah, Father and Governor of all my whole life, leave me not to their counsels, and let me not fall by them.

verses.raw: Who will set scourges over my thoughts, and the discipline of wisdom over my heart? that they spare me not for my ignorances, and it pass not by my sins:
verses.text: Who will set scourges over my thoughts, and the discipline of wisdom over my heart? that they spare me not for my ignorances, and it pass not by my sins:

verses.raw: Lest my ignorances increase, and my sins abound to my destruction, and I fall before my adversaries, and my enemy rejoice over me, whose hope is far from your mercy.
verses.text: Lest my ignorances increase, and my sins abound to my destruction, and I fall before my adversaries, and my enemy rejoice over me, whose hope is far from your mercy.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), Father and Yahuah (God) of my life, give me not a proud look, but turn away from your servants always a haughty mind.
verses.text: O Yahuah, Father and Yahuah of my life, give me not a proud look, but turn away from your servants always a haughty mind.

verses.raw: Turn away from me vain hopes and concupiscence, and you shall hold him up that is desirous always to serve you.
verses.text: Turn away from me vain hopes and concupiscence, and you shall hold him up that is desirous always to serve you.

verses.raw: Let not the greediness of the belly nor lust of the flesh take hold of me; and give not over me your servant into an impudent mind.
verses.text: Let not the greediness of the belly nor lust of the flesh take hold of me; and give not over me your servant into an impudent mind.

verses.raw: Hear, O you children, the discipline of the mouth: he that keepeth it shall never be taken in his lips.
verses.text: Hear, O you children, the discipline of the mouth: he that keepeth it shall never be taken in his lips.

verses.raw: The sinner shall be left in his foolishness: both the evil speaker and the proud shall fall thereby.
verses.text: The sinner shall be left in his foolishness: both the evil speaker and the proud shall fall thereby.

verses.raw: Accustom not your mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One.
verses.text: Accustom not your mouth to swearing; neither use thyself to the naming of the Holy One.

verses.raw: For as a servant that is continually beaten shall not be without a blue mark: so he that sweareth and nameth Yahuah (God) continually shall not be faultless.
verses.text: For as a servant that is continually beaten shall not be without a blue mark: so he that sweareth and nameth Yahuah continually shall not be faultless.

verses.raw: A man that useth much swearing shall be filled with iniquity, and the plague shall never depart from his house: if he shall offend, his sin shall be upon him: and if he acknowledge not his sin, he makes a double offence: and if he swear in vain, he shall not be innocent, but his house shall be full of calamities.
verses.text: A man that useth much swearing shall be filled with iniquity, and the plague shall never depart from his house: if he shall offend, his sin shall be upon him: and if he acknowledge not his sin, he makes a double offence: and if he swear in vain, he shall not be innocent, but his house shall be full of calamities.

verses.raw: There is a word that is clothed about with death: Yahuah (God) grant that it be not found in the heritage of Jacob; for all such things shall be far from the godly, and they shall not wallow in their sins.
verses.text: There is a word that is clothed about with death: Yahuah grant that it be not found in the heritage of Jacob; for all such things shall be far from the godly, and they shall not wallow in their sins.

verses.raw: Use not your mouth to intemperate swearing, for in it is the word of sin.
verses.text: Use not your mouth to intemperate swearing, for in it is the word of sin.

verses.raw: Remember your father and your mother, when you sittest among great men. Be not forgetful before them, and so you by your custom become a fool, and wish that you had not been born, and curse they day of your nativity.
verses.text: Remember your father and your mother, when you sittest among great men. Be not forgetful before them, and so you by your custom become a fool, and wish that you had not been born, and curse they day of your nativity.

verses.raw: The man that is accustomed to opprobrious words will never be reformed all the days of his life.
verses.text: The man that is accustomed to opprobrious words will never be reformed all the days of his life.

verses.raw: Two sorts of men multiply sin, and the third will bring wrath: a hot mind is as a burning fire, it will never be quenched till it be consumed: a fornicator in the body of his flesh will never cease till he has kindled a fire.
verses.text: Two sorts of men multiply sin, and the third will bring wrath: a hot mind is as a burning fire, it will never be quenched till it be consumed: a fornicator in the body of his flesh will never cease till he has kindled a fire.

verses.raw: All bread is sweet to a whoremonger, he will not leave off till he die.
verses.text: All bread is sweet to a whoremonger, he will not leave off till he die.

verses.raw: A man that breaks wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me? I am compassed about with darkness, the walls cover me, and no body seeth me; what need I to fear? the Most High will not remember my sins:
verses.text: A man that breaks wedlock, saying thus in his heart, Who seeth me? I am compassed about with darkness, the walls cover me, and no body seeth me; what need I to fear? the Most High will not remember my sins:

verses.raw: Such a man only fears the eyes of men, and knoweth not that the eyes of Yahuah (God) are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men, and considering the most secret parts.
verses.text: Such a man only fears the eyes of men, and knoweth not that the eyes of Yahuah are ten thousand times brighter than the sun, beholding all the ways of men, and considering the most secret parts.

verses.raw: He knew all things ere ever they were created; so also after they were perfected he looked upon them all.
verses.text: He knew all things ere ever they were created; so also after they were perfected he looked upon them all.

verses.raw: This man shall be punished in the streets of the city, and where he suspecteth not he shall be taken.
verses.text: This man shall be punished in the streets of the city, and where he suspecteth not he shall be taken.

verses.raw: Thus shall it go also with the wife that leaveth her husband, and brings in an heir by another.
verses.text: Thus shall it go also with the wife that leaveth her husband, and brings in an heir by another.

verses.raw: For first, she has disobeyed the law of the Most High; and secondly, she has trespassed against her own husband; and thirdly, she has played the whore in adultery, and brought children by another man.
verses.text: For first, she has disobeyed the law of the Most High; and secondly, she has trespassed against her own husband; and thirdly, she has played the whore in adultery, and brought children by another man.

verses.raw: She shall be brought out into the congregation, and inquisition shall be made of her children.
verses.text: She shall be brought out into the congregation, and inquisition shall be made of her children.

verses.raw: Her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit.
verses.text: Her children shall not take root, and her branches shall bring forth no fruit.

verses.raw: She shall leave her memory to be cursed, and her reproach shall not be blotted out.
verses.text: She shall leave her memory to be cursed, and her reproach shall not be blotted out.

verses.raw: And they that remain shall know that there is nothing better than the fear of Yahuah (God), and that there is nothing sweeter than to take heed to the commandments of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And they that remain shall know that there is nothing better than the fear of Yahuah, and that there is nothing sweeter than to take heed to the commandments of Yahuah.

verses.raw: It is great glory to follow Yahuah (God), and to be received of him is long life. ⸻
verses.text: It is great glory to follow Yahuah, and to be received of him is long life. ⸻

verses.raw: Wisdom shall praise herself, and shall glory in the midst of her people.
verses.text: Wisdom shall praise herself, and shall glory in the midst of her people.

verses.raw: In the congregation of the Most High shall she open her mouth, and triumph before his power.
verses.text: In the congregation of the Most High shall she open her mouth, and triumph before his power.

verses.raw: I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a cloud.
verses.text: I came out of the mouth of the Most High, and covered the earth as a cloud.

verses.raw: I dwelt in high places, and my throne is in a cloudy pillar.
verses.text: I dwelt in high places, and my throne is in a cloudy pillar.

verses.raw: I alone compassed the circuit of heaven, and walked in the bottom of the deep.
verses.text: I alone compassed the circuit of heaven, and walked in the bottom of the deep.

verses.raw: In the waves of the sea and in all the earth, and in every people and nation, I got a possession.
verses.text: In the waves of the sea and in all the earth, and in every people and nation, I got a possession.

verses.raw: With all these I sought rest: and in whose inheritance shall I abide?
verses.text: With all these I sought rest: and in whose inheritance shall I abide?

verses.raw: So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: He created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.
verses.text: He created me from the beginning before the world, and I shall never fail.

verses.raw: In the holy tabernacle I served before him; and so was I established in Sion.
verses.text: In the holy tabernacle I served before him; and so was I established in Sion.

verses.raw: Likewise in the beloved city he gave me rest, and in Jerusalem was my power.
verses.text: Likewise in the beloved city he gave me rest, and in Jerusalem was my power.

verses.raw: And I took root in an honourable people, even in the portion of the inheritance of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And I took root in an honourable people, even in the portion of the inheritance of Yahuah.

verses.raw: I was exalted like a cedar in Libanus, and as a cypress tree upon the mountains of Hermon.
verses.text: I was exalted like a cedar in Libanus, and as a cypress tree upon the mountains of Hermon.

verses.raw: I was exalted like a palm tree in En-gaddi, and as a rose plant in Jericho, as a fair olive tree in a pleasant field, and grew up as a plane tree by the water.
verses.text: I was exalted like a palm tree in En-gaddi, and as a rose plant in Jericho, as a fair olive tree in a pleasant field, and grew up as a plane tree by the water.

verses.raw: I gave a sweet smell like cinnamon and aspalathus, and I yielded a pleasant odour like the best myrrh, as galbanum, and onyx, and sweet storax, and as the fume of frankincense in the tabernacle.
verses.text: I gave a sweet smell like cinnamon and aspalathus, and I yielded a pleasant odour like the best myrrh, as galbanum, and onyx, and sweet storax, and as the fume of frankincense in the tabernacle.

verses.raw: As the turpentine tree I stretched out my branches, and my branches are the branches of honour and grace.
verses.text: As the turpentine tree I stretched out my branches, and my branches are the branches of honour and grace.

verses.raw: As the vine brought I forth pleasant savour, and my flowers are the fruit of honour and riches.
verses.text: As the vine brought I forth pleasant savour, and my flowers are the fruit of honour and riches.

verses.raw: I am the mother of fair love, and fear, and knowledge, and holy hope: I therefore, being eternal, am given to all my children which are named of him.
verses.text: I am the mother of fair love, and fear, and knowledge, and holy hope: I therefore, being eternal, am given to all my children which are named of him.

verses.raw: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.
verses.text: Come to me, all you that be desirous of me, and fill yourselves with my fruits.

verses.raw: For my memorial is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance than the honeycomb.
verses.text: For my memorial is sweeter than honey, and my inheritance than the honeycomb.

verses.raw: They that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty.
verses.text: They that eat me shall yet be hungry, and they that drink me shall yet be thirsty.

verses.raw: He that obeyeth me shall never be confounded, and they that work by me shall not do amiss.
verses.text: He that obeyeth me shall never be confounded, and they that work by me shall not do amiss.

verses.raw: All these things are the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah (God), even the law which Moses commanded for an heritage to the congregations of Jacob.
verses.text: All these things are the book of the covenant of the most high Yahuah, even the law which Moses commanded for an heritage to the congregations of Jacob.

verses.raw: Faint not to be strong in Yahuah (God); that he may confirm you, cleave to him: for Yahuah (God) Almighty is Yahuah (God) alone, and beside him there is no other Saviour.
verses.text: Faint not to be strong in Yahuah; that he may confirm you, cleave to him: for Yahuah Almighty is Yahuah alone, and beside him there is no other Saviour.

verses.raw: He filleth all things with his wisdom, as Phison and as Tigris in the time of the new fruits.
verses.text: He filleth all things with his wisdom, as Phison and as Tigris in the time of the new fruits.

verses.raw: He makes the understanding to abound like Euphrates, and as Jordan in the time of the harvest.
verses.text: He makes the understanding to abound like Euphrates, and as Jordan in the time of the harvest.

verses.raw: He makes the doctrine of knowledge appear as the light, and as Geon in the time of vintage.
verses.text: He makes the doctrine of knowledge appear as the light, and as Geon in the time of vintage.

verses.raw: The first man knew her not perfectly: no more shall the last find her out.
verses.text: The first man knew her not perfectly: no more shall the last find her out.

verses.raw: For her thoughts are more than the sea, and her counsels profounder than the great deep.
verses.text: For her thoughts are more than the sea, and her counsels profounder than the great deep.

verses.raw: I also came out as a brook from a river, and as a conduit into a garden.
verses.text: I also came out as a brook from a river, and as a conduit into a garden.

verses.raw: I said, I will water my best garden, and will water abundantly my garden bed: and, lo, my brook became a river, and my river became a sea.
verses.text: I said, I will water my best garden, and will water abundantly my garden bed: and, lo, my brook became a river, and my river became a sea.

verses.raw: I will yet make doctrine to shine as the morning, and will send forth her light afar off.
verses.text: I will yet make doctrine to shine as the morning, and will send forth her light afar off.

verses.raw: I will yet pour out doctrine as prophecy, and leave it to all ages for ever.
verses.text: I will yet pour out doctrine as prophecy, and leave it to all ages for ever.

verses.raw: Behold that I have not laboured for myself only, but for all them that seek wisdom. ⸻
verses.text: Behold that I have not laboured for myself only, but for all them that seek wisdom. ⸻

verses.raw: In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before Yahuah (God) and men: the unity of brothers, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together.
verses.text: In three things I was beautified, and stood up beautiful both before Yahuah and men: the unity of brothers, the love of neighbours, a man and a wife that agree together.

verses.raw: Three sorts of men my soul hates, and I am greatly offended at their life: a poor man that is proud, a rich man that is a liar, and an old adulterer that doateth.
verses.text: Three sorts of men my soul hates, and I am greatly offended at their life: a poor man that is proud, a rich man that is a liar, and an old adulterer that doateth.

verses.raw: If you have gathered nothing in your youth, how can you find any thing in your age?
verses.text: If you have gathered nothing in your youth, how can you find any thing in your age?

verses.raw: O how comely a thing is judgment for gray hairs, and for ancient men to know counsel!
verses.text: O how comely a thing is judgment for gray hairs, and for ancient men to know counsel!

verses.raw: O how comely is the wisdom of old men, and understanding and counsel to men of honour.
verses.text: O how comely is the wisdom of old men, and understanding and counsel to men of honour.

verses.raw: Much experience is the crown of old men, and the fear of Yahuah (God) is their glory.
verses.text: Much experience is the crown of old men, and the fear of Yahuah is their glory.

verses.raw: There be nine things which I have judged in my heart to be happy, and the tenth I will utter with my tongue: A man that has joy of his children; and he that lives to see the fall of his enemy:
verses.text: There be nine things which I have judged in my heart to be happy, and the tenth I will utter with my tongue: A man that has joy of his children; and he that lives to see the fall of his enemy:

verses.raw: Well is him that dwells with a wife of understanding, and that has not slipped with his tongue, and that has not served a man more unworthy than himself:
verses.text: Well is him that dwells with a wife of understanding, and that has not slipped with his tongue, and that has not served a man more unworthy than himself:

verses.raw: Well is him that has found prudence, and he that speaks in the ears of them that will hear:
verses.text: Well is him that has found prudence, and he that speaks in the ears of them that will hear:

verses.raw: O how great is he that finds wisdom! yet is there none above him that fears Yahuah (God).
verses.text: O how great is he that finds wisdom! yet is there none above him that fears Yahuah.

verses.raw: But the love of Yahuah (God) passeth all things for illumination: he that holdeth it, to which shall he be likened?
verses.text: But the love of Yahuah passeth all things for illumination: he that holdeth it, to which shall he be likened?

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (God) is the beginning of his love: and faith is the beginning of cleaving to him.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is the beginning of his love: and faith is the beginning of cleaving to him.

verses.raw: Give me any plague, but the plague of the heart: and any wickedness, but the wickedness of a woman:
verses.text: Give me any plague, but the plague of the heart: and any wickedness, but the wickedness of a woman:

verses.raw: And any affliction, but the affliction from them that hate me: and any revenge, but the revenge of enemies.
verses.text: And any affliction, but the affliction from them that hate me: and any revenge, but the revenge of enemies.

verses.raw: There is no head above the head of a serpent; and there is no wrath above the wrath of an enemy.
verses.text: There is no head above the head of a serpent; and there is no wrath above the wrath of an enemy.

verses.raw: I had rather dwell with a lion and a dragon, than to keep house with a wicked woman.
verses.text: I had rather dwell with a lion and a dragon, than to keep house with a wicked woman.

verses.raw: The wickedness of a woman changeth her face, and darkeneth her countenance like sackcloth.
verses.text: The wickedness of a woman changeth her face, and darkeneth her countenance like sackcloth.

verses.raw: Her husband shall sit among his neighbours; and when he heareth it shall sigh bitterly.
verses.text: Her husband shall sit among his neighbours; and when he heareth it shall sigh bitterly.

verses.raw: All wickedness is but little to the wickedness of a woman: let the portion of a sinner fall upon her.
verses.text: All wickedness is but little to the wickedness of a woman: let the portion of a sinner fall upon her.

verses.raw: As the climbing up a sandy way is to the feet of the aged, so is a wife full of words to a quiet man.
verses.text: As the climbing up a sandy way is to the feet of the aged, so is a wife full of words to a quiet man.

verses.raw: Stumble not at the beauty of a woman, and desire her not for pleasure.
verses.text: Stumble not at the beauty of a woman, and desire her not for pleasure.

verses.raw: A woman, if she maintain her husband, is full of anger, impudence, and much reproach.
verses.text: A woman, if she maintain her husband, is full of anger, impudence, and much reproach.

verses.raw: A wicked woman abateth the courage, makes an heavy countenance and a wounded heart: a woman that will not comfort her husband in distress makes weak hands and feeble knees.
verses.text: A wicked woman abateth the courage, makes an heavy countenance and a wounded heart: a woman that will not comfort her husband in distress makes weak hands and feeble knees.

verses.raw: Of the woman came the beginning of sin, and through her we all die.
verses.text: Of the woman came the beginning of sin, and through her we all die.

verses.raw: Give the water no passage; neither a wicked woman liberty to gad abroad.
verses.text: Give the water no passage; neither a wicked woman liberty to gad abroad.

verses.raw: If she go not as you would have her, cut her off from your flesh, and give her a bill of divorce, and let her go. ⸻
verses.text: If she go not as you would have her, cut her off from your flesh, and give her a bill of divorce, and let her go. ⸻

verses.raw: Blessed is the man that has a virtuous wife, for the number of his days shall be double.
verses.text: Blessed is the man that has a virtuous wife, for the number of his days shall be double.

verses.raw: A virtuous woman rejoices her husband, and he shall fulfil the years of his life in peace.
verses.text: A virtuous woman rejoices her husband, and he shall fulfil the years of his life in peace.

verses.raw: A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (God).
verses.text: A good wife is a good portion, which shall be given in the portion of them that fear Yahuah.

verses.raw: Whether a man be rich or poor, if he have a good heart toward Yahuah (God), he shall at all times rejoice with a cheerful countenance.
verses.text: Whether a man be rich or poor, if he have a good heart toward Yahuah, he shall at all times rejoice with a cheerful countenance.

verses.raw: There be three things that my heart fears; and for the fourth I was sore afraid: the slander of a city, the gathering together of an unruly multitude, and a false accusation: all these are worse than death.
verses.text: There be three things that my heart fears; and for the fourth I was sore afraid: the slander of a city, the gathering together of an unruly multitude, and a false accusation: all these are worse than death.

verses.raw: But a grief of heart and sorrow is a woman that is jealous over another woman, and a scourge of the tongue which communicateth with all.
verses.text: But a grief of heart and sorrow is a woman that is jealous over another woman, and a scourge of the tongue which communicateth with all.

verses.raw: An evil wife is a yoke shaken to and fro: he that has hold of her is as though he held a scorpion.
verses.text: An evil wife is a yoke shaken to and fro: he that has hold of her is as though he held a scorpion.

verses.raw: A drunken woman and a gadder abroad causeth great anger, and she will not cover her own shame.
verses.text: A drunken woman and a gadder abroad causeth great anger, and she will not cover her own shame.

verses.raw: The whoredom of a woman may be known in her haughty looks and eyelids.
verses.text: The whoredom of a woman may be known in her haughty looks and eyelids.

verses.raw: If your daughter be shameless, keep her in straitly, lest she abuse herself through overmuch liberty.
verses.text: If your daughter be shameless, keep her in straitly, lest she abuse herself through overmuch liberty.

verses.raw: Watch over an impudent eye: and marvel not if she trespass against you.
verses.text: Watch over an impudent eye: and marvel not if she trespass against you.

verses.raw: She will open her mouth, as a thirsty traveller when he has found a fountain, and drink of every water near her: by every hedge will she sit down, and open her quiver against every arrow.
verses.text: She will open her mouth, as a thirsty traveller when he has found a fountain, and drink of every water near her: by every hedge will she sit down, and open her quiver against every arrow.

verses.raw: The grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones.
verses.text: The grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones.

verses.raw: A silent and loving woman is a gift of Yahuah (God); and there is nothing so much worth as a mind well instructed.
verses.text: A silent and loving woman is a gift of Yahuah; and there is nothing so much worth as a mind well instructed.

verses.raw: A shamefaced and faithful woman is a double grace, and her continent mind cannot be valued.
verses.text: A shamefaced and faithful woman is a double grace, and her continent mind cannot be valued.

verses.raw: As the sun when it ariseth in the high heaven; so is the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house.
verses.text: As the sun when it ariseth in the high heaven; so is the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house.

verses.raw: As the clear light is upon the holy candlestick; so is the beauty of the face in ripe age.
verses.text: As the clear light is upon the holy candlestick; so is the beauty of the face in ripe age.

verses.raw: As the golden pillars are upon the sockets of silver; so are the fair feet with a constant heart.
verses.text: As the golden pillars are upon the sockets of silver; so are the fair feet with a constant heart.

verses.raw: My son, keep the flower of your age sound; and give not your strength to strangers.
verses.text: My son, keep the flower of your age sound; and give not your strength to strangers.

verses.raw: When you have gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with your own seed, trusting in the goodness of your stock.
verses.text: When you have gotten a fruitful possession through all the field, sow it with your own seed, trusting in the goodness of your stock.

verses.raw: So your race which you leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.
verses.text: So your race which you leavest shall be magnified, having the confidence of their good descent.

verses.raw: An harlot shall be accounted as spittle; but a married woman is a tower against death to her husband.
verses.text: An harlot shall be accounted as spittle; but a married woman is a tower against death to her husband.

verses.raw: A wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man: but a godly woman is given to him that fears Yahuah (God).
verses.text: A wicked woman is given as a portion to a wicked man: but a godly woman is given to him that fears Yahuah.

verses.raw: A dishonest woman contemneth shame: but an honest woman will reverence her husband.
verses.text: A dishonest woman contemneth shame: but an honest woman will reverence her husband.

verses.raw: A shameless woman shall be counted as a dog; but she that is shamefaced will fear Yahuah (God).
verses.text: A shameless woman shall be counted as a dog; but she that is shamefaced will fear Yahuah.

verses.raw: A woman that honoureth her husband shall be judged wise of all; but she that dishonoureth him in her pride shall be counted ungodly of all.
verses.text: A woman that honoureth her husband shall be judged wise of all; but she that dishonoureth him in her pride shall be counted ungodly of all.

verses.raw: A loud crying woman and a scold shall be sought out to drive away the enemies.
verses.text: A loud crying woman and a scold shall be sought out to drive away the enemies.

verses.raw: There be two things that grieve my heart; and the third makes me angry: a man of war that suffers poverty; and men of understanding that are not set by; and one that returns from righteousness to sin; Yahuah (God) prepareth such an one for the sword.
verses.text: There be two things that grieve my heart; and the third makes me angry: a man of war that suffers poverty; and men of understanding that are not set by; and one that returns from righteousness to sin; Yahuah prepareth such an one for the sword.

verses.raw: A merchant shall hardly keep himself from doing wrong; and an huckster shall not be freed from sin. ⸻
verses.text: A merchant shall hardly keep himself from doing wrong; and an huckster shall not be freed from sin. ⸻

verses.raw: Many have sinned for a small matter; and he that seeks for abundance will turn his eyes away.
verses.text: Many have sinned for a small matter; and he that seeks for abundance will turn his eyes away.

verses.raw: As a nail sticketh fast between the joinings of the stones; so does sin stick close between buying and selling.
verses.text: As a nail sticketh fast between the joinings of the stones; so does sin stick close between buying and selling.

verses.raw: Unless a man hold himself diligently in the fear of Yahuah (God), his house shall soon be overthrown.
verses.text: Unless a man hold himself diligently in the fear of Yahuah, his house shall soon be overthrown.

verses.raw: As when one sifteth with a sieve, the refuse remains; so the filth of man in his talk.
verses.text: As when one sifteth with a sieve, the refuse remains; so the filth of man in his talk.

verses.raw: The furnace proves the potter’s vessels; so the trial of man is in his reasoning.
verses.text: The furnace proves the potter’s vessels; so the trial of man is in his reasoning.

verses.raw: The fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.
verses.text: The fruit declareth if the tree have been dressed; so is the utterance of a conceit in the heart of man.

verses.raw: Praise no man before you hear him speak; for this is the trial of men.
verses.text: Praise no man before you hear him speak; for this is the trial of men.

verses.raw: If you followest righteousness, you shall obtain her, and put her on, as a glorious long robe.
verses.text: If you followest righteousness, you shall obtain her, and put her on, as a glorious long robe.

verses.raw: The birds will resort to their like; so will truth return to them that practise in her.
verses.text: The birds will resort to their like; so will truth return to them that practise in her.

verses.raw: As the lion lieth in wait for the prey; so sin for them that work iniquity.
verses.text: As the lion lieth in wait for the prey; so sin for them that work iniquity.

verses.raw: The discourse of a godly man is always with wisdom; but a fool changeth as the moon.
verses.text: The discourse of a godly man is always with wisdom; but a fool changeth as the moon.

verses.raw: If you be among the indiscreet, observe the time; but be continually among men of understanding.
verses.text: If you be among the indiscreet, observe the time; but be continually among men of understanding.

verses.raw: The discourse of fools is irksome, and their sport is the wantonness of sin.
verses.text: The discourse of fools is irksome, and their sport is the wantonness of sin.

verses.raw: The talk of him that sweareth much makes the hair stand upright; and their brawls make one stop his ears.
verses.text: The talk of him that sweareth much makes the hair stand upright; and their brawls make one stop his ears.

verses.raw: The strife of the proud is bloodshedding, and their revilings are grievous to the ear.
verses.text: The strife of the proud is bloodshedding, and their revilings are grievous to the ear.

verses.raw: Whoso discovers secrets loses his credit; and shall never find friend to his mind.
verses.text: Whoso discovers secrets loses his credit; and shall never find friend to his mind.

verses.raw: Love your friend, and be faithful to him: but if you betrayest his secrets, follow no more after him.
verses.text: Love your friend, and be faithful to him: but if you betrayest his secrets, follow no more after him.

verses.raw: For as a man has destroyed his enemy; so have you lost the love of your neighbor.
verses.text: For as a man has destroyed his enemy; so have you lost the love of your neighbor.

verses.raw: As one that letteth a bird go out of his hand, so have you let your neighbour go, and shall not get him again
verses.text: As one that letteth a bird go out of his hand, so have you let your neighbour go, and shall not get him again

verses.raw: Follow after him no more, for he is too far off; he is as a roe escaped out of the snare.
verses.text: Follow after him no more, for he is too far off; he is as a roe escaped out of the snare.

verses.raw: As for a wound, it may be bound up; and after reviling there may be reconcilement: but he that betrayeth secrets is without hope.
verses.text: As for a wound, it may be bound up; and after reviling there may be reconcilement: but he that betrayeth secrets is without hope.

verses.raw: He that winketh with the eyes works evil: and he that knoweth him will depart from him.
verses.text: He that winketh with the eyes works evil: and he that knoweth him will depart from him.

verses.raw: When you are present, he will speak sweetly, and will admire your words: but at the last he will writhe his mouth, and slander your sayings.
verses.text: When you are present, he will speak sweetly, and will admire your words: but at the last he will writhe his mouth, and slander your sayings.

verses.raw: I have hated many things, but nothing like him; for Yahuah (God) will hate him.
verses.text: I have hated many things, but nothing like him; for Yahuah will hate him.

verses.raw: Whoso casteth a stone on high casteth it on his own head; and a deceitful stroke shall make wounds.
verses.text: Whoso casteth a stone on high casteth it on his own head; and a deceitful stroke shall make wounds.

verses.raw: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall in it: and he that sets a trap shall be taken in it.
verses.text: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall in it: and he that sets a trap shall be taken in it.

verses.raw: He that works mischief, it shall fall upon him, and he shall not know whence it comes.
verses.text: He that works mischief, it shall fall upon him, and he shall not know whence it comes.

verses.raw: Mockery and reproach are from the proud; but vengeance, as a lion, shall lie in wait for them.
verses.text: Mockery and reproach are from the proud; but vengeance, as a lion, shall lie in wait for them.

verses.raw: They that rejoice at the fall of the righteous shall be taken in the snare; and anguish shall consume them before they die.
verses.text: They that rejoice at the fall of the righteous shall be taken in the snare; and anguish shall consume them before they die.

verses.raw: Malice and wrath, even these are abominations; and the sinful man shall have them both. ⸻
verses.text: Malice and wrath, even these are abominations; and the sinful man shall have them both. ⸻

verses.raw: He that revengeth shall find vengeance from Yahuah (God), and he will surely keep his sins in remembrance.
verses.text: He that revengeth shall find vengeance from Yahuah, and he will surely keep his sins in remembrance.

verses.raw: Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you, so shall your sins also be forgiven when you prayest.
verses.text: Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you, so shall your sins also be forgiven when you prayest.

verses.raw: One man bears hatred against another, and does he seek pardon from Yahuah (God)?
verses.text: One man bears hatred against another, and does he seek pardon from Yahuah?

verses.raw: He sheweth no mercy to a man, which is like himself: and does he ask forgiveness of his own sins?
verses.text: He sheweth no mercy to a man, which is like himself: and does he ask forgiveness of his own sins?

verses.raw: If he that is but flesh nourish hatred, who will intreat for pardon of his sins?
verses.text: If he that is but flesh nourish hatred, who will intreat for pardon of his sins?

verses.raw: Remember your end, and let enmity cease; remember corruption and death, and abide in the commandments.
verses.text: Remember your end, and let enmity cease; remember corruption and death, and abide in the commandments.

verses.raw: Remember the commandments, and bear no malice to your neighbour: remember the covenant of the Highest, and wink at ignorance.
verses.text: Remember the commandments, and bear no malice to your neighbour: remember the covenant of the Highest, and wink at ignorance.

verses.raw: Abstain from strife, and you shall diminish your sins: for a furious man will kindle strife,
verses.text: Abstain from strife, and you shall diminish your sins: for a furious man will kindle strife,

verses.raw: A sinful man disquieteth friends, and makes debate among them that be at peace.
verses.text: A sinful man disquieteth friends, and makes debate among them that be at peace.

verses.raw: As the matter of the fire is, so it burneth: and as a man’s strength is, so is his wrath; and according to his riches his anger rises; and the stronger they are which contend, the more they will be inflamed.
verses.text: As the matter of the fire is, so it burneth: and as a man’s strength is, so is his wrath; and according to his riches his anger rises; and the stronger they are which contend, the more they will be inflamed.

verses.raw: An hasty contention kindleth a fire: and an hasty fighting sheddeth blood.
verses.text: An hasty contention kindleth a fire: and an hasty fighting sheddeth blood.

verses.raw: If you blow the spark, it shall burn: if you spit upon it, it shall be quenched: and both these come out of your mouth.
verses.text: If you blow the spark, it shall burn: if you spit upon it, it shall be quenched: and both these come out of your mouth.

verses.raw: Curse the whisperer and doubletongued: for such have destroyed many that were at peace.
verses.text: Curse the whisperer and doubletongued: for such have destroyed many that were at peace.

verses.raw: A backbiting tongue has disquieted many, and driven them from nation to nation: strong cities has it pulled down, and overthrown the houses of great men.
verses.text: A backbiting tongue has disquieted many, and driven them from nation to nation: strong cities has it pulled down, and overthrown the houses of great men.

verses.raw: A backbiting tongue has cast out virtuous women, and deprived them of their labours.
verses.text: A backbiting tongue has cast out virtuous women, and deprived them of their labours.

verses.raw: Whoso hearkeneth to it shall never find rest, and never dwell quietly.
verses.text: Whoso hearkeneth to it shall never find rest, and never dwell quietly.

verses.raw: The stroke of the whip makes marks in the flesh: but the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones.
verses.text: The stroke of the whip makes marks in the flesh: but the stroke of the tongue breaks the bones.

verses.raw: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword: but not so many as have fallen by the tongue.
verses.text: Many have fallen by the edge of the sword: but not so many as have fallen by the tongue.

verses.raw: Well is he that is defended through the venom thereof; who has not drawn the yoke thereof, nor has been bound in her bands.
verses.text: Well is he that is defended through the venom thereof; who has not drawn the yoke thereof, nor has been bound in her bands.

verses.raw: For the yoke thereof is a yoke of iron, and the bands thereof are bands of brass.
verses.text: For the yoke thereof is a yoke of iron, and the bands thereof are bands of brass.

verses.raw: The death thereof is an evil death, the grave were better than it.
verses.text: The death thereof is an evil death, the grave were better than it.

verses.raw: It shall not have rule over them that fear Yahuah (God), neither shall they be burned with the flame thereof.
verses.text: It shall not have rule over them that fear Yahuah, neither shall they be burned with the flame thereof.

verses.raw: Such as forsake Yahuah (God) shall fall into it; and it shall burn in them, and not be quenched; it shall be sent upon them as a lion, and devour them as a leopard.
verses.text: Such as forsake Yahuah shall fall into it; and it shall burn in them, and not be quenched; it shall be sent upon them as a lion, and devour them as a leopard.

verses.raw: Look that you hedge your possession about with thorns, and bind up your silver and gold,
verses.text: Look that you hedge your possession about with thorns, and bind up your silver and gold,

verses.raw: And weigh your words in a balance, and make a door and bar for your mouth.
verses.text: And weigh your words in a balance, and make a door and bar for your mouth.

verses.raw: Beware you slide not by it, lest you fall before him that lieth in wait. ⸻
verses.text: Beware you slide not by it, lest you fall before him that lieth in wait. ⸻

verses.raw: He that is merciful will lend to his neighbour; and he that strengtheneth his hand keepeth the commandments.
verses.text: He that is merciful will lend to his neighbour; and he that strengtheneth his hand keepeth the commandments.

verses.raw: Lend to your neighbour in time of his need, and pay you your neighbour again in due season.
verses.text: Lend to your neighbour in time of his need, and pay you your neighbour again in due season.

verses.raw: Keep your word, and deal faithfully with him, and you shall always find the thing that is necessary for you.
verses.text: Keep your word, and deal faithfully with him, and you shall always find the thing that is necessary for you.

verses.raw: Many, when a thing was lent them, reckoned it to be found, and put them to trouble that helped them.
verses.text: Many, when a thing was lent them, reckoned it to be found, and put them to trouble that helped them.

verses.raw: Till he has received, he will kiss a man’s hand; and for his neighbour’s money he will speak submissly: but when he should repay, he will prolong the time, and return words of grief, and complain of the time.
verses.text: Till he has received, he will kiss a man’s hand; and for his neighbour’s money he will speak submissly: but when he should repay, he will prolong the time, and return words of grief, and complain of the time.

verses.raw: If he prevail, he shall hardly receive the half, and he will count as if he had found it: if not, he has deprived him of his money, and he has gotten him an enemy without cause: he payeth him with cursings and railings; and for honour he will pay him disgrace.
verses.text: If he prevail, he shall hardly receive the half, and he will count as if he had found it: if not, he has deprived him of his money, and he has gotten him an enemy without cause: he payeth him with cursings and railings; and for honour he will pay him disgrace.

verses.raw: Many therefore have refused to lend for other men’s ill dealing, fearing to be defrauded.
