verses.text: Many therefore have refused to lend for other men’s ill dealing, fearing to be defrauded.

verses.raw: Yet have you patience with a man in poor estate, and delay not to shew him mercy.
verses.text: Yet have you patience with a man in poor estate, and delay not to shew him mercy.

verses.raw: Help the poor for the commandment’s sake, and turn him not away because of his poverty.
verses.text: Help the poor for the commandment’s sake, and turn him not away because of his poverty.

verses.raw: Lose your money for your brother and your friend, and let it not rust under a stone to be lost.
verses.text: Lose your money for your brother and your friend, and let it not rust under a stone to be lost.

verses.raw: Lay up your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High, and it shall bring you more profit than gold.
verses.text: Lay up your treasure according to the commandments of the Most High, and it shall bring you more profit than gold.

verses.raw: Shut up alms in your storehouses: and it shall deliver you from all affliction.
verses.text: Shut up alms in your storehouses: and it shall deliver you from all affliction.

verses.raw: It shall fight for you against your enemies better than a mighty shield and strong spear.
verses.text: It shall fight for you against your enemies better than a mighty shield and strong spear.

verses.raw: An honest man is surety for his neighbour: but he that is impudent will forsake him.
verses.text: An honest man is surety for his neighbour: but he that is impudent will forsake him.

verses.raw: Forget not the friendship of your surety, for he has given his life for you.
verses.text: Forget not the friendship of your surety, for he has given his life for you.

verses.raw: A sinner will overthrow the good estate of his surety:
verses.text: A sinner will overthrow the good estate of his surety:

verses.raw: And he that is of an unthankful mind will leave him in danger that delivered him.
verses.text: And he that is of an unthankful mind will leave him in danger that delivered him.

verses.raw: Suretiship has undone many of good estate, and shaken them as a wave of the sea: mighty men has it driven from their houses, so that they wandered among strange nations.
verses.text: Suretiship has undone many of good estate, and shaken them as a wave of the sea: mighty men has it driven from their houses, so that they wandered among strange nations.

verses.raw: A wicked man transgressing the commandments of Yahuah (God) shall fall into suretiship: and he that undertaketh and followeth other men’s business for gain shall fall into suits.
verses.text: A wicked man transgressing the commandments of Yahuah shall fall into suretiship: and he that undertaketh and followeth other men’s business for gain shall fall into suits.

verses.raw: Help your neighbour according to your power, and beware that you thyself fall not into the same.
verses.text: Help your neighbour according to your power, and beware that you thyself fall not into the same.

verses.raw: The chief thing for life is water, and bread, and clothing, and an house to cover shame.
verses.text: The chief thing for life is water, and bread, and clothing, and an house to cover shame.

verses.raw: Better is the life of a poor man in a mean cottage, than delicate fare in another man’s house.
verses.text: Better is the life of a poor man in a mean cottage, than delicate fare in another man’s house.

verses.raw: Be it little or much, hold you contented, that you hear not the reproach of your house.
verses.text: Be it little or much, hold you contented, that you hear not the reproach of your house.

verses.raw: For it is a miserable life to go from house to house: for where you are a stranger, you darest not open your mouth.
verses.text: For it is a miserable life to go from house to house: for where you are a stranger, you darest not open your mouth.

verses.raw: You shall entertain, and feast, and have no thanks: moreover you shall hear bitter words:
verses.text: You shall entertain, and feast, and have no thanks: moreover you shall hear bitter words:

verses.raw: Come, you stranger, and furnish a table, and feed me of that you have ready.
verses.text: Come, you stranger, and furnish a table, and feed me of that you have ready.

verses.raw: Give place, you stranger, to an honourable man; my brother comes to be lodged, and I have need of my house.
verses.text: Give place, you stranger, to an honourable man; my brother comes to be lodged, and I have need of my house.

verses.raw: These things are grievous to a man of understanding; the upbraiding of houseroom, and reproaching of the lender. ⸻
verses.text: These things are grievous to a man of understanding; the upbraiding of houseroom, and reproaching of the lender. ⸻

verses.raw: He that loves his son causeth him oft to feel the rod, that he may have joy of him in the end.
verses.text: He that loves his son causeth him oft to feel the rod, that he may have joy of him in the end.

verses.raw: He that chastiseth his son shall have joy in him, and shall rejoice of him among his acquaintance.
verses.text: He that chastiseth his son shall have joy in him, and shall rejoice of him among his acquaintance.

verses.raw: He that teaches his son grieves the enemy: and before his friends he shall rejoice of him.
verses.text: He that teaches his son grieves the enemy: and before his friends he shall rejoice of him.

verses.raw: Though his father die, yet he is as though he were not dead: for he has left one behind him that is like himself.
verses.text: Though his father die, yet he is as though he were not dead: for he has left one behind him that is like himself.

verses.raw: While he lived, he saw and rejoiced in him: and when he died, he was not sorrowful.
verses.text: While he lived, he saw and rejoiced in him: and when he died, he was not sorrowful.

verses.raw: He left behind him an avenger against his enemies, and one that shall requite kindness to his friends.
verses.text: He left behind him an avenger against his enemies, and one that shall requite kindness to his friends.

verses.raw: He that makes too much of his son shall bind up his wounds; and his bowels will be troubled at every cry.
verses.text: He that makes too much of his son shall bind up his wounds; and his bowels will be troubled at every cry.

verses.raw: An horse not broken becometh headstrong: and a child left to himself will be wilful.
verses.text: An horse not broken becometh headstrong: and a child left to himself will be wilful.

verses.raw: Cocker your child, and he shall make you afraid: play with him, and he will bring you to heaviness.
verses.text: Cocker your child, and he shall make you afraid: play with him, and he will bring you to heaviness.

verses.raw: Laugh not with him, lest you have sorrow with him, and lest you gnash your teeth in the end.
verses.text: Laugh not with him, lest you have sorrow with him, and lest you gnash your teeth in the end.

verses.raw: Give him no liberty in his youth, and wink not at his follies.
verses.text: Give him no liberty in his youth, and wink not at his follies.

verses.raw: Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn, and be disobedient to you, and so bring sorrow to yours heart.
verses.text: Bow down his neck while he is young, and beat him on the sides while he is a child, lest he wax stubborn, and be disobedient to you, and so bring sorrow to yours heart.

verses.raw: Chastise your son, and hold him to labour, lest his lewd behaviour be an offence to you.
verses.text: Chastise your son, and hold him to labour, lest his lewd behaviour be an offence to you.

verses.raw: Better is the poor, being sound and strong of constitution, than a rich man that is afflicted in his body.
verses.text: Better is the poor, being sound and strong of constitution, than a rich man that is afflicted in his body.

verses.raw: Health and good estate of body are above all gold, and a strong body above infinite wealth.
verses.text: Health and good estate of body are above all gold, and a strong body above infinite wealth.

verses.raw: There is no riches above a sound body, and no joy above the joy of the heart.
verses.text: There is no riches above a sound body, and no joy above the joy of the heart.

verses.raw: Death is better than a bitter life or continual sickness.
verses.text: Death is better than a bitter life or continual sickness.

verses.raw: Delicates poured upon a mouth shut up are as messes of meat set upon a grave.
verses.text: Delicates poured upon a mouth shut up are as messes of meat set upon a grave.

verses.raw: What good doeth the offering to an idol? for neither can it eat nor smell: so is he that is persecuted of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: What good doeth the offering to an idol? for neither can it eat nor smell: so is he that is persecuted of Yahuah.

verses.raw: He seeth with his eyes and groaneth, as an eunuch that embraceth a virgin and sigheth.
verses.text: He seeth with his eyes and groaneth, as an eunuch that embraceth a virgin and sigheth.

verses.raw: Give not over your mind to heaviness, and afflict not thyself in your own counsel.
verses.text: Give not over your mind to heaviness, and afflict not thyself in your own counsel.

verses.raw: The gladness of the heart is the life of man, and the joyfulness of a man prolongeth his days.
verses.text: The gladness of the heart is the life of man, and the joyfulness of a man prolongeth his days.

verses.raw: Love your own soul, and comfort your heart, remove sorrow far from you: for sorrow has killed many, and there is no profit in it.
verses.text: Love your own soul, and comfort your heart, remove sorrow far from you: for sorrow has killed many, and there is no profit in it.

verses.raw: Envy and wrath shorten the life, and carefulness brings age before the time.
verses.text: Envy and wrath shorten the life, and carefulness brings age before the time.

verses.raw: A cheerful and good heart will have a care of his meat and diet. ⸻
verses.text: A cheerful and good heart will have a care of his meat and diet. ⸻

verses.raw: Watching for riches consumeth the flesh, and the care thereof drives away sleep.
verses.text: Watching for riches consumeth the flesh, and the care thereof drives away sleep.

verses.raw: Watching care will not let a man slumber, as a sore disease breaks sleep,
verses.text: Watching care will not let a man slumber, as a sore disease breaks sleep,

verses.raw: The rich has great labour in gathering riches together; and when he resteth, he is filled with his delicates.
verses.text: The rich has great labour in gathering riches together; and when he resteth, he is filled with his delicates.

verses.raw: The poor laboureth in his poor estate; and when he leaveth off, he is still needy.
verses.text: The poor laboureth in his poor estate; and when he leaveth off, he is still needy.

verses.raw: He that loves gold shall not be justified, and he that followeth corruption shall have enough thereof.
verses.text: He that loves gold shall not be justified, and he that followeth corruption shall have enough thereof.

verses.raw: Gold has been the ruin of many, and their destruction was present.
verses.text: Gold has been the ruin of many, and their destruction was present.

verses.raw: It is a stumblingblock to them that sacrifice to it, and every fool shall be taken with it.
verses.text: It is a stumblingblock to them that sacrifice to it, and every fool shall be taken with it.

verses.raw: Blessed is the rich that is found without blemish, and has not gone after gold.
verses.text: Blessed is the rich that is found without blemish, and has not gone after gold.

verses.raw: Who is he? and we will call him blessed: for wonderful things has he done among his people.
verses.text: Who is he? and we will call him blessed: for wonderful things has he done among his people.

verses.raw: Who has been tried thereby, and found perfect? then let him glory. Who might offend, and has not offended? or done evil, and has not done it?
verses.text: Who has been tried thereby, and found perfect? then let him glory. Who might offend, and has not offended? or done evil, and has not done it?

verses.raw: His goods shall be established, and the congregation shall declare his alms.
verses.text: His goods shall be established, and the congregation shall declare his alms.

verses.raw: If you sit at a bountiful table, be not greedy upon it, and say not, There is much meat on it.
verses.text: If you sit at a bountiful table, be not greedy upon it, and say not, There is much meat on it.

verses.raw: Remember that a wicked eye is an evil thing: and what is created more wicked than an eye? therefore it weeps upon every occasion.
verses.text: Remember that a wicked eye is an evil thing: and what is created more wicked than an eye? therefore it weeps upon every occasion.

verses.raw: Stretch not yours hand whithersoever it looketh, and thrust it not with him into the dish.
verses.text: Stretch not yours hand whithersoever it looketh, and thrust it not with him into the dish.

verses.raw: Judge not your neighbour by thyself: and be discreet in every point.
verses.text: Judge not your neighbour by thyself: and be discreet in every point.

verses.raw: Eat as it becometh a man, those things which are set before you; and devour not, lest you be hated.
verses.text: Eat as it becometh a man, those things which are set before you; and devour not, lest you be hated.

verses.raw: Leave off first for manners’ sake; and be not unsatiable, lest you offend.
verses.text: Leave off first for manners’ sake; and be not unsatiable, lest you offend.

verses.raw: When you sittest among many, reach not yours hand out first of all.
verses.text: When you sittest among many, reach not yours hand out first of all.

verses.raw: A very little is sufficient for a man well nurtured, and he fetcheth not his wind short upon his bed.
verses.text: A very little is sufficient for a man well nurtured, and he fetcheth not his wind short upon his bed.

verses.raw: Sound sleep comes of moderate eating: he rises early, and his wits are with him: but the pain of watching, and choler, and pangs of the belly, are with an unsatiable man.
verses.text: Sound sleep comes of moderate eating: he rises early, and his wits are with him: but the pain of watching, and choler, and pangs of the belly, are with an unsatiable man.

verses.raw: And if you have been forced to eat, arise, go forth, vomit, and you shall have rest.
verses.text: And if you have been forced to eat, arise, go forth, vomit, and you shall have rest.

verses.raw: My son, hear me, and despise me not, and at the last you shall find as I told you: in all your works be quick, so shall there no sickness come to you.
verses.text: My son, hear me, and despise me not, and at the last you shall find as I told you: in all your works be quick, so shall there no sickness come to you.

verses.raw: Whoso is liberal of his meat, men shall speak well of him; and the report of his good housekeeping will be believed.
verses.text: Whoso is liberal of his meat, men shall speak well of him; and the report of his good housekeeping will be believed.

verses.raw: But against him that is a niggard of his meat the whole city shall murmur; and the testimonies of his niggardness shall not be doubted of.
verses.text: But against him that is a niggard of his meat the whole city shall murmur; and the testimonies of his niggardness shall not be doubted of.

verses.raw: Shew not your valiantness in wine; for wine has destroyed many.
verses.text: Shew not your valiantness in wine; for wine has destroyed many.

verses.raw: The furnace proves the edge by dipping: so does wine the hearts of the proud by drunkeness.
verses.text: The furnace proves the edge by dipping: so does wine the hearts of the proud by drunkeness.

verses.raw: Wine is as good as life to a man, if it be drunk moderately: what life is then to a man that is without wine? for it was made to make men glad.
verses.text: Wine is as good as life to a man, if it be drunk moderately: what life is then to a man that is without wine? for it was made to make men glad.

verses.raw: Wine measurably drunk and in season brings gladness of the heart, and cheerfulness of the mind:
verses.text: Wine measurably drunk and in season brings gladness of the heart, and cheerfulness of the mind:

verses.raw: But wine drunken with excess makes bitterness of the mind, with brawling and quarrelling.
verses.text: But wine drunken with excess makes bitterness of the mind, with brawling and quarrelling.

verses.raw: Drunkenness increaseth the rage of a fool till he offend: it diminisheth strength, and makes wounds.
verses.text: Drunkenness increaseth the rage of a fool till he offend: it diminisheth strength, and makes wounds.

verses.raw: Rebuke not your neighbour at the wine, and despise him not in his mirth: give him no despiteful words, and press not upon him with urging him to drink. ⸻
verses.text: Rebuke not your neighbour at the wine, and despise him not in his mirth: give him no despiteful words, and press not upon him with urging him to drink. ⸻

verses.raw: If you be made the master of a feast, lift not thyself up, but be among them as one of the rest; take diligent care for them, and so sit down.
verses.text: If you be made the master of a feast, lift not thyself up, but be among them as one of the rest; take diligent care for them, and so sit down.

verses.raw: And when you have done all your office, take your place, that you may be merry with them, and receive a crown for your well ordering of the feast.
verses.text: And when you have done all your office, take your place, that you may be merry with them, and receive a crown for your well ordering of the feast.

verses.raw: Speak, you that are the elder, for it becometh you, but with sound judgment; and hinder not musick.
verses.text: Speak, you that are the elder, for it becometh you, but with sound judgment; and hinder not musick.

verses.raw: Pour not out words where there is a musician, and shew not forth wisdom out of time.
verses.text: Pour not out words where there is a musician, and shew not forth wisdom out of time.

verses.raw: A concert of musick in a banquet of wine is as a signet of carbuncle set in gold.
verses.text: A concert of musick in a banquet of wine is as a signet of carbuncle set in gold.

verses.raw: As a signet of an emerald set in a work of gold, so is the melody of musick with pleasant wine.
verses.text: As a signet of an emerald set in a work of gold, so is the melody of musick with pleasant wine.

verses.raw: Speak, young man, if there be need of you: and yet scarcely when you are twice asked.
verses.text: Speak, young man, if there be need of you: and yet scarcely when you are twice asked.

verses.raw: Let your speech be short, comprehending much in few words; be as one that knoweth and yet holdeth his tongue.
verses.text: Let your speech be short, comprehending much in few words; be as one that knoweth and yet holdeth his tongue.

verses.raw: If you be among great men, make not thyself equal with them; and when ancient men are in place, use not many words.
verses.text: If you be among great men, make not thyself equal with them; and when ancient men are in place, use not many words.

verses.raw: Before the thunder goes lightning; and before a shamefaced man shall go favour.
verses.text: Before the thunder goes lightning; and before a shamefaced man shall go favour.

verses.raw: Rise up betimes, and be not the last; but get you home without delay.
verses.text: Rise up betimes, and be not the last; but get you home without delay.

verses.raw: There take your pastime, and do what you will: but sin not by proud speech.
verses.text: There take your pastime, and do what you will: but sin not by proud speech.

verses.raw: And for these things bless him that made you, and has replenished you with his good things.
verses.text: And for these things bless him that made you, and has replenished you with his good things.

verses.raw: Whoso fears Yahuah (God) will receive his discipline; and they that seek him early shall find favour.
verses.text: Whoso fears Yahuah will receive his discipline; and they that seek him early shall find favour.

verses.raw: He that seeks the law shall be filled with it: but the hypocrite will be offended thereat.
verses.text: He that seeks the law shall be filled with it: but the hypocrite will be offended thereat.

verses.raw: They that fear Yahuah (God) shall find judgment, and shall kindle justice as a light.
verses.text: They that fear Yahuah shall find judgment, and shall kindle justice as a light.

verses.raw: A sinful man will not be reproved, but finds an excuse according to his will.
verses.text: A sinful man will not be reproved, but finds an excuse according to his will.

verses.raw: A man of counsel will be considerate; but a strange and proud man is not daunted with fear, even when of himself he has done without counsel.
verses.text: A man of counsel will be considerate; but a strange and proud man is not daunted with fear, even when of himself he has done without counsel.

verses.raw: Do nothing without advice; and when you have once done, repent not.
verses.text: Do nothing without advice; and when you have once done, repent not.

verses.raw: Go not in a way in which you may fall, and stumble not among the stones.
verses.text: Go not in a way in which you may fall, and stumble not among the stones.

verses.raw: Be not confident in a plain way.
verses.text: Be not confident in a plain way.

verses.raw: And beware of your own children.
verses.text: And beware of your own children.

verses.raw: In every good work trust your own soul; for this is the keeping of the commandments.
verses.text: In every good work trust your own soul; for this is the keeping of the commandments.

verses.raw: He that believes in Yahuah (God) takes heed to the commandment; and he that trusts in him shall fare never the worse. ⸻
verses.text: He that believes in Yahuah takes heed to the commandment; and he that trusts in him shall fare never the worse. ⸻

verses.raw: There shall no evil happen to him that fears Yahuah (God); but in temptation even again he will deliver him.
verses.text: There shall no evil happen to him that fears Yahuah; but in temptation even again he will deliver him.

verses.raw: A wise man hates not the law; but he that is an hypocrite in it is as a ship in a storm.
verses.text: A wise man hates not the law; but he that is an hypocrite in it is as a ship in a storm.

verses.raw: A man of understanding trusts in the law; and the law is faithful to him, as an oracle.
verses.text: A man of understanding trusts in the law; and the law is faithful to him, as an oracle.

verses.raw: Prepare what to say, and so you shall be heard: and bind up instruction, and then make answer.
verses.text: Prepare what to say, and so you shall be heard: and bind up instruction, and then make answer.

verses.raw: The heart of the foolish is like a cartwheel; and his thoughts are like a rolling axletree.
verses.text: The heart of the foolish is like a cartwheel; and his thoughts are like a rolling axletree.

verses.raw: A stallion horse is as a mocking friend, he neigheth under every one that sits upon him.
verses.text: A stallion horse is as a mocking friend, he neigheth under every one that sits upon him.

verses.raw: Why does one day excel another, when as all the light of every day in the year is of the sun?
verses.text: Why does one day excel another, when as all the light of every day in the year is of the sun?

verses.raw: By the knowledge of Yahuah (God) they were distinguished: and he altered seasons and feasts.
verses.text: By the knowledge of Yahuah they were distinguished: and he altered seasons and feasts.

verses.raw: Some of them has he made high days, and hallowed them, and some of them has he made ordinary days.
verses.text: Some of them has he made high days, and hallowed them, and some of them has he made ordinary days.

verses.raw: And all men are from the ground, and Adam was created of earth:
verses.text: And all men are from the ground, and Adam was created of earth:

verses.raw: In much knowledge Yahuah (God) has divided them, and made their ways diverse.
verses.text: In much knowledge Yahuah has divided them, and made their ways diverse.

verses.raw: Some of them has he blessed and exalted and some of them he sanctified, and set near himself: but some of them has he cursed and brought low, and turned out of their places.
verses.text: Some of them has he blessed and exalted and some of them he sanctified, and set near himself: but some of them has he cursed and brought low, and turned out of their places.

verses.raw: As the clay is in the potter’s hand, to fashion it at his pleasure: so man is in the hand of him that made him, to render to them as liketh him best.
verses.text: As the clay is in the potter’s hand, to fashion it at his pleasure: so man is in the hand of him that made him, to render to them as liketh him best.

verses.raw: Good is set against evil, and life against death: so is the godly against the sinner, and the sinner against the godly.
verses.text: Good is set against evil, and life against death: so is the godly against the sinner, and the sinner against the godly.

verses.raw: So look upon all the works of the Most High; and there are two and two, one against another.
verses.text: So look upon all the works of the Most High; and there are two and two, one against another.

verses.raw: I awaked up last of all, as one that gathers after the grapegatherers: by the blessing of Yahuah (God) I profited, and tred my winepress like a gatherer of grapes.
verses.text: I awaked up last of all, as one that gathers after the grapegatherers: by the blessing of Yahuah I profited, and tred my winepress like a gatherer of grapes.

verses.raw: Consider that I laboured not for myself only, but for all them that seek learning.
verses.text: Consider that I laboured not for myself only, but for all them that seek learning.

verses.raw: Hear me, O you great men of the people, and hearken with your ears, you rulers of the congregation.
verses.text: Hear me, O you great men of the people, and hearken with your ears, you rulers of the congregation.

verses.raw: Give not your son and wife, your brother and friend, power over you while you livest, and give not your goods to another: lest it repent you, and you intreat for the same again.
verses.text: Give not your son and wife, your brother and friend, power over you while you livest, and give not your goods to another: lest it repent you, and you intreat for the same again.

verses.raw: As long as you livest and have breath in you, give not thyself over to any.
verses.text: As long as you livest and have breath in you, give not thyself over to any.

verses.raw: For better it is that your children should seek to you, than that you should stand to their courtesy.
verses.text: For better it is that your children should seek to you, than that you should stand to their courtesy.

verses.raw: In all your works keep to thyself the preeminence; leave not a stain in yours honour.
verses.text: In all your works keep to thyself the preeminence; leave not a stain in yours honour.

verses.raw: At the time when you shall end your days, and finish your life, distribute your inheritance.
verses.text: At the time when you shall end your days, and finish your life, distribute your inheritance.

verses.raw: Fodder, a wand, and burdens, are for the ass; and bread, correction, and work, for a servant.
verses.text: Fodder, a wand, and burdens, are for the ass; and bread, correction, and work, for a servant.

verses.raw: If you set your servant to labour, you shall find rest: but if you let him go idle, he shall seek liberty.
verses.text: If you set your servant to labour, you shall find rest: but if you let him go idle, he shall seek liberty.

verses.raw: A yoke and a collar do bow the neck: so are tortures and torments for an evil servant.
verses.text: A yoke and a collar do bow the neck: so are tortures and torments for an evil servant.

verses.raw: Send him to labour, that he be not idle; for idleness teaches much evil.
verses.text: Send him to labour, that he be not idle; for idleness teaches much evil.

verses.raw: Set him to work, as is fit for him: if he be not obedient, put on more heavy fetters.
verses.text: Set him to work, as is fit for him: if he be not obedient, put on more heavy fetters.

verses.raw: But be not excessive toward any; and without discretion do nothing.
verses.text: But be not excessive toward any; and without discretion do nothing.

verses.raw: If you have a servant, let him be to you as thyself, because you have bought him with a price.
verses.text: If you have a servant, let him be to you as thyself, because you have bought him with a price.

verses.raw: If you have a servant, entreat him as a brother: for you have need of him, as of your own soul: if you entreat him evil, and he run from you, which way will you go to seek him? ⸻
verses.text: If you have a servant, entreat him as a brother: for you have need of him, as of your own soul: if you entreat him evil, and he run from you, which way will you go to seek him? ⸻

verses.raw: The hopes of a man void of understanding are vain and false: and dreams lift up fools.
verses.text: The hopes of a man void of understanding are vain and false: and dreams lift up fools.

verses.raw: Whoso regardeth dreams is like him that catches at a shadow, and followeth after the wind.
verses.text: Whoso regardeth dreams is like him that catches at a shadow, and followeth after the wind.

verses.raw: The vision of dreams is the resemblance of one thing to another, even as the likeness of a face to a face.
verses.text: The vision of dreams is the resemblance of one thing to another, even as the likeness of a face to a face.

verses.raw: Of an unclean thing what can be cleansed? and from that thing which is false what truth can come?
verses.text: Of an unclean thing what can be cleansed? and from that thing which is false what truth can come?

verses.raw: Divinations, and soothsayings, and dreams, are vain: and the heart fancieth, as a woman’s heart in travail.
verses.text: Divinations, and soothsayings, and dreams, are vain: and the heart fancieth, as a woman’s heart in travail.

verses.raw: If they be not sent from the Most High in your visitation, set not your heart upon them.
verses.text: If they be not sent from the Most High in your visitation, set not your heart upon them.

verses.raw: For dreams have deceived many, and they have failed that put their trust in them.
verses.text: For dreams have deceived many, and they have failed that put their trust in them.

verses.raw: The law shall be found perfect without lies: and wisdom is perfection to a faithful mouth.
verses.text: The law shall be found perfect without lies: and wisdom is perfection to a faithful mouth.

verses.raw: A man that has travelled knoweth many things; and he that has much experience will declare wisdom.
verses.text: A man that has travelled knoweth many things; and he that has much experience will declare wisdom.

verses.raw: He that has no experience knoweth little: but he that has travelled is full of prudence.
verses.text: He that has no experience knoweth little: but he that has travelled is full of prudence.

verses.raw: When I travelled, I saw many things; and I understand more than I can express.
verses.text: When I travelled, I saw many things; and I understand more than I can express.

verses.raw: I was ofttimes in danger of death: yet I was delivered because of these things.
verses.text: I was ofttimes in danger of death: yet I was delivered because of these things.

verses.raw: The spirit of those that fear Yahuah (God) shall live; for their hope is in him that saves them.
verses.text: The spirit of those that fear Yahuah shall live; for their hope is in him that saves them.

verses.raw: Whoso fears Yahuah (God) shall not fear nor be afraid; for he is his hope.
verses.text: Whoso fears Yahuah shall not fear nor be afraid; for he is his hope.

verses.raw: Blessed is the soul of him that fears Yahuah (God): to whom does he look? and who is his strength?
verses.text: Blessed is the soul of him that fears Yahuah: to whom does he look? and who is his strength?

verses.raw: For the eyes of Yahuah (God) are upon them that love him, he is their mighty protection and strong stay, a defence from heat, and a cover from the sun at noon, a preservation from stumbling, and an help from falling.
verses.text: For the eyes of Yahuah are upon them that love him, he is their mighty protection and strong stay, a defence from heat, and a cover from the sun at noon, a preservation from stumbling, and an help from falling.

verses.raw: He raiseth up the soul, and lighteneth the eyes: he gives health, life, and blessing.
verses.text: He raiseth up the soul, and lighteneth the eyes: he gives health, life, and blessing.

verses.raw: He that sacrificeth of a thing wrongfully gotten, his offering is ridiculous; and the gifts of unjust men are not accepted.
verses.text: He that sacrificeth of a thing wrongfully gotten, his offering is ridiculous; and the gifts of unjust men are not accepted.

verses.raw: The most High is not pleased with the offerings of the wicked; neither is he pacified for sin by the multitude of sacrifices.
verses.text: The most High is not pleased with the offerings of the wicked; neither is he pacified for sin by the multitude of sacrifices.

verses.raw: Whoso brings an offering of the goods of the poor doeth as one that killeth the son before his father’s eyes.
verses.text: Whoso brings an offering of the goods of the poor doeth as one that killeth the son before his father’s eyes.

verses.raw: The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.
verses.text: The bread of the needy is their life: he that defraudeth him thereof is a man of blood.

verses.raw: He that takes away his neighbour’s living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.
verses.text: He that takes away his neighbour’s living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.

verses.raw: When one buildeth, and another pulleth down, what profit have they then but labour?
verses.text: When one buildeth, and another pulleth down, what profit have they then but labour?

verses.raw: When one prayeth, and another curses, whose voice will Yahuah (God) hear?
verses.text: When one prayeth, and another curses, whose voice will Yahuah hear?

verses.raw: He that washeth himself after the touching of a dead body, if he touch it again, what availeth his washing?
verses.text: He that washeth himself after the touching of a dead body, if he touch it again, what availeth his washing?

verses.raw: So is it with a man that fasteth for his sins, and goes again, and doeth the same: who will hear his prayer? or what does his humbling profit him? ⸻
verses.text: So is it with a man that fasteth for his sins, and goes again, and doeth the same: who will hear his prayer? or what does his humbling profit him? ⸻

verses.raw: He that keepeth the law brings offerings enough: he that takes heed to the commandment offers a peace offering.
verses.text: He that keepeth the law brings offerings enough: he that takes heed to the commandment offers a peace offering.

verses.raw: He that requiteth a goodturn offers fine flour; and he that gives alms sacrificeth praise.
verses.text: He that requiteth a goodturn offers fine flour; and he that gives alms sacrificeth praise.

verses.raw: To depart from wickedness is a thing pleasing to Yahuah (God); and to forsake unrighteousness is a propitiation.
verses.text: To depart from wickedness is a thing pleasing to Yahuah; and to forsake unrighteousness is a propitiation.

verses.raw: You shall not appear empty before Yahuah (God).
verses.text: You shall not appear empty before Yahuah.

verses.raw: For all these things are to be done because of the commandment.
verses.text: For all these things are to be done because of the commandment.

verses.raw: The offering of the righteous makes the altar fat, and the sweet savour thereof is before the Most High.
verses.text: The offering of the righteous makes the altar fat, and the sweet savour thereof is before the Most High.

verses.raw: The sacrifice of a just man is acceptable. and the memorial thereof shall never be forgotten.
verses.text: The sacrifice of a just man is acceptable. and the memorial thereof shall never be forgotten.

verses.raw: Give Yahuah (God) his honour with a good eye, and diminish not the firstfruits of yours hands.
verses.text: Give Yahuah his honour with a good eye, and diminish not the firstfruits of yours hands.

verses.raw: In all your gifts shew a cheerful countenance, and dedicate your tithes with gladness.
verses.text: In all your gifts shew a cheerful countenance, and dedicate your tithes with gladness.

verses.raw: Give to the Most High according as he has enriched you; and as you have gotten, give with a cheerful eye.
verses.text: Give to the Most High according as he has enriched you; and as you have gotten, give with a cheerful eye.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) recompenseth, and will give you seven times as much.
verses.text: For Yahuah recompenseth, and will give you seven times as much.

verses.raw: Do not think to corrupt with gifts; for such he will not receive: and trust not to unrighteous sacrifices; for Yahuah (God) is judge, and with him is no respect of persons.
verses.text: Do not think to corrupt with gifts; for such he will not receive: and trust not to unrighteous sacrifices; for Yahuah is judge, and with him is no respect of persons.

verses.raw: He will not accept any person against a poor man, but will hear the prayer of the oppressed.
verses.text: He will not accept any person against a poor man, but will hear the prayer of the oppressed.

verses.raw: He will not despise the supplication of the fatherless; nor the widow, when she poureth out her complaint.
verses.text: He will not despise the supplication of the fatherless; nor the widow, when she poureth out her complaint.

verses.raw: Do not the tears run down the widow’s cheeks? and is not her cry against him that causeth them to fall?
verses.text: Do not the tears run down the widow’s cheeks? and is not her cry against him that causeth them to fall?

verses.raw: He that serveth Yahuah (God) shall be accepted with favour, and his prayer shall reach to the clouds.
verses.text: He that serveth Yahuah shall be accepted with favour, and his prayer shall reach to the clouds.

verses.raw: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds: and till it come nigh, he will not be comforted; and will not depart, till the Most High shall behold to judge righteously, and execute judgment.
verses.text: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds: and till it come nigh, he will not be comforted; and will not depart, till the Most High shall behold to judge righteously, and execute judgment.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) will not be slack, neither will the Mighty be patient toward them, till he have struck in sunder the loins of the unmerciful, and repayed vengeance to the heathen; till he have taken away the multitude of the proud, and broken the sceptre of the unrighteous;
verses.text: For Yahuah will not be slack, neither will the Mighty be patient toward them, till he have struck in sunder the loins of the unmerciful, and repayed vengeance to the heathen; till he have taken away the multitude of the proud, and broken the sceptre of the unrighteous;

verses.raw: Till he have rendered to every man according to his deeds, and to the works of men according to their devices; till he have judged the cause of his people, and made them to rejoice in his mercy.
verses.text: Till he have rendered to every man according to his deeds, and to the works of men according to their devices; till he have judged the cause of his people, and made them to rejoice in his mercy.

verses.raw: Mercy is seasonable in the time of affliction, as clouds of rain in the time of drought. ⸻
verses.text: Mercy is seasonable in the time of affliction, as clouds of rain in the time of drought. ⸻

verses.raw: Have mercy upon us, O Yahuah (God) of all, and behold us:
verses.text: Have mercy upon us, O Yahuah of all, and behold us:

verses.raw: And send your fear upon all the nations that seek not after you.
verses.text: And send your fear upon all the nations that seek not after you.

verses.raw: Lift up your hand against the strange nations, and let them see your power.
verses.text: Lift up your hand against the strange nations, and let them see your power.

verses.raw: As you were sanctified in us before them: so be you magnified among them before us.
verses.text: As you were sanctified in us before them: so be you magnified among them before us.

verses.raw: And let them know you, as we have known you, that there is no Yahuah (God) but only you, O Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And let them know you, as we have known you, that there is no Yahuah but only you, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Shew new signs, and make other strange wonders: glorify your hand and your right arm, that they may set forth your wondrous works.
verses.text: Shew new signs, and make other strange wonders: glorify your hand and your right arm, that they may set forth your wondrous works.

verses.raw: Raise up indignation, and pour out wrath: take away the adversary, and destroy the enemy.
verses.text: Raise up indignation, and pour out wrath: take away the adversary, and destroy the enemy.

verses.raw: Make the time short, remember the covenant, and let them declare your wonderful works.
verses.text: Make the time short, remember the covenant, and let them declare your wonderful works.

verses.raw: Let him that escapeth be consumed by the rage of the fire; and let them perish that oppress the people.
verses.text: Let him that escapeth be consumed by the rage of the fire; and let them perish that oppress the people.

verses.raw: Smite in sunder the heads of the rulers of the heathen, that say, There is none other but we.
verses.text: Smite in sunder the heads of the rulers of the heathen, that say, There is none other but we.

verses.raw: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.
verses.text: Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Yashar'el (Israel), whom you have named your firstborn.
verses.text: O Yahuah, have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Yashar'el, whom you have named your firstborn.

verses.raw: O be merciful to Jerusalem, your holy city, the place of your rest.
verses.text: O be merciful to Jerusalem, your holy city, the place of your rest.

verses.raw: Fill Sion with your unspeakable oracles, and your people with your glory:
verses.text: Fill Sion with your unspeakable oracles, and your people with your glory:

verses.raw: Give testimony to those that you have possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in your name.
verses.text: Give testimony to those that you have possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in your name.

verses.raw: Reward them that wait for you, and let your prophets be found faithful.
verses.text: Reward them that wait for you, and let your prophets be found faithful.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), hear the prayer of your servants, according to the blessing of Aaron over your people, that all they which dwell upon the earth may know that you are Yahuah (God), the eternal Yahuah (God).
verses.text: O Yahuah, hear the prayer of your servants, according to the blessing of Aaron over your people, that all they which dwell upon the earth may know that you are Yahuah, the eternal Yahuah.

verses.raw: The belly devoureth all meats, yet is one meat better than another.
verses.text: The belly devoureth all meats, yet is one meat better than another.

verses.raw: As the palate tasteth divers kinds of venison: so does an heart of understanding false speeches.
verses.text: As the palate tasteth divers kinds of venison: so does an heart of understanding false speeches.

verses.raw: A froward heart causeth heaviness: but a man of experience will recompense him.
verses.text: A froward heart causeth heaviness: but a man of experience will recompense him.

verses.raw: A woman will receive every man, yet is one daughter better than another.
verses.text: A woman will receive every man, yet is one daughter better than another.

verses.raw: The beauty of a woman cheereth the countenance, and a man loves nothing better.
verses.text: The beauty of a woman cheereth the countenance, and a man loves nothing better.

verses.raw: If there be kindness, meekness, and comfort, in her tongue, then is not her husband like other men.
verses.text: If there be kindness, meekness, and comfort, in her tongue, then is not her husband like other men.

verses.raw: He that getteth a wife begins a possession, a help like to himself, and a pillar of rest.
verses.text: He that getteth a wife begins a possession, a help like to himself, and a pillar of rest.

verses.raw: Where no hedge is, there the possession is spoiled: and he that has no wife will wander up and down mourning.
verses.text: Where no hedge is, there the possession is spoiled: and he that has no wife will wander up and down mourning.

verses.raw: Who will trust a thief well appointed, that skippeth from city to city? so who will believe a man that has no house, and lodgeth wherever the night takes him? ⸻
verses.text: Who will trust a thief well appointed, that skippeth from city to city? so who will believe a man that has no house, and lodgeth wherever the night takes him? ⸻

verses.raw: Every friend says, I am his friend also: but there is a friend, which is only a friend in name.
verses.text: Every friend says, I am his friend also: but there is a friend, which is only a friend in name.

verses.raw: Is it not a grief to death, when a companion and friend is turned to an enemy?
verses.text: Is it not a grief to death, when a companion and friend is turned to an enemy?

verses.raw: O wicked imagination, whence camest you in to cover the earth with deceit?
verses.text: O wicked imagination, whence camest you in to cover the earth with deceit?

verses.raw: There is a companion, which rejoices in the prosperity of a friend, but in the time of trouble will be against him.
verses.text: There is a companion, which rejoices in the prosperity of a friend, but in the time of trouble will be against him.

verses.raw: There is a companion, which helps his friend for the belly, and takes up the buckler against the enemy.
verses.text: There is a companion, which helps his friend for the belly, and takes up the buckler against the enemy.

verses.raw: Forget not your friend in your mind, and be not unmindful of him in your riches.
verses.text: Forget not your friend in your mind, and be not unmindful of him in your riches.

verses.raw: Every counsellor extolleth counsel; but there is some that counselleth for himself.
verses.text: Every counsellor extolleth counsel; but there is some that counselleth for himself.

verses.raw: Beware of a counsellor, and know before what need he has; for he will counsel for himself; lest he cast the lot upon you,
verses.text: Beware of a counsellor, and know before what need he has; for he will counsel for himself; lest he cast the lot upon you,

verses.raw: And say to you, Your way is good: and afterward he stand on the other side, to see what shall befall you.
verses.text: And say to you, Your way is good: and afterward he stand on the other side, to see what shall befall you.

verses.raw: Consult not with one that suspecteth you: and hide your counsel from such as envy you.
verses.text: Consult not with one that suspecteth you: and hide your counsel from such as envy you.

verses.raw: Neither consult with a woman touching her of whom she is jealous; neither with a coward in matters of war; nor with a merchant concerning exchange; nor with a buyer of selling; nor with an envious man of thankfulness; nor with an unmerciful man touching kindness; nor with the slothful for any work; nor with an hireling for a year of finishing work; nor with an idle servant of much business: hearken not to these in any matter of counsel.
verses.text: Neither consult with a woman touching her of whom she is jealous; neither with a coward in matters of war; nor with a merchant concerning exchange; nor with a buyer of selling; nor with an envious man of thankfulness; nor with an unmerciful man touching kindness; nor with the slothful for any work; nor with an hireling for a year of finishing work; nor with an idle servant of much business: hearken not to these in any matter of counsel.

verses.raw: But be continually with a godly man, whom you know to keep the commandments of Yahuah (God), whose, mind is according to your mind, and will sorrow with you, if you shall miscarry.
verses.text: But be continually with a godly man, whom you know to keep the commandments of Yahuah, whose, mind is according to your mind, and will sorrow with you, if you shall miscarry.

verses.raw: And let the counsel of your own heart stand: for there is no man more faithful to you than it.
verses.text: And let the counsel of your own heart stand: for there is no man more faithful to you than it.

verses.raw: For a man’s mind is sometime wont to tell him more than seven watchmen, that sit above in an high tower.
verses.text: For a man’s mind is sometime wont to tell him more than seven watchmen, that sit above in an high tower.

verses.raw: And above all this pray to the Most High, that he will direct your way in truth.
verses.text: And above all this pray to the Most High, that he will direct your way in truth.

verses.raw: Let reason go before every enterprize, and counsel before every action.
verses.text: Let reason go before every enterprize, and counsel before every action.

verses.raw: The countenance is a sign of changing of the heart.
verses.text: The countenance is a sign of changing of the heart.

verses.raw: Four manner of things appear: good and evil, life and death: but the tongue ruleth over them continually.
verses.text: Four manner of things appear: good and evil, life and death: but the tongue ruleth over them continually.

verses.raw: There is one that is wise and teaches many, and yet is unprofitable to himself.
verses.text: There is one that is wise and teaches many, and yet is unprofitable to himself.

verses.raw: There is one that sheweth wisdom in words, and is hated: he shall be destitute of all food.
verses.text: There is one that sheweth wisdom in words, and is hated: he shall be destitute of all food.

verses.raw: For grace is not given, him from Yahuah (God), because he is deprived of all wisdom.
verses.text: For grace is not given, him from Yahuah, because he is deprived of all wisdom.

verses.raw: Another is wise to himself; and the fruits of understanding are commendable in his mouth.
verses.text: Another is wise to himself; and the fruits of understanding are commendable in his mouth.

verses.raw: A wise man instructs his people; and the fruits of his understanding fail not.
verses.text: A wise man instructs his people; and the fruits of his understanding fail not.

verses.raw: A wise man shall be filled with blessing; and all they that see him shall count him happy.
verses.text: A wise man shall be filled with blessing; and all they that see him shall count him happy.

verses.raw: The days of the life of man may be numbered: but the days of Yashar'el (Israel) are innumerable.
verses.text: The days of the life of man may be numbered: but the days of Yashar'el are innumerable.

verses.raw: A wise man shall inherit glory among his people, and his name shall be perpetual.
verses.text: A wise man shall inherit glory among his people, and his name shall be perpetual.

verses.raw: My son, prove your soul in your life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that to it.
verses.text: My son, prove your soul in your life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that to it.

verses.raw: For all things are not profitable for all men, neither has every soul pleasure in every thing.
verses.text: For all things are not profitable for all men, neither has every soul pleasure in every thing.

verses.raw: Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing, nor too greedy upon meats:
verses.text: Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing, nor too greedy upon meats:

verses.raw: For excess of meats brings sickness, and surfeiting will turn into choler.
verses.text: For excess of meats brings sickness, and surfeiting will turn into choler.

verses.raw: By surfeiting have many perished; but he that takes heed prolongeth his life. ⸻
verses.text: By surfeiting have many perished; but he that takes heed prolongeth his life. ⸻

verses.raw: Honour a physician with the honour due to him for the uses which you may have of him: for Yahuah (God) has created him.
verses.text: Honour a physician with the honour due to him for the uses which you may have of him: for Yahuah has created him.

verses.raw: For of the Most High comes healing, and he shall receive honour of the king.
verses.text: For of the Most High comes healing, and he shall receive honour of the king.

verses.raw: The skill of the physician shall lift up his head: and in the sight of great men he shall be in admiration.
verses.text: The skill of the physician shall lift up his head: and in the sight of great men he shall be in admiration.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) has created medicines out of the earth; and he that is wise will not abhor them.
verses.text: Yahuah has created medicines out of the earth; and he that is wise will not abhor them.

verses.raw: Was not the water made sweet with wood, that the virtue thereof might be known?
verses.text: Was not the water made sweet with wood, that the virtue thereof might be known?

verses.raw: And he has given men skill, that he might be honoured in his marvellous works.
verses.text: And he has given men skill, that he might be honoured in his marvellous works.

verses.raw: With such does he heal men, and takes away their pains.
verses.text: With such does he heal men, and takes away their pains.

verses.raw: Of such does the apothecary make a confection; and of his works there is no end; and from him is peace over all the earth,
verses.text: Of such does the apothecary make a confection; and of his works there is no end; and from him is peace over all the earth,

verses.raw: My son, in your sickness be not negligent: but pray to Yahuah (God), and he will make you whole.
verses.text: My son, in your sickness be not negligent: but pray to Yahuah, and he will make you whole.

verses.raw: Leave off from sin, and order yours hands aright, and cleanse your heart from all wickedness.
verses.text: Leave off from sin, and order yours hands aright, and cleanse your heart from all wickedness.

verses.raw: Give a sweet savour, and a memorial of fine flour; and make a fat offering, as not being.
verses.text: Give a sweet savour, and a memorial of fine flour; and make a fat offering, as not being.

verses.raw: Then give place to the physician, for Yahuah (God) has created him: let him not go from you, for you have need of him.
verses.text: Then give place to the physician, for Yahuah has created him: let him not go from you, for you have need of him.

verses.raw: There is a time when in their hands there is good success.
verses.text: There is a time when in their hands there is good success.

verses.raw: For they shall also pray to Yahuah (God), that he would prosper that, which they give for ease and remedy to prolong life.
verses.text: For they shall also pray to Yahuah, that he would prosper that, which they give for ease and remedy to prolong life.

verses.raw: He that sinneth before his Maker, let him fall into the hand of the physician.
verses.text: He that sinneth before his Maker, let him fall into the hand of the physician.

verses.raw: My son, let tears fall down over the dead, and begin to lament, as if you had suffered great harm thyself; and then cover his body according to the custom, and neglect not his burial.
verses.text: My son, let tears fall down over the dead, and begin to lament, as if you had suffered great harm thyself; and then cover his body according to the custom, and neglect not his burial.

verses.raw: Weep bitterly, and make great moan, and use lamentation, as he is worthy, and that a day or two, lest you be evil spoken of: and then comfort thyself for your heaviness.
verses.text: Weep bitterly, and make great moan, and use lamentation, as he is worthy, and that a day or two, lest you be evil spoken of: and then comfort thyself for your heaviness.

verses.raw: For of heaviness comes death, and the heaviness of the heart breaks strength.
verses.text: For of heaviness comes death, and the heaviness of the heart breaks strength.

verses.raw: In affliction also sorrow remains: and the life of the poor is the curse of the heart.
verses.text: In affliction also sorrow remains: and the life of the poor is the curse of the heart.

verses.raw: Take no heaviness to heart: drive it away, and remember the last end.
verses.text: Take no heaviness to heart: drive it away, and remember the last end.

verses.raw: Forget it not, for there is no turning again: you shall not do him good, but hurt thyself.
verses.text: Forget it not, for there is no turning again: you shall not do him good, but hurt thyself.

verses.raw: Remember my judgment: for your also shall be so; yesterday for me, and to day for you.
verses.text: Remember my judgment: for your also shall be so; yesterday for me, and to day for you.

verses.raw: When the dead is at rest, let his remembrance rest; and be comforted for him, when his Spirit is departed from him.
verses.text: When the dead is at rest, let his remembrance rest; and be comforted for him, when his Spirit is departed from him.

verses.raw: The wisdom of a learned man comes by opportunity of leisure: and he that has little business shall become wise.
verses.text: The wisdom of a learned man comes by opportunity of leisure: and he that has little business shall become wise.

verses.raw: How can he get wisdom that holdeth the plough, and that glorieth in the goad, that drives oxen, and is occupied in their labours, and whose talk is of bullocks?
verses.text: How can he get wisdom that holdeth the plough, and that glorieth in the goad, that drives oxen, and is occupied in their labours, and whose talk is of bullocks?

verses.raw: He gives his mind to make furrows; and is diligent to give the kine fodder.
verses.text: He gives his mind to make furrows; and is diligent to give the kine fodder.

verses.raw: So every carpenter and workmaster, that laboureth night and day: and they that cut and grave seals, and are diligent to make great variety, and give themselves to counterfeit imagery, and watch to finish a work:
verses.text: So every carpenter and workmaster, that laboureth night and day: and they that cut and grave seals, and are diligent to make great variety, and give themselves to counterfeit imagery, and watch to finish a work:

verses.raw: The smith also sitting by the anvil, and considering the iron work, the vapour of the fire wasteth his flesh, and he fighteth with the heat of the furnace: the noise of the hammer and the anvil is ever in his ears, and his eyes look still upon the pattern of the thing that he makes; he sets his mind to finish his work, and watcheth to polish it perfectly:
verses.text: The smith also sitting by the anvil, and considering the iron work, the vapour of the fire wasteth his flesh, and he fighteth with the heat of the furnace: the noise of the hammer and the anvil is ever in his ears, and his eyes look still upon the pattern of the thing that he makes; he sets his mind to finish his work, and watcheth to polish it perfectly:

verses.raw: So does the potter sitting at his work, and turning the wheel about with his feet, who is alway carefully set at his work, and makes all his work by number;
verses.text: So does the potter sitting at his work, and turning the wheel about with his feet, who is alway carefully set at his work, and makes all his work by number;

verses.raw: He fashioneth the clay with his arm, and boweth down his strength before his feet; he applieth himself to lead it over; and he is diligent to make clean the furnace:
verses.text: He fashioneth the clay with his arm, and boweth down his strength before his feet; he applieth himself to lead it over; and he is diligent to make clean the furnace:

verses.raw: All these trust to their hands: and every one is wise in his work.
verses.text: All these trust to their hands: and every one is wise in his work.

verses.raw: Without these cannot a city be inhabited: and they shall not dwell where they will, nor go up and down:
verses.text: Without these cannot a city be inhabited: and they shall not dwell where they will, nor go up and down:

verses.raw: They shall not be sought for in publick counsel, nor sit high in the congregation: they shall not sit on the judges’ seat, nor understand the sentence of judgment: they cannot declare justice and judgment; and they shall not be found where parables are spoken.
verses.text: They shall not be sought for in publick counsel, nor sit high in the congregation: they shall not sit on the judges’ seat, nor understand the sentence of judgment: they cannot declare justice and judgment; and they shall not be found where parables are spoken.

verses.raw: But they will maintain the state of the world, and all their desire is in the work of their craft. ⸻
verses.text: But they will maintain the state of the world, and all their desire is in the work of their craft. ⸻

verses.raw: But he that gives his mind to the law of the Most High, and is occupied in the meditation thereof, will seek out the wisdom of all the ancient, and be occupied in prophecies.
verses.text: But he that gives his mind to the law of the Most High, and is occupied in the meditation thereof, will seek out the wisdom of all the ancient, and be occupied in prophecies.

verses.raw: He will keep the sayings of the renowned men: and where subtil parables are, he will be there also.
verses.text: He will keep the sayings of the renowned men: and where subtil parables are, he will be there also.

verses.raw: He will seek out the secrets of grave sentences, and be conversant in dark parables.
verses.text: He will seek out the secrets of grave sentences, and be conversant in dark parables.

verses.raw: He shall serve among great men, and appear before princes: he will travel through strange countries; for he has tried the good and the evil among men.
verses.text: He shall serve among great men, and appear before princes: he will travel through strange countries; for he has tried the good and the evil among men.

verses.raw: He will give his heart to resort early to Yahuah (God) that made him, and will pray before the Most High, and will open his mouth in prayer, and make supplication for his sins.
verses.text: He will give his heart to resort early to Yahuah that made him, and will pray before the Most High, and will open his mouth in prayer, and make supplication for his sins.

verses.raw: When the great Yahuah (God) will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: he shall pour out wise sentences, and give thanks to Yahuah (God) in his prayer.
verses.text: When the great Yahuah will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: he shall pour out wise sentences, and give thanks to Yahuah in his prayer.

verses.raw: He shall direct his counsel and knowledge, and in his secrets shall he meditate.
verses.text: He shall direct his counsel and knowledge, and in his secrets shall he meditate.

verses.raw: He shall shew forth that which he has learned, and shall glory in the law of the covenant of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: He shall shew forth that which he has learned, and shall glory in the law of the covenant of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Many shall commend his understanding; and so long as the world endureth, it shall not be blotted out; his memorial shall not depart away, and his name shall live from generation to generation.
verses.text: Many shall commend his understanding; and so long as the world endureth, it shall not be blotted out; his memorial shall not depart away, and his name shall live from generation to generation.

verses.raw: Nations shall shew forth his wisdom, and the congregation shall declare his praise.
verses.text: Nations shall shew forth his wisdom, and the congregation shall declare his praise.

verses.raw: If he die, he shall leave a greater name than a thousand: and if he live, he shall increase it.
verses.text: If he die, he shall leave a greater name than a thousand: and if he live, he shall increase it.

verses.raw: Yet have I more to say, which I have thought upon; for I am filled as the moon at the full.
verses.text: Yet have I more to say, which I have thought upon; for I am filled as the moon at the full.

verses.raw: Hearken to me, you holy children, and bud forth as a rose growing by the brook of the field:
verses.text: Hearken to me, you holy children, and bud forth as a rose growing by the brook of the field:

verses.raw: And give you a sweet savour as frankincense, and flourish as a lily, send forth a smell, and sing a song of praise, bless Yahuah (God) in all his works.
verses.text: And give you a sweet savour as frankincense, and flourish as a lily, send forth a smell, and sing a song of praise, bless Yahuah in all his works.

verses.raw: Magnify his name, and shew forth his praise with the songs of your lips, and with harps, and in praising him you shall say after this manner:
verses.text: Magnify his name, and shew forth his praise with the songs of your lips, and with harps, and in praising him you shall say after this manner:

verses.raw: All the works of Yahuah (God) are exceeding good, and whatsoever he commands shall be accomplished in due season.
verses.text: All the works of Yahuah are exceeding good, and whatsoever he commands shall be accomplished in due season.

verses.raw: And none may say, What is this? wherefore is that? for at time convenient they shall all be sought out: at his commandment the waters stood as an heap, and at the words of his mouth the receptacles of waters.
verses.text: And none may say, What is this? wherefore is that? for at time convenient they shall all be sought out: at his commandment the waters stood as an heap, and at the words of his mouth the receptacles of waters.

verses.raw: At his commandment is done whatsoever pleaseth him; and none can hinder, when he will save.
verses.text: At his commandment is done whatsoever pleaseth him; and none can hinder, when he will save.

verses.raw: The works of all flesh are before him, and nothing can be hid from his eyes.
verses.text: The works of all flesh are before him, and nothing can be hid from his eyes.

verses.raw: He seeth from everlasting to everlasting; and there is nothing wonderful before him.
verses.text: He seeth from everlasting to everlasting; and there is nothing wonderful before him.

verses.raw: A man need not to say, What is this? wherefore is that? for he has made all things for their uses.
verses.text: A man need not to say, What is this? wherefore is that? for he has made all things for their uses.

verses.raw: His blessing covered the dry land as a river, and watered it as a flood.
verses.text: His blessing covered the dry land as a river, and watered it as a flood.

verses.raw: As he has turned the waters into saltness: so shall the heathen inherit his wrath.
verses.text: As he has turned the waters into saltness: so shall the heathen inherit his wrath.

verses.raw: As his ways are plain to the holy; so are they stumblingblocks to the wicked.
verses.text: As his ways are plain to the holy; so are they stumblingblocks to the wicked.

verses.raw: For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners.
verses.text: For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners.

verses.raw: The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.
verses.text: The principal things for the whole use of man’s life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing.

verses.raw: All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.
verses.text: All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.

verses.raw: There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.
verses.text: There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.

verses.raw: Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance;
verses.text: Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance;

verses.raw: Teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword punishing the wicked to destruction.
verses.text: Teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword punishing the wicked to destruction.

verses.raw: They shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word.
verses.text: They shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word.

verses.raw: Therefore from the beginning I was resolved, and thought upon these things, and have left them in writing.
verses.text: Therefore from the beginning I was resolved, and thought upon these things, and have left them in writing.

verses.raw: All the works of Yahuah (God) are good: and he will give every needful thing in due season.
verses.text: All the works of Yahuah are good: and he will give every needful thing in due season.

verses.raw: So that a man cannot say, This is worse than that: for in time they shall all be well approved.
verses.text: So that a man cannot say, This is worse than that: for in time they shall all be well approved.

verses.raw: And therefore praise you Yahuah (God) with the whole heart and mouth, and bless the name of Yahuah (God). ⸻
verses.text: And therefore praise you Yahuah with the whole heart and mouth, and bless the name of Yahuah. ⸻

verses.raw: Great travail is created for every man, and an heavy yoke is upon the sons of Adam, from the day that they go out of their mother’s womb, till the day that they return to the mother of all things.
verses.text: Great travail is created for every man, and an heavy yoke is upon the sons of Adam, from the day that they go out of their mother’s womb, till the day that they return to the mother of all things.

verses.raw: Their imagination of things to come, and the day of death, trouble their thoughts, and cause fear of heart;
verses.text: Their imagination of things to come, and the day of death, trouble their thoughts, and cause fear of heart;

verses.raw: From him that sits on a throne of glory, to him that is humbled in earth and ashes;
verses.text: From him that sits on a throne of glory, to him that is humbled in earth and ashes;

verses.raw: From him that wears purple and a crown, to him that is clothed with a linen frock.
verses.text: From him that wears purple and a crown, to him that is clothed with a linen frock.

verses.raw: Wrath, and envy, trouble, and unquietness, fear of death, and anger, and strife, and in the time of rest upon his bed his night sleep, do change his knowledge.
verses.text: Wrath, and envy, trouble, and unquietness, fear of death, and anger, and strife, and in the time of rest upon his bed his night sleep, do change his knowledge.

verses.raw: A little or nothing is his rest, and afterward he is in his sleep, as in a day of keeping watch, troubled in the vision of his heart, as if he were escaped out of a battle.
verses.text: A little or nothing is his rest, and afterward he is in his sleep, as in a day of keeping watch, troubled in the vision of his heart, as if he were escaped out of a battle.

verses.raw: When all is safe, he awakes, and marvelleth that the fear was nothing.
verses.text: When all is safe, he awakes, and marvelleth that the fear was nothing.

verses.raw: Such things happen to all flesh, both man and beast, and that is sevenfold more upon sinners.
verses.text: Such things happen to all flesh, both man and beast, and that is sevenfold more upon sinners.

verses.raw: Death, and bloodshed, strife, and sword, calamities, famine, tribulation, and the scourge;
verses.text: Death, and bloodshed, strife, and sword, calamities, famine, tribulation, and the scourge;

verses.raw: These things are created for the wicked, and for their sakes came the flood.
verses.text: These things are created for the wicked, and for their sakes came the flood.

verses.raw: All things that are of the earth shall turn to the earth again: and that which is of the waters does return into the sea.
verses.text: All things that are of the earth shall turn to the earth again: and that which is of the waters does return into the sea.

verses.raw: All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out: but true dealing shall endure for ever.
verses.text: All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out: but true dealing shall endure for ever.

verses.raw: The goods of the unjust shall be dried up like a river, and shall vanish with noise, like a great thunder in rain.
verses.text: The goods of the unjust shall be dried up like a river, and shall vanish with noise, like a great thunder in rain.

verses.raw: While he opens his hand he shall rejoice: so shall transgressors come to nought.
verses.text: While he opens his hand he shall rejoice: so shall transgressors come to nought.

verses.raw: The children of the ungodly shall not bring forth many branches: but are as unclean roots upon a hard rock.
verses.text: The children of the ungodly shall not bring forth many branches: but are as unclean roots upon a hard rock.

verses.raw: The weed growing upon every water and bank of a river shall be pulled up before all grass.
verses.text: The weed growing upon every water and bank of a river shall be pulled up before all grass.

verses.raw: Bountifulness is as a most fruitful garden, and mercifulness endureth for ever.
verses.text: Bountifulness is as a most fruitful garden, and mercifulness endureth for ever.

verses.raw: To labour, and to be content with that a man has, is a sweet life: but he that finds a treasure is above them both.
verses.text: To labour, and to be content with that a man has, is a sweet life: but he that finds a treasure is above them both.

verses.raw: Children and the building of a city continue a man’s name: but a blameless wife is counted above them both.
verses.text: Children and the building of a city continue a man’s name: but a blameless wife is counted above them both.

verses.raw: Wine and musick rejoice the heart: but the love of wisdom is above them both.
verses.text: Wine and musick rejoice the heart: but the love of wisdom is above them both.

verses.raw: The pipe and the psaltery make sweet melody: but a pleasant tongue is above them both.
verses.text: The pipe and the psaltery make sweet melody: but a pleasant tongue is above them both.

verses.raw: Your eye desires favour and beauty: but more than both corn while it is green.
verses.text: Your eye desires favour and beauty: but more than both corn while it is green.

verses.raw: A friend and companion never meet amiss: but above both is a wife with her husband.
verses.text: A friend and companion never meet amiss: but above both is a wife with her husband.

verses.raw: Brothers and help are against time of trouble: but alms shall deliver more than them both.
verses.text: Brothers and help are against time of trouble: but alms shall deliver more than them both.

verses.raw: Gold and silver make the foot stand sure: but counsel is esteemed above them both.
verses.text: Gold and silver make the foot stand sure: but counsel is esteemed above them both.

verses.raw: Riches and strength lift up the heart: but the fear of Yahuah (God) is above them both: there is no want in the fear of Yahuah (God), and it needeth not to seek help.
verses.text: Riches and strength lift up the heart: but the fear of Yahuah is above them both: there is no want in the fear of Yahuah, and it needeth not to seek help.

verses.raw: The fear of Yahuah (God) is a fruitful garden, and covereth him above all glory.
verses.text: The fear of Yahuah is a fruitful garden, and covereth him above all glory.

verses.raw: My son, lead not a beggar’s life; for better it is to die than to beg.
verses.text: My son, lead not a beggar’s life; for better it is to die than to beg.

verses.raw: The life of him that dependeth on another man’s table is not to be counted for a life; for he polluteth himself with other men’s meat: but a wise man well nurtured will beware thereof.
verses.text: The life of him that dependeth on another man’s table is not to be counted for a life; for he polluteth himself with other men’s meat: but a wise man well nurtured will beware thereof.

verses.raw: Begging is sweet in the mouth of the shameless: but in his belly there shall burn a fire. ⸻
verses.text: Begging is sweet in the mouth of the shameless: but in his belly there shall burn a fire. ⸻

verses.raw: O death, how bitter is the remembrance of you to a man that lives at rest in his possessions, to the man that has nothing to vex him, and that has prosperity in all things: yes, to him that is yet able to receive meat!
verses.text: O death, how bitter is the remembrance of you to a man that lives at rest in his possessions, to the man that has nothing to vex him, and that has prosperity in all things: yes, to him that is yet able to receive meat!

verses.raw: O death, acceptable is your sentence to the needy, and to him whose strength fails, that is now in the last age, and is vexed with all things, and to him that despaireth, and has lost patience!
verses.text: O death, acceptable is your sentence to the needy, and to him whose strength fails, that is now in the last age, and is vexed with all things, and to him that despaireth, and has lost patience!

verses.raw: Fear not the sentence of death, remember them that have been before you, and that come after; for this is the sentence of Yahuah (God) over all flesh.
verses.text: Fear not the sentence of death, remember them that have been before you, and that come after; for this is the sentence of Yahuah over all flesh.

verses.raw: And why art you against the pleasure of the Most High? there is no inquisition in the grave, whether you have lived ten, or an hundred, or a thousand years.
verses.text: And why art you against the pleasure of the Most High? there is no inquisition in the grave, whether you have lived ten, or an hundred, or a thousand years.

verses.raw: The children of sinners are abominable children, and they that are conversant in the dwelling of the ungodly.
