verses.text: The children of sinners are abominable children, and they that are conversant in the dwelling of the ungodly.

verses.raw: The inheritance of sinners’ children shall perish, and their posterity shall have a perpetual reproach.
verses.text: The inheritance of sinners’ children shall perish, and their posterity shall have a perpetual reproach.

verses.raw: The children will complain of an ungodly father, because they shall be reproached for his sake.
verses.text: The children will complain of an ungodly father, because they shall be reproached for his sake.

verses.raw: Woe be to you, ungodly men, which have forsaken the law of the most high Yahuah (God)! for if you increase, it shall be to your destruction:
verses.text: Woe be to you, ungodly men, which have forsaken the law of the most high Yahuah! for if you increase, it shall be to your destruction:

verses.raw: And if you be born, you shall be born to a curse: and if you die, a curse shall be your portion.
verses.text: And if you be born, you shall be born to a curse: and if you die, a curse shall be your portion.

verses.raw: All that are of the earth shall turn to earth again: so the ungodly shall go from a curse to destruction.
verses.text: All that are of the earth shall turn to earth again: so the ungodly shall go from a curse to destruction.

verses.raw: The mourning of men is about their bodies: but an ill name of sinners shall be blotted out.
verses.text: The mourning of men is about their bodies: but an ill name of sinners shall be blotted out.

verses.raw: Have regard to your name; for that shall continue with you above a thousand great treasures of gold.
verses.text: Have regard to your name; for that shall continue with you above a thousand great treasures of gold.

verses.raw: A good life has but few days: but a good name endureth for ever.
verses.text: A good life has but few days: but a good name endureth for ever.

verses.raw: My children, keep discipline in peace: for wisdom that is hid, and a treasure that is not seen, what profit is in them both?
verses.text: My children, keep discipline in peace: for wisdom that is hid, and a treasure that is not seen, what profit is in them both?

verses.raw: A man that hideth his foolishness is better than a man that hideth his wisdom.
verses.text: A man that hideth his foolishness is better than a man that hideth his wisdom.

verses.raw: Therefore be shamefaced according to my word: for it is not good to retain all shamefacedness; neither is it altogether approved in every thing.
verses.text: Therefore be shamefaced according to my word: for it is not good to retain all shamefacedness; neither is it altogether approved in every thing.

verses.raw: Be ashamed of whoredom before father and mother: and of a lie before a prince and a mighty man;
verses.text: Be ashamed of whoredom before father and mother: and of a lie before a prince and a mighty man;

verses.raw: Of an offence before a judge and ruler; of iniquity before a congregation and people; of unjust dealing before your partner and friend;
verses.text: Of an offence before a judge and ruler; of iniquity before a congregation and people; of unjust dealing before your partner and friend;

verses.raw: And of theft in regard of the place where you sojournest, and in regard of the truth of Yahuah (God) and his covenant; and to lean with your elbow upon the meat; and of scorning to give and take;
verses.text: And of theft in regard of the place where you sojournest, and in regard of the truth of Yahuah and his covenant; and to lean with your elbow upon the meat; and of scorning to give and take;

verses.raw: And of silence before them that salute you; and to look upon an harlot;
verses.text: And of silence before them that salute you; and to look upon an harlot;

verses.raw: And to turn away your face from your kinsman; or to take away a portion or a gift; or to gaze upon another man’s wife.
verses.text: And to turn away your face from your kinsman; or to take away a portion or a gift; or to gaze upon another man’s wife.

verses.raw: Or to be overbusy with his maid, and come not near her bed; or of upbraiding speeches before friends; and after you have given, upbraid not;
verses.text: Or to be overbusy with his maid, and come not near her bed; or of upbraiding speeches before friends; and after you have given, upbraid not;

verses.raw: Or of iterating and speaking again that which you have heard; and of revealing of secrets.
verses.text: Or of iterating and speaking again that which you have heard; and of revealing of secrets.

verses.raw: So shall you be truly shamefaced and find favour before all men. ⸻
verses.text: So shall you be truly shamefaced and find favour before all men. ⸻

verses.raw: Of these things be not you ashamed, and accept no person to sin thereby:
verses.text: Of these things be not you ashamed, and accept no person to sin thereby:

verses.raw: Of the law of the Most High, and his covenant; and of judgment to justify the ungodly;
verses.text: Of the law of the Most High, and his covenant; and of judgment to justify the ungodly;

verses.raw: Of reckoning with your partners and travellers; or of the gift of the heritage of friends;
verses.text: Of reckoning with your partners and travellers; or of the gift of the heritage of friends;

verses.raw: Of exactness of balance and weights; or of getting much or little;
verses.text: Of exactness of balance and weights; or of getting much or little;

verses.raw: And of merchants’ indifferent selling; of much correction of children; and to make the side of an evil servant to bleed.
verses.text: And of merchants’ indifferent selling; of much correction of children; and to make the side of an evil servant to bleed.

verses.raw: Sure keeping is good, where an evil wife is; and shut up, where many hands are.
verses.text: Sure keeping is good, where an evil wife is; and shut up, where many hands are.

verses.raw: Deliver all things in number and weight; and put all in writing that you give out, or receivest in.
verses.text: Deliver all things in number and weight; and put all in writing that you give out, or receivest in.

verses.raw: Be not ashamed to inform the unwise and foolish, and the extreme aged that contendeth with those that are young: thus shall you be truly learned, and approved of all men living.
verses.text: Be not ashamed to inform the unwise and foolish, and the extreme aged that contendeth with those that are young: thus shall you be truly learned, and approved of all men living.

verses.raw: The father waketh for the daughter, when no man knoweth; and the care for her takes away sleep: when she is young, lest she pass away the flower of her age; and being married, lest she should be hated:
verses.text: The father waketh for the daughter, when no man knoweth; and the care for her takes away sleep: when she is young, lest she pass away the flower of her age; and being married, lest she should be hated:

verses.raw: In her virginity, lest she should be defiled and gotten with child in her father’s house; and having an husband, lest she should misbehave herself; and when she is married, lest she should be barren.
verses.text: In her virginity, lest she should be defiled and gotten with child in her father’s house; and having an husband, lest she should misbehave herself; and when she is married, lest she should be barren.

verses.raw: Keep a sure watch over a shameless daughter, lest she make you a laughingstock to your enemies, and a byword in the city, and a reproach among the people, and make you ashamed before the multitude.
verses.text: Keep a sure watch over a shameless daughter, lest she make you a laughingstock to your enemies, and a byword in the city, and a reproach among the people, and make you ashamed before the multitude.

verses.raw: Behold not every body’s beauty, and sit not in the midst of women.
verses.text: Behold not every body’s beauty, and sit not in the midst of women.

verses.raw: For from garments comes a moth, and from women wickedness.
verses.text: For from garments comes a moth, and from women wickedness.

verses.raw: Better is the churlishness of a man than a courteous woman, a woman, I say, which brings shame and reproach.
verses.text: Better is the churlishness of a man than a courteous woman, a woman, I say, which brings shame and reproach.

verses.raw: I will now remember the works of Yahuah (God), and declare the things that I have seen: In the words of Yahuah (God) are his works.
verses.text: I will now remember the works of Yahuah, and declare the things that I have seen: In the words of Yahuah are his works.

verses.raw: The sun that gives light looketh upon all things, and the work thereof is full of the glory of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: The sun that gives light looketh upon all things, and the work thereof is full of the glory of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) has not given power to the saints to declare all his marvellous works, which the Almighty Yahuah (God) firmly settled, that whatsoever is might be established for his glory.
verses.text: Yahuah has not given power to the saints to declare all his marvellous works, which the Almighty Yahuah firmly settled, that whatsoever is might be established for his glory.

verses.raw: He seeks out the deep, and the heart, and considereth their crafty devices: for Yahuah (God) knoweth all that may be known, and he beholds the signs of the world.
verses.text: He seeks out the deep, and the heart, and considereth their crafty devices: for Yahuah knoweth all that may be known, and he beholds the signs of the world.

verses.raw: He declareth the things that are past, and for to come, and revealeth the steps of hidden things.
verses.text: He declareth the things that are past, and for to come, and revealeth the steps of hidden things.

verses.raw: No thought escapeth him, neither any word is hidden from him.
verses.text: No thought escapeth him, neither any word is hidden from him.

verses.raw: He has garnished the excellent works of his wisdom, and he is from everlasting to everlasting: to him may nothing be added, neither can he be diminished, and he has no need of any counsellor.
verses.text: He has garnished the excellent works of his wisdom, and he is from everlasting to everlasting: to him may nothing be added, neither can he be diminished, and he has no need of any counsellor.

verses.raw: Oh how desirable are all his works! and that a man may see even to a spark.
verses.text: Oh how desirable are all his works! and that a man may see even to a spark.

verses.raw: All these things live and remain for ever for all uses, and they are all obedient.
verses.text: All these things live and remain for ever for all uses, and they are all obedient.

verses.raw: All things are double one against another: and he has made nothing imperfect.
verses.text: All things are double one against another: and he has made nothing imperfect.

verses.raw: One thing establishes the good or another: and who shall be filled with beholding his glory? ⸻
verses.text: One thing establishes the good or another: and who shall be filled with beholding his glory? ⸻

verses.raw: The pride of the height, the clear firmament, the beauty of heaven, with his glorious shew;
verses.text: The pride of the height, the clear firmament, the beauty of heaven, with his glorious shew;

verses.raw: The sun when it appears, declaring at his rising a marvellous instrument, the work of the Most High:
verses.text: The sun when it appears, declaring at his rising a marvellous instrument, the work of the Most High:

verses.raw: At noon it parcheth the country, and who can abide the burning heat thereof?
verses.text: At noon it parcheth the country, and who can abide the burning heat thereof?

verses.raw: A man blowing a furnace is in works of heat, but the sun burneth the mountains three times more; breathing out fiery vapours, and sending forth bright beams, it dimmeth the eyes.
verses.text: A man blowing a furnace is in works of heat, but the sun burneth the mountains three times more; breathing out fiery vapours, and sending forth bright beams, it dimmeth the eyes.

verses.raw: Great is Yahuah (God) that made it; and at his commandment runs hastily.
verses.text: Great is Yahuah that made it; and at his commandment runs hastily.

verses.raw: He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.
verses.text: He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.

verses.raw: From the moon is the sign of feasts, a light that decreaseth in her perfection.
verses.text: From the moon is the sign of feasts, a light that decreaseth in her perfection.

verses.raw: The month is called after her name, increasing wonderfully in her changing, being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven;
verses.text: The month is called after her name, increasing wonderfully in her changing, being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven;

verses.raw: The beauty of heaven, the glory of the stars, an ornament giving light in the highest places of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: The beauty of heaven, the glory of the stars, an ornament giving light in the highest places of Yahuah.

verses.raw: At the commandment of the Holy One they will stand in their order, and never faint in their watches.
verses.text: At the commandment of the Holy One they will stand in their order, and never faint in their watches.

verses.raw: Look upon the rainbow, and praise him that made it; very beautiful it is in the brightness thereof.
verses.text: Look upon the rainbow, and praise him that made it; very beautiful it is in the brightness thereof.

verses.raw: It compasseth the heaven about with a glorious circle, and the hands of the Most High have bended it.
verses.text: It compasseth the heaven about with a glorious circle, and the hands of the Most High have bended it.

verses.raw: By his commandment he makes the snow to fall aplace, and sends swiftly the lightnings of his judgment.
verses.text: By his commandment he makes the snow to fall aplace, and sends swiftly the lightnings of his judgment.

verses.raw: Through this the treasures are opened: and clouds fly forth as fowls.
verses.text: Through this the treasures are opened: and clouds fly forth as fowls.

verses.raw: By his great power he makes the clouds firm, and the hailstones are broken small.
verses.text: By his great power he makes the clouds firm, and the hailstones are broken small.

verses.raw: At his sight the mountains are shaken, and at his will the south wind bloweth.
verses.text: At his sight the mountains are shaken, and at his will the south wind bloweth.

verses.raw: The noise of the thunder makes the earth to tremble: so does the northern storm and the whirlwind: as birds flying he scatters the snow, and the falling down thereof is as the lighting of grasshoppers:
verses.text: The noise of the thunder makes the earth to tremble: so does the northern storm and the whirlwind: as birds flying he scatters the snow, and the falling down thereof is as the lighting of grasshoppers:

verses.raw: The eye marvelleth at the beauty of the whiteness thereof, and the heart is astonished at the raining of it.
verses.text: The eye marvelleth at the beauty of the whiteness thereof, and the heart is astonished at the raining of it.

verses.raw: The hoarfrost also as salt he poureth on the earth, and being congealed, it lieth on the top of sharp stakes.
verses.text: The hoarfrost also as salt he poureth on the earth, and being congealed, it lieth on the top of sharp stakes.

verses.raw: When the cold north wind bloweth, and the water is congealed into ice, it abideth upon every gathering together of water, and clothes the water as with a breastplate.
verses.text: When the cold north wind bloweth, and the water is congealed into ice, it abideth upon every gathering together of water, and clothes the water as with a breastplate.

verses.raw: It devoureth the mountains, and burneth the wilderness, and consumeth the grass as fire.
verses.text: It devoureth the mountains, and burneth the wilderness, and consumeth the grass as fire.

verses.raw: A present remedy of all is a mist coming speedily, a dew coming after heat refresheth.
verses.text: A present remedy of all is a mist coming speedily, a dew coming after heat refresheth.

verses.raw: By his counsel he appeaseth the deep, and planteth islands in it.
verses.text: By his counsel he appeaseth the deep, and planteth islands in it.

verses.raw: They that sail on the sea tell of the danger thereof; and when we hear it with our ears, we marvel thereat.
verses.text: They that sail on the sea tell of the danger thereof; and when we hear it with our ears, we marvel thereat.

verses.raw: For in it be strange and wondrous works, variety of all kinds of beasts and whales created.
verses.text: For in it be strange and wondrous works, variety of all kinds of beasts and whales created.

verses.raw: By him the end of them has prosperous success, and by his word all things consist.
verses.text: By him the end of them has prosperous success, and by his word all things consist.

verses.raw: We may speak much, and yet come short: wherefore in sum, he is all.
verses.text: We may speak much, and yet come short: wherefore in sum, he is all.

verses.raw: How shall we be able to magnify him? for he is great above all his works.
verses.text: How shall we be able to magnify him? for he is great above all his works.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) is terrible and very great, and marvellous is his power.
verses.text: Yahuah is terrible and very great, and marvellous is his power.

verses.raw: When you glorify Yahuah (God), exalt him as much as you can; for even yet will he far exceed: and when you exalt him, put forth all your strength, and be not weary; for you can never go far enough.
verses.text: When you glorify Yahuah, exalt him as much as you can; for even yet will he far exceed: and when you exalt him, put forth all your strength, and be not weary; for you can never go far enough.

verses.raw: Who has seen him, that he might tell us? and who can magnify him as he is?
verses.text: Who has seen him, that he might tell us? and who can magnify him as he is?

verses.raw: There are yet hid greater things than these be, for we have seen but a few of his works.
verses.text: There are yet hid greater things than these be, for we have seen but a few of his works.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) has made all things; and to the godly has he given wisdom. ⸻
verses.text: For Yahuah has made all things; and to the godly has he given wisdom. ⸻

verses.raw: Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers that begat us.
verses.text: Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers that begat us.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) has wrought great glory by them through his great power from the beginning.
verses.text: Yahuah has wrought great glory by them through his great power from the beginning.

verses.raw: Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies:
verses.text: Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies:

verses.raw: Leaders of the people by their counsels, and by their knowledge of learning meet for the people, wise and eloquent are their instructions:
verses.text: Leaders of the people by their counsels, and by their knowledge of learning meet for the people, wise and eloquent are their instructions:

verses.raw: Such as found out musical tunes, and recited verses in writing:
verses.text: Such as found out musical tunes, and recited verses in writing:

verses.raw: Rich men furnished with ability, living peaceably in their habitations:
verses.text: Rich men furnished with ability, living peaceably in their habitations:

verses.raw: All these were honoured in their generations, and were the glory of their times.
verses.text: All these were honoured in their generations, and were the glory of their times.

verses.raw: There be of them, that have left a name behind them, that their praises might be reported.
verses.text: There be of them, that have left a name behind them, that their praises might be reported.

verses.raw: And some there be, which have no memorial; who are perished, as though they had never been; and are become as though they had never been born; and their children after them.
verses.text: And some there be, which have no memorial; who are perished, as though they had never been; and are become as though they had never been born; and their children after them.

verses.raw: But these were merciful men, whose righteousness has not been forgotten.
verses.text: But these were merciful men, whose righteousness has not been forgotten.

verses.raw: With their seed shall continually remain a good inheritance, and their children are within the covenant.
verses.text: With their seed shall continually remain a good inheritance, and their children are within the covenant.

verses.raw: Their seed stands fast, and their children for their sakes.
verses.text: Their seed stands fast, and their children for their sakes.

verses.raw: Their seed shall remain for ever, and their glory shall not be blotted out.
verses.text: Their seed shall remain for ever, and their glory shall not be blotted out.

verses.raw: Their bodies are buried in peace; but their name lives for evermore.
verses.text: Their bodies are buried in peace; but their name lives for evermore.

verses.raw: The people will tell of their wisdom, and the congregation will shew forth their praise.
verses.text: The people will tell of their wisdom, and the congregation will shew forth their praise.

verses.raw: Enoch pleased Yahuah (God), and was translated, being an example of repentance to all generations.
verses.text: Enoch pleased Yahuah, and was translated, being an example of repentance to all generations.

verses.raw: Noah was found perfect and righteous; in the time of wrath he was taken in exchange for the world; therefore was he left as a remnant to the earth, when the flood came.
verses.text: Noah was found perfect and righteous; in the time of wrath he was taken in exchange for the world; therefore was he left as a remnant to the earth, when the flood came.

verses.raw: An everlasting covenant was made with him, that all flesh should perish no more by the flood.
verses.text: An everlasting covenant was made with him, that all flesh should perish no more by the flood.

verses.raw: Abraham was a great father of many people: in glory was there none like to him;
verses.text: Abraham was a great father of many people: in glory was there none like to him;

verses.raw: Who kept the law of the Most High, and was in covenant with him: he established the covenant in his flesh; and when he was proved, he was found faithful.
verses.text: Who kept the law of the Most High, and was in covenant with him: he established the covenant in his flesh; and when he was proved, he was found faithful.

verses.raw: Therefore he assured him by an oath, that he would bless the nations in his seed, and that he would multiply him as the dust of the earth, and exalt his seed as the stars, and cause them to inherit from sea to sea, and from the river to the utmost part of the land.
verses.text: Therefore he assured him by an oath, that he would bless the nations in his seed, and that he would multiply him as the dust of the earth, and exalt his seed as the stars, and cause them to inherit from sea to sea, and from the river to the utmost part of the land.

verses.raw: With Isaac did he establish likewise for Abraham his father’s sake the blessing of all men, and the covenant,
verses.text: With Isaac did he establish likewise for Abraham his father’s sake the blessing of all men, and the covenant,

verses.raw: And made it rest upon the head of Jacob. He acknowledged him in his blessing, and gave him an heritage, and divided his portions; among the twelve tribes did he part them. ⸻
verses.text: And made it rest upon the head of Jacob. He acknowledged him in his blessing, and gave him an heritage, and divided his portions; among the twelve tribes did he part them. ⸻

verses.raw: And he brought out of him a merciful man, which found favour in the sight of all flesh, even Moses, beloved of Yahuah (God) and men, whose memorial is blessed.
verses.text: And he brought out of him a merciful man, which found favour in the sight of all flesh, even Moses, beloved of Yahuah and men, whose memorial is blessed.

verses.raw: He made him like to the glorious saints, and magnified him, so that his enemies stood in fear of him.
verses.text: He made him like to the glorious saints, and magnified him, so that his enemies stood in fear of him.

verses.raw: By his words he caused the wonders to cease, and he made him glorious in the sight of kings, and gave him a commandment for his people, and shewed him part of his glory.
verses.text: By his words he caused the wonders to cease, and he made him glorious in the sight of kings, and gave him a commandment for his people, and shewed him part of his glory.

verses.raw: He sanctified him in his faithfuless and meekness, and chose him out of all men.
verses.text: He sanctified him in his faithfuless and meekness, and chose him out of all men.

verses.raw: He made him to hear his voice, and brought him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob his covenants, and Yashar'el (Israel) his judgments.
verses.text: He made him to hear his voice, and brought him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob his covenants, and Yashar'el his judgments.

verses.raw: He exalted Aaron, an holy man like to him, even his brother, of the tribe of Levi.
verses.text: He exalted Aaron, an holy man like to him, even his brother, of the tribe of Levi.

verses.raw: An everlasting covenant he made with him and gave him the priesthood among the people; he beautified him with comely ornaments, and clothed him with a robe of glory.
verses.text: An everlasting covenant he made with him and gave him the priesthood among the people; he beautified him with comely ornaments, and clothed him with a robe of glory.

verses.raw: He put upon him perfect glory; and strengthened him with rich garments, with breeches, with a long robe, and the ephod.
verses.text: He put upon him perfect glory; and strengthened him with rich garments, with breeches, with a long robe, and the ephod.

verses.raw: And he compassed him with pomegranates, and with many golden bells round about, that as he went there might be a sound, and a noise made that might be heard in the temple, for a memorial to the children of his people;
verses.text: And he compassed him with pomegranates, and with many golden bells round about, that as he went there might be a sound, and a noise made that might be heard in the temple, for a memorial to the children of his people;

verses.raw: With an holy garment, with gold, and blue silk, and purple, the work of the embroiderer, with a breastplate of judgment, and with Urim and Thummim;
verses.text: With an holy garment, with gold, and blue silk, and purple, the work of the embroiderer, with a breastplate of judgment, and with Urim and Thummim;

verses.raw: With twisted scarlet, the work of the cunning workman, with precious stones graven like seals, and set in gold, the work of the jeweller, with a writing engraved for a memorial, after the number of the tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: With twisted scarlet, the work of the cunning workman, with precious stones graven like seals, and set in gold, the work of the jeweller, with a writing engraved for a memorial, after the number of the tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: He set a crown of gold upon the mitre, in which was engraved Holiness, an ornament of honour, a costly work, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful.
verses.text: He set a crown of gold upon the mitre, in which was engraved Holiness, an ornament of honour, a costly work, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful.

verses.raw: Before him there were none such, neither did ever any stranger put them on, but only his children and his children’s children perpetually.
verses.text: Before him there were none such, neither did ever any stranger put them on, but only his children and his children’s children perpetually.

verses.raw: Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually.
verses.text: Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually.

verses.raw: Moses consecrated him, and anointed him with holy oil: this was appointed to him by an everlasting covenant, and to his seed, so long as the heavens should remain, that they should minister to him, and execute the office of the priesthood, and bless the people in his name.
verses.text: Moses consecrated him, and anointed him with holy oil: this was appointed to him by an everlasting covenant, and to his seed, so long as the heavens should remain, that they should minister to him, and execute the office of the priesthood, and bless the people in his name.

verses.raw: He chose him out of all men living to offer sacrifices to Yahuah (God), incense, and a sweet savour, for a memorial, to make reconciliation for his people.
verses.text: He chose him out of all men living to offer sacrifices to Yahuah, incense, and a sweet savour, for a memorial, to make reconciliation for his people.

verses.raw: He gave to him his commandments, and authority in the statutes of judgments, that he should teach Jacob the testimonies, and inform Yashar'el (Israel) in his laws.
verses.text: He gave to him his commandments, and authority in the statutes of judgments, that he should teach Jacob the testimonies, and inform Yashar'el in his laws.

verses.raw: Strangers conspired together against him, and maligned him in the wilderness, even the men that were of Dathan’s and Abiron’s side, and the congregation of Core, with fury and wrath.
verses.text: Strangers conspired together against him, and maligned him in the wilderness, even the men that were of Dathan’s and Abiron’s side, and the congregation of Core, with fury and wrath.

verses.raw: This Yahuah (God) saw, and it displeased him, and in his wrathful indignation were they consumed: he did wonders upon them, to consume them with the fiery flame.
verses.text: This Yahuah saw, and it displeased him, and in his wrathful indignation were they consumed: he did wonders upon them, to consume them with the fiery flame.

verses.raw: But he made Aaron more honourable, and gave him an heritage, and divided to him the firstfruits of the increase; especially he prepared bread in abundance:
verses.text: But he made Aaron more honourable, and gave him an heritage, and divided to him the firstfruits of the increase; especially he prepared bread in abundance:

verses.raw: For they eat of the sacrifices of Yahuah (God), which he gave to him and his seed.
verses.text: For they eat of the sacrifices of Yahuah, which he gave to him and his seed.

verses.raw: Howbeit in the land of the people he had no inheritance, neither had he any portion among the people: for Yahuah (God) himself is his portion and inheritance.
verses.text: Howbeit in the land of the people he had no inheritance, neither had he any portion among the people: for Yahuah himself is his portion and inheritance.

verses.raw: The third in glory is Phinees the son of Eleazar, because he had zeal in the fear of Yahuah (God), and stood up with good courage of heart: when the people were turned back, and made reconciliation for Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The third in glory is Phinees the son of Eleazar, because he had zeal in the fear of Yahuah, and stood up with good courage of heart: when the people were turned back, and made reconciliation for Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Therefore was there a covenant of peace made with him, that he should be the chief of the sanctuary and of his people, and that he and his posterity should have the dignity of the priesthood for ever:
verses.text: Therefore was there a covenant of peace made with him, that he should be the chief of the sanctuary and of his people, and that he and his posterity should have the dignity of the priesthood for ever:

verses.raw: According to the covenant made with David son of Jesse, of the tribe of Juda, that the inheritance of the king should be to his posterity alone: so the inheritance of Aaron should also be to his seed.
verses.text: According to the covenant made with David son of Jesse, of the tribe of Juda, that the inheritance of the king should be to his posterity alone: so the inheritance of Aaron should also be to his seed.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) give you wisdom in your heart to judge his people in righteousness, that their good things be not abolished, and that their glory may endure for ever. ⸻
verses.text: Yahuah give you wisdom in your heart to judge his people in righteousness, that their good things be not abolished, and that their glory may endure for ever. ⸻

verses.raw: Jesus the son a Nave was valiant in the wars, and was the successor of Moses in prophecies, who according to his name was made great for the saving of the elect of Yahuah (God), and taking vengeance of the enemies that rose up against them, that he might set Yashar'el (Israel) in their inheritance.
verses.text: Jesus the son a Nave was valiant in the wars, and was the successor of Moses in prophecies, who according to his name was made great for the saving of the elect of Yahuah, and taking vengeance of the enemies that rose up against them, that he might set Yashar'el in their inheritance.

verses.raw: How great glory got he, when he did lift up his hands, and stretched out his sword against the cities!
verses.text: How great glory got he, when he did lift up his hands, and stretched out his sword against the cities!

verses.raw: Who before him so stood to it? for Yahuah (God) himself brought his enemies to him.
verses.text: Who before him so stood to it? for Yahuah himself brought his enemies to him.

verses.raw: Did not the sun go back by his means? and was not one day as long as two?
verses.text: Did not the sun go back by his means? and was not one day as long as two?

verses.raw: He called upon the most high Yahuah (God), when the enemies pressed upon him on every side; and the great Yahuah (God) heard him.
verses.text: He called upon the most high Yahuah, when the enemies pressed upon him on every side; and the great Yahuah heard him.

verses.raw: And with hailstones of mighty power he made the battle to fall violently upon the nations, and in the descent of Beth-horon he destroyed them that resisted, that the nations might know all their strength, because he fought in the sight of Yahuah (God), and he followed the Mighty One.
verses.text: And with hailstones of mighty power he made the battle to fall violently upon the nations, and in the descent of Beth-horon he destroyed them that resisted, that the nations might know all their strength, because he fought in the sight of Yahuah, and he followed the Mighty One.

verses.raw: In the time of Moses also he did a work of mercy, he and Caleb the son of Jephunne, in that they withstood the congregation, and withheld the people from sin, and appeased the wicked murmuring.
verses.text: In the time of Moses also he did a work of mercy, he and Caleb the son of Jephunne, in that they withstood the congregation, and withheld the people from sin, and appeased the wicked murmuring.

verses.raw: And of six hundred thousand people on foot, they two were preserved to bring them in to the heritage, even to the land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.text: And of six hundred thousand people on foot, they two were preserved to bring them in to the heritage, even to the land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) gave strength also to Caleb, which remained with him to his old age: so that he entered upon the high places of the land, and his seed obtained it for an heritage:
verses.text: Yahuah gave strength also to Caleb, which remained with him to his old age: so that he entered upon the high places of the land, and his seed obtained it for an heritage:

verses.raw: That all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) might see that it is good to follow Yahuah (God).
verses.text: That all the children of Yashar'el might see that it is good to follow Yahuah.

verses.raw: And concerning the judges, every one by name, whose heart went not a whoring, nor departed from Yahuah (God), let their memory be blessed.
verses.text: And concerning the judges, every one by name, whose heart went not a whoring, nor departed from Yahuah, let their memory be blessed.

verses.raw: Let their bones flourish out of their place, and let the name of them that were honoured be continued upon their children.
verses.text: Let their bones flourish out of their place, and let the name of them that were honoured be continued upon their children.

verses.raw: Samuel, the prophet of Yahuah (God), beloved of his Elohim (God), established a kingdom, and anointed princes over his people.
verses.text: Samuel, the prophet of Yahuah, beloved of his Elohim, established a kingdom, and anointed princes over his people.

verses.raw: By the law of Yahuah (God) he judged the congregation, and Yahuah (God) had respect to Jacob.
verses.text: By the law of Yahuah he judged the congregation, and Yahuah had respect to Jacob.

verses.raw: By his faithfulness he was found a true prophet, and by his word he was known to be faithful in vision.
verses.text: By his faithfulness he was found a true prophet, and by his word he was known to be faithful in vision.

verses.raw: He called upon the mighty Yahuah (God), when his enemies pressed upon him on every side, when he offered the sucking lamb.
verses.text: He called upon the mighty Yahuah, when his enemies pressed upon him on every side, when he offered the sucking lamb.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) thundered from heaven, and with a great noise made his voice to be heard.
verses.text: And Yahuah thundered from heaven, and with a great noise made his voice to be heard.

verses.raw: And he destroyed the rulers of the Tyrians, and all the princes of the Philistines.
verses.text: And he destroyed the rulers of the Tyrians, and all the princes of the Philistines.

verses.raw: And before his long sleep he made protestations in the sight of Yahuah (God) and his anointed, I have not taken any man’s goods, so much as a shoe: and no man did accuse him.
verses.text: And before his long sleep he made protestations in the sight of Yahuah and his anointed, I have not taken any man’s goods, so much as a shoe: and no man did accuse him.

verses.raw: And after his death he prophesied, and shewed the king his end, and lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the wickedness of the people. ⸻
verses.text: And after his death he prophesied, and shewed the king his end, and lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the wickedness of the people. ⸻

verses.raw: And after him rose up Nathan to prophesy in the time of David.
verses.text: And after him rose up Nathan to prophesy in the time of David.

verses.raw: As is the fat taken away from the peace offering, so was David chosen out of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: As is the fat taken away from the peace offering, so was David chosen out of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: He played with lions as with kids, and with bears as with lambs.
verses.text: He played with lions as with kids, and with bears as with lambs.

verses.raw: Slew he not a giant, when he was yet but young? and did he not take away reproach from the people, when he lifted up his hand with the stone in the sling, and beat down the boasting of Goliath?
verses.text: Slew he not a giant, when he was yet but young? and did he not take away reproach from the people, when he lifted up his hand with the stone in the sling, and beat down the boasting of Goliath?

verses.raw: For he called upon the most high Yahuah (God); and he gave him strength in his right hand to slay that mighty warrior, and set up the horn of his people.
verses.text: For he called upon the most high Yahuah; and he gave him strength in his right hand to slay that mighty warrior, and set up the horn of his people.

verses.raw: So the people honoured him with ten thousands, and praised him in the blessings of Yahuah (God), in that he gave him a crown of glory.
verses.text: So the people honoured him with ten thousands, and praised him in the blessings of Yahuah, in that he gave him a crown of glory.

verses.raw: For he destroyed the enemies on every side, and brought to nought the Philistines his adversaries, and brake their horn in sunder to this day.
verses.text: For he destroyed the enemies on every side, and brought to nought the Philistines his adversaries, and brake their horn in sunder to this day.

verses.raw: In all his works he praised the Holy One most high with words of glory; with his whole heart he sung songs, and loved him that made him.
verses.text: In all his works he praised the Holy One most high with words of glory; with his whole heart he sung songs, and loved him that made him.

verses.raw: He set singers also before the altar, that by their voices they might make sweet melody, and daily sing praises in their songs.
verses.text: He set singers also before the altar, that by their voices they might make sweet melody, and daily sing praises in their songs.

verses.raw: He beautified their feasts, and set in order the solemn times until the end, that they might praise his holy name, and that the temple might sound from morning.
verses.text: He beautified their feasts, and set in order the solemn times until the end, that they might praise his holy name, and that the temple might sound from morning.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) took away his sins, and exalted his horn for ever: he gave him a covenant of kings, and a throne of glory in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Yahuah took away his sins, and exalted his horn for ever: he gave him a covenant of kings, and a throne of glory in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: After him rose up a wise son, and for his sake he dwelt at large.
verses.text: After him rose up a wise son, and for his sake he dwelt at large.

verses.raw: Solomon reigned in a peaceable time, and was honoured; for Yahuah (God) made all quiet round about him, that he might build an house in his name, and prepare his sanctuary for ever.
verses.text: Solomon reigned in a peaceable time, and was honoured; for Yahuah made all quiet round about him, that he might build an house in his name, and prepare his sanctuary for ever.

verses.raw: How wise were you in your youth and, as a flood, filled with understanding!
verses.text: How wise were you in your youth and, as a flood, filled with understanding!

verses.raw: Your soul covered the whole earth, and you filledst it with dark parables.
verses.text: Your soul covered the whole earth, and you filledst it with dark parables.

verses.raw: Your name went far to the islands; and for your peace you were beloved.
verses.text: Your name went far to the islands; and for your peace you were beloved.

verses.raw: The countries marvelled at you for your songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations.
verses.text: The countries marvelled at you for your songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations.

verses.raw: By the name of Yahuah (God), which is called Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), you did gather gold as tin and did multiply silver as lead.
verses.text: By the name of Yahuah, which is called Yahuah of Yashar'el, you did gather gold as tin and did multiply silver as lead.

verses.raw: You did bow your loins to women, and by your body you were brought into subjection.
verses.text: You did bow your loins to women, and by your body you were brought into subjection.

verses.raw: You did stain your honour, and pollute your seed: so that you broughtest wrath upon your children, and were grieved for your folly.
verses.text: You did stain your honour, and pollute your seed: so that you broughtest wrath upon your children, and were grieved for your folly.

verses.raw: So the kingdom was divided, and out of Ephraim ruled a rebellious kingdom.
verses.text: So the kingdom was divided, and out of Ephraim ruled a rebellious kingdom.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (God) will never leave off his mercy, neither shall any of his works perish, neither will he abolish the posterity of his elect, and the seed of him that loves him he will not take away: wherefore he gave a remnant to Jacob, and out of him a root to David.
verses.text: But Yahuah will never leave off his mercy, neither shall any of his works perish, neither will he abolish the posterity of his elect, and the seed of him that loves him he will not take away: wherefore he gave a remnant to Jacob, and out of him a root to David.

verses.raw: Thus rested Solomon with his fathers, and of his seed he left behind him Roboam, even the foolishness of the people, and one that had no understanding, who turned away the people through his counsel. There was also Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who caused Yashar'el (Israel) to sin, and shewed Ephraim the way of sin:
verses.text: Thus rested Solomon with his fathers, and of his seed he left behind him Roboam, even the foolishness of the people, and one that had no understanding, who turned away the people through his counsel. There was also Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who caused Yashar'el to sin, and shewed Ephraim the way of sin:

verses.raw: And their sins were multiplied exceedingly, that they were driven out of the land.
verses.text: And their sins were multiplied exceedingly, that they were driven out of the land.

verses.raw: For they sought out all wickedness, till the vengeance came upon them. ⸻
verses.text: For they sought out all wickedness, till the vengeance came upon them. ⸻

verses.raw: Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.
verses.text: Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp.

verses.raw: He brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number.
verses.text: He brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number.

verses.raw: By the word of Yahuah (God) he shut up the heaven, and also three times brought down fire.
verses.text: By the word of Yahuah he shut up the heaven, and also three times brought down fire.

verses.raw: O Elias, how were you honoured in your wondrous deeds! and who may glory like to you!
verses.text: O Elias, how were you honoured in your wondrous deeds! and who may glory like to you!

verses.raw: Who did raise up a dead man from death, and his soul from the place of the dead, by the word of the Most High:
verses.text: Who did raise up a dead man from death, and his soul from the place of the dead, by the word of the Most High:

verses.raw: Who broughtest kings to destruction, and honorable men from their bed:
verses.text: Who broughtest kings to destruction, and honorable men from their bed:

verses.raw: Who heardest the rebuke of Yahuah (God) in Sinai, and in Horeb the judgment of vengeance:
verses.text: Who heardest the rebuke of Yahuah in Sinai, and in Horeb the judgment of vengeance:

verses.raw: Who annointedst kings to take revenge, and prophets to succeed after him:
verses.text: Who annointedst kings to take revenge, and prophets to succeed after him:

verses.raw: Who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, and in a chariot of fiery horses:
verses.text: Who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, and in a chariot of fiery horses:

verses.raw: Who were ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the judgment of Yahuah (God), before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.
verses.text: Who were ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the judgment of Yahuah, before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob.

verses.raw: Blessed are they that saw you, and slept in love; for we shall surely live.
verses.text: Blessed are they that saw you, and slept in love; for we shall surely live.

verses.raw: Elias it was, who was covered with a whirlwind: and Eliseus was filled with his spirit: while he lived, he was not moved with the presence of any prince, neither could any bring him into subjection.
verses.text: Elias it was, who was covered with a whirlwind: and Eliseus was filled with his spirit: while he lived, he was not moved with the presence of any prince, neither could any bring him into subjection.

verses.raw: No word could overcome him; and after his death his body prophesied.
verses.text: No word could overcome him; and after his death his body prophesied.

verses.raw: He did wonders in his life, and at his death were his works marvellous.
verses.text: He did wonders in his life, and at his death were his works marvellous.

verses.raw: For all this the people repented not, neither departed they from their sins, till they were spoiled and carried out of their land, and were scattered through all the earth: yet there remained a small people, and a ruler in the house of David:
verses.text: For all this the people repented not, neither departed they from their sins, till they were spoiled and carried out of their land, and were scattered through all the earth: yet there remained a small people, and a ruler in the house of David:

verses.raw: Of whom some did that which was pleasing to Yahuah (God), and some multiplied sins.
verses.text: Of whom some did that which was pleasing to Yahuah, and some multiplied sins.

verses.raw: Ezekias fortified his city, and brought in water into the midst thereof: he digged the hard rock with iron, and made wells for waters.
verses.text: Ezekias fortified his city, and brought in water into the midst thereof: he digged the hard rock with iron, and made wells for waters.

verses.raw: In his time Sennacherib came up, and sent Rabsaces, and lifted up his hand against Sion, and boasted proudly.
verses.text: In his time Sennacherib came up, and sent Rabsaces, and lifted up his hand against Sion, and boasted proudly.

verses.raw: Then trembled their hearts and hands, and they were in pain, as women in travail.
verses.text: Then trembled their hearts and hands, and they were in pain, as women in travail.

verses.raw: But they called upon Yahuah (God) which is merciful, and stretched out their hands toward him: and immediately the Holy One heard them out of heaven, and delivered them by the ministry of Esay.
verses.text: But they called upon Yahuah which is merciful, and stretched out their hands toward him: and immediately the Holy One heard them out of heaven, and delivered them by the ministry of Esay.

verses.raw: He struck the host of the Assyrians, and his angel destroyed them.
verses.text: He struck the host of the Assyrians, and his angel destroyed them.

verses.raw: For Ezekias had done the thing that pleased Yahuah (God), and was strong in the ways of David his father, as Esay the prophet, who was great and faithful in his vision, had commanded him.
verses.text: For Ezekias had done the thing that pleased Yahuah, and was strong in the ways of David his father, as Esay the prophet, who was great and faithful in his vision, had commanded him.

verses.raw: In his time the sun went backward, and he lengthened the king’s life.
verses.text: In his time the sun went backward, and he lengthened the king’s life.

verses.raw: He saw by an excellent spirit what should come to pass at the last, and he comforted them that mourned in Sion.
verses.text: He saw by an excellent spirit what should come to pass at the last, and he comforted them that mourned in Sion.

verses.raw: He shewed what should come to pass for ever, and secret things or ever they came. ⸻
verses.text: He shewed what should come to pass for ever, and secret things or ever they came. ⸻

verses.raw: The remembrance of Josias is like the composition of the perfume that is made by the art of the apothecary: it is sweet as honey in all mouths, and as musick at a banquet of wine.
verses.text: The remembrance of Josias is like the composition of the perfume that is made by the art of the apothecary: it is sweet as honey in all mouths, and as musick at a banquet of wine.

verses.raw: He behaved himself uprightly in the conversion of the people, and took away the abominations of iniquity.
verses.text: He behaved himself uprightly in the conversion of the people, and took away the abominations of iniquity.

verses.raw: He directed his heart to Yahuah (God), and in the time of the ungodly he established the worship of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: He directed his heart to Yahuah, and in the time of the ungodly he established the worship of Yahuah.

verses.raw: All, except David and Ezekias and Josias, were defective: for they forsook the law of the Most High, even the kings of Juda failed.
verses.text: All, except David and Ezekias and Josias, were defective: for they forsook the law of the Most High, even the kings of Juda failed.

verses.raw: Therefore he gave their power to others, and their glory to a strange nation.
verses.text: Therefore he gave their power to others, and their glory to a strange nation.

verses.raw: They burnt the chosen city of the sanctuary, and made the streets desolate, according to the prophecy of Jeremias.
verses.text: They burnt the chosen city of the sanctuary, and made the streets desolate, according to the prophecy of Jeremias.

verses.raw: For they entreated him evil, who nevertheless was a prophet, sanctified in his mother’s womb, that he might root out, and afflict, and destroy; and that he might build up also, and plant.
verses.text: For they entreated him evil, who nevertheless was a prophet, sanctified in his mother’s womb, that he might root out, and afflict, and destroy; and that he might build up also, and plant.

verses.raw: It was Ezekiel who saw the glorious vision, which was shewed him upon the chariot of the cherubims.
verses.text: It was Ezekiel who saw the glorious vision, which was shewed him upon the chariot of the cherubims.

verses.raw: For he made mention of the enemies under the figure of the rain, and directed them that went right.
verses.text: For he made mention of the enemies under the figure of the rain, and directed them that went right.

verses.raw: And of the twelve prophets let the memorial be blessed, and let their bones flourish again out of their place: for they comforted Jacob, and delivered them by assured hope.
verses.text: And of the twelve prophets let the memorial be blessed, and let their bones flourish again out of their place: for they comforted Jacob, and delivered them by assured hope.

verses.raw: How shall we magnify Zorobabel? even he was as a signet on the right hand:
verses.text: How shall we magnify Zorobabel? even he was as a signet on the right hand:

verses.raw: So was Jesus the son of Josedec: who in their time builded the house, and set up an holy temple to Yahuah (God), which was prepared for everlasting glory.
verses.text: So was Jesus the son of Josedec: who in their time builded the house, and set up an holy temple to Yahuah, which was prepared for everlasting glory.

verses.raw: And among the elect was Neemias, whose renown is great, who raised up for us the walls that were fallen, and set up the gates and the bars, and raised up our ruins again.
verses.text: And among the elect was Neemias, whose renown is great, who raised up for us the walls that were fallen, and set up the gates and the bars, and raised up our ruins again.

verses.raw: But upon the earth was no man created like Enoch; for he was taken from the earth.
verses.text: But upon the earth was no man created like Enoch; for he was taken from the earth.

verses.raw: Neither was there a young man born like Joseph, a governor of his brothers, a stay of the people, whose bones were regarded of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Neither was there a young man born like Joseph, a governor of his brothers, a stay of the people, whose bones were regarded of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Sem and Seth were in great honour among men, and so was Adam above every living thing in creation. ⸻
verses.text: Sem and Seth were in great honour among men, and so was Adam above every living thing in creation. ⸻

verses.raw: Simon the high priest, the son of Onias, who in his life repaired the house again, and in his days fortified the temple:
verses.text: Simon the high priest, the son of Onias, who in his life repaired the house again, and in his days fortified the temple:

verses.raw: And by him was built from the foundation the double height, the high fortress of the wall about the temple:
verses.text: And by him was built from the foundation the double height, the high fortress of the wall about the temple:

verses.raw: In his days the cistern to receive water, being in compass as the sea, was covered with plates of brass:
verses.text: In his days the cistern to receive water, being in compass as the sea, was covered with plates of brass:

verses.raw: He took care of the temple that it should not fall, and fortified the city against besieging:
verses.text: He took care of the temple that it should not fall, and fortified the city against besieging:

verses.raw: How was he honoured in the midst of the people in his coming out of the sanctuary!
verses.text: How was he honoured in the midst of the people in his coming out of the sanctuary!

verses.raw: He was as the morning star in the midst of a cloud, and as the moon at the full:
verses.text: He was as the morning star in the midst of a cloud, and as the moon at the full:

verses.raw: As the sun shining upon the temple of the Most High, and as the rainbow giving light in the bright clouds:
verses.text: As the sun shining upon the temple of the Most High, and as the rainbow giving light in the bright clouds:

verses.raw: And as the flower of roses in the spring of the year, as lilies by the rivers of waters, and as the branches of the frankincense tree in the time of summer:
verses.text: And as the flower of roses in the spring of the year, as lilies by the rivers of waters, and as the branches of the frankincense tree in the time of summer:

verses.raw: As fire and incense in the censer, and as a vessel of beaten gold set with all manner of precious stones:
verses.text: As fire and incense in the censer, and as a vessel of beaten gold set with all manner of precious stones:

verses.raw: And as a fair olive tree budding forth fruit, and as a cypress tree which grows up to the clouds.
verses.text: And as a fair olive tree budding forth fruit, and as a cypress tree which grows up to the clouds.

verses.raw: When he put on the robe of honour, and was clothed with the perfection of glory, when he went up to the holy altar, he made the garment of holiness honourable.
verses.text: When he put on the robe of honour, and was clothed with the perfection of glory, when he went up to the holy altar, he made the garment of holiness honourable.

verses.raw: When he took the portions out of the priests’ hands, he himself stood by the hearth of the altar, compassed about, as a young cedar in Libanus; and as palm trees compassed they him round about.
verses.text: When he took the portions out of the priests’ hands, he himself stood by the hearth of the altar, compassed about, as a young cedar in Libanus; and as palm trees compassed they him round about.

verses.raw: So were all the sons of Aaron in their glory, and the oblations of Yahuah (God) in their hands, before all the congregation of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So were all the sons of Aaron in their glory, and the oblations of Yahuah in their hands, before all the congregation of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And finishing the service at the altar, that he might adorn the offering of the most high Almighty,
verses.text: And finishing the service at the altar, that he might adorn the offering of the most high Almighty,

verses.raw: He stretched out his hand to the cup, and poured of the blood of the grape, he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweetsmelling savour to the most high King of all.
verses.text: He stretched out his hand to the cup, and poured of the blood of the grape, he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweetsmelling savour to the most high King of all.

verses.raw: Then shouted the sons of Aaron, and sounded the silver trumpets, and made a great noise to be heard, for a remembrance before the Most High.
verses.text: Then shouted the sons of Aaron, and sounded the silver trumpets, and made a great noise to be heard, for a remembrance before the Most High.

verses.raw: Then all the people together hasted, and fell down to the earth upon their faces to worship their Elohim (God) Almighty, the Most High.
verses.text: Then all the people together hasted, and fell down to the earth upon their faces to worship their Elohim Almighty, the Most High.

verses.raw: The singers also sang praises with their voices, with great variety of sounds was there made sweet melody.
verses.text: The singers also sang praises with their voices, with great variety of sounds was there made sweet melody.

verses.raw: And the people besought Yahuah (God), the Most High, by prayer before him that is merciful, till the solemnity of Yahuah (God) was ended, and they had finished his service.
verses.text: And the people besought Yahuah, the Most High, by prayer before him that is merciful, till the solemnity of Yahuah was ended, and they had finished his service.

verses.raw: Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), to give the blessing of Yahuah (God) with his lips, and to rejoice in his name.
verses.text: Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Yashar'el, to give the blessing of Yahuah with his lips, and to rejoice in his name.

verses.raw: And they bowed themselves down to worship the second time, that they might receive a blessing from the Most High.
verses.text: And they bowed themselves down to worship the second time, that they might receive a blessing from the Most High.

verses.raw: Now therefore bless you Yahuah (God) of all, which only doeth wondrous things every where, which exalteth our days from the womb, and dealeth with us according to his mercy.
verses.text: Now therefore bless you Yahuah of all, which only doeth wondrous things every where, which exalteth our days from the womb, and dealeth with us according to his mercy.

verses.raw: He grant us joyfulness of heart, and that peace may be in our days in Yashar'el (Israel) for ever:
verses.text: He grant us joyfulness of heart, and that peace may be in our days in Yashar'el for ever:

verses.raw: That he would confirm his mercy with us, and deliver us at his time!
verses.text: That he would confirm his mercy with us, and deliver us at his time!

verses.raw: There be two manner of nations which my heart abhorreth, and the third is no nation:
verses.text: There be two manner of nations which my heart abhorreth, and the third is no nation:

verses.raw: They that sit upon the mountain of Samaria, and they that dwell among the Philistines, and that foolish people that dwell in Sichem.
verses.text: They that sit upon the mountain of Samaria, and they that dwell among the Philistines, and that foolish people that dwell in Sichem.

verses.raw: Jesus the son of Sirach of Jerusalem has written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge, who out of his heart poured forth wisdom.
verses.text: Jesus the son of Sirach of Jerusalem has written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge, who out of his heart poured forth wisdom.

verses.raw: Blessed is he that shall be exercised in these things; and he that layeth them up in his heart shall become wise.
verses.text: Blessed is he that shall be exercised in these things; and he that layeth them up in his heart shall become wise.

verses.raw: For if he do them, he shall be strong to all things: for the light of Yahuah (God) leadeth him, who gives wisdom to the godly. Blessed be the name of Yahuah (God) for ever. Amen, Amen. ⸻
verses.text: For if he do them, he shall be strong to all things: for the light of Yahuah leadeth him, who gives wisdom to the godly. Blessed be the name of Yahuah for ever. Amen, Amen. ⸻

verses.raw: I will thank you, O Yahuah (God) and King, and praise you, O Yahuah (God) my Saviour: I do give praise to your name:
verses.text: I will thank you, O Yahuah and King, and praise you, O Yahuah my Saviour: I do give praise to your name:

verses.raw: For you are my defender and helper, and has preserved my body from destruction, and from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies, and has been my helper against my adversaries:
verses.text: For you are my defender and helper, and has preserved my body from destruction, and from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies, and has been my helper against my adversaries:

verses.raw: And have delivered me, according to the multitude of your mercies and greatness of your name, from the teeth of them that were ready to devour me, and out of the hands of such as sought after my life, and from the manifold afflictions which I had;
verses.text: And have delivered me, according to the multitude of your mercies and greatness of your name, from the teeth of them that were ready to devour me, and out of the hands of such as sought after my life, and from the manifold afflictions which I had;

verses.raw: From the choking of fire on every side, and from the midst of the fire which I kindled not;
verses.text: From the choking of fire on every side, and from the midst of the fire which I kindled not;

verses.raw: From the depth of the belly of hell, from an unclean tongue, and from lying words.
verses.text: From the depth of the belly of hell, from an unclean tongue, and from lying words.

verses.raw: By an accusation to the king from an unrighteous tongue my soul drew near even to death, my life was near to the hell beneath.
verses.text: By an accusation to the king from an unrighteous tongue my soul drew near even to death, my life was near to the hell beneath.

verses.raw: They compassed me on every side, and there was no man to help me: I looked for the succour of men, but there was none.
verses.text: They compassed me on every side, and there was no man to help me: I looked for the succour of men, but there was none.

verses.raw: Then thought I upon your mercy, O Yahuah (God), and upon your acts of old, how you deliverest such as wait for you, and savest them out of the hands of the enemies.
verses.text: Then thought I upon your mercy, O Yahuah, and upon your acts of old, how you deliverest such as wait for you, and savest them out of the hands of the enemies.

verses.raw: Then lifted I up my supplications from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death.
verses.text: Then lifted I up my supplications from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death.

verses.raw: I called upon Yahuah (God), the Father of my Elohim (God), that he would not leave me in the days of my trouble, and in the time of the proud, when there was no help.
verses.text: I called upon Yahuah, the Father of my Elohim, that he would not leave me in the days of my trouble, and in the time of the proud, when there was no help.

verses.raw: I will praise your name continually, and will sing praises with thanksgiving; and so my prayer was heard:
verses.text: I will praise your name continually, and will sing praises with thanksgiving; and so my prayer was heard:

verses.raw: For you savedst me from destruction, and deliveredst me from the evil time: therefore will I give thanks, and praise you, and bless they name, O Yahuah (God).
verses.text: For you savedst me from destruction, and deliveredst me from the evil time: therefore will I give thanks, and praise you, and bless they name, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: When I was yet young, or ever I went abroad, I desired wisdom openly in my prayer.
verses.text: When I was yet young, or ever I went abroad, I desired wisdom openly in my prayer.

verses.raw: I prayed for her before the temple, and will seek her out even to the end.
verses.text: I prayed for her before the temple, and will seek her out even to the end.

verses.raw: Even from the flower till the grape was ripe has my heart delighted in her: my foot went the right way, from my youth up sought I after her.
verses.text: Even from the flower till the grape was ripe has my heart delighted in her: my foot went the right way, from my youth up sought I after her.

verses.raw: I bowed down my ear a little, and received her, and got much learning.
verses.text: I bowed down my ear a little, and received her, and got much learning.

verses.raw: I profited in it, therefore will I ascribe glory to him that gives me wisdom.
verses.text: I profited in it, therefore will I ascribe glory to him that gives me wisdom.

verses.raw: For I purposed to do after her, and earnestly I followed that which is good; so shall I not be confounded.
verses.text: For I purposed to do after her, and earnestly I followed that which is good; so shall I not be confounded.

verses.raw: My soul has wrestled with her, and in my doings I was exact: I stretched forth my hands to the heaven above, and bewailed my ignorances of her.
verses.text: My soul has wrestled with her, and in my doings I was exact: I stretched forth my hands to the heaven above, and bewailed my ignorances of her.

verses.raw: I directed my soul to her, and I found her in pureness: I have had my heart joined with her from the beginning, therefore shall I not be foresaken.
verses.text: I directed my soul to her, and I found her in pureness: I have had my heart joined with her from the beginning, therefore shall I not be foresaken.

verses.raw: My heart was troubled in seeking her: therefore have I gotten a good possession.
verses.text: My heart was troubled in seeking her: therefore have I gotten a good possession.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) has given me a tongue for my reward, and I will praise him with it.
verses.text: Yahuah has given me a tongue for my reward, and I will praise him with it.

verses.raw: Draw near to me, you unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.
verses.text: Draw near to me, you unlearned, and dwell in the house of learning.

verses.raw: Wherefore are you slow, and what say you to these things, seeing your souls are very thirsty?
verses.text: Wherefore are you slow, and what say you to these things, seeing your souls are very thirsty?

verses.raw: I opened my mouth, and said, Buy her for yourselves without money.
verses.text: I opened my mouth, and said, Buy her for yourselves without money.

verses.raw: Put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction: she is hard at hand to find.
verses.text: Put your neck under the yoke, and let your soul receive instruction: she is hard at hand to find.

verses.raw: Behold with your eyes, how that I have but little labour, and have gotten to me much rest.
verses.text: Behold with your eyes, how that I have but little labour, and have gotten to me much rest.

verses.raw: Get learning with a great sum of money, and get much gold by her.
verses.text: Get learning with a great sum of money, and get much gold by her.

verses.raw: Let your soul rejoice in his mercy, and be not ashamed of his praise.
verses.text: Let your soul rejoice in his mercy, and be not ashamed of his praise.

verses.raw: Work your work betimes, and in his time he will give you your reward. ⸻
verses.text: Work your work betimes, and in his time he will give you your reward. ⸻

title: Baruch with the Letter of Jeremiah

verses.raw: And these are the words of the book, which Baruch the son of Nerias, the son of Maasias, the son of Sedecias, the son of Asadias, the son of Chelcias, wrote in Babylon,
verses.text: And these are the words of the book, which Baruch the son of Nerias, the son of Maasias, the son of Sedecias, the son of Asadias, the son of Chelcias, wrote in Babylon,

verses.raw: In the fifth year, and in the seventh day of the month, what time as the Chaldeans took Jerusalem, and burnt it with fire.
verses.text: In the fifth year, and in the seventh day of the month, what time as the Chaldeans took Jerusalem, and burnt it with fire.

verses.raw: And Baruch did read the words of this book in the hearing of Jechonias the son of Joachim king of Juda, and in the ears of all the people that came to hear the book,
verses.text: And Baruch did read the words of this book in the hearing of Jechonias the son of Joachim king of Juda, and in the ears of all the people that came to hear the book,

verses.raw: And in the hearing of the nobles, and of the king’s sons, and in the hearing of the elders, and of all the people, from the lowest to the highest, even of all them that dwelt at Babylon by the river Sud.
verses.text: And in the hearing of the nobles, and of the king’s sons, and in the hearing of the elders, and of all the people, from the lowest to the highest, even of all them that dwelt at Babylon by the river Sud.

verses.raw: Whereupon they wept, fasted, and prayed before Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Whereupon they wept, fasted, and prayed before Yahuah.

verses.raw: They made also a collection of money according to every man’s power:
verses.text: They made also a collection of money according to every man’s power:

verses.raw: And they sent it to Jerusalem to Joachim the high priest, the son of Chelcias, son of Salom, and to the priests, and to all the people which were found with him at Jerusalem,
verses.text: And they sent it to Jerusalem to Joachim the high priest, the son of Chelcias, son of Salom, and to the priests, and to all the people which were found with him at Jerusalem,

verses.raw: At the same time when he received the vessels of the house of Yahuah (God), that were carried out of the temple, to return them into the land of Juda, the tenth day of the month Sivan, namely, silver vessels, which Sedecias the son of Josias king of Juda had made,
verses.text: At the same time when he received the vessels of the house of Yahuah, that were carried out of the temple, to return them into the land of Juda, the tenth day of the month Sivan, namely, silver vessels, which Sedecias the son of Josias king of Juda had made,

verses.raw: After that Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried away Jechonias, and the princes, and the captives, and the mighty men, and the people of the land, from Jerusalem, and brought them to Babylon.
verses.text: After that Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried away Jechonias, and the princes, and the captives, and the mighty men, and the people of the land, from Jerusalem, and brought them to Babylon.

verses.raw: And they said, Behold, we have sent you money to buy you burnt offerings, and sin offerings, and incense, and prepare you manna, and offer upon the altar of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God);
verses.text: And they said, Behold, we have sent you money to buy you burnt offerings, and sin offerings, and incense, and prepare you manna, and offer upon the altar of Yahuah, our Elohim;

verses.raw: And pray for the life of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and for the life of Balthasar his son, that their days may be upon earth as the days of heaven:
verses.text: And pray for the life of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and for the life of Balthasar his son, that their days may be upon earth as the days of heaven:

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) will give us strength, and lighten our eyes, and we shall live under the shadow of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and under the shadow of Balthasar his son, and we shall serve them many days, and find favour in their sight.
verses.text: And Yahuah will give us strength, and lighten our eyes, and we shall live under the shadow of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and under the shadow of Balthasar his son, and we shall serve them many days, and find favour in their sight.

verses.raw: Pray for us also to Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), for we have sinned against Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God); and to this day the fury of Yahuah (God) and his wrath is not turned from us.
verses.text: Pray for us also to Yahuah, our Elohim, for we have sinned against Yahuah, our Elohim; and to this day the fury of Yahuah and his wrath is not turned from us.

verses.raw: And you shall read this book which we have sent to you, to make confession in the house of Yahuah (God), upon the feasts and solemn days.
verses.text: And you shall read this book which we have sent to you, to make confession in the house of Yahuah, upon the feasts and solemn days.

verses.raw: And you shall say, To Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) belongeth righteousness, but to us the confusion of faces, as it is come to pass this day, to them of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
verses.text: And you shall say, To Yahuah, our Elohim belongeth righteousness, but to us the confusion of faces, as it is come to pass this day, to them of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem,

verses.raw: And to our kings, and to our princes, and to our priests, and to our prophets, and to our fathers:
verses.text: And to our kings, and to our princes, and to our priests, and to our prophets, and to our fathers:

verses.raw: For we have sinned before Yahuah (God),
verses.text: For we have sinned before Yahuah,

verses.raw: And disobeyed him, and have not hearkened to the voice of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), to walk in the commandments that he gave us openly:
verses.text: And disobeyed him, and have not hearkened to the voice of Yahuah, our Elohim, to walk in the commandments that he gave us openly:

verses.raw: Since the day that Yahuah (God) brought our forefathers out of the land of Egypt, to this present day, we have been disobedient to Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), and we have been negligent in not hearing his voice.
verses.text: Since the day that Yahuah brought our forefathers out of the land of Egypt, to this present day, we have been disobedient to Yahuah, our Elohim, and we have been negligent in not hearing his voice.

verses.raw: Wherefore the evils cleaved to us, and the curse, which Yahuah (God) appointed by Moses his servant at the time that he brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt, to give us a land that floweth with milk and honey, like as it is to see this day.
verses.text: Wherefore the evils cleaved to us, and the curse, which Yahuah appointed by Moses his servant at the time that he brought our fathers out of the land of Egypt, to give us a land that floweth with milk and honey, like as it is to see this day.

verses.raw: Nevertheless we have not hearkened to the voice of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), according to all the words of the prophets, whom he sent to us:
verses.text: Nevertheless we have not hearkened to the voice of Yahuah, our Elohim, according to all the words of the prophets, whom he sent to us:

verses.raw: But every man followed the imagination of his own wicked heart, to serve strange gods, and to do evil in the sight of Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God). ⸻
verses.text: But every man followed the imagination of his own wicked heart, to serve strange gods, and to do evil in the sight of Yahuah, our Elohim. ⸻

title: Baruch with the Letter of Jeremiah
