verses.raw: Therefore Yahuah (God) has made good his word, which he pronounced against us, and against our judges that judged Yashar'el (Israel), and against our kings, and against our princes, and against the men of Yashar'el (Israel) and Juda,
verses.text: Therefore Yahuah has made good his word, which he pronounced against us, and against our judges that judged Yashar'el, and against our kings, and against our princes, and against the men of Yashar'el and Juda,

verses.raw: To bring upon us great plagues, such as never happened under the whole heaven, as it came to pass in Jerusalem, according to the things that were written in the law of Moses;
verses.text: To bring upon us great plagues, such as never happened under the whole heaven, as it came to pass in Jerusalem, according to the things that were written in the law of Moses;

verses.raw: That a man should eat the flesh of his own son, and the flesh of his own daughter.
verses.text: That a man should eat the flesh of his own son, and the flesh of his own daughter.

verses.raw: Moreover he has delivered them to be in subjection to all the kingdoms that are round about us, to be as a reproach and desolation among all the people round about, where Yahuah (God) has scattered them.
verses.text: Moreover he has delivered them to be in subjection to all the kingdoms that are round about us, to be as a reproach and desolation among all the people round about, where Yahuah has scattered them.

verses.raw: Thus we were cast down, and not exalted, because we have sinned against Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), and have not been obedient to his voice.
verses.text: Thus we were cast down, and not exalted, because we have sinned against Yahuah, our Elohim, and have not been obedient to his voice.

verses.raw: To Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God) appertaineth righteousness: but to us and to our fathers open shame, as appears this day.
verses.text: To Yahuah, our Elohim appertaineth righteousness: but to us and to our fathers open shame, as appears this day.

verses.raw: For all these plagues are come upon us, which Yahuah (God) has pronounced against us
verses.text: For all these plagues are come upon us, which Yahuah has pronounced against us

verses.raw: Yet have we not prayed before Yahuah (God), that we might turn every one from the imaginations of his wicked heart.
verses.text: Yet have we not prayed before Yahuah, that we might turn every one from the imaginations of his wicked heart.

verses.raw: Wherefore Yahuah (God) watched over us for evil, and Yahuah (God) has brought it upon us: for Yahuah (God) is righteous in all his works which he has commanded us.
verses.text: Wherefore Yahuah watched over us for evil, and Yahuah has brought it upon us: for Yahuah is righteous in all his works which he has commanded us.

verses.raw: Yet we have not hearkened to his voice, to walk in the commandments of Yahuah (God), that he has set before us.
verses.text: Yet we have not hearkened to his voice, to walk in the commandments of Yahuah, that he has set before us.

verses.raw: And now, O Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), that have brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and high arm, and with signs, and with wonders, and with great power, and have gotten thyself a name, as appears this day:
verses.text: And now, O Yahuah of Yashar'el, that have brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and high arm, and with signs, and with wonders, and with great power, and have gotten thyself a name, as appears this day:

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), we have sinned, we have done ungodly, we have dealt unrighteously in all your ordinances.
verses.text: O Yahuah, our Elohim, we have sinned, we have done ungodly, we have dealt unrighteously in all your ordinances.

verses.raw: Let your wrath turn from us: for we are but a few left among the heathen, where you have scattered us.
verses.text: Let your wrath turn from us: for we are but a few left among the heathen, where you have scattered us.

verses.raw: Hear our prayers, O Yahuah (God), and our petitions, and deliver us for your own sake, and give us favour in the sight of them which have led us away:
verses.text: Hear our prayers, O Yahuah, and our petitions, and deliver us for your own sake, and give us favour in the sight of them which have led us away:

verses.raw: That all the earth may know that you are Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), because Yashar'el (Israel) and his posterity is called by your name.
verses.text: That all the earth may know that you are Yahuah, our Elohim, because Yashar'el and his posterity is called by your name.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), look down from yours holy house, and consider us: bow down your ear, O Yahuah (God), to hear us.
verses.text: O Yahuah, look down from yours holy house, and consider us: bow down your ear, O Yahuah, to hear us.

verses.raw: Open your eyes, and behold; for the dead that are in the graves, whose souls are taken from their bodies, will give to Yahuah (God) neither praise nor righteousness:
verses.text: Open your eyes, and behold; for the dead that are in the graves, whose souls are taken from their bodies, will give to Yahuah neither praise nor righteousness:

verses.raw: But the soul that is greatly vexed, which goes stooping and feeble, and the eyes that fail, and the hungry soul, will give you praise and righteousness, O Yahuah (God).
verses.text: But the soul that is greatly vexed, which goes stooping and feeble, and the eyes that fail, and the hungry soul, will give you praise and righteousness, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: Therefore we do not make our humble supplication before you, O Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), for the righteousness of our fathers, and of our kings.
verses.text: Therefore we do not make our humble supplication before you, O Yahuah, our Elohim, for the righteousness of our fathers, and of our kings.

verses.raw: For you have sent out your wrath and indignation upon us, as you have spoken by your servants the prophets, saying,
verses.text: For you have sent out your wrath and indignation upon us, as you have spoken by your servants the prophets, saying,

verses.raw: Thus says Yahuah (God), Bow down your shoulders to serve the king of Babylon: so shall you remain in the land that I gave to your fathers.
verses.text: Thus says Yahuah, Bow down your shoulders to serve the king of Babylon: so shall you remain in the land that I gave to your fathers.

verses.raw: But if you will not hear the voice of Yahuah (God), to serve the king of Babylon,
verses.text: But if you will not hear the voice of Yahuah, to serve the king of Babylon,

verses.raw: I will cause to cease out of the cites of Yahudah (Judah), and from without Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: and the whole land shall be desolate of inhabitants.
verses.text: I will cause to cease out of the cites of Yahudah, and from without Jerusalem, the voice of mirth, and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride: and the whole land shall be desolate of inhabitants.

verses.raw: But we would not hearken to your voice, to serve the king of Babylon: therefore have you made good the words that you spakest by your servants the prophets, namely, that the bones of our kings, and the bones of our fathers, should be taken out of their place.
verses.text: But we would not hearken to your voice, to serve the king of Babylon: therefore have you made good the words that you spakest by your servants the prophets, namely, that the bones of our kings, and the bones of our fathers, should be taken out of their place.

verses.raw: And, lo, they are cast out to the heat of the day, and to the frost of the night, and they died in great miseries by famine, by sword, and by pestilence.
verses.text: And, lo, they are cast out to the heat of the day, and to the frost of the night, and they died in great miseries by famine, by sword, and by pestilence.

verses.raw: And the house which is called by your name have you laid waste, as it is to be seen this day, for the wickedness of the house of Yashar'el (Israel) and the house of Juda.
verses.text: And the house which is called by your name have you laid waste, as it is to be seen this day, for the wickedness of the house of Yashar'el and the house of Juda.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), you have dealt with us after all your goodness, and according to all that great mercy of yours,
verses.text: O Yahuah, our Elohim, you have dealt with us after all your goodness, and according to all that great mercy of yours,

verses.raw: As you spakest by your servant Moses in the day when you did command him to write the law before the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying,
verses.text: As you spakest by your servant Moses in the day when you did command him to write the law before the children of Yashar'el, saying,

verses.raw: If you will not hear my voice, surely this very great multitude shall be turned into a small number among the nations, where I will scatter them.
verses.text: If you will not hear my voice, surely this very great multitude shall be turned into a small number among the nations, where I will scatter them.

verses.raw: For I knew that they would not hear me, because it is a stiffnecked people: but in the land of their captivities they shall remember themselves.
verses.text: For I knew that they would not hear me, because it is a stiffnecked people: but in the land of their captivities they shall remember themselves.

verses.raw: And shall know that I am Yahuah (God), their Elohim (God): for I will give them an heart, and ears to hear:
verses.text: And shall know that I am Yahuah, their Elohim: for I will give them an heart, and ears to hear:

verses.raw: And they shall praise me in the land of their captivity, and think upon my name,
verses.text: And they shall praise me in the land of their captivity, and think upon my name,

verses.raw: And return from their stiff neck, and from their wicked deeds: for they shall remember the way of their fathers, which sinned before Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And return from their stiff neck, and from their wicked deeds: for they shall remember the way of their fathers, which sinned before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and they shall be lords of it: and I will increase them, and they shall not be diminished.
verses.text: And I will bring them again into the land which I promised with an oath to their fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and they shall be lords of it: and I will increase them, and they shall not be diminished.

verses.raw: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them to be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people: and I will no more drive my people of Yashar'el (Israel) out of the land that I have given them. ⸻
verses.text: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them to be their Elohim, and they shall be my people: and I will no more drive my people of Yashar'el out of the land that I have given them. ⸻

title: Baruch with the Letter of Jeremiah

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God) Almighty, Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), the soul in anguish the troubled spirit, cries to you.
verses.text: O Yahuah Almighty, Yahuah of Yashar'el, the soul in anguish the troubled spirit, cries to you.

verses.raw: Hear, O Yahuah (God), and have mercy; for you are merciful: and have pity upon us, because we have sinned before you.
verses.text: Hear, O Yahuah, and have mercy; for you are merciful: and have pity upon us, because we have sinned before you.

verses.raw: For you endurest for ever, and we perish utterly.
verses.text: For you endurest for ever, and we perish utterly.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God) Almighty, you Yahuah (God) of Yashar'el (Israel), hear now the prayers of the dead Israelites, and of their children, which have sinned before you, and not hearkened to the voice of you their Elohim (God): for the which cause these plagues cleave to us.
verses.text: O Yahuah Almighty, you Yahuah of Yashar'el, hear now the prayers of the dead Israelites, and of their children, which have sinned before you, and not hearkened to the voice of you their Elohim: for the which cause these plagues cleave to us.

verses.raw: Remember not the iniquities of our forefathers: but think upon your power and your name now at this time.
verses.text: Remember not the iniquities of our forefathers: but think upon your power and your name now at this time.

verses.raw: For you are Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God), and you, O Yahuah (God), will we praise.
verses.text: For you are Yahuah, our Elohim, and you, O Yahuah, will we praise.

verses.raw: And for this cause you have put your fear in our hearts, to the intent that we should call upon your name, and praise you in our captivity: for we have called to mind all the iniquity of our forefathers, that sinned before you.
verses.text: And for this cause you have put your fear in our hearts, to the intent that we should call upon your name, and praise you in our captivity: for we have called to mind all the iniquity of our forefathers, that sinned before you.

verses.raw: Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where you have scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from Yahuah (God), our Elohim (God).
verses.text: Behold, we are yet this day in our captivity, where you have scattered us, for a reproach and a curse, and to be subject to payments, according to all the iniquities of our fathers, which departed from Yahuah, our Elohim.

verses.raw: Hear, Yashar'el (Israel), the commandments of life: give ear to understand wisdom.
verses.text: Hear, Yashar'el, the commandments of life: give ear to understand wisdom.

verses.raw: How happeneth it Yashar'el (Israel), that you are in your enemies’ land, that you are waxen old in a strange country, that you are defiled with the dead,
verses.text: How happeneth it Yashar'el, that you are in your enemies’ land, that you are waxen old in a strange country, that you are defiled with the dead,

verses.raw: That you are counted with them that go down into the grave?
verses.text: That you are counted with them that go down into the grave?

verses.raw: You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom.
verses.text: You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom.

verses.raw: For if you had walked in the way of Yahuah (God), you should have dwelled in peace for ever.
verses.text: For if you had walked in the way of Yahuah, you should have dwelled in peace for ever.

verses.raw: Learn where is wisdom, where is strength, where is understanding; that you may know also where is length of days, and life, where is the light of the eyes, and peace.
verses.text: Learn where is wisdom, where is strength, where is understanding; that you may know also where is length of days, and life, where is the light of the eyes, and peace.

verses.raw: Who has found out her place? or who has come into her treasures?
verses.text: Who has found out her place? or who has come into her treasures?

verses.raw: Where are the princes of the heathen become, and such as ruled the beasts upon the earth;
verses.text: Where are the princes of the heathen become, and such as ruled the beasts upon the earth;

verses.raw: They that had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and they that hoarded up silver and gold, in which men trust, and made no end of their getting?
verses.text: They that had their pastime with the fowls of the air, and they that hoarded up silver and gold, in which men trust, and made no end of their getting?

verses.raw: For they that wrought in silver, and were so careful, and whose works are unsearchable,
verses.text: For they that wrought in silver, and were so careful, and whose works are unsearchable,

verses.raw: They are vanished and gone down to the grave, and others are come up in their steads.
verses.text: They are vanished and gone down to the grave, and others are come up in their steads.

verses.raw: Young men have seen light, and dwelt upon the earth: but the way of knowledge have they not known,
verses.text: Young men have seen light, and dwelt upon the earth: but the way of knowledge have they not known,

verses.raw: Nor understood the paths thereof, nor laid hold of it: their children were far off from that way.
verses.text: Nor understood the paths thereof, nor laid hold of it: their children were far off from that way.

verses.raw: It has not been heard of in Chanaan, neither has it been seen in Theman.
verses.text: It has not been heard of in Chanaan, neither has it been seen in Theman.

verses.raw: The Agarenes that seek wisdom upon earth, the merchants of Meran and of Theman, the authors of fables, and searchers out of understanding; none of these have known the way of wisdom, or remember her paths.
verses.text: The Agarenes that seek wisdom upon earth, the merchants of Meran and of Theman, the authors of fables, and searchers out of understanding; none of these have known the way of wisdom, or remember her paths.

verses.raw: O Yashar'el (Israel), how great is the house of Yahuah (God)! and how large is the place of his possession!
verses.text: O Yashar'el, how great is the house of Yahuah! and how large is the place of his possession!

verses.raw: Great, and has none end; high, and unmeasurable.
verses.text: Great, and has none end; high, and unmeasurable.

verses.raw: There were the giants famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in war.
verses.text: There were the giants famous from the beginning, that were of so great stature, and so expert in war.

verses.raw: Those did not Yahuah (God) choose, neither gave he the way of knowledge to them:
verses.text: Those did not Yahuah choose, neither gave he the way of knowledge to them:

verses.raw: But they were destroyed, because they had no wisdom, and perished through their own foolishness.
verses.text: But they were destroyed, because they had no wisdom, and perished through their own foolishness.

verses.raw: Who has gone up into heaven, and taken her, and brought her down from the clouds?
verses.text: Who has gone up into heaven, and taken her, and brought her down from the clouds?

verses.raw: Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold?
verses.text: Who has gone over the sea, and found her, and will bring her for pure gold?

verses.raw: No man knoweth her way, nor thinketh of her path.
verses.text: No man knoweth her way, nor thinketh of her path.

verses.raw: But he that knoweth all things knoweth her, and has found her out with his understanding: he that prepared the earth for evermore has filled it with fourfooted beasts:
verses.text: But he that knoweth all things knoweth her, and has found her out with his understanding: he that prepared the earth for evermore has filled it with fourfooted beasts:

verses.raw: He that sends forth light, and it goes, calls it again, and it obeyeth him with fear.
verses.text: He that sends forth light, and it goes, calls it again, and it obeyeth him with fear.

verses.raw: The stars shined in their watches, and rejoiced: when he calls them, they say, Here we be; and so with cheerfulness they shewed light to him that made them.
verses.text: The stars shined in their watches, and rejoiced: when he calls them, they say, Here we be; and so with cheerfulness they shewed light to him that made them.

verses.raw: This is our Elohim (God), and there shall none other be accounted of in comparison of him
verses.text: This is our Elohim, and there shall none other be accounted of in comparison of him

verses.raw: He has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el (Israel) his beloved.
verses.text: He has found out all the way of knowledge, and has given it to Jacob his servant, and to Yashar'el his beloved.

verses.raw: Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men. ⸻
verses.text: Afterward did he shew himself upon earth, and conversed with men. ⸻

title: Baruch with the Letter of Jeremiah

verses.raw: This is the book of the commandments of Yahuah (God), and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.
verses.text: This is the book of the commandments of Yahuah, and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.

verses.raw: Turn you, O Jacob, and take hold of it: walk in the presence of the light thereof, that you may be illuminated.
verses.text: Turn you, O Jacob, and take hold of it: walk in the presence of the light thereof, that you may be illuminated.

verses.raw: Give not yours honour to another, nor the things that are profitable to you to a strange nation.
verses.text: Give not yours honour to another, nor the things that are profitable to you to a strange nation.

verses.raw: O Yashar'el (Israel), happy are we: for things that are pleasing to Yahuah (God) are made known to us.
verses.text: O Yashar'el, happy are we: for things that are pleasing to Yahuah are made known to us.

verses.raw: Be of good cheer, my people, the memorial of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Be of good cheer, my people, the memorial of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: You were sold to the nations, not for your destruction: but because you moved Yahuah (God) to wrath, you were delivered to the enemies.
verses.text: You were sold to the nations, not for your destruction: but because you moved Yahuah to wrath, you were delivered to the enemies.

verses.raw: For you provoked him that made you by sacrificing to devils, and not to Yahuah (God).
verses.text: For you provoked him that made you by sacrificing to devils, and not to Yahuah.

verses.raw: You have forgotten the everlasting Yahuah (God), that brought you up; and you have grieved Jerusalem, that nursed you.
verses.text: You have forgotten the everlasting Yahuah, that brought you up; and you have grieved Jerusalem, that nursed you.

verses.raw: For when she saw the wrath of Yahuah (God) coming upon you, she said, Hearken, O you that dwell about Sion: Yahuah (God) has brought upon me great mourning;
verses.text: For when she saw the wrath of Yahuah coming upon you, she said, Hearken, O you that dwell about Sion: Yahuah has brought upon me great mourning;

verses.raw: For I saw the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting brought upon them.
verses.text: For I saw the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting brought upon them.

verses.raw: With joy did I nourish them; but sent them away with weeping and mourning.
verses.text: With joy did I nourish them; but sent them away with weeping and mourning.

verses.raw: Let no man rejoice over me, a widow, and forsaken of many, who for the sins of my children am left desolate; because they departed from the law of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Let no man rejoice over me, a widow, and forsaken of many, who for the sins of my children am left desolate; because they departed from the law of Yahuah.

verses.raw: They knew not his statutes, nor walked in the ways of his commandments, nor trod in the paths of discipline in his righteousness.
verses.text: They knew not his statutes, nor walked in the ways of his commandments, nor trod in the paths of discipline in his righteousness.

verses.raw: Let them that dwell about Sion come, and remember you the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting has brought upon them.
verses.text: Let them that dwell about Sion come, and remember you the captivity of my sons and daughters, which the Everlasting has brought upon them.

verses.raw: For he has brought a nation upon them from far, a shameless nation, and of a strange language, who neither reverenced old man, nor pitied child.
verses.text: For he has brought a nation upon them from far, a shameless nation, and of a strange language, who neither reverenced old man, nor pitied child.

verses.raw: These have carried away the dear beloved children of the widow, and left her that was alone desolate without daughters.
verses.text: These have carried away the dear beloved children of the widow, and left her that was alone desolate without daughters.

verses.raw: But what can I help you?
verses.text: But what can I help you?

verses.raw: For he that brought these plagues upon you will deliver you from the hands of your enemies.
verses.text: For he that brought these plagues upon you will deliver you from the hands of your enemies.

verses.raw: Go your way, O my children, go your way: for I am left desolate.
verses.text: Go your way, O my children, go your way: for I am left desolate.

verses.raw: I have put off the clothing of peace, and put upon me the sackcloth of my prayer: I will cry to the Everlasting in my days.
verses.text: I have put off the clothing of peace, and put upon me the sackcloth of my prayer: I will cry to the Everlasting in my days.

verses.raw: Be of good cheer, O my children, cry to Yahuah (God), and he will deliver you from the power and hand of the enemies.
verses.text: Be of good cheer, O my children, cry to Yahuah, and he will deliver you from the power and hand of the enemies.

verses.raw: For my hope is in the Everlasting, that he will save you; and joy is come to me from the Holy One, because of the mercy which shall soon come to you from the Everlasting our Saviour.
verses.text: For my hope is in the Everlasting, that he will save you; and joy is come to me from the Holy One, because of the mercy which shall soon come to you from the Everlasting our Saviour.

verses.raw: For I sent you out with mourning and weeping: but Yahuah (God) will give you to me again with joy and gladness for ever.
verses.text: For I sent you out with mourning and weeping: but Yahuah will give you to me again with joy and gladness for ever.

verses.raw: Like as now the neighbours of Sion have seen your captivity: so shall they see shortly your salvation from our Elohim (God) which shall come upon you with great glory, and brightness of the Everlasting.
verses.text: Like as now the neighbours of Sion have seen your captivity: so shall they see shortly your salvation from our Elohim which shall come upon you with great glory, and brightness of the Everlasting.

verses.raw: My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from Yahuah (God): for your enemy has persecuted you; but shortly you shall see his destruction, and shall tread upon his neck.
verses.text: My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from Yahuah: for your enemy has persecuted you; but shortly you shall see his destruction, and shall tread upon his neck.

verses.raw: My delicate ones have gone rough ways, and were taken away as a flock caught of the enemies.
verses.text: My delicate ones have gone rough ways, and were taken away as a flock caught of the enemies.

verses.raw: Be of good comfort, O my children, and cry to Yahuah (God): for you shall be remembered of him that brought these things upon you.
verses.text: Be of good comfort, O my children, and cry to Yahuah: for you shall be remembered of him that brought these things upon you.

verses.raw: For as it was your mind to go astray from Yahuah (God): so, being returned, seek him ten times more.
verses.text: For as it was your mind to go astray from Yahuah: so, being returned, seek him ten times more.

verses.raw: For he that has brought these plagues upon you shall bring you everlasting joy with your salvation.
verses.text: For he that has brought these plagues upon you shall bring you everlasting joy with your salvation.

verses.raw: Take a good heart, O Jerusalem: for he that gave you that name will comfort you.
verses.text: Take a good heart, O Jerusalem: for he that gave you that name will comfort you.

verses.raw: Miserable are they that afflicted you, and rejoiced at your fall.
verses.text: Miserable are they that afflicted you, and rejoiced at your fall.

verses.raw: Miserable are the cities which your children served: miserable is she that received your sons.
verses.text: Miserable are the cities which your children served: miserable is she that received your sons.

verses.raw: For as she rejoiced at your ruin, and was glad of your fall: so shall she be grieved for her own desolation.
verses.text: For as she rejoiced at your ruin, and was glad of your fall: so shall she be grieved for her own desolation.

verses.raw: For I will take away the rejoicing of her great multitude, and her pride shall be turned into mourning.
verses.text: For I will take away the rejoicing of her great multitude, and her pride shall be turned into mourning.

verses.raw: For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting, long to endure; and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time.
verses.text: For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting, long to endure; and she shall be inhabited of devils for a great time.

verses.raw: O Jerusalem, look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah (God).
verses.text: O Jerusalem, look about you toward the east, and behold the joy that comes to you from Yahuah.

verses.raw: Lo, your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of Yahuah (God). ⸻
verses.text: Lo, your sons come, whom you sentest away, they come gathered together from the east to the west by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the glory of Yahuah. ⸻

title: Baruch with the Letter of Jeremiah

verses.raw: Put off, O Jerusalem, the garment of mourning and affliction, and put on the comeliness of the glory that comes from Yahuah (God) for ever.
verses.text: Put off, O Jerusalem, the garment of mourning and affliction, and put on the comeliness of the glory that comes from Yahuah for ever.

verses.raw: Cast about you a double garment of the righteousness which comes from Yahuah (God); and set a diadem on yours head of the glory of the Everlasting.
verses.text: Cast about you a double garment of the righteousness which comes from Yahuah; and set a diadem on yours head of the glory of the Everlasting.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) will shew your brightness to every country under heaven.
verses.text: For Yahuah will shew your brightness to every country under heaven.

verses.raw: For your name shall be called of Yahuah (God) for ever The peace of righteousness, and The glory of the worship of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: For your name shall be called of Yahuah for ever The peace of righteousness, and The glory of the worship of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand on high, and look about toward the east, and behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the remembrance of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Arise, O Jerusalem, and stand on high, and look about toward the east, and behold your children gathered from the west to the east by the word of the Holy One, rejoicing in the remembrance of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For they departed from you on foot, and were led away of their enemies: but Yahuah (God) brings them to you exalted with glory, as children of the kingdom.
verses.text: For they departed from you on foot, and were led away of their enemies: but Yahuah brings them to you exalted with glory, as children of the kingdom.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) has appointed that every high hill, and banks of long continuance, should be cast down, and valleys filled up, to make even the ground, that Yashar'el (Israel) may go safely in the glory of Yahuah (God),
verses.text: For Yahuah has appointed that every high hill, and banks of long continuance, should be cast down, and valleys filled up, to make even the ground, that Yashar'el may go safely in the glory of Yahuah,

verses.raw: Moreover even the woods and every sweetsmelling tree shall overshadow Yashar'el (Israel) by the commandment of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Moreover even the woods and every sweetsmelling tree shall overshadow Yashar'el by the commandment of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (God) shall lead Yashar'el (Israel) with joy in the light of his glory with the mercy and righteousness that comes from him. ⸻
verses.text: For Yahuah shall lead Yashar'el with joy in the light of his glory with the mercy and righteousness that comes from him. ⸻

title: Baruch with the Letter of Jeremiah

verses.raw: A copy of an epistle, which Jeremy sent to them which were to be led captives into Babylon by the king of the Babylonians, to certify them, as it was commanded him of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: A copy of an epistle, which Jeremy sent to them which were to be led captives into Babylon by the king of the Babylonians, to certify them, as it was commanded him of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Because of the sins which you have committed before Yahuah (God), you shall be led away captives into Babylon by Nabuchodonosor king of the Babylonians.
verses.text: Because of the sins which you have committed before Yahuah, you shall be led away captives into Babylon by Nabuchodonosor king of the Babylonians.

verses.raw: So when you be come to Babylon, you shall remain there many years, and for a long season, namely, seven generations: and after that I will bring you away peaceably from thence.
verses.text: So when you be come to Babylon, you shall remain there many years, and for a long season, namely, seven generations: and after that I will bring you away peaceably from thence.

verses.raw: Now shall you see in Babylon gods of silver, and of gold, and of wood, borne upon shoulders, which cause the nations to fear.
verses.text: Now shall you see in Babylon gods of silver, and of gold, and of wood, borne upon shoulders, which cause the nations to fear.

verses.raw: Beware therefore that you in no wise be like to strangers, neither be you afraid of them, when you see the multitude before them and behind them, worshipping them.
verses.text: Beware therefore that you in no wise be like to strangers, neither be you afraid of them, when you see the multitude before them and behind them, worshipping them.

verses.raw: But say you in your hearts, O Yahuah (God), we must worship you.
verses.text: But say you in your hearts, O Yahuah, we must worship you.

verses.raw: For my angel is with you, and I myself caring for your souls.
verses.text: For my angel is with you, and I myself caring for your souls.

verses.raw: As for their tongue, it is polished by the workman, and they themselves are gilded and laid over with silver; yet are they but false, and cannot speak.
verses.text: As for their tongue, it is polished by the workman, and they themselves are gilded and laid over with silver; yet are they but false, and cannot speak.

verses.raw: And taking gold, as it were for a virgin that loves to go gay, they make crowns for the heads of their gods.
verses.text: And taking gold, as it were for a virgin that loves to go gay, they make crowns for the heads of their gods.

verses.raw: Sometimes also the priests convey from their gods gold and silver, and bestow it upon themselves.
verses.text: Sometimes also the priests convey from their gods gold and silver, and bestow it upon themselves.

verses.raw: Yea, they will give thereof to the common harlots, and deck them as men with garments, being gods of silver, and gods of gold, and wood.
verses.text: Yea, they will give thereof to the common harlots, and deck them as men with garments, being gods of silver, and gods of gold, and wood.

verses.raw: Yet cannot these gods save themselves from rust and moth, though they be covered with purple raiment.
verses.text: Yet cannot these gods save themselves from rust and moth, though they be covered with purple raiment.

verses.raw: They wipe their faces because of the dust of the temple, when there is much upon them.
verses.text: They wipe their faces because of the dust of the temple, when there is much upon them.

verses.raw: And he that cannot put to death one that offendeth him holdeth a sceptre, as though he were a judge of the country.
verses.text: And he that cannot put to death one that offendeth him holdeth a sceptre, as though he were a judge of the country.

verses.raw: He has also in his right hand a dagger and an ax: but cannot deliver himself from war and thieves.
verses.text: He has also in his right hand a dagger and an ax: but cannot deliver himself from war and thieves.

verses.raw: By which they are known not to be gods: therefore fear them not.
verses.text: By which they are known not to be gods: therefore fear them not.

verses.raw: For like as a vessel that a man useth is nothing worth when it is broken; even so it is with their gods: when they be set up in the temple, their eyes be full of dust through the feet of them that come in.
verses.text: For like as a vessel that a man useth is nothing worth when it is broken; even so it is with their gods: when they be set up in the temple, their eyes be full of dust through the feet of them that come in.

verses.raw: And as the doors are made sure on every side upon him that offendeth the king, as being committed to suffer death: even so the priests make fast their temples with doors, with locks, and bars, lest their gods be spoiled with robbers.
verses.text: And as the doors are made sure on every side upon him that offendeth the king, as being committed to suffer death: even so the priests make fast their temples with doors, with locks, and bars, lest their gods be spoiled with robbers.

verses.raw: They light them candles, yes, more than for themselves, of which they cannot see one.
verses.text: They light them candles, yes, more than for themselves, of which they cannot see one.

verses.raw: They are as one of the beams of the temple, yet they say their hearts are gnawed upon by things creeping out of the earth; and when they eat them and their clothes, they feel it not.
verses.text: They are as one of the beams of the temple, yet they say their hearts are gnawed upon by things creeping out of the earth; and when they eat them and their clothes, they feel it not.

verses.raw: Their faces are blacked through the smoke that comes out of the temple.
verses.text: Their faces are blacked through the smoke that comes out of the temple.

verses.raw: Upon their bodies and heads sit bats, swallows, and birds, and the cats also.
verses.text: Upon their bodies and heads sit bats, swallows, and birds, and the cats also.

verses.raw: By this you may know that they are no gods: therefore fear them not.
verses.text: By this you may know that they are no gods: therefore fear them not.

verses.raw: Notwithstanding the gold that is about them to make them beautiful, except they wipe off the rust, they will not shine: for neither when they were molten did they feel it.
verses.text: Notwithstanding the gold that is about them to make them beautiful, except they wipe off the rust, they will not shine: for neither when they were molten did they feel it.

verses.raw: The things in which there is no breath are bought for a most high price.
verses.text: The things in which there is no breath are bought for a most high price.

verses.raw: They are borne upon shoulders, having no feet by which they declare to men that they be nothing worth.
verses.text: They are borne upon shoulders, having no feet by which they declare to men that they be nothing worth.

verses.raw: They also that serve them are ashamed: for if they fall to the ground at any time, they cannot rise up again of themselves: neither, if one set them upright, can they move of themselves: neither, if they be bowed down, can they make themselves straight: but they set gifts before them as to dead men.
verses.text: They also that serve them are ashamed: for if they fall to the ground at any time, they cannot rise up again of themselves: neither, if one set them upright, can they move of themselves: neither, if they be bowed down, can they make themselves straight: but they set gifts before them as to dead men.

verses.raw: As for the things that are sacrificed to them, their priests sell and abuse; in like manner their wives lay up part thereof in salt; but to the poor and impotent they give nothing of it.
verses.text: As for the things that are sacrificed to them, their priests sell and abuse; in like manner their wives lay up part thereof in salt; but to the poor and impotent they give nothing of it.

verses.raw: Menstruous women and women in childbed eat their sacrifices: by these things you may know that they are no gods: fear them not.
verses.text: Menstruous women and women in childbed eat their sacrifices: by these things you may know that they are no gods: fear them not.

verses.raw: For how can they be called gods? because women set meat before the gods of silver, gold, and wood.
verses.text: For how can they be called gods? because women set meat before the gods of silver, gold, and wood.

verses.raw: And the priests sit in their temples, having their clothes rent, and their heads and beards shaven, and nothing upon their heads.
verses.text: And the priests sit in their temples, having their clothes rent, and their heads and beards shaven, and nothing upon their heads.

verses.raw: They roar and cry before their gods, as men do at the feast when one is dead.
verses.text: They roar and cry before their gods, as men do at the feast when one is dead.

verses.raw: The priests also take off their garments, and clothe their wives and children.
verses.text: The priests also take off their garments, and clothe their wives and children.

verses.raw: Whether it be evil that one doeth to them, or good, they are not able to recompense it: they can neither set up a king, nor put him down.
verses.text: Whether it be evil that one doeth to them, or good, they are not able to recompense it: they can neither set up a king, nor put him down.

verses.raw: In like manner, they can neither give riches nor money: though a man make a vow to them, and keep it not, they will not require it.
verses.text: In like manner, they can neither give riches nor money: though a man make a vow to them, and keep it not, they will not require it.

verses.raw: They can save no man from death, neither deliver the weak from the mighty.
verses.text: They can save no man from death, neither deliver the weak from the mighty.

verses.raw: They cannot restore a blind man to his sight, nor help any man in his distress.
verses.text: They cannot restore a blind man to his sight, nor help any man in his distress.

verses.raw: They can shew no mercy to the widow, nor do good to the fatherless.
verses.text: They can shew no mercy to the widow, nor do good to the fatherless.

verses.raw: Their gods of wood, and which are overlaid with gold and silver, are like the stones that be hewn out of the mountain: they that worship them shall be confounded.
verses.text: Their gods of wood, and which are overlaid with gold and silver, are like the stones that be hewn out of the mountain: they that worship them shall be confounded.

verses.raw: How should a man then think and say that they are gods, when even the Chaldeans themselves dishonour them?
verses.text: How should a man then think and say that they are gods, when even the Chaldeans themselves dishonour them?

verses.raw: Who if they shall see one dumb that cannot speak, they bring him, and intreat Bel that he may speak, as though he were able to understand.
verses.text: Who if they shall see one dumb that cannot speak, they bring him, and intreat Bel that he may speak, as though he were able to understand.

verses.raw: Yet they cannot understand this themselves, and leave them: for they have no knowledge.
verses.text: Yet they cannot understand this themselves, and leave them: for they have no knowledge.

verses.raw: The women also with cords about them, sitting in the ways, burn bran for perfume: but if any of them, drawn by some that passeth by, lie with him, she reproacheth her fellow, that she was not thought as worthy as herself, nor her cord broken.
verses.text: The women also with cords about them, sitting in the ways, burn bran for perfume: but if any of them, drawn by some that passeth by, lie with him, she reproacheth her fellow, that she was not thought as worthy as herself, nor her cord broken.

verses.raw: Whatsoever is done among them is false: how may it then be thought or said that they are gods?
verses.text: Whatsoever is done among them is false: how may it then be thought or said that they are gods?

verses.raw: They are made of carpenters and goldsmiths: they can be nothing else than the workmen will have them to be.
verses.text: They are made of carpenters and goldsmiths: they can be nothing else than the workmen will have them to be.

verses.raw: And they themselves that made them can never continue long; how should then the things that are made of them be gods?
verses.text: And they themselves that made them can never continue long; how should then the things that are made of them be gods?

verses.raw: For they left lies and reproaches to them that come after.
verses.text: For they left lies and reproaches to them that come after.

verses.raw: For when there comes any war or plague upon them, the priests consult with themselves, where they may be hidden with them.
verses.text: For when there comes any war or plague upon them, the priests consult with themselves, where they may be hidden with them.

verses.raw: How then cannot men perceive that they be no gods, which can neither save themselves from war, nor from plague?
verses.text: How then cannot men perceive that they be no gods, which can neither save themselves from war, nor from plague?

verses.raw: For seeing they be but of wood, and overlaid with silver and gold, it shall be known hereafter that they are false:
verses.text: For seeing they be but of wood, and overlaid with silver and gold, it shall be known hereafter that they are false:

verses.raw: And it shall manifestly appear to all nations and kings that they are no gods, but the works of men’s hands, and that there is no work of Yahuah (God) in them.
verses.text: And it shall manifestly appear to all nations and kings that they are no gods, but the works of men’s hands, and that there is no work of Yahuah in them.

verses.raw: Who then may not know that they are no gods?
verses.text: Who then may not know that they are no gods?

verses.raw: For neither can they set up a king in the land, nor give rain to men.
verses.text: For neither can they set up a king in the land, nor give rain to men.

verses.raw: Neither can they judge their own cause, nor redress a wrong, being unable: for they are as crows between heaven and earth.
verses.text: Neither can they judge their own cause, nor redress a wrong, being unable: for they are as crows between heaven and earth.

verses.raw: Whereupon when fire falls upon the house of gods of wood, or laid over with gold or silver, their priests will flee away, and escape; but they themselves shall be burned asunder like beams.
verses.text: Whereupon when fire falls upon the house of gods of wood, or laid over with gold or silver, their priests will flee away, and escape; but they themselves shall be burned asunder like beams.

verses.raw: Moreover they cannot withstand any king or enemies: how can it then be thought or said that they be gods?
verses.text: Moreover they cannot withstand any king or enemies: how can it then be thought or said that they be gods?

verses.raw: Neither are those gods of wood, and laid over with silver or gold, able to escape either from thieves or robbers.
verses.text: Neither are those gods of wood, and laid over with silver or gold, able to escape either from thieves or robbers.

verses.raw: Whose gold, and silver, and garments with which they are clothed, they that are strong take, and go away withal: neither are they able to help themselves.
verses.text: Whose gold, and silver, and garments with which they are clothed, they that are strong take, and go away withal: neither are they able to help themselves.

verses.raw: Therefore it is better to be a king that sheweth his power, or else a profitable vessel in an house, which the owner shall have use of, than such false gods; or to be a door in an house, to keep such things in it, than such false gods. or a pillar of wood in a a palace, than such false gods.
verses.text: Therefore it is better to be a king that sheweth his power, or else a profitable vessel in an house, which the owner shall have use of, than such false gods; or to be a door in an house, to keep such things in it, than such false gods. or a pillar of wood in a a palace, than such false gods.

verses.raw: For sun, moon, and stars, being bright and sent to do their offices, are obedient.
verses.text: For sun, moon, and stars, being bright and sent to do their offices, are obedient.

verses.raw: In like manner the lightning when it breaks forth is easy to be seen; and after the same manner the wind bloweth in every country.
verses.text: In like manner the lightning when it breaks forth is easy to be seen; and after the same manner the wind bloweth in every country.

verses.raw: And when Yahuah (God) commands the clouds to go over the whole world, they do as they are bidden.
verses.text: And when Yahuah commands the clouds to go over the whole world, they do as they are bidden.

verses.raw: And the fire sent from above to consume hills and woods doeth as it is commanded: but these are like to them neither in shew nor power.
verses.text: And the fire sent from above to consume hills and woods doeth as it is commanded: but these are like to them neither in shew nor power.

verses.raw: Wherefore it is neither to be supposed nor said that they are gods, seeing, they are able neither to judge causes, nor to do good to men.
verses.text: Wherefore it is neither to be supposed nor said that they are gods, seeing, they are able neither to judge causes, nor to do good to men.

verses.raw: Knowing therefore that they are no gods, fear them not,
verses.text: Knowing therefore that they are no gods, fear them not,

verses.raw: For they can neither curse nor bless kings:
verses.text: For they can neither curse nor bless kings:

verses.raw: Neither can they shew signs in the heavens among the heathen, nor shine as the sun, nor give light as the moon.
verses.text: Neither can they shew signs in the heavens among the heathen, nor shine as the sun, nor give light as the moon.

verses.raw: The beasts are better than they: for they can get under a cover and help themselves.
verses.text: The beasts are better than they: for they can get under a cover and help themselves.

verses.raw: It is then by no means manifest to us that they are gods: therefore fear them not.
verses.text: It is then by no means manifest to us that they are gods: therefore fear them not.

verses.raw: For as a scarecrow in a garden of cucumbers keepeth nothing: so are their gods of wood, and laid over with silver and gold.
verses.text: For as a scarecrow in a garden of cucumbers keepeth nothing: so are their gods of wood, and laid over with silver and gold.

verses.raw: And likewise their gods of wood, and laid over with silver and gold, are like to a white thorn in an orchard, that every bird sits upon; as also to a dead body, that is cast into the dark.
verses.text: And likewise their gods of wood, and laid over with silver and gold, are like to a white thorn in an orchard, that every bird sits upon; as also to a dead body, that is cast into the dark.

verses.raw: And you shall know them to be no gods by the bright purple that rotteth upon them: and they themselves afterward shall be eaten, and shall be a reproach in the country.
verses.text: And you shall know them to be no gods by the bright purple that rotteth upon them: and they themselves afterward shall be eaten, and shall be a reproach in the country.

verses.raw: Better therefore is the just man that has none idols: for he shall be far from reproach. ⸻
verses.text: Better therefore is the just man that has none idols: for he shall be far from reproach. ⸻

title: The Song of the Three Holy Children

verses.raw: And they walked in the midst of the fire, praising Yahuah (God), and blessing Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And they walked in the midst of the fire, praising Yahuah, and blessing Yahuah.

verses.raw: Then Azarias stood up, and prayed on this manner; and opening his mouth in the midst of the fire said,
verses.text: Then Azarias stood up, and prayed on this manner; and opening his mouth in the midst of the fire said,

verses.raw: Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God) of our fathers: your name is worthy to be praised and glorified for evermore:
verses.text: Blessed art you, O Yahuah of our fathers: your name is worthy to be praised and glorified for evermore:

verses.raw: For you are righteous in all the things that you have done to us: yes, true are all your works, your ways are right, and all your judgments truth.
verses.text: For you are righteous in all the things that you have done to us: yes, true are all your works, your ways are right, and all your judgments truth.

verses.raw: In all the things that you have brought upon us, and upon the holy city of our fathers, even Jerusalem, you have executed true judgment: for according to truth and judgment did you bring all these things upon us because of our sins.
verses.text: In all the things that you have brought upon us, and upon the holy city of our fathers, even Jerusalem, you have executed true judgment: for according to truth and judgment did you bring all these things upon us because of our sins.

verses.raw: For we have sinned and committed iniquity, departing from you.
verses.text: For we have sinned and committed iniquity, departing from you.

verses.raw: In all things have we trespassed, and not obeyed your commandments, nor kept them, neither done as you have commanded us, that it might go well with us.
verses.text: In all things have we trespassed, and not obeyed your commandments, nor kept them, neither done as you have commanded us, that it might go well with us.

verses.raw: Wherefore all that you have brought upon us, and every thing that you have done to us, you have done in true judgment.
verses.text: Wherefore all that you have brought upon us, and every thing that you have done to us, you have done in true judgment.

verses.raw: And you did deliver us into the hands of lawless enemies, most hateful forsakers of Yahuah (God), and to an unjust king, and the most wicked in all the world.
verses.text: And you did deliver us into the hands of lawless enemies, most hateful forsakers of Yahuah, and to an unjust king, and the most wicked in all the world.

verses.raw: And now we cannot open our mouths, we are become a shame and reproach to your servants; and to them that worship you.
verses.text: And now we cannot open our mouths, we are become a shame and reproach to your servants; and to them that worship you.

verses.raw: Yet deliver us not up wholly, for your name’s sake, neither disannul you your covenant:
verses.text: Yet deliver us not up wholly, for your name’s sake, neither disannul you your covenant:

verses.raw: And cause not your mercy to depart from us, for your beloved Abraham’s sake, for your servant Issac’s sake, and for your holy Yashar'el (Israel)’s sake;
verses.text: And cause not your mercy to depart from us, for your beloved Abraham’s sake, for your servant Issac’s sake, and for your holy Yashar'el’s sake;

verses.raw: To whom you have spoken and promised, that you would multiply their seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand that lieth upon the seashore.
verses.text: To whom you have spoken and promised, that you would multiply their seed as the stars of heaven, and as the sand that lieth upon the seashore.

verses.raw: For we, O Yahuah (God), are become less than any nation, and be kept under this day in all the world because of our sins.
verses.text: For we, O Yahuah, are become less than any nation, and be kept under this day in all the world because of our sins.

verses.raw: Neither is there at this time prince, or prophet, or leader, or burnt offering, or sacrifice, or oblation, or incense, or place to sacrifice before you, and to find mercy.
verses.text: Neither is there at this time prince, or prophet, or leader, or burnt offering, or sacrifice, or oblation, or incense, or place to sacrifice before you, and to find mercy.

verses.raw: Nevertheless in a contrite heart and an humble spirit let us be accepted.
verses.text: Nevertheless in a contrite heart and an humble spirit let us be accepted.

verses.raw: Like as in the burnt offerings of rams and bullocks, and like as in ten thousands of fat lambs: so let our sacrifice be in your sight this day, and grant that we may wholly go after you: for they shall not be confounded that put their trust in you.
verses.text: Like as in the burnt offerings of rams and bullocks, and like as in ten thousands of fat lambs: so let our sacrifice be in your sight this day, and grant that we may wholly go after you: for they shall not be confounded that put their trust in you.

verses.raw: And now we follow you with all our heart, we fear you, and seek your face.
verses.text: And now we follow you with all our heart, we fear you, and seek your face.

verses.raw: Put us not to shame: but deal with us after your lovingkindness, and according to the multitude of your mercies.
verses.text: Put us not to shame: but deal with us after your lovingkindness, and according to the multitude of your mercies.

verses.raw: Deliver us also according to your marvellous works, and give glory to your name, O Yahuah (God): and let all them that do your servants hurt be ashamed;
verses.text: Deliver us also according to your marvellous works, and give glory to your name, O Yahuah: and let all them that do your servants hurt be ashamed;

verses.raw: And let them be confounded in all their power and might, and let their strength be broken;
verses.text: And let them be confounded in all their power and might, and let their strength be broken;

verses.raw: And let them know that you are Yahuah (God), the only Yahuah (God), and glorious over the whole world.
verses.text: And let them know that you are Yahuah, the only Yahuah, and glorious over the whole world.

verses.raw: And the king’s servants, that put them in, ceased not to make the oven hot with rosin, pitch, tow, and small wood;
verses.text: And the king’s servants, that put them in, ceased not to make the oven hot with rosin, pitch, tow, and small wood;

verses.raw: So that the flame streamed forth above the furnace forty and nine cubits.
verses.text: So that the flame streamed forth above the furnace forty and nine cubits.

verses.raw: And it passed through, and burned those Chaldeans it found about the furnace.
verses.text: And it passed through, and burned those Chaldeans it found about the furnace.

verses.raw: But the angel of Yahuah (God) came down into the oven together with Azarias and his fellows, and struck the flame of the fire out of the oven;
verses.text: But the angel of Yahuah came down into the oven together with Azarias and his fellows, and struck the flame of the fire out of the oven;

verses.raw: And made the midst of the furnace as it had been a moist whistling wind, so that the fire touched them not at all, neither hurt nor troubled them.
verses.text: And made the midst of the furnace as it had been a moist whistling wind, so that the fire touched them not at all, neither hurt nor troubled them.

verses.raw: Then the three, as out of one mouth, praised, glorified, and blessed, Yahuah (God) in the furnace, saying,
verses.text: Then the three, as out of one mouth, praised, glorified, and blessed, Yahuah in the furnace, saying,

verses.raw: Blessed art you, O Yahuah (God) of our fathers: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.
verses.text: Blessed art you, O Yahuah of our fathers: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.

verses.raw: And blessed is your glorious and holy name: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.
verses.text: And blessed is your glorious and holy name: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.

verses.raw: Blessed art you in the temple of yours holy glory: and to be praised and glorified above all for ever.
verses.text: Blessed art you in the temple of yours holy glory: and to be praised and glorified above all for ever.

verses.raw: Blessed art you that beholdest the depths, and sittest upon the cherubims: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.
verses.text: Blessed art you that beholdest the depths, and sittest upon the cherubims: and to be praised and exalted above all for ever.

verses.raw: Blessed art you on the glorious throne of your kingdom: and to be praised and glorified above all for ever.
verses.text: Blessed art you on the glorious throne of your kingdom: and to be praised and glorified above all for ever.

verses.raw: Blessed art you in the firmament of heaven: and above all to be praised and glorified for ever.
verses.text: Blessed art you in the firmament of heaven: and above all to be praised and glorified for ever.

verses.raw: O all you works of Yahuah (God), bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever,
verses.text: O all you works of Yahuah, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever,

verses.text: O you heavens, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.text: O you angels of Yahuah, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.text: O all you waters that be above the heaven, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.text: O all you winds, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever,

verses.text: O you fire and heat, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.text: O you frost and snow, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.text: O let the earth bless Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you mountains and little hills, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you mountains and little hills, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O all you things that grow in the earth, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O all you things that grow in the earth, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you mountains, bless you Yahuah (God): Praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you mountains, bless you Yahuah: Praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you seas and rivers, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you seas and rivers, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you whales, and all that move in the waters, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you whales, and all that move in the waters, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O all you fowls of the air, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O all you fowls of the air, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O all you beasts and cattle, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O all you beasts and cattle, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you children of men, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you children of men, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O Yashar'el (Israel), bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O Yashar'el, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you priests of Yahuah (God), bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you priests of Yahuah, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you servants of Yahuah (God), bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you servants of Yahuah, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you spirits and souls of the righteous, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you spirits and souls of the righteous, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O you holy and humble men of heart, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever.
verses.text: O you holy and humble men of heart, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

verses.raw: O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever: for he has delivered us from hell, and saved us from the hand of death, and delivered us out of the midst of the furnace and burning flame: even out of the midst of the fire has he delivered us.
verses.text: O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless you Yahuah: praise and exalt him above all for ever: for he has delivered us from hell, and saved us from the hand of death, and delivered us out of the midst of the furnace and burning flame: even out of the midst of the fire has he delivered us.

verses.raw: O give thanks to Yahuah (God), because he is gracious: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.text: O give thanks to Yahuah, because he is gracious: for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.raw: O all you that worship Yahuah (God), bless Yahuah (God) of gods, praise him, and give him thanks: for his mercy endureth for ever. ⸻
verses.text: O all you that worship Yahuah, bless Yahuah of gods, praise him, and give him thanks: for his mercy endureth for ever. ⸻

verses.raw: There dwelt a man in Babylon, called Joacim:
verses.text: There dwelt a man in Babylon, called Joacim:

verses.raw: And he took a wife, whose name was Susanna, the daughter of Chelcias, a very fair woman, and one that feared Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And he took a wife, whose name was Susanna, the daughter of Chelcias, a very fair woman, and one that feared Yahuah.

verses.raw: Her parents also were righteous, and taught their daughter according to the law of Moses.
verses.text: Her parents also were righteous, and taught their daughter according to the law of Moses.

verses.raw: Now Joacim was a great rich man, and had a fair garden joining to his house: and to him resorted the Yahudim (Jews); because he was more honourable than all others.
verses.text: Now Joacim was a great rich man, and had a fair garden joining to his house: and to him resorted the Yahudim; because he was more honourable than all others.

verses.raw: The same year were appointed two of the ancients of the people to be judges, such as Yahuah (God) spoke of, that wickedness came from Babylon from ancient judges, who seemed to govern the people.
verses.text: The same year were appointed two of the ancients of the people to be judges, such as Yahuah spoke of, that wickedness came from Babylon from ancient judges, who seemed to govern the people.

verses.raw: These kept much at Joacim’s house: and all that had any suits in law came to them.
verses.text: These kept much at Joacim’s house: and all that had any suits in law came to them.

verses.raw: Now when the people departed away at noon, Susanna went into her husband’s garden to walk.
verses.text: Now when the people departed away at noon, Susanna went into her husband’s garden to walk.

verses.raw: And the two elders saw her going in every day, and walking; so that their lust was inflamed toward her.
verses.text: And the two elders saw her going in every day, and walking; so that their lust was inflamed toward her.

verses.raw: And they perverted their own mind, and turned away their eyes, that they might not look to heaven, nor remember just judgments.
verses.text: And they perverted their own mind, and turned away their eyes, that they might not look to heaven, nor remember just judgments.

verses.raw: And albeit they both were wounded with her love, yet durst not one shew another his grief.
verses.text: And albeit they both were wounded with her love, yet durst not one shew another his grief.

verses.raw: For they were ashamed to declare their lust, that they desired to have to do with her.
verses.text: For they were ashamed to declare their lust, that they desired to have to do with her.

verses.raw: Yet they watched diligently from day to day to see her.
verses.text: Yet they watched diligently from day to day to see her.

verses.raw: And the one said to the other, Let us now go home: for it is dinner time.
verses.text: And the one said to the other, Let us now go home: for it is dinner time.

verses.raw: So when they were gone out, they parted the one from the other, and turning back again they came to the same place; and after that they had asked one another the cause, they acknowledged their lust: then appointed they a time both together, when they might find her alone.
verses.text: So when they were gone out, they parted the one from the other, and turning back again they came to the same place; and after that they had asked one another the cause, they acknowledged their lust: then appointed they a time both together, when they might find her alone.

verses.raw: And it fell out, as they watched a fit time, she went in as before with two maids only, and she was desirous to wash herself in the garden: for it was hot.
verses.text: And it fell out, as they watched a fit time, she went in as before with two maids only, and she was desirous to wash herself in the garden: for it was hot.

verses.raw: And there was no body there save the two elders, that had hid themselves, and watched her.
verses.text: And there was no body there save the two elders, that had hid themselves, and watched her.

verses.raw: Then she said to her maids, Bring me oil and washing balls, and shut the garden doors, that I may wash me.
verses.text: Then she said to her maids, Bring me oil and washing balls, and shut the garden doors, that I may wash me.

verses.raw: And they did as she told them, and shut the garden doors, and went out themselves at privy doors to fetch the things that she had commanded them: but they saw not the elders, because they were hid.
verses.text: And they did as she told them, and shut the garden doors, and went out themselves at privy doors to fetch the things that she had commanded them: but they saw not the elders, because they were hid.

verses.raw: Now when the maids were gone forth, the two elders rose up, and ran to her, saying,
verses.text: Now when the maids were gone forth, the two elders rose up, and ran to her, saying,

verses.raw: Behold, the garden doors are shut, that no man can see us, and we are in love with you; therefore consent to us, and lie with us.
verses.text: Behold, the garden doors are shut, that no man can see us, and we are in love with you; therefore consent to us, and lie with us.

verses.raw: If you will not, we will bear witness against you, that a young man was with you: and therefore you did send away your maids from you.
verses.text: If you will not, we will bear witness against you, that a young man was with you: and therefore you did send away your maids from you.

verses.raw: Then Susanna sighed, and said, I am straitened on every side: for if I do this thing, it is death to me: and if I do it not I cannot escape your hands.
verses.text: Then Susanna sighed, and said, I am straitened on every side: for if I do this thing, it is death to me: and if I do it not I cannot escape your hands.

verses.raw: It is better for me to fall into your hands, and not do it, than to sin in the sight of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: It is better for me to fall into your hands, and not do it, than to sin in the sight of Yahuah.

verses.raw: With that Susanna cried with a loud voice: and the two elders cried out against her.
verses.text: With that Susanna cried with a loud voice: and the two elders cried out against her.

verses.raw: Then ran the one, and opened the garden door.
verses.text: Then ran the one, and opened the garden door.

verses.raw: So when the servants of the house heard the cry in the garden, they rushed in at the privy door, to see what was done to her.
verses.text: So when the servants of the house heard the cry in the garden, they rushed in at the privy door, to see what was done to her.

verses.raw: But when the elders had declared their matter, the servants were greatly ashamed: for there was never such a report made of Susanna.
verses.text: But when the elders had declared their matter, the servants were greatly ashamed: for there was never such a report made of Susanna.

verses.raw: And it came to pass the next day, when the people were assembled to her husband Joacim, the two elders came also full of mischievous imagination against Susanna to put her to death;
verses.text: And it came to pass the next day, when the people were assembled to her husband Joacim, the two elders came also full of mischievous imagination against Susanna to put her to death;

verses.raw: And said before the people, Send for Susanna, the daughter of Chelcias, Joacim’s wife. And so they sent.
verses.text: And said before the people, Send for Susanna, the daughter of Chelcias, Joacim’s wife. And so they sent.

verses.raw: So she came with her father and mother, her children, and all her kindred.
verses.text: So she came with her father and mother, her children, and all her kindred.

verses.raw: Now Susanna was a very delicate woman, and beauteous to behold.
verses.text: Now Susanna was a very delicate woman, and beauteous to behold.

verses.raw: And these wicked men commanded to uncover her face, (for she was covered) that they might be filled with her beauty.
verses.text: And these wicked men commanded to uncover her face, (for she was covered) that they might be filled with her beauty.

verses.raw: Therefore her friends and all that saw her wept.
verses.text: Therefore her friends and all that saw her wept.

verses.raw: Then the two elders stood up in the midst of the people, and laid their hands upon her head.
verses.text: Then the two elders stood up in the midst of the people, and laid their hands upon her head.

verses.raw: And she weeping looked up toward heaven: for her heart trusted in Yahuah (God).
verses.text: And she weeping looked up toward heaven: for her heart trusted in Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the elders said, As we walked in the garden alone, this woman came in with two maids, and shut the garden doors, and sent the maids away.
verses.text: And the elders said, As we walked in the garden alone, this woman came in with two maids, and shut the garden doors, and sent the maids away.

verses.raw: Then a young man, who there was hid, came to her, and lay with her.
verses.text: Then a young man, who there was hid, came to her, and lay with her.

verses.raw: Then we that stood in a corner of the garden, seeing this wickedness, ran to them.
verses.text: Then we that stood in a corner of the garden, seeing this wickedness, ran to them.

verses.raw: And when we saw them together, the man we could not hold: for he was stronger than we, and opened the door, and leaped out.
verses.text: And when we saw them together, the man we could not hold: for he was stronger than we, and opened the door, and leaped out.

verses.raw: But having taken this woman, we asked who the young man was, but she would not tell us: these things do we testify.
verses.text: But having taken this woman, we asked who the young man was, but she would not tell us: these things do we testify.

verses.raw: Then the assembly believed them as those that were the elders and judges of the people: so they condemned her to death.
verses.text: Then the assembly believed them as those that were the elders and judges of the people: so they condemned her to death.

verses.raw: Then Susanna cried out with a loud voice, and said, O everlasting Yahuah (God), that knowest the secrets, and knowest all things before they be:
verses.text: Then Susanna cried out with a loud voice, and said, O everlasting Yahuah, that knowest the secrets, and knowest all things before they be:

verses.raw: You know that they have borne false witness against me, and, behold, I must die; whereas I never did such things as these men have maliciously invented against me.
verses.text: You know that they have borne false witness against me, and, behold, I must die; whereas I never did such things as these men have maliciously invented against me.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (God) heard her voice.
verses.text: And Yahuah heard her voice.

verses.raw: Therefore when she was led to be put to death, Yahuah (God) raised up the holy spirit of a young youth whose name was Daniel:
verses.text: Therefore when she was led to be put to death, Yahuah raised up the holy spirit of a young youth whose name was Daniel:

verses.raw: Who cried with a loud voice, I am clear from the blood of this woman.
verses.text: Who cried with a loud voice, I am clear from the blood of this woman.

verses.raw: Then all the people turned them toward him, and said, What mean these words that you have spoken?
verses.text: Then all the people turned them toward him, and said, What mean these words that you have spoken?

verses.raw: So he standing in the midst of them said, Are you such fools, you sons of Yashar'el (Israel), that without examination or knowledge of the truth you have condemned a daughter of Yashar'el (Israel)?
verses.text: So he standing in the midst of them said, Are you such fools, you sons of Yashar'el, that without examination or knowledge of the truth you have condemned a daughter of Yashar'el?

verses.raw: Return again to the place of judgment: for they have borne false witness against her.
verses.text: Return again to the place of judgment: for they have borne false witness against her.

verses.raw: Wherefore all the people turned again in haste, and the elders said to him, Come, sit down among us, and shew it us, seeing Yahuah (God) has given you the honour of an elder.
verses.text: Wherefore all the people turned again in haste, and the elders said to him, Come, sit down among us, and shew it us, seeing Yahuah has given you the honour of an elder.

verses.raw: Then said Daniel to them, Put these two aside one far from another, and I will examine them.
verses.text: Then said Daniel to them, Put these two aside one far from another, and I will examine them.

verses.raw: So when they were put asunder one from another, he called one of them, and said to him, O you that are waxen old in wickedness, now your sins which you have committed aforetime are come to light.
verses.text: So when they were put asunder one from another, he called one of them, and said to him, O you that are waxen old in wickedness, now your sins which you have committed aforetime are come to light.

verses.raw: For you have pronounced false judgment and have condemned the innocent and have let the guilty go free; albeit Yahuah (God) says, The innocent and righteous shall you not slay.
verses.text: For you have pronounced false judgment and have condemned the innocent and have let the guilty go free; albeit Yahuah says, The innocent and righteous shall you not slay.

verses.raw: Now then, if you have seen her, tell me, Under what tree sawest you them companying together? Who answered, Under a mastick tree.
verses.text: Now then, if you have seen her, tell me, Under what tree sawest you them companying together? Who answered, Under a mastick tree.
