verses.raw: And Daniel said, Very well; you have lied against your own head; for even now the angel of Yahuah (God) has received the sentence of Yahuah (God) to cut you in two.
verses.text: And Daniel said, Very well; you have lied against your own head; for even now the angel of Yahuah has received the sentence of Yahuah to cut you in two.

verses.raw: So he put him aside, and commanded to bring the other, and said to him, O you seed of Chanaan, and not of Juda, beauty has deceived you, and lust has perverted yours heart.
verses.text: So he put him aside, and commanded to bring the other, and said to him, O you seed of Chanaan, and not of Juda, beauty has deceived you, and lust has perverted yours heart.

verses.raw: Thus have you dealt with the daughters of Yashar'el (Israel), and they for fear companied with you: but the daughter of Juda would not abide your wickedness.
verses.text: Thus have you dealt with the daughters of Yashar'el, and they for fear companied with you: but the daughter of Juda would not abide your wickedness.

verses.raw: Now therefore tell me, Under what tree did you take them companying together? Who answered, Under an holm tree.
verses.text: Now therefore tell me, Under what tree did you take them companying together? Who answered, Under an holm tree.

verses.raw: Then said Daniel to him, Well; you have also lied against your own head: for the angel of Yahuah (God) waiteth with the sword to cut you in two, that he may destroy you.
verses.text: Then said Daniel to him, Well; you have also lied against your own head: for the angel of Yahuah waiteth with the sword to cut you in two, that he may destroy you.

verses.raw: With that all the assembly cried out with a loud voice, and praised Yahuah (God), who saves them that trust in him.
verses.text: With that all the assembly cried out with a loud voice, and praised Yahuah, who saves them that trust in him.

verses.raw: And they arose against the two elders, for Daniel had convicted them of false witness by their own mouth:
verses.text: And they arose against the two elders, for Daniel had convicted them of false witness by their own mouth:

verses.raw: And according to the law of Moses they did to them in such sort as they maliciously intended to do to their neighbour: and they put them to death. Thus the innocent blood was saved the same day.
verses.text: And according to the law of Moses they did to them in such sort as they maliciously intended to do to their neighbour: and they put them to death. Thus the innocent blood was saved the same day.

verses.raw: Therefore Chelcias and his wife praised Yahuah (God) for their daughter Susanna, with Joacim her husband, and all the kindred, because there was no dishonesty found in her.
verses.text: Therefore Chelcias and his wife praised Yahuah for their daughter Susanna, with Joacim her husband, and all the kindred, because there was no dishonesty found in her.

verses.raw: From that day forth was Daniel had in great reputation in the sight of the people. ⸻
verses.text: From that day forth was Daniel had in great reputation in the sight of the people. ⸻

verses.raw: And king Astyages was gathered to his fathers, and Cyrus of Persia received his kingdom.
verses.text: And king Astyages was gathered to his fathers, and Cyrus of Persia received his kingdom.

verses.raw: And Daniel conversed with the king, and was honoured above all his friends.
verses.text: And Daniel conversed with the king, and was honoured above all his friends.

verses.raw: Now the Babylons had an idol, called Bel, and there were spent upon him every day twelve great measures of fine flour, and forty sheep, and six vessels of wine.
verses.text: Now the Babylons had an idol, called Bel, and there were spent upon him every day twelve great measures of fine flour, and forty sheep, and six vessels of wine.

verses.raw: And the king worshipped it and went daily to adore it: but Daniel worshipped his own Elohim (God). And the king said to him, Why do not you worship Bel?
verses.text: And the king worshipped it and went daily to adore it: but Daniel worshipped his own Elohim. And the king said to him, Why do not you worship Bel?

verses.raw: Who answered and said, Because I may not worship idols made with hands, but the living Yahuah (God), who has created the heaven and the earth, and has sovereignty over all flesh.
verses.text: Who answered and said, Because I may not worship idols made with hands, but the living Yahuah, who has created the heaven and the earth, and has sovereignty over all flesh.

verses.raw: Then said the king to him, Thinkest you not that Bel is a living Yahuah (God)? seest you not how much he eats and drinks every day?
verses.text: Then said the king to him, Thinkest you not that Bel is a living Yahuah? seest you not how much he eats and drinks every day?

verses.raw: Then Daniel smiled, and said, O king, be not deceived: for this is but clay within, and brass without, and did never eat or drink any thing.
verses.text: Then Daniel smiled, and said, O king, be not deceived: for this is but clay within, and brass without, and did never eat or drink any thing.

verses.raw: So the king was wroth, and called for his priests, and said to them, If you tell me not who this is that devoureth these expences, you shall die.
verses.text: So the king was wroth, and called for his priests, and said to them, If you tell me not who this is that devoureth these expences, you shall die.

verses.raw: But if you can certify me that Bel devoureth them, then Daniel shall die: for he has spoken blasphemy against Bel. And Daniel said to the king, Let it be according to your word.
verses.text: But if you can certify me that Bel devoureth them, then Daniel shall die: for he has spoken blasphemy against Bel. And Daniel said to the king, Let it be according to your word.

verses.raw: Now the priests of Bel were threescore and ten, beside their wives and children. And the king went with Daniel into the temple of Bel.
verses.text: Now the priests of Bel were threescore and ten, beside their wives and children. And the king went with Daniel into the temple of Bel.

verses.raw: So Bel’s priests said, Lo, we go out: but you, O king, set on the meat, and make ready the wine, and shut the door fast and seal it with your own signet;
verses.text: So Bel’s priests said, Lo, we go out: but you, O king, set on the meat, and make ready the wine, and shut the door fast and seal it with your own signet;

verses.raw: And to morrow when you come in, if you findest not that Bel has eaten up all, we will suffer death: or else Daniel, that speaks falsely against us.
verses.text: And to morrow when you come in, if you findest not that Bel has eaten up all, we will suffer death: or else Daniel, that speaks falsely against us.

verses.raw: And they little regarded it: for under the table they had made a privy entrance, by which they entered in continually, and consumed those things.
verses.text: And they little regarded it: for under the table they had made a privy entrance, by which they entered in continually, and consumed those things.

verses.raw: So when they were gone forth, the king set meats before Bel. Now Daniel had commanded his servants to bring ashes, and those they strewed throughout all the temple in the presence of the king alone: then went they out, and shut the door, and sealed it with the king’s signet, and so departed.
verses.text: So when they were gone forth, the king set meats before Bel. Now Daniel had commanded his servants to bring ashes, and those they strewed throughout all the temple in the presence of the king alone: then went they out, and shut the door, and sealed it with the king’s signet, and so departed.

verses.raw: Now in the night came the priests with their wives and children, as they were wont to do, and did eat and drink up all.
verses.text: Now in the night came the priests with their wives and children, as they were wont to do, and did eat and drink up all.

verses.raw: In the morning betime the king arose, and Daniel with him.
verses.text: In the morning betime the king arose, and Daniel with him.

verses.raw: And the king said, Daniel, are the seals whole? And he said, Yea, O king, they be whole.
verses.text: And the king said, Daniel, are the seals whole? And he said, Yea, O king, they be whole.

verses.raw: And as soon as he had opened the door, the king looked upon the table, and cried with a loud voice, Great art you, O Bel, and with you is no deceit at all.
verses.text: And as soon as he had opened the door, the king looked upon the table, and cried with a loud voice, Great art you, O Bel, and with you is no deceit at all.

verses.raw: Then laughed Daniel, and held the king that he should not go in, and said, Behold now the pavement, and mark well whose footsteps are these.
verses.text: Then laughed Daniel, and held the king that he should not go in, and said, Behold now the pavement, and mark well whose footsteps are these.

verses.raw: And the king said, I see the footsteps of men, women, and children. And then the king was angry,
verses.text: And the king said, I see the footsteps of men, women, and children. And then the king was angry,

verses.raw: And took the priests with their wives and children, who shewed him the privy doors, where they came in, and consumed such things as were upon the table.
verses.text: And took the priests with their wives and children, who shewed him the privy doors, where they came in, and consumed such things as were upon the table.

verses.raw: Therefore the king slew them, and delivered Bel into Daniel’s power, who destroyed him and his temple.
verses.text: Therefore the king slew them, and delivered Bel into Daniel’s power, who destroyed him and his temple.

verses.raw: And in that same place there was a great dragon, which they of Babylon worshipped.
verses.text: And in that same place there was a great dragon, which they of Babylon worshipped.

verses.raw: And the king said to Daniel, Will you also say that this is of brass? lo, he lives, he eats and drinks; you can not say that he is no living god: therefore worship him.
verses.text: And the king said to Daniel, Will you also say that this is of brass? lo, he lives, he eats and drinks; you can not say that he is no living god: therefore worship him.

verses.raw: Then said Daniel to the king, I will worship Yahuah (God), my Elohim (God): for he is the living Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Then said Daniel to the king, I will worship Yahuah, my Elohim: for he is the living Yahuah.

verses.raw: But give me leave, O king, and I shall slay this dragon without sword or staff. The king said, I give you leave.
verses.text: But give me leave, O king, and I shall slay this dragon without sword or staff. The king said, I give you leave.

verses.raw: Then Daniel took pitch, and fat, and hair, and did seethe them together, and made lumps thereof: this he put in the dragon’s mouth, and so the dragon burst in sunder: and Daniel said, Lo, these are the gods you worship.
verses.text: Then Daniel took pitch, and fat, and hair, and did seethe them together, and made lumps thereof: this he put in the dragon’s mouth, and so the dragon burst in sunder: and Daniel said, Lo, these are the gods you worship.

verses.raw: When they of Babylon heard that, they took great indignation, and conspired against the king, saying, The king is become a Yahudi (Jew), and he has destroyed Bel, he has slain the dragon, and put the priests to death.
verses.text: When they of Babylon heard that, they took great indignation, and conspired against the king, saying, The king is become a Yahudi, and he has destroyed Bel, he has slain the dragon, and put the priests to death.

verses.raw: So they came to the king, and said, Deliver us Daniel, or else we will destroy you and yours house.
verses.text: So they came to the king, and said, Deliver us Daniel, or else we will destroy you and yours house.

verses.raw: Now when the king saw that they pressed him sore, being constrained, he delivered Daniel to them:
verses.text: Now when the king saw that they pressed him sore, being constrained, he delivered Daniel to them:

verses.raw: Who cast him into the lions’ den: where he was six days.
verses.text: Who cast him into the lions’ den: where he was six days.

verses.raw: And in the den there were seven lions, and they had given them every day two carcases, and two sheep: which then were not given to them, to the intent they might devour Daniel.
verses.text: And in the den there were seven lions, and they had given them every day two carcases, and two sheep: which then were not given to them, to the intent they might devour Daniel.

verses.raw: Now there was in Jewry a prophet, called Habbacuc, who had made pottage, and had broken bread in a bowl, and was going into the field, for to bring it to the reapers.
verses.text: Now there was in Jewry a prophet, called Habbacuc, who had made pottage, and had broken bread in a bowl, and was going into the field, for to bring it to the reapers.

verses.raw: But the angel of Yahuah (God) said to Habbacuc, Go, carry the dinner that you have into Babylon to Daniel, who is in the lions’ den.
verses.text: But the angel of Yahuah said to Habbacuc, Go, carry the dinner that you have into Babylon to Daniel, who is in the lions’ den.

verses.raw: And Habbacuc said, Yahuah (God), I never saw Babylon; neither do I know where the den is.
verses.text: And Habbacuc said, Yahuah, I never saw Babylon; neither do I know where the den is.

verses.raw: Then the angel of Yahuah (God) took him by the crown, and bare him by the hair of his head, and through the vehemency of his spirit set him in Babylon over the den.
verses.text: Then the angel of Yahuah took him by the crown, and bare him by the hair of his head, and through the vehemency of his spirit set him in Babylon over the den.

verses.raw: And Habbacuc cried, saying, O Daniel, Daniel, take the dinner which Yahuah (God) has sent you.
verses.text: And Habbacuc cried, saying, O Daniel, Daniel, take the dinner which Yahuah has sent you.

verses.raw: And Daniel said, You have remembered me, O Yahuah (God): neither have you forsaken them that seek you and love you.
verses.text: And Daniel said, You have remembered me, O Yahuah: neither have you forsaken them that seek you and love you.

verses.raw: So Daniel arose, and did eat: and the angel of Yahuah (God) set Habbacuc in his own place again immediately.
verses.text: So Daniel arose, and did eat: and the angel of Yahuah set Habbacuc in his own place again immediately.

verses.raw: Upon the seventh day the king went to bewail Daniel: and when he came to the den, he looked in, and behold, Daniel was sitting.
verses.text: Upon the seventh day the king went to bewail Daniel: and when he came to the den, he looked in, and behold, Daniel was sitting.

verses.raw: Then cried the king with a loud voice, saying, Great art you, O Yahuah (God) of Daniel, and there is none other beside you.
verses.text: Then cried the king with a loud voice, saying, Great art you, O Yahuah of Daniel, and there is none other beside you.

verses.raw: And he drew him out, and cast those that were the cause of his destruction into the den: and they were devoured in a moment before his face. ⸻
verses.text: And he drew him out, and cast those that were the cause of his destruction into the den: and they were devoured in a moment before his face. ⸻

verses.raw: O Yahuah (God), Almighty Yahuah (God) of our fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and of their righteous seed;
verses.text: O Yahuah, Almighty Yahuah of our fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and of their righteous seed;

verses.raw: who have made heaven and earth, with all the ornament thereof;
verses.text: who have made heaven and earth, with all the ornament thereof;

verses.raw: who have bound the sea by the word of your commandment; who have shut up the deep, and sealed it by your terrible and glorious name;
verses.text: who have bound the sea by the word of your commandment; who have shut up the deep, and sealed it by your terrible and glorious name;

verses.raw: whom all men fear, and tremble before your power;
verses.text: whom all men fear, and tremble before your power;

verses.raw: for the majesty of your glory cannot be borne, and your angry threatening toward sinners is importable:
verses.text: for the majesty of your glory cannot be borne, and your angry threatening toward sinners is importable:

verses.raw: but your merciful promise is unmeasurable and unsearchable;
verses.text: but your merciful promise is unmeasurable and unsearchable;

verses.raw: for you are the most high Yahuah (God), of great compassion, longsuffering, very merciful, and repentest of the evils of men. You, O Yahuah (God), according to your great goodness have promised repentance and forgiveness to them that have sinned against you: and of your infinite mercies have appointed repentance to sinners, that they may be saved.
verses.text: for you are the most high Yahuah, of great compassion, longsuffering, very merciful, and repentest of the evils of men. You, O Yahuah, according to your great goodness have promised repentance and forgiveness to them that have sinned against you: and of your infinite mercies have appointed repentance to sinners, that they may be saved.

verses.raw: You therefore, O Yahuah (God), that are Yahuah (God) of the just, have not appointed repentance to the just, as to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, which have not sinned against you; but you have appointed repentance to me that am a sinner:
verses.text: You therefore, O Yahuah, that are Yahuah of the just, have not appointed repentance to the just, as to Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, which have not sinned against you; but you have appointed repentance to me that am a sinner:

verses.raw: for I have sinned above the number of the sands of the sea. My transgressions, O Yahuah (God), are multiplied: my transgressions are multiplied, and I am not worthy to behold and see the height of heaven for the multitude of my iniquities.
verses.text: for I have sinned above the number of the sands of the sea. My transgressions, O Yahuah, are multiplied: my transgressions are multiplied, and I am not worthy to behold and see the height of heaven for the multitude of my iniquities.

verses.raw: I am bowed down with many iron bands, that I cannot lift up my head, neither have any release: for I have provoked your wrath, and done evil before you: I did not your will, neither kept I your commandments: I have set up abominations, and have multiplied offences.
verses.text: I am bowed down with many iron bands, that I cannot lift up my head, neither have any release: for I have provoked your wrath, and done evil before you: I did not your will, neither kept I your commandments: I have set up abominations, and have multiplied offences.

verses.raw: Now therefore I bow the knee of my heart, beseeching you of grace.
verses.text: Now therefore I bow the knee of my heart, beseeching you of grace.

verses.raw: I have sinned, O Yahuah (God), I have sinned, and I acknowledge my iniquities:
verses.text: I have sinned, O Yahuah, I have sinned, and I acknowledge my iniquities:

verses.raw: wherefore, I humbly beseech you, forgive me, O Yahuah (God), forgive me, and destroy me not with my iniquites. Be not angry with me for ever, by reserving evil for me; neither condemn me to the lower parts of the earth. For you are Yahuah (God), even Yahuah (God) of them that repent;
verses.text: wherefore, I humbly beseech you, forgive me, O Yahuah, forgive me, and destroy me not with my iniquites. Be not angry with me for ever, by reserving evil for me; neither condemn me to the lower parts of the earth. For you are Yahuah, even Yahuah of them that repent;

verses.raw: and in me you will shew all your goodness: for you will save me, that am unworthy, according to your great mercy.
verses.text: and in me you will shew all your goodness: for you will save me, that am unworthy, according to your great mercy.

verses.raw: Therefore I will praise you for ever all the days of my life: for all the powers of the heavens do praise you, and yours is the glory for ever and ever. Amen. ⸻
verses.text: Therefore I will praise you for ever all the days of my life: for all the powers of the heavens do praise you, and yours is the glory for ever and ever. Amen. ⸻

verses.raw: And it happened, after that Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had struck Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece,
verses.text: And it happened, after that Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had struck Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece,

verses.raw: And made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth,
verses.text: And made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth,

verses.raw: And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him; whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.
verses.text: And went through to the ends of the earth, and took spoils of many nations, insomuch that the earth was quiet before him; whereupon he was exalted and his heart was lifted up.

verses.raw: And he gathered a mighty strong host and ruled over countries, and nations, and kings, who became tributaries to him.
verses.text: And he gathered a mighty strong host and ruled over countries, and nations, and kings, who became tributaries to him.

verses.raw: And after these things he fell sick, and perceived that he should die.
verses.text: And after these things he fell sick, and perceived that he should die.

verses.raw: Wherefore he called his servants, such as were honourable, and had been brought up with him from his youth, and parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive.
verses.text: Wherefore he called his servants, such as were honourable, and had been brought up with him from his youth, and parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive.

verses.raw: So Alexander reigned twelve years, and then died.
verses.text: So Alexander reigned twelve years, and then died.

verses.raw: And his servants bare rule every one in his place.
verses.text: And his servants bare rule every one in his place.

verses.raw: And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.
verses.text: And after his death they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.

verses.raw: And there came out of them a wicked root Antiochus surnamed Epiphanes, son of Antiochus the king, who had been an hostage at Rome, and he reigned in the hundred and thirty and seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks.
verses.text: And there came out of them a wicked root Antiochus surnamed Epiphanes, son of Antiochus the king, who had been an hostage at Rome, and he reigned in the hundred and thirty and seventh year of the kingdom of the Greeks.

verses.raw: In those days went there out of Yashar'el (Israel) wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us: for since we departed from them we have had much sorrow.
verses.text: In those days went there out of Yashar'el wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us: for since we departed from them we have had much sorrow.

verses.raw: So this device pleased them well.
verses.text: So this device pleased them well.

verses.raw: Then certain of the people were so forward in this, that they went to the king, who gave them licence to do after the ordinances of the heathen:
verses.text: Then certain of the people were so forward in this, that they went to the king, who gave them licence to do after the ordinances of the heathen:

verses.raw: Whereupon they built a place of exercise at Jerusalem according to the customs of the heathen:
verses.text: Whereupon they built a place of exercise at Jerusalem according to the customs of the heathen:

verses.raw: And made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant, and joined themselves to the heathen, and were sold to do mischief.
verses.text: And made themselves uncircumcised, and forsook the holy covenant, and joined themselves to the heathen, and were sold to do mischief.

verses.raw: Now when the kingdom was established before Antiochus, he thought to reign over Egypt that he might have the dominion of two realms.
verses.text: Now when the kingdom was established before Antiochus, he thought to reign over Egypt that he might have the dominion of two realms.

verses.raw: Wherefore he entered into Egypt with a great multitude, with chariots, and elephants, and horsemen, and a great navy,
verses.text: Wherefore he entered into Egypt with a great multitude, with chariots, and elephants, and horsemen, and a great navy,

verses.raw: And made war against Ptolemee king of Egypt: but Ptolemee was afraid of him, and fled; and many were wounded to death.
verses.text: And made war against Ptolemee king of Egypt: but Ptolemee was afraid of him, and fled; and many were wounded to death.

verses.raw: Thus they got the strong cities in the land of Egypt and he took the spoils thereof.
verses.text: Thus they got the strong cities in the land of Egypt and he took the spoils thereof.

verses.raw: And after that Antiochus had struck Egypt, he returned again in the hundred forty and third year, and went up against Yashar'el (Israel) and Jerusalem with a great multitude,
verses.text: And after that Antiochus had struck Egypt, he returned again in the hundred forty and third year, and went up against Yashar'el and Jerusalem with a great multitude,

verses.raw: And entered proudly into the sanctuary, and took away the golden altar, and the candlestick of light, and all the vessels thereof,
verses.text: And entered proudly into the sanctuary, and took away the golden altar, and the candlestick of light, and all the vessels thereof,

verses.raw: And the table of the shewbread, and the pouring vessels, and the vials. and the censers of gold, and the veil, and the crown, and the golden ornaments that were before the temple, all which he pulled off.
verses.text: And the table of the shewbread, and the pouring vessels, and the vials. and the censers of gold, and the veil, and the crown, and the golden ornaments that were before the temple, all which he pulled off.

verses.raw: He took also the silver and the gold, and the precious vessels: also he took the hidden treasures which he found.
verses.text: He took also the silver and the gold, and the precious vessels: also he took the hidden treasures which he found.

verses.raw: And when he had taken all away, he went into his own land, having made a great massacre, and spoken very proudly.
verses.text: And when he had taken all away, he went into his own land, having made a great massacre, and spoken very proudly.

verses.raw: Therefore there was a great mourning in Yashar'el (Israel), in every place where they were;
verses.text: Therefore there was a great mourning in Yashar'el, in every place where they were;

verses.raw: So that the princes and elders mourned, the virgins and young men were made feeble, and the beauty of women was changed.
verses.text: So that the princes and elders mourned, the virgins and young men were made feeble, and the beauty of women was changed.

verses.raw: Every bridegroom took up lamentation, and she that sat in the marriage chamber was in heaviness,
verses.text: Every bridegroom took up lamentation, and she that sat in the marriage chamber was in heaviness,

verses.raw: The land also was moved for the inhabitants thereof, and all the house of Jacob was covered with confusion.
verses.text: The land also was moved for the inhabitants thereof, and all the house of Jacob was covered with confusion.

verses.raw: And after two years fully expired the king sent his chief collector of tribute to the cities of Juda, who came to Jerusalem with a great multitude,
verses.text: And after two years fully expired the king sent his chief collector of tribute to the cities of Juda, who came to Jerusalem with a great multitude,

verses.raw: And spoke peaceable words to them, but all was deceit: for when they had given him credence, he fell suddenly upon the city, and struck it very sore, and destroyed much people of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And spoke peaceable words to them, but all was deceit: for when they had given him credence, he fell suddenly upon the city, and struck it very sore, and destroyed much people of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And when he had taken the spoils of the city, he set it on fire, and pulled down the houses and walls thereof on every side.
verses.text: And when he had taken the spoils of the city, he set it on fire, and pulled down the houses and walls thereof on every side.

verses.raw: But the women and children took they captive, and possessed the cattle.
verses.text: But the women and children took they captive, and possessed the cattle.

verses.raw: Then builded they the city of David with a great and strong wall, and with mighty towers, and made it a strong hold for them.
verses.text: Then builded they the city of David with a great and strong wall, and with mighty towers, and made it a strong hold for them.

verses.raw: And they put in it a sinful nation, wicked men, and fortified themselves in it.
verses.text: And they put in it a sinful nation, wicked men, and fortified themselves in it.

verses.raw: They stored it also with armour and victuals, and when they had gathered together the spoils of Jerusalem, they laid them up there, and so they became a sore snare:
verses.text: They stored it also with armour and victuals, and when they had gathered together the spoils of Jerusalem, they laid them up there, and so they became a sore snare:

verses.raw: For it was a place to lie in wait against the sanctuary, and an evil adversary to Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: For it was a place to lie in wait against the sanctuary, and an evil adversary to Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Thus they shed innocent blood on every side of the sanctuary, and defiled it:
verses.text: Thus they shed innocent blood on every side of the sanctuary, and defiled it:

verses.raw: Insomuch that the inhabitants of Jerusalem fled because of them: whereupon the city was made an habitation of strangers, and became strange to those that were born in her; and her own children left her.
verses.text: Insomuch that the inhabitants of Jerusalem fled because of them: whereupon the city was made an habitation of strangers, and became strange to those that were born in her; and her own children left her.

verses.raw: Her sanctuary was laid waste like a wilderness, her feasts were turned into mourning, her sabbaths into reproach her honour into contempt.
verses.text: Her sanctuary was laid waste like a wilderness, her feasts were turned into mourning, her sabbaths into reproach her honour into contempt.

verses.raw: As had been her glory, so was her dishonour increased, and her excellency was turned into mourning.
verses.text: As had been her glory, so was her dishonour increased, and her excellency was turned into mourning.

verses.raw: Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people,
verses.text: Moreover king Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people,

verses.raw: And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.
verses.text: And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king.

verses.raw: Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed to idols, and profaned the sabbath.
verses.text: Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion, and sacrificed to idols, and profaned the sabbath.

verses.raw: For the king had sent letters by messengers to Jerusalem and the cities of Juda that they should follow the strange laws of the land,
verses.text: For the king had sent letters by messengers to Jerusalem and the cities of Juda that they should follow the strange laws of the land,

verses.raw: And forbid burnt offerings, and sacrifice, and drink offerings, in the temple; and that they should profane the sabbaths and festival days:
verses.text: And forbid burnt offerings, and sacrifice, and drink offerings, in the temple; and that they should profane the sabbaths and festival days:

verses.raw: And pollute the sanctuary and holy people:
verses.text: And pollute the sanctuary and holy people:

verses.raw: Set up altars, and groves, and chapels of idols, and sacrifice swine’s flesh, and unclean beasts:
verses.text: Set up altars, and groves, and chapels of idols, and sacrifice swine’s flesh, and unclean beasts:

verses.raw: That they should also leave their children uncircumcised, and make their souls abominable with all manner of uncleanness and profanation:
verses.text: That they should also leave their children uncircumcised, and make their souls abominable with all manner of uncleanness and profanation:

verses.raw: To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.
verses.text: To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.

verses.raw: And whoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.
verses.text: And whoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.

verses.raw: In the selfsame manner wrote he to his whole kingdom, and appointed overseers over all the people, commanding the cities of Juda to sacrifice, city by city.
verses.text: In the selfsame manner wrote he to his whole kingdom, and appointed overseers over all the people, commanding the cities of Juda to sacrifice, city by city.

verses.raw: Then many of the people were gathered to them, to wit every one that forsook the law; and so they committed evils in the land;
verses.text: Then many of the people were gathered to them, to wit every one that forsook the law; and so they committed evils in the land;

verses.raw: And drove the Israelites into secret places, even wherever they could flee for succour.
verses.text: And drove the Israelites into secret places, even wherever they could flee for succour.

verses.raw: Now the fifteenth day of the month Casleu, in the hundred forty and fifth year, they set up the abomination of desolation upon the altar, and builded idol altars throughout the cities of Juda on every side;
verses.text: Now the fifteenth day of the month Casleu, in the hundred forty and fifth year, they set up the abomination of desolation upon the altar, and builded idol altars throughout the cities of Juda on every side;

verses.raw: And burnt incense at the doors of their houses, and in the streets.
verses.text: And burnt incense at the doors of their houses, and in the streets.

verses.raw: And when they had rent in pieces the books of the law which they found, they burnt them with fire.
verses.text: And when they had rent in pieces the books of the law which they found, they burnt them with fire.

verses.raw: And whoever was found with any the book of the testament, or if any committed to the law, the king’s commandment was, that they should put him to death.
verses.text: And whoever was found with any the book of the testament, or if any committed to the law, the king’s commandment was, that they should put him to death.

verses.raw: Thus did they by their authority to the Israelites every month, to as many as were found in the cities.
verses.text: Thus did they by their authority to the Israelites every month, to as many as were found in the cities.

verses.raw: Now the five and twentieth day of the month they did sacrifice upon the idol altar, which was upon the altar of Yahuah (God).
verses.text: Now the five and twentieth day of the month they did sacrifice upon the idol altar, which was upon the altar of Yahuah.

verses.raw: At which time according to the commandment they put to death certain women, that had caused their children to be circumcised.
verses.text: At which time according to the commandment they put to death certain women, that had caused their children to be circumcised.

verses.raw: And they hanged the infants about their necks, and rifled their houses, and slew them that had circumcised them.
verses.text: And they hanged the infants about their necks, and rifled their houses, and slew them that had circumcised them.

verses.raw: Howbeit many in Yashar'el (Israel) were fully resolved and confirmed in themselves not to eat any unclean thing.
verses.text: Howbeit many in Yashar'el were fully resolved and confirmed in themselves not to eat any unclean thing.

verses.raw: Wherefore they chose rather to die, that they might not be defiled with meats, and that they might not profane the holy covenant: so then they died.
verses.text: Wherefore they chose rather to die, that they might not be defiled with meats, and that they might not profane the holy covenant: so then they died.

verses.raw: And there was very great wrath upon Yashar'el (Israel). ⸻
verses.text: And there was very great wrath upon Yashar'el. ⸻

verses.raw: In those days arose Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem, and dwelt in Modin.
verses.text: In those days arose Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem, and dwelt in Modin.

verses.raw: And he had five sons, Joannan, called Caddis:
verses.text: And he had five sons, Joannan, called Caddis:

verses.raw: Simon; called Thassi:
verses.text: Simon; called Thassi:

verses.raw: Judas, who was called Maccabeus:
verses.text: Judas, who was called Maccabeus:

verses.raw: Eleazar, called Avaran: and Jonathan, whose surname was Apphus.
verses.text: Eleazar, called Avaran: and Jonathan, whose surname was Apphus.

verses.raw: And when he saw the blasphemies that were committed in Juda and Jerusalem,
verses.text: And when he saw the blasphemies that were committed in Juda and Jerusalem,

verses.raw: He said, Woe is me! wherefore was I born to see this misery of my people, and of the holy city, and to dwell there, when it was delivered into the hand of the enemy, and the sanctuary into the hand of strangers?
verses.text: He said, Woe is me! wherefore was I born to see this misery of my people, and of the holy city, and to dwell there, when it was delivered into the hand of the enemy, and the sanctuary into the hand of strangers?

verses.raw: Her temple is become as a man without glory.
verses.text: Her temple is become as a man without glory.

verses.raw: Her glorious vessels are carried away into captivity, her infants are slain in the streets, her young men with the sword of the enemy.
verses.text: Her glorious vessels are carried away into captivity, her infants are slain in the streets, her young men with the sword of the enemy.

verses.raw: What nation has not had a part in her kingdom and gotten of her spoils?
verses.text: What nation has not had a part in her kingdom and gotten of her spoils?

verses.raw: All her ornaments are taken away; of a free woman she is become a bondslave.
verses.text: All her ornaments are taken away; of a free woman she is become a bondslave.

verses.raw: And, behold, our sanctuary, even our beauty and our glory, is laid waste, and the Gentiles have profaned it.
verses.text: And, behold, our sanctuary, even our beauty and our glory, is laid waste, and the Gentiles have profaned it.

verses.raw: To what end therefore shall we live any longer?
verses.text: To what end therefore shall we live any longer?

verses.raw: Then Mattathias and his sons rent their clothes, and put on sackcloth, and mourned very sore.
verses.text: Then Mattathias and his sons rent their clothes, and put on sackcloth, and mourned very sore.

verses.raw: In the mean while the king’s officers, such as compelled the people to revolt, came into the city Modin, to make them sacrifice.
verses.text: In the mean while the king’s officers, such as compelled the people to revolt, came into the city Modin, to make them sacrifice.

verses.raw: And when many of Yashar'el (Israel) came to them, Mattathias also and his sons came together.
verses.text: And when many of Yashar'el came to them, Mattathias also and his sons came together.

verses.raw: Then answered the king’s officers, and said to Mattathias on this wise, You are a ruler, and an honourable and great man in this city, and strengthened with sons and brothers:
verses.text: Then answered the king’s officers, and said to Mattathias on this wise, You are a ruler, and an honourable and great man in this city, and strengthened with sons and brothers:

verses.raw: Now therefore come you first, and fulfil the king’s commandment, like as all the heathen have done, yes, and the men of Juda also, and such as remain at Jerusalem: so shall you and your house be in the number of the king’s friends, and you and your children shall be honoured with silver and gold, and many rewards.
verses.text: Now therefore come you first, and fulfil the king’s commandment, like as all the heathen have done, yes, and the men of Juda also, and such as remain at Jerusalem: so shall you and your house be in the number of the king’s friends, and you and your children shall be honoured with silver and gold, and many rewards.

verses.raw: Then Mattathias answered and spoke with a loud voice, Though all the nations that are under the king’s dominion obey him, and fall away every one from the religion of their fathers, and give consent to his commandments:
verses.text: Then Mattathias answered and spoke with a loud voice, Though all the nations that are under the king’s dominion obey him, and fall away every one from the religion of their fathers, and give consent to his commandments:

verses.raw: Yet will I and my sons and my brothers walk in the covenant of our fathers.
verses.text: Yet will I and my sons and my brothers walk in the covenant of our fathers.

verses.raw: Yahuah (God) forbid that we should forsake the law and the ordinances.
verses.text: Yahuah forbid that we should forsake the law and the ordinances.

verses.raw: We will not hearken to the king’s words, to go from our religion, either on the right hand, or the left.
verses.text: We will not hearken to the king’s words, to go from our religion, either on the right hand, or the left.

verses.raw: Now when he had left speaking these words, there came one of the Yahudim (Jews) in the sight of all to sacrifice on the altar which was at Modin, according to the king’s commandment.
verses.text: Now when he had left speaking these words, there came one of the Yahudim in the sight of all to sacrifice on the altar which was at Modin, according to the king’s commandment.

verses.raw: Which thing when Mattathias saw, he was inflamed with zeal, and his reins trembled, neither could he forbear to shew his anger according to judgment: wherefore he ran, and slew him upon the altar.
verses.text: Which thing when Mattathias saw, he was inflamed with zeal, and his reins trembled, neither could he forbear to shew his anger according to judgment: wherefore he ran, and slew him upon the altar.

verses.raw: Also the king’s commissioner, who compelled men to sacrifice, he killed at that time, and the altar he pulled down.
verses.text: Also the king’s commissioner, who compelled men to sacrifice, he killed at that time, and the altar he pulled down.

verses.raw: Thus dealt he zealously for the law of Yahuah (God) like as Phinees did to Zambri the son of Salom.
verses.text: Thus dealt he zealously for the law of Yahuah like as Phinees did to Zambri the son of Salom.

verses.raw: And Mattathias cried throughout the city with a loud voice, saying, Whoever is zealous of the law, and maintaineth the covenant, let him follow me.
verses.text: And Mattathias cried throughout the city with a loud voice, saying, Whoever is zealous of the law, and maintaineth the covenant, let him follow me.

verses.raw: So he and his sons fled into the mountains, and left all that ever they had in the city.
verses.text: So he and his sons fled into the mountains, and left all that ever they had in the city.

verses.raw: Then many that sought after justice and judgment went down into the wilderness, to dwell there:
verses.text: Then many that sought after justice and judgment went down into the wilderness, to dwell there:

verses.raw: Both they, and their children, and their wives; and their cattle; because afflictions increased sore upon them.
verses.text: Both they, and their children, and their wives; and their cattle; because afflictions increased sore upon them.

verses.raw: Now when it was told the king’s servants, and the host that was at Jerusalem, in the city of David, that certain men, who had broken the king’s commandment, were gone down into the secret places in the wilderness,
verses.text: Now when it was told the king’s servants, and the host that was at Jerusalem, in the city of David, that certain men, who had broken the king’s commandment, were gone down into the secret places in the wilderness,

verses.raw: They pursued after them a great number, and having overtaken them, they camped against them, and made war against them on the sabbath day.
verses.text: They pursued after them a great number, and having overtaken them, they camped against them, and made war against them on the sabbath day.

verses.raw: And they said to them, Let that which you have done hitherto suffice; come forth, and do according to the commandment of the king, and you shall live.
verses.text: And they said to them, Let that which you have done hitherto suffice; come forth, and do according to the commandment of the king, and you shall live.

verses.raw: But they said, We will not come forth, neither will we do the king’s commandment, to profane the sabbath day.
verses.text: But they said, We will not come forth, neither will we do the king’s commandment, to profane the sabbath day.

verses.raw: So then they gave them the battle with all speed.
verses.text: So then they gave them the battle with all speed.

verses.raw: Howbeit they answered them not, neither cast they a stone at them, nor stopped the places where they lay hid;
verses.text: Howbeit they answered them not, neither cast they a stone at them, nor stopped the places where they lay hid;

verses.raw: But said, Let us die all in our innocency: heaven and earth will testify for us, that you put us to death wrongfully.
verses.text: But said, Let us die all in our innocency: heaven and earth will testify for us, that you put us to death wrongfully.

verses.raw: So they rose up against them in battle on the sabbath, and they slew them, with their wives and children and their cattle, to the number of a thousand people.
verses.text: So they rose up against them in battle on the sabbath, and they slew them, with their wives and children and their cattle, to the number of a thousand people.

verses.raw: Now when Mattathias and his friends understood of this, they mourned for them right sore.
verses.text: Now when Mattathias and his friends understood of this, they mourned for them right sore.

verses.raw: And one of them said to another, If we all do as our brothers have done, and fight not for our lives and laws against the heathen, they will now quickly root us out of the earth.
verses.text: And one of them said to another, If we all do as our brothers have done, and fight not for our lives and laws against the heathen, they will now quickly root us out of the earth.

verses.raw: At that time therefore they decreed, saying, Whoever shall come to make battle with us on the sabbath day, we will fight against him; neither will we die all, as our brothers that were murdered in the secret places.
verses.text: At that time therefore they decreed, saying, Whoever shall come to make battle with us on the sabbath day, we will fight against him; neither will we die all, as our brothers that were murdered in the secret places.

verses.raw: Then came there to him a company of Assideans who were mighty men of Yashar'el (Israel), even all such as were voluntarily devoted to the law.
verses.text: Then came there to him a company of Assideans who were mighty men of Yashar'el, even all such as were voluntarily devoted to the law.

verses.raw: Also all they that fled for persecution joined themselves to them, and were a stay to them.
verses.text: Also all they that fled for persecution joined themselves to them, and were a stay to them.

verses.raw: So they joined their forces, and struck sinful men in their anger, and wicked men in their wrath: but the rest fled to the heathen for succour.
verses.text: So they joined their forces, and struck sinful men in their anger, and wicked men in their wrath: but the rest fled to the heathen for succour.

verses.raw: Then Mattathias and his friends went round about, and pulled down the altars:
verses.text: Then Mattathias and his friends went round about, and pulled down the altars:

verses.raw: And what children soever they found within the coast of Yashar'el (Israel) uncircumcised, those they circumcised valiantly.
verses.text: And what children soever they found within the coast of Yashar'el uncircumcised, those they circumcised valiantly.

verses.raw: They pursued also after the proud men, and the work prospered in their hand.
verses.text: They pursued also after the proud men, and the work prospered in their hand.

verses.raw: So they recovered the law out of the hand of the Gentiles, and out of the hand of kings, neither suffered they the sinner to triumph.
verses.text: So they recovered the law out of the hand of the Gentiles, and out of the hand of kings, neither suffered they the sinner to triumph.

verses.raw: Now when the time drew near that Mattathias should die, he said to his sons, Now has pride and rebuke gotten strength, and the time of destruction, and the wrath of indignation:
verses.text: Now when the time drew near that Mattathias should die, he said to his sons, Now has pride and rebuke gotten strength, and the time of destruction, and the wrath of indignation:

verses.raw: Now therefore, my sons, be you zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.
verses.text: Now therefore, my sons, be you zealous for the law, and give your lives for the covenant of your fathers.

verses.raw: Call to remembrance what acts our fathers did in their time; so shall you receive great honour and an everlasting name.
verses.text: Call to remembrance what acts our fathers did in their time; so shall you receive great honour and an everlasting name.

verses.raw: Was not Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was imputed to him for righteousness?
verses.text: Was not Abraham found faithful in temptation, and it was imputed to him for righteousness?

verses.raw: Joseph in the time of his distress kept the commandment and was made lord of Egypt.
verses.text: Joseph in the time of his distress kept the commandment and was made lord of Egypt.

verses.raw: Phinees our father in being zealous and fervent obtained the covenant of an everlasting priesthood.
verses.text: Phinees our father in being zealous and fervent obtained the covenant of an everlasting priesthood.

verses.raw: Jesus for fulfilling the word was made a judge in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Jesus for fulfilling the word was made a judge in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Caleb for bearing witness before the congregation received the heritage of the land.
verses.text: Caleb for bearing witness before the congregation received the heritage of the land.

verses.raw: David for being merciful possessed the throne of an everlasting kingdom.
verses.text: David for being merciful possessed the throne of an everlasting kingdom.

verses.raw: Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.
verses.text: Elias for being zealous and fervent for the law was taken up into heaven.

verses.raw: Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, by believing were saved out of the flame.
verses.text: Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, by believing were saved out of the flame.

verses.raw: Daniel for his innocency was delivered from the mouth of lions.
verses.text: Daniel for his innocency was delivered from the mouth of lions.

verses.raw: And thus consider you throughout all ages, that none that put their trust in him shall be overcome.
verses.text: And thus consider you throughout all ages, that none that put their trust in him shall be overcome.

verses.raw: Fear not then the words of a sinful man: for his glory shall be dung and worms.
verses.text: Fear not then the words of a sinful man: for his glory shall be dung and worms.

verses.raw: To day he shall be lifted up and to morrow he shall not be found, because he is returned into his dust, and his thought is come to nothing.
verses.text: To day he shall be lifted up and to morrow he shall not be found, because he is returned into his dust, and his thought is come to nothing.

verses.raw: Wherefore, you my sons, be valiant and shew yourselves men in the behalf of the law; for by it shall you obtain glory.
verses.text: Wherefore, you my sons, be valiant and shew yourselves men in the behalf of the law; for by it shall you obtain glory.

verses.raw: And behold, I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel, give ear to him alway: he shall be a father to you.
verses.text: And behold, I know that your brother Simon is a man of counsel, give ear to him alway: he shall be a father to you.

verses.raw: As for Judas Maccabeus, he has been mighty and strong, even from his youth up: let him be your captain, and fight the battle of the people.
verses.text: As for Judas Maccabeus, he has been mighty and strong, even from his youth up: let him be your captain, and fight the battle of the people.

verses.raw: Take also to you all those that observe the law, and avenge you the wrong of your people.
verses.text: Take also to you all those that observe the law, and avenge you the wrong of your people.

verses.raw: Recompense fully the heathen, and take heed to the commandments of the law.
verses.text: Recompense fully the heathen, and take heed to the commandments of the law.

verses.raw: So he blessed them, and was gathered to his fathers.
verses.text: So he blessed them, and was gathered to his fathers.

verses.raw: And he died in the hundred forty and sixth year, and his sons buried him in the sepulchres of his fathers at Modin, and all Yashar'el (Israel) made great lamentation for him. ⸻
verses.text: And he died in the hundred forty and sixth year, and his sons buried him in the sepulchres of his fathers at Modin, and all Yashar'el made great lamentation for him. ⸻

verses.raw: Then his son Judas, called Maccabeus, rose up in his stead.
verses.text: Then his son Judas, called Maccabeus, rose up in his stead.

verses.raw: And all his brothers helped him, and so did all they that held with his father, and they fought with cheerfulness the battle of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And all his brothers helped him, and so did all they that held with his father, and they fought with cheerfulness the battle of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So he got his people great honour, and put on a breastplate as a giant, and girt his warlike harness about him, and he made battles, protecting the host with his sword.
verses.text: So he got his people great honour, and put on a breastplate as a giant, and girt his warlike harness about him, and he made battles, protecting the host with his sword.

verses.raw: In his acts he was like a lion, and like a lion’s whelp roaring for his prey.
verses.text: In his acts he was like a lion, and like a lion’s whelp roaring for his prey.

verses.raw: For He pursued the wicked, and sought them out, and burnt up those that vexed his people.
verses.text: For He pursued the wicked, and sought them out, and burnt up those that vexed his people.

verses.raw: Wherefore the wicked shrunk for fear of him, and all the workers of iniquity were troubled, because salvation prospered in his hand.
verses.text: Wherefore the wicked shrunk for fear of him, and all the workers of iniquity were troubled, because salvation prospered in his hand.

verses.raw: He grieved also many kings, and made Jacob glad with his acts, and his memorial is blessed for ever.
verses.text: He grieved also many kings, and made Jacob glad with his acts, and his memorial is blessed for ever.

verses.raw: Moreover he went through the cities of Juda, destroying the ungodly out of them, and turning away wrath from Yashar'el (Israel):
verses.text: Moreover he went through the cities of Juda, destroying the ungodly out of them, and turning away wrath from Yashar'el:

verses.raw: So that he was renowned to the utmost part of the earth, and he received to him such as were ready to perish.
verses.text: So that he was renowned to the utmost part of the earth, and he received to him such as were ready to perish.

verses.raw: Then Apollonius gathered the Gentiles together, and a great host out of Samaria, to fight against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then Apollonius gathered the Gentiles together, and a great host out of Samaria, to fight against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Which thing when Judas perceived, he went forth to meet him, and so he struck him, and slew him: many also fell down slain, but the rest fled.
verses.text: Which thing when Judas perceived, he went forth to meet him, and so he struck him, and slew him: many also fell down slain, but the rest fled.

verses.raw: Wherefore Judas took their spoils, and Apollonius’ sword also, and with it he fought all his life long.
verses.text: Wherefore Judas took their spoils, and Apollonius’ sword also, and with it he fought all his life long.

verses.raw: Now when Seron, a prince of the army of Syria, heard say that Judas had gathered to him a multitude and company of the faithful to go out with him to war;
verses.text: Now when Seron, a prince of the army of Syria, heard say that Judas had gathered to him a multitude and company of the faithful to go out with him to war;

verses.raw: He said, I will get me a name and honour in the kingdom; for I will go fight with Judas and them that are with him, who despise the king’s commandment.
verses.text: He said, I will get me a name and honour in the kingdom; for I will go fight with Judas and them that are with him, who despise the king’s commandment.

verses.raw: So he made him ready to go up, and there went with him a mighty host of the ungodly to help him, and to be avenged of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: So he made him ready to go up, and there went with him a mighty host of the ungodly to help him, and to be avenged of the children of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And when he came near to the going up of Bethhoron, Judas went forth to meet him with a small company:
verses.text: And when he came near to the going up of Bethhoron, Judas went forth to meet him with a small company:

verses.raw: Who, when they saw the host coming to meet them, said to Judas, How shall we be able, being so few, to fight against so great a multitude and so strong, seeing we are ready to faint with fasting all this day?
verses.text: Who, when they saw the host coming to meet them, said to Judas, How shall we be able, being so few, to fight against so great a multitude and so strong, seeing we are ready to faint with fasting all this day?

verses.raw: To whom Judas answered, It is no hard matter for many to be shut up in the hands of a few; and with Yahuah (God) of heaven it is all one, to deliver with a great multitude, or a small company:
verses.text: To whom Judas answered, It is no hard matter for many to be shut up in the hands of a few; and with Yahuah of heaven it is all one, to deliver with a great multitude, or a small company:

verses.raw: For the victory of battle stands not in the multitude of an host; but strength comes from heaven.
verses.text: For the victory of battle stands not in the multitude of an host; but strength comes from heaven.

verses.raw: They come against us in much pride and iniquity to destroy us, and our wives and children, and to spoil us:
verses.text: They come against us in much pride and iniquity to destroy us, and our wives and children, and to spoil us:

verses.raw: But we fight for our lives and our laws.
verses.text: But we fight for our lives and our laws.

verses.raw: Wherefore Yahuah (God) himself will overthrow them before our face: and as for you, be you not afraid of them.
verses.text: Wherefore Yahuah himself will overthrow them before our face: and as for you, be you not afraid of them.

verses.raw: Now as soon as he had left off speaking, he leapt suddenly upon them, and so Seron and his host was overthrown before him.
verses.text: Now as soon as he had left off speaking, he leapt suddenly upon them, and so Seron and his host was overthrown before him.

verses.raw: And they pursued them from the going down of Bethhoron to the plain, where were slain about eight hundred men of them; and the residue fled into the land of the Philistines.
verses.text: And they pursued them from the going down of Bethhoron to the plain, where were slain about eight hundred men of them; and the residue fled into the land of the Philistines.

verses.raw: Then began the fear of Judas and his brothers, and an exceeding great dread, to fall upon the nations round about them:
verses.text: Then began the fear of Judas and his brothers, and an exceeding great dread, to fall upon the nations round about them:

verses.raw: Insomuch as his fame came to the king, and all nations talked of the battles of Judas.
verses.text: Insomuch as his fame came to the king, and all nations talked of the battles of Judas.

verses.raw: Now when king Antiochus heard these things, he was full of indignation: wherefore he sent and gathered together all the forces of his realm, even a very strong army.
verses.text: Now when king Antiochus heard these things, he was full of indignation: wherefore he sent and gathered together all the forces of his realm, even a very strong army.

verses.raw: He opened also his treasure, and gave his soldiers pay for a year, commanding them to be ready whenever he should need them.
verses.text: He opened also his treasure, and gave his soldiers pay for a year, commanding them to be ready whenever he should need them.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, when he saw that the money of his treasures failed and that the tributes in the country were small, because of the dissension and plague, which he had brought upon the land in taking away the laws which had been of old time;
verses.text: Nevertheless, when he saw that the money of his treasures failed and that the tributes in the country were small, because of the dissension and plague, which he had brought upon the land in taking away the laws which had been of old time;

verses.raw: He feared that he should not be able to bear the charges any longer, nor to have such gifts to give so liberally as he did before: for he had abounded above the kings that were before him.
verses.text: He feared that he should not be able to bear the charges any longer, nor to have such gifts to give so liberally as he did before: for he had abounded above the kings that were before him.

verses.raw: Wherefore, being greatly perplexed in his mind, he determined to go into Persia, there to take the tributes of the countries, and to gather much money.
verses.text: Wherefore, being greatly perplexed in his mind, he determined to go into Persia, there to take the tributes of the countries, and to gather much money.

verses.raw: So he left Lysias, a nobleman, and one of the blood royal, to oversee the affairs of the king from the river Euphrates to the borders of Egypt:
verses.text: So he left Lysias, a nobleman, and one of the blood royal, to oversee the affairs of the king from the river Euphrates to the borders of Egypt:

verses.raw: And to bring up his son Antiochus, until he came again.
verses.text: And to bring up his son Antiochus, until he came again.

verses.raw: Moreover he delivered to him the half of his forces, and the elephants, and gave him charge of all things that he would have done, as also concerning them that dwelt in Juda and Jerusalem:
verses.text: Moreover he delivered to him the half of his forces, and the elephants, and gave him charge of all things that he would have done, as also concerning them that dwelt in Juda and Jerusalem:

verses.raw: To wit, that he should send an army against them, to destroy and root out the strength of Yashar'el (Israel), and the remnant of Jerusalem, and to take away their memorial from that place;
verses.text: To wit, that he should send an army against them, to destroy and root out the strength of Yashar'el, and the remnant of Jerusalem, and to take away their memorial from that place;

verses.raw: And that he should place strangers in all their quarters, and divide their land by lot.
verses.text: And that he should place strangers in all their quarters, and divide their land by lot.

verses.raw: So the king took the half of the forces that remained, and departed from Antioch, his royal city, the hundred forty and seventh year; and having passed the river Euphrates, he went through the high countries.
verses.text: So the king took the half of the forces that remained, and departed from Antioch, his royal city, the hundred forty and seventh year; and having passed the river Euphrates, he went through the high countries.

verses.raw: Then Lysias chose Ptolemee the son of Dorymenes, Nicanor, and Gorgias, mighty men of the king’s friends:
verses.text: Then Lysias chose Ptolemee the son of Dorymenes, Nicanor, and Gorgias, mighty men of the king’s friends:

verses.raw: And with them he sent forty thousand footmen, and seven thousand horsemen, to go into the land of Juda, and to destroy it, as the king commanded.
verses.text: And with them he sent forty thousand footmen, and seven thousand horsemen, to go into the land of Juda, and to destroy it, as the king commanded.

verses.raw: So they went forth with all their power, and came and pitched by Emmaus in the plain country.
verses.text: So they went forth with all their power, and came and pitched by Emmaus in the plain country.

verses.raw: And the merchants of the country, hearing the fame of them, took silver and gold very much, with servants, and came into the camp to buy the children of Yashar'el (Israel) for slaves: a power also of Syria and of the land of the Philistines joined themselves to them.
verses.text: And the merchants of the country, hearing the fame of them, took silver and gold very much, with servants, and came into the camp to buy the children of Yashar'el for slaves: a power also of Syria and of the land of the Philistines joined themselves to them.

verses.raw: Now when Judas and his brothers saw that miseries were multiplied, and that the forces did encamp themselves in their borders: for they knew how the king had given commandment to destroy the people, and utterly abolish them;
verses.text: Now when Judas and his brothers saw that miseries were multiplied, and that the forces did encamp themselves in their borders: for they knew how the king had given commandment to destroy the people, and utterly abolish them;

verses.raw: They said one to another, Let us restore the decayed fortune of our people, and let us fight for our people and the sanctuary.
verses.text: They said one to another, Let us restore the decayed fortune of our people, and let us fight for our people and the sanctuary.

verses.raw: Then was the congregation gathered together, that they might be ready for battle, and that they might pray, and ask mercy and compassion.
verses.text: Then was the congregation gathered together, that they might be ready for battle, and that they might pray, and ask mercy and compassion.

verses.raw: Now Jerusalem lay void as a wilderness, there was none of her children that went in or out: the sanctuary also was trodden down, and aliens kept the strong hold; the heathen had their habitation in that place; and joy was taken from Jacob, and the pipe with the harp ceased.
verses.text: Now Jerusalem lay void as a wilderness, there was none of her children that went in or out: the sanctuary also was trodden down, and aliens kept the strong hold; the heathen had their habitation in that place; and joy was taken from Jacob, and the pipe with the harp ceased.

verses.raw: Wherefore the Israelites assembled themselves together, and came to Maspha, over against Jerusalem; for in Maspha was the place where they prayed aforetime in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Wherefore the Israelites assembled themselves together, and came to Maspha, over against Jerusalem; for in Maspha was the place where they prayed aforetime in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then they fasted that day, and put on sackcloth, and cast ashes upon their heads, and rent their clothes,
verses.text: Then they fasted that day, and put on sackcloth, and cast ashes upon their heads, and rent their clothes,

verses.raw: And laid open the book of the law, in which the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.
verses.text: And laid open the book of the law, in which the heathen had sought to paint the likeness of their images.

verses.raw: They brought also the priests’ garments, and the firstfruits, and the tithes: and the Nazarites they stirred up, who had accomplished their days.
verses.text: They brought also the priests’ garments, and the firstfruits, and the tithes: and the Nazarites they stirred up, who had accomplished their days.

verses.raw: Then cried they with a loud voice toward heaven, saying, What shall we do with these, and whither shall we carry them away?
verses.text: Then cried they with a loud voice toward heaven, saying, What shall we do with these, and whither shall we carry them away?

verses.raw: For your sanctuary is trodden down and profaned, and your priests are in heaviness, and brought low.
verses.text: For your sanctuary is trodden down and profaned, and your priests are in heaviness, and brought low.

verses.raw: And lo, the heathen are assembled together against us to destroy us: what things they imagine against us, you know.
verses.text: And lo, the heathen are assembled together against us to destroy us: what things they imagine against us, you know.

verses.raw: How shall we be able to stand against them, except you, O Yahuah (God), be our help?
verses.text: How shall we be able to stand against them, except you, O Yahuah, be our help?

verses.raw: Then sounded they with trumpets, and cried with a loud voice.
verses.text: Then sounded they with trumpets, and cried with a loud voice.

verses.raw: And after this Judas ordained captains over the people, even captains over thousands, and over hundreds, and over fifties, and over tens.
verses.text: And after this Judas ordained captains over the people, even captains over thousands, and over hundreds, and over fifties, and over tens.

verses.raw: But as for such as were building houses, or had betrothed wives, or were planting vineyards, or were fearful, those he commanded that they should return, every man to his own house, according to the law.
verses.text: But as for such as were building houses, or had betrothed wives, or were planting vineyards, or were fearful, those he commanded that they should return, every man to his own house, according to the law.

verses.raw: So the camp removed, and pitched upon the south side of Emmaus.
verses.text: So the camp removed, and pitched upon the south side of Emmaus.

verses.raw: And Judas said, arm yourselves, and be valiant men, and see that you be in readiness against the morning, that you may fight with these nations, that are assembled together against us to destroy us and our sanctuary:
verses.text: And Judas said, arm yourselves, and be valiant men, and see that you be in readiness against the morning, that you may fight with these nations, that are assembled together against us to destroy us and our sanctuary:

verses.raw: For it is better for us to die in battle, than to behold the calamities of our people and our sanctuary.
verses.text: For it is better for us to die in battle, than to behold the calamities of our people and our sanctuary.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, as the will of Yahuah (God) is in heaven, so let him do. ⸻
verses.text: Nevertheless, as the will of Yahuah is in heaven, so let him do. ⸻

verses.raw: Then took Gorgias five thousand footmen, and a thousand of the best horsemen, and removed out of the camp by night;
verses.text: Then took Gorgias five thousand footmen, and a thousand of the best horsemen, and removed out of the camp by night;

verses.raw: To the end he might rush in upon the camp of the Yahudim (Jews), and smite them suddenly. And the men of the fortress were his guides.
verses.text: To the end he might rush in upon the camp of the Yahudim, and smite them suddenly. And the men of the fortress were his guides.

verses.raw: Now when Judas heard thereof he himself removed, and the valiant men with him, that he might smite the king’s army which was at Emmaus,
verses.text: Now when Judas heard thereof he himself removed, and the valiant men with him, that he might smite the king’s army which was at Emmaus,

verses.raw: While as yet the forces were dispersed from the camp.
verses.text: While as yet the forces were dispersed from the camp.

verses.raw: In the mean season came Gorgias by night into the camp of Judas: and when he found no man there, he sought them in the mountains: for said he, These fellows flee from us
