verses.text: As for Bacchides, he was in the right wing: so the host drew near on the two parts, and sounded their trumpets.

verses.raw: They also of Judas’ side, even they sounded their trumpets also, so that the earth shook at the noise of the armies, and the battle continued from morning till night.
verses.text: They also of Judas’ side, even they sounded their trumpets also, so that the earth shook at the noise of the armies, and the battle continued from morning till night.

verses.raw: Now when Judas perceived that Bacchides and the strength of his army were on the right side, he took with him all the hardy men,
verses.text: Now when Judas perceived that Bacchides and the strength of his army were on the right side, he took with him all the hardy men,

verses.raw: Who discomfited the right wing, and pursued them to the mount Azotus.
verses.text: Who discomfited the right wing, and pursued them to the mount Azotus.

verses.raw: But when they of the left wing saw that they of the right wing were discomfited, they followed upon Judas and those that were with him hard at the heels from behind:
verses.text: But when they of the left wing saw that they of the right wing were discomfited, they followed upon Judas and those that were with him hard at the heels from behind:

verses.raw: Whereupon there was a sore battle, insomuch as many were slain on both parts.
verses.text: Whereupon there was a sore battle, insomuch as many were slain on both parts.

verses.raw: Judas also was killed, and the remnant fled.
verses.text: Judas also was killed, and the remnant fled.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan and Simon took Judas their brother, and buried him in the sepulchre of his fathers in Modin.
verses.text: Then Jonathan and Simon took Judas their brother, and buried him in the sepulchre of his fathers in Modin.

verses.raw: Moreover they bewailed him, and all Yashar'el (Israel) made great lamentation for him, and mourned many days, saying,
verses.text: Moreover they bewailed him, and all Yashar'el made great lamentation for him, and mourned many days, saying,

verses.raw: How is the valiant man fallen, that delivered Yashar'el (Israel)!
verses.text: How is the valiant man fallen, that delivered Yashar'el!

verses.raw: As for the other things concerning Judas and his wars, and the noble acts which he did, and his greatness, they are not written: for they were very many.
verses.text: As for the other things concerning Judas and his wars, and the noble acts which he did, and his greatness, they are not written: for they were very many.

verses.raw: Now after the death of Judas the wicked began to put forth their heads in all the coasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and there arose up all such as wrought iniquity.
verses.text: Now after the death of Judas the wicked began to put forth their heads in all the coasts of Yashar'el, and there arose up all such as wrought iniquity.

verses.raw: In those days also was there a very great famine, by reason of which the country revolted, and went with them.
verses.text: In those days also was there a very great famine, by reason of which the country revolted, and went with them.

verses.raw: Then Bacchides chose the wicked men, and made them lords of the country.
verses.text: Then Bacchides chose the wicked men, and made them lords of the country.

verses.raw: And they made enquiry and search for Judas’ friends, and brought them to Bacchides, who took vengeance of them, and used them despitefully.
verses.text: And they made enquiry and search for Judas’ friends, and brought them to Bacchides, who took vengeance of them, and used them despitefully.

verses.raw: So was there a great affliction in Yashar'el (Israel), the like of which was not since the time that a prophet was not seen among them.
verses.text: So was there a great affliction in Yashar'el, the like of which was not since the time that a prophet was not seen among them.

verses.raw: For this cause all Judas’ friends came together, and said to Jonathan,
verses.text: For this cause all Judas’ friends came together, and said to Jonathan,

verses.raw: Since your brother Judas died, we have no man like him to go forth against our enemies, and Bacchides, and against them of our nation that are adversaries to us.
verses.text: Since your brother Judas died, we have no man like him to go forth against our enemies, and Bacchides, and against them of our nation that are adversaries to us.

verses.raw: Now therefore we have chosen you this day to be our prince and captain in his stead, that you may fight our battles.
verses.text: Now therefore we have chosen you this day to be our prince and captain in his stead, that you may fight our battles.

verses.raw: Upon this Jonathan took the governance upon him at that time, and rose up instead of his brother Judas.
verses.text: Upon this Jonathan took the governance upon him at that time, and rose up instead of his brother Judas.

verses.raw: But when Bacchides got knowledge thereof, he sought for to slay him
verses.text: But when Bacchides got knowledge thereof, he sought for to slay him

verses.raw: Then Jonathan, and Simon his brother, and all that were with him, perceiving that, fled into the wilderness of Thecoe, and pitched their tents by the water of the pool Asphar.
verses.text: Then Jonathan, and Simon his brother, and all that were with him, perceiving that, fled into the wilderness of Thecoe, and pitched their tents by the water of the pool Asphar.

verses.raw: Which when Bacchides understood, he came near to Jordan with all his host upon the sabbath day.
verses.text: Which when Bacchides understood, he came near to Jordan with all his host upon the sabbath day.

verses.raw: Now Jonathan had sent his brother John, a captain of the people, to pray his friends the Nabathites, that they might leave with them their carriage, which was much.
verses.text: Now Jonathan had sent his brother John, a captain of the people, to pray his friends the Nabathites, that they might leave with them their carriage, which was much.

verses.raw: But the children of Jambri came out of Medaba, and took John, and all that he had, and went their way with it.
verses.text: But the children of Jambri came out of Medaba, and took John, and all that he had, and went their way with it.

verses.raw: After this came word to Jonathan and Simon his brother, that the children of Jambri made a great marriage, and were bringing the bride from Nadabatha with a great train, as being the daughter of one of the great princes of Chanaan.
verses.text: After this came word to Jonathan and Simon his brother, that the children of Jambri made a great marriage, and were bringing the bride from Nadabatha with a great train, as being the daughter of one of the great princes of Chanaan.

verses.raw: Therefore they remembered John their brother, and went up, and hid themselves under the covert of the mountain:
verses.text: Therefore they remembered John their brother, and went up, and hid themselves under the covert of the mountain:

verses.raw: Where they lifted up their eyes, and looked, and, behold, there was much ado and great carriage: and the bridegroom came forth, and his friends and brothers, to meet them with drums, and instruments of musick, and many weapons.
verses.text: Where they lifted up their eyes, and looked, and, behold, there was much ado and great carriage: and the bridegroom came forth, and his friends and brothers, to meet them with drums, and instruments of musick, and many weapons.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan and they that were with him rose up against them from the place where they lay in ambush, and made a slaughter of them in such sort, as many fell down dead, and the remnant fled into the mountain, and they took all their spoils.
verses.text: Then Jonathan and they that were with him rose up against them from the place where they lay in ambush, and made a slaughter of them in such sort, as many fell down dead, and the remnant fled into the mountain, and they took all their spoils.

verses.raw: Thus was the marriage turned into mourning, and the noise of their melody into lamentation.
verses.text: Thus was the marriage turned into mourning, and the noise of their melody into lamentation.

verses.raw: So when they had avenged fully the blood of their brother, they turned again to the marsh of Jordan.
verses.text: So when they had avenged fully the blood of their brother, they turned again to the marsh of Jordan.

verses.raw: Now when Bacchides heard of this, he came on the sabbath day to the banks of Jordan with a great power.
verses.text: Now when Bacchides heard of this, he came on the sabbath day to the banks of Jordan with a great power.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan said to his company, Let us go up now and fight for our lives, for it stands not with us to day, as in time past:
verses.text: Then Jonathan said to his company, Let us go up now and fight for our lives, for it stands not with us to day, as in time past:

verses.raw: For, behold, the battle is before us and behind us, and the water of Jordan on this side and that side, the marsh likewise and wood, neither is there place for us to turn aside.
verses.text: For, behold, the battle is before us and behind us, and the water of Jordan on this side and that side, the marsh likewise and wood, neither is there place for us to turn aside.

verses.raw: Wherefore cry you now to heaven, that you may be delivered from the hand of your enemies.
verses.text: Wherefore cry you now to heaven, that you may be delivered from the hand of your enemies.

verses.raw: With that they joined battle, and Jonathan stretched forth his hand to smite Bacchides, but he turned back from him.
verses.text: With that they joined battle, and Jonathan stretched forth his hand to smite Bacchides, but he turned back from him.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan and they that were with him leapt into Jordan, and swam over to the other bank: howbeit the other passed not over Jordan to them.
verses.text: Then Jonathan and they that were with him leapt into Jordan, and swam over to the other bank: howbeit the other passed not over Jordan to them.

verses.raw: So there were slain of Bacchides’ side that day about a thousand men.
verses.text: So there were slain of Bacchides’ side that day about a thousand men.

verses.raw: Afterward returned Bacchides to Jerusalem and repaired the strong cites in Judea; the fort in Jericho, and Emmaus, and Bethhoron, and Beth-el, and Thamnatha, Pharathoni, and Taphon, these did he strengthen with high walls, with gates and with bars.
verses.text: Afterward returned Bacchides to Jerusalem and repaired the strong cites in Judea; the fort in Jericho, and Emmaus, and Bethhoron, and Beth-el, and Thamnatha, Pharathoni, and Taphon, these did he strengthen with high walls, with gates and with bars.

verses.raw: And in them he set a garrison, that they might work malice upon Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And in them he set a garrison, that they might work malice upon Yashar'el.

verses.raw: He fortified also the city Bethsura, and Gazera, and the tower, and put forces in them, and provision of victuals.
verses.text: He fortified also the city Bethsura, and Gazera, and the tower, and put forces in them, and provision of victuals.

verses.raw: Besides, he took the chief men’s sons in the country for hostages, and put them into the tower at Jerusalem to be kept.
verses.text: Besides, he took the chief men’s sons in the country for hostages, and put them into the tower at Jerusalem to be kept.

verses.raw: Moreover in the hundred fifty and third year, in the second month, Alcimus commanded that the wall of the inner court of the sanctuary should be pulled down; he pulled down also the works of the prophets
verses.text: Moreover in the hundred fifty and third year, in the second month, Alcimus commanded that the wall of the inner court of the sanctuary should be pulled down; he pulled down also the works of the prophets

verses.raw: And as he began to pull down, even at that time was Alcimus plagued, and his enterprizes hindered: for his mouth was stopped, and he was taken with a palsy, so that he could no more speak any thing, nor give order concerning his house.
verses.text: And as he began to pull down, even at that time was Alcimus plagued, and his enterprizes hindered: for his mouth was stopped, and he was taken with a palsy, so that he could no more speak any thing, nor give order concerning his house.

verses.raw: So Alcimus died at that time with great torment.
verses.text: So Alcimus died at that time with great torment.

verses.raw: Now when Bacchides saw that Alcimus was dead, he returned to the king: whereupon the land of Judea was in rest two years.
verses.text: Now when Bacchides saw that Alcimus was dead, he returned to the king: whereupon the land of Judea was in rest two years.

verses.raw: Then all the ungodly men held a council, saying, Behold, Jonathan and his company are at ease, and dwell without care: now therefore we will bring Bacchides hither, who shall take them all in one night.
verses.text: Then all the ungodly men held a council, saying, Behold, Jonathan and his company are at ease, and dwell without care: now therefore we will bring Bacchides hither, who shall take them all in one night.

verses.raw: So they went and consulted with him.
verses.text: So they went and consulted with him.

verses.raw: Then removed he, and came with a great host, and sent letters privily to his adherents in Judea, that they should take Jonathan and those that were with him: howbeit they could not, because their counsel was known to them.
verses.text: Then removed he, and came with a great host, and sent letters privily to his adherents in Judea, that they should take Jonathan and those that were with him: howbeit they could not, because their counsel was known to them.

verses.raw: Wherefore they took of the men of the country, that were authors of that mischief, about fifty persons, and slew them.
verses.text: Wherefore they took of the men of the country, that were authors of that mischief, about fifty persons, and slew them.

verses.raw: Afterward Jonathan, and Simon, and they that were with him, got them away to Bethbasi, which is in the wilderness, and they repaired the decays thereof, and made it strong.
verses.text: Afterward Jonathan, and Simon, and they that were with him, got them away to Bethbasi, which is in the wilderness, and they repaired the decays thereof, and made it strong.

verses.raw: Which thing when Bacchides knew, he gathered together all his host, and sent word to them that were of Judea.
verses.text: Which thing when Bacchides knew, he gathered together all his host, and sent word to them that were of Judea.

verses.raw: Then went he and laid siege against Bethbasi; and they fought against it a long season and made engines of war.
verses.text: Then went he and laid siege against Bethbasi; and they fought against it a long season and made engines of war.

verses.raw: But Jonathan left his brother Simon in the city, and went forth himself into the country, and with a certain number went he forth.
verses.text: But Jonathan left his brother Simon in the city, and went forth himself into the country, and with a certain number went he forth.

verses.raw: And he struck Odonarkes and his brothers, and the children of Phasiron in their tent.
verses.text: And he struck Odonarkes and his brothers, and the children of Phasiron in their tent.

verses.raw: And when he began to smite them, and came up with his forces, Simon and his company went out of the city, and burned up the engines of war,
verses.text: And when he began to smite them, and came up with his forces, Simon and his company went out of the city, and burned up the engines of war,

verses.raw: And fought against Bacchides, who was discomfited by them, and they afflicted him sore: for his counsel and travail was in vain.
verses.text: And fought against Bacchides, who was discomfited by them, and they afflicted him sore: for his counsel and travail was in vain.

verses.raw: Wherefore he was very wroth at the wicked men that gave him counsel to come into the country, inasmuch as he slew many of them, and purposed to return into his own country.
verses.text: Wherefore he was very wroth at the wicked men that gave him counsel to come into the country, inasmuch as he slew many of them, and purposed to return into his own country.

verses.raw: Of which when Jonathan had knowledge, he sent ambassadors to him, to the end he should make peace with him, and deliver them the prisoners.
verses.text: Of which when Jonathan had knowledge, he sent ambassadors to him, to the end he should make peace with him, and deliver them the prisoners.

verses.raw: Which thing he accepted, and did according to his demands, and sware to him that he would never do him harm all the days of his life.
verses.text: Which thing he accepted, and did according to his demands, and sware to him that he would never do him harm all the days of his life.

verses.raw: When therefore he had restored to him the prisoners that he had taken aforetime out of the land of Judea, he returned and went his way into his own land, neither came he any more into their borders.
verses.text: When therefore he had restored to him the prisoners that he had taken aforetime out of the land of Judea, he returned and went his way into his own land, neither came he any more into their borders.

verses.raw: Thus the sword ceased from Yashar'el (Israel): but Jonathan dwelt at Machmas, and began to govern the people; and he destroyed the ungodly men out of Yashar'el (Israel). ⸻
verses.text: Thus the sword ceased from Yashar'el: but Jonathan dwelt at Machmas, and began to govern the people; and he destroyed the ungodly men out of Yashar'el. ⸻

verses.raw: In the hundred and sixtieth year Alexander, the son of Antiochus surnamed Epiphanes, went up and took Ptolemais: for the people had received him, by means of which he reigned there,
verses.text: In the hundred and sixtieth year Alexander, the son of Antiochus surnamed Epiphanes, went up and took Ptolemais: for the people had received him, by means of which he reigned there,

verses.raw: Now when king Demetrius heard thereof, he gathered together an exceeding great host, and went forth against him to fight.
verses.text: Now when king Demetrius heard thereof, he gathered together an exceeding great host, and went forth against him to fight.

verses.raw: Moreover Demetrius sent letters to Jonathan with loving words, so as he magnified him.
verses.text: Moreover Demetrius sent letters to Jonathan with loving words, so as he magnified him.

verses.raw: For said he, Let us first make peace with him, before he join with Alexander against us:
verses.text: For said he, Let us first make peace with him, before he join with Alexander against us:

verses.raw: Else he will remember all the evils that we have done against him, and against his brothers and his people.
verses.text: Else he will remember all the evils that we have done against him, and against his brothers and his people.

verses.raw: Wherefore he gave him authority to gather together an host, and to provide weapons, that he might aid him in battle: he commanded also that the hostages that were in the tower should be delivered him.
verses.text: Wherefore he gave him authority to gather together an host, and to provide weapons, that he might aid him in battle: he commanded also that the hostages that were in the tower should be delivered him.

verses.raw: Then came Jonathan to Jerusalem, and read the letters in the audience of all the people, and of them that were in the tower:
verses.text: Then came Jonathan to Jerusalem, and read the letters in the audience of all the people, and of them that were in the tower:

verses.raw: Who were sore afraid, when they heard that the king had given him authority to gather together an host.
verses.text: Who were sore afraid, when they heard that the king had given him authority to gather together an host.

verses.raw: Whereupon they of the tower delivered their hostages to Jonathan, and he delivered them to their parents.
verses.text: Whereupon they of the tower delivered their hostages to Jonathan, and he delivered them to their parents.

verses.raw: This done, Jonathan settled himself in Jerusalem, and began to build and repair the city.
verses.text: This done, Jonathan settled himself in Jerusalem, and began to build and repair the city.

verses.raw: And he commanded the workmen to build the walls and the mount Sion and about with square stones for fortification; and they did so.
verses.text: And he commanded the workmen to build the walls and the mount Sion and about with square stones for fortification; and they did so.

verses.raw: Then the strangers, that were in the fortresses which Bacchides had built, fled away;
verses.text: Then the strangers, that were in the fortresses which Bacchides had built, fled away;

verses.raw: Insomuch as every man left his place, and went into his own country.
verses.text: Insomuch as every man left his place, and went into his own country.

verses.raw: Only at Bethsura certain of those that had forsaken the law and the commandments remained still: for it was their place of refuge.
verses.text: Only at Bethsura certain of those that had forsaken the law and the commandments remained still: for it was their place of refuge.

verses.raw: Now when king Alexander had heard what promises Demetrius had sent to Jonathan: when also it was told him of the battles and noble acts which he and his brothers had done, and of the pains that they had endured,
verses.text: Now when king Alexander had heard what promises Demetrius had sent to Jonathan: when also it was told him of the battles and noble acts which he and his brothers had done, and of the pains that they had endured,

verses.raw: He said, Shall we find such another man? now therefore we will make him our friend and confederate.
verses.text: He said, Shall we find such another man? now therefore we will make him our friend and confederate.

verses.raw: Upon this he wrote a letter, and sent it to him, according to these words, saying,
verses.text: Upon this he wrote a letter, and sent it to him, according to these words, saying,

verses.raw: King Alexander to his brother Jonathan sends greeting:
verses.text: King Alexander to his brother Jonathan sends greeting:

verses.raw: We have heard of you, that you are a man of great power, and meet to be our friend.
verses.text: We have heard of you, that you are a man of great power, and meet to be our friend.

verses.raw: Wherefore now this day we ordain you to be the high priest of your nation, and to be called the king’s friend; (and therewithal he sent him a purple robe and a crown of gold:) and require you to take our part, and keep friendship with us.
verses.text: Wherefore now this day we ordain you to be the high priest of your nation, and to be called the king’s friend; (and therewithal he sent him a purple robe and a crown of gold:) and require you to take our part, and keep friendship with us.

verses.raw: So in the seventh month of the hundred and sixtieth year, at the feast of the tabernacles, Jonathan put on the holy robe, and gathered together forces, and provided much armour.
verses.text: So in the seventh month of the hundred and sixtieth year, at the feast of the tabernacles, Jonathan put on the holy robe, and gathered together forces, and provided much armour.

verses.raw: Of which when Demetrius heard, he was very sorry, and said,
verses.text: Of which when Demetrius heard, he was very sorry, and said,

verses.raw: What have we done, that Alexander has prevented us in making amity with the Yahudim (Jews) to strengthen himself?
verses.text: What have we done, that Alexander has prevented us in making amity with the Yahudim to strengthen himself?

verses.raw: I also will write to them words of encouragement, and promise them dignities and gifts, that I may have their aid.
verses.text: I also will write to them words of encouragement, and promise them dignities and gifts, that I may have their aid.

verses.raw: He sent to them therefore to this effect: King Demetrius to the people of the Yahudim (Jews) sends greeting:
verses.text: He sent to them therefore to this effect: King Demetrius to the people of the Yahudim sends greeting:

verses.raw: Whereas you have kept covenants with us, and continued in our friendship, not joining yourselves with our enemies, we have heard of this, and are glad.
verses.text: Whereas you have kept covenants with us, and continued in our friendship, not joining yourselves with our enemies, we have heard of this, and are glad.

verses.raw: Wherefore now continue you still to be faithful to us, and we will well recompense you for the things you do in our behalf,
verses.text: Wherefore now continue you still to be faithful to us, and we will well recompense you for the things you do in our behalf,

verses.raw: And will grant you many immunities, and give you rewards.
verses.text: And will grant you many immunities, and give you rewards.

verses.raw: And now do I free you, and for your sake I release all the Yahudim (Jews), from tributes, and from the customs of salt, and from crown taxes,
verses.text: And now do I free you, and for your sake I release all the Yahudim, from tributes, and from the customs of salt, and from crown taxes,

verses.raw: And from that which appertaineth to me to receive for the third part or the seed, and the half of the fruit of the trees, I release it from this day forth, so that they shall not be taken of the land of Judea, nor of the three governments which are added to it out of the country of Samaria and Galilee, from this day forth for evermore.
verses.text: And from that which appertaineth to me to receive for the third part or the seed, and the half of the fruit of the trees, I release it from this day forth, so that they shall not be taken of the land of Judea, nor of the three governments which are added to it out of the country of Samaria and Galilee, from this day forth for evermore.

verses.raw: Let Jerusalem also be holy and free, with the borders thereof, both from tenths and tributes.
verses.text: Let Jerusalem also be holy and free, with the borders thereof, both from tenths and tributes.

verses.raw: And as for the tower which is at Jerusalem, I yield up authority over it, and give the high priest, that he may set in it such men as he shall choose to keep it.
verses.text: And as for the tower which is at Jerusalem, I yield up authority over it, and give the high priest, that he may set in it such men as he shall choose to keep it.

verses.raw: Moreover I freely set at liberty every one of the Yahudim (Jews), that were carried captives out of the land of Judea into any part of my kingdom, and I will that all my officers remit the tributes even of their cattle.
verses.text: Moreover I freely set at liberty every one of the Yahudim, that were carried captives out of the land of Judea into any part of my kingdom, and I will that all my officers remit the tributes even of their cattle.

verses.raw: Furthermore I will that all the feasts, and sabbaths, and new moons, and solemn days, and the three days before the feast, and the three days after the feast shall be all of immunity and freedom for all the Yahudim (Jews) in my realm.
verses.text: Furthermore I will that all the feasts, and sabbaths, and new moons, and solemn days, and the three days before the feast, and the three days after the feast shall be all of immunity and freedom for all the Yahudim in my realm.

verses.raw: Also no man shall have authority to meddle with or to molest any of them in any matter.
verses.text: Also no man shall have authority to meddle with or to molest any of them in any matter.

verses.raw: I will further, that there be enrolled among the king’s forces about thirty thousand men of the Yahudim (Jews), to whom pay shall be given, as belongeth to all king’s forces.
verses.text: I will further, that there be enrolled among the king’s forces about thirty thousand men of the Yahudim, to whom pay shall be given, as belongeth to all king’s forces.

verses.raw: And of them some shall be placed in the king’s strong holds, of whom also some shall be set over the affairs of the kingdom, which are of trust: and I will that their overseers and governors be of themselves, and that they live after their own laws, even as the king has commanded in the land of Judea.
verses.text: And of them some shall be placed in the king’s strong holds, of whom also some shall be set over the affairs of the kingdom, which are of trust: and I will that their overseers and governors be of themselves, and that they live after their own laws, even as the king has commanded in the land of Judea.

verses.raw: And concerning the three governments that are added to Judea from the country of Samaria, let them be joined with Judea, that they may be reckoned to be under one, nor bound to obey other authority than the high priest’s.
verses.text: And concerning the three governments that are added to Judea from the country of Samaria, let them be joined with Judea, that they may be reckoned to be under one, nor bound to obey other authority than the high priest’s.

verses.raw: As for Ptolemais, and the land pertaining to it, I give it as a free gift to the sanctuary at Jerusalem for the necessary expences of the sanctuary.
verses.text: As for Ptolemais, and the land pertaining to it, I give it as a free gift to the sanctuary at Jerusalem for the necessary expences of the sanctuary.

verses.raw: Moreover I give every year fifteen thousand shekels of silver out of the king’s accounts from the places appertaining.
verses.text: Moreover I give every year fifteen thousand shekels of silver out of the king’s accounts from the places appertaining.

verses.raw: And all the overplus, which the officers payed not in as in former time, from henceforth shall be given toward the works of the temple.
verses.text: And all the overplus, which the officers payed not in as in former time, from henceforth shall be given toward the works of the temple.

verses.raw: And beside this, the five thousand shekels of silver, which they took from the uses of the temple out of the accounts year by year, even those things shall be released, because they appertain to the priests that minister.
verses.text: And beside this, the five thousand shekels of silver, which they took from the uses of the temple out of the accounts year by year, even those things shall be released, because they appertain to the priests that minister.

verses.raw: And whoever they be that flee to the temple at Jerusalem, or be within the liberties of this, being indebted to the king, or for any other matter, let them be at liberty, and all that they have in my realm.
verses.text: And whoever they be that flee to the temple at Jerusalem, or be within the liberties of this, being indebted to the king, or for any other matter, let them be at liberty, and all that they have in my realm.

verses.raw: For the building also and repairing of the works of the sanctuary expences shall be given of the king’s accounts.
verses.text: For the building also and repairing of the works of the sanctuary expences shall be given of the king’s accounts.

verses.raw: Yea, and for the building of the walls of Jerusalem, and the fortifying thereof round about, expences shall be given out of the king’s accounts, as also for the building of the walls in Judea.
verses.text: Yea, and for the building of the walls of Jerusalem, and the fortifying thereof round about, expences shall be given out of the king’s accounts, as also for the building of the walls in Judea.

verses.raw: Now when Jonathan and the people heard these words, they gave no credit to them, nor received them, because they remembered the great evil that he had done in Yashar'el (Israel); for he had afflicted them very sore.
verses.text: Now when Jonathan and the people heard these words, they gave no credit to them, nor received them, because they remembered the great evil that he had done in Yashar'el; for he had afflicted them very sore.

verses.raw: But with Alexander they were well pleased, because he was the first that entreated of true peace with them, and they were confederate with him always.
verses.text: But with Alexander they were well pleased, because he was the first that entreated of true peace with them, and they were confederate with him always.

verses.raw: Then gathered king Alexander great forces, and camped over against Demetrius.
verses.text: Then gathered king Alexander great forces, and camped over against Demetrius.

verses.raw: And after the two kings had joined battle, Demetrius’ host fled: but Alexander followed after him, and prevailed against them.
verses.text: And after the two kings had joined battle, Demetrius’ host fled: but Alexander followed after him, and prevailed against them.

verses.raw: And he continued the battle very sore until the sun went down: and that day was Demetrius slain.
verses.text: And he continued the battle very sore until the sun went down: and that day was Demetrius slain.

verses.raw: Afterward Alexander sent ambassadors to Ptolemee king of Egypt with a message to this effect:
verses.text: Afterward Alexander sent ambassadors to Ptolemee king of Egypt with a message to this effect:

verses.raw: Forasmuch as I am come again to my realm, and am set in the throne of my progenitors, and have gotten the dominion, and overthrown Demetrius, and recovered our country;
verses.text: Forasmuch as I am come again to my realm, and am set in the throne of my progenitors, and have gotten the dominion, and overthrown Demetrius, and recovered our country;

verses.raw: For after I had joined battle with him, both he and his host was discomfited by us, so that we sit in the throne of his kingdom:
verses.text: For after I had joined battle with him, both he and his host was discomfited by us, so that we sit in the throne of his kingdom:

verses.raw: Now therefore let us make a league of amity together, and give me now your daughter to wife: and I will be your son in law, and will give both you and her as according to your dignity.
verses.text: Now therefore let us make a league of amity together, and give me now your daughter to wife: and I will be your son in law, and will give both you and her as according to your dignity.

verses.raw: Then Ptolemee the king gave answer, saying, Happy be the day in which you did return into the land of your fathers, and satest in the throne of their kingdom.
verses.text: Then Ptolemee the king gave answer, saying, Happy be the day in which you did return into the land of your fathers, and satest in the throne of their kingdom.

verses.raw: And now will I do to you, as you have written: meet me therefore at Ptolemais, that we may see one another; for I will marry my daughter to you according to your desire.
verses.text: And now will I do to you, as you have written: meet me therefore at Ptolemais, that we may see one another; for I will marry my daughter to you according to your desire.

verses.raw: So Ptolemee went out of Egypt with his daughter Cleopatra, and they came to Ptolemais in the hundred threescore and second year:
verses.text: So Ptolemee went out of Egypt with his daughter Cleopatra, and they came to Ptolemais in the hundred threescore and second year:

verses.raw: Where king Alexander meeting him, he gave to him his daughter Cleopatra, and celebrated her marriage at Ptolemais with great glory, as the manner of kings is.
verses.text: Where king Alexander meeting him, he gave to him his daughter Cleopatra, and celebrated her marriage at Ptolemais with great glory, as the manner of kings is.

verses.raw: Now king Alexander had written to Jonathan, that he should come and meet him.
verses.text: Now king Alexander had written to Jonathan, that he should come and meet him.

verses.raw: Who thereupon went honourably to Ptolemais, where he met the two kings, and gave them and their friends silver and gold, and many presents, and found favour in their sight.
verses.text: Who thereupon went honourably to Ptolemais, where he met the two kings, and gave them and their friends silver and gold, and many presents, and found favour in their sight.

verses.raw: At that time certain pestilent fellows of Yashar'el (Israel), men of a wicked life, assembled themselves against him, to accuse him: but the king would not hear them.
verses.text: At that time certain pestilent fellows of Yashar'el, men of a wicked life, assembled themselves against him, to accuse him: but the king would not hear them.

verses.raw: Yea more than that, the king commanded to take off his garments, and clothe him in purple: and they did so.
verses.text: Yea more than that, the king commanded to take off his garments, and clothe him in purple: and they did so.

verses.raw: And he made him sit by himself, and said to his princes, Go with him into the midst of the city, and make proclamation, that no man complain against him of any matter, and that no man trouble him for any manner of cause.
verses.text: And he made him sit by himself, and said to his princes, Go with him into the midst of the city, and make proclamation, that no man complain against him of any matter, and that no man trouble him for any manner of cause.

verses.raw: Now when his accusers saw that he was honored according to the proclamation, and clothed in purple, they fled all away.
verses.text: Now when his accusers saw that he was honored according to the proclamation, and clothed in purple, they fled all away.

verses.raw: So the king honoured him, and wrote him among his chief friends, and made him a duke, and partaker of his dominion.
verses.text: So the king honoured him, and wrote him among his chief friends, and made him a duke, and partaker of his dominion.

verses.raw: Afterward Jonathan returned to Jerusalem with peace and gladness.
verses.text: Afterward Jonathan returned to Jerusalem with peace and gladness.

verses.raw: Furthermore in the hundred threescore and fifth year came Demetrius son of Demetrius out of Crete into the land of his fathers:
verses.text: Furthermore in the hundred threescore and fifth year came Demetrius son of Demetrius out of Crete into the land of his fathers:

verses.raw: Of which when king Alexander heard tell, he was right sorry, and returned into Antioch.
verses.text: Of which when king Alexander heard tell, he was right sorry, and returned into Antioch.

verses.raw: Then Demetrius made Apollonius the governor of Celosyria his general, who gathered together a great host, and camped in Jamnia, and sent to Jonathan the high priest, saying,
verses.text: Then Demetrius made Apollonius the governor of Celosyria his general, who gathered together a great host, and camped in Jamnia, and sent to Jonathan the high priest, saying,

verses.raw: You alone liftest up thyself against us, and I am laughed to scorn for your sake, and reproached: and why do you vaunt your power against us in the mountains?
verses.text: You alone liftest up thyself against us, and I am laughed to scorn for your sake, and reproached: and why do you vaunt your power against us in the mountains?

verses.raw: Now therefore, if you trustest in your own strength, come down to us into the plain field, and there let us try the matter together: for with me is the power of the cities.
verses.text: Now therefore, if you trustest in your own strength, come down to us into the plain field, and there let us try the matter together: for with me is the power of the cities.

verses.raw: Ask and learn who I am, and the rest that take our part, and they shall tell you that your foot is not able to stand before our face; for your fathers have been twice put to flight in their own land.
verses.text: Ask and learn who I am, and the rest that take our part, and they shall tell you that your foot is not able to stand before our face; for your fathers have been twice put to flight in their own land.

verses.raw: Wherefore now you shall not be able to abide the horsemen and so great a power in the plain, where is neither stone nor flint, nor place to flee to.
verses.text: Wherefore now you shall not be able to abide the horsemen and so great a power in the plain, where is neither stone nor flint, nor place to flee to.

verses.raw: So when Jonathan heard these words of Apollonius, he was moved in his mind, and choosing ten thousand men he went out of Jerusalem, where Simon his brother met him for to help him.
verses.text: So when Jonathan heard these words of Apollonius, he was moved in his mind, and choosing ten thousand men he went out of Jerusalem, where Simon his brother met him for to help him.

verses.raw: And he pitched his tents against Joppa: but; they of Joppa shut him out of the city, because Apollonius had a garrison there.
verses.text: And he pitched his tents against Joppa: but; they of Joppa shut him out of the city, because Apollonius had a garrison there.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan laid siege to it: whereupon they of the city let him in for fear: and so Jonathan won Joppa.
verses.text: Then Jonathan laid siege to it: whereupon they of the city let him in for fear: and so Jonathan won Joppa.

verses.raw: Of which when Apollonius heard, he took three thousand horsemen, with a great host of footmen, and went to Azotus as one that journeyed, and therewithal drew him forth into the plain. because he had a great number of horsemen, in whom he put his trust.
verses.text: Of which when Apollonius heard, he took three thousand horsemen, with a great host of footmen, and went to Azotus as one that journeyed, and therewithal drew him forth into the plain. because he had a great number of horsemen, in whom he put his trust.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan followed after him to Azotus, where the armies joined battle.
verses.text: Then Jonathan followed after him to Azotus, where the armies joined battle.

verses.raw: Now Apollonius had left a thousand horsemen in ambush.
verses.text: Now Apollonius had left a thousand horsemen in ambush.

verses.raw: And Jonathan knew that there was an ambushment behind him; for they had compassed in his host, and cast darts at the people, from morning till evening.
verses.text: And Jonathan knew that there was an ambushment behind him; for they had compassed in his host, and cast darts at the people, from morning till evening.

verses.raw: But the people stood still, as Jonathan had commanded them: and so the enemies’ horses were tired.
verses.text: But the people stood still, as Jonathan had commanded them: and so the enemies’ horses were tired.

verses.raw: Then brought Simon forth his host, and set them against the footmen, (for the horsemen were spent) who were discomfited by him, and fled.
verses.text: Then brought Simon forth his host, and set them against the footmen, (for the horsemen were spent) who were discomfited by him, and fled.

verses.raw: The horsemen also, being scattered in the field, fled to Azotus, and went into Bethdagon, their idol’s temple, for safety.
verses.text: The horsemen also, being scattered in the field, fled to Azotus, and went into Bethdagon, their idol’s temple, for safety.

verses.raw: But Jonathan set fire on Azotus, and the cities round about it, and took their spoils; and the temple of Dagon, with them that were fled into it, he burned with fire.
verses.text: But Jonathan set fire on Azotus, and the cities round about it, and took their spoils; and the temple of Dagon, with them that were fled into it, he burned with fire.

verses.raw: Thus there were burned and slain with the sword well nigh eight thousand men.
verses.text: Thus there were burned and slain with the sword well nigh eight thousand men.

verses.raw: And from thence Jonathan removed his host, and camped against Ascalon, where the men of the city came forth, and met him with great pomp.
verses.text: And from thence Jonathan removed his host, and camped against Ascalon, where the men of the city came forth, and met him with great pomp.

verses.raw: After this returned Jonathan and his host to Jerusalem, having any spoils.
verses.text: After this returned Jonathan and his host to Jerusalem, having any spoils.

verses.raw: Now when king Alexander heard these things, he honoured Jonathan yet more.
verses.text: Now when king Alexander heard these things, he honoured Jonathan yet more.

verses.raw: And sent him a buckle of gold, as the use is to be given to such as are of the king’s blood: he gave him also Accaron with the borders thereof in possession. ⸻
verses.text: And sent him a buckle of gold, as the use is to be given to such as are of the king’s blood: he gave him also Accaron with the borders thereof in possession. ⸻

verses.raw: And the king of Egypt gathered together a great host, like the sand that lieth upon the sea shore, and many ships, and went about through deceit to get Alexander’s kingdom, and join it to his own.
verses.text: And the king of Egypt gathered together a great host, like the sand that lieth upon the sea shore, and many ships, and went about through deceit to get Alexander’s kingdom, and join it to his own.

verses.raw: Whereupon he took his journey into Spain in peaceable manner, so as they of the cities opened to him, and met him: for king Alexander had commanded them so to do, because he was his brother in law.
verses.text: Whereupon he took his journey into Spain in peaceable manner, so as they of the cities opened to him, and met him: for king Alexander had commanded them so to do, because he was his brother in law.

verses.raw: Now as Ptolemee entered into the cities, he set in every one of them a garrison of soldiers to keep it.
verses.text: Now as Ptolemee entered into the cities, he set in every one of them a garrison of soldiers to keep it.

verses.raw: And when he came near to Azotus, they shewed him the temple of Dagon that was burnt, and Azotus and the suburbs thereof that were destroyed, and the bodies that were cast abroad and them that he had burnt in the battle; for they had made heaps of them by the way where he should pass.
verses.text: And when he came near to Azotus, they shewed him the temple of Dagon that was burnt, and Azotus and the suburbs thereof that were destroyed, and the bodies that were cast abroad and them that he had burnt in the battle; for they had made heaps of them by the way where he should pass.

verses.raw: Also they told the king whatsoever Jonathan had done, to the intent he might blame him: but the king held his peace.
verses.text: Also they told the king whatsoever Jonathan had done, to the intent he might blame him: but the king held his peace.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan met the king with great pomp at Joppa, where they saluted one another, and lodged.
verses.text: Then Jonathan met the king with great pomp at Joppa, where they saluted one another, and lodged.

verses.raw: Afterward Jonathan, when he had gone with the king to the river called Eleutherus, returned again to Jerusalem.
verses.text: Afterward Jonathan, when he had gone with the king to the river called Eleutherus, returned again to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: King Ptolemee therefore, having gotten the dominion of the cities by the sea to Seleucia upon the sea coast, imagined wicked counsels against Alexander.
verses.text: King Ptolemee therefore, having gotten the dominion of the cities by the sea to Seleucia upon the sea coast, imagined wicked counsels against Alexander.

verses.raw: Whereupon he sent ambasadors to king Demetrius, saying, Come, let us make a league between us, and I will give you my daughter whom Alexander has, and you shall reign in your father’s kingdom:
verses.text: Whereupon he sent ambasadors to king Demetrius, saying, Come, let us make a league between us, and I will give you my daughter whom Alexander has, and you shall reign in your father’s kingdom:

verses.raw: For I repent that I gave my daughter to him, for he sought to slay me.
verses.text: For I repent that I gave my daughter to him, for he sought to slay me.

verses.raw: Thus did he slander him, because he was desirous of his kingdom.
verses.text: Thus did he slander him, because he was desirous of his kingdom.

verses.raw: Wherefore he took his daughter from him, and gave her to Demetrius, and forsook Alexander, so that their hatred was openly known.
verses.text: Wherefore he took his daughter from him, and gave her to Demetrius, and forsook Alexander, so that their hatred was openly known.

verses.raw: Then Ptolemee entered into Antioch, where he set two crowns upon his head, the crown of Asia, and of Egypt.
verses.text: Then Ptolemee entered into Antioch, where he set two crowns upon his head, the crown of Asia, and of Egypt.

verses.raw: In the mean season was king Alexander in Cilicia, because those that dwelt in those parts had revolted from him.
verses.text: In the mean season was king Alexander in Cilicia, because those that dwelt in those parts had revolted from him.

verses.raw: But when Alexander heard of this, he came to war against him: whereupon king Ptolemee brought forth his host, and met him with a mighty power, and put him to flight.
verses.text: But when Alexander heard of this, he came to war against him: whereupon king Ptolemee brought forth his host, and met him with a mighty power, and put him to flight.

verses.raw: So Alexander fled into Arabia there to be defended; but king Ptolemee was exalted:
verses.text: So Alexander fled into Arabia there to be defended; but king Ptolemee was exalted:

verses.raw: For Zabdiel the Arabian took off Alexander’s head, and sent it to Ptolemee.
verses.text: For Zabdiel the Arabian took off Alexander’s head, and sent it to Ptolemee.

verses.raw: King Ptolemee also died the third day after, and they that were in the strong holds were slain one of another.
verses.text: King Ptolemee also died the third day after, and they that were in the strong holds were slain one of another.

verses.raw: By this means Demetrius reigned in the hundred threescore and seventh year.
verses.text: By this means Demetrius reigned in the hundred threescore and seventh year.

verses.raw: At the same time Jonathan gathered together them that were in Judea to take the tower that was in Jerusalem: and he made many engines of war against it.
verses.text: At the same time Jonathan gathered together them that were in Judea to take the tower that was in Jerusalem: and he made many engines of war against it.

verses.raw: Then came ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went to the king, and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower,
verses.text: Then came ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went to the king, and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower,

verses.raw: Of which when he heard, he was angry, and immediately removing, he came to Ptolemais, and wrote to Jonathan, that he should not lay siege to the tower, but come and speak with him at Ptolemais in great haste.
verses.text: Of which when he heard, he was angry, and immediately removing, he came to Ptolemais, and wrote to Jonathan, that he should not lay siege to the tower, but come and speak with him at Ptolemais in great haste.

verses.raw: Nevertheless Jonathan, when he heard this, commanded to besiege it still: and he chose certain of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel) and the priests, and put himself in peril;
verses.text: Nevertheless Jonathan, when he heard this, commanded to besiege it still: and he chose certain of the elders of Yashar'el and the priests, and put himself in peril;

verses.raw: And took silver and gold, and raiment, and divers presents besides, and went to Ptolemais to the king, where he found favour in his sight.
verses.text: And took silver and gold, and raiment, and divers presents besides, and went to Ptolemais to the king, where he found favour in his sight.

verses.raw: And though certain ungodly men of the people had made complaints against him,
verses.text: And though certain ungodly men of the people had made complaints against him,

verses.raw: Yet the king entreated him as his predecessors had done before, and promoted him in the sight of all his friends,
verses.text: Yet the king entreated him as his predecessors had done before, and promoted him in the sight of all his friends,

verses.raw: And confirmed him in the high priesthood, and in all the honours that he had before, and gave him preeminence among his chief friends.
verses.text: And confirmed him in the high priesthood, and in all the honours that he had before, and gave him preeminence among his chief friends.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan desired the king, that he would make Judea free from tribute, as also the three governments, with the country of Samaria; and he promised him three hundred talents.
verses.text: Then Jonathan desired the king, that he would make Judea free from tribute, as also the three governments, with the country of Samaria; and he promised him three hundred talents.

verses.raw: So the king consented, and wrote letters to Jonathan of all these things after this manner:
verses.text: So the king consented, and wrote letters to Jonathan of all these things after this manner:

verses.raw: King Demetrius to his brother Jonathan, and to the nation of the Yahudim (Jews), sends greeting:
verses.text: King Demetrius to his brother Jonathan, and to the nation of the Yahudim, sends greeting:

verses.raw: We send you here a copy of the letter which we did write to our cousin Lasthenes concerning you, that you might see it.
verses.text: We send you here a copy of the letter which we did write to our cousin Lasthenes concerning you, that you might see it.

verses.raw: King Demetrius to his father Lasthenes sends greeting:
verses.text: King Demetrius to his father Lasthenes sends greeting:

verses.raw: We are determined to do good to the people of the Yahudim (Jews), who are our friends, and keep covenants with us, because of their good will toward us.
verses.text: We are determined to do good to the people of the Yahudim, who are our friends, and keep covenants with us, because of their good will toward us.

verses.raw: Wherefore we have ratified to them the borders of Judea, with the three governments of Apherema and Lydda and Ramathem, that are added to Judea from the country of Samaria, and all things appertaining to them, for all such as do sacrifice in Jerusalem, instead of the payments which the king received of them yearly aforetime out of the fruits of the earth and of trees.
verses.text: Wherefore we have ratified to them the borders of Judea, with the three governments of Apherema and Lydda and Ramathem, that are added to Judea from the country of Samaria, and all things appertaining to them, for all such as do sacrifice in Jerusalem, instead of the payments which the king received of them yearly aforetime out of the fruits of the earth and of trees.

verses.raw: And as for other things that belong to us, of the tithes and customs pertaining to us, as also the saltpits, and the crown taxes, which are due to us, we discharge them of them all for their relief.
verses.text: And as for other things that belong to us, of the tithes and customs pertaining to us, as also the saltpits, and the crown taxes, which are due to us, we discharge them of them all for their relief.

verses.raw: And nothing of this shall be revoked from this time forth for ever.
verses.text: And nothing of this shall be revoked from this time forth for ever.

verses.raw: Now therefore see that you make a copy of these things, and let it be delivered to Jonathan, and set upon the holy mount in a conspicuous place.
verses.text: Now therefore see that you make a copy of these things, and let it be delivered to Jonathan, and set upon the holy mount in a conspicuous place.

verses.raw: After this, when king Demetrius saw that the land was quiet before him, and that no resistance was made against him, he sent away all his forces, every one to his own place, except certain bands of strangers, whom he had gathered from the isles of the heathen: wherefore all the forces of his fathers hated him.
verses.text: After this, when king Demetrius saw that the land was quiet before him, and that no resistance was made against him, he sent away all his forces, every one to his own place, except certain bands of strangers, whom he had gathered from the isles of the heathen: wherefore all the forces of his fathers hated him.

verses.raw: Moreover there was one Tryphon, that had been of Alexander’s part afore, who, seeing that all the host murmured against Demetrius, went to Simalcue the Arabian that brought up Antiochus the young son of Alexander,
verses.text: Moreover there was one Tryphon, that had been of Alexander’s part afore, who, seeing that all the host murmured against Demetrius, went to Simalcue the Arabian that brought up Antiochus the young son of Alexander,

verses.raw: And lay sore upon him to deliver him this young Antiochus, that he might reign in his father’s stead: he told him therefore all that Demetrius had done, and how his men of war were at enmity with him, and there he remained a long season.
verses.text: And lay sore upon him to deliver him this young Antiochus, that he might reign in his father’s stead: he told him therefore all that Demetrius had done, and how his men of war were at enmity with him, and there he remained a long season.

verses.raw: In the mean time Jonathan sent to king Demetrius, that he would cast those of the tower out of Jerusalem, and those also in the fortresses: for they fought against Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: In the mean time Jonathan sent to king Demetrius, that he would cast those of the tower out of Jerusalem, and those also in the fortresses: for they fought against Yashar'el.

verses.raw: So Demetrius sent to Jonathan, saying, I will not only do this for you and your people, but I will greatly honour you and your nation, if opportunity serve.
verses.text: So Demetrius sent to Jonathan, saying, I will not only do this for you and your people, but I will greatly honour you and your nation, if opportunity serve.

verses.raw: Now therefore you shall do well, if you send me men to help me; for all my forces are gone from me.
verses.text: Now therefore you shall do well, if you send me men to help me; for all my forces are gone from me.

verses.raw: Upon this Jonathan sent him three thousand strong men to Antioch: and when they came to the king, the king was very glad of their coming.
verses.text: Upon this Jonathan sent him three thousand strong men to Antioch: and when they came to the king, the king was very glad of their coming.

verses.raw: Howbeit they that were of the city gathered themselves together into the midst of the city, to the number of an hundred and twenty thousand men, and would have slain the king.
verses.text: Howbeit they that were of the city gathered themselves together into the midst of the city, to the number of an hundred and twenty thousand men, and would have slain the king.

verses.raw: Wherefore the king fled into the court, but they of the city kept the passages of the city, and began to fight.
verses.text: Wherefore the king fled into the court, but they of the city kept the passages of the city, and began to fight.

verses.raw: Then the king called to the Yahudim (Jews) for help, who came to him all at once, and dispersing themselves through the city slew that day in the city to the number of an hundred thousand.
verses.text: Then the king called to the Yahudim for help, who came to him all at once, and dispersing themselves through the city slew that day in the city to the number of an hundred thousand.

verses.raw: Also they set fire on the city, and got many spoils that day, and delivered the king.
verses.text: Also they set fire on the city, and got many spoils that day, and delivered the king.

verses.raw: So when they of the city saw that the Yahudim (Jews) had got the city as they would, their courage was abated: wherefore they made supplication to the king, and cried, saying,
verses.text: So when they of the city saw that the Yahudim had got the city as they would, their courage was abated: wherefore they made supplication to the king, and cried, saying,

verses.raw: Grant us peace, and let the Yahudim (Jews) cease from assaulting us and the city.
verses.text: Grant us peace, and let the Yahudim cease from assaulting us and the city.

verses.raw: With that they cast away their weapons, and made peace; and the Yahudim (Jews) were honoured in the sight of the king, and in the sight of all that were in his realm; and they returned to Jerusalem, having great spoils.
verses.text: With that they cast away their weapons, and made peace; and the Yahudim were honoured in the sight of the king, and in the sight of all that were in his realm; and they returned to Jerusalem, having great spoils.

verses.raw: So king Demetrius sat on the throne of his kingdom, and the land was quiet before him.
verses.text: So king Demetrius sat on the throne of his kingdom, and the land was quiet before him.

verses.raw: Nevertheless he dissembled in all that ever he spoke, and estranged himself from Jonathan, neither rewarded he him according to the benefits which he had received of him, but troubled him very sore.
verses.text: Nevertheless he dissembled in all that ever he spoke, and estranged himself from Jonathan, neither rewarded he him according to the benefits which he had received of him, but troubled him very sore.

verses.raw: After this returned Tryphon, and with him the young child Antiochus, who reigned, and was crowned.
verses.text: After this returned Tryphon, and with him the young child Antiochus, who reigned, and was crowned.

verses.raw: Then there gathered to him all the men of war, whom Demetrius had put away, and they fought against Demetrius, who turned his back and fled.
verses.text: Then there gathered to him all the men of war, whom Demetrius had put away, and they fought against Demetrius, who turned his back and fled.

verses.raw: Moreover Tryphon took the elephants, and won Antioch.
verses.text: Moreover Tryphon took the elephants, and won Antioch.

verses.raw: At that time young Antiochus wrote to Jonathan, saying, I confirm you in the high priesthood, and appoint you ruler over the four governments, and to be one of the king’s friends.
verses.text: At that time young Antiochus wrote to Jonathan, saying, I confirm you in the high priesthood, and appoint you ruler over the four governments, and to be one of the king’s friends.

verses.raw: Upon this he sent him golden vessels to be served in, and gave him leave to drink in gold, and to be clothed in purple, and to wear a golden buckle.
verses.text: Upon this he sent him golden vessels to be served in, and gave him leave to drink in gold, and to be clothed in purple, and to wear a golden buckle.

verses.raw: His brother Simon also he made captain from the place called The ladder of Tyrus to the borders of Egypt.
verses.text: His brother Simon also he made captain from the place called The ladder of Tyrus to the borders of Egypt.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan went forth, and passed through the cities beyond the water, and all the forces of Syria gathered themselves to him for to help him: and when he came to Ascalon, they of the city met him honourably.
verses.text: Then Jonathan went forth, and passed through the cities beyond the water, and all the forces of Syria gathered themselves to him for to help him: and when he came to Ascalon, they of the city met him honourably.

verses.raw: From whence he went to Gaza, but they of Gaza shut him out; wherefore he laid siege to it, and burned the suburbs thereof with fire, and spoiled them.
verses.text: From whence he went to Gaza, but they of Gaza shut him out; wherefore he laid siege to it, and burned the suburbs thereof with fire, and spoiled them.

verses.raw: Afterward, when they of Gaza made supplication to Jonathan, he made peace with them, and took the sons of their chief men for hostages, and sent them to Jerusalem, and passed through the country to Damascus.
verses.text: Afterward, when they of Gaza made supplication to Jonathan, he made peace with them, and took the sons of their chief men for hostages, and sent them to Jerusalem, and passed through the country to Damascus.

verses.raw: Now when Jonathan heard that Demetrius’ princes were come to Cades, which is in Galilee, with a great power, purposing to remove him out of the country,
verses.text: Now when Jonathan heard that Demetrius’ princes were come to Cades, which is in Galilee, with a great power, purposing to remove him out of the country,

verses.raw: He went to meet them, and left Simon his brother in the country.
verses.text: He went to meet them, and left Simon his brother in the country.

verses.raw: Then Simon encamped against Bethsura and fought against it a long season, and shut it up:
verses.text: Then Simon encamped against Bethsura and fought against it a long season, and shut it up:

verses.raw: But they desired to have peace with him, which he granted them, and then put them out from thence, and took the city, and set a garrison in it.
verses.text: But they desired to have peace with him, which he granted them, and then put them out from thence, and took the city, and set a garrison in it.

verses.raw: As for Jonathan and his host, they pitched at the water of Gennesar, from whence betimes in the morning they got them to the plain of Nasor.
verses.text: As for Jonathan and his host, they pitched at the water of Gennesar, from whence betimes in the morning they got them to the plain of Nasor.

verses.raw: And, behold, the host of strangers met them in the plain, who, having laid men in ambush for him in the mountains, came themselves over against him.
verses.text: And, behold, the host of strangers met them in the plain, who, having laid men in ambush for him in the mountains, came themselves over against him.

verses.raw: So when they that lay in ambush rose out of their places and joined battle, all that were of Jonathan’s side fled;
verses.text: So when they that lay in ambush rose out of their places and joined battle, all that were of Jonathan’s side fled;

verses.raw: Insomuch as there was not one of them left, except Mattathias the son of Absalom, and Judas the son of Calphi, the captains of the host.
verses.text: Insomuch as there was not one of them left, except Mattathias the son of Absalom, and Judas the son of Calphi, the captains of the host.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan rent his clothes, and cast earth upon his head, and prayed.
verses.text: Then Jonathan rent his clothes, and cast earth upon his head, and prayed.

verses.raw: Afterwards turning again to battle, he put them to flight, and so they ran away.
verses.text: Afterwards turning again to battle, he put them to flight, and so they ran away.

verses.raw: Now when his own men that were fled saw this, they turned again to him, and with him pursued them to Cades, even to their own tents, and there they camped.
verses.text: Now when his own men that were fled saw this, they turned again to him, and with him pursued them to Cades, even to their own tents, and there they camped.

verses.raw: So there were slain of the heathen that day about three thousand men: but Jonathan returned to Jerusalem. ⸻
verses.text: So there were slain of the heathen that day about three thousand men: but Jonathan returned to Jerusalem. ⸻

verses.raw: Now when Jonathan saw that time served him, he chose certain men, and sent them to Rome, for to confirm and renew the friendship that they had with them.
verses.text: Now when Jonathan saw that time served him, he chose certain men, and sent them to Rome, for to confirm and renew the friendship that they had with them.

verses.raw: He sent letters also to the Lacedemonians, and to other places, for the same purpose.
verses.text: He sent letters also to the Lacedemonians, and to other places, for the same purpose.

verses.raw: So they went to Rome, and entered into the senate, and said, Jonathan the high priest, and the people of the Yahudim (Jews), sent us to you, to the end you should renew the friendship, which you had with them, and league, as in former time.
verses.text: So they went to Rome, and entered into the senate, and said, Jonathan the high priest, and the people of the Yahudim, sent us to you, to the end you should renew the friendship, which you had with them, and league, as in former time.

verses.raw: Upon this the Romans gave them letters to the governors of every place that they should bring them into the land of Judea peaceably.
verses.text: Upon this the Romans gave them letters to the governors of every place that they should bring them into the land of Judea peaceably.

verses.raw: And this is the copy of the letters which Jonathan wrote to the Lacedemonians:
verses.text: And this is the copy of the letters which Jonathan wrote to the Lacedemonians:

verses.raw: Jonathan the high priest, and the elders of the nation, and the priests, and the other of the Yahudim (Jews), to the Lacedemonians their brothers send greeting:
verses.text: Jonathan the high priest, and the elders of the nation, and the priests, and the other of the Yahudim, to the Lacedemonians their brothers send greeting:

verses.raw: There were letters sent in times past to Onias the high priest from Darius, who reigned then among you, to signify that you are our brothers, as the copy here underwritten does specify.
verses.text: There were letters sent in times past to Onias the high priest from Darius, who reigned then among you, to signify that you are our brothers, as the copy here underwritten does specify.

verses.raw: At which time Onias entreated the ambassador that was sent honourably, and received the letters, in which declaration was made of the league and friendship.
verses.text: At which time Onias entreated the ambassador that was sent honourably, and received the letters, in which declaration was made of the league and friendship.

verses.raw: Therefore we also, albeit we need none of these things, that we have the holy books of scripture in our hands to comfort us,
verses.text: Therefore we also, albeit we need none of these things, that we have the holy books of scripture in our hands to comfort us,

verses.raw: Have nevertheless attempted to send to you for the renewing of brotherhood and friendship, lest we should become strangers to you altogether: for there is a long time passed since you sent to us.
verses.text: Have nevertheless attempted to send to you for the renewing of brotherhood and friendship, lest we should become strangers to you altogether: for there is a long time passed since you sent to us.

verses.raw: We therefore at all times without ceasing, both in our feasts, and other convenient days, do remember you in the sacrifices which we offer, and in our prayers, as reason is, and as it becometh us to think upon our brothers:
verses.text: We therefore at all times without ceasing, both in our feasts, and other convenient days, do remember you in the sacrifices which we offer, and in our prayers, as reason is, and as it becometh us to think upon our brothers:

verses.raw: And we are right glad of your honour.
verses.text: And we are right glad of your honour.

verses.raw: As for ourselves, we have had great troubles and wars on every side, forsomuch as the kings that are round about us have fought against us.
verses.text: As for ourselves, we have had great troubles and wars on every side, forsomuch as the kings that are round about us have fought against us.

verses.raw: Howbeit we would not be troublesome to you, nor to others of our confederates and friends, in these wars:
verses.text: Howbeit we would not be troublesome to you, nor to others of our confederates and friends, in these wars:

verses.raw: For we have help from heaven that succoureth us, so as we are delivered from our enemies, and our enemies are brought under foot.
verses.text: For we have help from heaven that succoureth us, so as we are delivered from our enemies, and our enemies are brought under foot.

verses.raw: For this cause we chose Numenius the son of Antiochus, and Antipater the son of Jason, and sent them to the Romans, to renew the amity that we had with them, and the former league.
verses.text: For this cause we chose Numenius the son of Antiochus, and Antipater the son of Jason, and sent them to the Romans, to renew the amity that we had with them, and the former league.

verses.raw: We commanded them also to go to you, and to salute and to deliver you our letters concerning the renewing of our brotherhood.
verses.text: We commanded them also to go to you, and to salute and to deliver you our letters concerning the renewing of our brotherhood.

verses.raw: Wherefore now you shall do well to give us an answer to it.
verses.text: Wherefore now you shall do well to give us an answer to it.

verses.raw: And this is the copy of the letters which Oniares sent.
verses.text: And this is the copy of the letters which Oniares sent.

verses.raw: Areus king of the Lacedemonians to Onias the high priest, greeting:
verses.text: Areus king of the Lacedemonians to Onias the high priest, greeting:

verses.raw: It is found in writing, that the Lacedemonians and Yahudim (Jews) are brothers, and that they are of the stock of Abraham:
verses.text: It is found in writing, that the Lacedemonians and Yahudim are brothers, and that they are of the stock of Abraham:

verses.raw: Now therefore, since this is come to our knowledge, you shall do well to write to us of your prosperity.
verses.text: Now therefore, since this is come to our knowledge, you shall do well to write to us of your prosperity.

verses.raw: We do write back again to you, that your cattle and goods are our’s, and our’s are your’s We do command therefore our ambassadors to make report to you on this wise.
verses.text: We do write back again to you, that your cattle and goods are our’s, and our’s are your’s We do command therefore our ambassadors to make report to you on this wise.

verses.raw: Now when Jonathan heard that Demebius’ princes were come to fight against him with a greater host than afore,
verses.text: Now when Jonathan heard that Demebius’ princes were come to fight against him with a greater host than afore,

verses.raw: He removed from Jerusalem, and met them in the land of Amathis: for he gave them no respite to enter his country.
verses.text: He removed from Jerusalem, and met them in the land of Amathis: for he gave them no respite to enter his country.

verses.raw: He sent spies also to their tents, who came again, and told him that they were appointed to come upon them in the night season.
verses.text: He sent spies also to their tents, who came again, and told him that they were appointed to come upon them in the night season.

verses.raw: Wherefore so soon as the sun was down, Jonathan commanded his men to watch, and to be in arms, that all the night long they might be ready to fight: also he sent forth centinels round about the host.
verses.text: Wherefore so soon as the sun was down, Jonathan commanded his men to watch, and to be in arms, that all the night long they might be ready to fight: also he sent forth centinels round about the host.

verses.raw: But when the adversaries heard that Jonathan and his men were ready for battle, they feared, and trembled in their hearts, and they kindled fires in their camp.
verses.text: But when the adversaries heard that Jonathan and his men were ready for battle, they feared, and trembled in their hearts, and they kindled fires in their camp.

verses.raw: Howbeit Jonathan and his company knew it not till the morning: for they saw the lights burning.
verses.text: Howbeit Jonathan and his company knew it not till the morning: for they saw the lights burning.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan pursued after them, but overtook them not: for they were gone over the river Eleutherus.
verses.text: Then Jonathan pursued after them, but overtook them not: for they were gone over the river Eleutherus.

verses.raw: Wherefore Jonathan turned to the Arabians, who were called Zabadeans, and struck them, and took their spoils.
verses.text: Wherefore Jonathan turned to the Arabians, who were called Zabadeans, and struck them, and took their spoils.

verses.raw: And removing thence, he came to Damascus, and so passed through all the country,
verses.text: And removing thence, he came to Damascus, and so passed through all the country,

verses.raw: Simon also went forth, and passed through the country to Ascalon, and the holds there adjoining, from whence he turned aside to Joppa, and won it.
verses.text: Simon also went forth, and passed through the country to Ascalon, and the holds there adjoining, from whence he turned aside to Joppa, and won it.

verses.raw: For he had heard that they would deliver the hold to them that took Demetrius’ part; wherefore he set a garrison there to keep it.
verses.text: For he had heard that they would deliver the hold to them that took Demetrius’ part; wherefore he set a garrison there to keep it.

verses.raw: After this came Jonathan home again, and calling the elders of the people together, he consulted with them about building strong holds in Judea,
verses.text: After this came Jonathan home again, and calling the elders of the people together, he consulted with them about building strong holds in Judea,

verses.raw: And making the walls of Jerusalem higher, and raising a great mount between the tower and the city, for to separate it from the city, that so it might be alone, that men might neither sell nor buy in it.
verses.text: And making the walls of Jerusalem higher, and raising a great mount between the tower and the city, for to separate it from the city, that so it might be alone, that men might neither sell nor buy in it.

verses.raw: Upon this they came together to build up the city, forasmuch as part of the wall toward the brook on the east side was fallen down, and they repaired that which was called Caphenatha.
verses.text: Upon this they came together to build up the city, forasmuch as part of the wall toward the brook on the east side was fallen down, and they repaired that which was called Caphenatha.

verses.raw: Simon also set up Adida in Sephela, and made it strong with gates and bars.
verses.text: Simon also set up Adida in Sephela, and made it strong with gates and bars.

verses.raw: Now Tryphon went about to get the kingdom of Asia, and to kill Antiochus the king, that he might set the crown upon his own head.
verses.text: Now Tryphon went about to get the kingdom of Asia, and to kill Antiochus the king, that he might set the crown upon his own head.

verses.raw: Howbeit he was afraid that Jonathan would not suffer him, and that he would fight against him; wherefore he sought a way how to take Jonathan, that he might kill him. So he removed, and came to Bethsan.
verses.text: Howbeit he was afraid that Jonathan would not suffer him, and that he would fight against him; wherefore he sought a way how to take Jonathan, that he might kill him. So he removed, and came to Bethsan.

verses.raw: Then Jonathan went out to meet him with forty thousand men chosen for the battle, and came to Bethsan.
verses.text: Then Jonathan went out to meet him with forty thousand men chosen for the battle, and came to Bethsan.

verses.raw: Now when Tryphon saw Jonathan came with so great a force, he durst not stretch his hand against him;
verses.text: Now when Tryphon saw Jonathan came with so great a force, he durst not stretch his hand against him;
