verses.text: And when I was feeding the flocks in Abel-Maul, the spirit of understanding of Yahuah came upon me, and I saw all men corrupting their way, and that unrighteousness had built for itself walls, and lawlessness sat upon towers.

verses.raw: And I was grieving for the race of the sons of men, and I prayed to Yahuah (Lord) that I might be saved.
verses.text: And I was grieving for the race of the sons of men, and I prayed to Yahuah that I might be saved.

verses.raw: Then there fell upon me a sleep, and I beheld a high mountain, and I was upon it.
verses.text: Then there fell upon me a sleep, and I beheld a high mountain, and I was upon it.

verses.raw: And behold the heavens were opened, and an angel of Elohim (God) said to me, Levi, enter.
verses.text: And behold the heavens were opened, and an angel of Elohim said to me, Levi, enter.

verses.raw: And I entered from the first heaven, and I saw there a great sea hanging.
verses.text: And I entered from the first heaven, and I saw there a great sea hanging.

verses.raw: And further I saw a second heaven far brighter and more brilliant, for there was a boundless light also therein.
verses.text: And further I saw a second heaven far brighter and more brilliant, for there was a boundless light also therein.

verses.raw: And I said to the angel, Why is this so? And the angel said to me, Marvel not at this, for thou shalt see another heaven more brilliant and incomparable.
verses.text: And I said to the angel, Why is this so? And the angel said to me, Marvel not at this, for thou shalt see another heaven more brilliant and incomparable.

verses.raw: And when thou hast ascended thither, Thou shalt stand near Yahuah (Lord), And shalt be His minister, And shalt declare His mysteries to men, And shalt proclaim concerning Him that shall redeem Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And when thou hast ascended thither, Thou shalt stand near Yahuah, And shalt be His minister, And shalt declare His mysteries to men, And shalt proclaim concerning Him that shall redeem Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And by thee and Yahudah (Judah) shall Yahuah (Lord) appear among men, [Saving every race of men].
verses.text: And by thee and Yahudah shall Yahuah appear among men, [Saving every race of men].

verses.raw: And from Yahuah's (Lord's) portion shall be thy life, And He shall be thy field and vineyard, And fruits, gold, and silver.
verses.text: And from Yahuah's (Lord's) portion shall be thy life, And He shall be thy field and vineyard, And fruits, gold, and silver.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Hear, therefore, regarding the heavens which have been shown to thee. The lowest is for this cause gloomy unto thee, in that it beholds all the unrighteous deeds of men.
verses.text: Hear, therefore, regarding the heavens which have been shown to thee. The lowest is for this cause gloomy unto thee, in that it beholds all the unrighteous deeds of men.

verses.raw: And it has fire, snow, and ice made ready for the day of judgment, in the righteous judgment of Elohim (God); for in it are all the spirits of the retributions for vengeance on men.
verses.text: And it has fire, snow, and ice made ready for the day of judgment, in the righteous judgment of Elohim; for in it are all the spirits of the retributions for vengeance on men.

verses.raw: And in the second are the hosts of the armies which are ordained for the day of judgment, to work vengeance on the spirits of deceit and of Beliar. And above them are the holy ones.
verses.text: And in the second are the hosts of the armies which are ordained for the day of judgment, to work vengeance on the spirits of deceit and of Beliar. And above them are the holy ones.

verses.raw: And in the highest of all dwelleth the Great Glory, far above all holiness.
verses.text: And in the highest of all dwelleth the Great Glory, far above all holiness.

verses.raw: In [the heaven next to] it are the archangels, who minister and make propitiation to Yahuah (Lord) for all the sins of ignorance of the righteous;
verses.text: In [the heaven next to] it are the archangels, who minister and make propitiation to Yahuah for all the sins of ignorance of the righteous;

verses.raw: Offering to Yahuah (Lord) a sweet-smelling savour, a reasonable and a bloodless offering.
verses.text: Offering to Yahuah a sweet-smelling savour, a reasonable and a bloodless offering.

verses.raw: And [in the heaven below this] are the angels who bear answers to the angels of the presence of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And [in the heaven below this] are the angels who bear answers to the angels of the presence of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And in [the heaven next to this] are thrones and dominions, in which always they offer praise to Elohim (God).
verses.text: And in [the heaven next to this] are thrones and dominions, in which always they offer praise to Elohim.

verses.raw: When, therefore, Yahuah (Lord) looketh upon us, all of us are shaken; yea, the heavens, and the earth, and the abysses are shaken at the presence of His majesty.
verses.text: When, therefore, Yahuah looketh upon us, all of us are shaken; yea, the heavens, and the earth, and the abysses are shaken at the presence of His majesty.

verses.raw: But the sons of men, having no perception of these things, sin and provoke the El Elyon (Most High).
verses.text: But the sons of men, having no perception of these things, sin and provoke the El Elyon.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Now, therefore, know that Yahuah (Lord) shall execute judgment upon the sons of men. Because when the rocks are being rent, And the sun quenched, And the waters dried up, And the fire cowering, And all creation troubled, And the invisible spirits melting away, And Hades taketh spoils through the visitations of the El Elyon (Most High), Men will be unbelieving and persist in their iniquity. On this account with punishment shall they be judged.
verses.text: Now, therefore, know that Yahuah shall execute judgment upon the sons of men. Because when the rocks are being rent, And the sun quenched, And the waters dried up, And the fire cowering, And all creation troubled, And the invisible spirits melting away, And Hades taketh spoils through the visitations of the El Elyon, Men will be unbelieving and persist in their iniquity. On this account with punishment shall they be judged.

verses.raw: Therefore the El Elyon (Most High) hath heard thy prayer, To separate thee from iniquity, and that thou shouldest become to Him a son, And a servant, and a minister of His presence.
verses.text: Therefore the El Elyon hath heard thy prayer, To separate thee from iniquity, and that thou shouldest become to Him a son, And a servant, and a minister of His presence.

verses.raw: The light of knowledge shalt thou light up in Jacob, And as the sun shalt thou be to all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: The light of knowledge shalt thou light up in Jacob, And as the sun shalt thou be to all the seed of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And there shall be given to thee a blessing, and to all thy seed, Until Yahuah (Lord) shall visit all the Gentiles in His tender mercies for ever.
verses.text: And there shall be given to thee a blessing, and to all thy seed, Until Yahuah shall visit all the Gentiles in His tender mercies for ever.

verses.raw: And therefore there have been given to thee counsel and understanding, That thou mightest instruct thy sons concerning this;
verses.text: And therefore there have been given to thee counsel and understanding, That thou mightest instruct thy sons concerning this;

verses.raw: Because they that bless Him shall be blessed, And they that curse Him shall perish.
verses.text: Because they that bless Him shall be blessed, And they that curse Him shall perish.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And thereupon the angel opened to me the gates of heaven, and I saw the holy temple, and upon a throne of glory the El Elyon (Most High).
verses.text: And thereupon the angel opened to me the gates of heaven, and I saw the holy temple, and upon a throne of glory the El Elyon.

verses.raw: And He said to me: Levi, I have given thee the blessings of the priesthood until I come and sojourn in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And He said to me: Levi, I have given thee the blessings of the priesthood until I come and sojourn in the midst of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Then the angel brought me down to the earth, and gave me a shield and a sword, and said to me: Execute vengeance on Shechem because of Dinah, thy sister, and I will be with thee because Yahuah (Lord) hath sent me.
verses.text: Then the angel brought me down to the earth, and gave me a shield and a sword, and said to me: Execute vengeance on Shechem because of Dinah, thy sister, and I will be with thee because Yahuah hath sent me.

verses.raw: And I destroyed at that time the sons of Hamor, as it is written in the heavenly tables.
verses.text: And I destroyed at that time the sons of Hamor, as it is written in the heavenly tables.

verses.raw: And I said to him: I pray Thee, O Yahuah (Lord), tell me Thy name, that I may call upon Thee in a day of tribulation.
verses.text: And I said to him: I pray Thee, O Yahuah, tell me Thy name, that I may call upon Thee in a day of tribulation.

verses.raw: And he said: I am the angel who intercedeth for the nation of Yashar'el (Israel) that they may not be smitten utterly, for every evil spirit attacketh it.
verses.text: And he said: I am the angel who intercedeth for the nation of Yashar'el that they may not be smitten utterly, for every evil spirit attacketh it.

verses.raw: And after these things I awaked, and blessed the El Elyon (Most High), and the angel who intercedeth for the nation of Yashar'el (Israel) and for all the righteous.
verses.text: And after these things I awaked, and blessed the El Elyon, and the angel who intercedeth for the nation of Yashar'el and for all the righteous.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And when I was going to my father, I found a brazen shield; wherefore also the name of the mountain is Aspis, which is near Gebal, to the south of Abila.
verses.text: And when I was going to my father, I found a brazen shield; wherefore also the name of the mountain is Aspis, which is near Gebal, to the south of Abila.

verses.raw: And I kept these words in my heart. And after this I counselled my father, and Reuben my brother, to bid the sons of Hamor not to be circumcised; for I was jealous because of the abomination which they had wrought on my sister.
verses.text: And I kept these words in my heart. And after this I counselled my father, and Reuben my brother, to bid the sons of Hamor not to be circumcised; for I was jealous because of the abomination which they had wrought on my sister.

verses.raw: And I slew Shechem first, and Simeon slew Hamor.
verses.text: And I slew Shechem first, and Simeon slew Hamor.

verses.raw: And after this my brothers came and smote that city with the edge of the sword.
verses.text: And after this my brothers came and smote that city with the edge of the sword.

verses.raw: And my father heard these things and was wroth, and he was grieved in that they had received the circumcision, and after that had been put to death, and in his blessings he looked amiss upon us.
verses.text: And my father heard these things and was wroth, and he was grieved in that they had received the circumcision, and after that had been put to death, and in his blessings he looked amiss upon us.

verses.raw: For we sinned because we had done this thing against his will, and he was sick on that day.
verses.text: For we sinned because we had done this thing against his will, and he was sick on that day.

verses.raw: But I saw that the sentence of Elohim (God) was for evil upon Shechem; for they sought to do to Sarah and Rebecca as they had done to Dinah our sister, but Yahuah (Lord) prevented them.
verses.text: But I saw that the sentence of Elohim was for evil upon Shechem; for they sought to do to Sarah and Rebecca as they had done to Dinah our sister, but Yahuah prevented them.

verses.raw: And they persecuted Abraham our father when he was a stranger, and they vexed his flocks when they were big with young; and Eblaen, who was born in his house, they most shamefully handled.
verses.text: And they persecuted Abraham our father when he was a stranger, and they vexed his flocks when they were big with young; and Eblaen, who was born in his house, they most shamefully handled.

verses.raw: And thus they did to all strangers, taking away their wives by force, and they banished them.
verses.text: And thus they did to all strangers, taking away their wives by force, and they banished them.

verses.raw: But the wrath of Yahuah (Lord) came upon them to the uttermost.
verses.text: But the wrath of Yahuah came upon them to the uttermost.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And I said to my father Jacob: By thee will Yahuah (Lord) destroy the Canaanites, and will give their land to thee and to thy seed after thee.
verses.text: And I said to my father Jacob: By thee will Yahuah destroy the Canaanites, and will give their land to thee and to thy seed after thee.

verses.raw: For from this day forward shall Shechem be called a city of imbeciles; for as a man mocketh a fool, so did we mock them,
verses.text: For from this day forward shall Shechem be called a city of imbeciles; for as a man mocketh a fool, so did we mock them,

verses.raw: Because also they had wrought folly in Yashar'el (Israel) by defiling my sister. And we departed and came to Bethel.
verses.text: Because also they had wrought folly in Yashar'el by defiling my sister. And we departed and came to Bethel.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And there again I saw a vision even as the former, after we had spent there seventy days.
verses.text: And there again I saw a vision even as the former, after we had spent there seventy days.

verses.raw: And I saw seven men in white raiment saying unto me: Arise, put on the robe of the priesthood, and the crown of righteousness, and the breastplate of understanding, and the garment of truth, and the plate of faith, and the turban of the head, and the ephod of prophecy.
verses.text: And I saw seven men in white raiment saying unto me: Arise, put on the robe of the priesthood, and the crown of righteousness, and the breastplate of understanding, and the garment of truth, and the plate of faith, and the turban of the head, and the ephod of prophecy.

verses.raw: And they severally carried (these things) and put (them) on me, and said unto me: From henceforth become a priest of Yahuah (Lord), thou and thy seed for ever.
verses.text: And they severally carried (these things) and put (them) on me, and said unto me: From henceforth become a priest of Yahuah, thou and thy seed for ever.

verses.raw: And the first anointed me with holy oil, and gave to me the staff of judgment.
verses.text: And the first anointed me with holy oil, and gave to me the staff of judgment.

verses.raw: The second washed me with pure water, and fed me with bread and wine (even) the most holy things, and clad me with a holy and glorious robe.
verses.text: The second washed me with pure water, and fed me with bread and wine (even) the most holy things, and clad me with a holy and glorious robe.

verses.raw: The third clothed me with a linen vestment like an ephod.
verses.text: The third clothed me with a linen vestment like an ephod.

verses.raw: The fourth put round me a girdle like unto purple.
verses.text: The fourth put round me a girdle like unto purple.

verses.raw: The fifth gave me a branch of rich olive.
verses.text: The fifth gave me a branch of rich olive.

verses.raw: The sixth placed a crown on my head.
verses.text: The sixth placed a crown on my head.

verses.raw: The seventh placed on my head a diadem of priesthood, and filled my hands with incense, that I might serve as priest to Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God).
verses.text: The seventh placed on my head a diadem of priesthood, and filled my hands with incense, that I might serve as priest to Yahuah Elohim.

verses.raw: And they said to me: Levi, thy seed shall be divided into three offices, for a sign of the glory of Yahuah (Lord) who is to come.
verses.text: And they said to me: Levi, thy seed shall be divided into three offices, for a sign of the glory of Yahuah who is to come.

verses.raw: And the first portion shall be great; yea, greater than it shall none be.
verses.text: And the first portion shall be great; yea, greater than it shall none be.

verses.raw: The second shall be in the priesthood.
verses.text: The second shall be in the priesthood.

verses.raw: And the third shall be called by a new name, because a king shall arise in Yahudah (Judah), and shall establish a new priesthood, after the fashion of the Gentiles [to all the Gentiles].
verses.text: And the third shall be called by a new name, because a king shall arise in Yahudah, and shall establish a new priesthood, after the fashion of the Gentiles [to all the Gentiles].

verses.raw: And His presence is beloved, as a prophet of the El Elyon (Most High), of the seed of Abraham our father.
verses.text: And His presence is beloved, as a prophet of the El Elyon, of the seed of Abraham our father.

verses.raw: Therefore, every desirable thing in Yashar'el (Israel) shall be for thee and for thy seed, And ye shall eat everything fair to look upon, And the table of Yahuah (Lord) shall thy seed apportion.
verses.text: Therefore, every desirable thing in Yashar'el shall be for thee and for thy seed, And ye shall eat everything fair to look upon, And the table of Yahuah shall thy seed apportion.

verses.raw: And some of them shall be high priests, and judges, and scribes; For by their mouth shall the holy place be guarded.
verses.text: And some of them shall be high priests, and judges, and scribes; For by their mouth shall the holy place be guarded.

verses.raw: And when I awoke, I understood that this (dream) was like the first dream.
verses.text: And when I awoke, I understood that this (dream) was like the first dream.

verses.raw: And I hid this also in my heart, and told it not to any man upon the earth.
verses.text: And I hid this also in my heart, and told it not to any man upon the earth.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And after two days I and Yahudah (Judah) went up with our father Jacob to Isaac our father's father.
verses.text: And after two days I and Yahudah went up with our father Jacob to Isaac our father's father.

verses.raw: And my father's father blessed me according to all the words of the visions which I had seen. And he would not come with us to Bethel.
verses.text: And my father's father blessed me according to all the words of the visions which I had seen. And he would not come with us to Bethel.

verses.raw: And when we came to Bethel, my father Jacob saw a vision concerning me, that I should be their priest unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: And when we came to Bethel, my father Jacob saw a vision concerning me, that I should be their priest unto Elohim.

verses.raw: And he rose up early in the morning, and paid tithes of all to Yahuah (Lord) through me.
verses.text: And he rose up early in the morning, and paid tithes of all to Yahuah through me.

verses.raw: And so we came to Hebron to dwell there.
verses.text: And so we came to Hebron to dwell there.

verses.raw: And Isaac called me continually to put me in remembrance of the law of Yahuah (Lord), even as the angel of Yahuah (Lord) showed unto me.
verses.text: And Isaac called me continually to put me in remembrance of the law of Yahuah, even as the angel of Yahuah showed unto me.

verses.raw: And he taught me the law of the priesthood, of sacrifices, whole burnt-offerings, first-fruits, freewill-offerings, peace-offerings.
verses.text: And he taught me the law of the priesthood, of sacrifices, whole burnt-offerings, first-fruits, freewill-offerings, peace-offerings.

verses.raw: And each day he was instructing me, and was busied on my behalf before Yahuah (Lord), and said to me:
verses.text: And each day he was instructing me, and was busied on my behalf before Yahuah, and said to me:

verses.raw: Beware of the spirit of fornication; for this shall continue and shall by thy seed pollute the holy place.
verses.text: Beware of the spirit of fornication; for this shall continue and shall by thy seed pollute the holy place.

verses.raw: Take, therefore, to thyself a wife without blemish or pollution, while yet thou art young, and not of the race of strange nations.
verses.text: Take, therefore, to thyself a wife without blemish or pollution, while yet thou art young, and not of the race of strange nations.

verses.raw: And before entering into the holy place, bathe; and when thou offerest the sacrifice, wash; and again, when thou finishest the sacrifice, wash.
verses.text: And before entering into the holy place, bathe; and when thou offerest the sacrifice, wash; and again, when thou finishest the sacrifice, wash.

verses.raw: Of twelve trees having leaves offer to Yahuah (Lord), as Abraham taught me also.
verses.text: Of twelve trees having leaves offer to Yahuah, as Abraham taught me also.

verses.raw: And of every clean beast and bird offer a sacrifice to Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And of every clean beast and bird offer a sacrifice to Yahuah.

verses.raw: And of all thy first-fruits and of wine offer the first, as a sacrifice to Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God); and every sacrifice thou shalt salt with salt.
verses.text: And of all thy first-fruits and of wine offer the first, as a sacrifice to Yahuah Elohim; and every sacrifice thou shalt salt with salt.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Now, therefore, observe whatsoever I command you, children; for whatsoever things I have heard from my fathers I have declared unto you.
verses.text: Now, therefore, observe whatsoever I command you, children; for whatsoever things I have heard from my fathers I have declared unto you.

verses.raw: And behold, I am clear from your ungodliness and transgression, which ye shall commit in the end of the ages [against the Saviour of the world, Messiah (Christ), acting godlessly], deceiving Yashar'el (Israel), and stirring up against it great evils from Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And behold, I am clear from your ungodliness and transgression, which ye shall commit in the end of the ages [against the Saviour of the world, Messiah, acting godlessly], deceiving Yashar'el, and stirring up against it great evils from Yahuah.

verses.raw: And ye shall deal lawlessly together with Yashar'el (Israel), so He shall not bear with Jerusalem because of your wickedness; but the veil of the temple shall be rent, so as not to cover your shame.
verses.text: And ye shall deal lawlessly together with Yashar'el, so He shall not bear with Jerusalem because of your wickedness; but the veil of the temple shall be rent, so as not to cover your shame.

verses.raw: And ye shall be scattered as captives among the Gentiles, and shall be for a reproach and for a curse there.
verses.text: And ye shall be scattered as captives among the Gentiles, and shall be for a reproach and for a curse there.

verses.raw: For the house which Yahuah (Lord) shall choose shall be called Jerusalem, as is contained in the book of Enoch the righteous.
verses.text: For the house which Yahuah shall choose shall be called Jerusalem, as is contained in the book of Enoch the righteous.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Therefore when I took a wife I was twenty-eight years old, and her name was Melcha.
verses.text: Therefore when I took a wife I was twenty-eight years old, and her name was Melcha.

verses.raw: And she conceived and bare a son, and I called his name Gersam, for we were sojourners in our land.
verses.text: And she conceived and bare a son, and I called his name Gersam, for we were sojourners in our land.

verses.raw: And I saw concerning him, that he would not be in the first rank.
verses.text: And I saw concerning him, that he would not be in the first rank.

verses.raw: And Kohath was born in the thirty-fifth year of my life, towards sunrise.
verses.text: And Kohath was born in the thirty-fifth year of my life, towards sunrise.

verses.raw: And I saw in a vision that he was standing on high in the midst of all the congregation.
verses.text: And I saw in a vision that he was standing on high in the midst of all the congregation.

verses.raw: Therefore I called his name Kohath [which is, beginning of majesty and instruction].
verses.text: Therefore I called his name Kohath [which is, beginning of majesty and instruction].

verses.raw: And she bare me a third son, Merari, in the fortieth year of my life; and since his mother bare him with difficulty, I called him Merari, that is my bitterness, because he also was like to die.
verses.text: And she bare me a third son, Merari, in the fortieth year of my life; and since his mother bare him with difficulty, I called him Merari, that is my bitterness, because he also was like to die.

verses.raw: And Jochebed was born in Egypt, in my sixty-fourth year, for I was renowned then in the midst of my brethren.
verses.text: And Jochebed was born in Egypt, in my sixty-fourth year, for I was renowned then in the midst of my brethren.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And Gersam took a wife, and she bare to him Lomni and Semei.
verses.text: And Gersam took a wife, and she bare to him Lomni and Semei.

verses.raw: And the sons of Kohath, Ambram, Issachar, Hebron, and Ozeel.
verses.text: And the sons of Kohath, Ambram, Issachar, Hebron, and Ozeel.

verses.raw: And the sons of Merari, Mooli and Mouses.
verses.text: And the sons of Merari, Mooli and Mouses.

verses.raw: And in my ninety-fourth year Ambram took Jochebed my daughter to him to wife, for they were born in one day, he and my daughter.
verses.text: And in my ninety-fourth year Ambram took Jochebed my daughter to him to wife, for they were born in one day, he and my daughter.

verses.raw: Eight years old was I when I went into the land of Canaan, and eighteen years when I slew Shechem, and at nineteen years I became priest, and at twenty-eight years I took a wife, and at forty-eight I went into Egypt.
verses.text: Eight years old was I when I went into the land of Canaan, and eighteen years when I slew Shechem, and at nineteen years I became priest, and at twenty-eight years I took a wife, and at forty-eight I went into Egypt.

verses.raw: And behold, my children, ye are a third generation.
verses.text: And behold, my children, ye are a third generation.

verses.raw: In my hundred-and-eighteenth year Joseph died.
verses.text: In my hundred-and-eighteenth year Joseph died.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, I command you: Fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God) with your whole heart, And walk in simplicity according to all His law.
verses.text: And now, my children, I command you: Fear Yahuah Elohaychem with your whole heart, And walk in simplicity according to all His law.

verses.raw: And do ye also teach your children letters, That they may have understanding all their life, Reading unceasingly the law of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And do ye also teach your children letters, That they may have understanding all their life, Reading unceasingly the law of Elohim.

verses.raw: For every one that knoweth the law of Yahuah (Lord) shall be honoured, And shall not be a stranger whithersoever he goeth.
verses.text: For every one that knoweth the law of Yahuah shall be honoured, And shall not be a stranger whithersoever he goeth.

verses.raw: Yea, many friends shall he gain more than his parents, And many men shall desire to serve him, And to hear the law from his mouth.
verses.text: Yea, many friends shall he gain more than his parents, And many men shall desire to serve him, And to hear the law from his mouth.

verses.raw: Work righteousness, therefore, my children, upon the earth, That ye may have (it) as a treasure in heaven.
verses.text: Work righteousness, therefore, my children, upon the earth, That ye may have (it) as a treasure in heaven.

verses.raw: And sow good things in your souls, That ye may find them in your life. But if ye sow evil things, Ye shall reap every trouble and affliction.
verses.text: And sow good things in your souls, That ye may find them in your life. But if ye sow evil things, Ye shall reap every trouble and affliction.

verses.raw: Get wisdom in the fear of Elohim (God) with diligence; For though there be a leading into captivity, And cities and lands be destroyed, And gold and silver and every possession perish, The wisdom of the wise naught can take away, Save the blindness of ungodliness, and the callousness (that comes) of sin.
verses.text: Get wisdom in the fear of Elohim with diligence; For though there be a leading into captivity, And cities and lands be destroyed, And gold and silver and every possession perish, The wisdom of the wise naught can take away, Save the blindness of ungodliness, and the callousness (that comes) of sin.

verses.raw: For if one keep oneself from these evil things, Then even among his enemies shall wisdom be a glory to him, And in a strange country a fatherland, And in the midst of foes shall prove a friend.
verses.text: For if one keep oneself from these evil things, Then even among his enemies shall wisdom be a glory to him, And in a strange country a fatherland, And in the midst of foes shall prove a friend.

verses.raw: Whosoever teaches noble things and does them, Shall be enthroned with kings, As was also Joseph my brother.
verses.text: Whosoever teaches noble things and does them, Shall be enthroned with kings, As was also Joseph my brother.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Therefore, my children, I have learnt that at the end of the ages ye will transgress against Yahuah (Lord), stretching out hands to wickedness [against Him]; and to all the Gentiles shall ye become a scorn.
verses.text: Therefore, my children, I have learnt that at the end of the ages ye will transgress against Yahuah, stretching out hands to wickedness [against Him]; and to all the Gentiles shall ye become a scorn.

verses.raw: For our father Yashar'el (Israel) is pure from the transgressions of the chief priests [who shall lay their hands upon the Saviour of the world].
verses.text: For our father Yashar'el is pure from the transgressions of the chief priests [who shall lay their hands upon the Saviour of the world].

verses.raw: For as the heaven is purer in Yahuah's (Lord's) sight than the earth, so also be ye, the lights of Yashar'el (Israel), (purer) than all the Gentiles.
verses.text: For as the heaven is purer in Yahuah's (Lord's) sight than the earth, so also be ye, the lights of Yashar'el, (purer) than all the Gentiles.

verses.raw: But if ye be darkened through transgressions, what, therefore, will all the Gentiles do living in blindness? Yea, ye shall bring a curse upon our race, because the light of the law which was given for to lighten every man, this ye desire to destroy by teaching commandments contrary to the ordinances of Elohim (God).
verses.text: But if ye be darkened through transgressions, what, therefore, will all the Gentiles do living in blindness? Yea, ye shall bring a curse upon our race, because the light of the law which was given for to lighten every man, this ye desire to destroy by teaching commandments contrary to the ordinances of Elohim.

verses.raw: The offerings of Yahuah (Lord) ye shall rob, and from His portion shall ye steal choice portions, eating (them) contemptuously with harlots.
verses.text: The offerings of Yahuah ye shall rob, and from His portion shall ye steal choice portions, eating (them) contemptuously with harlots.

verses.raw: And out of covetousness ye shall teach the commandments of Yahuah (Lord), wedded women shall ye pollute, and the virgins of Jerusalem shall ye defile; and with harlots and adulteresses shall ye be joined, and the daughters of the Gentiles shall ye take to wife, purifying them with an unlawful purification; and your union shall be like unto Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.text: And out of covetousness ye shall teach the commandments of Yahuah, wedded women shall ye pollute, and the virgins of Jerusalem shall ye defile; and with harlots and adulteresses shall ye be joined, and the daughters of the Gentiles shall ye take to wife, purifying them with an unlawful purification; and your union shall be like unto Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.raw: And ye shall be puffed up because of your priesthood, lifting yourselves up against men, and not only so, but also against the commands of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And ye shall be puffed up because of your priesthood, lifting yourselves up against men, and not only so, but also against the commands of Elohim.

verses.raw: For ye shall contemn the holy things with jests and laughter.
verses.text: For ye shall contemn the holy things with jests and laughter.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Therefore the temple, which Yahuah (Lord) shall choose, shall be laid waste through your uncleanness, and ye shall be captives throughout all nations.
verses.text: Therefore the temple, which Yahuah shall choose, shall be laid waste through your uncleanness, and ye shall be captives throughout all nations.

verses.raw: And ye shall be an abomination unto them, and ye shall receive reproach and everlasting shame from the righteous judgment of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And ye shall be an abomination unto them, and ye shall receive reproach and everlasting shame from the righteous judgment of Elohim.

verses.raw: And all who hate you shall rejoice at your destruction.
verses.text: And all who hate you shall rejoice at your destruction.

verses.raw: And if you were not to receive mercy through Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, our fathers, not one of our seed should be left upon the earth.
verses.text: And if you were not to receive mercy through Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, our fathers, not one of our seed should be left upon the earth.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now I have learnt that for seventy weeks ye shall go astray, and profane the priesthood, and pollute the sacrifices.
verses.text: And now I have learnt that for seventy weeks ye shall go astray, and profane the priesthood, and pollute the sacrifices.

verses.raw: And ye shall make void the law, and set at nought the words of the prophets by evil perverseness. And ye shall persecute righteous men, and hate the godly; the words of the faithful shall ye abhor.
verses.text: And ye shall make void the law, and set at nought the words of the prophets by evil perverseness. And ye shall persecute righteous men, and hate the godly; the words of the faithful shall ye abhor.

verses.raw: [And a man who reneweth the law in the power of the El Elyon (Most High), ye shall call a deceiver; and at last ye shall rush (upon him) to slay him, not knowing his dignity, taking innocent blood through wickedness upon your heads.]
verses.text: [And a man who reneweth the law in the power of the El Elyon, ye shall call a deceiver; and at last ye shall rush (upon him) to slay him, not knowing his dignity, taking innocent blood through wickedness upon your heads.]

verses.raw: And your holy places shall be laid waste even to the ground because of him.
verses.text: And your holy places shall be laid waste even to the ground because of him.

verses.raw: And ye shall have no place that is clean; but ye shall be among the Gentiles a curse and a dispersion until He shall again visit you, and in pity shall receive you [through faith and water].
verses.text: And ye shall have no place that is clean; but ye shall be among the Gentiles a curse and a dispersion until He shall again visit you, and in pity shall receive you [through faith and water].

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And whereas ye have heard concerning the seventy weeks, hear also concerning the priesthood.
verses.text: And whereas ye have heard concerning the seventy weeks, hear also concerning the priesthood.

verses.raw: For in each jubilee there shall be a priesthood. And in the first jubilee, the first who is anointed to the priesthood shall be great, and shall speak to Elohim (God) as to a father. And his priesthood shall be perfect with Yahuah (Lord), [and in the day of his gladness shall he arise for the salvation of the world].
verses.text: For in each jubilee there shall be a priesthood. And in the first jubilee, the first who is anointed to the priesthood shall be great, and shall speak to Elohim as to a father. And his priesthood shall be perfect with Yahuah, [and in the day of his gladness shall he arise for the salvation of the world].

verses.raw: In the second jubilee, he that is anointed shall be conceived in the sorrow of beloved ones; and his priesthood shall be honoured and shall be glorified by all.
verses.text: In the second jubilee, he that is anointed shall be conceived in the sorrow of beloved ones; and his priesthood shall be honoured and shall be glorified by all.

verses.raw: And the third priest shall be taken hold of by sorrow.
verses.text: And the third priest shall be taken hold of by sorrow.

verses.raw: And the fourth shall be in pain, because unrighteousness shall gather itself against him exceedingly, and all Yashar'el (Israel) shall hate each one his neighbour.
verses.text: And the fourth shall be in pain, because unrighteousness shall gather itself against him exceedingly, and all Yashar'el shall hate each one his neighbour.

verses.raw: The fifth shall be taken hold of by darkness.
verses.text: The fifth shall be taken hold of by darkness.

verses.raw: Likewise also the sixth and the seventh.
verses.text: Likewise also the sixth and the seventh.

verses.raw: And in the seventh shall be such pollution as I cannot express before men, for they shall know it who do these things.
verses.text: And in the seventh shall be such pollution as I cannot express before men, for they shall know it who do these things.

verses.raw: Therefore shall they be taken captive and become a prey, and their land and their substance shall be destroyed.
verses.text: Therefore shall they be taken captive and become a prey, and their land and their substance shall be destroyed.

verses.raw: And in the fifth week they shall return to their desolate country, and shall renew the house of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And in the fifth week they shall return to their desolate country, and shall renew the house of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And in the seventh week shall come priests, (who are) idolaters, adulterers, lovers of money, proud, lawless, lascivious, abusers of children and beasts.
verses.text: And in the seventh week shall come priests, (who are) idolaters, adulterers, lovers of money, proud, lawless, lascivious, abusers of children and beasts.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And after their punishment shall have come from Yahuah (Lord), the priesthood shall fail.
verses.text: And after their punishment shall have come from Yahuah, the priesthood shall fail.

verses.raw: Then shall Yahuah (Lord) raise up a new priest. And to him all the words of Yahuah (Lord) shall be revealed; And he shall execute a righteous judgment upon the earth for a multitude of days.
verses.text: Then shall Yahuah raise up a new priest. And to him all the words of Yahuah shall be revealed; And he shall execute a righteous judgment upon the earth for a multitude of days.

verses.raw: And his star shall arise in heaven as of a king, Lighting up the light of knowledge as the sun the day, And he shall be magnified in the world.
verses.text: And his star shall arise in heaven as of a king, Lighting up the light of knowledge as the sun the day, And he shall be magnified in the world.

verses.raw: He shall shine forth as the sun on the earth, And shall remove all darkness from under heaven, And there shall be peace in all the earth.
verses.text: He shall shine forth as the sun on the earth, And shall remove all darkness from under heaven, And there shall be peace in all the earth.

verses.raw: The heavens shall exult in his days, And the earth shall be glad, And the clouds shall rejoice; [And the knowledge of Yahuah (Lord) shall be poured forth upon the earth, as the water of the seas;] And the angels of the glory of the presence of Yahuah (Lord) shall be glad in him.
verses.text: The heavens shall exult in his days, And the earth shall be glad, And the clouds shall rejoice; [And the knowledge of Yahuah shall be poured forth upon the earth, as the water of the seas;] And the angels of the glory of the presence of Yahuah shall be glad in him.

verses.raw: The heavens shall be opened, And from the temple of glory shall come upon him sanctification, With the Father's voice as from Abraham to Isaac.
verses.text: The heavens shall be opened, And from the temple of glory shall come upon him sanctification, With the Father's voice as from Abraham to Isaac.

verses.raw: And the glory of the El Elyon (Most High) shall be uttered over him, And the spirit of understanding and sanctification shall rest upon him [in the water].
verses.text: And the glory of the El Elyon shall be uttered over him, And the spirit of understanding and sanctification shall rest upon him [in the water].

verses.raw: For he shall give the majesty of Yahuah (Lord) to His sons in truth for evermore; And there shall none succeed him for all generations for ever.
verses.text: For he shall give the majesty of Yahuah to His sons in truth for evermore; And there shall none succeed him for all generations for ever.

verses.raw: And in his priesthood the Gentiles shall be multiplied in knowledge upon the earth, And enlightened through the grace of Yahuah (Lord): In his priesthood shall sin come to an end, And the lawless shall cease to do evil. [And the just shall rest in him.]
verses.text: And in his priesthood the Gentiles shall be multiplied in knowledge upon the earth, And enlightened through the grace of Yahuah: In his priesthood shall sin come to an end, And the lawless shall cease to do evil. [And the just shall rest in him.]

verses.raw: And he shall open the gates of paradise, And shall remove the threatening sword against Adam.
verses.text: And he shall open the gates of paradise, And shall remove the threatening sword against Adam.

verses.raw: And he shall give to the saints to eat from the tree of life, And the spirit of holiness shall be on them.
verses.text: And he shall give to the saints to eat from the tree of life, And the spirit of holiness shall be on them.

verses.raw: And Beliar shall be bound by him, And he shall give power to His children to tread upon the evil spirits.
verses.text: And Beliar shall be bound by him, And he shall give power to His children to tread upon the evil spirits.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) shall rejoice in His children, And be well pleased in His beloved ones for ever.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall rejoice in His children, And be well pleased in His beloved ones for ever.

verses.raw: Then shall Abraham and Isaac and Jacob exult, And I will be glad; And all the saints shall clothe themselves with joy.
verses.text: Then shall Abraham and Isaac and Jacob exult, And I will be glad; And all the saints shall clothe themselves with joy.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, ye have heard all; choose, therefore, for yourselves either the light or the darkness, either the law of Yahuah (Lord) or the works of Beliar.
verses.text: And now, my children, ye have heard all; choose, therefore, for yourselves either the light or the darkness, either the law of Yahuah or the works of Beliar.

verses.raw: And his sons answered him, saying, Before Yahuah (Lord) we will walk according to His law.
verses.text: And his sons answered him, saying, Before Yahuah we will walk according to His law.

verses.raw: And their father said unto them, Yahuah (Lord) is witness, and His angels are witnesses, and ye are witnesses, and I am witness, concerning the word of your mouth. And his sons said unto him: We are witnesses.
verses.text: And their father said unto them, Yahuah is witness, and His angels are witnesses, and ye are witnesses, and I am witness, concerning the word of your mouth. And his sons said unto him: We are witnesses.

verses.raw: And thus Levi ceased commanding his sons; and he stretched out his feet on the bed, and was gathered to his fathers, after he had lived a hundred and thirty-seven years.
verses.text: And thus Levi ceased commanding his sons; and he stretched out his feet on the bed, and was gathered to his fathers, after he had lived a hundred and thirty-seven years.

verses.raw: And they laid him in a coffin, and afterwards they buried him in Hebron, with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.text: And they laid him in a coffin, and afterwards they buried him in Hebron, with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the words of Yahudah (Judah), what things he spake to his sons before he died.
verses.text: The copy of the words of Yahudah, what things he spake to his sons before he died.

verses.raw: They gathered themselves together, therefore, and came to him, and he said to them:
verses.text: They gathered themselves together, therefore, and came to him, and he said to them:

verses.raw: Hearken, my children, to Yahudah (Judah) your father. I was the fourth son born to my father Jacob; and Leah my mother named me Yahudah (Judah), saying, I give thanks to Yahuah (Lord), because He hath given me a fourth son also.
verses.text: Hearken, my children, to Yahudah your father. I was the fourth son born to my father Jacob; and Leah my mother named me Yahudah, saying, I give thanks to Yahuah, because He hath given me a fourth son also.

verses.raw: I was swift in my youth, and obedient to my father in everything.
verses.text: I was swift in my youth, and obedient to my father in everything.

verses.raw: And I honoured my mother and my mother's sister.
verses.text: And I honoured my mother and my mother's sister.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when I became a man, that my father blessed me, saying, Thou shalt be a king, prospering in all things.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when I became a man, that my father blessed me, saying, Thou shalt be a king, prospering in all things.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) showed me favour in all my works both in the field and in the house.
verses.text: And Yahuah showed me favour in all my works both in the field and in the house.

verses.raw: I know that I raced a hind, and caught it, and prepared the meat for my father, and he did eat.
verses.text: I know that I raced a hind, and caught it, and prepared the meat for my father, and he did eat.

verses.raw: And the roes I used to master in the chase, and overtake all that was in the plains. A wild mare I overtook, and caught it and tamed it.
verses.text: And the roes I used to master in the chase, and overtake all that was in the plains. A wild mare I overtook, and caught it and tamed it.

verses.raw: I slew a lion and plucked a kid out of its mouth. I took a bear by its paw and hurled it down the cliff, and it was crushed.
verses.text: I slew a lion and plucked a kid out of its mouth. I took a bear by its paw and hurled it down the cliff, and it was crushed.

verses.raw: I outran the wild boar, and seizing it 'as I ran', I tare it in sunder.
verses.text: I outran the wild boar, and seizing it 'as I ran', I tare it in sunder.

verses.raw: A leopard in Hebron leaped upon my dog, and I caught it by the tail, and hurled it on the rocks, and it was broken in twain.
verses.text: A leopard in Hebron leaped upon my dog, and I caught it by the tail, and hurled it on the rocks, and it was broken in twain.

verses.raw: I found a wild ox feeding in the fields, and seizing it by the horns, and whirling it round and stunning it, I cast it from me and slew it.
verses.text: I found a wild ox feeding in the fields, and seizing it by the horns, and whirling it round and stunning it, I cast it from me and slew it.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And when the two kings of the Canaanites came sheathed in armour against our flocks, and much people with them, single-handed I rushed upon the king of Hazor, and smote him on the greaves and dragged him down, and so I slew him.
verses.text: And when the two kings of the Canaanites came sheathed in armour against our flocks, and much people with them, single-handed I rushed upon the king of Hazor, and smote him on the greaves and dragged him down, and so I slew him.

verses.raw: And the other, the king of Tappuah, as he sat upon his horse, [I slew, and so I scattered all his people.
verses.text: And the other, the king of Tappuah, as he sat upon his horse, [I slew, and so I scattered all his people.

verses.raw: Achor the king] a man of giant stature 'I found', hurling javelins before and behind as he sat on horseback, and I took up a stone of sixty pounds weight, and hurled it and smote his horse, and killed it.
verses.text: Achor the king] a man of giant stature 'I found', hurling javelins before and behind as he sat on horseback, and I took up a stone of sixty pounds weight, and hurled it and smote his horse, and killed it.

verses.raw: And I fought with (this) other for two hours; and I clave his shield in twain, and I chopped off his feet, and killed him.
verses.text: And I fought with (this) other for two hours; and I clave his shield in twain, and I chopped off his feet, and killed him.

verses.raw: And as I was stripping off his breastplate, behold nine men his companions began to fight with me.
verses.text: And as I was stripping off his breastplate, behold nine men his companions began to fight with me.

verses.raw: And I wound my garment on my hand; and I slung stones at them, and killed four of them, and the rest fled.
verses.text: And I wound my garment on my hand; and I slung stones at them, and killed four of them, and the rest fled.

verses.raw: And Jacob my father slew 'Beelesath, king' of all the kings, a giant in strength, twelve cubits high.
verses.text: And Jacob my father slew 'Beelesath, king' of all the kings, a giant in strength, twelve cubits high.

verses.raw: And fear fell upon them, and they ceased warring against us.
verses.text: And fear fell upon them, and they ceased warring against us.

verses.raw: Therefore my father was free from anxiety in the wars when I was with my brethren.
verses.text: Therefore my father was free from anxiety in the wars when I was with my brethren.

verses.raw: For he saw in a vision 'concerning me' that an angel of might followed me everywhere, that I should not be overcome.
verses.text: For he saw in a vision 'concerning me' that an angel of might followed me everywhere, that I should not be overcome.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And in the south there came upon us a greater war than that in Shechem; and I joined in battle array with my brethren, and pursued a thousand men, and slew of them two hundred men and four kings.
verses.text: And in the south there came upon us a greater war than that in Shechem; and I joined in battle array with my brethren, and pursued a thousand men, and slew of them two hundred men and four kings.

verses.raw: And I went up upon the wall, and I slew four mighty men.
verses.text: And I went up upon the wall, and I slew four mighty men.

verses.raw: And so we captured Hazor, and took all the spoil.
verses.text: And so we captured Hazor, and took all the spoil.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: On the next day we departed to Aretan, a city strong and walled and inaccessible, threatening us with death.
verses.text: On the next day we departed to Aretan, a city strong and walled and inaccessible, threatening us with death.

verses.raw: But I and Gad approached on the east side of the city, and Reuben and Levi on the west.
verses.text: But I and Gad approached on the east side of the city, and Reuben and Levi on the west.

verses.raw: And they that were upon the wall, thinking that we were alone, 'were drawn down' against us.
verses.text: And they that were upon the wall, thinking that we were alone, 'were drawn down' against us.

verses.raw: And so my brothers secretly climbed up the wall on both sides by stakes, and entered the city, while the men knew it not.
verses.text: And so my brothers secretly climbed up the wall on both sides by stakes, and entered the city, while the men knew it not.

verses.raw: And we took it with the edge of the sword. And as for those who had taken refuge in the tower, we set fire to the tower and took both it and them.
verses.text: And we took it with the edge of the sword. And as for those who had taken refuge in the tower, we set fire to the tower and took both it and them.

verses.raw: And as we were departing the men of Tappuah seized our spoil, and seeing (this) we fought with them.
verses.text: And as we were departing the men of Tappuah seized our spoil, and seeing (this) we fought with them.

verses.raw: And we slew them all and recovered our spoil.
verses.text: And we slew them all and recovered our spoil.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And when I was at the waters of Kozeba, the men of 'Jobel' came against us to battle.
verses.text: And when I was at the waters of Kozeba, the men of 'Jobel' came against us to battle.

verses.raw: And we fought with them and routed them; 'and their allies from Shiloh we slew,' and we did not leave them 'power' to come in against us.
verses.text: And we fought with them and routed them; 'and their allies from Shiloh we slew,' and we did not leave them 'power' to come in against us.

verses.raw: And the men of 'Makir' came upon us the fifth day, to seize our spoil; and we attacked them and overcame them in fierce battle: for there was a host of mighty men amongst them, and we slew them before they had gone up the ascent.
verses.text: And the men of 'Makir' came upon us the fifth day, to seize our spoil; and we attacked them and overcame them in fierce battle: for there was a host of mighty men amongst them, and we slew them before they had gone up the ascent.

verses.raw: And when we came to their city their women rolled upon us stones from the brow of the hill on which the city stood.
verses.text: And when we came to their city their women rolled upon us stones from the brow of the hill on which the city stood.

verses.raw: And I and Simeon hid ourselves behind the town, and seized upon the heights, and destroyed this city also.
verses.text: And I and Simeon hid ourselves behind the town, and seized upon the heights, and destroyed this city also.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And the next day it was told us that the king of the city of Gaash with a mighty host was coming against us.
verses.text: And the next day it was told us that the king of the city of Gaash with a mighty host was coming against us.

verses.raw: I, therefore, and Dan feigned ourselves to be Amorites, and as allies went into their city.
verses.text: I, therefore, and Dan feigned ourselves to be Amorites, and as allies went into their city.

verses.raw: And in the depth of night our brethren came and we opened to them the gates; and we destroyed all the men and their substance, and we took for a prey all that was theirs, and their three walls we cast down.
verses.text: And in the depth of night our brethren came and we opened to them the gates; and we destroyed all the men and their substance, and we took for a prey all that was theirs, and their three walls we cast down.

verses.raw: And we drew near to Thamna, where was all the substance of the hostile kings.
verses.text: And we drew near to Thamna, where was all the substance of the hostile kings.

verses.raw: Then being insulted by them, I was therefore wroth, and rushed against them to the summit; and they kept slinging against me stones and darts.
verses.text: Then being insulted by them, I was therefore wroth, and rushed against them to the summit; and they kept slinging against me stones and darts.

verses.raw: And had not Dan my brother aided me, they would have slain me.
verses.text: And had not Dan my brother aided me, they would have slain me.

verses.raw: We came upon them, therefore, with wrath, and they all fled; and passing by another way, they besought my father, and he made peace with them.
verses.text: We came upon them, therefore, with wrath, and they all fled; and passing by another way, they besought my father, and he made peace with them.

verses.raw: And we did to them no hurt, and they became tributary to us, and we restored to them their spoil.
verses.text: And we did to them no hurt, and they became tributary to us, and we restored to them their spoil.

verses.raw: And I built Thamna, and my father built Rabael.
verses.text: And I built Thamna, and my father built Rabael.

verses.raw: I was twenty years old when this war befell.
verses.text: I was twenty years old when this war befell.

verses.raw: And the Canaanites feared me and my brethren.
verses.text: And the Canaanites feared me and my brethren.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And I had much cattle, and I had for chief herdsman Iram the Adullamite.
verses.text: And I had much cattle, and I had for chief herdsman Iram the Adullamite.

verses.raw: And when I went to him I saw Barsaba, king of Adullam; 'and he spake unto us', and he made us a feast; and when I was heated he gave me his daughter Bathshua to wife.
verses.text: And when I went to him I saw Barsaba, king of Adullam; 'and he spake unto us', and he made us a feast; and when I was heated he gave me his daughter Bathshua to wife.

verses.raw: She bare me Er, and Onan, and Shelah; and two of them Yahuah (Lord) smote: for Shelah lived, and his children are ye.
verses.text: She bare me Er, and Onan, and Shelah; and two of them Yahuah smote: for Shelah lived, and his children are ye.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And eighteen years my father abode at peace with his brother Esau, and his sons with us, after that we came from Mesopotamia, from Laban.
verses.text: And eighteen years my father abode at peace with his brother Esau, and his sons with us, after that we came from Mesopotamia, from Laban.

verses.raw: And when eighteen years were fulfilled, in the fortieth year of my life, Esau, the brother of my father, came upon us with a mighty and strong people.
verses.text: And when eighteen years were fulfilled, in the fortieth year of my life, Esau, the brother of my father, came upon us with a mighty and strong people.

verses.raw: And Jacob smote Esau with an arrow, and he was taken up wounded on Mount Seir, and as he went he died at Anoniram.
verses.text: And Jacob smote Esau with an arrow, and he was taken up wounded on Mount Seir, and as he went he died at Anoniram.

verses.raw: And we pursued after the sons of Esau. Now they had a city with walls of iron and gates of brass; and we could not enter 'into it', and we encamped around, and besieged it.
verses.text: And we pursued after the sons of Esau. Now they had a city with walls of iron and gates of brass; and we could not enter 'into it', and we encamped around, and besieged it.

verses.raw: And when they opened not to us in twenty days, I set up a ladder 'in the sight of all', and with my shield upon my head I went up, sustaining the assaults of stones, upwards of three talents weight; and I slew four of their mighty men.
verses.text: And when they opened not to us in twenty days, I set up a ladder 'in the sight of all', and with my shield upon my head I went up, sustaining the assaults of stones, upwards of three talents weight; and I slew four of their mighty men.

verses.raw: And Reuben and Gad slew six others.
verses.text: And Reuben and Gad slew six others.

verses.raw: Then they asked from us terms of peace; and having taken counsel with our father, we received them as tributaries.
verses.text: Then they asked from us terms of peace; and having taken counsel with our father, we received them as tributaries.

verses.raw: And they gave us five hundred cors of wheat, five hundred baths of oil, five hundred measures of wine, 'until the famine,' when we went down into Egypt.
verses.text: And they gave us five hundred cors of wheat, five hundred baths of oil, five hundred measures of wine, 'until the famine,' when we went down into Egypt.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And after these things my son Er took to wife Tamar, from Mesopotamia, a daughter of Aram.
verses.text: And after these things my son Er took to wife Tamar, from Mesopotamia, a daughter of Aram.

verses.raw: Now Er was wicked, and he 'was in need' concerning Tamar, because she was not of the land of Canaan. And on the third night an angel of Yahuah (Lord) smote him.
verses.text: Now Er was wicked, and he 'was in need' concerning Tamar, because she was not of the land of Canaan. And on the third night an angel of Yahuah smote him.

verses.raw: And he had not known her according to the evil craftiness of his mother, for he did not wish to have children by her.
verses.text: And he had not known her according to the evil craftiness of his mother, for he did not wish to have children by her.

verses.raw: In the days' of the wedding-feast I gave Onan to her in marriage; and he also in wickedness knew her not, though he spent with her a year.
verses.text: In the days' of the wedding-feast I gave Onan to her in marriage; and he also in wickedness knew her not, though he spent with her a year.

verses.raw: And when I threatened him he went in unto her, but he spilled the seed on the ground, according to the command of his mother, and he also died through wickedness.
verses.text: And when I threatened him he went in unto her, but he spilled the seed on the ground, according to the command of his mother, and he also died through wickedness.

verses.raw: And I wished to give Shelah also to her, but his mother did not permit it; 'for she wrought evil against Tamar,' because she was not of the daughters of Canaan, as she also herself was.
verses.text: And I wished to give Shelah also to her, but his mother did not permit it; 'for she wrought evil against Tamar,' because she was not of the daughters of Canaan, as she also herself was.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And I knew that the race of the Canaanites was wicked, but the impulse of youth blinded my mind.
verses.text: And I knew that the race of the Canaanites was wicked, but the impulse of youth blinded my mind.

verses.raw: And when I saw her pouring out wine, owing to the intoxication of wine was I deceived, and took her although my father had not counselled (it).
verses.text: And when I saw her pouring out wine, owing to the intoxication of wine was I deceived, and took her although my father had not counselled (it).

verses.raw: And while I was away she went and took for Shelah a wife from Canaan.
verses.text: And while I was away she went and took for Shelah a wife from Canaan.

verses.raw: And when I knew what she had done, I cursed her in the anguish of my soul.
verses.text: And when I knew what she had done, I cursed her in the anguish of my soul.

verses.raw: And she also died through her wickedness together with her sons.
verses.text: And she also died through her wickedness together with her sons.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And after these things, while Tamar was a widow, she heard after two years that I was going up to shear my sheep, and adorned herself in bridal array, and sat in the city Enaim by the gate.
verses.text: And after these things, while Tamar was a widow, she heard after two years that I was going up to shear my sheep, and adorned herself in bridal array, and sat in the city Enaim by the gate.

verses.raw: For it was a law of the Amorites, that she who was about to marry should sit in fornication seven days by the gate.
verses.text: For it was a law of the Amorites, that she who was about to marry should sit in fornication seven days by the gate.

verses.raw: Therefore being drunk with wine, I did not recognise her; and her beauty deceived me, through the fashion of her adorning.
verses.text: Therefore being drunk with wine, I did not recognise her; and her beauty deceived me, through the fashion of her adorning.

verses.raw: And I turned aside to her, and said: Let me go in unto thee. And she said: What wilt thou give me? And I gave her my staff, and my girdle, and the diadem of my kingdom 'in pledge'. And I went in unto her, and she conceived.

verses.raw: And not knowing what I had done, I wished to slay her; but she privily sent my pledges, and put me to shame.
verses.text: And not knowing what I had done, I wished to slay her; but she privily sent my pledges, and put me to shame.

verses.raw: And when I called her, I heard also the secret words which 'I spoke' when lying with her in my drunkenness; and I could not slay her, because it was from Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And when I called her, I heard also the secret words which 'I spoke' when lying with her in my drunkenness; and I could not slay her, because it was from Yahuah.

verses.raw: For I said, Lest haply she did it in subtlety, having received the pledge from another woman.
verses.text: For I said, Lest haply she did it in subtlety, having received the pledge from another woman.

verses.raw: But I came not again near her while I lived, because I had done 'this' abomination in 'all' Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But I came not again near her while I lived, because I had done 'this' abomination in 'all' Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Moreover, they who were in the city said that there was no harlot in the gate, because she came from another place, and sat for a while in the gate.
verses.text: Moreover, they who were in the city said that there was no harlot in the gate, because she came from another place, and sat for a while in the gate.

verses.raw: And I thought that no one knew that I had gone in to her.
verses.text: And I thought that no one knew that I had gone in to her.

verses.raw: And after this we came into Egypt 'to Joseph', because of the famine.
verses.text: And after this we came into Egypt 'to Joseph', because of the famine.

verses.raw: And I was forty and six years old, and seventy and three years lived I in Egypt.
verses.text: And I was forty and six years old, and seventy and three years lived I in Egypt.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now I command you, my children, hearken 'to Yahudah (Judah) your father,' and keep my sayings to perform all the ordinances of Yahuah (Lord), and to obey the commands of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And now I command you, my children, hearken 'to Yahudah your father,' and keep my sayings to perform all the ordinances of Yahuah, and to obey the commands of Elohim.

verses.raw: And walk not after your lusts, nor in the imaginations of your thoughts in haughtiness of heart; and glory not in the deeds and strength of your youth, for this also is evil in the eyes of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And walk not after your lusts, nor in the imaginations of your thoughts in haughtiness of heart; and glory not in the deeds and strength of your youth, for this also is evil in the eyes of Yahuah.

verses.raw: Since I also gloried that in wars no comely woman's face ever enticed me, and reproved Reuben my brother concerning Bilhah, the wife of my father, the spirits of jealousy and of fornication arrayed themselves against me, until I lay with Bathshua the Canaanite, and Tamar, who was espoused to my sons.
verses.text: Since I also gloried that in wars no comely woman's face ever enticed me, and reproved Reuben my brother concerning Bilhah, the wife of my father, the spirits of jealousy and of fornication arrayed themselves against me, until I lay with Bathshua the Canaanite, and Tamar, who was espoused to my sons.

verses.raw: For I said to my father-in-law: I will take counsel with my father, and so will I take thy daughter. And he was unwilling, but he showed me a boundless store of gold in his daughter's behalf; for he was a king.
verses.text: For I said to my father-in-law: I will take counsel with my father, and so will I take thy daughter. And he was unwilling, but he showed me a boundless store of gold in his daughter's behalf; for he was a king.

verses.raw: And he adorned her with gold and pearls, and caused her to pour out wine for us at the feast 'with the beauty of women'.
verses.text: And he adorned her with gold and pearls, and caused her to pour out wine for us at the feast 'with the beauty of women'.

verses.raw: And the wine turned aside my eyes, and pleasure blinded my heart.
verses.text: And the wine turned aside my eyes, and pleasure blinded my heart.

verses.raw: And I became enamoured of and I lay with her, and transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) and the commandment of my fathers, and I took her to wife.
verses.text: And I became enamoured of and I lay with her, and transgressed the commandment of Yahuah and the commandment of my fathers, and I took her to wife.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) rewarded me according to the imagination of my heart, inasmuch as I had no joy in her children.
verses.text: And Yahuah rewarded me according to the imagination of my heart, inasmuch as I had no joy in her children.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, 'I say unto you,' be not drunk with wine; for wine turneth the mind away from the truth, and inspires the passion of lust, and leadeth the eyes into error.
verses.text: And now, my children, 'I say unto you,' be not drunk with wine; for wine turneth the mind away from the truth, and inspires the passion of lust, and leadeth the eyes into error.

verses.raw: For the spirit of fornication hath wine as a minister to give pleasure to the mind; for these two also take away the mind of man.
verses.text: For the spirit of fornication hath wine as a minister to give pleasure to the mind; for these two also take away the mind of man.

verses.raw: For if a man drink wine to drunkenness, it disturbeth the mind with filthy thoughts 'leading to fornication', and heateth the body to carnal union; and if the occasion of the lust be present, he worketh the sin, and is not ashamed.
verses.text: For if a man drink wine to drunkenness, it disturbeth the mind with filthy thoughts 'leading to fornication', and heateth the body to carnal union; and if the occasion of the lust be present, he worketh the sin, and is not ashamed.

verses.raw: Such is the inebriated man, my children; for he who is drunken reverenceth no man.
verses.text: Such is the inebriated man, my children; for he who is drunken reverenceth no man.

verses.raw: For, lo, it made me also to err, so that I was not ashamed of the multitude in the city, in that before the eyes of all I turned aside unto Tamar, and I wrought a great sin, and I uncovered the covering of my sons' shame.
verses.text: For, lo, it made me also to err, so that I was not ashamed of the multitude in the city, in that before the eyes of all I turned aside unto Tamar, and I wrought a great sin, and I uncovered the covering of my sons' shame.

verses.raw: After I had drunk wine I reverenced not the commandment of Elohim (God), and I took a woman of Canaan to wife.
verses.text: After I had drunk wine I reverenced not the commandment of Elohim, and I took a woman of Canaan to wife.

verses.raw: For much discretion needeth the man who drinketh wine, my children; and herein is discretion in drinking wine, a man may drink so long as he preserveth modesty.
verses.text: For much discretion needeth the man who drinketh wine, my children; and herein is discretion in drinking wine, a man may drink so long as he preserveth modesty.

verses.raw: But if he go beyond this limit the spirit of deceit attacketh his mind, and it maketh the drunkard to talk filthily, and to transgress and not to be ashamed, but even to glory in his shame, and account himself honourable.
verses.text: But if he go beyond this limit the spirit of deceit attacketh his mind, and it maketh the drunkard to talk filthily, and to transgress and not to be ashamed, but even to glory in his shame, and account himself honourable.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: He that committeth fornication is not aware when he suffers loss, and is not ashamed when put to dishonour.
verses.text: He that committeth fornication is not aware when he suffers loss, and is not ashamed when put to dishonour.

verses.raw: For even though a man be a king and commit fornication, he is stripped of his kingship by becoming the slave of fornication, as I myself also suffered.
verses.text: For even though a man be a king and commit fornication, he is stripped of his kingship by becoming the slave of fornication, as I myself also suffered.

verses.raw: For I gave my staff, that is, the stay of my tribe; and my girdle, that is, my power; and my diadem, that is, the glory of my kingdom.
verses.text: For I gave my staff, that is, the stay of my tribe; and my girdle, that is, my power; and my diadem, that is, the glory of my kingdom.

verses.raw: And indeed I repented of these things; wine and flesh I eat not until my old age, nor did I behold any joy.
verses.text: And indeed I repented of these things; wine and flesh I eat not until my old age, nor did I behold any joy.

verses.raw: And the angel of Elohim (God) showed me that for ever do women bear rule over king and beggar alike.
verses.text: And the angel of Elohim showed me that for ever do women bear rule over king and beggar alike.

verses.raw: And from the king they take away his glory, and from the valiant man his might, and from the beggar even that little which is the stay of his poverty.
verses.text: And from the king they take away his glory, and from the valiant man his might, and from the beggar even that little which is the stay of his poverty.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Observe, therefore, my children, the (right) limit in wine; for there are in it four evil spirits—of lust, of hot desire, of profligacy, of filthy lucre.
verses.text: Observe, therefore, my children, the (right) limit in wine; for there are in it four evil spirits—of lust, of hot desire, of profligacy, of filthy lucre.

verses.raw: If ye drink wine in gladness, be ye modest with the fear of Elohim (God). For if in (your) gladness the fear of Elohim (God) departeth, then drunkenness ariseth and shamelessness stealeth in.
verses.text: If ye drink wine in gladness, be ye modest with the fear of Elohim. For if in (your) gladness the fear of Elohim departeth, then drunkenness ariseth and shamelessness stealeth in.

verses.raw: But if you would live soberly do not touch wine at all, lest ye sin in words of outrage, and in fightings and slanders, and transgressions of the commandments of Elohim (God), and ye perish before your time.
verses.text: But if you would live soberly do not touch wine at all, lest ye sin in words of outrage, and in fightings and slanders, and transgressions of the commandments of Elohim, and ye perish before your time.

verses.raw: Moreover, wine revealeth the mysteries of Elohim (God) and men, even as I also revealed the commandments of Elohim (God) and the mysteries of Jacob my father to the Canaanitish woman Bathshua, which Elohim (God) bade me not to reveal.
verses.text: Moreover, wine revealeth the mysteries of Elohim and men, even as I also revealed the commandments of Elohim and the mysteries of Jacob my father to the Canaanitish woman Bathshua, which Elohim bade me not to reveal.

verses.raw: And wine is a cause both of war and confusion.
verses.text: And wine is a cause both of war and confusion.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now I command you, my children, not to love money, nor to gaze upon the beauty of women; because for the sake of money and beauty I was led astray to Bathshua the Canaanite.
verses.text: And now I command you, my children, not to love money, nor to gaze upon the beauty of women; because for the sake of money and beauty I was led astray to Bathshua the Canaanite.

verses.raw: [For I know that because of these two things shall my race fall into wickedness.
verses.text: [For I know that because of these two things shall my race fall into wickedness.

verses.raw: For even wise men among my sons shall they mar, and shall cause the kingdom of Yahudah (Judah) to be diminished, which Yahuah (Lord) gave me because of my obedience to my father.
verses.text: For even wise men among my sons shall they mar, and shall cause the kingdom of Yahudah to be diminished, which Yahuah gave me because of my obedience to my father.

verses.raw: For I never caused grief to Jacob, my father; for all things whatsoever he commanded I did.
verses.text: For I never caused grief to Jacob, my father; for all things whatsoever he commanded I did.

verses.raw: And Isaac, the father of my father, blessed me to be king in Yashar'el (Israel), and Jacob further blessed me in like manner.
verses.text: And Isaac, the father of my father, blessed me to be king in Yashar'el, and Jacob further blessed me in like manner.

verses.raw: And I know that from me shall the kingdom be established.
verses.text: And I know that from me shall the kingdom be established.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And I know what evils ye will do in the last days.]
verses.text: And I know what evils ye will do in the last days.]

verses.raw: Beware, therefore, my children, of fornication and the love of money, and hearken to Yahudah (Judah) your father.
verses.text: Beware, therefore, my children, of fornication and the love of money, and hearken to Yahudah your father.

verses.raw: For these things withdraw you from the law of Elohim (God), And blind the inclination of the soul, And teach arrogance, And suffer not a man to have compassion upon his neighbour.
verses.text: For these things withdraw you from the law of Elohim, And blind the inclination of the soul, And teach arrogance, And suffer not a man to have compassion upon his neighbour.

verses.raw: They rob his soul of all goodness, And oppress him with toils and troubles, 'And drive away sleep from him,' And devour his flesh.
verses.text: They rob his soul of all goodness, And oppress him with toils and troubles, 'And drive away sleep from him,' And devour his flesh.

verses.raw: And he hindereth the sacrifices of Elohim (God); 'And he remembereth not the blessing of Elohim (God),' He hearkeneth not to a prophet when he speaketh, And resenteth the words of godliness.
verses.text: And he hindereth the sacrifices of Elohim; 'And he remembereth not the blessing of Elohim,' He hearkeneth not to a prophet when he speaketh, And resenteth the words of godliness.

verses.raw: For he is a slave to two contrary passions, And cannot obey Elohim (God), Because they have blinded his soul, And he walketh in the day as in the night.
verses.text: For he is a slave to two contrary passions, And cannot obey Elohim, Because they have blinded his soul, And he walketh in the day as in the night.
