title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: My children, the love of money leadeth to idolatry; because, when led astray through money, men name as gods those who are not gods, and it causeth him who hath it to fall into madness.
verses.text: My children, the love of money leadeth to idolatry; because, when led astray through money, men name as gods those who are not gods, and it causeth him who hath it to fall into madness.

verses.raw: For the sake of money I lost my children, and had not my repentance, 'and my humiliation,' and the prayers of my father been accepted, I should have died childless.
verses.text: For the sake of money I lost my children, and had not my repentance, 'and my humiliation,' and the prayers of my father been accepted, I should have died childless.

verses.raw: But the Elohim (God) of my fathers had mercy on me, because I did it in ignorance.
verses.text: But the Elohim of my fathers had mercy on me, because I did it in ignorance.

verses.raw: And the prince of deceit blinded me, and I was ignorant as a man and as flesh, being corrupted through sins; 'and I learnt my own weakness while thinking myself invincible'.
verses.text: And the prince of deceit blinded me, and I was ignorant as a man and as flesh, being corrupted through sins; 'and I learnt my own weakness while thinking myself invincible'.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Know, therefore, my children, that two spirits wait upon man—the spirit of truth and the spirit of deceit.
verses.text: Know, therefore, my children, that two spirits wait upon man—the spirit of truth and the spirit of deceit.

verses.raw: And in the midst is the spirit of the understanding of the mind, to which it belongeth to turn whithersoever it will.
verses.text: And in the midst is the spirit of the understanding of the mind, to which it belongeth to turn whithersoever it will.

verses.raw: And the works of truth and the works of deceit are written upon the hearts of men, and each one of them Yahuah (Lord) knoweth.
verses.text: And the works of truth and the works of deceit are written upon the hearts of men, and each one of them Yahuah knoweth.

verses.raw: And there is no time at which the works of men can be hid; for on the heart itself have they been written down 'before the Lord'.
verses.text: And there is no time at which the works of men can be hid; for on the heart itself have they been written down 'before the Lord'.

verses.raw: And the spirit of truth testifieth all things, and accuseth all; and the sinner is burnt up 'by his own heart', and cannot raise his face 'to the judge'.
verses.text: And the spirit of truth testifieth all things, and accuseth all; and the sinner is burnt up 'by his own heart', and cannot raise his face 'to the judge'.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, I command you, love Levi, that ye may abide, and 'exalt not yourselves against him', lest ye be utterly destroyed.
verses.text: And now, my children, I command you, love Levi, that ye may abide, and 'exalt not yourselves against him', lest ye be utterly destroyed.

verses.raw: [For to me Yahuah (Lord) gave the kingdom, and to him the priesthood, and He set the kingdom beneath the priesthood.
verses.text: [For to me Yahuah gave the kingdom, and to him the priesthood, and He set the kingdom beneath the priesthood.

verses.raw: To me He gave the things upon the earth; to him the things in the heavens.
verses.text: To me He gave the things upon the earth; to him the things in the heavens.

verses.raw: As the heaven is higher than the earth, so is the priesthood of Elohim (God) higher than the earthly kingdom, unless it falls away through sin from Yahuah (Lord) and is dominated by the earthly kingdom.'
verses.text: As the heaven is higher than the earth, so is the priesthood of Elohim higher than the earthly kingdom, unless it falls away through sin from Yahuah and is dominated by the earthly kingdom.'

verses.raw: For 'the angel of Yahuah (Lord) said unto me': Yahuah (Lord) chose him rather than thee, to draw near to Him, and to eat of His table and to offer Him the first-fruits' of the choice things of the sons of Yashar'el (Israel); but thou shalt be king of Jacob.
verses.text: For 'the angel of Yahuah said unto me': Yahuah chose him rather than thee, to draw near to Him, and to eat of His table and to offer Him the first-fruits' of the choice things of the sons of Yashar'el; but thou shalt be king of Jacob.

verses.raw: And thou shalt be amongst them as the sea. For as, on the sea, just and unjust are tossed about, 'some taken into captivity while some are enriched,' so also shall every race of men be in thee: some shall be impoverished, being taken captive, 'and others grow rich by plundering the possessions of others'.
verses.text: And thou shalt be amongst them as the sea. For as, on the sea, just and unjust are tossed about, 'some taken into captivity while some are enriched,' so also shall every race of men be in thee: some shall be impoverished, being taken captive, 'and others grow rich by plundering the possessions of others'.

verses.raw: For the kings shall be as sea-monsters. They shall swallow men like fishes: The sons and daughters 'of freemen' shall they enslave; Houses, lands, flocks, money shall they plunder:
verses.text: For the kings shall be as sea-monsters. They shall swallow men like fishes: The sons and daughters 'of freemen' shall they enslave; Houses, lands, flocks, money shall they plunder:

verses.raw: And with the flesh of many shall they 'wrongfully' feed the ravens and the cranes; 'And they shall 'advance in evil, in covetousness uplifted,''
verses.text: And with the flesh of many shall they 'wrongfully' feed the ravens and the cranes; 'And they shall 'advance in evil, in covetousness uplifted,''

verses.raw: And there shall be false prophets 'like' tempests, And they shall persecute all righteous men.
verses.text: And there shall be false prophets 'like' tempests, And they shall persecute all righteous men.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) shall bring upon them divisions 'one against another,' And there shall be 'continual' wars in Yashar'el (Israel);
verses.text: And Yahuah shall bring upon them divisions 'one against another,' And there shall be 'continual' wars in Yashar'el;

verses.raw: And among men of another race shall my kingdom be brought to an end, Until the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) shall come, 'Until the appearing of the Elohim (God) of righteousness,' That Jacob [and all the Gentiles] may rest in peace.
verses.text: And among men of another race shall my kingdom be brought to an end, Until the salvation of Yashar'el shall come, 'Until the appearing of the Elohim of righteousness,' That Jacob [and all the Gentiles] may rest in peace.

verses.raw: And He shall guard the might of my kingdom for ever; For Yahuah (Lord) sware to me with an oath that He would not destroy the kingdom from my seed for ever.
verses.text: And He shall guard the might of my kingdom for ever; For Yahuah sware to me with an oath that He would not destroy the kingdom from my seed for ever.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Now I have much grief, my children, because of your lewdness and witchcrafts, and idolatries which ye shall practise 'against the kingdom', following them that have familiar spirits, diviners, and demons of error.
verses.text: Now I have much grief, my children, because of your lewdness and witchcrafts, and idolatries which ye shall practise 'against the kingdom', following them that have familiar spirits, diviners, and demons of error.

verses.raw: Ye shall make your daughters singing girls and harlots, and ye shall mingle in the abominations of the Gentiles.
verses.text: Ye shall make your daughters singing girls and harlots, and ye shall mingle in the abominations of the Gentiles.

verses.raw: For which things' sake Yahuah (Lord) shall bring upon you famine and pestilence, death and the sword, beleaguering by enemies, and revilings of friends, the slaughter of children, the rape of wives, the plundering of possessions, [the burning of the temple of Elohim (God),] the laying waste of the land, the enslavement of yourselves among the Gentiles.
verses.text: For which things' sake Yahuah shall bring upon you famine and pestilence, death and the sword, beleaguering by enemies, and revilings of friends, the slaughter of children, the rape of wives, the plundering of possessions, [the burning of the temple of Elohim,] the laying waste of the land, the enslavement of yourselves among the Gentiles.

verses.raw: And they shall make some of you eunuchs for their wives.
verses.text: And they shall make some of you eunuchs for their wives.

verses.raw: Until Yahuah (Lord) visit you, when with perfect heart ye repent and walk in all His commandments, and He bring you up from captivity among the Gentiles.
verses.text: Until Yahuah visit you, when with perfect heart ye repent and walk in all His commandments, and He bring you up from captivity among the Gentiles.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And after these things shall a star arise to you from Jacob in peace, And a man shall arise [from my seed], like the sun of righteousness, Walking with the sons of men in meekness and righteousness; And no sin shall be found in him.
verses.text: And after these things shall a star arise to you from Jacob in peace, And a man shall arise [from my seed], like the sun of righteousness, Walking with the sons of men in meekness and righteousness; And no sin shall be found in him.

verses.raw: And the heavens shall be opened unto him, To pour out the spirit, (even) the blessing of the Holy Father;
verses.text: And the heavens shall be opened unto him, To pour out the spirit, (even) the blessing of the Holy Father;

verses.raw: And He shall pour out the spirit of grace upon you; And ye shall be unto Him sons in truth, And ye shall walk in His commandments first and last.
verses.text: And He shall pour out the spirit of grace upon you; And ye shall be unto Him sons in truth, And ye shall walk in His commandments first and last.

verses.raw: [This Branch of Elohim (God) El Elyon (Most High), And this Fountain giving life unto all.]
verses.text: [This Branch of Elohim El Elyon, And this Fountain giving life unto all.]

verses.raw: Then shall the sceptre of my kingdom shine forth; And from your root shall arise a stem;
verses.text: Then shall the sceptre of my kingdom shine forth; And from your root shall arise a stem;

verses.raw: And from it shall grow a rod of righteousness to the Gentiles, To judge and to save all that call upon Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And from it shall grow a rod of righteousness to the Gentiles, To judge and to save all that call upon Yahuah.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And after these things shall Abraham and Isaac and Jacob arise unto life, and I and my brethren shall be chiefs of the tribes 'of Israel': Levi first, I the second, Joseph third, Benjamin fourth, Simeon fifth, Issachar sixth, and so all in order.
verses.text: And after these things shall Abraham and Isaac and Jacob arise unto life, and I and my brethren shall be chiefs of the tribes 'of Israel': Levi first, I the second, Joseph third, Benjamin fourth, Simeon fifth, Issachar sixth, and so all in order.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) blessed Levi, and the Angel of the Presence, me; the powers of glory, Simeon; the heaven, Reuben; the earth, Issachar; the sea, Zebulun; the mountains, Joseph; the tabernacle, Benjamin; the luminaries, Dan; Eden, Naphtali; the sun, Gad; the moon, Asher.
verses.text: And Yahuah blessed Levi, and the Angel of the Presence, me; the powers of glory, Simeon; the heaven, Reuben; the earth, Issachar; the sea, Zebulun; the mountains, Joseph; the tabernacle, Benjamin; the luminaries, Dan; Eden, Naphtali; the sun, Gad; the moon, Asher.

verses.raw: And ye shall be the people of Yahuah (Lord), and have one tongue; And there shall be there no spirit of deceit of 'Beliar', For he shall be cast into the fire for ever.
verses.text: And ye shall be the people of Yahuah, and have one tongue; And there shall be there no spirit of deceit of 'Beliar', For he shall be cast into the fire for ever.

verses.raw: And they who have died in grief shall arise 'in joy', 'And they who were poor for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall be made rich,' And they who are put to death for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall awake 'to life'.
verses.text: And they who have died in grief shall arise 'in joy', 'And they who were poor for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall be made rich,' And they who are put to death for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall awake 'to life'.

verses.raw: And the harts of Jacob shall run 'in joyfulness', And the eagles of Yashar'el (Israel) shall fly 'in gladness'; And all the peoples shall glorify Yahuah (Lord) for ever.
verses.text: And the harts of Jacob shall run 'in joyfulness', And the eagles of Yashar'el shall fly 'in gladness'; And all the peoples shall glorify Yahuah for ever.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Observe, therefore, my children, all the law of Yahuah (Lord), for there is hope for all them who hold fast unto His ways.
verses.text: Observe, therefore, my children, all the law of Yahuah, for there is hope for all them who hold fast unto His ways.

verses.raw: And 'he said to them: Behold,' I die before your eyes this day, a hundred and nineteen years old.
verses.text: And 'he said to them: Behold,' I die before your eyes this day, a hundred and nineteen years old.

verses.raw: Let no one bury me 'in costly apparel', nor tear open my bowels, for this shall they who are kings do; and carry me up to Hebron with you.
verses.text: Let no one bury me 'in costly apparel', nor tear open my bowels, for this shall they who are kings do; and carry me up to Hebron with you.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah), when he had said these things, fell asleep; and his sons did according to all whatsoever he commanded them, and they buried him in Hebron with his fathers.
verses.text: And Yahudah, when he had said these things, fell asleep; and his sons did according to all whatsoever he commanded them, and they buried him in Hebron with his fathers.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the words of Issachar. For he called his sons and said to them: Hearken, my children, to Issachar your father; Give ear to the words of him who is beloved of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: The copy of the words of Issachar. For he called his sons and said to them: Hearken, my children, to Issachar your father; Give ear to the words of him who is beloved of Yahuah.

verses.raw: I was born the 'fifth son to Jacob', by way of hire for the mandrakes.
verses.text: I was born the 'fifth son to Jacob', by way of hire for the mandrakes.

verses.raw: For Reuben 'my brother' brought in mandrakes from the field, and Rachel met him and took them.
verses.text: For Reuben 'my brother' brought in mandrakes from the field, and Rachel met him and took them.

verses.raw: And Reuben wept, and at his voice Leah my mother came forth.
verses.text: And Reuben wept, and at his voice Leah my mother came forth.

verses.raw: Now these (mandrakes) were 'sweet-smelling' apples which were produced in the land of Haran below a ravine of water.
verses.text: Now these (mandrakes) were 'sweet-smelling' apples which were produced in the land of Haran below a ravine of water.

verses.raw: And Rachel said: I will not give them to thee, but they shall be to me instead of children. 'For Yahuah (Lord) hath despised me, and I have not borne children to Jacob'.
verses.text: And Rachel said: I will not give them to thee, but they shall be to me instead of children. 'For Yahuah hath despised me, and I have not borne children to Jacob'.

verses.raw: Now there were two apples; and Leah said 'to Rachel': Let it suffice thee that thou hast taken my husband: wilt thou take these also?
verses.text: Now there were two apples; and Leah said 'to Rachel': Let it suffice thee that thou hast taken my husband: wilt thou take these also?

verses.raw: And Rachel said 'to her': Thou shalt have Jacob this night for the mandrakes 'of thy son'.
verses.text: And Rachel said 'to her': Thou shalt have Jacob this night for the mandrakes 'of thy son'.

verses.raw: And Leah said to her: Jacob is mine, for I am the wife of his youth.
verses.text: And Leah said to her: Jacob is mine, for I am the wife of his youth.

verses.raw: But Rachel said: Boast not, and vaunt not thyself; for he espoused me before thee, and for my sake he served our father fourteen years.
verses.text: But Rachel said: Boast not, and vaunt not thyself; for he espoused me before thee, and for my sake he served our father fourteen years.

verses.raw: And had not craft increased on the earth and the wickedness of men prospered, thou wouldest not now see the face of Jacob.
verses.text: And had not craft increased on the earth and the wickedness of men prospered, thou wouldest not now see the face of Jacob.

verses.raw: For thou art not his wife, but in craft wert taken to him in my stead.
verses.text: For thou art not his wife, but in craft wert taken to him in my stead.

verses.raw: And my father deceived me, 'and removed me on that night,' and did not suffer 'Jacob to see me; for' had I been there, this had not happened 'to him'.
verses.text: And my father deceived me, 'and removed me on that night,' and did not suffer 'Jacob to see me; for' had I been there, this had not happened 'to him'.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, for the mandrakes I am hiring Jacob to thee for one night.
verses.text: Nevertheless, for the mandrakes I am hiring Jacob to thee for one night.

verses.raw: And Jacob knew Leah, and she 'conceived and' bare me, and on account of the hire I was called Issachar.
verses.text: And Jacob knew Leah, and she 'conceived and' bare me, and on account of the hire I was called Issachar.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Then appeared to Jacob an angel of Yahuah (Lord), saying: Two children shall Rachel bear, inasmuch as she hath refused company with her husband, and hath chosen continency.
verses.text: Then appeared to Jacob an angel of Yahuah, saying: Two children shall Rachel bear, inasmuch as she hath refused company with her husband, and hath chosen continency.

verses.raw: And had not Leah my mother paid the two apples for the sake of his company, she would have borne eight sons; for this reason she bare six, and Rachel bare the two: for on account of the mandrakes Yahuah (Lord) visited her.
verses.text: And had not Leah my mother paid the two apples for the sake of his company, she would have borne eight sons; for this reason she bare six, and Rachel bare the two: for on account of the mandrakes Yahuah visited her.

verses.raw: For He knew that for the sake of children she wished to company with Jacob, and not for lust of pleasure.
verses.text: For He knew that for the sake of children she wished to company with Jacob, and not for lust of pleasure.

verses.raw: For on the morrow also she again gave up Jacob. Because of the mandrakes, therefore, Yahuah (Lord) hearkened to Rachel.
verses.text: For on the morrow also she again gave up Jacob. Because of the mandrakes, therefore, Yahuah hearkened to Rachel.

verses.raw: For though she desired them, she eat them not, but offered them in the house of Yahuah (Lord), presenting them to the priest of the El Elyon (Most High) who was at that time.
verses.text: For though she desired them, she eat them not, but offered them in the house of Yahuah, presenting them to the priest of the El Elyon who was at that time.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: When, therefore, I grew up, my children, I walked in uprightness of heart, and I became a husbandman for my father and my brethren, and I brought in fruits from the field according to their season.
verses.text: When, therefore, I grew up, my children, I walked in uprightness of heart, and I became a husbandman for my father and my brethren, and I brought in fruits from the field according to their season.

verses.raw: 'And my father blessed me, for he saw that I walked in rectitude before him.'
verses.text: 'And my father blessed me, for he saw that I walked in rectitude before him.'

verses.raw: And I was not a busybody in my doings, 'nor envious and malicious against my neighbour.'
verses.text: And I was not a busybody in my doings, 'nor envious and malicious against my neighbour.'

verses.raw: I never slandered any one, nor did I censure the life of any man, walking as I did in singleness of eye'.
verses.text: I never slandered any one, nor did I censure the life of any man, walking as I did in singleness of eye'.

verses.raw: Therefore, when I was thirty-'five' years old, I took to myself a wife, for my labour wore away my strength, and I never thought upon pleasure with women; 'but owing to my toil, sleep overcame me.'
verses.text: Therefore, when I was thirty-'five' years old, I took to myself a wife, for my labour wore away my strength, and I never thought upon pleasure with women; 'but owing to my toil, sleep overcame me.'

verses.raw: And my father 'always' rejoiced in my rectitude, because I offered through the priest to Yahuah (Lord) all first-fruits; then to my father also.
verses.text: And my father 'always' rejoiced in my rectitude, because I offered through the priest to Yahuah all first-fruits; then to my father also.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) increased ten thousandfold His benefits in my hands; and also Jacob, my father, knew that Elohim (God) aided my singleness.
verses.text: And Yahuah increased ten thousandfold His benefits in my hands; and also Jacob, my father, knew that Elohim aided my singleness.

verses.raw: For on all the poor and oppressed I bestowed the good things of the earth in the singleness of my heart.
verses.text: For on all the poor and oppressed I bestowed the good things of the earth in the singleness of my heart.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, hearken to me, my children, And walk in singleness 'of your heart', For I have seen in it [all] that is well-pleasing to Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And now, hearken to me, my children, And walk in singleness 'of your heart', For I have seen in it [all] that is well-pleasing to Yahuah.

verses.raw: 'The single-(minded) man coveteth not gold, He overreacheth not his neighbour, He longeth not after manifold dainties, He delighteth not in varied apparel.
verses.text: 'The single-(minded) man coveteth not gold, He overreacheth not his neighbour, He longeth not after manifold dainties, He delighteth not in varied apparel.

verses.raw: He doth not desire to live a long life, But only waiteth for the will of Elohim (God).
verses.text: He doth not desire to live a long life, But only waiteth for the will of Elohim.

verses.raw: And the spirits of deceit have no power against him, For he looketh not on the beauty of women, [Lest he should pollute his mind with corruption].
verses.text: And the spirits of deceit have no power against him, For he looketh not on the beauty of women, [Lest he should pollute his mind with corruption].

verses.raw: There is no envy in his thoughts, [No malicious person maketh his soul to pine away,] Nor worry with insatiable desire in his mind.
verses.text: There is no envy in his thoughts, [No malicious person maketh his soul to pine away,] Nor worry with insatiable desire in his mind.

verses.raw: For he walketh in singleness 'of soul', And beholdeth all things in uprightness 'of heart', Shunning eyes (made) evil through the error of the world, Lest he should see the perversion of any of the commandments of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: For he walketh in singleness 'of soul', And beholdeth all things in uprightness 'of heart', Shunning eyes (made) evil through the error of the world, Lest he should see the perversion of any of the commandments of Yahuah.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Keep, therefore, my children, the law of Elohim (God), And get singleness, 'And walk in guilelessness, Not playing the busybody with the business of your neighbour.
verses.text: Keep, therefore, my children, the law of Elohim, And get singleness, 'And walk in guilelessness, Not playing the busybody with the business of your neighbour.

verses.raw: But love Yahuah (Lord) and your neighbour, Have compassion on the poor and weak.'
verses.text: But love Yahuah and your neighbour, Have compassion on the poor and weak.'

verses.raw: Bow down your back unto husbandry, And toil in labours 'in all manner of husbandry, Offering gifts to Yahuah (Lord) with thanksgiving.'
verses.text: Bow down your back unto husbandry, And toil in labours 'in all manner of husbandry, Offering gifts to Yahuah with thanksgiving.'

verses.raw: For with the first-fruits of the earth will Yahuah (Lord) bless you, even as He blessed all the saints from Abel even until now.
verses.text: For with the first-fruits of the earth will Yahuah bless you, even as He blessed all the saints from Abel even until now.

verses.raw: For no other portion is given to you 'than of the fatness of the earth, whose fruits are raised by toil.
verses.text: For no other portion is given to you 'than of the fatness of the earth, whose fruits are raised by toil.

verses.raw: For our father Jacob blessed me with blessings of the earth and of first-fruits.
verses.text: For our father Jacob blessed me with blessings of the earth and of first-fruits.

verses.raw: And Levi and Yahudah (Judah) were glorified by Yahuah (Lord) even among the sons of Jacob; for Yahuah (Lord) gave them an inheritance, and to Levi He gave the priesthood, and to Yahudah (Judah) the kingdom.
verses.text: And Levi and Yahudah were glorified by Yahuah even among the sons of Jacob; for Yahuah gave them an inheritance, and to Levi He gave the priesthood, and to Yahudah the kingdom.

verses.raw: And do ye therefore obey them, and walk in the singleness of your father; [for unto Gad hath it been given to destroy the troops that are coming upon Yashar'el (Israel)].
verses.text: And do ye therefore obey them, and walk in the singleness of your father; [for unto Gad hath it been given to destroy the troops that are coming upon Yashar'el].

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Know ye, therefore, my children, that in the last times Your sons will forsake singleness, 'And will cleave unto insatiable desire; And' leaving 'guilelessness, will draw near to malice; And forsaking the commandments of Yahuah (Lord), They will cleave unto Beliar.
verses.text: Know ye, therefore, my children, that in the last times Your sons will forsake singleness, 'And will cleave unto insatiable desire; And' leaving 'guilelessness, will draw near to malice; And forsaking the commandments of Yahuah, They will cleave unto Beliar.

verses.raw: And leaving' husbandry, 'They will follow after their own 'wicked' devices, And they shall be dispersed among the Gentiles, And shall serve their enemies.
verses.text: And leaving' husbandry, 'They will follow after their own 'wicked' devices, And they shall be dispersed among the Gentiles, And shall serve their enemies.

verses.raw: And do you therefore give these commands to your children, that, if they sin, they may the more quickly return to Yahuah (Lord);
verses.text: And do you therefore give these commands to your children, that, if they sin, they may the more quickly return to Yahuah;

verses.raw: For He is merciful, and will deliver them, even to bring them back into their land.
verses.text: For He is merciful, and will deliver them, even to bring them back into their land.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Behold, therefore, as ye see, I am a hundred and twenty-six years old and am not conscious of committing any sin.
verses.text: Behold, therefore, as ye see, I am a hundred and twenty-six years old and am not conscious of committing any sin.

verses.raw: Except my wife I have not known any woman. I never committed fornication by the uplifting of my 'eyes'.
verses.text: Except my wife I have not known any woman. I never committed fornication by the uplifting of my 'eyes'.

verses.raw: I drank not wine, to be led astray thereby; I coveted not any desirable thing that was my neighbour's.
verses.text: I drank not wine, to be led astray thereby; I coveted not any desirable thing that was my neighbour's.

verses.raw: Guile arose not in my heart; A lie passed not through my lips.
verses.text: Guile arose not in my heart; A lie passed not through my lips.

verses.raw: If any man were in distress I joined my sighs with his, And I shared my bread with the poor. I wrought godliness, all my days I kept truth.
verses.text: If any man were in distress I joined my sighs with his, And I shared my bread with the poor. I wrought godliness, all my days I kept truth.

verses.raw: I loved Yahuah (Lord); Likewise also every man with all my heart.
verses.text: I loved Yahuah; Likewise also every man with all my heart.

verses.raw: So do ye also these things, my children, And every spirit of Beliar shall flee from you, And no deed of wicked men shall rule over you; And every wild beast shall ye subdue, Since you have with you the Elohim (God) of heaven and earth (And) walk with men in singleness of heart.
verses.text: So do ye also these things, my children, And every spirit of Beliar shall flee from you, And no deed of wicked men shall rule over you; And every wild beast shall ye subdue, Since you have with you the Elohim of heaven and earth (And) walk with men in singleness of heart.

verses.raw: And having said these things, he commanded his sons that they should carry him up to Hebron, and bury him there in the cave 'with his fathers'.
verses.text: And having said these things, he commanded his sons that they should carry him up to Hebron, and bury him there in the cave 'with his fathers'.

verses.raw: And he stretched out his feet and died, the fifth son of Jacob, at a good old age; with every limb sound, and with strength unabated, he slept the eternal sleep.
verses.text: And he stretched out his feet and died, the fifth son of Jacob, at a good old age; with every limb sound, and with strength unabated, he slept the eternal sleep.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the words of Zebulun, which he enjoined on his sons 'before he died' in the hundred and fourteenth year of his life, two years after the death of Joseph.
verses.text: The copy of the words of Zebulun, which he enjoined on his sons 'before he died' in the hundred and fourteenth year of his life, two years after the death of Joseph.

verses.raw: And he said to them: Hearken to me, ye sons of Zebulun, attend to the words of your father.
verses.text: And he said to them: Hearken to me, ye sons of Zebulun, attend to the words of your father.

verses.raw: I, Zebulun, was born a good gift to my parents. For when I was born my father was increased very exceedingly, both in flocks and herds, when with the straked rods he had his portion.
verses.text: I, Zebulun, was born a good gift to my parents. For when I was born my father was increased very exceedingly, both in flocks and herds, when with the straked rods he had his portion.

verses.raw: I am not conscious that I have sinned all my days, 'save in thought'.
verses.text: I am not conscious that I have sinned all my days, 'save in thought'.

verses.raw: Nor yet do I remember that I have done any iniquity, except the sin of ignorance which I committed against Joseph; for I covenanted with my brethren not to tell my father what had been done.
verses.text: Nor yet do I remember that I have done any iniquity, except the sin of ignorance which I committed against Joseph; for I covenanted with my brethren not to tell my father what had been done.

verses.raw: But I wept 'in secret' many days on account of Joseph, for I feared my brethren, 'because they had all agreed, that if any one should declare the secret, he should be slain'.
verses.text: But I wept 'in secret' many days on account of Joseph, for I feared my brethren, 'because they had all agreed, that if any one should declare the secret, he should be slain'.

verses.raw: But when they wished to kill him, I adjured them much [with tears] not to be guilty of this sin.
verses.text: But when they wished to kill him, I adjured them much [with tears] not to be guilty of this sin.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: For Simeon and Gad came against Joseph 'to kill him', and he said unto them with tears:
verses.text: For Simeon and Gad came against Joseph 'to kill him', and he said unto them with tears:

verses.raw: Pity me, my brethren, have mercy upon the bowels of Jacob our father: lay not upon me your hands 'to shed innocent blood', for I have not sinned against you.
verses.text: Pity me, my brethren, have mercy upon the bowels of Jacob our father: lay not upon me your hands 'to shed innocent blood', for I have not sinned against you.

verses.raw: And if indeed I have sinned, with chastening chastise me, 'my brethren,' but lay not upon me your hand, for the sake of Jacob our father.
verses.text: And if indeed I have sinned, with chastening chastise me, 'my brethren,' but lay not upon me your hand, for the sake of Jacob our father.

verses.raw: And as he spoke these words, 'wailing as he did so', I was unable to bear his lamentations, and 'began' to weep, and my liver was poured out, and all the substance of my bowels was 'loosened'.
verses.text: And as he spoke these words, 'wailing as he did so', I was unable to bear his lamentations, and 'began' to weep, and my liver was poured out, and all the substance of my bowels was 'loosened'.

verses.raw: And I wept with Joseph, and my heart sounded, 'and the joints of my body trembled', and I was not able to stand.
verses.text: And I wept with Joseph, and my heart sounded, 'and the joints of my body trembled', and I was not able to stand.

verses.raw: And when 'Joseph' saw me weeping with him, and them coming against him to slay him, he fled behind me, beseeching them.
verses.text: And when 'Joseph' saw me weeping with him, and them coming against him to slay him, he fled behind me, beseeching them.

verses.raw: But meanwhile Reuben rose and said: 'Come,' my brethren, let us not slay him, but let us cast him into one of these dry pits, which our fathers digged and found no water.
verses.text: But meanwhile Reuben rose and said: 'Come,' my brethren, let us not slay him, but let us cast him into one of these dry pits, which our fathers digged and found no water.

verses.raw: For for this cause Yahuah (Lord) forbade that water should rise up in them, in order that Joseph should be preserved.
verses.text: For for this cause Yahuah forbade that water should rise up in them, in order that Joseph should be preserved.

verses.raw: And they did so, until they sold him to the Ishmaelites.
verses.text: And they did so, until they sold him to the Ishmaelites.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: For in his price I had no share, my children.
verses.text: For in his price I had no share, my children.

verses.raw: But Simeon and Gad and six other of our brethren took the price of Joseph, and bought sandals for themselves, and their wives, 'and their children,' saying:
verses.text: But Simeon and Gad and six other of our brethren took the price of Joseph, and bought sandals for themselves, and their wives, 'and their children,' saying:

verses.raw: We will not eat of it, for it is the price of our brother's blood, but we will assuredly tread it under foot, because he said that he would be king over us, 'and so let us see what will become of his dreams'.
verses.text: We will not eat of it, for it is the price of our brother's blood, but we will assuredly tread it under foot, because he said that he would be king over us, 'and so let us see what will become of his dreams'.

verses.raw: Therefore it is written in the writing of the law of Moses, that whosoever will not raise up seed to his brother, his sandal should be unloosed, and they should spit into his face.
verses.text: Therefore it is written in the writing of the law of Moses, that whosoever will not raise up seed to his brother, his sandal should be unloosed, and they should spit into his face.

verses.raw: And the brethren of Joseph wished not that their brother should live, and Yahuah (Lord) loosed from them the sandal which they wore against 'Joseph their brother'.
verses.text: And the brethren of Joseph wished not that their brother should live, and Yahuah loosed from them the sandal which they wore against 'Joseph their brother'.

verses.raw: For when they came into Egypt 'they were unloosed by the servants of Joseph outside the gate, and so they made obeisance to Joseph after the fashion of King Pharaoh.
verses.text: For when they came into Egypt 'they were unloosed by the servants of Joseph outside the gate, and so they made obeisance to Joseph after the fashion of King Pharaoh.

verses.raw: And' not only did they make obeisance to him, but 'were spit upon also, falling down before him forthwith, and so' they were put to shame before the Egyptians.
verses.text: And' not only did they make obeisance to him, but 'were spit upon also, falling down before him forthwith, and so' they were put to shame before the Egyptians.

verses.raw: For after this the Egyptians heard all the evils that they had done to Joseph.
verses.text: For after this the Egyptians heard all the evils that they had done to Joseph.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And after they had cast him into the pit 'my brethren' sat down to eat.
verses.text: And after they had cast him into the pit 'my brethren' sat down to eat.

verses.raw: 'For I through two days and two nights eat nothing, through pity for Joseph.' And Yahudah (Judah) eat not with them, but watched 'the pit'; for he feared lest Simeon and Gad should run off and slay him.
verses.text: 'For I through two days and two nights eat nothing, through pity for Joseph.' And Yahudah eat not with them, but watched 'the pit'; for he feared lest Simeon and Gad should run off and slay him.

verses.raw: And when they saw that I also eat not, they set me to watch him until he was sold.
verses.text: And when they saw that I also eat not, they set me to watch him until he was sold.

verses.raw: And he spent in the pit three days and three nights, and so was sold famishing.
verses.text: And he spent in the pit three days and three nights, and so was sold famishing.

verses.raw: And when Reuben heard that while he was away (Joseph) had been sold, he rent his clothes, and mourned, saying: How shall I look in the face of Jacob my father?
verses.text: And when Reuben heard that while he was away had been sold, he rent his clothes, and mourned, saying: How shall I look in the face of Jacob my father?

verses.raw: And he took the money and ran after the merchants, and found no one; for they had left the main road, and journeyed through the Troglodytes by a short cut.
verses.text: And he took the money and ran after the merchants, and found no one; for they had left the main road, and journeyed through the Troglodytes by a short cut.

verses.raw: 'But Reuben was grieved,' and eat no food that day. Dan therefore came to him and said:
verses.text: 'But Reuben was grieved,' and eat no food that day. Dan therefore came to him and said:

verses.raw: Weep not, neither grieve; for we have found what we can say to our father Jacob.
verses.text: Weep not, neither grieve; for we have found what we can say to our father Jacob.

verses.raw: Let us slay a kid of the goats, and dip in it the coat of Joseph; and let us send it to Jacob, saying: Know, is this the coat of thy son? And they did so.
verses.text: Let us slay a kid of the goats, and dip in it the coat of Joseph; and let us send it to Jacob, saying: Know, is this the coat of thy son? And they did so.

verses.raw: 'For they stripped off from Joseph his coat when they were selling him, and put upon him the garment of a slave.'
verses.text: 'For they stripped off from Joseph his coat when they were selling him, and put upon him the garment of a slave.'

verses.raw: Now Simeon took the coat, and would not give it up, 'for he wished to rend it with his sword', as he was angry that Joseph lived and that he had not slain him.
verses.text: Now Simeon took the coat, and would not give it up, 'for he wished to rend it with his sword', as he was angry that Joseph lived and that he had not slain him.

verses.raw: Then we [all] rose up and said unto him: If thou givest not up the coat, we will say 'to our father' that thou alone didst this evil thing in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Then we [all] rose up and said unto him: If thou givest not up the coat, we will say 'to our father' that thou alone didst this evil thing in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And so he gave it unto them, and they did even as Dan had said.
verses.text: And so he gave it unto them, and they did even as Dan had said.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, I bid you to keep the commands of Yahuah (Lord), 'and to show mercy to your neighbours, and to have compassion towards all, not towards men only, but also towards beasts.
verses.text: And now, my children, I bid you to keep the commands of Yahuah, 'and to show mercy to your neighbours, and to have compassion towards all, not towards men only, but also towards beasts.

verses.raw: For for this thing's sake Yahuah (Lord) blessed me,' and when all my brethren were sick, I escaped without sickness, for Yahuah (Lord) knoweth the purposes of each.
verses.text: For for this thing's sake Yahuah blessed me,' and when all my brethren were sick, I escaped without sickness, for Yahuah knoweth the purposes of each.

verses.raw: Have, therefore, compassion in your hearts, my children, because even as a man doeth to his neighbour, even so also will Yahuah (Lord) do to him.
verses.text: Have, therefore, compassion in your hearts, my children, because even as a man doeth to his neighbour, even so also will Yahuah do to him.

verses.raw: For the sons of my brethren were sickening and were dying on account of Joseph, 'because they showed not mercy in their hearts'; but my sons were preserved without sickness, as ye know.
verses.text: For the sons of my brethren were sickening and were dying on account of Joseph, 'because they showed not mercy in their hearts'; but my sons were preserved without sickness, as ye know.

verses.raw: And when I was in the land of Canaan, by the sea-coast, I made a catch of fish for Jacob my father; and when many were choked in the sea, I continued unhurt.
verses.text: And when I was in the land of Canaan, by the sea-coast, I made a catch of fish for Jacob my father; and when many were choked in the sea, I continued unhurt.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: I was the first to make a boat to sail upon the sea, for Yahuah (Lord) gave me understanding 'and wisdom therein'.
verses.text: I was the first to make a boat to sail upon the sea, for Yahuah gave me understanding 'and wisdom therein'.

verses.raw: And I let down a rudder behind it, and I stretched a sail upon another upright piece of wood in the midst.
verses.text: And I let down a rudder behind it, and I stretched a sail upon another upright piece of wood in the midst.

verses.raw: And I sailed therein along the shores, catching fish for the house of my father until we came to Egypt.
verses.text: And I sailed therein along the shores, catching fish for the house of my father until we came to Egypt.

verses.raw: [And through compassion I shared my catch with every stranger.
verses.text: [And through compassion I shared my catch with every stranger.

verses.raw: And if a man were a stranger, or sick, or aged, I boiled the fish, and dressed them well, and offered them to all men, as every man had need, grieving with and having compassion upon them.
verses.text: And if a man were a stranger, or sick, or aged, I boiled the fish, and dressed them well, and offered them to all men, as every man had need, grieving with and having compassion upon them.

verses.raw: Wherefore also Yahuah (Lord) satisfied me with abundance of fish when catching fish; for he that shareth with his neighbour receiveth manifold more from Yahuah (Lord).]
verses.text: Wherefore also Yahuah satisfied me with abundance of fish when catching fish; for he that shareth with his neighbour receiveth manifold more from Yahuah.]

verses.raw: For five years I caught fish, [and gave thereof to every man whom I saw, and sufficed for all the house of my father].
verses.text: For five years I caught fish, [and gave thereof to every man whom I saw, and sufficed for all the house of my father].

verses.raw: And in the summer I caught fish, and in the winter I kept sheep with my brethren.
verses.text: And in the summer I caught fish, and in the winter I kept sheep with my brethren.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: [Now I will declare unto you what I did. I saw a man in distress through nakedness in winter-time, and had compassion upon him, and stole away a garment secretly from my father's house, and gave it to him who was in distress.
verses.text: [Now I will declare unto you what I did. I saw a man in distress through nakedness in winter-time, and had compassion upon him, and stole away a garment secretly from my father's house, and gave it to him who was in distress.

verses.raw: Do you, therefore, my children, from that which Elohim (God) bestoweth upon you, show compassion and mercy without hesitation to all men, and give to every man with a good heart.
verses.text: Do you, therefore, my children, from that which Elohim bestoweth upon you, show compassion and mercy without hesitation to all men, and give to every man with a good heart.

verses.raw: And if ye have not the wherewithal to give to him that needeth, have compassion for him in bowels of mercy.
verses.text: And if ye have not the wherewithal to give to him that needeth, have compassion for him in bowels of mercy.

verses.raw: I know that my hand found not the wherewithal to give to him that needed, and I walked with him weeping for seven furlongs, and my bowels yearned towards him in compassion.
verses.text: I know that my hand found not the wherewithal to give to him that needed, and I walked with him weeping for seven furlongs, and my bowels yearned towards him in compassion.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Have, therefore, yourselves also, my children, compassion towards every man with mercy, that Yahuah (Lord) also may have compassion and mercy upon you.
verses.text: Have, therefore, yourselves also, my children, compassion towards every man with mercy, that Yahuah also may have compassion and mercy upon you.

verses.raw: Because also in the last days Elohim (God) will send His compassion on the earth, and wheresoever He findeth bowels of mercy He dwelleth in him.
verses.text: Because also in the last days Elohim will send His compassion on the earth, and wheresoever He findeth bowels of mercy He dwelleth in him.

verses.raw: For in the degree in which a man hath compassion upon his neighbours, in the same degree hath Yahuah (Lord) also upon him]
verses.text: For in the degree in which a man hath compassion upon his neighbours, in the same degree hath Yahuah also upon him]

verses.raw: And when we went down into Egypt, Joseph bore no malice against us.
verses.text: And when we went down into Egypt, Joseph bore no malice against us.

verses.raw: To whom taking heed, do ye also, my children, 'approve yourselves without malice, and' love one another; and do not set down in account, each one of you, evil against his brother.
verses.text: To whom taking heed, do ye also, my children, 'approve yourselves without malice, and' love one another; and do not set down in account, each one of you, evil against his brother.

verses.raw: For this breaketh unity, and divideth 'all kindred, and troubleth the soul', and weareth away the countenance.
verses.text: For this breaketh unity, and divideth 'all kindred, and troubleth the soul', and weareth away the countenance.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Observe, 'therefore,' the waters, and know when they flow together, they sweep along stones, trees, earth, and other things.
verses.text: Observe, 'therefore,' the waters, and know when they flow together, they sweep along stones, trees, earth, and other things.

verses.raw: But if they are divided into many streams, the earth swalloweth them up, and they become of no account.
verses.text: But if they are divided into many streams, the earth swalloweth them up, and they become of no account.

verses.raw: So shall ye also be if ye be divided.
verses.text: So shall ye also be if ye be divided.

verses.raw: Be not ye, therefore, divided into two heads, for everything which Yahuah (Lord) made hath but one head, and two shoulders, two hands, two feet, but all the remaining members.
verses.text: Be not ye, therefore, divided into two heads, for everything which Yahuah made hath but one head, and two shoulders, two hands, two feet, but all the remaining members.

verses.raw: For I have learnt in the writing of my fathers, that Ye shall be divided in Yashar'el (Israel), And ye shall follow two kings, And shall work every abomination.
verses.text: For I have learnt in the writing of my fathers, that Ye shall be divided in Yashar'el, And ye shall follow two kings, And shall work every abomination.

verses.raw: And your enemies shall lead you captive, And ye shall be evil entreated among the Gentiles, With many infirmities and tribulations.
verses.text: And your enemies shall lead you captive, And ye shall be evil entreated among the Gentiles, With many infirmities and tribulations.

verses.raw: And after these things ye shall remember Yahuah (Lord) and repent, And He shall have mercy upon you, for He is merciful and compassionate. And He setteth not down in account evil against the sons of men, Because they are flesh, and are deceived through their own wicked deeds.
verses.text: And after these things ye shall remember Yahuah and repent, And He shall have mercy upon you, for He is merciful and compassionate. And He setteth not down in account evil against the sons of men, Because they are flesh, and are deceived through their own wicked deeds.

verses.raw: And after these things shall there arise 'unto you' Yahuah (Lord) Himself, the light of righteousness, And ye shall return unto your own land. And ye shall see Him in Jerusalem, 'for His name's sake'.
verses.text: And after these things shall there arise 'unto you' Yahuah Himself, the light of righteousness, And ye shall return unto your own land. And ye shall see Him in Jerusalem, 'for His name's sake'.

verses.raw: And again 'through the wickedness of your works' shall ye provoke Him to anger, And ye shall be cast away 'by Him' unto the time of consummation.
verses.text: And again 'through the wickedness of your works' shall ye provoke Him to anger, And ye shall be cast away 'by Him' unto the time of consummation.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, grieve not that I am 'dying', nor be cast down in that I am coming to my end.
verses.text: And now, my children, grieve not that I am 'dying', nor be cast down in that I am coming to my end.

verses.raw: For I shall rise again in the midst of you, 'as a ruler in the midst of his sons'; and I shall rejoice in the midst of my tribe, as many as shall keep the law of Yahuah (Lord), 'and the commandments of Zebulun their father'.
verses.text: For I shall rise again in the midst of you, 'as a ruler in the midst of his sons'; and I shall rejoice in the midst of my tribe, as many as shall keep the law of Yahuah, 'and the commandments of Zebulun their father'.

verses.raw: But upon the ungodly shall Yahuah (Lord) bring eternal fire, and destroy them throughout all generations.
verses.text: But upon the ungodly shall Yahuah bring eternal fire, and destroy them throughout all generations.

verses.raw: But I am now hastening away to my rest, as did also my fathers.
verses.text: But I am now hastening away to my rest, as did also my fathers.

verses.raw: But do ye fear Yahuah (Lord) 'our Elohim (God) with all your strength all the days of your life'.
verses.text: But do ye fear Yahuah 'our Elohim with all your strength all the days of your life'.

verses.raw: And when he had said these things he fell asleep, 'at a good old age'. And his sons laid him in a 'wooden' coffin.
verses.text: And when he had said these things he fell asleep, 'at a good old age'. And his sons laid him in a 'wooden' coffin.

verses.raw: And afterwards they carried him up and buried him in Hebron, with his fathers.
verses.text: And afterwards they carried him up and buried him in Hebron, with his fathers.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the words of Dan, which he spake to his sons in his last days, in the hundred and twenty-fifth year of his life.
verses.text: The copy of the words of Dan, which he spake to his sons in his last days, in the hundred and twenty-fifth year of his life.

verses.raw: For he called together his family, and said: Hearken to my words, ye sons of Dan; and give heed to the words 'of your father'.
verses.text: For he called together his family, and said: Hearken to my words, ye sons of Dan; and give heed to the words 'of your father'.

verses.raw: I have proved in my heart, and in my whole life, that truth with just dealing is good and well pleasing to Elohim (God), and that lying and anger are evil, because they teach man all wickedness.
verses.text: I have proved in my heart, and in my whole life, that truth with just dealing is good and well pleasing to Elohim, and that lying and anger are evil, because they teach man all wickedness.

verses.raw: I confess, therefore, this day to you, my children, that in my heart resolved on the death of Joseph 'my brother', the true and good man.
verses.text: I confess, therefore, this day to you, my children, that in my heart resolved on the death of Joseph 'my brother', the true and good man.

verses.raw: [And I rejoiced that he was sold, because his father loved him more than us.]
verses.text: [And I rejoiced that he was sold, because his father loved him more than us.]

verses.raw: For the spirit of jealousy and vainglory said to me: Thou thyself also art his son.
verses.text: For the spirit of jealousy and vainglory said to me: Thou thyself also art his son.

verses.raw: And one of the spirits of Beliar stirred me up, saying: Take this sword, and with it slay Joseph; so shall thy father love thee when he is dead.
verses.text: And one of the spirits of Beliar stirred me up, saying: Take this sword, and with it slay Joseph; so shall thy father love thee when he is dead.

verses.raw: Now this was the spirit of anger that persuaded me to crush Joseph as a leopard crusheth a kid.
verses.text: Now this was the spirit of anger that persuaded me to crush Joseph as a leopard crusheth a kid.

verses.raw: But the Elohim (God) of my fathers did not suffer him to fall into my hands, so that I should find him alone and slay him, and cause a second tribe to be destroyed in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: But the Elohim of my fathers did not suffer him to fall into my hands, so that I should find him alone and slay him, and cause a second tribe to be destroyed in Yashar'el.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, behold I am dying, and I tell you of a truth, that unless ye keep yourselves from the spirit of lying and of anger, and love truth and longsuffering, ye shall perish.
verses.text: And now, my children, behold I am dying, and I tell you of a truth, that unless ye keep yourselves from the spirit of lying and of anger, and love truth and longsuffering, ye shall perish.

verses.raw: For anger is blindness, and does not suffer one to see the face of any man with truth.
verses.text: For anger is blindness, and does not suffer one to see the face of any man with truth.

verses.raw: For 'though it be a father or a mother', he behaveth towards them as enemies; though it be a brother, he knoweth him not; though it be a prophet of Yahuah (Lord), he disobeyeth him; though a righteous man, he regardeth him not; 'though a friend, he doth not acknowledge him'.
verses.text: For 'though it be a father or a mother', he behaveth towards them as enemies; though it be a brother, he knoweth him not; though it be a prophet of Yahuah, he disobeyeth him; though a righteous man, he regardeth him not; 'though a friend, he doth not acknowledge him'.

verses.raw: For the spirit of anger encompasseth him with the net of deceit, and blindeth his eyes, and through lying darkeneth his mind, and giveth him its own peculiar vision.
verses.text: For the spirit of anger encompasseth him with the net of deceit, and blindeth his eyes, and through lying darkeneth his mind, and giveth him its own peculiar vision.

verses.raw: And wherewith encompasseth it his eyes? With hatred of heart, so as to be envious of his brother.
verses.text: And wherewith encompasseth it his eyes? With hatred of heart, so as to be envious of his brother.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: For anger is an evil thing, my children, for it troubleth even the soul itself.
verses.text: For anger is an evil thing, my children, for it troubleth even the soul itself.

verses.raw: And the body of the angry man it maketh its own, and over his soul it getteth the mastery, and it bestoweth upon the body 'power that it may work all' iniquity.
verses.text: And the body of the angry man it maketh its own, and over his soul it getteth the mastery, and it bestoweth upon the body 'power that it may work all' iniquity.

verses.raw: And when the body does all these things, the soul justifieth what is done, since it seeth not aright.
verses.text: And when the body does all these things, the soul justifieth what is done, since it seeth not aright.

verses.raw: Therefore he who is wrathful, if he be a mighty man, hath a threefold power in his anger: one by the help of his servants; and a second by his wealth, whereby he persuadeth and overcometh wrongfully; and thirdly, having his own natural power he worketh thereby the evil.
verses.text: Therefore he who is wrathful, if he be a mighty man, hath a threefold power in his anger: one by the help of his servants; and a second by his wealth, whereby he persuadeth and overcometh wrongfully; and thirdly, having his own natural power he worketh thereby the evil.

verses.raw: And though the wrathful man be weak, yet hath he a power twofold of that which is by nature; for wrath ever aideth such in lawlessness.
verses.text: And though the wrathful man be weak, yet hath he a power twofold of that which is by nature; for wrath ever aideth such in lawlessness.

verses.raw: This spirit goeth always with lying 'at the right hand of Satan, that with cruelty and lying' his works may be wrought.
verses.text: This spirit goeth always with lying 'at the right hand of Satan, that with cruelty and lying' his works may be wrought.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Understand ye, therefore, the power of wrath, that it is vain.
verses.text: Understand ye, therefore, the power of wrath, that it is vain.

verses.raw: For it first of all gives provocation by word; then by deeds it strengtheneth him who is angry, and with sharp losses disturbeth his mind, and so stirreth up with great wrath his soul.
verses.text: For it first of all gives provocation by word; then by deeds it strengtheneth him who is angry, and with sharp losses disturbeth his mind, and so stirreth up with great wrath his soul.

verses.raw: Therefore, when any one speaketh against you, be not ye moved to anger, [and if any man praiseth you as holy men, be not uplifted: be not moved either to delight or to disgust].
verses.text: Therefore, when any one speaketh against you, be not ye moved to anger, [and if any man praiseth you as holy men, be not uplifted: be not moved either to delight or to disgust].

verses.raw: For first it pleaseth the hearing, and so maketh the mind keen to perceive the grounds for provocation; and then being enraged, he thinketh that he is justly angry.
verses.text: For first it pleaseth the hearing, and so maketh the mind keen to perceive the grounds for provocation; and then being enraged, he thinketh that he is justly angry.

verses.raw: If ye fall into any loss or ruin, my children, 'be not afflicted'; for this very spirit maketh (a man) desire that which is perishable, in order that he may be enraged through the affliction.
verses.text: If ye fall into any loss or ruin, my children, 'be not afflicted'; for this very spirit maketh (a man) desire that which is perishable, in order that he may be enraged through the affliction.

verses.raw: And if ye suffer loss voluntarily, or involuntarily, be not vexed; for from vexation ariseth wrath 'with lying'.
verses.text: And if ye suffer loss voluntarily, or involuntarily, be not vexed; for from vexation ariseth wrath 'with lying'.

verses.raw: Moreover, a twofold mischief is wrath with lying; and they assist one another in order to disturb the heart; and when the soul is continually disturbed, Yahuah (Lord) departeth from it, and Beliar ruleth over it.
verses.text: Moreover, a twofold mischief is wrath with lying; and they assist one another in order to disturb the heart; and when the soul is continually disturbed, Yahuah departeth from it, and Beliar ruleth over it.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Observe, therefore, my children, the commandments of Yahuah (Lord), And keep His law; Depart from wrath, And hate lying, That Yahuah (Lord) may dwell among you, And Beliar may flee from you.
verses.text: Observe, therefore, my children, the commandments of Yahuah, And keep His law; Depart from wrath, And hate lying, That Yahuah may dwell among you, And Beliar may flee from you.

verses.raw: Speak truth each one with his neighbour, So shall ye not fall into wrath and confusion; But ye shall be in peace, having the Elohim (God) of peace, So shall no war prevail over you.
verses.text: Speak truth each one with his neighbour, So shall ye not fall into wrath and confusion; But ye shall be in peace, having the Elohim of peace, So shall no war prevail over you.

verses.raw: Love Yahuah (Lord) through all your life, And one another with a true heart.
verses.text: Love Yahuah through all your life, And one another with a true heart.

verses.raw: I know that in the last days ye shall depart from Yahuah (Lord), And ye shall provoke Levi unto anger, And fight against Yahudah (Judah); But ye shall not prevail against them, For an angel of Yahuah (Lord) shall guide them both; For by them shall Yashar'el (Israel) stand.
verses.text: I know that in the last days ye shall depart from Yahuah, And ye shall provoke Levi unto anger, And fight against Yahudah; But ye shall not prevail against them, For an angel of Yahuah shall guide them both; For by them shall Yashar'el stand.

verses.raw: And whensoever ye depart from Yahuah (Lord), ye shall walk in all evil and work the abominations of the Gentiles, going a-whoring after women of the lawless ones, while with all wickedness the spirits of wickedness work 'in you',
verses.text: And whensoever ye depart from Yahuah, ye shall walk in all evil and work the abominations of the Gentiles, going a-whoring after women of the lawless ones, while with all wickedness the spirits of wickedness work 'in you',

verses.raw: [For I have read in the book of Enoch, the righteous, that your prince is Satan, and that all the spirits of wickedness and pride will conspire to attend constantly on the sons of Levi, to cause them to sin before Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: [For I have read in the book of Enoch, the righteous, that your prince is Satan, and that all the spirits of wickedness and pride will conspire to attend constantly on the sons of Levi, to cause them to sin before Yahuah.

verses.raw: And my sons will draw near to Levi, And sin with them in all things; And the sons of Yahudah (Judah) will be covetous, Plundering other men's goods like lions.]
verses.text: And my sons will draw near to Levi, And sin with them in all things; And the sons of Yahudah will be covetous, Plundering other men's goods like lions.]

verses.raw: Therefore shall ye be led away [with them] into captivity, And there shall ye receive all the plagues of Egypt, And all the evils of the Gentiles.
verses.text: Therefore shall ye be led away [with them] into captivity, And there shall ye receive all the plagues of Egypt, And all the evils of the Gentiles.

verses.raw: And so when ye return to Yahuah (Lord) ye shall obtain mercy, And He shall bring you into His sanctuary, And He shall give you peace.
verses.text: And so when ye return to Yahuah ye shall obtain mercy, And He shall bring you into His sanctuary, And He shall give you peace.

verses.raw: And there shall arise unto you from the tribe of [Yahudah (Judah) and of] Levi the salvation of Yahuah (Lord); And he shall make war against Beliar, And execute an everlasting vengeance on our enemies;
verses.text: And there shall arise unto you from the tribe of [Yahudah and of] Levi the salvation of Yahuah; And he shall make war against Beliar, And execute an everlasting vengeance on our enemies;

verses.raw: And the captivity shall he take from Beliar [the souls of the saints], And turn disobedient hearts unto Yahuah (Lord), And give to them that call upon him eternal peace.
verses.text: And the captivity shall he take from Beliar [the souls of the saints], And turn disobedient hearts unto Yahuah, And give to them that call upon him eternal peace.

verses.raw: And the saints shall rest in Eden, And in the New Jerusalem will the righteous rejoice, And it shall be unto the glory of Elohim (God) for ever.
verses.text: And the saints shall rest in Eden, And in the New Jerusalem will the righteous rejoice, And it shall be unto the glory of Elohim for ever.

verses.raw: And no longer shall Jerusalem endure desolation, Nor Yashar'el (Israel) be led captive; For Yahuah (Lord) shall be in the midst of it [living amongst men], And the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) shall reign over it [in humility and in poverty; and he who believeth on Him shall reign amongst men in truth].
verses.text: And no longer shall Jerusalem endure desolation, Nor Yashar'el be led captive; For Yahuah shall be in the midst of it [living amongst men], And the Holy One of Yashar'el shall reign over it [in humility and in poverty; and he who believeth on Him shall reign amongst men in truth].

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, fear Yahuah (Lord), my children, and beware of Satan and his spirits.
verses.text: And now, fear Yahuah, my children, and beware of Satan and his spirits.

verses.raw: Draw near unto Elohim (God) and to the angel that intercedeth for you, for he is a mediator between Elohim (God) and man, and for the peace of Yashar'el (Israel) he shall stand up against the kingdom of the enemy.
verses.text: Draw near unto Elohim and to the angel that intercedeth for you, for he is a mediator between Elohim and man, and for the peace of Yashar'el he shall stand up against the kingdom of the enemy.

verses.raw: Therefore is the enemy eager to destroy all that call upon Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: Therefore is the enemy eager to destroy all that call upon Yahuah.

verses.raw: For he knoweth that on the day on which Yashar'el (Israel) shall repent, the kingdom of the enemy shall be brought to an end.
verses.text: For he knoweth that on the day on which Yashar'el shall repent, the kingdom of the enemy shall be brought to an end.

verses.raw: For the very angel of peace shall strengthen Yashar'el (Israel), that it fall not into the extremity of evil.
verses.text: For the very angel of peace shall strengthen Yashar'el, that it fall not into the extremity of evil.

verses.raw: And it shall be in the time of the lawlessness of Yashar'el (Israel), that Yahuah (Lord) will (not) depart from them, but will transform them into a nation that doeth His will, for none of the angels will be equal unto him.
verses.text: And it shall be in the time of the lawlessness of Yashar'el, that Yahuah will (not) depart from them, but will transform them into a nation that doeth His will, for none of the angels will be equal unto him.

verses.raw: And His name shall be in every place of Yashar'el (Israel), 'and among the Gentiles'.
verses.text: And His name shall be in every place of Yashar'el, 'and among the Gentiles'.

verses.raw: Keep, therefore, yourselves, my children, from every evil work, And cast away wrath and all lying, And love truth and long-suffering.
verses.text: Keep, therefore, yourselves, my children, from every evil work, And cast away wrath and all lying, And love truth and long-suffering.

verses.raw: And the things which ye have heard from your father, do ye also impart to your children [that the Saviour of the Gentiles may receive you; for he is true and long-suffering, meek and lowly, and teacheth by his works the law of Elohim (God)].
verses.text: And the things which ye have heard from your father, do ye also impart to your children [that the Saviour of the Gentiles may receive you; for he is true and long-suffering, meek and lowly, and teacheth by his works the law of Elohim].

verses.raw: Depart, therefore, from all unrighteousness, and cleave unto the righteousness of Elohim (God), and your race will be saved for ever.
verses.text: Depart, therefore, from all unrighteousness, and cleave unto the righteousness of Elohim, and your race will be saved for ever.

verses.raw: And bury me near my fathers.
verses.text: And bury me near my fathers.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And when he had said these things he kissed them, and fell asleep at a good old age.
verses.text: And when he had said these things he kissed them, and fell asleep at a good old age.

verses.raw: And his sons buried him. And after that they carried up 'his bones', and placed them near Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.text: And his sons buried him. And after that they carried up 'his bones', and placed them near Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.raw: [Nevertheless, 'Dan' prophesied unto them that they should forget their Elohim (God), and should be alienated from the land of their inheritance 'and from the race of Israel', and from the family of 'their seed'.]
verses.text: [Nevertheless, 'Dan' prophesied unto them that they should forget their Elohim, and should be alienated from the land of their inheritance 'and from the race of Israel', and from the family of 'their seed'.]

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the testament of Naphtali, which he ordained at the time of his death in the hundred and thirtieth year of his life.
verses.text: The copy of the testament of Naphtali, which he ordained at the time of his death in the hundred and thirtieth year of his life.

verses.raw: When his sons were gathered together in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, while still in good health, he made then a feast of food and wine.
verses.text: When his sons were gathered together in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, while still in good health, he made then a feast of food and wine.

verses.raw: And after he was awake in the morning, he said to them, I am dying; and they believed him not.
verses.text: And after he was awake in the morning, he said to them, I am dying; and they believed him not.

verses.raw: And as he glorified Yahuah (Lord), he grew strong and said that after yesterday's feast he should die. Hear, my children, ye sons of Naphtali, hear the words of your father.
verses.text: And as he glorified Yahuah, he grew strong and said that after yesterday's feast he should die. Hear, my children, ye sons of Naphtali, hear the words of your father.

verses.raw: And he began then to say:
verses.text: And he began then to say:

verses.raw: I was born from Bilhah; 'and' because Rachel dealt craftily, and gave Bilhah in place of herself to Jacob, and she conceived and bare me upon Rachel's knees, 'therefore' she called my name Naphtali.
verses.text: I was born from Bilhah; 'and' because Rachel dealt craftily, and gave Bilhah in place of herself to Jacob, and she conceived and bare me upon Rachel's knees, 'therefore' she called my name Naphtali.

verses.raw: For Rachel loved me very much because I was born upon her knees; and when I was still young she was wont to kiss me, and say: May I have a brother of thine from mine own womb, like unto thee.
verses.text: For Rachel loved me very much because I was born upon her knees; and when I was still young she was wont to kiss me, and say: May I have a brother of thine from mine own womb, like unto thee.

verses.raw: Whence also Joseph was like unto me 'in all things', according to the prayers of Rachel.
verses.text: Whence also Joseph was like unto me 'in all things', according to the prayers of Rachel.

verses.raw: Now my mother was Bilhah, daughter of Rotheus the brother of Deborah, Rebecca's nurse, who was born on one and the self-same day with Rachel.
verses.text: Now my mother was Bilhah, daughter of Rotheus the brother of Deborah, Rebecca's nurse, who was born on one and the self-same day with Rachel.

verses.raw: And Rotheus was of the family of Abraham, a Chaldean, Elohim (God)-fearing, free-born, and noble.
verses.text: And Rotheus was of the family of Abraham, a Chaldean, Elohim-fearing, free-born, and noble.

verses.raw: And he was taken captive and was bought by Laban; and he gave him Euna his handmaid to wife, and she bore a daughter, and called her name Zilpah, after the name of the village in which he had been taken captive.
verses.text: And he was taken captive and was bought by Laban; and he gave him Euna his handmaid to wife, and she bore a daughter, and called her name Zilpah, after the name of the village in which he had been taken captive.

verses.raw: And next she bore Bilhah, saying: My daughter hastens after what is new, for immediately that she was born she seized the breast and hastened to suck it.
verses.text: And next she bore Bilhah, saying: My daughter hastens after what is new, for immediately that she was born she seized the breast and hastened to suck it.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And I was swift on my feet like the deer, and my father Jacob appointed me for all messages, and as a deer did he give me his blessing.
verses.text: And I was swift on my feet like the deer, and my father Jacob appointed me for all messages, and as a deer did he give me his blessing.

verses.raw: For as the potter knoweth the vessel, how much it is to contain, and bringeth clay accordingly, so also doth Yahuah (Lord) make the body after the likeness of the spirit, and according to the capacity of the body doth He implant the spirit.
verses.text: For as the potter knoweth the vessel, how much it is to contain, and bringeth clay accordingly, so also doth Yahuah make the body after the likeness of the spirit, and according to the capacity of the body doth He implant the spirit.

verses.raw: And the one does not fall short of the other by a third part of a hair; for by weight, and measure, and rule was all the creation made.
verses.text: And the one does not fall short of the other by a third part of a hair; for by weight, and measure, and rule was all the creation made.

verses.raw: And as the potter knoweth the use of each vessel, what it is meet for, so also doth Yahuah (Lord) know the body, how far it will persist in goodness, and when it beginneth in evil.
verses.text: And as the potter knoweth the use of each vessel, what it is meet for, so also doth Yahuah know the body, how far it will persist in goodness, and when it beginneth in evil.

verses.raw: For there is no inclination or thought which Yahuah (Lord) knoweth not, for He created every man after His own image.
verses.text: For there is no inclination or thought which Yahuah knoweth not, for He created every man after His own image.

verses.raw: For as a man's strength, so also is his work; as his mind, so also is his skill; and as his purpose, so also is his achievement; and as his heart, so also is his mouth; as his eye, so also is his sleep; as his soul, so also is his word, either in the law of Yahuah (Lord) or in the works of Beliar.
verses.text: For as a man's strength, so also is his work; as his mind, so also is his skill; and as his purpose, so also is his achievement; and as his heart, so also is his mouth; as his eye, so also is his sleep; as his soul, so also is his word, either in the law of Yahuah or in the works of Beliar.

verses.raw: And as there is a division between light and darkness, between seeing and hearing, so also is there a division between man and man, and between woman and woman; and it is not to be said that the one is like the other either in face or in mind.
verses.text: And as there is a division between light and darkness, between seeing and hearing, so also is there a division between man and man, and between woman and woman; and it is not to be said that the one is like the other either in face or in mind.

verses.raw: 'For' Elohim (God) made all things good in their order, the five senses in the head, and He joined on the neck to the head, adding to it the hair also for comeliness and glory, then the heart for understanding, the belly for excrement, and the stomach for grinding, the windpipe for taking in (the breath), the liver for wrath, the gall for bitterness, the spleen for laughter, the reins 'for prudence, the muscles of the loins' for power, the lungs for drawing in, the loins for strength, and so forth.
verses.text: 'For' Elohim made all things good in their order, the five senses in the head, and He joined on the neck to the head, adding to it the hair also for comeliness and glory, then the heart for understanding, the belly for excrement, and the stomach for grinding, the windpipe for taking in (the breath), the liver for wrath, the gall for bitterness, the spleen for laughter, the reins 'for prudence, the muscles of the loins' for power, the lungs for drawing in, the loins for strength, and so forth.

verses.raw: So 'then', my children, let all your works be done in order with good intent in the fear of Elohim (God), and do nothing disorderly in scorn or out of its due season.
verses.text: So 'then', my children, let all your works be done in order with good intent in the fear of Elohim, and do nothing disorderly in scorn or out of its due season.

verses.raw: For if thou bid the eye to hear, it cannot; so neither while ye are in darkness can ye do the works of light.
verses.text: For if thou bid the eye to hear, it cannot; so neither while ye are in darkness can ye do the works of light.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Be ye, therefore, not eager to corrupt your doings through covetousness or with vain words to beguile your souls; because if ye keep silence in purity of heart, ye shall understand how to hold fast the will of Elohim (God), and to cast away the will of Beliar.
