verses.text: Be ye, therefore, not eager to corrupt your doings through covetousness or with vain words to beguile your souls; because if ye keep silence in purity of heart, ye shall understand how to hold fast the will of Elohim, and to cast away the will of Beliar.

verses.raw: Sun and moon and stars change not their order; so do ye also change not the law of Elohim (God) in the disorderliness of your doings.
verses.text: Sun and moon and stars change not their order; so do ye also change not the law of Elohim in the disorderliness of your doings.

verses.raw: The Gentiles went astray, and forsook Yahuah (Lord), and changed their order, and obeyed stocks and stones, spirits of deceit.
verses.text: The Gentiles went astray, and forsook Yahuah, and changed their order, and obeyed stocks and stones, spirits of deceit.

verses.raw: But ye shall not be so, my children, recognising in the firmament, in the earth, and in the sea, and in all created things, Yahuah (Lord) who made all things, that ye become not as Sodom, which changed the order of nature.
verses.text: But ye shall not be so, my children, recognising in the firmament, in the earth, and in the sea, and in all created things, Yahuah who made all things, that ye become not as Sodom, which changed the order of nature.

verses.raw: In like manner the Watchers also changed the order of their nature, whom Yahuah (Lord) cursed at the flood, on whose account He made the earth without inhabitant and fruitless.
verses.text: In like manner the Watchers also changed the order of their nature, whom Yahuah cursed at the flood, on whose account He made the earth without inhabitant and fruitless.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: These things I say unto you, my children, for I have read in the writing of Enoch that ye yourselves also shall depart from Yahuah (Lord), walking according to all the lawlessness of the Gentiles, and ye shall do according to all the wickedness of Sodom.
verses.text: These things I say unto you, my children, for I have read in the writing of Enoch that ye yourselves also shall depart from Yahuah, walking according to all the lawlessness of the Gentiles, and ye shall do according to all the wickedness of Sodom.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) shall bring captivity upon you, and 'there' shall ye serve your enemies, and ye shall be bowed down with every affliction and tribulation, until Yahuah (Lord) have consumed you all.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall bring captivity upon you, and 'there' shall ye serve your enemies, and ye shall be bowed down with every affliction and tribulation, until Yahuah have consumed you all.

verses.raw: And after ye have become minished and made few, ye shall return and acknowledge Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God); and He shall bring you back into your own land, according to His abundant mercy.
verses.text: And after ye have become minished and made few, ye shall return and acknowledge Yahuah Elohaychem; and He shall bring you back into your own land, according to His abundant mercy.

verses.raw: And it shall be, that after that they come into the land of their fathers, they shall again forget Yahuah (Lord) and become ungodly.
verses.text: And it shall be, that after that they come into the land of their fathers, they shall again forget Yahuah and become ungodly.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) shall scatter them upon the face of all the earth, until the compassion of Yahuah (Lord) shall come, a man working righteousness and working mercy unto all them that are afar off, and to them that are near.
verses.text: And Yahuah shall scatter them upon the face of all the earth, until the compassion of Yahuah shall come, a man working righteousness and working mercy unto all them that are afar off, and to them that are near.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: For in the fortieth year of my life, I saw a vision on the Mount of Olives, on the east of Jerusalem, that the sun and the moon were standing still.
verses.text: For in the fortieth year of my life, I saw a vision on the Mount of Olives, on the east of Jerusalem, that the sun and the moon were standing still.

verses.raw: And behold Isaac, the father of my father, said to us: Run and lay hold of them, each one according to his strength; 'and to him that seizeth them will the sun and moon belong'.
verses.text: And behold Isaac, the father of my father, said to us: Run and lay hold of them, each one according to his strength; 'and to him that seizeth them will the sun and moon belong'.

verses.raw: And we all of us ran together, and Levi laid hold of the sun, and Yahudah (Judah) outstripped the others and seized the moon, and they were both of them lifted up with them.
verses.text: And we all of us ran together, and Levi laid hold of the sun, and Yahudah outstripped the others and seized the moon, and they were both of them lifted up with them.

verses.raw: And when Levi became as a sun, 'lo', a certain young man gave to him twelve branches of palm; and Yahudah (Judah) was bright as the moon, and under their feet were twelve rays.
verses.text: And when Levi became as a sun, 'lo', a certain young man gave to him twelve branches of palm; and Yahudah was bright as the moon, and under their feet were twelve rays.

verses.raw: [And the two, Levi and Yahudah (Judah), ran, and laid hold of them.]
verses.text: [And the two, Levi and Yahudah, ran, and laid hold of them.]

verses.raw: And lo, a bull upon the earth, with two great horns, and an eagle's wings upon his back; and we wished to seize him, but could not.
verses.text: And lo, a bull upon the earth, with two great horns, and an eagle's wings upon his back; and we wished to seize him, but could not.

verses.raw: But Joseph came, and seized him, and ascended up with him on high.
verses.text: But Joseph came, and seized him, and ascended up with him on high.

verses.raw: And I saw, for I was there, and behold a holy writing appeared to us, saying: Assyrians, Medes, Persians, [Chaldeans,] Syrians, shall possess in captivity the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And I saw, for I was there, and behold a holy writing appeared to us, saying: Assyrians, Medes, Persians, [Chaldeans,] Syrians, shall possess in captivity the twelve tribes of Yashar'el.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And again, after seven days, I saw our father Jacob standing by the sea of Jamnia, and we were with him.
verses.text: And again, after seven days, I saw our father Jacob standing by the sea of Jamnia, and we were with him.

verses.raw: And, behold, there came a ship sailing by, without sailors or pilot; and there was written upon the ship, The ship of Jacob.
verses.text: And, behold, there came a ship sailing by, without sailors or pilot; and there was written upon the ship, The ship of Jacob.

verses.raw: And our father saith to us: Come let us embark on our ship.
verses.text: And our father saith to us: Come let us embark on our ship.

verses.raw: And when we had gone on board, there arose a vehement storm, and a mighty tempest of wind; and our father, who was holding the helm, departed from us.
verses.text: And when we had gone on board, there arose a vehement storm, and a mighty tempest of wind; and our father, who was holding the helm, departed from us.

verses.raw: And we, being tost with the tempest, were borne along over the sea; and the ship was filled with water, (and was) pounded by mighty waves, until it was broken up.
verses.text: And we, being tost with the tempest, were borne along over the sea; and the ship was filled with water, (and was) pounded by mighty waves, until it was broken up.

verses.raw: And Joseph fled away upon a little boat, 'and we all were divided upon nine planks,' and Levi and Yahudah (Judah) were together.
verses.text: And Joseph fled away upon a little boat, 'and we all were divided upon nine planks,' and Levi and Yahudah were together.

verses.raw: And we were all scattered unto the ends of the earth.
verses.text: And we were all scattered unto the ends of the earth.

verses.raw: Then Levi, girt about with sackcloth, prayed for us all unto Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: Then Levi, girt about with sackcloth, prayed for us all unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And when the storm ceased, the ship reached the land, 'as it were' in peace. And, lo, our father came, and we all rejoiced with one accord.
verses.text: And when the storm ceased, the ship reached the land, 'as it were' in peace. And, lo, our father came, and we all rejoiced with one accord.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: These two dreams I told to my father; and he said to me: These things must be fulfilled in their season, after that Yashar'el (Israel) hath endured many things.
verses.text: These two dreams I told to my father; and he said to me: These things must be fulfilled in their season, after that Yashar'el hath endured many things.

verses.raw: Then my father saith unto me: I believe Elohim (God) that Joseph liveth, for I see 'always' that Yahuah (Lord) numbereth him with you.
verses.text: Then my father saith unto me: I believe Elohim that Joseph liveth, for I see 'always' that Yahuah numbereth him with you.

verses.raw: And he said, weeping: Ah me, my son, Joseph, thou livest, though I behold thee not, and thou seest not Jacob that begat thee.
verses.text: And he said, weeping: Ah me, my son, Joseph, thou livest, though I behold thee not, and thou seest not Jacob that begat thee.

verses.raw: He caused me also, therefore, to weep by these words, and I burned in my heart to declare that 'Joseph' had been sold, but I feared my brethren.
verses.text: He caused me also, therefore, to weep by these words, and I burned in my heart to declare that 'Joseph' had been sold, but I feared my brethren.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And lo! my children, I have shown unto you the last times, how everything shall come to pass in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And lo! my children, I have shown unto you the last times, how everything shall come to pass in Yashar'el.

verses.raw: Do ye also, 'therefore,' charge your children that they be united to Levi and to Yahudah (Judah); For through them shall salvation arise unto Yashar'el (Israel), And in them shall Jacob be blessed.
verses.text: Do ye also, 'therefore,' charge your children that they be united to Levi and to Yahudah; For through them shall salvation arise unto Yashar'el, And in them shall Jacob be blessed.

verses.raw: For through their tribes shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth, To save the race of Yashar'el (Israel), And to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles.
verses.text: For through their tribes shall Elohim appear [dwelling among men] on earth, To save the race of Yashar'el, And to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles.

verses.raw: If ye work that which is good, my children, 'Both' men and angels shall bless you; And Elohim (God) shall be glorified among the Gentiles through you, And the devil shall flee from you, 'And the wild beasts shall fear you,' And Yahuah (Lord) shall love you, [And the angels shall cleave to you].
verses.text: If ye work that which is good, my children, 'Both' men and angels shall bless you; And Elohim shall be glorified among the Gentiles through you, And the devil shall flee from you, 'And the wild beasts shall fear you,' And Yahuah shall love you, [And the angels shall cleave to you].

verses.raw: As a man who has trained a child well is kept in kindly remembrance; So also for a good work there is a good remembrance before Elohim (God).
verses.text: As a man who has trained a child well is kept in kindly remembrance; So also for a good work there is a good remembrance before Elohim.

verses.raw: But him who doeth not that which is good, 'Both' angels and men shall curse, And Elohim (God) shall be dishonoured among the Gentiles through him, And the devil shall make him as his own peculiar instrument, And every wild beast shall master him, And Yahuah (Lord) shall hate him.
verses.text: But him who doeth not that which is good, 'Both' angels and men shall curse, And Elohim shall be dishonoured among the Gentiles through him, And the devil shall make him as his own peculiar instrument, And every wild beast shall master him, And Yahuah shall hate him.

verses.raw: For the commandments of the law are twofold, 'And' through prudence must they be fulfilled.
verses.text: For the commandments of the law are twofold, 'And' through prudence must they be fulfilled.

verses.raw: For there is a season for a man to embrace his wife, And a season to abstain therefrom for his prayer.
verses.text: For there is a season for a man to embrace his wife, And a season to abstain therefrom for his prayer.

verses.raw: So, then, there are two commandments; and, unless they be done in due order, they bring 'very great' sin 'upon men'. So also is it with the other commandments.
verses.text: So, then, there are two commandments; and, unless they be done in due order, they bring 'very great' sin 'upon men'. So also is it with the other commandments.

verses.raw: Be ye therefore wise in Elohim (God), 'my children,' and prudent, understanding the order of His commandments, and the laws of every word, that Yahuah (Lord) may love you.
verses.text: Be ye therefore wise in Elohim, 'my children,' and prudent, understanding the order of His commandments, and the laws of every word, that Yahuah may love you.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And when he had charged them with many such words, he exhorted them that they should remove his bones to Hebron, and that they should bury him with his fathers.
verses.text: And when he had charged them with many such words, he exhorted them that they should remove his bones to Hebron, and that they should bury him with his fathers.

verses.raw: And when he had eaten and drunken with a merry heart, he covered his face and died.
verses.text: And when he had eaten and drunken with a merry heart, he covered his face and died.

verses.raw: And his sons did according to all that Naphtali their father had commanded them.
verses.text: And his sons did according to all that Naphtali their father had commanded them.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the testament of Gad, what things he spake unto his sons, in the hundred and twenty-fifth year of his life, saying unto them:
verses.text: The copy of the testament of Gad, what things he spake unto his sons, in the hundred and twenty-fifth year of his life, saying unto them:

verses.raw: 'Hearken, my children,' I was the ninth son born to Jacob, and I was valiant in keeping the flocks.
verses.text: 'Hearken, my children,' I was the ninth son born to Jacob, and I was valiant in keeping the flocks.

verses.raw: Accordingly I guarded 'at night' the flock; and whenever the lion came, 'or the wolf,' or any wild beast against the fold, I pursued it, and 'overtaking (it)' I seized its foot with my hand and hurled it about a stone's throw, and so killed it.
verses.text: Accordingly I guarded 'at night' the flock; and whenever the lion came, 'or the wolf,' or any wild beast against the fold, I pursued it, and 'overtaking (it)' I seized its foot with my hand and hurled it about a stone's throw, and so killed it.

verses.raw: Now Joseph my brother was feeding the flock with us for upwards of thirty days, and being young, he fell sick by reason of the heat.
verses.text: Now Joseph my brother was feeding the flock with us for upwards of thirty days, and being young, he fell sick by reason of the heat.

verses.raw: And he returned to Hebron to our father, who made him lie down near him, because he loved him greatly.
verses.text: And he returned to Hebron to our father, who made him lie down near him, because he loved him greatly.

verses.raw: And Joseph told our father that the sons of 'Zilpah and' Bilhah were slaying the best 'of the flock' and eating them against the judgment of Reuben and Yahudah (Judah).
verses.text: And Joseph told our father that the sons of 'Zilpah and' Bilhah were slaying the best 'of the flock' and eating them against the judgment of Reuben and Yahudah.

verses.raw: For he saw that I had delivered a lamb out of the mouth of the bear, and put the bear to death; but had slain the lamb, being grieved concerning it that it could not live, and that we had eaten it.
verses.text: For he saw that I had delivered a lamb out of the mouth of the bear, and put the bear to death; but had slain the lamb, being grieved concerning it that it could not live, and that we had eaten it.

verses.raw: And regarding this matter I was wroth with Joseph 'until the day that he was sold.'
verses.text: And regarding this matter I was wroth with Joseph 'until the day that he was sold.'

verses.raw: And the spirit of hatred was in me, and I wished not either to hear of Joseph with the ears, or to see him with the eyes, because he rebuked us to our faces 'saying' that we were eating of the flock without Yahudah (Judah). For whatsoever things he told our father, he believed him.
verses.text: And the spirit of hatred was in me, and I wished not either to hear of Joseph with the ears, or to see him with the eyes, because he rebuked us to our faces 'saying' that we were eating of the flock without Yahudah. For whatsoever things he told our father, he believed him.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: I confess now my sin, my children, that oftentimes I wished to kill him, because I hated him from my heart.
verses.text: I confess now my sin, my children, that oftentimes I wished to kill him, because I hated him from my heart.

verses.raw: Moreover, I hated him yet more for his dreams; and I wished to lick him out of the land of the living, even as an ox licketh up the grass of the field.
verses.text: Moreover, I hated him yet more for his dreams; and I wished to lick him out of the land of the living, even as an ox licketh up the grass of the field.

verses.raw: And Yahudah (Judah) sold him secretly to the Ishmaelites.
verses.text: And Yahudah sold him secretly to the Ishmaelites.

verses.raw: And thus through covetousness we were bent on slaying him.
verses.text: And thus through covetousness we were bent on slaying him.

verses.raw: Thus the Elohim (God) of our fathers delivered him from our hands, that we should not work great lawlessness in Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Thus the Elohim of our fathers delivered him from our hands, that we should not work great lawlessness in Yashar'el.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, hearken to the words of truth to work righteousness, and all the law of the El Elyon (Most High), and go not astray through the spirit of hatred, for it is evil in all the doings of men.
verses.text: And now, my children, hearken to the words of truth to work righteousness, and all the law of the El Elyon, and go not astray through the spirit of hatred, for it is evil in all the doings of men.

verses.raw: Whatsoever a man doeth the hater abominates him: and though a man worketh the law of Yahuah (Lord), he praiseth him not; though a man feareth Yahuah (Lord), and taketh pleasure in that which is righteous, he loveth him not.
verses.text: Whatsoever a man doeth the hater abominates him: and though a man worketh the law of Yahuah, he praiseth him not; though a man feareth Yahuah, and taketh pleasure in that which is righteous, he loveth him not.

verses.raw: He dispraiseth the truth, he envieth him that prospers, he welcometh evil-speaking, he loveth arrogance, for hatred blindeth his soul; as I 'also then' looked on Joseph.
verses.text: He dispraiseth the truth, he envieth him that prospers, he welcometh evil-speaking, he loveth arrogance, for hatred blindeth his soul; as I 'also then' looked on Joseph.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Beware, therefore, my children, of hatred; for it worketh lawlessness 'even' against Yahuah (Lord) Himself.
verses.text: Beware, therefore, my children, of hatred; for it worketh lawlessness 'even' against Yahuah Himself.

verses.raw: For it will not hear 'the words of' His commandments concerning the loving of one's neighbour, and it sinneth against Elohim (God).
verses.text: For it will not hear 'the words of' His commandments concerning the loving of one's neighbour, and it sinneth against Elohim.

verses.raw: 'For if a brother stumble,' it delighteth immediately to proclaim it to all men, and is urgent that he should be judged for it, and be punished and be put to death.
verses.text: 'For if a brother stumble,' it delighteth immediately to proclaim it to all men, and is urgent that he should be judged for it, and be punished and be put to death.

verses.raw: And if it be a servant it stirs him up against his master, and with every affliction it deviseth against him, if possibly he can be put to death.
verses.text: And if it be a servant it stirs him up against his master, and with every affliction it deviseth against him, if possibly he can be put to death.

verses.raw: For hatred worketh with envy also against them that prosper: so long as it heareth of or seeth their success, it always languisheth.
verses.text: For hatred worketh with envy also against them that prosper: so long as it heareth of or seeth their success, it always languisheth.

verses.raw: For as love would quicken 'even' the dead, and would call back them that are condemned to die, so hatred would slay the living, and those that had sinned venially it would not suffer to live.
verses.text: For as love would quicken 'even' the dead, and would call back them that are condemned to die, so hatred would slay the living, and those that had sinned venially it would not suffer to live.

verses.raw: For the spirit of hatred worketh together with Satan, through hastiness of spirit, in all things unto men's death; but the spirit of love worketh together with the law of Elohim (God) in long-suffering unto the salvation of men.
verses.text: For the spirit of hatred worketh together with Satan, through hastiness of spirit, in all things unto men's death; but the spirit of love worketh together with the law of Elohim in long-suffering unto the salvation of men.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: 'Hatred, therefore, is evil,' for it constantly mateth with lying, speaking against the truth; and it maketh small things to be great, and causeth the light to be darkness, and calleth the sweet bitter, and teacheth slander, and 'kindleth' wrath, and 'stirreth' up war, and violence and all covetousness; it filleth the heart with evils and devilish poison.
verses.text: 'Hatred, therefore, is evil,' for it constantly mateth with lying, speaking against the truth; and it maketh small things to be great, and causeth the light to be darkness, and calleth the sweet bitter, and teacheth slander, and 'kindleth' wrath, and 'stirreth' up war, and violence and all covetousness; it filleth the heart with evils and devilish poison.

verses.raw: These things, 'therefore', I say to you from experience, my children, that ye may drive forth hatred, which is of the devil, and cleave to the love of Elohim (God).
verses.text: These things, 'therefore', I say to you from experience, my children, that ye may drive forth hatred, which is of the devil, and cleave to the love of Elohim.

verses.raw: Righteousness casteth out hatred, humility destroyeth envy. For he that is just and humble is ashamed to do what is unjust, being reproved not of another, but of his own heart, because Yahuah (Lord) looketh on his inclination.
verses.text: Righteousness casteth out hatred, humility destroyeth envy. For he that is just and humble is ashamed to do what is unjust, being reproved not of another, but of his own heart, because Yahuah looketh on his inclination.

verses.raw: He speaketh not against a holy man, because the fear of Elohim (God) overcometh hatred.
verses.text: He speaketh not against a holy man, because the fear of Elohim overcometh hatred.

verses.raw: For fearing lest he should offend Yahuah (Lord), he will not do wrong to any man, even in thought.
verses.text: For fearing lest he should offend Yahuah, he will not do wrong to any man, even in thought.

verses.raw: These things I learnt at last, after I had repented concerning Joseph.
verses.text: These things I learnt at last, after I had repented concerning Joseph.

verses.raw: For true repentance after a godly sort [destroyeth ignorance, and] driveth away the darkness, and enlighteneth the eyes, and giveth knowledge to the soul, and leadeth the mind to salvation.
verses.text: For true repentance after a godly sort [destroyeth ignorance, and] driveth away the darkness, and enlighteneth the eyes, and giveth knowledge to the soul, and leadeth the mind to salvation.

verses.raw: And those things which it hath not learnt from man, it knoweth through repentance.
verses.text: And those things which it hath not learnt from man, it knoweth through repentance.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) brought upon me a disease of the liver; and had not the prayers of Jacob my father succoured me, it had hardly failed but my spirit had departed.
verses.text: For Elohim brought upon me a disease of the liver; and had not the prayers of Jacob my father succoured me, it had hardly failed but my spirit had departed.

verses.raw: For by what things a man transgresseth, by the same also is he punished.
verses.text: For by what things a man transgresseth, by the same also is he punished.

verses.raw: Since, 'therefore,' my liver was set mercilessly against Joseph, in my liver too I suffered mercilessly, and was judged for eleven months, for so long a time as I had been angry against Joseph.
verses.text: Since, 'therefore,' my liver was set mercilessly against Joseph, in my liver too I suffered mercilessly, and was judged for eleven months, for so long a time as I had been angry against Joseph.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And now, my children, 'I exhort you,' love ye each one his brother, and put away hatred from your hearts, love one another in deed, and in word, and in the inclination of the soul.
verses.text: And now, my children, 'I exhort you,' love ye each one his brother, and put away hatred from your hearts, love one another in deed, and in word, and in the inclination of the soul.

verses.raw: For in the presence of my father I spake peaceably to Joseph; and when I had gone out, the spirit of hatred darkened my mind, and stirred up my soul to slay him.
verses.text: For in the presence of my father I spake peaceably to Joseph; and when I had gone out, the spirit of hatred darkened my mind, and stirred up my soul to slay him.

verses.raw: Love ye one another from the heart; and if a man sin against thee, speak peaceably to him, and in thy soul hold not guile; and if he repent and confess, forgive him.
verses.text: Love ye one another from the heart; and if a man sin against thee, speak peaceably to him, and in thy soul hold not guile; and if he repent and confess, forgive him.

verses.raw: But if he deny it, do not get into a passion with him, lest catching the poison from thee he take to swearing and so thou sin doubly.
verses.text: But if he deny it, do not get into a passion with him, lest catching the poison from thee he take to swearing and so thou sin doubly.

verses.raw: [Let not another man hear thy secrets when engaged in legal strife, lest he come to hate thee and become thy enemy, and commit a great sin against thee; for ofttimes he addresseth thee guilefully or busieth himself about thee with wicked intent.]
verses.text: [Let not another man hear thy secrets when engaged in legal strife, lest he come to hate thee and become thy enemy, and commit a great sin against thee; for ofttimes he addresseth thee guilefully or busieth himself about thee with wicked intent.]

verses.raw: And though he deny it and yet have a sense of shame when reproved, give over reproving him. For he who denieth may repent so as not again to wrong thee; yea, he may also honour thee, and [fear and] be at peace with thee.
verses.text: And though he deny it and yet have a sense of shame when reproved, give over reproving him. For he who denieth may repent so as not again to wrong thee; yea, he may also honour thee, and [fear and] be at peace with thee.

verses.raw: But if he be shameless and persisteth in his wrong-doing, even so forgive him from the heart, and leave to Elohim (God) the avenging.
verses.text: But if he be shameless and persisteth in his wrong-doing, even so forgive him from the heart, and leave to Elohim the avenging.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: If a man prospereth more than you, do not be vexed, but pray also for him, that he may have perfect 'prosperity.' For so it is expedient for you.
verses.text: If a man prospereth more than you, do not be vexed, but pray also for him, that he may have perfect 'prosperity.' For so it is expedient for you.

verses.raw: And if he be further exalted, be not envious 'of him', remembering that all flesh shall die; and offer praise to Elohim (God), who giveth things good and profitable to all men.
verses.text: And if he be further exalted, be not envious 'of him', remembering that all flesh shall die; and offer praise to Elohim, who giveth things good and profitable to all men.

verses.raw: Seek out the judgments of Yahuah (Lord), and thy mind will rest and be at peace.
verses.text: Seek out the judgments of Yahuah, and thy mind will rest and be at peace.

verses.raw: And though a man become rich by evil means, even as Esau, the brother of my father, be not jealous; 'but' wait for the end of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And though a man become rich by evil means, even as Esau, the brother of my father, be not jealous; 'but' wait for the end of Yahuah.

verses.raw: For if He taketh away (from a man) wealth gotten by evil means He forgiveth him if he repent, but the unrepentant is reserved for eternal punishment.
verses.text: For if He taketh away (from a man) wealth gotten by evil means He forgiveth him if he repent, but the unrepentant is reserved for eternal punishment.

verses.raw: For the poor man, if free from envy he pleaseth Yahuah (Lord) in all things, is blessed beyond all men, because he hath not the travail of vain men.
verses.text: For the poor man, if free from envy he pleaseth Yahuah in all things, is blessed beyond all men, because he hath not the travail of vain men.

verses.raw: Put away, therefore, jealousy from your souls, and love one another with uprightness of heart.
verses.text: Put away, therefore, jealousy from your souls, and love one another with uprightness of heart.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Do ye also therefore tell these things to your children, that they honour Yahudah (Judah) and Levi, for from them shall Yahuah (Lord) raise up salvation to Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Do ye also therefore tell these things to your children, that they honour Yahudah and Levi, for from them shall Yahuah raise up salvation to Yashar'el.

verses.raw: [For I know that at the last your children shall depart from Him, and shall walk in all wickedness, and affliction and corruption before Yahuah (Lord).]
verses.text: [For I know that at the last your children shall depart from Him, and shall walk in all wickedness, and affliction and corruption before Yahuah.]

verses.raw: And when he had rested for a little while, he said again: My children, obey your father, and bury me near to my fathers.
verses.text: And when he had rested for a little while, he said again: My children, obey your father, and bury me near to my fathers.

verses.raw: And he drew up his feet, and fell asleep in peace.
verses.text: And he drew up his feet, and fell asleep in peace.

verses.raw: And after five years they carried him up to Hebron, and laid him with his fathers.
verses.text: And after five years they carried him up to Hebron, and laid him with his fathers.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the testament of Asher, what things he spake to his sons in the hundred and twenty-fifth year of his life.
verses.text: The copy of the testament of Asher, what things he spake to his sons in the hundred and twenty-fifth year of his life.

verses.raw: 'For' while he was still in health, he said to them: Hearken, ye children of Asher, to your father, and I will declare to you all that is upright in the sight of Elohim (God).
verses.text: 'For' while he was still in health, he said to them: Hearken, ye children of Asher, to your father, and I will declare to you all that is upright in the sight of Elohim.

verses.raw: Two ways hath Elohim (God) given to the sons of men, and two inclinations, 'and two kinds of action, and two modes (of action)', and 'two' issues.
verses.text: Two ways hath Elohim given to the sons of men, and two inclinations, 'and two kinds of action, and two modes (of action)', and 'two' issues.

verses.raw: Therefore all things are by twos, one over against the other.
verses.text: Therefore all things are by twos, one over against the other.

verses.raw: 'For' there are two ways of good and evil, and 'with these are the two inclinations in our breasts discriminating them'.
verses.text: 'For' there are two ways of good and evil, and 'with these are the two inclinations in our breasts discriminating them'.

verses.raw: Therefore if the soul take pleasure in the good (inclination), all its actions are in righteousness; and if it sin it straightway repenteth.
verses.text: Therefore if the soul take pleasure in the good (inclination), all its actions are in righteousness; and if it sin it straightway repenteth.

verses.raw: For, having its thoughts set upon righteousness, and casting away wickedness, it straightway overthroweth the evil, and uprooteth the sin.
verses.text: For, having its thoughts set upon righteousness, and casting away wickedness, it straightway overthroweth the evil, and uprooteth the sin.

verses.raw: But if it incline to the evil inclination, all its actions are in wickedness, and it driveth away the good, and cleaveth to the evil, and is ruled by Beliar; even though it work what is good, he perverteth it to evil.
verses.text: But if it incline to the evil inclination, all its actions are in wickedness, and it driveth away the good, and cleaveth to the evil, and is ruled by Beliar; even though it work what is good, he perverteth it to evil.

verses.raw: For whenever it beginneth to do good, he forces the issue of the action into evil for him, seeing that the treasure of the inclination is filled with an evil spirit.
verses.text: For whenever it beginneth to do good, he forces the issue of the action into evil for him, seeing that the treasure of the inclination is filled with an evil spirit.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: A person then may with words help the good for the sake of the evil, yet the issue of the action leadeth to mischief.
verses.text: A person then may with words help the good for the sake of the evil, yet the issue of the action leadeth to mischief.

verses.raw: There is a man who showeth no compassion upon him who serveth his turn in evil; and this thing hath two aspects, but the whole is evil.
verses.text: There is a man who showeth no compassion upon him who serveth his turn in evil; and this thing hath two aspects, but the whole is evil.

verses.raw: And there is a man that loveth him that worketh evil, because he would prefer 'even' to die in evil for his sake; and concerning this it is clear that it hath two aspects, but the whole is an evil work.
verses.text: And there is a man that loveth him that worketh evil, because he would prefer 'even' to die in evil for his sake; and concerning this it is clear that it hath two aspects, but the whole is an evil work.

verses.raw: Though indeed he have love, yet is he wicked who concealeth what is evil for the sake of the good name, but the end of the action tendeth unto evil.
verses.text: Though indeed he have love, yet is he wicked who concealeth what is evil for the sake of the good name, but the end of the action tendeth unto evil.

verses.raw: Another stealeth, doeth unjustly, plundereth, defraudeth, and withal pitieth the poor: this 'too' hath a twofold aspect, but the whole is evil.
verses.text: Another stealeth, doeth unjustly, plundereth, defraudeth, and withal pitieth the poor: this 'too' hath a twofold aspect, but the whole is evil.

verses.raw: He who defraudeth his neighbour provoketh Elohim (God), and sweareth falsely against the El Elyon (Most High), and yet pitieth the poor: Yahuah (Lord) who commandeth the law he setteth at nought and provoketh, and yet he refresheth the poor.
verses.text: He who defraudeth his neighbour provoketh Elohim, and sweareth falsely against the El Elyon, and yet pitieth the poor: Yahuah who commandeth the law he setteth at nought and provoketh, and yet he refresheth the poor.

verses.raw: He 'defileth the soul, and' maketh gay the body; he killeth many, and pitieth a few: this, too, hath a twofold aspect, but the whole is evil.
verses.text: He 'defileth the soul, and' maketh gay the body; he killeth many, and pitieth a few: this, too, hath a twofold aspect, but the whole is evil.

verses.raw: Another committeth adultery and fornication, and abstaineth from meats, and when he fasteth he doeth evil, and by the power of his wealth overwhelmeth many; and notwithstanding his excessive wickedness he doeth 'the' commandments: this, too, hath a twofold aspect, but the whole is evil.
verses.text: Another committeth adultery and fornication, and abstaineth from meats, and when he fasteth he doeth evil, and by the power of his wealth overwhelmeth many; and notwithstanding his excessive wickedness he doeth 'the' commandments: this, too, hath a twofold aspect, but the whole is evil.

verses.raw: Such men are hares; for they are half clean, but in very deed are unclean.
verses.text: Such men are hares; for they are half clean, but in very deed are unclean.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) in the tables of the commandments hath thus declared.
verses.text: For Elohim in the tables of the commandments hath thus declared.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: But do not ye, my children, wear two faces like unto them, of goodness and of wickedness; but cleave unto goodness only, for Elohim (God) hath His habitation therein, and men desire it.
verses.text: But do not ye, my children, wear two faces like unto them, of goodness and of wickedness; but cleave unto goodness only, for Elohim hath His habitation therein, and men desire it.

verses.raw: But from wickedness flee away, destroying the (evil) inclination by your good works; for they that are double-faced serve not Elohim (God), but their own lusts, so that they may please Beliar and men like unto themselves.
verses.text: But from wickedness flee away, destroying the (evil) inclination by your good works; for they that are double-faced serve not Elohim, but their own lusts, so that they may please Beliar and men like unto themselves.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: For good men, even they that are of single face, though they be thought by them that are double-faced to sin, are just before Elohim (God).
verses.text: For good men, even they that are of single face, though they be thought by them that are double-faced to sin, are just before Elohim.

verses.raw: For many in killing the wicked do two works, of good and evil; but the whole is good, because he hath uprooted and destroyed that which is evil.
verses.text: For many in killing the wicked do two works, of good and evil; but the whole is good, because he hath uprooted and destroyed that which is evil.

verses.raw: One man hateth the merciful and unjust man, and the man who committeth adultery and fasteth: this, too, has a twofold aspect, but the 'whole' work is good, because he followeth Yahuah's (Lord's) example, in that he accepteth not the seeming good as the genuine good.
verses.text: One man hateth the merciful and unjust man, and the man who committeth adultery and fasteth: this, too, has a twofold aspect, but the 'whole' work is good, because he followeth Yahuah's (Lord's) example, in that he accepteth not the seeming good as the genuine good.

verses.raw: Another desireth not to see a good day with them that riot, lest he defile his body and pollute his soul: this, too, is double-faced, but the whole is good.
verses.text: Another desireth not to see a good day with them that riot, lest he defile his body and pollute his soul: this, too, is double-faced, but the whole is good.

verses.raw: For such men are like to stags and to hinds, because in the manner of wild animals they seem to be unclean, but they are altogether clean; because 'they walk' in zeal for Yahuah (Lord) and abstain from what Elohim (God) also hateth and forbiddeth by His commandments, warding off the evil from the good.
verses.text: For such men are like to stags and to hinds, because in the manner of wild animals they seem to be unclean, but they are altogether clean; because 'they walk' in zeal for Yahuah and abstain from what Elohim also hateth and forbiddeth by His commandments, warding off the evil from the good.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Ye see, my children, how that there are two 'in all things', one against the other, and the one is hidden by the other: 'in wealth (is hidden) covetousness, in conviviality drunkenness, in laughter grief, in wedlock profligacy'.
verses.text: Ye see, my children, how that there are two 'in all things', one against the other, and the one is hidden by the other: 'in wealth (is hidden) covetousness, in conviviality drunkenness, in laughter grief, in wedlock profligacy'.

verses.raw: Death succeedeth to life, [dishonour to glory,] night to day, and darkness to light; [and all things are under the day, just things under life, 'unjust things under death';] wherefore also eternal life awaiteth death.
verses.text: Death succeedeth to life, [dishonour to glory,] night to day, and darkness to light; [and all things are under the day, just things under life, 'unjust things under death';] wherefore also eternal life awaiteth death.

verses.raw: Nor may it be said that truth is a lie, nor right wrong; for all truth is under the light, 'even as all things are under God'.
verses.text: Nor may it be said that truth is a lie, nor right wrong; for all truth is under the light, 'even as all things are under God'.

verses.raw: All these things, therefore, I proved in my life, and I wandered not from the truth of Yahuah (Lord), and I searched out the commandments of the El Elyon (Most High), walking according to all my strength with singleness of face unto that which is good.
verses.text: All these things, therefore, I proved in my life, and I wandered not from the truth of Yahuah, and I searched out the commandments of the El Elyon, walking according to all my strength with singleness of face unto that which is good.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Take heed, therefore, ye also, my children, to the commandments of Yahuah (Lord), following the truth with singleness of face.
verses.text: Take heed, therefore, ye also, my children, to the commandments of Yahuah, following the truth with singleness of face.

verses.raw: For they that are double-faced are guilty of a twofold sin; 'for they both do the evil thing and they have pleasure in them that do it', following the example of the spirits of deceit, and striving against mankind.
verses.text: For they that are double-faced are guilty of a twofold sin; 'for they both do the evil thing and they have pleasure in them that do it', following the example of the spirits of deceit, and striving against mankind.

verses.raw: Do ye, 'therefore, my children', keep the law of Yahuah (Lord), and give not heed unto evil as unto good; but look unto the thing that is really good, and keep it in all commandments of Yahuah (Lord), having your conversation therein, and resting therein.
verses.text: Do ye, 'therefore, my children', keep the law of Yahuah, and give not heed unto evil as unto good; but look unto the thing that is really good, and keep it in all commandments of Yahuah, having your conversation therein, and resting therein.

verses.raw: For the latter ends of men do show their righteousness (or unrighteousness), when they meet the angels of Yahuah (Lord) and of Satan.
verses.text: For the latter ends of men do show their righteousness (or unrighteousness), when they meet the angels of Yahuah and of Satan.

verses.raw: For when the soul departs troubled, it is tormented by the evil spirit which also it served in lusts and evil works.
verses.text: For when the soul departs troubled, it is tormented by the evil spirit which also it served in lusts and evil works.

verses.raw: But if he is peaceful with joy he meeteth the angel of peace, and he leadeth him into eternal life.
verses.text: But if he is peaceful with joy he meeteth the angel of peace, and he leadeth him into eternal life.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Become not, my children, as Sodom, which knew not the angels of Yahuah (Lord), and perished for ever.
verses.text: Become not, my children, as Sodom, which knew not the angels of Yahuah, and perished for ever.

verses.raw: For I know that ye shall sin, and be delivered into the hands of your enemies; and your land shall be made desolate, and your holy places destroyed, and ye shall be scattered unto the four corners of the earth. And ye shall be set at nought in the dispersion as useless water,
verses.text: For I know that ye shall sin, and be delivered into the hands of your enemies; and your land shall be made desolate, and your holy places destroyed, and ye shall be scattered unto the four corners of the earth. And ye shall be set at nought in the dispersion as useless water,

verses.raw: Until the El Elyon (Most High) shall visit the earth, coming Himself [as man, with men eating and drinking], and breaking the head of the dragon in the water. He shall save Yashar'el (Israel) and all the Gentiles [Elohim (God) speaking in the person of man].
verses.text: Until the El Elyon shall visit the earth, coming Himself [as man, with men eating and drinking], and breaking the head of the dragon in the water. He shall save Yashar'el and all the Gentiles [Elohim speaking in the person of man].

verses.raw: [Therefore do 'ye also, my children,' tell these things to your children, that they disobey Him not.
verses.text: [Therefore do 'ye also, my children,' tell these things to your children, that they disobey Him not.

verses.raw: For I have known that ye shall assuredly be disobedient, and assuredly act ungodly, not giving heed to the law of Elohim (God), but to the commandments of men, being corrupted through wickedness.
verses.text: For I have known that ye shall assuredly be disobedient, and assuredly act ungodly, not giving heed to the law of Elohim, but to the commandments of men, being corrupted through wickedness.

verses.raw: And therefore shall ye be scattered as Gad and Dan my brethren, and ye shall know not your own lands, tribe, and tongue.
verses.text: And therefore shall ye be scattered as Gad and Dan my brethren, and ye shall know not your own lands, tribe, and tongue.

verses.raw: But Yahuah (Lord) will gather you together in faith through His tender mercy, 'and' for the sake of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.]
verses.text: But Yahuah will gather you together in faith through His tender mercy, 'and' for the sake of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.]

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And when he had said these things unto them, he commanded saying: Bury me in Hebron. And he fell asleep and died at a good old age.
verses.text: And when he had said these things unto them, he commanded saying: Bury me in Hebron. And he fell asleep and died at a good old age.

verses.raw: And his sons did as he had commanded them, and they carried him up to Hebron, and buried him with his fathers.
verses.text: And his sons did as he had commanded them, and they carried him up to Hebron, and buried him with his fathers.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the testament of Joseph. When he was about to die he called his sons and his brethren together, and said to them:
verses.text: The copy of the testament of Joseph. When he was about to die he called his sons and his brethren together, and said to them:

verses.raw: My brethren and my children, Hearken to Joseph the beloved of Yashar'el (Israel); Give ear, my sons, unto your father.
verses.text: My brethren and my children, Hearken to Joseph the beloved of Yashar'el; Give ear, my sons, unto your father.

verses.raw: I have seen in my life envy and death, Yet I went not astray, 'but persevered' in the truth of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: I have seen in my life envy and death, Yet I went not astray, 'but persevered' in the truth of Yahuah.

verses.raw: These my brethren hated me, but Yahuah (Lord) loved me: They wished to slay me, but the Elohim (God) of my fathers guarded me: They let me down into a pit, and the El Elyon (Most High) brought me up again.
verses.text: These my brethren hated me, but Yahuah loved me: They wished to slay me, but the Elohim of my fathers guarded me: They let me down into a pit, and the El Elyon brought me up again.

verses.raw: I was sold into slavery, and Yahuah (Lord) of all made me free: I was taken into captivity, and His strong hand succoured me. I was beset with hunger, and Yahuah (Lord) Himself nourished me.
verses.text: I was sold into slavery, and Yahuah of all made me free: I was taken into captivity, and His strong hand succoured me. I was beset with hunger, and Yahuah Himself nourished me.

verses.raw: I was alone, and Elohim (God) comforted me: I was sick, and Yahuah (Lord) visited me: I was in prison, and my Elohim (God) showed favour unto me; 'In bonds, and He released me;
verses.text: I was alone, and Elohim comforted me: I was sick, and Yahuah visited me: I was in prison, and my Elohim showed favour unto me; 'In bonds, and He released me;

verses.raw: Slandered, and He pleaded my cause; Bitterly spoken against by the Egyptians, and He delivered me; Envied by my fellow-slaves, and He exalted me.
verses.text: Slandered, and He pleaded my cause; Bitterly spoken against by the Egyptians, and He delivered me; Envied by my fellow-slaves, and He exalted me.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And this chief captain of Pharaoh entrusted to me his house.
verses.text: And this chief captain of Pharaoh entrusted to me his house.

verses.raw: And I struggled against a shameless woman, urging me to transgress with her; but the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) my father delivered me from the burning flame.
verses.text: And I struggled against a shameless woman, urging me to transgress with her; but the Elohim of Yashar'el my father delivered me from the burning flame.

verses.raw: I was cast into prison, I was beaten, 'I was mocked'; but Yahuah (Lord) granted me to find mercy in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
verses.text: I was cast into prison, I was beaten, 'I was mocked'; but Yahuah granted me to find mercy in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (Lord) doth not forsake them that fear Him, Neither in darkness, nor in bonds, nor in tribulations, nor in necessities.
verses.text: For Yahuah doth not forsake them that fear Him, Neither in darkness, nor in bonds, nor in tribulations, nor in necessities.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) is not put to shame as a man, Nor as the son of Adam is He afraid, Nor as one that is earth-born is He [weak or] affrighted.
verses.text: For Elohim is not put to shame as a man, Nor as the son of Adam is He afraid, Nor as one that is earth-born is He [weak or] affrighted.

verses.raw: But in all these things doth He give protection, And in divers ways doth He comfort, (Though) for a little space He departeth to try the inclination of the soul.
verses.text: But in all these things doth He give protection, And in divers ways doth He comfort, (Though) for a little space He departeth to try the inclination of the soul.

verses.raw: In ten temptations He showed me approved, And in all of them I endured; For endurance is a mighty charm, And patience giveth many good things.
verses.text: In ten temptations He showed me approved, And in all of them I endured; For endurance is a mighty charm, And patience giveth many good things.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: How often did the Egyptian woman threaten me with death! How often did she give me over to punishment, and then call me back and threaten me, and when I was unwilling to company with her, she said to me:
verses.text: How often did the Egyptian woman threaten me with death! How often did she give me over to punishment, and then call me back and threaten me, and when I was unwilling to company with her, she said to me:

verses.raw: Thou shalt be lord of me, and all that is in mine house, if thou wilt give thyself unto me, and thou shalt be as our master.
verses.text: Thou shalt be lord of me, and all that is in mine house, if thou wilt give thyself unto me, and thou shalt be as our master.

verses.raw: But I remembered the words of my father, and going into my chamber, 'I wept and' prayed unto Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: But I remembered the words of my father, and going into my chamber, 'I wept and' prayed unto Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I fasted in those seven years, and I appeared to the Egyptians as one living delicately, for they that fast for Elohim's (God's) sake receive beauty of face.
verses.text: And I fasted in those seven years, and I appeared to the Egyptians as one living delicately, for they that fast for Elohim's (God's) sake receive beauty of face.

verses.raw: And if my lord were away from home, I drank no wine; nor for three days did I take my food, but I gave it to the poor and sick.
verses.text: And if my lord were away from home, I drank no wine; nor for three days did I take my food, but I gave it to the poor and sick.

verses.raw: And I sought Yahuah (Lord) early, and I wept for the Egyptian woman of Memphis, for very unceasingly did she trouble me, for also at night she came to me under pretence of visiting me.
verses.text: And I sought Yahuah early, and I wept for the Egyptian woman of Memphis, for very unceasingly did she trouble me, for also at night she came to me under pretence of visiting me.

verses.raw: And because she had no male child she pretended to regard me as a son, and so I prayed to Yahuah (Lord), and she bare a male child.
verses.text: And because she had no male child she pretended to regard me as a son, and so I prayed to Yahuah, and she bare a male child.

verses.raw: And for a time she embraced me as a son, and I knew it not; but later, she sought to draw me into fornication.
verses.text: And for a time she embraced me as a son, and I knew it not; but later, she sought to draw me into fornication.

verses.raw: And when I perceived it I sorrowed unto death; and when she had gone out, I came to myself, and I lamented for her many days, because I recognised her guile and her deceit.
verses.text: And when I perceived it I sorrowed unto death; and when she had gone out, I came to myself, and I lamented for her many days, because I recognised her guile and her deceit.

verses.raw: And I declared unto her the words of the El Elyon (Most High), if haply she would turn from her evil lust.
verses.text: And I declared unto her the words of the El Elyon, if haply she would turn from her evil lust.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Often, therefore, did she flatter me with words as a holy man, and guilefully in her talk praise my chastity before her husband, while desiring to ensnare me when we were alone.
verses.text: Often, therefore, did she flatter me with words as a holy man, and guilefully in her talk praise my chastity before her husband, while desiring to ensnare me when we were alone.

verses.raw: 'For' she lauded me openly as chaste, and in secret she said unto me: Fear not my husband; for he is persuaded concerning thy chastity: for even should one tell him concerning us, he would not believe.
verses.text: 'For' she lauded me openly as chaste, and in secret she said unto me: Fear not my husband; for he is persuaded concerning thy chastity: for even should one tell him concerning us, he would not believe.

verses.raw: Owing to all these things I lay upon the ground, and besought Elohim (God) that Yahuah (Lord) would deliver me from her deceit.
verses.text: Owing to all these things I lay upon the ground, and besought Elohim that Yahuah would deliver me from her deceit.

verses.raw: And when she prevailed nothing 'thereby', she came 'again' to me under the plea of instruction, that she might learn the word of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And when she prevailed nothing 'thereby', she came 'again' to me under the plea of instruction, that she might learn the word of Elohim.

verses.raw: And she said unto me: If thou willest that I should leave my idols, lie with me, and I will persuade my husband to depart from his idols, and we will walk in the law of thy Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And she said unto me: If thou willest that I should leave my idols, lie with me, and I will persuade my husband to depart from his idols, and we will walk in the law of thy Yahuah.

verses.raw: And I said unto her: Yahuah (Lord) willeth not that those that reverence Him should be in uncleanness, nor doth He take pleasure in them that commit adultery, 'but in those that approach Him with a pure heart and undefiled lips'.
verses.text: And I said unto her: Yahuah willeth not that those that reverence Him should be in uncleanness, nor doth He take pleasure in them that commit adultery, 'but in those that approach Him with a pure heart and undefiled lips'.

verses.raw: But she held her peace, longing to accomplish her evil desire.
verses.text: But she held her peace, longing to accomplish her evil desire.

verses.raw: And I gave myself yet more to fasting and prayer, that Yahuah (Lord) might deliver me from her.
verses.text: And I gave myself yet more to fasting and prayer, that Yahuah might deliver me from her.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: 'And' again, at another time she said unto me: If thou wilt not commit adultery, I will kill my husband by poison, and take thee to be my husband.
verses.text: 'And' again, at another time she said unto me: If thou wilt not commit adultery, I will kill my husband by poison, and take thee to be my husband.

verses.raw: I therefore, when I heard this, rent my garments, and said unto her: Woman, reverence Elohim (God), and do not this evil deed, lest thou be destroyed; for know indeed that I will declare this thy device unto all men.
verses.text: I therefore, when I heard this, rent my garments, and said unto her: Woman, reverence Elohim, and do not this evil deed, lest thou be destroyed; for know indeed that I will declare this thy device unto all men.

verses.raw: She therefore, being afraid, besought that I would not declare this device.
verses.text: She therefore, being afraid, besought that I would not declare this device.

verses.raw: And she departed, soothing me with gifts, and sending to me every delight of the sons of men.
verses.text: And she departed, soothing me with gifts, and sending to me every delight of the sons of men.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And 'afterwards' she sent me food mingled with enchantments.
verses.text: And 'afterwards' she sent me food mingled with enchantments.

verses.raw: And when the eunuch who brought it came, I looked up and beheld a terrible man giving me with the dish a sword, and I perceived that (her) scheme was to beguile me.
verses.text: And when the eunuch who brought it came, I looked up and beheld a terrible man giving me with the dish a sword, and I perceived that (her) scheme was to beguile me.

verses.raw: And 'when he had gone out' I wept, nor did I taste that nor any other of her food.
verses.text: And 'when he had gone out' I wept, nor did I taste that nor any other of her food.

verses.raw: So then after one day she came to me and observed the food, and said unto me: Why is it that thou hast not eaten of the food?
verses.text: So then after one day she came to me and observed the food, and said unto me: Why is it that thou hast not eaten of the food?

verses.raw: And I said unto her: It is because thou hast filled it with 'deadly' enchantments; and how saidst thou: I come not near to idols, but to Yahuah (Lord) 'alone'?
verses.text: And I said unto her: It is because thou hast filled it with 'deadly' enchantments; and how saidst thou: I come not near to idols, but to Yahuah 'alone'?

verses.raw: Now therefore know that the Elohim (God) of my father hath revealed unto me by His angel thy wickedness, and I have kept it to convict thee, if haply thou mayest see and repent.
verses.text: Now therefore know that the Elohim of my father hath revealed unto me by His angel thy wickedness, and I have kept it to convict thee, if haply thou mayest see and repent.

verses.raw: But that thou mayest learn that the wickedness of the ungodly hath no power over them that worship Elohim (God) with chastity, behold I will take of it and eat before thee. And having so said, I prayed thus: The Elohim (God) of my fathers and the angel of Abraham, be with me; and ate.
verses.text: But that thou mayest learn that the wickedness of the ungodly hath no power over them that worship Elohim with chastity, behold I will take of it and eat before thee. And having so said, I prayed thus: The Elohim of my fathers and the angel of Abraham, be with me; and ate.

verses.raw: And 'when she saw this' she fell upon her face at my feet, weeping; and I raised her up and admonished her.
verses.text: And 'when she saw this' she fell upon her face at my feet, weeping; and I raised her up and admonished her.

verses.raw: And she promised to do this iniquity no more.
verses.text: And she promised to do this iniquity no more.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: But her heart was still set upon evil, and she looked around how to ensnare me, and sighing deeply she became downcast, though she was not sick.
verses.text: But her heart was still set upon evil, and she looked around how to ensnare me, and sighing deeply she became downcast, though she was not sick.

verses.raw: And when her husband saw her, he said unto her: Why is thy countenance fallen? And she said 'unto him': I have a pain at my heart, and the groanings of my spirit oppress me; and so he comforted her who was not sick.
verses.text: And when her husband saw her, he said unto her: Why is thy countenance fallen? And she said 'unto him': I have a pain at my heart, and the groanings of my spirit oppress me; and so he comforted her who was not sick.

verses.raw: Then accordingly seizing an opportunity she rushed unto me while her husband was yet without, and said unto me: I will hang myself, or cast myself over a cliff, if thou wilt not lie with me.
verses.text: Then accordingly seizing an opportunity she rushed unto me while her husband was yet without, and said unto me: I will hang myself, or cast myself over a cliff, if thou wilt not lie with me.

verses.raw: And when I saw the spirit of Beliar was troubling her, I prayed unto Yahuah (Lord), and said unto her:
verses.text: And when I saw the spirit of Beliar was troubling her, I prayed unto Yahuah, and said unto her:

verses.raw: Why, 'wretched woman', art thou troubled and disturbed, blinded through sins? Remember that if thou kill thyself, Asteho, the concubine of thy husband, thy rival, will beat thy children, and thou wilt destroy thy memorial from off the earth.
verses.text: Why, 'wretched woman', art thou troubled and disturbed, blinded through sins? Remember that if thou kill thyself, Asteho, the concubine of thy husband, thy rival, will beat thy children, and thou wilt destroy thy memorial from off the earth.

verses.raw: And she said unto me: Lo, then thou lovest me; let this suffice me: only strive for my life 'and my children', and I expect that I shall enjoy my desire 'also'.
verses.text: And she said unto me: Lo, then thou lovest me; let this suffice me: only strive for my life 'and my children', and I expect that I shall enjoy my desire 'also'.

verses.raw: But she knew not that because of my lord I spake thus, and not because of her.
verses.text: But she knew not that because of my lord I spake thus, and not because of her.

verses.raw: For if a man hath fallen before the passion of a wicked desire and become enslaved by it, even as she, whatever good thing he may hear with regard to that passion, he receiveth it with a view to his wicked desire.
verses.text: For if a man hath fallen before the passion of a wicked desire and become enslaved by it, even as she, whatever good thing he may hear with regard to that passion, he receiveth it with a view to his wicked desire.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: I declare, therefore, unto you, my children, that it was about the sixth hour when she departed from me; and I knelt before Yahuah (Lord) all the day, and all the night; and about dawn I rose up, weeping the while and praying for a release from her.
verses.text: I declare, therefore, unto you, my children, that it was about the sixth hour when she departed from me; and I knelt before Yahuah all the day, and all the night; and about dawn I rose up, weeping the while and praying for a release from her.

verses.raw: At last, then, she laid hold of my garments, forcibly dragging me to have connection with her.
verses.text: At last, then, she laid hold of my garments, forcibly dragging me to have connection with her.

verses.raw: When, 'therefore', I saw that in her madness she was holding fast to my garment, I left it behind, and fled away naked.
verses.text: When, 'therefore', I saw that in her madness she was holding fast to my garment, I left it behind, and fled away naked.

verses.raw: And holding fast to the garment she falsely accused me, and when her husband came he cast me into prison in his house; and on the morrow he scourged me and sent me into Pharaoh's prison.
verses.text: And holding fast to the garment she falsely accused me, and when her husband came he cast me into prison in his house; and on the morrow he scourged me and sent me into Pharaoh's prison.

verses.raw: And when I was in bonds, the Egyptian woman was oppressed with grief, and she came and heard how I gave thanks unto Yahuah (Lord) and sang praises in the abode of darkness, and with glad voice rejoiced, glorifying my Elohim (God) that I was delivered from the lustful desire of the Egyptian woman.
verses.text: And when I was in bonds, the Egyptian woman was oppressed with grief, and she came and heard how I gave thanks unto Yahuah and sang praises in the abode of darkness, and with glad voice rejoiced, glorifying my Elohim that I was delivered from the lustful desire of the Egyptian woman.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And often hath she sent unto me saying: Consent to fulfil my desire, and I will release thee from thy bonds, 'and I will free thee from the darkness'.
verses.text: And often hath she sent unto me saying: Consent to fulfil my desire, and I will release thee from thy bonds, 'and I will free thee from the darkness'.

verses.raw: And not even in thought did I incline unto her. For Elohim (God) loveth him who in a den of darkness combines fasting with chastity, rather than the man who in kings' chambers combines luxury with licence.
verses.text: And not even in thought did I incline unto her. For Elohim loveth him who in a den of darkness combines fasting with chastity, rather than the man who in kings' chambers combines luxury with licence.

verses.raw: And if a man liveth in chastity, and desireth also glory, and the El Elyon (Most High) knoweth that it is expedient for him, He bestoweth this also upon him, even as upon me.
verses.text: And if a man liveth in chastity, and desireth also glory, and the El Elyon knoweth that it is expedient for him, He bestoweth this also upon him, even as upon me.

verses.raw: How often, though she were sick, did she come down 'to me' at unlooked-for times, and listened to my voice as I prayed! And when I heard her groanings I held my peace.
verses.text: How often, though she were sick, did she come down 'to me' at unlooked-for times, and listened to my voice as I prayed! And when I heard her groanings I held my peace.

verses.raw: 'For' when I was in her house she was wont to bare her arms, and breasts, and legs, 'that I might lie with her; for she was' very beautiful, 'splendidly adorned' in order to beguile me. And Yahuah (Lord) guarded me from her devices.
verses.text: 'For' when I was in her house she was wont to bare her arms, and breasts, and legs, 'that I might lie with her; for she was' very beautiful, 'splendidly adorned' in order to beguile me. And Yahuah guarded me from her devices.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Ye see, therefore, my children, how great things patience worketh, and prayer with fasting.
verses.text: Ye see, therefore, my children, how great things patience worketh, and prayer with fasting.

verses.raw: So ye too, 'if ye follow after chastity and purity with patience and prayer with fasting in humility of heart, Yahuah (Lord) will dwell among you, because He loveth chastity.
verses.text: So ye too, 'if ye follow after chastity and purity with patience and prayer with fasting in humility of heart, Yahuah will dwell among you, because He loveth chastity.

verses.raw: And wheresoever the El Elyon (Most High) dwelleth, even though envy, or slavery, or slander befalleth (a man), Yahuah (Lord) who dwelleth in him, for the sake of his chastity not only' delivereth him from evil, 'but also exalteth him even as me'.
verses.text: And wheresoever the El Elyon dwelleth, even though envy, or slavery, or slander befalleth (a man), Yahuah who dwelleth in him, for the sake of his chastity not only' delivereth him from evil, 'but also exalteth him even as me'.

verses.raw: For in every way the man' is lifted up, whether in deed, or in word, or in thought.
verses.text: For in every way the man' is lifted up, whether in deed, or in word, or in thought.

verses.raw: My brethren know how my father loved me, and yet I did not exalt myself 'in my mind': although I was a child, 'I had the fear of Elohim (God) in my heart'; for I knew that all things would pass away.
verses.text: My brethren know how my father loved me, and yet I did not exalt myself 'in my mind': although I was a child, 'I had the fear of Elohim in my heart'; for I knew that all things would pass away.

verses.raw: And I did not raise myself (against them) with evil intent, but I honoured my brethren; and out of respect for them, even when I was being sold, I refrained from telling the Ishmaelites that I was the son of Jacob, a great man and a mighty.
verses.text: And I did not raise myself (against them) with evil intent, but I honoured my brethren; and out of respect for them, even when I was being sold, I refrained from telling the Ishmaelites that I was the son of Jacob, a great man and a mighty.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Do ye also, therefore, my children, 'have the fear of Elohim (God) in all your works before your eyes, and' honour your brethren. For every one who doeth the law of Yahuah (Lord) shall be loved by Him.
verses.text: Do ye also, therefore, my children, 'have the fear of Elohim in all your works before your eyes, and' honour your brethren. For every one who doeth the law of Yahuah shall be loved by Him.

verses.raw: And when I came to the Indocolpitae with the Ishmaelites, they asked me, saying: Art thou a slave? And I said that I was a home-born slave, that I might not put my brethren to shame.
verses.text: And when I came to the Indocolpitae with the Ishmaelites, they asked me, saying: Art thou a slave? And I said that I was a home-born slave, that I might not put my brethren to shame.

verses.raw: And the eldest of them said unto me: Thou art not a slave, for even thy appearance doth make it manifest. But I said that I was 'their' slave.
verses.text: And the eldest of them said unto me: Thou art not a slave, for even thy appearance doth make it manifest. But I said that I was 'their' slave.

verses.raw: Now when we came into Egypt they strove concerning me, which of them should buy me and take me.
verses.text: Now when we came into Egypt they strove concerning me, which of them should buy me and take me.

verses.raw: Therefore it seemed good to all that I should remain in Egypt with the merchant of their trade, until they should return bringing merchandise.
verses.text: Therefore it seemed good to all that I should remain in Egypt with the merchant of their trade, until they should return bringing merchandise.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) gave me favour in the eyes of the merchant, and he entrusted unto me his house.
verses.text: And Yahuah gave me favour in the eyes of the merchant, and he entrusted unto me his house.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) blessed him by my means, and increased him in gold and silver 'and in household servants'.
verses.text: And Elohim blessed him by my means, and increased him in gold and silver 'and in household servants'.

verses.raw: And I was with him three months and five days.
verses.text: And I was with him three months and five days.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And about that time the Memphian woman, the wife of Pentephri, came down 'in a chariot', 'with great pomp, because she had heard from her eunuchs concerning me'.
verses.text: And about that time the Memphian woman, the wife of Pentephri, came down 'in a chariot', 'with great pomp, because she had heard from her eunuchs concerning me'.

verses.raw: And she told her husband that the merchant had become rich by means of a young Hebrew, and they say that he had assuredly been stolen out of the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And she told her husband that the merchant had become rich by means of a young Hebrew, and they say that he had assuredly been stolen out of the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: Now, therefore, render justice unto him, and take away the youth to thy house; so shall the Elohim (God) of the Hebrews bless thee, for grace from heaven is upon him.
verses.text: Now, therefore, render justice unto him, and take away the youth to thy house; so shall the Elohim of the Hebrews bless thee, for grace from heaven is upon him.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And Pentephris was persuaded by her words, and commanded the merchant to be brought, and said unto him: What is this that I hear 'concerning thee', that thou stealest persons out of the land of Canaan, and sellest them for slaves?
verses.text: And Pentephris was persuaded by her words, and commanded the merchant to be brought, and said unto him: What is this that I hear 'concerning thee', that thou stealest persons out of the land of Canaan, and sellest them for slaves?

verses.raw: But the merchant fell at his feet, and besought him, saying: I beseech thee, my lord, I know not what thou sayest.
verses.text: But the merchant fell at his feet, and besought him, saying: I beseech thee, my lord, I know not what thou sayest.

verses.raw: And Pentephris said unto him: Whence, then, is the Hebrew slave? And he said: The Ishmaelites entrusted him to me until they should return.
verses.text: And Pentephris said unto him: Whence, then, is the Hebrew slave? And he said: The Ishmaelites entrusted him to me until they should return.

verses.raw: But he believed him not, but commanded him to be stripped and beaten. And when he persisted in this statement, Pentephris said: Let the youth be brought.
verses.text: But he believed him not, but commanded him to be stripped and beaten. And when he persisted in this statement, Pentephris said: Let the youth be brought.

verses.raw: And when I was brought in, I did obeisance to Pentephris (for he was third in rank of the officers of Pharaoh).
verses.text: And when I was brought in, I did obeisance to Pentephris (for he was third in rank of the officers of Pharaoh).

verses.raw: And he took me apart from him, and said unto me: Art thou a slave or free? And I said: A slave.
verses.text: And he took me apart from him, and said unto me: Art thou a slave or free? And I said: A slave.

verses.raw: And he said: Whose? And I said: The Ishmaelites'.
verses.text: And he said: Whose? And I said: The Ishmaelites'.

verses.raw: And he said: How didst thou become their slave? And I said: They bought me out of the land of Canaan.
verses.text: And he said: How didst thou become their slave? And I said: They bought me out of the land of Canaan.

verses.raw: And he said unto me: 'Truly' thou liest; and 'straightway' he commanded me to be stripped and beaten.
verses.text: And he said unto me: 'Truly' thou liest; and 'straightway' he commanded me to be stripped and beaten.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Now the Memphian woman was looking through a window 'at me while I was being beaten, for her house was near, and she sent unto him, saying': Thy judgment is unjust; for thou dost punish a 'free' man who hath been stolen, as though he were a transgressor.
verses.text: Now the Memphian woman was looking through a window 'at me while I was being beaten, for her house was near, and she sent unto him, saying': Thy judgment is unjust; for thou dost punish a 'free' man who hath been stolen, as though he were a transgressor.

verses.raw: And when I made no change in my statement, 'though I was beaten', he ordered me to be imprisoned, until, he said, the owners of the boy should come.
verses.text: And when I made no change in my statement, 'though I was beaten', he ordered me to be imprisoned, until, he said, the owners of the boy should come.

verses.raw: And the woman said unto her husband: Wherefore dost thou detain the captive and well-born lad in bonds, who ought rather to be set at liberty, and be waited upon?
verses.text: And the woman said unto her husband: Wherefore dost thou detain the captive and well-born lad in bonds, who ought rather to be set at liberty, and be waited upon?

verses.raw: For she wished to see me out of a desire 'of sin', but I was ignorant concerning all these things.
verses.text: For she wished to see me out of a desire 'of sin', but I was ignorant concerning all these things.

verses.raw: And he said to her: It is not the custom of the Egyptians to take away that which belongeth to others before proof is given.
verses.text: And he said to her: It is not the custom of the Egyptians to take away that which belongeth to others before proof is given.

verses.raw: This, therefore, he said concerning the merchant; but as for the lad, he must be imprisoned.
verses.text: This, therefore, he said concerning the merchant; but as for the lad, he must be imprisoned.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Now after four and twenty days came the Ishmaelites; for they had heard that Jacob 'my father' was mourning 'much' concerning me. And they came and said unto me:
