verses.text: Now after four and twenty days came the Ishmaelites; for they had heard that Jacob 'my father' was mourning 'much' concerning me. And they came and said unto me:

verses.raw: How is it that thou saidst that thou wast a slave? and lo, we have learnt that thou art the son of a mighty man in the land of Canaan, and thy father 'still' mourneth for thee in sackcloth 'and ashes'.
verses.text: How is it that thou saidst that thou wast a slave? and lo, we have learnt that thou art the son of a mighty man in the land of Canaan, and thy father 'still' mourneth for thee in sackcloth 'and ashes'.

verses.raw: 'When I heard this my bowels were dissolved and my heart melted', and I desired greatly to weep, but I restrained myself, that I should not put my brethren to shame. 'And I said unto them, I know not, I am a slave'.
verses.text: 'When I heard this my bowels were dissolved and my heart melted', and I desired greatly to weep, but I restrained myself, that I should not put my brethren to shame. 'And I said unto them, I know not, I am a slave'.

verses.raw: Then, 'therefore', they took counsel to sell me, that I should not be found in their hands.
verses.text: Then, 'therefore', they took counsel to sell me, that I should not be found in their hands.

verses.raw: For they feared my father, lest he 'should come and' execute upon them a grievous vengeance. For they had heard that he was mighty with Elohim (God) and with men.
verses.text: For they feared my father, lest he 'should come and' execute upon them a grievous vengeance. For they had heard that he was mighty with Elohim and with men.

verses.raw: Then said the merchant unto them: Release me from the judgment of Pentephri.
verses.text: Then said the merchant unto them: Release me from the judgment of Pentephri.

verses.raw: And they came and requested me, saying: 'Say' that thou wast bought by us with money, and he will set us free.
verses.text: And they came and requested me, saying: 'Say' that thou wast bought by us with money, and he will set us free.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Now the Memphian woman said to her husband: Buy the youth; for I hear, said she, that they are selling him.
verses.text: Now the Memphian woman said to her husband: Buy the youth; for I hear, said she, that they are selling him.

verses.raw: And 'straightway' she sent a eunuch to the Ishmaelites, and asked them to sell me.
verses.text: And 'straightway' she sent a eunuch to the Ishmaelites, and asked them to sell me.

verses.raw: But since the eunuch would not agree to buy me (at their price) he returned, having made trial of them, and he made known to his mistress that they asked a large price for their slave.
verses.text: But since the eunuch would not agree to buy me (at their price) he returned, having made trial of them, and he made known to his mistress that they asked a large price for their slave.

verses.raw: And she sent another eunuch, saying: Even though they demand two minae, 'give them', do not spare 'the gold'; only buy the boy, and bring him to me.
verses.text: And she sent another eunuch, saying: Even though they demand two minae, 'give them', do not spare 'the gold'; only buy the boy, and bring him to me.

verses.raw: The eunuch therefore went and gave them eighty pieces of gold, and 'he received me'; but to the Egyptian woman he said: I have given a hundred.
verses.text: The eunuch therefore went and gave them eighty pieces of gold, and 'he received me'; but to the Egyptian woman he said: I have given a hundred.

verses.raw: And though I knew (this) I held my peace, lest the eunuch should be put to shame.
verses.text: And though I knew (this) I held my peace, lest the eunuch should be put to shame.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Ye see, therefore, my children, what great things I endured that I should not put my brethren to shame.
verses.text: Ye see, therefore, my children, what great things I endured that I should not put my brethren to shame.

verses.raw: Do ye also, therefore, love one another, and with long-suffering hide 'ye one another's faults'.
verses.text: Do ye also, therefore, love one another, and with long-suffering hide 'ye one another's faults'.

verses.raw: For Elohim (God) delighteth 'in the unity of brethren, and' in the purpose of a heart that takes pleasure in love.
verses.text: For Elohim delighteth 'in the unity of brethren, and' in the purpose of a heart that takes pleasure in love.

verses.raw: And when my brethren came into Egypt they learnt that I had returned their money unto them, and upbraided them not, and comforted them.
verses.text: And when my brethren came into Egypt they learnt that I had returned their money unto them, and upbraided them not, and comforted them.

verses.raw: And after the death of Jacob my father I loved them 'more abundantly', and all things whatsoever he commanded I did 'very abundantly' for them.
verses.text: And after the death of Jacob my father I loved them 'more abundantly', and all things whatsoever he commanded I did 'very abundantly' for them.

verses.raw: And I suffered them not to be afflicted even in the smallest matter; and all that was in my hand I gave unto them.
verses.text: And I suffered them not to be afflicted even in the smallest matter; and all that was in my hand I gave unto them.

verses.raw: 'And' their children were my children, and my children as their servants; and their life was my life, and all their suffering was my suffering, 'and all their sickness was my infirmity'. My land was their land, and their counsel my counsel.
verses.text: 'And' their children were my children, and my children as their servants; and their life was my life, and all their suffering was my suffering, 'and all their sickness was my infirmity'. My land was their land, and their counsel my counsel.

verses.raw: And I exalted not myself among them 'in arrogance' because of my 'worldly' glory, but I was among them as one of the least.
verses.text: And I exalted not myself among them 'in arrogance' because of my 'worldly' glory, but I was among them as one of the least.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: If ye also, therefore, walk in the commandments of Yahuah (Lord), my children, He will exalt you there, and will bless you with good things for ever and ever.
verses.text: If ye also, therefore, walk in the commandments of Yahuah, my children, He will exalt you there, and will bless you with good things for ever and ever.

verses.raw: 'And if any one seeketh to do evil unto you, do well unto him, and pray for him, and ye shall be redeemed of Yahuah (Lord) from all evil'.
verses.text: 'And if any one seeketh to do evil unto you, do well unto him, and pray for him, and ye shall be redeemed of Yahuah from all evil'.

verses.raw: 'For', behold, ye see that 'out of my humility and long-suffering' I took unto wife the daughter of the priest of Heliopolis. And a hundred talents of gold were given me with her, and Yahuah (Lord) made them to serve me.
verses.text: 'For', behold, ye see that 'out of my humility and long-suffering' I took unto wife the daughter of the priest of Heliopolis. And a hundred talents of gold were given me with her, and Yahuah made them to serve me.

verses.raw: And He gave me also beauty as a flower beyond the beautiful ones of Yashar'el (Israel); and He preserved me 'unto old age in strength and' in beauty, because I was like in all things to Jacob.
verses.text: And He gave me also beauty as a flower beyond the beautiful ones of Yashar'el; and He preserved me 'unto old age in strength and' in beauty, because I was like in all things to Jacob.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And hear ye, my children, also the vision which I saw.
verses.text: And hear ye, my children, also the vision which I saw.

verses.raw: There were twelve harts feeding: and the nine were (first) dispersed over all the earth, and likewise also the three.
verses.text: There were twelve harts feeding: and the nine were (first) dispersed over all the earth, and likewise also the three.

verses.raw: And I saw that the three harts became three lambs, and they cried to Yahuah (Lord), and He brought them forth into a flourishing and well-watered place, yea He brought them out of darkness into light.
verses.text: And I saw that the three harts became three lambs, and they cried to Yahuah, and He brought them forth into a flourishing and well-watered place, yea He brought them out of darkness into light.

verses.raw: And there they cried unto Yahuah (Lord) until there gathered together to them the nine harts, and they became as twelve sheep, and after a little time they increased and became many flocks.
verses.text: And there they cried unto Yahuah until there gathered together to them the nine harts, and they became as twelve sheep, and after a little time they increased and became many flocks.

verses.raw: And after these things I saw and behold, twelve bulls were sucking one cow, which produced a sea of milk, and there drank thereof the twelve flocks and innumerable herds.
verses.text: And after these things I saw and behold, twelve bulls were sucking one cow, which produced a sea of milk, and there drank thereof the twelve flocks and innumerable herds.

verses.raw: And the horns of the fourth bull went up unto heaven and became as a wall for the flocks, and in the midst of the [two] horns there grew another horn.
verses.text: And the horns of the fourth bull went up unto heaven and became as a wall for the flocks, and in the midst of the [two] horns there grew another horn.

verses.raw: And I saw a bull calf which surrounded them twelve times, and it became a help to the bulls wholly.
verses.text: And I saw a bull calf which surrounded them twelve times, and it became a help to the bulls wholly.

verses.raw: And I saw that [from Yahudah (Judah) was born] a virgin [wearing a linen garment, and from her] was born a lamb, [without spot]; and on his left hand there was as it were a lion; and all the beasts rushed against him, and the lamb overcame them, and destroyed them and trod them under foot.
verses.text: And I saw that [from Yahudah was born] a virgin [wearing a linen garment, and from her] was born a lamb, [without spot]; and on his left hand there was as it were a lion; and all the beasts rushed against him, and the lamb overcame them, and destroyed them and trod them under foot.

verses.raw: And because of him the angels and men rejoiced, and all the land.
verses.text: And because of him the angels and men rejoiced, and all the land.

verses.raw: And these things shall come to pass in their season, in the last days.
verses.text: And these things shall come to pass in their season, in the last days.

verses.raw: Do ye therefore, my children, observe the commandments of Yahuah (Lord), and honour Levi and Yahudah (Judah); for from them shall arise 'unto you' [the Lamb of Elohim (God), who taketh away the sin of the world] one who saveth [all the Gentiles and] Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: Do ye therefore, my children, observe the commandments of Yahuah, and honour Levi and Yahudah; for from them shall arise 'unto you' [the Lamb of Elohim, who taketh away the sin of the world] one who saveth [all the Gentiles and] Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, which shall not pass away; but my kingdom among you shall come to an end as a watcher's hammock, which after the summer disappeareth.
verses.text: For his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, which shall not pass away; but my kingdom among you shall come to an end as a watcher's hammock, which after the summer disappeareth.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: 'For' I know that after my death the Egyptians will afflict you, but Elohim (God) will avenge you, and will bring you into that which He promised to your fathers.
verses.text: 'For' I know that after my death the Egyptians will afflict you, but Elohim will avenge you, and will bring you into that which He promised to your fathers.

verses.raw: But ye shall carry up my bones with you; 'for when my bones are being taken up thither, Yahuah (Lord) shall be with you in light, and Beliar shall be in darkness with the Egyptians'.
verses.text: But ye shall carry up my bones with you; 'for when my bones are being taken up thither, Yahuah shall be with you in light, and Beliar shall be in darkness with the Egyptians'.

verses.raw: And carry ye up Asenath your mother [to the Hippodrome], and near Rachel your mother bury her.
verses.text: And carry ye up Asenath your mother [to the Hippodrome], and near Rachel your mother bury her.

verses.raw: And when he had said these things he stretched out his feet, and died at a good old age.
verses.text: And when he had said these things he stretched out his feet, and died at a good old age.

verses.raw: And all Yashar'el (Israel) mourned for him, and all Egypt, with a great mourning.
verses.text: And all Yashar'el mourned for him, and all Egypt, with a great mourning.

verses.raw: And when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went out of Egypt, they took with them the bones of Joseph, and they buried him in Hebron with his fathers, and the years of his life were one hundred and ten years.
verses.text: And when the children of Yashar'el went out of Egypt, they took with them the bones of Joseph, and they buried him in Hebron with his fathers, and the years of his life were one hundred and ten years.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The copy of the words of Benjamin, which he commanded his sons to observe, after he had lived a hundred and twenty-five years.
verses.text: The copy of the words of Benjamin, which he commanded his sons to observe, after he had lived a hundred and twenty-five years.

verses.raw: And he kissed them, and said: As Isaac was born to Abraham in his old age, so also was I to Jacob.
verses.text: And he kissed them, and said: As Isaac was born to Abraham in his old age, so also was I to Jacob.

verses.raw: And since Rachel my mother died in giving me birth, I had no milk; therefore I was suckled by Bilhah her handmaid.
verses.text: And since Rachel my mother died in giving me birth, I had no milk; therefore I was suckled by Bilhah her handmaid.

verses.raw: For Rachel remained barren for twelve years 'after she had borne Joseph'; and she prayed Yahuah (Lord) with fasting twelve days, and she conceived and bare me.
verses.text: For Rachel remained barren for twelve years 'after she had borne Joseph'; and she prayed Yahuah with fasting twelve days, and she conceived and bare me.

verses.raw: For 'my father' loved Rachel dearly, 'and prayed that he might see two sons born from her'.
verses.text: For 'my father' loved Rachel dearly, 'and prayed that he might see two sons born from her'.

verses.raw: Therefore was I called Benjamin, that is, a son of days.
verses.text: Therefore was I called Benjamin, that is, a son of days.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And when I went into Egypt, 'to Joseph, and my brother recognised me, he said' unto me: What did they tell my father when they sold me?
verses.text: And when I went into Egypt, 'to Joseph, and my brother recognised me, he said' unto me: What did they tell my father when they sold me?

verses.raw: And I said 'unto him', They dabbled thy coat with blood and sent it, and said: Know whether this be thy son's coat.
verses.text: And I said 'unto him', They dabbled thy coat with blood and sent it, and said: Know whether this be thy son's coat.

verses.raw: And he said unto me: Even so, brother, when they had stripped me of my coat they gave me to the Ishmaelites, and they gave me a loin cloth, and scourged me, and bade me run.
verses.text: And he said unto me: Even so, brother, when they had stripped me of my coat they gave me to the Ishmaelites, and they gave me a loin cloth, and scourged me, and bade me run.

verses.raw: And as for one of them that had beaten me with a rod, a lion met him and slew him.
verses.text: And as for one of them that had beaten me with a rod, a lion met him and slew him.

verses.raw: And so his associates were affrighted.
verses.text: And so his associates were affrighted.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Do ye also, therefore, my children, love Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of heaven and earth, and keep His commandments, following the example of the good and holy man 'Joseph'.
verses.text: Do ye also, therefore, my children, love Yahuah Elohim of heaven and earth, and keep His commandments, following the example of the good and holy man 'Joseph'.

verses.raw: And let your mind be unto good, even as ye know me; for he that hath his mind right, seeth all things rightly.
verses.text: And let your mind be unto good, even as ye know me; for he that hath his mind right, seeth all things rightly.

verses.raw: Fear ye Yahuah (Lord), and love your neighbour; and even though the spirits of Beliar claim you to afflict you with every evil, yet shall they not have dominion over you, even as they had not over Joseph my brother.
verses.text: Fear ye Yahuah, and love your neighbour; and even though the spirits of Beliar claim you to afflict you with every evil, yet shall they not have dominion over you, even as they had not over Joseph my brother.

verses.raw: How many men wished to slay him, and Elohim (God) shielded him! For he that feareth Elohim (God) and loveth his neighbour cannot be smitten by the spirit of Beliar, being shielded by the fear of Elohim (God).
verses.text: How many men wished to slay him, and Elohim shielded him! For he that feareth Elohim and loveth his neighbour cannot be smitten by the spirit of Beliar, being shielded by the fear of Elohim.

verses.raw: Nor can he be ruled over by the device of men or beasts, for he is helped by Yahuah (Lord) through the love which he hath towards his neighbour.
verses.text: Nor can he be ruled over by the device of men or beasts, for he is helped by Yahuah through the love which he hath towards his neighbour.

verses.raw: For Joseph also besought our father 'that he would pray for his brethren', that 'the Lord' would not impute to them as sin whatever evil they had done unto him.
verses.text: For Joseph also besought our father 'that he would pray for his brethren', that 'the Lord' would not impute to them as sin whatever evil they had done unto him.

verses.raw: And thus Jacob cried out: My good child, thou hast prevailed over the bowels of thy father Jacob. And he embraced him, and kissed him for two hours, saying:
verses.text: And thus Jacob cried out: My good child, thou hast prevailed over the bowels of thy father Jacob. And he embraced him, and kissed him for two hours, saying:

verses.raw: In thee shall be fulfilled the prophecy of heaven [concerning the Lamb of Elohim (God), and Saviour of the world], that a blameless one shall be delivered up for lawless men, and a sinless shall die for ungodly men [in the blood of the covenant, for the salvation of the Gentiles and 'of Israel', and shall destroy Beliar and his servants].
verses.text: In thee shall be fulfilled the prophecy of heaven [concerning the Lamb of Elohim, and Saviour of the world], that a blameless one shall be delivered up for lawless men, and a sinless shall die for ungodly men [in the blood of the covenant, for the salvation of the Gentiles and 'of Israel', and shall destroy Beliar and his servants].

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: See ye, therefore, my children, the end of the good man? Be followers of his 'compassion, therefore, with a good mind', that 'ye also' may wear crowns of glory.
verses.text: See ye, therefore, my children, the end of the good man? Be followers of his 'compassion, therefore, with a good mind', that 'ye also' may wear crowns of glory.

verses.raw: For the good man hath not a 'dark eye'; for he showeth mercy to all men, even though they be sinners.
verses.text: For the good man hath not a 'dark eye'; for he showeth mercy to all men, even though they be sinners.

verses.raw: 'And though they devise with evil intent concerning him, by doing good he overcometh evil, being shielded by God'; and he loveth the righteous as his own soul.
verses.text: 'And though they devise with evil intent concerning him, by doing good he overcometh evil, being shielded by God'; and he loveth the righteous as his own soul.

verses.raw: If any one is glorified, he envieth him not; if any one is enriched, he is not jealous; if any one is valiant, he praiseth him; the virtuous man he laudeth; 'on the poor man he hath mercy; on the weak he hath compassion; unto Elohim (God) he singeth praises'.
verses.text: If any one is glorified, he envieth him not; if any one is enriched, he is not jealous; if any one is valiant, he praiseth him; the virtuous man he laudeth; 'on the poor man he hath mercy; on the weak he hath compassion; unto Elohim he singeth praises'.

verses.raw: And him that hath the grace of a good spirit he loveth as his own soul.
verses.text: And him that hath the grace of a good spirit he loveth as his own soul.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: If, 'therefore, ye also' have a good 'mind', then will both wicked men be at peace with you, and the profligate will reverence you and turn unto good; and the covetous will not only cease from their inordinate desire, but even give the objects of their covetousness to them that are afflicted.
verses.text: If, 'therefore, ye also' have a good 'mind', then will both wicked men be at peace with you, and the profligate will reverence you and turn unto good; and the covetous will not only cease from their inordinate desire, but even give the objects of their covetousness to them that are afflicted.

verses.raw: If ye do well, even the unclean spirits will flee from you'; and the beasts will dread you.
verses.text: If ye do well, even the unclean spirits will flee from you'; and the beasts will dread you.

verses.raw: 'For where there is reverence for good works and light in the mind, even darkness fleeth away from him.'
verses.text: 'For where there is reverence for good works and light in the mind, even darkness fleeth away from him.'

verses.raw: 'For' if any one does violence to a holy man, he repenteth; for 'the holy man' is merciful to his reviler, and holdeth his peace.
verses.text: 'For' if any one does violence to a holy man, he repenteth; for 'the holy man' is merciful to his reviler, and holdeth his peace.

verses.raw: And if any one betrayeth a righteous man, the righteous man prayeth: though for a little he be humbled, yet not long after he appeareth far more glorious, as was Joseph my brother.
verses.text: And if any one betrayeth a righteous man, the righteous man prayeth: though for a little he be humbled, yet not long after he appeareth far more glorious, as was Joseph my brother.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: The inclination of the good man is not in the power of the deceit of the spirit of Beliar, for the angel of peace guideth his soul.
verses.text: The inclination of the good man is not in the power of the deceit of the spirit of Beliar, for the angel of peace guideth his soul.

verses.raw: 'And' he gazeth not 'passionately' upon corruptible things, nor gathereth together riches 'through a desire of pleasure'.
verses.text: 'And' he gazeth not 'passionately' upon corruptible things, nor gathereth together riches 'through a desire of pleasure'.

verses.raw: He delighteth not in pleasure, '[he grieveth not his neighbour], he sateth not himself with luxuries, he erreth not in the uplifting of the eyes', for Yahuah (Lord) is his portion.
verses.text: He delighteth not in pleasure, '[he grieveth not his neighbour], he sateth not himself with luxuries, he erreth not in the uplifting of the eyes', for Yahuah is his portion.

verses.raw: The good inclination receiveth not glory 'nor dishonour' from men, and it knoweth not any guile, or lie, or fighting or reviling; for Yahuah (Lord) dwelleth in him and lighteth up his soul, and he rejoiceth towards all men alway.
verses.text: The good inclination receiveth not glory 'nor dishonour' from men, and it knoweth not any guile, or lie, or fighting or reviling; for Yahuah dwelleth in him and lighteth up his soul, and he rejoiceth towards all men alway.

verses.raw: The good mind hath not two tongues, of blessing and of cursing, of contumely and 'of honour', of sorrow and of joy, of quietness and of confusion, of hypocrisy and of truth, [of poverty and of wealth]; but it hath one 'disposition', uncorrupt and pure, concerning all men.
verses.text: The good mind hath not two tongues, of blessing and of cursing, of contumely and 'of honour', of sorrow and of joy, of quietness and of confusion, of hypocrisy and of truth, [of poverty and of wealth]; but it hath one 'disposition', uncorrupt and pure, concerning all men.

verses.raw: It hath no double sight, nor double hearing; for in everything which he doeth, 'or speaketh, or seeth, he knoweth that Yahuah (Lord) looketh on his soul.
verses.text: It hath no double sight, nor double hearing; for in everything which he doeth, 'or speaketh, or seeth, he knoweth that Yahuah looketh on his soul.

verses.raw: And he cleanseth his mind that he be not condemned by men as well as' by Elohim (God). And in like manner the works of Beliar are twofold, and there is no singleness in them.
verses.text: And he cleanseth his mind that he be not condemned by men as well as' by Elohim. And in like manner the works of Beliar are twofold, and there is no singleness in them.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Therefore, my children, I tell you, flee the malice of Beliar; for he giveth a sword to them that obey him.
verses.text: Therefore, my children, I tell you, flee the malice of Beliar; for he giveth a sword to them that obey him.

verses.raw: And the sword is the mother of seven evils. First the mind conceiveth through Beliar, 'and first there is bloodshed; secondly, ruin; thirdly, tribulation; fourthly, exile; fifthly, dearth; sixthly, panic; seventhly, destruction.
verses.text: And the sword is the mother of seven evils. First the mind conceiveth through Beliar, 'and first there is bloodshed; secondly, ruin; thirdly, tribulation; fourthly, exile; fifthly, dearth; sixthly, panic; seventhly, destruction.

verses.raw: Therefore was Cain also delivered over to seven vengeances by Elohim (God), for in every hundred years Yahuah (Lord) brought one plague upon him.
verses.text: Therefore was Cain also delivered over to seven vengeances by Elohim, for in every hundred years Yahuah brought one plague upon him.

verses.raw: And when he was two hundred years old he began to suffer, and in the nine-hundredth year he was destroyed. For on account of Abel, his brother, with all the evils was he judged, but Lamech with seventy times seven.
verses.text: And when he was two hundred years old he began to suffer, and in the nine-hundredth year he was destroyed. For on account of Abel, his brother, with all the evils was he judged, but Lamech with seventy times seven.

verses.raw: Because for ever those who are like unto Cain 'in envy and hatred of brethren', shall be punished with the same judgment'.
verses.text: Because for ever those who are like unto Cain 'in envy and hatred of brethren', shall be punished with the same judgment'.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And do ye, my children, flee evil-doing, envy, and hatred of brethren, and cleave to goodness and love.
verses.text: And do ye, my children, flee evil-doing, envy, and hatred of brethren, and cleave to goodness and love.

verses.raw: He that hath a pure mind in love, looketh not after a woman with a view to fornication; for he hath no defilement in his heart, because the Spirit of Elohim (God) resteth upon him.
verses.text: He that hath a pure mind in love, looketh not after a woman with a view to fornication; for he hath no defilement in his heart, because the Spirit of Elohim resteth upon him.

verses.raw: For 'as' the sun is not defiled by shining on dung and mire, 'but rather drieth up both and driveth away the evil smell'; so also the pure mind, though encompassed by the defilements of earth, rather cleanseth (them) and is not itself defiled.
verses.text: For 'as' the sun is not defiled by shining on dung and mire, 'but rather drieth up both and driveth away the evil smell'; so also the pure mind, though encompassed by the defilements of earth, rather cleanseth (them) and is not itself defiled.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And I believe that there will be also evil-doings among you, from the words of Enoch the righteous: that ye shall commit fornication with the fornication of Sodom, and shall perish, all save a few, and shall renew wanton deeds with women; and the kingdom of Yahuah (Lord) shall not be among you, for straightway He shall take it away.
verses.text: And I believe that there will be also evil-doings among you, from the words of Enoch the righteous: that ye shall commit fornication with the fornication of Sodom, and shall perish, all save a few, and shall renew wanton deeds with women; and the kingdom of Yahuah shall not be among you, for straightway He shall take it away.

verses.raw: Nevertheless the temple of Elohim (God) shall be in your portion, and the last (temple) shall be more glorious than the first. And the twelve tribes shall be gathered together there, and all the Gentiles, until the El Elyon (Most High) shall send forth His salvation in the visitation of an 'only-begotten prophet'.
verses.text: Nevertheless the temple of Elohim shall be in your portion, and the last (temple) shall be more glorious than the first. And the twelve tribes shall be gathered together there, and all the Gentiles, until the El Elyon shall send forth His salvation in the visitation of an 'only-begotten prophet'.

verses.raw: [And He shall enter into the [first] temple, and there shall Yahuah (Lord) be treated with outrage, and He shall be lifted up upon a tree.
verses.text: [And He shall enter into the [first] temple, and there shall Yahuah be treated with outrage, and He shall be lifted up upon a tree.

verses.raw: And the veil of the temple shall be rent, and the Spirit of Elohim (God) shall pass on to the Gentiles as fire poured forth.
verses.text: And the veil of the temple shall be rent, and the Spirit of Elohim shall pass on to the Gentiles as fire poured forth.

verses.raw: And He shall ascend from Hades and shall pass from earth into heaven. And I know how lowly He shall be upon earth, and how glorious in heaven.]
verses.text: And He shall ascend from Hades and shall pass from earth into heaven. And I know how lowly He shall be upon earth, and how glorious in heaven.]

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: Now when Joseph was in Egypt, I longed to see his figure and the form of his countenance'; and through the prayers of Jacob my father I saw him, while awake in the day-time, even his entire figure exactly as he was.
verses.text: Now when Joseph was in Egypt, I longed to see his figure and the form of his countenance'; and through the prayers of Jacob my father I saw him, while awake in the day-time, even his entire figure exactly as he was.

verses.raw: 'And when he had said these things, he said unto them:' Know ye, therefore, my children, that I am dying.
verses.text: 'And when he had said these things, he said unto them:' Know ye, therefore, my children, that I am dying.

verses.raw: Do ye, therefore, truth each one to his neighbour, and keep the law of Yahuah (Lord) and His commandments.
verses.text: Do ye, therefore, truth each one to his neighbour, and keep the law of Yahuah and His commandments.

verses.raw: For these things do I leave you instead of inheritance. Do ye also, therefore,' give them to your children for an everlasting possession; for so did both Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.text: For these things do I leave you instead of inheritance. Do ye also, therefore,' give them to your children for an everlasting possession; for so did both Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.raw: For all these things they gave us for an inheritance, saying: Keep the commandments of Elohim (God), until Yahuah (Lord) shall reveal His salvation to all Gentiles.
verses.text: For all these things they gave us for an inheritance, saying: Keep the commandments of Elohim, until Yahuah shall reveal His salvation to all Gentiles.

verses.raw: 'And' then shall ye see Enoch, Noah, and Shem, and Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, rising on the right hand in gladness.
verses.text: 'And' then shall ye see Enoch, Noah, and Shem, and Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, rising on the right hand in gladness.

verses.raw: Then shall we also rise, each one over our tribe, worshipping the King of heaven, [who appeared upon earth in the form of a man in humility. And as many as believe on Him on the earth shall rejoice with Him].
verses.text: Then shall we also rise, each one over our tribe, worshipping the King of heaven, [who appeared upon earth in the form of a man in humility. And as many as believe on Him on the earth shall rejoice with Him].

verses.raw: Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah (Lord) shall judge Yashar'el (Israel) first, for their unrighteousness; [for when He appeared as Elohim (God) in the flesh to deliver them they believed Him not].
verses.text: Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah shall judge Yashar'el first, for their unrighteousness; [for when He appeared as Elohim in the flesh to deliver them they believed Him not].

verses.raw: And then shall He judge all the Gentiles, [as many as believed Him not when He appeared upon earth].
verses.text: And then shall He judge all the Gentiles, [as many as believed Him not when He appeared upon earth].

verses.raw: And He shall convict Yashar'el (Israel) through the chosen ones of the Gentiles, even as he reproved Esau through the Madianites, who deceived their brethren, [so that they fell into fornication, and idolatry; and they were alienated from Elohim (God),] becoming therefore children in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And He shall convict Yashar'el through the chosen ones of the Gentiles, even as he reproved Esau through the Madianites, who deceived their brethren, [so that they fell into fornication, and idolatry; and they were alienated from Elohim,] becoming therefore children in the portion of them that fear Yahuah.

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: If ye 'therefore, my children', walk in holiness 'according to the commandments of the Lord', ye shall again dwell securely with me, and all Yashar'el (Israel) shall be gathered unto Yahuah (Lord). And I shall no longer be called a ravening wolf on account of your ravages, but [a worker of Yahuah (Lord) distributing food to them that work what is good.
verses.text: If ye 'therefore, my children', walk in holiness 'according to the commandments of the Lord', ye shall again dwell securely with me, and all Yashar'el shall be gathered unto Yahuah. And I shall no longer be called a ravening wolf on account of your ravages, but [a worker of Yahuah distributing food to them that work what is good.

verses.raw: And there shall arise in the latter days] one beloved of Yahuah (Lord), [of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) and Levi], a doer of His good pleasure in his mouth, [with new knowledge enlightening the Gentiles].
verses.text: And there shall arise in the latter days] one beloved of Yahuah, [of the tribe of Yahudah and Levi], a doer of His good pleasure in his mouth, [with new knowledge enlightening the Gentiles].

verses.raw: Until the consummation of the age shall he be in the synagogues of the Gentiles, and among their rulers, as a strain of music in the mouth of all.
verses.text: Until the consummation of the age shall he be in the synagogues of the Gentiles, and among their rulers, as a strain of music in the mouth of all.

verses.raw: And he shall be inscribed in the holy books, both his work and his word, and he shall be a chosen one of Elohim (God) for ever.
verses.text: And he shall be inscribed in the holy books, both his work and his word, and he shall be a chosen one of Elohim for ever.

verses.raw: And through them he shall go to and fro as Jacob my father, saying: He shall fill up that which lacketh of thy tribe].
verses.text: And through them he shall go to and fro as Jacob my father, saying: He shall fill up that which lacketh of thy tribe].

title: The Testaments of the XII Patriarchs

verses.raw: And when he finished his words, he said: I command you, my children, carry up my bones out of Egypt, and bury me at Hebron, near my fathers.
verses.text: And when he finished his words, he said: I command you, my children, carry up my bones out of Egypt, and bury me at Hebron, near my fathers.

verses.raw: So Benjamin died a hundred and twenty-five years old, at a good old age, and they placed him in a coffin.
verses.text: So Benjamin died a hundred and twenty-five years old, at a good old age, and they placed him in a coffin.

verses.raw: And in the ninety-first year from the entrance of the children of Yashar'el (Israel) into Egypt, they and their brethren brought up the bones of their fathers secretly during the Canaanitish war; and they buried them in Hebron, by the feet of their fathers.
verses.text: And in the ninety-first year from the entrance of the children of Yashar'el into Egypt, they and their brethren brought up the bones of their fathers secretly during the Canaanitish war; and they buried them in Hebron, by the feet of their fathers.

verses.raw: And they returned from the land of Canaan and dwelt in Egypt until the day of their departure from the land of Egypt.
verses.text: And they returned from the land of Canaan and dwelt in Egypt until the day of their departure from the land of Egypt.

verses.raw: There was a wise man, a great artificer, and Yahuah (Lord) conceived love for him and received him, that he should behold the uppermost dwellings and be an eye-witness of the wise and great and inconceivable and immutable realm of El Shaddai (God Almighty), of the very wonderful and glorious and bright and many-eyed station of Yahuah's (Lord’s) servants, and of the inaccessible throne of Yahuah (Lord), and of the degrees and manifestations of the incorporeal hosts, and of the ineffable ministration of the multitude of the elements, and of the various apparition and inexpressible singing of the host of Cherubim, and of the boundless light.
verses.text: There was a wise man, a great artificer, and Yahuah conceived love for him and received him, that he should behold the uppermost dwellings and be an eye-witness of the wise and great and inconceivable and immutable realm of El Shaddai, of the very wonderful and glorious and bright and many-eyed station of Yahuah's (Lord’s) servants, and of the inaccessible throne of Yahuah, and of the degrees and manifestations of the incorporeal hosts, and of the ineffable ministration of the multitude of the elements, and of the various apparition and inexpressible singing of the host of Cherubim, and of the boundless light.

verses.raw: At that time, he said, when my one hundred and sixty-fifth year was completed, I begat my son Mathusal.
verses.text: At that time, he said, when my one hundred and sixty-fifth year was completed, I begat my son Mathusal.

verses.raw: After this too I lived two hundred years and completed of all the years of my life three hundred and sixty-five years.
verses.text: After this too I lived two hundred years and completed of all the years of my life three hundred and sixty-five years.

verses.raw: On the first day of the month I was in my house alone and was resting on my bed and slept.
verses.text: On the first day of the month I was in my house alone and was resting on my bed and slept.

verses.raw: And when I was asleep, great distress came up into my heart, and I was weeping with my eyes in sleep, and I could not understand what this distress was, or what would happen to me.
verses.text: And when I was asleep, great distress came up into my heart, and I was weeping with my eyes in sleep, and I could not understand what this distress was, or what would happen to me.

verses.raw: And there appeared to me two men, exceeding big, so that I never saw such on earth; their faces were shining like the sun, their eyes too were like a burning light, and from their lips was fire coming forth with clothing and singing of various kinds in appearance purple, their wings were brighter than gold, their hands whiter than snow.
verses.text: And there appeared to me two men, exceeding big, so that I never saw such on earth; their faces were shining like the sun, their eyes too were like a burning light, and from their lips was fire coming forth with clothing and singing of various kinds in appearance purple, their wings were brighter than gold, their hands whiter than snow.

verses.raw: They were standing at the head of my bed and began to call me by my name.
verses.text: They were standing at the head of my bed and began to call me by my name.

verses.raw: And I arose from my sleep and saw clearly those two men standing in front of me.
verses.text: And I arose from my sleep and saw clearly those two men standing in front of me.

verses.raw: And I saluted them and was seized with fear and the appearance of my face was changed from terror, and those men said to me:
verses.text: And I saluted them and was seized with fear and the appearance of my face was changed from terror, and those men said to me:

verses.raw: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear; the eternal Elohim (God) sent us to you, and lo! You shalt to-day ascend with us into heaven, and you shall tell your sons and all your household all that they shall do without you on earth in your house, and let no one seek you till Yahuah (Lord) return you to them.
verses.text: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear; the eternal Elohim sent us to you, and lo! You shalt to-day ascend with us into heaven, and you shall tell your sons and all your household all that they shall do without you on earth in your house, and let no one seek you till Yahuah return you to them.

verses.raw: And I made haste to obey them and went out from my house, and made to the doors, as it was ordered me, and summoned my sons Mathusal and Regim and Gaidad and made known to them all the marvels those men had told me.
verses.text: And I made haste to obey them and went out from my house, and made to the doors, as it was ordered me, and summoned my sons Mathusal and Regim and Gaidad and made known to them all the marvels those men had told me.

verses.raw: Listen to me, my children, I know not whither I go, or what will befall me; now therefore, my children, I tell you: turn not from Elohim (God) before the face of the vain, who made not Heaven and earth, for these shall perish and those who worship them, and may Yahuah (Lord) make confident your hearts in the fear of him. And now, my children, let no one think to seek me, until Yahuah (Lord) return me to you.
verses.text: Listen to me, my children, I know not whither I go, or what will befall me; now therefore, my children, I tell you: turn not from Elohim before the face of the vain, who made not Heaven and earth, for these shall perish and those who worship them, and may Yahuah make confident your hearts in the fear of him. And now, my children, let no one think to seek me, until Yahuah return me to you.

verses.raw: It came to pass, when Enoch had told his sons, that the angels took him on to their wings and bore him up on to the first heaven and placed him on the clouds. And there I looked, and again I looked higher, and saw the ether, and they placed me on the first heaven and showed me a very great Sea, greater than the earthly sea.
verses.text: It came to pass, when Enoch had told his sons, that the angels took him on to their wings and bore him up on to the first heaven and placed him on the clouds. And there I looked, and again I looked higher, and saw the ether, and they placed me on the first heaven and showed me a very great Sea, greater than the earthly sea.

verses.raw: They brought before my face the elders and rulers of the stellar orders, and showed me two hundred angels, who rule the stars and their services to the heavens, and fly with their wings and come round all those who sail.
verses.text: They brought before my face the elders and rulers of the stellar orders, and showed me two hundred angels, who rule the stars and their services to the heavens, and fly with their wings and come round all those who sail.

verses.raw: And here I looked down and saw the treasure-houses of the snow, and the angels who keep their terrible store-houses, and the clouds whence they come out and into which they go.
verses.text: And here I looked down and saw the treasure-houses of the snow, and the angels who keep their terrible store-houses, and the clouds whence they come out and into which they go.

verses.raw: They showed me the treasure-house of the dew, like oil of the olive, and the appearance of its form, as of all the flowers of the earth; further many angels guarding the treasure-houses of these things, and how they are made to shut and open.
verses.text: They showed me the treasure-house of the dew, like oil of the olive, and the appearance of its form, as of all the flowers of the earth; further many angels guarding the treasure-houses of these things, and how they are made to shut and open.

verses.raw: And those men took me and led me up on to the second heaven, and showed me darkness, greater than earthly darkness, and there I saw prisoners hanging, watched, awaiting the great and boundless judgment, and these angels were dark-looking, more than earthly darkness, and incessantly making weeping through all hours.
verses.text: And those men took me and led me up on to the second heaven, and showed me darkness, greater than earthly darkness, and there I saw prisoners hanging, watched, awaiting the great and boundless judgment, and these angels were dark-looking, more than earthly darkness, and incessantly making weeping through all hours.

verses.raw: And I said to the men who were with me: Wherefore are these incessantly tortured? They answered me: These are Elohim's (God’s) apostates, who obeyed not Elohim's (God’s) commands, but took counsel with their own will, and turned away with their prince, who also is fastened on the fifth heaven.
verses.text: And I said to the men who were with me: Wherefore are these incessantly tortured? They answered me: These are Elohim's (God’s) apostates, who obeyed not Elohim's (God’s) commands, but took counsel with their own will, and turned away with their prince, who also is fastened on the fifth heaven.

verses.raw: And I felt great pity for them, and they saluted me, and said to me: Man of Elohim (God), pray for us to Yahuah (Lord); and I answered to them: Who am I, a mortal man, that I should pray for angels? Who knows whither I go, or what will befall me? Or who will pray for me?
verses.text: And I felt great pity for them, and they saluted me, and said to me: Man of Elohim, pray for us to Yahuah; and I answered to them: Who am I, a mortal man, that I should pray for angels? Who knows whither I go, or what will befall me? Or who will pray for me?

verses.raw: And those men took me thence, and led me up on to the third heaven, and placed me there; and I looked downwards, and saw the produce of these places, such as has never been known for goodness.
verses.text: And those men took me thence, and led me up on to the third heaven, and placed me there; and I looked downwards, and saw the produce of these places, such as has never been known for goodness.

verses.raw: And I saw all the sweet-flowering trees and beheld their fruits, which were sweet-smelling, and all the foods borne by them bubbling with fragrant exhalation.
verses.text: And I saw all the sweet-flowering trees and beheld their fruits, which were sweet-smelling, and all the foods borne by them bubbling with fragrant exhalation.

verses.raw: And in the midst of the trees that of life, in that place whereon Yahuah (Lord) rests, when he goes up into paradise; and this tree is of ineffable goodness and fragrance, and adorned more than every existing thing; and on all sides it is in form gold-looking and vermilion and fire-like and covers all, and it has produce from all fruits.
verses.text: And in the midst of the trees that of life, in that place whereon Yahuah rests, when he goes up into paradise; and this tree is of ineffable goodness and fragrance, and adorned more than every existing thing; and on all sides it is in form gold-looking and vermilion and fire-like and covers all, and it has produce from all fruits.

verses.raw: Its root is in the garden at the earth’s end.
verses.text: Its root is in the garden at the earth’s end.

verses.raw: And paradise is between corruptibility and incorruptibility.
verses.text: And paradise is between corruptibility and incorruptibility.

verses.raw: And two springs come out which send forth honey and milk, and their springs send forth oil and wine, and they separate into four parts, and go round with quiet course, and go down into the PARADISE OF EDEN, between corruptibility and incorruptibility.
verses.text: And two springs come out which send forth honey and milk, and their springs send forth oil and wine, and they separate into four parts, and go round with quiet course, and go down into the PARADISE OF EDEN, between corruptibility and incorruptibility.

verses.raw: And thence they go forth along the earth, and have a revolution to their circle even as other elements.
verses.text: And thence they go forth along the earth, and have a revolution to their circle even as other elements.

verses.raw: And here there is no unfruitful tree, and every place is blessed.
verses.text: And here there is no unfruitful tree, and every place is blessed.

verses.raw: And there are three hundred angels very bright, who keep the garden, and with incessant sweet singing and never-silent voices serve Yahuah (Lord) throughout all days and hours.
verses.text: And there are three hundred angels very bright, who keep the garden, and with incessant sweet singing and never-silent voices serve Yahuah throughout all days and hours.

verses.raw: And I said: How very sweet is this place, and those men said to me:
verses.text: And I said: How very sweet is this place, and those men said to me:

verses.raw: This place, O Enoch, is prepared for the righteous, who endure all manner of offence from those that exasperate their souls, who avert their eyes from iniquity, and make righteous judgment, and give bread to the hungering, and cover the naked with clothing, and raise up the fallen, and help injured orphans, and who walk without fault before the face of Yahuah (Lord), and serve him alone, and for them is prepared this place for eternal inheritance.
verses.text: This place, O Enoch, is prepared for the righteous, who endure all manner of offence from those that exasperate their souls, who avert their eyes from iniquity, and make righteous judgment, and give bread to the hungering, and cover the naked with clothing, and raise up the fallen, and help injured orphans, and who walk without fault before the face of Yahuah, and serve him alone, and for them is prepared this place for eternal inheritance.

verses.raw: And those two men led me up on to the Northern side, and showed me there a very terrible place, and there were all manner of tortures in that place: cruel darkness and unillumined gloom, and there is no light there, but murky fire constantly flaming aloft, and there is a fiery river coming forth, and that whole place is everywhere fire, and everywhere there is frost and ice, thirst and shivering, while the bonds are very cruel, and the angels fearful and merciless, bearing angry weapons, merciless torture, and I said:
verses.text: And those two men led me up on to the Northern side, and showed me there a very terrible place, and there were all manner of tortures in that place: cruel darkness and unillumined gloom, and there is no light there, but murky fire constantly flaming aloft, and there is a fiery river coming forth, and that whole place is everywhere fire, and everywhere there is frost and ice, thirst and shivering, while the bonds are very cruel, and the angels fearful and merciless, bearing angry weapons, merciless torture, and I said:

verses.raw: Woe, woe, how very terrible is this place.
verses.text: Woe, woe, how very terrible is this place.

verses.raw: And those men said to me: This place, O Enoch, is prepared for those who dishonour Elohim (God), who on earth practice sin against nature, which is child-corruption after the sodomitic fashion, magic-making, enchantments and devilish witchcrafts, and who boast of their wicked deeds, stealing, lies, calumnies, envy, rancour, fornication, murder, and who, accursed, steal the souls of men, who, seeing the poor take away their goods and themselves wax rich, injuring them for other men’s goods; who being able to satisfy the empty, made the hungering to die; being able to clothe, stripped the naked; and who knew not their creator, and bowed to the soulless and lifeless gods, who cannot see nor hear, vain gods, who also built hewn images and bow down to unclean handiwork, for all these is prepared this place among these, for eternal inheritance.
verses.text: And those men said to me: This place, O Enoch, is prepared for those who dishonour Elohim, who on earth practice sin against nature, which is child-corruption after the sodomitic fashion, magic-making, enchantments and devilish witchcrafts, and who boast of their wicked deeds, stealing, lies, calumnies, envy, rancour, fornication, murder, and who, accursed, steal the souls of men, who, seeing the poor take away their goods and themselves wax rich, injuring them for other men’s goods; who being able to satisfy the empty, made the hungering to die; being able to clothe, stripped the naked; and who knew not their creator, and bowed to the soulless and lifeless gods, who cannot see nor hear, vain gods, who also built hewn images and bow down to unclean handiwork, for all these is prepared this place among these, for eternal inheritance.

verses.raw: Those men took me, and led me up on to the fourth heaven, and showed me all the successive goings, and all the rays of the light of sun and moon.
verses.text: Those men took me, and led me up on to the fourth heaven, and showed me all the successive goings, and all the rays of the light of sun and moon.

verses.raw: And I measure their goings, and compared their light, and saw that the sun’s light is greater than the moon’s.
verses.text: And I measure their goings, and compared their light, and saw that the sun’s light is greater than the moon’s.

verses.raw: Its circle and the wheels on which it goes always, like the wind going past with very marvellous speed, and day and night it has no rest.
verses.text: Its circle and the wheels on which it goes always, like the wind going past with very marvellous speed, and day and night it has no rest.

verses.raw: Its passage and return are accompanied by four great stars, and each star has under it a thousand stars, to the right of the sun’s wheel, and by four to the left, each having under it a thousand stars, altogether eight thousand, issuing with the sun continually.
verses.text: Its passage and return are accompanied by four great stars, and each star has under it a thousand stars, to the right of the sun’s wheel, and by four to the left, each having under it a thousand stars, altogether eight thousand, issuing with the sun continually.

verses.raw: And by day fifteen myriads of angels attend it, and by night a thousand.
verses.text: And by day fifteen myriads of angels attend it, and by night a thousand.

verses.raw: And six-winged ones issue with the angels before the sun’s wheel into the fiery flames, and a hundred angels kindle the sun and set it alight.
verses.text: And six-winged ones issue with the angels before the sun’s wheel into the fiery flames, and a hundred angels kindle the sun and set it alight.

verses.raw: And I looked and saw other flying elements of the sun, whose names are Phoenixes and Chalkydri, marvellous and wonderful, with feet and tails in the form of a lion, and a crocodile’s head, their appearance is empurpled, like the rainbow; their size is nine hundred measures, their wings are like those of angels, each has twelve, and they attend and accompany the sun, bearing heat and dew, as it is ordered them from Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I looked and saw other flying elements of the sun, whose names are Phoenixes and Chalkydri, marvellous and wonderful, with feet and tails in the form of a lion, and a crocodile’s head, their appearance is empurpled, like the rainbow; their size is nine hundred measures, their wings are like those of angels, each has twelve, and they attend and accompany the sun, bearing heat and dew, as it is ordered them from Elohim.

verses.raw: Thus the sun revolves and goes, and rises under the heaven, and its course goes under the earth with the light of its rays incessantly.
verses.text: Thus the sun revolves and goes, and rises under the heaven, and its course goes under the earth with the light of its rays incessantly.

verses.raw: Those men bore me away to the east, and placed me at the sun’s gates, where the sun goes forth according to the regulation of the seasons and the circuit of the months of the whole year, and the number of the hours day and night.
verses.text: Those men bore me away to the east, and placed me at the sun’s gates, where the sun goes forth according to the regulation of the seasons and the circuit of the months of the whole year, and the number of the hours day and night.

verses.raw: And I saw six gates open, each gate having sixty-one stadia and a quarter of one stadium, and I measured them truly, and understood their size to be so much, through which the sun goes forth, and goes to the west, and is made even, and rises throughout all the months, and turns back again from the six gates according to the succession of the seasons; thus the period of the whole year is finished after the returns of the four seasons.
verses.text: And I saw six gates open, each gate having sixty-one stadia and a quarter of one stadium, and I measured them truly, and understood their size to be so much, through which the sun goes forth, and goes to the west, and is made even, and rises throughout all the months, and turns back again from the six gates according to the succession of the seasons; thus the period of the whole year is finished after the returns of the four seasons.

verses.raw: And again those men led me away to the western parts, and showed me six great gates open corresponding to the eastern gates, opposite to where the sun sets, according to the number of the days three hundred and sixty-five and a quarter.
verses.text: And again those men led me away to the western parts, and showed me six great gates open corresponding to the eastern gates, opposite to where the sun sets, according to the number of the days three hundred and sixty-five and a quarter.

verses.raw: Thus again it goes down to the western gates, and draws away its light, the greatness of its brightness, under the earth; for since the crown of its shining is in heaven with Yahuah (Lord), and guarded by four hundred angels, while the sun goes round on wheel under the earth, and stands seven great hours in night, and spends half its course under the earth, when it comes to the eastern approach in the eighth hour of the night, it brings its lights, and the crown of shining, and the sun flames forth more than fire.
verses.text: Thus again it goes down to the western gates, and draws away its light, the greatness of its brightness, under the earth; for since the crown of its shining is in heaven with Yahuah, and guarded by four hundred angels, while the sun goes round on wheel under the earth, and stands seven great hours in night, and spends half its course under the earth, when it comes to the eastern approach in the eighth hour of the night, it brings its lights, and the crown of shining, and the sun flames forth more than fire.

verses.raw: Then the elements of the sun, called Phoenixes and Chalkydri break into song, therefore every bird flutters with its wings, rejoicing at the giver of light, and they broke into song at the command of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: Then the elements of the sun, called Phoenixes and Chalkydri break into song, therefore every bird flutters with its wings, rejoicing at the giver of light, and they broke into song at the command of Yahuah.

verses.raw: The giver of light comes to give brightness to the whole world, and the morning guard takes shape, which is the rays of the sun, and the sun of the earth goes out, and receives its brightness to light up the whole face of the earth, and they showed me this calculation of the sun’s going.
verses.text: The giver of light comes to give brightness to the whole world, and the morning guard takes shape, which is the rays of the sun, and the sun of the earth goes out, and receives its brightness to light up the whole face of the earth, and they showed me this calculation of the sun’s going.

verses.raw: And the gates which it enters, these are the great gates of the calculation of the hours of the year; for this reason the sun is a great creation, whose circuit lasts twenty-eight years, and begins again from the beginning.
verses.text: And the gates which it enters, these are the great gates of the calculation of the hours of the year; for this reason the sun is a great creation, whose circuit lasts twenty-eight years, and begins again from the beginning.

verses.raw: Those men showed me the other course, that of the moon, twelve great gates, crowned from west to east, by which the moon goes in and out of the customary times.
verses.text: Those men showed me the other course, that of the moon, twelve great gates, crowned from west to east, by which the moon goes in and out of the customary times.

verses.raw: It goes in at the first gate to the western places of the sun, by the first gates with thirty-one days exactly, by the second gates with thirty-one days exactly, by the third with thirty days exactly, by the fourth with thirty days exactly, by the fifth with thirty-one days exactly, by the sixth with thirty-one days exactly, by the seventh with thirty days exactly, by the eighth with thirty-one days perfectly, by the ninth with thirty-one days exactly, by the tenth with thirty days perfectly, by the eleventh with thirty-one days exactly, by the twelfth with twenty-eight days exactly.
verses.text: It goes in at the first gate to the western places of the sun, by the first gates with thirty-one days exactly, by the second gates with thirty-one days exactly, by the third with thirty days exactly, by the fourth with thirty days exactly, by the fifth with thirty-one days exactly, by the sixth with thirty-one days exactly, by the seventh with thirty days exactly, by the eighth with thirty-one days perfectly, by the ninth with thirty-one days exactly, by the tenth with thirty days perfectly, by the eleventh with thirty-one days exactly, by the twelfth with twenty-eight days exactly.

verses.raw: And it goes through the western gates in the order and number of the eastern, and accomplishes the three hundred and sixty-five and a quarter days of the solar year, while the lunar year has three hundred fifty-four, and there are wanting to it twelve days of the solar circle, which are the lunar epacts of the whole year.
verses.text: And it goes through the western gates in the order and number of the eastern, and accomplishes the three hundred and sixty-five and a quarter days of the solar year, while the lunar year has three hundred fifty-four, and there are wanting to it twelve days of the solar circle, which are the lunar epacts of the whole year.

verses.raw: Thus, too, the great circle contains five hundred and thirty-two years.
verses.text: Thus, too, the great circle contains five hundred and thirty-two years.

verses.raw: The quarter of a day is omitted for three years, the fourth fulfills it exactly.
verses.text: The quarter of a day is omitted for three years, the fourth fulfills it exactly.

verses.raw: Therefore they are taken outside of heaven for three years and are not added to the number of days, because they change the time of the years to two new months towards completion, to two others towards diminution.
verses.text: Therefore they are taken outside of heaven for three years and are not added to the number of days, because they change the time of the years to two new months towards completion, to two others towards diminution.

verses.raw: And when the western gates are finished, it returns and goes to the eastern to the lights, and goes thus day and night about the heavenly circles, lower than all circles, swifter than the heavenly winds, and spirits and elements and angels flying; each angel has six wings.
verses.text: And when the western gates are finished, it returns and goes to the eastern to the lights, and goes thus day and night about the heavenly circles, lower than all circles, swifter than the heavenly winds, and spirits and elements and angels flying; each angel has six wings.

verses.raw: It has a sevenfold course in nineteen years.
verses.text: It has a sevenfold course in nineteen years.

verses.raw: In the midst of the heavens I saw armed soldiers, serving Yahuah (Lord), with tympana and organs, with incessant voice, with sweet voice, with sweet and incessant voice and various singing, which it is impossible to describe, and which astonishes every mind, so wonderful and marvellous is the singing of those angels, and I was delighted listening to it.
verses.text: In the midst of the heavens I saw armed soldiers, serving Yahuah, with tympana and organs, with incessant voice, with sweet voice, with sweet and incessant voice and various singing, which it is impossible to describe, and which astonishes every mind, so wonderful and marvellous is the singing of those angels, and I was delighted listening to it.

verses.raw: The men took me on to the fifth heaven and placed me, and there I saw many and countless soldiers, called Grigori, of human appearance, and their size was greater than that of great giants and their faces withered, and the silence of their mouths perpetual, and their was no service on the fifth heaven, and I said to the men who were with me:
verses.text: The men took me on to the fifth heaven and placed me, and there I saw many and countless soldiers, called Grigori, of human appearance, and their size was greater than that of great giants and their faces withered, and the silence of their mouths perpetual, and their was no service on the fifth heaven, and I said to the men who were with me:

verses.raw: Wherefore are these very withered and their faces melancholy, and their mouths silent, and wherefore is there no service on this heaven?
verses.text: Wherefore are these very withered and their faces melancholy, and their mouths silent, and wherefore is there no service on this heaven?

verses.raw: And they said to me: These are the Grigori, who with their prince Satanail rejected Yahuah (Lord) of light, and after them are those who are held in great darkness on the second heaven, and three of them went down on to earth from Yahuah's (Lord’s) throne, to the place Ermon, and broke through their vows on the shoulder of the hill Ermon and saw the daughters of men how good they are, and took to themselves wives, and befouled the earth with their deeds, who in all times of their age made lawlessness and mixing, and giants are born and marvellous big men and great enmity.
verses.text: And they said to me: These are the Grigori, who with their prince Satanail rejected Yahuah of light, and after them are those who are held in great darkness on the second heaven, and three of them went down on to earth from Yahuah's (Lord’s) throne, to the place Ermon, and broke through their vows on the shoulder of the hill Ermon and saw the daughters of men how good they are, and took to themselves wives, and befouled the earth with their deeds, who in all times of their age made lawlessness and mixing, and giants are born and marvellous big men and great enmity.

verses.raw: And therefore Elohim (God) judged them with great judgment, and they weep for their brethren and they will be punished on Yahuah's (Lord’s) great day.
verses.text: And therefore Elohim judged them with great judgment, and they weep for their brethren and they will be punished on Yahuah's (Lord’s) great day.

verses.raw: And I said to the Grigori: I saw your brethren and their works, and their great torments, and I prayed for them, but Yahuah (Lord) has condemned them to be under earth till the existing heaven and earth shall end for ever.
verses.text: And I said to the Grigori: I saw your brethren and their works, and their great torments, and I prayed for them, but Yahuah has condemned them to be under earth till the existing heaven and earth shall end for ever.

verses.raw: And I said: Wherefore do you wait, brethren, and do not serve before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, and have not put your services before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, lest you anger your Lord utterly?
verses.text: And I said: Wherefore do you wait, brethren, and do not serve before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, and have not put your services before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, lest you anger your Lord utterly?

verses.raw: And they listened to my admonition, and spoke to the four ranks in heaven, and lo! As I stood with those two men four trumpets trumpeted together with great voice, and the Grigori broke into song with one voice, and their voice went up before Yahuah (Lord) pitifully and affectingly.
verses.text: And they listened to my admonition, and spoke to the four ranks in heaven, and lo! As I stood with those two men four trumpets trumpeted together with great voice, and the Grigori broke into song with one voice, and their voice went up before Yahuah pitifully and affectingly.

verses.raw: And thence those men took me and bore me up on to the sixth heaven, and there I saw seven bands of angels, very bright and very glorious, and their faces shining more than the sun’s shining, glistening, and there is no difference in their faces, or behaviour, or manner of dress; and these make the orders, and learn the goings of the stars, and the alteration of the moon, or revolution of the sun, and the good government of the world.
verses.text: And thence those men took me and bore me up on to the sixth heaven, and there I saw seven bands of angels, very bright and very glorious, and their faces shining more than the sun’s shining, glistening, and there is no difference in their faces, or behaviour, or manner of dress; and these make the orders, and learn the goings of the stars, and the alteration of the moon, or revolution of the sun, and the good government of the world.

verses.raw: And when they see evildoing they make commandments and instruction, and sweet and loud singing, and all songs of praise.
verses.text: And when they see evildoing they make commandments and instruction, and sweet and loud singing, and all songs of praise.

verses.raw: These are the archangels (1) who are above angels, measure all life in heaven and on earth, and the angels who are appointed over seasons and years, the angels who are over rivers and sea, and who are over the fruits of the earth, and the angels who are over every grass, giving food to all, to every living thing, and the angels who write all the souls of men, and all their deeds, and their lives before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face; in their midst are six Phoenixes and six Cherubim and six six-winged ones continually with one voice singing one voice, and it is not possible to describe their singing, and they rejoice before Yahuah (Lord) at his footstool.
verses.text: These are the archangels (1) who are above angels, measure all life in heaven and on earth, and the angels who are appointed over seasons and years, the angels who are over rivers and sea, and who are over the fruits of the earth, and the angels who are over every grass, giving food to all, to every living thing, and the angels who write all the souls of men, and all their deeds, and their lives before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face; in their midst are six Phoenixes and six Cherubim and six six-winged ones continually with one voice singing one voice, and it is not possible to describe their singing, and they rejoice before Yahuah at his footstool.

verses.raw: And those two men lifted me up thence on to the seventh heaven, and I saw there a very great light, and fiery troops of great archangels (2), incorporeal forces, and dominions, orders and governments, cherubim and seraphim, thrones and many-eyed ones, nine regiments, the Ioanit stations of light, and I became afraid, and began to tremble with great terror, and those men took me, and led me after them, and said to me:
verses.text: And those two men lifted me up thence on to the seventh heaven, and I saw there a very great light, and fiery troops of great archangels (2), incorporeal forces, and dominions, orders and governments, cherubim and seraphim, thrones and many-eyed ones, nine regiments, the Ioanit stations of light, and I became afraid, and began to tremble with great terror, and those men took me, and led me after them, and said to me:

verses.raw: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, and showed me Yahuah (Lord) from afar, sitting on His very high throne. For what is there on the tenth heaven, since Yahuah (Lord) dwells there?
verses.text: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, and showed me Yahuah from afar, sitting on His very high throne. For what is there on the tenth heaven, since Yahuah dwells there?

verses.raw: On the tenth heaven is Elohim (God), in the Hebrew tongue he is called Aravat (3).
verses.text: On the tenth heaven is Elohim, in the Hebrew tongue he is called Aravat (3).

verses.raw: And all the heavenly troops would come and stand on the ten steps according to their rank, and would bow down to Yahuah (Lord), and would again go to their places in joy and felicity, singing songs in the boundless light with small and tender voices, gloriously serving him.
verses.text: And all the heavenly troops would come and stand on the ten steps according to their rank, and would bow down to Yahuah, and would again go to their places in joy and felicity, singing songs in the boundless light with small and tender voices, gloriously serving him.

verses.raw: And the cherubim and seraphim standing about the throne, the six-winged and many-eyed ones do not depart, standing before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face doing his will, and cover his whole throne, singing with gentle voice before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face: Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah (Lord) Ruler of Sabaoth, heavens and earth are full of Your glory.
verses.text: And the cherubim and seraphim standing about the throne, the six-winged and many-eyed ones do not depart, standing before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face doing his will, and cover his whole throne, singing with gentle voice before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face: Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Ruler of Sabaoth, heavens and earth are full of Your glory.

verses.raw: When I saw all these things, those men said to me: Enoch, thus far is it commanded us to journey with you, and those men went away from me and thereupon I saw them not.
verses.text: When I saw all these things, those men said to me: Enoch, thus far is it commanded us to journey with you, and those men went away from me and thereupon I saw them not.

verses.raw: And I remained alone at the end of the seventh heaven and became afraid, and fell on my face and said to myself: Woe is me, what has befallen me?
verses.text: And I remained alone at the end of the seventh heaven and became afraid, and fell on my face and said to myself: Woe is me, what has befallen me?

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) sent one of his glorious ones, the archangel (4) Gabriel, and he said to me: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, arise before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face into eternity, arise, come with me.
verses.text: And Yahuah sent one of his glorious ones, the archangel (4) Gabriel, and he said to me: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, arise before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face into eternity, arise, come with me.

verses.raw: And I answered him, and said in myself: My Lord, my soul is departed from me, from terror and trembling, and I called to the men who led me up to this place, on them I relied, and it is with them I go before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.
verses.text: And I answered him, and said in myself: My Lord, my soul is departed from me, from terror and trembling, and I called to the men who led me up to this place, on them I relied, and it is with them I go before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.

verses.raw: And Gabriel caught me up, as a leaf caught up by the wind, and placed me before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.
verses.text: And Gabriel caught me up, as a leaf caught up by the wind, and placed me before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.

verses.raw: And I saw the eighth heaven, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Muzaloth, changer of the seasons, of drought, and of wet, and of the twelve constellations of the circle of the firmament, which are above the seventh heaven.
verses.text: And I saw the eighth heaven, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Muzaloth, changer of the seasons, of drought, and of wet, and of the twelve constellations of the circle of the firmament, which are above the seventh heaven.

verses.raw: And I saw the ninth heaven, which is called in Hebrew Kuchavim, where are the heavenly homes of the twelve constellations of the circle of the firmament.
verses.text: And I saw the ninth heaven, which is called in Hebrew Kuchavim, where are the heavenly homes of the twelve constellations of the circle of the firmament.

verses.raw: On the tenth heaven, which is called Aravoth, I saw the appearance of Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, like iron made to glow in fire, and brought out, emitting sparks, and it burns.
verses.text: On the tenth heaven, which is called Aravoth, I saw the appearance of Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, like iron made to glow in fire, and brought out, emitting sparks, and it burns.

verses.raw: Thus in a moment of eternity I saw Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, but Yahuah's (Lord’s) face is ineffable, marvellous and very awful, and very, very terrible.
verses.text: Thus in a moment of eternity I saw Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, but Yahuah's (Lord’s) face is ineffable, marvellous and very awful, and very, very terrible.

verses.raw: And who am I to tell of Yahuah's (Lord’s) unspeakable being, and of his very wonderful face? And I cannot tell the quantity of his many instructions, and various voices, Yahuah's (Lord's) throne is very great and not made with hands, nor the quantity of those standing round him, troops of cherubim and seraphim, nor their incessant singing, nor his immutable beauty, and who shall tell of the ineffable greatness of his glory.
verses.text: And who am I to tell of Yahuah's (Lord’s) unspeakable being, and of his very wonderful face?
