And I cannot tell the quantity of his many instructions, and various voices, Yahuah's (Lord's) throne is very great and not made with hands, nor the quantity of those standing round him, troops of cherubim and seraphim, nor their incessant singing, nor his immutable beauty, and who shall tell of the ineffable greatness of his glory.

verses.raw: And I fell prone and bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and Yahuah (Lord) with his lips said to me:
verses.text: And I fell prone and bowed down to Yahuah, and Yahuah with his lips said to me:

verses.raw: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, arise and stand before my face into eternity.
verses.text: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, arise and stand before my face into eternity.

verses.raw: And the archistratege (5) Michael lifted me up, and led me to before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.
verses.text: And the archistratege (5) Michael lifted me up, and led me to before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) said to his servants tempting them: Let Enoch stand before my face into eternity, and the glorious ones bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and said: Let Enoch go according to Your word.
verses.text: And Yahuah said to his servants tempting them: Let Enoch stand before my face into eternity, and the glorious ones bowed down to Yahuah, and said: Let Enoch go according to Your word.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) said to Michael: Go and take Enoch from out of his earthly garments, and anoint him with my sweet ointment, and put him into the garments of My glory.
verses.text: And Yahuah said to Michael: Go and take Enoch from out of his earthly garments, and anoint him with my sweet ointment, and put him into the garments of My glory.

verses.raw: And Michael did thus, as Yahuah (Lord) told him. He anointed me, and dressed me, and the appearance of that ointment is more than the great light, and his ointment is like sweet dew, and its smell mild, shining like the sun’s ray, and I looked at myself, and I was like one of his glorious ones (6).
verses.text: And Michael did thus, as Yahuah told him. He anointed me, and dressed me, and the appearance of that ointment is more than the great light, and his ointment is like sweet dew, and its smell mild, shining like the sun’s ray, and I looked at myself, and I was like one of his glorious ones (6).

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) summoned one of his archangels by name Pravuil, whose knowledge was quicker in wisdom than the other archangels, who wrote all the deeds of Yahuah (Lord); and Yahuah (Lord) said to Pravuil: Bring out the books from my store-houses, and a reed of quick-writing, and give it to Enoch, and deliver to him the choice and comforting books out of your hand.
verses.text: And Yahuah summoned one of his archangels by name Pravuil, whose knowledge was quicker in wisdom than the other archangels, who wrote all the deeds of Yahuah; and Yahuah said to Pravuil: Bring out the books from my store-houses, and a reed of quick-writing, and give it to Enoch, and deliver to him the choice and comforting books out of your hand.

verses.raw: And he was telling me all the works of heaven, earth and sea, and all the elements, their passages and goings, and the thunderings of the thunders, the sun and moon, the goings and changes of the stars, the seasons, years, days, and hours, the risings of the wind, the numbers of the angels, and the formation of their songs, and all human things, the tongue of every human song and life, the commandments, instructions, and sweet-voiced singings, and all things that it is fitting to learn.
verses.text: And he was telling me all the works of heaven, earth and sea, and all the elements, their passages and goings, and the thunderings of the thunders, the sun and moon, the goings and changes of the stars, the seasons, years, days, and hours, the risings of the wind, the numbers of the angels, and the formation of their songs, and all human things, the tongue of every human song and life, the commandments, instructions, and sweet-voiced singings, and all things that it is fitting to learn.

verses.raw: And Pravuil told me: All the things that I have told you, we have written. Sit and write all the souls of mankind, however many of them are born, and the places prepared for them to eternity; for all souls are prepared to eternity, before the formation of the world.
verses.text: And Pravuil told me: All the things that I have told you, we have written. Sit and write all the souls of mankind, however many of them are born, and the places prepared for them to eternity; for all souls are prepared to eternity, before the formation of the world.

verses.raw: And all double thirty days and thirty nights, and I wrote out all things exactly, and wrote three hundred and sixty-six books.
verses.text: And all double thirty days and thirty nights, and I wrote out all things exactly, and wrote three hundred and sixty-six books.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) summoned me, and said to me: Enoch, sit down on my left with Gabriel.
verses.text: And Yahuah summoned me, and said to me: Enoch, sit down on my left with Gabriel.

verses.raw: And I bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and Yahuah (Lord) spoke to me: Enoch, beloved, all that you see, all things that are standing finished I tell to you even before the very beginning, all that I created from non-being, and visible things from invisible.
verses.text: And I bowed down to Yahuah, and Yahuah spoke to me: Enoch, beloved, all that you see, all things that are standing finished I tell to you even before the very beginning, all that I created from non-being, and visible things from invisible.

verses.raw: Hear, Enoch, and take in these my words, for not to My angels have I told my secret, and I have not told them their rise, nor my endless realm, nor have they understood my creating, which I tell you to-day.
verses.text: Hear, Enoch, and take in these my words, for not to My angels have I told my secret, and I have not told them their rise, nor my endless realm, nor have they understood my creating, which I tell you to-day.

verses.raw: For before all things were visible, I alone used to go about in the invisible things, like the sun from east to west, and from west to east.
verses.text: For before all things were visible, I alone used to go about in the invisible things, like the sun from east to west, and from west to east.

verses.raw: But even the sun has peace in itself, while I found no peace, because I was creating all things, and I conceived the thought of placing foundations, and of creating visible creation.
verses.text: But even the sun has peace in itself, while I found no peace, because I was creating all things, and I conceived the thought of placing foundations, and of creating visible creation.

verses.raw: I commanded in the very lowest parts, that visible things should come down from invisible, and Adoil (7) came down very great, and I beheld him, and lo! He had a belly of great light.
verses.text: I commanded in the very lowest parts, that visible things should come down from invisible, and Adoil (7) came down very great, and I beheld him, and lo! He had a belly of great light.

verses.raw: And I said to him: Become undone, Adoil, and let the visible come out of you.
verses.text: And I said to him: Become undone, Adoil, and let the visible come out of you.

verses.raw: And he came undone, and a great light came out. And I was in the midst of the great light, and as there is born light from light, there came forth a great age, and showed all creation, which I had thought to create.
verses.text: And he came undone, and a great light came out. And I was in the midst of the great light, and as there is born light from light, there came forth a great age, and showed all creation, which I had thought to create.

verses.raw: And I saw that it was good.
verses.text: And I saw that it was good.

verses.raw: And I placed for myself a throne, and took my seat on it, and said to the light: Go thence up higher and fix yourself high above the throne, and be a foundation to the highest things.
verses.text: And I placed for myself a throne, and took my seat on it, and said to the light: Go thence up higher and fix yourself high above the throne, and be a foundation to the highest things.

verses.raw: And above the light there is nothing else, and then I bent up and looked up from my throne.
verses.text: And above the light there is nothing else, and then I bent up and looked up from my throne.

verses.raw: And I summoned the very lowest a second time, and said: Let Archas (8) come forth hard, and he came forth hard from the invisible.
verses.text: And I summoned the very lowest a second time, and said: Let Archas (8) come forth hard, and he came forth hard from the invisible.

verses.raw: And Archas came forth, hard, heavy, and very red.
verses.text: And Archas came forth, hard, heavy, and very red.

verses.raw: And I said: Be opened, Archas, and let there be born from you, and he came undone, an age came forth, very great and very dark, bearing the creation of all lower things, and I saw that it was good and said to him:
verses.text: And I said: Be opened, Archas, and let there be born from you, and he came undone, an age came forth, very great and very dark, bearing the creation of all lower things, and I saw that it was good and said to him:

verses.raw: Go thence down below, and make yourself firm, and be a foundation for the lower things, and it happened and he went down and fixed himself, and became the foundation for the lower things, and below the darkness there is nothing else.
verses.text: Go thence down below, and make yourself firm, and be a foundation for the lower things, and it happened and he went down and fixed himself, and became the foundation for the lower things, and below the darkness there is nothing else.

verses.raw: And I commanded that there should be taken from light and darkness, and I said: Be thick, and it became thus, and I spread it out with the light, and it became water, and I spread it out over the darkness, below the light, and then I made firm the waters, that is to say the bottomless, and I made foundation of light around the water, and created seven circles from inside, and imaged the water like crystal wet and dry, that is to say like glass, and the circumcession of the waters and the other elements, and I showed each one of them its road, and the seven stars each one of them in its heaven, that they go thus, and I saw that it was good.
verses.text: And I commanded that there should be taken from light and darkness, and I said: Be thick, and it became thus, and I spread it out with the light, and it became water, and I spread it out over the darkness, below the light, and then I made firm the waters, that is to say the bottomless, and I made foundation of light around the water, and created seven circles from inside, and imaged the water like crystal wet and dry, that is to say like glass, and the circumcession of the waters and the other elements, and I showed each one of them its road, and the seven stars each one of them in its heaven, that they go thus, and I saw that it was good.

verses.raw: And I separated between light and between darkness, that is to say in the midst of the water hither and thither, and I said to the light, that it should be the day, and to the darkness, that it should be the night, and there was evening and there was morning the first day.
verses.text: And I separated between light and between darkness, that is to say in the midst of the water hither and thither, and I said to the light, that it should be the day, and to the darkness, that it should be the night, and there was evening and there was morning the first day.

verses.raw: And then I made firm the heavenly circle, and made that the lower water which is under heaven collect itself together, into one whole, and that the chaos become dry, and it became so.
verses.text: And then I made firm the heavenly circle, and made that the lower water which is under heaven collect itself together, into one whole, and that the chaos become dry, and it became so.

verses.raw: Out of the waves I created rock hard and big, and from the rock I piled up the dry, and the dry I called earth, and the midst of the earth I called abyss, that is to say the bottomless, I collected the sea in one place and bound it together with a yoke.
verses.text: Out of the waves I created rock hard and big, and from the rock I piled up the dry, and the dry I called earth, and the midst of the earth I called abyss, that is to say the bottomless, I collected the sea in one place and bound it together with a yoke.

verses.raw: And I said to the sea: Behold I give you your eternal limits, and you shalt not break loose from your component parts.
verses.text: And I said to the sea: Behold I give you your eternal limits, and you shalt not break loose from your component parts.

verses.raw: Thus I made fast the firmament. This day I called me the first-created [Sunday].
verses.text: Thus I made fast the firmament. This day I called me the first-created [Sunday].

verses.raw: And for all the heavenly troops I imaged the image and essence of fire, and my eye looked at the very hard, firm rock, and from the gleam of my eye the lightning received its wonderful nature, which is both fire in water and water in fire, and one does not put out the other, nor does the one dry up the other, therefore the lightning is brighter than the sun, softer than water and firmer than hard rock.
verses.text: And for all the heavenly troops I imaged the image and essence of fire, and my eye looked at the very hard, firm rock, and from the gleam of my eye the lightning received its wonderful nature, which is both fire in water and water in fire, and one does not put out the other, nor does the one dry up the other, therefore the lightning is brighter than the sun, softer than water and firmer than hard rock.

verses.raw: And from the rock I cut off a great fire, and from the fire I created the orders of the incorporeal ten troops of angels, and their weapons are fiery and their raiment a burning flame, and I commanded that each one should stand in his order.
verses.text: And from the rock I cut off a great fire, and from the fire I created the orders of the incorporeal ten troops of angels, and their weapons are fiery and their raiment a burning flame, and I commanded that each one should stand in his order.

verses.raw: And one from out the order of angels, having turned away with the order that was under him, conceived an impossible thought, to place his throne higher than the clouds above the earth, that he might become equal in rank to my power.
verses.text: And one from out the order of angels, having turned away with the order that was under him, conceived an impossible thought, to place his throne higher than the clouds above the earth, that he might become equal in rank to my power.

verses.raw: And I threw him out from the height with his angels, and he was flying in the air continuously above the bottomless.
verses.text: And I threw him out from the height with his angels, and he was flying in the air continuously above the bottomless.

verses.raw: On the third day I commanded the earth to make grow great and fruitful trees, and hills, and seed to sow, and I planted Paradise, and enclosed it, and placed as armed guardians flaming angels, and thus I created renewal.
verses.text: On the third day I commanded the earth to make grow great and fruitful trees, and hills, and seed to sow, and I planted Paradise, and enclosed it, and placed as armed guardians flaming angels, and thus I created renewal.

verses.raw: Then came evening, and came morning the fourth day.
verses.text: Then came evening, and came morning the fourth day.

verses.raw: [Wednesday]. On the fourth day I commanded that there should be great lights on the heavenly circles.
verses.text: [Wednesday]. On the fourth day I commanded that there should be great lights on the heavenly circles.

verses.raw: On the first uppermost circle I placed the stars, Kruno, and on the second Aphrodit, on the third Aris, on the fifth Zoues, on the sixth Ermis, on the seventh lesser the moon, and adorned it with the lesser stars.
verses.text: On the first uppermost circle I placed the stars, Kruno, and on the second Aphrodit, on the third Aris, on the fifth Zoues, on the sixth Ermis, on the seventh lesser the moon, and adorned it with the lesser stars.

verses.raw: And on the lower I placed the sun for the illumination of day, and the moon and stars for the illumination of night.
verses.text: And on the lower I placed the sun for the illumination of day, and the moon and stars for the illumination of night.

verses.raw: The sun that it should go according to each constellation, twelve, and I appointed the succession of the months and their names and lives, their thunderings, and their hour-markings, how they should succeed.
verses.text: The sun that it should go according to each constellation, twelve, and I appointed the succession of the months and their names and lives, their thunderings, and their hour-markings, how they should succeed.

verses.raw: Then evening came and morning came the fifth day.
verses.text: Then evening came and morning came the fifth day.

verses.raw: [Thursday]. On the fifth day I commanded the sea, that it should bring forth fishes, and feathered birds of many varieties, and all animals creeping over the earth, going forth over the earth on four legs, and soaring in the air, male sex and female, and every soul breathing the spirit of life.
verses.text: [Thursday]. On the fifth day I commanded the sea, that it should bring forth fishes, and feathered birds of many varieties, and all animals creeping over the earth, going forth over the earth on four legs, and soaring in the air, male sex and female, and every soul breathing the spirit of life.

verses.raw: And there came evening, and there came morning the sixth day.
verses.text: And there came evening, and there came morning the sixth day.

verses.raw: [Friday]. On the sixth day I commanded my wisdom to create man from seven consistencies: one, his flesh from the earth; two, his blood from the dew; three, his eyes from the sun; four, his bones from stone; five, his intelligence from the swiftness of the angels and from cloud; six, his veins and his hair from the grass of the earth; seven, his soul from my breath and from the wind.
verses.text: [Friday]. On the sixth day I commanded my wisdom to create man from seven consistencies: one, his flesh from the earth; two, his blood from the dew; three, his eyes from the sun; four, his bones from stone; five, his intelligence from the swiftness of the angels and from cloud; six, his veins and his hair from the grass of the earth; seven, his soul from my breath and from the wind.

verses.raw: And I gave him seven natures: to the flesh hearing, the eyes for sight, to the soul smell, the veins for touch, the blood for taste, the bones for endurance, to the intelligence sweetness [enjoyment].
verses.text: And I gave him seven natures: to the flesh hearing, the eyes for sight, to the soul smell, the veins for touch, the blood for taste, the bones for endurance, to the intelligence sweetness [enjoyment].

verses.raw: I conceived a cunning saying to say, I created man from invisible and from visible nature, of both are his death and life and image, he knows speech like some created thing, small in greatness and again great in smallness, and I placed him on earth, a second angel, honourable, great and glorious, and I appointed him as ruler to rule on earth and to have my wisdom, and there was none like him of earth of all my existing creatures.
verses.text: I conceived a cunning saying to say, I created man from invisible and from visible nature, of both are his death and life and image, he knows speech like some created thing, small in greatness and again great in smallness, and I placed him on earth, a second angel, honourable, great and glorious, and I appointed him as ruler to rule on earth and to have my wisdom, and there was none like him of earth of all my existing creatures.

verses.raw: And I appointed him a name, from the four component parts, from east, from west, from south, from north, and I appointed for him four special stars, and I called his name Adam, and showed him the two ways, the light and the darkness, and I told him:
verses.text: And I appointed him a name, from the four component parts, from east, from west, from south, from north, and I appointed for him four special stars, and I called his name Adam, and showed him the two ways, the light and the darkness, and I told him:

verses.raw: This is good, and that bad, that I should learn whether he has love towards me, or hatred, that it be clear which in his race love me.
verses.text: This is good, and that bad, that I should learn whether he has love towards me, or hatred, that it be clear which in his race love me.

verses.raw: For I have seen his nature, but he has not seen his own nature, therefore through not seeing he will sin worse, and I said After sin what is there but death?
verses.text: For I have seen his nature, but he has not seen his own nature, therefore through not seeing he will sin worse, and I said After sin what is there but death?

verses.raw: And I put sleep into him and he fell asleep. And I took from him a rib, and created him a wife, that death should come to him by his wife, and I took his last word and called her name mother, that is to say, Eva.
verses.text: And I put sleep into him and he fell asleep. And I took from him a rib, and created him a wife, that death should come to him by his wife, and I took his last word and called her name mother, that is to say, Eva.

verses.raw: Adam has life on earth, and I created a garden in Eden in the east, that he should observe the testament and keep the command.
verses.text: Adam has life on earth, and I created a garden in Eden in the east, that he should observe the testament and keep the command.

verses.raw: I made the heavens open to him, that he should see the angels singing the song of victory, and the gloomless light.
verses.text: I made the heavens open to him, that he should see the angels singing the song of victory, and the gloomless light.

verses.raw: And he was continuously in paradise, and the devil understood that I wanted to create another world, because Adam was lord on earth, to rule and control it.
verses.text: And he was continuously in paradise, and the devil understood that I wanted to create another world, because Adam was lord on earth, to rule and control it.

verses.raw: The devil is the evil spirit of the lower places, as a fugitive he made Sotona (9) from the heavens as his name was Satanail (10), thus he became different from the angels, but his nature did not change his intelligence as far as his understanding of righteous and sinful things.
verses.text: The devil is the evil spirit of the lower places, as a fugitive he made Sotona (9) from the heavens as his name was Satanail (10), thus he became different from the angels, but his nature did not change his intelligence as far as his understanding of righteous and sinful things.

verses.raw: And he understood his condemnation and the sin which he had sinned before, therefore he conceived thought against Adam, in such form he entered and seduced Eva, but did not touch Adam.
verses.text: And he understood his condemnation and the sin which he had sinned before, therefore he conceived thought against Adam, in such form he entered and seduced Eva, but did not touch Adam.

verses.raw: But I cursed ignorance, but what I had blessed previously, those I did not curse, I cursed not man, nor the earth, nor other creatures, but man’s evil fruit, and his works.
verses.text: But I cursed ignorance, but what I had blessed previously, those I did not curse, I cursed not man, nor the earth, nor other creatures, but man’s evil fruit, and his works.

verses.raw: I said to him: Earth you are, and into the earth whence I took you you shalt go, and I will not ruin you, but send you whence I took you.
verses.text: I said to him: Earth you are, and into the earth whence I took you you shalt go, and I will not ruin you, but send you whence I took you.

verses.raw: Then I can again receive you at My second presence.
verses.text: Then I can again receive you at My second presence.

verses.raw: And I blessed all my creatures visible and invisible. And Adam was five and half hours in paradise.
verses.text: And I blessed all my creatures visible and invisible. And Adam was five and half hours in paradise.

verses.raw: And I blessed the seventh day, which is the Sabbath, on which he rested from all his works.
verses.text: And I blessed the seventh day, which is the Sabbath, on which he rested from all his works.

verses.raw: And I appointed the eighth day also, that the eighth day should be the first-created after my work, and that the first seven revolve in the form of the seventh thousand, and that at the beginning of the eighth thousand there should be a time of not-counting, endless, with neither years nor months nor weeks nor days nor hours.
verses.text: And I appointed the eighth day also, that the eighth day should be the first-created after my work, and that the first seven revolve in the form of the seventh thousand, and that at the beginning of the eighth thousand there should be a time of not-counting, endless, with neither years nor months nor weeks nor days nor hours.

verses.raw: And now, Enoch, all that I have told you, all that you have understood, all that you have seen of heavenly things, all that you have seen on earth, and all that I have written in books by my great wisdom, all these things I have devised and created from the uppermost foundation to the lower and to the end, and there is no counsellor nor inheritor to my creations.
verses.text: And now, Enoch, all that I have told you, all that you have understood, all that you have seen of heavenly things, all that you have seen on earth, and all that I have written in books by my great wisdom, all these things I have devised and created from the uppermost foundation to the lower and to the end, and there is no counsellor nor inheritor to my creations.

verses.raw: I am self-eternal, not made with hands, and without change.
verses.text: I am self-eternal, not made with hands, and without change.

verses.raw: My thought is my counsellor, my wisdom and my word are made, and my eyes observe all things how they stand here and tremble with terror.
verses.text: My thought is my counsellor, my wisdom and my word are made, and my eyes observe all things how they stand here and tremble with terror.

verses.raw: If I turn away my face, then all things will be destroyed.
verses.text: If I turn away my face, then all things will be destroyed.

verses.raw: And apply your mind, Enoch, and know him who is speaking to you, and take thence the books which you yourself have written.
verses.text: And apply your mind, Enoch, and know him who is speaking to you, and take thence the books which you yourself have written.

verses.raw: And I give you Samuil (11) and Raguil (12), who led you up, and the books, and go down to earth, and tell your sons all that I have told you, and all that you have seen, from the lower heaven up to my throne, and all the troops.
verses.text: And I give you Samuil (11) and Raguil (12), who led you up, and the books, and go down to earth, and tell your sons all that I have told you, and all that you have seen, from the lower heaven up to my throne, and all the troops.

verses.raw: For I created all forces, and there is none that resists me or that does not subject himself to me. For all subject themselves to my monarchy, and labour for my sole rule.
verses.text: For I created all forces, and there is none that resists me or that does not subject himself to me. For all subject themselves to my monarchy, and labour for my sole rule.

verses.raw: Give them the books of the handwriting, and they will read them and will know me for the creator of all things, and will understand how there is no other Elohim (God) but me.
verses.text: Give them the books of the handwriting, and they will read them and will know me for the creator of all things, and will understand how there is no other Elohim but me.

verses.raw: And let them distribute the books of your handwriting–children to children, generation to generation, nations to nations.
verses.text: And let them distribute the books of your handwriting–children to children, generation to generation, nations to nations.

verses.raw: And I will give you, Enoch, my intercessor, the archistratege Michael, for the handwritings of your fathers Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahaleleel, and Jared your father.
verses.text: And I will give you, Enoch, my intercessor, the archistratege Michael, for the handwritings of your fathers Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahaleleel, and Jared your father.

verses.raw: They have rejected my commandments and my yoke, worthless seed has come up, not fearing Elohim (God), and they would not bow down to me, but have begun to bow down to vain gods, and denied my unity, and have laden the whole earth with untruths, offences, abominable lecheries, namely one with another, and all manner of other unclean wickedness, which are disgusting to relate.
verses.text: They have rejected my commandments and my yoke, worthless seed has come up, not fearing Elohim, and they would not bow down to me, but have begun to bow down to vain gods, and denied my unity, and have laden the whole earth with untruths, offences, abominable lecheries, namely one with another, and all manner of other unclean wickedness, which are disgusting to relate.

verses.raw: And therefore I will bring down a deluge upon the earth and will destroy all men, and the whole earth will crumble together into great darkness.
verses.text: And therefore I will bring down a deluge upon the earth and will destroy all men, and the whole earth will crumble together into great darkness.

verses.raw: Behold from their seed shall arise another generation, much afterwards, but of them many will be very insatiate.
verses.text: Behold from their seed shall arise another generation, much afterwards, but of them many will be very insatiate.

verses.raw: He who raises that generation, shall reveal to them the books of your handwriting, of your fathers, to them to whom he must point out the guardianship of the world, to the faithful men and workers of my pleasure, who do not acknowledge my name in vain.
verses.text: He who raises that generation, shall reveal to them the books of your handwriting, of your fathers, to them to whom he must point out the guardianship of the world, to the faithful men and workers of my pleasure, who do not acknowledge my name in vain.

verses.raw: And they shall tell another generation, and those others having read shall be glorified thereafter, more than the first.
verses.text: And they shall tell another generation, and those others having read shall be glorified thereafter, more than the first.

verses.raw: Now, Enoch, I give you the term of thirty days to spend in your house, and tell your sons and all your household, that all may hear from my face what is told them by you, that they may read and understand, how there is no other Elohim (God) but me.
verses.text: Now, Enoch, I give you the term of thirty days to spend in your house, and tell your sons and all your household, that all may hear from my face what is told them by you, that they may read and understand, how there is no other Elohim but me.

verses.raw: And that they may always keep my commandments, and begin to read and take in the books of your handwriting.
verses.text: And that they may always keep my commandments, and begin to read and take in the books of your handwriting.

verses.raw: And after thirty days I shall send my angel for you, and he will take you from earth and from your sons to me.
verses.text: And after thirty days I shall send my angel for you, and he will take you from earth and from your sons to me.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) called upon one of the older angels, terrible and menacing, and placed him by me, in appearance white as snow, and his hands like ice, having the appearance of great frost, and he froze my face, because I could not endure the terror of Yahuah (Lord), just as it is not possible to endure a stove’s fire and the sun’s heat, and the frost of the air.
verses.text: And Yahuah called upon one of the older angels, terrible and menacing, and placed him by me, in appearance white as snow, and his hands like ice, having the appearance of great frost, and he froze my face, because I could not endure the terror of Yahuah, just as it is not possible to endure a stove’s fire and the sun’s heat, and the frost of the air.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) said to me: Enoch, if your face be not frozen here, no man will be able to behold your face.
verses.text: And Yahuah said to me: Enoch, if your face be not frozen here, no man will be able to behold your face.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) said to those men who first led me up: Let Enoch go down on to earth with you, and await him till the determined day.
verses.text: And Yahuah said to those men who first led me up: Let Enoch go down on to earth with you, and await him till the determined day.

verses.raw: And they placed me by night on my bed.
verses.text: And they placed me by night on my bed.

verses.raw: And Mathusal expecting my coming, keeping watch by day and by night at my bed, was filled with awe when he heard my coming, and I told him, Let all my household come together, that I tell them everything.
verses.text: And Mathusal expecting my coming, keeping watch by day and by night at my bed, was filled with awe when he heard my coming, and I told him, Let all my household come together, that I tell them everything.

verses.raw: Oh my children, my beloved ones, hear the admonition of your father, as much as is according to Yahuah's (Lord’s) will.
verses.text: Oh my children, my beloved ones, hear the admonition of your father, as much as is according to Yahuah's (Lord’s) will.

verses.raw: I have been let come to you to-day, and announce to you, not from my lips, but from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips, all that is and was and all that is now, and all that will be till judgment-day.
verses.text: I have been let come to you to-day, and announce to you, not from my lips, but from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips, all that is and was and all that is now, and all that will be till judgment-day.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (Lord) has let me come to you, you hear therefore the words of my lips, of a man made big for you, but I am one who has seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, like iron made to glow from fire it sends forth sparks and burns.
verses.text: For Yahuah has let me come to you, you hear therefore the words of my lips, of a man made big for you, but I am one who has seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, like iron made to glow from fire it sends forth sparks and burns.

verses.raw: You look now upon my eyes, the eyes of a man big with meaning for you, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) eyes, shining like the sun’s rays and filling the eyes of man with awe.
verses.text: You look now upon my eyes, the eyes of a man big with meaning for you, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) eyes, shining like the sun’s rays and filling the eyes of man with awe.

verses.raw: You see now, my children, the right hand of a man that helps you, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) right hand filling heaven as he helped me.
verses.text: You see now, my children, the right hand of a man that helps you, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) right hand filling heaven as he helped me.

verses.raw: You see the compass of my work like your own, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) limitless and perfect compass, which has no end.
verses.text: You see the compass of my work like your own, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) limitless and perfect compass, which has no end.

verses.raw: You hear the words of my lips, as I heard the words of Yahuah (Lord), like great thunder incessantly with hurling of clouds.
verses.text: You hear the words of my lips, as I heard the words of Yahuah, like great thunder incessantly with hurling of clouds.

verses.raw: And now, my children, hear the discourses of the father of the earth, how fearful and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of the earth, how much more terrible and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of heaven, the controller of quick and dead, and of the heavenly troops. Who can endure that endless pain?
verses.text: And now, my children, hear the discourses of the father of the earth, how fearful and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of the earth, how much more terrible and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of heaven, the controller of quick and dead, and of the heavenly troops. Who can endure that endless pain?

verses.raw: And now, my children, I know all things, for this is from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips, and this my eyes have seen, from beginning to end.
verses.text: And now, my children, I know all things, for this is from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips, and this my eyes have seen, from beginning to end.

verses.raw: I know all things, and have written all things into books, the heavens and their end, and their plenitude, and all the armies and their marchings.
verses.text: I know all things, and have written all things into books, the heavens and their end, and their plenitude, and all the armies and their marchings.

verses.raw: I have measured and described the stars, the great countless multitude of them.
verses.text: I have measured and described the stars, the great countless multitude of them.

verses.raw: What man has seen their revolutions, and their entrances? For not even the angels see their number, while I have written all their names.
verses.text: What man has seen their revolutions, and their entrances? For not even the angels see their number, while I have written all their names.

verses.raw: And I measured the sun’s circle, and measured its rays, counted the hours, I wrote down too all things that go over the earth, I have written the things that are nourished, and all seed sown and unsown, which the earth produces and all plants, and every grass and every flower, and their sweet smells, and their names, and the dwelling-places of the clouds, and their composition, and their wings, and how they bear rain and raindrops.
verses.text: And I measured the sun’s circle, and measured its rays, counted the hours, I wrote down too all things that go over the earth, I have written the things that are nourished, and all seed sown and unsown, which the earth produces and all plants, and every grass and every flower, and their sweet smells, and their names, and the dwelling-places of the clouds, and their composition, and their wings, and how they bear rain and raindrops.

verses.raw: And I investigated all things, and wrote the road of the thunder and of the lightning, and they showed me the keys and their guardians, their rise, the way they go; it is let out gently in measure by a chain, lest by a heavy chain and violence it hurl down the angry clouds and destroy all things on earth.
verses.text: And I investigated all things, and wrote the road of the thunder and of the lightning, and they showed me the keys and their guardians, their rise, the way they go; it is let out gently in measure by a chain, lest by a heavy chain and violence it hurl down the angry clouds and destroy all things on earth.

verses.raw: I wrote the treasure-houses of the snow, and the store-houses of the cold and the frosty airs, and I observed their season’s key-holder, he fills the clouds with them, and does not exhaust the treasure-houses.
verses.text: I wrote the treasure-houses of the snow, and the store-houses of the cold and the frosty airs, and I observed their season’s key-holder, he fills the clouds with them, and does not exhaust the treasure-houses.

verses.raw: And I wrote the resting-places of the winds and observed and saw how their key-holders bear weighing-scales and measures; first, they put them in one weighing-scale, then in the other the weights and let them out according to measure cunningly over the whole earth, lest by heavy breathing they make the earth to rock.
verses.text: And I wrote the resting-places of the winds and observed and saw how their key-holders bear weighing-scales and measures; first, they put them in one weighing-scale, then in the other the weights and let them out according to measure cunningly over the whole earth, lest by heavy breathing they make the earth to rock.

verses.raw: And I measured out the whole earth, its mountains, and all hills, fields, trees, stones, rivers, all existing things I wrote down, the height from earth to the seventh heaven, and downwards to the very lowest hell, and the judgment-place, and the very great, open and weeping hell.
verses.text: And I measured out the whole earth, its mountains, and all hills, fields, trees, stones, rivers, all existing things I wrote down, the height from earth to the seventh heaven, and downwards to the very lowest hell, and the judgment-place, and the very great, open and weeping hell.

verses.raw: And I saw how the prisoners are in pain, expecting the limitless judgment.
verses.text: And I saw how the prisoners are in pain, expecting the limitless judgment.

verses.raw: And I wrote down all those being judged by the judge, and all their judgment and sentences and all their works.
verses.text: And I wrote down all those being judged by the judge, and all their judgment and sentences and all their works.

verses.raw: And I saw all forefathers from all time with Adam and Eva, and I sighed and broke into tears and said of the ruin of their dishonour:
verses.text: And I saw all forefathers from all time with Adam and Eva, and I sighed and broke into tears and said of the ruin of their dishonour:

verses.raw: Woe is me for my infirmity and for that of my forefathers, and thought in my heart and said:
verses.text: Woe is me for my infirmity and for that of my forefathers, and thought in my heart and said:

verses.raw: Blessed is the man who has not been born or who has been born and shall not sin before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, that he come not into this place, nor bring the yoke of this place.
verses.text: Blessed is the man who has not been born or who has been born and shall not sin before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, that he come not into this place, nor bring the yoke of this place.

verses.raw: I saw the key-holders and guards of the gates of hell standing, like great serpents, and their faces like extinguishing lamps, and their eyes of fire, their sharp teeth, and I saw all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works, how they are right, while the works of man are some good, and others bad, and in their works are known those who lie evilly.
verses.text: I saw the key-holders and guards of the gates of hell standing, like great serpents, and their faces like extinguishing lamps, and their eyes of fire, their sharp teeth, and I saw all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works, how they are right, while the works of man are some good, and others bad, and in their works are known those who lie evilly.

verses.raw: I, my children, measured and wrote out every work and every measure and every righteous judgment.
verses.text: I, my children, measured and wrote out every work and every measure and every righteous judgment.

verses.raw: As one year is more honourable than another, so is one man more honourable than another, some for great possessions, some for wisdom of heart, some for particular intellect, some for cunning, one for silence of lip, another for cleanliness, one for strength, another for comeliness, one for youth, another for sharp wit, one for shape of body, another for sensibility, let it be heard everywhere, but there is none better than he who fears Elohim (God), he shall be more glorious in time to come.
verses.text: As one year is more honourable than another, so is one man more honourable than another, some for great possessions, some for wisdom of heart, some for particular intellect, some for cunning, one for silence of lip, another for cleanliness, one for strength, another for comeliness, one for youth, another for sharp wit, one for shape of body, another for sensibility, let it be heard everywhere, but there is none better than he who fears Elohim, he shall be more glorious in time to come.

verses.raw: Yahuah (Lord) with his hands having created man, in the likeness of his own face, Yahuah (Lord) made him small and great.
verses.text: Yahuah with his hands having created man, in the likeness of his own face, Yahuah made him small and great.

verses.raw: Whoever reviles the ruler’s face, and abhors Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, has despised Yahuah's (Lord's) face, and he who vents anger on any man without injury, Yahuah's (Lord’s) great anger will cut him down, he who spits on the face of man reproachfully, will be cut down at Yahuah's (Lord’s) great judgment.
verses.text: Whoever reviles the ruler’s face, and abhors Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, has despised Yahuah's (Lord's) face, and he who vents anger on any man without injury, Yahuah's (Lord’s) great anger will cut him down, he who spits on the face of man reproachfully, will be cut down at Yahuah's (Lord’s) great judgment.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man who does not direct his heart with malice against any man, and helps the injured and condemned, and raises the broken down, and shall do charity to the needy, because on the day of the great judgment every weight, every measure and every makeweight will be as in the market, that is to say they are hung on scales and stand in the market, and every one shall learn his own measure, and according to his measure shall take his reward.
verses.text: Blessed is the man who does not direct his heart with malice against any man, and helps the injured and condemned, and raises the broken down, and shall do charity to the needy, because on the day of the great judgment every weight, every measure and every makeweight will be as in the market, that is to say they are hung on scales and stand in the market, and every one shall learn his own measure, and according to his measure shall take his reward.

verses.raw: Whoever hastens to make offerings before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, Yahuah (Lord) for his part will hasten that offering by granting of his work.
verses.text: Whoever hastens to make offerings before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, Yahuah for his part will hasten that offering by granting of his work.

verses.raw: But whoever increases his lamp before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face and make not true judgment, Yahuah (Lord) will not increase his treasure in the realm of the highest.
verses.text: But whoever increases his lamp before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face and make not true judgment, Yahuah will not increase his treasure in the realm of the highest.

verses.raw: When Yahuah (Lord) demands bread, or candles, or the flesh of beasts, or any other sacrifice, then that is nothing; but Elohim (God) demands pure hearts, and with all that only tests the heart of man.
verses.text: When Yahuah demands bread, or candles, or the flesh of beasts, or any other sacrifice, then that is nothing; but Elohim demands pure hearts, and with all that only tests the heart of man.

verses.raw: Hear, my people, and take in the words of my lips.
verses.text: Hear, my people, and take in the words of my lips.

verses.raw: If any one bring any gifts to an earthly ruler, and have disloyal thoughts in his heart, and the ruler know this, will he not be angry with him, and not refuse his gifts, and not give him over to judgment?
verses.text: If any one bring any gifts to an earthly ruler, and have disloyal thoughts in his heart, and the ruler know this, will he not be angry with him, and not refuse his gifts, and not give him over to judgment?

verses.raw: Or if one man make himself appear good to another by deceit of tongue, but have evil in his heart, then will not the other understand the treachery of his heart, and himself be condemned, since his untruth was plain to all?
verses.text: Or if one man make himself appear good to another by deceit of tongue, but have evil in his heart, then will not the other understand the treachery of his heart, and himself be condemned, since his untruth was plain to all?

verses.raw: And when Yahuah (Lord) shall send a great light, then there will be judgment for the just and the unjust, and there no one shall escape notice.
verses.text: And when Yahuah shall send a great light, then there will be judgment for the just and the unjust, and there no one shall escape notice.

verses.raw: And now, my children, lay thought on your hearts, mark well the words of your father, which are all come to you from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips.
verses.text: And now, my children, lay thought on your hearts, mark well the words of your father, which are all come to you from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips.

verses.raw: Take these books of your father’s handwriting and read them.
verses.text: Take these books of your father’s handwriting and read them.

verses.raw: For the books are many, and in them you will learn all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works, all that has been from the beginning of creation, and will be till the end of time.
verses.text: For the books are many, and in them you will learn all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works, all that has been from the beginning of creation, and will be till the end of time.

verses.raw: And if you will observe my handwriting, you will not sin against Yahuah (Lord); because there is no other except Yahuah (Lord), neither in heaven, nor in earth, nor in the very lowest places, nor in the one foundation.
verses.text: And if you will observe my handwriting, you will not sin against Yahuah; because there is no other except Yahuah, neither in heaven, nor in earth, nor in the very lowest places, nor in the one foundation.

verses.raw: Yahuah (Lord) has placed the foundations in the unknown, and has spread forth heavens visible and invisible; he fixed the earth on the waters, and created countless creatures, and who has counted the water and the foundation of the unfixed, or the dust of the earth, or the sand of the sea, or the drops of the rain, or the morning dew, or the wind’s breathings? Who has filled earth and sea, and the indissoluble winter?
verses.text: Yahuah has placed the foundations in the unknown, and has spread forth heavens visible and invisible; he fixed the earth on the waters, and created countless creatures, and who has counted the water and the foundation of the unfixed, or the dust of the earth, or the sand of the sea, or the drops of the rain, or the morning dew, or the wind’s breathings? Who has filled earth and sea, and the indissoluble winter?

verses.raw: I cut the stars out of fire, and decorated heaven, and put it in their midst.
verses.text: I cut the stars out of fire, and decorated heaven, and put it in their midst.

verses.raw: That the sun go along the seven heavenly circles, which are the appointment of one hundred and eighty-two thrones, that it go down on a short day, and again one hundred and eighty-two, that it go down on a big day, and he has two thrones on which he rests, revolving hither and thither above the thrones of the months, from the seventeenth day of the month Tsivan it goes down to the month Thevan, from the seventeenth of Thevan it goes up.
verses.text: That the sun go along the seven heavenly circles, which are the appointment of one hundred and eighty-two thrones, that it go down on a short day, and again one hundred and eighty-two, that it go down on a big day, and he has two thrones on which he rests, revolving hither and thither above the thrones of the months, from the seventeenth day of the month Tsivan it goes down to the month Thevan, from the seventeenth of Thevan it goes up.

verses.raw: And thus it goes close to the earth, then the earth is glad and makes grow its fruits, and when it goes away, then the earth is sad, and trees and all fruits have no florescence.
verses.text: And thus it goes close to the earth, then the earth is glad and makes grow its fruits, and when it goes away, then the earth is sad, and trees and all fruits have no florescence.

verses.raw: All this he measured, with good measurement of hours, and fixed a measure by his wisdom, of the visible and the invisible.
verses.text: All this he measured, with good measurement of hours, and fixed a measure by his wisdom, of the visible and the invisible.

verses.raw: From the invisible he made all things visible, himself being invisible.
verses.text: From the invisible he made all things visible, himself being invisible.

verses.raw: Thus I make known to you, my children, and distribute the books to your children, into all your generations, and amongst the nations who shall have the sense to fear Elohim (God), let them receive them, and may they come to love them more than any food or earthly sweets, and read them and apply themselves to them.
verses.text: Thus I make known to you, my children, and distribute the books to your children, into all your generations, and amongst the nations who shall have the sense to fear Elohim, let them receive them, and may they come to love them more than any food or earthly sweets, and read them and apply themselves to them.

verses.raw: And those who understand not Yahuah (Lord), who fear not Elohim (God), who accept not, but reject, who do not receive the books, a terrible judgment awaits these.
verses.text: And those who understand not Yahuah, who fear not Elohim, who accept not, but reject, who do not receive the books, a terrible judgment awaits these.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man who shall bear their yoke and shall drag them along, for he shall be released on the day of the great judgment.
verses.text: Blessed is the man who shall bear their yoke and shall drag them along, for he shall be released on the day of the great judgment.

verses.raw: I swear to you, my children, but I swear not by any oath, neither by heaven nor by earth, nor by any other creature which Elohim (God) created.
verses.text: I swear to you, my children, but I swear not by any oath, neither by heaven nor by earth, nor by any other creature which Elohim created.

verses.raw: Yahuah (Lord) said: There is no oath in me, nor injustice, but truth.
verses.text: Yahuah said: There is no oath in me, nor injustice, but truth.

verses.raw: If there is no truth in men, let them swear by the words, Yea, yea, or else, Nay, nay.
verses.text: If there is no truth in men, let them swear by the words, Yea, yea, or else, Nay, nay.

verses.raw: And I swear to you, yea, yea, that there has been no man in his mother’s womb, but that already before, even to each one there is a place prepared for the repose of that soul, and a measure fixed how much it is intended that a man be tried in this world.
verses.text: And I swear to you, yea, yea, that there has been no man in his mother’s womb, but that already before, even to each one there is a place prepared for the repose of that soul, and a measure fixed how much it is intended that a man be tried in this world.

verses.raw: Yea, children, deceive not yourselves, for there has been previously prepared a place for every soul of man.
verses.text: Yea, children, deceive not yourselves, for there has been previously prepared a place for every soul of man.

verses.raw: I have put every man’s work in writing and none born on earth can remain hidden nor his works remain concealed.
verses.text: I have put every man’s work in writing and none born on earth can remain hidden nor his works remain concealed.

verses.raw: I see all things.
verses.text: I see all things.

verses.raw: Now therefore, my children, in patience and meekness spend the number of your days, that you inherit endless life.
verses.text: Now therefore, my children, in patience and meekness spend the number of your days, that you inherit endless life.

verses.raw: Endure for the sake of Yahuah (Lord) every wound, every injury, every evil word and attack.
verses.text: Endure for the sake of Yahuah every wound, every injury, every evil word and attack.

verses.raw: If ill-requitals befall you, return them not either to neighbour or enemy, because Yahuah (Lord) will return them for you and be your avenger on the day of great judgment, that there be no avenging here among men.
verses.text: If ill-requitals befall you, return them not either to neighbour or enemy, because Yahuah will return them for you and be your avenger on the day of great judgment, that there be no avenging here among men.

verses.raw: Whoever of you spends gold or silver for his brother’s sake, he will receive ample treasure in the world to come.
verses.text: Whoever of you spends gold or silver for his brother’s sake, he will receive ample treasure in the world to come.

verses.raw: Injure not widows nor orphans nor strangers, lest Elohim's (God’s) wrath come upon you.
verses.text: Injure not widows nor orphans nor strangers, lest Elohim's (God’s) wrath come upon you.

verses.raw: Stretch out your hands to the poor according to your strength.
verses.text: Stretch out your hands to the poor according to your strength.

verses.raw: Hide not your silver in the earth.
verses.text: Hide not your silver in the earth.

verses.raw: Help the faithful man in affliction, and affliction will not find you in the time of your trouble.
verses.text: Help the faithful man in affliction, and affliction will not find you in the time of your trouble.

verses.raw: And every grievous and cruel yoke that come upon you bear all for the sake of Yahuah (Lord), and thus you will find your reward in the day of judgment.
verses.text: And every grievous and cruel yoke that come upon you bear all for the sake of Yahuah, and thus you will find your reward in the day of judgment.

verses.raw: It is good to go morning, midday, and evening into Yahuah's (Lord’s) dwelling, for the glory of your creator.
verses.text: It is good to go morning, midday, and evening into Yahuah's (Lord’s) dwelling, for the glory of your creator.

verses.raw: Because every breathing thing glorifies him, and every creature visible and invisible returns him praise.
verses.text: Because every breathing thing glorifies him, and every creature visible and invisible returns him praise.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man who opens his lips in praise of Elohim (God) of Sabaoth and praises Yahuah (Lord) with his heart.
verses.text: Blessed is the man who opens his lips in praise of Elohim of Sabaoth and praises Yahuah with his heart.

verses.raw: Cursed every man who opens his lips for the bringing into contempt and calumny of his neighbour, because he brings Elohim (God) into contempt.
verses.text: Cursed every man who opens his lips for the bringing into contempt and calumny of his neighbour, because he brings Elohim into contempt.

verses.raw: Blessed is he who opens his lips blessing and praising Elohim (God).
verses.text: Blessed is he who opens his lips blessing and praising Elohim.

verses.raw: Cursed is he before Yahuah (Lord) all the days of his life, who opens his lips to curse and abuse.
verses.text: Cursed is he before Yahuah all the days of his life, who opens his lips to curse and abuse.

verses.raw: Blessed is he who blesses all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works.
verses.text: Blessed is he who blesses all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works.

verses.raw: Cursed is he who brings Yahuah's (Lord’s) creation into contempt.
verses.text: Cursed is he who brings Yahuah's (Lord’s) creation into contempt.

verses.raw: Blessed is he who looks down and raises the fallen.
verses.text: Blessed is he who looks down and raises the fallen.

verses.raw: Cursed is he who looks to and is eager for the destruction of what is not his.
verses.text: Cursed is he who looks to and is eager for the destruction of what is not his.

verses.raw: Blessed is he who keeps the foundations of his fathers made firm from the beginning.
verses.text: Blessed is he who keeps the foundations of his fathers made firm from the beginning.

verses.raw: Cursed is he who perverts the decrees of his forefathers.
verses.text: Cursed is he who perverts the decrees of his forefathers.

verses.raw: Blessed is he who imparts peace and love.
verses.text: Blessed is he who imparts peace and love.

verses.raw: Cursed is he who disturbs those that love their neighbours.
verses.text: Cursed is he who disturbs those that love their neighbours.

verses.raw: Blessed is he who speaks with humble tongue and heart to all.
verses.text: Blessed is he who speaks with humble tongue and heart to all.

verses.raw: Cursed is he who speaks peace with his tongue, while in his heart there is no peace but a sword.
verses.text: Cursed is he who speaks peace with his tongue, while in his heart there is no peace but a sword.

verses.raw: For all these things will be laid bare in the weighing-scales and in the books, on the day of the great judgment.
verses.text: For all these things will be laid bare in the weighing-scales and in the books, on the day of the great judgment.

verses.raw: And now, my children, do not say: Our father is standing before Elohim (God), and is praying for our sins, for there is there no helper of any man who has sinned.
verses.text: And now, my children, do not say: Our father is standing before Elohim, and is praying for our sins, for there is there no helper of any man who has sinned.

verses.raw: You see how I wrote all works of every man, before his creation, all that is done amongst all men for all time, and none can tell or relate my handwriting, because Yahuah (Lord) see all imaginings of man, how they are vain, where they lie in the treasure-houses of the heart.
verses.text: You see how I wrote all works of every man, before his creation, all that is done amongst all men for all time, and none can tell or relate my handwriting, because Yahuah see all imaginings of man, how they are vain, where they lie in the treasure-houses of the heart.

verses.raw: And now, my children, mark well all the words of your father, that I tell you, lest you regret, saying: Why did our father not tell us?
verses.text: And now, my children, mark well all the words of your father, that I tell you, lest you regret, saying: Why did our father not tell us?

verses.raw: At that time, not understanding this let these books which I have given you be for an inheritance of your peace.
verses.text: At that time, not understanding this let these books which I have given you be for an inheritance of your peace.

verses.raw: Hand them to all who want them, and instruct them, that they may see Yahuah's (Lord’s) very great and marvellous works.
verses.text: Hand them to all who want them, and instruct them, that they may see Yahuah's (Lord’s) very great and marvellous works.

verses.raw: My children, behold, the day of my term and time have approached.
verses.text: My children, behold, the day of my term and time have approached.

verses.raw: For the angels who shall go with me are standing before me and urge me to my departure from you; they are standing here on earth, awaiting what has been told them.
verses.text: For the angels who shall go with me are standing before me and urge me to my departure from you; they are standing here on earth, awaiting what has been told them.

verses.raw: For to-morrow I shall go up on to heaven, to the uppermost Jerusalem to my eternal inheritance.
verses.text: For to-morrow I shall go up on to heaven, to the uppermost Jerusalem to my eternal inheritance.

verses.raw: Therefore I bid you do before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face all his good pleasure.
verses.text: Therefore I bid you do before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face all his good pleasure.

verses.raw: Mathosalam having answered his father Enoch, said: What is agreeable to your eyes, father, that I may make before your face, that you may bless our dwellings, and your sons, and that your people may be made glorious through you, and then that you may depart thus, as Yahuah (Lord) said?
verses.text: Mathosalam having answered his father Enoch, said: What is agreeable to your eyes, father, that I may make before your face, that you may bless our dwellings, and your sons, and that your people may be made glorious through you, and then that you may depart thus, as Yahuah said?

verses.raw: Enoch answered to his son Mathosalam and said: Hear, child, from the time when Yahuah (Lord) anointed me with the ointment of his glory, there has been no food in me, and my soul remembers not earthly enjoyment, neither do I want anything earthly.
verses.text: Enoch answered to his son Mathosalam and said: Hear, child, from the time when Yahuah anointed me with the ointment of his glory, there has been no food in me, and my soul remembers not earthly enjoyment, neither do I want anything earthly.

verses.raw: My child Methosalam, summon all your brethren and all your household and the elders of the people, that I may talk to them and depart, as is planned for me.
verses.text: My child Methosalam, summon all your brethren and all your household and the elders of the people, that I may talk to them and depart, as is planned for me.

verses.raw: And Methosalam made haste, and summoned his brethren, Regim, Riman, Uchan, Chermion, Gaidad, and all the elders of the people before the face of his father Enoch; and he blessed them, and said to them:
verses.text: And Methosalam made haste, and summoned his brethren, Regim, Riman, Uchan, Chermion, Gaidad, and all the elders of the people before the face of his father Enoch; and he blessed them, and said to them:

verses.raw: Listen to me, my children, to-day.
verses.text: Listen to me, my children, to-day.

verses.raw: In those days when Yahuah (Lord) came down on to earth for Adam’s sake, and visited all his creatures, which he created himself, after all these he created Adam, and Yahuah (Lord) called all the beasts of the earth, all the reptiles, and all the birds that soar in the air, and brought them all before the face of our father Adam.
verses.text: In those days when Yahuah came down on to earth for Adam’s sake, and visited all his creatures, which he created himself, after all these he created Adam, and Yahuah called all the beasts of the earth, all the reptiles, and all the birds that soar in the air, and brought them all before the face of our father Adam.

verses.raw: And Adam gave the names to all things living on earth.
verses.text: And Adam gave the names to all things living on earth.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) appointed him ruler over all, and subjected to him all things under his hands, and made them dumb and made them dull that they be commanded of man, and be in subjection and obedience to him.
verses.text: And Yahuah appointed him ruler over all, and subjected to him all things under his hands, and made them dumb and made them dull that they be commanded of man, and be in subjection and obedience to him.

verses.raw: Thus also Yahuah (Lord) created every man lord over all his possessions.
verses.text: Thus also Yahuah created every man lord over all his possessions.

verses.raw: Yahuah (Lord) will not judge a single soul of beast for man’s sake, but adjudges the souls of men to their beasts in this world; for men have a special place.
verses.text: Yahuah will not judge a single soul of beast for man’s sake, but adjudges the souls of men to their beasts in this world; for men have a special place.

verses.raw: And as every soul of man is according to number, similarly beasts will not perish, nor all souls of beasts which Yahuah (Lord) created, till the great judgment, and they will accuse man, if he feed them ill.
verses.text: And as every soul of man is according to number, similarly beasts will not perish, nor all souls of beasts which Yahuah created, till the great judgment, and they will accuse man, if he feed them ill.

verses.raw: Whoever defiles the soul of beasts, defiles his own soul.
verses.text: Whoever defiles the soul of beasts, defiles his own soul.

verses.raw: For man brings clean animals to make sacrifice for sin, that he may have cure of his soul.
verses.text: For man brings clean animals to make sacrifice for sin, that he may have cure of his soul.

verses.raw: And if they bring for sacrifice clean animals, and birds, man has cure, he cures his soul.
verses.text: And if they bring for sacrifice clean animals, and birds, man has cure, he cures his soul.

verses.raw: All is given you for food, bind it by the four feet, that is to make good the cure, he cures his soul.
verses.text: All is given you for food, bind it by the four feet, that is to make good the cure, he cures his soul.

verses.raw: But whoever kills beast without wounds, kills his own souls and defiles his own flesh.
verses.text: But whoever kills beast without wounds, kills his own souls and defiles his own flesh.

verses.raw: And he who does any beast any injury whatsoever, in secret, it is evil practice, and he defiles his own soul.
verses.text: And he who does any beast any injury whatsoever, in secret, it is evil practice, and he defiles his own soul.

verses.raw: He who works the killing of a man’s soul, kills his own soul, and kills his own body, and there is no cure for him for all time.
verses.text: He who works the killing of a man’s soul, kills his own soul, and kills his own body, and there is no cure for him for all time.

verses.raw: He who puts a man in any snare, shall stick in it himself, and there is no cure for him for all time.
verses.text: He who puts a man in any snare, shall stick in it himself, and there is no cure for him for all time.

verses.raw: He who puts a man in any vessel, his retribution will not be wanting at the great judgment for all time.
verses.text: He who puts a man in any vessel, his retribution will not be wanting at the great judgment for all time.

verses.raw: He who works crookedly or speaks evil against any soul, will not make justice for himself for all time.
verses.text: He who works crookedly or speaks evil against any soul, will not make justice for himself for all time.

verses.raw: And now, my children, keep your hearts from every injustice, which Yahuah (Lord) hates. Just as a man asks something for his own soul from Elohim (God), so let him do to every living soul, because I know all things, how in the great time to come there is much inheritance prepared for men, good for the good, and bad for the bad, without number many.
verses.text: And now, my children, keep your hearts from every injustice, which Yahuah hates. Just as a man asks something for his own soul from Elohim, so let him do to every living soul, because I know all things, how in the great time to come there is much inheritance prepared for men, good for the good, and bad for the bad, without number many.

verses.raw: Blessed are those who enter the good houses, for in the bad houses there is no peace nor return from them.
verses.text: Blessed are those who enter the good houses, for in the bad houses there is no peace nor return from them.

verses.raw: Hear, my children, small and great! When man puts a good thought in his heart, brings gifts from his labours before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face and his hands made them not, then Yahuah (Lord) will turn away his face from the labour of his hand, and that man cannot find the labour of his hands.
verses.text: Hear, my children, small and great! When man puts a good thought in his heart, brings gifts from his labours before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face and his hands made them not, then Yahuah will turn away his face from the labour of his hand, and that man cannot find the labour of his hands.

verses.raw: And if his hands made it, but his heart murmur, and his heart cease not making murmur incessantly, he has not any advantage.
verses.text: And if his hands made it, but his heart murmur, and his heart cease not making murmur incessantly, he has not any advantage.

verses.raw: Blessed is the man who in his patience brings his gifts with faith before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, because he will find forgiveness of sins.
verses.text: Blessed is the man who in his patience brings his gifts with faith before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, because he will find forgiveness of sins.

verses.raw: But if he take back his words before the time, there is no repentance for him; and if the time pass and he do not of his own will what is promised, there is no repentance after death.
verses.text: But if he take back his words before the time, there is no repentance for him; and if the time pass and he do not of his own will what is promised, there is no repentance after death.

verses.raw: Because every work which man does before the time, is all deceit before men, and sin before Elohim (God).
verses.text: Because every work which man does before the time, is all deceit before men, and sin before Elohim.

verses.raw: When man clothes the naked and fills the hungry, he will find reward from Elohim (God).
verses.text: When man clothes the naked and fills the hungry, he will find reward from Elohim.

verses.raw: But if his heart murmur, he commits a double evil; ruin of himself and of that which he gives; and for him there will be no finding of reward on account of that.
verses.text: But if his heart murmur, he commits a double evil; ruin of himself and of that which he gives; and for him there will be no finding of reward on account of that.

verses.raw: And if his own heart is filled with his food and his own flesh, clothed with his own clothing, he commits contempt, and will forfeit all his endurance of poverty, and will not find reward of his good deeds.
verses.text: And if his own heart is filled with his food and his own flesh, clothed with his own clothing, he commits contempt, and will forfeit all his endurance of poverty, and will not find reward of his good deeds.

verses.raw: Every proud and magniloquent man is hateful to Yahuah (Lord), and every false speech, clothed in untruth; it will be cut with the blade of the sword of death, and thrown into the fire, and shall burn for all time.
verses.text: Every proud and magniloquent man is hateful to Yahuah, and every false speech, clothed in untruth; it will be cut with the blade of the sword of death, and thrown into the fire, and shall burn for all time.

verses.raw: When Enoch had spoken these words to his sons, all people far and near heard how Yahuah (Lord) was calling Enoch. They took counsel together:
verses.text: When Enoch had spoken these words to his sons, all people far and near heard how Yahuah was calling Enoch. They took counsel together:

verses.raw: Let us go and kiss Enoch, and two thousand men came together and came to the place Achuzan where Enoch was, and his sons.
verses.text: Let us go and kiss Enoch, and two thousand men came together and came to the place Achuzan where Enoch was, and his sons.

verses.raw: And the elders of the people, the whole assembly, came and bowed down and began to kiss Enoch and said to him:
verses.text: And the elders of the people, the whole assembly, came and bowed down and began to kiss Enoch and said to him:

verses.raw: Our father Enoch, may you be blessed of Yahuah (Lord), the eternal ruler, and now bless your sons and all the people, that we may be glorified to-day before your face.
verses.text: Our father Enoch, may you be blessed of Yahuah, the eternal ruler, and now bless your sons and all the people, that we may be glorified to-day before your face.

verses.raw: For you shalt be glorified before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face for all time, since Yahuah (Lord) chose you, rather than all men on earth, and designated you writer of all his creation, visible and invisible, and redeemed of the sins of man, and helper of your household.
verses.text: For you shalt be glorified before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face for all time, since Yahuah chose you, rather than all men on earth, and designated you writer of all his creation, visible and invisible, and redeemed of the sins of man, and helper of your household.

verses.raw: And Enoch answered all his people saying: Hear, my children, before that all creatures were created, Yahuah (Lord) created the visible and invisible things.
verses.text: And Enoch answered all his people saying: Hear, my children, before that all creatures were created, Yahuah created the visible and invisible things.

verses.raw: And as much time as there was and went past, understand that after all that he created man in the likeness of his own form, and put into him eyes to see, and ears to hear, and heart to reflect, and intellect wherewith to deliberate.
verses.text: And as much time as there was and went past, understand that after all that he created man in the likeness of his own form, and put into him eyes to see, and ears to hear, and heart to reflect, and intellect wherewith to deliberate.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) saw all man’s works, and created all his creatures, and divided time, from time he fixed the years, and from the years he appointed the months, and from the months he appointed the days, and of days he appointed seven.
verses.text: And Yahuah saw all man’s works, and created all his creatures, and divided time, from time he fixed the years, and from the years he appointed the months, and from the months he appointed the days, and of days he appointed seven.

verses.raw: And in those he appointed the hours, measured them out exactly, that man might reflect on time and count years, months, and hours, their alternation, beginning, and end, and that he might count his own life, from the beginning until death, and reflect on his sin and write his work bad and good; because no work is hidden before Yahuah (Lord), that every man might know his works and never transgress all his commandments, and keep my handwriting from generation to generation.
verses.text: And in those he appointed the hours, measured them out exactly, that man might reflect on time and count years, months, and hours, their alternation, beginning, and end, and that he might count his own life, from the beginning until death, and reflect on his sin and write his work bad and good; because no work is hidden before Yahuah, that every man might know his works and never transgress all his commandments, and keep my handwriting from generation to generation.

verses.raw: When all creation visible and invisible, as Yahuah (Lord) created it, shall end, then every man goes to the great judgment, and then all time shall perish, and the years, and thenceforward there will be neither months nor days nor hours, they will be adhered together and will not be counted.
verses.text: When all creation visible and invisible, as Yahuah created it, shall end, then every man goes to the great judgment, and then all time shall perish, and the years, and thenceforward there will be neither months nor days nor hours, they will be adhered together and will not be counted.

verses.raw: There will be one aeon, and all the righteous who shall escape Yahuah's (Lord’s) great judgment, shall be collected in the great aeon, for the righteous the great aeon will begin, and they will live eternally, and then too there will be amongst them neither labour, nor sickness, nor humiliation, nor anxiety, nor need, nor brutality, nor night, nor darkness, but great light.
