verses.text: There will be one aeon, and all the righteous who shall escape Yahuah's (Lord’s) great judgment, shall be collected in the great aeon, for the righteous the great aeon will begin, and they will live eternally, and then too there will be amongst them neither labour, nor sickness, nor humiliation, nor anxiety, nor need, nor brutality, nor night, nor darkness, but great light.

verses.raw: And they shall have a great indestructible wall, and a paradise bright and incorruptible, for all corruptible things shall pass away, and there will be eternal life.
verses.text: And they shall have a great indestructible wall, and a paradise bright and incorruptible, for all corruptible things shall pass away, and there will be eternal life.

verses.raw: And now, my children, keep your souls from all injustice, such as Yahuah (Lord) hates.
verses.text: And now, my children, keep your souls from all injustice, such as Yahuah hates.

verses.raw: Walk before his face with terror and trembling and serve him alone.
verses.text: Walk before his face with terror and trembling and serve him alone.

verses.raw: Bow down to the true Elohim (God), not to dumb idols, but bow down to his similitude, and bring all just offerings before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face. Yahuah (Lord) hates what is unjust.
verses.text: Bow down to the true Elohim, not to dumb idols, but bow down to his similitude, and bring all just offerings before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face. Yahuah hates what is unjust.

verses.raw: For Yahuah (Lord) sees all things; when man takes thought in his heart, then he counsels the intellects, and every thought is always before Yahuah (Lord), who made firm the earth and put all creatures on it.
verses.text: For Yahuah sees all things; when man takes thought in his heart, then he counsels the intellects, and every thought is always before Yahuah, who made firm the earth and put all creatures on it.

verses.raw: If you look to heaven, Yahuah Shammah (the Lord is there); if you take thought of the sea’s deep and all the under-earth, Yahuah Shammah (the Lord is there).
verses.text: If you look to heaven, Yahuah Shammah (the Lord is there); if you take thought of the sea’s deep and all the under-earth, Yahuah Shammah (the Lord is there).

verses.raw: For Yahuah (Lord) created all things. Bow not down to things made by man, leaving Yahuah (Lord) of all creation, because no work can remain hidden before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.
verses.text: For Yahuah created all things. Bow not down to things made by man, leaving Yahuah of all creation, because no work can remain hidden before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.

verses.raw: Walk, my children, in long-suffering, in meekness, honesty, in provocation, in grief, in faith and in truth, in reliance on promises, in illness, in abuse, in wounds, in temptation, in nakedness, in privation, loving one another, till you go out from this age of ills, that you become inheritors of endless time.
verses.text: Walk, my children, in long-suffering, in meekness, honesty, in provocation, in grief, in faith and in truth, in reliance on promises, in illness, in abuse, in wounds, in temptation, in nakedness, in privation, loving one another, till you go out from this age of ills, that you become inheritors of endless time.

verses.raw: Blessed are the just who shall escape the great judgment, for they shall shine forth more than the sun sevenfold, for in this world the seventh part is taken off from all, light, darkness, food, enjoyment, sorrow, paradise, torture, fire, frost, and other things; he put all down in writing, that you might read and understand.
verses.text: Blessed are the just who shall escape the great judgment, for they shall shine forth more than the sun sevenfold, for in this world the seventh part is taken off from all, light, darkness, food, enjoyment, sorrow, paradise, torture, fire, frost, and other things; he put all down in writing, that you might read and understand.

verses.raw: When Enoch had talked to the people, Yahuah (Lord) sent out darkness on to the earth, and there was darkness, and it covered those men standing with Enoch, and they took Enoch up on to the highest heaven, where Yahuah (Lord) is; and he received him and placed him before his face, and the darkness went off from the earth, and light came again.
verses.text: When Enoch had talked to the people, Yahuah sent out darkness on to the earth, and there was darkness, and it covered those men standing with Enoch, and they took Enoch up on to the highest heaven, where Yahuah is; and he received him and placed him before his face, and the darkness went off from the earth, and light came again.

verses.raw: And the people saw and understood not how Enoch had been taken, and glorified Elohim (God), and found a roll in which was traced The Invisible Elohim (God); and all went to their dwelling places.
verses.text: And the people saw and understood not how Enoch had been taken, and glorified Elohim, and found a roll in which was traced The Invisible Elohim; and all went to their dwelling places.

verses.raw: Enoch was born on the sixth day of the month Tsivan, and lived three hundred and sixty-five years.
verses.text: Enoch was born on the sixth day of the month Tsivan, and lived three hundred and sixty-five years.

verses.raw: He was taken up to heaven on the first day of the month Tsivan and remained in heaven sixty days.
verses.text: He was taken up to heaven on the first day of the month Tsivan and remained in heaven sixty days.

verses.raw: He wrote all these signs of all creation, which Yahuah (Lord) created, and wrote three hundred and sixty-six books, and handed them over to his sons and remained on earth thirty days, and was again taken up to heaven on the sixth day of the month Tsivan, on the very day and hour when he was born.
verses.text: He wrote all these signs of all creation, which Yahuah created, and wrote three hundred and sixty-six books, and handed them over to his sons and remained on earth thirty days, and was again taken up to heaven on the sixth day of the month Tsivan, on the very day and hour when he was born.

verses.raw: As every man’s nature in this life is dark, so are also his conception, birth, and departure from this life.
verses.text: As every man’s nature in this life is dark, so are also his conception, birth, and departure from this life.

verses.raw: At what hour he was conceived, at that hour he was born, and at that hour too he died.
verses.text: At what hour he was conceived, at that hour he was born, and at that hour too he died.

verses.raw: Methosalam and his brethren, all the sons of Enoch, made haste, and erected an altar at that place called Achuzan, whence and where Enoch had been taken up to heaven.
verses.text: Methosalam and his brethren, all the sons of Enoch, made haste, and erected an altar at that place called Achuzan, whence and where Enoch had been taken up to heaven.

verses.raw: And they took sacrificial oxen and summoned all people and sacrificed the sacrifice before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.
verses.text: And they took sacrificial oxen and summoned all people and sacrificed the sacrifice before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.

verses.raw: All people, the elders of the people and the whole assembly came to the feast and brought gifts to the sons of Enoch.
verses.text: All people, the elders of the people and the whole assembly came to the feast and brought gifts to the sons of Enoch.

verses.raw: And they made a great feast, rejoicing and making merry three days, praising Elohim (God), who had given them such a sign through Enoch, who had found favour with him, and that they should hand it on to their sons from generation to generation, from age to age.
verses.text: And they made a great feast, rejoicing and making merry three days, praising Elohim, who had given them such a sign through Enoch, who had found favour with him, and that they should hand it on to their sons from generation to generation, from age to age.

verses.raw: Amen.
verses.text: Amen.

verses.raw: And it came to pass in the twenty-fifth year of Jeconiah, king of Yahudah (Judah), that the word of Yahuah (Lord)
verses.text: And it came to pass in the twenty-fifth year of Jeconiah, king of Yahudah, that the word of Yahuah

verses.raw: came to Baruch, the son of Neriah, and said to him: 'Hast thou seen all that this people are doing to Me, that the evils which these two tribes which remained have done are greater than (those of)
verses.text: came to Baruch, the son of Neriah, and said to him: 'Hast thou seen all that this people are doing to Me, that the evils which these two tribes which remained have done are greater than (those of)

verses.raw: For I have said these things to thee that thou mayst bid Jeremiah, and all those that are like you, to retire from this city.
verses.text: For I have said these things to thee that thou mayst bid Jeremiah, and all those that are like you, to retire from this city.

verses.raw: For your works are to this city as a firm pillar, And your prayers as a strong wall.'
verses.text: For your works are to this city as a firm pillar, And your prayers as a strong wall.'

verses.raw: And I said: 'O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, have I come into the world for this purpose that I might see the evils of my mother? Not (so) my Lord.
verses.text: And I said: 'O Yahuah, my Lord, have I come into the world for this purpose that I might see the evils of my mother? Not (so) my Lord.

verses.raw: If I have found grace in Thy sight, first take my spirit
verses.text: If I have found grace in Thy sight, first take my spirit

verses.raw: that I may go to my fathers and not behold the destruction of my mother. For two things vehemently constrain me: for I cannot resist Thee, and my soul, moreover, cannot behold the evils
verses.text: that I may go to my fathers and not behold the destruction of my mother. For two things vehemently constrain me: for I cannot resist Thee, and my soul, moreover, cannot behold the evils

verses.raw: of my mother. But one thing I will say in Thy presence, O Yahuah (Lord). What, therefore, will there be after these things? for if Thou destroyest Thy city, and deliverest up Thy land to those that hate

verses.raw: us, how shall the name of Yashar'el (Israel) be again remembered? Or how shall one speak of Thy praises?

verses.raw: and the nature of man not again be named? And where is all that which Thou didst say to Moses regarding us?'
verses.text: and the nature of man not again be named? And where is all that which Thou didst say to Moses regarding us?'

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto me: 'This city shall be delivered up for a time, And the people shall be chastened during a time, And the world will not be given over to oblivion.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me: 'This city shall be delivered up for a time, And the people shall be chastened during a time, And the world will not be given over to oblivion.

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'So then I am destined to grieve for Zion, For Thine enemies will come to this place and pollute Thy sanctuary, And lead Thine inheritance into captivity, And make themselves masters of those whom Thou hast loved, And they will depart again to the place of their idols, And will boast before them: And what wilt Thou do for Thy great name?'
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'So then I am destined to grieve for Zion, For Thine enemies will come to this place and pollute Thy sanctuary, And lead Thine inheritance into captivity, And make themselves masters of those whom Thou hast loved, And they will depart again to the place of their idols, And will boast before them: And what wilt Thou do for Thy great name?'

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) said unto me: 'My name and My glory are unto all eternity; And My judgement shall maintain its right in its own time.
verses.text: And Yahuah said unto me: 'My name and My glory are unto all eternity; And My judgement shall maintain its right in its own time.

verses.raw: And thou shalt see with thine eyes That the enemy will not overthrow Zion, Nor shall they burn Jerusalem, But be the ministers of the Judge for the time.
verses.text: And thou shalt see with thine eyes That the enemy will not overthrow Zion, Nor shall they burn Jerusalem, But be the ministers of the Judge for the time.

verses.raw: But do thou go and do whatsoever I have said unto thee.'
verses.text: But do thou go and do whatsoever I have said unto thee.'

verses.raw: And I went and took Jeremiah, and Adu, and Seriah, and Jabish, and Gedaliah, and all the honourable men of the people, and I led them to the valley of Cedron, and I narrated to them all that had been said to me.
verses.text: And I went and took Jeremiah, and Adu, and Seriah, and Jabish, and Gedaliah, and all the honourable men of the people, and I led them to the valley of Cedron, and I narrated to them all that had been said to me.

verses.raw: And they lifted up their voice, and they all wept.
verses.text: And they lifted up their voice, and they all wept.

verses.raw: And we sat there and fasted until the evening.
verses.text: And we sat there and fasted until the evening.

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the morrow that, lo! the army of the Chaldees surrounded the city, and at the time of the evening, I, Baruch, left the people, and I went forth and stood by the oak.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the morrow that, lo! the army of the Chaldees surrounded the city, and at the time of the evening, I, Baruch, left the people, and I went forth and stood by the oak.

verses.raw: And I was grieving over Zion, and lamenting over the captivity which had come upon the people.
verses.text: And I was grieving over Zion, and lamenting over the captivity which had come upon the people.

verses.raw: And lo! suddenly a strong spirit raised me, and bore me aloft over the wall of Jerusalem.
verses.text: And lo! suddenly a strong spirit raised me, and bore me aloft over the wall of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: And I beheld, and lo! four angels standing at the four corners of the city, each of them holding a torch of fire in his hands.
verses.text: And I beheld, and lo! four angels standing at the four corners of the city, each of them holding a torch of fire in his hands.

verses.raw: And another angel began to descend from heaven, and said unto them: 'Hold your lamps, and do not light them till I tell you.
verses.text: And another angel began to descend from heaven, and said unto them: 'Hold your lamps, and do not light them till I tell you.

verses.raw: For I am first sent to speak a word to the earth, and to place in it what Yahuah (Lord) the El Elyon (Most High) has commanded me.'
verses.text: For I am first sent to speak a word to the earth, and to place in it what Yahuah the El Elyon has commanded me.'

verses.raw: And I saw him descend into the Holy of Holies, and take from thence the veil, and the holy ark, and the mercy-seat, and the two tables, and the holy raiment of the priests, and the altar of incense, and the forty-eight precious stones, wherewith the priest was adorned and all the holy vessels of the tabernacle.
verses.text: And I saw him descend into the Holy of Holies, and take from thence the veil, and the holy ark, and the mercy-seat, and the two tables, and the holy raiment of the priests, and the altar of incense, and the forty-eight precious stones, wherewith the priest was adorned and all the holy vessels of the tabernacle.

verses.raw: And he spake to the earth with a loud voice: 'Earth, earth, earth, hear the word of El Gibbor (the mighty God), And receive what I commit to thee, And guard them until the last times, So that, when thou art ordered, thou mayst restore them, So that strangers may not get possession of them.
verses.text: And he spake to the earth with a loud voice: 'Earth, earth, earth, hear the word of El Gibbor (the mighty God), And receive what I commit to thee, And guard them until the last times, So that, when thou art ordered, thou mayst restore them, So that strangers may not get possession of them.

verses.raw: For the time comes when Jerusalem also will be delivered for a time, Until it is said, that it is again restored for ever.'
verses.text: For the time comes when Jerusalem also will be delivered for a time, Until it is said, that it is again restored for ever.'

verses.raw: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up.
verses.text: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up.

verses.raw: And after these things I heard that angel saying unto those angels who held the lamps: 'Destroy, therefore, and overthrow its wall to its foundations, lest the enemy should boast and say: "We have overthrown the wall of Zion, And we have burnt the place of El Gibbor (the mighty God)."'
verses.text: And after these things I heard that angel saying unto those angels who held the lamps: 'Destroy, therefore, and overthrow its wall to its foundations, lest the enemy should boast and say: "We have overthrown the wall of Zion, And we have burnt the place of El Gibbor (the mighty God)."'

verses.raw: And ye have seized the place where I had been standing before.
verses.text: And ye have seized the place where I had been standing before.

verses.raw: Now the angels did as he had commanded them, and when they had broken up the corners of the walls, a voice was heard from the interior of the temple, after the wall had fallen, saying:
verses.text: Now the angels did as he had commanded them, and when they had broken up the corners of the walls, a voice was heard from the interior of the temple, after the wall had fallen, saying:

verses.raw: 'Enter, ye enemies, And come, ye adversaries; For he who kept the house has forsaken (it).'
verses.text: 'Enter, ye enemies, And come, ye adversaries; For he who kept the house has forsaken (it).'

verses.raw: And I, Baruch, departed.
verses.text: And I, Baruch, departed.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after these things that the army of the Chaldees entered and seized the house, and all that was around it.
verses.text: And it came to pass after these things that the army of the Chaldees entered and seized the house, and all that was around it.

verses.raw: And they led the people away captive and slew some of them, and bound Zedekiah the king, and sent him to the king of Babylon.
verses.text: And they led the people away captive and slew some of them, and bound Zedekiah the king, and sent him to the king of Babylon.

verses.raw: And I, Baruch, came, and Jeremiah, whose heart was found pure from sins, who had not been captured in the seizure of the city.
verses.text: And I, Baruch, came, and Jeremiah, whose heart was found pure from sins, who had not been captured in the seizure of the city.

verses.raw: And we rent our garments, we wept, and mourned, and fasted seven days.
verses.text: And we rent our garments, we wept, and mourned, and fasted seven days.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after seven days, that the word of Elohim (God) came to me, and said unto me: 'Tell Jeremiah to go and support the captivity of the people unto Babylon.
verses.text: And it came to pass after seven days, that the word of Elohim came to me, and said unto me: 'Tell Jeremiah to go and support the captivity of the people unto Babylon.

verses.raw: But do thou remain here amid the desolation of Zion, and I will show to thee after these days what will befall at the end of days.
verses.text: But do thou remain here amid the desolation of Zion, and I will show to thee after these days what will befall at the end of days.

verses.raw: And I said to Jeremiah as Yahuah (Lord) commanded me.
verses.text: And I said to Jeremiah as Yahuah commanded me.

verses.raw: And he, indeed, departed with the people, but I, Baruch, returned and sat before the gates of the temple, and I lamented with the following lamentation over Zion and said:
verses.text: And he, indeed, departed with the people, but I, Baruch, returned and sat before the gates of the temple, and I lamented with the following lamentation over Zion and said:

verses.raw: 'Blessed is he who was not born, Or he, who having been born, has died.
verses.text: 'Blessed is he who was not born, Or he, who having been born, has died.

verses.raw: But as for us who live, woe unto us, Because we see the afflictions of Zion, And what has befallen Jerusalem.
verses.text: But as for us who live, woe unto us, Because we see the afflictions of Zion, And what has befallen Jerusalem.

verses.raw: I will call the Sirens from the sea, And ye Lilin, come ye from the desert, And ye Shedim and dragons from the forests: Awake and gird up your loins unto mourning, And take up with me the dirges, And make lamentation with me.
verses.text: I will call the Sirens from the sea, And ye Lilin, come ye from the desert, And ye Shedim and dragons from the forests: Awake and gird up your loins unto mourning, And take up with me the dirges, And make lamentation with me.

verses.raw: Ye husbandmen, sow not again; And, O earth, wherefore givest thou thy harvest fruits? Keep within thee the sweets of thy sustenance.
verses.text: Ye husbandmen, sow not again; And, O earth, wherefore givest thou thy harvest fruits? Keep within thee the sweets of thy sustenance.

verses.raw: And thou, vine, why further dost thou give thy wine; For an offering will not again be made therefrom in Zion, Nor will first-fruits again be offered.
verses.text: And thou, vine, why further dost thou give thy wine; For an offering will not again be made therefrom in Zion, Nor will first-fruits again be offered.

verses.raw: And do ye, O heavens, withhold your dew, And open not the treasuries of rain: And do thou, O sun, withhold the light of thy rays.
verses.text: And do ye, O heavens, withhold your dew, And open not the treasuries of rain: And do thou, O sun, withhold the light of thy rays.

verses.raw: And do thou, O moon, extinguish the multitude of thy light; For why should light rise again Where the light of Zion is darkened?
verses.text: And do thou, O moon, extinguish the multitude of thy light; For why should light rise again Where the light of Zion is darkened?

verses.raw: And you, ye bridegrooms, enter not in, And let not the brides adorn themselves with garlands; And, ye women, pray not that ye may bear.
verses.text: And you, ye bridegrooms, enter not in, And let not the brides adorn themselves with garlands; And, ye women, pray not that ye may bear.

verses.raw: For the barren shall above all rejoice, And those who have no sons shall be glad, And those who have sons shall have anguish.
verses.text: For the barren shall above all rejoice, And those who have no sons shall be glad, And those who have sons shall have anguish.

verses.raw: For why should they bear in pain, Only to bury in grief? Or why, again, should mankind have sons?
verses.text: For why should they bear in pain, Only to bury in grief? Or why, again, should mankind have sons?

verses.raw: Or why should the seed of their kind again be named, Where this mother is desolate, And her sons are led into captivity?
verses.text: Or why should the seed of their kind again be named, Where this mother is desolate, And her sons are led into captivity?

verses.raw: From this time forward speak not of beauty, And discourse not of gracefulness.
verses.text: From this time forward speak not of beauty, And discourse not of gracefulness.

verses.raw: Moreover, ye priests, take ye the keys of the sanctuary, And cast them into the height of heaven, And give them to Yahuah (Lord) and say: "Guard Thy house Thyself, For lo! we are found false stewards."
verses.text: Moreover, ye priests, take ye the keys of the sanctuary, And cast them into the height of heaven, And give them to Yahuah and say: "Guard Thy house Thyself, For lo! we are found false stewards."

verses.raw: And you, ye virgins, who weave fine linen And silk with gold of Ophir, Take with haste all (these) things And cast (them) into the fire, That it may bear them to Him who made them, And the flame send them to Him who created them, Lest the enemy get possession of them.'
verses.text: And you, ye virgins, who weave fine linen And silk with gold of Ophir, Take with haste all (these) things And cast (them) into the fire, That it may bear them to Him who made them, And the flame send them to Him who created them, Lest the enemy get possession of them.'

verses.raw: Moreover, I, Baruch, say this against thee, Babylon: 'If thou hadst prospered, And Zion had dwelt in her glory, Yet the grief to us had been great That thou shouldst be equal to Zion.
verses.text: Moreover, I, Baruch, say this against thee, Babylon: 'If thou hadst prospered, And Zion had dwelt in her glory, Yet the grief to us had been great That thou shouldst be equal to Zion.

verses.raw: But now, lo! the grief is infinite, And the lamentation measureless, For lo! thou art prospered And Zion desolate.
verses.text: But now, lo! the grief is infinite, And the lamentation measureless, For lo! thou art prospered And Zion desolate.

verses.raw: Who will be judge regarding these things? Or to whom shall we complain regarding that which has befallen us? O Yahuah (Lord), how hast Thou borne (it)?
verses.text: Who will be judge regarding these things? Or to whom shall we complain regarding that which has befallen us? O Yahuah, how hast Thou borne (it)?

verses.raw: Our fathers went to rest without grief, And lo! the righteous sleep in the earth in tranquillity;
verses.text: Our fathers went to rest without grief, And lo! the righteous sleep in the earth in tranquillity;

verses.raw: For they knew not this anguish, Nor yet had they heard of that which had befallen us.
verses.text: For they knew not this anguish, Nor yet had they heard of that which had befallen us.

verses.raw: Would that thou hadst ears, O earth, And that thou hadst a heart, O dust: That ye might go and announce in Sheol, And say to the dead:
verses.text: Would that thou hadst ears, O earth, And that thou hadst a heart, O dust: That ye might go and announce in Sheol, And say to the dead:

verses.raw: "Blessed are ye more than we who live."'
verses.text: "Blessed are ye more than we who live."'

verses.raw: But I will say this as I think, And I will speak against thee, O land, which art prospering.
verses.text: But I will say this as I think, And I will speak against thee, O land, which art prospering.

verses.raw: The noonday does not always burn, Nor do the rays of the sun constantly give light.
verses.text: The noonday does not always burn, Nor do the rays of the sun constantly give light.

verses.raw: Do not expect [and hope] that thou wilt always be prosperous and rejoicing. And be not greatly uplifted and boastful.
verses.text: Do not expect [and hope] that thou wilt always be prosperous and rejoicing. And be not greatly uplifted and boastful.

verses.raw: For assuredly in its own season shall the (divine) wrath awake against thee, Which now in long-suffering is held in as it were by reins.
verses.text: For assuredly in its own season shall the (divine) wrath awake against thee, Which now in long-suffering is held in as it were by reins.

verses.raw: And when I had said these things, I fasted seven days.
verses.text: And when I had said these things, I fasted seven days.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after these things, that I, Baruch, was standing upon Mount Zion, and lo! a voice came from the height and said unto me:
verses.text: And it came to pass after these things, that I, Baruch, was standing upon Mount Zion, and lo! a voice came from the height and said unto me:

verses.raw: 'Stand upon thy feet, Baruch, and hear the word of El Gibbor (the mighty God).'
verses.text: 'Stand upon thy feet, Baruch, and hear the word of El Gibbor (the mighty God).'

verses.raw: Because thou hast been astonied at what has befallen Zion, thou shalt therefore be assuredly preserved to the consummation of the times, that thou mayst be for a testimony.
verses.text: Because thou hast been astonied at what has befallen Zion, thou shalt therefore be assuredly preserved to the consummation of the times, that thou mayst be for a testimony.

verses.raw: So that, if ever those prosperous cities say: 'Why hath El Gibbor (the mighty God) brought upon us this retribution?' Say
verses.text: So that, if ever those prosperous cities say: 'Why hath El Gibbor (the mighty God) brought upon us this retribution?' Say

verses.raw: thou to them, thou and those like thee who shall have seen this evil: '(This is the evil) and retribution which is coming upon you and upon your people in its (destined) time that the nations may be thoroughly smitten.
verses.text: thou to them, thou and those like thee who shall have seen this evil: '(This is the evil) and retribution which is coming upon you and upon your people in its (destined) time that the nations may be thoroughly smitten.

verses.raw: And then they shall be in anguish.
verses.text: And then they shall be in anguish.

verses.raw: And if they say at that time:
verses.text: And if they say at that time:

verses.raw: For how long? Thou wilt say to them: "Ye who have drunk the strained wine, Drink ye also of its dregs, The judgement of the Lofty One Who has no respect of persons."'
verses.text: For how long? Thou wilt say to them: "Ye who have drunk the strained wine, Drink ye also of its dregs, The judgement of the Lofty One Who has no respect of persons."'

verses.raw: On this account he had aforetime no mercy on His own sons, But afflicted them as His enemies, because they sinned,
verses.text: On this account he had aforetime no mercy on His own sons, But afflicted them as His enemies, because they sinned,

verses.raw: Then therefore were they chastened That they might be sanctified.
verses.text: Then therefore were they chastened That they might be sanctified.

verses.raw: But now, ye peoples and nations, ye are guilty Because ye have always trodden down the earth, And used the creation unrighteously.
verses.text: But now, ye peoples and nations, ye are guilty Because ye have always trodden down the earth, And used the creation unrighteously.

verses.raw: For I have always benefited you. And ye have always been ungrateful for the beneficence.
verses.text: For I have always benefited you. And ye have always been ungrateful for the beneficence.

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'Lo! Thou hast shown me the method of the times, and that which shall be after these things, and Thou hast said unto me, that the retribution, which has been spoken of by Thee, shall come upon the nations.
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'Lo! Thou hast shown me the method of the times, and that which shall be after these things, and Thou hast said unto me, that the retribution, which has been spoken of by Thee, shall come upon the nations.

verses.raw: And now I know that those who have sinned are many, and they have lived in prosperity, and departed from the world, but that few nations will be left in those times, to whom those words shall be said which Thou didst say.
verses.text: And now I know that those who have sinned are many, and they have lived in prosperity, and departed from the world, but that few nations will be left in those times, to whom those words shall be said which Thou didst say.

verses.raw: For what advantage is there in this, or what (evil), worse than what we have seen befall us, are we to expect to see?
verses.text: For what advantage is there in this, or what (evil), worse than what we have seen befall us, are we to expect to see?

verses.raw: But again I will speak in Thy presence:
verses.text: But again I will speak in Thy presence:

verses.raw: What have they profited who had knowledge before Thee, and have not walked in vanity as the rest of the nations, and have not said to the dead: "Give us life," but always feared Thee, and have not left Thy ways?
verses.text: What have they profited who had knowledge before Thee, and have not walked in vanity as the rest of the nations, and have not said to the dead: "Give us life," but always feared Thee, and have not left Thy ways?

verses.raw: And lo! they have been carried off, nor on their account hast Thou had mercy on Zion.
verses.text: And lo! they have been carried off, nor on their account hast Thou had mercy on Zion.

verses.raw: And if others did evil, it was due to Zion, that on account of the works of those who wrought good works she should be forgiven, and should not be overwhelmed on account of the works of those who wrought unrighteousness.
verses.text: And if others did evil, it was due to Zion, that on account of the works of those who wrought good works she should be forgiven, and should not be overwhelmed on account of the works of those who wrought unrighteousness.

verses.raw: But who, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, will comprehend Thy judgement, Or who will search out the profoundness of Thy way? Or who will think out the [weight] of Thy path?
verses.text: But who, O Yahuah, my Lord, will comprehend Thy judgement, Or who will search out the profoundness of Thy way? Or who will think out the [weight] of Thy path?

verses.raw: Or who will be able to think out Thy incomprehensible counsel? Or who of those that are born has ever found The beginning or end of Thy wisdom?
verses.text: Or who will be able to think out Thy incomprehensible counsel? Or who of those that are born has ever found The beginning or end of Thy wisdom?

verses.raw: For we have all been made like a breath.
verses.text: For we have all been made like a breath.

verses.raw: For as the breath ascends involuntarily, and again dies, so it is with the nature of men, who depart not according to their own will, and know not what will befall them in the end.
verses.text: For as the breath ascends involuntarily, and again dies, so it is with the nature of men, who depart not according to their own will, and know not what will befall them in the end.

verses.raw: For the righteous justly hope for the end, and without fear depart from this habitation, because they have with Thee a store of works preserved in treasuries.
verses.text: For the righteous justly hope for the end, and without fear depart from this habitation, because they have with Thee a store of works preserved in treasuries.

verses.raw: On this account also these without fear leave this world, and trusting with joy they hope to receive the world which Thou hast promised them.
verses.text: On this account also these without fear leave this world, and trusting with joy they hope to receive the world which Thou hast promised them.

verses.raw: But as for us—woe to us, who also are now shamefully entreated, and at that time look forward (only) to evils.
verses.text: But as for us—woe to us, who also are now shamefully entreated, and at that time look forward (only) to evils.

verses.raw: But Thou knowest accurately what Thou hast done by means of Thy servants; for we are not able to understand that which is good as Thou art, our Creator.
verses.text: But Thou knowest accurately what Thou hast done by means of Thy servants; for we are not able to understand that which is good as Thou art, our Creator.

verses.raw: But again I will speak in Thy presence, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord.
verses.text: But again I will speak in Thy presence, O Yahuah, my Lord.

verses.raw: When of old there was no world with its inhabitants, Thou didst devise and speak with a word, and forthwith the works of creation stood before Thee.
verses.text: When of old there was no world with its inhabitants, Thou didst devise and speak with a word, and forthwith the works of creation stood before Thee.

verses.raw: And Thou didst say that Thou wouldst make for Thy world man as the administrator of Thy works, that it might be known that he was by no means made on account of the world, but the world on account of him.
verses.text: And Thou didst say that Thou wouldst make for Thy world man as the administrator of Thy works, that it might be known that he was by no means made on account of the world, but the world on account of him.

verses.raw: And now I see that as for the world which was made on account of us, lo! it abides, but we, on account of whom it was made, depart.'
verses.text: And now I see that as for the world which was made on account of us, lo! it abides, but we, on account of whom it was made, depart.'

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) answered and said unto me: 'Thou art rightly astonied regarding the departure of man,
verses.text: And Yahuah answered and said unto me: 'Thou art rightly astonied regarding the departure of man,

verses.raw: but thou hast not judged well regarding the evils which befall those who sin.
verses.text: but thou hast not judged well regarding the evils which befall those who sin.

verses.raw: And as regards what thou hast said, that the righteous are carried off and the impious are prospered,
verses.text: And as regards what thou hast said, that the righteous are carried off and the impious are prospered,

verses.raw: And as regards what thou hast said: "Man knows not Thy judgement"—On this account hear, and I will speak to thee, and hearken, and I will cause thee to hear My words.
verses.text: And as regards what thou hast said: "Man knows not Thy judgement"—On this account hear, and I will speak to thee, and hearken, and I will cause thee to hear My words.

verses.raw: Man would not rightly have understood My judgement, unless he had accepted the law, and I had instructed him in understanding.
verses.text: Man would not rightly have understood My judgement, unless he had accepted the law, and I had instructed him in understanding.

verses.raw: But now, because he transgressed wittingly, yea, just on this ground that he wot (thereof), he shall be tormented.
verses.text: But now, because he transgressed wittingly, yea, just on this ground that he wot (thereof), he shall be tormented.

verses.raw: And as regards what thou didst say touching the righteous, that on account of them has this world come, so also again shall that, which is to come, come on their account.
verses.text: And as regards what thou didst say touching the righteous, that on account of them has this world come, so also again shall that, which is to come, come on their account.

verses.raw: For this world is to them a strife and a labour with much trouble; and that accordingly which is to come, a crown with great glory.'
verses.text: For this world is to them a strife and a labour with much trouble; and that accordingly which is to come, a crown with great glory.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, lo! the years of this time are few and evil, and who is able in his little time to acquire that which is measureless?'
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'O Yahuah, my Lord, lo! the years of this time are few and evil, and who is able in his little time to acquire that which is measureless?'

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) answered and said unto me: 'With the El Elyon (Most High) account is not taken of much time nor of a few years.
verses.text: And Yahuah answered and said unto me: 'With the El Elyon account is not taken of much time nor of a few years.

verses.raw: For what did it profit Adam that he lived nine hundred and thirty years, and transgressed that which he was commanded?
verses.text: For what did it profit Adam that he lived nine hundred and thirty years, and transgressed that which he was commanded?

verses.raw: Therefore the multitude of time that he lived did not profit him, but brought death and cut off the years of those who were born from him.
verses.text: Therefore the multitude of time that he lived did not profit him, but brought death and cut off the years of those who were born from him.

verses.raw: Or wherein did Moses suffer loss in that he lived only one hundred and twenty years, and, inasmuch as he was subject to Him who formed him, brought the law to the seed of Jacob, and lighted a lamp for the nation of Yashar'el (Israel)?'
verses.text: Or wherein did Moses suffer loss in that he lived only one hundred and twenty years, and, inasmuch as he was subject to Him who formed him, brought the law to the seed of Jacob, and lighted a lamp for the nation of Yashar'el?'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'He that lighted has taken from the light, and there are but few that have imitated him.
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'He that lighted has taken from the light, and there are but few that have imitated him.

verses.raw: But those many whom he has lighted have taken from the darkness of Adam and have not rejoiced in the light of the lamp.'
verses.text: But those many whom he has lighted have taken from the darkness of Adam and have not rejoiced in the light of the lamp.'

verses.raw: And He answered and said unto me: 'Wherefore at that time he appointed for them a covenant and said: "Behold I have placed before you life and death," And he called heaven and earth to witness against them.
verses.text: And He answered and said unto me: 'Wherefore at that time he appointed for them a covenant and said: "Behold I have placed before you life and death," And he called heaven and earth to witness against them.

verses.raw: For he knew that his time was but short, But that heaven and earth endure always.
verses.text: For he knew that his time was but short, But that heaven and earth endure always.

verses.raw: But after his death they sinned and transgressed, Though they knew that they had the law reproving (them), And the light in which nothing could err, Also the spheres which testify, and Me.
verses.text: But after his death they sinned and transgressed, Though they knew that they had the law reproving (them), And the light in which nothing could err, Also the spheres which testify, and Me.

verses.raw: Now regarding everything that is, it is I that judge, but do not thou take counsel in thy soul regarding these things, nor afflict thyself because of those which have been.
verses.text: Now regarding everything that is, it is I that judge, but do not thou take counsel in thy soul regarding these things, nor afflict thyself because of those which have been.

verses.raw: For now it is the consummation of time that should be considered, whether of business, or of prosperity, or of shame, and not the beginning thereof.
verses.text: For now it is the consummation of time that should be considered, whether of business, or of prosperity, or of shame, and not the beginning thereof.

verses.raw: Because if a man be prospered in his beginnings and shamefully entreated in his old age, he forgets all the prosperity that he had.
verses.text: Because if a man be prospered in his beginnings and shamefully entreated in his old age, he forgets all the prosperity that he had.

verses.raw: And again, if a man is shamefully entreated in his beginnings, and at his end is prospered, he remembereth not again his evil entreatment.
verses.text: And again, if a man is shamefully entreated in his beginnings, and at his end is prospered, he remembereth not again his evil entreatment.

verses.raw: And again hearken: though each one were prospered all that time—all the time from the day on which death was decreed against those who transgress—and in his end was destroyed, in vain would have been everything.'
verses.text: And again hearken: though each one were prospered all that time—all the time from the day on which death was decreed against those who transgress—and in his end was destroyed, in vain would have been everything.'

verses.raw: 'Therefore, behold! the days come, And the times shall hasten more than the former, And the seasons shall speed on more than those that are past, And the years shall pass more quickly than the present (years).
verses.text: 'Therefore, behold! the days come, And the times shall hasten more than the former, And the seasons shall speed on more than those that are past, And the years shall pass more quickly than the present (years).

verses.raw: Therefore have I now taken away Zion, That I may the more speedily visit the world in its season.
verses.text: Therefore have I now taken away Zion, That I may the more speedily visit the world in its season.

verses.raw: Now therefore hold fast in thy heart everything that I command thee, And seal it in the recesses of thy mind.
verses.text: Now therefore hold fast in thy heart everything that I command thee, And seal it in the recesses of thy mind.

verses.raw: And then I will show thee the judgement of My might, And My ways which are unsearchable.
verses.text: And then I will show thee the judgement of My might, And My ways which are unsearchable.

verses.raw: Go therefore and sanctify thyself seven days, and eat no bread, nor drink water, nor speak to anyone.
verses.text: Go therefore and sanctify thyself seven days, and eat no bread, nor drink water, nor speak to anyone.

verses.raw: And afterwards come to that place and I will reveal Myself to thee, and speak true things with thee, and I will give thee commandment regarding the method of the times; for they are coming and tarry not.'
verses.text: And afterwards come to that place and I will reveal Myself to thee, and speak true things with thee, and I will give thee commandment regarding the method of the times; for they are coming and tarry not.'

verses.raw: And I went thence and sat in the valley of Cedron in a cave of the earth, and I sanctified my soul there, and I eat no bread, yet I was not hungry, and I drank no water, yet I thirsted not, and I was there till the seventh day, as He had commanded me.
verses.text: And I went thence and sat in the valley of Cedron in a cave of the earth, and I sanctified my soul there, and I eat no bread, yet I was not hungry, and I drank no water, yet I thirsted not, and I was there till the seventh day, as He had commanded me.

verses.raw: And afterwards I came to that place where He had spoken with me.
verses.text: And afterwards I came to that place where He had spoken with me.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at sunset that my soul took much thought, and I began to speak in the presence of the Mighty One, and said:
verses.text: And it came to pass at sunset that my soul took much thought, and I began to speak in the presence of the Mighty One, and said:

verses.raw: 'O Thou that hast made the earth, hear me, that hast fixed the firmament by the word, and hast made firm the height of the heaven by the spirit, that hast called from the beginning of the world that which did not yet exist, and they obey Thee.
verses.text: 'O Thou that hast made the earth, hear me, that hast fixed the firmament by the word, and hast made firm the height of the heaven by the spirit, that hast called from the beginning of the world that which did not yet exist, and they obey Thee.

verses.raw: Thou that hast commanded the air by Thy nod, and hast seen those things which are to be as those things which Thou art doing.
verses.text: Thou that hast commanded the air by Thy nod, and hast seen those things which are to be as those things which Thou art doing.

verses.raw: Thou that rulest with great thought the hosts that stand before Thee: also the countless holy beings, which Thou didst make from the beginning, of flame and fire, which stand around Thy throne
verses.text: Thou that rulest with great thought the hosts that stand before Thee: also the countless holy beings, which Thou didst make from the beginning, of flame and fire, which stand around Thy throne

verses.raw: Thou rulest with †indignation†. To Thee only does this belong that Thou shouldst do forthwith whatsoever Thou dost wish.
verses.text: Thou rulest with †indignation†. To Thee only does this belong that Thou shouldst do forthwith whatsoever Thou dost wish.

verses.raw: Who causest the drops of rain to rain by number upon the earth, and alone knowest the consummation of the times before they come; have respect unto my prayer.
verses.text: Who causest the drops of rain to rain by number upon the earth, and alone knowest the consummation of the times before they come; have respect unto my prayer.

verses.raw: For Thou alone art able to sustain all who are, and those who have passed away, and those who are to be, those who sin, and those who are righteous [as living (and) being past finding out].
verses.text: For Thou alone art able to sustain all who are, and those who have passed away, and those who are to be, those who sin, and those who are righteous [as living (and) being past finding out].

verses.raw: For Thou alone dost live immortal and past finding out, and knowest the number of mankind. And if in time many have sinned, yet others not a few have been righteous.
verses.text: For Thou alone dost live immortal and past finding out, and knowest the number of mankind. And if in time many have sinned, yet others not a few have been righteous.

verses.raw: Thou knowest where Thou preservest the end of those who have sinned, or the consummation of those who have been righteous.
verses.text: Thou knowest where Thou preservest the end of those who have sinned, or the consummation of those who have been righteous.

verses.raw: For if there were this life only, which belongs to all men, nothing could be more bitter than this.
verses.text: For if there were this life only, which belongs to all men, nothing could be more bitter than this.

verses.raw: For of what profit is strength that turns to sickness, Or fullness of food that turns to famine, Or beauty that turns to ugliness.
verses.text: For of what profit is strength that turns to sickness, Or fullness of food that turns to famine, Or beauty that turns to ugliness.

verses.raw: For the nature of man is always changeable. For what we were formerly now we no longer are,
verses.text: For the nature of man is always changeable. For what we were formerly now we no longer are,

verses.raw: and what we now are we shall not afterwards remain. For if a consummation had not been prepared for all, in vain would have been their beginning.
verses.text: and what we now are we shall not afterwards remain. For if a consummation had not been prepared for all, in vain would have been their beginning.

verses.raw: But regarding everything that comes from Thee, do Thou inform me, and regarding everything about which I ask Thee, do Thou enlighten me.
verses.text: But regarding everything that comes from Thee, do Thou inform me, and regarding everything about which I ask Thee, do Thou enlighten me.

verses.raw: How long will that which is corruptible remain, and how long will the time of mortals be prospered, and until what time will those who transgress in the world be polluted with much wickedness?
verses.text: How long will that which is corruptible remain, and how long will the time of mortals be prospered, and until what time will those who transgress in the world be polluted with much wickedness?

verses.raw: Command therefore in mercy and accomplish all that Thou saidst Thou wouldst bring, that Thy might may be made known to those who think that Thy long-suffering is weakness.
verses.text: Command therefore in mercy and accomplish all that Thou saidst Thou wouldst bring, that Thy might may be made known to those who think that Thy long-suffering is weakness.

verses.raw: And show to those who know not, that everything that has befallen us and our city until now has been according to the long-suffering of Thy power, because on account of Thy name Thou hast called us a beloved people.
verses.text: And show to those who know not, that everything that has befallen us and our city until now has been according to the long-suffering of Thy power, because on account of Thy name Thou hast called us a beloved people.

verses.raw: Bring to an end therefore henceforth mortality. And reprove accordingly the angel of death, and let Thy glory appear, and let the might of Thy beauty be known, and let Sheol be sealed so that from this time forward it may not receive the dead, and let the treasuries of souls restore those which are enclosed in them.
verses.text: Bring to an end therefore henceforth mortality. And reprove accordingly the angel of death, and let Thy glory appear, and let the might of Thy beauty be known, and let Sheol be sealed so that from this time forward it may not receive the dead, and let the treasuries of souls restore those which are enclosed in them.

verses.raw: For there have been many years like those that are desolate from the days of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, and of all those who are like them, who sleep in the earth, on whose account Thou didst say that Thou hadst created the world.
verses.text: For there have been many years like those that are desolate from the days of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, and of all those who are like them, who sleep in the earth, on whose account Thou didst say that Thou hadst created the world.

verses.raw: And now quickly show Thy glory, and do not defer what has been promised by Thee.'
verses.text: And now quickly show Thy glory, and do not defer what has been promised by Thee.'

verses.raw: And (when) I had completed the words of this prayer I was greatly weakened.
verses.text: And (when) I had completed the words of this prayer I was greatly weakened.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after these things that lo! the heavens were opened, and I saw, and power was given to me, and a voice was heard from on high, and it said unto me: 'Baruch, Baruch, why art thou troubled?
verses.text: And it came to pass after these things that lo! the heavens were opened, and I saw, and power was given to me, and a voice was heard from on high, and it said unto me: 'Baruch, Baruch, why art thou troubled?

verses.raw: He who travels by a road but does not complete it, or who departs by sea but does not arrive at the port, can he be comforted?
verses.text: He who travels by a road but does not complete it, or who departs by sea but does not arrive at the port, can he be comforted?

verses.raw: Or he who promises to give a present to another, but does not fulfil it, is it not robbery?
verses.text: Or he who promises to give a present to another, but does not fulfil it, is it not robbery?

verses.raw: Or he who sows the earth, but does not reap its fruit in its season, does he not lose everything?
verses.text: Or he who sows the earth, but does not reap its fruit in its season, does he not lose everything?

verses.raw: Or he who plants a plant unless it grows till the time suitable to it, does he who planted it expect to receive fruit from it?
verses.text: Or he who plants a plant unless it grows till the time suitable to it, does he who planted it expect to receive fruit from it?

verses.raw: Or a woman who has conceived, if she bring forth untimely, does she not assuredly slay her infant?
verses.text: Or a woman who has conceived, if she bring forth untimely, does she not assuredly slay her infant?

verses.raw: Or he who builds a house, if he does not roof it and complete it, can it be called a house? Tell Me that first.'
verses.text: Or he who builds a house, if he does not roof it and complete it, can it be called a house? Tell Me that first.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'Not so, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord.' And He answered and said unto me: 'Why therefore art thou troubled about that which thou knowest not, and why art thou ill at ease about things in which thou art ignorant?
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'Not so, O Yahuah, my Lord.' And He answered and said unto me: 'Why therefore art thou troubled about that which thou knowest not, and why art thou ill at ease about things in which thou art ignorant?

verses.raw: For as thou hast not forgotten the people who now are and those who have passed away, so I remember those who are appointed to come.
verses.text: For as thou hast not forgotten the people who now are and those who have passed away, so I remember those who are appointed to come.

verses.raw: Because when Adam sinned and death was decreed against those who should be born, then the multitude of those who should be born was numbered, and for that number a place was prepared where the living might dwell and the dead might be guarded.
verses.text: Because when Adam sinned and death was decreed against those who should be born, then the multitude of those who should be born was numbered, and for that number a place was prepared where the living might dwell and the dead might be guarded.

verses.raw: Before therefore the number aforesaid is fulfilled, the creature will not live again [for My spirit is the creator of life], and Sheol will receive the dead.
verses.text: Before therefore the number aforesaid is fulfilled, the creature will not live again [for My spirit is the creator of life], and Sheol will receive the dead.

verses.raw: And again it is given to thee to hear what things are to come after these times.
verses.text: And again it is given to thee to hear what things are to come after these times.

verses.raw: For truly My redemption has drawn nigh, and is not far distant as aforetime.
verses.text: For truly My redemption has drawn nigh, and is not far distant as aforetime.

verses.raw: 'For behold! the days come and the books shall be opened in which are written the sins of all those who have sinned, and again also the treasuries in which the righteousness of all those who have been righteous in creation is gathered.
verses.text: 'For behold! the days come and the books shall be opened in which are written the sins of all those who have sinned, and again also the treasuries in which the righteousness of all those who have been righteous in creation is gathered.

verses.raw: For it shall come to pass at that time that thou shalt see—and the many that are with thee—the long-suffering of the El Elyon (Most High), which has been throughout all generations, who has been long-suffering towards all who are born, (alike) those who sin and (those who) are righteous.'
verses.text: For it shall come to pass at that time that thou shalt see—and the many that are with thee—the long-suffering of the El Elyon, which has been throughout all generations, who has been long-suffering towards all who are born, (alike) those who sin and (those who) are righteous.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'But, behold! O Yahuah (Lord), no one knows the number of those things which have passed nor yet of those things which are to come.
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'But, behold! O Yahuah, no one knows the number of those things which have passed nor yet of those things which are to come.

verses.raw: For I know indeed that which has befallen us, but what will happen to our enemies I know not, and when Thou wilt visit Thy works.'
verses.text: For I know indeed that which has befallen us, but what will happen to our enemies I know not, and when Thou wilt visit Thy works.'

verses.raw: And He answered and said unto me: 'Thou too shalt be preserved till that time till that sign which the El Elyon (Most High) will work for the inhabitants of the earth in the end of days.
verses.text: And He answered and said unto me: 'Thou too shalt be preserved till that time till that sign which the El Elyon will work for the inhabitants of the earth in the end of days.

verses.raw: This therefore shall be the sign.
verses.text: This therefore shall be the sign.

verses.raw: When a stupor shall seize the inhabitants of the earth, and they shall fall into many tribulations, and again when they shall fall into great torments.
verses.text: When a stupor shall seize the inhabitants of the earth, and they shall fall into many tribulations, and again when they shall fall into great torments.

verses.raw: And it will come to pass when they say in their thoughts by reason of their much tribulation: "The Mighty One doth no longer remember the earth"—yea, it will come to pass when they abandon hope, that the time will then awake.'
verses.text: And it will come to pass when they say in their thoughts by reason of their much tribulation: "The Mighty One doth no longer remember the earth"—yea, it will come to pass when they abandon hope, that the time will then awake.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'Will that tribulation which is to be continue a long time, and will that necessity embrace many years?'
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'Will that tribulation which is to be continue a long time, and will that necessity embrace many years?'

verses.raw: And He answered and said unto me: 'Into twelve parts is that time divided, and each one of them is reserved for that which is appointed for it.
verses.text: And He answered and said unto me: 'Into twelve parts is that time divided, and each one of them is reserved for that which is appointed for it.

verses.raw: In the first part there shall be the beginning of commotions.
verses.text: In the first part there shall be the beginning of commotions.

verses.raw: And in the second part (there shall be) slayings of the great ones.
verses.text: And in the second part (there shall be) slayings of the great ones.

verses.raw: And in the third part the fall of many by death.
verses.text: And in the third part the fall of many by death.

verses.raw: And in the fourth part the sending of the sword.
verses.text: And in the fourth part the sending of the sword.

verses.raw: And in the fifth part famine and the withholding of rain.
verses.text: And in the fifth part famine and the withholding of rain.

verses.raw: And in the sixth part earthquakes and terrors.
verses.text: And in the sixth part earthquakes and terrors.

verses.raw: [Wanting.]
verses.text: [Wanting.]

verses.raw: And in the eighth part a multitude of spectres and attacks of the Shedim.
verses.text: And in the eighth part a multitude of spectres and attacks of the Shedim.

verses.raw: And in the ninth part the fall of fire.
verses.text: And in the ninth part the fall of fire.

verses.raw: And in the tenth part rapine and much oppression.
verses.text: And in the tenth part rapine and much oppression.

verses.raw: And in the eleventh part wickedness and unchastity.
verses.text: And in the eleventh part wickedness and unchastity.

verses.raw: And in the twelfth part confusion from the mingling together of all those things aforesaid.
verses.text: And in the twelfth part confusion from the mingling together of all those things aforesaid.

verses.raw: For [these parts of that time are reserved, and] shall be mingled one with another and minister one to another.
verses.text: For [these parts of that time are reserved, and] shall be mingled one with another and minister one to another.

verses.raw: For some shall leave out some of their own, and receive (in its stead) from others, and some complete their own and that of others, so that those may not understand who are upon the earth in those days that this is the consummation of the times.
verses.text: For some shall leave out some of their own, and receive (in its stead) from others, and some complete their own and that of others, so that those may not understand who are upon the earth in those days that this is the consummation of the times.

verses.raw: 'Nevertheless, whosoever understandeth shall then be wise.
verses.text: 'Nevertheless, whosoever understandeth shall then be wise.

verses.raw: For the measure and reckoning of that time are two parts a week of seven weeks.'
verses.text: For the measure and reckoning of that time are two parts a week of seven weeks.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'It is good for a man to come and behold, but it is better that he should not come lest he fall.
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'It is good for a man to come and behold, but it is better that he should not come lest he fall.

verses.raw: [But I will say this also:
verses.text: [But I will say this also:

verses.raw: Will he who is incorruptible despise those things which are corruptible, and whatever befalls in the case of those things which are corruptible, so that he might look only to those things which are not corruptible?]
verses.text: Will he who is incorruptible despise those things which are corruptible, and whatever befalls in the case of those things which are corruptible, so that he might look only to those things which are not corruptible?]

verses.raw: But if, O Yahuah (Lord), those things shall assuredly come to pass which Thou hast foretold to me, so do Thou show this also unto me if indeed I have found grace in Thy sight.
verses.text: But if, O Yahuah, those things shall assuredly come to pass which Thou hast foretold to me, so do Thou show this also unto me if indeed I have found grace in Thy sight.

verses.raw: Is it in one place or in one of the parts of the earth that those things are come to pass, or will the whole earth experience (them)?'
verses.text: Is it in one place or in one of the parts of the earth that those things are come to pass, or will the whole earth experience (them)?'

verses.raw: And He answered and said unto me: 'Whatever will then befall (will befall) the whole earth; therefore all who live will experience (them).
verses.text: And He answered and said unto me: 'Whatever will then befall (will befall) the whole earth; therefore all who live will experience (them).

verses.raw: For at that time I will protect only those who are found in those self-same days in this land.
verses.text: For at that time I will protect only those who are found in those self-same days in this land.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass when all is accomplished that was to come to pass in those parts, that the Messiah shall then begin to be revealed.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass when all is accomplished that was to come to pass in those parts, that the Messiah shall then begin to be revealed.

verses.raw: And Behemoth shall be revealed from his place and Leviathan shall ascend from the sea, those two great monsters which I created on the fifth day of creation, and shall have kept until that time; and then they shall be for food for all that are left.
verses.text: And Behemoth shall be revealed from his place and Leviathan shall ascend from the sea, those two great monsters which I created on the fifth day of creation, and shall have kept until that time; and then they shall be for food for all that are left.

verses.raw: The earth also shall yield its fruit ten thousandfold and on each (?) vine there shall be a thousand branches, and each branch shall produce a thousand clusters, and each cluster produce a thousand grapes, and each grape produce a cor of wine.
verses.text: The earth also shall yield its fruit ten thousandfold and on each (?) vine there shall be a thousand branches, and each branch shall produce a thousand clusters, and each cluster produce a thousand grapes, and each grape produce a cor of wine.

verses.raw: And those who have hungered shall rejoice: moreover, also, they shall behold marvels every day.
verses.text: And those who have hungered shall rejoice: moreover, also, they shall behold marvels every day.

verses.raw: For winds shall go forth from before Me to bring every morning the fragrance of aromatic fruits, and at the close of the day clouds distilling the dew of health.
verses.text: For winds shall go forth from before Me to bring every morning the fragrance of aromatic fruits, and at the close of the day clouds distilling the dew of health.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass at that self-same time that the treasury of manna shall again descend from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have come to the consummation of time.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass at that self-same time that the treasury of manna shall again descend from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have come to the consummation of time.

verses.raw: 'And it shall come to pass after these things, when the time of the advent of the Messiah is fulfilled, that He shall return in glory.
verses.text: 'And it shall come to pass after these things, when the time of the advent of the Messiah is fulfilled, that He shall return in glory.

verses.raw: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.
verses.text: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.

verses.raw: For they know that the time has come of which it is said, that it is the consummation of the times.
verses.text: For they know that the time has come of which it is said, that it is the consummation of the times.

verses.raw: But the souls of the wicked, when they behold all these things, shall then waste away the more.
verses.text: But the souls of the wicked, when they behold all these things, shall then waste away the more.

verses.raw: For they shall know that their torment has come and their perdition has arrived.'
verses.text: For they shall know that their torment has come and their perdition has arrived.'

verses.raw: And it came to pass after these things that I went to the people and said unto them: 'Assemble unto me all your elders and I will speak words unto them.'
verses.text: And it came to pass after these things that I went to the people and said unto them: 'Assemble unto me all your elders and I will speak words unto them.'

verses.raw: And they all assembled in the valley of the Cedron.
verses.text: And they all assembled in the valley of the Cedron.

verses.raw: And I answered and said unto them: 'Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel), and I will speak to thee, And give ear, O seed of Jacob, and I will instruct thee.
verses.text: And I answered and said unto them: 'Hear, O Yashar'el, and I will speak to thee, And give ear, O seed of Jacob, and I will instruct thee.

verses.raw: Forget not Zion, But hold in remembrance the anguish of Jerusalem.
verses.text: Forget not Zion, But hold in remembrance the anguish of Jerusalem.

verses.raw: For lo! the days come, When everything that is shall become the prey of corruption And be as though it had not been.
verses.text: For lo! the days come, When everything that is shall become the prey of corruption And be as though it had not been.

verses.raw: 'But as for you, if ye prepare your hearts, so as to sow in them the fruits of the law, it shall protect you in that time in which the Mighty One is to shake the whole creation.
verses.text: 'But as for you, if ye prepare your hearts, so as to sow in them the fruits of the law, it shall protect you in that time in which the Mighty One is to shake the whole creation.

verses.raw: [Because after a little time the building of Zion will be shaken in order that it may be built again.
verses.text: [Because after a little time the building of Zion will be shaken in order that it may be built again.

verses.raw: But that building will not remain, but will again after a time be rooted out, and will remain desolate until the time.
verses.text: But that building will not remain, but will again after a time be rooted out, and will remain desolate until the time.

verses.raw: And afterwards it must be renewed in glory, and perfected for evermore.]
verses.text: And afterwards it must be renewed in glory, and perfected for evermore.]

verses.raw: Therefore we should not be distressed so much over the evil which has now come as over that which is still to be.
verses.text: Therefore we should not be distressed so much over the evil which has now come as over that which is still to be.

verses.raw: For there will be a greater trial than these two tribulations when the Mighty One will renew His creation.
verses.text: For there will be a greater trial than these two tribulations when the Mighty One will renew His creation.

verses.raw: And now do not draw near to me for a few days, nor seek me till I come to you.'
verses.text: And now do not draw near to me for a few days, nor seek me till I come to you.'

verses.raw: And it came to pass when I had spoken to them all these words, that I, Baruch, went my way, and when the people saw me setting out, they lifted up their voice and lamented and said : 'Whither departest thou from us, Baruch, and forsakest us as a father who forsakes his orphan children, and departs from them ?
verses.text: And it came to pass when I had spoken to them all these words, that I, Baruch, went my way, and when the people saw me setting out, they lifted up their voice and lamented and said : 'Whither departest thou from us, Baruch, and forsakest us as a father who forsakes his orphan children, and departs from them ?

verses.raw: 'Are these the commands which thy companion, Jeremiah the prophet, commanded thee, and said unto thee: "Look to this people till I go and make ready the rest of the brethren in Babylon,
verses.text: 'Are these the commands which thy companion, Jeremiah the prophet, commanded thee, and said unto thee: "Look to this people till I go and make ready the rest of the brethren in Babylon,

verses.raw: against whom has gone forth the sentence that they should be led into captivity"?
verses.text: against whom has gone forth the sentence that they should be led into captivity"?

verses.raw: And now if thou also forsakest us, it were good for us all to die before thee, and then that thou shouldst withdraw from us.'
verses.text: And now if thou also forsakest us, it were good for us all to die before thee, and then that thou shouldst withdraw from us.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said unto the people: 'Far be it from me to forsake you or to withdraw from you, but I will only go unto the Holy of Holies to inquire of the Mighty One concerning you and concerning Zion, if in some respect I should receive more illumination: and after these things I will return to you.'
verses.text: And I answered and said unto the people: 'Far be it from me to forsake you or to withdraw from you, but I will only go unto the Holy of Holies to inquire of the Mighty One concerning you and concerning Zion, if in some respect I should receive more illumination: and after these things I will return to you.'

verses.raw: And I, Baruch, went to the holy place, and sat down upon the ruins and wept, and said:
verses.text: And I, Baruch, went to the holy place, and sat down upon the ruins and wept, and said:

verses.raw: 'O that mine eyes were springs, And mine eyelids a fount of tears.
verses.text: 'O that mine eyes were springs, And mine eyelids a fount of tears.

verses.raw: For how shall I lament for Zion, And how shall I mourn for Jerusalem ?
verses.text: For how shall I lament for Zion, And how shall I mourn for Jerusalem ?

verses.raw: Because in that place where I am now prostrate, Of old the high priest offered holy sacrifices, And placed thereon an incense of fragrant odours.
verses.text: Because in that place where I am now prostrate, Of old the high priest offered holy sacrifices, And placed thereon an incense of fragrant odours.

verses.raw: But now our glorying has been made into dust, And the desire of our soul into sand.'
verses.text: But now our glorying has been made into dust, And the desire of our soul into sand.'

verses.raw: And when I had said these things I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision in the night.
verses.text: And when I had said these things I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision in the night.

verses.raw: And lo! a forest of trees planted on the plain, and lofty and rugged rocky mountains surrounded it, and that forest occupied much space.
verses.text: And lo! a forest of trees planted on the plain, and lofty and rugged rocky mountains surrounded it, and that forest occupied much space.

verses.raw: And lo! over against it arose a vine, and from under it there went forth a fountain peacefully.
verses.text: And lo! over against it arose a vine, and from under it there went forth a fountain peacefully.

verses.raw: Now that fountain came to the forest and was (stirred) into great waves, and those waves submerged that forest, and suddenly they rooted out the greater part of that forest, and overthrew all the mountains which were round about it.
verses.text: Now that fountain came to the forest and was (stirred) into great waves, and those waves submerged that forest, and suddenly they rooted out the greater part of that forest, and overthrew all the mountains which were round about it.

verses.raw: And the height of the forest began to be made low, and the top of the mountains was made low and that fountain prevailed greatly, so that it left nothing of that great forest save one cedar only.
verses.text: And the height of the forest began to be made low, and the top of the mountains was made low and that fountain prevailed greatly, so that it left nothing of that great forest save one cedar only.

verses.raw: Also when it had cast it down and had destroyed and rooted out the greater part of that forest, so that nothing was left of it, nor could its place be recognized, then that vine began to come with the fountain in peace and great tranquillity, and it came to a place which was not far from that cedar, and they brought the cedar which had been cast down to it.
verses.text: Also when it had cast it down and had destroyed and rooted out the greater part of that forest, so that nothing was left of it, nor could its place be recognized, then that vine began to come with the fountain in peace and great tranquillity, and it came to a place which was not far from that cedar, and they brought the cedar which had been cast down to it.

verses.raw: And I beheld and lo! that vine opened its mouth and spake and said to that cedar: 'Art thou not that cedar which was left of the forest of wickedness, and by whose means wickedness persisted, and was wrought all those years, and goodness never.
verses.text: And I beheld and lo! that vine opened its mouth and spake and said to that cedar: 'Art thou not that cedar which was left of the forest of wickedness, and by whose means wickedness persisted, and was wrought all those years, and goodness never.

verses.raw: And thou didst keep conquering that which was not thine, and to that which was thine thou didst never show compassion, and thou didst keep extending thy power over those who were far from thee, and those who drew nigh thee thou didst hold fast in the toils of thy wickedness, and thou didst uplift thyself always as one that could not be rooted out!
verses.text: And thou didst keep conquering that which was not thine, and to that which was thine thou didst never show compassion, and thou didst keep extending thy power over those who were far from thee, and those who drew nigh thee thou didst hold fast in the toils of thy wickedness, and thou didst uplift thyself always as one that could not be rooted out!

verses.raw: But now thy time has sped and thine hour is come.
verses.text: But now thy time has sped and thine hour is come.

verses.raw: Do thou also therefore depart, O cedar, after the forest, which departed before thee, and become dust with it, and let your ashes be mingled together.
verses.text: Do thou also therefore depart, O cedar, after the forest, which departed before thee, and become dust with it, and let your ashes be mingled together.

verses.raw: And now recline in anguish and rest in torment till thy last time come, in which thou wilt come again, and be tormented still more.'
