verses.text: And now recline in anguish and rest in torment till thy last time come, in which thou wilt come again, and be tormented still more.'

verses.raw: And after these things I saw that cedar burning, and the vine growing, itself and all around it, the plain full of unfading flowers. And I indeed awoke and arose.
verses.text: And after these things I saw that cedar burning, and the vine growing, itself and all around it, the plain full of unfading flowers. And I indeed awoke and arose.

verses.raw: And I prayed and said: 'O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, Thou dost always enlighten those who are led by understanding.
verses.text: And I prayed and said: 'O Yahuah, my Lord, Thou dost always enlighten those who are led by understanding.

verses.raw: Thy law is life, and Thy wisdom is right guidance.
verses.text: Thy law is life, and Thy wisdom is right guidance.

verses.raw: Make known to me therefore the interpretation of this vision.
verses.text: Make known to me therefore the interpretation of this vision.

verses.raw: For Thou knowest that my soul hath always walked in Thy law, and from my (earliest) days I departed not from Thy wisdom.'
verses.text: For Thou knowest that my soul hath always walked in Thy law, and from my (earliest) days I departed not from Thy wisdom.'

verses.raw: And He answered and said unto me: 'Baruch, this is the interpretation of the vision which thou hast seen.
verses.text: And He answered and said unto me: 'Baruch, this is the interpretation of the vision which thou hast seen.

verses.raw: As thou hast seen the great forest which lofty and rugged mountains surrounded, this is the word.
verses.text: As thou hast seen the great forest which lofty and rugged mountains surrounded, this is the word.

verses.raw: Behold! the days come, and this kingdom will be destroyed which once destroyed Zion, and it will be subjected to that which comes after it.
verses.text: Behold! the days come, and this kingdom will be destroyed which once destroyed Zion, and it will be subjected to that which comes after it.

verses.raw: Moreover, that also again after a time will be destroyed, and another, a third, will arise, and that also will have dominion for its time, and will be destroyed.
verses.text: Moreover, that also again after a time will be destroyed, and another, a third, will arise, and that also will have dominion for its time, and will be destroyed.

verses.raw: And after these things a fourth kingdom will arise, whose power will be harsh and evil far beyond those which were before it, and it will rule many times as the forests on the plain, and it will hold fast for times, and will exalt itself more than the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.text: And after these things a fourth kingdom will arise, whose power will be harsh and evil far beyond those which were before it, and it will rule many times as the forests on the plain, and it will hold fast for times, and will exalt itself more than the cedars of Lebanon.

verses.raw: And by it the truth will be hidden, and all those who are polluted with iniquity will flee to it, as evil beasts flee and creep into the forest.
verses.text: And by it the truth will be hidden, and all those who are polluted with iniquity will flee to it, as evil beasts flee and creep into the forest.

verses.raw: And it will come to pass when the time of its consummation that it should fall has approached, then the principate of My Messiah will be revealed, which is like the fountain and the vine, and when it is revealed it will root out the multitude of its host.
verses.text: And it will come to pass when the time of its consummation that it should fall has approached, then the principate of My Messiah will be revealed, which is like the fountain and the vine, and when it is revealed it will root out the multitude of its host.

verses.raw: And as touching that which thou hast seen, the lofty cedar, which was left of that forest, and the fact, that the vine spoke those words with it which thou didst hear, this is the word.
verses.text: And as touching that which thou hast seen, the lofty cedar, which was left of that forest, and the fact, that the vine spoke those words with it which thou didst hear, this is the word.

verses.raw: 'The last leader of that time will be left alive, when the multitude of his hosts will be put to the sword, and he will be bound, and they will take him up to Mount Zion, and My Messiah will convict him of all his impieties, and will gather and set before him all the works of his hosts.
verses.text: 'The last leader of that time will be left alive, when the multitude of his hosts will be put to the sword, and he will be bound, and they will take him up to Mount Zion, and My Messiah will convict him of all his impieties, and will gather and set before him all the works of his hosts.

verses.raw: And afterwards he will put him to death, and protect the rest of My people which shall be found in the place which I have chosen.
verses.text: And afterwards he will put him to death, and protect the rest of My people which shall be found in the place which I have chosen.

verses.raw: And his principate will stand for ever, until the world of corruption is at an end, and until the times aforesaid are fulfilled.
verses.text: And his principate will stand for ever, until the world of corruption is at an end, and until the times aforesaid are fulfilled.

verses.raw: This is thy vision, and this is its interpretation.'
verses.text: This is thy vision, and this is its interpretation.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'For whom and for how many shall these things be? or who will be worthy to live at that time?
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'For whom and for how many shall these things be? or who will be worthy to live at that time?

verses.raw: For I will speak before Thee everything that I think, and I will ask of Thee regarding those things which I meditate.
verses.text: For I will speak before Thee everything that I think, and I will ask of Thee regarding those things which I meditate.

verses.raw: For lo! I see many of Thy people who have withdrawn from Thy covenant, and cast from them the yoke of Thy law.
verses.text: For lo! I see many of Thy people who have withdrawn from Thy covenant, and cast from them the yoke of Thy law.

verses.raw: But others again I have seen who have forsaken their vanity, and fled for refuge beneath Thy wings.
verses.text: But others again I have seen who have forsaken their vanity, and fled for refuge beneath Thy wings.

verses.raw: What therefore will be to them? or how will the last time receive them?
verses.text: What therefore will be to them? or how will the last time receive them?

verses.raw: Or perhaps the time of these will assuredly be weighed, and as the beam inclines will they be judged accordingly?'
verses.text: Or perhaps the time of these will assuredly be weighed, and as the beam inclines will they be judged accordingly?'

verses.raw: And He answered and said unto me: 'These things also will I show unto thee.
verses.text: And He answered and said unto me: 'These things also will I show unto thee.

verses.raw: As for what thou didst say—"To whom will these things be, and how many (will they be)?"—to those who have believed there shall be the good which was spoken of aforetime, and to those who despise there shall be the contrary of these things.
verses.text: As for what thou didst say—"To whom will these things be, and how many (will they be)?"—to those who have believed there shall be the good which was spoken of aforetime, and to those who despise there shall be the contrary of these things.

verses.raw: And as for what thou didst say regarding those who have drawn near and those who have withdrawn this is the word.
verses.text: And as for what thou didst say regarding those who have drawn near and those who have withdrawn this is the word.

verses.raw: As for those who were before subject, and afterwards withdrew and mingled themselves with the seed of mingled peoples, the time of these was the former, and was accounted as something exalted.
verses.text: As for those who were before subject, and afterwards withdrew and mingled themselves with the seed of mingled peoples, the time of these was the former, and was accounted as something exalted.

verses.raw: And as for those who before knew not but afterwards knew life, and mingled (only) with the seed of the people which had separated itself, the time of these (is) the latter, and is accounted as something exalted.
verses.text: And as for those who before knew not but afterwards knew life, and mingled (only) with the seed of the people which had separated itself, the time of these (is) the latter, and is accounted as something exalted.

verses.raw: And time shall succeed to time and season to season, and one shall receive from another, and then with a view to the consummation shall everything be compared according to the measure of the times and the hours of the seasons.
verses.text: And time shall succeed to time and season to season, and one shall receive from another, and then with a view to the consummation shall everything be compared according to the measure of the times and the hours of the seasons.

verses.raw: For corruption shall take those that belong to it, and life those that belong to it.
verses.text: For corruption shall take those that belong to it, and life those that belong to it.

verses.raw: And the dust shall be called, and there shall be said to it: "Give back that which is not thine, and raise up all that thou hast kept until its time".'
verses.text: And the dust shall be called, and there shall be said to it: "Give back that which is not thine, and raise up all that thou hast kept until its time".'

verses.raw: 'But, do thou, Baruch, direct thy heart to that which has been said to thee, And understand those things which have been shown to thee; For there are many eternal consolations for thee.
verses.text: 'But, do thou, Baruch, direct thy heart to that which has been said to thee, And understand those things which have been shown to thee; For there are many eternal consolations for thee.

verses.raw: For thou shalt depart from this place, And thou shalt pass from the regions which are now seen by thee, And thou shalt forget whatever is corruptible, And shalt not again recall those things which happen among mortals.
verses.text: For thou shalt depart from this place, And thou shalt pass from the regions which are now seen by thee, And thou shalt forget whatever is corruptible, And shalt not again recall those things which happen among mortals.

verses.raw: Go therefore and command thy people, and come to this place, and afterwards fast seven days, and then I will come to thee and speak with thee.'
verses.text: Go therefore and command thy people, and come to this place, and afterwards fast seven days, and then I will come to thee and speak with thee.'

verses.raw: And I, Baruch, went from thence, and came to my people, and I called my first-born son and [the Gedaliahs] my friends, and seven of the elders of the people, and I said unto them:
verses.text: And I, Baruch, went from thence, and came to my people, and I called my first-born son and [the Gedaliahs] my friends, and seven of the elders of the people, and I said unto them:

verses.raw: 'Behold, I go unto my fathers According to the way of all the earth.
verses.text: 'Behold, I go unto my fathers According to the way of all the earth.

verses.raw: But withdraw ye not from the way of the law, But guard and admonish the people which remain, Lest they withdraw from the commandments of the Mighty One.
verses.text: But withdraw ye not from the way of the law, But guard and admonish the people which remain, Lest they withdraw from the commandments of the Mighty One.

verses.raw: For ye see that He whom we serve is just, And our Creator is no respecter of persons.
verses.text: For ye see that He whom we serve is just, And our Creator is no respecter of persons.

verses.raw: And see ye what hath befallen Zion, And what hath happened to Jerusalem.
verses.text: And see ye what hath befallen Zion, And what hath happened to Jerusalem.

verses.raw: For the judgement of the Mighty One shall (thereby) be made known, And His ways, which, though past finding out, are right.
verses.text: For the judgement of the Mighty One shall (thereby) be made known, And His ways, which, though past finding out, are right.

verses.raw: For if ye endure and persevere in His fear, And do not forget His law, The times shall change over you for good, And ye shall see the consolation of Zion.
verses.text: For if ye endure and persevere in His fear, And do not forget His law, The times shall change over you for good, And ye shall see the consolation of Zion.

verses.raw: Because whatever is now is nothing, But that which shall be is very great. For everything that is corruptible shall pass away, And everything that dies shall depart, And all the present time shall be forgotten, Nor shall there be any remembrance of the present time, which is defiled with evils.
verses.text: Because whatever is now is nothing, But that which shall be is very great. For everything that is corruptible shall pass away, And everything that dies shall depart, And all the present time shall be forgotten, Nor shall there be any remembrance of the present time, which is defiled with evils.

verses.raw: For that which runs now runs unto vanity, And that which prospers shall quickly fall and be humiliated.
verses.text: For that which runs now runs unto vanity, And that which prospers shall quickly fall and be humiliated.

verses.raw: For that which is to be shall be the object of desire, And for that which comes afterwards shall we hope; For it is a time that passes not away,
verses.text: For that which is to be shall be the object of desire, And for that which comes afterwards shall we hope; For it is a time that passes not away,

verses.raw: And the hour comes which abides for ever. And the new world (comes) which does not turn to corruption those who depart to its blessedness, And has no mercy on those who depart to torment, And leads not to perdition those who live in it.
verses.text: And the hour comes which abides for ever. And the new world (comes) which does not turn to corruption those who depart to its blessedness, And has no mercy on those who depart to torment, And leads not to perdition those who live in it.

verses.raw: For these are they who shall inherit that time which has been spoken of, And theirs is the inheritance of the promised time.
verses.text: For these are they who shall inherit that time which has been spoken of, And theirs is the inheritance of the promised time.

verses.raw: These are they who have acquired for themselves treasures of wisdom, And with them are found stores of understanding, And from mercy have they not withdrawn, And the truth of the law have they preserved.
verses.text: These are they who have acquired for themselves treasures of wisdom, And with them are found stores of understanding, And from mercy have they not withdrawn, And the truth of the law have they preserved.

verses.raw: For to them shall be given the world to come, But the dwelling of the rest who are many shall be in the fire.'
verses.text: For to them shall be given the world to come, But the dwelling of the rest who are many shall be in the fire.'

verses.raw: 'Do ye therefore so far as ye are able instruct the people, for that labour is ours. For if ye teach them, ye will quicken them.'
verses.text: 'Do ye therefore so far as ye are able instruct the people, for that labour is ours. For if ye teach them, ye will quicken them.'

verses.raw: And my son and the elders of the people answered and said unto me: 'Has the Mighty One humiliated us to such a degree As to take thee from us quickly?
verses.text: And my son and the elders of the people answered and said unto me: 'Has the Mighty One humiliated us to such a degree As to take thee from us quickly?

verses.raw: And truly we shall be in darkness, And there shall be no light to the people who are left.
verses.text: And truly we shall be in darkness, And there shall be no light to the people who are left.

verses.raw: For where again shall we seek the law, Or who will distinguish for us between death and life?'
verses.text: For where again shall we seek the law, Or who will distinguish for us between death and life?'

verses.raw: And I said unto them: 'The throne of the Mighty One I cannot resist; Nevertheless, there shall not be wanting to Yashar'el (Israel) a wise man Nor a son of the law to the race of Jacob.
verses.text: And I said unto them: 'The throne of the Mighty One I cannot resist; Nevertheless, there shall not be wanting to Yashar'el a wise man Nor a son of the law to the race of Jacob.

verses.raw: But only prepare ye your hearts, that ye may obey the law, And be subject to those who in fear are wise and understanding; And prepare your souls that ye may not depart from them.
verses.text: But only prepare ye your hearts, that ye may obey the law, And be subject to those who in fear are wise and understanding; And prepare your souls that ye may not depart from them.

verses.raw: For if ye do these things, Good tidings shall come unto you. [Which I before told you of; nor shall ye fall into the torment, of which I testified to you before.'
verses.text: For if ye do these things, Good tidings shall come unto you. [Which I before told you of; nor shall ye fall into the torment, of which I testified to you before.'

verses.raw: But with regard to the word that I was to be taken I did not make (it) known to them or to my son.]
verses.text: But with regard to the word that I was to be taken I did not make (it) known to them or to my son.]

verses.raw: And when I had gone forth and dismissed them, I went thence and said unto them: 'Behold! I go to Hebron: for thither the Mighty One hath sent me.'
verses.text: And when I had gone forth and dismissed them, I went thence and said unto them: 'Behold! I go to Hebron: for thither the Mighty One hath sent me.'

verses.raw: And I came to that place where the word had been spoken unto me, and I sat there, and fasted seven days.
verses.text: And I came to that place where the word had been spoken unto me, and I sat there, and fasted seven days.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after the seventh day, that I prayed before the Mighty One and said:
verses.text: And it came to pass after the seventh day, that I prayed before the Mighty One and said:

verses.raw: 'O my Lord, Thou summonest the advent of the times, And they stand before Thee; Thou causest the power of the ages to pass away, And they do not resist Thee;
verses.text: 'O my Lord, Thou summonest the advent of the times, And they stand before Thee; Thou causest the power of the ages to pass away, And they do not resist Thee;

verses.raw: Thou arrangest the method of the seasons, And they obey Thee.
verses.text: Thou arrangest the method of the seasons, And they obey Thee.

verses.raw: Thou alone knowest the duration of the generations, And Thou revealest not Thy mysteries to many.
verses.text: Thou alone knowest the duration of the generations, And Thou revealest not Thy mysteries to many.

verses.raw: Thou makest known the multitude of the fire, And Thou weighest the lightness of the wind.
verses.text: Thou makest known the multitude of the fire, And Thou weighest the lightness of the wind.

verses.raw: Thou explorest the limit of the heights, And Thou scrutinizest the depths of the darkness.
verses.text: Thou explorest the limit of the heights, And Thou scrutinizest the depths of the darkness.

verses.raw: Thou carest for the number which pass away that they may be preserved, And Thou preparest an abode for those that are to be.
verses.text: Thou carest for the number which pass away that they may be preserved, And Thou preparest an abode for those that are to be.

verses.raw: Thou rememberest the beginning which Thou hast made, And the destruction that is to be Thou forgettest not.
verses.text: Thou rememberest the beginning which Thou hast made, And the destruction that is to be Thou forgettest not.

verses.raw: With nods of fear and indignation Thou commandest the flames, And they change into spirits, And with a word Thou quickenest that which was not, And with mighty power Thou holdest that which has not yet come.
verses.text: With nods of fear and indignation Thou commandest the flames, And they change into spirits, And with a word Thou quickenest that which was not, And with mighty power Thou holdest that which has not yet come.

verses.raw: Thou instructest created things in the understanding of Thee, And Thou makest wise the spheres so as to minister in their orders.
verses.text: Thou instructest created things in the understanding of Thee, And Thou makest wise the spheres so as to minister in their orders.

verses.raw: Armies innumerable stand before Thee And minister in their orders quietly at Thy nod.
verses.text: Armies innumerable stand before Thee And minister in their orders quietly at Thy nod.

verses.raw: Hear Thy servant And give ear to my petition.
verses.text: Hear Thy servant And give ear to my petition.

verses.raw: For in a little time are we born, And in a little time do we return.
verses.text: For in a little time are we born, And in a little time do we return.

verses.raw: But with Thee hours are as a time, And days as generations.
verses.text: But with Thee hours are as a time, And days as generations.

verses.raw: Be not therefore wroth with man; for he is nothing And take not account of our works; For what are we?
verses.text: Be not therefore wroth with man; for he is nothing And take not account of our works; For what are we?

verses.raw: For lo! by Thy gift do we come into the world, And we depart not of our own will.
verses.text: For lo! by Thy gift do we come into the world, And we depart not of our own will.

verses.raw: For we said not to our parents, "Beget us," Nor did we send to Sheol and say, "Receive us."
verses.text: For we said not to our parents, "Beget us," Nor did we send to Sheol and say, "Receive us."

verses.raw: What therefore is our strength that we should bear Thy wrath, Or what are we that we should endure Thy judgement?
verses.text: What therefore is our strength that we should bear Thy wrath, Or what are we that we should endure Thy judgement?

verses.raw: Protect us in Thy compassions, And in Thy mercy help us.
verses.text: Protect us in Thy compassions, And in Thy mercy help us.

verses.raw: Behold the little ones that are subject unto Thee, And save all that draw nigh unto Thee: And destroy not the hope of our people, And cut not short the times of our aid.
verses.text: Behold the little ones that are subject unto Thee, And save all that draw nigh unto Thee: And destroy not the hope of our people, And cut not short the times of our aid.

verses.raw: For this is the nation which Thou hast chosen, And these are the people, to whom Thou findest no equal.
verses.text: For this is the nation which Thou hast chosen, And these are the people, to whom Thou findest no equal.

verses.raw: But I will speak now before Thee, And I will say as my heart thinketh. In Thee do we trust, for lo! Thy law is with us, And we know that we shall not fall so long as we keep Thy statutes.
verses.text: But I will speak now before Thee, And I will say as my heart thinketh. In Thee do we trust, for lo! Thy law is with us, And we know that we shall not fall so long as we keep Thy statutes.

verses.raw: [To all time are we blessed at all events in this that we have not mingled with the Gentiles.]
verses.text: [To all time are we blessed at all events in this that we have not mingled with the Gentiles.]

verses.raw: For we are all one celebrated people, Who have received one law from One: And the law which is amongst us will aid us, And the surpassing wisdom which is in us will help us.'
verses.text: For we are all one celebrated people, Who have received one law from One: And the law which is amongst us will aid us, And the surpassing wisdom which is in us will help us.'

verses.raw: And when I had prayed and said these things, I was greatly weakened. And He answered and said unto me:
verses.text: And when I had prayed and said these things, I was greatly weakened. And He answered and said unto me:

verses.raw: 'Thou hast prayed simply, O Baruch, And all thy words have been heard.
verses.text: 'Thou hast prayed simply, O Baruch, And all thy words have been heard.

verses.raw: But My judgement exacts its own And My law exacts its rights.
verses.text: But My judgement exacts its own And My law exacts its rights.

verses.raw: For from thy words I will answer thee, And from thy prayer I will speak to thee.
verses.text: For from thy words I will answer thee, And from thy prayer I will speak to thee.

verses.raw: For this is as follows: he that is corrupted is not at all; he has both wrought iniquity so far as he could do anything, and has not remembered My goodness, nor accepted My long-suffering.
verses.text: For this is as follows: he that is corrupted is not at all; he has both wrought iniquity so far as he could do anything, and has not remembered My goodness, nor accepted My long-suffering.

verses.raw: Therefore thou shalt surely be taken up, as I before told thee.
verses.text: Therefore thou shalt surely be taken up, as I before told thee.

verses.raw: For that time shall arise which brings affliction; for it shall come and pass by with quick vehemence, and it shall be turbulent coming in the heat of indignation.
verses.text: For that time shall arise which brings affliction; for it shall come and pass by with quick vehemence, and it shall be turbulent coming in the heat of indignation.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass in those days that all the inhabitants of the earth shall be moved one against another, because they know not that My judgement has drawn nigh.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass in those days that all the inhabitants of the earth shall be moved one against another, because they know not that My judgement has drawn nigh.

verses.raw: For there shall not be found many wise at that time, And the intelligent shall be but a few: Moreover, even those who know shall most of all be silent.
verses.text: For there shall not be found many wise at that time, And the intelligent shall be but a few: Moreover, even those who know shall most of all be silent.

verses.raw: And there shall be many rumours and tidings not a few, And the doings of phantasmata shall be manifest, And promises not a few be recounted. Some of them (shall prove) idle, And some of them shall be confirmed.
verses.text: And there shall be many rumours and tidings not a few, And the doings of phantasmata shall be manifest, And promises not a few be recounted. Some of them (shall prove) idle, And some of them shall be confirmed.

verses.raw: And honour shall be turned into shame, And strength humiliated into contempt, And probity destroyed, And beauty shall become ugliness.
verses.text: And honour shall be turned into shame, And strength humiliated into contempt, And probity destroyed, And beauty shall become ugliness.

verses.raw: And many shall say to many at that time: "Where hath the multitude of intelligence hidden itself, And whither hath the multitude of wisdom removed itself?"
verses.text: And many shall say to many at that time: "Where hath the multitude of intelligence hidden itself, And whither hath the multitude of wisdom removed itself?"

verses.raw: And whilst they are meditating these things, Then envy shall arise in those who had not thought aught of themselves (?) And passion shall seize him that is peaceful, And many shall be stirred up in anger to injure many, And they shall rouse up armies in order to shed blood, And in the end they shall perish together with them.
verses.text: And whilst they are meditating these things, Then envy shall arise in those who had not thought aught of themselves (?) And passion shall seize him that is peaceful, And many shall be stirred up in anger to injure many, And they shall rouse up armies in order to shed blood, And in the end they shall perish together with them.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass at the self-same time, That a change of times shall manifestly appear to every man, Because in all those times they polluted themselves And they practised oppression, And walked every man in his own works, And remembered not the law of the Mighty One.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass at the self-same time, That a change of times shall manifestly appear to every man, Because in all those times they polluted themselves And they practised oppression, And walked every man in his own works, And remembered not the law of the Mighty One.

verses.raw: Therefore a fire shall consume their thoughts, And in flame shall the meditations of their reins be tried; For the Judge shall come and will not tarry.
verses.text: Therefore a fire shall consume their thoughts, And in flame shall the meditations of their reins be tried; For the Judge shall come and will not tarry.

verses.raw: Because each of the inhabitants of the earth knew when he was transgressing. But My Law they knew not by reason of their pride.
verses.text: Because each of the inhabitants of the earth knew when he was transgressing. But My Law they knew not by reason of their pride.

verses.raw: But many shall then assuredly weep. Yea, over the living more than over the dead,'
verses.text: But many shall then assuredly weep. Yea, over the living more than over the dead,'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'O Adam, what hast thou done to all those who are born from thee? And what will be said to the first Eve who hearkened to the serpent?
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'O Adam, what hast thou done to all those who are born from thee? And what will be said to the first Eve who hearkened to the serpent?

verses.raw: For all this multitude are going to corruption, Nor is there any numbering of those whom the fire devours.
verses.text: For all this multitude are going to corruption, Nor is there any numbering of those whom the fire devours.

verses.raw: But again I will speak in Thy presence. Thou, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, knowest what is in Thy creature.
verses.text: But again I will speak in Thy presence. Thou, O Yahuah, my Lord, knowest what is in Thy creature.

verses.raw: For Thou didst of old command the dust to produce Adam, and Thou knowest the number of those who are born from him, and how far they have sinned before Thee, who have existed and not confessed Thee as their Creator.
verses.text: For Thou didst of old command the dust to produce Adam, and Thou knowest the number of those who are born from him, and how far they have sinned before Thee, who have existed and not confessed Thee as their Creator.

verses.raw: And as regards all these their end shall convict them, and Thy law which they have transgressed shall requite them on Thy day.'
verses.text: And as regards all these their end shall convict them, and Thy law which they have transgressed shall requite them on Thy day.'

verses.raw: [' But now let us dismiss the wicked and inquire about the righteous.
verses.text: [' But now let us dismiss the wicked and inquire about the righteous.

verses.raw: And I will recount their blessedness And not be silent in celebrating their glory, which is reserved for them.
verses.text: And I will recount their blessedness And not be silent in celebrating their glory, which is reserved for them.

verses.raw: For assuredly as in a little time in this transitory world in which ye live, ye have endured much labour, So in that world to which there is no end, ye shall receive great light.'
verses.text: For assuredly as in a little time in this transitory world in which ye live, ye have endured much labour, So in that world to which there is no end, ye shall receive great light.'

verses.raw: 'Nevertheless, I will again ask from Thee, O Mighty One, yea, I will ask mercy from Him who made all things.
verses.text: 'Nevertheless, I will again ask from Thee, O Mighty One, yea, I will ask mercy from Him who made all things.

verses.raw: "In what shape will those live who live in Thy day? Or how will the splendour of those who (are) after that time continue?
verses.text: "In what shape will those live who live in Thy day? Or how will the splendour of those who (are) after that time continue?

verses.raw: Will they then resume this form of the present, And put on these entrammelling members, Which are now involved in evils, And in which evils are consummated, Or wilt Thou perchance change these things which have been in the world As also the world?"'
verses.text: Will they then resume this form of the present, And put on these entrammelling members, Which are now involved in evils, And in which evils are consummated, Or wilt Thou perchance change these things which have been in the world As also the world?"'

verses.raw: And He answered and said unto me: 'Hear, Baruch, this word, And write in the remembrance of thy heart all that thou shalt learn.
verses.text: And He answered and said unto me: 'Hear, Baruch, this word, And write in the remembrance of thy heart all that thou shalt learn.

verses.raw: For the earth shall then assuredly restore the dead, [Which it now receives, in order to preserve them]. It shall make no change in their form, But as it has received, so shall it restore them, And as I delivered them unto it, so also shall it raise them.
verses.text: For the earth shall then assuredly restore the dead, [Which it now receives, in order to preserve them]. It shall make no change in their form, But as it has received, so shall it restore them, And as I delivered them unto it, so also shall it raise them.

verses.raw: For then it will be necessary to show to the living that the dead have come to life again, and that those who had departed have returned (again).
verses.text: For then it will be necessary to show to the living that the dead have come to life again, and that those who had departed have returned (again).

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass, when they have severally recognized those whom they now know, then judgement shall grow strong, and those things which before were spoken of shall come.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass, when they have severally recognized those whom they now know, then judgement shall grow strong, and those things which before were spoken of shall come.

verses.raw: 'And it shall come to pass, when that appointed day has gone by, that then shall the aspect of those who are condemned be afterwards changed, and the glory of those who are justified.
verses.text: 'And it shall come to pass, when that appointed day has gone by, that then shall the aspect of those who are condemned be afterwards changed, and the glory of those who are justified.

verses.raw: For the aspect of those who now act wickedly shall become worse than it is, as they shall suffer torment.
verses.text: For the aspect of those who now act wickedly shall become worse than it is, as they shall suffer torment.

verses.raw: Also (as for) the glory of those who have now been justified in My law, who have had understanding in their life, and who have planted in their heart the root of wisdom, then their splendour shall be glorified in changes, and the form of their face shall be turned into the light of their beauty, that they may be able to acquire and receive the world which does not die, which is then promised to them.
verses.text: Also (as for) the glory of those who have now been justified in My law, who have had understanding in their life, and who have planted in their heart the root of wisdom, then their splendour shall be glorified in changes, and the form of their face shall be turned into the light of their beauty, that they may be able to acquire and receive the world which does not die, which is then promised to them.

verses.raw: For over this above all shall those who come then lament, that they rejected My law, and stopped their ears that they might not hear wisdom or receive understanding.
verses.text: For over this above all shall those who come then lament, that they rejected My law, and stopped their ears that they might not hear wisdom or receive understanding.

verses.raw: When therefore they see those, over whom they are now exalted, (but) who shall then be exalted and glorified more than they, they shall respectively be transformed, the latter into the splendour of angels, and the former shall yet more waste away in wonder at the visions and in the beholding of the forms.
verses.text: When therefore they see those, over whom they are now exalted, (but) who shall then be exalted and glorified more than they, they shall respectively be transformed, the latter into the splendour of angels, and the former shall yet more waste away in wonder at the visions and in the beholding of the forms.

verses.raw: For they shall first behold and afterwards depart to be tormented.
verses.text: For they shall first behold and afterwards depart to be tormented.

verses.raw: But those who have been saved by their works, And to whom the law has been now a hope, And understanding an expectation, And wisdom a confidence, Shall wonders appear in their time.
verses.text: But those who have been saved by their works, And to whom the law has been now a hope, And understanding an expectation, And wisdom a confidence, Shall wonders appear in their time.

verses.raw: For they shall behold the world which is now invisible to them, And they shall behold the time which is now hidden from them:
verses.text: For they shall behold the world which is now invisible to them, And they shall behold the time which is now hidden from them:

verses.raw: And time shall no longer age them.
verses.text: And time shall no longer age them.

verses.raw: For in the heights of that world shall they dwell, And they shall be made like unto the angels, And be made equal to the stars, And they shall be changed into every form they desire, From beauty into loveliness, And from light into the splendour of glory.
verses.text: For in the heights of that world shall they dwell, And they shall be made like unto the angels, And be made equal to the stars, And they shall be changed into every form they desire, From beauty into loveliness, And from light into the splendour of glory.

verses.raw: For there shall be spread before them the extents of Paradise, and there shall be shown to them the beauty of the majesty of the living creatures which are beneath the throne, and all the armies of the angels, who [are now held fast by My word, lest they should appear, and] are held fast by a command, that they may stand in their places till their advent comes.
verses.text: For there shall be spread before them the extents of Paradise, and there shall be shown to them the beauty of the majesty of the living creatures which are beneath the throne, and all the armies of the angels, who [are now held fast by My word, lest they should appear, and] are held fast by a command, that they may stand in their places till their advent comes.

verses.raw: Moreover, there shall then be excellency in the righteous surpassing that in the angels.
verses.text: Moreover, there shall then be excellency in the righteous surpassing that in the angels.

verses.raw: For the first shall receive the last, those whom they were expecting, and the last those of whom they used to hear that they had passed away.
verses.text: For the first shall receive the last, those whom they were expecting, and the last those of whom they used to hear that they had passed away.

verses.raw: For they have been delivered from this world of tribulation, And laid down the burthen of anguish.
verses.text: For they have been delivered from this world of tribulation, And laid down the burthen of anguish.

verses.raw: For what then have men lost their life, And for what have those who were on the earth exchanged their soul?
verses.text: For what then have men lost their life, And for what have those who were on the earth exchanged their soul?

verses.raw: For then they chose (not) for themselves this time, Which, beyond the reach of anguish, could not pass away: But they chose for themselves that time, Whose issues are full of lamentations and evils, And they denied the world which ages not those who come to it, And they rejected the time of glory, So that they shall not come to the honour of which I told thee before.'
verses.text: For then they chose (not) for themselves this time, Which, beyond the reach of anguish, could not pass away: But they chose for themselves that time, Whose issues are full of lamentations and evils, And they denied the world which ages not those who come to it, And they rejected the time of glory, So that they shall not come to the honour of which I told thee before.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'How can we forget those for whom woe is then reserved?
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'How can we forget those for whom woe is then reserved?

verses.raw: And why therefore do we again mourn for those who die? Or why do we weep for those who depart to Sheol?
verses.text: And why therefore do we again mourn for those who die? Or why do we weep for those who depart to Sheol?

verses.raw: Let lamentations be reserved for the beginning of that coming torment, And let tears be laid up for the advent of the destruction of that time.
verses.text: Let lamentations be reserved for the beginning of that coming torment, And let tears be laid up for the advent of the destruction of that time.

verses.raw: [But even in the face of these things will I speak.
verses.text: [But even in the face of these things will I speak.

verses.raw: And as for the righteous, what will they do now?
verses.text: And as for the righteous, what will they do now?

verses.raw: Rejoice ye in the suffering which ye now suffer: For why do ye look for the decline of your enemies?
verses.text: Rejoice ye in the suffering which ye now suffer: For why do ye look for the decline of your enemies?

verses.raw: Make ready your soul for that which is reserved for you, And prepare your souls for the reward which is laid up for you.']
verses.text: Make ready your soul for that which is reserved for you, And prepare your souls for the reward which is laid up for you.']

verses.raw: And when I had said these things I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision, and lo! a cloud was ascending from a very great sea, and I kept gazing upon it, and lo! it was full of waters white and black, and there were many colours in those self-same waters, and as it were the likeness of great lightning was seen at its summit.
verses.text: And when I had said these things I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision, and lo! a cloud was ascending from a very great sea, and I kept gazing upon it, and lo! it was full of waters white and black, and there were many colours in those self-same waters, and as it were the likeness of great lightning was seen at its summit.

verses.raw: And I saw the cloud passing swiftly in quick courses, and it covered all the earth.
verses.text: And I saw the cloud passing swiftly in quick courses, and it covered all the earth.

verses.raw: And it came to pass after these things that that cloud began to pour upon the earth the waters that were in it.
verses.text: And it came to pass after these things that that cloud began to pour upon the earth the waters that were in it.

verses.raw: And I saw that there was not one and the same likeness in the waters which descended from it.
verses.text: And I saw that there was not one and the same likeness in the waters which descended from it.

verses.raw: For in the first beginning they were black and many for a time, and afterwards I saw that the waters became bright, but they were not many, and after these things again I saw black (waters), and after these things again bright, and again black and again bright.
verses.text: For in the first beginning they were black and many for a time, and afterwards I saw that the waters became bright, but they were not many, and after these things again I saw black (waters), and after these things again bright, and again black and again bright.

verses.raw: Now this was done twelve times, but the black were always more numerous than the bright.
verses.text: Now this was done twelve times, but the black were always more numerous than the bright.

verses.raw: And it came to pass at the end of the cloud, that lo! it rained black waters, and they were darker than had been all those waters that were before, and fire was mingled with them, and where those waters descended, they wrought devastation and destruction.
verses.text: And it came to pass at the end of the cloud, that lo! it rained black waters, and they were darker than had been all those waters that were before, and fire was mingled with them, and where those waters descended, they wrought devastation and destruction.

verses.raw: And after these things I saw how that lightning which I had seen on the summit of the cloud, seized hold of it and hurled it to the earth.
verses.text: And after these things I saw how that lightning which I had seen on the summit of the cloud, seized hold of it and hurled it to the earth.

verses.raw: Now that lightning shone exceedingly, so as to illuminate the whole earth, and it healed those regions where the last waters had descended and wrought devastation.
verses.text: Now that lightning shone exceedingly, so as to illuminate the whole earth, and it healed those regions where the last waters had descended and wrought devastation.

verses.raw: And it took hold of the whole earth, and had dominion over it.
verses.text: And it took hold of the whole earth, and had dominion over it.

verses.raw: And I saw after these things, and lo! twelve rivers were ascending from the sea, and they began to surround that lightning and to become subject to it.
verses.text: And I saw after these things, and lo! twelve rivers were ascending from the sea, and they began to surround that lightning and to become subject to it.

verses.raw: And by reason of my fear I awoke.
verses.text: And by reason of my fear I awoke.

verses.raw: And I besought the Mighty One, and said: 'Thou alone, O Yahuah (Lord), knowest of aforetime the deep things of the world, And the things which befall in their times Thou bringest about by Thy word, And against the works of the inhabitants of the earth Thou dost hasten the beginnings of the times, And the end of the seasons Thou alone knowest.
verses.text: And I besought the Mighty One, and said: 'Thou alone, O Yahuah, knowest of aforetime the deep things of the world, And the things which befall in their times Thou bringest about by Thy word, And against the works of the inhabitants of the earth Thou dost hasten the beginnings of the times, And the end of the seasons Thou alone knowest.

verses.raw: (Thou) for whom nothing is too hard, But who dost everything easily by a nod:
verses.text: (Thou) for whom nothing is too hard, But who dost everything easily by a nod:

verses.raw: (Thou) to whom the depths come as the heights, And whose word the beginnings of the ages serve:
verses.text: (Thou) to whom the depths come as the heights, And whose word the beginnings of the ages serve:

verses.raw: (Thou) who revealest to those who fear Thee what is prepared for them, That thenceforth they may be comforted.
verses.text: (Thou) who revealest to those who fear Thee what is prepared for them, That thenceforth they may be comforted.

verses.raw: Thou showest great acts to those who know not; Thou breakest up the enclosure of those who are ignorant, And lightest up what is dark, And revealest what is hidden to the pure, [Who in faith have submitted themselves to Thee and Thy law.]
verses.text: Thou showest great acts to those who know not; Thou breakest up the enclosure of those who are ignorant, And lightest up what is dark, And revealest what is hidden to the pure, [Who in faith have submitted themselves to Thee and Thy law.]

verses.raw: Thou hast shown to Thy servant this vision; Reveal to me also its interpretation.
verses.text: Thou hast shown to Thy servant this vision; Reveal to me also its interpretation.

verses.raw: For I know that as regards those things wherein I besought Thee, I have received a response, And as regards what I besought, Thou didst reveal to me with what voice I should praise Thee, And from what members I should cause praises and hallelujahs to ascend to Thee.
verses.text: For I know that as regards those things wherein I besought Thee, I have received a response, And as regards what I besought, Thou didst reveal to me with what voice I should praise Thee, And from what members I should cause praises and hallelujahs to ascend to Thee.

verses.raw: For if my members were mouths, And the hairs of my head voices, Even so I could not give Thee the meed of praise, Nor laud Thee as is befitting, Nor could I recount Thy praise, Nor tell the glory of Thy beauty.
verses.text: For if my members were mouths, And the hairs of my head voices, Even so I could not give Thee the meed of praise, Nor laud Thee as is befitting, Nor could I recount Thy praise, Nor tell the glory of Thy beauty.

verses.raw: For what am I amongst men, Or why am I reckoned amongst those who are more excellent than I, That I have heard all these marvellous things from the El Elyon (Most High), And numberless promises from Him who created me?
verses.text: For what am I amongst men, Or why am I reckoned amongst those who are more excellent than I, That I have heard all these marvellous things from the El Elyon, And numberless promises from Him who created me?

verses.raw: Blessed be my mother among those that bear, And praised among women be she that bare me.
verses.text: Blessed be my mother among those that bear, And praised among women be she that bare me.

verses.raw: For I will not be silent in praising the Mighty One, And with the voice of praise I will recount His marvellous deeds.
verses.text: For I will not be silent in praising the Mighty One, And with the voice of praise I will recount His marvellous deeds.

verses.raw: For who doeth like unto Thy marvellous deeds, O Elohim (God), Or who comprehendeth Thy deep thought [of life].
verses.text: For who doeth like unto Thy marvellous deeds, O Elohim, Or who comprehendeth Thy deep thought [of life].

verses.raw: For with Thy counsel Thou dost govern all the creatures which Thy right hand has created, And Thou hast established every fountain of light beside Thee, And the treasures of wisdom beneath Thy throne hast Thou prepared.
verses.text: For with Thy counsel Thou dost govern all the creatures which Thy right hand has created, And Thou hast established every fountain of light beside Thee, And the treasures of wisdom beneath Thy throne hast Thou prepared.

verses.raw: And justly do they perish who have not loved Thy law, And the torment of judgement shall await those who have not submitted themselves to Thy power.
verses.text: And justly do they perish who have not loved Thy law, And the torment of judgement shall await those who have not submitted themselves to Thy power.

verses.raw: For though Adam first sinned And brought untimely death upon all, Yet of those who were born from him Each one of them has prepared for his own soul torment to come, And again each one of them has chosen for himself glories to come.
verses.text: For though Adam first sinned And brought untimely death upon all, Yet of those who were born from him Each one of them has prepared for his own soul torment to come, And again each one of them has chosen for himself glories to come.

verses.raw: [For assuredly he who believeth will receive reward.
verses.text: [For assuredly he who believeth will receive reward.

verses.raw: But now, as for you, ye wicked that now are, turn ye to destruction, because ye shall speedily be visited, in that formerly ye rejected the understanding of the El Elyon (Most High).
verses.text: But now, as for you, ye wicked that now are, turn ye to destruction, because ye shall speedily be visited, in that formerly ye rejected the understanding of the El Elyon.

verses.raw: For His works have not taught you, Nor has the skill of His creation which is at all times persuaded you.]
verses.text: For His works have not taught you, Nor has the skill of His creation which is at all times persuaded you.]

verses.raw: Adam is therefore not the cause, save only of his own soul, But each of us has been the Adam of his own soul.
verses.text: Adam is therefore not the cause, save only of his own soul, But each of us has been the Adam of his own soul.

verses.raw: But do Thou, O Yahuah (Lord), expound to me regarding those things which Thou hast revealed to me, And inform me regarding that which I besought Thee.
verses.text: But do Thou, O Yahuah, expound to me regarding those things which Thou hast revealed to me, And inform me regarding that which I besought Thee.

verses.raw: For at the consummation of the world vengeance shall be taken upon those who have done wickedness according to their wickedness, And Thou wilt glorify the faithful according to their faithfulness.
verses.text: For at the consummation of the world vengeance shall be taken upon those who have done wickedness according to their wickedness, And Thou wilt glorify the faithful according to their faithfulness.

verses.raw: For those who are amongst Thine own Thou rulest, And those who sin Thou blottest out from amongst Thine own.'
verses.text: For those who are amongst Thine own Thou rulest, And those who sin Thou blottest out from amongst Thine own.'

verses.raw: And it came to pass when I had finished speaking the words of this prayer, that I sat there under a tree, that I might rest in the shade of the branches.
verses.text: And it came to pass when I had finished speaking the words of this prayer, that I sat there under a tree, that I might rest in the shade of the branches.

verses.raw: And I wondered and was astonied, and pondered in my thoughts regarding the multitude of goodness which sinners who are upon the earth have rejected, and regarding the great torment which they have despised, though they knew that they should be tormented because of the sin they had committed.
verses.text: And I wondered and was astonied, and pondered in my thoughts regarding the multitude of goodness which sinners who are upon the earth have rejected, and regarding the great torment which they have despised, though they knew that they should be tormented because of the sin they had committed.

verses.raw: And when I was pondering on these things and the like, lo! the angel Ramiel who presides over true visions was sent to me, and he said unto me:
verses.text: And when I was pondering on these things and the like, lo! the angel Ramiel who presides over true visions was sent to me, and he said unto me:

verses.raw: 'Why does thy heart trouble thee, Baruch, and why does thy thought disturb thee?
verses.text: 'Why does thy heart trouble thee, Baruch, and why does thy thought disturb thee?

verses.raw: For if owing to the report which thou hast only heard of judgement thou art so moved, What (wilt thou be) when thou shalt see it manifestly with thine eyes?
verses.text: For if owing to the report which thou hast only heard of judgement thou art so moved, What (wilt thou be) when thou shalt see it manifestly with thine eyes?

verses.raw: And if with the expectation wherewith thou dost expect the day of the Mighty One thou art so overcome, What (wilt thou be) when thou shalt come to its advent?
verses.text: And if with the expectation wherewith thou dost expect the day of the Mighty One thou art so overcome, What (wilt thou be) when thou shalt come to its advent?

verses.raw: And, if at the word of the announcement of the torment of those who have done foolishly thou art so wholly distraught, How much more when the event will reveal marvellous things?
verses.text: And, if at the word of the announcement of the torment of those who have done foolishly thou art so wholly distraught, How much more when the event will reveal marvellous things?

verses.raw: And if thou hast heard tidings of the good and evil things which are then coming and art grieved, What (wilt thou be) when thou shalt behold what the majesty will reveal, Which shall convict these and cause those to rejoice.'
verses.text: And if thou hast heard tidings of the good and evil things which are then coming and art grieved, What (wilt thou be) when thou shalt behold what the majesty will reveal, Which shall convict these and cause those to rejoice.'

verses.raw: 'Nevertheless, because thou hast besought the El Elyon (Most High) to reveal to thee the interpretation of the vision which thou hast seen, I have been sent to tell thee.
verses.text: 'Nevertheless, because thou hast besought the El Elyon to reveal to thee the interpretation of the vision which thou hast seen, I have been sent to tell thee.

verses.raw: And the Mighty One hath assuredly made known to thee the methods of the times that have passed, and of those that are destined to pass in His world from the beginning of its creation even unto its consummation, of those things which (are) deceit and of those which (are) in truth.
verses.text: And the Mighty One hath assuredly made known to thee the methods of the times that have passed, and of those that are destined to pass in His world from the beginning of its creation even unto its consummation, of those things which (are) deceit and of those which (are) in truth.

verses.raw: For as thou didst see a great cloud which ascended from the sea, and went and covered the earth, this is the duration of the world (= αἰών) which the Mighty One made when he took counsel to make the world.
verses.text: For as thou didst see a great cloud which ascended from the sea, and went and covered the earth, this is the duration of the world (= αἰών) which the Mighty One made when he took counsel to make the world.

verses.raw: And it came to pass when the word had gone forth from His presence, that the duration of the world had come into being in a small degree, and was established according to the multitude of the intelligence of Him who sent it.
verses.text: And it came to pass when the word had gone forth from His presence, that the duration of the world had come into being in a small degree, and was established according to the multitude of the intelligence of Him who sent it.

verses.raw: And as thou didst previously see on the summit of the cloud black waters which descended previously on the earth, this is the transgression wherewith Adam the first man transgressed.
verses.text: And as thou didst previously see on the summit of the cloud black waters which descended previously on the earth, this is the transgression wherewith Adam the first man transgressed.

verses.raw: For [since] when he transgressed Untimely death came into being, Grief was named And anguish was prepared, And pain was created, And trouble consummated, And disease began to be established, And Sheol kept demanding that it should be renewed in blood, And the begetting of children was brought about, And the passion of parents produced, And the greatness of humanity was humiliated, And goodness languished.
verses.text: For [since] when he transgressed Untimely death came into being, Grief was named And anguish was prepared, And pain was created, And trouble consummated, And disease began to be established, And Sheol kept demanding that it should be renewed in blood, And the begetting of children was brought about, And the passion of parents produced, And the greatness of humanity was humiliated, And goodness languished.

verses.raw: What therefore can be blacker or darker than these things?
verses.text: What therefore can be blacker or darker than these things?

verses.raw: This is the beginning of the black waters which thou hast seen.
verses.text: This is the beginning of the black waters which thou hast seen.

verses.raw: And from these black (waters) again were black derived, and the darkness of darkness was produced.
verses.text: And from these black (waters) again were black derived, and the darkness of darkness was produced.

verses.raw: For he became a danger to his own soul: even to the angels became he a danger.
verses.text: For he became a danger to his own soul: even to the angels became he a danger.

verses.raw: For, moreover, at that time when he was created, they enjoyed liberty.
verses.text: For, moreover, at that time when he was created, they enjoyed liberty.

verses.raw: And some of them descended, and mingled with the women.
verses.text: And some of them descended, and mingled with the women.

verses.raw: And then those who did so were tormented in chains.
verses.text: And then those who did so were tormented in chains.

verses.raw: But the rest of the multitude of the angels, of which there is (no) number, restrained themselves.
verses.text: But the rest of the multitude of the angels, of which there is (no) number, restrained themselves.

verses.raw: And those who dwelt on the earth perished together (with them) through the waters of the deluge.
verses.text: And those who dwelt on the earth perished together (with them) through the waters of the deluge.

verses.raw: These are the black first waters.
verses.text: These are the black first waters.

verses.raw: 'And after these (waters) thou didst see bright waters: this is the fount of Abraham, also his generations and advent of his son, and of his son's son, and of those like them.
verses.text: 'And after these (waters) thou didst see bright waters: this is the fount of Abraham, also his generations and advent of his son, and of his son's son, and of those like them.

verses.raw: Because at that time the unwritten law was named amongst them, And the works of the commandments were then fulfilled, And belief in the coming judgement was then generated, And hope of the world that was to be renewed was then built up, And the promise of the life that should come hereafter was implanted.
verses.text: Because at that time the unwritten law was named amongst them, And the works of the commandments were then fulfilled, And belief in the coming judgement was then generated, And hope of the world that was to be renewed was then built up, And the promise of the life that should come hereafter was implanted.

verses.raw: These are the bright waters, which thou hast seen.
verses.text: These are the bright waters, which thou hast seen.

verses.raw: 'And the black third waters which thou hast seen, these are the mingling of all sins, which the nations afterwards wrought after the death of those righteous men, and the wickedness of the land of Egypt, wherein they did wickedly in the service wherewith they made their sons to serve.
verses.text: 'And the black third waters which thou hast seen, these are the mingling of all sins, which the nations afterwards wrought after the death of those righteous men, and the wickedness of the land of Egypt, wherein they did wickedly in the service wherewith they made their sons to serve.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, these also perished at last.
verses.text: Nevertheless, these also perished at last.

verses.raw: 'And the bright fourth waters which thou hast seen are the advent of Moses and Aaron and Miriam and Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb and of all those like them.
verses.text: 'And the bright fourth waters which thou hast seen are the advent of Moses and Aaron and Miriam and Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb and of all those like them.

verses.raw: For at that time the lamp of the eternal law shone on all those who sat in darkness, which announced to them that believe the promise of their reward, and to them that deny, the torment of fire which is reserved for them.
verses.text: For at that time the lamp of the eternal law shone on all those who sat in darkness, which announced to them that believe the promise of their reward, and to them that deny, the torment of fire which is reserved for them.

verses.raw: But also the heavens at that time were shaken from their place, and those who were under the throne of the Mighty One were perturbed, when He was taking Moses unto Himself.
verses.text: But also the heavens at that time were shaken from their place, and those who were under the throne of the Mighty One were perturbed, when He was taking Moses unto Himself.

verses.raw: For He showed him many admonitions together with the principles of the law and the consummation of the times, as also to thee, and likewise the pattern of Zion and its measures, in the pattern of which the sanctuary of the present time was to be made.
verses.text: For He showed him many admonitions together with the principles of the law and the consummation of the times, as also to thee, and likewise the pattern of Zion and its measures, in the pattern of which the sanctuary of the present time was to be made.

verses.raw: But then also He showed to him the measures of the fire, also the depths of the abyss, and the weight of the winds, and the number of the drops of rain:
verses.text: But then also He showed to him the measures of the fire, also the depths of the abyss, and the weight of the winds, and the number of the drops of rain:

verses.raw: And the suppression of anger, and the multitude of long-suffering, and the truth of judgement:
verses.text: And the suppression of anger, and the multitude of long-suffering, and the truth of judgement:

verses.raw: And the root of wisdom, and the riches of understanding, and the fount of knowledge: And the height of the air, and the greatness of Paradise, and the consummation of the ages, and the beginning of the day of judgement:

verses.text: And the number of the offerings, and the earths which have not yet come:

verses.raw: And the likeness of future torment, and the multitude of innumerable angels, and the flaming hosts, and the splendour of the lightnings, and the voice of the thunders, and the orders of the chiefs of the angels, and the treasuries of light, and the changes of the times, and the investigations of the law.
verses.text: And the likeness of future torment, and the multitude of innumerable angels, and the flaming hosts, and the splendour of the lightnings, and the voice of the thunders, and the orders of the chiefs of the angels, and the treasuries of light, and the changes of the times, and the investigations of the law.

verses.raw: These are the bright fourth waters which thou hast seen.
verses.text: These are the bright fourth waters which thou hast seen.

verses.raw: 'And the black fifth waters which thou hast seen raining are the works which the Amorites wrought, and the spells of their incantations which they wrought, and the wickedness of their mysteries, and the mingling of their pollution.
verses.text: 'And the black fifth waters which thou hast seen raining are the works which the Amorites wrought, and the spells of their incantations which they wrought, and the wickedness of their mysteries, and the mingling of their pollution.

verses.raw: But even Yashar'el (Israel) was then polluted by sins in the days of the judges, though they saw many signs which were from Him who made them.
verses.text: But even Yashar'el was then polluted by sins in the days of the judges, though they saw many signs which were from Him who made them.

verses.raw: 'And the bright sixth waters which thou didst see, this is the time in which David and Solomon were born.
verses.text: 'And the bright sixth waters which thou didst see, this is the time in which David and Solomon were born.

verses.raw: And there was at that time the building of Zion, And the dedication of the sanctuary, And the shedding of much blood of the nations that sinned then, And many offerings which were offered then in the dedication of the sanctuary.
verses.text: And there was at that time the building of Zion, And the dedication of the sanctuary, And the shedding of much blood of the nations that sinned then, And many offerings which were offered then in the dedication of the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And peace and tranquillity existed at that time,
verses.text: And peace and tranquillity existed at that time,

verses.raw: And wisdom was heard in the assembly: And the riches of understanding were magnified in the congregations,
verses.text: And wisdom was heard in the assembly: And the riches of understanding were magnified in the congregations,

verses.raw: And the holy festivals were fulfilled in blessedness and in much joy.
verses.text: And the holy festivals were fulfilled in blessedness and in much joy.

verses.raw: And the judgement of the rulers was then seen to be without guile, And the righteousness of the precepts of the Mighty One was accomplished with truth.
verses.text: And the judgement of the rulers was then seen to be without guile, And the righteousness of the precepts of the Mighty One was accomplished with truth.

verses.raw: And the land [which] was then beloved by Yahuah (Lord), And because its inhabitants sinned not, it was glorified beyond all lands, And the city Zion ruled then over all lands and regions.
verses.text: And the land [which] was then beloved by Yahuah, And because its inhabitants sinned not, it was glorified beyond all lands, And the city Zion ruled then over all lands and regions.

verses.text: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.

verses.text: 'And the black seventh waters which thou hast seen, this is the perversion (brought about) by the counsel of Jeroboam, who took counsel to make two calves of gold:

verses.raw: And all the iniquities which kings who were after him iniquitously wrought.
verses.text: And all the iniquities which kings who were after him iniquitously wrought.

verses.text: And the curse of Jezebel and the worship of idols which Yashar'el practised at that time.

verses.text: And the time of their captivity which came upon the nine tribes and a half, because they were in many sins.

verses.text: And Salmanasar king of Assyria came and led them away captive.

verses.raw: 'And the bright eighth waters which thou hast seen, this is the rectitude and uprightness of Hezekiah king of Yahudah (Judah) and the grace (of God) which came upon him.
verses.text: 'And the bright eighth waters which thou hast seen, this is the rectitude and uprightness of Hezekiah king of Yahudah and the grace (of God) which came upon him.

verses.raw: For when Sennacherib was stirred up in order that he might perish, and his wrath troubled him in order that he might thereby perish, for the multitude also of the nations which were with him.
verses.text: For when Sennacherib was stirred up in order that he might perish, and his wrath troubled him in order that he might thereby perish, for the multitude also of the nations which were with him.

verses.raw: When, moreover, Hezekiah the king heard those things which the king of Assyria was devising, (i.e.) to come and seize him and destroy his people, the two and a half tribes which remained: nay, more he wished to overthrow Zion also: then Hezekiah trusted in his works, and had hope in his righteousness, and spake with the Mighty One and said:
verses.text: When, moreover, Hezekiah the king heard those things which the king of Assyria was devising, (i.e.) to come and seize him and destroy his people, the two and a half tribes which remained: nay, more he wished to overthrow Zion also: then Hezekiah trusted in his works, and had hope in his righteousness, and spake with the Mighty One and said:

verses.raw: "Behold, for lo! Sennacherib is prepared to destroy us, and he will be boastful and uplifted when he has destroyed Zion."
verses.text: "Behold, for lo! Sennacherib is prepared to destroy us, and he will be boastful and uplifted when he has destroyed Zion."

verses.raw: And the Mighty One heard him, for Hezekiah was wise, And He had respect unto his prayer, because he was righteous.
verses.text: And the Mighty One heard him, for Hezekiah was wise, And He had respect unto his prayer, because he was righteous.

verses.raw: And thereupon the Mighty One commanded Ramiel His angel who speaks with thee.
verses.text: And thereupon the Mighty One commanded Ramiel His angel who speaks with thee.

verses.raw: And I went forth and destroyed their multitude, the number of whose chiefs only was a hundred and eighty-five thousand, and each one of them had an equal number (at his command).
verses.text: And I went forth and destroyed their multitude, the number of whose chiefs only was a hundred and eighty-five thousand, and each one of them had an equal number (at his command).

verses.raw: And at that time I burned their bodies within, but their raiment and arms I preserved outwardly, in order that the still more wonderful deeds of the Mighty One might appear, and that thereby His name might be spoken of throughout the whole earth.
verses.text: And at that time I burned their bodies within, but their raiment and arms I preserved outwardly, in order that the still more wonderful deeds of the Mighty One might appear, and that thereby His name might be spoken of throughout the whole earth.

verses.raw: And Zion was saved and Jerusalem delivered: Yashar'el (Israel) also was freed from tribulation.
verses.text: And Zion was saved and Jerusalem delivered: Yashar'el also was freed from tribulation.

verses.raw: And all those who were in the holy land rejoiced, and the name of the Mighty One was glorified so that it was spoken of.
verses.text: And all those who were in the holy land rejoiced, and the name of the Mighty One was glorified so that it was spoken of.

verses.raw: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.
verses.text: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.

verses.raw: 'And the black ninth waters which thou hast seen, this is all the wickedness which was in the days of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah.
verses.text: 'And the black ninth waters which thou hast seen, this is all the wickedness which was in the days of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah.

verses.raw: For he wrought much impiety, and he slew the righteous, and he wrested judgement, and he shed the blood of the innocent, and wedded women he violently polluted, and he overturned the altars, and destroyed their offerings, and drove forth their priests lest they should minister in the sanctuary.
verses.text: For he wrought much impiety, and he slew the righteous, and he wrested judgement, and he shed the blood of the innocent, and wedded women he violently polluted, and he overturned the altars, and destroyed their offerings, and drove forth their priests lest they should minister in the sanctuary.

verses.raw: And he made an image with five faces: four of them looked to the four winds, and the fifth on the summit of the image as an adversary of the zeal of the Mighty One.
verses.text: And he made an image with five faces: four of them looked to the four winds, and the fifth on the summit of the image as an adversary of the zeal of the Mighty One.

verses.raw: And then wrath went forth from the presence of the Mighty One to the intent that Zion should be rooted out, as also it befell in your days.
verses.text: And then wrath went forth from the presence of the Mighty One to the intent that Zion should be rooted out, as also it befell in your days.

verses.raw: But also against the two tribes and a half went forth a decree that they should also be led away captive, as thou hast now seen.
verses.text: But also against the two tribes and a half went forth a decree that they should also be led away captive, as thou hast now seen.

verses.raw: And to such a degree did the impiety of Manasseh increase, that it removed the praise of the El Elyon (Most High) from the sanctuary.
verses.text: And to such a degree did the impiety of Manasseh increase, that it removed the praise of the El Elyon from the sanctuary.

verses.raw: On this account Manasseh was at that time named "the impious", and finally his abode was in the fire.
verses.text: On this account Manasseh was at that time named "the impious", and finally his abode was in the fire.

verses.raw: For though his prayer was heard with the El Elyon (Most High), finally, when he was cast into the brazen horse and the brazen horse was melted, it served as a sign unto him for the hour.
verses.text: For though his prayer was heard with the El Elyon, finally, when he was cast into the brazen horse and the brazen horse was melted, it served as a sign unto him for the hour.

verses.raw: For he had not lived perfectly, for he was not worthy—but that thenceforward he might know by whom finally he should be tormented.
verses.text: For he had not lived perfectly, for he was not worthy—but that thenceforward he might know by whom finally he should be tormented.

verses.raw: For he who is able to benefit is also able to torment.
verses.text: For he who is able to benefit is also able to torment.

verses.raw: 'Thus, moreover, did Manasseh act impiously, and thought that in his time the Mighty One would not inquire into these things.
verses.text: 'Thus, moreover, did Manasseh act impiously, and thought that in his time the Mighty One would not inquire into these things.

verses.raw: These are the black ninth waters which thou hast seen.
verses.text: These are the black ninth waters which thou hast seen.

verses.raw: 'And the bright tenth waters which thou hast seen: this is the purity of the generations of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), who was the only one at the time who submitted himself to the Mighty One with all his heart and with all his soul.
verses.text: 'And the bright tenth waters which thou hast seen: this is the purity of the generations of Josiah king of Yahudah, who was the only one at the time who submitted himself to the Mighty One with all his heart and with all his soul.

verses.raw: And he cleansed the land from idols, and hallowed all the vessels which had been polluted, and restored the offerings to the altar, and raised the horn of the holy, and exalted the righteous, and honoured all that were wise in understanding, and brought back the priests to their ministry, and destroyed and removed the magicians and enchanters and necromancers from the land.
verses.text: And he cleansed the land from idols, and hallowed all the vessels which had been polluted, and restored the offerings to the altar, and raised the horn of the holy, and exalted the righteous, and honoured all that were wise in understanding, and brought back the priests to their ministry, and destroyed and removed the magicians and enchanters and necromancers from the land.

verses.raw: And not only did he slay the impious that were living, but they also took from the sepulchres the bones of the dead and burned them with fire.
verses.text: And not only did he slay the impious that were living, but they also took from the sepulchres the bones of the dead and burned them with fire.

verses.raw: [And the festivals and the sabbaths he established in their sanctity], and their polluted ones he burnt in the fire, and the lying prophets which deceived the people, these also he burnt in the fire, and the people who listened to them when they were living, he cast them into the brook Cedron, and heaped stones upon them.
verses.text: [And the festivals and the sabbaths he established in their sanctity], and their polluted ones he burnt in the fire, and the lying prophets which deceived the people, these also he burnt in the fire, and the people who listened to them when they were living, he cast them into the brook Cedron, and heaped stones upon them.
