verses.raw: And he was zealous with zeal for the Mighty One with all his soul, and he alone was firm in the law at that time, so that he left none that was uncircumcised, or that wrought impiety in all the land, all the days of his life.
verses.text: And he was zealous with zeal for the Mighty One with all his soul, and he alone was firm in the law at that time, so that he left none that was uncircumcised, or that wrought impiety in all the land, all the days of his life.

verses.raw: Therefore he shall receive an eternal reward, and he shall be glorified with the Mighty One beyond many at a later time.
verses.text: Therefore he shall receive an eternal reward, and he shall be glorified with the Mighty One beyond many at a later time.

verses.raw: For on his account and on account of those who are like him were the honourable glories, of which thou wast told before, created and prepared.
verses.text: For on his account and on account of those who are like him were the honourable glories, of which thou wast told before, created and prepared.

verses.raw: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.
verses.text: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.

verses.raw: 'And the black eleventh waters which thou hast seen: this is the calamity which is now befalling Zion.
verses.text: 'And the black eleventh waters which thou hast seen: this is the calamity which is now befalling Zion.

verses.raw: Dost thou think that there is no anguish to the angels in the presence of the Mighty One, That Zion was so delivered up, And that lo! the Gentiles boast in their hearts, And assemble before their idols and say, "She is trodden down who ofttimes trod down, And she has been reduced to servitude who reduced (others)"?
verses.text: Dost thou think that there is no anguish to the angels in the presence of the Mighty One, That Zion was so delivered up, And that lo! the Gentiles boast in their hearts, And assemble before their idols and say, "She is trodden down who ofttimes trod down, And she has been reduced to servitude who reduced (others)"?

verses.raw: Dost thou think that in these things the El Elyon (Most High) rejoices, Or that His name is glorified?
verses.text: Dost thou think that in these things the El Elyon rejoices, Or that His name is glorified?

verses.raw: [But how will it serve towards His righteous judgement?]
verses.text: [But how will it serve towards His righteous judgement?]

verses.raw: Yet after these things shall the dispersed among the Gentiles be taken hold of by tribulation, And in shame shall they dwell in every place.
verses.text: Yet after these things shall the dispersed among the Gentiles be taken hold of by tribulation, And in shame shall they dwell in every place.

verses.raw: Because so far as Zion is delivered up And Jerusalem laid waste, Shall idols prosper in the cities of the Gentiles, And the vapour of the smoke of the incense of the righteousness which is by the law is extinguished in Zion, And in the region of Zion in every place lo! there is the smoke of impiety.
verses.text: Because so far as Zion is delivered up And Jerusalem laid waste, Shall idols prosper in the cities of the Gentiles, And the vapour of the smoke of the incense of the righteousness which is by the law is extinguished in Zion, And in the region of Zion in every place lo! there is the smoke of impiety.

verses.raw: But the king of Babylon will arise who has now destroyed Zion, And he will boast over the people, And he will speak great things in his heart in the presence of the El Elyon (Most High).
verses.text: But the king of Babylon will arise who has now destroyed Zion, And he will boast over the people, And he will speak great things in his heart in the presence of the El Elyon.

verses.raw: But he also shall fall at last. These are the black waters.
verses.text: But he also shall fall at last. These are the black waters.

verses.raw: 'And the bright twelfth waters which thou hast seen: this is the word.
verses.text: 'And the bright twelfth waters which thou hast seen: this is the word.

verses.raw: For after these things a time will come when thy people shall fall into distress, so that they shall all run the risk of perishing together.
verses.text: For after these things a time will come when thy people shall fall into distress, so that they shall all run the risk of perishing together.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, they will be saved, and their enemies will fall in their presence.
verses.text: Nevertheless, they will be saved, and their enemies will fall in their presence.

verses.raw: And they will have in (due) time much joy.
verses.text: And they will have in (due) time much joy.

verses.raw: And at that time after a little interval Zion will again be builded, and its offerings will again be restored, and the priests will return to their ministry, and also the Gentiles will come to glorify it.
verses.text: And at that time after a little interval Zion will again be builded, and its offerings will again be restored, and the priests will return to their ministry, and also the Gentiles will come to glorify it.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, not fully as in the beginning.
verses.text: Nevertheless, not fully as in the beginning.

verses.raw: But it will come to pass after these things that there will be the fall of many nations.
verses.text: But it will come to pass after these things that there will be the fall of many nations.

verses.raw: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.
verses.text: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.

verses.raw: 'For the last waters which thou hast seen which were darker than all that were before them, those which were after the twelfth number, which were collected together, belong to the whole world.
verses.text: 'For the last waters which thou hast seen which were darker than all that were before them, those which were after the twelfth number, which were collected together, belong to the whole world.

verses.raw: For the El Elyon (Most High) made division from the beginning, because He alone knows what will befall.
verses.text: For the El Elyon made division from the beginning, because He alone knows what will befall.

verses.raw: For as to the enormities and the impieties which should be wrought before Him, He foresaw six kinds of them.
verses.text: For as to the enormities and the impieties which should be wrought before Him, He foresaw six kinds of them.

verses.raw: And of the good works of the righteous which should be accomplished before Him, He foresaw six kinds of them, beyond those which He should work at the consummation of the age.
verses.text: And of the good works of the righteous which should be accomplished before Him, He foresaw six kinds of them, beyond those which He should work at the consummation of the age.

verses.raw: On his account there were not black waters with black, nor bright with bright; for it is the consummation.
verses.text: On his account there were not black waters with black, nor bright with bright; for it is the consummation.

verses.raw: 'Hear therefore the interpretation of the last black waters which are to come [after the black]: this is the word.
verses.text: 'Hear therefore the interpretation of the last black waters which are to come [after the black]: this is the word.

verses.raw: Behold! the days come, and it shall be when the time of the age has ripened, And the harvest of its evil and good seeds has come, That the Mighty One will bring upon the earth and its inhabitants and upon its rulers Perturbation of spirit and stupor of heart.
verses.text: Behold! the days come, and it shall be when the time of the age has ripened, And the harvest of its evil and good seeds has come, That the Mighty One will bring upon the earth and its inhabitants and upon its rulers Perturbation of spirit and stupor of heart.

verses.raw: And they shall hate one another, And provoke one another to fight, And the mean shall rule over the honourable, And those of low degree shall be extolled above the famous.
verses.text: And they shall hate one another, And provoke one another to fight, And the mean shall rule over the honourable, And those of low degree shall be extolled above the famous.

verses.raw: And the many shall be delivered into the hands of the few, And those who were nothing shall rule over the strong, And the poor shall have abundance beyond the rich, And the impious shall exalt themselves above the heroic.
verses.text: And the many shall be delivered into the hands of the few, And those who were nothing shall rule over the strong, And the poor shall have abundance beyond the rich, And the impious shall exalt themselves above the heroic.

verses.raw: And the wise shall be silent, And the foolish shall speak, Neither shall the thought of men be then confirmed, Nor the counsel of the mighty, Nor shall the hope of those who hope be confirmed.
verses.text: And the wise shall be silent, And the foolish shall speak, Neither shall the thought of men be then confirmed, Nor the counsel of the mighty, Nor shall the hope of those who hope be confirmed.

verses.raw: And when those things which were predicted have come to pass, Then shall confusion fall upon all men, And some of them shall fall in battle, And some of them shall perish in anguish,
verses.text: And when those things which were predicted have come to pass, Then shall confusion fall upon all men, And some of them shall fall in battle, And some of them shall perish in anguish,

verses.raw: And some of them shall be destroyed by their own. Then the El Elyon (Most High) will reveal those peoples whom He has prepared before, And they shall come and make war with the leaders that shall then be left.
verses.text: And some of them shall be destroyed by their own. Then the El Elyon will reveal those peoples whom He has prepared before, And they shall come and make war with the leaders that shall then be left.

verses.raw: And it shall come to pass that whosoever gets safe out of the war shall die in the earthquake, And whosoever gets safe out of the earthquake shall be burned by the fire, And whosoever gets safe out of the fire shall be destroyed by famine.
verses.text: And it shall come to pass that whosoever gets safe out of the war shall die in the earthquake, And whosoever gets safe out of the earthquake shall be burned by the fire, And whosoever gets safe out of the fire shall be destroyed by famine.

verses.raw: [And it shall come to pass that whosoever of the victors and the vanquished gets safe out of and escapes all these things aforesaid will be delivered into the hands of My servant Messiah.]
verses.text: [And it shall come to pass that whosoever of the victors and the vanquished gets safe out of and escapes all these things aforesaid will be delivered into the hands of My servant Messiah.]

verses.raw: For all the earth shall devour its inhabitants.
verses.text: For all the earth shall devour its inhabitants.

verses.raw: 'And the holy land shall have mercy on its own, And it shall protect its inhabiters at that time.
verses.text: 'And the holy land shall have mercy on its own, And it shall protect its inhabiters at that time.

verses.raw: This is the vision which thou hast seen, and this is the interpretation.
verses.text: This is the vision which thou hast seen, and this is the interpretation.

verses.raw: For I have come to tell thee these things, because thy prayer has been heard with the El Elyon (Most High).
verses.text: For I have come to tell thee these things, because thy prayer has been heard with the El Elyon.

verses.raw: 'Hear now also regarding the bright lightning which is to come at the consummation after these black (waters): this is the word.
verses.text: 'Hear now also regarding the bright lightning which is to come at the consummation after these black (waters): this is the word.

verses.raw: After the signs have come, of which thou wast told before, when the nations become turbulent, and the time of My Messiah is come, he shall both summon all the nations, and some of them he shall spare, and some of them he shall slay.
verses.text: After the signs have come, of which thou wast told before, when the nations become turbulent, and the time of My Messiah is come, he shall both summon all the nations, and some of them he shall spare, and some of them he shall slay.

verses.raw: These things therefore shall come upon the nations which are to be spared by Him.
verses.text: These things therefore shall come upon the nations which are to be spared by Him.

verses.raw: Every nation, which knows not Yashar'el (Israel) and has not trodden down the seed of Jacob, shall indeed be spared.
verses.text: Every nation, which knows not Yashar'el and has not trodden down the seed of Jacob, shall indeed be spared.

verses.raw: And this because some out of every nation shall be subjected to thy people.
verses.text: And this because some out of every nation shall be subjected to thy people.

verses.raw: But all those who have ruled over you, or have known you, shall be given up to the sword.
verses.text: But all those who have ruled over you, or have known you, shall be given up to the sword.

verses.raw: 'And it shall come to pass, when He has brought low everything that is in the world, And has sat down in peace for the age on the throne of His kingdom, That joy shall then be revealed, And rest shall appear.
verses.text: 'And it shall come to pass, when He has brought low everything that is in the world, And has sat down in peace for the age on the throne of His kingdom, That joy shall then be revealed, And rest shall appear.

verses.raw: And then healing shall descend in dew, And disease shall withdraw, And anxiety and anguish and lamentation pass from amongst men, And gladness proceed through the whole earth.
verses.text: And then healing shall descend in dew, And disease shall withdraw, And anxiety and anguish and lamentation pass from amongst men, And gladness proceed through the whole earth.

verses.raw: And no one shall again die untimely, Nor shall any adversity suddenly befall.
verses.text: And no one shall again die untimely, Nor shall any adversity suddenly befall.

verses.raw: And judgements, and revilings, and contentions, and revenges, And blood, and passions, and envy, and hatred, And whatsoever things are like these shall go into condemnation when they are removed.
verses.text: And judgements, and revilings, and contentions, and revenges, And blood, and passions, and envy, and hatred, And whatsoever things are like these shall go into condemnation when they are removed.

verses.raw: For it is these very things which have filled this world with evils, And on account of these the life of man has been greatly troubled.
verses.text: For it is these very things which have filled this world with evils, And on account of these the life of man has been greatly troubled.

verses.raw: And wild beasts shall come from the forest and minister unto men, And asps and dragons shall come forth from their holes to submit themselves to a little child.
verses.text: And wild beasts shall come from the forest and minister unto men, And asps and dragons shall come forth from their holes to submit themselves to a little child.

verses.raw: And women shall no longer then have pain when they bear, Nor shall they suffer torment when they yield the fruit of the womb.
verses.text: And women shall no longer then have pain when they bear, Nor shall they suffer torment when they yield the fruit of the womb.

verses.raw: 'And it shall come to pass in those days that the reapers shall not grow weary, Nor those that build be toilworn; For the works shall of themselves speedily advance Together with those who do them in much tranquillity.
verses.text: 'And it shall come to pass in those days that the reapers shall not grow weary, Nor those that build be toilworn; For the works shall of themselves speedily advance Together with those who do them in much tranquillity.

verses.raw: For that time is the consummation of that which is corruptible, And the beginning of that which is not corruptible.
verses.text: For that time is the consummation of that which is corruptible, And the beginning of that which is not corruptible.

verses.raw: Therefore those things which were predicted shall belong to it: Therefore it is far away from evils, and near to those things which die not.
verses.text: Therefore those things which were predicted shall belong to it: Therefore it is far away from evils, and near to those things which die not.

verses.raw: This is the bright lightning which came after the last dark waters.'
verses.text: This is the bright lightning which came after the last dark waters.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said: 'Who can understand, O Yahuah (Lord), Thy goodness? For it is incomprehensible.
verses.text: And I answered and said: 'Who can understand, O Yahuah, Thy goodness? For it is incomprehensible.

verses.raw: Or who can search into thy compassions, Which are infinite?
verses.text: Or who can search into thy compassions, Which are infinite?

verses.raw: Or who can comprehend Thy intelligence?
verses.text: Or who can comprehend Thy intelligence?

verses.raw: Or who is able to recount the thoughts of Thy mind?
verses.text: Or who is able to recount the thoughts of Thy mind?

verses.raw: Or who of those who are born can hope to come to those things, Unless he is one to whom Thou art merciful and gracious?
verses.text: Or who of those who are born can hope to come to those things, Unless he is one to whom Thou art merciful and gracious?

verses.raw: Because, if assuredly Thou didst not have compassion on man, Those who are under Thy right hand, They could not come to those things, But those who are in the numbers named can be called.
verses.text: Because, if assuredly Thou didst not have compassion on man, Those who are under Thy right hand, They could not come to those things, But those who are in the numbers named can be called.

verses.raw: But if, indeed, we who exist know wherefore we have come, And submit ourselves to Him who brought us out of Egypt, We shall come again and remember those things which have passed, And shall rejoice regarding that which has been.
verses.text: But if, indeed, we who exist know wherefore we have come, And submit ourselves to Him who brought us out of Egypt, We shall come again and remember those things which have passed, And shall rejoice regarding that which has been.

verses.raw: But if now we know not wherefore we have come, And recognize not the principate of Him who brought us up out of Egypt, We shall come again and seek after those things which have been now, And be grieved with pain because of those things which have befallen.'
verses.text: But if now we know not wherefore we have come, And recognize not the principate of Him who brought us up out of Egypt, We shall come again and seek after those things which have been now, And be grieved with pain because of those things which have befallen.'

verses.raw: And He answered and said unto me: ['Inasmuch as the revelation of this vision has been interpreted to thee as thou besoughtest], hear the word of the El Elyon (Most High) that thou mayst know what is to befall thee after these things.
verses.text: And He answered and said unto me: ['Inasmuch as the revelation of this vision has been interpreted to thee as thou besoughtest], hear the word of the El Elyon that thou mayst know what is to befall thee after these things.

verses.raw: For thou shalt surely depart from this earth, nevertheless not unto death, but thou shalt be preserved unto the consummation of the times.
verses.text: For thou shalt surely depart from this earth, nevertheless not unto death, but thou shalt be preserved unto the consummation of the times.

verses.raw: Go up therefore to the top of that mountain, and there shall pass before thee all the regions of that land, and the figure of the inhabited world, and the top(s) of the mountains, and the depth(s) of the valleys, and the depths of the seas, and the number of the rivers, that thou mayst see what thou art leaving, and whither thou art going.
verses.text: Go up therefore to the top of that mountain, and there shall pass before thee all the regions of that land, and the figure of the inhabited world, and the top(s) of the mountains, and the depth(s) of the valleys, and the depths of the seas, and the number of the rivers, that thou mayst see what thou art leaving, and whither thou art going.

verses.raw: Now this shall befall after forty days. Go now therefore during these days and instruct the people so far as thou art able, that they may learn so as not to die at the last time, but may learn in order that they may live at the last times.'
verses.text: Now this shall befall after forty days. Go now therefore during these days and instruct the people so far as thou art able, that they may learn so as not to die at the last time, but may learn in order that they may live at the last times.'

verses.raw: And I, Baruch, went thence and came to the people, and assembled them together from the greatest to the least, and said unto them:
verses.text: And I, Baruch, went thence and came to the people, and assembled them together from the greatest to the least, and said unto them:

verses.raw: 'Hear, ye children of Yashar'el (Israel), behold how many ye are who remain of the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: 'Hear, ye children of Yashar'el, behold how many ye are who remain of the twelve tribes of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: For to you and to your fathers Yahuah (Lord) gave a law more excellent than to all peoples.
verses.text: For to you and to your fathers Yahuah gave a law more excellent than to all peoples.

verses.raw: And because your brethren transgressed the commandments of the El Elyon (Most High), He brought vengeance upon you and upon them, And He spared not the former, And the latter also He gave into captivity: And He left not a residue of them, But behold! ye are here with me.
verses.text: And because your brethren transgressed the commandments of the El Elyon, He brought vengeance upon you and upon them, And He spared not the former, And the latter also He gave into captivity: And He left not a residue of them, But behold! ye are here with me.

verses.raw: If, therefore, ye direct your ways aright, Ye also shall not depart as your brethren departed, But they shall come to you.
verses.text: If, therefore, ye direct your ways aright, Ye also shall not depart as your brethren departed, But they shall come to you.

verses.raw: For He is merciful whom ye worship, And He is gracious in whom ye hope, And He is true, so that He shall do good and not evil.
verses.text: For He is merciful whom ye worship, And He is gracious in whom ye hope, And He is true, so that He shall do good and not evil.

verses.raw: Have ye not seen here what has befallen Zion?
verses.text: Have ye not seen here what has befallen Zion?

verses.raw: Or do ye perchance think that the place had sinned, And that on this account it was overthrown? Or that the land had wrought foolishness, And that therefore it was delivered up?
verses.text: Or do ye perchance think that the place had sinned, And that on this account it was overthrown? Or that the land had wrought foolishness, And that therefore it was delivered up?

verses.raw: And know ye not that on account of you who did sin, That which sinned not was overthrown, And, on account of those who wrought wickedly, That which wrought not foolishness was delivered up to (its) enemies?'
verses.text: And know ye not that on account of you who did sin, That which sinned not was overthrown, And, on account of those who wrought wickedly, That which wrought not foolishness was delivered up to (its) enemies?'

verses.raw: And the whole people answered and said unto me: 'So far as we can recall the good things which the Mighty One has done unto us, we do recall them; and those things which we do not remember He in His mercy knows.
verses.text: And the whole people answered and said unto me: 'So far as we can recall the good things which the Mighty One has done unto us, we do recall them; and those things which we do not remember He in His mercy knows.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, do this for us thy people: write also to our brethren in Babylon an epistle of doctrine and a scroll of hope, that thou mayst confirm them also before thou dost depart from us.
verses.text: Nevertheless, do this for us thy people: write also to our brethren in Babylon an epistle of doctrine and a scroll of hope, that thou mayst confirm them also before thou dost depart from us.

verses.raw: For the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) have perished, And the lamps which gave light are extinguished, And the fountains have withheld their stream whence we used to drink.
verses.text: For the shepherds of Yashar'el have perished, And the lamps which gave light are extinguished, And the fountains have withheld their stream whence we used to drink.

verses.raw: And we are left in the darkness, And amid the [trees of the forest], And the thirst of the wilderness.'
verses.text: And we are left in the darkness, And amid the [trees of the forest], And the thirst of the wilderness.'

verses.raw: And I answered and said unto them: 'Shepherds and lamps and fountains come from the law: And though we depart, yet the law abideth.
verses.text: And I answered and said unto them: 'Shepherds and lamps and fountains come from the law: And though we depart, yet the law abideth.

verses.raw: If therefore ye have respect to the law, And are intent upon wisdom, A lamp will not be wanting, And a shepherd will not fail, And a fountain will not dry up.
verses.text: If therefore ye have respect to the law, And are intent upon wisdom, A lamp will not be wanting, And a shepherd will not fail, And a fountain will not dry up.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, as ye said unto me, I will write also unto your brethren in Babylon, and I will send by means of men, and I will write in like manner to the nine tribes and a half, and send by means of a bird.'
verses.text: Nevertheless, as ye said unto me, I will write also unto your brethren in Babylon, and I will send by means of men, and I will write in like manner to the nine tribes and a half, and send by means of a bird.'

verses.raw: And it came to pass on the one and twentieth day in the eighth month that I, Baruch, came and sat down under the oak under the shadow of the branches, and no man was with me, but I was alone.
verses.text: And it came to pass on the one and twentieth day in the eighth month that I, Baruch, came and sat down under the oak under the shadow of the branches, and no man was with me, but I was alone.

verses.raw: And I wrote these two epistles: one I sent by an eagle to the nine and a half tribes; and the other I sent to those that were at Babylon by means of three men.
verses.text: And I wrote these two epistles: one I sent by an eagle to the nine and a half tribes; and the other I sent to those that were at Babylon by means of three men.

verses.raw: And I called the eagle and spake these words unto it:
verses.text: And I called the eagle and spake these words unto it:

verses.raw: 'The El Elyon (Most High) hath made thee that thou shouldst be higher than all birds.
verses.text: 'The El Elyon hath made thee that thou shouldst be higher than all birds.

verses.raw: And now go and tarry not in (any) place, nor enter a nest, nor settle upon any tree, till thou hast passed over the breadth of the many waters of the river Euphrates, and hast gone to the people that dwell there, and cast down to them this epistle.
verses.text: And now go and tarry not in (any) place, nor enter a nest, nor settle upon any tree, till thou hast passed over the breadth of the many waters of the river Euphrates, and hast gone to the people that dwell there, and cast down to them this epistle.

verses.raw: Remember, moreover, that, at the time of the deluge, Noah received from a dove the fruit of the olive, when he sent it forth from the ark.
verses.text: Remember, moreover, that, at the time of the deluge, Noah received from a dove the fruit of the olive, when he sent it forth from the ark.

verses.raw: Yea, also the ravens ministered to Elijah, bearing him food, as they had been commanded.
verses.text: Yea, also the ravens ministered to Elijah, bearing him food, as they had been commanded.

verses.raw: Solomon also, in the time of his kingdom, whithersoever he wished to send or seek for anything, commanded a bird (to go thither), and it obeyed him as he commanded it.
verses.text: Solomon also, in the time of his kingdom, whithersoever he wished to send or seek for anything, commanded a bird (to go thither), and it obeyed him as he commanded it.

verses.raw: And now let it not weary thee, and turn not to the right hand nor the left, but fly and go by a direct way, that thou mayst preserve the command of the Mighty One, according as I said unto thee.'
verses.text: And now let it not weary thee, and turn not to the right hand nor the left, but fly and go by a direct way, that thou mayst preserve the command of the Mighty One, according as I said unto thee.'

verses.raw: These are the words of that epistle which Baruch the son of Neriah sent to the nine and a half tribes, which were across the river Euphrates, in which these things were written.
verses.text: These are the words of that epistle which Baruch the son of Neriah sent to the nine and a half tribes, which were across the river Euphrates, in which these things were written.

verses.raw: Thus saith Baruch the son of Neriah to the brethren carried into captivity: 'Mercy and peace. I bear in mind, my brethren, the love of Him who created us, who loved us from of old, and never hated us, but above all educated us.
verses.text: Thus saith Baruch the son of Neriah to the brethren carried into captivity: 'Mercy and peace. I bear in mind, my brethren, the love of Him who created us, who loved us from of old, and never hated us, but above all educated us.

verses.raw: And truly I know that behold all we the twelve tribes are bound by one bond, inasmuch as we are born from one father.
verses.text: And truly I know that behold all we the twelve tribes are bound by one bond, inasmuch as we are born from one father.

verses.raw: Wherefore I have been the more careful to leave you the words of this epistle before I die, that ye may be comforted regarding the evils which have come upon you, and that ye may be grieved also regarding the evil that has befallen your brethren; and again, also, that ye may justify His judgement which He has decreed against you that ye should be carried away captive—for what ye have suffered is disproportioned to what ye have done—in order
verses.text: Wherefore I have been the more careful to leave you the words of this epistle before I die, that ye may be comforted regarding the evils which have come upon you, and that ye may be grieved also regarding the evil that has befallen your brethren; and again, also, that ye may justify His judgement which He has decreed against you that ye should be carried away captive—for what ye have suffered is disproportioned to what ye have done—in order

verses.raw: that, at the last times, ye may be found worthy of your fathers.
verses.text: that, at the last times, ye may be found worthy of your fathers.

verses.raw: Therefore, if ye consider that ye have now suffered those things for your good, that ye may not finally be condemned and tormented, then ye will receive eternal hope; if above all ye destroy from your heart vain error, on account of which ye departed hence.
verses.text: Therefore, if ye consider that ye have now suffered those things for your good, that ye may not finally be condemned and tormented, then ye will receive eternal hope; if above all ye destroy from your heart vain error, on account of which ye departed hence.

verses.raw: For if ye so do these things, He will continually remember you, He who always promised on our behalf to those who were more excellent than we, that He will never forget or forsake us, but with much mercy will gather together again those who were dispersed.
verses.text: For if ye so do these things, He will continually remember you, He who always promised on our behalf to those who were more excellent than we, that He will never forget or forsake us, but with much mercy will gather together again those who were dispersed.

verses.raw: Now, my brethren, learn first what befell Zion: how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against us.
verses.text: Now, my brethren, learn first what befell Zion: how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against us.

verses.raw: For we have sinned against Him who made us, and we have not kept the commandments which he commanded us, yet he hath not chastened us as we deserved.
verses.text: For we have sinned against Him who made us, and we have not kept the commandments which he commanded us, yet he hath not chastened us as we deserved.

verses.raw: For what befell you we also suffer in a pre-eminent degree, for it befell us also.
verses.text: For what befell you we also suffer in a pre-eminent degree, for it befell us also.

verses.raw: And now, my brethren, I make known unto you that when the enemy had surrounded the city, the angels of the El Elyon (Most High) were sent, and they overthrew the fortifications of the strong wall, and they destroyed the firm iron corners, which could not be rooted out.
verses.text: And now, my brethren, I make known unto you that when the enemy had surrounded the city, the angels of the El Elyon were sent, and they overthrew the fortifications of the strong wall, and they destroyed the firm iron corners, which could not be rooted out.

verses.raw: Nevertheless, they hid all the vessels of the sanctuary, lest the enemy should get possession of them.
verses.text: Nevertheless, they hid all the vessels of the sanctuary, lest the enemy should get possession of them.

verses.raw: And when they had done these things, they delivered thereupon to the enemy the overthrown wall, and the plundered house, and the burnt temple, and the people who were overcome because they were delivered up, lest the enemy should boast and say: 'Thus by force have we been able to lay waste even the house of the El Elyon (Most High) in war.'
verses.text: And when they had done these things, they delivered thereupon to the enemy the overthrown wall, and the plundered house, and the burnt temple, and the people who were overcome because they were delivered up, lest the enemy should boast and say: 'Thus by force have we been able to lay waste even the house of the El Elyon in war.'

verses.raw: Your brethren also have they bound and led away to Babylon, and have caused them to dwell there.
verses.text: Your brethren also have they bound and led away to Babylon, and have caused them to dwell there.

verses.raw: But we have been left here, being very few.
verses.text: But we have been left here, being very few.

verses.raw: This is the tribulation about which I wrote to you.
verses.text: This is the tribulation about which I wrote to you.

verses.raw: For assuredly I know that (the consolation of) the inhabitants of Zion consoleth you: so far as ye knew that it was prospered (your consolation) was greater than the tribulation which ye endured in having to depart from it.
verses.text: For assuredly I know that (the consolation of) the inhabitants of Zion consoleth you: so far as ye knew that it was prospered (your consolation) was greater than the tribulation which ye endured in having to depart from it.

verses.raw: But regarding consolation, hear ye the word.
verses.text: But regarding consolation, hear ye the word.

verses.raw: For I was mourning regarding Zion, and I prayed for mercy from the El Elyon (Most High), and I said:
verses.text: For I was mourning regarding Zion, and I prayed for mercy from the El Elyon, and I said:

verses.raw: 'How long will these things endure for us? And will these evils come upon us always?'
verses.text: 'How long will these things endure for us? And will these evils come upon us always?'

verses.raw: And the Mighty One did according to the multitude of His mercies, And the El Elyon (Most High) according to the greatness of His compassion, And He revealed unto me the word, that I might receive consolation, And He showed me visions that I should not again endure anguish, And He made known to me the mystery of the times, And the advent of the hours he showed me.
verses.text: And the Mighty One did according to the multitude of His mercies, And the El Elyon according to the greatness of His compassion, And He revealed unto me the word, that I might receive consolation, And He showed me visions that I should not again endure anguish, And He made known to me the mystery of the times, And the advent of the hours he showed me.

verses.raw: Therefore, my brethren, I have written to you, that ye may comfort yourselves regarding the multitude of your tribulations.
verses.text: Therefore, my brethren, I have written to you, that ye may comfort yourselves regarding the multitude of your tribulations.

verses.raw: For know ye that our Maker will assuredly avenge us on all our enemies, according to all that they have done to us, also that the consummation which the El Elyon (Most High) will make is very nigh, and His mercy that is coming, and the consummation of His judgement, is by no means far off.
verses.text: For know ye that our Maker will assuredly avenge us on all our enemies, according to all that they have done to us, also that the consummation which the El Elyon will make is very nigh, and His mercy that is coming, and the consummation of His judgement, is by no means far off.

verses.raw: For lo! we see now the multitude of the prosperity of the Gentiles, Though they act impiously, But they shall be like a vapour:
verses.text: For lo! we see now the multitude of the prosperity of the Gentiles, Though they act impiously, But they shall be like a vapour:

verses.raw: And we behold the multitude of their power, Though they do wickedly, But they shall be made like unto a drop:
verses.text: And we behold the multitude of their power, Though they do wickedly, But they shall be made like unto a drop:

verses.raw: And we see the firmness of their might, Though they resist the Mighty One every hour, But they shall be accounted as spittle.
verses.text: And we see the firmness of their might, Though they resist the Mighty One every hour, But they shall be accounted as spittle.

verses.raw: And we consider the glory of their greatness, Though they do not keep the statutes of the El Elyon (Most High), But as smoke shall they pass away.
verses.text: And we consider the glory of their greatness, Though they do not keep the statutes of the El Elyon, But as smoke shall they pass away.

verses.raw: And we meditate on the beauty of their gracefulness, Though they have to do with pollutions, But as grass that withers shall they fade away.
verses.text: And we meditate on the beauty of their gracefulness, Though they have to do with pollutions, But as grass that withers shall they fade away.

verses.raw: And we consider the strength of their cruelty, Though they remember not the end (thereof), But as a wave that passes shall they be broken.
verses.text: And we consider the strength of their cruelty, Though they remember not the end (thereof), But as a wave that passes shall they be broken.

verses.raw: And we remark the boastfulness of their might, Though they deny the beneficence of Elohim (God), who gave (it) to them, But they shall pass away as a passing cloud.
verses.text: And we remark the boastfulness of their might, Though they deny the beneficence of Elohim, who gave (it) to them, But they shall pass away as a passing cloud.

verses.raw: [For the El Elyon (Most High) will assuredly hasten His times, And He will assuredly bring on His hours.
verses.text: [For the El Elyon will assuredly hasten His times, And He will assuredly bring on His hours.

verses.raw: And He will assuredly judge those who are in His world, And will visit in truth all things by means of all their hidden works.
verses.text: And He will assuredly judge those who are in His world, And will visit in truth all things by means of all their hidden works.

verses.raw: And He will assuredly examine the secret thoughts, And that which is laid up in the secret chambers of all the members of man, And will make (them) manifest in the presence of all with reproof.
verses.text: And He will assuredly examine the secret thoughts, And that which is laid up in the secret chambers of all the members of man, And will make (them) manifest in the presence of all with reproof.

verses.raw: Let none therefore of these present things ascend into your hearts, but above all let us be expectant, because that which is promised to us shall come.
verses.text: Let none therefore of these present things ascend into your hearts, but above all let us be expectant, because that which is promised to us shall come.

verses.raw: And let us not now look unto the delights of the Gentiles in the present, but let us remember what has been promised to us in the end.
verses.text: And let us not now look unto the delights of the Gentiles in the present, but let us remember what has been promised to us in the end.

verses.raw: For the ends of the times and of the seasons and whatsoever is with them shall assuredly pass by together.
verses.text: For the ends of the times and of the seasons and whatsoever is with them shall assuredly pass by together.

verses.raw: The consummation, moreover, of the age shall then show the great might of its ruler, when all things come to judgement.
verses.text: The consummation, moreover, of the age shall then show the great might of its ruler, when all things come to judgement.

verses.raw: Do ye therefore prepare your hearts for that which before ye believed, lest ye come to be in bondage in both worlds, so that ye be led away captive here and be tormented there.
verses.text: Do ye therefore prepare your hearts for that which before ye believed, lest ye come to be in bondage in both worlds, so that ye be led away captive here and be tormented there.

verses.raw: For that which exists now or which has passed away, or which is to come, in all these things, neither is the evil fully evil, nor again the good fully good.
verses.text: For that which exists now or which has passed away, or which is to come, in all these things, neither is the evil fully evil, nor again the good fully good.

verses.raw: For all healthinesses of this time are turning into diseases,
verses.text: For all healthinesses of this time are turning into diseases,

verses.raw: And all might of this time is turning into weakness, And all the force of this time is turning into impotence,
verses.text: And all might of this time is turning into weakness, And all the force of this time is turning into impotence,

verses.raw: And every energy of youth is turning into old age and consummation, And every beauty of gracefulness of this time is turning faded and hateful,
verses.text: And every energy of youth is turning into old age and consummation, And every beauty of gracefulness of this time is turning faded and hateful,

verses.raw: And every proud dominion of the present is turning into humiliation and shame,
verses.text: And every proud dominion of the present is turning into humiliation and shame,

verses.raw: And every praise of the glory of this time is turning into the shame of silence, And every vain splendour and insolence of this time is turning into voiceless ruin.
verses.text: And every praise of the glory of this time is turning into the shame of silence, And every vain splendour and insolence of this time is turning into voiceless ruin.

verses.raw: And every delight and joy of this time is turning to worms and corruption,
verses.text: And every delight and joy of this time is turning to worms and corruption,

verses.raw: And every clamour of the pride of this time is turning into dust and stillness.
verses.text: And every clamour of the pride of this time is turning into dust and stillness.

verses.raw: And every possession of riches of this time is being turned into Sheol alone,
verses.text: And every possession of riches of this time is being turned into Sheol alone,

verses.raw: And all the rapine of passion of this time is turning into involuntary death, And every passion of the lusts of this time is turning into a judgement of torment.
verses.text: And all the rapine of passion of this time is turning into involuntary death, And every passion of the lusts of this time is turning into a judgement of torment.

verses.raw: And every artifice and craftiness of this time is turning into a proof of the truth,
verses.text: And every artifice and craftiness of this time is turning into a proof of the truth,

verses.raw: And every sweetness of unguents of this time is turning into judgement and condemnation,
verses.text: And every sweetness of unguents of this time is turning into judgement and condemnation,

verses.raw: And every love of lying is turning to contumely through truth.
verses.text: And every love of lying is turning to contumely through truth.

verses.raw: Since therefore all these things are done now, does anyone think that they will not be avenged? But the consummation of all things will come to the truth.]
verses.text: Since therefore all these things are done now, does anyone think that they will not be avenged? But the consummation of all things will come to the truth.]

verses.raw: Behold! I have therefore made known unto you (these things) whilst I live; for I have said (it) that ye should learn the things that are excellent; for the Mighty One hath commanded me to instruct you: and I will set before you some of the commandments of His judgement before I die.
verses.text: Behold! I have therefore made known unto you (these things) whilst I live; for I have said (it) that ye should learn the things that are excellent; for the Mighty One hath commanded me to instruct you: and I will set before you some of the commandments of His judgement before I die.

verses.raw: Remember that formerly Moses assuredly called heaven and earth to witness against you and said: 'If ye transgress the law ye shall be dispersed, but if ye keep it ye shall be kept.'
verses.text: Remember that formerly Moses assuredly called heaven and earth to witness against you and said: 'If ye transgress the law ye shall be dispersed, but if ye keep it ye shall be kept.'

verses.raw: And other things also he used to say unto you when ye the twelve tribes were together in the desert.
verses.text: And other things also he used to say unto you when ye the twelve tribes were together in the desert.

verses.raw: And after his death ye cast them away from you: on this account there came upon you what had been predicted.
verses.text: And after his death ye cast them away from you: on this account there came upon you what had been predicted.

verses.raw: And now Moses used to tell you before they befell you, and lo! they have befallen you: for ye have forsaken the law.
verses.text: And now Moses used to tell you before they befell you, and lo! they have befallen you: for ye have forsaken the law.

verses.raw: Lo! I also say unto you after ye have suffered, that if ye obey those things which have been said unto you, ye will receive from the Mighty One whatever has been laid up and reserved for you.
verses.text: Lo! I also say unto you after ye have suffered, that if ye obey those things which have been said unto you, ye will receive from the Mighty One whatever has been laid up and reserved for you.

verses.raw: Moreover, let this epistle be for a testimony between me and you, that ye may remember the commandments of the Mighty One, and that also there may be to me a defence in the presence of Him who sent me.
verses.text: Moreover, let this epistle be for a testimony between me and you, that ye may remember the commandments of the Mighty One, and that also there may be to me a defence in the presence of Him who sent me.

verses.raw: And remember ye the law and Zion, and the holy land and your brethren, and the covenant of your fathers, and forget not the festivals and the sabbaths.
verses.text: And remember ye the law and Zion, and the holy land and your brethren, and the covenant of your fathers, and forget not the festivals and the sabbaths.

verses.raw: And deliver ye this epistle and the traditions of the law to your sons after you, as also your fathers delivered (them) to you.
verses.text: And deliver ye this epistle and the traditions of the law to your sons after you, as also your fathers delivered (them) to you.

verses.raw: And at all times make request perseveringly and pray diligently with your whole heart that the Mighty One may be reconciled to you, and that He may not reckon the multitude of your sins, but remember the rectitude of your fathers.
verses.text: And at all times make request perseveringly and pray diligently with your whole heart that the Mighty One may be reconciled to you, and that He may not reckon the multitude of your sins, but remember the rectitude of your fathers.

verses.raw: For if He judge us not according to the multitude of His mercies, woe unto all us who are born.
verses.text: For if He judge us not according to the multitude of His mercies, woe unto all us who are born.

verses.raw: Know ye, moreover, that in former times and in the generations of old our fathers had helpers, Righteous men and holy prophets:
verses.text: Know ye, moreover, that in former times and in the generations of old our fathers had helpers, Righteous men and holy prophets:

verses.raw: Nay more, we were in our own land, [And they helped us when we sinned], And they interceded for us with Him who made us, Because they trusted in their works], And the Mighty One heard their prayer and forgave us.
verses.text: Nay more, we were in our own land, [And they helped us when we sinned], And they interceded for us with Him who made us, Because they trusted in their works], And the Mighty One heard their prayer and forgave us.

verses.raw: But now the righteous have been gathered, And the prophets have fallen asleep, And we also have gone forth from the land, And Zion has been taken from us, And we have nothing now save the Mighty One and His law.
verses.text: But now the righteous have been gathered, And the prophets have fallen asleep, And we also have gone forth from the land, And Zion has been taken from us, And we have nothing now save the Mighty One and His law.

verses.raw: If therefore we direct and dispose our hearts, We shall receive everything that we lost, And much better things than we lost by many times.
verses.text: If therefore we direct and dispose our hearts, We shall receive everything that we lost, And much better things than we lost by many times.

verses.raw: For what we have lost was subject to corruption, And what we shall receive shall not be corruptible.
verses.text: For what we have lost was subject to corruption, And what we shall receive shall not be corruptible.

verses.raw: [Moreover, also, I have written thus to our brethren to Babylon, that to them also I may attest these very things.]
verses.text: [Moreover, also, I have written thus to our brethren to Babylon, that to them also I may attest these very things.]

verses.raw: And let all those things aforesaid be always before your eyes, Because we are still in the spirit and the power of our liberty.
verses.text: And let all those things aforesaid be always before your eyes, Because we are still in the spirit and the power of our liberty.

verses.raw: Again, moreover, the El Elyon (Most High) also is long-suffering towards us here, And He hath shown to us that which is to be, And hath not concealed from us what will befall in the end.
verses.text: Again, moreover, the El Elyon also is long-suffering towards us here, And He hath shown to us that which is to be, And hath not concealed from us what will befall in the end.

verses.raw: Before therefore judgement exact its own, And truth that which is its due, Let us prepare our soul That we may possess, and not be taken possession of, And that we may hope and not be put to shame, And that we may rest with our fathers, and not be tormented with our enemies.
verses.text: Before therefore judgement exact its own, And truth that which is its due, Let us prepare our soul That we may possess, and not be taken possession of, And that we may hope and not be put to shame, And that we may rest with our fathers, and not be tormented with our enemies.

verses.raw: For the youth of the world is past, And the strength of the creation already exhausted, And the advent of the times is very short, Yea, they have passed by; And the pitcher is near to the cistern, And the ship to the port, And the course of the journey to the city, And life to (its) consummation.
verses.text: For the youth of the world is past, And the strength of the creation already exhausted, And the advent of the times is very short, Yea, they have passed by; And the pitcher is near to the cistern, And the ship to the port, And the course of the journey to the city, And life to (its) consummation.

verses.raw: And again prepare your souls, so that when ye sail and ascend from the ship ye may have rest and not be condemned when ye depart.
verses.text: And again prepare your souls, so that when ye sail and ascend from the ship ye may have rest and not be condemned when ye depart.

verses.raw: For lo! when the El Elyon (Most High) will bring to pass all these things, There shall not there be again [a place of repentance, nor] a limit to the times, Nor a duration for the hours, Nor a change of ways, Nor place for prayer, Nor sending of petitions, Nor receiving of knowledge, Nor giving of love, Nor place of repentance for the soul, Nor supplication for offences, Nor intercession of the fathers, Nor prayer of the prophets, Nor help of the righteous.
verses.text: For lo! when the El Elyon will bring to pass all these things, There shall not there be again [a place of repentance, nor] a limit to the times, Nor a duration for the hours, Nor a change of ways, Nor place for prayer, Nor sending of petitions, Nor receiving of knowledge, Nor giving of love, Nor place of repentance for the soul, Nor supplication for offences, Nor intercession of the fathers, Nor prayer of the prophets, Nor help of the righteous.

verses.raw: There there is the sentence of corruption, The way of fire, And the path which bringeth to Gehenna.
verses.text: There there is the sentence of corruption, The way of fire, And the path which bringeth to Gehenna.

verses.raw: On this account there is one law by one, One age and an end for all who are in it.
verses.text: On this account there is one law by one, One age and an end for all who are in it.

verses.raw: Then He will preserve those whom He can forgive, And at the same time destroy those who are polluted with sins.]
verses.text: Then He will preserve those whom He can forgive, And at the same time destroy those who are polluted with sins.]

verses.raw: When therefore ye receive this my epistle, read it in your congregations with care.
verses.text: When therefore ye receive this my epistle, read it in your congregations with care.

verses.raw: And meditate thereon, above all on the days of your fasts.
verses.text: And meditate thereon, above all on the days of your fasts.

verses.raw: And bear me in mind by means of this epistle, as I also bear you in mind in it, and always. Fare ye well.
verses.text: And bear me in mind by means of this epistle, as I also bear you in mind in it, and always. Fare ye well.

verses.raw: And it came to pass when I had ended all the words of this epistle, and had written it sedulously to its close, that I folded it, and sealed it carefully, and bound it to the neck of the eagle, and dismissed and sent it.
verses.text: And it came to pass when I had ended all the words of this epistle, and had written it sedulously to its close, that I folded it, and sealed it carefully, and bound it to the neck of the eagle, and dismissed and sent it.

verses.raw: A narrative and revelation of Baruch, concerning those ineffable things which he saw by command of Elohim (God). Bless Thou, O Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: A narrative and revelation of Baruch, concerning those ineffable things which he saw by command of Elohim. Bless Thou, O Yahuah.

verses.raw: A revelation of Baruch, who stood upon the river Gel weeping over the captivity of Jerusalem, when also Abimelech was preserved by the hand of Elohim (God), at the farm of Agrippa. And he was sitting thus at the beautiful gates, where the Holy of holies lay.
verses.text: A revelation of Baruch, who stood upon the river Gel weeping over the captivity of Jerusalem, when also Abimelech was preserved by the hand of Elohim, at the farm of Agrippa. And he was sitting thus at the beautiful gates, where the Holy of holies lay.

verses.raw: Verily I Baruch was weeping in my mind and sorrowing on account of the people, and that Nebuchadnezzar the king was permitted by Elohim (God) to destroy His city, saying: Yahuah (Lord), why didst Thou set on fire Thy vineyard, and lay it waste? Why didst Thou do this? And why, Yahuah (Lord), didst Thou not requite us with another chastisement, but didst deliver us to nations such as these, so that they reproach us and say, Where is their Elohim (God)?
verses.text: Verily I Baruch was weeping in my mind and sorrowing on account of the people, and that Nebuchadnezzar the king was permitted by Elohim to destroy His city, saying: Yahuah, why didst Thou set on fire Thy vineyard, and lay it waste? Why didst Thou do this? And why, Yahuah, didst Thou not requite us with another chastisement, but didst deliver us to nations such as these, so that they reproach us and say, Where is their Elohim?

verses.raw: And behold as I was weeping and saying such things, I saw an angel of Yahuah (Lord) coming and saying to me: Understand, O man, greatly beloved, and trouble not thyself so greatly concerning the salvation of Jerusalem, for thus saith Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God), the Almighty. For He sent me before thee, to make known and to show to thee all (the things) of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And behold as I was weeping and saying such things, I saw an angel of Yahuah coming and saying to me: Understand, O man, greatly beloved, and trouble not thyself so greatly concerning the salvation of Jerusalem, for thus saith Yahuah Elohim, the Almighty. For He sent me before thee, to make known and to show to thee all (the things) of Elohim.

verses.raw: For thy prayer was heard before Him, and entered into the ears of Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God).
verses.text: For thy prayer was heard before Him, and entered into the ears of Yahuah Elohim.

verses.raw: And when he had said these things to me, I was silent. And the angel said to me: Cease to provoke Elohim (God), and I will show thee other mysteries, greater than these.
verses.text: And when he had said these things to me, I was silent. And the angel said to me: Cease to provoke Elohim, and I will show thee other mysteries, greater than these.

verses.raw: And I Baruch said, As Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) liveth, if thou wilt show me, and I hear a word of thine, I will not continue to speak any longer.
verses.text: And I Baruch said, As Yahuah Elohim liveth, if thou wilt show me, and I hear a word of thine, I will not continue to speak any longer.

verses.raw: Elohim (God) shall add to my judgement in the day of judgement, if I speak hereafter. And the angel of the powers said to me, Come, and I will show thee the mysteries of Elohim (God).
verses.text: Elohim shall add to my judgement in the day of judgement, if I speak hereafter. And the angel of the powers said to me, Come, and I will show thee the mysteries of Elohim.

verses.raw: And he took me and led me where the firmament has been set fast, and where there was a river which no one can cross, nor any strange breeze of all those which Elohim (God) created.
verses.text: And he took me and led me where the firmament has been set fast, and where there was a river which no one can cross, nor any strange breeze of all those which Elohim created.

verses.raw: And he took me and led me to the first heaven, and showed me a door of great size. And he said to me, Let us enter through it, and we entered as though borne on wings, a distance of about thirty days' journey.
verses.text: And he took me and led me to the first heaven, and showed me a door of great size. And he said to me, Let us enter through it, and we entered as though borne on wings, a distance of about thirty days' journey.

verses.raw: And he showed me within the heaven a plain; and there were men dwelling thereon, with the faces of oxen, and the horns of stags, and the feet of goats, and the haunches of lambs.
verses.text: And he showed me within the heaven a plain; and there were men dwelling thereon, with the faces of oxen, and the horns of stags, and the feet of goats, and the haunches of lambs.

verses.raw: And I Baruch asked the angel, Make known to me, I pray thee, what is the thickness of the heaven in which we journeyed, or what is its extent, or what is the plain, in order that I may also tell the sons of men?
verses.text: And I Baruch asked the angel, Make known to me, I pray thee, what is the thickness of the heaven in which we journeyed, or what is its extent, or what is the plain, in order that I may also tell the sons of men?

verses.raw: And the angel whose name is Phamael said to me: This door which thou seest is the door of heaven, and as great as is the distance from earth to heaven, so great also is its thickness; and again as great as is the distance from North to South, so great is the length of the plain which thou didst see. And again the angel of the powers said to me, Come, and I will show thee greater mysteries.
verses.text: And the angel whose name is Phamael said to me: This door which thou seest is the door of heaven, and as great as is the distance from earth to heaven, so great also is its thickness; and again as great as is the distance from North to South, so great is the length of the plain which thou didst see. And again the angel of the powers said to me, Come, and I will show thee greater mysteries.

verses.raw: But I said, I pray thee show me what are these men.
verses.text: But I said, I pray thee show me what are these men.

verses.raw: And he said to me, These are they who built the tower of strife against Elohim (God), and Yahuah (Lord) banished them.
verses.text: And he said to me, These are they who built the tower of strife against Elohim, and Yahuah banished them.

verses.raw: And the angel of Yahuah (Lord) took me and led me to a second heaven. And he showed me there also a door like the first and said, Let us enter through it.
verses.text: And the angel of Yahuah took me and led me to a second heaven. And he showed me there also a door like the first and said, Let us enter through it.

verses.raw: And we entered, being borne on wings a distance of about sixty days' journey.
verses.text: And we entered, being borne on wings a distance of about sixty days' journey.

verses.raw: And he showed me there also a plain, and it was full of men, whose appearance was like that of dogs, and whose feet were like those of stags.
verses.text: And he showed me there also a plain, and it was full of men, whose appearance was like that of dogs, and whose feet were like those of stags.

verses.raw: And I asked the angel: I pray thee, Yahuah (Lord), say to me who are these.
verses.text: And I asked the angel: I pray thee, Yahuah, say to me who are these.

verses.raw: And he said, These are they who gave counsel to build the tower, for they whom thou seest drove forth multitudes of both men and women, to make bricks; among whom, a woman making bricks was not allowed to be released in the hour of child-birth, but brought forth while she was making bricks, and carried her child in her apron, and continued to make bricks.
verses.text: And he said, These are they who gave counsel to build the tower, for they whom thou seest drove forth multitudes of both men and women, to make bricks; among whom, a woman making bricks was not allowed to be released in the hour of child-birth, but brought forth while she was making bricks, and carried her child in her apron, and continued to make bricks.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) appeared to them and confused their speech, when they had built the tower to the height of four hundred and sixty-three cubits.
verses.text: And Yahuah appeared to them and confused their speech, when they had built the tower to the height of four hundred and sixty-three cubits.

verses.raw: And they took a gimlet, and sought to pierce the heaven, saying, Let us see (whether) the heaven is made of clay, or of brass, or of iron.
verses.text: And they took a gimlet, and sought to pierce the heaven, saying, Let us see (whether) the heaven is made of clay, or of brass, or of iron.

verses.raw: When Elohim (God) saw this He did not permit them, but smote them with blindness and confusion of speech, and rendered them as thou seest.
verses.text: When Elohim saw this He did not permit them, but smote them with blindness and confusion of speech, and rendered them as thou seest.

verses.raw: And I Baruch said, Behold, Yahuah (Lord), Thou didst show me great and wonderful things; and now show me all things for the sake of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And I Baruch said, Behold, Yahuah, Thou didst show me great and wonderful things; and now show me all things for the sake of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And the angel said to me, Come, let us proceed. (And I proceeded) with the angel from that place about one hundred and eighty-five days' journey.
verses.text: And the angel said to me, Come, let us proceed. (And I proceeded) with the angel from that place about one hundred and eighty-five days' journey.

verses.raw: And he showed me a plain and a serpent, which appeared to be two hundred plethra in length.
verses.text: And he showed me a plain and a serpent, which appeared to be two hundred plethra in length.

verses.raw: And he showed me Hades, and its appearance was dark and abominable. And I said, Who is this dragon, and who is this monster around him?
verses.text: And he showed me Hades, and its appearance was dark and abominable. And I said, Who is this dragon, and who is this monster around him?

verses.raw: And the angel said, The dragon is he who eats the bodies of those who spend their life wickedly, and he is nourished by them.
verses.text: And the angel said, The dragon is he who eats the bodies of those who spend their life wickedly, and he is nourished by them.

verses.raw: And this is Hades, which itself also closely resembles him, in that it also drinks about a cubit from the sea, which does not sink at all.
verses.text: And this is Hades, which itself also closely resembles him, in that it also drinks about a cubit from the sea, which does not sink at all.

verses.raw: Baruch said, And how (does this happen)? And the angel said, Hearken, Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) made three hundred and sixty rivers, of which the chief of all are Alphias, Abyrus, and the Gericus; and because of these the sea does not sink. And I said, I pray thee show me which is the tree which led Adam astray.
verses.text: Baruch said, And how (does this happen)? And the angel said, Hearken, Yahuah Elohim made three hundred and sixty rivers, of which the chief of all are Alphias, Abyrus, and the Gericus; and because of these the sea does not sink. And I said, I pray thee show me which is the tree which led Adam astray.

verses.raw: And the angel said to me, It is the vine, which the angel Sammael planted, whereat Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) was angry, and He cursed him and his plant, while also on this account He did not permit Adam to touch it, and therefore the devil being envious deceived him through his vine.
verses.text: And the angel said to me, It is the vine, which the angel Sammael planted, whereat Yahuah Elohim was angry, and He cursed him and his plant, while also on this account He did not permit Adam to touch it, and therefore the devil being envious deceived him through his vine.

verses.raw: And I Baruch said, Since also the vine has been the cause of such great evil, and is under judgement of the curse of Elohim (God), and was the destruction of the first created, how is it now so useful?
verses.text: And I Baruch said, Since also the vine has been the cause of such great evil, and is under judgement of the curse of Elohim, and was the destruction of the first created, how is it now so useful?

verses.raw: And the angel said, Thou askest aright. When Elohim (God) caused the deluge upon earth, and destroyed all flesh, and four hundred and nine thousand giants, and the water rose fifteen cubits above the highest mountains, then the water entered into paradise and destroyed every flower; but it removed wholly without the bounds the shoot of the vine and cast it outside.
verses.text: And the angel said, Thou askest aright. When Elohim caused the deluge upon earth, and destroyed all flesh, and four hundred and nine thousand giants, and the water rose fifteen cubits above the highest mountains, then the water entered into paradise and destroyed every flower; but it removed wholly without the bounds the shoot of the vine and cast it outside.

verses.raw: And when the earth appeared out of the water, and Noah came out of the ark, he began to plant of the plants which he found.
verses.text: And when the earth appeared out of the water, and Noah came out of the ark, he began to plant of the plants which he found.

verses.raw: But he found also the shoot of the vine; and he took it, and was reasoning in himself, What then is it? And I came and spake to him the things concerning it.
verses.text: But he found also the shoot of the vine; and he took it, and was reasoning in himself, What then is it? And I came and spake to him the things concerning it.

verses.raw: And he said, Shall I plant it, or what shall I do? Since Adam was destroyed because of it, let me not also meet with the anger of Elohim (God) because of it. And saying these things he prayed that Elohim (God) would reveal to him what he should do concerning it.
verses.text: And he said, Shall I plant it, or what shall I do? Since Adam was destroyed because of it, let me not also meet with the anger of Elohim because of it. And saying these things he prayed that Elohim would reveal to him what he should do concerning it.

verses.raw: And when he had completed the prayer which lasted forty days, and having besought many things and wept, he said: Yahuah (Lord), I entreat thee to reveal to me what I shall do concerning this plant.
verses.text: And when he had completed the prayer which lasted forty days, and having besought many things and wept, he said: Yahuah, I entreat thee to reveal to me what I shall do concerning this plant.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) sent his angel Sarasael, and said to him, Arise, Noah, and plant the shoot of the vine, for thus saith Yahuah (Lord): Its bitterness shall be changed into sweetness, and its curse shall become a blessing, and that which is produced from it shall become the blood of Elohim (God); and as through it the human race obtained condemnation, so again through Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) the Immanuel will they receive in Him the upward calling, and the entry into paradise.
verses.text: But Elohim sent his angel Sarasael, and said to him, Arise, Noah, and plant the shoot of the vine, for thus saith Yahuah: Its bitterness shall be changed into sweetness, and its curse shall become a blessing, and that which is produced from it shall become the blood of Elohim; and as through it the human race obtained condemnation, so again through Yahusha HaMashiach the Immanuel will they receive in Him the upward calling, and the entry into paradise.

verses.raw: Know therefore, O Baruch, that as Adam through this very tree obtained condemnation, and was divested of the glory of Elohim (God), so also the men who now drink insatiably the wine which is begotten of it, transgress worse than Adam, and are far from the glory of Elohim (God), and are surrendering themselves to the eternal fire.
verses.text: Know therefore, O Baruch, that as Adam through this very tree obtained condemnation, and was divested of the glory of Elohim, so also the men who now drink insatiably the wine which is begotten of it, transgress worse than Adam, and are far from the glory of Elohim, and are surrendering themselves to the eternal fire.

verses.raw: For (no) good comes through it. For those who drink it to surfeit do these things: neither does a brother pity his brother, nor a father his son, nor children their parents, but from the drinking of wine come all evils, such as murders, adulteries, fornications, perjuries, thefts, and such like. And nothing good is established by it.
verses.text: For (no) good comes through it. For those who drink it to surfeit do these things: neither does a brother pity his brother, nor a father his son, nor children their parents, but from the drinking of wine come all evils, such as murders, adulteries, fornications, perjuries, thefts, and such like. And nothing good is established by it.

verses.raw: And I Baruch said to the angel, Let me ask thee one thing, Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And I Baruch said to the angel, Let me ask thee one thing, Yahuah.

verses.raw: Since thou didst say to me that the dragon drinks one cubit out of the sea, say to me also, how great is his belly?
verses.text: Since thou didst say to me that the dragon drinks one cubit out of the sea, say to me also, how great is his belly?

verses.raw: And the angel said, His belly is Hades; and as far as a plummet is thrown (by) three hundred men, so great is his belly. Come, then, that I may show thee also greater works than these.
verses.text: And the angel said, His belly is Hades; and as far as a plummet is thrown (by) three hundred men, so great is his belly. Come, then, that I may show thee also greater works than these.

verses.raw: And he took me and led me where the sun goes forth; and he showed me a chariot and four, under which burnt a fire, and in the chariot was sitting a man, wearing a crown of fire, (and) the chariot (was) drawn by forty angels.
verses.text: And he took me and led me where the sun goes forth; and he showed me a chariot and four, under which burnt a fire, and in the chariot was sitting a man, wearing a crown of fire, (and) the chariot (was) drawn by forty angels.

verses.raw: And behold a bird circling before the sun, about nine cubits away. And I said to the angel, What is this bird?
verses.text: And behold a bird circling before the sun, about nine cubits away. And I said to the angel, What is this bird?

verses.raw: And he said to me, This is the guardian of the earth.
verses.text: And he said to me, This is the guardian of the earth.

verses.raw: And I said, Yahuah (Lord), how is he the guardian of the earth? Teach me.
verses.text: And I said, Yahuah, how is he the guardian of the earth? Teach me.

verses.raw: And the angel said to me, This bird flies alongside of the sun, and expanding his wings receives its fiery rays.
verses.text: And the angel said to me, This bird flies alongside of the sun, and expanding his wings receives its fiery rays.

verses.raw: For if he were not receiving them, the human race would not be preserved, nor any other living creature. But Elohim (God) appointed this bird thereto.
verses.text: For if he were not receiving them, the human race would not be preserved, nor any other living creature. But Elohim appointed this bird thereto.

verses.raw: And he expanded his wings, and I saw on his right wing very large letters, as large as the space of a threshing-floor, the size of about four thousand modii; and the letters were of gold.
verses.text: And he expanded his wings, and I saw on his right wing very large letters, as large as the space of a threshing-floor, the size of about four thousand modii; and the letters were of gold.

verses.raw: And the angel said to me, Read them. And I read, and they ran thus: Neither earth nor heaven bring me forth, but wings of fire bring me forth.
verses.text: And the angel said to me, Read them. And I read, and they ran thus: Neither earth nor heaven bring me forth, but wings of fire bring me forth.

verses.raw: And I said, Yahuah (Lord), what is this bird, and what is his name? And the angel said to me, His name is called Phoenix.
verses.text: And I said, Yahuah, what is this bird, and what is his name? And the angel said to me, His name is called Phoenix.

verses.raw: (And I said), And what does he eat? And he said to me, The manna of heaven and the dew of earth.
verses.text: (And I said), And what does he eat? And he said to me, The manna of heaven and the dew of earth.

verses.raw: And I said, Does the bird excrete? And he said to me, He excretes a worm, and the excrement of the worm is cinnamon, which kings and princes use. But wait and thou shalt see the glory of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And I said, Does the bird excrete? And he said to me, He excretes a worm, and the excrement of the worm is cinnamon, which kings and princes use. But wait and thou shalt see the glory of Elohim.

verses.raw: And while he was conversing with me, there was as a thunder-clap, and the place was shaken on which we were standing. And I asked the angel, My Lord, what is this sound? And the angel said to me, Even now the angels are opening the three hundred and sixty-five gates of heaven, and the light is being separated from the darkness.
verses.text: And while he was conversing with me, there was as a thunder-clap, and the place was shaken on which we were standing. And I asked the angel, My Lord, what is this sound? And the angel said to me, Even now the angels are opening the three hundred and sixty-five gates of heaven, and the light is being separated from the darkness.

verses.raw: And a voice came which said, Light-giver, give to the world radiance.
verses.text: And a voice came which said, Light-giver, give to the world radiance.

verses.raw: And when I heard the noise of the bird, I said, Yahuah (Lord), what is this noise?
verses.text: And when I heard the noise of the bird, I said, Yahuah, what is this noise?

verses.raw: And he said, This is the bird who awakens from slumber the cocks upon earth. For as men do through the mouth, so also does the cock signify to those in the world, in his own speech.
verses.text: And he said, This is the bird who awakens from slumber the cocks upon earth. For as men do through the mouth, so also does the cock signify to those in the world, in his own speech.

verses.raw: For the sun is made ready by the angels, and the cock crows.
verses.text: For the sun is made ready by the angels, and the cock crows.

verses.raw: And I said, And where does the sun begin its labours, after the cock crows?
verses.text: And I said, And where does the sun begin its labours, after the cock crows?

verses.raw: And the angel said to me, Listen, Baruch: All things whatsoever I showed thee are in the first and second heaven, and in the third heaven the sun passes through and gives light to the world. But wait, and thou shalt see the glory of Elohim (God).
