verses.text: Then Adam and Eve came out of the Cave of Treasures, and went near to the garden gate, and there they stood to look at it, and cried for having come away from it.

verses.raw: And Adam and Eve went from before the gate of the garden to the southern side of it, and found there the water that watered the garden, from the root of the Tree of Life, and that split itself from there into four rivers over the earth.
verses.text: And Adam and Eve went from before the gate of the garden to the southern side of it, and found there the water that watered the garden, from the root of the Tree of Life, and that split itself from there into four rivers over the earth.

verses.raw: Then they came and went near to that water, and looked at it; and saw that it was the water that came forth from under the root of the Tree of Life in the garden.
verses.text: Then they came and went near to that water, and looked at it; and saw that it was the water that came forth from under the root of the Tree of Life in the garden.

verses.raw: And Adam cried and wailed, and beat his chest, for being severed from the garden; and said to Eve:--
verses.text: And Adam cried and wailed, and beat his chest, for being severed from the garden; and said to Eve:--

verses.raw: "Why have you brought on me, on yourself, and on our descendants, so many of these plagues and punishments?"
verses.text: "Why have you brought on me, on yourself, and on our descendants, so many of these plagues and punishments?"

verses.raw: And Eve said to him, "What is it you have seen that has caused you to cry and to speak to me in this manner?"
verses.text: And Eve said to him, "What is it you have seen that has caused you to cry and to speak to me in this manner?"

verses.raw: And he said to Eve, "Do you not see this water that was with us in the garden, that watered the trees of the garden, and flowed out from there?
verses.text: And he said to Eve, "Do you not see this water that was with us in the garden, that watered the trees of the garden, and flowed out from there?

verses.raw: And we, when we were in the garden, did not care about it; but since we came to this strange land, we love it, and turn it to use for our body."
verses.text: And we, when we were in the garden, did not care about it; but since we came to this strange land, we love it, and turn it to use for our body."

verses.raw: But when Eve heard these words from him, she cried; and from the soreness of their crying, they fell into that water; and would have put an end to themselves in it, so as never again to return and behold the creation; for when they looked at the work of creation, they felt they must put an end to themselves.
verses.text: But when Eve heard these words from him, she cried; and from the soreness of their crying, they fell into that water; and would have put an end to themselves in it, so as never again to return and behold the creation; for when they looked at the work of creation, they felt they must put an end to themselves.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God), merciful and gracious, looked at them thus lying in the water, and close to death, and sent an angel, who brought them out of the water, and laid them on the seashore as dead.
verses.text: Then Elohim, merciful and gracious, looked at them thus lying in the water, and close to death, and sent an angel, who brought them out of the water, and laid them on the seashore as dead.

verses.raw: Then the angel went up to Elohim (God), was welcome, and said, "O Elohim (God), Your creatures have breathed their last."
verses.text: Then the angel went up to Elohim, was welcome, and said, "O Elohim, Your creatures have breathed their last."

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) sent His Word to Adam and Eve, who raised them from their death.
verses.text: Then Elohim sent His Word to Adam and Eve, who raised them from their death.

verses.raw: And Adam said, after he was raised, "O Elohim (God), while we were in the garden we did not require, or care for this water; but since we came to this land we cannot do without it."
verses.text: And Adam said, after he was raised, "O Elohim, while we were in the garden we did not require, or care for this water; but since we came to this land we cannot do without it."

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam, "While you were under My command and were a bright angel, you knew not this water.
verses.text: Then Elohim said to Adam, "While you were under My command and were a bright angel, you knew not this water.

verses.raw: But now that you have transgressed My commandment, you can not do without water, wherein to wash your body and make it grow; for it is now like that of beasts, and is in want of water."
verses.text: But now that you have transgressed My commandment, you can not do without water, wherein to wash your body and make it grow; for it is now like that of beasts, and is in want of water."

verses.raw: When Adam and Eve heard these words from Elohim (God), they cried a bitter cry; and Adam entreated Elohim (God) to let him return into the garden, and look at it a second time.
verses.text: When Adam and Eve heard these words from Elohim, they cried a bitter cry; and Adam entreated Elohim to let him return into the garden, and look at it a second time.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) said to Adam, "I have made you a promise; when that promise is fulfilled, I will bring you back into the garden, you and your righteous descendants."
verses.text: But Elohim said to Adam, "I have made you a promise; when that promise is fulfilled, I will bring you back into the garden, you and your righteous descendants."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) ceased to commune with Adam.
verses.text: And Elohim ceased to commune with Adam.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve felt themselves burning with thirst, and heat, and sorrow.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve felt themselves burning with thirst, and heat, and sorrow.

verses.raw: And Adam said to Eve, "We shall not drink of this water, even if we were to die. O Eve, when this water comes into our inner parts, it will increase our punishments and that of our descendants."
verses.text: And Adam said to Eve, "We shall not drink of this water, even if we were to die. O Eve, when this water comes into our inner parts, it will increase our punishments and that of our descendants."

verses.raw: Both Adam and Eve then went away from the water, and drank none of it at all; but came and entered the Cave of Treasures.
verses.text: Both Adam and Eve then went away from the water, and drank none of it at all; but came and entered the Cave of Treasures.

verses.raw: But when in it Adam could not see Eve; he only heard the noise she made. Neither could she see Adam, but heard the noise he made.
verses.text: But when in it Adam could not see Eve; he only heard the noise she made. Neither could she see Adam, but heard the noise he made.

verses.raw: Then Adam cried, in deep affliction, and beat his chest; and he got up and said to Eve, "Where are you?"
verses.text: Then Adam cried, in deep affliction, and beat his chest; and he got up and said to Eve, "Where are you?"

verses.raw: And she said to him, "Look, I am standing in this darkness."
verses.text: And she said to him, "Look, I am standing in this darkness."

verses.raw: He then said to her, "Remember the bright nature in which we lived, when we lived in the garden!
verses.text: He then said to her, "Remember the bright nature in which we lived, when we lived in the garden!

verses.raw: O Eve! Remember the glory that rested on us in the garden. O Eve! Remember the trees that overshadowed us in the garden while we moved among them.
verses.text: O Eve! Remember the glory that rested on us in the garden. O Eve! Remember the trees that overshadowed us in the garden while we moved among them.

verses.raw: O Eve! Remember that while we were in the garden, we knew neither night nor day. Think of the Tree of Life, from below which flowed the water, and that shed lustre over us! Remember, O Eve, the garden land, and the brightness thereof!
verses.text: O Eve! Remember that while we were in the garden, we knew neither night nor day. Think of the Tree of Life, from below which flowed the water, and that shed lustre over us! Remember, O Eve, the garden land, and the brightness thereof!

verses.raw: Think, oh think of that garden in which was no darkness, while we lived in it.
verses.text: Think, oh think of that garden in which was no darkness, while we lived in it.

verses.raw: Whereas no sooner did we come into this Cave of Treasures than darkness surrounded us all around; until we can no longer see each other; and all the pleasure of this life has come to an end."
verses.text: Whereas no sooner did we come into this Cave of Treasures than darkness surrounded us all around; until we can no longer see each other; and all the pleasure of this life has come to an end."

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam beat his chest, he and Eve, and they mourned the whole night until the crack of dawn, and they sighed over the length of the night in Miyazia.
verses.text: Then Adam beat his chest, he and Eve, and they mourned the whole night until the crack of dawn, and they sighed over the length of the night in Miyazia.

verses.raw: And Adam beat himself, and threw himself on the ground in the cave, from bitter grief, and because of the darkness, and lay there as dead.
verses.text: And Adam beat himself, and threw himself on the ground in the cave, from bitter grief, and because of the darkness, and lay there as dead.

verses.raw: But Eve heard the noise he made in falling on the ground. And she felt about for him with her hands, and found him like a corpse.
verses.text: But Eve heard the noise he made in falling on the ground. And she felt about for him with her hands, and found him like a corpse.

verses.raw: Then she was afraid, speechless, and remained by him.
verses.text: Then she was afraid, speechless, and remained by him.

verses.raw: But the merciful Yahuah (Lord) looked on the death of Adam, and on Eve's silence from fear of the darkness.
verses.text: But the merciful Yahuah looked on the death of Adam, and on Eve's silence from fear of the darkness.

verses.raw: And the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam and raised him from his death, and opened Eve's mouth that she might speak.
verses.text: And the Word of Elohim came to Adam and raised him from his death, and opened Eve's mouth that she might speak.

verses.raw: Then Adam stood up in the cave and said, "O Elohim (God), why has light departed from us, and darkness covered us? Why did you leave us in this long darkness? Why do you plague us like this?
verses.text: Then Adam stood up in the cave and said, "O Elohim, why has light departed from us, and darkness covered us? Why did you leave us in this long darkness? Why do you plague us like this?

verses.raw: And this darkness, O Yahuah (Lord), where was it before it covered us? It is because of this that we cannot see each other.
verses.text: And this darkness, O Yahuah, where was it before it covered us? It is because of this that we cannot see each other.

verses.raw: For so long as we were in the garden, we neither saw nor even knew what darkness is. I was not hidden from Eve, neither was she hidden from me, until now that she cannot see me; and no darkness came over us to separate us from each other.
verses.text: For so long as we were in the garden, we neither saw nor even knew what darkness is. I was not hidden from Eve, neither was she hidden from me, until now that she cannot see me; and no darkness came over us to separate us from each other.

verses.raw: But she and I were both in one bright light. I saw her and she saw me. Yet now since we came into this cave, darkness has covered us, and separated us from each other, so that I do not see her, and she does not see me.
verses.text: But she and I were both in one bright light. I saw her and she saw me. Yet now since we came into this cave, darkness has covered us, and separated us from each other, so that I do not see her, and she does not see me.

verses.raw: O Yahuah (Lord), will You then plague us with this darkness?"
verses.text: O Yahuah, will You then plague us with this darkness?"

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then when Elohim (God), who is merciful and full of pity, heard Adam's voice, He said to him:--
verses.text: Then when Elohim, who is merciful and full of pity, heard Adam's voice, He said to him:--

verses.raw: "O Adam, so long as the good angel was obedient to Me, a bright light rested on him and on his hosts.
verses.text: "O Adam, so long as the good angel was obedient to Me, a bright light rested on him and on his hosts.

verses.raw: But when he transgressed My commandment, I deprived him of that bright nature, and he became dark.
verses.text: But when he transgressed My commandment, I deprived him of that bright nature, and he became dark.

verses.raw: And when he was in the heavens, in the realms of light, he knew nothing of darkness.
verses.text: And when he was in the heavens, in the realms of light, he knew nothing of darkness.

verses.raw: But he transgressed, and I made him fall from the heaven onto the earth; and it was this darkness that came over him.
verses.text: But he transgressed, and I made him fall from the heaven onto the earth; and it was this darkness that came over him.

verses.raw: And on you, O Adam, while in My garden and obedient to Me, did that bright light rest also.
verses.text: And on you, O Adam, while in My garden and obedient to Me, did that bright light rest also.

verses.raw: But when I heard of your transgression, I deprived you of that bright light. Yet, of My mercy, I did not turn you into darkness, but I made you your body of flesh, over which I spread this skin, in order that it may bear cold and heat.
verses.text: But when I heard of your transgression, I deprived you of that bright light. Yet, of My mercy, I did not turn you into darkness, but I made you your body of flesh, over which I spread this skin, in order that it may bear cold and heat.

verses.raw: If I had let My wrath fall heavily on you, I should have destroyed you; and had I turned you into darkness, it would have been as if I had killed you.
verses.text: If I had let My wrath fall heavily on you, I should have destroyed you; and had I turned you into darkness, it would have been as if I had killed you.

verses.raw: But in My mercy, I have made you as you are; when you transgressed My commandment, O Adam, I drove you from the garden, and made you come forth into this land; and commanded you to live in this cave; and darkness covered you, as it did over him who transgressed My commandment.
verses.text: But in My mercy, I have made you as you are; when you transgressed My commandment, O Adam, I drove you from the garden, and made you come forth into this land; and commanded you to live in this cave; and darkness covered you, as it did over him who transgressed My commandment.

verses.raw: Thus, O Adam, has this night deceived you. It is not to last forever; but is only of twelve hours; when it is over, daylight will return.
verses.text: Thus, O Adam, has this night deceived you. It is not to last forever; but is only of twelve hours; when it is over, daylight will return.

verses.raw: Sigh not, therefore, neither be moved; and say not in your heart that this darkness is long and drags on wearily; and say not in your heart that I plague you with it.
verses.text: Sigh not, therefore, neither be moved; and say not in your heart that this darkness is long and drags on wearily; and say not in your heart that I plague you with it.

verses.raw: Strengthen your heart, and be not afraid. This darkness is not a punishment. But, O Adam, I have made the day, and have placed the sun in it to give light; in order that you and your children should do your work.
verses.text: Strengthen your heart, and be not afraid. This darkness is not a punishment. But, O Adam, I have made the day, and have placed the sun in it to give light; in order that you and your children should do your work.

verses.raw: For I knew you would sin and transgress, and come out into this land. Yet I wouldn't force you, nor be heard over you, nor shut up; nor doom you through your fall; nor through your coming out from light into darkness; nor yet through your coming from the garden into this land.
verses.text: For I knew you would sin and transgress, and come out into this land. Yet I wouldn't force you, nor be heard over you, nor shut up; nor doom you through your fall; nor through your coming out from light into darkness; nor yet through your coming from the garden into this land.

verses.raw: For I made you of the light; and I willed to bring out children of light from you and like to you.
verses.text: For I made you of the light; and I willed to bring out children of light from you and like to you.

verses.raw: But you did not keep My commandment one day; until I had finished the creation and blessed everything in it.
verses.text: But you did not keep My commandment one day; until I had finished the creation and blessed everything in it.

verses.raw: Then, concerning the tree, I commanded you not to eat of it. Yet I knew that Satan, who deceived himself, would also deceive you.
verses.text: Then, concerning the tree, I commanded you not to eat of it. Yet I knew that Satan, who deceived himself, would also deceive you.

verses.raw: So I made known to you by means of the tree, not to come near him. And I told you not to eat of the fruit thereof, nor to taste of it, nor yet to sit under it, nor to yield to it.
verses.text: So I made known to you by means of the tree, not to come near him. And I told you not to eat of the fruit thereof, nor to taste of it, nor yet to sit under it, nor to yield to it.

verses.raw: Had I not been and spoken to you, O Adam, concerning the tree, and had I left you without a commandment, and you had sinned--it would have been an offence on My part, for not having given you any order; you would turn around and blame Me for it.
verses.text: Had I not been and spoken to you, O Adam, concerning the tree, and had I left you without a commandment, and you had sinned--it would have been an offence on My part, for not having given you any order; you would turn around and blame Me for it.

verses.raw: But I commanded you, and warned you, and you fell. So that My creatures cannot blame Me; but the blame rests on them alone.
verses.text: But I commanded you, and warned you, and you fell. So that My creatures cannot blame Me; but the blame rests on them alone.

verses.raw: And, O Adam, I have made the day so that you and your descendants can work and toil in it. And I have made the night for them to rest in it from their work; and for the beasts of the field to go forth by night and look for their food.
verses.text: And, O Adam, I have made the day so that you and your descendants can work and toil in it. And I have made the night for them to rest in it from their work; and for the beasts of the field to go forth by night and look for their food.

verses.raw: But little of darkness now remains, O Adam, and daylight will soon appear."
verses.text: But little of darkness now remains, O Adam, and daylight will soon appear."

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam said to Elohim (God): "O Yahuah (Lord), take You my soul, and let me not see this gloom any more; or remove me to some place where there is no darkness."
verses.text: Then Adam said to Elohim: "O Yahuah, take You my soul, and let me not see this gloom any more; or remove me to some place where there is no darkness."

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) Yahuah (Lord) said to Adam, "Indeed I say to you, this darkness will pass from you, every day I have determined for you, until the fulfillment of My covenant; when I will save you and bring you back again into the garden, into the house of light you long for, in which there is no darkness*. I will bring you to it--in the kingdom of heaven."
verses.text: But Elohim Yahuah said to Adam, "Indeed I say to you, this darkness will pass from you, every day I have determined for you, until the fulfillment of My covenant; when I will save you and bring you back again into the garden, into the house of light you long for, in which there is no darkness*. I will bring you to it--in the kingdom of heaven."

verses.raw: Again said Elohim (God) to Adam, "All this misery that you have been made to take on yourself because of your transgression, will not free you from the hand of Satan, and will not save you.
verses.text: Again said Elohim to Adam, "All this misery that you have been made to take on yourself because of your transgression, will not free you from the hand of Satan, and will not save you.

verses.raw: But I will. When I shall come down from heaven, and shall become flesh of your descendants, and take on Myself the infirmity from which you suffer, then the darkness that covered you in this cave shall cover Me in the grave, when I am in the flesh of your descendants.
verses.text: But I will. When I shall come down from heaven, and shall become flesh of your descendants, and take on Myself the infirmity from which you suffer, then the darkness that covered you in this cave shall cover Me in the grave, when I am in the flesh of your descendants.

verses.raw: And I, who am without years, shall be subject to the reckoning of years, of times, of months, and of days, and I shall be reckoned as one of the sons of Adam, in order to save you."
verses.text: And I, who am without years, shall be subject to the reckoning of years, of times, of months, and of days, and I shall be reckoned as one of the sons of Adam, in order to save you."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) ceased to commune with Adam. * Reference: John 12:46
verses.text: And Elohim ceased to commune with Adam. * Reference: John 12:46

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: After this, Adam and Eve continued to stand in the cave, praying and crying, until the morning dawned on them.
verses.text: After this, Adam and Eve continued to stand in the cave, praying and crying, until the morning dawned on them.

verses.raw: And when they saw the light returned to them, they retrained from fear, and strengthened their hearts.
verses.text: And when they saw the light returned to them, they retrained from fear, and strengthened their hearts.

verses.raw: Then Adam began to come out of the cave. And when he came to the mouth of it, and stood and turned his face towards the east, and saw the sunrise in glowing rays, and felt the heat thereof on his body, he was afraid of it, and thought in his heart that this flame came forth to plague him.
verses.text: Then Adam began to come out of the cave. And when he came to the mouth of it, and stood and turned his face towards the east, and saw the sunrise in glowing rays, and felt the heat thereof on his body, he was afraid of it, and thought in his heart that this flame came forth to plague him.

verses.raw: He then cried and beat his chest, then he fell on the ground on his face and made his request, saying:--
verses.text: He then cried and beat his chest, then he fell on the ground on his face and made his request, saying:--

verses.raw: "O Yahuah (Lord), plague me not, neither consume me, nor yet take away my life from the earth."
verses.text: "O Yahuah, plague me not, neither consume me, nor yet take away my life from the earth."

verses.raw: For he thought the sun was Elohim (God).
verses.text: For he thought the sun was Elohim.

verses.raw: Because while he was in the garden and heard the voice of Elohim (God) and the sound He made in the garden, and feared Him, Adam never saw the brilliant light of the sun, neither did its flaming heat touch his body.
verses.text: Because while he was in the garden and heard the voice of Elohim and the sound He made in the garden, and feared Him, Adam never saw the brilliant light of the sun, neither did its flaming heat touch his body.

verses.raw: Therefore he was afraid of the sun when flaming rays of it reached him. He thought Elohim (God) meant to plague him therewith all the days He had decreed for him.
verses.text: Therefore he was afraid of the sun when flaming rays of it reached him. He thought Elohim meant to plague him therewith all the days He had decreed for him.

verses.raw: For Adam also said in his thoughts, as Elohim (God) did not plague us with darkness, behold, He has caused this sun to rise and to plague us with burning heat.
verses.text: For Adam also said in his thoughts, as Elohim did not plague us with darkness, behold, He has caused this sun to rise and to plague us with burning heat.

verses.raw: But while he was thinking like this in his heart, the Word of Elohim (God) came to him and said:--
verses.text: But while he was thinking like this in his heart, the Word of Elohim came to him and said:--

verses.raw: "O Adam, get up on your feet. This sun is not Elohim (God); but it has been created to give light by day, of which I spoke to you in the cave saying, 'that the dawn would come, and there would be light by day.'
verses.text: "O Adam, get up on your feet. This sun is not Elohim; but it has been created to give light by day, of which I spoke to you in the cave saying, 'that the dawn would come, and there would be light by day.'

verses.raw: But I am Elohim (God) who comforted you in the night."
verses.text: But I am Elohim who comforted you in the night."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) ceased to commune with Adam.
verses.text: And Elohim ceased to commune with Adam.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: The Adam and Eve came out at the mouth of the cave, and went towards the garden.
verses.text: The Adam and Eve came out at the mouth of the cave, and went towards the garden.

verses.raw: But as they went near it, before the western gate, from which Satan came when he deceived Adam and Eve, they found the serpent that became Satan coming at the gate, and sorrowfully licking the dust, and wiggling on its breast on the ground, by reason of the curse that fell on it from Elohim (God).
verses.text: But as they went near it, before the western gate, from which Satan came when he deceived Adam and Eve, they found the serpent that became Satan coming at the gate, and sorrowfully licking the dust, and wiggling on its breast on the ground, by reason of the curse that fell on it from Elohim.

verses.raw: And whereas before the serpent was the most exalted of all beasts, now it was changed and become slippery, and the meanest of them all, and it crept on its breast and went on its belly.
verses.text: And whereas before the serpent was the most exalted of all beasts, now it was changed and become slippery, and the meanest of them all, and it crept on its breast and went on its belly.

verses.raw: And whereas it was the fairest of all beasts, it had been changed, and was become the ugliest of them all. Instead of feeding on the best food, now it turned to eat the dust. Instead of living, as before, in the best places, now it lived in the dust.
verses.text: And whereas it was the fairest of all beasts, it had been changed, and was become the ugliest of them all. Instead of feeding on the best food, now it turned to eat the dust. Instead of living, as before, in the best places, now it lived in the dust.

verses.raw: And, whereas it had been the most beautiful of all beasts, all of which stood dumb at its beauty, it was now abhorred of them.
verses.text: And, whereas it had been the most beautiful of all beasts, all of which stood dumb at its beauty, it was now abhorred of them.

verses.raw: And, again, whereas it lived in one beautiful home, to which all other animals came from elsewhere; and where it drank, they drank also of the same; now, after it had become venomous, by reason of Elohim's (God's) curse, all beasts fled from its home, and would not drink of the water it drank; but fled from it.
verses.text: And, again, whereas it lived in one beautiful home, to which all other animals came from elsewhere; and where it drank, they drank also of the same; now, after it had become venomous, by reason of Elohim's (God's) curse, all beasts fled from its home, and would not drink of the water it drank; but fled from it.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: When the accursed serpent saw Adam and Eve, it swelled its head, stood on its tail, and with eyes blood-red, acted like it would kill them.
verses.text: When the accursed serpent saw Adam and Eve, it swelled its head, stood on its tail, and with eyes blood-red, acted like it would kill them.

verses.raw: It made straight for Eve, and ran after her; while Adam standing by, cried because he had no stick in his hand with which to hit the serpent, and did not know how to put it to death.
verses.text: It made straight for Eve, and ran after her; while Adam standing by, cried because he had no stick in his hand with which to hit the serpent, and did not know how to put it to death.

verses.raw: But with a heart burning for Eve, Adam approached the serpent, and held it by the tail; when it turned towards him and said to him:--
verses.text: But with a heart burning for Eve, Adam approached the serpent, and held it by the tail; when it turned towards him and said to him:--

verses.raw: "O Adam, because of you and of Eve, I am slippery, and go on my belly." Then with its great strength, it threw down Adam and Eve and squeezed them, and tried to kill them.
verses.text: "O Adam, because of you and of Eve, I am slippery, and go on my belly." Then with its great strength, it threw down Adam and Eve and squeezed them, and tried to kill them.

verses.raw: Who knows what may happen in that land by day or by night? And who knows whether it will be far or near, O Eve? Where it will please Elohim (God) to put us, may be far from the garden, O Eve? Or where Elohim (God) will prevent us from beholding Him, because we have transgressed His commandment, and because we have made requests of Him at all times?
verses.text: Who knows what may happen in that land by day or by night? And who knows whether it will be far or near, O Eve? Where it will please Elohim to put us, may be far from the garden, O Eve? Or where Elohim will prevent us from beholding Him, because we have transgressed His commandment, and because we have made requests of Him at all times?

verses.raw: O Eve, if Elohim (God) will bring us into a strange land other than this, in which we find consolation, it must be to put our souls to death, and blot out our name from the face of the earth.
verses.text: O Eve, if Elohim will bring us into a strange land other than this, in which we find consolation, it must be to put our souls to death, and blot out our name from the face of the earth.

verses.raw: O Eve, if we are further alienated from the garden and from Elohim (God), where shall we find Him again, and ask Him to give us gold, incense, myrrh, and some fruit of the fig-tree?
verses.text: O Eve, if we are further alienated from the garden and from Elohim, where shall we find Him again, and ask Him to give us gold, incense, myrrh, and some fruit of the fig-tree?

verses.raw: Where shall we find Him, to comfort us a second time? Where shall we find Him, that He may think of us, as regards the covenant He has made on our behalf?"
verses.text: Where shall we find Him, to comfort us a second time? Where shall we find Him, that He may think of us, as regards the covenant He has made on our behalf?"

verses.raw: Then Adam said no more. And they kept looking, He and Eve, towards the cave, and at the fire that flared up around it.
verses.text: Then Adam said no more. And they kept looking, He and Eve, towards the cave, and at the fire that flared up around it.

verses.raw: But that fire was from Satan. For he had gathered trees and dry grasses, and had carried and brought them to the cave, and had set fire to them, in order to consume the cave and what was in it.
verses.text: But that fire was from Satan. For he had gathered trees and dry grasses, and had carried and brought them to the cave, and had set fire to them, in order to consume the cave and what was in it.

verses.raw: So that Adam and Eve should be left in sorrow, and he should cut off their trust in Elohim (God), and make them deny Him.
verses.text: So that Adam and Eve should be left in sorrow, and he should cut off their trust in Elohim, and make them deny Him.

verses.raw: But by the mercy of Elohim (God) he could not burn the cave, for Elohim (God) sent His angel around the cave to guard it from such a fire, until it went out.
verses.text: But by the mercy of Elohim he could not burn the cave, for Elohim sent His angel around the cave to guard it from such a fire, until it went out.

verses.raw: And this fire lasted from noon-day until the break of day. That was the forty-fifth day.
verses.text: And this fire lasted from noon-day until the break of day. That was the forty-fifth day.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Yet Adam and Eve were standing and looking at the fire, and unable to come near the cave from their dread of the fire.
verses.text: Yet Adam and Eve were standing and looking at the fire, and unable to come near the cave from their dread of the fire.

verses.raw: And Satan kept on bringing trees and throwing them into the fire, until the flames of the fire rose up on high, and covered the whole cave, thinking, as he did in his own mind, to consume the cave with much fire. But the angel of Yahuah (Lord) was guarding it.
verses.text: And Satan kept on bringing trees and throwing them into the fire, until the flames of the fire rose up on high, and covered the whole cave, thinking, as he did in his own mind, to consume the cave with much fire. But the angel of Yahuah was guarding it.

verses.raw: And yet he could not curse Satan, nor injure him by word, because he had no authority over him, neither did he take to doing so with words from his mouth.
verses.text: And yet he could not curse Satan, nor injure him by word, because he had no authority over him, neither did he take to doing so with words from his mouth.

verses.raw: Therefore the angel tolerated him, without saying one bad word, until the Word of Elohim (God) came who said to Satan, "Go away from here; once before you deceived My servants, and this time you seek to destroy them.
verses.text: Therefore the angel tolerated him, without saying one bad word, until the Word of Elohim came who said to Satan, "Go away from here; once before you deceived My servants, and this time you seek to destroy them.

verses.raw: Were it not for My mercy I would have destroyed you and your hosts from off the earth. But I have had patience with you, until the end of the world."
verses.text: Were it not for My mercy I would have destroyed you and your hosts from off the earth. But I have had patience with you, until the end of the world."

verses.raw: Then Satan fled from before Yahuah (Lord). But the fire went on burning around the cave like a coal-fire the whole day; which was the forty-sixth day Adam and Eve had spent since they came out of the garden.
verses.text: Then Satan fled from before Yahuah. But the fire went on burning around the cave like a coal-fire the whole day; which was the forty-sixth day Adam and Eve had spent since they came out of the garden.

verses.raw: And when Adam and Eve saw that the heat of the fire had somewhat cooled down, they began to walk towards the cave to get into it as they usually did; but they could not, by reason of the heat of the fire.
verses.text: And when Adam and Eve saw that the heat of the fire had somewhat cooled down, they began to walk towards the cave to get into it as they usually did; but they could not, by reason of the heat of the fire.

verses.raw: Then they both began crying because of the fire that separated them from the cave, and that came towards them, burning. And they were afraid.
verses.text: Then they both began crying because of the fire that separated them from the cave, and that came towards them, burning. And they were afraid.

verses.raw: Then Adam said to Eve, "See this fire of which we have a portion in us: which formerly yielded to us, but no longer does so, now that we have transgressed the limit of creation, and changed our condition, and our nature is altered. But the fire is not changed in its nature, nor altered from its creation. Therefore it now has power over us; and when we come near it, it scorches our flesh."
verses.text: Then Adam said to Eve, "See this fire of which we have a portion in us: which formerly yielded to us, but no longer does so, now that we have transgressed the limit of creation, and changed our condition, and our nature is altered. But the fire is not changed in its nature, nor altered from its creation. Therefore it now has power over us; and when we come near it, it scorches our flesh."

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam rose and prayed to Elohim (God), saying, "See, this fire has separated us from the cave in which You have commanded us to live; but now, behold, we cannot go into it."
verses.text: Then Adam rose and prayed to Elohim, saying, "See, this fire has separated us from the cave in which You have commanded us to live; but now, behold, we cannot go into it."

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) heard Adam, and sent him His Word, that said:--
verses.text: Then Elohim heard Adam, and sent him His Word, that said:--

verses.raw: "O Adam, see this fire! How different the flame and heat thereof are from the garden of delights and the good things in it!
verses.text: "O Adam, see this fire! How different the flame and heat thereof are from the garden of delights and the good things in it!

verses.raw: When you were under My control, all creatures yielded to you; but after you have transgressed My commandment, they all rise over you."
verses.text: When you were under My control, all creatures yielded to you; but after you have transgressed My commandment, they all rise over you."

verses.raw: Elohim (God) said again to him, "See, O Adam, how Satan has exalted you! He has deprived you of the Godhead, and of an exalted state like Me, and has not kept his word to you; but has, after all, become your enemy. He is the one who made this fire in which he meant to burn you and Eve.
verses.text: Elohim said again to him, "See, O Adam, how Satan has exalted you! He has deprived you of the Godhead, and of an exalted state like Me, and has not kept his word to you; but has, after all, become your enemy. He is the one who made this fire in which he meant to burn you and Eve.

verses.raw: Why, O Adam, has he not kept his agreement with you, not even one day; but has deprived you of the glory that was on you--when you yielded to his command?
verses.text: Why, O Adam, has he not kept his agreement with you, not even one day; but has deprived you of the glory that was on you--when you yielded to his command?

verses.raw: Do you think, Adam, that he loved you when he made this agreement with you? Or that he loved you and wished to raise you on high?
verses.text: Do you think, Adam, that he loved you when he made this agreement with you? Or that he loved you and wished to raise you on high?

verses.raw: But no, Adam, he did not do all that out of love to you; but he wished to make you come out of light into darkness; and from an exalted state to degradation; from glory to abasement; from joy to sorrow; and from rest to fasting and fainting."
verses.text: But no, Adam, he did not do all that out of love to you; but he wished to make you come out of light into darkness; and from an exalted state to degradation; from glory to abasement; from joy to sorrow; and from rest to fasting and fainting."

verses.raw: Elohim (God) also said to Adam, "See this fire kindled by Satan around your cave; see this wonder that surrounds you; and know that it will encompass about both you and your descendants, when you obey his command; that he will plague you with fire; and that you will go down into hell after you are dead.
verses.text: Elohim also said to Adam, "See this fire kindled by Satan around your cave; see this wonder that surrounds you; and know that it will encompass about both you and your descendants, when you obey his command; that he will plague you with fire; and that you will go down into hell after you are dead.

verses.raw: Then you will see the burning of his fire, that will be burning around you and likewise your descendants. You will not be delivered from it until My coming; just like you cannot go into your cave right now because of the great fire around it; not until My Word comes and makes a way for you on the day My covenant is fulfilled.
verses.text: Then you will see the burning of his fire, that will be burning around you and likewise your descendants. You will not be delivered from it until My coming; just like you cannot go into your cave right now because of the great fire around it; not until My Word comes and makes a way for you on the day My covenant is fulfilled.

verses.raw: There is no way for you at present to come from this life to rest, not until My Word comes, who is My Word. Then He will make a way for you, and you shall have rest." Then Elohim (God) called with His Word to the fire that burned around the cave, that it split itself in half, until Adam had gone through it. Then the fire parted itself by Elohim's (God's) order, and a way was made for Adam*.
verses.text: There is no way for you at present to come from this life to rest, not until My Word comes, who is My Word. Then He will make a way for you, and you shall have rest." Then Elohim called with His Word to the fire that burned around the cave, that it split itself in half, until Adam had gone through it. Then the fire parted itself by Elohim's (God's) order, and a way was made for Adam*.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) withdrew His Word from Adam. * Reference: Exodus 14:21,22 and Joshua 3:15-17
verses.text: And Elohim withdrew His Word from Adam. * Reference: Exodus 14:21,22 and Joshua 3:15-17

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve began again to come into the cave. And when they came to the way between the fire, Satan blew into the fire like a whirlwind, and caused the burning coal-fire to cover Adam and Eve; so that their bodies were singed; and the coal-fire scorched them*.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve began again to come into the cave. And when they came to the way between the fire, Satan blew into the fire like a whirlwind, and caused the burning coal-fire to cover Adam and Eve; so that their bodies were singed; and the coal-fire scorched them*.

verses.raw: And from the burning of the fire Adam and Eve screamed, and said, "O Yahuah (Lord), save us! Leave us not to be consumed and plagued by this burning fire; neither require us for having transgressed Your commandment."
verses.text: And from the burning of the fire Adam and Eve screamed, and said, "O Yahuah, save us! Leave us not to be consumed and plagued by this burning fire; neither require us for having transgressed Your commandment."

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) looked at their bodies, on which Satan had caused fire to burn, and Elohim (God) sent His angel that stayed the burning fire. But the wounds remained on their bodies.
verses.text: Then Elohim looked at their bodies, on which Satan had caused fire to burn, and Elohim sent His angel that stayed the burning fire. But the wounds remained on their bodies.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said to Adam, "See Satan's love for you, who pretended to give you the Godhead and greatness; and, behold, he burns you with fire, and seeks to destroy you from off the earth.
verses.text: And Elohim said to Adam, "See Satan's love for you, who pretended to give you the Godhead and greatness; and, behold, he burns you with fire, and seeks to destroy you from off the earth.

verses.raw: Then look at Me, O Adam; I created you, and how many times have I delivered you out of his hand? If not, wouldn't he have destroyed you?"
verses.text: Then look at Me, O Adam; I created you, and how many times have I delivered you out of his hand? If not, wouldn't he have destroyed you?"

verses.raw: Elohim (God) said again to Eve, "What is that he promised you in the garden, saying, 'As soon as you eat from the tree, your eyes will be opened, and you shall become like gods, knowing good and evil.' But look! He has burnt your bodies with fire, and has made you taste the taste of fire, for the taste of the garden; and has made you see the burning of fire, and the evil of it, and the power it has over you.
verses.text: Elohim said again to Eve, "What is that he promised you in the garden, saying, 'As soon as you eat from the tree, your eyes will be opened, and you shall become like gods, knowing good and evil.' But look! He has burnt your bodies with fire, and has made you taste the taste of fire, for the taste of the garden; and has made you see the burning of fire, and the evil of it, and the power it has over you.

verses.raw: Your eyes have seen the good he has taken from you, and in truth he has opened your eyes; and you have seen the garden in which you were with Me, and you have also seen the evil that has come over you from Satan. But as to the Godhead he cannot give it to you, neither fulfil his speech to you. No, he was bitter against you and your descendants, that will come after you."
verses.text: Your eyes have seen the good he has taken from you, and in truth he has opened your eyes; and you have seen the garden in which you were with Me, and you have also seen the evil that has come over you from Satan. But as to the Godhead he cannot give it to you, neither fulfil his speech to you. No, he was bitter against you and your descendants, that will come after you."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) withdrew His Word form them. * At this time, the garments that Yahuah (Lord) had given them in Genesis 3:21 were burned off so that Adam and Eve were again naked. Reference chapter L whereby Adam and Eve seek garments with which to cover their nakedness..
verses.text: And Elohim withdrew His Word form them. * At this time, the garments that Yahuah had given them in Genesis 3:21 were burned off so that Adam and Eve were again naked. Reference chapter L whereby Adam and Eve seek garments with which to cover their nakedness..

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve came into the cave, yet trembling at the fire that had scorched their bodies. So Adam said to Eve:--
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve came into the cave, yet trembling at the fire that had scorched their bodies. So Adam said to Eve:--

verses.raw: "Look, the fire has burnt our flesh in this world; but how will it be when we are dead, and Satan shall punish our souls? Is not our deliverance long and far off, unless Elohim (God) come, and in mercy to us fulfil His promise?"
verses.text: "Look, the fire has burnt our flesh in this world; but how will it be when we are dead, and Satan shall punish our souls? Is not our deliverance long and far off, unless Elohim come, and in mercy to us fulfil His promise?"

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve passed into the cave, blessing themselves for coming into it once more. For it was in their thoughts, that they never should enter it, when they saw the fire around it.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve passed into the cave, blessing themselves for coming into it once more. For it was in their thoughts, that they never should enter it, when they saw the fire around it.

verses.raw: But as the sun was setting the fire was still burning and nearing Adam and Eve in the cave, so that they could not sleep in it. After the sun had set, they went out of it. This was the forty-seventh day after they came out of the garden.
verses.text: But as the sun was setting the fire was still burning and nearing Adam and Eve in the cave, so that they could not sleep in it. After the sun had set, they went out of it. This was the forty-seventh day after they came out of the garden.

verses.raw: Adam and Eve then came under the top of hill by the garden to sleep, as they were accustomed.
verses.text: Adam and Eve then came under the top of hill by the garden to sleep, as they were accustomed.

verses.raw: And they stood and prayed Elohim (God) to forgive them their sins, and then fell asleep under the summit of the mountain.
verses.text: And they stood and prayed Elohim to forgive them their sins, and then fell asleep under the summit of the mountain.

verses.raw: But Satan, the hater of all good, thought within himself: "Whereas Elohim (God) has promised salvation to Adam by covenant, and that He would deliver him out of all the hardships that have befallen him--but has not promised me by covenant, and will not deliver me out of my hardships; no, since He has promised him that He should make him and his descendants live in the kingdom in which I once was--I will kill Adam.
verses.text: But Satan, the hater of all good, thought within himself: "Whereas Elohim has promised salvation to Adam by covenant, and that He would deliver him out of all the hardships that have befallen him--but has not promised me by covenant, and will not deliver me out of my hardships; no, since He has promised him that He should make him and his descendants live in the kingdom in which I once was--I will kill Adam.

verses.raw: The earth shall be rid of him; and shall be left to me alone; so that when he is dead he may not have any descendants left to inherit the kingdom that shall remain my own realm; Elohim (God) will then be wanting me, and He will restore it to me and my hosts."
verses.text: The earth shall be rid of him; and shall be left to me alone; so that when he is dead he may not have any descendants left to inherit the kingdom that shall remain my own realm; Elohim will then be wanting me, and He will restore it to me and my hosts."

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: After this Satan called to his hosts, all of which came to him, and said to him:--
verses.text: After this Satan called to his hosts, all of which came to him, and said to him:--

verses.raw: "O, our lord, what will you do?"
verses.text: "O, our lord, what will you do?"

verses.raw: He then said to them, "You know that this Adam, whom Elohim (God) created out of the dust, is the one who has taken our kingdom, come, let us gather together and kill him; or hurl a rock at him and at Eve, and crush them under it."
verses.text: He then said to them, "You know that this Adam, whom Elohim created out of the dust, is the one who has taken our kingdom, come, let us gather together and kill him; or hurl a rock at him and at Eve, and crush them under it."

verses.raw: When Satan's hosts heard these words, they came to the part of the mountain where Adam and Eve were asleep.
verses.text: When Satan's hosts heard these words, they came to the part of the mountain where Adam and Eve were asleep.

verses.raw: Then Satan and his host took a huge rock, broad and even, and without blemish, thinking within himself, "If there should be a hole in the rock, when it fell on them, the hole in the rock might come over them, and so they would escape and not die."
verses.text: Then Satan and his host took a huge rock, broad and even, and without blemish, thinking within himself, "If there should be a hole in the rock, when it fell on them, the hole in the rock might come over them, and so they would escape and not die."

verses.raw: He then said to his hosts, "Take up this stone, and throw it flat on them, so that it doesn't roll off them to somewhere else. And when you have hurled it, get away from there quickly."
verses.text: He then said to his hosts, "Take up this stone, and throw it flat on them, so that it doesn't roll off them to somewhere else. And when you have hurled it, get away from there quickly."

verses.raw: And they did as he told them. But as the rock fell down from the mountain toward Adam and Eve, Elohim (God) commanded the rock to become a dome over them*, that did them no harm. And so it was by Elohim's (God's) order.
verses.text: And they did as he told them. But as the rock fell down from the mountain toward Adam and Eve, Elohim commanded the rock to become a dome over them*, that did them no harm. And so it was by Elohim's (God's) order.

verses.raw: But when the rock fell, the whole earth quaked with it**, and was shaken from the size of the rock.
verses.text: But when the rock fell, the whole earth quaked with it**, and was shaken from the size of the rock.

verses.raw: And as it quaked and shook, Adam and Eve awoke from sleep, and found themselves under a dome of rock. But they didn't know what had happened; because when the fell asleep they were under the sky, and not under a dome; and when they saw it, they were afraid.
verses.text: And as it quaked and shook, Adam and Eve awoke from sleep, and found themselves under a dome of rock. But they didn't know what had happened; because when the fell asleep they were under the sky, and not under a dome; and when they saw it, they were afraid.

verses.raw: Then Adam said to Eve, "Wherefore has the mountain bent itself, and the earth quaked and shaken on our account? And why has this rock spread itself over us like a tent?
verses.text: Then Adam said to Eve, "Wherefore has the mountain bent itself, and the earth quaked and shaken on our account? And why has this rock spread itself over us like a tent?

verses.raw: Does Elohim (God) intend to plague us and to shut us up in this prison? Or will He close the earth over us?
verses.text: Does Elohim intend to plague us and to shut us up in this prison? Or will He close the earth over us?

verses.raw: He is angry with us for our having come out of the cave, without His order; and for our having done so of our own accord, without consulting Him, when we left the cave and came to this place."
verses.text: He is angry with us for our having come out of the cave, without His order; and for our having done so of our own accord, without consulting Him, when we left the cave and came to this place."

verses.raw: Then Eve said, "If, indeed, the earth quaked for our sake, and this rock forms a tent over us because of our transgression, then we will be sorry, O Adam, because our punishment will be long.
verses.text: Then Eve said, "If, indeed, the earth quaked for our sake, and this rock forms a tent over us because of our transgression, then we will be sorry, O Adam, because our punishment will be long.

verses.raw: But get up and pray to Elohim (God) to let us know concerning this, and what this rock is that is spread over us like a tent."
verses.text: But get up and pray to Elohim to let us know concerning this, and what this rock is that is spread over us like a tent."

verses.raw: Then Adam stood up and prayed before Yahuah (Lord), to let him know what had brought about this difficult time. And Adam stood praying like that until the morning. * The word "dome" is used here but the text does not specifically suggest that the covering was round--only that it covered them on all sides, however a dome is the most likely shape that would have be able to withstand the impact with the ground. From verse 9 that says "when they saw it" and verse 11 that says "shut us up in this prison", we can conclude that the dome had holes in its sides that were big enough to let in light and air but were too small to allow Adam and Eve to escape. Another conclusion would be that the holes were large but too high up for Adam and Eve to reach, however the former is more likely. ** In verse 7 of the next chapter (XLIX), Elohim (God) tells Adam and Eve that the ground was also lowered under them--"I commanded . . . the rock under you to lower itself".
verses.text: Then Adam stood up and prayed before Yahuah, to let him know what had brought about this difficult time. And Adam stood praying like that until the morning. * The word "dome" is used here but the text does not specifically suggest that the covering was round--only that it covered them on all sides, however a dome is the most likely shape that would have be able to withstand the impact with the ground. From verse 9 that says "when they saw it" and verse 11 that says "shut us up in this prison", we can conclude that the dome had holes in its sides that were big enough to let in light and air but were too small to allow Adam and Eve to escape. Another conclusion would be that the holes were large but too high up for Adam and Eve to reach, however the former is more likely. ** In verse 7 of the next chapter (XLIX), Elohim tells Adam and Eve that the ground was also lowered under them--"I commanded . . . the rock under you to lower itself".

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came and said:--
verses.text: Then the Word of Elohim came and said:--

verses.raw: "O Adam, who counselled you, when you came out of the cave, to come to this place?"
verses.text: "O Adam, who counselled you, when you came out of the cave, to come to this place?"

verses.raw: And Adam said to Elohim (God), "O Yahuah (Lord), we came to this place because of the heat of the fire, that came over us inside the cave."
verses.text: And Adam said to Elohim, "O Yahuah, we came to this place because of the heat of the fire, that came over us inside the cave."

verses.raw: Then Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said to Adam, "O Adam, you dread the heat of fire for one night, but how will it be when you live in hell?
verses.text: Then Yahuah Elohim said to Adam, "O Adam, you dread the heat of fire for one night, but how will it be when you live in hell?

verses.raw: Yet, O Adam, don't be afraid, and don't believe that I have placed this dome of rock over you to plague you with it.
verses.text: Yet, O Adam, don't be afraid, and don't believe that I have placed this dome of rock over you to plague you with it.

verses.raw: It came from Satan, who had promised you the Godhead and majesty. It is he who threw down this rock to kill you under it, and Eve with you, and thus to prevent you from living on the earth.
verses.text: It came from Satan, who had promised you the Godhead and majesty. It is he who threw down this rock to kill you under it, and Eve with you, and thus to prevent you from living on the earth.

verses.raw: But, in mercy for you, just as that rock was falling down on you, I commanded it to form an dome over you; and the rock under you to lower itself.
verses.text: But, in mercy for you, just as that rock was falling down on you, I commanded it to form an dome over you; and the rock under you to lower itself.

verses.raw: And this sign, O Adam, will happen to Me at My coming on earth: Satan will raise the people of the Yahudim (Jews) to put Me to death; and they will lay Me in a rock, and seal a large stone over Me, and I shall remain within that rock three days and three nights.
verses.text: And this sign, O Adam, will happen to Me at My coming on earth: Satan will raise the people of the Yahudim to put Me to death; and they will lay Me in a rock, and seal a large stone over Me, and I shall remain within that rock three days and three nights.

verses.raw: But on the third day I shall rise again, and it shall be salvation to you, O Adam, and to your descendants, to believe in Me. But, O Adam, I will not bring you from under this rock until three days and three nights have passed."
verses.text: But on the third day I shall rise again, and it shall be salvation to you, O Adam, and to your descendants, to believe in Me. But, O Adam, I will not bring you from under this rock until three days and three nights have passed."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) withdrew His Word from Adam.
verses.text: And Elohim withdrew His Word from Adam.

verses.raw: But Adam and Eve lived under the rock three days and three nights, as Elohim (God) had told them.
verses.text: But Adam and Eve lived under the rock three days and three nights, as Elohim had told them.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) did so to them because they had left their cave and had come to this same place without Elohim's (God's) order.
verses.text: And Elohim did so to them because they had left their cave and had come to this same place without Elohim's (God's) order.

verses.raw: But, after three days and three nights, Elohim (God) created an opening in the dome of rock and allowed them to get out from under it. Their flesh was dried up, and their eyes and hearts were troubled from crying and sorrow.
verses.text: But, after three days and three nights, Elohim created an opening in the dome of rock and allowed them to get out from under it. Their flesh was dried up, and their eyes and hearts were troubled from crying and sorrow.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve went forth and came into the Cave of Treasures, and they stood praying in it the whole of that day, until the evening.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve went forth and came into the Cave of Treasures, and they stood praying in it the whole of that day, until the evening.

verses.raw: And this took place at the end of the fifty days after they had left the garden.
verses.text: And this took place at the end of the fifty days after they had left the garden.

verses.raw: But Adam and Eve rose again and prayed to Elohim (God) in the cave the whole of that night, and begged for mercy from Him.
verses.text: But Adam and Eve rose again and prayed to Elohim in the cave the whole of that night, and begged for mercy from Him.

verses.raw: And when the day dawned, Adam said to Eve, "Come! Let us go and do some work for our bodies."
verses.text: And when the day dawned, Adam said to Eve, "Come! Let us go and do some work for our bodies."

verses.raw: So they went out of the cave, and came to the northern border of the garden, and they looked for something to cover their bodies with*. But they found nothing, and knew not how to do the work. Yet their bodies were stained, and they were speechless from cold and heat.
verses.text: So they went out of the cave, and came to the northern border of the garden, and they looked for something to cover their bodies with*. But they found nothing, and knew not how to do the work. Yet their bodies were stained, and they were speechless from cold and heat.

verses.raw: Then Adam stood and asked Elohim (God) to show him something with which to cover their bodies.
verses.text: Then Adam stood and asked Elohim to show him something with which to cover their bodies.

verses.raw: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) and said to him, "O Adam, take Eve and come to the seashore where you fasted before. There you will find skins of sheep that were left after lions ate the carcasses. Take them and make garments for yourselves, and clothe yourselves with them. * Chapter XLVI, verse 1, says "Satan blew into the fire ... so that their bodies were singed". At this time, the garments that Yahuah (Lord) had given them in Genesis 3:21 were burned off so that Adam and Eve were again naked.

There you will find skins of sheep that were left after lions ate the carcasses. Take them and make garments for yourselves, and clothe yourselves with them. * Chapter XLVI, verse 1, says "Satan blew into the fire ... so that their bodies were singed".
