title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: When Adam heard these words from Elohim (God), he took Eve and went from the northern end of the garden to the south of it, by the river of water where they once fasted.
verses.text: When Adam heard these words from Elohim, he took Eve and went from the northern end of the garden to the south of it, by the river of water where they once fasted.

verses.raw: But as they were going on their way, and before they got there, Satan, the wicked one, had heard the Word of Elohim (God) communing with Adam respecting his covering.
verses.text: But as they were going on their way, and before they got there, Satan, the wicked one, had heard the Word of Elohim communing with Adam respecting his covering.

verses.raw: It grieved him, and he hastened to the place where the sheep-skins were, with the intention of taking them and throwing them into the sea, or of burning them with fire, so that Adam and Eve would not find them.
verses.text: It grieved him, and he hastened to the place where the sheep-skins were, with the intention of taking them and throwing them into the sea, or of burning them with fire, so that Adam and Eve would not find them.

verses.raw: But as he was about to take them, the Word of Elohim (God) came from heaven, and bound him by the side of those skins until Adam and Eve came near him. But as they got closer to him they were afraid of him, and of his hideous look.
verses.text: But as he was about to take them, the Word of Elohim came from heaven, and bound him by the side of those skins until Adam and Eve came near him. But as they got closer to him they were afraid of him, and of his hideous look.

verses.raw: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and said to them, "This is he who was hidden in the serpent, and who deceived you, and stripped you of the garment of light and glory in which you were.
verses.text: Then came the Word of Elohim to Adam and Eve, and said to them, "This is he who was hidden in the serpent, and who deceived you, and stripped you of the garment of light and glory in which you were.

verses.raw: This is he who promised you majesty and divinity. Where, then, is the beauty that was on him? Where is his divinity? Where is his light? Where is the glory that rested on him?
verses.text: This is he who promised you majesty and divinity. Where, then, is the beauty that was on him? Where is his divinity? Where is his light? Where is the glory that rested on him?

verses.raw: Now his figure is hideous; he is become abominable among angels; and he has come to be called Satan.
verses.text: Now his figure is hideous; he is become abominable among angels; and he has come to be called Satan.

verses.raw: O Adam, he wished to take from you this earthly garment of sheep-skins, and to destroy it, and not let you be covered with it.
verses.text: O Adam, he wished to take from you this earthly garment of sheep-skins, and to destroy it, and not let you be covered with it.

verses.raw: What, then, is his beauty that you should have followed him? And what have you gained by obeying him? See his evil works and then look at Me; at Me, your Creator, and at the good deeds I do you.
verses.text: What, then, is his beauty that you should have followed him? And what have you gained by obeying him? See his evil works and then look at Me; at Me, your Creator, and at the good deeds I do you.

verses.raw: See, I bound him until you came and saw him and beheld his weakness, that no power is left with him."
verses.text: See, I bound him until you came and saw him and beheld his weakness, that no power is left with him."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) released him from his bonds.
verses.text: And Elohim released him from his bonds.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: After this Adam and Eve said no more, but cried before Elohim (God) on account of their creation, and of their bodies that required an earthly covering.
verses.text: After this Adam and Eve said no more, but cried before Elohim on account of their creation, and of their bodies that required an earthly covering.

verses.raw: Then Adam said to Eve, "O Eve, this is the skin of beasts with which we shall be covered, but when we put it on, behold, we shall be wearing a token of death on our bodies. Just as the owners of these skins have died and have wasted away, so also shall we die and pass away."
verses.text: Then Adam said to Eve, "O Eve, this is the skin of beasts with which we shall be covered, but when we put it on, behold, we shall be wearing a token of death on our bodies. Just as the owners of these skins have died and have wasted away, so also shall we die and pass away."

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve took the skins, and went back to the Cave of Treasures; and when in it, they stood and prayed as they were accustomed.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve took the skins, and went back to the Cave of Treasures; and when in it, they stood and prayed as they were accustomed.

verses.raw: And they thought how they could make garments of those skins; for they had no skill for it.
verses.text: And they thought how they could make garments of those skins; for they had no skill for it.

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) sent to them His angel to show them how to work it out. And the angel said to Adam, "Go forth, and bring some palm-thorns." Then Adam went out, and brought some, as the angel had commanded him.
verses.text: Then Elohim sent to them His angel to show them how to work it out. And the angel said to Adam, "Go forth, and bring some palm-thorns." Then Adam went out, and brought some, as the angel had commanded him.

verses.raw: Then the angel began before them to work out the skins, after the manner of one who prepares a shirt. And he took the thorns and stuck them into the skins, before their eyes.
verses.text: Then the angel began before them to work out the skins, after the manner of one who prepares a shirt. And he took the thorns and stuck them into the skins, before their eyes.

verses.raw: Then the angel again stood up and prayed Elohim (God) that the thorns in those skins should be hidden, so as to be, as it were, sewn with one thread.
verses.text: Then the angel again stood up and prayed Elohim that the thorns in those skins should be hidden, so as to be, as it were, sewn with one thread.

verses.raw: And so it was, by Elohim's (God's) order; they became garments for Adam and Eve, and He clothed them therewith.
verses.text: And so it was, by Elohim's (God's) order; they became garments for Adam and Eve, and He clothed them therewith.

verses.raw: From that time the nakedness of their bodies was covered from the sight of each other's eyes.
verses.text: From that time the nakedness of their bodies was covered from the sight of each other's eyes.

verses.raw: And this happened at the end of the fifty-first day.
verses.text: And this happened at the end of the fifty-first day.

verses.raw: Then when Adam's and Eve's bodies were covered, they stood and prayed, and sought mercy of Yahuah (Lord), and forgiveness, and gave Him thanks for that He had had mercy on them, and had covered their nakedness. And they ceased not from prayer the whole of that night.
verses.text: Then when Adam's and Eve's bodies were covered, they stood and prayed, and sought mercy of Yahuah, and forgiveness, and gave Him thanks for that He had had mercy on them, and had covered their nakedness. And they ceased not from prayer the whole of that night.

verses.raw: Then when the morning dawned at the rising of the sun, they said their prayers after their custom; and then went out of the cave.
verses.text: Then when the morning dawned at the rising of the sun, they said their prayers after their custom; and then went out of the cave.

verses.raw: And Adam said to Eve, "Since we don't know what there is to the west of this cave, let us go out and see it today." Then they came forth and went toward the western border.
verses.text: And Adam said to Eve, "Since we don't know what there is to the west of this cave, let us go out and see it today." Then they came forth and went toward the western border.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: They were not very far from the cave, when Satan came towards them, and hid himself between them and the cave, under the form of two ravenous lions three days without food, that came towards Adam and Eve, as if to break them in pieces and devour them.
verses.text: They were not very far from the cave, when Satan came towards them, and hid himself between them and the cave, under the form of two ravenous lions three days without food, that came towards Adam and Eve, as if to break them in pieces and devour them.

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve cried, and prayed Elohim (God) to deliver them from their paws.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve cried, and prayed Elohim to deliver them from their paws.

verses.raw: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to them, and drove away the lions from them.
verses.text: Then the Word of Elohim came to them, and drove away the lions from them.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said to Adam, "O Adam, what do you seek on the western border? And why have you left of thine own accord the eastern border, in which was your living place?
verses.text: And Elohim said to Adam, "O Adam, what do you seek on the western border? And why have you left of thine own accord the eastern border, in which was your living place?

verses.raw: Now then, turn back to your cave, and remain in it, so that Satan won't deceive you or work his purpose over you.
verses.text: Now then, turn back to your cave, and remain in it, so that Satan won't deceive you or work his purpose over you.

verses.raw: For in this western border, O Adam, there will go from you a descendant, that shall replenish it; and that will defile themselves with their sins, and with their yielding to the commands of Satan, and by following his works.
verses.text: For in this western border, O Adam, there will go from you a descendant, that shall replenish it; and that will defile themselves with their sins, and with their yielding to the commands of Satan, and by following his works.

verses.raw: Therefore will I bring over them the waters of a flood, and overwhelm them all. But I will deliver what is left of the righteous among them; and I will bring them to a distant land, and the land in which you live now shall remain desolate and without one inhabitant in it.
verses.text: Therefore will I bring over them the waters of a flood, and overwhelm them all. But I will deliver what is left of the righteous among them; and I will bring them to a distant land, and the land in which you live now shall remain desolate and without one inhabitant in it.

verses.raw: After Elohim (God) had thus spoken to them, they went back to the Cave of Treasures. But their flesh was dried up, and they were weak from fasting and praying, and from the sorrow they felt at having trespassed against Elohim (God).
verses.text: After Elohim had thus spoken to them, they went back to the Cave of Treasures. But their flesh was dried up, and they were weak from fasting and praying, and from the sorrow they felt at having trespassed against Elohim.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve stood up in the cave and prayed the whole of that night until the morning dawned. And when the sun was risen they both went out of the cave; their heads were wandering from heaviness of sorrow and they didn't know where they were going.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve stood up in the cave and prayed the whole of that night until the morning dawned. And when the sun was risen they both went out of the cave; their heads were wandering from heaviness of sorrow and they didn't know where they were going.

verses.raw: And they walked in that condition to the southern border of the garden. And they began to go up that border until they came to the eastern border beyond which there was no more land.
verses.text: And they walked in that condition to the southern border of the garden. And they began to go up that border until they came to the eastern border beyond which there was no more land.

verses.raw: And the cherub who guarded the garden was standing at the western gate, and guarding it against Adam and Eve, lest they should suddenly come into the garden. And the cherub turned around, as if to put them to death; according to the commandment Elohim (God) had given him.
verses.text: And the cherub who guarded the garden was standing at the western gate, and guarding it against Adam and Eve, lest they should suddenly come into the garden. And the cherub turned around, as if to put them to death; according to the commandment Elohim had given him.

verses.raw: When Adam and Eve came to the eastern border of the garden--thinking in their hearts that the cherub was not watching--as they were standing by the gate as if wishing to go in, suddenly came the cherub with a flashing sword of fire in his hand; and when he saw them, he went forth to kill them. For he was afraid that Elohim (God) would destroy him if they went into the garden without His order.
verses.text: When Adam and Eve came to the eastern border of the garden--thinking in their hearts that the cherub was not watching--as they were standing by the gate as if wishing to go in, suddenly came the cherub with a flashing sword of fire in his hand; and when he saw them, he went forth to kill them. For he was afraid that Elohim would destroy him if they went into the garden without His order.

verses.raw: And the sword of the cherub seemed to shoot flames a distance away from it. But when he raised it over Adam and Eve, the flame of the sword did not flash forth.
verses.text: And the sword of the cherub seemed to shoot flames a distance away from it. But when he raised it over Adam and Eve, the flame of the sword did not flash forth.

verses.raw: Therefore the cherub thought that Elohim (God) was favorable to them, and was bringing them back into the garden. And the cherub stood wondering.
verses.text: Therefore the cherub thought that Elohim was favorable to them, and was bringing them back into the garden. And the cherub stood wondering.

verses.raw: He could not go up to Heaven to determine Elohim's (God's) order regarding their getting into the garden; he therefore continued to stand by them, unable as he was to part from them; for he was afraid that if they should enter the garden without permission, Elohim (God) would destroy him.
verses.text: He could not go up to Heaven to determine Elohim's (God's) order regarding their getting into the garden; he therefore continued to stand by them, unable as he was to part from them; for he was afraid that if they should enter the garden without permission, Elohim would destroy him.

verses.raw: When Adam and Eve saw the cherub coming towards them with a flaming sword of fire in his hand, they fell on their faces from fear, and were as dead.
verses.text: When Adam and Eve saw the cherub coming towards them with a flaming sword of fire in his hand, they fell on their faces from fear, and were as dead.

verses.raw: At that time the heavens and the earth shook; and another cherubim came down from heaven to the cherub who guarded the garden, and saw him amazed and silent.
verses.text: At that time the heavens and the earth shook; and another cherubim came down from heaven to the cherub who guarded the garden, and saw him amazed and silent.

verses.raw: Then, again, other angels came down close to the place where Adam and Eve were. They were divided between joy and sorrow.
verses.text: Then, again, other angels came down close to the place where Adam and Eve were. They were divided between joy and sorrow.

verses.raw: They were glad, because they thought that Elohim (God) was favorable to Adam, and wished him to return to the garden; and wished to restore him to the gladness he once enjoyed.
verses.text: They were glad, because they thought that Elohim was favorable to Adam, and wished him to return to the garden; and wished to restore him to the gladness he once enjoyed.

verses.raw: But they sorrowed over Adam, because he was fallen like a dead man, he and Eve; and they said in their thoughts, "Adam has not died in this place; but Elohim (God) has put him to death, for his having come to this place, and wishing to get into the garden without His permission."
verses.text: But they sorrowed over Adam, because he was fallen like a dead man, he and Eve; and they said in their thoughts, "Adam has not died in this place; but Elohim has put him to death, for his having come to this place, and wishing to get into the garden without His permission."

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and raised them from their dead state, saying to them, "Why did you come up here? Do you intend to go into the garden, from which I brought you out? It cannot be today; but only when the covenant I have made with you is fulfilled."
verses.text: Then came the Word of Elohim to Adam and Eve, and raised them from their dead state, saying to them, "Why did you come up here? Do you intend to go into the garden, from which I brought you out? It cannot be today; but only when the covenant I have made with you is fulfilled."

verses.raw: Then Adam, when he heard the Word of Elohim (God), and the fluttering of the angels whom he did not see, but only heard the sound of them with his ears, he and Eve cried, and said to the angels:--
verses.text: Then Adam, when he heard the Word of Elohim, and the fluttering of the angels whom he did not see, but only heard the sound of them with his ears, he and Eve cried, and said to the angels:--

verses.raw: "O Spirits, who wait on Elohim (God), look at me, and at my being unable to see you! For when I was in my former bright nature, then I could see you. I sang praises as you do; and my heart was far above you.
verses.text: "O Spirits, who wait on Elohim, look at me, and at my being unable to see you! For when I was in my former bright nature, then I could see you. I sang praises as you do; and my heart was far above you.

verses.raw: But now, that I have transgressed, that bright nature is gone from me, and I am come to this miserable state. And now I have come to this, that I cannot see you, and you do not serve me like you used to do. For I have become animal flesh.
verses.text: But now, that I have transgressed, that bright nature is gone from me, and I am come to this miserable state. And now I have come to this, that I cannot see you, and you do not serve me like you used to do. For I have become animal flesh.

verses.raw: Yet now, O angels of Elohim (God), ask Elohim (God) with me, to restore me to that wherein I was formerly; to rescue me from this misery, and to remove from me the sentence of death He passed on me, for having trespassed against Him."
verses.text: Yet now, O angels of Elohim, ask Elohim with me, to restore me to that wherein I was formerly; to rescue me from this misery, and to remove from me the sentence of death He passed on me, for having trespassed against Him."

verses.raw: Then, when the angels heard these words, they all grieved over him; and cursed Satan who had misled Adam, until he came from the garden to misery; from life to death; from peace to trouble; and from gladness to a strange land.
verses.text: Then, when the angels heard these words, they all grieved over him; and cursed Satan who had misled Adam, until he came from the garden to misery; from life to death; from peace to trouble; and from gladness to a strange land.

verses.raw: Then the angels said to Adam, "You obeyed Satan, and ignored the Word of Elohim (God) who created you; and you believed that Satan would fulfil all he had promised you.
verses.text: Then the angels said to Adam, "You obeyed Satan, and ignored the Word of Elohim who created you; and you believed that Satan would fulfil all he had promised you.

verses.raw: But now, O Adam, we will make known to you, what came over us though him, before his fall from heaven.
verses.text: But now, O Adam, we will make known to you, what came over us though him, before his fall from heaven.

verses.raw: He gathered together his hosts, and deceived them, promising to give them a great kingdom, a divine nature; and other promises he made them.
verses.text: He gathered together his hosts, and deceived them, promising to give them a great kingdom, a divine nature; and other promises he made them.

verses.raw: His hosts believed that his word was true, so they yielded to him, and renounced the glory of Elohim (God).
verses.text: His hosts believed that his word was true, so they yielded to him, and renounced the glory of Elohim.

verses.raw: He then sent for us--according to the orders in which we were--to come under his command, and to accept his vein promise. But we would not, and we did not take his advice.
verses.text: He then sent for us--according to the orders in which we were--to come under his command, and to accept his vein promise. But we would not, and we did not take his advice.

verses.raw: Then after he had fought with Elohim (God), and had dealt forwardly with Him, he gathered together his hosts, and made war with us. And if it had not been for Elohim's (God's) strength that was with us, we could not have prevailed against him to hurl him from heaven.
verses.text: Then after he had fought with Elohim, and had dealt forwardly with Him, he gathered together his hosts, and made war with us. And if it had not been for Elohim's (God's) strength that was with us, we could not have prevailed against him to hurl him from heaven.

verses.raw: But when he fell from among us, there was great joy in heaven, because of his going down from us. For if he had remained in heaven, nothing, not even one angel would have remained in it.
verses.text: But when he fell from among us, there was great joy in heaven, because of his going down from us. For if he had remained in heaven, nothing, not even one angel would have remained in it.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) in His mercy, drove him from among us to this dark earth; for he had become darkness itself and a worker of unrighteousness.
verses.text: But Elohim in His mercy, drove him from among us to this dark earth; for he had become darkness itself and a worker of unrighteousness.

verses.raw: And he has continued, O Adam, to make war against you, until he tricked you and made you come out of the garden, to this strange land, where all these trials have come to you. And death, which Elohim (God) brought to him, he has also brought to you, O Adam, because you obeyed him, and trespassed against Elohim (God)."
verses.text: And he has continued, O Adam, to make war against you, until he tricked you and made you come out of the garden, to this strange land, where all these trials have come to you. And death, which Elohim brought to him, he has also brought to you, O Adam, because you obeyed him, and trespassed against Elohim."

verses.raw: Then all the angels rejoiced and praised Elohim (God), and asked Him not to destroy Adam this time, for his having sought to enter the garden; but to bear with him until the fulfillment of the promise; and to help him in this world until he was free from Satan's hand.
verses.text: Then all the angels rejoiced and praised Elohim, and asked Him not to destroy Adam this time, for his having sought to enter the garden; but to bear with him until the fulfillment of the promise; and to help him in this world until he was free from Satan's hand.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him:--
verses.text: Then came the Word of Elohim to Adam, and said to him:--

verses.raw: "O Adam, look at that garden of joy and at this earth of toil, and behold the garden is full of angels, but look at yourself alone on this earth with Satan whom you obeyed.
verses.text: "O Adam, look at that garden of joy and at this earth of toil, and behold the garden is full of angels, but look at yourself alone on this earth with Satan whom you obeyed.

verses.raw: Yet, if you had submitted, and been obedient to Me, and had kept My Word, you would be with My angels in My garden.
verses.text: Yet, if you had submitted, and been obedient to Me, and had kept My Word, you would be with My angels in My garden.

verses.raw: But when you transgressed and obeyed Satan, you became his guests among his angels, that are full of wickedness; and you came to this earth, that brings forth to you thorns and thistles.
verses.text: But when you transgressed and obeyed Satan, you became his guests among his angels, that are full of wickedness; and you came to this earth, that brings forth to you thorns and thistles.

verses.raw: O Adam, ask him who deceived you, to give you the divine nature he promised you, or to make you a garden as I had made for you; or to fill you with that same bright nature with which I had filled you.
verses.text: O Adam, ask him who deceived you, to give you the divine nature he promised you, or to make you a garden as I had made for you; or to fill you with that same bright nature with which I had filled you.

verses.raw: Ask him to make you a body like the one I made you, or to give you a day of rest as I gave you; or to create within you a reasonable soul, as I created for you; or to take you from here to some other earth than this one which I gave you. But, O Adam, he will not fulfil even one of the things he told you.
verses.text: Ask him to make you a body like the one I made you, or to give you a day of rest as I gave you; or to create within you a reasonable soul, as I created for you; or to take you from here to some other earth than this one which I gave you. But, O Adam, he will not fulfil even one of the things he told you.

verses.raw: Acknowledge, then, My favor towards you, and My mercy on you, My creature; that I have not avenged you for your transgression against Me, but in My pity for you I have promised you that at the end of the great five and a half days I will come and save you."
verses.text: Acknowledge, then, My favor towards you, and My mercy on you, My creature; that I have not avenged you for your transgression against Me, but in My pity for you I have promised you that at the end of the great five and a half days I will come and save you."

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) said again to Adam and Eve, "Get up, go down from here, before the cherub with a sword of fire in his hand destroys you."
verses.text: Then Elohim said again to Adam and Eve, "Get up, go down from here, before the cherub with a sword of fire in his hand destroys you."

verses.raw: But Adam's heart was comforted by Elohim's (God's) words to him, and he worshipped before Him.
verses.text: But Adam's heart was comforted by Elohim's (God's) words to him, and he worshipped before Him.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) commanded His angels to escort Adam and Eve to the cave with joy, instead of the fear that had come over them.
verses.text: And Elohim commanded His angels to escort Adam and Eve to the cave with joy, instead of the fear that had come over them.

verses.raw: Then the angels took up Adam and Eve, and brought them down from the mountain by the garden, with songs and psalms, until they arrived at the cave. There the angels began to comfort and to strengthen them, and then departed from them towards heaven, to their Creator, who had sent them.
verses.text: Then the angels took up Adam and Eve, and brought them down from the mountain by the garden, with songs and psalms, until they arrived at the cave. There the angels began to comfort and to strengthen them, and then departed from them towards heaven, to their Creator, who had sent them.

verses.raw: And it seemed to them that they were really his offspring, when they saw that his face was like their own; and they trusted him. * The existence of the two words helpmeet and helpmate, meaning exactly the same thing, is a comedy of errors. Elohim's (God's) promise to Adam, as rendered in the King James version of the Bible, was to give him an help meet for him (that is, a helper fit for him). In the 17th century the two words help and meet in this passage were mistaken for one word, applying to Eve, and thus helpmeet came to mean a wife. Then in the 18th century, in a misguided attempt to make sense of the word, the spelling helpmate was introduced. Both errors are now beyond recall, and both spellings are acceptable.

verses.raw: Not for his mere sake, then, have these trees grown up at once; but I had mercy on you and I commanded them to grow. And they grew to be two large trees, that you be overshadowed by their branches, and find rest; and that I made you see My power and My marvelous works.

verses.raw: And, also, to show you Satan's meanness, and his evil works, for ever since you came out of the garden, he has not ceased, no, not one day, from doing you some harm. But I have not given him power over you."

verses.raw: For we know Your marvelous works, O Elohim (God), that they are great, and that by Your power You can bring one thing out of another, without one's wish. For Your power can make rocks to become trees, and trees to become rocks."

verses.raw: Adam accomplished all that, until he grew very faint and weary. He then returned to the cave; rejoicing at what he had learned of what is done with wheat, until it is made into bread for one's use. * In this book, the terms 'corn' and 'wheat' are used interchangeably. The reference is possibly used to indicate a type of ancient grain resembling Egyptian Corn also known as Durra. Durra is a wheat-like cereal grain frequently cultivated in dry regions such as Egypt.

verses.text: And Elohim told His angels to take Adam and Eve, and to bear them up to the field of wheat, which they found as before, with the bucket full of water.

verses.raw: There they saw a tree, and found on it solid manna; and wondered at Elohim's (God's) power. And the angels commanded them to eat of the manna when they were hungry.
verses.text: There they saw a tree, and found on it solid manna; and wondered at Elohim's (God's) power. And the angels commanded them to eat of the manna when they were hungry.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) admonished Satan with a curse, not to come again, and destroy the field of corn.
verses.text: And Elohim admonished Satan with a curse, not to come again, and destroy the field of corn.

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve took of the corn, and made of it an offering, and took it and offered it up on the mountain, the place where they had offered up their first offering of blood.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve took of the corn, and made of it an offering, and took it and offered it up on the mountain, the place where they had offered up their first offering of blood.

verses.raw: And they offered this offering again on the altar they had built at first. And they stood up and prayed, and besought Yahuah (Lord) saying, "Thus, O Elohim (God), when we were in the garden, our praises went up to you, like this offering; and our innocence went up to you like incense. But now, O Elohim (God), accept this offering from us, and don't turn us away, deprived of Your mercy."
verses.text: And they offered this offering again on the altar they had built at first. And they stood up and prayed, and besought Yahuah saying, "Thus, O Elohim, when we were in the garden, our praises went up to you, like this offering; and our innocence went up to you like incense. But now, O Elohim, accept this offering from us, and don't turn us away, deprived of Your mercy."

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam and Eve, "Since you have made this offering and have offered it to Me, I shall make it My flesh, when I come down on earth to save you; and I shall cause it to be offered continually on an altar, for forgiveness and for mercy, for those who partake of it duly."
verses.text: Then Elohim said to Adam and Eve, "Since you have made this offering and have offered it to Me, I shall make it My flesh, when I come down on earth to save you; and I shall cause it to be offered continually on an altar, for forgiveness and for mercy, for those who partake of it duly."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) sent a bright fire over the offering of Adam and Eve, and filled it with brightness, grace, and light; and the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) came down on that offering.
verses.text: And Elohim sent a bright fire over the offering of Adam and Eve, and filled it with brightness, grace, and light; and the Ruach HaKodesh came down on that offering.

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) commanded an angel to take fire tongs, like a spoon, and with it to take an offering and bring it to Adam and Eve. And the angel did so, as Elohim (God) had commanded him, and offered it to them.
verses.text: Then Elohim commanded an angel to take fire tongs, like a spoon, and with it to take an offering and bring it to Adam and Eve. And the angel did so, as Elohim had commanded him, and offered it to them.

verses.raw: And the souls of Adam and Eve were brightened, and their hearts were filled with joy and gladness and with the praises of Elohim (God).
verses.text: And the souls of Adam and Eve were brightened, and their hearts were filled with joy and gladness and with the praises of Elohim.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) said to Adam, "This shall be to you a custom, to do so, when affliction and sorrow come over you. But your deliverance and your entrance in to the garden, shall not be until the days are fulfilled as agreed between you and Me; were it not so, I would, of My mercy and pity for you, bring you back to My garden and to My favor for the sake of the offering you have just made to My name."
verses.text: And Elohim said to Adam, "This shall be to you a custom, to do so, when affliction and sorrow come over you. But your deliverance and your entrance in to the garden, shall not be until the days are fulfilled as agreed between you and Me; were it not so, I would, of My mercy and pity for you, bring you back to My garden and to My favor for the sake of the offering you have just made to My name."

verses.raw: Adam rejoiced at these words which he heard from Elohim (God); and he and Eve worshipped before the altar, to which they bowed, and then went back to the Cave of Treasures.
verses.text: Adam rejoiced at these words which he heard from Elohim; and he and Eve worshipped before the altar, to which they bowed, and then went back to the Cave of Treasures.

verses.raw: And this took place at the end of the twelfth day after the eightieth day, from the time Adam and Eve came out of the garden.
verses.text: And this took place at the end of the twelfth day after the eightieth day, from the time Adam and Eve came out of the garden.

verses.raw: And they stood up the whole night praying until morning; and then went out of the cave.
verses.text: And they stood up the whole night praying until morning; and then went out of the cave.

verses.raw: Then Adam said to Eve, with joy of heart, because of the offering they had made to Elohim (God), and that had been accepted of Him, "Let us do this three times every week, on the fourth day Wednesday, on the preparation day Friday, and on the Sabbath Sunday, all the days of our life."
verses.text: Then Adam said to Eve, with joy of heart, because of the offering they had made to Elohim, and that had been accepted of Him, "Let us do this three times every week, on the fourth day Wednesday, on the preparation day Friday, and on the Sabbath Sunday, all the days of our life."

verses.raw: And as they agreed to these words between themselves, Elohim (God) was pleased with their thoughts, and with the resolution they had each taken with the other.
verses.text: And as they agreed to these words between themselves, Elohim was pleased with their thoughts, and with the resolution they had each taken with the other.

verses.raw: After this, came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said, "O Adam, you have determined beforehand the days in which sufferings shall come over Me, when I am made flesh; for they are the fourth Wednesday, and the preparation day Friday.
verses.text: After this, came the Word of Elohim to Adam, and said, "O Adam, you have determined beforehand the days in which sufferings shall come over Me, when I am made flesh; for they are the fourth Wednesday, and the preparation day Friday.

verses.raw: But as to the first day, I created in it all things, and I raised the heavens. And, again, through My rising again on this day, will I create joy, and raise them on high, who believe in Me; O Adam, offer this offering, all the days of your life."
verses.text: But as to the first day, I created in it all things, and I raised the heavens. And, again, through My rising again on this day, will I create joy, and raise them on high, who believe in Me; O Adam, offer this offering, all the days of your life."

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) withdrew His Word from Adam.
verses.text: Then Elohim withdrew His Word from Adam.

verses.raw: But Adam continued to offer this offering thus, every week three times, until the end of seven weeks. And on the first day, which is the fiftieth, Adam made an offering as he was accustomed, and he and Eve took it and came to the altar before Elohim (God), as He had taught them.
verses.text: But Adam continued to offer this offering thus, every week three times, until the end of seven weeks. And on the first day, which is the fiftieth, Adam made an offering as he was accustomed, and he and Eve took it and came to the altar before Elohim, as He had taught them.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Satan, the hater of all good, envious of Adam and of his offering through which he found favor with Elohim (God), hastened and took a sharp stone from among the sharp iron stones; appeared in the form of a man, and went and stood by Adam and Eve.
verses.text: Then Satan, the hater of all good, envious of Adam and of his offering through which he found favor with Elohim, hastened and took a sharp stone from among the sharp iron stones; appeared in the form of a man, and went and stood by Adam and Eve.

verses.raw: Adam was then offering on the altar, and had begun to pray, with his hands spread before Elohim (God).
verses.text: Adam was then offering on the altar, and had begun to pray, with his hands spread before Elohim.

verses.raw: Then Satan hastened with the sharp iron stone he had with him, and with it pierced Adam on the right side, from which flowed blood and water, then Adam fell on the altar like a corpse. And Satan fled.
verses.text: Then Satan hastened with the sharp iron stone he had with him, and with it pierced Adam on the right side, from which flowed blood and water, then Adam fell on the altar like a corpse. And Satan fled.

verses.raw: Then Eve came, and took Adam and placed him below the altar. And there she stayed, crying over him; while a stream of blood flowed from Adam's side over his offering.
verses.text: Then Eve came, and took Adam and placed him below the altar. And there she stayed, crying over him; while a stream of blood flowed from Adam's side over his offering.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) looked at the death of Adam. He then sent His Word, and raised him up and said to him, "Fulfil your offering, for indeed, Adam, it is worth much, and there is no shortcoming in it."
verses.text: But Elohim looked at the death of Adam. He then sent His Word, and raised him up and said to him, "Fulfil your offering, for indeed, Adam, it is worth much, and there is no shortcoming in it."

verses.raw: Elohim (God) said further to Adam, "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth, when I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side and run over My body, which is the true offering; and which shall be offered on the altar as a perfect offering."
verses.text: Elohim said further to Adam, "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth, when I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side and run over My body, which is the true offering; and which shall be offered on the altar as a perfect offering."

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) commanded Adam to finish his offering, and when he had ended it he worshipped before Elohim (God), and praised Him for the signs He had showed him.
verses.text: Then Elohim commanded Adam to finish his offering, and when he had ended it he worshipped before Elohim, and praised Him for the signs He had showed him.

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) healed Adam in one day, which is the end of the seven weeks; and that is the fiftieth day.
verses.text: And Elohim healed Adam in one day, which is the end of the seven weeks; and that is the fiftieth day.

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve returned from the mountain, and went into the Cave of Treasures, as they were used to do. This completed for Adam and Eve, one hundred and forty days since their coming out of the garden.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve returned from the mountain, and went into the Cave of Treasures, as they were used to do. This completed for Adam and Eve, one hundred and forty days since their coming out of the garden.

verses.raw: Then they both stood up that night and prayed to Elohim (God). And when it was morning, they went out, and went down westward of the cave, to the place where their corn was, and there rested under the shadow of a tree, as they were accustomed.
verses.text: Then they both stood up that night and prayed to Elohim. And when it was morning, they went out, and went down westward of the cave, to the place where their corn was, and there rested under the shadow of a tree, as they were accustomed.

verses.raw: But when there a multitude of beasts came all around them. It was Satan's doing, in his wickedness; in order to wage war against Adam through marriage.
verses.text: But when there a multitude of beasts came all around them. It was Satan's doing, in his wickedness; in order to wage war against Adam through marriage.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: After this Satan, the hater of all good, took the form of an angel, and with him two others, so that they looked like the three angels who had brought to Adam gold, incense, and myrrh.
verses.text: After this Satan, the hater of all good, took the form of an angel, and with him two others, so that they looked like the three angels who had brought to Adam gold, incense, and myrrh.

verses.raw: They passed before Adam and Eve while they were under the tree, and greeted Adam and Eve with fair words that were full of deceit.
verses.text: They passed before Adam and Eve while they were under the tree, and greeted Adam and Eve with fair words that were full of deceit.

verses.raw: But when Adam and Eve saw their pleasant expression, and heard their sweet speech, Adam rose, welcomed them, and brought them to Eve, and they remained all together; Adam's heart the while, being glad because he thought concerning them, that they were the same angels, who had brought him gold, incense, and myrrh.
verses.text: But when Adam and Eve saw their pleasant expression, and heard their sweet speech, Adam rose, welcomed them, and brought them to Eve, and they remained all together; Adam's heart the while, being glad because he thought concerning them, that they were the same angels, who had brought him gold, incense, and myrrh.

verses.raw: Because, when they came to Adam the first time, there came over him from them, peace and joy, through their bringing him good tokens; so Adam thought that they had come a second time to give him other tokens for him to rejoice therewith. For he did not know it was Satan; therefore he received them with joy and consorted with them.
verses.text: Because, when they came to Adam the first time, there came over him from them, peace and joy, through their bringing him good tokens; so Adam thought that they had come a second time to give him other tokens for him to rejoice therewith. For he did not know it was Satan; therefore he received them with joy and consorted with them.

verses.raw: Then Satan, the tallest of them, said, "Rejoice, O Adam, and be glad. Look, Elohim (God) has sent us to you to tell you something."
verses.text: Then Satan, the tallest of them, said, "Rejoice, O Adam, and be glad. Look, Elohim has sent us to you to tell you something."

verses.raw: And Adam said, "What is it?" Then Satan answered, "It is a simple thing, yet it is the Word of Elohim (God), will you accept it from us and do it? But if you will not accept it, we will return to Elohim (God), and tell Him that you would not receive His Word."
verses.text: And Adam said, "What is it?" Then Satan answered, "It is a simple thing, yet it is the Word of Elohim, will you accept it from us and do it? But if you will not accept it, we will return to Elohim, and tell Him that you would not receive His Word."

verses.raw: And Satan said again to Adam, "Don't be afraid and don't tremble; don't you know us?"
verses.text: And Satan said again to Adam, "Don't be afraid and don't tremble; don't you know us?"

verses.raw: But Adam said, "I do not know you."
verses.text: But Adam said, "I do not know you."

verses.raw: Then Satan said to him, "I am the angel that brought you gold, and took it to the cave; this other angel is the one that brought you incense; and that third angel, is the one who brought you myrrh when you were on top of the mountain, and who carried you to the cave.
verses.text: Then Satan said to him, "I am the angel that brought you gold, and took it to the cave; this other angel is the one that brought you incense; and that third angel, is the one who brought you myrrh when you were on top of the mountain, and who carried you to the cave.

verses.raw: But as to the other angels our fellows, who bare you to the cave, Elohim (God) has not sent them with us this time; for He said to us, 'You will be enough'."
verses.text: But as to the other angels our fellows, who bare you to the cave, Elohim has not sent them with us this time; for He said to us, 'You will be enough'."

verses.raw: So when Adam heard these words he believed them, and said to these angels, "Speak the Word of Elohim (God), that I may receive it."
verses.text: So when Adam heard these words he believed them, and said to these angels, "Speak the Word of Elohim, that I may receive it."

verses.raw: And Satan said to him, "Swear, and promise me that you will receive it."
verses.text: And Satan said to him, "Swear, and promise me that you will receive it."

verses.raw: Then Adam said, "I do not know how to swear and promise."
verses.text: Then Adam said, "I do not know how to swear and promise."

verses.raw: And Satan said to him, "Hold out your hand, and put it inside my hand."
verses.text: And Satan said to him, "Hold out your hand, and put it inside my hand."

verses.raw: Then Adam held out his hand, and put it into Satan's hand; when Satan said to him, "Say, now--So true as Elohim (God) is living, rational, and speaking, who raised the stars in heaven, and established the dry ground on the waters, and has created me out of the four elements*, and out of the dust of the earth--I will not break my promise, nor renounce my word."
verses.text: Then Adam held out his hand, and put it into Satan's hand; when Satan said to him, "Say, now--So true as Elohim is living, rational, and speaking, who raised the stars in heaven, and established the dry ground on the waters, and has created me out of the four elements*, and out of the dust of the earth--I will not break my promise, nor renounce my word."

verses.raw: And Adam swore thus.
verses.text: And Adam swore thus.

verses.raw: Then Satan said to him, "Look, it is now some time since you came out of the garden, and you know neither wickedness nor evil. But now Elohim (God) says to you, to take Eve who came out of your side, and to marry her so that she will bear you children, to comfort you, and to drive from you trouble and sorrow; now this thing is not difficult, neither is there any scandal in it to you. * See the previous footnote in chapter XXXIV regarding the 'four elements'.
verses.text: Then Satan said to him, "Look, it is now some time since you came out of the garden, and you know neither wickedness nor evil. But now Elohim says to you, to take Eve who came out of your side, and to marry her so that she will bear you children, to comfort you, and to drive from you trouble and sorrow; now this thing is not difficult, neither is there any scandal in it to you. * See the previous footnote in chapter XXXIV regarding the 'four elements'.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: But when Adam heard these words from Satan, he sorrowed much, because of his oath and of his promise, and said, "Shall I commit adultery with my flesh and my bones, and shall I sin against myself, for Elohim (God) to destroy me, and to blot me out from off the face of the earth?
verses.text: But when Adam heard these words from Satan, he sorrowed much, because of his oath and of his promise, and said, "Shall I commit adultery with my flesh and my bones, and shall I sin against myself, for Elohim to destroy me, and to blot me out from off the face of the earth?

verses.raw: Since, when at first, I ate of the tree, He drove me out of the garden into this strange land, and deprived me of my bright nature, and brought death over me. If, then, I should do this, He will cut off my life from the earth, and He will cast me into hell, and will plague me there a long time.
verses.text: Since, when at first, I ate of the tree, He drove me out of the garden into this strange land, and deprived me of my bright nature, and brought death over me. If, then, I should do this, He will cut off my life from the earth, and He will cast me into hell, and will plague me there a long time.

verses.raw: But Elohim (God) never spoke the words that you have said; and you are not Elohim's (God's) angels, and you weren't sent from Him. But you are devils that have come to me under the false appearance of angels. Away from me; you cursed of Elohim (God)!"
verses.text: But Elohim never spoke the words that you have said; and you are not Elohim's (God's) angels, and you weren't sent from Him. But you are devils that have come to me under the false appearance of angels. Away from me; you cursed of Elohim!"

verses.raw: Then those devils fled from before Adam. And he and Eve got up, and returned to the Cave of Treasures, and went into it.
verses.text: Then those devils fled from before Adam. And he and Eve got up, and returned to the Cave of Treasures, and went into it.

verses.raw: Then Adam said to Eve, "If you saw what I did, don't tell anyone; for I sinned against Elohim (God) in swearing by His great name, and I have placed my hand another time into that of Satan." Eve, then, held her peace, as Adam told her.
verses.text: Then Adam said to Eve, "If you saw what I did, don't tell anyone; for I sinned against Elohim in swearing by His great name, and I have placed my hand another time into that of Satan." Eve, then, held her peace, as Adam told her.

verses.raw: Then Adam got up, and spread his hands before Elohim (God), beseeching and entreating Him with tears, to forgive him what he had done. And Adam remained thus standing and praying forty days and forty nights. He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.
verses.text: Then Adam got up, and spread his hands before Elohim, beseeching and entreating Him with tears, to forgive him what he had done. And Adam remained thus standing and praying forty days and forty nights. He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.

verses.raw: Then Elohim (God) sent His Word to Adam, who raised him up from where he lay, and said to him, "O Adam, why have you sworn by My name, and why have you made agreement with Satan another time?"
verses.text: Then Elohim sent His Word to Adam, who raised him up from where he lay, and said to him, "O Adam, why have you sworn by My name, and why have you made agreement with Satan another time?"

verses.raw: But Adam cried, and said, "O Elohim (God), forgive me, for I did this unwittingly; believing they were Elohim's (God's) angels."
verses.text: But Adam cried, and said, "O Elohim, forgive me, for I did this unwittingly; believing they were Elohim's (God's) angels."

verses.raw: And Elohim (God) forgave Adam, saying to him, "Beware of Satan."
verses.text: And Elohim forgave Adam, saying to him, "Beware of Satan."

verses.raw: And He withdrew His Word from Adam.
verses.text: And He withdrew His Word from Adam.

verses.raw: Then Adam's heart was comforted; and he took Eve, and they went out of the cave, to prepare some food for their bodies.
verses.text: Then Adam's heart was comforted; and he took Eve, and they went out of the cave, to prepare some food for their bodies.

verses.raw: But from that day Adam struggled in his mind about his marrying Eve; afraid that if he was to do it, Elohim (God) would be angry with him.
verses.text: But from that day Adam struggled in his mind about his marrying Eve; afraid that if he was to do it, Elohim would be angry with him.

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve went to the river of water, and sat on the bank, as people do when they enjoy themselves.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve went to the river of water, and sat on the bank, as people do when they enjoy themselves.

verses.raw: But Satan was jealous of them; and planned to destroy them.
verses.text: But Satan was jealous of them; and planned to destroy them.

title: The First Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: Then Satan, and ten from his hosts, transformed themselves into maidens, unlike any others in the whole world for grace.
verses.text: Then Satan, and ten from his hosts, transformed themselves into maidens, unlike any others in the whole world for grace.

verses.raw: They came up out of the river in presence of Adam and Eve, and they said among themselves, "Come, we will look at the faces of Adam and Eve, who are of the men on earth. How beautiful they are, and how different is their look from our own faces." Then they came to Adam and Eve, and greeted them; and stood wondering at them.
verses.text: They came up out of the river in presence of Adam and Eve, and they said among themselves, "Come, we will look at the faces of Adam and Eve, who are of the men on earth. How beautiful they are, and how different is their look from our own faces." Then they came to Adam and Eve, and greeted them; and stood wondering at them.

verses.raw: Adam and Eve looked at them also, and wondered at their beauty, and said, "Is there, then, under us, another world, with such beautiful creatures as these in it?"
verses.text: Adam and Eve looked at them also, and wondered at their beauty, and said, "Is there, then, under us, another world, with such beautiful creatures as these in it?"

verses.raw: And those maidens said to Adam and Eve, "Yes, indeed, we are an abundant creation."
verses.text: And those maidens said to Adam and Eve, "Yes, indeed, we are an abundant creation."

verses.raw: Then Adam said to them, "But how do you multiply?"
verses.text: Then Adam said to them, "But how do you multiply?"

verses.raw: And they answered him, "We have husbands who have married us, and we bear them children, who grow up, and who in their turn marry and are married, and also bear children; and thus we increase. And if so be, O Adam, you will not believe us, we will show you our husbands and our children."
verses.text: And they answered him, "We have husbands who have married us, and we bear them children, who grow up, and who in their turn marry and are married, and also bear children; and thus we increase. And if so be, O Adam, you will not believe us, we will show you our husbands and our children."

verses.raw: Then they shouted over the river as if to call their husbands and their children, who came up from the river, men and children; and every man came to his wife, his children being with him.
verses.text: Then they shouted over the river as if to call their husbands and their children, who came up from the river, men and children; and every man came to his wife, his children being with him.

verses.raw: But when Adam and Eve saw them, they stood dumb, and wondered at them.
verses.text: But when Adam and Eve saw them, they stood dumb, and wondered at them.

verses.raw: Then they said to Adam and Eve, "See all our husbands and our children? You should marry Eve, as we have married our husbands, so that you will have children as we have." This was a device of Satan to deceive Adam.
verses.text: Then they said to Adam and Eve, "See all our husbands and our children? You should marry Eve, as we have married our husbands, so that you will have children as we have." This was a device of Satan to deceive Adam.

verses.raw: Satan also thought within himself, "Elohim (God) at first commanded Adam concerning the fruit of the tree, saying to him, 'Eat not of it; else of death you shall die.' But Adam ate of it, and yet Elohim (God) did not kill him; He only decreed on him death, and plagues and trials, until the day he shall come out of his body.
verses.text: Satan also thought within himself, "Elohim at first commanded Adam concerning the fruit of the tree, saying to him, 'Eat not of it; else of death you shall die.' verses.raw: Now, then, if I deceive him to do this thing, and to marry Eve without Elohim's (God's) permission, Elohim (God) will kill him then."
verses.text: Now, then, if I deceive him to do this thing, and to marry Eve without Elohim's (God's) permission, Elohim will kill him then."

verses.raw: Therefore Satan worked this apparition before Adam and Eve; because he sought to kill him, and to make him disappear from off the face of the earth.
verses.text: Therefore Satan worked this apparition before Adam and Eve; because he sought to kill him, and to make him disappear from off the face of the earth.

verses.raw: Meanwhile the fire of sin came over Adam, and he thought of committing sin. But he restrained himself, fearing that if he followed this advice of Satan, Elohim (God) would put him to death.
verses.text: Meanwhile the fire of sin came over Adam, and he thought of committing sin. But he restrained himself, fearing that if he followed this advice of Satan, Elohim would put him to death.

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve got up, and prayed to Elohim (God), while Satan and his hosts went down into the river, in presence of Adam and Eve; to let them see that they were going back to their own world.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve got up, and prayed to Elohim, while Satan and his hosts went down into the river, in presence of Adam and Eve; to let them see that they were going back to their own world.

verses.raw: Then Adam and Eve went back to the Cave of Treasures, as they usually did; about evening time.
verses.text: Then Adam and Eve went back to the Cave of Treasures, as they usually did; about evening time.

verses.raw: And they both got up and prayed to Elohim (God) that night. Adam remained standing in prayer, yet not knowing how to pray, by reason of the thoughts in his heart regarding his marrying Eve; and he continued so until morning.
verses.text: And they both got up and prayed to Elohim that night. Adam remained standing in prayer, yet not knowing how to pray, by reason of the thoughts in his heart regarding his marrying Eve; and he continued so until morning.

verses.raw: And when light came up, Adam said to Eve, "Get up, let us go below the mountain, where they brought us gold, and let us ask Yahuah (Lord) concerning this matter."
verses.text: And when light came up, Adam said to Eve, "Get up, let us go below the mountain, where they brought us gold, and let us ask Yahuah concerning this matter."

verses.raw: Then Eve said, "What is that matter, O Adam?"

But when it is spoiled, the gold the incense, and the myrrh shall be taken care of with the spoil that is kept; and naught of them shall perish, until the Word of Elohim (God), made man shall come; when kings shall take them, and shall offer to Him, gold in token of His being King; incense, in token of His being Elohim (God) of heaven and earth; and myrrh, in token of His passion.
verses.text: "Then, after a long time, the city in which the gold, the incense, and the myrrh are found with my body, shall be plundered. But when it is spoiled, the gold the incense, and the myrrh shall be taken care of with the spoil that is kept; and naught of them shall perish, until the Word of Elohim, made man shall come; when kings shall take them, and shall offer to Him, gold in token of His being King; incense, in token of His being Elohim of heaven and earth; and myrrh, in token of His passion.

verses.raw: "Gold also, as a token of His overcoming Satan, and all our foes; incense as a token that He will rise from the dead, and be exalted above things in heaven and things in the earth; and myrrh, in token that He will drink bitter gall; and feel the pains of hell from Satan.
verses.text: "Gold also, as a token of His overcoming Satan, and all our foes; incense as a token that He will rise from the dead, and be exalted above things in heaven and things in the earth; and myrrh, in token that He will drink bitter gall; and feel the pains of hell from Satan.

verses.raw: "And now, 0 Seth, my son, behold I have revealed unto thee hidden mysteries, which Elohim (God) had revealed unto me. Keep my commandment, for thyself, and for thy people."
verses.text: "And now, 0 Seth, my son, behold I have revealed unto thee hidden mysteries, which Elohim had revealed unto me. Keep my commandment, for thyself, and for thy people."

title: The Second Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: WHEN Adam had ended his commandment to Seth, his limbs were loosened, his hands and feet lost all power, his mouth became dumb, and his tongue ceased altogether to speak. He closed his eyes and gave up the ghost.
verses.text: WHEN Adam had ended his commandment to Seth, his limbs were loosened, his hands and feet lost all power, his mouth became dumb, and his tongue ceased altogether to speak. He closed his eyes and gave up the ghost.

verses.raw: But when his children saw that he was dead, they threw themselves over him, men and women, old and young, weeping.
verses.text: But when his children saw that he was dead, they threw themselves over him, men and women, old and young, weeping.

verses.raw: The death of Adam took place at the end of nine hundred and thirty years that he lived upon the earth; on the fifteenth day of Barmudeh, after the reckoning of an epact of the sun, at the ninth hour.
verses.text: The death of Adam took place at the end of nine hundred and thirty years that he lived upon the earth; on the fifteenth day of Barmudeh, after the reckoning of an epact of the sun, at the ninth hour.

verses.raw: It was on a Friday, the very day on which he was created, and on which he rested; and the hour at which he died, was the same as that at which he came out of the garden.
verses.text: It was on a Friday, the very day on which he was created, and on which he rested; and the hour at which he died, was the same as that at which he came out of the garden.

verses.raw: Then Seth wound him up well, and embalmed him with plenty of sweet spices, from sacred trees and from the Holy Mountain; and he laid his body on the eastern side of the inside of the cave, the side of the incense; and placed in front of him a lamp - stand kept burning.

verses.raw: Then his children stood before him weeping and wailing over him the whole night until break of day.

verses.raw: Then Seth and his son Enos, and Cainan, the son of Enos, went out and took good offerings to present unto Yahuah (Lord), and they came to the altar upon which Adam offered gifts to Elohim (God), when he did offer.

verses.raw: But Eve said to them, "Wait until we have first asked Elohim (God) to accept our offering, and to keep by Him the soul of Adam His servant, and to take it up to rest."

verses.raw: And they all stood up and prayed.

title: The Second Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: AND when they had ended their prayer, the Word of Elohim (God) came and comforted them concerning their father Adam.

verses.raw: After this, they offered their gifts for themselves and for their father.
verses.text: After this, they offered their gifts for themselves and for their father.

verses.raw: And when they had ended their offering, the Word of Elohim (God) came to Seth, the eldest among them, saying unto him, "0 Seth, Seth, Seth, three times. As I was with thy father, so also shall I be with thee, until the fulfilment of the promise I made him - thy father saying, I will send My Word and save thee and thy seed.

verses.text: "But as to thy father Adam, keep thou the commandment he gave thee; and sever thy seed from that of Cain thy brother."

verses.raw: Then Seth, Eve, and their children, came down from the mountain to the Cave of Treasures.
verses.text: Then Seth, Eve, and their children, came down from the mountain to the Cave of Treasures.

verses.raw: But Adam was the first whose soul died in the land of Eden, in the Cave of Treasures; for no one died before him, but his son Abel, who died murdered.

verses.raw: Then all the children of Adam rose up, and wept over their father Adam, and made offerings to him, one hundred and forty days.
verses.text: Then all the children of Adam rose up, and wept over their father Adam, and made offerings to him, one hundred and forty days.

title: The Second Book of Adam and Eve

verses.raw: AFTER the death of Adam and of Eve, Seth severed his children, and his children's children, from Cain's children. Cain and his seed went down and dwelt westward, below the place where he had killed his brother Abel.
verses.text: AFTER the death of Adam and of Eve, Seth severed his children, and his children's children, from Cain's children. Cain and his seed went down and dwelt westward, below the place where he had killed his brother Abel.

verses.raw: But Seth and his children, dwelt northwards upon the mountain of the Cave of Treasures, in order to be near to their father Adam.
verses.text: But Seth and his children, dwelt northwards upon the mountain of the Cave of Treasures, in order to be near to their father Adam.

verses.raw: And Seth the elder, tall and good, with a fine soul, and of a strong mind, stood at the head of his people; and tended them in innocence, penitence, and meekness, and did not allow one of them to go down to Cain's children.

verses.raw: But because of their own purity, they were named "Children of Elohim (God)," and they were with Elohim (God), instead of the hosts of angels who fell; for they continued in praises to Elohim (God), and in singing psalms unto Him, in their cave - the Cave of Treasures.

verses.raw: Then Seth stood before the body of his father Adam, and of his mother Eve, and prayed night and day, and asked for mercy towards himself and his children; and that when he had some difficult dealing with a child, He would give him counsel.
verses.text: Then Seth stood before the body of his father Adam, and of his mother Eve, and prayed night and day, and asked for mercy towards himself and his children; and that when he had some difficult dealing with a child, He would give him counsel.

verses.raw: But Seth and his children did not like earthly work, but gave themselves to heavenly things; for they had no other thought than praises, doxologies, and psalms unto Elohim (God).
verses.text: But Seth and his children did not like earthly work, but gave themselves to heavenly things; for they had no other thought than praises, doxologies, and psalms unto Elohim.

verses.raw: Therefore did they at all times hear the voices of angels, praising and glorifying Elohim (God); from within the garden, or when they were sent by Elohim (God) on an errand, or when they were going up to heaven.

verses.raw: For Seth and his children, by reason of their own purity, heard and saw those angels. Then, again, the garden was not far above them, but only some fifteen spiritual cubits.
verses.text: For Seth and his children, by reason of their own purity, heard and saw those angels. Then, again, the garden was not far above them, but only some fifteen spiritual cubits.

verses.raw: Now one spiritual cubit answers to three cubits of man, altogether forty-five cubits.
verses.text: Now one spiritual cubit answers to three cubits of man, altogether forty-five cubits.

verses.raw: Seth and his children dwelt on the mountain below the garden; they sowed not, neither did they reap; they wrought no food for the body. not even wheat; but only offerings. They ate of the fruit and of trees well flavoured that grew on the mountain where they dwelt.

verses.raw: Then Seth often fasted every forty days, as did also his eldest children. For the family of Seth smelled the smell of the trees in the garden, when the wind blew that way.
verses.text: Then Seth often fasted every forty days, as did also his eldest children. For the family of Seth smelled the smell of the trees in the garden, when the wind blew that way.

verses.raw: They were happy, innocent, without sudden fear, there was no jealousy, no evil action, no hatred among them. There was no animal passion; from no mouth among them went forth either foul words or curse; neither evil counsel nor fraud. For the men of that time never swore, but under hard circumstances, when men must swear, they swore by the blood of Abel the just.

For the men of that time never swore, but under hard circumstances, when men must swear, they swore by the blood of Abel the just.

verses.raw: But they constrained their children and their women every day in the cave to fast and pray, and to worship the most High Elohim (God). They blessed themselves in the body of their father Adam, and anointed themselves with it.

verses.raw: Adam's family fared. THEN Seth, the just, called his son Enos, and Cainan, son of Enos, and Mahalaleel, son of Cainan, and said unto them:-
verses.text: Adam's family fared. THEN Seth, the just, called his son Enos, and Cainan, son of Enos, and Mahalaleel, son of Cainan, and said unto them:-

verses.raw: "As my end is near, I wish to build a roof over the altar on which gifts are offered."
verses.text: "As my end is near, I wish to build a roof over the altar on which gifts are offered."

verses.raw: They hearkened to his commandment and went out, all of them, both old and young, and worked hard at it, and built a beautiful roof over the altar.
verses.text: They hearkened to his commandment and went out, all of them, both old and young, and worked hard at it, and built a beautiful roof over the altar.

verses.raw: Then Seth and his children, and his children's children, met together, and came down from the altar, and went to the Cave of Treasures - where they prayed, and blessed themselves in the body of our father Adam, and anointed themselves with it.

verses.text: Then Seth prayed over them, and blessed them, and adjured them by the blood of Abel the just, saying, "I beg of you my children, not to let one of you go down from this Holy and pure Mountain.

verses.raw: Make no fellowship with the children of Cain the murderer and the sinner, who killed his brother; for ye know, 0 my children, that we flee from him, and from all his sin with all our might because he killed his brother Abel."

verses.raw: After having said this, Seth blessed Enos, his first - born son, and commanded him habitually to minister in purity before the body of our father Adam, all the days of his life; then, also, to go at times to the altar which he Seth had built. verses.raw: But by the time Enos was eight hundred and twenty years old, Cain had a large progeny; for they married frequently, being given to animal lusts; until the land below the mountain, was filled with them.

verses.raw: IN those days lived Lamech the blind, who was of the sons of Cain. He had a son whose name was Atun, and they two had much cattle.
verses.text: IN those days lived Lamech the blind, who was of the sons of Cain. He had a son whose name was Atun, and they two had much cattle.

verses.raw: But Lamech was in the habit of sending them to feed with a young shepherd, who tended them; and who, when coming home in the evening wept before his grandfather, and before his father Atun and his mother Hazina, and said to them, "As for me, I cannot feed those cattle alone, lest one rob me of some of them, or kill me for the sake of them." For among the children of Cain, there was much robbery, murder and sin.

verses.raw: Then Lamech pitied him, and he said, "Truly, he when alone, might be overpowered by the men of this place."

verses.raw: So Lamech arose, took a bow he had kept ever since he was a youth, ere he became blind, and he took large arrows, and smooth stones, and a sling which he had, and went to the field with the young shepherd, and placed himself behind the cattle; while the young shepherd watched the cattle. Thus did Lamech many days.

verses.raw: Meanwhile Cain, ever since Elohim (God) had cast him off, and had cursed him with trembling and terror, could neither settle nor find rest in any one place; but wandered from place to place.
