verses.text: I am the one who was commissioned to set on fire thy father's house together with him, because he displayed reverence for dead idols.

verses.raw: I have been sent to bless thee now, and the land which the Eternal One, whom thou hast invoked, hath prepared for thee, and for thy sake have I wended my way upon the earth.
verses.text: I have been sent to bless thee now, and the land which the Eternal One, whom thou hast invoked, hath prepared for thee, and for thy sake have I wended my way upon the earth.

verses.raw: Stand up, Abraham!
verses.text: Stand up, Abraham!

verses.raw: Go without fear, be right glad and rejoice; and I am with thee!
verses.text: Go without fear, be right glad and rejoice; and I am with thee!

verses.raw: For eternal honour hath been prepared for thee by the Eternal One.
verses.text: For eternal honour hath been prepared for thee by the Eternal One.

verses.raw: Go, fulfil the sacrifices commanded.
verses.text: Go, fulfil the sacrifices commanded.

verses.raw: For, lo, I have been appointed to be with thee and with the generation prepared to spring from thee; and with me Michael blesseth thee for ever.
verses.text: For, lo, I have been appointed to be with thee and with the generation prepared to spring from thee; and with me Michael blesseth thee for ever.

verses.raw: Be of good cheer, go!"
verses.text: Be of good cheer, go!"

verses.raw: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.
verses.text: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.

verses.raw: And he said to me: "Abraham!"
verses.text: And he said to me: "Abraham!"

verses.raw: And I said: "Here am I, thy servant."
verses.text: And I said: "Here am I, thy servant."

verses.raw: And he said: "Let not my look affright thee, nor my speech, that thy soul be not perturbed.
verses.text: And he said: "Let not my look affright thee, nor my speech, that thy soul be not perturbed.

verses.raw: Come with me and I will go with thee, until the sacrifice, visible; but after the sacrifice, invisible for ever.
verses.text: Come with me and I will go with thee, until the sacrifice, visible; but after the sacrifice, invisible for ever.

verses.raw: Be of good cheer, and come!"
verses.text: Be of good cheer, and come!"

verses.raw: And we went, the two of us together, forty days and nights, and I ate no bread, and drank no water, because my food was to see the angel who was with me, and his speech — that was my drink.
verses.text: And we went, the two of us together, forty days and nights, and I ate no bread, and drank no water, because my food was to see the angel who was with me, and his speech — that was my drink.

verses.raw: And we came to the Mount of Elohim (God), the glorious Horeb.
verses.text: And we came to the Mount of Elohim, the glorious Horeb.

verses.raw: And I said to the angel: "Singer of the Eternal One!
verses.text: And I said to the angel: "Singer of the Eternal One!

verses.raw: Lo, I have no sacrifice with me, nor am I aware of a place of an altar on the mountain: how can I bring a sacrifice?"
verses.text: Lo, I have no sacrifice with me, nor am I aware of a place of an altar on the mountain: how can I bring a sacrifice?"

verses.raw: And he said to me: "Look round!"
verses.text: And he said to me: "Look round!"

verses.raw: And I looked round, and lo, there were following us all the prescribed sacrificial animals — the young heifer, and the she-goat, and the ram, and the turtle-dove, and the pigeon.
verses.text: And I looked round, and lo, there were following us all the prescribed sacrificial animals — the young heifer, and the she-goat, and the ram, and the turtle-dove, and the pigeon.

verses.raw: And the angel said to me: "Abraham!"
verses.text: And the angel said to me: "Abraham!"

verses.raw: I said: "Here am I."
verses.text: I said: "Here am I."

verses.raw: And he said to me: "All these slaughter, and divide the animals into halves, one against the other, but the birds do not sever; and give to the men, whom I will shew thee, standing by thee, for these are the altar upon the Mountain, to offer a sacrifice to the Eternal; but the turtledove and the pigeon give to me, for I will ascend upon the wings of the bird, in order to shew thee in heaven, and on the earth, and in the sea, and in the abyss, and in the under-world, and in the Garden of Eden, and in its rivers and in the fulness of the whole world and its circle — thou shalt gaze in them all."
verses.text: And he said to me: "All these slaughter, and divide the animals into halves, one against the other, but the birds do not sever; and give to the men, whom I will shew thee, standing by thee, for these are the altar upon the Mountain, to offer a sacrifice to the Eternal; but the turtledove and the pigeon give to me, for I will ascend upon the wings of the bird, in order to shew thee in heaven, and on the earth, and in the sea, and in the abyss, and in the under-world, and in the Garden of Eden, and in its rivers and in the fulness of the whole world and its circle — thou shalt gaze in them all."

verses.raw: And I did everything according to the commandment of the angel, and gave the angels, who had come to us, the divided animals, but the angel took the birds.
verses.text: And I did everything according to the commandment of the angel, and gave the angels, who had come to us, the divided animals, but the angel took the birds.

verses.raw: And I waited for the evening sacrifice.
verses.text: And I waited for the evening sacrifice.

verses.raw: And there flew an unclean bird down upon the carcasses, and I drove it away.
verses.text: And there flew an unclean bird down upon the carcasses, and I drove it away.

verses.raw: And the unclean bird spake to me, and said: "What doest thou, Abraham, upon the holy Heights, where no man eateth or drinketh, neither is there upon them any food of man, but these consume everything with fire, and will burn thee up?
verses.text: And the unclean bird spake to me, and said: "What doest thou, Abraham, upon the holy Heights, where no man eateth or drinketh, neither is there upon them any food of man, but these consume everything with fire, and will burn thee up?

verses.raw: Forsake the man who is with thee, and flee; for if thou ascendest to the Heights they will make an end of thee."
verses.text: Forsake the man who is with thee, and flee; for if thou ascendest to the Heights they will make an end of thee."

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when I saw the bird speak, I said to the angel: "What is this, my lord?"
verses.text: And it came to pass, when I saw the bird speak, I said to the angel: "What is this, my lord?"

verses.raw: And he said: "This is ungodliness, this is Azazel."
verses.text: And he said: "This is ungodliness, this is Azazel."

verses.raw: And he said to it: "Disgrace upon thee, Azazel!
verses.text: And he said to it: "Disgrace upon thee, Azazel!

verses.raw: For Abraham's lot is in heaven, but thine upon the earth.
verses.text: For Abraham's lot is in heaven, but thine upon the earth.

verses.raw: Because thou hast chosen and loved this for the dwelling-place of thine uncleanness, therefore the eternal mighty Yahuah (Lord) made thee a dweller upon the earth, and through thee every evil spirit of lies, and through thee wrath and trials for the generations of ungodly men; for Elohim (God), the Eternal, Mighty One, hath not permitted that the bodies of the righteous should be in thy hand, in order that thereby the life of the righteous and the destruction of the unclean may be assured.
verses.text: Because thou hast chosen and loved this for the dwelling-place of thine uncleanness, therefore the eternal mighty Yahuah made thee a dweller upon the earth, and through thee every evil spirit of lies, and through thee wrath and trials for the generations of ungodly men; for Elohim, the Eternal, Mighty One, hath not permitted that the bodies of the righteous should be in thy hand, in order that thereby the life of the righteous and the destruction of the unclean may be assured.

verses.raw: Hear, friend, begone with shame from me.
verses.text: Hear, friend, begone with shame from me.

verses.raw: For it hath not been given to thee to play the tempter in regard to all the righteous.
verses.text: For it hath not been given to thee to play the tempter in regard to all the righteous.

verses.raw: Depart from this man!
verses.text: Depart from this man!

verses.raw: Thou canst not lead him astray, because he is an enemy to thee, and of those who follow thee and love what thou willest.
verses.text: Thou canst not lead him astray, because he is an enemy to thee, and of those who follow thee and love what thou willest.

verses.raw: For, behold, the vesture which in heaven was formerly thine hath been set aside for him, and the mortality which was his hath been transferred to thee."
verses.text: For, behold, the vesture which in heaven was formerly thine hath been set aside for him, and the mortality which was his hath been transferred to thee."

verses.raw: The angel said to me: "Abraham!"
verses.text: The angel said to me: "Abraham!"

verses.raw: And I said: "Here am I, thy servant."
verses.text: And I said: "Here am I, thy servant."

verses.raw: And he said: "Know from henceforth that the Eternal One hath chosen thee, He whom thou lovest; be of good courage and use this authority, so far as I bid thee, against him who slandereth truth; should I not be able to put him to shame who hath scattered over the earth the secrets of heaven and hath rebelled against the Mighty One?
verses.text: And he said: "Know from henceforth that the Eternal One hath chosen thee, He whom thou lovest; be of good courage and use this authority, so far as I bid thee, against him who slandereth truth; should I not be able to put him to shame who hath scattered over the earth the secrets of heaven and hath rebelled against the Mighty One?

verses.raw: Say to him: 'Be thou the burning coal of the Furnace of the earth; go, Azazel, into the inaccessible parts of the earth; for thy heritage is to be over those existing with thee, being born with the stars and clouds, with the men whose portion thou art, and who through thy being exist; and thine enmity is justification.
verses.text: Say to him: 'Be thou the burning coal of the Furnace of the earth; go, Azazel, into the inaccessible parts of the earth; for thy heritage is to be over those existing with thee, being born with the stars and clouds, with the men whose portion thou art, and who through thy being exist; and thine enmity is justification.

verses.raw: On this account, by thy perdition disappear from me.'" And I uttered the words which the angel had taught me.
verses.text: On this account, by thy perdition disappear from me.'" And I uttered the words which the angel had taught me.

verses.raw: And he said: "Abraham!"
verses.text: And he said: "Abraham!"

verses.raw: And I said: "Here am I, thy servant."
verses.text: And I said: "Here am I, thy servant."

verses.raw: And the angel said to me: "Answer him not; for Elohim (God) hath given him power (lit. will) over those who do answer him."
verses.text: And the angel said to me: "Answer him not; for Elohim hath given him power (lit. will) over those who do answer him."

verses.raw: And the angel spake to me a second time and said: "Now rather, however much he speak to thee, answer him not, that his will may have no free course in thee, because the Eternal and Mighty One hath given him weight and will; answer him not."
verses.text: And the angel spake to me a second time and said: "Now rather, however much he speak to thee, answer him not, that his will may have no free course in thee, because the Eternal and Mighty One hath given him weight and will; answer him not."

verses.raw: I did what was commanded me by the angel; and however much he spake to me, I answered him nothing whatsoever.
verses.text: I did what was commanded me by the angel; and however much he spake to me, I answered him nothing whatsoever.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the sun went down, and lo, a smoke as of a furnace.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the sun went down, and lo, a smoke as of a furnace.

verses.raw: And the angels who had the portions of the sacrifice ascended from the top of the smoking furnace.
verses.text: And the angels who had the portions of the sacrifice ascended from the top of the smoking furnace.

verses.raw: And the Angel took me with the right hand and set me on the right wing of the pigeon, and set himself on the left wing of the turtle-dove, which birds had neither been slaughtered nor divided.
verses.text: And the Angel took me with the right hand and set me on the right wing of the pigeon, and set himself on the left wing of the turtle-dove, which birds had neither been slaughtered nor divided.

verses.raw: And he bore me to the borders of the flaming fire, and we ascended as with many winds to the heaven which was fixed upon the surface.
verses.text: And he bore me to the borders of the flaming fire, and we ascended as with many winds to the heaven which was fixed upon the surface.

verses.raw: And I saw on the air, on the height to which we ascended, a strong light which it was impossible to describe, and lo, in this light a fiercely burning fire for people, many people of male appearance, all constantly changing in aspect and form, running and being transformed, and worshipping and crying with a sound of words which I knew not.
verses.text: And I saw on the air, on the height to which we ascended, a strong light which it was impossible to describe, and lo, in this light a fiercely burning fire for people, many people of male appearance, all constantly changing in aspect and form, running and being transformed, and worshipping and crying with a sound of words which I knew not.

verses.raw: And I said to the Angel: "Why hast thou brought me up here now, because I cannot now see, for I am already grown weak, and my spirit departeth from me?"
verses.text: And I said to the Angel: "Why hast thou brought me up here now, because I cannot now see, for I am already grown weak, and my spirit departeth from me?"

verses.raw: And he said to me: "Remain by me; fear not.
verses.text: And he said to me: "Remain by me; fear not.

verses.raw: And He whom thou seest come straight towards us with great voice of holiness — that is the Eternal One who loveth thee; but Himself thou canst not see.
verses.text: And He whom thou seest come straight towards us with great voice of holiness — that is the Eternal One who loveth thee; but Himself thou canst not see.

verses.raw: But let not thy spirit grow faint on account of the loud crying, for I am with thee, strengthening thee."
verses.text: But let not thy spirit grow faint on account of the loud crying, for I am with thee, strengthening thee."

verses.raw: And while he yet spake, and lo, fire came against us round about, and a voice was in the fire like a voice of many waters, like the sound of the sea in its uproar.
verses.text: And while he yet spake, and lo, fire came against us round about, and a voice was in the fire like a voice of many waters, like the sound of the sea in its uproar.

verses.raw: And the angel bent his head with me and worshipped.
verses.text: And the angel bent his head with me and worshipped.

verses.raw: And I desired to fall down upon the earth, and the high place, on which we stood, at one moment rose upright, but at another rolled downwards.
verses.text: And I desired to fall down upon the earth, and the high place, on which we stood, at one moment rose upright, but at another rolled downwards.

verses.raw: And he said: "Only worship, Abraham, and utter the song which I have taught thee;" because there was no earth to fall upon.
verses.text: And he said: "Only worship, Abraham, and utter the song which I have taught thee;" because there was no earth to fall upon.

verses.raw: And I worshipped only, and uttered the song which he had taught me.
verses.text: And I worshipped only, and uttered the song which he had taught me.

verses.raw: And he said: "Recite without ceasing."
verses.text: And he said: "Recite without ceasing."

verses.raw: And I recited, and he also himself with me recited the song: "Eternal, mighty, Holy, El, Elohim (God) only — Supreme!
verses.text: And I recited, and he also himself with me recited the song: "Eternal, mighty, Holy, El, Elohim only — Supreme!

verses.raw: Thou who art self-originated, incorruptible, spotless, Uncreate, immaculate, immortal, Self-complete, self-illuminating, Without father, without mother, unbegotten, Exalted, fiery One!
verses.text: Thou who art self-originated, incorruptible, spotless, Uncreate, immaculate, immortal, Self-complete, self-illuminating, Without father, without mother, unbegotten, Exalted, fiery One!

verses.raw: Lover of men, benevolent, bountiful, jealous over me and very compassionate; Eli, that is, My Elohim (God) — Eternal, mighty, holy Sabaoth, very glorious.
verses.text: Lover of men, benevolent, bountiful, jealous over me and very compassionate; Eli, that is, My Elohim — Eternal, mighty, holy Sabaoth, very glorious.

verses.raw: El, El, El, El, Jaoel!
verses.text: El, El, El, El, Jaoel!

verses.raw: Thou art He whom my soul hath loved!
verses.text: Thou art He whom my soul hath loved!

verses.raw: Eternal Protector, shining like fire, Whose voice is like the thunder, Whose look is like the lightning, all-seeing, Who receiveth the prayers of such as honour Thee, and turneth away from the requests of such as embarrass with the embarrassment of their provocations, Who dissolveth the confusions of the world which arise from the ungodly and righteous in the corruptible age, renewing the age of the righteous!
verses.text: Eternal Protector, shining like fire, Whose voice is like the thunder, Whose look is like the lightning, all-seeing, Who receiveth the prayers of such as honour Thee, and turneth away from the requests of such as embarrass with the embarrassment of their provocations, Who dissolveth the confusions of the world which arise from the ungodly and righteous in the corruptible age, renewing the age of the righteous!

verses.raw: Thou, O Light, shinest before the light of the morning upon Thy creatures, so that it becometh a day upon the earth; and in Thy heavenly dwelling-places there is no need of any other light than that of the unspeakable splendour from the lights of Thy countenance.
verses.text: Thou, O Light, shinest before the light of the morning upon Thy creatures, so that it becometh a day upon the earth; and in Thy heavenly dwelling-places there is no need of any other light than that of the unspeakable splendour from the lights of Thy countenance.

verses.raw: Accept my prayer, and be well-pleased with it, likewise also the sacrifice which Thou hast prepared Thee through me who sought Thee!
verses.text: Accept my prayer, and be well-pleased with it, likewise also the sacrifice which Thou hast prepared Thee through me who sought Thee!

verses.raw: Accept me favourably, and shew me, and teach me, and make known to Thy servant as Thou hast promised me!"
verses.text: Accept me favourably, and shew me, and teach me, and make known to Thy servant as Thou hast promised me!"

verses.raw: And while I still recited the song, the mouth of the fire which was on the surface rose up on high.
verses.text: And while I still recited the song, the mouth of the fire which was on the surface rose up on high.

verses.raw: And I heard a voice like the roaring of the sea, nor did it cease on account of the rich abundance of the fire.
verses.text: And I heard a voice like the roaring of the sea, nor did it cease on account of the rich abundance of the fire.

verses.raw: And as the fire raised itself up, ascending into the height, I saw under the fire a throne of fire, and, round about it, all-seeing ones, reciting the song; and under the throne four fiery living creatures singing, and their appearance was one, each one of them with four faces.
verses.text: And as the fire raised itself up, ascending into the height, I saw under the fire a throne of fire, and, round about it, all-seeing ones, reciting the song; and under the throne four fiery living creatures singing, and their appearance was one, each one of them with four faces.

verses.raw: And such was the appearance of their countenances, of a lion, of a man, of an ox, of an eagle: four heads were upon their bodies, so that the four creatures had sixteen faces; and each had six wings from their shoulders, and their sides, and their loins.
verses.text: And such was the appearance of their countenances, of a lion, of a man, of an ox, of an eagle: four heads were upon their bodies, so that the four creatures had sixteen faces; and each had six wings from their shoulders, and their sides, and their loins.

verses.raw: And with the two wings from their shoulders they covered their faces, and with the two wings which sprang from their loins they covered their feet, while the two middle wings they spread out for flying straightforward.
verses.text: And with the two wings from their shoulders they covered their faces, and with the two wings which sprang from their loins they covered their feet, while the two middle wings they spread out for flying straightforward.

verses.raw: And when they had ended the singing, they looked at one another and threatened one another.
verses.text: And when they had ended the singing, they looked at one another and threatened one another.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, when the angel who was with me saw that they were threatening each other, he left me and went running to them, and turned the countenance of each living creature from the countenance immediately confronting him, in order that they might not see their countenances threatening each other.
verses.text: And it came to pass, when the angel who was with me saw that they were threatening each other, he left me and went running to them, and turned the countenance of each living creature from the countenance immediately confronting him, in order that they might not see their countenances threatening each other.

verses.raw: And he taught them the song of peace which hath its origin in the Eternal One.
verses.text: And he taught them the song of peace which hath its origin in the Eternal One.

verses.raw: And as I stood alone and looked, I saw behind the living creatures a chariot with fiery wheels, each wheel full of eyes round about; and over the wheels was a throne, which I saw, and this was covered with fire, and fire encircled it round about, and lo, an indescribable fire environed a fiery host.
verses.text: And as I stood alone and looked, I saw behind the living creatures a chariot with fiery wheels, each wheel full of eyes round about; and over the wheels was a throne, which I saw, and this was covered with fire, and fire encircled it round about, and lo, an indescribable fire environed a fiery host.

verses.raw: And I heard its holy voice like the voice of a man.
verses.text: And I heard its holy voice like the voice of a man.

verses.raw: And a voice came to me out of the midst of the fire, saying: "Abraham, Abraham!"
verses.text: And a voice came to me out of the midst of the fire, saying: "Abraham, Abraham!"

verses.raw: I said: "Here am I!"
verses.text: I said: "Here am I!"

verses.raw: And He said: "Consider the expanses which are under the firmament on which thou art now placed, and see how on no single expanse is there any other but He whom thou hast sought, or who hath loved thee."
verses.text: And He said: "Consider the expanses which are under the firmament on which thou art now placed, and see how on no single expanse is there any other but He whom thou hast sought, or who hath loved thee."

verses.raw: And while He was yet speaking, lo, the expanses opened, and beneath me the heavens.
verses.text: And while He was yet speaking, lo, the expanses opened, and beneath me the heavens.

verses.raw: And I saw upon the seventh firmament upon which I stood a fire widely extended, and light, and dew, and a multitude of angels, and a power of invisible glory over the living creatures which I saw; but no other being did I see there.
verses.text: And I saw upon the seventh firmament upon which I stood a fire widely extended, and light, and dew, and a multitude of angels, and a power of invisible glory over the living creatures which I saw; but no other being did I see there.

verses.raw: And I looked from the mountain in which I stood downwards to the sixth firmament, and saw there a multitude of angels, of pure spirit, without bodies, who carried out the commands of the fiery angels who were upon the eighth firmament, as I was standing suspended over them.
verses.text: And I looked from the mountain in which I stood downwards to the sixth firmament, and saw there a multitude of angels, of pure spirit, without bodies, who carried out the commands of the fiery angels who were upon the eighth firmament, as I was standing suspended over them.

verses.raw: And behold, upon this firmament there were no other powers of any other form, but only angels of pure spirit, like the power which I saw on the seventh firmament.
verses.text: And behold, upon this firmament there were no other powers of any other form, but only angels of pure spirit, like the power which I saw on the seventh firmament.

verses.raw: And He commanded that the sixth firmament should be taken away.
verses.text: And He commanded that the sixth firmament should be taken away.

verses.raw: And I saw there, on the fifth firmament, the powers of the stars which carry out the commands laid upon them, and the elements of the earth obeyed them.
verses.text: And I saw there, on the fifth firmament, the powers of the stars which carry out the commands laid upon them, and the elements of the earth obeyed them.

verses.raw: And the Eternal Mighty One said to me: "Abraham, Abraham!"
verses.text: And the Eternal Mighty One said to me: "Abraham, Abraham!"

verses.raw: And I said: "Here am I."
verses.text: And I said: "Here am I."

verses.raw: And He said: "Consider from above the stars which are beneath thee, and number them for me, and make known to me their number."
verses.text: And He said: "Consider from above the stars which are beneath thee, and number them for me, and make known to me their number."

verses.raw: And I said: "When can I?
verses.text: And I said: "When can I?

verses.raw: For I am but a man of dust and ashes."
verses.text: For I am but a man of dust and ashes."

verses.raw: And He said to me: "As the number of the stars and their power, so will I make thy seed a nation and a people, set apart for me in my heritage with Azazel."
verses.text: And He said to me: "As the number of the stars and their power, so will I make thy seed a nation and a people, set apart for me in my heritage with Azazel."

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: Let thy servant speak before Thee, and let not Thine anger kindle against Thy chosen one!
verses.text: Let thy servant speak before Thee, and let not Thine anger kindle against Thy chosen one!

verses.raw: Lo, before Thou leddest me up Azazel inveighed against me.
verses.text: Lo, before Thou leddest me up Azazel inveighed against me.

verses.raw: How, then, while he is not now before Thee, hast Thou constituted Thyself with him?"
verses.text: How, then, while he is not now before Thee, hast Thou constituted Thyself with him?"

verses.raw: And He said to me: "Look, now, beneath thy feet at the firmaments, and understand the creation foreshadowed in this expanse, the creatures existing on it, and the age prepared according to it."
verses.text: And He said to me: "Look, now, beneath thy feet at the firmaments, and understand the creation foreshadowed in this expanse, the creatures existing on it, and the age prepared according to it."

verses.raw: And I saw beneath the surfaces of the feet, and I saw beneath the sixth heaven and what was therein, and then the earth and its fruits, and what moved upon it and its animate beings, and the power of its men, and the ungodliness of their souls, and their righteous deeds and the beginnings of their works, and the lower regions and the perdition therein, the Abyss and its torments.
verses.text: And I saw beneath the surfaces of the feet, and I saw beneath the sixth heaven and what was therein, and then the earth and its fruits, and what moved upon it and its animate beings, and the power of its men, and the ungodliness of their souls, and their righteous deeds and the beginnings of their works, and the lower regions and the perdition therein, the Abyss and its torments.

verses.raw: I saw there the sea and its islands, and its monsters and its fishes, and Leviathan and his dominion, and his camping-ground, and his caves, and the world which lay upon him, and his movements, and the destructions of the world on his account.
verses.text: I saw there the sea and its islands, and its monsters and its fishes, and Leviathan and his dominion, and his camping-ground, and his caves, and the world which lay upon him, and his movements, and the destructions of the world on his account.

verses.raw: I saw there streams and the rising of their waters, and their windings.
verses.text: I saw there streams and the rising of their waters, and their windings.

verses.raw: And I saw there the Garden of Eden and its fruits, the source of the stream issuing from it, and its trees and their bloom, and those who behaved righteously.
verses.text: And I saw there the Garden of Eden and its fruits, the source of the stream issuing from it, and its trees and their bloom, and those who behaved righteously.

verses.raw: And I saw therein their foods and blessedness.
verses.text: And I saw therein their foods and blessedness.

verses.raw: And I saw there a great multitude — men and women and children, half of them on the right side of the picture, and half of them on the left side of the picture.
verses.text: And I saw there a great multitude — men and women and children, half of them on the right side of the picture, and half of them on the left side of the picture.

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: What is this picture of the creatures?"
verses.text: What is this picture of the creatures?"

verses.raw: And He said to me: "This is my will with regard to those who exist in the divine world-counsel, and it seemed well-pleasing before my sight, and then afterwards I gave commandment to them through my Word.
verses.text: And He said to me: "This is my will with regard to those who exist in the divine world-counsel, and it seemed well-pleasing before my sight, and then afterwards I gave commandment to them through my Word.

verses.raw: And it came to pass, whatever I had determined to be, was already planned beforehand in this picture, and it stood before me ere it was created, as thou hast seen."
verses.text: And it came to pass, whatever I had determined to be, was already planned beforehand in this picture, and it stood before me ere it was created, as thou hast seen."

verses.raw: And I said: "O Yahuah (Lord), mighty and eternal!
verses.text: And I said: "O Yahuah, mighty and eternal!

verses.raw: Who are the people in this picture on this side and on that?"
verses.text: Who are the people in this picture on this side and on that?"

verses.raw: And He said to me: "These which are on the left side are the multitude of the peoples which have formerly been in existence, and which are after thee destined, some for judgement and restoration, and others for vengeance and destruction at the end of the world.
verses.text: And He said to me: "These which are on the left side are the multitude of the peoples which have formerly been in existence, and which are after thee destined, some for judgement and restoration, and others for vengeance and destruction at the end of the world.

verses.raw: But these which are on the right side of the picture — they are the people set apart for me of the peoples with Azazel.
verses.text: But these which are on the right side of the picture — they are the people set apart for me of the peoples with Azazel.

verses.raw: These are they whom I have ordained to be born of thee and to be called My People."
verses.text: These are they whom I have ordained to be born of thee and to be called My People."

verses.raw: "Now look again in the picture, who it is who seduced Eve and what is the fruit of the tree, and thou wilt know what there shall be, and how it shall be to thy seed among the people at the end of the days of the age, and so far as thou canst not understand I will make known to thee, for thou art well-pleasing in my sight, and I will tell thee what is kept in my heart."
verses.text: "Now look again in the picture, who it is who seduced Eve and what is the fruit of the tree, and thou wilt know what there shall be, and how it shall be to thy seed among the people at the end of the days of the age, and so far as thou canst not understand I will make known to thee, for thou art well-pleasing in my sight, and I will tell thee what is kept in my heart."

verses.raw: And I looked into the picture, and mine eyes ran to the side of the Garden of Eden.
verses.text: And I looked into the picture, and mine eyes ran to the side of the Garden of Eden.

verses.raw: And I saw there a man very great in height and fearful in breadth, incomparable in aspect, embracing a woman, who likewise approximated to the aspect and shape of the man.
verses.text: And I saw there a man very great in height and fearful in breadth, incomparable in aspect, embracing a woman, who likewise approximated to the aspect and shape of the man.

verses.raw: And they were standing under a tree of the Garden of Eden, and the fruit of this tree was like the appearance of a bunch of grapes of the vine, and behind the tree was standing as it were a serpent in form, having hands and feet like a man's, and wings on its shoulders, six on the right side and six on the left, and they were holding the grapes of the tree in their hands, and both were eating it whom I had seen embracing.
verses.text: And they were standing under a tree of the Garden of Eden, and the fruit of this tree was like the appearance of a bunch of grapes of the vine, and behind the tree was standing as it were a serpent in form, having hands and feet like a man's, and wings on its shoulders, six on the right side and six on the left, and they were holding the grapes of the tree in their hands, and both were eating it whom I had seen embracing.

verses.raw: And I said: "Who are these mutually embracing, or who is this who is between them, or what is the fruit which they are eating, O Mighty Eternal One?"
verses.text: And I said: "Who are these mutually embracing, or who is this who is between them, or what is the fruit which they are eating, O Mighty Eternal One?"

verses.raw: And He said: "This is the human world, this is Adam, and this is their desire upon the earth, this is Eve; but he who is between them representeth ungodliness, their beginning on the way to perdition, even Azazel."
verses.text: And He said: "This is the human world, this is Adam, and this is their desire upon the earth, this is Eve; but he who is between them representeth ungodliness, their beginning on the way to perdition, even Azazel."

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: Why hast Thou given to such power to destroy the generation of men in their works upon the earth?"
verses.text: Why hast Thou given to such power to destroy the generation of men in their works upon the earth?"

verses.raw: And He said to me: "They who will to do evil — and how much I hated it in those who do it! — over them I gave him power, and to be beloved of them."
verses.text: And He said to me: "They who will to do evil — and how much I hated it in those who do it! — over them I gave him power, and to be beloved of them."

verses.raw: And I answered and said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I answered and said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: Wherefore hast Thou willed to effect that evil should be desired in the hearts of men, since Thou indeed art angered over that which was willed by Thee, at him who is doing what is unprofitable in thy counsel?"
verses.text: Wherefore hast Thou willed to effect that evil should be desired in the hearts of men, since Thou indeed art angered over that which was willed by Thee, at him who is doing what is unprofitable in thy counsel?"

verses.raw: And He said to me: "Being angered at the nations on thy account, and on account of the people of thy family who are to be separated after thee, as thou seest in the picture the burden of destiny that is laid upon them — and I will tell thee what shall be, and how much shall be, in the last days.
verses.text: And He said to me: "Being angered at the nations on thy account, and on account of the people of thy family who are to be separated after thee, as thou seest in the picture the burden of destiny that is laid upon them — and I will tell thee what shall be, and how much shall be, in the last days.

verses.raw: Look now at everything in the picture."
verses.text: Look now at everything in the picture."

verses.raw: And I looked and saw there what was before me in creation: I saw Adam, and Eve existing with him, and with them the cunning Adversary, and Cain who acted lawlessly through the Adversary, and the slaughtered Abel, and the destruction brought and caused upon him through the lawless one.
verses.text: And I looked and saw there what was before me in creation: I saw Adam, and Eve existing with him, and with them the cunning Adversary, and Cain who acted lawlessly through the Adversary, and the slaughtered Abel, and the destruction brought and caused upon him through the lawless one.

verses.raw: I saw there also Impurity, and those who lust after it, and its pollution, and their jealousy, and the fire of their corruption in the lowest parts of the earth.
verses.text: I saw there also Impurity, and those who lust after it, and its pollution, and their jealousy, and the fire of their corruption in the lowest parts of the earth.

verses.raw: I saw there Theft, and those who hasten after it, and the arrangement of their retribution, the judgement of the Great Assize.
verses.text: I saw there Theft, and those who hasten after it, and the arrangement of their retribution, the judgement of the Great Assize.

verses.raw: I saw there naked men, the foreheads against each other, and their disgrace, and their passion which they had against each other, and their retribution.
verses.text: I saw there naked men, the foreheads against each other, and their disgrace, and their passion which they had against each other, and their retribution.

verses.raw: I saw there Desire, and in her hand the head of every kind of lawlessness, and her scorn and her waste assigned to perdition.
verses.text: I saw there Desire, and in her hand the head of every kind of lawlessness, and her scorn and her waste assigned to perdition.

verses.raw: I saw there the likeness of the idol of jealousy, having the likeness of woodwork such as my father was wont to make, and its statue was of glittering bronze; and before it a man, and he worshipped it; and in front of him an altar, and upon it a boy slain in the presence of the idol.
verses.text: I saw there the likeness of the idol of jealousy, having the likeness of woodwork such as my father was wont to make, and its statue was of glittering bronze; and before it a man, and he worshipped it; and in front of him an altar, and upon it a boy slain in the presence of the idol.

verses.raw: But I said to Him: "What is this idol, or what is the altar, or who are they that are sacrificed, or who is the sacrificer?
verses.text: But I said to Him: "What is this idol, or what is the altar, or who are they that are sacrificed, or who is the sacrificer?

verses.raw: Or what is the Temple which I see that is beautiful in art, and its beauty being like the glory that lieth beneath Thy throne?"
verses.text: Or what is the Temple which I see that is beautiful in art, and its beauty being like the glory that lieth beneath Thy throne?"

verses.raw: And He said: "Hear, Abraham.
verses.text: And He said: "Hear, Abraham.

verses.raw: This which thou seest, the Temple and altar and beauty, is my idea of the priesthood of my glorious Name, in which dwelleth every single prayer of man, and the rise of kings and prophets, and whatever sacrifice I ordain to be offered to me among my people who are to come out of thy generation.
verses.text: This which thou seest, the Temple and altar and beauty, is my idea of the priesthood of my glorious Name, in which dwelleth every single prayer of man, and the rise of kings and prophets, and whatever sacrifice I ordain to be offered to me among my people who are to come out of thy generation.

verses.raw: But the statue which thou sawest is mine anger, wherewith the people anger me who are to proceed for me from thee.
verses.text: But the statue which thou sawest is mine anger, wherewith the people anger me who are to proceed for me from thee.

verses.raw: But the man whom thou sawest slaughtering — that is he who inciteth murderous sacrifices, which are a witness to me of the final judgement, even at the beginning of creation."
verses.text: But the man whom thou sawest slaughtering — that is he who inciteth murderous sacrifices, which are a witness to me of the final judgement, even at the beginning of creation."

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: Wherefore hast Thou established that it should be so, and then proclaim the knowledge thereof?"
verses.text: Wherefore hast Thou established that it should be so, and then proclaim the knowledge thereof?"

verses.raw: And He said to me: "Hear, Abraham; understand what I say to thee, and answer me as I question thee.
verses.text: And He said to me: "Hear, Abraham; understand what I say to thee, and answer me as I question thee.

verses.raw: Why did thy father Terah not listen to thy voice, and why did he not cease from the devilish idolatry until he perished, and his whole household with him?"
verses.text: Why did thy father Terah not listen to thy voice, and why did he not cease from the devilish idolatry until he perished, and his whole household with him?"

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: It was entirely because he did not choose to listen to me; but I, too, did not follow his works."
verses.text: It was entirely because he did not choose to listen to me; but I, too, did not follow his works."

verses.raw: And He said to me: "Hear, Abraham.
verses.text: And He said to me: "Hear, Abraham.

verses.raw: As the counsel of thy father is in him, and as thy counsel is in thee, so also is the counsel of my will in me ready for the coming days, before thou hast knowledge of these, or canst see with thine eyes what is future in them.
verses.text: As the counsel of thy father is in him, and as thy counsel is in thee, so also is the counsel of my will in me ready for the coming days, before thou hast knowledge of these, or canst see with thine eyes what is future in them.

verses.raw: How those of thy seed will be, look in the picture."
verses.text: How those of thy seed will be, look in the picture."

verses.raw: And I looked and saw: lo, the picture swayed, and from it emerged, on its left side, a heathen people, and they pillaged those who were on the right side, men and women and children: some they slaughtered, others they retained with themselves.
verses.text: And I looked and saw: lo, the picture swayed, and from it emerged, on its left side, a heathen people, and they pillaged those who were on the right side, men and women and children: some they slaughtered, others they retained with themselves.

verses.raw: Lo, I saw them run towards them through four entrances, and they burnt the Temple with fire, and the holy things that were therein they plundered.
verses.text: Lo, I saw them run towards them through four entrances, and they burnt the Temple with fire, and the holy things that were therein they plundered.

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal One!

verses.raw: Lo, the people that spring from me, whom Thou hast accepted, the hordes of the heathen do plunder, and some they kill, while others they hold fast as aliens, and the Temple they have burnt with fire, and the beautiful things therein they do rob and destroy.
verses.text: Lo, the people that spring from me, whom Thou hast accepted, the hordes of the heathen do plunder, and some they kill, while others they hold fast as aliens, and the Temple they have burnt with fire, and the beautiful things therein they do rob and destroy.

verses.raw: O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: If this be so, wherefore hast Thou now lacerated my heart, and why should this be so?"
verses.text: If this be so, wherefore hast Thou now lacerated my heart, and why should this be so?"

verses.raw: And He said to me: "Hear, Abraham.
verses.text: And He said to me: "Hear, Abraham.

verses.raw: What thou hast seen shall happen on account of thy seed who anger me by reason of the statue which thou sawest, and on account of the human slaughter in the picture, through zeal in the Temple; and as thou sawest, so shall it be."
verses.text: What thou hast seen shall happen on account of thy seed who anger me by reason of the statue which thou sawest, and on account of the human slaughter in the picture, through zeal in the Temple; and as thou sawest, so shall it be."

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: May the works of evil wrought in ungodliness now pass by, but rather show me those who fulfilled the commandments, even the works of his righteousness.
verses.text: May the works of evil wrought in ungodliness now pass by, but rather show me those who fulfilled the commandments, even the works of his righteousness.

verses.raw: For thou canst do this."
verses.text: For thou canst do this."

verses.raw: And He said to me: "The time of the righteous meeteth them first through the holiness flowing from kings and righteous-dealing rulers whom I at first created in order, from such to rule among them.
verses.text: And He said to me: "The time of the righteous meeteth them first through the holiness flowing from kings and righteous-dealing rulers whom I at first created in order, from such to rule among them.

verses.raw: But from these issue men who care for their interests, as I have made known to thee and thou hast seen."
verses.text: But from these issue men who care for their interests, as I have made known to thee and thou hast seen."

verses.raw: And I answered and said: "Mighty, Eternal One, hallowed by Thy power!
verses.text: And I answered and said: "Mighty, Eternal One, hallowed by Thy power!

verses.raw: Be favourable to my petition, for for this hast Thou brought me up here and shew me.
verses.text: Be favourable to my petition, for for this hast Thou brought me up here and shew me.

verses.raw: As Thou hast brought me up to Thy height, so make this known to me, Thy beloved one, as much as I ask whether what I saw shall happen to them for long?"
verses.text: As Thou hast brought me up to Thy height, so make this known to me, Thy beloved one, as much as I ask whether what I saw shall happen to them for long?"

verses.raw: And He showed me a multitude of His people, and said to me: "On their account, through four issues, as thou sawest, I shall be provoked by them, and in these my retribution for their deeds shall be accomplished.
verses.text: And He showed me a multitude of His people, and said to me: "On their account, through four issues, as thou sawest, I shall be provoked by them, and in these my retribution for their deeds shall be accomplished.

verses.raw: But in the fourth outgoing of a hundred years and one hour of the age — the same is a hundred years — it shall be in misfortune among the heathen, but one hour in mercy and contumely, as among the heathen."
verses.text: But in the fourth outgoing of a hundred years and one hour of the age — the same is a hundred years — it shall be in misfortune among the heathen, but one hour in mercy and contumely, as among the heathen."

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: And how long a time is an hour of the Age?"
verses.text: And how long a time is an hour of the Age?"

verses.raw: And He said: "Twelve years have I ordained of this ungodly Age to rule among the heathen and in thy seed; and until the end of the times it shall be as thou sawest.
verses.text: And He said: "Twelve years have I ordained of this ungodly Age to rule among the heathen and in thy seed; and until the end of the times it shall be as thou sawest.

verses.raw: And do thou reckon and understand and look into the picture."
verses.text: And do thou reckon and understand and look into the picture."

verses.raw: And I looked and saw a man going out from the left side of the heathen; and there went out men and women and children, from the side of the heathen, many hosts, and worshipped him.
verses.text: And I looked and saw a man going out from the left side of the heathen; and there went out men and women and children, from the side of the heathen, many hosts, and worshipped him.

verses.raw: And while I still looked, there came out from the right side many, and some insulted that man, while some struck him; others, however, worshipped him.
verses.text: And while I still looked, there came out from the right side many, and some insulted that man, while some struck him; others, however, worshipped him.

verses.raw: And I saw how these worshipped him, and Azazel ran and worshipped him, and, having kissed his face, he turned and stood behind him.
verses.text: And I saw how these worshipped him, and Azazel ran and worshipped him, and, having kissed his face, he turned and stood behind him.

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One!

verses.raw: Who is the man insulted and beaten, who is worshipped by the heathen with Azazel?"
verses.text: Who is the man insulted and beaten, who is worshipped by the heathen with Azazel?"

verses.raw: And He answered and said: "Hear, Abraham!
verses.text: And He answered and said: "Hear, Abraham!

verses.raw: The man whom thou sawest insulted and beaten and again worshipped — that is the relief granted by the heathen to the people who proceed from thee, in the last days, in this twelfth hour of the Age of ungodliness.
verses.text: The man whom thou sawest insulted and beaten and again worshipped — that is the relief granted by the heathen to the people who proceed from thee, in the last days, in this twelfth hour of the Age of ungodliness.

verses.raw: But in the twelfth year of my final Age I will set up this man from thy generation, whom thou sawest issue from my people; this one all will follow, and such as are called by me will join, even those who change in their counsels.
verses.text: But in the twelfth year of my final Age I will set up this man from thy generation, whom thou sawest issue from my people; this one all will follow, and such as are called by me will join, even those who change in their counsels.

verses.raw: And those whom thou sawest emerge from the left side of the picture — the meaning is: there shall be many from the heathen who set their hopes upon him; and as for those whom thou sawest from thy seed on the right side, some insulting and striking, others worshipping him — many of them shall be offended at him.
verses.text: And those whom thou sawest emerge from the left side of the picture — the meaning is: there shall be many from the heathen who set their hopes upon him; and as for those whom thou sawest from thy seed on the right side, some insulting and striking, others worshipping him — many of them shall be offended at him.

verses.raw: He, however, is testing those who have worshipped him of thy seed, in that twelfth hour of the End, with a view to shortening the Age of ungodliness.
verses.text: He, however, is testing those who have worshipped him of thy seed, in that twelfth hour of the End, with a view to shortening the Age of ungodliness.

verses.raw: Before the Age of the righteous beginneth to grow, my judgement shall come upon the lawless heathen through the people of thy seed who have been separated for me.
verses.text: Before the Age of the righteous beginneth to grow, my judgement shall come upon the lawless heathen through the people of thy seed who have been separated for me.

verses.raw: In those days I will bring upon all creatures of the earth ten plagues, through misfortune and disease and sighing of the grief of their soul.
verses.text: In those days I will bring upon all creatures of the earth ten plagues, through misfortune and disease and sighing of the grief of their soul.

verses.raw: Thus much will I bring upon the generations of men that be upon it, on account of the provocation and the corruption of its creatures, whereby they provoke me.
verses.text: Thus much will I bring upon the generations of men that be upon it, on account of the provocation and the corruption of its creatures, whereby they provoke me.

verses.raw: And then shall righteous men of thy seed be left, in the number which is kept secret by me, hastening in the glory of My Name to the place prepared beforehand for them, which thou sawest devastated in the picture; and they shall live and be established through sacrifices and gifts of righteousness and truth in the Age of the righteous, and shall rejoice in Me continually; and they shall destroy those who have destroyed them, and shall insult those who have insulted them.
verses.text: And then shall righteous men of thy seed be left, in the number which is kept secret by me, hastening in the glory of My Name to the place prepared beforehand for them, which thou sawest devastated in the picture; and they shall live and be established through sacrifices and gifts of righteousness and truth in the Age of the righteous, and shall rejoice in Me continually; and they shall destroy those who have destroyed them, and shall insult those who have insulted them.

verses.raw: And of those who defamed them they shall spit in the face, scorned by Me, while they, the righteous, shall behold Me full of joy, rejoicing with My people, and receiving those who return to Me in repentance.
verses.text: And of those who defamed them they shall spit in the face, scorned by Me, while they, the righteous, shall behold Me full of joy, rejoicing with My people, and receiving those who return to Me in repentance.

verses.raw: See, Abraham, what thou hast seen, and hear what thou hast heard, and take full knowledge of what thou hast come to know.
verses.text: See, Abraham, what thou hast seen, and hear what thou hast heard, and take full knowledge of what thou hast come to know.

verses.raw: Go to thy heritage, and lo, I am with you for ever."
verses.text: Go to thy heritage, and lo, I am with you for ever."

verses.raw: But while He was still speaking, I found myself upon the earth.
verses.text: But while He was still speaking, I found myself upon the earth.

verses.raw: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One, I am no longer in the glory in which I was while on high, and what my soul longed to understand in mine heart I do not understand."
verses.text: And I said: "O Eternal, Mighty One, I am no longer in the glory in which I was while on high, and what my soul longed to understand in mine heart I do not understand."

verses.raw: And He said to me: "What is desired in thine heart I will tell thee, because thou hast sought to see the ten plagues which I have prepared for the heathen, and have prepared beforehand at the passing over of the twelfth hour of the earth.
verses.text: And He said to me: "What is desired in thine heart I will tell thee, because thou hast sought to see the ten plagues which I have prepared for the heathen, and have prepared beforehand at the passing over of the twelfth hour of the earth.

verses.raw: Hear what I divulge to thee, so shall it come to pass: the first is pain of great distress; the second, conflagration of many cities; the third, destruction and pestilence of animals; the fourth, hunger of the whole world and of its people; the fifth, by destruction among its rulers, destruction by earthquake and the sword; the sixth, multiplication of hail and snow; the seventh, the wild beasts will be their grave; the eighth, hunger and pestilence will alternate with their destruction; the ninth, punishment by the sword and flight in distress; the tenth, thunder and voices and destructive earthquake."
verses.text: Hear what I divulge to thee, so shall it come to pass: the first is pain of great distress; the second, conflagration of many cities; the third, destruction and pestilence of animals; the fourth, hunger of the whole world and of its people; the fifth, by destruction among its rulers, destruction by earthquake and the sword; the sixth, multiplication of hail and snow; the seventh, the wild beasts will be their grave; the eighth, hunger and pestilence will alternate with their destruction; the ninth, punishment by the sword and flight in distress; the tenth, thunder and voices and destructive earthquake."

verses.raw: "And then I will sound the trumpet out of the air, and will send mine Elect One, having in him all my power, one measure; and this one shall summon my despised people from the nations, and I will burn with fire those who have insulted them and who have ruled among them in this Age.
verses.text: "And then I will sound the trumpet out of the air, and will send mine Elect One, having in him all my power, one measure; and this one shall summon my despised people from the nations, and I will burn with fire those who have insulted them and who have ruled among them in this Age.

verses.raw: And I will give those who have covered me with mockery to the scorn of the coming Age; and I have prepared them to be food for the fire of Hades, and for ceaseless flight to and fro through the air in the underworld beneath the earth, the body filled with worms.
verses.text: And I will give those who have covered me with mockery to the scorn of the coming Age; and I have prepared them to be food for the fire of Hades, and for ceaseless flight to and fro through the air in the underworld beneath the earth, the body filled with worms.

verses.raw: For on them shall they see the righteousness of the Creator — those, namely, who have chosen to do my will, and those who have openly kept my commandments; and they shall rejoice with joy over the downfall of the men who still remain, who have followed the idols and their murders.
verses.text: For on them shall they see the righteousness of the Creator — those, namely, who have chosen to do my will, and those who have openly kept my commandments; and they shall rejoice with joy over the downfall of the men who still remain, who have followed the idols and their murders.

verses.raw: For they shall putrefy in the body of the evil worm Azazel, and be burnt with the fire of Azazel's tongue; for I hoped that they would come to me, and not have loved and praised the strange god, and not have adhered to him for whom they were not allotted, but instead they have forsaken the mighty Yahuah (Lord)."
verses.text: For they shall putrefy in the body of the evil worm Azazel, and be burnt with the fire of Azazel's tongue; for I hoped that they would come to me, and not have loved and praised the strange god, and not have adhered to him for whom they were not allotted, but instead they have forsaken the mighty Yahuah."

verses.raw: "Therefore hear, O Abraham, and see; lo, thy seventh generation shall go with thee, and they shall go out into a strange land, and they shall enslave them, and evil-intreat them as it were an hour of the Age of ungodliness; but the nation whom they shall serve I will judge."
verses.text: "Therefore hear, O Abraham, and see; lo, thy seventh generation shall go with thee, and they shall go out into a strange land, and they shall enslave them, and evil-intreat them as it were an hour of the Age of ungodliness; but the nation whom they shall serve I will judge."

verses.raw: And Paul, full of the blessings of Messiah (Christ), and abounding in the spirit, departed out of Rome, determining to go into Spain, for he had a long time purposed to journey thitherward, and was minded also to go from thence into Britain.
verses.text: And Paul, full of the blessings of Messiah, and abounding in the spirit, departed out of Rome, determining to go into Spain, for he had a long time purposed to journey thitherward, and was minded also to go from thence into Britain.

verses.raw: For he had heard in Phoenicia that certain of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), about the time of the Assyrian captivity, had escaped by sea to "the isles afar off," as spoken by the prophet, and called by the Romans, Britain.
verses.text: For he had heard in Phoenicia that certain of the children of Yashar'el, about the time of the Assyrian captivity, had escaped by sea to "the isles afar off," as spoken by the prophet, and called by the Romans, Britain.

verses.raw: And Yahuah (Lord) commanded the gospel to be preached far hence to the Gentiles, and to the lost sheep of the House of Yashar'el (Israel).
verses.text: And Yahuah commanded the gospel to be preached far hence to the Gentiles, and to the lost sheep of the House of Yashar'el.

verses.raw: And no man hindered Paul; for he testified boldly of Yahusha (Jesus) before the tribunes and among the people; and he took with him certain of the brethren which abode with him at Rome, and they took shipping at Ostium, and having the winds fair were brought safely into an haven of Spain.
verses.text: And no man hindered Paul; for he testified boldly of Yahusha before the tribunes and among the people; and he took with him certain of the brethren which abode with him at Rome, and they took shipping at Ostium, and having the winds fair were brought safely into an haven of Spain.

verses.raw: And much people were gathered together from the towns and villages and the hill country; for they had heard of the conversion of the apostle, and the many miracles which he had wrought.
verses.text: And much people were gathered together from the towns and villages and the hill country; for they had heard of the conversion of the apostle, and the many miracles which he had wrought.

verses.raw: And Paul preached mightily in Spain, and great multitudes believed and were converted, for they perceived he was an apostle sent from Elohim (God).
verses.text: And Paul preached mightily in Spain, and great multitudes believed and were converted, for they perceived he was an apostle sent from Elohim.

verses.raw: And they departed out of Spain, and Paul and his company finding a ship in Armorica sailing unto Britain, they went therein, and passing along the South coast they reached a port called Raphinus.
verses.text: And they departed out of Spain, and Paul and his company finding a ship in Armorica sailing unto Britain, they went therein, and passing along the South coast they reached a port called Raphinus.

verses.raw: Now when it was noised abroad that the apostle had landed on their coast, great multitudes of the inhabitants met him, and they treated Paul courteously, and he entered in at the east gate of their city, and lodged in the house of an Hebrew and one of his own nation.
verses.text: Now when it was noised abroad that the apostle had landed on their coast, great multitudes of the inhabitants met him, and they treated Paul courteously, and he entered in at the east gate of their city, and lodged in the house of an Hebrew and one of his own nation.

verses.raw: And on the morrow he came and stood upon Mount Lud; and the people thronged at the gate, and assembled in the Broadway, and he preached Messiah (Christ) unto them, and many believed the word and the testimony of Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And on the morrow he came and stood upon Mount Lud; and the people thronged at the gate, and assembled in the Broadway, and he preached Messiah unto them, and many believed the word and the testimony of Yahusha.

verses.raw: And at even the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) fell upon Paul, and he prophesied, saying, Behold in the last days the Elohim (God) of Peace shall dwell in the cities, and the inhabitants thereof shall be numbered; and in the seventh numbering of the people, their eyes shall be opened, and the glory of their inheritance shine forth before them. And nations shall come up to worship on the Mount that testifieth of the patience and long suffering of a servant of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.text: And at even the Ruach HaKodesh fell upon Paul, and he prophesied, saying, Behold in the last days the Elohim of Peace shall dwell in the cities, and the inhabitants thereof shall be numbered; and in the seventh numbering of the people, their eyes shall be opened, and the glory of their inheritance shine forth before them. And nations shall come up to worship on the Mount that testifieth of the patience and long suffering of a servant of Yahuah.

verses.raw: And in the latter days new tidings of the Gospel shall issue forth out of Jerusalem, and the hearts of the people shall rejoice, and behold, fountains shall be opened, and there shall be no more plague.
verses.text: And in the latter days new tidings of the Gospel shall issue forth out of Jerusalem, and the hearts of the people shall rejoice, and behold, fountains shall be opened, and there shall be no more plague.

verses.raw: In those days there shall be wars and rumours of wars; and a king shall rise up, and his sword shall be for the healing of the nations, and his peacemaking shall abide, and the glory of his kingdom a wonder among princes.
verses.text: In those days there shall be wars and rumours of wars; and a king shall rise up, and his sword shall be for the healing of the nations, and his peacemaking shall abide, and the glory of his kingdom a wonder among princes.

verses.raw: And it came to pass that certain of the Druids came unto Paul privately, and showed by their rites and ceremonies they were descended from the Yahudim (Jews) which escaped from bondage in the land of Egypt, and the apostle believed these things, and he gave them the kiss of peace.
verses.text: And it came to pass that certain of the Druids came unto Paul privately, and showed by their rites and ceremonies they were descended from the Yahudim which escaped from bondage in the land of Egypt, and the apostle believed these things, and he gave them the kiss of peace.

verses.raw: And Paul abode in his lodgings three months, confirming in the faith and preaching Messiah (Christ) continually.
verses.text: And Paul abode in his lodgings three months, confirming in the faith and preaching Messiah continually.

verses.raw: And after these things Paul and his brethren departed from Raphinus, and sailed unto Atium in Gaul.
verses.text: And after these things Paul and his brethren departed from Raphinus, and sailed unto Atium in Gaul.

verses.raw: And Paul preached in the Roman garrisons and among the people, exhorting all men to repent and confess their sins.
verses.text: And Paul preached in the Roman garrisons and among the people, exhorting all men to repent and confess their sins.

verses.raw: And there came to him certain of the Belgae to enquire of him of the new doctrine, and of the man Yahusha (Jesus); and Paul opened his heart unto them, and told them all things that had befallen him, how be it that HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus) came into the world to save sinners; and they departed, pondering among themselves upon the things which they had heard.
verses.text: And there came to him certain of the Belgae to enquire of him of the new doctrine, and of the man Yahusha; and Paul opened his heart unto them, and told them all things that had befallen him, how be it that HaMashiach Yahusha came into the world to save sinners; and they departed, pondering among themselves upon the things which they had heard.

verses.raw: And after much preaching and toil Paul and his fellow labourers passed into Helvetia, and came unto Mount Pontius Pilate, where he who condemned Yahuah (Lord) Yahusha (Jesus) dashed himself down headlong, and so miserably perished.
verses.text: And after much preaching and toil Paul and his fellow labourers passed into Helvetia, and came unto Mount Pontius Pilate, where he who condemned Yahuah Yahusha dashed himself down headlong, and so miserably perished.

verses.raw: And immediately a torrent gushed out of the mountain and washed his body broken to pieces into a lake.
verses.text: And immediately a torrent gushed out of the mountain and washed his body broken to pieces into a lake.

verses.raw: And Paul stretched forth his hands upon the water and prayed unto Yahuah (Lord), saying, O Yahuah Elohim (LORD God), give a sign unto all nations that here Pontius Pilate, which condemned thine only-begotten Son, plunged down headlong into the pit.
verses.text: And Paul stretched forth his hands upon the water and prayed unto Yahuah, saying, O Yahuah Elohim, give a sign unto all nations that here Pontius Pilate, which condemned thine only-begotten Son, plunged down headlong into the pit.

verses.raw: And while Paul was yet speaking, behold there came a great earthquake, and the face of the waters was changed, and the form of the lake like unto the Son of Adam hanging in an agony upon the cross.
verses.text: And while Paul was yet speaking, behold there came a great earthquake, and the face of the waters was changed, and the form of the lake like unto the Son of Adam hanging in an agony upon the cross.

verses.raw: And a voice came out of heaven saying, Even Pilate hath escaped the wrath to come, for he washed his hands before the multitude at the blood-shedding of Yahuah (Lord) Yahusha (Jesus).
verses.text: And a voice came out of heaven saying, Even Pilate hath escaped the wrath to come, for he washed his hands before the multitude at the blood-shedding of Yahuah Yahusha.

verses.raw: When, therefore, Paul and those that were with him saw the earthquake, and heard the voice of the angel, they glorified Elohim (God), and were mightily strengthened in the spirit.
verses.text: When, therefore, Paul and those that were with him saw the earthquake, and heard the voice of the angel, they glorified Elohim, and were mightily strengthened in the spirit.

verses.raw: And they journeyed and came to Mount Julius, where stood two pillars, one on the right hand and one on the left hand, erected by Caesar Augustus.
verses.text: And they journeyed and came to Mount Julius, where stood two pillars, one on the right hand and one on the left hand, erected by Caesar Augustus.

verses.raw: And Paul, filled with the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit), stood up between the two pillars, saying, Men and brethren, these stones which ye see this day shall testify of my journey hence; and verily I say, they shall remain until the outpouring of the spirit upon all nations, neither shall the way be hindered throughout all generations.
verses.text: And Paul, filled with the Ruach HaKodesh, stood up between the two pillars, saying, Men and brethren, these stones which ye see this day shall testify of my journey hence; and verily I say, they shall remain until the outpouring of the spirit upon all nations, neither shall the way be hindered throughout all generations.

verses.raw: And they went forth and came unto Illyricum, intending to go by Macedonia into Asia, and grace was found in all the churches; and they prospered and had peace. Amen.
verses.text: And they went forth and came unto Illyricum, intending to go by Macedonia into Asia, and grace was found in all the churches; and they prospered and had peace. Amen.
